chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Goddess Around Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 1: The Goddess Around Me
Early morning, Lin Yi slowly woke up.
The outside light was bright, and it was already well past sunrise.
He expertly threw off the covers, intending to get out of bed.
But Lin Yi was startled because he suddenly found a jade arm resting on his chest.
This slender arm was like white jade, flawless and perfect.
The delicate skin against Lin Yi’s body felt like the world’s most exquisite silk, its cool touch sending his imagination running wild.
After a brief stupor, Lin Yi jumped out of bed.
His mind was in chaos, somewhat at a loss.
Rubbing his temples forcefully, Lin Yi finally remembered last night’s events.
“Damn it, drunk and disorderly, what am I going to do now?”
Lin Yi’s mind raced, he had only gone to the bar to drown his sorrows after a breakup last night.
But once he started drinking, he couldn’t stop, and he vaguely remembered he was so drunk he couldn’t even walk properly.
It was a kindhearted girl who helped him to a nearby hotel to stay.
After that, he couldn’t remember anything, and the woman lying in the bed before him was most likely the girl who had helped him.
What on earth had he done?
Lin Yi looked at himself, completely naked.
And the woman on the bed seemed to be without her undergarments as well.
Just a little thought, and Lin Yi roughly had an answer.
Feeling guilty, he carefully searched the bed for his clothes.
After covering himself briefly, Lin Yi found his trousers pressed under the woman’s lower leg.
Helplessly, he carefully held the woman’s ankle, planning to lift it so he could retrieve his trousers.
As his hand held the woman’s ankle, feeling its springy touch, he couldn’t help but let his thoughts wander again.
“Sinful, sinful,” Lin Yi chanted in his mind as he quickly pulled out his trousers.
Before he had time to put down the woman’s ankle, she was awakened by Lin Yi’s actions from her sleep.
Three seconds later, a scream sharp enough to pierce eardrums rang out.
Lin Yi looked towards the woman on the bed in panic; she had already retreated under the covers, leaving only her large eyes flickering with fear as they scanned the surroundings.
Lin Yi hurriedly put on his trousers. Extending his hand awkwardly, he tried to soothe the woman’s emotions.
“Beautiful, don’t yell, let’s talk this over,” he said.
Right then, Lin Yi could feel aches all over his body.
It was evident that he had indeed overexerted himself last night.
It was unfortunate for this woman, who had kindly helped him only to be taken advantage of by him…
“Sigh!” Lin Yi sighed, wanting to take responsibility for this woman.
The woman rustled as she dressed under the covers, and finally, her face came into view before Lin Yi.
The moment her face was revealed, Lin Yi, who had a bunch to say, was suddenly speechless.
What kind of face was this?!
Fair skin with a hint of blush, a pair of eyes that looked pitiful and at the same time revealed toughness.
Below the eyes was a small and refined nose.
Below the nose were soft, beautiful lips that didn’t lack definition.
Only at this moment, the lipstick on her mouth was smeared a bit messily.
Stray wisps of hair on her forehead were messily spread out, which instead of making her look unkempt, gave off a lazy vibe.
“Are you still looking, turn around!” she exclaimed.
The woman’s angry voice startled Lin Yi from his daze.
“Okay, okay, I’m turning around now,” Lin Yi quickly complied, fearing the woman might be further agitated.
The woman behind him was getting dressed, and Lin Yi sighed as he explained, “About last night, it wasn’t intentional, but don’t worry, I’ll take responsibility.”
That was his true inner thought, after all, he was a man.
Having made a mistake in a moment of impulse the night before, he had to take responsibility for his actions.
However, as soon as he finished speaking, the woman’s voice came through like a startled oriole.
“Last night? Just pretend nothing happened! We’re all adults here, you don’t need to play the good, responsible man act.”
Lin Yi was stunned,”Uh…”
The woman’s words left him speechless.
He hadn’t expected the seemingly frail woman to utter such strong words.
Lin Yi thought for a moment, realizing that his own thoughts were indeed naive, as both of them had acted on impulse the night before.
Neither party knew each other, so how could they possibly get along right away?
Even if the two were to pay for their impulsiveness by starting a relationship, such a malformed romance was unlikely to last.
From this perspective, the woman’s thinking was much more mature than Lin Yi’s.
Lin Yi continued, “So, see, do you need me to do anything for you?”
He genuinely wanted to make amends, but he couldn’t think of an appropriate way to do so.
“Compensation? Do you think that will help?” her words made Lin Yi feel somewhat uncomfortable.
“I’m leaving, let’s pretend last night never happened!”
After saying this, the woman headed towards the room’s door.
Lin Yi felt a bit of discomfort, yet he didn’t quite dare to face the woman directly.
The sound of the door opening echoed, but the woman didn’t leave right away.
“You, turn your head!” the woman’s voice reached Lin Yi’s ears.
Lin Yi’s body tensed, and he slowly turned his head.
The woman’s eyes were sharp as knives, deeply embedding Lin Yi’s image into her memory.
Then she slammed the door and left.
Lin Yi’s tensed nerves relaxed, “What on earth is all this!”
As he searched the bed for his belongings, the moment he lifted the covers, Lin Yi’s hand froze. He wasn’t foolish, he understood.
“Damn, I’ve made a huge mistake,” Lin Yi felt endless compassion for the woman.
“No, I can’t just let her go like this. I wonder if last night’s bar surveillance caught her face.”
Last night, Lin Yi had gone to the bar alone to drown his sorrows.
The reason was rather melodramatic, his recently ex-girlfriend had taken up with a rich man, and he had walked in on them.
She had broken up with him because of rumors that Lin Yi’s father’s company was about to go bankrupt, prompting her to end things quickly.
But in fact, Lin Yi’s father did face a cash flow problem, which was resolved fairly soon after.
Yet Lin Yi couldn’t understand how his ex-girlfriend, who he was still upset about breaking up with, could have found someone else so quickly.
His serious girlfriend turned out to be so mercenary, inevitably leaving Lin Yi heartbroken.
It was just one trip to the bar to drown his sorrows that unintentionally led to a one-night stand.
While Lin Yi was rummaging for his belongings, he suddenly spotted a student ID.
The ID wasn’t his, it belonged to the woman who had just left.
“She’s a university student too?”
Lin Yi was pleasantly surprised by the student ID. With this in hand, he wouldn’t worry about not being able to find her!

chapters.title: Chapter 2 - 2 Triplets
chapters.content:
Chapter 2: Chapter 2 Triplets
“`
Picking up the student ID, Lin Yi looked at it carefully and found out that the other person was actually from the same university as himself!
“A senior in the Art Department, Han Xuewei?” Lin Yi murmured to himself.
He had heard this name many times before.
Because Han Xuewei was the recognized campus belle of their university!
It never crossed his mind that the campus belle, the dream girl of tens of thousands, had just lost her virginity the night before.
And to him, of all people?!!
Lin Yi felt as if he were dreaming.
Even though Lin Yi himself was quite handsome, whenever he was compared to the campus belle, he couldn’t help feeling somewhat inferior.
Because Han Xuewei’s beauty was not that of flashy aesthetic, but rather one with a transcendent quality.
Even when she walked towards someone, she emanated a sense of distance that made one dare not defile her.
Lin Yi had never imagined that a mistake he made unwittingly had led to a night of intimacy with Han Xuewei.
Soon, Lin Yi saw a line of small print on the back of the student ID.
“If found, please call: 135********”
A wave of excitement washed over Lin Yi, as it seemed he had found Han Xuewei’s phone number.
He took out his mobile phone, but hesitated for a moment and didn’t dial the number right away.
Instead, he opened WeChat, searched for the WeChat account linked to the phone number.
After clicking to add as a friend, he sent the request and then Lin Yi waited for her to accept his friend request.
But by the afternoon, Han Xuewei still hadn’t accepted his friend request.
Out of options, Lin Yi explained his intent and tried sending the friend request again.
“I found your student ID.”
This time, it wasn’t long before Han Xuewei accepted his friend request.
Lin Yi quickly typed a message: “I’m really sorry, where are you? I can bring your student ID to you.”
The chat window showed that the other party was typing…
Lin Yi felt a bit nervous inside, as he also wanted to see Han Xuewei again.
However, a moment later, Han Xuewei’s message came back.
“Leave your student ID before 6 o’clock tonight on the bench under the third trash bin on the right side of the school’s main gate. I will come to get it, let’s not meet again.”
Reading the message from Han Xuewei, Lin Yi’s heart sank.
But if the belle didn’t want to see him, he had no right to insist.
Following her instructions, he left the student ID in the specified spot, then Lin Yi resumed his normal life.
Time flew by quickly, and in the blink of an eye three months had passed.
Winter break was just around the corner, and Lin Yi knew that after this winter break, their college life would basically be reduced to internships.
It wouldn’t be long before all these senior students stepped into society.
That day, in the city’s maternity hospital, Han Xuewei was holding a B-ultrasound report with a pale face.
In her other hand, she also held a medical report.
In her mind, Han Xuewei was still replaying the doctor’s congratulations.
“Congratulations, congratulations, you are pregnant, and it’s triplets at that! This is quite rare!”
Without realizing it, tears began to slide down the corners of Han Xuewei’s eyes.
She never expected such an outcome; originally, she just wanted one night of madness with the person she fancied.
But she had never thought that she’d end up pregnant, and with the rare occurrence of triplets at that!
“`
The cold reality left Han Xuewei feeling panicky and disordered.
According to the doctor, she had already missed the optimal window for an abortion, and forcing it now could likely affect her ability to bear children in the future.
What should she do now? Should she keep the baby?
She didn’t dare tell her family about it, yet she couldn’t handle it on her own anymore.
Unable to stay calm any longer, overwhelmed by helplessness and despair, her hands trembling, she took out her phone.
Han Xuewei, her face pale, dialed Lin Yi’s number.
“Lin Yi, do you have time right now?”
Once the call connected, Han Xuewei couldn’t hold back her tears any longer, and she started to sob uncontrollably.
Upon hearing Han Xuewei’s crying, Lin Yi immediately became flustered.
He asked anxiously, “I have time, don’t cry… What happened? Where are you?”
Instinctively, Lin Yi felt something wasn’t right.
Ever since that night of madness, Han Xuewei had never reached out to him first; she must be calling today because something serious had happened.
“I… I’m at the city’s maternal and child hospital,” Han Xuewei said between sobs.
Lin Yi’s head buzzed upon hearing this. Was Han Xuewei sick?
And to go to the city’s maternal and child hospital, of all places… but that shouldn’t be possible; he was the very model of moderation in his daily life. How could she be sick because of him?
Confused, Lin Yi hurriedly hailed a cab and rushed to the city’s maternal and child hospital.
Before long, Lin Yi, in a flurry, arrived at the hospital, where he saw Han Xuewei in the long corridor that smelled of disinfectant.
She was curled up in a chair, crying incessantly.
Lin Yi quickly approached and handed a tissue to Han Xuewei.
“What’s the matter, how did you get sick?” Lin Yi asked softly.
Looking at Han Xuewei in that moment, his heart genuinely ached for her.
Han Xuewei, hearing Lin Yi’s words, didn’t say anything but instead handed him her ultrasound report.
Lin Yi took the paper in a daze, and after staring at it for a full minute, he suddenly jumped up from his seat.
“This… this is… real??” Lin Yi stammered, pointing at the report in his hand, his face showing profound shock.
Han Xuewei, who had been crying, was startled by his abrupt reaction.
At that moment, with her lips quivering and her beautiful eyes lifted, she glared at Lin Yi beside her.
The look in her eyes made Lin Yi’s heart race; it was as if she was peering into his very soul.
It didn’t take long for Lin Yi to regain his composure from the initial shock.
The report made it very clear, Han Xuewei was pregnant, already three months along.
What’s more, she was carrying triplets!
No wonder Lin Yi had jumped up; naturally conceived triplets were almost as unlikely as winning the lottery.
The report also clearly stated that choosing to abort this time could seriously harm Han Xuewei’s body.
At that moment, Han Xuewei kept her unblinking gaze fixed on Lin Yi.
Despite feeling extremely fragile inside, she forced herself to appear resilient.
She was eager to see what Lin Yi’s stance would be regarding the three unborn babies.
If Lin Yi was willing to take responsibility, then she would choose to give birth to the three children.
However, if Lin Yi refused to take responsibility, then Han Xuewei would risk not being able to get pregnant again and get an abortion no matter what.
Seeing Lin Yi still staring at the report without making a statement, the tears in Han Xuewei’s eyes began to flow uncontrollably once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: System Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 3: System Arrival
Watching the beauty in tears, Lin Yi realized that he had lost his composure just now.
So he quickly put away the medical report and sat next to Han Xuewei.
“Xue Mei, don’t cry, I was just a little shocked for a moment,” Lin Yi explained softly.
Han Xuewei started to speak, “I originally thought I had an irregular period, and with the winter clothes being so thick, I didn’t think much of it. But lately, my belly has been growing, and I came to the hospital for a checkup, just to be sure, and the result…”
As she spoke, Han Xuewei broke into sobs again.
Lin Yi felt helpless; all he could do was gently pat Han Xuewei’s back as a gesture of comfort.
After calming down for a moment, Han Xuewei continued, “Lin Yi, do you know? I’ve actually liked you for a long time, ever since we first started school. It’s just that you already had a girlfriend at the time, so I didn’t interfere.”
“That day when you were arguing with your girlfriend outside school, I saw everything, and I also saw you coming out of the bar completely drunk. I couldn’t bear to see you so intoxicated on the street, so I helped you check into a room.”
“I’m really sorry, I didn’t want to deliberately disturb your life.”
“At that time I hadn’t expected that I would get pregnant, let alone with triplets. Although I know this is unfair to you… I don’t want to miss the chance to be a mother. Lin Yi, what… what do you think?”
After Han Xuewei had spoken, she curled up like a wounded bunny.
After hearing Han Xuewei’s bold confession about her feelings for him, Lin Yi felt stupefied.
Because he had never expected that the campus belle had been harboring a crush on him since her freshman year.
At that moment, he could feel a warm current welling up in his heart.
In fact, Lin Yi also had a clear fondness for Han Xuewei, except that his ex-girlfriend Li Jingwen had pursued him too persistently at the time.
After all, it’s always easier when a girl chases a guy.
However, now, Lin Yi couldn’t help but think about the rest of his life when he looked at Han Xuewei.
Accepting Han Xuewei meant that from this moment on, he had to take up the responsibilities of a husband and even a father.
Although he did not resist the idea of starting a family with Han Xuewei, he really was not mentally prepared yet.
Even though Lin Yi had his worries, he was very clear that aborting the pregnancy, especially triplets, would cause immense harm to a woman.
If it were because of him that Han Xuewei lost her chance to ever get pregnant again, Lin Yi would never forgive himself.
Especially a woman as beautiful as Han Xue, who could still be so pure, was one in a million in this world, right?
So after much thought, Lin Yi decided he would take up this responsibility.
As a man, how could he flee at the moment of truth?
Although Han Xuewei took advantage of him while he was drunk, Lin Yi himself was not averse to her.
To have such a beautiful campus belle as a wife and adorable triplets, Lin Yi suddenly felt his life was full of drive.
“Ding! Congratulations, host, on making the right choice and officially activating the Good Father System!”
“As this is the host’s first time binding with the system, a special newcomer reward is provided: a luxury villa of four hundred square meters in the city center!”
The moment Lin Yi made his decision, this somewhat mechanical voice rang directly in his mind.
He was instantly frozen in place.
A system??
And rewarding him with a four hundred square meter villa in the city center?
As someone who had been a bookworm for ten years, he naturally knew about the existence of systems.
“`
But he had never imagined that one day he would be chosen by the system!
And was the system’s generosity too much? It had actually started off by gifting him a 400-square-meter villa in the city.
Lin Yi was so shocked that he simply couldn’t react.
Then, a mechanical voice rang out again in Lin Yi’s mind.
“Congratulations to the host for having triplet babies. I’m the system’s little assistant. If the host has any questions, feel free to ask me, okay?”
This brought Lin Yi out of his astonishment.
“Is it really a system?!”
He almost thought he was dreaming just now.
Now Lin Yi could confirm that he had indeed been chosen by the system.
Then Lin Yi quickly asked, “Little assistant, where is the city villa the system gave me?”
“To answer the host’s question, the city villa gifted by the system is located in Xianggui Garden, at the center of the city. All furniture and items have been arranged for you, the host only needs to move in with his bags.”
Lin Yi was surprised when he heard what the system assistant said.
Because he had heard about the great reputation of Xianggui Garden; it was an extremely luxurious location where only the rich and prestigious lived.
Lin Yi felt a bit dazed; he had not expected that in just one day, not only had he suddenly acquired a wife and children, but he also owned a cheat-system!
Doesn’t this mean that his future life was destined for glory?
He was also happy about the right choice he had made for himself.
Now that he had a place to live, Lin Yi needed to worry about money.
After all, Lin Yi was no fool; he had already thought it through when he agreed to take on the three children.
After the birth of the three little ones, they would definitely need a lot of money, so it seemed he had to work hard to earn money.
After some deliberation, Lin Yi felt that, although he now had the system, it was still best to find a stable job first.
Because he was unclear about the functions and reliability of the system, he couldn’t simply wait and eat away his savings.
Han Xuewei, such a wonderful woman choosing to be with him, he must not let her suffer with him.
Then Lin Yi asked the system in his heart, “System assistant, how can I receive rewards from you, like money and so on?”
Lin Yi asked directly because it was directly related to their little family’s future living conditions.
“The host only needs to spend money on the children and wife to be able to receive corresponding rewards. After the tasks given by the system are completed, the host will also have the chance to win special prizes, and the system can be upgraded as well!”
The system assistant’s words excited Lin Yi immensely.
Then the little assistant of the system spoke again, “A reminder for the host, you will have more opportunities to trigger rewards if you treat your wife and children better.”
Lin Yi was somewhat pleased because, as it seemed now, the conditions to trigger the system’s rewards weren’t too difficult.
Besides, Lin Yi had already decided that he would treat his wife and children with great love and care.
Even without the system, he would have done so.
Doesn’t this mean that Lin Yi just needed to do his own part well, and the system would take care of the rest?
Then Lin Yi embraced Han Xuewei, looking affectionately at her incredibly beautiful face.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 4 - 4 Let's Get Married
chapters.content:
Chapter 4: Chapter 4 Let’s Get Married
“Xue Mei, I never expected you’ve liked me for so long, why don’t we get married?”
At this moment, Han Xuewei had already wiped the tears from her face.
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, her body trembled slightly, then she looked at Lin Yi with disbelief.
She never expected Lin Yi would suddenly propose to marry her!
In Han Xuewei’s eyes, tears began to shimmer once again.
But this time, she wasn’t crying out of grievance but out of joy!
Thinking that the man she had admired for the past four years in university had personally proposed marriage to her made Han Xuewei feel it was almost unreal.
Although she had occasionally fantasized about this, she still felt somewhat overwhelmed when it actually happened.
Only now did she finally understand that in this world, the saying “a child brings blessings to its mother” really did exist.
Han Xuewei was also very clear that it was only because she was carrying three of Lin Yi’s babies in her belly.
If she hadn’t gotten pregnant that night, she and Lin Yi would probably have become strangers by now.
In fact, Han Xuewei was being a bit pessimistic with these thoughts.
Because after that night, Lin Yi had never really let go of Han Xuewei.
He simply thought that Han Xuewei might not want him to bother her, which is why he had been refraining from contacting her.
Now that they were together, it seemed like a serendipitous encounter, but in reality, it was a match made in heaven.
It took a full three minutes before Han Xuewei woke from the wave of happiness.
With hesitation, she said, “Lin Yi, I don’t want to use the child to threaten you, nor do I want to force you to break up with your girlfriend, maybe…”
Lin Yi held Han Xuewei even tighter, feeling her frail body trembling in his embrace, he said softly.
“You haven’t forced me, and you haven’t been a third party. The time you saw us arguing, I had already broken up with Li Jingwen, I’m single now.”
Lin Yi informed Han Xuewei of the true situation immediately.
Because he didn’t want Han Xuewei to always carry an emotional burden.
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei’s face showed an expression of surprise, “Are you serious??”
“Of course, Xue Mei, you wouldn’t be unwilling to marry me and have children, would you? I’m not planning on forcing you either,” Lin Yi admitted, then added with a teasing tone.
At that moment, Han Xuewei gazed earnestly at Lin Yi’s face.
The handsome and clean features were deeply etched in her heart.
Without hesitation, she nodded and said, “I’m willing, I’m willing to marry you, have children, this has been my dream throughout university!”
Lin Yi listened to Han Xuewei’s heartfelt confession, he knew well how much courage it took for a woman to say such words.
So he held Han Xuewei tightly and was reluctant to let go.
“Xue Mei, don’t worry, since I’ve said I’ll marry you, I’ll definitely not let you and our child suffer hardships. I will work hard to make sure you both have a good life,” Lin Yi said.
This was Lin Yi’s promise, as well as his own requirement.
If it had been in the past, Lin Yi might have felt immense pressure.
But now with the system, Lin Yi was filled with hope for the future.
“Okay, I believe you!” Han Xuewei finally extended her arms and embraced Lin Yi in return.
In Lin Yi’s mind, he had already started planning their future.
Originally, Lin Yi had planned to go home during the winter vacation, but now with Han Xuewei and others, he felt it was necessary to first take care of the villa in the city.
After sorting out the villa, Lin Yi intended to discuss the matter of getting married with the parents of both sides.
His own parents were the easier part, having no doubt that they would wholeheartedly approve of him getting married right after graduation.
The main issue lay with Han Xuewei’s parents.
Although Lin Yi was aware that an unplanned pregnancy before marriage would definitely make the girl’s parents feel disgraced,
Lin Yi had no other choice but to bite the bullet and convince Han Xuewei’s parents.
After taking Han Xuewei back to school, Lin Yi also returned to his own dormitory.
In his mind, he was still mulling over how to proceed in the future.
He felt that, for such a big matter, it was necessary to first get in touch with his parents.
So he shared his thoughts with Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei considerately stated that she would follow Lin Yi’s lead in these matters.
Upon seeing Han Xuewei’s response, Lin Yi felt a unique sensation rise within his heart.
Because his previous girlfriend, Li Jingwen, had been a feisty woman who tended to be somewhat willful.
Now that he had gotten to know Han Xuewei, he realized that this was how an excellent girlfriend should be.
Not only was she beautiful, but in everything she did and said, she always prioritized Lin Yi’s feelings, always filling him with a sense of happiness.
That evening, Lin Yi picked up an express delivery that had been rushed to him.
After opening it, he discovered it was the deed to the villa in the city.
Holding the deed in his hand, he still felt a sense of unreality.
Not long after receiving the delivery, Lin Yi’s parents had also received his message and, unable to contain their excitement, they had left home and arrived directly at Lin Yi’s school with their household registration book in hand.
Lin Yi first arranged for them to stay in a hotel room.
Intending to return to school, he was tightly held back by his parents, who wouldn’t let him go.
“You rascal, is that how eager you are to leave? Tell us what’s going on!”
Lin Yi’s mother firmly grasped the sleeve of Lin Yi’s shirt, refusing to let go.
His father also spoke with heartfelt concern, “Yes, Yi’er, you gave us no warning and suddenly told us we’re going to be grandparents. Now that we’re here, aren’t you going to explain?”
Lin Yi sighed. He had foreseen this scene unfolding.
It appeared that if he didn’t clarify everything today, his parents would not allow him to leave the hotel room.
“You little scoundrel, didn’t you just say that you had broken up with Li Jingwen? How come you’re getting back together with her, and suddenly getting married now?”
“Don’t let that girl fool you. You’ve been apart for months, it better not be someone else’s child, and she’s coming to hoodwink you.”
Lin Yi’s mother, naturally a talkative woman, was even more like a machine gun now, speaking incessantly in the face of such a major event.
Lin Yi, standing beside her, felt his head growing heavy.
Finally, when his mother paused to catch her breath, Lin Yi found his chance to speak.
“Mom, don’t rush, let me explain one thing at a time, alright?”
“You’ve misunderstood, the one I’m going to marry is not Li Jingwen.”
With that single sentence, Lin Yi brought his parents to silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 5 - 5 Thank You, My Dear
chapters.content:
Chapter 5: Chapter 5 Thank You, My Dear
After Lin Yi finished speaking, his mother was stunned for a good ten seconds before she snapped out of her surprise.
“You’re saying the person you’re going to marry isn’t Li Jingwen?”
Lin Yi nodded, “Yes, I’ve been broken up with her for several months now, so how could I possibly suddenly decide to marry her?”
“Then…this person…who you’re going to marry now, who is she?”
Lin Yi’s mother felt her mind couldn’t quite keep up at this point.
His father, at this time, said with a grave expression, “Son, are you perhaps rushing into marriage because the last relationship hurt you too much? We’re not in a hurry to become grandparents; you have to think carefully about your life.”
His father’s words were sincere, attempting to awaken Lin Yi to his situation.
At that moment, listening to his father’s concerns, Lin Yi was at a loss for words, struggling to articulate his thoughts.
After all, his first time with Han Xuewei hadn’t exactly been conventional.
If he were to reveal the whole truth, it might make his parents uncomfortable.
So, he stammered, “Dad, Mom, this is someone I got together with after breaking up with Li Jingwen, and it just so happened that she got pregnant, and now she’s already three months along.”
“Oh, and she’s carrying triplets.”
Lin Yi glossed over the details of his relationship with Han Xuewei, trying to shift his parents’ focus onto the children.
Sure enough, after Lin Yi shared this news, his mother’s eyes widened in shock.
“What… triplets!?”
She exclaimed in surprise, clearly both shocked and delighted by the news.
At this time, she looked at her son in disbelief.
She never could have imagined that her son, who seldom took any action, would suddenly bring home three grandchildren?
Lin Yi’s father, usually a very composed individual, was also taken aback when he heard this.
“Yi’er, are you serious?”
Lin Yi was both amused and exasperated as he looked at his parents.
He could guess what was going through their minds—they were probably already calculating the cost of milk powder, diapers, and education for three children.
They were surely concerned about how he would manage financially in the future.
However, Lin Yi was not worried. After all, he had the system, which had already granted him a villa in the center of town worth several million.
Lin Yi knew that it would be difficult to convince his parents just by talking, so he directly took out Han Xuewei’s medical reports and ultrasound results.
Once the parents saw the official documents from the city’s maternity and child care hospital, they began to believe that Lin Yi was telling the truth.
Before they could fully recover from their initial shock, Lin Yi lied to them again.
He falsely claimed that he had been investing in stocks since his university days and that he had earned nearly ten million from stock trading.
He also told them that he had already prepared a marriage house, and everything was ready, just waiting for the approval of both parents to proceed with the wedding.
After hearing all this shocking news, Lin Yi’s parents were left dumbfounded.
They could never have imagined why Lin Yi, usually so quiet, had suddenly pulled off so many big moves?
But soon enough, the elderly couple recovered from their shock.
After all, Lin Yi was already considered a not-so-modest second-generation rich kid.
His father’s company often boasts annual sales of over one hundred million.
Even when their family had yet to face tribulations, Lin Yi’s yearly expenditures were around a million.
This was also why Li Jingwen, the former pursuer, had spared no effort in chasing after Lin Yi.
Having seen the world, the elders quickly accepted Lin Yi’s explanation.
“Son, well done,” his father said with gravity, “but you must not become arrogant and complacent, especially when it comes to stock trading. You must not be hasty for quick success and profit!”
Lin Yi nodded, indicating he understood the advice from his father.
Subsequently, the family of three discussed some of the upcoming events in detail.
The important matter at hand was to inform Han Xuewei’s parents, so both families could start discussing the details of the wedding.
Lin Yi had sent the news to Han Xuewei early on.
Han Xuewei told Lin Yi that her parents were already on their way to Xiangcheng and should arrive tomorrow.
Therefore, Lin Yi planned to schedule the meeting of both sets of parents for tomorrow evening.
He could also take everyone to visit the city villa he had just acquired.
As for tomorrow during the day, Lin Yi intended to have Han Xuewei meet his own parents first, followed by a meal.
He would also take Han Xuewei to buy some maternity items, all to be placed in the villa.
After all, as it was the first time both parties were meeting the parents, Lin Yi still valued etiquette highly.
Although his relationship with Han Xuewei developed abruptly, Lin Yi was willing to accord her the highest level of attention.
Finally returning to the dormitory, Lin Yi lay on the bed still feeling unreal.
He could never have imagined that in a single day, he not only had a wife and child, but also owned a villa worth tens of millions.
This kind of thing, happening to anyone, would feel like a dream, wouldn’t it?
Lin Yi couldn’t sleep, and since it wasn’t too late, he picked up his phone and sent a message to Han Xuewei.
“Vivi, do you want to go out for some late-night food?” he texted.
Han Xuewei hadn’t slept yet; she always kept her phone with her and had set special notifications for Lin Yi’s messages.
Upon seeing Lin Yi’s message and the nickname he used for her, Han Xuewei couldn’t help but blush.
After all, this was, in a strict sense, her first experience with love.
Plus, Lin Yi was the man she had secretly adored for more than three years in college.
Thinking of this, Han Xuewei couldn’t help but smile with happiness.
So after chuckling to herself for a moment, Han Xuewei sweetly replied to the message.
“Darling, I’d like some grilled chicken, thank you,” she typed.
After sending the message, she quickly covered her phone, as though afraid Lin Yi could somehow see her bashfulness at that moment.
Now that she and Lin Yi were discussing marriage, even though they had just gotten together, Han Xuewei was confident that in the days to come, she could make Lin Yi wholeheartedly devoted to her.
It was only about fifteen minutes later that Lin Yi arrived with the grilled chicken at the dorm where Han Xuewei resided.
He sent Han Xuewei a message, and before long, he saw her, dressed in thick pajamas, coming down the stairs.
Her pregnant belly was slightly bulging, making her look a bit clumsy and somewhat like an adorable penguin.
Even without makeup, she was still stunningly beautiful.

chapters.title: Chapter 6 - 6 Rewards for a Happy Baby
chapters.content:
Chapter 6: Chapter 6 Rewards for a Happy Baby
Although Han Xuewei tried to cover up, her outstanding beauty was recognized in an instant.
Necks stretched one after another, their gazes rolling continually over Lin Yi and Han Xuewei.
“Did you see it clearly? That is our goddess!”
“Who is that guy? How does he have such clout?”
“Support me, guys, my heart’s fatally shattered now that the goddess has a boyfriend.”
They were all very curious, when had the famed campus beauty of Xiangcheng University gotten a boyfriend?
At this moment, someone recognized Lin Yi.
“I remember now, that kid seems to be called Lin Yi!”
“Everyone still remembers Li Jingwen, right? The belle of the music department, she used to be this guy’s girlfriend.”
“To be honest, this kid could be considered a rich second generation too, but his family fell on hard times, and his father’s company is facing bankruptcy. Li Jingwen of course wasn’t willing to ‘hang from a single tree.'”
“After dumping him, she quickly found herself another boyfriend, also from a rich second generation.”
The people around pressed in, discussing fervently.
“Who would have thought this kid has some moves, just got dumped by the department belle and in a turn, hooked up with the campus goddess.”
“Not a whiff of it was in the air, yet they’re already out in the open.”
Han Xuewei’s face turned a slight red, ignoring the crowd’s chatter, she nervously came forward and took the late-night snack from Lin Yi’s hands.
Daringly rising on her tiptoes, she gave Lin Yi’s cheek a quick kiss, and said with a shy courage, “What others say is not important, I have set my heart on you anyway.”
“In my eyes, you are unparalleled.”
The surrounding people suddenly widened their eyes, scarcely believing what they saw.
They had thought that Lin Yi was quite the operator to have snagged the aloof campus goddess.
Looking at it now, it wasn’t quite like that; it should probably be the other way around.
What a rare spectacle indeed!
“Ding!”
“As the host has made the baby in his belly feel joy, a reward of 2 million has been granted. Congratulations to the host!”
At that moment, the system’s voice rang out in his mind.
Lin Yi’s eyes widened in surprise, well I’ll be, a single late-night snack had earned him a 2 million reward; wasn’t this way of making money a bit too easy?
“Ding dong!”
Without needing to check his phone, Lin Yi knew it was the 2 million just transferred into his account.
Ignoring the astonished gazes around him, he quickly stepped forward and embraced Han Xuewei in his arms, his expression filled with tenderness.
What other people say doesn’t matter; the most important thing is to protect his wife and children. In the long years to come, no one would be allowed to bully his wife and child, not even a little.
In an instant, a chorus of screams erupted around them.
Some even eagerly took out their phones, videos being recorded, photos being taken, busy as bees.
In just a few minutes, the story of the two spread across the internet.
“Down-and-out rich second generation welcomes his spring!”
“The aloof campus goddess shows tenderness too!”
“The daily happiness of the aloof campus goddess and her dorky boyfriend.”
Post after post spread rapidly online, instantly sparking a wave of followers. Below the videos, strings of text made brilliant comments.
The person who’s had too much lemon just can’t help but make snide remarks.
After Lin Yi and Han Xuewei parted ways, they each returned to their own dormitories.
In Lin Yi’s dorm, each of his roommates waited excitedly for his arrival.
The moment he opened the door, they surrounded him, with Wang Ziyi being the first to speak.
He just couldn’t wait to blurt out, “President Lin, I didn’t see it coming. You’ve nabbed the campus belle so effortlessly, you sly dog.”
“Spill the beans, when did it happen? Where? What did you guys do? Did you by any chance… ”
Yang Junchen leaned in a bit closer with a mischievous tone.
Lin Yi couldn’t be bothered with them, and went straight for the nearest chair, plopping down with ease, leaning back comfortably, and let out a deep sigh.
For him, today had too many events to count; he needed to take a moment to sort things out.
But how could his roommates let him off so easily? They continued to crowd around him, chattering nonstop with questions.
“Y’all don’t need to be so curious, nothing major happened between us, it’s just dating.”
Pressed by everyone’s questioning, Lin Yi finally said, somewhat impatiently.
The others perked up upon hearing this, the look of gossips etched onto their faces.
Han Xuewei, a rare beauty, the prettiest girl at Xiangcheng University, the goddess in everyone’s heart.
The guys in this dorm had long since fallen for Han Xuewei, and now seeing their goddess conquered by Lin Yi, they felt quite bittersweet.
“Well done, you snuck in without making a sound and cut off all our chances.”
“In the game of love, I’ve always considered myself quite the player, yet I didn’t even stand a chance. Han Xuewei, the aloof campus belle, and she ends up with you, kid.”
“My curiosity is killing me; what did you do, a forceful conquest?”
Everyone was abuzz with comments. However, what Lin Yi said next made all the guys unable to remain seated.
“My brothers, the wedding arrangements with Vivi are already on the schedule, and if nothing goes wrong, we’ll be getting our license soon. Once we’ve hammered out the details of the wedding, I want every single one of you as my groomsmen.”
What?
The rest of them were struck with astonishment. Wasn’t this moving a bit too fast?
After a while, Gao Li’an, the first to regain composure, asked incredulously, “For real? You’re not just shooting the breeze here, are you?”
“We haven’t even graduated yet. Getting married right after graduation, aren’t you rushing things?”
Lin Yi nodded earnestly and said, “I’d prefer to keep it low-key too, but it’s just not in my power. Our parents are already on their way here.”
“If all goes well, the arrangements for the marriage should be finalized during the winter break.”
Han Xuewei’s belly had already begun to show slightly, and it wouldn’t be long before hiding it would become impossible, let alone the fact that she was carrying triplets.
The marriage was now the most pressing matter. Before the child was born, he had to give Han Xuewei a legitimate status; this was the responsibility he must shoulder as a man.
He just didn’t know what Han Xuewei was thinking.
Whether she could accept getting the license first and then holding the wedding ceremony after the baby was born.
He also wondered what kind of choices Han Xuewei’s parents would make after finding out about the pregnancy.
All of this was beyond Lin Yi’s knowledge. He could only wait for the parents from both sides to meet and discuss the matter.
The other roommates didn’t take Lin Yi’s marriage seriously, thinking he was just talking big. Each of them readily agreed to be groomsmen.
They laughed and made a racket for a while, then went back to their own tasks.
They didn’t take the earlier conversation to heart at all, believing Lin Yi was just crazy about getting married.

chapters.title: Chapter 7 - 7 Ex-Girlfriend Shows Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 7: Chapter 7 Ex-Girlfriend Shows Up
Before they knew it, the next day had arrived.
Lin Yi arrived early at the girls’ dormitory building, waiting patiently for Han Xuewei to arrive.
The two had already made plans to have morning tea with Lin Yi’s parents.
After a phone call, he learned that Han Xuewei was still getting dressed up. It was her first time meeting the parents, so it was understandable.
Just then, Lin Yi’s ex-girlfriend—Li Jingwen—appeared at the foot of the girls’ dormitory building. It didn’t look like she was passing by; instead, she seemed to have come looking for Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi, don’t think you’re something special just because you’ve latched onto Han Xuewei. A down-and-out rich second generation, what’s so great about that? I really want to see what you have to offer to be with Han Xuewei,” Li Jingwen said disdainfully as she quickly approached upon seeing Lin Yi, her nose turned up in the air.
Lin Yi sneered internally and replied composedly, “A down-and-out rich second generation? Who told you that my dad was going bankrupt?”
“Lin Yi!”
At that moment, they heard Han Xuewei’s voice from behind them.
Lin Yi turned around, quickly walked up to Han Xuewei, and reached out his hand to her.
With a shy smile, Han Xuewei placed her small hand into Lin Yi’s. Upon seeing Li Jingwen, she stepped forward with a smile and extended her right hand, saying politely, “Hello, I’m Han Xuewei, Lin Yi’s girlfriend.”
Li Jingwen snorted coldly, her expression souring as she glared at Han Xuewei and said impatiently, “Hmph! I really want to see how far you two can go!”
After speaking, she briskly brushed off Han Xuewei’s hand and stormed off.
The onlookers began to murmur amongst themselves.
They unanimously agreed that Li Jingwen was being unreasonable. She and Lin Yi had already broken up, and now she was coming back to get angrily involved, which was completely unjustifiable.
The relationship between Lin Yi and Han Xuewei, after one night, had become public knowledge. With one being the beauty of the department and the other the belle of the campus, anyone with a little gossiping tendency couldn’t help but comment.
“Xue Mei, you must believe me, Li Jingwen is my ex-girlfriend, but I’m clear of any wrongdoings with her, nothing ever happened between us.”
Lin Yi quickly explained to Han Xuewei.
As for a woman like Li Jingwen, Lin Yi felt no nostalgia. She jumped into someone else’s arms and left the scene the second they broke up.
Such a woman, Lin Yi didn’t care for.
Han Xuewei nodded, revealing a sweet smile, “I know, don’t worry. I don’t care about your past, only about your future.”
“Let’s hurry, we shouldn’t keep uncle and auntie waiting; that would be really impolite.”
Witnessing the lovely charm of Han Xuewei, Lin Yi’s heart softened naturally, and he took her small hand, a trembling sensation passing through his heart.
Soon, the two arrived at the hotel where Lin Yi’s parents were waiting.
As for those discussions in the background, they were completely ignored by the couple, believing in walking their own path and letting others say what they will.
Lin Yi’s parents had some anxiety in their hearts, fearing that the two of them were rushing into marriage because of an unexpected pregnancy, which could make the marriage short-lived.
That would be a considerable loss for both the young man and the woman.
When the two appeared hand in hand in front of Lin Yi’s parents, the elders exchanged a glance, understanding one another, and their worries subsided.
As long as it wasn’t a moment of impulse, emotional issues could be slowly nurtured.
Han Xuewei subtly let go of Lin Yi’s hand upon meeting his parents and put on a sweet smile, politely saying, “Hello Uncle and Auntie, sorry to have kept you waiting!”
Lin’s father’s tense nerves instantly relaxed, feeling overwhelmingly affectionate and immediately started to fuss over Han Xuewei.
Seeing Han Xuewei’s well-behaved demeanor, Lin’s mother felt extremely joyous. Without consideration for anything else, she quickly stepped forward, took Han Xuewei’s hands, and said with delight, “So you are Xue Mei! Such a good child!”
Lin’s mother and Han Xuewei hit it off right away, and in no time at all, they found common ground, chatting away happily.
The father and son beside them, of course, were pleased to see this.
The four of them sat together, eating breakfast and chatting about everyday family matters. Through their conversation, they each learned a lot about the others.
Han Xuewei’s family was financially well-off; her mother was a civil servant, and her father owned his own company. Her family’s conditions were excellent, and she had received a good education from a young age.
Lin Yi’s parents became even more satisfied with Han Xuewei.
As for the marriage arrangements, they would still need to wait for Han Xuewei’s parents to arrive before they could discuss the specifics.
After breakfast, just as Han Xuewei was about to put down her bowl, her parents called.
“Vivi, where are you now? At school or out somewhere? Immediately send us your location, we’ve already arrived at Xiangcheng,” Han Xuewei’s mother said with an urgent tone.
“Mom, how did you get here so fast? I’m not at school, I’m having breakfast with Lin Yi’s mom and dad. Where are you right now?”
Han Xuewei was quite surprised, not expecting her parents to arrive so promptly.
Her family lived in the county town, which would typically require three to four hours to reach Xiangcheng. They had searched yesterday, but the high-speed train tickets were long sold out, and they had planned on coming by bus.
“Cut the chit-chat. We’ve just gotten off the highway. Quickly send the location, and we’ll come directly to you,” came the voice of Han Xuewei’s mother again.
Her mother’s voice once again came through the phone.
“Mom, I’m sending the location right now. We’ll wait for you here. I just didn’t expect you to arrive so early; I thought it would be in the afternoon, but you’re already here just after 11 o’clock,” Han Xuewei said with a smile on her face, a bit of nervousness in her heart as she worked on her phone.
“My child, after hearing about your situation, how could your father and I just sit around? So, we got up early. Unable to wait for the bus, we simply took a fast car here,” her mother explained.
“We’ve received the location. Don’t move from there, just wait for us,” Han’s mother said before quickly hanging up.
Clutching her phone, Han Xuewei felt extremely nervous. She looked at Lin Yi and briefly explained the situation regarding her parents’ arrival.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s parents were grinning from ear to ear. They called the waiter over and decided to stay in their current private dining room to host a banquet in honor of Han Xuewei’s parents.
It wasn’t long before Han Xuewei’s parents arrived.
Both families were exceedingly polite, exchanging warm greetings, and taking their seats with humility.
“In-laws, you’ve come from so far; it must have been tiring, and we should have been the ones visiting you. Have you had breakfast yet? Shall we order some food?” Lin’s mother asked warmly and generously.
The leftovers from their earlier meal had been quickly cleared away by the staff. It would have been incredibly rude to greet the in-laws with remnants of a meal still on the table.
The attentive waiter, upon hearing Lin’s mother’s words, promptly placed the menu in front of Han’s mother and then stood quietly to the side, waiting.
Han’s mother, not standing on ceremony, glanced at the menu and said directly, “Let’s have these few signature dishes. Anything else you’d like to add?”

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Talking about Marriage and Matchmaking
chapters.content:
Chapter 8: Talking about Marriage and Matchmaking
Lin Yi’s mother said with a cheerful smile, “Please enjoy your meal at your leisure, Mr. Lin and Ms. Han Xue. We just finished breakfast with Vivi, so just a few signature dishes will suffice.”
“Waiter, please add a serving of vegetables.”
Ms. Han nodded without much formality and, after exchanging pleasantries, went straight to the topic at hand—wedding talks and marriage discussions.
“Lin Yi’s mom, I really want to know what your family thinks about this matter. The kids have reached this stage, and I’m curious how you plan to arrange things?”
Han Xuewei’s mother was the first to speak, her gaze sweeping over Lin Yi.
This young man had made a favorable initial impression: poised yet shrewd, a dependable sort of person.
“Ms. Han, first of all, we are very grateful that your family has raised such an exceptional daughter-in-law for us. You don’t need to worry at all, I really like Vivi. If they want to live by themselves after marriage, I wholeheartedly approve.”
“If they want to live with us, we welcome that too. As long as Vivi is happy, we have no objections. Vivi is pregnant with triplets, and she definitely won’t be able to manage on her own.”
“When the time comes, we’ll take care of the nanny and baby formula, and we absolutely won’t let Vivi be wronged.”
“Besides, our son is here, and I see him as a responsible person. I believe he will also treat Vivi well.”
Lin Yi’s mother eagerly put forth her sincerity.
“Auntie, please rest assured that as long as I’m here, I absolutely won’t let Vivi suffer the slightest grievance,” Lin Yi promised as he stood up.
They had reached the stage of discussing marriage, so they were practically family. His wife and children would, of course, need his protection.
Furthermore, his wife was famously the school beauty, talented and beautiful, gentle and caring towards him—a rare find. If he didn’t treat her well, who else would he treat well?
Han Xuewei’s cheeks reddened slightly and her heart swelled with sweetness. She cast a loving glance at Lin Yi.
Ms. Han observed all this and let out a small sigh of relief in her heart. After a glance at Lin Yi and his parents, her worried mind was finally at ease.
Still, there were questions in her mind that needed to be asked.
She inquired, “What about their marriage home?”
Lin Yi smiled confidently and said, “Auntie, I have already purchased the marriage home. It’s in the central Xiangcheng City, in Fragrant Osmanthus Gardens, about 400 square meters. Even if our parents move in, there should be enough space.”
“If Vivi doesn’t like it and wants to buy a new one, that’s also an option.”
“Our family has a car, and when we get married, we’ll buy a new one.”
Upon hearing this, Ms. Han was pleased. The young man’s family was reliable, with both a car and a home, and their financial strength was quite good. Most importantly, the in-laws seemed easy to get along with.
As long as they had the approval of her parents-in-law and found a husband who would dote on her daughter, her daughter’s life would be settled and stable.
Ms. and Mr. Han exchanged a look, both very satisfied with the marriage arrangement.
As long as their daughter was happy, everything else was negotiable. The concern that had hung over them all night finally found resolution.
They didn’t seek wealth from the other family; as long as the husband’s family was understanding, respected, and cherished their daughter, that was all they could ask for.
The parents of both families met without many differences, quickly reaching a consensus. The young couple was filled with sweetness, which also reassured both sets of parents.
The house that Lin Yi claimed to have already bought was even unknown to his parents. After discussing it, they decided to go have a look to avoid any confusion when the time comes to visit.
After lunch, the six family members took a seven-seater car straight to Fragrant Osmanthus Gardens in the city center.
Upon arriving at the destination, Lin Yi quickly jumped out of the car, opened Han Xuewei’s door, and carefully helped her down, constantly reminding her to be careful of this and that.
He was simply the epitome of a good husband.
Han Xuewei’s pretty face blushed as she felt the warmth from his palm, sweetly contented.
Both sets of parents followed behind the young couple, looked at each other, and exchanged knowing smiles.
As long as the young couple was living well, it brought great joy to their hearts as parents.
The group of six people quickly arrived at the sales office.
“Good day, sir. Are you here to view properties? What size are you interested in?”
The sales assistant approached them eagerly upon their arrival, professionally making her inquiry.
Lin Yi gave her a smile and calmly pulled out the property deed, saying, “Hello, could you find me the keys for this building? We’d like to take a look in person.”
The moment the sales assistant saw the property deed, she was shocked and quickly called the manager over without delay.
Once the manager took a glance at the property deed, his face lit up with a smile, and he loudly said, “Number 9, Xiang Gui Garden, this gentleman must be Mr. Lin! We received a notification from the higher-ups yesterday and have been waiting for a while.”
“I have the keys right here. Let’s go!”
The manager had been notified the previous night that a Mr. Lin would come to view the villa today, and he had been instructed repeatedly to provide excellent service. The keys had even been delivered to him personally by the senior management.
Seeing this, Han Xue’s father and mother truly set their worries aside; now that there was a house, they knew their daughter’s future would be secured.
They initially planned that if needed, both families could discuss and jointly provide a complete set of housing assistance for the couple, to help them lead a more relaxed life.
Even if finances were tight, it would pose no issue for both families to cover a down payment. After the child’s birth, with a little help here and there, the couple’s life would still be manageable.
Just graduated, without a house or car, and with three children to raise—it wasn’t a joke.
They had not expected their in-laws to be so supportive and resolve the couple’s problems so swiftly, allowing them to fully set aside their concerns.
Looking at the 400 square meter detached villa, Han Xue’s parents could not contain their happiness.
“Mr. Lin, the villa was renovated a year ago, using only world-class materials, and it’s ready to move in. Mr. Lin can rest assured that the materials used are high-end and environmentally friendly.”
“It’s safe for both infants and the elderly.”
The sales manager prattled on confidently.
“A villa in the center of Xiangcheng City, the price must be quite high, right?” Han Xue’s mother asked.
With a smile, the sales manager replied, “Madam, you might not be aware, but house prices have skyrocketed within this year. Mr. Lin’s villa was purchased a year ago.”
“Back then, the price was not even 1/20th of what it is now. The value of this house has increased dozens of times in just a short year.”
“Especially now, it’s extremely popular, as all the surrounding amenities have been built up. From kindergartens to high schools, there are available positions, making this location the top choice for many citizens.”
Lin Yi listened, somewhat stunned. He truly didn’t know when the house was bought; he only knew that he received the property deed yesterday.
The renovation had been completed a year ago; by now, any potential harmful substances must have mostly dissipated, meaning even a pregnant woman wouldn’t be greatly affected.
With Han Xuewei’s belly growing bigger, living in a dormitory was inconvenient, and taking care of herself was a challenge. It was best to move in earlier.

chapters.title: Chapter 9 - 9 With the System in Hand, No Worries About Food and Clothing
chapters.content:
Chapter 9: Chapter 9 With the System in Hand, No Worries About Food and Clothing
“Mr. Lin, do you have any other business here? If not, I’ll take my leave, so as not to affect your mood while looking at the house.”
After the sales manager finished speaking, her gaze fell on Lin Yi, filled with inquiry.
“Thank you, sales manager; we’ll be fine on our own, please don’t mind us, and go ahead with your work!”
Lin Yi said politely.
The sales manager escorted them to the door of the house and notified the relevant staff members. She gave them a polite smile, turned around, and left to attend to her own business.
“Vivi, I think we should move in first! Your belly is getting bigger day by day, and I’m really worried about you living in the dormitory alone.”
“If we live together, I can take care of you all the time, which is much more convenient.”
Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei and said.
Han Xuewei turned her head to look at her parents, then at Lin Yi’s parents, trying to gauge their reaction.
Both sets of parents, feeling her gaze, smiled knowingly but remained noncommittal.
Han Xuewei immediately made up her mind and spoke, “You make the decision; I have no objections.”
Han Xuewei felt very sweet inside; she always liked Lin Yi. What happened was just an accident.
Unexpectedly, Lin Yi was not only mild-tempered and purposeful in his actions, but also particularly responsible. Regardless of the level of affection, he took great care of her.
Lin Yi’s performance made Han Xuewei very satisfied.
Their parents, walking behind them, kept an eye on the two young people from the corners of their eyes. Seeing that they negotiated and agreed with each other, they were completely relieved.
As parents, they didn’t ask for much; they just hoped their children could live safely and well, which was sufficient.
After a while, Lin Yi’s mother found the right moment to pull him aside and asked with concern, “My good boy, please tell your mom honestly, where did all this money come from?”
“Don’t try to fob me off, kid. Even a year ago, the real estate prices there were definitely not cheap. I know how much money you have.”
Lin Yi looked at his mother and smiled a little, patted her hand, and assured, “Mom, you can relax; your son is not a scoundrel.”
“I can assure you, this money is absolutely clean, and there isn’t the slightest illegal thing involved. Your son wouldn’t touch that with even a ten-foot pole.”
“There’s no point in hiding it from you now. Over the years, the pocket money you and dad have given me wasn’t a small amount, I guess you also don’t keep much track of it.”
“I’ve been frugal and saved up, and I learned to invest in stocks and made quite a bit of money, only I never dared to tell you.”
“The money for this villa comes from there. But after buying this villa, there isn’t much left. I’ll need you and dad to worry and take care when I get married.”
Upon hearing the money was legally earned, Lin Yi’s mother’s anxiety eased and she said, “Regarding the wedding, be completely reassured. Your father and I have been saving for it.”
“The only thing I’m worried about is that you two have just graduated from college and have no jobs yet, and there are three children to support. As parents, we will definitely help whenever we can.”
As for the future life, Lin Yi didn’t worry at all. After all, his phone still had a full 2 million lying in it.
Besides, with the system at hand, food and clothing are the least of his concerns.
He was determined not to let his wife and children suffer even the slightest grievance.
Thinking of this, he turned his head and said to his mother, “Mom, don’t worry about this, your son isn’t a lazy man. As soon as I get my diploma, I’ll start working right away.”
“I will absolutely not let Vivi and the child suffer even a tiny bit. My wife is beautiful as a flower, and even if she wanted to endure hardships, I wouldn’t have the heart to let her do so.”
Han’s mother, walking not far away, heard Lin Yi’s words and felt very satisfied.
She silently praised him, It seems this young man is quite responsible. My daughter has good judgment. Having a man like him to accompany her for life is indeed a fortunate thing.
But her own daughter hadn’t finished university yet and her career was not settled, and now at such a young age, she was becoming a mother, which filled her with regret.
It seemed that she needed to take her annual leave soon and come over to help out.
Han’s mother explored the villa, which was quite large. She was happy in her heart, thinking that her daughter had finally married into a good family. With a house and a child, she could still find work later on, and life would gradually get better.
Now, with the help of both sets of parents, they probably wouldn’t suffer too much.
Thinking of this, Han’s mother pulled Han Xuewei aside and said, “Vivi, marriage is no trifling matter. You need to think it through carefully.”
“Mom, don’t worry, I’ve thought it through. I like him, and spending a lifetime with him wouldn’t be bad,” said Han Xuewei as she looked seriously at Lin Yi.
Han’s mother sighed softly and said, “Since you’ve decided, I won’t say more. I can see that your in-laws are quite easy to get along with.”
“But now, with the situation as it is, your studies can only be put aside. After all, you’re carrying triplets. The further along you get, the more difficult it will be. You must be mentally prepared.”
“In terms of finances, both parents can lend a hand, but in daily life, we shouldn’t get too involved. It’s entirely up to you. From now on, you should prioritize your family and live your life well.”
“All those little tempers and impetuousness from before, it’s time to curb them as well. Becoming a mother means your life isn’t just about romance and beauty, but countless heavy responsibilities.”
Han Xuewei, moved by her mother’s words, lowered her head, not wanting her mom to see her emotions, and could only reply softly, “Please rest assured, Mom. I understand.”
She looked up slightly and saw Lin Yi ahead, and breathed a sigh of relief.
The man before her was the one she loved. To be able to walk through life together, and to have each other’s children, was truly one of life’s great blessings.
It was definitely better than forming a family with someone incompatible.
After the parents toured the villa, they decided on the spot that the marriage of the two kids would be handled after the birth of the child.
Lin Yi’s parents were very reasonable and immediately set the dowry at 288,000.
They promised to prepare everything and decided not to let Han Xuewei suffer any grievances.
As Han Xuewei’s body became increasingly heavy – though she was only three months pregnant with triplets, her belly was comparable to someone five months into a single pregnancy.
That night, led by Lin Yi and Han Xuewei, both sets of parents rushed to the dormitory, hastily packed up their belongings, and moved them to the villa.
A pregnant woman needed many things, and as mothers themselves, they had ample experience.
They instructed Han Xuewei to rest well and hurried to the necessary places to prepare everything needed.
Before long, the living room was filled with all sorts of items.
Everything prepared, the parents finally left.

chapters.title: Chapter 10 - 10 Successful Proposal
chapters.content:
Chapter 10: Chapter 10 Successful Proposal
The parents of the Han family, citing inconvenience, declined the invitation from their future in-laws and the couple stayed in a hotel.
They were planning to wait until the next day, after the two young people had received their marriage certificate and everything was arranged, before they could leave.
Lin Yi saw the living room filled with things and his heart was brimming with endless emotion.
Time really flew by, and in the blink of an eye, the big decision of his life had been made.
Not only that, but he now had both a wife and a child.
In an instant, he felt he had grown up, with heavy responsibilities weighing on his shoulders.
Everything felt like a dream.
Han Xuewei sat on the sofa resting, leaning back slightly in boundless laziness.
Lin Yi looked up at Han Xuewei.
He noticed that her face seemed fuller than before.
In his memory, Han Xuewei always had a melon-seed face with a sharp chin.
Probably because of her pregnancy, her melon-seed face had turned into an oval one, but it did not affect her beauty in the slightest.
Compared to those beauties sculpted and made up through artificial means, Han Xuewei looked naturally graceful and strikingly regal.
Han Xuewei had always been the most beautiful belle at Xiangcheng University. However, she was naturally cold and low-key, focusing completely on her studies, and up to this point, had not dated anyone.
With her natural beauty and slender figure, she became the goddess in the hearts of nearly all the male students at Xiangcheng University.
But no one dared to get too close to her.
Before he was pursued by Li Jingwen, Lin Yi had also been incredibly attracted to Han Xuewei.
However, Li Jingwen had taken the initiative, wholeheartedly devoted to him, taking care of everything he needed.
Lin Yi saw that she was not lacking in looks and was devoted to him, so he agreed to be with her.
But unexpectedly, after many twists and turns, the wheel of fate had brought him and Han Xuewei together, and they had reached the point of discussing marriage.
Moreover, due to a series of unforeseen events, they had ended up having three children together.
Han Xuewei had always liked him and was the first to confess her feelings, which indeed surprised Lin Yi. He never thought that the unattainable flower of Xiangcheng University would end up in his own pocket.
Han Xuewei snapped back to reality and noticed that Lin Yi had been staring at her, which made her a bit uncomfortable. Her cheeks turned slightly red as she extended her hands and touched her face, asking, “Is there something dirty on my face?”
“Why are you staring at me like that?”
Lin Yi smiled tenderly, shook his head slightly, and said, “Vivi, you are truly beautiful!”
Han Xuewei was stunned on the spot, not expecting Lin Yi to be so direct. Her face blushed crimson, like a cooked shrimp.
With just a few succinct words from Lin Yi, the distance between them had closed considerably, and Han Xuewei found herself reflecting on the past, amazed at how time flies.
She looked up at Lin Yi, remembered that he had an ex-girlfriend, and felt a bit worried. She asked, “Lin Yi, we’re getting our certificate tomorrow, have you really thought it through?”
“If you’re not sure about marrying me, we can postpone the date to get our certificate.”
Lin Yi was surprised and then thought of something. He grasped Han Xuewei’s hand and said, “Vivi, is it because everything is moving too fast? Is it hard for you to adjust all at once?”
“You don’t need to feel that way. I’m not without feelings for you. I was moved and felt emotions for you once, probably back in our freshman year, the first time I saw you, I felt my heart race.”
“But back then, you were so aloof that I didn’t dare to approach you. As for what happened later, I assume you already know, and I do not wish to bring it up again.”
“As for getting married, I have thought it over very clearly. You, Han Xuewei, are the one I, Lin Yi, have decided to spend my life with, the one I will cherish for a lifetime.”
After hearing this, Han Xuewei completely forgot how she was supposed to react. Lin Yi’s words had taken her completely by surprise.
She had never expected the man she cherished to have feelings for her all along.
Could this be what they call mutual affection?
In that instant, Han Xuewei’s eyes sparkled with indescribable excitement.
Feeling her excitement, Lin Yi immediately stepped forward, took Han Xuewei’s hands, and then knelt on one knee.
With the swiftness of lightning, he quickly took out the engagement ring he had secretly purchased and proclaimed, “Miss Han Xuewei, may I ask if you would like to marry Mr. Lin Yi?”
“From this day forward, to support and cherish each other through sickness or health, poverty or wealth, until death parts you. Do you agree?”
Han Xuewei looked at Lin Yi, deeply touched by his proposal. She fiercely wiped the tears from her eyes, covering her mouth, fearing that she might start crying out loud if she wasn’t careful.
When Lin Yi didn’t receive an answer right away, he spoke again, “Miss Han Xuewei, please marry me!”
“Yes! Yes! I will!”
Han Xuewei’s tears fell like broken strings of beads as she choked out the words.
Lin Yi stood up and embraced Han Xuewei passionately, gently patting her back and comforting her, “Silly girl, no more tears. Trust me, I will see things through to the end.”
At that moment, a voice from the system suddenly echoed in Lin Yi’s mind.
“Ding!”
“Congratulations, host. As you have made a commitment and provided a complete family for the baby, the system has decided to award you with a 5 million marriage fund.”
“Ding dong!”
The notification of the 5 million reward resounded on Lin Yi’s phone.
What the heck!
There’s even a reward for a successful proposal, and it’s 5 million all at once. Now, providing for his wife and child was no longer going to be a problem.
Lin Yi was overwhelmed with excitement.
At the same time, he resolved that after graduation, aside from accompanying his wife, he would also find a respectable job. He was determined to ask the system how to trigger special tasks.
Right now, making money was the top priority.
The atmosphere between them was harmonious and warm.
After a little while, Lin Yi tenderly asked, “Vivi, you must be hungry after half a day, right? Shall I warm up the dumplings I brought back for you?”
“Mhm, thank you!”
Han Xuewei felt a surge of sweetness and responded in a soft voice.
Knowing that Han Xuewei was pregnant, Lin Yi had looked up relevant information on his phone and knew that expectant mothers could get hungry easily and needed better nutrition than usual.
So during the meal at the hotel, he had purposely packed an extra portion of dumplings to bring back for Han Xuewei’s supper.
The tenderness and thoughtfulness of Lin Yi were beyond what Han Xuewei had ever imagined. Watching him busying around, waves of sweetness washed over her heart.
The villa they lived in was fully furnished and required no additional setup; even the smallest decoration was already placed in its appropriate spot.
In the afternoon, both mothers were very diligent and had cleaned out the master bedroom. They briefly cleaned the rest of the place, making it just about suitable for living.
Tomorrow, they would hire a home cleaning service for a thorough clean-up, after which they could move in with peace of mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 11 - 11 This is the Rhythm of a House-Husband
chapters.content:
Chapter 11: Chapter 11 This is the Rhythm of a House-Husband
Just in a little while, Lin Yi came out carrying a plate full of dumplings and said with a smile, “Vivi, eat up, but be careful, it’s hot!”
“We’re still missing a few things in the kitchen, I’ll need to run to the supermarket tomorrow to stock up on the necessary daily items, and then we can live happily.”
“Ding!”
“Congratulations to the host for completing the task of making a midnight snack for your wife and child, and for acquiring the system reward of a set of High-Level Cooking Skills, plus 2 million in cash.”
What?
A herd of grass-mud horses galloped through Lin Yi’s heart in an instant.
Following the system’s beat, could it be that it wanted him to become a house-husband?
A man should prioritize his career; isn’t it disgraceful to spin around the kitchen all day long?
He glanced down slightly and saw Han Xuewei’s pregnant belly, sighed in his heart, and let it go. With a pregnant woman at home, this High-Level Cooking Skill would really come in handy.
Entering the kitchen for his wife and child wasn’t something to be ashamed of.
Han Xuewei, looking at the dumplings in the plate, felt her appetite surge and said with a sweet smile, “Thank you, it’s so good to have you!”
“Silly woman, thanking your own husband over and over, it’s really improper.”
Lin Yi stretched out his index finger, gently flicked her cute nose, and said very affectionately.
After speaking, he looked around and felt infinitely sentimental. Then, seeing Han Xuewei’s happy expression, he was pleased and said, “Vivi, this will be the home for our family of five from now on.”
“After we get the certificate tomorrow, we’ll be legally husband and wife, so we must manage our little home well.”
“Mhm! I’ll listen to you!”
Han Xuewei’s mouth was full of dumplings as she spoke, making her words somewhat muffled, yet utterly adorable.
“Lin Yi, you try some too; they’re delicious.”
At that moment, she picked up a dumpling and gently offered it to Lin Yi’s lips.
The dumpling, coming from the beauty’s hand, surely had a special flavor. Lin Yi, with eyes full of smiles, didn’t refuse. He took the dumpling, along with her chopsticks, into his mouth. Amorous elements undulated between them.
The couple took advantage of the late-night snack to unabashedly flirt with each other.
After a while, they finished their late-night meal and went upstairs to wash up and get ready to rest.
Everything prepared, Lin Yi felt a bit uneasy, picked up a blanket, and said, “I should probably sleep in the next room!”
Han Xuewei’s face flushed red, her eyes filled with reluctance. Seeing Lin Yi about to walk out the door, she anxiously grabbed hold of him, throwing caution and her shyness to the wind.
“Lin Yi, stay with me tonight!”
“We’re getting our certificate tomorrow, and we already have the baby; we’re legitimately husband and wife, so there’s no need to sleep separately.”
“Let’s… let’s just be natural about it.”
As she spoke, Han Xuewei’s cheeks were so red they seemed to bleed.
The night they conceived the child, both of them had been drinking, and it was a complete accident. This time, it would be a truly meaningful sharing of the bed. Between them, there was an added layer of shyness and discomfort.
“Vivi, don’t worry, I won’t do anything improper. I may be young and vigorous, but I can still distinguish right from wrong,” Lin Yi promised, holding Han Xuewei’s hand, reassuring her repeatedly.
No sooner had he finished speaking than his gaze quickly drifted away, truthfully unable to linger any longer.
His heart was in turmoil. A beauty of stunning grace stood before him, visible but untouchable, which man could endure that?
Had Han Xuewei not been pregnant, Lin Yi would never have endured such hardship.
But given the current circumstances, he had no choice but to bear with it. It was said online that the first three months of pregnancy were the most dangerous, and sexual intercourse could lead to complications.
The uncomfortable couple both got into bed, their bodies stiff as they lay facing away from each other. Lin Yi, struggling greatly with the restraint, bored and in agony, took out his phone, ready to play a game.
Just then, a sharp cry from Han Xuewei instantly clenched his heart.
“Vivi, what’s wrong? Are you feeling uncomfortable somewhere?”
Lin Yi quickly sat up, his voice filled with concern.
“Lin Yi, the baby moved. I just felt it clear as day, the baby moved inside my stomach. It’s an indescribably wonderful feeling.”
Han Xuewei’s eyes sparkled, her whole being radiated with joy as she spoke excitedly.
Hearing this, Lin Yi, about to become a father for the first time, marveled at the miracle of life, and reached out his hand, saying, “Vivi, can I feel it too?”
He asked tentatively, the child in Han Xuewei’s belly was his own flesh and blood; his excitement was irrepressible.
Seeing the look on Lin Yi’s face, Han Xuewei knew how much he cared about the child in her womb. She was instantly wrapped in a sense of bliss and rolled on her side to lie flat.
“Lin Yi, put your ear close to my stomach. Then you can hear what our child is up to. It’s such a happy feeling,” she said sweetly.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi quickly lay down, bowed his head, and pressed his ear to Han Xuewei’s belly, quieting his heart to feel carefully.
“Good baby, move a little, let your handsome dad see what you’re up to.”
“If there is anything you like or want, you can tell your handsome dad too. As soon as daddy graduates and starts working, no matter what nice things you want, we’ll buy them all!” Lin Yi spoke to the little treasure inside Han Xuewei’s belly.
After a while, no movement was felt from the baby, but instead, a voice from the system echoed in his mind.
“Ding!”
“Congratulations host for completing the tiny task of intimate contact with the baby and receiving a 200,000 reward from the system. You have three chances every day.”
Upon hearing the system’s voice, Lin Yi was immediately thrilled. As the child’s father, closeness with the baby came naturally.
With three chances a day to receive a reward, and at 200,000 each time, that was a total of 600,000.
It looked like there was no need to worry about money for baby formula and diapers in the future.
In this way, even if there were not just three children but a dozen, providing for them would not be an issue.
Han Xuewei looked at his silly expression and found it endearing, and couldn’t help but let out a soft laugh.
“You should brush up on your general knowledge. Our baby is only three months old and definitely can’t understand yet,” she teased with a smile.
“Vivi, you’re wrong there. The baby is over three months old now, and according to the information, at this stage, they are nearly fully formed. Fingers and toes have long developed.”
“The brain is one of the first organs to develop, and it should be getting more sophisticated by the day. Understanding their handsome dad’s words is definitely not a problem. Don’t move; let me talk to them a bit. It will be like prenatal education,” Lin Yi said earnestly.
Han Xuewei was successfully convinced and grabbed a pillow to prop behind her back, revealing her belly to continue letting Lin Yi communicate with the baby.
The relationship between them had grown much closer because of the little one in her stomach, turning the initial stiffness and embarrassment into nothingness.
Both their faces were brimming with smiles of happiness as they continually fantasized about their soon-to-be boisterous family of five.

chapters.title: Chapter 12 - 12 Lawful Spouses
chapters.content:
Chapter 12: Chapter 12 Lawful Spouses
