The two of them, having successfully diffused an awkward situation, quickly embraced one another and entered the land of dreams.
The next day came in the blink of an eye.
Unable to wait, both sets of parents, as soon as dawn broke, hailed a taxi directly to the villa where they lived, urging them to hurry up in hopes of being the first couple to get registered.
Both sets of parents were ready with their respective household registration books, waiting for the young couple to wake up and grab their ID cards. Supported by Lin Yi, a large group made their way majestically towards the civil affairs office.
The overly excited crowd, upon arrival at the doors of the civil affairs office, suddenly realized that taking photos was necessary for marriage registration.
And so, the parents dragged the two youngsters, bustling off to the photo studio and explaining the situation to the staff. Seated together, Weiwei leaned in slightly.
With a few clicks, the photos were taken.
Picking up the photos and once again supporting Han Xuewei, they returned to the civil affairs office and laid the photos, household registration books, and ID cards in front of the staff.
The staff member looked up, glanced over the group, and without further ado, entered various details, took out a red booklet, and put it into the printer.
There was a series of noises, and then the red booklet was taken out, the official stamp whipped out, and with a couple of firm thuds, it was stamped.
The booklets were handed over to them.
From that moment on, these two youngsters were declared a legally married couple.
Han Xuewei turned to look at Lin Yi, a sense of indescribable happiness spreading through her heart.
Lin Yi stepped forward and took Han Xuewei’s hand, saying, “Vivi, we’re husband and wife from now on, please take good care of me.”
His words made both sets of parents laugh.
A party of six once again dashed to the relevant stores to procure everything the home was lacking, cleaning out the inventory in one fell swoop. Inevitably, they carried bags large and small back to the house.
Before they left, they contacted a domestic service company first, wishing to have the company take advantage of the empty house to thoroughly clean it.
At the same time, they instructed to avoid using too much disinfectant, to prevent any harm to the expectant mother.
The Lin Family parents were even more thoughtful, moving their own nanny straight over to look after the young couple’s daily meals and living needs.
By the time they returned, the house had been scrubbed spotless; it was so clean and bright that it brought an instinctive sense of joy to everyone’s hearts.
Han Xuewei’s mother, seeing all the arrangements made by the Lin Family, was extraordinarily pleased. She was moved beyond words, feeling that her daughter had indeed married into a good family.
The marriage certificate had been obtained; they were officially a married couple, and there was nothing else to worry about.
As for the wedding celebration, there was no rush; it could wait until after the child was born.
At the moment, Han Xuewei was pregnant with a large belly, carrying triplets, and it was indeed inappropriate for her to exert herself, afraid that any bump or mishap would not be worth it in the end.
The family sat together on the couch, basking in an atmosphere of warm conviviality.
“Vivi, this is the maid from our home, one of our own and very considerate. Now I’ve brought her here to help you out. If you need anything, just tell her directly, don’t be shy,” Aunt Wang said.
“Even though I wish I could, I simply can’t come over to take care of you because I’m too tied up with work at home. I can only shamelessly apologize to you,” Lin Yi’s mother said, her face full of guilt, holding onto Han Xuewei’s hand tightly, not wanting to let go.
The Lin Family’s original maid heard her introduction and looked towards Han Xuewei, smiling affectionately.
Han Xuewei looked back at Lin Yi’s mother and replied with a gentle smile, “Thank you for the concern, Auntie. It’s wonderful to have you here.”
“Silly child, you’ve been pregnant for several months now, and still calling me ‘Auntie?’ You’re going to make me sad.”
Lin’s mother struck a gesture as if clutching her heart like Xi Shi and deliberately said.
Han Xuewei came back to her senses, her pretty face slightly red, and she whispered, “Dad, Mom, I’ve caused you trouble.”
“Ah!”
“Good child!”
Lin’s father was immediately so happy he couldn’t close his mouth.
The Lin Family of three looked at Han Xuewei with eyes full of intense affection and doting.
Han Xuewei’s mother, seeing her daughter being cherished both by the in-laws and son-in-law, finally felt relieved and was also happy for her daughter.
“Vivi, I promise you, as soon as I have time, I will come over right away. If there is anything I can help with, I will certainly not delay.”
“At the same time, you also don’t need to worry. As someone who’s been through it, I definitely won’t disturb the two of you. Young people, after all, need to build their relationship, and that’s a good thing,” Lin Yi’s mother said cheerfully.
“Oh, that’s right, Lin Yi. Vivi has already started calling us as she should, and that calling fee can’t just be dismissed. It’s a matter of etiquette. Don’t forget to send me Vivi’s account details later, I’ll transfer it as soon as I get back,” she continued.
“Vivi, the calling fee is a symbol of etiquette, you can’t refuse it,” Lin Yi’s mother remembered the calling fee matter and said once more.
Han Xuewei couldn’t decide at all at the moment and could only look at her own mother with eyes seeking help.
Mrs. Han nodded slightly, and then Han Xuewei continued, “Dad, Mom, thank you!”
“Vivi, you can rest assured and give birth to the child. We’re not that kind of irresponsible family. When it comes to the wedding, whether it’s the dowry or the three or five pieces of gold jewelry, we won’t shortchange you,” Lin Yi’s mother said with a smile.
“On the contrary, you are our family’s greatest hero, and your father and I truly adore you from the bottom of our hearts.”
Seeing her in-laws being so generous, Han Xuewei’s mother didn’t want to fall behind and took over the conversation, “About the car that we’ve promised for the dowry, do you think we should buy it now or wait until the wedding?”
Lin Yi promptly said, “Since it’s part of the dowry, then let’s buy it when the wedding takes place. Right now, the car isn’t the most important thing.”
“What should be prioritized is Vivi’s health. As long as she is well, everything else will surely come later,” he added.
Han Xuewei’s parents heard this and were even more satisfied in their hearts, praising that their daughter hadn’t chosen the wrong person.
“Aunt Wang, we’ll leave this little household in your hands! We hope you can take good care of them. Although these two young ones are already parents, they haven’t yet graduated from university and there’s a lot they don’t understand.”
“Or rather, they understand but don’t really grasp it fully. When they are confused, we hope you can remind them and take good care of them,” Lin Yi’s mother turned her gaze to the housekeeper and instructed.
“Sister Li, don’t worry, I will do my utmost to take care of these two children. Seeing them well also makes me happy,” the housekeeper Aunt Wang said.
Housekeeper Aunt Wang and Lin Yi’s mother were from the same family and had a good relationship. As Lin Yi’s mother was slightly older than Aunt Wang, she was addressed as Sister.
Lin Yi’s mother’s real name was Wang Li.
Aunt Wang also had her own family; her husband managed a breeding business at home, and she worked at the Lin Family’s house. Her children were also quite outstanding.
The elder son had graduated from university and had just started working. The younger daughter was attending university in another city and needed a monthly allowance.
Therefore, Aunt Wang had to continue working. As employers like the Lin Family were always considerate to her, she felt the warmth and naturally wanted to stay.

chapters.title: Chapter 13 - 13 We Must Save on the Bride Price
chapters.content:
Chapter 13: Chapter 13 We Must Save on the Bride Price
A group feasted beautifully on a family dinner at the villa before they each went their separate ways.
With Aunt Wang in charge, who constantly reminded the two youngsters at home, Lin Yi’s mother felt very reassured. Aunt Wang had been with their family for many years, and her temperament and working style were all too familiar.
Thinking of the triplets in Han Xuewei’s womb, a twinge of heartache rose in Lin’s mother’s heart. Other women suffered immensely just bearing a single child.
But her daughter-in-law was having three at once, the hardship she faced was undoubtedly multiple times that of others.
Therefore, Lin Yi’s mother decided to come over and help out at the young couple’s home during her spare time, determined to take good care of their living situation.
Now that their factory’s operations had scaled down, it was no longer as busy as before, and Lin Yi’s father could basically handle it on his own.
Suddenly, Lin’s mother turned to Lin’s father, who was driving, and said, “After we get back, let’s carefully calculate the money we have on hand. In the coming days, we must save wherever we can, and make sure to set the dowry money aside.”
“The in-laws are understanding and allowed the two kids to register their marriage smoothly, even offering a car as part of the dowry. We must not be ungrateful.”
“In my opinion, we should give as much as we can for the dowry money. After all, he’s our only child, and in the end, isn’t it all for them?”
“Besides, giving the in-laws face, giving our daughter-in-law pride, can bring our families closer and foster harmony, giving us two old folks something to rely on. Why not do it?”
“Although the in-laws don’t care and say that the dowry is just for show and any amount is fine, we can’t be too excessive. If it really comes down to it, let’s use the emergency fund!”
Lin’s father gripped the steering wheel and agreed with a serious nod, saying, “It seems that this time the emergency fund will have to be spent on our son and daughter-in-law.”
“The original funds set aside for our son’s marriage were completely used up during the company crisis. Fortunately, the emergency fund is substantial enough to cover the young couple’s wedding.”
“As for money, if it’s spent, we can earn it back. As long as everyone is happy and satisfied with completing this matter, it’s a cause for great celebration.”
“To be honest, when I first received the call from our son, I was a bit slow to react. We are so young and suddenly became grandparents; I bet not many people would believe it.”
“Vivi is a good girl, not only pretty and academically successful but also has blessed us with triplets, increasing our family by three grandchildren. Compared to other families, who can boast such fortune?”
Lin’s father’s face was brimming with excitement, making him look somewhat endearing.
At first, he was completely baffled and couldn’t accept it, repeatedly muttering about being too young to become grandparents.
But just the thought of having two or three little ones toddling behind him or sitting on his lap, pulling at his beard with their delicate hands and sweetly calling him grandpa, filled him with a wonderful feeling.
Seeing Lin’s father agree to the idea of using the emergency fund eased Lin Yi’s mother’s mind, which had been up in the air.
The couple had agreed that this emergency fund should not be touched unless absolutely necessary.
Following the crisis, their finances had taken a severe hit, leaving them with a preliminary estimate of about two million. But Han Xuewei was carrying triplets.
Just the expenses for baby formula and diapers alone would be a considerable sum.
Their son and daughter-in-law, not yet having graduated from university and still in internships, couldn’t support themselves, let alone raise children. This heavy burden could only fall on the shoulders of the elderly couple.
For a moment, the old couple felt like money was flowing away like water, gushing forward.
Now, with the economy being tough, they could only just get by.
Fortunately, their son Lin Yi was competent right from the start and knew how to save money. He saved his pocket money, had a sharp mind, and was cut out for business.
He went straight into investment, and a year ago, he settled the matter of his marital home. That greatly reduced their burden. Otherwise, with just the money they had on hand, it would have been difficult to even buy an apartment in the city center, let alone a villa.
Lin Yi’s mother, while speaking, took out her phone, found WeChat, searched for Han Xuewei among new friends, quickly added her, and, after waiting for the approval, she hurriedly sent some words expressing her concern.
Immediately after, she transferred 300,000 yuan for the bride price and instructed Han Xuewei to rest, not to do any chores, to take care of herself, to exercise appropriately, and so on.
Han Xuewei received the message and immediately sent back a smiley face, followed by a big bouquet of fresh flowers, sweetly saying, “Thank you, mom, I promise to give you several healthy grandsons.”
At that time, Aunt Wang invited Lin Yi to the living room on the first floor and said seriously, “Lin Yi, tell Auntie honestly, are you and Vivi still sleeping together?”
Lin Yi was momentarily stunned, his ears turned slightly red, and he arched an eyebrow in response, “Yes, Auntie, Vivi and I are husband and wife, we sleep in the same bed, is there something wrong with that?”
Aunt Wang looked up at the second floor, didn’t hear Han Xuewei’s voice, and then lowered her voice to say, “Lin Yi, are you being foolish?”
“Vivi is only just over three months pregnant, if you two sleep together and you can’t hold back, saying something that could hurt the children, that would be terrible.”
“Even later on, when Vivi is further along, you still can’t do that sort of thing. After all, she is carrying triplets, which is different from other pregnant women.”
“Lin Yi, you’re a man, there are some things you should not indulge in, and you must take care of your wife and children.”
Aunt Wang was very close to Lin Yi, and emotionally, she could be considered half a mother to Lin Yi.
She came to the Lin Family when Lin Yi was not even five years old. Lin Yi’s parents were busy with their business every day, and Lin Yi was not raised alongside Wang Yi.
That’s why she didn’t hesitate to voice her concerns without any reservations.
“Auntie, rest assured.”
“I know all this. Do you think the Lin Yi you raised would be so irresponsible? If a man doesn’t even care for his wife and children, what kind of man would that be?”
Lin Yi came to his senses, understood what Aunt Wang meant, and quickly responded with a smile.
Aunt Wang smiled happily and said, “It makes me happy to hear you think this way. I know your character, and I trust you won’t do anything reckless.”
“Besides, both of you are university graduates with access to a wide range of information. You know well what should and shouldn’t be done, so I won’t say more.”
“I need to go down to the storeroom and organize the stuff we bought today so it’s convenient when we need it.”
“Almost forgot, can you ask Vivi for me what she’d like for supper tonight? So I can prepare.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi immediately perked up and said, “Auntie, you’ve been busy all day, take some rest. I can handle the supper.”

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Unceasing System Rewards
chapters.content:
Chapter 14: Unceasing System Rewards
Making a late-night snack, Lin Yi was more than happy.
He had already acquired high-level cooking skills, and the food he made, he was certain his wife and child would definitely love.
Also, he could get rewards from the system, so why not?
Aunt Wang felt very comforted, yawned, and said, “Alright then, you guys take care of the night snack yourselves, I’m going to check the storeroom and then go straight to bed.”
Lin Yi agreed and walked towards the second floor, their child was already more than three months old, and it was very nice to start bonding with them early.
In the bedroom, Han Xuewei was leaning against the headboard, holding her phone, and continuously checking it.
Lin Yi walked in, went straight to her side, and said tenderly, “Wife, what are you playing with? You’re so focused.”
The word “wife,” filled with endless indulgence and magic power, made Han Xuewei unable to resist the desire to immerse herself in that tenderness and reliance.
Although Lin Yi said it very smoothly, when Han Xuewei heard it, she couldn’t help but feel a wave of sweetness in her heart.
So she looked up slightly, and said tenderly, “My parents are going back tomorrow, I’m booking high-speed train tickets for them.”
“They could’ve stayed a few more days with you, no need to rush, they could come stay at our house tomorrow,”
said Lin Yi.
“No need, there are a bunch of things to do at home. Moreover, my mom still has to work, she can’t take too many days off, and she still needs to save some leave for her annual vacation,”
said Han Xuewei, shaking her head.
“Alright then, what time is their train tomorrow? Let’s go together to see them off,” Lin Yi said.
Han Xuewei smiled sweetly and said, “Okay! We can prepare some local specialties for them to take back, I’m sure they’ll like that.”
“Ah, I almost forgot about that. Mom just transferred the ‘change of tongue’ fee over, 300,000, that’s really too much. I haven’t accepted it yet, I want to follow your opinion.”
“This is the proper courtesy, go ahead and accept it, why wouldn’t you? If you don’t, they’ll really be hurt, feeling like you don’t acknowledge them,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
Han Xuewei’s face turned slightly red, and she said bashfully, “It really is too much, Mom even told me to send over my bank account number, for large amounts in the future, to go directly through bank transactions, saying it would be more secure that way.”
“They’ve transferred so much money to me right after we got our marriage certificate, I… ”
“What’s so strange about that? If Mom tells you to take it, just take it. My parents are so happy about having a grandson, they can’t get enough of it. They said not to let you and the child suffer even a smidgen of hardship.”
“You’re the hero in our family, from now on I won’t dare to mess with you, knowing my parents’ style, they’re definitely the type to prefer the daughter-in-law over the son,” Lin Yi joked.
“Don’t worry about those things, just focus on taking care of yourself and the baby. Come on, let me listen to the baby’s movements today, surely feeling the emotions will help the baby grow,” Lin Yi said.
After speaking, Lin Yi lay down, his ear against Han Xuewei’s stomach, and listened intently.
“Daddy’s good babies, are you happy in mommy’s tummy? When can you come out and meet your handsome dad?”
“You must be good, okay? Mommy is already working so hard; don’t you fuss.”
Lin Yi lay on Han Xuewei’s belly, speaking with a face full of indulgence.
Han Xuewei leaned against the pillow, propping up her head with her elbows, and seeing Lin Yi loving the children so much made her feel incredibly sweet. Her tender gaze fell on him.
The man in front of her, she had liked him for many years, and now, not only could they be together and have a marriage certificate, they also had a baby on the way. At this moment, she felt like the happiest woman in the world.
“Ding dong!”
The sound of Lin Yi’s incoming payment notification rang out.
No need to look, Lin Yi knew it was the reward he had received for bonding with the baby just now.
At this moment, Lin Yi saw a clear account in his mind: three chances a day, ten thousand yuan as a reward for each time, which is a direct 9 million yuan a month.
Providing for the family was no problem at all.
A regular worker definitely couldn’t make that much money in a year!
Even for those who ran their own companies, there might be months when their businesses didn’t do so well and they couldn’t earn that much.
Suddenly, a thought flashed through his mind: virtual companies and investments are really too illusory, and someday someone would see through it all.
If worst came to worst, should he really start his own company to legitimize all these sources of income? Even a family of five’s needs could be met with dignity.
However, there was no rush to start a company, regardless, it was better to wait until the child was born. At present, the most important thing was to take good care of his wife and child.
As long as he had this omnipotent system at hand, providing for his family was no problem at all.
The problem he was now considering was how to be a good husband and a good father, to care for his wife and child with meticulous attention, not allowing them to suffer the slightest grievance.
“Ding!”
“Just now the system detected the host’s heart harbors the ambition to be a good father and a good husband, and the system has decided to reward the host with 2 million yuan in cash.”
The system’s voice sounded in Lin Yi’s mind.
What?
Lin Yi’s eyes widened in surprise; he hadn’t expected to receive a reward just for having that kind of thought.
Good Lord, is money just a number to the system?
“The host has guessed right, to the system, money is just a number, meaningless.”
The system’s responding voice sounded again.
Uh!
This system is awesome, it can even answer the host’s questions.
Lin Yi stopped interacting with the system and concentrated on speaking, communicating with the baby in Han Xuewei’s belly, simply taking a book and reading it with cadence and emotion.
At that moment, movement came from Han Xuewei’s belly, as if the baby had turned over, brushing past Lin Yi’s face, the sensation was very clear.
Han Xuewei was also overflowing with excitement; she distinctly felt it. One of the babies in her belly, either turned over or gave a little kick, was quite noticeable.
The young couple looked at each other excitedly, as if by prior agreement.
“Vivi, I felt the baby.”
“Yes, it seems like one of the babies turned over.”
The couple wished they could come together immediately, to discuss the wonder of this life.
“Vivi, we must buy a fetal heartbeat monitor so we can clearly hear the heartbeat of the babies.”
“At three months, they can turn over and make their parents feel the movement. I think their vitality must be very strong. Just thinking about their thumping heartbeats makes me uncontrollably excited.”
Lin Yi said with a glowing expression.
This magical feeling was something he was experiencing for the first time, and he felt that he had gotten one step closer to the baby.

chapters.title: Chapter 15 - 15 Money is Just a Number
chapters.content:
Chapter 15: Chapter 15 Money is Just a Number
“Ding!”
“Congratulations to the host and baby for the zero-distance contact, the system rewards you with a cash prize of 100,000 yuan.”
At this moment, the system’s voice came over again.
While happy, Lin Yi made up his mind that after seeing off his in-laws tomorrow, he must go to the baby store and bring back all the necessary baby products.
He washed them clean for future use to avoid any last-minute rush.
He looked up at Han Xuewei and said seriously, “Vivi, I think we need to prepare some baby products, like bottles and little clothes.”
“I’ve checked, and we must buy these things in advance, wash them, and get them ready. It’ll make things much more convenient later on.”
“What time is the ticket you booked for Mom and Dad tomorrow?”
With her fingers gracefully dancing on the phone screen, Han Xuewei said, “About 11 o’clock, we can totally sleep in a bit, no need to wake up early.”
“Isn’t it perfect? After we see them off, we can join them for breakfast and then take them to the high-speed rail station—not too late at all.”
Lin Yi turned tomorrow’s schedule over in his mind and immediately made a plan: after having breakfast with his in-laws, he would take them to the high-speed rail station.
On the way back, head straight to the baby store and bag everything needed. The previous day, with both sets of parents around, everyone had forgotten about this, and everyday spices and things for Vivi were priority. Without realizing it, they could have neglected the babies.
Having planned everything, Lin Yi said to Han Xuewei, “Wife, after we drop off your parents, let’s go buy the stuff straight away. After shopping, we can have lunch out, and then you’ll have plenty of time to rest in the afternoon.”
“Of course, if you feel tired, staying home to rest is also fine. I can handle these tasks on my own.”
Han Xuewei quickly agreed with a nod, the man she had adored for years, though they were now married, had not yet reached the depth of emotion she yearned for.
How could she not seize such an opportunity to spend quality time together?
“No worries, you don’t have to be anxious. It’s only been just over three months, and my belly isn’t fully showing yet. Besides, selecting the children’s items, it’s better if I do it myself.”
Han Xuewei looked at Lin Yi tenderly and said.
“Alright then!”
“The two of us, along with our three little treasures, will go shopping and bring back everything they need.”
Lin Yi said excitedly while caressing Han Xuewei’s belly.
After speaking, he made playful faces at Han Xuewei, indulgent and gentle.
Han Xuewei blushed, her heart filled with sweetness, like a little fairy who had just fallen in love. She thought Lin Yi’s smile was warm and sunny, making it irresistible to get lost in it.
For a moment, Han Xuewei was spellbound, completely forgetting to respond, gazing at Lin Yi with endless love. In Lin Yi’s eyes, however, it was a boundless temptation.
Lin Yi’s lips curved into an even brighter smile, and he said in a raspy voice, “Wife, snap out of it, don’t play with fire! I really can’t resist this kind of extreme temptation.”
Before Han Xuewei could react, he pounced, avoiding her belly and pressing down on her tightly, breathing heavily.
Husband and wife, eyes locked.
The ambiance of intimacy swiftly spread between them. A tendril of affection, unnoticed at first, enshrouded them, and an infinite sweetness surged in their hearts.
The temperature around them gradually rose, showing signs of spiraling out of control.
At that moment, Han Xuewei snapped back to reality and quickly stretched out her hands to protect her belly, trying to break free.
Lin Yi felt Han Xuewei’s struggle, knew the reason, and couldn’t help but smile helplessly, gently stroking her hair as he looked into her eyes and said, “Silly girl, what are you thinking about? Is your husband really that much of a scoundrel?”
After he finished, his deep and pleasing voice echoed by Han Xuewei’s ear.
Suddenly, Han Xuewei stopped struggling, and with a swift move, she tightly hugged Lin Yi’s neck, gazing at him with deep affection.
Just as Lin Yi was sinking deeper, she quickly pecked Lin Yi’s face with the speed of lightning.
Boom!
“Silly woman, you started this fire; you’re responsible for putting it out.”
The strings in Lin Yi’s mind snapped, disregarding everything else, he swiftly pulled Han Xuewei into his arms and domineeringly lowered his head, sealed her red lips without any explanation.
Han Xuewei’s mind was also blank, responding innocently, with an indescribable sweetness continuously rising from her heart.
Lin Yi had long lost control of himself, his hands roamed ceaselessly over Han Xuewei’s body, feeling the flame inside growing even fiercer, wishing he could vent immediately.
“Ding!”
“Congratulations to the host for successfully activating the special function and directly receiving a cash reward of 10 million.”
As he was unable to extract himself, that slightly indifferent voice of the system entered his mind.
Suddenly, Lin Yi shivered, came to his senses, and quickly jumped away, swiftly tidying Han Xuewei’s clothes, looking intently at her as he immediately created some distance between them.
“Danger!”
“Wife, we can’t yet, we must consider the safety of the child and your health.”
“I’m very sorry, I really lost control just now.”
The sober Lin Yi quickly turned his gaze away, apologizing.
Meanwhile, he took deep breaths, telling himself to calm down, striving for the fire inside him to die down quickly.
Han Xuewei’s cheeks were as red as cooked shrimp. Thinking about the kiss they had just shared, her heart couldn’t help but race.
Lin Yi dared not look back, quickly got up, and rushed to the door, before managing to turn around and say, “Let’s sleep separately tonight! Sleeping together is simply too dangerous.”
“If you need anything, or if there’s any problem, just call for me, I’ll come right over. I’ll… I’ll… need to calm down a bit…”
Seeing the retreating figure of Lin Yi, a slight smile played on Han Xuewei’s lips, her heart filled with sweetness. From the beginning, she had known that Lin Yi would never do such a thing.
So there she sat on the bed, smiling foolishly to herself, reaching out to gently touch her own lips. The scene just now kept replaying in her mind.
She thought: This feeling is simply too wonderful. Is this what it feels like to be intimate with the person you love?
The fleeing Lin Yi had just reached the doorway when Aunt Wang grabbed him, giving him quite a start.
“Aunt, why are you here? Didn’t you say you were tired and went to rest?”
Lin Yi asked in astonishment.
Without a doubt, from the look on Aunt Wang’s face, she had been eavesdropping, and she likely heard everything, which instantly made Lin Yi feel somewhat embarrassed.

chapters.title: Chapter 16 - 16 Should Buy a Car
chapters.content:
Chapter 16: Chapter 16 Should Buy a Car
Aunt Wang was far from courteous, directly reaching out to slap Lin Yi on the head and starting her lecture, “You little rascal, haven’t I told you before?”
“It’s a dangerous period right now, and you shouldn’t act recklessly. It’s only a matter of a few months, isn’t it? Why can’t you endure it? How many men have undergone this?”
“If you don’t listen to your aunt and continue to behave irresponsibly, you’ll regret it.”
“Vivi is pregnant with triplets; we must be even more careful and not a bit negligent.”
Lin Yi was caught between laughter and tears, plaintively saying, “Auntie, you are really making a mountain out of a molehill. We didn’t do anything, just kissed, that’s all.”
“I think that shouldn’t have any effect, right?”
Aunt Wang gave a resigned smile and said, “Child, don’t blame your aunt for being strict. All this is for your own good. If it’s just a simple kiss, then there’s nothing to criticize.”
“But what if during the process of kissing you can’t help yourself? Being swayed by emotions and desires is only human. The difference between humans and animals is the ability to withstand our own desires.”
“Not to cause harm to others, that’s what true skill is.”
“Your mother is smart to have sent me here to keep watch, otherwise who knows when disaster might strike.”
Lin Yi was so embarrassed by the scolding that he repeatedly begged for mercy, “Auntie, please spare me. You mean well, I know that. I promise I won’t do that again, is holding hands okay at most?”
Aunt Wang couldn’t help but snort with laughter at Lin Yi’s words, not believing a single one, but there was nothing she could do as both kids were young and struggling to control themselves.
It seemed she had to keep a closer eye on them in the future to prevent any irreversible issues from happening, now that would be a real regret.
Aunt Wang made up her mind in her heart.
“Enough, as long as you are aware, you’ve had a long day, go to sleep now!”
Aunt Wang, looking at the child she had raised from young, felt a wave of pity and promptly said.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi felt as if he’d been pardoned and immediately turned into a slippery fish, swiftly dashing into the guest room, closing the door, and with a leap landed on the bed, sprawling out in a starfish pose.
His mind leaped to the special reward the system had mentioned, stirring his curiosity; up till now, he had received countless cash rewards, just not sure how to trigger this special reward.
He only remembered that a simple kiss with Han Xuewei had inadvertently triggered the special reward.
Could a kiss really fetch a special reward?
Lin Yi was utterly baffled.
“Ding!”
“Host, please note, special tasks are randomly assigned by the system and there is no fixed pattern. When they occur, it is good if the host can seize the opportunity, there’s no need to delve into it further.”
Just then, the system’s voice rang out in his mind again.
Lin Yi couldn’t help but roll his eyes.
This lousy system really knew how to play games—random, wasn’t it all up to its whims?
Definitely unreliable.
However, Lin Yi vividly remembered at the same time that when the special task was triggered, they were indeed kissing, and that very moment, he received a reward of 10 million.
By that logic, if they did something else? Or perhaps went a step further, could it trigger a special task, therefore getting even more rewards?
Endless guesses swirled in Lin Yi’s mind.
It really was no use, they tried everything they could, and earning a bit more money was pretty good after all.
At this thought, Lin Yi’s mind suddenly filled with visions, and Han Xuewei’s devilish figure lingered in his mind, an audacious plan forming in his heart.
The next day.
The young couple got up almost at the same time, got ready, walked out the door, and took a taxi straight to Han Xuewei’s parents’ hotel.
After having breakfast with Han Xuewei’s parents, they took a taxi to the high-speed rail station, ready to see them onto the train.
At that moment, Lin Yi felt an intense desire—he had to buy a car for commuting.
Without a car, it was extremely inconvenient, especially since Han Xuewei had a big belly and it was not convenient to take taxis, he had no choice but to accompany her on foot.
For a pregnant woman, it was just too hard.
Aunt Wang, who shopped for groceries every day, had to take taxis everywhere, and it was very inconvenient to transport even a little extra.
It seemed not only did the couple need a car for commuting, but Aunt Wang, who shopped for groceries, also urgently needed one.
Funds were not an issue at all, as up to now, Lin Yi’s hands already held tens of millions, enough to buy any car he desired.
The young couple planned to immediately go to the maternity store and purchase everything they needed after sending the parents off on the high-speed train.
At the high-speed rail station, naturally, a scene of parting unfolded.
Han Xuewei watched her parents gradually recede into the distance and couldn’t help but feel an onset of sadness, even though the man by her side was her beloved, the bond of family was still irreplaceable.
Han Xuewei sighed in her heart, everything had happened too quickly, as if just yesterday she was still a girl by her parents’ side, and in the blink of an eye, she had to leave her parents and live her own life.
“Wife, don’t be sad, it’s not good for the baby. When we have time, we’ll go and see mom and dad properly, or maybe when they have time, I’ll bring them over to keep you company,” Lin Yi said tenderly, holding Han Xuewei in his arms, constantly comforting her.
Han Xue’s mother, as she walked farther away, couldn’t help but look back and see the young couple leaning on each other, feeling an endless sigh in her heart, but at the same time, she was able to let go.
The girl had grown up; this step was inevitable, it just came faster than expected.
Only when the backs of Han Xue’s parents completely disappeared did Han Xuewei wipe her eyes and allow Lin Yi to half-support and half-embrace her towards the temporary taxi stand.
On the high-speed train.
Han Xuewei’s father was gloomy and sighed deeply.
Han Xue’s mother lifted her head to look at Han Xue’s father and said, “Lao Han, Vivi has found a good home, meeting such a family, we should be content. What’s there to sigh about?”
Han Xue’s father sighed again and replied, “I understand all that you’re saying. I’m happy for our daughter to have found such a person.”
“It’s just, when I think about my daughter, whom I’ve raised for so many years, my pearl that I held in my palm, in just a blink of an eye, she’s married to someone else. It’s honestly hard for me to accept this kind of drop in my heart.”
Han Xue’s mother smiled slightly and comforted him, “Don’t think too much. Now that Vivi is pregnant, it’s not good to fuss about the wedding dress. After the child is born, we’ll still need to follow all the necessary rituals.”
“Luckily, the in-laws are understanding and considerate towards Vivi. We don’t need to feel lost. With transportation so convenient, whenever we miss our daughter, we can come up to see her.”
“In a few months, I will have a few more grandchildren, we are going to be grandparents, we should be happy about it.”
Han Xue’s father gave Han Xue’s mother a blank stare and said irritably, “Enough, after all this talk, you still don’t understand.”

chapters.title: Chapter 17: The Inseparable Attachment of Parents
chapters.content:
Chapter 17: The Inseparable Attachment of Parents
Han’s mother’s eyes suddenly became vacant, not because she had never felt that way, but because she saw her daughter could be happy, that she had found a reliable family to marry into, and this was what finally eased her mind.
Vivi was her only child, and the greatest concern of her life. Now that her daughter was getting married all of a sudden, to say her heart wasn’t a bit heavy would certainly be a lie.
But as a woman, Han’s mother naturally knew where a woman’s destination lay. No matter how much parents doted on their daughter, she couldn’t stay at home for her entire life.
Nowadays, there were no more stay-at-home sons-in-law, and moreover, they were not easy to get along with.
The parents-in-law were understanding and reasonable, and the son-in-law was extremely affectionate toward her daughter. Having children, they were indeed on the right track in life.
As long as her daughter could lead a good life, no matter how much reluctance she felt, she could only keep it in her heart.
Gradually, the tears of Han’s mother uncontrollably started to spill from her eyes.
Han’s mother felt as if her heart was suddenly missing a large piece, hollow and unable to find a place to lean on.
“Old Han, we who have raised daughters must eventually face this scene. As long as our daughter is happy, we can be at ease. Our daughter now has a home of her own, getting married and having children is a joyous occasion, let’s not be sad,” she said, lifting her arm to fiercely wipe her eyes, her voice choked with emotion.
“In a few years, I’ll be able to retire. Then, you can close down your company, and we’ll buy a small apartment next to our daughter’s, settling down here for the long term, and we’ll be able to see our daughter and grandchildren often,” she said.
“So, in these few years, we both need to earn more money to achieve this goal. Just thinking about being close to our daughter makes me feel settled,” she said, and as she spoke, she was the first to laugh, her heart filled with boundless anticipation.
With a deep sigh, Han’s father said, “How can my ‘company’ just be closed down like that? I still envy you government workers who can retire a few years earlier.”
“The employees in the company have worked with me for most of their lives, relying on the business to feed their families. If we suddenly announce a closure, what will happen to their families?”
“We can’t just think about ourselves and completely ignore them,” he said.
Getting old Han to close down the company was just a pipe dream. Nobody could persuade him.
At that moment, old Han was lost in thought.
Suddenly, old Han raised his head, his eyes shining as he said, “Wife, there’s a good solution to this. We can hand the company over to our son-in-law to manage.”
“We have only this one daughter, and our entire fortune will ultimately be left to them anyway.”
“The staff are all long-time employees. I know their temperaments well. There’s no need to be there every day, just manage occasionally,” he said.
“Anyway, our son-in-law hasn’t found a job yet, so letting him manage the company would be perfect. Once he gets on the right track, if he wants to expand on a large scale, the company isn’t far from here, and it can be done,” he continued.
“In this way, our son-in-law can balance family and career,” he concluded.
Upon hearing this, Han’s mother’s face lit up with joy as she nodded and said, “Old Han is the more thoughtful one, such an arrangement is indeed the best.”
“But how much money do you have on hand right now? I have about a million left here, and buying a small apartment there will require a substantial amount,” she said.
After a moment of reflection, old Han said candidly, “I have a few million on hand, but it’s all in fixed deposits. I was planning to use it to buy an apartment for Vivi as her dowry when she married.”
“It’s just that now that the son-in-law has become successful, the matter of the wedding house has been resolved. There’s no need to buy another house, as buying too many would be a waste of resources. Besides, compared to the son-in-law’s villa, any house we could offer as a dowry would just be a small witch seeing a great sorcerer.”
“So I plan to give a car as part of the dowry, but even that will cost several million. Add to that some gold and silver jewelry, and it will pretty much use up the money I have saved in fixed deposits.”
Upon hearing this, Han Xue’s mother was also happy and said, “Your plan isn’t bad, as long as our daughter lives a good life, everything else is a minor matter.”
“Our son-in-law is a reliable and dependable man, and the in-laws are understanding and reasonable. I believe Vivi will have a comfortable and smooth life in the future. That’s enough for us.”
The couple on the high-speed train seemed to be warming each other up.
Despite holding a thousand reluctant and helpless feelings in their hearts, thinking about their daughter’s future allowed them to breathe a sigh of relief, feeling optimistic about what’s to come.
On Lin Yi’s side.
After sending off their parents, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei headed to the temporary taxi stand and took a cab to Xiangcheng’s largest maternity and baby store—Xiangcheng Maternity & Baby.
As soon as they walked in, a sharp-eyed salesperson noticed Han Xuewei’s slightly bulging belly and then glanced at their age and the hands tightly held together.
She immediately understood that they were a newlywed couple, likely here to buy some items for their child due to the pregnancy.
The salesperson eagerly approached them and said, “Mr. and Mrs., are you here to prepare things for the child? Then you’ve come to the right place. Our Xiangcheng Maternity & Baby store has a complete range of products, everything you could need.”
“For newborn babies, besides preparing their inner and outer clothes, other items like bottles, nipples, formula, and such also need to be ready.”
“Moreover, our Baby City has launched a promotion. If you participate in it, you can get a postnatal gift package, which will take care of all the things the Mrs. needs for childbirth.”
The salesperson chatted enthusiastically, leading them and introducing them cheerily to various products.
Lin Yi, with a smile, replied, “Beauty, we’re expecting triplets, so we need a bit more stuff. Could you prepare a trolley for us to stack what we like together?”
Upon hearing this, the salesperson became visibly excited and exclaimed, “Triplets? Mrs. is really amazing, and the Mr. is a lucky man, congratulations!”
As the salesperson offered congratulations, she fetched a shopping cart for them. With her guidance, Lin Yi and his wife quickly selected a number of baby items.
All the items Han Xuewei needed for childbirth had also been bought.
They also purchased a variety of baby clothes. They planned to take them home and wash and prepare them beforehand to avoid a last-minute scramble.
“Sir, the total is 5,800 yuan. Will you be paying by card, WeChat, or cash?” the salesperson asked happily, looking at the many items.
Lin Yi took out his phone and paid by scanning a QR code.
Han Xuewei was ready to help carry some items, but Lin Yi refused.
Lin Yi asked Han Xuewei to be careful walking and took all the bags himself. The salesperson said they could use the shopping cart to take the items out and she would bring the cart back after they had loaded everything into the car.
Lin Yi and his wife expressed their thanks and, pushed by the salesperson, headed toward the exit of the store with Lin Yi supporting Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei looked at her husband beside her and then at the pile of baby items, feeling extremely sweet inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 18 - 17 Another Reward Received
chapters.content:
Chapter 18: Chapter 17 Another Reward Received
Just then, the voice of the system entered Lin Yi’s mind again.
“Ding!”
“As the host is buying baby items for the first time, the system has decided to grant the host a baby items fund, rewarding the host with 200,000 yuan.”
Lin Yi was somewhat bewildered, never expecting that buying things for his child could also earn him a reward from the system.
It seemed the system could do whatever it wanted.
If he bought many things for his child in the future, did it mean he could get rewards until his hands were sore from receiving them?
At this moment, the sales associate suddenly remembered something and said, “Sir, please push the cart for a moment, I almost forgot. Our mall is having a promotion. If a couple comes together and spends over 5000 yuan, they will receive a set of parenting books for free.”
“I was so busy talking just now that I forgot about it. I’ll go get them for you right away.”
After saying this, the sales associate parked the shopping cart to the side and quickly ran to the counter.
In the blink of an eye, she came back holding a set of books, breathing somewhat heavily, lifted it in front of the couple, and placed it in their shopping cart, suggesting they look through it later.
When they reached the taxi stand, a car happened to come by. Lin Yi hailed it and loaded each item from the cart into the taxi’s trunk.
Before they left, the sales associate hurriedly took out her business card and placed it in Han Xuewei’s hand, saying, “Madam, here is my business card.”
“If you need anything in the future, you can call me. As long as you are in this city, we can deliver it right to your door. In the later stages, Madam will be heavier and needn’t run back and forth for small items.”
The sales associate knew very well that in this day and age, a family that could afford to have and raise triplets certainly wouldn’t be an ordinary one.
Moreover, a consumption of five or six thousand yuan didn’t even make the gentleman blink. Young as he was, he looked just like a college student, but with such economic strength, he must either come from a substantial background or a distinguished family.
In either case, if handled properly, they could certainly become a big client for her.
Han Xuewei glanced at Lin Yi and, seeing him nod, she took the business card and put it away, thanking the sales associate once more. Then, the couple took the taxi and soon disappeared from sight in a trail of exhaust.
At that moment, Aunt Wang called. Han Xuewei answered the phone and immediately Aunt Wang’s voice came through, “Vivi, are you planning to eat lunch out, or will you come back to eat?”
Han Xuewei did not answer right away but turned to look at Lin Yi and whispered, “Aunt is asking about our lunch plan, where shall we eat?”
Lin Yi looked at her with affectionate eyes and said, “Where do you want to eat? As your belly grows, it won’t be convenient to come out often.”
“I want to eat out before we go back,” Han Xuewei said directly.
Lin Yi caressed Han Xuewei’s hair indulgently and said, “Then let’s have the driver deliver our things back home while we go out for a meal before resting, just let Aunt know, and it will be fine.”
Aunt Wang, on the other end of the phone, heard everything loud and clear. She smiled cheerfully and said briskly, “You can have the driver send the stuff back to me first.”
“Go enjoy your meal with no worries!”
“Just remember that Vivi needs to be careful with her diet, make sure you eat healthy food.”
“Thank you, Aunt, we got it, goodbye,” replied Han Xuewei sweetly and then hung up.
“So where shall we go for lunch? This is the first time we’re eating out together, it’s kind of like our first date,” Han Xuewei said with sparkling eyes and a shy tone.
Lin Yi laughed and said, “That’s right. So we absolutely need something classy. Just going to a random place really doesn’t show the sincerity of my love for my wife. What would you like to eat in your heart?”
Han Xuewei replied, “Anything is fine, as long as there’s food. I’m not picky.”
Lin Yi rolled his eyes, thinking to himself, could it be that all women are like this?
“Let’s go to Piaoxue Villa. I’ve heard the scenery there is beautiful, and dining while enjoying the views, that’s truly romantic. Moreover, the food is very delicious, I guarantee you’ll like it,”
Lin Yi continued.
Han Xuewei looked a bit shocked as she said, “Piaoxue Villa? Maybe we shouldn’t? The consumption there is really high. There’s no need to waste that much money.”
Lin Yi sighed inwardly, wondering if all women were like this or if it was just pregnant women?
“It’s just Piaoxue Villa; we can afford it. We’re going there. Just think, this is our first date. No matter how expensive it is, we have to go,”
“In our lives, we can’t have any regrets. That’s settled then,”
Lin Yi stated in a very assertive manner.
Han Xuewei’s heart instantly filled with sweetness, and without saying anything more, agreed with Lin Yi’s reasoning. This was their first date for a meal, and it wouldn’t feel right if it was too simple and lacked a sense of ceremony.
“Driver, please take us to Piaoxue Villa first, and then you can deliver these things back to number nine, Guixiang Garden. Thank you for your troubles,”
Lin Yi instructed directly.
Before long, the young couple appeared at Piaoxue Villa.
Piaoxue Villa, true to its name, was covered in a cloak of white, a stark contrast to the city of Xiangcheng.
Upon seeing it, Han Xuewei felt naturally joyful, wanting to hop and skip around to admire the landscape, but Lin Yi caught hold of her arm. That’s when she came back to her senses, belatedly remembering she was a pregnant woman.
So, supported by Lin Yi’s arm, she walked slowly, admiring the endless beauty that was utterly refreshing.
At that moment, a villa attendant approached and simply greeted, “Mr. and Mrs., welcome! Can I assist you with anything?”
Lin Yi responded, “We’ve come to eat. Show us your menu.”
The attendant handed Lin Yi the menu and then introduced some dishes and arranged a private room.
Lin Yi chose dishes according to Han Xuewei’s tastes, handed them to the attendant for preparation, and then leisurely supported Han Xue, soaking in Piaoxue Villa’s breathtaking views.
Lin Yi turned his head, looked at Han Xuewei, and felt an immense sense of wonder at how quickly time had passed. In what seemed like the blink of an eye, he had gone from being single to a husband and a father-to-be.
A heavy responsibility weighed on his shoulders, accompanied by a gentle sense of happiness that spread through his heart.
“Vivi, how do you like me to call you? Wife or Vivi?” Lin Yi asked with a smile.
Han Xuewei gave a shy smile, lifted her head to look at Lin Yi, and said, “Whatever you like to call me, I like them all. But can I call you ‘husband’ from now on?”
The newlyweds, though together through unexpected circumstances, would feel somewhat distant if they still addressed each other by their full names.
Lin Yi happily answered, “However you’d like to call is fine, though ‘husband’ is certainly the best.”

chapters.title: Chapter 19 - 19 Is it because of the child?
chapters.content:
Chapter 19: Chapter 19 Is it because of the child?
“Alright, husband, I still prefer you calling me ‘wife.’ It shows that we are a married couple without any sense of distance,” Han Xuewei said somewhat shyly.
Han Xuewei’s body leaned gently against Lin Yi, enveloped in tender affection.
After last night’s incident, they felt even closer to each other. Like lovers who had just started dating, although not completely open, they no longer felt strangers to each other.
Han Xuewei could feel that Lin Yi’s attitude towards her and their child had gradually become more tender from being stiff.
“Husband, have you told your friends and classmates about our marriage?” Han Xuemei asked with a smile.
Lin Yi was stunned for a moment, then said, “I haven’t had the chance to tell anyone else, just mentioned it briefly in our dormitory. But those guys don’t take it to heart, all thinking I’m just blowing my own trumpet.”
“They all think you are the most beautiful belle of Xiangcheng University, and a goddess in every man’s heart. They would never believe I’d marry you.”
“It’s just that no one could have imagined that the famous belle would end up in my hands, becoming the treasure in my heart,” he added.
Han Xuewei walked for a while, her beautiful form enwrapped as she turned her head to glance at Lin Yi’s handsome face and leaned gently against him.
Han Xuewei said, “Even the most beautiful face is just a human skin. The school belle is also a person; it’s not strange to have all sorts of feelings.”
“From the moment I saw you in our freshman year, I was attracted by your handsome face, and couldn’t help my heart beating faster. Your abilities are outstanding, a rare talent, so from that time, I started to like you,” she confessed.
“It’s just that because of my personality, I’m not good at expressing myself, which is why I missed out on a few years. Just… I don’t know… if you… you… liked me too?”
Lin Yi smiled tenderly, pulled Han Xuewei tightly into his embrace, and said, “The answer is for sure, I also started liking you from that time.”
“There’s no doubt about this answer. Between us, we even have a child; you mustn’t think too much, I have you in my heart.”
In Han Xuewei’s eyes, a flicker of desolation crossed as she said with a sense of loss, “I understand. You chose to marry me because of the child, right?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi knew this little woman was overthinking and quickly pulled her close, hands on her shoulders, gazed at her intently and seriously.
“Vivi, I won’t allow you to think like that, nor doubt my feelings. If it were only for the child, at my young age, I could have simply chosen not to,” he said firmly.
“Or after you gave birth to the child, I could just provide a large sum for child support, so why would I need to marry you?”
“The child is indeed a bond in our marriage, but the reason I chose the opportunity is because of my fondness for you in my heart, and that is undeniable.”
“You must firmly believe in your heart that your husband loves you! We are like entering our dating phase—we need to sincerely develop and maintain our feelings for each other. Suspicion is the greatest killer in a marriage,” he said with conviction.
Lin Yi spoke with unwavering certainty.
Han Xuewei smiled awkwardly and said, “Husband, all this stems from my lack of confidence. I always feel you’re so outstanding, scared that one day you might disappear from my life.”
“Despite the title of school belle, I have never truly been with a man, immersed in my studies and never fallen in love.”
“In my heart, I always worried that you would disappear from my world before I had the chance to turn around.”
Lin Yi looked into Han Xuewei’s eyes, no longer able to hold back, pulled her into his arms, their heads resting against each other, and he spoke deeply, “Silly girl, don’t worry, I will never leave you.”
“My love for you will only grow with time, never diminishing.”
Lin Yi clearly felt that at the beginning, he indeed married her because of the child, but he also had affection for her.
Being with Han Xuewei, Lin Yi felt extremely lucky, having married the woman of his dreams, as one can imagine.
However, after spending these few days together, he realized that not only was Han Xuewei beautiful and of good character, but she also treated him with tender dependence, which in turn made his feelings for Han Xuewei soar rapidly.
Most importantly, there was Han Xuewei’s deep affection for him.
Gradually, Lin Yi found himself slowly falling in love with Han Xuewei, naturally responding to her love, and everything fell into place effortlessly.
The couple, embracing in the snow, followed their deep gaze at one another with a tender hug. Both sides expressed their feelings for each other.
In an instant, the veil that had been between them was ripped to shreds. Two young hearts drew close together tightly.
At that moment, the system’s voice rang out again in Lin Yi’s mind.
“Ding!”
“Due to the host’s heartfelt confession to the female lead, and mutual affection, a special system task has been triggered. Now awarding 2 million yuan in cash as a love fund.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was overjoyed.
The system was really interesting, as if there were rewards everywhere, including ones related to the child, and also for the wife. It seems that when he gets back, he needs to find some time to study it thoroughly.
He might find some patterns indeed.
The two embraced in the snow, filled with tender affection, reluctant to part.
At this moment, the waiter came over and told them that all the dishes had been served and asked them to go and eat immediately.
The couple walked to the private room arm in arm, and seeing the exquisite and delicious food on the table, they immediately felt famished.
“Wife, don’t be polite with me. Eat to your heart’s content. Right now, you need to eat for several people. Your husband is rich and you don’t need to worry at all.”
“If it’s not enough, we’ll order more, money is not a problem,”
Lin Yi said indulgently and extravagantly.
“Okay, thank you, husband!”
Han Xuewei’s pretty face blushed slightly as she quickly expressed her gratitude.
The couple sat together, feeding each other, and it felt a bit like they were dating, with something called ambiguity rapidly spreading between them.
“Wife, do you think my parents are easy to get along with? You must tell me the truth, so I know how to handle it,” Lin Yi asked.
“Your parents are really nice, they are easy to get along with and they’re good to me too. It’s just that I don’t know how I might seem in the eyes of those upstairs,” Han Xuewei said while eating.
“My parents really like you, they keep telling me to live well with you, and to always see the challenges you face, never allowing me to be willful and reckless,”
Lin Yi smiled, then continued, “What about your mom and dad? Do they have even the slightest fondness for me?”
Han Xuewei turned with a smile that dazzled Lin Yi’s eyes, and she said, “My parents really like you; they think you’re a dependable man.”
“Now, I feel especially happy, from the initial fear and confusion to the current bliss and fulfillment.”

chapters.title: Chapter 20: The Divine Skill of Eidetic Memory Goes Online
chapters.content:
Chapter 20: The Divine Skill of Eidetic Memory Goes Online
“My mom thinks I will definitely be happy in your family.”
“With loving and doting in-laws, and a husband who is also very good to me.”
“I feel like I’m the happiest woman in the world.”
Han Xuewei said blissfully.
Lin Yi was overjoyed and moved forward to embrace Han Xuewei.
“I also feel very happy!”
“To have married the goddess of my heart.”
“And those three little babies who are about to be born.”
Han Xuewei also spoke with a blushing face, “You’re very handsome too, and you’re also in my heart.”
Lin Yi, seeing Han Xuewei’s shy and expressive eyes, suddenly became a bit restless.
He hurriedly said, “Alright, wife. Let’s eat first! Otherwise, I really can’t hold back… ”
Han Xuewei smiled happily, feeling that their relationship had grown even closer.
They ate lunch outside and then took a taxi straight home.
Lin Yi’s desire to buy a car grew stronger; it seemed necessary to find some time to go look at cars with Han Xuewei.
One for him to drive, another for slight driving, and one for Aunt Wang to use for grocery shopping, all these were essential.
He just didn’t know how much it would cost to buy these cars.
But now Lin Yi was not short of money—his account still had tens of millions lying in it, so buying these cars surely wouldn’t be an issue.
Han Xuewei, heavy with child, tired easily.
As soon as she got home, she immediately went to the bedroom to rest.
Han Xuewei always felt she could never get enough sleep and was very languid all day long. It was as if becoming pregnant had made her lazy all over.
Lin Yi, bored, remembered the set of child-rearing books the salesperson had given them and hurried to find them.
Lin Yi went straight to the study, opened his hands, wanting to take a good look.
The salespeople really were reliable, knowing exactly what this young couple needed and delivering it right away.
Scientific child-rearing was indeed an essential matter.
As the father of triplets, Lin Yi knew many things would have to be paid attention to after the children’s birth.
Lin Yi opened the book, and all his thoughts immediately immersed in its content; he had to study it well to avoid being flustered later on.
After the birth of the children, there surely would be many things to take into account. If he did not prepare in advance, he would undoubtedly be at a loss, which would not be good for the children’s development.
Moreover, taking care of a pregnant woman was another big issue. Knowing exactly how to manage her nutrition intake and diet was also crucial.
This knowledge was a complete mystery to Lin Yi at present.
Lin Yi took a deep breath, stopped his idle thoughts, and closely focused on every word in the book.
Just then, the voice of the system echoed in his mind.
“Ding!”
“As the host is dedicated to solving his wife and child’s problems, he has triggered the system’s special skill. The system has decided to reward the host with the Divine Skill of Photographic Memory.”
Lin Yi was taken aback; this system really was interesting.
It seemed as if anything related to his wife and child could earn a reward.
For instance, he received a reward when he decided to marry Han Xuwei and have children.
Latterly, making Han Xuewei late-night snacks, buying dumplings, hearing the baby’s fetal movements for the first time, and making the first purchase for the baby—all of these had garnered system rewards.
He just didn’t know how to use this Photographic Memory skill yet.
No sooner had Lin Yi thought of this question than the system immediately provided an answer.
“Ding!”
“Report to the host, this Divine Skill is truly extraordinary and easy to use. The host only needs to agree to activate it.”
“In future studies or daily life, the host can use this Divine Skill.”
“Does the host wish to activate the Divine Skill now?”
Lin Yi couldn’t help but admire internally, the system was really fucking impressive.
If he had this Divine Skill, what would he ever have to worry about forgetting?
“Alright, start now,” Lin Yi said.
“Ding!”
“Congratulations to the host, the activation is successful, and the host can now use it.”
The voice of the system once again transmitted into Lin Yi’s mind.
He took a deep breath, wanting to test out how effective this Divine Skill was.
So Lin Yi picked up the book again and found that his focus was much more concentrated than before! Reading now felt extremely relaxing and enjoyable.
Even when he read the Later Stages of the content, he could still replay the Earlier Stages clearly in his mind.
Lin Yi couldn’t help but marvel internally: This Divine Skill really is awesome.
If he had this Divine Skill in high school, perhaps he could have chosen any world-class university at will.
Lin Yi stopped these various thoughts and started reading the book seriously.
This set of scientific parenting books, from the time a mom-to-be is pregnant until the child is 12 years old, clearly outlines what the child should be doing at each stage.
The entire set took Lin Yi merely one hour to finish reading. And regarding the content, he had committed to memory every page thoroughly.
This left Lin Yi even more shocked; this photographic memory Divine Skill was truly formidable.
If he had had it back when he was in school, he would undoubtedly have been an extraordinary top student.
Lin Yi shook his head and quickly dismissed other messy thoughts.
All of that was in the past; the most important thing was to seize the present.
According to this set of books, before the child is born, formula and clothing, as well as some wrapping items, must all be prepared in advance.
Baby products must be sterilized before use, to avoid harming the baby’s skin.
The care for pregnant women is explained even more in detail: diet must be nutritionally balanced, eat less sweets, and consume more whole grains and fruits.
In the Later Stages of pregnancy, the sleep quality will decline, and this is when the husband’s help is urgently needed.
After a woman becomes pregnant, because of the instability in her hormones, her temper may also become irritable.
Therefore, the family of the pregnant woman must be extra considerate, to ensure her mood is as pleasant as possible, which is beneficial for the baby’s health.
After the baby is born, in addition to preparing the essentials for food, clothing, shelter, and transportation, one must also master certain life skills.
When holding a newborn baby, there are specifics to consider, from the posture—using both hands, holding them close to an adult’s chest, providing the baby with enough sense of security.
The book details extensively, providing excellent guidance on what caregivers should do at each stage for the baby.
Even novices, after learning, can do it just right.
The book also mentions the process of morning sickness for expectant mothers.
After becoming pregnant, due to the invasion of a foreign entity, the body starts showing a series of rejection responses.
Added to this are the hormones secreted by pregnant women in the early stages, which can cause morning sickness.
When morning sickness occurs, there’s no need for panic, as this is all within the normal range.
If the morning sickness is too severe, one can also use certain foods to adjust.
Of course, all this depends on the health foundation of the expectant mother.
After reading it, Lin Yi’s heart was filled with deep emotion.

chapters.title: Chapter 21 - 21 I'm the Chef
chapters.content:
Chapter 21: Chapter 21 I’m the Chef
After organizing the content of the books, Lin Yi reflected on how Han Xuewei usually behaved in daily life.
Lin Yi found that Han Xuewei had never really shown any unusual tendencies, except that compared to other women, she seemed to be a bit sleepier, taking just a few extra minutes to rest.
There was a slight change in her dietary habits; her appetite seemed to have improved quite a bit.
Beyond that, Lin Yi hadn’t noticed anything special.
“This is good too, suffering less is always better. Otherwise, if she were carrying triplets again, that would be excessively hard,”
Lin Yi thought to himself.
Suddenly, Lin Yi remembered that the book also mentioned that it was essential for pregnant women to exercise. Not only would it help the baby’s development, but it’s also particularly beneficial for the expectant mother.
“In the coming days, I should sign my wife up for a prenatal yoga or swimming class,” Lin Yi immediately thought to himself.
“Let her exercise well to keep herself and the four of them healthy.”
“Of course, all of this still depends on whether Han Xuewei is willing. If she doesn’t like it, then never mind,” he added.
It was not until the afternoon that Han Xuewei came out of the bedroom.
As Han Xuewei passed the study, she saw Lin Yi engrossed in writing and drawing.
She noticed several books and a mobile phone in front of Lin Yi, and he was holding a notebook in his hand.
Han Xuewei walked in through the door and hugged Lin Yi from behind, asking softly, “Husband, what are you doing?”
Lin Yi turned around with a tender smile and said, “Didn’t that salesperson give us a set of books yesterday?”
“I took them out to study and make some notes, so it’s easier for you when you look at them.”
“You need to learn some of this child-rearing knowledge too. For the baby’s and your health, it’s good to understand more.”
“I’ve written down the key points from the books in the notebook. You don’t have to read such a thick book; just look at the content I’ve summarized.”
“This way it’s easier for you.”
After finishing his sentence, Lin Yi handed the notebook to Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei took it and opened it to find that the notebook was filled with meticulous notes on various cautions for pregnant women and babies.
The considerate Lin Yi had even used different colored pens for annotations, which greatly moved Han Xuewei.
Through the lines, Han Xuewei could feel Lin Yi’s deep love and painstaking effort.
She remembered being mesmerized by Lin Yi’s sunny and cheerful presence from the first time she saw him in college.
For a while, wherever Han Xuewei went, she heard other girls discussing Lin Yi, their lively expressions making her envious.
It went without saying that, in those days, Lin Yi had become the dream lover of many girls.
Sometimes paying attention to Lin Yi, Han Xuewei realized over time that she had quietly fallen in love with him.
On the night of the unexpected event, Han Xuewei didn’t feel any panic or unease, but rather a hint of relief.
As a girl, she thought it was a great fortune to give the most precious part of herself to the man she loved the most.
Later, when she discovered she was pregnant, a wave of joy couldn’t help but surge in Han Xuewei’s heart. She had been prepared to bear the consequences alone, but still felt somewhat reluctant. To provide a complete home for her child, Han Xuewei decided to take a gamble.
The responsibility and commitment shown by Lin Yi once brought tears of joy to Han Xuewei’s eyes, making her feel she had not loved the wrong person.
Lin Yi’s agreement to marry her and give their baby a home was more than enough for Han Xuewei to feel completely satisfied.
Han Xuewei had made up her mind that even if Lin Yi only loved the child and not her after marriage, she would accept it.
Nowadays, many couples are together in name only, staying married for the sake of giving their child a complete home, with little love between them; only the bond of the child and a paper certificate remain.
Han Xuewei thought to herself that entering into marriage was merely an early start to the kind of life where only a paper certificate and a child remained, and she was ready to accept it.
She had never expected that Lin Yi actually had feelings for her as well, which made Han Xuewei feel extremely happy.
As she looked at the densely packed notebook, a wave of happiness swept through her heart.
Han Xuewei lowered her head and gently kissed Lin Yi’s cheek.
“Husband, thank you!” Han Xuewei said happily.
“By the way, it’s time for afternoon tea now, what would you like to eat? Just tell me what you want, and I’ll make it for you right away,”
Lin Yi said tenderly.
“Husband, you can cook?” Han Xuewei asked in surprise.
Her eyes shone brightly as she looked at Lin Yi, somewhat disbelieving.
“Of course! To take care of my wife and child, even if I didn’t know how, I’d have to learn.”
“Besides, you can rest assured, your husband here is of high-level international chef skill, top-notch in cooking techniques.”
“If you don’t believe me, today I’ll let you see for yourself.”
Lin Yi patted his chest confidently.
The smile on Han Xuewei’s lips grew even sweeter.
An inexplicable and indescribable feeling spread from within her heart.
Could this be what they call love?
Lin Yi’s face was filled with vitality, planning a piece of cake for himself.
With the system in hand, he had everything!
His high-level cooking skills were a special reward from the system, certainly nothing to scoff at.
Not to mention a simple afternoon tea, even competing with chefs from several-star hotels would be a breeze.
“That’s great, since my husband is so enthusiastic, as your wife, I would be rude to decline.”
“It’s about time, let’s skip the afternoon tea! I’ll just have some fruit to tide me over.”
“However, tonight I expect a feast to witness your international chef level skills,” Han Xuewei said with a laugh.
“Not a problem at all, then I’ll start by making you a fruit salad,”
“Let’s go downstairs, you can eat the fruit salad and watch TV, have a bit of a rest, and the feast will be served in the evening,” Lin Yi said.
Lin Yi followed Han Xuewei’s small hand, walking towards the downstairs.
Once downstairs, Lin Yi asked Han Xuewei to wait a moment while he himself went into the kitchen.
In no time at all, a colorful and fragrant fruit salad was brought to the table.
“Husband, you’re amazing! Just looking at this fruit salad makes one’s mouth water,” Han Xuewei exclaimed excitedly.
“Wife, you eat the fruit salad first, I’m going to start preparing the dinner feast right away,”
After speaking, Lin Yi arranged for Han Xuewei to sit on the sofa in front of the television, with the delicious fruit salad placed on the coffee table.
He and Aunt Wang then busied themselves in the kitchen.
After finishing the salad and playing with her phone for half the day, Han Xuewei felt a bit bored and thought about getting up and moving around, but she found herself too comfortably lazy to do so.
Therefore, Han Xuewei reclined gently on the couch and soon fell into a deep sleep.

chapters.title: Chapter 22 - 22 Lin Yi Cooks
chapters.content:
Chapter 22: Chapter 22 Lin Yi Cooks
By the time Han Xuewei woke up, the dining table was already laden with several delicious dishes.
Even from a significant distance, the enticing aroma could be perceived, irresistibly luring out countless cravings.
“Honey, what delicious food have you made?”
“Why does it smell so good?”
Just awakened, Han Xuewei’s eyes were slightly bleary, lazy and enchanting.
“Go and have a look, and you’ll know.”
“Come, I’ve already served the soup.”
Lin Yi said with a smile, his voice gentle.
Supported by Lin Yi, Han Xuewei made her way to the dining table and felt overwhelmingly hungry at the sight of it, her appetite was unprecedentedly stirred.
On the table were two bowls of aromatic soup—Sausage and Winter Melon Soup and Hakka Sanqi Chicken Soup with Pig’s Stomach.
Beside the soups were several small dishes that were both colorful and fragrant, particularly the Dry-Fried Mandarinfish which looked extraordinary.
“Husband, I feel so blessed. I didn’t expect you could actually cook!”
“These dishes look so delicious!”
Han Xuewei couldn’t help but express her joy.
Lin Yi chuckled and placed the already served soup in front of Han Xuewei.
Lin Yi said, “Wife, try it and see how it is.”
“If you don’t like it, I’ll go make something else right away.”
Moved, Han Xuewei smiled sweetly and said with emotion, “Husband, I can already smell it. It’s a flavor I really love.”
“I never imagined your cooking would be even better than mine, being able to make such flavorful, aromatic, and visually appealing dishes. You’ve made me feel so blessed.”
Lin Yi’s face was filled with a doting smile.
He had indeed put a lot of effort into this table of dishes.
From choosing the ingredients to incorporating the herbal medicine, every detail had been meticulously attended to.
The diet of a pregnant woman should be primarily light, yet nutritious. Pregnancy greatly depletes the mother’s body, and not paying attention can completely wear her out, with loss outweighing the gain.
Reflecting on all these considerations, Lin Yi had taken great action.
Looking at the table full of dishes, Han Xuewei felt a rapid surge of happiness, realizing the soup was almost ready to drink.
She picked up a small bowl and took a delicate sip.
In an instant, the mild fragrance of the winter melon spread across her lips and teeth, refreshing her soul.
Unable to resist, Han Xuewei continued to sip gently.
Watching her, Lin Yi felt an immense sense of satisfaction.
This must be what love is all about!
He couldn’t help but think to himself.
“Husband, this soup is so delicious! It’s light yet leaves a lingering taste that makes one reluctant to put down the bowl. I didn’t expect your culinary skills to be so remarkable.”
“It’s certainly on par with the soups from star-rated hotels.”
“I’m truly blessed!”
Enjoying each sip, Han Xuewei looked up and spoke happily.
“Aunt Wang, come and drink with us.”
“Try Lin Yi’s craftsmanship. You’ve really been working too hard.”
As Han Xuewei looked up and saw Aunt Wang still bustling around not too far away, she quickly called her over.
Aunt Wang responded with a smile and walked over, her face beaming.
Honestly, she was also curious about the dishes Lin Yi had prepared. They looked good, but she wondered how they tasted.
In Aunt Wang’s experience, Lin Yi rarely stepped into the kitchen.
Approaching the table, Han Xuemei served her a bowl of soup, enthusiastically saying, “Aunt Wang, give it a try.”
“Oh my, just take care of yourself; I can serve myself.”
Aunt Wang, slightly overwhelmed by the pampering, spoke as she saw Han Xuewei serving her the soup.
Under Han Xuewei’s urging, she picked up the small bowl and gently took a sip, her face immediately filled with disbelief.
These were clearly ordinary ingredients, so how did they become so extraordinary after Lin Yi’s touch?
This flavor, Aunt Wang felt, didn’t have any additional ingredients, but rather fully brought out the essence of the food, creating a wonderful blend that was indescribable.
Han Xuewei couldn’t hold back anymore and began to eat heartily.
Seeing this, Aunt Wang quickly urged her to eat slowly.
She sat by the table, unable to resist reaching out for each dish.
This kid is really skilled at cooking, it seems he has truly grown up.
Aunt Wang couldn’t help but feel at ease seeing the child she had brought up being so considerate to his wife.
She believed Lin Yi would definitely become a good husband, a good father.
Lin Yi sat close to Han Xuewei, occasionally serving her dishes, taking care of her perfectly.
Soon after Han Xuewei finished eating, she looked even more lazy and contented, like an adorable big kitty.
“This food is really too delicious!”
“It’s a flavor I’ve never tasted before.”
“It’s in no way inferior to those star-level chefs,” Han Xuewei said happily.
“What’s so big about that? As long as you like it, I’ll cook for you every day in the future, and make sure to fatten you up,” Lin Yi said with great indulgence.
Han Xuewei smiled sweetly, her voice tender, “How could that be? In no time at all, I’ll probably become as fat as a pig.”
Lin Yi gently stroked her hair and said, “It’s fine to be a little fat, I like it either way, and definitely won’t despise you.”
“Still, it’s not okay. Being too overweight during pregnancy is hard to reduce and not good for the health,” Han Xuewei quickly shook her head.
Lin Yi cracked a slight smile, clearly aware of a girl’s strictness with her own weight.
“Ding!”
“Congratulations Host, you have received a cash reward of 500,000 from the system.”
At that moment, the system’s voice reached Lin Yi’s mind.
“What?”
“Another 500,000 bonus?”
“The system’s awards aren’t small, just wonder why it is.”
Lin Yi asked in surprise in his mind.
“Ding!”
“Because the host cooked for his wife, a reward was granted.”
The system’s voice came again.
