Lin Yi couldn’t help but feel an inner burst of joy, just for cooking a meal for his wife, he could get a 500,000 reward.
Did that mean that as long as he took care of his wife and children in the future, he would be able to receive such generous rewards?
If that was the case, then he’d get tired from accepting rewards.
Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei with a tender smile and said, “Then alright! We’ll do everything your way. But making you a meal once in a while is still a must.”
“You’re carrying triplets in your belly, so the supplement of nutrients is extremely important. Don’t neglect your health over worries about your weight.”
“Only by ensuring your health can we ensure the children.”
Hearing this, Han Xuewei’s heart immediately filled with endless anticipation for life.
She spoke in a soft voice, “Having a husband who is a chef of supreme level, I don’t have to worry about nutrition and taste, it’s so good to have you!”
“I’m a bit scared that in the future I won’t be able to resist eating a lot, and if the weight keeps going up and then can’t come down, what then?”
“I don’t want to become fat!” Han Xuewei said, pouting her lips adorably as she spoke.
Seeing Han Xuewei like this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but become somewhat infatuated.

chapters.title: Chapter 23 - 23 Are You Playing Hide and Seek with Daddy?
chapters.content:
Chapter 23: Chapter 23 Are You Playing Hide and Seek with Daddy?
After a sumptuous meal, the couple snuggled up on the sofa, chatting and catching up on a drama series.
“Wife, I’ve noticed that getting around isn’t very convenient for us, and it’s only going to get more difficult once you start showing. So I was thinking, maybe we should buy a car as our means of transportation. Will you accompany me to pick one out?”
“By the way, wife, have you got your driving license?” Lin Yi suddenly remembered something and asked.
Han Xuewei nodded and replied seriously, “I just got it this semester, but I’ve never actually driven on the road…”
Lin Yi smiled and touched her forehead, saying, “No worries, then I’ll be your personal chauffeur, and I’ll take care of the driving. Will you join me tomorrow to choose our future ride, or would you rather sleep in at home?”
Without a second thought, Han Xuewei immediately agreed, of course, she wanted to go with Lin Yi. Their relationship was heating up rapidly, even faster than any other couple in the throes of love; they just wanted to be glued to each other day and night, without ever getting tired of it!
“Then I’ll go with you! But you have to wake me up tomorrow. These past few days, I’ve been unusually sleepy for some reason. I always feel groggy, wanting to sleep as soon as I’ve eaten and getting hungry the moment I wake up. If this keeps up, I might turn into a little pig, right?”
“Hahaha, is that what you’re worried about? So what if you did? Even if you became a little pig, I’d make sure you’re the happiest little pig in the world!” Lin Yi said, looking at her with adoration and pulling Han Xuewei into his arms.
After some sweet cuddling, Han Xuewei began to feel her eyelids fighting each other, a wave of drowsiness washing over her.
“I’m getting sleepy again… I’ll rest first, hubby.”
Lin Yi immediately leaned in after hearing this, “Don’t rush, give me another two minutes. I want to listen for any activity from the little baby in your belly. Look, I even bought a fetal heart monitor especially for today!”
Lin Yi was surprised to find he was already addicted to interacting with the baby every day. To further savor this delightful experience, he had specifically purchased this monitor.
“By the way, wife, when buying the monitor today, I saw some equipment for prenatal checkups. So I was thinking, it’s about time we went for a checkup, right? And I’ve heard that you need to file with the maternity and child health care office before the birth! We should also take care of getting a birth permit; there are quite a few things we need to do…”
Lin Yi began to recall all the information he had learned these past days and started to make a simple plan in his head.
It’s safe to say, Lin Yi had spent a lot of thought on his wife and child recently.
“That’s right! If you hadn’t mentioned it, I would have forgotten. It’s time for a prenatal checkup!”
“They say pregnancy makes you stupid for three years, and I feel like I’m already getting there. I have no idea what I’m thinking about every day; I nearly forgot such an important thing…” Han Xuewei said, suddenly waking up from a daze and quickly sitting up as Lin Yi mentioned it.
“Tomorrow I’ll accompany you for that!” Lin Yi also instantly perked up.
“Should we postpone the car shopping, then?” Han Xuewei asked.
“There’s no rush for that, what could be more important than my wife’s prenatal checkup?” Lin Yi had no objections and immediately decided on the checkup for the next day.
“Good thing I set up my medical card when I went for a health check, so I can make an appointment in advance today – no need to queue!” Han Xuewei hurriedly opened the app to make an online appointment.
Maybe it was the belly, but Han Xuewei could feel that neither sitting nor standing were comfortable anymore, so the thought of queuing was definitely troubling.
After some tapping and swiping, she finally said, “Appointment successful, but since we waited until the last minute, there’s only a ten o’clock slot available for the checkup. Is that okay?”
“It’s okay, you can take some extra rest. Let’s take a ride-hailing service! Although it’s not as comfortable and convenient as having a private car, I don’t want to rush you,” Lin Yi said.
After saying this, he eagerly pulled out the fetal heart monitor he had purchased.
Han Xuewei had also noticed the changes in her body over the past few days. Aside from changes in her diet and sleep, her belly had grown significantly, and sometimes, she would wake up to find her belly had risen so high!
Her situation wasn’t like others’, after all, she had three little ones in her belly!
Sometimes, expectant mothers with only one baby feel very uncomfortable, let alone now with three babies inside!
So this also led to a significant increase in her appetite and sleep quality in recent days!
Seeing Lin Yi running over excitedly, she first propped up her back with a pillow, then shyly lifted up half of her nightgown, revealing her bulging belly, which was indeed more noticeable than it had been a few days before.
Lin Yi began to study the so-called fetal heart monitor, getting a bit flustered for a moment.
Han Xuewei took one look and immediately remembered the examinations she had at the hospital. She realized the monitor worked on the same principle as the ultrasound and began to patiently instruct him.
“Honey, try to aim the probe here at the belly… No no, you should first apply that gel to the probe…” After a long while of studying, they finally made some progress.
Once Lin Yi understood the principle, he began to try it eagerly.
“My dear babies, Daddy is going to listen to your heartbeats now!” Lin Yi carefully aimed the probe, operating it somewhat clumsily.
As soon as the monitor was turned on, it began to respond.
Han Xuewei felt a coolness on her belly, causing her to shiver involuntarily.
“Hm? Are the three little ones hiding? Where have you all gone?” Lin Yi earnestly searched, as if playing a game of hide and seek with the children.
Han Xuewei watched Lin Yi, who was acting like a child himself, with a warm feeling in her heart.
At that moment, she felt like the happiest mother in the world, reassured that her babies could have such a father!
Just then, as Lin Yi’s attention was still focused on Han Xuewei’s belly, there was a slight anomaly on the monitor!
The chaotic, irregular noise in the monitor became very regular, and a series of beeping sounds disrupted their train of thought.
Lin Yi was startled by the sudden noise, and his hand holding the instrument shook uncontrollably.
But at that moment, a system prompt sounded in Lin Yi’s mind!
“Ding…”

chapters.title: Chapter 24 - 24 Fetal Heart Rate Monitor
chapters.content:
Chapter 24: Chapter 24 Fetal Heart Rate Monitor
“Ding! Congratulations to the host, you have successfully captured the heartbeats of three babies and earned a reward of two million!”
He no longer cared at all about the amount of the reward!
Everything seemed to have turned into floating clouds!
Lin Yi was now only focused on intently listening to the activities of the three babies, feeling an overwhelming sense of happiness!
“Haha! Daddy heard it! Heard you guys stirring!”
“Is this voice the eldest’s, or is it the two younger brothers?” Lin Yi’s expression had become extremely tender at this moment, his eyes squinting joyfully into slits!
At this moment, Han Xuewei also got quite a start from the sudden activity just now, and she suddenly realized how miraculous all this was!
So this was what the nurturing of life was like! It really was so fascinating!
However, not long after, the beeping sound from the monitor gradually dissipated, replaced by a flurry of noise.
Han Xuewei smiled and said softly, “Looks like the babies are playing hide and seek again. This time, make sure to hide well!”
For the first time, Han Xuewei felt so close to the babies; she could also sense the little ones wriggling around in her belly!
Perhaps sensing that mom and dad were playing a game with them, they seriously hid themselves again.
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei exchanged looks, their faces covered with sweet smiles, a warm feeling naturally welling up between them. It was their first time experiencing such parental joy!
What a blissfully happy family this was! Everything had become so warm and sweet!
At this point, even Aunt Wang, who had been peering through the doorway for a while, nodded with satisfaction. It seemed that Lin Yi had indeed grown up a lot!
He had started to take care of his own family!
Doting on his wife, cherishing his children, he had even learned to cook meals out of nowhere!
Aunt Wang didn’t want to disturb the couple, so she carefully retreated to rest in her room.
The next morning, when Lin Yi got up, it was almost nine o’clock, and he noticed that his wife was still sleeping soundly. He gently stroked her forehead, then gave her a kiss, and without causing much disturbance, went to wash up alone.
In fact, after using the fetal heart rate monitor yesterday, Lin Yi had been deeply moved; it was the first time he had experienced life so delicately, so he had some trouble falling asleep!
The alarm clock he had set in advance went off several times early in the morning but failed to wake Lin Yi from his sleep, which was why he got up so late today.
After a simple wash, he went downstairs, planning to make a loving breakfast for his still-slumbering wife, but to his surprise, he found Aunt Wang already busy, so he had to go back to the bedroom to wake Han Xuewei.
“Dear wife, time to get up! We have a prenatal check-up soon.”
“Mmm… I want to sleep a bit more; I can’t wake up…” mumbled Han Xuewei languidly, rolling over. She had intended to sleep a while longer but suddenly remembered the day’s agenda and sprang up from the bed!
“We have a prenatal appointment today! We can’t be late for that! I almost missed a big deal!” With that, Han Xuewei got out of bed.
“Honey, we’re not going to be late, are we?” Han Xuewei asked Lin Yi worriedly.
Looking at Han Xuewei’s sleepy eyes, Lin Yi affectionately stroked her head and said, “Don’t worry, it’s only half past nine. I wanted you to get some more rest, that’s why I woke you up at this time. Go freshen up! Aunt Wang has already prepared breakfast, and the car we booked will be here soon. Trust me, we won’t be late today!”
“Then you go downstairs first, I’ll be quick and come down right after freshening up!” As soon as she finished speaking, Han Xuewei hurriedly ran out.
Seeing her hasty retreat, Lin Yi couldn’t help but smile helplessly.
After getting ready, the couple sat down at the dining table and savored the nutritious breakfast Aunt Wang had prepared. Shortly afterward, they hurried out the door and directly into the car they had booked in advance.
They didn’t forget to hold hands as they left, affectionately chatting all the way.
It wasn’t long before the car gently stopped at the entrance of the maternity and child health hospital. They quickly made their way to the prenatal checkup room, only to find a long line at the door. Clearly, there were quite a few people waiting, so they asked a nearby nurse about their appointment.
The nurse had them fill out forms and supplement their information. After a lot of hustle and bustle, they finally received a booklet.
Lin Yi accompanied his wife while she had her blood pressure taken and got weighed, then quietly waited by her side.
It wasn’t long before the nurse called her name.
Upon seeing the doctor, the very young doctor looked at Han Xuewei in surprise, and almost shouted with astonishment!
“This young lady, I know you! I helped you with your last checkup! It’s really rare to see someone pregnant with triplets on the first try!”
“This gentleman, he must be your… He looks quite handsome! You two are a really good match,” the doctor continued.
Han Xuewei responded with a shy smile and a nod of her head, saying softly, “Yes, we are husband and wife.”
“Come on, let me see your booklet!” said the doctor, taking the prenatal examination sheet, checking the information on it, and then starting to calculate the days of pregnancy.
“You’ve been pregnant for quite some time now! It’s almost four months. However, your physical condition isn’t very good. Your blood pressure is obviously low, but don’t worry, these are all normal physiological responses. In a few days, you’ll need to start moving around every day. You can’t sit for too long or lie down all the time.”
“If you have time next week, you will need to come for another check-up, preferably with an appointment like today. By the way, do you have medical insurance?”
“Your situation is different from that of other expectant mothers; you’re carrying three babies! You need to be extra careful! Try to avoid crowded places, and in a few days, you’ll start to experience even greater changes in your body.”
“The babies are going to grow rapidly soon. For your diet, it’s best to consult experienced elders. Diet is very important. You need to ensure a balance of nutrients and food while not consuming too much sugar.”
The young couple listened earnestly, wishing they could take notes on the spot.
After all, this husband and wife had no experience, and they hadn’t been neglecting their three babies at all.
After finishing, the doctor smiled and said slowly, “I must say, your husband is a very responsible man. It’s rare nowadays to find a man who accompanies his wife to prenatal checkups!”
The two exchanged smiles, and Han Xuewei’s face overflowed with happiness. “Mhm, it’s my good fortune to have met someone as wonderful as him. He is not only a qualified dad but also a qualified husband.”
For Han Xuewei, praising her own husband was like giving herself a compliment.

chapters.title: Chapter 25 - 25 Let's buy two cars then
chapters.content:
Chapter 25: Chapter 25 Let’s buy two cars then
“What a loving couple you are! Here’s to wishing your family of five even more happiness!”
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei exchanged smiles, then said to the doctor, “Okay, thank you doctor. We’ll come for the check-up on time next week.”
When the two of them left the hospital, it was almost midday.
Han Xuewei checked the time and asked, “Is there still time to go pick out a car now?”
Lin Yi glanced at his watch, then said, “It feels like there isn’t much time left. Choosing a car can take a while, let’s wait until tomorrow! It can’t interfere with your afternoon rest today, especially since I still want to make dinner for you with my own hands! So, we only have the morning to choose a car.”
Hearing such meticulous arrangements made Han Xuewei a bit shyly say, “There’s no need to go to so much trouble, and I can wait at home. You can go pick one alone. After all, it’s just for getting around, and I don’t have any specific requirements.”
“Since that’s what you think, then I won’t drag you all over the place. It’s not good for your health either. Today I’ll go alone to have a look first. By the way, what kind of car should we choose?”
Lin Yi pondered for a moment, then said, “Here’s what I’m thinking, our family will have five people, and we’ll need to hire a few nannies to take care of the three babies. The car can’t be too cramped, so we should choose one with more space.”
“If we plan it like that, we might need two cars! One just right for our family of five, since we won’t always bring the babies with us on every outing.”
Lin Yi paused, then continued, “It’s perfect to get another car for the nanny, one with bigger space. That’d be more convenient for traveling, especially when taking the babies for check-ups. Do you think that’s a good idea?”
Lin Yi had been studying his duties as a father these past few days. He had read plenty of parenting books, and he knew all the essential things by heart, like when to do prenatal checks, when to take the kids for physical exams, and what sorts of complementary foods the babies should eat—he knew it better than anyone else.
Han Xuewei looked at him with admiration, saying, “Wow! Honey, you’re so thoughtful!”
“But, if we’re going to buy two cars, we probably don’t have that much money, right? However, it doesn’t matter. I was thinking of contacting my parents, they could contribute some, and originally there was supposed to be a car for my dowry…”
“No no no, that won’t do. You don’t have to worry about these things, dear. I’ve got some savings!”
Thankfully, these past few days, with the aid of the system, he had accumulated quite a bit of savings. His wealth had grown to nearly ten million! Two cars were not an issue—buying two more houses would be no problem either!
“I’ve bought quite a few stocks and made a lot of investments, so you don’t need to worry about money on my account. Let your parents keep their money! We can rely on ourselves entirely.”
Even though Lin Yi said this, as his wife, Han Xuewei was still somewhat worried, “Then, I’ll give you the bride price I received to help with buying the car.”
Immediately after hearing this, Lin Yi rejected the idea, “That won’t do, we must keep things separate. That’s the bride price your parents gave, and from now on, that’s your spending money—you can only use it for yourself!”
“Right, honey, speaking of spending money, it just occurred to me. We’re legally married now, but I’ve never actually given you an allowance! A good husband shouldn’t be like that!”
“I’ll transfer some money to you right now. Go buy whatever you want. Treat yourself to some good food and drinks, and if you see clothes you like, don’t hesitate—our wardrobe at home is still pretty empty!”
No sooner had he finished speaking, Lin Yi transferred two million to Han Xuewei on the spot!
Han Xuewei was stunned. She had been thinking about using her bride price to help him buy a car, but Lin Yi not only declined, he also gave her such a generous amount of spending money!
She was momentarily at a loss, bombarded with a multitude of questions.
What kind of investments had her husband made to have so much money?
Not long ago, she had heard that his family’s company had suffered significant economic impacts and his net worth had shrunk, so how could he suddenly afford to give away two million like it was nothing?
Although Han Xuewei had a million questions, she was naturally very reassured to have such an outstanding husband.
“Honey, how do you still have so much money? I had heard that your family’s income had reduced dramatically. Are those rumors?”
“Seeing you now able to take out so much money, I almost feel like I’ve married into wealth…”
Han Xuewei said it in jest.
“You don’t have to worry about money matters anymore, just focus on nurturing yourself! And I guarantee, everything at home I have earned with my own abilities! And I will earn even more in the future!”
After all, he had the reward system. Since it was bound to him, all the money he earned was thanks to his capabilities. Wasn’t it fair to say that?
Han Xuewei smiled contentedly, no longer overly worried.
Since all the money was earned by her husband’s abilities, she couldn’t be happier!
Marrying such a husband who loved and cared for her, attentive to the family, and capable of earning money, must be a blessing from a past life, right?
Han Xuewei knew she wasn’t equipped to manage finances and didn’t care much about money normally. After getting married, she was even less involved with financial matters!
Now that she had a husband who was adept at managing wealth and making investments, there was nothing for her to worry about!
Seeing Han Xuewei still somewhat dazed, Lin Yi patted his chest and said with sincere earnestness, “Don’t worry, every month I’ll give you an allowance! Spend freely, don’t feel like you have to save for me. If you see something you like, just tell me, and I can buy it for you!”
Lin Yi knew one thing for sure: A wife is to be cherished, to be spoiled!
Now that he had a wife, he needed to double down on pampering her!
“Anyway, I can still earn more, so this money is for you to spend. Don’t think too much about it! Understand?”
Lin Yi fervently instilled this idea in Han Xuewei, urging her never to shortchange herself. As long as it made her happy, there was nothing Lin Yi wouldn’t do for her!
Han Xuewei dived into Lin Yi’s arms filled with happiness and whispered, “Thank you, honey. Thank you for loving me so much!”
Lin Yi embraced her waist, his other hand gently stroking her hair, and said, “Silly girl, why say thanks? From now on, no more formalities, we’re husband and wife! Isn’t loving you the most natural thing? Besides, if not you, who else would I love?”

chapters.title: Chapter 26 - 26 Spend Your Pocket Money as You Like
chapters.content:
Chapter 26: Chapter 26 Spend Your Pocket Money as You Like
The two of them hit it off, and Lin Yi decided to go car shopping alone. After all, his wife was now pregnant, and it wasn’t too convenient for her to go anywhere with a big belly. Lingering around with him would only make her tired; it would be better for her to go home and rest well.
“By the way, honey, I’ve been thinking, we should both take a semester off from school. Nothing is more important than your health. Right now, you should just focus on nurturing our baby peacefully, and after your confinement period is over, we can go back to school. How does that sound?”
“Otherwise, you would have to go to class with a big belly every day, and resting in the dormitory is definitely not as comfortable as home. It’s also inconvenient for us to take care of you. As long as you and the baby’s comfort and safety are ensured, nothing else matters.”
These past few days, Lin Yi had been thinking about this and decided to consult Han Xuewei for her opinion first.
After hearing his thoughts, Han Xuewei was very puzzled and asked with a confused look, “Actually, I can just take a leave of absence myself. It’s convenient for you to take care of me at school!”
Lin Yi shook his head repeatedly after hearing this and replied, “How can that be possible? I wish I could be by your side every day! Besides, I want to present a united front with my wife. We’ll take a break together, and then we can graduate together. Later on, we can bring our babies to the graduation ceremony. How about that?”
“Mm, hubby, you’re so good to me.” Han Xuewei buried her head in Lin Yi’s chest, her face brimming with a happy smile.
Just at this moment, Lin Yi’s phone suddenly rang. Picking it up, he saw that it was a call from Aunt Wang.
“Ah Yi, I’d like to take some time off. I have to go home for a couple of days. My son and his fiancée are coming to see me. Will you and Vivi be alright? I’m still a bit worried. I will be back soon.”
Lin Yi said, “Aunt Wang, please go home without worrying! Vivi and I will definitely be fine. Stay a bit longer this time, we will need your help even more in the future.”
Aunt Wang: “Then take good care of Vivi. Have her pay more attention to her health. If you have any questions, just ask me anytime. I didn’t have time to cook today, so you two should grab something to eat before heading back!”
“Alright! Aunt Wang, have a safe trip!”
After finishing the call, Lin Yi kissed Han Xuewei’s forehead and said affectionately, “Honey, Aunt Wang has some family matters to attend to and needs to head back. It looks like I’ll be a full-time husband these days! I’ll take good care of you. Don’t worry, I’ll make sure you’re satisfied with every meal! Let’s go buy some of your favorite food!”
Han Xuewei, linking arms with Lin Yi, nodded and said, “Mm! Let’s go grocery shopping!”
Life is just like that, a couple together through daily meals and seasons. For Lin Yi, there was nothing more blissful than this!
The young couple hailed a taxi and headed to the supermarket closest to their home. Thanks to living in the upscale Xiangcheng district, they had access to very well-appointed infrastructure nearby.
The supermarket and shopping centers near their home were among the best in Xiangcheng.
Since they usually didn’t do much grocery shopping, they just browsed casually, trying to pick out the freshest ingredients.
As soon as they entered the supermarket, they headed for the fresh meat section, determining what the main dish of the day would be before choosing the side dishes, and then they would buy some fruits and snacks.
Faced with an array of products, the two of them discussed their options.
“Here we have Ribeye steaks. I’ll cook steaks for you!” Lin Yi said as he picked out a few from the steak section.
“Anything is fine… after all, it’s you who’s cooking, hubby. I love whatever you make.” Han Xuewei revealed a serene smile.
After they picked the steaks, they chose a Jiangtuan fish, as Lin Yi planned to make a paper-wrapped fish for his wife that evening.
Having chosen some of Han Xuewei’s favorite side dishes, Lin Yi was ready to take his wife home.
But at this moment, Han Xuewei suddenly grabbed Lin Yi’s arm with some anticipation, “Wait, husband!”
“We’re already living in our new house, but there are still many necessities that we’re missing. Why don’t we go to the dedicated area and pick out some common household items? I want you to help me choose.”
Lin Yi was slightly puzzled after hearing this, thinking to himself that his parents had already purchased things like toothpaste and chopsticks a few days ago. Could there be anything else they were lacking?
Actually, Lin Yi didn’t really care what they bought. He was just curious about what Han Xuewei had said. Since he was idle anyway, he might as well go shopping with his wife.
Plus, as long as he could accompany his wife, he was willing to do anything.
Without giving it much thought, he readily agreed, “Sure! Then I’ll go with you and pick out some household items.”
And so, the two of them walked slowly towards the household section.
Han Xuewei immediately picked out a pair of slippers with a strange design and asked Lin Yi with a smile, “What do you think?”
Lin Yi found it strange, thinking they were men’s slippers! Why would she choose men’s slippers? Could it be because she was worried that her figure would change during the last few months of pregnancy and that regular slippers would be uncomfortable?
But that still didn’t justify buying men’s slippers directly! Wasn’t that a bit too exaggerated?
Just as Lin Yi was filled with doubts and about to ask.
He heard Han Xuemei say with a smile, “I think they look really nice, and you would look good wearing them!”
Lin Yi was taken aback for a moment and said, “Me wear them? But I already have slippers.”
Han Xuewei, however, was excited and continued enthusiastically, “Take a look at this pair. It’s suitable for both of us to wear. My taste isn’t bad, right? I want to wear the same as you, so we both have to match!”
When it came to couple items, Han Xuewei also had a whim to come and check them out. Of course, apart from slippers for daily use at home, they also had couple’s pajamas, mugs, and even hoodies for going out, among other things.
Indeed, it could further close the gap between them and make the young couple seem even more loving!
Plus, after their three babies were born, the family of five would also need matching outfits! Just thinking about it made Han Xuewei uncontrollably excited!
At this point, Lin Yi also understood his wife’s little idea, and of course, he was fully supportive of her suggestion!
Following that, Han Xuewei picked out another pair of slippers that looked rather pink and girly with a hint of light blue trim, asking, “Husband, I think this pair is so pretty! Plus, I really like pink with light blue.”
As soon as she finished speaking, she began to pout her lips, seemingly not quite satisfied.
Lin Yi was amused by this scene and let her choose as she pleased! In the end, he wasn’t particular, whatever his wife chose, he would use!
Indeed, using some couple items in life could greatly enhance their relationship.
“The pink series isn’t bad, at least I can accept it. If you really like it, then we’ll just wear this from now on!”
After hearing this, Han Xuewei looked at him in surprise and asked, “Ah? Husband, are you really willing to wear it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 27 - 27 Pink Slippers
chapters.content:
Chapter 27: Chapter 27 Pink Slippers
Lin Yi shrugged nonchalantly and said, “Anyway, it’s just to wear at home. I don’t have to wear it out every day, so as long as it’s chosen by my wife, I will gladly accept it!”
Han Xuewei’s expression instantly became very joyful, “I knew it, you are the best, hubby!”
Lin Yi, of course, loved hearing his wife’s praise; his heart swelled with pride every time he heard it.
After that, the two of them went to the clothing section and carefully picked out matching couple’s hoodies for going out.
Then, things got out of control. From toothbrushes and water cups to pajamas and underwear, the young couple almost completely switched to matching couple’s items.
Seeing the smile on his wife’s face, Lin Yi felt very content.
After all, as a man, this was the first time he had gone shopping with a woman other than his mother!
Even Lin Yi himself felt that this was the first time he had been so patient while shopping with a woman.
After about two hours of shopping, their cart was almost full, and the couple pushed it to the self-checkout area.
Scan to pay complete!
Just as they completed the checkout, the system notification chimed in again!
“Ding! Congratulations, host. The hidden task of taking your wife to the mall has been completed. You will now receive double the amount of your bill! Please sign for it!”
The next second, Lin Yi’s phone received a text message!
Good Lord! It’s the rhythm of spending a thousand to get back two thousand!
This hidden task is really cool!
Lin Yi couldn’t help but wonder, will he ever be able to spend all this money?
When Lin Yi walked out of the supermarket carrying loads of stuff, he finally realized that their family urgently needed a car!
After leaving the supermarket, the two noticed it was already late, even past lunchtime, and it was almost 2 p.m., so the plan to go home and cook was clearly not feasible anymore.
Therefore, the young couple went to a nearby Chinese restaurant, had a quick meal, and then planned to go back home for a beauty sleep!
So, until the sun set, Han Xuewei was still immersed in her dreams, while Lin Yi got up early, planning to make a romantic candlelight dinner for his wife with the ingredients they bought today!
Lin Yi busied himself in the kitchen alone, completely unaware that Han Xuewei, at some point, had already changed into the matching couple’s outfit they bought today and was now in the kitchen.
“Honey, does this matching couple’s outfit we bought today fit me well?”
Urged by his wife, Lin Yi slipped on the pair of pink and blue matching slippers. This was his first time wearing slippers of these colors, and he felt somewhat unaccustomed to it at first.
He indeed hadn’t expected to ever use anything pink in his life.
The wife was clearly satisfying her girlish dreams!
Lin Yi obediently put on the matching couple’s outfit and pinched Han Xuewei’s cheek, which was pink with excitement, “My wife looks good in anything! I’ve never tried this color before! Isn’t it too pinkish?”
Seeing the slightly strange color, the couple couldn’t help but laugh.
After all, Lin Yi was a man of staunch straight-forwardness; who would have thought that he would one day be wearing clothes in shades of pink!
Thinking about it, although strange, was indeed very warm and cozy!
Believing that one of life’s greatest happinesses is to live and eat with the person you love, wearing couple outfits and experiencing life together!
Han Xuewei had been a bit nervous before, worrying that Lin Yi wouldn’t wear the pink slippers!
But unexpectedly, her husband had changed into them without any hesitation, so warmth flooded her heart as well.
Han Xuewei also noticed the savory aroma drifting from the kitchen and asked with widened eyes, “Darling, what’s this delicious smell? It smells so good!”
“This is the candlelight dinner I made especially for you. It’s only partly ready. Go and do something else for now, and I’ll call you to eat in twenty minutes!”
“Wife, how done do you want your steak? These marinated steaks cook quickly—it’s the highlight of tonight’s dinner.”
Moreover, Lin Yi had already prepared a corn and radish pork bone soup that was about to be served. This soup with nourishing effects was very nutritious and was often made by Aunt Wang.
Half the salad was already prepared. Now all that was left was to wait for the soup to be served, fry two steaks, and the candlelight dinner would be a great success!
It was undeniable that this system of his was simply incredible, enabling him to easily learn high-level cooking! Now, give him any ingredient and he could create delicious dishes!
It was just like cheating!
Lin Yi, with one hand holding the salad bowl and the other gently pushing his wife out of the kitchen, kept saying, “You don’t have to do anything right now, go watch TV! Don’t come in while I’m cooking, okay? The fumes from frying the steaks are strong, and that could be bad for your health or even make you nauseous. Just wait for me to call you to eat!”
Thus, Han Xuewei was pushed by her husband onto the couch and forced to start watching TV as Lin Yi alone headed to the kitchen, as if heading into battle!
About fifteen minutes later, everything was ready!
Lin Yi brought all the dishes to the table, and of course, Han Xuewei couldn’t resist the temptation of the aroma and hurried over to the dining table!
“This is fantastic! It smells so good!”
Han Xuewei immediately locked her gaze on the two pieces of steak on the table, full of admiration!
No wonder her husband had been so secretive and hadn’t let her help. He was preparing this lavish dinner!
For a moment, her eyes brimmed with tears, emotionally saying, “Dear, you are really too good to me!”
“I suddenly realize that I am really so lucky! I married a husband who loves me deeply!”
Lin Yi, smiling, stroked her forehead and softly replied, “All right! I know! You have to eat even if you love me! Wait for me for a moment, and I’ll bring the last dish!”
Once they took their seats, Lin Yi thoughtfully cut the steak for his wife, ceremoniously lit the candle, and then brought out a bottle of red wine.
“Wife, I won’t pour you any red wine, okay? After all, you are pregnant now—just drink this warm lemon water! Here’s a toast to our beautiful life!”
Han Xuewei picked up the lemon water and toasted to a happy life!
“I will love you well and fulfill my duties as a wife—cheers!”
Lin Yi, looking at the dishes on the table, laughed and said, “You’ve been waiting for a long time, haven’t you? My little glutton must be impatient by now—let’s dig in!”
Han Xuewei, chuckling, replied, “That’s because my husband’s cooking skills are amazing! Darling, do you know? The food you make is even tastier than that of a five-star hotel!”

chapters.title: Chapter 28 - 28 Candlelight Dinner
chapters.content:
Chapter 28: Chapter 28 Candlelight Dinner
Lin Yi was of course very happy after being encouraged by his wife, and with joy in his heart, he laughed and said, “Alright, alright! I’ve heard you say it so many times. Let’s dig in!”
Han Xuewei looked at the table full of delicious dishes and couldn’t wait either, after all, who could resist such a lavish feast!
She really couldn’t control her appetite anymore!
The two of them didn’t exchange another word and started eating!
Han Xuewei tasted each dish and couldn’t stop praising them, not even taking time to talk.
After enjoying their meal and wine, Han Xuewei gathered all the bowls and chopsticks, ready to wash them, but Lin Yi quickly interjected, “Wife! How can you do such chores? You are pregnant now! Which husband in the world would sit idly by and watch their wife, with a big belly, do the dishes!”
“Be good! Listen to me. Now, all you need to do each day is rest, and leave the rest to your husband!”
While they were talking, Lin Yi pushed Han Xuewei in front of the TV and onto the couch, and even peeled an orange for her.
It had to be said, Han Xuewei was really being spoiled like a pampered little wife!
Her heart was incredibly excited. She couldn’t help but gaze at the matching couple’s slippers they both wore!
The scene looked incredibly lovely!
It was in this moment that Han Xuewei’s happiness soared through the roof! She felt like the happiest person in the world!
As she thought about this, Han Xuewei’s tears almost spilled over!
It felt like every day with Lin Yi brought different surprises!
She knew how lucky she was to have a man like this in marriage—what happiness!
There were too many husbands who neglected their families after marriage, not willing to even do household chores, let alone cook a good meal like Lin Yi!
Just as Lin Yi had settled Han Xuewei on the couch, the system in his mind chimed in again!
“Ding! Congratulations to the host! By pampering your wife and increasing her happiness, you have successfully earned a reward of two hundred thousand!”
As soon as the voice ended, the mobile phone in his pocket vibrated twice.
Good gracious!!!
Is this even possible? A reward just for increasing my wife’s happiness?
So this is how it works! Alright, I’m beginning to get familiar with this system inside of me!
The next morning, Lin Yi gave up the chance to sleep in and climbed out of bed with enthusiasm!
After a simple wash, he started preparing a loving breakfast in the kitchen.
Only after he finished, did he go to the bedroom and wake Han Xuewei, and by then it was already half past eight.
From the parenting knowledge he had crammed, he knew that it was best for expectant mothers to have breakfast before nine o’clock, which is beneficial for both the pregnant woman and the fetus.
So he purposely set the time, waking Han Xuewei at half past eight.
But before he could enter Han Xuewei’s bedroom, she herself pushed the door open.
Perhaps it was because she drank too much lemon water yesterday and went to bed quite early, so she naturally woke up early in the morning and went to the bathroom.
The couple exchanged glances at the bedroom door and both laughed.
At first, Han Xuewei always avoided going to the bathroom in front of her husband. Though they were married, there was still a bit of unfamiliarity, and some things should be approached with caution.
But after so many days of affectionate togetherness, their relationship had grown stronger by the day, practically becoming inseparable. Thus, Han Xuewei didn’t mind going bare-faced and encountering her husband face-to-face.
After a quick freshening up, the two of them sat down together at the dining table for breakfast. As soon as they finished eating, Lin Yi’s mobile vibrated once more, notifying him that he had received a reward for doting on his wife!
Lin Yi couldn’t have been happier. Taking care of his wife was naturally his duty, yet now he was being rewarded for doing what should be done—it couldn’t get any better!
“Dear wife, it seems we don’t have other plans today, why don’t we go choose a car?” Lin Yi asked softly.
“But I can’t give you any good advice. I don’t know much about cars, I can’t even recognize the models…” Han Xuewei hesitated.
“No problem, as long as you think the interior is nice and it’s comfortable to sit in, let’s buy it! We’re not short on money!”
Hearing this, Han Xuewei laughed and teased, “Listen to you, buy it if it’s comfortable? We don’t even know if we have enough money. What if I pick one that costs tens of millions? What then?”
“Look at what you’re saying. Of course, we’ll buy it! As long as my wife likes it, we must have it! If really necessary, we can just take out a loan!” Lin Yi said generously.
Worth tens of millions? If his wife liked it, then he must buy it, especially since he could afford it!
“A loan? That won’t do. I’ve heard that the interest on car loans is extremely high,” Han Xuewei said as she shook her head repeatedly. She knew that Lin Yi’s family was wealthy, but money still needed to be saved.
“I’ll accompany you to pick a car today! We don’t need to buy anything too expensive, something economical will do. We’re only going to use it for transportation, so we don’t have high requirements, how does that sound?”
She wasn’t aware of how much her husband had in savings, but then again, they were both university students and buying their house must have cost a lot. Not to mention, his family’s business wasn’t doing well, so they wouldn’t have much saved.
The sensible Han Xuewei naturally didn’t have high demands for a car.
In her view, a car was merely a means of transportation; excessive luxury served no benefit. Practicality and comfort were sufficient.
Lin Yi smiled slightly upon hearing this and then said, “I’ll listen to my wife, so I wanted to take you with me to help me decide, to consider your opinion! Otherwise, I might get carried away and buy something too expensive, which wouldn’t be good.”
“After much consideration, I plan to buy three cars at once, one for the two of us, one with more space for the nanny, and the last one as a dedicated shopping car for Aunt Wang. Considering this, the budget should be a few million, right?”
“That much? Hubby, three cars would need at least two million, right? You’ve made such a huge budget? I really think you are so good at making money!”
Han Xuewei was genuinely surprised after hearing this. How could an average family just decide to pick up cars on the spur of the moment? Especially three at once!
Buying a car isn’t a trivial matter; routine maintenance and various insurances are significant expenses.
This is about three cars! The monthly expenses could easily run into several thousand yuan!
And Lin Yi had actually prepared such a large budget to buy cars? Han Xuewei was also puzzled, wondering how much would be left after purchasing the cars.
If all the money was used up in the beginning, it wouldn’t be easy to raise a child!

chapters.title: Chapter 29: 29: Picking Up My Beloved Car
chapters.content:
You should know, there are three babies in her belly!
In today's society, raising just one child is a lot of pressure, what with countless invisible expenses, not to mention triplets!
Seeing the astonishment written all over Han Xuemei's cheeks, Lin Yi laughed and then said, "You don't have to worry about these things at all, wife. Your husband can afford this money, and besides, our family really isn't short on cash!"
"Let's head out now! If possible, we'll pick up the car today, choose a good one and drive it right off the lot! Without a vehicle for transportation, it's really too inconvenient! We spend quite a lot of time on the road every day, having a car would make things a bit easier!"
Han Xuewei couldn't help but smile seeing how excited her husband got at the mention of buying a car.
It seems that men are very interested in buying cars! It's like they have endless things to say as soon as cars are mentioned.
Maybe every man has a dream of driving his ideal car in his heart!
Seeing his dream about to come true, such emotions are truly relatable!
With that, Lin Yi took his wife out, and the two of them went directly to the most famous dealership in Xiangcheng - Lao You Dealership.
Lin Yi had checked all the car dealerships in Xiangcheng last night and found that this Lao You Dealership had a very good reputation. They had all sorts of models, from sedans to SUVs, be it domestic, joint-venture, or even imported cars, so he was confident that buying a car here would be the right choice!
Moreover, he had researched many models yesterday, and today he mainly wanted to experience the test drive effects!
And the selection of interiors, as well as the comfort level for his wife, had to be experienced in person for them to make a choice.
After all, his current balance was in the tens of millions! Unless he customized every single component inside and out, his savings would be more than sufficient!
"Husband, did you pick out any model yesterday?"
Upon arriving at Lao You Dealership, this couple faced a dazzling array of car brands and for a moment, were a bit overwhelmed by the choices.
Han Xuewei especially, who had never looked into car brands before and had just gotten her driver's license, was unfamiliar with some of the brands she saw!
Lin Yi smiled and said to her, "You pick first. If you see something you like, we can take it straight away!"
Most of the cars in this dealership were mid-priced, not very expensive. Given the savings he had now, it wouldn't be an issue to pick up several million-dollar cars all at once, so his confidence was understandably high.
As soon as his wife liked one, they would take it!
Seeing her husband's generous attitude, Han Xuewei didn't think too much and started to take her selection seriously.
Choosing the general type of car by herself should be fine, right? As for the price, it was just a few hundred thousand, as long as it didn't exceed the budget.
From the budget her husband had prepared in advance, cars in the few-hundred-thousand range were completely fine.
After looking around for a while, Han Xuewei stopped in the BMW section and casually pointed to a BMW Mini next to her.
"If we're going to get a nanny car in the future, then I should choose something more moderately priced. A car like this would also be more convenient to drive around."
Indeed, this BMW Mini model was particularly suitable for women, and parking it around town was convenient as well.
Moreover, Han Xuewei wasn't too picky about cars; the most she would do was to take the kids out for fun, so this car was more than enough to meet their needs.
"Isn't that model a bit too small? I don't think it's quite right. When we have three children, occasionally taking them out or going to the mall to shop, the space in this car won't be enough. Let's pick one with a bigger space!"
The salesperson, listening in on the couple's conversation, couldn't help but light up; it looked like they had landed a big client today!
Suddenly energized, the salesperson started introducing more suitable models with greater earnestness.
They showed the couple almost every brand available.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xuewei finally spoke without a second thought, "Some cars look cool, but they don't seem right for us. Let's pick something that looks more low-key! I think the Mercedes GLB is not bad."
After several selections, Han Xuewei ultimately settled on this model, feeling that it appeared quite imposing yet remained subdued. Compared to various sports cars, this was the most suitable choice.
Han Xuewei was just that type of person. As the beauty of the school, she was very low-key on a regular basis. The top-level configuration of this car she had chosen was only in the four-hundred-thousands, and it felt quite comfortable to sit in.
Lin Yi was still pondering something and then said, "Wife, this price is a bit low. I wanted to choose a car over a million for you. The interior would be more luxurious, the ride more comfortable, do you want to pick again?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei shook her head repeatedly, "No, no, no, husband, I don't want to look anymore. I'm a bit tired after walking for so long, let's just go with this one!"
As soon as he heard his wife say she was tired, Lin Yi hurried forward to support her, worrying about her getting fatigued, with a look of concern he asked, "Wife, are you alright? Then let's not shop anymore and just go with the car you liked! I've chosen a car with a lot of space, considering we have to take our whole family out for fun! I'll go with the Land Rover Range Rover Sport!"
"We'll get a BMW Mini for Aunt Wang, as you were looking at earlier. You can also drive it out for fun sometimes, and it's pretty convenient for everyday travel."
Han Xuewei was surprised and said, "Huh? Are we really going to buy three cars at once? But you said we're also getting a car for the nanny, isn't this spending a bit too much?"
Lin Yi just smiled faintly, comforting her, "This expense is manageable. After all, this money isn't being wasted, it's all for improving the quality of our daily life, it's okay."
Upon hearing this, the salesperson's eyes nearly bulged out of their head!
Good grief! They had nearly met their sales target for the month! They had never imagined someone would come in and buy three cars at once!
Who wouldn't be thrilled?
With enthusiasm, the salesperson invited Lin Yi and his wife to the VIP room to process the paperwork and even brewed them a pot of fine Longjing tea!
Lin Yi, of course, knew that his pregnant wife shouldn't drink tea, so he got her a glass of water instead.
The salesperson brought the materials and started to tally them up.
"Mr. Lin, Mrs. Lin, what configurations were you looking at for the cars you just selected?"
Lin Yi didn't even need to think about it and confidently said, "Of course, the top configurations would be best. We came for the experience, so equip them all with top specs."
Lin Yi had actually planned this all along; the three cars were completely different models, suitable for their family of five plus their nanny, Aunt Wang, to travel in comfort.

chapters.title: Chapter 30: 30: Return Twice the Amount?
chapters.content:
"Okay, Mr. Lin!"
After speaking, the salesperson opened the calculator and began to calculate the full-equipped prices of the three models.
"First is the BMW Mini, the top configuration is priced at 370,000; the Mercedes GLB top configuration at 400,000; the Range Rover Sport you selected, fully equipped, requires 1.9 million, totaling 2.67 million."
"Mr. Lin, this price..." The salesperson turned to Lin Yi after finishing the calculation, trying hard to suppress his excited tone.
If this deal was made, his commission would be substantial!
It wasn't an exaggeration to say that the commission alone could afford him a new car!
It must be said, when this couple first walked in, the salesperson didn't think they would go for high-priced cars, as they were dressed simply and seemed to be here for cost-effective models.
But unexpectedly, they went straight for three cars without a second thought! The total value was nearly 3 million!
"Does your dealership have any promotions?"
Although Lin Yi had plenty of money, he wasn't one to waste it and naturally knew such high prices could be squeezed.
Besides, haggling is quite normal when shopping! The wealthier the person, the more meticulous they are. Those who don't bargain are the real nouveau riche or tycoons!
On the topic of promotional policies, the salesperson didn't have much authority, so he immediately went out to invite the manager.
As soon as the manager learned that a major customer had arrived, he dropped his work right away and quickly followed the salesperson to the VIP room.
Upon entering, he greeted the couple with a smile plastered on his face.
"Mr. Lin, the total price for the three models you've picked today is a bit high. Are you planning to pay in full or choose to finance?"
"I'll pay in full," Lin Yi replied calmly.
The three cars totaled just over 2 million, and he had more than enough in his account to cover them without needing to finance.
After hearing this, the manager, with a standard smile, courteously said, "Our dealership is offering substantial discounts at the moment. Since you've chosen the high-end models, and since you're such a good customer, we won't be stingy. We'll give you a direct discount of 100,000, a total of 2.57 million. Can you accept this price?"
Wow! A one-off discount of 100,000!
The profit margins in the automobile industry must be really high!
After hearing this, Lin Yi couldn't help but be tempted, though he continued to maintain a cool demeanor.
He turned his attention to Han Xuewei, asking, "Wife, can you accept this price?"
Han Xuewei was initially stunned by the total quoted price for the three cars, not expecting them to be so expensive! This price seemed a bit too high...
"This... I'm fine with it! Husband, I'll go with your decision," Han Xuewei said, still in shock and also extremely impressed that Lin Yi could afford to buy cars in such a manner.
After all, in her view, there weren't many who could go to a dealership and pick up three cars at once, let alone young people like her husband!
To put it non-exaggeratively, this should count as young and successful, right?
"Is there any other paperwork that needs to be done? I want to drive one of the cars away today," Lin Yi sincerely looked at the manager.
"As long as you swipe your card and sign this contract, you can take the car immediately!" the latter replied with a smile.
"Let's process it now! My wife shouldn't stay out too long; we need to go back and rest," Lin Yi said calmly as he took out his bank card.
After all the paperwork was done and the card had been swiped, a notification tone from the system echoed in Lin Yi's mind!
"Ding, congratulations to the host! You have successfully picked up a car for your wife and child! The expenses for today's car purchase will be returned to you double!"
Lin Yi was momentarily startled when he heard the news.
Good Lord!
His blood pressure instantly skyrocketed!
Such good news, why didn't you say it earlier? Double the return? Is there really such a good deal?
If he had known about the double return earlier, he would have specifically chosen the more expensive options to buy!
Look at the commotion this has caused!
A moment later, Lin Yi received a text message notification, informing him that the amount for the double return had been deposited into his account.
That was over five million!
About an hour later, all the paperwork was sorted out, and Lin Yi was directly driving the top-of-the-line Range Rover Sport he had selected.
The other two cars would be delivered to his house by the dealership staff later.
When the couple returned home, Han Xuewei hadn't snapped out of her surprise yet. A car worth millions, and they just got in it like that?
How come it feels so effortless, as if this is all a dream?
Is this the lifestyle of the wealthy?
Han Xuewei couldn't help asking, "Husband, I never realized you were so rich before!"
Up to this point, her life still felt like a dream, having married such a money-making husband, living in a 400-square-meter mansion, and having three cars delivered to their home at once!
And according to what Lin Yi said on the way home, there was still a deposit of tens of millions in their bank account!
"Just focus on taking care of your pregnancy. You don't need to worry about anything else, especially money matters. Just tell me if we're ever short on cash," Lin Yi said, his voice involuntarily lowering as he spoke, since after all, the money was easily obtained from the system, which made him feel somewhat guilty.
Lin Yi realized at this moment that he urgently needed to find a proper occupation to make his savings seem legitimate.
Now all he could say to others was that he made some money from investing before, but as for what specifically he invested in and how, he really couldn't say.
For now, he just had to make do with vague responses verbally.
After listening, Han Xuewei nodded and said, "Don't worry, husband, I trust you! I also trust that I haven't misjudged you, you must be a very capable husband!"
With that, she stepped forward and hugged Lin Yi tightly.
The man before her was her husband, as well as the father of the three children in her belly; no matter what, she would stand by Lin Yi's side.
In a few days, they would have to visit the hospital for another prenatal checkup.
Aunt Wang, upon returning home, twisted her foot due to fatigue, rendering her movement inconvenient. To recover better, she had no choice but to take two weeks off until her legs were well enough for her to return to work.
Lin Yi didn't have much to be busy with each day; his primary task was taking care of his wife.
However, in his spare time, he had already started considering hiring a maternity matron and a nanny for after his wife gave birth.
With three babies on the way, the household was sure to be hectic, making a nanny and a maternity matron necessary.
Besides, with his significant savings, spending on his wife and children was only natural and right.
One morning, Lin Yi got out of bed early and went straight into the kitchen.

chapters.title: Chapter 31: 31 Another Prenatal Check-up
chapters.content:
As always, he prepared breakfast and then went to wake Han Xuewei up.
Lin Yi had noticed in the past few days that his wife's love for sleep had grown even worse; if she wasn't woken up in the morning, she might sleep all the way until noon!
Moreover, his wife would occasionally act like a child and was quite dependent on him.
After all, his wife was still a young girl, so he could tolerate all her little tantrums. The most important thing for an expectant mother during pregnancy is care, which Lin Yi, understanding this well, provided to his wife without a trace of negligence.
In just a few days at home, Lin Yi had received a system reward for his meticulous care for his wife and child, amounting to a total of three million.
By this calculation, the savings in his account were about to break through the twenty million mark!
This also brought him a continuous motivation to care for his wife and child.
He had already done the math in his heart; earning money was now most important. Not to mention the expenses for the three children as they grew up, just the cost of baby formula and diapers alone was a significant investment!
Not to mention hiring a nanny and maternity matron—each month that'd cost quite a bit as well!
Of course, having just one nanny was undoubtedly not enough!
Just by doing the math, one could tell this expense was substantial!
In this day and age, raising children really is something that piles up money!
Only grown-ups know how embarrassing it is to be penniless!
After hastily finishing breakfast, Lin Yi drove his wife to the hospital; by now she was six months pregnant and it was obviously harder for her to walk, her waistline had grown quite a bit from two weeks ago.
They had made an appointment for an ultrasound today to check on the fetal heartbeat.
Lin Yi carefully supported his wife, truly afraid that she would feel the slightest discomfort.
It would have been even more inconvenient if they had come to the hospital in the first or second month of the early morning.
Han Xuewei also carefully protected her swelling belly. Her waistline was nearly the same as someone who was eight months pregnant, making her feel very uncomfortable when walking.
She could even predict that when she reached eight months, going out might become a problem! Weren't the signs of pregnancy with triplets way too obvious?!
In fact, more than this, Han Xuewei's biggest concern was whether there would be any dangers when she gave birth to these three babies?
After all, there are many unforeseen situations during childbirth, especially for a mom like her who is expecting triplets at once.
Han Xuewei's worries were not superfluous, seeing as it was her first pregnancy, and every mother must psychologically overcome this difficult barrier.
Faced with all the unknowns, Han Xuewei couldn't help but hold her husband's hand tightly.
The couple arrived at the door of the ultrasound room and were soon called in by a nurse.
The consulting doctor was still the one who had examined Han Xuewei a few days ago.
After a brief exchange of pleasantries, Han Xuewei lay down quietly waiting for the examination.
Lin Yi also stood by, obediently.
The doctor was also very careful with the probe, aiming it at Han Xuewei's belly.
As the probe moved back and forth, Lin Yi had already taken out his camera and started recording a video at the side.
He wanted to use this camera to personally document each and every beautiful moment from the prenatal check-ups to the children's growth and create a video collection.
This way, it would be a very, very precious memory for both him and the children when they looked back on this video in the future!
"The babies are developing very well, they are so obedient!" the doctor, after staring at the screen for a long while, said softly.
"Let's give your body a check to see, what is this little one hiding in the corner doing?" the doctor asked Han Xuemei to lie on her side, then placed another instrument against her belly.
At that moment, a strong, rhythmic heartbeat sound emitted from the equipment in front of them.
It sounded vigorous and was incredibly melodious.
This heartbeat was clearer and stronger than the one Lin Yi had heard a few days ago with the fetal heart monitor he had purchased.
Both husband and wife felt a surge of joy in their hearts.
"This heartbeat is from the baby on the far left... Listen, this one is from the baby in the middle..." the doctor gently moved the probe, whispering to them.
It was as if making any loud noise would startle the three children.
"The last baby is the shyest, always hiding in the corner, so the sound is a bit soft," the doctor said, diligently moving the probe and continuously applying coupling gel in an attempt to hear more clearly.
"There it is! That's the sound..." After a moment, the doctor finally found the optimal angle.
The heartbeat became much clearer.
"Hmm, you can rest easy now, all three babies are very healthy! Their heart rates are very steady."
As soon as the doctor finished speaking, he picked up another probe and, smiling, said to the couple, "Now let's check the developmental state of the three babies. Their limbs are very clear now!"
But as the probe kept moving, the corresponding images appeared on the screen, showing the babies sleeping quietly in the amniotic fluid.
The doctor had Han Xuemei turn slightly, and after some searching, a baby's cheek finally appeared on the screen.
"Look quickly, the nose is already very clear, it looks like a baby with a high bridge of the nose! Very much like your husband!"
Lin Yi, standing by, was earnestly taking a video. Hearing what the doctor said, he couldn't help but smile, his heart filled with irrepressible joy, yet he dared not speak.
He didn't want to miss a second of the recording; he wanted to capture every moment perfectly!
After all, these videos would be the most precious memories in the future!
"Both of you have high attractiveness, I believe the babies that are born will also be very cute."
No sooner had the doctor spoken than Han Xuewei felt a kick from the baby in her stomach!
The doctor holding the probe also felt a tremor.
She couldn't help but smile and said, "The little one can hear us talking!"
After a simple examination, the young couple successfully received the printed results.
Since Han Xuewei had been there for check-ups before, the doctor was very familiar with her condition.
In fact, all the doctors in the department now recognized Han Xuewei.
It's rare to see triplets, after all!
The doctor responsible for the prenatal examination was named Sun, and Dr. Sun took out the printed report, studied it, and began to explain it carefully to the couple.
"You must be very tired, right, Mommy? It's good to persist, and fortunately, the babies' development is going well now, but you need to pay more attention to your diet, focusing on light foods, as what you eat now will directly affect the baby's weight. If they become too heavy, it will greatly impact your daily life."
"Especially sugary desserts with a lot of energy, it's best not to eat them."

chapters.title: Chapter 32: 32 I Love Only You
chapters.content:
"There are still many things to be aware of. Now that you're at this stage, if you feel tired every day, you don't need to exercise anymore. Let's skip the post-meal walks too. It's time to start thinking about the delivery. It's best to book a private hospital bed in advance because the triplets are likely to be born by cesarean section.
When the time comes, you can just come straight to the hospital."
"Your abdominal circumference will continue to grow, and your belly will get even bigger. Natural childbirth is not good for both the baby and mother. So you need to be mentally prepared."
Lin Yi was worried about this very thing, and after hearing the doctor's advice, he decisively booked a private delivery room in advance. After all, with a big family and many people, he had to provide the most comfortable rest environment for his wife and babies.
Han Xuewei just sat there silently, patiently waiting for her husband to complete the procedures.
She now had trouble even walking, and would get tired if she moved around too much. Aside from resting, she refrained from thinking about anything else.
Hearing what the doctor had just said, it seemed like the hard times were still ahead!
If she gave birth to the three babies by cesarean section, there would be a long scar on her stomach, and maybe even stretch marks! They say those are very ugly and that the skin on the stomach completely loses its elasticity.
Moreover, giving birth to triplets might have greater side effects than just having one child!
Thinking of all these unpleasant things, Han Xuewei couldn't help but sigh and her eyes began to well up with tears.
At this moment, she wondered, what if her husband started to despise her because of these things?
Han Xuewei also suddenly realized that she had been having some strange thoughts lately, always considering her husband and child's well-being.
The more she thought, the sourer her heart felt, and her nose stinged with emotion.
Han Xuewei was even a bit worried that she might be suffering from what is called depression, which she heard is most likely to occur postpartum. That's why she was being very careful in everything she did.
When Lin Yi finished the procedures and came back to her, Han Xuewei shared her thoughts with her husband.
He too was very concerned upon hearing this. This was definitely an issue that needed attention! Fortunately, Han Xuewei had shared her worries, otherwise, having her dwell on these problems alone could have indeed led to depression.
Lin Yi began to reflect on his behavior as well, realizing that in recent days, he had been overly concerned with the babies in the womb, possibly neglecting his wife's feelings.
It was clear that he needed to change. His wife was the most important, and while taking good care of the three children, he needed to keep her at the center and care more about her feelings.
Lin Yi comforted his wife with great care, whispering, "Wife, please be assured, I will always love you just like now! How could I despise you? You've been so good to me, even made me a father. If I did despise you, everyone would condemn me! That kind of behavior would be utterly inhumane, wouldn't it?"
"Husband will continue to dote on you as always, I won't allow you to think of these things anymore! Don't worry, in this lifetime, I only love you! Also, the car we bought is registered in your name, and tomorrow I will add your name to the property deed as well. And let's sign an agreement that if I ever do anything bad to you, I will leave with nothing! Not a single penny!"
Han Xuewei immediately covered Lin Yi's mouth with her hand, stopping him from saying more.
"Don't say such things, I've never thought about any of this. Maybe I'm just... thinking too much for a moment; there's no need for you to worry too much."
"Then I'll stop talking about it, wife. You now need to pay attention to rest properly and can't have these negative thoughts anymore! I need to give you enough sense of security. How could I disregard you when you're about to give birth to our three lovely babies?! I would never do something so outrageous!"
Lin Yi consoled her with a concerned look on his face, fearing even the slightest instability in his wife's emotions!
After all, depression is no joke, especially when a pregnant woman suffers from it. Whether before or after birth, it's very detrimental to both mother and baby!
Lin Yi still had a lifetime to spend with his wife. How could he bear to let her suffer the torment of illness?
About a few days later, Lin Yi's parents, as well as Han Xuewei's parents, rushed over to accompany the couple.
The parents also discussed taking care of the formalities for the couple to take a leave of absence from school since the school required parents to handle the procedures, and Han Xuewei, with her pregnant belly, was already finding it inconvenient to go out.
The leave of absence was arranged for one year, so after the baby was born, Han Xuewei could have a peaceful postpartum confinement period, and the couple could spend a few more months with their child.
A few days later, Aunt Wang also recovered from her foot injury and came back early to take care of them.
Life for the couple became much more comfortable.
Now, the big family was thoroughly reunited, and the atmosphere was harmonious and joyful with everyone together!
The next morning, just as dawn was breaking, Han Xuewei's phone began to ring.
She was woken up from her sleep, rubbed her bleary eyes, and slowly picked up the phone that was charging on the bedside table.
The doctor had specifically instructed her to get enough sleep and to put her phone on airplane mode while sleeping, but evidently, she had forgotten to do so the previous night.
Looking at the screen, she saw dozens of missed calls and quite a few unread WeChat messages!
Upon closer inspection, she realized that all these messages were from her college friend, Qin Xiaoxu.
Feeling puzzled, Han Xuewei wondered why Qin Xiaoxu would be in such a rush to contact her so early in the morning, calling and messaging.
Without overthinking it, she immediately returned the call.
"Vivi! Thank goodness, I've finally reached you! Why did it take you so long to answer the phone?" Qin Xiaoxu's excited voice came through the phone, though her tone seemed somewhat angry.
Han Xuewei asked anxiously, "What's happened? You scared me to death. Seeing that you had called me so many times, I hurriedly called you back after I saw it."
On the other end of the phone, Qin Xiaoxu started yelling, "Such an important matter and I have to chase you down for it? I am very, very angry! And I don't want to hear your explanations!"
"How could there be secrets between best friends? Why didn't you tell me right away that you were pregnant? I didn't even know you were married!"
After hearing this, Han Xuewei was also startled and asked in surprise, "You already know I'm pregnant? How did you find out?"
Listening to Han Xuewei's response, Qin Xiaoxu was so angry she could hardly contain herself. "You've done a great job keeping it a secret! Well, you certainly didn't expect that someone from our school saw you going to the hospital with a man, and you even entered the ultrasound room! They also saw you wearing a diamond ring at the time!"

chapters.title: Chapter 33: 33 Everybody Knows
chapters.content:
"I heard you two even went car shopping and bought a luxury car, right? Other students have said they've seen that guy! He's from the same school as us!"
"With you not returning to school for such a long time, of course, you wouldn't know how much this has blown up! The confession wall and forums are all buzzing about you two! I heard both of you have taken a leave of absence from school!"
"At first, I didn't believe it, but then all signs began to point towards it being true! You haven't been back to school for so long – you couldn't possibly be showing with a big belly, ready to give birth, could you?"
Han Xuewei was listening to her best friend's complaints while washing up, soon joining Lin Yi at the dining table for breakfast.
Seeing his wife on the phone all morning, Lin Yi quietly asked, "Who is it?"
He was met with his wife's smile in response.
At this time, only Lin Yi and Han Xuewei sat at the dining table. Lin Yi's parents had stayed only a few days after helping their son with his school hiatus before returning home to prepare for handing the company over to him, planning to come back the month before the baby's due date.
Han Xuewei's dad also returned home due to related matters, while her mom stayed behind with Aunt Wang to take care of her, and the two were currently off to the market to shop for groceries.
Han Xuemei lowered her voice and then, with a smile, confessed to her friend on the phone, "They're right, I'm with Lin Yi, and I'm actually almost due to give birth."
Her admission left Qin Xiaoxu silent for a long while before he finally said over the phone, "You don't mean that time you said you were going out and then didn't come back in the evening..."
Han Xuewei blushed and whispered back, "Mhm."
With a heavy sigh, Qin Xiaoxu pressed on, "Why the sudden marriage? Didn't you guys have a wedding ceremony? Isn't something missing?"
Han Xuewei walked slowly to the living room and leaned against the sofa while patiently explaining, "It's not as you think. I have triplets in my tummy, so right now, I can't exert myself; we'll make up the wedding ceremony after the children are born. Lin Yi has promised me that we won't miss out on anything."
"Besides, we are very much in love. He really loves me a lot, so you don't need to worry! When have I ever been at a disadvantage? The husband I chose for myself is definitely without issue," Han Xuewei confidently assured her best friend while not forgetting to glance at Lin Yi.
After hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu couldn't help but exclaim, "What? You're carrying triplets? How are you so fertile, like a little guinea pig?!"
Han Xuewei, irritated by her friend's words, retorted, "Humph, you're the guinea pig! May all your future children be guinea pigs! My triplets are adorable! I will give birth to them no matter what!"
Qin Xiaoxu replied helplessly, "Alas, it's a shame, our beautiful flower has plunged into the cow dung! And you're about to have three babies for him!! From now on, don't hide anything from me like this again! I insist on being godmother to the three little ones!"
Laughing softly, Han Xuewei said, "Speaking so poorly of Lin Yi isn't right; I think he's quite handsome, and indeed the type I like. He'll make a handsome dad, and the kids will definitely be beautiful. And as for the godmother, you were always going to be it; I wouldn't have it any other way!"
Qin Xiaoxu laughed and asked, "Aren't you tired of staying at home for so long? Don't you want to go out and have some fun? It would be nice to chat with you. If it's inconvenient, I'll come over. By the way, did he buy you a marital home? You both are still students; surely you didn't struggle to buy a house, right?
Or did you just settle for a small place? Especially since I heard his family's business isn't doing well this year, almost like they're going bankrupt – it's not too dire, is it?"
Han Xuewei replied, "Actually, it's not really bankruptcy – some people are just spreading rumors. Lin Yi used the money he earned from stock investments to buy a house, in fragrant Osmanthus Garden's Building Nine."
"The house is pretty big, our parents from both sides can move in without a problem. His parents think highly of me, especially since Lin Yi is an only child. By the way, you should come over to keep me company. We can chat and catch up. I'm so bored being alone, and now with the baby growing, it's getting harder to get around."
Qin Xiaoxu was very surprised, "Xianggui Garden, Building Number Nine! Vivi, you're not living in a villa area, are you? I'll find time to visit you. Take good care of yourself. I want to see what a big villa is really like! And let me know if you need anything; I'll bring some stuff for you.
I will fulfill all your little wishes!"
"Hmm!"
"Alright, I have to get back to studying for an exam! Let's talk later. If you get bored or upset, just send me a WeChat message, don't let our expectant mother be alone and bored!"
After chatting briefly, the two girls went back to their busy lives.
After Han Xuewei hung up the phone, she looked up and noticed that Lin Yi was staring at her.
"Hmm? Husband, what's up?"
The latter replied helplessly, "I could hear every word of your conversation from all the way over here. Does the whole school know we're married by now?"
Han Xuewei nodded and answered, "I heard some students even saw us going for a prenatal checkup. And it seems like everyone is talking about us; opinions are all over the place."
Suddenly, Lin Yi asked, "So, wife, do you want everyone to know about this?"
Han Xuewei looked puzzled, "Why do you suddenly ask that?"
Lin Yi said, "You've always been the school belle, the focus of attention in our school. I've never had much presence there. The news about us being together is bound to have an impact on you. I'm a bit worried about you..."
"Lin Yi, I won't allow you to think like that! We're married now, and any problems we face, we face together. Besides, I feel that being with you was the right choice. I've been very happy with all the time we've spent together! I think you're the best choice for me!"
Han Xuewei had never confessed so boldly before. As soon as she finished speaking, even her cheeks became slightly red.
At that moment, the same thought crossed both their minds, and they made a deep and firm resolution...
Suddenly, Lin Yi's phone also received a message.
Upon checking, it was from the dormitory group he belonged to.
Lin Yi gently kissed Han Xuewei's forehead, then took out his phone to check the message.
"Lin Yi, do you guys already have a child? The whole school knows that the school belle is pregnant. You better not tell me this is just a rumor!"

chapters.title: Chapter 34: 34 Welcoming a Close Girlfriend
chapters.content:
"Holy moly! I said Han Xuewei comes from a good family too, seems like they're also loaded! A bona fide rich second generation, huh! You must have built up a ton of good karma in your last life to have married her!"
"Is that even a question? Our school's beauty would be anything less than amazing? Not only is her family well-off, but she's also stunning. All the good stuff falls into your lap!"
"Brother Lin! I want to learn from you! How can one marry such a goddess? To marry a beauty with both brains and bucks, that's what I call reaching the Peak of life!"
"Hahahaha, I think you should save your effort, Lin Yi's family conditions were already pretty good. Even a skinny camel is bigger than a horse, what can you, a total loser, even compare to him? Forget about those dreams... "
"Pffft, that's spot on, you've got nothing on Lin Yi."
