When Lin Yi saw these guys, each one tirelessly brownnosing, he was instantly speechless!
Since when were these guys such experts in brownnosing?
He replied in the chat group with utter calm.
"I already told you guys before, we were definitely going to get married, did you all just not take it seriously? Now we are legally married, we've had the marriage certificate for months."
Lin Yi's words quickly caused a stir in the dormitory chat group!
"My God! Back then I thought you were just kidding, but you actually managed to win over our school beauty? Nice one!"
"Dude! Was everything you said the other day true? But we never saw any signs of you two dating at school! How on earth did you end up together out of the blue? You're saying you got the certificate in less than two months???"
"So, do you really have kids already like everyone's been rumoring? I've heard plenty of those whispers. And I've heard Han Xuewei's belly is already big, she's about to give birth, right?"
"Yeah! How come you've got a baby so quickly? The timing doesn't quite add up, dude. You better not have just taken over someone else's problem just because you fancied her looks... We men have got to have some dignity..."
???
Lin Yi responded with a string of question marks, not knowing how to handle this barrage of questions from his friends!
What is this 'taking over someone else's problem' nonsense?
He's not sick! Why would he take over anything?
He, Lin Yi, could proudly say he was a real man!
"Don't believe the nonsense people tell you. When I disclosed the news, Vivi was already pregnant. The child is indeed mine, so I thought it best to take responsibility quickly by marrying her. Us guys have to keep up appearances; I would never take over someone else's problem!"
The group fell silent for a moment, and everyone went quiet.
"Holy smokes! You've been making a fortune in silence, man! Silently scoring the school beauty like that... I would've never guessed!"
"Seriously impressive, I have to admit that! When are you coming back, so we can get together?"
"Yeah man, you're married now, and we're waiting to attend your wedding! When will it be?"
"Whatever you say, we have to celebrate for you! Waiting for your return to throw you a feast!"
Lin Yi helplessly said, "I also want to have the wedding as soon as possible! But now Vivi is about to give birth, pregnant with triplets no less, so it's not very convenient for her to travel. Don't worry though, we'll definitely make up for the wedding, and you guys have to be there!"
"Besides, when I have time I'll treat you guys to a big meal."
Lin Yi got along very harmoniously with his dormmates, and they had a great relationship, so he wanted to find the time to treat them.
After seeing Lin Yi's response, the three brothers in the dormitory finally understood the truth and stopped pressing the matter, waiting for Lin Yi to treat them to a feast.
Lin Yi took a long breath, set his phone aside, and finally settled down.
He turned his gaze toward his wife next to him and happened to catch Han Xuewei's expression, which seemed a bit odd.
He instinctively leaned in and asked, "Wife, what are you looking at?"
To his surprise, she picked up her phone with a flustered look and stammered, "Ah? Nothing, not looking at anything..."
Lin Yi immediately noticed her panicked demeanor and knew she must be hiding something.
"Do you have something on your mind, or is there some secret? Why hide it even from your husband?" Lin Yi smiled, intentionally moving closer to her and whispered.
"There's nothing... really, nothing at all..." Han Xuewei's eyes kept darting around, clearly showing her guilt.
But at that moment, Lin Yi's phone suddenly vibrated, bombarded with a barrage of messages!
Still looking at Han Xuewei with an adoring face, he comforted her, "Let me finish up what I'm doing, and then I'll see what big secret my treasure is hiding."
As soon as he said this, he opened the unread messages.
These numerous messages were also from the dormitory group chat, where a roommate had sent dozens of photos into the group.
After seeing the photos, his eyes lit up, and he started flipping through them one by one.
Every photo was of Lin Yi and Han Xuewei together.
There were everyday snapshots of the two at home and casual photos taken while out shopping. The photos even included the big diamond ring Lin Yi had bought and their couple outfits.
Each of these photos was sweeter than the last!
And it wasn't until the end that he realized his wife had posted all of these pictures on the campus's official confession wall!
It was practically an official announcement!
And the caption added, "Finally waited for you, my Mr. Lin! Please take good care of me for the rest of our lives!"
It truly was an official announcement.
Lin Yi had been planning in his heart to officially announce their marriage today, he had talked to his roommates for a while and then put it to the back of his mind!
Yet, he hadn't expected his wife to have the same idea and to have beat him to the punch with a confession wall post!
More importantly, their thoughts were exactly the same!
He excitedly showed his phone to Vivi beside him and quickly asked, "Wife... I'm your husband, and as a man, I should be the one to announce it first. But just now I got distracted, and you posted it first..."
However, Han Xuewei comforted him with a smile, "It's okay! I saw that many classmates were discussing this, and some people even confessed to me. I was just anxious to announce our relationship. We are legally married, after all; we should acknowledge it openly! Let everyone know that we deeply love each other!"
Seeing his wife so serious, Lin Yi's heart nearly melted, and he felt a pinch in his nose!
He really did marry a wonderful wife!
He suddenly thought of something and without a second thought, started typing a comment directly beneath Han Xuewei's announcement.
After carefully crafting his response, he left a message.
"To hold your hand and grow old together with you! May our love last forever!"

chapters.title: Chapter 35: 35: A Real Eye-Opener
chapters.content:
Apart from that, the comment section also displayed blessings from other people. But aside from those, there was another person looking at the official announcement who was clenching her teeth in anger!
That was Lin Yi's ex-girlfriend, Li Jingwen.
Lin Yi gently hugged Han Xuewei and said earnestly, "Wifey, I can understand how you feel but this kind of thing should be dealt with by me because I need to be more responsible."
"Mm." Han Xuewei looked at her husband's serious face and responded with a smile.
A few days later, her close girlfriend, Qin Xiaoxu, specially came over to see her!
Lin Yi had just arranged to take his three roommates out for a big meal, which also gave the ladies some space to themselves.
"Oh my! I've never seen a mansion of four hundred square meters! I wonder if I'll ever have such luck! Even the laundry room is so big! Wow, is the balcony really this spacious? A balcony is enough to dry clothes for the whole family!"
Qin Xiaoxu exclaimed with amazement as she followed Han Xuewei around, looking here and there with surprise all over her face!
"It's actually alright. There's a small garden behind the house and a garage on the side. Though it's said to be over four hundred square meters, the actual area is just barely four hundred," Han Xuewei demurred.
"That's already a lot, okay? This villa has several floors! Your living space is definitely more than four hundred square meters!" Qin Xiaoxu said excitedly.
"My goodness! I really can't believe it—some people are even saying that Lin Yi went bankrupt at home! Nowadays, people really say anything, and it had me worried about you! I was afraid that you'd suffer, that you married for love but ended up wronging yourself! But I never expected that, after all this time, my worries were totally unnecessary!"
Watching her friend struggle to calm her emotions, Han Xuewei soothed her while leading her to the living room. Aunt Wang brought them afternoon tea, and then went off to clean.
Just then, Han Xuewei's mother came downstairs with a smile and said, "Xiaoxu is here? You really should be thanked for taking such good care of our Vivi all the time. She always talks about you, and my, how beautiful you're growing up to be!"
Qin Xiaoxu smiled and replied, "Hello, Auntie!"
Han Xuewei's mother didn't linger long; after a short chat, she went to water the flowers on the balcony.
The two girls hadn't seen each other in a long time, and today, sitting together, they surely had endless topics to catch up on!
"I just can't imagine it, Vivi, is your mom here just to take care of you?" Qin Xiaoxu asked enviously.
"Yes, both my parents and Lin Yi's parents are going to move in. They've been a bit busy lately but will come over a month before the due date to take care of me. I've picked out the bedrooms for the babies and decided to let them stay on the second floor for convenience. The room next to it is perfect for the nanny, and the maternity matron will need one too.
Then, we'll clear out two rooms on the third floor for our parents," Han Xuewei explained.
"I can't believe it! Really, poverty limits one's imagination! Your whole family is moving in!" Qin Xiaoxu was struggling to control her emotions!
"With the financial resources you have, when the three children grow up, wouldn't it be nothing to buy each of them a house?"
"We'll talk about that when the time comes. I'm only focused on the present right now; I have not thought that far ahead," Han Xuewei said.
While she spoke, Han Xuewei's face was overflowing with a joyful smile, and beside her, Qin Xiaoxu was beyond envious.
"What does Lin Yi do for work? Or is he just staying at home with you? Let me tell you, you can never let him live off his parents! It's better to use your own money rather than your parents'. Men must have the ability to make money! As his wife, you must make sure he starts his own business to make money!"
After listening to her, Han Xuewei laughed and replied, "Don't worry! Lin Yi isn't like what you described; he has never lived off his parents, and he paid for this luxury house himself without even asking his family for money!"
"I heard that he had already bought this luxury house a year before we got married. I just moved in with my bags."
After hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu was shocked, her face incredulous, "Ah? He really bought it? Your husband is so amazing! I can't believe he made so much money while studying in university; truly it's in his genes, coming from a family that owns a company—the superior genes determine everything! Right, what does he do exactly? How can he afford a luxury house!"
Qin Xiaoxu suddenly became very interested, and in her view, it seemed an unbelievable thing, as most college students nowadays are still asking their parents for living expenses, yet here someone had bought a luxury house himself!
"I only know he's into investments, buys and sells stocks and stuff like that, and he has made quite a lot during that time. Plus, his dad already owns a company, and although business was affected recently, it didn't go bankrupt as everyone has been saying."
As Han Xuewei talked, her expression turned a bit proud.
She was proud because she had married a good man!
Which woman wouldn't be proud that her husband can make money?
"Alright, alright! Your face is about to split with all that smiling," Qin Xiaoxu said, feigning annoyance.
"By the way, why did you two suddenly decide to get married? Who was the one to bring it up first?" Qin Xiaoxu suddenly recalled something, and asked.
"He was the one who proposed," Han Xuewei said, a bit shyly.
She had nothing to hide from her close girlfriend, and so she narrated the whole story, from beginning to end.
The story left Qin Xiaoxu stunned, and she couldn't help saying, "When luck comes, nothing can stop it! If it had been some other scumbag, the outcome might not have been the same! Aren't you worried? Fortunately, this guy took responsibility for you, otherwise, the consequences would have been unimaginable!"
"Come on! Don't be so loud, neither of our parents know about this yet, you absolutely mustn't let my mom find out," Han Xuewei hurriedly covered her friend's mouth, making a shushing gesture.
The latter caught on, and her gaze lingered on the diamond ring on Han Xuewei's finger.
The ring looked quite conventional, with a moderate size, and was very beautiful; it was the ring Lin Yi had used to propose.
Since that day, Han Xuewei had always worn that ring, but lately she had been gaining weight quite rapidly, her fingers had also grown thicker, so the ring felt a bit tight.
Han Xuewei noticed her friend's look and extended her hand to show off, "Look, this is the engagement ring he bought for me. Lin Yi even said this one isn't enough; after the baby is born, he wants to pick out a bigger one to serve as a wedding ring. Looks nice, doesn't it? He bought it himself without telling me, and it looks so pretty."
Qin Xiaoxu clicked her tongue, "Our campus beauty is blinded by love! I didn't expect her to hang herself on a single tree before seeing the whole forest..."

chapters.title: Chapter 36: 36: Go to the Hospital Early
chapters.content:
"Let's talk about his parents. Now that you have three little treasures in your belly, are his parents treating you well?" Qin Xiaoxu asked in a hushed voice, gently inquiring.
She had watched too many urban dramas filled with various mother-in-law and daughter-in-law conflicts, so she was quite worried about her best friend possibly being plagued by similar issues, which is why she casually asked.
"His parents are really nice, they value me a lot. I can feel that his family really likes me and also hopes that the two of us can have a better future. Luckily, his entire family is easy to get along with, so don't worry about me. I am sure I won't be treated unfairly," she said.
As soon as she spoke about this, Han Xuewei's face was once again brimming with a happy smile.
All the good things seemed to have happened to her.
Not only does she have a capable husband who's tender and caring towards her and good at earning money, but also her in-laws are very kind to her. Now, I am already quite content," she added.
The two close friends chatted back and forth, so engrossed in conversation that they almost forgot about time...
It's uncertain how much time had passed when Lin Yi returned home at that moment.
After parking his newly bought Range Rover in the garage, he came to the yard just in time to see Han Xuewei and her best friend taking a walk.
Today, Lin Yi had treated his roommates to a big dinner. Since he had to drive home, he didn't drink a drop of alcohol. He also took the opportunity to drop Jiang Shan off at his dormitory before hurrying back home.
Qin Xiaoxu happened to witness the moment Lin Yi got out of the Range Rover, and her eyes nearly popped out.
Is this the high-end version of the Range Rover?!
The price of this Range Rover Sport isn't low, right?
Lin Yi is actually driving such a nice car!
A student can hardly afford a car worth nearly two million, can they?
Not to mention how exquisite the interior is.
Qin Xiaoxu, who was quite familiar with cars and generally knowledgeable about them, was unspeakably shocked at this moment!
Upon seeing the two taking a walk, Lin Yi approached with a smile and greeted them.
"Wife! Is this your good friend Qin Xiaoxu? Thank you for always taking care of Vivi," Lin Yi said courteously.
Qin Xiaoxu replied generously, "Hello! My name is Qin Xiaoxu!"
"I'm so envious of you two! And you're really lucky as well! Vivi is the most popular beauty at our school!"
The two had seen each other at school a few times and were not strangers, so they quickly started chatting.
"Hahaha, indeed I'm lucky. By the way, stay for dinner tonight!" Lin Yi invited proactively.
"Then I won't be polite! I came today especially to mooch a meal and drinks!" Qin Xiaoxu laughed as she said.
Lin Yi considerately asked, "What would you two like to eat? I'll go get the ingredients now."
"Wow! Lin Yi, I didn't expect you to actually go and pick up the ingredients yourself! This means that you can also cook, right?"
Han Xuewei took Qin Xiaoxu's hand, smiling as she said, "The dishes he makes are so delicious. I've never tasted such flavorful food before. You're in luck today because you get to try it!"
Then she turned to Lin Yi and said, "I didn't expect you to come back so early; I thought you might play till late tonight."
Lin Yi said with an adoring face, "I feel restless not seeing my wife for even a second, I miss you too much!"
"Alright, cut it out! Stop showing off your love in front of me, okay? I'm not eating this dog food! I'm really asking for it, huh? I come for a meal and get fed dog food; I protest!" Qin Xiaoxu hurriedly tried to intervene.
But little did she know, her protest not only had no effect at all, but it even increased the nauseating affection between the two!
The good friend Han Xuewei went directly to Lin Yi's side and took his arm, sweetly calling him husband.
Lin Yi also wrapped his free hand around Han Xuewei's lower back; because his wife's belly was big, hugging her was not easy anymore. At the same time, he gently kissed Han Xuewei's forehead.
Qin Xiaoxu couldn't bear the scene in front of her, and she screamed as she made her escape, determined not to get her fill of dog food before even having dinner!
However, thinking about it, her best friend having such a blissful married life truly made her happy, and she sent her heartfelt blessings.
At dinner time, the couple invited Qin Xiaoxu to join them.
Lin Yi prepared a lavish dinner for them, and since they both loved seafood, he made a total of eight dishes.
They should have invited Qin Xiaoxu to dine out at a fancy restaurant, but with Han Xuewei's condition making it inconvenient for her to travel, Lin Yi personally took charge of the cooking, trying his best to do well.
It must be said, his culinary skills were no less than those of a professional chef.
When the dishes were brought to the table, Qin Xiaoxu's eyes went wide with excitement; for any food lover, this was indeed paradise!
"I'm starting on it first! A seafood feast!" exclaimed Qin Xiaoxu.
Without further ado, she began to devour the king crab on her plate.
While eating, she didn't forget to caution Han Xuewei, "Oh right, Vivi, I looked it up specifically, pregnant women shouldn't eat too much seafood, it can greatly affect the baby!"
As she spoke, she continued to heap praise on the dishes on the table.
After hearing this, Han Xuewei looked towards Lin Yi, who was still busy in the kitchen, and said with a smile, "It's okay! My husband has already done his research on this, so my meal is different. Take your time eating, there's plenty of food here! If you're not busy, why not stay over tonight? It would be great company for me, especially since I'm bored."
Qin Xiaoxu replied, "That won't work, I'll be starting my internship immediately after exams. Even though I'd love to enjoy the feast, time just won't allow it!"
......
Not long after, Han Xuewei entered her eighth month of pregnancy, and she was clearly starting to feel the strain.
According to the prenatal checkup data, the weight of each of the triplets in her belly was around four pounds, with the strongest weighing five pounds. Although this seemed to be good news, Han Xuewei suffered quite a bit.
Lately, she had noticed an increase in her nighttime trips to the bathroom and a decline in the quality of her sleep; she was always listless, her body suffered from edema, and overall, she was uncomfortable all over.
Seeing Han Xuewei's suffering, the family began discussing the possibility of checking into the hospital early to see if they could opt for a cesarean section, which would provide her some relief.
After the discussion, Han Xuewei also agreed with the idea, so the family made their way to the maternity and child health hospital.
Lin Yi had previously planned to hire several nannies and maternity matrons, thinking three maternity matrons would be necessary, but now that both sets of parents were there, hiring two would suffice.
Han Xuewei was thus admitted to the hospital early, and two maternity matrons arrived, ready to start work at any moment.
With two experienced maternity matrons on hand, there would be no need for panic when the time for delivery arrived.
Lin Yi had also been reading up on various childcare knowledge these days, so he was very attentive to many things.

chapters.title: Chapter 37: 37 Safe and Sound Mother and Child
chapters.content:
Moreover, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei were both only children, so their parents were especially excited about the arrival of new lives into the family, and even started to feel nervous.
On the day of the cesarean section, everyone's faces were filled with tension, pacing anxiously outside the operating room door.
Lin Yi still held a package in his hands, which contained the maternity towels prepared in advance as well as baby supplies.
"Family of Han Xuewei, is the family of Han Xuewei here?" The door of the operating room suddenly opened, and a nurse stepped out, shouting to the crowd.
"That's me! I am Han Xuewei's husband," Lin Yi quickly stood up and responded, "Nurse, how is the situation now?"
Seeing the nurse come out, Lin Yi couldn't help feeling timid and hurriedly moved forward to greet her.
The nurse beamed with joy, "Congratulations, you're going to be a father! It's twins, one daughter and two sons, the mother and babies are all very safe."
After hearing the nurse's words, the whole family finally let go of the anxiety they had been holding!
Safe, as long as everyone is safe, that's good!
"Since it was triplets, the situation is special, two of the babies are underweight and we need to send them for a checkup now. If the checkup results confirm the babies are healthy, then there will be no problem. You need to sign here, and there's also the admission notice," the nurse patiently explained.
Lin Yi couldn't help feeling nervous and quickly asked, "There shouldn't be any major issues, right? We had all the checks before the cesarean and also consulted the doctors."
The nurse spoke cautiously, "We can't be certain of these situations now, as there are many unexpected occurrences during childbirth. We need to wait for the checkup results to have a further conclusion. But don't worry, the babies' crying is very loud, which generally means there shouldn't be any problems, so rest assured!"
Lin Yi was now feeling uncertain, worrying about the health of the children, but the nurse's words calmed him down, so he signed his name first, then watched as the nurse returned to the operating room.
Soon after, the three babies were wheeled out, and everyone immediately gathered around to see them.
Upon seeing the three babies, Lin Yi's gaze immediately softened; a feeling he had never experienced before arose in his heart, perhaps that was a sense of responsibility!
But at that moment, the system's prompt sounded in his mind!
"Ding! Congratulations to the host for meeting your three babies, awarding the host three million to buy baby formula!"
In Lin Yi's eyes, no amount of rewards seemed important anymore. From the moment he saw his children, Lin Yi's only wish was for them to grow up happy and safe.
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's parents hurriedly took out their cameras, eager to take photos with the babies and record the moment the three babies arrived in this world.
Lin Yi turned his gaze back towards the operating room, asking the nurse with some urgency, "How is my wife doing now? Why hasn't she come out yet?"
That nurse explained, "The dose of anesthesia we used earlier was somewhat large, so we need to observe your wife's condition a bit longer. You need to find a maternity matron to accompany me in taking the three babies to the pediatric ward!"
Han Xuewei's parents asked worriedly after hearing the news, "Oh dear, nurse, is our daughter doing okay? Is there any problem? She must not have any accidents, we can't be without our daughter, and the children can't be without their mother..."
The nurse explained, "Auntie, please don't worry, there are so many doctors here, there won't be any problems. What we're facing now are just minor complications. Using anesthesia is just a precaution, this is all normal."
Relieved by the nurse's explanation, Han Xuewei's parents sighed, "As long as she is fine, we hope for peace and safety..."
Accompanied by his parents, Lin Yi took the babies to the pediatric department, while Han Xuewei's parents patiently waited for their daughter to be brought out of the operating room.
About two hours passed before Han Xuewei was wheeled out, but she looked pale and weary, not in good condition.
Lin Yi had also returned to the entrance of the operating room by then and seeing his wife in such a state, his heart ached immensely.
"Vivi, are you feeling any better?"
"Doctor, how is my wife?"
Lin Yi was now quite agitated, fearful that something unexpected might happen to his wife.
"Mr. Lin, please be assured, the anesthesia hasn't completely worn off yet, there are still some side effects, so Miss Han Xuewei is breathing a bit heavily. In a little while, her body might start to tremble slightly. These common side effects won't have any impact on her health, so you need not worry too much. What is important is that she takes good care of herself in the next few days."
Following that, they were led by a nurse to complete the hospitalization procedures, and then Han Xuewei was taken to her hospital room.
However, at that time, Han Xuewei still had very heavy breathing and seemed extremely uncomfortable. Not long after, her body began to tremble incessantly, just as the nurse had mentioned earlier.
The two Maternity Matrons who had been arranged in advance quickly stepped forward to help and comforted everyone present by saying, "Everyone, don't worry. Mrs. Han's current condition is normal. Other expectant mothers have experienced similar symptoms before. Once the medicinal effects wear off, she'll recover quickly.
It's crucial to keep the expectant mother warm, absolutely do not let her catch a chill."
The Maternity Matron surnamed Ji, while comforting everyone, also thoughtfully pulled the blanket around Han Xuewei to ensure it covered her more snugly.
By then, Han Xuewei had regained some consciousness. While her body shook, she asked with difficulty, "What about the babies? How are they doing?"
No sooner had she finished speaking than she gasped for air heavily, as if that short sentence had exhausted all her strength.
Lin Yi hurriedly knelt beside his wife and soothingly said, "Wife, don't worry, our babies are safe now. The doctors have taken them for a check-up; they will be back soon. You need to focus on getting better quickly!"
Lin Yi was also anxious, but in order not to worry his wife, he could only reassure her that everything was fine with the babies.
Knowing that his wife had just come out of surgery, she could not withstand any setbacks now, so it was imperative to maintain a positive mood. Moreover, the results of the babies' examinations were still unknown, so Lin Yi chose to give only the good news while keeping any worries to himself.
Seeing Han Xuewei lying on the bed, Lin Yi's parents' faces were also filled with worry. After all, she was their daughter-in-law and had been a great help in the family. Seeing her in such discomfort, the elderly couple also felt a deep unease.
In this manner, while Lin Yi comforted his wife, he also reassured the four elders, "Dad, Mom, please don't worry! Since the doctor has said it's nothing serious, it will soon get better!"

chapters.title: Chapter 38: 38: The Babies' Video
chapters.content:
The two maternity matrons were also touched by the warmth of this big family, smiling as they watched the harmonious scene unfold.
After nearly two hours of waiting, Han Xuewei's condition finally improved slightly. Her breathing became smoother, and her face had regained some color.
Seeing their daughter pull through at last, her parents wiped away their tears beside her. Who wouldn't feel pain for their own child?
Now, everyone began to worry about the three babies. As long as the babies were safe and sound, it would truly be a happy ending for all!
Lin Yi could feel his emotions nearing collapse, but still, he forced himself to peel fruit for his wife, saying, "Don't worry too much! A check-up and she'll be back."
Han Xuewei nodded upon hearing this and said, "At that moment, I heard the babies crying very hard. They must be fine, but I just can't help worrying."
Lin Yi spoke softly, "The doctor has instructed that you can't eat anything before you pass gas. I've asked Aunt Wang to prepare porridge in advance, and it will be delivered soon. You don't need to think about anything other than recovering. Get some sleep first."
"Just now I saw all three babies, and they were looking at me too. Each one was so cute, but I was taken away by the nurse before I could get a good look. However, we took a photo together with the babies; do you want to see it?"
On hearing this, Han Xuewei immediately perked up, "There are photos of the babies? I want to see them! I want to see the babies!"
Lin Yi smiled, then picked up his wife's phone from the bedside and opened a group chat named "A Happy Family Together."
This group chat was created by Lin Yi's mother, a place for the family to chat and share photos. Everyone had also sent photos of the three babies to the group, including a video from soon after the cesarean delivery, where the babies were crying loudly.
Seeing the three adorable babies, each brimming with vitality, Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh through her tears. It was apparent that the children were doing well, certainly nothing to worry about.
Han Xuewei repeatedly opened the video of the babies crying loudly, watching it over and over as if the sound of their cries could bring her more peace.
After all, she was overly worried about the children.
Before they knew it, night had fallen. Since the hospital room was large enough, the entire family stayed there. The next morning, Aunt Wang brought over the nutrition-packed morning porridge for breakfast, not daring to prepare anything else.
After all, these were the doctor's orders; other than porridge, nothing else was allowed.
The family could see that Han Xuewei was very hungry, as porridge alone wasn't enough to maintain her nutrition.
When the doctors started their rounds in the morning, they checked on Han Xuewei's condition and, at the same time, gave everyone a shot in the arm.
"The results of the babies' checks are out, and they are all doing very well. They'll be brought over soon to stay in the same room as their mother."
Upon hearing this, everyone was immediately ecstatic!
Now, it was indeed joy for everyone! The babies were safe and sound!
The entire family's burden was finally lifted, and after finishing her porridge, Han Xuewei fell into a deep sleep once more, much more restful than the night before.
When she opened her eyes again, the three children had already been brought into the room and placed in their separate little beds.
The whole family gathered around, curiously observing these three little lives.
The babies had been bathed before being brought in, so they were sleeping very soundly!
Lin Yi's dad didn't talk much usually, his personality rather reserved, but when he saw the three adorable grandkids, he couldn't help smiling, looking from the left to the right, as if he couldn't get enough of them.
While looking, he also asked, "Say, wife, look at our sweet granddaughter, her eyes are so much like Lin Yi's when he was just born!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi's mom hurriedly made a shushing gesture, "Don't make noise, the kids are still sleeping! People say girls grow up to resemble their fathers, looks like it's true."
She then turned her gaze towards the two grandsons, smiling and saying, "The two dear grandsons really do resemble Vivi a bit, the more you look, the cuter they get, really too adorable. And have you noticed? Our three darling grandchildren have high foreheads, they are bound to be very smart when they grow up!"
Han Xuewei's mom also joined in with a smile, "I also think the more you look, the more they resemble, the two grandchildren and our Vivi seem as if they were cast from the same mold, my little darlings, they become even more precious the more you look at them!"
The gazes of the two moms were filled with affection, and they weren't willing to leave the three babies for even a minute.
The three little ones, while asleep, kept putting their hands in their mouths, constantly sucking.
Han Xuewei's mom, looking at this scene, couldn't help but ask, "Are they hungry? Do they need to be fed now?"
The Maternity Matron replied, "After bathing, the little ones will generally sleep, and this is when they sleep most comfortably. However, if they haven't been fed beforehand, they will wake up after a while. If they are hungry, they will start to cry loudly. Does Mrs. Han have breast milk?
You could feed the babies breast milk, but if it's only breast milk, it might not be enough for the three of them, and this is when you would need to use formula."
Han Xuewei had also woken up by now, and she felt very gratified looking at the three babies in the crib beside her.
Enduring the pain in her body, she gently tugged Lin Yi's arm, whispering, "Honey, I want to see our children."
Seeing the pained expression on his wife's face, Lin Yi hurriedly said, "Wife, don't move, you can't get out of bed right now, I'll bring the baby to you."
Getting out of bed and walking around carelessly might cause the surgical wound to reopen, Lin Yi naturally didn't want Han Xuewei to move at all.
"It's okay, the doctor also said I should try getting out of bed and walking around, a little pain doesn't matter."
"How can that be? What the doctor says isn't always accurate, I've read quite a few books on the subject, you should still wait until the third day after birth to get out of bed! You want to see our children, I'll bring them to you right now."
Since her husband said so, Han Xuewei of course didn't insist, after all, she had never experienced this pain before, and she somewhat couldn't adapt to it for a moment.
The doctor had touched her wound during the examination in the morning, which made her feel even more pain.
Lin Yi carefully picked up his sleeping daughter and slowly walked over to his wife's side.
Just then, a system notification echoed in his mind!
"Ding! Congratulations host! You have acquired a reward for your first close contact with your baby! Five hundred thousand!"
Han Xuewei gently kissed her daughter on the face, her expression becoming exceptionally tender and loving at that moment.
This was her own child!
Her own flesh and blood!
Han Xuemei smiled, she smiled so happily, yet gradually, she burst into tears of joy.
Lin Yi was startled by the scene, hastily asking, "What's wrong? Wife? Why are you crying? The three babies are all fine!"

chapters.title: Chapter 39: 39 Happy Tears
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei spoke plainly, "These are tears of happiness! I'm so touched, I have babies now! Three adorable babies! There are three of them!"
When Lin Yi saw the three new lives joining the big family, his heart was also deeply moved, but he didn't have the maternal emotions that Han Xuewei displayed. He just instinctively thought that these vibrant lives were magical.
But the next second, he distinctly felt a warm current in his hand, followed by a foul smell in the air?!
Lin Yi's hand froze in place.
That feeling...
Did it get on my hand?
Lin Yi looked down and saw his daughter's face had turned bright red, and then she began to cry with soft yelps.
Han Xuewei also saw this scene, and then she saw Lin Yi's bitter face, which made her laugh.
"Oh my! This smell is too foul, isn't it? Honey, did you smell that? How can it stink so much?!"
Having said that, Lin Yi brought his little daughter even closer to Han Xuewei, who quickly covered her nose and shouted, "Quick, change the baby's diaper!"
The parents from both sides, as well as the maternity matrons present, couldn't help but laugh at this scene.
Every time Han Xuewei laughed, her own wound would hurt along with it, and she said with a pained expression, "Aiyaya, I can't laugh anymore, the wound is so painful!"
After hearing this, Lin Yi also started to worry and stopped joking with his wife.
"Does it hurt a lot? Honey, I won't tease you anymore."
Han Xuewei waited until the pain in her wound slowly subsided before she slowly said, "Hurry up and wipe our daughter's butt! This is her punishment for you, who made me hurt so much?"
Since it was still March, the weather in the north was still a bit chilly, so the heating was generally not turned off.
The nearby maternity matron said patiently, "If the child pooped, it's best to deal with it as soon as possible, as bacteria can grow easily in a warm environment. You need to use warm water to clean it thoroughly, and cleaning a girl requires even more attention to detail than a boy."
Han Xuewei then understood what the nanny meant.
Her husband was a big man, definitely inexperienced, who would know how to help their daughter wipe her butt? So she quickly said to the maternity matron, "Please, Nanny Ji, help him with it."
Nanny Ji hurriedly took the child from Lin Yi's arms, while another maternity matron helped run hot water in the restroom.
Lin Yi said apologetically, "If my sons pooped, let me take care of it as their father! That would be my punishment. After all, we have two sons, so double the punishment! Hahaha..."
Lin Yi was very earnest in tucking in the blanket for his wife, but he hadn't finished being busy when farting sounds came from the other two cribs...
Could it be???
It's really such a coincidence??
Both sons pooped at the same time!!!
"Oh my God, did you guys plot this together? Giving your old dad such a hard time!"
Lin Yi looked helplessly at his two sons in front of him.
Meanwhile, Han Xuewei tried her best to suppress her laughter, but her silvery giggles could still be heard.
Lin Yi's mother was also laughing uncontrollably, saying, "Do you think it's easy to be a dad? Your dad and I had our fair share of wiping your butt and changing diapers back in the day! We've been through the same."
"From now on, you've got kids too, and no matter what you do, you'll have to work even harder because raising three children isn't that easy."
"Okay, Mom, don't you know me? I always work hard at everything I do... Okay, okay, I'm off to change the kids' diapers..."
As Lin Yi spoke, he approached the two cribs and rolled up his sleeves.
He hadn't expected fatherhood to feel like this.
Since he lacked experience, he was somewhat clumsy with changing diapers, and it was only under the joint guidance of the two moms that he managed to get the job done.
It wasn't as smooth as he had imagined; Lin Yi not only dirtied his hands but also the baby's blanket. With no other choice, he had to replace it.
With this experience, he figured he would be much more adept at changing diapers for his sons in the future.
Even though his two sons were twins, telling them apart wasn't too difficult.
Since the eldest son's weight was normal and the younger son's weight was on the light side, he could feel the difference as soon as he picked them up.
Looking at it this way, the eldest had hogged all the nutrition from his little brother and sister! In the future, he'd have to take on the responsibility of protecting his siblings!
Since Han Xuewei had undergone a cesarean section, she still needed a stitch removal surgery. The whole family stayed by her side, waiting for the surgery to be done before they all went home together.
So every day, Aunt Zhang prepared meals for everyone, and Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's dad took turns bringing the food from home to the hospital.
Actually, Lin Yi had also thought about staying with his wife at the confinement center for a while to recuperate, but then he realized that since they had hired a maternity matron, staying at home would be more spacious.
Moreover, the maternity matron they had hired was highly capable and had an excellent reputation, as well as being a kind person.
In addition to looking after the babies, she would also give Han Xuewei professional massages and work on every acupoint on her body every day.
During this time, Lin Yi had even found one of the best lactation consultants in the city online and could even arrange for her to come home to induce lactation.
Everything was taken care of, and he had thought of everything for Han Xuewei.
Lin Yi had often seen how some women ended up with health problems because they weren't taken care of properly during their confinement period. No matter what, such a thing could not happen to his wife!
A few days later, as Lin Yi entered the hospital room, he saw Han Xuewei breastfeeding their daughter.
Han Xuewei's face immediately turned red, and Lin Yi also felt somewhat at a loss.
Although the two of them were husband and wife, and had been close before, Lin Yi had had too much to drink that day, which didn't mean much.
It was the first time he had seen Han Xuewei so shy, and for a moment, he also felt embarrassed.
Both dads would take a walk downstairs every day at this time, straightforwardly avoiding the scene, whereas the two moms and the maternity matron were already used to it.
Lin Yi paused, then said softly, "Maybe... I'll take a walk downstairs for a bit..."
Nanny Ji, whose surname was Ji, couldn't help but laugh when she saw this and said, "Mr. Lin, you two are husband and wife, how can you still be shy!"
As soon as she finished speaking, the other few people also laughed.
What she said was indeed true – what was there to be shy about breastfeeding a child?
With that being said, Lin Yi was even more at a loss, unsure whether he should leave or not.
Han Xuewei offered a way out, "It's okay, just sit on the sofa and wait, I'll be done soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 40: 40 I Can Carry It
chapters.content:
Due to Han Xuewei's unfamiliarity with breastfeeding, she even seemed a bit stiff holding the baby.
Lin Yi just sat down honestly on the couch next to her, his mind somewhat elsewhere.
He hadn't expected that after so many days of trouble, he had suddenly become the father of three babies, and the feeling of growing up overnight was truly wonderful.
Since he had become a father, he must be more mature, and he had much more to shoulder!
Lin Yi, watching Han Xuewei breastfeed their daughter, felt a warm surge of affection in his heart.
He would be a family man from now on, with a wife who loved him dearly and three adorable babies—he was content with his life.
The only thing left to do was to take good care of his wife and children and to make sure he earned enough money to raise the kids properly!
Thinking of these things, Lin Yi couldn't help but let out a long sigh.
A person's life is nothing but a few major events: establishing a family and developing one's career.
Lin Yi already had a family, and what he needed to do next was to develop his career!
He was the father of two sons, and the pressure in the future would indeed be great.
Only through his own efforts could he provide a good life for his children, and he also hoped his children would be the wealthy second generation! Moreover, he wished for Han Xuewei to experience the feeling of being a young mistress.
A few days later, the family accompanied Han Xuewei as she was discharged from the hospital. Before leaving, Lin Yi wrapped his wife up tightly, not allowing a whisper of wind to pass through!
Otherwise, she could catch a cold, and if it got serious, it might leave lingering health issues—a common risk during the postpartum period!
Finally arriving at home, Lin Yi carried his wife princess-style from the garage straight to the bedroom, leaving the three babies in the care of the elders. Aunt Wang also hurried down to help carry things.
The housekeepers and maternity matron, who were new to the mansion, were shocked by the sight before them, a scale of wealth and triple-car garage that ordinary families couldn't afford.
They had worked in the villas of rich people before, but only in upscale neighborhoods with high prices for goods and property; they had never seen a mansion this large!
It seemed they were in for an eye-opening experience.
When Lin Yi finally brought Han Xuewei to their room, she smiled and said, "Husband, I can walk by myself, my wound has almost healed."
Lin Yi decisively replied, "How could I let you walk up the stairs by yourself? You've only had the stitches out for a few days. If the wound splits open, that would be bad."
With a face full of happiness, Han Xuewei burrowed into Lin Yi's embrace and said with a laugh, "I shouldn't be very heavy now, right? After giving birth to the babies, I weighed myself—I'm nearly 130 pounds."
"That's nothing at all. Even if you were as heavy as you were during pregnancy, I wouldn't mind! Silly girl, I don't care about your weight at all!" replied Lin Yi with deep affection.
"I remember now, the doctor instructed me not to forget to change the dressing every day. I might need… your help later…" Han Xuewei said, her face turning red, looking very shy.
Because changing the dressing involved a particularly sensitive area, Han Xuewei had to lift up a large part of her clothes, which inevitably made her feel embarrassed.
Though they were husband and wife, the two had not yet had an intimate relationship.
"Mm, how should I change it? Just teach me, and I'll be able to do it," Lin Yi said with ease, "Do you want me to change it for you now?"
"Not now, wait until tonight! The nurses have already changed it during the day, but later you'll need to go to the pharmacy to buy some gauze, cotton swabs, disinfectant, and remember to get the iodophor specified by the doctor, which doesn't sting when you use it."
"By the way, wife, how's the wound recovery? Does it hurt a lot?" Lin Yi asked with concern.
"If I don't move too much and just do some routine exercise and walking, it's fine. The wound should heal in a few more days, but it's been feeling itchy these days."
"Then I'll go to the pharmacy! I'll buy everything we need right now. You reminded me—we really don't have medical supplies at home. Leave it to me!"
"Mm, thanks, husband! Be careful when you go out." Lin Yi saved the list of items his wife said they needed to his phone's notes, told his parents, and then drove off.
After arriving at a nearby pharmacy, Lin Yi walked in and asked directly, "Do you have things like gauze and cotton swabs?"
A clerk stepped forward and replied, "Hello, sir, which type do you need?"
"It's like this, my wife just had a cesarean section a few days ago, and I need to buy some medical supplies for dressing her wound, like gauze and cotton swabs."
After hearing this, the clerk asked, "I understand, these gauze and cotton swabs are specially made for postpartum women who have had cesarean sections. How much do you need?"
Lin Yi was taken aback upon hearing this. He indeed didn't know how much he needed or how many days they'd be required.
Lin Yi hastily answered, "Just give me twenty or so of those, bring me three large packs of those special cotton swabs, and pack some extra iodophor as well, I'll pay by card."
Lin Yi took quite a lot of everything, and then, with a look of surprise on the clerk's face at the local pharmacy, he walked out with big bags in his hands.
"Ding! Congratulations, Host, for caring for your wife daily, you receive a system reward of two hundred thousand!"
Lin Yi was somewhat helpless at this moment, thinking perhaps there was some problem with the system?
All day he had been tired from carrying his wife around and got no reward, yet now, after just buying a few things, he was splurging money.
How did it just hand out rewards like that? It felt completely random.
Lin Yi was somewhat confused but still accepting, considering everything he did to earn rewards involved caring for his wife and child, and this he could most certainly accomplish.
When Han Xuewei saw her husband coming back with a big bag of medical supplies, she couldn't help but laugh.
"You might as well have moved the pharmacy home! The things you've bought will last us several months. My wound will heal in a few more days, and we won't need so many bottles of iodophor. Usually, just a little bit is enough."
"I was worried we'd run short, I thought we'd need to sit out the full month of confinement, so I bought enough for a month. But no worries, we can also use these supplies at home. With these specially made gauze, you can change them more frequently—it's better for the wound. Should we change it now?"
"Ah? No, no, no, not now, let's wait for tonight, we can change it tonight..." Han Xuewei stammered her refusal.
Even though her husband was extremely meticulous in his actions, he truly treated her well. Lin Yi was indeed a reliable and good husband!
It seems she can relax from now on.

chapters.title: Chapter 41: 41: The Unique Milky Fragrance
chapters.content:
As evening approached, everyone planned to give the babies a warm bath.
Lin Yi picked up his daughter from the cradle, his gaze fixed tightly on the tiny, fair-skinned child in his arms, his paternal love rising like a tide within him.
He really wanted to give this little one a big kiss!
But he couldn't do that now!
The baby's immunity was at its weakest now, and they carried many germs. Kissing the baby would transfer the germs onto her!
Lin Yi could only bury his head into his daughter's blanket instead.
The scent of milk swept over him in an instant!
That milky scent was indeed very comforting! It even made his head spin a little!
And this scent was somewhat similar to that of his wife!
At that thought, Lin Yi paused for a moment!
Perhaps it was because the baby had been breastfeeding?
These past few days, he had noticed that whenever he got close to his wife Han Xuewei, he could clearly smell that unique milky scent on her.
Both sets of grandparents were there to help bathe the babies now, and the maternity matrons were busy adjusting the water temperature!
He sniffed at the scent of all three babies and still felt that his daughter's fragrance was the richest and most pleasant.
As the saying goes, a daughter is a daddy's warm jacket, and he still loved his daughter.
Not like those two little guys who seemed to have conspired to give him trouble together. Whenever Lin Yi thought of his sons' behavior that day, he couldn't help but laugh and cry.
After the hot water was ready, and the clothes for the babies were taken out, everything was prepared, ready to give the three little ones a good wash!
But he never expected that bathing the little babies wouldn't be as easy as he imagined. When he started undressing his youngest son, he encountered a small problem; the baby began to cry loudly halfway through.
Hearing the crying, the eldest son also cooperatively joined in, and soon, their cries formed a duet in the room!
The two brothers seemed to be competing with each other, each cry louder than the last.
Lin Yi's mother quickly picked up the second son and started comforting him, rocking him in her arms and singing a lullaby, "Be good, obedient, don't be afraid when grandma is holding you. There, there."
Han Xuewei's parents also picked up the eldest son and comforted him with much tenderness.
Only Lin Yi's daughter was lying quietly in her father's arms, her little eyes moving around, observing everything with a look of intense curiosity.
Han Xuewei soon took notice of the babies' crying and said with a laugh, "Look at how the two sons are crying all of a sudden! They cry as soon as they're undressed, seems like they have quite the temperament."
Lin Yi smiled and said slowly, "This temper might not come from me, right? But as long as they are my babies, I don't mind any temper they have!"
Han Xuewei leaned in too, gently poking her daughter's chubby little cheeks with her finger, "Little treasure!"
Then, she turned her gaze to her sons, who had finally calmed down, and said with a smile, "Look how well-behaved your sister is, you two should learn from her."
Mr. Lin's mother said to Han Xuemei, "Vivi, you can't touch this water, it's warm water. It's not good for you to come in contact with it too much during your confinement period."
Han Xuemei smiled and replied from the side, "I know, Mom. I'm just taking a picture of the babies. I'll send the photo of the babies bathing to our group chat later, so everyone can see."
As soon as she finished speaking, Han Xuewei excitedly turned on her camera, trying out various angles to take pictures of the babies.
The three adorable little fellows were thus placed in the water, and Lin Yi also started to play nursery rhymes nearby, hoping to make the bath time pleasant for the babies.
The water temperature was just right! At least it was perfect for the babies, who started to slightly close their eyes as soon as they touched the water, clearly filled with sleepiness.
But at that moment, a prompt in Lin Yi's mind interrupted his thoughts.
"Ding, congratulations to the host, you've successfully bathed the babies and provided them with a sense of comfort, earning a reward of two hundred thousand!"
Lin Yi was no longer surprised by this, especially since the reward was entirely within his expectations.
After just a few short minutes, the three adorable babies were out of the water, as bathing infants doesn't require too much time, otherwise it could harm their skin.
One must know that the skin of infants is very delicate.
Han Xuewei was holding her phone, capturing every moment from start to finish - taking photos and recording videos of the babies, not wanting to miss any splendid moment.
As soon as the little babies were taken out of the water, their bodies were quickly dried, but they still made cooing sounds and didn't stop sucking on their fingers, seeming very comfortable.
Not long after putting on clothes, they fell asleep again.
Because they didn't know whether the babies would be boys or girls before birth, they prepared three sets of boy clothes and three sets of girl clothes, so there was no need to worry about not having enough clothes.
Han Xuewei sent the photos to the group, and then went back to her room to rest.
However, she hadn't been asleep for long when all three children started crying simultaneously. The sister's cry was clearly different from her two brothers', sounding like a little kitten, very pleasant to the ear.
Lin Yi was especially fond of his little daughter; once he picked her up, he couldn't bear to put her down again. Watching her big eyes twinkling, he found his heart unable to settle for a long time.
A daughter is truly a delight, not only smelling sweet but even her cries are so melodious. He believed that his daughter would grow up to be even cuter and more affectionate!
Just then, the Maternity Matron brought over two bottles filled with high-quality baby formula specially prepared for the babies.
"Mr. Lin, children can't eat as regularly as adults, they need to eat many times a day, and they must be hungry now, it's about time to feed them."
Lin Yi quickly agreed, "Okay, I'll go call Vivi to prepare."
Since all three children needed to be fed, just relying on breast milk was completely insufficient, so the little ones had to take turns, and the other two had to make do with formula.
However, the formula that Lin Yi picked for the babies was extremely expensive and considered premium; it was even imported, and its nutrition wasn't inferior to breast milk at all.
Filled with joy and excitement, Lin Yi picked up his daughter and headed towards Han Xuewei's room.
As he slowly pushed open the door, he froze on the spot, his eyes glued to the scene inside, swallowing his saliva uncontrollably!
He actually saw Han Xuewei pumping milk!
Lin Yi's eyes nearly popped out!
And Han Xuewei immediately noticed Lin Yi, who entered directly without knocking. Seeing her husband staring blankly at her, she stopped her hands!
Slow to realize, she quickly came to her senses, then she instantly turned halfway around!
Han Xuewei immediately said, "Ah... honey, you... you should remember to knock!"
Her cheeks were flushed with embarrassment.
"I... I'm really sorry! I got a bit too excited..."

chapters.title: Chapter 42: 42 Feeding the Baby
chapters.content:
Lin Yi quickly reacted and then retreated, making sure to close the door behind him.
In recent days, everyone in the family had to knock before entering Han Xuewei's room, for fear of inconveniencing her. Lin Yi, too excited, had forgotten to do so.
A moment later, Han Xuewei called out to the hallway, "Come in!"
Only then did Lin Yi carefully push the door open, his heart sighing with relief.
Han Xuewei's mood didn't seem to fluctuate much, and her flushed face gradually returned to normal, indicating she didn't blame him much.
Han Xuewei turned her head and said, "Just hand me the daughter."
Lin Yi nodded in response, his expression still slightly awkward.
He nodded vaguely, uttering an agreement.
Immediately after, he passed the daughter to his wife's embrace, the thick scent of milk assailing his nose; it was identical to the one emanating from his daughter, truly intoxicating!
Lin Yi tiptoed out of his wife's room and gently closed the door.
Yet the image he'd seen when he opened the door kept replaying in his mind.
Lin Yi shook his head quickly, dismissing all thoughts that had arisen at that moment, and returned to the room where his two sons were sleeping.
When Lin Yi returned, the two boys were already feeding, their eyes half-closed, looking utterly content.
"Come on, let me feed them." Lin Yi tried to take the older son from his mother's arms, but the younger son, seeming to pick up on the movement, stopped feeding, whimpering and flailing his tiny hands.
Seeing this, his mother laughed and said, "You can't favor one over the other, can you? Look, the younger one is unhappy. You have to hold this one too."
Lin Yi offered a wry smile and pretended to be upset, "You two little guys are trying to wear your dad out!"
But even as he said this, his actions betrayed him; he took both children in his arms, each in a different arm, while Han Xuewei and the Maternity Matron helped by holding the milk bottles at the ready.
Only after being held like this did the little ones feed properly again. They made satisfied "mmm" sounds, clearly relishing their meal!
The two mothers were smitten by the charming children, adoringly watching their babies.
As Lin Yi busied himself feeding, the system's notification chime sounded in his head!
"Ding, congratulations host, you have successfully fed the babies and have received a reward of two hundred thousand!"
Lin Yi's mother-in-law joked at that moment, "Lin Yi, if you get used to it, maybe the babies will only want to feed when you're holding them!"
Lin Yi replied, "Then I'll just keep on feeding! Maybe I'll become a full-time stay-at-home dad from now on. As long as my children aren't wronged, I'm up for anything."
His statement made everyone burst into laughter.
What is happiness? Being together is a form of happiness. It's an atmosphere not easily achieved, so this precious sense of joy is priceless.
Feeding his own babies, Lin Yi was filled with a sense of achievement.
And during this time, he hadn't even been to work, yet he received several system rewards each month, each for no less than two hundred thousand! Could there be anything better than this in the world?
He had just received a two hundred thousand reward for feeding the babies, and by that count, he would have to feed them four or five times a day!
That easily came to over a million—effortlessly!
Where else could he find a job more relaxing than this?
Of course, he didn't have to feed her the milk every day by himself as sometimes there were other things to take care of; however, if calculated as once a day, the income for a month was quite substantial!
So, after everyone had dinner together, Maternity Matron Auntie Ji specially prepared warm water in a wooden bucket in the washroom, and then went to Han Xuewei's room.
"Mrs. Lin, according to the schedule, you can wash your hair now. The water temperature is just right, and I've also added ginger slices to the bucket, which is effective."
Han Xuewei asked, "Then, can I use shampoo? It's been a long time since I've washed my hair."
Maternity Matron Auntie Ji said with a smile, "Of course you can."
"Then Auntie, you go rest, I can do it myself."
Han Xuewei stepped forward to bring the items into her room, indicating she would wash by herself.
After hearing this, Maternity Matron Auntie Ji hesitated a bit and said, "Mrs. Lin, are you sure you can do it alone? I'll be outside then, just call me if you need anything."
With her help, Han Xuewei set up the waterproof protector.
At that moment, Lin Yi walked in, saw what was happening, and naturally picked up the shampooing items, similarly telling Maternity Matron Auntie Ji, "Auntie, I'll help her!"
Han Xuewei was slightly startled when she saw this, her expression revealing a trace of surprise. She hadn't expected Lin Yi to offer to wash her hair.
Han Xuewei lay down naturally, and Auntie Ji patiently explained to Lin Yi.
"This is waterproof, you must drape it properly, otherwise the clothes will get wet, and you might catch a cold."
"Also, try to keep the time under ten minutes. Definitely don't wash too long or you'll catch a cold and it might even lead to a headache."
After giving all the instructions, Maternity Matron Auntie Ji returned to her own bedroom.
Only the husband and wife were left in the room.
Lin Yi took out Han Xuewei's hair clip and gently parted her thick, black hair with his hands.
He carefully wet the ends with water, then gradually poured it up along the hair.
Then, he squeezed some shampoo into the palm of his hand and began massaging her hair.
Even though it was very quiet, with neither of them speaking, a sweet sensation naturally arose, filling the entire room.
At that time, Han Xuewei slowly said, "Lin Yi, you're so good to me!"
Lin Yi was slightly taken aback upon hearing this and asked with a smile, "Haven't you always called me 'husband'? Why have you changed today? It sounds a bit unfamiliar."
Lin Yi deliberately asked with a chuckle.
"Alright, from now on, I'll always call you 'husband'!"
A radiant smile of happiness spread across Han Xuewei's face.
Deep down, she knew she had married the right person. Lin Yi was not only a good husband but also a competent father!
She felt like meeting Lin Yi was the luckiest thing that ever happened to her in her lifetime!
But at that moment, her expression suddenly turned very serious, and she said slowly, "Husband, you might not know, but I was terrified during childbirth. I thought I wouldn't make it off the operating table."
Lin Yi comforted her, "Silly girl, how could you think like that? All that's behind us now, don't worry needlessly."
"Yes, I know. But I was panicked and scared then. The doctor told me I was resistant to anesthetics. If that were true, the success rate for a cesarean might not have been high, and we would have had to resort to other methods."

chapters.title: Chapter 43: 43 Han Xuewei's Memories
chapters.content:
"The situation was very serious, and the anesthesiologist was out of options, so they could only slightly increase the dosage for me. I felt like I was having trouble breathing. But at that time, the doctors did everything to keep me awake. When I turned my head, I saw the heartbeat rate on the machine steadily getting lower, and I was truly afraid!"
"Worried that I might not make it out of the OR safely, that my baby might end up without a mother, or worse, never even having seen me... that's why I kept forcing myself to stay awake..."
Lin Yi could hardly bear to hear more and instantly hugged Han Xuewei's trembling body.
"Wife, you should have told me about this sooner! I had no idea things were so critical at that time!" Lin Yi couldn't help but feel a pain in his heart, and it was at that moment he also noticed several conspicuous bruises on Han Xuewei's chest.
The bruises tugged at his heartstrings even more, prompting him to reach out gently to touch them.
To his surprise, Han Xuewei slapped his hand away, feigning anger, "Don't take advantage of someone in a weak state! Focus on shampooing properly!"
Only then did Lin Yi realize, with an embarrassed face, he shampooed his wife's hair.
"Just feeling sorry for you! Seeing those bruises made me feel distressed."
Han Xuewei whispered, "I'm only telling you this, okay? I'm just sharing my innermost thoughts with you, and you mustn't tell anyone else. Mom and Dad would worry if they heard..."
Lin Yi comforted her earnestly, "Don't worry, I won't let you take any risks anymore! We're not going through this again. Having triplets at one go, we're already very content!"
Lin Yi made a silent vow to himself that he would always protect his wife in this life, so she would never have to endure any hardship!
He needed to be a competent father, a competent husband, ensuring the whole family stayed healthy and happy!
Lin Yi timed it perfectly and quickly finished washing his wife's hair, then dried it bit by bit with a towel as the Maternity Matron had instructed.
After everything was taken care of, the couple went to the nursery.
It was now almost ten o'clock at night, and the whole family had already gone to bed early. There were nannies and the Maternity Matron looking after the nursery.
The two of them crept over quietly and saw their sleeping babies were well-behaved. They seemed to have no habit of crying loudly at night and would sleep quietly after their feed.
Thankfully, they were mostly awake during the day, so they slept soundly at night.
Babies like these were indeed a relief for the parents!
Upon closer thought, aside from crying during feedings, the three of them didn't seem to cause much trouble for the adults at other times.
Today was the first time the babies were sleeping at home, and they slept very well, meaning no one else had to be disturbed.
When they were all accompanying each other in the hospital room, despite choosing a private room, the hospital environment was still somewhat noisy. Sometimes, not only the babies but also the adults found it hard to get a good night's sleep.
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei slowly approached the crib, watching their three lovely little ones, and for a moment, neither wanted to leave.
The little ones sometimes sucked on their fingers, sometimes stretched their arms or yawned, just too adorable for words!
At this moment, Han Xuewei also felt sleepy and gently tugged on Lin Yi's arm, whispering, "Husband, it's getting late, let's go back and rest! Besides, the babies still need to be fed tonight."
With his wife's call, Lin Yi reluctantly withdrew his adoring gaze, put his arm around his wife's waist, and they both returned to their room.
After Han Xuewei lay down, she yawned and said, "I've been so tired these past few days! I've been longing for the day when I could finally return to my own little bed. It feels so much better to be at home, the sleep is sweeter, and breastfeeding is much more convenient."
Lin Yi also sat down and spoke, "I was actually planning to take you to a postnatal care center to rest up properly, but now it seems unnecessary. With the nanny and the Maternity Matron here, it's indeed quite convenient at home."
"I never told you, but changing environments can make it hard for me to sleep. Apart from that day when I was knocked out from the overdose of anesthesia, I haven't been resting well at all, feeling listless every day!"
"Alright, then get some rest quickly!" Lin Yi also climbed into the covers and naturally wrapped his arms around Han Xuewei.
But at that moment, the latter suddenly said, "I can't sleep yet! Hubby, there's something very, very important we need to do!"
"Hmm? What's the matter that can't wait until tomorrow?" Lin Yi asked with some confusion, but as soon as he finished his question, he slapped his forehead, "Ah, if you hadn't mentioned it, I would have almost forgotten! I almost forgot to change the gauze! To apply the medicine!"
"Yes, I need to clean the wound before I can sleep!" Han Xuewei quickly said.
No sooner had she finished speaking than Lin Yi hurriedly got out of bed, grabbed a bag from the table in one swift motion, and after rummaging through it for quite a while, pulled out some gauze and specialized cotton swabs, and proceeded to open a bottle of iodine.
At that moment, Han Xuewei was ready, slowly removing the gauze and waiting for Lin Yi to clean her wound.
She was feeling very shy at this time.
Moreover, Han Xuewei thought her wound was really unsightly and was worried that Lin Yi would be frightened by the sight of it.
However, there was no ripple in Lin Yi's heart as he gently peeled off the tape from the gauze.
Since the tape had been on for so long, it had become very tight, and removing it had left Han Xuewei's delicate skin slightly red.
As the tape was slowly peeled off, Han Xuewei endured it silently, but she knew that applying iodine near the wound would hurt even more.
Seeing his wife's furrowed brows, Lin Yi hurriedly comforted her, "Does it hurt a lot? Then I'll go slower."
Han Xuewei quickly responded, "No! Please don't do that! Just tear it off quickly, the longer it takes, the more torturous it is. It's better to get it over with quickly!"
Lin Yi couldn't help but laugh, "Alright, alright, I'll listen to you. It's my first time doing this, just bear with it a little longer, it'll be over soon."
Han Xuewei was surprised by her own words, realizing that unconsciously, the relationship between them as husband and wife had become even more delicate.
Lin Yi gave her a look and said, "I'll count down, and at one, I'll tear it off right away!"
"One!" Lin Yi pulled it off abruptly while she wasn't paying attention.
"Ah..." Han Xuewei bit her teeth firmly.
Just when Lin Yi felt proud for sparing his wife some pain, his gaze quickly settled on that prominent scar!
Although it was stitched up nicely, one must admit, it was a cut! And it was several centimeters long!
Who wouldn't feel heartache looking at it?
And upon closer inspection, you could see that the wound was slightly reddish and swollen, as if the tiny blood vessels would burst at any second.

chapters.title: Chapter 44: 44 Lin Yi's Silence
chapters.content:
Lin Yi fell silent for a moment, his brows slightly furrowed as he asked, "Does it hurt?"
Han Xuewei was slightly startled, and hurriedly said, "Ah... It's actually not that painful, it just occasionally tugs when I walk, it's almost ten days now, and the wound is healing at the moment. Besides the itchiness, there's nothing else."
Lin Yi said, "It's good it's not that painful."
With that, he slowly twisted open the bottle cap of the iodine, soaked a cotton swab for a while, and then gently wiped Han Xuewei's wound.
Lin Yi knew in his heart, saying it didn't hurt was just a lie.
This cut was at least 15 centimeters long, it must have needed quite a few stitches when it was sewn!
Lin Yi wiped the wound very carefully, and from time to time he would blow on it gently.
Han Xuewei looked at her husband with deep affection, deeply moved by his actions. As she watched, she even occasionally laughed out loud.
These past few days, she had always told herself that she truly married the right person!
Not only had she found a good husband, but she also had such wonderful in-laws!
And not to mention how adorable the three babies were!
She even had this feeling that she was the happiest person in the world!
After cautiously finishing cleaning the wound, Lin Yi wrapped it with gauze.
"Wife, the gauze is changed," Lin Yi said with a serious face.
"Okay!" Han Xuewei instinctively responded, then quietly watched as Lin Yi helped her pull up her pants, adjusted her clothes properly, and then thoughtfully covered her with the blanket.
"Wife, do you feel a bit tired breastfeeding the babies during this time?"
Lin Yi lay down next to her and asked in a soft voice.
"Not particularly tired, sometimes I lack enough sleep, but actually, I really enjoy breastfeeding. I really like the process."
"Oh? Really?" Lin Yi became curious.
"Yes."
Lin Yi pondered for a moment, then finally said what he had been thinking for a long time, "Wife, what I'm thinking is, should we stop breastfeeding for a while? The babies can actually be fed formula because I see you getting up in the wee hours every day to feed them. I always feel you're working too hard, and I hope you can get some good sleep, at least rest well every day."
Han Xuewei quickly explained, "Husband, don't worry about me, I'm really not very tired. And even if we only had one baby, I would insist on breastfeeding. By now, I really love the little ones, so I want to let them have more breast milk, to be closer to me."
"It doesn't matter if I'm a bit tired. As long as the babies are well, no matter how hard or tiring, I will accept it."
Lin Yi nodded and said, "Breast milk indeed is irreplaceable! It truly is the best choice for the babies' development. Even though the babies' immunity is improved, watching you work so hard day and night to feed the three of them, not even getting enough sleep, makes me feel bad!"
Lin Yi paused, then continued, "I understand the principle, but I still don't want to see you suffer or get overly tired. Promise me, no matter what, your health is the most important. I must find a way to help you recover as soon as possible."
"And I still want to hold your hand and go back to campus with you! To attend the graduation ceremony!"
Han Xue smiled and said, "I'm very happy that you care for and look after me so much. But husband, perhaps you can't understand a mother's genuine love for her children. It's this profound love that strongly drives me to want to breastfeed. Even when I'm feeding them, I feel not that tired at all, any bad mood just dissipates."
"And didn't you say that we would only want these three babies? We won't have any more after this. If that's really the case, then I want to cherish the opportunity to breastfeed them."
Lin Yi leaned closer to his wife and then wrapped his arms around her, saying, "I'm all ears to you! As long as you're willing, I will definitely agree to your requests. The reason I don't want more babies is that I'm afraid it's too exhausting for you. But if you really love little babies and want to have another one in a few years, I will still support your choice, okay?"
Suddenly, the room was filled with an intimate atmosphere.
The couple embraced each other, discussing whether or not to have more babies in the future while under the covers, and it must be said that this scene certainly led to some fanciful thoughts.
With such a beauty with a stunning appearance lying next to anyone, who could resist?
Lin Yi couldn't help but take a deep breath, trying to control the desire he felt for his wife.
But just then, Han Xuewei took the initiative to move closer, gently kissing Lin Yi's lips!
Lin Yi instantly felt warmth in his heart, his entire body seemingly electrified, and in the quiet surroundings, I could hear his thunderous heartbeat.
"Wife, don't be naughty!"
His wife had just given birth not long ago, and she was in her postpartum period now; he couldn't do anything impulsive!
No matter what, it was absolutely not negotiable! This was an immovable line!
But if his wife kept teasing him like this, it would be hard for him, a grown man, to guarantee he could always keep under control!
What should he do?
Lin Yi kept reminding himself in his heart that he must not act recklessly!
"Okay, I'll stop teasing you!" said Han Xuemei, and she then hugged Lin Yi's arm tightly.
Lin Yi didn't dare to say a word, just looking at his wife, afraid that saying a few more words might really cause him to lose control!
He lay quietly, allowing his wife to hug his arm tightly; he could already feel his wife's soft body pressed closely against his.
My goodness!
Who could endure this?
Having a virtuous and upright beauty with a goddess-like face and a svelte figure lying next to oneself while sleeping! Nobody would be able to control themselves, right!
Okay, okay, I can't keep thinking about this!!
Lin Yi tried to calm his restless emotions and honestly held his wife as he drifted off to sleep.
In the middle of the night, Han Xuewei also woke up several times from her dreams, going to the bathroom as well as to store milk for the baby. Then she returned to the bedroom, exhausted, and fell into a deep sleep once she lay down.
Lin Yi was very affectionate towards his wife—the truth is, he sincerely didn't want Han Xuewei to be so tired every day, and the baby formula he bought for the child was top-notch, so there was no worry about nutritional issues.
However, Han Xuewei insisted on breastfeeding, perhaps to fulfill her maternal responsibilities completely! Moreover, it's been said in books that breastfeeding is good for both the mother and baby.
If a mother breastfeeds her child, it helps her figure return to its pre-pregnancy state in a short time and is also beneficial for the uterus.

chapters.title: Chapter 45: 45 A Complete View
chapters.content:
By the next morning, the three little ones had woken up the entire family bright and early with their cries, just as punctual as roosters.
The two maternity matrons were bustling about, swiftly wiping down the babies' bodies before getting busy with feeding them again.
Han Xuewei got up on time as well, as she had to breastfeed the babies first thing in the morning, or else she would suffer from engorgement.
Today it was her eldest son's turn to be breastfed, but before she could even finish halfway, the little guy unexpectedly pooped right into his diaper!
Han Xuewei, who was practically smoked out by the poop in the diaper, twisted her head away, covered her nose with one hand, and began shouting, "Husband! Come help, please! Our eldest son needs his diaper changed!"
Lin Yi rushed over at the sound, but found Han Yilin still in the act of breastfeeding; his eyes couldn't help but wander, taking in the expanse of her whiteness.
Lin Yi froze on the spot.
It was then that Han Xuewei suddenly remembered she should have lifted the baby away first.
The two of them locked eyes, falling into a mutual silence.
Han Xuewei immediately turned halfway around and also lifted her son away from her chest.
After she adjusted her clothes, Han Xuewei then handed her son over to Lin Yi.
However, it seemed the baby wasn't full yet, and the moment he was picked up, he started to cry a little.
Lin Yi quickly took his son into his arms and rushed to the nursery not far away, singing nursery rhymes and soothing the child while swiftly getting the diaper ready.
The brother and sister had already finished eating, but the eldest son still hadn't had enough! The longer the diaper change took, the louder he cried.
"Don't cry, don't cry. Listen to Daddy, once we've changed your diaper, we'll eat right away! As long as we clean you up and wipe you down, you can have your milk—just hang in there!"
While Lin Yi was uselessly comforting aloud, he was also busily changing the baby's diaper.
