The brother and sister had weighed just over four pounds when they were born, while the eldest had reached five pounds. After many days of everyone's careful attention, the brother and sister had gained a good amount of weight, and the eldest had grown bigger as well.
These days, it was noticeably more strenuous to pick them up! They must have put on maybe two more pounds already, right?
Lin Yi quickly finished changing the baby's diaper and then swiftly brought Da Bao back to Han Xuewei's arms.
"I didn't expect Da Bao to have such a temper, it's getting harder and harder to change his diaper, but as soon as you hold him, he seems to stop crying..." Lin Yi shook his head helplessly.
Han Xuewei hastily took the baby, gently rocking him in her arms, and consoled, "Sweetheart, be good, don't cry."
Da Bao was quite clever, as if sensing his mother's scent and realizing there was milk to be had, he soon stopped crying and began to coo and babble.
"You little rascal, so you were just picking on your dad when you had me all to yourself!" Lin Yi said, finding the situation both frustrating and amusing.
Laughing, Han Xuewei added from the side, "The baby didn't do it on purpose, honey. He just wants to eat. If you fed him with a bottle, he wouldn't cry either."
Seeing his wife turn halfway around and start to feed Da Bao, Lin Yi felt it wasn't right to stay any longer, so he turned and left.
At the lunch table, Lin Yi's father suddenly spoke up, asking the couple, "Speaking of which, the baby has been born for so many days now, have you both thought of a name yet?"
Lin Yi suddenly looked up, puzzled, and said, "We haven't thought of a name yet, but that shouldn't be urgent, should it?"
His father shook his head and said, "How can it not be urgent? When you get the birth certificate, you'll need to register the child's residence, and logically, all three babies should have had their names picked out on the day they were born. If not now, then when?"
After listening, Han Xuewei's father laughed and said, "Hahaha, my dear friend, don't blame him. After all, it's his first time being a dad; it's understandable that he doesn't get these things. Do you have any good names in mind?"
Lin Yi's father smiled and said, "I've been struggling, too. I'm torn between several names. Does anyone else have any good ideas? Let's talk and discuss them together."
Han Xuewei's parents also fell into deep thought.
At this moment, Lin Yi's mother said to everyone, "A name is for life, we can't be careless about it. For the three babies' names, let's all name them together!"
"Lin Dad and I will name the eldest brother, Vivi's parents can name the second brother, and the couple can name the little sister! After we agree on the names, we can share them with each other for reference. Does that sound good?"
Han Xuewei eagerly clapped and praised, "That's a good approach! It will make it much easier to name the babies, and it won't take too much effort to think. I wholeheartedly agree."
Han Xuewei's mother smiled and slowly said, "It indeed is a good idea. Let's all think together! Surely, we can find suitable names for the babies."
"How about this! We use the afternoon to think, and we can discuss it together at dinner. It will be like our big family's first family meeting!" Lin Yi's father quickly set an example.
"Vivi, my dear in-law, our Lin Family has never been strict with names, so don't hold back. As long as it sounds good and has a good meaning, we can all accept it," Lin Yi's mother added.
Han Xuewei's parents also smiled and responded, "That's even better; there's nothing for us to worry about then."
After enjoying lunch together, Han Xuewei and Lin Yi went back to their bedroom, planning to take a good afternoon nap.
Once back in the bedroom, Lin Yi picked up a dictionary and started flipping through it page by page, hoping to find the right characters for his daughter's name.
There's no denying he was a responsible and good dad!
Han Xuewei often couldn't resist the urge to nap after lunch, so she had formed the habit of taking an afternoon rest, but today she found herself with engorged breasts, so she sat at the head of the bed and used a breast pump.
Seeing how serious Lin Yi was, she didn't have the heart to disturb him.
Han Xuewei's health had been good lately, and perhaps she naturally had a good constitution, such that now her milk production was almost enough for two babies every day. So looking at it this way, it was possible that in a little while, the babies could be fed exclusively on breast milk.
This detail also implies that Han Xuewei's bust must be quite sizable, right?
Occasionally, when she was breastfeeding and Lin Yi walked in, he would end up staring and daydreaming, which made Han Xuewei feel embarrassed for a while.
After expressing the excess milk, she stored it in a bag and then casually placed it in the bedroom fridge.

chapters.title: Chapter 46: 46 Naming the Baby
chapters.content:
The small refrigerator placed in the bedroom had only one purpose, and that was to store breast milk. On Han Xuewei's vanity, there was another fridge of the same model, which was used exclusively for storing skincare products.
Han Xuewei also gradually noticed that the physical contact between her and her husband had been increasing recently. Perhaps in a few days, they would interact even more naturally with each other.
They might live like a normal couple then, feeling less and less embarrassed about things. At least for now, many things between them felt awkward, but with more contact, it would become natural.
Take what had just happened, for example. Lin Yi had noticed Han Xuewei's movements early on and knew what she was going to do, so he couldn't help but sneak peeks in her direction.
Despite Han Xuewei turning her body slightly away, Lin Yi couldn't stop his wandering thoughts.
After searching the dictionary for a long time, Lin Yi finally found a name that sounded suitable and hurriedly asked Han Xuewei what she thought of it.
"Wife, I've found two incredibly beautiful names, one is Jing and the other is Yishu. Which one is better?"
Han Xuewei pondered for a moment, then slowly said, "Both are quite nice."
At that moment, Lin Yi was overjoyed. Surely everyone would get excited when naming their own baby!
"This Yishu means gentle and restrained, delicate and subtle. These two characters also come from the Book of Songs, very wonderful. Jing stands for someone with temperament, intelligent, having lofty aspirations. But none of these words can represent what I hope for my daughter, which is for her to be happy and healthy every day as she grows up!"
Indeed, every parent hopes their child will grow up happy and cheerful. After all, health and happiness are what matter the most.
Han Xuewei shared the same thoughts. She wanted to be with her baby every day, watching her grow day by day. That was the happiest thing for every parent.
"Both meanings are good. It feels like either would be suitable."
Lin Yi started to struggle, muttering to himself, "Lin Yishu! Lin Jing? They both sound pretty good. Which one should I choose?"
After pondering for a long time, he finally turned his gaze back to Han Xuewei: "Wife, what do you think?"
Han Xuewei silently pronounced the names, and after a moment, stated confidently, "Lin Yishu sounds nicer. Let's go with this one!"
"Then I'll listen to my wife, Lin Yishu, Lin Yishu! Not bad, not bad at all! Indeed very catchy!"
Lin Yi repeated the name several times in a row, jubilantly saying, "Now we also need to pick a nickname! Let me think, let's call her Mengmeng! She's just too cute, and so sensible. Truly my girl, hahaha!"
But just at that moment, the system prompt echoed in Lin Yi's mind again!
"Ding! Congratulations to the host for choosing the baby's name yourself! You have received a system reward of two million!"
Good grief! To get such a reward just for naming a child? If he had known it was like this, he would have taken the names of all three children!
But upon reflection, this was already quite enough. After all, he couldn't be too greedy and needed to give the parents a chance to name their babies too! And with these two million, he was very content!
Thinking of this, Lin Yi felt an intense excitement in his heart, plunging into dreams of a wonderful future life. He even fantasized about his daughter putting a coat on him when it was cold, cooking for him decades from now.
At the thought of this scene, Lin Yi couldn't help but break into a goofy smile once again.
Han Xuewei felt very content at this moment. Lin Yi truly loved, deeply loved this family, and he valued her a lot. This was the epitome of a husband's commitment to family care.
Seeing her husband's goofy smile, Han Xuewei couldn't help but giggle softly as well.
As long as a couple is harmonious, then their family is successful, and it will develop better and better.
Moreover, they now have both a son and a daughter, which is the envy of many families!
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei chatted for a while, discussing some household matters. Seeing that his wife's eyelids were starting to droop, Lin Yi suggested she go to rest early.
After a nap, Han Xuewei had no choice but to feed the babies again.
Now, almost ten days had passed since the start of her confinement, and she only went downstairs for necessary activities such as eating, let alone going out.
This cloistered life seemed to involve nothing but eating and sleeping outside of meal times, and Han Xuewei distinctly felt she had little to do every day.
Even tasks like bathing the babies or taking turns changing diapers didn't require her intervention - Lin Yi eagerly took them on, with the additional help of the Maternity Matron.
Yet, even with staying at home every day and not doing anything, Han Xuewei's weight continued to drop. Perhaps this was one of the advantages of nursing!
It's said that breastfeeding can help a mother recover her figure quickly. Now, Han Xuewei's weight had already fallen below 120 pounds, and she didn't look overweight at all, almost back to her size during her school days.
In the past couple of days, Han Xuewei had removed the belly band, which had always been a bit uncomfortable. She planned to stay home for another half-month and then sign up for a yoga class, aiming to further improve her figure.
During her period of confinement, her good friend Qin Xiaoxu frequently came to visit. After all, she was the godmother to the three children. It was only right for her to come to see them, and she also gave each of the babies a generous red envelope!
Probably no one in the whole school knew about the triplets except for Qin Xiaoxu, right?
Lin Yi also hadn't told his dorm mates. He hoped that after Han Xuewei finished her confinement and it was confirmed she could travel, he would then invite everyone out for a big meal!
And that would be the perfect opportunity to tell everyone about their plans to hold a belated wedding ceremony.
Plus, he would be inviting his good brothers to be groomsmen! So, no matter what, it was important for everyone to come together and have a good gathering.
And whenever Lin Yi thought about holding the belated wedding with his wife, he would get carried away by his fantasies, envisioning all kinds of scenarios.
The more he thought about it, the more excited he became. Lin Yi was very clear in his heart that Han Xuewei yearned for an unforgettable wedding!
Because that's every girl's dream, isn't it? Which girl wouldn't hope for a grand wedding feast with her Prince Charming?
Lin Yi checked his account balance and then pinched his fingers, estimating the rough expenses.
It seemed that the wedding would require at least ten million!
Alright, let's not think too much about it for now, it's still early days for that!
As evening approached, the whole family neatly gathered around the dining table.

chapters.title: Chapter 47: 47: Nicknamed Mengmeng
chapters.content:
Lin Yi's father anxiously asked, "How has everyone been doing with thinking up names?"
Han Xuewei's father said, "We have come up with several names, but we'd like to see the ones you've come up with."
"Then let's discuss it while we eat."
Lin Yi's father didn't ask Lin Yi for his opinion at all, and Lin Yi even believed that his dad probably had a name ready for the third baby already!
Saying that they are all his own grandchildren, with his father's personality, it wouldn't be impossible for him to do such a thing!
Soon everyone sat down at the dining table, and Aunt Wang carefully brought several plates of fruit, taking care to prepare Han Xuewei's portion.
Lin Yi's father, brimming with excitement, took the lead and said, "I don't know what everyone else has been thinking?"
Lin Yi quickly answered, "We have already chosen a name!"
Tuition-Wei's father also said in a hurry, "I have also chosen a name for the child on my end."
Lin Yi's father said, "My wife and I have named our eldest son Lin Zhiyan. How does this name sound?"
After hearing this, everyone began to ponder.
"The reason we chose this name is that we hope that Da Bao will grow up to be erudite and a distinguished scholar. That's why we specially picked these two characters." Lin Yi's mother, true to her profession as a teacher, even chose names with such depth!
After hearing this, Lin Yi quickly raised his hand and said, "This name is indeed good, I am the first to support it! Wife, do you have any suggestions?"
Han Xuewei nodded and said, "This name is indeed good, I have no objections."
Having the name he chose unanimously approved by the family before Lin Yi's father had time to rejoice!
"Then let's go with this name! We have also thought of a nickname for the child, and we'll just call him Da Bao!"
Of course, the host had no objections.
At this time, Han Xuewei's mother also said to everyone, "If we're naming him that, then the second baby should be called Zhiyu, right? It implies a spirited and dignified bearing. How about it?"
"This name is great! It's a good name! I support it!" Han Xuewei's father quickly expressed his approval after hearing it!
It must be said that the two names did suit the brothers very well, and everyone showed satisfied smiles.
Lin Yi's mother asked the young couple, "How about this name? Lin Yi, Vivi, do you have any good suggestions?"
Han Xuewei shook her head and said very sensibly, "This name also sounds good."
Lin Yi slumped his shoulders a bit and said, "Of course, I have no objections, as long as it's a name you all chose, I'm definitely reassured!"
In fact, Lin Yi's father had always been worried about one thing, whether his in-laws would insist on one child taking the Han surname.
After all, they had only one daughter, Han Xuewei, and if the Han family had this wish, he would understand it.
However, to his surprise, the in-laws had never brought this up from the beginning to the end, which showed great magnanimity. This made them think highly of Han Xuewei's parents.
Seeing that everyone had agreed, Han Xuewei's mother said with a smile, "Then it's decided! The little brother's name will be Lin Zhiyu."
Clearly, everyone showed their agreement!
At this time, Lin Yi also hurriedly said, "We have come up with a very meaningful name for our daughter, Lin Yishu. What do you think of this name?"
"Lin Yishu? That really is a good name! It not only sounds pleasant but also has a deep meaning! Our little darling will surely grow up to be an elegant and sunny girl!" Lin Yi's mother exclaimed.
True to a teacher's knowledge, she understands these characters from the Book of Songs almost like the back of her hand!
After hearing the names, everyone also expressed their approval.
"These names! Not bad at all, I didn't expect you two to come up with such great names!"
Lin Yi quickly added, "We've even thought of a milk name—Mengmeng! Our little Mengmeng is the most adorable and cutest!"
Han Xuewei also covered her mouth and started laughing, "Okay, okay! Everyone knows now, that your daughter is the most adorable, all right?"
Everyone laughed heartily upon hearing this, and the children's names were thus happily decided.
Tomorrow, Lin Yi could go to the hospital to handle the birth certificate for the babies using these three names and then directly register their residence.
By the next morning, Lin Yi got up early, saved the names in the memo app on his phone, and took all the necessary documentation needed to handle the babies' paperwork.
Seeing that the babies would be a month old in just a few days and that it would soon be time to take the little ones for their vaccinations. Lin Yi could only imagine what his three little cuties would look like crying then.
When he arrived at the designated department in the hospital, he found the place was just as crowded as the times he'd attended prenatal checkups with his wife.
He had waited in the hallway for nearly half an hour before it was finally his turn.
The nurse glanced over his documents and then looked at him with a very surprised expression.
"So you're the father of the triplets? The whole hospital is talking about this! You're very fortunate!" The nurse said with envy.
"Ah? Is that so… haha." Lin Yi laughed.
"You may not believe this, but your triplets are the first in Xiangcheng in nearly fifty years! It's really rare! Especially naturally conceived triplets, which are very uncommon!"
"Have you already chosen the names for the babies?" The nurse asked with a smile.
"Yes, I planned to register them today and have all the required documents prepared," Lin Yi said.
"We'll have the birth certificates ready shortly. However, since you need three at once, it will take a little more time," the nurse explained.
Those waiting at the door overheard Lin Yi's conversation with the nurse and were all amazed!
"Wow, having triplets in one go? How impressive is that?"
"Twins are already rare, but someone actually had triplets! They must be so blessed!"
"Hey buddy, do you have dragon triplets or phoenix triplets?" a curious onlooker asked.
Lin Yi answered with a smile, "Two boys and a girl."
"So you do have dragon and phoenix twins! You're very lucky to have both a boy and a girl!" the person exclaimed in surprise!
"I too would love to have dragon and phoenix twins; the joy of having both a son and a daughter must feel great!"
Lin Yi just kept smiling and nodding his head.
"Buddy, taking care of three kids must be tough? It must be hard to manage!"
"And the cost of formula for three babies is no small amount! A can of formula must be finished in one day, right?"
Lin Yi scratched the back of his head and laughed, not knowing how to answer everyone's numerous questions. He just responded casually to one or two of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 48: 48: Do I Have Shares This Time?
chapters.content:
About ten minutes later, the nurse came out with the birth certificate and handed it to Lin Yi.
At that moment, a system notification sounded in his mind!
"Ding! Congratulations to the host for processing the birth certificates for three babies, you have earned ten percent of the shares in the mother and baby brand 'Fuwa Baby' as a system reward."
Lin Yi had already grown accustomed to receiving rewards easily after doing something for his wife and children, but this was the first time he had received a reward that wasn't cash!
Could it be shares in a company?
He quickly checked out the so-called Fuwa Baby brand to find out how much it was worth!
But as soon as he glanced at the numbers, he was completely flabbergasted!
Was it really that exaggerated? This turned out to be a mother and baby brand worth 20 billion dollars!
If he really got ten percent of the shares, that would mean he had instantly earned two billion dollars!
The kind you couldn't spend in a lifetime!
However, Lin Yi would definitely not sell his shares for cash lightly, as it was a once-in-a-lifetime investment opportunity. He was counting on these shares to reassure his family about his abilities!
Even though he wouldn't cash out the shares, just leaving them there would still mean receiving an annual dividend from the company! By that calculation, his income would become much more stable!
This was absolutely a huge cause for celebration!
He had truly made a fortune!
Instantly, Lin Yi was immersed in a sea of joy. After a moment, he packed up the babies' birth certificates and headed towards the underground parking garage.
He had to hurry and register the babies for household registration! No delays were tolerable.
Upon arriving at the registration hall and seeing the long queue there, he waited for a long time, and finally, it was his turn!
Just as the staff member stamped his family register, the system notification rang in his mind again!
"Ding, congratulations to the host, as you have processed the household registration for three babies, you will soon receive a 900-square-meter villa located at No. 3 Xinjing Garden! You will receive the property deed and keys via courier in the near future."
Upon hearing this notification, Lin Yi's pupils constricted, and he was plunged into deep surprise!
What kind of place was Xinjing Garden?
He had heard that many wealthy people lived there, real tycoons with fortunes over a hundred million! And there were quite a few celebrities too!
The residential area was quite special, with villas as well as high-end communities. He had heard that the annual property management fees amounted to millions! Lin Yi had never imagined having the chance to live in such a place!
The villa he currently lived in was located in the suburbs, and it took half an hour to drive into the city, but Xinjing Garden was different! The villas there were right in the center of the city!
Wow!
The estate must be worth over a billion by now, right? A 900-square-meter mansion—who could imagine that?
Just how many rooms are inside? Other than allowing him and Han Xue's parents to move in, each of the three children could have their own room. Even the nanny and the Maternity Matron could have separate rooms.
He could hardly imagine such a life!
But at that moment, Lin Yi suddenly paused and asked directly, "That, I wanted to ask, is my name on the property deed of that mansion?"
Lin Yi had actually wanted to give Han Xuewei a piece of property, and now there was a mansion up for grabs—wasn't that perfect? So now was the time to get Han Xuewei's name on the property deed.
"This mansion is jointly owned by both husband and wife, so there are two names on it."
"Is it possible to make a change?" Lin Yi asked straightforwardly.
"The host can directly make changes."
"Change the name to Han Xuewei, I want only her name on the property deed."
"Receiving new instructions, change in progress," the system didn't ask further but simply acted according to Lin Yi's instructions.
Only then did Lin Yi feel at ease.
After dealing with the matter at hand, it was nearly noon, and Lin Yi managed to find time to visit his parents' company. By the time he got home, everyone had finished lunch.
By then, Han Xuewei had also returned to the bedroom for a noon rest.
Aunt Wang had specially set aside a portion of the meal for Lin Yi on the table. Lin Yi's parents were also making time to go to the company these days.
They were currently planning to relocate the company! Lin Yi's mansion was in the eastern part of the city while their company was located in the west; commuting to work took nearly two hours each way! Back and forth, it was too much trouble—so they considered moving headquarters closer. That way, even if they were busy, they could still spend time with their grandchildren.
Moreover, the construction of the mansion area was excellent; their whole family could take walks here every day or play badminton. They could even bring the grandchildren to play here in the future!
However, Lin Yi's parents had been busy selecting a new site for the company these past few days because the rent nearby was still very high, so they had to make a careful decision.
Lin Yi wolfed down his lunch when his mother happened to walk out of her room and came silently to her son's side, starting to chat about this matter.
"Lin Yi, you now have a family, with a wife and children depending on you! But you haven't gone out to work—do you have any thoughts? Your father and I have discussed it and are considering handing over the family business to you. You've grown up, and we feel reassured."
After listening, Lin Yi smiled faintly and said, "Mom, you don't think I'm incapable of supporting my family, do you?"
Lin Yi's mother replied, "The expenses for three children are not small! Moreover, you can start from scratch with the family company, and we will all support you. The stock investments and such you talked about before surely won't last long. A man still has to engage in real business!"
"And I am not ignorant about these matters. You may have made some money, but there are risks involved. It would be better to start learning in the family company sooner rather than later, considering you have three children to support! This burden will eventually fall on you, and you'll need to shoulder it as soon as possible.
Your father and I are not old yet, but in a few years, we can only help with the kids—we won't be much help with anything else. Sooner or later, it will be up to you to carry the flag."
Listening to his mother's advice, Lin Yi nodded continuously; he understood the reasoning, but what young man doesn't want to carve out his own path?
And he really wanted to accompany his children as they grew up, not wanting to spend every morning buried in his parents' company dealing with various matters. After all, babies grow up better with their parents' company.
However, looking at it from another angle, taking over the family business in a hurry had its benefits: at the very least, he could let his old man relax, no longer needing to tire himself out every day. Aside from spending time with grandchildren, his father wouldn't need to worry about anything else!

chapters.title: Chapter 49: 49 Maternal and Infant Brand
chapters.content:
This has always been something Lin Yi struggled with, he wanted to spend more time with his baby as they grow, yet he didn't want his parents to work too hard every day.
But now he couldn't just ask his dad to put the company projects on hold, could he? He knew his father had built the company from the ground up, so it was his life's work!
The company might not be very big, but after all, it had experienced many difficulties and challenges, and had weathered many storms!
Although the company was facing some difficulties, Lin Yi still couldn't make certain decisions for his dad.
Lin Yi replied without hesitation, "Mom, I understand everything you're saying, and I take it all to heart. But before we go any further, there are some things I need to tell you, and then you can help me decide."
He paused, then said very earnestly, "Mom, I'm now a shareholder in a mother and baby brand, holding as much as ten percent of the shares! And as you know, the industry is doing quite well these days with an overall upward trend, so I'm not worried about not making money."
"Which mother and baby brand? Does Mother Lin know?" asked Lin Yi's mother curiously.
"Fubao Baby," Lin Yi blurted out.
"Ah?" His mother was startled upon hearing this, "Fubao Baby? How could I not know about it? Its market value is in the hundreds of billions!"
"Do you really hold ten percent of the shares???"
"As far as I know, Fubao Baby is a brand that has risen rapidly in recent years. The state has introduced policies to support the three-child policy, lifting some enterprises. It is one of them!"
"So, are you saying you started investing in this enterprise while you were still in college?"
At this point, besides being astonished, Lin Yi's mother remained astonished!
Ten percent of the shares! What did that entail?
At a conservative estimate, that's worth at least a billion, right??!
A billion! To put it mildly, that's more money than she and Father Lin could earn in their entire lifetime! Even if they sold all their family assets, it would only be a drop in the bucket!
After hearing his mother's words, Lin Yi suddenly felt panicked, not expecting his mother to be so knowledgeable!
His brain whirled rapidly, his speech mumbled and unclear.
"Ah? Well... I started a business with some friends at the beginning, there were just a few of us, but over the past few years, we've grown and become a team. The performance of recent years has been pretty good, with a large initial investment, later on, many people approached us for partnerships and franchises. We've made tens of millions just from franchise fees alone!"
"With so many franchises, business became easier; everyone needed to get their supplies directly from us, and then it just got bigger and better, with annual profits exceeding my expectations. Now, my personal dividends have already reached over a hundred million!"
In order not to let his mother realize that he had made up his entrepreneurship history, Lin Yi spoke vaguely, and business was like that after all, apart from relying on one's own hard work, so much depended on opportunities, and he believed his mother would understand him.
Besides, the ten percent of the shares he now held were solid and beyond any doubt. As for the process of his own entrepreneurship, that was not so important. Therefore, he said he hadn't been heavily involved in the whole process, and it was his good friends who had been supportive.
After listening to her son's explanation, Lin Yi's mother slapped her thigh and exclaimed, "I see! You should have told us about it earlier! At that time, our business was on the rise, and we still had some money, much better than now. Well, thinking about it, the future belongs to the young. The methods your dad and I used to start our business were bound to become obsolete.
It's for this reason that your dad has been wanting you to take over, considering this as well."
Lin Yi nodded and said earnestly, "I understand, Mom. But you don't have to worry about me being jobless now; my income is very stable, and I have enough energy to raise the baby. If you or Dad's company faces any issues, you can come to me anytime. If there's a need for money, I can provide it, drawing out tens of millions at a time is not a problem."
"Oh, and I bought a villa for Vivi. Just bought it today."
Lin Yi's mother's face showed surprise once again, "Ah? You bought another villa? But this one is really good! It's enough for the whole family to live in, why another purchase?"
It seems Lin Yi's mother hadn't had a heart-to-heart in a long time and was completely unaware of how capable her son had become, now a billionaire with even two villas to his name!
Lin Yi nodded and said slowly, "Although we already have a villa, I thought it would be nice for our whole family to live together in the future, where the kids could have their own bedrooms, right?"
"Moreover, the new villa is much larger than this one, almost 900 square meters!"
Lin Yi's mother's eyes widened once again as she asked, "Ah? Over 900 square meters? That's huge! Son, when did you become so rich? Tell me, where have you chosen this villa?"
Lin Yi smiled and said mysteriously, "You might not believe it if I tell you; I chose the New Vista Gardens, number three!"
Mother Lin was suddenly at a loss for words!
New Vista Gardens???
That's a residential area teeming with wealthy people! To own a villa there, especially one that's 900 square meters, would likely cost over a hundred million!
"You sneaky kid! If it weren't for our chat today, you would still be keeping this from me! You've actually made so much!"
Mother Lin covered her mouth in disbelief, her eyes full of unspeakable emotions!
"Oh, Mom, there's still so much you don't know! My investments are not few, this is just a part of them, but I can't reveal everything for now."
"Ah? You've made other investments too?" Mother Lin was now overwhelmed with excitement!
Now that Lin Yi had explained his work and financial status to his family, and with more rewards from the system to come, he decided to hold back some information for later.
Besides, after counting his savings, he figured he had at least tens of millions, which certainly bolstered his confidence.
"So now, I just want you and Dad to understand my situation, bottom line—I'm not short on money. And if you both need anything, I can transfer funds anytime to help Dad's company through this crisis. You've never been clear about the issues the company has been facing lately, so I thought you and Dad had solutions and didn't step in to help.
But I've come to realize recently that the situation is different from what I assumed."

chapters.title: Chapter 50: 50 Find a Reason
chapters.content:
Lin Yi could only lie and evade the question, saying he wasn't clear about his family previously being in dire need of money, otherwise, his mother would think he was unwilling to help!
After a long time, Mother Lin managed to calm down and then spoke very seriously, "You don't need to worry about this side, your father and I will definitely find a way. In fact, what we are most concerned about is you. As long as all the money you make is legitimate, your father and I won't pry too much. Those of us in business must always remember that dirty money is not to be touched!"
Her worries were not without reason; many wealthy families' greatest concern was education. A lot of kids, once they have money, start doing whatever they want, and may even on a whim cross the legal line, which is not acceptable.
Moreover, their own child was now worth nearly a billion, so they had to constantly remind him to be proactive in preventing problems!
"Okay, I understand what you mean, but rest assured, I've only made some investments without telling you and Dad, and they're all legitimate, with no breaches of discipline or law. I think a big part of today's success is down to luck!"
Lin Yi was not exaggerating with his words; all his earnings were indeed the result of luck. With billions of people in the world, why was he the one chosen by the system? Without the system's help, there would be no today for him. Otherwise, he would have had to rely on his parents to support his three babies.
Even with exhausting work every day, he'd be lucky to rake in ten thousand a month—a tight fit to feed a family of five!
The other option would be to follow in his father's footsteps and take over his father's company. But business had been tough for his father in the past two years, and the monthly take-home pay hadn't been much better.
If that really had been the case, he would have to think about providing for his family the moment he opened his eyes every day! It was anything but easy!
After much thought, Lin Yi finally realized how vital the system was. Everything he had today was given by the system! How could he alone bear the burden of supporting a family?
Mother Lin found the conversation with her son satisfying and knew her child had his dreams and ambitions, so she and her husband no longer insisted on involving Lin Yi in their business.
"You run a maternity and baby brand, so you should use that brand's baby products for our family's Da Bao! As a major shareholder, you can purchase through internal channels, right? That definitely would save a lot, considering the daily expenses for the baby aren't small!"
"Do you know how expensive the baby formula the babies are eating now is? The brand seems to be called Zhenyingbao, an imported brand. The three babies go through it so fast! Sometimes, a can of formula is finished in just one day, and less than a month later, two boxes are already gone!
These days are just about time for us to buy more formula, so I wanted to ask if your maternity and baby brand does any distribution?"
"Besides the formula, there are diapers too. Each baby uses about four or five pieces a day, and we'll soon need to switch the small size for the little brother and sister to medium, and switch Da Bao's to large size. You wouldn't believe how this big chubby guy has gained a pound in just a few days, his little belly bulging out!"
The moment Mother Lin started talking about the three lovely babies, her face would almost bloom into a smile.
After lunch, Lin Yi washed the dishes himself. He had been busy since morning and was now quite tired, not to mention he had woken up many times last night to feed the babies, so he hadn't had a good rest all night.
But when he heard that the baby's formula was running low and they needed to change diaper sizes, he decisively got in the car and drove out again.
Lin Yi vaguely remembered seeing a brand called Fuwa Baby in the maternity section when he went to the supermarket to buy couple items with Han Xuewei. They had shopped around there.
Han Xuewei had picked out plenty of maternity and baby items at that time, and he had even signed up for a VIP membership card.
This store's VIP consumption was a bit unique, with each customer's spending contributing towards accumulating points that could elevate their VIP level. The higher the level, the bigger the discount when shopping.
Undoubtedly, this kind of discount model was innovative and could entice customers who liked the brand to receive more significant discounts, increasing the business's revenue markedly.
But since he now owned shares in this brand, the size of the discount didn't matter much anymore, since he was certainly not short on money!
He rummaged through his wallet for a while and finally found the business card handed to him by the store manager the day he bought maternity and baby items, never thinking it would come in handy one day.
Making a special trip seemed inconvenient; he didn't feel like going out now, so he could ask the manager to send a salesperson over. If all went well, he should receive the goods in about an hour.
Lin Yi took out his phone, entered the number from the business card, and pressed the call button directly.
It happened to be the store manager who answered, and Lin Yi recognized the familiar, somewhat sweet voice, "Hello, welcome to Fuwa Baby chain stores. How may I assist you?"
Lin Yi got straight to the point, "I've shopped at your store before and kept your business card; I need to repurchase some items but really can't make it out. Do you offer home delivery services?"
It was almost noon, right after lunchtime, so the mall wasn't very busy, and they could provide home delivery.
The female associate replied very respectfully, "May I have your surname, sir? We can provide home delivery service. Please let us know what products you need."
"No need for formalities, my surname is Lin. Does your store carry Fuwa Baby brand formula? And I need some diapers too, do you have medium and large sizes in stock?"
"Hello Mr. Lin, we have all of these items. How much would you like?" The associate asked while preparing to jot down the details.
"Let's start with five boxes of formula. I need five packs of medium-size diapers and five packs of large-size diapers!"
As Lin Yi spoke, he calculated inwardly. The children hadn't yet reached a month old; the three babies could consume half a can of formula a day. When the little ones grow a bit more, not even a whole can might be enough for a day's supply!
It wouldn't hurt to buy more formula all at once—at least 30 cans with five boxes. It had to be said, this stash of formula should last a month. People say you have to earn the money for kids' formula, don't they? Because formula is so expensive, costing hundreds per can, and just the monthly expense for formula alone is quite a substantial sum.

chapters.title: Chapter 51: 51 Online Procurement
chapters.content:
The figure was indeed a bit hefty for some ordinary families, and some could only afford to buy regular formula for their babies, which wasn't as expensive but still cost at least a hundred. Any cheaper, and they really wouldn't dare to feed it to their children!
Some mothers who were in their postpartum confinement still hoped to breastfeed their babies, using formula only as a supplement, which also helped to save a bit on expenses!
Diapers, although not as costly as formula, got used up very fast. Each pack had about 50 pieces, and with two little ones like brother and sister, each would use at least five or six a day, so a pack wouldn't even last a week.
As the babies grew past their first month, they would continue to grow, and by that time, they would need larger diapers!
So just to be safe, he didn't buy too many medium-sized ones.
Since becoming a father of three, Lin Yi hadn't worried much about family expenses, but he paid close attention to other details, like how much milk the babies drank each day, and how many diapers they used; he kept a mental note of it all!
The shop assistant was secretly thrilled after hearing his words!
It seemed today was her lucky day, as she'd landed a big order!
"Alright, Mr. Lin, we will get your items ready for delivery right away. May I ask where to send these goods?"
"Fragrant Osmanthus Garden, number six."
????
That place was a villa district!
The female shop assistant instantly keyed into the crux of the matter; her pen flew as she jotted down the address, silently thinking to herself, "This turns out to be a big client! I must offer the best service no matter what!"
The shop assistant on the phone said, "Mr. Lin, please wait at home for a moment. I will have the items you need ready right away and delivered within an hour. May I know how to enter the residential area? Do I need a gate card? Without a gate card, won't I be unable to deliver the goods to your home?"
Lin Yi also immediately thought of this issue; security was indeed very good in his villa district. He pondered for a moment, then said on the phone, "Well, in that case, I will inform the guards at the entrance about the situation. After you arrive, just report my house number, 3A6, and they will let you in."
The shop assistant quickly agreed. After they finished the call, Lin Yi promptly explained to the security guard about his online purchase and then headed straight to the second floor of his home.
In the past few days, Lin Yi found that if he was away from his wife and children for just a few hours, he couldn't contain his anxious feelings.
He rushed excitedly to the second floor, and as he climbed the stairs, he heard the piercing cry of a baby!
He was familiar with this voice; it was his eldest's!
He walked towards his and his wife's bedroom, the crying growing louder and louder. Slowly pushing open the bedroom door, he saw his wife holding Da Bao, seemingly ready to feed him.
Han Xuemei smiled and asked, "Back at last, did everything go smoothly today?"
Lin Yi moved closer, watching the baby flail its arms and cry loudly with its mouth wide open, and replied, "Everything went very smoothly; the babies' household registrations are all sorted. After you finish feeding, I have a very, very important thing to tell you."
Han Xuewei nodded, saying, "Then wait a few more minutes, please. The eldest is too impatient; if we don't feed him quick, he'll cry even louder!"
Han Xuewei skillfully started feeding the baby, while Lin Yi stepped outside, closing the door behind him as he left.
He immediately headed for the baby room, intending to check on his two other little darlings!
"Babies, Daddy's back! Did you miss Daddy at home?"
Upon hearing the sound, his daughter Mengmeng reacted; she seemed to quickly recognize Lin Yi's voice. Her little mouth, with a pacifier in it, moved, and her small hands began to wave about, making a soft humming noise for the first time today.
Zhiyu, the second child, also turned his head in a very coordinated manner, as if he were looking toward Lin Yi.
It must be said that this scene made Maternity Matron Ji and the nanny laugh involuntarily.
"These two little ones are really clever! Hahaha, they are just like little elves."
Watching his two adorable babies, Lin Yi felt a surge of joy and immediately picked up both of them, one in each arm.
After picking up the children, he could clearly feel they had gained a good bit of weight. He remembered that when they were first brought home from the hospital, neither of them weighed even five pounds, but in less than a month, both babies had surpassed six or seven pounds!
Moreover, these days, they had started trying to support their bottles with their small hands while feeding!
The matrons were right; they indeed were little elves.
After the babies finished feeding, Lin Yi stayed by their side, coaxing them to sleep. Only when they were sound asleep did he tiptoe out of the baby room.
In recent days, the babies had begun to establish their own circadian rhythms. After feeding, they took a short nap, and once they gradually woke up, what awaited them was a comfortable bath and then some playtime.
This routine was excellent for the babies. They slept soundly during the day and, upon waking, spent their energy by bathing and playing, meaning they didn't fuss at night and sometimes could even sleep through till dawn. This was also great for the adults, who at least didn't need to get up in the middle of the night.
Newborns were growing more quickly than Lin Yi had expected, and he soon became concerned about their nutrition.
He seemed to recall from a book that infants also needed to intake trace elements and that it was also appropriate to supplement with calcium as needed.
In any case, they were due for a full-month health checkup in a few days, and he could take that opportunity to consult with the doctor to inquire about the most efficient way to supplement the babies' bodies. Of course, all this had to be based on a thorough health check of the babies first, and the supplementation would be tailored according to their physical condition.
He walked gently out of the baby room and headed for the bedroom. Once inside, he found his wife had soothed the baby to sleep in her arms.
With a hush sign, Han Xuewei stood up and went to the baby room, placing the child back in the crib.
Lin Yi followed her from start to finish. After she came out of the baby room, she asked Lin Yi, "Honey, what did you want to tell me? Is it important?"
Lin Yi chuckled, then went around behind Han Xuewei and pushed her back into the bedroom, saying as he did, "Of course it's very important! Come on, let's go to the bedroom."
"Because this is a gift for you, I want to tell you very formally."
She laughed upon hearing this and then asked, "It feels very mysterious, having to go to the bedroom to tell me."
Lin Yi said, "Because it's a piece of very good news! I'm worried you'll be so happy when you find out that you might make noise and disturb the babies."

chapters.title: Chapter 52: 52: The Big Surprise for You
chapters.content:
Lin Yi feigned mystery at that moment, slowly getting close to Han Xuewei's ear and whispered, "I've prepared a big surprise for you, a villa. The property deed only has your name on it."
Han Xuewei's reaction was completely within Lin Yi's expectation. When she learned that her husband wanted to give her a villa, and even the property deed only had her name, Han Xuewei froze, too surprised to say anything for a long time!
"Ah? You... you're giving me a villa? It's for me?" She stared at Lin Yi, her wide eyes filled with disbelief.
"Yes, it's for you, and our whole family will move there in the future. Just don't mind it, okay! Hahaha." Lin Yi finished speaking and burst into laughter.
"Why does the whole family have to move there? Isn't it nice where we live now?" Her watery big eyes were full of confusion.
"Well... that's because the villa is much bigger than our current place! The kids will each have their own room, and we'll have much more living space, about 900 square meters, I guess." Lin Yi said with a serious face.
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei became even more shocked!
900 square meters? That big? It's almost five times larger than the villa we live in now!
"Hu, hubby, where have you buried the villa?" Han Xuewei tried to calm herself down and continued to ask.
At this point, Lin Yi got even closer to his wife, pushing her back to the edge of the bed.
"The location is quite good, right in the city center, Xingjing Garden, Building No. 3. You will soon receive the property deed and the front door keys. Once I get them, I'll hand them over to you. I'm not joking with you, nor would I ever lie to you."
"No... I know you wouldn't lie to me, and I wouldn't doubt what you say to me..."
Han Xuewei had no way out as Lin Yi steadily closed in, and she eventually sat down at the edge of the bed.
Lin Yi seized the opportunity to get on the bed too, pinning his wife beneath him, observing her very attractive face flushed with surprise and joy, feeling an indescribable love in his heart.
Although he pinned his wife down, he still propped up his body, not daring to touch her.
At this time, the shock on Han Xuewei's face had not dissipated, and her cheeks became flushed.
Lin Yi lowered his head slightly, whispering in her ear, "You have to accept it no matter what, because this is my love. My love is like this, never hanging on my lips, expressing my feelings through real actions. I don't make empty promises. So, are you satisfied with your husband?"
Han Xuewei's face was nearly red to her ears, and Lin Yi's incredibly magnetic voice, slightly husky, made her somewhat intoxicated, her body trembling slightly.
Could this be what they call being audio controlled?
When Han Xuewei first took an interest in Lin Yi, part of it was because of his unique and magnetic voice. Sometimes she found listening to him talk was also a pleasure.
She slightly closed her eyes, then gently said in Lin Yi's ear, "Mm, I'm satisfied, super satisfied! I love you to death!"
As soon as she finished speaking, her arms naturally wrapped around Lin Yi's shoulders, causing him to be slightly taken aback at that moment.
He had only intended to playfully tease his wife, but he didn't expect this silly girl to take it seriously. Oh no, what should he do now?
Lin Yi instantly became worried, as he could clearly feel that he... was reacting!!
"Vivi..."
The air suddenly became incredibly charged, Lin Yi's heart pounded wildly, and he quickly grabbed Han Xuewei's hands, softly calling her name.
Han Xuewei also responded in a soft voice, her voice becoming somewhat hoarse...
Suddenly, Lin Yi grasped Han Xuewei's neck with one hand, without any hesitation, and kissed her fiercely!
Han Xuewei responded in kind, and the married couple passionately kissed, just as Lin Yi's hand slowly reached out towards Han Xuewei!
A knock on the door interrupted their next move!
In an instant, they sprang apart!
The next second, Lin Yi's mother slowly opened the door. Seeing the two of them with strange expressions and standing awkwardly, she quickly understood and hurriedly said, "Oh dear, I've disturbed you, I'm so sorry!"
As she spoke, Lin Yi's mother quickly closed the door. She had initially come to bring her daughter-in-law some sliced fruit, but she did not expect to open the door to see them both blushing. Lin Yi's mother didn't know what to do!
But no matter what, she had to intervene!
After all, Han Xuewei was in her postpartum care period!
Even if the young couple were burning with passion and couldn't wait, they should not engage in that kind of activity!
Health is the key! Han Xuewei's well-being had to be prioritized and taken care of!
No, she had to take charge of this matter no matter what!
With this thought, Lin Yi's mother hurried downstairs and sent a message to her son, asking him to come down for a moment.
After Lin Yi's mother left, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei sat on the bed in a daze, still not having recovered from the shock they'd just experienced!
The knock on the door was just too sudden!
No, they had to lock the door!
The same thought occurred in both of their minds.
Lin Yi looked down at his phone and said with an awkward tone, "Wife... My, my mother said she wants me to..."
"Mhm," Lin Yi hadn't finished speaking when Han Xuewei quickly responded.
At this moment, Han Xuewei already knew why Lin Yi's mother was looking for him.
"Then I'll go downstairs to talk to her, I'll be right back, don't overthink..." After soothing Han Xuewei for a while, Lin Yi hurried downstairs.
As soon as he stepped out, reaching the staircase, he saw his mother standing there, muttering something under her breath.
Lin Yi hurried forward and asked, "What's wrong, Mom?"
Lin Yi's mother quickly pulled her son aside and asked in a whisper, "What were you two doing just now? If I hadn't come in when I did, you would have caused a big problem. It's not that I want to scold you, but Vivi is still in her postpartum period! No matter how anxious you are, it's not okay! Health is the most important thing! She's your wife."
"And with a cesarean, the body is really hurt, and you need to take good care of her during this period. If something untoward were to happen, the damage would be permanent!"
"No matter what, you have to wait another two months! Even after those two months, you can't skimp on the necessary precautions! Remember, she cannot get pregnant within the two years following a cesarean!"

chapters.title: Chapter 53: 53: Do Not Act Rashly
chapters.content:
"The Vivi family had a cesarean birth for three babies! So, it's even more important to focus on postpartum uterine recovery. If by any chance she gets pregnant again, the consequences would be unimaginable! We might be forced to terminate the pregnancy, which is very harmful to her health!"
"They are really young after all, so thoughtful too!"
Mother Lin educated her son, believing deep down that her daughter-in-law was exceptionally beautiful and captivating, making it understandable for her son to struggle with self-control.
Her intervention aimed to make her son aware of the risks and ensure he wouldn't act recklessly in such matters.
Mother Lin truly adored her daughter-in-law, not only for her beauty but also her sensibility, gentle nature, and inherent grace; she felt like a lady from a stately family.
Where else could they find such a splendid daughter-in-law? She was indeed a blessing for the Lin Family!
Based on the genes of this young couple, she believed their babies would grow up to be handsome boys and beautiful girls!
However, Lin Yi suddenly exclaimed in protest, "Enough! Mom! Stop it! You're worrying over nothing! Although what you just saw... might have been a bit intimate, I would never do such a thing while Vivi is in her confinement!"
"I wouldn't commit an act only a beast would do. You can rest assured, I know my limits. I've endured through the ten months of pregnancy, so can't I manage a few more months?"
"Mom, you can put your mind completely at ease! Don't you know what kind of person your son is? I would never do something to hurt Vivi and will stay away from anything that could!"
Mother Lin, observing her son's serious demeanor, finally chose to trust him, but still made him give a verbal promise before letting the matter go.
After all, being experienced herself, Mother Lin knew her son well enough to trust that he wouldn't likely do anything to harm Vivi.
At that moment, Lin Yi's phone suddenly rang; the incoming call was from the infant supplies store clerk.
"Mr. Lin, good afternoon. I have arrived at the entrance of your building with all the items you requested," she said.
On hearing this, Lin Yi rushed towards the front door: "Understood, wait a moment, I'll be right there."
The moment he reached the door, he saw the female clerk looking around at their villa with a surprised gaze.
Even if such a villa wasn't situated in the city center, it wasn't something an average person could afford! It was clear without saying that this person must be a wealthy boss!
Seeing Lin Yi emerge, the clerk hurried forward to greet him: "Mr. Lin, here are the formula and diapers you requested."
Lin Yi noticed a taxi parked beside them with the trunk lid wide open, filled with baby supplies. The female clerk, having spoken, went back to moving items around, and the taxi driver simply sat silently in the car watching, showing no intention to help.
Lin Yi stepped up to lend a hand, placing all the items at the doorstep, and then asked, "How much do I owe for these items? I'll transfer the money to you."
The clerk produced an invoice and addressed Lin Yi: "The formula is priced at 3,000 yuan per case, and you've purchased five cases, making it 15,000 yuan. The medium and large diapers are 97 yuan and 117 yuan each, and you bought five packs of each size, totaling 1,070 yuan.
So, your total for the infant supplies comes to 16,070 yuan, but we can offer you a discount of 8.8%, reducing the final price to 14,141 yuan."
Lin Yi looked over the invoice briefly and asked indifferently, "How shall I pay?"
The clerk pulled out a payment QR code and said politely, "You can just scan the code to make the payment, and I'll upload your points to the system once I'm back."
After scanning the code, Lin Yi immediately entered 14,500 yuan and transferred it without hesitation.
"Ah? Mr. Lin, it seems you've sent the wrong amount. Only 14,141 yuan is needed."
"You have worked hard; use the extra money for your taxi fare back and forth! You have worked hard," Lin Yi said to the clerk with a smile.
Upon hearing this, the clerk immediately became excited and hurriedly thanked him, "That's really so kind of you! I wish you a joyful life!"
The female clerk's excitement was naturally beyond words. She had made a decent commission from this order, easily close to a thousand, and the taxi fare here was less than 50. However, she had not expected Lin Yi to be so courteous, which touched her.
"This man is really too kind. If such a person doesn't become wealthy, it would truly be an injustice in this world!"
After the female clerk left by taxi, Lin Yi went up and down the stairs several times, moving these items into the storage room.
While moving the milk powder, he found that its weight was beyond his expectations, certainly not light! He even found it somewhat challenging to move!
After spending quite a bit of time finishing this task, he returned to the bedroom.
He gently pushed open the bedroom door and saw Han Xuewei already taking a nap. He tiptoed over to her side and kissed her forehead.
In fact, Han Xuewei wasn't fully asleep at that moment; she was pretending!
The instant Lin Yi kissed her, Han Xuewei's heart started to throb wildly.
The relationship between this married couple was like that of young lovers in the throes of romance. When kissed, Han Xuewei couldn't help but clench her hands together, even preparing for the next step.
Lin Yi's gaze became a bit intense as he began to scrutinize the beauty in front of him, clad in a dressing gown and looking very attractive.
At that moment, Han Xuewei involuntarily blushed,
Though she didn't open her eyes, she could sense that Lin Yi was there beside her, not leaving her side.
All of a sudden, Han Xuewei opened her eyes, her cheeks flushed as she said, "Why keep staring at me?"
"I knew you were pretending to sleep! I didn't believe you could have fallen asleep so quickly. Haha." Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei lying down and said cheerfully.
"So you were purposely teasing me?" Han Xuewei smiled as well.
"What's wrong with teasing my own wife? Besides," he said, planting another kiss on Han Xuewei's forehead.
"Hubby, I really appreciate you!" Han Xuewei's eyes suddenly filled with deep affection as she spoke sincerely to Lin Yi.
The latter placed his hand on Han Xuewei's slightly messy hair, smiled, and said earnestly, "My little treasure, what's there to be formal about with me? Your husband has many more gifts for you! And I'll definitely make you very, very happy!"

chapters.title: Chapter 54: 54 Another Wave of Rewards
chapters.content:
But just at that moment, Lin Yi's mind suddenly recalled the system notification!
It was that familiar voice again!
"Ding! Congratulations, host! You've received a reward for your daily care of your wife, two million has been credited to your account!"
Lin Yi was also startled after hearing this!
It seemed that the old ancestor's advice was all correct! The saying that 'a wife brings wealth, never mistreat her, otherwise wealth will not enter your home' is true!
As a man, being good enough to one's own wife, hence rewards keep coming one after another!
He even vividly remembered that the system appeared when he had made up his mind to be with Han Xuewei and had decided to have the baby.
This inference wasn't wrong at all!
Han Xuewei snuggled into Lin Yi's embrace, just softly murmuring an agreement, then she pulled Lin Yi over, and the two of them slept together.
Han Xuewei at this moment was also deeply touched, they as a couple had never officially dated, directly stepping into the palace of marriage and giving birth to three adorable babies.
Looking just at this affection, Han Xuewei was very proactive. Indeed, she did suffer from insecurity, but with the half-year foundation of their relationship, Han Xuewei felt the sensation of being in love at every moment.
She believed she had chosen the right person, living each day in bliss. This must be a dependable good husband, right?
Lin Yi was also startled by Han Xuewei suddenly pulling on him like this and quickly said, "Vivi, not now."
Lin Yi immediately turned his gaze to Han Xuewei, his expression becoming somewhat odd.
The latter just smiled faintly, teasing on purpose, "Of course I know that, just want you to lie beside me, get some good rest. You also didn't sleep well last night. And you got up so early today, you've been busy until now, you must be tired, right?"
"Also, what did mom talk to you about when she asked you to step out?" Han Xuewei couldn't help but become curious.
"What could it be, she just said... cough cough, just let me not rush things, to wait for another month or two, wait for you to regain your strength," Lin Yi said, scratching his head embarrassedly.
At his words, Han Xuewei's face turned red once again.
It was indeed awkward just now, who would have thought to be interrupted by her mother-in-law during an intimate moment with her husband.
Could there be anything more embarrassing than this?
Seeing that Han Xuewei's complexion was off, Lin Yi knew she also felt uneasy talking about this matter, so he smiled and stroked her head, saying, "It's okay, mom was just giving a kind reminder, there's no other implication, after all, she's also very concerned about your recovery."
"And she was right, I just now indeed almost... lost control of myself," Lin Yi expressed with relief.
Fortunately, mom came in just then, otherwise, he really might have lost control, and the consequences would be truly frightful!
The most important was the irreversible damage it could have caused to his own wife!
Ah, it was all because his wife was just too beautiful, her slightly plump figure during the nursing period was precisely his ideal type! Who wouldn't be tempted by that?
Han Xuemei blushed and buried her face in Lin Yi's chest, saying shyly, "Husband, it's all my fault, I won't dare to tease you like that again."
After hearing that, Lin Yi was surprised and thought, how could this be?
They were a couple, after all; isn't it normal to have a bit of fun like that? Not flirting with each other, how could that be right? He didn't like that at all! No, he had to make sure his wife kept up this good habit, no matter what! It was rare for her to be so enlightened!
Not only should he flirt with her in the future, but he should flirt more, and even better, focus all the flirting on just him!
Which man doesn't like it when his wife takes the initiative? Such a life would be so much more interesting!
It would be even better if they could play role-playing games and explore all kinds of different stockings... life would definitely be more fun!
Lin Yi's mind began to wander with endless thoughts.
After all, he had learned quite a bit from some enlightening movies, so he had a lot of fantasies about things he was interested in!
So Lin Yi suddenly sat up and exclaimed, "Don't do that! Honey, I really like it when you flirt with me!"
After hearing this, Han Xuewei laughed and said, "Who would have thought? Seems like guys really do like it when girls take the lead!"
When Han Xuewei and Lin Yi were together, she had been worried about their lack of emotional foundation, so she had looked up many tips on love online, and discovered that the top-rated advice was: the more proactive the woman, the more hooked the man!
However, this principle came with a premise, which was that the girl had to be pretty enough!
With Han Xuewei's looks, surely every man who saw her would be smitten, right?
Yet she had always been quite conservative, and if Lin Yi didn't take the initiative, she'd be hesitant to show her other side.
Looking back now, she realized how much courage she mustered up that night they spent together—it was almost crazy!
Lin Yi looked at his wife, who lay in his arms still giggling, and hugged her even tighter, "Why are you taking pleasure in my misery? Are you really not afraid... not afraid that I'll lose control and make a mistake?"
To his surprise, Han Xuewei kept on laughing and said, "I'm not afraid of you. If you get too carried away, I'll just call Mom over!"
Lin Yi was left without a comeback, and after a while of cooing and cuddling together, they fell asleep.
Even in sleep, they held each other very tightly, and it was actually their first time sleeping this way!
After all, Vivi had been pregnant until not long ago, sporting a large belly every day, and it was tough for her to sleep well, not to mention that hugging wasn't very convenient, and their relationship hadn't been this intimate before.
But after spending days together, they had grown much closer, and being in the throes of love, their actions towards each other had become much more intimate, with not a hint of awkwardness.
Han Xuewei clearly sensed this very delicate relationship with Lin Yi, and she was quite happy about it.
Seeing Lin Yi deeply asleep by her side, Han Xuewei planned to snuggle up in her husband's arms for a solid night's rest; she really loved sleeping embraced like that.
But just at that moment, cries suddenly came from the baby's room!
The baby had unexpectedly woken up!
Since the baby was awake, Han Xuewei had no choice but to get up from bed!
There was no helping it; once you become a mother, this is just how life goes. Han Xuewei sighed deeply, fully aware that raising a baby meant tough times followed by sweet ones, and she was willing to endure it.
To avoid waking Lin Yi, she gently got out of bed, quietly left the room, and after closing the bedroom door behind her, she quickly went to breastfeed the baby in the nursery.
At night, Aunt Wang generally helped take care of the baby, because maternity matrons were busy during the day handling many things, so when evening came, Aunt Wang would take over to let them rest.

chapters.title: Chapter 55: 55 Considerate Daughter-in-Law
chapters.content:
Upon hearing the baby's cries, both mothers hurried out.
Han Xuewei's mother, seeing her daughter rush over, asked, "I thought you were asleep, did you wake up so soon?"
"Yes, I came over as soon as I heard the child crying," Han Xuewei replied.
Han Xuewei's mother-in-law handed Er Bao to her, saying, "Today is it Zhiyu's turn to breastfeed, isn't it?"
Han Xuewei took the baby and said to Er Bao with a smile, "Yes, it's our Er Bao's turn today."
This little guy was very well-behaved, and even more sensible. As soon as Han Xuewei held him in her arms, he would immediately quiet down, which was completely different from Da Bao, who previously was just like an adorable little cat in grandma's arms.
Han Xuewei looked over at the other two cribs and noticed the other two babies were still sound asleep. She then pulled over a small stool and sat beside the crib, openly breastfeeding the baby.
Mother Lin asked anxiously after seeing this, "Is Lin Yi sleeping in the bedroom?"
Han Xuewei typically wouldn't breastfeed in front of others; she would usually take the baby into the bedroom, which is why everyone was surprised by her nursing like this.
But she just smiled lightly and continued, "Lin Yi has been busy for a long time today, he was especially tired, and fell asleep as soon as he lay down."
Han Xuewei's mother also added, "Yes, I saw him leave early in the morning, he came back at noon famished and devoured his food."
Mother Lin also said with a smile, "Vivi is really considerate!"
Seeing her daughter-in-law be so caring and attentive to Lin Yi, Mother Lin was quite moved in her heart. Needless to say, she couldn't be more pleased with her daughter-in-law!
Although she had not interacted with Han Xuewei very much overall, Mother Lin, who had climbed the ranks as a merchant over many years, was certainly not wrong in her judgment.
From their first meeting, she had noticed a unique quality in Han Xuewei, and found her to be very adept in dealing with people.
Moreover, after meeting Han Xuewei's parents, she found them to be quite elegant and polite, understanding and reasonable, so it made sense that they raised such a well-mannered daughter!
So Mother Lin's satisfaction with her daughter-in-law was heartfelt.
Blushing slightly upon hearing her mother-in-law's compliments, Han Xuewei shyly responded, "It's all part of my duty, after all, he is my husband, and I will certainly take good care of him in the future."
Mother Lin and Han Xuewei's mother exchanged a look and both smiled, the whole family basking in a happy atmosphere.
After spending these days with Lin Yi and his family, Han Xuewei's mother had gained a general understanding of them.
She too had noticed that her in-laws were very adept in social etiquette, as expected of seasoned merchants who had weathered many storms. They were all very kind to Vivi and also very courteous to her and her husband.
The Han family had only one precious daughter, of course, they hoped she had married the right person!
Now that her daughter had happily married a son-in-law whom she was very satisfied with, she was naturally much reassured. And her husband, Old Han, had more than once mentioned to her how sensible their son-in-law was, could she be anything but pleased?
If falling in love involves two people, then marriage involves two families. In today's society, it's rare to find someone capable like Lin Yi, who also cares deeply for his family.
Watching the young couple so affectionate every day, the parents from both sides are quite happy.
And so, time passed day by day, and nearly half a month later, Han Xuewei finally concluded her confinement.
Lin Yi, having read books on the subject, was determined to let his wife rest for a full two months of confinement, especially since she had given birth to triplets, which greatly impacted her health.
In a short while, the maternity matron they had hired would leave, and when that time came, the responsibility of caring for the three babies would fall on the three families.
On the day the babies turned one month old, Lin Yi, remembering the instructions of the medical staff, needed to take the three babies to get vaccinated.
To prepare for this day, Lin Yi bought a very high-end stroller especially for the babies, making traveling much more convenient. Each family could take care of one baby, making it manageable for everyone.
However, Lin Yi had been busy with family affairs these past few days and had completely forgotten to arrange a car for the nanny.
Without a doubt, he had to quickly provide the nanny with a car, preferably a spacious one, so they could go out with one less vehicle in the future.
After Lin Yi's parents explained, the whole family came to know about the achievements Lin Yi had made throughout his years of entrepreneurship. With this in mind, everyone had a better understanding of his current wealth and were not surprised anymore.
Han Xuewei's parents were, of course, very happy upon learning the truth and couldn't be more fond of their son-in-law.
Lin Yi originally wanted Han Xuewei to take a good rest at home today and not join them, but his wife insisted on going along.
"That won't do," she said. "Today is the first time the babies are getting vaccinated, and as their mother, I can't miss this important moment. I can't miss any important moments!
Plus, I've been in confinement for a month, and the wound has mostly healed. Going out for a while is like getting some fresh air—I'm about to suffocate staying at home all the time! It's better to go with you and watch the babies get vaccinated."
"My dear husband, I know you're the best. I just want to go..."
As she spoke, Han Xuewei even began to act coquettishly, and Lin Yi was helpless against it.
He had no resistance to a woman's coquetry, especially when his wife was looking at him with big, longing eyes.
Lin Yi, feeling quite helpless, conceded, "You can go, but you must dress warmly, especially your head must not be exposed to the wind, or confinement illnesses can be really uncomfortable."
After much pestering by Han Xuewei, Lin Yi had no choice but to take her along.
Today's outing was, after all, the babies' first glimpse of the world outside and also the largest family outing since the beginning of confinement.
Lin Yi drove his Range Rover, with Mother Lin holding the eldest, Han Xuewei's mother holding the second child, and Vivi holding the youngest daughter in the back row.
Lin Yi's father drove his own car, taking Han Xuewei's father and Aunt Wang, and off the whole family went to get the babies vaccinated.
Before departing, they checked all the things they needed to bring and got up especially early for today. Lin Yi had also learned online about the precautions for vaccinating babies in advance.

chapters.title: Chapter 56: 56 Vaccination
chapters.content:
Avoid going for vaccinations on Saturdays and Sundays as it is particularly crowded then, since many parents work during the week and only have time to take their babies for vaccinations on the weekend.
Moreover, vaccinations need to be scheduled in advance. Lin Yi had booked the babies' vaccinations early. Although he had to take all three babies at once, it saved time having them done together.
The whole family drove there and in no time, arrived at the service center. After getting there, they discovered that quite a few cars had already parked. It seemed that there were many babies getting vaccinated today!
They finally found two parking spots and were able to settle in. The three dads hurried down from the car, propping up the strollers. The triplets had already been fed milk at home and changed into fresh diapers, now they were sleeping soundly.
They carefully placed the babies into the strollers and made their way towards the community service spot.
Lin Yi filled out the necessary information, having memorized the kids' ID numbers by heart. After finishing, a nearby nurse told everyone, "You can go to the third floor for the vaccination shots."
With that said, the nurse looked at the group with a slightly strange expression.
"Okay, thank you," Lin Yi responded without saying much, and directly lead everyone to the elevator.
Lin Yi noticed the nurse's peculiar gaze, but had nothing to say about it, as he knew exactly what the nurse was thinking at that moment.
Soon they reached the third floor, and upon the elevator doors opening, they saw the vaccination processing area; the hall was already crowded with hardly any vacant seats.
Many parents were still holding their babies, standing in the corners of the hall—and even standing by the elevator entrance, you could hear the cries of children being vaccinated in the rooms across.
The cries were heart-wrenchingly loud!
Seeing this scene, Lin Yi knew they had left home a bit late today; it was almost eleven o'clock now, which was nearing peak vaccination time.
According to other people's suggestions online, it was best to arrive before ten o'clock; otherwise, you'd end up waiting a long time.
Lin Yi quickly took three numbers from the ticket dispenser and estimated that fifteen or so other babies needed their vaccinations before it would be their turn.
Besides, after the babies were vaccinated, they had to stay there for half an hour as the medical staff would observe their conditions during that time, which meant there were still a lot of people lingering in the hall.
As soon as Lin Yi and the others stepped out of the elevator, many eyes in the hall turned towards them—all because they were carrying three babies! It seemed they had triplets!
Therefore, wherever they went, many eyes followed.
The onlookers began to talk amongst themselves.
"Looks like the whole family's come along!"
"It seems so bizarre; did they have triplets all at once, or did the old couple have a second child? I've been staring for a while and still can't figure it out."
"I reckon it's probably a second child. The two-child policy was put forward and has been fully implemented, but judging by their age, the couple must be in their late forties, right? Would they still choose to have a second child? That's really bold! I truly admire them!"
"Right. I also heard that person call her 'mom.' It's definitely the whole family. But didn't you think it's unnecessary to be so crazy for the second-child policy? Wouldn't that make her an older mother?"
"Indeed, it's unusual. I can also understand that young man's feelings—just as he's starting his own family, his parents have another child. Anyone would be overwhelmed, right?! It would be maddening!"
The volume of these discussions wasn't loud, but Lin Yi had good hearing and wasn't far away, so he clearly heard their conversation!
Really, what does someone else having a second child have to do with you? Besides, if you're going to discuss others' affairs, shouldn't you at least know the truth beforehand?
Why talk nonsense about things you know nothing about?
After hearing this, Lin Yi's father couldn't help but glare at those people, but Mother Lin tugged at him, consoling him, "Don't listen to them. There are all sorts of people who will say anything these days. Don't stoop to their level! Really, what does it matter to them if others choose to have a second child? It's not like they're eating their food!"
Han Xuewei's parents, being very cultured individuals, didn't bother arguing with these people. Compared to this chatter, the two sets of grandparents were still reveling in the joy of having grandsons and granddaughters.
While waiting, Lin Yi started to chat with everyone, turning the conversation towards buying a new car.
"Here's what I'm thinking. I want to buy another car, preferably one with more space, considering our large family. Whether it's for family outings or other matters, it's inconvenient to drive too many cars. It's better to just pick one big car right away. A camper van is quite affordable, and so are dedicated nanny-vans."
Lin Yi's father was surprised to hear this, "I know about camper vans, but nanny-vans are new to me. Some cars, despite appearing to have a lot of space, are not at all economical—it's important to be cautious with such purchases! It's best to prioritize cost-effectiveness. After all, we won't use it a lot, so the depreciation rate must be considered..."
Upon hearing this, Mother Lin joined the discussion, "I recommend buying a camper van! I've seen many people find it convenient to drive. However, the only downside is that the vehicle is somewhat large. But it must be very comfortable."
