"And even the smallest camper van has a bed inside, which is a major convenience. During travel, the kids can rest directly on the bed, and if we put some toys there, it will be more fun than sitting in a car seat. That's why I think camper vans are more comfortable."
Han Xuewei's mother also smiled and added, "I agree with you, mother-in-law. We also considered getting a camper van before, but it seemed like a waste for just the three of us. Now that our family has grown, it's very convenient for cooking or heating milk for the children on the go, and parking isn't a worry either."
"Right, one person can drive while others play with the children. Tired drivers can take turns, which is ideal for road trips," added Han Xuewei's father, showing his agreement.
After thinking for a while, Lin Yi's father realized that there was indeed some truth to this. After careful consideration, he finally said slowly, "That seems reasonable, but compared to nanny-vans, camper vans are much more expensive!"
"Expensive has its advantages, and you don't need to worry about it—we'll let our son handle it," Mother Lin said with a smile to her son, "No problem, right son?"
Lin Yi gave a helpless shrug and looked at his dad, "Did you all come to a consensus so quickly? I was thinking that a nanny-van would be more convenient for traveling. Take the Alfa, for example; the model is quite nice."

chapters.title: Chapter 57: 57 Buy a motorhome?
chapters.content:
"I think the Alfa is not as convenient as the Land Rover Range Rover you drive. In two or three years, when the baby gets naughty, they definitely won't be willing to just sit quietly in the car! If that's the case, it might be better to buy a motorhome; the kids can play inside, and it's very safe. Don't you think so?" Lin Yi's mother started encouraging her son again.
She now clearly understood that when it came to selecting a car, her son no longer needed to worry about the price. As long as it was genuinely convenient, the cost was irrelevant.
After hearing the suggestions from the elders, Lin Yi finally nodded and said, "You're right, since everyone thinks a motorhome is good, I'll stand on your side! Let's go car hunting together after some time, and try to get the car within this month. It will be much more convenient for travel in the future."
Lin Yi's parents nodded in agreement, "Yes, a motorhome is indeed convenient. Today, it took forever to find two parking spots."
"In this era, almost everyone has a car, and our big family traveling in one vehicle will be much faster," Han Xuewei's father added, nodding.
"After getting vaccinated, let's find some time to go to the dealership, and we must choose carefully. The space arrangement in different motorhomes varies," Lin Yi said earnestly.
"If you're buying the car, then you guys go. I don't really understand these things, and I can just stay home to watch the kids," Lin Yi's mother suddenly said.
Today, one of the maternity matrons had left, so Lin Yi's mother needed to invest more effort in taking care of the children. Moreover, Han Xuewei's mother hadn't retired yet and was about to return to work in a few days, so Lin Yi's mother had to focus all her attention on the family.
She had recently handed over all her duties to Lin Yi's father, and visiting the company once a week was enough. She spent the rest of her time at home with the children.
Han Xuewei's mother also said hurriedly, "I don't need to go, do I? I really don't know much about cars, after all. You guys choose, and I'll just stay home, no need for me to go."
Men have a great interest in cars, and every man has a dream of owning a luxury car! A car is a man's pride, and if you have a beauty by your side and can drive a luxury car, you're really a winner in life!
Seeing that his mom and mother-in-law weren't too keen on going, Lin Yi had no choice but to have his dad and father-in-law go with him.
"Tomorrow's Saturday, and we're free anyway, let's go together. How about it, in-laws? Do you have time tomorrow?" Lin Yi's father asked with a smile.
Ever since Han Xuewei's father moved in, he had been busy helping take care of the children. In the past few days, he had been bustling about, even going to Xiangcheng by himself to buy baby formula and diapers. Still, he had to visit the company every now and then.
Han Xuewei's father said with a smile, "I happen to be free tomorrow, but I have an important meeting on Monday, so I need to get back at least by Houtian."
Lin Yi replied directly, "No worries, it won't take too long. In that case, let's go take a look tomorrow."
If they were planning to take the car home the same day, they definitely needed to visit a big dealership. Small dealers often don't have vehicles in stock, let alone specialty motorhomes with a small target audience!
After chatting for a while, they heard their number being called on the loudspeaker.
"Number 99, please come to register."
Upon hearing his number called, Lin Yi quickly reached into his bag and pulled out the vaccine books and went to the front desk to register.
The person at the desk was taken aback when he saw three books, his gaze toward Lin Yi turned a bit strange. He then looked at the babies' birth dates and seemed even more surprised.
"Wow! They are triplets!"
The staff member couldn't help but become curious; triplets were indeed rare, at least in her more than ten years on the job, she had never seen them!
Lin Yi simply smiled politely, then said, "Yes, they are my babies."
The staff member's voice was loud, and many people turned their eyes towards them. After hearing the term 'triplets,' everyone suddenly realized with a start of surprise that after talking for so long, they hadn't expected that the family had had triplets all at once!
The staff, unable to hide her curiosity, said with a smile, "That's really impressive! Your wife is amazing too, the triplets were conceived naturally, right? That's so rare, I've worked here for so long and have never seen triplets!"
Lin Yi "hmm"ed in response, without saying much; that was his answer.
He didn't want a lot of people gossiping about his family and his children behind his back.
The person smiled and took the vaccination booklet, wrote some things in it, then placed it under the printer. After completing these tasks, she smiled at Lin Yi and said, "Each baby needs to be vaccinated twice. I've registered you now; you can hold the babies and line up at that entrance, it will be your turn soon."
After retrieving his booklet, Lin Yi nodded politely and said, "Okay, thank you."
Then, the large family proceeded majestically to the designated area and began to queue up.
There weren't many people ahead in line, and judging by the rate things were moving, they would be able to get the vaccinations in about fifteen minutes.
But while they were waiting, their eldest baby suddenly woke up—perhaps the noisy environment was too much for him, and feeling uneasy, he began crying as soon as he awoke.
Lin Yi's father immediately took the child from his wife's arms and soothed him, "There, there, it's alright, grandpa is here, don't cry, oh, oh..."
Guided by the tears of the eldest son, the other two children also woke up. Perhaps it was because the three babies were usually on the same schedule, they tended to sleep and awake at the same time. This kept the entire family busy.
This situation had its pros and cons. At least they weren't in a situation where after calming one baby down, another would wake up and cry—that would be a real headache. Having the same schedule meant the whole family was either busy all at once or relaxed all at once.
Parents who have had twins certainly share this sentiment.
Han Xuewei's father swiftly took the younger brother out of the stroller, "Don't cry, Zhiyu is good, grandfather is here, there you go, grandfather will hold you."
Lin Yi instinctively took his daughter, who had not yet started to cry, into his arms, and said, somewhat gleefully, "Our little Mengmeng is the well-behaved one, Mengmeng is the best-behaved! Mengmeng, won't you cry? Daddy is here!"
After such a commotion, the people lining up in front turned around to look. After hearing their address, they finally understood—so the two older couples were the grandparents and maternal grandparents of the babies?
The busybodies who were previously chatting couldn't help but marvel; it was a misunderstanding, and the family had had triplets!
But then, those people started a new round of discussion!
"Wow, isn't that so rare? This is the first time I've seen triplets! And there are two boys and one girl! It feels so magical!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 58: 58: The Focus of Discussion
chapters.content:
"It's rare enough to see twins, but to encounter triplets today! Indeed, it's quite miraculous."
For a moment, everyone's faces were filled with astonishment.
It's believed that wherever these triplets go, they'll surely become the center of everyone's attention!
Everyone was profoundly moved by Han Xuewei's greatness. It must not be easy being the mother of triplets!
Those who were initially babbling nonsense had completely forgotten that they were just joking about their large family!
As for Lin Yi, he was just holding and soothing the baby, not caring at all about what the people around him were saying.
That's life, as long as you take care of your own, that's enough; the rest doesn't matter!
"Treasure Body had some milk before coming out, so why is he suddenly crying? Could it be that he is hungry again?" Lin Yi's mother asked anxiously as she watched her well-behaved grandson crying so loudly.
Han Xuewei said to her, "Mom, today Da Bao had breast milk, but he didn't eat well when I fed him and fell asleep soon after, so he must be crying because he's hungry. Let me try feeding him now."
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi's mother quickly looked around and pointed to a room, saying, "Then you should take the baby there, that's the nursing room."
Lin Yi, ready to carry the baby over, said, "Should I accompany you? Because you won't be able to feed the baby when it's time for the vaccination."
Han Xuewei took her daughter and then said, "It's not convenient for you to go, you still have other moms feeding their babies here, I can go by myself."
After hearing this, Lin Yi didn't know what else to say. He had wanted to accompany his wife, but he had overlooked that there were other moms nursing their babies inside!
Lin Yi's mother hurriedly said, "Then I'll go with you, Lin Yi can wait here."
Without another word, Lin Yi's mother promptly took Han Xuewei and the baby and headed towards the room.
Just at that moment, the woman who had registered the three babies happened to pass by and casually asked, "I noticed you didn't have any medical reports in hand when I saw you earlier. The babies are just a month old, do you have their medical reports?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi became anxious, "Do we need medical reports, too? Does vaccination require so many things?"
At that point, Han Xuewei and several elders cast surprised glances at him.
Seeing everyone's stunned expressions, the woman shrugged helplessly and said, "Is this your first time here? You certainly wouldn't know about these things. A medical check-up is indispensable, and if the medical report shows the baby is fine, then they can be vaccinated. That's why many parents have their babies checked in advance at the maternal and child health center.
Didn't the doctor tell you all this?"
At this moment, Lin Yi slapped his forehead, feeling helpless, "I really did forget... But now... we've already queued for such a long time..."
Lin Yi's father hurriedly thanked the staff member, saying, "Thank you so much for reminding us, otherwise we would have wasted so much time here."
The staffer said matter-of-factly, "It's all part of the job, but don't worry. We also have a clinic here where the babies can be checked. You'll just need to queue again and take a number over there!"
Lin Yi looked towards the nursing room not far away and asked, "Our turn is almost up to be called, if we go for the check-up now, will we be able to get back in time to continue with the injection??"
The woman glanced at the long queue and then said, "Let one person stay here in line, and the others can take the baby for the check-up! It's also better to rejoin the line from the end. There are almost 20 babies ahead, and each baby takes about three minutes, so you have an hour."
After thinking for a moment, the staff member continued, "And at this hour, the clinic should be empty, so you'll get the results quickly. However, you can only get a routine examination. If you want a more comprehensive one, you should take the baby to the maternal and child health hospital!"
Lin Yi expressed his gratitude, "Alright, thank you so much. Otherwise, we would have been busy for nothing."
"Given your special circumstances, you can also let the staff inside know in advance that you're taking the baby for a check-up and will be back quickly. When your number is called, they can wait a bit or let the others go first. These are not major issues. However, the one-month check-up for the baby is absolutely essential.
Although our clinic can only give a general check, it's important because some babies are not suited for vaccinations so early on. Discuss this among yourselves, I have to get back to work."
Lin Yi said with an apologetic tone, "I'm really sorry for taking up so much of your time, but thank you!"
The woman replied kindly, "Don't worry, it's part of my job."
After that, she returned to her post.
Lin Yi had been really negligent when he came, forgetting such an important matter.
He wasn't even clear on what the medical check-up for the baby would involve.
But now there was no time to worry about that; he just had to wait patiently for Han Xuewei to finish feeding the baby.
Just then, Lin Yi's father remarked, "I didn't expect that a vaccination for the baby would require a medical check-up. It seems my general knowledge isn't sufficient!"
For their generation, they indeed had little concept of such things; when they were young, not to mention vaccinations, there wasn't even enough milk to drink.
Even Lin Yi, who was raised by his mother while his father was busy with work, had little involvement in other childrearing tasks.
Therefore, Lin Yi's father, lacking in parenting knowledge, naturally didn't know about the medical check-up requirement for a one-month-old baby before vaccination. He had even had to practice for a long time to learn how to hold his grandchild properly, and in Lin Yi's mother's eyes, he was seen as rough and certainly not delicate enough to care for babies.
Lin Yi himself shook his head helplessly, saying, "I was negligent too; the doctor clearly explained it to me."
He felt some regret; although he had a remarkable memory for reading or watching videos, it never occurred to him that he could forget something the doctor said. From now on, he resolved that for anything related to his baby, he would have to switch on his "skill."
Moreover, the one-month medical check-up for the baby was indeed extremely important.
Seeing Lin Yi's self-reproach, Han Xuewei's mother comforted him, "Don't worry, we found out in time, and it's not too late. If needed, we can just go to the maternal and child health hospital. It won't be a hassle, so there's no need to blame yourself."

chapters.title: Chapter 59: 59: "Pregnancy Brain" for Three Years
chapters.content:
Lin Yi's father was also very optimistic, "Indeed, since we're free this afternoon, it might as well be the perfect time to take the treasures to get a check-up. If it really doesn't work out, we can come back first thing tomorrow morning for the vaccination. It's quite convenient to make an appointment online, and none of this is a big deal."
Lin Yi still shook his head and said, "I was actually planning to spend tomorrow morning selecting a motorhome."
Han Xuewei's father added at this point, "Then let's take the kids to the maternal and child health hospital for a check-up in the morning! The RV can wait until the afternoon. As long as you choose one, I'll pay for it; consider it a wedding gift for my daughter. It's a good chance for me to show my support."
Han Xuewei's father was very generous, having long since made this decision without any ambiguity.
After all, there were already three cars in the family, and they had previously agreed to use a car as a dowry. Now was the time to make good on that promise, especially since the children had just had their first month celebration, making it the perfect time to buy the vehicle!
Seeing Han Xuewei's father's earnestness, Lin Yi could only smile and say, "Then I shall graciously accept! Thank you, Father-in-law!"
Even though Lin Yi was now very wealthy, he knew that he couldn't refuse this gift. It was a gesture from his father-in-law, not only meant for him but also for his daughter and grandchildren.
He couldn't meddle; he would have to find other ways to slowly return the large sum to his father-in-law's pocket.
Just like that, everyone quickly reached an agreement on what to do the following day.
Less than ten minutes later, Han Xuewei and Lin Yi's mothers came out holding the babies.
Lin Yi hurried forward and said, "Mom, honey, we only found out just now that the baby needs a check-up before getting vaccinated. I'm going to go to the check-up room and get a number!"
It was then that Han Xuewei suddenly remembered, "Oh my, I just remembered too, the doctor had reminded me before. Sigh, I'm becoming more forgetful. Is this the so-called 'pregnancy brain' that lasts for three years?"
While holding his daughter, Lin Yi didn't forget to comfort his wife, "Ha ha ha, turning into a little silly?"
Upon hearing that, Han Xuewei's cheeks instantly flushed with embarrassment, but when she looked up, she saw the elders smiling at her, leaving her nowhere to hide.
She playfully said to Lin Yi, "How could you say such a thing, not even avoiding people!"
At that moment, Han Xuewei was quite shy. She felt that such sweet nothings should be whispered between spouses, not announced loudly in front of others; otherwise, it would be too embarrassing.
Upon seeing this, everyone else laughed and quickly turned their heads, "Alright, alright, let's pretend we didn't hear anything."
After the joking subsided, Lin Yi carried the children toward the check-up area. Since there weren't many people there, they were able to get a number straight away.
Even before the number was securely in hand, the loudspeaker called out for that very number. It seemed their luck was good; no one else was waiting.
The whole family followed along, bringing the three babies inside. The doctor was stunned to see so many people arrive at once.
"How did you... line up and come in? I just called one number."
Seeing three babies being brought in all at once would baffle anyone, and no one would guess that the three were from the same litter!
"We only called one number just now, so those behind, please don't rush. Stay outside and wait; it will be quick," the doctor said as he stood up to start directing.
However, Lin Yi immediately explained, "Doctor, the number called was mine, but we are all one family."
The doctor seemed very puzzled, "One family?"
Lin Yi's father quickly said, "We are a family. I am the baby's grandfather."
Han Xuewei's father also hastened to say, "I am the baby's maternal grandfather. We are all together. These three babies are all ours."
After hearing this, the doctor suddenly understood, his expression revealing a touch of surprise, "Ah, triplets!"
Lin Yi smiled and said, "Yes, we have triplets."
The doctor's eyes showed envy as he exclaimed, "That's really rare! Even twins are uncommon nowadays, and here you have triplets. You are truly blessed! Then, bring the babies over."
Hearing the doctor's words, everyone quickly brought the babies over to the doctor, who carefully put each little one on the baby scale to be weighed.
After quite a bustling process, the height and weight of the three babies were all measured. Han Xuewei was on the side, diligently recording the data.
The doctor also carefully checked the babies' limbs, followed by their mouths. Although it was a tedious process, the examination was completed in less than ten minutes.
Logically, the next step would be to proceed with the vaccinations.
After comparing the recorded data with the computer, the doctor said very responsibly, "The babies are in good shape, but since they're only a month old, I recommend doing a detailed check-up, especially a complete blood count and tests for bone calcium; these are very important for the babies."
Lin Yi replied, "Then, thank you very much."
And with that, Lin Yi grabbed the three A4 papers with the babies' health check information, and after everyone thanked the doctor, they all returned to the main hall.
By now, the queue for vaccinations had dwindled, and looking around, the hall was nearly empty of waiting patrons.
Lin Yi checked the time; it was already approaching noon, and the place would be closing soon. In a little while, they would stop taking numbers. It seemed that the morning had not been enough.
Lin Yi led everyone to some empty seats to rest for a while.
"Everyone, please take a seat. Honey, you sit too. Are you tired from today?" Lin Yi quickly offered his wife a seat.
Then he said to the two elders holding babies, "Mother-in-law, Mom, please sit down and rest! You're holding the babies, after all."
Since there weren't many seats left, after the mothers settled down with their babies, the others had to stand. But the remaining group was all men, and it was natural for them to give up their seats for the ladies.
Han Xuewei's mother laughed, "You must be tired from running around, right? We can squeeze in; there's room to sit."
"Ah, don't mention it. Standing for a bit doesn't bother me, Mengmeng is light, and I'm not tired at all. You all just sit down," he dismissed.

chapters.title: Chapter 60: 60 Vaccination
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei's mother could only sit down and say, "Let's rest for a little while then, the babies will start crying again soon enough, and there will be no chance to relax."
Lin Yi's mother suddenly said, "I also remember when our Lin Yi was little and went to the hospital for vaccinations, he cried his heart out, and no one could calm him down."
Han Xuewei's mother smiled and said, "Did he cry fiercely? I remember Vivi was pretty okay as a child, she just whimpered and shed a couple tears during vaccination, and she was fine soon after."
"In my opinion, our eldest grandson's temperament is simply too much like our Lin Yi's!" Lin Yi's father added from the side.
"The little grandson and granddaughter do indeed resemble our Vivi, both very well-behaved."
Lin Yi's mother continued, "In a few years when the babies are a bit older, we absolutely must not let the hot-tempered elder brother bully the other two little ones!"
"Yes, education is most important, we need to tell him early on that as an elder brother, he must be responsible and always protect his younger brother and sister. Judging from his current weight, our Da Bao will certainly be big and strong, a chubby little fellow indeed."
The whole family chatted away as they waited for their turn, and when they brought up the story of Lin Yi's vaccinations as a child, he was the first to burst into laughter.
After a short wait, the baby's name came through the speakers.
"Please Lin Zhiyan come to the examination room to prepare for your appointment."
Everyone was a bit surprised to hear the name so soon and quickly picked up the babies and headed for the examination room.
The nurse responsible for vaccinations, seeing so many people pour in, said loudly, "Don't bring in so many people, those who haven't been called, please wait outside."
"Our baby is a set of triplets, we're all one family."
"Yes, nurse, we're the baby's grandparents, they are the maternal grandparents, and these two are the parents of the three babies."
At this moment, only Aunt Wang stood in the hall, looking after the baby stroller and other personal belongings outside.
The nurse and a nearby doctor, upon seeing this big family and the three adorable little ones, had looks of astonishment on their faces!
"They're really triplets?"
Lin Yi replied calmly, "Yes, they are triplets."
The nurse took out three syringes, while busily informing everyone, "Triplets are really rare these days, and to have two boys and one girl at that!"
Lin Yi responded with a polite smile, but said nothing more.
"We need to wake all three babies up, we can't inject them while they're asleep, otherwise it could cause a fright," said the nurse.
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei's mother quickly began to gently wake the babies, "So that's how it is. I thought it would be easier to soothe them if they were asleep. Sweetheart, wake up, come on, wake up."
Lin Yi's mother also hurriedly picked up Da Bao, attempting to gently get the baby to wake, but after a long while, it was in vain. It looked like the little guy wasn't done sleeping. After aimlessly turning his head a few times, he was fast asleep again.
Han Xuewei quickly took out her cellphone and started recording the scene beside them, intending to capture the three babies' first vaccination.
The nurse, seeing this scene, came over to help and gently fiddled with Da Bao's ear, hoping to wake the baby from sleep, but the little one merely twitched a few times and then fell back asleep.
The nurse was somewhat helpless about this and could only gently pat the baby's little hand. After a few pats, Da Bao quickly woke from his sleep and then began to cry uncontrollably.
Upon witnessing this scene, everyone started to laugh. The nurse also revealed the syringe in her hand and signaled to Mother Lin to open the baby's clothes to expose an arm.
Since two shots were required, both arms would have to endure a prick this time. Surely the little one would cry terribly, right?
Indeed, as everyone expected, the nurse and doctor each held a syringe and injected them one after the other. The little one was already crying fiercely, and after receiving the second shot, he let out a high-pitched scream!
After both shots were done, the nurse said with a smile, "Every baby cries a lot when they come for vaccinations. You should press down on the wound."
Lin Yi's mother, holding the baby in her arms, watched as the large needle pierced her baby's tender skin and felt incredibly heartbroken! Her baby's cries made her even more anxious. Although she had anticipated this and even prepared herself mentally, she still couldn't help feeling upset at that moment.
Even a long while after the shots were finished, Da Bao's cries were still loud, with his face and neck turning red—a large area. It seemed the little one's temper was much worse than they had expected.
Although other people's babies also cried when getting shots, it wasn't this intense, was it?!
Next, it was the turn of the younger brother and sister to get vaccinated, and they both cried for a long time, just not as loudly as their brother. Especially little sister Mengmeng, who whimpered a bit and shed a few tears before stopping.
To everyone's surprise, Da Bao kept crying for a very long time afterward, who would have thought that apart from having a bad temper, he was also such a crybaby!
By the time all three babies were vaccinated, it was already 12:32 PM.
The family returned to the car, and Lin Yi asked Han Xuewei sitting beside him, "Wife, can you check on your phone if we can schedule a check-up for the babies after 2 PM today?"
Han Xuewei immediately responded, "Mhm, I'll look it up right now."
No sooner had she finished speaking than she took out her phone and started checking the infant health check-up section on a mobile app, only to find that the afternoon slots were already fully booked, not a single opening was left!
"There are no more slots available today. Should we schedule one for tomorrow morning? Although the slots we can get are a bit late, only after ten o'clock. What should we do now?"
Lin Yi thought for a moment and then said directly, "Just make the appointment! The check-up should be done as soon as possible. It's okay if it's a bit late."
Han Xuewei operated on her phone and got the babies registered.
"Then let's all take the babies to the maternal and child health hospital again tomorrow. Don't forget to bring the check-up booklets," Han Xuewei instructed.
Lin Yi smiled and replied, "Mhm, alright."
However, the next second, an important question popped into his head, and he quickly asked, "Vivi, you should also have a postpartum check-up after your confinement period, right?"
Mother Lin jumped in to explain, "There's no need to do it so early. The postpartum check-up should be done 42 days later, and that's when you'll also have to take a bath."
Mother Lin had experienced these things at least once, so she knew a bit more.

chapters.title: Chapter 61: 61 Postnatal Check-up
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei's mother hurriedly added after hearing this, "Should we make some more soup to nourish her properly? I remember the Maternity Matron also advised that chicken and fish soups are the best."
Han Xuewei shook her head and said, "Mom, I'm fine. I'm already out of confinement, and my body has almost recovered. I can go to the hospital for a check-up after forty-two days."
Lin Yi, hearing his wife say this, naturally wasn't worried.
The two mothers looked at each other and finally nodded, saying, "Then we'll just wait for the time to come!"
The group finally made it home, where the three little ones seemed to still feel pain in their arms from the vaccinations, or perhaps they were scared during the shots as they occasionally cried, which made Han Xuewei very worried.
Han Xuewei's mother reassured her, "Don't worry, it's very normal for a one-month-old baby to be like this after getting vaccinated. Just hold them more, and they will be better by tomorrow. It's okay."
Lin Yi's mother added, "Yes, our Mengmeng has been very good, barely crying after her vaccination. Today, it was Da Bao who cried the most. Hold him more; he might even wake up crying in the middle of the night. You have to comfort him properly to make the baby feel safe."
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei took it more seriously and hurriedly nodded. She was very worried about the baby. It seemed he was indeed frightened today, and she couldn't help feeling a pang of heartache.
Moreover, today she was supposed to breastfeed her younger brother, and Han Xuewei had specifically fed her older brother to comfort him.
After dinner in the evening, Han Xuewei began to settle the babies, and by the time the three children fell asleep, it was already nine at night.
She finally had time for herself and returned to her room.
As soon as she pushed the door open, she found Lin Yi already lying in bed. It seemed he was waiting for her!
Han Xuewei immediately sensed Lin Yi's intentions, no wonder he seemed a bit unusual tonight. Without thinking too much, she gently closed the door and lay down on the bed.
When Lin Yi saw his wife enter and push the door, he quickly closed his eyes, entering a state of resting with his eyes closed.
As Han Xuewei got into bed and lay beside him, Lin Yi's heart skipped a beat.
He then took a deep breath.
He calmed himself down, his mind going blank. A few seconds later, he suddenly turned over and directly pinned Han Xuewei under him!
"Vivi, I..."
At that moment, Han Xuewei finally understood why Lin Yi had asked her on the way home when she would have her postnatal checkup!
It seemed he really couldn't control himself!
Why so eager?
But when she thought about it, it did seem reasonable. It was much better than those men who cheated during their wives' pregnancies. Lin Yi indeed took care of her by her side, always letting her spend her pregnancy with peace of mind.
For a long time, nothing had happened. It must be said that Lin Yi had indeed controlled his desires well, which wasn't easy when she thought about it.
But now she had just finished her confinement, and her body was still somewhat uncomfortable. Wouldn't it be somewhat inappropriate for that kind of thing?
Han Xuewei tried to struggle out of Lin Yi's embrace, but Lin Yi held himself firmly on top of her, leaving no room for movement.
After several unsuccessful attempts, she could only suppress her embarrassment and whispered softly, "Why... are you suddenly acting like this..."
Lin Yi lowered his head, his eyes staring intently at his charming and slightly shy wife beneath him. He leaned close to Han Xuewei's ear and murmured, "Acting like what? Surely you know what I want to do, right?"
Han Xuewei cleared her throat; faced with Lin Yi's teasing, she also found it hard to resist, especially when she heard Lin Yi's magnetic voice, which left her utterly defenseless!
It seemed Lin Yi knew his wife liked this kind of play, so he moved even closer and kept breathing heavily.
Han Xuewei had never been teased like this before and suddenly felt her entire body soften considerably. She whispered softly, "But… we can't yet… We have to wait for the check-up after 42 days… Just hold on a bit longer…"
But unexpectedly, Lin Yi didn't seem to want to stop and simply smiled faintly, whispering into Han Xuewei's ear, "Silly girl…"
These two were already husband and wife and had even shared the intimacy of skin; they even had a baby together.
But the only contact between the two of them was that night, and since then, they had not had a deep conversation. Even that special night had been initiated by Han Xuewei, making their relationship very delicate.
Even though, at this moment, Han Xuewei wished to be closer to Lin Yi, her body clearly hinted that it wasn't possible yet.
Seeing Lin Yi like this now left Han Xuewei at a bit of a loss. No matter how she felt, her body wouldn't cooperate!
Lin Yi gently kissed her cheek, laughed right next to her ear, and at that moment, Han Xuewei's cheeks turned crimson, her face heated, and her body softened even more.
Lin Yi just smiled and then said, "Silly girl, I won't do anything until your body has recovered. Besides, matters between a man and a woman should certainly be consensual. How dare I be reckless now? Silly girl, stop overthinking."
After hearing this, Han Xuewei finally let down her guard; thankfully, Lin Yi thought this way. Otherwise, if he had been forceful, she might have truly succumbed.
With a weight lifted from her heart, Han Xuewei finally closed her eyes in relief. Seeing her like this, Lin Yi chuckled and said, "Why are you so scared? I was just teasing you."
After saying that, Lin Yi rolled on his side and lay flat, with one hand under his head and the other arm wrapped around Han Xuewei.
After a while, Lin Yi spoke slowly, "Speaking of the night we spent together, do you remember it? It seems I've completely forgotten."
After hearing this, Han Xuewei's heart began to race even faster as she remembered that beautiful night. Her face turned a deep shade of red, and she clenched the corner of the blanket tightly, uncertain of what to do.
Of course, she remembered that intimate night very clearly! It was etched in her memory!
Back then, Lin Yi seemed to be venting a kind of indescribable rage, and that night, Han Xuewei was also drenched in sweat.
Until the next morning, she felt so weak in the legs that she had some difficulty walking. She even hurriedly fled the hotel, and once she reached the street, people would stare at her with strange looks.
She had no choice but to go to Qin Xiaoxu's place, where she rested for two or three days before returning to her dormitory.
Otherwise, with the condition she was in, if she had returned to school, the gossip would have spread across the entire campus!

chapters.title: Chapter 62: 62: In-depth Communication
chapters.content:
At this moment, Han Xuewei didn't know how to respond to all of Lin Yi's questions. Now, the couple was lying on the same bed, speaking words that made cheeks flush and ears burn. Could it be that he really wasn't afraid of a fire starting?
Although the two of them hadn't formally dated or experienced a passionate love affair, Han Xuewei felt she knew very little about boys. However, she often heard her close friend Qin Xiaoxu talk about some matters between men and women, and sometimes Han Xuewei would blush listening to her on the side.
Seeing Vivi lying beside him not willing to speak for a long time, Lin Yi slowly turned to his side and comforted her, "There's nothing to be nervous about. I'm actually just reminiscing about that day..."
The recollection process? Of course, it was to reminisce about my manly pride!
However, Lin Yi only thought the last sentence to himself. His wife was truly too shy and extremely bashful; some things shouldn't be said too explicitly.
Lin Yi even clearly remembered that when he woke up that day, he saw a smudge of blood on the bed sheet.
He immediately realized that the school beauty had shared a beautiful night exclusively with him, Lin Yi. This was something that made him feel fortunate and also gave him a great surprise!
As Lin Yi was thinking about this, he hugged Han Xuewei's hand even tighter.
"It's okay, we are husband and wife after all. We have so much more to understand about each other, to enter into each other's hearts. You don't have to be shy; I will respect your..."
After Lin Yi finished speaking, he fell silent.
Han Xuewei also understood very clearly that a husband and wife should communicate more, even more in-depth communication. Without more profound communication, even the most harmonious couple would gradually grow cold.
Han Xuewei truly loved Lin Yi from the bottom of her heart. Of course, she didn't want their relationship to become perfunctory and cold, but rather like that of a normal couple, hopefully growing more and more loving.
As long as Lin Yi had similar requests like tonight in the future, she would definitely agree.
Otherwise, her husband would grow distant from her, unwilling to communicate, and such a development trend would not be beneficial for their relationship at all.
At this time, Han Xuewei took the initiative to hug Lin Yi, and said with some shyness, "I... I'm not ready yet, and my body hasn't recovered these past few days..."
The latter indulgently soothed her in return, softly saying, "Don't take it seriously. Just now, your husband was just teasing you. And I will wait quietly until you are willing, is that okay?"
Han Xuewei hugged Lin Yi's hand tighter and whispered her agreement.
After a moment, the young couple fell asleep in this position.
The next day at dawn, the couple awoke at the same time, but today Han Xuewei seemed a bit tired.
She hadn't rested well the night before because the baby had been quite scared while getting vaccinated, which led to a lot of fuss.
Especially their eldest son, who would even wake up crying from sleep as if he had a nightmare.
This was Han Xuewei's first time as a mother, so her excessive concern was understandable. Last night, she was even woken up by the baby's crying and got up to soothe the child.
Compared to their eldest son, the younger brother and sister were a bit better, at least they didn't wake up crying in the night, and if there was any discomfort, both sets of parents and Aunt Wang could take care of them.
An old saying goes well, having an elder in the family is like having a treasure!
At this time, Han Xuewei finally understood the meaning of this saying, realizing that the four elders of her family indeed shared a lot of their burdens and offered much help!
Sometimes a large family is just like this, both good and bad are bidirectional, as long as you consider others, they will consider you too!
Some people, after getting a daughter-in-law, always want to put her in her place right away or elevate their own status. But life should not be like this; deliberate actions by some can only make things more complicated, and if not careful, resentment may grow.
Some outrageous behaviors might even become the talk of the town, turning into a joke among the neighbors.
There are even those who go too far, only wanting their daughter-in-law to produce grandsons, not granddaughters. The mindset of favoring boys over girls is deeply rooted; if a granddaughter is born, they don't show up or help at all during the daughter-in-law's confinement.
Perhaps these people have never considered that one day when they get old and need care themselves, whether they might be met with indifferent responses from others?
Therefore, there's an old saying that goes, "You can't hold grudges during confinement, or they will be remembered for a lifetime!" After all, a daughter-in-law is at her most vulnerable during confinement, and if you upset her, she may never forget your ill treatment.
Many things in life are reciprocal; as long as you treat others with kindness, they will respond in kind. This applies to strangers and even more so among family members.
Lin Yi's parents were also reasonable people; all they hoped for now was that Han Xuewei would take good care of her health every day. They even feared that sometimes they might be too busy or not attentive enough, which is why they had Lin Yi invite his in-laws to come and live with them.
Han Xuewei was really tired today, feeling utterly drained, so she could not accompany the baby to the hospital check-up. She only asked Lin Yi to take several videos during the babies' check-ups, as she wanted to watch them at home.
After everyone finished their tasks, they set off with the three babies.
Today it was Lin Yi and his father driving, and the large family set off towards the maternal and child health hospital once again.
On the way there, Lin Yi even thought that he must hurry to change the car; getting a motorhome sooner would be better, as traveling would only become less convenient otherwise.
He had also thought about it last night; a motorhome would be much more baby-friendly. For example, heating a bottle of milk on the road or changing a diaper temporarily would be quite convenient.
They arrived at the maternal and child health hospital just on time, as per their appointment. There were still quite a few people in the queue ahead of them, with babies crying in chorus.
These babies all looked very young, the oldest being only around one year old, and there were also those like their three family babies who had been brought in for a check-up at one month old.
Overall, the scene was somewhat chaotic.
Lin Yi managed to find some open space for the family after some effort, and the names of their three babies appeared on the display screen. It seemed their turn would come before long.
And with the three little babies, only one number was displayed, which seemed quite convenient. As long as they handed over this number, all three babies could be examined together.
After waiting outside for about ten minutes, their number began flashing on the display, almost exactly on schedule with their appointment.
The entire family marched grandly into the examination room, where the doctor couldn't help but frown at the sight. But after checking the number and seeing three names behind it, he quickly realized.

chapters.title: Chapter 63: 63: Heaven and Earth are vast, but the wife is the greatest
chapters.content:
"So it's triplets! Ever since you all left last time, my colleagues have been talking about these three babies." The doctor greeted everyone warmly.
Lin Yi was also very polite to the doctor, "The babies have just turned one month old, and we've brought them for a comprehensive check-up."
Lin Yi's mother hurriedly brought over her eldest grandson and handed his health check book to the doctor, then said with a smile, "This one in my arms is Lin Zhiyan, he's the older brother."
The doctor picked up the stethoscope with a smile, "Well then, let's follow this order, with the big brother setting a good example."
"You might not know, but there are still quite a few people in the hospital talking about these three little babies. Many of my colleagues are so envious! They say they can't even have twins, let alone triplets, Your family really has great fortune! Moreover, the children are very healthy, meeting all standards, and didn't even need an incubator after birth, which is already considered a miracle!"
Lin Yi's mother of course was all smiles upon hearing the doctor's words, as everyone loves getting compliments!
And it's all thanks to the daughter-in-law's efforts!
Truthfully, their daughter-in-law suffered a lot for these three babies. Without Han Xuewei's hard work, the Lin Family wouldn't have such great luck!
It seems I need to remind Lin Yi to always treat his wife well, no matter what. The world is big, but the wife is the greatest!
Lin Yi probably didn't expect that he would be receiving advice from his elders again.
Lin Yi's mother hurriedly said to the doctor, "We also owe a lot to the babies' mother! Women are naturally tender, but fierce when they become mothers. My daughter-in-law is really great, she's the biggest hero and has worked the hardest."
The doctor agreed wholeheartedly and slowly said, "As a doctor, I'm naturally aware of the difficulties of having triplets. It's no small feat that each baby is at a healthy weight. You must pay close attention to the mother's health. She needs proper postpartum recovery."
The doctor's words struck Lin Yi like a revelation. How had he not thought about getting Han Xuewei postpartum recovery services!
He had been concerned about his children from the start, and at most had shown concern for his wife's confinement, but had completely overlooked the need for postpartum recovery!
Lin Yi quickly assured, "Thank you for the reminder, I will take my wife for recovery services."
Lin Yi, not wanting to forget this matter, had already triggered his photographic memory and had firmly decided to take Han Xuewei for postpartum recovery no matter what.
"By the way, doctor, I wanted to ask which place is better for postpartum recovery?"
The doctor, while examining the baby, said to Lin Yi, "Our maternal and child health hospital can do it as well. Just go to the postpartum department when you register. However, you should consult beforehand since not every aspect requires recovery. It varies from person to person!"
"Mm-hmm, I've got it," Lin Yi replied.
The three little ones quickly finished their checkups, which were all pretty routine. The doctor slowly spoke while entering data into the computer, "I've taken a brief look, and everything like the babies' weight and heart rhythms are very normal. Next, we'll do a complete blood count — that's important. Then we'll move on to a bone density test. There are quite a few similar tests to go through.
Once I've written up the orders, you can go and pay. It looks like your family will be busy this morning. Haha."
"Oh, and after all the tests are done, come back with the report, and I'll take a look at the results. If everything's alright, you can go home."
Lin Yi quickly agreed, "Got it, I'll go pay right now."
Lin Yi's mother and Aunt Wang were each looking after a brother, who had already started crying during the earlier heart check by the doctor — it's hard to tell if the little ones were scared.
Fortunately, the sister Mengmeng was doing a bit better; she mainly just squirmed around without any other reactions.
Having received the written orders, Lin Yi went to the front desk to pay the fees all in one go, and then took the babies to have the complete blood count done. Although the blood sample was collected quickly, the report would take about half an hour to be ready.
All three little ones were crying fiercely during the blood test as their small hands got pricked and the nurses held them tightly to make the blood flow more easily. This was something the babies had never experienced before, turning them all into weeping messes.
But there was no other way; with the advancement of technology, the comprehensive physical examinations for babies had become more thorough. It's only through such complete checkups that any issues can be detected earlier and treated sooner.
While waiting for the blood test results, everyone took the babies to undergo other examinations. Luckily, there were not many people in line, so they got through the tests quite quickly.
About half an hour later, they had all the test results in hand and went back to the doctor's office.
The doctor examined the results for the three babies very carefully, then addressed everyone, "Please have a seat and wait; I need to go through these one by one, which might take some time."
Lin Yi gestured for his family to sit down. While he was worried about the babies, he was also thinking that they had been fed milk, given water, and had their diapers changed before leaving home, so there were no delays during the checkups. After being there for a total of an hour, it looked like they were just about finished with the physical examination.
After comparing the data to the benchmarks, the doctor concluded, "The babies are healthy, but there is one minor issue — their bone density is not quite up to standard. However, please don't worry as it's quite common in infants and toddlers. Just supplement calcium and vitamin D promptly, and they should improve soon."
Lin Yi's mother quickly asked, "So what medication should the babies take? Can you prescribe it directly?"
"Our hospital can prescribe vitamin D for the babies, but for calcium, you can buy the supplements at a pharmacy near your home. Of course, the liquid form is best, as it can be added directly to the milk the babies drink."
Lin Yi nodded, "We'll get the vitamin D here at the hospital, and I'll check out the calcium when I get back home."
"Actually, they don't need too much — 0.5 grams daily per baby is enough. One box per baby should suffice. One box is just one course of treatment. Oh, and once you get the calcium tablets or liquid calcium, remember to also give some to the babies' mother, because their deficiency is fundamentally due to a deficiency in the mother."
After hearing this, Lin Yi quickly said, "Yes, yes, I understand. Thank you, doctor. Please prescribe an extra couple of boxes of vitamin D for my wife to supplement as well!"

chapters.title: Chapter 64: 64: The Reward for the Physical Examination
chapters.content:
Lin Yi, holding the prescription, took the whole family to get the medicine, aiming to do so before the maternal and child health clinic closed for the day.
By the time they retrieved the medicine, a familiar system notification sound rang out in Lin Yi's mind.
"Ding, congratulations, Host. You've earned a reward for taking the babies for a health checkup, one million yuan for each baby."
Lin Yi was no longer greatly surprised by the system's rewards; everything was as expected. Besides, he now had at least tens of millions in savings—there was no need to worry about food and clothing for the rest of his life!
After collecting the medicines, they returned home. When they arrived, it was already twelve in the afternoon. Han Xuewei's mother and Lin Yi's mother were both readying lunch.
Today, Han Xuewei's mother took the initiative to cook. After preparing several dishes, she said with a smile to everyone, "My cooking skills aren't the best; I just stir-fried a few dishes. The meals are ready for everyone, but it seems there was no time to make Vivi's."
After consoling the babies, Lin Yi went to the kitchen: "Mom, let me cook for Vivi! You go ahead and eat. I'm not very hungry right now. I can just have the nutritional meal I make for Vivi later."
Even when they had a maternity matron, Han Xuewei's daily meals were prepared by Lin Yi, as his culinary skills were certainly much better than the maternity matrons'. But since the maternity matron's departure, it had been a bit too much for him, and sometimes the responsibility of cooking had fallen on Aunt Wang.
Lin Yi also realized it had been days since he last made a nutritional meal for his wife. Today was a good day to cook.
Although his wife had already come out of her confinement period, most people's lives would return to normal after it was over. Lin Yi, however, continued to carefully prepare nutritional meals for her, as she needed more time to recover from the birth of triplets.
He prepared a very lavish meal for his wife. By the time he finished, everyone had just finished eating, and Lin Yi served himself and Han Xuewei a bowl each, then took them upstairs together.
Gently pushing open the bedroom door, he found Han Xuewei still sound asleep. Lin Yi couldn't bear to wake her up, especially since she really hadn't rested well last night, and the little ones had another health checkup during the day—they might fuss again tonight!
To ensure Han Xuewei got enough sleep, Lin Yi decided not to wake her for the time being. Unexpectedly, just as he put down the food on the table, she woke up on her own.
She rubbed her sleepy eyes, her voice hoarse, and asked bewilderedly, "Honey, did you finish the baby's checkup so soon?"
"Yes, wife. How did you sleep today?" Lin Yi was about to come forward to help her when suddenly, the sound of crying came from the nursery.
Han Xuewei's mother and Aunt Wang were right there in the room. Han Xuewei hurried out of bed and ran with Lin Yi towards the nursery.
"Mom, did the babies get a scare today?" Han Xuewei asked with concern.
"Nothing to worry about, they are probably hungry by now. We left early today and they haven't had their milk since. It's noon now; they must be starving."
"Yeah, we've been out with the babies non-stop, and even we adults are this hungry, let alone the kids," Lin Yi said.
Even if the babies had been fed before leaving the house, that was a long time ago, so they must be crying now because of hunger.
Han Xuewei quickly picked up Da Bao, who was crying the loudest, and said, "Today, I'll breastfeed my brother. Lin Yi, you prepare the formula milk for the younger brother and sister."
Lin Yi was momentarily taken aback upon hearing this, because mixing formula was something others had done before; she had only breastfed the babies and had never made formula milk. Now that it was her turn, she didn't quite know how to proceed.
"Um... I'll give it a try," Lin Yi replied without giving it much thought and agreed at once.
```
No, we can learn again.
Han Xuewei carried her eldest son back to the bedroom while Lin Yi turned to ask his mother-in-law and Aunt Wang, "I've never made formula before, how do I do it?"
Aunt Wang quickly explained, "Here, you hold little Mengmeng, and I'll handle the formula. You just watch from the side, you'll learn after seeing it once."
However, Lin Yi stated plainly, "It's fine, Aunt Wang, leave making the formula to me. You can guide me from the side, that way I'll learn faster."
At that moment, Lin Yi was also calculating in his mind, he had never prepared formula for the baby before, and if he were to do it himself today, he would definitely get a reward from the system.
Furthermore, it wasn't a difficult task, and once he had learned, he would have to make more formula for the baby in the future.
"The water in the baby's special warmer kettle is always kept at a constant temperature. Water at 45 degrees can be used directly to make the formula. For every scoop of formula, add 40 milliliters of water. The little brother and sister don't eat much each day, 120 milliliters is completely enough. But since the baby is very hungry today, make 160 milliliters!"
Lin Yi listened very carefully and started to do as Aunt Wang had instructed, even placing the bottle on the table and reading the measurements to get exactly 160 milliliters.
Seeing the water was about right, Lin Yi added four scoops of formula.
Han Xuewei's mother, seeing Lin Yi's serious demeanor, was also very satisfied.
Such a good son-in-law, you couldn't find one even if you searched with a lantern! She liked the look of him more and more.
After Lin Yi finished adding the formula, he screwed on the bottle cap and picked up the bottle to start shaking it.
But after just one shake, both Han Xuewei's mother and Aunt Wang hurriedly stopped him, "No, that's not the right way to shake it."
Lin Yi was also taken aback by the two of them speaking up at the same time, saying, "Don't worry, I won't let it get foamy inside, I've done my homework and won't make a mistake."
Lin Yi first stirred it a couple of times and then slowly began to shake it. Only after being sure that both bottles of formula were ready did he smile and say to them, "All good now! Though I've never made formula myself before, I've read quite a few informative books on it!"
Lin Yi's actions also satisfied them both, clearly nothing had gone wrong.
Han Xuewei's mother came forward to take the bottle, finally at ease, "Yes, it's ready to be eaten."
After all the hustle and bustle from the three of them, the two little ones finished the 160 milliliters of milk in no time. The little brother and sister had better routines than their older brother; they fell asleep soon after their feed.
Just as Lin Yi was putting away the bottles, the prompt in his mind rang out on time.
"Ding, congratulations to the host for successfully making formula for the babies, reward: two hundred thousand!"
After hearing this, Lin Yi also revealed a hint of a smile on his face, this was all part of being a dad!
After washing the babies' bottles, he placed them in the sterilizer cabinet and finally had some free time, so he went back to the bedroom.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 65: 65: Let Me Feed You
chapters.content:
At this moment, Han Xuewei was still facing away from the door, breastfeeding Da Bao. Lin Yi walked over to the table, glanced at the meals prepared over the past few days, and asked softly, "Vivi, you must be quite hungry by now? I'll feed you, or else the food will get cold."
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei was slightly taken aback. Didn't Lin Yi realize she was breastfeeding the baby? If he came over to feed her, her chest would be seen!
Han Xuewei immediately said, "No, I'm not that hungry."
After speaking, her gaze drifted to the two full bowls of rice, and she asked, "Did you bring up all the meals? Didn't you skip lunch too? Why did you serve two bowls?"
Han Xuewei figured out that Lin Yi must have come up to accompany her for the meal.
Lin Yi nodded and said, "Yeah, I didn't have lunch either, and now I'm very hungry. Besides, you need to breastfeed Da Bao, which uses more energy, so you must be hungrier than I am. I'll feed you lunch now; being hungry for too long isn't good for you."
As soon as Lin Yi finished speaking, without waiting for a response and not caring what Han Xuewei had just said, he picked up her bowl and began feeding her with a spoon.
Though he didn't look directly, a glance caught a full view of Han Xuewei's chest.
His heartbeat couldn't help but speed up, but he still looked quite calm, steadily feeding her.
If he showed any other expression right now, Han Xuewei would surely feel embarrassed.
Lin Yi urged with seriousness, "Quick, take a bite. If you get too hungry, you will lose your appetite."
Han Xuewei's face turned red instantly, and her head shook like a bobblehead.
This is going to be tricky!How will he deal with the fact that his wife gets so easily shy, like a maiden experiencing her first bloom...?
However, under Lin Yi's insistence, she took a few sips of soup in small gulps; before long, half the soup in the bowl had gone.
But at that moment, Han Xuewei's complexion suddenly changed.
Lin Yi noticed this and asked anxiously, "Wife, what's wrong?"
With an embarrassed face, Han Xuewei explained, "Could you find a nursing pad over there? I feel like... it might be... leaking a bit."
Lin Yi quickly put down the bowl and stood up to search for the nursing pad that Han Xuewei mentioned.
"You can just tear it open for me and leave it beside me; I can put it in myself."
Lin Yi thought to himself, "How could a husband help with that!"
His hands moved fast; after unwrapping the nursing pad, he placed it in Han Xuewei's hands.
She took it, holding Da Bao with one hand while trying to stuff the pad in place with the other.
Lin Yi said softly, "You eat lunch first. Didn't we agree yesterday to pick out an RV today?"
Lin Yi replied. "It's okay; these things are trivial. It won't matter if it's delayed for a day or two. Right now, I'm just worried about you being hungry. You can't go hungry during the postpartum period; it could harm your stomach."
Han Xuewei then said, "I'll be done breastfeeding soon, and I've already had some soup, so I'm not that hungry right now. You eat your lunch first."
Seeing Han Xuewei's persistence, Lin Yi didn't say much and started eating his lunch quietly on the side.
And judging by Han Xuewei's movements at the time, she must have just finished breastfeeding and was getting ready to take the baby back to the nursery.
But all of a sudden, the system's voice rang out once again.
This time, there was no warning at all.
"Ding, congratulations to the host, you've successfully triggered a hidden task by feeding your wife while she was breastfeeding, and have earned a reward: the (True Love Baby) series diamond, valued at 888 million."
And at the same time, a card seemingly appeared out of nowhere beside Lin Yi. He picked it up and examined it for a while, realizing it was inscribed with the "True Love" brand, and the golden card was dazzling with the gleaming VIP in big letters!
This was a gold card! And it was made of pure gold!
Lin Yi was stunned by the card and quickly inquired, "My goodness, could this be a wedding gift from the system?"
"This is not a gift, it's simply the reward the host has obtained."
After hearing the system's response, Lin Yi said no more as his gaze was deeply attracted to the pure gold VIP card, which was exquisitely made, not to mention, quite heavy.
Holding it in his hand, he weighed it for a moment, almost as heavy as his car keys!
But this was merely a VIP membership card after all, it really cost a pretty penny!
However, thinking it over, it made sense; after all, having spent nine hundred million, if the company didn't spend tens of thousands to make a VIP card that could stand to be seen, wouldn't it be too stingy?!
Lin Yi did some quick calculations on his fingers and estimated that just during his wife's postpartum confinement period, the rewards he had received were already around thirty million. And if you added the rewards from before the wife gave birth, it would be at least forty million by now, right?
His calculations accounted just for cash and did not consider the shares he'd received, since he had no intention of selling his shares in the near future.
Firstly, the mother and baby industry was trending well, the whole sector was on the rise, and he owned as much as ten percent of the shares. Every year he would receive an end-of-year bonus from the company. With this in mind, just the dividends alone should bring in a hefty sum, possibly even seventy or eighty million – no problem!
There were probably not many industries that could boast such good returns nowadays!
Lin Yi wondered when the end-of-year bonus would be deposited in his account, and planned to ask the system later to confirm the timing.
At this moment, Han Xuewei had already taken the baby into the nursery, and Lin Yi, while thinking about the good news, continued eating his meal.
When Han Xuewei came in and saw Lin Yi with a smile on his face, she couldn't help but smile and ask, "What are you thinking about? You're laughing sneakily! Did something good happen?"
Lin Yi quickly replied, "I have a gift for you!"
No sooner had he spoken than he pulled the "True Love" VIP card from his pocket. It had to be said, this pure gold card already qualified as a super VIP.
He handed the card to Han Xuewei and said with a smile, "Let's find a time to give it a try! See if there's a style that suits us. We'll need it for the wedding. What others have, we should not lack – and we should have even better! It's time to discuss wedding arrangements. I promise to give you a grand wedding that will make you the most cherished bride in the world!"
Looking at the card, Han Xuewei didn't know it was made of pure gold, but when she heard they were going to plan the wedding, she quickly agreed, "Okay, I want my mom to come with me. Let's go pick it out when she's free this Sunday!"
Han Xuewei knew her mother would definitely be selecting a dowry for her, so she wanted to bring her mother along to check it out.
Lin Yi said with a smile, "Then it's settled."
The couple continued to chat and began to have their lunch together.

chapters.title: Chapter 66: 66: Company Dividends
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei, upon seeing the baby's used diaper, immediately remembered that some items were running low and hastily said, "Honey, we're almost out of medium-sized diapers and there's only one box of formula left. Let's find some time to buy more."
Lin Yi nodded and replied, "Let's buy them today, though it might be a bit late. This afternoon, I'm taking the dads to pick out an RV, since the need to take the baby out is becoming more urgent."
"Well, it's not that urgent, it doesn't have to be today. We can just take some time in the next couple of days to stock up," Han Xuewei said.
Lin Yi was relieved to hear this. Thankfully, he had kept the contact information of that sales clerk from last time, so he could just ask her to deliver what they needed again.
Lin Yi nodded, "Yeah, once the RV is ready, traveling anywhere with the whole family will be much more convenient!"
After hearing this, Han Xuewei smiled and picked up a piece of meat from her bowl and gave it to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi saw his wife putting food on his plate and hurriedly stretched out his mouth, biting down on her chopsticks. After eating, he even blew a kiss. If it weren't for the grease on his mouth, he would have been all over her by now, wouldn't he?!
His wife's move made Han Xuewei laugh as well, and Lin Yi also picked up a piece of lean meat from his bowl and fed it to his wife.
Han Xuewei felt a bit shy, but she still ate the piece of meat.
For a while, the two of them found joy in feeding each other, turning a meal that could've been finished in ten minutes into a half-hour affair.
After finishing the meal, Lin Yi started to go downstairs to wash the dishes, but just then, his phone received a text message.
Since he was busy with the dishes, he didn't have time to check the message, but Aunt Wang came over to help, so he wiped his hands and took out his phone.
As soon as he saw the message, Lin Yi couldn't help but get a huge shock.
His heart started racing faster and faster, feeling like it was about to jump out of his chest!
Lin Yi stared in disbelief at the text message, his eyes almost popping out of his head!
The message was from the bank, concerning a deposit that had been made. It clearly indicated that the payer was the "Fuwawa Baby Products Company"!
Looking at the string of digits, Lin Yi began to count.
"One, ten, hundred... hundred thousand, million!"
A total of ninety-seven million had been credited!
Good heavens! To have that much money?!?
Lin Yi's eyes widened in disbelief. If he remembered correctly, the dividends from this company were distributed quarterly, and shareholders could receive a payout every six months.
This was just half of it! There was almost an equal amount of dividends to come in the second half of the year!
With only ten percent of the shares in his hands, he hadn't expected to receive such a considerable dividend. The profits of the baby product industry were unimaginable!
Moreover, now that the two-child policy is completely relaxed, and people's living conditions have improved a lot compared to before, who wouldn't want to buy good things for their baby?
Whether it's the daily milk powder or complementary foods, you have to choose the healthy ones that are suitable for the baby's physical development. Not to mention the things they use, from the baby's toys to water bottles and utensils, even the diaper needs to be of better quality! There is no doubt about that!
After all, times are progressing!
Free-range parenting is so last century, nowadays, every family's baby is precious, aren't they all spoiled by two generations?
As a result, the maternal and child industry is becoming more and more profitable, so there are noticeably more maternity and baby stores on the streets.
Lin Yi looked at the text messages on his phone and couldn't help but giggle, at a loss for a moment.
Just then, Lin Yi's dad came out to pour tea and, seeing his son standing at the kitchen door laughing like that, he casually asked, "What's got you so happy? It's the first time I've seen you laugh like this."
Lin Yi hurriedly showed his dad the text message, excitedly saying, "Dad, look how many zeros there are! Just receiving this much in dividends for ten percent of the shares for this quarter, and the second half of the year is definitely only going to bring more! I never thought it would be so much!"
Lin Yi's dad took the phone, counted the zeros, and was also somewhat astonished.
"Based on this, the dividends you'll get in two years could catch up to the market value of my company! Just the other day your mom was nagging at my side, saying you made an investment and now you have made money, and in the future, we won't have to worry about you. I didn't take it seriously, thinking she was exaggerating. But I never expected, your quarterly dividend would be so substantial!"
"Indeed my son! Each generation gets stronger than the last, well done, well done!" Lin Yi's dad patted his shoulder and spoke earnestly.
He had never thought that one day his son would achieve such great success. He had full confidence in his son's abilities. He was equally comforted, it seemed he could finally rest easy leaving the company in his hands to manage.
The scale of his own company was not very large, during its most brilliant time, the market value nearly broke one billion, but these past two years the industry has been sluggish, and the company experienced losses, with market value halved, leading to rumors in the industry that the Lin Family's business might be on the verge of bankruptcy.
But looking now, it seems the blue is outshining the indigo. His era had passed, but his son was still very promising! The future belongs to the young, and he feels pride in having such a son!
What he hopes for now is that his son can take the company he founded and grow it further, for the son to continue the father's legacy, and create an even better future!
At this time, Lin Yi quickly said, "Dad, Mom mentioned that the relocation has been quite costly these days. I'll transfer a sum over right now for you to use, and if it's not enough, just let me know."
Lin Yi's dad quickly shook his head after hearing this, "No, no, no, keep the money you've earned for yourself, you will have many more expenses in the future, your dad can get by for now."
Although Lin Yi's dad said this, they had only prepared five million for their son's marriage. If the company's development continued as before, the wedding gift could possibly have reached hundreds of millions.
Lin Yi's dad may not yet know that his son has given his daughter-in-law a villa. If he knew that his son could afford a 900-square-meter villa in the city center, he would certainly be shocked!
They, as a couple, had once planned to buy a five-bedroom, two-living-room house for their son as a wedding home, but plans don't always keep up with changes. They did not expect their son to marry so early, nor did they foresee the company's development slump in these two years.
If Lin Yi hadn't made it clear that he had bought a villa already for the wedding home, they probably would have had to borrow money even for the down payment on the son's house!
But after hearing his dad's words, Lin Yi just smiled lightly and continued, "Dad, you don't have to be polite with me, this is just a token of my feelings, and you can rest assured with the money. Plus, you know my financial situation, I have more than enough to spare right now. "

chapters.title: Chapter 67: 67 Repurchase
chapters.content:
As the father and son were still talking, Lin Yi's mother came over.
"What's the matter? I heard you two arguing from the second floor. Don't wake the babies; their sleep is so light," Lin Yi's mother said as she came down.
Lin Yi said, "Mom, I wanted to transfer some money to Dad, but he just won't accept it."
When Lin Yi's mother heard this, she quickly asked in response, "Oh, making big money again, son?"
It was the first time she had ever seen the father and son disagree about money. And it was about the son wanting to give his father money, and the father refusing to take it.
After hearing about it, Lin Yi's mother also smiled, but deep down she was very comforted. Her son had finally grown up, not only making big money but also understanding the importance of filial piety.
Lin Yi quickly showed his mother the text message on his phone, hastily explaining, "Mom, this is the quarterly bonus from the company, paid out twice a year, and this time it's ninety-five million! I wanted to give Dad ten million to use for emergencies. That's reasonable, right?"
"Besides, all three babies are so young, they don't need much money right now, so is it okay to transfer some to Dad?"
When Lin Yi's mother saw the huge amount in the text message, she too was very surprised and exclaimed, "So much money? Son, is your company really doing that well? To have such a large quarterly bonus! Listen, Mr. Lin, our son is capable now and he wants to express his filial piety, so just accept the money. What's there to refuse?"
It was only when Lin Yi's mother heard this that she realized her son had received his company's quarterly bonus and was giving his father a sum of money; of course she was happy as a mother.
The next second, Lin Yi continued, "Mom, let me also send you some money. You've been working hard these days. You must accept this ten million."
Without a second word, Lin Yi immediately transferred another sum to his mother.
Since WeChat transfers couldn't handle such a large amount as ten million in one go, it had to be split into several transactions. Lin Yi made sure his parents clicked through each transfer, confirming that they received the money before he relaxed.
With ten million each for both parents, that should be enough.
Next, Lin Yi sent a WeChat message to his wife, saying he didn't have her parents' bank account details, and wanted to give the two elders and her some living expenses, so he transferred it all to her in one go and asked Han Xuewei to distribute it to them.
However, he didn't specify how much in the WeChat message. Moments later, Han Xuewei received a transfer notification, the money going straight into her bank account!
It was a full thirty million!!!
Han Xuewei was stunned when she saw the amount!
She was still in shock even after her phone screen turned off.
She quickly sent a text to Lin Yi, "Honey, why did you send so much money all at once?"
Lin Yi immediately took a screenshot of the text message he had received and sent it to Han Xuewei, then added, "Wife, the company just handed out a quarterly bonus, so I wanted to reward you guys a bit."
After learning where the money came from, Han Xuewei finally relaxed and replied with a happy emoji, "Love you, husband, thank you!"
Lin Yi replied with a mischievous emoji, "Need a kiss!"
Upon seeing the emoji, Han Xuewei couldn't help but blush, but she also replied with a very cute "muah" emoji.
Lin Yi didn't let it rest and continued, "I need a real kiss..."
Han Xuewei didn't know how to respond for a while, and after a long time, she finally sent, "Then tonight..."
Seeing his wife's message, Lin Yi immediately felt energized, as if he had boundless energy within him!
Ever since his wife was pregnant until she gave birth and now having completed her confinement period, Lin Yi was constantly concerned and caring for her, afraid that she would feel insecure.
After all, they didn't have the opportunity to cultivate their feelings before marriage, and now that they were truly in love, he wanted to be the best protector. For so long, Lin Yi had been holding back his expression of love for Han Xuewei, even avoiding quick kisses, for fear of going too far.
Anyway, one must always be careful in everything.
Remembering the matter of the baby formula and diapers, Lin Yi quickly took out his phone and called the number of the female shop assistant who had made the delivery.
"Hello, this is Lin Yi, yes, the one who asked you to deliver the other day. I need more of the same formula and diapers, but what about this afternoon?"
After hearing this, the shop assistant immediately replied, "I'm really sorry, Mr. Lin, the items you need are currently out of stock, but we should be able to restock by tonight. I can deliver them to you before nine o'clock tonight."
"That will be perfect. I'm going out this afternoon, so when the goods arrive, just bring them over then! By the way, does your store carry calcium supplements for the baby and the mother? The doctor said our baby needs calcium," Lin Yi added.
The shop assistant immediately said, "We have it, and this type of milk calcium has been a best-seller for a long time. It's imported from Europe and is suitable for both baby and mother."
"What's the price?"
The shop assistant replied, "Each bottle is 199 yuan, containing 120 pills. Would you like some?"
"Then let's start with four bottles."
"Alright, Mr. Lin, how many boxes of the formula would you like delivered today? How many of both the medium and large size diapers do you need?" the shop assistant asked.
Lin Yi pondered for a moment, then said, "The baby's weight has been increasing quickly these last few days, and he's consuming a lot of formula, so this time bring three more boxes of formula. For the diapers, take three more packs of each size than last time."
Lin Yi knew the shop assistant would probably need to take a taxi to deliver these items, which wouldn't be especially convenient, otherwise he would have asked for even more!
"Hearing you say that, it seems the baby has a great appetite! So, he will grow even faster," the shop assistant said.
"I think so too. In a little while, we won't be able to use the medium size anymore, and all three babies will probably need the large size!" Lin Yi said.
Upon hearing this, the shop assistant also became interested, "You have three babies! That's really fortunate. Are they all boys or girls?"
The shop assistant wondered to herself, usually, in wealthy families, they hope to have a son to inherit the family legacy. But having several children wouldn't matter either, as they could afford it.
For such families, raising children was never about money, but whether they were willing or not.

chapters.title: Chapter 68: 68 The Bonus for Aunt Wang
chapters.content:
Lin Yi replied with a smile, "Three babies, two boys, one girl, and the girl is the youngest."
Upon hearing this, the female clerk excitedly said again, "Wow! Mr. Lin, you really are blessed! To have triplet babies and both sons and a daughter, anyone who hears this would be envious!"
Lin Yi politely responded, "Mmm, thank you. Did you get everything I need written down?"
The clerk promptly answered, "Everything is noted down. Is there anything else you require?"
Lin Yi caught a glimpse of the bottles in the sterilizer cabinet and said, "I could use some suitable nipples. Six would be enough."
