The clerk noted it down on the paper beside her and said while writing, "The better nipples here are thirty yuan each, and they are durable even when the babies start teething."
Lin Yi said, "Then I'll take those ones! I need to go out for a moment, just contact me after you've delivered them."
The clerk hurriedly replied, "Of course, happy shopping."
Lin Yi hung up and then set out to choose a motorhome with his dad and father-in-law.
However, at this moment, his father-in-law hurriedly said to him.
"Oh Lin Yi, why did you transfer so much money all at once? We really can't accept this."
Looking at his father-in-law so agitated and insisting on returning the money to him, Lin Yi was very calm as he said, "I sent this money to Vivi. It's for her to allocate. If you truly don't want it, just return it directly to Vivi."
This move by Lin Yi was indeed savvy, putting the responsibility squarely on Han Xuewei, indicating that the money was now hers, and that how she chose to use it was her prerogative. He wouldn't interfere or have a say in it.
The situation had turned into their daughter showing filial respect to her parents, leaving Lin Yi's father-in-law speechless, though he still insisted on giving the money back.
Lin Yi added, "Dad, you should keep the money. No matter what, it's a token of your daughter's affection, and besides, I've also transferred some to my own parents. If my mom and dad have theirs, then my wife's parents should too, right?"
"Ah? Both Vivi's mom and I have it? You transferred it to the both of us?" Surprise was written all over Han Xuewei's father's face.
After all, the profits from the company he ran were only a few million per year, occasionally hitting ten million in a good year. But he hadn't expected Lin Yi to just send ten million to each member of his family of three. Wasn't that a bit too much?
Even going as far as to call it pocket money!
Han Xuewei's mother, who had been playing with her phone in her room, suddenly received a message about the money transfer from her daughter. After running to her daughter to ask about it and learning it was Lin Yi's idea, she hurried downstairs looking for him.
Upon exiting the room, she happened to see her husband talking with Lin Yi in the living room and quickly approached to inquire.
"Lin Yi, you transferred a lot of money, didn't you? We really don't need it, you should take it back!"
Han Xuewei's father also added, "Our son-in-law transferred thirty million to Vivi in one go and told her to share it with the three of us. We really can't accept this money, how can we take our child's money?"
Lin Yi helplessly spread his hands, and his father quickly stepped in to help out, "Don't be shy, it's all the kid's good intentions. This boy has earned quite a bit of money this year!"
"The company just distributed a dividend today, ninety-five million, and that's only the quarterly dividend. There will be another one in the second half of the year. Dear in-laws, please rest assured, from what Lin Yi means, all four of us as the elders have a share.
So just accept it, and even if we don't use it ourselves, buying some things for the grandchildren occasionally isn't out of the question, right?"
Hearing what Lin Yi's father had said, Han Xuewei's parents also had no choice but to accept the money. Although they felt somewhat embarrassed, the father-in-law had spoken up, and it would seem quite inappropriate to refuse.
"Now that you've put it that way, it's really difficult for us to refuse. We won't squander the money; it will eventually end up in the hands of our precious grandchildren sooner or later."
Lin Yi hastily said, "Dad, you really shouldn't do that! You should use the money I gave you, don't hesitate to spend it, especially since I'll make even more money in the future! Vivi is your only daughter, and I will always treat you two like my own parents. So you and my mother-in-law are also my parents, and we, as one big family, absolutely shouldn't split things so distinctly.
When I make money, the whole family makes money, so how can I differentiate between you and my mother-in-law? Right?"
"Oh my, I have to say, dear in-law, Lin Yi is really filial! You've done well in raising him; he is both capable and sensible," praised Han Xuewei's mother generously.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi was calculating something else: he needed to talk to Aunt Wang later and give her a raise, and absolutely give her a big bonus!
Aunt Wang had been taking care of him since he was little, and of course, he took her many years of hard work to heart. Now, with three babies of his own, Aunt Wang rarely got a good night's sleep, and her efforts were not insignificant.
Before Lin Yi left with the two fathers, he had a private chat with Aunt Wang, telling her that he would increase her salary next month by at least double, and he also transferred a bonus of fifty thousand yuan to her then and there as a token of appreciation.
Aunt Wang was quite happy to hear about the salary increase, but she initially refused the money no matter what. After much persuasion from Lin Yi, who claimed that the company he invested in had distributed dividends, she finally accepted it.
"Lin Yi has grown up; he's even more impressive than your dad!" Aunt Wang had watched him grow up, and she was, of course, immensely gratified.
For many years, Aunt Wang's salary had always been directly transferred by Lin Yi's mother, totaling more than nine thousand each month. Lin Yi told her that starting next month, he would be handling the transfers himself, amounting to nineteen thousand a month, which of course included holiday allowances, year-end bonuses, and the like.
After giving instructions to Aunt Wang, Lin Yi quickly took the two fathers out the door and drove his Land Rover Range Rover to a big car dealership.
This dealership was the same one where he had purchased three cars in one transaction previously. The staff member standing at the entrance recognized Lin Yi immediately and hurried over to greet him without a second word.
After all, Lin Yi's face was one he could never forget!
"Oh! You're here? Mr. Lin!" The staff member greeted with a smile, "We've just gotten a batch of fine tea leaves, quickly brew some for Mr. Lin."
He instructed a younger staff member next to him.
While talking, he cheerfully invited the two men following Lin Yi.
"Ah, these must be the uncles, right? Please, directly into the VIP room, welcome, welcome."

chapters.title: Chapter 69: 69 Choosing a Motorhome
chapters.content:
Lin Yi said to the sales assistant, "These two are my dad and father-in-law. We mainly want to pick an RV because we have quite a few family members, so functionality will do."
"Of course, of course! Our dealership has a wide variety of models, and we'll make sure you find one that satisfies you!" The assistant led the three men to the VIP room and served them tea.
"The price of an RV will definitely be higher, Mr. Lin, do you have a budget? Or were there any specific models you had in mind in advance?" the sales assistant inquired.
"We haven't set a budget and haven't looked at any models in advance. Let's just see what's available today! If we find the right one, we won't care about the price," Lin Yi said with great confidence, obviously a man of means.
Lin Yi's dad also added, "The most important thing is that it has to be suitable. It might take us a while to choose, does your dealership have the RVs in stock?"
The assistant quickly replied, "We do have RVs in stock! We're one of the top three largest dealerships in Xiangcheng, with a significant inventory! If you find the right one, taking it home today won't be a problem at all! Let me take you all to have a closer look at the RV interiors!"
The assistant made a point to wait until the three valued customers had finished their tea before standing up to lead them to the showroom.
"We have a great variety of brands here too. Do you have a particular brand in mind? Whether it's Hyundai, Ford, SAIC, or others, it's no issue. We carry over a dozen brands!"
Lin Yi's dad responded, "Let's start by looking at the SAIC ones. Then we can see how the Hyundai models are, and I've heard good things about Geely as well."
After hearing this, Lin Yi also said to the assistant, "After looking at those three brands, let's take a look at Mercedes! After all, with a name like that, nobody would believe they're not up to par."
The assistant perked up upon hearing this, "Mr. Lin, if you're really considering the Mercedes brand, why don't we head over to look at those models now? Our dealership only has one model of Mercedes RV, so after you've seen that, we can look at other brands."
"Alright, let's start with Mercedes then," both elders agreed.
And so, they walked towards the Mercedes section, passing by other brand-specific areas, and saw a variety of RVs, some compact, and some incredibly large, just like buses.
"The interiors of these larger RVs must be very spacious, but they seem a bit too big; driving and finding parking spaces would be inconvenient," Han Xuewei's dad commented upon seeing the larger RVs.
Lin Yi's dad also added, "Such a large vehicle isn't quite right for us. We're buying an RV for convenience. Our baby is still small and we can't go far, just around the city area. So, something this large and bulky doesn't make much sense."
Lin Yi nodded in agreement, "Yeah, I had also considered this type, but in the end, I thought it would be better to wait until the kids are older and we go on family trips. Then we could sell the old one and get something bigger, more spacious for the whole family. For now, when choosing a model, we should aim for practicality! After all, we won't drive it all the time."
The assistant started to give an introduction, "Let me give you all a brief overview! We have all sorts of RVs here in our dealership."
"These RVs to our left are the economical models, very popular among the younger crowd for traveling, and they're quite affordable too, costing less than 400,000 yuan to drive off the lot."
"And these RVs are not too bulky, maximizing the use of space. Small but complete, you know. Although they're about the same size, some have two beds, some only one, and the number of seats also varies, so it's up to you to decide what you prefer!"
After listening, Lin Yi's dad nodded and said, "We hope for more seats, as it's certainly more secure to sit holding the baby."
"Yes, I agree with that," Han Xue's dad also nodded in approval.
"As for the size, it would be nice if it's slightly bigger than an ambulance and, of course, it needs to be comfortable," Lin Yi added.
After looking around with the sales assistant for quite some time, they found that all the RVs were bigger than they expected.
Money was no object for them; what they truly wanted was practicality.
After touring with the assistant and trying out various classic models, Lin Yi still hadn't found one to his satisfaction.
Some were the right size but had an interior layout he didn't like, or the inside was too low. In short, after looking for a long time, not one of the models caught their eye.
Ever since Han Xue's dad started receiving pocket money from his son-in-law, he had begun to pursue quality and practicality, not caring about the price at all! After all, the money was spent on the family, so naturally, he wanted something better.
"This model is by Geely, unlike other RVs, as it's a new energy vehicle. However, it is slightly longer, which makes finding a parking spot difficult, almost impossible on the side of the road," the assistant explained.
"But just so you know, many RVs have long bodies, which is something you should consider."
"This Ford T is relatively smaller in size, but still takes up an entire parking space. If the space is small, it's not easy to park. Would you consider a business vehicle?" the assistant turned and inquired.
"We've discussed this before we came out; we don't really want a business vehicle, because of the baby."
The reason they chose an RV was that it's convenient when out and about to feed the baby, and even making up a bottle of milk is very easy. Even folding three strollers is not an issue, and when the baby grows up and needs more stuff, the RV has enough room to accommodate everything.
The family had already made plans, and both fathers agreed.
"So, are we still interested in the Mercedes, or shall we go directly to the Ford?" the assistant turned and asked.
"Your dealership has the cars in stock, right? Can we drive one home today?" Han Xuewei's dad suddenly asked.
"Yes, we can complete the paperwork in under ten minutes, and after payment, you can take the car," the assistant answered with a standard smile, very respectfully.
Last time, Lin Yi bought three cars in one go, shooting his sales for the day up to several million! He also won the sales champion of the month!
And from today's situation, he had to sell an RV, no matter what. Since the commission on RVs was high and these customers were not short of money, he might as well try to sell them something a bit more expensive!

chapters.title: Chapter 70: 70 Mercedes-Benz C-Class
chapters.content:
```
No matter whether he sold a Ford or a Mercedes, he could earn a commission of tens of thousands! So the more expensive the car they bought, the better!
"May I take you to see the Model B RV? The space is sufficient and the performance is quite good, would you consider it?"
It was at this moment that Lin Yi's father and Han Xuewei's dad started discussing.
"We've been looking so long, it seems all these RVs are about the same; there's not much difference. Should we just go for the most expensive one?"
"Yes, I feel the same way. After all, we're not concerned about the price, the more expensive ones must have better performance. Otherwise, a bunch of small issues might crop up, and we better choose quickly and head home to see the kids. I have to go back to the company tomorrow, I don't know when I will see these three little ones again."
"Haha, I'm also eager to get home to spend time with my grandkids. I'll be very busy in the next few days."
Hearing the two fathers talk, Lin Yi immediately understood their thoughts. He had originally thought that these two would try out various models and select carefully. Lin Yi did not expect them to be so eager to get home to the kids!
But their thinking was correct, continuing like this was not the solution. Although they had already been looking for quite some time, they had not covered even half of this dealership! It must be said that the dealer's owner was really impressive, rightfully one of the top dealerships!
Upon hearing the conversation of the two fathers behind, the salesperson couldn't be happier. The more expensive the purchase, the higher his commission!
Lin Yi, seeing the two who were so intent on getting home to the children, turned to the salesperson and said, "You know our requirements for choosing a car, so you recommend one! The price should be higher, assuring quality and comfort, and take us to see it now; I'm a bit busy."
"Sure, sure, leave it to me, please rest assured. Let's have a look at the Mercedes models now! The Model C RV, its performance is all OK."
The salesperson couldn't help but quicken his pace, leading them through numerous RVs, finally stopping in front of that particular model.
He briskly stepped forward to pull open the car door and began to introduce it skillfully.
"Listening to your needs, personally, I think the Model C RV is indeed a good choice. Especially this Sprinter, whether for family use or business purposes, there are no problems! The chassis of this vehicle is lower, giving a very prestigious appearance, and the power is also substantial, don't worry about the performance at all!
After all, the Mercedes brand speaks for itself, both external and internal are nearly perfect!"
"Since you are mainly buying the vehicle for family use, the equipped air conditioning, refrigerator, water heater are all imported and are assured in terms of quality, likewise symbolizing the owner's status!"
"The three of you can take a seat and feel it for yourself, every inch of the leather is very comfortable!"
The salesperson hastily invited Lin Yi and the two fathers to board the vehicle and experience the interior furnishings. Visit m,v le,mpyr today
"The doors of this RV are quite luxurious, featuring mosquito bite prevention technology and are also very durable."
"This RV is positioned as a high-end model, mainly for business use, so on top of being comfortable, the luxury factor has been elevated. The sofa is made of genuine leather, and the floors are of the same type used in high-end yachts. It offers an elegant environment while also ensuring your travel is more pleasant!"
"We can have a close feel of this leather sofa now; the touch is very substantial and even if the elderly have uncomfortable backs, they will not feel discomfort when sitting on it. Plus, it's very breathable, and since the table is height-adjustable, the space inside is also quite large. If the beds are not enough, you can lay another bed here!"
After listening to the introduction, Lin Yi's father and Han Xuewei's father expressed satisfaction, and Lin Yi himself also thought it to be quite nice after hearing the introduction.
"We've designed a charging port here; you can connect a power strip, you have a baby already, right? The vehicle has a built-in induction cooker, which is very convenient for heating milk for the baby when traveling. And it doesn't affect the space at all; the fridge also has a capacity of 200 liters, quite large but not energy-consuming, the battery is very energy-efficient!"
"By pulling down the back of the sofa, there's a storage box which can also serve as a sterilizing cabinet, offering a great sense of space."
The salesperson became quite talkative, and then led them into the driver's cabin.
"The driver's seat is also very comfortable and breathable, and offers a broad view while driving. The overall color palette is soft and exudes a feeling of elegance and grandeur!"
Han Xuewei's father nodded after hearing this, adding, "It seems you're quite familiar with your business. Nicely explained!"
Lin Yi's father also commented, "You explained everything in detail; we listened with clarity."
The salesman responded modestly, "You're too kind, Uncle. This is all part of my job."
"Lin Yi, what do you think about this car?" Lin Yi's father suddenly asked his opinion.
"It looks pretty good, the interior seems very high-end as well." Lin Yi looked around and spoke slowly.
"This spot is very comfortable to sit in; it's my favorite part!" Lin Yi's father said as he sat on the sofa, "I've already figured it out; I'll just sit right here. The dinette can be lowered, and the overall space is quite spacious! Very nice."
Han Xuewei's father added, "Yes, I also think this design is very good, and this is an advantage not found in other RVs."
It had to be said, the more Han Xuewei's father looked at the vehicle, the more he liked it.
Hearing their opinions, Lin Yi naturally had nothing else to say, so he turned to the salesperson and stated, "We'll take this one! I also think it's very nice."
"By the way, Dad, should I take a photo and send it to the family group chat? Let Vivi and Mom, Mother-in-law have a look, see what they think?"
"Alright, alright, you guys sit there; I'll take a photo, it's more referential this way." Lin Yi's dad took out his phone, snapping photos of every area, not missing any detail.
Han Xuewei's father, playing the role of a tour guide, even spoke directly in the chat about the advantages of this vehicle.
Just like that, the family chatted excitedly in the group chat.
After some discussion, everyone felt that the RV was very good, so Lin Yi followed the salesperson to start the paperwork.
He still enjoyed the usual discount; the total price of the vehicle was 1.6 million.
The paperwork took a long time, with signing and various tedious processes involved. Lin Yi's father and Han Xuewei's father sat in the VIP lounge waiting patiently.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 71: 71: Acquiring a Plot of Land
chapters.content:
So they waited for about ten minutes before the two elders began to grow impatient, "Lin Yi, why don't you go ahead and complete the paperwork? When you're done, you can drive the RV back. Xue Mei and I are heading home to spend some more time with the baby before I have to return to the office."
Seeing how these two were constantly preoccupied with their grandson and granddaughter, Lin Yi could only agree, "Alright, then you two take my car home first. I'll come back as soon as I finish the paperwork."
After Lin Yi finished speaking, he handed the car keys to his dad and had the staff escort the two of them out.
With plenty of time on his hands, Lin Yi had the staff give him a detailed explanation of the vehicle's operating system. They were quite enthusiastic, even going through the manual button by button.
Lin Yi activated his photographic memory skill and firmly memorized all the operations.
After that, the familiar notification sounded in his mind!
"Ding! Congratulations, Host, for acquiring a new skill for the babies! You have received a hidden reward!"
"The reward is 1,800 square meters of land in the city center. The area is well-equipped with nearby facilities."
Lin Yi was startled upon hearing this and immediately asked, "Are you talking about land in the city center? The reward is a plot of land! And it's 1,800 square meters at that! This reward is completely unfounded! Could it be random? Could learning one skill really come with such a huge reward?"
"Replying to the Host, each reward is randomly selected by the system."
Lin Yi was instantly dumbfounded! He was completely overwhelmed!
No wonder! He had long noticed that the rewards he received were always unpredictable, sometimes gaining great rewards for a trivial action!
Lin Yi, very excited inside, drove the newly purchased RV home. By the time he arrived, it was already evening, close to dinner time.
He parked the vehicle in the garage, and the whole family immediately came to take a look, entering the RV to admire it.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi took the opportunity to grab Han Xuewei's slender hand and whispered, "You promised me today that tonight..."
Han Xuewei's face turned red immediately, and she playfully scolded him, "Oh, stop it..."
Her coy voice made Lin Yi's heart unable to calm down for a long time.
The family admired the vehicle for quite a while and unanimously expressed their satisfaction. Lin Yi then made dinner for everyone to celebrate the new acquisition.
After they finished eating, Lin Yi contacted the female sales associate.
"Hello, you have all the items I need in stock, right?"
The sales associate on the other end sounded very busy, with Lin Yi hearing a noisy background before she hurriedly responded, "We've already packed everything and will deliver it to your house right away!"
"Okay, great."
After helping Aunt Wang with the dishes, Lin Yi received a call from the sales associate, informing him that all the baby products were delivered to the front door.
At the same time, he also received the baby walkers.
Two in blue and one in pink.
"Mr. Lin, these are gifts for the babies, specially instructed by our store manager as a thank you for your long-term support of our store."
By the time Lin Yi got to the front door, several boxes of formula and many bags of diapers were neatly placed at the entrance.
And unlike before, this time the driver also got out of the car to help move things.
Seeing the color of the baby walker, Lin Yi felt that the store manager was quite attentive.
Lin Yi accepted the gift and said very politely, "Your company is really too kind, thank you so much! Just leave the things at the door; I can move them myself!"
Lin Yi saw that the female clerk wanted to help him move the things inside, so he kindly refused.
Actually, he was quite particular about letting others into his home, and besides, there weren't many items; he could completely handle them on his own.
After the clerk heard this, she quickly agreed and then said to the driver, "Honey, there's no need to move them upstairs then."
It dawned on Lin Yi that these two people were a couple. It seemed that the female clerk had learned her lesson, grown wiser; if the driver she called last time wouldn't help, then she had to get her own husband to step in.
After asking about the price, Lin Yi transferred some money as usual, and still, as always, sent a few hundred more.
The clerk thanked him very politely, then left with her husband.
Lin Yi moved the items one by one to the storeroom. At this time, Lin Yi's dad and Dad Han were taking care of the baby in the nursery!
After all, they would leave early the next morning, feeling somewhat reluctant to part with their dear grandson and granddaughter.
Lin Yi finally moved everything to the storeroom and then returned to the bedroom.
He said to Han Xuewei, "Vivi, I have a big surprise for you! Let's go have a look in a bit!"
"Ah? What kind of surprise? Didn't you just give me a gift not long ago? And you already sent so much money, I really don't need anything else."
"Oh come on, just go out with me for a bit. Walk with me, it's just a little surprise. Also, make sure to bring the card I gave you last time."
Lin Yi actually wasn't clear about what kind of jewelry the brand called "True Love" had sent, so he just told his wife it was a little surprise.
"Well... I'll go with you then. Fortunately, I had a good rest at noon, so I feel quite energized. I'll go upstairs and get dressed, then we can go out together."
After finishing up what she was doing, Han Xuewei got up and went upstairs to the walk-in closet.
But after trying on clothes for quite a while, she found she nearly had no suitable clothing left! It turned out that her figure had changed during pregnancy, and now there were almost no suitable clothes for going out, except for maternity wear.
Lin Yi waited outside for quite a while, and seeing that his wife hadn't come out yet, he gently knocked on the door and asked, "Vivi, are you done changing?"
Han Xuewei, feeling quite embarrassed after hearing her husband's prompting, replied, "I can't fit into many clothes anymore, especially pants. I can't squeeze into them; now I can only wear maternity outfits."
Han Xuewei couldn't help but remember how she weighed less than 100 pounds before her pregnancy! Now that her figure had changed like this, what was she to do?
"Ah, I've been negligent, overlooking this. Since we're going out today, let's buy you more clothes. I haven't gone shopping with you in a long time. Make sure to buy anything you like, okay?"
Han Xuewei softly hummed an affirmation from inside, then changed into a piece of maternity wear.
With that, Lin Yi also noticed the changes in his wife's figure.
Before the pregnancy, Han Xuewei was known as the school beauty not only because of her good looks but also her impeccable figure!
She was 167cm tall, but her weight was less than 100 pounds, a truly enviable figure!

chapters.title: Chapter 72: 72: Super VIP Membership Card
chapters.content:
```
But now, her chest and hips had obviously grown a lot, and her face also seemed fleshier than before.
"I just remembered, if we need to go out, I should pump milk in advance; otherwise, it'll be very uncomfortable after a few hours, with the milk engorgement."
Han Xuewei had already completed her confinement. He milk supply was ample, and sometimes she could satisfy both babies at once. If there was any excess milk, she had to pump it out and store it in the refrigerator.
Han Xuewei had breastfed the baby before dinner, and not much time had passed since then, but she needed to pump before leaving the house, or else she would feel engorged in another two hours, which would be very uncomfortable.
And since it would be inconvenient to pump milk while out, she had to finish all these tasks before leaving.
Lin Yi also knew that as long as the baby regularly breastfed, the milk supply would increase, but if engorgement occurred frequently, her milk supply would decrease over time.
Han Xuewei tried her best to prevent engorgement at all costs, not even once, because she wished for each baby to have breast milk every day.
Thinking of this, she quickly ran back to the room and started pumping with a breast pump.
Lin Yi found his cute wife rushing around a bit amusing, but after all, Han Xuewei was a very competent mother and truly loved their babies.
Maybe this was the essence of the saying, "Women are fragile by nature but turn strong for their children."
Lin Yi waited at the door for a while longer before he saw Han Xuewei carrying a bag of milk, which she then placed in a small refrigerator.
She quickly came out, took Lin Yi's arm, and said, "Let's hurry out. Aunt Wang can help me with the rest."
"Sure, no problem. You can just leave the breast pump out, and I'll help you wash it when we come back!"
With that, the couple informed others and then got into the car together and left.
This was the second time the two of them had gone out for shopping together since the pregnancy, spending sweet time in their own little world!
The mothers of Lin Yi and Han Xuewei saw them leave and couldn't help smiling as they both headed for the nursery. The responsibility of taking care of the grandchildren then fell on their shoulders.
The young couple was very affectionate every day, and the whole family got along harmoniously. Which parents and elders wouldn't be satisfied with such a scene?
Lin Yi drove the Range Rover and chatted with his wife about how the weight of the three babies had been increasing continuously these days.
After more than half an hour, the car slowly stopped in front of one of the most prestigious shopping centers around.
Qianda Shopping Plaza.
Han Xuewei, arm in arm with Lin Yi, walked in. They took the elevator to the second floor and headed straight for the "True Love" diamond counter.
An extremely glamorous counter attendant quickly came forward to greet Lin Yi and Han Xuewei, "Good evening, are you here to select a diamond?"
Most of the young men and women who came here were there to choose wedding rings, but this consumer group generally didn't spend more than twenty or thirty thousand on a diamond, so the sales figures weren't particularly high.
The attendant similarly had no intention of selling high-value diamonds and promptly guided them towards the lower-priced area upon greeting them.
But Lin Yi did not answer her directly. Instead, in the next second, he calmly asked Han Xuewei to show her VIP card.
When the attendant saw the glittering gold card, she was instantly flabbergasted!
```
He stood there stunned for a long time, at a loss for what to do.
Lin Yi slowly said, "I placed an order for a set of jewelry in your store previously, and I came specially today to pick it up."
The female staff member, aware of how esteemed the customer before her was, quickly took the VIP card and said with great respect, "Right away! How should I address you, sir? I will call the manager right now."
Every employee who starts working here must recognize this card on their first day!
Only the most honored VIPs can obtain this card! Moreover, this card is not obtained through application, but one must accumulate purchases amounting to six hundred million for the company to specially customize this pure gold VIP card for the customer!
Six hundred million!! What kind of concept is that?!!
Some people might not earn that much money in their entire lifetime!
So just with this dazzling golden VIP card, the counter staff was utterly dumbfounded!
Without another word, she turned and ran into the store to look for the manager!
The manager of this store, surnamed Guo, was instantly alert when she saw the dazzling golden card in the staff member's hand.
After all, throughout Xiangcheng, there must be very few people who possess this card, let alone on a national scale, possibly less than ten!
After all, those who can spend around six hundred million on diamonds and gold are incredibly wealthy magnates!
Such super-members are considered prime clients of the entire brand, and it is every manager's duty to receive them well.
So, upon seeing the gold card, Manager Guo did not dare to delay, and she came rushing over in a fluster.
She paused for a moment to adjust her appearance, then approached Lin Yi and Han Xuewei with the brand's signature smile, and warmly asked, "Good evening, how may I address the two of you?"
"My name is Lin Yi, I've ordered a full set of diamonds here before, the True Love Baby series, and I've come especially today to collect them," replied Lin Yi.
The manager was even more astonished upon hearing this, because just a few days ago, in an afternoon, the company had gathered all the managers for an important meeting.
The content of the meeting was straightforward - the True Love Baby diamond set had been purchased by a wealthy businessman at a premium price!
This wealthy businessman's name was Lin Yi!!
Looking once more at the young man before her, who claimed to be Lin Yi, along with the super VIP gold card in his hand, everything was clear, Lin Yi's status was right there before her eyes!
"Mr. Lin, I apologize for our indiscretion as this is our first meeting. Please forgive our lack of respect," said the manager.
Lin Yi indifferently replied, "It's fine."
"Thank you so much for your understanding," the manager said with a persevering smile, then asked, "Would you like to take the custom-ordered True Love Baby diamond series now? We temporarily cannot produce the diamonds you ordered at this branch, but please don't worry. We will send someone to the company's warehouse to retrieve them right now.
Please wait a moment, it will be in your hands within twenty minutes. Mr. Lin, would you be willing to wait a bit?" The manager maintained the very emblematic smile on her face throughout.
After hearing this, Lin Yi didn't react much, simply nodding faintly, "Alright then, we will take a walk nearby. I will leave my number; you can call me directly when the diamonds arrive."
He thought it would be a good opportunity to stroll in the vicinity with Han Xuewei and pick out a few fitting clothes for his wife.

chapters.title: Chapter 73: 73 The Women's Clothing Store
chapters.content:
The manager also breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing that, she had thought this VIP customer might get angry because of the long wait. But to her surprise, the young man before her was so easygoing!
Lin Yi left his mobile number, discussed the timing with the manager, then put the VIP card into his pocket, and walked out of the jewelry store with Han Xuewei. They headed towards the floor specializing in women's clothing.
They entered a very prestigious women's clothing store, where even from the outside, they could see many beautifully designed garments.
All of the clothing in this store was the work of a domestically well-known designer, and Han Xuewei was deeply attracted to the clothes here.
Because, compared to the styles commonly seen on the streets, every piece of clothing in this store was handmade and required customization! While ensuring quality, this also ensured that each piece of clothing was unique!
It must be said, this sales method was quite distinctive.
As a result, this First Grade brand had some renown in the country, with a considerable annual sales volume.
The brand was named LZZ, after the designer Liang Zhizhong.
Lin Yi saw that Han Xuewei's attention was entirely captured, so he led his wife straight into the store to start picking out clothes.
Han Xuewei casually picked up a price tag: "Oh my God! The clothes here are so expensive! These pants alone cost two thousand five hundred!"
Pants worth over two thousand on display in the regular area, then how much must those premium suits in the luxury section cost? Although Lin Yi had given her ten million as pocket money, Han Xuewei was not the type of person to spend money like water!
The education she received also didn't allow her to do so!
Even though Han Xuewei's father was a business owner with a significant yearly income, this didn't stop him from instilling the right values in his daughter.
From a young age, the clothes Han Xuewei wore were not necessarily expensive; as long as they fit well and were comfortable, that was enough, and the most expensive would only be a few hundred yuan. Even if she had to attend events that required more formal attire, she would pick out a gown.
However, that gown cost only two or three thousand, and she had been wearing it for several years.
Many girls spend a lot on their clothes, even competing with others, but Han Xuewei was not such a girl.
Although she had delicate features and a good figure, widely recognized as the school beauty, she did not like to mingle too much with those girls who wore heavy makeup.
So much so that many classmates thought Han Xuewei was very unusual, or rather, had the image of a high-and-mighty goddess.
At this moment, Han Xuewei looked at the price tag on the pants and started to feel conflicted. She admitted that she liked the cut of the pants, but spending so much on a single pair didn't seem worth it to her.
In fact, Han Xuewei was not very familiar with this brand; it seemed niche to her, so she thought the clothing would be moderately priced. Even if it were more expensive, it couldn't be pricier than those branded fashion stores, right?
But the reality was not as she expected; the price of a pair of pants made her hesitant.
Indeed, Lin Yi was very wealthy, and a couple thousand was nothing to him, but Han Xuewei just couldn't persuade herself to spend that much on a pair of pants.
Lin Yi saw his wife eyeing these pants for a long time, occasionally checking the price tag; he could guess what she was thinking.
It seemed she must have found the price unreasonable and thought the pants weren't worth it.
Then, Lin Yi said to Han Xuewei, "Wife, it's been a long time since we've gone out shopping together. If you really like them, then let's buy them. You don't have much time to shop usually, so let's just go ahead and buy, okay? Don't worry about the money."
Han Xuewei turned her gaze towards him: "Ah, but I… still feel these pants are a bit too expensive, and the material doesn't seem that special…"
Lin Yi hurriedly said, "No, no, no, I think these pants look good, and they'll definitely suit you. If you think they're okay, then let's buy them. I'm willing to buy them for you! As the saying goes, 'you can't put a price on willingness'."
Han Xuewei looked at Lin Yi with a gentle gaze: "Thank you, husband; then, I'll pick what I like!"
Actually, she had thought about checking out other stores; after all, good things don't have to be expensive. But this store indeed had clothes whose styles attracted her, and since Lin Yi kept reassuring her, she changed her mind.
Actually, Lin Yi also greatly appreciated this aspect of Han Xuewei.
It's known that some women, when shopping with their partners, want to buy whatever they like without considering if the price is within their range or even sparing a thought for their partner.
Sometimes, a single shopping trip can leave the partner needing to cut corners for a long time to recover from the expenditure.
When the two entered the shop, a female sales associate quietly followed them; naturally, their conversation also reached her ears.
The sales associate thought: "Haven't sold a single item in the past two days, but this couple seems promising! Maybe they'll really buy a few pieces. If so, I'll make sure they spend a few tens of thousands more, or they won't leave so easily!"
Usual shoppers here were, of course, wealthy people, so in the sales associate's view, it was common for customers to spend tens of thousands of yuan.
However, there were also some who stumbled in by mistake; these people typically didn't recognize the high-end brand and would walk away dejectedly upon seeing the prices. To such people, the eagle-eyed sales associate could spot at a glance.
However, from her perspective, Han Xuewei seemed to be that type of customer, obviously troubled upon learning the price and even discussing it with her boyfriend.
Most of the young female customers who shopped here understood well; they never looked at prices and would pay immediately after choosing what they liked.
But Lin Yi's words instantly brightened the sales associate's mood.
He was encouraging his girlfriend not to worry about prices, to freely buy what she liked, so the sales associate could be sure that today's business was a done deal!
The sales associate approached them with a smile on her face and suddenly said, "My, you're really blessed, aren't you? Your boyfriend must love you very much!"
Lin Yi corrected her, "I'm her husband; we're already married."
The sales associate couldn't help but feel a hint of surprise. The couple was quite good-looking and seemed young, almost like students, so she assumed they were a couple in the throes of passionate love. However, to her surprise, they were actually married!

chapters.title: Chapter 74: 74: The Fitting Room Kiss
chapters.content:
However, the next second, the female clerk quickly corrected herself, "Oh, that really is congratulations, congratulations, I didn't expect you two to be so young and already have found true love! I'm really envious of you, how lucky! And this miss is both beautiful and good at running a household!"
The words spoken by the female clerk were indeed sincere, as she genuinely felt that Han Xuewei was a good girl.
After all, she had worked here for such a long time, and her judgment of people was quite accurate. Many girls as beautiful as Han Xuewei would come here, not even looking at the price tags; they'd choose clothes they liked and have their companions buy, buy, buy!
It was unexpected that these two had married so early, and that this girl would save money for her husband.
Every time Lin Yi openly said they were husband and wife, Han Xuewei's heart would feel a secret delight.
Upon hearing the praise, she smiled and nodded, expressing her thanks.
Lin Yi also nodded politely to the clerk without saying much.
The clerk started to introduce the more fashionable items in the store to Han Xuewei and, at the same time, kept praising how Han Xuewei had married a good husband who was very caring.
Throughout it all, Han Xuewei's cheeks were slightly red; although she agreed with the point, she still couldn't help but feel shy due to other people's compliments.
Lin Yi was now focused on accompanying his wife shopping, buying her clothes she liked, picking styles that suited her, and matching them with beautiful bags.
This was, after all, the first time he had come out with Han Xuewei specifically to pick clothes and bags!
In the past, their shopping mainly centered around baby stores, occasionally looking at clothes they passed by, or they were accompanied by their parents the whole time, without any space for themselves.
Today was a good opportunity to firmly remember everything his wife liked! Whether it was the brands or styles of clothes.
As they shopped, Han Xuewei looked at a dress and then turned to ask Lin Yi, "Honey, how about this one?"
Lin Yi thought the dress was quite nice, so he smiled and said, "Try it on! It looks pretty, let's see if it fits well."
Han Xuewei saw the eager expression on the clerk's face and looked at Lin Yi's eyes, so she nodded, "Then I'll give it a try."
The clerk led Han Xuewei into the fitting room and waited at the door for her to change into the dress.
Outside, Lin Yi was busy picking out a lot of clothes for Han Xuewei, all of which were in larger sizes.
It was at that moment that Han Xuewei called out from the fitting room, "Husband, can you come in now?"
Hmm? What does she need at this moment asking me to come in?
Lin Yi was also taken aback for a second.
But he couldn't hesitate as the fitting room door was slowly pushed open a crack.
Lin Yi, holding the clothes he had chosen, hurried through the door and had to admit the interior was quite spacious, fitting three or four people at a time.
As soon as he entered, he saw Han Xuewei with her back to him.
She said, "Honey, I can't zip up this dress, please help me."
Lin Yi placed the clothes Han Xuewei had picked out and the ones he had chosen for her on a bench, then went over to help.
After zipping up the dress, Han Xuewei walked to the mirror to take a look, then smiled at Lin Yi, "Wow, this dress really looks good on me, and the size I chose is just right. I purposely picked two sizes larger just now."
Sighing, she said, "I was quite slender before pregnancy, but now I need two sizes larger when buying clothes."
Lin Yi didn't say much else and instead directly embraced Han Xuewei in his arms.
"Who says you've gained weight? I think you look great like this, healthier than before, and there's more of you to hold. I like it this way, and I don't care about your looks at all, it's you I love. If you really do mind your current figure and want to get back to how you used to be, then let's go for a slimming treatment! We'll go to a good beauty salon. Postnatal recovery is definitely helpful."
Lin Yi, looking at his incredibly cute wife, continued, "Postnatal recovery was recommended by the doctor before, and it's highly encouraged for women to do it, otherwise it can greatly impact your health. Since even the doctors suggest it, let's go for it with confidence!"
Han Xuewei leaned her head on Lin Yi's shoulder and quietly said, "Okay, sure."
Lin Yi then said, "So whatever clothes you like now, I'll buy them for you. Don't worry about the price at all."
Han Xuewei nodded gently, agreeing softly.
Lin Yi was very satisfied with this response, then pointed to the clothes he had picked out and said, "These are chosen according to my taste. Try them on one by one. It won't take long, and if you like them, we'll buy them right away."
Han Xuewei stood on tiptoes and kissed Lin Yi's face, saying, "Thank you, hubby."
"What's there to thank your hubby for? Isn't this what I should be doing? Besides, isn't it my duty to love you properly?"
With that, Lin Yi took Han Xuewei's head in his hands and placed a deep kiss on her red lips, leaving a kiss mark!
They kissed for a good while in the fitting room before stopping!
And if it hadn't been for Han Xuewei being short of breath and pushing Lin Yi back, he would have been reluctant to stop!
"Oh no, that won't do, I'm out of breath, and people will come in to change soon." Han Xuewei hurriedly urged Lin Yi to wait outside.
"Okay, I'll wait for you out here. Take your time changing, no rush."
Although Lin Yi verbally agreed, he couldn't help listening for her a bit longer. Who could blame him when Han Xuewei attracted him like Magic Power in every way!
Lin Yi, looking at Han Xuewei's blushing face, smiled and said, "Once you're done changing, we can go out together."
"You've been in here so long, people outside are bound to get the wrong idea." As Han Xuewei spoke, she couldn't help feeling shy.
After all, the stories about certain fitting room incidents had already gone viral on the internet. So if a man and a woman stayed in a mall fitting room for too long, misunderstandings were bound to arise.
And so they both walked out of the fitting room.
The female store clerk wasn't waiting at the entrance of the fitting room; instead, she had gone directly to the cash register.
Seeing this, Han Xuewei also breathed a sigh of relief. It was a good thing the clerk wasn't waiting outside; otherwise, how embarrassing that would've been!
Moreover, they were in a public place, and they had to be more mindful of their behavior.
Han Xuewei pretended to be composed as she straightened her dress, admiring it in front of the mirror.
Lin Yi came to her side and stood quietly as well.
Looking at Han Xuewei, Lin Yi said with a smile, "How about we pick out a matching couple's outfit next? The clothes in this store are indeed nice, and I've already got my eye on a set for us."

chapters.title: Chapter 75: 75 All Wrapped Up
chapters.content:
The cashier at the counter, upon hearing their request, led the couple to the couples' clothing section and started showcasing the store's latest matching outfits.
Lin Yi even accompanied Han Xuewei in trying on many styles, and even received a call from the jewelry store while fitting. He simply asked them to wait for a moment.
Han Xuewei was of course very happy trying on the couples' outfits. This scene reminded her of the last time they went shopping together, and a sweet feeling naturally emerged, as if they were deeply in love.
After trying on clothes back and forth for over half an hour, Lin Yi picked out the ones he felt were suitable and looked better on them, then directly said to the female cashier, "Pack up all these in our sizes, please!"
Han Xuewei immediately tried to dissuade him upon hearing this, "Isn't this too much? One or two sets would be enough; we can't wear all of these."
Lin Yi, however, appeared nonchalant, "If anything, we can just wear a different set every two or three days, no problem."
Seeing Lin Yi's stubbornness, Han Xuewei had no choice but to watch the cashier pack up all the selected couples' outfits and her own clothes.
After some calculations, the cashier quoted the couple, "Sir, all your clothes are packed, and you've been automatically enrolled as a member, enjoying a 20% discount. The total is 310,000. Will you be paying by QR code or card?"
Without a second thought, Lin Yi pulled out a card from his wallet and handed it over, "Card, please!"
The cashier was momentarily taken aback when she saw that Lin Yi had produced just a regular bank card, but after swiping it, the screen immediately displayed the word "Success!"
310,000, swiped just like that!
And without using a credit card! He paid directly with a debit card!
Could this be what wealthy people are like?
The cashier promptly handed over all the packaged clothes to Lin Yi, very respectfully saw them off, and then watched them take the escalator towards the jewelry specialist floor.
The envy in her eyes was unmistakable!
Watching the couple's retreating backs, the cashier mumbled, "I wonder when my Prince Charming will show up. Good men like this are truly rare..."
After her moment of reflection, she returned to the store and got back to work earnestly.
No sooner had Lin Yi stepped out of the store than he heard the system's notification in his mind.
"Ding, congratulations host, you've successfully increased your wife's joy level, earning one system reward gala entry ticket."
"A gala entry ticket? What kind of gala entry ticket?" Lin Yi was slightly startled upon hearing this and expressed his confusion.
"Charity ball."
Hearing this, Lin Yi was even more puzzled. Weren't these system rewards a bit too random?
Could it be the system was hinting that he should take Han Xuewei to attend? It would be a perfect opportunity for his wife to wear this beautiful set of diamonds.
If that was indeed the case, then he should take his wife to choose a gown later on!
With this in mind, Lin Yi carried several shopping bags from the mall, leading his wife towards the Zhen Ai Baby Jewelry store.
As soon as they entered the store, they noticed the presence of not only the previously encountered Manager Guo but also several other department managers. At the same time, there were many more security guards in the jewelry store.
With a 890 million diamond in hand, anyone would enhance security measures.
To say one wasn't anxious would be lying.
```
Seeing Lin Yi enter the store, those people quickly came forward to greet him.
"Mr. Lin, the True Love Baby series diamond you ordered has arrived. Please confirm and sign here after checking."
Lin Yi nodded and replied, "Hmm, okay."
On
Manager Guo and his party led them straight into the VIP room, while the security guards stood honestly by the door, with others waiting outside.
Just at this moment, a woman happened to pass by the entrance of the jewelry store.
She was Lin Yi's ex-girlfriend—Li Jingwen!
However, Li Jingwen didn't come here alone, at this moment she was clinging to a man's arm, inadvertently walking into this store.
The store clerk at the entrance, seeing the stylistic appearance of the two, greeted them quite enthusiastically.
"Good evening to you both."
Li Jingwen didn't bother to respond to the approaching clerk, instead, she directly lifted her hand to check the ring on it, then said, "Do you have any five-carat diamond rings here? If so, bring them all out. Let me see what styles you have."
The man accompanying Li Jingwen had been playing with his phone, head down, ever since he entered the store, seemingly uninterested.
As soon as Li Jingwen walked in, she caught sight of Lin Yi being ushered into a room, swarmed by a group of people, and couldn't help but look over several times.
Right after that, she leaned into the ear of her companion and whispered a few words. After hearing this, the man laughed contemptuously, "Humph, even if he hasn't gone bankrupt, my family's assets are probably miles ahead of theirs!"
This man was also an alumnus of theirs. He came from a wealthy family and was quite ostentatious, which made him a well-known figure in the campus.
His name was Yang Fan.
His family was indeed rich, with total assets exceeding two billion yuan. Yet even so, looking at the whole of Xiangcheng, the business his family ran could only be considered ordinary, classified as third-rate in the industry.
Lin Yi's father's company was, before its decline, roughly equal to Yang Fan's family business.
When Lin Yi's family company began to falter, Yang Fan had known early on; since then, he looked down on Lin Yi quite a bit.
However, what surprised Yang Fan was that Li Jingwen had mentioned that Han Xuewei, the recognized campus belle, was also with Lin Yi!
After hearing this, Yang Fan suddenly felt infuriated!
After all, he was once one of Han Xuewei's suitors!
Moreover, from freshman year he had pursued her relentlessly, but as the four years of university were about to draw to a close, he still hadn't won her over.
As a rich second-generation, Yang Fan didn't stick to his original intention of pursuing only Han Xuewei; he also dated other girls, even more than one!
Han Xuewei always saw Yang Fan with different girls by his side, so she never had the slightest bit of affection for this rich second-generation from the start to the end.
Li Jingwen, noticing the obvious change in her boyfriend's expression after hearing the news, asked, "What are you thinking about?"
Yang Fan said coldly, "Why is today so unlucky? I didn't expect to run into her! Han Xuewei!"
Li Jingwen, after hearing this, shrugged indifferently and then said, "What's so surprising? I've long heard the rumors that these two have already had a child together! They're on a break from school now! I just can't understand, when did the two of them start an affair? It hasn't been that long since I broke up with Lin Yi, has it? How come they already have a child now?
They sure move fast!"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 76 Running into an Ex-Girlfriend
chapters.content:
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan's anger surged uncontrollably, knowing that he had pursued Han Xuewei for nearly four years without ever receiving a warm response from her; she hadn't even given him the chance to be alone with her. Yet, unexpectedly, Lin Yi, the young upstart, had picked up such a great deal!
How could Yang Fan remain composed?
At that moment, in the VIP room, Han Xuewei mentioned she wanted to go to the restroom, so Lin Yi accompanied her out.
After spotting them, Yang Fan immediately took Li Jingwen by the arm and quickly walked over toward the pair!
The corners of Li Jingwen's mouth curled up slightly. Her efforts to stir the pot on the side were bearing fruit!
"Oh, I was wondering why that face looked so familiar. It's Lin Yi, isn't it? We haven't seen each other for a while, have we?" Li Jingwen was the first to greet Lin Yi, but she didn't give Han Xuewei a glance at all from beginning to end.
Lin Yi recognized the newcomers but silently chose not to acknowledge them.
Manager Guo, who was accompanying them, became very alert upon seeing someone approaching, and the security guards in the lobby also started to walk slowly in their direction.
Curious, Han Xuewei asked, "Eh? Yang Fan? What are you doing here?"
Hearing his wife mention the name of Li Jingwen's boyfriend, Lin Yi grew a bit curious.
In a low voice, Han Xuewei whispered to Lin Yi, "His name is Yang Fan, and he has been pursuing me since our freshman year, but he hasn't bothered me in recent months. It turns out that he's been dating Li Jingwen."
Lin Yi nodded slightly, saying nothing further.
It seemed that Li Jingwen had quickly found a new boyfriend after breaking up with him, and this person was undoubtedly Yang Fan.
Seeing Li Jingwen's hand tightly linked with Yang Fan's arm, looking very intimate, it was clear that the two of them were likely in the throes of a passionate romance.
In Lin Yi's previous relationship with Li Jingwen, he had never seen her take such initiative!
The two had known each other since their freshman year, and the relationships they had back then were very serious. However, as Li Jingwen experienced more of life, her standards continued to rise, and so did her desires for material things.
So, during the last year of their relationship, Li Jingwen always demanded that Lin Yi give her a variety of handbags, along with diamond and gold jewelry.
Lin Yi didn't think such requests were excessive and considered them quite normal, after all, it's no big deal to give gifts to a girlfriend while dating.
At that time, Lin Yi's family business hadn't begun to decline, and he received tens of thousands in living expenses each month, though a large portion went to Li Jingwen.
Even now, the bags Li Jingwen carried were birthday gifts from Lin Yi, each valued at over ten thousand.
However, their relationship did not have a happy ending. Upon hearing that Lin Yi's family company was on the brink of bankruptcy, Li Jingwen coldly broke it off with him.
Realizing that Lin Yi's living expenses had drastically reduced and that she could no longer gain anything more from him, she decisively cut ties with Lin Yi and resolutely started dating Yang Fan!
Lin Yi took Han Xuewei to the restroom, while Yang Fan led Li Jingwen directly into the VIP room. The proud Yang Fan ignored everyone around him, only waiting for Lin Yi and Han Xuewei to return.
A short while later, the pair returned to the VIP room, led by Manager Guo. Yang Fan looked at the manager and then at Lin Yi, letting out a sneer, and said, "You really surprise me, you know? Your family is almost bankrupt, and yet you dare to bring a woman to such a fancy place? Are you not afraid of emptying your pockets?"
Manager Guo and the other staff noticed that Lin Yi seemed to know the two people who had just come in, so they didn't dare to interrupt from beginning to end.
At this moment, a staff member brought over a very delicate safety box, which was also kept aside by Manager Guo, simply to avoid disturbing Lin Yi and his conversation.
It truly was a diamond worth several hundred million! Even the safety box for the diamond was so exquisite!
Upon hearing their conversation, Manager Guo couldn't help but murmur to himself, "Why did these young people have to show up at this critical moment? And they even dare to be aggressive towards our VIP guests, what kind of background do they have?"
Despite his vast experience in judging people, the manager was at a loss for a moment upon seeing how strongly they were disparaging the buyer of the diamonds.
Han Xuewei saw that Lin Yi was unwilling to speak, and even ignored Yang Fan, so she shifted the topic by asking Yang Fan, "Are you here to buy a diamond ring?"
Yang Fan, hearing the question from the goddess he had long admired, gave a faint smile and then said, "More or less, just buying a little gift for my girlfriend."
Li Jingwen saw that Lin Yi had been silent from the beginning and gave him a contemptuous glance before immediately picking up on Han Xuewei's thread of conversation.
"Right, a gift for my girlfriend! Our Yang Fan always brings me to these kinds of jewelry stores to buy gifts, unlike some people, who didn't even bother to buy a ring after being with me for so long!"
Lin Yi lifted his eyes slightly and replied indifferently, "That's right, I can't afford rings. Some people currently carry a bag that is still a gift from me though! That bag costs at least fifty thousand, right?"
Upon hearing this, Li Jingwen was upset and quickly retorted, "That's nonsense! This isn't a gift from you! I bought this bag with my own money!"
"Heh," Lin Yi merely let out a cold laugh and said no more.
Li Jingwen's family ran a fruit shop, and their annual turnover was barely a few hundred thousand. How could she possibly buy such an expensive bag?
At this moment, Lin Yi couldn't be bothered to pay her any more attention!
He didn't want to haggle over every detail with such people in public!
Otherwise, it would make him look cheap!
However, Li Jingwen became even more aggressive, "Hmph, I'm not like certain people who don't understand their own limits. You can barely keep your own company from going bankrupt, and yet you bring a woman to a place with such high consumption? Who are you trying to fool? With the little pocket change you have, buying a two-carat diamond must be tough, right?"
Li Jingwen, having said these words, did not show a friendly face either, and after finishing her sentence, she crossed her legs arrogantly and rolled her eyes dramatically.
Han Xuewei couldn't listen any longer at this point. She hadn't expected Lin Yi's ex-girlfriend to be so hypocritical!
"Li classmate, what we buy is a matter between husband and wife and has nothing to do with you two. If you're here to shop, please go outside. Sitting here, you are only disturbing me and my husband!"
"Disturbing? Ha! You…" Li Jingwen got even more excited upon hearing this, "I want to hear exactly how we are disturbing you?"
Yang Fan sat silently on the side, not saying a word. He wanted to see what these two people were going to do now!
Seeing Han Xuewei arrive, Lin Yi reached out and pulled her to his side. He didn't want his wife involved in this dispute because it was clear that Li Jingwen's intention was to target him!

chapters.title: Chapter 77: Chapter 78: The Invaluable Pink-Purple Diamond
chapters.content:
Because the True Love baby series of diamond jewelry features extremely high carat diamonds that are flawless, without a single impurity!
Li Jinglei and Yang Fan had very complex expressions on their faces when they saw this, their eyes filled with surprise and confusion!
How could this be possible? How could Lin Yi afford such expensive diamonds??
Where did he get so much money from?
Both of them simply couldn't believe their eyes!
Beneath their indescribable emotions, Lin Yi opened the safe and placed the diamond necklace, the size of a chicken egg, around Han Xuewei's neck, and it must be said, it looked incredibly exquisite! It also suited her perfectly!
Han Xuewei watched in shock as Lin Yi put a necklace worth hundreds of millions around her neck, and she couldn't react for a long time.
She instinctively stepped back and said, "This... This is too expensive! I can't accept it!"
But she couldn't escape, as Lin Yi grabbed her firmly, "This is a surprise your husband is giving you, you can't refuse! No matter what, you have to wear it!"
After hearing this, Han Xuewei became even more anxious and said, "But you've already given me a gift, the villa you gave me earlier was enough! And we've just bought clothes worth more than 300,000, I can't accept such an expensive gift again!"
Lin Yi, however, shook his head seriously and said, "We are husband and wife, mine is yours, and giving you gifts is very common! You don't have to be polite at all, it's what a husband should do, it's my duty."
Hearing these words, Han Xuewei of course felt overwhelmed with favor. She knew that all the things Lin Yi had given her added up to a total value of more than ten billion!
As the couple talked, everyone around them heard their conversation.
Li Jinglei felt even more surprised upon hearing this. Lin Yi even gave Han Xuewei a villa? And at their feet were so many shopping bags from the mall, and now there was a large box of diamond jewelry!
...…
Unfortunately, there was no such thing as a regret medicine in this world, and right now Li Jinglei almost turned green with regret!
If only she hadn't broken up with Lin Yi back then, she would be Lin Yi's wife today! Wouldn't everything Han Xuewei was talking about be hers?
But looking at Yang Fan beside her, the best he could probably do was buy her something worth tens of thousands of dollars, right?
Li Jinglei couldn't help but recall all the love that Lin Yi had shown her before, all the pampering, all the concessions, and wished she could run to him right now and beg for his forgiveness!
But at this moment, she had to suppress her emotions, because what was missed was missed, and she couldn't lose Yang Fan no matter what!
Although this fish wasn't big, it was still a fish after all!
So Li Jinglei had to bow her head.
At that moment, Yang Fan, completely embarrassed by Lin Yi's words, pointed at him angrily, "Lin Yi, don't you get too pleased with yourself! Just you wait!"
After saying this, he took Li Jinglei and left.
Li Jinglei's heart was bursting with frustration at the moment, a belly full of grievances with no one to confide in!
She had agreed with her boyfriend to buy a diamond ring for herself, but unexpectedly at this place she came across her ex-boyfriend and his wife, who flaunted their relationship in such a way that left them both dumbfounded.
In the end, not only was she angry, but the diamond ring her boyfriend had promised to buy didn't materialize.
Manager Guo saw the two young people storm out angrily and rolled his eyes at them without sympathy.
Han Xuewei gazed at the dazzling diamond on her chest; her eyes almost dazzled, and she found it incredibly beautiful, "Thank you for the surprise, husband, I love it."
Lin Yi didn't pay any mind to the two who scurried out the door; he just smiled and said, "That's my good wife!"
Han Xuewei turned around, gazed out the door, and whispered to Lin Yi, "Have they left?"
Lin Yi gently kissed Han Xuewei's forehead and replied, "They've gone far."
Han Xuewei let out a long sigh of relief and then said, "I didn't expect to encounter your ex-girlfriend here, it felt pretty awkward at the moment."
Lin Yi was very calm, smiling, he said, "Let what's past pass! It was hard to move on right after the breakup, but since then, you and I came together, and now we have three adorable babies. There's nothing more important than this in my heart. And besides, I know very well what kind of person Li Jinglei is, and I'm sure you see it very clearly too.
So, there's no need to feel awkward; I've moved on a long time ago. Now, you just need to remember, the person I deeply love is you, and only you."
Han Xuewei was deeply moved by Lin Yi's earnest confession and threw herself into his arms, her heart fluttering like a jumpy little deer!
The night she and Lin Yi were intimate coincided with the day Lin Yi and Li Jinglei broke up, so Han Xuewei worried that Lin Yi might be unable to let go of his ex-girlfriend or still harbor a secret crush on her.
But today, seeing Lin Yi face his ex-girlfriend Li Jinglei so frankly in front of her, she believed this was proof enough of Lin Yi's feelings!
And most of all, this was the outcome Han Xuewei had hoped for!
As for Li Jinglei, she was convinced that Lin Yi couldn't let go of her, at least that he still harbored feelings for her. In her eyes, his relationship with Han Xuewei was just a quick substitute!
Especially after hearing about the many gifts Lin Yi had given Han Xuewei, not to mention piles of clothes and even a villa and that diamond jewelry set, how could she not be envious?
That was a diamond worth several hundred million!
How many people in the country could afford it?
And all of this should have been hers!
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei packed all the jewelry back into the safety box, covered it securely with clothes in the shopping bag, and then left the store.
One must not flash one's wealth, regardless of how rich they are, it's important to stay low-key. After all, this was jewelry worth several hundred million!
Manager Guo, with the entire staff, sent off the couple at the door.
On the way out of the mall, Han Xuewei happily linked arms with Lin Yi, checked the time, and asked, "Husband, it's getting late, should we head back now? I wonder how the baby is doing."
Lin Yi's mind was filled with thoughts of the party invitation that the system had rewarded him with—it seemed to be a charity gala. Although he had never attended one, he understood the basics and knew that if he were to take Han Xuewei, they must don formal attire.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: Chapter 77 Desperation
chapters.content:
Li Jingwen now found these two individuals particularly distasteful. Logically speaking, Lin Yi was just the man she had discarded. But why on earth was this guy dating the school beauty acknowledged by so many? She couldn't understand it at all, so she was inexplicably angry!
As the dispute between the two groups reached this point, Manager Guo beside them had figured it out too. It seemed that the girl who had just arrived was the ex-girlfriend of the buyer.
At this moment, Manager Guo smiled at Li Jingwen and said, "Miss, may I ask if you two have any intention of making purchases in our store? If not, we hope you will leave promptly so as not to disturb our customers."
Li Jingwen glared fiercely at Manager Guo and demanded, "Who are you? What right do you have to ask us to leave? We are customers!"
"I am the manager of this store, as well as the manager of True Love Diamonds headquarters. Right now, we have some very precious merchandise to deliver to Mr. Lin," Manager Guo said very seriously.
"Very precious merchandise?" Upon hearing this, Li Jingwen felt a hint of surprise and looked around at the people present, then turned her gaze to a beautifully crafted safe box held by one of the staff members.
"So, do you two intend to shop here, or do you have other plans?" Manager Guo said, looking at the security guards nearby and giving them a signal with his eyes.
However, at this moment, Lin Yi, who had been silent for a while, suddenly spoke up, "Since we're all old acquaintances, if they really don't want to leave, then let them stay and watch. It might also be eye-opening for them."
Upon hearing this, Manager Guo nodded very politely.
Since the big buyer had spoken, they dared not object, so the two could stay.
No sooner had Lin Yi finished speaking than the security guards stepped back, clearing a large area.
Li Jingwen, who had been exposed to grand scenes before, said with a feigned smile, "Then let us witness what kind of purchase the great Mr. Lin has made to keep so many security guards on standby!
Li Jingwen certainly did not believe that Lin Yi could afford to buy invaluable jewelry!
The news that his family was on the verge of bankruptcy had spread almost throughout the school. Furthermore, the parents of some students who were in business with the Lin family had confirmed the truth of these rumors.
Lin Yi ignored what she had said and simply told Manager Guo, "Let's inspect the goods now. I'm in a hurry to get back and take care of the baby."
As soon as he had spoken, everyone's eyes eagerly turned toward the exquisite safe box!
Lin Yi sat up straight, feeling a sense of anticipation. He too wanted to see what a few hundred million dollars' worth of diamonds looked like.
Manager Guo solemnly put on a pair of white gloves, then opened the sophisticated safe box and took out a small, brown, silk-like round box.
Manager Guo held the box up to Lin Yi and slowly opened the lid!
In that instant, words could not describe the dazzling brilliance of the diamond necklace inside the box!
At the same time, the staff member who had handled the posh safe explained, "Mr. Lin, the diamond series you ordered is the most expensive from our company, and it was designed by the renowned designer, Miss Plenity."
"This necklace is rich in composition and also high-end, with each link of the chain made up of small diamonds. There are 1314 of these small diamonds, symbolizing eternal devotion. The diamonds are all round and identical, exuding prestigious elegance when worn. The craftsmanship and design are flawless, guaranteeing comfortable wear.
The centerpiece pink diamond in the heart shape, adorned by purple diamonds, is particularly captivating."
"The total price for this necklace is 270 million, making it the most expensive piece in our company."
Upon hearing this, Li Jingwen, Yang Fan, and even Han Xuewei all instantly widened their eyes in shock!
That expensive??
This was merely a necklace to wear around the neck, and it was so pricey! 270 million?
Everyone present was likely seeing the most expensive piece of jewelry they would ever lay eyes on in their entire lives!
Just as everyone was still dazed, Manager Guo put the necklace back and took out another exceedingly pretty small box.
He then brought it in front of Lin Yi and slowly opened it.
"This ring is another highlight of the series, with the main diamond on the ring the same as that on the necklace, a large pink diamond. The total value of this ring is 190 million. It would be hard to find another with the same price tag anywhere in the world," he explained.
Having finished showing the ring, Manager Guo proceeded to display earrings from the series, as well as bracelets and so on.
He went into great detail about the series' craftsmanship and purity. In the end, he added, "Mr. Lin, your customized True Love baby series of diamonds are all here, worth a total of 890 million. If you confirm the receipt, please sign here."
Manager Guo then packed everything neatly back into the elegant safe box and also handed over an acknowledgment form.
At this scene, Li Jinglei was stunned into stillness. Initially, she had speculated whether the jewelry store manager was putting on an act to deceive her.
But this thought quickly dissipated. These people were sharper than monkeys; who would waste their time putting on a play here?
A multitude of chaotic thoughts surged through Li Jinglei's mind, leaving her feeling a mix of emotions. She couldn't comprehend where Lin Yi got so much from, let alone using it to buy diamonds!
After finishing these procedures, Manager Guo turned his gaze to Li Jinglei and Yang Fan sitting aside.
He wondered what was wrong with these two young people who had come into the store and mockingly criticized a buyer with a super VIP card, even claiming they were bankrupt!
Bankrupt? Who would have so much money if they were bankrupt?
The pink diamonds and purple diamonds used in this series of diamonds were extremely rare and valuable on a global scale!
A rough estimate suggested that unless a person had a net worth reaching several billion, it would be entirely out of the question for them to purchase such precious diamonds.
At this moment, Manager Guo looked at Li Jinglei and Yang Fan with disdain. Even though they were customers of the jewelry store, if they were at odds with Lin Yi and his group, he would certainly side with the most prestigious customers!
Even if these two people, who had been squabbling from the moment they entered, now suddenly bought a ten-carat ring, it would still be a drop in the bucket compared to Lin Yi's True Love baby series.
Even ten carats combined would not compare to the smallest diamond in the series Lin Yi had purchased.

chapters.title: Chapter 80 : 80 Swipe the Card!
chapters.content:
Lin Yi then thought there was no need to inquire about the price, as since they had come to such a high-end shopping center, if they liked something, they just had to buy it. If there were any discounts, the sales staff would account for it, but if not, no amount of haggling would bring the price down, and even if it were to be cheaper, it wouldn't be by much.
After selecting a gown for his wife, Lin Yi casually picked out an outfit for himself and looked at the brand—it was a Pierre Cardin suit.
Han Xuewei also picked out a nice tie for her husband and then bought a pair of quite beautiful high heels.
This store truly lacked for nothing, even offering undergarments appropriate for ladies' gowns.
Guided by the store manager, Han Xuewei entered the fitting room and emerged moments later, walking out elegantly in a white dress.
The gown really was figure-hugging!
Even without makeup, Han Xuewei looked stunning in it, after all, she was the unanimously acknowledged beauty of the whole school! It seemed all outfits were made for her!
Perhaps because she had been breastfeeding their baby recently, her chest was noticeably larger than before, and her fair skin, along with a slightly plump face, complemented the peacock-edged gown beautifully!
Such a figure was surely too elegant to be described by the word 'elegant' alone?
With curves both front and back, not to mention her long legs, she would definitely turn heads walking down the street!
Even Lin Yi found his eyes gleaming when he saw her long legs at that moment!
The owner of the dress shop, as well as the other salespeople, were also dazzled by Han Xue's transformation in the outfit! Very few could carry off this dress without makeup— even celebrities and internet icons who visited wouldn't dare to try it without makeup.
Taking small steps, Han Xuewei approached Lin Yi and asked with a smile, "What do you think? How does it look?"
Lin Yi, already entranced, unconsciously swallowed and said outright, "It's beautiful! My wife is truly exceptional!"
Han Xuewei was, of course, overjoyed at the compliment.
Lin Yi continued with a laugh, "It's a good thing this gown isn't too revealing, it covers just enough. Otherwise, I wouldn't want to buy it! I can't stand the idea of others ogling my wife!"
As Han Xuewei showed off the gown to Lin Yi, the store manager said, "Mr. Lin, if your wife needs makeup services, we provide complimentary makeup here to perfect your experience."
However, after hearing this, Han Xuewei shook her head repeatedly, "There's no need for makeup; we're in a hurry to get back home."
Lin Yi also nodded and said, "Then we'll do as my wife says. We won't try the makeup."
Seeing his wife so satisfied with the dress, Lin Yi let her go change out of it in the fitting room and asked the staff to hang it up.
Han Xuewei also never expected the gown to fit so perfectly; it was as if it had been tailor-made for her!
Of course, the most surprised was the store manager. Many customers had tried on this gown before, and it either ended up a bit too small or too large around the chest, failing to fill it out. Even if they liked it, they had to get it custom-made, but she never expected, when Han Xuewei tried it on... it fit so perfectly!
Anyone who could carry off this gown must possess a devilishly good figure!
She had even thought of getting Han Xuewei to touch up her makeup and then inviting her to take a photo for Later Stages advertising, but knowing that the couple was in a hurry to return home, she had to let go of the thought.
Having worked there for so long, she knew that it was rare to see a couple both wealthy and good-looking—Mrs. Lin was quite the catch.
