As everyone knew, some exceedingly wealthy men weren't that handsome, and it's only their partners that were generally more attractive— and these partners might not even be their first spouses.
Such situations were commonplace in society, and those involved in the luxury industry had long gotten used to it.
The store manager carefully packaged the clothes herself, and when Lin Yi went to the checkout, he realized the gown was indeed pricey, valued at 550,000, his suit was worth 220,000. Adding Han Xuewei's high heels, handbag, and his own tie, the total came to 930,000.
In such a high-end shopping environment, there is no room for bargaining. The shop also operates a membership system with discounts if available, and otherwise, a fixed price.
As Lin Yi and Han Xuewei were about to leave, the store manager handed him a VIP card saying, "Mr. Lin, you've reached the spending threshold and have become a member of our store, which gives you access to certain services."
"We offer a range of services, such as if you can't make it to an evening event in time, you can call and tell us your location, and a business car will take you to the event, providing a gown and makeup services on the car."
"If you happen to soil your gown at the event, our business car will also arrive promptly and assist you accordingly. Rest assured, our services will definitely satisfy you."
At the same time, the store manager handed Lin Yi a business card, and he graciously accepted it, nodding his head and saying, "Thank you."
"Well, it's not convenient to carry the gown home, so I'll leave it here for now. Please help me clean it. I'll notify you in advance on the day of the evening party, and then you can deliver it; would that be alright?"
"All these are possible, you just need to notify us five hours before the event, and we will deliver it to the specified location."
Lin Yi said, "Then I'll leave the time and place now. It's at the end of this month, on the 30th at 8 pm. I'll also experience your services then. Please arrange a good makeup artist, price is no issue."
"Mr. Lin, you can experience our top-tier services, with all the necessary equipment and personnel fully prepared. However, the team's travel expenses are high, at 100,000 per trip. Do you need it?"
Lin Yi nodded, "Book it then. When do I pay?"
"You can pay half the deposit now, and the rest after the event. If there's any problem with our service, we will compensate you double," the store manager explained.
Lin Yi, very calmly took out his bank card and swiped it again.
To Han Xuewei, these services seemed perfectly normal; after all, she had already acquired diamonds worth hundreds of millions, and such necessary expenses for important occasions were reasonable.
She also realized that being with Lin Yi meant she had to gradually get used to such high expenses, especially since she had already accepted ten million from him as her spending money!
That was just pocket money! Considering her usual spending at school, how long would it take for her to spend it all?

chapters.title: Chapter 81 : 81: Envy
chapters.content:
Her usual expenses weren't high, aside from some essential items that she would choose to buy at a higher price, her regular consumption was minimal, limited to the occasional outing for fun.
Han Xuewei had come to understand that when Lin Yi shopped for expensive items, it was to ensure quality. Besides, the circles they were to move in later would be different, and having normal high-quality items was essential. As for everyday expenses, it was possible to save a bit.
As soon as Lin Yi swiped his card, a system prompt echoed in his mind.
"Ding! Congratulations to the host, for successfully purchasing a gown for your wife. You have been rewarded with a new skill—The Art of Discernment. This skill can be utilized over a short period and cannot be used persistently or activated at will."
Lin Yi was startled by the system's prompt. Usually, the rewards he received were either money or items. A skill like this was indeed rare.
He couldn't help but wonder if there would come a day when he would complete all the tasks? And what kind of conspiracy lay hidden behind it all?
Why would it reward him with a ticket to a charity gala for no reason, rather than to other events? Could it be guiding him towards achieving a certain goal?
Lin Yi's brain worked overtime, but even after considerable thought, he couldn't figure it out. Without any evidence, he had no choice but to let it go.
At that moment, Han Xuewei suddenly said to Lin Yi, "Husband, it's getting late. Let's head back for now; we've bought plenty today."
Then, she whispered in Lin Yi's ear, "We've been out for quite a while now, and I'm starting to feel my milk come in. I need to be home by ten..."
As Han Xuewei spoke, she adjusted her clothes, her cheeks flushing with color.
Seeing the shy look on his wife's face, Lin Yi hurried her along more quickly, "Then let's get back as fast as we can, just hang in there a little longer."
At this very moment, Li Jingwen and Han Xue had picked out a large diamond ring at a jewelry store and spent several tens of thousands on it.
With a coquettish tone, Li Jingwen complained to Yang Fan, "Those two left already, right? Geez, it's just our bad luck. Everywhere we go, they're there. Why did they have to go to the gown shop as well?"
Yang Fan shook his head, "Let's hurry back to that store; we haven't finished choosing clothes yet. I didn't expect such bad luck. With all this time past, they should have left by now."
Li Jingwen said with a hint of disdain, "Yes, we can't let it delay our selection of gowns for the charity gala! I wonder what kind of people will gather at the Orlan charity gala. Just thinking about it makes me excited!"
Having said that, they left the jewelry store with their gift boxes and headed towards the Gezi gown shop.
No sooner had they entered than they heard several sales assistants nearby gossiping, "They look so young, I didn't expect them to be married already. They do seem well-matched!"
"Yeah, especially Mr. Lin—he's like the ideal man in my heart! He totally has the look of a domineering CEO! Do wealthy people spoil their wives this willfully?"
"Exactly! Especially when he took out a card and told us to charge it, spending so much without a credit card. It's quite unusual indeed."
"Is there a need to admire him so much? Just because someone is a high spender, you find him handsome?"
"Not at all, he bought himself a suit and a tie that totaled up to just over 200 thousand, but he spent over 700 thousand when buying something for his wife! That's spoiling his wife! I'm so envious, and what's more, the gowns they bought were specially for the gala, costing over 900 thousand. Who wouldn't be surprised!"
"What kind of gala is it anyway? Is it that important? Just gowns cost so much money, and there has been quite a few people coming to buy gowns lately!"
"I heard it has something to do with charity, tch, what does that kind of soirée have to do with us? Let's not talk about this anymore. You need to take good care of this gown and not ruin the peacock pattern when you tidy it up—damaging it could cost us hundreds of thousands, enough to cover a lifetime of compensation!"
"Oh, I know already!"
The sales associates chatted while they neatly arranged the gown Han Xuewei had chosen and hung it back up.
They would have to take the gown for cleaning later, and then it could be stored away until the end of the month when it would be handed over to Han Xuewei.
Upon hearing this, Li Jingwen immediately understood which Mr. Lin these clerks were discussing. She also saw several people attending to a very exquisite white gown.
Her expression changed in an instant! It was filled with envy, mixed with jealousy—an emotion completely impossible to conceal.
How could she not regret? She simply couldn't fathom who had spread such baseless rumors in school, claiming that Lin Yi's family had gone bankrupt! Wasn't that just nonsense?
That rumor had single-handedly ruined her chance at a high-quality life! It had thoroughly caused her to miss out on a big catch!!
Li Jingwen couldn't help but shift her gaze to Yang Fan beside her. His family's company was actually on par with Lin Yi's in terms of strength, but Yang Fan wasn't the only son—he was merely a junior!
The Yang family's eldest son had always been the favored child, and had even started to take over some company affairs, but Yang Fan never involved himself with the family business, caring for nothing other than spending money as if he had no interest in anything else.
But Lin Yi was different! He was bound to inherit his family's company eventually, and as a second-generation rich kid, Lin Yi wasn't fickle in love, nor did he act like Sea King, leaving a trail of romance everywhere. Instead, he had big ideas for work and was very capable.
It's true what they say, comparison is the thief of joy! Li Jingwen felt her past decision was too hasty and her choice too rushed, filled with regret.
But once a choice is made, it can't be changed! Having made the decision, one must face the consequences that come with it!
Li Jingwen had also clearly heard the staff's discussion—Lin Yi seemed to be attending a charity gala as well!
Could it also be the Orlan charity gala?
If someone's net worth isn't at least several billion, they wouldn't even get an invitation to this charity event.
Could it be that Lin Yi's family company... has completely risen now? But she had confirmed after inquiring through various sources that Lin Yi's family company was valued at only two or three billion!
What's going on here? Could it be that all the information she had gathered was incorrect? Besides, Yang Fan had personally told her that his dad said Lin Yi's company was only worth so much money, with no chance of a comeback!
So what exactly is the situation now?
What has happened with Lin Yi's family?
Moreover, she had witnessed it with her own eyes today—Lin Yi had bought several billion worth of diamonds for Han Xuewei in one go!
She had seen these billions in diamonds with her own eyes; there was no way it could be fake!

chapters.title: Chapter 82: Chapter 82 Li Jingwen's Thoughts
chapters.content:
Li Jingwen admitted that although her looks were indeed inferior to Han Xuewei's, it could not be denied that she and Lin Yi had truly loved each other! Moreover, she had heard that Lin Yi got dead drunk on the day they broke up, which was enough to prove that Lin Yi couldn't let go of her either!
Just now, she had mockingly berated him, but Lin Yi remained silent from beginning to end, never uttering a single word of disdain. His feelings must be complicated! He couldn't bear to do this!
So no matter what, she was determined to take back everything she had lost, everything that belonged to her! Lin Yi would always belong to her!
With that thought in mind, Li Jingwen couldn't help but shift her gaze to Yang Fan, who was beside her, and suddenly, an idea sprang up in her heart!
She had long been aware that Yang Fan had been pursuing Han Xuewei since their freshman year, but she had always dismissed him. If she were to lend a hand and help Yang Fan... huh.
However, at this moment, Yang Fan was also preoccupied with his own thoughts. He cared a lot about the upcoming charity gala, but the funds provided by his family were limited to 1.5 million yuan. For someone like him who was used to spending money lavishly, that amount could be used for quite a good time of leisure!
But ever since he had Li Jingwen as a girlfriend, his monthly expenses had risen significantly. Apart from buying her jewelry, selecting the right outfits and handbags ate into the 1.5 million, leaving almost half of it gone!
Of course, Yang Fan was not pleased, but Li Jingwen was after all the most beautiful girl in the department, so he felt the money was well spent!
It must be said that Li Jingwen's attractiveness truly couldn't match Han Xuewei's; more importantly, their styles were worlds apart. While the former was exceptionally charming, the latter was pure and beautiful, naturally giving off a different vibe!
Plus, Yang Fan could tell that Li Jingwen was definitely not the type to take care of a household after marriage; she spent money freely. If someone was willing to spend on her, she would depend on them, but if they were not, she would immediately turn around and leave, very shrewd indeed!
So up until now, the money Yang Fan had spent on Li Jingwen was at least over a million!
What had allowed him to win Li Jingwen over was using money to dazzle her—bold and aggressive!
Which girl could withstand such a temptation?
After overhearing the conversation between a few staff members, Yang Fan also learned that Lin Yi would be taking Han Xuewei to the charity gala. He was quite puzzled over how Lin Yi managed to get an invitation, but he didn't overthink it. Most entrepreneurs have a backup plan.
Some seem on the brink of bankruptcy, yet they have long since transferred their assets, with the ensuing events having no impact on them!
While being assisted by the sales staff in selecting gowns, both were preoccupied with their own schemes.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi had already brought Han Xuewei back to his home. The moment they entered the house, they heard the baby crying from the second floor.
The loudest cries came from his eldest son.
Han Xuewei didn't even have time to change her clothes before running to the nursery to pick up the baby.
She needed to feed the children quickly because she was already experiencing breast engorgement.
Seeing his wife's hurried figure, Lin Yi's eyes filled with tenderness and affection.
He began to organize the storage for baby formula and diapers, and even brought several packs of diapers into the nursery. Coming and going, he saw Han Xuewei breastfeeding the baby, but the two didn't exchange glances—they had become accustomed to this way of life and no longer felt the embarrassment or shyness of the past.
Lin Yi, watching Han Xuewei carefully breastfeeding the baby, whispered, "Wife, I was thinking after we picked up the diamond, we'd go to the beauty salon too! Ask about postpartum recovery and see which beauty salon is better. But I didn't expect to get so busy all of a sudden."
Han Xuewei whispered back, "It's okay, there will be other chances. I don't mind a day or two. Actually, I really want to do postpartum recovery, but I never looked into it before. You don't know, when I was trying on that white dress in the mall, I was holding in my stomach the whole time. It was really uncomfortable! You haven't seen how much flesh I've got on my stomach now!"
Han Xuewei was very dissatisfied with her current body shape and took every opportunity to complain about it. Her weight was hard to reduce after giving birth, and she felt somewhat unaccustomed for a while.
To think that in the past, if she had gained dozens of pounds, it was because she was carrying three babies! But now that the three babies were born, why wasn't the flesh on her body dropping?
It seemed like every part of her body had gained a bit of flesh!
For many years, Han Xuewei had been strictly controlling her figure, her body almost had no extra flesh at all! And if she ever found any, she would immediately lose it within a week!
Seeing several rolls of flesh on her stomach, she reminded herself that she must find a way to lose them! Otherwise, how could she attend the charity gala like this? She couldn't hold it in all night, could she? That would be too unnatural!
The charity gala was at the end of this month, so she still had ten days!
If she could go to the beauty salon with Lin Yi tomorrow to ask about postpartum recovery, she could start as soon as tomorrow, and surely there would be results in ten days?
When attending the charity gala, she wouldn't have to keep holding in her stomach!
It must be said, Han Xuewei was very worried about her figure.
But Lin Yi didn't see it that way, he thought Han Xuewei's slightly plump figure was perfect! Was this the legendary "chubby goddess"? So full of tactile pleasure, isn't it!!
So he laughed and comforted Han Xuewei, "Hahaha, but your husband really likes it."
The latter shrugged helplessly, "If it's only you who sees me every day, then I wouldn't mind. But you're taking me to a charity gala, and there must be a lot of people attending, right? Everyone else's wives are slim and graceful, but with all this flesh on my stomach, won't I make you lose face?"
Lin Yi responded nonchalantly, "Tsk, I don't care about face, and I won't mind what others say. After all, it's just you and me who will be together for life, no one else. If your husband says he likes it, then he really likes it!"
Han Xuewei shook her head seriously, "That won't do, tomorrow you have to take me to ask about postpartum recovery. When we were shopping in the mall last night, I saw a beauty salon not far from the jewelry store. I just checked on my phone, and it's a chain store with good reviews online, and the service is good too. Let's check it out tomorrow! They can definitely do postpartum recovery there."
Seeing his wife so concerned about her figure, Lin Yi could only nod, "Then I'll listen to you. We'll check it out tomorrow."
Han Xuewei finished breastfeeding Da Bao and then picked up her younger brother, agreeing with a muttered, "Mm."

chapters.title: Chapter 83 Please Hire Two Nannies
chapters.content:
Lin Yi then prepared to take a bath, before resting.
After a little more than an hour, the couple had finished tidying up, changed into their pajamas, lay down together, and prepared to sleep.
Lin Yi suddenly asked Han Xuewei, "Vivi, I've noticed that Aunt Wang is often very busy. Should we consider hiring another nanny? Sometimes she really can't manage it all by herself."
"If one day both our mothers are very busy and have no time to help us, you and Aunt Wang might not cope. Although sometimes I'm here, something unexpected like a business trip could come up."
"And I've thought it over, it would be best to hire two nannies."
Han Xuewei also gave it some thought and then said, "I also think we should hire two. You can ask the two maternity matrons who took care of me during my postnatal period if they can take on the nanny role. They were skilled in taking care of the baby, and they've worked with us before; their work capability is quite impressive."
Lin Yi nodded, "Then I'll ask them tomorrow. You've reminded me—I also think those two maternity matrons would be totally up for it. If we offer them a higher salary, I'm sure they won't refuse. Aunt Wang could train the two ladies, and they'll be able to handle the work in no time!"
Han Xuewei nodded her head in agreement as well.
Lin Yi said, "Then that's settled. After lunch tomorrow, I'll accompany you to the mall! We don't need to get up so early in the morning; we might as well sleep in a bit."
"Mhm."
With that, the two of them embraced and drifted off to sleep.
The next morning, Lin Yi got up at around half-past nine. Han Xuewei had woken up much earlier because she had to feed the baby; during this time, Lin Yi had not noticed at all.
After all, he had been exhausted these days, almost reaching the 'Realm' where he could fall asleep the moment he lay down.
Fortunately, all the pressing matters had been tended to. His only plan was to take Han Xuewei for her postnatal rehabilitation, and coincidentally, two days before they were due to attend the charity gala, they could go for the postpartum check-up at the hospital; then they wouldn't have to worry about traveling.
Days passed by, with everything going smoothly. This was the life Lin Yi yearned for—simple yet filled with a deep sense of happiness.
After feeding the baby, Han Xuewei came back to bed to catch up on sleep. When Lin Yi got up, she was still asleep. He didn't wake her, tiptoed downstairs alone, brushed his teeth, washed his face, and made himself a simple breakfast.
Checking the time, he estimated that Xue Mei would wake up after ten and would have to have lunch instead. Thinking this, Lin Yi rolled up his sleeves and began to prepare a lavish lunch for the family.
The two maternity matrons they had hired before had been gone for a while now, so these days, the baby had been looked after by Mother Lin and Aunt Wang. Toiling day and night was not a solution.
So the pressing matter was to hire two more nannies. If the previous maternity matrons could return to take on this role, that would be ideal.
As he was offering a fairly high salary, which was about twenty percent more than their peers, the two maternity matrons gladly accepted the job as nannies, although they each had some other matters to attend to and needed a few more days before they could start.
With all conditions agreed upon, although they were nannies in name, their work would be no different from before, still helping to take care of the children.
So, considering this, with Aunt Wang and the two former maternity matrons looking after the children, even if everyone else was busy at times, they should be able to manage.
Lin Yi's greatest hope now was to prevent Han Xuewei and the two mothers from feeling too tired from taking care of the baby day and night.
After deciding on this matter, he got busy with preparing lunch.
After cooking meals for the whole family, he made a separate nutritional meal for Han Xuewei. Just when he was about to bring the bowl to her room, Han Xuewei came downstairs at that moment.
It was almost noon, and she must have been very hungry. Moreover, she had eaten something in the morning while feeding the baby before going back to sleep.
Last night, the three little ones slept soundly and didn't wake up crying, which was already quite good.
Han Xuewei greeted Lin Yi with a smile, "Good morning, husband."
Lin Yi, "It's already noon now, has mom woken up yet?"
Aunt Wang had been helping Lin Yi with cooking since early in the morning and said at this point, "Then I'll go upstairs to call Sister Fang. She has been staying up late these past few days to deal with your father's company matters, and she also got up early in the morning to change the baby's diapers before going back to bed."
After hearing this, Lin Yi also realized how right it was to hire two nannies to help!
As the family sat down for lunch together, Lin Yi mentioned to everyone that he had hired the two maternity matrons to come back and help.
With more people to take care of the baby, everyone could relax a bit more, and they could even make a clear division of labor, like who would be responsible for night watch, who for changing diapers and feeding, or who would help with cooking and taking out the trash.
Mother Lin and Wang Yi naturally had no objections and were even very pleased with Lin Yi's thoughtfulness. Ever since the two maternity matrons left, they also felt taking care of the baby every day was exhausting and very busy, sometimes not even getting enough sleep.
But now, if they could really have two more people to help, they would surely be much more relaxed. After everyone had had lunch, Han Xuewei fed the babies and then followed Lin Yi to Qianda Shopping Mall again.
As soon as they entered, Han Xuewei immediately pulled Lin Yi to the beauty store she had seen the day before.
She had asked her good friend Qin Xiaoxu about it yesterday, and after asking, she learned that her friend had also been to that beauty salon, and it had a pretty good reputation.
The two of them walked in, and the receptionist at the front desk quickly came forward to greet the customers when she saw them.
"Good afternoon, what can I do for you two?"
As soon as Han Xuewei entered, she was looking around and said with a hint of shyness when she heard the receptionist's question, "Um, I would like to inquire about postpartum recovery."
Han Xuewei was now the mother of three babies, but she was not quite able to immerse herself in this identity, especially when mentioning to others that she was a mother.
The receptionist at the beauty store, seeing this young couple, smiled and said, "You'd like to know about postpartum recovery, right? Our store's recovery program is very well regarded in the industry. Please wait in the resting area for a moment while I get the relevant materials."
Han Xuewei nodded and pulled Lin Yi to sit down at the side.
Lin Yi accompanied her in silence, not saying a word.

chapters.title: Chapter 84: Chapter 84 Going to the Beauty Salon
chapters.content:
After all, as a man, he didn't understand these matters, so he let Han Xuewei decide for herself!
His role was to pay the bill for his wife.
After sitting and having tea for a while, the receptionist from earlier came over and brought a thick brochure.
"This lady is so pretty, the one accompanying you is your husband, right?" the receptionist asked with a smile.
Han Xuewei nodded shyly and said, "Yes, this is my husband. His surname is Lin. You can just call me Mrs. Lin."
The reason for her shyness was that she had not yet spoken about her marital status with Lin Yi in public before.
"Mrs. Lin, you're really fortunate, it's not common to see husbands coming along to learn about postpartum recovery with their wives. I think your husband must love you a lot!" said the receptionist, who also greeted Lin Yi with a smile.
After hearing this, Lin Yi responded with a light smile, indeed he loved Han Xuewei very much and wanted her to feel happy!
Han Xuewei's face turned slightly red, and with a smile beaming on her face, she replied, "Yes, my husband really loves me and spoils me a lot."
"Then may I ask Mrs. Lin, how long has it been since you gave birth?"
Han Xuewei replied, "In six more days I have to go to the hospital for a check-up, it's been 36 days." Han Xuewei thought for a moment and answered without hesitation.
"Then this timing is just right; it's perfect to start postpartum recovery," the receptionist suddenly asked, "Have you been cleansed properly after giving birth?"
"I was clean quite soon after giving birth," Han Xuewei answered, her gaze inadvertently sweeping over Lin Yi.
"You can start by looking at our brochure; it contains all the information related to postpartum recovery. Actually, postpartum recovery can also be done at hospitals, but it's impossible to get in the queue in the short term, it requires an appointment well in advance. By comparison, our service is more convenient; you can even make a reservation on the same day.
We have specialists who will provide services directly to you."
The receptionist spoke with patience, "Although we're just a beauty salon, we collaborate with many hospitals in Xiangcheng; our professionals have passed the assessment of hospitals, some are guided by doctors themselves, and our equipment is the same as that of hospitals, some of our treatments are even more effective than those in the hospitals."
"Since you've chosen us, please rest assured, our service will definitely be very comprehensive and satisfying."
"You can start by looking at our brochure which has detailed introductions."
Han Xuewei and Lin Yi picked up the brochure and began to flip through it page by page. Certain eye-catching words in the brochure made Han Xuewei blush.
Isn't this content a bit too direct?
After all, it's about postpartum recovery, focusing on the private parts of a woman, hence the brochure was all about that.
The receptionist naturally was not aware of Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's situation, and regarded them as a common couple, so was a bit more straightforward during the reception.
"May I ask how much your baby weighs?" the receptionist asked with a smile.
When Han Xuewei heard this, she couldn't help but feel puzzled, "My baby's weight? Does it even matter with this?"
"A lot actually. If the baby's weight is on the heavier side, it can cause a certain degree of damage to the mother's rectus abdominis during childbirth, similar to the principle of muscle strain," explained the receptionist.
Han Xuewei suddenly understood and asked, "Well, they are really triplets, and when the time came, two of the babies weighed four pounds each, and one was five pounds."
The receptionist's eyes were filled with astonishment after hearing this!
"Ah? You gave birth to three babies at once?? And each one's weight is on the larger side, it's hard to imagine how big your belly was!"
"Your pregnancy must have been tougher than that of other mothers!" the receptionist exclaimed in astonishment.
Han Xuewei nodded and said, "Yes, especially the last three months. It was really unbearable. And after giving birth to the three babies, I could feel that my stomach was a bit… uncomfortable. Maybe my body hasn't recovered yet. Apart from feeling lots of flab, I also feel... the skin is particularly loose."
Han Xuewei didn't really want to be so explicit, but since Lin Yi had already helped to clean her wound, he had seen everything, and now that they were here for recovery, there was nothing to hide.
After listening, the receptionist nodded earnestly and said, "This situation is inevitable for you, not only were the babies quite large, but there were also three of them. It's very hard for the belly stretched out that much to quickly return to normal, so what you need to repair most is your rectus abdominis.
The flab on your belly is not necessarily excess fat; it's very likely affecting your internal organs."
"Actually, the rectus abdominis can protect the belly, but since you gave birth to three babies at once, the degree of damage would certainly be much greater."
The receptionist patiently explained to Han Xuewei and Lin Yi, and Lin Yi also found the explanation very reasonable.
He had read about these things in books, so he was eager to take Han Xuewei for postpartum recovery. Han Xuewei cared a lot about her figure and, as he loved her, he wanted to help her.
The receptionist continued, "So for you right now, the most important thing is the recovery of the rectus abdominis, then to tighten up down there a bit more, which will make your private life experience better. However, this repair might be slightly more challenging as it involves the pelvis."
"Although your three babies were delivered by cesarean section, it definitely had a huge impact on your private life. Once a baby is born, it affects the whole body and creates major changes. But according to your situation, your pelvis and areas below are probably in better shape than for women who've had natural childbirth."
The receptionist didn't avoid Lin Yi's presence and was very clear about everything she mentioned.
However, when Han Xuewei heard words like private life experience and tighter down there, she became extremely flushed!
But upon hearing this, Lin Yi remained very calm and simply asked, "Can I make an appointment now? If possible, I'll pay right away."
The receptionist replied with a smile, "You can make an appointment! And you can get started in half an hour, can you wait, sir?"
Lin Yi replied, "Yes, that's fine. Do you also have other better skincare treatments? If so, let's make a membership card first."
After hearing this, the receptionist was visibly overjoyed, "We have many skincare treatments; sir, take a look at this."
She brought over an even larger brochure and began to introduce Lin Yi, "This is our most popular skincare treatment, and we are continually improving it. You could take a look."

chapters.title: Chapter 85 Handling the Supreme VIP
chapters.content:
"Mm." Lin Yi took over the brochure and flipped through it with Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei whispered in his ear, "You are so good to me, husband."
Lin Yi wrapped his arm around her and laughed, "Silly girl, isn't this what I'm supposed to do? It's my duty, and I know you care about your figure, so I want to take you for the best and most comprehensive care."
Han Xuewei nodded happily.
The receptionist had been quietly waiting by their side the whole time, and watching this scene unfold, she couldn't help but feel so envious!
The other one or two employees also stared straight over, their eyes fixed on them.
Why can't I meet such a good man?
Is this what other people's love is like?
Lin Yi flipped through the brochure back and forth and went straight to the last page, looking at the most expensive package, he slowly said, "This one seems more comprehensive, let's go with this one."
After pondering for a while, he asked, "Does your store provide home service?"
The receptionist was momentarily stunned, then hurriedly replied, "We can provide home service, but... it requires a VIP membership, the Supreme VIP."
"How do I apply for this Supreme VIP?" Lin Yi asked without hesitation.
"Sir, to become a Supreme VIP, you must first make a one-time top-up of three hundred thousand. If your wife wants to do any treatments later, she can deduct the cost by signing on the card. If you need home service, you can only get the regular skincare treatments. Other major repair projects require large equipment, so they are not convenient for home visits."
As Lin Yi listened, he flipped through the brochure back and forth, did some quick calculations, and then said directly, "Understood, I'll top up six hundred thousand first. For the postnatal recovery program, I want the highest level one. We'll see how the recovery goes after a while. For other skincare treatments, pick a few of the best and let's try each one out."
The receptionist was so excited upon hearing this that she nearly jumped on the spot!
A top-up of six hundred thousand!!!
She had worked at this store as a receptionist for so many years and had never seen such a straightforward customer! Absolutely extravagant!
Even the wealthiest clients would try topping up three hundred thousand first after seeing the prices, which was already the limit, and how many of those did you meet a year?
Today, someone actually did a one-time top-up of six hundred thousand! And it was a gentleman doing it for his wife to get the Supreme VIP! This was almost an unheard-of situation!
Who wouldn't feel sour seeing this?
Though the receptionist would get a nice commission from this transaction, at this moment, her feelings were not all that excited but more sour.
Han Xuewei was also startled upon hearing this. She was truly impressed by Lin Yi's generosity. Diamonds, cars, houses were all expensive and tangible.
But care was different, especially postnatal care. Many husbands think it's not a big deal, a mere comfort in their minds.
Clearly, Lin Yi did not think so and took it very seriously, valuing her very much!
It must be said, Han Xuewei was moved by his actions, she was close to bursting into tears.
At this time, Lin Yi also noticed that Han Xuewei's eyes were a bit reddish, so he held her more tightly and comforted her on the spot.
If there weren't so many employees around, he probably would have pulled Han Xuewei into his arms right then and there.
At this moment, the receptionist was busy setting up a special file for the couple, named the Supreme VIP card after Han Xuewei, and then brought over the platinum card.
The receptionist asked with a smile, "Sir, the charge is six hundred thousand, may I know how you would like to pay..."
Lin Yi took out a bank card directly, "Swiped this card."
...…
"Ka!"
It was successful!
He paid with his balance!
At the moment the amount was deducted, the system's voice in his mind rang as expected!
"Ding! Congratulations to the host, for taking your wife for postnatal care, you receive the system reward of a building in Xiangcheng City. The building's name is Wenqu Building, with a construction area of four thousand square meters, and a total area of fifteen thousand square meters."
Upon hearing this prompt, Lin Yi's eyes widened instantly!
Wow!!
This reward was really too strong, wasn't it?
It could absolutely be regarded as one of the most significant awards among the many he had received!
Wenqu Building is definitely one of the largest buildings in Xiangcheng, he never expected that the building would change hands in an instant!
He became the new owner!
The system was really generous!
This building is worth at least tens of billions now, right?
And now it's his??
At the same time, Lin Yi finally noticed a pattern regarding the system awards!
As long as he did some practical things for Han Xuewei, there was a high probability of completing some special tasks. There was another possibility, which was indirectly completing some tasks for the baby.
Like right now, taking his wife for postnatal care after the babies were born from Han Xuewei's belly, which was akin to fixing their cradles, therefore completing a special task.
Lin Yi kept guessing in his heart, and as he thought, he laughed, "The pattern is essentially one of these two. It's the arrival of the three babies that made me decide to be with Han Xuewei! That's what led to the appearance of the system! Moreover, there's always a connection between the baby and the mother. Doing something for one side is tantamount to doing it indirectly for the other.
That's why there's a trigger for the reward! But recently the system seems to have upgraded, making the rewards larger each time, how should that be explained?"
Lin Yi couldn't clear up this question, but instinctively believed that whenever he completed a special task, the system would gain experience, and in time, it would upgrade!
Yes! That's the most likely explanation!
The receptionist, seeing Lin Yi deep in thought and not receiving the Supreme VIP card, gave a big start, fearing that Lin Yi regretted his decision, so her hand holding the card trembled.
After a moment, Lin Yi quickly came back to his senses, looked up and saw the receptionist looking somewhat panicked and laughed as he took the card from her hand.
The receptionist finally exhaled a sigh of relief, it was a false alarm!
She quickly said, "Mrs. Lin, everything is ready now, you can start right away, please come with us."
"Mr. Lin, the waiting time might be a bit long, you can continue to have tea here, or go for a stroll in the mall. You can come to pick up Mrs. Lin after an hour."
"Remember to do the skincare treatments," Lin Yi reminded.
The receptionist said with a smile, "Yes, we will definitely not forget."
Han Xuewei said to Lin Yi, "You can take a casual stroll in the mall. I'll send you a WeChat message when I'm done here, and then we can get in touch."

chapters.title: Chapter 86: Chapter 86 Lingerie Specialty Store
chapters.content:
Lin Yi nodded at her words, and before he left, he didn't forget to give her a kiss, "Got it, I have plenty of ways to kill time, go ahead with your things!"
After bidding farewell to Lin Yi with a smile, Han Xuewei walked into the room with the receptionist.
Most clients at the beauty salon are women, though there is a small portion of male clients receiving treatments, privacy is ensured by separating them into different areas.
Once Han Xuewei was led into the room, another receptionist hurriedly brought magazines for Lin Yi, filled his cup with tea, and also brought over a large fruit platter.
All this was to help Lin Yi pass the lengthy hour easily, but he just thanked the receptionist and then left the beauty salon.
He wanted to stroll around the mall and pick a nice bag for Han Xuewei.
After all, she was his wife, and she should at least carry a beautiful bag for the charity evening event! How else could he uphold his own face? Otherwise, people might say he's stingy and unwilling to spend money on his wife! Once you reach a certain social status, people judge whether you are successful by the woman beside you.
If you love your wife, then you'll definitely be willing to spend money on her.
Qianda Shopping Mall could be counted as one of the top malls in the city, boasting various luxury brands, Chanel, LV, Hermes...
The women's bag section should be on the Fourth Layer, Lin Yi checked the sign and then took the elevator up.
Upon arriving at the Fourth Layer, he was met with a variety of big-name brands, some of which had their logos maximized to catch more attention—it was a veritable garden of brands!
To say the least, such a place bursting with luxury goods is simply paradise to women!
Many shops offer not just bags but also clothing, watches, and more.
The moment he saw the watches, Lin Yi couldn't help but feel tempted himself. He thought, he and Han Xuewei have never bought watches before, let alone the sort of prestigious, eye-catching ones.
Since they hadn't, why not buy one?
After browsing the Fourth Layer, Lin Yi finally chose a shop he admired, Rolex!
Surely, many people are familiar with this name! After all, its watches are very well-known globally!
As soon as he stepped into the watch store, a salesperson greeted him with a standard smile and asked, "Hello, sir, welcome to Hermes, is there a particular style you're fond of?"
While looking around, Lin Yi replied, "I'd like to have a look by myself first."
The attentive salesperson explained, "The watches in this area you're currently browsing are all sports models, the brown display counter in front features business styles, and the black display counter on your left features casual styles. Feel free to browse, and if you wish to try any on, I can assist you."
Lin Yi smiled impolitely and said, "Okay, I got it."
The saleswoman thought Lin Yi was just casually looking and unlikely to purchase a watch, so she just gave a general introduction.
Because many people who come to buy watches have usually done their research beforehand and can specify exactly what they want. Lin Yi's behavior was quite common, as luxury stores like these don't have customers every day.
Lin Yi looked closely and pondered.
After wandering the store for seven or eight minutes, he already had a watch in mind.
However, he shouldn't be hasty, it would be best to come back with Han Xuewei, let her pick one too, and concurrently help him make a choice; ideally, they could have matching watches for couples.
Vivi would definitely be delighted! Haha!
As Lin Yi thought about it, he couldn't help but laugh, then he leisurely strolled out, planning to browse some other places.
Just as he stepped out, he saw a lingerie store opposite him!
Vickedelic!
This brand, with a certain history, specializes in selling sexy lingerie for women, an English brand that maximally exhibits the nobility and maturity of modern women, much beloved by many ladies!
And it's considered in the top five in the circle, the pricing isn't particularly high, within reach for more than half of the female population!
But Lin Yi wasn't concerned about the price at this moment, his gaze was deeply captivated by a piece of lingerie displayed outside!
All at once, he seemed to have envisioned another scene, deep-rooted desires magnifying within him!
However, lingering so long at the entrance of a lingerie store, he indeed felt somewhat embarrassed. Just when he decided to switch angles, a man walked directly into the shop.
Lin Yi gulped, straightened his clothes, and then strode toward the Vickedelic store!
Good heavens!
It truly had everything one could imagine! You couldn't think of anything they didn't sell!
The lingerie hanging inside was one prettier and more exquisite than the next!
As a man, Lin Yi began to blush at the sight of these undergarments.
A seven-foot-tall man in a lingerie store, and particularly one that specializes in women's erotic lingerie! If it were anyone less bold, they wouldn't even dare to enter the door!
Although it was Lin Yi's first visit here, he was already overwhelmingly excited!
After choosing for about fifteen minutes, Lin Yi picked out the lingerie he'd set his eye on, quickly informed the clerk of the sizes, swiftly paid, and then walked out the door carrying several shopping bags!
After such aimless wandering, forty minutes had passed. Lin Yi consolidated the items in the shopping bags into one, planning to show them to Han Xuewei in the evening and give them to her very formally.
But he was still a bit anxious inside, what if Vivi didn't wear them?
The bags and watches he had picked out earlier would be best bought together with Han Xuewei, shopping together would be more meaningful. Moreover, before they had their baby, the couple frequented the mall, so some of the shop managers recognized them.
Holding the shopping bag, Lin Yi felt a bit awkward for a moment, as if wanting to flee from somewhere, he quickly left the floor and hurried back to the beauty salon.
However, Han Xuewei was still inside undergoing skincare treatments, with one small treatment left, so she wouldn't be out for another twenty minutes.
Upon Lin Yi's entrance, the front desk greeted him with an immediate beaming smile.
As soon as Lin Yi walked through the door of the beauty salon, he appeared much more serious, sitting down with great propriety.
He stuffed the shopping bag behind him, then put on a calm expression, and with a slightly trembling hand, he slowly lifted the cup on the table and took a sip of tea, settling his excited mood.

chapters.title: Chapter 87: Chapter 87 Rolex Couple Watches
chapters.content:
After a while, Han Xuewei returned to the lobby, led by a sales associate.
"Husband!" Han Xuewei was extremely excited upon seeing Lin Yi.
Lin Yi also stood up and approached.
Han Xuewei had just finished her skincare treatment and her skin looked much whiter and tender than before, which made Lin Yi very satisfied.
At that moment, Han Xuewei turned her gaze to the shopping bags in Lin Yi's hands and asked, "Eh? Did you go shopping? What did you buy?"
"Ah? I... it's nothing, just bought a couple of clothes," Lin Yi answered, breaking into a cold sweat at her question. Right now, his biggest worry was that Han Xuewei might suddenly want to check the clothes in the bag!
If that were the case, it would have been a disaster! Wouldn't that be social death in public?
Luckily, Han Xuewei simply responded with a light "Oh, did you buy them for yourself?"
Not knowing how to answer, Lin Yi responded to the wrong question, "Just a few pieces of underwear, nothing serious."
After hearing this, Han Xuewei instantly realized she had almost wanted to take a look. She hadn't expected Lin Yi to have bought underwear!
She quickly corrected herself, "Mm, I got it. Were you bored waiting outside? We can go home now, or do you still want to shop around?"
Lin Yi said, "While you were inside for the treatment, I looked around on the Fourth Layer and took a liking to a Rolex watch. It looked pretty nice, and I really like it."
Han Xuewei, ever considerate, said, "Then let's go have a look now."
If her husband truly liked it, she would definitely support him!
Han Xuewei followed Lin Yi up to the Fourth Layer, heading straight for the Rolex store.
The sales associate showed a hint of surprise upon seeing Lin Yi, especially since he was accompanied by a woman.
She hurried over to greet them, "Sir, Miss, hello to both of you."
Han Xuewei replied politely: "Mm, hello."
Lin Yi turned to Han Xuewei and said, "The watch I like is over there. It's a couple's watch, but I didn't dare to make a decision for you, so I wanted to ask your opinion first. Let's go take a look!"
Lin Yi led Han Xuewei directly to a counter and, following the direction of his finger, she saw a set of couple's watches.
"This is the one I chose. What do you think? Does it look good?" Lin Yi asked earnestly, waiting for her response.
Han Xuewei too was attracted by the dazzling array of watches inside the counter and began carefully comparing them.
And the female sales associate was even more amazed!
Because all the watches in that counter were automatic mechanical watches priced in the millions! If they were to buy the couple's set as he mentioned, the price would shoot up to more than 2.6 million!
The man's watch was priced at 1,249,342 yuan, while the woman's watch cost 1,367,925 yuan.
The design of the couple's watches was very similar, both with round dials and automatic movements, and interchangeable straps. Every detail was very eye-catching.
The price of the woman's watch was a bit higher than the man's because there were a few small diamonds on the dial, making it more in tune with a woman's temperament.
Moreover, it's worth mentioning that this couple's watch was not launched very long ago. It's a new model that has just entered the market, which can be considered a Valentine's Day limited edition.
Since it is a limited edition, the price is definitely going to be higher.
Thus, throughout the entire Xiangcheng, not many people can afford this couple's watch, and this counter hasn't sold more than ten sets. It's completely impossible to encounter the embarrassment of "watch-clashing" with someone else.
The salesperson smiled and said, "You two really have an eye for quality! This watch is a limited edition released by our brand for Valentine's Day. If you like it, you can try it on, and both watches here are brand new, in unopened condition."
"Because this watch is so popular, every couple who has tried it on has bought it," the salesperson confidently asserted.
After all, several couples had tried on this watch on her recommendation and ended up liking it so much that they naturally bought it. If today Lin Yi were to make a purchase as well, her sales performance would break through five pairs!
And it only took a brief observation of the two people's expressions at that moment to come to a conclusion—they were very likely to make a purchase!
Han Xuewei took a close look at the price tag and couldn't help but be taken aback. She hadn't expected the watch to be so expensive, costing over a million!
But she also knew that if Lin Yi really liked it, he wouldn't blink an eye before buying it straight away, so she wasn't worried about the money.
Han Xuewei was now just wondering if they had been spending a bit too much these days? Close to 900 million had been spent, and now they had their eyes on this couple's watch. If they really were to buy it, it would cost another 2.6 million!
If she hadn't married Lin Yi and started a family, she might never have imagined herself wearing such an expensive watch!
In the end, Han Xuewei was still somewhat moved.
However, while she was distracted, Lin Yi asked the salesperson to let them try on the couple's watch.
Lin Yi himself put the watch on Han Xuewei.
It had to be said, it was indeed beautiful!
What's more important was that it was a couple's style, both of them wearing it looked quite nice.
Han Xuewei couldn't help but smile, and Lin Yi seeing this, directly asked, "What do you think? Looks good, right?"
Han Xuewei nodded her head, "Yeah, it's quite nice."
It had to be said, her husband had great taste, and since he liked it, she definitely had no objections.
Without any hesitation, Lin Yi told the salesperson, "We'll take this one, please pack it for us."
The salesperson, upon hearing this, was still in a daze, doubting her hearing, and so she asked again, "Ah? You're saying you'll take this watch?"
Lin Yi: "Yeah, I'll take this couple's watch."
At this time, Han Xuewei also watched the salesperson with a smile, without saying much.
The salesperson, flustered and hurried, took out a very vintage packaging box, carefully placed the two watches inside, and then led Lin Yi to the checkout.
Arriving at the cashier, the salesperson took out a calculator and a card reader.
She said to them both, "Sir, Miss, I can now upgrade you to a diamond member for free, and you can enjoy an 8.8% discount on all purchases in our store. The total price for the couple's watch you're purchasing today is 2,617,267 yuan. After an 8.8% discount, it comes to 2,303,194 yuan."
As soon as the salesperson finished quoting the price, Lin Yi immediately took out a card, "Swipe the card!"

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Chapter 88 Another Double Return?
chapters.content:
The sales associate at that moment was beyond excited, hurriedly taking the bank card that Lin Yi handed over.
"Ka-ching!"
There was no doubt about it, the transaction was approved!
Almost at that instant, Lin Yi recalled another prompt from the system!
"Ding! Congratulations to the host, for regular spending with your wife, you have received a reward — double the amount spent will be returned!"
Right after that, he received a text message. Upon closer inspection, it was a bank transfer notification—4,606,388 yuan credited to his account, not a penny less!
In that very moment, Lin Yi no longer wanted the sales associate to give him an 8.8% discount!
Even though the discount was applied, it meant he received significantly less money back!
However, even so, there was a considerable amount of interest accumulating in his card.
The sales associate respectfully returned the card to Lin Yi, and also handed over the watch packed in a gift box along with a membership card.
As the two left the store, Han Xuewei looped her arm through Lin Yi's and asked, "Are we going home now, or shall we continue to look around elsewhere?"
Lin Yi smiled and said, "Of course we're going to browse more. Today we're going to splurge with no restraints!"
He then led Han Xuewei from shop to shop. They visited many stores, buying bags and accessories, and in less than two hours, they had spent hundreds of thousands more.
Lin Yi took his purchases to the underground parking lot and placed them in the car, then he returned to the mall to continue their spree!
All shopping expenses would be doubled and returned by the system!
The feeling was indescribably exhilarating! It was as if he couldn't run out of money even if he tried!
When the couple finally got home, Han Xuewei categorized all the things they bought that day, as some of the items were gifts for the family members.
Han Xuewei took out three shopping bags, inside which were two thermal garments, a woolen coat, and a silk scarf—all purchased for Mother Lin.
Seeing that her son and daughter-in-law had bought so much for her after just one trip out, Mother Lin was overjoyed. When she learned that Han Xuewei had taken the initiative to buy and choose them, she praised her, saying, "Vivi is so thoughtful. You might not believe it, but Lin Yi has never bought me much since he was little! What a good daughter-in-law I have found, I am truly blessed."
Han Xuewei smiled and said, "Mom, rest assured, I will treat you just like my own mother."
Mother Lin's smile grew even wider, "Good, I couldn't be happier to have a daughter-in-law like you. Beautiful and sensible, truly a paragon of virtue. Our Lin Family is blessed to have you marry into it!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi couldn't help but interject, "Mom, how can you say that about me? Who says I never bought you anything? I've bought you plenty of snacks."
After listening to this, Mother Lin didn't hesitate to rib him, "You have the nerve to mention that? Weren't those snacks always eaten by you alone? And they were all your favorites anyway. Plus, when did I ever say I loved snacks?"
Lin Yi retorted without missing a beat, "Mom, that's not fair, you ate half of my spicy strips!"
Lin Yi vaguely remembered his mom used to be like a little girl, unable to control herself around snacks—perhaps now that she was getting older, she had to start taking care of her health!
Mother Lin huffed in feigned annoyance, then carried the big and small packages that Han Xuehui had brought back to her bedroom.
Mother Lin was very clear in her heart that it was her daughter-in-law who had suggested buying these things, but in the end, it was definitely her son who paid for them. However, as people age, they tend to find happiness quite easily.
Lin Yi and Tang Xuewei saw Mother Lin return to her room, and then the two of them moved the rest of the items upstairs.
They hadn't finished sorting through everything yet; some were for Lin Yi's father, and others were gifts for Han Xuewei's parents. Since no one else was around at the moment, they had to store all these items in the warehouse.
Han Xuewei and Lin Yi happened to pass by the nursery, and coincidentally, the three babies had just woken up. Han Xuewei hurried in to take care of the babies, while Lin Yi was left to organize the remaining items on his own.
He first unpacked all of the outer packaging and then neatly arranged everything.
When he got to the last few items, he unpacked the lingerie he had bought and casually hung it on the clothes rack.
Lin Yi took a look and realized that the lingerie was a bit too revealing; the weather had turned cold these past few days, and it seemed like wearing them might lead to a chill!
Just as he was about to hang the last piece of lingerie, the bedroom door opened, and in came Han Xuewei.
She immediately saw the sexy lingerie Lin Yi was holding, which was even transparent, and her cheeks turned pink.
Lin Yi had actually bought this in the mall!
So the shopping bag she had been holding in her hand all this time contained...
Obviously, it wasn't for herself, but something for her to wear...
At this moment, Han Xuewei stood at the bedroom door, staring blankly at Lin Yi, her eyes full of embarrassment, and he was clearly even more embarrassed than she was!
Lin Yi had planned to hang them all up so that Han Xuewei would find them when changing clothes, but the two of them had faced each other face to face, and now he was still spreading out that lingerie to admire it! How could he let Han Xuewei catch him with such a lecherous expression on his face!!!
Damn it!
Isn't this just social suicide?
Lin Yi was at a loss for what to do and eventually just stiffly hung the lingerie up, then said to Han Xuewei, "I've taken out all the things I bought for you. The bags are in the cabinet now, and I haven't had time to hang the clothes up yet. Uh, do you want to do it or should I?"
Han Xuewei didn't speak, but quietly came over to Lin Yi's side: "Honey, do you really like this kind?"
After hearing this, Lin Yi was completely startled; he had thought Han Xuewei would just blush and say nothing, but he didn't expect her to ask him such a question!
Lin Yi's face turned red and his heart raced; for a moment, he was at a loss for words!
He laughed nervously a couple of times: "Ah… uh… I… just thought they looked nice..."
Han Xuewei gave a sly smile: "Then when we have time... I'll wear it..."
"But I've never tried these before... I don't know if I can meet your expectations..."
Han Xuewei hadn't finished speaking when Lin Yi quickly said, "You'll definitely look good in them, you're even better than those models in winter..."
As he spoke, he suddenly realized something and hurriedly closed his mouth!
Han Xuewei smiled softly and said in a low voice, "It's okay, honey. We're family now; we're a married couple with a certificate, so there's nothing to be shy about... you don't need to be so indirect..."

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Chapter 89 Just These Few Hobbies
chapters.content:
After a long period of inner struggle, Han Xuewei finally understood that there's nothing embarrassing about opening up and discussing certain topics when the two of them were husband and wife.
She had been very proactive from the beginning, which led to the outcomes that followed, but as a woman, she still hoped to retain a certain level of dignity.
Seeing Lin Yi do such a thing today, she thought it was pretty normal.
After all, life should have a bit of romance to be good.
Lin Yi chuckled, pulled Han Xuewei into his arms, and whispered in her ear, "As a man, these are pretty much the only hobbies I have. If one day you feel better, try them on, so I can admire you too."
Han Xuemei blushed and nodded softly in response.
The young couple hugged each other tightly once again.
With the 42-day postpartum check-up approaching fast, Lin Yi had made thorough preparations for it.
On the day of the check-up, Lin Yi woke up very early, and Han Xuewei had made an appointment for her postpartum examination a few days in advance, having to be at the hospital by nine o'clock.
So as soon as eight o'clock passed, the two of them got out of bed together. It was tough to wake up so early, especially since Han Xuewei had to wake up to feed the babies at night and usually couldn't get up until after nine in the morning.
On their way to the hospital, Han Xuewei, sitting in the passenger seat, fell asleep after a while. Lin Yi, seeing this, felt helpless; it really wasn't easy for a mother to breastfeed her treasure body!
When they arrived at the hospital for the check-up, the time was just right, but as there were quite a few people who had booked in advance, they still had to wait a bit longer, and since it was a weekend, such a scenario was all too common.
Han Xuewei fell asleep against Lin Yi while waiting outside, and when their number was called, he woke her up so they could enter the department together.
The doctor looked through Han Xuewei's file, showed a trace of surprise, and asked directly, "So you're the mother who gave birth to triplets that everyone has been talking about! You've really done a fantastic job!"
"Judging from the weight of the babies delivered by cesarean section, it's clear that you've had a very successful prenatal care!"
Han Xuemei smiled and nodded, "Yes, two babies were four pounds each, and one was five pounds."
The doctor, looking at the computer, said slowly, "Since you've had triplets, you must take good care of your rectus abdominis muscle, which has been significantly damaged, and that can greatly affect your health."
Han Xuewei nodded, "Yes, my husband has already taken me to the beauty salon, and I've been undergoing postpartum recovery these days."
"Oh? It seems your husband is quite insightful, but the postpartum check-up we're going to do today is also very important. Go and pay first, then come back. We'll schedule an ultrasound for you first. Don't worry, you don't need to hold your urine for this ultrasound today."
Han Xuewei nodded, "Okay, we'll come back as soon as we've paid."
Lin Yi also stood up to express his gratitude, then went to pay the fees.
After paying the fees, she returned to find the nurse, and then Han Xuewei went for the check-up.
After waiting for about half an hour, Han Xuewei got the results of the examination.
She looked at them and found some of the medical terms incomprehensible, so she and Lin Yi went to find a doctor together.
"The doctor who did my ultrasound earlier said that my recovery has been better than he anticipated," she relayed.
As they were talking, they returned to the initial department where the doctor took the results, scrutinized them, and then said, "Good, your recovery is going very well, and your anemia has improved a lot.
Your file notes that you had significant bleeding during the caesarean section, causing your hemoglobin levels to be below standard before discharge, but the current data shows your recovery is looking great!"
"Though the report is positive, I still recommend that you continue to reinforce your Qi-Blood once you're home, so it can better regulate and ensure a more thorough recovery."
"Postpartum repair must not stop. Currently, your rectus abdominis is not looking optimistic, and its function has not fully recovered. You can see your belly is noticeably larger; you might think it's just a thick layer of fat, but in reality, it's due to the accumulation of your internal organs.
No matter what, you must ensure the health and proper function of the rectus abdominis since it's an important protector of your internal organs! Fortunately, you've already started postpartum repair, and from what we can see in the results now, it's gradually improving. I hope you will continue to persevere until it's fully repaired!"
Lin Yi committed the doctor's words to memory and said earnestly, "Alright, we will definitely keep it up!"
When the couple left the hospital, Lin Yi took Han Xuewei straight to the pharmacy and bought a huge amount of supplements for replenishing Qi and Blood, including enough bird's nest to last a month!
Lin Yi had one principle when selecting supplements: choose the most expensive, as he believed the most expensive were the best. As a result, the expenses came in at least to a total of 150,000 yuan.
Fortunately, the system was still offering a double reward return today!
Now, if something can be bought with money, Lin Yi would purchase it without hesitation!
Lin Yi immediately told Han Xuewei, "Starting from tomorrow, the two Maternity Matrons will continue to work. I'll instruct them to prepare a bowl of bird's nest every day so you can drink it at night, along with various other supplements. You'll have to eat whatever they make. You can't skip any of it."
"And I will be monitoring you constantly. Right now, the most important thing is to replenish your Qi-Blood."
Han Xuewei responded with a frightened look, "Ah? How is that possible? I was planning to start losing weight this month..."
Lin Yi shook his head repeatedly, "No dieting, health is most important, and I think you're fine just as you are."
"But if I follow your recommendations for supplementation, with several kinds a day, I'll become even fatter within a week..." Han Xuewei hurriedly argued.
"You must listen to your husband, no arguing! There will be plenty of opportunities to lose weight in the future. Once you've regained your strength, if you really want to lose weight, I will hire a Nutritionist to specially design a diet and workout plan for you, ensuring you get back to your previous figure.
However, the priority now is to build up your body, or you might suffer health issues in the future. You must stick to the supplements I bought," Lin Yi asserted with a commanding tone, not allowing any room for refusal.
Han Xuewei had no choice but to comply, "Ah... then I'll listen to you..."
And just then, the familiar notification sound rang out in Lin Yi's mind!

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Chapter 90 New Skills
chapters.content:
"Ding, congratulations to the host for buying supplements for your wife, the reward you've earned this time is the skill—Nutritionist!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was overjoyed, and he couldn't help but wonder, is the system constantly capturing my thoughts? How come it delivers precisely what I'm thinking about?
If that's the case, then when I get back, I'll definitely make a meal plan for my wife myself! I'll have the Aunties cook according to the meal plan every day! That way, the whole family can enjoy nutritious meals!
While calculating this in his mind, Lin Yi drove towards the beauty center at Qianda Shopping Plaza with Han Xuewei.
According to the repair treatment schedule, the care for today would still be for the entire body, and these past two days an additional item had been added, something involving mugwort nourishment.
Lin Yi, eager to accompany his wife through the treatment, waited silently outside for nearly two hours, realizing it was too late to make lunch.
By the time Han Xuewei finished her treatment, it was already two o'clock in the afternoon, Lin Yi was quite hungry, but he waited outside quietly, determined to have lunch with Han Xuewei after her treatment.
Seeing that the evening party was approaching fast, Lin Yi was keen on taking his wife with him, and likewise hoped she could adjust her condition well, since after all, health is most important.
Moreover, Lin Yi had taken the opportunity to call the manager of Gezi's custom-made dresses to confirm the time of the party, so they could just wait for the car that afternoon.
After Han Xuewei walked out from the treatment room, she ran straight to Lin Yi and hugged him, whispering in his ear, "I was feeling a bit of milk engorgement during the treatment, so I had the staff help me out a little."
After hearing this, Lin Yi smiled and said, "No wonder it took so long today, I was getting worried about you. By the way, I've already told Aunt Wang that we would be having lunch outside today, so just tell me what you want to eat, and I'll take you there."
Han Xuewei nodded, "We delayed too long today, and I'm really hungry now... I only had a little millet porridge before leaving this morning, I feel like I have no strength now, I even had the staff fetch me a piece of cake during the treatment."
Lin Yi held Han Xuewei and said, "You've worked hard, baby, let's go have something delicious now. It's okay to delay occasionally, as long as you keep up with these repair treatments, that's what matters most."
"Oh, the evening party is tomorrow, and I have already scheduled a home visit from Gezi's dress fitters."
Han Xuewei thought for a moment, "Hmm, schedule a home skincare service as well, so after the skincare, I can put on makeup and head out."
Lin Yi quickly went to the beauty shop's front desk to arrange the appointment, and then he and Han Xuewei went up to the highest floor of the mall, which was entirely dedicated to dining.
The two had a quick lunch in the mall and wandered around a bit before heading home around five in the afternoon.
Before dinner, Lin Yi told Aunt Wang ahead of time that he and Vivi weren't very hungry yet, so they would have dinner a bit later.
The couple hadn't visited their baby for a whole day, and now they planned to head straight to the nursery.
No sooner had Han Xuewei entered the house than she changed her clothes and washed her hands before heading to the nursery. Lin Yi's mother called him over and asked, "How did Vivi's postpartum check-up go today? What did the doctor say?"
Lin Yi said with ease, "The data shows she's recovering quite well, but she must continue to replenish her qi and blood. The doctor insists on persistence. Mom, I bought a lot of tonics today. If you have time later on, could you make some for Vivi? Boil some soup or prepare some bird's nest for her."
Lin Yi continued, "Oh, and I bought a lot of bird's nest today, enough for our family to eat for a month. You can make extra, so everyone can enjoy it together!"
Having said that, Lin Yi pointed to another bag and said, "This bag contains medicinal herbs, supplements in other words. I wasn't as financially capable in the past and never thought about buying these tonics for mom, just remembered that you liked spicy strips and enjoyed all sorts of snacks with me. Now, as your son's financial situation has improved, I've also learned to care for you more.
This bag is yours, the other is for my mother-in-law, and the rest is for Vivi. Nothing is more important than health. From now on, you all must take good care of yourselves!"
Lin Yi's mother was very touched by her son's words and couldn't help but feel that her son had really grown up so much! Especially after having his own family, the change had been transformative!
Lin Yi's mother spoke earnestly, "Oh, son, it makes mom very happy that you think of these things. Not only do you know how to look after your home now, but you also care for the people around you."
"However, I still have some concerns. Mom knows you have many shares and have amassed a fair amount of wealth. Still, I hope that in the future, you will own a business that's entirely yours."
"Your father and I are getting older and nearing retirement, but we're still holding on. Throughout a person's life, from birth to aging, one must always keep learning. If one day your father and I must retire, then everything about the company must be handed over to you."
Lin Yi's mother shared so much all at once, and Lin Yi absorbed it all. He knew this day would inevitably come, and he couldn't avoid it.
Lin Yi took a deep breath and said to his mother, "Mom, I understand your thoughts completely, and when that day comes as expected, I will certainly be a competent successor! My current idea is to relocate the company to the city center."
Lin Yi's mother replied, "Your father doesn't see it that way. I told you the other day, his wish is to move the company to a location closer to home."
"Have you already chosen a place to move to?" Lin Yi suddenly asked.
"We haven't found a suitable location yet, and even the office buildings a little closer to here are quite expensive. Nearly half a year's income would go to rent, and these locations are very sought after. It's not easy to find an appropriate place right away," said Lin Yi's mother, clearly finding the issue challenging.
Lin Yi continued to inquire, "How big an office are you planning to rent? Why don't we expand the company in the city center?"
After listening to Lin Yi, his mother shook her head repeatedly, "Well, the head office is manageable; even a few hundred square meters would suffice. But if we want to expand in the city center, too small won't do. We'd need at least a thousand square meters! That would be a significant expense!"
Lin Yi responded calmly, "You can discuss with dad. If you really like the idea, or think it's feasible, then don't worry about the rest. Leave it to me. I have several friends who can give me advice. There's always a way, and besides, this isn't difficult."

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Chapter 91 General Manager of Wenqu Building
chapters.content:
Lin Yi's mother: "Hmm, if it's really possible, of course that would be best. If your friend could help, that would be wonderful. Your father and I have fewer acquaintances in the city."
Lin Yi's parents' net worth is quite high, even reaching over ten billion at their peak. However, in the grand scheme of Xiangcheng, they are only considered slightly wealthy with no significant reputation or extensive social connections.
Yet, to some real tycoons, such wealth could only be described as a comfortable living at best!
Lin Yi chatted with his mother for a while, his mind still on the system reward he had received a few days ago, the Wenqu Building!
The building was not small in scale, at least it was the largest in the city center! It had a building area of about four thousand square meters, with a total area of fifteen thousand!
Lin Yi quickly communicated with the system, inquiring about the property manager of that building.
He got a bit of information from the system about the property manager and directly dialed the number provided.
After several rings, a male voice came from the other end of the line.
As soon as the general manager picked up the phone, he said very courteously, "Mr. Lin, hello, it's an honor to receive your call. Let me introduce myself, I am the general property manager of Wenqu Building. My name is Jiao Xingbiao; you can call me Jiao. What can I do for you? Is there anything I can assist you with?"
Lin Yi had already anticipated that the general manager would know him, so he calmly asked, "I want to ask if there are any vacant floors currently in Wenqu Building? I am interested in renting them out."
Jiao Xingbiao blurted out his reply to Lin Yi without any hesitation, clearly very knowledgeable about Wenqu Building.
"Mr. Lin, here is the situation: we currently have some spaces available on both the first and second floors, with identical layouts—nine hundred square meters on the first floor, eight hundred on the second. Our building has a total of forty-two floors, and as of now, there are still twenty office spaces vacant, each ranging from 277 to 388 square meters."
"May I ask what you need the space for, Mr. Lin?" Jiao Xingbiao asked, following his explanation.
"The offices are quite spacious. Are there any adjacent ones available? I'm in urgent need. If there are some on the lower floors available for rent, please let me know first."
His parents had not yet agreed on whether to expand the company's business in the city center, but considering relocating the headquarters here could be a good option.
Jiao Xingbiao, worthy of his position as the general property manager, immediately grasped Lin Yi's intent. Since Lin Yi personally inquired about this matter, it meant it was of significant importance, so Jiao Xingbiao firmly kept this in mind.
He hastily responded, "Of course, rest assured."
"There happen to be two adjacent offices vacant on the 32nd floor. I will instruct right now to reserve those offices for you."
Lin Yi: "Hmm."
Jiao Xingbiao continued, "Mr. Lin, July is just around the corner, and all of the building's rent for the first half of the year has been collected. Once the finance department has processed everything, the funds will be transferred to your account immediately. Please check your account by then."
Lin Yi became intrigued upon hearing this and inquired, "How much is the rent for the first half of the year approximately?"
Jiao Xingbiao replied, "After deducting all necessary expenses, you should have about three billion left, which will be transferred into your account by July 5th. Please Mr. Lin, check your account then!"
Lin Yi: "I understand, thank you for your efforts."
Jiao Xingbiao: "It's no trouble, no trouble at all, this is my duty."
Lin Yi didn't say much else and hung up the phone.
When Jiao Xingbiao saw Lin Yi's call, his heart tightened, and he broke out into a cold sweat.
He originally thought that Lin Yi's call was to question him about the delay in collecting rent!
In the past, everything would've been handled by the middle of June, and the money would've been transferred immediately. However, recently a company renting office space in the building had financial issues and delayed paying their rent for a few days. But Jiao Xingbiao had already ordered that they pay the rent within three days, or they would have to pack up and move out!
He had not expected that Lin Yi's call was to inquire about the vacant office spaces.
The call had indeed given him quite a scare! It turned out to be a false alarm!
No matter what, he had to protect his job—that was his cash cow!
As the largest building in the city center and a landmark, Wenqu Building was extremely popular. The profit from the building was also very substantial, with a net profit of a million in just one month; thus, making tens of millions in a year was a breeze!
He had to find a way to keep Lin Yi satisfied at all costs!
After speaking with Jiao Xingbiao, Lin Yi couldn't calm his emotions for a long time; he felt an extreme joy that left his brain blank for a moment!
Without having to lift a finger, he could receive three billion in net income in just half a year!
Could he be anything but excited?
Without doing anything himself, the rent from Wenqu Building, combined with the dividends from Fuwa Baby, would generate several billion in profit in just half a year!
What did this mean? He wouldn't have to worry about money for the rest of his life!
After calming his excitement, he immediately found his mother and said straightaway, "Mom, I have some great news. I've found a large office space in the city center. If you decide to expand the business downtown, we could take quite a bit of space! Will 1,700 square meters be enough?"
Lin Yi's family business was in the food industry, which included the expansion into large supermarkets, though the supermarket venture was a joint investment with others.
Lin Yi's mother paused and then said, "I need to discuss this with your father, to hear his thoughts."
"I was just talking to your dad on the phone. Guess what he's thinking? He actually wants to sell his shares and peacefully spend time at home with his grandchildren, quietly enjoying retirement. He said some business partners are not so easy to deal with, and the incident that happened before left your dad distressed for months!"
Lin Yi thought for a moment, then confidently said, "I support my dad's decision, and he doesn't need to worry. If it comes to it, he still has his son to provide for him!"
After hearing this, Lin Yi's mother laughed and said, "We don't need you to provide for us. If your father really wants to sell his shares, he'll have at least a billion or two!
