Not just for the two of us to retire—we could open a retirement home with that amount! Actually, these days I've been thinking about how to arrange your and Vivi's education in the future, w? What about the wedding ceremony?
Shouldn't we hurry and make up for it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 92 A Wedding Do-Over
chapters.content:
"You can't wrong Vivi, nor can you think getting a marriage certificate is the end of it. Nowadays, young girls value romance; who doesn't dream of a fairy-tale, romantic wedding? You must fulfill this wish for her," Lin Yi's mother advised.
"Oh, whenever we talk about these things, I remember when your dad and I got married. Forget about any grand dowry; we didn't even take wedding photos. I always felt like we missed out," she added regretfully.
Lin Yi chuckled and said, "I've been thinking about this lately, but I planned to discuss it with Vivi and her parents first. We'll arrange it however they wish."
Lin Yi's mother nodded and continued, "Right, that makes sense. Both sides' opinions should be taken into account. By the way, you little rascal, have you proposed to Vivi yet? Life must be romantic; no matter what, you have to treat my daughter-in-law well and must not neglect her!"
Lin Yi hurriedly replied, "Ah, Mom, don't worry about that. I proposed before we went to get the marriage certificate!"
"Smart boy, but don't ever follow your dad's footsteps. When your dad and I got married, he was literally penniless. I followed him without a second thought. We're getting on in years now, and after all this time, he's never thought to buy me a replacement ring or anything! It still gets me angry," Lin Yi's mother complained.
Hearing this, Lin Yi also snickered, then replied, "I'll be sure to pass your message successfully to dad!"
The mother and son chatted for a while before each going about their own business.
When Lin Yi returned to the bedroom, Han Xuewei was already asleep, deeply resting.
After all, she had been out all day and had just finished breastfeeding the baby, so she was certainly feeling exhausted.
The three little ones had had their milk, but their eyes were wide open, showing no signs of sleepiness. Moreover, they needed to be held; otherwise, they'd easily cry.
Seeing the babies like this, Lin Yi couldn't help but be filled with emotion. The little ones were growing up so fast; they looked different almost every day.
Lin Yi had been quite busy these days and hadn't had the time to hold them much. Now, he realized how big the changes were when he picked up the three little ones!
The three little ones were very clever and seemed to know they were in their father's arms. They were quite happy when picked up, especially the little girl, Mengmeng. Whenever Lin Yi held her, he could hear her making "eheh-ahah" sounds, as if she was trying to talk to him!
It must be said that every father would find it hard to refuse such wonderful moments with their children. But Lin Yi had his career to develop in the future, and many busy days ahead, so he'd likely not have a lot of time to spend with them. That meant he had to treasure these moments even more now!
Just then, a system prompt sounded in his mind!
"Ding! Congratulations, Host, for successfully interacting with the three babies. You have been rewarded with three million yuan by the system!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi smiled lightly. Perhaps because it was the first time Mengmeng had tried to talk to him, the system considered it a significant bonding interaction and rewarded him generously!
On regular days, just changing a diaper or making formula for the babies would get him at the most a few hundred thousand.
So the day passed and by lunchtime, the beauty center came for a home service spa treatment for Han Xuewei.
At that time, Han Xuewei was about to take a nap, feeling sleepy, so she lay down and started to enjoy the treatment.
It took a full two hours to complete the skincare and maintenance routine, and the staff from the Gossi Dress Shop arrived as promised.
There were four people who came along, besides the store employee Lin Yi felt impressed by the other day, there was also a makeup artist, a business car driver, and a stylist.
These four individuals would accompany them to the gala venue and wait outside for the entire event, until Lin Yi and Han Xuewei had just finished attending the gala before taking them back home, at which their task would be considered thoroughly completed.
They brought with them Han Xuewei's limited-edition gown and also, with the help of the stylist, put on the full set of "True Love Baby" diamond jewelry.
Looking at the goddess-like Han Xuewei, Lin Yi was captivated, unable to deny that Han Xuewei would definitely be the focus of the entire gala!
The beautiful gown, complemented by the dazzling array of diamond jewelry, only served to accentuate Han Xuewei's high level of attractiveness, making her exceptionally beautiful and captivating!
This Orlan charity gala is very famous nationwide and is even one of the few large-scale charity galas.
Those who attend the gala are generally celebrities, many well-known figures from different industries, and even stars active in the top tiers of the entertainment industry. If not for special circumstances, they would definitely attend the gala.
As the two of them arrived at their destination and got out of the car, what came into view was a red carpet spanning over a hundred meters. Everyone attending the gala was dressed incredibly stunningly and acted with utmost elegance, making the scene resemble a competition of flourishing beauty.
The Orlan gala itself is wasteful, occurring only once a year, and it was precisely because this year's event location was chosen to be in Xiangcheng that Lin Yi, the wealthy tycoon, was definitely invited. He was even the first person to receive the invitation.
Han Xuewei linked arms with Lin Yi, and the two of them stepped onto the red carpet with great solemnity.
The suit chosen by Lin Yi was grey, which matched perfectly with Han Xuewei's white evening gown.
Both were wearing the couple's watches they had selected at Hermes, and Han Xuewei's limited-edition diamond jewelry was equally eye-catching.
Her figure-hugging evening gown perfectly sculpted her figure, outlining it beautifully. Her small cheeks, illuminated by the lights, were rosy and even looked slightly chubby, making Lin Yi want to give her a kiss.
Moreover, Han Xuewei was in her nursing period during this time, so she really did have curves in all the right places!
But in that moment, unbeknownst to both of them, Li Jingwen in her purple body-hugging dress was staring intently at Han Xuewei through the crowd! If looks could kill, Han Xuewei would have been injured a thousand times over by now!
How could Li Jingwen not be jealous? She was almost losing control of her emotions due to her envy.
Li Jingwen stood there still pondering, but her companion Yang Fan urged her not to dawdle and to head inside quickly.
After the two of them entered from the red carpet, Li Jingwen claimed she needed to touch up her makeup in the restroom and used this time to call over a well-prepped roommate.
Lin Yi surveyed the surroundings, feeling curious about everything, and even saw an old classmate of his. He informed Han Xuewei that he'd go have a look.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Chapter 93 A Conspiracy
chapters.content:
He wouldn't have imagined the incredible things that were about to happen.
In a corner of the restroom, Li Jingwen asked her roommate and best friend, "How are the preparations? Any problems?"
"Jingwen, you can rest assured, when have I ever dropped the ball?"
"That's great! It all depends on your performance now! You know how hard it was for me to bring you to this party!" As she spoke, Li Jingwen took out a small bottle filled with liquid and lowered her voice, "In a little while, just find a way to get Han Xuewei into that room, tell her that Lin Yi's ex-girlfriend wants to tell her something, I can guarantee she will come with you after hearing it."
"And, the stuff in this bottle never fails; she's definitely going to fall into my trap today!" Li Jingwen looked at the bottle in her hand with great satisfaction and handed it over to her roommate.
The latter took the small bottle and confirmed with Li Jingwen with a look in which a hint of malice was clearly visible.
"If things go well today, Lin Yi will definitely leave Han Xuewei for good, and then, he'll come back to me!"
A cold smile appeared on Li Jingwen's face, "Han Xuewei, don't you think you can firmly tie Lin Yi down with three kids! Today, I'll let you see for yourself who Lin Yi truly loves!!"
"Just do as I said, and if this gets done, I'll give you fifty thousand as a reward tonight, directly into your account. Now go."
After hearing this, Li Jingwen's roommate walked out.
The reason she was helping Li Jingwen today was not only to make some money but also because she had her own little scheme—what a perfect place to find a wealthy husband!
After her roommate left, Li Jingwen revealed a sinister smile that she had been hiding: "I've already given Yang Fan the drug early on; today, Han Xuewei won't be able to escape my grasp, even if she grew wings!"
"If Lin Yi catches you red-handed with another man outside today, I'd like to see how you'll talk your way out of it! I don't believe he'll still want you then!"
Li Jingwen had calculated very well, feeling proud of her plan while smirking as she walked out.
But what she hadn't calculated was that Lin Yi had overheard her entire conversation while looking for someone!
Lin Yi had casually entered the restroom, and before he could leave, he heard a very familiar voice from the washbasin area outside!
Listening carefully, it turned out to be his ex-girlfriend, Li Jingwen!
What made him furious was that Li Jingwen was actually scheming something sinister! After Li Jingwen left, a chilly look appeared in Lin Yi's eyes!
Daring to target my wife??
Just then, two mysterious men stealthily approached from this direction.
Man one, "What's the current status of the land acquisition report for Yantan District Expo Park?"
Man two replied, "The top brass is planning it out right now. Maybe by the next meeting, we can finalize it. Just wait a few more weeks. After all, gathering information takes time."
"Hmm, the sooner the better. We need..."
Lin Yi didn't pay attention to the conversation between the two men; at this moment, his mind was filled with rage. But the pressing matter at hand was to find Han Xuewei right away and ensure she stayed by his side—glued to him, so to speak!
Lin Yi thought of this and immediately turned around to leave, heading back to where he and Han Xuewei had parted ways.
But at this moment, Han Xuewei, following the lead of Li Jingwen's roommate, had arrived at a rather secluded and enclosed room. It was the backstage room used by the hosts to review their scripts, as well as the control room for the film projection, which contained many pieces of hardware equipment.
Han Xuewei, at this particular moment, was unaware of the impending crisis she was about to face.
Seeing that Lin Yi had made an urgent call to her, she picked up before she could even speak, she heard Lin Yi asking anxiously over the phone, "Vivi, where did you go?"
Han Xuewei explained, "Honey, wait for me there, Li Jingwen's bestie came to find me, I've seen her at school before. She said she wanted to take me to see Li Jingwen, there's something very important she needs to tell me, and it's also related to you."
"I want to know what she has to say. It's too noisy outside, we are now in the back control room."
After hearing this, Lin Yi replied with great urgency, "Right now, don't worry about anything they say, don't listen to them! Come back immediately! Head towards the hall, I'll be there right away! Leave the control room first!"
Lin Yi was now truly worried. The hall was a great distance from the rear control room, and with the hall filled with people standing around, running was almost impossible!
But just as Han Xuewei was about to turn around and leave, she was blocked by Li Jingwen's roommate, who was accompanied by Yang Fan.
Yang Fan was dressed in a crisp black suit; his face was very red, from his forehead all the way down to his neck, the medication must have taken effect!
After taking the medication, Yang Fan had obediently waited in one place, not knowing what medication Li Jingwen had given him—only hearing her say that today he had the opportunity to fulfill his dream and win over the school beauty he had long pursued!
Now, seeing the graceful and enchanting Han Xuewei standing right before him, how could Yang Fan not be excited? He quickly stepped forward, approaching Han Xuewei!
At this point, even Yang Fan's breathing had become much more rapid; the medicinal effect had fully taken hold!
Medications with similar functions generally have effects that last for several hours!
Han Xuewei was about to push him away and leave the place, but suddenly she felt a bit dizzy and her body noticeably started to feel hot!
Upon her arrival, Han Xuewei hadn't felt this sensation, but as the discomfort grew, she smelled something strange!
Her intuition told her there was something wrong with this odor!
But as time ticked away, Han Xuewei found she was becoming unable to exert any strength in her body!
If she looked at Yang Fan now, his face was filled with excitement, as he foolishly smiled and called out, "Vivi!"
Step by step, he advanced toward Han Xuewei, forcing her to retreat repeatedly while he expressed his affections deeply, "Vivi, I've liked you for a very long time! From the first moment I saw you, I fell deeply in love with you, and I've thought of you every day! You're so beautiful today, breathtakingly so!"
Indeed, Han Xuewei today could make anyone's heart skip a beat!
As soon as Yang Fan finished speaking, he audaciously reached out and wrapped his arms around Han Xuewei!
At this moment, Han Xuewei's consciousness was still fairly clear, and she really didn't want this man to get any closer! Using the last of her strength, she pushed Yang Fan away!

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Chapter 94 Critical Moment
chapters.content:
Yang Fan hadn't steadied his feet either, and with that push, he fell straight to the ground, but he wasn't angry at all, because he could feel that Han Xuewei's strength was very weak at that moment!
It must be said, Li Jingwen really knew how to seize the moment!
The Han Xuewei before him was nothing but a lamb to the slaughter. What was to follow was just a matter of time!
Li Jingwen's roommate was also very tactful. Seeing this scene, she quickly said, "Then I won't disturb you two, take your time catching up! I have the key to this room, just remember to lock the door from the inside... and no one will disturb you."
After she spoke, she walked towards the door.
But just then, a figure suddenly appeared at the doorway!
The newcomer was Lin Yi!
He had just rushed to the door when he heard Li Jingwen's roommate's words, so he firmly blocked the door, standing in the way!
His gaze swiftly scoured the room, and soon he saw Han Xuewei standing inside, looking very uncomfortable. At the same time, he noticed Yang Fan staring at Han Xuewei with a lecherous face, and he was instantly furious! He couldn't help but clench his fists, a chill sweeping over his body!
Han Xuewei also noticed Lin Yi barging in and weakly looked at him, finding herself unable to utter a single word at this moment!
Seeing this, Lin Yi immediately snatched the key from Li Jingwen's best friend's hand and then forcefully pushed her aside!
The latter, losing her balance, fell to the ground, her phone flying out a good distance, and in such a state, it had to be broken!
Lin Yi rushed forward and threw a hard punch at Yang Fan's face, and Yang Fan began retreating continuously while covering his nose!
Lin Yi hurried to Han Xuewei's side, pulling her into his embrace, and he also noticed that her body had started to heat up!
He supported Han Xuewei out the door, then promptly closed it and locked it up tight with the key!
In this way, only Yang Fan and Li Jingwen's roommate were left in the room!
As soon as the door was locked, Li Jingwen's roommate finally reacted!
She quickly got up, picking up her phone, and immediately tried to call Li Jingwen, but the inner screen of the phone was also shattered, completely unresponsive to her touch!
Turning to look at Yang Fan, he had already lost all control over his desire!
What was even more outrageous was that beforehand, Li Jingwen's roommate had sprayed a bottle of special perfume in the room, hence Han Xuewei's reaction upon smelling it.
Having stayed inside too long, she herself started to feel dizzy and weak after smelling the scent!
She couldn't help but mutter in her heart, "Since there's nothing I can do now, and my purpose here was just to find a sugar daddy, the man Li Jingwen picked certainly wouldn't have a shallow pocket! So this Yang Fan isn't too bad, maybe today I'll just…"
As one of Li Jingwen's close friends, although her beauty wasn't as breathtaking as Li Jingwen's, she still counted as a pretty girl!
Yang Fan had felt nothing for her until now, but he didn't have a choice! No one could resist the 'Medicinal Effect'!
After not too long, the two who were locked in the small, dark room started to become intimate...
Meanwhile, there was another matter that was even more preposterous!
Li Jingwen had used her roommate and best friend to pull off this cunning deed, but at this very moment, she was plotting yet another scheme in her heart!
Similar control rooms were installed with plenty of surveillance, but aside from the working staff, guests had no way of viewing the monitor screens.
However, Li Jingwen had spent some money to buy a key that allowed access to the control room from one of the workers.
She emerged from who knows where, then stood at the door of the control room listening for a while, and when she heard ambiguous noises inside, a smug smile spread across her face, "Humph! Got you now, Han Xuewei, I didn't expect you to be enjoying yourself this much!"
Immediately after, she went to the neighboring control room, followed the operating procedure given by that person, and successfully turned on the surveillance feed from the control room!
She sneered and took out her phone, beginning to record. But because of the dim lighting, she couldn't see very clearly, so she turned a nearby knob, activating the camera's infrared feature.
As she smugly appreciated the perfect conspiracy unfolding before her, suddenly, she saw clearly that the woman entangled with Yang Fan was actually her best friend!!
She screamed like a madwoman, "Chen Fei??? How could you do such a thing!! What on earth is going on?"
.net
In her haste, she threw down her phone and rushed toward the control room!
Seeing the key still in the lock, she quickly turned it!
She dashed forward, pulling apart the entwined couple caught in deep waters and fiery flames.
Li Jingwen kept cursing at the two, but by this time, the no longer sober Yang Fan suddenly pulled her toward him; Li Jingwen couldn't break free in time, and after a short tussle, she was overwhelmed by the perfume in the room!
By the time she realized it, it was too late!
Yang Fan had already pushed her to the ground!
Li Jingwen's roommate, Chen Fei, seeing what had transpired, finally snapped back to reality, hurriedly got dressed, and ran out cautiously, making sure to lock the door from the outside!
Li Jingwen saw the retreating figure of Chen Fei and roared in a low voice, "Chen Fei!! I will never forgive you!"
Meanwhile, at the other end, Lin Yi was carrying Han Xuewei into the hotel lobby.
"Get a room, the more expensive, the better!"
This hotel was hosting today's Orlan charity event, and many guests would come here to book a room and rest after getting drunk, and it was not unusual for couples to come to the hotel too.
However, the front desk clerk started to give strange looks when she saw Lin Yi's anxious expression and the somewhat abnormal Han Xuewei.
Lin Yi cleared his throat and said in a deep voice, "We are husband and wife, legitimate, with marriage certificate!"
Hearing this, the clerk naturally retracted her gaze and quickly began checking for available rooms.
Lin Yi felt speechless at the clerk, was booking a hotel room in this day and age still requiring proof of innocence?
He quickly remembered himself getting utterly drunk and being taken to a hotel by Han Xuewei, and couldn't help but smile at the thought, as it seemed rather amusing.
When he received the room card from the front desk, he carried Han Xuewei straight into the elevator, found the room after some effort, and finally breathed a sigh of relief!
If only he had known such a thing would happen, he wouldn't have come to the charity event!
Talk about bad luck, to be schemed against by a person like Li Jingwen!
Lin Yi clenched his teeth, thinking to himself, "This couple in cahoots, just you wait and see! I'll make sure you get what's coming to you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Chapter 95 Ambiguous Night
chapters.content:
Meanwhile, he quickly took out his phone and notified the attendant from Zige Boutique, who accompanied him earlier, that he had encountered some unexpected issues and wouldn't be able to return just yet, so they shouldn't wait for him.
After hanging up the phone, he also called his mother to let her know he had run into some special circumstances and would not be coming home tonight.
Lin Yi's mother immediately understood, as she had been through similar situations herself, and she reassured him not to worry about the baby, as she was at home.
After hearing this, Lin Yi simply smiled and did not say much else.
When he turned his head back around, he found that Han Xuewei's condition had worsened compared to before!
Even her complexion had changed considerably!
At this moment, Han Xuewei started mumbling, "Husband, help me... I feel a bit hot, take me to have a bath."
Lin Yi felt helpless but complied, lifting Han Xuewei and carrying her into the bathtub.
Lin Yi now realized that Han Xuewei's consciousness was beginning to blur.
Furthermore, in this state, she had become even more uninhibited.
Even with Lin Yi by her side, she slowly took off her clothes; although she felt somewhat shy in her heart, it was at least different from before.
Han Xuewei murmured, "Husband, help me..."
Her voice was faint, but Lin Yi heard it very clearly, and to his ears, it sounded like she was coquettishly pleading!
He was, after all, a young man full of vigor!
......
About half an hour later, the bathtub finally became completely quiet.
Lin Yi lifted the exhausted Han Xuewei out of the bathtub, gently placed her on the bed, and his body still carried Han Xuewei's fragrance.
Some things in this world are just so wonderful; after you've experienced them, they become irresistible, almost like an addiction!
Lin Yi was feeling just that way; although he had just been through quite an ordeal, he quickly became addicted again!
He carefully covered Han Xuewei with the blanket, his eyes unavoidably taking a few extra glances at her chest – the size was indeed impressive!
The next second, he deeply kissed Han Xuewei's red lips, which led to another bout of intimacy!
By the next morning, when Han Xuewei opened her eyes, she found Lin Yi staring at her intently!
She instinctively drew her legs in, feeling a burning sensation sweep through her body, and then she kicked Lin Yi angrily, "Stop looking!"
But it was only after she moved that she realized she had no strength in her legs at all, and they were even a little sore, so even though she kicked Lin Yi, it was as ineffective as a small fist thumping a chest.
She quickly snatched the blanket, wrapping herself up tightly, and with a slight frown, she rubbed her calves.
It seemed that what happened here last night was far crazier than their first time!
Lin Yi then reached out to hold Han Xuewei's foot and began to massage it delicately.
"Does your calf hurt?"
After hearing this, Han Xuewei puffed out her cheeks and in a low voice reproached, "It's all your fault!"
Lin Yi was absolutely a gentleman in normal times! Yet despite that, one cannot control human nature! He was not a Sage, so how could he suppress his male instincts?
Especially in front of such a beautiful wife!
And if he did the math, it had been nearly a year since he had such intimate contact with Han Xuewei! Once he indulged, it was hard not to get addicted!
Furthermore, when he was dating Li Jingwen, she never got intimate with him to keep him hooked, sometimes not letting him touch her for half a year.
Seeing Han Xuewei fall silent, Lin Yi's hands crept towards her thighs again, beginning to massage them.
And his touch was naughtily creeping upwards.
It must be said, the squishy feel was really very comfortable!
As Lin Yi praised the sensation inwardly, he also thought that he wanted to enjoy this squishy feel every day in the future! He hoped she never slimmed down!
He also discovered that Han Xuewei's skin was really very good; every time he got close to her, the softness was unforgettable and even lingered in his memory!
Unknowingly, his hand had moved up quite a bit.
He took a deep breath and couldn't help but lean in to kiss her!
But Han Xuewei quickly reached out to hold Lin Yi's head, blushing slightly and said with a mix of shyness and indignation, "It's almost ten o'clock; it's getting late. We should hurry home! If you keep this up, then I... then I'll have to tell mom about you!"
Lin Yi paused for a moment when he heard what Han Xuewei said, then he couldn't help but burst into laughter.
"Wife, are you serious? This is the most private thing between us two, and you really want to tell mom about it?"
Han Xuewei saw that this approach wasn't working and could only plead with Lin Yi in a pitiful tone, "Husband, I'm really too tired right now. I just want a good rest. We can't let mom and dad see us looking haggard when we get home, right? I have no strength left at all..."
Lin Yi was amused by his wife's gesture: "Hahaha, silly girl, don't worry, your husband knows you're tired. I just want to give you a kiss."
"And whatever I do is completely reasonable. You are my little baby; if I don't desire you, whom shall I desire? Every time I see you, I can't help but think about it—I am very possessive!"
Having said that, Lin Yi kissed Han Xuewei.
At that moment, Han Xuewei realized that her future life... might not be easy!!
Seeing Han Xuewei silent again, Lin Yi asked with concern, "Do you feel sleepy all the time? Is there anywhere that feels sore? Let your husband give you a massage, I promise I won't get carried away!"
Han Xuewei tried to stretch and then realized that her whole body was sore, her bones felt like they were aching, and it would probably be hard to stand up.
Lin Yi had no choice but to let Han Xuewei lie prone on the bed, and began massaging her from the shoulders to her back.
As Han Xuewei lay down, images from the previous night's frenzy involuntarily flashed in her mind, and her face turned even redder, spreading to the base of her neck!
Seeing his little wife blushing while lying down, Lin Yi started to tease her with a laugh, "What's up? Why is your face all red? Couldn't be that you're remembering something, could it?"
Lin Yi chuckled again.
"So you must be full of energy now, right?"
Han Xuewei shivered at those words and, enduring the soreness in her body, quickly turned over and pulled her legs back, even pushing away Lin Yi's hands that were massaging her!
She had already put on the shirt Lin Yi gave her, but she hadn't put on her bra yet! One glance and it was still very clear!

chapters.title: Chapter 96 Continue After Eating and Drinking to Satisfaction
chapters.content:
```
Lin Yi had no idea what had happened by the time he realized Han Xuewei had already shrunk into a corner of the bed.
Lin Yi clicked his tongue helplessly, laid down on the bed, spread himself out into a "big" character, and upon seeing Han Xuewei curled up in the quilt with just her little head poking out, couldn't help but smile and teasingly asked, "I didn't expect you to be so quick, I didn't even react. You seem to be recovering quite well, not so tired anymore, huh... then..."
"Baby, how about taking a bath before we go back?" Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei and suddenly asked.
Han Xuewei's face was already a bit red. When she heard Lin Yi say this, she wrapped the quilt around herself even tighter, "I'll wash myself, you, you go first..."
Lin Yi responded with an even wickeder grin, "Why wrap yourself up so tightly! Is there any part of you I haven't seen before? Even if you put on a thick cotton coat today, I know very well!"
"Besides, we were originally going to wash separately, are you thinking of washing together? From what you're saying, it seems like you're trying to seduce me??"
"It's not like that!!" Han Xuewei's face was so flushed with anger!
Where's the seduction!!
I already said you go wash first! How did that become seduction?
"Husband, please stop teasing me!"
"Hmm!? How am I teasing you? No, if I don't tease you, who else would I tease?"
It must be said, Lin Yi is usually very honest, but he's not short of bawdy jokes! Isn't his skin a little too thick?!
At this point, Han Xuewei really couldn't take it anymore, she hurriedly wrapped herself in the quilt and staggered into the bathroom, even locking the door behind her!
Lin Yi had washed all her underwear last night, and now it was hanging in the bathroom, dry thanks to the dryer having been turned on.
It must be said, the equipment in this high-end hotel is really comprehensive!
Soon after, Lin Yi heard the "whoosh" of running water from the bathroom, and he didn't forget to shout towards the inside, "Wife, it's very spacious in there, the bathtub is big enough for two people! Let's wash together and go home early..."
But Han Xuewei seriously replied, "Wait a bit longer for me, I'll finish in no time."
"Husband, quickly find a bath towel to wrap yourself with, not wearing a single piece of clothing... so embarrassing..."
Lin Yi couldn't help but look down at himself, he was accustomed to this and didn't find it inappropriate, rather it felt quite natural.
"I'm only like this in front of my wife, is that not okay?"
Inside, Han Xuewei busied herself with her shower, no longer speaking, while Lin Yi, feeling a bit tired by then, lay down and began to rest with closed eyes.
Maybe it was because he had held back for too long, so last night was a bit too wild.
Thinking about it, he still felt relieved that Han Xuewei hadn't had too much.
About ten minutes later, Han Xuewei emerged from the bathroom wrapped in a bathrobe.
Lin Yi then sat up.
"I'll finish washing quickly too... By the way, wife, I should call mom to let her know. We won't be coming back for lunch. You can get some more sleep, and we can go home in the afternoon. Even if we hurry back now, the baby will have finished his milk, and we won't be able to rest well..."
Han Xuewei nodded her head in agreement. If they rushed back now, she would likely have to breastfeed non-stop, and she definitely wouldn't be able to rest well.
"I feel so hungry..."
```
Lin Yi laughed and said, "You can order directly from the hotel if you want to eat something. If you're not used to it, I'll help you order takeout!"
Han Xuewei thought for a while, "Just let the hotel deliver a meal. I'll start with breakfast! I'm so hungry now, I don't even have the energy to get out of bed..."
Lin Yi nodded, "Then I'll have them make breakfast right now and let Mom know."
Han Xuewei nodded and said, "Mm, I'm going to rest, still a bit sleepy."
Lin Yi even took special care to tuck her in properly, and couldn't help but chuckle to himself.
Get a good sleep first, and then have dinner... When she's rested enough, we can... hehe...
Were the thoughts in Lin Yi's mind too beastly?
After ordering breakfast from the hotel front desk, Lin Yi dialed his mother's mobile number. But no sooner had he finished speaking, his mother started scolding him, "Vivi is tired? You little scamp, what on earth did you do last night? Don't you have any self-control? Vivi's body can't withstand you tormenting her like this!"
Lin Yi felt wronged, "I... I didn't do anything, and I... have been holding back for so long... She's just resting for a bit now, as soon as she wakes up, we'll head home!"
Lin Yi's mother was silent for a moment, then said, "Then you need to be careful with your limits!"
Lin Yi's mother wanted to say more but held back the words on the tip of her tongue. After all, it's the couple's own business, and she shouldn't nag anymore.
After speaking with his mother, Lin Yi put away his phone, looked at the sleeping Han Xuewei, and then went to the bathroom.
When he came out after the shower, the server had also brought up the breakfast.
Lin Yi pushed the breakfast cart right up to Han Xuewei's bedside and then woke her up, "Little cutie, time to get up! Eat breakfast and then you can go back to sleep, okay?"
Lin Yi knew that Han Xuewei was very hungry by now, she had eaten very little the previous night, and it was already this late without having had breakfast. He didn't want his wife to go hungry.
Han Xuewei was pulled up by him, rubbed her sleepy eyes, and then sat at the edge of the bed to drink her porridge.
Shortly after finishing, she lay down to sleep again, but little did she expect that Lin Yi would also slip under the covers with her.
Han Xuewei was startled, "What are you doing! I'm really tired now!"
Lin Yi put on a pitiful face, "Wife, you've taken all the blankets. I'll wake up frozen."
Han Xuewei looked at him and warned, "Then you're not allowed to move around!"
Seeing his wife's permission, Lin Yi smiled and said, "Yes, my lady!"
Just like that, the two of them fell asleep cuddled together, one wrapped in a bathrobe, and the other stark naked!
After a while, Han Xuewei suddenly murmured in her sleep and then woke up from her dream. She was startled by the dream she just had!
Oh my goodness! Why am I dreaming about being affectionate with Lin Yi?
But as soon as she woke up from the dream, she immediately realized something was off!
Lin Yi, who was holding Han Xuewei tightly, was being very naughty! Moving around!
No wonder she had such a dream!
"Husband! How can you act like this?" Han Xuewei got annoyed again!
Lin Yi moved even closer and kissed her on the back of her neck, "You've been asleep for three and a half hours now, you should be ready to..."

chapters.title: Chapter 97: Chapter 97 Soft Grinding Hard Foaming
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei suddenly realized that she was starting to feel engorged!
She hurriedly got up from the bed and rushed into the bathroom to start pumping milk.
When she came out of the bathroom, Lin Yi was already lying down with his eyes closed, quietly, possibly asleep.
Now, to Han Xuewei, Lin Yi seemed like a ticking time bomb!
This ever-present risk of explosion was something she had to bear!
But even though she was aware of this fact, under Lin Yi's crazy lament about how long it had been since he'd been intimate, Han Xuewei naturally couldn't stand up to his persistence and soft soap, and finally she softened her heart and enjoyed another passionate round with Lin Yi.
Then, they ordered lunch in the hotel.
While Lin Yi was waiting in the corridor for the serving cart to arrive, he overheard two attendants talking around the corner. .net
"Did you hear about yesterday? There was quite the show in the control room! A threesome!"
"I heard too, people these days really know how to play, three of them, haha, it's just different!"
"And one girl ran out in the middle of it!"
"I wonder if the guy monitoring has any video? The footage must be thrilling!".
"He probably does, I'll ask the security department later..."
After hearing this conversation, Lin Yi's face remained very calm as he brought the lunch back to the room.
After enjoying a sumptuous meal together, the two cuddled up and fell asleep again.
When they woke up again, it was almost four in the afternoon!
After getting up, Han Xuewei felt so much more energized.
Han Xuewei just pouted and pretended to be angry before ignoring Lin Yi.
They had one last heated battle in the room before leaving the hotel!
It was almost four-thirty by the time the two of them came out of the hotel.
As Han Xuewei walked, she could clearly feel her legs shaking, but she persevered.
At this moment, Lin Yi had already noticed that Han Xuewei was feeling very embarrassed, but luckily their mom and Aunt Wang were busy taking care of the baby, and no one was watching the two of them.
Lin Yi gave Han Xuewei a princess carry and tiptoed towards the bedroom.
But before they could even enter the door, they encountered Aunt Wang in the hallway.
Aunt Wang shook her head with a strange look after seeing them. It seemed the couple's exploits had spread throughout the family.
Han Xuewei immediately blushed, turned her head away, and leaned into Lin Yi's embrace, too embarrassed to look up.
Lin Yi was unfazed, as the elders in the family were all experienced and would surely understand his actions. But his little wife was always so shy!
However, this meant he could now tease his little wife! Hehe!
Finally back in the bedroom, Han Xuewei carefully packed away her dress, changed into her pajamas, and locked away the whole set of priceless diamond jewelry.
It was still early, not even five o'clock, and the weather was very clear.
Aunt Wang had washed and changed the three babies' clothes and hung them out on the balcony. Right then, Han Xuewei's dad's voice could be heard from the kitchen!
Turns out Han Xuewei's parents had taken advantage of their free time to swing by, picking out a lot of groceries at the supermarket on their way.
Han Xuewei's dad let slip that he had something to discuss with his daughter and son-in-law, and he was specially cooking a lavish dinner today.
After changing into pajamas, Han Xuewei went downstairs to check on her parents.
She had barely reached the door when she heard laughter from the kitchen—her mom and dad's.
You hear them before you see them, ah!
As she approached the kitchen, she saw her dad wearing an apron, busy cooking, and chatting with his wife.
Han Xuewei walked in, smiling and asked, "Dad, Mom, what are you two talking about?"
Han Xuewei's mom turned around, smiling, "We have some good news for you: after discussing with your dad, he suggested moving the company here from our hometown to Xiangcheng. A good part of it is already prepared."
Han Xuewei's dad spoke cheerfully, "When our restaurant is up and running, we can even hold your wedding banquet there, and I'll invite all our friends and family!"
"Also, I've been exploring many new dishes these past few days! Maybe I can try them out at your wedding banquet for everyone to taste!"
Your dad continued, relieved, "The company's relocation site is set for Yantan District, at Expo Park №7. We've already done an on-site inspection, and the pedestrian traffic there is very substantial, although we have potential competitors. Someone's also trying to lease the same place as us, a local from Xiangcheng—that's why I'm worried whether we can successfully rent it."
Han Xuewei nodded in response, "Hmm, whatever ideas you and mom have, I support them, and besides, you won't have to travel back and forth so much when it happens."
Han Xuewei's mom nodded, too, "Right, after discussing it with your dad, I decided to retire early—this year, actually! Retiring early might affect the pension, but compared to these three adorable babies, that's nothing! Plus, I don't need that little amount of money. Ah, when you get older, you just love the kids. I can't stand not seeing them for a single day now.
The babies have been growing so fast these recent days, and they laugh every time you make a joke, babbling non-stop!"
"With the holidays coming up, I'll move over once I'm off and be able to take care of all three every day!"
Han Xuewei also expressed agreement, "Hmm, that sounds good. At your age, you should really start to take it easy. Otherwise, when dad moves here and you're still alone at home, I'd worry. It looks like our whole family will be able to spend every day together soon!"
"We should thank your father-in-law and mother-in-law for not minding. Plus, our son-in-law is very capable!"
Han Xuewei offered to help her dad with the work, "Dad, let me take over."
"Oh? Are you sure you can do it?" He looked at Han Xuewei, puzzled, "As I recall, you seldom show up in the kitchen! Why do you seem like a different person today?"

chapters.title: Chapter 98 Vivi Cooks
chapters.content:
After hearing this, Han Xuewei's face turned red, "Dad, I already have a family, of course, things have to be different."
"Besides, our family business is in the catering industry. If I couldn't cook, wouldn't that be a joke to others?"
Han Xuewei's dad laughed heartily, "Yes, yes, it seems my daughter does have some awareness. If you can capture a man's stomach, then you are successful. Come on, let dad teach you some of the secret recipes I have accumulated over the years!"
Han Xuewei also grabbed a spoon and tried to follow her dad's movements, but she didn't have enough strength, and several times she dropped all the vegetables from the spoon back into the pot.
Seeing this, Han Xuewei's mother hurried to interject, "Oh no, that won't do. You can't learn from your dad like that, he's just a rough man who has been tossing spoons from a young age, and you haven't even touched this before. This pot is just too heavy, you just watch from the side."
Han Xuewei shrugged helplessly, smiling and saying, "Alright then, as you command!"
"Oh my, as a woman, you should have your own career no matter what, even if it's a small one. You can't depend on a man for everything, just like I do as a teacher, a quiet and proper job, even though your dad's business is so big."
"Summer vacation is almost here, so try to make up for the wedding banquet during my holiday, okay? It doesn't matter whether it's at our own restaurant or not, these things are actually not important."
"Once we get the marriage back on track, there's nothing else to worry about. The baby is born, and you should also go back to school to continue your studies. By the way, your dad plans to upgrade our catering business to hotel services after he moves here, and he needs to pull in some investments during this time."
"However, your dad discussed it with me, hoping that Lin Yi could invest, because no matter what, this hotel will eventually be handed over to you two. We'll talk about it at the dinner table, I'm just informing you in advance."
Han Xuewei nodded, "Mhm, I understand. Lin Yi and I also discussed this, that after our wedding is made up, we'll go back to finish our studies."
"Mhm, I don't know how his parents have arranged it, but if starting a hotel is too difficult, then continuing the catering business is fine too. This matter mainly needs to be discussed with Lin Yi."
Han Xuewei said, "Mhm, if there's a lack of funds, Lin Yi will definitely help."
"Lin Yi indeed has the ability, so we also want to hear his opinion on this matter."
While continuing to toss the big spoon, Han Xuewei's dad added, "Ah, the future belongs to the young. We will inevitably be phased out."
"Haha, dad, please don't think like that. In my eyes, you're not old at all," said Han Xuewei with a giggling smile, "Dad, take a look, is this stir-fry okay? Can it be served now?"
Han Xuewei's dad turned his head to look, "It needs a bit more cooking, stir for another minute, and that should be enough."
Han Xuewei thought for a moment and then suddenly realized, "So, stir it sixty more times and it will be ready, right?"
Dad Han laughed heartily, "Hahaha, thinking that way isn't wrong."
"Then that's great!"
At this point, Han Xuewei was already finding it hard to stand, able to endure only a few more minutes at most. Her feet felt as if they had lost all sensation, aching unbearably!
Han Xuewei was in the kitchen cooking with her dad, while Tian Bei had been called to another room by her mother to talk.
"Lin Yi, what's going on with you? I've always said that we must be restrained in that regard. Have you seen how Vivi walks now? Ah, what am I to say? Of course, you should take care of your own wife!"
Lin Yi defended himself with an innocent look, "Mom, aren't you exaggerating a bit... I think she walks just fine. It's just that we haven't for quite a while..."
Mother Lin said impatiently, "Then you must be extra careful in the future, you can't be like this anymore! If you don't listen, you'll have to face the consequences."
Lin Yi chuckled and said nothing more.
After thinking for a moment, Mother Lin added, "Your dad has been quite busy lately, letting him decide whether to relocate the company or sell all his shares and retire in peace. He might need some time."
Lin Yi nodded in response, "Mm-hmm, okay."
Lin Yi wasn't planning to tell his family about the building he owned yet, for with his current financial situation, buying the largest building in the city center wouldn't be so simple.
Moreover, in just a few days, he would be receiving the building's rent—three billion! And that's just for half a year's worth.
After chatting with his mom about other family matters, Lin Yi headed towards the kitchen, as he needed to say hello to his in-laws.
Hurrying downstairs and heading straight to the kitchen, he could hear Han Xuewei's family's joyful voices from afar.
Upon seeing Lin Yi, his in-laws smiled and pulled him over, saying, "Come here, Lin Yi, you must try this dish. Vivi made it with her own hands; let's see how it tastes?"
With his interest piqued, Lin Yi stepped forward with a smile, "Oh? I haven't had the chance to taste Vivi's cooking yet; I must try it no matter what."
Lin Yi picked up some chopsticks, took a piece of meat from the plate, blew on it, and tasted it seriously.
After tasting it, he immediately gave a thumbs up: "Turns out Vivi's cooking is so delicious! The heat control is just right, the meat is so tender, it's crispy on the outside and juicy inside, very flavorful, rich but not greasy..."
"I definitely need to eat more later; in short, it's super delicious!"
At that moment, Mother Lin also came over, "It sounds very tasty, let me also try some."
Mother Lin took over the chopsticks from her son, also took a piece of meat, tasted it, and also gave a thumbs up: "Wow, it really tastes great!"
Han Xuewei's mother said from the side, "This dish is a new recipe that Vivi's dad recently developed; he's quite confident about it."
Hearing everyone praise the dish, Han Xuewei nodded humbly with a flushed face.
At this point, Mother Lin suddenly said, "Mother-in-law, when Tian Bei (Lin Yi's dad) gets home, let's sit down and have a good talk, discuss the matter of holding a wedding celebration for Vivi and Lin Yi, what do you think?"
Han Xuewei's mother quickly nodded in agreement, "Sure! We were also looking for a time to discuss this with you. We have some other matters to talk about with everyone today. Let's discuss it after lunch!"

chapters.title: Chapter 99: Chapter 99 Family Meeting
chapters.content:
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei were naturally very excited to hear that their big day was to be discussed imminently.
Nowadays, every child is a treasure, and as they are the only children of the two families, a life event as significant as a wedding has captured the entire family's attention.
Today's sumptuous dinner was prepared by Han Xuewei's parents. Seeing that Han Xuewei couldn't be of much help, they let her accompany the baby in the nursery. Lin Yi's mother also helped in the kitchen, sparking lively conversations among everyone as they pitched in.
By the time Lin Yi's father got home, it was already half past six in the evening, and the three who had been busy in the kitchen all afternoon finally completed a rich banquet.
With many dishes served on the table, everyone sat together, basking in a harmonious atmosphere.
The three little ones, having just been fed, were full of energy and showed no sign of sleepiness, so they were placed in their strollers and brought down to quietly lie by the dining table, munching on their fingers.
The three babies were babbling away, almost as if they were conversing with one another.
Because there were important matters to discuss, everyone quickly finished their meals and took seats in the living room. Aunt Wang had prepared a plate of fruit for everybody.
After some casual chatting, the group began today's main topic.
Lin Yi's mother took the lead, "In-laws, Vivi's postpartum period has ended; it's time we give the two kids a proper wedding. Let's discuss the details of the wedding today."
Han Xuewei's mother said, "We've been thinking about this for a while but haven't had the chance to bring it up. The wedding is a significant event for them, and we would like to hear what the in-laws think. What do Vivi and Lin Yi themselves want?"
"We've previously mentioned the bridal price, but it's still something we need to discuss formally."
"We, as parents, had no idea that Lin Yi's financial situation had become so good over the years, so the bridal price we initially suggested was based on the standards of an ordinary family. Now that circumstances have changed, Lin Yi, you could mention how much you plan to offer as a bridal price to marry Vivi."
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei looked at the four elders before them, exchanged smiles, and then Lin Yi stood up.
"I'd like to first hear the thoughts of my father-in-law and mother-in-law. Please state your requirements first, and we'll use those as the premise."
"That said, we don't necessarily need to move in. There are many houses for sale nearby, and Vivi's dad and I can buy one. It's not too far; just a few minutes' drive away."
Lin Yi's mother quickly said, "Oh dear, in-law, those words are just too formal. You're Vivi's parents after all; how could Lin Yi let you live alone in a separate house? Besides, it's so convenient for the whole family to live together; it's lively every day, and there are still many ways for Lin Yi and Vivi to honor you!"
Lin Yi's father also chimed in promptly, "Exactly, in-laws, you adore the three babies so much, and you can see the children every day; that's a blessing! We would welcome it more than anything!"
Han Xuewei's mother said somewhat embarrassedly, "It's very kind of you to think so, dear parents-in-law. We are very pleased. Lin Yi is truly a capable and good child indeed! You've raised him well. To take better care of the three children, I've already submitted my retirement application, so as to share the burden with everyone, allowing each person to have their own time."
Lin Yi also hurriedly said, "There's something Vivi and I have been keeping from everyone. Some time ago, I gave Vivi a villa. It's located in New View Garden, number 3, with a total area of 970 square meters, which is much more spacious than the one we're living in now. I plan that when Vivi and I get married, our whole family will move in together."
Both of Han Xuewei's parents exclaimed almost in unison, "What? A 970-square-meter villa? Given directly to Vivi? Why didn't you tell us sooner?"
Lin Yi nodded and said calmly, "The deed only has Vivi's name on it, so my parents-in-law can rest assured and live there, after all, the homeowner is Vivi. Moreover, that villa is several times larger than this place. In the future, when the three babies grow up, each will have their own room!"
Han Xuewei's mother said excitedly, "Oh, Lin Yi, you are really too kind. If our whole family could live together, Vivi's father and I wouldn't ask for anything else."
Han Xuewei's father added, "Actually, I have another idea. I'd like to continue to pass on my culinary skills, perhaps by opening a restaurant in Xiangcheng."
"Originally, I was thinking of starting big, opening a hotel, but that would take a long time to prepare, and I don't want to wait too long. So, let's use our ancestral brand 'Han Merchant's Private Kitchen.' Lin Yi, what do you think about this?"
Han Xuewei's father had initially thought of handing the restaurant over to Lin Yi and Vivi to manage, so he could take care of the three babies without worries.
Moreover, Lin Yi wasn't busy with much each day, and he held several stocks that hardly required his attention, so why not let them promote the 'Han Merchant's Private Kitchen' heritage with the vigor of the younger generation!
Having only Han Xue as a daughter, his culinary skills, no matter how excellent, could not be passed on to her alone.
If Lin Yi didn't want to manage the shop, Vivi could run it herself, and when the time came, he would just help his daughter out.
At this moment, Lin Yi was thinking that he had already mastered high-level cooking skills. If he were to use his culinary skills to open a restaurant, it would surely have an excellent reputation.
So he readily said, "Father-in-law, you can rest assured that I will fully support whatever Vivi wants to do in the future. If it ever comes to a lack of funds, I can provide support at any time. As long as Vivi is willing, I will work hard alongside her!"
After hearing this, Han Xuewei's father nodded happily, "With your answer, I'm relieved!"
In fact, before bringing up these ideas, Han Xuewei's parents knew that Lin Yi would agree, as the in-laws and Lin Yi had always taken great care of them.
At this moment, Han Xuewei's mother was still joyful that Lin Yi had given her daughter a villa in the city!
Furthermore, Lin Yi had generously given each of them ten million, more than enough for a lifetime and certainly sufficient for retirement!
Nevertheless, there were still three babies who hadn't grown up yet, and no matter what, even if it meant their old age would be filled with hard work, they were determined to carry forward the family legacy and provide a carefree environment for the children to grow up in.

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Chapter 100 Dowry
chapters.content:
Even if their three children didn't perform well in their studies in the future, with economic support, they could still let the kids do what they wanted to do, or they could be self-reliant through this time-honored restaurant.
There is an old saying that if one generation sits idle, not striving or making an effort, then the next generation will have to endure the hardships in their place.
Han Xuewei's parents were making the longest-term plans, always considering what was best for the babies.
Although their considerations were long-term, this was simply the mindset of their generation, and there's nothing wrong with that!
With great excitement, Han Xuewei's mother asked, "Lin Yi, what are your thoughts about your wedding with Vivi?"
She had no other thoughts at the moment. Since Lin Yi had bought a villa specially for Vivi as their marriage house, and even asked them to live there, it closely aligned with the ideas of Han Xuewei's parents.
Lin Yi was simply the epitome of a good son-in-law! Everything he did satisfied them, and in the future, even if he and Vivi had an argument, they would certainly feel it was their daughter's fault!
After hearing this, Lin Yi just smiled faintly and seriously said, "I would still like to hear Vivi's thoughts on this matter. Vivi, do you have any requests for our wedding?"
Han Xuewei thought for a moment, then said with a smile, "Well, I... just want to wear a beautiful wedding gown and take vows with you. I'm imagining all these romantic scenes. As for the rest... I'll just listen to you."
Lin Yi's parents exchanged glances and then asked, "We should hold a big banquet when the time comes. Mr. Han, what do you think?"
Han Xuewei's father thought for a moment and then said, "My mother watched Vivi grow up. She's old now and has trouble getting around, so she can't travel far. I would like to find a time to take Lin Yi, Vivi, and the three children to visit her, so she can enjoy the happiness of having four generations under one roof.
If possible, we should also invite and entertain all the friends and relatives from the hometown, as if celebrating with them."
Lin Yi's father pondered for a while and said, "Mr. Han, Mrs. Han, there's no need for such trouble. Since we're going to do it, let's have a big celebration. Your hometown is only about two hundred kilometers from here. We'll just hold the wedding banquet there, at least eighty tables I reckon!
The more lively, the better, since we're looking for festivity, we must properly entertain the relatives and friends."
Lin Yi's mother also added, "Yes, it's not that far away. The round trip is just about two hours. We could leave early in the morning, arrive there before nine, and still have plenty of time to prepare other things. We could even hold a big event, arrive at the hotel by noon, finish eating within two hours, then sit together and chat, have some tea, and be home before evening without any issue."
After hearing this, Han Xuewei's father shook his head, "If that's the case, then the day will be too rushed. Not only will nobody have a good rest, but the three babies definitely won't rest well either.
Just let you handle the wedding banquet, and there's no need for so much fuss on our side; we'll just casually entertain the relatives when we go back, and then let my old mother feel the lively atmosphere. Moreover, when you host the banquet, we from the bride's side won't bring too many guests, just a few tables of relatives we are close with is enough."
"Having a post-wedding banquet does seem a bit rushed, and there's no need to go through so much hassle."
Lin Yi's father said, "Since Mr. Han thinks this way, I will follow your wishes and do as you suggest! We could also take the babies to the hometown when they reach a hundred days old; it's not a bad time for a banquet then either."
As soon as Han Xuewei's mother heard this, she immediately agreed, "Mr. Han's idea is good too, it offsets the busy wedding days, so the schedule won't be so tight."
"Let's settle this matter for now. Mr. and Mrs. Han, do you have any specific requests regarding the dowry? Just let us know, and we will do our best to meet your expectations."
Han's mother said, "Oh dear, you're being too polite. We really have no particular demands regarding the betrothal gifts, it's all up to your family! No matter how much is given, we will have no objections."
"My husband and I are discussing the dowry for Vivi's wedding—whether to give her a car, or to pick out an apartment in the city. I'm not sure what Vivi would prefer."
Suddenly, Han Xuewei's father interjected, "Or a shop."
In fact, they knew that Lin Yi's family currently lacked nothing, so whatever they chose for the dowry didn't really matter.
Han Xuewei's mother gave him a look and said, "The shop is already included; it's the one you've been talking about every day. That shop will be left to Vivi no matter what."
Vivi's dad smiled and nodded, "My wife is right, the shop cannot be counted in it."
Something suddenly occurred to Han's mother, so she asked, "By the way, Lin Yi, the villa you bought in the city center, has it been furnished yet? Are you missing any appliances? Since you bought the house, the renovation costs should be covered by our family."
Lin Yi explained, "Mother-in-law, the house comes fully furnished, and it even has all the appliances. You don't need to worry about these things at all. Let's all go see the villa together in a few days, and if we feel like something is missing, we can buy it later."
Han Xuewei's mother nodded, "You're so thoughtful."
Then she turned her gaze to her daughter, "Vivi, regarding the dowry, what would you like to choose?"
Han Xuewei, seeing everyone's eyes on her, shrugged helplessly, "I… really don't have any particular demands, I don't know how to choose…"
She truly didn't know what to choose now, since she really wasn't lacking money. Lin Yi transferred a substantial amount to her every month, but she didn't have the habit of spending lavishly, so she was able to save quite a bit each month.
The wedding house had already been purchased by Lin Yi in advance, and the property deed was even in her name. Besides, there was also a car at home that belonged to her.
The total of all Han Xuewei's assets could now place her among the ranks of the wealthy in Xiangcheng. Therefore, she really didn't know what to choose at the moment.
It was then that Lin Yi suddenly said, "How about this, I'll make the decision for Vivi. When I took Vivi to buy a car, she chose one that was not too expensive, probably because she was reluctant to buy a very costly car!"
Han Xuewei's mother quickly said, "Then let's settle on a good car for the dowry! It's decided."
After hearing this, Han Xuewei immediately retorted, "It's several hundred thousand—how can you say that's not expensive? And I'm quite comfortable driving this car; I don't want to change it."

chapters.title: Chapter 101: Chapter 101 The Five Golden Dragon and Phoenix Bracelets
chapters.content:
Lin Yi would sometimes let Han Xuewei drive his Range Rover, but the opportunity for her to take the wheel was quite rare. After all, with Lin Yi as her personal driver, it was naturally expected.
Lin Yi said, "I'm just providing a reference for my mother-in-law."
If they really let Xuewei's parents provide a house as part of her dowry, it could impact their goal of opening a restaurant, considering how costly buying a house can be. However, buying a car was different. He had previously given twenty million to the elders, which was more than enough to buy a good car.
Han Xuewei's father also chimed in, "Vivi, let your mother and me decide on this. We'll choose a decent car. Even if you don't want to drive, Lin Yi can take it out occasionally. In any case, there must be a dowry."
Without a better idea, Han Xuewei could only pout and say, "Understood."
In truth, she didn't have any particular demands; the dowry was of no consequence to her. Besides, other than for commuting, she had no use for a car, so one worth several hundred thousand was completely sufficient, while one worth over a million seemed wasteful to her since she was not a car enthusiast.
However, Lin Yi believed that since no one had a better idea, he had to make a suggestion.
Since the car he bought for his wife was indeed the cheapest, it should be somewhat presentable as a dowry, to avoid idle gossip. Moreover, his parents-in-law would definitely want to give their daughter a bit more face!
Now that the dowry had been agreed upon, it was also appropriate to discuss the bride price.
Lin Yi was well aware that his parents-in-law wouldn't dictate the amount of the bride price. If he didn't bring it up, it would be difficult to negotiate a figure.
At that moment, Lin Yi took the initiative to say, "How about this? Since no one is mentioning the bride price, I'll suggest a figure—nine million, nine hundred and ninety-nine thousand yuan, symbolizing long-lasting fortune. It's an auspicious number, right?"
Han Xuewei's mother quickly laughed and said, "That's enough, it's too much."
Nowadays, when it comes to bride prices, many people just look for a numerically auspicious figure—it's a kind of modern romance, I suppose!
Lin Yi had already given them ten million each, which was quite a generous gift!
If they demanded too much more, it would make people think that the Han family was selling their daughter, especially since this bride price was already quite high locally!
"So are we agreed on these matters? For the wedding banquet, my family will take care of it, and we will also entertain guests from the bride's side," Lin Yi's father stated on the spot.
Han Xuewei's parents had no objections and nodded their agreement.
Thus, the arrangements for the couple's belated wedding were quickly settled: Han Xuewei's parents would provide a nice car as part of the dowry, Lin Yi would personally offer a bride price of nine million, nine hundred and ninety-nine thousand, and Lin Yi's parents would handle the banquets for both families, also ensuring to furnish the bride with jewelry.
Lin Yi's mother had, in fact, already gone to the jewelry store and purchased a considerable amount of gold and silver jewelry, including several pairs of dragon and phoenix bracelets, spending over a million in total. However, since the children's wedding details had not been fully set, she had not told anyone else.
After all, marriage is a significant event in life. And since Lin Yi is the Lin Family's treasured son, his mother definitely wants to splurge this time. However, the business had seen a downturn recently, so she had been more frugal with her spending. If it hadn't been for the ten million her son had given her to splurge with, she wouldn't have been able to buy all that jewelry!
With the wedding settled, it was time to visit Han Xuewei's grandmother's home, to check in on her, and to make arrangements for the necessary banquet, ensuring a proper celebration.
After sitting together for a while chatting, Han Xuewei's father suddenly said to everyone, "Today I sent someone to check out that shop we were interested in before, it's at No. 3 Expo Garden in Yantan District. It's a duplex structure, with the first layer having an area of 180 square meters, and the second layer is twice the size of the first layer.
It's definitely big enough, and the rent is not that high."
"However, there's a new problem now. Recently, when I was planning to rent this shop, I encountered a competitor, a catering company from Xiangcheng. They also have their eyes on this place. Since I'm from out of town, I might not have much of an advantage in the competition. I wonder if any of you know someone related who could help speak on my behalf."
Lin Yi started to think it over; he had heard about Expo Garden in Yantan District a long time ago. Just walk five avenues to the east and you'll reach Yantan. The Expo Garden is actually just a big street, and it's not very far from here. The Expo Garden used to be bustling, it was also one of the earliest city centers.
At that moment, Lin Yi also suddenly remembered that on the day he took Han Xuewei to the charity gala, he had overheard a conversation around the corner, discussing news that the Expo Garden in Yantan District was about to be expropriated, which was supposed to happen within the upcoming month.
If his father-in-law rushed to rent that place now, he would face the outcome of losing a large sum of money! The investment into the decoration would go down the drain!
"Father-in-law, do you know which catering company is competing with you for the same shop?"
Lin Yi wanted to understand the background of this catering company first.
He determined that this catering company must be somewhat famous; after all, Expo Garden in Yantan District has a large flow of people and not a small amount of rent. Their ability to take over that spot indicates that they have considerable strength.
Moreover, Yang Fan's family also works in catering, and they have the capacity as well.
Speaking of Yang Fan, it's necessary to talk about his personality. He's extremely flamboyant in his actions, and almost all students at the school are aware of his family's wealth and know about his company.
.net
He also heard recently that Yang Fan's family company was planning to expand their scale.
It must be said that their catering company really does a good job; it is an up-and-coming star in recent years, with a certain local reputation.
If it's their company competing with Han Xuewei's father, there really is a significant gap in strength.
Han Xuewei's father took out his phone, looked at his notes, and then said, "The name of that company is Kaiyue. They're also quite famous locally."
"Ah? Kaiyue Catering Company??" Lin Yi was startled after hearing that!
By a stroke of ironic luck, that was Yang Fan's family company!
Talk about enemies on a narrow road!
He hadn't yet found the right opportunity to give Yang Fan and Li Jingwen a bit of hardship!
Having just shifted his scheming to Han Xuewei's side, Lin Yi had to take this chance to get his revenge!
Han Xuewei's father seemed to notice Lin Yi's expression at that moment and asked curiously, "Do you know about this Kaiyue Catering Company?"

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Chapter 102 Kaiyue Catering Company
chapters.content:
Lin Yi smiled and then answered, "It's more than just hearing about it, this company belongs to a classmate of mine, their family business, and it has been developing really well in the recent years."
Han Xuewei's dad couldn't help but shake his head, "It seems I won't be able to secure this location, I'll have to choose somewhere else."
Lin Yi suddenly said, "Father-in-law, maybe the people you sent didn't do thorough research? Didn't they hear about the upcoming acquisition of Bolan Street?"
Han Xuewei's dad said, "I heard about that news early on too, but people have been saying for years that the area would be acquired and demolished, yet all these years have passed with no progress. There shouldn't be any problems in the short term, right? The foot traffic there is much more than I expected, I think it's a very suitable choice."
Lin Yi didn't know how to explain to his father-in-law, but he instinctively felt that the conversation he had overheard that day was very likely to occur.
So he thought for a moment and quickly came up with an idea.
He directly said to his father-in-law, "I've heard a lot about the upcoming acquisition recently, we should be more cautious! How about this, tomorrow I'll accompany you for an on-site investigation, and I can share my thoughts. A friend of mine just so happens to have a shop for rent, located right in the city center at the Wenqu Building.
His dad is a shareholder of that building, we could also take a look there. By comparing the two locations, we won't be hanging our hopes on one tree."
Han Xuewei's dad agreed, "That makes sense, let's go have a look tomorrow! We'll make a decision after comparing the two."
"Let's go early tomorrow to have a look, the sooner we handle this the better, I've been worrying about it every day!"
Lin Yi said, "Then I'll tell my friend right now, and the two of us will go have a look tomorrow."
"Hmm!"
Lin Yi's mother, overhearing their conversation, couldn't help but be surprised: "Lin Yi, I didn't know you made so many friends in college! Even the Wenqu Building belongs to them, their business is massive! He's really a big landlord!"
Lin Yi hurriedly explained, "That... they're just partners I met through doing business... We got to know each other through... the investment in 'Fortune Baby', it's just a coincidence. I've seen them a few times, I believe we can settle this matter too."
Han Xuewei's dad nodded, "As the saying goes, one more friend means one more path. It's good to make more friends, Lin Yi is a good kid!"
Lin Yi could only give a dry laugh, with embarrassment written all over his face...
How could he tell others that he was the real owner of the Wenqu Building!
Lin Yi was now focused on finding out exactly what happened the night of the charity gala. Then, he intended to give those scumbags a taste of their own medicine and take his revenge!
After chatting with his family for a bit, he returned to his room and made a phone call to his good brother and roommate, Qiang Hengxuan. After all, the guy had his finger on the pulse of the school's gossip news!
He was very active in campus events and had acquaintances in every club or department, making many friends, hence his extensive network!
If you wanted to inquire about anything at school, you could go directly to him; you wouldn't be wrong!
After the two got on the phone, Lin Yi greeted him, "Bro Qiang, what have you been busy with these days?"
On the other end of the phone, Qiang Hengxuan laughed and said, "What would I be busy with? I'm sure I'm nowhere as comfortable as you! Spinning around with your wife and kids every day without a care in the world. We should hang out together sometime. Speaking of which, didn't you hold a full month celebration for your three babies?"
Lin Yi suddenly slapped his forehead, "Ah, I've been so busy recently that I actually forgot about it."
Reminded by this, Lin Yi also recalled the matter, which he had planned quite early but inadvertently pushed to the back of his mind.
His parents were busy doting on their grandchildren every day, and perhaps his in-laws were too polite to mention it. He and Han Xuewei, being new parents, were naturally prone to overlook some matters.
So such an important event was overlooked!
In the future, such negligence couldn't be allowed; he would have to bring it up in the group chat later!
After hearing this, Qiang Hengxuan burst into laughter, "I was wondering, you're so rich now, you wouldn't skimp on the cost of a full month celebration for the children, right?"
"Sigh, it's my first time being a dad, I really did overlook a lot. If you hadn't reminded me today, I would have totally forgotten."
"Alright, I know you wouldn't miss out on these things. We're all about to graduate but you went on leave to take care of your wife and kids at home. Suddenly calling today, do you need some important help from me?"
Lin Yi quickly said, "As a matter of fact, there is something quite important. I've come across some issues recently and wanted to find out through you what Yang Fan has been up to lately?"
Qiang Hengxuan became puzzled after hearing this, "Why are you suddenly asking about him? You should know he's with your ex-girlfriend Li Jingwen, right? It's almost spread throughout the whole school! Are you thinking of getting revenge on the two of them, or do you want to find out about some other affair of his?"
Li Jingwen and Yang Fan were both very high-profile in their conduct, so once they got together they were bound to be very showy, almost wishing they could flaunt their love every day!
Lin Yi coldly said, "The reason for revenge is because those two provocatively targeted me first! They even had designs on Han Xuewei! You think I could tolerate that?"
Only then did Qiang Hengxuan realize that Lin Yi was really out to protect his wife!
"Not bad, now you're protective of your wife like this. What on earth did the two of them do? Even someone as mild-mannered as you is seeking revenge; what exactly happened?"
Lin Yi: "This matter is quite complicated, and it's not convenient to tell others. Speaking of which, what have the two of them been up to at school recently?"
Qiang Hengxuan said, "On the surface, all is calm. After all, everyone is busy preparing for graduation. However, just after finishing the exams and at the end of last month, the two of them started talking about breaking up, and since then, a video started circulating in the school."
"The video features Li Jingwen, Yang Fan, and her roommate Chen Fei—those three in a room having a threesome! No one knows what happened, it just looks pretty chaotic! I can send it to you if you want to see it. It's two hours long! But the version that's circulating now has definitely been edited by others; key content has been deleted. You can imagine how sensational the original must have been!
Hahaha!"

chapters.title: Chapter 103 Video Leak
chapters.content:
Lin Yi, upon hearing this, didn't have much of a reaction, relieved that he had double-locked the front door when he left. Otherwise, such an embarrassing video might have never stopped spreading!
Qiang Hengxuan then added, "The only pity is that the environment in the video is a bit dark, the lighting somewhat dim. It's a shame no one turned on the light; otherwise, it would have been even more thrilling... I'll send it to you right away, maybe you'll be able to recognize Li Jingwen!"
Lin Yi quickly said, "No! I don't want to see that kind of footage! And I definitely won't listen to anything about Li Jingwen ever again! The only reason I called was to confirm something, are Yang Fan's family's catering company planning to open a new store?"
Lin Yi didn't care to pay attention to such things!
Qiang Hengxuan thought for a moment and then answered, "Seems like there is such a thing. A few days ago while drinking, he was showing off about it to others, saying that the new store's location is pretty good, with a lot of foot traffic. Yang Fan also said that as soon as he graduated, he would go there to manage the place!"
"Their catering company is called Kaiyue Catering, and the new store is also named Kaiyue Fang. Due to the special location, they've invested quite a bit this time, and he's even celebrated in advance by dining there with a few close friends!"
"A friend told me that the new location of Kaiyue Fang was personally chosen by Yang Fan, but for some reason, they haven't secured that place yet. If it really opens successfully, the daily turnover will be substantial!"
Lin Yi continued to ask, "Is there any other news?"
Qiang Hengxuan: "Eh, that's about it. These days everyone's worried about finding jobs, who has the energy to care about other people's business. We're not like you; you're not lacking anything now."
Lin Yi said, "No way, Bro Qiang, compared to your family, I'm far behind. Are you still worried about money?"
Qiang Hengxuan burst into laughter after hearing this, "Let's not talk about this anymore. I'm giving you a heads up; we have to have a taste of your child's full-moon banquet before we graduate! You better not miss this one. Seriously though, I never conceded to anyone in our four years at college, but I'm really impressed with you! You even managed to get the school belle to bear you three kids!
Right now the entire school is discussing your story; you're truly a person of the moment!"
Qiang Hengxuan was quite clever; whenever the conversation drifted towards himself, he would shift the topic, which was a skill in itself.
Lin Yi: "We're going to have our wedding ceremony soon, so there will be plenty of feasts to attend, just be patient!"
"Hahaha, that's going to be too hectic to join in on! Why not do it all at once? After your wedding banquet, you still have to hold a full-moon party for the baby, and then there's the hundred-day celebration. Don't you find it troublesome? So pick a good day, and combine it all; it'll be much easier that way."
Lin Yi thought it over and found it indeed to be a good suggestion. There would be many friends and relatives from both sides at his and Vivi's wedding, so it would certainly be lively enough. If they were to wait until then, the most suitable time would likely be the baby's hundred-day celebration!
Lin Yi said with a smile, "Thanks for the reminder, Bro Qiang."
Qiang Hengxuan: "Eh, what's there to thank? Don't be so formal."
The two chatted about other matters for a while, then each went back to their own business. Lin Yi learned through Qiang Hengxuan that a lot had been going on at school lately.
To his surprise, that charity gala he attended turned out to be a major debacle, even involving a video of three people, which was now widespread throughout the school!
Serves them right! They got what they deserved!
But now that Lin Yi had confirmed that the competitor for the parcel in Yantan District's Expo Park Number Three was indeed Yang Fan's family company, things became much easier to handle!
He sneered, "Still dreaming of opening your store? Keep dreaming of your riches! With this golden opportunity, I will make sure you pay through the nose this time!"
