Lin Yi had already planned many things in his heart. Although the expropriation of Exhibition Garden was not yet officially confirmed, the conversation he had overheard at the charity event was enough to confirm it for him.
But how could he use this to make Yang Fan bleed?
At this thought, Lin Yi suddenly had an idea in his mind!
Soon, Lin Yi had settled on his plan.
He took out his phone and directly sent a voice message in the "Happy Family" group chat.
Lin Yi, "I just remembered something very important. We forgot about the babies' full moon celebration feast! I was reminded of it by a friend, and I think we should make it up to them!"
Han Xuewei, "I was just talking to Qin Xiaoxu, and she brought it up too. I suddenly realized that I had forgotten as well…"
Lin Yi's mom, "Oh dear, look at what I've been thinking about all day! How could I completely forget something like this."
Lin Yi's dad, "Let's set a date to make up for it quickly! We can't delay it any longer..."
Han Xuewei's mom also posted a very surprised emoji in the group, "I've been so busy these days that I forgot about the kids' thing..."
Han Xuewei's dad asked hurriedly, "Then when should we set it for? Does anyone have any good ideas? We can talk about it today. It's my first time being a grandpa, and I've been a bit careless..."
Not just him, everyone present was a first-timer! Truly, each more careless than the last!
It was then that Lin Yi suddenly suggested, "I have a suggestion. Considering the babies are already over two months old, we can just wait for the hundredth day and have a hundred-day celebration feast. And we could combine it with Vivi's and my wedding! How about that?"
Lin Yi's mom quickly said, "That's perfect. I've already checked with someone, and there really aren't any good dates for a wedding this month, so let's wait a bit longer. Let's plan to do all these things together in September! Make it a grand event!"
Lin Yi, "I think that's perfect too. We can bring the babies to Vivi's grandma's place in advance to liven things up."
"After coming back from there, we'll hold a big wedding, and at the same time, we'll celebrate the babies' hundredth-day feast. There are many good dates in September, which is pretty convenient."
Lin Yi's mom, "Let's discuss it first, and I'll ask that gentleman for the best time to set the date. I'll post it in the group later."
Han Xuewei's parents hurriedly said, "Alright, please do us the favor then, dear in-law mother."
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei also expressed their agreement.
After putting down the phone, Lin Yi pondered how to take his father-in-law to see the shop at Wenqu Building. He immediately dialed the property manager's mobile number at Wenqu Building.

chapters.title: Chapter 104 Where is the Wedding Photo?
chapters.content:
It was just a few seconds after the call went through when a response came right away, "Mr. Lin, hello, how can I assist you?"
Lin Yi got straight to the point, "Here's the thing, I'll come to the building tomorrow to select a shop space, but it's not for me to rent, it's for someone else. When that time comes, just say you're in a hurry to lease it and try to lower the rent as much as possible, you understand?" .net
After all, he was a general manager who had fought his way up in the workplace. How could he not understand Lin Yi's implication? He immediately knew that Mr. Lin would definitely bring relatives and friends to rent shops the next day.
Following that, Lin Yi continued, "The person coming with me tomorrow is my father-in-law, so you should know what to do!"
Jiao Xingbiao kept agreeing over the phone, "Understood, understood! Mr. Lin, please rest assured, I will take care of this matter and will personally welcome you when you arrive!"
Lin Yi: "Hmm, I'll be at the building around ten o'clock tomorrow morning; I'll be counting on you then."
Jiao Xingbiao: "I will be sure to welcome you on time!"
Under normal circumstances, even with highly esteemed visitors, Jiao Xingbiao wouldn't need to make an appearance, but now it was different; he couldn't wait to volunteer and also had the chance to meet this young boss!
After confirming the time, Lin Yi hung up the phone.
Then, he mentioned Han Xuewei's father in the chat group: "Father-in-law, how about we go to the exposition garden in Yantan District at eight o'clock tomorrow morning? Let's first check out the shop space you are interested in and contact the landlord. We'll say we're very keen on taking over that place.
Then we'll head over to Wenqu Building, where my friend said there's currently a 1,700 square meter shop space, and he has already arranged for someone to meet us tomorrow."
Han Xuewei's father replied in the group, "Hmm, okay. But since we're choosing between two, why do we still have to say that to the landlord? Besides, I'm not sure if we can really get the rental."
Lin Yi replied with a light smile, "It's okay, just say that for now! I guarantee that the spot at Wenqu Building will definitely catch your eye; it's so much better than the exposition garden in countless ways!"
"Okay! Got it, you should rest early then."
"Hmm, will do."
After discussing the matter with his father-in-law, Lin Yi tiptoed into the baby room to take a look at the three adorable little ones!
He had been really busy these days and hadn't had the chance to see the babies' babbling antics!
The moment Lin Yi entered the baby room, he saw his mom and two maternity matrons each holding and soothing a child.
He walked slowly towards his little daughter and lifted her into his arms.
"Little Mengmeng! Have you missed daddy these past few days?" Lin Yi carefully held his daughter, supporting her little head with his hand.
After all, the baby wasn't even a hundred days old yet and couldn't hold up her head. At this stage, the baby's body is growing rapidly, and her bones are very soft, so he had to be extremely careful.
But for some reason, soon after he held her, she started crying, her small face turning red as if protesting against daddy for not holding her these past few days!
Lin Yi hurriedly soothed her, "Don't cry, don't cry, Mengmeng, be good; daddy will come to hold you every day, okay?"
The little one seemed to understand what he said, as she stopped crying after being coaxed a bit, although her face remained flushed and pitiful.
After calming his daughter, Lin Yi handed her back to his mother and then turned his attention to the other two little ones.
These two were already asleep; it must be said, the sight of them peaceful and quiet was truly adorable!
While Lin Yi watched the babies lovingly, he was reminded of the system hint in his mind!
"Ding! Congratulations to the host! You have held the baby for fifteen minutes and have earned a reward card."
"This card is an all-purpose card that can be used anytime, anywhere."
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi became puzzled, "All-purpose card? What does it do?"
"The host can use the all-purpose card at any time, just swipe it, and you can exchange it for anything you need. There is one limitation to the card's use—it can only be exchanged for items related to the children."
Only then did Lin Yi have an epiphany, "Ah, I see what you mean now!"
He racked his brains for a long time, but for the moment, he couldn't think of what things related to the children he might need right now?
There's no rush. Let's just set this card aside for now, believing that one day it will come in handy.
While Lin Yi was still pondering, his mom began to instruct him, "Lin Yi, you can't keep doing this. You haven't held the baby for several days. What the babies need most for their growth is their parents' company! Once they start talking, they will cling to you every day!"
Lin Yi quickly promised, "I know, Mom. Don't worry, I've just been a bit busy these few days and neglected them a bit. From now on, no matter how busy I am, I will still make time for my family."
Lin Yi's mom continued, "We can take our time to discuss the new date for your wedding with Vivi, but before the ceremony, shouldn't you at least have some proper wedding photos? Otherwise, what are we going to show everyone? I've never heard of anyone getting married without wedding photos!"
As soon as his mom finished speaking, Lin Yi had an epiphany!
Ah!
How foolish! I've been so foolish!
To have been with Han Xuewei for so long and to forget about the children's one-month celebration is understandable, but forgetting to take wedding photos with Vivi is too much!
At the same time, Lin Yi deeply felt that he owed Han Xuewei far too much.
After Han Xuewei got pregnant, she moved in with him, and they quickly got married, followed by a smooth delivery of the baby.
Yet all this time, other than the proposal, Lin Yi hadn't given her a very formal ceremony! He had to admit he had made a significant mistake.
"Ah! Mom, I'm so glad you mentioned the wedding photos today, or I would've completely forgotten about such an important thing!" Lin Yi hastily said.
Although it's a bit late to take wedding photos, if we start preparations these next few days, it should still be possible.
After hearing this, Lin Yi's mom was also quite annoyed and slapped Lin Yi's head, "Aiya! I don't know what's going on in your head! You don't even take care of such matters yourself!"
Lin Yi certainly didn't want to hear his mom nagging anymore, so he hurriedly ran back to the bedroom!
But just then, Han Xuewei was taking a bath!
As Lin Yi pushed the door open, he heard the sound of running water.
He cracked a mischievous smile.
Approaching the door, he deliberately asked, "My dear wife, may I come in for a moment?"

chapters.title: Chapter 105: Chapter 105 Restraint Impulse
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei was startled upon hearing him, and almost jumped up. "Don't come in! I'll be done with the shower soon!"
She really was scared!
Just hearing Lin Yi's voice while bathing made her legs involuntarily clench together!
Her body was nearly trembling!
Last night and today, she had been truly terrified by Lin Yi's torment! Tonight, she just wanted to sleep soundly, and wanted nothing else!
But Lin Yi's thoughts seemed totally different!
For some reason, as soon as he saw Han Xuewei, a strong desire would emerge from the depths of his heart, uncontrollable, sparking various thoughts in his mind.
Upon hearing Han Xuewei's response, Lin Yi could only calmly say, "Oh, then I'll wait a bit longer."
Perhaps Han Xuewei could detect a hint of dejection in Lin Yi's tone, and suddenly her own heart felt empty.
She understood very well that during the ten months of her pregnancy and the confinement period, Lin Yi had restrained himself entirely and never considered seeking other women.
Han Xuewei could now understand why Lin Yi had been so frenzied these past days; it was all within reason.
At his vigorous age, how many men could truly restrain their nature for a year?
Thinking about this, Han Xuewei's feelings towards Lin Yi were mixed with pity.
It's just that today, she was simply too tired.
After wrapping herself in a bath towel, seeing Lin Yi's pitiful expression made Han Xuewei's heart ache.
"Um... husband, go take a shower," she told him.
Lin Yi responded, "Mhm, got it."
After speaking, he got up and headed towards the bathroom.
Lin Yi had also been worn out from all the craziness from last night to this morning; he should heed his mother's advice and exercise some restraint.
He must control his impulses!
While showering, he couldn't help but reminisce about the previous night's events. .net
An urge surged up inside him once again!
Lin Yi promptly switched the hot water to cold, hoping to sober up a bit.
After showering like that for a few minutes, he started to feel a bit calmer.
But he knew that the urge was like a time bomb—a bomb without a timer, ready to explode at any moment!
He went back into the bedroom to find Han Xuewei already sound asleep.
Reflecting on his actions, realizing how exhausted he had made Han Xuewei, he decided not to do anything but quietly lie beside her and rest with his eyes closed.
It's safe to say that the cold shower had had some effect; he no longer had such desires. But the moment he lay next to Han Xuewei, a fragrant scent wafted over from beside him—it was Han Xuewei's body fragrance!
The aroma, mingled with a faint milky scent and still warm, flooded over him.
Instantly, the urge Lin Yi had suppressed within him burst forth like a torrent breaking through a dam!
He could feel his body heating up noticeably!
This feeling was agony!
It was like giving meat to a bear; once tasted, it would crave it every day!
Han Xuewei seemed to be talking in her sleep, making soft, low moans as she slept.
This was almost too much for Lin Yi to bear!
Gradually, he started to move his hand.
Maybe it was because Han Xuewei was exhausted and sleeping deeply, in a half-dream state she felt something strange happening to her body, wondering if the vivid memories of last night were causing similar sensations in her dreams.
But in the middle of the night, when Han Xuewei planned to get up to feed the babies, she suddenly realized Lin Yi's hand was actually behind her...
She wasn't dreaming just now!
All the sensations were real physical reactions!
Looking at the now asleep Lin Yi, Han Xuewei didn't know whether to be angry or to laugh.
She hurriedly got up, took a quick shower, and then headed to the nursery.
The next morning, Lin Yi naturally woke up at 7:30.
Today he had an important matter to attend to with his father-in-law! He couldn't forget about that!
He hastily went to the kitchen and saw his father-in-law having breakfast; fortunately, he wasn't too late. The two chatted while eating and then drove off toward the exhibition garden in Yantan District.
They had arranged a meeting time in advance with the shop owner, and after waiting for about ten minutes upon arrival, the owner hurried over.
Han Xuewei's father went up to greet him first, "Hello, homeowner! Today, my son-in-law and I have come to take a look, his name is Lin Yi."
Then he said to Lin Yi, "This is the owner of shop No. 3, Old Sun."
"Mr. Sun, hello," Lin Yi greeted.
"Hello, hello, Mr. Lin, you should be aware of the rental prices in this area, right? You can see the crowd flow here, and the price I'm offering is absolutely the market average, 180,000 a month! After all, this shop is in high demand, and if you think it's too expensive, then you'll have to look elsewhere. There are others who want to rent this shop space right now," the owner said.
Listening to this, Lin Yi smiled faintly and then said, "Are you referring to the people from Kaiyue Catering Company?"
The landlord replied, "Hmm, it seems you're well informed already. Let's speak frankly then. Kaiyue Catering Company has offered a high price, 190,000 in rent monthly, and it was the company owner's second son who came to discuss it personally! However, he said he couldn't make the decision on his own and needed some time to discuss it with his dad.
If you can't make up your mind soon, I'll have to rent it to him, as he will give me an answer before tomorrow."
Lin Yi smiled slightly, then took out his phone and showed the landlord a message, smiling lightly, "Mr. Sun, about your shop… Is it really worth this price?"
Just then, coincidentally, Yang Fan and his father and brother arrived at the location; they were also there for an on-site inspection and happened upon Lin Yi.
Before they approached, that familiar voice was heard from afar.
"What a coincidence, Mr. Sun, this is..." Yang Fan and his companions slowly came over, inquiring as they approached.
He certainly knew it was Lin Yi, but he still didn't understand why this man would be here and what he intended to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Chapter 106 Competitors
chapters.content:
Lin Yi was slightly taken aback when he saw Yang Fan, then he put his phone back in his pocket.
Landlord Sun hurriedly answered, "They have also come to see the third shop."
It was then that Yang Fan realized, the landlord had mentioned someone else also wanted to rent this place, but he didn't expect it to be Lin Yi!
So he turned his head and said to the two people behind him, "Dad, big brother, wasn't I right? It's not just me who's interested in this shop; the business here is definitely booming."
Then, he turned back to Lin Yi and asked, "Lin Yi, what exactly do you plan to do with this place?"
Lin Yi didn't care about Yang Fan in the slightest, and said nonchalantly, "What else could I do? Exactly what you're doing!" .net
At that moment, Yang Fan's gaze lingered on the man next to Lin Yi, and after a while, he slowly said, "Ah, could he be the clueless financier you've brought along? I remember your family does not run a catering business."
It was then that Han Xuewei's father spoke up, "He is my son-in-law."
Yang Fan's eyes revealed a trace of surprise; he hadn't expected him to be Han Xuewei's father!
But even so, what of it? If they were here to snatch the shop from him, he wouldn't be soft-hearted!
Immediately afterward, he whispered to his father and brother, "This place is really great. There's no better location than this. Dad, big brother, this is a golden opportunity! We mustn't miss this chance no matter what! And I'm about to graduate soon; you all want me to join society and grow quickly, don't you? You have to trust my judgment; this investment will definitely make a fortune!"
"Dad, you trust me, right? There's no way I'll be wrong about this!"
Yang Fan had already boasted in front of his classmates, so no matter what, he had to open the shop quickly! Otherwise, his reputation and credibility would be utterly lost! That would be somewhat embarrassing!
After hearing this, Yang Hongwei nodded and said, "Hmm. I can trust you, but don't let me down. For leasing, renovation, and all other expenses, I'll give you a budget of 8 million! If you don't earn back half of the costs in your first year of operation, then don't think about joining the management team."
It was true that Kaiyue Catering Company had been founded single-handedly by Yang Hongwei. However, the current Kaiyue Catering Company was a product of financing, with Yang Hongwei being the largest shareholder now.
If his second son, Yang Fan, wanted to enter the management level, he needed the agreement of other shareholders.
So for them, opening a store was not difficult, but if they wanted to compete for the management level later on, they would have to demonstrate undeniable capability that would satisfy everyone, just like what his eldest son had done!
Yang Hongwei held the same expectations for his two sons, both with the hope that they would become successful.
At that moment, Yang Fan assured his father with a pat on his chest, "You can be completely reassured! I will put in more than my full effort this time!"
He always believed that his judgment and investigation were flawless. After all, this was the old downtown area with completely sufficient surrounding facilities, and there was no need to worry about foot traffic. Wasn't this an excellent spot that guaranteed profits without losses?
Yang Fan had already made up his mind; no matter what, he was determined to get this shop!
Then he said to the two of them, "Dad, big brother, although the rent here is high, 190,000 is still within our affordable range, right?"
And just at that moment, Yang Fan's elder brother, Yang Zhen, also chimed in, "Dad, I've already had someone survey this area once, and overall, the location and the plan for Later Stages business operations are perfect, with absolutely no room for error."
Yang Hongwei looked up and surveyed the surroundings before turning his gaze to the two brothers, and finally nodded in satisfaction.
The matter was settled!
Seeing his father persuaded by himself and his elder brother, Yang Fan then walked towards Lin Yi, high-spirited and jubilant.
But as Yang Fan approached, Lin Yi caught a glimpse of Yang Fan's brother, Yang Zhen, whose mouth corners lifted slightly to reveal a strange smile that nearly went unnoticed by others!
It looked rather sinister!
If it weren't for the fact that Lin Yi happened to be looking at Yang Zhen, that expression would have been missed entirely!
And through that instant, he was almost certain that Yang Fan's brother was no simple character!
Could it be...
The thought had barely crossed his mind when Lin Yi decided to use the ability granted by the system as a reward—the Art of Appraisal!
It was, after all, his first time using this ability! Why not test it out today to see its effectiveness?
"Report to the host, if the host wishes to use a certain ability, merely utter its name to activate the skill! For example, say 'Use Art of Appraisal' towards the person you wish to identify, and the skill will be successfully triggered."
Lin Yi finally understood.
He didn't expect the skill to be so convenient to use, being able to discern whether the person identified was good or bad almost instantly.
Immediately after, Lin Yi's eyes were fixed intently on Yang Zhen as he silently commanded, "Art of Appraisal! Activate!"
System: "Please wait a moment, host. Identification in progress."
Before a moment had passed, the system replied, "The identified person harbors a scheming heart, is deceitful, highly calculative, and constantly laying plans. One must not associate with such a person."
As Lin Yi listened, he pondered, "So he's quite a scheming person..."
Indeed, having seen the expression on Yang Zhen's face just earlier, Lin Yi had already guessed as much.
Upon uncovering the truth, Lin Yi was also surprised, "Could it be... Yang Fan's own brother set him up? To even scheme against his own flesh and blood, this is too much..."
However, thinking about it, this wasn't all that strange; after all, in well-to-do families, many brothers who are as close as hands and feet would stop at nothing for their own interests, especially when competing for inheritance or fighting for power.
Moreover, Lin Yi had listened clearly just a while ago—if Yang Fan could get the store up and running, there was a chance for him to reach new heights in the future!
But if Yang Fan were to take a management position, his brother's interests would inevitably be affected. So, it would be better to play some tricks and make Yang Fan out to be an inept businessman, a wealthy second-generation who only knew how to play.
Then, Yang Zhen could take control of the power all by himself!
And no one would threaten his position!
This move was truly ingenious! It had to be said that this person was incredibly ruthless, not even sparing his own brother when inflicting pain!
However, Lin Yi was well aware that all this had nothing to do with him, and he couldn't manage these affairs.
It appeared things were becoming even more interesting!
Originally, Lin Yi had planned to inform Mr. Sun, the landlord here, that the entire street had been requisitioned and would soon be demolished, then persuade Mr. Sun to rent to Yang Fan at all costs, ideally jacking up the rent! But looking at the current situation, things were obviously different now!
At the same time, Lin Yi felt an eagerness to watch how events would unfold.

chapters.title: Chapter 107 Going with the Flow
chapters.content:
Today, I really did a bit too much.
But now that things have come to this point, I might as well go with the flow!
Thinking of this, Lin Yi shook his head repeatedly, even starting to feel a bit of sympathy for Yang Fan!
If Yang Fan knew that after such a long time spent selecting the shop and the hefty sum he poured into renovations, it would be forced into demolition, his expression would certainly be priceless! I'm afraid by then, he wouldn't even have the chance to regret it!
I wonder if the video that went viral at the school recently has been seen by his dad and brother?
If those two knew about the big fuss he caused at school, and then learned about the store he spent so long preparing and the huge amount of capital he invested not earning a single cent, he won't be able to hold his head high in the Yang Family anymore!
Hehe, I am actually quite eager to see just how miserably you'll lose.
You shouldn't have messed with Lin Yi. Otherwise, out of classmate camaraderie, I might have lent you a hand! But it's too late to say anything now!
Yang Fan hurriedly ran up to the landlord, Mr. Sun, and respectfully said, "Landlord Sun, you must have heard of our Kaiyue Catering Company's reputation! Our strength is also self-evident! Rather than trusting those insignificant minor roles in the industry, why not cooperate directly with us? I believe our cooperation would definitely be long-term, not the kind that leaves after a year or two.
Plus, if you agree, I can offer 200,000 a month for the rent! We can sign the contract in two hours!"
Han Xuewei's dad got upset upon hearing this, as their Han family's private kitchen had been handed down for generations! The reputation and flavor of the dishes were naturally beyond question! Since when had they become insignificant minor roles?
For a moment, Han Xuewei's dad was so angered that his face turned a bright red! .net
This was when Lin Yi pulled his father-in-law aside and whispered in his ear, "Father-in-law, it's okay, it's not certain yet."
Han Xuewei's dad had no choice but to try to calm himself and turned his attention back to landlord Sun.
As for the landlord, a beaming smile spread across his face, for the outcome of this matter was already decided. As a businessman, who would refuse money?
Seeing the landlord's expression, Yang Fan knew that the deal was almost sealed.
"A fixed price of 200,000 a month for the rent! And it can start from this month!"
Upon hearing this, Mr. Sun eagerly agreed, "Great, great, let's do it at the price you said. I'll rent it exclusively to you! Let's sign the contract in a moment!"
At this point, the landlord couldn't contain his excitement, as if he feared the ready meal might fly away, he quickly agreed to the offer!
He knew very well in his heart that the price Yang Fan was offering was the highest, and seeing that half of this month had already passed, yet the tenant was willing to pay rent starting from the current month, it was a surefire profitable deal!
At this time, Yang Fan looked at Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's dad with a smug face, his expression filled with pride!
When Lin Yi saw his schadenfreude, he just smiled lightly without saying much, then turned his head to the landlord and said, "Mr. Sun, then congratulations on successfully leasing out the place. We will look elsewhere, farewell."
The landlords also expressed their apologies to them, "Sorry about this time, gentlemen. If there's an opportunity in the future, we can cooperate again."
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi laughed and said, "That's how business is. They offered a higher price, so it's reasonable for you to lease to them."
Having said that, Lin Yi took his father-in-law and left.
However, his father-in-law was still preoccupied with the perfect location they just left and couldn't help but mutter, "Ah, it would be hard to find a better place than this. It would've been so good if we could've struck a deal! Absolutely a guaranteed profit!"
Lin Yi, of course, noticed his father-in-law's thoughts but kept silent and merely drove his father-in-law toward the Wenqu Building.
The time was not too late; they might even arrive half an hour early.
When Lin Yi parked the car at the entrance of Wenqu Building, he saw the property manager, Jiao Xingbiao, along with a few people, coming out to receive them!
There were three people waiting at the entrance, including the property manager at the very front, who clearly had an air of authority about him, followed by a man and a woman dressed like assistants. Each was more respectful than the last.
Jiao Xingbiao stepped forward and said, "Mr. Lin, hello! I am the property manager you spoke with over the phone; just call me Xiao Jiao."
Then, he turned to Han Xuewei's dad and inquired politely, "May I ask who this gentleman is?"
Lin Yi answered, "He's my father-in-law, Mr. Han."
After Jiao Xingbiao stopped, he immediately straightened up and said very respectfully, "Mr. Han, a pleasure to meet you!"
Lin Yi and his father-in-law might then have shaken hands with the three of them.
The two assistants also came forward to greet them.
Lin Yi then said, "Let's go up and take a look at the shop now, shall we?"
As soon as Lin Yi spoke, Jiao Xingbiao immediately made an inviting gesture, "Of course, right this way, please!"
He led the way in front, and the two assistants followed at the back.
As they were heading upstairs, Han Xuewei's dad whispered to his son-in-law, "Lin Yi, doesn't this atmosphere seem a bit off? These people are extremely respectful towards you, even though he is the manager of this building; he acted as if he were seeing a boss when he saw you?"
Lin Yi explained without changing his expression, "Well, one of the shareholders of this building is my friend's father, and I have a pretty good relationship with that friend, so naturally the manager treats me as if I were the young master. If the hospitality isn't good enough, he could lose his job!"
Even though Lin Yi's voice was quiet, it could be heard very clearly in the silent surroundings.
Especially the leading Jiao Xingbiao, who shivered upon hearing Lin Yi's words.
Whatever you say, there's no help for it, since you're the boss, right?
After hearing this, Han Xuewei's dad seemed to ponder for a moment, "That makes sense; seems about right."
It wasn't long before an empty large storefront came into view!
Jiao Xingbiao stood in front of the store then turned around and introduced earnestly, "This is the largest remaining shop we have here at the moment. The shop has a duplex structure, and if you include the external rooftop space, both floors together exceed one thousand square meters."
"This is the biggest building in the city center, so you don't have to worry about the traffic at all. Over two thousand people work in this building every day. May I ask what you gentlemen have planned?"
Han Xuewei's dad quickly explained, "I plan to open a private kitchen restaurant and wanted to find a place with a larger crowd. It seems this place is indeed quite suitable!"
Upon finishing, he turned to Lin Yi and quietly said, "Lin Yi, this location can definitely be ranked as the best in the city, and it's so spacious. The rent must be pretty high, right? Anyway, it must be at least two or three hundred thousand more than the rental fee of Bolan Garden, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 108 Sign the Contract
chapters.content:
Although it has only been a few years since this place was designated as the city center, it developed from a high-tech district! It is also the commercial center of the entire city!
Therefore, you can imagine how prosperous it is here, and it will only increase in the future.
Seeing such a prime location, Han Xuewei's father was not only worried about the rent but also anxious about whether his out-of-town restaurant could integrate into the local market. To truly establish a strong presence here would be quite difficult.
If they really rented this golden area, they would probably have to lease it by the year, which would only increase his concerns.
Jiao Xingbiao saw the two whispering to each other and felt a multitude of emotions. Just two days ago, Kaiyue Catering Company had inquired about renting this place, offering a rather generous amount.
They offered a monthly rent of 600,000 right off the bat, which even tempted him! If it hadn't been for Lin Yi calling him with specific instructions, this shop would have already been taken!
Just then, Lin Yi gave him a meaningful look, and Jiao Xingbiao understood immediately.
So he stepped forward and said to the two, "Both of you, this is indeed a golden spot with a large space. Everyone must think our rent is astronomical. (And it is.) That's why some people gave up without even asking the price. This shop has been vacant for almost half a year now. To rent it out as soon as possible, our strategy is to lower the rent. Now, it's only 190,000."
Han Xuewei's father brightened up immediately, his face one of incredulity as he looked at everyone around him.
Only 190,000?
This is the center of the city, the largest building for miles around! The rent is so low!
Isn't this a great opportunity?
Jiao Xingbiao, seeing Han Xuewei's father's strange expression, clenched his teeth and directly said, "170,000! That's the lowest we can go! You can sign the contract today…"
"We'll take it! We can sign the contract right now!"
Han Xuewei's father interrupted Jiao Xingbiao!
Even if it were 190,000, he would have definitely signed! Not to mention 170,000. He had no hesitation whatsoever!
Jiao Xingbiao looked at Lin Yi, who showed no expression, then continued, "The thing is, we have a rule here. Although the rent is lower, the contract has to be for a minimum of five years."
Han Xuewei's father promptly replied, "Fine, that's not a problem!"
With a monthly rent of only 170,000, making a profit was certain. Even if they ended up running at a loss, it wouldn't be too severe—it would at least be within his tolerance!
Lin Yi coughed softly and said, "Let's not talk about other things. If it's possible, let's sign the contract now."
Han Xuewei's father eagerly said, "Yes, yes, yes! Let's sign the contract now! The sooner the better—I'll be at peace once this matter is settled."
About 20 minutes later, both parties had signed the contract, and Han Xuewei's father was already beaming with joy!
"Lin Yi, we've really got ourselves a bargain today! Your friend is very reliable! This place is a hundred times better than I imagined! Ah, finally, this matter is resolved. Now we just need to contact the decoration company!"
"It's such a great deal. They didn't charge us any rent for the first two months and specially set aside time for us to decorate, which is really lucky!"
Seeing his father-in-law so excited, Lin Yi also felt quite content inside.
Meanwhile, Yang Fan had also signed a two-year lease in one breath. He couldn't be more thrilled at this moment!
But the naïve Yang Fan could never imagine that behind this transaction, a conspiracy was lurking!
Once everything was settled, Lin Yi thought of going to Kaiyue Hotel for a meal with his father-in-law to taste the dishes and check the level of service, among other things.
On hearing this, his father-in-law also agreed, as knowing your competition is the key to winning battles!
After discussing, they let their families know not to expect them back for lunch.
Lin Yi looked up the nearby hotels and restaurants under Kaiyue Company and drove them there directly.
The hotel had both a Chinese and a Western restaurant. The Western restaurant was a buffet, lacking core competition, so they were more interested in the Chinese cuisine.
As soon as they entered the hotel, the lobby manager greeted them enthusiastically, providing excellent service.
As they walked, Lin Yi noted the interior decoration was simple yet tasteful, even somewhat luxurious.
Strictly speaking, it was not yet lunchtime, but looking around, the Chinese restaurant's main hall was almost fully seated.
They were led to the only vacant seat in the hall by the waiter, close to the restroom. Although they had no other choice, there was a partition separating their seat from the restroom. The Wenqu Building centralized all restrooms in one area, and the restroom in their leased shop was also tucked in a corner, at least not so close to where the diners sat.
Before they even ordered, they were already a bit discontent.
Even though they arrived late with no reservation, they didn't expect to be seated in such a spot!
And he was convinced that any customer seated in this place would have complaints!
After reluctantly taking their seats, they picked up the menu and started looking at the featured dishes.
They were determined to try everything today!
Without much hesitation, Lin Yi ordered every dish marked as featured.
The waiter, noticing Lin Yi had chosen all the featured dishes, reminded them, "Our portions are quite generous. You don't need to order so much; you might not be able to finish it all."
Lin Yi smiled and replied, "We're from out of town and heard that your dishes are good, so we specially came to try them."
The waiter then said, "Since you two want to try the featured dishes, as there were many customers this noon, our kitchen will be a bit busier, so we hope you can wait patiently."
That wasn't really an issue, and Lin Yi didn't mind. He flipped through the menu and then said, "It's fine, we can wait. In the meantime, could you serve us a pot of health tea?"
"Certainly, we have a variety of health teas. Which type would you like? We have ones for replenishing Qi and blood, and others for expelling dampness."
"Expelling dampness."
Lin Yi, upon seeing words like 'health', suddenly remembered he had to write a nutritional menu for Han Xuewei when he returned!
This was something that required careful study and time.
A few minutes later, the waiter brought over a pot of tea and poured some for them.
Lin Yi and his father-in-law sipped the dampness-expelling tea while patiently waiting for their food.
Just then, from the other side of the partition near the restroom door, there arose a deep male voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Chapter 109 A Conspiracy
chapters.content:
"President Yang, will Yang Fan really enter the company's management in the future? I don't find his abilities to be very outstanding, but it seems the Chairman intends to focus on developing him further. You should understand, once many positions are assumed, they are hard to withdraw from. If he really is cultivated, you..."
Just as this person was speaking, another voice sounded from nearby.
"You needn't worry about that. This matter, I will handle at my discretion. I've reached my position today by being cunning. Wanting to enter the company's management? Hah, he's still far from making it!"
When this voice spoke, Lin Yi immediately realized that the man was none other than Yang Fan's brother—Yang Zhen!
Yang Zhen gave a cold laugh and continued, "A week ago, I had already obtained the expropriation information for that area. I guarantee that within one month, the whole street will be demolished! And the information about the shop being up for rent, I deliberately told him about it. I didn't expect that guy to act like he had found treasure, and he jumped right into the pit!
After saying that, Yang Zhen let out another cold laugh.
The man at his side understood completely and joined in, "Haha, President Yang is indeed brilliant!"
"Enough, we shouldn't speak too much, for walls have ears," said Yang Zhen, and without looking back, he went up the stairs with the other man.
Watching his retreating figure, Lin Yi shrugged helplessly, it seemed everything was exactly as he had anticipated!
Han Xuewei's father also happened to overhear the conversation through the partition. He looked up just in time to see Yang Zhen leaving, paused for a moment, then excitedly said, "Lin Yi, did you hear that? It's good we didn't snatch up that place! Otherwise, we would have surely suffered a massive loss!"
Lin Yi just smiled faintly and replied, "A misfortune may turn out to be a blessing in disguise."
The father-in-law sighed in relief and gratefully said, "Yes, indeed, I was still worried about the shop issue. I had no idea that today, not only would we find a better option but also avoid a disaster. Thanks to your help! Otherwise, I might have been tempted to raise the price and try for it! It's good you were here!"
While the two were still discussing this, the ordered dishes were gradually served to the table.
Lin Yi and his father-in-law tasted each dish in turn, feeling that these specialty dishes were indeed quite good, although they were nothing particularly impressive.
Among these signature dishes, there were also a few that were Western cuisine, which seemed quite palatable.
After tasting these dishes, Han Xuewei's father didn't feel much, and even pointed out several shortcomings of some dishes, but he wasn't very familiar with Western cuisine.
So he thought for a while, then said to Lin Yi, "Lin Yi, when the private restaurant opens, should we serve only Chinese cuisine, or should we incorporate Western cuisine as well? Nowadays, young people generally accept Western cuisine, so we should consider this consumer group. Maybe we'll even need to hire a few chefs who specialize in Western dishes."
After pondering for a moment, Lin Yi said, "Actually, as long as we bring out our own characteristics in Chinese cuisine, we already have core competitiveness. If possible, we can also add Western cuisine. After all, we need diversity to cater to most people's tastes."
Han Xuewei's father agreed with the suggestion, for with changing times, a businessman must cater to the prevailing consumer attitudes and making some attempts is not out of the question.
The only thing to consider now was the operational plan.
As they ate and discussed, Dad Han also shared his many years of experience with Lin Yi.
And so, they talked until three o'clock, and now it was time to return.
Today, Lin Yi had finally helped his father-in-law resolve a major concern, and he himself could relax now, looking forward to sleeping in for the next few days.
And Han Xuewei could also breathe a sigh of relief.
Lin Yi called the server to pay the bill and then headed back home with his father-in-law.
They were both eager to get home and see the three babies, who were growing faster by the day; each day, they seemed a bit different, so just one day apart made them incredibly missed.
The two had left early in the morning and hadn't even glanced at the three little ones before departing.
Before long, they both returned home, bringing with them some desserts from the hotel.
Lin Yi burst excitedly into the bedroom, intending to share the day's joy with his wife, but as soon as he entered, he found Han Xuewei still fast asleep, so he tiptoed out of the room and headed to the nursery next door.
The little ones had just been fed, and at the moment they were busy babbling away with the adults.
Lin Yi's mother and his mother-in-law were holding the brother and sister, while Aunt Wang was soothing the eldest.
Han Xuewei's father brought the desserts into the kitchen and then joined everyone in the nursery, saying, "We've brought back some desserts for everyone to enjoy as afternoon tea. There's plenty so the two maternity matrons can have some as well."
Han's mother said, "Yes, the babies just had a bit too much milk. We'll go down as soon as we've finished burping them. It will be soon."
Lin Yi's mother, knowing that Lin Yi came specifically for Mengmeng, handed the little girl to him.
As soon as Lin Yi took his daughter into his arms, he saw her face light up with a joyful smile.
His mother and mother-in-law quietly left the nursery.
Aunt Wang said, "It's okay, I'm not in a hurry to eat. I'd rather keep an eye on the children. After all, you guys can be quite careless sometimes and may not take good care of the babies."
Lin Yi and his father-in-law exchanged a smile upon hearing this.
The eldest and the second child seemed to realize that their dad was only doting on their sister and not holding them, which made them unhappy, and they immediately started to cry loudly.
His father-in-law laughed heartily at the sight of the two little ones and said, "What's the matter, not comfortable with grandpa holding you? Why so reserved?"
"It's alright, it's alright, in a few more days your grandfather will retire and look after you full-time at home!"
With that, Dad Han's face was brimming with joyous laughter!
In the afternoon, he volunteered to cook, planning to prepare a lavish dinner.
This dinner was to celebrate the successful reservation of the shop!
Of course, Lin Yi also made a gesture, opening a bottle of expensive wine to celebrate. Since nobody was much of a drinker, each person only took a few sips.
After all, this high-priced wine was meant to be savored carefully, not to get drunk on.
Han Xuewei was currently breastfeeding, so it was best for her to stay completely abstinent from alcohol!
After everyone had dinner, the babies woke up from their nap. Lin Yi rolled out the stroller, and the whole family planned to go for a walk to dispel the effects of the alcohol.

chapters.title: Chapter 110: Chapter 110 Two Vicious Dogs
chapters.content:
So, the babies were placed in the stroller and pushed out.
It was only then that Lin Yi realized that he had moved here for such a long time without really taking a good walk around the neighborhood, barely familiar with its layout.
It seemed like a good opportunity today to check out the area, just take it as a chance to relax and get some fresh air.
Chatting and laughing along the way, they hadn't walked far when suddenly, at a small intersection, two large dogs dashed out from somewhere at great speed.
And they were Alaskas!
The two Alaskas unexpectedly charged at the strollers carrying the elder baby and little sister Mengmeng!
Everyone barely had time to react, caught off guard by the sudden scene, and was hugely startled!
Thankfully, Lin Yi was quick-witted and fast, stepping forward to block the dogs, delivering a sideways kick that sent the dogs flying aside!
Due to the urgency of the situation, he had used almost all his strength, and the two Alaskas were kicked several meters away, yelping.
The poor little ones in the stroller, having never experienced such a fright, all started crying loudly!
The family was in a frantic hustle to lift the babies out of the stroller, each trying to soothe them!
Mother Lin was immediately annoyed and raised her voice in reprimand, "Whose big dogs are these? Can't you at least keep them on a leash when going out? Don't you know this can scare people?"
Just as Mother Lin was speaking, a young couple came around the corner of the road up ahead.
The woman defiantly yelled back, "The dogs are ours, what about it? It's your own fault for not watching where you're going. We also have the right to be here! It didn't kill anyone, so why are you making such a fuss?"
Lin Yi and his mother, not used to taking such nonsense, were immediately triggered, "These two beasts are yours, aren't they? Don't you know that dogs must be leashed nowadays? Why do you think you're the exception?"
The volume of both parties escalated, and their quarrel quickly drew the attention of onlookers, and soon, a large crowd had gathered to watch the commotion.
The woman previously had heavy makeup on and with a scornful glance, she continued arrogantly, "Heh, leashes? You expect me to leash my dogs just because you say so? Please, this is right in front of my house, I won't leash them, got a problem with that?"
Han Xuewei's mother frowned slightly, patiently explaining, "Just now, these two large dogs rushed towards our strollers, and the children were all scared and crying. If they frightened other playing children, it wouldn't be good. These large breeds can be quite aggressive, and if they started to bite, the consequences would be unthinkable! Today's incident was truly dangerous!"
The man beside her was still dismissive, "Heh, our two dogs have pure bloodlines! They might even be more precious than your little kids by a long shot!"
"It was you who kicked our pets just now, wasn't it? We should be the ones to settle the score first, right? How come you're the one to speak up first??"
Meanwhile, Lin Yi's mind flashed with the system's notification!
"Ding! Congratulations, host, for successfully protecting the baby during a moment of danger! You have earned a system reward."
"The reward is fifty-two percent of the stock ownership of Romeo Security Company! From this moment on, you are the major shareholder of this security company!"
"Ding! The system detects that the host is currently in a crisis and can seek help from the security company with the push of a special emergency button. Once this special emergency button is activated, High Level security will appear by your side within three minutes to provide assistance. Would you like to activate the button now?"
Lin Yi glanced at the man and woman before him, thinking that the two were quite arrogant, but surely they wouldn't pose too much of a threat to him, right? At the same time, he wondered why the system was warning him that he was in imminent danger.
Lin Yi looked down and realized that the two Alaskans were baring their teeth at him and growling softly by his side, leading him to understand the reason for his alarm.
Without hesitation, he said, "Activate the button now!"
"Host's command received, the button has been activated! High Level security will soon appear at your side to solve all your problems!"
Only then did Lin Yi feel relieved.
This man is really too arrogant, isn't he? How can he compare his babies to two dogs!
The three mothers present immediately took offense, with Mother Lin and Han's mother cursing outright, expressing their dissatisfaction loudly!
"Do you even know how to speak? What kind of comparison is this? How dare you compare our babies to those two beasts of yours?"
"How could you have such low standards?"
"It was clearly your fault to begin with, not leashing your dogs while walking them. Now you're turning around and biting back, blaming us? Don't you have any sense of morality?"
Because they couldn't scare the children in their arms, they were already showing great restraint!
But the arrogant couple felt that the family was an easy target and raised their voices even higher in dispute, "Our doggies are also our children! Are only your children precious?"
"Why can't we compare? Dogs are alive too, dogs are also family. When I say they are our children, they are our children! Do you have a problem with that?"
"This is right in front of our house. Is there a problem with us taking a walk here? Besides, we don't have to leash them here, do we? If you're unhappy, you can go somewhere else! Nobody's forcing you to come here!" the heavily made-up woman said disdainfully.
At this moment, a buzz of discussion started among the crowd.
"I had a quarrel with this couple last time too. They are notorious for being unreasonable."
"Looks like someone's going to suffer again."
"This isn't the first time a fight has broken out because of a dog. These two large dogs they keep have hurt several children before! There have even been cases of women being knocked down by them; it's really too dangerous! If someone gets bitten, the consequences would be unimaginable!"
.net
"And the three babies in the stroller don't look very big. It's just that there was no stroller just now, and no harm came to the kids!"
"Although their doorway is on my way home, I usually choose to walk around it. The sight of their two dogs makes me nervous now!"
Lin Yi had sharp ears, and from the crowd's chatter, he could tell that this couple's reputation was not very good.
Mother Lin was still not over it and wanted to continue arguing, but at that moment, the sound of uniform footsteps caught everyone's attention!
Following the noise, the crowd saw seven or eight men dressed in neat suits and of impressive stature walking quickly towards them!

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Chapter 111 Preside Over Justice
chapters.content:
Meanwhile, a few patrol uncles were nearby.
These tall, black-clothed men came straight over, using their bodies to encircle Lin Yi's family members in the middle!
At this point, everyone but Lin Yi was taken aback, staring dumbfounded at these burly men of unclear origin.
Lin Yi, however, was very calm.
"Don't be afraid, they are High Level security personnel, especially hired by me. They are here to protect our entire family!" Lin Yi said lightly.
After hearing this, everyone let out a sigh of relief. They had indeed been frightened by the imposing manner of these men and had thought they were the couple's bodyguards!
Since the babies were still crying fiercely, everyone was now comforting the children and had no time to care about anything else.
The patrol uncles, who had accompanied the security, were also quick to approach the couple and question them.
"We received an emergency call from the residents of the community, reporting an incident with a large dog attacking people. Are these two dogs yours?"
The leader of the patrol team, a tall man, went straight up to ask.
However, the couple remained defiant and self-willed in the face of the sudden appearance of the security and patrol officers.
"Both dogs are mine. Who reported it? How can they blatantly lie? Where is the injured person? Who was hurt? Isn't everything fine here?
We're just taking a walk in front of our house; what's the problem with that?"
The captain of the patrol team said sternly, "According to the city's public safety regulations, residents who take medium to large dogs into public places not only need to have them on a leash but must also put a muzzle on them to avoid disturbing others. These are basic common sense, surely you must be aware of them?"
"Do your two dogs have licenses? Have they been vaccinated?"
At that moment, a person who had been standing by for quite a while quickly stepped forward and showed his phone to the patrol uncle.
"Comrade, when the incident occurred, I happened to be nearby. I started recording a video as soon as they began arguing. You can have a look for reference."
"Thank you for providing the clue; we will watch it now."
The patrol officers gathered around to view the complete footage captured by the resident.
It showed the entire sequence of events after the altercation broke out between the two families, as well as the arrival of the security and patrol officers on the scene!
Although the video did not capture how the two large dogs lunged at the stroller, and how Lin Yi kicked them away, bystanders all testified for Lin Yi, indicating the young couple was at fault first, but they refused to admit it and even cursed loudly!
Seeing almost all the bystanders expressing their discontent, the patrol officer sternly reprimanded them.
"We have already watched the video, and you were insulting others here. Do you know that is wrong? Moreover, it violates related laws. If you insult someone, the victim can seek help immediately, and you are about to receive criticism and education! At the same time, you may be detained or fined! If the circumstances are serious, you can be detained for ten days!"
"In the video, you were the first to insult others, and when your mistake was pointed out, you did not repent but replied with abusive language. Such medium to large dogs must be leashed when going out! Also, do your dogs have licenses?"
The couple, who had been creating trouble and being unreasonable, had completely failed to realize their wrongdoing and continued to argue defiantly, "What does it matter if we have a license or not? What does it mean if we don't? It's none of your business!"
"According to the city dog-keeping regulations, your practice of not using a leash has seriously violated the relevant clauses. We will now give you both a verbal warning, and at the same time, there will be a fine! If you show no remorse and maintain a bad attitude, your dog license will be seized! From now on, you will not be allowed to have a dog!
If you do not have a dog license right now, that is illegal! We also have the right to take direct custody!"
The couple tried to argue, but the captain of the patrol team, seeing their behavior, knew they were the type to be unreasonable and signaled the accompanying officers with a glance.
The other members of the patrol quickly surrounded them, attempting to subdue them, but the two large dogs began to bark aggressively!
The High Level security personnel protecting Lin Yi's family immediately pulled out a device resembling a taser and swiftly moved forward to stun the two large dogs!
After completing this action, the security personnel backed away and no longer interfered with the situation on the scene.
The captain of the patrol team sternly announced, "Take these two people away for now, and temporarily confiscate the two dogs as strays! Today they have also committed another offense—obstructing law enforcement!"
But to everyone's surprise, the couple continued to resist fiercely while shouting angrily, "What are you doing? Do you know who I am? What right do you have to arrest me? I warn you in advance, you will be held accountable for your actions!"
The patrol team captain, still stern, declared, "I've already made the reasons clear, and before I am held responsible, it's you who must be accountable!"
Anyone who knew the captain would say that if Xiangcheng had to choose the fairest, most impartial, and most courageous patrol officer, he would rank second, with no one daring to claim the first!
Even if you have powerful connections, in his hands, everything must be handled according to the law!
It must be said, this arrogant and domineering couple has finally been sanctioned!
Indeed, it is a delight to everyone's hearts!
And at this moment, several law enforcement vehicles parked nearby, and a few patrol officers disembarked!
"Captain!"
"Take them all, along with the two dogs, back to the station!"
Just like that, the couple who were so arrogant just a second ago, were now adorned with a pair of cold handcuffs at this moment.
Seeing the couple with faces of misery being escorted onto the law enforcement vehicle, and the two large dogs also being lifted into the van, motionless throughout the process.
Perhaps it was because the taser was too powerful!
This scene also led to applause and cheers from the onlookers, as today someone had finally come to discipline them!
After arranging everything, the patrol team captain approached Lin Yi's family and apologized, "I am truly sorry, we did not notice this issue before, which has brought inconvenience to your life!"
At this moment, the three babies had calmed down and were quietly lying in their stroller, sleeping soundly.
Lin Yi expressed his gratitude, "I should be the one thanking you for upholding justice for me! Otherwise, I really would have had no way to deal with those two!"
The onlookers also expressed their thanks, and the patrol captain soothed them, "Please rest assured, in the future, any reports we receive will be dealt with as seriously as today! To provide everyone with a pleasant living environment, please disperse now."

chapters.title: Chapter 112: Chapter 112 Romeo Security Company
chapters.content:
Only after the enforcement vehicle had driven away, and the onlookers gradually dispersed, did Lin Yi have the others take the three babies back home first.
At this moment, the captain of the security team from Romeo Security Company approached with great respect and said to Lin Yi, "Mr. Lin Yi, we apologize for our late arrival. I hope you and your family weren't frightened?"
"We are high-level security personnel from the Romeo Security Company. I am the captain, my name is Zhou Jianlai. From today onwards, you can entrust the safety of your family to me. Please rest assured!"
Lin Yi smiled calmly and said, "Well, thank you for that. Now, I'm going to take my family home. You don't need to worry about us anymore."
Zhou Jianlai nodded and said, "Okay, the company will send my personal contact information to you later. My phone will always be available. If you encounter any problems, please call me directly."
As of now, Lin Yi still didn't quite understand why the system had rewarded him with a security company?
He needed to find out as soon as possible what the purpose of this security company was, and how these security personnel were able to arrive at his side within a few minutes?
Wasn't this a bit too bizarre?
Lin Yi felt somewhat puzzled by this unexpected scene.
Thus, he decided that his first step was to investigate the background of this Romeo Security Company and the nature of their services.
Consequently, Lin Yi let his family go home first and also instructed the security team captain to withdraw.
Lin Yi couldn't help but wonder, could Romeo Security Company really be this straightforward?
He walked and thought, and casually sat down on a bench by the roadside. Driven by a strong curiosity, he opened a search app.
And just as he finished reading the messages in the pop-up, he was so astonished that he almost jumped out of his seat!
This security company was indeed not simple! The introduction about it also surprised Lin Yi!
It was not just an ordinary security company. Apart from security tasks, Romeo Company also undertakes important missions such as escorting and convoy, with military-style management and not short on high-tech equipment.
Romeo Security Company's operations had already spread across the entire globe, even in some inconspicuous small countries, there were branches of Romeo Security.
Because of such strength, they had their own intelligence network. Any political or military events occurring in any country or region around the world, would be included in their network.
The information in their hands was far more comprehensive, more accurate, and timelier than that of other security companies.
What others could find out, they could find out; what others couldn't find, they could also find.
It was such a security company, with registered capital reaching as high as fifty billion yuan!
Moreover, the headquarter of this security company in Huaxia employed personnel who were all retired from special forces, truly the elite of the elite, and undoubtedly, they were also experienced in live ammunition and battlefield trials!
So it's not an exaggeration to say that no matter how dangerous or difficult the mission, as long as the funds were in place, they would take it on without hesitation!
And, wherever Romeo Company was present globally, any individual or group that wanted to contend with them would surely be intimidated!
Lin Yi also realized an exceptional detail, that Romeo Security Company was strongly supported by the state! Enjoying a number of special privileges, with just these, this security company could already be regarded as an ace in the industry!
Looking at the fifty-two percent ownership in his hands again, it was an invaluable asset! Even if you had the wealth, couldn't buy even one percent of the shares!
So, at this moment, Lin Yi had complete control over a formidable system!
After checking out the key information he had searched, Lin Yi found no words to describe the shock he felt inside!
It had to be said, among the many rewards received from the system, this one must be the most valuable!
If its value cannot even be measured by money!
Lin Yi was also convinced that the information about Romeo Security Company he found online was still very one-sided, and some of the details not suitable for public disclosure would definitely be even more unbelievable!
He had now become the largest shareholder of what could be called the strongest security company! Even though he was wealthy before, his social status had been unchanging, but this new identity had turned everything around overnight.
In the whole of Huaxia, this status was already considered very high! And his social standing would become extraordinary.
Money does not represent power, but power and money can be equated. This special identity was something wealth could not measure!
Although today's Lin Yi possessed the Wenqu Building valued at tens of billions and held shares in many large enterprises, at the end of the day, he had no status whatsoever in Xiangcheng, a nobody.
But he never imagined that a casual stroll with his family could turn into such a fortuitous reward!
It could already be called the most hardcore company in history!
This system was too powerful, wasn't it? If he had known, he would have taken his family out for a walk a few days earlier!
What made Lin Yi most relieved was that now his entire family had received the highest level of protection, beyond the reach of ordinary people.
It was precisely because he had stepped forward to protect them during their babies' crisis that he received such a special reward!
After pondering for a while, he immediately dialed the number of Zhou Jianlai, the captain of that security team he had just met.
"Mr. Lin Yi, do you need assistance with anything?"
Lin Yi got straight to the point, "Your security team can protect my family 24 hours a day, right?"
Zhou Jian responded, "Yes. However, we protect you covertly without affecting your daily life in any way."
Lin Yi replied, "Good, I understand."
Actually, he just wanted to confirm his own guess; at this moment, words could not describe his excitement!
Zhou Jian continued, "Mr. Lin Yi, if you encounter anything difficult to handle, you can contact me directly. Our service range is very broad. For example, whether you want to investigate a person or a company, I can assist you with that."
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was so surprised that he couldn't close his mouth!
However, since he was still on the phone with Zhou Jian, it wasn't proper to show any loss of composure, so he composed himself first before calmly replying, "Um, I got it."

chapters.title: Chapter 113 Great Satisfaction
chapters.content:
He hung up the phone and immediately burst into a happy dance!
After imagining all sorts of things outside for a long time, Lin Yi finally returned home.
Upon seeing their son come back, the family hurriedly approached him, all of them asking with concern.
"Dad, Mom, Vivi, how did it go with calming the babies down? Are they still crying?"
His mother-in-law quickly said, "The other two are okay, but our little Mengmeng was the most frightened. She cries from time to time. Girls are more timid by nature. The babies are all napping now; there shouldn't be any major problems."
Han Xuewei anxiously walked over, grabbed Lin Yi, and sat down together on the living room sofa, where the family started chatting.
Lin Yi's mother, looking a bit worried, asked, "Those bodyguards looked strong and mysterious. Who are they?"
They had been too anxious earlier to check on the children to ask for details about what had happened!
Lin Yi then smiled and said to his family, "A few days ago, I signed a contract with a security company to hire a team to protect our family's safety. I didn't expect them to be so efficient, they came as soon as something happened."
Lin Yi's mother suddenly realized and said, "Ah, I see. I didn't get a chance to ask when you hired bodyguards?"
Lin Yi replied, "Mom, I'm just concerned about our family's safety. Nowadays, society is full of all kinds of people. We have many babies, and it's difficult to take care of them in public. It can be really dangerous if a child gets older and more mischievous and runs off. So hiring a security company is more convenient."
Lin Yi's mother nodded thoughtfully and said, "You're right. It's good that you thought this through. We're getting older, and there are times when we can be a bit careless with the children."
Just then, Lin Yi's phone started buzzing with a barrage of message notifications. He checked it and saw that they were messages from the homeowners' group.
Lin Yi's mother leaned over to take a look, and then said, "What are they discussing in the group? It looks like they're talking about what just happened to us!"
Lin Yi said, "Yes, the gentleman uploaded the video he took, and now many homeowners are watching it."
After hearing this, Lin Yi's mother quickly took out her phone and entered the homeowners' group.
While everyone was still enthusiastically discussing, a person, with the note 'Mr. Xu from Building 32, Unit 502', suddenly sent a message.
"Hey, I'm quite familiar with the captain of the patrol team! One of my relatives is in his brigade! How about I ask about the progress of this incident?"
As soon as he finished speaking, the entire group chat became lively, with everyone showing interest.
"You have a relative who's a patrolman? Then please ask right away. I want to hear about the follow-up too!"
"Right, those two are always so annoying, I never bother with them. They're truly infuriating!"
"It's the first time I've seen someone walking a dog without a leash, and those are large breeds, too! My child gets scared just seeing such a big dog."
"Alaska dogs are usually quite docile, how come those two from their family are so fierce..."
...…
As the conversation went on, it eventually veered off topic.
Lin Yi also found it meaningless and put his phone aside, then headed upstairs towards the nursery.
When he reached the door, he saw Han Xuewei holding their daughter Mengmeng, trying to lull her to sleep with a softly hummed lullaby.
Seeing his wife, Lin Yi's eyes filled with tenderness. Han Xuewei also smiled gently. Lin Yi stepped forward, took Mengmeng into his arms, and whispered, "Honey, you can leave her with me."
Han Xuewei whispered to him, "Mm, I'll go rest then. Mengmeng was pretty scared today; she keeps waking up from her sleep. If she wakes up, just hold her and gently pat her back. She'll calm down quickly."
Lin Yi nodded his head and smiled, "Yeah, ok. Don't worry, I promise the task will be completed."
After Han Xuewei had finished giving these instructions, she finally relaxed and returned to the bedroom.
Lin Yi looked at his little daughter Mengmeng, and couldn't help but feel a pang of heartache, "Mengmeng, be good, we're not afraid, Daddy is here! Mengmeng isn't afraid of anything, right!"
"Daddy will chase away all the bad people and protect you..."
While gently comforting her, Lin Yi slowly placed his daughter into the crib.
Ding!
The system notification suddenly sounded!
"Ding! Congratulations to the host for successfully soothing the baby's mood, reward of 800,000 yuan received!"
At the same time, he received a text message on his phone, and he knew without looking that it was from the bank.
It looked like the money had arrived!
Lin Yi was already accustomed to this, unfazed in the slightest.
In his eyes, everything he did was a given; he had to be a responsible father, and he wouldn't specifically do anything just for the system's rewards.
Lin Yi also never behaved like most fathers these days, who would lie on the couch watching their phones as soon as they returned home every day.
In his opinion, love is always a two-way journey, with both sides needing to contribute, and as a man, loving one's family is essential!
Han's mother whispered, "Lin Yi, we're here to watch the baby, you go ahead with your stuff."
Although parents need to be with their children, they surely have their own matters to attend to; as elders, it's only right to share some of the load.
After agreeing, Lin Yi headed back to the bedroom.
However, he still remembered that he had something to keep him busy tonight.
He had to personally tailor a nutritious meal plan for Han Xuewei and help her recuperate through her diet.
By this time, Han Xuewei had already gone to bed early. Lin Yi tiptoed into the bedroom, took a shower in the bathroom, and then went to the closet to dry his hair with the hairdryer.
When he finally got to the study, it was almost eleven at night.
He casually took out his phone and saw there were many unread WeChat messages, all from the homeowner's group chat.
Lin Yi skimmed through the chat content, seeing that the discussion still centered on that extremely arrogant couple, speculating on their fate.
And after the incident, the group admin immediately kicked those two out of the group.
Everyone was also sharing news about the couple's deal with the authorities, and this news was directly released by the officials.
"Today, in a high-end residential area, Xu Moufang and Shang Mouhui publicly insulted others, with serious implications, not seeking to obstruct law enforcement; they have been dealt with by law enforcement officers according to law and may face detention for up to ten days."
"Due to their walking two large dogs without leashes, and not having processed the relevant documentation for their pets, they are to be treated as strays and taken in, plus a fine of 500 yuan."

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Chapter 114 Official News
chapters.content:
"I hope that the general public will take this as a warning, and I would also like to remind everyone that insulting others in public places is prohibited. We advocate for everyone to be well-mannered, law-abiding, and morally responsible citizens! I also hope that pet owners take their responsibilities seriously and abide by all regulations."
After reading the news, Lin Yi let out a long sigh of relief. It was truly gratifying!
Judging from the photos attached to the news, the couple had a wry smile on their faces—it appeared they had received a proper education!
How could they not be educated when they were obstructing law enforcement with such arrogance?
Lin Yi's mood had improved significantly. He turned off his cell phone screen, laid it on the table, and then booted up his computer. Combining his knowledge of diet therapy, he began to formulate a nutrition menu for his wife!
After about half an hour of focused writing, he finally completed a nutritional menu he was satisfied with!
Almost every ingredient listed was essential, some providing nourishment to ensure her nutrition.
There were also other plans to help Han Xuewei manage her fat intake properly, and later stages included alternative menus. The final menu was aimed at reducing her fat, though the results would be slower to manifest.
These menu plans could be rotated and alternated.
Lin Yi looked at the several menus he had created with great satisfaction, planning to hand them over to Aunt Wang the next day and also explain the corresponding cooking methods.
Even though everything was clearly marked, he wanted it to be perfect.
Lin Yi stretched lazily and then returned to the bedroom. Lying down, he couldn't help but smile again at the sight of Han Xuewei's delicate and charming cheeks beside him.
He wrapped his arms around Han Xuewei and fell into a deep sleep.
Come the next morning, his father-in-law, upon seeing Lin Yi, enthusiastically said, "Lin Yi, now that you've rented the shop, consider the decoration as soon as possible!"
Han Xuewei's father was eager to get the private family restaurant up and running, as it couldn't be delayed any longer. Back in their hometown, trusted individuals were already handling their business, and he was very confident leaving it in their hands.
So now, he could focus all his energies on the development here in Xiangcheng, especially since his beloved daughter was here, and he wanted to center his attention on this place.
If there was an opportunity in the future, he would consider transferring all business from his hometown to here.
Lin Yi naturally understood his father-in-law's urgency, and reassured him, "Leave it to me. My roommate's family does renovations for others—I'll contact him first."
The father-in-law was very satisfied upon hearing this and said, "Mhm, I feel very reassured leaving it in your hands. That will trouble your classmate then. Your mother-in-law will retire and be at home before next month, and I have also made all the preparations on my end, having nothing to do all day."
"So now I just want to run this shop well, as it will eventually be handed over to Vivi."
Originally, he had planned for his daughter Vivi to return to their side after graduation, find a fit boyfriend, and settle down quietly for the rest of their lives.
But plans can't keep up with changes—as his daughter had decided to develop her life here, he was definitely going to support her!
Lin Yi promised with a smile, "Don't worry, my buddy is also very reliable. He'll definitely make it look fabulous for you!"
After saying this, Lin Yi pulled out his phone and dialed his roommate Qiu Zhenhua's number.
Qiu Zhenhua's family ran a decoration company. Although it wasn't very big, they were known for reliable work.
Soon after the call connected, Qiu Zhenhua's voice came through. .net
"Hey, President Lin, what brings you to call me? Aren't you busy with your wife?"
Lin Yi laughed heartily upon hearing this, "Hahaha, of course I should spend time with my wife and child, but that doesn't mean I can't chat with a brother."
Qiu Zhenhua said, "Seriously, you've become quite the rare visitor. You don't even message in our dorm group chat anymore. Now you suddenly call me, should I be on guard?"
Lin Yi coughed awkwardly after hearing this, as he had been busy taking care of his family and hadn't really had time for school matters.
So he hurriedly changed the subject, "You still worry about me? Have you got your diploma yet?"
Qiu Zhenhua replied, "I'll get it as soon as I pass the last exam. Everyone's preparing for the tests lately. When have my grades ever slipped? No problem at all!"
While Qiu Zhenhua was on the phone, there was a book lying on the table titled "English Vocabulary Analytical Memory" that had been bought in his freshman year. It looked brand new, with only a name written on it.
Lin Yi laughed again, "Keep bragging! Weren't you planning on taking over the family business from the start? But speaking of that, I actually need your help with something."
Qiu Zhenhua said, "What family business do I have? It's nothing compared to yours. Just tell me what you need help with. You're not considering taking care of my business, are you?"
Lin Yi said with a smile, "I'm not quite sure how to tell you this, but it's actually about my father-in-law. He's looking to open a private kitchen restaurant here, and we've just found a nice place in Wenqu Building to rent. Now that we need to think about renovation, I remembered your family does exactly this, so I wanted to ask if you'd be interested in this business deal?"
When Qiu Zhenhua heard this, his body that had been lying back like Ge You's instantly sat upright.
"A restaurant renovation, right?"
"Yes, why not? Of course, we will take this deal! I'm making the decision on behalf of my dad right here!"
Lin Yi said with a laugh, "Don't rush to a conclusion. Although it's just a restaurant, the area is not small at all, it's nearly two thousand square meters. Can your family really handle such a big project?"
Qiu Zhenhua was taken aback upon hearing this, quite shocked by the figure!
His family had undertaken restaurant renovation projects before, but the largest had been only three to five hundred square meters. Two thousand square meters? That was the first time he had heard of something so big!
"Damn! Lin Yi! Is your father-in-law that wealthy? Talk about luck, marrying a rich and beautiful girl! Although your own family isn't bad off, if you marry someone like her, you really won't have to worry about anything in the future!"
Envy was evident in Qiu Zhenhua's words!
Lin Yi responded with a light smile, "Easier said than done! Conquering is easy, but maintaining is hard. In this day and age, even running a small restaurant is quite sophisticated, and the most important thing is to consider the business approach. Vivi and I are outsiders, having never dealt with these matters, let alone knowing how to run a business. So, there's still a lot to learn!
It sounds difficult just thinking about it."
Qiu Zhenhua said quite relaxedly, "You're overthinking things, man. You're planning too far ahead. Who knows, maybe the money left by your parents will be enough for your grandchildren!"

chapters.title: Chapter 115: Chapter 115 Discussing Serious Matters
chapters.content:
