Lin Yi laughed after hearing this and then returned to the previous topic, "Alright, let's not talk about this for now. Discuss it with your family! The moment I think of the decoration issues, I'm coming straight to take care of your business!"
Qiu Zhenhua slapped his chest and said, "Don't worry, leave it to me! I'll have a word with my old man and we'll figure this out."
This matter indeed needed careful consideration because if their family had already accepted other jobs, they probably wouldn't have enough manpower to renovate this more than 2000 square meter restaurant!
Lin Yi said, "Hmm, I'll wait for your news."
After the call, Lin Yi put away his phone and turned to his father-in-law, "Let's wait for his reply!"
Han Xuewei's father nodded, "Hmm, let's go have breakfast."
Just a few minutes later, Qiu Zhenhua made a direct call.
Qiu Zhenhua was very excited on the other end of the phone and blurted out, "Lin Yi! My dad said we don't have other jobs right now, and we have enough people, so we can take on this project! Find a time to have a meal, shall we? We can talk about this matter in detail then."
Lin Yi said, "There's no need for that, I'll head over to your dad's company directly, so we can discuss it in person."
Han Xuewei's father also added, "Yes, we will go to the company and discuss it in detail."
So, they set the meeting for eleven o'clock and went straight to Qiu Zhenhua's family's decorating company.
Lin Yi took out the nutritional meal menus he had written last night, handed them to Aunt Wang, and even went into the kitchen to cook one for Han Xuewei according to the menu.
Although it was already past nine o'clock, it was still a good time for breakfast. He took the nutritional meal he made and brought it directly to the bedroom, where he found Han Xuewei washing up.
He considerately placed the nutritional meal on the table and said, "Starting today, every meal of yours will come from the nutritional meal menu I've designed for you. It's tailor-made, even the portions are specified. Eat with confidence! It will meet your figure requirements without causing weight gain, no high calories!"
The moment he placed the lovingly prepared breakfast on the table, the system's notification rang in his mind!
"Ding! Congratulations to the host for daily caring for your wife, earning a system reward of five hundred thousand!"
Lin Yi was already accustomed to such rewards, so he didn't even bother to check the deposit message.
At that time, Han Xuewei's face was also brimming with happiness as she smiled and said, "Thanks to my husband."
Lin Yi patted her head and said, "Eat it while it's warm. I'm going to drive and take dad to my classmate's company to discuss the renovation in a bit."
"Mmm, then you guys go ahead. I'll start eating right away," urged Han Xuewei.
Only after Lin Yi had left did Han Xuewei look at the lavish breakfast on the table and felt a warm glow in her heart.
Although Lin Yi had made her loving breakfasts many times before, she hadn't expected him to pull out a meticulously customized menu today.
She felt incredibly delighted.
Lin Yi drove, taking his father-in-law with him, to Qiu Zhenhua's company—Liangce Decorating Company.
Qiu Zhenhua had been waiting at the store entrance for Lin Yi. When he saw a brand-new Range Rover Sport coming, he was taken aback!
He examined the person getting out of the driver's seat with some disbelief and almost dropped his jaw when he confirmed it was Lin Yi!
Qiu Zhenhua hurried over to Lin Yi and then circled the Range Rover a few times, eyes full of envy, "Lin Yi, Lin Yi, look at you, living on the conditions now!"
Which man wouldn't be moved by a Range Rover Sport? Right then, his feelings were nothing but envy.
Lin Yi smiled and introduced, "Let me introduce, this is Vivi's dad, also my father-in-law."
Then he continued to his father-in-law, "This is my college roommate and good friend, Qiu Zhenhua."
Qiu Zhenhua quickly straightened his clothes and formally said, "Hello, Uncle!"
Han Xuewei's father responded with a smile, "Hello, hello."
Leading the way, Qiu Zhenhua explained, "Let's go upstairs for some tea first. A new worker came in today who isn't familiar with the work environment, so my dad took him to check it out. He should be back soon. Sorry to keep you waiting at home."
Knowing that today's visitors were important guests, Qiu Zhenhua did not dare to neglect and after he had seated them upstairs, prepared a pot of tea, pouring a cup for each.
With his dad not yet back, Qiu Zhenhua didn't feel it was right to talk shop, so he began chatting with them about everyday matters, passing a few minutes until Qiu Ce, his father, appeared.
As soon as he entered, he was very polite, apologizing, "I am so sorry! You shouldn't have to wait this long, there was a new worker today, and I was showing him around the site, which took some time."
Han Xuewei's father also quickly said, "No worries, no worries, your son took great care of us. Let's sit down and discuss the specifics."
Qiu Zhenhua then poured tea for his father as well.
Qiu Ce took a sip of tea to moisten his throat and then introduced himself, "I'm Qiu Zhenhua's father, Qiu Ce. We've been running this decorating company for some years now and our business capacity is quite good. Zhenhua briefed me this morning, and I'm very glad to meet you all."
Lin Yi responded very politely, "It's a pleasure to meet you."
Han Xuewei's father also greeted, "Hello." .net
After the brief introductions, they began to get down to business.
Qiu Ce earnestly said, "Lin Yi, I heard as soon as you thought about the renovation, our company was the first one that came to your mind. I really must thank you, I'm very grateful for your trust!"
Lin Yi said, "Actually, it's only natural. For such matters, it's better to go to someone you're familiar with. My father-in-law has secured quite a large shop space and wants to renovate it to open a restaurant. I really want to help him, but I don't know how, as I'm an outsider and not familiar with this stuff."
Han Xuewei's father took out a document folder from a handbag and handed it over, saying, "This contains some data and some photos, all related to the decoration style of my restaurant back home. In fact, I want to retain most of the styles. For the details, there's comprehensive information inside.
However, we haven't surveyed the new rental space, so some of the data will need to be measured on-site by yourselves. Since Lin Yi has chosen you, I trust him too. I'll leave this renovation work in your hands then, with a two-month deadline. Can you handle it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 116 Start Decorating
chapters.content:
Qiu Zhenhua cast an expectant glance at Dad.
Qiu Ce also quickly responded, "Timing is completely negotiable, no problem at all. I haven't taken any other jobs recently, so if we sign the contract, my entire team will be dedicated to this renovation project. Thus, two months is absolutely doable!"
"Uncle, I was wondering about the cost..." Lin Yi tentatively asked.
Qiu Ce: "Since the materials needed are quite a lot, we always collect a certain percentage of the deposit for renovation jobs and the remaining amount is paid by the client upon completion."
Lin Yi then asked, "How much would the deposit roughly be?"
Qiu Ce did a quick calculation, then said, "Given the rather large size of your shop, a conservative estimate would put the deposit around seven to eight hundred thousand."
Lin Yi nodded and said, "Well, then I'll just pay a deposit of nine hundred thousand upfront, and the balance after the work is completed."
Qiu Ce eagerly agreed, "That's fine. If we sign the contract today, we can visit the site this afternoon or tomorrow."
Han Xuewei's dad nodded and said, "Alright, let's sign it now." .net
And just like that, both parties reached a consensus and quickly signed the contract.
Lin Yi paid the nine hundred thousand as the deposit straightaway. Han Xuewei's dad had originally planned to pay the deposit himself, but in the end, he couldn't persuade Lin Yi.
Dad Han said to Qiu Ce, "Would it be alright for me to observe the construction when it begins? Don't worry, I promise not to interfere with your work."
Qiu Ce quickly said, "Of course, of course. You are welcome to visit anytime, we accept our customers' supervision!"
Han Xuewei's father said, "I wouldn't call it supervision. I might just have some design ideas of my own to propose."
After chatting for a while longer, Qiu Ce and his son saw Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's dad out.
With these matters settled, what followed was the refinement and implementation of the plan.
Lin Yi also knew that actually, decorating wasn't the challenging part. It was the series of tasks that followed which would be demanding.
Like organizing a grand opening ceremony, doing good preliminary promotional work, and operation preparations, even recruiting waitstaff for the various positions. Indeed, running a successful restaurant now was definitely not simple.
Only with investment comes gain, and spending energy to learn relevant knowledge is how one can operate better.
Lin Yi couldn't bear to leave all these tasks to his father-in-law, so he still had to do most of the heavy lifting himself.
At first, Lin Yi had even thought about finding a suitable job for himself, possibly getting some awards from the system.
But later on, he realized his idea wasn't feasible because he found he needed to spend more time with his family. Not worrying about wealth and being able to accompany his family often was a wonderful feeling!
So no matter what, she was determined to get the restaurant up and running; it would have a considerable potential for future development!
So, in the upcoming period, he would need to prepare for the tasks at hand and face the challenges!
He planned to find time to talk more with his father-in-law, learning about restaurant management and operational tricks. By contributing more, Han Xuemei and his father-in-law would have less hardship.
After finishing up, Lin Yi and his father-in-law headed back.
As soon as they got home, they saw Aunt Wang busily preparing lunch.
Dad Han hurried back to his room to change his clothes after washing his hands, ready to check on the three babies.
Lin Yi's mom and Han's mother were playing with the kids in the nursery at this moment.
Han Xuewei was in charge of assisting Aunt Wang in the kitchen and was also making a special love-filled lunch just for Lin Yi!
Seeing Han Xuewei bustling about, Lin Yi couldn't help but show a mischievous smile!
He sneaked up behind Han Xuewei and carefully whispered in her ear.
At that moment, Han Xuewei also sensed something unusual, and she quickly turned around, only to accidentally plant a kiss on Lin Yi's face!
Lin Yi, with his cheeky manner, feigned surprise, "Oh! If you want to kiss me, just do it directly!"
Then he planted a big kiss on Han Xuewei's cheek!
The latter's face turned slightly red as she said in a soft voice, "Why are you sneaking around when you come back? I didn't even hear you."
Lin Yi laughed quietly, "Seeing you so focused, I just couldn't bear to disturb you!"
Han Xuewei gave him a light push with her elbow, "Hmph, all you know is how to be sly. I think you did it on purpose."
Lin Yi chuckled, "You are my treasure, my lawful wife, it's not too much for me to be a little sly with you, right?"
Seeing Han Xuewei still busy, Lin Yi asked curiously, "By the way, wife, what delicious food did you make today? It smells so good, I didn't get full from breakfast and I'm so hungry now!"
Han Xuemei smiled and said, "I've learned a new dish recently, double-cooked pork. I made it especially for you to try."
Lin Yi gave a thumbs-up and praised, "It already smells so good! The taste must be amazing!"
Han Xuewei proudly said, "Do I even need to say it? Your wife's cooking skills are definitely top-notch."
Lin Yi said with a smile, "In that case, my wife is indeed very virtuous."
With that, he took the opportunity to leave another kiss on Han Xuewei's face.
Han Xuewei murmured shyly, "Hey, Aunt Wang is still right there..."
"Right, how did the business discussion go today? Did you finalize everything?"
Lin Yi patted his chest and said, "You can rest assured when your husband handles things! Everything is arranged perfectly!"
At that moment, Han Xuewei became quite serious, "Honey, if this restaurant really does take off, and I end up having to take over sooner or later, will you help me out when that time comes?"
Lin Yi also became very earnest, "Wife, we're family, no need for formalities. I feel these are things I should do. In short, I won't let you worry or work too hard! Even if you don't like running the restaurant in the future, I can help you with it! So, rest assured, a thousand times over!"
Only after receiving such a response from Lin Yi did Han Xuewei's hanging heart settle down.
"Love you, honey, thank you for being so good to me. As an only child, I have to take on more responsibility. I feel my parents have great expectations for me, so sometimes I worry about letting them down and disappointing them. Fortunately, you're here to encourage me, always helping and sharing the burden. So I'm really happy, and I don't need to worry! Honey, you are so good to me!"
"Silly girl, why are you thanking me again?" he said, then hugged her from behind.

chapters.title: Chapter 117: Chapter 117 The Lacking Space for Two
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei struggled shyly to get free, saying, "Oh no, Aunt Wang is still here, it's not good for others to see."
But Lin Yi showed no sign of letting go, "Oh, Aunt Wang just went to the storeroom, and everyone else is in the baby room watching the baby."
Han Xuewei quickly tried to break free again, "That's still not okay, Aunt Wang will be back soon, we need to be careful!"
After hearing this, Lin Yi said with a sense of grievance, "Sigh, I originally thought it was convenient for the whole family to live together, but I didn't expect there to be disadvantages, now we completely lack a world of our own."
Han Xuewei glared at Lin Yi and scooped all the vegetables from the pot into a plate, "There's nothing we can do about it, come on, hurry up and call everyone to have lunch together."
At this moment, Han Xuewei also felt the same dilemma in her heart; she felt that she and Lin Yi started too abruptly without a dating process, and went straight into married life. She actually wished she could have more private space with Lin Yi to make their relationship sweeter.
But having skipped the honeymoon phase, the adjustment period, among others, the two of them always felt something was missing, and even then, they wouldn't have much intimate interaction, if any, it would be in the bedroom.
So, thinking about it this way, they both really had a bellyful of complaints with no one to tell!
But now that they already had a baby, some matters had to be pursued half-heartedly.
As evening approached, Lin Yi's mother gathered everyone and held a small family meeting.
"I have called everyone here to inform you that I've had the master calculate a good date, and Lin Yi and Vivi's wedding will be held on the 23rd of August. There is a little over a month left, so we have plenty of time to prepare. Is there anything else that needs to be added?"
Everyone looked at each other, it seemed there was nothing to add, and they all quite agreed with the date.
Moreover, once the two of them had their wedding ceremony, they should be ready to go back to school to continue their studies. Thankfully, the curriculum in their senior year was more relaxed, so other than handling exams, they had nothing else to worry about.
"Then we need to set a time to go visit Vivi's grandmother, after all, we have to take the babies there to recognize her," Lin Yi's father pondered for a moment before stating.
Lin Yi's mother looked at the calendar, made some calculations, and then said, "How about this, we go ten days early for a visit, by that time the babies will also have grown quite a bit, making going out more convenient."
Lin Yi also expressed his agreement, "Yeah, I think that works. Going ten days early won't interfere with other matters."
Lin Yi's mother said to everybody quite earnestly, "At that time, we can follow the process of a formal engagement visit, and I have already bought all the necessary items, all according to the highest standards. We can also bring relatives with us, what does everyone think about that?"
At this moment, Han Xuewei's father suddenly spoke up, "I have no objections to the other arrangements, just a little suggestion about the date. The mother-in-law mentioned going ten days early, why not make it eight days? Because that day happens to be my mother's birthday; it would be like a double celebration, and we could also celebrate her longevity. How does that sound to everyone?"
After hearing this, Lin Yi's mother was very surprised, "Gosh, I didn't expect two happy events to coincide! Then let's set the date together! We'll follow the standards of an engagement banquet, and when it's time for the wedding banquet, our Lin Family will host it."
"Of course, the livelier the better, both sides can invite more relatives, don't worry about seating, in any case, we must have a grand celebration for the children!"
"Exactly, I also hope for a grand celebration," Han Xuewei's mother said excitedly. "The bride's side will surely have no shortage of relatives, we'll welcome as many as come! And it's also a great opportunity to celebrate the triplets!"
Everyone expressed strong agreement with these ideas.
Although the two of them were already married, and their child had already had its full-month celebration, they couldn't skip any of the traditional procedures.
For them, a wedding ceremony was indispensable. Only by holding it on a grand scale could they highlight the importance they placed on Vivi.
After all, Weiwei was their precious daughter-in-law! So, this wedding had to be meticulously planned no matter what!
The grander, the better!
They couldn't wait to tell all the relatives in the Lin Family that Vivi was a good daughter-in-law and also the treasure of the Lin Family!
In recent days, Lin Yi's parents had been busy with these matters, communicating with relatives from both sides to get a rough estimate of how many could come to meet Vivi's grandmother.
Once the number of attendees was confirmed, the initial plan was to take the high-speed train there, but they were worried that the baby might feel uncomfortable on the way and it might be difficult to manage if he started crying. After discussing it together, since they had plenty of cars now, they decided to all drive there!
Driving from Xiangcheng to Xiaochuan County wouldn't take too long. Since there was a baby on board, they couldn't drive too fast. If there was no traffic jam, they could completely reach their destination in three hours.
Plus, they planned to go there by RV, saving quite a bit of unnecessary trouble on the road.
The family had a brief discussion and planned out everything smoothly.
In these days, Han Xuewei's father had idle time on his hands and would often check on the store to see the progress of the renovations.
Her mother had returned to Xiaochuan County in the past few days, for the purpose of discussing the big event with relatives and friends.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi's parents had also called all the relatives over to discuss Lin Yi's major life event over dinner.
Of course, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei, along with their three babies, also attended the meal.
In fact, Lin Yi was not clear about the customs and rules regarding weddings, so it was the elders who made suggestions for them.
After this meal, Lin Yi's uncle, Lin Xibei, made a complete 180-degree turn in his attitude towards his son when he got back home, almost wanting to kick his cousin Lin Jie out of the house that very night.
He said with dissatisfaction, "Pack your things and move out tomorrow!"
Lin Jie replied in complete astonishment, "What? Dad! What are you doing? Why are you kicking me out all of a sudden? I don't think I've done anything bad recently, have I?"
Lin Xibei stated directly, "Remember this, boy! Starting tomorrow, I'm increasing your monthly living allowance by half, for you to rent a place. But you must bring a daughter-in-law to meet me as soon as possible! Your old man also wants to hold his grandchild soon!"
Lin Jie started to laugh secretly upon hearing this. Free money was not to be declined! This way, he would have at least seventeen or eighteen thousand a month. As for a daughter-in-law... heh, that could be put aside for now!
After all, he still wanted to make the most of his prime years and have some fun!
Lin Jie couldn't help but laugh, "Dad, I don't think I've ever seen you be this generous before! You're that eager for a daughter-in-law? But these things can't be rushed; it's not that easy, you know?"

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Chapter 118 Unlucky Cousin
chapters.content:
Lin Xibei was instantly infuriated after hearing this, "Do you still have the nerve to say that? Why don't you compare yourself to your cousin Lin Yi? He not only has a wife now but has also fathered three kids! He hasn't even finished university, and he's already settled most of life's major events—I'm so jealous! I'm not even asking for three grandchildren, I'm not that demanding, just one will do!
Just one!"
Lin Jie answered reluctantly, "That's not the point, Dad. Is this something that can be solved by being anxious? Girlfriends aren't something you can find just because you want one!"
Seeing his son argue back, Lin Xibei became even more irritated, "You rascal, I can't be bothered with all that. Whatever it takes, you have to bring someone back. If all else fails, go on a blind date! You ought to have a child no matter what! As long as you do the job, I don't mind raising the child!"
Lin Jie shrugged and said, "Dad, dating takes time, too! Even if I want to have kids, the woman has to be willing, right? The cost of dating is high nowadays, just going out for a date costs a lot! Let me do the math for you; don't you have to hand out a red envelope during the holidays? For birthdays, at least a handbag as a gift, right?
Occasionally giving a ring or something is pretty standard, not to mention the money spent on dates, it's already tens of thousands gone."
"So when you calculate it, out of the seventeen or eighteen thousand yuan I get for living expenses each month, I use a part to pay rent, then for meals and necessities, there's not much left! It's also not quite enough for buying little things for someone, and although you might raise the child, I still have to support my wife! Surprises certainly can't be left out, Dad.
Times have changed; today's girls are different from those of your time, what they value most is romance. At the minimum, a trip every year, and who knows, maybe even going abroad in the future!"
After listening, Lin Xibei clenched his teeth and steeled his heart, finally saying, "Fine! I'll give you fifty thousand yuan a month for living expenses! But you only have six months. If you don't manage to find a girlfriend within half a year, don't blame me for being unfriendly!"
Lin Jie was astonished by his dad's generosity!
Alright, he had never been this generous before! Fifty thousand yuan a month for living expenses!
What did that mean?
Any video game console he liked, he could buy on a whim, every kind of AAA title he could purchase without a second thought! Just the thought of it was exciting!
All thanks to my dear cousin!
As for a girlfriend or something, worst case scenario, after half a year, I can just find any girl, trick my dad, maybe I can even prolong these good days for a few more months. In the end, I can just say we broke up!
In just a moment, Lin Jie had completely figured out his dad!
Lin Yi's father and the second uncle both started from scratch, and although Lin Xibei's business wasn't as big as his brother's, it was worth tens of millions at the least.
And since he had only this one precious son, he could afford the fifty thousand a month for living expenses.
Knowing his dad's thoughts, Lin Jie started to scheme, thinking about ways to coax some money out of his father to refresh his life.
Han Xuewei hadn't received any messages from Qin Xiaoxu recently and couldn't help feeling worried. After all, she had been too busy these days, having no time to chat with her bestie.
Thinking of this, she took out her phone and asked, "Xiaoxu, what have you been busy with these days? It's been so long since we chatted."
Qin Xiaoxu replied instantly, "Vivi, my dear sister! I've been occupied with making a living! I don't have the good fortune of being accompanied by a husband every day and not worrying about life. Entering society is really difficult! Without working hard, one could starve to death!"
Seeing the complaint-filled message from her friend, Han Xue almost burst out laughing, "Why didn't you stay at home and help out? I remember your family runs a business."
Qin Xiaoxu quickly replied, "I wanted to go back too, but my dad wouldn't let me! He insists that I gain some social experience for a few years, and I also don't want to rely on my family. I hope to have my own career! But reality is too harsh, it's so difficult to work out here!"
Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei were from the same department, majoring in art. However, Qin Xiaoxu also minored in graphic design during her free time, so her current job was related to design.
Qin Xiaoxu continued to complain, "You don't know how psychotic our company's manager is; we aren't even allowed to look at our phones during work hours. We have to put everyone's phones at the front desk when clocking in, and we can't get them back until we clock out. I can't even reply to other people's messages, let alone watch a video when going to the toilet!"
"I'm really frustrated right now; I don't want to stay even for a day! But when I think about saving more than ten thousand yuan a month, I tell myself I have to endure!"
"My workplace is near Qianda, and I've rented a place nearby, too. The rent in this area is so expensive, a tiny apartment of less than 50 square meters costs four thousand five hundred yuan a month!"
Han Xuewei quietly watched her best friend continue to grumble. When she saw the word "Qianda," her eyes lit up, and she followed up with, "Wait, did you say you work at Qianda?"
Qin Xiaoxu responded, "Yes, at Qianda, why?"
Han Xuewei then remembered that she hadn't been to the beauty salon for postnatal care for several days and thought it would be a good time to visit her friend and also get some beauty treatments.
"Are you off work now? Do you have time? I'll take you to get a beauty treatment."
The moment she hit send, she received Qin Xiaoxu's enthusiastic reply: "Yes, yes, yes! I'm free now!"
"Once I start work, I have no time. I've been feeling so tired these few days. I only get four days off a month, sometimes I even have to work overtime!"
"I've been close to collapsing these past days, I just sleep once I get home! I don't do anything else, I don't even have the energy to binge-watch, my skin is getting worse! Every day, I'm so tired!"
"Can that skincare place do massages? I just want a massage right now, and it would be great if they could also realign some bones!"
Han Xuewei smiled and quickly replied, "They have everything there, any treatment you want!"
Qin Xiaoxu: "Great, then I will wait for you at Qianda, let me know when you arrive!"
Han Xuewei: "Alright, I will get there within an hour, let's meet at half past one."
Qin Xiaoxu: "Babe! How about we have dinner out today? It's not easy to have a day off, let's enjoy a big meal!"
Han Xuewei actually planned to have lunch after meeting with her friend, especially since Lin Yi had ordered nutritious meals for her.

chapters.title: Chapter 119 The Gathering Between Besties
chapters.content:
She hesitated for a moment, then said, "I need to ask Lin Yi first."
Qin Xiaoxu: "??? Han Xuewei! How could you do this? Don't you realize you've changed!! It's just a meal between besties, why do you need to ask your husband for his opinion?"
Han Xuewei hurriedly explained, "No, no, no, Lin Yi has tailored a nutritional menu specifically for me. I have to follow the menu for my meals every day because he says it's to replenish nutrients, so I just want to run it by him first."
Qin Xiaoxu sent over a huge eye-roll emoji!
But she had to admit, she was really envious of Han Xuewei now! .net
Not only did she have a happy and fulfilling family, but every day her husband was doting, and her in-laws were loving. Both her own parents and her in-laws were very wealthy! It seemed like she lacked nothing in life!
Qin Xiaoxu's family was also quite well-off, but she still needed to face some serious challenges right now!
Thinking of this, Qin Xiaoxu was full of worries. When would such a life come to an end!
She was now really missing her college days when life was truly carefree!
There was absolutely no need to fret over living expenses!
Once she graduated, she began living the working-life, driven every day by circumstances beyond her control!
Then, she calmed her depressed mood and quickly got out of bed to dress up, planning to go shopping with her bestie!
At this time, Han Xuewei tiptoed into the baby room, and seeing Lin Yi playing with the babies, whispered in his ear, "Honey, come out for a moment."
Lin Yi was pulled by Han Xuewei into the bedroom after asking Aunt Wang and the Maternity Matron to help watch over the babies for a bit.
Han Xuewei pulled Lin Yi into the bedroom, then said to him, "Honey, Xiaoxu just asked me out to eat. May I have lunch with her outside today?"
Lin Yi, seeing Han Xuewei so coy for the first time, decided to tease her a bit.
"Sure, but first you have to give me a kiss, and then I'll agree," Lin Yi said with a smile.
Han Xuewei did not hesitate at all, directly tiptoed up and planted a kiss on Lin Yi's mouth.
But Lin Yi seemed to lock the door, then scooped her up in a princess carry and headed toward the bed.
…
About half an hour later, Lin Yi stretched lazily, very satisfied, then said with a mischievous grin, "By the way, baby. The food outside is much greasier than at home, and the quality of that oil isn't too good, so you'll need to ensure a certain amount of exercise after eating."
"Remember to come back early tonight, we need to get some exercise!"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei immediately objected, "No way! I don't want to! You're really too lecherous!"
But Lin Yi craftily replied, "So what if I'm lecherous? It's all aimed at my wife, not bothering anyone else. Right?"
Han Xuewei found it difficult to argue back, so she headed straight for the walk-in closet to change her clothes, not planning to continue the argument with him.
Lin Yi, with a rather unserious laugh, said, "Baby, I might as well drive you there! After all, I have nothing to do right now."
From inside the walk-in closet, Han Xuewei shouted, "It's fine, I can go alone. After lunch with Qin Xiaoxu, we're going to Qianda's beauty salon. It's really not convenient for you to hang around while we chat about work, right?"
Lin Yi could only respond with a smile, "Then have a good time, and if you need me, just call. I promise I'll be there as soon as possible!"
"Mhm, I know!"
After finally changing her clothes, Han Xuewei hurriedly made a phone call to her best friend, "I'm heading out and will be there soon. Wait for me at the east gate, okay?"
Qin Xiaoxu replied, "Got it, I've already packed up and am about to leave as well. Did you just leave now? Did Lin Yi deliberately make it difficult for you to leave?"
In her heart, Han Xuewei thought, "Humph, I barely managed to escape his clutches!"
The two best friends who cherished each other finally met up, and Qin Xiaoxu went straight to the hot pot restaurant with Han Xuewei.
Once they were seated, Han Xuewei whispered, "Xiaoxu, I'm still breastfeeding, so I can't have anything spicy."
Qin Xiaoxu, flipping through the menu, consoled her, "Don't worry, we'll just order a 'yuan yang' hot pot—I'll have extra spicy! And we'll get you the classic mild broth."
After about fifteen minutes or so, all the dishes they ordered were served by the waitstaff!
The servings here were small and the prices were reasonable. The table was filled with plates and there wasn't even any space left on the small trolley.
Han Xuewei looked incredulously at the table full of dishes, then at her best friend, "Babe, I agreed to treat today, but isn't this a little too much? Besides, the two of us couldn't possibly finish all this..."
She looked helplessly at her best friend.
With a woeful expression, Qin Xiaoxu said, "Ah, I don't know what's gotten into me—I want to eat everything I see. And ever since I started working, I've been living paycheck to paycheck! I have to consider everything carefully before buying. Even though my salary seems high now, a huge chunk goes to rent, not to mention beauty salon expenses. Aaaah! I really miss our school days!
Vivi, I'm so envious of you!"
Watching her best friend continue to complain, Han Xuewei smiled and said, "What's there to envy about me? Sigh, I have my own worries too; it's not like I'm living a carefree life. And all my worries are about the baby."
Qin Xiaoxu didn't understand her point of view because, to her, any problem in the world could be solved with money.
Being rich really does bring happiness!
Plus, as Han Xuewei mentioned, besides Aunt Wang, there were two other nannies to help out at home. So considering that, she shouldn't have any worries—what trouble could she possibly have?
All Han Xuewei did was let out a sigh, "Perhaps it's because it's my first time being a mother. I just don't know how to take care of the baby properly."
Seeing her best friend's spirit seemingly down, Qin Xiaoxu asked in surprise, "Babe, you don't have postpartum depression, do you??! You absolutely can't have that! Your family is so perfect, your husband is so good to you, your in-laws dote on you, and your three babies are so adorable. You are truly blessed; please don't let anything worry you!
The babies will grow up eventually; everything will get better and better, and you don't know how much people envy you!"
Han Xuewei pursed her lips, puzzled, "You haven't had a baby, so you definitely can't understand this feeling. I've checked it out online too, and my current state of mind does seem to align with postpartum depression. But it's mild for now, and I can feel myself getting overly worried about the children. I've even been losing hair lately!"
Qin Xiaoxu, still unable to bear seeing her best friend like this, quickly took out her phone and started searching for information.

chapters.title: Chapter 120: Chapter 120 Vivi is Sick?
chapters.content:
"Vivi, I took a quick look, and it seems that the main cause of postpartum depression is the decrease in hormones after giving birth. How about this? You should try and take some more time to go out and about, right, have you been breastfeeding the baby lately?"
Qin Xiaoxu saw Han Xuewei nodding her head, then asked, "Is it possible to take a break? Maybe you should stop breastfeeding."
After hearing this, Han Xuewei shook her head like a rattle drum, "That won't do, I can't stop no matter what, only this way can I recognize my identity as a mother."
Seeing Han Xuewei so insistent, Qin Xiaoxu had no choice but to say, "Alright then, breastfeeding is really good for the child, so just continue."
Qin Xiaoxu also knew that her suggestion was somewhat problematic, she was thinking too one-sidedly!
After all, Han Xuewei hadn't been a mother for very long, and she was extremely attentive to the babies. If she were to stop breastfeeding, it would only make her more anxious.
Moreover, Qin Xiaoxu didn't understand what kind of troubles her best friend Han Xuewei was currently facing. Right now, she was completely worry-free, lacking nothing in material and spiritual terms, even much better off than others. So why would she suffer from postpartum depression?
If Han Xuewei didn't have such favorable conditions now, or if she hadn't met good in-laws, or even if Lin Yi had many flaws and treated her poorly, her postpartum depression could have been much worse!
The more Qin Xiaoxu thought about it, the more terrified she felt, and she started to worry about Han Xuewei.
But now there was so little she could do; it seemed that apart from offering comfort, she didn't know what else to say.
She grabbed Han Xuewei's hand and said earnestly, "Vivi, you must take good care of yourself no matter what, don't overthink things, do what you love every day. If you feel even a bit unhappy, you can totally tell Lin Yi, or you can come and talk to me! In any case, you can't keep things bottled up inside, understand?"
Han Xuewei nodded seriously and then began to chat with her best friend about something that had happened a few days ago.
"Xiaoxu, a few days ago our family was pushing the baby stroller around the neighborhood, and then two large dogs burst out and rushed toward the stroller, scaring the babies into crying. That really frightened me, and the babies' situation didn't look too optimistic, especially little Mengmeng. Even after we got home, she needed to be held by an adult to fall asleep, or she would just keep crying.
Those days, I also suffered a bit of insomnia. Everyone else tells me that the babies are fine and they'll get over it in a few days, but I'm still very worried..."
As she spoke, Han Xuewei's eyes filled with tears, as if she was about to start crying at any second.
Qin Xiaoxu quickly handed over a tissue, patted her on the back, and comforted, "It's okay, don't keep it inside, let it all out if you want to cry! If you feel it's not right to talk about it in a public place, we can go to a private room."
Han Xuewei nodded with red eyes.
And just like that, Qin Xiaoxu immediately called the service staff to switch them to a private room.
Han Xuewei also poured out her troubles to her best friend, and the two of them chatted and dined there for a solid two hours.
.net
After finishing these conversations, Han Xuewei finally took a long breath, "Xiaoxu, after talking to you, I feel much relieved. It seems I need to invite you out more often."
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu burst into laughter, "That's right, so I'll keep waiting for your treat to a big meal then!"
After finishing their meal, they then went to the beauty salon in Qianda Shopping Mall.
"Vivi, I really am too exhausted, it's been such a long time since I've been to a beauty salon! Look at my skin, it's so much worse than when we were at school!"
After they arrived at the beauty salon, Qin Xiaoxu lay down to be massaged and was clearly enjoying herself as she spoke to Han Xuewei.
However, Han Xuewei said with a smile, "That's no problem, we can just come here more often. We'll make up for the times we've missed."
But the other shook her head and replied, "No, no, I'm just too busy with work. Let me at least get past my probation period! Just half a month more to go! But... even though I might have the time then, I still won't be able to afford the expenses here..."
Back when I was still at school, my mom gave me a monthly allowance that wasn't small, almost the same as my monthly salary!
But now rent takes up a lot, and every meal is much more expensive than at school. Sigh, it's really tough! I don't dare to spend money recklessly now that I've earned it!
I'll try saving up first! I'll do my best to set aside some, probably can't afford to come here more than twice a month!
After all, the treatments at this beauty salon aren't cheap. The average expenditure is over fifteen hundred.
At this moment, Han Xuewei suddenly turned to ask the beautician beside her, "Can I share my card with someone else? I mean, can my bestie use my card directly the next time she comes, is that okay?"
The beautician replied very politely, "Mrs. Lin, you can use the card with your bestie. Likewise, we support the issuance of supplementary cards here, also known as sisterhood cards. You can set a spending limit for the supplementary card."
Han Xuewei hurriedly said to the beautician, "Then please issue one for me! Oh, and with no spending limit. Give the supplementary card to my bestie here."
The beautician responded, "Okay, the two of you can take care of that at the front desk after finishing your treatments. It's quick to process, and you can get the card today after filling out the relevant information."
Han Xuewei nodded, "Alright, I got it."
Lying beside her, Qin Xiaoxu exclaimed excitedly, "Wow! Vivi, you really are my best bestie, you're so good to me!"
Seeing her bestie's excited reaction, Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh too, "Now the two of us can go to beauty treatments together! Make sure you come when you have time!"
Qin Xiaoxu clapped her hands excitedly, "Mm, we'll hang out more often! This is so awesome!"
Seeing her bestie this happy made her very joyful too. In that moment, it felt like her mood lifted as well.
Han Xuewei originally planned to drive her bestie home, but Qin Xiaoxu said she didn't live very far away and didn't need a ride, so Han Xuewei went home alone.
After she got into the car, Qin Xiaoxu sent a message to Lin Yi, "Lin Yi, I think Vivi is showing signs of postpartum depression. You really have to pay more attention to her and keep an eye on her recent state."
Lin Yi was busy at home when he received the message and was startled!
He replied anxiously, "How could that happen? What did she say today? Why would she suddenly have postpartum depression?"
Qin Xiaoxu replied, "Vivi said she's been very worried about the child recently, so you need to help her adjust her mindset."

chapters.title: Chapter 121 An Anxious Vivi
chapters.content:
Lin Yi looked at the message sent by Qin Xiaoxu and couldn't help but become lost in thought.
Ever since he and Vivi got together, not only Lin Yi as a husband but also other family members had always taken great care of Vivi and even spoiled her.
Lin Yi thought that going on like this wouldn't pose any issues, but what he never expected was that despite all his calculations, he could have overlooked this point!
After all, Han Xuewei was a mother for the first time! So, he could understand many of her feelings.
Lin Yi hurriedly turned on his computer and began to search online for relevant information.
He himself had also learned some knowledge about postpartum care for mothers in advance, which now came in handy.
Lin Yi also began to carefully analyze the main reasons that led to Han Xuewei's condition.
After careful consideration, he found that the most likely reason was the last time they took the baby out and those two large dogs frightened her. Since that day, Han Xuewei had been very worried about the baby.
Besides that, Lin Yi temporarily couldn't find any other clues.
It seems that his concern for his wife was still not enough!
Regardless, Lin Yi resolved to give Han Xuewei even more care.
Turning to Qin Xiaoxu, after saying goodbye to Han Xuewei, she went straight back to her apartment.
Although she could only rest for four days a month, she preferred to stay in her apartment during her days off, watching dramas and cooking delicious food.
She boredly flipped through her phone and then saw a pinned message on the school's almighty wall, "I need a sister to pretend to be my girlfriend! Not for anything else, just to deal with my family. I will not cross any boundaries, and a generous reward will be offered!"
She would usually see posts of high-looks classmates showing off on the almighty wall, who also wanted to be in relationships. But this was the first time she had seen someone looking for a person to pretend to be a girlfriend.
Qin Xiaoxu became interested immediately, so she clicked on the message.
Upon closer inspection, oh!
She didn't expect him to be quite handsome!
So without much thought, Qin Xiaoxu took the initiative and sent a friend request right away.
...
At this time, Han Xuewei had just returned home. She parked the car in the garage and then saw Lin Yi waiting for her at the doorstep!
Before she could even walk to the door, Lin Yi rushed over and hugged her tightly.
"Vivi, I'm really sorry! The care I've given you has been too little. Qin Xiaoxu has told me that you're not feeling very well," he said.
"Baby, you must promise me that from now on you'll tell me about any troubles you have, or if you're feeling unhappy. It's better to express it than to hold it inside, okay?"
Lin Yi feared that the family would worry too much, so he didn't plan to disclose Han Xuewei's postpartum depression symptoms.
Han Xuewei leaned directly into Lin Yi's arms, "Okay, I'll be obedient." .net
They returned home together and were about to go upstairs to change clothes when Aunt Wang came running over anxiously.
"Lin Yi, Da Bao seems to be constipated. He hasn't pooped for several days, and I've tried everything, massaging him daily, but it hasn't had any effect. What's going on?" she asked.
Aunt Wang continued, "You know, many babies experience this around the two-month mark, maybe it's because the baby formula is causing him to become overheated. I think we should give the baby some probiotics or something similar! First, we must get his stomach and intestines in order, and promptly help the baby to poop!"
After hearing this, Han Xuewei was also quite nervous, "Aunt Wang, is this okay? I'm not sure if it'll work. I received a WeChat message from my mom when I was coming back, so I also looked it up in advance. Everyone suggests using an enema, otherwise the baby's poop will become pellets."
Aunt Wang nodded and replied, "Indeed, using an enema is also okay. However, probiotics and the like shouldn't be overlooked, the baby is still overheated, so we also need to cool him down."
Therefore, Han Xuewei quickly said to Lin Yi, "Lin Yi, you hurry and buy the enema and the probiotics Aunt Wang talked about. The baby hasn't pooped for several days, and this is not good!"
Seeing Han Xuewei's anxious look and remembering what Qin Xiaoxu said about Vivi being very worried about the baby, Lin Yi quickly reassured her, "Vivi, please don't worry, I'll buy the things right now. Since the baby isn't crying now, that means the situation isn't too severe. Don't worry, I'll find a way to solve it!"
Han Xuewei expressed her concern, "I'm really worried! Even adults feel uncomfortable if they don't have a bowel movement for several days, let alone such a small baby."
Lin Yi used some knowledge he had learned to comfort her, "Wife, you really don't need to worry so much. We're different from babies in this regard. We adults consume carbohydrates and fiber every day. But it's different for a baby, who only drinks milk every day. Most of the nutrients are absorbed by the body, and the rest is excreted through urine.
The baby hasn't cried these past few days; he still eats and sleeps normally, so it's not that serious. You don't have to worry too much, okay?"
Han Xuewei nodded after hearing this, as it seemed to make sense. The baby also didn't drink much milk every day, and usually, excretion was mainly through urine.
Aunt Wang also added, "Yes, Vivi, you don't need to worry too much. These situations are actually normal, and it also shows that there is no problem with the baby's absorption."
After consoling his wife, Lin Yi then called the employee at the "Happy Baby" store.
"Mr. Lin, hello! What can I do for you?" A few seconds later, the familiar voice of that employee came through the phone.
Lin Yi was direct, "Hello, do you have children's enema available? Also, probiotics for reducing heat and nourishing the stomach and intestines?"
The employee quickly replied, "We have all those! Mr. Lin, when do you need them?"
Lin Yi stated, "I need them now, and it's quite urgent. Can you deliver them as soon as possible?"
The employee responded, "We can deliver them to you right now. Please wait at home."
Then Lin Yi asked Aunt Wang standing next to him, "Aunt Wang, is the baby's formula almost out?"
Aunt Wang replied, "There are just two boxes left."
"Then continue with the phone," Lin Yi said, "Please also deliver the formula and diapers as per our usual standard, including the calcium supplements."
Lin Yi's purchases were always recorded, and the employee was well-familiar with them, so there wouldn't be any issues.
"Okay, then please wait awhile; I'll have it to you within half an hour," the employee confirmed.

chapters.title: Chapter 122: Chapter 122 Finally Pulled!
chapters.content:
After finishing these words on the phone, Lin Yi turned to Han Xuewei and said, "Wife, the items should arrive soon, so let's just wait a bit more patiently!"
Han Xuewei's eyes were red as she rubbed them and nodded.
Lin Yi was already very considerate, and he even took care of all her emotions meticulously.
But just at this moment, Da Bao suddenly began to cry!
Without any warning, he let out a big wail and then his little face turned very red, his small eyes bulged round, and his little fists clenched tightly together, as if he was exerting himself.
Could it be that he was starting to poo?
Aunt Wang was still massaging Da Bao to help him pass gas, and then she leaned close to the diaper and sniffed, saying excitedly, "Oh my, it seems like Da Bao is going!"
After hearing this, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei were also quite excited.
Looking at Han Xuewei, Lin Yi then said, "Wife, see what I told you? There really was no need to worry so much. The things haven't even arrived yet and the baby has already done it on his own."
Han Xuewei said seriously, "It seems that I worried too much. It's best not to use those things to avoid affecting the baby. I've read online that enemas are very bad, so I was really worried about the baby."
Lin Yi laughed and soothed, "Silly, I've read about it too, using it once or twice occasionally is not a problem. You're just too concerned about the little baby. You don't need to worry so much; we're all here!"
In front of everyone, Lin Yi directly embraced Han Xuewei in his arms, and Han Xuewei's face instantly turned red.
Aunt Wang and the others also laughed.
Right then, Aunt Wang suddenly said, "These days we need to get Da Bao to drink more water, and we also need to prevent this situation with the other two babies. The hottest time of the year is coming and we absolutely can't let the babies get heaty."
Lin Yi said, "Mm, okay, I got it, Aunt Wang."
Lin Yi was also very happy in his heart, because Aunt Wang was a seasoned childcare expert, and his parents had hired her to work here for so many years precisely because of that!
After receiving guidance from Lin Yi and her close girlfriends, Han Xuewei's mood also stabilized quite a bit, but raising one's own children was never an easy task.
She was slightly depressed lately due to worrying too much about the baby, so starting today she had to control her emotions better and adjust her mentality as a priority. Moreover, there wasn't anything that couldn't be resolved.
However, after Vivi and the babies were frightened by a large dog in the community, Lin Yi became even more determined to move to the villa in the city center as soon as possible.
Once they moved there, the backyard would have several hundred square meters, and if they wanted to take walks or stroll, they could completely do so in their own backyard without worrying about being frightened by large dogs.
Moreover, as the baby grew bigger, he would definitely play outside, so moving there would be safer.
Although the greening here was quite well managed and there was infrastructure specifically for children to play with, they had three babies and sometimes really couldn't keep an eye on all of them. Therefore, their own backyard was more reassuring by comparison, and he could also build entertainment facilities for the babies in the yard.
Seeing Da Bao's face turn red with effort while he pooped, Lin Yi became quite interested and moved closer, even encouraging his son, "Come on, son! Daddy is rooting for you!"
"Son, just hold on a bit longer and get all that stuff that's been accumulating in your belly out!"
Aunt Wang and the two maternity matrons were also nervously watching, and at this time, it was as if the little brother and sister could feel what their big brother was doing. They began to wave their hands and feet, as if they were cheering their brother on!
Instead, Han Xuewei, seeing everyone's reactions, couldn't help but snicker to herself, after all, the situation was indeed quite comical.
When Lin Yi noticed that Han Xuewei finally cracked a knowing smile, he felt a lot more at ease and started to joke around with even greater enthusiasm.
All of a sudden—
there came a "pfft" sound from the room!
Da Bao had farted!
"Baby did a poo-poo!"
To get a better look at whether the baby had actually done a number two, Lin Yi pulled back the diaper a bit and just like that, everyone saw the baby spray poop out!!
Almost his entire back was covered in it!
Lin Yi instinctively stepped back, "Oh my God, this…"
"I thought it was just a fart!" Lin Yi burst out laughing beside, "Let daddy have a good look, just how much could you hold after not pooing for days? Look how worried you made your mom."
Han Xuewei smiled on the side and leaned in closer as well.
Aunt Wang quickly interjected, "Alright, alright, nothing to see here, let's give the baby a bath! He's covered in it now!"
Lin Yi also sighed helplessly, "Oh my dear big boy! If you're gonna do a poo-poo, just do a poo-poo, why did you have to get it all over yourself!"
Han Xuewei stepped forward and picked up Da Bao, noticing that his entire back was smeared with yellow poop!
The people present all showed faces of disgust, "Ew! The whole room smells like it…"
At this moment, Han Xuewei was still holding the baby with her hand and said, "Aunt Wang, could you please get some water. Lin Yi, go grab the baby's clothes, we're giving him a bath!"
You can't bathe with a back full of poop; you have to rinse it off first!
Throughout this whole time, Han Xuewei had never anticipated that her baby, who had such a healthy routine and drank milk normally, would still end up constipated.
If such an incident were to happen again in the future, at least she would have the experience and know how to handle it, not worrying excessively like today.
After hearing Han Xuewei's words, everyone busied themselves with preparations. They were all pitching in to clean up the baby when the employee from "Fortune Baby" already arrived at the door.
Lin Yi quickly washed his hands and went to the door to move things.
Finally, after hauling in all the shopped items into the room, the employee also pulled out three baby walkers from the trunk, one red and two light blue.
Lin Yi took all the probiotics and stuff into the baby's room, just as Han Xuewei was pouring some warm water into the bottles, getting ready to give the babies a drink.
Aunt Wang added, "With July fast approaching, the weather is really hot, and the babies are getting dehydrated, so we need to replenish their water regularly every day."
Lin Yi took out a packet of probiotics and passed it over, "Half a pack each day is enough, I checked the instructions, and it's best mixed in the morning. So let's give it to the baby tomorrow! Here's also some Seven-Star tea, it's very sweet; you only need to pour out 25 grams each time, about a quarter will do."

chapters.title: Chapter 123: Chapter 123 Jinguo Hotel
chapters.content:
Meanwhile, Lin Yi heard the familiar notification sound in his mind!
"Ding! Congratulations to the host, you have completed the daily task of caring for the baby and earned a system reward of eight hundred thousand!"
Aunt Wang placed all the items in the corner, then checked the instructions one by one. After familiarizing herself with them, she brewed Seven-Star tea for each of the three babies.
At the same time, Lin Yi's mother and Han Xuewei's mother also returned home from shopping, both carrying many bags of various sizes. They even managed to find a baby stroller that could accommodate all three babies from some department store!
It has to be said, the design of this stroller was quite excellent, with the three seats distributed in a triangular formation. Although it appeared compact, the interior was surprisingly spacious!
Even if only one person was pushing the stroller, they could manage it completely.
Both mothers had their eyes set on this stroller the moment they saw it in the shopping mall.
After choosing the stroller, they sent photos of it to the family group chat immediately, but Lin Yi and Han Xuewei, being so busy with the children's matters, hadn't found the time to take a look.
The two mothers excitedly wheeled the stroller into the nursery, which was already piled with many shopping boxes.
Lin Yi's mother came rushing over to everyone and said, "Come quick, take a look! See what we both have bought today!"
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei hurriedly came over with the babies in their arms, and everyone gathered in the living room on the same floor. Seeing the mothers with their large and small packages, they too were dumbfounded!
"Wow! No way, Mom! How did you buy so much all at once?" Lin Yi exclaimed in astonishment.
Lin Yi's mother, in a flurry, put all the purchased items together while Han Xuewei's mother helped to organize them.
After finally clearing the stroller, Lin Yi's mother proudly said, "Look at this, we fell in love with this baby stroller at first sight. It's perfect, isn't it? It will come in handy when the three babies are one-year-old! We actually shouldn't have bought it so early, but after leaving the store, we couldn't stop thinking about it. In the end, we gritted our teeth and went back to get it!"
Han Xuewei's mother continued, "Right, when we saw this baby stroller, we were totally enchanted. It's so much more convenient. In the future, we just need to push this one when going out! To find such a stroller is really difficult because it's rare for a family to have triplets. We are not good at online shopping, so seeing it in the mall felt like fate.
After some thought, we just bought it directly!"
Lin Yi looked at the baby stroller and smiled, saying, "This little stroller does seem pretty nice! And it must be very practical. Let's give it a wash first to get rid of the germs on it, and then we can store it. We'll take it out when we need it later."
At this point, Han Xuewei also added, "It looks beautiful too. You both have a good eye for picking things!"
Seeing Lin Yi and Han Xuewei very satisfied with the purchases, Lin Yi's mother and Han Xuewei's mother were of course very happy.
Han Xuewei then said, "Mother-in-law, Mom, Da Bao finally had a bowel movement. We've just been busy cleaning it up."
As soon as Han Xuewei finished speaking, the baby in her arms began to babble, as if he were trying to tell grandma and grandmother about his day too.
Seeing the adorable babbling of the baby, Han Xuewei's mother hurried forward to take the child, "Oh my, let grandmother have a look, how was our little rascal today?"
Han Xuewei quickly handed the baby over to her mother, and then went to look at the spoils of their shopping spree.
After a quick scan, she asked, "It looks like you've bought so many things! What's inside all these bags?"
Han Xuerui's mother had just taken the baby into her arms, but immediately handed him back to Han Xuewei, "Oh dear, look at my memory, I haven't had the chance to wash my hands since I got back! Most of what we bought today is for the baby, and I've noticed the prices for baby products aren't low these days.
Just wait for us a moment, we'll come over after washing our hands and changing our clothes."
Lin Yi's mother neatly arranged the things they purchased and then said, "My in-law, let's cut off the tags! Then we should wash these clothes. The sun is still quite strong, we can dry them on the balcony in no time."
After listening, Han Xuewei's mother also hurried over to help, "Right, let's finish this work and then wash our hands!"
Having said that, the two mothers worked together to unwrap all the shopping bags and showed everyone the clothes they had bought for the baby.
Lin Yi had been watching Han Xuewei all along, only when he saw Han Xuewei's contented smile could he truly relax.
Perhaps only when there was an issue with the babies did Han Xuewei feel anxious because of her worry. But as long as the babies were healthy and had no problems, Han Xuewei wouldn't feel anxious.
In short, Lin Yi had to be constantly attentive to Han Xuewei's mood, it was best not to let Han Xuemei be alone, as that's when she was most prone to overthinking.
Ever since Lin Yi learned that Han Xuewei showed mild postpartum depression symptoms, he hadn't let her out of his sight, sticking to her like a shadow.
Eventually, the unusual behavior displayed by Lin Yi was noticed by both mothers.
One day, after Han Xuewei fell asleep, Lin Yi's mother and mother-in-law called him out for a questioning, "Lin Yi, what has happened? What exactly is going on with Vivi?"
The mother-in-law spoke with marked concern, "I've been feeling you've been watching Vivi very closely these past few days. Did something happen?"
Lin Yi's odd behavior during this period had already raised their suspicions, and now they were waiting for Lin Yi to confirm it.
Lin Yi lowered his voice and said to his mother and mother-in-law, "Mom, mother-in-law, I've heard that new moms can easily suffer from postpartum depression, so I thought I'd give her extra care. We mustn't let Vivi fall victim to this condition. A couple of days ago, Vivi went out for a meal with her best friend, her friend Qin Xiaoxu told me that Vivi was showing some mild depression symptoms.
That's why I've been watching over her these days. After observing her for some days, I see that Vivi's condition has been quite stable."
The mother-in-law quickly asked in concern, "What could be the reason for Vivi to experience this condition?"
Lin Yi pondered for a moment, then answered, "The biggest reason is the baby. After all, everyone has been caring for her, and perhaps it's the worry of being a mother for the first time that causes her to overthink, to the point that a very minor thing can lead to endless speculation and worry."

chapters.title: Chapter 124 Yang Fan's Predicament
chapters.content:
Lin Yi's mother nodded after hearing this and said, "Yeah, I think so too, especially since the twins were scared by that big dog last time. Then every time they sleep, they needed an adult to soothe them. Vivi spent a long time in the nursery when she was breastfeeding, and it wasn't until I urged her that she went back to her room. It seems we still need to be concerned about everything...
at least let Vivi calm her emotions."
Han Xuewei's mother also said, "That's right, Xue Mei has been sensitive since she was young, but after all, she's in the postpartum period now, and she can't help it. We should give her more care ordinarily and not let her worry too much about the babies."
The other two people also nodded in agreement.
Now everyone unanimously agreed that as long as the babies were taken care of well, Vivi wouldn't have anything to worry about, and they could also pay more attention to her emotions regularly.
After all, all mothers in the world love their own children! That's all everyone can do within their power now.
Fortunately, Han Xuewei's symptoms were quite mild, probably at an early stage. It was discovered relatively early, so everything was still manageable.
So, under the meticulous care of the whole family, Han Xuewei's mood had gradually improved a lot, and her sleep quality had also improved over these days.
Han Xuewei lay quietly and whispered in the ear of a half-asleep Lin Yi, "I love you, husband. You've been so good to me."
It was at this moment that Lin Yi's mind heard the system's notification!
"Ding! Congratulations to the host for touching your wife's heart, you have received a special reward — Jinguo Hotel!"
Just like that, he suddenly woke up, opening his eyes in an instant to see Han Xuewei gently gazing at him.
Lin Yi's gaze also softened a lot.
He then embraced Han Xuewei in his arms and said, "Why are you staring at me like that? Did you get dazzled by my handsomeness?"
Han Xuewei lightly pounded on his chest and said, "Pfft, vain... "
Lin Yi immediately leaned in and rubbed his face against Han Xuewei's forehead a few times: "How am I being vain? Clearly, you were woken up by my handsomeness, and you won't admit it..."
Han Xuewei wriggled free from his arms and then gave Lin Yi a kiss on the lips.
Lin Yi took a deep breath, a sly smile on his face, "Do you realize you're playing with fire?"
During these days, Lin Yi had been constantly mindful of Han Xuewei's feelings, so they hadn't had any deep communication for several days.
For a moment, Lin Yi really couldn't hold back!
...…
The next morning, Lin Yi came down from upstairs feeling refreshed, just as his father-in-law was having breakfast.
So he asked, "Father-in-law, how has the restaurant renovation been these past few days?"
The father-in-law, beaming with joy, smiled and said to Lin Yi, "The progress is quite fast, beyond my expectations! The plumbing and electrical work are almost finished, and at this rate, I reckon we can complete it before the 20th. Especially your roommate, he works worth two people, such a good young man. If I had another daughter, I'd definitely set her up with him."
Lin Yi broke out in a cold sweat as he listened... It seemed that starting early had its benefits!
After drinking a soy milk, his father-in-law then said to him, "Lin Yi, would you be interested in taking over in the future? The restaurant has a lot of potential."
Lin Yi smiled and replied, "Look at what you're saying, if there's ever anything that needs my help, I will definitely lend a hand. How could I possibly stand by idly? After all, you only have that one daughter, if I don't share some of the burden, it will all fall on her. Right?"
Lin Yi had actually already made up his mind, he was married to Han Xuewei, but after all, this was her family's property, so it should be under Han Xuewei's name, and he was at most there to help manage it.
Han Xuewei's dad understood what Lin Yi meant too, he would just be helping Vivi share the load, as eventually, all these things would still belong to Vivi. However, as a father-in-law, he didn't make such a clear distinction and felt it was the same no matter who it was given to.
Today, Lin Yi was supposed to feed the baby in the room when his roommate Qiang Hengxuan chased after him with a phone call.
"Lin Yi, I've got some explosive news to tell you! Do you know what Yang Fan is up to? I just happened to hear some news about him, his dad just opened a restaurant for him, and now something huge has happened!"
Lin Yi was well aware of the predicament Yang Fan was about to face, so he simply asked indifferently, "Oh? What big event has occurred?"
Qiang Hengxuan continued unabated, "Everyone was envious when they heard that his dad opened a restaurant for him, but since this incident, everyone has been sighing."
"That hotel had just been renovated not long ago, for about seven or eight days, before he received the news that the whole street was going to be expropriated and demolished. Actually, I had heard that the area was going to be demolished five or six years ago, but there had been no movement.
But he really didn't expect his luck to be so bad; just after renovating, before he even had the chance to show what he could do, this happened... Hahaha, his luck is just too bad. The more I think about it, the funnier it gets! I even went to his restaurant a few days ago. The renovation was clearly very costly, quite luxurious!
The area wasn't small either, the renovation fees must have been at least two or three million!"
"Can there be anyone more miserable than him? He hasn't even had his grand opening, and now he has no choice but to demolish it. The landlord of the shop was clever too—there was no mention of such sudden circumstances in the contract, so he can only accept his bad luck. Hahaha, he can only shoulder this loss himself!" Qiang Hengxuan laughed out loud. Discover exclusive tales on mvl
Lin Yi also smiled faintly and said, "Such a person really deserves it, well, let's not talk about him. How's your job search going?"
All the events about to happen to Yang Fan were within his expectations, and even without Lin Yi's intervention, his older brother had left a trick up his sleeve!
But Lin Yi was still quite concerned about Qiang Hengxuan.
When Qiang Hengxuan was asked this question, he was momentarily confused, "You asked about Yang Fan's situation before, I thought you were pretty anxious, so as soon as I got the news, I immediately reported to you! Why do you seem to not care that much?"
After saying that, he thought for a moment, then said, "I've already got my diploma, but as for a job... I'll talk about that later!"
Lin Yi responded, "Mm-hmm, work is important, you can't be as playful as before anymore. Ah, it's time to feed the baby, I need to go. We'll chat another time."
Qiang Hengxuan laughed mischievously on the other end of the phone, "Hahaha, who would have thought our Brother Lin would be revolving around his wife and child every day now—eh?"
Lin Yi smiled knowingly, then said, "Don't be too happy too soon, one day you'll understand this feeling too."

chapters.title: Chapter 125 Han Xuewei's Cousin
chapters.content:
Qiang Hengxuan uttered a meaningful tsk and said, "Dude, I'm still single right now and can't think that far ahead, so I don't need to worry about that at all! Alright, let's not talk about this anymore. Go feed the three little ones!"
As Lin Yi listened to the phone, he helped his little daughter Mengmeng prop up the milk bottle, watching her gulp it down voraciously, and he couldn't help but think how adorably chubby her little cheeks were!
He really wanted to give her a big kiss!
As the day they had agreed on approached, the family got everything ready the night before and loaded it into the RV.
Han Xuewei's father was in charge of driving with the two maternity matrons, while Lin Yi drove the RV with Han Xuewei and both mothers on board, accompanied by Aunt Wang to help take care of the babies easily.
Lin Yi and his dad first drove their own car to bring over some uncles and older relatives. Although there wasn't enough room, it was fine because the uncles and older relatives had their own cars as well.
Lin Yi's maternal relatives also drove over, and looking around, the entire convoy had a total of ten cars!
Seeing that Lin Yi's parents brought so many relatives, Han Xuewei's mom could tell how much they valued their daughter, so she was naturally very happy. Discover hidden tales at mvl
They were a big family, and the core of a big family is unity, and the more united they are, the stronger their relationships become, allowing them to develop further into the future. Even if some big families aren't very wealthy, if one person makes a fortune, the other family members will also be lifted up.
It had to be said that the family Lin Yi belonged to was extremely united; his original family was very harmonious.
About two hours later, the entire convoy slowly pulled up in front of the main branch of "Han Family Private Kitchen" that Han Xuewei's dad had opened in their hometown.
At the entrance of this main branch, Han family relatives had already arrived early to prepare for receiving guests.
Han Xuewei's uncles, aunts, and other relatives warmly came forward to greet them when they saw the convoy arrive.
"Oh my, you must have had a hard time on the road, traveling for so long. You must be tired, right?"
"Welcome, welcome!"
Lin Yi's Uncle Lin Xibei smiled and came forward to shake hands, saying, "Don't mention it, don't mention it, thanks for welcoming us!"
Lin Jie was seriously looking at his phone, sending messages while following his father inside.
The restaurant was decorated in a traditional Chinese style, not exactly luxurious, but it looked quite impressive! Being the main branch, it was quite majestic, the whole building being divided into three layers. Lin Yi remembered his father-in-law saying that each layer exceeded one thousand square meters.
The First Layer was primarily for entertaining parties of four or fewer guests, with a portion set aside as the kitchen.
The Second Layer was fully opened up for hosting banquets.
And the top layer consisted entirely of private rooms.
As Lin Yi and others got out of the RV carrying the babies, the aunts quickly pushed the strollers over.
Lin Yi's mother couldn't help but marvel at the sight of the restaurant, "Wow, such a big building! The rent collected each year must be quite a bit, right?"
Han Xuewei's mother replied with a smile, "Actually, there wasn't much investment; the land was already ours, so we don't have to pay any rent."
When Han Xuewei's father was young, he had bought quite a lot of land, so now all of their businesses were built on these owned lands.
After hearing this, Lin Yi's mother became even more surprised, "My goodness, the area of this land doesn't look small at all. The initial investment must have been hefty!"
Han Xuewei's mother said, "It was manageable, I suppose, at that time we did put all of our family wealth into it. That's all in the past now. You must be hungry after the journey, right? Let's all go inside and have lunch quickly, and see how our homecooked dishes taste."
With that, she ushered in dozens of people.
Knowing that Lin Yi's parents had invited many relatives over, Han Xuewei's parents only called in seven or eight relatives, which made hosting the banquet easier.
The midday banquet was akin to a welcome feast, and Han Xuewei's parents quickly arranged for all the relatives from Lin Yi's side to stay in a high-end local hotel, but for Lin Yi and his parents, they were directly brought to their family villa.
Han Xuewei's grandmother used to alternate stays between her two sons' houses, but Han Xuewei's father had come to Xiangcheng, so she stayed with her eldest son for the time being.
Although Han Xuewei's father wanted to take her to Xiangcheng as well, the elderly lady preferred not to hassle herself with traveling back and forth.
When her grandmother's big birthday arrived, the birthday banquet was held in "Han Family's Home Cooking."
On that day, the restaurant was almost plastered with the large character "Shòu" (longevity).
One could see from afar the very festive couplets pasted at the entrance, and a long red carpet laid out front, with colorful lights decorating both the inside and outside—it was an extraordinarily lively day.
Han family's matriarch's husband had passed away a few years ago, and now her two sons were taking care of her in her old age.
The elder son, Han Chunping, was a doctor at the local hospital, a down-to-earth and honest man, though not adept at doing business.
The younger son, Han Xinmin, took over the restaurant from his father and gradually developed it to where it stood today, making a name for itself in the local dining industry.
So, on this day, the restaurant saw quite a few customers, and of course, they all came for the face of the Han family.
On the day itself, the Han family's grandmother was dressed in a red Tang suit, looking dignified and imposing. Though she was already in her eighties, her eyes were bright and full of life, making her look much younger than her age—years behind her peers.
Surrounded by relatives, today's matriarch was receiving congratulations all around amidst laughter and joy.
Naturally, the elderly lady was very happy and did not forget to nod and praise her younger son, Han Xinmin, with a smile.
After all, if it weren't for her younger son Han Xinmin's capability, her birthday celebration would not have had such grandeur!
Han Xuemei, who is also Han Xuewei's cousin, wore a dress that day, sporting a freshly cut bob and her makeup was particularly dazzling.
Looking at the scene in front of her, she couldn't help but start complaining again about her incapable parents, her dissatisfaction having nowhere to vent!
Her father was the grandfather's eldest son, but why was the restaurant left to her second uncle? How exactly did her second uncle monopolize it?
And now Han Xuewei had even found an extremely wealthy husband!
She had long heard from her parents that Han Xuewei's husband was now worth quite a bit! Over ten billion at least!
And they owned two big villas, had several cars at home, and had savings that one couldn't spend in a lifetime!
If her own father hadn't been so spineless, the signboard of "Han Family's Home Cooking" would be in her father's hands, and she, today, would have to be even more glorious than Han Xuewei!

chapters.title: Chapter 126 An Undeniable Green Tea
chapters.content:
Han Xuemei's family conditions were considered quite acceptable. Her father was at least a chief physician, which meant that her family was on the path to modest prosperity. They might not have had a villa, but they still lived in a relatively upscale neighborhood.
Looking back, Han Xuemei saw her grandmother's face filled with joy, lovingly doting on Han Xuewei's baby. Her anger was beyond words!
She turned around and ran out in a huff!
Once outside the door, she saw a long line of people who had come to offer birthday congratulations.
Among them were some of the well-known wealthy of Xiao Chuan County. Dressed in their finery, suits, and shoes, each held an expensive gift in hand.
Jealousy was about to spill out from her eyes!!
Everyone was discussing how the Han family had a young miss, Han Xuewei, who was lovely and beloved by all who met her.
What they didn't know was that there was another young miss in the Han family—Han Xuemei!
The more she thought about it, the angrier she became!
As she was turning around, the tall figure of a very impressive person came into view. Although she quickly controlled her emotions, the other party still witnessed the scene.
Walking towards the dining room, this tall figure had the perfect build, looking just like a male god from the comics, with neat short hair and a face with smooth lines which outlined his handsome and dashing appearance.
This person was her cousin-in-law, Lin Yi!
When Lin Yi saw the expression on Han Xuemei's face, his brow furrowed.
Han Xuewei had already introduced this girl to him; she was Han Xuewei's cousin.
But why did she look so strange just now? Almost ferocious.
Lin Yi immediately chanted in his mind, "Activate Art of Discernment!"
Two seconds later, he received feedback from the system: "This person is a gold digger, without a doubt, a green tea!"
When Han Xuemei realized the man before her was her cousin's husband, she was also taken aback, having not expected her cousin's husband to be here.
While she was still feeling embarrassed, suddenly an idea sprouted in her mind!
To be precise, it was a scheme!
Han Xuewei and Han Xuemei were cousins of the same age, with Han Xuewei being born two months earlier. However, both were now seniors in college. Han Xuemei was majoring in dance, so she was very strict about maintaining her figure.
She was particularly pleased with her willowy waist, a feature she was proud of!
She controlled her figure in all aspects every day. Besides being careful with her diet, she also had her own personal trainer as well as a nutritional meal plan, strictly managing her daily calorie intake.
