Han Xuewei had previously expressed jealousy of her figure, so Han Xuemei secretly vowed to keep her figure in check, not allowing herself to get fat!
Han Xuemei had a large social circle but in her eyes, there appeared to be no man in Xiao Chuan County worthy of her attention. Otherwise, with her figure and looks, she should have at least had a decent boyfriend by now!
As she concocted this scheme in her mind, the corners of her mouth lifted in a subtle smile that went unnoticed.
She confidently sashayed over with her willowy waist, blocking Lin Yi's path.
The latter was momentarily startled but then stood still, observing her with a frown.
Being scrutinized by Lin Yi, Han Xuemei started to feel uncomfortable, at a loss for what to do, and eventually averted her gaze from Lin Yi's.
Nevertheless, she firmly believed that this feeling was love at first sight!
Yes, she was utterly taken by Lin Yi's commanding presence!
"Are you today's guest?" Lin Yi deliberately pretended not to recognize her and asked.
When she heard that magnetic voice, Han Xuemei nearly swooned. She couldn't help but swallow her saliva hastily and replied, "Yes, I am."
Lin Yi sized her up, and thanks to the people-recognition system provided, he had a poor impression of the girl in front of him.
However, when Han Xuemei saw Lin Yi staring at her, she stood even straighter, confident that he admired her.
Han Xuemei couldn't help but feel surprised herself; as their eyes met, her heartbeat accelerated.
After a long while, Han Xuemei finally remembered to introduce herself: "Um, Han Xuewei is my cousin; we've lived together since we were kids... Are you out for a stroll to clear your mind?"
Lin Yi picked up the baby bottle and said to her, "No, I forgot the bottle in my car, so I came out specially to get it."
The baby is crying from hunger now!
Han Xuemei looked at the baby bottle and was taken aback.
"You're getting the bottle, huh? Let's go back to the restaurant together," she offered.
As Han Xuemei tried to reach out and take the bottle, Lin Yi stepped back half a step and said, "It's okay; I can carry it myself."
Lin Yi didn't say much more to her and headed straight to the restaurant.
But Han Xuemei really had a thick skin; she just kept following him, annoyingly trying to make conversation.
On this short walk, she tried several times to take the bottle, but Lin Yi blocked her attempts every time.
Meanwhile, others also started to look their way, and in no time, the crowd at the scene was buzzing with chatter.
"Are they both here to attend the birthday banquet too? That guy is so handsome, but who's the girl next to him?"
"You don't know the girl? She's another granddaughter of Old Madam Han, named Han Xuemei."
"But the guy looks unfamiliar; could she have brought her boyfriend with her?"
"Not at all. He's the son-in-law of Han Xinmin, the second son of Old Madam Han, and the dutiful husband of Han Xuewei!"
"Turns out he's the father of the twins! Hahaha, I must say, Han Xuewei really didn't have it easy, getting pregnant with triplets all at once. This family is truly blessed!"
"I feel the same way, and I also heard that her husband gave Han Xuewei a car, and after having the children, he even bought her a villa! And the diamond jewelry he prepared isn't cheap either! Moreover, the villa is in Han Xuewei's name! Right in the city center, over nine hundred square meters!"
"Ah?? That expensive! That's a villa in the city center, after all! It's unimaginable!"
"Wow, I didn't expect her husband to be in such good conditions!"
"If you ask me, her husband is pretty lucky too, after all, Han Xuewei is one of the top beauties in our entire county, and she's got a great figure, right?"
"Hahahaha, which kind of lucky are you talking about?"
......
And Han Xuemei heard their conversations, by then, jealousy had made her completely unrecognizable!
When Lin Yi saw everyone warmly greeting him, he also nodded his head politely in response, without saying much.
He went straight to Han Xuewei's side, passed the baby bottle to his mother-in-law and Aunt Wang, and casually wrapped his arm around Han Xuewei's waist.
Then he whispered in her ear: "Wife, do we need to find a private room for the babies to feed?"

chapters.title: Chapter 127 Understated Luxury
chapters.content:
Han Xuemei's little face turned red as she nodded.
All of this was witnessed by Han Xuemei standing behind.
"It's Xue Mei, isn't it?" the Han family's old lady said, looking at Han Xuemei behind her, suddenly speaking up.
Only after being called out did Han Xue react, hastily recalling her purpose and then quickly smiling and saying, "Grandma, today is your birthday, Xue Mei wishes you the same joy you find today, every year and every age!"
The Han family's old lady's face burst into a smile, "Good, good, good, have a seat quickly."
Han Xuewei's mother and Lin Yi's mother were holding the older and younger brothers, while Han Xuewei was holding her little daughter, Mengmeng.
The three of them, each with a milk bottle in hand. Han Xuewei's mother even turned her head to say to the Han family's old lady, "Mom, please wait a moment, we'll come out after feeding the milk, otherwise the kids are going to cry later."
The old Mrs. Han reluctantly withdrew her hand from pinching the baby's little face and said with a smile, "Mm, the children's mouths are all puckered up from hunger, go and feed them! You don't have to worry about things here, there are other people."
The two old fathers were busy welcoming guests, receiving gifts from them, and then leading them to wish the old lady happy returns.
Han Xuemei said to the old lady, "Then I would like to take a look, too, as today is my first time seeing the baby."
After listening to her, the old lady also smiled and said, "Mm, then you go take a look! Don't just watch the excitement, you need to hurry up for me too, I'm waiting to see your children in the future!"
Hearing grandma actually hurrying her, Han Xuemei's face instantly turned red, but shyly said, "Oh, Grandma, I don't even have a boyfriend yet..."
Having said that, she followed Lin Yi and the others and ran off, while the old Mrs. Han watched everyone leave with a face full of kindly warmth.
Lin Yi led everyone to a private room, but to his reluctance, Han Xuemei had the nerve to follow them in.
Perhaps it was because the first impression was so bad that he always felt Han Xuemei was approaching with an ulterior motive and deep down did not like her, but she was Han Xuewei's cousin, so he couldn't be too obvious with his attitude.
Lin Yi guarded Han Xuewei like this, and the entering Han Xuemei wasn't a stranger, so she simply started feeding the milk.
At that time, Han Xuemei approached the babies, watching them with a beaming smile.
Seeing this scene, Han Xuewei's mother laughed and asked, "Xuemei, you should find a partner too, right? At least start dating, let us also hold your baby. We're moving to Xiangcheng later, the old lady loves children so much, and later she'll be waiting for you to bring your children to see her."
Upon hearing these words, Han Xuemei's expression suddenly became much dimmer.
Ha, your whole family is going to develop in Xiangcheng, leaving us behind? Do we have to live here forever? Can't I, Han Xuemei, go to a bigger city like you?
Impossible!
I will never stay here forever!
Han Xuemei just smiled faintly and then said, "I also think about going to a broader city to broaden my horizons just like my sister, and I hope to find my own Prince Charming just like her, preferably as outstanding as my cousin-in-law."
After hearing this, Han Xuewei's mother was slightly taken aback, clearly not expecting her to say such a thing.
If it were someone else, they certainly would have exchanged pleasantries first before saying that they are still young and can't find a suitable match so soon. However, from Han Xuemei's words, it wasn't hard to tell that her desire was just too strong!
But Han Xuewei's mom didn't say much, replying with a simple, "After all, she's young. It's only right for her to go out and see the world."
Yet, this statement took on a different meaning in Han Xuemei's eyes, "Heh, your son-in-law's qualifications are so good, but I haven't heard you say anything about helping me. You're really being petty, huh? Tch! Selfish!"
About fifteen minutes later, all three babies had begun their post-meal nap, with Aunt Wang and the two Maternity Matrons watching over them as they slept.
The little ones had gotten up early this morning and had also been in the car for so long. They must have been extremely tired, so it was a good opportunity for them to get some good sleep.
The others came out to keep the old lady company. They took their seats at the largest main table. When the old lady saw everyone return, she asked with a smile, "How did the children feed? Are they all asleep now?"
Han Xuewei's mom quickly responded, "Mom, they're sleeping soundly now. They should wake up just after we finish eating."
The old lady nodded in satisfaction and said, "Later on, bring the children out. I have some gifts for them! As soon as I heard you were coming, I specially prepared three red envelopes. I must hand them over personally."
Han Xuewei's mom said with a laugh, "Mom, you've really gone to a lot of trouble."
It was rare for the old lady to show such fondness for the babies, and Han Xuewei's mom felt truly happy from the bottom of her heart.
By around noon, all eighty-eight tables in the hall were filled with guests. At the front and center, an eye-catching bright red "Shou" character stood out, making for a grand scene!
Especially magnificent!
Looking around the venue, the entire decor was in a traditional Chinese style. Although it wasn't as opulent as a star-rated hotel, the grandeur was certainly luxurious.
The guests invited were also extraordinary, at least being somewhat well-known and wealthy from various industries.
Han Xuewei's father, Han Xinmin, didn't actually like to make a big deal out of events. He preferred to keep a low profile, and nowadays, he focused all his attention on the three babies.
Even today's gathering was simply out of obligation, and his main intent was to greet the guests who had dealings with him from time to time.
He also had it figured out that he wanted to step back from business within the next few years to concentrate on taking care of his family, as the future belonged to the younger generation and he would eventually step out of the market.
Gradually, he planned to hand over all his shops in Xiaochuan County to his relatives. Moreover, he had been busy recently training several capable assistants.
As for everything in Xiangcheng, he would let his daughter and son-in-law take over. Whether the future was bright or grim, the restaurant would belong to them. The main store opened in Xiangcheng would serve as their wedding gift!
Amidst everyone's discussion, a relative from the Han family suddenly asked, "Logically, as Han Xinmin's son-in-law, Lin Yi should be presenting a congratulatory gift to the old lady. Why hasn't it appeared yet?"
"That's unknown. Maybe he already gave something in advance."
"Pssh, listen to you. Han Xinmin's son-in-law's family is quite wealthy; they can afford to give a villa of more than nine hundred square meters in the city center. Would they lack such small gifts?"
Lin Yi's father, overhearing the guests' comments, immediately got worked up. He quickly urged his son to call the jewelry store and ask when the items they had selected yesterday would be delivered.

chapters.title: Chapter 128 The Pure Gold Peach of Longevity
chapters.content:
In fact, Lin Yi and his father had selected the birthday present for the old lady the night before, but they did not bring it with them. Instead, they had instructed the people from the gold shop to ensure its delivery today.
The reason for this was to avoid Han Xuewei's parents from commenting on how expensive the gift was.
So, Lin Yi's father had the manager of Lin Yi's gold shop make a phone call to inquire about the current status of the delivery.
"Lin Yi, has the item not arrived yet? Isn't it a bit too late?"
Lin Yi replied anxiously, "Dad, I'm even more anxious than you are. I asked about it ten minutes ago, and they said because the item is so valuable, it needs to be escorted by security personnel. They asked us to wait patiently."
Lin Yi's father shrugged helplessly and said, "They said last night that it would be delivered by twelve o'clock, but it's already ten minutes past, and we're about to start dinner. If it's any later, it will lose its meaning! Could it be that it will only arrive once everyone has finished eating and the party is over?"
Lin Yi's father's concerns were not unfounded. After all, it was the Lin Family's first time attending a joyous event of the Han family. If they couldn't even produce a birthday present, they would be laughed at by relatives.
Even though before this, Han Xuewei's mother had brought a large supply of nourishing gifts for the old lady, at most this could only be considered her personal greeting gift and could not be counted as a birthday present for the elder!
While the father and son were worrying, the elevator door on one side of the banquet hall slowly opened, and out came a person dressed in a sharp, sophisticated suit.
Behind him followed several security personnel dressed in uniform black, surrounding a cabinet that appeared to be about a meter tall.
Their arrival attracted many people's attention and started discussions among the crowd, "Oh, that person is the manager from our county's leading jewelry shop, Da Fu Gold!"
"How familiar, so it was him."
"And he's got a safe with him, quite a statement. Could it be a birthday gift for the old lady?"
"Anyway, this setup is far from simple, so many bodyguards following him, it's indeed a bit mysterious."
"Could it be filled with gold? Isn't that a bit too extravagant?"
Most of those present today were wealthy businessmen from various sectors, and for people like them, gold was the best asset to preserve value.
Da Fu Gold Shop is considered the largest gold shop in the county.
However, it's said that the owner of Da Fu Gold Shop is from out of town and happens to be away on a business trip these days, so the manager brought this generous gift instead.
Lin Yi's father, who had been anxiously checking his watch and watching the elevator, was the first to notice the commotion over there.
He quickly grabbed Lin Yi and ran towards the elevator entrance, shouting as he went, "Manager Guo, over here!"
Manager Guo smiled immediately upon seeing the father and son and hurriedly came over to greet them, "I'm so sorry for the inconvenience, there was a bit of a traffic jam, so we're slightly behind schedule!"
Lin Yi's father hastily said, "It's alright, dinner hasn't started yet. Otherwise, it would have been a real problem. Even complaining wouldn't have made me feel better!"
Manager Guo quickly apologized with a smile and instructed the security personnel to push the safe forward, for the father and son to inspect, "Gentlemen, this is the Gold Peach of Longevity you reserved at our store. We have delivered it for you!"
"Our tardiness was our fault, we hope you can forgive us, and the safe will be a complimentary gift!"
Because compared to this pure Gold Peach of Longevity, the safe was relatively inexpensive!
After all, the price of the Gold Peach of Longevity was already several million!
Lin Yi took a quick look and confirmed the receipt of the delivery.
Manager Guo also hurriedly unlocked the safe and after giving a look to the security personnel, he left.
All the guests were still discussing the events when Lin Yi and his father slowly pushed the safe towards the main table.
They arrived beside the elderly lady and said, "Grandma, today is your birthday, we wish you longevity beyond your years. We hope you will accept this modest gift as a token of the younger generation's affection."
The Han family's elderly matriarch, seeing how articulate Lin Yi was, quickly responded with a smile, "Good, good, good. As long as it's from my grandson-in-law, I like it! I like everything!"
She truly thought from the bottom of her heart that Lin Yi was a good kid!
And so, Lin Yi carefully opened the safe and under the gaze of the audience, gradually revealed the Gold Peach of Longevity!
It was made of pure gold!
It was no light object; he and his father had weighed it—twenty-five pounds!
As everyone got a clear look at the object, the room burst into astonished murmurs; the word 'surprise' could no longer describe their reaction!
Some people were very familiar with this Peach of Longevity because it was the treasure of the Great Fortune Gold Store!
It had been on display for more than a decade, with nobody buying it!
The price had also skyrocketed to over five million!
But nobody had expected that just yesterday, the Lin family father and son had bought it!
And now, it became the old lady's birthday gift!
At this moment, everyone present was certain of the Lin family's financial strength that was not comparable to that of ordinary people!
Moreover, by tomorrow, there would be a new topic of conversation in Xiao Chuan County!
Looking at Han Xuemei now, her eyes were filled with very complex emotions!
Envy, jealousy, and even hatred!
A five-million-worth birthday gift??!!
Not just her, but everyone present had never seen anything like it before! Just how strong were the Lin family's resources?
When the Han family's elderly lady saw the Peach of Longevity, she too was taken aback at first, but the next second, a pleased expression spread across her face, and it wasn't hard for everyone to see that she was genuinely happy.
"Oh my! Lin Yi, my in-laws, this... this birthday gift is too precious! We've already received so many gifts, you've really gone too far today!" Han Xuewei's mother hastily said.
Seeing the elderly's satisfied expression, Lin Yi smiled and replied, "It's what our younger generation ought to do, making the elder happy is what matters, don't worry about the expense."
The Han family's elderly lady also said, "Good, this birthday gift is wonderful! Thank you for your thoughtfulness."
At this moment, both Lin Yi's mother and Han Xuewei's mother were also quite surprised; they hadn't anticipated that Lin Yi and his father had prepared such a birthday gift.
The elderly lady promptly had her eldest son, Han Chunping, take the generous gift, and they moved the safe away.
All the birthday gifts received by the elderly lady were kept in a private room for safety, and she also went there to put a password on the safe.
About fifteen minutes later, she returned, assisted by her eldest son.
Seeing that it was getting late, the elderly's eldest son, Han Chunping, stood up and suggested, "Mom, it's already half-past twelve, let's let the guests start eating. We, the younger generation of the Han family, will write a birthday blessing for you."

chapters.title: Chapter 129: Chapter 129 Preparing the Wedding Banquet
chapters.content:
What he referred to by writing "longevity" was for the younger generations to write the character "寿" for the old lady as a way of congratulating her, which was also a local custom.
The more characters written, the more it signified the number of descendants and the greater the old lady's blessings were.
Upon hearing this, Grandma Han nodded in agreement.
Although Grandma Han's granddaughters were only Han Xuewei and Han Xuemei, the children of other relatives could also be included, so for a while, those writing the "longevity" character for her nearly filled the entire stage.
Grandma Han, sitting at the head of the main table, felt very honored seeing so many of her descendants.
Han Xuewei, an arts college student, designed a very unique "longevity" character for her grandmother with her own creative ideas.
Han Xuewei's three babies were also brought out, and with their little hands, they pressed Hand Seals on it, which delighted the old lady beyond words when she saw it!
The old lady also handed out red packets to all the younger generation who wrote the "longevity" character, with the largest undoubtedly given to Han Xuewei's three babies.
She didn't forget to remind them, "In a few years, you'll need to bring back even more babies."
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei's face instantly turned red, while Lin Yi's mother hurriedly responded, "Certainly, certainly."
To others, whether or not to have a second child was all the same; it mainly depended on the young couple's wishes. If they really wanted, Lin Yi's mother would certainly help take care of them.
At that moment, a system notification also rang in Lin Yi's mind!
"Ding! Congratulations to the host, you've successfully delivered a congratulatory gift to your wife's grandmother, and the system will now return double the amount of the gift!"
Lin Yi was also very surprised, having not expected the congratulatory gift for the old lady to be doubled in return by the system! This was indeed an unexpected windfall!
After the younger generations finished writing the "longevity" character, everyone began to eat together.
The birthday banquet was full of laughter and conversation, lasting until about three in the afternoon before the guests gradually dispersed.
Then everybody took a ride to the Han family's large villa.
Not long after arriving at the villa, Lin Yi's phone rang.
"Hello? Yes… Mm… where are you guys now… Got it, I'll send you a location and we'll meet there."
After finishing the call, he turned to Han Xuewei and said, "Vivi, I need to step out for a bit."
Han Xuewei asked with a puzzled look, "You're going out? Did you make plans with friends today?"
Lin Yi smiled mysteriously, "I'm going to take you along to see something, you'll understand when we get there."
Uncertain, Han Xuewei finished changing the babies' diapers, then went to her room to put on makeup and get dressed.
After all, it was a matter of meeting Lin Yi's friends, so such etiquettes were necessary, if only to show respect to them.
Once she was ready, Han Xuewei asked him, "Husband, should we go now? Have they arrived already?"
Lin Yi glanced at his watch and said, "They said they'll be here soon, we can still make it if we leave now."
Han Xuewei nodded and replied, "Okay."
Then, he sent a WeChat message to Qin Xiaoxu: "Xiaoxu, you must remember the time we agreed on, you have to ask for leave! You definitely have to be my bridesmaid! The other roommates also promised they would come over."
Qin Xiaoxu seemed to be off for a few days too, so her reply came very quickly: "Mhm, okay, don't worry, how could I not take your matters seriously?"
Han Xuewei replied with a "kissy face" emoji.
At that moment, Qin Xiaoxu was busy chatting with someone who was renting a girlfriend on the confession wall. The other party, somewhat anxiously, asked: "Do you have absolutely no time on the 23rd this month? That's too bad, my cousin's wedding is on the 23rd, and I was hoping to bring you to meet my parents that day!"
Qin Xiaoxu replied: "That's really unfortunate, the 23rd is also my best friend's wedding, and she needs me to be her bridesmaid, so we'll have to pick another time."
The netizen called "Don't Love Me, It's Hopeless" replied: "Then it can't be helped, we'll look for another opportunity next time. I've already sent your selfie over to my parents, and they're quite satisfied, so you absolutely must not let me down at the crucial moment! If you don't meet them, they're definitely going to give me a hard time!"
Qin Xiaoxu laughed and sent a cheeky emoji, then replied: "As long as the payment is good, everything will be no problem!"
According to what this guy had said, she only needed to pretend to be his girlfriend once, but she had to give off the feeling of a gold digger.
Qin Xiaoxu couldn't help but feel that she would definitely be good at it! And the commission was very high, this was like a little interlude in her mundane life!
A very interesting part-time job!
And who knows, maybe the two of them could develop real feelings after chatting for a while, and Qin Xiaoxu could find the love she had always dreamed of!
From their current interactions, this boy seemed quite reliable.
No sooner had they finished chatting than he directly transferred 99 yuan to Qin Xiaoxu, who, of course, happily accepted it.
This "Don't Love Me, It's Hopeless" netizen was the same guy she had seen on the confession wall, and Qin Xiaoxu had hurriedly applied for the job after seeing his message!
And this netizen called "Don't Love Me, It's Hopeless" often forwarded screenshots of his chats with Qin Xiaoxu to his father.
When his father heard that his son finally had a partner, he generously handed him a bank card with a deposit of 150,000 yuan.
After giving the card to his son, Zhao Yu couldn't contain his smile and said, "Using money to settle matters is so convenient! Who would've thought that just by giving my son a little love subsidy, he would get a girlfriend! It's lucky he could afford it; otherwise, he might have ended up without a girlfriend!"
Back at the Han family home, after chatting with Qin Xiaoxu for a while, Lin Yi received a call that the people on the other end had arrived at their destination.
Lin Yi drove to the arranged address, and there was a moderately sized house parked by the road. Stay tuned for updates on mvl
Lin Yi led these people inside, and Han Xuewei saw that they were holding various pieces of equipment that seemed to be for photography. There were four people in total, with one woman carrying a makeup bag, and the others carrying equipment.
Surprised, Han Xuewei looked at Lin Yi incredulously and asked, "Honey, they..."
"They're the photographers I specially hired to take our wedding photos; consider it a little surprise!" Lin Yi was moved when he saw all the equipment they brought, "Our wedding photos must be taken in the city where you grew up! And later, when we look at the photos, I can listen to the stories of your childhood."
After hearing this, Han Xuewei was quite moved, and she looked earnestly at Lin Yi, finding herself at a loss for words.

chapters.title: Chapter 130: Chapter 130 Wedding Photos
chapters.content:
"Husband..."
She really hadn't expected that Lin Yi would prepare such a thoughtful surprise for her when he accompanied her to Xiaochuan County!
Lin Yi looked at her affectionately, and in a soft voice, said, "Baby, do you like it?"
"Yes! I like it a lot! I really, really like it!" Han Xuewei jumped up to hug Lin Yi's neck and exclaimed, "Husband! I love you!"
Find adventures on mvl
Han Xuewei had initially thought that Lin Yi had forgotten about the wedding dress photo shoot and, with the wedding just a few days away, there might not be enough time to do it upon returning to Xiangcheng.
Moreover, the team doing the wedding dress photo shoot was very professional, and they charged one hundred and fifty thousand for a single session, which of course included the Later Stages production.
And their efficiency was unmatched - photos taken today would be ready within two days!
You really do get what you pay for!
At that moment, the whole professional team smiled as they watched Lin Yi and Han Xuewei.
The female makeup artist asked with a smile, "May we start the makeup trial now?"
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei exchanged smiles and then separated from their embrace.
Lin Yi told everyone, "Let's start now!"
The professionals then opened the rear door of the RV and took down quite a few pieces of equipment. They came to the front of the Han family's villa and first set up a tent to serve as a changing room.
Inside were many different styles of wedding dresses.
Han Xuewei followed the female makeup artist into the RV to start applying makeup.
There weren't many outfits for Lin Yi to try on today, just a few similar styles, but Han Xuewei had a much greater selection to choose from.
Lin Yi took Han Xuewei to look at these wedding dresses, then asked, "Vivi, what do you think of these wedding dresses? Are they nice? The ones we saw at their store before weren't very clean, after all, many people had tried them on. So, I paid to have all the clothes replaced with new ones. After we finish the photo shoot, we'll just let them take all the dresses away!"
Han Xuewei's eyes widened in disbelief, "Ah? We're buying these wedding dresses?"
Han Xuewei had also considered whether to rent or buy for the wedding dress photo shoot, but after some thought, she felt it wasn't very cost-effective to buy since they would only be used once and would take up space ordinarily.
But she had never imagined that Lin Yi would buy so many all at once! And to give them to the bridal shop after wearing seemed somewhat wasteful!
But Lin Yi didn't see it that way; he believed that the wedding dress photo shoot was a very important event in life, so it had to be perfect!
When Lin Yi had visited the bridal shop to select wedding dresses, he found that some were not cleaned properly, with stains still on them, or there were holes, although not very noticeable. But wearing them still made one feel uncomfortable!
What's more, some of the dresses even had an unpleasant odor, which was very pungent, likely due to inadequate disinfection; they seemed to just spray some disinfectant and call it cleaned, without proper washing.
And in the summer, these odors would become even more irritating, and unfortunately, it was very hot at the moment!
However, the cost of buying these wedding dresses wasn't particularly high for Lin Yi, and after their return to Xiangcheng, the staff from Gezi Bridal Shop would come to Lin Yi's family villa.
It wasn't until that day that they officially took the wedding photos; today was just a simple preview.
Moreover, these clothes weren't very expensive, totaling just tens of thousands at most.
There was a Western-style wedding dress and Chinese-style attire; the makeup artist applied an extremely exquisite makeup for her. The couple together picked out suitable clothes.
They chose several outfits, as they needed to take pictures in various combinations. After selecting, they took them to the changing room.
Upon entering, Lin Yi instantly embraced Han Xuewei, and the makeup artist by their side very tactfully left.
Han Xuewei pushed Lin Yi gently and whispered, "Hey, what are you doing? There are other people here."
Lin Yi whispered in her ear, "The makeup artist has gone out. It's fine, baby, you look so beautiful today!"
Han Xuewei smiled and said, "Am I only beautiful today? Clearly, I've always been like this!"
Lin Yi kissed her, "I think these outfits are all quite suitable. We have plenty of time today; I want to try on all these clothes!"
After hearing this, Han Xuewei said, "Husband, we don't have that much time, do we? We're only here for two days, and once we go back, there's still other stuff to take care of. Plus, you said we have to move into the villa, and mom has already picked the day."
Lin Yi's mother also found a master to calculate the best time for the move, which was set for the 20th. They had to go back at least one or two days in advance to pack everything that needed to be prepared.
Lin Yi said somewhat disappointedly, "We can only do so much. I'll first weed out the ones that aren't quite right and try to photograph all of the rest."
Han Xuewei had no way to object since all of the clothes were purchased by Lin Yi. It would indeed be a pity not to photograph them.
Everyone quickly chose the scenes, and Han Xuewei led them to the park where she had always played as a child, which also housed an open amusement park.
Now, the place was in disarray, totally abandoned, but Han Xuewei's favorite spot as a child was right there. They went to the swing together, ran down the shady path, and sat hand in hand under that big tree...
Afterward, they visited the school where Han Xuewei studied...
As they took their wedding photos, they talked about Han Xuewei's childhood memories, and through this, Lin Yi came to understand Han Xuewei even better.
Because there were many outfits, the photo shoot took about two days. They were both very happy and had high hopes for the final outcome.
On the last day, both families gathered for a grand meal. Lin Yi's parents briefly discussed the children's wedding plans, and then they returned to Xiangcheng before evening.
The day before moving, everyone got busy packing up again, with Lin Yi's main task being to organize all of Han Xuewei's clothes together, as the villa at the new Xingjing Garden was much bigger than here!
Just the walk-in closet alone was twice the size of this one!
So Lin Yi was thinking to himself that after moving, he must buy Han Xuewei several more sets of clothes, at least to ensure the walk-in closet wouldn't look too empty!
Although moving was a happy event, Lin Yi's family decided not to inform other relatives because the wedding was fast approaching, and there was no need to host a banquet for moving.
When the 20th arrived, Lin Yi specially called the moving company, so everything was moved out neatly in half a day, and they spent the remaining half day arranging the new house.

chapters.title: Chapter 131: Chapter 131 Moving House
chapters.content:
Lin Yi also brought the staff of Gezi Bridal to the new villa, and asked the whole family to come over and pick out suitable dresses!
Their selection included wedding gown services, so everyone started choosing a wedding dress for Han Xuewei first, after all, this dress would hold extraordinary significance; the photos taken in this gown were to be hung in the villa!
At that moment, Han Xuewei's mother asked her husband, "Your new restaurant should be ready by now, right? Didn't you say that our daughter's wedding will be held there?"
After hearing this, Han Xuewei's father laughed heartily and said, "After being married for so many years, don't you understand me? You can set your mind at rest about my work. Before we returned to our hometown, everything at the restaurant was completed, and even the post-renovation inspections were finished. Some of the chefs and helpers are acquaintances from back home."
"The property management at the Wenqu Building is indeed good. They didn't charge rent during the renovation period, and Lin Yi's family's renovation company worked tirelessly, often making progress beyond my expectations!"
He thought for a moment, then continued, "Oh, right, there's also another piece of good news I haven't told everyone yet. Wenqu Building offered me an additional floor for rent, which is over a thousand square meters. I gave it some thought and converted that space into private rooms."
"As a restaurant, we must have private rooms no matter what. Although the space is over a thousand square meters, the price the manager offered me is still very low, just sixty thousand a month. It's such a bargain! The rents in the city center are actually lower than other places!"
Han Xuewei's father couldn't contain his inner joy, believing that his luck was exceptionally good to have rented such a great space for a low budget!
He paused for a moment and then excitedly said, "Let's have our dinner there tonight! The whole family will go and taste the dishes! I've given all the instructions already! Everything is ready except for the east wind."
Lin Yi's mother said joyfully, "That sounds wonderful! Let's taste our in-laws' dishes,"
Immediately afterward, she turned her gaze to Lin Yi and asked, "Lin Yi, could the wedding photo studio you mentioned help with the wedding venue as well? Or do your father and I need to prepare anything in advance?"
Lin Yi shook his head and replied, "Mom, it doesn't have to be that complicated. They will take care of everything, from the decoration of the wedding site to the adornment of the vehicle motorcade. They even offer a free full family portrait service. After the wedding ceremony, when it's convenient, we'll take the family portrait on the spot."
After hearing this, Lin Yi's mother was slightly surprised.
"Right, I almost forgot about that. But since we are taking a full family portrait, let's do it now! Then we can showcase it during the wedding ceremony! Let all the relatives and guests have a good look at our three little treasures!"
Lin Yi slapped his forehead as if he had just remembered something: "The hundred-day photoshoot for the kids isn't done yet, so we might as well catch up on that now! Killing two birds with one stone!"
"Let me check the time... It's two-thirty in the afternoon now, we should still have some time, right? I'll call and ask."
It was possible that due to tight scheduling, they might not be available.
Lin Yi hurriedly made a call to inquire, and although the reply he received indicated that there was time available, such a rush job would require additional payment.
Without blinking an eye, Lin Yi immediately promised a fee of twenty thousand yuan and asked them to send their best team.
All three babies were then brought out together.
Han Xuewei also changed into the dress she had picked at Gezi Bridal, as well as the wedding gown and took some photos that exuded a sense of luxury.
All these arrangements were made in tight succession, and the photographer rushed back to edit the pictures after the shoot, finally managing to get them done.
When the next day came, they had to get up early to print, and there was not a moment of rest.
Finally, on the eve of the wedding, all the photographs were successfully delivered into Lin Yi's hands.
When he received the photos, he could even smell the scent of the ink.
Lin Yi also felt quite guilty as he said to Han Xuewei, "Vivi, I'm really sorry, everything feels so hasty and rushed, and much of it is last minute..."
However, Han Xuewei tenderly took Lin Yi's arm, comforting him, "Honey, it's okay, you have already worked so hard! And as your wife, I am very happy! Even if you hadn't prepared all this, I would still marry you willingly!"
After all, for most people, a wedding is just a formality, and true happiness can only be felt by oneself.
Lin Yi looked at the one who was about to walk down the aisle with him with adoration and couldn't help but get teary-eyed.
After that, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei embraced each other tightly!
If this had been in the past, both of them might have felt a little awkward about hugging in front of others, but after such a long period of close contact, their relationship had grown even more like that of a husband and wife!
It must be said that such intimate contact is the foundation of their affection for each other.
And so, their wedding photos and the family portrait were all taken care of.
On the wedding day, Lin Yi felt that the makeup artist of the wedding photo team wasn't as skilled as the staff from Gezi bridal, so he hired the latter to help.
And on that day, Han Xuewei's cousin, Han Xuemei, also arrived; although Han Xuewei hadn't asked her cousin to be a bridesmaid, Han Xuemei came specifically for the excitement. Thus, she followed the other bridesmaids, dressed differently, into Han Xuewei's bedroom.
Han Xuewei didn't really know what to say; after all, it was her cousin. Since she came uninvited, she couldn't snub her cousin's feelings, so now she just let it be!
In fact, throughout the entire wedding, there wasn't much for Han Xuewei to worry about, as everything had been arranged just the way she wanted it.
All she needed to do was adjust her mindset and be a happy bride.
Lin Yi also got up very early today; it seemed the three babies knew it was a special day, and after waking up, they were dancing and full of excitement.
Lin Yi called his cousin early on, asking him to be a groomsman, and also invited his college roommates and close friends.
Enjoy new adventures at mvl
When the group arrived at Lin Yi's villa, they were completely astonished! After all, who had ever seen a villa of over nine hundred square meters?
"I have to say, Lin Yi, who would've thought you'd get a new place for the wedding! Quite the grandeur!"
Yet Lin Yi just smiled faintly and said, "Well, as long as everyone is willing to work hard, there will be bread, and everything is possible."
His cousin Lin Jie was even more surprised, having heard that his cousin's parents' company was starting to decline, but he hadn't expected they could still afford such an expensive villa!

chapters.title: Chapter 132 Looking at Each Other in Bewilderment
chapters.content:
```
Right in the city center!
Lin Jie also remembered that his father had lent a sum of money to his cousin's family, but then he heard that it had all been paid back within a few days. At the time, Lin Jie didn't think much of it, just that Lin Yi's family might have overcome their difficulties. But now, it seemed that they had done more than just that, they had entered the spring of their careers!
Lin Yi had originally planned to arrange for Han Xuewei's wedding at the previous villa, but it was a mess after moving out and hadn't been tidied up yet, so they had to temporarily place it in the hotel.
A group of people, in a grand procession, drove to the Jinguo Hotel owned by Lin Yi, who had also arranged in advance for all of Han Xuewei's relatives to stay there.
The manager of the Jinguo Hotel's lobby, of course, knew that today was the president's big day, so he prepared early in the morning outside the door to welcome the bridal entourage.
Moreover, the evening before, he had made sure to have the hall decorated with festive characters and had been very thoughtful with the decorations!
Lin Yi, witnessing this scene, nodded in approval and smiled at the lobby manager.
The latter, feeling like he had received encouragement, became excited.
He knew that the president had seen his hard work!
It must be said that the bridal entourage was quite sizable, including groomsmen and Lin Yi's friends, as well as quite a few relatives from the Lin Family.
This also included Lin Yi's uncles and aunts, along with other family members.
As for Han Xuewei's dowry, Lin Yi himself transferred the funds to his in-laws, who eventually chose a rather lavish Mercedes-Benz as the dowry vehicle.
Enjoy exclusive chapters from mvl
Lin Yi, holding a bouquet of flowers, arrived excitedly at the door and knocked like a gentleman, saying to the inside, "Vivi! My dear wife! Come home with me!"
The groomsmen nearby started to tease, "Sister-in-law, Brother Lin is here to take you home!"
"Ladies inside, open the door!"
Since the hotel rooms had no windows, they could only start by knocking on the door.
The girls' voices came from inside, "Where's the red envelope? We can't open the door without a red envelope!"
But because the doors of the hotel rooms were quite special with no gap at all, it was difficult to slip in the red envelope.
Lin Jie had a stroke of genius and suddenly shouted, "This won't do, there's no gap at all. Could you please open a crack in the door? However many red envelopes you want, we'll give you!"
No sooner had he spoken than he winked gleefully at the other groomsmen!
He whispered, "As soon as the door opens, we charge!"
The bridesmaids inside, finding no other way, secured the inner chain lock and then opened the door.
This gap could fit quite a few red envelopes at once!
But they were too naive. Although they had secured the chain lock, the groomsmen outside were nearly all strong as bulls. As soon as the door cracked open, everyone rushed in!
The chain lock was virtually useless!
Amidst the whole group of groomsmen, charging the fiercest and at the forefront, naturally, was Lin Jie!
And defending the door inside was Han Xuewei's good friend, Qin Xiaoxu!
The groomsmen outside charged so fiercely that when they burst in, they frightened the bridesmaids into retreating and even knocked some over!
Lin Jie, pushed too strongly by the people behind him, felt something soft in front of him upon entering, as if he were in a girl's embrace!
But by the time he realized what was happening, a hefty slap had landed on his face!
```
"Shameless!"
The slap was resoundingly loud, and the voice of the girl cursing was even clearer!
He looked up and suddenly realized that the person before him was very familiar!
At that moment, Qin Xiaoxu's expression also changed from anger to surprise!
The next second, both of them exclaimed in unison!
"Do not love me, there is no result?!"
"Little bee?!"
Qin Xiaoxu and Lin Jie had dined together after reaching a consensus, so they had met before!
It was the first time Lin Jie had done such a thing, so naturally, he had to personally ensure everything was perfect. It was best for both parties to get acquainted in advance to ensure that when it was time to bring someone home to meet the family, nothing would be amiss!
But now, the two of them had blurted out each other's online names at the same time and their faces revealed shock, which didn't fit in with the scene of the marriage procession at all!
However, everyone else was immersed in the joyous atmosphere, simply walking around the two of them, completely unaware of what had transpired.
Lin Jie hastily pulled Qin Xiaoxu aside and asked in a lowered voice, "What are you doing here?"
Qin Xiaoxu also hurriedly straightened her clothes and replied, "I told you before, I have to be my bestie's bridesmaid today..."
After saying so, the two looked at each other in astonishment!
"You're saying the bride is your bestie?"
"And the groom, Lin Yi, is your cousin?"
At that moment, another bridesmaid rushed over and asked anxiously, "Xiaoxu, are you okay? What happened to you guys?"
After finishing, she looked at them with a puzzled expression.
Qin Xiaoxu quickly stepped back, widening the distance from Lin Jie, and immediately said, "Oh, I'm fine, she just looked familiar so I asked a few more questions..."
The bridesmaid did not say much more, and directly took Qin Xiaoxu to Han Xuewei's side.
Lin Jie's parents, who had just come in from the outside, also saw Qin Xiaoxu and felt this girl looked familiar. Despite having seen many photos of Qin Xiaoxu their son had shared before, they could not immediately recall who she was in this setting.
Besides, with young people using beauty filters and image enhancements on their pictures these days, the resemblance between the photos and the person was not particularly strong. Not recognizing her right away was rather normal.
Lin Yi's parents also anxiously pushed their son to stand beside Lin Yi.
Today's Lin Yi was much more mature than usual, especially when it came to his attire; there was a substantial elevation in his style!
Normally, he preferred casual clothes, but today Lin Yi was dressed in a sharp suit and had a mature and stylish pompadour. This natural-born charisma made him particularly noticeable in the crowd.
He held flowers in one hand and then knelt on one knee before the bride, Han Xuewei, who was wearing a white wedding dress and looking enchantingly lovely.
He declared directly, "Wife! Come home with me!"
With a fan partially covering her face, Han Xuewei giggled shyly and nodded her head.
Lin Yi quickly said to his cousin Lin Jie, "Brother, hand out all the red envelopes we prepared for today! Show some appreciation to Weiwei's bridesmaid group too!"
These red envelopes, which Lin Yi had prepared the night before, had amounts ranging from one hundred at the least to nine hundred at the most; moreover, the groomsmen were carrying a total of ninety-nine red envelopes!

chapters.title: Chapter 133 Distributing Red Envelopes
chapters.content:
Lin Jie hurriedly opened the backpack he was carrying and then took out handfuls of red envelopes, directly handing them over to Qin Xiaoxu.
After receiving the red envelopes, Qin Xiaoxu excitedly said to the bridesmaids, "No need to fight, ha, we'll divide these red envelopes later!"
Every place has its own rules for fetching the bride, and the bridesmaids must divide the red envelopes given by the groom equally.
Then, Qin Xiaoxu changed her tone and said with a smile, "All right, now we need to stand united, ready for a major move! How can we let them take the bride away from her home so easily?"
Lin Yi pleaded with a smile, "Aiya, please don't think like this! Getting married is not easy for me, I beg you all to show mercy!"
After hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu smirked proudly and then said loudly, "The first challenge of today! Bring another big red envelope for each member of our bridesmaid group!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi finally relaxed. It was just money, after all, something that indeed wouldn't stump him!
Immediately after, without even blinking an eye, Lin Yi handed out fifty thousand yuan to each bridesmaid!
Seeing this, Qin Xiaoxu was so surprised she could hardly speak!
She had originally intended to scare Lin Yi a bit, but she really didn't expect him to be so generous! He was indeed willing to spend a fortune to marry Han Xuewei!
And to give an additional fifty thousand to each bridesmaid!
Hurriedly, Qin Xiaoxu said, "Okay, okay, that's enough, the first challenge is passed! But the next one can't be that simple, we have to play some games, right?"
The bridesmaids, seeing Lin Yi's generosity, did not make things difficult for him during the game segment and let him win the games one after the other.
And Han Xuemei, who had been watching from the side the whole time, witnessed everything, making her thoughts even more resolute!
While the groomsmen played the games, she kept trying to find ways to get close to Lin Yi!
However, her out-of-character behavior was noticed by Qin Xiaoxu!
So Qin Xiaoxu began to pay attention to this person!
After all, it was her cousin's big wedding day today; how could this girl keep making physical contact with her cousin's husband?
It was simply devoid of any manners!
And even in other situations, it was not appropriate!
But Lin Yi, who had long seen through that his wife's cousin was not an easy character, had been deliberately avoiding other contacts all along. Now that she was actually taking the initiative to get close to him, Lin Yi was even more repulsed!
Qin Xiaoxu also noticed how Lin Yi was trying his best to stay away from this "green tea" and admired him even more for it!
It seems that her good friend Vivi really chose the right person this time! That meant she wouldn't have to worry too much in the future!
During the games, Lin Jie, as one of the groomsmen, was bound to be deliberately troubled by the bridesmaid group. One of the bridesmaids seemed to have a crush on Lin Jie, so she kept standing with him.
Indeed, Lin Jie was a straight man. Not only did he not feel anything, but he also started flirting with the other girls.
Enjoy new tales from mvl
The observant Qin Xiaoxu noticed this too. Although she seemed indifferent to everything on the surface, in reality, she was very good at reading people and situations. This ability was second to none among those present!
Han Xuewei also noticed that her sister Dong Huijuan was subconsciously getting closer to Lin Jie, which made her jealous!
However, Qin Xiaoxu herself didn't know why she felt inexplicably jealous, but she began to find it unbearable whenever she saw Lin Jie flirting with other girls!
So she went straight to Lin Jie's side, nudged him with her elbow a couple of times, and said, "What are you doing? There's a photographer right there, watch your image!"
Lin Jie responded with a mischievous grin, "We're just pretending to be a couple, why are you starting to boss me around? Could it be, you're jealous seeing me chatting with other girls?"
Qin Xiaoxu's face turned red with anger, and she glared at him fiercely before storming off to the other side!
At this moment, Lin Yi was smoothly taking care of the bride and then went back home with everyone.
Lin Yi's parents and a whole bunch of relatives were waiting in the bridal room!
They had set up the fireworks early and even used hundreds of balloons bursting to replace firecrackers!
Han Xuewei was lifted out of the car by Lin Yi, and the two of them, holding hands, stepped onto the red carpet and walked towards the grand entrance of the mansion!
As the two newlyweds made their way in, flower children scattered petals, balloons popped in celebration, and fireworks continued to sound off.
They entered through the mansion's doors, and the mission to pick up the bride was completely accomplished!
Han Xuemei, Han Xuewei's cousin, also arrived at the wedding chamber, and when she saw the scale of the mansion located in the city center, she couldn't calm her inner excitement!
However, Qin Xiaoxu didn't notice her expression at the time, or else she would have been even more wary of the person right in front of her!
As soon as Han Xuemei got out of the car, she hurried over to Lin Yi's mother to start buttering her up.
Han Xuemei said with a beaming smile, "Auntie, hello, we've met before, I'm Vivi's cousin, Han Xuemei."
Lin Yi's mother responded with a polite smile, "Ah, no wonder you look so familiar!"
After hearing this, Han Xuemei was naturally very happy, not expecting the auntie to remember her, and then she further attempted to ingratiate herself.
But Lin Yi's mother was busy with her son's wedding, so she didn't continue the conversation and simply said to her, "Xue Mei, I'm really busy right now. Please feel free to enjoy yourself at home, and don't be shy."
"I must excuse myself for now as I have to greet the Han family's relatives."
Han Xuewei saw that Lin Yi's mother was busy, so she also aimlessly wandered on her own.
Meanwhile, Lin Jie was being pulled aside by Han Xuewei's sister, Dong Rui, to chat.
Dong Rui and Han Xuewei were roommates and good friends; they both were from the same major.
Dong Rui sat next to Lin Jie and said, "I overheard you discussing the 'chicken-eating' game with the other groomsmen; you seemed quite skilled. I love that game too. Do you have time to team up with me sometime?"
Lin Jie, who was still playing with his phone at the time, absentmindedly replied, "Hmm? I never said I was very good at it, just playing to kill time, really. My skills aren't that great."
Teaming up with someone else to play games? And a girl, at that?
The last thing Lin Jie wanted was to team up with girls; he was convinced that out of ten girls, nine were novices, and besides dragging him down, they were of no use!
If Qin Xiaoxu knew Lin Jie's thoughts at the time, she would have definitely made a big scene!
Lin Jie didn't have time for such trifles, so he joined the others to rest inside the mansion.
Han Xuewei was then taken to the master bedroom, and the whole procession moved over as well.
Actually, according to tradition, accessories and the like could already be taken off; first, because they were cumbersome, and second, for fear of losing them during the toasting.

chapters.title: Chapter 134 Eye-Catching Diamond Ring
chapters.content:
In the center of the bedroom, there was a large table covered in gold and silver jewelry that was as plentiful as the displays in a small jewelry shop.
If Han Xuewei were to wear all of these, she'd probably have trouble walking!
A large part of the jewelry on the table was bought by Lin Yi and his mother, while the rest were gifts from relatives on the Lin Family's side.
Mother Lin hurried over to help, and along with a few relatives, she put on one or two of the best pieces for Han Xuewei, and then gave her a pair of jade bracelets of her own.
Han Xuewei smiled politely and said, "You are too kind, Mom!"
Mother Lin was delighted by her daughter-in-law's address of "Mom" and responded with a smile.
"Oh! From now on, you need to keep a close eye on Lin Yi. The road ahead is long, and I'm counting on you!"
Han Xuemei blushed and nodded, "Yes, I know, Mom."
Only a few pieces of jewelry could be worn at a time, so the rest would have to be kept in a safe. Mother Lin took out a diamond ring she had bought earlier and slipped it onto Han Xuewei's finger.
To the side, Han Xuemei's jaw nearly hit the floor when she saw that diamond ring!
Goodness me!
If I remember correctly, that must be from the "True Love" series of diamond jewelry!
That pink diamond is so iconic!
The entire set of that diamond jewelry must be worth several hundred million! Han Xuewei actually owns a set!
Isn't that just crazy?
Han Xuemei rubbed her eyes again. Although she verbally expressed disbelief, deep down she already knew the answer—the reality was right in front of her!
Everyone around couldn't help but be amazed as well when they saw that the diamond was as big as a pigeon's egg.
The sharp-eyed Qin Xiaoxu also recognized it quickly, "Ah! Vivi! The pink diamond ring you're wearing couldn't possibly be from the True Love collection, could it? That entire set is so expensive! Eight or nine hundred million at least! My goodness!
The more I look, the more it seems like it! Why have I never heard you mention this before?? You guys are really rich, aren't you?!"
Qin Xiaoxu, who had been using Han Xuewei's VIP card at the beauty salon, had always felt a bit embarrassed, but when she saw the pigeon egg-sized diamond ring on Han Xuewei's finger, from the most expensive series no less, it felt like her entire worldview had been flipped on its head.
Han Xuewei just smiled and explained, "Right after I gave birth to the baby, Lin Yi gave me a set, and this villa was his wedding gift to me, as our marital home."
After hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu's voice rose a few decibels, "Vivi! I've never heard you talk about this before!! You've kept it so well hidden! And this villa is about four or five times the size of the previous one, right? And it's in the city center! It must be worth a few hundred million at least, right??
Oh my goodness! Lin Yi spoils his wife too much, giving you so much!! He must be very wealthy!!"
Han Xuewei made a shushing gesture, signaling her to keep her voice down.
But, walls have ears, and their entire conversation was heard loud and clear by Han Xuemei!
Han Xuemei knew her cousin-in-law's family was wealthy, but she hadn't imagined they were this extravagant!
Just for having a child, her cousin had been given so much? The total value must be over ten billion!
And that's not even including the bride price!
She had heard that apart from the bride price, her cousin's husband had also given twenty million to her cousin's parents as just spending money!
To say I'm not jealous, that would be a lie!
Han Xuemei thought about it, her current situation was really not optimistic. She must figure out as soon as possible what Lin Yi liked, and use that as an opportunity to slowly get closer to him and gradually make her move!
At this point, Han Xuemei was almost at the brink of insanity! Every day all she could think about was how to latch onto Lin Yi, the rich guy!
She was truly determined, eyeing her cousin's photos! Such people would really stop at nothing to achieve their goals, not hesitating to do things that would completely shatter moral standards!
Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu were happily chatting when Lin Yi and his group of groomsmen brought in the glutinous rice balls.
This was a custom in their hometown. During a wedding, everyone had to drink glutinous rice ball soup together, symbolizing happiness and reunion.
However, two bowls were brought in, one with raw rice balls and one with cooked.
The aunty took a raw rice ball from one of the bowls and fed it to Han Xuewei, asking loudly with a laugh, "Is it raw?"
Han Xuewei had heard of this custom before, so she could only smile and say, "Raw."
The crowd started to cheer and shout, "Raw! More to come!"
Everybody laughed when they saw this.
Relatives from both sides grew more familiar with each other due to today's wedding, and the groomsmen kept egging them on, "You have to have a second child in the future! Assemble a basketball team!" Explore more at мѵʟ
Lin Yi said, "Alright, alright, stop saying such things!"
Mother Lin was also smiling by the side, asking everyone not to continue egging them on. She knew her daughter-in-law was too shy to take such jokes that could not be made too often.
She took the other bowl of glutinous rice balls and came over to Han Xuewei, "Come on, let's eat together."
And so, Mother Lin and Han Xuewei fed each other, following the tradition.
Seeing that Han Xuewei was wearing a lot of gold and silver jewelry, Lin Yi whispered in her ear, "Wife, isn't this jewelry kind of heavy? If it's uncomfortable, you can put it in the safe. Wearing just a ring should be enough."
At first, Han Xuewei had the same thought, but the jewelry had all been personally put on her by her mother-in-law, and what she wore today represented the Lin Family and maintained their reputation.
So, for the sake of her in-laws' face, she figured it was okay to suffer a little.
If she really just wore a single ring to the ceremony, the relatives might think the in-laws were stingy and unwilling to buy more!
Han Xuewei certainly didn't want such unpleasant incidents to occur. After all, a wedding should be a joyous occasion, and such an important day had to be perfect. A bit of physical hardship was fine as long as she felt happy inside.
It had to be said that Han Xuewei was quite a traditional bride, perhaps a result of the education she had received since childhood!
Seeing her husband's concern, she smiled and replied, "It's fine, not that heavy. Don't worry, husband."
Han Xuewei planned to wear all the jewelry for the time being at the wedding ceremony, and then take it all off when it was time for the toast. If possible, she hoped to bring the safe to the venue because the environment there was bound to be complicated.
Lin Yi could easily tell what Han Xuewei was thinking and comforted her, "You don't need to worry about anything. Once we get to the wedding venue, the security company will also be present, and they will protect all our valuable items throughout. They will also have a portable safe. So all you need to do is relax and be the beautiful bride!"
After hearing this, Han Xuewei looked at Lin Yi with eyes full of admiration and surprise, exclaiming, "Wow! Husband! You even know what I am thinking right now! You really understand me so well!"

chapters.title: Chapter 135: Chapter 135 Stirring up trouble
chapters.content:
Lin Yi laughed, then directly pulled Han Xuewei into his arms, "Hahaha, that's for sure, we are husband and wife! Living with you for so long, I know what you're thinking."
The next second, they hugged each other tightly, and the other guests tactfully left the room, giving the couple plenty of space.
Han Xuemei saw their intimate interaction and couldn't help but clench her teeth in anger, "Hmph, as long as I'm here, I won't let you two have a happy ending!"
At that moment, Lin Yi also inadvertently caught a glimpse of Han Xuemei's expression and couldn't help but frown slightly!
What is she planning to do?
Since picking up the bride today, Lin Yi had seen Han Xuemei make that strange expression more than once, as if she was begrudging and somewhat jealous. He really couldn't figure out what Han Xuemei was up to.
But in both fairness and reason, Han Xuewei was her cousin, and Lin Yi couldn't understand what she could possibly do.
However, there's a saying that goes, "It's always good to be cautious."
Lin Yi became even more determined to be wary of her.
The photographer also expressed a hope that the bride and groom would go to the garden downstairs to take a set of photos, as he was a professional and had to dutifully follow each scene!
The entire photography team was all-encompassing, not missing any angle, and having almost finished with the indoor shots, it was time to change to outdoor scenes.
His villa's exterior was also very spacious, so they took quite a few photos there, probably for about half an hour, until Aunt Wang came running over to Han Xuewei and whispered, "The babies are hungry, are you still breastfeeding today?"
Han Xuewei immediately replied, "Mhm, I know, I'll go right now."
Then she leaned closer to Lin Yi's ear and said, "Lin Yi, it's time for nursing, the children are hungry."
After she mentioned it, Lin Yi remembered that it had been quite a while since the babies had been fed, and that he'd have to take good care of them soon.
If the babies could walk, he would definitely have them be the flower children at the wedding!
Thinking about it made him smile contentedly, as he indulged in dreams of a wonderful future life.
The bridesmaids and groomsmen heard this and began to tease, "Wow, a shotgun wedding! Lin Yi, I want to be like you, marrying a rich and beautiful woman and becoming a winner in life! Driving luxury cars, living in mansions, it's just so enviable!"
"Can you share with us how you pursued the school belle?"
"What's there to share? When you've got it all, the rich and beautiful naturally come to you!"
Lin Yi always smiled without a word, but Qin Xiaoxu, upon hearing this, spoke up in defense, "Our Vivi didn't care about what cars or houses he had. She and Lin Yi are truly in love. Besides, Vivi's family conditions are not bad either, she's been living in a villa since she was young.
And Lin Yi is quite outstanding himself; after they got married, he gave Vivi so many gifts, and all under Vivi's name! I'm afraid not many men could do that!"
Qin Xiaoxu's words were straightforward; Han Xuewei's conditions were also great, so dating was not about cars or houses; finding the right person was what mattered most!
Love, after all, is about both parties giving, and the fact that Lin Yi was willing to buy this and that for Han Xuewei was enough to show his love for her.
After these words, everyone fell silent.
Unexpectedly, Lin Jie suddenly stood up, his face full of pride, "Miss Qin flatters us. But need we say more? Every man in the Lin Family is good to his wife and is a great family man from the Gu Family!"
Lin Jie was talking, seemingly unaware that Qin Xiaoxu was staring at him.
Originally, Qin Xiaoxu had a poor opinion of Lin Jie finding someone to pretend to be his girlfriend in order to deceive his parents, and she even thought it was just a gimmick since she had never heard of anyone being rushed to marry before graduating from university.
However, when she learned Lin Yi was the other's older cousin, she finally understood; maybe Lin Jie's parents saw someone else's son getting a wife and children all at once and were a bit envious!
Generally speaking, parents at that age are at their happiest with little children around.
But just then, Han Xuewei's roommate, Dong Rui, picked up the thread of conversation, her voice full of laughter, "Oh? Really? Saying it yourself doesn't count, you only know once you date…"
After hearing that, Lin Jie felt a sense of impending doom and hurriedly ran off, "Um, I need to go to the restroom…"
And with that, he left Dong Rui standing there, who then shouted angrily.
"Lin Jie! Why are you running? Stop right there!"
This scene amused everyone present, and they burst into hearty laughter, "Hahaha, Lin Yi, who would've thought your cousin is so popular!"
"Even has girls chasing after him, so envious."
"Miss, I'm quite nice too, can we spend some time together?"

But Dong Rui seemed indifferent, merely replying half-heartedly, "Sorry, I'm not interested in you, and we're not familiar."
Old Niu laughed and said, "Hehe, unfamiliarity can be resolved by getting to know each other! Spend some time, and the interest will follow!"
Dong Rui blushed and cursed, "Get to know your big-headed ghost!"
After saying that, she ran off without looking back, clearly regarding Old Niu as some kind of rogue!
Old Niu, however, looked wronged as he shrugged his shoulders, "I don't think I said anything wrong… Interest can be cultivated slowly, and without getting to know each other, how does one have a chance?"
The other buddies laughed and patted his shoulder, saying, "Haha, don't worry, it's not your fault, she's just too conservative. Right?"
Then, they took another look at Old Niu's crotch, but he quickly covered up, "What are you looking at? Am I that kind of person? What's with girls these days?"
Qiu Zhenhua said with a laugh, "Hahaha, they see you as a naive youngster untouched by the world, and you did look a bit creepy just now as if you've never dated."
Old Niu truly felt aggrieved as he said, "I've never dated, but I'm not creepy at all! I swear, other than my family, I've never had physical contact with any other girls! Haven't even touched hands!"
Upon hearing this, his good buddies started to tease him, "Ah, I never realized our Old Niu was such a good boy! How about we help you find a girl so you can also try what it feels like to hold hands?"
After hearing this, Old Niu started to squirm, "It's not that easy to find someone, I still want to find a girl who truly loves me in the future!"
He had actually considered casually finding a girl to try it out, just to experience what dating felt like, but his upbringing didn't allow him to treat love so lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 136 Conversation between Lin Jie and His Mother
chapters.content:
Qiang Hengxuan laughed and said, "Then you just stick to your bottom line or I'm really afraid you won't be able to control yourself in the future!"
His words once again provoked a round of hearty laughter from everyone!
Lin Yi hurriedly asked everyone to drop the topic, "Okay, okay, let's not keep making fun of the old cow. You guys are not any better, daring to bully the old cow? Besides, isn't there someone among you who has remained single from the womb till now, just like the old cow? How can you laugh at someone else's plight when you're in the same boat?"
Upon hearing this, Qiang Hengxuan quickly shook his head and said, "Who is Lin Yi talking about? Definitely not me!"
Then, he looked at Qiu Zhenhua in shock and said, "Qiu Zhenhua! It cannot be you, right? You've kept it really deep! Normally, you speak as if you have a wealth of experience when sharing with us buds – we thought you were seasoned in such matters. Turns out you're just like the old cow!"
Before Qiu Zhenhua could explain, Lin Yi quickly gestured, "Alright, I'm going to check on the baby. Let's not make too much noise; we could startle the bridesmaids with all this loud talking."
After Lin Yi had finished speaking, the groomsmen finally shifted their attention to the bridesmaids present.
Lin Yi wanted to join his wife in feeding the baby.
And Han Xuemei quietly followed the two of them to the bedroom, planning to also take a look at the baby.
For her, there was nothing else of concern at the moment. Her main mission was to ensure Lin Yi was left with a deep impression of her!
However, Qin Xiaoxu noticed Han Xuemei quietly following behind the couple, and something about Xuemei's demeanor seemed off, which gave Qin Xiaoxu a jolt.
It seemed Han Xuemei was really not as simple as she appeared!
Qin Xiaoxu felt like she should intervene, as this was about her close friend's significant life decision!
So Qin Xiaoxu told the bridesmaids she was going to check on the three babies and then silently followed Han Xuemei.
But just then, Qin Xiaoxu's phone vibrated!
Lin Jie was calling her!
As soon as she answered, Lin Jie, on the other end of the call, anxiously said, "Qin Xiaoxu, my parents just said you look a lot like the girl in the picture, but they didn't dare to ask you directly. Anyway, we will have to introduce you to them eventually, so you might as well admit it today! Otherwise, Dong Rui will keep harassing me!"
Qin Xiaoxu replied in a laid-back manner, "Oh, who was it that just claimed to be a good man? What kind of good man randomly finds someone to pretend to be his girlfriend and deceive his own parents? And since Dong Rui likes you, isn't that perfect? Just take her to meet your parents!"
Lin Jie fell silent for a while, momentarily at a loss for words.
At this moment, Qin Xiaoxu had just turned a corner when he saw Lin Jie's mom heading towards Lin Jie.
Qin Xiaoxu hurriedly hung up the phone and then heard the conversation between the two.
"Lin Jie, tell me the truth, is that bridesmaid your cousin hired actually your girlfriend? Your dad and I looked for quite a while, and the more we looked, the more we thought she looked like her, but we were too embarrassed to ask."
As she spoke, Lin Jie's mom opened her phone's photo album and, while looking, said, "The hairstyle is exactly the same, and even the color is identical. The only difference is the lack of glasses, and there's something slightly different about the chin. Lin Jie, you have to tell the truth, is it or isn't it?"
Lin Jie didn't rush to answer the question but was anxiously messaging on his phone, it seemed like it was to Qin Xiaoxu.
Seeing her son seriously looking at his phone, Lin Jie's mom gave him a nudge, "Lin Jie, who are you messaging? Didn't you hear your mom talking to you? How can you be so impolite!" Read latest stories on мѵʟ
Lin Jie was also getting very impatient, but he patiently explained to his mom, "Mom, can you not disturb me, I'm in the middle of texting my girlfriend right now! Can't you wait until I'm done?"
After hearing this, Lin Jie's mom became very interested and leaned in closer, "Eh? Why didn't you say so earlier? Let your mom have a look at what you're chatting about. Send her a photo of our family portrait, you never know, we might bump into her in the future!"
Lin Jie shrugged his shoulders and said with a look of speechlessness, "How could we possibly bump into her? Your and dad's old-fashioned taste in shopping definitely doesn't match with hers!"
Lin Jie's mom got annoyed and smacked him on the forehead, saying, "You little rascal, since when have I been old-fashioned? Back in the day, I shopped at all the big malls across the city, and I never skimped on trendy brands!"
Lin Jie then said with a feeling of injustice, "No, Mom, I haven't known her for very long, and you guys are already eager to meet her. The girl is shy and easily scared off."
Seeing his mom lost in thought, Lin Jie became even more serious.
After thinking it over, Lin Jie's mom finally nodded and said, "You really are more thoughtful. We indeed rushed things. You two have just started to get to know each other and need more time to invest in your feelings. It indeed isn't time for a meeting yet!"
Following up on his mom's words, Lin Jie continued, "Exactly, you finally understand. Dating is like building a house; the preliminary stage is all about laying a solid foundation. We can't just confirm a relationship and then bring her home to meet the parents, right?
The girls nowadays are not like they used to be, they have a lot on their minds, and I still haven't figured out if her feelings for me are genuine..."
Lin Jie's mom sighed sentimentally, "Ah, the thoughts of young people these days, I really don't get it. My son isn't half bad either, handsome and all, shouldn't be without a girlfriend, right?" She glanced at Lin Jie and said, "You little rascal, you didn't upset the girl, did you?"
Lin Jie's tone became even more aggrieved, "No, Mom, I send her a red envelope every day, there's no way she's upset!"
Without another word, Lin Jie's mom slapped the back of his head and said, "I knew it! These days, girls want romance in a relationship! You think a single red envelope can make her happy? It's not about the money, she needs your care! If it's like you say, that would just attract gold diggers. Dating isn't like that; it should be with the goal of marriage in mind.
Of course, old mom here hopes you find a good woman, like me, who knows how to manage a household, with the right values! Of course, character is also a priority! You must consider this, understand?"
Lin Jie rubbed his head innocently and slowly said, "Alright, Mom, I understand everything you're saying. If you hit me again, what if I become stupid? Aren't you afraid I won't be able to find a wife in the future?"
Lin Jie's mom huffed and said in an irritated tone, "You don't know how to cherish the girl at all, hmph. Today, you're going to give your girlfriend a little surprise, cheer her up, and you must make sure she receives it! I want to see the payment information later, as well as the delivery confirmation. Not a single detail less, got it?
You stinker, don't you know how to put some effort into a relationship."

chapters.title: Chapter 137: Chapter 137 Too Thick-Skinned
chapters.content:
Lin Jie's mother didn't want to pressure her son, but she and Lin Jie's father were eager to hold a grandson soon!
So when they saw Qin Xiaoxu's photo, they were very impressed and thought she looked quite nice, definitely the pure and innocent type. They couldn't help but give a nod of approval to Lin Jie's taste.
The reason Lin Jie chose Qin Xiaoxu from many "applicants" was that he knew very well what kind of girl would please his parents. As soon as he saw Qin Xiaoxu's photo and contacted her for a detailed discussion, he had already decided on her!
Therefore, no matter what, he had to get through this by leveraging Qin Xiaoxu, because he couldn't afford to have his allowance cut off!
But coincidentally, just at that moment, Dong Rui appeared before the two of them. Continue your journey with мѵʟ
While Lin Jie's mother was still scolding her son, Dong Rui came over with a smile and greeted, "Auntie, Lin Jie, hello."
Lin Jie's mother looked at Dong Rui with a puzzled expression, then turned her gaze to her son, watching him quickly typing away, her face growing even more perplexed!
She directly asked, "And you are...?"
Dong Rui, very considerate, moved to Lin Jie's side and took his arm, saying, "Auntie, I'm Lin Jie's... good friend."
This scene also made Qin Xiaoxu, who was in the corner, stunned and she couldn't help but sigh to herself, "My goodness, Dong Rui is too persistent! It's clear Lin Jie has already rejected her, yet she's still clinging to him! That's just shameless!"
After hearing this, Lin Jie's mother's expression changed instantly, seemingly mixed with slight anger, and she asked in a demanding tone, "Lin Jie, don't you think you owe an explanation?"
At this moment, Lin Jie was truly frightened by Dong Rui's action; his mother always despised those who were not serious about relationships and two-timed. Now that she had seen a photo of his girlfriend, this girl obviously seemed unfamiliar. If his mother thought he had cheated or found another woman, she'd never forgive him!
The next second, Lin Jie quickly shook her off and moved next to his mother, saying, "No, Mom, listen to me explain. This girl is my cousin's roommate; we've just met, and I don't even know her name!"
Upon hearing this, Dong Rui's expression immediately dimmed, "Huh? How could you do this? I already told you, my name is Dong Rui!"
Lin Jie's mother also hurriedly said, "Girl, didn't Lin Jie tell you that he isn't single?"
After hearing this, Dong Rui was taken aback, and said awkwardly, "Ah, I... why didn't you say so? How annoying!"
After dropping that remark, she turned on her heels and stormed off!
Seeing this, Lin Jie's mother also directly grabbed his ear!
"You little rascal, why didn't you tell her? Are you still looking to flirt around outside?"
Lin Jie, in pain, quickly begged for mercy, "Ow! Mom! Let go! It hurts!! I didn't know what that girl was up to; she just kept badgering me and wanted me to take her to play a game!"
When Qin Xiaoxu saw how pitifully Lin Jie was being scolded, she couldn't help but snicker to herself!
It seemed that Lin Jie's mother held very upright values and also instilled in Lin Jie a good sense of reason.
After all, in this day and age, there are all kinds of elders out there. Some parents, proud of their charming and handsome sons, even see it as an honor to have their sons dating multiple girlfriends!
This is truly a case of skewed values!
