Only upon hearing her son yelp in pain did she let go of his ear. In truth, she understood her son very well; putting it bluntly, he was indeed a stereotypical straight guy! He didn't worry about dating or put any thought into it, which was exactly why she and Lin Jie's father started urging him.
Now that her son had finally found someone, it was a cause for immense celebration! So, she chose to believe Lin Jie's words. Besides, her son really wasn't capable of such actions.
"In any case, you must be honest no matter what, don't make a mess like other people. The Lin Family has never had any scandals, and if you dare to step out of line, don't ever think of stepping through the Lin Family's door again! Plus, you won't get a penny of the inheritance!"
Lin Jie felt very wronged as he said, "Alright, Mom, I get it."
Seeing her son's attitude was not bad, Lin Jie's mom finally went about her own business.
With his mom finally gone, Lin Jie then rubbed his red ear and couldn't help but mutter, "Such bad luck today, to get a scolding like this!"
Upon seeing this, Qin Xiaoxu felt that his family's house rules were indeed quite good!
And it seemed Lin Jie was a bit afraid of his mom!
However, Qin Xiaoxu had one doubt. If he was so afraid of his mom, why would he think of getting a fake girlfriend to deceive her?
Lin Jie picked up his phone again and resumed sending messages.
Qin Xiaoxu didn't approach him. Instead, he took a detour to Han Xuewei's room.
It wasn't much later that Xiaoxu's phone started vibrating.
When she looked, it was indeed a WeChat message from Lin Jie.
"I haven't had any desire to date these past few years, nor do I want to waste time on it. But my parents insist that I find a girlfriend, or else I won't get any pocket money in the future! However, ever since I told them you were my girlfriend, they ended up giving me the apartment and even multiplied my monthly living expenses several times. Plus, that apartment is specifically for us to cohabit!"
Qin Xiaoxu hurriedly replied, "What? Cohabit? Am I supposed to pretend to live together with you? I would never do such a thing! What if you have some ill intentions toward me, then what?"
Lin Jie went silent upon seeing Qin Xiaoxu's message. A moment later, he replied, "This... I really hadn't thought that much. Let's not talk about it for now; let's see how it goes when the time comes! Anyway, we're just in the preliminary stage of our relationship, we can't think about that much, and cohabitation is at least a year away! Besides, by then we can totally put on a breakup act!
So, you don't need to worry about the cohabitation thing!"
Qin Xiaoxu cut him off with a definitive reply, "Jerk!"
Lin Jie was quite speechless when he saw those three words and sent back a questioning emoticon, "Huh? How did I become a jerk? All the men in the Lin Family are good men. If I didn't find dating to be such a hassle, with my looks, getting a girlfriend would take mere minutes! But right now, I just don't want to date or lead any girl on."
After reading the message, Qin Xiaoxu did have some thoughts. He was right; with looks, Lin Jie was indeed handsome, and despite Dong Rui being so proactive just now, Lin Jie seemed completely uninterested.
You had to admit, he did have his principles.
Sigh, this time she would help him out. It wasn't a bad thing after all.

chapters.title: Chapter 138: Chapter 138 Too Nervous
chapters.content:
Qin Xiaoxu had no choice but to change the subject, "So do your parents give you a lot of money for living expenses each month..."
Lin Jie directly transferred 888 to Qin Xiaoxu, saying, "Don't worry, your share will definitely not be short!"
Qin Xiaoxu clicked to receive the transfer and replied with a sneaky grin emoticon, "Hehe, pretty sensible."
Not only did this help him, but it also earned him some extra cash, which he thought was not bad!
It wasn't easy for Lin Jie to soothe Qin Xiaoxu's mood, and he finally felt relieved. His parents had not skimped on looking at Qin Xiaoxu's pictures, so now he couldn't switch out for someone else, or else his mom would definitely scold him!
After sending the message, Lin Jie started playing mobile games.
Now that he was free, and with nothing else to do, he decided to just play a couple of rounds.
Just then, Qiang Hengxuan came to find him, "Why are you staying in this place? Come on, let's go find Lin Yi and have some fun together."
Lin Jie had just opened the game and said, "I just started this game. You wait by the window and enjoy the view first; the river scenery is really something to behold."
The villa in the city center where Lin Yi lived was right next to the river, and because the move was so rushed, Lin Yi and his family hadn't had the time to enjoy it.
Qiang Hengxuan also plopped down next to him and said, "What game are you playing? Let's play together; my jungling is super strong!"
Lin Jie laughed and said, "Haha, I am the true jungle king! Is there anyone who jungles better than me?"
Qiang Hengxuan looked at him with a peculiar gaze and said, "No wonder you're still single. How come you're hiding here playing by yourself? There are plenty of girls outside; isn't it better to play with them?"
Lin Jie looked up at Dong Rui and shook his head repeatedly, "What's so fun about that? Women will only slow down the speed of my sword drawing! It will make me lose ranks!"
Qiang Hengxuan, after hearing his remark, clicked his tongue in amazement and then said, "Wow, if you don't play games with girls, you'll lose a lot of fun! You can build a good relationship with girls, you know? They might be impressed by your skills and even start a romance on the side!"
Lin Jie also disdainfully replied, "Well, according to what you're saying, you should have a girlfriend too, right? But here you are, still single!"
Qiang Hengxuan was suddenly at a loss for words and huffed, "Alright, alright, I won't argue with you on this. I'm heading outside..."
With that, he turned and walked out.
Lin Jie just smiled and didn't say anything.
While playing the game halfway, he pulled up a pop-up window and sent a WeChat message to Qin Xiaoxu, "What are you doing? Do you want to play the game together?"
He seemed to guess that Qin Xiaoxu was also idle at the moment, so he thought about inviting her to play together to pass the time.
However, at this time, Qin Xiaoxu was busy looking after three babies. She heard the message notification sound, but she didn't have time to check it.
The three little ones had just finished their milk and were now in high spirits.
Moreover, ever since they were born, they had never experienced such a lively scene, seeing dozens of new faces every hour.
The babies kept talking today, not forgetting to wave their arms and dance.
Qin Xiaoxu laughed heartily at this spectacle and playfully asked, "You little cuties, do you think it's pretty?"
The biggest baby in her arms, entertained by Qin Xiaoxu's antics, laughed along while swinging his little hands as though he had already given the answer.
Pleased with herself, Qin Xiaoxu turned to Han Xuewei next to her and said, "Vivi, your baby also says I'm pretty!"
Han Xuewei looked at her vanity and couldn't help but laugh, "Look at how childish you're being, so vain."
"Oh, why didn't I realize before, baby is actually this cute! I should have more in the future too!"
Han Xuewei laughed again, "Having babies isn't something one person can do, you have to find someone willing to have them with you!"
Qin Xiaoxu pursed her lips and said, "Maybe one day happiness will come my way too, and then I'll have a whirlwind marriage and baby!"
Han Xuewei continued, "Xiaoxu, you're usually so carefree, but I can be sure of one thing—you'll definitely be more conservative when it comes to love."
Qin Xiaoxu shook her head and said, "I can't be certain, nothing is absolute after all. Maybe one day I'll also meet someone worth going crazy for, just like you met Lin Yi."
Hearing her best friend say this, Qin Xiaoxu's face turned red, "Alright, alright, let's not talk about this anymore, there are other people listening."
Qin Xiaoxu continued to play with the babies.
Han Xuewei checked her phone for a while, then sent Lin Yi a message on WeChat: "Hubby, where are you?"
Lin Yi replied immediately: "I was chatting with a few relatives, wife, are you missing me?"
Lin Yi had planned to come over to feed the baby, but the relatives who came today were so enthusiastic, each one of them wanting to talk more with Lin Yi!
Han Xuewei was also tied up on her end, some relatives were there for the first time to see the triplets, and since triplets are rare, everyone was quite curious.
Han Xuewei saw the message and smiled, then after thinking, she replied: "Missing you, I miss my hubby!"
Seeing this message, Lin Yi grinned, feeling a rush of joy, then he hurried over to find Han Xuewei.
After all, it was the first time for the couple to express their longing for each other.
Lin Yi rushed to the bedroom, and as soon as he entered, he saw the bridesmaids and a few other girls watching the babies!
Some were taking pictures with the triplets, some were playing with them, everyone's attention was on the children, but Han Xuewei seemed to be an exception, as she was staring at her phone with a silly smile.
Lin Yi quietly moved behind her and wrapped his arms around her. Today was their big day, so they could openly embrace and kiss.
The bridesmaids and the other girls in the room, seeing Lin Yi and Han Xuewei hugging, whispered to each other, "I think we should go outside, right? It's not nice to be a third wheel! It seems the couple needs some mushy time together."
"Can we take the three babies outside with us? They just had their milk, they need to digest it first!"
Qin Xiaoxu also expressed her agreement.
Right after that, she and the other girls took the babies outside.
With that, only Lin Yi and Han Xuewei were left in the room.
And as Qin Xiaoxu left, she closed the door behind them,
As soon as the door closed, it left Han Xuemei outside.
She looked at the affectionate pair, and her gaze turned much colder, her fists clenching involuntarily!
The moment Qin Xiaoxu closed the door behind her, she turned around and caught Han Xuemei's chilling expression!

chapters.title: Chapter 139: Chapter 139 Who Dares Call Me Inexperienced
chapters.content:
She furrowed her brows, "What's the deal with this person? It's like she has a deep-seated grudge against Vivi! I can always see the resentment in her eyes!! Could there be some connection with Lin Yi? This woman needs to be watched!"
Qin Xiaoxu just couldn't figure out what was going on because Vivi hardly ever talked about her family, and she had never mentioned her cousin!
Actually, this had little to do with Han Xuewei, since Han Xuewei herself rarely interacted with her cousin. And the two girls had quite different personalities, such as Han Xuewei who studied fine arts, and her cousin who studied dance; one was calm, the other lively, and they usually had nothing in common to talk about.
They only met at family gatherings, where Han Xuemei was always very lively, whereas her cousin Han Xuewei was demure and restrained, totally not from the same world.
Lin Yi glanced at the closed door, thought it was not safe enough, then stepped forward and locked it.
He walked over to Han Xuewei, hugged her, and kissed her forehead, asking with great concern, "Baby, why do you seem a little anxious?"
Lin Yi was sure that Han Xuewei was worried about something.
Han Xuewei leaned her head against Lin Yi's chest, and after a moment, she slowly spoke, "Hubby, I am indeed a bit anxious today... but I don't know why, maybe I'm just too nervous?"
Han Xuewei was so anxious that she wanted Lin Yi to stay with her.
Lin Yi smiled, took Han Xuewei into his arms with calm, and said, "Silly girl, what's there to be anxious about? Your husband is with you!"
Han Xuewei looked up at him and said, "Maybe it's because... today is our wedding... so I just..."
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi simply laughed. He was helpless; what could he do if his wife was so easily nervous? But he rather liked Han Xuewei's serene and gracious character.
Thinking this, he left another kiss on Han Xuewei's forehead.
Meanwhile, outside the door, seeing Han Xuemei storm off, Qin Xiaoxu paid her no mind, because she still had to entertain the baby!
Lin Yi's mother and mother-in-law passed by and couldn't help but ask in confusion, "Why is everyone standing outside? Shouldn't you be inside the room?"
Qin Xiaoxu quickly said, "Auntie, Lin Yi and Vivi are being lovey-dovey inside the room. We wanted to play with the baby, so we brought them out with us. We can't be the third wheel, after all!"
Only then did Lin Yi's mother and mother-in-law realize what was going on, and they came over and said, "Then just hand the baby to us, it's almost nap time. They woke up early today and haven't slept yet, and since we're free now, we'll lull the babies to sleep. You guys have fun here, no need to be shy, and remember the time in the afternoon for the banquet!"
And so, Qin Xiaoxu handed the baby to the two aunts, and then led the bridesmaids to the living room to have fun, planning to sit together to chat, and then eat some fruit and snacks.
At this time, Qin Xiaoxu finally had the chance to check her unread messages.
Upon careful inspection, she noticed that several unread messages were all sent by Lin Jie.
"What are you up to? Want to log on? I can take you for a couple of rounds and kill some time."
"No way, you've played six thousand rounds and your rank is still so low? Haven't reached King rank yet?"
"That's just pathetic! Too weak!"
"Just call me big brother, and I'll think about carrying you! I'm known as the King of the Jungle in all of Xiangcheng!"
"How come you're playing hard to get now? I'll definitely get you to King rank within a day! Hurry up and log on!"
When Qin Xiaoxu saw his messages about playing six thousand rounds with such a low rank, still not reaching King rank, she was infuriated!
But... after playing for so long, it had always been her teammates who failed! She had never let anyone down!
More importantly, she had been playing solo all along and didn't really like teaming up with others or, shall we say, having someone "carry" her!
What skill level was this Lin Jie, anyway?
To dare speak of her like that??
He could mock her for not being of a high enough rank, for not being a King, but he simply couldn't ridicule her for lack of skill! She wouldn't accept it!
Damn it! This was utterly intolerable!
Qin Xiaoxu checked the time and realized the message had come two minutes ago, then hastily replied, "Who do you think you're looking down on? Just wait, I'll show you my strength right now! Logging on!"
But to her surprise, Lin Jie replied, "Ah, I'm really sorry, I've already started another game."
However, he continued, "Wait a moment, I'll restart for you, just wait a moment!"
Qin Xiaoxu was now completely clouded by annoyance and anger, incessantly muttering to herself, "Today, I'm going to show you just how strong my mage is!"
A thousand MVPS aren't for nothing!
By the time Qin Xiaoxu logged into the game, Lin Jie had already restarted. When she saw Lin Jie's ID, her dissatisfaction surged.
Dare to call me a noob?
Today I really want to see just how wild this "King of the Jungle" can be!
Qin Xiaoxu immediately created a room and pulled Lin Jie in!
Qin Xiaoxu turned on the team voice chat, "Lin Jie, where are you?"
Lin Jie scratched his head and said casually, "I'm just in the east corridor on the first floor, why?"
Qin Xiaoxu shouted angrily, "Stay there! I'm coming over!"
Qin Xiaoxu simply wanted to confront Lin Jie face to face and scold him a couple of times, as that would be more satisfying!
But the young lady really miscalculated today! She had vastly underestimated Lin Jie!
Lin Jie's skill level in Kings was indeed not ordinary; from his freshman year to now, he had always been the powerhouse of the entire dorm. Moreover, he had single-handedly "carried" his entire dorm! In their dorm squad, Lin Jie often played the jungler role and was undoubtedly the captain!
Even average girls would likely be impressed by his skills!
Qin Xiaoxu directly approached Lin Jie, who was leisurely sitting in a chair, and since there were no other chairs around, she simply kicked him out of his seat.
Lin Jie pursed his lips and said, "You're really overbearing! What kind of girl acts like you? Aren't you afraid you'll never get married?"
Qin Xiaoxu replied dismissively, "Psh, that's none of your business!"
Lin Jie could see that Qin Xiaoxu was somewhat angry, but since he didn't know what was up, he just kept his mouth shut and stayed silent.
Better not to provoke this woman and have her take her anger out on him!
When this woman got angry, it was indeed frightening. One could never be sure she wouldn't resort to physical violence! Better not provoke her, not worth the risk!

chapters.title: Chapter 140 Jungling Brother
chapters.content:
Lin Jie had reached the rank of King with 4 stars; he usually didn't spend too much time on games, playing only occasionally in his spare time, and he preferred PC games over mobile ones.
Qin Xiaoxu clicked to start the game immediately and soon matched with teammates. Lin Jie was assigned to the first slot, while Qin Xiaoxu was in the third.
As soon as she entered, she said to Lin Jie, "I want the mage role! You have to snatch it for me! Got it? Aside from mage, I'm really not good at other roles."
Lin Jie glanced at her sideways, "Yeah, I got it!"
After the heroes were banned, someone unexpectedly pre-selected a middle lane mage. Lin Jie glanced at Qin Xiaoxu's reaction to see her hands on her hips, cursing, "My luck is so bad today, someone stole my role right at the start. Fine, whatever, I'll play the marksman!"
Qin Xiaoxu kept thinking to herself, "Pfft, if it weren't for teaming up with Lin Jie, I'd snatch that mage no matter what. Worst case, we play double mages!"
Middle lane mage was Qin Xiaoxu's forte. As for the marksman role, she was barely passable – she could hold her own unless she was specifically targeted.
Qin Xiaoxu pondered for quite a while before finally choosing Marco Polo.
Lin Jie went with Ah Ke, catching the opposing marksman Hou Yi off guard early in the game. His maneuvers impressed Qin Xiaoxu and earned some approval for his abilities. At least his jungling rhythm was good, and he had a decent grasp of the timing for ganking.
During previous games, Qin Xiaoxu found that some teammates would jungle selfishly, with no concept of ganking. By the time an enemy lane got fed, it was utterly out of control!
As they continued to develop into the Intermediate Stage, Lin Jie suddenly said to Qin Xiaoxu, "No way, how did bottom lane collapse like that? Didn't I come down to gank multiple times? Why hasn't the bottom tower fallen yet?"
Qin Xiaoxu quickly replied, "Their mid laner kept coming down after you left, you need to gank their mid laner more!"
Lin Jie said helplessly, "Sis, I'm in bad shape after each gank, and the enemy purposely targets you when I'm not there. You'll have to watch out for yourself; I need to go back to base first."
Lin Jie then typed in the game, "Mage, press against their mid laner. He's always going bottom, so let the marksman safely take down the bottom tower."
The mage replied with a voice message, "Roger that."
But the mid lane mage had used both of his spells during a trip to the top lane just before and was now playing very cautiously.
At that moment, a danger signal appeared in the river pathway leading to the bottom lane.
Just then, Qin Xiaoxu, with Lin Jie's help, engaged with Hou Yi in the bottom lane again, but the enemy escaped with low health using flash. Qin Xiaoxu also lost half of her health.
After seeing the signal, Lin Jie quickly said, "This is bad, their mid laner is coming down. I'd better go back. It's best to recall at the second tower's position."
Qin Xiaoxu defiantly replied, "I'm not going to! I'll just recall at the first tower, no need for all that trouble."
Lin Jie, failing in his gank, went for the Red Buff and then turned to Qin Xiaoxu, "Come get the Red Buff! Approach from the side of the second tower."
After hearing that, Qin Xiaoxu was overjoyed inside, but she pretended to be very calm, "Mhm, got it."
She then headed towards the jungle.
But at that moment, an enemy mage suddenly appeared from the bushes. Thankfully, the distance was not close enough for her to be instantly killed.
Qin Xiaoxu was startled into alertness!
Good thing she had moved in time, or she would have had to 'lightning recall' back to base again!
Since the start of the school year, Qin Xiaoxu's marksman not only hadn't scored any kills, but she had also died several times!
She really couldn't bear to mention such a score!
Upon seeing this, Lin Jie smirked and promptly claimed the Red Buff for himself.
Then he said in the game, "Hehe, if I didn't trick you into coming for the Buff, you would have lost it."
The mid-lane mage chimed in, "Impressive, jungler bro."
Lin Jie's heart swelled with joy when he read this message, and he mused to himself, "Didn't expect playing escort to be this fun, haha."
However, she was so immersed in her own delight that she completely failed to notice the piercing glare from Qin Xiaoxu beside her!
Oh Lin Jie, Lin Jie, how dare you interact with other girls in the game!
Have you forgotten about your pretend girlfriend sitting right beside you?
Telling me to go get the Red Buff was actually a ruse to get me away from the first tower!
Qin Xiaoxu felt like she was being played, and right now she was itching to clear out all of Lin Jie's jungle!
But this game was also crucial; Qin Xiaoxu's rank always got stuck at this point, and if she could win just one more match, just one, she would reach the King rank today!
So she had to bite her tongue for now.
But what she never expected was that the support would twist the knife further, "Ah Ke has finally seen the archer's greed clearly!"
The next second, the other teammates started bombarding Qin Xiaoxu with question marks!
Qin Xiaoxu couldn't take it anymore!
Then, in a fit of pique, she typed out, "Mage, nobody would take you for mute if you kept quiet! Ah Ke is being played by my boyfriend!"
Currently, Lin Jie didn't even dare to breathe loudly; it seemed Qin Xiaoxu was genuinely angry.
Maybe he saw the resemblance to his mother when she was angry in Qin Xiaoxu, which is why he chose to keep silent as a survival strategy!
Seeing that he was now keeping quiet, Qin Xiaoxu felt much better.
Hmph, you know what's good for you, or else you would've been in for it today!
No matter what, at least in the eyes of others, Lin Jie gave Qin Xiaoxu plenty of respect!
The other teammates also fell silent upon hearing this. When a couple is gaming together, it's best not to speak out of turn—you might become a target!
The tactful mid-laner quickly changed his tune, "Could you grab the dragon, jungler?"
The support and top-laner also added, "Would be much obliged!"
Lin Jie remained silent and focused quietly on the game.
Throughout the game, Lin Jie dictated the pace, making catches and timely clearing the jungle, leading to a smooth victory.
Yet, he never saw the Red Buff in his jungle again!
A woman's wrath is truly frightening!
Qin Xiaoxu finally reached the coveted King rank, and since Lin Jie didn't refute her when she called him her boyfriend, she felt a bit smug about it!
But now Lin Jie was still pondering why a woman's anger is so terrifying? He definitely must not provoke her in the future, or else he would be the one to suffer!
It must be said that, in this regard, Lin Jie was quite enlightened.
And so, the two of them continued to play several more matches, and coincidentally, the other groomsmen also passed by this place.

chapters.title: Chapter 141 Ascend to King
chapters.content:
"Ah, isn't that our Lin Jie? Why are you hiding here playing games?"
"Whoa, brought a girl, too? Why didn't you call us? You're totally putting beauty before bros, aren't you?"
"Right? We're all close friends who often play together, and you sneak off with a girl—why not invite your brothers to share the fun?"
Qiu Zhenhua, Niu Chenghu, and others began teasing at the sight.
They were just having fun with the two of them and didn't really intend to start a game here.
But a guy and a girl hiding out in this spot playing games did raise some suspicions.
Lin Jie just smiled and said, "Alright, stop messing around. She's stuck in the Star rank with several thousand matches, and I just took pity on her and decided to help her rank up."
"Several thousand matches? Thousands? That many?" Qiang Hengxuan was the first to show a surprised expression.
Qin Xiaoxu, who was thin-skinned, felt extremely embarrassed at that moment, not expecting the young man to speak about her that way in front of others!
So, she vehemently retorted, "I just play casually for fun sometimes. Don't you know what 'playing for fun' means? I rarely play ranked matches, okay?"
Even though she said that, Qin Xiaoxu knew full well that only about a thousand matches were for fun, and the rest of the five thousand were all ranked…
"Plus, I often get teammates who are pretty bad, sometimes they don't cooperate or even steal positions... It's not my fault if we lose, okay? When I lose, I just can't let it go and keep playing!"
After hearing her, Qiang Hengxuan chuckled and said, "It's alright, now that you have Lin Jie to coach you, your rank will skyrocket!"
Niu Chenghu also chimed in from the side, "That's right, when Lin Yi plays with us, he always brings his cousin, a surefire jungle god, and almost every match he's the MVP!"
After hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu shot him a brief look, but even so, she still preferred to play ranked matches alone because if she encountered bad teammates, she would just turn on voice chat and scold them—this felt very liberating, and when playing solo, even if she messed up, it didn't really matter!
Qin Xiaoxu was now aware of Lin Jie's high skill level, yet she still said, "You're not bad, so are you guys going to join us for a match?"
"Sure! Let's all play together! We have just enough people to form a team for multi-player ranked!" Lin Jie said excitedly.
He naturally hoped to play with everyone, as that would mean, if Qin Xiaoxu got angry, she wouldn't direct her temper solely at him.
After receiving Lin Jie's invitation, Qiang Hengxuan shook his head repeatedly, considering himself quite the veteran in affairs of the heart, he quickly decided that Lin Jie was an unmistakable straight male!
Is there any hope for such a straight male?
But now they had nothing else to do, Jiang Jing had seen enough, snacked enough, and Lin Yi was busy taking care of the baby. They had already explored every place there was to see, and there was still a while to go before the banquet!
So, it was decided on the spot—everyone took out their phones, logged into the game, and started a multi-player ranked match.
They still didn't know what exactly Lin Jie and Qin Xiaoxu were to each other, so instinctively they thought that Qin Xiaoxu must have taken a fancy to Lin Jie.
Having known Lin Jie for so long, they were very clear about his character; he seldom interacted with girls, let alone play "King of Glory" with one!
They always felt that girls would just be a drag, affecting his climb in rank!
But the truth was different, and they definitely wouldn't have guessed that Lin Jie had taken the initiative to invite Qin Xiaoxu, not with any romantic ideas in mind, but because he felt sorry for her.
He thought her personal skills weren't good enough; after playing so many matches, she was still stuck at the Starshine tier, and had never even reached the rank of "King", so he simply decided to help her out.
With this thought, Lin Jie could already be considered a mega straight guy!
Since there weren't enough seats, everyone had to squeeze in, and Lin Jie and Qin Xiaoxu ended up sitting together.
Like that, the group started playing together, and after a few rounds, the others noticed that Qin Xiaoxu's mid-lane mage skills were decent, and she could coordinate well with the other lanes at critical moments.
Maybe she was just unlucky, always getting matched with teammates who weren't that great, which made her promotion matches not go so smoothly sometimes.
Just as everyone was having a good time, Lin Jie's mom came over.
"Why are all of you gathered here? We're supposed to head to the banquet soon, hurry up and join us, we mustn't be late!"
As soon as Lin Jie's mom arrived, she saw her son sitting next to a girl and frowned slightly, beginning to harbor some suspicions.
Hearing his mom, Lin Jie immediately asked, "Mom, we've just started this match, we'll head over once we're done!"
If they had enough time, even fifteen minutes, they were confident they could make a direct push for the high ground.
But Lin Jie's mom said directly, "Oh, stop playing, there's no more time. The other relatives have already boarded the vehicle. You guys really should be more concerned about your cousin's big day instead of hiding here playing games and losing track of time."
Lin Jie had no choice but to say to Qin Xiaoxu and the others, "We can't play anymore. I've got important things to do later; I need to drive and pick up some relatives. I think we should just surrender this match, how about that?"
Everyone agreed with a nod; today was a wedding, which was the biggest event of all. Everything else could wait!
So that was how they played games there, preparing to surrender when the time came, while Lin Jie's mom quietly watched. After they finished playing and everyone scattered, she pulled her son aside and asked, "Lin Jie, tell me the truth, is that girl your girlfriend?"
After his mom said this, Lin Jie looked startled, thought for a moment, then gritted his teeth and came clean, "Ah, Mom, she's my girlfriend, but please, don't tell anyone. She isn't ready to go public yet. My cousin and his wife don't even know about her, and if you go around telling people, you might scare her. We're not ready to go public yet, so please don't interrupt us."
Lin Jie's mom was overjoyed and quickly nodded, "Okay, okay, mom won't say a word. I know you two have only been together for a few days, so I won't go spreading it around!"
Having seen her son's girlfriend today, Lin Jie's mom was incredibly happy. Even though she could only look and not engage in conversation, she was already beside herself with joy and was eager to tell Lin Jie's dad about it right away.
Then she hurriedly turned and left quickly, but not before turning back to glance at Qin Xiaoxu. Qin Xiaoxu, who hadn't gone far, noticed Lin Jie's mom's gaze and instantly felt flustered.

chapters.title: Chapter 142: Chapter 142 Delightful Visions
chapters.content:
Fortunately, Lin Jie's mother only glanced at them casually and didn't say much before walking away.
Qin Xiaoxu then turned her attention back to Lin Jie, but he was visibly avoiding her gaze. However, under Qin Xiaoxu's stern look, he had no choice but to tell the truth and spill the beans.
He lowered his voice and said, "I've been sending the selfies you gave me to my parents, so they know about our relationship. And even if I didn't, they would have pestered me to see them. I was going to tell them eventually, so when my mom asked if you were my girlfriend, I just admitted it~"
After hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu didn't react much, just took a deep sigh and said, "Phew, when I saw the look in your mother's eyes just now, my heart skipped a beat. Are you sure our act isn't going to be found out? I feel like if they discover the truth, I won't be able to face the consequences."
Lin Jie laughed and said, "Don't worry, it absolutely won't be found out. And the way my mom looked at you was definitely doting. Just imagine, you are their future daughter-in-law! Just like how my uncle and auntie are with my cousin's wife, that's what my parents' attitude towards you would be. Alright, no need to worry too much, everything is under control!"
Qin Xiaoxu asked angrily, "Why did you choose to make me pretend to be a gold digger? Isn't there any risk in that? I'm afraid they would kill me with just their stares!"
Lin Jie was very cautious and scanned their surroundings before whispering in her ear, "I'm just being prepared for the worst, and we can't let my parents like you too quickly. If you were too perfect and they became satisfied with you, then it would be hard for you to get out later. Plus, if I happen to meet someone I really like in the future, it would be easier to explain!"
After hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu nodded in understanding. When she thought it over, Lin Jie did have a point.
With that, Lin Jie grabbed Qin Xiaoxu's arm and led her outside, saying on the way, "Okay, let's not talk about this anymore, we need to hurry to the wedding venue! I've got to drive later, and there are so many relatives to attend to! If you have anything to say, just message me after the rush is over!"
Qin Xiaoxu felt a warmth spread through her arm and even her heart felt different, as if a ripple had disturbed its calm surface.
Suddenly, she realized she might have developed a bit of a crush on Lin Jie, and became extremely interested in his family!
Everyone gathered together again, and Lin Yi drove off with the groomsmen and relatives towards the hotel run by his father-in-law.
The wedding Lin Yi arranged was in a traditional Chinese style, overall very conventional and unlike the flashy weddings thrown by the nouveau riche that seemed to have no purpose other than to show off, spending heaps of money on the banquet and hosting it in a five-star hotel.
The purpose of this traditional Chinese wedding was to add more warmth and personal touch to the feast, and also to promote his father-in-law's new business; it was like using his own popularity to create a massive advertisement, and he also hoped the business could flourish in Xiangcheng.
By doing this, he was helping his father-in-law to the best of his ability, simultaneously fulfilling his desire to host his daughter's banquet. After all, Han Xuewei was an only child, and her parents were extremely fond of her, so their wish to satisfy her and her family was paramount.
Even though their wedding wasn't held in a fancy hotel, the venue was impressive, and Lin Yi didn't skimp on any expenses, opting for the most lavish options available.
Han Xue's dad had initially just planned to run a restaurant, but upon securing such a large space, he decided to open a proper hotel instead and was very satisfied with the renovations.
The first floor of the hotel dedicated half its space to the kitchen with the rest used for individual seating, while the second floor housed the main banquet hall, and the top floor was completely made into private dining rooms, each floor boasting considerable space.
Even so, the rent here is even lower than other places, who would believe that? Therefore, in Dad Han's eyes, it was an incredible bargain!
The "Han's Private Kitchen" restaurant, under the decoration of the professional team from the wedding planning company, looked exceptionally festive. The inside and outside were both "dressed up," and the decorations could also be used for the opening ceremony after the wedding concluded.
The manager Jiao from the Wenqu Building was also quite savvy, having arranged all the parking lots in advance. Today, the main focus was on vehicles from out of town, which were all to park in the underground parking lot. As for the outdoor lots, they were reserved only for wedding guests. If those were not enough, half of the First Layer was also cleared out.
Lin Yi's wedding banquet was set up with ninety-nine large tables, and the cars parked in the parking lot were numerous. Many people came specifically for this wedding feast.
Lin Jie specially drove to pick up relatives who had rushed over from his old home and brought them to the wedding venue. At the entrance of the restaurant, Lin Yi, hand in hand with Han Xuewei, greeted the guests, accompanied by the bridesmaids and groomsmen waiting nearby.
Lin Yi's parents, as well as his uncles and aunts, which included Lin Jie's parents, were neatly seated in the front hall, also welcoming the guests.
However, throughout the process, Lin Jie's mother kept her gaze fixed on Qin Xiaoxu across from her, and the more she watched, the more she liked her.
There's always a type of people who are attracted to one another, birds of a feather flock together, and perhaps this was a kind of effect!
Lin Jie's mother felt that if Qin Xiaoxu could be Han Xuewei's bridesmaid, it indicated a good relationship between the two, so they must share some common values.
In any case, she was sure it couldn't be bad!
And Han Xuewei had left a particularly good impression on them; even Lin Yi's parents would wear a satisfied expression whenever they mentioned their daughter-in-law, so even if Qin Xiaoxu were not as outstanding as Han Xuewei, she should be of the same kind of girl, and they would definitely approve of her.
If she turned out to be even more excellent than Han Xuewei, that would be an immense blessing!
Today's young people seem to have a different understanding of love, so in some marriages, if the couple's values are compatible, or even good, that's already quite favorable!
As for the family background of the other party, Lin Jie's mother didn't care at all, and even if the future daughter-in-law were a bit lazy, that didn't matter, as maternity matrons and maids were indispensable!
And it wasn't just Lin Jie's mother—even his father was staring intently at Qin Xiaoxu, with shining eyes last time he saw her!
The sensitive Qin Xiaoxu, of course, noticed Lin Jie's parents smiling at her from across the way, and the more they looked, the more anxious she felt in her heart.
She even worried that her acting skills were too poor and that she might inadvertently give herself away!

chapters.title: Chapter 143: Chapter 143 Red Envelope Bombing
chapters.content:
Lin Jie caught sight of his parents' intense gaze and hurriedly stood in front of Qin Xiaoxu, forcefully blocking their stares—the nearly frenzied stares!
Then, Lin Jie quickly pulled his parents aside to a corner of the corridor, puzzledly saying, "Dad, Mom, what are you doing? Staring at her like that, she'll get shy or even scared. What if she gets frightened?"
Lin Jie's parents then smiled apologetically and quickly explained, "We were just taking a few extra looks, but alright, we'll stop now. We'll pretend we don't know her for the moment. However, you have to bring her over to see us in a few days. We really like little Qin, the more we look at her, the more satisfied we are!"
Lin Jie's parents were beaming with joy as if they had definitely decided Qin Xiaoxu was their future daughter-in-law.
Lin Jie had no choice but to agree. When he returned to Qin Xiaoxu's side, he whispered in her ear, "You'll have to say hello to my parents later. I've talked to them, and it's not good to be at an impasse like this."
After that, Lin Jie asked Qin Xiaoxu to check her phone and receive a message.
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu opened her phone and immediately saw a transfer from Lin Jie.
Several instances of 520, no less!
The next second, Qin Xiaoxu's eyes filled with astonishment.
Oh my! Five 520s in a row, so many!
Qin Xiaoxu then said with a smile, "Alright, leave it to me."
After speaking, she bypassed Lin Jie and even squeezed him aside, walking directly up to Lin Jie's parents and saying, "Uncle, Auntie, you've been standing here a long time. You must be tired, right? Why don't you sit down and rest a bit? Pretty much all the guests have arrived, so just leave this area to us."
Lin Jie's parents were both surprised and delighted by Qin Xiaoxu's unexpected action, exclaiming, "Oh, yes, we'll go rest in a bit, we can still hold on for a while."
Their son's girlfriend, no, their future daughter-in-law was standing right there. How could they consider resting first? However long little Qin chose to stand, they could stand with her!
Even if it was more exhausting, their hearts were sweet as honey!
Most of the guests had already taken their seats, with only a few scattered arrivals making their way inside. The scene was now exceptionally lively.
The guests were also sitting together and starting to discuss.
Most of the guests were relatives of the Lin Family and the Han Family.
"You might not know, but Lin Yi now even has a child!"
"Yes, yes, I heard as well. It seems they've already celebrated the baby's full month."
"Exactly, they're timing the wedding to coincide with the baby's hundredth day celebration."
"Apparently, they had triplets in one go, truly blessed with good fortune."
"Ah? Really? A friend of mine who works at the hospital said that triplets were born in Xiangcheng recently. I never thought they'd be our own family's babies! That's great."
"It looks like you're out of the loop. I just saw the babies a moment ago. Each one cuter than the last."
"I heard the bride and groom are from the same university and they haven't even graduated yet! The two of them are even having a shotgun wedding."
"Tsk, that's all pretty normal these days. The views on love for today's youth are different. Living together and such is pretty commonplace now."
"Right, having a shotgun wedding isn't a bad thing; at least it shows that both parties are in good health. If one of them were infertile, that would be the real bad news."
"Yeah, yeah, these days there are so many problematic men and women. Some women have had too many abortions to have children, while some men smoke and drink too much and don't exercise, making it even harder to conceive."
Everyone chatted about all sorts of topics, and before long, the conversation had drifted off course.
As all the seats filled up, some of the guests who arrived were business partners or friends of Lin Yi's parents. Judging by today's banquet, the Lin Family had quite a few friends. Although they weren't a famous noble family, they still had a certain reputation and were well-established in the market.
Others went over to ask the Han family guests, "Does your Han family have any girls who are as pretty and sensible as the bride? Our little rascal at home has reached the age for talking about marriage, but he doesn't even have a partner yet! It's driving me crazy!"
"Maybe your son is just keeping it from you? There are plenty of beautiful girls in college. If he really tries, he could get one, maybe he just isn't ready to bring someone home yet."
"Sigh, he didn't date anyone in college, and now it's been two years since he graduated; it's even tougher to find someone. I'm thinking about setting him up on a blind date. If you know anyone suitable, please do introduce her to us. If it really works out, we'll be sure to show our gratitude."
This topic involved many people, and everyone started looking for potential partners for their children during the wedding.
"If someone makes a successful introduction, I'm willing to give the matchmaker twenty thousand as a thank you!"
"If someone introduces a girlfriend for my son, I'll give thirty thousand!"
"If there are any good daughter-in-law candidates, prioritize me! I can offer fifty thousand!!"
As the discussion became more heated, the proposed amounts started to increase markedly.
"I know a girl with good character, but her only flaw is that she's divorced. Her husband had another woman, and she's raising the child by herself. Would anyone like an introduction?"
At these words, the previously quarreling crowd fell silent, looking at each other, speechless.
"Well, I have a son who got divorced last year, but he doesn't have children. I was wondering, is the child the woman is raising a boy or a girl? If it's a girl, we wouldn't mind, at least letting the two meet each other or something."
To put it bluntly, they didn't mind a divorce; what was concerning was if she came with a son, because nobody wanted to raise someone else's son!
.......
The wedding soon began, and the atmosphere became increasingly lively, filled with celebratory cheer.
After a short wait, all the seats were taken, and Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's family, who had greeted guests at the door, finally returned to their places.
The bride was busy touching up her makeup!
Lin Yi had already arranged early on for the Romeo Security Company's personnel to help guard a safe in a private room.
Inside, besides several sets of Gold's jewelry for Han Xuewei, there was also the True Love series of diamond jewelry, worth several hundred million.
Lin Yi selected some suitable jewelry, and then put it on Han Xuewei, making her look extremely luxurious and noble.
After Lin Yi carefully adorned her, he hugged Han Xuewei from behind and came in front of a mirror.
"Baby, you really look so beautiful and enchanting!"
Han Xuewei smiled and asked, "So am I only beautiful today?"

chapters.title: Chapter 144: Chapter 144 I'm willing
chapters.content:
Lin Yi quickly shook his head and said, "No, no, you've always been beautiful, but today is the most special!"
Han Xuewei's face was brimming with a blissful smile as she looked at Lin Yi in the mirror, with tears glistening at the corners of her eyes.
Just at that moment, Lin Yi's phone rang.
Looking at the caller ID, it was a call from his mom.
"Lin Yi, how are the preparations going? If you're ready, come straight here. Remember to watch the time, we can't miss the auspicious moment."
Lin Yi smiled and said, "Mom, you can rest assured, we absolutely won't be late. We're all packed up and will be there soon!"
Then, he personally put the veil on Han Xuewei, and just as he opened the door, he saw the bridesmaids and others waiting outside.
Upon seeing Han Xuewei come out, the makeup artist quickly helped her with the final touches.
"Lin Yi, you can go down now, I'll be right down."
Because of the different sequence of appearances, Lin Yi could only nod and say, "Hmm, I'll go down first then."
After saying that, he took the lead and left.
At this time, Qin Xiaoxu hurried over to Han Xuewei and said, "Vivi, make sure you take a good look when you toss the bouquet later! See clearly where I am before you throw it!"
After hearing this, Han Xuewei smiled.
Of course, she knew Qin Xiaoxu's thoughts— her best friend was also anxious to find her own true love!
So, she promised with a smile, "I'll definitely throw it to you, but you have to catch it! It won't be good if someone else snatches it away."
The other bridesmaids chuckled after hearing this and said, "No problem, we'll fulfill your dream if we let you have the bouquet."
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu was immediately touched beyond words. She wasn't in a hurry to get married or to meet a soul mate or anything like that.
All she hoped for was to fall in love as soon as possible, especially since she hadn't had a boyfriend during her college years, and not only were her parents urging her on, but she was also becoming a bit anxious herself!
Besides, her parents had been letting her live freely, allowing her to move out on her own to make more contacts out there until she found a boyfriend!
If she really found a boyfriend, then she would be able to rightfully return home and lie down, returning to a comfortable life just like before!
But if not, then she could only consider herself unlucky and keep living on her own outside, slogging to and from work every day!
…
The long-awaited wedding finally began, with a lovely, melodious tune starting to play. Lin Yi and his groomsmen took their places on the stage while an archway was temporarily set up at the entrance, especially for Han Xuewei's appearance.
Han Xuewei was standing under the archway, with her bridesmaids holding the train of her dress.
Directly behind Han Xuewei were the girls, pushing a baby stroller decorated like a float, with the Lin Family triplets inside!
Close by were Aunt Wang and two maternity matrons, ready to handle all sorts of baby-related issues.
It was clear that Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's triplet babies were playing the roles of flower children today!
Just then, Han Xuewei's father-in-law walked towards his daughter, and Han Xuewei linked her arm with her father's, slowly walking towards Lin Yi.
With the lead of the enthusiastic emcee, Dad Han handed his daughter over to Lin Yi.
Han Xuewei's hand was also placed into Lin Yi's palm.
"Lin Yi, she's my only daughter, and from today on, she's completely in your hands! You must never bully her, okay?"
Lin Yi nodded very seriously and promised, "Mhm, father-in-law, I won't let everyone down!"
And just like that, Lin Yi, in all his glory, held Han Xuewei's hand as they faced the many friends and relatives gathered there.
The master of ceremonies also led a round of applause, with words of blessing flowing endlessly, and then the liveliest part of the event was about to begin!
The MC went straight to Han Xuewei and said, "Today's bride, Han Xuewei, are you willing to take today's groom, Mr. Lin Yi, to be your lawfully wedded husband? Whether he is healthy or not in the future, will you remain by his side, love him with all your heart, tolerate everything about him until the last moment of life!!"
Han Xuewei calmed her excited heart and then said earnestly, "I do."
Next, the MC turned to Lin Yi and asked, "Mr. Lin Yi, as today's groom, do you..."
But Lin Yi, without any hesitation, interrupted the MC, eagerly saying, "I do! I do!"
Seeing this, the MC laughed, "I gotta say, our groom today is quite impatient! Are you in a hurry to get to the bridal chamber?"
The guests burst into laughter upon hearing this.
It was this laughter that made the atmosphere at the scene even more lively and festive.
And Han Xuewei, upon hearing these words, also blushed slightly but her face was still filled with a sweet smile, brimming with happiness.
It was Han Xuewei's every smile and frown that sparked discussions among the guests.
"Wow, the bride is so beautiful! A real goddess of beauty!"
"Look at what you're saying, the bride is the recognized campus beauty of Xiangcheng University, and her beauty is beyond question!"
"I heard that the couple is still in their senior year of college, and they haven't finished their studies yet."
"Yeah, they took a sabbatical right after learning about the pregnancy. But that's alright; after all, they got pregnant with triplets at once, and the pregnancy must have been harder than for the average expectant mom, so they need plenty of rest. So envious!"
"Hahaha, if these two return to school this year, they'll definitely be the center of attention!"
"Yes, even though they are married now, she will still be the campus beauty when they return, and beauty is one thing, but being a mother adds to her gentleness..."
"Although she is extremely gentle, when I think of the triplets, I can't help but feel it's tough; the confinement period must be very tiring, it's really not easy..."
"Many people would love to have that kind of 'tiring'; they can't even get it. It's also about having good fortune; if I could have triplets, I would be willing no matter how exhausting!"
"Haha, you're right about that..."
Han Xuewei, dressed in her immaculate white wedding gown, along with the triplets, immediately became the center of everyone's attention.
At that moment, Aunt Wang and the nannies held the babies in their arms. The little ones were already a hundred days old, and they were staring intently at Lin Yi and Han Xuewei!
The luckiest thing was that the babies witnessed the moment their parents stepped into the halls of matrimony with their own eyes!
Daddy looks so handsome today!
Mommy is so beautiful today!
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei also exchanged rings!
Han Xuewei, wearing a veil, looked at Lin Yi with anticipation, waiting for him to lift it.
After Lin Yi lifted the veil, he looked at Han Xuewei with deep affection, and then the two embraced tightly and kissed in front of so many relatives present.

chapters.title: Chapter 145: Chapter 145 Moved to Tears
chapters.content:
After the kiss, Lin Yi didn't forget to continue holding Han Xuewei tightly in his arms. The emcee laughed and said, "Oh, it seems that our groom is not only eager but doesn't think of us as outsiders! Why don't the two of you show a little more restraint?"
Red-faced, Han Xuewei and Lin Yi separated after hearing this.
Han Xuemei looked up at everyone, first at her parents who had raised her for so many years, then at her relatives and friends, and her close girlfriends, before finally resting her gaze on the children. At that moment, her eyes filled with tears of happiness.
Lin Yi was also quite emotional at this time, and he couldn't help but feel a lump in his throat as tears swirled in his eyes.
Seemingly having anticipated this moment, he took out a tissue from his pocket and tenderly wiped Han Xuewei's tears, saying softly, "Vivi, my wife."
At that moment, he could not say anything else; his gentle gaze conveyed all his love.
The emcee also tactfully gave them a moment, and after a short while, stirred up everyone's emotions again.
"Now let's move on to the next fun segment! I invite today's bride to toss her bouquet to the others! Let's see which bridesmaid or groomsman can catch this lucky blessing!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei quickly wiped the tears from the corner of her eyes and laughed happily.
She said to Qin Xiaoxu not far away, "Xiaoxu, then I'll just throw it directly to you. You must catch it! Get ready to receive the blessing!"
Qin Xiaoxu immediately snagged the center spot and said to Han Xuewei, "Just throw it. Today this bouquet is a must for me! Don't you guys snatch it away!"
Two bridesmaids teased deliberately, "How can this be acceptable? We have to follow the rules and grab it by our ability!"
The groomsmen also tactfully moved to the edge of the stage at this time, clearing a space for them, "You girls enjoy this kind of thing! We'll stand aside for now."
With that, the competition was lessened, and Qin Xiaoxu's confidence increased.
Compared to the groomsmen, the bridesmaids seemed to value this blessing more, as they saw that everyone had graduated, but some didn't even have boyfriends yet! Who wouldn't want to meet a husband like Lin Yi?
Even if it meant quitting their jobs to be a housewife at home, they were willing to make that sacrifice!
Han Xuewei saw the expectant looks of the bridesmaids and slowly turned around.
She was ready to throw the bouquet!
Closing her eyes gently and taking a few deep breaths, Han Xuewei tossed the bouquet from over her head to behind her!
But as she threw it, the bouquet was leaning sideways, and the next second, Lin Jie, standing on the edge of the field with a stunned look, found himself holding the bouquet and looked around.
"Oh my, I didn't snatch it... it fell into my arms on its own!"
Seeing this, everyone laughed, and the other groomsmen teased, "Hahaha, Lin Jie, this is fate that can't be defied! Brothers are waiting for your wedding banquet! You've got to work harder now!"
But who would have guessed he would just stuff the bouquet into Qin Xiaoxu's arms: "Go on, what's with the teasing? I'm definitely not getting married within the next two years! Take it, take it, you keep it."
However, Qin Xiaoxu was quite displeased, "No, that's yours; you caught it. I don't want it!"
Then she tried to return the bouquet to Lin Jie.
But Lin Jie refused to take it no matter what.
Immediately after, the emcee called Han Xuewei back to the stage, "It seems that our lucky star for today has been born. Now, will this beautiful bridesmaid please come to our stage."
Qin Xiaoxu at this time was also very helpless, after all, today was her best friend's wedding; she couldn't refuse to give even this bit of face, right?
She straightened her clothes and walked toward the stage.
Seeing the scene before their eyes, Lin Jie's parents couldn't have been happier, because in their eyes, the one receiving this blessing was to be their daughter-in-law!
Of course, this was also their expectation, hoping that the next wedding banquet they attended would be for their son and his future bride. How wonderful that would be!
After all, they were both looking forward to holding their grandchildren soon!
"Our bridesmaid today seems very beautiful! I believe all the single men here must have one question: Miss, are you currently single?"
After speaking, he turned with a smile to look at the other groomsmen.
Not only the groomsmen present but also the other men started to cheer along, casting their gazes this way.
While Qin Xiaoxu's beauty might not surpass that of today's bride, Han Xuewei, when seen on her own, she was definitely a pretty lady!
But when Qin Xiaoxu heard the question, she was completely dumbfounded!
Her brain whirred rapidly, at a loss for words in the moment.
At her side, Han Xuewei was anxiously shaking her arm, saying, "Quickly tell everyone, aren't you just in need of a boyfriend?"
Caught in a dilemma, Qin Xiaoxu knew she couldn't admit she was single with Lin Jie's parents watching her!
Yet if she didn't confess, the great opportunity for a relationship might slip away—for good! She didn't know when she would next encounter so many single men!
Oh my goodness! I should never have pretended to be Lin Jie's girlfriend!!
It was a loss far outweighing the gain!!
Ah, I'm so angry!
In the end, Han Xuewei chose to protect the hopes of Lin Jie's parents and, with determination and gritted teeth, she said bluntly, "I'm sorry, I'm not single."
It didn't matter anymore; she wasn't concerned with those things now!
Perhaps all this was arranged by fate! It seemed that her destiny wasn't here.
And naturally, the most surprised by her answer was Han Xuewei: "Ah! Xiaoxu! Not single? When did you find someone? Why didn't you ever tell us? You've kept it so well hidden!"
Qin Xiaoxu hurriedly explained in a whisper, "Wait until we get off the stage, I'll tell you. I said that for a reason."
Han Xuewei looked at Qin Xiaoxu with perplexity, knowing that no matter what the reason she gave today, she would be happy! After all, they were the best of friends!
Upon hearing this, Lin Jie's parents also showed content smiles, believing that the girl still had their son in her heart!
As soon as Qin Xiaoxu finished speaking, the other men in the audience clearly showed looks of disappointment, but Lin Jie didn't seem surprised at all—in fact, his eyes were filled with gratitude!
Qin Xiaoxu was a true friend indeed! Not only did she bear no grudge against him, but she also acknowledged in front of his parents that she wasn't single!
The emcee, having heard her response, expressed regret on behalf of the other single men present: "Oh no, so the lady is not single after all!"

chapters.title: Chapter 146: Chapter 146 Breaking the Deadlock
chapters.content:
"This just shattered everyone's hopes!"
Clearly, some sighs from the male guests could be heard from below.
"Hahaha, don't feel too regretful, everyone. This beautiful lady already has a boyfriend, so let's sincerely wish them happiness! I hope you all can also enter the marriage hall soon!" the host said with high emotional intelligence, deftly smoothing over the situation.
"And I hope to have the chance to continue hosting and witness your love stories!"
After hearing this, the other guests also burst into applause.
"Alright, let's all taste the wedding cake now! Pop open the champagne of blessings!"
The waiters, who had been waiting outside for a long time, wheeled in the massive seven-tier cake and three trolleys filled with champagne!
At this moment, Han Xuewei no longer pressed Qin Xiaoxu about not being single.
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei worked together to cut the cake and then opened all the champagne bottles.
The babies were taken to a private room on the third layer, as it was almost time for their feeding.
The wedding was more or less over at this point, and Han Xuewei, with the help of others, stepped down and then went to change clothes with her makeup artist.
Lin Yi went straight to his seat to eat.
Lin Yi's parents considerately served food for their daughter-in-law, waiting for her to return before eating, fearing that otherwise she might miss out on the food.
The groomsmen were also arranged to sit at the same table, with Qin Xiaoxu and Lin Jie naturally sitting together.
Lin Jie was through and through a typical straight male character, so during the meal, he only concentrated on serving himself, and Han Xuewei didn't pay him any attention. However, this scene had Lin Jie's mother anxiously exclaiming!
She knew her son all too well. This straight male character of his had never changed! He simply didn't know how to be considerate of girls!
Lin Jie's mother helplessly shook her head, deciding that when they got back, she would give him a proper lesson, no matter what, to make him remember how to be thoughtful towards girls. What kind of way was this to be in a relationship?
As several hot dishes were served, the host picked up the microphone and returned to the stage, saying, "I have some good news for everyone here. Today, we celebrate double happiness, not only the wedding of the lovely couple but also the opening ceremony of (Han's Private Kitchen). This ninth-floor venue, where the wedding is held, happens to be the property of the bride's father.
This great father has been waiting for this day for more than 20 years, and every dish is his own creation, filled with fatherly love!"
"Han's Private Kitchen initially made a name for itself with braised dishes, but over the decades of development, it has evolved into a diverse restaurant. Here, in addition to traditional Chinese dishes, there are buffet and Western dining options. Today's banquet features a variety of signature dishes.
Chapter Enjoy:
Everyone, please enjoy your meal today, and we look forward to welcoming you again in the future!"
Before the host went on stage, Lin Yi had already instructed him to say so, and the father-in-law, after hearing such a speech, expressed his gratitude, looking at Lin Yi with a very satisfied smile and nodding.
Lin Yi looked back at his father-in-law with a smile, greeting him with a smile in return.
As soon as the host finished speaking, the guests started to discuss amongst themselves.
"Oh my, I only knew that the Lin family was well-off, but I didn't expect the bride's family to be so well-off too!"
"Yes, this is the biggest building in the city center, and renting such a large place here to open a shop, their strength must be considerable!"
"I just checked it out, and there are three floors here, with each floor being about a thousand square meters. The top floor is all private rooms!"
"Look at their vision, it's simply far-sighted! Growing big and strong here today is for being even stronger in Xiangcheng!"
"Indeed, I was chatting with a relative from the Han family just now, and heard that the bride's father also runs a hotel in Xiao Chuan County, and it's a family business too, quite large in scale! Importantly, she is their only daughter."
"Gosh, they must be so rich, no wonder they can afford to open a restaurant in a building in the city center. The rent here must be cheap, right? Given the size, I'm afraid it could be over a million a month!"
"Probably even two million, considering the scale!"
"The Lin Family's strength isn't bad either, Lin Yi directly gave Han Xuewei's parents a cash gift of two hundred and fifty thousand! And that's no small sum! Plus, the dowry is several million! I heard they picked a particularly auspicious number."
"And the bride's dowry isn't small either; they gave her a Mercedes Benz as part of it, which is parked right outside in the parking lot. I saw it with my own eyes! It's incredible! Poverty really does limit my imagination!"
Just as everyone was chatting enthusiastically, Han Xuewei had changed her clothes and was slowly coming downstairs.
Now, with her hair tied up, her entire face was visible, so delicate and charming.
She walked slowly over to this side.
Lin Yi also hurriedly went forward to greet her, and Lin Yi's mother served Han Xuewei the dishes she had set aside.
Han Xuewei also smiled, nodded, and said, "Mom, thank you."
Lin Yi's mother said, "Eat while it's hot; these are all your favorites. Later, you still have to toast the guests!"
Many of the guests at the tables began to discuss today's bride, after all, her captivating appearance was hard to overlook.
But one person's mood was completely opposite that of the other guests. Han Xuemei, sitting at a table, kept her head down and focused on her meal, merely to conceal her nearly frantic expression!
She glanced at her cousin, then at her mother next to her, and deliberately said in a coquettish voice, "Mom, I'm so envious of cousin! I want to come to Xiangcheng to make something of myself. I wonder if I could find my Mr. Right here!"
After hearing this, Han Xuemei's mother was taken aback, then asked, "Xue Mei, why are you suddenly thinking this way? I still think it's better to develop in Xiao Chuan County. At least your dad and I can look after you and help you out. Can't we stay away from here, okay?"
Han Xuemei was also an only child; due to the special policies back then, they didn't have a second child. Otherwise, their family would certainly have one or two more children.
After hearing her mother's words, Han Xuemei shook her head repeatedly and said, "Mom, times are different now, young people need to see the world, to go out and make their mark. At least let me try for a few more years before going back. Otherwise, if I stay in Xiao Chuan County my whole life, I definitely won't be satisfied! If I can't even find a boyfriend there, what will I do in the future?"
After listening, Han Xuemei's mother felt there was some truth in her daughter's words and began worrying too.
The reason she wanted her daughter to stay close was the fear of her marrying far away. But now, with the daughter hoping to develop herself in Xiangcheng, it wasn't out of the question.
Xiangcheng was only a two or three-hour drive from their place, and it would be quicker by high-speed rail. So, this distance was still acceptable to them.

chapters.title: Chapter 147: Chapter 147 Conspiracy
chapters.content:
```
However, she was very worried about what kind of boyfriend Han Xuewei would find when she came back. If her daughter planned to live separately with her husband in the future, then she and Xue Mei's father would have to consider buying an apartment in Xiangcheng, but this was a big problem. They simply didn't have the financial strength to buy wherever they wanted, like Lin Yi could.
"Oh, Mom, I think this city is quite suitable for me to make my way in, and besides, my uncle is here, and I can help him out, you know."
After hearing this, Han Xuemei's mother became even more puzzled, "Help? You'd do well not to be a burden, he doesn't need your help. Besides, aren't you a dance major? What help could you possibly be?"
But Han Xuemei said, "Although my major is different, I've always been very interested in cooking. Mom, I've been learning to cook with grandpa since I was little, even he said I have a talent for it. And it's a skill, right? Even if I live on my own in the future, I won't starve, right?"
After listening, Han Xuemei's mother pondered for a moment, feeling that her daughter indeed had a point.
"Well... let's do as you say then! I'll give your uncle a heads up later, so he can look out for you too."
At last, Han Xuemei smiled in satisfaction.
She had planned everything out very well. She knew Lin Yi didn't need to do much at home, so she would often come to help out at the restaurant. Moreover, her uncle had only one daughter, her cousin, so who else would he count on if not her and her cousin's husband?
Her uncle was probably already calculating his retirement life.
Now all she had to do was get there as soon as possible to scope things out, then she could proceed with the next step of her plan!
Han Xuemei lowered her head slightly, a cunning smile curling up the corners of her mouth.
Meanwhile, on the other side, Lin Jie was gorging himself when he suddenly saw the message from his mom on WeChat. After a moment, he nudged Qin Xiaoxu beside him, "Do you want to go over to my mom's table? She's calling us both over."
Qin Xiaoxu was startled by this, then looked towards Lin Jie's parents' table and saw the two smiling warmly at her.
She smiled shyly and said quietly, "Isn't it... might not be too good..."
But Lin Jie bluntly said, "Psh, what's not good about it? They'll just chat with you a bit, they don't bite. What are you afraid of?"
Chapter Stay:
However, after hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu got upset, "If I go over with you now, won't that be telling everyone that I'm dating you? Anyway, I'll just stay here where I am, I'm not going anywhere. I agreed to pretend to be your girlfriend, but that was only to deceive your parents. It's not necessary to be so public in front of all these people!"
After hearing this, Lin Jie hunched his shoulders and said, "Then let's forget it and just stay here to eat."
He then replied to his parents on the phone, "Mom, Xiaoxu said she's not coming over, it's all unfamiliar people at that table, and she feels a bit embarrassed."
Mother Lin considered the message and thought that Qin Xiaoxu's concerns were reasonable. The girl had just announced she wasn't single, and now to join her son at the table, the other relatives would certainly gossip.
After all, she's still a young girl, and it's okay to be a bit shy.
They would wait for the two to develop their relationship further, and there would be opportunities to eat together later. If she pushed too hard now, it might scare her away, which would not be good.
So, she nodded with a smile.
Lin Jie also said to Qin Xiaoxu beside him, "Didn't I tell you? They definitely won't make things difficult for you, they're all very understanding."
```
Qin Xiaoxu also took a few more glances over there. Although she had refused, she could see that the smiles on the faces of Lin Jie's parents still radiated kindness. You can't fool people with a look in your eyes; they must be very amicable people.
For almost an instant, Qin Xiaoxu found herself completely projecting herself into Lin Jie's family, or rather, she imagined herself as Lin Jie's girlfriend!
Ah spit spit spit!
Qin Xiaoxu hastily banished the thought, reminding herself in her mind, "This is just an act, don't get too carried away! I'm just making some extra money! I'm definitely not his girlfriend!"
Qin Xiaoxu immediately snapped back to reality, and then began eating again!
Meanwhile, Lin Yi was busy serving dishes to his wife, scraping off the excess oil from the dishes that were too greasy, and then feeding her personally.
Mother Lin saw that the dishes had mostly been served, with only one dish of golden and silver steamed buns remaining, and casually said to Lin Yi, "Lin Yi, it's about time, go toast the guests now, call everyone else and let's go."
And so, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei, Lin Yi's parents, as well as Han Xuewei's parents, and all the other bridesmaids and groomsmen got up with their drinks and began toasting the guests table by table.
All of the guests sent their most heartfelt blessings to Lin Yi and Han Xuewei, the newlyweds, and also praised the food here to no end!
"The braised dishes here can be considered some of Xiangcheng's most delicious and authentic, the flavor is really good!"
"Yes, especially that braised duck, the meat is tender and juicy, rich but not greasy, deeply flavorful! Such tasty dishes are rare in Xiangcheng!"
"With banquet halls and dining seats already, there should be private rooms too, right?"
Han Xuewei's father, hearing everyone's unending praise of the dishes, was of course very pleased.
He also told everyone, "We do have private rooms too! There are rooms for four people, as well as ones that can accommodate up to fifteen people, suitable for family gatherings or business entertaining! If you all come to visit in the future, I will definitely secure the biggest discount for everyone! The first month after opening, everything is 30% off!"
"We'll definitely come to patronize in the future!"
Lin Yi was also very happy, it seemed that it wasn't so difficult for the restaurant to gain a foothold in Xiangcheng. At that moment, Han Xuewei was also very satisfied, as long as her dad was happy, she too would feel good.
After finally toasting all the guests, an hour had flown by in the blink of an eye.
Because it was his big day, Lin Yi did not escape the toasts from relatives and friends, he seemed flushed and slightly red in the ears, the entire groomsman group had drunk quite a bit.
Some guests also came up to toast the bride, and even wanted bridesmaid Qin Xiaoxu to have a drink too, but Lin Jie stepped in to block them.
Thanks to Lin Jie's intervention, Qin Xiaoxu was quite grateful. It seemed that Lin Jie really did have a sense of responsibility.
Some groomsmen completely disregarded the bridesmaids' feelings, and when they saw others trying to get the bridesmaids to drink, they joined in the hubbub, even showing a bit of a 'the more chaos, the better' attitude. But unexpectedly, Lin Jie was so different!
It must be said, Qin Xiaoxu felt warmed by his actions, if only for a moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 148: Chapter 148 Facts
chapters.content:
Lin Jie's parents also saw their son blocking drinks for Qin Xiaoxu.
They were overjoyed!
Their precious son had finally come to his senses!
After toasting, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei, along with others, hurried back to their seats at the head table to grab a quick bite before preparing to see off guests at the restaurant's main entrance!
Weddings are really all about busying oneself, attending to guests; as joyous as they are, the exhausting parts are unavoidable.
But when you think about it, it's all worth it.
Such events happen only once in a lifetime after all! As long as you're happy at heart, what's a little suffering or fatigue?
It was also during this time that Han Xuewei took the opportunity to feed the baby for a while, with Qin Xiaoxu coming up to help. Lin Jie, having been drinking for his cousin, was now thoroughly drunk and was resting in a private room on the third floor.
And his parents planned to take him home once they were done with the busy work.
Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu were in the next private room, feeding the baby.
Suddenly Han Xuewei brought up the topic from earlier, and, smiling, she asked, "Xiaoxu, tell me the truth, do you already have a boyfriend?"
"You've kept it quite a secret! You didn't even tell me! How much longer were you planning to hide it? Have you stopped caring about our friendship?"
Qin Xiaoxu explained anxiously, "Vivi, you have to listen to me explain, it's not what you think at all!"
"I'll tell you the truth, I'm still single! I don't have a boyfriend."
Han Xuewei asked suspiciously, "Are you really still single? Then why didn't you tell the truth earlier?"
Qin Xiaoxu replied with a hint of aggrievement, "Here's the thing, I promised Lin Jie that for a while I'd pretend to be his girlfriend, just to satisfy his parents."
Han Xuewei's eyes widened in disbelief and she exclaimed, "What? That's really a thing? I'm curious, where did you two meet? How long have you known each other? You didn't seem that familiar with each other today!"
Since her best friend had asked, Qin Xiaoxu could only respond truthfully, "I saw his post on our school's confession wall, but when I added him as a friend, I had no idea he and Lin Yi were cousins, much less that he'd be coming to the wedding today as a groomsman! I really didn't know!"
Han Xuewei nodded and said, "Hmm, and then?"
Qin Xiaoxu continued, "Lin Jie had posted a message on the confession wall saying that if any girl was willing to help him, he would reward her handsomely. So I added him as a friend. We met once before, so we naturally got to know each other."
Listening intently, Han Xuewei's eyes shone with curiosity, "Wow, you two are so fated!"
But at that moment, Qin Xiaoxu shrugged her shoulders and said, "Fated? I don't care for such fate. I have no interest at all. Just now, when we were picking up the bride, seeing him scared me! It was only then that I realized his connection to Lin Yi! Isn't the world just too small?"
Han Xuewei kept smiling and said, "Well, I think that is fate, maybe it's your romantic destiny!"
"No, no, no, I don't care for that kind of romantic destiny, and besides, I, I'm... not interested in him..." Qin Xiaoxu said, realizing she felt a bit guilty.
And how could Han Xuewei, a close friend for many years, fail to notice that? "You're hesitating even to speak, and whenever you hesitate, it means you're not sure about it!"
"The two of you even might reach fruition in your relationship!"
Qin Xiaoxu, when told this, also knew she wasn't certain, but at the beginning, she indeed found the matter rather interesting and had joined in.
She had previously fantasized that maybe through this she could encounter romance, but looking at the current progress, there wasn't much development between her and Lin Jie, and Lin Jie completely disregarded such matters, not even giving Qin Xiaoxu any flutter of the heart.
Qin Xiaoxu had always been a rational person, especially when it came to relationships, so she wouldn't easily confess her true feelings to someone, much less fall for someone casually.
Han Xuewei, although she didn't say much more, already knew her best friend's predicament. Sometimes emotions are like this; they always come unexpectedly, and when they do, they're unstoppable.
If two people could end up together, that would already be fate, definitely not something one person could decide alone.
However, Han Xuewei just had a strong hunch, she felt that there definitely would be a story happening between these two.
Lin Yi finally finished seeing off the guests and drove back to the new villa.
By the time they returned, it was already 8:30 in the evening, with everyone busy with other matters. Lin Yi and Han Xuewei had nothing pressing to do, and there were still a few relatives staying in the house, and it was about time for the babies to feed and sleep.
The others talked with the guests, while Lin Yi and Han Xuewei tidied their bridal room, and after finishing, they joined the conversation.
According to local customs, they were supposed to serve tea to everyone.
The first to be served were Lin Yi's parents.
The couple sat side by side on the mahogany bench, Aunt Wang specially brought over the tea, Lin Yi, holding Han Xuewei, stood in the middle, and Han Xuewei took the tea, bowing to her father-in-law and mother-in-law, "Dad, your daughter-in-law offers you tea!"
Lin Yi's dad quickly took out the previously prepared red envelope, smiling as he agreed, "Good! Drink the tea."
He took the tea, drained the small cup in one gulp, and then set it back on the plate.
Han Xuewei took another cup of tea, calling out to her mother-in-law, "Mom! Your daughter-in-law offers you tea!"
Lin Yi's mom also hurriedly pulled out a red envelope, tossing it into Han Xuewei's hand, very happily saying, "Good! You and Lin Yi must manage this household well."
"Yes, I understand, Mom."
Lin Yi's mother was certainly very happy now; she was extremely pleased with her daughter-in-law!
After serving tea to the parents, it was time to serve tea to the other relatives!
Once this process was completed, Lin Yi's parents and Han Xuewei's parents together saw off the guests, then quickly went to freshen up, as they would help Aunt Wang and the two Maternity Matrons look after the babies later.
