Everyone had been busy all day today, and the babies, having gone out and met quite a few people, were pleased with the excitement of the whole day, so they would go to sleep later than usual today.
The Maternity Matrons and Aunt Wang planned to conveniently give the kids a bath and, before bedtime, feed them; otherwise, the babies would be uncomfortable.
The newly moved-into villa had a separate bathing area, and it was especially spacious, at least 15 square meters, so there was ample space for the adults to help the three babies bathe together.

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Chapter 149 Qianda Shopping Mall
chapters.content:
Lin Yi, elated, scooped Han Xuewei up in a princess carry and brought her into the bedroom.
And at that moment, a prompt from the system rang in his mind!
"Congratulations, host, you've unlocked a hidden task and earned the reward of Qianda Shopping Mall! (Domestic Chain)"
Right at that instant, Lin Yi's arms quivered while holding Han Xuewei!
Wow!
Qianda Shopping Mall!!
It's actually become mine??
Wow! Just wow!
Lin Yi was absolutely stunned by this news.
So now, wouldn't that mean his wealth had reached tens of billions?
But at that moment, Han Xuewei smiled and said mysteriously to Lin Yi, "Honey, today is our wedding day, and I want to accomplish something together with you."
Upon hearing that, Lin Yi felt a thump in his heart and then pinned Han Xuewei against the wall, "Baby, you're so forward today..."
Han Xuewei pushed him off with a giggly smile, saying, "It's not what you think, silly. It's another thing that we have to do together."
Lin Yi looked puzzled.
Han Xuewei sneaked a smile, then walked towards the wardrobe, rummaged around, and took out several sheets of white paper, some pens, and quite a few paints.
Lin Yi watched Han Xuewei curiously, asking, "Baby, what are you doing with these things? Don't tell me you want me to lay down and you'll paint a nude of me?"
Han Xuewei gave him an exasperated glance, saying indignantly, "Go away, who wants to paint that? You wish!"
She placed the paint and brushes aside, then started mixing colors on the palette. She chose a few and mixed them carefully, and after a moment, several attractive warm colors emerged.
She tidied up the paper, then said to Lin Yi beside her, "Come on, stretch out your hand."
Lin Yi obediently did as told, and Han Xuewei applied a lighter shade of blue with a brush.
Lin Yi stayed still, but the look he gave Han Xuewei started to grow odd.
"Baby, what are you trying to do?" Lin Yi watched as his hand was fully coated with paint.
However, Han Xuewei continued mysteriously, "Don't rush, you'll know soon."
Han Xuewei pulled Lin Yi's hand onto the paper, then pressed down!
After Lin Yi lifted his hand, she applied another color and immediately swapped to a new sheet, pressing a fresh handprint.
After repeating this process several times, she finally showed a satisfied expression and told Lin Yi to go to the washroom to clean up.
"Okay, you can go clean up now; you'll understand what I'm doing when you get back!"
Lin Yi, half-understanding, nodded, then rushed to the sink with his hands covered in paint.
After Lin Yi left, Han Xuewei took a clean brush and, using the same method, started working on herself, leaving her handprints on every piece of paper with Lin Yi's handprints.
When Lin Yi came back to the room, he instantly saw the neat array of artworks laid out before him.
He smiled, then wrapped Han Xuewei in his arms, very intimately and said, "Baby."
Han Xuewei, with her dirty hands, kissed Lin Yi's cheek, "Look, what do you think?"
Lin Yi nodded, looking at her affectionately, "Mmm, it's very beautiful, and I really like the meaning of this painting too."
"To hold your hand and to grow old with you together. Vivi, rest assured, I will never let you down!"
Han Xuewei smiled back at him, without saying much, Lin Yi understood its meaning, maybe that's what matching souls are like!
She had always believed that Lin Yi would indeed fulfill his promises to her!
"Mhmm, okay."
Lin Yi hugged Han Xuewei even tighter, and what followed was a series of passionate kisses. Han Xuewei pushed him, "Honey, I'm going to take a shower now."
Lin Yi kissed her deeply again, "Let me help you wash your hands first, the paint is hard to get off."
The next second, he swept her up in a princess carry and headed straight for the restroom.
True love is just like this, to hold your hand and to grow old with you together.
By the time the next morning came around, Han Xuewei was almost holding her waist with one hand as she got up, calling the soundly sleeping Lin Yi at her side while shaking him, "Honey, it's not early anymore, time to get up."
Lin Yi rubbed his sleepy eyes and checked the time, "Baby, we can sleep a bit longer, we don't have anything to rush for today anyway."
But Han Xuewei said to him, "We need to get up early today, according to custom, both of us have to get up early to serve tea to our parents."
After hearing this, Lin Yi scrambled out of the bed too, "Got it, I'm getting up. The first day of married life starts with listening to my wife!"
And so, the two of them went to freshen up together.
All their daily necessities now were couple versions, some were even freshly changed to red yesterday, and for a moment, Han Xuewei felt her happiness was off the charts.
Lin Yi saw her looking at him with a smile while he brushed his teeth, and gently touched her head with his hand, "What are you thinking about? You're smiling so happily."
Han Xuewei teased, "I am thinking, ah! Will you dare to bully me in the future? I'll tell mom and dad at the first instance! Let them teach you a lesson."
Lin Yi chuckled mischievously, "You want to tattle? I want to hear how you will tell on me. Will you tell them the details?"
Han Xuewei playfully gave him a look, "Go away, annoying."
Then she started washing her face on her own, no longer paying attention to Lin Yi. Due to the lack of time to wash her hair, she had to simply manage with some spray, before changing her clothes.
Lin Yi's parents were also aware of this custom, so they got up early in the morning too, while Aunt Wang and the two maternity matrons had already fed the babies and took them out to the yard for a walk.
Maybe because the babies had played non-stop the day before, they were especially tired at night, sleeping even more soundly, and didn't wake up throughout the night.
By the time the babies woke up in the morning, Aunt Wang and the two maternity matrons had been pushing the strollers, already having made several rounds in this vast courtyard!
It must be said, the babies had been growing rapidly during this time, their weight and height had seen noticeable increases, with Da Bao looking even sturdier than the other two.
Now whenever Lin Yi picked up Da Bao, he could distinctly feel the increased weight.
He and Han Xuewei went downstairs together, as they had only moved here two or three days ago, they hadn't had the chance to take a close look at the structure of the place. The wedding kept them so busy that they seemed to be running around for everything.
Aunt Wang greeted the newlywed couple with a smile, "Ah, if it isn't our groom and bride, you're up so early today."

chapters.title: Chapter 150: Chapter 150 Preparation for Returning to School
chapters.content:
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei replied with a laugh, "Aunt Wang, good morning."
Han Xuewei turned her head and asked, "Aunt Wang, is it just you? Where are the others?"
Aunt Wang said, "Everyone has gone out to take the babies for a walk in the yard."
After hearing this, Han Xuewei was somewhat uncertain and asked quietly, "Aunt Wang, according to the custom, I am supposed to pour tea for my parents this morning. Since they aren't here right now, should I do it at noon instead?"
After hearing this, Aunt Wang replied with a laugh, gently shaking her head, "Ah, Vivi, the custom you're talking about is from a long time ago. Nowadays, it's not that troublesome. Just now your parents were saying, all you need to do today is offer some prayers to the gods. Vivi, Lin Yi, if you haven't rested well, you can go back to sleep for a bit. I will call you when lunch is ready."
Before Han Xuewei could speak, Aunt Wang added, "Also, the three babies slept really well last night without waking up for milk. This morning, after filling their bellies, I thought I'd let you sleep in instead of waking you up early."
It had to be said, the three little ones truly exhausted themselves playing yesterday and behaved quite well.
They slept especially soundly on the night of their parents' wedding, without waking at all!
Not bad at all, such well-behaved little ones!
Lin Yi smiled.
After hearing this, Han Xuewei quickly said, "Husband, let's go for a walk too! After all, we've been here for several days now and haven't had the chance to properly explore the area."
After saying this, they bade farewell to Aunt Wang and the couple walked out towards the outside.
As they walked, Lin Yi said to her, "Vivi, I have a suggestion. Is it time to start weaning the baby off breast milk?"
Han Xuewei, of course, was not willing and asked with confusion, "Why do you ask this all of a sudden? The kids are only three months old, and the weaning you mention should wait until they are at least five months. Besides, breast milk is superior to formula in many ways."
But Lin Yi seriously explained, "I've been thinking, since we'll need to go back to school next week, continuing to breastfeed will definitely be inconvenient. Plus, you wouldn't want to suddenly ask for leave during class to pump milk, right? And there's nowhere to store the pumped milk anyway."
Only then did Han Xuewei come to her senses, considering his words, "You're right, I overlooked this issue."
Lin Yi was actually very thoughtful about Han Xuewei's concerns, so he began to offer suggestions.
He pondered for a moment and then said, "How about this, don't we have an RV?"
Lin Yi smiled and then said, "Our RV is equipped with a fridge, which could be really useful. You can just extract milk in our RV, and the fridge can be used for storage, so upon reflection, it's actually quite convenient. Naturally, there are no other issues."
Han Xuewei also had a moment of realization and said, "Yeah, why didn't I think of that? Husband, that's a great idea!"
Lin Yi suddenly said with a mischievous smile, "And there's another use for it; if we want to go on a date, we can use the RV for some private space!"
Han Xuewei's face turned red and she protested, "Hey now, you can't do anything reckless, the school is a public place."
But Lin Yi turned it around, "I didn't say anything though, I just meant we could kiss in the RV! The school is a public place, so it's not good to kiss in front of everyone."
Han Xuewei pursed her lips and said, "But going to the RV could be misunderstood by others."
Lin Yi embraced Han Xuewei and said with a laugh, "What's there to fear, we are a legally married couple, we've got our marriage certificate, let them misunderstand however they like. I really don't care."
Han Xuewei had no choice but to silently pray that Lin Yi wouldn't get up to mischief when they returned to school!
The two of them arrived in the yard, and soon found the family.
Mother Lin saw her son and daughter-in-law and asked with a smile, "Why are you up so early? Aren't you sleeping in today?"
Lin Yi replied with a smile, "Vivi got me up to come see the babies and spend some parent-child time. I've been sleeping in too much these days."
Having such a spacious yard at home is really comfortable! At least there will be no annoying neighbors to disturb and ruin a good mood for the day.
Mother Lin suddenly inquired, "Lin Yi, Vivi, you two are going back to school next week, is there anything else you need to prepare?"
Lin Yi replied, "We are almost done with the preparations. Let's go a day in advance tomorrow and get all the necessary paperwork sorted out."
The two mothers readily agreed, "Then just go ahead and do what you need to do. Don't worry about the babies, just come and visit when you have the time. After graduating smoothly, you can come back and look after the children with peace of mind!"
Lin Yi had no other choice, as his father-in-law had fully planned to retire, and besides, there were quite a few immovable properties in Xiao Chuan County. Just Han's Private Kitchen alone had over a dozen restaurants, and he had already handed over the management of those restaurants.
Although this reduced the profits he received, it was time to subtract rather than add burdens in life at an older age.
Han Xuewei nodded, "I understand, Mom."
In fact, Han Xuewei had some plans of her own. She hoped to make a difference in her field of expertise after graduation, so she wasn't eager to take over her father's restaurant.
When it was noon, she asked Lin Yi, "Husband, would you consider taking over that restaurant after you graduate?"
Lin Yi responded honestly, "Actually, I could consider it, as I won't be busy with anything else in the short term. So I could learn about business by running the restaurant."
After hearing this, Han Xuewei finally breathed a sigh of relief, "That's great, as long as you're willing, I wouldn't want to trouble you. My major is in fine arts, and after graduating, I hope to pursue development in this direction. At least for now, I'm not too keen on taking over my dad's business.
My initial dream was to hold my own art exhibition, and I want it to be on an international platform."
Lin Yi himself didn't have many plans, he believed that making money was the most important thing. If his wife had ambitions and dreams, he would definitely support her!
Then, he patted his chest and said to Han Xuewei, "Vivi, you don't need to think too much or worry too much. I will handle the restaurant, so just go ahead and pursue what you like. If you encounter any difficulties and need my help, I'll face them with you."

chapters.title: Chapter 151: Chapter 151 Sick
chapters.content:
```
Just at that moment, the voice of the system echoed in Lin Yi's mind.
"Congratulations to the host for completing the new task, reward is a ten percent share of Supreme Grade Supermarket."
Upon hearing the system's voice, Lin Yi froze in place. He hadn't yet figured out the things that had been given to him before, and now, the system had directly granted him the largest national chain of Supreme Grade Supermarkets.
That ten percent share was no small sum.
It excited Lin Yi immensely, after all, one shouldn't say no to free money.
The next day.
He brought Han Xuewei with him back to their former university, and having completed all the necessary procedures, they walked through their old campus.
Lin Yi felt quite sentimental. He really hadn't expected to be with the once campus belle, and after being married for so long, stepping on this land once more still gave him a subtle feeling.
Although Lin Yi felt that they were a couple that married first and fell in love later, supposedly leading to an ordinary life like any other husband and wife, it seemed that they had grown closer and closer, becoming inseparable.
Now, Lin Yi walked hand in hand with Han Xuewei through the campus. They had known each other back in their university days without ever greeting one another, yet now they were a married couple, walking on this once-familiar ground, each step seemed so precious.
Han Xuehui looked at the flowers and plants on campus and laughed, saying, "What was your reaction when you knew I liked you?"
Hearing this, Lin Yi was somewhat surprised, and with a slight frown and a curl of his lips, he said, "Thank you for liking me."
His words were filled with deep affection, and Han Xuewei was visibly surprised, her complexion reddening. She didn't respond to Lin Yi but walked ahead, and Lin Yi immediately followed her, a gentle look on his face.
"I'm serious, I really didn't expect you would like me. I was very happy. If you hadn't liked me then, perhaps I wouldn't have had the courage to see you!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei seemed quite pleased with Lin Yi's answer and began to giggle.
Then the two of them went to their old cafeteria to eat. The taste was still familiar. Sitting opposite each other, many junior students who saw this scene started talking among themselves.
"Isn't that the Campus Belle sister? She's graduating. Once she graduates, won't our school lose its Campus Belle?"
"That senior sister is really beautiful, and the guy opposite her is quite handsome too!"
"A perfect match, that's more like it."
"Why do I feel like the two of them seem more like a married couple than boyfriend and girlfriend?"
"How could that be! The senior sister is still so young..."
People whispered among themselves, many showing expressions of surprise, but none of them would believe that Han Xuewei was married, much less a mother of three.
After all, Han Xuewei still looked very much the young girl she used to be, with bright eyes and white teeth, very attractive.
Lin Yi hardly touched his food. Instead, he was much more interested in watching Han Xuewei eat. She noticed it and immediately froze, her pretty face turning bright red. She tapped on Lin Yi's hand and said, "You're supposed to eat, why are you looking at me?"
"Because you're beautiful!"
```
Lin Yi wasn't embarrassed at all and immediately made his stance clear; in fact, he had just overheard some idle gossip.
Those people were coveting his wife, and he certainly wasn't having it.
What? You can only look from a distance! I can admire her up close!
After finishing the meal, Lin Yi took Han Xuewei with him. Once in the car, Lin Yi had prepared quite a few snacks for Han Xuewei.
He kept handing bag after bag of snacks to Han Xuewei, who, seeing this, was momentarily stunned.
"I'm going to class, not camping!"
Han Xuewei, looking at Lin Yi's exaggerated actions, couldn't help but tease him.
Lin Yi, hearing this, just scratched his head and said, "I'm worried you might get hungry!"
It's only a few hours of class, but Lin Yi seemed exceptionally concerned about it, now truly worried that Han Xue might get cold or hungry, he was completely in full-on nanny mode.
Han Xuewei just smiled, casually took a pack of snacks, and left to reassure Lin Yi. In reality, she wasn't very fond of them, but she felt a warm fuzziness knowing that Lin Yi had specifically prepared them for her.
Lin Yi had classes to attend as well, but their class times usually didn't overlap.
However, it was surprisingly coincidental that their class end times matched up. At three in the afternoon, they both left the building together, with Lin Yi driving and Han Xuewei falling asleep in the passenger seat.
The ride from school back home was not short, and it took half an hour before Lin Yi brought Han Xuewei back.
As soon as the two of them entered the door, they saw Lin Yi's mother holding her phone in a panic, her brows deeply furrowed.
Lin Yi instinctively thought something had happened. Lin Yi's mother then turned her head, and seeing Lin Yi, her face lit up with joy, and she blurted out, "I was just about to call you when you two arrived."
"Lin Yi, today I noticed something off about Da Bao's condition. He didn't want to eat and had a bit of diarrhea. He seemed really uncomfortable when he went to the bathroom, and his face was pale and ashen. I already gave him a little medicine, but I'm still very worried. Maybe we should take the child to the hospital."
Hearing Lin Yi's mother's words, Han Xuewei immediately looked anxious. She slapped her forehead as if she had just remembered something and said, "Oh no! I actually forgot this, the babies have not had a check-up or vaccination for nearly two months, I've been so busy recently that it totally slipped my mind..."
Seeing Han Xuewei's panicked expression, Lin Yi felt a bit guilty. The baby's well-being shouldn't just be Han Xuewei's concern alone. He immediately patted Han Xuewei on the shoulder and said, "I was also negligent about this. Don't blame yourself; it's nothing serious. It's normal for kids to have a reaction or two. It's not too late to take him for a check-up now!"
Lin Yi's words did calm Han Xuewei down a bit. Whenever it came to the baby, she would get flustered.
Although she was now a mother, she still frequently worried that her carelessness might lead to some problem for the baby.
"Weiwei, why don't you make an appointment for the baby on your phone? I'll go outside and start the car," Lin Yi said, then walked out, taking the keys with him.
Han Xuewei immediately went to the room to carry the baby out, and they both got in the car. On the way, Han Xuewei was very concerned because Da Bao's complexion did not look very good.
The usually lively Da Bao was especially subdued today.
Upon arriving at the hospital, Lin Yi processed a series of documents and went straight to the doctor, saying, "Doctor, the child has a bit of diarrhea and has taken some medicine, but it seems that he hasn't gotten better yet..."

chapters.title: Chapter 152: Chapter 152 Seeing a Doctor
chapters.content:
Hearing Lin Yi's words, the doctor directly took Da Bao into his arms. He was very professional, gently lifting Da Bao's clothes with his hands and pressing on the baby's belly.
He said calmly, "The child probably just has a bit of indigestion; there's some bloating in the stomach. It's just ordinary gas. Giving the child some Potion to relieve the gas should do the trick!"
"Also, with common medications, when it's not too severe, don't feed them to the child. It's better to bring the child to the hospital. Then, regarding the diet of little children, it's best to keep it light and avoid letting them eat a lot at times and little at others, as that can easily lead to indigestion."
The doctor spoke methodically, while Lin Yi made sure to remember each point.
The common knowledge that the doctor mentioned was not well understood by Han Xuewei and their partner. On normal days, they didn't pay much attention to Da Bao's diet; they primarily focused on making sure the child was well-fed.
But the doctor indeed advised against letting the toddler eat too much; just enough was appropriate.
Thinking of this, both of them felt a bit remorseful and revealed an expression of distress, realizing they had been too careless.
Seeing the couple's expression, the doctor couldn't help but smile and said, "Ah, it's normal for young people not to understand. You'll gradually learn and come to understand in time."
Just as the couple was about to leave, Han Xuewei seemed to remember something, turned her head back, and asked the doctor, "The child has almost missed two months of vaccinations; can he get them now?"
"As for vaccinations, let's wait until after the child has recovered," replied the doctor.
Having said that, Han Xuewei and Lin Yi both bowed to the doctor, expressed their thanks, and left with the Potion that the doctor had prescribed.
That night, after Da Bao had a bit of Potion, his stomach stopped acting up, his complexion improved, and he started giggling again. He fussed around on the bed for a little while before he was willing to sleep.
After Lin Yi had lulled the baby to sleep, the system sent another doctor's notification sound.
"Congratulations, Host, for feeding Da Bao to great satisfaction. As a reward, the system grants you 100,000 yuan as startup funds."
Lin Yi was somewhat surprised, curved his lips slightly, and checked his mobile phone, where he indeed received a transfer message on Alipay.
After putting the children to bed, Han Xuewei came to Lin Yi's side, and they both slept soundly until morning.
The next day when the two woke up, they heard a commotion outside. Han Xuewei glanced at Lin Yi, who also wore a puzzled look. They were still a bit groggy as they stepped out of the room, and just then, Lin Yi's mother was excitedly shouting.
"That's wonderful, that's wonderful, my grandson is sure to be successful in the future!!"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei was still a bit confused. Both of them looked ahead and walked into the children's room.
At that moment, Er Bao lifted his round eyes and looked at Lin Yi and Han Xuewei. The couple was still somewhat stunned and asked, "Mom, what are you showing us?"
"Er Bao can roll over now!"
At this news, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's eyes widened instantly. For them, every single detail of their child's development was highly memorable.
Er Bao was now placed on the bed, looking around with his big round eyes. Lin Yi's mother was especially thrilled, standing beside Er Bao and clapping her hands saying, "My little grandson! Keep it up, keep it up!!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh as well, walking over to Er Bao's side and continuously cheering him on.
At this moment, Er Bao's eyes were round and wide, his little cheeks flushed red.
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei both ran to the right side of the bed, continuously cheering him on.
Seeing them, Er Bao too became extremely excited, clapping his hands and laughing, then suddenly stretching his legs, he rolled right over.
He really did turn over, and upon seeing this scene, both Lin Yi and Han Xuewei excitedly embraced each other.
Han Xuewei, very excited, picked Er Bao up and said with a slight smile, "You little rascal can roll over now, aren't you clever."
Lin Yi leaned toward her, gently touched Er Bao's little head, and couldn't help but smile softly.
"Kids grow up so quickly, pretty soon he'll be able to turn over, sit up, then walk, and talk. Step by step he'll grow, go to elementary school, middle school, high school, university..."
As Lin Yi murmured, his eyes suddenly filled with tears; he didn't understand why he felt this way.
Han Xuewei was taken aback by Lin Yi's words, and both of them were stunned for a good while before bursting into laughter again.
Indeed, the child would certainly grow up and then slowly leave them, and they would age too; it was an irreversible fact. But what of it? The important thing was to cherish the present.
The present child still needed them, and they were not that mature as adults either; they were family members growing up alongside the children.
Just when the family was happily chatting away, Dad Han came by; typically he was tied up until late, and usually only stopped by in the evenings, but today he came over at noon.
Seeing Dad Han, Lin Yi immediately stepped forward and asked, "Dad, has something happened?"
Hearing Lin Yi's question, Dad Han showed a look of helplessness. Recently his workload had been very heavy; after all, the hotel had just started a series of events, and the new staff all needed his attention.
Dad Han sat down, his face etched with worry, and Lin Yi, sensing something amiss, sat down with him. When Dad Han sighed, Lin Yi poured him a glass of water.
Dad Han then began, "I indeed encountered some troubles. My older brother has previously visited my hotel, and now he has just called saying he wants his daughter to come over here to learn!"
"I was going to oppose it since his daughter studied art and it has nothing to do with hotels. I didn't understand what he was intending to do. But he insisted, saying a non-demanding position for his daughter would suffice, you know, Han Xuemei whom you met last time."
On hearing Dad Han's words, Lin Yi remembered the Han Xuemei he met before.
He simply nodded, listening silently as Dad Han continued to speak.
"I always wanted to refuse; it put me in such an awkward position. But I couldn't just fail to look after her since she is, after all, my niece."
Hearing Dad Han's words, Lin Yi could tell he was somewhat helpless and said, "Have you arranged a place for her to stay? Upon hearing these words, Dad Han was still driving, there is accommodation on the hotel side. Just let her stay there."
Naturally, Dad Han could not arrange for Han Xuemei to stay here since this place belonged to the Lin Family, and besides, Han Xuewei didn't quite like her cousin.
He, like Han Xuewei, didn't have much liking for Han Xuemei either, for she was too scheming.
At this moment, scratching his head, Dad Han spoke, "I don't have much time tonight, how about you go there to pick her up later? It's too busy at the hotel!"

chapters.title: Chapter 153 Pressuring to Get Married
chapters.content:
```
Hearing this, Lin Yi just nodded; for him, this was not a big deal.
As Dad Han was about to leave, Lin Yi immediately stood up and blocked his path, saying, "Dad! Having worked so hard, you should stay and have a meal here before you go…"
Upon hearing this, Dad Han immediately shook his head and said, "No, no, it's really too busy over there. I'll just have a quick bite and then I need to head over. Remember to pick up Han Xuemei."
Lin Yi nodded and then saw Dad Han off before picking up his phone to make a call.
Without any hesitation, Lin Yi arranged an apartment. He didn't like the idea of Han Xue not staying at their home, especially since Han Xuemei and Han Xuewei didn't get along.
He didn't want to cause Han Xuewei any trouble, so he had Han Xuemei stay somewhere else.
At this moment, Han Xuemei was still packing her luggage. She saw the message from Dad Han on her phone that Lin Yi would pick her up, and a smile curled on her lips.
Once she truly arrived at the Lin Family's home, everything would go the way she wanted. She just hadn't anticipated that Dad Han had no intention to let her go to the Lin Family's home.
...
Meanwhile, Qin Xiaoxu was also very troubled because her parents had attended Lin Yi's wedding banquet. That segment of the video had been filmed and somehow ended up on her parents' phones.
Now that they were back, with strict household rules as usual, she had to report everything to them.
So now, facing Qin Xiaoxu, the elderly couple directly asked who that boy was and if they knew him.
Hearing these words made Qin Xiaoxu's head ache. She felt extremely helpless, remembering how, when she had an early love affair as a child, her parents had also shown a gossipy demeanor.
She wasn't sure if they were interested in her love life or what, but eventually, she became resistant to such matters. But now she was no longer young, and naturally her parents very much hoped she would find someone to marry soon.
But at this moment, Qin Xiaoxu felt distressed; naturally, she couldn't possibly reveal her situation with Lin Jie.
She could only attempt to explain helplessly, yet her explanations sounded so powerless in front of her parents. Even she didn't believe them, but what else could she do?
The elderly couple was very curious, moving closer to Qin Xiaoxu and directly saying, "Actually, sometimes you should take initiative, right? The young man I saw was rather decent."
Hearing her parents' concern, Qin Xiaoxu grew a bit panicked and stepped back.
Her parents had no intention of letting her off the hook, continuing, "You really need to seize the opportunity. We're worried about you. Think about your age now; you can't always be staying at home. Yes, you should go out more often, sometimes with young men…"
As expected, the conversation had turned back to her being single. But at this moment, Qin Xiaoxu felt utterly helpless, and then stood up, "You both just rest assured, I absolutely won't have trouble finding someone to marry, no more questions!"
The elderly couple was still unwilling to give up and immediately responded, "If you know you won't have trouble getting married, you should be more confident and take a direct approach."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu was even more at a loss, and she patted her head before escaping to her room.
```
"This child really knows how to dodge the topic every time it's brought up…"
The Qin family's parents were worried that Qin Xiaoxu was too naive and could be deceived by others, considering how strictly they had raised her from childhood.
As a result, Qin Xiaoxu's social circle had become very small; she hardly interacted with boys outside, and over time, developed a tendency to keep to herself.
…
When Lin Yi went to pick up Han Xuemei, she was dressed very elegantly. Her outfit was quite bold and avant-garde, and she stood by the roadside with a suitcase in tow.
As Lin Yi drove up to her, Han Xuemei waved at him and flashed an enchanting smile, saying quite openly, "Brother-in-law, you've finally arrived."
As she spoke, Han Xuemei went directly to the passenger seat and took a seat, prompting a clear look of displeasure from Lin Yi.
Moreover, Han Xuemei was trying too hard to cozy up to him. Lin Yi felt they were not very close, yet Han Xuemei acted as though they were very intimate, which only increased his aversion.
Lin Yi didn't respond to her, simply driving in silence, but Han Xuemei was very keen on starting a conversation. She talked on and on by herself.
However, Han Xuemei's words did not catch Lin Yi's attention at all. He had no intention of engaging with her, leaving her somewhat helpless until she mentioned Han Xuewei and the children.
It was only then that Lin Yi would occasionally respond with a word or two.
But Han Xuemei was obviously very eager and couldn't wait to build a good relationship with Lin Yi, so she chattered nonstop throughout the ride. Lin Yi, finding it annoying, finally spoke up coldly, "Sorry, I'm driving. Can you just be quiet for a while!"
Lin Yi said coolly. Hearing this, Han Xuemei froze in place, fumbling with her phone, her head bowed in embarrassment.
But soon, as if she had found another topic, Han Xuemei reached for her bag and said, "Brother-in-law, I spent a long time at the mall, picked out lots of gifts for the little ones. We can bring them over to play with, they'll definitely be happy."
Lin Yi glanced at her impassively and shook his head, "There's no need to buy anything. I'll take you straight to the apartment. The conditions and amenities there are very good; you can stay there for now."
At these words, Han Xuemei showed a look of surprise, nearly dropping her phone, her eyes fixed on Lin Yi as she asked, "Brother-in-law, aren't we going back to your house?"
Hearing this, Lin Yi just frowned and didn't look directly at her.
He spoke his mind bluntly, "No! It's the same if you stay at the apartment. I think it's inappropriate and inconvenient for you to stay at our house."
Lin Yi said outright, his voice cold, as if he was not inclined to spare Han Xuemei's feelings.
Instantly, Han Xuemei's expression froze, unsure whether to keep looking at her phone or respond to Lin Yi's curt words.
In a moment, an awkward silence fell between the two, but while Lin Yi seemed indifferent, Han Xuemei was visibly anxious.

chapters.title: Chapter 154: Chapter 154 Shocked
chapters.content:
Han Xuemei had thought that Lin Yi would at least take her to their family home to stay, seeing as Han Xuewei was also there, and it seemed quite reasonable for her, as the younger sister, to go there.
But what she hadn't expected was that Lin Yi didn't give her any face at all, he flatly refused and even said that he had found an apartment for her!
What could she say at that point? When someone says it's inconvenient, what more could she say?
Moreover, it wasn't like she had nowhere to stay, so his explanation was even more awkward. Lin Yi seemed to see her discomfort and spoke directly, "Don't worry, the apartment I've arranged for you is in great condition, with all the facilities you need.
If there's anything else you need, I can get it for you, and you don't have to worry about the rent or utilities, I've already paid them in advance."
Lin Yi spoke indifferently, his aim was to leave Han Xuemei with no excuse to wriggle out of this situation.
But Han Xuemei's face turned very grim, her purpose for coming here was to move into the Lin Family home, and now being told to live in an apartment, why did she even bother coming?
So Han Xuemei immediately put on a pitiful expression and said, "Actually, that's not what I was thinking. I wanted to go to your family home mainly because there are more people, and I'd be very scared living alone in an apartment."
Hearing this, Lin Yi just smiled faintly and replied.
"The security over there is very strict, they patrol each building thoroughly, and I can hire someone to protect you expressly. The quality conditions are top-notch, there's really no need for such worries."
Lin Yi continued indifferently, and Han Xuemei was instantly petrified. She knew that wasn't what he meant, but naturally, Lin Yi wouldn't let her have her way, just coldly watching her.
Han Xuemei was far too scheming, having mapped out her plan from the start. Her motives were certainly not innocent, so Lin Yi would never let her stay close to him.
Moreover, having such a woman around would make Han Xuewei jealous, not to mention he simply didn't like Han Xuemei that much.
Throughout the trip, Lin Yi had fulfilled whatever requests Han Xuemei made, but his one stipulation was that she must not enter the Lin Family household. There really was nothing she could do, and neither spoke again for the rest of the journey. Soon, Lin Yi drove Han Xuemei to the hotel, where he stopped the car and told Han Xuemei to take out her luggage.
But Dad Han also came out from the first floor of the hotel, and when he saw Han Xuemei and Lin Yi, he greeted them. Han Xuemei, inherently very good at ingratiating herself with others.
Upon seeing Dad Han, she immediately called out sweetly, "Uncle," while Lin Yi just nodded his head.
"Xue Mei, if you have any problems here, you can ask Lin Yi. He's quite familiar with everything around here!"
Dad Han said, and Lin Yi nodded before saying, "I've already found her an apartment nearby, she can move in right away."
Lin Yi exchanged a few more pleasantries with Dad Han, at that moment Han Xuemei's expression was particularly ugly.
If not for her desire to get close to Lin Yi and enter the Lin Family home, why would she have come to work in this shoddy hotel? She had never done such menial labor in her life, and now it had backfired.
Lin Yi glanced at her from the corner of his eye, not knowing what Han Xuemei's ultimate purpose was, but as a woman with such deep schemes, he naturally didn't want to interact with her much.
Lin Yi made a phone call and asked the manager to come down.
The manager was somewhat embarrassed when he arrived because he was late, but Lin Yi didn't blame him, he just instructed him on a few things and asked him to lead Han Xuemei to the apartment where he was staying.
Han Xuemei originally wanted to continue exploring the apartment with Lin Yi, to understand the various construction materials. In truth, she wanted to take the opportunity to spend some alone time with him.
But Lin Yi instantly refused, simply shaking his head as he said, "I need to go buy some daily necessities for the kids!"
Speaking indifferently, the manager immediately understood Lin Yi probably wanted to get rid of this woman.
So, he immediately put on a professional smile and said, "Miss Han, I'm in charge here! If you have any questions, you can call me. Here's my business card."
After saying this, he handed a business card to Han Xuemei, whose expression was very unpleasant as she directly took the card, looking in the direction where Lin Yi had left.
However, when Han Xuemei carefully read the company name on the business card, she was struck dumb on the spot, frowning as she blurted out, "My brother-in-law is the owner here??"
How come she had never heard Han Xuewei mention this building to her?
What in the world was going on?
Seeing Han Xuemei's shocked expression, the manager just nodded calmly. He assumed Lin Yi preferred to keep a low profile and thus hadn't revealed his assets to outsiders.
But at that moment, Han Xuemei was completely stunned in place, and the manager did not continue to discuss the matter. Instead, he changed the subject and said, "Miss Han, since you have come to our place, we will naturally provide you with excellent service. If there's anything lacking in your apartment, be sure to tell me right away; just a phone call will do. I will have it sent over to you."
Han Xuemei stood there dazed, not listening to what the manager was saying to her.
Since her brother-in-law was the owner of this building, he must be very wealthy, for this building was an incredibly valuable property. Han Xuemei's expression was one of utter amazement at the revelation.
Previously, she knew that Lin Yi's family was well-off and that they owned several companies, but she had never imagined that Lin Yi was connected to this building, which surprised her even more.
Yet Han Xuewei was her cousin, so why hadn't she mentioned this before? Could it be that Han Xuewei herself did not know?
At that moment, Han Xuemei's heart was racing with excitement. She had not expected Lin Yi to be such a wealthy person.
Before, she only knew that Lin Yi came from a comfortably off family, but she had never imagined that he could afford such an expensive building.
Soon, Han Xuemei arrived at the apartment and was startled by the scene before her.
The apartment, which could well be described as a villa, had an incredibly pleasant environment, and the living conditions and space were spacious. The equipment was also very complete, so much so that she couldn't even find any fault.
At that moment, the manager stood aside Han Xuemei, bowed slightly, and said, "Miss Han, if there's anything you need, please let me know."
Seeing how exquisite and luxurious the place was, Han Xuemei realized she didn't need anything and waved her hand, saying, "No need."
Han Xuemei's attitude was very cold. This apartment had been arranged by Lin Yi, but at this moment, she acted as if it belonged to her, with a manner that seemed to rush people off.

chapters.title: Chapter 155: Chapter 155 Da Bao Grows Up
chapters.content:
After leaving the building, Lin Yi went straight to the hotel operated by his father-in-law. The first floor of the hotel was decorated like a restaurant, where many guests came to dine.
Lin Yi didn't want to get involved with a woman like Han Xuelai, so he didn't linger and quickly returned home. It was only after he got back that he realized his family hadn't eaten yet, probably waiting for him.
Lin Yi's mother came straight up to him and said, "Lin Yi, why are you back so late today? Didn't you go to drop off Vivi's cousin? Why did it take so long!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi replied, "Mom, I've already found her an apartment. She's staying over there, and it will be very convenient for her to go to the hotel from there."
After hearing his reply, Lin Yi's mother nodded and didn't say much more. At this time, Lin Yi went upstairs, ready to call Han Xuewei down for dinner. It was only when he reached the top of the stairs that he saw Han Xuewei arranging their wedding photos.
She was meticulously sorting them one by one, and when she heard the door open, Han Xuewei turned her head, and Lin Yi was standing in front of her. He walked over with a smile and asked, "What are you doing?"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei just gave a faint smile and said, "I'm almost done with our photos from before. I'm thinking of hanging them up. Do you think it's a good idea to hang them in the middle above our bed?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi nodded and said, "Let's go downstairs to eat first, and later I'll help you hang them."
After saying this, Han Xuewei nodded, and after dinner, the two of them went to play with Da Bao and Er Bao.
The little one was asleep at this time, very well-behaved.
Lin Yi picked up Da Bao, preparing to bathe him, and at that moment, little Da Bao was laughing joyfully. Lin Yi grabbed Da Bao's little arms and burst into laughter.
"This little guy's arms are just like lotus roots, joint by joint."
Hearing Lin Yi describe it like that, Han Xuewei laughed out loud, happily watching Lin Yi.
Both of them were bathing the children, and Da Bao was enjoying the bubbles in the bathtub, his eyes bright and adorable, always staring at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi handed a bottle of warm milk to Da Bao, and upon seeing the bottle, Da Bao's expression immediately lit up with joy, his little hands reaching out to grab it.
But Lin Yi did not give it to him directly, and Da Bao's mouth turned down in frustration, about to cry.
Lin Yi just shook his head and said, "Da Bao, you can't cry, okay? If you cry, I won't give it to you."
It was as if Da Bao understood, looking pitiful, his little red face still reaching out for the milk bottle in Lin Yi's hand, but no matter how much he tried, he couldn't get it.
Da Bao turned to look at Han Xuewei, who just chuckled.
At that moment, Han Xuewei was arranging Er Bao's clothes and handed the milk bottle to Er Bao.
Er Bao started drinking, and seeing Er Bao with the bottle made Da Bao even more upset, and he burst into tears with a loud wail.
Seeing Da Bao like this, Lin Yi shook his head but still seriously holding his own bottle said, "As an older brother, you need to be an example for your brother and sister. You're already a little man. If you listen to daddy and manage to roll over, I will definitely give it to you!"
Lin Yi coaxed, pointing to the bottle, and Han Xuewei, hearing this, also smiled and nodded. She moved closer to Lin Yi and said, "Da Bao, you need to be good. You need to learn to roll over like Er Bao. Once you can roll over, mommy will feed you right away, and we won't drink from the bottle in daddy's hand anymore."
With a mix of coaxing and trickery, Da Bao's eyes lit up with yearning when he heard Han Xuewei say she was going to nurse him.
He was initially upset, but now started to cheer up, wiggling his little bottom, fluttering his legs non-stop, trying to turn over.
But just as he lifted up a bit, just as he inclined a little, he fell back down again. Seeing this, both Lin Yi and Han Xuewei looked resolutely at Da Bao and said, "Don't be discouraged, Da Bao! You're almost there, you can do it!"
Er Bao was also standing by, looking dazedly at Da Bao's great effort, tensing his arms and legs. Lin Yi found this scene very exciting.
He had never thought children could be so amusing and immediately grabbed his phone to record the scene.
"Thump!!"
Finally, Da Bao's legs thrust hard, and his whole body flipped over. Lin Yi exclaimed in surprise, while Han Xuewei immediately scooped up Er Bao.
Da Bao seemed to feel the joy of victory, constantly slapping his soft hands, his eyes brimming with delight.
But at that moment, seeing Han Xuewei pick up Er Bao, Da Bao stood frozen on the spot, babbling as if he were complaining.
Hearing this, Han Xuewei laughed and explained, "Don't worry, Da Bao. Mommy is just bringing your little brother over here. I'm still going to nurse you."
Hearing this, Da Bao finally showed a happy expression, while Lin Yi watched. The system's voice then sounded.
"Congratulations to the host for increasing intimacy with the baby. You have been rewarded with one hundred thousand yuan."
Hearing this system message, Lin Yi was visibly delighted and curved his lips into a smirk.
Han Xuewei put down Er Bao and reached out to Da Bao, who eagerly crawled over to her.
And as Lin Yi's mother chatted animatedly in the family group chat, Lin Yi shared the video of Da Bao finally relaxing to the family group, causing everyone to erupt with excitement—Da Bao was just too cute.
After finally getting the babies to sleep, Lin Yi went back into Han Xuewei's room. The large photos were still hanging, and Lin Yi prepared to get busy with them.
Han Xuewei came over, intending to help, but Lin Yi shook his head and said, "Go take a shower first, you've also been tired all day. Leave these little tasks to me."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei felt a sweetness in her heart, she walked up to Lin Yi and raised her face to give a quick kiss on the corner of his mouth.
Lin Yi turned his head too, gently returning the kiss.
Then, Han Xuewei entered the bathroom, and after a while, she called out, "Honey, I think I forgot to bring clothes. Can you get them for me?"
Hearing this, Lin Yi took a bathrobe from the closet and handed it to Han Xuewei. When Han Xuewei received the bathrobe, she paused slightly and said, "Why did you only give me a bathrobe? What about my underwear?"
Hearing this, Lin Yi just smiled slightly, and Han Xuewei, understanding his intention, blushed deeply, quickly pulled the bathrobe inside, and stopped talking to Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 156 Do you like it or not?
chapters.content:
Qin Xiaoxu had recently decided not to live at home anymore, as her parents were always nagging, and she had no choice but to move to an apartment closer to the company.
Being a homebody, she went to the supermarket and bought a bunch of snacks, planning to rest well at home.
Days with snacks and games to play were, for her, simply too blissful.
However, she was too tired yesterday, so she decided to get some catch-up sleep today.
After just over an hour of sleep, she heard a familiar ringtone—her phone was ringing. She was still groggy, reached for her phone, and upon seeing the messages that came in, her expression immediately soured.
This person is like a persistent ghost, disturbing her even when she's trying to rest.
Qin Xiaoxu had already seen the callout on the screen.
"You there? You there?"
Five consecutive messages, all "You there?"
Just seeing the words "You there?" made Qin Xiaoxu feel irritable, thinking that only people with low EQ would send such a message. If she were there, she would have replied on her own.
If there's something to say, just say it. Why does one always need to ask if she's there?!
Qin Xiaoxu was a bit agitated, seeing that the name above was Lin Jie. She quickly typed a response of "Here" on the screen.
The moment he saw her response, he immediately sent three more words: "Get online now."
Qin Xiaoxu saw these three words and replied indifferently.
"I'm jobless now, not in the mood for this!"
Qin Xiaoxu said flatly, still troubled by her inability to find a job.
But at that moment, Lin Jie was stupefied by her message; he didn't understand, after all, he was still in college, a time without much worry.
And the greatest concern in college was about finding a job afterward, but he never considered the possibility of unemployment.
So, he couldn't understand Qin Xiaona, and he really wanted to play games now; Qin Xiaoxu was the perfect gaming partner for him, so he immediately sent another message.
Qin Xiaoxu glanced at the message and was immediately three degrees hotter with anger. This guy was truly too exasperating for her, suggesting that if she was jobless, she should just hurry up and find a job—as if it wasn't a big deal hearing such words.
Qin Xiaoxu felt like she was so angry she could spit blood. Was it so easy to find a job just by hurrying to look for one?
Could she just find the right one by looking? Was it that simple?
Greatly annoyed, Qin Xiaoxu's fingers rapidly typed a long string of text on the screen. Lin Jie was stunned when he saw the barrage of words.
He was somewhat taken aback, not having prepared a good response, but upon seeing another message from Qin Xiaoxu with an acid tone, he replied.
"Go play with all those girls you like!"
Hearing this, Lin Jie, a straightforward guy, thought there was a turn of events, allowing him to skip the previous message and respond directly to this one. He immediately typed a reply.
"Where on my phone are there other girls? Besides, other girls are too noobish in games; I think it's better if you just play with me!"
Lin Jie didn't realize anything inappropriate in what he said, and Qin Xiaoxu was somewhat taken aback by his message, but what surprised her even more was that Lin Jie's phone indeed didn't have any other girls.
Qin Xiaoxu continued chatting with Lin Jie for a bit, but she was quickly shocked by his insensitivity.
He didn't know how to comfort her when she was so upset, only knowing to urge her to join him in gaming.
Qin Xiaoxu was getting annoyed; she stopped replying to Lin Jie's messages and opened up her phone to order some takeaway.
She normally didn't cook when at home, and when outside, takeaway was her only option. Meanwhile, Lin Jie was utterly confused. He looked at his phone, having sent numerous messages, but Qin Xiaoxu hadn't replied to a single one.
What was up with her today? Was it just because she lost her job? Was that why she was ignoring him?
Hearing Lin Jie's words, his buddy Zhao Xin couldn't help but give Lin Jie a look of astonishment.
"Dude, you really don't get it! The girl lost her job; you could at least comfort her a bit, and instead, you complain about her not paying attention to you."
Zhao Xin walked up to Lin Jie, took a look at the chat history on his phone, and was immediately shocked.
"What the hell are you talking with her about? Can't you think of anything besides games?"
Zhao Xin showed a helpless smile, and upon hearing this, Lin Jie naturally responded, "I'm still studying, and I'm not the one looking for a job. Besides, if she lost her job, she can just find a new one—it's not a big deal. She's going to drop ranks in the game if she doesn't play soon."
Hearing this, Zhao Xin was pretty much speechless, only shaking his head and saying, "You really are a hopeless case of a 'steel straight man'!"
Lin Jie, feeling slightly dissatisfied, furrowed his brows and replied, "Don't talk about me like that; I don't think I am."
He understood emotions between men and women; it's just that his mind was more focused on games, which is why he didn't pay much attention. But he was still interested in women.
Seeing Lin Jie's troubled expression, Zhao Xin asked, "What do you feel towards that girl in the game, Qin Xiaoxu? Do you have feelings for her, like, actually like her?"
Upon hearing that, Lin Jie pondered for quite some time, unsure about this 'liking' feeling Zhao Xin was referring to, and could only say, "She's really good at gaming, we have synergy when we play together, and she has a nice personality, someone I can chat with."
Zhao Xin nodded, thinking since Lin Jie said they got along, it must mean he liked her quite a bit.
So, he said, "Then you must have feelings for her, feelings like, you know, being thrilled by her, paying a lot of attention to everything about her, really enjoying being with her."
Zhao Xin earnestly tried to describe the feeling because he feared that Lin Jie, this hopeless straight man, might not even grasp that kind of emotion.
Lin Jie thought for a long while without saying anything, leading Zhao Xin to continue, "So, when playing with other girls versus playing with Qin Xiaoxu, who do you think is better?"
At this, Lin Jie frowned and said, "Of course Qin Xiaoxu is better. The other girls I played with were so terrible; I'd lose every game with them, and I couldn't even scold them. If I did, they'd get mad at me. I was really..."
He had gone completely off-topic again.
Zhao Xin was a bit exasperated, only able to say, "Is that really all you care about? Or do you think Qin Xiaoxu is interested in you, that she might really have feelings for you, or that you feel differently about her compared to others?"
Zhao Xin was trying hard to steer the conversation back on track. Lin Jie knitted his brows upon hearing this, then smiled and said, "How could that be? My feelings towards Qin Xiaoxu are different from those towards other girls, but that doesn't mean she likes me or that I like her."

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Chapter 157 Straight Man's Speech
chapters.content:
Lin Jie had indeed mentioned to Qin Xiaoxu before that he wanted her to pretend to be his girlfriend to deal with some things, but it couldn't be that Qin Xiaoxu had agreed to it just by acting along now, right? That would be too unimaginable!
However, he had also seen Qin Xiaoxu playing with other guys before, and he really felt somewhat indignant about it.
Meanwhile, Zhao Xin kept on analyzing Qin Xiaoxu's attitude toward him to Lin Jie without pausing.
The hot and cold behavior he described was just Qin Xiaoxu playing hard to get. If she played games with guys, she was just trying to make him jealous. In short, he just felt that Qin Xiaoxu was interested in him.
Lin Jie showed a look of astonishment upon hearing these words and eventually shook his head.
He wasn't brainless and incapable of thought, he could plainly feel that Qin Xiaoxu indeed didn't have much of a feeling toward him.
But with Zhao Xin saying this, considering his many years of dating experience, there seemed to be some truth in it, so he silently took note in his heart, just in case Qin Xiaoxu really did like him.
It wouldn't be bad, then he could continue playing games with her.
If Qin Xiaoxu knew what Lin Jie was thinking, she'd probably be so angry she'd cough up blood and die.
Zhao Xin was looking at Lin Jie with great interest while Lin Jie looked extremely indifferent. Zhao Xin couldn't help but kick him and said, "You can't keep being so clueless all the time. You should at least get a girlfriend during your college years."
Upon hearing this, Lin Jie turned his head back, shaking it like a rattle-drum and said directly, "I'm still studying now; I don't want to think about these things. Moreover, today Qin Xiaoxu made it very clear to me. She said if she's out of work or out of love, she'll stop bothering with me. It's evident she has no interest in me.
If she were into me, she'd at least pay some attention to what I want!"
Zhao Xin felt like picking up a shoe horn and smacking Lin Jie across the face.
Here was a girl who came to Lin Jie for solace after losing her job, and this guy was still talking as if it was none of his concern; he really was a fool.
"Haven't you ever considered how serious being unemployed is for her? You should learn to offer comfort!"
Hearing this, Lin Jie nodded and immediately picked up his phone to search how to comfort someone.
Seeing Lin Jie's action, Zhao Xin was somewhat surprised, but still felt a sense of achievement inside.
If Lin Jie was willing to learn how to love someone like this, it showed that Qin Xiaoxu was different from other girls in his heart.
After Qin Xiaoxu finished her takeaway, she saw that she had received quite a few messages on her phone, with Lin Jie inviting her to play games again.
She was already feeling irritable, and seeing Lin Jie's invite to play games ignited her fury. She was about to say something in response, when Zhao Xin at her side started giving Lin Jie tips, speaking for a while to comfort Qin Xiaoxu.
Qin Xiaoxu showed a look of astonishment upon hearing these words. She had not expected Lin Jie to be somewhat different today.
Although she had easily taken a fancy to some internet celebrities in the past, the feeling Lin Jie gave her was different from the others.
He exuded a very clear sense of authenticity, while after all, people on the internet are wrapped in a veneer, often deliberately pretending, but Lin Jie was entirely sincere.
At this time, Qin Xiaoxu also felt a bit bored and couldn't help but open the game and accept Lin Jie's invitation; they started playing together.
After playing for a while, Zhao Xin looked at Lin Jie and thought that since Lin Jie enjoyed gaming so much, it might be feasible to make a move in this area. He spoke up, "Actually, you could try forming a couple relationship with her in the game. That way, you can always play together, and it'll be so much more fun when you log in, completely different from the way you played before."
Hearing that this way of playing was completely different from before, Lin Jie's face immediately lit up with excitement.
If that was the case, it would indeed be quite interesting; he had grown somewhat tired of the same old approach, so he excitedly sent out his idea.
When Qin Xiaoxu heard this, she originally had no intention of forming a couple relationship with anyone, but then she received the invitation and was immediately delighted, replying right away, "Let's pair up now!"
Seeing Qin Xiaoxu's reaction, Lin Jie was also taken aback. He hadn't expected Qin Xiaoxu to agree so quickly to forming a CP, which came as a huge surprise to him.
After playing a round, Lin Jie found it very entertaining, since in the game their names were extremely affectionate, and they received a lot of attention from everyone within the game.
Every time Qin Xiaoxu was in danger, Lin Jie would quickly come to her rescue, and in the game, they were just like a sweet couple.
After the game ended, Lin Jie sent Qin Xiaoxu a message, starting with,
"You've been unemployed lately, you must have a lot of free time, why don't you come meet my parents!"
Hearing Lin Jie's words, Qin Xiaoxu's brow immediately furrowed; why on earth should she decently go meet Lin Jie's parents?
Plus, their relationship was just a pretend couple, and every time she met his parents, she felt extremely awkward.
So at this point, she was hesitant, but considering Lin Jie came from a wealthy family and she was not so affluent herself, she figured she could well wring out a substantial amount from him.
That way, even if she was unemployed and not working, she could support herself, so she directly replied with a message, "If I go see your parents with you, what's in it for me?"
Hearing this, Lin Jie calmly typed out a few words on his phone, "If you go with me, buy whatever you want."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu was a bit astonished, and couldn't help but think mischievously as she said, "What if I want to buy a car, or if I want expensive handbags, or even a house?"
Qin Xiaoxu sent these messages just to test Lin Jie, who thought for a moment before replying with a message.
"Anything within a few hundred thousand I can give you, but if you want a house or a car, then you might have to marry me."
Although Lin Jie said this with the utmost calm, Qin Xiaoxu now found his remark not so straightforward, but rather intriguing; she replied, "Well, in that case, that would be fantastic!"
Qin Xiaoxu was very excited at the moment; a man willing to spend money on her – how could she possibly refuse?
Furthermore, the condition was simply to meet the parents. She had already set her eyes on numerous luxury items and wanted to truly indulge herself.
Besides, Lin Jie's parents were not short on funds; they were always urging him to find a girlfriend, and they would certainly not skimp on the money to buy his girlfriend gifts. They would at least provide him a few hundred thousand as startup funds.

chapters.title: Chapter 158: Chapter 158 Vaccination
chapters.content:
Actually, Lin Jie's parents were also at a loss, because Lin Jie had always been somewhat of a loner since he was young and liked playing video games a lot.
He showed no interest in the outside world, and his parents once suspected that he might be someone who liked boys instead of girls.
Since he only played with boys, Father Lin and Mother Lin were extremely worried, but later on, they heard that there could be a genetic component to it.
However, Lin Jie never showed any such tendencies, so they were both relieved. But as Lin Jie entered university, he was still alone, which made them very concerned.
If Lin Jie truly had no intention of dating, would he just lead a life in solitude until he grew old?
Pity the anxiety of parents worldwide regarding their child's lifetime happiness—they were still extremely anxious about it.
Moreover, someone like Lin Jie would be called a "homebody" by the young people outside, and his parents would be overjoyed to hear that he was buying gifts for a girl, so Lin Jie was confident that he could certainly get a good amount of money from them.
Qin Xiaoxu had recently lost her job and was surprised that Lin Jie was willing to spend money for her. If the price was so small, she was definitely willing to do it, so she was very happy.
She agreed right away and said they should meet for a meal together the next day.
...
Lin Yi had noticed that Da Bao had been doing much better lately, and he remembered mentioning vaccinations to him before. He directly said to Han Xuewei, "We talked about the vaccines before, it's time to schedule that now. Since there's nothing going on today, let's take them to get vaccinated."
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei immediately nodded and walked into the next room.
"You're right, my memory is indeed terrible, I almost forgot about this. I'll make an appointment for the babies now, maybe for tomorrow morning? After all, they have to go back to school today, and it takes a long time. Tomorrow is the weekend; we can take them to get vaccinated and buy some school supplies!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi nodded as well.
He thought Lin Xuewei's suggestion made a lot of sense, so they decided to wait until tomorrow.
The weather wasn't very good today anyway, and they planned accordingly.
Han Xuewei immediately returned to the children's room to play with the babies.
Then the next morning, Lin Yi got up early and prepared breakfast for the family.
Han Xuewei had wanted to get up and prepare breakfast for everyone but was surprised to find that Lin Yi had appeared earlier than her, showing a look of astonishment.
"How come you got up so early to make breakfast for everyone!"
When Lin Yi heard this, he looked up at her and said, "You've been working hard lately, it's only right for me to get up and make breakfast for everyone. You can go back and be with the babies first, it won't be long until we eat."
Han Xuewei felt touched and stood on her tiptoes to kiss his cheek.
Seeing this, Lin Yi immediately turned his head and pecked her on the cheek, their affectionate gestures seen by Mother Lin who had walked over.
Mother Lin, seeing how affectionate the young couple were, immediately covered her mouth with a chuckle, moved to the side, but Lin Yi still noticed her. His expression, however, was quite calm.
Just that Han Xuewei felt a bit shy and quickly went back to the room to be with the children.
After breakfast, Lin Yi drove Han Xuewei and the others out.
He had even specially prepared a stroller that could fit all three children.
So when they went out with that eye-catching vehicle, they instantly became the focus of the entire neighborhood.
The surrounding people all looked at this scene with great astonishment, and although it was very warm, it still seemed miraculous because the ones sitting inside the stroller were three adorable babies.
At this moment, Da Bao was sleeping, while Er Bao and Mengmeng were playing beside him. Er Bao was drooling and continuously patting with his little hands.
He had never been afraid of strangers; on the contrary, when he saw strangers, he would even greet them.
The people around them found this scene very wonderful and could not help but exclaim one after another.
"Those three children are simply too cute, especially that little girl; she's truly exquisite!"
"You're right! Haven't you seen their parents? Their parents are so attractive; it's normal for the children to be good-looking too. But these are triplets! The expenses for triplets must be pretty substantial, right?"
"It seems only a well-off family could afford to raise three children!"
People discussed, but more than anything, they were curious and amazed by the triplets.
However, at this time, Lin Yi didn't care about their words; he put the babies into the car and then headed towards the hospital.
He drove slowly because he was afraid the babies weren't accustomed to riding, but fortunately, the distance between the hospital and their home was not long, so they quickly arrived at the hospital.
When they arrived at the hospital, Lin Yi pushing the three babies still attracted the attention of a crowd of doctors and nurses, who all showed surprised expressions.
Many doctors particularly loved children and kept greeting the three babies. Er Bao and Mengmeng, being very active, even responded to those who greeted them, waving their chubby little hands, while Da Bao was sound asleep.
On their previous visit for vaccinations, the doctors had told them that a check-up was necessary before getting the shots.
So first, Lin Yi took the three babies into the examination room ahead of time, where they were received by a nurse in a graceful uniform, gentle and elegant.
When she saw the three adorable babies, her face instantly showed delight, and after touching their faces with her hand, she placed the babies on the bed and began some simple examination procedures.
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei both watched the nurse nervously, their faces full of tension, surprising the nurse with their expressions.
"Family members, you can relax at any time. Children's check-ups are very simple examinations; there won't be any risk!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei both felt a bit embarrassed and stepped aside. By then, Da Bao had vaguely finished several examination items and was very cooperative, completing the check-up in an instant.
Er Bao was somewhat difficult to handle and took a good while to finish his check-up.
Afterward, the nurse turned her attention to Mengmeng and upon seeing her, she couldn't help but sigh, "It's been a long time since I've seen such a cute baby, with such long eyelashes and an incredibly delicate appearance!"
Mengmeng immediately won the favor of the nurse.

chapters.title: Chapter 159: Chapter 159 Completed Physical Examination
chapters.content:
"Mengmeng, you need to behave, and your check-up will be over soon!"
Han Xuewei said as she held Mengmeng in front of the nurse, but this time Mengmeng was quite resistant to being held by the nurse.
So she pouted and struggled, with the nurse somewhat helpless, she had no choice but to gently pat her on the shoulder, trying to be as gentle as possible.
Then, she took the equipment and approached Mengmeng.
Mengmeng grew nervous at the sight of the equipment and wouldn't budge from her spot. Lin Yi walked up to her and carefully spoke to her for a while. Mengmeng seemed to half understand, and taking advantage of this moment, the nurse took the opportunity to check Mengmeng.
At first, Mengmeng didn't want to cooperate, but as she became more confused, she naturally went through with the check-up.
After the three babies had completed their check-ups, Lin Yi took them to get their vaccinations.
The vaccinations were to be administered by a male doctor. Seeing this, Lin Yi immediately frowned, he was worried that if the male doctor wasn't skilled, it would be troublesome if the babies cried.
Seeing Lin Yi's concerned expression, Han Xuewei immediately spoke in a calm voice, "I think you're overthinking it. Actually, male doctors are no worse than female doctors in technique, and crying is pretty much inevitable with vaccinations. Just relax. You definitely cried when you got vaccinated as a child!"
Lin Yi was taken aback by Han Xuewei's words.
Turning to look at Han Xuewei, she was simply holding Da Bao in her arms, sitting in front of the doctor.
The doctor started wiping with alcohol cotton. Da Bao's chubby arm seemed to sense something and stared straight at Lin Yi.
The doctor immediately squatted in front of the baby, pressing down on Da Bao's chubby arm. Da Bao's brow furrowed immediately, showing an uneasy expression.
Seeing this, Lin Yi immediately soothed him, constantly distracting him. The doctor, seeing this, swiftly injected the needle into Da Bao's arm and, as expected, Da Bao cried out with a "waah," and Lin Yi's hands were immediately filled with tears.
He patted Da Bao's back somewhat helplessly and lifted him up, pressing the cotton on Da Bao's arm.
Da Bao cried for a long time, exhausting Lin Yi's hands a bit, but eventually Da Bao cried himself to sleep.
Lin Yi placed Da Bao on the stroller, then saw Mengmeng eyeing him with a cunning gaze, seemingly aware of what was to come, and immediately showing an unhappy face.
Lin Yi was a bit helpless. This little girl was just too clever.
Meanwhile, Er Bao had been vaccinated, and he cried loudly just like Da Bao. Han Xuewei was comforting Er Bao at that time, and Lin Yi didn't want to delay the people behind him in line for vaccinations, so he immediately picked up Mengmeng.
Mengmeng was visibly upset when picked up; she wanted to struggle, but was powerless in Lin Yi's arms, shrinking into his embrace.
Lin Yi sat down in front of the doctor, who was surprised upon seeing Mengmeng.
He had seen many children before, but it was the first time he had encountered a child as adorable as Mengmeng, who looked like a porcelain doll.
The doctor felt a bit heartbroken and started moving more gently. Yet, when he wiped Mengmeng's arm with the alcohol, Mengmeng began to tremble, and Lin Yi immediately rubbed her head, gently comforting her by her side.
But none of it worked; Mengmeng was still very nervous, and it took quite a while before her emotions were calmed down.
The doctor could not delay any longer and decisively stuck the needle in.
Mengmeng pursed her lips, her face looking as if she was about to cry but no tears came out. Lin Yi thought she was holding back her tears, but the next second, Mengmeng burst into loud wails.
Crying with her little face all red, Lin Yi held her in his arms, soothing her for a while before placing her back into the stroller.
Perhaps tired from crying, she lay down in the stroller and fell asleep after a short while.
Lin Yi left the hospital with the babies and they headed towards the parking spot to put the little ones in the car.
The car was very spacious, making it easy for the babies to get in, and it drove smoothly. Although there were many sharp stops required on the way, the ride was very stable.
Because the car performed well, riding in it was exceedingly stable. Han Xuewei originally didn't want the children to be jostled too much and thought about holding them, but she couldn't manage all three, so she gave up on that idea.
Lin Yi was driving very slowly at this point. He was worried about the car jolting when braking, so he kept his speed extremely low.
The family of five thus made their unhurried way home.
At this time, Han Xuemei was already waiting outside the hotel; what she needed to do was to gain the affection and trust of Dad Han.
She had to prove herself, for it would make Dad Han pay more attention to her, and she would have a higher status in his eyes.
Moreover, she hoped to take full control of the hotel, so everyone would submit to her and follow her arrangements. Then, Lin Yi would see her capability and have a better impression of her.
She wanted to prove she was far superior to Han Xuewei.
Even if she couldn't gain Lin Yi's approval, it didn't matter. She would take the hotel by leveraging her connections. The Han family wouldn't be able to do anything about her then.
She was simply jealous of Han Xuewei and didn't want Han Xuewei to have more advantages than her. Deep down, she knew that Han Xuewei and her family were kind and had never wronged her.
She resented that her own father was not ambitious, while her uncle had distinguished himself. She couldn't accept that Han Xuewei was always a step ahead of her; it bothered her greatly.
In plain terms, it was naked jealousy. But Dad Han was very generous; hearing that she wanted to help at the hotel, he arranged for her the easiest position.
Although she resented it, she was not about to turn down taking advantage of a kindhearted person's offer.
However, Dad Han had a different perspective. After all, since Han Xuemei was Han Xuewei's cousin, family meant she should be looked after.
Having one more person to help was a good thing, especially a relative—it was even more reassuring. But little did Dad Han know, he was inviting a wolf into the fold.
Han Xuemei had no good intentions; she had already planned everything meticulously.
Han Xuemei had long coveted the Han family's assets. Initially, she had planned to seduce Lin Yi, but unfortunately, Lin Yi had shown little interest in her, so she had to ensure she had a fallback option.
The Han family's business was her backup plan. Actually, she had no real interest in Lin Yi, but since he was wealthy, he was worth the effort of seduction.
Furthermore, learning that Lin Yi was the owner of Wenqu Building inflamed her desires even further. If she could gain Lin Yi's trust, perhaps she could secure the rights she longed for.

chapters.title: Chapter 160 Keeping up with the Joneses
chapters.content:
So when she arrived at the hotel, he had already decided that sooner or later he would take back the power of the hotel; it was only a matter of time.
Dad Han was inherently a simple-minded man, and he basically left his businesses to his subordinates to manage. Therefore, as long as she could become a person trusted by the Han family.
Naturally, Dad Han's businesses would be handed over for her to manage. This was a classic case of hitting two birds with one stone. At this thought, a spark of desire flickered in Han Xuemei's eyes.
Soon she would occupy a great portion of the Han family's businesses. At this thought, she was brimming with excitement, elegantly stepping into the hotel in her high heels.
…
Meanwhile, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei had put the kids in the car and planned to go buy study supplies together.
This was the same Wenqu Building they had been to before - a building he secretly owned, though he had never revealed this to anyone.
When Han Xuewei followed him and walked forward, she suddenly spotted two familiar figures and immediately furrowed her brows, standing frozen in place.
Lin Yi was somewhat surprised and turned to look at her.
Then, as Lin Yi lifted his gaze, he saw a man and a woman just ahead. Lin Yi didn't recognize either of them.
However, Han Xuewei was very familiar with them, as these two were her classmates, with the girl being Li Lanxue, her university classmate, and the boy being Shen Wenjun.
Li Lanxue and Han Xuewei had known each other since university, and Han Xuewei's beauty stood out so much that she often overshadowed everyone else at school.
Li Lanxue had been quietly working hard, constantly improving her makeup skills in the hopes that one day she could have many men fall at her feet.
However, when the campus belle was announced, she collapsed. Han Xuewei's sudden appearance totally crushed all of her efforts, as the male students virtually worshiped Han Xuewei alone.
They didn't spare Li Lanxue a single glance.
After many years of effort spent on makeup and weight loss to enhance her beauty, when she realized that all her efforts were just the starting point for someone with natural beauty like Han Xuewei, she felt devastated.
No matter how heavy the makeup she applied or how exquisitely she dressed, she could not compare to the subtle, natural beauty of Han Xuewei, which only intensified her jealousy.
The boy, Shen Wenjun, had also been acquainted with Han Xuewei; he had even pursued her but was rejected.
Later on, rumors were that he had gone abroad and made a good life for himself, and now he had businesses in Huaxia as well.
However, Han Xuewei hadn't gone out of her way to find out more; her classmates had simply told her.
After all, Shen Wenjun was quite a significant figure, having once pursued her, and naturally attracted attention.
Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun, both of whom came from well-off families, left Han Xuewei puzzled as to how two such unrelated people could end up together.
But at that moment, as she looked at them, she had no desire to greet them, only wanting to get away from them as quickly as possible.
After all, in her memory, these two weren't exactly easy to get along with.
So Han Xuewei immediately pulled Lin Yi to walk aside, and Lin Yi also noticed that something was off with Han Xuewei, so he said to her, "Aren't we going to buy stationery supplies?"
