After Lin Yi finished speaking, Han Xuewei told him about the general situation of these two people they had run into.
Once Lin Yi heard it, he instantly understood the situation of these two people and guessed that they probably had some grudges with Han Xuewei and that they must have made things difficult for her.
Because in his memory, Han Xuewei was someone with a very good temperament and personality, despite being the school beauty, she didn't put on airs. The only possibility was that these people had been troubling her.
Seeing his wife showing a troubled expression, Lin Yi naturally felt somewhat displeased.
He certainly didn't want Han Xuewei to be submissive in front of others. She should strike back when it was right to do so.
Therefore, Lin Yi did not let Han Xuewei lead him away, and at this moment, Li Lanxue obviously had some intention to stir up trouble as she approached them with a sour tone.
"Isn't this our school's beauty? How come I see you here today? It's really surprising!"
After she finished speaking, Li Lanxue raised her eyes to look at Han Xuewei.
Xue Mei looked at her, feeling somewhat embarrassed and simply nodded, "Yeah, I didn't expect to see old classmates here either."
Seeing Han Xuewei's graceful composure, the jealousy in Li Lanxue's eyes was unmistakable as she directly said, "I heard before that you got married, but I thought it was a joke. After all, we are still in university, getting married so early is quite special."
Li Lanxue actually knew about it already, the news of Han Xuemei's marriage had spread throughout the grade long ago. She remembered that Xuemei's wedding was a big event, and many of their classmates attended.
How could she not know about this? Moreover, she had already seen Han Xuewei's wedding. In her view, the wedding was quite ordinary, it was just held at a slightly better hotel and didn't count as very luxurious.
She turned to look behind her and saw Lin Yi's car parked to the side, which made her look even more disdainful.
That kind of ordinary sedan was just a few hundred thousand yuan, nothing noteworthy at all. A glance at Lin Yi was enough to tell her that both of them came from average families.
So she immediately understood the situation, realizing that both of them were just from ordinary families and simply couldn't compare with her current man, Shen Wenjun.
Shen Wenjun owned several houses here and also had a company under his name.
Han Xuewei immediately realized and spoke up, "I forgot to tell you, this is my husband, Lin Yi, he's also from our school."
Han Xuewei said with poise, her smile making her look very beautiful. Now that she had had a child, her entire aura seemed even more charming. Shen Wenjun, seeing Han Xuewei like this, also showed a look of astonishment.
At this moment, Li Lanxue noticed Shen Wenjun's gaze and immediately showed an unhappy look. She didn't give Lin Yi any face and just snorted, "I haven't seen him."
Hearing Li Lanxue's sour tone, Han Xuewei instantly felt somewhat dissatisfied, but she did not lose her temper, while Lin Yi remained composed as he looked ahead.
Shen Wenjun's gaze was fixed on Han Xuewei. Although they had met before, they hadn't seen each other for several years now, and he didn't expect Han Xuewei to still be so beautiful.
She seemed even more stunning and attractive than when he had seen her in university, and now her figure also seemed fuller. He didn't know that was because Han Xue had already had a child.
Seeing Shen Wenjun staring intently at Han Xuewei, Li Lanxue felt immediately unsatisfied and directly pulled on Shen Wenjun's arm, saying, "This is my boyfriend, Shen Wenjun!"

chapters.title: Chapter 161 Quirky and Weird
chapters.content:
Just as Li Lanxue finished speaking, she remembered Shen Wenjun's pursuit of Han Xuewei during their college years and immediately showed signs of displeasure, speaking sarcastically, "I suppose you two must be quite familiar with each other!"
After finishing, she turned her gaze towards Shen Wenjun, who was still staring at Han Xuewei.
Actually, he didn't want to look at Han Xuewei, but for some reason, every time he saw her, his eyes would be unconsciously drawn to her.
Han Xuewei, now a mother, had a figure different from her college days, but she seemed even more charming.
Shen Wenjun was also very surprised by Han Xuewei's changes. Feeling Shen Wenjun's gaze, Lin Yi immediately showed his displeasure, staring coldly at Shen Wenjun.
He directly took Han Xuewei's hand, pulled her behind him, and glared unfriendly at Shen Wenjun.
Shen Wenjun also came to his senses at this point, turning his head back with some embarrassment.
Li Lanxue was watching him fiercely—as if he was seeing another woman right in front of her, and so enraptured at that, completely ignoring her!
At that moment, Li Lanxue was pinching Shen Wenjun's arm tightly. She looked upset, her gaze alternating between bluish and purplish as she stared at Shen Wenjun.
Shen Wenjun only then showed a guilty expression and retreated to Li Lanxue's side.
Earlier, he had been so lost in staring at Han Xuewei because, after all, he had been deeply attracted to her since his first year of college.
Back then, he had believed Han Xuewei to be the woman he would commit to for life, but after confessing several times, Han Xuewei always rejected him.
He had thought that he had given up, and over the years abroad, he had become much more composed, but now seeing Han Xuewei again stirred something restless within him.
He was with Li Lanxue entirely because their families' interests aligned, and although his family seemed respectable, in reality, it was all facade—a shell company.
If it weren't for Li Lanxue's help, it would be difficult for him to gain a foothold in this city, which was why Li Lanxue had agreed to partner with him.
Seeing Shen Wenjun's intense gaze only made Lin Yi more upset, as he stepped in front of Han Xuewei.
This guy really was clueless. Lin Yi felt like slapping Shen Wenjun dead, staring coldly at him.
Although he knew Han Xuewei didn't like Shen Wenjun, he also disliked others coveting her, especially with such blatant looks. Han Xuewei was his now, and yet this guy had no sense of self-awareness, truly annoying.
Meanwhile, Li Lanxue, looking displeased, smoothed over her expression after a while and put on a smile, saying, "Actually, it's quite a coincidence running into you today. We just happen to have a gathering tonight. Our classmates will all be there—Qin Xiaoxu must have told you about it, I presume.
If he hasn't yet, then let me tell you now, you definitely have to come, and remember to bring your husband with you. After all, it'll be good for everyone to get acquainted!"
Li Lanxue appeared hospitable, while Lin Yi watched her with a consistent cold look.
He could see right through her intentions. At that moment, Han Xuewei felt somewhat uneasy; she never really liked these kinds of gatherings.
She wasn't one to conform to social situations, so she usually refused invitations to college reunions.
But now, with Li Lanxue inviting her so eagerly, it would seem rather rude to refuse on the spot, making her hesitant.
At that moment, Li Lanxue turned around, gave Lin Yi a cold glance, looked at the car behind him, and their indecisive expressions, immediately revealing a smug look on her face.
Then, she began to speak with feigned concern, "Xue Mei, we were quite fateful sisters in college, even though we haven't graduated yet! But having spent several years together, as the campus belle you should really go and show your face. If you don't attend, I think a lot of male classmates will be very disappointed."
Li Lanxue's words were sharp and harsh, not bothering to disguise them at all.
Having said that, Li Lanxue then grabbed Shen Wenjun's arm and continued, "Your wedding was so quiet, we all got the news from other classmates. It's really not fun to not invite us!"
"But I think these reunions are occasions where I should invite you. It wouldn't hurt for everyone to get to know each other a little better!"
After finishing her speech, she turned to Shen Wenjun with a flirtatious smile.
At this time, Han Xuewei, hearing Li Lanxue's mocking tone, suddenly felt awkward, but she really didn't want to go to the reunion.
At the reunion, those people would surely pressure her to drink, to do this and that—it would be so uncomfortable!
She would rather spend this time at home with her children, so she hesitated but eventually said, "Maybe I should pass, I'm quite busy with the family now that I'm married, and besides, I have children to take care of!"
When it came to children, Shen Wenjun immediately frowned; he hadn't expected Han Xuewei to have had children already at this time.
A tinge of disappointment flashed across his heart, and then he turned to Han Xuewei and said, "Actually, classmates' gatherings are no big deal. If you really don't want to come, then let it be."
Hearing Shen Wenjun speak up for Han Xuewei, Li Lanxue became annoyed and snorted coldly, "Wasn't your husband said to be very capable before? Why not bring him to the reunion to show everyone!"
"If you don't dare, then don't pretend to be something big and flashy outside. I've heard from several classmates that your husband is quite rich, and now you act all timid—it's really not becoming!"
Li Lanxue's words were far too direct, and Han Xuewei immediately showed a displeased expression.
She rarely looked at others with such an expression, and Shen Wenjun also felt it was a bit too much, as he held Li Lanxue's hand.
But Li Lanxue couldn't let go of her pride and just glared angrily at Han Xuewei.
At this time, Lin Yi, watching the two of them with a cold gaze, took Han Xuewei's hand and said with a slight smile, "Wife, since they're inviting us so eagerly, let's just go so as to avoid people gossiping if we don't."
"You!"
Li Lanxue was clearly angry and wanted to say something more.
But Lin Yi snorted coldly and said, "Since we've agreed, I'd like you to keep your distance from us. We're off to the mall, so don't waste our time."
Lin Yi said this and immediately walked forward with Han Xuewei, not wanting to waste time with these two.
Having the rare opportunity to be alone with Han Xuewei, why should he squander his time on such people?
Li Lanxue, watching them hurry away, immediately revealed a scornful look and said, "Just two poor bugs pretending to be big shots; I want to see how long they can keep up the act."

chapters.title: Chapter 162 Gathering
chapters.content:
Li Lanxue spoke coldly, her eyes full of disdain as she looked at Shen Wenjun; his earlier attitude had infuriated her.
Li Lanxue's face was ugly as she sneered, "It seems you still can't forget that woman, how shameless of you. If that were the case, you shouldn't have come to me for a partnership in the first place!"
"If you do anything else to anger me, I will cut off all partnership with the Shen Family, and then you can just wait for all your suppliers to disappear," she said coldly, confident in her own standing, for she was one of the top suppliers in the city.
Wasn't Shen Wenjun only with her because of this fact? Since they were together, if he dared to show any fickleness thinking about another woman, she would not let him off lightly.
At this moment, Shen Wenjun could only nod in response to Li Lanxue's words.
The truth was their relationship was nothing but a forced situation.
If one of them did not cooperate, they were bound to scatter like birds and beasts.
But Li Lanxue still quite liked Shen Wenjun; after all, he was an elite who had studied abroad, and both his personality and looks were good.
But he had deep feelings for Han Xuewei, which annoyed her greatly; not that she cared that much for Shen Wenjun, she instead vented her grievances on Han Xuewei, watching their receding figures with even greater annoyance in her eyes.
...
At this time, Lin Yi directly took Han Xuewei to the mall. The mall was large, and Lin Yi hadn't paid particular attention to it even after receiving it from the system.
Every day, the mall was making a profit, and his bank account frequently gained several million in revenue, but Lin Yi simply didn't bother managing it because he owned too many companies.
However, coming over today turned out to be a bit of a surprise; the layout of the mall was excellent, which seemed to be the reason for the good business.
Lin Yi had originally planned to buy some stationery cards for studying with Han Xuewei, but now it seemed they couldn't just buy those items.
After all, they had just been provoked by Li Lanxue and her group; they must buy something fitting for a gathering, especially because they were dressed too casually today.
At the same time, Han Xuewei felt a full sense of security in her heart as Lin Yi held her hand and led her forward.
If she had to deal with the earlier scene on her own, it would definitely have been very awkward, and if she couldn't out-argue the others, she would end up resenting herself for not performing well.
But Lin Yi's presence today had helped her greatly. She usually didn't provoke anyone, but if others provoked her, she would also think about retaliating.
However, due to her inherently kind nature, she was prone to soft-heartedness, and many things could be let go if possible.
But Lin Yi's demeanor today could be summed up in two words: domineering!
At this moment, Han Xuewei was very happy, hugging his arm and walking forward with a cheerful smile. Seeing that Han Xuewei was in a good mood, Lin Yi couldn't help but smile and said, "What's up? You seem to be in a great mood!"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei replied, "Because you are so good."
Feeling pleased by this comment, Lin Tian browsed for a while before pulling her into a coffee shop.
After ordering two cups of coffee, the two of them sat in a corner.
At this moment, Han Xuewei looked at Lin Yi and couldn't help but speak up, "Actually, I really dislike gatherings; we shouldn't have agreed to them back then, so we could have gone home early to be with the babies!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi simply said, "I've already arranged for someone to take the babies back home, and now my mom is there taking care of them. We can go back later; it's not a problem!"
As he spoke, Lin Yi continued, "Actually, what that woman said just now was so obvious. She's clearly jealous of you, which is why she's picking on you."
"I feel the same way. I had plenty of trouble with her back in college, but I never did anything to offend her. She just inexplicably picks fights every time, and I often don't even want to interact with her. I'm truly unlucky to have run into her today!"
As Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Yi's expression turned unpleasant too. He hated anyone who made Han Xuewei unhappy.
"That woman is just jealous because you're better and prettier than her, so she targets you at every turn. Against such people, you must never be soft-hearted."
Upon hearing Lin Yi's words, Han Xuewei just nodded.
But she found it difficult to follow through with such things, as many relationships bound her thinking.
Moreover, she grew up in a superior family environment where her parents taught her to value harmony and to be kind to others.
So quite often, she couldn't bring herself to do those vicious things. Han Xuewei took a sip of her coffee and suddenly thought of something, saying, "Li Lanxue just seemed to suggest that our classmates will all be there. Does that mean Qin Xiaoxu will be going too?"
"If she knew, she would've told me in advance, but it's strange that there's been no word from her today. I need to give her a call right away."
After saying this, Han Xuewei immediately took out her phone and called Qin Xiaoxu, whose voice came through lazy and hoarse, as if she had just woken up.
"Vivi, did you call to tell me something?"
Qin Xiaoxu's voice was lazy and husky. She had just woken up and, still bleary-eyed, was holding her phone in a daze. But upon Han Xuewei mentioning a name, Qin Xiaoxu instantly perked up.
"What! Li Lanxue?? Isn't she that annoying girl from my dorm, always causing me trouble? Thank goodness the dorm supervisor finally kicked her out, or I would've ended up fighting with her!"
Qin Xiaoxu immediately woke up as she spoke.
She remembered her past interactions with Li Lanxue and showed an unhappy expression.
Han Xuewei merely recounted encountering Li Lanxue earlier that day. Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu also seemed surprised and her expression was filled with disbelief as she asked many questions, to which Han Xuewei responded one by one.
"Yeah, she came with her boyfriend and insisted we attend some class reunion. And her boyfriend turns out to be Shen Wenjun; I did not expect Shen Wenjun would be with her. It's truly surprising. She spoke about me in a passive-aggressive way just now, and they must have invited you too. You have to come over!"
Han Xuewei said this. Then Qin Xiaoxu glanced at her phone screen, and several messages had popped up in WeChat, all sent in the group chat.
She saw the last invitation, and an expression of resignation appeared on her face.
"This is just so annoying; I hate gatherings the most."
Qin Xiaoxu showed a helpless look, prompting Han Xuewei to feel somewhat helpless as well.
If Qin Xiaoxu was not going, then Han Xuewei was even less inclined to attend the gathering.

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Chapter 163 Pretending
chapters.content:
But at this moment, Lin Yi saw Han Xuewei's dilemma and reached out to her. Han Xuewei then handed him the phone.
Lin Yi spoke directly, "We're at the mall right now. If you come over, whatever you want to buy, I'll cover it!"
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu immediately showed a surprised look and sprang up from the bed, eagerly saying, "Really?!"
She wasn't interested in much, but her one true passion was shopping, and she also knew Lin Yi was very wealthy. When it came to luxury items, Lin Yi wouldn't be stingy.
So at that moment, she immediately put on her shoes and asked, "Can I buy anything?"
"Anything!"
Lin Yi said calmly. Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu was the first to grab the shoes and clothes beside her and dashed to the bathroom.
"I'll be right there!"
Hearing that, Lin Yi curled his lips and handed the phone back to Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei raised an eyebrow and spoke, "She's willing to come now?"
Lin Yi nodded.
Han Xuewei immediately smiled and said, "You really have a way with things!"
Before long, Qin Xiaoxu showed up in front of them.
Qin Xiaoxu was in a hurry and didn't take much time to get ready. She was dressed in casual clothes and hardly had any makeup on, perhaps just some moisturizer.
But knowing she was going to the mall to shop, she was still very excited, fearing Lin Yi might change his mind, so she rushed over without pause.
Seeing Qin Xiaoxu out of breath, Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh and patted her shoulder, saying, "You didn't have to rush like that!"
Qin Xiaoxu shook her head and counted on her fingers, saying, "You don't understand, I was afraid Lin Yi would back out. Anyway, I'm going to go on a huge shopping spree today."
Hearing Qin Xiaoxu's words, Han Xuewei found her quite amusing.
At this time, Lin Yi, watching them, spoke up, "I definitely won't back out on buying things, but you look like you just woke up?"
Qin Xiaoxu nodded, and Lin Yi continued, "In that case, let's go get something to eat first, then come back afterwards."
Her eyes lit up when she heard this. She hadn't expected Lin Yi to be so thoughtful and turned to Han Xuewei, "You're really lucky. Lin Yi is definitely a thoughtful and good man,"
Hearing Qin Xiaoxu's praise, Han Xuewei just smiled slightly, took Qin Xiaoxu's hand, and started walking ahead. She said, "I'm not very familiar with the restaurants here, but my dad's hotel is just up ahead and it's pretty good! Let's go eat at my dad's place, the food there is delicious. You haven't tried it yet."
Qin Xiaoxu nodded, having wanted to go there for a while, but she never had the chance.
At this point, the two of them walked ahead hand in hand, and Lin Yi followed, realising he seemed like the third wheel, somewhat awkwardly catching up to Han Xuewei's side.
But Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu were chatting away non-stop.
Lin Yi wasn't upset; seeing Han Xuewei happy made him happy too.
The three of them chatted and laughed as they arrived at the entrance of the hotel, and just as they were about to enter, they saw Han Xuemei standing at the front desk.
In her hand, she held a flyer, yet her expression seemed somewhat frozen, Lin Yi had grown accustomed to it whereas Qin Xiaoxu suddenly stopped in her tracks, frowning.
She looked at Han Xuemei with some puzzlement, having seen Xuemei at the wedding banquet before, her impression of her wasn't very good, and what was she doing here! Why hadn't she received any news?
And her ability to spot green tea was always accurate, Han Xuewei was always someone without schemes, just a genuinely kind person.
If it came to a fight with Han Xuemei, she definitely wouldn't win; she couldn't let a scheming woman like Han Xuemei get in touch with Han Xuewei.
Lin Yi, holding Han Xuewei's hand, walked past her towards the front.
Han Xuemei, who had a frozen face just moments ago, immediately put on a professional smile and said to Han Xuewei and Lin Yi, "Brother-in-law, Vivi sis, what brings the two of you here?"
Upon hearing Han Xuemei call out "Brother-in-law" with such intimacy, Qin Xiaoxu immediately showed a displeased expression, staring coldly at her.
This woman was truly too sly, playing the innocent in front of others with great flair.
Qin Xiaoxu immediately stood beside Han Xuewei, giving a slight smile as she looked at her.
At that moment, Han Xuemei noticed Qin Xiaoxu, showing a surprised expression as she said, "I think I also saw this sister at the wedding before, but I'm so dumb, I didn't remember your name, could you tell me again?"
Upon hearing this from Han Xuemei, Qin Xiaoxu's face immediately turned very unpleasant.
What was this woman playing at?
She remembered she was about the same age as this woman, right? What gave her the right to call her "sister" so casually?
Initially, Qin Xiaoxu didn't want to argue with Han Xuemei, but felt that Xuemei was too pretentious and couldn't help saying, "My name is Qin Xiaoxu, and we indeed met at the wedding before, but it seems I'm actually younger than you."
Upon hearing this, Han Xuemei immediately laughed awkwardly, feeling a bit guilty as she said, "I'm sorry, I got it wrong. My brain isn't very sharp. Sorry, younger sister."
Hearing these words, Qin Xiaoxu immediately showed a look of displeasure.
What was up with this woman? She just corrected her, and now she's acting as if she had done something wrong.
Qin Xiaoxu was somewhat speechless and chose not to speak any further. Lin Yi sensed the awkward atmosphere and spoke indifferently, "We're here to eat today, the three of us. Please arrange a table for us, somewhere quiet, okay?"
Lin Yi said this faintly, and upon hearing this, Han Xuemei felt somewhat discontent. She watched them enjoying themselves, while she could only be at others' service, inevitably feeling the disparity in her heart.
But she quickly squeezed out another smile, immediately saying warmly, "Sure, I'll arrange it for you right away."
Soon after, Han Xuemei gave Lin Yi a card, and Lin Yi led both of them upstairs.
At this time, Han Xuemei's expression turned sour as she looked back at them climbing the stairs, the displeasure clear in her eyes.
Han Xuewei had originally planned to check on her Dad Han during her visit, but was informed by the waiter that her dad had gone out for social engagements today.
Therefore, she couldn't see him and had no choice but to let it be.
Meanwhile, Qin Xiaoxu, sitting next to her, was already enjoying her meal with great delight, savoring the food, and occasionally expressing her admiration, her thumbs up never lowered.

chapters.title: Chapter 164 The Single Dog
chapters.content:
"Vivi, really, I'm not bragging, it's truly delicious. Your dad's hotel serves food that's much tastier than those other restaurants outside. I have to come again next time, will you treat me? Hahaha!"
Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei were particularly close, so of course they could joke around like this. Han Xuewei, however, frowned and said, "No way, with your appetite, our shop will be eaten into bankruptcy!"
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu immediately reached out to pinch Han Xuewei's face, and the atmosphere between the two was very beautiful.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi had ordered several signature dishes, and when they were served, Qin Xiaoxu immediately showed a surprised expression and said, "Aren't these Western dishes?"
Hearing this, Lin Yi nodded and said, "The chefs in this hotel are all high-level; they can cook both Western and Chinese cuisine. There's basically nothing they can't make."
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu's surprise was evident, and he couldn't help but give a big thumbs up, and then he said, "No wonder this hotel's business is so good, it's because you've hired high-level chefs, no wonder!"
After the three of them finished eating, Lin Yi led them downstairs.
At that moment, Qin Xiaoxu showed a helpless expression and said, "I wish I didn't have to go to the gathering. I'm already full, I really want to go home and sleep!"
Han Xuewei, hearing this, knocked on her head and said, "If you dare to run away now, I'll beat you up!"
The two of them chuckled and chatted away, and Lin Yi was surprised to find that Qin Xiaoxu's appearance seemed to relax Han Xuewei quite a bit, bringing back some of her girlish liveliness.
When they walked out the door, they saw Han Xuemei.
Han Xuewei greeted Han Xuemei, who responded warmly, "Where are you guys heading?"
Han Xuewei then said, "We're planning to go shopping at the mall. Why don't you join us?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xuemei immediately said, "That's fine!"
Lin Yi and Qin Xiaoxu were startled at Han Xuemei's response, and Han Xuewei didn't know what to say in the moment. She had spoken without thinking, not expecting Han Xuemei to really want to join them at the mall.
Worried about the situation getting out of hand, Qin Xiaoxu quickly went to Han Xuewei's side and took her hand.
Han Xuewei also realized what was happening, but she didn't know what to say, while Han Xuemei seemed to realize her words were a bit awkward. With a helpless look, she said, "I actually have things to take care of, I was just joking with you guys. Go ahead and have fun!"
At that moment, Han Xuewei smiled slightly, nodded her head, said goodbye, and then continued walking forward with Lin Yi and the others.
Qin Xiaoxu was also pleased, since he had almost thought Han Xuemei was going to come along, which would surely have made him crumble.
He barely knew Han Xuemei, and having her join them for shopping, what would that look like?
Fortunately, Han Xuemei wasn't lacking in social awareness. If she really had come along, he would have preferred to drop out immediately.
As for Han Xuemei, as she watched them leave, her expression grew uglier, her fists clenched tightly, her eyes filled with envy.
Of course, she liked shopping and buying things like any other girl, wishing she could buy whatever she wanted without a second thought, dreaming of having the same status as Han Xuewei.
But now she couldn't do anything, she could only watch the life she dreamed of have nothing to do with her.
Why should this be? Even though they were from the same family, her fate was so much worse than Han Xuewei's.
Han Xuewei could live as she pleased, while she could only stay here to greet the guests.
She had to use all her wits just to get what she wanted!
She didn't want this kind of life to continue any longer, sooner or later she would definitely replace Han Xuewei.
Thinking this in her heart, a resentful look flashed across her eyes, and it was at this moment that Lin Yi furrowed his brows and glanced over at her.
With just an indifferent glance, Han Xuemei's face suddenly stiffened, and she couldn't stop trembling all over, not knowing what was wrong with herself.
Lin Yi had only looked at her, yet she felt as if he had seen through all her dirty thoughts, which made her feel unnatural at once.
Lin Yi also sensed that something was amiss, gave Han Xuemei a cold look, and then turned his head away.
He had always felt that Han Xuemei seemed to have a lot of schemes hidden, and he couldn't let his guard down against her; he should have someone keep a close watch on her.
Soon, Lin Yi led them back into the shopping center, which was enormously large, occupying almost half of the building, and inside there were all kinds of luxury goods, sports cars, bags, designer brands—you name it.
At that moment, Lin Yi looked at the store directory in the lobby on the first floor, spotted the clothing logo, and led them into the elevator.
When they reached the fourth floor, they walked out into an area that was all designer clothes.
Lin Yi also planned to treat Han Xuewei to a good shopping trip this time, to pick out some clothes that she liked.
Han Xuewei had rarely gone out these days, and all her clothes were old.
Qin Xiaoxu followed along to the front, but seeing Lin Yi holding Han Xuewei's hand, something suddenly came to her mind, and she couldn't help but frown and speak up.
"Is everyone going to bring their boyfriends to the gathering? It'll be so awkward for me to sit there alone," she said.
Qin Xiaoxu thought of her own concerns and immediately showed a troubled expression.
At this moment, she wanted to go even less, but then Han Xuewei laughed and said, "It's your own fault for being idle usually and not seriously finding a boyfriend."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu immediately showed a disdainful look and replied, "I've never been unserious about finding one. The problem is that all those boys I met were too timid to even dare to date me!"
Han Xuewei laughed upon hearing this, recalling the boys who had pursued Qin Xiaoxu, and found it to be one funny joke after another.
Because Qin Xiaoxu's usual personality was carefree, but in reality, she was a once-in-a-millennium homebody, even more socially anxious than herself, only able to put on a show of bravado in front of people she knew.
So, in front of those boys, she had to put on an attitude that pushed people away by a thousand miles, yet at the same time, she seemed to show that she really wanted to date them.
Those men couldn't figure out her thoughts, even thinking she had a split personality, which is why no one dared to be with her over the years.
But Qin Xiaoxu had never doubted herself; she had great confidence in herself, after all, her good looks and family background spoke for themselves. If those men didn't chase her, it only showed they knew when to give up, they simply weren't good enough for her.
Lately, fewer boys pursued her because Qin Xiaoxu came from a well-off family, and she liked to buy luxury items, all with her own money.
But when this got to the ears of those boys, it turned into something quite unsavory.

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Chapter 165 Jealousy
chapters.content:
She didn't know why some boys' minds were so filthy, even more loathsome than girls'. She often bought herself luxury goods, and those boys assumed she was clinging to some wealthy tycoons, which is why she could afford those luxuries.
Many people didn't understand her family background, so they started spreading rumors about her.
They thought she was a blatant gold-digger, and as a result, many boys at school began hearing these rumors.
They didn't care about the truth of the matter, anyway. They saw Qin Xiaoxu with luxury goods and believed the matter was settled.
So now, very few boys approached her, and those who pursued her didn't understand her.
But Qin Xiaoxu didn't care about all this, because her vision and family background were far above the ordinary, so why should she bother with the lower-class people's gossip?
As Qin Xiaoxu contemplated, a notification sound came from her phone.
She took out her phone and read the message aloud, "Vivi, that Li Lanlan seems to have asked us to meet at Jinguo Hotel!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi showed a look of surprise; he was also unexpected, not expecting the meeting to be at his own hotel.
It was a reward from the system before, but he hadn't been there either.
However, at this moment, Qin Xiaoxu was rather vexed and spoke helplessly.
"You all have partners, and me going alone is just too awkward. No way, I need to find myself a boyfriend too!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei burst into laughter, "Is a boyfriend something you can just find like that?"
But Qin Xiaoxu actually took out her phone and sent a message.
Han Xuewei immediately leaned in and saw the contact name Lin Jie, then showed a look of surprise, saying, "I forgot to ask you earlier, haven't you always been familiar with him? Are you two...?"
Han Xuewei said with implied meaning. Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu gave her a look and said, "How could I possibly be genuine with him? It's just to cope with family, so I pretend to be his girlfriend, just putting on a show for the parents! And that guy is surprisingly generous; he actually spends money to buy me things, saying the more convincing I am, the more I'll get!"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei couldn't help laughing. Qin Xiaoxu sure was a little money-grubber.
At this moment, Lin Yi showed a look of surprise and said, "Lin Jie is actually quite nice; you could consider getting to know him a bit more."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu shook her head and said directly, "That guy is just a stereotypical straight man, what does he know? Plus, I think I don't hate him. After all, he's a good person, his personality is okay, and he's generous with me. But I always feel something's not perfect about being with him, like something's missing..."
"Ah, I can't quite put my finger on it, but anyway, I haven't planned on making him my real boyfriend."
As Qin Xiaoxu spoke hesitantly, Han Xuewei and Lin Yi exchanged looks and burst into laughter.
Han Xuewei walked over to Qin Xiaoxu and said, "If you're afraid of feeling awkward, just call him over. I guarantee, once he's there, he can help you manage the situation. After all, Lin Jie has the demeanor and the looks, he's not worse than other guys."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu also thought it made sense. Lin Jie was always having her pretend to be his girlfriend to deal with things; it was about time she called him over to handle a situation for her.
After saying that, Qin Xiaoxu immediately made a phone call.
Soon, Lin Jie picked up on the other side, and Qin Xiaoxu spoke up, "Lin Jie, I have a get-together tonight with some old classmates, and your brother and Vivi will be there too. Why don't you come with me?"
Qin Xiaoxu spoke quickly, a bit afraid of the awkwardness, while Han Xuewei rarely saw Qin Xiaoxu with this attitude and couldn't help but laugh.
At this moment, Lin Jie, having heard this, put down the game he had in hand and responded, "You promised to come see me before, and you haven't dealt with dad and mom's matter yet. Now you want me to go to a class reunion for you?"
Hearing Lin Jie's words, Qin Xiaoxu immediately became somewhat agitated and retorted, "I'm just asking you to come over and help out; it's not a big deal. Besides, couldn't you just see your parents these two days? Why are you bargaining as soon as you open your mouth!"
Lin Jie was a bit taken aback by Qin Xiaoxu's remarks but seemed to sense that Qin Xiaoxu was somewhat upset as he said, "In that case, I'll come over and save you the embarrassment in front of your classmates!"
When Qin Xiaoxu heard Lin Jie say this, he was stunned on the spot. Lin Jie rarely showed this attitude, but this time it seemed as though he had become enlightened, even knowing how to annoy him.
Just as Qin Xiaoxu was about to say something, Lin Jie interrupted, "Send me the address, I'll hurry over."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu hung up and sent over the address.
Lin Yi then said to the two of them, "Since he is attending the get-together today, I think both of you should dress up nicely."
Upon hearing Lin Yi's words, Qin Xiaoxu nodded seriously and, patting Han Xuewei's shoulder, said, "I do think we should dress up nicely. Just to make sure Li Lanxue has nothing to say. She must have acted all high and mighty in front of you this time. I must dress up beautifully to leave her speechless."
With a laugh at Qin Xiaoxu's words, Han Xuewei said, "You are right, I agree!"
The two of them continued to walk ahead, laughing and chatting as they shopped for a while.
Lin Jie soon arrived, and upon seeing Lin Yi, immediately greeted, "Bro."
Lin Yi nodded at him and pointed towards Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu.
Lin Jie immediately showed a surprised expression and said, "Bro, you have no idea. Qin Xiaoxu can really shop. Your wallet is definitely going to take a hit this time."
Hearing this, Lin Yi looked at him nonchalantly, and Lin Jie, suddenly with a mischievous smile, asked, "Since I'm here too, can I buy something as well, bro?"
Lin Yi knew what he was thinking and nodded at him. Lin Jie immediately ran over to them, thrilled.
At that moment, when Qin Xiaoxu saw Lin Jie, she said indifferently, "Knowing we are shopping, you sure came quickly."
Lin Jie simply smiled and browsed through the suits, saying, "I just hope to look good when the time comes."
Qin Xiaoxu was somewhat surprised by this statement, thinking he wanted to show off at the event, but Lin Jie's next sentence left her speechless.
"Since my friend always complains about my poor taste in clothes, I'll have your classmates see just how good my taste is when I go there today!"
Qin Xiaoxu: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 166 Shopping Spree
chapters.content:
The shopping atmosphere heated up because Lin Jie had arrived.
Lin Yi had no interest in choosing clothes, so he just sat to one side looking at his phone, ready to try on anything Han Xuewei might pick out for him if she found something suitable.
If left to his own devices, he probably wouldn't be able to make a decision, and he didn't really enjoy picking out clothes anyway.
Just as they were bustlingly selecting items, a few men in suits walked in. Lin Yi, sitting off to the side, frowned when he saw them.
It seemed he had thought of something and immediately stood up to walk toward them.
These men were likely the management staff of the mall, and his intuition told him they must be looking for him for some reason. After all, this mall was his, and they would certainly be aware of the insider information.
As Lin Yi approached, the man leading the group greeted him, "Hello, sir, I'm the manager of this mall, my name is Han Dong. May I ask if you are Mr. Lin Yi?"
Hearing this, Lin Yi's frown deepened; he had a vague idea of what they were here for. He was the owner of the mall, the shareholder with the largest stake.
And he also owned the Wenqu Building, probably the mall's senior management, and he had greeted them and revealed his identity before, so they must have come looking for him now.
Since it was his property, he shouldn't need to pay for his purchases.
But Lin Yi didn't care about the money; it was just that the suit-clad men looked somewhat constrained and serious as they gazed at him.
Lin Yi looked towards Han Xuewei; he didn't want to let this situation out into the open, after all, it would be too sudden without a suitable reason.
Saying it was a system issue seemed too unbelievable, so Lin Yi chose to keep it from them.
He then made a discreet gesture to Han Dong, who, after seeing Lin Yi's expression and glancing at the people selecting clothes behind him, seemed to have an idea and casually began, "Well, our mall is planning to run a promotion and you, sir, have won our mall's prize. We noticed your number when you came in!"
"Our tail number is eight-eight-eight?"
At these words, Lin Yi raised his eyebrows and nodded. Han Xuewei and the others also came closer.
They thought it was strange to see these suit-clad men, so they quickly joined Lin Yi. Upon hearing what the man said, they all turned their attention to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi just nodded, and Han Dong said, "That's really fortunate, you've won our big prize, a mall promotion! We've provided a starting fund of ten million, which means you can spend up to ten million here today; anything up to that amount, you're free to take!"
At these words, Qin Xiaoxu immediately displayed a shocked expression, looking incredulously at the suit-clad men.
Lin Jie and Han Xuewei were also slightly surprised, but at that moment Lin Yi simply nodded his head and calmly said, "Well, thank you very much!"
At this, the suit-clad man seemed to breathe a sigh of relief, smiling as he said, "Don't mention it, you're just really lucky. Here's my business card, just take this card to the front desk later and you can settle the bill."
Hearing this, Lin Yi took the business card.
Qin Xiaoxu showed a delighted expression, exclaiming, "My God, ten million! That's such a bargain."
Lin Yi, looking calmly at the man, also thought his approach was good, as it saved him from some trouble.
Han Xuewei was likewise astonished, as such occurrences had happened many times before. She could only recognize that Lin Yi possessed extraordinary abilities.
At that moment, Han Dong just smiled and, not saying anything more, greeted them and left.
Lin Yi just nodded.
As Han Dong turned his head, he secretly breathed a sigh of relief, still feeling very nervous. He was shocked to hear the instructions from his superiors, but upon learning that the entire building belonged to this gentleman, he almost kneeled in astonishment.
Because this gentleman had never shown the presence of a big boss, he couldn't detect it at all.
Could wealthy people really be so low-key?
He thought to himself, surprised that Lin Yi was such a person, unwilling to reveal his information. Fortunately, he had kept it secret for Lin Yi.
Otherwise, he would have been finished. He had initially planned to flatter Lin Yi by telling him that the entire store's consumption would be free, that the people above would take care of the bills.
After all, for a mall as large as theirs, every penny had to be accounted for clearly, and a big boss like Lin Yi would definitely make purchases worth a significant amount.
So his quick thinking was indeed very good, or else Lin Yi wouldn't have smiled at him. Thinking this, he let out a sigh of relief.
At that moment, Qin Xiaoxu was also extremely excited, hearing about the ten million starting fund. She had no doubt and just took it as good fortune.
After all, she had seen malls like this with prices that were never cheap, so now she was just consuming eagerly.
Now without any reservations, she initially thought she was spending Lin Yi's money and spending a million was already the limit.
But now with the ten million starting fund, why should she care? It was right just to grab what she liked.
Lin Jie started picking out suits for himself with pleasure, but suddenly ended up with several shopping bags in his hands, unknowingly taking quite a few from behind Qin Xiaoxu.
The girl was just too extravagant; buying things was all about appeal for her. If she liked something, she would just let the salesperson pack it up.
Han Xuewei, on the other hand, was more meticulous in her shopping. She would pick what she liked and then try it on to see if it fit. If it wasn't the right fit, she wouldn't buy it.
Because that would be a waste; after all, even if she wouldn't wear them, those clothes weren't cheap. Although she had always lived in luxury since she was young and wore expensive clothes, she nearly wore each and every item, never engaging in wasteful behavior.
She had just reminded Qin Xiaoxu to pick something she could wear regularly, but Qin Xiaoxu seemed to be replying randomly.
Now she had chosen for herself a deep purple coat that seemed very hard to pull off, but Qin Xiaoxu really liked it and just went ahead with the purchase.

chapters.title: Chapter 167: Chapter 167 Personal Taste
chapters.content:
At this moment, Qin Xiaoxu was clearly very happy, and she quickly picked out some clothes she liked but never had the chance to buy.
Moreover, she felt that such an occasion definitely called for commitment, so she wasn't that reserved, thinking that even if she couldn't wear them, she could give them away later.
Moreover, Qin Xiaoxu was someone who would like anything she saw; she wanted to buy and try on the clothes worn by stars on TV.
So, at this moment, she saw a feather-covered dress and fell into deep thought.
Seeing this, Lin Jie's eyes widened in surprise, and he couldn't help but say, "You're not really thinking about buying that, are you? Wearing that would make you look like a feather duster."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu immediately showed a disdainful expression, turned her head to Lin Jie, and said, "What do you know about fashion? Wearing this kind of dress will definitely give off a high-end brand vibe. Salesperson, pack this one up for me!"
Lin Jie had come to a realization; he couldn't afford to anger Qin Xiaoxu now, otherwise, she would buy all the clothes he thought were bad.
After a while shopping, Lin Jie was already carrying dozens of shopping bags.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi was following behind Han Xuewei, holding only about ten shopping bags. The items Han Xuewei picked were all very carefully chosen; besides buying for herself, she also bought some for Lin Yi.
If there had been children's clothes here, she would have been extremely happy and would have bought some for the babies as well, but sadly, there weren't any.
However, there was no lack of children's clothes at home, so she dismissed the thought and after shopping for a while longer, Han Xuewei also started to feel tired.
After all, she had to try on every piece of clothing she picked, and that process was quite troublesome.
Looking at the dozens of shopping bags in his hands, Lin Jie frowned and said, "Qin Xiaoxu, that's enough. If you take any more, I won't be able to carry it all even if I had ten hands. Look at how much you've picked; among all these bags, only one or two are mine. You need to restrain yourself!"
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu turned her head, her expression also one of shock.
Without realizing it, she had picked out so much, but when she picked them, she did look at the price tags—the total came to just over a million.
The event had given a budget of ten million, so she had been quite restrained. With this in mind, Qin Xiaoxu felt it was reasonable and smiled lightly, saying, "No worries, just wait a bit longer, I'll pick two more pieces!"
Hearing that, Lin Jie's eyes widened, because he knew that the 'two pieces' Qin Xiaoxu mentioned probably meant twenty.
But there was nothing he could do, he just had to follow behind her.
At this point, looking at Qin Xiaoxu's retreating figure, Lin Jie couldn't help but think that if he had to shop with Qin Xiaoxu in the future, wouldn't he need to be prepared with funds? Otherwise, just one shopping spree with Qin Xiaoxu might leave him unable to pay back the debt!
At this thought, he suddenly looked astonished; why was he having such thoughts?
He scratched his head, deeply furrowing his brows.
Qin Xiaoxu was just his fake girlfriend; how could he even think about shopping and buying things for her!
Thinking this, Lin Jie became a bit irritated. He was carrying those dozens of shopping bags and took out his phone, just in time to vent to his family.
They had been very satisfied with Qin Xiaoxu before, but Qin Xiaoxu was far from being an ideal daughter-in-law. Would an ideal daughter-in-law spend money so lavishly?
Lin Jie then took a photo and sent it to the family group chat.
When Lin Yi's parents saw the message, they immediately showed a look of surprise. Mother Lin couldn't help but express her amazement, "Old Lin, your son is now quite promising, and he even takes his girlfriend out shopping."
Then, a message popped up on Lin Jie's phone—it was a transfer from his Dad.
Upon opening it, he saw his dad had transferred a full million to him!
Lin Jie was stunned by this, and couldn't help but send a message to his old man to ask about it.
At that moment, Lin Yi sent over a disdainful emoticon, followed by another message.
"If you need more money, just come to me!"
Lin Jie, seeing this, was dumbfounded once again; he hadn't expected his parents to be so easygoing.
Usually, they would lecture him about independence and finding a job whenever he asked for living expenses, but now they were transferring so much money just because he bought his girlfriend some things.
Lin Jie was at a loss as to when his parents became so inconsistent. Although he was somewhat speechless, receiving a cool million for nothing was definitely worth it.
After walking around the upper floors, Han Xuewei finally got tired. Qin Xiaoxu only stopped when she saw that Lin Jie couldn't carry any more.
But today was the happiest she had been shopping in years, because although her family background was decent, she couldn't always spend so freely.
Today, however, there was a sale, which made the shopping experience even more thrilling.
At this point, Han Xue looked at Lin Jie's almost tearful expression and said with a light smile, "Everyone has bought almost everything they wanted, so let's head back first. You two should head back as well, get ready, and then tonight, we'll meet at the hotel!"
After Han Xuewei finished speaking, she and Lin Yi left. Lin Yi gave Lin Jie a few reminders before leaving.
After they had their say, they all went home. Lin Yi was driving, with Han Xuewei sitting in the passenger seat.
After spending a long time choosing clothes, she felt tired and took a nap.
Lin Yi deliberately drove slower, but at this moment, the system's voice rang out.
"Congratulations to the host for completing a special task! Reward issued: one 'Golden Dragon' black card containing one hundred million in cash."
"The host has completed quite a few special tasks, so the system is granting a special reward! As long as you hasten the cultivation of affection with your wife, the system will be even more supportive!"
The system's voice sounded somewhat elfish, and Lin Yi couldn't help but laugh, yet he was very happy—he had actually received a black card with a hundred million in cash.
Previously, the system would reward him amounts ranging from a hundred thousand to a million or provide him with companies, but this time the reward was extravagantly large!
Actually receiving a hundred million, Lin Yi immediately showed a look of surprise. He wanted to check his phone, but since he was driving, he had to wait.
After he got home, the first thing he did was check his phone, and indeed, a hundred million in cash appeared on it. He was once again delighted.
Lin Yi, looking at the hundred million in cash, planned to use it for investment. However, finding the amount substantial, after some thought, he transferred ten million to Han Xuewei.
This should act as his personal savings. While he knew Han Xuewei wasn't short of money, he believed that a man should provide a sense of security to a woman, not just emotionally, but materially as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 168: Chapter 168 Investing to Make Money
chapters.content:
After Lin Yi made the transfer, he thought of Han Xuewei's parents, who had taken care of Han Xuewei diligently for so many years. Therefore, he also transferred five million to each of her parents.
After completing the transfer, he remembered his own parents were the same and transferred five million to each of his parents as well.
Sounds of inquiry arose in the family group chat with Han Xuewei's parents asking why Lin Yi suddenly transferred money to them!
But Lin Yi always said that he had some recent success in investment, which was why he transferred the money to them.
At that moment, Han Xuewei came out and saw Lin Yi, her eyebrows knitted in confusion as she spoke, "Husband! Why did you transfer money to me, and it's ten million at that!"
Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei and immediately embraced her, "Husband earns money to spend on his wife, and the money I transferred to you is all from my recent earnings in investments!"
"Don't worry about my investments having any risks. I'll just tell you straight, I'm very wealthy now!"
Lin Yi laughed heartily, and Han Xuewei immediately hugged his arm and said, "That's fantastic, my husband is so wealthy that I can live like a princess from now on."
After their cheerful chat, Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei's gentle and elegant face, couldn't help but lower his head and plant a kiss on her face, making Han Xuewei show a bashful expression.
However, after hearing the notification sound on the phone, Han Xuewei picked it up and saw her parents' inquiry, her brows furrowed as she said, "You also transferred money to my parents."
Lin Yi nodded his head. Han Xuewei wanted to say more, but the family group chat kept buzzing with messages. Not wanting her parents to refuse, Lin Yi had to keep explaining.
He replied to Dad Han and Han's mother, "Dad, Mom, don't worry. I recently made a bit of money from investing, so consider this money as a little token of my filial piety. It's really not much!"
After he finished speaking, Dad Han sent a message back.
"But if you want to transfer money, a few tens of thousands would suffice. We don't really spend much anyway. You transferred five million in one go, which is just too much."
For Dad Han, five million was entirely too much, sometimes not even reaching that amount in a month on a bad day of business, and now that Lin Yi had transferred it to him, he might as well retire and stop working.
At this moment, Han's mother was also very surprised and sent a message, "Lin Yi, you really shouldn't have, we're so old now, where would we need that much money? You should spend the money on the children. We old bones don't need it."
Lin Yi's mother and father were both extremely amazed and said, "What windfall have you come across recently, child?"
Lin Yi's parents weren't as astonished; they were very happy to see their child successful.
Lin Yi simply replied that he had profited from investments and had invested a lot earlier, so this time the returns were substantial. He assured everyone not to worry, as he was involved in legitimate business.
Seeing Lin Yi's response settled everyone's minds as the work wasn't illicit.
Moreover, Lin Yi was always considered steady and reliable, so they didn't overthink it.
Dad Han and Han's mother were extremely moved, although he was their son-in-law, he could offer such sincerity. With the meticulous care he showed towards Han Xuewei, it naturally touched their hearts.
"Lin Yi must take good care of himself and not be too busy with work!"
Dad Han said this, and Lin Yi simply replied, "I'm still young, I need to work hard when I can. As for you, if you ever want to retire, I'll come to help with your hotel right away."
Upon hearing this, Dad Han's eyes immediately brimmed with tears. Before he had founded his hotel, he was often ridiculed by others, and he only had one daughter, Han Xuewei, without a son.
To be honest, it wasn't very practical to pass on the family business to Han Xuewei eventually, as she would leave and grow further apart from him.
But unexpectedly, Han Xuewei had married such a wonderful man who not only took care of her but also offered help and comfort to him.
Having such an excellent son-in-law, he was very satisfied in his heart.
After chatting enough with his family, Lin Yi went to take a shower.
Being a straightforward man, he cleaned up quite quickly, and after just about ten minutes, he came out.
At that moment, Han Xuewei was choosing clothes. Lin Yi, watching her tender silhouette, couldn't help but walk over to her and held her in his arms, inhaling her faint fragrance.
Suddenly, Lin Yi felt an urge, wishing he could pin Han Xuewei down right then. Han Xuewei sensed something was off and immediately turned her head, saying, "Stop fooling around, we'll be late. Hurry up and change."
Lin Yi could only reluctantly let go of Han Xuewei and said indifferently, "It's fine, it's not any important party. If we're late, we're late."
Han Xuewei just smiled faintly. She had planned to pick out a smart-looking suit for Lin Yi, but since he didn't care much about tonight's gathering, he casually picked a casual outfit from the closet.
Although it was a regular piece of clothing, it still cost nearly a hundred thousand, being a niche brand not well-known to many. Lin Yi found it comfortable to wear, so he took it in his hands.
If he were still courting Han Xuewei, then perhaps he would dilly-dally and take two hours to get ready.
But as this gathering was not worth fretting over, Lin Yi wasn't so serious about it.
Han Xuewei chose a bright red gown, an elegant piece that exposed a portion of her back. Although not very sexy, it was nonetheless grand.
Han Xuewei thought the dress was very beautiful, so she took it in her hands. Lin Yi frowned at the gown.
It was just too revealing for his liking, and with his wife's good figure, if they went to the gathering and so many people saw her…
Thinking this, he felt uncomfortable, so he pressed down on the dress and said, "Don't wear this one. Wear this instead."
Lin Yi picked a skirt from the wardrobe that matched the color of his outfit, which was also very beautiful.
It was a distinctly subtle and elegant type of beauty. Many people would wear special gowns to these gatherings to look more sophisticated.
But Lin Yi thought Han Xuewei looked beautiful in anything, and he didn't want other men ogling his wife at the party.

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Chapter 169 Beautiful and Elegant
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei seemed to have read Lin Yi's mind, and with a faint smile, she took the dress from his hands and said, "I didn't expect you to be so petty!"
Lin Yi, upon hearing this, looked at Han Xuewei and leaned down to kiss her, saying, "I'm indeed petty!"
Han Xuewei's face turned red, and she immediately pushed Lin Yi away, "Alright, stop fooling around, we're really going to be late."
When Han Xuewei was in college, she was an exemplary student, so under these circumstances, she definitely wouldn't be late and would not have any issues.
But today, because of Lin Yi's playing around, they ended up being several minutes later than usual.
However, Lin Yi was comforting her on the side, not caring much about the gathering, while Han Xuewei was somewhat nervous, as she rarely attended such events.
Lin Yi drove the car and, arriving a few minutes late, they reached the entrance of Jinguo Hotel.
In fact, Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun were not that punctual either, arriving just a minute or two before Lin Yi and Han Xuewei. They parked their car right at the hotel entrance and got out together.
Hand in hand, they walked towards the entrance of the hotel, but just as they were about to step inside, they heard a series of exclamations from outside.
Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun also showed looks of surprise, turning their heads only to see another car still parked at the hotel entrance.
Sitting inside that car were Lin Yi and Han Xuewei.
At that moment, Han Xuewei looked up and saw Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun, realizing she actually wasn't late at all, and she immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
She got out of the car from the passenger side and said, "Honey, I'll wait for you here, go park the car!"
Lin Yi looked around and found a parking spot right there, which was also convenient for getting out.
So, without hesitation, he intended to park right there, but the security guards nearby wore looks of astonishment, and both exclaimed simultaneously, "That's a Mercedes Benz worth several million. That's not just any car."
"Exactly, hurry and tell that rich guy not to park there! If it gets scratched by another car, both of us are going to end up jobless!"
The security guard, in a rush, said this and ran over.
One guard, speaking hastily into a walkie-talkie, pointed at Lin Yi and said, "Sir, please park your car over by the entrance. There are too many cars here, and I'm worried yours could get damaged!"
Lin Yi had initially wanted to refuse, but seeing the man's worried expression, he realized the psychological pressure his car might be causing him.
Not wishing to cause any trouble, Lin Yi obediently drove towards the indicated spot.
The security guard finally sighed in relief; if the car were to get scratched, he wouldn't earn enough in his lifetime to pay for that paint job.
Meanwhile, Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun also displayed looks of surprise, watching the scene unfold incredulously.
However, Shen Wenjun quickly diverted her gaze back to Han Xuewei, who was waiting for Lin Yi.
Han Xuewei had her hair deliberately let down today, adorned with a delicate hair clip. She was wearing a very soft casual outfit and looked gentle and elegant—a virtuous wife and good mother, beautiful and poised.
When she turned her head and saw Li Lanxue, whose features clearly showed signs of cosmetic refinement, she felt a vast disparity and showed a look of disappointment.
At that moment, Li Lanxue also noticed Shen Wenjun's gaze, lifted her head, and upon seeing Shen Wenjun's disappointed expression, she immediately frowned and said, "Why are you looking at me like that? Is there something wrong with me?"
Li Lanxue said, having applied a particularly exquisite makeup for today, her goal was to dazzle everyone in attendance.
At that moment, Shen Wenjun immediately turned his head, his eyes brimming with disappointment. If only he had tried harder back then, he might truly have won the heart of Han Xuewei.
His family's financial condition wasn't bad. If only he had put in more effort, he could certainly have gained Han Xuewei's admiration.
Moreover, Han Xuewei's family background was indeed very impressive. He had previously thought Han Xuewei came from a comfortable, middle-class family. But when he saw on the school forum that Han Xuewei provided Lin Yi with an expensive Mercedes-Benz as part of her dowry, he was utterly shocked.
After learning this, many guys at school also realized Han Xuewei was the epitome of a proper "rich and beautiful" lady, completely out of reach for someone from an ordinary family.
Lin Yi had already parked the car and was walking toward Han Xuewei.
Today, Lin Yi was dressed in very casual attire. She was tall and fair-skinned, which complemented the clothes perfectly.
And that handsome face of hers, paired with the clothing, made her look extremely elegant. On closer inspection, she was much better looking than Shen Wenjun.
At that point, Shen Wenjun also noticed Lin Yi's elegance and his expression turned to one of amazement.
He, in fact, often compared himself to Lin Yi in secret, although Lin Yi's regular attire was quite casual.
Just like today, Lin Yi's style was still very relaxed, but her natural good looks and height already put her a cut above him.
At this moment, Li Lanxue was also slightly shocked. Lin Yi, when properly dressed, had her attractiveness soar, "zoom, zoom, zoom," skyrocketing upward. In the end, it was all thanks to her good genes.
Shen Wenjun, on the other hand, needed a good outfit to elevate his entire aura, and in this respect, he was streets behind Lin Yi.
Li Lanxue looked at Lin Yi, then shifted her gaze to Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei was wearing a casual long dress today that made her look gentle and elegant. Although pretty, it didn't seem as luxurious as her own outfit.
She, on the other hand, was wearing a high-end dress, purposely tight around the chest and studded with many diamonds, sparkling as she walked down the street.
Today was the class reunion she had specially organized, so she would not allow anyone to outshine her.
What Li Lanxue didn't know at the time was that Shen Wenjun didn't find her dress flattering at all.
Especially her intentionally tightened waist and snug chest. Given that Li Lanxue's bust was average at best, and her cinching to create curves in the middle, it didn't look beautiful, instead it seemed particularly forced.
But at this moment, Li Lanxue was unaware of her lack of self-awareness. She felt she looked stunning and walked straight over to Han Xuewei.
With a contemptuous expression, she opened her mouth and said, "Han Xuewei, you hesitated so much when you were invited today, I thought you wouldn't come."
Li Lanxue said this, her gaze fixed on Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei immediately frowned. She knew Li Lanxue, and it seemed she was here to provoke her again, though her demeanor remained indifferent.
Li Lanxue, while puffing out her chest, noticed that although Han Xuewei was also dressed in a long gown, not having deliberately cinched her waist, the drapes of her skirt still effortlessly outlined Han Xuewei's figure and proud chest.
This alone was something she could not achieve!
At that moment, Li Lanxue was clutching an exquisite handbag, her nails digging into the real leather.

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Chapter 170 Jealousy
chapters.content:
At this point, Li Lanxue was almost furious to death. She originally thought that Han Xuewei was just wearing an ordinary dress, but upon closer inspection, she discovered that Han Xuewei had such a superior figure.
Before, Han Xuewei always wore relatively loose clothing, and Li Lanxue didn't really pay attention to it.
Even though Han Xuewei had put on some weight after having a child, her recovery was quite good, and her balanced figure had just a bit of fleshiness, which actually made her look particularly tempting.
Just seeing how good Han Xuewei's figure was, Li Lanxue naturally felt anger. She finally understood why Shen Wenjun had been staring straight at Han Xuewei when they first arrived.
She was somewhat annoyed, and at this time, when Han Xuewei heard her words, she simply responded very gently, "Yes, since you invited me so warmly today, of course I had to come, otherwise you would definitely be disappointed!"
Hearing Han Xuewei's words, Li Lanxue also detected the malice in her tone, and immediately let out a cold snort.
"Yes, when I arrived earlier, I ran into you both, and I even saw just now, your husband came in a Mercedes, which must be rented. I saw you two together at the building at noon, and it was not this car he was driving then."
Li Lanxue spoke coldly, having made a point earlier to glance several times at Lin Yi's car.
That was just a several-hundred-thousand-dollar car, certainly nothing remarkable, but now he had come driving this luxury car.
It was obvious he had deliberately come to show off. Renting such a car wouldn't have been cheap. She hadn't expected that Han Xuewei, who usually seemed so meek, could put on such a front.
Hearing these words, Shen Wenjun immediately showed a look of astonishment. Li Lanxue was really brainless. Had she not seen the sensational news on the forums before? All she focused on were the topics targeting Han Xuewei, and now she was making a fool of herself in front of everyone. That car was the very one Han Xuewei brought as a dowry when she married Lin Yi.
At this time, Shen Wenjun felt some panic and immediately grabbed Li Lanxue, saying, "What are you thinking? That car was personally offered as a dowry by her father for her. Her father runs a hotel here, didn't you know?"
Shen Wenjun said this in a flurry, causing Li Lanxue's face to drastically change. She furrowed her brows and looked at Han Xuewei in astonishment.
Back in their college days, Han Xuewei had always kept a low profile. The supplies she used were similar to those of ordinary students, and her clothes were from common brands, despite knowing that her family's background was pretty good. But she had never thought in that direction.
After all, Han Xuewei never really used luxury items, and now seeing Han Xuewei made her eyes widen in surprise.
Han Xuewei was aware of what Li Lanxue's expression meant at this moment and immediately curled her lips into a smile, saying, "That's right! She's not wrong. I just came to join the gathering today. I don't want to hear you purposely making things difficult or saying anything, because in the end, the only person embarrassed will be you."
Han Xuewei said coldly, feeling genuinely angry. She didn't understand why Li Lanxue always seemed to seize the opportunity to deliberately trouble her.
If she didn't make her stance clear, that woman might never stop. After Han Xuewei finished speaking, she took Lin Yi by the hand and headed forward.
Lin Yi was also a bit surprised at this moment. It was the first time he had seen Han Xuewei so assertive. He curled his lips slightly and couldn't help but reach out to touch Han Xuewei's cheek.
Han Xuewei's cheeks were flushed as she glanced at him. She felt very justified about her attitude just now and suddenly laughed happily.
At this moment, Li Lanxue watched their retreating figures, immediately her forehead veins bulging with rage as she glared at them viciously.
Her face was an ashen shade of iron, a torrent of jealousy consuming her entire being. It turned out that Han Xuewei was not only the university's beauty queen but also a concealed rich second generation.
How could she possibly accept such a vast disparity?
Now, all Shen Wenjun could do was shake his head helplessly while looking at Li Lanxue.
Li Lanxue pondered, then cast a cold glance at Shen Wenjun. After all, he was a successful individual who had returned from studying abroad, an elite, while Lin Yi was just a man dependent on a woman's support, nothing to worry about indeed.
At the banquet later on, I will definitely humiliate your husband well. Your husband truly deserves to be called a kept man.
Since the family is so wealthy, only managing to find a man who lives off a woman, it should be quite the joke by then.
At this thought, a spiteful sneer formed on the corners of Li Lanxue's mouth. At that moment, Shen Wenjun was unaware of what Li Lanxue was thinking and could only follow her and walk ahead.
However, Shen Wenjun was well aware that Li Lanxue was not someone to be trifled with and had most likely already begun scheming; yet there was little he could do about such matters and had no choice but to accompany her.
"Who would have thought the man Han Xue found would look so virtuous but in reality is just a man who lives off a woman. Look at the clothes he was wearing earlier, just an ordinary brand.
To my eyes, he's just a man who stays at home looking after kids, utterly useless. He even dared to speak to me in that manner previously. Later, you must cooperate with me to give them a good lesson; that woman is just too arrogant."
As Li Lanxue spoke, she strode forward, while Shen Wenjun furrowed his brow. He wasn't very familiar with Lin Yi's family situation.
But as far as he knew, Lin Yi's family seemed to be in business as well, and the two families should be well-matched in social status.
Otherwise, it would be impossible to cultivate Lin Yi's composed demeanor, so to prevent Li Lanxue from embarrassing herself, he said, "I think their family must be quite wealthy, seeing as they are in business."
Hearing this, Li Lanxue just snorted coldly and sarcastically responded, "That's really funny. Do you just believe whatever they say? I know about the Lin Family's enterprise, but isn't their company just a shell company?"
"My dad has been in the business world for so long and has hardly come across the Lin Family. I suppose that CEO is just putting on an act outside, probably even the company is just registered to deceive people."
Li Lanxue was saying this with full confidence, and all Shen Wenjun could do was nod in agreement.
"Indeed, I haven't seen Lin Yi busy with anything; he doesn't seem to have a job."
What they didn't know was that Lin Yi's father had actually retired from the company voluntarily due to its cumbersome affairs. He chose to manage it independently, and whether he made money was not that important to him.
Regardless, Lin Yi had already earned back several years of the company's profits by now.

chapters.title: Chapter 171: Chapter 171 Black Truffle Steak
chapters.content:
Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun didn't say anything more and quickly made their way to the second-floor hall.
This time, Li Lanxue had deliberately chosen the second floor of the hotel for the gathering. Above the second floor was a very large club that could accommodate several hundred people, which was extremely spacious and luxurious.
There were also quite a few luxury decorations within, perfect for taking photos.
Some of the female classmates were very fond of such exquisite things, and they would gather around to take photos.
In the center, tables were set up for the banquet, and there were only a few dozen classmates. However, some people would bring their partners, which added up to about a hundred people.
But the banquet hall was indeed a bit too large, so she had arranged the banquet in a buffet style this time.
Many students really enjoyed this sort of atmosphere, grabbing whatever they liked!
In this respect, many students were satisfied, having quietly complimented Li Lanxue.
Although Li Lanxue didn't show it, her eyes were filled with pride. Her dad was the president of a listed company, and she could easily afford this expense.
Most of the classmates had also arrived, and at that moment, Qin Xiaoxu came over with Lin Jie.
Han Xuewei also entered holding Lin Yi's hand. Lin Yi was very tall, and his handsome appearance instantly attracted many gazes.
Han Xuewei became the center of attention. She wore a simple and elegant long dress.
It was a very common outfit, but on her, it exuded a unique charm, and everyone in the room had their eyes fixated on her.
The school beauty was indeed the school beauty; even casually dressed, she could outshine everyone!
What's more, people were surprised by Lin Yi at her side. Lin Yi's looks were also extremely charming, and among all the male classmates, he was clearly the most outstanding one.
At this moment, everybody's eyes were on Han Xuewei.
Even some of the female classmates couldn't help but exclaim in admiration.
"Goodness! Our school beauty is really something else, standing out with her aura!"
"Of course, and her husband is also good-looking. I initially thought she'd marry someone average-looking, but her husband is quite the catch!"
"Hey! You guys don't know? I heard her husband was from our school and in the same grade, but I had never seen him before. Who knew he was such a hunk!"
"Oh, you guys are unaware of their low profile, I heard they took a break from school a while back to go have a baby!"
"Yeah, I've heard those little babies are gorgeous. The school forum went crazy over it, don't you know?"
"That forum's been shut down a long time ago, no idea which big shot did it, managing to close the forum and have all the photos taken down. But I've still heard some whispers and rumors!"
"They had their wedding ceremony not long ago, and we weren't there."
"That's so mysterious, but look at her husband, so dashing. What do you think he does for a living?" "Probably in the same line of business as Han Xuewei's family, I guess. All I know is that Han Xuewei's family is very wealthy."
The crowd was abuzz with speculation, admiring Han Xuewei's beautiful look, with many girls calling Han Xuewei the epitome of a modern-day 'rich and beautiful'!
"I heard her dad opened a hotel near the Wenqu Building. The food there is really excellent and great value for money. I visited their place once, and their attitude toward people and customers is really good. It's truly a cultivated family; whatever they do is very high-level..."
Everyone was talking about it, their conversation moving from Han Xuewei's life at university to her personal family background.
It all boiled down to envy, and at that moment, Qin Xiaoxu saw Han Xuewei and her group approaching and couldn't help but reveal an excited expression, beckoning them over.
Han Xuewei and Lin Yi looked up and saw Qin Xiaoxu and immediately headed towards her.
Qin Xiaoxu was very surprised. She picked up her purse and said right away, "The place just got so crowded, but luckily I was quick and put my purse here, snagging two good spots!"
"This is right in the middle, I think sitting here we will definitely get the tastiest food!"
As Qin Xiaoxu spoke, she happily reached for Han Xuewei's hand.
Han Xuewei sat down beside her and, seeing the food piled up in front of her, couldn't help but speak, "You girl, can you think of anything other than eating? Look at you go, Lin Jie is even watching from the side."
As Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Jie felt somewhat embarrassed.
But when Qin Xiaoxu lifted her head to look at Lin Jie, she showed a disdainful expression, "Let him watch, if he doesn't want to eat, that's his problem!"
Qin Xiaoxu really didn't care about maintaining a girlish image at all, Lin Jie felt awkward watching her behave like this.
Han Xuewei just watched the two of them, shaking her head at their attitude of disdain for one another.
These two were obviously the most well-matched, yet both behaved so childishly.
At that moment, Lin Yi tidied up the things on the table and then said, "Wife, what would you like to eat? I'll go get it for you."
Lin Yi was indeed very considerate, his subtle actions taking great care of Han Xuewei.
When Han Xuewei heard this, she nodded and said, "Husband, I want to eat pasta and steak!
Han Xuewei had hardly eaten anything today and was hungry by now, with a hearty appetite.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi turned back to look forward, where the steak from this hotel was quite famous, and since Li Lanxue offered to treat, many female students were fond of steak, so a long queue had already formed at the front.
Lin Yi frowned at the sight of the line ahead.
Queuing up seemed too troublesome, it would probably be better to just order directly from the restaurant.
"Wait a bit, wife, I'll order for you now, the line over there is too long, I think it will be faster if I order a steak to be delivered!"
Since there were so many people queuing for steak, Lin Yi didn't mind queuing, but those steaks were almost all synthetic.
In a place like this, the hotel might only splurge on a few hundred yuan for a steak. If the prices were too high, it would become a lavish expense for the numerous guests, and sales wouldn't hold up.
After all, even though there are customers for high-priced steaks, the general public still leans towards more affordable dining.
So Lin Yi waved over a waiter right away, asked for a menu, and spotted the most expensive steak, priced nearly at three thousand yuan, named the Black Truffle Steak.
That was the truly authentic steak in the restaurant, and Lin Yi ordered one right away.
At that moment, Qin Xiaoxu, with her mouth still full of pasta, raised her eyebrows and said, "Then I want one too… I want one too!"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei smiled slightly and said, "Then let's order two."

chapters.title: Chapter 172 Loves to Freeload
chapters.content:
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu nodded in satisfaction and flashed a heart-shaped hand gesture towards Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei was amused to laughter by her antics, while Lin Yi simply watched from the sidelines.
Lin Yi, of course, felt he had to look after Qin Xiaoxu, after all, with Qin Xiaoxu by Han Xuewei's side, he could tell that Han Xuewei was visibly much happier.
Lin Yi stood up and said, "Vivi, I'll go get you some snacks. You haven't eaten much today, let's get something to fill you up first!"
Having said that, Lin Yi walked to the front, and this action caught the attention of Li Lanxue.
