She had been watching Lin Yi all along, as she was the host of the party and it was her treat, with everyone ordering their own food.
She was curious about what Lin Yi would order, so when she saw the waiter holding the bill, she walked straight forward and stopped the waiter.
Seeing that it was today's hostess, the waiter lifted his head to look at Li Lanxue, somewhat perplexed.
But Li Lanxue simply reached out and took the bill from his hand, and upon seeing that Lin Yi had ordered two servings of black truffle steak, her expression turned steely.
A serving of this black truffle steak cost nearly three thousand yuan. Lin Yi was really splurging — was he taking advantage of her generosity?
He had ordered two servings at once!
Even though her family was affluent, they weren't necessarily that generous, especially since the costs here were already high. The venue and food together added up could not make this gathering happen with less than a hundred thousand yuan.
She was holding this event to showcase her family's status as successful entrepreneurs in Xiangcheng, and naturally, she couldn't let her classmates pay.
Therefore, many of her classmates were very conscious and wouldn't dare pick such expensive items!
However, Lin Yi's actions, in her view, were shameless freeloading, and at this moment, her gaze towards Han Xuewei revealed contempt.
Sure enough, the poor love to freeload! People from small places, who haven't seen the world, would probably only have this chance in their lives to eat a steak worth thousands.
But at this moment, Li Lanxue was unaware of the other side's perspective, and what she didn't know was that Lin Yi had specifically told the waiter that he would not be mooching off this steak.
Furthermore, he had also checked the price. These prices should not be considered cheap to the person footing the bill.
If everyone were to order carelessly like this, the gathering could end up costing nearly five hundred thousand. He didn't want to take advantage of anyone, so he asked the waiter to bring the food and bill at the same time.
Li Lanxue, oblivious to these details and having not asked the waiter, simply handed back the bill and stormed off in a huff.
Her disdain for Lin Yi intensified in her heart!
People from the backwaters are all the same!
At that moment, Qin Xiaoxu, who had been eating, suddenly stopped and turned back to speak to Han Xuewei, "Vivi, I think I just saw a guy I'm very familiar with. He seemed to have chased after me before, and today he's here too, sitting right behind us!"
Hearing Qin Xiaoxu's words, Lin Jie was taken aback.
Although Qin Xiaoxu was whispering to Han Xuewei, her voice was perhaps a bit too loud!
He heard it loud and clear from beside them.
That girl actually had suitors—that was quite a surprise to him!
At that moment, Han Xuewei leaned into Qin Xiaoxu's ear and said, "Really? I think I've seen that guy before too."
Han Xuewei had been the subject of Qin Xiaoxu's venting several times before because she really didn't like that guy, and now Qin Xiaoxu earnestly nodded her head, "Yes, I saw him. He even brought his girlfriend with him!"
Han Xuewei couldn't help but look up towards the front. She had little impression of other men.
Even among the men who had pursued her in the past, she might not even remember their names.
During her college days in Xiangcheng, the only male student who had made a lasting impression on her was Lin Yi.
She remembered the first time she went to school, Lin Yi had helped her out.
When she saw Lin Yi's handsome face, a very good impression was imprinted on her heart.
Afterward, her interest in Lin Yi grew, and through getting to know him, she found that Lin Yi was a very considerate person.
What's more, an important point for her was his deep respect for women—an internal respect that fascinated her. How could she not like such an outstanding guy?
Meanwhile, Qin Xiaoxu spoke up again: "It's that guy sitting at the back table, the one in the middle wearing a white shirt, and his girlfriend is sitting beside him!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei finally looked up and said, "Didn't he continuously pursue you before? Now he seems to have found a girlfriend."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu nodded and commented, "I saw him on social media before. People say he is working in a corporate office for an overseas company now, the salary should be quite high. For a newly graduated college student, that position is already pretty good."
"What's gotten into you all of a sudden? You used to despise him, didn't you?" Qin Xiaoxu replied shaking her head, "Let it be. I don't want to hold a grudge over past events anymore."
Han Xuewei's expression turned sour as she said, "That guy didn't stop badmouthing you before, and everything he said was slanderous."
As Qin Xiaoxu's good sister, Han Xuewei naturally wanted to stand up for her, so seeing Qin Xiaoxu so easily let things go made her visibly displeased.
But Qin Xiaoxu didn't mind and simply said, "If others so easily believe those rumors, it also shows they actually didn't care about me much. So it's better to let it be."
Qin Xiaoxu seemed quite at peace with it, but Han Xuewei held a grudge against that guy.
It was because she had heard that he had once gifted Qin Xiaoxu a branded bracelet, but since Qin Xiaoxu didn't like him, she refused it.
However, he then spread rumors that Qin Xiaoxu was a gold-digger, a woman who liked to cling to the rich and powerful, which was why she didn't accept his gift.
In short, he insinuated she looked down on his 'poor' status and preferred to be with wealthy men, which led to very unpleasant gossip.
When Han Xuewei first heard about it, she nearly confronted him on behalf of Qin Xiaoxu, but Qin Xiaoxu stopped her.
Now, after so much time, Han Xuewei had almost forgotten about the incident until Qin Xiaoxu brought it up again, and only then did she remember.

chapters.title: Chapter 173 Add a Contact Method
chapters.content:
However, at today's gathering, Han Xuewei didn't want to talk about these uninteresting matters and said, "I think you're quite fine as you are now, you don't really need to date, you can go straight to marriage!"
As Han Xuewei spoke, she glanced at Lin Jie.
Lin Jie at that moment was stealthily listening to their conversation and was startled by Han Xuewei's remark, promptly fixing an expression of surprise and sitting upright.
Seeing Lin Jie's comical reaction, Han Xuewei managed a slight smile.
In Han Xuewei's opinion, Lin Jie was undoubtedly very fond of Qin Xiaoxu, after all, the two seemed so well-matched and got along so harmoniously.
As long as feelings developed over time, marriage wasn't out of the question.
At this, Qin Xiaoxu couldn't help but laugh, looking back at Han Xuewei, then turning to Lin Jie, she couldn't help but say, "Vivi, what are you thinking? You don't actually want me to marry this guy, do you?"
Han Xuewei just smiled, "I think it's quite good, Lin Jie is really a great person, and both his parents are very warm-hearted, plus the family conditions are good!"
"Although the age difference isn't perfect, older woman-younger man relationships are in vogue now. I think you can rest assured to entrust yourself to him; he's quite caring!"
Han Xuewei couldn't stop talking whenever the topic of Lin Jie came up, as if she was planning to settle the marriage right then and there.
Qin Xiaoxu felt overwhelmed; previously pressured by her own parents, and now Han Xuewei was on her case too, she could only reluctantly say, "Eat your steak, let's not talk about this."
Meanwhile, Han Xuewei just chuckled and lowered her head to eat.
Qin Xiaoxu, tired of eating, sat to the side and played with her phone. Some people had yet to arrive, and the gathering hadn't truly started yet.
At that moment, a man seated behind Qin Xiaoxu lifted his gaze to look over at her.
His name was Lin Zhiyuan, and he had noticed Qin Xiaoxu as soon as he arrived.
This spot was chosen deliberately by him so he could have a clearer view of Qin Xiaoxu's every move.
He was always very confident in himself and had not expected his pursuit of Qin Xiaoxu to end in failure. Qin Xiaoxu had rejected him outright in front of many people, causing him to lose all face.
The flower he couldn't acquire, he wished only to destroy!
The girlfriend beside him was a female colleague he had known before. Although the woman was not as beautiful as Qin Xiaoxu, her personality was better than Qin Xiaoxu's, not as willful, and both her figure and appearance were quite passable.
He could get along with such women, and he truly didn't understand how Qin Xiaoxu dared to reject him!
He had saved several months' worth of living expenses just to buy Qin Xiaoxu a certain brand's bracelet, a piece that was worth tens of thousands!
So now, he no longer harbored admiration for Qin Xiaoxu, mostly just jealousy and resentment.
He was very confident about his current self, after all, how many could land such a good job just after graduating from college?
Stable job, high salary, and he even had a girlfriend now - he might not be considered successful, but at least his life was prosperous and stable.
If Qin Xiaoxu had followed him back then, she could have had a decent life as well.
Yet, what he hadn't expected was for Qin Xiaoxu to reject him outright.
What he wouldn't expect even more was that Qin Xiaoxu never took him seriously at all.
For her, Lin Zhiyuan's salary of tens of thousands was simply not enough. Qin Xiaoxu was a true heiress.
Fortunately, Qin Xiaoxu had not revealed her family's wealth, otherwise Lin Zhiyuan wouldn't have given up pursuing her so easily.
People like him, always looking to climb the social ladder, probably see a rich wife as the ultimate goal. The girlfriend he currently has is merely a cure for loneliness.
At this moment, Lin Zhiyuan was staring intently at Qin Xiaoxu, then glanced at his own girlfriend.
To be honest, just sitting there, Qin Xiaoxu's demeanor was far superior to that of his current girlfriend.
Though his girlfriend had a decent body and face, she was only average. Qin Xiaoxu, on the other hand, was delicately nurtured from a young age, and there was no comparison in terms of refinement and poise.
Feeling restless, he stood up and said, "I'm going to have a word with an old classmate. Wait here for me, and I'll come and join you in a bit!"
As Lin Zhiyuan spoke, the girl nodded her head.
She didn't have the slightest doubt about Lin Zhiyuan, as he had a way with words that was particularly reassuring. During the few months they had been together, she hadn't noticed anything amiss.
So she was very confident in Lin Zhiyuan.
Lin Zhiyuan then approached Qin Xiaoxu, while Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun also walked towards them.
Li Lanxue noticed Lin Zhiyuan and was somewhat surprised.
She recognized this classmate who seemed to have pursued Qin Xiaoxu before, but she wasn't very familiar with Lin Zhiyuan, so she didn't greet him.
She just walked to the opposite side of Han Xuewei's group. After all, Han Xuewei was the protagonist of the drama unfolding before her, and she couldn't miss any detail.
Just then, Lin Zhiyuan directly sat down in front of Qin Xiaoxu.
He immediately slapped Qin Xiaoxu on the back, causing her to turn her head sharply, clearly startled by the gesture.
Lin Zhiyuan's face was all too familiar to her, but being so close now made her feel a bit flustered. She almost choked on her red wine and, coughing, looked at Lin Zhiyuan.
Lin Jie reacted very quickly, immediately protecting Qin Xiaoxu and pulling out a tissue to wipe the corners of her mouth and the wine stains on her dress.
He wiped everything off neatly and proficiently, his actions neither awkward nor intrusive.
Lin Zhiyuan watched this scene unfold with some surprise, his gaze settling on Lin Jie, sizing him up. Meanwhile, Lin Jie snorted coldly and said, "I am Qin Xiaoxu's boyfriend. Do you have a problem with that? You've been staring at us since you came in!"
Reminded by these words, Lin Zhiyuan realized his expression had been somewhat presumptuous a moment earlier, and he smiled awkwardly and said, "That's not what I meant..."
"I'm Qin Xiaoxu's classmate. I just came over to say hello!"
Lin Jie had been listening in on Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei's whispers, so he was well aware of what the man before him had done to elicit such aversion from Qin Xiaoxu, which now filled him with disgust.
He looked alright, but his character was truly reprehensible.
At this moment, Qin Xiaoxu spoke up, "Is there something you needed from me?"
Hearing her words, his face lit up with a joyous expression, and he said somewhat awkwardly, "Qin Xiaoxu, I've really reflected on what happened before. It was my fault, and I'm apologizing to you. I just hope you can forgive me!"
Expecting something serious, Qin Xiaoxu replied promptly, "It doesn't matter, I have already forgotten about it. You don't need to dwell on it!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Zhiyuan suddenly became excited and said, "Then, may I add your contact information again?"
Lin Zhiyuan's expression was one of earnest pleading. Witnessing this,
both Lin Jie and Han Xuewei were a bit surprised, while Qin Xiaoxu found herself in an awkward position and could only say, "My contact information is in the class group. You can add me there."

chapters.title: Chapter 174 Winner in Life
chapters.content:
Hearing this, Lin Zhiyuan immediately showed a delighted expression and couldn't help saying, "That's really great, Qin Xiaoxu, I thought you were still mad at me!"
His words were somewhat intimate, as if the two of them had a special relationship, which immediately made Lin Jie somewhat dissatisfied. He directly said, "Qin Xiaoxu, you've really grown some nerve, I'm your boyfriend, and now you're adding another guy on WeChat right in front of me, is that appropriate?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Zhiyuan immediately defended himself, "We are just classmates after all, and I have a girlfriend now. I added Xiaoxu purely out of classmates' friendship, I won't disturb you two!"
His words reeked of sarcasm.
In fact, Lin Zhiyuan had no so-called boundaries at all, she was just a girlfriend, not a wife, Lin Zhiyuan certainly didn't care.
At this moment, Qin Xiaoxu had no choice but to say, "That's right, we are just classmates. You must have quite a few female classmates in your phone too!"
Lin Jie wanted to say something else, but was infuriated by Qin Xiaoxu.
But Qin Xiaoxu didn't take it seriously, after all, their relationship wasn't truly that of a couple, but feigned; Lin Jie had no place to interfere so much.
Naturally, Lin Jie thought the same, he turned his head, but he was getting more and more annoyed inside.
At this moment, Han Xuewei watched the two of them and couldn't help but laugh.
These two guys were just too proud and arrogant, neither willing to give in nor apologize, just at a stalemate. If there wasn't some reinforcement to push them, they probably would never make any progress in this lifetime.
Han Xuewei watched them and resolved that if she had the chance, she definitely must play matchmaker for the two of them, as they really seemed so perfect for each other.
Meanwhile, the situation here had also been noticed by Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun.
Li Lanxue looked coldly at Lin Zhiyuan at this moment.
She had no interest in Lin Zhiyuan, for he was a person of no use in her network.
She wouldn't associate with such a person, after all, just a wage earner. The people she needed to know were those useful in the business world, like Shen Wenjun, who had connected with her because of business matters.
So at this moment, when Li Lanxue looked at them, she waited until Lin Zhiyuan had left before approaching Han Xuewei, toasted her with a glass of wine, and said, "Han Xuewei, we were quite familiar with each other back at school, but almost everyone has not yet graduated. I heard before that you and your husband dropped out halfway, and you probably haven't graduated yet, right?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei frowned. She had a hunch that Li Lanxue was definitely up to some mischief again.
Despite this, she still replied amiably, "Yes, we need to go back to school when the term starts this year. We must get the graduation certificate, and I also want to pursue postgraduate studies..."
Hearing Han Xuewei's words, Li Lanxue immediately revealed a mocking expression and said, "Is that so? But we've heard you now have three kids at home. You're really amazing, having triplets. Your husband hasn't even graduated from college yet and the whole weight of the family has fallen on him. Can he afford it?"
After she finished speaking, she sized up Han Xuewei and could see that Han Xuewei's complexion had already turned rather unpleasant.
The many classmates around also showed curious expressions, and Li Lanxue continued, "I heard before that the industry on your husband's side hasn't been doing well these past few years, do you need help from classmates?"
Upon hearing these words, everyone present began to buzz with excitement.
Li Lanxue's insinuation was that Lin Yi was jobless and even had to support a large family, which surely meant he was relying on Han Xuewei.
Isn't this just a clear case of living off a woman?
Han Xuewei certainly understood Li Lanxue's meaning and directly responded, "I think you may be mistaken. Lin Yi has been taking care of my father's hotel business, and my husband has amassed a substantial amount of money from his time as a student. He has made quite a bit from investments and stocks, so it's not as embarrassing as you imagine. Moreover, his studies have not been delayed."
Han Xuewei despised Li Lanxue's insinuating tone, even if she were to speak of herself—but why should Lin Yi be slandered?!
Thus, at that moment, she did not speak as softly as usual.
Hearing this, Li Lanxue immediately furrowed her brows and said, "I haven't heard about these investments, and I don't understand them well! But as far as I know, whether it's investing or trading stocks, these are difficult endeavors, right? If there are losses, it becomes even harder. Truly, you can be honest—it doesn't matter. We're all classmates here; if we can help you, we will.
With your husband out of a job and you taking care of three children, we just can't stand by and watch..."
Upon hearing this, Shen Wenjun also chimed in from the side, "That's right, Xue Mei. Honestly, we're just concerned, and why not have Lin Yi work at our company? The salary definitely won't be low!"
As these words were spoken, Lin Jie stood to the side with furrowed brows and stood up.
How dared these people take advantage of Lin Yi's absence to say he was living off a woman—this was utterly absurd!
So Lin Jie looked straight at them and retorted, "You people are really something, defaming and insulting someone without any evidence. Do you think you have any dignity?"
Then, his voice grew louder, echoing around the room, "I tell you, ten of you combined aren't worth as much as my brother. My brother is already tired enough just running Supreme Grade Supermarkets!"
"Ever heard of Supreme Grade Supermarkets? The biggest chain of supermarkets in Huaxia. He alone holds ten percent of the equity, and the profits and dividends amount to over ten billion. Who do you think you're looking down on?!"
Speaking somewhat indignantly, Lin Jie mentioned that the Supreme Grade Supermarkets was something Lin Yi had specifically told him about, which the two brothers were managing together.
In fact, this venture was also a reward given to Lin Yi by the system, but as Lin Yi lacked the time to manage it, he had entrusted the responsibility to Lin Jie and their parents.
At that moment, hearing these words, the surrounding crowd all showed astonished expressions. Supreme Grade Supermarkets was an essential part of their daily lives. It could be said that this establishment had woven itself into everyone's life.
With a quick search on their phones, they found Lin Yi's name among the shareholders, complete with his photo.
Everyone gasped in shock. Supreme Grade Supermarkets was a business with assets worth several hundred billion. With so many chain stores nationwide, owning ten percent of the shares translated to a fortune of several billion.
Everyone looked at Han Xuewei with amazement, not expecting that she had married a hidden tycoon!
And they were all still students, yet Lin Yi had become a billionaire, a true winner in life!

chapters.title: Chapter 175 Chapter 175 Invitation to Dinner
chapters.content:
At this moment, everyone was looking at Han Xuewei, who stood at the center, poised and graceful.
Suddenly, they all understood, how could the school beauty possibly marry an ordinary man?
"Oh my god, I can't believe the school beauty's husband is actually a billionaire worth tens of billions!"
"Yeah, who would've thought her husband was that rich? But I saw it earlier too, her husband is indeed very handsome. That means the luxury items given at the wedding were all real!"
"Exactly! To buy things worth several hundred million as if it's nothing, it seems it wasn't an exaggeration."
"No way, what are you guys talking about? How could anyone give gifts worth several hundred million?"
"It's true, I saw the pictures posted on the forum at that time, I couldn't believe it... but now it seems to be real!"
Some had already set their sights on the accessories Han Xuewei was wearing today. Unbeknownst to Han Xuewei herself, her necklace was a nationally-limited edition, priced at tens of millions.
But a female classmate immediately exclaimed, "Look! Isn't that the nationally-limited custom Holy Maiden crystal?"
Upon hearing this, everyone turned their gaze towards Han Xuewei.
Then someone spoke up, "It's indeed the Holy Maiden crystal, I can't be wrong! Under the light, the Holy Maiden crystal seems dim, but in areas with no light, it shines incredibly brilliantly, something ordinary diamonds can't achieve."
Only then did the crowd realize that the necklace Han Xuewei was wearing was indeed in that state.
At this time, Han Xuewei herself was also slightly astonished, she had not expected Lin Yi to give her such a valuable item.
Previously, she had only worn it as a normal necklace.
Hearing these words, people were very surprised and began discussing among themselves.
On the side, Lin Zhiyuan also displayed a look of shock, he had thought his own level was quite high-end, but had not expected that among his classmates there would be a boss worth tens of billions.
How could this be possible?
Wouldn't his salary of tens of thousands seem laughable in comparison?
And now, seeing Lin Jie's indifferent demeanor, does that mean Lin Jie is the brother of the tycoon worth tens of billions?
And also the boyfriend of Qin Xiaoxu, how could this be possible?
They were still in university and Lin Yi already owned tens of billions in wealth, completely overturning his understanding.
Moreover, there had been news of hard times for Lin Yi's family business before, so how did it suddenly turn into owning billions in assets?
Therefore, at this moment, everyone showed a look of surprise, while Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun naturally did not believe it.
Li Lanxue looked at Lin Jie and snorted coldly, "Who are you? Who let you spout nonsense here!"
Hearing this, Lin Jie couldn't help but roll his eyes at her and retorted, "I am Lin Yi's cousin, and I'm naturally aware of how many businesses my brother has. Moreover, you can check on Heavenly Eye, no need to question me here!"
Upon hearing this, everyone showed a look of surprise
Shen Wenjun was also somewhat displeased at this moment and directly said, "The things you're saying have no basis, and besides, who knows if that information he posted was forged."
"What did I fabricate?"
Just at that moment, a chilly voice rang out. Lin Yi held in his hand a small cake, the very one he had taken quite some time to select, finally settling on Han Xuewei's favorite flavor, even going so far as to sprinkle it with some extra toppings himself.
At that moment, he heard the crowd chattering around him, and the subject of their conversation was none other than his own affairs. Nevertheless, he strolled over with an air of nonchalance.
He directly handed the cake to Han Xuewei and said, "This is your favorite strawberry cake. I didn't make it too sweet, so you can eat it first."
Experience new tales on empire
Han Xuewei was somewhat surprised upon hearing this, as Lin Yi completely ignored the people around them.
Many nearby wore looks of envy.
Yet Shen Wenjun felt humiliated, his eyes gradually reddening as he huffed, "We're all adults here; there's no need to lie in this setting. Furthermore, the idea that a mere university student would possess a fortune of billions is utterly absurd. Supreme Grade supermarkets are not open to just anyone as shareholders."
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi turned his head and glared coldly at Shen Wenjun.
At that moment, Shen Wenjun, feeling the weight of Lin Yi's stare, grew somewhat irritated, and Li Lanxue stepped forward to say, "Lin Yi, there's really no need for you to argue. If you're capable, why not just cover tonight's bill? Then I might actually believe you have some power!"
Li Lanxue spoke with full confidence, looking down upon someone who would mooch even a high-end black truffle steak.
She was certain that Lin Yi simply couldn't afford it and that eventually, Han Xuewei would have to step in to deal with the aftermath.
Unexpectedly, Lin Yi replied straightforwardly, "My fellow students, go ahead and place your orders. I'll cover the bill for everyone tonight!"
Lin Yi spoke coolly, and Han Xuewei immediately reached out to grasp his hand, signaling him not to do this.
After all, it wasn't their group's gathering today, so why should he foot the bill?
And making such a display was hardly going to win Lin Yi any favors.
But Lin Yi simply didn't care about the money, and he snorted confidently, "It's no big deal, Vivi. These are your classmates; it's nothing to treat them once in a while!"
Lin Yi's words reached everyone's ears, and all were struck with astonishment.
This was a top-notch hotel with no small tab; it carried many luxury foods as well.
At first, the classmates hesitated to order, but after Lin Yi's declaration, settling the bill would take at least half a million.
Lin Yi was just a university student who hadn't graduated yet, without even a job, and his classmates were likewise skeptical about his alleged multibillion fortune.
In the meantime, Shen Wenjun, seeing that Lin Yi was provoked into taking the bait, revealed a smug expression and said, "Classmate Lin Yi, you really surprise me. Even if our family's company is worth a few billion in the market, claiming that you have tens of billions is a bit much, even for saving face. There's really no need for you to cover tonight's meal."
Shen Wenjun's words were clear and filled with mockery; he just wanted Lin Yi to admit his lack of ability.
But at that moment, Lin Yi shook his head and replied indifferently, "I'll cover it. Isn't that what you all want? Well, it's settled—tonight I'm treating!"
Upon hearing these words, Shen Wenjun's face grew even more unsightly. He had been coddled from a young age, always a figure of affluence and status.
Yet Lin Yi had casually claimed to have a fortune of tens of billions, something Shen Wenjun would never believe.
Many classmates shared his perspective. Tens of billions was just too preposterous, but Shen Wenjun's family wealth was well known to them all.

chapters.title: Chapter 176 Chapter 176 The Black Gold Dragon Card
chapters.content:
At this moment, Shen Wenjun stood at the center, with many classmates showing ingratiating expressions, walking over to him, and toasting him one after another.
Many people started to talk.
"Oh my god, do you guys know? Shen Wenjun studied abroad, and he has now inherited his father's business, which is worth ten billion in the market!"
"I heard he's even dating Li Lanxue. Both their families are well off—it seems they are really a match made in heaven!"
"We're talking about Shen Wenjun, right now he's definitely the richest second-generation rich in our class. As for Lin Yi, we really haven't heard anything about him..."
Many people were discussing, but they weren't very clear about Lin Yi's personal situation.
And at that moment, Li Lanxue also showed an arrogant expression, looking coldly at Lin Yi with a sarcastic and mean demeanor.
Someone, trying to please Li Lanxue, chimed in.
"Your boyfriend is really successful now, unlike some who boast about having tens of billions of fortune but don't even dare to show it!"
"Right, how could that be possible? Owning tens of billions before even graduating from college? Then might as well claim I'm the biggest international entrepreneur!"
As they spoke, some opportunistic individuals burst into a huge laughter.
Seizing the opportunity, Li Lanxue added, "You're right, they just love to swell their faces to look fat."
"Just now, I saw Lin Yi order two servings of the black truffle steak. You all saw the price list just now, right? That's the most expensive steak here, and he ordered two servings. He's only here at this reunion to freeload a meal and drinks!"
After saying that, she showed a contemptuous look, turned towards Lin Yi and said, "Since you claim to have a fortune of billions, why be so miserly that you can't even afford a steak worth a few thousand yuan!"
Li Lanxue said coldly, and Shen Wenjun also showed a look of displeasure. His dislike for Lin Yi was growing.
He couldn't stand Lin Yi's arrogance, and moreover, Lin Yi had married the woman he loved most in his life. These two things were undoubtedly an affront to him; he wanted to pierce through Lin Yi's façade himself.
Hearing these words, Han Xuewei frowned.
She was now somewhat at a loss, having not expected that this reunion was a trap set by Li Lanxue, just to humiliate her.
Thinking of this, Han Xuewei's expression became very unsightly, but at this time Lin Yi looked calm, lightly patted Han Xuewei's shoulder, and walked straight to the front, to the waiter.
He took out a black Golden Dragon card from his wallet, which is unique to the Golden Dragon Banking. It was given to him by the system, and there were still tens of millions in cash left in it now.
Lin Yi swiped the card, and at this moment, everyone saw the card in his hand and was shocked.
Someone immediately covered their mouth, exclaiming, "Isn't that the black card from Golden Dragon Bank?"
Some classmates were surprised, looking at the card in Lin Yi's hand, with a string of golden text engraved in pure gold.
The entire card was black, the genuine Golden Dragon card, a privilege only the top VIPs of Golden Dragon Bank could enjoy.
"Oh my god, I heard that you need to have at least one hundred million in cash on the Golden Dragon card to get it. Could it be that classmate Lin Yi really has a hundred million?!"
All the people showed looks of amazement.
"Don't underestimate that one hundred million; it's a hundred million in liquid cash, not fixed assets!"
Hearing this, everyone's expressions turned to shock, having one hundred million in liquid cash these days was truly indicative of a tycoon.
At that moment, both Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun also had ashen faces, looking at Lin Yi.
You should know, although Li Lanxue had several businesses and a net worth of more than ten billion, that money was all in fixed assets, and she only had two or three billion in liquid assets to move around.
That was quite decent, but now Lin Yi had an entire hundred million in his hand.
Shen Wenjun was even more troubled; their family needed a partnership with Li Lanxue because they couldn't manage their funds.
They sought a marriage alliance with each other for the sake of their family businesses. He never expected Lin Yi to be able to produce a Golden Dragon card.
It wasn't just Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun; even Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu were looking at Lin Yi with suspicion and uncertainty.
Han Xuewei was totally shocked; she had heard that customers of Golden Dragon Bank's cards must have at least one hundred million in cash for registration.
Could it be that Lin Yi already had a hundred million in cash before this?!
Find adventures at empire
This was truly too surprising, and at this moment, Lin Yi could only scratch his head awkwardly. This card was acquired through the system, and since he had not brought any other card, he could only make do with this one for now.
Yet, this caught everyone's attention, leaving him somewhat helpless, and he could only explain, "I just got this card today. I'll explain to you later tonight, wife!"
Lin Yi said, not feeling the need to explain to the onlookers, but to the people around them, these words sounded like a bombshell.
A card with one hundred million in cash, so casually mentioned—with no weight to it at all? That's one hundred million we're talking about! He's saying he can't explain it right now? Could it be that Lin Yi actually has tens of billions in assets?
Meanwhile, the waiter was nervously looking at Lin Yi, successfully processing the transaction for several thousand yuan, and then expressed gratitude to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi spoke calmly, "The expenses for tonight will be all on me. You can find me later to settle it. The steak I ordered just now, and the best red wine you have here, serve a portion to everyone!"
Lin Yi said indifferently, turned his head and smiled. "Everyone need not be courteous with me. You're all my wife's classmates, and it's only right to look out for each other!"
Hearing this, the onlookers' eyes widened.
Soon, the coveted black truffle steaks were served to everyone, a dish costing several thousand yuan each!
With nearly a hundred people here, that would already cost hundreds of thousands! That was extravagantly generous.
Everyone showed an astounded and pleased expression, and Lin Yi didn't mind at all; the assets in his hands were not limited to this card.
He regarded the card as mere pocket money.
At this time, no one dared to underestimate Lin Yi anymore. After all, they had never seen anyone who could so casually spend hundreds of thousands.
And to think Lin Yi was actually their classmate—others' college years had already started to earn big money!
While they were still just average students, the psychological gap was too much to bear!
Everyone quieted down, looking at Lin Yi with eyes full of admiration and respect.

chapters.title: Chapter 177 Chapter 177 Hotel Owner
chapters.content:
At this moment, Lin Yi simply walked back, himself not the kind to flaunt his wealth. If he really wanted to show off, this very hotel belonged to him. Did he really need to announce it as soon as he walked in?
Now, as Lin Yi approached Han Xuewei, she too revealed a shocked expression and involuntarily gave Lin Yi a thumbs up.
Meanwhile, Qin Xiaoxu and Lin Jie were also extremely astonished, both displaying looks of admiration.
Lin Yi didn't say much more and led everyone back to their seats to continue their meal.
But right then, the doors to the nearby VIP elevator opened, and several men in business suits stepped out, quickly making their way into the banquet hall.
Li Lanxue looked up and noticed these tall men, with Song Jinhui, the general manager of Jinguo Hotel, in the center.
Li Lanxue recognized Song Jinhui. Her family had done business with him before, which is why she had specifically arranged the gathering at this venue.
After all, Song Jinhui had negotiated with her father in the past, so he would undoubtedly offer a discount as a courtesy.
Therefore, she immediately went up to him with a flattering smile, and Song Jinhui walked towards her as well.
But as he approached, Song Jinhui merely brushed past her without paying any attention, proceeding straight to Lin Yi.
Watching this unfold, Li Lanxue's face turned a pale shade of green and white.
Yet Song Jinhui's demeanor towards Lin Yi was entirely different from how he had treated her, as he bowed and nodded, saying, "My goodness, Mr. Lin, why didn't you inform me of your visit? Your sudden arrival here makes us seem quite disrespectful..."
As Song Jinhui spoke, he was extremely courteous and kept bowing and nodding, leaving everyone present dumbfounded!!
Han Xuewei and Lin Jie also exhibited surprised looks at this time. Lin Yi, on the other hand, remained utterly composed, simply shaking his head and saying, "It's nothing, just having a meal with friends. There's really no need for such a fuss."
Lin Yi spoke calmly; he hadn't expected the hotel manager to come to greet him personally.
He had thought he was being low-key enough, but apparently, he had still been noticed.
But now, there wasn't much he could say since everyone was aware, and the trouble was, he had to explain things to Han Xuewei again.
At that moment, Song Jinhui was visibly excited, for he had spotted the bill that Lin Yi had left on the table amounting to several hundred thousand.
While it was understood that a tycoon would certainly not be short of money, if he, a wage earner, was insensitive, it would be the end of him.
He promptly took back the bill Lin Yi had placed on the table, saying, "Mr. Lin, as the owner of our hotel, there's no need to spend money when you dine here."
After these words, he handed the bill to the waiter, who was completely befuddled, taking the bill in a daze.
At this time, everyone was shocked by Song Jinhui's words; Lin Yi turned out to be the owner of Jinguo Hotel!
Jinguo Hotel was the biggest hotel in Xiangcheng, standing out among the many hotels in the city, representing a significant business presence not to be underestimated. And the owner behind it all was the young Lin Yi, their university classmate! At this moment, everyone wanted to exclaim, "Oh my God," realizing that what Lin Jie said earlier was true.
The Supreme Grade Hypermarket indeed had shares owned by Lin Yi, and with him also owning this hotel, the combined wealth of these two giant enterprises made Lin Yi's fortune immeasurable.
So the fact that he possessed a black card from the Golden Dragon Bank was not at all incomprehensible, but rather quite ordinary.
At this moment, Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun both heard these words, and their faces turned ashen.
Li Lanxue's face was flushed with holding back her annoyance, as she had not expected that she would offend such an important person.
Lin Yi turned out to be the owner of Jinguo Hotel. Weren't all the careless things she had said just now going to...
With this thought, Li Lanxue showed a look of horror, somewhat at a loss, as she looked at Lin Yi.
Several of the enterprises under her father's name were involved with Jinguo Hotel, among which the best performing was the liquor business.
Their family was the largest liquor supplier in Xiangcheng, and Jinguo Hotel was their biggest customer.
She had heard that her father had recently managed to secure a large order with Jinguo Hotel after much effort. That's why she had purposely chosen this hotel, hoping the hotel staff would do her a favor by giving a discount for the funds used at the gathering. But now, it all seemed to be ruined.
If her actions were to screw up her father's business, then she was truly done for.
Therefore, her face took on an embarrassed expression as she walked up to Song Jinhui and Lin Yi, bowing her head repeatedly and speaking, "Lin Yi, I truly apologize for just now. I really didn't mean it, and I wasn't aware of the situation. Since we're classmates from the same school, I beg you to forgive my blunders. I am really sorry…"
At this moment, Li Lanxue was completely different from just before, continuously bowing and apologizing.
After all, if she caused her father's business to fail because of today's actions, her future days would not be easy.
At this time, Song Jinhui watched Li Lanxue with surprise, then turned to Lin Yi. Having long been adept at reading people and situations, he quickly grasped the gist of the matter and said, "Mr. Lin, this young lady discussed a collaboration with our hotel before, but the order hasn't been confirmed yet. What do you think…"
As Song Jinhui spoke, his insinuation was clear: he was waiting for Lin Yi's opinion.
But Lin Yi didn't wish to elaborate and simply waved his hand indifferently, "This is my personal time, and I don't wish to discuss work now. Handle this matter yourself!"
Lin Yi said indifferently, and at this moment Song Jinhui instantly understood.
With his years of experience in the workplace, how could he fail to interpret Lin Yi's meaning?
So, he nodded and said, "Mr. Lin, enjoy your meal. I shall take my leave now."
After saying this, he turned and walked away without so much as glancing at Li Lanxue.
At that moment, Li Lanxue instantly realized what had happened and showed a look of panic, attempting to chase after Song Jinhui.
Song Xinhui paid her no mind and entered the elevator with his companions, not giving her a single look.
Inside the elevator, Song Jinhui took a deep breath. He hadn't expected the business partner he was about to cooperate with to be so oblivious. He said directly, "Secretary Liu, reject all previous collaborations with the Li Family. From now on, we will no longer work with the Li Family in any capacity!"
Upon hearing this, Secretary Liu immediately took out the documents at hand and drew a cross over the Li Family's page. From then on, the Li Family's businesses would no longer have any dealings with Jinguo Hotel.
At this time, everyone at the banquet was extremely shocked. They had not expected a classmate they usually interacted with to be such a concealed tycoon.
And this was a realm that even a well-born young master like Shen Wenjun could not reach.

chapters.title: Chapter 178 Chapter 178 Request
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei immediately grabbed Lin Yi's hand at that moment, pulling him to one side and sitting down before saying, "Honey, I think you need to explain this to me!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi scratched his head somewhat guiltily and chuckled, "I haven't told you before, but now you've seen it, it was indeed a business I started privately, I didn't expect it to become..."
As Lin Yi spoke calmly, Han Xuewei was obviously shocked.
However, after Lin Yi said a few words, she believed him completely. She had no reason to distrust Lin Yi, and even patted his shoulder with a look of satisfaction.
"I didn't expect you to be a big boss now, and that makes me the boss's wife. You're really something, honey."
Han Xuewei said this very happily.
Lin Yi felt a bit unnatural upon receiving Han Xuewei's praise, sitting up straight and smiling slightly.
He was still somewhat reserved in such a public setting, and just then, Lin Jie, seeing their affectionate display, inadvertently showed an awkward look.
Looking down, he saw Qin Xiaoxu gnawing on their shared steak—she had already finished one and was now eating his portion too!
How could this girl eat so much?!
The people present didn't dare to say more, especially after witnessing the humiliating consequences of Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun's previous show-off.
So now they just focused on eating, eating, and eating!!
They might never get a second chance in their lives to eat at such a high-class hotel buffet, where they could have whatever they wanted; even lobster and abalone were no longer any concern.
Meanwhile, the manager of the hotel demonstrated sharp acuity by specially arranging some top chefs to come over and cook for them.
Many people were eating, their gazes unconsciously drifting towards Lin Yi. Lin Yi, however, didn't care at all. He ate very little, as he was mostly full already.
Now, he was sitting aside, chatting with Han Xuewei.
At this moment, Li Lanxue sat in the corner with a face ashen with mortification, knowing that she had caused a huge problem.
Just then, her phone suddenly lit up with a call from her father. The moment she answered, an enraged voice burst forth on the other end.
"Li Lanxue, what trouble have you caused outside? I'll tell you, the general manager Song Jinhui just called me. I thought it was something good, but he told me that starting today, they are terminating the contract with the Li Family!!"
"Do you realize that our family's liquor business's biggest client is Jinguo Hotel? Do you know how much it helps our company in a year? Now that you've offended such a big client, are you going to care about the stock in the warehouse or not? Have you thought about that?!"
"Perfectly fine as you were, you just had to go out and hold a party, and now you've upset the owner of the hotel. You really know how to cause trouble. I actually thought you were sensible, but he went as far as calling me directly."
"Billions of business just gone like that. If the wine business doesn't prosper after this, then you'd better be ready to face the wind, and forget about living the lavish life you're used to! It's just naive, overly naive!!"
Li Lanxue's father was shouting furiously, clearly about to have a stroke with anger.
At this moment, Li Lanxue, having heard all this, was so frightened that she didn't dare to speak again, and after being scolded by her father, she hung up the phone.
Shen Wenjun came over and saw Li Lanxue's demeanour; he could roughly guess what had happened.
However, he offered no comfort to Li Lanxue; their relationship was such that if her company went bankrupt, it would be of no value to him.
Shen Wenjun was about to leave when several men approached.
The men wore suit uniforms, one of them in a gray suit, whom Shen Wenjun recognized.
That was Han Dong, the manager of Wenqu Mall.
Seeing Han Dong, Shen Wenjun showed a delighted expression, as he had specifically discussed a partnership with Han Dong before. It seemed Han Dong valued him highly, hence his presence here.
Feeling very pleased, Shen Wenjun eagerly approached and said, "Manager Han, I didn't expect to see you here. Have you come to dine?"
Han Dong, surprised, looked over at Shen Wenjun.
After a moment, Han Dong felt awkward; he didn't remember who this man was.
Meeting many clients every day, Han Dong wouldn't recall anyone unimportant. So, he politely inquired, "May I ask who you are?"
Hearing this, Shen Wenjun appeared embarrassed and stood there stiffly, with a forced smile on his face.
He was taken aback by how quickly Han Dong had forgotten him and realized he held no weight in Han Dong's eyes.
Somewhat mortified, he managed to say, "Manager Han, it's normal for you to be busy and not remember me. I've been in touch with your assistant these past few days, and I wanted to invite you out for a meal, but you've always been busy. I am Shen Wenjun, the owner of a women's accessory company."
Hearing this, Han Dong remained somewhat confused.
He was there to find Lin Yi, yet now this man had stopped him.
Normally very efficient in his work and not tolerating delays, Han Dong tried to remember.
Suddenly, a name came to his mind, and he said, "Are you that young man surnamed Shen who has been calling me?"
Recently, Han Dong had indeed received a call from someone wanting his jewelry company to be housed in their mall, hoping for a chance to partner with them.
But the jewelry was just ordinary, small-branded stuff, while their mall hosted international brands.
Such small brands wouldn't sell well, and taking them on would just take up space without profit, so he had no intention of doing so.
Moreover, Shen Wenjun really lacked discernment; Han Dong had already deliberately rejected him during the call.
Thus, without leaving Shen Wenjun any face, he straightforwardly asked, "Were you the one who kept calling, asking me to give your company an opportunity?"
With Han Dong's words out, the surrounding people heard every word clearly. They were shocked that Shen Wenjun, the apparently affluent young man, had to grovel to others as well. It was truly astonishing.

chapters.title: Chapter 179 The Hidden Tycoon
chapters.content:
However, what surprised them even more at this moment was that, even someone with the status of Shen Wenjun seemed utterly inconsequential in Han Dong's eyes.
He simply hadn't remembered him, whereas Shen Wenjun was seizing this opportunity, tirelessly pitching himself and his company's products.
He spoke with great enthusiasm, completely oblivious to the displeasure on Han Dong's face at that moment.
At that moment, Han Dong felt that Shen Wenjun had wasted too much of his time, so without hesitation, he said directly, "Sorry! Sir, if there's a chance, we can talk next time, I have other matters to attend to now!"
Han Dong outright rejected Shen Wenjun and walked away.
Hearing this, Shen Wenjun could only stand there, dumbfounded.
At that moment, he was extremely embarrassed. The surrounding crowd was staring at him, and the manager Han in front of him didn't give him any face and just strode away.
And at that moment, Han Dong approached Lin Yi, who also looked surprised, frowning at Han Dong.
He had seen what Han Dong said to Shen Wenjun, but he hadn't paid much attention to it.
Nevertheless, he hadn't expected Han Dong to rush over so hastily, as if it really was for himself.
At that moment, Lin Yi genuinely had forgotten about Han Dong; he never made an effort to remember people's faces, and he met far too many people every day.
Seeing the expression on Lin Yi's face, Han Dong naturally guessed that Lin Yi had forgotten about him. Very respectfully, he said directly, "Hello, Chairman Lin Yi, I am the junior manager who met you last time at Wenqu Mall."
At this moment, Han Dong referring to himself as a junior manager also shocked Shen Wenjun.
The surrounding crowd also showed expressions of amazement, while Lin Yi just then remembered their previous meeting. That manager had handled matters quite cleverly.
At this moment, the expressions on the faces of the surrounding crowd revealed their astonishment. They really hadn't expected Lin Yi to be the chairman of Wenqu Mall.
Everyone knew that Wenqu Mall was a mall specializing in the sale of luxury goods!
Everyone was speechless with shock, for Lin Yi had brought them not just one or two surprises that day.
At this time, Han Xuewei was also very shocked. Lin Yi took Han Xuewei's hand and stood in front of Han Dong, saying, "Why would you be here?"
Lin Yi frowned, his own movements were always quite careful, and unless there was some matter, he wouldn't likely go out of his way to find him.
Hearing this, Han Dong also nodded and said, "Actually, I've been looking for you since this afternoon. I didn't leave a way to contact you, and just today someone informed me that you were in this hotel, so I made a special trip here. I want to talk to you about the new product launch that is being held tomorrow. I wanted to ask whether the chairman plans to attend..."
As Han Dong spoke respectfully, Shen Wenjun's face went completely pale. He hadn't expected Lin Yi to be the owner of Wenqu Mall! Then, what was there to talk about any cooperation now?!
At this point, Lin Yi spoke up, "That man just now, what's your relationship with him?"
He had just seen Shen Wenjun and Han Dong chatting, so he made a point to ask.
Hearing this, Han Dong simply said, "Chairman, the gentleman just now has been seeking a cooperation with our mall, but I don't think it will work. Our mall only accepts high-end cooperations, and his brand is too minor, probably a generic one without any credibility. We cannot cooperate. However, if he is a friend of yours, then we could certainly give him some support."
Han Dong said respectfully, knowing that if Lin Yi wanted to cooperate, then he naturally had no right to object.
However, Lin Yi simply shook his head upon hearing this.
```
"A brand that can't make money, what's the use of keeping it?" Lin Yi's voice was very cold, and upon hearing this, Shen Wenjun's eyes widened, her teeth clenching with a gritting sound, yet there was nothing she could do.
And everyone present heard these words. Explore more at empire
All of them showed surprised expressions, never having expected Lin Yi to have such a status.
And to think that Shen Wenjun was nothing more than a lackey to him, it was truly shocking.
Now it seemed that Lin Yi was a hidden big shot, whereas Shen Wenjun was just a fool who tried to swagger but ended up being screwed over instead.
At this moment, seeing Han Dong's expectant look, Lin Yi could only shake his head helplessly.
"I won't be going to the new product launch. You can lead it just the same. I need to go home to take care of my child; I don't have time to go over there."
Lin Yi said brazenly, and upon hearing his words, Han Dong immediately nodded, not daring to say anything more.
Ever since their chairman took over the mall, he had hardly managed it, just letting it develop smoothly, as if he didn't care at all about such a small business.
After Han Dong was done speaking, he took his leave, and Lin Yi just smiled faintly.
At this point, the atmosphere of the entire gathering inexplicably changed.
All of them showed surprised expressions again. Lin Yi turned to look at Han Xuewei and noticed that she too was completely baffled.
Lin Yi could only awkwardly say, "Wife, I'll explain to you when we get home."
Lin Yi felt a bit guilty at this moment. This feeling of keeping his relatives in the dark and letting his family know nothing made him feel a sense of guilt.
Moreover, since Han Xuewei was his wife, his silence could make her feel that he didn't trust her.
So he decided that once they got home, he would definitely come clean to Han Xuewei. She just nodded calmly and smiled lightly, "Husband, I never imagined you'd be such a business tycoon."
Han Xuewei felt extremely proud at this moment, although she did not know where all these assets that Lin Yi had popped up from.
Yet she was sure that Lin Yi must have acquired them through legitimate means, and that was something to be proud of.
The people at the scene were all stirred up, looking at Lin Yi with disbelief.
It was truly astonishing; to be so young and yet the chairman of several companies, it was completely beyond their imagination.
At this moment, Qin Xiaoxu was also somewhat unable to react. She had been incredibly shocked when she spent money at Wenqu Building, because the mall had been so generous to give them ten million for their expenditures.
Now thinking back on Lin Yi being the chairman, it all made much more sense.
Hence, Qin Xiaoxu immediately grabbed Lin Jie's arm and pulled him aside, exclaiming, "Oh my gosh, your family's business is doing so well now? Lin Yi is actually the chairman of Wenqu Mall!!"
Hearing this, Lin Jie was also completely baffled at the moment. He himself didn't know and could only furrow his brows.
"I honestly didn't know this, he never mentioned it before. The only thing I knew was that my brother had a stake in the Supreme Grade supermarket since our parents were helping to run it, but as for Jinguo Hotel and Wenqu Mall, I really had no idea..."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 180 Everyone's Envy
chapters.content:
However, at this moment, Qin Xiaoxu was extremely happy. She blurted out, "That's really great, I never expected my dear sister to have married such an impressive husband, and the food at Jinguo Hotel is so delicious, from now on we can come and eat for free!"
Qin Xiaoxu laughed hee-hee, tossing that matter to the back of her mind in an instant.
Lin Jie looked at Qin Xiaoxu with a sense of helplessness.
All this guy thinks about is eating and shopping; can't she think of anything else?
Meanwhile, Han Xuewei and Lin Yi sat together, behind them the sound of very evident murmurs of discussion rose, nearly all of them in praise of the couple.
"My goodness, it's so shocking, I didn't expect our school's beauty to have such an incredible husband!"
"Yes, the items in Wenqu Mall are all luxury goods, probably worth nearly ten billion! I didn't expect him to be the Chairman of Wenqu Mall!"
"I just saw that black card; I've never seen a Golden Dragon black card in my life, and it even had gold lettering engraved on it!"
"And this hotel belongs to them too..."
"Right, right, the hotel is also theirs, no wonder he was acting so domineering just now!!"
"Exactly, we can't even imagine the life of the rich, Lin Yi is really too capable. I remember he was very low-key in college, never expected him to be such a hidden boss!!"
Everyone heatedly discussed, and at this moment, looking towards Lin Yi, all they had was admiration in their eyes.
Shen Wenjun at this time showed a jealous expression, his teeth grinding with a creaking noise, filled with deep hatred towards Lin Yi.
Why does someone like Lin Yi receive such favor from heaven when I have to fight tooth and nail for any opportunity and still get none!
Lin Yi simply sat in a superior position, looking calm and unruffled.
This only made Shen Wenjun's jealousy and distortion grow.
As Shen Wenjun was submerged in resentment, suddenly his phone rang. He picked up the phone, only to see his father's name on the display.
It was a call from his own father!
Seeing that phone call, Shen Wenjun suddenly felt a bit panicked, but he still answered it.
Soon the voice on the other end erupted with his father's roar, exclaiming, "Shen Wenjun, have you lost your mind? Did you go to the hotel gathering today really just for the gathering? You've caused me a lot of trouble. There was still a possibility for Wenqu Building to welcome us, but you've thoroughly screwed it up for me!!"
His voice was full of anger, continuously scolding him.
Shen Wenjun hung up the phone, somewhat panicked.
And at that moment, the phone of Li Lanxue, who was sitting beside him, also rang.
She too received her father's roar, because the Wenqu Building previously had quite a few collaborations with Li Lanxue's family.
But they had the same boss, all Lin Yi's enterprises; with just a word from Lin Yi, naturally, they would be in trouble.
At this time, both Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun were scolded miserably, both showing helpless expressions. Everyone around looked towards them, revealing faces of surprise.
In fact, most people were just watching the excitement. Shen Wenjun's face couldn't hold up anymore, and he walked straight towards the front.
Li Lanxue, even more angered, stamped her high heels, quickly running forward without even saying goodbye to her classmates.
After the two left, many classmates started to talk.
"Oh my god, did you hear what just happened between those two? I heard their fathers both called to scold them. The deal they had with Jinguo Hotel is totally down the drain!"
"That's what they get for not opening their eyes and offending Lin Yi!"
"Oh my god, all that funding gone to waste. Looks like they're really in for it this time!"
Everyone was buzzing with discussion, and at this moment, Lin Zhiyuan also overheard the chatter and looked up.
Some classmates who were in the know revealed information about Qin Xiaoxu, saying Lin Jie was not really her boyfriend; their relationship was just barely put together. So, at this moment, observing Lin Jie, he couldn't help but feel smug.
Lin Jie looked very young, probably still in university, while Qin Xiaoxu was likely two or three years older than him.
He, being so mature, was truly the perfect match for Qin Xiaoxu. Hence, he sported a smug expression, constantly keeping an eye on Qin Xiaoxu.
Right now Lin Jie was sitting next to Qin Xiaoxu, watching him constantly eating. He couldn't help but snort and said, "Are you ever going to get enough, you slob? Keep eating like this and you'll turn into a fat pig. See who'll marry you then!"
Hearing these words, Qin Xiaoxu pouted and retorted with a cold huff, "So what if I become a fat pig? It's not like I'm marrying you!"
At this, Lin Jie's eyebrows shot up.
"Who'd want to marry you? Don't flatter yourself!"
They were alright when they kept quiet, but as soon as they talked, they bickered endlessly.
After Qin Xiaoxu finished eating, he just chatted with Han Xuewei and completely ignored Lin Jie, which made him unbearably awkward. Lin Jie could only take out his phone and play games to distract himself.
Meanwhile, Han Xuewei was sitting beside Lin Yi, who was extremely considerate, peeling shrimp after shrimp for her and even cutting her steak before placing it in front of her.
Many students were paying attention to Lin Yi, with quite a few of them eager to curry favor. Behind Lin Yi, many female students noticed his attentive actions and couldn't help but begin to gossip.
"Oh my god, such an outstanding person and still so caring!"
"Exactly, when will I ever find such a great boyfriend?"
"Did you hear? The wedding he hosted for Han Xuewei was incredibly lavish. I heard it cost a fortune, and the ring Han Xuewei wore could buy several houses!"
"Rich people do like to wear their houses on their fingers." Find more to read at empire
"Look, there's Han Xuewei sitting over there. Should we go say hi...?"
"Forget it, she's now the wife of a wealthy man. She doesn't have time to greet us!"
"That can't be true; I remember Han Xuewei has a great personality. She definitely wouldn't look down on us."
The classmates said this and went straight to Han Xuewei to say hello.
To their surprise, both Han Xuewei and Lin Yi were very friendly, warm, and easygoing, which completely overturned their expectations.
Not only are they good-looking but also approachable. It's just too likable.
Seeing Lin Yi's attentive and gentle demeanor towards Han Xuewei, naturally, everyone felt envious to the extreme.
At this moment, Qin Xiaoxu, having finished eating, also felt a bit bored and picked up his phone to play some games.
But then, he suddenly received a message on WeChat. Taking a closer look, it turned out to be from Lin Zhiyuan.
Lin Zhiyuan: "Xiaoxu, what are you up to after dinner!"

chapters.title: Chapter 181 On the Way Home
chapters.content:
At that moment, Qin Xiaoxu received a message from Lin Zhiyuan, looking very calm. She didn't even bother to reply and just started playing a game.
Meanwhile, Lin Zhiyuan saw the two of them huddled so close together that his face turned green with anger.
Noticing his expression, his girlfriend sitting beside him suddenly furrowed her brows, looked at his unhappy face, and asked, "What's wrong? You seem a bit off today. Why do you keep looking over there? What's your relationship with that woman?"
Lin Zhiyuan's girlfriend couldn't help but inquire. She had noticed Qin Xiaoxu at a glance, because in that group, Qin Xiaoxu's demeanor was indeed outstanding.
Only then did Lin Zhiyuan turn around and said, "Nothing, nothing, just an old classmate. Don't think too much about it. Look, she already has a boyfriend."
Upon hearing this, the girl glanced sideways at the scene in front of her.
With Qin Xiaoxu and Lin Jie so close to each other, there was naturally no chance for Lin Zhiyuan.
When playing the game, Qin Xiaoxu was very excited and immediately called out, "Hurry up and let me have the minion wave, give it to me."
Lin Jie, fully engaged in the game, just chuckled and said, "Giving you the minion wave won't help you. You'd better go jungle now!"
While saying this, Qin Xiaoxu pinched Lin Jie's wrist hard. Lin Jie yelped in pain and, with a shake of his hand, lost the position to Qin Xiaoxu.
At that moment, Lin Zhiyuan, who was watching on the side, felt jealous seeing how close the two were. He couldn't say much, but his girlfriend beside him showed a displeased look.
Who could tolerate their boyfriend always staring at someone else?
But her relationship with Lin Zhiyuan could only be considered as them hanging out together, so there was no need to make a big fuss about it.
After all, the girl seemed to come from a well-off family and would definitely not be interested in someone like Lin Zhiyuan.
At this time, Lin Jie, who had been absorbed in the game, also noticed Lin Zhiyuan's gaze. Naturally, this sparked his mischievous side even more, and he moved closer to Qin Xiaoxu.
He leaned in very close, whispering in her ear, "See, good thing you have me as your fake boyfriend to ward him off, otherwise that guy would definitely take things too far."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu finally looked up towards the front.
Indeed, Lin Zhiyuan was still staring at her, but she didn't look at Lin Zhiyuan. Instead, she just lowered her head to continue playing the game and snorted, "The fact that such a man could have a girlfriend is truly laughable!"
Hearing Qin Xiaoxu's words, Lin Jie just smiled lightly and said, "I don't care. In any case, I've helped you this time!"
At this, Qin Xiaoxu looked at Lin Jie somewhat surprised. Based on her understanding, Lin Jie was usually quite shy. She didn't expect him to be so shameless this time. She just smiled faintly and snorted.
Of course, she was not so naive as to fall for Lin Zhiyuan's tricks.
In fact, Lin Zhiyuan was not even comparable to the young guy sitting next to her.
Thinking this, Qin Xiaoxu couldn't help but glance at Lin Jie, who simply smiled faintly and then focused on playing the game again.
Because Lin Yi had told everyone that they could order whatever they wanted, the classmates didn't hold back. Although some restrained themselves a little, there were still others who unreservedly grabbed expensive drinks like Moutai without a second thought.
But Lin Yi didn't care much, as these amounts were only petty cash to him, and his hotel could easily afford them.
However, today Lin Yi and Lin Jie both only ate a little food, and didn't drink any alcohol.
After all, both of them had driven there; if it had been just one of them, they could have found a substitute driver.
But since they came with girls, it naturally wasn't very convenient, so neither Lin Yi nor Lin Jie drank.
Soon, the banquet ended, and after saying thanks, everyone made their way to the lobby on the first floor.
Lin Jie directly drove off in a sedan worth several hundred thousand yuan and picked up Qin Xiaoxu. This scene somewhat surprised Lin Zhiyuan.
Lin Jie didn't seem like someone from a great family! His car was just an average family sedan, about two hundred thousand yuan or so, and it looked quite old; it seemed he really was just a poser.
Lin Zhiyuan thought with disdain in his eyes, but Lin Jie didn't care; he had wanted to buy a nice car for himself, but his father had forbidden it, thinking it was too showy.
Going to university and then comparing himself with others on the outside was unnecessary, so his father only allowed him to buy a car worth ten or twenty thousand yuan—as long as it could run, it was fine.
Lin Jie didn't say much; he didn't care. After all, his gaming setup was worth more than the car.
When Lin Yi drove his car over, the female classmates all showed expressions of surprise; they had never seen such a luxurious car before, and it obviously looked very expensive.
Some of the boys who knew about cars also looked shocked, as this car was worth several houses.
Lin Yi picked up Han Xuewei and also took along a few female friends from university who were close to her.
The girls didn't stand on ceremony and promptly got into Lin Yi's car.
His car was very spacious; fitting four or five people was not a problem at all. Once inside Lin Yi's car, many of the girls were astounded by the interior equipment. Continue reading at empire
They couldn't help but compliment Han Xuewei, "Vivi, your husband is seriously incredible. Look at this car, I couldn't even dream of sitting in one like this!"
"Yeah, Vivi, your husband is so capable and caring. I really hope to find a husband as good as him one day!"
"What are you all talking nonsense for? Vivi is great too. She is so beautiful and so smart, it's totally normal for her to have a husband who loves her. If you're envious, you should work on improving yourselves!"
The girls chatted and laughed, and one of them turned to Han Xuewei and couldn't help asking, "Vivi, none of us knew about your wedding beforehand—it was only after we heard about it on the school forum. Why didn't you invite us?"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei looked a bit embarrassed and immediately responded, "Because the wedding was so rushed, it was a sudden decision. We didn't have time to tell everyone, and my parents also thought it was just a ceremony at the time, so they didn't announce it. If there's a chance in the future, I'll invite everyone over for a meal."
Seeing Han Xuewei's guilty expression, the group of girls felt a bit embarrassed.
They quickly said, "It's okay, Vivi. We don't really mind. We just feel close to you and wanted to witness your wedding, that's all!"
"Exactly, exactly. You must have looked beautiful in your wedding dress. And about that meal you just mentioned inviting us to, we'll hold you to that—don't forget when the time comes!"

chapters.title: Chapter 182 Being Pursued
chapters.content:
Those girls who were on good terms with Han Xuewei also had pleasant personalities, so after Han Xuewei said a few words, they started teasing each other and the atmosphere became very harmonious.
However, at this moment, one of the girls couldn't help but say, "Vivi, do you know? Gu Li is coming back in a few days."
Upon hearing this, many of the girls started discussing it together.
Continue your adventure at empire
"Didn't Gu Li go abroad?"
"Yes, she did, but I saw on her social media posts that she is coming back to the country in a few days!"
Hearing these words, Han Xuewei also suddenly realized.
Previously, Gu Li was her classmate, and it seemed that they had a fight over a boy.
At that time, the boy probably liked Han Xuewei—she wasn't sure—but Gu Li insisted that Han Xuewei was seducing the boy, and even insulted Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei didn't argue with her but did harbor some prejudices against her in her heart.
Later, for some reason, she went abroad to study.
But there were still quite a few classmates who said it was Han Xuewei who had driven her away. Han Xuewei was naturally very gentle; how could she do something like that?
These girls knew it too, so at this moment, they all felt somewhat indignant on behalf of Han Xuewei.
After hearing these words, Han Xuewei recalled and said, "I haven't had contact with her for a long time, so I don't know how she has been doing recently."
"I heard that she is going to come back to our Xiang University to continue studying, probably staying in our class. I don't know what she will think by then!"
"But I think it's possible that..."
As the girl spoke, she looked up worriedly at Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei was a bit surprised when Lin Yi, through the rearview mirror, saw the girl's expression.
The girl appeared a bit awkward and nervous, but Han Xuewei said, "It's okay, go ahead and speak."
Hearing this, the girl continued, "Vivi, actually, after she had a falling out with that boy and had a fight with you, she went abroad. Some people in the school said that you were the one who forced her to leave, and she even pretended to be pitiful at that time."
"Now she might be coming back because she has calculated that you would have graduated. She probably doesn't know about your year off for pregnancy, so if she really comes back to Xiang University, she will surely make trouble for you when she sees you..."
As the girl said this, many of the other girls showed contemptuous expressions.
"I always knew it, her intentions were never pure. She even told us before that she was the famous beauty of the school, claiming that you, Vivi, didn't deserve to be called that. If she comes back to study here now, she will surely nitpick everything with you. She can't be the school beauty anymore, and so she will start playing her little games again,"
The group of girls spoke, some of them expressed their indignation on behalf of Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei heard this and simply smiled lightly, saying, "I don't really mind the 'school beauty' title; actually, I think there are many beautiful girls in our school. Maybe a new student will become the school beauty in the future. I think I look okay, but to be called truly beautiful, that's really everyone overestimating me."
With modesty, Han Xuewei spoke, honestly not considering herself as a celestial beauty above others.
Getting flattered as the school beauty and then losing touch with reality was not her style. After all, there are many beautiful people in the world, and even if she is beautiful now, she can't resist time; she will eventually age.
At that moment, hearing what Han Xuewei said, the group of female classmates all exclaimed in unison, "No!"
A girl shook her head repeatedly, saying, "Vivi, that's too modest of you. You're as beautiful as the actresses on TV, even prettier than the currently popular ones. How could you possibly not be pretty?"
"Exactly, you've had a child and still look prettier than those of us who haven't!"
All these female classmates were chattering away, unanimously agreeing on Han Xuewei's beauty—after all, it wasn't like they were blind.
Lin Yi was driving and had also heard a lot about Han Xuewei, and he even remembered a name associated with a clear rivalry with her: Gu Li.
If that girl dared to bully Han Xuewei, Lin Yi certainly wouldn't stand for it, because in his eyes, Han Xuewei truly was the most beautiful girl at Xiang University.
It wasn't surprising at all for her to be the campus belle.
At this time, Lin Yi, smiling as he drove, said, "Wife, everyone says you're the school beauty. I don't know what everyone's standards are, but in my eyes, you are the most beautiful."
Hearing this, all the female classmates sighed.
"My gosh, your husband is really shoving dog food down our throats."
"Yeah, yeah, Vivi, your husband really loves you so much. I'm so envious."
A few classmates cast envious glances at Han Xuewei. Lin Yi, meanwhile, drove leisurely, listening to their gossip and hearing quite a few stories about Han Xuewei.
Most of the stories about Han Xuewei were about her being pursued by people at the university. Some of the more daring boys had tried to pursue Han Xuewei, while those who lacked the courage quietly harbored crushes on her.
After hearing all this, Lin Yi felt a bit jealous.
Soon, he dropped off each of the female classmates at their respective homes, and finally, when he reached the last house, he stopped the car and sighed in relief, "Finally, it's over."
Han Xuewei saw Lin Yi looking tired for the first time and said, "If you're tired, I can drive."
Hearing this, Lin Yi shook his head.
"I'm not tired, just a little jealous."
At his words, Han Xuewei furrowed her brows and asked, "What's wrong?"
She knew Lin Yi must have heard what was said just now and replied with a small smile, "Those were just things from when I first started university. When I first appeared at the school, I was just a freshman. Initially, I wasn't the school belle, but later everyone started saying I was the prettiest girl at Xiang University, and they made me the school belle."
"You know very well, the school beauty is bound to be pursued by lots of boys. But afterwards, I rejected them all. Everyone then thought I was aloof, so you don't need to worry about it. I'm aloof towards them but passionate towards you alone."
Hearing those words, Lin Yi raised his eyebrows, somewhat surprised. Han Xuewei had touched his heart with just a few sentences.
However, he also had a question that had been lingering in his mind, something he wanted to ask Han Xuewei.
That was how, with so many boys pursuing her, she could have fallen for him.
After the incident, he had taken the initiative to contact Han Xuewei, saying he would take responsibility, but the answer he got was that Han Xuewei liked him too.
This was the most amazing thing in the world, and Lin Yi had never had the courage to ask. He feared that Han Xuewei had said so only because she was pregnant and felt she had no choice.

chapters.title: Chapter 183 Anxious Denial
chapters.content:
Seeing Lin Yi with such a heavy heart, Han Xuewei couldn't help but rub his head and said, "If you have any problems, you can ask me. Why do you always look so preoccupied?"
Enjoy new tales from empire
Hearing this, Lin Yi also rubbed his head somewhat irritably.
"I'm afraid you'll be unhappy."
"But if you don't ask and say nothing, that's what makes me unhappy."
Hearing this, Lin Yi took a deep breath and held both of Han Xuewei's hands as he spoke, "Then I'll ask, but you can't get angry, okay?"
Han Xuewei laughed, looking very charming, while Lin Yi said, "You mentioned before that you had a crush on me, but back then, so many boys in school liked you, you had so many options, why did you have a crush on me?"
At this point, Lin Yi hung his head. He wasn't someone prone to self-doubt, but when faced with a girl as outstanding as Han Xuewei, he naturally reflected on his own shortcomings.
Han Xuewei was really too beautiful—it could be said that ninety percent of men who came into contact with her would take a liking to her.
After all, she was a girl both gentle and beautiful, and capable too.
Han Xuewei had naturally guessed that Lin Yi would ask this question, and with a laugh, she patted his shoulder and said, "Actually, you don't need to doubt it will definitely be you, although you might not be as handsome as those boys, but in my eyes, you have the best character and personality."
"Remember when I was a new student, as soon as I started school, you were there helping other classmates carry their luggage. Later on, I paid special attention to you. You have a good character, are very sunny and enthusiastic, and I also paid particular attention to you in class."
"I even secretly read the essays you wrote. I think you're very respectful of others, from the inside out, and don't treat people like objects, never slandering others without understanding them. With you being so wonderful, how could I not like you?!"
With these words, Han Xuewei gave Lin Yi a big hug.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi immediately felt overjoyed and, holding Han Xuewei, said, "Really? Turns out my wife, you've hidden it so well, I didn't even notice at the time."
Han Xuewei patted his shoulder and replied, "Yeah, so many people were looking at me, why didn't you turn back and look at me!"
At these words, Lin Yi embarrassedly said, "I was too shy to look at you. I thought with so many people pursuing you, I wouldn't stand a chance at all."
"If you had looked back at me back then, who knows, we might have ended up together without that incident."
Han Xuewei smiled faintly and, hearing this, Lin Yi hugged her tightly.
"Don't worry, honey. I will work even harder to make you the happiest woman in the whole world."
"I already am the happiest person in the world."
…
At this time, Lin Jie had already driven Qin Xiaoxu over, arriving at her front door.
As his car came to a stop, Qin Xiaoxu looked up at Lin Jie and said, "Aren't you going to escort me upstairs?"
Hearing this, Lin Jie glanced at his phone, noticing it was about time, and replied, "No need, it's fine for you to go up by yourself, the buildings here are very high quality, and the elevator is quick. My friend is hurrying me..."
As Lin Jie said this, Qin Xiaoxu felt a twitch at the corner of her mouth.
She had asked Lin Jie to take her to her doorstep, which was clearly giving him an opportunity!
If someone else asked for her home address in the future, Lin Jie would know it, but there he was, just letting such an opportunity slip by!!
Lin Jie didn't say anything at the moment, except that he was in a rush, and then the car began to chug forward.
Qin Xiaoxu was standing by the roadside, her eyes wide open like brass bells. She was already somewhat annoyed—she should have dragged Lin Jie out earlier.
