Feeling sulky, Qin Xiaoxu made her way upstairs on her own.
The reason Lin Jie was in such a hurry was that his friend Lin Hao had been waiting for him for quite a while, so he definitely needed to speed up.
Lin Hao got along well with him. The two often played games together. Recently, Lin Hao had been job hunting but retreated without a fight every time, leaving him no choice but to come and stay with Lin Jie.
Since Lin Hao's family wasn't from Xiangcheng and renting a place here was quite expensive without someone to share it with, he had to rely on Lin Jie.
When Lin Jie got home, he found Lin Hao leaning against his door playing a game; seeing Lin Jie return, he immediately stood up and said, "I've been looking forward to your return, bro! Let's go inside quickly; my legs are numb from squatting. You have food at home, right?"
Without any hesitation, Lin Hao continued, and Lin Jie replied, "Isn't there a Saxian Snack place downstairs? Just grab something to eat there."
Hearing this, Lin Hao simply smiled faintly, "I was worried you wouldn't find me if I left, so I just waited here for a bit. It wasn't that long."
As they spoke, Lin Jie immediately opened the door and walked in, with Lin Hao following by his side.
"I hardly cook at home; there's just some instant food. There's instant noodles over there... How about some instant noodles?"
After entering, Lin Hao dropped his suitcase to one side and went over to where Lin Jie had pointed.
He looked at a large box filled with various instant foods, self-heating hot pots, self-heating rice, and a heap of instant noodles.
Seeing this, Lin Hao was slightly taken aback, "Bro, do you usually eat this stuff??"
"Not always; occasionally, I order takeout."
At this, Lin Hao was completely dumbfounded and reluctantly picked up a box of instant noodles.
"Make one for me too; I'm also hungry."
Lin Jie said casually, and Lin Hao raised an eyebrow, "You're hungry just after returning from a party?"
"I didn't really eat; I just watched others eat at the gathering!"
As Lin Jie spoke, he couldn't help but remember Qin Xiaoxu's appearance when she was eating, stuffing her mouth full as if she couldn't get enough. She must be pretty full by now after getting back, he thought.
After a while, Lin Hao had made the instant noodles and placed them on the table, immediately moving closer to Lin Jie and said, "I heard you went to the party with your girlfriend."
Upon hearing this, Lin Jie corrected him, "She's a pretend girlfriend, not a real one."
"Ah, one day it will turn real!"
Lin Hao said unconcernedly, and Lin Jie felt compelled to explain, "It's because my brother and sister-in-law invited her, so I had to go with her."
There's no need to rush your explanation, "Some people can affect your emotions without you even realizing it. Who knows, maybe the two of you will actually become a thing. I often see you playing games with her. Aren't you two planning to form a CP?"
"How could that be possible! I'm just playing games with her, and even the girlfriend is pretend. Do you think there's anything real about it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 184 Reply
chapters.content:
Lin Jie wasn't thinking like that, he just wanted to focus on his studies, find a reliable profession, and preferably break free from his father's control and carve out his own world.
Plus, he had witnessed the consumer power of women through Qin Xiaoxu, thinking if he married someone like Qin Xiaoxu in the future, wouldn't his modest savings be blown through to bankruptcy??
So now he had to find a way to make more money.
"Don't be so quick to deny it, I think that Qin Xiaoxu is quite nice, pretty, and has a good personality!"
"I pretended to be in a boyfriend-girlfriend relationship with her, just to shut our parents up. I saw she was enjoying herself, how could she possibly like me?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Hao didn't say much, just slurped a mouthful of instant noodles and said, "Don't think like that. Some women are insincere with their words, maybe she sees you as a good catch. And don't think so poorly of yourself!"
Lin Jie reflected carefully before responding, "Could she really have taken a liking to me? But indeed, she did invite me to the entrance of her place earlier, asking me to take her upstairs!"
At these words, Lin Hao suddenly widened his eyes and exclaimed, "Yes, yes, yes, then why did you come back? She actually invited you upstairs; there must be something going on."
"Are you out of your mind? She just felt that you needed someone to accompany her up, and weren't you the one who told me you've been waiting at home for a long time? Of course, I declined and let her go back by herself."
Lin Jie argued with conviction. Hearing this, Lin Hao slapped his forehead, "Then it looks like I've let you down, she might be mad at you now."
"Don't worry, she definitely won't be mad. She said before that she has no expectations of me, so why would she be mad at me?"
Lin Jie spoke nonchalantly, while Lin Hao clicked his tongue and said, "Brother, it seems I owe you one this time. Rest assured, I'll definitely be a good wingman for you from now on."
Upon hearing this, Lin Jie patted his hand and said, "You don't need to help me, it's unnecessary."
After finishing his statement, Lin Jie didn't dwell on the matter and went straight back to eating his instant noodles.
Meanwhile, Qin Xiaoxu had arrived home. After freshening up, she lay down on the bed. Having eaten too much today, she took out her phone intending to scroll through videos but received a message instead.
Upon opening it, it was from Lin Jie: Hurry up and come play the game!!
Seeing these words, Qin Xiaoxu couldn't help but roll her eyes. This Lin Jie really left her speechless, not caring about anything other than playing that damn game. However, having nothing else to do, Qin Xiaoxu tapped into the gaming interface and played for a while by herself.
She was so annoyed that she didn't even want to team up with Lin Jie; she could see that Lin Jie was online but when he greeted her, she ignored him, leaving Lin Jie somewhat baffled.
After playing for a bit, Qin Xiaoxu, feeling tired, closed the game interface and looked at the unanswered message. She then typed a line and sent it.
At this moment, Lin Jie received the message and took a glance.
"Other than asking me to play games with you, what else can you do!"
Seeing these words, Lin Jie scratched his head in a panic, unsure of how to reply.
Meanwhile, Lin Hao stood beside Lin Jie and, upon seeing the message from Qin Xiaoxu, said, "Oh my god, Qin Xiaoxu messaged you, you need to reply to her fast!"
Hearing this, Lin Jie couldn't help but scratch his head, saying somewhat helplessly, "I don't know how to reply to her."
Seeing Lin Jie's troubled expression, Lin Hao knew that Lin Jie still hadn't made up his mind.
"So what exactly do you think? Look, she already said that to you, maybe what she means indirectly is that she's asking which is more important to you, the game or her. I think she definitely has feelings for you. You can't always refuse to show your feelings. If you continue like this, there will certainly be no progress with her."
Upon hearing this, Lin Jie also lowered his head and said, "I'm also not sure what I think right now. Originally, I pretended to be her boyfriend just to shut my parents up, and when I buy her things, my dad would even give me money and fully support it. If I can use it to make my dad give me more money, then later on I can use the money to do what I really want to do."
Hearing this, Lin Hao replied, "Then what do you want to do? In the past, you've also played games with several girls, but I've noticed you aren't nearly as enthusiastic with other girls. When those girls were performing poorly in games, you would often grumble about them. But now, look at you with Qin Xiaoxu—she's a girl too, but your attitude towards her is clearly different from the others."
"Having spent so much time together, of course I'd be friendlier to her," he said.
"Then, would you be jealous? If she got too close to other guys!"
At that question, Lin Jie's brows immediately furrowed, and thinking about today's incident involving Lin Zhiyuan, he said with a frown, "Of course! Those trashy guys have no good intentions. How could I possibly let her be bullied by them!"
"That's right, you must have feelings for her, otherwise you wouldn't care so much about who she's with or whether she might be bullied!"
The two of them kept chattering non-stop, and at this time, Qin Xiaoxu, with her phone in hand, still hadn't received a reply, causing her to frown in frustration.
This guy couldn't really be planning to ignore me, could he!
Qin Xiaoxu didn't have that much patience, and feeling somewhat upset, she quickly typed a line of text on her phone.
"If you're not going to talk, then don't play with me anymore."
Lin Jie was still talking when he noticed his phone screen light up, and after seeing the message Qin Xiaoxu sent, he said, "Look, she clearly has no interest in me. She doesn't even want to play games with me anymore; she obviously doesn't like me."
Upon hearing this, Lin Hao slapped him on the head and said, "Are you an idiot? She's obviously angry. You've been here talking endlessly with me and haven't thought about replying to her because you don't know how! Naturally, the person waiting on the other end for a message would be unhappy. You need to reply to her now, quickly. If you don't reply soon, she might really block you." Enjoy new stories from empire
Looking at Lin Jie's flustered state, Lin Hao felt somewhat exasperated by his stupidity and said, "Women can be terrifying when they get angry. They're capable of anything. If you don't reply now, you'll end up on her blacklist."
Hearing this, Lin Jie looked at Lin Hao with a mixture of doubt and belief.
"You haven't had many relationships yourself, so how come you understand so well? I don't even know if she's really angry, so how can you be so sure she is?"
Hearing this, Lin Hao couldn't help but laugh.
"Although I haven't dated much, at least I have more experience than you. Hurry up and reply!"
"But how should I reply?"
"Just say everything that you want to say."

chapters.title: Chapter 185 Confession?
chapters.content:
Hearing this, Lin Jie held his phone and thought for a long time before typing a long string of text and sending it directly.
"Actually, I think that the two of us have such great rapport when playing games, even if we lose, we wouldn't blame each other. We're already the best partners, so you don't need to worry about whether or not to continue being friends with me. I really enjoy playing games with you. Just now, I just didn't know how to respond. I didn't know if you were happy or angry."
Lin Jie's reply was evidently awkward and somewhat silly. Qin Xiaoxu couldn't help but laugh out loud when she received the message. Continue your journey on empire
This kid is actually quite cute!
Qin Xiaoxu thought to herself happily, holding her phone and chuckling for a while, whereas Lin Jie, who hadn't received a reply from Qin Xiaoxu, was becoming somewhat frantic and involuntarily frowned.
"Look, I've already said all that, and she still hasn't replied. She can't still be angry, can she?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Hao leaned in and saw Lin Jie's reply, shaking his head, "I think what you said makes sense. She probably isn't mad anymore, might be thinking about how to reply to you."
As he spoke, Lin Hao waited alongside Lin Jie.
But after waiting a while and seeing no reply, Lin Jie grew anxious, while Lin Hao simply took Lin Jie's phone, "How about I reply for you?"
Lin Jie nodded his head upon hearing this; he also feared that he might say the wrong thing, so he was more at ease letting Lin Hao handle it.
Lin Hao took Lin Jie's phone and, not hesitating, quickly typed a series of characters and sent them off.
Watching Lin Hao's smooth movements, Lin Jie couldn't help but become curious and peered over his shoulder, "What did you send, huh?"
Lin Hao, with a sly smile, looked at Lin Jie, locked the phone screen, and lifted it behind his back, saying, "Hold on, wait a moment! Let's see how she replies first."
At that moment, Qin Xiaoxu had been paying close attention to Lin Jie, so as soon as he sent a message she checked it.
But when she saw the message, she was stunned.
Is he serious? How should I even respond to this?
Qin Xiaoxu hadn't expected Lin Jie to reply like that; she was completely bewildered!
Had she ever been in such a situation before? If it were someone else, Qin Xiaoxu might have known how to reply, but facing Lin Jie, she really didn't know what to say!
So, at that moment, Qin Xiaoxu didn't dare to reply and immediately called Han Xuewei,
Han Xuewei answered the phone only to hear Qin Xiaoxu's urgent voice on the other end, "This is bad, this is so bad! Vivi, you have no idea, Lin Jie just messaged me, and he flat out said he wants to start dating me. How should I respond?"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei took a deep breath and said into the phone, "Really? He actually said that? That means he likes you. Do you like him?"
At this moment, Han Xuewei was very eager to hear Qin Xiaoxu's answer, and Qin Xiaoxu then said, "I think I probably like him quite a bit. He's quite nice, apart from being a bit of a straight man. It could be worse, you know."
Han Xuewei immediately turned excitedly to Lin Yi and said, "Your cousin just confessed to my sister. What do you think?"
Hearing this, Lin Yi said, "I'm sure my cousin's character is not a problem, but he rarely takes initiative with girls. This time he must have been prompted by Qin Xiaoxu, and it must be because he really likes the other party."
At that moment, Han Xuewei had put the call on speaker, and Qin Xiaoxu could hear everything clearly, suddenly becoming nervous, "If that's the case, then what should I do? Ah, I... I don't even know how to respond to him."
She was completely unprepared at this point and felt somewhat at a loss.
She naturally knew that Lin Jie was a great guy, but she also feared that Lin Jie's feelings for her were just those of an old friend and not romantic love.
At this time, Han Xuewei, holding her phone, couldn't help but say, "I think if you really like him, you should be a little braver because I also understand Lin Jie. If he can take this step, it's naturally very difficult.
After all, you know his temperament, and my husband and I also got to where we are because we both took the initiative to get along well, so I think you shouldn't let yourself down. You should step out."
As Han Xuewei spoke, she turned to look at Lin Yi, who just gave a faint smile. He was clearly a little tired.
Qin Xiaoxu, hearing Han Xuewei's words, naturally also very much hoped she could find a love like Han Xuewei's and spoke up, "I also think I could give it a try, but he's younger than me..."
"What are you afraid of nowadays? Isn't it popular to have relationships with younger men? And besides, you two don't have that much of an age difference. It's at most one or two years. Why are you panicking?"
Han Xuewei laughed when she realized that Qin Xiaoxu was worried about that.
Qin Xiaoxu, however, still stuttered, "But I'm still not ready, and also…"
"Enough with the 'buts.' If you really like him, you might as well give it a try. He's younger than you, so you won't suffer any loss. Plus, Lin Jie's family is quite wealthy."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu widened her eyes and nodded, "Indeed, his family is quite rich, and his parents are very nice to me..."
Eventually, Qin Xiaoxu agreed to it.
After all, Lin Jie had the physique, the looks, and he also played video games. All aspects of him were already good.
The only issue was his straightforward male personality, which was bound to slowly become warmer with her influence. Qin Xiaoxu had confidence in herself.
At this moment, Qin Xiaoxu's heartbeat quickened. She was extremely nervous as she held her phone, patting her forehead to stay calm.
Meanwhile, Lin Jie was getting anxious. He grabbed the phone from Lin Hao and shouted, "You little rascal! You didn't send something you shouldn't have, did you?"
Lin Hao was out of breath, looking at Lin Jie's anxious expression. Lin Jie opened WeChat and saw the message Lin Hao had sent, his face going white at once.
Lin Hao had sent, "I think I really like you. Do you want to date me?"
"Oh my God, are you insane? Why would you send that? You're going to kill me,"
Lin Jie couldn't help but shout out. Lin Hao, still fearlessly leaning over, said confidently, "I've already noticed that you have feelings for her, and she seems to have a good impression of you as well. Otherwise, she wouldn't keep finding reasons to be together with you. Now that I've sent it, let's see how she replies. If she really likes you, then you have a chance.
If she doesn't, it's just a probe; we can say it was a misunderstanding on my part."
Lin Hao spoke with ease, while Lin Jie was already panicking.

chapters.title: Chapter 186 Going Home
chapters.content:
"No, no, you're such a pig teammate!"
Lin Jie said anxiously, immediately editing a message on his phone, planning to explain to Qin Xiaoxu that the previous message wasn't sent by him.
But at this moment, seeing Lin Jie's actions, Lin Hao became excited, stood up to grab his phone and said, "What are you doing, dude? You finally sent her a message, and you definitely have to see how she responds. If you explain to her now, won't you have spoiled everything?"
Lin Hao was anxiously trying to snatch Lin Jie's phone, while Lin Jie argued urgently, "You just don't understand her personality; it's not something you can guess. If she ends up ignoring me because of this, it will be all your fault!"
Lin Jie was anxious and quite distressed. He was genuinely worried that he wouldn't even be able to be friends with Qin Xiaoxu in the future.
So at that moment, he typed urgently, deleting and rewriting again and again.
Right then, a new message popped up. Seeing Qin Xiaoxu's reply, he froze, lifted his phone, and exclaimed, "She... she told me... agreed!"
Lin Jie panicked at that point, and hearing his words, Lin Hao showed an astonished expression, leaning in close to Lin Jie to see Qin Xiaoxu's reply, then hugged Lin Jie's shoulder, saying, "No way, I was just trying it out, but it seems she indeed has a thing for you, otherwise she wouldn't have agreed so easily!"
After sending her message, Qin Xiaoxu chuckled, holding her phone as she waited for Lin Jie's reply.
Meanwhile, Lin Jie was still dumbfounded and didn't know how to reply to Qin Xiaoxu, saying, "So am I really her boyfriend now?"
"Of course, you are. Since she has acknowledged it, she's your girlfriend now."
Feeling a bit panicked after hearing this, Lin Jie looked at his phone and said, "Then what should I say to her? I have no idea how to respond."
He was completely flustered at the moment. Pretending to be Qin Xiaoxu's boyfriend had been one thing, but now that he was actually her boyfriend, he didn't know what to say.
"Just talk to her like you usually do; after all, she understands you, and you are boyfriend and girlfriend now. Speak with a doting tone, and try not to be too much of a typical guy, or she'll be unhappy!"
After considering for a long time, Lin Jie finally sent a message.
"Since you agreed, let's go on a date tomorrow."
Qin Xiaoxu leaped up excitedly upon hearing this. Her hands grasping the phone were sweating, suddenly feeling that every word Lin Jie said made her so happy.
Previously, since Lin Jie hadn't confirmed their relationship, she hadn't dared to show the slight feelings she had for him. But now that they were officially dating, naturally, they could exhibit the affection typical of boyfriends and girlfriends.
At this time, sitting in the passenger seat, Han Xuewei received Qin Xiaoxu's message, looked down, realized Qin Xiaoxu had succeeded, and couldn't help but feel joyful as she said,
Explore new worlds at empire
"Lin Yi, it really happened! It seems like they've confirmed their relationship."
Lin Yi, who was driving, curved his lips and said, "Lin Jie is a good man; your friend won't be at a loss with him!"
Hearing this, Han Xue only smiled slightly.
"Of course, I hope she can meet a good man. Lin Jie does seem quite decent, and considering her family background, we all hope they get along well..."
As they spoke, their car entered the highway, and they were soon able to reach home.
By the time the two of them got home, it was almost midnight. As soon as she stepped out of the front door, Han Xuewei heard the cry of a baby and became a bit tense. She immediately dropped her bag and ran upstairs.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi had just parked the car. Seeing Han Xuewei's bag at the door, he picked it up for her and they both headed to the second floor.
When Lin Yi reached the second floor, Han Xuewei was already holding the baby and trying to soothe him—the one crying was Er Bao.
Er Bao was crying in a whimpering tone. Han Xuewei held him and began to sway gently, while at that time Lin Yi's mother came out but did not disturb her.
She went directly to Lin Yi and asked, "Where did you go today? Why are you coming back so late? Er Bao was just giving me a hard time!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi replied indifferently, "We went to a class reunion tonight and came back a bit late."
Lin Yi's mother didn't say anything more at that moment. Han Xuewei was seriously trying to console Er Bao, who had become much quieter and calmer by now.
After all, when Er Bao cried, the other two babies also woke up, watching Han Xuewei with their round eyes.
Feeling a bit helpless, Han Xuewei sat down and started to entertain the babies. Lin Yi walked into the babies' bedroom. Seeing Lin Yi, Han Xuewei couldn't help but say, "I can take care of the babies here. You must be tired today. Go take a shower first, then come and lull them to sleep after..."
Lin Yi nodded upon hearing this and went into the bathroom. Lin Yi was quick with his shower; he emerged from the bathroom in just over ten minutes.
Coming out of the room, Lin Yi asked, "Have the babies fallen asleep?"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei nodded, "They're all asleep, and I had the caretaker go in to look after them."
Lin Yi nodded and said, "Wife, go take a shower, I've already got the water ready for you."
"Okay. Thank you, honey!"
After saying that, Han Xuewei tiptoed up and pecked Lin Yi on the corner of his lips.
Lin Yi smiled and said, "You're so tired today, how about I help you with your bath?"
At his words, Han Xuewei pushed him away with shy protest, "I don't need that."
Having said that, she hurried into the bathroom. Lin Yi watched her rush in, a faint smile on his face.
After Han Xuewei finished her bath, she came to the bed, where Lin Yi was holding the hairdryer, blowing her hair with skilled and gentle motions, quickly drying it.
Seeing how skillfully Lin Yi was blowing her hair, Han Xuewei joked, "You're so adept at blow-drying a girl's hair, surely you haven't done it often for other girls!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi smiled mischievously, pulling her hair over and said, "How could that be? This is the first time I've blow-dried a girl's hair. I practiced so much just for you!"
As Lin Yi said this, he gently kissed Han Xuewei's lips, and they both broke into laughter.

chapters.title: Chapter 187 Assets
chapters.content:
After drying her hair, Lin Yi sat down next to Han Xuewei and began massaging her shoulders, helping her to relax, while Han Xuewei took a deep breath.
"I said today at the hotel that I have some explaining to do when we got back," Lin Yi began, "In fact, all the businesses I mentioned at the hotel today are real. There's a lot I haven't told you because I was afraid it would make you worry..."
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei said, "I know you wouldn't engage in illegal business, so what do I have to worry about?"
Seeing Han Xuewei's trust in him, Lin Yi couldn't help but feel touched.
Meanwhile, Han Xuewei seemed indifferent. Actually, she didn't care how much money Lin Yi had; what mattered to her was whether his money was earned legally.
But observing Lin Yi's demeanor, it seemed all the money was indeed acquired legally, so she stopped worrying.
"Then wife, don't you want to know how much I'm worth?" Lin Yi asked.
Hearing this, Han Xuewei laughed, "If you're willing to tell me, then I will listen; but if you don't want to talk about it, that's okay too."
Han Xuewei showed great understanding. Surprised by her response, Lin Yi found himself receiving a shoulder massage from her as she turned to him.
Feeling spoiled by the attention, Lin Yi listened as Han Xuewei said, "Husband, when you revealed your identity in front of everyone today, I felt so proud!"
As she spoke, her eyes shone brightly, clearly filled with admiration.
Moved by her words, Lin Yi patted her hand and said, "Actually, Wenqu Building is also mine."
At these words, Han Xuewei's hands froze, and she exclaimed in disbelief, "Are you serious? How could Wenqu Building be yours?!!"
Lin Yi had anticipated that Han Xuewei's reaction to the news would be excited, but he hadn't expected her to be so stunned.
Staring at Lin Yi, Han Xuewei said, "If Wenqu Building is yours, no wonder the rent for my father's hotel is so low—it was your doing all along."
"My goodness, if we're talking about Wenqu Building, how much rent must you collect a year? Wow, how can you be so impressive? Do mom and dad know about this?"
As Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Yi simply smiled and replied, "I don't even know how to tell them right now. I'm worried they will need a lot of explanations, and might not even understand,"
Lin Yi said, somewhat vexed. Hearing this, Han Xuewei stared at him in shock.
With a casual smile, Lin Yi said, "I also own Jinguo Hotel and the shopping mall inside Wenqu Building, along with some other real estate. I haven't been managing them much recently, but all together, they account for quite a sum of money!"
As Lin Yi spoke, Han Xuewei, overwhelmed by the revelations, was already beside herself with excitement.
"Husband! With all that said, you truly are a hidden tycoon. In this case, won't I become the biggest 'boss lady' in all of Xiangcheng? My goodness!"
Ecstatic, Han Xuewei stood up as Lin Yi laughed at her reaction.
"A husband's job is to earn money for his wife to spend, isn't it?"
Lin Yi said, picking up the black Golden Dragon card from the table beside him and handing it to Han Xuewei.
"I've loaded a hundred million in cash onto this card. Spend it however you like."
At these words, Han Xuewei was dumbfounded. Looking at the black card Lin Yi gave her, she shook her head vehemently, "No, no! I can't accept this. If I do, I'm certain to become a spendthrift!"
Lin Yi just smiled serenely, stuffed the card into her hand, and hugged her. At that moment, Han Xuewei was also extremely thrilled.
"That's great, husband, I truly love you to death."
Han Xuewei was extremely excited at the moment, while Lin Yi held her face gently, giving a soft peck at the corner of her lips, and Han Xuewei was also very excited, eagerly responding to him.
But just at that moment, the system voice rang out, and Lin Yi felt somewhat interrupted, suddenly pausing.
Seeing Lin Yi stop, Han Xuewei didn't say anything. She stood up and said, "I'll go warm up a glass of milk for you, you've had a tiring day as well."
After speaking, Han Xuewei walked out.
The system voice, however, was very enthusiastic.
"Congratulations to the host, the affection between husband and wife is heating up, therefore you are rewarded with a Supreme Grade God Card! This card comes with an unlimited amount of money, but it can only be used on family members."
Lin Yi heard this and was also somewhat astonished.
It turned out that the card he was rewarded with had no limits, which meant it could be used without any spending restrictions.
He had never received such a card before, and having one now was simply miraculous.
At that moment, Lin Yi looked at the card that appeared in his hand with a look of surprise. From some point on, he felt as though his life was starting to unfold according to the system's tasks.
It all seemed controlled, and although it felt a bit surreal, the outcomes Lin Yi ultimately received were not bad,
so he didn't think too much about it at the moment. Now, as long as he took good care of Han Xuewei and worked hard to take care of the babies, that was all that mattered.
When Han Xuewei came back, she handed Lin Yi a glass of warm milk. After taking a sip, he couldn't wait to hold Han Xuewei in his arms. Han Xuewei knew what he wanted to do, and both of them smiled, then covered themselves with the blanket.
...
The next morning, both Han Xuewei and Lin Yi got up early.
After all, in the coming days, they would need to go back to school, and during their previous leave, they had always been with the babies. But now, having to return to their studies, the babies naturally found it very hard to part with them.
So in the morning, sensing that Lin Yi and Han Xuewei wouldn't be with them in the coming days, the babies immediately started crying loudly.
Han Xuewei had to soothe them for a long time before they finally calmed down quietly.
But there was no choice, they still needed to continue their studies.
After all, they both needed to get their diplomas, and with Han Xuewei pursuing even greater aspirations, they couldn't afford to delay any longer. The children had to be left in the care of Lin Yi's mother and the family nanny,
while Lin Jie, having confirmed his relationship with Qin Xiaoxu, was in a constant state of panic, not knowing how to face what lay ahead.
Qin Xiaoxu naturally understood that it was impossible for the two of them to live together, as they were not that intimate yet.
Nevertheless, with Qin Xiaoxu still unemployed, Lin Jie felt he should take even more care of her. So whenever Lin Jie had free time, he searched for a myriad of job opportunities online for her.
But in reality, Qin Xiaoxu didn't have to work since her family was wealthy, which is why he started looking up information on how to interact with girls online.
After reading recommendations from various love experts, he still felt very confused.
Meanwhile, Lin Hao, who was living with Lin Jie, was dying of boredom. He was feeling very regretful at the moment,

chapters.title: Chapter 188 Gu Li Returns
chapters.content:
He should have known better than to set Lin Jie and Qin Xiaoxu up together. Ever since they announced their relationship, they were constantly joined at the hip, leaving him no time to play games with Lin Jie.
When Lin Jie played games, she would basically invite Qin Xiaoxu, and he could only play alone.
Moreover, if Qin Xiaoxu wanted to move in with Lin Jie, he would have no choice but to skulk away. The thought left him feeling somewhat helpless.
Lately, the relationship between Lin Jie and Qin Xiaoxu had been heating up. After they met up, Lin Jie was even more attentive to Qin Xiaoxu's recent situation.
In his presence, Qin Xiaoxu was very natural, and the two appeared just like a couple in love.
Fearing that she was jobless, Lin Jie went ahead and transferred her nearly a hundred thousand yuan at once. Qin Xiaoxu was shocked by the amount. Although the luxury goods she usually bought were expensive, this was different, since it was money meant for living expenses.
A hundred thousand yuan for living expenses was indeed substantial, yet they only contacted each other through games and the internet, actually meeting up very rarely.
And with Lin Jie being a typical straight man, making any further progress was extremely difficult—he hadn't even held her hand once so far.
But these past few days, their university had started the new semester as well, and Han Xuewei had also gone to school. While the start of the semester wasn't much of a hassle, Han Xuewei was busy taking care of a child and going to school.
On the morning of the first day of the semester, Lin Yi drove Han Xuewei to school and casually found a parking spot.
Together, they headed towards the interior of the school, and when the surrounding students saw them, they all showed looks of amazement.
Some junior students who had just transferred to the school had also heard of the campus belle's reputation and were equally shocked.
"My God, did you see that? That's our Xiangcheng University's campus belle!"
"To be honest, she really lives up to her reputation. Look how beautiful she is!"
"Yeah, before I came to this school, I even read about it online. It's said that the campus belle and her husband already have a child together, and now their family is really happy."
"And I heard her husband is a very capable man, very wealthy too. The two of them together are a match made in heaven, truly a role model for our generation."
A group of junior students watched the two of them and began to discuss, mostly expressing envy.
At that moment, Lin Yi, dutifully holding Han Xuewei's hand, walked towards the front. They were not in the same department, so they didn't have classes on the same floor.
After Lin Yi dropped Han Xuewei off at her classroom, he headed back on his own. He always had to take the long way around, but he didn't mind the hassle—in fact, he enjoyed the experience.
Also, after class, Lin Yi often took Han Xuewei out shopping.
Han Xuewei didn't really like the coffee and milk tea from school, but Lin Yi would enthusiastically buy her a bunch every time, and she would just have to accept them.
In fact, when Han Xuewei first came to the school, she had worried about fitting into the group.
But now it seemed to be going quite well; there wasn't the gossip she had expected, and everything was very peaceful.
Because she had taken a year off from school, Han Xuewei did not recognize many of her classmates upon her return.
But when they saw Han Xuewei's appearance, they all knew that she was the most famous school beauty in the whole Xiangcheng University.
So, many students were very enthusiastic about interacting with her. What Han Xuewei did not expect was that Gu Li had also come back.
However, she only wanted to obtain a diploma from Xiangcheng University, just like herself.
After all, it could prove that she had graduated from Xiangcheng University, even though she had studied abroad. But her academic performance there wasn't very impressive, so she had no choice but to come back.
But she didn't say that to others, she just said she didn't want to stay overseas anymore.
Before, she had competed with Han Xuewei for the title of school beauty. Although Han Xuewei did not care, there was no helping it, Han Xuewei's vote count just kept climbing.
Even when Gu Li specially bought votes to surpass Han Xuewei, she ultimately couldn't overtake her. So, seeing this old acquaintance now, Gu Li instantly showed a displeased expression, her eyes filled with malice.
She was very aggravated by Han Xuewei, and her personality had always been very willful, with quite a significant princess attitude.
As a result, many girls at the school did not think highly of her, even if her family was well-off. They were not like little girls in elementary or middle school who could be swayed by a bit of materialism. They were university students who naturally made friends with like-minded individuals.
They would not fawn over her just because she had a bit of money.
Gu Li was also very angry. When she returned to school, she originally thought that with her beautiful face, she could become this year's school beauty of Xiangcheng University. Yet, when she was in the process of enrollment, she heard that Han Xuewei had also returned to this school!
She learned that Han Xuewei had left Xiangcheng University for an entire year to get married and have a child, which instantly infuriated her. She had already backed off substantially, so why did Han Xuewei still appear in her life!
And now, having to attend the same university as her, this was absolutely intolerable!!
Moreover, she learned that Han Xuewei had already had a child, and looking at Han Xuewei's state, she was stunningly beautiful, not at all like a woman who had had a child.
And the title of school beauty of Xiangcheng University was still held by Han Xuewei, igniting intense jealousy in her.
However, she felt somewhat consoled when she heard from classmates that the man Han Xuewei married wasn't very well-off.
Yet, many classmates additionally revealed that Lin Yi, now, had a very high net worth and wasn't just some nobody, which Gu Li met with skepticism.
And since she was jealous of Han Xuewei, she certainly did not wish for Han Xuewei to have married too well.
Gu Li had been pampered since childhood, and her father had done business for so many years, turning her into a little princess. As for Han Xuewei, she was just someone from a small city, who honestly wasn't worth mentioning to her.
Moreover, those rumors about her husband Lin Yi being wealthy were just hearsay and hadn't been confirmed, so she still maintained her sense of superiority.
But now she was thinking about applying to transfer to a different classroom. However, their department only had this one classroom, so she still had to squeeze in with Han Xuewei, which made her quite irritated.
Meanwhile, Han Xuewei was messaging Lin Yi, who had sent her many caring words. Han Xuewei was also very happy, revealing a sweet smile.
After replying, a group of classmates nearby approached her under the pretense of looking at practice problems, intentionally getting close to Han Xuewei in no small number.
It seemed that everyone was very willing to hang out with Han Xuewei. Perhaps it was because she had a very amiable personality and was gently beautiful, naturally attracting everyone's liking.

chapters.title: Chapter 189 The Neighbor Brother
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei, upon arriving in this new environment, hadn't expected her classmates to be so kind to her, which pleasantly surprised her.
During the first class, the director had asked everyone to introduce themselves, and many students whom Han Xuewei didn't know took to the podium to start their introductions.
Many were overly attentive towards Han Xuewei, so when introducing themselves, they couldn't help but glance over at her.
Han Xuewei responded with a sweet smile, and just a smile was enough to excite the students considerably.
At that moment, Gu Li also took to the podium, and as she introduced herself, Han Xuewei inadvertently looked her way.
There had been a conflict between the two in the past, so when Han Xuewei looked at Gu Li, her expression was a bit awkward.
And when Gu Li saw Han Xuewei, she just stared at her coldly, not offering any pretense of courtesy, and even rolled her eyes at Han Xuewei.
Stay tuned for updates on empire
Han Xuewei didn't seem to mind and merely lowered her head to work on practice questions, not looking at her again.
After all, as far as she was concerned, Gu Li was just an old acquaintance, nothing of particular significance.
However, these actions of the two were noticed by their classmates, and from time to time, some would say, "Vivi, I feel like that student has something against you!"
"Yeah, she seemed to glare at you just now, how rude..."
Hearing these words, Han Xuewei just smiled faintly.
"It's nothing, that student is someone I know, she's a former classmate of mine."
Understanding dawned on the classmates upon hearing this.
"Did she also take a leave of absence to have a baby, just like you did?"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei laughed awkwardly.
"I wouldn't know about that."
For some reason, these university juniors and sophomores were very curious about childbirth and marriage, so they couldn't help asking on the side, and Han Xuewei answered awkwardly.
The bespectacled girl sitting next to Han Xuewei spoke with great enthusiasm, "Vivi, I actually envy you, after all, you can have triplets at once, and by doing so, you won't even have to consider having a second child."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei just sighed and said, "Actually, it's simpler than you think. Being pregnant, whether it's with twins or triplets, always carries certain risks. Plus, as time goes by, your stomach gets heavier and heavier, and the weight of the babies will make you feel very tired, so I hope you won't make the same decision as me in the future..."
Han Xuewei spoke gently, and hearing this, the bespectacled girl had a moment of realization and nodded.
Nevertheless, she didn't want to continue asking because as Han Xuewei talked about childbirth, she seemed to exhibit a pained expression; the girl felt she might have been intrusive, so she didn't ask any further.
But Han Xuewei didn't hold it against her and maintained her gentle demeanor, which made the girl's fondness for Han Xuewei surge significantly.
It wasn't just the boys, even the girls couldn't resist Han Xuewei's gentle charm.
After class, Han Xuewei organized some books, put them in her bag, and walked to the parking lot. Halfway there, a voice called out from behind her.
A tall man approached her, looked at Han Xuewei with a hooking smile, and said, "Vivi, I didn't expect to see you here."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei was somewhat surprised and showed a delighted expression when she saw the man. He was dressed in a casual black outfit and was looking down at her with a handsome smile.
This was Han Xuewei's neighbor from her childhood, a few years older than her. When she was in elementary school, he was already in junior high, and he would sometimes come to her house to tutor her when he had the chance.
So naturally, Han Xuewei was very excited to see him and said fluently, "Ji Hua brother, I didn't expect to see you here."
The man in front of her was named Mo Jihua; he was a foreign language teacher at this school.
Seeing Han Xuewei, Mo Jihua also expressed his happiness and said, "I didn't expect to see you here. Actually, I've been working here as a foreign language teacher for the past two years."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei couldn't help covering her mouth and exclaimed, "You're a foreign language teacher at our school, and I haven't seen you before."
Hearing this, Mo Jihua smiled and replied, "I have heard about you. After all, you took a year off last year, so it's normal that we didn't bump into each other. I didn't expect you to get married and have children so quickly..."
As Mo Jihua spoke, Han Xuewei felt a bit shy and awkwardly said, "Yeah, it should have been you who got married and had kids first, but I didn't expect to beat you to it!"
Hearing that, Mo Jihua laughed and replied, "Are you looking for your husband after class now? Isn't he at the same school as you? He should be coming over soon."
Hearing that, Han Xuewei nodded and smiled, saying, "Yes, he should be getting the car now. Oh right, there's something I wanted to ask you. You moved away before, but I never heard from you after that. Where did you go all these years...?"
At Han Xuewei's words, Mo Jihua's expression darkened imperceptibly as he said, "After I moved away, my family emigrated for some reasons, and I've been living abroad for these past few years before returning."
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei gave a faint smile and said, "Yeah, if you hadn't left in such a hurry back then, maybe our families would still be in touch. Unfortunately, you left too quickly. By the time I asked my mom the next day, she said she didn't know you had already moved away, without even leaving a phone number."
As Han Xuewei spoke, Mo Jihua's face showed a look of regret. He was about to respond when his words were interrupted by a clear male voice.
At that moment, Lin Yi came out and said, "Wife, I've been looking for you for so long, and here you are."
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei immediately smiled and walked toward Lin Yi.
"Husband! I thought I was going to look for you, but here you are."
Hearing this, Lin Yi immediately took Han Xuewei's hand and said, "Didn't I see you got out of class? I thought I would find you in the parking garage, but when you didn't show up, I came out to look for you."
After speaking, Lin Yi followed Han Xuewei's gaze to Mo Jihua and asked, "Who is this?"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei replied gently, "This is my neighbor from before, his name is Mo Jihua. When I was little, I used to call him Ji Hua brother. He's probably older than you."
"This is my husband, Lin Yi."

chapters.title: Chapter 190 Buy a Diamond Ring
chapters.content:
At that moment, when Lin Yi saw Mo Jihua, he just gave a small smile and said, "Hello, I'm Lin Yi!"
Then he reached out his hand, and Mo Jihua extended his as well, and their hands clasped together. Han Xuewei smiled and said, "Ji Hua brother, now a foreign language teacher at our school, we'll be seeing each other often. From now on, he'll be Teacher Mo!"
As Han Xuewei spoke, Mo Jihua couldn't help but say, "Vivi, actually, you can still call me Ji Hua brother, after all, you've called me that since we were kids."
Mo Jihua said tenderly, and upon hearing this, Lin Yi immediately felt a sour sensation in his heart.
How can this Mo Jihua be so oblivious! With her husband right here, how can he still bring himself to call her sister? Lin Yi felt a bit unhappy inside, but Han Xuewei didn't have so many guards up, after all, this was the big brother from next door who'd grown up with her.
At this moment, Lin Yi looked up at Mo Jihua, who, feeling Lin Yi's gaze, suddenly felt a bit awkward and said, "Vivi, since your husband is here, why don't you head back, goodbye."
After Mo Jihua finished speaking, he walked away, and Lin Yi watched his retreating figure without saying anything more, just taking Han Xuewei's hand and walking forward.
Han Xuewei seemed to sense that Lin Yi was a bit upset and said, "Husband, do you not like me calling Ji Hua brother?"
Hearing this, Lin Yi frowned and couldn't help but say, "Yes, I think you should call him Teacher Mo. Lin Yi was indeed a bit jealous. After all, Han Xuewei never called him brother. Anyway, he just didn't like his wife calling another man brother, which he felt was somewhat ambiguous."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei just gave a faint smile; she didn't mind.
If Lin Yi didn't like it, she wouldn't call him that anymore.
Meanwhile, Lin Tian had moved closer to her and said, "Why don't you call me Lin Yi brother? You were just calling her so sweetly, 'brother'. Now, regardless, you also have to call me Lin Yi brother."
Han Xuewei's face immediately turned red at these words and she hastily said, "Don't say it like that, it's not like that. I've been close to him since we were kids, that's why I've always called him Ji Hua brother. If you're going to put it that way, should I call him Brother Mo from now on?"
Hearing Han Xuewei wildly testing the limits, Lin Yi directly grabbed her arm, his tone stern.
"You can only call him Teacher Mo, then call me Lin Yi brother. Hurry up!"
Lin Yi stared at Han Xuewei's blurred face and couldn't resist kissing her.
Han Xuewei, being teased like this by Lin Yi, suddenly blushed, nervously looking around, thankfully there weren't many people here.
Lin Yi then looked at her with a mischievous smile and said, "If you don't call me that, then your husband can only keep on kissing you."
As Lin Yi moved in closer, Han Xuewei's entire face was flushed, and she said somewhat shyly, "Lin Yi brother..."
Her voice was very soft, and Lin Yi raised an eyebrow and said, "What did you call me? Huh? I didn't hear it clearly."
Han Xuewei's face was so red it was almost bleeding, and she said, "Lin Yi brother, Lin Yi brother..."
Her voice was low, yet it had an enchanting quality to it, and being so close, Lin Yi could completely smell her fragrance.
Lin Yi was instantly bewitched and quickly stood up straight, saying, "Let's go back to the car."
Seeing Lin Yi's reaction, Han Xuewei was also somewhat puzzled, but she just followed behind Lin Yi.
Lin Yi was acting really strangely today, but only Lin Yi himself knew, "If Han Xuewei keeps calling like that, I really won't be able to resist and will have to take her right here, right now."
After getting back into the car, Han Xuewei frowned and said, "Husband, I think I'm feeling a bit engorged. Please give me the breast pump."
As Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Yi handed her the breast pump and couldn't help saying, "Do you need hubby to help?" Hearing this, Han Xuewei's cheeks flushed as she replied, "No need, I can do it myself."
Continue your adventure at empire
As she spoke, Han Xuewei turned her back, and Lin Yi just smiled faintly, finding his shy wife rather amusing.
"Since it's a rare day out, why don't we go have a meal first, and then I'll take you shopping for some stuff."
Lin Yi suggested, and upon hearing this, Han Xuewei nodded her head. After Han Xuewei finished expressing milk, she passed the breast pump back to Lin Yi.
However, Lin Yi noticed she wasn't wearing her wedding ring and, seeing her fair hand, he was momentarily stunned and couldn't help asking, "Wife, why aren't you wearing your ring?"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei just smiled lightly and replied, "Husband, it's not that I don't want to wear it, but the ring you bought me is really too ostentatious. I'm afraid it would attract too much attention. It might lead to too many questions from classmates, and I really don't like that..."
As Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Yi also found her point valid and nodded, then said after putting away the breast pump, "Then I'll take you to buy a new one."
What?
Han Xuewei was somewhat surprised and looked at Lin Yi, whose expression was very serious, and at that moment, he seemed a bit displeased.
She had long noticed Lin Yi's mood was quite volatile, so she didn't want to make Lin Yi unhappy, choosing to go along with him. The two drove to the mall and grabbed something to eat,
Afterward, Lin Yi took Han Xuewei to an international brand diamond ring store.
Opening the car door, Lin Yi took Han Xuewei's hand and walked inside. The store's salespeople were top-notch in the country, so they stood very professionally and greeted them warmly, "Good day, sir and madam, how may we assist you?"
"Our diamonds here are of extremely high quality, virtually flawless, and we offer custom design services as well!"
A female sales associate spoke eloquently. Hearing this, Lin Yi just looked on indifferently.
The surrounding salespeople were equally astonished to see Han Xuewei's beautiful face, each showing a look of surprise, while Lin Yi simply said, "I'm here to pick a suitable diamond ring for my wife. Show me the best rings you have that are light and not too flamboyant but definitely luxurious."
Lin Yi spoke calmly, and the female sales associate immediately understood. She was accustomed to serving wealthy individuals.
These clients had a particular trait when selecting rings: some liked big and extravagant, while others preferred something more subtle, yet no less expensive.
Quickly, the sales associate went inside, and their manager also came out, as big clients always warranted personal attention from the management.
Shortly after, the sales associate brought out several styles and displayed them before Lin Yi, saying, "Sir, look, these are the top-tier diamond rings from our store..."

chapters.title: Chapter 191 Buy Out
chapters.content:
Walking into the store, Han Xuewei hadn't had much of a look around when she received a phone call from Qin Xiaoxu.
Han Xuewei immediately answered, and the voice on the other end quickly began, "Vivi, I heard today that Gu Li came back. Didn't that woman have a conflict with you before? Is she attending classes with you...?"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei replied with emotion, "Yeah, I saw her today, but we don't get along, so I didn't speak to her."
Upon hearing that, Qin Xiaoxu immediately showed a displeased expression.
"Exactly, that woman is really something! I'm so annoyed just seeing her around with that smug look of hers, acting all proud just because she went abroad? What's so great about that?"
Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei had already come across Gu Li before, so their impression of her was very unfavorable.
And Qin Xiaoxu, who is quite straightforward, wouldn't beat around the bush like Han Xuewei. If Gu Li dared to lord it over Qin Xiaoxu, Qin would certainly put her in her place.
But she's not in the university anymore, so all she could do was express indignation on behalf of Han Xuewei; she couldn't really help in any practical sense.
As they talked, Qin Xiaoxu mentioned someone else.
Hearing this, Han Xuewei also felt somewhat speechless.
"Are you talking about Ye Caiwei? Didn't Ye Caiwei take a leave of absence from school?"
"Yes, she did take a leave, but she just called me a moment ago, saying she wants to get together with everyone from our dormitory. I don't even know how she's been doing recently. I think maybe she's afraid of facing us..."
"I don't know either, but we can ask her when we see her. When is the gathering?"
"It's tonight. She just called to tell me. Vivi, you must come, of course I'm going. After all, I was pretty close with her during college."
As Han Xuewei spoke, Qin Xiaoxu finally took a deep breath and then hung up the phone.
At this moment, after hearing this phone call, Han Xuewei looked somewhat bewildered. She hadn't expected Ye Caiwei to come back all of a sudden, and even to be talking about organizing a reunion. She wondered what had happened.
Lin Yi was picking out some rings when he turned and saw Han Xuewei looking somewhat listless, so he couldn't help but ask, "Wife, what's wrong? You seemed upset after that phone call."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei quickly shook her head.
"No, it's not that I'm feeling bad. It's just that my college dormmate said she wants to meet up. The person organizing the gathering is a friend I knew from before. When she was in her freshman or sophomore year at college,
she found out she was pregnant. Then she decided to go home and get married. At the time, I advised her to finish school first, then deal with this matter, but I don't know what happened after, it seemed like she just dropped out."
At this, Han Xuewei's brows furrowed.
"Back then, we tried to contact her through phone calls and WeChat, but she didn't respond to anything; it's like she just disappeared. We didn't meet over the winter vacation either, and it seemed like she never returned to school."
"I don't know if she's doing well now, married with children. If she's really not doing well... So I definitely need to go tonight."
As Han Xuewei spoke, her mood became somber.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi nodded in agreement.
After the conversation, Lin Yi turned his head back and continued to select diamond rings for Han Xuewei.
Looking at the few diamond rings laid out by the sales associate, Lin Yi was not quite satisfied. Although his knowledge of diamond rings was not very extensive, the rings did not look very appealing even in terms of display.
Lin Yi knitted his brows and spoke up, "Do you have anything else? Something that looks more imposing, and then, perhaps, more expensive? These all seem a bit too modest for my taste. Price is no object! As long as it's suitable!"
Lin Yi said indifferently, while the ring in the saleswoman's hand was by no means cheap—it would take a good million to acquire it. However, Lin Yi seemed unimpressed.
At that moment, she felt somewhat at a loss and looked over to the female manager, who, upon seeing Lin Yi, immediately walked over with a smile.
"Sir, please don't worry, we have many more diamond rings that you can choose from. Just give us a moment..."
Then, the female manager headed inside. Their more valuable rings were locked up in the safe, and generally, no one would ask about them. Sometimes they would make a sample or show a photograph to the customers.
But even the well-known tycoons of Xiangcheng rarely asked for rings of that level because they were simply too expensive.
Soon, the manager returned and said, "Sir, please come with me to take a look inside."
Hearing this, Lin Yiling turned to Han Xuewei. Han Xuewei nodded, and the two of them went inside together.
The manager carefully presented a diamond ring that sparkled magnificently, looking exceedingly luxurious and valuable, like a gemstone.
Han Xuewei was astonished at first glance, as it was her first time seeing such a beautiful diamond ring.
It brought out the beauty of the diamond to the extreme, and it was also full of design sense. Han Xuewei couldn't help but say, "Honey, this ring looks pretty good!"
Seeing Han Xuewei satisfied, Lin Yi stepped forward to take a look and said, "This ring's diamond seems a bit small!"
Hearing this, the female manager excitedly responded, "Sir, we can customize the size of the diamond here. It's just that the larger diamond will be more expensive and will require some time to prepare..."
Hearing this, Lin Yi turned back to Han Xuewei and said, "Since this style is good, just wrap this one up for me for now. As for your custom model, can it be expedited..."
As Lin Yi spoke, the manager's expression immediately turned respectful. She rarely encountered a big spender like Lin Yi, and naturally, she responded respectfully and promptly, "Of course, we can hasten the process, but may I know when sir would like to pick it up? We will definitely try to finish it as soon as possible."
"Can I get it by tonight? If so, I will place the order right now."
As Lin Yi said this, the manager and all the sales associates around were stunned. They looked at Lin Yi in surprise.
The ring that Lin Yi had just purchased was also worth five million, and the custom one with the larger diamond he spoke of would cost nearly over ten million. It was no small sum of money.
Therefore, the sales associate couldn't help but approach and say, "Sir, the cost of these two items is different. The custom one you want will start at least at ten million, and the craftsmanship fee is also extremely high."
However, the manager stopped the sales associate and bowed respectfully to Lin Yi, "If sir wants to customize, we would require an upfront payment. If you wish, we can work to finish it for you by tonight, guaranteeing your satisfaction."

chapters.title: Chapter 192 Swipe the Card
chapters.content:
The female manager said this, knowing she couldn't let such a big deal slip away.
At that moment, Lin Yi's expression was extremely indifferent, as if the matter was trivial to him. He lifted the card in his hand and said, "Swipe the card!"
Lin Yi didn't even ask the price; he simply commanded to swipe the card. At this, the female sales associate didn't dare say another word and could only stare at Lin Yi with her mouth agape.
The manager was also somewhat surprised as she took the card machine and walked over to Lin Yi.
"Good afternoon, sir, the total for this transaction is sixteen million yuan. Please swipe your card."
As the manager spoke, Lin Yi didn't even bat an eyelid before swiping his card.
Seeing Lin Yi's generous manner, all the surrounding salespeople showed astonished expressions.
They had worked there for a long time but had never seen a customer who spent so much money in one go.
After the card was swiped, everyone was greatly shocked, while Lin Yi remained utterly indifferent.
As he put away his card, he heard the system's voice.
"Ding! Congratulations to the host for completing the task of spending money for your wife. The system will return all the money spent by the host and also gift five Divine Pills.
"Host, please note that Divine Pills can provide health benefits to the host's body. Consuming Divine Pills when in good health is harmless but will not be effective. However, if the host has diseases like cancer, the Divine Pills can treat them. The Divine Pills have been placed in the host's system space."
At this moment, the system's interface appeared before Lin Yi, and he could clearly see five black Divine Pills.
Lin Yi was somewhat shocked now. In the modern world, illnesses typically required chemotherapy or surgery.
Some diseases were simply incurable, but the system seemed too much like a cheat, giving him Divine Pills that could resist any disease.
Does that not mean it could bring back people on the verge of death?
This was too incredible. Lin Yi was delighted and quickly checked the effects of the Elixir. However, these could only be used when the body was injured or ill.
They could not enhance his physical fitness, so consuming these Divine Pills while healthy would be of no benefit.
Lin Yi wasn't particularly interested in the money given by the system, but he would quite like it if the system could give him some life-hacking items.
At this moment, Lin Yi was in a good mood and couldn't help but sigh to himself.
"System, in the future, please send me more things like this."
"Ding! The system has received the host's request!"
Hearing the system's response, Lin Yi immediately looked surprised, thinking the system might have become self-aware.
Meanwhile, the people around them all showed delighted expressions.
This one transaction by Lin Yi could be said to equal their entire year's sales.
At that moment, all the staff members were extremely respectful, looking at the two of them with adoring eyes.
Lin Yi took Han Xuewei's hand and walked towards the exit, and the manager immediately showed great foresight, leading the staff to see Lin Yi and Han Xuewei off.
They kept offering their eager services until after the couple had left; only then did the female manager breathe a sigh of relief.
The surrounding salespeople exclaimed in awe.
"That guy was so handsome just now, and the way he spent money on his wife, I'm really in love."
"Yeah, when will I ever meet such a husband who doesn't even blink before dropping ten million to buy something?"
The many female sales associates around them gathered together, endlessly discussing that recent event.
"The man just now must be a successful person. The way he spends money on his wife is really cool."
"Didn't you see the clothes she was wearing? They're all from niche brands, pretty impressive."
"Despite that, they're so low-profile. When they first came in, they didn't show off at all. I've dealt with a customer before who was just like that but loved to show off!"
"Real wealthy people are always low-key!"
"Yeah, yeah, when will I ever meet a man like that!"
The many female sales associates thought of Lin Yi's face and couldn't stop swooning.
Meanwhile, the manager, seeing them, couldn't help but speak up, "Alright, get back to work all of you, stop daydreaming here!"
As the manager spoke, she turned to look and saw the couple had already walked far away.
In fact, she felt a bit envious, never expecting to encounter such a powerful customer that day.
The surrounding group of female sales associates, as if snapped out of a dream, sighed and returned to their posts.
Lin Yi was now with Han Xuewei in their car; they had finished class early today and still had plenty of time.
"How about we go home to check on the kids first?"
Now the babies were growing faster and faster, already over three months old, and it should be the stage where they start recognizing people. Like now, they can't speak yet, but they can almost recognize their own dad and mom.
"Although these kids are young, they're really smart."
As Lin Yi said this, Han Xuewei nodded her head in agreement, also missing the little ones at home.
"You sleep for a bit. I'll call you when we get there!"
Having said that, Lin Yi started the car, and Han Xuewei took a short rest in the passenger seat.
When they got home, the babies had already been fed. Lin Yi's mother and some aunties were pushing the babies around in the yard.
The sunlight spilled over them and the little ones reached out their hands to touch the world around them.
Everything was a source of wonder for them. Holding a little flower, Da Bao was shaking it in his hand and, upon seeing Lin Yi and Han Xuewei, excitedly raised his hand, causing the flower to shake along.
Children really change every day, growing incredibly fast.
By now, these little treasures were growing up very healthily, and seeing this, Lin Yi felt somewhat relieved.
Han Xuewei was also very excited as she ran over. Lin Yi, seeing the flower in Da Bao's hand, unexpectedly asked, "Is this for daddy?"
Hearing this, Da Bao giggled, handing the flower over to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi was surprised by her gesture and caught the little flower, then said, "Are you calling me daddy now? If you call daddy, he will pick you up."
As Lin Yi spoke, Han Xuewei, holding Da Bao, couldn't help but say, "Honey, aren't you being a little too eager? Da Bao is still so young, how can she actually call you daddy?"
As Han Xuewei spoke, Da Bao pouted, looking sadly at Lin Yi, reaching for the flower in Lin Yi's hand.
It seemed as though she was saying, I've already given you the flower, why aren't you holding me yet?

chapters.title: Chapter 193 Cooing the Baby
chapters.content:
Read latest chapters at empire
Lin Yi couldn't help but laugh when he saw this, putting the flower he was holding onto the little baby's ear, which made the flower-adorned baby look especially cute.
The little baby already resembled a porcelain doll and was the only girl in their family; naturally, Lin Yi was filled with affection for her.
"Mengmeng, don't cry, Daddy was just teasing you!"
As Lin Yi spoke, he reached for the little baby's armpits and smoothly picked her up.
Seeing Lin Yi, the little baby couldn't help but smile, bobbing her small head adorably.
Lin Yi couldn't help but smile as he watched her.
Da Bao was being held by Han Xuewei at this time, and Er Bao was looking around.
Han Xuewei, seeing Er Bao, crouched down to look at him.
When Er Bao saw that Han Xuewei was not holding him, he immediately reached out to grab Da Bao's diaper; Han Xuewei, seeing this, said, "Okay, Mommy will hold your brother first, then I'll hold you."
After Han Xuewei had finished speaking, Er Bao seemed to understand and looked at Han Xuewei with a pitiful cry.
Seeing this, Lin Yi couldn't help feeling a bit helpless and immediately joined in, saying, "Then let Daddy hold you."
Lin Yi held the little baby to one side and extended his other hand, finding it not difficult at all to hold two children at the same time.
However, when Lin Yi reached out his hand, Er Bao displayed a look of disgust.
Seeing her look of disdain, Lin Yi couldn't help but laugh, "Why do you disdain Daddy? Then Mommy won't hold you either."
Lin Yi was joking, but Er Bao acted as if she understood and immediately started crying at Han Xuewei.
Everyone who saw this burst out laughing.
An aunt immediately found a pacifier for Er Bao and even picked her up.
Er Bao then looked at Lin Yi triumphantly, as if she had won a victory.
Actually, Lin Yi couldn't help but laugh at Er Bao's demeanor, and Han Xuewei also watched Lin Yi with a smile, holding Da Bao and pinching his little cheek, saying, "When these kids are still young, we wish they would grow up faster. But when they actually do grow up, that's when you realize that they are the sweetest at this age."
Hearing this, Lin Yi couldn't help laughing.
"Indeed, at this age, kids are the sweetest, but taking care of them can be troublesome too. Holding her like this, I'm even afraid of hurting the little baby!"
As Lin Yi spoke, he tenderly held the little baby in his arms.
At this moment, he turned to look at his mother, who had lifted Er Bao entirely in the air, pinching Er Bao's armpits and suspending her vertically.
Er Bao's little face turned red, and she seemed uncomfortable, but she couldn't express it.
Seeing this, Lin Yi immediately spoke up, "Mom, that's not the right way to hold her. Look, Er Bao's face has turned red. Holding her like that can hurt the child's spine and waist. You should hold her horizontally, like I do."
Han Xuewei had noticed too, but as a daughter-in-law, she felt a bit embarrassed to criticize Mother Lin for holding the baby incorrectly.
So she thought for a long time, planning to let Er Bao endure it for a while, then to quietly take Er Bao into her arms later.
But unexpectedly, Lin Yi spoke out directly at that moment. Hearing Lin Yi's words, Mother Lin was also a bit surprised, furrowing her brows and holding Er Bao in her arms.
"Kids these days, so sensitive. I held him just like that, and he didn't cry or make a fuss. Kids don't even have waists. I held you the same way when you were little."
Mother Lin was not convinced by Lin Yi's words and directly scooped Er Bao into her arms.
At that moment, after hearing Mother Lin's words, Lin Yi directly spoke, "Mom, you really can't do this with kids nowadays. It's not about being capricious, but it can be bad for their bodies. If you occasionally hold them like this, it's okay. But if it's done for a long period, it will definitely be detrimental. Now we have to raise children scientifically!"
Upon hearing this, the nearby aunt nodded her head in agreement.
"There really is a lot of little knowledge in parenting!"
Mother Lin indeed realized her own issue. She was not the type to be obstinately unreasonable. Upon hearing that this kind of behavior might harm the baby, she immediately corrected herself.
Back when Lin Yi was little, in fact, she rarely took care of him because they had hired a nanny to look after him due to business matters.
Moreover, so much time had passed since then, and she had forgotten many of the details, but as long as it was good for the baby, that was all that mattered.
However, at this moment, Er Bao looked at Han Xuewei, fussing to be held by Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei had no choice but to put Da Bao into Lin Yi's arms and reached out to pick up Er Bao.
At this time, Er Bao looked like a victorious little warrior, shaking his little arms.
Lin Yi couldn't help but laugh. Da Bao, on the other hand, was well-behaved and stayed still while being held in Lin Yi's arms.
He simply stretched out his hand and touched Mengmeng's little cheek.
Mengmeng reciprocated the touch, and as soon as her little hand reached Da Bao's chubby cheek, she pinched it.
Da Bao immediately burst into tears with a "wah." Seeing this, Lin Yi immediately grabbed Mengmeng's hand and revealed a fierce expression as he said, "Mengmeng, big brother was just touching your face, he didn't hit you. You can't hit people. Do you hear me?"
Seeing Lin Yi so serious, Mother Lin, who was standing by, wanted to speak up and intervene, while Han Xuewei's face showed a look of surprise.
Lin Yi was very serious at this point since it was important for children, even very young ones, to learn to discern right from wrong.
At that moment, Mengmeng, looking like a child who had done something wrong, stretched out her little hand and touched Da Bao's head as a way of apologizing.
By then, Da Bao had stopped crying and looked up at Lin Yi.
Mengmeng, looking pitifully at Lin Yi, knew she had made a mistake. In fact, these babies were quite smart and would correct their behavior as soon as they were told.
Seeing this, Lin Yi touched Mengmeng's little hand and said, "Good Mengmeng, Daddy's not angry with you, just telling you that you can't do that."
Hearing Lin Yi's words, Mengmeng made babbling sounds as if she understood.
The surrounding people finally breathed a sigh of relief. It was the first time they had seen Lin Yi get angry with Mengmeng. At that moment, Han Xuewei couldn't help but start laughing.
"The little guy understands everything, as long as you're patient enough to teach them!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi also smiled. They were all very good.
Just then, Mother Lin took out her camera and said, "Come on, everyone look at the camera, I'm going to take a picture of you guys!"
The babies were excited, while Lin Yi smiled and gathered Han Xuewei and the others close together to pose for the photo.
Mother Lin took several photos one after another, each one very warm. When the pictures were developed, Han Xuewei immediately took them in her hand to show Lin Yi and the three babies.
The three babies seemed to understand as they looked at the photos and laughed, while Lin Yi also joined in the fun with them.

chapters.title: Chapter 194 Divine Water
chapters.content:
```
It is really fun to take care of little children when they are young, but I don't know what these three kids will be like when they grow up.
Lin Yi still can't feel that kind of feeling. However, he must imagine that in the future he will have even more things to worry about, so it's better to live well in the present.
At this moment, just as Lin Yi placed Da Bao in the rocking chair, the system's voice sounded.
"Ding! Congratulations to the host for triggering a system reward, the system has fulfilled the host's request, please check your reward!"
"Ding? Congratulations to the host on obtaining a bottle of Body Tempering Divine Water. This Divine Water can be mixed with water. Though it can't be directly consumed, adding just a drop or two will have very good effects. The host can use it to strengthen one's body or to help others recuperate."
Lin Yi looked at the Divine Water, somewhat surprised, and a look of astonishment appeared on his face as he muttered to himself.
"I didn't expect the system to be so smart, whatever I want, as long as I have a request, the system will help me achieve it!"
Thinking of this, Lin Yi showed a satisfied expression.
Lin Yi is now holding two children, while Han Xuewei is just coaxing Da Bao to sleep.
At this time, Mother Lin also showed a tired look and said, "You two are back, I'm going to get some sleep first, I'm too tired today."
Mother Lin stood up wearily and walked forward. Seeing this, Lin Yi showed a concerned expression.
Indeed, he hadn't exerted much effort these days, and a lot of the time it was his mother who had been taking care of these little babies.
Although they had hired a nanny, there were just so many things to take care of with the little babies, especially since there were three of them, it was definitely tiring for a mother to look after them all by herself.
Thinking of this, Lin Yi felt a bit guilty, so he decided to pour some of the newly obtained Body Tempering Divine Water, mixing it into the water that Mother Lin and Father Lin usually drank. By drinking this, their bodies could become stronger.
After all, they were getting older and it was natural for health issues to emerge, Lin Yi thought.
Han Xuewei was now preparing to wean the children off breast milk, since they were already quite big and should slowly be weaned. Moreover, sometimes there wasn't enough breast milk for three kids.
At this moment, Han Xuewei looked at Mother Lin and said, "Mom, go sleep first. There's the nanny here to watch over them, and the two of us are here too, don't worry!"
Hearing this, Mother Lin was able to let go of her worries and headed to her room.
Then Han Xuewei added, "Mom, tonight Lin Yi and I have to go out to attend a gathering and will come back a bit late."
Hearing this, Mother Lin was somewhat surprised and said, "I remember you two seemed to go to a gathering a few days ago."
"Mom, this time it's a little get-together with several sisters from my college dorm, just having a meal!"
As Han Xuewei spoke, Mother Lin nodded. She supported the idea of them having regular get-togethers with college friends to keep their relationships, so she nodded in agreement.
"Then come back early. It's getting cold outside, so wear more clothes when you go out tonight. And the children, they've really become too clingy lately. The sooner you come back, the sooner they'll agree to sleep," said Mother Lin.
Lin Yi nodded too, knowing that as the children grew, staying close to their parents would give them a greater sense of dependency.
```
If Han Xuewei appeared before her, pacifying them would be simpler. So Mother Lin cautioned her again, "I'm not saying you young people shouldn't go out and have fun, but now that you have children, you need to be more responsible. Spending more time with them is good. I won't oppose gatherings like this in the future, but you can't come back so late.
Last time, you stayed out until midnight, which isn't good!"
Mother Lin couldn't help but lecture Lin Yi as she looked at him. Although she didn't openly say much, Han Xuewei understood very well, and her heart also prioritized the children.
At this moment, Lin Yi was being scolded by Mother Lin, then he said a few cheeky words and escorted his mother back to her room.
It was quite normal for Mother Lin to worry, as Lin Yi and Han Xuewei were well-behaved, but Lin Yi could be quite reckless at times.
Furthermore, since the children are still so young, interacting more with their parents helps develop their sense of responsibility and overall well-being.
Parents are their closest guardians, and frankly, grandparents can't be the direct guardians of these children, so the little ones still need plenty of parental companionship.
Han Xuewei took these words to heart. After all, they were already parents, even though they were still in college and couldn't change some of their immature ways.
But with the guidance of Mother Lin and Father Lin, Han Xuewei was naturally mild-mannered and obedient, so she took these matters seriously.
It was just that Lin Yi might still be a bit more carefree. Sitting on the couch, Han Xuewei said, "What Mom just said makes a lot of sense. It looks like I should really prioritize my family from now on!"
As she spoke, Han Xuewei felt that her youth was behind her; she was now the mother of three children.
Hearing this, Lin Yi couldn't help but laugh, reached out to touch her head, and said, "Then I guess I can't take you out late at night anymore!"
Lin Yi said this with an implicit smile. Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei's face turned red—they were still surrounded by a few aunts who had not yet left.
Feeling embarrassed, Han Xuewei gave Lin Yi's shoulder a pat and said, "What are you talking about!"
Soon it was afternoon, and Han Xuewei had previously agreed to a get-together. At this moment, she received a message.
It was from Qin Xiaoxu.
"Vivi, come over around six o'clock tonight. I've sent you the location. You should arrive a bit earlier, I need to ask Ye Caiwei where she has been these days."
Reading that message, Han Xuewei grew a bit anxious. Knowing Qin Xiaoxu's impulsive personality, she cautioned, "But you mustn't be too hasty, she's kind of introverted by nature!"
"I know... I won't be,"
Han Xuewei didn't hide her messages from Lin Yi, so he could see what she was discussing with Qin Xiaoxu. Continue your journey with empire
Just then, a friend request notification popped up on Han Xuewei's screen, labeled "Brother Ji Hua."
Upon seeing this note, Han Xuewei was somewhat surprised and quickly added the person as a friend, then sent a message asking Mo Jihua how he had found her on WeChat.
Mo Jihua saw the message and felt nervous, but when he picked up his phone, his expression turned to one of dejection.
Because the display showed "Teacher Mo." Seeing those three words, "Teacher Mo," always made Mo Jihua feel a certain resistance.

chapters.title: Chapter 195 Care About
chapters.content:
Even though everyone at school called him by his name, he wished Han Xuewei would get a bit closer to him, so he replied with a message.
"Added from the school directory."
Han Xuewei didn't find anything peculiar about it and started chatting with him. At this moment, Lin Yi saw it too and couldn't help frowning, leaning over to take a look.
He knew his wife was the school beauty and that a lot of people would want to add Han Xuewei on WeChat.
Given Han Xuewei's nature, she was not one to refuse, so her WeChat was probably exploding with requests.
