Looking down, he saw Mo Jihua was sending WeChat messages to Han Xuewei, which made him frown with a somewhat sour expression, "Oh, you guys just met last time, and now he's already added you on WeChat!"
Lin Yi's tone didn't attempt to hide his sourness.
Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh when she heard this, but it was something Lin Yi truly cared about, especially since Han Xuewei had told him that Mo Jihua was like an older brother from next door to her.
Plus, Mo Jihua and she had a very good relationship, almost like childhood sweethearts, which meant he had known her many years before Lin Yi did.
If Mo Jihua had any thoughts about Han Xuewei, it would be impossible to guard against.
Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei, who appeared completely indifferent at the time, for her, Mo Jihua was just a brother, a teacher, nothing more. Explore stories at empire
Lin Yi, of course, knew Han Xuewei didn't have those kinds of feelings for other men, but if Mo Jihua did, he would feel extremely uncomfortable.
Seeing Lin Yi looking at her chat, Han Xuewei opened her mouth, "This is Teacher Mo, he just added me. He's now our foreign language teacher, so he saw my number and added it. That's not unusual, right?"
Lin Yi nodded and responded, "Yeah, when you see him later, just call him Teacher Mo."
Continuing, Lin Yi asked, "How old is he this year? Why do you always call him 'bro'? He can't be that much older than you!"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei frowned, "He is indeed quite a bit older than me, four or five years maybe. When I was in elementary school, he was already in middle school. I don't know his exact age, but yeah, he's just an older brother to me!"
Lin Yi didn't know what to say at that moment, but he was feeling increasingly sour on the inside, and Han Xuewei laughed as she saw him like this.
"Hubby, are you jealous?"
Lin Yi turned to look at Han Xuewei and couldn't help but smile.
"My wife is so beautiful; of course, many people will like her, okay? I admit it, I am jealous. I'm as sour as a lemon now. Wife, please contact these guys less in the future; they all have bad intentions!"
As he said this, Lin Yi embraced Han Xuemei.
Hearing Lin Yi's words, Han Xuewei laughed heartily.
"Husband, you're getting cuter by the day. Alright, I'll contact him less from now on. I'm a married woman and will be mindful of that. Don't worry, hubby!"
As Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Yi leaned down and gave her a kiss on the face.
"I don't care what you do, hubby won't restrict you, but in the future, don't get too close to other men. After all, some men have unsavory intentions!"
Lin Yi raised his hand as he spoke, and when Han Xuewei heard this, she responded, "Alright, alright, I promise you, but tonight at the party, hubby, you might have to wait outside for me because I promised them that it would just be me going to the party. So if you're there, it'll be awkward, and I need to have a chat with Ye Caiwei.
With a guy around, I'm worried she might not dare to speak her mind..."
As Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Yi also showed understanding and nodded, saying, "Wife's gathering with the sisters, hubby definitely won't bother."
While saying this, the two of them played around together. As for Mo Jihua's matter, Lin Yi wasn't actually unconfident; he just feared that Han Xuewei would become too close to Mo Jihua, who lacked a sense of propriety, potentially leading to unpleasant rumors.
Moreover, the school was not short of girls jealous of Han Xuewei, who were first-rate rumor spreaders. Han Xuewei was naive, unlike the others, so he didn't want her to fall into a trap.
Touched by what Lin Yi said, the two stood together and didn't reply to Mo Jihua.
At this moment, Mo Jihua was staring at his phone, a strong sense of loss welling up inside him.
Six o'clock came around quickly.
Lin Yi drove Han Xuewei to the agreed-upon location, and soon he saw Qin Xiaoxu in a coffee shop.
Qin Xiaoxu was holding his phone, looking anxiously around.
Knowing that Qin Xiaoxu was impatient, Han Xuewei quickly got out of the car and came up to him. When he saw her, he couldn't help but say, "Vivi, how come you're here so early!"
"I knew you would probably come first, so I couldn't let you wait here alone," Han Xuewei replied, and then looked around, frowning when she didn't see Ye Caiwei.
"Is Caiwei not here yet?"
Han Xuewei was very concerned about Ye Caiwei.
After all, they had known each other since their college days and had lived in the same dormitory, sharing genuine affection.
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu shook his head.
"I didn't arrive much earlier than you. I had wanted to meet with her sooner, but she's not here yet."
"When will she probably arrive?"
"Should be in about fifteen minutes."
As Qin Xiaoxu spoke, Lin Yi ordered them some coffee and brought it to the table. Seeing Lin Yi, Qin Xiaoxu couldn't help but ask, "Lin Yi, what kind of person do you think Lin Jie is? You should know her pretty well, right?"
Lin Yi hadn't expected this question. He was taken aback by Qin Xiaoxu's sudden query and furrowed his brow, saying, "What's the matter, did Lin Jie bully you? If she did, I'd go teach her a lesson for you!"
Laughing at this, Qin Xiaoxu shook his head and said, "It's not quite that serious. How could she bully me? I just find her personality puzzling. I can't figure her out."
"When we're together, she's so indifferent, a straight man with worryingly low EQ, but then at home, she becomes incredibly attentive. While chatting with me, she keeps calling me 'little treasure' so smoothly. It's like she's not the same person, as if she has many personalities, like the split personalities you see on TV!"
Qin Xiaoxu spoke with conviction. Hearing this, Lin Yi frowned while Han Xuewei, sitting on the side, couldn't help but laugh. She never expected Lin Jie's personality to deviate so much.
Lin Yi spoke up, saying, "No way, her personality is just straightforward. There's nothing special about it, and her parents never mentioned her having any issues either."

chapters.title: Chapter 196 Distress
chapters.content:
Lin Yi, hearing Qin Xiaoxu say this, was also somewhat puzzled, since he always thought that his brother, Lin Jie, was very normal during their interactions and didn't seem to have any problems with his personality. The guy was just straightforward.
Could it be that he had never truly understood his own brother?
At this thought, Lin Yi found himself at a loss for words, standing there stunned.
Qin Xiaoxu was even more bewildered. Why did Lin Jie act so clueless and dumb when they were together, and why did he sometimes seem like a simpleton with a low EQ, especially in the straightforwardness of a stereotypical male? Yet, when he got home, he became incredibly clever and knew exactly how to please someone. It was like he was two different people.
Han Xuewei heard this and couldn't help but laugh.
Leaning in towards Qin Xiaoxu, she said, "Now that you're in love, have you turned your brain to mush? When you encounter such an issue, why don't you just ask him directly, instead of guessing endlessly here?"
"You are boyfriend and girlfriend now, what can't you talk about?"
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu bowed her head and said, "Ah, we've only been dating for a few days. I just feel like something is off with him, but if he really has that dual personality disorder, then I'll just have to accept it."
"Stop overthinking it. I think as boyfriend and girlfriend, you should be honest with each other. Lin Jie is a good guy. He might have different thoughts from you, but from my experience, I can tell you that Lin Jie isn't much of a liar. So if you ask him, he will surely tell you the truth."
After hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu could only nod in agreement. After all, she didn't have much experience with love and tended to be straightforward and casual, which made it easy for her to get along with guys.
However, even though she often ended up being friends with men like a brother, she was quite sensitive about her own feelings, just reluctant to show this side in front of Lin Jie.
Moreover, when it comes to love, men and women indeed think differently. Women tend to be more emotional and sometimes overthink, while men are generally more rational and might be slow to respond to the situation at hand.
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei, seeing Qin Xiaoxu in distress, offered her a good deal of advice.
After listening to them, Qin Xiaoxu decided that it was no use worrying and overthinking; she had to directly ask Lin Jie what was going on.
While they were chatting, a young woman approached and said, "Xiaoxu, Vivi, why are you here so early?"
The woman's voice was filled with surprise. When Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei heard the voice, they immediately turned around to see Ye Caiwei, whom they had been waiting for a long time.
"Caiwei, you're finally here!"
Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu called out to Ye Caiwei almost simultaneously, as a gentle-looking woman dressed in a long skirt approached them.
Ye Caiwei sat down and began, "It's been a long time, and her gaze settled on Lin Yi, as it was quite unexpected to see him sitting there."
Upon noticing, Han Xuewei quickly said, "Caiwei, this is my husband, Lin Yi, and Lin Yi, this is my university roommate I told you about, Ye Caiwei."
Hearing this, Lin Yi politely nodded his head and greeted Ye Caiwei, who responded in kind.
Aside from exchanging greetings, they didn't have much communication, after all, they weren't acquainted with each other.
Moreover, Ye Caiwei had come to meet with Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu.
As soon as Qin Xiaoxu saw Ye Caiwei, he said, "Caiwei, where have you been all these three years? We haven't heard from you, and we were very worried."
Hearing this, Ye Caiwei showed an expression of helplessness, and seeing her like that, Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu both felt that something was off.
Without speaking, Ye Caiwei simply sat there blankly. Seeing her like this, Han Xuewei immediately grew anxious and said, "Caiwei, have you run into some trouble? You must tell us if you have problems. We can both help you, and if it's a matter of money, we can take on the burden for you. Don't be afraid!"
Han Xuewei spoke very tenderly, and only then did Ye Caiwei open up her heart. Her eyes grew moist as she looked at Han Xuewei and the other person.
She felt grateful at the moment. During college, Han Xuewei had often taken care of her, and now Han Xuewei was still the first person to show concern for her.
"Thank you both, you two are really kind," Ye Caiwei said with a touch of grievance and then continued, "Actually, this matter definitely has something to do with money, but it's not that serious."
As Ye Caiwei spoke, Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewen listened intently, but Ye Caiwei felt somewhat embarrassed and glanced towards Lin Yi. She did not want to reveal her current situation to anyone other than them.
Han Xuewei understood instantly and addressed Lin Yi directly, "Honey, I think you should go out for a while, and I'll call you after we're done talking, okay?"
As Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Yi looked at them and seemed to feel it was indeed inappropriate for him to stay. He nodded and stood up.
"Alright, I'll go around other places first. Just give me a call when you're done."
Lin Yi said, not wanting to listen to their gossip, and considering that Ye Caiwei's behavior suggested she had something she didn't want him to know.
Seeing no need to say more, he greeted them and left.
With Lin Yi gone, Ye Caiwei could no longer hold herself together. She covered her face, and tears began to slide down. Actually, she had felt very repressed all day, but only now, seeing Han Xuewei and the others, could she let it out.
Seeing her like this, Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu immediately passed her tissues and patted her back. "What happened? Why are you suddenly crying?"
As Qin Xiaoxu spoke, Han Xuewei also said, "You have to tell us what's going on. Don't keep everything bottled up inside. If something's wrong, you should have spoken to us earlier, you silly girl."
As Han Xuewei spoke, seeing how distressed Ye Caiwei was made them both feel uneasy.
Ye Caiwei sniffled for a while, took the tissues, and dried her tears, her emotions gradually calming down.
Looking at Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu, she couldn't help but say, "I'm sorry, I deleted your phone numbers before. The truth is I really didn't know what to say, I didn't know what to do." Continue reading at empire

chapters.title: Chapter 197 Looking for a Job
chapters.content:
Seeing Ye Caiwei like this, Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu immediately comforted her, smoothing over her emotions so she could calm down.
Soon, Ye Caiwei's condition had improved a lot. Han Xuewei handed her a cup of hot coffee and said, "You should drink something first, to fill your stomach."
As Han Xuewei spoke, her gentleness seemed to touch Ye Caiwei even more. Ye Caiwei's eyes turned red, but she still said, "Actually, when I dropped out of school, it was because my father...my father had... At that time, I didn't want it like this either; it was all because I got pregnant before marriage. My father felt it was a shame, and he got so angry that he had a stroke on the spot!"
"When we went to the hospital, I was terrified, but luckily he was treated in time, so my father's life was saved. However, because of the stroke, his legs became paralyzed. Then, that so-called boyfriend of mine...after he got me into this situation, he just abandoned me. He wouldn't return my calls or messages on WeChat, it was as if he had disappeared."
"I had no choice, my mother told me that I couldn't give birth to the child because it would be a burden to me, and also because the child wouldn't have a father, so I had no choice but to have an abortion. Although I was reluctant at that time, I... I wasn't capable, I just couldn't afford to raise a child!"
While saying this, Ye Caiwei sobbed.
"To have given birth would have been irresponsible, but I truly felt so ridiculous," Ye Caiwei said, unable to hold back her tears again. She felt guilty, especially towards the child.
Hearing her words, Qin Xiaoxu's expression instantly turned to one of fury; he was so angry he was nearly ready to hit someone. "That's outrageous; what kind of man is that? Tell me who he is now, and I'll take you to teach him a lesson today."
At the mention of that guy, Ye Caiwei felt nothing but hatred because almost all the hardship she experienced stemmed from him. Now, all she felt towards him was hate.
At this moment, Han Xuewei was also grinding her teeth in anger, her face rarely showing such a fierce expression. She said coldly, "Yes, that man is simply no good. Tell us who he is, and I'll take you, along with Xiaoxu and my husband, to deal with him!"
As Han Xuewei spoke, hearing them be so loyal, Ye Caiwei couldn't help but smile. She sighed and said, "It's already been a long time, and now I just want to live for myself. After my father became paralyzed, there has been no one who could sustain our family. Moreover, a lot of money was spent on my father's medical treatment, and the subsequent rehabilitation has drained all our savings..."
At this point, Ye Caiwei was left only with sighs. Read exclusive chapters at empire
"Previously, our family relied solely on my father's earnings. Now that he probably won't be able to work, I obviously can't continue my studies, so I could only look for work in our area."
"But since I didn't get a university degree, I can only find jobs that pay three to four thousand. You know, that salary simply can't support the family; it's really hard for us now, but I don't want to give up.
I've come back to Xiangcheng this time to look for a job with a slightly higher salary. I'm not afraid of hard work; I want to take my father to a better hospital. He ended up like this all because of me; I really feel so useless.
Although I don't have a degree, my hometown is in the countryside where the wages are definitely lower than here, and right now, all I want is to find a job with a bit higher salary."
Ye Caiwei said, with her requests actually very simple. Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu immediately spoke up, "You silly girl, why be so naive? If you need money, you could have just told us. No matter what, we could lend you some. Why do you have to make life so tough for yourself? You don't need to rush to pay us back.
You should have told us when your father got sick!"
Han Xuewei, hearing this, also felt a certain exasperation and said, "You should have talked to us. We thought you went back to get married to that man; we had no idea such a huge change had occurred in your family. You silly girl, why didn't you say anything?"
Han Xuewei continued, actually feeling quite sympathetic for Ye Caiwei. Caiwei, moved by her words, still replied, "I didn't know what to do at the time. I thought I was going to marry him, but he just disappeared on me. I had no choice but to listen to my parents and terminate the pregnancy.
Then my dad got sick, and without the means to continue my studies or pay tuition, and with my dad needing someone to care for him..."
Hearing all this, Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei both took a moment to relax their judgment, no longer blaming her, especially considering that Ye Caiwei was not even twenty years old at the time.
A sudden family crisis like this, and being pregnant to boot, she must have been clueless about what to do.
Plus, she was someone with an incredibly strong sense of pride, making it truly difficult for her to ask for a loan.
Han Xuewei didn't blame her further and, patting her shoulder, said, "So, what is your plan now? Good positions here certainly require higher education, and with only a high school diploma, finding a job won't be easy."
"However, I think you could try getting a diploma online and get back to studying. That way, finding a job wouldn't be an issue."
"Really? What I want most now is to cure my dad's illness. I hope he can at least take care of himself. Otherwise, it's too exhausting for my mom. I'm not very demanding when it comes to work; I'm willing to do tough jobs. I just hope the salary is higher, at least ten thousand, otherwise the expenses at home, along with my dad's hospital bills, are just too much to handle."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei both felt troubled; after all, although Xiangcheng is a big city, even tough jobs are unlikely to pay ten thousand.
And what Ye Caiwei needs isn't just ten thousand; her expenses would far exceed that amount.
Considering this, Qin Xiaoxu couldn't help but say, "How about working at my dad's company? I'll see if his company or one of his friends needs someone. My dad arranged a job for me before, but I didn't take it.
But since it's an office job, the treatment is bound to be better, and you wouldn't have to work so hard." Qin Xiaoxu said this, but she didn't know the specifics about the salary since she never paid much attention to her own wages.
Her father's allowance for her each month was higher than her salary, but she still had to recommend something for Ye Caiwei, for seeing her in such a state was truly worrying.
Moreover, Qin Xiaoxu was also looking for a job for herself, as she didn't want to only live off her parents' money, nor did she want to rely solely on Lin Jie's money; she wanted to earn her own.
Her nature was that of a strong woman, so she definitely couldn't stay unemployed. It wouldn't do to be seen as a jobless loafer, how awful that would be.

chapters.title: Chapter 198 Affection
chapters.content:
Ye Caiwei listened to these words and nodded gratefully as she said, "That's the only option for now, thank you, Xiaoxu."
"Stop crying, silly girl, the help we can offer you isn't all that much. If you're out of money, you can borrow from us. It's not too late to pay us back once you have the cash."
"We're all good sisters here, don't do this again next time."
Upon hearing this, Ye Caiwei nodded, and Han Xuewei couldn't help but ask, "Where are you staying now?"
"I'm currently staying at a small inn, so I hope I can quickly find a job, preferably one that provides dormitory accommodations."
When Qin Xiaoxu heard this, she nearly exploded, "What are you saying? Why are you living in a small inn? You should have called us when you first arrived here. I'm renting a place outside, just come live with me, there's no need for you to stay at that inn. Don't go back tonight, pack your things and come over to my place."
As Qin Xiaoxu said this, she almost let slip her thoughts about how dirty those small inns were, but she held back for fear of hurting Ye Caiwei's pride, so she said nothing.
After all, it was quite normal for Ye Caiwei to stay in a small inn since she was alone in Xiangcheng and didn't have much money.
Hearing this, Ye Caiwei asked, "Xiaoxu, are you living alone right now?"
Ye Caiwei was also afraid that if Qin Xiaoxu had a boyfriend, it wouldn't be right for her to intrude.
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu replied, "Yes, you must have heard from a friend that I have a boyfriend. Don't worry. We're not living together yet, so you can stay at my place."
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu blushed and awkwardly said, "Won't it be inconvenient? If I come to stay at your place, I'm afraid there might be some..."
Ye Caiwei stammered, looking uneasy.
"Don't worry, it's fine."
"Yeah, you should go live with Qin Xiaoxu. If you stay alone at the inn, we'll still be worried," Han Xuewei interjected.
"Alright then." Ye Caiwei no longer said anything and agreed.
Seeing this, Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei finally breathed a sigh of relief, and at that moment, Su Zina arrived. Experience tales at empire
Su Zina approached and quickly walked up to Qin Xiaoxu and Ye Caiwei.
Qin Xiaoxu was somewhat surprised to see Su Zina.
During the previous class reunion, she had deliberately avoided Su Zina because during their last encounter, Su Zina seemed to have a crush on Lin Jie.
Therefore, Qin Xiaoxu naturally became a bit wary, but as it turned out, her concerns were unnecessary.
Because at this moment, when Su Zina saw Qin Xiaoxu, she did not act as Qin Xiaoxu had expected. Instead, she sat close to Qin Xiaoxu and said, "I heard that you are with Lin Jie?"
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu replied, "Yeah, oh, you don't need to be so nervous, I didn't have anything serious going on with him. At the time, I just thought he was quite handsome and I had a bit of a crush, but who wouldn't like a handsome guy! Plus, they told me he had a girlfriend then, so I didn't pursue him further!"
"How come I never knew about this?" Han Xuewei widened her eyes and immediately showed a gossipy expression upon hearing this.
Su Zina burst into laughter upon hearing this, "I haven't really said much about that kind of thing, but now that you two are together, I'll definitely wish you well. Don't overthink it!"
Su Zina was quite magnanimous, and Qin Xiaoxu nodded in response, thanking her.
It was then that she came back to her senses, realizing she was overthinking the situation.
"There's no need for thanks. We've known each other for so long. By the way, Caiwei, after starting college, you just vanished on me. Where did you actually go?"
Caught off guard by the sudden turn of the conversation towards her, Ye Caiwei spoke up with a touch of embarrassment, "My dad fell ill at the time, quite seriously, so I had to go home and take care of him, that's why I didn't continue with my studies..."
"So that was it. What are you planning to do now?"
Su Zina too sighed helplessly. She didn't dare to pry too much into other people's affairs.
"I'm planning to look for a job first."
Upon hearing this, Su Zina simply nodded, not saying much more since many students fresh out of graduation were looking for jobs, and finding a job was a hassle in itself. There wasn't much of a social network she could offer to help Ye Caiwei.
So she chose not to speak, and just as everyone was quieting down, another roommate came out.
"Oh, I got held up in traffic, I'm late." As she spoke, she took off her things and placed her bag on the table before sitting across from them, "I really didn't expect you all to come so early, but I also called a few classmates and good sisters to come along, you guys won't mind, right?"
This revelation left everyone a bit surprised.
Ye Caiwei was even more taken aback. She had thought the gathering was simply a meet-up with a few friends from the dorm, since they got along well, but she hadn't expected other people to be invited as well.
At this news, everyone fell silent, apparently many weren't pleased with their time being encroached upon by others.
Seeing the silence, the roommate then spoke up with an awkward tone, "I actually thought of Caiwei, since you've been away for such a long time and missed the previous gatherings. Having more people makes it livelier. That's why I invited a few other friends, and they're all nice people!"
Feeling awkward, the roommate continued, and Han Xuewei, sensing the tension, stepped in to smooth things over, "It's okay. Later we can get together for a meal regardless of the number of people. Gathering is always good."
At these words, the roommate finally sighed in relief, "Thank you, Vivi!"
Then she turned to Ye Caiwei and said, "Caiwei, I was quite clueless when you dropped out. What exactly happened to you?"
Ye Caiwei had no choice but to explain her situation again briefly, and the roommate understood.
After hearing this, she nodded sympathetically, unable to offer any solution, and stayed silent.
Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu endeavored to lighten the mood. They all had a particularly close relationship, and reminiscing about their college days brought up happy memories, enlivening the atmosphere once again.
Just then, Qin Xiaoxu looked up to see five or six female classmates enter through the main door. They were all quite close, but many were no longer familiar to Qin Xiaoxu.
Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu both looked displeased at the moment. Han Xuewei, visibly surprised, turned following Qin Xiaoxu's gaze, and to her shock, saw that Gu Li was also there.
Why would Gu Li be here?
Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei exchanged a look of surprise,

chapters.title: Chapter 199 Envy
chapters.content:
The girls approached them and some of the more outgoing ones immediately said, "Oh my gosh, how did you guys get here so early? We just got stuck in traffic over there, and we also had to gather, so we were a bit late."
"Ah, sorry, sorry, you must have been waiting for a long time."
As the women students spoke, they took their seats.
All they could say was it was no problem, but at that moment, Su Zina also noticed the change in their expressions and looked at that roommate.
The roommate was also feeling very awkward since Ye Caiwei had told them it was just a casual gathering, but she had taken it upon herself to invite other students.
The other students, unaware, had also invited more classmates, and as a result, Gu Li also showed up.
In front of them, with everyone suddenly falling silent, Gu Li felt a bit awkward and could only speak up, "Sorry, Ah Lan just told me she was coming and asked me to come along, so that's why I'm here."
As Gu Li spoke, her eyes revealed indifference. She believed that choosing to come should be considered giving face to others, so she casually took a seat.
However, Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei were somewhat displeased; they really didn't want to gather with Gu Li.
Actually, Gu Li had a purpose for coming this time; she had heard that Han Xuewei would be there, which was why she had come.
After all, by coming, they couldn't reject her, and she could also use this opportunity to gather some information.
What was supposed to be a gathering of just a few roommates had now turned into an assembly of more than a dozen people, which made everyone feel somewhat awkward.
Since some of the attendees were not well-acquainted, Qin Xiaoxu had no choice but to say, "Has everyone not eaten yet? Why don't we find a place to grab some food, so we can eat and chat at the same time!"
As Qin Xiaoxu spoke, everyone seemed to agree and nodded their heads in approval.
But at this time, Gu Li looked directly at Han Xuewei and made a suggestion, "Why don't we go to the restaurant owned by Han Xuewei's family? Isn't there a hotel they own near Wenqu Building? The food there is really delicious!"
Hearing this, the crowd was a bit surprised and turned to look back.
"Right, Vivi, doesn't your family own a hotel near Wenqu Building? The restaurant downstairs must be really good, right?"
"We haven't been there before, is it okay if we go to your place?"
"Yeah, I really want to see for myself how good your dad's cooking is."
Many students were flattering Han Xuewei, and Han Xuewei didn't mind, so she nodded her head.
However, at this point, one of the female students spoke up, "How about we go to the hotel owned by Vivi's in-laws? The food was really good at the last class reunion, and I think you all haven't tasted it yet."
"You're talking about Jinguo Hotel, right?" Find adventures on empire
"Jinguo Hotel is indeed very good; their steak is particularly amazing."
A few more female students chimed in. Frankly, the restaurant in Wenqu Building was fairly ordinary, but having the chance to go to Jinguo Hotel would naturally be more luxurious.
Hearing this, Gu Li suddenly showed a look of astonishment. She had heard of Jinguo Hotel, one of the top hotels in Xiangcheng, but the idea that it belonged to Han Xuewei's husband seemed improbable, it must just be an agency relationship.
With this thought, Gu Li's expression turned to one of surprise, and her brows furrowed tighter. If it was just a franchise, that wouldn't be a big deal.
But if the hotel truly belonged to Han Xuewei's husband personally, that would be incredible. How much money would that bring in a year?
As these thoughts crossed her mind, she revealed a skeptical expression. Han Xuewei, hearing these words, didn't react much and simply stated calmly, "Actually, I don't have any objections, after all, I've been to both. You all can consider which one to go to. Jinguo Hotel is fine too, I'll have my husband take us there."
"The restaurants in my father's hotel are actually quite good as well. There's a wide range of dishes, and everyone can pick what they like at reasonable prices."
Han Xuewei spoke with easy generosity, but at that moment, Ye Caiwei showed an embarrassed expression as she quietly sent a message to Qin Xiaoxu and the others with her phone.
"I might need to borrow money from you later. With so many classmates suddenly joining, what was supposed to be a small gathering is getting too big. Going to a hotel would definitely cost a lot, and I might not even have enough money to pay the bill."
At this point, Ye Caiwei looked helpless. Han Xuewei glanced at Qin Xiaoxu and then at Ye Caiwei, and directly replied, "Don't worry, I'll cover the bill this time. Last time we had a gathering, we could waive the bill at my husband's hotel. Rest assured, it's no trouble."
Qin Xiaoxu also replied, "Don't worry about it; we're here for you."
Seeing their messages, Ye Caiwei showed a grateful expression. These two friends were really too good to her.
Everyone was discussing where to go for the meal. Aside from Gu Li's idea to eat at Han Xuewei's family's restaurant, many wanted to go to the Jinguo Hotel.
After all, Jinguo Hotel was so luxurious, and someone was offering to pay, which ensured an excellent experience. So if they could join the feast, they wanted to make it a good one.
Ultimately, everyone decided to go to Jinguo Hotel, but it was still quite far from their location, so they all agreed to take cars there.
Gu Li had a car, so she took a few classmates with her, while Han Xuewei arranged for Lin Yi to come pick them up.
When Lin Yi drove over, no one showed surprise since they had seen his car before. However, Gu Li was shocked when she saw Lin Yi's Mercedes.
Her own car was worth nearly a million, and she thought it was already very luxurious.
But Lin Yi's car was a Mercedes-Benz, worth several millions.
Gu Li had thought that coming here would give her a lot of prestige, but Han Xuewei had already outdone her from the start.
The female classmates were astonished to see Lin Yi's car, and they were overwhelmed by its interior when they got inside.
"Oh my god, this is the first time I'm riding in such a luxurious car. Vivi, your husband is so impressive," one remarked.
"Yes, your husband is really amazing. To think he drives such a luxurious car. We're truly honored," another added.
As they spoke, Lin Yi simply smiled lightly and continued driving calmly in front.
At that moment, Ye Caiwei seemed a bit embarrassed, sitting to the side without speaking. Qin Xiaoxu merely commented nonchalantly, "You all don't know? This car was part of Vivi's dowry."

chapters.title: Chapter 200 Hotel Owner
chapters.content:
Gu Li was listening to them chatting and laughing when she saw that luxurious car, but she didn't expect that the luxurious car was merely Han Xuewei's dowry. So it seemed that Lin Yi was just someone with superficial skills.
Since the car wasn't his, the hotel was even less likely to be his, at most he could just be a franchisee.
At this time, her expression became much more indifferent, yet many female classmates were still shocked, as Han Xuewei was usually very low-key and her personal wealth had not been exposed.
So many classmates thought she was from a moderately well-off family, with parents that just ran an ordinary restaurant.
When many classmates saw the luxurious car, they couldn't help but exclaim, "Oh my god, Vivi, your family is so rich. Yeah, Vivi, you were so low-key before, I thought you were just a commoner like us,"
As the classmates spoke, Han Xue'er felt a bit embarrassed and spoke out, "Actually, it's nothing special, this car is quite expensive for us too."
Han Xuewei spoke, actually not liking the feeling of being flattered, and whether her family was rich or not wasn't something she should care too much about; she needed to do what's right, and in the future, she hoped to make money on her own merits.
Seeing Han Xuewei's humility, people did not plan to say much more, so they did not dwell on this topic any longer.
The car drove slowly forward, originally Qin Xiaoxu was lively inside the car, but she too stopped talking, it was supposed to be just a small gathering of a few people, it was those people's fault for insisting on bringing so many along, now it was just awkward.
It would have been better for the two of them to meet up with Ye Caiwei instead, given that Ye Caiwei was currently facing frustrating matters and was in no mood for cheerful chatter with so many people.
But now that everyone was gathered together, she couldn't very well show her displeasure and had to fake a smile.
Lin Yi, driving the car, seemed to sense something was amiss among the others. Although he didn't know what had happened, he saw that Han Xuewei was not happy. Lin Yi made a mental note and continued driving them to Jinguo Hotel. Han Xuewei got out of the car with them and walked to the hotel.
Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei's retreating figure with concern and took out his phone to send her a message.
"Wife, what was wrong just now? I noticed you weren't very happy at the gathering today."
At the elevator entrance, Han Xuewei received Lin Yi's message and typed a line on her phone.
"Husband, I'll talk to you later."
"If you're unhappy about something you must tell your husband. I'm always here for you!"
By then they had reached the elevator interior, and the female classmates, quite enthusiastic, spoke up, "Vivi, we just saw your husband, he's really handsome."
"He also studied at our Xiangcheng University, I had never really noticed him before!"
"You guys don't know, Vivi's husband is very low-key, he doesn't really stand out, so it's normal that you didn't notice him."
"But he is indeed very good-looking."
"Right? Vivi, your husband is super handsome!"
All the female classmates were talking, and Han Xuewei listened to these words and smiled gently, replying, "Thank you for your compliments, but it's good that you didn't praise him in the car just now, or else he would definitely get conceited."
Upon hearing this, everyone around laughed. The place they had arranged for the gathering was a large private room. After leaving the elevator, Han Xuewei saw some familiar faces from before.
Manager of Jinguo Hotel, Song Jinhui.
When Song Jinhui saw them, he immediately offered a respectful greeting, "Mrs. Lin, this way please."
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei nodded and said.
"Manager Song, I'll be delivering some goods later, and a few classmates will come by as well. Please take care of them when they arrive."
Upon hearing this, Song Jinhui was somewhat taken aback, not expecting Han Xuewei to be so polite. He looked up and smiled, "No problem, it's all part of our job."
Seeing Han Xuewei at this moment, he couldn't help but think she was incredibly beautiful. Only an outstanding man like Lin Yi could marry such a gorgeous wife.
Her personality was great, and she was beautiful too.
After he led Han Xuewei and her companions to the private room that Lin Yi had already made reservations for, he withdrew.
Meanwhile, Gu Li and her companions arrived, and seeing their party-like attire and similar age to Han Xuewei, Song Jinhui asked, "Excuse me, are you the classmates of our Chairman's wife, Han Xuewei?"
Read the latest on empire
Caught by surprise, Gu Li was momentarily stunned, her head still in a daze, but she nodded.
Song Jinhui immediately ushered them into the private room and said, "The Chairman's wife has already instructed us, please follow me this way."
Song Jinhui courteously led them, while Gu Li's eyes were full of shock. She had just doubted the truth behind Lin Yi's ownership of a hotel, but now it seemed Lin Yi indeed owned one.
Moreover, it was not through Han Xuewei's support—after all, she understood the capital behind Jinguo Hotel.
Jinguo Hotel was one of the top hotels in Xiangcheng, generating several hundred million in annual revenue, with a market value of over ten billion. Now, her eyes were filled with amazement. Her mind was in turmoil as she followed Song Jinhui into the private room.
By this time, Han Xuewei and the others had arrived. She offered a few menus for everyone to look at and said, "Can the food come out a bit faster? I forgot to make a reservation."
As she spoke, Han Xue showed a troubled expression, and Song Jinhui immediately approached Han Xuewei, saying, "Madam, please allow me to handle this."
The waiter was visibly panicked and quickly handed the order tablet to Song Jinhui.
After taking the tablet, Song Jinhui turned to Han Xuewei and said, "Mrs. Lin, our hotel will certainly prioritize you, so don't worry. Please look at what you want, and we will deliver the dishes as quickly as possible."
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei was quite pleased and couldn't help but express her thanks.
When she said thanks, Song Jinhui was somewhat startled, while all her classmates were incredibly surprised. Indeed, the attitude of the hotel owner's wife was different.
At this moment, Han Xuewei spoke very generously, "If you want to eat something, just order it. Everyone, feel free to enjoy yourselves."
After she had finished speaking, Song Jinhui, very perceptive, approached everyone and began to bend over to eagerly recommend dishes to them, behaving much like a waiter.
However, this time he was serving the friends of the owner's wife, which was naturally a different matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 201 - Expensive Ring
chapters.content:
Seeing this scene, Gu Li revealed an astonished expression; she had just thought Lin Yi was a freeloader, but now it became clear that Lin Yi was indeed very capable.
Moreover, he was the owner of this hotel; she had underestimated Lin Yi.
After everyone had ordered their dishes, they all engaged in conversation, and many were extremely excited, naturally delighted to dine at such a fine hotel. Suddenly, a girl raised her head towards Han Xuewei and said, "Vivi, I heard before that your husband bought you jewelry worth over a hundred million. Could you show it to us?
We've never really seen such things, and today I haven't seen you wearing it."
The news about Lin Yi buying Han Xuewei luxury jewelry had spread, and many people said that the ring Han Xuewei wore was extremely expensive; everyone wanted to know if the rumor was true or not.
They didn't doubt it; they simply wanted to see it for themselves.
Hearing this, another female classmate also showed a curious look and spoke up, "Vivi, right, you didn't wear it at the last gathering either. The last time, you only wore a necklace, not the ring. Did you bring it today?"
Everyone appeared curious, but Han Xuewei wasn't there to show off her wealth; however, these classmates were flattering her, and she felt too embarrassed to speak up, "The diamond ring is a bit large and inconvenient to carry around, and it easily gets knocked against things, so I didn't bring it."
As Han Xuewei spoke, she felt awkward. She was wearing the new ring Lin Yi had bought for her that noon.
At that moment, Su Zina caught sight of the ring in Han Xuewei's hand, radiating brilliant light, and could not help but show a look of surprise as she said, "Vivi, the ring you're wearing on your hand is a limited edition Tiffany piece, isn't it?"
As a design student, Su Zina was sensitive to such accessories and immediately recognized the ring that Han Xuewei was wearing.
In fact, she had noticed it right from the start, but she hadn't asked, feeling that it wouldn't be appropriate; however, now that it had been mentioned, she spoke up.
Han Xuewei nodded in response.
"Right, I didn't wear the ring at noon. The previous ring actually wasn't very comfortable to wear, so my husband took me to buy a new one."
On hearing this, Gu Li couldn't help but show a dismissive expression; jewelry worth over a hundred million was something she had never even heard of. It must be fake.
She had tried to discreetly inquire about it from many classmates, but being too embarrassed to ask outright and since some female classmates didn't get along with her, they didn't tell her much.
She only understood some recent circumstances about Han Xuewei, piecing things together from bits and pieces of information, which wasn't very thorough.
So, the purpose of joining the gathering was to learn more about Han Xuewei. She had been skeptical, so she had secretly checked on Heavenly Eye, only to find out that the chairman of Jinguo Hotel was indeed Lin Yi.
Furthermore, Lin Yi was the sole chairman of Jinguo Hotel, which meant all the shares were owned by him alone.
This alone was enough to prove Lin Yi's strength.
Her expression turned awkward at this moment; after all, even one Jinguo Hotel could surpass her entire family's enterprises.
Now hearing her classmates discussing Lin Yi buying jewelry worth over a hundred million for Han Xuewei, she didn't believe it.
Fortunately, Han Xuewei didn't produce the jewelry, so at this moment, her expression became displeased, and her heart couldn't bear it anymore, fuming with jealousy.
After all, it was bad enough that Han Xuewei was pretty, but even her husband was so amazing—how could this not make people envious?
Gu Li felt agitated at this point, but looking at Han Xuewei, she was inwardly determined to find an exceedingly impressive man in the future, one who could surpass Han Xuewei. Her husband would have to be a billionaire.
Only then could she obtain the glory she desired. At this time, Su Zina leaned in close to Han Xuewei, examining the diamond ring on her hand. She was an expert on diamond rings and directly said, "Vivi, I think the diamond ring on your hand is almost flawless, which is rare." Enjoy new adventures from empire
"Moreover, look at its purity, it's very high quality. In terms of diamond rings, it's considered extremely pure, and it should be 1.2 carats. Look, just lift your hand in the light."
At her words, Han Xuewei lifted her hand, and the diamond ring in the light shone even brighter.
Su Zina then smiled and said, "A ring of this caliber couldn't be bought for anything less than several million."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei just smiled. She didn't want to flaunt her wealth, so she quickly withdrew her hand.
"I don't know much about diamond rings, but what you said sounds about right," said Han Xuewei, now feeling somewhat embarrassed. She didn't want to show off at the gathering, nor did she want to discuss just how much capital she had in front of others.
After all, excessive flattery wasn't good for her.
Moreover, if it were just Qin Xiaoxu and Ye Caiwei, she wouldn't mind, but now there were so many others present, and also Gu Li was there.
What she feared most were rumors. The jealousy of some girls could be terrifying; they would deliberately spread false gossip and slander, painting her as pretentious.
Han Xuewei, though confident that truth fears no slander, couldn't help but be concerned about attracting unwanted attention.
She didn't want to bring these troubles upon herself.
Seeing Han Xuewei's reaction, Qin Xiaoxu couldn't help but come over, holding a glass of wine, and laughingly changed the subject with everyone.
Su Zina also felt that Han Xuewei didn't want to talk about it, so she didn't continue, and the group moved on to other conversations.
At this time, Gu Li looked at Han Xuewei with an uncomfortable expression.
Though she wanted to chat with others, many didn't pay her much mind, finding her unpleasant to deal with.
The gathering today was actually one she had managed to attend by thickening her skin and pleading with a female classmate; in fact, no one had particularly invited her, so at this point, she could only stand aside, listening to the others' discussions.

chapters.title: Chapter 202 - The Party Ends
chapters.content:
"You all know already, right? I told you, Vivi's husband is loaded. They once had a gathering here, and she pulled out a black Golden Dragon card – you can't have a card like that without having at least a hundred million in cash!"
"Yeah, I think her net worth is now in the tens of billions, a real billionaire."
"Exactly, I heard about it too. I was there at that gathering, and that card seriously dazzled all of us."
"There's also that, like, Wenqu Building's mall, where the manager came to look for her husband, asking him to attend a board meeting!"
"Right, right, right, her husband is the owner of that mall, because where I sat, I overheard everything."
"Yeah, but he seemed to have turned it down, mentioned something about going home to take care of the kid and not attending."
"Oh my God, do you remember when we ran into Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun at that party? They were so embarrassed." Discover stories with empire
Once Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun were mentioned, everyone became agitated and the discussion took off.
"Yeah, Li Lanxue and Shen Wenjun are in a bad spot now, having offended Lin Yi. Surely, they've lost a lot of business deals, especially since Jinguo Hotel is one of the top clients in our city center."
"If they've offended him, naturally, they won't need to supply products anymore. Anyway, many big companies are clamoring to supply goods to Jinguo Hotel!"
"Yes, yes, it looks like they're finished now. I'm so envious of Han Xuewei. Her husband is the chairman in so many places, and his net worth must be in the tens of billions now."
"I wonder how many shares of the hotel her husband holds?"
At this point, one of the girls couldn't help but laugh, "Are you kidding me? Jinguo Hotel only has one boss, and there's no partner, which means Han Xuewei's husband is the sole director!"
"So this hotel is entirely under her husband's control? My goodness, he must have at least several billion to his name, not to mention other businesses. Jeez, it's absolutely mind-blowing!"
"If I had such a husband, I would definitely pray and offer incense every single day."
"Oh, you can stop dreaming now. First, you'd need to have Han Xuewei's beautiful face. If you were even half as pretty, you might be able to climb the social ladder."
"What are you talking about? Han Xuewei comes from a well-off family, okay?! Plus, she has such great grades and is so pretty – being with Lin Yi is totally within her league!"
As her classmates chatted away, Gu Li remained silent the whole time, but after hearing all these remarks, she was utterly stunned.
She hadn't expected Han Xuewei's husband to be so impressive. She had thought her family's situation was quite good, comparable to Han Xuewei's.
But it turned out that the man Han Xuewei married was not a freeloader, but a very successful individual.
As everyone gossiped and laughed, Gu Li's expression turned sour. She couldn't believe Han Xuewei had married such a wealthy man, and she felt more and more jealous, looking down on Han Xue with disdain.
The more she thought about it, the more she resented Han Xuewei. Why couldn't she have all the things she wanted?
And yet Han Xuewei seemed to get everything so easily?
At this moment, Gu Li was the only one not looking happy, while many people were quite delighted, naturally overjoyed to be able to spend time in such a luxurious hotel.
Meanwhile, Han Xuewei was chatting with Qin Xiaoxu and others, not making the effort to greet everyone. She had said a few words at the start of the meeting, but afterwards, she simply kept to chatting with Qin Xiaoxu and Ye Caiwei.
When Ye Caiwei tasted the food at the high-level hotel, she too was astonished. Seeing how good Han Xuewei's living conditions were now, she felt a pang of disparity in her heart.
But she wasn't unhappy; on the contrary, she was very happy for Han Xuewei. It was just that she felt annoyed about her own circumstances.
However, neither Han Xuewei nor Qin Xiaoxu would look down on her. They comforted her all along the way.
Qin Xiaoxu was always good at lifting people's spirits, so Ye Caiwei didn't dwell on that matter for too long.
After eating, the time was just about right. They did not linger and each went their own way after dinner.
Gu Li, upon learning about Han Xuewei's current situation, was naturally very upset. Initially, some female classmates planned to catch a ride with her, but she was not in the mood to take them back with her.
After all, if she took them, the topic of their conversation would inevitably revolve around Han Xuewei alone. Thinking about this made her heart flare up with jealousy.
She did not take those female classmates, simply stating that her way home wasn't convenient, and thus she drove off.
Sitting in her car, she was still consumed with jealousy. Her appearance wasn't as good as Han Xuewei's, and she couldn't become the school beauty, but now Han Xuewei had even married such a good husband, who could outshine her by leagues.
A few classmates did not have cars, which put them in an embarrassing situation.
Han Xuewei looked at them and then offered that her husband would come to pick them up and take them home.
Many female classmates couldn't get a taxi at that hour and were extremely grateful to Han Xuewei. They thanked her profusely, and soon Lin Yi arrived in his car and took those female classmates back to their homes.
After that, he also drove Qin Xiaoxu and Ye Caiwei home, helping Ye Caiwei move her luggage to Qin Xiaoxu's place.
Only after everything was settled did Lin Yi take Han Xuewei home. The whole trip was quite tiring. Han Xuewei looked at Lin Yi and couldn't help saying, "Husband, you've really worked hard."
Feeling a bit fatigued, Han Xuewei spoke, and for the first time, Lin Yi saw such an expression on her face. He said, "I haven't asked you just now, wife, did you encounter something unpleasant today?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei replied, "Yes, because there were too many people at today's gathering. It was supposed to be just a small meet-up with a few dorm mates, but in the end, so many people showed up."
Han Xuewei had never been fond of attending gatherings. Moreover, for her, such a large group meant having to cater to many people's emotions. And many loved to center their conversation around her, which was an uncomfortable feeling.
If she could just meet with Qin Xiaoxu and Ye Caiwei, they could share more personal things. But now that it was over, she saw no need to make a fuss.
Hearing this, Lin Yi reached out and gently touched Han Xuewei's head, saying, "Wife, don't be angry. It doesn't matter. After all, since everyone came, they ate and left, and there's hardly any contact after that. Don't be unhappy!"
As Lin Yi spoke, his voice was very tender, and Han Xuewei's mood eased.
Then Lin Yi opened his palm, revealing a black ring box that looked very exquisite. Han Xuewei was somewhat surprised as she looked at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi then said, "Wife, the ring is ready."
As he spoke, Lin Yi opened the ring box. The ring sparkled with brilliant purity, high-grade to the utmost and most luxurious, from Diamond Palace itself. At that moment, the ring shone dazzlingly, truly breathtakingly beautiful.

chapters.title: Chapter 203 Going Home to Take Care of the Baby
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei looked at the ring in surprise. She was already wearing an identical one, except the diamond wasn't as big, and it wasn't as luxurious-looking as that ring.
But she was already very satisfied. When they went to the store before, Lin Yi had said this was just a temporary one for her to wear and that the ring they had actually designed would arrive later.
She had intended to refuse because the one she was wearing was already very nice, but Lin Yi still thought he should buy the best for her.
So, she didn't say anything more, not expecting the ring to arrive so quickly.
Explore more stories at empire
At that time, their car reached a crossroads, a red light flashing ahead, a full sixty seconds. Lin Yi took off the ring and opened his mouth to speak, "Wife, let me help you put it on."
As he spoke, Lin Yi skillfully took Han Xuewei's hand, removed the old ring, and slipped the new one on her finger.
Han Xuewei's hand was as white as snow. With the glittering ring on, it looked stunningly bright. Lin Yi, seeing this, couldn't help but smile, leaning down to kiss the back of Han Xuewei's hand.
"Wife, your hand is so pretty, and it looks even better with the ring on."
As Lin Yi spoke, both his hands grasped Han Xuewei's, gently stroking them. Seeing Lin Yi's actions, Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh, playfully hitting his hand. She said, "Wearing the ring isn't the goal here, is it? You just want an excuse to touch!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi broke into laughter.
"A wife is meant to be touched."
As he said this, Han Xuewei blushed instantly, slapping his shoulder and saying, "Stop fooling around and drive. It's green now."
Hearing this, Lin Yi reluctantly withdrew his hand, placed it on the steering wheel, and started driving.
She paid great attention to the details and could sense Han Xuewei's subtle changes in mood, and couldn't help but say, "Wife, I noticed you seemed a bit off at the gathering today. Did something happen?"
Although he had calmed Han Xuewei down by now, he could still feel that her mood wasn't great today.
Han Xuewei was usually very gentle, rarely showing her petulant side.
Moved by Lin Yi's words, Han Xuewei didn't expect that he had been paying such close attention to every little thing about her. She responded, "Husband, focus on driving for now. I'll tell you about it when we get home; I'm going to take a nap first."
After saying this, Han Xuewei reclined her seat and lay down to rest for a while.
Lin Yi didn't say anything more, concentrating on driving. He slowed the car down, hoping Han Xuewei would have a more peaceful sleep.
He didn't want Han Xuewei to be unhappy; as a husband, he hoped his wife would be cheerful every day.
They didn't get home late, it was just half-past eight. Lin Yi glanced at his watch, then turned to Han Xuewei and said, "Luckily we got back early today, so we still have time to play with the babies."
At eight thirty, the babies were still awake. By nine o'clock they would need another feeding, which is why Lin Yi said this.
Han Xuewei actually hoped that after the babies finished their milk, they wouldn't need more at night, because it's really tough when they start crying in the middle of the night.
Moreover, Han Xuewei had recently decided to wean the babies, so she no longer breastfed them and only prepared formula instead. However, the babies would still sometimes cry and fuss.
Therefore, she could only breastfeed them, especially at night. If she could feed them enough to keep them asleep until dawn, that would be perfect.
Today, Mengmeng had fallen asleep early. Looking at her adorable face, Han Xuewei curved her lips into a smile and walked over.
As the babies got older, she would need to prepare them some supplementary foods; they couldn't live on formula alone forever.
At this moment, gazing at the babies, Han Xuewei couldn't help but sigh. Children really did grow incredibly fast. When she first became a mother, she had been utterly clueless about how to take care of them and had to read a lot of childcare material every day before figuring out what to do.
Otherwise, she would have been completely lost. According to scientific feeding practices, breastfeeding exclusively until six months was the standard, and that's what Han Xuewei thought as well.
Doing so benefited the babies' physical development, but her breast milk wasn't enough for the three of them. Therefore, she had no choice but to supplement by mixing it with something else—formula.
This approach worked quite well. The babies were not overly attached to breast milk, so sometimes when she wasn't home, Mother Lin could manage with formula instead.
That was quite convenient. Lin Yi and Han Xuewei had now entered the babies' room. Mengmeng had already settled down for the night, while Da Bao and Er Bao were still playing nearby.
Seeing them, Han Xuewei immediately went over to pick up Da Bao, while Lin Yi lifted Er Bao.
These days they had been either studying or attending gatherings, with very tight schedules, leaving even less opportunity for this.
Mother Lin walked in, saw the two of them, and laughed, "These three little ones started throwing tantrums since yesterday. They wouldn't go to sleep without seeing you. I had just managed to coax Mengmeng to sleep after a long while, and these two rascals stubbornly refused to sleep, just waiting for you to come home."
Hearing this, for fear that Mother Lin would blame Han Xuewei for talking too much, and knowing that Han Xuewei was actually quite sensible, Lin Yi quickly said, "Mom, I understand."
Han Xuewei also nodded, "Mom, don't worry, we'll pay attention to that."
Upon hearing this, Mother Lin said, "It's not that I'm blaming you, I just really hope that you could spend more time with the kids."
Mother Lin didn't add anything else; she just hoped that the little ones could go to bed early.
After all, it's exhausting for both Lin Yi and Han Xuewei if the little kids don't want to sleep early after their day. After saying this, Mother Lin, who had just been run ragged by Mengmeng for a long while, was tired and went back to her room to rest.
After Lin Yi and Han Xuewei had settled Da Bao, it was Er Bao's turn, who was now eagerly staring at them with wide eyes.
Han Xuewei then said, "Why don't you go take a shower first?"
After she spoke, Han Xuewei took Er Bao from him, but Lin Yi shook his head and replied, "I'll take care of him. You go shower first."
Seeing Lin Yi so insistent, Han Xuewei didn't say more, nodded, and left the room.
Lin Yi now, holding Er Bao, began to coax him with soft murmurs. Er Bao was still gazing with his round, wide eyes, occasionally stretching out his little chubby hands to touch Lin Yi's face.

chapters.title: Chapter 204 Coaxing Er Bao
chapters.content:
At this moment, Lin Yi was rather helpless and could only pick up Er Bao to cradle in his arms, swaying back and forth as he began to sing a lullaby. Lin Yi's voice was very soft, and he only murmured in front of Er Bao.
Er Bao looked at Lin Yi and couldn't help but laugh out loud.
Seeing this, Lin Yi frowned, "You little guy, can't you give your dad some face? I've sung you a song, can you please just go to sleep?"
As Lin Yi spoke, Er Bao continued to laugh heartily as if Lin Yi were a joke, making Lin Yi feel extremely awkward. He could only stand up and gently rock Er Bao in his arms.
Er Bao looked at Lin Yi, dug in his mouth with his fingers a couple of times, then his chubby hands, covered in saliva, made their way towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi's face was suddenly covered in drool, and out of exasperation, he said, "Er Bao, you really need to rest. Your dad's old bones can't handle this roughhousing."
Enjoy exclusive chapters from empire
Hearing this, Er Bao seemed to understand and chuckled, then continued to dig in his mouth and once again reached his saliva-covered hands out towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi could only keep tilting his head back to avoid Er Bao's touch, while Er Bao just laughed and reached out.
When Lin Yi let his guard down, Er Bao's large palm slapped onto Lin Yi's face.
At this point, Lin Yi was somewhat helpless and had to put Er Bao down, reaching for a tissue to wipe his own face.
He also wiped Er Bao's hands and said, "You can't mess around like this in the future. If you spray saliva on someone else when they hold you, daddy will get angry."
As Lin Yi spoke, he made a fierce face, and Er Bao stared back at him blankly.
He had never sprayed spit on anyone else, only Lin Yi.
Unaware of this, Lin Yi believed that children should be taught reasoning from a young age and shouldn't be indulged in bad habits.
Lin Yi coddled Er Bao for a while longer, but today Er Bao was particularly energetic, and Lin Yi had no choice but to put him down on the couch. He picked up his cell phone and said, "Er Bao, give it up. Dad won't hold you anymore. If you don't sleep, just play here with your saliva, and dad will play with his phone for a while."
As Lin Yi spoke, he deliberately sat opposite Er Bao and began to play with his phone.
When Lin Yi put him down, Er Bao suddenly seemed at a loss. It was as if he realized he had done something wrong, but he also felt uncomfortable not being held. He wanted his dad to soothe him, and his mouth began to quiver as he was about to cry.
Seeing Er Bao twisting and turning his arms, with his little face contorted, Lin Yi immediately became anxious and stood up, "Er Bao, you mustn't cry. Everyone is asleep. If you cry now, that won't do!"
In a panic, Lin Yi immediately picked up Er Bao.
"Don't wake up your brother and sister."
As Lin Yi spoke, he carried Er Bao out of the room, truly afraid that Er Bao would cry and wake up the other children, which would really give him a tough time trying to soothe them all.
Lin Yi carried Er Bao out and, seeing this, Er Bao immediately stopped crying, snuggling into Lin Yi's chest. He no longer used his saliva to smear Lin Yi's face but just quietly stayed in Lin Yi's embrace.
Seeing him not causing trouble, Lin Yi also began to smile and held him close, "That's right, you need to be good. Otherwise, daddy will definitely spank you!"
As Lin Yi said this, he made a spanking gesture with his hand, and Er Bao, seeing Lin Yi do that, immediately narrowed his eyes and squealed.
It looked as though he was protesting, and Lin Yi couldn't help but laugh.
"Alright, alright, Daddy won't hit you. When has Daddy ever hit you? Just sleep well, Daddy won't hit you, okay? Be good and go to sleep."
As Lin Yi spoke, Er Bao murmured a few sounds at this time, her little face nestled into Lin Yi's chest, and she didn't fuss any longer.
Lin Yi's embrace was warm, and soon she fell asleep. Lin Yi breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that Er Bao was asleep. When he put Er Bao back on the bed, he covered her with the little blanket.
Then he turned off the air conditioning and found thinner blankets for them all to avoid them getting too hot later.
But leaving the air conditioner on, he wasn't completely at ease. Just at this moment, the system's voice rang out, its sudden sound making Lin Yi freeze in place.
"Congratulations host, for completing the system task. Intimacy with your baby has increased, and the system rewards the host with the Economic Adjustment Master Management skill!"
"Once the host uses this skill, they will be able to self-teach and master any business skill!"
Upon hearing the system's voice, Lin Yi was immediately stunned on the spot, considering that with this skill he wouldn't need to learn any business tactics and could dominate the business world.
Moreover, he could now bypass school and teach himself everything, meaning he could effectively graduate now.
However, this wasn't important to him because, for him, going to school wasn't about earning the diploma. Whether he had a diploma or not wasn't significant anymore; after all, he was already a winner in life.
He was in school only because his wife was still studying, and he was accompanying her, at least keeping her company.
Now, the system's rewards were always magical, almost tailor-made according to his needs.
That is to say, the previous rewards were some properties and funds, but now what it granted him was stuff he could use. It seemed the system really listened to his demands.
As Lin Yi was contemplating this, the ringing of his phone suddenly jolted him. Fearing that it might disturb the babies, Lin Yi immediately answered. It was a call from the manager of Wenqu Building that he had spoken to earlier.
Lin Yi took his phone out to the balcony and, after picking up, a voice came through from the other side.
"Mr. Lin, I'm sorry for disturbing you so late."
Lin Yi nodded and replied, "It's fine, go ahead."
"Mr. Lin, you had us stay alert for Han Xuemei before, right? We've been keeping an eye on her, and recently, she has indeed made some moves."
Lin Yi, initially disinterested, suddenly frowned and asked, "Tell me, what has she done?"
He had had someone watch Han Xuemei exactly to be on guard in case she was up to something. Now he was genuinely curious to know what this Han Xuemei was plotting.
"She has started to target our hotel now. We don't know exactly what method she's using, but the hotel's business has significantly declined recently. Her tactics are quite clever. We haven't figured them out yet, but don't worry, Mr. Lin. We have someone watching her closely, and we're bound to find some traces."
Lin Yi nodded upon hearing this and said, "Keep a close eye on her, and at first, do not spook her. And gather all the evidence for me, I will handle it from there!"
Lin Yi spoke calmly, and the manager nodded, repeatedly agreeing.
"Yes! Mr. Lin, we will definitely keep a tight watch on her for you."
Lin Yi gave a few more instructions.

chapters.title: Chapter 205 Carefully Designed
chapters.content:
There's one thing he had to make clear and he immediately spoke, "If she does anything to harm my family, don't hesitate, just take action immediately."
Lin Yi said this, and for him, he truly wouldn't care about the assets, but if Han Xuemei dared to touch his family, he would never let her off lightly.
Moreover, he planned to have a talk with Dad Han in a while, he absolutely had to make Dad Han be wary of Han Xuemei.
From the beginning when Han Xuemei came here, he felt that Han Xuemei had a purpose, even though she was a relative of Dad Han, he still could not indulge such a woman to stay in their home.
The manager across him immediately nodded and bowed, "Mr. Lin, rest assured, we will definitely not let her get away with anything."
If Han Xuemei really caused trouble and harmed Lin Yi's family, then he could forget about wearing this suit, so at this moment he was naturally very cautious.
"Mr. Lin, there's one thing I think we need to be particularly cautious about, which is that she has recently purchased a variety of hormone drugs. She is a very healthy person, and we even asked for her medical check-up report specifically; she doesn't have any problems at all. Therefore, I suspect that these hormone-related substances are what she may use for wrongdoing,"
Hearing this, Lin Yi furrowed his brows.
Hormones? He couldn't think clearly for a moment what hormones could potentially be used for,
The manager across him spoke, "I have also specially looked into the hormones she bought and even checked them out; these substances should be used very carefully, and one must consult a doctor, because long-term use can cause significant problems and even death. Muscle atrophy is one particularly terrifying thing."
Hearing this, Lin Yi furrowed his brows, suddenly feeling the need to be cautious.
And the voice opposite continued relentlessly.
"If not used, these substances can also cause great harm to an adult's body, and problems like osteoporosis are just a matter of time, and muscle atrophy is inevitable. If given to children, it would directly stop their development.
After all, these kinds of hormones are very potent, and if consumed excessively, they could lead to various diseases. Moreover, she didn't just buy one type of hormone; the results are unpredictable if mixed."
The manager spoke, and Lin Yi, hearing more and more, felt that something was amiss and couldn't help but interject, "Alright, stop talking about the drugs for now. Has she done anything unusual recently?"
"She has also been up to some minor tricks recently, but it doesn't seem to have caused any serious problems, so we haven't treated her actions with suspicion.
However, we have noticed that starting just these past two days, she would make tea for Mr. Han every day, and she has been adding in the hormones I just mentioned to you."
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi's brows furrowed deeply, his temples throbbing as he felt an urge to rage.
But at that moment, realizing that Lin Yi's mood was off, the manager across him immediately spoke up, "However, Mr. Lin, rest assured, we have already replaced the drugs she bought with common vitamins, identical to the original medications, and she won't notice because you had previously instructed us not to alert her, and we haven't said anything."
Yet Lin Yi's face turned ashen, his fists clenched tightly, he shouted furiously, thankful for their preparedness; otherwise, this malicious woman would have certainly succeeded. Thinking of this made him extremely angry.
Considering what Han Xuemei has been doing lately, she has come to understand that Han Xuemei's goal is to replace Dad Han's company.
She doesn't want to destroy Dad Han's company, she wants to directly snatch it away.
By now, he has figured out Han Xuemei's purpose, but he can't afford to startle the snake. It's no problem for him if the store doesn't make money, as long as his family is safe.
Lin Yi can't act recklessly at the moment, as it would only result in Han Xuemei biting back. He must wait until the time is ripe, with enough physical evidence and witness testimony, so that Han Xuemei won't be able to deny it.
Lin Yi took a deep breath and spoke on the phone, "Keep a close watch on her these days. If she touches my family, act immediately.
If she continues to act according to her previous plan, then just hold off for a while until it's the right time to deal with it." Lin Yi spoke, and the person on the other end immediately acknowledged.
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi returned to the room. By then, Han Xuewei had already finished her shower and was drying her hair. She looked up and saw Lin Yi.
Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei and took a deep breath before saying, "Wife, I have something to tell you in a bit, don't rest yet."
As he spoke, Han Xuewei looked puzzled, as Lin Yi was acting stranger than usual today, given that he normally told her to rest early if there was nothing important.
Lin Yi took a quick shower and soon came out.
He walked over to Han Xuewei and sat down beside her. Seeing Lin Yi's mood was off, Han Xuewei immediately came over and said, "Husband, is there something you want to tell me? It seems quite important from the way you're acting."
Hearing this, Lin Yi just gave a faint smile and looked at Han Xuewei, "Now you seem to know everything."
"Husband, I'm your wife, and I've already come to understand your character. If it weren't for something important, you wouldn't be like this."
Han Xuewei clung tightly to Lin Yi as she spoke, and Lin Yi turned his head and gently kissed her on the forehead, saying, "This matter is indeed quite important."
Lin Yi's expression was serious, and Han Xuewei, also concerned, furrowed her brows. "Is it a problem with your company? If there's a problem, I can ask my dad to help you. If he has enough funds for turnover, he can help you to handle that..."
Han Xuewei stopped mid-sentence as Lin Yi shook his head. How could his business possibly have problems?
Even if the company did encounter problems, he had more than just one or two companies, so Lin Yi shook his head and said, "What do you think about your cousin Han Xuemei? She's been working at your dad's hotel recently, right? How much do you really know about her?"
As Lin Yi spoke, Han Xuewei was a bit flustered by his question. Experience new stories on empire
"Han Xuemei? Actually, I haven't had much contact with her. However, sometimes the way she looks at me is not friendly, and I don't like her much either. I don't know what she's up to."
Seeing this, Lin Yi reached out and touched her face, intending to tell Han Xuewei everything he had just found out, to put her on alert.

chapters.title: Chapter 206 Cunning Plan
chapters.content:
At this moment, Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei, his expression somber as he spoke with gravity, "Actually, you're right. There is indeed something peculiar about your cousin. I had noticed it a while ago."
"When I first met her, I sensed something was off about the way she looked at you… It was as if she was jealous," Lin Yi said, leaving Han Xuewei somewhat astonished.
"In fact, since she started working at your father's hotel, I've had the previous security company keep an eye on her, and these past few days, they've indeed uncovered something."
Stirred by Lin Yi's words, Han Xuewei became curious and asked him, "Is there something amiss?"
"I suspect she is planning on taking action against our father's assets. According to my recent investigations, she seems to have been buying people's loyalty!" Hearing this, Han Xuewei immediately looked vigilant.
Lin Yi continued, "I believe she will make her next move soon, and I've also discovered that she seems to have targeted our dad."
"How is it possible for her to target my dad? He's her uncle."
Han Xuewei's expression was one of sheer disbelief as she frowned and pressed on, "What has she done?"
"It's quite simple. My people found out she bought some hormones, and I had them investigate if she had any medical condition that required those drugs, but there was none." Discover hidden stories at empire
"Those drugs were used on your father. She brewed them into tea for your dad to drink, but don't worry, my love, I've had someone replace those drugs already."
At that moment, Han Xuewei's face was flushed with panic, but upon hearing this, she breathed a sigh of relief, her eyes reddening with anger as she said, "Why would she target my dad? Haven't we been good enough to her family? And now she's setting her sights on my father's assets!"
"When she used to harbor such petty thoughts, I thought it was just because she was young and a bit jealous, but I never imagined she'd be so malicious and do something like this!"
At that moment, Han Xuewei's complexion was terrible. She certainly believed that what Lin Yi had told her was true, which meant that Han Xuemei was truly despicable, having gone so far as to strike at her own father.
After hearing Lin Yi speak, Han Xuewei's mood soured greatly, sitting aside and brooding.
Seeing this, Lin Yi immediately embraced Han Xuewei and reassured her, "Wife, you don't need to worry. I won't let her harm my family members, so don't be afraid…"
Hearing these words, Han Xuewei still looked deeply troubled and said bluntly, "Husband, you know, it's not just that. What breaks my heart the most is that the person doing these things is her, my own cousin!"
"Although we played together as children and didn't have much contact after growing up, I've always given way to her in everything. She could learn anything she liked along with me, and it was my dad who found those hobby classes for us, even paying for their family as well.
The hobby classes were expensive, but my dad said nothing and let her attend with me, covering all the expenses.
Even the place where their family lives was financed and supported by my dad because he felt guilty for having Uncle give up the chance to inherit the family restaurant. He was very grateful to his own family, so he was especially kind to hers.
And over the years, to be honest, my uncle's family has had it pretty good. I never expected she would be the one to do such a thing. Although I knew she was jealous of me, I didn't give it much thought. If she had targeted me, it would have been better, but why did she hurt my dad?"
Han Xuewei said, her voice choking up, Lin Yi immediately wiped away her tears and said, "Silly girl, what are you talking about? If she dares to lay a hand on you, I definitely won't let her get away with it!"
"Wife, don't be sad now. It's not worth feeling sad for someone with the heart of a wolf and lungs of a dog. Sometimes people do change. Someone as selfish as her can't keep anything warm. Her venomous heart has indeed made a grave mistake this time, and we should punish her, not ourselves!"
As Lin Yi spoke, he didn't know exactly how to comfort Han Xuewei, for he had never been through such a situation himself, and could only hold Han Xuewei tightly in his arms.
Han Xuewei's mood also eased quite a bit, and she gradually stopped sobbing. Lin Yi, looking at Han Xuewei, couldn't help but say, "Also, while you were at the gathering today, I was paying attention and noticed there seemed to be a girl who was quite unfriendly towards you, almost as much as Han Xuemei. I think she has an agenda, did she do anything harmful to you at the banquet?"
As Lin Yi spoke, Han Xuewei frowned upon hearing this.
"Are you talking about Gu Li? I know about her. She has been jealous of me throughout our university years.
But that doesn't really matter, after all, my classmates all know I don't get along with her, so I didn't talk much to her. She has been avoiding me, so I guess she won't do anything. And I won't let her get her way."
Han Xuewei said, moved by Lin Yi's attentiveness, and leaned towards Lin Yi. Lin Yi, at this moment, stroked Han Xuewei's hair and said, "Wife, it's good that you're aware. It's better to be vigilant against such people. Since you know her intentions, from now on we should keep our distance from her."
"If she really dares to do anything, I won't let her off!" Lin Yi said, and Han Xuewei smiled slightly, feeling warm inside.
Lin Yi nodded, holding Han Xuewei tightly.
He moved his head to Han Xuewei's shoulder and said, "As for Han Xuemei's matter, leave it to me. Once I've gathered the evidence, we'll discuss the issue. You don't have to worry about it; you don't seem to know what to do. Stop thinking about it and leave everything to your husband!"
As Lin Yi spoke, Han Xuewei listened, her expression somewhat helpless.
"Why would she turn out like this..." Han Xuewei sighed deeply.
