Indeed, she had never imagined that her beloved sister she grew up with could change so much over the years. Jealousy truly distorts people.
Hearing this, Lin Yi could only pat Han Xuewei's shoulder and say, "Don't think about these things. People change, and jealousy can alter a lot of things. Maybe when you were little you didn't notice, but in fact, she might have had those thoughts for a long time!"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei nodded her head, no longer wanting to talk about it.
Lin Yi didn't intend to bring it up again either. Once he found the evidence, he didn't plan to make a big deal out of it, after all, they were family.
And according to what Han Xuewei said, their great-uncle's family had always been quite nice to them.
They couldn't just create a huge conflict because of what their daughter did, which was not what Dad Han wanted to see.

chapters.title: Chapter 207 Finding a Job
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei leaned on Lin Yi's shoulder, pondered for a moment, and then looked at Lin Yi as if she had thought of something.
Lin Yi couldn't help but frown.
"What's wrong?"
"Husband, I remembered something. Today at our class reunion, one of the sisters from my dorm during our freshman year in college had to drop out because her father had a stroke.
Now, she has to take care of her father and manage the whole family. She also has to consider rehabilitation training for her father, which all require a lot of money. She is someone with a lot of pride, and both Qin Xiaoxu and I offered to help her, but she refused.
I was thinking, since she has come here, she must want to settle down here eventually. She would also have to bring her father over, and all these things need a lot of money. She doesn't want to accept our help and is thinking of finding a job here…" At this point, Han Xuewei showed a look of melancholy.
Lin Yi furrowed his brow and said, "So, has she found one?"
"She hasn't found one yet. She doesn't have a high level of education, and you know, here in Xiangcheng, all the companies require higher education, but she doesn't have it."
"With just a high school diploma, basically no company is willing to accept her. Even if they do, the salary would be very low. She needs a high salary now, otherwise, she can't afford her family's expenses."
Seeing Han Xuewei's melancholic look, Lin Yi agreed as well, since that's just the way society is nowadays.
In a first-tier city like Xiangcheng, if you don't have work experience or a good educational background, finding a good job is indeed very difficult.
Even if she really had the chance to get into one of those big companies, she wouldn't be able to adapt to the high-intensity work. Some jobs are indeed tailored to educational qualifications.
At this moment, Han Xuewei spoke up, "So there's no other way. I plan to tell her to earn her degree first, which will make finding a job easier, and it will also help her career in the future. She won't be looked down upon."
Hearing this, Lin Yi agreed, "Wife, you're actually thinking about it the right way."
Nowadays, education is indeed very important, and you also need certain opportunities.
After all, every year there are tens of millions of college graduates pouring into the cities. But now, Ye Caiwei is alone and helpless in this city, which is quite difficult. Just surviving is hard enough, let alone finding a good job.
So, at this time, both Lin Yi and Han Xuewei felt quite troubled. Han Xuewei had decided to find a job for Ye Caiwei now. She couldn't wait for her to get her qualifications before looking, that would be too late.
Moreover, she needs money now. If she isn't willing to accept financial assistance, she simply can't stay in this city where the cost of living is too high…
Your next on empire
The two of them discussed it while they were going to sleep, and after reaching a conclusion, they went to bed until the next day's sunrise.
In the early morning, Lin Yi got up and made a call to Zhou Jianlai, the captain of the Romeo Security Company that he contacted before.
Zhou Jianlai was somewhat surprised to receive Lin Yi's call so early in the morning and said, "Mr. Lin, why do you have the time to call me so early?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi just smiled faintly, "Captain Zhou, I'm calling to ask if there's a suitable position in our security company for someone who hasn't been to college."
Hearing this, Zhou Jianlai was somewhat taken aback, as the people he usually dealt with were highly educated.
But when he thought of Lin Yi's request, he nodded and said, "Mr. Lin, rest assured, leave it to me. The company happens to be short-staffed right now, I guarantee to find a job that will satisfy the person you're referring to."
Lin Yi, hearing this, also nodded in satisfaction.
Even for a top-tier security company like this, arranging for someone to do an ordinary job would not result in a low salary.
However, he had specifically mentioned it to Zhou Jianlai, who would likely arrange a good position out of respect for him.
After all, Zhou Jianlai offered very attractive terms, and since he agreed to them without asking any questions, there naturally wasn't any problem.
"Since that's the case, I'll trouble you to make the arrangements. I'll send you the contact information in a bit, and you can talk to her yourself."
After finishing, Lin Yi hung up the phone.
Returning to his room and seeing Han Xuewei, who had finished washing up, he couldn't help but say, "I guess it will happen today. I just called them, and you can send over your classmate's contact information later."
As Lin Yi spoke, Han Xuewei immediately nodded, clearly very happy as she said, "Then wait for me, I'll go and get it now."
Soon after, Lin Yi received the contact's WeChat and forwarded it to Zhou Jianlai.
At this moment, Han Xuewei directly called Ye Caiwei.
"Caiwei, my husband has already found you a job. He will call you later, so just keep an eye out for it."
Upon hearing this, Ye Caiwei was instantly overjoyed and immediately thanked Han Xuewei.
"We're sisters, no need to be so formal."
Ye Caiwei also quickly informed Qin Xiaoxu.
After learning the news, Qin Xiaoxu was also very happy and sent a message to Han Xuewei to greet her.
"Vivi, I really owe you one this time. If it hadn't been for your help in finding a job for Ye Caiwei first, I would have been in an awkward position because my father's company can't accept anyone with less than a college diploma. I wouldn't have been able to help Ye Caiwei, and I was wondering how to tell her. You truly saved the day!"
On hearing this, Han Xuewei merely smiled and replied softly.
"It's really nothing. The job was arranged by my husband's side. I'm not sure what kind of job they will arrange yet, so if it doesn't end up being suitable, then there's nothing we can do."
But at that moment, Ye Caiwei was still extremely happy; after all, just being given an opportunity was great, and since coming to Xiangcheng, she had truly realized how hard it was to find a job.
Recently, Ye Caiwei had been staying at Qin Xiaoxu's home.
Qin Xiaoxu was also very happy for Ye Caiwei and said, "This is good, you've really found a job. Now just wait for the call. Caiwei, you're hardworking and diligent, you can definitely do it!"
Hearing that, Ye Caiwei was very pleased, nodded, and felt a surge of energy for the future.
Meanwhile, Qin Xiaoxu, sitting to the side and looking at her phone for a while, saw a message from Lin Jie.
"What are you up to now? Playing games?"
"No, I'm at home. What about you?"
"I'm free today, so why not play some games with me?" Lin Jie said, prompting Qin Xiaoxu to frown slightly.
"Aren't you supposed to be in school? Why are you always talking about games!"
"No, no, I saw you lost some ranks last night. I'm thinking of helping you climb back up!"
Hearing that, Qin Xiaoxu felt somewhat helpless.
Can't this guy do something else?

chapters.title: Chapter 208 Let's go to your house
chapters.content:
Qin Xiaoxu had nothing much to do at the moment, so she directly opened the game interface.
When she opened the game, she saw the person who had messaged her before, flirting and planning to form a CP with her, messaging her again.
"Beauty, can't we be friends?"
Qin Xiaoxu was somewhat speechless upon seeing this message, thinking that indeed nothing online could be trusted.
Online romances were even less reliable, and she hadn't had much interaction with these people in the game anyway. People like these probably called countless others "beauty" throughout the day.
And they were all different from Lin Jie, so if she played with them, she'd surely just become one of the many fish in their pond.
Thinking of this, Qin Xiaoxu felt disgusted and bluntly replied.
"No need, don't talk to me about forming a CP anymore. I already have a boyfriend now, and I don't want to stay in touch with you anymore. I was only using you to make my boyfriend jealous before, now do whatever you want!"
After Qin Xiaoxu sent that, she had no further contact with the person.
For her, these people were just not reliable for anything beyond online chatting, and she was the kind to lose interest swiftly after a brief moment of excitement.
She had been idle these past few days and hadn't found a suitable job yet, so she spent her time playing games and dining out with Lin Jie.
But they hadn't done any of the things real couples should do.
Not even holding hands, let alone kissing!
At the thought, Qin Xiaoxu felt annoyed.
It had been almost half a month since they got to know each other, yet there was no progress at all. Something as simple as holding hands, why wouldn't Lin Jie take the initiative!
Of course, she couldn't be so straightforward; as a girl, she had to maintain a bit of reserve. Thinking of this, Qin Xiaoxu became agitated.
Lin Jie was such a typical guy, missing so many opportunities and hints she gave him. How could he be so useless?
Qin Xiaoxu was somewhat upset and picked up her phone to ask Lin Jie out for a meal.
Lin Jie, naturally very happy to see the message on his phone, immediately agreed.
For him, Qin Xiaoxu taking the initiative meant she had feelings for him, indicating a closer relationship. With this in mind, Lin Jie chuckled delightedly.
Qin Xiaoxu, however, was infuriated at having to always initiate dates and meetings as Lin Jie wouldn't take the lead!
Although Lin Jie often talked about her meeting his parents, Qin Xiaoxu thought it best to wait.
Before, as a fake couple, she believed meeting the parents was just to appease family members and that was just fine.
But now as a real couple, she found the idea somewhat inappropriate. Meeting the parents is quite sensitive; it should only be necessary if both parties are certain about getting married in the future.
So at the moment, she wasn't planning to directly meet Lin Jie's parents, unsure if she was nervous or something else.
At noon, Ye Caiwei received a call from Zhou Jianlai of the security company.
In the call, many things were said, but Qin Xiaoxu, playing games beside her, did not listen carefully.
Ye Caiwei, however, looked very serious and listened intently, nodding and saying, "Don't worry, Mr. Zhou. I will do a good job."
The person on the other end of the line then said, "Yes, because we are Mr. Lin Yi's friends, we have great respect for you. I will transfer the advanced payment to you in a moment. As long as you do as we instructed, we will handle everything else here. Remember, you must not expose yourself..."
After Zhou Jianlai finished speaking, Ye Caiwei nodded in response.
"Alright, alright."
"Someone will meet with you tonight and teach you what to do. Miss Ye Caiwei, please be at ease!"
Hearing this, Ye Caiwei nodded solemnly again, then hung up. After the call, Qin Xiaoxu curiously approached her.
"What was that about? What kind of job did Vivi's husband introduce to you?"
Hearing this, Ye Caiwei just smiled faintly and replied, "This matter has to be kept secret. However, I might be staying here for a while now. Once I'm settled, I'll go rent a place. Sorry for the inconvenience…"
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu patted her chest and said, "What are we if not close? It's not an inconvenience at all. But what exactly is this job you've found?"
Qin Xiaoxu looked at Ye Caiwei with even greater curiosity.
Hearing her question, Ye Caiwei just smiled lightly, "You don't need to ask about that. They told me it's a secret job, and it's not appropriate for me to discuss it. I'll tell you everything once I succeed!"
Ye Caiwei spoke with excitement, which only fueled Qin Xiaoxu's curiosity.
Actually, when Ye Caiwei heard the job offer Zhou Jianlai had for her, she too was surprised.
She had thought such jobs didn't exist in modern times.
Just find a place to hide a camera, and that would be perfect, right?
But now she'd been given such a job that felt like being part of an intelligence group, like a spy nestled within the enemy ranks, a notion that seemed both mysterious and exciting to her.
Suddenly, her phone screen lit up.
She received the initial funding of over ten thousand from Zhou Jianlai. Looking at the ten thousand, her lips curled into a smile.
Now that she had found a new job, she could start a new life. It was time to say goodbye to her past life.
She was ready to reclaim her life, and to make up for the wasted youthful years.
Qin Xiaoxu had invited Lin Jie to dinner at a restaurant, and by the time they had finished eating, it was nearly eight o'clock.
Qin Xiaoxu then turned to Lin Jie and asked, "I've never been to your place. Where do you live?"
Hearing this, Lin Jie frowned, "Didn't I say before that you should meet my parents? You said you didn't want to, and now it's too late to go."
"Oh come on, I'm not talking about where your parents live. I mean where you're renting now. Where do you live?" Qin Xiaoxu was clearly impatient, not expecting him to be so obtuse.
Hearing her question, Lin Jie just frowned.
"You want to visit my place? As a guy living alone, there's not much to see at my place."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu showed a determined expression.
"No, I want to see!"
The two dawdled on the road for quite some time.
In the end, Lin Jie had no choice but to take Qin Xiaoxu there.

chapters.title: Chapter 209 Awkward
chapters.content:
Lin Jie didn't quite understand why Qin Xiaoxu felt the need to visit his place out of the blue, but since she was so adamant about it, he couldn't refuse.
So he drove her to the house he was renting. After parking the car, Qin Xiaoxu looked at Lin Jie with a sly smile.
Lin Jie was still a bit confused. He opened the car door and stepped out, while Qin Xiaoxu, excitedly running out, naturally took his hand.
Seeing her gesture, Lin Jie just smiled warmly and they entered the elevator together. Lin Jie turned to Qin Xiaoxu and said, "Two weeks ago, a friend of mine came to stay over. Don't be too surprised when you see him, I used to live alone, but this time he might stay with me for quite a while."
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu's brow furrowed immediately.
Her heart sank in an instant. She had never expected someone to be at Lin Jie's home!!
She had deliberately followed Lin Jie in hopes of spending some time alone with him.
Now there was someone at his place? The perfect atmosphere was gone!
At that moment, she showed an incredulous look and asked, "You have someone at home, is it a man or a woman?"
Lin Jie frowned upon hearing this question, surprised at Qin Xiaoxu's inquiry. His friend was of course a man!
And how could he possibly live with a woman?
"What are you thinking? He's a friend from my childhood. He's been facing a lot of setbacks recently while looking for a job and he hasn't found one yet. Plus, rents here are high. Where could he afford to rent without a job? So he came to stay at my place!"
Relieved by his words, Qin Xiaoxu exhaled but then looked at Lin Jie with a speechless expression.
If Lin Jie had a friend at home, why did he agree to her request?
She had thought that just the two of them going back together would've meant some private time, but now it was incredibly awkward. If only she'd known, she wouldn't have come.
Qin Xiaoxu muttered to herself silently, looking at Lin Jie with none of the excitement she had before.
As they exited the elevator, Qin Xiaoxu was still standing there dazed when Lin Jie pulled her along, saying, "Come on, I live right over here."
At that point, Qin Xiaoxu couldn't well refuse since she had already come; so she simply followed Lin Jie as they walked on.
Lin Jie knocked on the door and called out, "Lin Hao, come open the door!"
There was no response from inside as Lin Jie called.
Lin Jie furrowed his brows, "That guy isn't home!"
Muttering to himself, Lin Jie reached into his pocket for his keys. Seeing this, Qin Xiaoxu couldn't help but laugh, "If you have the keys, why bother calling him?"
"I needed to let him know, after all, you're my girlfriend."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu said nothing and just followed Lin Jie inside.
Once in the living room, Qin Xiaoxu found a spot to sit down, while Lin Jie looked around and said, "You must be thirsty; I'll get you some water."
With that, Lin Jie picked up a glass and walked towards the kitchen.
Qin Xiaoxu looked around at the surroundings.
The room was quite tidy, and the environment was nice too.
Just then, Lin Hao also came back. Lin Hao opened the door and called out, "Lin Jie, did you not realize how hot it was outside today? I feel like I'm about to turn into jerky!"
As he spoke, he walked forward and, upon seeing Lin Jie, his face showed a look of surprise as he said, "Are you drinking a beverage? I brought some."
While Lin Hao said this, he was handing a drink over to Lin Jie. Right at that moment, Lin Jie, who was holding a glass of boiled water and about to give it to Qin Xiaoxu, saw Lin Hao.
Lin Hao also saw Qin Xiaoxu at this time, and he suddenly looked embarrassed, "Did I interrupt you guys?"
Qin Xiaoxu also felt a bit awkward and replied, "It's okay, I just got here too."
Qin Xiaoxu said this, though in her mind, she really hoped not to be disturbed, but given the situation, she had no choice.
Lin Jie, however, was quite enthusiastic and walked up to Lin Hao saying, "You're finally back. You made my clothes so dirty this morning, didn't you say you could wash clothes? I didn't put them in the washing machine because only washing by hand will get them clean. You have to wash the ones you dirtied, and how could you still go out and hang around!"
Lin Jie spoke indifferently, and upon hearing this, Lin Hao replied, "Alright, alright! I'll go wash them, okay?"
He finished speaking and headed for the bathroom.
During his recent visits, he hadn't brought enough clothes, so he ended up wearing Lin Jie's. While eating, he had accidentally splattered them.
He had long forgotten about this incident, but Lin Jie brought it up again now.
At that moment, Lin Hao stopped at the bathroom and started to pull out the clothes. Back when his living conditions weren't very good, he had to wash his clothes by hand, so he had gotten used to it.
Seeing this scene, Qin Xiaoxu found it very strange and frowned as she asked, "What the heck? Why does he even have to wash your clothes?"
As Qin Xiaoxu spoke up, Lin Jie responded nonchalantly, "He got my clothes dirty last night after I showered. He's clumsy when he eats; he knocked over the cup noodle and got oil all over them. Those clothes can't be machine washed—I usually take them to the dry cleaners. He insisted on wearing them, so now he has to wash them himself."
Lin Jie said and walked forward without a care.
Qin Xiaoxu looked at him and couldn't help but say, "If the clothes are dirty, just pour some detergent on them and soak for a while, rub them clean later. How lazy can you be, making someone else do this for you!"
Hearing Qin Xiaoxu's words, Lin Jie shook his head, "I don't care, whoever made the mess should clean it up."
Lin Jie said and sat down next to her. Qin Xiaoxu had no way to argue with him and didn't pursue the matter.
After a while, Lin Hao came out, holding the cleaned clothes and walked to the balcony to hang them up.
After hanging the clothes, Lin Hao came back toward them, took a package from the table, and said, "When I went downstairs just now, I also bought some hand-grabbed pancakes, the ones that old man downstairs bakes. They're really tasty, you should try some."
As Lin Hao spoke, he placed the hand-grabbed pancakes on the table, ready to be taken out and eaten.
At this point, Qin Xiaoxu looked at them and suddenly felt a stomachache, so she said, "I'll go to the bathroom first."
She felt incredibly awkward at that moment, wishing she had not come at all. With an extra person around, things always seemed awkward.
Stuck between two guys, she felt somewhat at a loss. In fact, as soon as she went into the bathroom and squatted down, she was already fuming.
Why on earth would Lin Jie live with someone else!
She had wanted to... Ah! Annoying!!
Qin Xiaoxu muttered to herself, feeling extremely irritable, but when she looked up, she saw something that took her by surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 210 Are they the same??
chapters.content:
Qin Xiaoxu was squatting in a spot that directly faced the sink, where some couple's items were placed on top.
The mouthwash cups and towels were almost all in matching colors, and upon closer inspection, even the toothbrushes were couple's models, with two colors that matched perfectly, and they were even engraved with text. The patterns on the towels depicted two characters from an anime.
Upon seeing this scene, Qin Xiaoxu instantly panicked; she lost all feeling and stood up, revealing a shocked expression.
That's not possible, right? How could it be?!!
Could it be that the two of them...!
At this moment, Qin Xiaoxu felt almost insane. Could it be that the two of them were a couple!
How could this be possible?
Qin Xiaoxu usually gathered some information; she even shipped CPs online, but she never imagined that this kind of thing would happen to her!
Seeing these items, she was somewhat speechless. Her mind was filled with images of Lin Jie and Lin Hao hugging each other intimately.
There they were, sleeping together on the same bed, engaging in many intimate behaviors. These images churned in her mind, and at that moment, she felt as though she had been struck by lightning, completely frozen in place.
How could this be? If he were gay, then why would he still have a girlfriend?
And besides, it was he who confessed to me, that can't be right!
At this moment, Qin Xiaoxu felt appalled as she remembered all of Lin Jie's past behaviors.
After all, Lin Jie getting a girlfriend to pretend to be a couple was just to fool his parents.
Could it be that this was what he really thought, to hide his little lover at home...
So I've been tricked!
Actually, Lin Jie is gay.
Thinking of this, Qin Xiaoxu's eyes widened. She had seen many news stories before; some gay men, disliking women, would still marry a woman, the purpose being for that woman to bear children for them.
After having a child, that woman would be abandoned, nothing more pitiable.
Could such a tragic event possibly happen to me? Surely not!
Why! Why do I have to be so miserable?
At this moment, tears nearly burst forth as Qin Xiaoxu stood in the bathroom, flustered and clueless, with scenes of being abandoned constantly playing in her mind, which made her seething with anger.
That bastard Lin Jie, if he really dares to do this, I will skin him!
Right now, Qin Xiaoxu was in a terrible mood; she took a deep breath and steadied her emotions.
It can't be. His feelings for me don't seem insincere. It must be a misunderstanding...
Comforting herself, Qin Xiaoxu patted her chest and walked towards the outside, and just at that moment, she saw a scene that made her jaw drop.
Lin Jie was currently using chopsticks to split off a piece of the hand-grabbed pancake and directly placed it in Lin Hao's mouth, the action very natural, and he leaned in quite close.
Lin Hao, looking at Lin Jie, couldn't help but say, "Hey, eat more, it's really delicious. That old man downstairs has some skills!"
As Lin Hao spoke, the chopsticks moved ever closer and Lin Jie took a bite, the movement graceful.
Seeing this scene, Qin Xiaoxu instantly became infuriated and strode out, saying, "What are you two doing?"
Her expression was incredibly serious as she said this, her brows furrowed.
Lin Jie, somewhat puzzled, said directly, "He just said this was tasty, so he insisted on making me try it—I'm not very fond of scallion pancakes."
"Not very fond of scallion pancakes, yet you've got a piece in your mouth?"
At that moment, Qin Xiaoxu's expression became increasingly unpleasant to look at, while Lin Hao hadn't noticed anything amiss and turned to Qin Xiaoxu, saying, "I also bought an extra one, here, give it a try—it's really good!"
Hearing Lin Hao's words, Qin Xiaoxu, unable to hold back, burst out, "Why are you two using couple's items? I just saw in the bathroom there were two identical cups, two couple's towels."
Upon hearing this, Lin Hao immediately laughed and said, "What's the big deal? These were all bought from a supermarket, and they even gave us towels for free."
"Then why do all those things in there match so well, if not by coincidence?" Continue your adventure with empire
As Qin Xiaoxu spoke, Lin Jie couldn't help but furrow his brow, and Lin Hao replied, "When you buy two of something, many items come in couples' editions, what's wrong with that?"
"Yeah, there's nothing wrong with that!" Lin Jie chimed in.
After hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu took a deep breath.
"There's a huge problem! I'm your girlfriend, right?!"
Qin Xiaoxu continued, looking first at Lin Jie then turning to Lin Hao, "Then what's his deal? You two aren't a couple, are you? Why use so many couples' items? Come on, tell me the truth—are you into men?"
"Are you planning to deceive me into being a 'beard'?" Qin Xiaoxu said, her voice becoming a whine.
Hearing this, Lin Jie's eyes widened in disbelief, and he looked at Qin Xiaoxu, speechless.
What exactly was going through this woman's mind?
Just because of a few items in the bathroom, she jumps to the conclusion that he's gay? What kind of gay would he be?
Unable to contain himself, Lin Jie immediately stood up and exclaimed, "Qin Xiaoxu, what nonsense are you spouting? Of course, I like women. What are you thinking about, really..."
Lin Jie was so angry he was almost inarticulate while Qin Xiaoxu was too lazy to listen to his explanation and simply walked to the door. Then she remembered her bag was still on the sofa, left unclaimed.
As she turned back, Lin Jie also came out, with Lin Hao following behind him.
Lin Hao was following too closely, and Lin Jie was caught off-balance by his foot, causing both of them to collide and fall together. Lin Jie ended up on top of Lin Hao, their faces almost touching. Just as Qin Xiaoxu turned her head, she witnessed this scene, her face freezing and her anger growing. She snatched up her bag and snorted coldly, "I wish you a lifetime of happiness!"
After saying that, she slammed the door and left.
At that moment, Lin Jie stood there bewildered, chasing after her outside. But by the time he opened the door, Qin Xiaoxu had already closed the elevator door.
Gasping for breath and somewhat confused, Lin Jie looked ahead; Lin Hao also came out, helplessly saying to Lin Jie, "Bro, I'm sorry, I really didn't mean for this to happen."
As he spoke, his awkwardness was apparent. If he hadn't come back today, the two of them might have made more progress, but his return had spoiled everything.
Lin Jie turned to look at Lin Hao, saying somewhat helplessly, "Qin Xiaoxu, she didn't really think there's something going on between us, did she?"
Pointing at Lin Hao, Lin Jie said, "Is there something you're hiding from me? Could it be that you actually have feelings for me??"

chapters.title: Chapter 211 Collapse
chapters.content:
Hearing this, Lin Hao felt somewhat speechless and directly said, "What the hell are you thinking? How could I possibly be interested in you? I definitely like women."
Lin Hao just sighed and patted Lin Jie's shoulder, "Actually, it was just a misunderstanding. It's not a big deal, just explain it clearly. After all, those cups and toothbrushes can't be evidence to prove that we are that."
"But the way you knocked me down just now might make her think that we are."
Hearing this, Lin Jie immediately panicked, "What should I do now? It's over, I lost a girlfriend just like that!"
Lin Hao heard this and simply replied, "This isn't just your issue; I like women too. Why didn't you tell me before you came back? If I knew your girlfriend was coming back with you, I wouldn't have come back and would've given you two some space to be alone."
As Lin Hao spoke, Lin Jie looked at him and said, "You! If it weren't for you wanting to buy cheaper stuff, to save money on couple towels, toothpaste, toothbrushes, and all that, none of this would've happened. Now look, I have to go explain to her. That girl's way of thinking is anything but ordinary. I don't even know how to start!"
Lin Jie spoke, feeling agitated.
Upon hearing this, Lin Hao immediately shook his shoulders, "Brother! I really owe you an apology for this one. Hurry and go after her."
Lin Jie nodded at these words, took his phone, and made a call to Qin Xiaoxu. Qin Xiaoxu didn't pick up, so he sent a WeChat message, but there was no reply either.
Only then did Lin Jie realize the gravity of the situation. Qin Xiaoxu really misunderstood. He immediately ran to the elevator and, by the time he was out of the residential complex, he could no longer see Qin Xiaoxu.
At this moment, Qin Xiaoxu was already gone.
Lin Jie ran out only to see no one around, feeling as if he had fallen into an icy pit, muttering while clutching his hair.
"It's over! It's really over..."
Seeing him like this, Lin Hao patted his shoulder and said, "Brother, I'm really sorry. I will definitely help you explain to your girlfriend later."
Meanwhile, Qin Xiaoxu walked on the road, feeling extremely troubled. She shouldn't have come to Lin Jie's home.
No, it was right to come to Lin Jie's home. That was the only way she could see Lin Jie for who he really was!
Poor me, I almost became a 'tongqi'!
Qin Xiaoxu sighed and immediately made a call. It was to Han Xuewei.
She was used to calling Han Xuewei whenever something happened. As soon as the call connected, she blurted out, "Vivi, I'm doomed! My romance hadn't even started, and I'm already heading towards a breakup. Lin Jie is totally unreliable; I'm going to break up with him. He's gone too far. He actually turned out to be gay.
I must break up with him!"
"When I went to his house just now, I saw there was another man there. How could he do such a thing? How could he deceive me? He's too much, really too much..."
Qin Xiaoxu said this, and when Han Xuewei on the other side understood, she showed a look of astonishment and couldn't help saying, "How is that possible? How could he possibly be gay, he is Lin Yi's cousin, and Lin Yi would definitely know about this. You must have misunderstood him!"
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu shook her head helplessly and said, "It's impossible. I just saw it with my own eyes. When I was using the restroom, I saw that almost all of their toiletries were couple's items!"
"And that Lin Hao, he even fed Lin Jie food, he did it so skillfully and naturally, and then he helped Lin Jie do the laundry, and Lin Jie didn't think it was a big deal. These are things that only a girlfriend would do, okay. Right, right, there's something even more explosive.
I was about to leave, I hadn't taken my bag, and then I turned back to get my bag, and they couldn't wait to throw themselves at each other, they threw themselves at each other!!" Read exclusive adventures at empire
"I saw it all with my own eyes. Otherwise, I would still be kept in the dark, about to become someone else's beard, a pitiful beard, Vivi, I'm so miserable, it hurts so much to go through another breakup!"
As Qin Xiaoxu spoke, she started sobbing.
Hearing this, Han Xuewei panicked and immediately said, "Xiaoxu, there must be some misunderstanding. It's impossible for Lin Jie to be gay, I can't tell at all. Stop crying. When Lin Yi comes over, I will ask him, and then talk to Lin Jie about it. You must have misunderstood him, I think he likes you, how can he be keeping a man at home?"
While saying this, Qin Xiaoxu had already soaked through several tissues with her tears, walking down the street, crying.
Passersby were all shocked, looking over at her. Seeing the crowd around her staring, she suddenly burst out crying, "What are you looking at, haven't you seen someone go through a breakup?!"
Saying this, she quickened her pace and walked forward.
She readjusted her mental state. Now, she hailed a car using an APP on her phone, and when she got into the car, messages were still popping up incessantly, and calls kept coming in.
Qin Xiaoxu, at this point, couldn't care less and simply hung up all those calls.
The driver in front recognized that something was off with this young lady and took a glance in the rearview mirror. Qin Xiaoxu was still crying; realizing she had caught someone's attention, she wiped away her tears, to the extent that she even turned off her phone.
By now, she didn't want to think about these things anymore; men like Lin Jie, she would never trust again. Getting close to men would only lead to unhappiness!
Thinking thus, the car quickly arrived at her rented place. When she got back, Ye Caiwei had returned. Seeing Qin Xiaoxu's dreary expression and red-rimmed eyes, Ye Caiwei instantly became worried and hurried over to Qin Xiaoxu.
"What's the matter, Xiaoxu? Did someone bully you, or is it your boyfriend?"
Ye Caiwei was very concerned. Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu burst into tears, hugged Ye Caiwei tightly, and said, "Caiwei, you have no idea how terrible my day has been. That Lin Jie—he's gay. I just saw him keeping another man at home…"
As she said this, she started crying again. Hearing this, Ye Caiwei was flabbergasted, her expression one of shock, doubting that she had heard correctly.
"That's impossible, the day before yesterday when you told me about him, he didn't sound like he was gay at all. Don't scare yourself."
Qin Xiaoxu tried to calm down for a moment, then sat down on the couch and said, "I saw in their bathroom, those couple's towels and toothbrushes. He said they were on sale at the supermarket so I just believed him, but all their behavior indicates that they are very intimate—those are things only a couple would do…"
"Plus, as I was leaving, I saw them throwing themselves at each other, face to face, almost kissing!!" Qin Xiaoxu was on the verge of breaking down.

chapters.title: Chapter 212 Misunderstanding
chapters.content:
Hearing what Qin Xiaoxu said, Ye Caiwei couldn't help but feel a bit helpless. She reached out, touched her head, and spoke, "Maybe you really misunderstood him. I've heard that those gay men tend to dress quite distinctively. Many gays lean towards feminization, and many can be identified as gay. Do you usually find his thoughts easy to understand?"
"If she really understands women well, then she might be gay. If she doesn't get women that much, then she's probably not!"
As Ye Caiwei spoke, although she hadn't done research on this area, she had once met a friend who was part of this minority community.
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu took a deep breath through her nose.
"He is just a stubborn straight man!"
Hearing that, Ye Caiwei just smiled faintly, reached out, touched Qin Xiaoxu's head, and said, "Then he shouldn't be, but let's wait and see. Even if he does end up deceiving you, planning to make you a 'beard,' I will be the first to not let him off the hook!" Continue reading on empire
By now, Ye Caiwei had become very strong. She didn't have much interest in men anymore because men had once hurt her badly, leaving wounds all over her body. She no longer had that much trust in men.
So, it was only right for her to warn Qin Xiaoxu to be cautious. Qin Xiaoxu nodded at her words and stopped crying, wiping away her tears before saying, "Right, Caiwei, didn't you tell me before you went out tonight that you were going for an interview? Did you get the results?"
She looked at Ye Caiwei earnestly as she spoke. Despite her own worries, she still cared for her friend.
Ye Caiwei laughed upon hearing this and handed Qin Xiaoxu a cup of hot water, "It all went smoothly. Don't worry, relax your mind. Don't think about this matter anymore. If there are still problems later on, Vivi and I will both help you."
"Once I settle my job, I'll have to move out of here!" Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu suddenly grabbed her hand and pouted, "Can't you live in this area? I haven't seen you for so long, and just after staying here for a little while, you're going to leave..."
Qin Xiaoxu felt a bit reluctant. She seemed lonely living alone, and she was quite happy that Ye Caiwei was willing to come over.
Hearing this, Ye Caiwei shook her head and said, "The company I'm going to has already arranged a place for me to stay, and the accommodations are quite good. Mainly, living there is convenient because it's closer to work."
Qin Xiaoxu found Ye Caiwei's reasoning sensible and nodded, "Alright then, but you must come and visit me often. I'm currently unemployed and get bored easily!"
Ye Caiwei couldn't help but laugh at this, "Don't worry, I will definitely call. Also, didn't you tell me before that your dad's friend had introduced some jobs to you? You might get so busy you'll forget about me."
As Ye Caiwei spoke, Qin Xiaoxu instantly started laughing.
As for work, she was always the type to slack off; she was either taking leave or playing hooky. How could she be dedicated?
Just at this moment, Qin Xiaoxu and Ye Caiwei were chatting.
Ye Caiwei's phone suddenly rang. She looked at the caller ID with a bit of surprise—it was a call from Han Xuewei.
She immediately answered. From the other end came a voice, "Caiwei, has Xiaoxu returned home yet?"
"She's home, right beside me now..." The person on the other end heaved a sigh of relief and spoke, "I just tried calling her, but her phone was turned off the whole time. I was worried something had happened to her. She probably told you about it. Let her listen to you now..."
Han Xuewei said with some concern, and Ye Caiwei immediately handed the phone to Qin Xiaoxu, saying, "Vivi is looking for you."
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu's eyes were still a bit red as she took a tissue to wipe her nose and leaned into the phone, asking, "What's up, Vivi?"
When Han Xuewei heard her voice, she truly felt relieved and said, "Xiaoxu, I think you've really misunderstood Lin Jie. What you're talking about is all a misunderstanding. The reason he threw himself on that guy is that he ran into the guy when he was running out—even if he were, he wouldn't do that in front of you!"
"So you see, it's all a misunderstanding. Lin Jie likes you, stop overthinking it. You're making things awkward for him, too. He just called me asking for help, and I didn't know what to say!"
Qin Xiaoxu sniffled and replied bluntly, "I don't want to hear it, I don't believe any of it. He must be hiding something, I'm sure of it. I don't buy any of these excuses. I'd rather believe that he just doesn't like women!"
As Qin Xiaoxu spoke, both Han Xuewei and Ye Caiwei were taken aback and immediately crowded in to look at Qin Xiaoxu.
At this point, Han Xuewei also sensed something was off and blurted out, "Is there anything that makes you think he's bad?!"
Han Xuewei understood Qin Xiaoxu very well; Qin Xiaoxu wouldn't believe such an absurd reason without a reason.
Feeling a bit embarrassed, Qin Xiaoxu said, "I don't want to think this way either, but I can't help it. You know, we've been dating for so long, and he hasn't even held my hand, let alone kissed me. The way he acts just shows that he doesn't like girls at all..."
"With that being the case, it's more likely that he likes men. The way he pounced on that guy was so casual, and he's been dating me for so long without being anywhere near as close to me as he was with that guy."
Qin Xiaoxu said this, somewhat helplessly.
Han Xuewei almost burst into laughter upon hearing this, while Lin Yi, who had been laughing so hard he was nearly lying down, sat across from her on the bed.
Seeing Lin Yi laughing like that, Han Xuewei couldn't help but join in the laughter.
Lin Yi truly hadn't expected Lin Jie to be so timid—dating for so long and not even holding the girl's hand; it was no wonder people suspected him of being gay.
At this moment, Han Xuewei looked at Lin Yi and spoke directly, "Alright, alright, I'll speak up for you now, and you can't just turn off your phone like that. You have to give her a chance to explain. Turn on your phone now and see how many calls she's made to you!"
As Han Xuewei spoke, Qin Xiaoxu was feeling a bit shy, merely sniffing.
"I don't want to talk anymore, I'm hanging up," Qin Xiaoxu said and then hung up the phone.
If things were really like Han Xuewei had said, then she had indeed misunderstood.
But the two of them were closer than she ever was to him; Lin Jie had been dating her for so long and had never fed her or made any intimate gestures; they were like mere friends.
What kind of relationship was that?
At this moment, as Qin Xiaoxu thought about it, and then envisioned the scene where the two of them gazed at each other when not together, she suddenly felt somewhat disinclined to believe.

chapters.title: Chapter 213 Explain Clearly
chapters.content:
But Qin Xiaoxu was willing to be persuaded, so she turned her phone on. As soon as she did, a flurry of missed calls popped up. She was a bit surprised, and her lips curled into a smile, a hint of sweetness blooming in her heart.
It seemed that Lin Jie still cared about her very much. She wanted to call him back immediately, but didn't want to seem too eager, so she decided to wait here, betting that Lin Jie would call her soon.
As expected, it wasn't long before Lin Jie called again. This time the call connected, and Lin Jie, somewhat excited, immediately picked up the phone and said, "Xiaoxu, don't be angry. I really didn't, you've misunderstood me. It's really not like you think. Just now I just accidentally bumped into her... "
"And, those towels and toothbrushes... it's because that kid loves a bargain. He's been out of work and not getting paid recently. He said he'd buy me some stuff and ended up getting me one as well, but I didn't notice they were couple's items. I... I just thought if it's usable, then it's fine.
I didn't think too much about it. Later, I will buy couple's items for you, and I'll only use the same ones as you, okay? I like you..."
Lin Jie spoke haltingly and with an air of impatience.
Qin Xiaoxu, while touched by his words, still pretended to be angry and retorted, "Your words are useless. I won't believe them."
Upon hearing this, Lin Jie on the other end became anxious, "Don't disbelieve me, I can't explain clearly over the phone. Let's meet up."
As Lin Jie spoke, Qin Xiaoxu cleared her throat and said, "Then let's meet at the coffee shop below my apartment. I want to see you within twenty minutes. If you don't show up within twenty minutes, then let's not meet at all!"
Qin Xiaoxu's tone was quite firm. Ye Caiwei, seeing her like this, couldn't help but break into a smile, "Are you really going to treat him like this?"
Qin Xiaoxu feigned arrogance.
"I must show him my stance." Having said that, Qin Xiaoxu took a wet wipe and cleaned her face, which still had the marks of tears. She then sniffled and went downstairs.
After going downstairs, she headed straight for the coffee shop. Upon entering, she was surprised to find Lin Jie already there, panting and propping himself on a table as he looked at her.
Seeing him like that moved Qin Xiaoxu, but she didn't want Lin Jie to see it, so she shook off his hand and found a place to sit down.
Observing her sit down like that, Lin Jie took a seat opposite her and said, "Xiaoxu, you've really misunderstood me. There's really nothing between him and me, really. We both like girls."
As Lin Jie spoke, he signaled the server and said, "Hello, could you please bring us two Americano coffees, half sugar, no ice?" Turning back to Qin Xiaoxu, he added, "You see, I remember exactly how you like your coffee. I've got it all memorized…"
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu's expression softened slightly, though she remained silent, still feeling uncertain.
Because of Lin Jie's prior behavior, she had her doubts. Why wouldn't he take a step closer to her?
It was such a simple matter. Lin Jie, seeing her like this, was unsure how to start a conversation, so he just sat quietly across from her.
But after a moment of thought, she finally said, "Xiaoxu, I…" He leaned in close to Qin Xiaoxu, and she felt oddly warm, turning her head to glare at him.
At this point, Lin Jie couldn't care less and he leaned in close.
Qin Xiaoxu frowned but didn't back away; instead, she leaned in and kissed Lin Jie quite dominantly.
Lin Jie's heart pounded as Qin Xiaoxu kissed him. She felt nervous too but tried to act nonchalant.
After they had kissed for a while, Qin Xiaoxu stepped back with a blush on her face. Lin Jie, now somewhat excited, wanted to explain himself, but Qin Xiaoxu covered his mouth and said, "You don't need to say anything; I believe you!"
Hearing these words, Lin Jie felt a rush of excitement.
Qin Xiaoxu was also feeling embarrassed, her cheeks flushed red. As the waiter came over and served the coffee, she took a sip and regained her composure before speaking. "I no longer suspect you like men, but I do have one question. Why is it that when you go shopping with me, the tone of your voice and our conversations are so different, especially at night?
After you go back, the way you chat with me feels different from usual!" Enjoy exclusive chapters from empire
Upon hearing this, Lin Jie panicked. He often didn't know how to respond to Qin Xiaoxu and was afraid she would think he lacked emotional intelligence, but he didn't want to hide things from her either. After all, Qin Xiaoxu had quite the imagination; if he let her keep guessing, it would become even more awkward.
"Actually, sometimes I don't know how to reply to the messages you send me, so I often ask Lin Hao for help, to get some ideas. You know, I'm not very articulate. When you're out shopping with me, sometimes you find my responses quite dull.
I don't know what to say, but I like you. That's the only way I can put it, I don't want you to dislike me..." Lin Jie said, fidgeting with his fingers.
Qin Xiaoxu looked at Lin Jie and firmly and directly said, "You don't need to explain. From now on, when you text me, just express yourself in your own way. But make sure to say things I like to hear, okay? I'm not mad at you."
As Qin Xiaoxu spoke, she simply hoped that their interactions would remain genuine. Lin Jie, relieved by her words, looked at Qin Xiaoxu excitedly and smiled. "Don't worry, I'll be good to you, for a lifetime."
When Qin Xiaoxu heard this, her cheeks flushed with a rosy tint; she was quite a shy person and started to laugh.
Now she had finally fully understood what kind of person Lin Jie really was. Lin Jie was too reserved and it was necessary for her to take the initiative. It wasn't that Lin Jie didn't like her, but rather that he valued her so much he got caught up in his thoughts about how to behave around her.
Meanwhile, after hanging up the phone with Lin Jie, Lin Yi lay on the bed laughing for quite some time.
Han Xuewei sat beside him, joining in the laughter.
"Xiaoxu has always thought differently from others since she was young, but the things Lin Jie did were indeed quite misleading.
Their progress is way too slow, isn't it? Although he did manage to feed that guy..."
While Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Yi continued to laugh, slapping the bed.
"The two of them are just too funny. How come it's completely different from our time."

chapters.title: Chapter 214 Mengmeng Falls Ill
chapters.content:
At that moment, Lin Yi got close to Han Xuewei's face, smiling, "When I was with you, we even went all the way..."
As Lin Yi spoke, he conjured a meaningful smile.
Hearing this, Han Xuewei's face blushed furiously, and she quickly pushed Lin Yi away, "Stop talking about that!"
Lin Yi, however, did not back off but continued to look at her with a mischievous grin.
While they were talking, Han's mother came in, her face etched with worry, and she said directly, "Lin Yi, Mengmeng seems to be sick. I just saw her with a runny nose, and she yawned and sneezed. I think she might have a cold..."
Hearing this, both Lin Yi and Han Xuewei immediately became anxious.
A child's illness cannot be taken lightly at all.
The two of them jumped up anxiously. If Mengmeng's illness was serious, it could also affect the other children, so Lin Yi always tried to keep them separate as much as possible. They all hoped the children could always be healthy because the waiting period during illness was just too wearing.
At that time, Han's mother also said, "She had a runny nose this morning; I didn't think much of it at the time, wiped it away, and it stopped. But in the evening, she started sneezing again and had a runny nose. I felt something wasn't right. Maybe it's because the weather has been hot lately, and they always fuss when the air conditioning isn't on.
Last night we forgot to turn off the air conditioning, and you know how children easily kick off their blankets. Maybe she caught a cold?"
As she spoke, Han's mother seemed a bit guilty, as if she had not taken proper care of the children.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi immediately said, "It's okay. It's not your fault, mom. A little cold is nothing to worry about; just make sure she drinks plenty of water. Good rest will help her recover. Luckily, there's no fever; it's just a minor symptom for a child."
While speaking, Han's mother nodded and then suggested, "Then for tonight, let Mengmeng sleep in this room so she won't risk infecting the others in the baby room..."
Lin Yi nodded and replied, "It's alright. We'll take extra care of her tonight. Thank you for your hard work, mom."
After saying that, the two mothers nodded and left without any further comment.
At this point, Han Xuewei quickly picked up Mengmeng, who looked pale from illness. She felt a pang of heartache looking at her adorable and usually healthy daughter now struggling with sickness.
Seeing this, Lin Yi walked over to Han Xuewei and said, "Don't worry about it now. She probably just caught a cold. Kids actually have weak immune systems and get sick easily; it's quite normal. Tomorrow, I'll take a day off and take Mengmeng to the doctor."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei still showed a worried expression. As a mother, how could she focus on classes when her child was sick? She immediately responded, "Then I need to take a day off as well."
After she finished speaking, Lin Yi didn't object but simply patted her shoulder and said, "You go take a shower first. I'll put Mengmeng to bed." Saying this, he took Mengmeng in his arms and gently stroked her round little head.
Mengmeng was drowsy, but probably because of her illness, she had difficulty falling asleep.
Han Xuewei looked pained but still made her way to the shower. Lin Yi was holding Mengmeng at this time, singing nursery rhymes to comfort her.
Mengmeng couldn't fall asleep; her nose kept making uncomfortable sounds, as if she were congested. Seeing her breathe with such difficulty, Lin Yi realized she could only breathe through her mouth.
He immediately got out the medicine box, retrieved the same Potion used before for clearing the nose, applied it inside Mengmeng's nostrils. The scent of the Potion was just right, but it was still a bit strong for a child.
Mengmeng made a sound of discomfort and mumbled a few words. Lin Yi immediately comforted her softly, "Mengmeng, don't be afraid, it's just a little bit of Potion, you'll feel better soon."
As Lin Yi spoke, Mengmeng's breathing eventually became gentle and even, and she fell asleep in his arms.
Lin Yi gently placed Mengmeng in the cradle with a sigh of relief, and Han Xuewei came out, going over to check on Mengmeng.
Han Xuewei urged Lin Yi to go take a shower. He nodded and entered the bathroom. After a while, after Lin Yi finished his shower and was drying his hair with a towel, he just stepped out.
Han Xuewei's face turned pale and she called out urgently, "Husband, Mengmeng seems to have a fever. Quick, grab the keys and drive to the hospital!"
"Just now, Mengmeng's face turned pale; I thought something was wrong. I just picked her up and she vomited her milk, then she started coughing non-stop. I took her temperature with the thermometer, she's starting to have a low fever!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi felt nervous and immediately picked up the keys and said, "I'll have them prepare things right now, I'm heading downstairs immediately!"
A child's fever can't be delayed for a moment, and Han Xuewei was very anxious. She held Mengmeng close and gently soothed her, immediately heading to the baby's room.
Aunty Liu was still in the room watching over the other two children. Han Xuewei instructed her, "Aunty Liu, could you please prepare some warm water, and some tissues? Also bring some diapers and wet wipes; I need to take Mengmeng to the hospital, she's got a fever. Get me a bag to put these in..."
Han Xuewei was speaking urgently. Aunty Liu immediately nodded her head and went into the room to collect the items. Enjoy exclusive chapters from empire
At this moment, Lin Yi's parents woke up and came to the second floor to see what was happening. Mother Lin saw Han Xuewei's anxious look and immediately asked, "Vivi, what's happened?"
Han Xuewei looked up and replied, "Mom, Mengmeng just took her temperature with the thermometer and she's running a slight fever. She also vomited and afterward started coughing. I'm worried her fever might worsen, so I've asked Lin Yi to go downstairs to drive us."
Upon hearing this, Mother Lin, worried, said, "Then I'll come with you to the hospital!"
Children's resistance is naturally low, and a sickness can make the whole family anxious. Lin Yi had just driven the car out, feeling a bit of regret in his heart. He should have shared the Divine Water he got from the system with his family earlier.
After all, the Divine Water definitely had significant healing effects, and it would probably mean less sickness.
With that thought, Lin Yi decided that in the future, he would share some Body Strengthening Divine Water with his family to improve their health, so they wouldn't get sick so easily.
At this moment, the system's voice sounded, as if offering a gentle reminder, "Body Tempering Divine Water can only enhance a person's resistance and immunity; it doesn't mean that one will never get sick after drinking it."

chapters.title: Chapter 215 A Medical Team
chapters.content:
Hearing the system's voice, Lin Yi's eyebrows lifted immediately, and the system continued, "Body Tempering Divine Water can only enhance the body's defenses, but it cannot completely isolate viruses, just like if a person gets a cold or some common flu, it can't prevent illness from happening afterward, but only lessen the symptoms."
"Moreover, drinking Body Strengthening Divine Water only has a preventive effect. If faced with an extremely destructive disease, one can still be affected, just with reduced impact."
As the system spoke, Lin Yi nodded, but he still thought it would be a good idea for his family to drink it, as it could boost their immunity somewhat.
At this time, Han Xuewei was already holding Mengmeng and had come downstairs, followed by Mother Lin. Father Lin originally wanted to come as well, but stayed behind after being dissuaded by Mother Lin.
Aunt Liu, holding a bag of things, followed behind Han Xuewei, and Lin Yi, driving the car, took them all into the vehicle.
At this moment, Lin Yi was extremely anxious, driving at a high speed, while Han Xuewei anxiously watched Mengmeng throughout the journey.
Soon, they reached the city's largest hospital. There were many clinics near their home, but Lin Yi thought they were unreliable, so he decided to go directly to the hospital.
Upon arrival at the hospital, he saw a long line waiting ahead.
Lin Yi felt somewhat helpless, as most of those in line were parents with children, and many of the children were about Mengmeng's age. This season is a period when seasonal flu is prevalent, so children with lower immunity often get infected.
During this changing season, sensitivity is even higher. Lin Yi looked at the long queue ahead, with Han Xuewei waiting anxiously at the back.
Seeing this scene, Lin Yi couldn't help but sigh, thinking that having a personal doctor would have been better, for there would have been no need to queue up like this late at night.
Lin Yi was reminded again of the Body Tempering Divine Water he had obtained from the system. If he could have done more research on those Divine Waters, couldn't he have opened his own pharmaceutical company?
This seemed like a good idea, after all, those Body Strengthening Divine Waters were gifted by the system. Although they could not directly combat illnesses, they could slow down their progress and enhance immunity; prevention was quite nice.
Even though there were such medicines available now, the Body Strengthening Divine Water was a gift from the system, with effects that were definitely outstanding, making it the best potential medicine.
With these thoughts in mind, Lin Yi went to register Mengmeng. After getting a number, he returned and ate. At that moment, a nurse walked past Lin Yi, reaching Han Xuewei directly.
She held a thermometer, and as Han Xuewei, holding Mengmeng, saw the nurse approaching, she immediately opened her hand.
The nurse skillfully placed the thermometer on Mengmeng. The thermometer felt cool and Mengmeng, already uncomfortable from being sick, was particularly sensitive to the touch, prompting her to start crying.
Due to her cold, as she cried, she also coughed, soon turning her face red with distress. Seeing this, Han Xue was extremely heartbroken and immediately started comforting Mengmeng.
"Mengmeng is a good girl, mommy's here, right here... Don't be afraid, don't be afraid..." Han Xuewei said, and Lin Yi, feeling very distressed, moved closer to Han Xuewei's side to comfort Mengmeng together.
Perhaps because Mengmeng had adapted to the coldness of the thermometer, she was no longer crying, and merely took some deep breaths through her nose.
Seeing Mengmeng not crying, Han Xuewei let out a sigh of relief. Being a first-time mother, her baby's illness was the most worrying thing to her. Watching her sick child made her heart ache as well.
At this moment, Lin Yi felt he could no longer just wait idly. He thought of Zhou Jianlai from the Romeo Security Company.
Zhou Jianlai was the captain of the entire security team, and perhaps his company might have a specialized medical team—after all, the company was large and might even have private doctors.
With this in mind, Lin Yi immediately picked up his phone and made a call. He had to seize the opportunity now because if they had to wait in such a long line, it would undoubtedly delay a lot of time.
Mengmeng's condition wasn't good, and Han Xuewei was so worried. Han Xuewei tried to give Mengmeng some water, but even drinking water would cause Mengmeng to throw up.
Lin Yi was on the phone, and the call was immediately connected on the other side.
Zhou Jianlai had Lin Yi's number saved, so he immediately began to speak, "Mr. Lin..."
Lin Yi got straight to the point, "My daughter is sick. I remember you mentioning that your company has a lot of emergency equipment and a medical team. Is it possible to have the medical team come over..."
As Lin Yi was speaking, Zhou Jianlai immediately nodded and replied, "Indeed, we have a medical team here, and they are all private. If Mr. Lin needs it, I can have them go there right now!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi suddenly felt some joy. Looking at Mengmeng's pale face, he quickly asked, "Can they come to my house now?"
Hearing this, Zhou Jianlai nodded and said, "Yes, if you need it, we can arrange for them to go directly to your home to attend to the child."
Lin Yi didn't plan on making another trip, after all, if he were to go back home, it would be more troublesome. It would be better to have the medical personnel come to the hospital directly, so Lin Yi immediately replied, "I'm currently at the Central Hospital. Can you send someone here right away, um, as soon as possible?"
Upon hearing this, Zhou Jianlai smiled and said, "Rest assured, Mr. Lin, we already have quite a few people training at the Central Hospital, and they all came from there. I'll speak to them now, and it should take only about fifteen minutes for them to come down and find you!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi's face lit up with excitement. He had initially thought it would take the personnel some time to drive over, but it turned out they were already inside the Central Hospital. Explore new worlds at empire
"Then ask them to move quickly. The child has a fever, and we can't delay," Lin Yi said, and on the other end of the line, they immediately nodded in agreement.
After hanging up the phone, Zhou Jianlai immediately called the doctors at the Central Hospital.
Mother Lin, seeing the expression on Lin Yi's face as he made the call, asked nervously, "Is there a meeting you have to attend, or is there something else? If you're busy and need to go, then go ahead. I'll take care of them!"
"No, Mom! It's just a friend of mine. He has a medical team here at this hospital, and I've asked them to come and help."

chapters.title: Chapter 216 No Big Problem
chapters.content:
Hearing Lin Yi's words, Han Xuewei immediately showed a look of surprise. Mother Lin was also somewhat astonished, and she quickly said, "Lin Yi, are you telling the truth? You really know the doctors here, that would be the best! Have them come down directly to see our Mengmeng."
As Mother Lin spoke, Han Xuewei, holding Mengmeng, also quickly added, "But won't it bother other people, it's not like they will neglect other patients to come see ours, right?"
While Han Xuewei said this, she was indeed afraid that her own privilege would cause others to miss their medical treatment time.
After all, every child is someone's child, Lin Yi immediately shook his head.
"No, they aren't involved with the hospital's doctors at all, they are private doctors doing their own work."
As Lin Yi explained, Han Xuewei suddenly breathed a sigh of relief and said, "Lucky for us that you have connections here, husband, otherwise who knows when we would get help."
Han Xuewei said this with some joy.
Lin Yi just nodded without saying anything else.
After all, if the people he called were actually the hospital doctors treating children, there would certainly be objections, but since he called his own private medical team, there was nothing inappropriate about it.
They waited for a few minutes, and then a male doctor in a white lab coat, wearing gold-rimmed glasses and accompanied by several nurses, came walking over to them.
Upon reaching Lin Yi, he said directly, "You must be Mr. Lin Yi."
Lin Yi, hearing this, nodded.
"Correct!"
Upon hearing this reply, the male doctor respectfully nodded and said, "Then, please come this way with me!"
Saying this, the doctor led Lin Yi, along with Han Xuewei and the others, to go with him.
Lin Yi followed to a partitioned room, took the thermometer from Mengmeng and handed it to the nurse, saying, "This is the temperature we just took."
The male doctor, hearing this, waited for the nurse to check it out.
"This is almost thirty-nine degrees, a pretty high temperature for a child..."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei frowned even harder, anxiously looking at Mengmeng.
At this time, Mengmeng's little face was all scrunched up, and the male doctor, who initially thought it was just a minor issue and came to a small partition, realized the equipment there wasn't sufficient and said, "Mr. Lin Yi, let us go up to the emergency department on the top floor, to my place!"
As the doctor spoke, he took them to the elevator, and soon they arrived upstairs.
The doctor then sat down at his workplace and said, "Mrs. Lin, bring the child over."
The nurse remained close by the doctor's side.
"What time did the fever start today? This morning, it was just a slight cold, and then in the evening. There was no fever initially, just a cold which probably caused the fever. The temperature at the time was just a low-grade fever, not yet thirty-eight degrees. I guess it might have been delayed a bit, and the temperature rose, and it took quite a while on the road..."
As Han Xuewei spoke, Mother Lin also chimed in, "This morning there was a bit of a runny nose, but it wasn't that serious, and we didn't expect the sneezing to start in the evening."
Hearing this, the male doctor seemed to understand the symptoms and took out his stethoscope to listen to Mengmeng.
The stethoscope was a bit cold, which made Mengmeng cry immediately, but the doctor was very careful, warming the stethoscope with his hand before touching Mengmeng again.
Mengmeng had stopped crying by this point, but she still looked uncomfortable. The doctor then addressed Han Xuewei, "Mrs. Lin, could you have the child open her mouth, please?"
As he spoke, Han Xuewei reached out to pinch Mengmeng's mouth, but Mengmeng was reluctant to open it. The doctor took a small wooden stick directly, inserting it into Mengmeng's mouth, causing her discomfort, which made her open her mouth.
The doctor, holding a flashlight, examined her and said, "The child's throat is not comfortable; it's already inflamed. I'll start by writing a prescription, then we'll take a blood sample to see if it's just some common flu virus. That way, we can treat the symptoms accurately."
"Yes, come over here, and we'll draw a little blood to see if there's any other infection."
The male doctor spoke as his hands clattered away on the computer keyboard. Hearing this, Han Xuewei looked at Mengmeng's pale little face, filled with pity.
"To have such a small child draw blood..."
Lin Yi too showed a helpless expression. They had taken care of Mengmeng these past days and could not bear to see her hurt at all.
The male doctor could tell from their expressions that they were new parents, therefore especially concerned. He immediately said, "We won't draw much, just a little blood sample. Frankly, one could use a syringe to make a small cut and collect the first few drops of blood, but since the child is so young, we'll just use a syringe to draw a little. It won't hurt much."
The male doctor was quite understanding of Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's worries.
A nurse beside them simply smiled and approached Mengmeng with a small syringe.
The female nurse crouched down while Han Xuewei gently held Mengmeng, spreading out her hand. The nurse was very gentle, and Mengmeng's eyes were open, looking bemusedly at the nurse.
"It's okay, little one, I'll be very gentle..."
The female nurse was very soft-spoken, reaching out towards Mengmeng's hand, which Mengmeng watched passively.
When the needle pierced the skin, Mengmeng cried out, and the nurse gently drew a few drops of blood.
And yet Mengmeng was still crying, and crying made it easy for her to cough. Seeing her like this, Han Xuewei couldn't stand it and immediately started to soothe her.
Mengmeng's face was bright red, coughing so hard that her entire body was uncomfortable, and the nurse looked at her with a sense of guilt. After a while of consoling, Mengmeng quieted down.
The nurse then took the blood sample to the machine for testing. Lin Yi asked, "How long until we get the results?"
"It'll just take about ten minutes!" The nurse answered, working on the machine.
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei silently waited nearby. After a short while, the results came out, and with a beep, the reports were printed out from the computer.

chapters.title: Chapter 217 Father and Son
chapters.content:
The doctor looked at the computer with great composure and spoke while holding the report in his hand, "Mr. Lin, I have seen the results of the blood sample. The child has a minor flu infection, which has caused a fever, but it's not severe. This situation is quite common, and I'll prescribe some antipyretic powder first.
Then, I will also add some oral solutions for the child to take after the antipyretic powder. Since the child can only take powder, I will grind some extra for you to keep at home. All these medications are suitable for children under three years of age."
As the male doctor spoke, he placed the report on the table and handed the list of medications he had just selected to the nurse.
The nurse immediately went to the back to prepare the medications. The doctor simply looked at Mengmeng's adorable face and said, "I'll prescribe some antipyretic medicine for the child to take, along with some oral solution. Children nowadays can't bear injections, and I estimate that the child will recover after taking the medication."
Han Xuewei, holding Mengmeng, expressed her gratitude, "Do we pay here, or should we go down to the lobby to settle the bill?" Han Xuewei said, and the male doctor looked at Lin Yi somewhat surprised.
He hadn't mentioned anything about charging; he had just come over following orders from above, so how could he dare to charge his own boss?
But seeing Han Xuewei's response, the doctor realized that his low-key boss probably hadn't been honest with his wife, so he said, "There's no need for that. This will be taken care of on the company's books. We will contact Mr. Lin about it later..."
Hearing what he said, Han Xuewei didn't think too much of it.
The nurse had already prepared the medicine, which for a child of that age would be powder, hence it was one packet after another, each with a medical record sticker explaining clearly how to take it and the dosage.
Mother Lin finally felt a weight lifted from her shoulders and took the medications, saying, "I really thank you all."
"Auntie, there's no need to be polite. It's all part of the service."
While they were at the hospital, Han Xuewei fed Mengmeng some of the medicine with a spoon and water. It had to be said that the powder was incredibly bitter, causing Mengmeng's cute face to contort when she took it.
Fortunately, Mengmeng was very well-behaved and didn't have the energy to fuss, so the medicine was administered in no time. After finishing it, Mengmeng's complexion began to show signs of improvement.
At that moment, Han Xuewei smiled with a great sense of relief, while Lin Yi led them out of the hospital. Just as they exited the corridor, Lin Yi heard the system notification.
"Ding! Congratulations to the host for completing the emergency task of taking care of the baby. The reward for the host is one Huadian Charity Foundation!"
Upon hearing the system's voice, Lin Yi was initially skeptical that he had misheard — he was being rewarded with a foundation, which encompassed an enormous amount of money.
Was the system now changing his path from being a wealthy businessman to becoming a kind-hearted capitalist?
However, the system now required him to complete such a task. He couldn't figure out why at the moment.
But a gift from the system was his property, so he didn't dwell on it and led his family away from the hospital lobby.
Lin Yi walked ahead, instructing them to wait at the hospital while he went to fetch the car.
Considering the strong wind outside, Lin Yi planned to bring the car directly to the entrance to pick them up. After Lin Yi gave the instructions, Han Xuewei and the others nodded in agreement.
At this moment, Han Xuewei saw Mengmeng regain her energy and instantly showed a delighted expression.
At that moment, Mother Lin also raised her hand to play with Mengmeng.
Mengmeng's condition had improved quite a bit. As they stood at his door, Han Xuewei looked forward and saw a lean man sitting at the entrance with a child in his arms; both of their expressions were filled with helplessness.
The man held a medical record in his hand, sighing with a sense of helplessness as he looked at his child.
At that moment, Han Xuewei, standing at the door, met his gaze. The man, seeing Han Xuewei as if spotting hope, started walking towards them with the child in his arms.
Han Xuewei was also somewhat surprised. The man, looking at Han Xuewei with resignation, said, "Ma'am, can you help me out? I brought my child here for treatment. I've spent all my money, my savings are gone, and now I can't even afford food. My child has been hungry for quite a while, he hasn't eaten anything all day. Could you give me a little money, just two or three dollars to buy some food?
I really don't have any money left..."
As the man spoke, a distressed look crossed his face, the kind of look that only those who have experienced despair can show, that only comes after being washed by hardships.
The child in his arms, hearing his not so clear words, seemed to understand yet not, but started crying along as well, truly very hungry.
Han Xuewei, looking at the two of them, immediately showed a surprised expression.
Both Mother Lin and Han Xuewei were a bit astonished as they looked forward. Han Xuewei was always wary of strangers she encountered on the road, as there were indeed many who used such means to scam food and drink.
Scamming a few dollars was one thing for Han Xuewei, but some news was even more cruel. Some scammers actually targeted those with children, planning to kidnap the children to sell them.
Thinking this, Han Xuewei couldn't help but become vigilant, but at this time Mother Lin stepped forward to look at the piece of paper in the man's hand.
The man, realizing they might not believe him, lifted the medical record and handed it over to them.
Mother Lin, after one glance, became a bit flustered and said, "Vivi, this child has leukemia."
On hearing 'leukemia,' people instinctively feel a bit scared. The man started to cry, exhaling resignedly, "Yes, it was confirmed today at the hospital. I had noticed something was off with my child, but I never imagined it would be like this.
I'm completely out of money now. I wanted to take my child home, but now I don't even have the money for a cab ride. He's very hungry at the moment. I just want to get him something to eat. If it were possible, I'd lay down my life for my child to bear all this; he's still so young." With that, the man couldn't help but choke up.
Han Xuewei, watching the two of them, felt a tinge of compassion.
Stay tuned for updates on empire
The man sighed deeply and knelt down right in front of Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei immediately reached out to help him up, "Sir, please get up, we can talk things over slowly, let me get my aunt here to buy you some food first."
Han Xuewei immediately spoke up after looking at them.
After all, Lin Yi had people here. If it was indeed a sickness, he could have someone come down to check.
And at that moment, Lin Yi's car happened to drive up and witnessed the scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 218 Charity Fund
chapters.content:
Lin Yi looked up and saw Han Xuewei in the distance, helping a man to his feet. The sight made Lin Yi frown—he was all too familiar with this kind of thing.
After all, he often heard news on TV about a new type of fraud involving people pretending to be sick or pitiable and then taking advantage of those who offered to help them.
Some did it for money, while others did it to kidnap children, so Lin Yi was on alert and immediately stopped his car and walked toward the scene.
In the meantime, Aunt Liu had bought several hamburgers and a few cups of cola, and she approached the man.
The little boy, seeing the food, immediately reached out to grab it—he was just too hungry, and he had hardly ever eaten something like a hamburger before. The smell alone was enough to make him lose control.
The man, seeing the child's impolite gesture, slapped the boy's hand away.
At the slap, tears nearly spilled from the little boy's eyes; the man had not been gentle, "You can't be so rude!" the man scolded, and then respectfully took the food from Aunt Liu and bowed his head, saying, "Thank you so much, really, I'm so grateful. Good people will get their reward..."
While speaking, he patted the little boy's head.
Your next read awaits at empire
The little boy, hearing this, nodded as well, "Thank you."
At the hospital entrance, a lot of people had gathered, and upon seeing the man, they started murmuring to each other.
"Did you see that man? I think I saw him here a couple of days ago; he's been hanging around this area asking for food, but he doesn't seem to beg for money much."
"Oh, come on, if he were here to ask for money and didn't get any, why would he keep coming back? Money doesn't just walk away."
"You folks don't know? The news lately has been fierce about people who come to hospitals pretending to be sick. They're clearly angling for the wealthy; rich people don't fuss over these things, do they?"
"Look at those people over there, their clothing is so fancy, they're definitely not from your average family!"
"That can't be right. I just heard about them over the hospital PA system this morning; isn't that little boy sick?"
"Have you not heard about the new kind of fraud, where they say it's all a scheme to kidnap kids? You know, with the hospital being such a hectic place, full of sick children and with adults sometimes not paying enough attention, their kids could just wander off..."
People were talking all over the place, and at that moment, Han Xuewei, despite what she overheard, looked resolute; she believed she hadn't misjudged the situation.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi approached her and asked, "What's happened?"
Han Xuewei looked at the man in front of her and replied, "Honey, that little boy has leukemia, and they don't have the money for treatment. It seems they can only go back home now.
I find it too heartbreaking; such a young child afflicted with such a serious disease," she said, unwittingly casting a glance at her own child, Mengmeng, who was by then asleep.
Since becoming a mother, Han Xuewei has become more sensitive to everything around her, especially to seeing these kinds of situations—the little boy was now gobbling down the hamburger, his eyes wide, clear, and bright.
It was just too much for anyone to bear seeing a child so young suffer like this; upon hearing this, the man wiped away his tears, saying, "Thank you all very much. It's alright, children getting sick is just fate. If I weren't so helpless, maybe I could save my child. But with this disease, he probably doesn't have much time left."
The man sighed. If he had the ability, he would undoubtedly want to save his own child by any means necessary, but he couldn't morally coerce others into helping. He was already grateful for the willingness he'd encountered.
Not wanting to waste anyone else's time, he held his child and began to retreat toward the back, planning to leave, when Lin Yi looked at the man before him.
For Lin, such a matter was not significant. However, he wasn't the type to help out at the sight of suffering, for then he wouldn't have a life of his own—he couldn't possibly step outside and help everyone he met.
After all, every living being suffers, and one can only liberate oneself.
