But Lin Yi spoke up, "Sir, don't be in a hurry. I know of a charity foundation. They provide help for people in difficult situations like yours. I can contact them for you. Maybe there's hope."
As Lin Yi spoke, he had already decided to help after seeing the sad look on Han Xuewei's face. Han Xuewei was a kind person who, when faced with such circumstances, always wanted to help a little more if she could.
Lin Yi was now quite capable, and whether to help or not depended solely on his own decision.
Upon hearing these words, the man's eyes widened with excitement. Holding his child, he was about to kneel down again, "Really? Sir, is there really a chance? That would be wonderful, I'm so grateful..."
The man spoke and was about to kneel when Lin Yi and Han Xuewei immediately stepped forward to lift him up.
"Yes, there might be a chance!"
Lin Yi said while helping him up and added, "Don't worry just yet. Let me make a phone call and talk to them."
Lin Yi said this and directly called Zhou Jianlai. When Zhou Jianlai took the call, he was somewhat worried—could it be that the medical team wasn't reliable?
Zhou Jianlai answered the call nervously, but Lin Yi's unhurried voice came through from the other end.
"Zhou Jianlai, I'm at the entrance of this hospital. Just as I was leaving, I came across a man and his child. His child has leukemia and needs to be hospitalized now. Have the doctor we just talked to come down to receive them, and we will take care of all the expenses."
After Lin Yi finished speaking, Zhou Jianlai immediately nodded in agreement and hung up the call.
Lin Yi liked dealing with Zhou Jianlai for many things, largely because Zhou Jianlai's methods were efficient.
After making the call, Lin Yi then phoned the president of the Huadian Charity Foundation, which the system had granted him.
Once the system gave him a company, it would add all the contact information and everything else to his phone. Therefore, Lin Yi could easily find the number and call. The voice that immediately rang out on the other end was cordial.
"Hello, Mr. Lin. How can I assist you today?" The voice on the other end was Wang Shaogang, the president of the foundation.
Wang Shaogang was somewhat surprised to receive a call from Lin Yi, a major figure in their foundation. He hadn't expected him to make a call.
Lin Yi simply recounted the situation he had encountered. Wang Shaogang immediately understood and responded, "Please rest assured, Mr. Lin. We'll handle this matter. Our team will go out to verify and have them fill out the registration. As long as the situation is confirmed as true, we can cover all the medical expenses."

chapters.title: Chapter 219 Gratitude
chapters.content:
Wang Shaogang was eagerly speaking while Lin Yi simply nodded indifferently.
"We will bear all sorts of risks and conditions on this side to ensure that the child won't have to worry about the expenses during the process. However, if the child's problem is too severe and incurable, then there's nothing we can do…"
As Wang Shaogang spoke, in reality, they would also help some people as a funding association, which always involved some investment or connections. Ordinary people like this usually wouldn't have the chance to get to know their foundation, let alone come in contact with it.
After all, this was still a service leaning towards the upper class which wasn't widespread among the general public, but since it was Lin Yi who asked, he naturally arranged it immediately.
At this moment, Lin Yi simply nodded and then hung up the phone.
Right now, the man was holding his child, who had eaten a burger and drank half a bottle of cola, showing a satisfied expression,
Lin Yi looked at them and then turned to Han Xuewei.
At this time, Han Xuewei furrowed her brows, asking Lin Yi how well the arrangements had been made. Lin Yi just nodded, and Han Xuewei felt relieved.
Han Xuewei knew that Lin Yi wasn't lacking money, and as for herself, she wasn't short on money either. She could completely afford the cost of treating leukemia.
However, this could be a huge burden for an ordinary family. Many ordinary families with a child suffering from such a disease would nearly face ruin; the suffering of ordinary people was so cruel and real.
If the child couldn't be cured, then even tons of money would be of no help.
To Han Xuewei, a few million was like a diamond ring on her finger, which when removed, the millions dangled above the tabletop. The life of a child was the same; a child with leukemia needed millions for treatment, yet the value was like that of a diamond ring, this world was inherently unequal.
But Han Xuewei always maintained her sincere and eager heart, always willing to help as much as she could.
She wouldn't be stingy. If she hadn't encountered them, that would be another matter, but having met them, and knowing their situation was real, she couldn't just ignore it.
She could do without those diamond rings; she wished for a healthy child in this world.
Lin Yi certainly knew of Han Xuewei's kind nature, so he would definitely not ignore the situation. Actually, if he had encountered such a case on a normal day, he wouldn't have had the time or energy to deal with it.
He was rather indifferent towards these matters; men have always stood on a rational perspective. Even if he helped one person, there were millions of others suffering in the world, and it was impossible to help them all.
But Han Xuewei was different. Both were subtly influencing each other. By this time, Lin Yi had already arranged everything and approached the man, saying, "Mr., you don't need to worry anymore. I have already contacted the relevant people, and they will cover your medical expenses.
The foundation is quite good, and they won't ignore such matters."
Upon hearing this, the man immediately bowed his head in gratitude. Seeing that Lin Yi didn't let him kneel, he firmly held his child and knelt down before Lin Yi.
The child was only two or three years old and couldn't speak clearly. At this moment, he knelt in front of Lin Yi. Lin Yi wanted to stop them but seeing the man's hands clench with veins protruding from his stubborn grip,
Because he could not repay anything, he was simply trying his best to express his gratitude in his own way.
Lin Yi didn't know what else to say, and Han Xuewei at this moment crouched down with him, reaching out to help both the child and the man back to their feet.
Han Xuewei spoke directly, "Mr., don't worry. Take good care of the child; we've already made arrangements for these issues. The child will be alright."
As Han Xuewei spoke, the male doctor who had treated him just now came over, followed by several nurses, quickly approaching Lin Yi.
And at this moment, a middle-aged man in a white coat also arrived. The male doctor stood by his side as if he were an apprentice. The middle-aged man looked at Lin Yi, took a deep breath, and said, "Mr. Lin, I truly apologize, I've been held up by some matters. I'm the head of the medical department here, Dong Wentao."
The man hurriedly spoke, and Lin Yi simply nodded, saying, "No worries, Director Dong. Could you first take a look at this child for me?"
Dong Wentao, having already been briefed on the situation, directly held the medical report and said, "Mr. Lin, I have already looked through the medical records. This little friend was indeed diagnosed with leukemia this morning at our hospital.
From today onwards, we will formally admit him to the hospital and arrange a more spacious private room. Tomorrow, we can conduct a full-body examination and assign the best doctors to treat him. Our hospital has the most authoritative leukemia specialists, and they will certainly cure him."
As Dong Wentao spoke, Lin Yi simply nodded and said, "I've already arranged for the Huadian Charity Foundation to take over, so we don't need the hospital to cover the cost. Just make sure to provide the best equipment, medicine, and conditions for them."
Lin Yi spoke, and Dong Wentao nodded earnestly, immediately responding, "Yes, yes, as Mr. Lin says. Then, please Mr. Li and young Li Dongjun follow us inside."
After saying this, the nurses beside them quickly led them forward.
At that moment, the man showed a look of excitement, tears welling up in his eyes. He had been without hope and ready to resign himself to fate, but unexpectedly he met Lin Yi and Han Xuewei, such kind-hearted people.
His eyes brimming with tears, he continuously thanked them.
He regarded Lin Yi and his group as the greatest benefactors in his life. Lin Yi shook his head and said, "You don't need to thank me; really, there's no need!"
Seeing the man's excited expression, Lin Tian turned to Han Xuewei, "If you must thank someone, it should be my wife. If it weren't for her, I probably wouldn't have come across you."
Lin Yi said, understanding his own heart quite well. He was a person who usually didn't meddle in others' business.
At this time, the man looked towards Han Xuewei and sobbed, "Thank you so much, Mrs. Lin. You truly are a person beautiful both inside and out."
As the man spoke, from the first moment he saw Han Xuewei, he felt she was exceptionally beautiful. People who were as beautiful and kind as her were very rare in this world.
Han Xuewei just smiled gently and said, "Actually, there's no need for thanks. It's all just a small effort, and we all hope the child will be well."

chapters.title: Chapter 220 Spread
chapters.content:
Soon, the matter was dealt with, and the man took his child and followed Dong Wentao and the others away.
Lin Yi also said his goodbyes to them at this time, his gaze following the man's figure. He couldn't help but ponder the Divine Pill he had obtained before that could cure all diseases. It was a truly sacred thing, but due to the limited availability of the Divine Pill, Lin Yi had not taken it out.
However, he felt that by doing this much, he had already fulfilled his moral duty.
At this moment, Lin Yi thought of himself. Previously, he had also received a universal amount card from the system, which could be exchanged for an endless number of things. He wondered if the universal amount could be used here to allocate some Divine Pills for use.
Just as Lin Yi was entertaining this thought, the system's voice sounded.
"Ding! The system kindly reminds the host not to think about it anymore. Such a thing is impossible. The scarcity of the Divine Pill is sufficient to prove its preciousness, and even ordinary elixirs cannot be provided by the system. It was just a coincidence, and the host should cherish it even more."
Hearing this, Lin Yi felt a bit disappointed and couldn't help but laugh awkwardly.
But then he thought that the universal card should allow him to exchange for other things. Since those Divine Pills were so scarce and rare in the world that they could not be exchanged, the Body Tempering Divine Water that the system had given him before should be exchangeable, right?
After all, those items were not so miraculous; they were just a bit more high-level than ordinary medicines, Lin Yi mused. At that moment, the system issued a prompt.
"The universal card can be exchanged for many things, and items like the Body Strengthening Divine Water can be exchanged too!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi was overjoyed. If he could really exchange for Body Tempering Divine Water, he could prepare to start a pharmaceutical company that specialized in selling these medical treatments that also improved immunity and various aspects of bodily functions.
Because he had been wanting to start this for a while, especially since in this era, the market was crazy about overpriced elderly health care products which often just defrauded people of their money. Many times, people would gullibly fall for these things, all wishing to be in good health and not to be a burden to their children.
Therefore, many people, especially those with limited discernment capabilities, were interested in those heavily advertised health care products, which was complete fraud!
If Lin Yi opened a pharmaceutical shop targeted at the elderly, he could make a meaningful impact on the market.
Thinking this, Lin Yi spoke to the system: "Then, can I use that endless card to exchange for an endless supply of Body Tempering Divine Water?"
This time, the system easily agreed.
"That's possible, oh!"
After the system finished speaking, Lin Yi immediately proceeded with the exchange. Soon, he had exchanged for an infinite supply of Body Tempering Divine Water, which he then stored in his system space.
After the successful exchange, Lin Yi's face lit up with excitement. However, since he still wanted to start a pharmaceutical company, he hoped to have a direct supply of medicines. But since the system had not given them to him directly, he planned to set it up himself when he had the time later on.
At this moment, Han Xuewei had calmed down and began to play with Mengmeng in her arms.
Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei and couldn't help but laugh, saying, "Wife, you really are a person of beauty and kindness."
Lin Yi echoed the words that the man had said before. Han Xuewei, upon hearing this, just smiled and replied, "Ah, you think too highly of me. At first, I also suspected they were swindlers. What I fear most are those child-trafficking scammers, so I didn't believe him.
But seeing their situation and the child's plight, I really felt heartbroken. Now that the hospital staff have arrived and they are not afraid, it just shows that they're truly in trouble."
Lin Yi found her words very reasonable. It was normal to be cautious when encountering such people on the street or in front of the hospital; one couldn't call it indifference, it was just that there were too many bad people in the world, and everyone had to be careful.
And some people, fearing deception, are scared to help which is quite normal. Some kind-hearted individuals who buy things to help them are simply doing their part.
Han Xuewei didn't think she had helped much. As they were talking, they prepared to head back home, but from a distance, someone was recording.
What they had just witnessed at the hospital entrance had caught the attention of some onlookers. Many people were astonished.
They never expected that someone would indeed help them, and even spend hundreds of thousands. Therefore, at this moment, they were all greatly shocked, capturing the incident on their phones. Such topics were always sensitive and could tug at the public's heartstrings.
So, as soon as the story was reported, it immediately surged to the top of the trending topics.
After Lin Yi and Han Xuewei returned home, Mengmeng's condition had improved a lot, especially after taking the powdered medicine, she became more energetic. However, Han Xuewei remained very vigilant and covered her with two blankets.
The next morning, Mengmeng's fever had not subsided, although it had decreased slightly, it still hadn't broken. While feeding Mengmeng her medicine, Han Xuewei used a spoon, distracting Mengmeng's attention, and then unexpectedly fed it to her.
Mengmeng didn't react at first, but the next second, her face twisted with discomfort.
Fortunately, Mengmeng was well-behaved and did not cry. She just moved around a bit and then drank the medicine down.
Lin Yi was also particularly concerned about Mengmeng and kept telling her to drink more water. He also prepared oral rehydration solutions, and Mengmeng's condition had improved a lot.
They had taken leave specially, so there was not much to do at home. Lin Yi decided to turn on the short video platform, planning to watch some videos for entertainment. However, as soon as he opened it, he saw that what had happened the previous evening at the hospital entrance had spread all over the internet.
Netizens online started to discuss it, all praising the couple's actions.
"Oh my! This is really amazing! This couple is so kind. How can they be so loving!"
"It's the most positive video I've seen today; it's just like when I encounter such situations, although I don't have the capacity to do the same!"
"Even wealthy people wouldn't be so generous, after all, leukemia treatment costs hundreds of thousands."
"Yes, and did you see how handsome that man was? He arranged everything in the hospital with just a phone call."
"Plus, the father and son duo looked so pitiful."
"My goodness, who would have thought one could meet someone so rich and yet so kind-hearted..."

chapters.title: Chapter 221 Purpose
chapters.content:
It wasn't long before the incident involving Lin Yi and Han Xuewei made waves online.
Their heroic act and eagerness to help others spread across various online platforms.
Soon, all sorts of media outlets zeroed in on the story, frantically reporting on it to boost their ratings.
After all, it's quite uplifting to hear about ordinary people willing to donate such significant assets to help a stranger.
Before long, the Li father and son duo were interviewed by numerous reporters and quickly surrounded by a throng, all eager for the latest scoop. In front of the cameras, Dad Li displayed his excitement as he shared their hardships and expressed endless gratitude toward Lin Yi and Han Xue for their kindness.
Beyond that, he made a special point to mention the Huadian Charity Foundation for its substantial help.
However, with many media wanting interviews, there was concern about delaying the child's recuperation, so Dad Li declined them. Fortunately, the reporters weren't too persistent and left after a couple of days.
Still, the story continued to buzz on the internet. Since the initial footage was taken by passersby with amateur equipment and from a distance, only the silhouettes of the two individuals were visible, not their actual faces.
However, curious netizens were still very keen to learn what these altruistic individuals looked like.
The netizens were also very enthusiastic...
"This is so amazing, I can't believe there are still such kind-hearted people in this world!"
"Yeah, and they are a young couple too, who you'd think would be focused on supporting their family. I couldn't have imagined they'd do something so shocking."
"You're right. But it seems they must be from wealthy families given their attire!"
"Even among the wealthy, it's rare to see such actions. It's truly news worth reporting."
"That charity organization is incredible too, taking on such a big risk. This kind of selfless spirit is exactly what we need today. What was that charity's name...?"
"It seems to be Huadian Charity Foundation; it's been around for many years. I think we should all donate—only then will the foundation have the funds to operate and continue spreading goodwill."
"That's true, I'm planning to donate too..."
Soon enough, thanks to extensive media promotion, the Huadian Charity Foundation rode a wave of popularity, receiving nearly ten million in donations in just a day or two.
The media continued to follow up, and Li Dongjun's condition remained under media scrutiny. The Huadian Charity Foundation was completely transparent, with no deception involved.
Lin Yi saw all the reports on various social media, which was exactly the outcome he had hoped for. Now he understood why the system had given him the charity foundation.
It was because he was expected to channel some of his wealth into helping others. With this in mind, Lin Yi was very satisfied; such acts of charity were something he would not hesitate to perform.
After all, it was the system that had granted him so much, and often when people are fortunate, they develop even more empathy to help others, preserving their wealth in the process.
Otherwise, had he been an extremely selfish person, perhaps he would not have been chosen by the system at all. As Lin Yi thought this, he now planned to prioritize his career, making it his driving force for effort.
Initially, he had intended to start a business after graduating, but it now seemed imperative to push his entrepreneurial plans forward. He didn't want to give up on his business, his studies, or his family.
More importantly, he aimed to excel at all three: his business, his studies, and his family life. Lin Yi was ambitious but not blindly confident; he believed in his ability to manage it all well.
On that note, he also resolved to be doubly good to Han Xuewei, who was always there to support him, no matter what.
...
Today, because of looking after the baby, Han Xuewei didn't go to school and rested at home instead.
Upon checking her phone, she received a message from Mo Jihua.
"Vivi, why didn't you come to class today? I didn't see you this morning..."
Han Xuewei swiftly replied, "The child was sick today. I took leave to take him to the hospital."
Mo Jihua was surprised to see her message and continued to send another one.
"Do you need me to save today's test and some notes for you? You can copy them when you come."
Seeing this message, Han Xuewei was a bit surprised—she hadn't expected Mo Jihua to be so considerate. However, she was already married and didn't want to keep such an ambiguous relationship with him, so she promptly declined.
"No need, thank you, Teacher Mo."
After Han Xuewei sent this message, Mo Jihua read it but didn't reply any further.
Han Xuewei paid no further attention to it and went to check on the child on the second floor. When she entered the second floor, she saw Lin Yi on the first-floor balcony on the phone and decided not to disturb him.
At that moment, Lin Yi nodded and said, "Alright then, do as you say, and keep a close eye on Han Xuemei's situation for me. Don't let her get even the slightest chance to find out, understand?"
"Of course, Mr. Lin, don't worry at all."
Meanwhile, Han Xuemei was brewing tea, pouring out an entire bottle of yellow liquid with a sly smile on her lips. She approached Dad Han.
When she got to Dad Han, she transformed into a picture of tender care, placing the tea on his desk and saying, "Uncle, it's so hot these days, I brewed you some tea. You should drink it while it's still warm; it's good for your health. And since you've been working so hard lately, drink more—I brewed plenty. Help yourself to more when you're finished."
Moved by her words, Dad Han appreciated how attentive Han Xuemei had been to him. Even though she was his elder brother's daughter, her kindness and compliance made him quite satisfied.
"Thank you, you really do know how to take care of people. Whoever marries you will be a lucky man," he said.
As Dad Han remarked, Han Xuemei just smiled and replied, "Uncle, let's not talk about my marriage. I don't want to marry off so soon. I plan to stay by your side and learn. In the future, I might even help you manage the hotel."
She chuckled as she said this, with an imperceptible gleam of triumph in her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 222 Acquiring the Factory
chapters.content:
Dad Han was very happy, too. Han Xuemei had recently come to his restaurant, and she was committed and diligent in helping out; he saw all of this.
In the past, he had been worried that no one would help him with the restaurant, but now with Han Xuemei around, he felt quite at ease.
At that moment, Han Xuemei, holding a cloth, wiped the countertop and said with a smile, "Uncle, it's almost evening, I'm going to check on how things are in the kitchen."
After she finished speaking, she walked toward the front, and Dad Han nodded and said, "Alright, alright, don't rush, take your time."
As Han Xuemei turned and left, a smug smile formed on her lips, and she couldn't help thinking.
Alright, this is just great, now that you trust me this much, I'll manage the restaurant well for you when the time comes!
Thinking this, she walked toward the kitchen. As long as Dad Han's health wasn't good, Lin Yi would definitely ask Dad Han to retire and then take over personally.
But when Lin Yi takes over the restaurant, he will inevitably need some key staff, and she herself had recently gained a lot of technical knowledge; she had been diligently studying these technical issues, so Lin Yi certainly wouldn't consider letting her go.
As long as there was hope, she might be able to take over the restaurant. Moreover, Han Xuewei had absolutely no interest in the restaurant business; her interest lay only in the arts, so she would never take over the restaurant, making herself the ultimate beneficiary in the end.
At this thought, Han Xuemei felt a surge of pride within.
If she could inherit the restaurant, she would no longer be so humble in front of Han Xuewei, but what she didn't know was that Lin Yi had already seen through all her little tricks.
When the time was right, Lin Yi would definitely deliver a heavy blow.
Two days later, Mengmeng's cold had almost cleared up, and she was no longer running a fever. She still had a bit of a cough, but the doctor said this was normal, so Han Xuewei had peace of mind.
It was fortunate that she had noticed Mengmeng's illness early the last time, allowing Mengmeng to sleep in a different room, while her two brothers slept in another room, avoiding contagion.
After all, children with colds have weaker immune systems, and if they all fell ill at the same time, Han Xuewei would probably be exhausted, but luckily Mengmeng had recovered.
Han's mother and Mother Lin had time to care for the three children together, while Han Xuewei and Lin Yi had returned to school to continue their studies. Many classmates at the school were particularly attentive to the news and had noticed the report about them providing assistance at the hospital entrance that night.
However, they weren't sure if it was Lin Yi and Han Xuewei because the video was too blurry, and the news had protected their privacy very well, without deliberately revealing their names.
But there were still many discussions about it at school.
"Do you think that the news that has been buzzing around lately, about the Huadian Charity Foundation helping the child with leukemia, has anything to do with the school beauty from our school?"
"The silhouette in the video really does look like her!"
"Yeah, it really does look like the two of them, after all, Lin Yi from our school was rumored to come from a very distinguished family, and from that video, the height really matches his," someone said.
"But how can it be so simple? Just a phone call and the matter is resolved? It's impossible for someone ordinary to get involved with Huadian Charity Foundation. Lin Yi's family doesn't have any government officials; how could there possibly be a connection with the charity foundation?"
"Besides, you need national recognition to join a charity foundation, which is harder than getting into a top university."
"Right, the biggest charity organizations recognized by the country are mainly two, one being Huadian Charity Foundation which specializes in helping patients, and the other one is Huichuan Charity Foundation, mainly aiding disabled people. These two foundations are the largest national charities..."
"My gosh, with just these two foundations being recognized, they must be incredibly influential."
"I'm telling you, so if we're really sly, having someone from Huadian Charity Foundation come over is a big deal. We shouldn't spread rumors without confirmation!"
"These foundations are managed by the government, it's not something we commoners can easily discuss..." As the crowd debated, none of these rumors reached Lin Yi's ears, and he didn't care; as long as he knew what was going on, it didn't matter whether others were aware or not.
Moreover, he wasn't very familiar with people at school, so it wasn't much of a concern to him.
What was most important to him now was to develop his pharmaceutical company and promote the Body Tempering Divine Water that he had acquired. His security company had also helped him make quite a few contacts.
Lin Yi selected the most secure and his favorite pharmaceutical factory. Although that factory was not famous, Lin Yi had found it.
The factory wasn't well-known and was not a large establishment, so it normally didn't get many large orders. Basically, it could only last a year or two before fading away due to financial issues, as small factories must find enduring partners.
But partners usually prefer the larger factories, and small ones have no stable clientele, so these factories have been losing money. But since they've chosen this path, they need to persevere. Unexpectedly, Lin Yi had discovered this little factory.
He had been looking to acquire a factory that wasn't too big but had complete equipment and supplies.
After all, acquiring large factories would be a waste for Lin Yi. The acting CEO of this factory was Zhou Kongshan.
Zhou Kongshan was waiting for the person in charge of acquiring the factory to come and sign the contract. He could no longer maintain the factory and it had drained many years of his efforts, ultimately amounting to nothing.
He had felt the performance decline over the years, and in the last year, as large factories emerged one after another, his small factory was left behind by the tide of the times and could no longer keep up.
He was waiting for the person who would acquire the factory to come and sign the contract, after which he would sell the factory and be free of this burden.
The pressure was too much for him to bear, and though he wanted to continue, the right opportunity never came. If he delayed any further, he might not even be able to pay the workers' wages.
Therefore, as Zhou Kongshan prepared for the transfer, he waited in the top-floor office of the factory, wondering who would purchase his pharmaceutical plant. Just then, there was the sound of footsteps at the door, followed by a knock.

chapters.title: Chapter 223 Entrepreneurial Journey
chapters.content:
The person who walked in at the door was his secretary, who directly spoke, "Mr. Zhou, a young man is here to see you outside. He said he wants to meet with you."
Upon hearing this, Zhou Kongshan immediately understood what was going on. After all, recently he had terminated partnerships with many collaborators and basically no one would come to look for him, so the person looking for him this time was likely here for collaboration.
However, he had thought that those who did business in this field would be much older, so he did not expect that a young person would come to seek him out this time. Therefore, he also had new expectations and immediately stood up.
After all, his industry had been in a downturn these years. Since someone was coming to acquire it, that meant they saw the potential to make money, but he was already unable to turn things around. He was actually looking forward to what this brave young person would bring and immediately went downstairs.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi had also gotten out of his car and walked into the front lobby. Upon seeing Zhou Kongshan, Lin Yi appeared very calm.
A middle-aged man around forty years old.
When Zhou Kongshan saw Lin Yi, he immediately extended his hand and said, "You must be Mr. Lin, right? I'm the agent of this potion factory; my name is Zhou Kongshan!"
Lin Yi nodded, reached out his hand, and said, "Hello, I'm here for the acquisition, my name is Lin Yi. Can I take a look around first?" Lin Yi said, and Zhou Kongshan nodded, "Of course, of course!"
Lin Yi was actually just taking a casual look. After all, he had already had Zhou Jianlai help him inspect it before, so he just needed to see the standards and the specific structure of the factory building.
If the standards were met, Lin Yi could rest assured and let the company develop the Body Strengthening Divine Water.
Lin Yi had originally planned to directly release it to the market, but if he released such a miraculous potion, it would certainly arouse many people's suspicions on the market, especially if such a magical product really appeared.
Lin Yi feared he would become a key interview subject, but the key point was that he did not want to deal with that kind of thing; he only knew the basics and did not understand the essence. If he really had to explain it, he wouldn't be able to say much, so it was essential to find a factory to produce it for him, which would not attract other people's attention.
Moreover, it would help to promote the product, and then it could be sold. Lin Yi did not want to monopolize the gimmick of owning the formula; otherwise, journalists would definitely come to interview him, and his name would be listed on some rankings. He did not want to become someone who was highly noticeable and attracted attention.
His life would be completely disrupted by that, so he chose to quietly run a small potion factory and release his products.
When Zhou Kongshan first saw Lin Yi, he pegged Lin Yi as someone who was a bit frivolous and unrestrained, someone who asserted their own personality. After all, acquiring his factory, which was about to go bankrupt, seemed like a joke.
It seemed like something a young master from an affluent family would do to air frustration towards his parents.
But as he showed Lin Yi around, Lin Yi's behavior and attitude did not seem like a joke at all, but instead, he was exceptionally focused.
He truly intended to sell off his factory, but he also hoped it would be transferred to a capable person, as it represented many years of his efforts. He did not want it to be utterly ruined.
Moreover, he had not laid off the workers in the factory; if it could continue to operate, the workers' livelihoods would be secured.
Zhou Jian had already checked it out for Lin Yi before, and Lin Yi had also acquired the factory's information. Initially, he had just skimmed it, but when he actually arrived at the factory, he was somewhat surprised.
The location and size of the factory were quite substantial, but the factory was rented. If it were to be acquired, he could discuss the price with Zhou Kongshan.
However, Lin Yi's main concern now was to make sure the potions were well-made, but the location was indeed excellent. The surrounding area was vacant land, and if his business were to grow in the future, he should consider purchasing the surrounding land to expand the factory.
That would make future work more convenient.
As they entered the production area at the moment, many workers were busy with their tasks. Upon seeing Lin Yi, some looked surprised.
Some who knew the inside story spoke up, "Isn't that our new boss?"
"So young, huh!"
"Aiyo, don't you know these young guys are capable these days?"
The workers seemed very honest. After Lin Yi finished looking around, he followed Zhou Kongshan, who then looked at Lin Yi seriously and said, "If Mr. Lin plans to take over the entire factory, I hope you won't abandon these workers.
They are very skilled; they have been working for many years. They are all very familiar with the positions and conditions here, and are quite satisfied. If you decide to take over, I hope you will keep them all."
Lin Yi looked at Zhou Kongshan and smiled, "Mr. Zhou, rest assured. The fact that these employees have persisted in a potion factory for so many years proves they are very resilient. They won't fail to persevere just because they have a new boss. After all, what I require is only that they do their work well, and I will not make things difficult for others."
Hearing this, Zhou Kongshan immediately shook his head, "It's not about making things difficult. It's just that when the employees started, they were all very sincere. Now the company has fallen to such a state, sometimes I can't even pay their salaries on time, and yet they have never complained. So, I hope they can have some stability going forward."
Hearing these words, Lin Yi nodded. Zhou Kongshan really was a good boss.
However, running a factory certainly requires a lot of effort, and there must be core personnel. Looking up, Lin Yi couldn't help but ask, "There should be core personnel for the development of your potions, don't you have any masters now?"
Hearing Lin Yi's question, Zhou Kongshan seemed somewhat embarrassed and laughed self-deprecatingly.
"We used to have some, but not anymore. Now it's just me holding the fort. Many people think this factory has no future, and we have started to lose money this year. I feel bad about keeping them since they came to work with me out of passion. But as you've seen, the losses have been disastrous over the years."
Saying this, Zhou Kongshan appeared somewhat dejected, but when he spoke of the time he had started his business right after graduating from college, he did not regret it. One must be brave at least once in life, so he felt that he had done nothing wrong.
Lin Yi was moved by his words, as indeed, a person who dares to start a business really needs a firm heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 224 Taking Over the Factory
chapters.content:
"Actually, when I insisted on pursuing this career, my family didn't support me. After all, they believed that someone with an overseas master's degree like me should have better options."
"But I couldn't help it. I truly have a deep passion for this industry. Even if things aren't going well now, I accept it, and I have no regrets!" Hearing this, Lin Yi was somewhat surprised.
He hadn't expected that the person standing before him was a master in pharmaceutical studies. Indeed, someone with such academic credentials could find very good positions. Lin Yi admired Zhou Kongshan's aspirations.
After all, the risk involved in running a business is significant, and most people would abandon their passions for higher-paying jobs.
Given that oversea masters can indeed secure great positions, Lin Yi admired Zhou Kongshan for standing firm under such pressure to pursue his passion.
At that moment, Zhou Kongshan looked up at Lin Yi with a smile and said, "After selling this pharmaceutical factory to you, I will be out of a job. If Mr. Lin needs it though, I could continue to stay here and develop some medicines for you. The products that our factory has produced so far were also my research, so the quality and effectiveness are guaranteed. If Mr.
Lin wishes, he could sign a contract with me to keep me on here." Zhou Kongshan was offering himself for the role.
He wanted to stay because he wished to see if the factory could survive under Lin Yi's management. Even though it wasn't his property, he had deep feelings for the pharmaceutical factory and considered it inseparable from himself.
He was quite curious to see what path Lin Yi would take it on. Lin Yi, looking at him, was surprised. He hadn't expected that a boss would be willing to work for someone else and be indifferent to the public's scrutiny.
Considering there were still his workers here, this caught Lin Yi off guard, but he did value Zhou Kongshan. Having such a responsible person by his side was definitely of great use. So Lin Yi nodded and said directly, "Mr. Zhou Kongshan, how about this?
Since you are an expert in medicine and also have a master's degree, which is truly valuable for me, I have thought it over, and I've decided not to acquire the factory!"
As Lin Yi spoke, Zhou Kongshan immediately panicked. If he could not sell the factory, continuing to run it would only lead to losses. He thought he might have misspoken and caused Lin Yi to change his mind, revealing a helpless expression.
"Mr. Lin! Did… did I say something wrong?! Mr. Lin, there's nothing wrong with our factory. If you really feel the workers can't stay, then I… I…"
He spoke haltingly, but Lin Tian simply waved him off, interrupting him with a gentle smile and said, "Mr. Zhou Kongshan, you've misunderstood. What I mean is that I won't be acquiring the factory, but I am willing to invest in it through another approach.
I've looked into your factory's situation before and understand that it's suffering from a cash flow issue. Now, I've decided to keep the factory operating under your name, but I would like to become a shareholder. We must draft a new contract. This time, I'll invest enough capital to ensure your factory operates smoothly, and, Mr. Zhou Kongshan, you can continue in your management role.
I only request to become the largest shareholder of the pharmaceutical factory, and you may hold ten percent of the shares. As for your salary, I'll offer you three and a half million a year!"
Lin Yi spoke plainly and confidently, watching Zhou Kongshan as he added, "Since you are so familiar with managing the pharmacy, I plan to leave it entirely in your hands. Moreover, you get along well with the employees, so there shouldn't be any issues. As for everything related to the product, leave it to me. Whether it's marketing or production, I'll handle it."
Lin Yi's intentions were clear – essentially, all the pharmaceuticals may need to be replaced. Acquiring ninety percent of the factory's shares equated to nearly buying it out, but in this way, Zhou Kongshan could still retain ten percent of the shares, preventing him from merely becoming an employee.
This was also because Lin Yi trusted him and chose to offer it to him.
This would also allow Lin Yi some ease as he wouldn't need to throw himself completely into the pharmaceutical factory. He only needed to oversee Zhou Kongshan handling these miscellaneous tasks. And since Zhou Kongshan was said to be vocal in this area and had spent many years on pharmaceutical research, Lin Yi trusted him to formulate the Body Tempering Divine Water and then market it globally.
He was confident in such actions and saw the many benefits they could bring, making things more convenient for him.
At that time, Zhou Kongshan naturally felt bewildered upon hearing this. He hadn't expected Lin Yi to proceed in this way.
Even if he went out to seek a job elsewhere or started his own business with his qualifications, he might not be able to make an annual salary of three and a half million.
Moreover, Lin Yi had decided to offer him ten percent of the shares.
Even though the value of those shares was uncertain, if the company turned a profit, that ten percent could turn out to be substantial. Plus, he would not have to assume the role of an employee but could continue to lead the factory. For him, it was an offer too good to pass up.
Considering that his factory had been running at a loss for years, Lin Yi's generous offer of a three and a half million annual salary excited him greatly.
He nodded immediately, accepting Lin Yi's proposal—it was an opportunity too good to miss. However, he would need to find a professional lawyer to draft the contract properly.
So, they could only make a temporary contract for now and later sign a proper agreement with full legal standing.
Since he decided to take over the factory and develop his products, investing billions into this industry was indeed an unknown venture. There would be risks, but Lin Yi believed he could handle it.
Moreover, since he was effectively acquiring the factory, he planned to rename it after himself.
Initially, Lin Yi couldn't think of an appropriate name for the factory, but then, considering both his and Han Xuewei's names, he decided to rename it as Lin Xue Pharmaceutical Factory.
Lin Yi had been considering if he could create a formula for the Body Tempering Divine Water on his own, mixing it up since he had an unlimited supply. However, recalling that the system's offerings might not be decipherable by anyone in this world, he decided to put that idea aside for the moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 225 Can Take It Now
chapters.content:
Lin Yi didn't get back home until almost evening after dealing with the matter.
Since it was the weekend and Han Xue didn't have anything to do, she stayed at home.
Qin Xiaoxu had made plans with Han Xuewei to go out today, saying she wanted to learn some love secrets from Han Xuewei, so they went out together.
In fact, this was just an excuse for Qin Xiaoxu, who was simply bored at home and wanted to go shopping.
Since having a child, Han Xuewei seldom went shopping, and it was usually only when Qin Xiaoxu or Lin Yi dragged her out that she would agree to look around.
Somehow, after having a child, she lost interest in clothes and outfits, mostly wearing loose or casual clothing for comfort.
Plus, it made taking care of the baby easier, which she didn't mind at all.
Qin Xiaoxu had been in a good mood lately because the misunderstanding with Lin Jie had been cleared up, and their relationship had rapidly improved.
Lin Jie also realized the importance of taking the initiative. He had made a lot of progress recently, and they had become very intimate, though they hadn't moved in together yet. Ye Caiwei's work was going well, and she had already moved out of the place Qin Xiaoxu rented.
While out on the street today, Qin Xiaoxu led Han Xuewei into a branded shoe store, having noticed it in front of them.
As they entered, Qin Xiaoxu couldn't stop talking about Lin Jie's antics, making Han Xuewei laugh heartily every time.
Engrossed in conversation, they walked straight into the shoe store. It was only upon entering that Qin Xiaoxu saw the store's sign and said to Han Xuewei, "Vivi, I haven't been here before. It looks like it's new."
While the two were talking, a salesperson saw them and said, "Hello. All of our shoes are branded with a quality assurance, and there are professional designs by our designers. If you find something you like, feel free to pick something out."
Hearing the salesperson, Qin Xiaoxu looked at Han Xuewei and started browsing around. After a while, she turned to Han Xuewei and asked, "Vivi, you must be graduating soon, right? What do you plan to do after graduation?"
Having recently experienced the pain of unemployment, Qin Xiaoxu was quite curious about what kind of job someone as outstanding as Han Xuewei would take on.
Han Xuewei just smiled slightly and said, "Haven't I mentioned it before? I've been interested in art since I was young, and I've also learned to paint. If I get the chance, I definitely want to open a gallery. Even if I can't open one myself, I still want to be someone who holds exhibitions. Plus, I can teach my children through my paintings. I think that's quite nice."
With that, Han Xuewei simply smiled lightly.
"Is that really the case? But I feel that many things could change after getting married. You might not be able to fulfill your previous plans. You might even have to be a full-time housewife at home. But then again, being a full-time housewife isn't so bad since Lin Yi is a very responsible person, and he wouldn't let you suffer even if you stayed at home."
Qin Xiaoxu said this, holding a good impression of Lin Yi.
Hearing that, Han Xuewei just laughed and nodded her head.
"Well, you're not wrong about that. He does treat me very well and supports me even though I have career ambitions. Being a full-time housewife is also nice because I won't miss out on the children's growth. They change every day and grow up fast. But if I can't make it as an artist, I'm not sure what I'll do later on. I guess I'll just take it slowly!"
Han Xuewei seemed very relaxed, prompting Qin Xiaoxu to laugh, "How about we go into business together? We can open a shop selling shoes and clothes, and design our own favorite outfits. Just like this place, hiring some brilliant designers. Oh, we wouldn't need to hire actually; you're an artist, Vivi. We could design them ourselves and then sell them."
Now interested, Han Xuewei laughed, "That sounds pretty good."
"Right? I'll talk to my dad about it, get some startup funds, and you can come be my best designer when we open our shop."
"I haven't agreed yet, and you're already planning ahead," Han Xuewei quipped.
Laughing together, they continued their conversation. However, they'd been in the store for quite some time without any service. Then, Han Xuewei noticed a pair of silver shoes adorned with white diamonds ahead that looked very luxurious.
She was very fond of such items and couldn't hide her delight. Turning to the sales associates in black behind her, she began, "Excuse me…"
But before Han Xuewei could finish, one of the sales associates in black gave a look of disdain, apparently rolling her eyes deliberately or involuntarily, and without even looking at Han Xuewei, interrupted, "Sorry ma'am, this pair of shoes only comes in a size 36, and the rest are smaller sizes. They won't fit you!"
Her condescending manner of speaking was irritating to hear.
After saying this, the sales associate walked over. Han Xuewei felt a bit awkward but didn't say much, just picked up another pair of shoes that somewhat resembled the silver, ornate ones and asked, "What about these?"
The sales associate in black responded dismissively, "I can check on that pair for you if you want them."
Without giving them a second glance, she had already decided that Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu were not big spenders and didn't deserve her attention.
After all, the customers who came here usually had very individual tastes, and only those with such tastes would come for custom designs. Both Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu were dressed very casually, clearly not the type who could afford their products.
So she didn't bother explaining in detail. Meanwhile, Qin Xiaoxu was somewhat unhappy and spoke up, "We need to try them to know if they fit. Please fetch them for us to try!"
"We'll take them if they're right." After Qin Xiaoxu spoke, the sales associate showed slight defiance.
Although she managed a smile, her words were less courteous as she said, "I'm sorry, miss. The warehouse is quite far from here, and searching there is a hassle. I can check for you, but if you decide not to buy after all the trouble, that wouldn't be too good, would it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 226 Judging by Appearances
chapters.content:
Upon hearing the saleswoman's words, Qin Xiaoxu suddenly felt her anger rising, and frowning at the saleswoman, she spoke up, "But if you bring them to us, we also don't know if we can wear them or not, and besides, you're in sales, which is fundamentally about service. Am I wrong?"
Qin Xiaoxu certainly wasn't as easy to talk to as Han Xuewei, so she straightforwardly voiced her question. As soon as she said this, a woman wearing a gold dress walked in through the door.
The dress the woman wore looked expensive, a haute couture, but such high fashion wasn't something Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu would ever wear out, considering it still seemed a bit tacky to them, and it was just a dress worth over ten thousand yuan.
At that moment, a saleswoman who had been sitting aside watching the commotion got up and walked towards the front. She immediately surrounded the newcomer with extreme politeness, while the saleswoman in black, witnessing this scene, had her eyes light up instantly and she too quickly headed forward, just in time to see another woman who was rather petite.
This woman was also a new sales associate, but a rookie. Just as she stepped out, the saleswoman in black called out to her, "Hey, Xiao Lan, come and attend to these two customers. Someone is calling me over there!"
Having said that, she immediately walked over to the woman in the gold dress and surrounded her.
The woman had only spoken a few words when she broke out into a smile, running to the warehouse to fetch shoes for her.
Seeing such disparate treatment, Qin Xiaoxu felt her temper flare and was almost at the point of turning over the store.
But right then, Han Xuewei immediately grabbed her hand and spoke up, "Forget it, it's better to avoid trouble. We'll leave after we finish buying. Besides, look, someone has come to serve us, haven't they?"
Qin Xiaoxu, angered to death by the situation, had been to many stores—whether rich or not, whether it was luxury goods or not, everyone else had always treated her kindly after all, the service industry shouldn't be looking down on people, should it?
Encountering such an absurd store, it was truly Qin Xiaoxu's first time.
If she had known, she would never have come.
Looking at Han Xuewei, Qin Xiaoxu felt a need to assert herself, so she spoke directly, "Vivi, whichever ones you like later, I'll buy for you. You and Lin Yi took care of me that time I bought so much at the mall, this time buy whatever you like, don't be shy."
As Qin Xiaoxu spoke, she was unwilling to put up with such treatment. The rookie sales associate, standing off to the side, looked a bit awkward, probably also understanding the situation but not daring to speak up.
Han Xuewei, noticing her discomfort, immediately spoke with a smile, "Miss, you don't need to be scared, my sister's just a bit temperamental, she's not as hard to get along with as you might think!"
Han Xuewei said this somewhat indifferently, but she too could tell that the sales associate seemed inexperienced, her gaze filled with unfamiliarity.
The sales associate, upon hearing this, nodded gratefully and replied, "Yes, my name is Xiao Lan. I've been staying at home taking care of the kids ever since I had them, and only now that the child is a bit older have I been able to come out to work. If there's anything I'm not doing well, please tell me, and I'll correct it. I hope you won't give me a bad review."
Xiao Lan said cautiously, and Han Xuewei, hearing this, spoke up, "Hmm, you still look so young, the child mustn't be very old!"
Upon hearing that, Xiao Lan smiled and said, "The child is only just over two years old. It's because the child is old enough to go to daycare that I was able to bring them there and start working. Which shoes do you ladies like? I'll go check for your sizes in a bit.
The shoes we sell here are mostly limited editions. After all, the designs the designer comes up with are all over the place, and most of the shoes displayed here are smaller sizes. I don't think either of you would fit them, so just tell me what you like, and I'll go fetch them from the warehouse."
As Xiao Lan spoke, Qin Xiaoxu was quite satisfied, finding her attitude much more pleasant than that of the black-clad saleswoman, who was so full of herself it was annoying.
Xiao Lan could tell at a glance that neither of them had small feet since the shoes displayed here were meant for women with much smaller feet.
As they were picking out items, the black-clad saleswoman began enthusiastically promoting to the woman in the gold haute couture, "Miss, look, this gold one is a new arrival the designer brought in yesterday. You should try it, it's very beautiful. And our shop currently has some discounts.
Miss, take a look! And this, this is a hot-seller from our exclusive designer, who can design to your preferences. This silver one is quite nice."
The black-clad saleswoman said, and hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu felt displeased, simply staring coldly at the saleswoman. Really, it was a case of tailoring her service according to the person.
Han Xuewei, however, seemed unconcerned, picking up a pair of light blue flats and speaking to Xiao Lan, "Xiao Lan, do you have other sizes for these shoes? I wear size thirty-eight."
Han Xuewei said gently, and Xiao Lan immediately moved closer. Hearing Han Xuewei's words, Qin Xiaoxu was somewhat surprised, and couldn't help speaking up, "Vivi, I remember when we've gone shoe shopping before that you always wore size thirty-seven."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh.
"You're not wrong, I did indeed wear size thirty-seven before, but then my weight skyrocketed during pregnancy, and my feet grew along with it. Maybe it's because I had to bear so much weight every day, after all, I was carrying more than just one baby at the time, and I don't know why. Though now it makes sense, I was always wearing Lin Yi's slippers then."
Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu was shocked.
"What, your feet can get bigger during pregnancy? That's too outrageous!"
Han Xuewei laughed upon hearing this.
"It's true, I didn't believe it at first either. I thought things would go back to normal after giving birth, but it seems now they've only somewhat returned to their original size."
Xiao Lan, having been pregnant herself, nodded in agreement and commented, "It's really like that, everyone's physique is different, and some people's feet do get bigger because of the great changes in body weight during pregnancy."
With this, she looked at Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu and ventured, "May I ask what surnames the two ladies have?"
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu just smiled and said, "My last name is Qin, and hers is Han!"

chapters.title: Chapter 227 Disgust
chapters.content:
When Han Xuewei mentioned that one's feet can get bigger after pregnancy, Qin Xiaoxu already felt somewhat despondent because her feet were already quite large, nearly size 39. If they were to grow even bigger during pregnancy, that was unthinkable.
After all, when her classmates used to ask about her shoe size, she would lie about it. It wasn't a big deal, but she had always disliked her large feet.
If her feet were to get even larger after pregnancy, Qin Xiaoxu would definitely be devastated.
Noticing Qin Xiaoxu's worries, Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh, "Oh, don't overthink it. Our bodies are different, and it's not guaranteed that you'll have twins."
After Han Xuewei finished speaking, Qin Xiaoxu breathed a sigh of relief. Then, Han Xuewei looked at Xiao Lan and said, "I'll take size 38 in those blue ones I mentioned earlier and the black ones too, if you have them; otherwise, I'll pick something else."
After Han Xuewei spoke, Qin Xiaoxu chimed in immediately. She was quite casual when shopping since, for her, these shoes weren't too expensive. She said directly, "I'll take those too, I want this pair and that pair."
She pointed at two pairs in front of her that looked luxurious, but were probably not practical for everyday wear.
However, what surprised Xiao Lan was what Qin Xiaoxu added next, "Right, right, and that custom model your colleague mentioned, get me a pair of those, and also from this cabinet here."
Qin Xiaoxu pointed at the cabinet, and Xiao Lan looked over, a bit taken aback—there must be at least seven or eight pairs in there. But Qin Xiaoxu was resolute, "Just pick all size 38.5 for me and bag them all up."
After Qin Xiaoxu finished speaking, she simply stood in the center, while Xiao Lan, upon hearing this, immediately took out her notebook with a somewhat embarrassed expression, "I'm sorry, but I can't remember that much. Let me write it down first."
As Xiao Lan said this, Han Xuewei smiled, knowing that Qin Xiaoxu was just trying to aggravate the situation. Just then, the black-clad saleswoman who had spoken earlier said, "No problem, take your time to write it down. After all, we can wait a while."
Hearing this, Xiao Lan nodded and replied, "Okay then, Miss Han, you two please wait for a moment. There's a self-service coffee machine over there."
After Xiao Lan had taken note of all the shoe models, Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu poured themselves some coffee and waited outside.
About ten minutes later, the girl in the golden haute couture standing in front of them had picked out quite a few pairs of shoes, but she hadn't decided to purchase just yet, merely taking pictures non-stop.
By now, quite a few shoe boxes accumulated at her feet, indicating she must've tried on many. Having taken her photos, she elegantly put her phone back in her purse and then turned to the black-clad saleswoman and said, "Bag this pair for me."
Upon hearing this, the saleswoman appeared somewhat stunned—the stylish lady had chosen the most heavily discounted and cheapest pair in the store.
At that moment, Qin Xiaoxu looked up and caught sight of the scene, her face breaking into a self-satisfied smile. Han Xuewei immediately stopped her, for if she didn't remind Qin Xiaoxu,
Qin Xiaoxu might indeed burst out laughing right there. She was indeed too pleased with herself and leaned in to whisper to Han Xuewei, "I just hate people who look down on others. Look at her face now, it's as green as anything."
Han Xuewei was about to say something to Qin Xiaoxu when Xiao Lan came out with the shoes.
Xiao Lan placed them in front of Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu, saying, "Miss Qin, Miss Han, here are your shoes. I've picked out a part of them. These two pairs are for Miss Han: a pair of light blue sneakers and a pair of black cloth shoes."
"Miss Qin, there are a few more pairs for you that I haven't brought out yet. Please wait a moment."
Xiaolan then walked inside. At that moment, Han Xuewei just gave a faint smile, picked up the pair of light blue slip-on shoes, and liked them so much that she immediately slipped them on.
Her feet were still very white, which, when paired with the light blue color, made them appear particularly spotless and pure. It was a sight of pure beauty that Han Xuewei herself didn't realize. She looked at Qin Xiaoxu and asked, "Do they look good?"
Qin Xiaoxu replied, "They do look really nice, but I still think you look better in high heels. Your feet are so white and slender, and your ankles are so pretty. High heels are the real deal."
Hearing Qin Xiaoxu's words, Han Xuewei just laughed.
"High heels aren't suitable for me anymore. With a baby, it's inconvenient to wear them, and they make a lot of noise when walking or climbing stairs. Just for the sake of beauty, I don't think it's necessary. Anyway, slip-on shoes like these are also very comfortable to wear, and they don't look bad."
As Han Xuewei spoke, Qin Xiaoxu couldn't help but feel a bit astonished. Indeed, the radiance of motherhood shone from her.
Still, deep down she was a little scared, as the thought of giving birth felt quite terrifying to her.
Meanwhile, Xiaolan came out, holding a large pile of shoes and placed them in front of Qin Xiaoxu. She said, "I'm sorry, Miss Qin, there's a pair of shoes here that is out of stock. But we have another version in the same style but a different color, um, you can try them."
At that moment, Han Xuewei had taken off the shoes she had tried on and put them back into their box. Just then, the saleswoman in black came over, huffing and puffing. Seeing Han Xuewei put the shoes away, she couldn't help but snicker to herself.
Looks like she can't afford them after all. Truly just a pauper!
Just then, Qin Xiaoxu turned around and caught the disdainful expression on her face. She looked at Xiaolan and said, "No need, just pack them up, all of them!"
Qin Xiaoxu stressed the word "all" as she spoke, which clearly surprised Xiaolan. Xiaolan responded, "Miss Qin, you've tried on those shoes, so you can take them. But if you haven't tried this pair, I don't know if they will be comfortable. Maybe you should try them on first."
Qin Xiaoxu looked at the pair of shoes. She didn't care about whether or not they were comfortable; she hardly ever wore them anyway.
"No need!" Then she turned to Han Xuewei and asked, "Vivi, do you like any other shoes? Pick a few more pairs?"
Han Xuewei looked around at the shoes here. She didn't fancy any of them, and two pairs were already more than enough for her.
"No need, I think what I have is enough."
"Well then, pack them all up," Qin Xiaoxu said nonchalantly.
Hearing this, Xiaolan was incredibly shocked and then nodded, "Alright, Miss Qin. I'll get your bill ready."
As Xiaolan said that and began collecting the shoes, Han Xuewei, seeing so many on the floor, helped her pick up a few pairs, and Qin Xiaoxu also helped with a few. Together, they went to the checkout counter.
While Xiaolan was packing the chosen shoes for both Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei, the saleswoman in black came over.

chapters.title: Chapter 228 Slap in the Face
chapters.content:
At this moment, the saleswoman in black saw them and gave a flattering smile, no longer as rude as before.
Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei didn't like her, and now she approached Xiao Lan and said directly, "Oh, Xiao Lan, you're new here, you're not familiar with these things, let me help you settle the account."
Her words sounded pleasant, but Xiao Lan's face turned somewhat embarrassed. Seeing this, Qin Xiaoxu immediately showed displeasure.
She knew that sales positions like this involved certain commissions and performance metrics, and that completing several transactions with a few customers was all recorded. If someone else handled the checkout and registered it under their own employee number, it would have nothing to do with her.
This woman wanted to use her position as an older employee to bully the newcomer which was too much. Seeing this, Qin Xiaoxu's displeasure grew and she waved her hand, saying, "Sorry, I don't need your service. You were very impatient when you were serving me earlier, I can't be burdened by you. Xiao Lan, please handle this for me."
Upon hearing this, Xiao Lan immediately showed a grateful expression. She was in fact a new employee and wasn't very adept yet. Han Xuewei watched from the side, merely smiling faintly.
"It's alright, Xiao Lan, take your time, we have time,"
The situation became extremely awkward for the saleswoman in black, standing to the side with an embarrassed expression, her whole face frozen.
She still wore a hypocritical smile but was unable to say anything more, silently moving aside.
At that moment, Xiao Lan looked at Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei with a deeply grateful expression.
Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu shared a smile, fully aware of the black-clothed saleswoman's intentions, and were determined not to let her succeed.
"Ms. Qin, that would be thirteen pairs of shoes, totaling eighty thousand nine hundred yuan. The discount has already been applied, wish you a pleasant purchase!"
After she finished speaking, Qin Xiaoxu promptly swiped her card.
With a ding, the transaction went through, and Qin Xiaoxu calmly put her card away, casting a casual smile at the saleswoman nearby.
Seeing the woman's face twist as if she had eaten something terrible, Qin Xiaoxu felt inwardly pleased, while Han Xuewei turned to Xiao Lan. Intending to support Xiao Lan's business, she said, "Could you give us your WeChat or other contact information? You can let us know if there are any new styles coming out."
Hearing this, Xiao Lan, feeling grateful, immediately pulled a business card from her pocket and handed it to Han Xuewei.
"Ms. Han, this is my personal card with my contact information and WeChat QR code on it. I'm really thankful to you,"
Xiao Lan's eyes were brimming with tears, looking at them with great appreciation. She was a new employee and had been bullied a lot during her first few days. The older staff always took advantage of her, and she couldn't even protest.
But today, the purchase made by Qin Xiaoxu and Han Xuewei was the only order she had taken in so many days since starting her job, and it was the most valuable one.
After all, since she became a full-time mother after having a baby and then returned to work, the process had been very difficult for her. She had to silently endure the harassment from the older staff because she couldn't afford to lose this job.
But today, the encouragement from Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu made her feel that perhaps she could do well in this job too.
They gave her firm courage and confidence. With the first order under her belt, she could believe in herself more and wouldn't be bullied by those people again.
Han Xuewei understood how difficult it is for every mother who has gone through childbirth to rebuild their confidence and return to the workplace, so she empathized with Xiao Lan.
She empathized with a mother's feelings, so she was sure to take extra care of her. In the future, she would definitely buy whatever Xiao Lan liked. After paying the bill, Han Xuewei and Qin Xiaoxu walked out of the shop together, carrying about ten shopping bags each.
At this moment, the saleswoman in black felt very embarrassed, but she could only nod and bow as she waited for the two of them to leave.
Qin Xiaoxu, watching her, couldn't help but laugh when she remembered how the saleswoman had been put in her place just before.
No sooner had they stepped out of the store than Qin Xiaoxu looked at Han Xuewei and said unabashedly, "Vivi, did you see that woman's face just now? Her expression was like she had eaten shit, serves her right for looking down on people earlier. I swear... it killed me. If we run into her again and she acts like that, we definitely need to show her up."
Han Xuewei immediately turned around, feeling that it was somehow wrong to speak like this right outside the store's door; they should at least wait until they were further away!
So, she tugged at Qin Xiaoxu's hand. Qin Xiaoxu just curled her lips and said, "Even if she heard, it wouldn't make a difference. Her attitude was poor to begin with, so criticism from the customers is normal."
Han Xuewei naturally agreed, as patience is definitely required in the service industry, and looking down on people never ends well.
Qin Xiaoxu, looking at the ten or so shopping bags she was holding, frowned and exclaimed, "Oh my gosh, how did I accidentally buy so many shoes? I couldn't wear them all even if I had ten feet."
"You're just now realizing you bought so much? Weren't you doing it to piss her off? To flex your spending power a bit?" teased Han Xuewei.
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu simply said nonchalantly, "Anyway, this amount is pocket change for me; Lin Jie gives me a lot of money each month."
After Qin Xiaoxu finished speaking, Han Xuewei burst into laughter, "Looks like he's trying to keep you!"
"What are you babbling about? Let's put the stuff in the car and then continue shopping," Qin Xiaoxu quickly changed the subject, and Han Xuewei didn't say anything, just accompanied her as they walked forward.
This time, as they got into the elevator and looked at each other, Qin Xiaoxu seemed to think of something and started to say, "Vivi, there's something I want to talk to you about. It's about the misunderstanding I had with Lin Jie last time, and then after the phone call, the misunderstanding was cleared up..."
As Qin Xiaoxu spoke of this incident, Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh, as that misunderstanding was just too funny.
She hadn't expected Qin Xiaoxu's way of thinking to be like this, but at the moment, she restrained her laughter and looked at Qin Xiaoxu.
Qin Xiaoxu then said, "Although our relationship has become more important and intimate, it still hasn't progressed further."
Hearing that, Han Xuewei seemed to understand her meaning and laughed, "Are you thinking of doing something else? If so, just be more direct about it, I don't see you as someone who's normally so timid."

chapters.title: Chapter 229 Bringing Home
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh at Qin Xiaoxu's helpless expression, "Actually, I think you really should be more direct. After all, Lin Jie is a straightforward person, and if you hint or say those messy things, he simply won't get it. I think only if you love blatantly and openly will he dare to take the initiative, otherwise, he's afraid of offending you."
"Ouch, I know that's the case, but I just feel it's not right, those words coming from my mouth just aren't suitable. I'm a girl, you know. If I fling myself at him, wouldn't that make me look cheap?"
Qin Xiaoxu pouted as she spoke. She had even specifically looked up on the internet for many ways for a woman to chase a man, which absolutely stressed not to lose oneself, to remain clear-headed about who you are.
Then, to coexist with modesty and rationality, how could she throw herself at a guy just because she liked him? In that case, a guy who gets me definitely won't cherish me.
So Qin Xiaoxu was also hesitating at this time. Hearing these words, Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh, "If you continue to be so wishy-washy, pretending to be modest, then for sure nothing will develop."
"I know, but it really annoys me. Why can't he take the initiative for once? Everyone else's boyfriend can 'Kabedon' and all that, and I have to say everything!"
Qin Xiaoxu couldn't help but complain, which made Han Xuewei burst into laughter.
"Actually, if you want to take the initiative, then take the initiative, just like I did, expressing my love candidly. Isn't it good now?" Han Xuewei said and just smiled faintly.
She thought the way Qin Xiaoxu and Lin Jie interacted was really too funny. Hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu nodded and scratched her head, "It seems I could do that, but again, it feels a bit... Aiyah, if he doesn't take the initiative, then it's up to me to do so."
She then remembered the development of Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's previous romance. At that time, it also seemed like Han Xuewei was the one who initiated, and Lin Yecai and she started a family. If two people truly like each other, it doesn't really matter who takes the initiative.
Perhaps Lin Yi didn't expect Han Xuewei to like him either, just as she had not expected Lin Jie to actually confess to her. Thinking of this relaxed Qin Xiaoxu's mood, maybe by doing this, she really could get what she wanted.
The two of them strolled until the evening. As Han Xuewei had a family to take care of, Qin Xiaoxu didn't invite her for dinner. So they parted ways for the evening meal.
Lin Yi came to pick up Han Xuewei in his car. Seeing Han Xuewei at the mall entrance with a shopping cart full of items next to her,
Lin Yi immediately ran up, greeted the young man, and then turned to Han Xuewei, "Wife, did you come for a big shopping haul today?"
Hearing Lin Yi's words, Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh.
"Right. Today, Qin Xiaoxu said she would treat us because last time her bill got taken care of when she went to Wenqu Building's vendor mall, remember? So she felt she should invite me out for some shopping. But she ended up buying even more than I did," Han Xuewei said, and Lin Yi immediately started loading the items into the car.
Han Xuewei also wanted to help, but Lin Yi stopped her, "Wife, you've bought so much and must be tired. How could I let you lift a finger?"
Seeing Lin Yi being so attentive, Han Xuewei's face broke into a blissful smile. She truly thought that Lin Yi was the best man in the world.
Lin Yi placed a pair of shoes in the corner and turned his head to look at Han Xuewei and freely spoke, "Wife, is there anything for me among all these things?"
A gentle smile appeared on Lin Yi's face, he guessed Han Xuewei had definitely bought him something, but he just wanted to ask.
At that moment, Han Xuewei just gave a mysterious smile and moved closer to him. "Really not, I seem to have forgotten to buy for you."
Hearing this, Lin Yi immediately put on a look of aggrieved frown, "Ah, wife, how could you forget to buy something for me?"
Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh upon hearing this, Lin Yi's expression just now was too cute; she directly wrapped her arms around Lin Yi.
"Because I feel that no gift is worthy of my husband. So, I decided to make a love-filled meal for my husband."
As Han Xuewei spoke, she leaned toward Lin Yi's face, and Lin Yi started to smile, taking her hand and walking forward while Han Xuewei, walking along, couldn't help but look at Lin Yi and speak, "Husband, have you ever thought about marketing the dishes I make to the market? The things you designed before were only used by me, it's actually quite a waste; this is like a patent..."
Han Xuewei's eyes shone as if she had discovered a business opportunity, and hearing this, Lin Yi couldn't help but hook his lips into a smile.
"This was originally designed just for you. However, wife, since you want to promote this area, your husband will also obey the orders fully."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei immediately moved to Lin Yi's cheek and kissed him hard, revealing a beautiful smile, "That's great."
"Anyway, our family already has a ready restaurant; later, we can prepare it there. After I deal with things, we'll discuss it, okay?" Lin Yi said, and Han Xuewei, smiling, agreed, and they both walked forward together.
Lin Yi also thought that Han Xuewei's suggestion just now was very good. After all, in this era of fast food, many people don't cook themselves, usually ordering takeaways, and even the diet isn't regular, with junk food dominating the era.
Young people lack exercise, and the food they eat is unhealthy; they really need some nutritious and healthful foods.
Moreover, these foods can also have a broader development path, specifically catering to those with health issues. After all, people with illnesses generally have dietary restrictions, so tailoring it for their health could attract a whole new clientele, benefiting society as well.
Thinking of this, Lin Yi felt this matter could also be put on the agenda. He couldn't help but look at Han Xuewei, "Wife, I'm planning to start up the medicine bottle factory first. The pharmaceutical plant has been sold to me, I've inspected it, the space is big, and the conditions and equipment are very good. After finalizing things tomorrow, the lawyers can draft the contract, and we can sign it.
That former owner even brought me a whole lot of stuff; there are many health products, and I've seen their medicinal material production line, the quality is definitely guaranteed. Those medicines are supplements for vitamins and boosting immunity. Later, I'll take a few bottles for dad, then bring the rest back home. The effects of this medicine are really good."
Han Xuewei was somewhat surprised at Lin Yi's words, "Really effective?"
"Yeah, definitely very potent."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei got a bit excited, "Then giving it to the babies, they'll grow up even healthier."

chapters.title: Chapter 230 Boosting Immunity
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei fully trusted every word Lin Yi said; if he said that the medicine would be effective in preventing diseases, then it must be true.
By doing so, the babies' health could be significantly improved, so why not do it?
After all, when children fall ill, it's extremely exhausting, not just for the adults but the kids suffer too, so having such a medicine was truly great.
Soon, the two of them drove back home, Lin Yi carrying a pile of shopping bags upstairs, with Han Xuewei following behind.
When Han's mother saw Han Xuewei, she couldn't help but be a little surprised, thinking Han Xuewei would have dinner with Qin Xiaoxu, as it was normal for the two sisters to get together.
"Vivi, didn't you go to have dinner with Xiaoxu?"
Han Xuewei shook her head, "No, she's supposed to be with her boyfriend tonight."
Hearing this, Lin Yi laughed, "Right, she's someone with a boyfriend now."
As Lin Yi walked away, Han's mother laughed hearing this, "The girl who came last time, right? She was quite adorable and quirky; seems like she's finally in a relationship."
After saying that, Han's mother went downstairs.
When Han Xuewei returned to the room, she saw Lin Yi organizing the shopping bags and said with some confusion, "It's so strange why my mom is managing Xiaoxu's affairs. They aren't that familiar with each other..."
Hearing this Lin Yi smiled lightly, "Didn't I tell you last time? Your mom mentioned it to my mom before. It's about a relative of yours who seemed to have taken a liking to Qin Xiaoxu. It's your distant cousin, he came to that wedding last time, I'm not very familiar with him, but it seems he has a fondness for Qin Xiaoxu..."
After thinking for a while, Han Xuewei, not very familiar with her distant relatives, suddenly remembered someone and slapped her forehead, "Oh, that's my uncle's son. I haven't had much contact with him, but their family is indeed quite wealthy."
Han Xuewei commented, and Lin Yi agreed; after all, Han Xuewei's family also had a good foundation.
After arranging all the items neatly, Han Xuewei began to put away the shopping bags while Lin Yi was tidying up the other things. She usually wouldn't just leave the bags in a corner; she would save them for when she needed to pack things later on.
