Having almost finished cleaning up, Han Xuewei said, "Husband, didn't you bring back some medicines just now? It's a good chance to let the family try them."
As Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Yi then remembered and pulled out several bottles of Potion from one of the bags. These were all Body Tempering Divine Water he had obtained from the system previously. In the later stages, he would have to see how the Potion room was set up, but for now, he only had the raw materials.
Lin Yi walked over to Han Xuewei, put the bottles in front of her and said, "Just by adding one or two drops of this into water or directly into the mouth, you can drink it.
This is the original product, and in the later stages, we'll design it as a liquid or pills. We'll see how they handle it then, and we can just use this original product for now."
Lin Yi said, and Han Xuewei couldn't help but show a look of admiration as she looked at the few bottles of potion, "Husband, you are really amazing, saying you would start a pharmaceutical company and starting it the very next day. Husband, I find myself admiring you more and more."
Hearing this, Lin Yi laughed heartily, "That's nothing, really. It's just that when my mother fell ill before, I realized how serious the matter was, especially how difficult it is to handle when children get sick. If everyone could use it, to boost their immunity, then these common diseases might not so easily invade the body."
Children catching colds and fevers really can be deadly. If a medicine that can be so effective at prevention can be developed, it would definitely be loved by everyone.
Han Xuewei strongly agreed, "Yeah, last time Mengmeng got sick, she would cry every time she took her medicine. Having such an effective preventive medicine is really too important."
"Yes, if this can have a ninety percent effectiveness, people with strong resistance would almost be immune after taking it, if it could be made available to everyone. That would surely bring substantial profits, and children and the elderly would definitely become important customers. I believe that most people would be very interested in medicine for the elderly and children."
Hearing Lin Yi's analysis, Han Xuewei agreed wholeheartedly and nodded, "Husband, although I don't know where you learned all this, I think you're really amazing."
"And you're the man with the strongest sense of responsibility I've ever met in this world. Mengmeng got sick just once, and you've considered so much. I never thought about it this way before," Han Xuewei said, her eyes full of admiration.
Lin Yi's perspective was indeed long-term. Many times, she felt that she simply couldn't compare to Lin Yi's mind.
Hearing this, Lin Yi immediately embraced Han Xuewei, "That's for sure, I must put family first. I want to work hard to make money now because I hope our family can have a better life, that our children can receive the best education and grow up carefree. All this requires effort and, after all, I'm so young, what's the harm in trying?"
As Lin Yi thought this, Han Xuewei nodded, wrapped her arms around Lin Yi's neck, and kissed him on the corner of his lips, "I love you the most, husband."
At this moment, Lin Yi was already thinking about the pharmaceutical factory. The system had previously given him an all-purpose card, which would come in handy this time. It was supposed to have an unlimited balance, so he should be able to withdraw endless funds, right?
Thinking this, the system's voice issued a prompt.
"Host, the all-purpose card is equivalent to having an unlimited amount of money, but it can only be used for family members and cannot be used for others."
Hearing this, Lin Yi's heart grew cold by half, and he continued to speak, "System, I just want to start a pharmaceutical factory and need startup capital, so I was thinking of using the funds from the all-purpose card."
"Sorry, Host, all of this requires the Host to exchange your original amount with the system, it can only be done in accordance with the system's rules, and can only be used on family members, not for the outside world."
After that, Lin Yi showed a helpless look, as it was indeed difficult for him to withdraw billions as startup capital right now.
Although he had many assets, those were all fixed assets. Thinking of this, Lin Yi continued to inquire with the system, "Then, can I sell some of those assets?"
"Ding! Yes, Host, assets under the Host's name are at the disposal of the system, and it's no problem if the Host wants to transfer or profit from them."

chapters.title: Chapter 231 Profit
chapters.content:
Hearing the system's response, Lin Yi also felt relieved.
Since he could sell off the assets he had acquired before, he would be able to get the funds he needed now, which was also acceptable.
At this time, after pondering for a while with a serious expression on his face, Han Xuewei saw the change in Lin Yi's expression and couldn't help asking, "Husband, is there something on your mind?"
At her words, Lin Yi raised his head to look at Han Xuewei and said, "I plan to sell off my shares in the Supreme Grade Supermarket, only then can I have the funds to invest in the pharmaceutical factory I mentioned before. The investment in the pharmaceutical factory has to be substantial; otherwise, it definitely won't get off the ground. This time, I've decided to go all in."
As Lin Yi spoke, Han Xuewei was somewhat surprised and hugged him tightly, "Husband, no matter what you want to do, your wife will always support you from behind."
As Han Xuewei spoke, she reached toward the counter, took out the black Golden Dragon card Lin Yi had given her before, and handed it to Lin Yi, saying, "There was over a hundred million in cash in here you gave me before; I haven't used it, so you take it first."
Han Xuewei continued, and Lin Yi took the card from Han Xuewei's hand, suddenly feeling moved. This was originally meant to be his gift to her, but now Han Xuewei had returned it back to him.
At this moment, he looked at Han Xuewei, feeling a burst of emotion.
"Wife, once our pharmaceutical factory turns a profit, I will definitely return tenfold what I owe to you!" Lin Yi said, reaching out to caress Han Xuewei's face.
But Han Xuewei just laughed, "Hey, why do you say that? We're husband and wife, how can we keep such a score? Besides, this is what you gave to me, why mention repaying it?" Han Xuewei said very generously, and Lin Yi was very moved by her words.
Han Xuewei was the kind of virtuous woman who would always stand behind him no matter what. Having her by his side made Lin Yi even more confident. He now embraced Han Xuewei tightly and lifted her head to kiss her forehead.
"You're really the best, wife. Marrying you is the biggest fortune of my life."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei couldn't help laughing, held Lin Yi's head in her hands, and looked at him earnestly, saying, "The love between us is mutual. You're always so good to me, willing to give me anything, and buy me whatever I want, so this one hundred million is really nothing."
When she heard that Lin Yi was planning to sell off some immovable asset shares, she knew Lin Yi's current capital flow wasn't adequate, and it was good that Lin Yi had given her over a hundred million in cash, money she wouldn't use on a daily basis.
And since Lin Yi was considering financial issues, she was certainly there to help.
Even so, Lin Yi still felt extremely moved. He believed that even if he had never given Han Xuewei the card, she would still have given her all to help him.
This was the woman he married, someone who would unconditionally stand behind him. With Han Xuewei so resolute, Lin Yi was even more certain of his goals.
Although Lin Yi had many assets now, they were all in real estate. Without making a profit, they were essentially tied up — no liquidity at all, and even if some cash could be raised, it wouldn't be nearly enough.
He needed tens of billions to finance the entire pharmaceutical factory. He had previously considered the potential of his various industries; many had prospects for development. Only the shares in Supreme Grade Supermarket, of which he held a relatively small amount, could be sold without much impact on him.
Lin Yi now held the black Golden Dragon card given by Han Xuewei, weighed it in his hand, and thought for quite a while.
Seeing that Lin Yi seemed preoccupied, Han Xuewei couldn't help but approach and say, "Husband, I really don't think you need to worry. You have a natural talent for business, this won't be difficult for you. The beginning is always the hardest, but as long as you're determined, I'll always be there supporting you. Even if it fails, it doesn't matter.
If it comes to it, we'll just start a small business later on."
As Han Xuewei spoke, she hugged Lin Yi tightly. Lin Yi was deeply touched upon hearing her words, realizing that Han Xuewei had thought through everything for him.
She had even considered the possibility of his entrepreneurial failure, which wouldn't have too much impact on him either— at most, it would be a financial loss, but it ultimately wouldn't affect his lifestyle.
After all, Lin Yi's assets were already in the tens of billions, and he turned to pinch Han Xuewei's cheek, saying, "Right, what my wife says goes. I'll listen to my wife. Dinner's ready; let's go eat together."
With that, Lin Yi took Han Xuewei's hand, and she immediately moved close to him. Lin Yi wrapped one arm around her waist and effortlessly lifted Han Xuewei into his arms.
He carried her in a princess hold and quickly walked towards the exit, while Han Xuewei, somewhat surprised, patted Lin Yi's shoulder.
"Hey, what are you doing? It wouldn't look good if mom saw us like this at home."
"Isn't it good for our mom to see our affection?" Lin Yi said with a smile, and the two went downstairs together to have dinner.
The next day...
After breakfast the next morning, Han Xuewei took a pile of fluffy toys up to the baby's room on the second floor to play with the child.
Lin Yi returned to his room to strategize on what he recently had to do. He had been quite busy lately with setting up the pharmaceutical factory. Just as he was planning to transfer his shares from Supreme Grade Supermarket, the screen of his phone lit up.
It was a message from the bank. Lin Yi initially thought it was just a regular advertisement and didn't intend to look, but he was drawn in by a long string of digits.
The message on the bank was clear—it was the recent profit from the Wenqu Building. All the property management fees, combined with the regular taxes, totaled over four billion.
Seeing this string of numbers, Lin Yi was momentarily stunned.
After all, Lin Yi hadn't been managing Wenqu Building for long, so he was unaware of its earnings. He immediately made a call to the person in charge at the Wenqu Building.
Upon picking up the phone, the person on the other side seemed even more excited than Lin Yi and said, "Mr. Lin, sorry about that message sent this morning about the deposit. I hope you received it. Apologies for the delay, it should have been sent to you yesterday."
"But due to some minor issues, the finance department delayed it. However, now all the property fees and rents from the past few months have been transferred. After accounting for taxes, please check the total of four billion, two hundred and fifty-four million eight hundred thousand. I will send the profit ledger of the company to you later for verification."

chapters.title: Chapter 232 Fired up
chapters.content:
Lin Yi was shocked when he saw the message; he had never paid much attention to his businesses before and was surprised that in just a few months, their revenue had reached over four hundred million.
Looking at the message, Lin Yi directly asked, "How many months of profits?"
"Five months."
"Four hundred million in five months…" Lin Yi was somewhat astonished, his voice involuntarily rising in pitch. The person on the other end was shocked and asked confusedly, "Is there a problem, Mr. Lin?"
Realizing he might have scared the other person with his words, Lin Yi couldn't help but smile, "No, no, just checking."
Lin Yi spoke indifferently and then hung up the call while the person on the other end let out a sigh after the call had ended.
Just five months and they had earned a whopping four hundred million, and all that while lying at home—it really was different for capitalists!
Now Lin Yi kept counting the figures on his phone; this sudden windfall of over four hundred million had taken him by surprise.
Lin Yi had opened the ledger sent by the manager and began to check the accounts, but the dense figures made no sense to him, so he stopped looking at them.
At that moment, his phone "dinged" with a notification. Lin Yi looked down to see another message from the bank.
As soon as Lin Yi looked down, he couldn't help but curse, "Fuck!"
He kept counting, trying to make sure he wasn't mistaken, but after going over it three or four times, the answer remained the same.
It was the revenue from Jinguo Hotel, a staggering thirty-seven billion. Seeing this figure, Lin Yi felt his eyes go blurry.
"Impossible, it's so exaggerated! How can there be so much money after only five or six months?"
Although the Jinguo Hotel had many chain hotels with little difference—just a bit more upscale—Lin Yi had never anticipated such terrifying profit margins.
He picked up his phone and immediately called Jinguo Hotel's manager Song Jinhui, who, upon answering, already knew what Lin Yi wanted to ask. Song Jinhui's tone was somewhat apologetic.
"I'm so sorry for disturbing you this early, Mr. Lin. I've already had accounting send all of the hotel's profits from the past five months. The total revenue for all our chain hotels that you'll receive in your account amounts to thirty-seven billion, five hundred and eighty-four million, six thousand, two hundred and eighty-eight yuan."
As Lin Yi heard this long string of numbers, his head buzzed. Without the help of his system, he probably wouldn't have been able to earn so much money even if he had started from the Stone Age.
So at this point, Lin Yi was still in a state of astonishment. He didn't speak, but Song Jinhui on the other end was startled by Lin Yi's reaction and quickly said, "I'm truly sorry, Mr. Lin. The profits over the past five months have been nearly a billion less than in the first half of the year. I am really sorry for this loss; it's mainly due to my inadequate management…"
Seeing Song Jinhui full of apologies, Lin Yi finally snapped out of his astonishment and quickly replied, "No problem, no problem! It's just a billion, I was just confirming. Okay, bye!"
Lin Yi said and directly hung up the phone.
Anyway, with over thirty-seven billion, he didn't care about that one billion anymore. Meanwhile, Song Jinhui on the other end stood there stunned, holding his phone.
To the big boss, a billion more or less was of no importance at all—this was incredible!
He had worked hard for many years to reach the position of manager, and earning enough in a year to buy a house already made him an enviable rich man in Xiangcheng.
But Lin Yi? He didn't even care about a billion. The contrast was simply speechless.
Lin Yi looked at the balance on his phone with a joyful smile; he had nothing to worry about anymore. The money had already come through, so he didn't need to think about funding issues for the time being.
Yet soon his phone received many alerts of deposits. It seemed today was the day for receiving transfers: the mall in Wenqu Building had made three billion, the previous security company had made five billion.
There were also quite generous rents from some real estate investments. Lin Yi looked at the messages on his phone, astonished, nearly speechless; he made a rough tally and found an additional fifty-five billion had come in!
Seeing this long string of numbers, Lin Yi felt his head buzzing.
It was indeed shocking.
He had originally planned to sell ten percent of the shares of Supreme Grade Supermarket to convert into cash, but now it seemed there was no need.
Lin Yi took out the black Golden Dragon card from his pocket and placed it on Han Xuewei's desk
His wife was willing to support his career, and he was naturally moved by this, but now that he had the money, why use his wife's?
Looking at the black Golden Dragon card, Lin Yi felt a bit guilty. He hadn't really given Han Xuewei much, and in such tight circumstances, she had even given him money. Thinking of this, Lin Yi immediately transferred five billion yuan to Han Xuewei's black Golden Dragon card and sent twenty million to each of their parents.
Lin Yi went downstairs, where Han Xuewei and Han's mother were talking. Han's mother looked at the message she had received on her phone and furrowed her brows, approaching Lin Yi.
"Oh, Lin Yi, Xue Mei just told me you're planning to set up a pharmaceutical factory and need a significant investment. I was going to ask her father to help you out with the capital turnover, but why have you transferred money to us? You shouldn't be transferring money to us now; you have to keep the capital!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi couldn't help but laugh and said, "You don't have to worry about that anymore. The money from the investments I made before has all been recovered. Today is the settlement day, and there's more than enough funds under my control to invest in the pharmaceutical factory, so there's no need for further complications."
Lin Yi said casually, but Han Xuewei frowned, stepped closer to Lin Yi, and tugged at his sleeve
"Really? Last night, you were still discussing financing with me. How has it been resolved into tens of billions so quickly? Can it be that easy to gather? Honey, don't tell me your investments had a 'mana' boost worth tens of billions!"
Han Xuewei appeared shocked; she kept her voice down to avoid alarming Han's mother.
But Lin Yi just laughed in response, leaning in to Han Xuewei and said, "Wife, you don't have to worry about this. The revenue from Wenqu Building and that new restaurant at Jinguo Hotel, where we dined before, the money earned from those many chain hotels is already quite substantial."

chapters.title: Chapter 233 Shopping
chapters.content:
At this moment, Lin Yi was saying this, and Hannah Xuewei couldn't help but frown, looking somewhat shocked as she leaned into Lin Yi's face.
"Even so, it can't be that much, right? You told me last night that you were going to invest, which usually needs a lot of money."
"Indeed, it requires a lot of money, but the profits from today have all been reclaimed. Now, real estate is very expensive, so the money collected is naturally substantial. Plus, the earnings from nearly half a year of profit from Jinguo Hotel chains were all credited to my card. I now have several tens of billions."
Lin Yi whispered, causing Hannah Xuewei to widen her eyes in surprise.
"I've just transferred five billion to your card," Lin Yi said, and Hannah Xuewei was still shocked. "No way, that much money?!"
"Yes, all of this is just the profits from the past few months. Okay, now you don't have to think too much, nor worry about me!" Lin Yi said, afraid that Hannah Xuewei wouldn't believe him.
At this moment, Hannah Xuewei's expression was one of elation as she hugged Lin Yi. "Husband, you're too amazing. I'm going to congratulate you in advance for the huge sales in your pharmaceutical factory. When that happens, we will have even more money, and then I definitely want to be a spendthrift."
Hannah Xuewei said, laughing.
Lin Yi pinched her little face and nodded, "Okay, wife! The husband earns money to spend on his wife..."
After they finished speaking, at this moment, Mother Lin's call was heard at the entrance, "Lin Yi, come out and help quickly, hurry up."
Hearing this voice, Lin Yi and Hannah Xuewei looked at each other, then walked toward the outside.
As Lin Yi reached the door, both he and Hannah Xuewei were stunned in place.
Mother Lin just came out at this moment, opened the trunk, which was packed full with various items. Father Lin got off the car and spoke directly to Lin Yi: "Boy, hurry up and help. These things all need to be moved to the babies' rooms."
Father Lin said, and Lin Yi furrowed his brows, looking at the trunk full of children's supplies and clothes which almost completely filled up the entire trunk.
"Good heavens, Mom, this is way too much!" Lin Yi's pupils dilated in shock, and Hannah Xuewei was also very surprised. It seemed Mother Lin's spending power could compete with that of Qin Xiaoxu.
But right now, Mother Lin was still very happy, patting Lin Yi's shoulder and saying, "Oh, you rascal. When I was at the mall just now, I saw those children's clothes, they were just too adorable, I couldn't help but buy a bit more!"
"This is more than just a bit!" Lin Yi teased, while Mother Lin laughingly said, "I bought many styles, these are all for the babies to change into. Some styles, I bought two or three of each. Besides, our three kids are different from others; these won't go bad if we keep them, and kids grow so fast. I also bought bigger sizes that can fit the little ones until they're three years old!"
Mother Lin boasted proudly, and Hannah Xuewei just laughed along. She had no intention of dampening anyone's spirits, and for them, this sort of thing genuinely couldn't be counted as wasteful.
After all, it's better to buy some practical things than some luxury goods.
"I think it's good, kids grow up so quickly anyway. Thanks, Mom, for buying me so much stuff," Hannah Xuewei said, and Mother Lin also was amused into laughter, as she was thoroughly pleased with her daughter-in-law.
After all, Hannah Xuewei was very gentle, and she had a knack for being insightful, not one to throw a tantrum over minor issues—utterly virtuous and impeccable.
"Exactly, Vivi, you like all these clothes, don't you? I just thought this piece was so adorable that if we put it on Mengmeng, she'll be off-the-charts cute."
Mother Lin said while pulling out a pink bow. Han Xuewei also liked it very much. At this moment, Lin Yi was busy organizing the clothes, sorting them one by one and placing them in the box.
As he was sorting, he felt something hard and slightly frowned before saying, "Mom! Isn't this a stroller? We already have strollers at home."
Mother Lin turned her head to look at Lin Yi and replied, "You don't understand, do you? We don't have just one child; we have three. I bought these few strollers so we can switch them out immediately when they get dirty, which will save us a lot of effort.
Besides, some of them are the larger size, which the babies can still use when they get a bit bigger. I didn't buy many, just four!" After Mother Lin explained, Lin Yi suddenly felt dizzy and overwhelmed. With three kids at home, they already had two or three strollers, and now four more were bought…
Indeed, women, as a species, tend to buy something as long as they feel it will be useful, regardless of the quantity. The main point is its utility.
Lin Yi laughed, having nothing to say. After all, earning money was for the sake of his family's happiness.
After organizing the clothes, Lin Yi carried them upstairs, to a room similar to a storage area, where mainly kids' items were placed, and rarely anything for grown-ups.
Once Lin Yi had put everything away, Mother Lin looked at the neatly arranged items in the room and couldn't help but show a delighted expression, "This is just wonderful. Tomorrow, I'll wash these first, and after they're clean, the babies can wear them."
Han's mother came out at that moment, too, and upon seeing the vast amount of stuff filling the room, she showed a surprised look. Drawing closer, she realized all of it was the babies' belongings and couldn't help but laugh.
"Oh my, in-law, you really went all out this time. These clothes are just too cute. I can already picture how they'll look in them."
"Yes, yes, that shopping mall was such a delight to browse. We'll go together next time."" They chattered on and on.
Lin Yi, panting with exertion from moving all the stuff upstairs, was nearly on the verge of collapse. Meanwhile, Han Xuewei was helping Lin Yi sort things out at his side.
As Lin Yi placed the clothes, he couldn't help but say, "Isn't this item's design the same as that one?"
Han Xuewei: "This one has a bow, and that one does not."
Lin Yi: "..."
"And what about this one? They're both blue; they don't look any different!"
"The patterns on this one are different!" Han Xuewei added, causing Lin Yi's head to swim. Women truly are perceptive creatures; what seemed to him as repetitive and similar, each piece felt unique to Han Xuewei.
The two of them were organizing when Mother Lin and Han's mother started chatting enthusiastically at the doorstep. After a while, Lin Yi called Han Xuewei over to join the conversation with them.
Seeing that most of the sorting was done, Han Xuewei didn't refuse.
And just like that, the day passed joyfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 234 Overbearing Counterattack
chapters.content:
The next morning, Lin Yi left home as he was planning to sign a contract with Zhou Kongshan.
When he arrived at Zhou Kongshan's pharmaceutical factory, Zhou Kongshan had already prepared the contract and had it stamped by a lawyer. Lin Yi reviewed it, found no issues, and signed it directly.
Zhou Kongshan now became his official shareholder, and Lin Yi decided to keep him as the factory director, with all the employees continuing their work. Lin Yi was just holding ninety percent of the shares, and everything except the name remained unchanged.
The factory's name was changed to Yi Xue Pharmaceuticals, but other than that, Lin Yi made no changes. After all, he wasn't very familiar with all this, and the person who knew it best was still Zhou Kongshan.
So, leaving Zhou Kongshan to handle things was something Lin Yi was comfortable with. Lin Yi directly transferred forty-five billion to the company's account, leaving everything in Zhou Kongshan's hands. As for recruiting core personnel, that was up to Zhou Kongshan to manage.
The few demands Lin Yi made included the most important one—the development of a medication that could boost the immune and defensive power of children and the elderly.
In Lin Yi's opinion, if such a medication could be successfully developed, it would have a huge market potential in the future, something he had always wanted to pursue.
After chatting for a while, Lin Yi drove back to school. Inside the car, he didn't idle away his time; he took a Bluetooth headset and dialed a number, reaching the head of security, Zhou Jianlai.
Zhou Jianlai was somewhat surprised to receive the call, but Lin Yi immediately instructed him to keep a close watch on the situation at the hotel.
As for the Body Tempering Divine Water he had obtained from the system previously, Lin Yi hadn't planned to use it right away. After all, he still needed to see what kind of core technical personnel Zhou Kongshan could recruit before bringing out his Body Tempering Divine Water for them to research.
If they weren't competent, he couldn't afford to take risks. Moreover, he needed to assess a person's character, as it would greatly impact him if they decided to sell his Potion outright. Therefore, this matter required careful consideration.
Lin Yi was driving and had intended to go directly to school to meet Han Xuewei, but when he passed by a barbershop and saw his flowing long hair, he remembered that Han Xuewei had mentioned that his hair was too long.
Lin Yi had been meaning to get a haircut but hadn't found the time. Taking advantage of being en route, he decided to get a haircut, so he parked his car by the roadside and walked into the barbershop.
…
Lin Yi was busy today, so he didn't go to school with her and would probably be late, which was just as well since he didn't have any classes in the morning.
However, Han Xuewei's schedule was quite packed, except for a long lunch break at noon. Lin Yi thought that the dormitory conditions at school were not very good, so Han Xuewei rested directly in their RV, given that its conditions were no less than those of a villa.
Han Xuewei, who had been looking after the child recently, felt quite exhausted, so she headed towards the RV intending to have a good sleep.
Halfway there, she saw a girl walking out and stopping in front of Han Xuewei.
The girl looked quite pretty, appearing very young—probably just a freshman—with a white dress trailing down to her knees, her waist cocked as she stood in front of Han Xuewei, still looking quite attractive.
However, Han Xuewei hadn't put on makeup or dressed up, but she seemed much more graceful and luxurious than the girl. Showing an expression of surprise, Han Xuewei frowned as she looked at the girl blocking her path, finding the encounter rather baffling.
Fixing Han Xuewei with a hostile gaze, the girl directly said, "You are the campus belle of our Xiangcheng University, Han Xuewei, right? I just started as a freshman this year, and the guy I've been pursuing—is he often paying attention to you? Has he asked for your WeChat? His name is Lin Shuo, is there such a thing?"
"Heh, I'm here to warn you, from now on, act less pretentious in front of him, and don't walk this way anymore. He often appears around here. Don't think I don't know what you're up to, walking this path deliberately just to seduce those new boys!"
"I remember you're married, aren't you? It's not appropriate for a married woman to flirt so openly with other young men." The girl's words were pointed and sarcastic, as she chastised Han Xuewei relentlessly.
Han Xuewei was somewhat shocked, and her face quickly took on a displeased look. She didn't have the temperament to let someone walk all over her, and she was just about to lose her temper.
But then, a tall figure walked up from behind her, placing a hand to stop Han Xuewei and leaning his chin on her forehead, wrapping her up tight, taking the purse from her shoulder and slinging it over himself in a movement that was both domineering and intimate.
Han Xuewei hadn't quite reacted yet, but she recognized the scent of the person behind her and it dawned on her.
Lin Yi looked at the girl in front of him with a nonchalant gaze and snorted coldly, "Are you here to joke? You know my wife is someone's wife; why would you still fear she might seduce other men? Could it be that you lack the confidence to charm a man yourself? So much so that you have to malign my wife here?!
My wife, she just has that charm—she didn't seduce anyone; it's those men who have eyes to see and can't help but be drawn to her."
Lin Yi looked down at the girl with disdain in his eyes. Han Xuewei looked up at Lin Yi, admiration welling up in her gaze.
Lin Yi had his hair cut short and neat, his gaze sharp, his features handsome, and together with his tall stature standing behind Han Xuewei, he truly resembled a domineering CEO out of a novel.
Looking at Lin Yi's haircut, Han Xuewei couldn't help but internally exclaim, too handsome!
Seeing the admiration in Han Xuewei's eyes, Lin Yi's expression instantly brightened, pleased that a simple haircut could make such a difference.
Before Lin Yi could revel in his happiness, Han Xuewei eagerly said, "Honey, why are you here so early today?"
Han Xue'er felt happy; now looking at the girl, she spoke with more confidence, "Fellow student, you well know I'm a married woman, so you should understand I will only love my husband. As for whether others like me or focus their attention on me—that has nothing to do with me, I can't control other people's thoughts.
But to say I can't walk this way anymore, that's out of the question. You don't have the right to interfere with my life. Besides, let me remind you, a woman should not lack self-confidence, otherwise she's already lost. And another thing, don't devalue yourself by rushing to throw yourself at someone—they may not even like you!"
Han Xuewei spoke assertively. Lin Yi was also a bit surprised, his eyes sparkling as he watched her.

chapters.title: Chapter 235 Intimacy
chapters.content:
At that moment, the girl facing Han Xuewei was extremely embarrassed by what she'd just said, her face flushed as she looked at the loving couple before her, feeling like she had lost face in a big way.
She had been paying close attention to the person she liked, but recently she realized that he was always paying attention to Han Xuewei.
She deliberately took this route just to catch a glimpse of Han Xuewei, naturally not willing to accept it. She had pursued that guy for so long, and he hadn't given her any response.
Yet, he was so affectionate toward Han Xuewei, even purposely waiting for her on this path just for a fleeting glance at her.
How could she accept this? So, finally finding her opportunity today, she had intended to thoroughly humiliate Han Xuewei, only to end up being the one humiliated.
Lin Yi looked at how domineering Han Xuewei had been just now and couldn't help but laugh, "Wife, you're so cool."
As Lin Yi spoke, Han Xuewei simply smiled faintly. Without saying much, she took Lin Yi's hand and walked forward.
Meanwhile, the girl who had been confronting Han Xuewei stood frozen in the center, her face extremely red and not knowing what to do as the surrounding people began to whisper among themselves.
"Hey, did you see what just happened? There seemed to be a quarrel up there."
"I recognize that girl, isn't she the new student who just arrived? She's quite pretty and I heard she's studying arts, named Jiang Lanyu."
"Why would she argue with our school's beauty queen?"
Explore hidden tales at empire
"Haven't you heard? She likes a really handsome guy, but it seems like he's not into her. Before this, he was praising our school beauty's looks in front of everyone."
"Looks like someone couldn't take it and went after her."
"No way, isn't our school beauty's attractiveness known to everyone? Why would she act like this?"
"That new girl is indeed pretty, but I don't know why she's so insecure and even went to pick a fight; she just doesn't know, after all being new here, our school beauty and her husband are incredibly close. There's no need for anyone else to gossip."
Amidst the murmuring crowd, Jiang Lanyu felt extreme embarrassment and humiliation.
She had already confessed to Lin Shuo, but he didn't accept or reject her, just kept her hanging.
Yet she still couldn't give up. Now that this incident had attracted attention, it would surely spread like wildfire. She was feeling extremely embarrassed and regretted being so unrelenting earlier.
If Lin Shuo found out about this, he would probably dislike her even more.
Lin Shuo would always take this particular route just to see Han Xuewei. In this moment, Jiang Lanyu felt extremely awkward, immediately fleeing the scene. She didn't want to encounter Lin Shuo anymore.
Han Xuewei walked forward with Lin Yi, who was wearing a calm expression at the moment, silent.
His neat and sharp short hair complimented his handsome features, giving him an air of aloofness when silent.
However, Lin Yi rarely showed displeasure in front of her, so Han Xuewei knew that he was probably upset because of what that girl had said earlier.
Lin Yi, though not expressive, simply loathed those who caused Han Xuewei trouble and distress.
"Husband, I thought you were going to talk business today and probably wouldn't come to the school!" Han Xuewei initiated the conversation; Lin Yi looked at her and merely took a breath before saying, "No, I didn't drop you off this morning, so I thought I'd come over to see you."
As Lin Yi spoke, Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh. They walked on, and ahead of them, a large pipe was pumping water for the construction of a fountain, with water all over the ground.
The pipe was very large, and Han Xuewei could only walk around it from one side. Just as she was about to step forward, Lin Yi immediately blocked her waist, and with a lean of his body, Han Xuewei was held in his arms, pressed against Lin Yi.
Next, Lin Yi lifted his leg and strode forward, instantly stepping over the huge pipe. Han Xuewei was somewhat astonished, and by the time she realized what was happening, her face had already turned red.
Everyone around was watching them, and Han Xuewei felt a bit embarrassed as Lin Yi put her down, but at that moment, Lin Yi was quite smug, leaning in and saying, "Call me 'brother' and let me hear it."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei's face turned even redder, like a ripe apple.
"Lin Yi brother, put me down," Han Xuewei's warm, tender voice rang out, stirring something in Lin Yi, softening him. He patted her head and then set her down, taking her hand.
"It's not often we get to stroll around the campus together, so we definitely need to take a good walk. All these people always gossiping, now it's time to strut our stuff."
With that said, Lin Yi childishly took Han Xuemei's hand.
Seeing his reaction, Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh. The two of them then walked together toward the campus corridors. Han Xuewei and Lin Yi were quite nonchalant since everyone already knew that they were a married couple.
Some couples in the school would also stroll around together, but there were still some new students who were quite gossipy. Seeing Lin Yi and Han Xuewei, they started discussing it amongst themselves, but most of their comments were of admiration.
After wandering for a while, Lin Yi found a long bench to sit on. Han Xuewei was about to sit next to him when he unexpectedly stretched out his hand and wrapped it around her waist, and Han Xuewei tumbled into his arms, sitting on Lin Yi's lap.
Lin Yi held Han Xuewei with a calm and indifferent expression, as if it was nothing out of the ordinary, but Han Xuewei felt that this position was way too bold. At home, she wouldn't mind, but they were at school now, where many people would pass by!
If they were seen by others, she would die of embarrassment. Han Xuewei looked around quickly and immediately tapped Lin Yi on the shoulder, "Husband, it would be so awkward if someone came by now, let me down."
Han Xuewei said anxiously, Lin Yi raised an eyebrow casually answering, "We're not doing anything, just hugging."
Lin Yi spoke nonchalantly, but Han Xuewei's face had turned as red as a cooked shrimp. She looked at Lin Yi, still feeling embarrassed, "No, no, if someone comes by later..."
Han Xuewei said, struggling to get up.
Lin Yi then leaned in close to Han Xuewei's face, "No one will see, just for a moment."
Lin Yi said and moved closer to Han Xuewei's face, kissing her.
Han Xuewei hadn't finished her sentence when Lin Yi kissed her, and since Han Xuewei liked Lin Yi very much, she lost her senses at that moment and fervently responded.
The two of them indulged for quite a while before separating. Han Xuewei didn't dare to continue kissing; if Lin Yi really couldn't hold back after a while, it would be the end of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 236 Flirting
chapters.content:
However, aside from kissing for a while, Lin Yi didn't do anything else.
Now that Han Xuewei had become a wife, she was no longer as guarded and fearful about such matters.
She now fully trusted Lin Yi, and if they had been at home, he probably would have been more proactive. Lin Yi had always been very gentle with Han Xuewei before; he never made a move on her too directly. Trust was something they had built up step by step.
Cradling Han Xuewei in his arms, Lin Yi spoke, "If someone ever gives you trouble again, just tell me or call me. How could my wife have to endure such things?"
As Lin Yi spoke, he pinched Han Xuewei's cheek. Seeing no one around, Han Xuewei wrapped her arms around Lin Yi, "Alright, husband, I got it. How did the business talk go today? Did you settle the matters with the pharmaceutical factory?"
Han Xuewei was very concerned, and Lin Yi nodded in response, "Yes, the contracts are all signed, and the funding has started to roll out too. We'll be up and running soon."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei was somewhat surprised.
"That means we can start developing that medicine you talked about, right? But the one you mentioned sounds too miraculous. Does it really have such magical effects?"
The current vaccines can only provide simple prevention against diseases. If a vaccine could be 100% effective, that would be like a panacea.
If that were the case, there would certainly be a high sales rate. After all, it's so tough when children get sick, and parents definitely hope their children can be free from illness and pain.
"If it were up to me, as long as the medicine isn't exorbitantly priced, I would definitely buy it for my children," she said.
At this, Lin Yi nodded and replied, "Yes, children's health is something we can't delay. The elderly, too, if they get sick, it's a lot of trouble, so I think a greater part of the public is very concerned about this.
Remember the child with leukemia we saw at the hospital entrance? Chemotherapy for leukemia is extremely tough, and they have to endure a lot of pain. If this industry really takes off, then we can promote it to the outside world, help more children, and prevent some unnecessary diseases. I think it's very meaningful."
As Lin Yi spoke, he lowered his head and hugged Han Xuewei tighter, saying, "Oh my, we came out today to enjoy our time together, and here we are talking about work again."
With those words, Lin Yi held Han Xuewei close, his hand on hers. As he touched her hand, he frowned and chuckled playfully.
"Why didn't you wear your ring today?" After saying that, Lin Yi took out the custom-made multi-million dollar ring he had given to Han Xuewei from his pocket and slid it onto her finger.
In the sunlight, the ring sparkled brilliantly. Han Xuewei cherished the ring since it was so expensive, but she hadn't expected Lin Yi to carry it with him so casually—it was a multi-million dollar diamond ring after all.
But Han Xuewei didn't say anything, just looking at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi couldn't help but laugh, "What, do you think today's hairstyle looks handsome on me? Are you afraid that other girls will try to hook me?"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei also laughed, "Yeah, as you walked down the street today, who knows how many girls you've captivated."
As they talked, Lin Yi was serious, holding Han Xuewei tightly, "I don't know about others, but I only have eyes for my wife."
The two of them were wrapped up in each other, exchanging their corny love talk.
Han Xuewei laughed heartily, teased by Lin Yi. They had chatted for a long time, but when Han Xuewei turned her head upon hearing footsteps, she couldn't help but frown. She was still sitting on Lin Yi's lap; it would definitely be awkward if they were seen!
Thus, her body stiffened in fright, and she hurriedly attempted to get up, but Lin Yi held her shoulders down, embracing her waist tightly, preventing her from getting up no matter how much she moved.
"Oh, Lin Yi, let me go. I hear footsteps; someone must be coming this way," Han Xuewei said anxiously, her face flushed. It would be incredibly embarrassing if they were to be seen.
And right now, she also didn't want to be seen in front of others. She thought if word got out, she would die of embarrassment.
Lin Yi laughed, holding Han Xuewei tight and flashing a cunning smile, "Oh no, we can't. Holding you for a while is nothing serious. So you've been paying attention all this time to see if anyone is coming, getting so alert at any sound of footsteps. We are husband and wife, after all; this kind of behavior is very generous and natural."
"Don't tell me, wife, that you think your husband is so ugly that it embarrasses you," he said before pressing against Han Xuewei like a rascal, refusing to let go.
Han Xuewei felt incredibly awkward and without further thought, she turned her head and buried it into Lin Yi's chest.
Since she couldn't escape, she decided to hide her face from others. Lin Yi couldn't help but laugh at her ostrich-like reaction.
Soon, a couple walked by. Seeing them cuddled up on the bench, they did not interrupt and walked away.
Lin Yi couldn't help but burst out laughing, "See, I told you there was nothing to worry about. You got all panicked for nothing."
Han Xuewei then pinched Lin Yi's chest, causing him pain, which made him immediately let go.
Han Xuewei's hair had become disheveled when she buried her head into Lin Yi's chest. He immediately smoothed her hair down for her.
"Alright, don't be angry. Do you want to eat in the canteen tonight or go back home?"
"Of course, we'll go home. I only want to eat what you cook. The canteen food isn't tasty, it's greasy, but the dishes my husband makes are the best."
"Okay, okay, I'll make whatever you want to eat," Lin Yi said, pinching Han Xuewei's cheek.
Han Xuewei laughed, "That's wonderful, my husband is a great chef. You're the best to me." Stay tuned to empire
"I'm your husband, if I don't treat you well, whom should I treat well? Didn't you just call me 'brother' a while ago? Call me that again, and I'll go back and cook for you right now."
At that moment, Han Xuewei showed a giggling expression and hesitated for a moment before saying, "Okay, Lin Yi brother."
"Is that reluctant tone because you're just considering the meal I'll make? You don't sound very willing."
Lin Yi couldn't help but curve his lips upwards, and Han Xuewei laughed again, "Come on, let's go home to cook. Lin Yi brother, Yi brother, Yi brother!!"
Han Xuewei kept calling out, and Lin Yi listened with extra pleasure. He nodded and said, "Good girl."

chapters.title: Chapter 237 Accidental Encounter
chapters.content:
The two flirted for a while before Han Xuewei returned to the classroom for her lesson, and Lin Yi to his.
Han Xuewei also got back to her classroom. The afternoon class consisted of outdoor sketching, but since going outside wasn't convenient at the moment, they carried on with it on campus.
There happened to be a park nearby the school, spacious enough for the students to sketch together.
Explore stories on empire
Han Xuewei went along with her classmates. It wasn't far, and she arrived quickly. She really liked this kind of class because it was quite free; once her painting was finished, she could leave.
Han Xuewei chose a quiet spot to sit down, away from the passing crowd. Though people came and went in front, her little corner was quite peaceful. She observed her surroundings.
She had planned to start with the plants, but then she saw a couple sitting on a bench in the park, looking at the children playing in the distance. She found the scene beautiful and hoped to have such a life with Lin Yi one day.
So, she picked up her pencil and started to gently sketch on the blank paper. The tip of her pencil danced across the page, tracing curves that twisted into a beautiful drawing. She soon brought the scene to life.
The sketch featured a couple with several kids frolicking in front. After finishing, Han Xuewei planned to hand in this drawing to the teacher and decided to take the other one home with her.
The other was a casual drawing of children. Han Xuewei was very good at sketching, so she worked quickly. After completing the drawing, she checked her watch and saw that an hour had gone by. They had already spent a lot of time looking for a place to sketch, so it was indeed time to go back.
After packing up her paints and some pens and paper, Han Xuewei slung her bag over her shoulder and walked toward the front. Some classmates had left before her, so there were only a few people around when she stepped out.
All of Han Xuewei's classmates had left, so she walked alone towards the front. On the way, there was an adorably designed kindergarten with several balloons flying above it.
As the bell rang, a group of children ran out to play, their laughter instantly filling the entire kindergarten.
The kindergarten wasn't very big, just one building's space with a courtyard-like area below.
There were many child-friendly structures for the kids to play with. As Han Xuewei walked towards the front, she stopped at the school gate. The children had innocent and cute faces, brimming with smiles as they ran around the grass and various play structures. Their joy was so radiant, and they played with such happiness.
Watching them, a gentle smile spread across Han Xuewei's face. She loved children very much, and seeing them play so happily brightened her mood as well.
At that moment, Teacher Mo approached her. Han Xuewei looked up and saw a figure standing in front of her.
Seeing Teacher Mo, Han Xuewei spoke with some surprise, "Teacher Mo, what a surprise to see you here!"
Hearing Han Xuewei address him as Teacher Mo, Mo Jihua's expression dimmed slightly, but he didn't say much. He just felt that Han Xuewei was becoming more and more estranged from him.
After all, when they were little, the two of them were extremely close, but now Han Xuewei had become a wife, and everything was changing.
At that moment, Mo Jihua just smiled slightly and said, "No, I just came out to buy some groceries and didn't expect to see you here. It's quite a coincidence."
"Yes, I came out for class today. Our teacher organized a group of us students to come out and do sketching. Now that my lesson is finished, I'm about to head back."
Upon hearing this, Mo Jihua just nodded and said, "Is that so? I saw you lingering here for quite a while and didn't have the heart to disturb you. But I thought since I was here, I should definitely greet you. I was afraid I had startled you with my appearance earlier."
Mo Jihua spoke with a hint of apology. Hearing this, Han Xuewei immediately waved her hands dismissively, "That's not at all necessary, Teacher Mo. Seeing these kids now just makes me feel they're so adorable, brimming with vitality and life. Thinking that my child will someday attend kindergarten, I just couldn't help but watch them a bit longer and observe how they would behave in the future."
At these words, Mo Jihua just laughed, "It seems you really like children. I've been following your social media and 'Moments'. Although I've never seen your child, I have seen the photos, and they really are very cute and beautiful, a lot like you."
Han Xuewei was somewhat surprised; she hadn't expected Mo Jihua to follow her social platforms and 'Moments'. She just smiled and replied, "Well, thank you for your attention, Teacher Mo."
After saying this, she scratched her head, possibly thinking she had oversimplified everything. She had always thought her relationship with Mo Jihua was merely a normal friendship, not too much to say childhood sweethearts, from youth to adulthood.
She didn't seem to have other interests beyond that, but after Lin Yi's reminder, she did realize something – that perhaps Mo Jihua's feelings for her were different, not just the simple affection of a boy next door.
Moreover, the fact that he followed her 'Moments' made Han Xuewei feel somewhat embarrassed, but she didn't say anything more and planned to just say goodbye and leave.
Just as the two of them quieted down, a security guard walked toward them from the school gate, frowned when he saw them, and asked, "What are you two doing here? Are you here to pick up a child or to check out the school?"
As he spoke, he observed Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua. After all, this was a kindergarten, and so he naturally assumed they were a couple here to see the school for their child's potential enrollment.
But Han Xuewei immediately shook her head, "No, sir, you've got it wrong."
As she spoke, she attempted to put some distance between herself and Mo Jihua. Meanwhile, the security guard, looking at Mo Jihua and then Han Xuewei, felt they both seemed quite kind-hearted. Thinking that since they were interested in the kindergarten, it would not be a problem to let them in.
After all, they were currently deciding on admissions and indeed needed some promotion. The guard then smiled and said, "If you two don't mind, I can notify the principal to give you a tour. Our facilities here are pretty good, and the educational environment is excellent as well. It's worth considering."
As he spoke, he still regarded Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua as a couple because both their appearance and demeanor seemed very compatible.

chapters.title: Chapter 238 On Fire
chapters.content:
Seeing how well the security guard treated the two of them, and that he was sincerely inviting them to visit, Han Xuewei was somewhat moved.
She really liked children and wanted to see how they lived in the kindergarten, so she walked forward.
Mo Jihua nodded and said, "Not bad, we can go in and take a look."
Seizing the opportunity, Han Xuewei nodded, and Mo Jihua walked inside. He understood that the security guard probably mistook him for Han Xuewei's husband.
For some reason, he felt extremely pleased to be misunderstood like this. If all of it were true, how wonderful that would be.
Han Xuewei walked towards the inside, where the children were still playing outside. One child slid down a slide, and another ran out. Seeing this scene full of vitality, Han Xuewei just smiled slightly.
Then the security guard came over with a pencil and a notebook and said, "The two of you, please register first. Everyone needs to sign in when they enter here."
Soon after finishing the registration, Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua ran to the front to watch the children play. The children were not shy, probably because they felt that Han Xuewei radiated a maternal glow that made them feel close to her.
But just then, while the children were playing, a series of heart-wrenching screams suddenly came from the second floor of the kindergarten, sounding utterly terrifying.
The security guard immediately showed a vigilant expression and rushed forward without paying any attention to Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua.
Quickly, many children were carried out from the first floor, crying and wailing, creating a scene of chaos. Many teachers were pulling three or four children with one hand and dragging five or six children with the other hand, all heading outside.
Looking towards the second floor, thick black smoke was already billowing out.
Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua were both shocked by the sight, and the teachers started to scream.
"Quick, put out the fire, save them! There's a fire inside, someone set it on fire, catch her, it's one of our school's teachers!"
Both Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua were stunned by these words.
Han Xuewei's eyes widened, "What's going on? Is there really a fire?"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei found it unbelievable. This was a kindergarten, filled with children. Who would be so audacious to set fire to a building here?! Were they indifferent to the lives of so many little children?
At that moment, a female teacher ran out breathlessly, putting down a little boy she was carrying. She spoke exhaustedly, "That woman is one of our teachers. When I went up to catch her, she ran away. I don't know what she was up to. After clearing the children a bit, she just ignited the gas in the kitchen!"
"And she ignited it inside the classroom. There are still other children inside. I managed to bring a few out; the children were all frightened and crying..."
"We've called the police. It's too terrifying, really too terrifying!"
"How much longer until the firefighters arrive?!"
"It should still be about ten more minutes; we've just called the police!"
The teachers were discussing it amongst themselves, their faces not hiding the panic. Han Xuewei looked at the billowing black smoke coming from the second floor and thought of the children. Seeing the children gasping and crying, she showed a look of determination.
"Teacher Mo, we can't delay any longer, the children are still inside!" Han Xuewei said, and quickly walked toward the front.
The direction they were headed was the security room, where some spare fire extinguishers were usually kept idle. Just now, a security guard had taken one and ran upstairs with it.
Han Xuewei thought that another person could provide additional strength. Mo Jihua was also somewhat surprised, having not expected Han Xuewei to be so brave in such a situation.
Mo Jihua grabbed two fire extinguishers, and Han Xuewei took one from him. The extinguisher was quite heavy in her hands, but she still forcefully lifted it without saying a word and quickly ran forward.
The surrounding teachers were all frightened by their actions, but only they knew how serious it was inside.
At this moment, seeing the billowing black smoke pouring out, Han Xuewei knew it must be very dangerous inside. If the children were inside, inhaling that black smoke could potentially cause lifelong damage to their lungs.
Han Xuewei, regardless of anything else, charged forward. Ever since she became a mother, her courage had grown much greater than before. Dense black smoke rolled toward them, but Han Xuewei didn't hesitate and briskly continued onward.
At the staircase, they saw a panicked woman running out crazily, followed by a group of security guards shouting.
"It's that woman, don't let her escape!"
"Go to the first floor, block her! Block her!"
As the people yelled, the woman, with no way out, turned back from the corridor and charged toward Han Xuewei and her group.
At that moment, Han Xuewei was holding a fire extinguisher when she heard the commotion outside. The woman came rushing toward her, wielding a knife, which caused Han Xuewei to reveal a look of panic.
Mo Jihua immediately raised the fire extinguisher in his hand and it clashed with the knife, producing a sonorous clang.
Then, he swung the heavy extinguisher down, hitting the woman's wrist. She immediately showed a pained expression and stumbled backward, falling to the ground.
Seeing the weapon drop from the woman's hand, Mo Jihua acted quickly, lunging forward. It was relatively easy for an adult man to subdue a woman. Mo Jihua grabbed her hand and pressed her back hard, pinning her to the ground.
But the woman struggled wildly, flailing her arms and legs at Mo Jihua, scratching and clawing at his hands. In an instant, several bloodstains appeared on the back of Mo Jihua's hand and arm.
Yet Mo Jihua did not hesitate and continued to hold the woman down, while Han Xuewei also stepped in to help pin her down, until several security guards quickly arrived.
Mo Jihua then lifted his head and said, "First, take the fire extinguisher, put out the fire!"
As Mo Jihua spoke, Han Xuewei didn't hesitate and immediately took the fire extinguisher and ran forward. The most important thing now was the group of children hiding in the classroom. After the security guards had subdued the woman,
Mo Jihua also picked up a fire extinguisher and charged in with Han Xuewei, followed by several other people who came to help.
Although the fire was increasingly fierce, they had discovered it in time. Thankfully, the children had already left the classroom and were all hiding in the corner of the classroom. The fire had started in another classroom.
At least the situation wasn't as bad as it could have been. Han Xuewei was pressing on the fire extinguisher, which was nearly emptied.

chapters.title: Chapter 239 Rescue the Child
chapters.content:
At that moment, a security guard rushed in, urgently waving her hand and saying, "We can evacuate now, the fire brigade has arrived."
The fire was evolving so violently that it was a good opportunity to leave in light of the fire brigade's arrival, for staying any longer would cause one to inhale too much smoke, which is harmful to one's health.
However, at this time, Han Xuewei heard the crying of children from a nearby classroom. Unfortunately, there were still two children trapped inside, and that classroom was already ablaze.
Seeing this scene, Han Xuewei felt a chill in her heart.
If the children weren't rescued in time, they would surely be scorched by the fierce flames. The thought of the children she had seen on the news, burned and in agony, filled Han Xuewei with pain.
That would be a life entirely surrendered to the flames, so Han Xuewei grabbed a fire extinguisher from another security guard and said, "Teacher Mo, let's go in together."
Mo Jihua hadn't expected Han Xuewei to be so brave. He nodded and followed her as she charged in. When Han Xuewei ran in, she saw two little boys crying loudly, hiding in a corner.
Looking at the fierce flames, the two boys were terrified. Seeing that the children weren't in immediate danger, Han Xuewei rushed over at once.
Mo Jihua could only spray the fire extinguisher from the outside, but the fire was too fierce and too far away; the extinguisher had no effect. At that time, Han Xuewei picked up the two children who were both crying, already cried out of energy.
"Don't be afraid, don't be afraid..." Han Xuewei comforted them as she picked them up, their faces covered in grime, probably from the black smoke.
Han Xuewei was also exhausted, coughing continuously. If she stayed any longer, she feared she wouldn't last much longer herself.
Cradling the two children was difficult for Han Xuewei, so Mo Jihua, without hesitation, dashed forward, took one child from her arms, and the two of them quickly ran toward the front.
Most of the children in the classroom had been evacuated, leaving only these two boys. As they ran out, the fire truck had just arrived, and the firefighters were climbing up with hoses.
At that moment, Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua, holding the two children, ran out frantically. Seeing this, the teachers showed expressions of joy and rushed forward.
If not for the sudden rescue by Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua, today might have ended in tragedy. These two young children, so young and caught in the midst of raging flames, might have been rendered unconscious by the smoke long before burning.
At that moment, the two children were still wailing, shaking from shock.
Mo Jihua then put the child he was carrying down, his arm bearing distinct scratches, wounds that were still oozing beads of blood, a sobering sight.
Then, Han Xuewei looked at Mo Jihua's bloodied hands, which bore several scratches from the frantic female teacher.
Feeling a sting at the sight, Han Xuewei immediately asked, "Teacher Mo, do you need to go to the hospital for your hand?"
Several teachers next to them had already taken out the medical kit and ran out, then they brought out disinfecting Potion and walked towards them.
Meanwhile, the children were still crying incessantly. Watching the firefighters running out one by one from the fire truck and scaling the building in their gear, the blare of the fire truck's siren filled the air. All the children showed a look of amazement and stopped crying.
Later, after asking the teachers, it was learned that the two little boys had run to other classrooms to play and hid behind cabinets on purpose. They thought they were safe, but unexpectedly, everyone else had already evacuated, and the fire started burning from that side.
They wanted to run but the door was too far away, and the thick smoke obstructed their vision. Children of this age simply didn't have the skills to cope with such a situation, and so they broke out crying in panic.
At this time, the crazed woman was also apprehended. Her complexion was extremely pale, and as she was pinned to the ground screaming, she was quickly subdued by the crowd.
The female teachers, holding some medicine and alcohol, came to Han Xuewei and handed them directly to her, probably misunderstanding the relationship between Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua, thinking the two were husband and wife.
Han Xuewei at that moment didn't have the luxury to think about this misunderstanding, as it was Mo Jihua who had suggested they rescue others and had been injured in helping her. She felt it was her duty to help treat him, and she skillfully dripped alcohol on Mo Jihua's hand.
Mo Jihua's hand trembled slightly, and looking at his resolute face, Han Xuewei couldn't help but say, "Teacher Mo, just bear with it a bit, it will be over soon. First we'll disinfect it with alcohol and apply some medication, then you should go to the hospital to have it checked."
As Han Xuewei spoke, Mo Jihua had already stopped feeling the pain. A gentle breeze lightly stirred Han Xuewei's hair, and he suddenly remembered the times when they played together as children.
Han Xuewei was the kind of girl who always participated in dangerous activities and would come crying to him after a fall, enduring the pain while he would apply medication, but her tears would well up nonetheless.
Thinking about those memories was nostalgic, but turning to look at Han Xuewei now, she was already the wife of another man.
At this moment, hearing Han Xuewei address him so politely and respectfully as Teacher Mo was like having the dream shattered all over again, perhaps he had grown increasingly distant from Han Xuewei and shouldn't harbor such inappropriate thoughts anymore.
Being a brotherly figure wasn't such a bad thing after all. As long as Han Xuewei was doing well, that was actually quite nice.
Mo Jihua didn't say anything but simply smiled faintly, "It's okay, I don't feel the pain."
Soon, the police also arrived at the scene to disperse the crowd. The two children that Han Xuewei had carried out had inhaled too much gas, so an immediate call to 120 was made to take the children for treatment.
The police and firefighters also expressed their concern for Mo Jihua, but he considered it a minor injury and thus declined any help.
Quickly, the fire was extinguished in time, preventing substantial damage.
Because Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua played a very crucial role in this event and had also helped in apprehending the criminal, they had to go to the police station along with some of the kindergarten's management and teachers to give a statement.
Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua didn't regard it as an issue and went together to the police station.

chapters.title: Chapter 240 Heartache and Fear
chapters.content:
After arriving at the police station, the police officers inside were also aware of their deeds, and they held Lin Yi and Han Xuewei in very high regard. If it weren't for their timely response, the situation might not have been resolved so smoothly.
Many people within the police station admired them greatly, especially after hearing some of the teachers' comments, they found Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's selflessness particularly admirable. Thus, the local police immediately posted a commendation notice on the internet.
It was specifically to commend those who had shown courage in the face of justice, including the two security guards at the kindergarten, as well as Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua.
Some of the crowd and teachers who helped extinguish the fire were also mentioned, with Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua standing out the most.
After all, the two of them had made great contributions and even managed to bring two children to safety. The incident was even captured in a rather blurry video, and the news about them spread across the entire internet platform that very day.
Their story made it to the top headlines, and various media outlets were racing to report on them.
Moreover, many people mistook Han Xuewei for Mo Jihua's wife, because they indeed looked like a well-matched pair, assuming they went to the kindergarten intending to enroll their child there.
Han Xuewei was unaware of this when she was at the police station; she hadn't expected the local police to misunderstand their relationship and to present them as a married couple in the reports.
It was also Han Xuewei's fault for not making it clear, but she hadn't anticipated that they would be mistaken for a married couple based on their appearance.
Their relationship was, in fact, that of teacher and student. By the time Han Xuewei returned home, she was very tired. She only saw those news reports late at night.
This time, she and Mo Jihua directly made it onto the trending search list. After this incident was released, the entire society was moved by it.
Setting fire in a kindergarten, where there were so many young children, was utterly devoid of conscience. Discussions about the incident on the internet were abuzz immediately, and the condemnation of the arsonist was boundless.
"My goodness, how could someone do such a thing, is her heart black?"
"Right, I had thought. Every kindergarten teacher would be very caring, but I never expected to encounter such a person; it's terrifying."
"Now, obtaining a kindergarten teaching qualification should have some conditions set, so one can't just pass the exam so easily."
"Ah, those things can't prevent malicious people; some are just born evil."
"I heard a rumor online that the woman actually had an affair with one of the managers, and she wanted to burn down the kindergarten in revenge."
"That's too horrifying. Even if she wanted revenge, that's her private business; how could she involve these children? Thankfully, my child doesn't go to that kindergarten."
"Yes, yes, it's way too dangerous. When choosing a kindergarten in the future, we'll definitely need to ask clearly and make sure there's assurance. People with such a strong vengeful mentality, who are a danger to society, should be given the death penalty outright."
The discussions on the internet were intense. This incident was indeed atrocious, and although it didn't result in any fatalities, it still attracted widespread attention. And a video was even circulating online, showing the moment when Han Xuewei treated a wounded Mo Jihua, holding a first aid kit.
At that time, Han Xuewei wasn't thinking too much; saving people was the priority.
However, the incident was shared online and immediately went viral. Nowadays, it's too easy to find someone's information on the internet, hence, Han Xuewei's personal information was quickly exposed by others.
From various clues, people learned that Han Xuewei was the long-esteemed campus belle of Xiangcheng University, rumored to have gotten married and had children. Therefore, based on the content of the video, people naturally assumed that Mo Jihua was Han Xuewei's husband.
Suddenly, the internet was abuzz, especially since Han Xuewei was very beautiful, which attracted even greater attention.
"Oh my God, such a beautiful girl and yet so kind-hearted, she's practically an Immortal sister."
"Right, calling her an Immortal isn't an exaggeration at all. If it were me, I probably wouldn't have the courage to run into that fire."
"You didn't see how chaotic the scene was, this Miss is really very brave."
"Yes, yes, and her husband is truly admirable, they are the most impressive model couple of the year."
Online, everyone began discussing the two of them. However, as it turned out, this was just a rumor, quickly quashed by the authorities of Xiangcheng University, as such talk wasn't good for either their teachers or their students.
Soon after, Han Xuewei returned home. She didn't know whether her family had seen the news or not, but she didn't say anything to them, not wanting to cause them worry.
Perhaps her family hadn't seen the news, and she could let the matter pass vaguely. But the moment she stepped through the door, she saw Lin Yi. Lin Yi was standing inside the room, his eyes reddening when he saw Han Xuewei.
He walked straight towards Han Xuewei, looked at her seriously, and then wrapped his arms around her tightly, "Vivi, I was really scared just now. Please don't do this again, okay? I was so worried about you."
Lin Yi's voice was choked with emotion, lacking his usual composure. Seeing this, Han Xuewei hugged Lin Yi tightly and patted his head.
"I'm sorry, husband. I thought you were angry with me just now. Please don't be angry, okay? Those news reports are all nonsense, I didn't do anything..."
Hearing this, Lin Yi hugged Han Xuewei tightly, and kissed her forehead, "Silly girl, how could I possibly misunderstand you? I was worried about you getting hurt. Think about how dangerous it was in there with the fire. Normally, I don't let you do anything risky, but this time you were quite brave, rushing straight into someone's fire scene!
Don't do this kind of thing again in the future, let the firefighters or the security handle it. You're a girl; you can't do this anymore. You scared me to death."
As Lin Yi spoke, he was somewhat confused, but very genuinely panicked. Seeing this, Han Xuewei nodded her head.
"I thought it was just a small fire at the time, so I grabbed a fire extinguisher and rushed up with everyone without thinking too much. This time I also saved two kids, husband, do you think I'm amazing?"
Han Xuewei said this to cheer Lin Yi up, revealing a smile.
Lin Yi still furrowed his brows deeply, simply holding Han Xuewei quietly.
"What would I do if something happened to you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 241 Worrying About You
chapters.content:
Lin Yi was very worried at this moment, holding Han Xuewei tightly.
Feeling his concerned words, Han Xuewei also knew that her actions today had made Lin Yi very anxious, so she reached out and gently caressed his head.
"I promise you, I won't do anything this dangerous again, I'm sorry, husband."
As Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Yi nodded, holding her tightly.
Fortunately, today's events had turned out safe. Lin Yi knew that Han Xuewei was naturally kind-hearted, especially concerning matters about children, she would definitely rescue them due to her maternal instincts.
But Lin Yi didn't want to talk about the incident any further, simply looking at Han Xuewei and saying, "My wife must be very tired today…"
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei nodded, and Lin Yi pulled her into the bathroom, preparing the bathwater for her.
"Take a bath and then go to sleep early," Lin Yi said softly, making Han Xuewei feel a warm surge in her heart as she nodded.
Lin Yi stepped out, and by then the bathtub was filled. Han Xuewei started to soak in it.
She picked up the thick foam in her hands and contemplated it, getting somewhat lost in thought.
Recalling everything that happened today, thinking of the billowing smoke that had emerged before her eyes, she still felt a bit nervous.
However, she did not regret it, as she succeeded in bringing the two children out. It was worth it.
At this time, Lin Yi waited for Han Xuewei. He played with his phone for a while and then saw today's big news, which had already hit the top of the trending list and exploded in popularity.
The comments were mostly positive.
There was even a video that had been taken of Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua together that day.
It shot to the top of the trending list, and many people, not knowing the two's identities, thought they were a couple.
Some of the titles were indeed too suggestive…
Seeing this, Lin Yi couldn't help but frown; he admitted that he felt a bit jealous now.
Yet, he was not going to blame Han Xuewei for this. Instead, he was worried about her safety.
When the time seemed right, Lin Yi picked up the pajamas and walked to the bathroom, opening the door to enter. Han Xuewei was still a bit dazed, and when she looked up, she saw Lin Yi.
Seeing Lin Yi's annoyed expression, Han Xuewei knew he was somewhat displeased and said, "What's wrong, husband?"
Hearing this, Lin Yi managed a forced smile, opened the trending list he had seen, and handed his phone to Han Xuewei.
At this point, Han Xuewei looked at the phone and clearly saw the people in the video, suddenly feeling flustered and instantly said, "It's not like that, husband! They're just making things up; I never told them about my relationship with Teacher Mo."
"This isn't what you think it is, they're talking nonsense!" Han Xuewei said, sounding displeased, afraid that Lin Yi would be unhappy because of this matter.
Hearing her words, Lin Yi just nodded, "Of course, I trust my wife. These netizens are just looking for drama with the hype, and I didn't misunderstand! I'm not angry... really, I'm not angry!!"
As Lin Yi said that, his face almost fell to his neck.
At that moment, Han Xuewei burst into laughter seeing Lin Yi's sullen face, "Husband, are you jealous over this? You do look quite handsome when you're jealous, very manly!"
As Han Xuewei spoke, she hooked her finger and playfully lifted Lin Yi's chin.
Lin Yi put down the phone straight away, looking at Han Xuewei, "It seems my wife wants to play with fire. I really have to assert my authority and see who the real husband is!"
Lin Yi said this, reaching out toward Han Xuewei, who immediately shook off his hand, splashing water onto Lin Yi's body.
Lin Yi's clothes were instantly soaked, and he moved closer to Han Xuewei, "The clothes are all wet, so let's wash them together."
As he spoke, Lin Yi revealed a triumphant smile...
...
The next morning, after Lin Yi got up, Han Xuewei was already sitting at the windowsill, grooming herself. Lin Yi walked straight to her and took out the ring he had bought for her from the cabinet.
The million-dollar ring was placed on Han Xuewei's finger, and seeing his earnest attitude, she couldn't help but laugh. Looking up at Lin Yi, she joked, "Husband, you are being quite domineering today."
Lin Yi didn't speak; he simply leaned down and kissed her forehead, which made Han Xuewei laugh at his action.
"Wife, from now on, you must wear the ring I gave you every day, to let everyone know who your husband is, and to prevent those with ulterior motives from getting any ideas," Lin Yi stated, making it clear he wanted to make their relationship public — to tell everyone that Han Xuewei was his!
Seeing him like this, Han Xuewei simply smiled and said, "Alright, husband! I got it."
Han Xuewei looked at the ring in her hand; ultimately, she felt it was a bit too flashy. Such a large diamond ring would be very noticeable at school.
She would inevitably become the topic of conversation among her classmates again, but seeing Lin Yi's jealous look, she had no choice but to comply.
Touching the ring, her thoughts drifted to Mo Jihua, and she realized she would have to minimize her contact with him from now on.
As for Mo Jihua, Han Xuewei naturally thought he was a good person, as he had been willing to enter the burning building with her to extinguish the fire. Even if he had feelings for her, she believed they were a thing of the past.
She trusted that he would find his true love eventually.
After getting ready, Han Xuewei planned to go out with Lin Yi.
Lin Yi grabbed her hand, patted down her clothes, and said, "You have your foreign language class this morning, and you should be free afterward, right? I'll come over to pick you up then."
Lin Yi had almost memorized Han Xuewei's entire class schedule, as he always took the opportunity to see her whenever she was free, never letting go of any chance to spend time with her.
Han Xuewei nodded, then suddenly frowned.
It just so happened that her foreign language class was taught by Mo Jihua.
She couldn't help but ask, "Husband, you're not planning to do something to Teacher Mo, are you?"
Han Xuewei was somewhat shocked, but Lin Yi just smiled at her words.
"You're overthinking, wife. How could I possibly do anything to him? Do I look like a violent person to you?" Lin Yi responded.
At that, Han Xuewei immediately shook her head, "No, that's not what I meant. I know your temperament, husband. I'm just worried that there might be…"
Han Xuewei was actually afraid that Lin Yi might get into a conflict with Mo Jihua and end up hitting him.
After all, Lin Yi seemed to be much stronger than Mo Jihua. At that moment, Lin Yi raised an eyebrow at Han Xuewei, as if he had read her mind, which made Han Xuewei feel quite embarrassed.
"Don't worry, nothing is going to happen," Lin Yi assured her as he led her downstairs.
At this point, the whole family was in the living room.
