The incident of Han Xuewei helping to extinguish the fire at the kindergarten yesterday had become known to everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 242 Old Feelings Persist
chapters.content:
Such a major piece of social news has been spreading like wildfire recently, naturally drawing public attention.
With the advancement of smartphone media nowadays, everyone has a cell phone, which makes the flow of information even faster.
Therefore, although Mother Lin and Han's mother were both of middle to old age, once they scrolled through the videos, they still came across it.
It was only because Han Xuewei returned home a bit late last night and was harassed by Lin Yi all night, that the family members didn't bother them.
However, when they got up this morning, everyone looked at Han Xuewei with serious and worried eyes.
At this point, Han Xuewei felt somewhat uncomfortable, and Lin Yi also understood the situation. He stepped forward and said, "Dad, mom, you must have seen the news from last night. You don't need to worry, when Vivi came back I checked her, she wasn't injured, and Vivi was very brave. She's become quite the celebrity now."
Lin Yi said this, trying to tease and lighten the mood.
But Han's mother's expression was very serious as she walked straight up to Han Xuewei, took her hand, furrowed her brows, and sighed, "Vivi, you must never do such a thing again."
"How could you, as a girl, handle something so dangerous? That fire extinguisher must have weighed quite a few pounds. Besides, if something really had happened to you, what would the children do? What would we do? You reckless girl, you need to think things through before you act!"
Although Han's mother was reprimanding Han Xuewei, tears were swirling in her eyes.
Han Xuewei immediately began to comfort her upon seeing this.
And at this moment, Mother Lin also showed a look of concern, "It's good that you're alright, but if something had happened to you, we..."
Mother Lin sighed and continued, "Vivi, we are very proud of you, but please don't do this kind of thing again..."
The two mothers only said a few words to Han Xuewei and did not blame her too much.
After all, Han Xuewei did indeed do the right thing, and they also knew that Han Xuewei had grown up and was not an ignorant child. She did it from the kindness of her heart, so saying more was futile.
Dad Han and Lin's father looked at Han Xuewei with concern at this time, but they also admired her deeply, for as a woman, she had the courage to dash into the fire to save people, which was indeed a deed worthy of praise.
But the two men didn't know how to express their feelings and just looked at Han Xuewei with a mix of seriousness and concern.
Standing in the living room, Han Xuewei said somewhat helplessly, "Dad, mom, I know I was wrong, and I won't be so rash next time. Look, I'm fine now, aren't I? Don't be sad, it wasn't just me who went to put out the fire, there was also Mo Jihua from our hometown. He used to be our neighbor, and he helped with the fire. I was just assisting, it was he who got hurt, not me..."
As Han Xuewei spoke, everyone nodded, but Han's mother looked surprised and asked, "Mo Jihua? The eldest son of the neighbor from our old home?"
"Yes, that's him. He's working as a foreign language teacher at our school now, I heard he studied abroad and came back to the country."
As Han Xuewei said this, Han's mother's face showed a strange expression, and she frowned, "Why did he become a foreign language teacher at your school?"
Han's mother's expression was serious. After all, she had watched the two of them grow up since they were little, and had noticed Mo Jihua's feelings for Han Xuewei were quite special from a young age.
```
But back then everyone was just a child, so she didn't say much, and she understood her own daughter well; Han Xuewei wouldn't think in that direction, but there was no guarantee others wouldn't!
At that time, she felt when she saw Mo Jihua that he had some different emotions towards Han Xuewei.
Now, thinking about him coming to Han Xuewei's school to teach a foreign language, all this undoubtedly led to much speculation.
If Han Xuewei wasn't married now, without having formed a family with Lin Yi, she might agree, after all, from childhood Mo Jihua had also been an exceptional person.
But now Han Xuewei was married, and she was very clear about what relationships could develop and what could not.
However, Mo Jihua's arrival at Han Xuewei's school as a foreign language teacher couldn't help but make her wonder if he still had lingering feelings for Han Xuewei, if he hadn't given up.
At this moment, Han's mother had a strange expression on her face, and Han Xuewei didn't look at her anymore, while Mother Lin also seemed to catch a hint of something in their conversation.
It turned out Han Xuewei also had a childhood sweetheart. At this thought, Mother Lin couldn't help but ponder.
She guessed Lin Yi had been having a peaceful time these days, and now a rival in love had appeared.
However, Mother Lin didn't have any criticisms about Han Xuewei; for such an outstanding and beautiful woman like Han Xuewei, it was only natural that she would be pursued and liked by others.
She had confidence in her own son, and at this time Han's mother simply smiled faintly, "It's nothing else, just that when we have time, we could meet up with him!"
As she spoke, in fact, she was already thinking about getting rid of the trouble for Han Xuewei; after all, she couldn't let outsiders pester her own daughter, given that the daughter was already married.
But she didn't say anything; such matters still depended on the opinions of the younger generation, and with Lin Yi present, it was not a good time to say anything further.
Mother Lin naturally also noticed the subtleties, but she only smiled, looking at Han's mother; both of them understood each other's thoughts.
But such matters were not a big deal to them, because Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's relationship was very stable. After Han Xuewei explained it, and not having been affected much, everyone stopped probing further.
After all, Han Xuewei was now an adult, and too much interference was inappropriate. Lin Yi then took Han Xuewei to the car. Lin Yi drove at the front and Han Xuewei sat in the back seat when a message popped up on her phone.
It was from her own mother.
Han Xuewei opened it to see a long message.
"Vivi, just now in the living room, I couldn't tell you, but I think I still need to remind you."
"Remember when you were young and played well with Mo Jihua? Our families were neighbors at the time, and I didn't think too much about it. But later, I noticed that boy's attitude towards you was quite different, and I thought it was just naive love from youth."
"At the time, I thought this kind of affection was nice, and since you were so much younger than him, and he didn't do anything excessive, I didn't say much. But now you say Mo Jihua has even gone to your school! I can't help but overthink it, with so many excellent schools out there.
Then as a teacher who has studied abroad, he had so many options, the likelihood of him choosing your school is probably because he still has feelings for you."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 243 Jealous
chapters.content:
"I see you two are now at the same school, and he's your teacher. I think he's set on spending day and night with you.
You're not a child anymore; you're a mother of three. From now on, you should keep your distance from these people. I've heard you're quite the center of attention at school. If people start to speculate, it could impact you negatively. If he says anything, you must reject him clearly, but don't let him harbor those thoughts anymore."
"Mom isn't trying to meddle in your life. I know our Vivi is a good girl and wouldn't do anything inappropriate, but I have to guard you against other people's intentions!"
"If rumors start, it would be very detrimental to your current studies!" Upon completing this string of messages, Han Xuewei couldn't help but feel moved.
Her own mother had been worrying herself to pieces for her. Although her thoughts were naive, she wasn't the kind of person who couldn't think for herself.
However, she had indeed regarded Mo Jihua as just a neighbor, a nice older brother, without any ulterior thoughts.
After all, there was some age gap between the two of them, and it seemed she hadn't done anything that might lead Mo Jihua to misunderstand.
But now, after her mother's warning, she began to recall all the little things over the years and realized her mother might not be wrong; she really should distance herself from Mo Jihua.
It would cut off his lingering thoughts and prevent rumors from spreading in the school.
Thinking this, Han Xuewei replied to her mother not to worry.
At that moment, seeing Han Xuewei's response on her phone, Han's mother breathed a sigh of relief.
She knew Han Xuewei had always been a sensible girl, and she was entirely satisfied with Lin Yi, absolutely unable to tolerate anyone disrupting Han Xuewei's marriage.
Marriage might seem solid, but it's also fragile. Small misunderstandings not clarified early on might lead to major mistakes.
Therefore, Han's mother was very concerned about Han Xuewei's marital issues.
At this time, Lin Yi's car arrived at the school. After getting out, he took Han Xuewei's hand and walked forward, intent on escorting Han Xuewei to her classroom, even forgoing his own morning reading class.
Seeing this, Han Xuewei couldn't help but smile awkwardly, "Honey, you're not going to morning reading and are just going to take me to my classroom?"
"Of course, after such news about you came out yesterday, I have to show my face and cut off some people's thoughts!" Lin Yi said, making Han Xuewei laugh.
This time Lin Yi's jealousy had completely overturned; she couldn't soothe him and just had to go with it.
After all, the incident yesterday was too sensational; the video was very clear, making Han Xuewei a celebrity throughout the whole school, and her situation with Mo Jihua was buzzing all over the internet.
Although someone had clarified the rumors, some people still didn't know the truth and kept speculating, causing Han Xuewei quite a bit of trouble.
Fortunately, since it was a good deed, many people admired Han Xuewei even more.
At this moment, Lin Yi, holding Han Xuewei's hand, walked toward the school corridor, and many people around them turned their gazes toward them.
After all, a handsome man and a beautiful woman are always pleasant to look at.
Feeling so many eyes on her, Han Xuewei was very shy and couldn't help but lower her head, and Lin Yi took the opportunity to pull her head into his chest.
This caused quite an outcry among the onlookers, who were all very shocked.
"Oh my gosh, our campus belle's husband is back at our faculty!"
"Really? Look how dominant the school beauty's husband is. News spread last night, and today he's here to refute the rumors!"
"Of course, if someone mistook your wife for somebody else's, wouldn't you be furious?"
"Ah, speaking of which, the school beauty's husband is really handsome. They look like a true married couple just by standing together."
"I haven't even had breakfast yet, and I'm already full from the dog food they're feeding us!"
Everyone showed expressions of envy and started talking among themselves.
Han Xuewei was a bit nervous at the moment, but Lin Yi patted her shoulder and took her hand, walking forward without caring at all about the surrounding eyes.
He wanted his wife to show off however she liked.
Lin Yi led Han Xuewei to the doorstep of her classroom. As they stood at the classroom door, more students looked outside from time to time, casting glances at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi handed the backpack to Han Xuewei, "Wife, I'll come to pick you up after class."
"Okay, husband, you go ahead and attend your class."
Han Xuewei said, feeling uncomfortable under the burning gaze of the crowd.
As the bell rang, Han Xuewei entered the classroom. At that moment, both the students inside and those outside showed surprised expressions. They loved to be involved in such gossip, and discussions started to bubble up energetically.
"We finally see the school beauty's husband's face, and we have to admit he's really handsome. No wonder she's with him. It seems perfectly reasonable."
"Exactly, and the school beauty's husband is also very wealthy. Just look at the car he drives and the clothes he wears—it's completely the posture of the nobility."
"Is that so? I thought our school beauty was above earthly desires, and I didn't think she liked rich people."
"Oh, what do you mean by that? Our school beauty is so pretty and comes from such a good family, she's bound to marry someone with good conditions. Seems like you're just sour because you can't eat the grapes!"
The female students expressed their dissatisfaction with the male student's comment.
"Exactly, if I had a face as pretty as the school beauty, no one could marry me without a dowry of several million."
"That's true, and look at how well the school beauty's husband treats her. It just shows that he's both outstanding and knows how to pamper his wife."
Lin Yi didn't leave but just stood silently to the side. His handsome face attracted quite a few glances. Hearing those words, he felt secretly pleased.
This time his visit had been just right, as it perfectly demonstrated who was the real ace.
Lin Yi was very pleased with himself, but at that moment, an untimely voice made his expression turn sour.
"That's true, but just yesterday I saw on the news that the school beauty and our Teacher Mo went together to fight a fire. They both looked quite compatible on camera, like two elite individuals meeting, giving off a superior vibe. That could work too."
"Right, right! Actually, they didn't look bad together at all. Ah, our school beauty is more than enough for any outstanding man!"
Lin Yi was displeased to hear these comments, which is why he didn't leave but just waited in a corner by the classroom door.
Han Xuewei knew Lin Yi hadn't left. After class, she immediately ran out to find him.
"Husband!" Han Xuewei showed an uncommon warmth, hugging Lin Yi tightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 244 Asura Field?
chapters.content:
At that moment, Lin Yi caressed Han Xuewei's head, straightening her hair, just as Mo Jihua stepped out of the classroom door. He had barely reached the hallway when he witnessed this scene, his gaze colliding with Lin Yi's in an instant.
Lin Yi, upon seeing Mo Jihua, simply curved his lips and said, "Thank you, Teacher Mo, for taking such good care of my wife recently. How about we all grab lunch together later?"
Lin Yi spoke calmly while Han Xuewei immediately frowned, feeling that Lin Yi might be stirring up trouble. She really didn't want to cause any waves at school, given how much the people there loved to gossip.
She didn't want her personal life to become fodder for others' dinner conversations, so she tugged at Lin Yi's sleeve.
At this, Lin Yi gently touched her hand and took hold of it, turning his gaze towards Mo Jihua.
His little expression seemed to say: Even if you do like her, it's useless, she is my wife, and only I can hug her, kiss her, and hold her hand.
Meanwhile, the other students who had left the classroom silently watched the scene, and those farther away began to discuss it openly.
"Oh my god, what kind of soap opera scene is this?"
"Who do you guys think deserves our school belle? Teacher Mo or her husband?"
"Obviously, it's the main guy. Didn't you see how dominant he acted? He's declaring his sovereignty as her husband, basically telling Teacher Mo to back off."
"I think the school belle's husband seems really caring, running all the way here just for her. He's clearly the best husband in the world."
"Did you hear? Didn't he just invite Teacher Mo to have lunch with them? Do you think he'll accept? If he really does, it's going to be a real battleground!"
The group excitedly chattered away, while at this time Mo Jihua just smiled warmly and nodded, saying, "Sure, let's meet at lunchtime then."
Lin Yi, hearing this, was very pleased and nodded, "I'll be in the cafeteria at lunchtime. Don't stand me up."
Having said that, Lin Yi took Han Xuewei's hand and walked forward.
The surrounding crowd felt a thrill. They had thought that Lin Yi would invite Mo Jihua out for a meal, but to their surprise, it was going to happen in the school cafeteria, where they could also observe.
But at this moment, Mo Jihua seemed unconcerned with the surrounding gossip. He watched the departing figures of Han Xuewei and Lin Yi.
How well-matched the two were, and at this time, he even revealed a smile of letting go.
He thought it was time for him to move on, so his expression was calm and indifferent, lacking the love triangle drama the students were anticipating.
Since there were no more classes and it was still a while before lunch, Lin Yi directly took Han Xuewei back to their RV.
After all, there was nothing else to do now, and the RV's environment and amenities were quite comfortable.
Yet at this moment, a post popped up on the school forum, instantly attracting countless people's attention; it was written by Mo Jihua.
First of all, I am very grateful for everyone's keen attention to the fire incident yesterday, the arson incident, which also proves that everyone is very enthusiastic and caring, but I must apologize to everyone for the untrue rumors online and some of the comments that have affected Han Xuewei's student life...
Because the incident happened so suddenly that day, there was no time to refute those rumors, and this incident is closely related to me personally, so I must come out and explain it; I hope everyone will not believe in some of the rumors and also avoid clicking on those posts online to prevent affecting Han Xuewei's normal life.
This official statement was very clear and straightforward, and it indeed attracted the attention of many female students. Many girls had already admired Mo Ji Hua for his good looks, and now seeing Mo Ji Hua issue such an open and generous explanatory post, there was an immediate surge of calls of support.
"Teacher Mo really has such a sense of responsibility. He's handsome and responsible."
"Right, I never knew Teacher Mo's character was so good."
"From now on, we should stop clicking on those untrue posts, right? We can't affect Teacher Mo after all; his foreign language classes are genuinely excellent."
"Husband, husband..."
There were also many more outspoken female students leaving bold comments below,
Meanwhile, Lin Yi had also seen this viral post in school, and naturally, Han Xuewei knew about it too. She looked at Lin Yi and couldn't help but laugh, "Husband, now you see, people really weren't overthinking it. Look, they've even posted an explanation, so there's no need for you to be jealous of him anymore."
As she spoke, Han Xuewei reached out and poked Lin Yi's face.
Lin Yi then brushed off the post and turned to Han Xuewei, saying, "Yeah, I'm not jealous anymore, but you're still treating me to lunch."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei burst into laughter. Wasn't this still reeking of jealousy?
During lunchtime, the cafeteria was crowded with people. The incident involving Lin Yi had already spread throughout the entire grade; many knew about Lin Yi inviting Teacher Mo to have lunch with them.
So in the cafeteria, many people deliberately sat close to them to observe, and at this time, the two men sat there, creating a somewhat awkward atmosphere while Han Xuewei, sitting beside them, felt utterly helpless and could only keep eating the food in front of her.
Feeling the intense gaze of everyone around her, Han Xuewei felt like she was in the midst of a massive social death scene.
Why on earth had Lin Yi decided to come eat in the cafeteria? It was like being the center of attention in a live show.
After all, their school had a great environment, and there were quite a few restaurants along the whole street outside the school. Going somewhere else was possible, too; it always felt very uncomfortable being watched by so many people.
At this moment, however, Lin Yi was calmly and casually chatting with Mo Ji Hua, who seemed unconcerned.
Lin Yi then smiled at Mo Ji Hua, "Because I have a class right after this, I can't waste too much time, so I had no choice but to make do with what's here, and grab a meal nearby. Teacher Mo, you don't mind, do you?"
"Of course, I don't mind. I think our cafeteria's food is quite good compared to other schools, but when it comes to treating, as a teacher, I should be the one doing it, after all. This incident has caused quite a bit of trouble for Vivi, leading the whole school and outsiders to misunderstand, which is truly inappropriate," Mo Ji Hua said indifferently.
At this moment, Lin Yi felt that he was there to assert his pride, so he definitely could not lose face.
He waved his hand decisively, "That won't do. After all, I said I would treat, so how can it not count? Besides, you saved my wife in a risky situation last time. It's only right and proper that I show my gratitude to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 245 Shocking News
chapters.content:
Hearing their back-and-forth discussion, Han Xuewei just felt like she wanted to find a hole to crawl into.
The two of them were still insisting on who should pay for the meal, while Han Xuewei only wanted to say, let him pay, but she didn't dare to speak out. She just felt the situation was extremely awkward, and people around were still watching.
Mo Jihua noticed Han Xuewei's mood at that time, smiled slightly, and said, "Since you want to treat, then I really appreciate it."
"Actually, you don't need to be hostile towards me. I've thought about it during these days, and as for the previous incidents, they were all misunderstandings. I have only ever seen Vivi as a sister, after all, that's how we've been together since childhood.
In the fire, Vivi was very brave; I certainly couldn't hold her back, and as for those reports outside, I've already written a post to explain. I expect this will all settle down soon. I hope Vivi's life won't be affected by these trivial matters."
Lin Yi, hearing this, was very satisfied. "I really appreciate that, Teacher Mo. I will take good care of my wife's affairs from now on."
Han Xuewei just felt very embarrassed as Lin Yi pulled her into his embrace, and they stood there rigidly.
However, they soon regained their composure, and the three of them quietly began eating. Han Xuewei and Mo Jihua occasionally exchanged words, but Han Xuewei felt extremely awkward.
Under the gaze of many eyes, the three of them happily finished dinner.
Mo Jihua had a class to attend afterwards, so he didn't linger with them. Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei.
This time Han Xuewei ate quite a lot, twice as much as she usually did, and at that time she felt incredibly full. But given the situation, if she didn't eat, she wouldn't know what else to do.
Lin Yi then took out a tissue to wipe Han Xuewei's mouth and they left the cafeteria. He was very satisfied with her attitude towards Mo Jihua this time.
Now, he took Han Xuewei to the same corridor they had been to before, a place that was essentially deserted and quiet.
Lin Yi encircled Han Xuewei's waist in his arms, making her sit on his lap. Han Xuewei, seeing this position, blushed, but since nothing had happened the last time they were there, she relaxed.
Lin Yi lifted Han Xuewei's chin, looked at her for a while, and then kissed her directly. They cuddled up and kissed for what felt like tens of minutes.
It was only then that Han Xuewei pushed Lin Yi away, took a deep breath, and said shyly, "Okay, stop kissing, I'm almost out of breath, and I still have class later."
Han Xuewei patted Lin Yi's shoulder, feeling that Lin Yi had been too eager just now.
Lin Yi did not move to kiss her again but just touched Han Xuewei's hand, saying, "Alright, wife, but I don't have class this afternoon either. I'm planning to go to the pharmaceutical factory to oversee the operation and come back to pick you up tonight."
As Lin Yi spoke, he caressed Han Xuewei's shoulder with reluctance. At that moment, Han Xuewei stood up and said directly, "Alright, you should come over early and not work too hard."
Lin Yi nodded and left.
Han Xuewei didn't linger either and returned to the classroom. As soon as she got back, she found many people looking at her with strange expressions.
But she didn't think much of it and went back to her desk. That's when she saw a flood of messages on her phone. Since she was very popular at the school, almost everyone had her contact information.
So now, within the group chat, Han Xuewei saw a mass of messages. She hadn't checked her phone when she was with Lin Yi, but now she was bombarded by them.
A junior girl sent a message to Han Xuewei, "Vivi sis, today you are, the talk of our school."
Han Xuewei, surprised by this message, clicked into the school's forum. The explosive post's title was absolutely shocking.
The school beauty and her husband were affectionate, kissing each other for half an hour.
Below is a clear photo of the two of them kissing.
At this moment, Han Xuewei, looking at the photo, had her whole face as red as a fully cooked shrimp.
She was flustered, put down her phone, and covered her face, which was burning hot; the comments below made her feel extremely embarrassed.
"Look at the video, the school beauty's husband is really good at kissing."
"Who's the genius that took this? It's so clear, and the angle is perfect!"
"The school beauty and her husband look like they're acting in a romantic drama when they kiss."
"Oh my, this is definitely the hottest news today."
At this moment, Han Xuewei, reading these comments, felt unbearably shy, covering her face and afraid to move.
Just as Lin Yi was about to arrive outside the pharmaceutical factory, the system's voice suddenly rang out, leaving him somewhat astonished and frozen in place.
"Ding! Congratulations to the host for completing the temporary mission, 'Spoil your wife and skyrocket her good feelings.' Rewarding the host with a magical pill."
"Friendly reminder, the magical pill can only be used by the host and cannot be ingested by others."
At this moment, Lin Yi, hearing the system's message, was somewhat confused. He hadn't expected that the system would almost always give him medicine recently.
He didn't know what the effects of this pill were, and that it could only be used by him and not by others.
Could it be that the system is doing this intentionally?
Lin Yi pondered but didn't think too much of it and continued walking forward. His visit this time was to check on the newly recruited technical personnel.
Because last night, Zhou Kongshan had called Lin Yi and mentioned that he had found quite a few people and wanted to hear Lin Yi's thoughts.
By this time, Lin Yi had reached the pharmaceutical factory. After entering, Zhou Kongshan immediately greeted Lin Yi and looked over the research personnel.
Actually, he wasn't very clear about these people's written exams, but now that he could trigger the system's abilities, he could tell authenticity at a glance.
After a quick look, he found no issues with these people; both their character and individual abilities were excellent, which reassured Lin Yi, and he gave his approval.
The technical personnel were then led inside to find their respective positions, and at this point, Lin Yi took out a bottle of Body Tempering Divine Water from his pocket and handed it to Zhou Kongshan.
"This is a potion that can improve a person's immunity and resistance. Take a look and discuss with everyone if we can study it, extract the substances it contains, and see if we can analyze them or manufacture them into marketable medicines."
As Lin Yi spoke, Zhou Kongshan immediately took the potion, examined it in his hands, nodded, and responded, "Mr. Lin, I will definitely lead everyone to research it as soon as possible."
Although Zhou Kongshan didn't know what Lin Yi was planning, having researched for so many years, he was naturally resolute about medicines.

chapters.title: Chapter 246 Test Pill
chapters.content:
Lin Yi was certain that Zhou Kongshan couldn't possibly research and develop the Potion given by the system.
After all, ordinary people simply couldn't come up with the items gifted by the system, but Lin Yi wanted to see if they could unearth the potential functions of this Potion.
Developing other pharmaceuticals would be worthwhile in time.
At this moment, they stood in the corridor when a luxurious vehicle approached the entrance.
Zhou Kongshan glanced over and said, "Mr. Lin, the landlord you asked me to invite has arrived."
The two looked down and saw a man stepping out of the car.
The man, well acquainted with his own factory, promptly made his way to the top-floor office.
Zhou Kongshan immediately entertained the guest, reaching out his hand, "Mr. Zhang, it's been too long since we last met!"
Zhou Kongshan was very enthusiastic, the two of them familiar with each other, while Lin Yi sat by calmly watching them, as Zhou Kongshan quickly ushered Mr. Zhang over to Lin Yi.
"Mr. Zhang, this gentleman is our new boss, Mr. Lin."
Mr. Zhang was somewhat surprised when he saw Lin Yi, not expecting someone so young to take over the factory.
Lin Yi, on the other hand, was very polite, immediately standing up and warmly extending his hand. After exchanging greetings, they both sat down together.
Mr. Zhang had a good impression of Lin Yi, admiring him naturally, for he seemed so young, and Zhang had heard from Zhou Kongshan that Lin Yi was still a university student.
"It's always good to see a young person, such poise, I admire that."
Mr. Zhang had long heard of Lin Yi's deeds and knew Lin Yi had invested a considerable sum this time, which left him quite moved.
"Young man, I've heard you want to take over this plot of land of mine," Mr. Zhang said, and Lin Yi nodded.
"Yes, Mr. Zhang, the price is not an issue," Lin Yi said while Mr. Zhang smiled.
"As long as the price is right, I can sell the land as I don't need it now, but I don't know how much Mr. Lin is willing to accept…"
Lin Yi pondered for a moment.
For him, acquiring a piece of land wasn't a matter of simple talk—the price would definitely be steep. So at that moment, he simply smiled lightly.
"Mr. Zhang, I've heard that you purchased this land over a decade ago when the price was worlds apart from today's, which must have increased tenfold over the years."
"Indeed, but the price back then and what it's worth now is different, an increase is reasonable," Mr. Zhang replied.
"I'm aware of that, so I want to propose a solution to Mr. Zhang to see if he can accept my offer," Lin Yi said seriously.
"Let's hear it," Mr. Zhang gestured.
"I hope Mr. Zhang will sell me the land at its current market value, and in addition, I will pay you an extra eighty million. What do you think?" Upon hearing this, Mr. Zhang lowered his head, contemplating the value of the land.
When he had initially bought the land, it was for tens of millions, but now its value had soared to over two billion, with the annual rent amounting to millions.
However, Lin Yi's proposal seemed appealing; offering an additional eighty million was equivalent to a decade's worth of rent.
Considering that real estate business wasn't easy and sale opportunities could be scarce, Mr. Zhang was quite satisfied with Lin Yi's terms, so he didn't hesitate and nodded right away.
"Sure, I admire someone with your courage, young man…"
Both of them laughed together and soon signed the contract.
Since this place wasn't located in the center of the market, but only boasted a sizeable plot of land, Mr. Zhang didn't haggle with Lin Yi in the end.
Following Lin Yi's subsidy scheme, he charged Lin Yi two hundred million.
After the two men had signed the contract, Mr. Zhang, having nothing else to do, left.
The subsequent procedures could be handled by the lawyer. Lin Yi didn't say much. For him, this kind of business conversation was the most convenient, and he liked such forthright people as well.
Lin Yi's remaining task was to check on the progress of their factory, the treatment of the workers, and the overall situation, as well as whether some equipment needed to be added.
After Lin Yi finished dealing with these matters, it was already quite late, and Han Xuewei was about to get out of school. After saying goodbye to Zhou Kongshan, Lin Yi quickly got in the car and drove to the school.
When he arrived at the school, he was delayed a little, and Han Xuewei had been waiting for nearly an hour. As Lin Yi walked over, he couldn't help showing a remorseful expression.
"Wife, I'm late today…" Lin Yi said as he reached for Han Xuewei's backpack.
But Han Xuewei just smiled faintly, "Husband, I only waited an hour, it's really nothing. Just be careful when you drive next time, okay?"
Han Xuewei didn't mind Lin Yi being late; she was just worried that Lin Yi might have rushed and had an accident on the road.
Lin Yi nodded, gave a light smile, and then pulled Han Xuewei into the car with him.
When the two returned home, Han Xuewei put down her backpack and went upstairs to be with the children, and Lin Yi followed to play with the kids for a while.
"Wife, I'm going back to our room first. Call me when it's time to eat."
As Lin Yi spoke, Han Xuewei just thought that Lin Yi was probably too tired today, so she didn't ask further and let him go and rest.
At that moment, her phone suddenly lit up with a message from Qin Xiaoxu.
To her surprise, Qin Xiaoxu and Lin Jie's relationship had progressed so quickly that they were already living together.
Han Xuewei was somewhat astonished but also quite happy for them. As there was nothing urgent, she chatted with Qin Xiaoxu for a while.
Now Qin Xiaoxu was leading a happy life, so Han Xuewei didn't want to disturb her too much and let her spend more time with Lin Jie.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi had returned to his room, not to rest, but with a purpose.
Lin Yi now took out the magical pill he had received from the system space.
Lin Yi looked at the pill, quite curious about the effects the system had given him with this pill.
But the system had told him it was for his use alone, so it surely wouldn't harm him.
So, without hesitation, Lin Yi swallowed the pill, not even bothering to drink any water.
At the moment, he felt nothing, so he lay on the bed for a while. After about fifteen minutes, Lin Yi started to feel an intense heat all over his body and sat up, gasping for air, unable to bear the heat!
His body was drenched in sweat, leaving an imprint of his body on the bed.
Getting up, Lin Yi felt light-headed and extremely weak, with sweat dripping from his fingertips to the ground.
He had never imagined that sweating profusely would be like this.

chapters.title: Chapter 247 Sick?
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei approached the door to the room at this point, and seeing nobody replied when she knocked, she went straight in.
At that moment when she saw Lin Yi, her face turned pale with fright, and she immediately ran over.
Lin Yi was covered in redness all over his body, drenched in sweat, with his clothes completely soaked.
Han Xuewei panicked and quickly hugged Lin Yi. As soon as she touched him, she felt that his entire body was sweaty.
"What's wrong with you, hubby?! Are you having a fever or what?!"
"Hubby, I'm going to call an ambulance now!"
In her anxious state, Han Xuewei spoke, looking at Lin Yi in a fluster. Lin Yi shook his head, took a deep breath, gestured with his hand, and stopped Han Xuewei's hand that was holding her phone.
"Wife, don't call 120, I'm okay, don't call!!" said Lin Yi, while Han Xuewei looked puzzled and disoriented.
But Lin Yi shook his head stubbornly, his expression grave, "I'll explain everything to you soon, just don't call!"
As he spoke, Lin Yi pulled Han Xuewei's hand away, placed her phone on a table nearby, and collapsed into Han Xuewei's arms.
"I haven't fainted, just a bit sleepy."
Han Xuewei was still very tense, secretly took the phone, ready to call 120 at any moment.
She couldn't relax, seeing Lin Yi in this state for the first time.
"Are you really okay, hubby?!"
"I'm fine, could you get me some water..."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei nodded and quickly brought a glass of water for Lin Yi, placing it in front of him.
Lin Yi drank the entire glass as if he was extremely thirsty, shook his head, and said, "Not enough..."
Han Xuewei, very anxious, took the whole water jug, kept pouring water, and Lin Yi kept drinking.
In just a moment, Lin Yi had drunk all the water in the jug, his body sweating more and more, wetting the whole blanket.
Lin Yi felt dizzy and slept for nearly ten minutes. After a while, Lin Yi woke up.
By that time, he felt much better, looking significantly more refreshed.
"Wife, I'm fine now, just was testing a drug developed by the pharmaceutical factory. The medicine is greatly beneficial to the body, I just didn't expect it to be so potent, but now I'm alright..."
Han Xuewei, seeing Lin Yi's face regaining its usual bright expression, felt relieved. However, recalling the way Lin Yi looked earlier, she was still a bit shaken, patted Lin Yi's chest, and said, "Hubby, you really scared me just now, I thought you were ill!"
Lin Yi laughed, "No worries at all, I feel like I'm full of energy now, ready to accomplish a lot!"
As he spoke, Han Xuewei continued to look at him with concern, while Lin Yi noticed that both their bodies were thoroughly soaked and the beddings were filthy from the sweat.
Lin Yi casually suggested, "Let's both take a shower."
Lin Yi spoke and stood up, his arm blocking Han Xuewei's waist as he carried her straight into the bathroom.
The two of them took a bath in the bathroom, and while bathing, Lin Yi couldn't restrain himself and tormented Han Xuewei before they went downstairs.
By then, it was already quite late, and the expressions on their family members' faces were very telling when they saw the two of them. Han Xuewei felt extremely embarrassed.
However, after hastily finishing dinner, they went upstairs to check on the babies, who were already sleepy at that time and fell asleep after being coaxed for a while.
After returning to the room, Han Xuewei drew near Lin Yi and pulled open his clothes to look inside.
Seeing her do that, Lin Yi frowned and couldn't help asking, "Wife, do you want to…"
Hearing these words, Han Xuewei's face turned red. They had just been intimate, and she tugged at Lin Yi's clothes irritably, "I just want to see what medicine you took; I feel like you've changed entirely after taking it."
Lin Yi, seeing her wish to look, quickly peeled off his coat, standing bare before Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei looked at his robust upper body, and her little face turned red again.
At this moment, Lin Yi was also very satisfied with his own body, with all his muscles feeling incredibly strong. Han Xuewei reached out to touch him and said, "Husband, I feel like your body has become so much stronger. Even though there aren't too many changes, your muscles seem full of strength."
Lin Yi nodded at this, indeed feeling it was quite effective. The magical pill awarded to him by the system was not meant for others, only for his personal use—truly a good thing.
At this time, Han Xuewei expressed her concern, "Husband, what exactly is that medicine your pharmaceutical factory developed?"
"It's for enhancing physical fitness, probably a first-generation prototype, so the reaction was a bit too strong."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei nodded as well, having been quite startled by Lin Yi's appearance just a moment ago.
"Even though a medicine like this has beneficial effects, if people actually used it, they might also be scared," Han Xuewei added, then looked at Lin Yi with some worry.
"This is the first batch of medicine developed. If there are any side effects, it would be terrible. How about you go with me to the hospital tomorrow to see if there's anything wrong with you or if there are any side effects or anything…"
Lin Yi didn't want Han Xuewei to worry, so he said, "I can go by myself tomorrow."
In fact, it was a gift from the system; how could the hospital possibly detect it? Thus, Lin Yi was just telling a harmless lie.
"Husband, don't try such things again next time. If something really happened to you, we wouldn't be able to guarantee anything. Wait until the product is officially released before attempting it, you hear me?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi nodded, "Okay, wife, don't worry, I will take responsibility for my own body from now on."
But if it was from the system, Lin Yi would definitely try whatever the system sent him!
After all, his finances had now reached saturation, and the system rarely rewarded him with money anymore. Therefore, now Lin Yi needed to focus more on advancing his career.
Since the system wasn't awarding him money any longer, and he only had fixed assets, he must make use of these assets to earn money for himself, which was the real way to survive.
Lin Yi hugged Han Xuewei close, and she fell asleep quickly, but Lin Yi stayed awake the entire night pondering this issue.
The next morning, Lin Yi received a call from Zhou Kongshan. He was a bit surprised but heard the other party's excited voice as soon as he answered the call.

chapters.title: Chapter 248 Almost Found Out
chapters.content:
"I'm sorry to bother you so early in the morning, Mr. Lin, but today's event is just too exciting not to share immediately!"
"It's about the potion you gave me yesterday. You said to take it back to my team for development, to see what substances we could extract from it. We started research last night and worked on this potion all night. The conclusions we came to are truly astonishing.
Mr. Lin, the potion you gave me is simply miraculous. Although we can't extract the substances within it, when I combined it with other medications, it led to a groundbreaking discovery.
This potion can enhance the performance of ordinary drugs. As long as it's mixed with the potion, their function and effectiveness instantly increase by dozens of times. It's truly magical. Just last night, Little Li from our team caught a severe cold. I gave him an ordinary cold medicine and then mixed in a drop of this potion, and right after he drank it, he was cured. It's simply amazing!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was also taken aback. This was an outcome he had never anticipated.
Originally, he had only wanted to extract the concentrated substances in the potion to see if he could develop different medicines, but he never imagined it would be so miraculous.
"Really?"
Zhou Kongshan was naturally very excited and nodded, "It's true. Mr. Lin, this potion should be brought to the international stage and have some patents applied for it. The potion contains substances that current medical science cannot decipher, yet it is incredible."
Hearing this, Lin Yi nodded thoughtfully, then said, "Then you think it over. First, work on the health-care medications I asked you to develop before. Ideally, they should be affordable, accessible to everyone, and highly effective…"
Upon hearing this, Zhou Kongshan on the other end of the line appeared surprised. He hadn't expected Lin Yi would choose not to prioritize this potion and said, "You're not planning to research this first, Mr. Lin?"
Lin Yi pondered for a moment before saying, "First make sure that the health-care product we planned to focus on is well-developed, ensuring its effectiveness and functionality. As for that potion, we haven't handled it properly yet and need to proceed with caution. I'm worried about potential side effects, so let's start by getting our market operations up and running.
I'll consider what to do with the potion later."
Zhou Kongshan nodded in understanding, impressed by Lin Yi's cautious approach.
Most people, upon discovering something the whole world has yet to find, especially with such a great commercial potential, would rush to market it widely.
But not Lin Yi. He was well aware that things like this come with side effects, so it's better to remain cautious under these unknown circumstances.
At this moment, Zhou Kongshan was also thrilled. After hanging up the call, he planned to devote himself wholeheartedly to his career, hoping that his industry, which he had persisted with for more than a decade, could reach new heights with Lin Yi's involvement.
After Lin Yi ended the call, he went to school with Han Xuewei. All along the way, he pondered over Zhou Kongshan's words. According to Zhou, the ingredients in his potions were special—when combined with other drugs, they would enhance the performance of ordinary medicine by several tens of times.
If that were the case, the development of his future pharmaceuticals would certainly surge, and they would be exclusive in the whole world. As long as he assembled the best team and developed the best products, he wouldn't have to worry about sales!
Moreover, he had numerous other industries. Those business ventures could all promote the medications produced by his pharmaceutical factory. Just thinking about it made him happy.
Lin Yi was very excited.
He was about to make money!
After arriving at school, Lin Yi attended his classes. During lunch, he received a call from Zhou Jianlai, the head of security.
After talking to Zhou Jianlai for a while, Lin Yi asked, "Have you kept an eye on that woman like I told you? Has she continued to give my father-in-law those hormones lately?"
"She still has, but you don't have to worry, Mr. Lin. We're all watching closely, and we won't let her harm your family."
"Alright, keep a close eye on her, but don't let her notice. Let her relax for now, then we can catch her in one fell swoop when the time comes. There must be no mistakes."
Lin Yi cautioned him, and Zhou Jianlai on the other end immediately nodded, "I assure you the task will be completed." After saying that, he hung up the call.
Zhou Jianlai looked at his phone, somewhat surprised.
He couldn't understand why Lin Yi, who already had the evidence in hand, didn't directly confront Han Xuemei. He wondered what Lin Yi was thinking.
But Lin Yi thought it necessary to find an opportunity to talk to Dad Han, to make him aware of the situation and be vigilant.
After all, they and Han Xuemei were relatives, and openly confronting her would be awkward. After the phone call, Lin Yi turned to Han Xuewei and said, "Wife, my people have noticed Han Xuemei's new direction."
At these words, Han Xuewei immediately became vigilant and looked at Lin Yi, "What has she done now?"
Lin Yi didn't hide anything and simply stated, "She has gathered a lot of power in the restaurant, and on top of that, she has bribed some chefs and wait staff. She has them stirring trouble in the restaurant, steadily damaging the business."
Hearing this, Han Xuewei's brow furrowed, and she said with displeasure, "What is she trying to do? Is she planning to ruin my dad's business?"
Lin Yi nodded and replied, "I don't think her goal is that simple. She's not going to destroy the restaurant; what she wants to ruin is your dad's overall business, trying to transfer the assets and then ruin your dad's health…"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei showed a helpless expression. Although she knew Lin Yi was keeping a close eye on Han Xuemei and that her family wouldn't be harmed, she still couldn't help but feel repulsed.
"Our family has always been good to theirs; I don't understand why she would do these things. Besides, my dad left behind the family business back home to start from scratch in Xiangcheng, and now there's barely any contact with her family. I cannot grasp why she harbors such animosity towards us.
My dad has truly been nice to her, otherwise he wouldn't have asked her to come and help." Upon hearing Han Xuewei's heartfelt words, Lin Yi immediately moved closer and hugged her.
"Don't be saddened by this, wife. Some people simply have a poor mindset and are envious of others; this is not your family's problem, but her own."
Lin Yi knew his wife was emotional, so he hadn't taken things to the extreme; that's why, despite having the evidence, he didn't immediately confront Han Xuemei.

chapters.title: Chapter 249 Han Xuemei's Move
chapters.content:
After all, there was no way to resolve such matters through discussion, and being relatives, Lin Yi could at most only dismiss Han Xuemei, but was helpless to directly confront Han Xuewei on their behalf.
Making such a fuss between two families was definitely not an option, especially since they were all relatives.
But Lin Yi didn't want to deal with anything else; his only concern was to protect Han Xuewei and her family.
Two days later, Lin Yi received a phone call from Wang Shaogang of the Huadian Charity Fund.
Wang's words were laced with urgency when he called. Lin Yi immediately asked, "Is there a problem?"
"I'm sorry to disturb you, Mr. Lin! The thing is, the situation of the young Li Dongjun we talked about earlier isn't great.
Li Dongjun is suffering from leukemia, and he needs a bone marrow match that we haven't found yet. Plus, his condition..." Wang Shaogang paused briefly, and Lin Yi quickly pressed, "Hurry up and say it!"
Wang Shaogang nodded, "It's just that young Li Dongjun's health is deteriorating, and now we must immediately find a matching bone marrow donor for him to proceed with the transplant surgery. We've already issued a public announcement, and the hospital is dealing with it..."
Lin Yi was somewhat taken aback and furrowed his brows, "It's that serious? Wasn't he just diagnosed and admitted to the hospital? Besides, I've instructed them to use the best medicine, the best ward—how could this problem arise?"
Upon hearing this, Wang Shaogang grew nervous and quickly explained, "That's not the issue, Mr. Lin. It's the child's physical condition that is too precarious; he was undernourished before, and now chemotherapy is proving to be extremely challenging for his weakened body."
Understanding the dire situation of the father and son, Lin Yi nodded and said, "Then you arrange it. I will also go tomorrow to see if I can match with him."
To this, Wang Shaogang reacted with surprise, not expecting the company's boss himself to step in directly.
After reflecting for a moment, Lin Yi then added, "Issue a reward notice, encouraging everyone to donate bone marrow. If someone is a match for the child, offer them a one-million sponsorship. With such an incentive, I believe many will go!"
Wang Shaogang immediately agreed. He hadn't expected Lin Yi to demonstrate such decisiveness, not only offering his own marrow but also setting aside a substantial sum for the cause. Surely, with such an approach, many would be willing to go through the matching process, knowing there was money to be made if they were compatible.
Who wouldn't want to participate in something like this?
The next morning, Lin Yi went to the hospital for a matching test, but the results would take another two or three days.
After returning to school and attending two classes, he went to the pharmaceutical factory. Now juggling both studies and work, he was truly busy.
All the factory equipment and internal facilities at the pharmaceutical plant needed to be overhauled, and even the external signage required an update. Watching the old, tattered factory sign being taken down and replaced with the new one, Zhou Kongshan looked on with a reflective expression.
But he didn't say anything, because he was still there, and he was still committed to his job and hadn't left.
Many of the equipment inside the plant had been replaced with new ones, and the living conditions in the worker dormitories had also been paid attention to and greatly improved. Zhou Kongshan had always been good to his employees, it was just that the factory's public funds were tight, which is why better facilities had not been upgraded before.
Now as Lin Yi watched, within a matter of days, the whole plant began to present a different, new atmosphere.
Zhou Kongshan was also very satisfied. He had secured a job that he was very pleased with, and it was all thanks to the opportunity that Lin Yi had given him; otherwise, he might have faced unemployment after the sale of the factory.
...
In the evening, after everyone finished dinner, Dad Han sat alone in the living room, looking somber and distressed, clutching a ledger and furrowing his brows.
He turned to Han Xuewei and said, "Xue Mei, do you feel the quality of the dishes at the hotel has gone down lately, or what? Why haven't they made any profit recently?"
Han Xuewei took over the ledger her dad handed to her, but she couldn't make sense of it. Lin Yi leaned in close and took a look—he had already gotten an inkling of the situation from Zhou Kongshan, so the ledger must have been tampered with, how could it be clear?
Lin Yi made a noncommittal comment, "We are still making money at our store, it's just that the cost of ingredients is high, so it's a bit difficult, plus the overhead for labor and materials, which is why we are experiencing losses."
Hearing this, Dad Han's brows furrowed even more.
"But the rent at Wenqu Building is the lowest for me. Even with high ingredient costs, the low rent already means earning a profit!" Dad Han said, his brows deeply knit.
He was getting on in years and found it hard to make out the details of the ledger.
Lin Yi then nodded and said, "Dad, don't worry about the ledger. I'll take care of it for you."
Dad Han immediately agreed, "That sounds good!"
After the discussion, the three of them sat in the living room for a while. Lin Yi then took the ledger and went to the room with Han Xuewei. She looked at Lin Yi and said, "Husband, is there a problem with this ledger? Has my dad's business really been doing that poorly recently?"
As Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Yi nodded, set the ledger aside, and said, "This ledger is just for show; you can't figure out the real situation from it. But don't worry about it now, I'll help you."
Han Xuewei was pulled into Lin Yi's embrace and leaned against him. She furrowed her brows with concern and said, "Husband, didn't you mention dealing with her before? How exactly are we going to handle it? I may not understand the intricacies of the business world, but from what you're saying, I feel like I should know a little bit..."
As Han Xuewei spoke earnestly and looked at him, ready to listen, Lin Yi couldn't help but smile, took her hand, and said, "If my wife is so eager to learn, then I suppose I can explain a bit. Right now, Han Xuemei's only target is your dad's hotel. You understand what her motive is now, right..."

chapters.title: Chapter 250 Want to Know Now
chapters.content:
Hearing this, Han Xuewei was somewhat surprised and nodded, "Husband, you mean she's trying to first run my dad's hotel into the ground and then ruin his health, so he can no longer manage the hotel.
Then, by improving her own abilities, she can rightfully take my dad's place, right!"
Lin Yi nodded in response and stroked Han Xuewei's head, "That's right. Moreover, I've noticed that her demeanor towards me has been a bit off. Every time she sees me, her expression isn't quite right, it seems like she has taken a liking to me..."
As Lin Yi said this, Han Xue looked at him with great surprise, "Husband, what are you talking about? She, she has taken a liking to you?"
Han Xuewei was a bit shocked, how could this be possible?
Hearing this, Lin Yi's lips curled into an interested smile, "Wife, what do you mean by that? Why can't she like me? Look at how handsome and excellent your husband is, how could someone not fancy me? Wife, you must keep a close eye on me, lest I be snatched away!"
Han Xuewei immediately grabbed Lin Yi, "If you dare, I'll definitely beat you up!"
Lin Yi, hearing this, immediately hugged Han Xuewei tightly, "I won't, even if someone else takes a fancy to me, I won't reciprocate, since I already have such a beauty before me."
At his words, Han Xuewei's lips curled into a smile.
"Of course, your wife is such a beauty! I'm full of confidence in myself," Han Xuewei said with a light smile.
"I've now obtained some evidence, and you'll see how I'll deal with her when the time comes."
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei poked Lin Yi's chest immediately, "Oh, come on, tell me now, I want to know…"
"I'll tell you tomorrow night," Lin Yi said. Han Xuewei frowned, knowing Lin Yi was keeping her in suspense, so she changed the subject.
"I've actually known all along that my dad has been considering having me inherit his hotel. He's getting on in years. Han Xuemei probably realized that I wasn't going to inherit my dad's properties, which is why she made up her mind..."
Lin Yi raised an eyebrow upon hearing this, "Wife, you mustn't blame yourself for the wicked things others do. People like her would harbor such thoughts even if it weren't for the hotel business. There are other properties in your family that she would eye greedily as well!
Those kinds of people are just like that. Don't worry, your husband is right by your side. If your dad does want you to take over those properties, I might be able to help."
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei looked at Lin Yi. She knew he had many businesses under his control and was already too busy to handle them all. Lately, seeing him running back and forth between the school and the pharmaceutical factory, she felt heartache and shook her head, "Actually, I can learn too, study with my dad, then I can help him."
As Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Yi held her hand and looked at her fair hands, smiling.
"Wife, how could I let you do such dirty and tiring work? Moreover, you wouldn't even know how to pick ingredients at the market; what to choose, how to select them, how to store them—you haven't known these things since you were a child!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei immediately puffed up her cheeks and said, "I really don't know, but I can learn slowly. Anyway, I don't need to worry about selecting ingredients. When the time comes, just find a professional, and he can choose the ingredients very well!"
Lin Yi then laughed, "If you don't even know this, how are you going to tell if someone has ulterior motives or if they'll embezzle funds and buy substandard ingredients?"
And if your restaurant is busy every day, but you haven't separated the costs and profits and don't understand how to operate it, you might still not make money even with good traffic.
There is also a lot to learn, like you need to know the cooking time for a dish, and when to serve it. Plus, you have to keep a close eye on your employees to prevent any mistakes. Whether they're trustworthy or not is crucial. Some might even be spies sent by other restaurants, and you have to be absolutely sure about that.
If they tamper with the food, it could cause tremendous damage to your restaurant...
Lin Yi said this; although she didn't fully understand the restaurant business, her family's generations of commerce had honed her business acumen.
Hearing Lin Yi go on and on, Han Xuewei suddenly felt terrified and hugged Lin Yi tightly, saying, "Alright, alright, husband, I don't want to hear any more. I think I'll give up on taking over my dad's restaurant after all. Listening to you, it sounds way too difficult. I'll just stick with my painting and, if possible, hold an exhibition.
If not, I'll be content to stay at home and be the family spender.
As Han Xuewei spoke, Lin Yi couldn't help but laugh.
"No worries, with your husband here, you'll never have to worry about food and drink for the rest of your life," Lin Yi said. He decided to take his wife to the hotel to take a look tomorrow night, so everyone could see Han Xuemei's true colors.
...
The next evening.
Lin Yi took Han Xuewei to his father's hotel restaurant.
Han Xuewei thought it would be too boring to go alone, so she called Qin Xiaoxu, who now lived with Lin Jie, and naturally, she brought Lin Jie along.
Since the last misunderstanding between the two of them was cleared up, their relationship had progressed rapidly, and Lin Jie had become more proactive.
Together, they all entered the hotel restaurant. Dad Han was very enthusiastic when he saw them and originally wanted to seat them in a private room, where the environment was more comfortable and quiet.
The first floor was where ordinary guests dined, noisy and bustling, but Lin Yi declined. He came to see how the hotel's management system was functioning, and at this moment, Han Xuemei, standing at the reception, saw Lin Yi and the others arriving and flashed a smug smile.
She wore a black miniskirt that screamed "bad girl," a sharp contrast to the dowdy staff uniform that she absolutely refused to wear.
Dad Han didn't enforce any dress code on her, so she wore her own clothes every day. She eagerly walked up to Han Xuewei and the rest, pouring each a cup of tea.
Looking at Lin Yi, she sweetly asked, "Lin Yi, are you not busy today? What brings you here?"
Hearing this, everyone present showed a look of surprise as if they had sensed an unmistakably bitchy aura, but Lin Jie had no particular reaction.
He wasn't someone who could tell such nuances. After sipping his tea and finding it pleasantly sweet, he said, "Pour me another cup, please."
Upon hearing this, Qin Xiaoxu snatched the tea cup from his hand, "Why are you drinking so much tea? Water will do!" As she said this, she grabbed a water jug from the side and handed it directly to Lin Jie.
"Drink this!"
At that moment, Lin Jie was utterly baffled. What did I do wrong again?

chapters.title: Chapter 251 Gathering Everyone
chapters.content:
Lin Jie was somewhat at a loss and couldn't help but look over at Lin Yi, who was just looking at them impassively, while Han Xuemei stood aside, feeling a bit awkward. She could only nod and back away.
Taking advantage of her departure, Lin Jie immediately leaned in to Qin Xiaoxu and spoke, "What were you pushing me for just now? That girl isn't even as pretty as you, why are you so lacking in confidence?"
As Lin Jie spoke, Qin Xiaoxu immediately felt quite pleased and harrumphed.
Lin Jie, this straightforward guy, didn't beat around the bush, and what he said was indeed true. Han Xuemei was indeed far less attractive than Qin Xiaoxu in terms of looks.
At this moment, Han Xuemei brought over some small dishes, placing them in front of everyone, deliberately pushing them towards Lin Yi with a smile, she said, "Brother Lin Yi, the appetizers in our store are pretty good. You should try them first."
As she spoke, everyone exchanged glances. Lin Yi simply pushed the small dishes to Lin Jie's side and looked at Han Xuewei, saying, "I've caught a cold recently and can't eat any of these things."
The way Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei was very gentle. Han Xuemei, standing on the side, felt as if she had been pricked by thorns.
At this time, Han Xuewei's expression wasn't good either because ever since Lin Yi had been honest with her the night before, now when she looked at her cousin, she always felt that something had changed.
Thinking of this, she felt very uncomfortable. Lin Yi was also aware of the changes in Han Xuewei's expression.
Because by then, it wasn't just Han Xuewei's expression that was unattractive; her hand was digging into Lin Yi's hand. Lin Yi could only raise his eyebrows awkwardly and reached out to hold Han Xuewei's hand before he could remove it.
At this time, although Lin Jie wanted to start eating, Qin Xiaoxu was staring straight at him, making him feel flustered even though he didn't know what he had done wrong.
But since following Qin Xiaoxu's words was always right, he refrained from touching the small dishes, saying indifferently, "I don't like these things."
No one paid attention to him, and Han Xuemei, feeling like she couldn't save face, merely smiled thinly and said, "Then you guys wait here for a bit. I'll go get busy."
After she finished speaking, the atmosphere around the dining table lightened a bit. Qin Xiaoxu then picked up her phone and quietly sent a message to Han Xuewei.
"Vivi, didn't you notice how your cousin's attitude towards your husband is a bit different?"
Han Xuewei felt displeased at that moment. She had just begun to notice it from Han Xuemei's change in demeanor. Thinking about this, Han Xuewei felt somewhat jealous. She had really been too naive before, not even noticing such things, so she angrily sent a message.
"You knew about it all along, why didn't you tell me earlier?"
Seeing that message, along with Han Xuewei's somewhat annoyed expression, Qin Xiaoxu couldn't help but smile and immediately replied to Han Xuewei.
"Vivi dear, I hadn't thought about it before. I just took it as a sister's admiration for her brother. But now, she's quite upfront about it."
"Besides, when I saw her at your wedding, it was supposed to be a festive occasion, so I didn't pay much attention to these details."
Hearing this made Han Xuewei feel surprised. Qin Xiaoxu had sensed such emotions from Han Xuemei since they had just gotten married.
At this moment, unable to control herself, Han Xuewei raised her eyes to look at Qin Xiaoxu, who felt a bit embarrassed and hurriedly replied with her phone: "It was indeed like that. At that time, I just felt that her expression when she looked at your husband wasn't quite right."
This matter was now confirmed, and Han Xuewei was somewhat displeased. She only sent back a line of text on her phone.
"She's after more than just my husband, and soon you'll see just how big of a mistake she's made," said Han Xuewei. Qin Xiaoxu was somewhat surprised, but seeing the meaningful expression on Han Xuewei's face, she didn't ask any further.
After all, she would find out soon enough.
At this moment, Han Xuewei was utterly convinced of the affair; it seemed Han Xuemei had not had simple intentions from the start. She had long set her sights on Lin Yi, and all of this was part of her plan.
She had thought that Han Xuemei would restrain herself when she came over today, but she didn't expect Han Xuemei's recent behavior to be so provocative.
Lin Yi, watching their expressions, couldn't help but speak up, "Alright, let's finish eating first, then we can deal with the matter."
Soon, the waiter had brought all the dishes. It was a busy time, and the staff were all bustling around. The service wasn't very fast, and sometimes Dad Han even had to come over to serve the dishes himself.
Seeing his father so busy, Lin Yi decided that he must help Dad Han more in the future to prevent him from working so hard, and that he should hire more staff.
He didn't want to skimp on staffing to save money, as fewer people meant his father would be even more tired. Lin Yi looked over there, not really in the mood for eating; he was observing the condition of the waitstaff.
These waiters often broke the tableware. In just a short while, many plates and utensils were shattered, and it didn't take long for customers to complain about the service and the quality of the food. While they were still dining, there were constant accidents with broken tableware or customer complaints about the food and service.
Lin Yi and the others were seated at a table on the upper floor, which allowed them to see the entire situation on the first floor. Lin Yi knew Han Xuewei must have sent quite a few people to sabotage their restaurant's business, but he didn't expect her to be so brazen about it right under his eyes."
After dinner, Lin Jie stood up, thinking they would leave after eating, but Lin Yi and Qin Xiaoxu didn't move; they all sat there without stirring.
Lin Jie frowned, looking around in confusion. Qin Xiaoxu naturally knew that Lin Yi and Han Xuewei must have had their reasons, so she looked up at Lin Jie.
Without saying anything more, Lin Jie could only idly pick up his phone and play games for a while.
An hour later, the dinner rush was over, and many customers had left. Lin Yi had already told Dad Han that he would gather all the staff later in the evening, as he had something to say.
And just then, a message came from Dad Han.
"Everyone's here; come down."
Lin Yi replied with an okay and looked at everyone before leading them downstairs.
Dad Han didn't interfere and, after sending the message, walked away, leaving everything to Lin Yi.
When everyone gathered, Han Xuemei was still somewhat confused. However, she felt confident about the things she had done earlier; she was certain they would not be discovered.
With this thought, she breathed a sigh of relief and stood in the middle of everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 252 First Warning
chapters.content:
After Lin Yi came down with the others, he found it somewhat amusing to see Han Xuemei standing confidently among the people.
So full of self-confidence, it seems you're very sure of everything you've done.
Today, I'll show you what despair looks like.
Lin Yi, while supporting Han Xuewei, called over the other two people.
For some reason, Han Xuemei didn't know why, but it seemed like Dad Han had already left today. Was he not with Lin Yi?
And why had Lin Yi called all these people here?
"Brother Lin Yi, is there something wrong? Or is there something in our hotel that has made you uncomfortable?"
As soon as Lin Yi and the others walked over, she couldn't wait to debase herself.
That cautious look in her eyes, if other men saw it, they'd probably contact her immediately, but Lin Yi was different.
"Indeed, there are many things about the hotel that make me very uncomfortable. I gave the hotel to you, not to manage it this way. Today, we'll talk about a few issues inside the hotel."
Lin Yi looked at Han Xuemei with a cold gaze, his condescending tone made Han Xuemei uneasy, but she still forcibly suppressed the displeasure in her heart.
She couldn't expose herself so quickly, or else all her planned efforts would have been in vain.
"Okay, Brother Lin Yi, please bring up any issues you have."
This woman didn't feel disgusted, and the sisters of Han Xuewei were almost rolling their eyes up to the heaven.
In the end, they couldn't hold back and directly smacked their boyfriend next to them.
"Ah! Why did you hit me? What did I do wrong?"
"I can't stand your face, can't I hit you?"
After hearing his girlfriend's fierce words, Lin Jie could only look pitiable and then stood a little further away from her.
Why was this woman always acting so crazy?
He hadn't provoked her or anything!
Han Xuewei watched the two quarreling friends with great amusement.
Lin Jie was indeed a typical straight man, completely unable to guess the feelings of his close female friend.
"Today, during the serving of the dishes, how many plates did you all break? Do you have any idea?"
"This…"
Lin Yi stood in front of everyone, his gaze cold as he looked at the waitstaff in front of him.
The waitstaff were all stuttering, unable to answer, after all, they had previously agreed that they would earn money by breaking plates, but the condition was to keep it secret.
"Do you still want to continue hiding it? Do you know what breaking those plates counts as? It's considered damage to public and private property, I can take all of you to court!"
Lin Yi's stern voice intimidated everyone present, and the waitstaff were also very surprised.
It had been previously agreed upon that these were their duties—how could that be considered damaging public and private property?
"How can you say that? Didn't we agree on this before…"
"Shut up!"
One of the waitstaff, who couldn't keep his mouth shut, nearly spilled the truth.
Fortunately, Han Xuemei spoke up just in time, stopping him, and the cold sweat on her body kept pouring out, nearly scaring her to death.
"I'm really sorry, Brother Lin Yi, this is my mistake for not managing them well. Rest assured, give me one chance, and I'll train them properly from now on. They absolutely will not make such low-level mistakes again!"
Han Xuemei adjusted her tone and then turned around, striding with a seductive gait to Lin Yi's side.
She even wanted to reach out and pull Lin Yi's arm.
Han Xuewei's eyes darkened instantly.
Feeling the low pressure emanating from his wife nearby, Lin Yi very obviously shook off her hand.
"If you can't even handle this little thing, why would I keep you in this hotel? How did you assure me at the beginning? If it weren't for the fact you are my wife's cousin, I definitely wouldn't have let you in!"
Lin Yi's words grew more and more severe, and Han Xuemei's face could hardly maintain its dignity.
After all, in front of so many people, why should Lin Yi scold her like that? She was, after all, holding a manager's position!
Moreover, he had already taken over most of the hotel's management on behalf of Dad Han.
"Lin Yi, what do you mean by this? Haven't I done enough for this hotel? Even if there's no merit, there's hard work!"
Seeing that her words failed to move Lin Yi, Han Xuemei immediately began to play the card of emotional appeal.
Her acting almost made the people present want to vomit their lunch.
Why not become an actress? If she took it up, she would probably have to be given the Best Actress award, right?
"Don't get worked up, I didn't say you've done nothing. I must tell you, though, there are some things that if they belong to you, they are yours; if not, no matter how hard you try, you won't be able to snatch them away."
Lin Yi's voice contained nuances that had a deeper meaning—wondering if Han Xuemei understood?
Actually, Lin Yi had planned to expose Han Xuemei's true colors that very day.
However, Dad Han had begged him to give Han Xuemei another chance, believing she was capable of reforming.
Such a thing was absolutely impossible, Lin Yi understood, but he did not know how to tell Dad Han.
And since Dad Han insisted, Lin Yi did not say anything further.
"I understand. Rest assured, with me here, this hotel won't encounter any problems. Although revenues haven't been great recently, under my leadership, I am confident this hotel will go a long way."
After pondering for a while, Han Xuemei put on a smile again and lifted her head.
She also stirred the staff around her to applaud, to showcase the unity she commanded in the hotel.
Lin Yi and Han Xuemei exchanged a glance, then Lin Yi looked away and focused on Han Xuewei by his side.
"Wife, let's hurry home. I want to see how the baby is doing now."
Lin Yi's voice was tender and soft—completely different from how he addressed Han Xuemei, almost dripping with gentleness.
It made Han Xuemei extremely jealous.
"Okay."
Han Xuewei had been feeling jealous, but upon hearing Lin Yi's words, she immediately let go of her anger.
Her husband was the best to her, and he would love only her for his whole life!
Therefore, she truly didn't need to worry about other women snatching him away.
"Hmph! You'd better be careful. I'll be watching you, and if I find you doing anything to harm Han Xuewei, see if I don't swell up your face with slaps!"
Before leaving, Qin Xiaoxu didn't forget to drop a few harsh words and then dragged Lin Jie away by the ear.
After they left, Han Xuemei glared angrily at the door.
Had these people really discovered her secret?

chapters.title: Chapter 253 A New Task
chapters.content:
Han Xuemei bit her lower lip, her face showing a hint of panic.
What should she do now?
If her plan had really been discovered by Lin Yi, what would she do next?
No! She absolutely couldn't allow herself to be at a disadvantage; she had to find an opportunity to test Lin Yi.
Afterward, Han Xuemei had her waitstaff continue their tasks.
There was no need to hold back, they could just continue as before.
"Manager, can we really keep doing this? Plus that man earlier warned us; if we keep this up, he'll sue us," one of the waitstaff said, a bit scared.
He was worried whether he might end up in court if they kept going like this.
If they got sued, they would surely have to pay a fine, and he didn't earn enough to cover that!
"What are you scared of, haven't you got me? Even if something does happen, I'll be the one to take the heat for you guys. Don't be afraid, keep working for me, and without my command, you're not allowed to stop!"
Han Xuemei glared at the waiter.
The other waitstaff didn't dare to say anything either and quickly got back to their own tasks.
When Lin Yi and Han Xuewei returned home, Han Xuewei was in a gloomy mood.
"Are you unhappy because of what happened just now?"
Lin Yi was very concerned about Han Xuewei's situation and paid close attention to her at all times.
Seeing that Han Xuewei looked unhappy, Lin Yi wondered if it was because of the incident at the hotel that had upset her.
"Is there really nothing going on between you and my cousin? Why does he call you with such intimacy? And he wasn't afraid at all even though I was there..."
The more Han Xuewei spoke, the softer her voice became.
She knew it was just her baseless suspicions, without any evidence.
And with Lin Yi being so good to her, how could she have such thoughts about him.
But she couldn't help thinking about it that way.
Seeing how Han Xuewei's head was getting lower and lower, Lin Yi quickly cupped Han Xuewei's cheeks and made her look into his eyes.
"You can doubt anything about me, but you must never doubt my feelings for you, understand? I love you, truly deeply, and I love our children and this home, so I would never do anything to betray you," he said.
Lin Yi held up four fingers, swearing he would never lie to Han Xuewei, or else let lightning strike him.
Han Xuewei was a bit scared and quickly covered Lin Yi's mouth.
However, her expression seemed to brighten a bit, as if she was happy.
"Oh my, I didn't say anything! Alright, let's not talk about this anymore. I trust you, let's go back quickly, I wonder how Da Bao and Er Bao are doing at home?"
Han Xuewei linked her arm with Lin Yi's, and the two of them went upstairs.
After arriving home, the first thing Han Xuewei did was to go to the children's room to check on her two treasures.
Lin Yi stood behind them, watching this incredibly warm scene.
Having a family like this, Lin Yi was already very content.
He would no longer think about those unnecessary things; as long as he took good care of Han Xuewei and managed his career, that would be enough.
As for Han Xuemei, if she continued to ignore advice, even Dad Han couldn't protect her.
"Ding-ling-ling!"
Just as the pair were immersed in this warm atmosphere, Lin Yi's phone rang.
"Hello?"
Continue your adventure at empire
After truly closing the bedroom door, Lin Yi stood on the staircase and answered the call.
"Lin Yi, how are things at the hotel?"
"Dad, I've already warned her. If she continues to be stubborn, I won't be able to protect her. This matter is very serious, and you should also stop taking the medicine she gave you."
After hearing what Lin Yi said, Dad Han sighed. He really wanted to save this child.
After all, she wasn't like this before.
No one knew what had happened that made her change to the person she is now.
Even if Han Xuemei wanted to harm Dad Han, he still wished to save this child.
"If possible, Lin Yi, spare her. Being a girl, maybe she's doing all this because she feels insecure and fears ending up with nothing."
Up to this moment, Dad Han was still making excuses for Han Xuemei. Lin Yi was very helpless, but in the end, he agreed.
After hanging up the phone, Han Xuewei came out of the room and returned to the bedroom with Lin Yi.
As for the hotel incident, Lin Yi didn't have time to attend to it now, but he would have his men secretly watch Han Xuemei.
If she continued with her little schemes, Lin Yi would really take action, but for now, it wasn't necessary.
She was just a woman, and not yet causing too much trouble.
