"Husband, was it Dad who just called you?"
"Yes, he was asking about the hotel. Don't worry, I'll take care of it. It's getting late, you should rest early. Don't you have school tomorrow?"
Lin Yi put away his somewhat indifferent expression and smiled tenderly at Han Xuewei.
Then, he reached out his hand and waved at Han Xuewei, motioning her to come over and sit by his side.
Han Xuewei obediently cuddled up to Lin Yi.
"You don't need to worry about these troubles. I'll handle them. You just need to be happy."
With such a husband, Han Xuewei really felt very fortunate.
If she had married someone else, she probably wouldn't have been treated so well.
"Okay."
The two of them cuddled for a while longer and then fell into a deep sleep. It had been a long day, and Lin Yi was tired.
Just as he fell into a deep sleep, the system popped up.
"A new mission is now issued, please ensure the product you developed is released to the public soon, and sales must reach ten million."
What's the deal, can't it let him have peace even while sleeping?
"System, you issue so many tasks every day, don't you ever wonder if I can complete them?"
Actually, Lin Yi was quite curious. The system issued one task or more every day, but had it ever worried about whether Lin Yi could complete them?
If Lin Yi consistently failed, what would be the outcome?
In fact, Lin Yi once had such thoughts, but the rewards given were too tempting.
"Don't worry, Host. With your intelligence and wisdom, you will certainly complete the mission. The reward for this task is a Vigor Pill."
What? Lin Yi wondered if he had heard wrong.
A Vigor Pill?
Does such a thing really exist?
Wondering what kind of effect it would have after consumption, Lin Yi suddenly looked forward to it.
By the time Lin Yi woke up, it was already the next morning.
"You go to school first, I have some things to handle. Is it alright if I pick you up after class?"

chapters.title: Chapter 254 Seduction
chapters.content:
Before leaving the house, Lin Yi planted a kiss on Han Xuewei's forehead, and she smiled happily.
"Good husband!"
"Remember to keep your distance from that guy, and if I find out he's deliberately getting close to you, I'll rush to the school immediately." Find your next read at empire
There it was, a reminder to Han Xuewei before leaving.
She had to keep her distance from a certain teacher at school; the students were all her informants.
If Lin Yi found out, the first one he wouldn't let off would be that stinky teacher!
"Oh, I know, you don't have to worry. I belong to you, and how could you even think I might run away?"
Han Xuewei pushed Lin Yi from behind, urging him to get to work and not to worry about such things.
She would never leave Lin Yi!
After all, no one else had been as good to her as Lin Yi.
And why would she let go of a high-quality husband like Lin Yi?
"Although I'm not afraid, you must pay attention to keep your distance from him; I don't want to hear any more rumors about the two of you."
Lin Yi shook his head helplessly, and after reaching the door, they embraced.
Han Xuewei assured Lin Yi that she would certainly keep her distance from him, and only then did he leave with peace of mind.
After arriving at the pharmaceutical factory, Lin Yi met Zhou Kongshan.
"Lin Yi, about the new medicine you gave me a while back, we've made significant progress recently. Would you like to come and see?"
There were stars in Zhou Kongshan's eyes.
Lin Yi knew this guy loved researching these things and had top-notch skills.
Lin Yi nodded and followed Zhou Kongshan into the innermost office, where he saw the prototype of the medicine.
"This was developed based on the medicine you gave me before, but it's currently in the trial phase."
What made them anxious now was that nobody was willing to take the medicine, even though it had no side effects.
But a newly developed medicine is truly worrying.
"When can we start normal mass production?"
Because of the task assigned by the system last night, Lin Yi asked Zhou Kongshan about the progress for the first time.
"According to our current pace, it should be about one more month before we can start normal mass production, and so far, we haven't found any volunteers to test this medicine."
It had already been such a long time, and still no volunteers? It seemed the compensation offered wasn't enough.
"No worries, don't try to save money for me. Just increase the compensation for finding volunteers to 1 million."
Money was the least of Lin Yi's concerns; he was determined to develop this medicine.
With their low pricing strategy, they were bound to win the public's favor and establish their reputation.
Moreover, once their medicine was developed, its effectiveness would be top-notch.
With their low prices, the consumer groups would naturally make the right choice.
"Why have I suddenly become so anxious? I remember you weren't particularly concerned about the progress of these drugs before."
Zhou Kongshan nodded; he wasn't too shocked by this.
After all, once the medicine was developed, it would still have to be sold.
Lin Yi wasn't a philanthropist; he couldn't keep giving without making a profit, could he?
He was just curious about what had made Lin Yi so suddenly anxious.
Before, Lin Yi told him that all he needed to do was to try his best to develop it.
Even if he couldn't develop it, he wouldn't say anything.
"It's probably because I've received a task recently, you wouldn't understand even if I told you, are there any other issues?"
Lin Yi said this seemingly out of nowhere, and Zhou Kongshan, you really couldn't understand.
Afterward, Zhou Kongshan began to introduce other achievements to Lin Yi.
To be honest, the speed of their team was quite fast, and Lin Yi was also very gratified.
"Not bad at all. But I heard you've been staying in the lab for almost three months now, are you sure you don't need to go home for a visit?"
Lin Yi did feel somewhat concerned for Zhou Kongshan.
He himself was a capitalist, but he wouldn't exploit the value and rest time of his employees.
If Zhou Kongshan wanted to take a week's leave now, Lin Yi would also allow it.
"It's okay, Lin Yi, I can just continue to stay in the lab. Don't look at how long I've been here; I actually do rest properly and balance work with leisure, I understand all that. If there are no other issues, I should get back to my research. And if you come across any other good pills, bring them over too, really. The pills you've brought are truly miraculous; they're beyond my expectations.
I've never seen anything like them!"
The moment Zhou Kongshan mentioned this, his eyes lit up immediately.
Lin Yi felt helpless, how come everyone he found was a workaholic?
"Since you say it's no problem, then I won't fuss over it. As for the pills, if I make any new discoveries, I will definitely bring them to you guys, after all, you are my excellent researchers."
After exchanging a few pleasantries, Lin Yi left; he didn't want to continue hindering their progress.
The task given by the system required too much time to complete; it was impossible to finish in a short period.
He had barely left the laboratory when Lin Yi received a call from Han Xuemei, how could this person still have the face to call him?
But after some thought, Lin Yi still answered.
He was curious to see what Han Xuemei wanted to do.
"Lin Yi brother, do you have time? Can I treat you to lunch at noon?"
As soon as he answered the call, Lin Yi heard Han Xuemei's overly sweet and cloying voice.
Isn't she afraid that if others heard her say this, they would vomit out their meals?
"I have time, you pick the place, and I'll come to you."
Han Xuemei initially thought Lin Yi wouldn't agree, but to her surprise, he accepted very readily.
A hint of triumph flickered through Han Xuemei's eyes.
She thought, how could there possibly be men who wouldn't want a bit on the side? Lin Yi was the same.
Normally, because of Han Xuewei's presence, he acted all righteous, but now with Han Xuewei gone, didn't he immediately reveal his true nature?
"Okay, Lin Yi brother, I'll send you the address in a while. You can directly come over at noon~"
Han Xuemei wanted to continue the conversation and seduce Lin Yi a bit more.
Who knew Lin Yi would give a grunt and then hang up immediately.
He feared that if he continued listening, he wouldn't be able to stop himself from throwing up his breakfast.
Han Xuemei wasn't upset by this small matter; she planned to dress up carefully.
If possible today at noon, she was going to win over Lin Yi; she couldn't let this guy ruin her plans.
And if she snagged Lin Yi, why would she need to bother making all these painstaking plans?
Wouldn't everything belonging to Han Xuewei become hers!
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi sent a message to Han Xuewei, informing her that he might not be able to accompany her for lunch at noon.

chapters.title: Chapter 255 Slinging Mud
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei didn't see the message Lin Yi had sent her until after her class had ended, and she had no idea what Lin Yi was busy with.
But if there was no time for a meal together, then so be it.
As Han Xuewei was walking in the corridor, she ran into Mo Jihua head-on.
After the two met, the atmosphere was somewhat awkward.
The main concern Han Xuewei had was whether Lin Yi, if he found them talking again, would get jealous when he got back?
"Good afternoon, Teacher Mo," she said.
After a simple greeting, Han Xuewei turned to leave, but Mo Jihua called out to her unexpectedly. Find exclusive stories on empire
In his heart, Mo Jihua was still somewhat unwilling to let go, but he couldn't properly express it.
After all, Han Xuewei was already married with a child; he couldn't eagerly play the role of the lover.
"Lin Yi didn't come to have lunch with you? I remember he usually comes to find you, doesn't he?"
"My husband had some matters to attend to this noon, so he couldn't make it. It's the same whether I eat alone or not. If there's nothing else, I'll be leaving first, Teacher Mo."
On Han Xuewei's face was an appropriately polite smile.
But it was that very smile that seemed to widen the distance between them.
Mo Jihua felt extremely uncomfortable.
They used to be so close; why should they give way just because of Lin Yi's arrival?
"If no one is joining you for lunch, then why not eat with me instead? Or is it that now you have a husband, even an old friend like me can't join you?"
Teacher Mo smiled, then slowly approached Han Xuewei, who involuntarily took a step back.
Mo Jihua stood still, stunned.
Since when had Han Xuewei become so wary of him?
"No need, Teacher Mo, I can eat by myself. It's mainly because I'm afraid of my 'jealous jar' at home. If he sees us again, he might run over to the school," she said with a forced laugh and then hurried away, leaving Mo Jihua alone in the corridor, watching Han Xuewei's retreating figure.
Passing students also discussed their relationship.
It now seemed that Han Xuewei was trying to avoid Teacher Mo.
"Oh my god, does it feel like Teacher Mo is pining? Could he be secretly in love with our Teacher Han?"
"Bro, it's not just you who feels that way; I think so too. Although Teacher Mo is outstanding, Teacher Han's husband is even more formidable," one of them said.
While the principals themselves weren't making a fuss, these onlookers were already getting excited.
After that, Teacher Mo gave them a look before leaving the area.
Lin Yi arrived at the restaurant on time, following the address sent by Han Xuemei.
Han Xuemei had already arrived early, sitting obediently in the restaurant waiting for Lin Yi.
She did so in order to let Lin Yi see her at her best the moment he walked through the door.
Moreover, those around her kept complimenting how beautiful Han Xuemei looked.
This only further strengthened Han Xuemei's resolve, believing she could still make a significant impression on him.
When Han Xuemei finally saw the man she had been yearning for enter through the door, she immediately stood up and waved him over.
"Lin Yi, brother, I'm here."
As soon as Lin Yi walked in, he saw Han Xuemei flirting with the crowd.
To be honest, Han Xuemei was not unattractive, but her personality was not the type Lin Yi liked, and this woman was too affected for his taste.
Lin Yi approached with an expressionless face, sat down opposite Han Xuemei, and didn't say a word, leaving Han Xuemei slightly embarrassed.
But she still forced herself to stay composed.
Why would she shrink back because of such a small challenge?
"You called me over for something?"
Get to the point and don't waste my time. For her nonsense, I even skipped lunch with my wife.
It was this thought that brought a touch of impatience to Lin Yi's face.
"Lin Yi, brother, it's really nothing much, I thought I had made myself very clear. Don't you understand what I mean?"
Han Xuemei was puzzled – why had Lin Yi suddenly become impatient with her?
Hadn't he agreed to have lunch with her? Wasn't that because he was interested in her?
Han Xuemei's coy expression, in Lin Yi's eyes, was just plain annoying.
But the men around them were already bewitched.
"I don't understand what you mean, and I don't want to. You should know that I am now married to your cousin, and we have a very happy family. If you intend to disrupt that, I advise you to let go of that thought. There's no need to fixate on me. Instead of harboring such thoughts, it might be better for you to properly manage your hotel."
Lin Yi's words were quite heartless, weren't they? The men around them wanted to stand up for Han Xuemei.
Han Xuemei clenched her fists under the table. Why couldn't this man be swayed?
She had already thrown away her pride to approach him, even willing to bear the name of a homewrecker – why couldn't he give her a chance!
She couldn't possibly be worse than her cousin, could she?
"Lin Yi, brother, I have been managing the hotel well, but I don't know why it has turned out like this recently. Perhaps my sister thinks I'm in her way, so she always... It's better not to tell Lin Yi, brother, about this; I'm afraid it might lead to misunderstandings between you two."
Han Xuemei's voice was tinged with a sob, causing Lin Yi to frown.
This person wouldn't be planning to blame all her faults on Han Xuewei, would she?
Han Xuewei hardly interacted with her; how could she be blamed for this mess?
"What exactly happened? I'm actually quite curious."
Lin Yi leaned back and crossed his legs, fiddling with the ring on his finger.
"It's really nothing, I truly don't want to say it and affect the relationship between you and my cousin. I can handle a little grievance."
As she spoke, Han Xuemei suddenly started crying. What a waste of acting talent - Lin Yi had to play along.
"We can't have you feeling wronged. Just speak your mind."
"Since Lin Yi, brother, insists, I won't keep it to myself anymore. It's just that my cousin came to the hotel previously and said some really over-the-top things. Those words are too nasty, I won't repeat them to dirty your ears, brother. She even warned the waitstaff not to do their jobs properly but to mess up intentionally.
I really don't know what I did to offend my cousin to make her treat me like this…"
After finishing, Han Xuemei covered her face with her hands, and her shoulders shook uncontrollably.
With every word, she slandered Han Xuewei.

chapters.title: Chapter 256 Communication Failure
chapters.content:
After using it, Lin Yi's face suddenly turned cold.
Han Xuemei thought she had finally earned Lin Yi's sympathy, pitying that she was about to have a big fight with Han Xuewei, right?
"Lin Yi, brother, please don't be angry, and certainly don't quarrel with Han Xuemei because of me..."
Seeing this, Han Xuemei wanted to intensify the misunderstanding between them, but Lin Yi interrupted her as he spoke.
"You don't think I'm going to argue with my wife because of you, do you? You're really giving yourself too much credit. Even if my wife really did what you're suggesting, how would that be? It could only mean you've done something to make her mad. Han Xuemei, it seems I've already warned you yesterday, haven't I? Don't play these petty tricks, they really don't cut it in front of me."
Originally, Lin Yi had intended to give Han Xuemei a chance, but who knew she'd try to drag Han Xuewei down with her?
She was utterly ungrateful. She had been able to drag this out until now only because Han Xuewei and Dad Han had been covering for her.
Otherwise, Han Xuemei would have already fired her and tossed her out to fend for herself.
"It's not like that, Brother Lin Yi!"
Han Xuemei suddenly panicked. Why had it turned out this way?
If it were any other man who heard what she had said, the normal reaction should have been to question Han Xuewei and then have an argument with her, right?
Why was Lin Yi still so steadfast in his trust for Han Xuewei and instead turned to accuse herself?
Jealousy began to swell immensely within Han Xuemei's heart.
Why had such a good man set his sights on Han Xuewei? Where did she fall short?!
Fearing she couldn't control her facial expressions, Han Xuemei quickly lowered her head.
"Han Xuemei, the chance I gave you seems to be wasted on you. You shouldn't have dragged Han Xuewei into this. You should know how much I treasure my wife. I was planning on playing along with your nonsense for a while longer, but you're like a wolf that can't be tamed. Dad Han and Han Xuewei have been so good to you, yet you insist on hurting them both.
To be honest, someone like you shouldn't be employed by any company, or even exist in this world."
Your journey continues on empire
Lin Yi snorted coldly, having said all he wanted to say, and stood up ready to leave.
But Han Xuemei suddenly stood up, as if about to explode.
"What right do you have to say that about me? Lin Yi, what do you know anyway? You talk about that old man and Han Xuewei being good to me, but where is their goodness? That old man only cares about his daughter, he should be nicer to me!"
Han Xuemei vented the anger in her heart, but all of these issues stemmed from her own distortions.
The men nearby who had originally felt sympathy for her now displayed expressions of disgust on their faces.
It was clear that this woman was to blame, yet she turned around and shifted all the responsibility onto others.
"Enough! Han Xuemei, you really should be grateful I don't hit women. This is my final warning to you, if you continue like this, I can only tell you, I will take back everything you have, after all, none of it was truly yours in the first place."
Lin Yi gave her a cold look, then quickly walked away.
Being in the same place as this woman made him feel as though he'd tainted himself.
He was anxious about how his beloved was doing now and hurried back to school to have lunch with Han Xuewei.
It was already this time, had Han Xuewei eaten yet?
Upon reaching the school, Lin Yi immediately went to the faculty cafeteria.
Seeing Han Xuewei sitting there eating alone, he felt relieved.
But the next second, Mo Jihua walked straight up to her with a tray in hand.
Lin Yi's expression turned cold instantly, and he quickly approached.
"There's nobody here, right? Can I sit here?"
"Ah?"
"No way! Who says there's no one here? Her husband, well, here I am! Teacher Mo, you should go eat somewhere else. After all, we, as a couple, would like to have some quality time together."
Lin Yi suddenly appeared beside Han Xuewei, giving her quite a scare.
Her face was filled with surprise, as she had thought that Lin Yi wouldn't be coming for lunch today.
But regarding the incident just now, she hoped that Lin Yi wouldn't misunderstand; she had intended to refuse!
"Since your husband is here, I'll take my leave. Enjoy your meal," said Teacher Mo, his smile unwavering as he picked up his things and left.
The surrounding students were thoroughly enjoying the spectacle, barely able to contain their amusement.
"The possessiveness of Teacher Han's husband is something else!"
"Honey, you're just eating this for lunch? Haven't I told you not to shortchange yourself at noon and to eat well?"
Han Xuewei was all prepared for Lin Yi to start nagging her about the interaction with Mo Jihua.
Unexpectedly, Lin Yi didn't mention it.
Instead, upon seeing what Han Xuewei was eating, he scolded her for not eating more meat and consuming too many vegetables instead.
This was no way to get proper nutrition!
"Hubby, don't be mad, I just didn't have much of an appetite since you couldn't join me for lunch today. I only wanted something simple. But now that you're here, I feel hungry again. Could you grab me some more food?"
With one act of coquetry toward Lin Yi from Han Xuewei, he was powerless to resist.
He patted Han Xuewei's head and then went to get her more delicious food, all of which were her favorites.
Just like that, the two of them spent the entire lunchtime showering each other with affection in the canteen.
When it was time for her to go teach, the two were reluctant to part.
"Don't worry, as soon as you finish work, I'll come pick you up and we'll go home. Try not to miss me too much during class," Lin Yi said.
It was hard for him to say goodbye to his wife so soon after just seeing her; Lin Yi felt genuinely challenged.
He regretted agreeing to meet with that woman at noon; otherwise, he could have spent more time with his wife.
"Stop talking nonsense and get going; I have to get to class. I'll call you when I'm done," said Han Xuewei, her face flushed from Lin Yi's teasing as she quickly walked into her classroom.
Lin Yi flashed a smile at the students inside before turning to leave.
All these students were his informants; he still needed them to keep an eye on Teacher Mo for him.
After leaving the school, Lin Yi headed to the plot of land he had recently acquired.
The land was vast, and Lin Yi planned to build his own pharmaceutical factory there, which would also serve as his future company.
No sooner had the idea struck him than Lin Yi began reaching out to manufacturers.
At that moment, the system issued a new task.
"Please address the matter of Han Xuemei swiftly; do not prolong it. Ultimately expel Han Xuemei from the house, with a random pill as the reward."

chapters.title: Chapter 257 Director Zhao
chapters.content:
It seems the system also disapproves of that woman's approach, huh?
Indeed, if that woman isn't dealt with soon, Lin Yi feared more complications might arise over time.
"Old Hei, do me a favor."
Lin Yi called a friend and asked him to investigate everything about Han Xuemei and then compile a report to be sent to his email.
Old Hei didn't expect that Lin Yi's first call to him would be about a woman?
Had this woman offended him?
It seemed quite serious. Otherwise, Lin Yi wouldn't have resorted to using him.
"Boss, are you sure you want to use such a precious opportunity to investigate a woman? I promised to help you three times before, and this counts as one."
"It's fine, if I use it once, then I use it once. I want to deal with this woman as soon as possible; otherwise, she will keep my wife awake at night."
Old Hei really regretted why he had to say more and suffer this dose of a dog's breakfast.
The tongue-tied Old Hei, scolded by Lin Yi, quickly hung up the phone and then went to take care of business.
After returning to the hotel, Han Xuemei was still extremely unwilling to let things go.
She also called the director she had always been in contact with, hoping he could help her eliminate Lin Yi.
"Hello, is this Director Zhao?"
"Xue Mei, what's the matter? Have you decided on the thing I talked to you about before?"
After receiving Han Xuemei's call, Director Zhao didn't show any surprise; he knew Han Xuemei wouldn't be able to hold back.
How could someone with Han Xuemei's personality be content with being second best?
"Yes, Director Zhao, I've made up my mind. You've been so good to me, and I can't be ungrateful, but I have a condition."
The thought of talking on the phone with a big-bellied old man made Han Xuemei feel sick.
But she had no choice; apart from Director Zhao, there was no one else who could help her now.
She couldn't miss out on such a good opportunity.
"Xue Mei, just tell me, how could I possibly say no? As long as you are willing to be with me, whatever you say, I'll grant it."
Director Zhao was overjoyed, his long-pursued goddess had finally agreed.
As for her condition, he felt it would probably be buying her handbags or branded goods.
What else could it be? That's just how women are.
"I hope Director Zhao can help me eliminate someone. Of course, by 'eliminate,' I mean I hope Director Zhao can suppress him a bit, I heard he recently has a pharmaceutical factory."
Director Zhao was from the pharmaceutical industry, so it should be very easy to sanction Lin Yi. Trading her charm wasn't completely out of the question.
Lin Yi had humiliated her, and he had made her lose face in public. She would not let Lin Yi have a comfortable life!
"So that's it? That's easy for me. Xue Mei, just wait for my good news. Pack your things in the meantime. If possible, I hope you can move into the villa I bought for you."
Director Zhao's calculation was crafty. He'd satisfy Xue Mei's request first.
Then, when the goddess moved into the villa he bought, he could visit anytime he wanted. Discover hidden tales at empire
"I have my own place. If Director Zhao needs me to accompany him to events, or wants to go shopping and have fun, you can find me. I'll be there whenever I'm called."
The woman clenched her fists. Didn't she realize what lecherous plot this old man was devising?
She absolutely could not agree to this man's demands; otherwise, she would put herself at a disadvantage.
Director Zhao snorted coldly, thinking that Han Xuemei was as easy to deceive as other young women.
He hadn't expected this wretched girl to be so scheming. Fine, he would indulge her for now.
After he took care of that person, he guessed she would agree to any demand he made.
"Oh, then I'll let you have your way, but I hope that whenever I want to see you, you can come right away. Afterwards, just send that person's information to my phone. I'm busy with some other stuff right now, so I'll hang up first."
Director Zhao said a few more words, then ended the call.
Han Xuemei didn't hesitate to send Lin Yi's information over, which also included Han Xuewei's details.
She told Director Zhao that Han Xuewei was an exceptionally beautiful woman.
If he could get rid of Lin Yi, she was sure that Han Xuewei would eventually become part of his collection as well.
Director Zhao was someone who extremely enjoyed collecting beautiful women; he had already had more than a hundred beauties under his wing, each one with impressive looks.
But none could last more than two weeks in his clutches.
The main reason was that Director Zhao simply loved to move on to new toys; Han Xuemei was just his most recent target.
Han Xuemei had to use his current fondness for her to climb the ranks. Otherwise, once he lost interest in her, she would become useless.
Director Zhao glanced at the information Han Xuemei sent him, licked his lips, and another beauty was on the hook.
But for now, his top priority was to deal with Lin Yi— Lin Yi's name had come up a few times recently.
Yet, he was just a young man who had recently made a bit of a name for himself.
"Go and find out everything about this guy for me. The moment you get any information, send it to me. Also, I want to know what he's been up to recently, what projects he's been researching—send me everything."
Since his beauty wanted to target that man, he had to do a good job, satisfy her thoroughly, so she would willingly submit to him.
After his subordinate left, they immediately began to investigate.
Lin Yi also received a message that someone was investigating him. Which of his enemies could it be?
"It's Director Zhao from Huaxun Pharmaceuticals."
"I don't recall offending that guy, why would he suddenly start investigating me?"
Lin Yi truly didn't understand what he had done to offend him, or whether his actions had somehow affected the man's interests.
Impossible, Lin Yi had just started out and had begun to gain some reputation; it was unlikely that he had already interfered with his interests.
Moreover, he hadn't even started selling officially.
"If he's just looking into my information, don't bother with him. But if he takes any other action, make sure to inform me immediately."
People like him, if left unchecked, would definitely cause a catastrophe later on.
Lin Yi was a rather cautious individual; he wouldn't let these people target him while he remained in a vulnerable position.
"Yes!"
Lin Yi arrived at the plot of land he had bought. Honestly, the land was vast, but the location was rather poor, situated in a remote area.
After taking a few photos, Lin Yi left—he needed to reach out and see if anyone was willing to help him build a factory there.
On his way back, Lin Yi suddenly heard a commotion.
"Help!"

chapters.title: Chapter 258 Goodwill Rescue
chapters.content:
It seemed to be a woman's voice; what was she shouting? Lin Yi hesitated, should he help or not?
He wasn't the type to meddle in others' affairs, but he couldn't just stand by and watch someone possibly in grave danger, could he?
Finally, driven by his conscience, Lin Yi started driving toward the source of the voice.
After covering several hundred meters, Lin Yi finally saw a woman.
She sat on the ground, holding her head and weeping bitterly, with a child beside her.
"Hello, is there anything I can help you with?"
The woman clearly seemed desperate, her voice somewhat weak and breathless.
However, when she heard Lin Yi's voice, she suddenly looked up, her tear-streaked face tugging at his heartstrings.
"Could you please take us to the hospital? Something's wrong with my child; he suddenly passed out and won't wake up, and the situation is really critical. No one is willing to help us; they all think we're scammers. If you just take us to the hospital, I will definitely give you a high reward!"
After understanding the situation, Lin Yi nodded his head and opened the car door to let them in.
The woman picked up her child and got into the back seat, while Lin Yi stepped on the gas, rushing to the hospital as fast as possible.
Luckily, because they arrived in time, the child was not in grave danger; it was due to an illness that had caused the unconsciousness.
The child was indeed fortunate; being able to hail a car in that place and get to the hospital was certainly not easy.
The doctor glanced at Lin Yi and the woman, unsure of their relationship.
"Who is the child's parent? Please come here to sign the form. The child is in a critical condition, but an emergency operation can be performed since you arrived in time; there should be no serious issue."
The woman hurried over to sign, but then she realized that she had left in such a hurry that she forgot her wallet.
She approached Lin Yi with an embarrassed air, her hesitation clueing him in to what she was implying.
"I have a card here with a hundred thousand yuan on it; you can use it for now. If it's not enough, let me know."
Lin Yi took out the card and handed it to the woman, who repeatedly thanked him and told him her name.
"I can't thank you enough, Sir! I don't know how to repay you. My name is Wang Guixiang. I hope you can give me your contact information so that I can return the money to you once the surgery is done."
The woman was so pretty and seemed fashionable; it was unexpected that she would have such a name.
Lin Yi waved his hand, saying it really wasn't necessary, as it was just a simple gesture, not deserving any fuss.
"Focus on your child's treatment. I have to leave now due to other matters. As for contact information, if destiny wills it, we shall meet again. Then you can return the money to me."
Without waiting for Wang Guixiang to respond, Lin Yi left the hospital.
Watching Lin Yi's retreating figure, Wang Guixiang silently vowed to find him and repay the money.
She had already called that good-for-nothing husband of hers; why hadn't he shown up yet? Why couldn't she find one passerby who was helpful?
Being here, Wang Guixiang entertained the thought of getting a divorce.
Her own husband, though impressive and a big boss, was just too irresponsible towards the family.
So Wang Guixiang really didn't plan to continue living with him.
She had already told him—their child was sick, very, very seriously sick, yet he wouldn't even show his face.
But now was not the time to think about these things. Wang Guixiang, holding her bank card, hurried to deposit the money, then rushed to wait outside the operating room.
Director Zhao hadn't expected his wife to call him so many times, and when he saw that his precious son was in trouble, he immediately rushed to the hospital.
It was his fault; he was having too much fun with his mistresses earlier and hadn't noticed his phone.
"How is the child? Why are you still sitting here? Have you paid the money yet? What exactly is going on with the child? Tell me clearly!"
When Director Zhao arrived at the hospital, his first reaction, upon seeing his wife, wasn't to care for her but to focus all his attention on the child.
His wife was already so exhausted, yet all he could do was blame her.
"You even have the nerve to show up here? How many calls and texts did I send you, why couldn't you return just one? Do you know that if it wasn't for a kind person willing to give me a ride to the hospital, our child might be gone by now!"
Wang Guixiang didn't want to make a scene in the hospital with this man, so she spoke relatively calmly.
Director Zhao suppressed the anger boiling inside him; right now, the child was more important. He didn't want to argue with this woman.
"Wasn't it because the company was so busy that I didn't get your calls? Alright, alright, don't be angry. Tell me first, how is the child? The most urgent thing is to cure the child's illness."
"They said it's a congenital disease, nothing serious as long as he undergoes surgery. I've already paid the fee, but the money was given by that kind person. He didn't leave his phone number when he left, so I don't know where to find him to repay the money."
Wang Guixiang told her husband about the child's condition and then started talking about the kind person.
But her husband didn't care about the kind person.
Since that person didn't leave any contact information, they didn't need to repay the money. The kind person didn't expect it back; why waste the one hundred thousand yuan?
"He didn't leave a phone number for us, which means he doesn't want us to find him. Don't bother with that effort. You go back home; I'll stay here and look after the child."
In fact, Director Zhao had already contemplated divorcing his wife, but the children were still young.
If they divorced, the children would certainly be awarded to the mother, which Director Zhao didn't want to see happen.
So he definitely had to find a way to make the children have a bad relationship with their mother and then take action through the children.
As long as the children say they want to be with their father, he could surely win the lawsuit.
"I'm not going back. I want to stay here. Who knows when you might run off? If the child wakes up and sees no family around, who knows how heartbroken he might be."
Wang Guixiang insisted on staying, and Director Zhao didn't say anything else. Experience tales with empire
Right now, all he could think about were his little beauties; he needed to sort out Lin Yi as soon as possible.
After Lin Yi returned home, he found both children awake, with Da Bao and Er Bao bouncing around energetically.

chapters.title: Chapter 259 Scandal
chapters.content:
After playing with the two little babies for a while, Lin Yi was also a bit tired and went back to the room to take a nap.
But then, a flurry of phone calls bombarded him, forcing Lin Yi to open his eyes again and answer them.
"Boss, what's the deal with those messages online? People are saying a woman, holding a child, got into your car, and the two of you were acting intimately!"
As soon as Lin Yi heard this, he instantly lost all sleepiness. Where did this rumor come from?
When had he been intimate with that woman? He had simply been lending a hand; did it have to be twisted into something like this?
Lin Yi immediately felt a headache coming on. These reporters refused to report the truth.
"That woman was just a lady I helped on the side of the road. She's already married. Her child had an issue, she couldn't hail a cab, so I kindly let her into my car and took her to the hospital. After that, the two of us had no further contact."
Lin Yi explained the situation to his subordinate, then instructed him to immediately release a statement clarifying that he had no relationship with that woman.
Now, Lin Yi was more worried about Han Xuewei. What would she think if she saw it?
He had told her he had something to take care of, yet turned around and let another woman into his car.
After understanding the situation, the subordinate began working on how to issue the statement.
Han Xuewei had just finished her class when she received Lin Yi's call. She had just turned on her phone.
She was about to answer when suddenly a news alert popped up about Lin Yi.
After reading it, Han Xue became very upset—the photos were real.
Hadn't Lin Yi told her he had things to do? Could it have been this he was busy with?
And what was the deal with the child? It couldn't be Lin Yi's illegitimate son, could it?
Han Xue quickly concocted an entire drama in her head.
"Hello!"
As the call connected, Han Xue's tone was not very pleasant. Lin Yi guessed that she must have heard about the incident.
"Wife, listen to me explain about the news—it's all made up by the reporters. I have nothing to do with that woman. I was just walking back after inspecting the site I had just visited, and I heard someone calling for help, so I went over. She's married, and her child was sick but she couldn't find a cab, so I let her into my car and took her to the hospital.
Wife, please don't be mad or misunderstand me, okay?"
Lin Yi rushed through everything he wanted to say, not wanting to upset his wife.
Han Xue was initially very angry, but after listening to Lin Yi's explanation, she couldn't help but laugh. Was he really that nervous?
It was just a misunderstanding, after all, and it was cleared up now.
She wasn't the unreasonable type; she wouldn't not trust Lin Yi.
"Ahem! Since that's the case, I'll let it slide this one time, but absolutely no next time. Got it? I really hate those journalists making things up, and all the students are watching. They've seen you before, and if they find out, I don't know what they'll make up about me at school."
Perhaps these students just lived too boring of lives so they loved to gossip.
If those students saw such news, she might become the focus of the school for a while.
Relieved that Han Xue wasn't angry, Lin Yi immediately drove to pick her up and take her home.
The pair were lovey-dovey on the way back, and once home, they took a bath together.
Although Han Xue was very embarrassed, Lin Yi insisted, and with a mix of reluctance and compliance, she agreed.
After the bath, Han Xuewei's entire face was flushed, and Lin Yi looked so refreshed, it was obvious they had just been intimate.
"From now on, you're not allowed to shower with me anymore, got it? If you dare to shower with me again, watch out, I won't let you into bed!"
It was just a shower, but because Lin Yi made a mess, it ended up taking a full two hours!
What did two hours mean? Han Xuewei felt like she was about to be soaked soft.
"I'll listen to my wife."
When admitting mistakes, men always act fast, but whether they can actually keep to it, that's for the future to decide, Lin Yi couldn't care less at the moment.
Thanks to Lin Yi's clarification, the situation online had been suppressed, no longer making waves.
The woman in the hospital also saw the message. Find your next read on empire
She thought she could negatively impact Lin Yi, but seeing that there were no real effects, she felt relieved.
Director Zhao, while waiting for his child to come out of the operating room, browsed his phone and saw the message.
Only then did he realize that his wife knew Lin Yi.
"What's this I'm seeing online? You know that man; why did you get into his car?"
Director Zhao had his own flings, yet he was always controlling his wife.
Even though the situation was already clarified online, he just had to bring it up again.
"Didn't you see the message online? I just took a ride in his car to the hospital because you wouldn't answer my calls."
Wang Guixiang rolled her eyes dramatically, finding it increasingly difficult to communicate with this man.
Why couldn't he just reflect on his own issues?
If it wasn't because of him, how could such rumors about her even begin?
Director Zhao's first concern was whether it affected his and the company's reputation; he didn't worry about Wang Guixiang herself at all.
"Hmph, I advise you to behave yourself. Since you're my wife, just stay at home and take care of the child. Don't even think about flirting around and damaging my reputation or the company's!"
Seeing his wife, who had lost her figure, Director Zhao increasingly found the women outside more attractive.
Whenever there was an event, Director Zhao would bring out his mistresses instead, never wanting to take his own wife.
Although she was once a great beauty, childbirth had changed her body.
And because she had no time to manage her figure due to childcare, she became less and less appealing.
She wasn't as good as the women he had on the side.
Director Zhao sent a message to one of his subordinates, instructing him to arrange a meeting with Lin Yi when convenient.
Lin Yi's company was just a small one at the moment; he planned to find an opportunity to take it over.
This would not only humiliate Lin Yi but also satisfy that beauty's demand.
Just thinking about the beauty becoming his after he fulfilled this condition filled him with immense joy.

chapters.title: Chapter 260 Humiliation
chapters.content:
After soothing Han Xuewei, Lin Yi received a text message from one of his subordinates.
The message roughly indicated that the CEO of a listed company wanted to meet with Lin Yi to discuss an acquisition.
Lin Yi was puzzled at that moment.
His pharmaceutical plant had just started to develop, and now someone already wanted to acquire it; why couldn't they first consider whether Lin Yi was willing?
Who on earth was so interesting? It seemed impossible for Lin Yi to agree to the terms of the acquisition.
Alright, but suddenly Lin Yi wanted to meet this person. Who was so brainless? And who had such audacity and confidence?
"Just agree to the meeting on my behalf, and check out the other party's information. If there's nothing problematic, I can meet with him tomorrow."
Upon receiving the boss's message, the secretary was dumbfounded on the spot. What did the boss mean?
The boss was actually going to meet with him. The boss wouldn't just hand over the company he had only just started, would he?
No way, having finally found such a good boss, if they were to part now, the subordinates would surely cry themselves to death!
After all, no one treated their staff like Lin Yi did.
But he was just an employee and had no way to interfere with the boss's decision.
So after investigating for Lin Yi, the secretary didn't speak any further. They would just have to leave everything to fate.
They believed Lin Yi was no fool and wouldn't easily give away his hard work.
The next day, Lin Yi arrived at Huaxun Pharmaceuticals as agreed.
"Congratulations, Host, on receiving a new task. Please slap Director Zhao's face to show him how treacherous the world can be. Reward: one Youth Rejuvenation Pill."
He had just arrived when the system immediately issued a new task. It really kept up with the times!
Lin Yi was about to head upstairs when the receptionist stopped him. The receptionist was a lady dressed in a standard work uniform.
However, she looked like someone not to be messed with.
"Hello sir, we don't allow just anyone in here. Do you have an appointment or a work pass?"
"I'm here to see your Director Zhao. He should have told you about me."
"Many people wish to see our Director Zhao every day. He didn't inform us of any meeting with you today. Are you impersonating someone else, or are you trying to sneak in?"
Upon hearing Lin Yi's purpose, the receptionist immediately showed a disdainful expression. She had seen too many like Lin Yi.
They just wanted to sneak in and then desperately sell themselves to Director Zhao.
In fact, this was intentional by Director Zhao.
He wanted to humiliate Lin Yi and then use the surveillance to record it all, sending the footage to the goddess to please her.
"I think you shouldn't judge others based on your feelings alone and then speak out those thoughts. You're just a receptionist. Even if I did want to sneak in, you should at least show the bare minimum of respect—that's a matter of professional ethics."
This receptionist could deny him, but she definitely shouldn't have uttered such insulting words.
Lin Yi could imagine what kind of company it was.
If their receptionists acted like this, their boss couldn't be much better.
A good boss will educate their staff to be cautious in their words and actions.
"It's not your place to lecture me! If you don't leave now, I'm going to call security. I deal with too many people like you every day, and I really don't have the patience to waste time here with you."
The receptionist called security, and the guards rushed in immediately.
After the receptionist explained the situation, the guards attempted to grab Lin Yi and drag him outside.
But before the two guards could get close to Lin Yi, he floored them.
Now the receptionist began to panic; she thought Lin Yi was like all the others before.
The receptionist still forced herself to remain calm, though. This was a society governed by law, and Lin Yi couldn't just attack her at will. Explore more at empire
"I'm warning you, don't you try anything foolish! Otherwise, I'll call the police. What do you want anyway? Director Zhao indeed did not mention that anyone was coming today. If you have business, you can call Director Zhao instead of giving me, a mere receptionist, a hard time."
The receptionist was already scared, her tone no longer as firm as before, and even offered a solution.
Lin Yi didn't have Director Zhao's number; it had always been his subordinates who made contact.
But they had confirmed the meeting time via text message, which meant that this Director Zhao was doing it on purpose.
No sooner had he arrived than Director Zhao gave him a cold welcome—it was somewhat interesting.
"I don't want to make things difficult for just a receptionist, but your tone really made me uncomfortable. I know you must have treated many people this way, and some did not have good intentions, but you should at least respect everyone and not generalize."
After speaking, Lin Yi immediately had his subordinates contact Director Zhao's office, and they quickly got through.
Director Zhao's secretary called the receptionist, and then they finally let him through.
The receptionist didn't expect this man was actually here to see Director Zhao. Why didn't Director Zhao tell her in the first place?
It was an embarrassing situation, and it seemed she might have also offended someone important.
After all, not many people could see Director Zhao; those who came here generally discussed cooperation with him.
After going upstairs, Lin Yi looked displeased.
What kind of person was this Director Zhao? But he was sure he wouldn't be easy to deal with.
Before reaching Director Zhao's office, his secretary came over, even holding disinfectant tools, which made Lin Yi even more uncomfortable.
What was wrong with these people?
They called him over but treated him with this attitude.
This time, Lin Yi didn't give face and just pushed the door open and walked in. Director Zhao was inside, seated with his legs crossed, waiting for Lin Yi to enter.
When he saw Lin Yi, he didn't even stand up, but continued sitting and talking with Lin Yi.
"You must be Lin Yi, right? Young man, I've always wanted to meet you. You should understand what I mean, right?"
Director Zhao smiled and then gestured for Lin Yi to sit on the nearby sofa. Lin Yi, however, didn't sit down but slowly approached Director Zhao.
He was just a young punk, but Director Zhao felt a pressure emanating from Lin Yi.
"Director Zhao, what do you mean? I really don't understand. Starting from not informing the receptionist, making her block me at the door, to now humiliating me like this, Director Zhao, you really play your cards well!"

chapters.title: Chapter 261 Provocation of Language
chapters.content:
Lin Yi's tone inexplicably gave off an intimidating vibe, making Director Zhao swallow hard.
How could he let himself be frightened by a mere whippersnapper?
"Lin Yi, don't forget whose company you are in right now. You'd better watch how you speak to me, or you'll regret it!"
Director Zhao slammed his hand on the table, attempting to conceal his panic.
Lin Yi had seen through him long ago; he was nothing more than a coward without guts.
He was just a young guy, and also the boss of a no-name company.
What about Director Zhao? He was the head of a listed company and the only one in this industry! And yet he was allowing himself to be strutted before by Lin Yi?
"What? Do you want to send your security guards to teach me a lesson? They're no match for me. I came here today just to see what kind of person you are, someone who can be so senseless."
This time Lin Yi had come with no intention of showing any courtesy.
Anyone capable of uttering such words must be no good at all.
Lin Yi gave him a glare and then sat on the sofa, leisurely crossing his legs. Explore new worlds at empire
Director Zhao adjusted his tie, trying to hide his discomposure.
How could he not stand tall in front of a young upstart, how could this be? Absolutely unacceptable, he must put this young man in his place!
"I know youngsters like you surely have youthful enthusiasm, but I hope you'll show some restraint on someone else's turf. Let me tell you, aside from security, I actually have other formidable people here. If you act recklessly again, be careful I won't let you leave today."
Is this how these company owners threaten people nowadays?
Lin Yi let out a cold laugh and gave Director Zhao a casual glance.
Director Zhao instantly shut his mouth at Lin Yi's look.
Where did this kid come from? He just gives off such an unpleasant feeling.
"Director Zhao, don't be too confident in your words. You wanted to see me today because you were thinking about discussing a partnership, right? Perhaps considering acquiring my company? Do you know how many hundreds of millions my company's market value is? And you dare to say such things."
Lin Yi didn't continue to argue with Director Zhao but instead talked reason with him. He was determined to make this man back off.
Although uncertain why this old guy had taken an interest in him, this was also an opportunity to make a name for himself.
If he could get Director Zhao to spread word of this meeting, perhaps more of these overconfident people would come along.
Lin Yi wasn't busy at all, and he could also complete more tasks and obtain some superior Elixirs.
"Young man, I advise you not to be too arrogant. Even if your company is worth many billions, what of it? Do you believe I can make sure it never sees the market? You should know who controls the market now. If you want a slice of the pie here, you'd better do as I say, and not go against my orders."
Now in his element, Director Zhao smiled, thinking he must have convinced Lin Yi to back off by now, right?
After all, his company plays an immensely important role throughout the whole city.
No other pharmaceutical factory is more famous than his.
"Your talk is way too arbitrary. Don't you have any self-awareness? As soon as my product is developed, you won't be able to monopolize the market anymore, and I will replace you."
Lin Yi noticed not even a cup of tea was offered to him in front of Director Zhao. So much for hospitality.
He stood up and poured a cup for himself.
Director Zhao was infuriated by Lin Yi's words and actions.
This youngster couldn't possibly be treating his office as if it were his own? Coming and going so freely, showing no respect for him at all!
"Oh, I'm quite curious about the medication that your company can develop. Our elixir sells incredibly well across the entire continent. It's precisely because of that elixir that I have become a monopolist. What about you? What can you bring to the table that compares to mine?"
After mentioning his trademark product, Director Zhao wore a smug look on his face.
Lin Yi should be at a loss for words now, right? His elixir, which Lin Yi must have heard of, bolstered Director Zhao's confidence—it was pure serendipity that he stumbled upon its formula, which elevated him to his current status.
No one could replace him!
His elixir, when added to any other medicine, would work wonders, rightfully earning its title as the Elixir.
"Your medicine is indeed impressive, but it's outdated. I have a newer formula now. Its effects are similar to yours; it produces miraculous results when combined with other medicines. Tell me, if I sell it for even cheaper, who do you think they will choose?"
After hearing Lin Yi's words, Director Zhao's eyes widened.
How could that be possible? The formula was his, and his alone! How could Lin Yi claim to have a newer formula?
Could that kind of thing even be updated? Lin Yi wasn't just bluffing, was he?
"Don't think you can bluff me. I'm not going to fall for it. The Elixir recipe is right here with me and there's absolutely no other copy. You say you've got a newer version of the Elixir, how could that be? Are you trying to deceive me? I tell you, I won't be fooled!"
No wonder Han Xuemei had sought him out to deal with Lin Yi; this young man was indeed troublesome to handle.
If it had been any other young person, they would probably have been broken down by Director Zhao's mere words by now.
Not only had Lin Yi not cracked, but he had also come back strong and left him speechless.
Director Zhao was actually starting to worry now, seeing Lin Yi's confidence. It seemed as though Lin Yi really did have a more advanced formula.
But Director Zhao still consoled himself; it just couldn't be possible.
"I didn't intend to be hostile with you, young man. You don't have to be so adversarial with me. This morning's incident was all a misunderstanding. Since you claim to have a newer formula, why don't you bring it out? I'll also bring out my formula, and we can compare the two to see whose is superior."
Director Zhao's eyes shifted, and he chuckled.
He slowly stood up and moved closer to Lin Yi, his demeanor now vastly different.
Lin Yi could almost guess what Director Zhao had in mind.
He wanted Lin Yi to reveal his formula and then steal it.
This way, he could possess the new Elixir, while Lin Yi's plans would be nipped in the bud.
"Director Zhao, you really don't think I'm like those other young people, do you? Your little tricks are so transparent to me. Don't do that, it's uninteresting."

chapters.title: Chapter 262 New Special Effect Drug
chapters.content:
After his true nature was revealed, Director Zhao's face turned beet red.
This man really couldn't manage a word of small talk, why did he have to provoke such a man?
He was no longer worried about whether he could win over his goddess, but about whether what Lin Yi said was true or false.
If Lin Yi truly had a medicine better than his own special remedy, then once it hit the market his company would be finished!
Lin Yi would replace his company and become the new leader in the pharmaceutical industry.
Thinking of this, Director Zhao felt uncomfortable all over. He wanted to talk to Lin Yi again, but Lin Yi suddenly stood up.
"I know you must have heard something from behind the scenes about our company. I hope you can tell that person not to waste their effort anymore. They have nowhere to run now, and even with help, it won't work."
Throughout his exchange with Director Zhao, Lin Yi had already learned something, and he had even looked into Director Zhao's past.
Director Zhao was a man who greatly appreciated beautiful women, and Han Xuemei just happened to be a beautiful woman.
Although Lin Yi was not interested, other men treated her like a treasure.
Given the intimate connection between Director Zhao and Han Xuemei previously, Lin Yi guessed that Director Zhao's sudden targeting of him was probably due to Han Xuemei.
"How would you know that? Did you investigate me? Lin Yi, just who are you? How come I've never heard of someone like you around here before?"
Director Zhao was completely dumbfounded. What kind of man had he provoked?
Not only had he failed to intimidate Lin Yi today, but he had also invested his own assets in the process.
Moreover, Director Zhao even felt that he might not be a match for Lin Yi.
"You don't need to concern yourself with that. Did you not investigate me before asking me to come? Alright, let's be clear, I won't do anything to you, okay? And as of now, I haven't quickly developed my special remedy yet. If you have other methods or formulas, you might want to do some more research, maybe then you will be able to compete with me."
The slap to his face was resoundingly clear.
Director Zhao had thought that by calling Lin Yi over today he could display his authority and deflate Lin Yi's arrogance.
But he never expected to be shown up by Lin Yi instead.
After finishing, Lin Yi left the place.
He couldn't stay another second in such a shabby location.
He didn't know what Han Xuemei was thinking, choosing such an old man to deal with him.
She couldn't truly believe that because of that special remedy, Director Zhao had a bit of fame in the world.
And thus would be able to handle Lin Yi. Han Xuemei was simply too naïve.
As long as he had the world's top research team and a system that could provide him with all kinds of medicine at any time, Your next read is at empire
Han Xuemei had no chance of winning, and none could surpass Lin Yi!
Lin Yi arrived downstairs, and the woman at the reception immediately walked up to him to apologize.
It was her negligence for not confirming Lin Yi's identity, causing him to wait outside for a long time.
Lin Yi did not even spare her a glance as he strode away.
The receptionist was very disheartened; she was determined to find a way to get that man's information, for he looked handsome and wealthy.
And being able to contact Director Zhao directly meant he must be a person of wealth or noble status.
But how could she obtain Lin Yi's contact information? It was undoubtedly like finding a needle in a haystack, for she knew nobody from the upper echelons of society.
The receptionist now deeply regretted her actions, wondering why she had done something so foolish.
Had she been very nice to Lin Yi from the start, she might have been able to get to know him.
Instead, she had humiliated him, only to end up looking foolish herself.
No sooner had Lin Yi stepped out of the Huaye Pharmaceutical Factory than the system immediately popped up a notification.
"Congratulations to the host for completing the low-level mission, rewarded with one Youth-Preserving Pill."
Lin Yi had received the mission reward, which was a Youth-Preserving Pill for a low-level mission.
So, it wasn't as impressive as those with special effects or the more potent elixirs.
However, it was still quite remarkable, especially in terms of its miraculous effects on beauty.
If he could develop this elixir.
Lin Yi believed that their clientele would not be limited to just patients in the future, but could also potentially appeal to a broad female demographic.
They were always anxious about their appearance, and this Youth-Preserving Pill could significantly alleviate their concerns.
The most pressing matter now was to take this elixir to Zhou Kongshan for a thorough examination.
Before Lin Yi could contact Zhou Kongshan, he received a call from Han Xuewei.
"Where are you right now?"
"I just went to someone else's company to discuss some business, and I've just left. I'm about to go to the factory. What's the matter, wife?"
Han Xuewei rarely initiated calls to Lin Yi, and wasn't it her working hours now? What exactly had happened?
"My dad has been hospitalized. Can you come to the hospital?"
After hesitating for a moment, Han Xuewei still spoke up.
She really didn't want to bother Lin Yi, but Dad Han insisted on seeing Lin Yi.
Lin Yi was also very surprised to hear that Dad Han had an issue.
Hadn't he already replaced Dad Han's medication? How could he possibly have fallen ill and been hospitalized?
"Don't worry for now. Just give me the address of the hospital. I'll be there right away. Wait for me, and don't do anything rash or worry too much. Once I get there, I'll take care of everything."
While comforting Han Xuewei, Lin Yi asked her to send him the address of the hospital. Han Xuewei quietly acknowledged.
She then quickly sent Lin Yi the address, and he hurried to the hospital as fast as he could.
He had never imagined that Dad Han would be foolish enough to swap back the medication he had switched out for him.
He had not expected his dearly regarded "daughter" would turn out this way.
"Dad, I don't know what to say to you. I know ever since our cousin came to our house, you've treated her as your own daughter, but how could you indulge her like this? She's after your life, and her intentions have never been pure. Hasn't Lin Yi already told you that?"
As Lin Yi stood by Han Xuewei's side, he really couldn't comprehend the reasons Dad Han gave.
A bitter smile appeared on Dad Han's face.
He had never imagined that Han Xuemei, who had been kind-hearted as a child, would do something like this.
"After all, she is your cousin, and now she is staying in our home. I've come to regard her as my own daughter, treating her as my very own."

chapters.title: Chapter 263 Hospitalization
chapters.content:
Dad Han's heart was also breaking.
He thought he had entrusted his trust to someone, only to find that they had betrayed it—and they even wanted his life.
Han Xuemei no longer resembled the little girl he remembered; she had changed completely, and it was terrifying.
Such a young woman harbored such heavy intentions and even schemed for wealth and murder; she was truly without fault.
"Dad, if you continue like this, no one will be able to help you. Regarding my cousin's affairs, Lin Yi said he would help us resolve them, so there's no need for you to worry anymore. Given your condition, I doubt you're able to go back, so just focus on recuperating in the hospital. Don't meddle in future matters anymore, and don't disrupt Lin Yi's judgment," she said.
It seemed to be the first time Lin Yi had seen Han Xuewei so resolute, exuding an air of a master strategist.
Lin Yi felt as if Han Xuewei had grown up a bit.
As the two were discussing, Han Xuemei suddenly burst in, wearing a look of feigned concern on her face.
She seemed very worried as she called for Dad, but in reality, she was not; she was only concerned about whether the old man was dead.
"Dad Han, what on earth happened to you? I rushed over as soon as I got the message, I'm so sorry, I was delayed because of the traffic jam, Brother Lin Yi, please tell me, what happened to Dad?"
At this moment, Han Xuemei completely ignored Han Xuewei beside her, focusing all her attention on Lin Yi.
Shouldn't she be most concerned about Dad Han at this time?
Shouldn't she be tending to Dad Han's bedside, offering comfort? Why had she run to Lin Yi's side instead?
"Han Xuemei, I remember making myself very clear before. If you continue like this, I really can't guarantee how much longer I can tolerate you, and right now, the person you should be most concerned about ought to be Dad Han," Lin Yi said coldly as he pushed Han Xuemei away and walked to Han Xuewei's side.
Han Xuemei's face darkened instantly, but she quickly recovered.
With teary eyes, she walked to Dad Han's bed, but to her surprise, Dad Han did not even spare her a glance.
Although Han Xuemei was taken aback, she knew the show must go on.
"I know, Dad Han, are you upset with me because I didn't arrive in time? It was really because of the traffic that I got here late. I closed the hotel immediately after receiving the message and rushed back. Dad Han, I'm really sorry and I apologize. Please let me take care of you at the hospital for the next while, alright?"
Han Xuemei forced a strong smile, as if now she was the one who had been bullied all along.
Dad Han continued not to utter a word, leaving Han Xuemei extremely embarrassed.
She thought to herself.
Why isn't the old man saying anything?
Usually, as soon as she acted coquettishly, the old man would immediately yield.
Why isn't he responding now? Could it be that the old man has discovered her true nature?
That won't do, her plan was not yet complete.
Moreover, the poison was a slow-acting one. If he allowed the old man to recover now, how would he carry out his subsequent plans?
"Dad Han, can you say a few words to me, please? You're really scaring me. You won't ignore me forever, will you? Are you angry with me? What if I apologize? I'll make your favorite dishes for you.
Apart from you, I have no other family left in this world!"
As she spoke, Han Xuemei started to cry, and she played the sympathy card as well.
Han Xuewei knew that Dad Han couldn't stand to see Han Xuemei cry in front of him; he always felt he should take good care of her.
"Alright, stop crying. I'm not blaming you. I was just thinking about what to say. My body is quite weak, so I'd prefer not to speak much. If you want to take care of me during this time, then stay here. Don't trouble others.
The hotel can be left to Lin Yi and Han Xuewei for now. They are your sister and brother-in-law, so you can rest assured."
Dad Han, in just a few words, had made Han Xuemei relinquish her managerial authority, and her face turned ugly on the spot.
What is this old man thinking?
How could he actually let her hand over the managerial rights? How could this be acceptable?
She was only making a perfunctory gesture, yet the old man truly agreed to it.
"It's not that I don't want to hand over the management, but my sister and brother-in-law have their own affairs to attend to. If they manage the hotel, they might be too busy to cope. Dad Han, could it be that you don't have confidence in me? Or do you think I haven't been managing it well recently?"
Han Xuemei put on a troubled expression that almost convinced everyone she genuinely cared for the hotel.
In reality, she was just trying to carry out her plan. This woman had truly lost all sense of morality.
Right at that moment, Director Zhao called Han Xuemei.
Han Xuemei couldn't continue her act any longer, so she just gave a forced smile to everyone and slipped out to answer the call.
Lin Yi, being cautious, went outside and eavesdropped on Han Xuemei's phone conversation.
He always suspected there was a connection between Han Xuemei and Director Zhao.
"Baby, the man you asked me to deal with—who exactly is he? How does he have our company's upgraded formula for the special medicine? Could there have been a mistake? A person like him shouldn't have the chance to come into contact with you, right?"
Director Zhao now treated Han Xuemei as his plaything and didn't care about the way he talked to her. Continue your journey with empire
Han Xuemei was repulsed, but she had to suppress her feelings.
It seemed that Director Zhao had already met Lin Yi.
"Director Zhao, please don't be fooled by his words. He doesn't have any upgraded special medicine! That man is the biggest liar. He's just trying to scare you off. Whatever you do, don't fall for it. Moreover, Director Zhao, if you can't even fulfill my request or achieve it, I cannot be with you.
I've given so much; you can't let me walk away with nothing."
Han Xuemei's eyes were practically rolling back in her head.
This old man, not having helped her accomplish her task, was still longing for her body; how shameless could he get?
Without completing the task, Han Xuemei would never give herself to an old man.
She still harbored dreams of attaching herself to a wealthy man and marrying into a wealthy family.
"Xue Mei, why are you talking so heartlessly? I'm in the midst of figuring things out. And I didn't expect that man to be so hard to deal with either. Give me a few more days, will you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 264 Laying the Cards on the Table
chapters.content:
It's said that the more unattainable a man finds something, the more he desires it.
This is also why Han Xuemei can do whatever she wants in front of Director Zhao, and he never gets sick of her or treats her harshly.
"Then I'll give you one more chance, if you still can't take care of Lin Yi this time, there's nothing more I can do. After this, let's not see each other again."
After saying that, Han Xuemei immediately hung up the phone, and at that moment, she turned the corner and saw Lin Yi leaning against the wall.
This gave Han Xuemei quite a fright. How could Lin Yi be here?
How much did he hear? He couldn't have found out about her deal with Director Zhao!
"Lin Yi, what are you doing here? I thought you were in the ward with Sister, keeping Dad Han company."
Han Xuemei's attempt to appear calm seemed especially ridiculous to Lin Yi.
How can a woman be so calculating? And all of them wanted to help him.
Yet Han Xuemei wanted to harm them. What exactly was she thinking?
Lin Yi simply couldn't figure her out. A person like her really didn't need to be around them any longer.
"It was a bit stuffy inside, so I came out for some air. Are you done with your phone call? If you are, you'd better hurry back inside."
Seeing Lin Yi's demeanor, he probably didn't hear anything.
Otherwise, he would have questioned her by now. Han Xuemei finally left, feeling relieved.
After returning to the ward, Dad Han had already fallen asleep, and Han Xuewei no longer showed a friendly face toward Han Xuemei.
But Han Xuemei felt that she no longer needed to pretend, since the two of them had already shown their true colors.
Moreover, she had deliberately tried to seduce Lin Yi right in front of Han Xuewei.
"Sister, this should be the last time I call you that. How about we compete fairly from now on? It's not certain who Lin Yi will end up with. With the way you are, Lin Yi will soon get tired of you. You don't know how to tempt a man, unlike me. Don't worry, Sister, if I get Lin Yi in the end, I will definitely treat him well."
Han Xuemei stood shamelessly in front of Han Xuewei, infuriating her.
If it weren't for their father sleeping there, she would surely let him see just what kind of person his dearly spoiled daughter really was.
Why couldn't Dad Han see the truth?
Just for such a daughter, he had disrupted the harmony between him and his own daughters.
"Do you really think that with your behavior, Lin Yi would take a liking to you? If Lin Yi had liked you, then the person with him wouldn't have been me. Lin Yi never drags things out. Whoever he fancies, he commits to. I believe Lin Yi will never betray me. Don't even dream of getting involved between us."
Lin Yi heard the dialogue between Han Xuemei and Han Xuewei before he came in.
He had intended to eavesdrop for a while to see how Han Xuewei would handle the situation.
After all, there would certainly be various women in the future trying to seduce Lin Yi.
At this moment, Lin Yi hoped his wife would step in and help him deal with those women.
"Whether I should get involved between the two of you isn't for me to say. It's up to my brother-in-law. There's a saying, 'A wild flower has a scent that the garden flower lacks,' and I am that wild flower, sister. You're past your prime and have given Lin Yi two children. Have the two of you grown any closer because of them? Besides, after having children, your figure must have suffered, right?"
Every single word pierced deep into Han Xuewei's heart.
Han Xuewei was truly worried, wondering if Lin Yi would still like her if she lost her figure in the future.
Lin Yi was simply too outstanding. There would definitely be no shortage of women trying to seduce him, leaving Han Xuewei speechless from irritation caused by Han Xuemei.
Just then, Lin Yi walked in, approached Han Xuewei, and immediately pulled her into his embrace.
"Have you taken everything I said before as a joke? I told you not to meddle in the affairs between my wife and me. If you interfere again, do you remember what the consequences would be? I have warned you before, Han Xuemei, but it seems you keep forgetting my words over and over. If that's the case, there's no need for me to show you any mercy. From now on, you don't need to manage the hotel anymore.
I will take over completely, and if I find you involved in anything immoral again, watch out, for I might just kick you out of the house."
Lin Yi looked coldly at Han Xuemei, who was completely dumbfounded before him.
All she did was say a few words, did Lin Yi really need to react this way?
Moreover, the hotel wasn't Lin Yi's, so what right did he have to speak to her like this?
Without an order from Dad Han, what was Lin Yi talking about here?
Read exclusive chapters at empire
"You have no right to kick me out. I have invested so much effort into that hotel, and everyone has seen my hard work. Even if you want me to leave, the staff wouldn't want to see me go!"
Han Xuemei was hysterical, completely oblivious to the fact that Dad Han was still sleeping beside them.
Woken by the arguing voices, Dad Han slowly opened his eyes.
Seeing her father's exhausted expression filled Han Xuewei with immense heartache. She no longer paid attention to Han Xuemei and went straight to her father's bedside.
"Dad, it's our fault for speaking too loudly and disturbing you. Continue to rest, we'll talk outside. You don't have to worry about these things, Dad. We can handle them. You just focus on recuperating here."
Han Xuewei spoke as gently as possible to her father, tucked him in, and then pulled Lin Yi and Han Xuemei outside.
Meanwhile, in the room, Dad Han let out a deep sigh.
He blamed himself for causing his beloved daughter such trouble.
If he had seen through Han Xuemei's true colors from the beginning and stopped trusting her, none of this mess would have happened.
"Han Xuewei, stop being hypocritical here. You're just trying to look good in front of Dad Han. Now that I've burned bridges with you, I'm not afraid for you to know that I won't easily give up the hotel. Moreover, I hold the majority of the shares, and most of the staff are on my side. What right does Lin Yi have to fire me?"
Han Xuemei finally dropped the pretense, but a strange smile surfaced on Lin Yi's face.
He promptly unlocked his phone, scrolled to the photo gallery, found the pictures, and showed them to Han Xuemei.
"Take a good look at this. You might hold a significant number of shares, but I am the largest shareholder. So don't always be so confident; in fact, you are nothing."
Lin Yi's words left Han Xuemei frozen in place.

chapters.title: Chapter 265 Dedication, Use
chapters.content:
"How is this possible? I didn't receive any news—where did you get so many shares from? I should be the largest shareholder!"
She had been the largest shareholder before, so how had it become Lin Yi overnight?
She hadn't gotten any news either!
Could it be that those people had betrayed her? Han Xuemei had lost completely this time.
She had thought that with those shares, she would have a say in the hotel's board of directors, and then gradually take over Dad Han's industries.
Now, Han Xuemei leaned against the wall, looking completely distraught.
It was all over, her hard work had all been for nothing.
Was she really going to become someone's mistress?
No, her life couldn't just end like this! She definitely wouldn't let Lin Yi and Han Xuewei off the hook!
"Sister, considering our sisterhood, would you really have me end up on the streets? Although we're not blood siblings, we share the same bloodline, and Dad Han wouldn't agree to you treating me like this."
Han Xuemei's face changed in an instant.
She started crying pitifully, hoping to earn Han Xuewei's forgiveness, or at least a bit of sympathy.
But Han Xuewei had already given up on her.
Ever since Han Xuemei unabashedly poisoned their father, Han Xuewei knew that Han Xuemei was a thankless wretch who could never be trusted.
"You should discuss these things with Dad instead; he now knows that his current condition is all because of the elixir you administered to him."
Han Xuemei was even more dumbfounded, realizing her plan, which she thought perfect, had been seen through long ago.
She was like a joke, there for others to play with.
Eventually, Han Xuemei left the hospital, feeling she had no face to stay there any longer.
And no matter what she said, Han Xuewei and Dad Han would definitely not forgive her.
But Han Xuemei couldn't accept defeat just like that; her life was just beginning.
She had such a beautiful appearance; she had to make good use of it.
Wasn't Director Zhao a good tool right now? Han Xuemei took the initiative to call Director Zhao.
Director Zhao was overcome with joy; the goddess he'd longed for was proposing to meet up with him.
"You take care of the children here; I have to step out for a bit. If there's any issue with the children, just call me directly—I'll definitely answer this time."
After saying this, Director Zhao left without looking back.
Wang Guihua knew very well that her husband had been cheating, and not just once.
The sole reason she persisted and didn't divorce him was because of their child.
Discover hidden stories at empire
She didn't want her child to grow up fatherless; the child was still so young—she would consider it later.
She could endure it; there was nothing left to cherish between her and Director Zhao.
All their good times had halted back when she supported Director Zhao in his entrepreneurial days.
After leaving the hospital, Director Zhao finally met up with Han Xuemei as he had wished.
Han Xuemei dropped her usual aloofness; upon seeing Director Zhao, she rushed to greet him.
And she took the initiative to take his arm, a move that pleased Director Zhao immensely.
"My little beauty, why are you reaching out to me on your own? I haven't fulfilled my promise to you yet. Could it be that you've already fallen for me? So you plan to be with me ahead of time?"
Hearing Director Zhao's greasy words, Han Xuemei almost threw up the food she had eaten the day before yesterday.
But she had to keep it down.
Now, Director Zhao was the only one who could help her, the only one who could stand up to Lin Yi.
"I never expected to come to my senses so late. It turns out that only Director Zhao is the best to me. I was so shy before, it was really inappropriate. I'm afraid Director Zhao would leave me, so I want to seize Director Zhao–"
Han Xuemei put on a coquettish and shy demeanor, even going as far as to kiss Director Zhao on the cheek.
With this, Director Zhao was even more firmly under Han Xuemei's thumb.
Afterward, the two of them went to a hotel, where Han Xuemei spent a night she would never forget.
Han Xuemei never expected that the old man would still have such vigor.
