However, his skills were truly awful!
Yet, Han Xuemei still had to pretend that Director Zhao was great, complimenting him and going along with him.
After they finished, Director Zhao lit up a cigar, contentedly holding his little beauty in his arms.
"Husband, I have a favor to ask of you. Now that I'm yours, you will surely help me, right?"
When Director Zhao was in the best mood, Han Xuemei spoke up.
True to form, Director Zhao agreed without a second thought.
He hadn't even heard what her request was yet.
"My treasure, just tell me what you want. Whether it's gold and silver treasure or a designer bag, I'll buy them for you."
"I don't want such vulgar things. I want to find a job at your company. Is that possible? As you know, I have the character of a strong woman. I don't always want to rely on you. Besides, if you leave me someday, I want to be able to survive on my own."
By the end of her plea, she put on a pitiful look.
It was this look that made Director Zhao feel such pity for her, and he immediately arranged for Han Xuewei to be a company director.
"Baby, rest assured, you can go to work whenever you want, and the salary is up to you. Just let me know what you want. Having a beauty like you is the greatest fortune of my life."
Director Zhao was now completely infatuated with Han Xuemei.
Things were moving in the direction Han Xuemei had hoped for.
Next, she had to quietly infiltrate Director Zhao's inner circle and then dismantle his company.
Eventually, she would climb up and face Lin Yi!
After Lin Yi got rid of Han Xuemei, he immediately contacted the hotel to arrange a revamp.
There were still many of Han Xuemei's people inside the hotel.
If he didn't get rid of them, the hotel wouldn't be able to operate properly.
Lin Yi also just completed the task that the system had assigned to him.
"Congratulations to the host for completing the ultimate task and receiving a random Elixir."
The Elixir fell into Lin Yi's pocket unnoticed by everyone else.
Lin Yi wasn't quite ready to try out what the random Elixir was yet; he planned to wait until he got back.
"I'll need you to take care of Dad Han for the next few days. I'm going back to sort out the hotel business and will return immediately. Is that okay?"

chapters.title: Chapter 266 Journalist
chapters.content:
"Don't worry about leaving; just leave everything here to me. How could I possibly fail to take care of my own dad?"
Han Xuewei hugged Lin Yi.
She assured that she would definitely take good care of Dad Han here and wouldn't let those inexplicable people come here to hurt Dad's heart!
Seeing Han Xuewei act so sensibly, Lin Yi felt truly delighted.
Having such a girlfriend was his lucky fortune for three lifetimes.
Now he had to leave, since the hotel was still waiting for him.
After saying goodbye to Han Xuewei, Lin Yi went to the hotel alone, only to find that the hotel had unexpectedly suspended business today, probably a trick played by Han Xuemei.
Did she think that without him being at the hotel, it couldn't operate?
Although Han Xuemei had always been in charge of looking after the hotel, Lin Yi knew all the business aspects, and sometimes the male supporting role would secretly help her too.
It turned out his kindness was taken for granted, and fortunately, he had foreseen this, otherwise he would've been doomed this time.
"You no longer need to keep things from me; tell me everything you know. Perhaps I can be lenient with you. But if you continue to hide things, I'm really sorry, but I will have to deal with all of you together."
After entering the hotel, Lin Yi didn't bother with small talk with the waitstaff.
After taking Han Xuemei's money, these guys didn't even have a conscience left, doing all these atrocious things.
The waitstaff, seeing Lin Yi walk in with an imposing air, felt a bit intimidated.
This man didn't look easy to mess with.
If they didn't compromise, would they end up with nothing?
They had been working for that woman for such a long time; if they didn't get any money out of it, wouldn't they have worked for nothing?
"Are you in cahoots with that woman? If you are, then hurry up and hand over the money to us. We don't care about the rest; we're just here to get paid for our work."
So it turned out that Han Xuemei had been running a tab with these people all this time.
These people were foolish enough to work for Han Xuemei for so long without demanding payment.
"If you want to get paid, you have to do as I say. Everyone must sign an agreement listing all the things that woman made you do, all her crimes, and you have to make everything clear. If you miss a single point, I will deduct from your money."
Lin Yi made it very clear, and those people could probably guess who the woman was.
They exchanged glances and eventually nodded their heads. It was better than not getting any money at all.
Lin Yi then distributed a piece of paper to each of them.
He asked them to write down everything they knew. That was Lin Yi's only demand.
While everyone was leaning over the desks writing, Lin Yi heard a commotion at the door.
A lot of reporters surged in, and Lin Yi hurriedly closed the main door.
"Is it true that your hotel is about to go bankrupt, and there have been internal issues? Can you please answer directly?"
"And it's said that your family is fighting over this hotel due to family issues, is that true? Please come out and respond; don't hide, the netizens all really want to know!"
These reporters were really annoying, Lin Yi knew it must have been Han Xuemei and her people who sent them to create chaos for him.
However, Lin Yi would not be influenced by them; as long as he got his hands on Han Xuemei's criminal evidence, Han Xuemei would be completely defeated this time.
If she still wanted to stay in this city, she would have to keep her head down and obey him at all times.
Yet, the hotel staff became fearful upon witnessing such a scene.
They did not want to get involved in any lawsuits; they just wanted to receive the money they were entitled to.
After all, they had been doing this for a long time, even though it wasn't anything good. But they had been at it for quite a while!
Moreover, these people were all pitiful souls who had no choice but to earn this money.
"You don't need to be so scared of what's happening outside. I'll handle it. Right now, all you need to do is quickly write down what I instructed you to write. Don't worry about anything else, and once you are done, you can go to the finance department to get paid."
Fortunately, Lin Yi had previously replaced the finance staff.
Otherwise, it would have been impossible to use the hotel's funds this time, and Lin Yi would probably have had to dig into his own pockets.
Han Xuemei, that character, had schemed and schemed, but she had probably not anticipated that he had already silently replaced most of her people.
Even though there were still many, many people, it did not matter.
Just as Lin Yi was contemplating how to deal with the upcoming events, a woman in high heels walked in through the door.
After entering, she quickly closed the door, keeping the journalists outside.
The woman took off her sunglasses, and Lin Yi recognized her.
This person had always been following Han Xuemei around; she must be Han Xuemei's lackey. Why had she come here?
Her master had already fallen.
"Lin Yi, you have no right to take over this hotel because Han Xuemei has already pledged it to me."
Lu Xinyao walked with an air of arrogance to Lin Yi's side, brandishing the contract Han Xuemei had signed with her and placing it in front of Lin Yi.
Lin Yi merely glanced at it calmly, without any significant emotional reaction.
"Hey, what's with that look? Don't you see this? Han Xuemei has pledged this hotel to me, which means I am now its legal chairman!"
Lu Xinyao hadn't expected Lin Yi to disregard her so completely.
Discover more stories at empire
Wasn't the evidence she presented convincing enough?
What was the matter with this guy? Did he not have a brain? Had he not read what was written on the contract properly?
"This contract does not take effect at all. Han Xuemei is not the legal chairman of this hotel, so she has no right to pledge it."
After Lin Yi finished speaking, Lu Xinyao was dumbfounded. How could that be possible!
She had checked everything before, and Han Xuemei had given her proof. How could it be invalid?
"Don't try to deceive me. This contract is valid. She showed me proof at the time. You can't fool me. If it really comes down to it, call Han Xuemei over, and we'll confront her in person."
"I am not lying to you. Han Xuemei has been fired by me, and she no longer has any association with this hotel. The legal chairman of this hotel is still my wife's father."
Lin Yi looked at Lu Xinyao with an expressionless face and slightly furrowed his brow.
Could this woman stop causing trouble here? There were already enough issues as it was.

chapters.title: Chapter 267 Invitation
chapters.content:
"Go call Han Xuemei out for me right now. I want to confront her in person. How dare she deceive me? And she took quite a lot of money from me back then."
It was only at this moment that Lu Xinyao realized she had truly been fooled.
That damned Han Xuemei, not only did she swindle so much money from her, but she got it for nothing.
She couldn't even take her to court!
"This is a matter between you two. Please resolve it yourselves. If you keep pestering me in my hotel, I'll have no choice but to call security to throw you out. You'll end up just like those reporters outside."
Lin Yi pointed to the reporters outside who had already been driven away by the security guards he had called in.
They couldn't break into a private residence, so all they could do was make a ruckus outside.
But they stood no chance against the strength of so many bodyguards and were thus sent packing.
However, they didn't leave but continued to stake out at the entrance.
They had to capture the breaking news because, if such a story was released, it would definitely shock the entire city!
"You! I don't care, Lin Yi. After all, it's your family's private affair. Someone from your family has scammed me, so why don't you take responsibility? I can't even get in touch with her now; she has blocked me. Otherwise, why would I come looking for you?"
Lu Xinyao once thought she had finally gained some advantage from Han Xuemei. Your journey continues with empire
But to her shock, she was deceived yet again, swindled to the point of losing everything she had left. She was truly out of money.
That was why she had no choice but to come looking for Lin Yi.
"Don't you try playing the victim here. If my wife sees this, she might get the wrong idea. I don't want my wife to misunderstand, so you better leave quickly. It's your issue; you go find her and sort it out. I can't help you get in touch with her, and as of now, she is no longer part of our family."
Lin Yi wasn't about to go soft just because a woman shed tears in front of him.
He wasn't very familiar with this woman, so he saw no need to clean up her mess.
She hadn't considered the consequences when she acted, nor had she investigated properly before carelessly signing a contract with someone. That was solely her own fault.
Just like that, Lu Xinyao was sent packing by Lin Yi. She stood outside the hotel, dazed.
It was infuriating, all because of that wretched woman!
If it weren't for her, how could she have ended up in such an embarrassing situation?
And that woman had swindled so much money from her!
No, she had to find Han Xuemei.
Before that, she needed to curry favor with Han Xuewei.
Only with Han Xuewei's help could she get Lin Yi's assistance in locating that woman.
Lu Xinyao had never interacted with Han Xuewei before; even their encounters were nothing more than a nod of acknowledgment.
Suddenly having to approach Han Xuewei was embarrassing for Lu Xinyao, but at this critical juncture, she must recover her money!
No matter, she would just have to grit her teeth and do it!
After steeling herself, Lu Xinyao dialed Han Xuewei's number, which she had inadvertently learned from Han Xuemei before.
"Hello, who is this?"
After Han Xuewei picked up, her close friend suddenly didn't know what to say.
"Um, is this Han Xuewei? I'm your friend. I was hoping to talk to you—can we meet up for a meal or maybe a coffee?"
Lu Xinyao blurted out everything she had wanted to say in one breath.
Han Xuewei was a bit surprised, what could this guy possibly want from her all of a sudden?
And wasn't she one of Han Xuemei's people? Suddenly contacting her, could it be some sort of conspiracy?
After some thought, Han Xuewei ultimately decided not to report this matter to Lin Yi; she hoped she could solve some issues independently.
So, Han Xuewei accepted her close friend's invitation.
After Lin Yi received the documents from the waitstaff, he finally allowed them to go to finance to report their earnings.
After all, these people had it tough, and if they ended up not receiving any payment for their work, it would be quite difficult to handle.
Furthermore, if they were to band together to make trouble, Lin Yi would also have a hard time resolving the situation.
"Alright, now you can leave, this matter no longer concerns you. I also hope you won't get involved in the future; otherwise, I truly won't be able to save you again."
Having obtained what he wanted, Lin Yi waved his hands, signaling that they could leave.
They quickly got up and left, all heading towards finance to report their earnings.
They had to leave quickly, this place of contention.
They couldn't stay here any longer, otherwise, they would lose everything they had.
They just wanted to make some quick money, not realizing they would get entangled in a family feud.
After Lin Yi collected the documents, he locked the hotel doors before leaving, unaware that the reporters were still waiting outside.
Since they couldn't do anything to Lin Yi, they started targeting the waitstaff instead.
Scared by their actions, the waitstaff stood frozen on the spot, not daring to move.
Lin Yi shook his head helplessly, sighed, and then walked over to the group, helping the waitstaff out of the encirclement.
"It seems my words weren't clear enough just now; you didn't understand my point. There's no need for you to stay here any longer. Do you understand? If you don't leave now, I will call the police and have you arrested. After all, you are seriously interfering with my business now, and these people are my employees. You have no right to block them here."
As Lin Yi spoke, his face was stern, and the reporters were intimidated by his presence.
They each held their microphones, unsure of what to do next, and ultimately, they could only leave reluctantly.
The waitstaff thanked Lin Yi and quickly departed; they couldn't stay there any longer, those people were too frightening.
Lin Yi had planned to go home directly, but he was worried about his business and decided to check on the pharmaceutical factory.
After work, Han Xuewei went straight to meet her close friend.
Upon arriving at the agreed-upon location, Han Xuewei easily spotted that woman in the café.
She seemed plain and unassuming, not like someone who would collude with Han Xuemei.
After all, one could tell from the first glance that Han Xuemei was no simple character.
But this girl gave off an impression of innocence.
"You must be the close friend, right? What do you want from me? If there's something you need, just speak directly. We didn't seem to have any interaction before, and I remember you were always with Han Xuemei."
Han Xuewei sat opposite Lu Xinyao, ordering a cup of the coffee she usually liked.
Actually, Lu Xinyao was very nervous; she didn't know how to face Han Xuewei.
Standing by Han Xuemei's side in the past, she was essentially an enemy of Han Xuewei.
"I was indeed with Han Xuemei before."

chapters.title: Chapter 268 Eating and Shopping
chapters.content:
Silence lingered for a long while, and at last, her best friend uttered only this one sentence.
"So what do you mean now?"
Han Xuewei was taken aback, then continued to inquire, as Lu Xinyao's face turned even redder.
She didn't know how to broach the subject, as she really didn't want to ask Han Xuewei for help.
But there were no other options left.
She couldn't let all her money go down the drain. She truly couldn't bear that.
And there was no way to explain it to her parents after going home!
"A while ago, Han Xuemei borrowed a large sum of money from me, and her return gift was your hotel. But today, when I went to find Lin Yi, he told me that the contract couldn't be executed because Han Xuewei isn't the chairman of that hotel at all. He had no way to directly sell the hotel to me. I really don't know what to do now.
I couldn't get in touch with you, so I thought I'd come and see if there was any way you could help."
Lu Xinyao blurted out everything she wanted to say in one breath.
Han Xuewei was also startled, not expecting that Han Xuemei could turn out to be such a terrible person.
If Dad Han knew about it, he probably wouldn't be able to accept it either, right?
The daughter he had always cherished had come to such an end.
Han Xuewei sighed. She couldn't contact Han Xuemei now either.
After all, they had already fallen out previously, effectively tearing their relationship apart.
"Hearing about your trouble, I really want to help you, but sadly, we've cut ties with Han Xuemei, and we do not know where she is now."
Han Xuewei apologized with a smile to her best friend. It looked like she would not be able to help with this matter.
She had thought she might be able to do something on her own, without relying on Lin Yi.
With that, Han Xuewei stood up, ready to pack up her coffee and leave.
Lu Xinyao suddenly panicked; if Han Xuewei left, she would be completely without anyone to rely on.
She quickly stood up and grabbed Han Xuewei's hand, then, overcome with nervousness, tears began to fall pitter-patter.
"Don't cry, okay? I really can't stand girls crying in front of me!"
Han Xuewei was in a fluster; no girl had ever cried in front of her before, although she herself had cried plenty.
Upon hearing Han Xuewei say such words, her best friend cried even harder.
If just crying could soften Han Xuewei's heart and get her help, then she would cry even more.
"Han Xuewei, my dear sister, I really have no other option, I can't find anyone else. I don't know who else to turn to, please, I'm begging you, can you help me? If you don't, when I get home, my parents will surely beat me to death, they don't know I spent so much money."
Just thinking that she might return home without even securing the contract, let alone acquiring the hotel, she truly didn't know how to face her parents.
They still thought that she had finally managed to accomplish something, but who knew she would end up ruining it all.
In the end, Han Xuewei could not reject Lu Xinyao, the poor girl who was crying so pitifully.
Seeing that Han Xuewei had agreed, Lu Xinyao quickly clutched Han Xuewei's hand.
"Han Xuewei, I'm truly so thankful to you. From now on, you're my real sister. As long as you're willing to help me this time, from now on, forget about Han Xuemei, even if the Emperor of Heaven came along, I will definitely not let him go against you!"
The best friend got a bit excited and suddenly hugged Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei was startled by the sudden hug, could this child's emotional contrast be any greater?
For a moment, Han Xuewei didn't know whether she should be happy or sad.
Why had this little girl been staying with Han Xuemei before?
Staying with someone like her and yet not being influenced to become like that was truly no small feat.
"But I'm just trying, if Lin Yi doesn't want to help you, I can't do anything about it. Although he's my husband, I can't force him to do things he doesn't want to do."
It was necessary for Han Xuewei to set this precautionary condition in advance.
If she couldn't manage it, this little girl better not come to trouble her.
But this best friend was quite adorable, making one a friend would also be nice.
"Don't worry, Lin Yi likes you so much, he'll definitely agree to help you. Besides, aren't you two in a married relationship? There definitely won't be a problem. Sister, this time I can only rely on you. If it weren't for you, my legs would surely be broken when I return."
Until the very end, the best friend didn't forget to play the sympathy card, and like that, after finishing their coffee, the two of them went out to have dinner and shop together.
When Lin Yi returned home and didn't see Han Xuewei, he was very surprised. Wasn't she supposed to have finished work early? Why hadn't she come home? Continue reading at empire
Perhaps because her problem had been resolved, the best friend was more than happy while shopping.
She suddenly felt that Han Xuewei wasn't as annoying as Han Xuemei had said, this person was actually quite pleasant to be around.
The two of them enjoyed shopping more and more, and before she knew it, Han Xuewei had completely forgotten about Lin Yi.
That was until she received a call from Lin Yi.
"Oh no, I forgot the time and didn't report to my husband, he's calling me."
In a fluster, Han Xuewei answered the phone.
Lin Yi on the other end was very worried about Han Xuewei's condition and hastily asked where she was now?
"Honey, don't worry, I'm just out eating and shopping with a friend, she's a girl, so there won't be any problems. We're done shopping now and I'll be heading back immediately. We were having so much fun that I lost track of time, I'm so sorry for making you worry."
After Han Xuewei explained everything in one go, she was still very worried whether Lin Yi would stay angry or not?
After listening, Lin Yi just breathed a sigh of relief. Thank goodness, he had almost thought his wife might have been abducted.
"Which friend are you with? How come I don't know her? No worries, as long as you are safe. Do you need me to pick you up? It might be hard to get a taxi right now."
Why couldn't Lin Yi remember Han Xuewei having such close female friends?
And at this hour, shouldn't people be at work or having dinner? How come she was out shopping with Han Xuewei?
"You should know her, she seemed to have tried to find you this afternoon, it's that best friend girl."
Upon hearing the woman's name, Lin Yi's eyes widened.
He hadn't expected that after failing with him, she'd go seek out his wife, what a clever move indeed.
"Alright then, I'll come to pick you up now, send me the address."
Lin Yi did not dwell on the matter over the phone with Han Xuewei; after all, it was futile. He'd rather warn the best friend in person.
After hanging up, Han Xuewei sent the address to Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 269 The New Dad
chapters.content:
Lin Yi quickly drove over, and when he saw Lu Xinyao, she somewhat fearfully hid behind Han Xuewei.
Han Xuewei, through her interactions with Lu Xinyao, had already realized that she was a good kid without any ill intent.
So she reached out to protect Lu Xinyao, a gesture that somewhat surprised Lin Yi.
"You really know how to find ways, huh? If it doesn't work with me, you go to my wife?"
"I didn't want to, but who asked you not to help me? And if I can't resolve this issue, I'll definitely be beaten to death when I get home."
At this time, Lu Xinyao was still somewhat afraid of Lin Yi, so she spoke in an almost inaudible whisper.
As Lin Yi slowly advanced, Lu Xinyao became even more frightened, clutching desperately at Han Xuewei's clothes.
"Sister, don't let him come over. I really don't have any bad intentions. I just want to resolve this matter. I can give up on that hotel, I just want to get the money back."
Xue Mei quickly tugged at Han Xuewei's sleeve, urging her to block Lin Yi from coming over—she wasn't going to be hit, was she?
Han Xuewei was torn between laughter and tears because of these two, having already seen that Lin Yi was only trying to scare them.
She took a couple of steps forward and then hugged Lin Yi, gently patting his back.
"After all, she is a victim in this matter, and Han Xuemei was previously part of our family. Since this has happened, we need to give her an explanation. If Dad Han finds out, he would definitely want us to help this girl resolve it too."
Having shared her thoughts with Lin Yi, he pondered for a moment and then sighed.
Alright, since his wife wanted to help, he'd help this woman out, albeit reluctantly.
"Fine, since my wife has spoken for you, I'll take care of your issue. But I expect you to give me all the evidence and not hide anything. If there's any hint of concealment, I won't be able to help you."
After Lin Yi finished speaking, Lu Xinyao no longer hid behind Han Xuewei.
She stood out, overjoyed, and did a couple of excited hops.
Great! The matter was finally resolved, and she could now give a proper account of it when she got home.
"Don't worry, I won't keep anything from you. Just ask me whatever you want to know, and I'll tell you everything, down to the smallest detail."
And so, the three of them reached a consensus, and Han Xuewei acknowledged her as a friend.
The girl was quite innocent, and following Han Xuewei from now on, she would probably have an easier time, lest others take advantage of her.
Han Xuewei followed Lin Yi home, and the moment they entered the door, Lin Yi pinned Han Xuewei against it.
Han Xuewei's face flushed red immediately, wondering what Lin Yi was up to, especially with the children still at home.
"Husband, what are you doing? If you don't want to help her, I can just go and refuse her."
Find your next read on empire
After saying that, Han Xuewei struggled to free herself from Lin Yi's hold, but his arms were like they had "Magic Power," and she couldn't struggle free no matter what.
"No, I just want to know why you met with her alone today without telling me. I remember that you used to ask me about these sort of things first, didn't you?"
For a moment, Lin Yi actually felt as though he was no longer needed by Han Xuewei.
Because Han Xuewei didn't consult with him first about such matters.
Did she really think she could solve it? She obviously didn't even know what had happened.
"Honey, please don't get the wrong idea, that's not what I meant, I just want to try and accomplish something on my own. It can't always be that I rely on you, can it? Although I know you would always pamper me, but sometimes you won't be by my side," she said.
After hearing Lin Yi's words, Han Xuewei hurriedly waved her hands, she didn't want her husband to misunderstand her.
Actually, once the two of them talked it out, things got better.
Lin Yi couldn't guarantee he would always be by Han Xuewei's side, and he also hoped that Han Xuewei could become independent.
"Alright, it really makes me happy that you feel this way, but you can rest assured, unless it's a special situation, I will definitely stay by your side. You can ask me anything and seek my help," he said.
After being affectionate for a while, the couple went to bed, and the children were also very well-behaved today.
The next day, Lin Yi was awoken by the baby's crying. What had happened? Had the world come to an end?
It was only after Lin Yi came to his senses that he discovered that the two babies had woken up and were crying nonstop, and Han Xuewei was nowhere to be found.
"Ouch, Da Bao, Er Bao, why are you two crying? What happened?"
"Your mom, I don't know where she went. What should I do? I've never taken care of children before."
Lin Yi frantically dealt with the two children. Since he didn't know, he would have to learn!
Lin Yi immediately took out his phone and started searching online for how to take care of crying children.
He then discovered that the children were either hungry or had soiled their diapers.
After changing the diapers for the two babies, Lin Yi also learned how to make formula.
After all, their mother wasn't here right now and couldn't breastfeed, so they had to use formula.
By the time Lin Yi had clumsily dealt with everything, Han Xuewei had returned from outside.
She had just gone out for a morning jog and hadn't expected the house to be in such chaos when she got back.
"I'm so sorry, honey. I saw that you were sleeping soundly this morning, so I thought of going out for a jog. I didn't expect the children to wake up, maybe because I closed the door too loudly," she said.
After Han Xuewei came back, she apologized to Lin Yi, but she didn't expect that the children were already asleep.
Although the kitchen was a mess, all was well.
"I didn't realize that taking care of the children was so hard for you. Why don't we hire a nanny? I only did it once and found it so overwhelming and couldn't cope. And you've been dealing with it all the time," he said.
Lin Yi probably felt the phrase 'clumsy and overwhelmed' more times that day than ever before.
Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh and cry, as Lin Yi, after all, was a new dad.
Being able to take care of the children so well on his first try was no mean feat.
If they handed the children to a nanny, they would grow distant from their parents in the future.
"We can have a nanny help during the day, plus we have Dad Han, right? It's okay to let her take care of the children. I don't want a nanny to take over all the time, we can take care of the children after work too," she said.
Han Xuewei voiced her concerns and Lin Yi understood her intentions, so in the end, they dropped the idea.

chapters.title: Chapter 270 Auction
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei went to work, and Lin Yi left the two children at home with the nanny.
He had already installed surveillance at home, so he could see everything that happened there.
If the nanny did anything to hurt the children, Lin Yi would find out right away.
The first thing Lin Yi did after leaving the house was to contact Han Xuemei, and to his surprise, Han Xuemei actually dared to answer the phone.
"Why are you suddenly calling me? Are you ready to beg for mercy? If you kneel down and beg me now, perhaps I might consider seeing you once."
Han Xuemei had thought that Director Zhao had made his move and that Lin Yi was calling her to beg for mercy—what else could it be?
She was feeling quite smug, while Lin Yi was completely baffled.
"It's daytime now. If you're dreaming, it would be better to wait for the night."
What did Lin Yi mean? Wasn't he here to beg her for forgiveness?
If not, then why was he calling her on his own initiative?
Or had Lin Yi finally realized that she was far better than Han Xuewei?
"So why are you calling me? I have nothing to do with you guys anymore. For other matters, you should contact someone else."
After saying this, Han Xuemei was about to hang up, but how could Lin Yi give her that chance? He quickly spoke up.
"You've scammed a lot of money from others through this hotel, is that true?"
Han Xuemei didn't expect Lin Yi to reach out to her because of this issue. How could it be possible? How could it be exposed?
Could it be that that wretched girl went to them on her own initiative?
"I don't understand what you are talking about. These things have nothing to do with me. If anyone has come to you, you'd better go talk to them to clear things up—it has nothing to do with me."
Han Xuemei was obviously guilty.
Lin Yi hadn't even mentioned that someone had come looking for them. Wasn't this an inadvertent admission?
Fortunately, Lin Yi had automatically recorded the call while speaking to Han Xuemei.
"I never said it had anything to do with you. I just want to know whether you did such a thing or not. If not, then let's pretend I never came to you today. However, I need to make it clear to you that a lie can be told once, but if you tell too many, you won't be able to wriggle out of them later."
Lin Yi always spoke in innuendos when talking to Han Xuemei, which irritated her greatly.
Why did he always have to act so superior and lecture her?
What was so great about him, just because he had more money than others? Just because he had more property?
He hasn't made his fortune yet, and she was already attached to a big shot in the pharmaceutical industry!
Sooner or later, Lin Yi would be at her feet.
"Even if that were the case, I don't need you to worry about it. If there's nothing else, I'll hang up now."
Having said this, Han Xuemei quickly hung up the call and immediately dialed Director Zhao.
Director Zhao, upon receiving a call from his goddess, was, of course, ecstatic.
The goddess had just been embraced into his arms, and he intended to cherish her for a few days. Read new chapters at empire
"Honey, Lin Yi just called me, and he threatened me again. If you don't help me get rid of him quickly, we might not be able to live together in the future, and then I won't be able to take care of you."
Han Xuemei was disgusted by the sound of her own voice.
But there was no choice; the old man liked it that way, so Han Xuemei had to endure it.
Upon hearing his goddess call him honey, his soul nearly flew out of his body.
It seems that if Lin Yi isn't dealt with promptly, he'll interfere with grand plans later on.
"Darling, don't worry. Leave it to your husband. I'll take care of him as soon as possible, and make sure he doesn't disturb the two of us," he said.
After a few more sweet nothings, Han Xuemei reluctantly ended the call.
But the moment she hung up, Han Xuemei's demeanor changed completely; it was truly disgusting!
No matter how many showers she took, she couldn't wash off the filth from her body.
Why should she have to lower herself to such an old man, while you and I have a handsome husband to love and cherish her? That's so unfair, isn't it?
Han Xuemei never contemplated her own issues, always blaming everything on Han Xuewei.
After finishing the call with his goddess, Director Zhao also started to ponder how to deal with Lin Yi.
Attempting the straightforward approach would certainly fail.
Lin Yi was a man full of schemes, and he seemed to have a considerable amount of funding; acting rashly would only alert him.
There was a batch of new medicinal herbs coming to market soon… might as well use that to blunt Lin Yi's edge a bit.
Lin Yi had collected a lot of evidence against Han Xuemei from Lu Xinyao, which would play a significant role later on.
Now, Lin Yi hoped to quickly deal with the hotel, as there were some people there that needed handling as well.
But now, Lin Yi had an even more important task to attend to; a new batch of medicinal herbs had arrived, and an auction was about to begin.
Lin Yi had to win this batch of herbs for the use of his employees.
Soon, Lin Yi felt the bustling atmosphere at the auction; this place was indeed crowded.
Those sitting in the audience were from smaller enterprises.
And those with private rooms were from larger corporations.
Of course, there were also people like Lin Yi, who had spent a great deal of money for a private room and thus had the right to bid first.
"Hello, Mr. Lin, who would have thought you'd come today? We've kept the private room you snatched from us last time reserved just for you," said the attendant at the door, recognizing Lin Yi's name and immediately taking his role seriously.
This was a VIP customer, after all!
Their boss had instructed them to take good care of Lin Yi and not to neglect him in any way.
"Then lead me there. I've heard there's a batch of medicinal herbs being auctioned today, freshly imported," Lin Yi said.
"Yes, that's right. This batch contains many precious herbs, hence the auction. If Mr. Lin is interested, you could join in," the attendant replied.
Lin Yi was there precisely for these herbs, slated as the final item at the auction, while there were many other items being auctioned first.
If Lin Yi found something interesting, he might bid on it for Han Xuewei's amusement.
On his way to his private room, Lin Yi ran into Director Zhao.
"I didn't expect to see you here, Little Brother Lin. Are you here for that batch of medicinal herbs?" Director Zhao greeted Lin Yi, not ignoring him.
As annoying as he was, Lin Yi was not going to pick a fight at this time.
"Most people here are probably here for the medicinal herbs, isn't that today's big attraction?" Lin Yi replied.
"Hahaha! Little Brother Lin, you're new to society and there's a lot you don't understand. That batch of herbs won't be so easy to secure," Director Zhao said with laughter.

chapters.title: Chapter 271 Bid
chapters.content:
"Oh? I find it quite relaxing myself. The people who came today don't seem all that formidable." Enjoy new chapters from empire
Upon hearing Director Zhao's words, Lin Yi merely cracked a smile, but his retort was anything but light.
"Young man, you're still young after all. If you're this arrogant in the business world, you'll never achieve great things. I'll give you a chance now. If you work like an ox and horse for me, maybe I can carve out a place for you in this industry."
The waiter beside them watched as the tension escalated; he wasn't sure if he should intervene to defuse the situation.
After all, Lin Yi was a major client, but Director Zhao was also not someone they could afford to offend.
He could only stand by tensely, cold sweat beading on his forehead.
If these two tycoons started a conflict, would they both stop coming to this place in the future?
"I appreciate your concern, Director Zhao, but you should really take care of your own mistresses."
After he finished speaking, Lin Yi no longer paid attention to Director Zhao before him, and instead instructed the waiter beside him to take him to the private room.
Leaving Director Zhao behind with a look of shock on his face.
He hadn't expected Lin Yi to know about the new lover he had recently taken.
It seemed that Lin Yi was not as simple as he appeared on the surface; he must have a lot of dirt hidden away. With just a little investigation, Lin Yi would surely fall!
Once Lin Yi had entered the private room with the waiter's guidance, he tipped the waiter and inquired about some things regarding Director Zhao.
"Does that Director Zhao, whom I saw outside just now, come here often? I've been here a few times but haven't seen him."
"That Director Zhao is a regular here. He always brings different women to this place, it's no secret. Everyone knows it. He comes here either to amuse himself with women or to woo them."
After receiving a tip, the waiter immediately sold out Director Zhao.
It wasn't really a betrayal, since this was common knowledge to everyone who came here, and they didn't concern themselves with the private lives of their clients.
If his own wife hadn't said anything, it wasn't their place to worry about it.
"So that's how it is. Director Zhao sure knows how to have fun. I don't need you anymore; you may leave. If I need anything, I'll ring the bell for you."
Lin Yi waved his hand and the waiter left.
It looked like Director Zhao really enjoyed playing with women. Han Xuemei must be with him now, otherwise Director Zhao wouldn't always be targeting Lin Yi for no good reason.
Since Han Xuemei was so confident in her allure, Lin Yi was curious to see just how deep Director Zhao's feelings for her were.
He decided to put the matter aside for now, as the meeting was about to start soon, and those below knew that at least four big shots had arrived in the private room today.
Those underlings might manage to bid on the items in front, but these tycoons were surely here for the last batch of medicinal herbs.
"Have you heard? The big shot from the pharmaceutical industry, Director Zhao, is here today too, in the private room. I wonder which beauty he brought today."
"Hahaha! Despite his age, Director Zhao sure knows how to play the field. I wonder what his wife thinks. It's such common gossip on the outside, yet his wife hasn't made a peep."
The crowd outside chattered excitedly, while Director Zhao enjoyed himself in the private room, surrounded by beauties, having a great time.
"Welcome everyone to today's auction. I am your host. Next up, I'll be presenting many precious items. Of course, what I believe you're all most interested in is our final batch of medicinal herbs. Please be patient, it will be up for bidding soon!"
The items being auctioned off before were so boring to Lin Yi that he felt it was a real waste of time. This auction truly lacked anything worthwhile.
If it weren't for the medicinal herbs, Lin Yi wouldn't have come today at all.
He found himself missing his wife and thought he should've brought her along.
But perhaps it was better not to expose his wife to such a filthy place, or she might be corrupted by these people.
Finally, after the previous items had been auctioned off, they moved into the most intense part of the event.
Some audience members, having acquired what they wanted, had left.
The rest stayed to watch the final showdown, as the tycoons above began to bid.
"Next up is the batch of medicinal herbs everyone has been anticipating. Within this batch are many herbs of immense value, some priceless, others seen only once in centuries. As for what specifically—well, you'll have to examine them closely after you've won the bid! The starting bid is 1 million!"
The host played coy, not wanting to reveal their hand too early. Lin Yi, on the other hand, was not shy at all, immediately bidding 5 million.
The crowd below was shocked; they couldn't believe the starting bid for this batch had reached 1 million. Wasn't that a bit much?
Although they had seen many expensive items before, they usually started at 100,000.
It seemed that this batch of medicinal herbs must truly contain treasures, otherwise they wouldn't dare ask for such a high price—after all, going against these tycoons wasn't a laughing matter.
Director Zhao, after hearing Lin Yi's bid, followed suit immediately. He was not going to be outdone by some greenhorn.
"6 million."
"8 million."
"10 million!"
...
After several rounds of bidding, the price had been driven up to 50 million.
The audience was even more thrilled. Was this batch of herbs really worth such a high price?
They understood, though, that these tycoons were mostly posturing—none wanted to lose face to the others.
Aside from Lin Yi and Director Zhao, there were two other big shots worth noting today.
However, Lin Yi did not know who they were.
They weren't shy with their bidding either, which was why the price had soared to such heights.
Lin Yi was actually considering backing out. No matter how precious the batch of medicinal herbs, it wasn't worth 50 million.
"Young man, didn't I tell you? You're no match for us. These waters are too muddled for you; it's best you don't wade in."
Director Zhao, feeling triumphant, believed Lin Yi couldn't compete any longer. The auctioneer had already called out the second time, and if Lin Yi didn't place a bid soon, the herbs would go to Director Zhao.
"100 million."
The crowd erupted in disbelief, taken aback that the newcomer could raise the price so high. He must be incredibly wealthy.
Director Zhao was a bit taken aback.

chapters.title: Chapter 272 Obtaining the Medicinal Herbs
chapters.content:
This brat, just for a batch of herbs, actually drove the price up so high, if I continue to bid, I'd truly be the fool.
Even if these medicinal materials were that precious? They're definitely not worth a hundred million.
Lin Yi is just forcing my hand!
If I keep bidding and Lin Yi decides not to bid anymore, what then? I'd just be throwing away all this money for a pile of unworthy herbs.
After the last three knocks, Director Zhao didn't continue bidding either; he couldn't afford such a high price.
The company is actually in a bit of trouble right now, managing to come up with 50 million was already quite difficult, there's no more money to squander.
"Really sorry about that, Director Zhao, looks like I have a bit of an edge this time, no worries, keep trying next time, you might be able to snatch something from my hands. Also, I didn't expect you to be so fond of beauties, I'll definitely introduce you to a nation-toppling great beauty another day."
Initially, Director Zhao was very angry hearing what Lin Yi said at first, but when he heard the word "beauty," the anger on his face dissipated like smoke.
Lin Yi sure knows his stuff, his only hobby is his fondness for beauties.
If Lin Yi could introduce him to a beauty even more stunning than Han Xuemei, he might even switch sides.
"Haha, little brother, you really get me, alright, let's exchange contact information. If you come across any beauties or extremely beautiful ladies in the future, remember to send them my way, we can be friends then. I won't hold the past against you, and don't take my actions to heart."
Now, Director Zhao wasn't concerned about Han Xuemei anymore; all he could think about were the pretty girls.
Lin Yi let out a cold laugh, then exchanged contact information with Director Zhao.
Director Zhao left full of joy, while Lin Yi went to the warehouse to collect his batch of medicinal materials.
When he arrived at the warehouse, even the president of the auction house had come.
He hadn't expected the price for this batch of medicinal materials to go so high, far exceeding his expectations.
Thus, he had to see for himself who was willing to pay such a high price—it turned out to be one of their members.
"Hello, Mr. Lin, it's a pleasure to meet you. I'm the president of this auction house. Thank you very much for your support. Now, let me show you the medicinal materials. Frankly speaking, this batch might not be worth a hundred million, but it definitely won't disappoint you."
This president is quite a sincere person, willing to tell Lin Yi the truth.
Lin Yi doesn't mind spending money like water, how could he possibly care about such things?
As long as he got what he needed, as for the cost, Lin Yi always doesn't bother to calculate.
Lin Yi still has lots of money; this is just a drop in the bucket.
"No problem, I don't mind. I just really need this batch of medicinal materials to assist me. Let's speed up the process and go. No more dawdling around here."
After a bit of small talk, the president took Lin Yi to their warehouse, where Lin Yi saw for himself what the batch of herbs he had bid on actually consisted of.
A bunch of fairly common herbs, and then a pile of precious medicinal materials in the middle, with the main event coming last.
In the very center, placed within a box, was a century-old ginseng, a rarity of a hundred years.
This ginseng had different effects and was very ancient.
There were also a few stalks of Chianshan snow lotus, but what Lin Yi cared about most was the caterpillar.
```
"What is this thing?"
"This is no ordinary bug. It's called Gu, created through refinement. This little fellow can be quite useful. After you go back, hand it over to the people in your company who understand these things, and they will recognize its value. It's a good item; although it can't reach such a high price, it definitely isn't cheap either."
The chairman only knew a little about this thing.
Looking at the profit made today, Lin Yi was quite satisfied and planned to transport all these items to his pharmaceutical factory.
He exchanged addresses with the chairman, then had them take responsibility for delivering the goods.
After all, he had already spent so much money; it would be somewhat disappointing if Lin Yi had to collect the items himself.
The chairman was very happy today; he had a casual chat with Lin Yi and only then did Lin Yi discover that the chairman was from the Long Family.
Who would have thought the Long Family's business ventures were so extensive? They even owned an auction house.
In fact, Lin Yi also had the intention of opening an auction house.
He had so many elixirs; if he could research and develop them, then the top-grade elixirs he possessed would indeed become rare treasures.
"I really didn't expect this auction house to be a Long Family enterprise. It looks like I will visit the Long Family when I have time, just not sure if you will welcome me when that time comes."
As Lin Yi chatted with the chairman, the chairman quickly smiled obsequiously, how could they possibly not welcome him?
Find more chapters on empire
After all, Lin Yi was so wealthy, and a major patron of their establishment.
Perhaps Lin Yi would become an even more remarkable figure in the future; they definitely needed to cling to this big tree.
"Mr. Lin, rest assured, from now on, I consider you as a brother. We are as close as siblings; how could we not welcome you? You can come to our Long Family anytime. Just let me know, and I will immediately come to receive you."
After chatting a bit more, Lin Yi left; he still had to meet Han Xuewei.
These past few days, Han Xuewei had been quite bored in school, without anyone to keep her company, and her happiness diminished a bit.
She couldn't speak with Mo Jihua either. If Lin Yi's informants found out, who knows how jealous or angry they might get?
To avoid these unnecessary family conflicts, she had been controlling herself.
But after all, the two of them had known each other since they were young; it simply wasn't right to suddenly stop speaking.
As it happened, Mo Jihua had come to invite Han Xuewei to lunch again.
"You haven't been eating lunch with me recently, but we used to eat together often, didn't we? Or are you afraid that your family member will get jealous? He wouldn't deny you even this little bit of freedom, would he?"
Though the words were somewhat uncomfortable to hear, Han Xuewei ultimately said nothing.
She simply told Mo Jihua that, being a married person, it was proper for her to maintain a certain distance from another man.
And this would not affect the relationship between them.
They are friends, they were in the past, are in the present, and will be in the future.
"I understand. From now on, I won't come looking for you. I will maintain the status of a friend. Well, I should be going now. You're going to eat lunch alone again today. If you feel bored, you can ask one of your students to accompany you."

chapters.title: Chapter 273 Divorce
chapters.content:
After it was over, Mo Jihua left directly, but he felt somewhat despondent. He had never anticipated that their relationship would devolve to such a state.
Besides, he had no ill intentions; he simply couldn't control the feelings he had for her.
It's all Lin Yi's fault!
If it weren't for Lin Yi's appearance, how could their situation have turned out like this?
Mo Jihua placed all the blame squarely on Lin Yi's shoulders.
Moreover, if not for Lin Yi and the child, they wouldn't have gotten to the point where they couldn't even speak to each other.
Director Zhao left the auction feeling very pleased. He would wait patiently for Lin Yi to introduce him to beautiful women.
By then, he reckoned he would be tired of Han Xuemei anyway.
It's just that he had already promised Han Xuemei he would deal with Lin Yi—yet now the latter was his good brother.
If he betrayed him after crossing the river, he wouldn't get the beauties.
Right on his way home, he suddenly received a call from his wife.
"What is it? Speak quickly if there's something; I have a very important meeting to attend."
When facing his own wife, Director Zhao seemed extremely impatient.
The two had been married for some years now, and their child was already several years old.
But the more he looked at his wife at home, the more he felt displeased. How had he ever fallen for this woman?
"The child is being discharged from the hospital today and you're not coming?"
"It's because the company's matters are just too numerous; I got so busy I forgot. Besides, if I don't earn money, who will support you and the kid? Just bring the child home. If there's nothing else, don't call me again. The company has a lot of things to handle, and I don't have the time to waste on you."
At first, it was all fine, but when Wang Guixiang heard the word "waste," she couldn't hold back any longer.
Tears rolled down her cheeks.
They used to be so loving, and she had even given birth to a son for him. Logically, life should only be getting better.
Why was her husband always leaving early and returning late? Or even not coming home at night at all?
"Zhao Guangchen! How can you treat me like this? Have I been bad to you? When you had no money, I stayed by your side. I even married you. I've cut off relationships with my own family for you and your money, yet this is how you repay me.
Do you think I don't know about the things you're doing outside? I've been turning a blind eye, trying to provide a nice living environment for our child. But you? If this is how you're going to be, then don't blame me for being heartless. Let's get a divorce!"
Director Zhao hadn't expected his wife to suddenly explode and say so much.
But truth be told, he had been wanting to divorce this woman for a long time.
He had plenty of women outside, each more beautiful and younger than her. Why should he expend all his energy on this woman?
A divorce suited him just fine—it was exactly what he wanted.
"Those are your words, not mine. I think I've been more than fair to you. However, I must have custody of the child. Of course, if you object to that, you can talk to my lawyer. Since you've decided on a divorce, we'll no longer be husband and wife in the future, so you have no need to contact me further. I'm hanging up now."
After speaking, Zhao Guangchen immediately hung up the phone. Once the call was ended, he felt a burden had been lifted. Wasn't this just fantastic?
At last, he had gotten rid of that woman. Now, he was off to find his goddess—Han Xuemei was probably waiting for him at home.
How wonderful it was to be so successful and to have such a large company. Why should he have to look at a woman's face?
Zhao Guangchen had long forgotten how Wang Guixiang had been with him from the start, helping him to build his business from nothing.
She worked tirelessly by his side, even without asking for any compensation.
Han Xuemei was getting restless in the villa, but she had nowhere else she could go. Moreover, she had to rely on Director Zhao.
After returning to the small villa he shared with Han Xuemei, Director Zhao was even happier and shared the news with her.
"Let me tell you, I've finally gotten rid of that stinking woman. All these years, I've been generous to her and given her so much money. She should be content. Now, I can be with you properly. Are you happy, baby?"
But after hearing this, Han Xuemei wasn't the least bit thrilled.
Her smile froze on her face.
What was going on? Why had this despicable man divorced his wife?
He wasn't thinking of marrying her, was he?
No way, she was in the prime of her life!
Even though she had already given her body to him, she intended to marry a wealthy and handsome man! How could she possibly marry an old man?
Han Xuemei's mind was racing. How could she rid herself of this man and get past this situation?
"Of course, I'm happy, hubby. From now on, it will just be the two of us together, with no that stinking woman in the way. And will you go public with our relationship?"
With that last sentence, Han Xuemei was testing Director Zhao. If he was just playing with her, she would make good use of the relationship.
But if Director Zhao truly had her in his heart and intended to marry her, Han Xuemei would have to think hard about how she could escape him.
When Director Zhao heard the words "go public with our relationship," his face stiffened for a moment.
He hadn't had enough fun yet, and he guessed that he would soon grow tired of this woman as well.
Furthermore, Lin Yi had mentioned introducing him to even more beautiful women, so he definitely wasn't going to waste too much time on Han Xuemei.
"Baby, if we go public with our relationship now, you're bound to be the target of so many rumors. My wife and I are just preparing for a divorce, we're still legally married. If we disclose our relationship at this moment, just think what people would say about you. So, let's wait a bit longer, okay? Rest assured, since you are with me, I will definitely give you a proper status.
You're different from the others."
Director Zhao was saying this only to pacify Han Xuemei's feelings.
If this woman started to make a fuss, he would be left with a gap in his affairs.
He was a man who despised having a gap in companionship. Enjoy exclusive adventures from empire
"I knew hubby is the best, always considering things for me. Are you particularly tired today? Let me give you a massage!"
Han Xuemei finally breathed a sigh of relief. Great, it seemed Director Zhao didn't have that intention with her.
She would not have to marry an old man; she just needed to make good use of this relationship.
Lin Yi went to pick up Han Xuewei from work, making the school students green with envy.

chapters.title: Chapter 274 Ling'er
chapters.content:
"Look! The school beauty's husband is here to pick her up from work again. Their relationship is so strong, I heard they already have two kids. Who would have thought they're already on their second child and yet still so close. I must find a man as good as the school beauty's husband in the future!"
These girls' gossiping abilities are truly on par with the old ladies in the village.
"Same here, I'm so envious of the school beauty. Their kind of love is what we should aspire to. Even though I think the school beauty and Teacher Mo are a great match, official couples are indeed the sweetest!"
Whenever people mention Han Xuewei and Lin Yi, they can't help but bring Mo Jihua into the conversation.
After all, Mo Jihua's relationship is just too interesting, and quite tragic too. He's the perfect image of the second male lead in TV dramas.
"Today my little spies haven't reported back to me. It looks like you behaved yourself, huh? Keep it up in the future. Of course, I haven't restricted you from making friends, but I really hope you won't have too much contact with that man anymore. I've been jealous over you two so many times. I know you were childhood sweethearts.
Normal daily communication, I can allow."
Lin Yi first embraced Han Xuewei, then started discussing this matter with her.
Han Xuewei was at a loss whether to cry or laugh. When did Lin Yi become so possessive? He wasn't like this before.
The two of them left work together for home, and Lin Yi casually mentioned Han Xuemei's current situation on the way.
"Although I'm still speculating, I can pretty much confirm it now; she's now Director Zhao's mistress."
This statement left Han Xuewei dumbstruck. What was Lin Yi talking about?
How could Han Xuemei, who was so proud, become an old man's mistress?
That Director Zhao is at least 40 years old, right?
"I know it might be hard to believe, but that's the case. I've tested Director Zhao, and unless something unexpected happens, it's true."
Lin Yi was not particularly shocked by this.
Han Xuemei had been pushed into a corner. If she didn't find a man to rely on at this point, she wouldn't be able to go on.
And she wanted so badly to seek revenge on them—how could she be content to just fail and leave?
"My God, who would have thought she'd turn out this way? If Dad knew, he'd be heartbroken."
After work, they planned to visit Dad in the hospital for a while.
They had their own lives and work to attend to, and couldn't be by Dad's side all the time. But Dad was recovering well now.
However, they visited every day without fail.
On the way to the hospital, Han Xuewei hesitated whether to tell Dad about this.
Lin Yi thought it was better not to say anything.
They would deal with Han Xuemei first, then tell Dad the news.
Of course, by that time, if Han Xuemei was no longer Director Zhao's mistress, there wouldn't be any need to bring it up.
Everything was Han Xuemei's own choice. No one forced her. She could have left; she could have chosen not to be so wicked.
"Sigh, I remember she used to be pretty good as a child. How did she grow up to be like this?"
Han Xuewei really didn't understand Lin Yi, nor did she know about these issues until they got to the hospital. After making small talk there, they went home.
Dad was in great condition today. He should be able to be discharged in about five days.
Once home, Lin Yi received a phone call from Zhou Kongshan.
Zhou Kongshan had received the medicinal herbs Lin Yi had secured for them, and he was incredibly excited.
The Elixir was exceptionally hard to find. It must have taken a long time to achieve such fullness through refinement.
"Boss, rest assured, this time it's all on us. It's absolutely foolproof. If nothing goes wrong, our medicine will hit the market within half a month. I hope you'll take some time to think about how to promote our new product!"
Zhou Kongshan was now fully confident. After all, he had so many precious herbs.
If they couldn't develop it now, it would be a huge letdown for Lin Yi.
Lin Yi laughed it off, discussed a few more details with him, and then hung up.
"Is it work stuff again? If you're busy, go ahead, I'll deal with some student matters on my own."
It had to be said, the progress the students had made was impressive, which brought Han Xuewei a great deal of satisfaction.
Lin Yi nodded, then remained in the study, while Han Xuewei went back to their bedroom.
In the bedroom, there was a desk where Han Xuewei could study on her own.
At the moment, all Lin Yi could think about was that woman. Her beauty was unique in the world, extremely captivating,
She owed Lin Yi a favor, and now was the time to return it. With Director Zhao out of the picture, things would be easier for him.
Although Director Zhao wasn't too fearsome, he was still one of the industry's giants.
"How come you have time to call me all of a sudden? Did you just remember there's someone like me? If you didn't contact me, I might have completely forgotten about this."
After picking up the phone, Ling'er was quite angry. She hadn't expected Lin Yi to lose contact with her for so long.
Had he forgotten about the bond they once shared?
Of course, this bond referred to their friendship, nothing more. Find more to read at empire
Ling'er, who worked in a special profession, didn't believe any man could love her.
"Alright, alright, stop being a smart aleck. I contacted you because I need you to do me a favor. For you, it shouldn't be hard to seduce someone."
Seductress, Ling'er was indeed adept at that. But she was someone who performed but didn't sell her body.
"Sure, but what's in it for me? Yes, I owe you a favor, but I don't usually do such things. If you're asking me to do it, you've got to offer me something in return, right?"
Ling'er was after some Elixir again, recalling the Youth-Preserving Pills she had taken before leaving Lin Yi. They were impressively effective, making her feel as though she had suddenly become five years younger!
"Fine, fine. As long as you get the job done, you can have as many pills as you want."
Lin Yi, somewhat exasperated, agreed. After they finalized their arrangement, Lin Yi sent Director Zhao's information to Ling'er. The rest was up to her.
Once finished with these matters, Lin Yi went to spend time with his wife and child.

chapters.title: Chapter 275 Street Punk
chapters.content:
After receiving the promise from Lin Yi, Ling'er also was not idle, immediately setting out a series of plans based on the hints given by Lin Yi.
She wanted to make Director Zhao become obsessed with her tender allure.
"This time I can swindle a whole bunch of Elixir from Lin Yi's hands again, I must say the kid does have some skills, to have so many effective Elixirs in his possession."
In the past, she also had taken many kinds of medicine, but none were as effective as Lin Yi's.
The Elixirs from Lin Yi were the kind that allowed you to see results immediately, visibly rejuvenating people at a glance.
The three little friends were growing bigger now and becoming more mischievous was unavoidable, sometimes giving Lin Yi and Han Xuewei quite a headache.
"How come these three little brats just won't listen to advice?"
Looking at the messy house, Lin Yi felt his head getting bigger, as the three kids had been extremely boisterous since they learned to crawl.
Han Xuewei also came over, then picked up the children, letting Lin Yi clean up the place while she lulled the kids to sleep.
It was almost time for class, and if Han Xuewei didn't hurry, she would be late.
"Wait a moment, remember to take me to school, today's class is very important, and I can't ask for leave."
Lin Yi nodded, then obediently started tidying up.
He had never imagined that after becoming a father, he could end up doing such things, which he wouldn't have dared to consider before.
With his status, how could he possibly do house cleaning himself?
In fact, he had thought about hiring a nanny, but the nanny would only come over when they were not home.
When they were at home, the nanny was generally not there.
After finally lulling the children to sleep, Han Xuewei put on her bag and walked out, signaling Lin Yi to drive her to school.
"Don't rush, I will definitely get you to school on time, it's not good if you start panicking again."
Lin Yi took Han Xuewei's bag from her hand, then followed her downstairs.
Han Xuewei seemed in a hurry, but how could Lin Yi let his beloved wife be late?
Without breaking any traffic laws, Lin Yi successfully dropped Han Xuewei off at school, and she wasn't late.
When her classmates saw the school beauty's husband coming to drop her off again, they were all extremely envious.
Why didn't they have a husband to send them to school?
Well, never mind, they didn't have Han Xuewei's looks either, after all, not just anyone could be the school beauty.
Beyond that, the school beauty's abilities were formidable indeed; she wasn't just a pretty face, her studies were also quite impressive.
"You should go back now, I have to attend class and can't keep talking to you, remember to pick me up after class, you mustn't forget again." Continue your adventure at empire
Lin Yi had forgotten to pick up Han Xuewei several times because of his own matters, which upset her greatly.
The two of them had previously agreed that unless there was something serious, Lin Yi must come to pick her up after school.
Lin Yi reassured Han Xuewei over and over that he definitely would not forget today.
Afterward, Han Xuewei returned to her class, satisfied.
Having dropped off his wife, Lin Yi drove away, he needed to check on how the Elixir was coming along.
On the road, Lin Yi encountered a roadblock, where a group of guys deliberately lay down in front of him to prevent him from leaving.
Lin Yi could tell that these people were doing it on purpose.
"Sorry, brothers, I have something very important right now. Can you please let me through, and moreover, under the broad daylight, you wouldn't want to cause trouble, right?"
The way Lin Yi dealt with such gangsters was always very simple—call the police and let them handle these lawless citizens.
The gangsters came up to Lin Yi's car and then took out their clubs.
The bystanders, upon seeing the situation, reacted not by calling the police, but by running away.
They didn't want to meddle in other people's business. What if they brought trouble upon themselves?
Lin Yi also didn't expect that these guys would be tough cookies, as they suddenly snatched the phone from his hand, but Lin Yi still looked at them calmly.
"Judging by your car, you must be quite wealthy, right? My brothers and I are all out of money. How about you lend us a few bucks to spend? Don't worry, we definitely won't hurt you, as long as the money is right."
Some people look like they are surely desperadoes, or else they wouldn't break the law in such an attention-grabbing way.
Most of the bystanders had already run off, so Lin Yi didn't need to worry about involving other ordinary people.
"Congratulations, host, you have a new mission. Deal with these gangsters in front of you, punish them, and you will be rewarded with a random elixir."
The mission was issued just as these guys arrived; Lin Yi had just been worrying about not having a chance to earn a reward, but their arrival was timely.
Lin Yi cracked his knuckles and got out of the car directly; the gangsters thought Lin Yi was about to give them money.
But who knew that Lin Yi's one-second move would stun them on the spot.
Lin Yi threw a left hook and knocked one of the gangsters to the ground.
The other gangsters quickly realized what was happening and picked up their weapons, charging at Lin Yi, but they underestimated his reaction speed.
Lin Yi could be said to have teleported behind one of them in an instant and then punched him in the back.
The man's eyes rolled back, and he fell to the ground.
"What are you all standing there for? Don't let him take us down one by one, let's all go at him together. He's only one person, and we're so many. Can't we take care of him?"
The leader of the gangsters was getting anxious. He had been hiding in the back, not daring to go forward, ordering his subordinates to advance.
The underlings, afraid of their boss, grabbed their weapons and charged at Lin Yi again.
Yet, Lin Yi took care of all of them in just a couple of moves.
In the end, only the gang leader was left standing there, his legs numb.
"Brother, I was wrong. Brother, I really didn't know you were so formidable. I was blind not to recognize Mount Tai. Please spare my life. From now on, I will do anything to repay you!"
Now you know to beg for mercy. What were you doing earlier?
The kind of person Lin Yi disliked the most was someone like him, who didn't care about his own underlings.
If he had treated his underlings well, Lin Yi might have been lenient and let him off, but this guy was simply not worth the sympathy.
Lin Yi took him down with a punch, then tied up everyone at the scene and called the police.
After the police arrived, Lin Yi handed over all the gangsters to them.
And he told the police that he would go to the station to give a statement later, but for now, he had more important things to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 276 New Love
chapters.content:
The police were very understanding and immediately agreed to Lin Yi's request. Lin Yi drove away and arrived at the pharmaceutical factory.
Zhou Kongshan was overjoyed to see Lin Yi arrive.
He needed to share the thrilling news with Lin Yi.
Indeed, their experiment had succeeded, and the drug pills were successfully developed!
"Lin Yi, our elixir has finally been produced successfully," he said, "and we can now start mass production. We have already begun to promote our elixir and can put it on the shelves at any time, as long as we can keep up with demand."
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi merely smiled slightly.
He knew that with these people, the drugs would certainly be successfully developed, it was just a matter of time.
Now Lin Yi also felt confident in his heart.
Next, as long as they dealt with Director Zhao, their factory would become stronger and stronger in the market.
Eventually, Lin Yi's pharmacy would become even more famous.
"That's great. Ramp up the production immediately," he said. "I'm going to start promoting our elixir. After waiting for so long, we finally have a payoff. Well done. Once this is over, I will give you all a long vacation.
After all, you've been troubled for so long. It will definitely be paid leave, and there will be bonuses for you, too, distributed as we discussed earlier."
How could Zhou Kongshan ask for more money from Lin Yi? After all, Lin Yi had already helped him so much.
He quickly waved his hand to show he needed nothing more, truly grateful that Lin Yi had helped him keep the pharmaceutical factory afloat.
If it hadn't been for Lin Yi, he wouldn't be where he was today.
"Lin Yi, why are you being so polite with me?" he asked. "Besides, if it weren't for you, how could I be where I am today? So don't be polite. I am really grateful to you for the help. This is just our beginning, and I'm sure we will be even more successful!"
Although Zhou Kongshan had no idea where Lin Yi had gotten such remarkable elixirs.
Nevertheless, that they could refine even a part was already quite an achievement.
The ingredients of these elixirs were truly beyond his knowledge.
"We will undoubtedly be more successful. Now, you guys go and rest; I'm leaving too," he said.
After all, now that the drugs had been successfully developed, there was no need to keep them in the factory every day.
Zhou Kongshan nodded; indeed, he needed a good rest, as he hadn't returned home for a long time.
The other employees, upon hearing the news, were also very happy and left for home to rest, as the factory temporarily closed.
Director Zhao found out that his schemes had been uncovered. He had planned to gather a bunch of people to deal with Lin Yi properly.
Who would have thought that those men would be defeated by Lin Yi alone? It seemed that dealing with Lin Yi was more challenging than he expected.
So, where should he strike next?
Han Xuemei was also anxiously waiting. She had been waiting so long without any news. Could it be that Director Zhao had deceived her?
"Damn it, if that old geezer has fooled me, I'll make his life a living hell!" she fumed. "He dares to deceive me? Can he bear the consequences?"
But with her current power, she had no way to contend with Director Zhao or to temper her anger with him.
After all, if Director Zhao wished, he could replace her at any moment.
At that time, she would truly be left without a support.
Meanwhile, at a banquet attended by Director Zhao, a stunningly beautiful woman appeared.
This woman was someone he had never seen before, and the gorgeous lady was heading in his direction.
Watching her graceful gait, Director Zhao felt like he was floating on air.
She was even more beautiful than the one in his villa!
"You must be Director Zhao, right? I've heard a lot about you, and I've always wanted to get to know you. I didn't expect to run into you here. It's such an honor," she said.
Seeing this beauty speaking with him and flattering him, Director Zhao was over the moon.
Could it be that his springtime had arrived? He put on an air of being a profound scholar.
Little did he know that to Ling'er, he looked extremely greasy.
"I'm still unaware of this lady's name," he said. "Being admired by such a lady is truly an honor for me!"
"My name is Xu Ling'er, and I'm from the Xu family. I came with my father today. If possible, after the banquet, may I invite Director Zhao for a small gathering? There are many matters I'd like to consult you about," she proposed.
Upon hearing this, Director Zhao nearly lost his composure. Heavens, what luck to be invited by such a beauty!
He had always been the one pursuing others before, but today was a different day!
"Of course, it would be my honor. Let's not wait for the banquet to end; let's go now. After all, if it gets too late, you, a young lady, will surely worry your father," he said.
Director Zhao was deliberately showing a considerate side.
Inside, though, he was bursting with eagerness, but he couldn't reveal his true intentions too soon; he needed to let the woman fall for him gradually.
"That's fine with me," she agreed.
And so, Director Zhao and Ling'er left for a pub to have drinks together.
At that moment, Han Xuemei in the villa was waiting endlessly for Director Zhao.
She had called him n number of times, and he had not once picked up.
What's with that old man? Might he have found a new love outside?
"Director Zhao, your phone is ringing nonstop; it's from home. Is someone looking for you? Perhaps you should answer it; it's fine by me," Ling'er suggested.
After hearing Ling'er's words, Director Zhao offered an awkward smile. He knew who was calling but didn't want to answer.
After all, compared to Ling'er, Han Xuemei's presence was insignificant.
Yet now that Ling'er had spoken, if Director Zhao didn't take the call, it would be like showing her disrespect.
So with resignation, Director Zhao answered the call.
"Haven't I told you? I have a banquet tonight and can't return early. You needn't keep calling me; it interferes with my business. When did you become so ununderstanding?" he said.
Before Han Xue Mei could even speak, Director Zhao gave her a scolding, leaving her dumbfounded.
Wasn't this Director Zhao's way of indicating that he had found a new love?
At that moment, as Han Xuemei was about to speak, Ling'er beat her to it.
"Is there an emergency at home, Director Zhao? You should go back if necessary. I don't mind; we can meet another day," she said.
Han Xuemei was so angry that she almost crushed her phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 277 Hooked
chapters.content:
"Zhao Guangchen! What do you mean? I've only been with you for a few days, and you already have someone new on the side?"
Listening to Han Xuemei's hysterical rant, Director Zhao no longer felt the sympathy he had before.
He now desperately wanted to rid himself of Han Xuemei, especially since he already had a new target in mind.
But he hadn't yet made things official with the new beauty, so he couldn't ditch Han Xuemei just yet.
"Baby, what are you talking about? She's just a regular client, nothing more. Don't think too much about it. I'll be home soon, just wait for me there like a good girl."
After finishing, Director Zhao immediately hung up the phone; he didn't want to get entangled with Han Xuemei any more than necessary.
Han Xuemei was fuming; she hadn't expected another woman to appear so soon.
Was that woman prettier than her? Why do men always tire of women so quickly?
"Zhao Guangchen, how dare you treat me like this, I will make you pay!"
But Han Xuemei was powerless at the moment; all she could do was wait in the villa for Director Zhao to return.
"Director Zhao, was that your wife who called just now? It seems she's misunderstood our relationship."
Ling'er gently tucked a stray lock of hair back into place, leaving Director Zhao utterly mesmerized.
"She just likes to get jealous, but she's not my wife. Don't overthink it. We're just boyfriend and girlfriend," said Director Zhao.
Director Zhao didn't want Ling'er to misunderstand their relationship.
After all, if Ling'er knew he was married, she might not want to be with him anymore.
Director Zhao was a long-term planner; he could already envision how happy they would be together after Ling'er agreed to be with him.
He had never imagined a woman as stunningly beautiful as her, far surpassing Han Xuemei in looks by miles.
He absolutely could not let Ling'er slip away!
"Alright, it's getting late. Let's meet another day. You should head back now, Director Zhao. My driver will be here to pick me up soon."
The tactic of playing hard to get never seems to grow old, no matter how many times it's used.
Watching Ling'er smile like a blooming flower right before him, Director Zhao felt his heart burst with joy and his pulse race.
He had never thought he could feel this way about a woman on first sight.
Despite his age, whenever he saw Ling'er, he felt as though he had instantly shed decades, rejuvenating back into a young man in his twenties.
"Will I be able to see you again, Ling'er?"
"Of course, Director Zhao. You're so knowledgeable, I might just visit your company in a few days for advice. There's a lot I want to learn from you, and my father is very pleased with me spending time with you."
Hearing Ling'er's reply, Director Zhao couldn't contain his joy.
Little did he know that he had already fallen into Ling'er's trap, all part of Lin Yi's plan.
"Then I'll wait for you at the company. You have to come, okay?"
