Director Zhao was like a boy with a first crush, eagerly looking forward to the next time he would meet the object of his affection.
"Sure."
No sooner had Ling'er finished speaking than her driver arrived. As she climbed into the sports car and drove out of sight, Director Zhao felt an overwhelming sense of loss.
He really wanted to see Ling'er once more, he wanted to never part with Ling'er again.
Thus, the dispirited Director Zhao returned to the villa.
When he saw Han Xuemei coming over aggressively, Director Zhao felt truly exhausted.
"Don't you think you owe me an explanation about that woman's voice? We've barely been together for a while, and you've already found someone new. How can you be like this?"
"I've been busy all day and am very tired. Can you stop pestering me? Don't forget that everything you have now is given by me. You should do as I say!"
Since the day Han Xuemei had been with Director Zhao, she had never heard him raise his voice to her. This was the first time.
It seemed that the man before her was no longer reliable; a new love interest meant she was useless to him. Men were indeed all the same.
"Fine, I didn't expect you to be like this. I believed in you when we first met, and that's why I was with you. But what about you?"
After saying this, Han Xuemei ran away crying. Director Zhao did not go after her to comfort her.
He only felt that he had a terrible headache right now and missed Ling'er terribly.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi received a call from Ling'er.
She said her first step had been successful; she had met Director Zhao.
And the mission was likely to be completed soon since that man was quite easy to seduce. Lin Yi told her to continue.
"Who was calling you?"
"A friend gave him a task that seems to be nearing completion. Oh and, the new enhancement drug my company has developed is about to hit the market too."
"That was quick. I thought it would take a while longer. You must be getting busy soon then, right? No worries, if you're too busy to pick me up from school, I can come back on my own."
Han Xuewei felt a bit unhappy inside, but it quickly dissipated.
She was now Lin Yi's wife, and she should prioritize Lin Yi in everything.
Lin Yi was on the rise in his career, and she definitely didn't want to cause him any trouble.
Seeing his sensible, obedient little wife made Lin Yi very happy, indeed. He was right to have married her.
"Don't worry. If I'm free, I'll still come to pick you up after work. Then we can go shopping or something together. But it seems you have exams coming up too, right?"
While Han Xuewei was very happy at the beginning of his statement, the mention of upcoming exams made her mood plummet.
Her recent study state wasn't good, mainly because of the three kids making a fuss.
"Don't even mention it. I've been wanting to revise properly, but with the kids crying and causing a scene, I just can't study. And to leave them be, it just doesn't sit well with me. After all, I gave birth to them, they're my children."
Hearing Han Xuewei's words, Lin Yi also felt distressed. He should help her share the load more.
Lin Yi held Han Xuewei in his embrace, assuring her that next time he would definitely help her take care of the children.
The next day, Lin Yi took Han Xuewei to school.
After their farewell kiss, Lin Yi headed to the pharmaceutical factory; today was the grand opening of their drugstore.
There was a lot to do. Zhou Kongshan was already waiting at the entrance.
"Lin Yi, why are you so late? We can't do without you, the boss, at the opening ceremony!"
"I was just seeing my wife off, so I got here a bit late. Is everyone here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 278 Promotion Begins
chapters.content:
It seems like all the brothers are already here, and Lin Yi has called a few media outlets over.
After all, it would be a great pity if there were no media present at this time.
"Today is the grand opening day of our Lin Family Pharmacy, and I am genuinely happy to see everyone here. I hope the journalists present can witness this sacred moment. Please, my friends, help spread the word about our opening. Of course, there will be no shortage of benefits for you."
After Lin Yi finished speaking, the reporters began taking photos. They all knew how generous this man was, so they didn't dare to slack off in the slightest.
Soon, the ribbon-cutting ceremony was successfully completed, and photos were circulating.
Director Zhao was furious when he saw such photos.
What happened? Wasn't he just not paying attention to Lin Yi for a few days, and now Lin Yi's pharmacy is open?
Does this mean he's going to compete with me now?
No, absolutely not. Lin Yi is a significant competitive force, so he must be dealt with!
"Damn it, what kind of job are you doing? Getting caught by the police and taken to the station, and not even managing to complete my task. What use do I have for someone like you? If you don't help me finish the job this time, be careful, I will deal with your family too."
Director Zhao dialed his subordinate's number and ordered him to take care of Lin Yi as soon as possible; he would not allow Lin Yi to become a pressure on him.
After hanging up Director Zhao's call, the subordinate felt extremely irritated.
He had not expected that Lin Yi, such a thin man, would have such high Attack Power.
"Brother Hu, what should we do now? Should we really go after that guy? It's clear we are not his match. If we go after him again, won't we be sacrificing ourselves in vain?"
Some of their brothers had already been arrested because of their confrontations with Lin Yi.
If they got arrested too, then they would be completely out of people. And what about their families?
"What's there to panic about? Don't we still have me? Besides, if we can't complete this task, I reckon all of us will be in trouble."
Having followed Director Zhao for a while, he knew what kind of person Director Zhao was.
They definitely weren't a match for Director Zhao.
They might as well just do as Director Zhao said and obediently complete the task.
As for dealing with Lin Yi, there must be a way, and if it really came down to it, they could start by targeting his family members.
"Brother Hu, are you suggesting we kidnap his wife?"
Indeed, that was a method, but it was said that Lin Yi protected his wife exceptionally well.
Moreover, there were many bodyguards around his wife. Could they really succeed?
"Let's try it, what if we succeed? If it works out, we won't have to worry about food and clothing in the future. Have you forgotten how much Director Zhao promised to pay us?"
Money can move even ghosts, so all these people were motivated by money. Otherwise, who would want to do such an ungrateful task?
Lin Yi's pharmacy had officially opened, but no one dared to buy their Enhancement Medicine.
"Lin Yi, it seems this business isn't easy. It's been half a day since we opened, and not a single person has come. I thought we'd sell out on the first day."
Zhou Kongshan had stood with Lin Yi at their new store for a whole day, but not a single person came.
He felt a significant sense of loss. After all the hard work, they couldn't sell even one medicine.
"These things happen; you don't need to worry. After all, we're a newly opened store, and it's normal for people to distrust us. How can they take such things lightly?"
Lin Yi, with a wry smile, reassured Zhou Kongshan that he needn't be so concerned and that soon people would come to buy.
An elderly man passed by their store, looked at it for a long time, but eventually left.
Not long after he left, the old man suddenly fell to the ground, convulsing uncontrollably. Lin Yi panicked for a moment.
The people nearby didn't dare to approach. They didn't know if the old man was really in trouble or faking it, as the number of cases where an elderly person suddenly falls to the ground to scam others was not small.
They feared that if they helped the old man up, they would end up having to compensate him a significant sum of money.
Even Zhou Kongshan hesitated for a moment, but in the end, it was Lin Yi who went forward to check on the old man.
"Old man, what's wrong? Old man?"
The old man continued to convulse, frothing at the mouth, looking very critical. With no other choice, Lin Yi had to rely on the system's power to help diagnose the old man, suddenly realizing that he had asthma.
He was already running out of breath. Lin Yi quickly fished out the asthma medication from his pocket and fed it to the old man.
After the old man took the medication, his condition improved somewhat, but it was still not good.
Lin Yi then put his Enhancement Medicine into the old man's mouth.
After taking both the asthma medication and the Enhancement Medicine, the old man immediately seemed different.
"Young man, was it you who saved me? What did you give me just now? It's slightly different from the asthma medicine I usually take."
After standing up, the old man expressed his gratitude to Lin Yi but also inquired about what he was given.
Because he clearly felt that this was not the usual asthma medication he took.
Otherwise, he would have merely reduced his condition and still needed to go to the hospital.
But now, he felt full of vigor as if nothing was wrong with him.
"Old man, this is a new type of medicine we've launched. If you're interested, you can go to our pharmacy, and I'll give you a detailed introduction."
This was also a great promotional opportunity. Lin Yi didn't pay attention to other people's reactions; instead, he escorted the old man into their pharmacy.
Others, seeing this, followed them in.
After all, with such a miraculous medicine, they wanted to see it for themselves.
"Old man, this is our new medicine. Our pharmacist here will give you an introduction. Actually, I'm not that clear on the details myself."
With that, Zhou Kongshan was pushed forward by Lin Yi.
Zhou Kongshan felt a bit nervous when he saw the crowd in front of him.
He took a deep breath and began to introduce their new product to the old man, with the others listening quietly.
"Our medicine currently doesn't have a more sophisticated name; we refer to it as Enhancement Medicine. When taken with any other medication, it will enhance the effects of that drug. That's why, a moment ago, when we were administering asthma medicine to the old man, and we added our Enhancement Medicine, he felt much better, and the result was very significant, which everyone can clearly see."

chapters.title: Chapter 279 Explosive
chapters.content:
Zhou Kongshan had just finished introducing everything, and the people in front of him were shocked and speechless.
Could such a medicine really exist? To be honest, they didn't believe it themselves.
The old man had tried it, so he believed without a doubt and immediately pulled out his wallet.
But suddenly he remembered, what if the medicine was incredibly expensive? What could he do if he couldn't afford it?
So the old man cautiously asked Lin Yi how much the medicine was actually selling for?
"Old man, you don't need to worry, our medicine here is very affordable, one pill for, in this case, a pack of it we sell for 200 yuan, and there are a total of five tablets in it."
If it had been any other time, 200 yuan for five pills really could be said to be quite expensive.
But compared to the effects of this medicine, it seemed to become much more affordable.
The old man immediately pulled out 1000 yuan and bought five packs of medicine.
Seeing this, the others also took out 200 yuan each and bought 100 to try for themselves.
They each had some ailments, more or less; some had colds, while others faced more serious issues.
They wanted to find out if this medicine really worked?
If it did, they thought, taking future medications after this could enhance the effects, which would be extremely beneficial.
Even hospitals found such medicine incredibly unbelievable.
Some hospital staff also bought some of the medicine to take back with them.
Suddenly, Lin Yi's shop appeared to become incredibly popular.
Director Zhao's people were watching Lin Yi all the time and didn't expect Lin Yi's enhanced medicine to sell even better than theirs.
Lin Yi had not overly promoted how amazing his medicine was, nor had he ever mentioned Director Zhao's company.
"Damn it! I didn't expect this guy to actually start his business, no, I can't let him steal my thunder. My medicine is obviously the best in the world, after all, I spent many years finding this formula!"
Director Zhao's heart was really unsettled.
He believed that the formula he had searched for so many years and the medicine he had developed after years of research.
Should not be so easily replaced by Lin Yi. On what basis? This made Director Zhao very uncomfortable, especially since Lin Yi's medicine was so cheap.
In comparison, it seemed that Lin Yi's home-based medicine could be a bit better, and he estimated that he would lose a lot of customers in the future.
What should he do now? Director Zhao was extremely anxious.
He dialed his subordinates once again and urged them to resolve the Lin Yi issue quickly.
But at this very moment, just after he hung up the phone, Ling'er's call came through.
"Director Zhao, do you have time today? I would like to visit your company to see you in person."
The discontent in Director Zhao's heart instantly disappeared.
Great, his new goddess was about to pay him a visit, what an honor.
Despite his age, to still receive the favor of a goddess was simply unbelievable.
"Of course, whenever you want to come, you can. I'll be waiting for you at the company. When you arrive, remember to call me, and if anyone dares to stop you, you must let me know. I'd like to see who dares to stop our Miss Ling'er."
Ling'er chuckled lightly, making Director Zhao think there was something amusing in what he had said.
But it wasn't so; the laughter was filled with Ling'er's scorn.
This man couldn't possibly believe that at his age he could still attract the favor of a beauty, right?
After all, Ling'er herself is from a prominent family, so how could she possibly compromise for the sake of family interests and end up with an old man?
Their acquaintance seemed to be full of ulterior motives, yet Director Zhao was completely oblivious.
It must be said that this man is really too foolish.
"Alright, Director Zhao."
After hanging up the phone, Director Zhao took a shower in the restroom of his office, changed into a fresh set of clothes, and made himself look more presentable.
Great, he was about to meet the goddess he admired.
Find more chapters on empire
Meanwhile, Lin Yi quickly sold out all the stock he had prepared for the day.
The customers would probably all try out their purchases as soon as they got home.
It was expected that very soon, news would break out and Lin Yi's medicine would cause a sensation in the world.
"That's it for today's work, everyone can go home and rest, I need to head home too, and pick up my wife before that."
Lin Yi checked the time, and it was almost time for his wife to finish her class, he had to hurry to pick her up.
Zhou Kongshan did the same, leaving Lin Yi and driving to his wife's school.
When Han Xuewei came out with her bag and saw Lin Yi waiting by the car door, she couldn't help feeling elated.
She felt incredibly happy just seeing her husband.
"Husband!"
Han Xuewei called out Lin Yi's name and ran towards him.
This scene made the passing students and teachers extremely envious.
Their school beauty was so lucky, wasn't she?
But then again, it was because she was the school beauty that she was able to be with such a person.
Lin Yi embraced Han Xuewei, and just at that moment, Mo Jihua walked out from behind, Lin Yi holding Han Xuewei and then looking at him.
"Tomorrow is my birthday, may I invite you both to my birthday party? After all, Xue Mei used to spend every birthday with me, and I'll really miss it if she's not there."
Mo Jihua looked at Lin Yi somewhat provocatively, but Lin Yi smiled generously and agreed to his request.
"That's fine, you are my wife's good friend, and you've known each other for so many years. If she doesn't go to your birthday party, people won't know what to say about her, so don't worry, I will definitely accompany my wife. We'll bring you a big gift as a token of our affection as a couple," Lin Yi said, although he agreed, his words were a jab at Mo Jihua's heart.
Lin Yi was really quite amusing; he appeared very magnanimous, but every word emphasized that he and Han Xuewei were now husband and wife.
"Yeah, don't worry, my husband and I will definitely be there. We are still friends, don't overthink it," Han Xuewei echoed Lin Yi's words, and in an awkward atmosphere, Mo Jihua left and Lin Yi told Han Xuewei to get into the car first.
Afterward, Lin Yi also got into the car, having received a phone call from Ling'er.
After Ling'er arrived at Director Zhao's company, she realized that this man was really good at pretending.
For a moment, Ling'er almost let her disdainful eyes show.
But fortunately, she managed to restrain herself and didn't let it show in the end.

chapters.title: Chapter 280 Incoming Call
chapters.content:
"Ling'er, you really came, I thought you were just teasing me, I never expected you to actually take the initiative to come see me."
Director Zhao's expression changed immediately upon seeing Ling'er.
To show off his tenderness, he had purposely styled his hair to look handsome.
Ling'er walked up to Zhao Guangchen.
"How could I tease you? Director Zhao, besides, our families will often be in contact in the future, and there's a contract coming up soon, I hope to earn Director Zhao's appreciation."
Director Zhao's face flushed with embarrassment when he heard Ling'er praise him like that.
He laughed loudly twice, trying to cover up his awkwardness.
"Don't worry, as long as it's a contract you discuss with me personally, I will sign it without hesitation."
Saying this, Zhao Guangchen even showed a deep affectionate look in front of Ling'er.
He couldn't possibly think he looked handsome now, could he?
If he could grow taller and lose some belly fat, maybe Ling'er would consider making him her real boyfriend.
But for now, forget it, right?
"I didn't expect you to be so good to me, Director Zhao. Since that's the case, I'll come to see you in a few days. I have some things to take care of today and must leave, but I'll definitely treat you to a meal to celebrate our contract's success."
"You're leaving just after you arrived? Why don't I treat you to lunch then?"
Director Zhao didn't want to let Ling'er go just like that, because it was the first time such a beautiful Han Xuewei had approached him on her own initiative.
In the past, it was always him doing the chasing.
Though there had been women who desperately wanted to climb into his bed before, Director Zhao found them average-looking and didn't like them.
But those who were beautiful never lacked suitors.
Director Zhao had managed to stand out from those suitors, thanks to his money and the company.
"I really do have something to take care of today. Let's choose another day for it, and I'll host. Let's not chat any longer, Director Zhao, I have to go, or I'll be late."
Ling'er declined politely, and Director Zhao didn't insist further since constantly clinging to a goddess would make her annoyed.
"Then let me escort you out. That way, everyone in the company will know not to stop you next time you come."
Director Zhao's maneuver was quite clever.
He planned to escort Ling'er out so that once the whole company saw, gossip would start to circulate, and rumors would spread.
Then, acting nonchalant, he could issue some sort of ambiguous statement.
By then, netizens would surely believe that Director Zhao and Ling'er were an item.
Director Zhao also needed to hurry up and sign those divorce papers with his wife.
Ling'er didn't refuse; she knew what Director Zhao was up to, but it was also an opportunity for her.
As expected, when company employees saw Director Zhao standing with a stunning beauty, they all sneaked out their phones to take pictures.
And they uploaded these photos to the internet.
Everyone started speculating whether Director Zhao had a new lady friend. What about his wife at home?
"Are all these beauties blind? Why do they all fall for a potbellied old man? I'm obviously much handsomer than them, how come they can't see it?"
"The guy above, you're not faceless, you might have the looks, but you don't have the money, what's the point if you don't have money? These beauties are after their wealth, you know? There's a saying that goes well, money makes the world go round."
Online, the discussions were now in full swing, and when Wang Guixiang saw such comments, her heart ached immensely.
How had her own good marriage become like this?
She must divorce Director Zhao as soon as possible, but just then, Lin Yi's call unexpectedly came through to her.
"May I speak to Ms. Wang Guixiang? I'm Lin Yi, we've met before. When your child had an accident, I was the one who took you to the hospital."
Lin Yi revealed his identity, and Wang Guixiang hadn't expected her benefactor to take the initiative to contact her.
Could it be that her benefactor had encountered some trouble and was seeking her assistance?
If she could help, she would definitely do her utmost to do so!
"So it's you, Benefactor. You're contacting me, do you need something? Don't worry, just speak boldly, I'll certainly help if I can."
Wang Guixiang was no fool; she had tried to get Lin Yi's contact information before, and he was unwilling to provide it.
Now Lin Yi had initiated contact with her, which clearly suggested he might need her help with something.
"You're a smart person. I indeed have something I need your help with. It's not a big matter. I know you and your husband, Zhao Guangchen, are at odds, and currently facing divorce, and he's had a succession of women around him, so I guess you might have given up on him, right?"
If it were any other matter, Wang Guixiang might have understood.
But Lin Yi suddenly brought up her husband, which confused her somewhat.
How did Lin Yi know her husband?
Or could it be that Lin Yi had approached her from the start with her husband in mind?
"I won't hide it from you, Benefactor; indeed, my relationship with my husband is strained. But, Benefactor, how do you know my husband?"
"When I took you to the hospital that time on the road, I actually didn't know there was any relationship between you two. Director Zhao has been targeting me recently, so I did some digging into him and that's how I learned that you are family."
Lin Yi's response was very perfect, leaving Wang Guixiang with no fault to find.
"So that's it. What is it that you want me to help you with, Benefactor?"
"Your husband has been causing me trouble lately, so I decided to take action. The beautiful lady around him was arranged by me; of course, I didn't mean to meddle in your affairs, but a cousin of mine got involved with your husband, and the beauty I planted was actually to split them up."
Hearing what Lin Yi said, Wang Guixiang just scoffed coldly. She had long stopped caring about such affairs.
In their marriage, her husband had cheated countless times, so she had grown accustomed to it.
"Just get to the point, Benefactor."
"I hope you can help me obtain some corporate secrets or dirt from your husband's company. Of course, if you are unwilling, I won't force you. I just hope today's matter won't leak out."
Lin Yi didn't pressure Wang Guixiang; he only hoped she would see clearly, and he could also help her with legal action later on.
"Let me think about it, Benefactor."
Wang Guixiang also really wanted to get back at her husband.
Enjoy new stories from empire
After all, if it weren't for that bastard's constant cheating, she wouldn't have ended up like this.

chapters.title: Chapter 281 Sister Xiao Li
chapters.content:
"Of course, I'll give you a day to think it over. After the task is complete, I'll also help you find some evidence of your husband's infidelity. I can teach you everything so you can use it in court when divorcing your husband."
This directly struck a chord with Wang Guixiang.
Although Wang Guixiang knew her husband had cheated multiple times, she didn't have any proof.
Find more to read at empire
Zhao Guangchen had really kept it very secretive, but Lin Yi said he could provide evidence.
Then, in the upcoming divorce case,
Wang Guixiang had a great chance to leave the man with nothing and gain custody of the children.
"Really? Do you really have evidence of his infidelity?"
"Of course, don't forget one of his mistresses is my cousin, so I do have the evidence."
Lin Yi was very confident that Wang Guixiang would agree, as this deal was all benefit and no harm to her.
"For me to agree to you, just show me the evidence, and I'll do it. I can help you find some dirt on him. After all, he's my husband, so I know some of his dirty secrets and company secrets."
Wang Guixiang agreed without hesitation, and Lin Yi chuckled.
He then asked Wang Guixiang to send him the information once she found it, and in return, Lin Yi would give her the evidence of the affair.
After the call, Wang Guixiang looked at her child.
She finally breathed a sigh of relief; this absurd marriage was finally coming to an end.
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi turned to Han Xuewei beside him.
His wife was indeed the best in the world, and they were not like others.
And now that Lin Yi was quite wealthy, there was no chance he would turn bad after becoming rich.
"Husband, who were you just calling?"
"I was calling someone I had saved before, who happens to be related to something I need to deal with recently, so I gave him a call."
Lin Yi explained to Han Xuewei, then began to help her select a dress.
Lin Yi's clothes were chosen by Han Xuewei, and they took turns picking.
After all, they were attending his love rival's birthday party tonight.
"But do we really need to dress up so formally? It's just a birthday party, and there won't be many people. If we're so dressed up and everyone else is casual, won't we seem out of place?"
Han Xuewei still felt it wasn't appropriate, as she had previously worn everyday clothes to birthday parties.
Now suddenly changing to a formal dress made Han Xuewei uncomfortable.
"Today we're going to outshine everyone, plus your husband will be there. Besides, doesn't this show we take his birthday party seriously? That way he can't find any fault."
In the end, persuaded by Lin Yi, Han Xuewei compromised.
At the evening birthday party, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei attended in full attire.
Indeed, they stood out from the rest of the crowd.
But it wasn't a problem – after all, what's wrong with looking good?
"Teacher Mo, happy birthday, this is a gift from me and my wife."
Lin Yi, with one arm around Han Xuewei's waist, handed the gift to Mo Jihua.
Mo Jihua received the gift, then glanced at Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's outfits, and let out a soft chuckle.
Han Xuewei's face flushed red. Was it really that strange?
"Actually, today's just a casual gathering; you didn't need to dress so formally. It makes our little get-together seem like a banquet."
Mo Jihua had meant to put Lin Yi in his place with that remark, but it seemed to have no effect whatsoever.
"Isn't it a way to show our respect for Teacher Mo? Besides, Teacher Mo, you and my wife have been friends for so long. Dressing formally is appropriate, isn't it?"
Lin Yi and Mo Jihua both smiled, but their smiles didn't reach their eyes.
"Alright, alright, come and eat some cake. Today is a day worth celebrating; let's not make everyone unhappy."
A woman standing next to Mo Jihua spoke up, someone Lin Yi had never met before.
However, Han Xuewei seemed to know her, and their relationship appeared to be quite good.
This woman exuded an androgynous charm and was very cultured and reasonable.
"Sister Li, I can't believe you're back from abroad!"
When Han Xuewei first saw Sister Li, she was thrilled and rushed to give her a big hug.
Seeing the two of them like this, Mo Jihua smiled indulgently.
Lin Yi suddenly felt like an outsider.
But mingling with others was Lin Yi's forte.
"So you're Sister Li. I've heard my wife mention you often. You two must be close. She's missed you a lot. I said that one day, if we had the chance, we'd go abroad to visit you. I didn't expect you to come back so soon."
"Hahaha, the relationship I have with this little friend of mine is indeed very good. I didn't expect her to get married so soon either. I had planned to attend the wedding, but there was never a chance to come back. This time, I'm not leaving again because there is something very important I need to deal with here."
From their conversation, one could easily tell they shared a deep bond.
After all, Sister Li was like an understanding older sister, gently patting Han Xuewei's head.
"Enough, enough. Let's not talk about such sentimental matters here. Come on, let's eat cake. You're all ignoring me, the guest of honor."
There were other friends too, but Lin Yi didn't find them significant, choosing instead to stick close to Han Xuewei.
Sometimes Han Xuewei would chat with others, but Lin Yi could not bear to be a step away from her.
Watching this scene, Sister Li, standing beside Mo Jihua, raised her glass and clinked it with his.
"I can't believe our youngest friend is already married, and I heard she has a child too. I must see the baby when I get a chance. What about you? Still can't let go of her?"
Sister Li's words cut right to the heart of their relationship.
Mo Jihua liked Han Xuewei, something Sister Li had long noticed, but Han Xuewei was oblivious.
"How could that be? I've always seen her as a sister. Your coming to my birthday today, I really didn't expect it. And you say you're not leaving? What's this important matter?"
"I came back to get married. My parents wouldn't take no for an answer."
Sister Li gave a wry smile, never expecting her life to end up this way.
But faced with her parents' insistence to the point of threats, she was helpless.
"You're getting married?"

chapters.title: Chapter 282 Birthday Party Ends
chapters.content:
```
After hearing what Sister Xiao Li said, Mo Jihua was stunned for a moment before returning to a normal expression.
"Right, I'm already getting on in years. How could I not get married? My parents are nearly dying of anxiety. I even came back recently just for matchmaking. I might get very busy soon, and if I meet the right one, I may just go ahead and get a marriage certificate, right?"
Sister Xiao Li painted herself as very pitiable, and seeing her like that, it seemed Mo Jihua had made up his mind as well.
"Though you're getting married, you'd better put in some effort with your husband, pick carefully, and don't end up with any damaged goods," he said.
"I actually have picked someone out. It's just that I don't know if that person is willing."
"Who could possibly have won Miss Li's favor? How could he not want to? If he doesn't, I'll go beat him up for you."
Mo Jihua took a sip of the drink from his glass and then chatted idly with Sister Xiao Li.
All of a sudden, Sister Xiao Li put down her glass and looked at Mo Jihua with a serious face. Mo Jihua had a bad feeling.
"The one I fancy is you. We've known each other for such a long time, can't you feel my feelings for you? Initially, I went abroad to give you two space, but I never expected your progress to be so slow. Since Han Xuewei is now married, maybe you should just settle for me," she said.
Mo Jihua swallowed hard, unable to believe what he was hearing. Had Sister Xiao Li really fallen for him? How could that be possible?
"Sister Xiao Li, this isn't the kind of thing we should joke about," he cautioned.
Mo Jihua avoided her gaze, not wishing to address the matter directly.
After all, they might even end up not being able to remain friends.
Seeing Mo Jihua's reaction, Sister Xiao Li's eyes grew dim, so she started laughing heartily again.
"You didn't really believe I liked you, did you? If I liked you, how could I possibly have gone abroad? And why would I have let you be with my little sister? Alright, it was just a joke. Don't be so serious. How was my acting?
Did I fool you?"
Sister Xiao Li patted Mo Jihua's shoulder twice before turning to leave.
As she left, a tear fell from the corner of her eye, but nobody saw.
It seems it just wasn't meant to be after all, so she might as well leave it up to fate.
If she couldn't marry Mo Jihua, then it didn't matter who she married, did it?
"Little sister, I have some things I need to take care of, so I might leave earlier. You all keep having fun. I'll come to your house in a couple of days. Remember to welcome me and bring out all three treasures for me to see. I haven't yet met my goddaughters."
Han Xuewei was somewhat reluctant to see Sister Xiao Li leave so soon.
She wanted to invite Sister Xiao Li to stay at her house tonight.
Experience more tales on empire
But knowing that Lin Yi definitely wouldn't agree, since he was very clingy.
"Sister Xiao Li, you're leaving so soon? Why don't you stay a little longer next time? We haven't got together in such a long time."
Han Xuewei tugged playfully at Sister Xiao Li's arm, swaying it back and forth, hoping she would agree.
"I knew seeing you today would be exactly like this. Come on, it's not like we won't get another chance to meet. Didn't I say? I'm not leaving again, which means we'll have plenty of opportunities to see each other in the future. But I really do have something I need to take care of today and must leave."
Sister Xiao Li affectionately ruffled Han Xuewei's hair, then said her goodbyes to everyone and left.
Mo Jihua watched Sister Xiao Li's receding figure, lost in thought.
"Husband, I always thought Teacher Mo would end up with Sister Xiao Li. I didn't expect that in the end, she would go abroad," said Han Xue.
Lin Yi had realized from the start that there was something fishy between the two of them, because the way you look at someone you love just can't lie.
```
"Maybe she had her own reasons,"
Lin Yi noticed that Han Xuewei's friends seemed to especially enjoy ruffling her hair.
"But this time, for what purpose exactly did Sister Li return, she hasn't mentioned it to us either. I hope Sister Li and Teacher Mo can end up together, they really are quite suited for each other."
When mentioning the two of them again, Han Xuewei's eyes lit up with a 'shipping' kind of gleam.
"That's really up to the two of them, we can't interfere. It's also getting late, shall we head back? The child is still at home."
Han Xuewei glanced at the time and was surprised to find it was already past ten o'clock, no wonder Sister Li had to leave.
Since it was so, they should also be on their way.
"Teacher Mo, happy birthday. We're going to head off as well since the child is still home."
Han Xuewei, arm in arm with Lin Yi, walked over to Mo Jihua, who smiled and nodded.
Following that, Han Xuewei and Lin Yi left together.
When they returned home, all three babies were already asleep, unusually well-behaved today, with no crying or fussing.
The babysitter left upon seeing the homeowners return.
"We really can't thank you enough for this period. Without you, looking after three kids, we wouldn't be able to manage. After all, with so many things to handle, if you wish to ask for a raise, you can talk to us; we will agree."
Before the babysitter left, Han Xuewei stopped her, wanting to discuss the matter of salary.
After all, taking care of three children is quite a hassle.
Handling the three kids alone for a night nearly exhausted Han Xuewei to no end.
Not to mention the babysitter, who looked after the children all day, every day.
"The salary you're offering is really quite generous already, I have no reason to ask for a raise, especially since this salary is almost four times higher than the norm."
The babysitter laughed heartily.
Truth be told, the pay was so generous that she felt too embarrassed to bring up a raise herself.
And getting a raise after such a short period might also invite envy from her peers.
"So it's like that, huh? To be honest, we aren't too familiar with these things. Alright then, there's nothing else; you can go ahead and leave."
So the salary is enough? Han Xuewei laughed awkwardly and then let the babysitter leave.
Seeing Han Xuewei act like this, Lin Yi couldn't help but feel a mix of amusement and sympathy.
Had Han Xuewei not checked the usual rates for babysitters before hiring one?
Lin Yi had thought Han Xuewei had done her research, which was why she had been so decisive about the salary.
"It feels like we might have spent too much money. No matter, the babysitter is quite competent, and she has even helped us tidy up the home."
Fearing that Lin Yi might chide her, Han Xuewei could only laugh awkwardly and then offered an explanation.
Lin Yi simply indulgently stroked Han Xuewei's head, then carried her off to their bedroom to sleep.

chapters.title: Chapter 283 Crisis
chapters.content:
The next day, Lin Yi woke up and began to busy himself with his pharmacy's affairs.
The sales of his special medicine had been quite good recently, and the online reputation was unanimously positive.
Everyone was praising Lin Yi's medicine, claiming it was unprecedented and unrepeatable!
At that time, Zhao Guangchen started to sense danger. He had not expected Lin Yi to actually have developed it.
Furthermore, those people online were comparing it with his family's product, saying Lin Yi's was somewhat better.
Heavens, what on earth was happening?
How could everything have changed after just one night?
At this moment, Ling'er called him coincidentally.
Zhao Guangchen wasn't in the mood to mingle with a beauty, but Ling'er was exactly the type he liked.
After a long contemplation, Zhao Guangchen still answered Ling'er's call.
"Hello, Ling'er, what's up? Did you call me suddenly for something important?"
"Director Zhao, have you heard about what I mentioned? It seems that a Lin Family Pharmacy has emerged out of nowhere, and they're selling special medicines too."
Ling'er deliberately brought up Lin Yi's pharmacy with Zhao Guangchen, and he indeed exploded with anger.
Why did even the woman he had just taken a liking to start taking an interest in Lin Yi?
Lin Yi, that guy, truly should not exist in this world. Otherwise, he would only become a stumbling block for himself!
"He's nothing but a pirated copy of what our company developed. Ling'er, you mustn't believe what those people online are saying. They're all paid commenters hired by Lin Yi. I've met the guy before, and he's actually not that great. Plus, he already has a wife."
Zhao Guangchen was very afraid that Ling'er would take an interest in Lin Yi, given that Lin Yi was younger than him.
More handsome than him, taller than him, with a better physique than him.
And now he might even surpass his own achievements.
Zhao Guangchen was truly very afraid. If he couldn't keep Ling'er, he might even lose Han Xuemei.
After all, Han Xuemei had already started to doubt him, and his treatment of her had also turned sour.
"So that's how it is. At first, I actually thought that the medicine he developed was really magical. I didn't expect it was just a copycat of your company, Director Zhao!"
Ling'er pretended to have an epiphany, even her voice carrying a trace of anger.
That was when Zhao Guangchen finally breathed a sigh of relief.
"If that's the case, Director Zhao, how can you let him continue to be so presumptuous? You really need to deal with him properly. How can he go around selling his pirated products? Director Zhao, if you have evidence, you should just post it online and crush him, make sure that store of his can never surface again."
How could Zhao Guangchen possibly have any evidence? He was completely bluffing.
"After all, he's just a young man starting out. I don't need to be hell-bent on destroying him. It'll be fine once everyone later realizes who really has the best medicinal materials. Ling'er, you don't need to worry about this."
In the end, Zhao Guangchen found a very weak excuse and muddled through, but Ling'er was not fooled at all.
Ling'er lay on her high-level sofa, fiddling with her nails, her other hand holding a cellphone.
She was pondering how to make Zhao Guangchen slip up and take action against Lin Yi.
This would also help Lin Yi to deal with him properly later on.
"Alright, Director Zhao, since you've put it that way, I'll stay out of it. But there are still some things you need to do, it's better to be more decisive, otherwise it might hinder you, and later on, it could even become a stumbling block for both of us," she said.
Ling'er didn't make her point too clear.
However, Director Zhao was a clever person, and he instantly understood what Ling'er meant.
Now that Ling'er had already referred to them as 'both of us', it indicated that she had that intention towards him as well.
But Ling'er wasn't sure whether her family would choose to collaborate with Lin Yi if he rose to power.
By that time, Ling'er would certainly be a trophy for them to flaunt their connection to power.
"Ling'er, don't worry. He definitely won't be a hindrance to us, and I absolutely won't let your family collaborate with Lin Yi. Go back and persuade your parents. Our company is still very stable, and in the pharmaceutical industry, we're a major player, so if you're going to choose a partner, it's better to collaborate with me!"
Zhao Guangchen was fooled, and Ling'er laughed contentedly a couple of times before agreeing with what Zhao Guangchen had said.
Afterwards, she ended the call and dialed Lin Yi.
She warned Lin Yi to be careful lately, as Zhao Guangchen might make a move against him. Continue reading at empire
"That fool can't deal with me, but I advise you to do less. Otherwise, he might turn his attention to you."
Initially, Lin Yi only wanted Ling'er to seduce Zhao Guangchen and then dump Han Xuemei.
To teach Han Xuemei a lesson, otherwise that woman would only bring more trouble to himself.
Unexpectedly, Ling'er increasingly found the game very amusing.
She even wanted to raise the stakes and thoroughly toy with Zhao Guangchen.
"Aren't you confident in me by now? I've done these kinds of things many times. Besides, he's just a stinky old man. You're not worried that I'll fall for him, are you? He's nothing but my toy, and when this is all over, don't forget what you promised me."
Ling'er didn't want to listen to Lin Yi preaching to her, so she hung up swiftly.
This little girl always loved to play. She should be careful not to get burnt playing with fire.
However, recently many media outlets wanted to interview Lin Yi, who had not yet decided which one to choose.
After all, such matters were very formal and also very important.
If his responses were improper, he could very well bring his defenses into crisis, with everyone watching him.
Other pharmaceutical companies had also noticed Lin Yi.
They originally thought dealing with Zhao Guangchen alone was troublesome enough, but then Lin Yi appeared on the scene.
Moreover, it was said that Lin Yi's medicine seemed to be even more effective than those from Zhao Guangchen's company.
"Where on earth did these guys get it from? Why haven't we told the staff in the factory to put in more effort? Have they learned all their knowledge for nothing? And the salaries I pay them aren't for them to come and play around without developing a single hit product!"
People from the Wang Family were nearly fuming. No matter how you looked at it, they were in this business for generations, a legacy that continued until now.
Yet unexpectedly, their generation had begun to decline, with many formulas having disappeared.
They had thought that even without those formulas, they could still dominate alone.
However, a few years ago, Zhao Guangchen suddenly appeared, and now Lin Yi had emerged as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 284 Wang Family
chapters.content:
"Master, what should we do now? We can't let him go on like this; otherwise, we will have two rivals!"
Standing next to Grandfather Wang was his youngest son, a child naturally prone to frivolity.
Moreover, he didn't have much understanding of these work-related issues.
The reason he said this was entirely to prevent anyone from surpassing him.
The Wang Family was actually in the pharmaceutical industry and had a reputable standing.
But due to the emergence of Zhao Guangchen, their family had gradually been forgotten, which greatly upset him.
He used to be the boss in his circle of friends, but now they had begun to mock him.
"You little brat, what do you know? Do you think it's that simple to make it disappear? He has just appeared, and his medicine is widely praised. If we take action against him, we will surely raise suspicions."
It really was a headache; Lin Yi was indeed a difficult opponent to deal with.
Grandfather Wang was also considering whether they should befriend Lin Yi, as it could lead to potential collaboration later on.
If they could get a share of Lin Yi's medicine, they could make a lot of money.
Actually, by this time, they no longer hoped to become famous.
They just wanted to properly manage the family business; otherwise, they would face the risk of bankruptcy.
"Dad, but if we don't take action against him, what are we going to do later? Have you thought about that? Honestly, I'm not trying to undermine you, Dad, I'm just asking how we should handle this matter?"
When had his youngest son become so concerned about the family? Grandfather Wang didn't want to think about this matter anymore.
He needed to seriously consider whether to make friends with or enemies of Lin Yi.
"You go out first and let me think alone. Remember not to go out; always running around outside, I haven't seen you achieve anything." Continue reading on empire
Grandfather Wang truly felt disappointed in his youngest son.
Although his eldest son was currently in a comparatively good state, he did not measure up to the other distinguished young masters.
Could it really be that their family would decline in this generation?
Upon hearing his father speak of him in such a way, the youngest son was also angry and left without looking back.
He was determined to be contrary to his father. Was it wrong for him to enjoy playing? Moreover, with such a large family enterprise, couldn't it support one idle person like him?
All he wanted in life was to live comfortably; was that not allowed?
Did he have to fight tooth and nail like his older brothers?
Han Xuemei on the other side had not expected Lin Yi's pharmaceutical industry to truly take off and, moreover, to seem quite successful.
It was infuriating! Why did such a good man end up with Han Xuewei.
If only he were hers.
Han Xuemei still hadn't given up on Lin Yi, but she knew she had no chance anymore.
The moment she started following Director Zhao, she lost all opportunity with Lin Yi.
"I never thought Zhao Guangchen would have found himself a new love interest so quickly. No way, I can't let him have what he wants. If that little vixen outshines me, how am I supposed to face anyone? Besides, if Zhao Guangchen doesn't care about me anymore, who else can I rely on?"
With these thoughts, Han Xuemei decided to go to the company to see what state Zhao Guangchen was in.
She also wanted to find out who that woman was.
After dressing neatly and putting on her sunglasses, Han Xuemei grabbed her limited edition purse and left her house for the Zhao Corporation.
Upon arriving at the Zhao Corporation, she didn't expect to be stopped right at the reception desk by the front desk attendant.
"I'm sorry, miss, could you tell me whom you're here to see? You're not wearing our employee badge, so you're not allowed to enter."
Seeing how Han Xuemei was dressed, one might think she was here to cozy up to the CEO.
The receptionist who had previously humiliated Lin Yi had been replaced, and the new one was even less competent.
True enough, upon seeing Han Xuemei, an expression of disdain immediately appeared on her face.
She had been here for a while and had never heard of anyone named Han Xuemei.
"I'm here to see Director Zhao. Just tell him and let me go up. My relationship with your Director Zhao isn't ordinary. If you dare stop me, be careful he doesn't come down and fire you on the spot."
After saying her piece, Han Xuemei strutted forward, intending to go up, but the receptionist stopped her again.
This time, the receptionist's face showed clear contempt.
What is this woman thinking? She couldn't possibly believe that just saying a few words was enough to get her through.
She really thought she had a relationship with Director Zhao, who was, in fact, married.
The wife of Director Zhao, whom the receptionist had seen, was indeed quite beautiful but not fashionably dressed and was already of a certain age.
"I'm sorry, miss, but since you know our Director Zhao, could you please call him to come down and fetch you? We can't get in touch with him directly."
Though the words were apologetic, the face was full of mockery.
It seemed they were laughing at Han Xuemei's delusions of grandeur, and this infuriated her.
"You bunch really can't see beyond your noses, can you? How have you not heard of me? Hasn't Director Zhao mentioned me to you? Even though I'm not his wife, my status is much higher than hers. If you dare to stop me again, you'll all be fired!"
Looking at Han Xuemei's haughty demeanor, the receptionists almost believed her.
But they had already sent a text to Director Zhao and he hadn't mentioned knowing a Han Xuemei.
Actually, Director Zhao wasn't willing to pay any attention to Han Xuemei at all.
She was there for a few predictable reasons: either to get him to buy things for her, or to ask about Lin Yi.
Yet now Director Zhao was already overwhelmed with matters related to Lin Yi, how could he possibly have time for Han Xuemei?
What's more, his feelings for Han Xuemei had cooled significantly.
"Stop being stubborn here. I just asked Director Zhao, and he definitely doesn't recognize you. Now, now, hurry along. I've seen plenty like you before. If you really want to seduce a man, could you kindly do it outside? Don't cause trouble in our company.
If you don't leave now, I'm calling security!"
The receptionist rolled her eyes and went back to her station, leaving Han Xuemei dumbfounded.
Zhao Guangchen had the audacity to say he didn't know her?!
Had he lost his mind? No matter what, she had been with him for a time, hadn't she!

chapters.title: Chapter 285 Comfort
chapters.content:
"Call him out for me; I called him and he didn't answer. What does he mean by this? Is he really planning on forcing me to spill all his secrets?"
Han Xuemei had thrown caution to the wind regarding her own image, and she immediately started shouting loudly right at the entrance.
Soon, she drew the attention of passersby, and even the security guard at the door approached Han Xuemei.
Director Zhao, hearing the commotion downstairs, thought this crazy woman was really going to shout and scream here.
Had she completely lost regard for her own image?
Wasn't she a woman who cared greatly about her image?
Left with no choice, Director Zhao had to show himself and then led the woman into his office.
But the gossiping desire of the onlookers couldn't be reined in.
"What's happening here? What's the relationship between that woman and Director Zhao? Although there were rumors of Director Zhao having many girlfriends, I never thought we'd actually see one today. No woman has ever caused a scene in the company before."
"Yeah, she's really bold, isn't she afraid of being discarded by Director Zhao? Or does Director Zhao really like her but if he did, why didn't he let her go up?"
The employees outside were gossiping about the relationship between the two.
Director Zhao scolded Han Xuemei, his face lined with frustration.
All this—the sight of Director Zhao pulling Han Xuemei up the stairs—was captured by Lin Yi's people and sent to Wang Guixiang's cell phone.
Wang Guixiang didn't expect to receive evidence so quickly; Lin Yi's words seemed to be true.
She needed to accelerate her efforts to gather more information about her husband's affair.
"Have you lost your mind? What are you doing at my company? Don't you know our relationship cannot be seen by others? I told you, just wait for me in the villa, why did you have to come out? And to make such a scene at the company, did you do it on purpose?"
When Zhao Guangchen saw Han Xuemei, he bore none of the gentle appearance he once showed.
To her, he had become unrecognizable.
This man was everything to her when he pursued her, but now that he had a new love, his attitude had shifted dramatically.
"Why do you think I came looking for you, don't you understand? What's the deal between you and that woman? I've only been with you for a few days, and you've already found someone new. How can you treat me like this? You can't do this to me!"
As Han Xuemei spoke, tears began to fall.
In the past, whenever Director Zhao saw Han Xuemei cry, he would pull her into his arms, unwilling to let her go.
But now he was on the verge of being driven mad.
His company was about to crumble, and he still had to divorce his wife—if another thing like this happened, it could be the death of him.
He waved his hands to admonish Han Xuemei, telling her not to cry anymore, not to disturb his peace of mind here.
If she wanted to cry, she should go home and cry.
"Can you not cry here? It's distressing to watch. If you feel like crying, go cry somewhere else, and don't ever come to the company again, do you hear? Otherwise, I'll cancel all your cards!"
Director Zhao shouted at Han Xuemei, leaving her dumbfounded on the spot.
Was this still the man who had adored her before?
Clearly, she should never have entrusted herself to Director Zhao.
She had actually thought at the beginning that Director Zhao could help her.
And now she was completely dumbfounded, wasn't she? He didn't take you seriously at all.
"Fine! Remember how you treated me today. I will definitely pay you back double in the future, and I won't stay in that crappy villa of yours any longer. Do you really think I don't have any evidence of your dirty deeds? I'm telling you, you won't get away with crossing me unscathed!"
After saying this, Han Xuemei stormed off, full of fury.
Explore more stories at empire
Seeing that things were going south, Director Zhao hastily grabbed Han Xuemei's arm, and then softly whispered as he pulled her into his embrace.
He couldn't afford to have a falling out with Han Xuemei just yet, especially since, as she said, he did indeed have a few skeletons in his closet where she was concerned.
Who asked him to spend time with her?
"Alright, alright, I was just a bit rash because I was anxious about Lin Yi's issue, so I lost my temper. I apologize, okay? I'll give you another card. If there's anything you want to buy, you can get it all. Stop bothering me here, will you? Let me have some peace to think about how to deal with Lin Yi.
Isn't this also for our future? And I'll definitely take care of what I promised you. I'm already figuring out how to deal with Lin Yi."
Zhao Guangchen spoke to Han Xue with soft and gentle words, and she began to believe him again somewhat.
This man was quite reliable; after all, he had chased her persistently in the beginning.
So Han Xuemei was actually unwilling to believe that Zhao Guangchen would treat her this way.
Eventually, Han Xuemei dried her tears, acted coy for a while, and then left.
On her way out, she specifically told Zhao Guangchen to fire the two receptionists at the entrance.
"Don't worry, I will definitely fire the two of them. Who let them upset my darling? Remember to text me when you get home. I might not be able to come back and stay with you for the next few days, I have too much on my plate."
Since Zhao Guangcheng was treating her this way for the sake of dealing with Lin Yi,
Xuemei could overlook it, as long as she could trample Lin Yi underfoot mercilessly.
After Han Xuemei went downstairs, she shot a fierce glance at the receptionists, and they immediately lowered their heads.
They knew they had offended the wrong person and couldn't believe that woman really had a relationship with their Director Zhao.
Now they were in trouble, probably about to be fired soon.
"Weren't the two of you acting all high and mighty at first? Continue that, why don't you? How come you're not acting tough now?"
Han Xuemei deliberately walked up to them, stopped, and taunted them.
The receptionists kept their heads down, sweating bullets, and didn't dare say a word,
fearing that they might say something else to displease her.
After seeing them cower, Han Xuemei scolded them and departed.
This incident spread among the people, and the rumors started from there.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi was bustling with vigorous energy, and his business was booming.
Lin Yi spent every day in his pharmacy, with customers coming and going relentlessly.
Zhou Kongshan was almost too busy to manage, and Lin Yi felt it was time to hire more staff.
But even if he hired more people, Lin Yi wouldn't just hire anyone. Why bring trouble to his business by hiring incompetent people?
"Do you have any preferred candidates over there? Actually, we don't need to research new medicines right now. We could transfer some people from the factory over."

chapters.title: Chapter 286 Kidnapping
chapters.content:
```
"I haven't seen anyone suitable recently, and they are all devoted to their research. They wouldn't be interested in this sort of thing, so you'd better recruit externally."
Zhou Kongshan also found this matter quite troublesome.
The people here generally love their research, so it's unlikely they would leave this place.
Going out to recruit people or sell things, either way.
Lin Yi had no choice but to transfer people from elsewhere.
"Alright, then you keep busy. I'm keeping watch here. We did have a lot of visitors today."
"Fine, I'll hang up first."
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi looked around the empty room and felt a severe headache.
What should he do next? He couldn't possibly keep watch here every day.
So he still needed to find some other people to help him.
Meanwhile, Director Zhao wasn't idling. He was continuously searching for ways to deal with Lin Yi.
He had already instructed his subordinates that if those idiots couldn't handle it, then he would just have to fire all of them.
He wasn't giving them so much money just to let them eat for free.
But now he had an even more troublesome issue at hand; his scandal with Han Xuemei had spread everywhere.
What if his little goddess found out about this?
"Damn it! Why did Han Xuemei that crazy woman have to yell all over the office? Didn't I give her enough money? What's she dissatisfied with after being with me? Does she really think I would fulfill those sweet nothings I said before? As soon as there's a better option, I'd certainly dump her."
Because Director Zhao hadn't gotten Ling'er yet, he didn't dare to quickly say goodbye to Han Xuemei yet.
He still quite liked Han Xuemei's personality and looks.
If he lost Han Xuemei before securing Ling'er, Director Zhao felt that the loss would outweigh the gain.
After all, he had also spent a lot of money on Han Xuemei.
On the other side, Director Zhao's men had directly gone to Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's apartment.
There, they encountered the nanny.
Upon seeing intruders, the nanny panicked and grabbed her phone to call Lin Yi.
But they harshly grabbed her, slapped her, and then snatched the phone away.
"I warn you, you'd better behave. If I find out you dare to call the police, I'll kill you. Now, you're only allowed to send a text to Lin Yi, telling him, his three children are with me. If he doesn't come to see me, then I can only express my regrets for those three children."
Seeing that these people meant business, the nanny could only oblige and send Lin Yi a text message as instructed.
Lin Yi was in the middle of his worries when he heard the ring of his phone and immediately looked down to check.
He didn't expect it to be such a matter.
"These guys really did come looking. Director Zhao wouldn't want to have a life-and-death struggle with me, would he? I shouldn't pose such a big threat to him now."
Lin Yi grumbled to himself and drove back in a hurry.
But when he returned, he only found the nanny unconscious on the floor, and his children were nowhere to be seen.
```
He didn't dare to tell Han Xuewei about this matter.
Otherwise, Han Xuewei would definitely be very anxious at school, and Han Xuewei couldn't help anyway.
So Lin Yi planned to solve the problem by himself before telling Han Xuewei, or maybe not to tell her at all.
Lin Yi arrived at the designated spot, the abandoned warehouse.
"I really didn't expect you to come alone. I thought you would bring some backup. But it doesn't matter now. Lin Yi, if you have to blame someone, blame yourself for hurting our boss. Though I don't know why someone like you would foolishly offend our boss, those who have offended our boss have never had a good ending!"
These thugs were very arrogant under Director Zhao's protection; they had always had it easy.
But it was Lin Yi's arrival that had made their situation difficult.
Director Zhao would no longer indulge them as before and wouldn't give them generous sums of money.
Moreover, Director Zhao had made a fierce declaration, if they couldn't deal with Lin Yi this time, then none of them should expect to get a single penny.
Even their families would be implicated.
This time, they were staking everything on killing Lin Yi to eliminate future threats for their boss.
"I never intended to offend your boss. Right now, I don't even know who your boss is. Maybe you'd like to tell me?"
Lin Yi stepped closer to them, step by step, and for some reason, they began to fear this man who had come alone to the meeting.
But they quickly dismissed the thought. He was just one person, and they had at least ten. Why should they be afraid of one man?
"Stop! Stay right there, don't come any closer, or if you take one more step forward, I'll have your three kids call out to you down below."
One of the thugs spoke up, holding Lin Yi's three children in his arms.
The three kids were very young, all at the stage of learning to speak.
The sudden catastrophe made them cry their eyes out.
The ruffians were also getting a bit irritated by these children.
They even hit the children's backs roughly a couple of times, which made Lin Yi's face turn dark on the spot.
Continue your adventure at empire
These guys seemed to be rushing towards their deaths.
Lin Yi had already thought of a way to deal with them.
"Didn't you ask me to come? Now I'm here, can you let my three children go? They're still small and should pose no threat to you, right? Can you put them aside? If you have any problems, let's talk it out between ourselves."
Before coming, Lin Yi had already sent his location to his partners, who would be arriving soon.
At that time, it wouldn't be clear who would be begging for mercy, so now Lin Yi needed to buy time.
"They are my means of threatening you. I'm not that foolish to put them aside. How can I threaten you then? Besides, we know about your strength. Weren't you very powerful? Why can't you show your strength now?
Take that small knife over there, and stab it into your leg."
This also counted as avenging their brother, who had been deeply humiliated by Lin Yi!
"Fine, but don't you dare do anything rash. If even a tiny bit of harm comes to my children, I will make you pay a severe price!"
Lin Yi's face was cold as he picked up the small knife nearby, and then fiercely plunged it into his own thigh without even letting out a cry.
It seemed as if the three children could sense their father's condition, and they stopped crying.

chapters.title: Chapter 287 Support Has Arrived
chapters.content:
"You're quite the devoted father to your child, aren't you? Now get on your knees and kowtow to us a few times as revenge for my wounded brothers. You really didn't hold back before, showing no mercy at all!"
Who would have thought this guy was so loyal? Even now, he's still concerned about his brothers-in-arms.
Lin Yi suddenly heard the sound of motorcycles outside, indicating his brothers were arriving.
The time was up for these guys. Weren't they acting all high and mighty just a moment ago? Lin Yi was about to make sure they couldn't be arrogant anymore!
"Expecting me to kowtow to you? You must not know how many 'balls' are on your own heads."
Just now, Lin Yi had been completely compliant with them. Why had his demeanor suddenly changed?
The leader, infuriated, couldn't believe it. They had just breathed a sigh of relief; how could they let Lin Yi off so easily?
"If you don't kneel and kowtow now, watch out—I might make sure your three children never return home. Lin Yi, aren't you being too arrogant? Or is it that you just don't care about your three children at all?"
The gang leader lifted the three children abruptly, causing Lin Yi's pupils to dilate as he dropped to one knee on the ground.
It was the very moment Lin Yi knelt on one knee that his brothers burst through the door on their motorcycles, shattering the door to pieces.
This sudden turn of events left the thugs present dumbfounded.
What was happening, how had they suddenly become the ones surrounded?
But they quickly realized, was Lin Yi planning a double-cross?
Luckily, they still held Lin Yi's children in their grasp, so he wouldn't dare make any rash moves.
"I warn you—if you try anything stupid, your children won't be leaving here today."
These people had been in the game for quite some time, so they reacted extremely quickly to such situations.
They immediately clutched the three children tightly in their arms.
Lin Yi stood up from the ground.
His good pal Hei Lang approached his side.
"Why would I act rashly? But I advise you to consider your actions carefully as well. If you cause my three children to be unable to leave here today, not only will I ensure you don't leave this place, but your family members won't escape either. Before I came, I already had my brothers investigate your backgrounds thoroughly.
I know exactly how many people there are in your families, so weigh your options carefully."
This time, the home advantage had shifted. Lin Yi sat nonchalantly with his legs crossed on a stool that Hei Lang had brought over, looking down at them from above.
The little thugs were already shaking with fear. What sort of person had they chosen to confront?
They had truly been blind to follow Director Zhao.
Now they had not only found an adversary, but they also saw no way out.
"Boss, what do we do now? We're no match for this guy, and if we run away now, the consequences will be terrible. Boss, you need to think of something!"
In their desperation, the thugs began to shake their leader beside them.
At this moment, the gang leader was sweating profusely. How was he supposed to know what to do?
He had no idea that he would encounter such a tough nut to crack.
Director Zhao had never mentioned that Lin Yi would have so much support.
"Lin Yi, you better think this through. Our deaths mean nothing to you, but what about your children? Are you really willing to take that risk?"
Lin Yi continued to watch them coldly, saying not a word. Everything was entirely up to them to decide.
After all, Lin Yi had already laid out their possible fates before them.
When they said such things to Lin Yi, did they ever consider that for themselves, it was actually the same outcome?
Was it really worth it to ruin their entire lives for three unrelated children? And the lives of their own families too?
Explore stories on empire
After staring each other down for nearly three minutes, the gangsters finally couldn't hold out any longer. A few of them fell to their knees on the ground, begging Lin Yi for mercy.
"Big brother, we were wrong, we truly realize our mistake. We never intended to do anything like this from the start, it's all Director Zhao, the one you know as Zhao Guangchen; he's the one who told us to do this. Please, could you let us go?"
"Yes, yes, everything we've done was under the orders of Director Zhao. Let those who owe the debt pay the debt. If you really want revenge, please go find that man!"
These people were really cowardly and fearful. It was a mystery how Zhao Guangchen could raise such a bunch of men.
Utterly useless, and at the critical moment, they'd even betray their own.
"I will seek revenge on that man, but right now I need to deal with you lot. If you truly want to save your lives, then I suggest you convince your boss," Lin Yi said.
Lin Yi cocked his leg and glanced at his watch. They didn't have much time left.
If they didn't make a decision soon, Lin Yi was ready to resort to violent means.
"Boss, what are you waiting for? If we don't return the children to him, we're all going to die here today. Boss, do you really want to see that outcome?"
Under the persuasive talks, the gangsters began to plead with their boss.
Under pressure from his subordinates, the boss finally returned the children to Lin Yi.
But Lin Yi had no intention of letting them off so easily.
After all, when these men were torturing him earlier, they had shown no mercy.
"You're dishonest! Didn't I return the children to you already? Why are you still treating us this way?"
The gangsters were indignant. They had clearly returned the children to Lin Yi, so why were they not allowed to leave?
Instead, they were surrounded by these menacing figures.
"You did return the children to me, but did I ever say I'd let you go? I've always allowed you to make your own choices. I won't go after your families now, but that doesn't mean I won't go after you. Weren't you quite happy while tormenting me earlier?"
Lin Yi held his three children in his arms. Now, with wide-open eyes, the children looked up at their father without a trace of fear.
Finally, Lin Yi gave the command, leaving everything to Hei Lang to handle on his own.
Lin Yi trusted that Hei Lang would take care of it.
And he wouldn't let these men off easily or let them die.
After all, so many sudden deaths would raise suspicions elsewhere.
And so, Lin Yi left with his children, leaving behind only the abandoned warehouse from where howls of pain and screams of agony echoed.

chapters.title: Chapter 288 Life-saving Straw
chapters.content:
Lin Yi returned home with the children, and as soon as Han Xuewei received the call from the nanny, she hurried back from school.
Lin Yi had originally intended to keep the incident a secret.
But unexpectedly, the nanny spilled the beans to Han Xuewei, who cried nonstop after arriving back home.
"Alright, wife, stop crying. Hasn't the problem been resolved? Why are you still crying? The children, I've already rescued them. Rest assured, I definitely won't let anything like this happen again."
Lin Yi promised his wife that such an incident would absolutely not happen again, but Han Xuewei was only focused on her grief at that moment.
How could she have let her children fall into such danger? It was utterly absurd. How could she qualify as a mother?
"What exactly happened? Why were the children kidnapped? Lin Yi, did you offend someone out there?"
This was the first time Han Xuewei had been so furious with Lin Yi. He was taken aback for a moment, then gently and softly began to explain to Han Xuewei.
He hadn't offended anyone; it was those people who were bad-hearted and jealous.
"But what if the children fall into danger again? They are still so young, husband, we can't let them be in danger anymore. Husband, if it really comes to it, let's move, okay?"
Han Xuewei was a bit panicked; she didn't know how to handle the situation, because she felt that no matter what, it seemed like the children would never be truly safe in the end.
"Wife, don't be so anxious. Aren't we trying to find a solution? If you keep panicking like this, what are we going to do next? Alright, alright, let me handle this matter. I will definitely eradicate all those who targeted our children, alright? Weren't you supposed to have an exam today?
Why did you suddenly run back from school?"
Han Xuewei had just finished the first subject when she received the call from the nanny, so she immediately asked her teacher for leave and ran back home.
"Husband, I know I can't blame you for this, but I really don't want our children to be in danger again in the future, or to be unable to live a good life."
Tears streaked Han Xuewei's face so profusely that Lin Yi couldn't wipe them away fast enough.
Lin Yi could only hold his wife gently and comfort her.
Things won't be that way; everything will get better.
After consoling his wife, Han Xuewei returned to the room to be with her three children.
Find your next read at empire
Lin Yi went out to the balcony, his expression very grim.
He had not expected Director Zhao to be so cunning and to target his children and family.
Initially, Lin Yi had no intentions of troubling Director Zhao, but now things were different.
He only wanted to see Director Zhao's family ruined and him dead without a place to be buried. No, perhaps a fate worse than death would be more fitting.
Meanwhile, Zhao Guangchen became even more frightened after learning that all the thugs he sent had failed.
What kind of person was Lin Yi exactly? The hoodlums he had trained were all very powerful.
He had never failed in any task before, but this time he was helpless against Lin Yi.
"What am I going to do now!"
As Zhao Guangchen panicked, Wang Guixiang gave him a call. He didn't think twice before answering.
He had planned on ignoring this woman, but then he suddenly remembered that Wang Guixiang's family actually had some power.
It could be a good choice to rely on them to deal with Lin Yi.
"Honey, why did you suddenly call me today? Are you missing me? Don't worry, I'll come home after work, or where are you now? I can drive to pick you up, or are you planning to have dinner with me?"
Director Zhao had never acted like this before. Whenever there was a change, it meant he was up to something with Wang Guixiang.
Wang Guixiang snorted coldly—if it were before, maybe she would have dinner with Director Zhao.
But now she had seen through this man and just wanted to divorce him as soon as possible.
However, she still had to complete the task Lin Yi gave her.
"Husband, could you come home for a while? I have some things I want to talk to you about. By the way, has the company been having some trouble lately?"
So his wife missed him. Director Zhao was very happy and immediately agreed to come home.
And he informed Wang Guixiang that he would be home soon.
He told her not to worry, to just cook a nice meal at home and wait for him.
Meanwhile, Han Xuemei was also anxiously waiting for Director Zhao to return, but now Director Zhao had no time to spare for Han Xuemei.
"I'll come home soon. Recently the company indeed encountered some issues, but you don't have to worry about it; it won't affect us."
Still so stubborn at death's door.
How could it possibly not affect their company? He was probably scheming something in his mind.
After hanging up the call, Wang Guixiang did not prepare any food but stayed together with her younger son.
Director Zhao sent a text to Han Xuewei saying he would not return tonight, so she shouldn't wait up for him.
Han Xuewei was furious. She had dressed up so beautifully, ready to seduce Director Zhao again.
After work, Director Zhao rushed home non-stop and saw that Wang Guixiang and his child were waiting for him.
He ran over wanting to hug his son, but the boy dodged him.
"My sweet boy, have you been missing Daddy? The company has been really busy lately, so I haven't had time to come home. I've neglected you, and Daddy is wrong. How about Daddy apologizes to you?"
"Dad, do you have a new family outside? Is that why you refuse to come back? I've seen the news already. Dad, if you really have a new family out there, please don't come back to our home anymore."
Director Zhao was left speechless on the spot; children of today are so precocious, even knowing about such matters.
Zhao Guangchen coughed awkwardly twice, then stopped paying attention to his younger son.
He walked back to his wife's side, trying to take Wang Guixiang's hand.
But she dodged, leaving him wondering what this all meant.
"What have you been telling our child? I'm telling you, all those things outside are misunderstandings, just gossip. As a high-profile CEO, I'm bound to have some rumors, you shouldn't take them seriously, my wife. You're the only one for me!"
Even at this point, Zhao Guangchen was still planning to keep things from Wang Guixiang.
He couldn't truly think Wang Guixiang was a fool, could he?
Wang Guixiang had cursed him countless times in her heart.
"I know, I called you back today to talk about this. The company is having a hard time now, isn't it? I'm thinking about reaching out to my family to see if they can help you out."

chapters.title: Chapter 290 Seeing Everyone Clearly
chapters.content:
Lin Yi truly felt helpless, as he inexplicably ended up carrying this blame.
Moreover, if it had not been for Director Zhao investigating him and being against him from the beginning, Lin Yi would not have fought back against the two of them.
With actions and reactions, naturally, the situation had evolved into what it was now.
So Director Zhao had no grounds to complain about Lin Yi here.
"Talking about this now is still premature, you should first take care of yourself. Your side must already be in chaos, right? And are you sure there isn't a problem with your family's medicine? If there's no problem, why have this year's sales been continuously dropping? Could it be that you can no longer find the raw materials?"
This was information that Wang Guixiang had told Lin Yi, which he found quite interesting.
No wonder their family's medicine sales were not good this year, and people were saying that their medicine was not as effective as before.
It turned out their medicine had lost its original raw materials, or even that they could no longer find the raw materials.
They had simply found something similar to pose as the real thing, thus naturally reducing the medicinal effect.
"You're spouting nonsense, don't slander without proof. You have no evidence, what gives you the right to make wild accusations? I know our company's sales have not been good this year, but do you think the foundation we've built over the years could be shaken by a mere newcomer like you?
Lin Yi, I admit I underestimated you before, but from now on, I will treat you seriously as an opponent," Director Zhao said, sounding defiant.
Even at this juncture, Director Zhao continued to be stubborn; he would definitely not let this matter get out. Absolutely not!
And he absolutely couldn't let it get out. Once exposed, his downfall would be extremely miserable.
Those who had bought medicine from him would know they had been sold fakes.
There had already been precedents for selling fake medicines; he didn't want to be one of them. He would certainly guard this secret with his life.
Although he didn't know where Lin Yi had gotten his information from,
since Lin Yi had come to confront him today, it meant that he didn't have any evidence in hand.
If he did, he would have made it public already. Why else would he bother calling him?
"Alright, if you're not willing to admit it, I won't force you, but I hope your methods can be more above board.
