Don't go after my family again, and if I find out you've targeted my family, it won't be this simple, got it? My last line of defense is my family. If I find out you've done anything to them, even remotely, I will make you pay a painful price!"
Lin Yi had no objections to fighting between them; even if someone was sent to take his life, it wouldn't make him bat an eyelid.
But what he couldn't tolerate the most was targeting his family members.
Dragging innocent people into this, for what reason?
"So you already knew. But Lin Yi, in our circle, that's just the rules of the game. If you don't have the ability to protect your own family, you might as well leave our circle as soon as possible. Don't delude yourself with thoughts of coming back. What makes you, an ordinary person, think you can blend into our circle?
You have merely just started rising, and your medicinal effect is only significant because of my backing. If I were to start over, you would be nothing!" Director Zhao boasted in his last sentence, inadvertently revealing his desperation; they indeed had no raw materials left.
Lin Yi would not allow them to find the raw materials; he would take a step ahead and block off all their supply of raw materials.
And he had heard their raw material was extremely rare and hard to come by, yet possessed remarkable effects.
They had always been in a state of monopoly, but for some reason, they had not received any this year.
Director Zhao, facing his end, still kept up his obstinate facade. Lin Yi had nothing more to say to him.
The game was just beginning. If Director Zhao was eliminated so quickly, Lin Yi would find it quite dull.
Lin Yi stopped wasting time with Director Zhao and hung up the phone to go spend time with his wife instead.
Director Zhao had intended to scold Lin Yi a few more words; however, he didn't expect Lin Yi to hang up so quickly.
Was he cowardly? Was he afraid of him?
"I knew it, you're just a newcomer. What makes you think you can strut around in front of me? Hilarious!" Director Zhao laughed loudly, feeling extremely satisfied. If only he could curse at Lin Yi a little more.
Han Xuemei had been messaging him nonstop.
Asking him what exactly was going on? Why was he so cold to her lately? Was he sick of her?
Director Zhao was very annoyed by this. Women can sometimes be quite a hassle.
Without wasting words, Director Zhao called Han Xuemei.
It was late and Han Xuemei hadn't gone to sleep; she kept waiting for Zhao Guangchen to reply to her messages. Find exclusive stories on empire
She could only rely on Zhao Guangchen now; everything she had done before had been exposed.
Although Lin Yi hadn't pursued her, she felt disgruntled and sought revenge!
"You finally decided to reply to my messages. What on earth have you been up to? Even if you went back home, you should have told me. Without a word, you just tell me you're not coming tonight. What do you mean by that?"
"I mean nothing by it. I did indeed come back home tonight because something happened, so I had to return. You're currently nothing more than a lover to me, and I hope you can understand your place and stop engaging in pointless actions. Haven't I treated you well? Haven't I given you enough money?"
It was these words that made Han Xuemei see herself and this man clearly for the first time.
She should not have expected a man to like her for a long time or to help her seek revenge.
Indeed, in the end, one can only rely on oneself.
"I understand what you mean now, sorry to bother you. I'll hang up first."
Afterwards, Han Xuemei hung up the phone without hesitation, gripping her phone tightly in her hand as veins popped out on her face.
She would definitely make everyone who had let her down pay the price. She would be reborn from the ashes!
However, after hearing the busy tone, Director Zhao wasn't the least bit upset. Instead, he was extremely pleased.
Actually, if his wife could be a bit more attractive, he might consider reconciling with his family and stop his philandering.
But ever since his wife had given birth, her appearance deteriorated too much for him to have any interest at all.
The next morning, Director Zhao left home early, and Wang Guixiang, after dropping her child off at school, didn't waste any time and left home as well.
Lin Yi dropped Han Xuewei off at school, and then he went to the pharmacy.
The pharmacy was still swarming with people today.
Lin Yi had just arrived when he saw the entrance was already crowded with people.

chapters.title: Chapter 289 Pretense
chapters.content:
Upon hearing what Wang Guixiang said, Zhao Guangchen's entire face changed.
He had not expected his wife to bring up this issue proactively.
It was just too good, he was still pondering over how to broach the subject.
Unexpectedly, without lifting a finger, his wife took the initiative to speak.
Indeed, he must possess a certain charm, otherwise why would his wife have stayed so loyally by his side for so long?
"Honestly, honey, I'm really happy that you feel this way; you're right, the company's situation is indeed not very good. If you're willing to let your family help our company, I am ready to give you 20% of the shares."
20% of the shares was a considerable amount, but Wang Guixiang was not ready to let it rest at that.
She was determined to make Zhao Guangchen pay the price he deserved; otherwise, she would never feel at peace.
At this moment, Zhao Guangchen still had no realization of the seriousness of the situation.
He continued to feel very confident in his charm, otherwise why would his wife be willing to remain such a big fool?
"If you talk like that, you're being too formal. Aren't we husband and wife? Helping you is what I should do. Besides, I have put my heart and soul into that company as well, so you don't need to worry about me not helping you."
As she spoke, not a hint of a smile crossed Wang Guixiang's face, but Zhao Guangchen didn't think much of it.
After all, he had done so many wrongful things to his wife before; it was only right for her to be a little angry.
Even at this point, Zhao Guangchen hadn't started thinking about the possibility of divorce.
"Wife, only now do I realize how good you've been to me; all those other people were just after my money. Don't worry, once we get through this tough time, I will never make the same mistakes again. I promise to live a good life with you and properly guide our children as they grow."
This statement, in fact, indirectly admitted that he had multiple affairs in the past.
But now he had seen the error of his ways and knew that his wife was the best.
In reality, he didn't understand that all these sweet nothings were just meant to ensure Wang Guixiang would wholeheartedly help him.
"It's great that you can think like this. Come eat, we didn't know when you'd be back, so the two of us have already eaten."
Wang Guixiang replied perfunctorily, then went back to her room with her child.
Zhao Guangchen ate at the dining table with indifference.
As long as he could get the help from Wang Guixiang's family, he didn't care even if it meant eating leftovers.
After finishing his meal, he didn't even consider doing the dishes to make a good impression but went straight back to his room.
Who knew that Wang Guixiang had already locked the door from the inside?
He couldn't understand what Wang Guixiang meant by this. Could it be that she still hadn't forgiven him?
"Wife, why have you locked the door? I haven't gone in yet. I haven't seen the child for such a long time; I'd like to talk to him, is that okay?"
"It's too late now. We should sleep in separate rooms from now on. I've been feeling a little unwell lately. If I sleep with you, I'm afraid it'll affect you."
Wang Guixiang had no desire to continue sharing a bed with this hypocritical man, so she had already prepared her excuses.
"Wife, what's wrong with you? Why do you feel uncomfortable? Should we see a doctor? And why are you shutting me out like this? Even if you don't want to sleep with me, you should at least let me see our child, right? I haven't seen our son in such a long time."
Now he thinks to see his own son? Where was he before? Wasn't he happily fooling around with other women?
This time, Wang Guixiang had made up her mind; she definitely wouldn't let Zhao Guangchen in.
She wouldn't give Zhao Guangchen any chance. As soon as she got the information she wanted, she would immediately divorce Zhao Guangchen and leave him with nothing.
"It's late, you should go to sleep too. Just sleep in the guest room next door. If you come home early in the future, remember to tell me, otherwise I won't know to save your dinner."
No matter how Zhao Guangchen knocked on the door, Wang Guixiang ignored him.
Wang Guixiang cuddled with her son and told him a bedtime story.
With a confused expression, her son asked his mother what was going on between her and dad?
Did dad really start a new family outside? Does he not want him anymore?
"Don't overthink it. Dad and I indeed have some conflicts, but it's nothing too serious. Oh, son, if you had to choose between dad and me, who would you want to live with?" Stay updated via empire
"Of course with mom. I don't spend much time with dad, so why would I choose him? Mom, you're not really going to divorce dad, are you? I know dad might not be that great, but if you guys divorce, does that mean I won't have a dad anymore?"
Her son's innocent words caught Wang Guixiang off guard.
She had always been thinking about herself and forgot to consider her son.
Right, what would happen to the child after they divorce?
Would the child be able to accept being part of a single-parent family?
However, she didn't want her child to suffer with Zhao Guangchen, so it was best for the child to be with her.
After all, being with Zhao Guangchen, who knows when there would be a stepmother.
"Even if you have no dad, you still have me. And since you barely see dad anyway, what's the difference? Alright, let's not talk about this, it's too depressing. Let me read you a bedtime story, and then we'll go to sleep, okay?"
After Wang Guixiang got her son to sleep, Zhao Guangchen tossed and turned in the guest room, unable to sleep.
Then Lin Yi actually made a phone call to him, which instantly energized Zhao Guangchen.
"Lin Yi, you dare to call me? You've really done me in, haven't you? Vanishing off to open a pharmacy without a word, you really don't take me seriously. But do you think you can replace me just like that? You're too naive!"
After answering the call, Zhao Guangchen cursed Lin Yi out.
Lin Yi cleared his ears before bringing the phone back to his ear.
"If you keep talking this nastily, then I might not be able to continue this conversation with you."
"What more is there to say? I've already been ruined by you. Lin Yi, I will not let this go; you think you can defeat me? Impossible. Let me tell you, I'll make a comeback soon, and at that time, I'll make sure you're kneeling at my feet begging for mercy!"
Lin Yi had never intended to oppose Director Zhao; it was Zhao who concocted the idea of Lin Yi being his adversary.

chapters.title: Chapter 291 Going to the Wang Family Appointment
chapters.content:
"Boss, the cough medicine from your pharmacy is seriously amazing. After my wife took it, her cold was gone immediately, and she even felt stronger. So, I hurried over today to stock up more, in case we run out when someone gets sick at home."
"Yeah, Boss, how exactly do you make your medicine? It's practically a panacea, so incredible!"
The customers at the door were showering Lin Yi with so much praise that he was starting to feel embarrassed.
Speaking of credit, it all had to go to the system.
If it hadn't been for the system providing him with these Mysterious Elixirs, he would never have thought to enter this line of business.
And it wouldn't have been possible to help Zhou Kongshan buy their factory.
"How we make our medicine is a secret we can't reveal, but rest assured, I can promise that our prices won't increase. However, it is supplied in limited quantities. If you need it, please come early each day. Now, please line up; the sale of the medicine will now begin."
Their pharmacy was only selling this one kind of medicine, Lin Yi was still managing to keep up on his own.
Your next read is at empire
But Lin Yi feared that in the future, once more Elixirs were developed, if it was just him alone, he wouldn't be able to keep up.
He also wouldn't be able to properly explain to the customers.
"Alright, everyone, today's supply of the medicine is gone. If you need more, please come earlier tomorrow. I'm truly sorry, but because the production process of our medicine is very difficult, it is always supplied in limited quantities."
The line was still long even after the medicine sold out—?
They were all very annoyed. Why had they come so late? If only they'd come earlier.
"Boss, why does the medicine from your shop look so similar to Zhao Corporation's? Are you guys related or something?"
As expected, someone finally asked the question. In fact, many people wanted to ask, but none had the guts.
The person who asked today must be quite a keyboard warrior to speak so boldly.
Everyone was curious about the question because the medicinal effects were just too similar.
Though they asserted confidently that the medicine from Lin Yi's pharmacy might be a bit better and more affordable,
they still wanted to know what the deal was.
How come such miraculous medicine was suddenly available at two different places?
"Let me clarify for everyone here, we have no relation whatsoever with Zhao Corporation. We are a newly established pharmacy, and our Elixir has not a single thing in common with theirs, except maybe that the effects are the same, enhancing the potency of other medicines.
However, our production process and recipe are completely different," Lin Yi clarified for everyone, yet some people were still not convinced.
Of course, those who were not convinced were sent by Director Zhao and the Wang Family.
"Just saying so doesn't make it believable. We've been buying from Zhao Corporation for so many years, and suddenly you come out of nowhere selling cheaper medicine. Did you steal their secret recipe? That's why you dare to sell it at such a price."
The person who said this was wearing a cap and a mask, covering himself up tightly, as if afraid of being recognized.
A glance would tell any sensible person that there was something fishy.
Nevertheless, the onlookers, in the mood for a spectacle, didn't intervene.
"Young man, can you remove your mask and cap while you speak? This way, it always makes me feel like you were sent by them, perhaps to fish for some useful information from me. I hope everyone can trust us, and those who have used our medicine should be able to tell that it's somewhat different from Zhao Corporation's."
Lin Yi felt that these kinds of rumors were pointless to explain away; they would collapse under their own weight.
An elderly gentleman stood up and spoke in support of Lin Yi.
"The young man is right, their medicine is nothing like Zhao Corporation's. And Zhao's medicines are so expensive, how could we ordinary people afford them? I can say with confidence, their medicine is great, and completely different from Zhao Corporation's!"
The old man spoke with such fervor that he ended up coughing a couple of times, prompting nods of agreement from the crowd.
Indeed, Lin Yi's medicine was more effective and extremely affordable,
making it within reach for ordinary people.
And so, the focus returned to the masked speaker.
He was so well-covered, could he really be some sort of spy, sent to stir up trouble?
As the crowd started murmuring about him, he felt a bit scared and disappeared without a trace.
And with that, Lin Yi's task for the day was done.
The rest of the day was quiet, but he received an invitation from the Wang Family and needed to make a trip.
Lin Yi had heard of the Wang Family, known for their pharmaceutical legacy.
But for some reason, from their generation onwards, they had begun to decline.
They couldn't even compare to Zhao Corporation now.
When Lin Yi arrived at the Wangs' residence, no servant came to greet him, not even someone to open the door for him.
Lin Yi had to keep knocking at the door repeatedly.
Actually, Lin Yi was running out of patience. If this was their attitude, he was ready to leave.
Just as Lin Yi was about to turn away, the door finally opened.
"I apologize for the wait; our master was getting ready, hence the delay. Please, come in," the butler opened the door and, with a fairly decent attitude, Lin Yi's mood somewhat softened.
He nodded and then followed the butler inside.
The Wang Family indeed showed the wealth of a pharmaceutical legacy. They left no stone unturned.
Upon reaching the living room, Lin Yi sat on the sofa, and it took the old Master Wang nearly ten minutes to come down from upstairs.
"You must be Lin Yi. I'm very pleased to meet you. I always like getting to know young, talented individuals," Master Wang said, leaning on his cane and smiling broadly as he took the seat of honor next to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi greeted Master Wang and wondered what the man's intentions for calling him over were.
"I'm also glad to meet you, Master Wang. I've heard a lot about the greatness of the Wang Family, and it's my honor to be here today," Lin Yi responded politely, but it was just a modest formality.
Master Wang laughed heartily, stroked his beard, and beckoned his son to come over and greet Lin Yi.
It was only then that Lin Yi realized there were other people present.

chapters.title: Chapter 292 Buyout
chapters.content:
"Are you Lin Yi? I've heard you've been pretty arrogant lately, acting as if you've created some kind of miraculous cure-all?"
When Wang Sheng opened his mouth, why was his tone so unpleasant?
Lin Yi frowned slightly. Was this the attitude of the Wang Family?
The old Master Wang immediately patted Wang Sheng's back, but the force was so light that there was absolutely no sense of reprimand.
It seemed they had invited Lin Yi over today just to intimidate him and show him who the real protagonist was.
Continue your adventure at empire
"You little brat, what are you saying? If I catch you speaking rudely to our guests again, watch out, I'll smack you!"
After saying this, the old Master Wang immediately made a motion as if he was going to hit him.
Wang Sheng just snorted coldly and said nothing more.
"I'm terribly sorry, Lin Yi. I didn't expect you to witness such a farce when you came over today. It's my fault for not teaching him well. Please, I hope you can forgive us."
The old Master Wang very apologetically lifted his teacup towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi said nothing in return and did not reciprocate the gesture, which infuriated Wang Sheng even more.
"Didn't you see my dad talking to you? Why aren't you answering my dad? What do you mean by that? You are the junior here, and moreover, this is our house!"
That little brat Wang Sheng, he obviously hasn't been beaten down by society, or he wouldn't act like this.
The old Master Wang's face was actually having trouble maintaining his composure.
He had thought that just saying a few words would make Lin Yi eager to ingratiate himself with smiles.
But from the moment Lin Yi had walked in, he showed no sign of fearing him or admiring him.
He looked at the old Master Wang as if he were a peer.
This left the old Master Wang extremely incredulous; after all, he was someone with considerable prestige.
Lin Yi should have felt very accomplished just by being able to come here; how could he dare to expect more and make such a move?
"I know this is your house, but don't forget that it was you who invited me, over and over again. What is this about? Are you putting on a play for me to watch? Is it to intimidate me? I don't have any demands on your property, so there's no need for me to grovel."
Lin Yi's words made the atmosphere even more awkward.
The old Master Wang's face turned as dark as could be, and even Wang Sheng looked at Lin Yi as if he'd seen a ghost.
"There's no need for any more acting. Just speak plainly about what you want from me. If you don't tell me, I may as well leave."
Lin Yi sipped the tea in his cup, noting that the tea they brewed for him was nothing special – it seemed they didn't think much of him.
Lin Yi sneered, then put the teacup back on the table.
"Indeed, a young and promising man. Since you're so straightforward, I won't beat around the bush. We want to buy your miracle cure. Just name your price. No matter how much you ask for, we won't bargain. If we think it's too little, we might even add more."
Was the old Master Wang being too optimistic?
Lin Yi was at the height of his popularity, and his miracle cure had already won the hearts of a vast number of users.
If he abandoned his cure at this time and chose a large sum of money, that would be a huge mistake.
"Old Master Wang, how much do you think your offer should be for my medicine?"
"I'll give you five billion. The medicine will belong to the Wang Family henceforth. You hand over the formula, and that will be the end of it. In the future, we won't interfere with whatever you do. Of course, if you need help, you can come to us."
Just five billion? Lin Yi thought there would be a higher offer.
Yet the old Master Wang felt he was already offering a lot, and if Lin Yi didn't agree, he would be overreaching.
Seeing this, Lin Yi burst into laughter.
"Old Master Wang, you're aware of the current situation of our pharmacy, right? You're offering me just five billion, expecting me to sell you the medicine outright? That's too naive. And there's no way I'd give you the formula; your offer is too low."
Lin Yi crossed his legs and leaned back into the chair's backrest.
Wang Sheng, unable to sit still, stood up and pointed at Lin Yi.
"Our offer of five billion for your trashy medicine is already quite generous. Don't be greedy, Lin Yi, I've disliked you for a long time! Be careful, I might make sure you can't leave here today."
Wang Sheng was someone unable to keep his cool – no wonder the old Master Wang didn't like him at all, preferring his older brother instead.
But when Wang Sheng made such a rude move, the old Master Wang did not stop him.
It seemed the old Master Wang felt very much out of line as well.
Did they really think Lin Yi was so inexperienced?
Lin Yi had managed to produce such a product; how could he possibly be tempted by a mere five billion?
"Whether I can leave here or not, I don't know, but I do know that if you try to harm me, the consequence will be very dire. Old Master Wang, if there's nothing else today, I'll be leaving now. If you want to visit my pharmacy, you're always welcome."
Lin Yi got up and swaggered to the door, where a group of bodyguards ran out and blocked his way.
Lin Yi paused, turned around, and looked at the old Master Wang.
"Old Master Wang, do you really not intend to let me leave today? Or are you trying to force me to agree?"
"Young man, you've just stepped into society, and there's much you don't understand. Moreover, you dared to come alone today, which honestly shocked me. I can see you're still green. I'll give you a max of ten billion. If you refuse that, you won't get a single penny in the end."
The old Master Wang gripped his walking stick with certainty that Lin Yi would agree.
After all, that was ten billion – a sum most people couldn't earn in several lifetimes.
Lin Yi laughed coldly twice, then fully turned to face the old Master Wang and Wang Sheng.
"It seems I didn't make myself clear enough before: I will not give you the formula, and your offer is too low. My formula is worth far more."
Lin Yi was still producing, and his sales in recent days had been very high.
Although his prices weren't high, the volume of purchasers was substantial.
With steady daily production, reaching ten billion eventually wouldn't be unrealistic.

chapters.title: Chapter 293 Escape
chapters.content:
Lin Yi's words instantly put the two members of the Wang Family, especially Wang Sheng, in a bad mood.
With an arrogant stride, he approached Lin Yi, grabbed his collar, while murder glinted in Lin Yi's eyes.
If Wang Sheng continued to be presumptuous, Lin Yi would not hesitate to break his neck.
The shrewd elder of the Wang family could not fail to perceive this. Lin Yi was already angered, and if the provocation continued, it wouldn't benefit them in any way.
So he loudly scolded his son, urging him to stop immediately and not to provoke Lin Yi any further.
Wang Sheng could only, very unwillingly, let go of Lin Yi, his gaze still warning Lin Yi.
If Lin Yi continued talking nonsense, as soon as he left this place, he would definitely hire someone to kill Lin Yi.
"Young man, I know what you're thinking, and you're not wrong; everyone thinks the same. But have you considered what happens if you can't sell your drugs later on? With such a large stockpile, they will just accumulate in the warehouse. Moreover, at that point, you may not even make ten billion. You have only just developed a new drug. If you plan to research another, who knows how long it will take."
The old Mr. Wang didn't believe he couldn't persuade Lin Yi today. After all, new drugs couldn't always be produced continuously, and Lin Yi was bound to have a lull period.
This lull period was their best chance to make a move.
"I won't trouble you with this matter, old Mr. Wang, no need to worry. It's just that the price you've offered is far too low; I simply can't accept it. I don't have anything else to discuss, so I will take my leave now, old Mr. Wang. I have my own matters to attend to.
Continuing to detain me here serves no purpose, and if my brothers find out I'm missing, they will surely come here prepared to kill," Lin Yi said, his tone calm and unperturbed, making it hard to discern his current emotional state.
Old Mr. Wang's expression darkened, and with a wave of his hand, the bodyguards immediately stepped aside.
Even though these bodyguards also felt that someone as young as Lin Yi was being too bold in front of old Mr. Wang,
it was, after all, an order from old Mr. Wang, so they would not object, and Lin Yi left the Wang Family successfully.
After Lin Yi left, Wang Sheng, dissatisfied, came to his father's side.
"Dad, why did you compromise? He's just an upstart brat. Our family can definitely crush him. Aren't you essentially admitting that we've lost? Dad, you can't be like this!"
Looking at his disappointing son, old Mr. Wang felt like he was about to cough up blood.
When would his son realize that the business world isn't just about the family's power, but also about intelligence?
Someone like Wang Sheng would definitely not survive in the workforce for even a month.
"Enough, don't say any more. I advise you not to provoke Lin Yi. He didn't take issue with our actions, which is already quite generous. Surprisingly, this kid has some talent and is very deep, you're simply no match for him. Be careful, or you might end up in trouble that even I won't be able to get you out of," warned old Mr.
Wang as he tapped his cane twice then headed back upstairs, leaving Wang Sheng alone in the living room, his fists clenched tightly.
He was determined to make Lin Yi pay. If it weren't for Lin Yi, how could he have ended up like this? Explore more stories at empire
Moreover, he would take all the drugs and the formulas from Lin Yi's hands.
He wanted his father to look at him with new respect, not to always focus on his elder brother.
No sooner said than done, he went online to call his subordinates and arranged to meet them that very night to discuss how to deal with Lin Yi.
It was clear just by looking that Lin Yi was not to be trifled with, and it was unknown how many people Lin Yi had working for him, so they had to be cautious.
After leaving the Wang Family residence, Lin Yi returned to his home.
He had thought there would be many things to deal with today, but he didn't expect to return from the Wang family so soon; now Lin Yi could spend some quality time with his three children.
On the other hand, Han Xuemei was agitated, unable to do anything right every day, and she kept trying to contact Zhao Guangchen.
But the guy wouldn't even pick up the phone or respond to a text message. Han Xuemei didn't know what to do next.
In the meantime, Zhao Guangchen, to gain Wang Guixiang's trust, stayed home all along, dedicating his time to his wife and son.
It was the first time his son had ever experienced fatherly love, since his father had always been absent in the past.
Zhao Guangchen also wanted to mend his relationship with Wang Guixiang, but from the looks of it, she didn't seem to need it.
"Wife, I really know I was wrong about before. Can you forgive me? Can we start over? Don't worry, I will never make the same mistake again. If I do, you can punish me!" Zhao Guangchen pleaded, kneeling in front of Wang Guixiang, confessing his past transgressions.
But what he didn't know was that Wang Guixiang had recorded everything he said, following a tactic provided by Lin Yi.
First, she needed photographs, second, she needed a confession from Zhao Guangchen of his infidelity.
Now that she had both pieces of evidence, she was ready to escape the misery and flee far away with her son.
"I won't dwell on the past anymore. Oh, and I've reestablished contact with my family, but they have a condition. If they are to help you, you must hand over some important documents from your company to me, which I have to give to them," Wang Guixiang said impassively to Zhao Guangchen, who became suspicious.
What kind of request was this, needing to see the important documents?
"Why so sudden? What are your parents thinking? I don't understand why they want me to give the company's important documents to them when they can't understand them anyway," Zhao Guangchen wondered.
Wang Guixiang, knowing that Zhao Guangchen was always meticulous, was sure he'd sense something was amiss.
She told him the excuses she had prepared.
"They don't mean anything else; they just want to see your commitment. After all, they are considering putting in a lot of money to help you, and they will also have to contribute manpower. They are unsure themselves; if they can't recoup the investment, what will they do? They need some kind of security.
Don't worry, we have no use for these documents; it's only to hold something in hand just in case. If you can't defeat Lin Yi and end up bankrupt, we can still make a fresh start," she reassured.
Hearing Wang Guixiang's reasons, Zhao Guangchen gradually came to accept them.
"Since you put it that way, I have no choice but to agree," Zhao Guangchen conceded.

chapters.title: Chapter 294 Living in Fear and Anxiety
chapters.content:
After their discussion, Zhao Guangchen decided that he would go to the company tomorrow to get all the documents from Wang Guixiang.
Wang Guixiang was very pleased with Zhao Guangchen's current situation, this was the best, and hoped that he wouldn't cause any trouble recently.
If Zhao Guangchen still went to meet with Han Xuemei in the next few days, Wang Guixiang would definitely not show any mercy; she had already secretly sent someone to follow Zhao Guangchen.
As long as Zhao Guangchen met with Han Xuemei, Wang Guixiang would be able to successfully divorce him.
"You should rest early too, I'm going back to the room with my son. Have you not been busy these days? Why haven't you gone to the company? You've been staying at home. You should still focus on the big picture, after all, the company is in such a difficult situation. If you're not busy, you should spend more time at the company.
We don't lack anything at home."
At first glance, these words seemed harmless, but upon closer listen, the problem became apparent.
Wang Guixiang was telling Zhao Guangchen that he was no longer indispensable at home and could be replaced at any time.
But Zhao Guangchen, foolish as he was, didn't catch on and thought Wang Guixiang was considering his well-being.
In his eyes, his wife, despite having aged a bit, still fit the standard for marriage perfectly.
"My wife, you're so sensible. Don't worry, there are people watching over the company's matters for me. If there's a problem, I'll be there immediately. I still want to spend more time at home with you and the children, especially since I need to make up for the mistakes I made. Dear, I really know I was wrong; can I come back to our room to sleep?"
Zhao Guangchen even threw Wang Guixiang a coquettish look, as if he still thought he was in the same position as before.
Wang Guixiang almost vomited out the food she had eaten; this man was truly greasy.
Wang Guixiang rolled her eyes and suppressed the feeling of disgust.
"Who asked you to behave so poorly before? So, for the time being, you should keep sleeping in the guest room. Until when? I'll let you move back once I feel that you've sufficiently proved yourself."
Rest assured, that day will never come; they would soon escape the bitter sea, taking the children to fly high and live the life they desired.
Though Zhao Guangchen was a bit disappointed, he wasn't in a hurry. Time was on his side. Since Wang Guixiang had already forgiven him, they could slowly rebuild their relationship.
The next day, Zhao Guangchen went to the company to look for his documents, intending to hand them all over to Wang Guixiang.
Lin Yi had also been waiting for news from Wang Guixiang.
Wang Guixiang sent a text to Lin Yi, telling him that she had almost finished her preparations and that Lin Yi should get the photos ready.
Lin Yi clapped his hands.
Good, everything was ready, they were just waiting for the east wind.
Recently, Han Xuewei had been feeling gloomy in school, always wanting to return home to accompany the children.
If she stayed at school all the time, the children's childhood would lack a mother's company. They couldn't always just have a nanny with them, right?
She didn't know how her three darlings were doing now. Were they adjusting well at home? Was the nanny treating them properly?
Because the kindergarten was undergoing rectification, they didn't have to attend kindergarten classes.
Moreover, with the recent abduction incident, Han Xuewei always felt very uneasy and often wanted to return home.
But she hadn't finished her studies yet. She couldn't just focus only on the children, could she?
These concerns also prevented Han Xuewei from being able to calm down and concentrate on her studies.
Today, she found she couldn't stay in school any longer and directly took leave to go back home.
I didn't expect Lin Yi to be here after I got home; don't you have to keep an eye on the pharmacy today?
"I remember you had a class today, so why did you suddenly come back?"
"This..."
Han Xuewei felt a bit guilty. She had said she would attend school diligently, but now she had sneaked back from school without telling Lin Yi.
If Lin Yi knew, he would definitely be very angry.
Seeing Han Xuewei's reluctance to speak, Lin Yi had actually guessed what was going on.
Because of the previous kidnapping incident, Han Xuewei was now extremely anxious about the children. The smallest disturbance would upset her greatly.
"I know you're worried about the kids, but you still need to focus on your studies. Don't you want to graduate? Think about how many times you've taken leave already. What if your instructor becomes unhappy and you fail a class? The children have me to look after them, rest assured, there won't be any more issues.
Last time was just an accident." Lin Yi said, pulling Han Xuewei into his arms and soothing her in a gentle, soft voice.
Children, they are all like this.
Even though Han Xuewei had become a mother, she wasn't so different from a child herself.
Da Bao, Er Bao, and San Bao also came over to comfort their mom.
The kindergarten incident had scared them too, but now thinking about it, they had gotten over it, as well as the kidnapping affair. Stay updated with empire
"Mommy, don't be angry, Daddy said he will protect us. We all believe in Daddy, don't you, Mommy?"
Hearing Da Bao's childishly milky voice, all Han Xuewei's bad temper vanished in an instant.
She hugged all three children close and kissed each of them in turn.
Da Bao, Er Bao, and San Bao all had wet marks on their faces from her kisses.
"Babies, I know Daddy will definitely protect you, but because so many dangerous things have happened, I can't just leave you at home by yourselves. If it really doesn't work out, then Mommy... I'll just quit school. Worse comes to worst, I'll resign and come home to stay with you three little treasures."
It was the first time Han Xuewei had ever thought this way, perhaps because she was truly frightened.
Han Xuewei had never considered giving up her studies before.
Even during the time when she was having children, she continued her studies diligently.
But with the recent dangers, Han Xuewei didn't dare take the risk.
"Mom, what are you talking about? You absolutely can't do that. Daddy told us that we can't be a burden to you, so you must continue your studies!"
Er Bao came up to Han Xuewei with much conviction, his youthful face making her adore him immensely.
He looked mature beyond his years.
"That's right, Mommy, if Daddy finds out that you can't go to school because of us, he will definitely blame us."
The three big treasures took turns shaking Han Xuewei's arm, how could she not be moved?
"Alright, alright, since you all say so, then Mommy won't give up her studies. But I'm really worried."

chapters.title: Chapter 295 Return to Grandma's House
chapters.content:
Han Xuewei looked at her three children with a worried expression. With so many things that had happened, she really couldn't go back to school anymore.
Lin Yi was also seriously thinking about how to find a perfect solution.
It was simply not possible to let Han Xuewei take her three children to school; that would certainly become a huge joke.
"Otherwise, let's leave the three children with our parents first, and let them help us take care of them," said Lin Yi suddenly.
Han Xuewei glanced at him, and then her eyes lit up. This was indeed a solution,
and their parents were also strong.
There were many bodyguards around them for protection, so the children would definitely not be threatened.
Experience more on empire
Staying with their grandparents, and great-grandparents, they might be happier too.
"But if we dump the kids at our parents' place, won't they mind? After all, they have their own lives to live, and we can't force them," said Han Xuewei.
Lin Yi knew Han Xuewei was worrying unnecessarily. Which grandparents wouldn't want their grandchildren to stay with them?
"Mom, don't worry, we three treasures will definitely win over grandpa and grandma. Then, you can't go back on your word, and you must let us stay with grandpa and grandma. Of course, if mom misses us, we will come back to see you anytime."
The three treasures took turns coaxing Han Xuewei, making her suddenly feel like she was the big baby.
How could these children be more mature than her?
Well, since the babies were so willing, Han Xuewei didn't say anything further.
Finally, Lin Yi drove, and Han Xuewei led the three treasures to the Han family's home.
"Mom and Dad, we're back."
Because Dad Han had been in the hospital before, Han Xuewei had often come back, but she had come back less often recently because she had been dealing with a lot.
"You know to come back? Do you still remember that you have such a home? What, as soon as I'm discharged, you stop coming?"
Dad Han came out to greet them.
Upon seeing his three great grandchildren, he immediately opened his arms wide.
The three great grandchildren also gave much face, immediately pounced on him, and jumped into grandpa's embrace.
"My dear grandchildren, you're finally back. Grandpa nearly missed you to death. Without seeing you for so long, I was worried the incident before might have traumatized your little hearts. Stay with grandpa for a few more days, I will make sure you have a lot of fun," said Dad Han.
Dad Han still loved the children as always, which put Lin Yi and Han Xuewei at ease.
As long as Dad liked them, the children would be happier here.
Then, Han's mother also walked out of the room and, upon seeing her three great-grandchildren, immediately ignored Lin Yi and Han Xuewei.
"Oh my, my three treasures, you've finally come. Grandma has missed you so much. Why haven't you come to see grandma recently? You've been following your parents around and learned bad habits."
If it were possible to see question marks, Han Xuewei's head would be full of them right now.
Since when did they have such an image in their parents' hearts?
"Mom, what are you talking about? What do you mean we're learning bad things by following us? We didn't know such things would happen before!"
"You all make sense, and I don't want to bother with you anymore. Alright, alright, my three grandbabies, come inside with me quick. There are lots of things you like to eat, you know."
With a roll of her eyes, Han's mother then took the three treasures into the room and firmly shut the door behind them.
Standing still, Han Xuewei and Lin Yi didn't know what to say, wondering when they had become so unwelcome.
They remembered that things used to be quite good when they came home before.
It seems that once there are grandchildren, daughters aren't needed anymore.
Dad Han handed the kids over to his wife, and then called Lin Yi aside, he had something to say.
"How's the restaurant doing lately? Have you heard from Han Xuemei? After she left, we've all been very worried about her. Even though the child has committed many serious sins, she's still a child after all, and we'll take care of her as best as we can."
Despite the fact that Han Xuemei had done something so serious to him, he was still thinking of her.
Lin Yi really didn't know if he should agree or what else to say, so he could only relay to Dad Han all the news he knew.
Dad Han sighed. He hadn't expected Han Xuemei to become involved as the other woman in someone else's relationship.
This really had brought shame to their family.
"That child might have some psychological issues, so when you deal with her, don't push her to the brink. Leave her some wiggle room so that she can live a good life. I need to be able to explain things to her parents."
Dad Han knew that it was impossible not to deal with Han Xuemei, so he wouldn't stop Lin Yi.
But he hoped Lin Yi would give her a chance to live, at the very least, not to the point of death.
"Dad, don't worry. I have a clear idea about this. I absolutely won't be too cruel to her. But the things she's done are simply intolerable to me, so I will give her some lessons, teach her that there are things she can't just do as she pleases."
Lin Yi explained to Dad Han the well-intentioned reasons behind his actions, and Dad Han nodded in agreement.
After that, the two of them started to chat idly.
Soon the meal was ready, and the two joined the others at the dining table—what a lively scene it was, the whole big family eating together.
"If you have time, visit more often. Besides, our homes aren't far from each other. Why so reluctant to come by more frequently? When your dad was in the hospital, although you took care of him, I have been through this too. You must come home more often, see how we are doing, got it?"
Han's mother chided Han Xuewei and Lin Yi rather seriously.
It was their own fault for not visiting home often. Such a wrong choice!
Da Bao and Er Bao sat on their stools fighting over a chicken leg, both finding it exceptionally delicious.
There were many other dishes, yet they both wanted that specific piece.
As they struggled and argued, they eventually started to quarrel.
Han Xuewei glared at them, and immediately they dared not speak anymore.
Seeing this, Lin Yi also started to scold the two kids in a pretentious manner.
"Have you forgotten what your parents taught you before, hm? You two are siblings. If you do this sort of thing again, beware of getting spanked. You must love each other and not engage in such behavior. And there's plenty more, so no fighting!"
After hearing Lin Yi reprimand the children, Han Xuewei nodded in satisfaction.

chapters.title: Chapter 296 Two-Person World
chapters.content:
"Educating children should be like this, mom and dad, although I've left the kids with you recently, please don't spoil them. If they pick up any bad habits, I'll have to take them back," Han Xuewei said when discussing this matter with Dad Han and Han's mother, immediately drawing their displeasure.
"What do you mean by that? Are we going to harm our grandchildren or what? Fine, fine, don't bother eating, just go back. Leave the kids here. Seeing the two of you just annoys me. Just look at what you're saying, what kind of talk is that?" Dad Han and Han's mother were clearly unhappy with the conversation.
Especially Han's mother, who was very angry.
They treated the children well, but they still knew right from wrong, so how could they possibly raise the kids to be mischievous?
This was clearly a matter of distrust!
Besides, if they didn't understand reason, how did Han Xuewei grow up to be this big? And how did she become the school beauty?
Han Xuewei also felt embarrassed; she had only meant it as a gentle reminder.
If they spoiled the kids too much, it would be hard to discipline them when they got back. Who knew her mother would react so strongly?
Han Xuewei wanted to say more, but Lin Yi timely grabbed her arm.
He urged her not to continue, as it would only deepen the misunderstanding.
"Mom, dad, please don't think too much of it. We didn't mean it like that. We feel very relieved to leave the kids with you. Although you may not want to see us, we'll go back first. We'll come visit the children after a while. Their kindergarten is currently undergoing renovation, so if possible, could you please hire a tutor to coach them at home?" Han Xuewei said.
As for what to tutor, it was entirely up to the grandparents to decide.
If they wanted, even if it meant teaching the three children advanced mathematics, they had no objections.
Lin Yi and Han Xuewei quickly made their escape; they couldn't stay there any longer.
Otherwise, they would definitely be disliked to death. They didn't know when it had started, but both mom and dad seemed to have grown so resentful towards them.
After leaving the house, Han Xuewei breathed a sigh of relief. Being inside had been unbearable with the constant nagging of her parents.
Great, now that the children were with them, they could finally have a world of their own.
"Wife, what shall we do next? Now it's just the two of us," Lin Yi said, taking Han Xuewei's arm and forcibly pulling her into his embrace.
Within Lin Yi's arms, Han Xuewei greedily inhaled his scent, then opened her eyes with a somewhat seductive look at Lin Yi.
"Right, husband, now it's just the two of us. You can do whatever you want. Why ask me? Let's go home then," Han Xuewei said with an inviting expression that Lin Yi saw right through.
Lin Yi immediately drove them home, and they spent an unforgettable day together.
When Lin Yi woke up the next day, he felt incredibly comfortable.
But it was different for Han Xuewei. She felt as though she was nearly falling apart.
Lin Yi had been married for such a long time, yet he didn't expect to still have so much stamina.
"You're not allowed to touch me anymore, do you hear? You, are you the reincarnation of a teddy bear or what? Last night almost killed me. Don't you know the meaning of the word 'moderation'? And today I have to go to school, what's with leaving all these hickey marks all over my neck?" Han Xuewei protested.
Han Xuewei was about to be driven mad by Lin Yi; if she went to school today and her classmates saw her current state, who knows how they would tease her?
Lin Yi, however, propped up his chin with his hand, then looked at Han Xuewei with a wicked smile. Stay connected via empire
"I think it's rather good. Besides, we're husband and wife. They probably understand these things; they must know. This is just the right way to assert my authority."
Han Xuewei found it impossible to communicate with Lin Yi; this guy was always either jealous or, well, jealous.
Although she was the school beauty, it's not like there were people pursuing her, okay?
They were all rejected by Han Xuewei.
There was Teacher Mo in the past, and now there's Lin Yi; how could any boys even think of approaching Han Xuewei? They must have a death wish.
"If you keep this up, I'm going back to my parents' house. I absolutely won't live alone with you anymore. Alright, alright, I'm almost late; hurry up and take me to school!"
As soon as Han Xuewei saw the clock nearby, she panicked at once.
It's over, the time is already up.
If she didn't leave now, she wouldn't even make it to her first class on time.
Lin Yi slowly got out of bed and after getting dressed, finally took Han Xuewei to school.
"Then, you should eat lunch at school first. If anything comes up, remember to call me. I'll pick you up after your class in the evening."
Han Xuewei waved her hand and then quickly ran into her classroom.
Although the teacher noticed that Han Xuewei was late, they didn't say much.
After all, Han Xuewei was a mother now. She had to take care of her child at night, which was hard work. The teacher didn't think in any other direction.
Han Xuewei hadn't expected to have this teacher's class today either.
This teacher was very understanding, and Han Xuewei was no longer worried about failing or losing points.
After she returned to her seat, her neck full of love bites was still discovered by others, and soon, rumors started.
"Did you see the love bites on our school beauty's neck? They must be Lin Yi's handiwork, right? I didn't expect that after being married for so long, our joke of a husband still has such vigor!"
"Hahaha! If you guys hadn't mentioned it, I wouldn't have noticed! Yeah, yeah, look at those love bites all over her neck. He must have worn out our school beauty last night, or she wouldn't have been late today, right?"
Listening to everyone teasing, Han Xuewei wished she could find a hole to bury herself in.
After she got home, she definitely had to punish Lin Yi properly to make sure he never dared to do such a thing again.
Even if he had to leave love bites, he should at least do it where others can't see. All over her neck, how was she supposed to face anyone now?!
Han Xuewei could only take a scarf out of her bag and wrap it around her neck.
After dropping off Han Xuewei, Lin Yi went to the pharmacy, which opened later than usual today, causing much dissatisfaction among the customers.
"Boss, why are you so late today? We've been waiting here for a long time. It's true that your pharmacy's medicine is top-notch, but you should really stick to a fixed opening time. Otherwise, isn't our waiting in vain?"
"Yes, boss, you can't just leave us waiting here."

chapters.title: Chapter 297 No Clue
chapters.content:
Upon hearing the dissatisfied reactions from customers, Lin Yi immediately responded.
He offered a very sincere apology to these customers right away.
Lin Yi hadn't expected to oversleep today and was already in a hurry on the road, but still, he arrived so late.
It was indeed Lin Yi's fault, so he decided that everyone who came to buy medicine today could get an extra pill.
"I'm very sorry, everyone, due to some issues that occurred yesterday, I overslept today, and on top of that, the traffic was very bad, so I arrived late. Since everyone is so dissatisfied, I'll give everyone a little benefit!"
After the promise of benefits, the complaints naturally weren't as vehement—who wouldn't want to receive an extra pill?
However, since it was limited, those who arrived late had no need to line up anymore.
Lin Yi limited the supply to 500 boxes daily.
"Boss, can we talk for a moment? We're willing to pay a higher price; please produce more. We really think the Elixir is very good, but you're giving out too little—it's simply not enough for competition. I've been queuing up for two consecutive days and still haven't managed to get any."
Lin Yi heard such responses countless times every day.
But there was nothing Lin Yi could do; after all, it was a rare medicine, and the raw materials were very precious.
Extracting medicine takes time, and they cannot print these medicines directly.
"I'm terribly sorry, everyone, we can only supply a limited amount. If you all think that we're giving out too little, you could actually check out other stores' medicines—they're also quite good. If you really want to buy medicine, please come earlier next time. I truly have no other solution."
Lin Yi once again apologized to everyone, but beyond that, he had no other solution.
They could only wait until Lin Yi's family released other medicines.
Since the boss had already given such a definite answer, everyone had no reason to continue troubling Lin Yi.
It was then that a large group of journalists suddenly surged forward, encircling Lin Yi.
They then began to question Lin Yi about the source of these medicines.
Whether these medicines had passed proper approvals.
Whether these medicines were plagiarized.
Listening to their questions, Lin Yi felt his head swell—hadn't he already responded to them before? Did these people not follow the news?
"I'm pleased that you've come to interview me, but I've already responded to these questions before. Our medicine is definitely not a case of plagiarism, and it has indeed passed proper approvals. As for the source, that's confidential, and I'm unable to reveal it to everyone."
Lin Yi was determined to protect this secret; he wouldn't let others know what was really going on.
After all, if the system's secret were to be revealed, everyone would surely treat him as an aberration.
Of course, these journalists were not buying Lin Yi's approach.
Since they came to inquire from Lin Yi, they were hoping to dig up a sensation, not some indifferent responses.
"Recently, there has been talk that your Elixir is very similar to the Zhao Corporation's. How do you respond to that? Are you saying there's no plagiarism at all? After all, their Elixir has been on the market for years, and after your arrival, not only is the effect the same, even the names are almost identical."
The journalist's question was extremely sharp; moreover, she pushed her microphone right up to Lin Yi's mouth.
If Lin Yi didn't answer, her camera would capture everything about Lin Yi and post it online.
Who knows how they would spin it.
"If everyone insists we're plagiarizing, there's not much we can do about the name clash—indeed, it happened because the effects are the same. But as for the details, those who have used it should know the answers. I really don't want to repeat myself; I hope you could ask something else. Of course, in a few days, we will launch new medicines, so I hope everyone will continue to pay attention.
If there's nothing else, then please leave."
After answering the journalists' questions, Lin Yi unceremoniously called the security guards over and had all the journalists expelled.
Lin Yi dialed Zhou Kongshan's number.
"How's the Youth-Preserving Pill I gave you recently?"
The Youth-Preserving Pill had been given to Zhou Kongshan for some time now—surely they must have some clue by now?
Compared to Strong Efficacy Medicine, the Youth-Preserving Pill should be simpler, so why hadn't Lin Yi received any news for such a long time?
"I'm really sorry, Lin Yi, but as of now we have no clue about this Elixir. We have dissected and extracted its substances, but these substances are beyond our understanding; we've never seen them before. Moreover, they're miraculous. We tested one and it made someone look five years younger!"
Of course, this youthfulness referred only to appearance and didn't mean any rejuvenating effects.
Zhou Kongshan had also been rather anxious lately; he hadn't expected the Elixir Lin Yi gave him to be even more difficult than the last one.
With the previous one, they partially understood the substances after extraction, but this time, they were completely at a loss.
They had never even seen these substances before—how could they possibly continue the process?
"Alright, if it's so difficult for you, I won't press you. If there are any issues, remember to communicate with me promptly, and I'll try my best to find a book for you to refer to."
If they could get a book, that would be superb.
Zhou Kongshan could only pray that Lin Yi would indeed be able to find them a manual. Experience more content on empire
If not, they had no idea how long it would take to deconstruct the substance and then reproduce it.
Now, they could only depend on the system. Lin Yi immediately called out the system.
"System, are you there? You gave me this thing to deconstruct, but you didn't provide even a manual; how do you expect me to deconstruct it? Isn't that a bit too much? Give me a manual for once!"
The system appeared immediately, but it hadn't expected Lin Yi to make such a request.
No one had ever asked it for such a thing before.
"I'm really sorry, host, but this is your task; we can't directly give you the manual. If we give you the manual, then we wouldn't be able to continue with the tasks later."
The system's tone sounded not the least apologetic—it was plainly making things difficult for Lin Yi.
Plus, humans have limited abilities, and these substances are beyond the knowledge of ordinary people.
So giving a manual wouldn't be too much to ask for!

chapters.title: Chapter 298 Objective Achieved
chapters.content:
"But have you ever considered that our knowledge is limited? The materials you've given me are incomprehensible; you just heard that my team is absolutely top-notch, yet they have no idea what substances are inside. If you don't provide an instruction manual, how are we supposed to proceed?"
Lin Yi had a point, and even the system began to waver.
Lin Yi felt that since his argument made sense, he might as well push a little harder.
Perhaps the system would really hand over the manual to him.
"System, you think I'm right, don't you? If you feel that giving it to me directly isn't feasible, assigning me a task would also work. As a reward, you can give me the instruction manual, right?"
Lin Yi was already being quite tactful; he had even suggested a solution to the system. The system couldn't be so inflexible, could it?
After contemplation, the system finally agreed to Lin Yi's proposal. After all, it had indeed pushed Lin Yi and his team a bit too hard.
It was better to lower the difficulty after all; otherwise, they wouldn't be able to continue. There were still many tasks leftunfinished.
If Lin Yi's side stopped working, then the system would lose its purpose.
"Now issuing a new task: please increase the sales volume by two times in the upcoming days, and as a reward, you will receive the Youth-Preserving Pill instruction manual."
Lin Yi nodded in satisfaction.
"This is more like it. Don't worry, I will complete the task very soon, even in less than three days."
The system had given him a three-day deadline, but Lin Yi believed he could achieve it in just two days.
As long as Zhou Kongshan lent a hand and ramped up production, it would be sufficient.
After leaving contentedly, Lin Yi headed for the pharmaceutical factory and found Zhou Kongshan.
"Zhou Kongshan, I need to assign you a very critical task presently. You must complete it excellently for me. The daily production volume must be doubled."
Zhou Kongshan was dumbfounded on the spot; Lin Yi had never made such demands regarding production volume before.
Why did he suddenly start asking for an increase in production? Were the past few days' sales poor, or was he no longer satisfied with the status quo?
"Doubling the volume isn't a problem, but we can't maintain it for long, maybe just around three days. After all, increasing the workload will leave us very exhausted, and once we double it, we might lose any rest time."
Lin Yi couldn't exactly tell Zhou Kongshan that if they hit the production target, their sales would increase, and thus they would receive the instruction manual, could he?
"I have my reasons for doing this. You just need to follow orders. Rest assured, I will not mistreat you. Once this task is completed, I'll give you a week of paid leave."
If this were with anyone else, they probably would have jumped at the offer, but Zhou Kongshan did not think this was a good thing.
They could rest, but Zhou Kongshan still wanted to immerse himself in the pharmaceutical factory to fulfill his value.
"Since you, the boss, have said so, we will do our utmost."
Hearing Zhou Gongshan's response, Lin Yi nodded in approval and then left the pharmaceutical factory.
Wondering how things were going with Director Zhao, Lin Yi decided to make a call to Ling'er.
"Don't even mention it, how am I supposed to contact him recently? He refuses to reply to my messages. Although he occasionally says a few words, they are all trivial matters. I heard he hasn't gone to the company either, not sure what he's busy with?"
Ling'er's tone was sour because she felt she was about to lose; she had never failed before.
But this guy dared not to respond to her messages for so many days!
"I see. In that case, you don't need to contact him anymore for now. Just focus on your own stuff. When I need you to reach out to him, I'll notify you."
It seemed that Wang Guixiang had made her move, so Zhao Guangchen had started to cut off contact with his mistresses.
Enjoy more content from empire
Since Lin Yi had already said so, Ling'er wouldn't persist anymore.
She immediately put down her phone, firmly resolved not to contact that guy Director Zhao and to focus on her own things.
Lin Yi was actually quite curious about Han Xuemei's current situation.
When Han Xuemei was with Zhao Guangchen, she was haughty and even tried to use him to get rid of Lin Yi, but she didn't expect to end up in her present predicament.
She could only stay in a villa, completely unable to go out.
If she did, countless cameras would chase her for photos.
Han Xuemei was extremely anxious inside; she couldn't afford to lose Zhao Guangchen as her cash cow.
What would she do next without him?
When Zhao Guangchen returned to his company, he gathered all the documents, then sent them to Wang Guixiang.
The first thing Wang Guixiang did after receiving the documents was to forward them to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi quickly received the files from Wang Guixiang, along with some compromising information.
Perfect, he would soon witness Zhao Guangchen's downfall.
"Wife, I've sent you everything. Please forward it to your mother quickly and have her transfer the money to me. Then, ask her to send someone over," Zhao Guangchen said, still oblivious to the looming trouble, thinking he was about to outwit Lin Yi.
But why hadn't Wang Guihua replied to his message yet after such a long time?
Suddenly, Zhao Guangchen had a bad feeling.
Didn't Wang Guixiang just sell out all those documents? Or could they have some other use?
Was that wretched woman planning to screw him over?
He immediately called Wang Guixiang, who was no longer afraid of him.
Now that she had all the evidence and recordings, all that was left was to divorce him smoothly and then leave with the child.
"Wife, why didn't you answer my message just now? I've sent you the documents. Did you receive them? When can I expect the support you promised?" Zhao Guangchen implored her, not rushing to question her but trying a different approach instead.
"You won't receive any support. Let's get a divorce. I'll send you the divorce agreement; sign it, and we can amicably part ways. Of course, you must leave without a single asset. If you're unwilling, then we can go to court."
This rapid-fire statement left Zhao Guangchen completely dumbfounded.
What did Wang Guixiang mean? Was she planning to discard him after use? He had just sent her the documents!
"Are you out of your mind? I've just handed over the documents to you, and you promised to support me. Why are you suddenly asking for a divorce?"

chapters.title: Chapter 299 Lawyer Liu
chapters.content:
Zhao Guangchen could never agree to divorce, after all, his wife was the only one he could depend on now.
If Wang Guixiang abandoned him too, who could he trust and rely on in the future?
"I indeed said I'd assist you, but now I've changed my mind, the things you've done are simply unworthy of my assistance, so don't entangle yourself with me anymore, rest assured, I won't deal with you like I did before, since you already have so many beautiful lovers, go find them, and sign the divorce agreement quickly."
Having been married for so long, it was the first time Wang Guixiang had treated him like this, and she felt unable to calm her heart for a long time.
In the past, Wang Guixiang always endured for the sake of the child.
But now, she wanted to leave with the child, she would not let this scumbag harm the two of them anymore.
"Impossible, you can forget about it, I will never agree to divorce, if you want a divorce, transfer the child to me and leave with nothing!"
Zhao Guangchen shouldn't still think he could decide where Wang Guixiang stays or goes.
He no longer had any right to speak, after all, Wang Guixiang had gathered all the evidence already.
Next, if Zhao Guangchen wasn't willing, Wang Guixiang could take him to court at any moment.
By then, even if he disagreed, he would have to agree.
"I knew this would be your reaction, we won't be coming home recently, you can just stay in that room by yourself, if you're bored, you can have your lovers accompany you, I've found all the evidence, so just wait for the subpoena."
After saying that, Wang Guixian hung up the phone, he had never felt so relieved, great, he had finally escaped from misery!
He could now lead a normal life with his son, Zhao Guangchen was furious after being hung up on.
He smashed everything in his room onto the floor, looking utterly insane.
The employees outside heard such noises coming from the boss's office and were afraid.
"Good for you, Wang Guixiang, you're playing this trick on me, you must have been prepared for a while now, probably those pieces of evidence were collected beforehand, you crazy woman, I will definitely not let you have your way!"
Zhao Guangchen dialed his secretary's phone, asking him to find a lawyer immediately, as he wanted to discuss the matter of divorce.
Ling'er also received the news, so Zhao Guangchen was getting divorced, it seemed that Lin Yi had started to make a move.
"Hmph! The wicked will eventually receive their retribution, he used to womanize without restraint, now he's got it, probably going to be left with nothing, after making so many mistakes."
Although these matters had nothing to do with Ling'er, she still felt very pleased.
She particularly despised such scumbags, and the reason she tempted these people was to ensure the wicked received their dues.
Soon, the secretary found a lawyer for Zhao Guangchen.
"Hello, Director Zhao, how may I assist you?"
"Lawyer Liu, I have a very important matter, I hope you can help me, we have worked together several times before, this time I want to discuss divorce matters with you, my wife wants to divorce me now."
This Lawyer Liu had been involved in many injustices with Zhao Guangchen.
Since Lawyer Liu had high professional integrity, his skills were considerable.
"Divorce is not a big deal, if there is anything you need help with, Director Zhao, just tell me, I will do everything possible to assist you."
It was just a divorce lawsuit after all, why was Director Zhao so afraid?
He should have divorced that wife of his a long time ago.
After all, Director Zhao is living such a good life now, if he doesn't divorce his former wife soon, he will miss out on many beautiful girls.
"I know, Attorney Liu, it's just that the situation is different now. My wife has gathered a lot of evidence about my affairs, including photos and recordings of me. So, the situation must be very critical now. Her demand is that I leave with nothing and the child stays with her."
After hearing what Director Zhao had said, Attorney Liu's eyes widened.
He didn't expect such a shrewd man as Director Zhao to be caught in such a predicament.
This just made his job a lot more troublesome.
After all, the other side had evidence of his infidelity, and many more of his weaknesses in hand.
If these were disclosed in court, then Director Zhao would very likely be ruled to leave with nothing.
"Director Zhao, this really puts me in a difficult position."
Attorney Liu deliberately put on a troubled look, which immediately panicked Director Zhao.
If even Attorney Liu could not save him, it seemed this lawsuit was doomed to be lost.
He was willing to spend more money to have Attorney Liu protect him.
"Attorney Liu, please don't feel it's too difficult. I'll give you as much money as you want, however much more you need, I'll raise it. But I hope you can definitely keep my son this time. If there's no way to stay with me, that's fine, but please don't let me leave with nothing!"
Director Zhao really didn't know who else to turn to and all he could think of was Attorney Liu.
Actually, Attorney Liu did have a way to help Director Zhao.
But he hoped that the previous price could be increased a bit so he could live more comfortably.
"Director Zhao, don't panic. As long as the money is good, rest assured, I will definitely resolve this issue for you. Leave that woman to me."
People like them could never wash their hands clean.
Since that woman opposed him and prevented him from making money, then he would have that woman disappear.
After Attorney Liu left, Director Zhao still felt very anxious. He was completely uncertain, not knowing whether he could win the case.
After all, the things he had done were well known to everyone; a simple investigation would reveal the truth.
He used to be fearless because he never worried that Wang Guixiang would divorce him.
It seemed like besides herself, Wang Guixiang had no one else to rely on.
He had long forgotten that Wang Guixiang had her own family, which was not weak in power.
But it was this incident that made him realize for the first time that Wang Guixiang was a very smart woman.
She knew how to hide herself and how to help herself get through the current predicament.
It was his own fault for not seeing her true value, squandering such a good woman.
Now, it's all too late, he would definitely make that woman pay the price, after all, no one who opposed him had a good ending. Your next chapter awaits on empire
Wang Guixiang had already moved out with the child and found a random hotel to stay in.
For the time being, they would have to stay here.
Luckily, Wang Guixiang still had a good amount of money on hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 300 Threat
chapters.content:
"Mommy, why don't we go home instead of staying in a hotel? Isn't Daddy staying with us? Daddy only spent a few days with me, and now I won't be able to see him again."
The child conveyed his longing for his father in front of Wang Guixiang.
Actually, the child didn't understand the complexities between the adults; he just wanted his father to spend more time with him.
After all, the days his father spent with him were countable on one hand.
"Xiaobao, from now on, there will be no Daddy, only Mommy to be with you. Would you be sad? If you want to go with Daddy, you can. Mommy wants to respect your choice."
Guixiang held her child's hand and as she spoke these words, Xiaobao began to understand.
It seemed that, in the end, Mommy and Daddy had reached this point.
He had heard other people say that Mommy and Daddy would eventually get divorced one day.
After all, a marriage like theirs couldn't last long, and it seemed that now they really had reached that point.
Xiaobao's expression suddenly became serious.
If he had to choose, he would still choose to be with Mommy, because he didn't have much affection for his father.
"Mommy, don't worry, I won't go with Daddy. I will stay with you. After all, Mommy is a girl and needs a boy's protection. Mommy has already lost Daddy; she can't lose me too!"
Holding Xiaobao, who seemed so understanding, Wang Guixiang couldn't hold back any longer.
Her long-suppressed emotions burst forth, and tears fell like a torrent.
She hugged her child and wept for a long time, Xiaobao gently patted Mommy's back, just like she used to comfort him.
Xiaobao still remembered how, on his previous birthday, Daddy never came back, and he cried just like Mommy was crying now.
Mommy used to comfort him patiently, bit by bit, so he also wanted to comfort Mommy.
Even without Daddy in the future, he would be there.
He would protect Mommy and ensure that no one bullied her!
After releasing her emotions, Wang Guixiang could clearly feel that she was in a much better state now.
Next, she wanted to take her son to enjoy the beauty of nature and travel the world together.
But just as they stepped out of the hotel, they were abducted.
Wang Guixiang could have never imagined that she and her son would fall into the hands of evil people.
They hadn't done anything heinous, nor did they possess anything that others would covet.
"Wuu wuu wuu!"
When Wang Guixiang woke up, she found that the bad guys had gagged her; she couldn't make a sound and could only cry out for help hoarsely.
Xiaobao lay unconscious around her, and Wang Guixiang looked around at the unfamiliar setting.
What on earth was happening?
How could they suddenly have been kidnapped by someone?
Could it have been arranged by Zhao Guangchen?
Impossible, even if Zhao Guangchen had a hundred guts, he wouldn't dare to do this.
"Wang Guixiang, look at the mess you're in, I heard you're getting a divorce from Director Zhao. How could you make such a pathetic decision? Just hand over those documents to me, then choose to leave with nothing, and I'll spare both your lives. Of course, if you're unwilling to hand over the documents, I'm afraid you won't be able to leave here today."
Wang Guixiang seemed to have heard this voice before, but she just couldn't remember where. Discover stories with empire
Now that the gag was removed from her mouth, she could finally speak.
"I knew you were sent by him. Dream on, I will absolutely not hand over the evidence to you. What he has done is public knowledge. Even without this evidence, any judge with a bit of sense could simply ask anyone to find out what's going on."
As the saying goes, you can't escape the eyes of heaven. Zhao Guangchen can't truly believe that no one is watching what he's doing!
Seeing Wang Guixiang's defiant demeanor, Lawyer Liu was getting impatient.
If this woman refuses a toast only to be forced to drink a forfeit, then let her learn her lesson the hard way.
"Hmph, overestimating yourself. Just because you are a woman, don't even think about opposing Director Zhao. Today I want to see just how tough you really are. What are you guys standing around for? Give her a good slap now!"
Lawyer Liu stepped aside.
His two lackeys approached, rolled up their sleeves, and slapped Wang Guixiang's face twice with a loud smack.
Xiaobao woke up to the noise and was crying from the scare at this point.
But seeing his mother being bullied, he gathered his courage again.
"What are you doing? Don't you dare bully my mom, I won't let you off!"
Xiaobao stood up from the ground, and probably because he was a child, they hadn't gagged him.
Xiaobao could still speak, and after standing up, he rushed toward those two men as fast as he could.
But he was kicked away by the two men.
For the first time, Wang Guixiang felt hopeless, she couldn't allow her child to be put in danger, she herself was dispensable.
"If you have an issue, take it out on me, don't lay a hand on a child. You want the evidence, right? I can give it to you. It's hidden in the hotel room, go find it!"
In the end, Wang Guixiang still chose to save her child, after all, nothing was more important than Xiaobao.
Lawyer Liu needed to verify whether what Wang Guixiang said was true, so he only sent one of his men.
And Lin Yi had actually placed his people around Wang Guixiang to protect her.
He knew that once Wang Guixiang openly broke with Zhao Guangchen, things would not end well for her, so his people were there to protect her.
The moment Wang Guixiang disappeared, his people received the news and immediately informed Lin Yi.
"Find out where Wang Guixiang was taken, try to protect her and her son by all means, don't let them be harmed, and also, find the ones who kidnapped them."
Lin Yi didn't need to get involved personally, his subordinates could handle it all. Hei Lang was extremely top-notch.
Hei Lang nodded and then left with his men to rescue Wang Guixiang.
At this very moment, Lawyer Liu's men had just arrived at the hotel.
The moment they stepped into the room, they were immediately subdued by Hei Lang's people.
"Talk! Where did you take them? If you confess truthfully, I might spare your life, but if you lie, this knife will cut off your hand."
The lackey, who had never seen such a scene, was terrified and blurted out their hideout.
Hei Lang and his men rushed toward the location.
Time ticked away, and Lawyer Liu still hadn't received any message from his men.

chapters.title: Chapter 301 Gratitude
chapters.content:
"How come these guys are taking so long to come? They've never been this slow before when doing a job!"
Lawyer Liu was getting a bit impatient. He wanted to call his brothers, but no one answered.
It was at this moment that the door was kicked open.
Hei Lang and his men rushed in, quickly encircling the area.
Lawyer Liu was dumbstruck on the spot. What's going on? How had the situation reversed in an instant?
"Who are you people? Who let you in? Get out now, do you know who I am? If you dare to cross me, be careful, I'll make it so you can't survive in this city!"
But he was just a lawyer and yet sounded so arrogant—it seemed there were other forces behind him.
Hei Lang recorded everything, intending to bring it back to Lin Yi so that Lin Yi could deal with the people backing Lawyer Liu.
"We don't need to know who you are. We're here on a mission, and these two are not people you can afford to offend. Hand them over to me now, and you might have a chance to live. If you refuse to compromise, then you'll have to die here."
Hei Lang was a cold-hearted and ruthless person; thus, he wouldn't entertain unnecessary thoughts.
He had already warned Lawyer Liu. If Lawyer Liu didn't back down, then Hei Lang would execute him on the spot.
People like Fang Zheng, of Lawyer Liu's ilk, were a blight upon the world even if they remained alive.
Wang Guixiang hadn't expected that, at a crucial moment, it would be Lin Yi's men coming to her rescue.
"Boss, we're surrounded. If we don't surrender, it seems we really will die here just as he says."
Not knowing the other party's influence but to make such bold statements and to find them in such a short time shows that their boss is no ordinary person.
Lawyer Liu was, in fact, somewhat hesitant.
"Fine, we'll hand them over to you now, but you must retreat and not harm any of us."
Since there was no way to salvage the situation, the best course of action was to protect his brothers as much as possible.
Hei Lang agreed and then took away Wang Guixiang and her son.
Lawyer Liu stood on the spot, unable to recover from the shock for a long time.
Where had it all gone wrong? How could they have been exposed so quickly?
"It seems that no one can help Director Zhao this time."
