Zhao Guangchen's luck had run out; no one could help him now.
Lawyer Liu had done whatever he could, and now not only had he failed to secure the necessary evidence, but he had also been compromised by the adversary.
So, for Lawyer Liu, the priority was self-preservation, not dealing with Director Zhao.
Hei Lang took Wang Guixiang and her son to meet Lin Yi.
When they saw Lin Yi, Wang Guixiang and her son immediately fell to their knees with a thud.
"What are you doing? Get up quickly; besides, the child is so young, it's not good to teach him this," Lin Yi said.
Lin Yi was also taken aback by Wang Guixiang's action.
This woman couldn't be out of her mind, could she? Why on earth was she suddenly kneeling? He hadn't mistreated her.
Wang Guixiang was sobbing with snot and tears; she really didn't know how to express her gratitude to Lin Yi.
```
If it hadn't been for Lin Yi, their mother and son would probably be in heaven by now.
"Lin Yi, I really don't know how to repay you. Although the documents I gave you before were my duty, if you ever need me in the future, please just say the word. I would gladly lay down my life for you. I'm truly grateful to you, Lin Yi, for saving both of us!"
Wang Guixiang expressed her gratitude to Lin Yi once again.
Her son also just realized that this big brother was their savior.
"It's okay, you don't have to worry about it. Besides, we were already business partners, how could I stand by and watch you die? Alright, enough with the grand gestures, get up quickly, I accept your thanks."
Lin Yi urged them to get up quickly, feeling somewhat awkward about the situation.
After Wang Guixiang and her son stood up, Da Bao suddenly ran to Lin Yi and hugged his thigh.
Was this what they called 'clinging to the powerful's thigh'?
"Da Bao, what are you doing? Come back here quickly!"
Wang Guixiang was startled by her son's actions, worried about how Lin Yi might react if he got angry.
To her surprise, Da Bao clung to Lin Yi's leg and looked up at him with an innocent face.
"Big brother, I know you saved us, and I'm really thankful for that. Big brother, I don't know how to repay you. I'm too weak right now, but if you can wait, when I grow up, I will definitely help you!"
The child was too adorable, somewhat like Lin Yi's own Er Bao.
Er Bao had once said the same thing to Lin Yi.
He felt that he was still particularly weak and couldn't protect his parents well, so he was determined to become stronger.
Hopefully, his dad could rely on him by that time.
"Da Bao, what are you talking about? How can you say such things to your brother? Come here quickly!"
Because Lin Yi looked young, even though he was already married, in the end, Wang Guixiang still let her son call Lin Yi 'brother'.
"It's fine. My own son has said the same thing to me. It seems you two are quite alike. If there's a chance in the future, I'll let you be friends. You can go home now, it's safe. Plus, I've arranged for people to protect you, so you don't have to worry about being threatened again."
Lin Yi patted Da Bao's head and signaled that they could go home.
Lin Yi wouldn't engage in too much conversation with a woman, after all, it would make Han Xuewei angry. Your journey continues with empire
"I'm really grateful to you, Lin Yi."
Wang Guixiang also understood the importance of avoiding danger, so she quickly left with her son, who kept looking back at Lin Yi as they departed.
"Mom, that big brother is so amazing, he didn't even show up and saved us. I want to become like him in the future!"
The child spoke candidly, and in fact, Wang Guixiang herself believed in her son's words.
One day, he would surely become someone like Lin Yi, as impressive as Lin Yi.
After Wang Guixiang and her son had left, Lin Yi began dealing with the following matters.
Director Zhao's situation was probably in complete chaos by now.
Just as Lin Yi had expected, Zhao Guangchen was terrified upon receiving the information from Lawyer Liu.
He had never imagined that things would have come to this point without accomplishing anything.
"It's over, completely over. What should I do now? There's no one who can help me. Lin Yi has destroyed everything for me!"
Zhao Guangchen finally realized the severity of the issue; he should never have opposed Lin Yi from the start.

chapters.title: Chapter 302 Watching the Drama
chapters.content:
Han Xuemei had also found out about Zhao Guangchen's predicament.
"I didn't expect this man to fall from power so quickly. What should I do next? Without him, how can I confront Lin Yi? Oh God, I shouldn't have given myself to that man. I was so naive, thinking he was incredible, but it turns out he's just another loser!"
Han Xuemei was filled with regret. She couldn't believe she had given herself to an old man, especially when that was her most precious possession.
Now it was too late for any regrets.
She had to move out of the villa quickly; otherwise, if others discovered her missteps, she would be even less able to clear her name.
After packing up her belongings, Han Xuemei immediately slipped out of the villa.
At the same time, Zhao Guangchen returned to the villa. He wanted to see Han Xuemei one last time.
After all, before he had lost everything, he still had Han Xuemei.
But when he encountered her, he discovered that she looked at him with utter disdain.
"Why have you come here? Shouldn't you be unable to protect yourself right now? I heard your company is about to go under, and your wife wants to divorce you."
Han Xuemei spoke with sharp sarcasm, laying bare Zhao Guangchen's current circumstances.
Zhao Guangchen came here to escape reality, but to his dismay, Han Xuemei dragged him back into it.
He couldn't understand. He had treated Han Xuemei so well, so why did she treat him this way?
Why did she want to leave him, and what gave her the right? He had given her so much!
Even if Han Xuemei didn't return his possessions, the least she could do was to show him some genuine feeling!
"How could you treat me this way, Han Xuemei? Ask yourself, have I ever treated you poorly? I've been so good to you, I've given you everything I have. Although I might not have been nice these past few days, wasn't I good enough before? Why do you want to leave me? Why can't you stay with me a while longer?"
Zhao Guangchen advanced step by step, and Han Xuemei, frightened, stepped back twice, her luggage case still in her hand.
She had to leave this place today, no matter what.
She could not follow Zhao Guangchen any longer; it would ruin her life.
"Why should I stay with you? We were only ever in a relationship of convenience. Now that you have nothing useful to me, why should I stay? Stop being naively hopeful, okay? You don't really think those women were with you because they liked you, do you? They were all just after your money and power."
Now that things had reached this point, Han Xuemei saw no need to continue placating him with lies.
So, she laid out the harsh truth.
Zhao Guangchen couldn't accept it. Were all those women with him just for those things?
He had foolishly believed that, at least, those women had loved him, even if they eventually parted ways.
Zhao Guangchen became enraged, his face twisting with anger.
"You're talking nonsense. Women like you deserve the same fate as me. Why should you get to leave me? You're not going anywhere today. Don't forget, this is my territory. Even if I'm finished, don't you forget that it would be easy for me to kill you!"
Ultimately, Han Xuemei had provoked Zhao Guangchen's fury.
Zhao Guangchen charged at her and grabbed her neck, squeezing it hard.
He was determined to make this woman pay!
"What are you doing? Let go of me at once!"
Han Xuemei was scared; she feared Zhao Guangchen might really kill her.
She hadn't lived long enough; she hadn't had her fill of the world yet. How could she leave so easily?
No, she had to escape!
But the disparity in strength between men and women was just too great.
Han Xuemei almost thought she was going to be choked to death by Zhao Guangchen several times.
"Women like you shouldn't live in this world, fickle and insincere. I will kill you, and when I die, someone will pay for me!"
This time, Zhao Guangchen was like a man who had nothing to lose; his eyes were ferocious, showing no hint of jest.
Han Xuemei gradually found it hard to breathe.
She wouldn't really meet her end here today, would she?
Han Xuemei was terrified. This was the first time she felt that death was so close to her.
She suddenly saw a flowerpot nearby, grabbed it without hesitation, and smashed it onto Zhao Guangchen's body.
Zhao Guangchen fainted instantly, and seeing this, Han Xuemei hurriedly grabbed her suitcase and fled.
Even though she didn't know where to go now, it was better than staying here. She could not entangle with this man any longer.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi had received the news.
He heard that Zhao Guangchen was now in the most dangerous state.
But he was still unwilling to give up and was determined to confront Lin Yi; he had already gone to the villa to see Han Xue for one last time.
It was unclear how the two got along, but Lin Yi was very eager to meddle in these affairs.
"Inform me whenever anything comes up; I'm going out for a bit."
After everything was settled, Lin Yi drove to Zhao Guangchen's villa in the suburbs.
He had actually figured out where the two lived a long time ago but simply didn't care to bother with them.
He came here today partly to provoke and partly to enjoy the drama.
He did not expect the gate to be unlocked, and just like that, Lin Yi walked in.
When he saw Zhao Guangchen collapsed on the ground, Lin Yi hesitated for a moment, but eventually, he still called an ambulance for him.
When Zhao Guangchen opened his eyes, he was surprised to find Lin Yi standing by the bedside.
"Why are you here? How did I end up in the hospital, and where did that damn woman go? Did you hide her? Lin Yi, I didn't expect you would oppose me to the very end!"
Experience more tales on empire
Zhao Guangchen looked angrily at Lin Yi. His condition wasn't good, and the doctor had advised against him getting angry.
So Lin Yi didn't want to provoke him.
"Alright, alright, not sure who hit you with a flowerpot, you ended up collapsing on the ground. If it weren't for me, you would have been gone by now. Thank me, you should."
After Lin Yi finished speaking, Zhao Guangchen recalled that he was indeed hit by a flowerpot by Han Xue, that despicable woman.
Realizing that he had really misunderstood Lin Yi, Zhao Guangchen felt a bit bad, although reluctantly.
But then he thought about what Lin Yi had done to him, and all those feelings of remorse dissipated in an instant.
"I don't need your charity, nor do I need your intervention. Lin Yi, isn't my current plight all thanks to you? What are you pretending for here?"
Seeing Zhao Guangchen's ungrateful demeanor, Lin Yi felt there was no need to say more.

chapters.title: Chapter 303 Company Goes Bankrupt
chapters.content:
"I know you don't need me to take care of you, but since that's the case, just pay up, will you? I did spend quite a bit on your hospital stay and treatment after all. You've got to pay me back every penny."
Lin Yi slapped the bill right onto Zhao Guangchen's face, urging him to pay up quickly so he could leave.
Charity was not his thing.
Zhao Guangchen, unable to take such an insult, reached into his pocket to pull out his wallet.
But then it hit him—he didn't have any money on him, not a single dime.
Besides, his wife had already canceled all his bank cards.
The atmosphere turned awkward. He had been defiant about not needing help, but now he couldn't even produce the cash.
Lin Yi clearly intended not to leave without the money.
"You go on back first, leave your contact information. I'll transfer the money to you, don't worry. I absolutely won't skip town. After all, I don't want to owe someone like you. It's just that I can't pay you right now, so please leave!"
At this moment, Zhao Guangchen's voice lost some of its force, probably realizing how embarrassing his situation was.
"No way, how do I know you won't skip town? And you've never been trustworthy in your speech. I don't want to make things difficult for you, but give me the money and I'll go. Don't tell me you don't have the money right now. You're such a big boss, and you don't even have this bit of cash? That's really shameful."
Couldn't Lin Yi see what a bind he was in?
Moreover, wasn't it thanks to Lin Yi that he was in this situation to begin with?
How could he have the nerve to sit there, asking him for money—and such a sum at that?
"I really don't have any money right now, but rest assured, I won't shortchange you. After all, I don't want to owe you anything. So, please just go back. I'll transfer it to you. Can you stop bothering me here? I'm a patient.
I need to rest."
It was truly rare to see someone who owed money speak with such an assertive tone.
If he didn't have the money, Lin Yi figured there was no need for him to continue staying in the hospital; he certainly wasn't going to get paid.
So Lin Yi just went ahead and processed Zhao Guangchen's discharge.
When Zhao Guangchen stood at the hospital entrance, his entire face darkened.
What was Lin Yi thinking? He surely knew that Zhao's body was still not well, suffering from a slight concussion.
By suddenly discharging him, was Lin Yi trying to kill him?
"As for the money for your treatment, consider it charity. Now you can go home. Since you don't want to accept my help, there's no need for you to stay in the hospital. Check yourself back in when you have the funds."
With that, Lin Yi vanished in the blink of an eye, leaving Zhao Guangchen disheveled in the wind,
Lin Yi was truly born to be his adversary.
What was he to do now?
He couldn't go home, and his company was nearly gone. He didn't have a penny, couldn't stay in the hospital, and his head was throbbing with pain.
He suddenly felt as if his world had plunged into darkness.
"Lin Yi, I hate you. If it weren't for you, how could I have fallen this low? It's all because of you that I am now isolated and helpless!"
When the people at the company heard that their boss had nothing left, they all came to him one after another, demanding this week's pay.
But Zhao Guangchen now can't even afford the hospital fees, so how could he possibly pay the employees' wages?
He told everyone the truth.
But they wouldn't buy it.
After working themselves to the bone for so long, if they didn't get a salary, wouldn't they have worked the whole month for nothing?
"Boss, we know you're in a tough spot, but we need to make ends meet, and we can't just work for you for a week for free."
"Exactly, boss, if you do this, that would be really underhanded. It's your own problem to solve, but you can't delay our wages, or else, we will definitely sue you."
Zhao Guangchen hadn't even sorted out his family affairs, and now he had the company's issues added to the pile. How could he possibly handle it well?
"Everyone, please calm down. I know you're all very angry, but pressuring me won't make money appear; I really can't come up with it. If you're willing, look around the company to see if there's anything you can take, and take it all away."
That was the only solution Zhao Guangchen could think of in the end.
The company was now drowning in debt, to the point where they couldn't even pay the staff salaries.
As for why things had come to this, it was all thanks to Lin Yi, who had dug a big pit for Zhao Guangchen.
Ling'er had previously invited Zhao Guangchen to invest together; unexpectedly, they had recently lost everything, and even more!
Indeed, seduced by a beauty, Zhao Guangchen had deeply realized his mistake; he shouldn't have trusted that guy.
Now Zhao Guangchen knew that the woman and Lin Yi were in cahoots, aiming to put him in a difficult position.
"Boss, we're not intentionally making things hard for you, but these things are of no use to us. Even if we take them, then what? Just give us the money, boss. We'll give you a few days to think it over, hoping you can come up with the money in that time,"
the employee leader left Zhao Guangchen with those words and then led the employees away, as they didn't want to strike either.
But without the boss settling the wages, they had no other choice.
Looking at his once-large company, now empty and heavily in debt...
He thought of seeking out Wang Guixiang. Enjoy new tales from empire
But with Wang Guixiang wanting a divorce, how could she be expected to fall for his sweet talk?
Zhao Guangchen, however, still wanted to try.
After all, aside from Wang Guixiang, he couldn't think of anyone else who would help him.
"You're calling me, what do you want? Or have you made up your mind to have a peaceful divorce with me?"
If they could avoid a lawsuit, that would naturally be best, but if Zhao Guangchen persisted in his folly, Wang Guixiang would have no choice but to sue him.
"Wife, I really know I was wrong. Can you forgive me this one time? I will never make the same mistake again. I truly need you right now, and to think that we've been together for so many years, it would be such a pity to divorce now."
To Wang Guixiang, Zhao Guangchen's words were all nonsense, completely unnecessary to say.
Did this guy not realize how badly he had wronged Wang Guixiang before?
And now he came with these righteous-sounding words, which were simply laughable.
"We have reached the end. You don't need to say these words to deceive me anymore; I won't listen."

chapters.title: Chapter 304 In a sorry state
chapters.content:
If this had happened in the past, hearing such words would have made her very happy, her husband had finally seen the error of his ways.
But now, Wang Guixiang could only find it laughable.
Over the years, it wasn't that Wang Guixiang had never given him chances.
But what had he done? He had never taken Wang Guixiang seriously.
Now, because Wang Guixiang could threaten him, he turned around and apologized to her, hoping to avoid divorce. How could that be possible?
Wang Guixiang truly felt that his brain was too simple. She hung up the phone with a snap, and her son asked who had called.
"It was your dad," she replied, "but you should give up on him now. He's not a qualified father. Don't worry, I will never let you down in the future; I will be very good to you. You must know what kind of person your mother is."
Over the years, Zhao Guangchen's return home could be counted on one hand.
He had no real affection for his son, so there was no point in letting his son waste time on him. It would be better to find a new father for his son.
"Mom, rest assured, I will definitely not feel any sympathy for that man. I know how he has treated us over the years, so I'll never forgive him. I might have held some illusions about him before, but now I don't have any," the son said.
Da Bao indeed had harbored fantasies about Zhao Guangchen before, hoping his father would return home.
But time and time again, disappointment had made it a familiar feeling.
He had intended to persuade his mother not to divorce.
But now, he realized that if he sided with his mother, it would only harm both her and himself.
His father was never going to change, so the best course of action was divorce, to leave that man.
After hearing Da Bao's words, Wang Guixiang felt very satisfied. It should be just like this.
He shouldn't harbor any illusions about that man.
After all, that man was nothing, and he couldn't even be good to his own son.
Zhao Guangchen was still trying every means to contact Wang Guixiang, seeking her forgiveness.
Only then could he possibly turn the situation around, have a chance to start over.
Without Wang Gui's help and facing the prospect of leaving with nothing, it would all be over for him.
Finally, he found out where Wang Guixiang was staying and immediately rushed to the hotel.
He must have a proper talk with Wang Guixiang!
He couldn't believe that Wang Guixiang, who loved him so much, would choose to divorce him at such a time.
Upon arriving at the hotel, Zhao Guangchen said nothing and barged in.
He arrived in front of Wang Guixiang's room and knocked on the door.
Wang Guixiang, not expecting anything, opened the door.
But when she saw Zhao Guangchen, her gaze turned cold immediately.
Find adventures at empire
How did this guy find this place? It seems the hotel staff isn't very tight-lipped.
"How did you get here? Didn't I make myself clear? Either sign the agreement, or we'll go to court."
Wang Guixiang felt she had nothing to say to this man and tried to close the door, but Zhao Guangchen stopped her.
Zhao Guangchen placed his foot in the doorway, and even though the door was pinching his foot painfully, he refused to move it away.
"Wife, please hear me out, okay? I know what I've done before is utterly inhuman, but I've truly changed now. Would you give me another chance? I'm begging you, you don't want our son to grow up without a father, do you? Look, he still cares for me in his heart, so please forgive me this once, for our son's sake, alright?"
He really had the nerve, resorting to such shamelessness even now, trying to use his son as a shield.
Expecting Han Xuemei to forgive him, how could that ever be possible?
Wang Guixiang had given up on Zhao Guangchen, and even if their son insisted on staying with his father, she would not choose to stay married.
"Don't worry, if our son voluntarily chooses to be with you, I won't say a thing, but this divorce must happen. I don't want to be entangled with you any longer. If you have nothing else to say, then please leave, or else I'm calling security."
Wang Guixiang's eyes were extremely cold, she had to get rid of Zhao Guangchen, the dead weight, as soon as possible.
She was already picking up the phone to call security when Zhao Guangchen took the chance to slip into the room.
Their son stood between Wang Guixiang and Zhao Guangchen.
"Dad, please leave. Mom said she doesn't welcome you here, so you can't come in. And if you take one more step forward, we are going to call the police!"
Seeing his own son standing opposite him filled Zhao Guangchen's heart with mixed emotions; this was, after all, his only child.
"Da Bao, how can you talk to your father like this? I'm your dad! Even if I get divorced from your mom, I'm still your dad, and you're not allowed to speak to me with that tone, do you hear me?"
Zhao Guangchen spoke to Da Bao in a stern tone, and when Wang Gui heard him talking to Da Bao like that, she immediately pulled Da Bao behind her.
She had already dialed security, and they would arrive shortly.
This man really was shameless.
After all that had happened, he still had the audacity to talk this way in front of her and their son.
"Don't talk to our Da Bao like that, you have no right to speak to him that way. If you really knew you were his dad, you wouldn't have stayed away from home for so long, not being there for his birthday. You're completely unqualified."
Wang Guixiang rebuked Zhao Guangchen with an extremely stern voice, and Zhao Guangchen still wanted to argue with them.
But security had already arrived.
Two security guards took hold of Zhao Guangchen, one on each side, and threw him out of the hotel.
Zhao Guangchen looked at his own disheveled appearance and suddenly burst into loud laughter; the people around thought he was a lunatic.
"Who would have thought, I'd one day end up like this. It seems the world really does envy the gifted!"
He had actually stumbled upon the formula for a miracle drug by chance in the past.
Now, he was once again faced with the feeling of being completely worthless; no wife, no son, only himself.
The beauties from before were no longer willing to give him the time of day.
Lost and dispirited, he walked the streets back to his own company, to take one last look.
On the other hand, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei's life together was quite joyous.
"Why don't we go pick up our three treasures today? They've been with their grandparents all this time, and to tell the truth, I feel a bit embarrassed about it."
Han Xuewei actually missed the children a bit, and wanted to bring them over until her vacation was over, then she could send them back.
"Sure, let's go today."

chapters.title: Chapter 305 Taking the Child Away
chapters.content:
No sooner said than done, Lin Yi immediately took Han Xuewei to his parents' house. When they saw the children again, Han Xuewei couldn't have been happier.
"Mom and Dad, you're finally here! You haven't come to see us for ages, have you forgotten about us?"
Da Bao was the first to confront them, standing in front of his parents and then clinging to their arms, cooing.
"How could we have forgotten you? It's just that Mom and Dad have been so busy lately that we haven't had the time to come over. Now, Mom's finally on vacation and can spend a few good days with you guys, so is it okay if we take you back home with us?"
Han Xuewei spoke softly and gently to her three children.
However, Han's mother and Dad Han immediately became unhappy when they heard this.
"What do you two mean by this? Are you trying to cast us aside after using us? Throw us away when you no longer need us, is that it? Don't even think about it, it's absolutely not going to happen!"
They had finally been able to spend so much time with their eldest grandson.
And now these two show up, saying they're going to take the children away just like that.
"Mom, we're just taking the children for a few days. When I start school, I will bring them back to you. How could you possibly not see your grandson?"
Lin Yi was sitting on the couch, drinking tea and chatting with Dad, leaving the negotiation with Mom to Han Xuewei.
"Don't talk to me about that, I'm not listening. My eldest grandson's only been with us for a few days, and you want to take them away? That's impossible, absolutely not, do you hear me? My granddaughter, like my grandson, must stay right here with me. You can't just decide to take the children away after sending them over!"
His mother's tone was very agitated, she didn't want her beloved grandchildren to be taken away by these two.
Why didn't they think of that when they initially sent their grandchildren over?
It had only been a few days, and they were not ready to part with them!
Han Xuewei hadn't expected it to be this difficult, she had thought she could simply take the children away.
After all, weren't the three children supposed to be a burden to them? Shouldn't they have been very annoyed already?
They had reached the age to enjoy their peace and quiet, and yet they had to take care of the children, which should have been a tiring task.
So why didn't these old folks feel tired at all, and even didn't want to let the children leave?
"Fine, fine, we'll just come by more often these next few days. Mom, you mustn't forget that they are my children after all. I will have to take them home eventually. It's okay for them to stay a bit longer, of course. And besides, Mom, you know that your daughter is of school age now."
Han Xuewei had explained it many times, but Mom wouldn't listen, the negotiation had failed.
Lin Yi sat on the side, drinking tea and chatting with Dad.
Han Xuewei walked over to Lin Yi, crestfallen, and then punched him in the arm.
Lin Yi was completely baffled, what had happened? Why had she suddenly hit him?
"Why didn't you help me talk just now? Mom won't let us take the kids away, so we'll just have to come back a few more times in the next few days. Besides, if you had spoken up, Mom would have definitely agreed; she loves you the most."
Han Xuewei truly wanted to take the children with her. She couldn't possibly keep running back and forth over the next few days, that would be too inconvenient.
So, they could only ask Lin Yi to step in.
"It's useless for you to talk to Mom, and how could it be useful if I talk to her? Okay, okay, don't be angry, alright? I'll talk to her in a bit, but first, come see this game of chess between me and Dad."
To soothe his wife, Lin Yi still agreed to Han Xuewei's request.
After dinner, he would have a good talk with his mother.
Usually, his mother did tend to listen to Lin Yi.
But on this matter, Lin Yi felt that even if he spoke up, it wouldn't make a difference.
"New task: Please pick up the children and spend three days with them, letting them experience complete happiness. The reward is 50 million."
After hearing about the new task issued by the system, Lin Yi almost spat out all the tea he was drinking.
What was going on? The tasks given by the system were too random, weren't they?
And what was this about staying with the children for three days and ensuring they felt complete happiness?
What exactly counted as making the children happy? Would buying them things and taking them out to play suffice?
Read new chapters at empire
"How can you be so full from drinking tea? Alright, alright, I'll play chess with Dad. You go and talk to Mom."
Looking at the situation, if he didn't take the children away, he probably wouldn't be able to complete the task.
If he couldn't complete the task, he wouldn't be able to move on to the next one.
Lin Yi gave up his seat at the chessboard and then went to find Han's mother.
"Mom, I heard from Xuewei that she wants to pick up the children, but you disagree. I came to see what the situation is. Is it because the children haven't been back for a long time, so you want to spend more days with them?"
Lin Yi sat down beside Han's mother and spoke softly to her.
He hoped Han's mother could understand them and let them take the children away for a few days.
After all, it had been so many days since they had spent time together with their children, and they, as parents, missed them too.
"You still know we miss our granddaughter and grandson? You haven't brought them to see us for so many days, and you didn't even tell me about the dangers at the kindergarten. It wasn't easy for you to bring the children here, so how can you take them away so quickly? I know you want to take the children back, but we also want them to stay here."
Han's mother had never done something like this before, but since she did it today, it clearly showed how much she loved these children.
"Mom, I understand. We'll only take the children back for three days. Very soon, we'll bring them back to you. Don't worry, we won't interfere with the time you want to spend with your grandchildren."
After Lin Yi's unwavering persuasion, Han's mother eventually gave in and agreed to let them take the children back.
Lin Yi breathed a sigh of relief; otherwise, this task would have been rather difficult to complete.
"Alright, alright, you always have the sweet tongue, you're the smooth talker. I really don't know how my silly daughter managed to land you. Okay, go pick up the children, but remember, you must bring them back to me after three days!"

chapters.title: Chapter 306 The Competition
chapters.content:
Eventually, Han's mother was persuaded, and Lin Yi could now explain the current situation to his beloved children.
After lunch, Lin Yi and Han Xuewei took their three children and left.
"Mom, why are you picking us up so early to go back? We thought we were going to spend more time at grandma and grandpa's place."
Not only Da Bao, but the other children also believed they might stay at their grandparents' house for a longer period.
But they never expected their parents would come to take them back so soon. They were very reluctant to leave grandma and grandpa.
Seeing her three adorable children like this, Han Xuewei felt her heart melting.
"My darlings, don't you want to go back with mom and dad? Don't worry, mom is on vacation for a while, so I have time to spend with you. That's why I came to take you home. Or do you prefer grandma and grandpa a bit more, and don't like mom and dad anymore?"
Han Xuewei pretended to be very sad.
The children, seeing mom upset, immediately became restless and hurried to explain to Han Xuewei.
"How could that be? Mom, how could we dislike you? We are, of course, very happy. It's just that we also worry about holding you back from your work. Mom, please don't cry; we know we were wrong."
As soon as Han Xuewei cried, the children instantly panicked, and Lin Yi really didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
Han Xuewei was already so grown-up, how could she still be like a child? But Lin Yi loved her for just that.
"Alright, alright, stop teasing them. They are still so young; how would they know your tricks? Sit tight, we're almost home. Darlings, is there anything you want to eat for lunch?"
Before going home, if the children wanted anything to eat, Lin Yi could make a detour to buy it.
The children thought for a moment.
They hadn't had hotpot for a long time, so they decided to have a hotpot for lunch at home. Lin Yi nodded in agreement.
Then, he went with the children and Han Xuewei to the market, buying some vegetables and other food for the hotpot.
Just after arriving at home, Lin Yi received a call from an unfamiliar number, with a very arrogant male voice on the other end.
After careful recollection, Lin Yi realized it was Wang Sheng.
"Do you have something important? Because if not, I'm going to hang up. I'm very busy and don't have time to chat with you."
Nothing was more important than being with his children and wife, so Lin Yi really didn't want to bother with him.
Upon hearing Lin Yi's tone, Wang Sheng became even angrier.
This guy really didn't see them as important at all.
It was precisely because of this that Wang Sheng made this call—he wanted to challenge Lin Yi!
"Lin Yi, what's there for you to be arrogant about? If you're a man, then have a match with me. I can't accept it, why should father compromise? I am determined to defeat you and show him!"
This Wang Sheng must have a case of second-year syndrome, right? Stricken with his own delusions, and now he wants to drag Lin Yi into it?
"Kid, I have zero interest in your business, so don't bother me."
After speaking, Lin Yi was already ready to hang up the phone.
People like Wang Sheng, Lin Yi had seen plenty.
It was all about wanting to show off in front of their own father because there wasn't an opportunity before.
Now, suddenly Lin Yi showed up, and it was a good opportunity; he wanted to seize this chance.
Hearing that Lin Yi was about to hang up, the person on the other end of the line panicked instantly, fearing to lose this opportunity with Lin Yi.
I guess I'll never have the chance again, huh?
"Don't hang up, Lin Yi, are you scared? I'm telling you, I've got your family's address. If you don't compete with me, then I'll have no choice but to start with the people around you."
That threat made Lin Yi stop the action of hanging up the phone.
No matter what, he absolutely couldn't lay a hand on his family. That was Lin Yi's bottom line.
And Wang Sheng had just trampled on Lin Yi's bottom line.
"Interesting, you're threatening me to compete with you? Well then, tell me, what do you want to compete in?"
Find exclusive stories on empire
Since this guy was so presumptuous as to challenge Lin Yi,
Lin Yi would then smack him down hard, ensuring he could never lift his head in front of his father again.
He mustn't really think Lin Yi was easily bullied.
Although Lin Yi was indeed a newcomer to the scene, dealing with someone like Wang Sheng was still well within his capabilities.
The kid seemed to be lacking in cunning; probably the competition he'd choose would be rather simple.
"What's wrong with me threatening you? I haven't even started on you. My competition is very simple. We both sell things. Whoever sells more wins. What do you think?
It should be a good topic for us, since you sell stuff and so do I."
Wang Sheng was secretly elated in his heart, convinced he had already won. He simply didn't take Lin Yi seriously.
He thought Lin Yi was just a guy who had become popular relying on his own medicine formula and was not to be feared.
"Alright then, tell me what you want to sell. Are we selling our own medicines, or something else?"
If he didn't smack this guy hard, he would probably keep pestering Lin Yi.
So to save himself future trouble, he agreed to his request.
After some thought, Wang Sheng realized he definitely couldn't out-sell Lin Yi if it came to medicines.
After all, the medicines Lin Yi currently had were selling like hotcakes.
"Let's sell herbal medicines. However, these herbs must be shipped out from our homes. You are not allowed to use your own. Of course, I assure you, our herbs will be the same. There won't be any discrepancies."
Although Lin Yi had no idea what scheme Wang Sheng had in mind, he agreed in the end.
After Wang Sheng hung up the phone, he went to prepare.
He was determined to humble Lin Yi forever and show those who looked down on him that he was actually very impressive!
Day in, day out, there were always these overconfident people coming to cause trouble.
Lin Yi shook his head helplessly and then returned to his wife's side.
They had already prepared everything needed for the hotpot.
"Dad, where did you go just now? Why were you on the phone for so long? We've been waiting for you."
Da Bao jumped into his father's arms, while Er Bao and Xiao Bao also wanted to join in the fun, but Lin Yi pushed them away.
After all, they were boys and couldn't be like the girls.
Luckily, Er Bao and Xiao Bao didn't mind much, as going to cuddle with Mom was just as good.
"It was work stuff, so the call took a bit longer."

chapters.title: Chapter 307 Eating Hot Pot
chapters.content:
Since it was a matter related to work, Da Bao wouldn't ask too many questions.
After all, he was still a child and didn't quite understand his father's affairs.
Then, the whole family started to have lunch together, and the hot pot was really delicious.
Especially at this time, when everyone gathered together, living happily, one couldn't mention how heartwarming it was.
"Mom and Dad, if we have the chance in the future, let's have hot pot together more often. It's really delicious. When we visit Grandma and Grandpa, they don't eat hot pot."
After all, they were elderly, and they were somewhat resistant to something like hot pot. They didn't like it, but they wouldn't refuse it either.
Sometimes Han Xuewei and Lin Yi would take things over to have hot pot with them, and they would agree to it.
However, in front of the children, they still felt that such food wasn't very healthy.
"After all, they're your grandparents, so it's normal for them not to like it. We can't force our likes on people who don't enjoy the same things, right? Okay, eat up, have a good sleep after lunch, and then tomorrow, let's see where you want to go? Mom and Dad should both have time."
After Han Xuewei finished speaking, Lin Yi thought for a while and realized that he probably wouldn't have time tomorrow, so he wouldn't be able to join them in their activities.
"I'm really sorry, my dear wife and children, I have some things to take care of tomorrow, so I may not be able to accompany you. It will be a long time, but don't worry, once Dad finishes his work, I'll come right back to be with you, okay?"
Since Dad had said so, how could anyone make things difficult for him?
"It's okay, Dad, you go ahead with your work first, we are already very happy with Mom here. And Dad, you must love us, you'll come back after you're done with your work, right?"
Little Bao ran to his dad's side, with big eyes twinkling and looking very cute, staring at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi immediately picked up Little Bao and handed over Da Bao to Han Xuewei.
"Of course, Dad likes you guys so much, I will surely come back early. You won't blame Dad for not having time to be with you, right?"
After all, he was the pillar of the family, and Lin Yi had many things to do, so he couldn't always focus on the children.
However, Lin Yi wouldn't miss any important moment in his children's lives.
Afterward, everyone chatted for a while, and then Lin Yi went to deal with his work.
He didn't know if he could complete the task like this, considering he had to be with the children for three days, but he couldn't even manage one day.
Who knew that someone as brainless as Wang Sheng would suddenly appear?
"System, it should be okay if I go out occasionally, right? After all, I can't drop all my work just to be with the children. But I will also try my best to limit my time and accompany the kids."
Just to be on the safe side, Lin Yi still asked the system for clarification after giving it some thought. In fact, there wasn't much of a problem.
"It's okay. If you're busy, just go ahead with your own work, it won't be a problem here."
The system was very amenable to its host.
Having received a satisfactory response, Lin Yi went on to work, first contacting Zhou Kongshan.
"I might be quite busy these next few days and won't be able to get to the factory. Can you keep an eye on things for me, make sure they don't slack off? The Youth-Preserving Pills you've been given also need to be developed quickly."
"Boss, don't worry, I will definitely keep a close eye on them. With me here, you can rest assured, they won't slack off at all. But the Life-Prolonging Pill is really tough to research; there are many things in it we've never seen before, so don't get your hopes up too high."
Zhou Kongshan was actually worried that Lin Yi had too high expectations of them.
```
The failure to develop it in the end left Lin Yi extremely disappointed.
"Don't worry, didn't I say before? I'll try my best to find the formula and manual for you."
With Lin Yi's words, Zhou Kongshan also felt relieved.
Alright, next up was dealing with that Wang Sheng fellow. There was no need to worry about Zhao Guangchen anymore—he was now struggling to save himself.
It probably wouldn't be long before he declared bankruptcy and had to find a way to survive on his own, right?
Wang Guixiang had been staying in the hotel for a while now, and she had already submitted an application to the court, about to sue Zhao Guangchen.
That guy must be stripped of everything to relieve the hatred in her heart.
If it hadn't been for that Zhao Guangchen, how could she have been trapped by his side for so long? It was all for the sake of the child.
Read exclusive adventures at empire
But the appearance of Lin Yi also made Wang Guixiang see things clearly.
Meanwhile, Han Xuemei was drifting aimlessly, unsure of where she could go.
Now, using the little money she had left, she had booked a room in the hotel,
She had to think about where to go next; she would definitely make Han Xuewei and Lin Yi pay the price.
If it hadn't been for those two, how could she be in such a difficult situation?
As Han Xuemei was deep in thought, she suddenly heard a commotion nearby and immediately turned her gaze toward it.
"Lin Yi will eventually fall by my hand, you don't have to support me, I'm not that drunk!"
Upon hearing Lin Yi's name, Han Xuemei knew her opportunity had come again.
She had to forge good relations with those who opposed Lin Yi or didn't get along with him.
An easy prey, she thought, considering her own beauty and the drunken man before her.
But with so many people around that guy, she hadn't found the right opportunity to make her move, so Han Xuemei had no choice but to follow them.
Finally, at a corner, the drunk suddenly went berserk, pushing all his friends away.
"I said I'm not that drunk, can you stop fussing over me? How are you any different from my dad? All nagging, always thinking I can't do anything right, get lost all of you, I don't need you to interfere!"
Wang Sheng yelled at his companions like this, and everyone got angry.
After all, they weren't his servants and didn't have to babysit him all the time.
Since he had said so himself, they decided not to bother and no longer court his displeasure.
Afterward, all his friends left, leaving Wang Sheng sitting alone by the roadside.
Han Xuemei knew her moment had come and immediately ran over.
"Excuse me, sir, why are you sitting here alone? Did something happen? If you need help, feel free to tell me."
They say alcohol is a troublemaker, and now that Wang Sheng was under its influence, with a peerless beauty suddenly appearing by his side, his heart naturally raced.

chapters.title: Chapter 308 Successful Seduction
chapters.content:
"Miss? You're really gorgeous."
Under the influence of alcohol, Wang Sheng was hardly lucid.
Looking at Han Xuemei, who appeared as beautiful as a fairy before him, Wang Sheng felt overjoyed.
He instantly pressed his entire body against Han Xuemei.
At first, Han Xuemei was somewhat embarrassed, but she realized that this was her only option now.
She had to cling to this lifeline, for at this moment she had no one else to rely on.
"Do I really look that pretty? Do you like me? Do you want to play with me?"
"What do you want to play with Miss? Or is Miss doing this on purpose? Just waiting for the moment when no one's around me to get close to me?"
Wang Sheng could easily guess what Han Xuemei wanted to do, but he wouldn't refuse.
After all, he longed for such a beautiful girl willing to offer herself to him.
Han Xuemei's cheeks turned crimson; she knew what she was doing was inappropriate, but she was out of options. She had to do it!
"Yeah, that's right, I waited for you to be alone before I came to find you. Are you willing to come with me?"
Without much thought, Wang Sheng placed his hand on Han Xuemei's, and afterwards, they went to a nearby hotel together.
What happened that night goes without saying.
The next day, when Wang Sheng woke up, he finally realized and saw the lovely person beside him.
He felt a surge of secret delight; he was accustomed to having beautiful women around, but Han Xuemei's sudden presence interested him greatly.
Perhaps because of the intense gaze from beside him, Han Xuemei gradually woke up and locked eyes with Wang Sheng.
Both of them quickly averted their gazes.
Wang Sheng also behaved for the first time like a pure-hearted young man. He used to be an experienced player.
"About last night…"
Since she had taken the initiative, Han Xuemei wasn't sure what to say.
But Wang Sheng suddenly embraced her, urging her to say no more.
He didn't mind what Han Xuemei's intentions were; he only hoped she would stay by his side moving forward.
After all, it was rare for a woman to be like this with him.
Find more to read at empire
He wasn't very handsome, although his family was rich.
"I don't care what purpose you had in approaching me, but I hope that in the coming time, there can only be one man by your side, which is me. If I find that there are other men, I won't be nice to you."
Hearing Wang Sheng's words, Han Xuemei realized she'd succeeded, hadn't she?
Looking at Wang Sheng like this, she must have succeeded, right? It seemed he too was within her grasp now.
Despite how all these men admire her looks, why doesn't Lin Yi see her the same way?
And how does she fall short compared to Han Xuewei? Lin Yi really is a man without taste.
"Don't worry, from now on there will only be you in my life. I suddenly became audacious, after all, seeing a handsome guy like you on the street, who wouldn't be smitten, right?"
Wang Sheng wasn't the kind of handsome that could be whisked away straight from the streets, but still, he was quite attractive.
Wang Sheng's face turned red at Han Xuemei's words, as no woman had ever spoken to him like this before, and he truly liked this Han Xuemei.
Moreover, the experience she gave him last night felt very good.
"Why are you blushing? You're already at this age, haven't you heard these kinds of words before, or is it that you've never encountered a girl like me?"
Seeing Wang Sheng's blushing face, Han Xuemei suddenly became interested and wanted to tease this guy a bit.
But Wang Sheng suddenly got dressed and climbed out of bed.
This caught Han Xuemei by surprise, would he be regretting it? That wouldn't do at all!
"Where are you going?"
"I have some things to do today, so I need to take care of them. You just wait here for me, I'll pay for the room fee. Once I'm done dealing with that matter, I'll come back to pick you up, and I'll take you home to stay with me. We'll live together, okay?"
Wang Sheng hadn't forgotten his arrangement with Lin Yi, but he couldn't let down a beauty either.
Once he settled Lin Yi's matter, he would come back to pick up the beauty.
He would talk to his father, who would probably agree, after all, who wouldn't like such a beautiful woman?
And one could tell at a glance that Han Xuemei was the kind of woman parents would like.
"Can you give me your phone number? I'm afraid I won't be able to reach you. You must come back to pick me up, okay?"
Han Xuemei knew she couldn't be too clingy, she just had to wait for Wang Sheng to come for her, even if he didn't come, she couldn't complain.
After all, she was the one who had pursued him, but she really didn't want to lose this lifeline.
Wang Sheng knew what Han Xuemei was thinking; he wouldn't leave such a beautiful woman alone in the hotel.
He left Han Xuemei his phone number and a personal item of his.
"Rest assured, I said I'd take responsibility for you, and I will. Just wait here for me to come back."
After saying this, Wang Sheng left a kiss on Han Xuemei's forehead and then left.
Han Xuemei sat anxiously in the room, she could only quietly wait for Wang Sheng to return.
Although she didn't know what Wang Sheng was going to do, she had to maintain a gentle demeanor.
After Wang Sheng left the room, he immediately contacted Lin Yi, telling him where to meet today.
Lin Yi agreed, and when the two met, the atmosphere was very tense.
"Kid, you better listen to your dad. Even he knows I'm not easy to mess with, so why are you so eager to get slapped in the face?"
And the first thing Lin Yi said upon seeing Wang Sheng wasn't too friendly.
After all, disturbing his time with family was a great sin.
"My dad can make mistakes too. I don't find you intimidating. Let's have a fair competition today, these herbs are all brought from my house, no relying on brand effects, only on personal strength."
Such a childish competition content was just too boring for Lin Yi; he didn't need to do much to win.
After all, someone like Wang Sheng, who probably never actually fought, was definitely one of those pampered young masters, well-protected by his family.
"Alright, let's get this over with, I have my matters to tend to."
Lin Yi cut off Wang Sheng's words.
Wang Sheng's face grew grim, but he endured, determined to embarrass Lin Yi in the upcoming competition.

chapters.title: Chapter 309 The Race Begins
chapters.content:
The competition has officially begun, with both people going to purchase two batches of medicinal ingredients.
How to sell? It's entirely up to their discretion, but they still need to abide by the competition rules.
Wang Sheng might have not said before that it wasn't allowed to ask others for help, so he brought a whole bunch of bodyguards to help him buy.
"Don't think I'm bullying you. I never said we couldn't ask others for help. You could ask your friends to help you too, but since we've already started, it might be too late for them to come and help you, right? We have a total of three hours to sell, let's see who sells more."
Wang Sheng looked at the man with a smug expression, couldn't be more arrogant; he wanted exactly this effect.
How could Lin Yi not have thought of asking others to help him?
But probably only Wang Sheng himself could think of such a foolish method.
Lin Yi ignored Wang Sheng's provocation.
Even if Wang Sheng brought 100 people to help him, so what? If he couldn't sell them, they couldn't leave his hands; he certainly couldn't force sales, right?
Lin Yi first carefully examined the herbs.
These herbs were relatively easy to sell, mostly herbs that could be used at home.
For example, there were herbal ingredients for sour plum drinks, as well as some herbs that could be applied externally, and others for treating common ailments.
Of course, buying here would definitely be much cheaper than in those herbal medicine shops outside, so Lin Yi felt it was quite easy to sell.
"Ladies and gentlemen, please take a look. All of the herbs we're selling here come from famous sources and are licensed by legitimate manufacturers, guaranteed to be without any issues. Everyone is welcome to take a look. I can assure you that our prices are definitely much cheaper than the average herbal medicine shop, and this opportunity is available only today."
Indeed, because of Lin Yi's last sentence, "only today," everyone immediately crowded around.
They believed that if it's only sold once, it must be a loss-making sale.
After all, if they sold too much later, they would not be able to make a profit. Wang Sheng was instantly dumbfounded.
What's going on?
Just now, there was no one at Lin Yi's, but now so many elderly ladies and gentlemen surged over, and even some young people.
No, he couldn't lose, he absolutely couldn't lose!
Find your adventure at empire
This was a matter of his dignity; how could he lose to Lin Yi?
Wang Sheng was extremely anxious; he further reduced his prices.
It didn't matter, although the unit price was lower than Lin Yi's, winning in volume in the end was also fine!
"Come and buy, folks, we're selling at a loss, our prices are definitely lower than those across the way. Don't miss out as you pass by!"
Wang Sheng, this guy, really doesn't get it, does he?
Setting the price so low on the spot, it'll disrupt the market.
Lin Yi watched him silently.
And the customers who had been buying from Lin Yi, without a single exception, all ran over to Wang Sheng's side.
"Are your prices really lower than the ones across the way? How do you sell? Tell us about it, don't just shout. If the goods we buy aren't right, we will come looking for you!"
After the customers arrived, they started asking all kinds of questions.
Wang Sheng was not adept at dealing with these people; he immediately stepped to the side and handed these matters over to his bodyguards.
All he had to do was sit beside and collect the profits. That was one way to do it.
But when these customers saw the guy who had just been shouting walk over to rest, they were also very annoyed.
What did this guy mean? Did he not take them, the customers, seriously? Handing them off to someone else, what was that all about?
"What's the deal with you, the owner? We've already come over to buy stuff, and what's with your attitude? Why aren't you coming over to serve us? Why do you need to rest over there? Handing us over to your employees, huh? Do you think we're not even worth talking to?"
One person voiced this concern, and the others began to shout out one after another.
They really disliked the owner's attitude towards them.
It seemed that the owner across the way had a better temper, and he took matters into his own hands.
This guy, it was clear he was just messing around, not taking them, the customers, seriously at all.
"What do you mean by my attitude? I've already dropped the prices so low. So what if I take a break for a while? Can't you just buy what you want? Why waste so much breath, what's it to me!"
Wang Sheng also disliked the way these common folk spoke to him.
What right did they have to yell at him like this, to not take him seriously at all?
He had already dropped the prices so low, why were they still making a fuss?
The customers, seeing the owner still acting arrogantly, decided to teach him a lesson.
It was only a few dollars difference; they could forgo that small advantage in search of better service.
Even though Lin Yi was a bit slower, he provided excellent service.
And just like that, the customers he had just started to gather instantly flocked to Lin Yi's side, something Lin Yi had already anticipated.
He wasn't acting like an owner now but as a service attendant on the outside.
How could one treat customers this way? Of course, they would be extremely dissatisfied.
Watching his shop that had been bustling just moments ago empty as the customers scurried over to Lin Yi's side, Wang Sheng froze, mouth agape.
What was going on? Why had this happened?
"Why are you running over there? Haven't I already dropped the prices so low? Why are you still leaving? Come back here, I can lower the prices even more."
Hearing the arrogant owner shouting, the customers were delighted; that's exactly what they wanted—to see him upset and regretful!
Who asked him to treat his customers like that just now?
Doesn't he know that the customer is always right? And yet he was so arrogant, not taking them into account.
Now he's had it, right? Tasted his own medicine?
The customers, as if they hadn't heard Wang Sheng speak at all, left him to dejectedly sit down on the ground. Wasn't he going to lose now? Why were these people so hard to please?
He had already made the prices so low, what was there to be dissatisfied with?
"Boss, they probably left because you were too arrogant just now, and they prefer Lin Yi's hands-on, much more amicable way of treating customers," said an attendant from behind, identifying Wang Sheng's problem. Wang Sheng gave him a glance.
What right did these commoners have, demanding he stoop to speak to them?
It was already quite something that he could sell them goods so cheaply, wasn't it?

chapters.title: Chapter 310 The End of the Match
chapters.content:
"Is it any of your business? Are you supposed to speak? Did I allow you to speak? Shut up!"
Wang Sheng was frustrated with nowhere to vent his anger, and when his subordinate spoke up, it was the perfect opportunity to take all his anger out on him!
The subordinate felt extremely aggrieved; he didn't say anything more and stepped aside.
He had only intended to give the boss a reminder, after all, this was indeed his problem.
Since the boss had no interest in his words, the subordinate decided not to speak out anymore in the future and rely entirely on the boss to figure things out.
Now, Wang Sheng glared fiercely at Lin Yi as if he could kill. How could he have ended up like this if it weren't for that guy?
It was all Lin Yi's fault, every single bit of it.
Now look at what's happened: he had no customers left, as all the customers had flocked to Lin Yi's side. He couldn't really end up with not a single customer and lose face, could he?
In the end, Wang Sheng thought of playing the customer himself and buying from his shop. After all, Lin Yi wouldn't know how many people were his.
"What are you all standing around for? Hurry up and go find people for me, find a lot of clients!"
Wang Sheng spoke to his subordinates in the nastiest tone, and they were taken aback for a moment, only then realizing that the boss was planning to cheat.
After all, their boss had always been like this. Just put up with it, since he paid well.
With that, Wang Sheng's subordinates swarmed out, while Lin Yi had already anticipated what they were up to.
However, Lin Yi didn't care about this competition, whether he won or lost didn't matter.
Because Lin Yi was not only selling medicinal herbs but also advertising his pharmacy.
"Everyone, if you like the herbs here, you can also visit our pharmacy. Of course, if you don't, that's fine too. At such cheap prices, you can't lose out or be cheated. Once you get home, I guarantee they'll last you a long time. Oh right, the main product of our pharmacy is a special remedy that people should have seen in the news recently..."
With that other guy unable to hear what he was saying, Lin Yi shamelessly advertised his pharmacy.
Soon, a lot of people had arrived at Wang Sheng's side, all scrambling to buy his herbs.
"Hmph! Lin Yi, see that? We still have a lot of people here. Sure enough, the audience is discerning; they won't go to a crappy place like yours. All of you have been hoodwinked, or else how could you possibly not come to my place? I really wonder what you're thinking."
With customers at hand, Wang Sheng grew bolder and even had the audacity to pick a fight with Lin Yi.
But Lin Yi simply ignored him.
Lin Yi's customers, however, were not happy. If it weren't for that guy's attitude earlier, how could they have ended up at Lin Yi's?
Although they admitted Wang Sheng's prices were indeed low, they didn't appreciate that kind of customer treatment, which really irked them.
The people who came didn't know about the other boss's attitude; once they found out, they would come too.
But this time, the customers guessed wrong, none switched sides because of Wang Sheng's attitude.
It could almost be confirmed that these people were shills.
"It's just selling herbs, and you've resorted to using shills? I really don't know how you manage your shop. Hasn't your boss taught you anything?"
A customer complained dissatisfiedly, Wang Sheng's face turning so dark it couldn't get any darker.
He had indeed used shills, and he had no way to rebut.
But he absolutely couldn't let these poor people have the last word.
They were only able to afford such good herbs because they were on the lookout for a bargain; what right did they have to criticize him?
"What are you idiots talking about? You're just a bunch of poor wretches. If it weren't for the discount on these herbs, would you be able to buy them? You probably wouldn't even dare to take a look."
Wang Sheng's words were too harsh, and even Lin Yi found it hard to listen.
"Enough, Wang Sheng. These people are customers, not capital for us to judge. And you're just someone with a bit of stinking money, don't get too full of yourself. To be honest, if it weren't for the shills you hired, you probably wouldn't have had any customers by the end of this. Customers really value service attitude, and you have none."
Lin Yi didn't want to see his customers being humiliated by Wang Sheng anymore, so he spoke up.
When the customers saw Lin Yi standing up for them, they couldn't have been happier.
Find adventures at empire
They immediately took out their wallets, ready to buy more to help boost Lin Yi's sales and ensure he wouldn't lose.
"Thinking finding shills will let you win? Don't kid yourself; with us here, we'll never let you win. Boss, we'll take more, as much as you have!"
"Exactly!"
The boss on the other side dared to mock them for being poor, and though they did love a bargain, they could certainly afford the normal-priced herbs.
If there was a discount on offer, why shouldn't they join the excitement? Their money didn't come from the wind.
They're different from those rich kids; they earned their money through hard work.
"Don't get carried away, everyone; we still encourage rational consumption. We don't recommend buying so much that it might not even be used after taking it home."
Lin Yi was somewhat amused at his customers' affection; he hadn't expected such a turn of events to happen to him.
On the other side, seeing this scene made Wang Sheng extremely jealous.
After all, the customers at his side were all shills he had hired, all his own subordinates.
And he had to spend money to buy back the herbs he was selling, which really upset the balance in his heart.
"What are you standing around for? Aren't you going to buy already?"
Unable to vent his frustration, Wang Sheng took it out on his subordinates instead.
They not only had to obey the boss's orders but also be manipulated by him; they felt extremely stifled, looking at the harmonious scene on the other side.
Honestly, these subordinates had already thought about defecting, but Lin Yi probably wouldn't welcome them.
Finally, after three grueling hours of selling, the competition came to an end.
Lin Yi's side of the table was completely empty, without a single item left, while Wang Sheng's side still had some.
The winner was clear.
"The competition is over; it's pretty obvious who won and who lost. I don't want to argue with you, and I have no grudge against you. I'm leaving first."

chapters.title: Chapter 311 Comparison
chapters.content:
Lin Yi had won, and there was no need for him to get entangled with Wang Sheng anymore, so Lin Yi wanted to leave.
But Wang Sheng preempted him, blocking Lin Yi's way; he wouldn't let Lin Yi go.
Is this guy never going to stop?
Lin Yi felt that he had already given him enough face. If he continued to cling on senselessly, Lin Yi would get serious with him.
"What on earth do you want? You wanted a competition, and I've competed with you. But if your planning fails that's not my problem. Now that the competition is over, you still won't let me leave. What exactly are you up to? Don't tell me you plan to continue?"
It was getting late; he needed to hurry back for lunch.
"You can't leave; our competition isn't over yet. You don't think that just because you've won against me once, you will always win, do you?"
It was clear that Wang Sheng was being unreasonable, completely devoid of logic. He had lost; there was no need to compete anymore.
Lin Yi didn't want to continue this nonsense with him.
"Fine, let's say you won, okay? You win this time, I really need to go home now, I won't continue to entertain you."
Lin Yi admitted that Wang Sheng had won just so he wouldn't have to continue this conversation with a brat who understood nothing.
Yet Wang Sheng insistently refused to let Lin Yi leave.
The onlookers couldn't stand it anymore; what was going on with their boss? He wasn't usually this stupid.
"Lin Yi, can you stop humiliating me? You don't really think you beat me, do you? I was just taking it easy on you. Let's compete again; this time, I'll definitely win!"
Wang Sheng was so angered by Lin Yi that his face turned red. He really couldn't accept that he had lost to Lin Yi.
He had intended to use this opportunity to hold his head high in front of his father.
Yet he didn't expect to lose to Lin Yi, and to lose so miserably at that.
Without any favors, he might not have garnered a single customer; he admitted that his approach might indeed have been problematic.
But now that he knew, he would correct it next time.
"I've said it, you won. This is my last warning; stop bothering me, or else you'll suffer the consequences, and the Wang Family will pay the price."
After speaking, Lin Yi's gaze gradually turned icy.
Wang Sheng was intimidated by Lin Yi's presence, stepped back twice, giving Lin Yi the chance to leave.
After Lin Yi left, Wang Sheng was furiously powerless.
"Ding-a-ling-a-ling!"
As Wang Sheng was pondering, suddenly a phone call came in, and he answered it.
"Where are you?"
It was the old Mr. Wang calling, and his tone was not pleasant. Wang Sheng thought his own matter had been exposed.
"I'm outside."
"Doing what?"
"Nothing much, just strolling around."
"I warn you, don't lie to me; you should know what the consequences of lying to me are like."
Upon hearing this, Wang Sheng panicked immediately.
He knew what kind of person his father was; he would show no mercy to his own underlings.
If he truly lied to his father, what would his fate be once found out?
"I'm here to see Lin Yi."
Although Wang Sheng really didn't want to say it, everything had already been pushed to this point. Even if he didn't speak, his father would be able to find out.
"Who told you to go find him? Did you take my words for nothing? Did I not say it? Don't provoke him. Do you think you're very impressive? What was the result after you found him?"
Old Master Wang's emotions suddenly became agitated, and he berated Wang Sheng.
Wang Sheng didn't say a word, just letting Old Master Wang scold him.
"Isn't it because I felt that our family was humiliated by him, and I couldn't swallow that anger? So I went to challenge him, but who knew that stinking brat actually had some skills."
That last sentence, Wang Sheng did not say out loud.
He knew his father must already be aware of the situation, probably some sneak among his own people had snitched.
After all, he had been flawless in his execution. How could his father possibly have known about this?
"You get back here immediately. Don't embarrass us in public anymore. Do you realize how much face you've lost for me? I don't even know what to say to you. You do nothing at home and that's bad enough, why do you have to go outside and lose face for me?"
Old Master Wang gave Wang Sheng a severe scolding.
Wang Sheng knew that he would probably be grounded upon his return this time.
But what about that beauty? He had just started a relationship with that beauty.
If he just went back like this, he guessed he wouldn't be able to see that beauty for a long time.
"What are you standing there dawdling for? Move it, will you? Or do my words no longer carry weight with you? Have your wings hardened and you think you can fly? Wang Sheng, I really didn't expect you to have turned into such a state. You should really learn more from your brother!"
Old Master Wang's emotions intensified as he spoke, and Wang Sheng's mood also turned sour when he heard his father mention his brother. Continue your journey on empire
Meanwhile, Lin Yi had already returned home.
Seeing his children and wife running towards him, he felt a great sense of comfort in his heart.
After getting tired from work outside, coming home to rest well was also very nice.
"Good, hasn't Daddy come back? Did you miss Daddy? What have you been doing at home today?"
Lin Yi immediately picked up Da Bao.
"We were very well-behaved at home today, doing crafts with Mom. Daddy, do you want to see our crafts?"
Er Bao and Xiao Bao also looked up at Lin Yi with hopeful eyes, wishing Daddy would come and see their work.
Han Xuewei was standing gently to the side, watching this all unfold.
"Since it's a craft made by my darlings, of course Daddy wants to see it."
After finishing speaking, Lin Yi, holding Da Bao and followed by Er Bao and Xiao Bao, came to the table and saw their crafts.
It was a drawing, it seems, of their big family.
"It looks like you all have a talent for drawing. How about I enroll you in a class so we can study it systematically? Look at how wonderful your drawings are, fantastic!"
Lin Yi praised them, and the little guys nearly wagged their tails high into the sky.
"Hahaha! I knew Daddy would like it, so we picked out this gift for you. Can you accept it, Daddy?"
Since it was a gift from his darlings, Lin Yi naturally had no reason to refuse, as doing so could hurt their feelings.
"Of course I can, and Daddy will treasure it. Alright, have you thought about what you want to eat for lunch today?"
After finishing that matter, it was time to think about what to have for lunch.
While one household was full of joy, things were not going so well in another.

chapters.title: Chapter 312 Buffet
chapters.content:
By the time Wang Sheng returned home, the Old Master Wang immediately called him over, then subjected him to a harsh scolding.
Wang Sheng felt extremely aggrieved inside.
At least his initial intentions were good, even if he hadn't managed to accomplish what he set out to do, but there was no need for Old Master Wang to speak to him that way.
And why was it that every time he did something, Old Master Wang would compare him with his brothers?
"What's with that look in your eyes? Are you saying you don't accept what I'm saying? How can you still think of arguing with me after everything that's come to this? Haven't I told you before not to provoke Lin Yi, do you know how much loss this could cause our family?"
Old Master Wang truly had not expected his son to do something so foolish.
Now he suddenly began to doubt whether Wang Sheng was really his biological son. Otherwise, how could he be so different from him?
Enjoy new chapters from empire
"Didn't I do it for the good of our family too? Why do you always compare me with my brothers? Are they really that great? If they're so great, then why don't you ask them to come back?"
Wang Sheng truly felt like he was about to die of grievance, even though his intentions were good, why did things always go wrong?
He didn't want this either. Couldn't Old Master Wang be a bit more lenient with him?
Old Master Wang really felt like he was going to be angered to death by Wang Sheng.
In the past, Wang Sheng wouldn't dare to actively oppose him. Now, even his tone of speech lacked any politeness.
Did he think that he, his father, had become old? Did he believe that his father no longer had the means to control him?
"Is this the way you talk to me now? Disrespectful, not taking me seriously at all. If that's the case, then get out of my sight and never come back. You are no longer related to our Wang Family, do you hear me!"
Upon hearing Old Master Wang's definitive words, Wang Sheng truly gave up hope.
In a fit of anger, he ran out of the house without taking anything with him, leaving his bank cards and everything else behind.
The only thing he had left was a cellphone, which he used to contact Han Xuemei.
He didn't know if at this time Han Xuemei would look down on him.
"Wang Sheng, you actually contacted me. Are you home now? Have you finished everything? When are you going to pick me up and take me back?"
Given all that had happened, Wang Sheng knew he shouldn't tell Han Xuemei, so he hesitated on whether to speak to her about it or not.
The two of them had shared nothing more than a one-night stand.
If he told her everything, would that be too much? Would she despise him? Would she think he was useless?
"I've finished my business here. Do you have time? If you do, come out, I have some things I need to talk to you about. Right now, I might not be able to take you home."
In all honesty, Han Xuemei had initially felt that Wang Sheng was deceiving her, trying to make her happy with promises of taking a strange woman home.
But since Wang Sheng had contacted her, it meant he was still interested in her, and of course, Han Xuemei would not refuse Wang Sheng's invitation.
"I have time, so I'll come to you now!"
Han Xuemei was very excited on the other end, whereas Wang Sheng was very hesitant about how he should talk to Han Xuemei about this.
He had just started a relationship with her, and then this happened.
He had been kicked out of his home, penniless, and for the foreseeable future, he might have to depend on Han Xuemei for support.
While they were tense on one side, Lin Yi took his own children and Han Xuewei to a high-level restaurant for a meal on the other.
It had been a long time since they had last gone out to eat together, and now the progress of their tasks had gradually picked up.
In the next two days, all he needed to do was to stay with the children, and the task would surely be completed.
"Babies, you can't make noise and fuss like you usually do at home once we're inside, okay?"
The children pouted, realizing they couldn't play happily in a high-end restaurant.
But they still behaved very appropriately.
Lin Yi always received compliments on the children as they passed by others.
"Your children are just too cute, and they're so well-behaved. Not like our kids, who are always mischievous and causing trouble. How do you educate them? Come on, share your secrets so I can learn too."
Although everyone was meeting for the first time and knew each other not at all, it was good that Lin Yi could chat freely, though he looked at everyone somewhat helplessly.
To be honest, it's not that he didn't want to socialize, but some things are simply difficult to explain.
"I haven't really done much to educate our kids; I'm usually quite busy with work. It's their mom who takes care of their education. If you have any questions, you should ask their mom directly."
Lin Yi threw all these questions to Han Xuewei, who, although she was still smiling on the surface, had already pinched Lin Yi secretly.
"How could you, throwing such a thorny problem to me? And to think I trusted you so much before, but now our trust has collapsed!"
Lin Yi looked at Han Xuewei with begging eyes, hoping she would wait until they got home to settle accounts with him.
Afterward, those mothers began crowding around Han Xuewei, bombarding her with all sorts of questions.
How exactly should you educate kids, anyway?
In truth, it didn't have much to do with the parents; mainly, it was that the kids were sensible.
Da Bao saw a delicious-looking treat and wanted to grab it. After telling his father, he immediately ran over, with Er Bao and Xiao Bao close by his side.
"Run slower, and remember to come back. After you've gotten the food, come over here."
This place was somewhat like a buffet, but much cleaner than those outside and with much higher quality ingredients.
After they got the pastries they wanted, they immediately ran back to their parents' side.
"Mom, Dad, are you done talking? The food here is so good. Can we go to the amusement park this afternoon?"
Xiao Bao looked at his parents with hopeful eyes.
In the end, Lin Yi did not have the heart to refuse the kids and agreed to their request. They were going to have a great time today.
Tomorrow, Lin Yi would have them rest at home; they couldn't go out every day, after all.
"Yay, Dad is the best! Mom's not done yet? Why do those aunties keep talking to Mom?"
They had never seen any of those aunties before, but why were they chatting so freely with Mom?
"Maybe everyone is just more outgoing, and since they're all from the same social circle, it's normal to talk."
Those aunties seemed like wealthy ladies, probably bored at home, which was why they brought their children out for a meal.

chapters.title: Chapter 313 Homeless
chapters.content:
The children looked at their father, half understanding, thinking it wasn't that big of a deal.
It was a while before the society ladies finally left; they actually wanted to keep Han Xuewei around to ask her some more questions.
But since it was mealtime, they were too embarrassed to keep bothering her.
Once the society ladies had left, Han Xuewei returned to her seat, feeling somewhat exhausted.
Why was talking to these society ladies so tiring? She had never felt that way before.
"It's all your fault. If you hadn't dumped the problem on me, how could they have kept me tied up like that? It's all on you, all on you. If you ever dump something like this on me again, I won't let you off the hook!"
Han Xuewei looked at Lin Yi angrily; if he hadn't pushed the problem onto her, she wouldn't have been cornered by them.
It was clear that Han Xuewei was truly angry. Lin Yi quickly pulled her into his arms and whispered comforting words to her.
The children felt a jolt in their little hearts upon seeing this.
Mom and Dad were showing off their affection right in front of them. Was that really okay? Weren't they taking the kids too lightly?
One by one, they covered their eyes and continued eating.
"Enough already, the kids are still here. What are you trying to look like? Let me go now!"
Even though Han Xuewei enjoyed Lin Yi's embrace, she was embarrassed to do such intimate things in front of the children.
"The kids have all covered their eyes nicely, so it's fine."
Lin Yi teased Han Xuewei on purpose, even though he knew it was not good to do this in front of the children.
But he found Han Xuewei's reaction amusing.
"If you keep teasing me, you won't be allowed to sleep in the bedroom tonight. You'll sleep on the sofa, do you hear me?"
After Han Xuewei wrestled free, she looked at Lin Yi sternly. She was not joking; she meant it.
Since his wife didn't want to play anymore, Lin Yi stopped provoking her.
After dinner, the family headed to the amusement park.
They wondered if the amusement park would be crowded today since it was a day off.
Meanwhile, Wang Sheng and Han Xuemei's meeting was incredibly awkward.
Han Xuemei had wanted to rush up and hug Wang Sheng, but he dodged her.
What was going on?
