How had Wang Sheng become so distant in less than a day, when last night they were still the closest to each other?
"Take a seat first, let's hear what he has to say. Then we'll decide whether to hug or not."
Han Xuemei was thrown off by this. What on earth could be so serious?
Could it be that the Wang Family had gone bankrupt?
Impossible. She had been checking the news all day and hadn't seen any such headlines.
"What exactly happened? It seems really serious. You look like this, and it's breaking my heart. If there's anything I can do, I'll definitely help you."
Han Xuemei showed a look of great sympathy for Wang Sheng, and Wang Sheng was persuaded by Han Xuemei.
Maybe he really could be accepted by Han Xuemei, even if he had nothing at all.
Looking at Han Xuemei's expression, she didn't seem to be deceiving him.
"I've been kicked out by my family, and now I'm homeless. Would you be willing to live with me for a while? I have no money to offer you, but rest assured, once I get back home, I'll definitely repay you double," he said.
Wang Sheng looked at Han Xuemei with some anticipation, hoping she would accept him.
If Han Xuemei stayed by his side during these tough times, he would definitely marry her and not discard her afterwards like he did with the girls before.
But Han Xuemei hesitated, uncertain whether what Wang Sheng was saying was true or false.
What if Wang Sheng never made it back home for the rest of his life? Was she supposed to support a playboy?
"Are you joking with me? This joke isn't funny at all. How could you possibly be kicked out by your family? You haven't done anything wrong, and there's no news about it. You must be testing me, rest assured, even if you were kicked out, I would never abandon you," she said.
Han Xuemei still thought Wang Sheng was testing her.
He was probably probing whether her feelings for him were genuine, so Han Xuemei had to pretend to be very sincere.
When Wang Sheng heard what Han Xuemei said, he shook his head. He wasn't joking. Why couldn't Han Xuemei understand?
"I'm not joking with you. This is true. I really have been kicked out by my family. You see, all I have on me is my phone, nothing else. My bank cards have already been stopped by my father," he said with a bitter smile.
Wang Sheng smiled bitterly; indeed, no one was willing to accept him. All the girls from his past had already run away.
It seemed that Han Xuemei was the only one he could turn to now.
After all, even his own brothers had hung around with him just because of his status.
Now that he had been disowned, they were probably laughing behind his back.
"If this really happened, then I can only express regret. But there is no way I can support two people with the money I have," she said.
So it wasn't a joke, and Han Xuemei's tone changed immediately.
She wouldn't waste her time on someone who was useless, just considering the previous night as feeding a dog.
After saying this, Han Xuemei stood up, intending to leave, but Wang Sheng suddenly grabbed her.
"It's okay. I just want to stay by your side. I really don't have anyone else I can rely on now. Even though we just met last night, I believe you won't abandon me, right?" he said.
"Right now, you are a burden to me, do you understand? How could I possibly let you stay with me? I simply don't have enough money to take care of two people, have you got that?" she said.
Han Xuemei felt that her words were already very clear.
She wasn't going to waste so much time and money on someone who was useless; she pushed Wang Sheng's hand away.
"Come find me after you've managed to return home. But that's probably not going to happen. I think you must have done something to make your father very angry, that's why he kicked you out," she said with a cold laugh before leaving.
Before she left, she didn't make things difficult for Wang Sheng; instead, she settled the bill and then departed.
When Wang Sheng emerged from the restaurant, he was at a loss.
He didn't know where to go, but he didn't want to compromise with his father. Find your next read at empire
In the end, Wang Sheng wandered aimlessly, lost in a daze.

chapters.title: Chapter 314 Help
chapters.content:
He didn't know where he would go, but he wouldn't stay in one place forever, so he just wandered back and forth.
Perhaps he could find a job that belonged to him.
It was also the first time he had to work to support himself.
Actually, when the old master of the Wang Family kicked him out, he wanted him to understand a lesson, that he couldn't go on like this forever.
After all, he was a member of the Wang Family, born with noble blood.
If he continued to live in a daze, the Wang Family would absolutely not harbor idlers.
As he wandered, Wang Sheng arrived at the entrance of the amusement park.
Seeing those children accompanied by their fathers and mothers, Wang Sheng actually felt very envious of them.
Suddenly, Wang Sheng saw Lin Yi and his family. What were they doing here?
Without knowing why, Wang Sheng followed them.
He wanted to see how Lin Yi usually treated his family members.
The moment Wang Sheng saw Lin Yi, Lin Yi had already noticed him.
But Lin Yi didn't want to trouble himself, knowing how troublesome this guy had been in the past.
He shouldn't have agreed to that match in the first place.
For the following period, that guy kept following them.
What exactly did Wang Sheng want to do? Could it be that he was planning to harm the children around him? Lin Yi's gaze turned stern.
He then told Han Xuewei to take the children to play first. He needed to make a phone call and they shouldn't wait for him.
Once he was finished with his business, he would find them.
Although the children were somewhat unhappy in their hearts, having arrived at the amusement park only to find out their father had to tend to work, they didn't complain in the end.
Afterward, the children went off to play with Han Xuewei.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi stealthily slipped behind Wang Sheng.
"Why have you been following me around here?"
Wang Sheng had just realized that he seemed to have lost sight of Lin Yi and his family, thinking he had lost them.
Then Lin Yi's voice appeared behind him, giving Wang Sheng quite a scare.
Turning around in embarrassment, Wang Sheng knew that stalking was inappropriate behavior.
But he had indeed become very interested, which was why he did it.
He coughed lightly twice to mask the awkwardness in his heart.
"Who said I've been following you? I just happened to come here to play, don't flatter yourself too much."
When Wang Sheng spoke, he even avoided looking directly at Lin Yi, and of course Lin Yi could see through his obvious lies.
Lin Yi had to find out why he had been following him incessantly; otherwise, he wouldn't feel at ease.
What if Wang Sheng harbored thoughts of harming his family?
"Since you came here to play, where are your bodyguards? Don't you always have a lot of bodyguards with you when you go out? How come there's not a single one this time? Instead, it's just you. And you say you're here to play, but it doesn't look like you have any tickets or food in your hands, right?"
Lin Yi had only spoken a few words, but he shattered all of Wang Sheng's lies, leaving Wang Sheng feeling disgraced.
It's not like I can tell Lin Yi that I got kicked out of the house and have no money, right?
"Is it any of your business? Am I not allowed to not want security following me, or to not buy those things? Are you meddling too much? I already said it was a coincidence, can't you just leave already? Stop bothering me here!"
Clearly, Wang Sheng was infuriated after being exposed, and Lin Yi just watched him calmly.
If Wang Sheng doesn't explain himself clearly today, Lin Yi was determined not to leave.
He wouldn't give Wang Sheng any chance to harm his family.
"You must make it clear today, if you don't, I won't leave. Of course, I have all the time in the world to keep you company here."
Wang Sheng immediately burst into rage, pointing at Lin Yi's nose and cursing him out with extremely offensive language.
Releasing much of his pent-up resentment.
Lin Yi didn't retort, he just watched Wang Sheng calmly.
Gradually, Wang Sheng started to get frightened by Lin Yi's gaze. Could this guy Lin Yi not get angry at all?
After being cursed at like this, why hadn't he beaten me up?
That way, I could have bilked some money out of him with this headache.
"Did something happen to you? Is that why you have no money now?"
Wang Sheng was stunned. How did Lin Yi know?
I didn't give away that I had no money just now, did I? How did he know all this?
"You..."
"Did you have a fight with your dad? So, you got kicked out, had nowhere to go, and just wandered outside until you ran into me by chance? I guess I'm right, aren't I? Your thoughts are too easy to read, and the discord with your dad has long been public knowledge."
Lin Yi was incredibly sharp to have guessed all these details.
"So what if I fought with my dad? It's none of your business. I'm not going to follow you anymore, just go."
After saying that, Wang Sheng squatted down on the ground in a huff.
Lin Yi watched him in silence, eventually taking out a bank card and offering it to him.
Once again, Lin Yi surprised Wang Sheng. Why give me his bank card? Was he pitying me?
No! I don't need Lin Yi's pity, Wang Sheng thought, pushing Lin Yi's hand away and glaring at him angrily.
"You don't have to pity me, and I don't need your pity. If it weren't for you, how could I have been kicked out of my house!"
Truth be told, Wang Sheng was not young, but he was still rather immature.
Compared to his two older brothers, he was hardly a match.
The only reason he managed to stay in the Wang Family this long was that the old Mr. Wang doted on him.
But now Mr. Wang probably realized, that continuing to spoil him was not a solution.
Explore hidden tales at empire
One day, when he's gone, it's possible that his two brothers might crush him.
"I'm not pitying you. Consider this money a loan from me; pay me back when you've earned your own money. Sometimes, you might try to understand the meaning behind your dad's words. He might not really want to kick you out. He might just want you to learn a lesson," said Lin Yi, insisting on giving him the bank card.
After seeing to this sequence of events, Lin Yi left to meet up with his wife and children.
Wang Sheng held the bank card for a long time, pondering Lin Yi's words from earlier,
Eventually, Wang Sheng cried, weeping bitterly. Onlookers saw him as if he were insane, but he didn't care.

chapters.title: Chapter 315 Acceptance
chapters.content:
He suddenly remembered why he couldn't follow Lin Yi. Wasn't Lin Yi very impressive?
If he stayed by Lin Yi's side, he would surely learn many things.
Right, this was also a strategy.
It wouldn't only ensure the quality of his life, but also allow him to learn from Lin Yi, and even keep an eye on him.
If Lin Yi did anything detrimental to the Wang Family, he could tattle and inform the Wang Family!
No sooner said than done, Wang Sheng immediately chased after him, searching everywhere for Lin Yi.
Lin Yi had not expected to be followed by a dead weight.
After walking a long distance, Wang Sheng finally spotted Lin Yi.
He rushed over at once, and Lin Yi was taken aback by Wang Sheng.
The nearby children and Han Xuewei were confused by the sudden commotion.
Who was this person? They had never seen him before, nor had Lin Yi ever mentioned him.
"Lin Yi, let me learn under you. I can do anything, just give me some work, and I'll definitely do it, and do it beautifully!"
Wang Sheng ran over, trying to hold onto Lin Yi, but Lin Yi dodged him.
Lin Yi didn't understand what Wang Sheng meant.
Hadn't he always disliked him before? Why did he now want to work by his side?
"I remember you used to resent me quite a bit, so why suddenly do you want to work by my side? I don't have any suitable jobs for you here. You should look elsewhere. Although I know your dad has kicked you out, it doesn't mean I will accept you, especially since you left a very bad impression on me before."
Lin Yi was desperate to distance himself from this guy – being entangled with such a person would never end well.
But this time, Wang Sheng seemed determined to work by Lin Yi's side.
He suddenly grabbed Lin Yi's arm and wouldn't let go no matter how hard Lin Yi shook him off.
Lin Yi's face was lined with frustration. What was this guy doing?
If he didn't leave soon, he'd have to call the police, as this individual was seriously disturbing him.
"Just take me in. I won't cause you any trouble. You've seen my cleverness. With my talents, learning by your side will be perfect. How could you not accept me? Or are you scared, Lin Yi?"
Wang Sheng switched tactics, trying to provoke Lin Yi.
Yet goading tactics had no effect on Lin Yi.
Lin Yi looked at him calmly, then glancing at his wife and children by his side, he saw they were terrified.
After all, seeing their husband and father suddenly wrapped up with a stranger, and this guy refusing to leave, would scare anyone.
"There's no need for this, I absolutely won't take you in. If you don't leave now, I will call the police, and then you'll end up at the police station. Let your dad come and pick you up."
That statement immediately took effect. If he ended up as a nobody and even got taken to the police station, his dad surely wouldn't come to bail him out.
He'd probably have to stay in the police station indefinitely. Wang Sheng, feeling disheartened, let go of Lin Yi's arm.
As soon as Wang Sheng released him, Lin Yi quickly prepared to leave with his wife and children.
It seemed impossible to continue enjoying the amusement park today, with a jerk around.
After watching Lin Yi and the others leave, Wang Sheng was extremely disappointed and slumped to the ground. Could it be that he was incapable of accomplishing anything?
The proud Wang Family's young master, how had he ended up in such a sorry state?
This was too miserable and absolutely not fitting for him!
Wang Sheng remained in the amusement park until it closed, and then he reluctantly left.
Wandering aimlessly through the streets, he didn't know where to go, for he had no money on him.
Even though he had the bank card Lin Yi gave him, he really didn't want to use something given out of charity; it made him feel very uncomfortable.
Eventually, he found a public bench on the street and prepared to make do for the night.
But the night was exceptionally cold, and suddenly a shadow loomed over his face.
He slowly opened his eyes, only to find Lin Yi standing in front of him unexpectedly.
Lin Yi was actually somewhat worried—a grown young man, and a pampered young master at that; how could he cope being out in the world?
In the end, under the persuasion of Han Xuewei, Lin Yi still came to check on him, and sure enough, the fellow was homeless.
"Are you here to mock me? Didn't you refuse to take me in? I don't need your pity. I was planning to sleep here alone, and if it comes to that, I might as well freeze to death. You don't have to worry about me."
Wang Sheng was clearly speaking out of spite; he was just angry that Lin Yi wouldn't accept him.
After all, he did have some abilities, he was quite impressive.
However, his self-evaluation was all in his own mind, never coming from anyone else.
Lin Yi sighed and then told him to follow.
"Just because you tell me to go with you, I should comply? Wouldn't that be a loss of face? After how you previously treated me, how can I just follow you so easily?"
Wang Sheng followed behind Lin Yi arrogantly, inching forward little by little.
"I'm not forcing you. If you don't want to go with me, you can continue to sleep there. If you come with me, at least you can have a full stomach and a warm place to sleep, instead of being homeless on the streets."
Lin Yi turned around, looking very seriously at Wang Sheng. If Wang Sheng truly didn't want to go, Lin Yi wouldn't force him.
He would let Wang Sheng make his own choice.
Ultimately, Wang Sheng still chose to leave with Lin Yi; he wasn't foolish enough to sleep outside just because he was miffed.
And so, Lin Yi took Wang Sheng back to his own home.
Their home was spacious enough, accommodating a guest was absolutely no problem.
Han Xuewei and the children sat on the sofa, watching Wang Sheng somewhat cautiously, sensing that he might not be a good person.
After all, the image he presented was exactly like that of an unreasonable wealthy scion.
But Lin Yi had brought Wang Sheng back, so he probably wasn't a bad person, right?
"For tonight, you'll just have to make do in our house. I'll arrange a new place for you tomorrow. Since you want to learn and work at my company, that's fine. But you must follow all my arrangements. If there's anything I'm not satisfied with, I will fire you immediately."
Lin Yi brought Wang Sheng in front of him, explaining what needed to be done, and Wang Sheng nodded all the way.
As long as he had a job and something to do, Wang Sheng was very content.

chapters.title: Chapter 316 Becoming a Disciple
chapters.content:
"I can do everything you've said, so rest assured, but you can't keep secrets either; you must teach me everything you know!"
That was Wang Sheng's only request. As long as Lin Yi could do it, so could he.
Even though he was very pampered when he stayed at home.
But now he was, after all, homeless and had been driven out.
There was no one to rely on anymore; all he had was himself.
So he believed he would certainly be able to complete all the tasks Lin Yi gave him very splendidly.
To make Lin Yi and Old Master Wang look at him with new respect.
"I really don't understand why you keep pestering me. To be honest, there isn't much I can teach you. The only thing I might be able teach you is how to entertain guests. Your hospitality has serious issues. If you continue acting that way, no customers will want to buy anything from you."
Lin Yi was genuinely puzzled. What on earth did this guy see in him? Wasn't it possible for him to change?
He didn't consider himself very exceptional.
After all, it was Zhou Kongshan and the others who had developed the medicine; it didn't have much to do with Lin Yi, even though Lin Yi provided them with the raw medicine.
"Whatever it is, as long as it's something you know, just teach it all to me."
Lin Yi furrowed his brow. To be honest, Wang Sheng's attitude was really annoying him, and he didn't want to teach Wang Sheng anymore.
"Fine, then the first lesson I'll teach you today is to respect your teacher and value the Way. You should be my disciple now, and if you talk to me with that attitude in the future, then I'll have no choice but to drive you out as well. I really hate it when people, especially my disciples, speak to me in that tone."
The children nearby and Han Xuewei, seeing Lin Yi's powerful and commanding presence, all started to swoon.
The children always looked up to Lin Yi as their role model.
"Mommy, Daddy is really amazing, huh? When I grow up, I also want to marry someone as impressive as Daddy,"
Little Bao ran into her mother's arms and then kept looking in Lin Yi's direction. She really thought her dad was very handsome.
If her future husband wasn't as excellent as her dad, she would rather not marry at all.
Even though Little Bao was still young, she already understood quite a lot.
Han Xuewei couldn't help but laugh and cry. Weren't the kids a bit too precocious? But perhaps it was just part of their personality.
The other two children also took their dad as their role model.
They vowed to be even better than their father in the future so as not to bring shame upon him.
They wouldn't be like this big brother, chased out of the house by their father.
"Babies, if you really love Daddy, then you must cheer him on in the future. It's hard for Daddy to make money by himself out there, so we, as his family, must protect Daddy and keep his mind at ease,"
Taking advantage of the moment, Han Xuewei also wanted to instill some lessons in the children, to ensure they didn't always turn to their parents for everything.
They should be able to solve problems on their own and not put too much pressure on their parents.
Even though it was unlikely, considering how clever her children were.
But there were some things Han Xuewei felt she still needed to say.
The children nodded vigorously at Han Xuewei; they understood. They would definitely not cause trouble for their parents.
The matter at the kindergarten before, they really were sorry, after all, such things were not what they wanted to happen.
On one side, Han Xuewei was educating the children, and on the other, Lin Yi was also instructing Wang Sheng.
Grandpa Wang had driven Wang Sheng out, there definitely was a reason for that.
Since Wang Sheng had chosen to follow him, then Lin Yi would tell Wang Sheng some necessary things.
So as to save Wang Sheng from embarrassing himself in public.
If it came to admitting that Wang Sheng was his disciple, Lin Yi would also feel embarrassed.
"Did you not hear what I said? Why aren't you responding? Now I am your master, right? If you don't acknowledge me as your master, then you can just walk out the door and turn right."
Lin Yi looked sternly at Wang Sheng in front of him. Clenching his teeth, Wang Sheng finally called out "Master Lin Yi" at last.
Although he was somewhat reluctant inside, he had to bow his head under someone else's roof after all.
"If you don't call me master from the heart, there's also no need for you to suffer this humiliation here. It's not that I asked you to come, it was you who wanted to learn from me and work alongside me. So please be clear, it wasn't me who forced you to come, you asked for it yourself. I gave you this opportunity, you should be grateful, and not sit here complaining."
Lin Yi looked at Wang Sheng with a cold face.
He had already stated before that if Wang Sheng wasn't willing, he could leave; Lin Yi would not force Wang Sheng.
He didn't want to bring trouble upon himself, honestly, it was still because she was too kind.
Wang Sheng bowed his head and thought for a while, then lifted it up and earnestly called out "Master Lin Yi."
With that, the two of them's fate was tied together.
From now on, Wang Sheng was Lin Yi's disciple. Lin Yi would take Wang Sheng wherever he went, teaching him everything he knew.
But if Wang Sheng didn't pull his weight, there was nothing else Lin Yi could do.
"Good, you can rest well here today, and wait until the day after tomorrow, then I will take you to the company to familiarize yourself. Actually, the company doesn't have much to deal with recently."
The main reason was because Lin Yi's three-day task with the children was not yet complete.
If it weren't finished, he wouldn't be able to move on to the next task.
So Lin Yi must complete this task properly before thinking of other things.
"Do we have to wait that long? Can't we start tomorrow? Why wait until the day after tomorrow?"
Wang Sheng was very impatient, wanting to make a name for himself and show his father.
To let him see that he wasn't the worthless person his father spoke of.
"We can only go the day after tomorrow because naturally, I have my reasons. As a disciple, don't ask too many questions, just follow my lead. You can stay in the guest room tonight, don't worry, our house won't run short, you won't lack for food, and if you have any issues with your clothing, just communicate with me in time."
Last night, Lin Yi, with his wife and children, left without looking back.
Leaving Wang Sheng alone in the living room.
After Lin Yi and the others left, Wang Sheng felt a deep-seated resentment from within.
"One by one, they all look down on me; I will certainly make something of myself, and by that time, I will trample all of you underfoot!"
Lin Yi, who was not far away, naturally heard his words, shook his head helplessly and sighed.

chapters.title: Chapter 317 Reasoning
chapters.content:
After returning to the bedroom, Lin Yi told Han Xuewei to wait for him here.
He needed to take the children to their room and then lull them to sleep before coming back.
This task was usually done by the mother, but the two had agreed to take turns, one day each.
It was impossible to always let one person do a job; they needed to take turns, and the children needed both their father's and mother's company.
"What story would you like to hear today? Shall Daddy tell you one?"
Lin Yi picked up a picture book from the side and chose a few.
He prepared to let the children choose one from among these books as their bedtime story for the night.
The children each picked one.
In the end, Lin Yi closed his eyes and used a random grabbing method to select the book for the evening.
After the children's countdown stopped, he ended up choosing the book picked by the second child.
"It looks like tonight we'll be reading this one. Nobody's unhappy, right? After all, we take turns with these things. Since we're reading the second child's choice tonight, that means the second child won't participate in choosing tomorrow—it'll be between the other two of you."
Lin Yi was worried that the children might be upset, so he came up with this idea, which never failed to work.
"Daddy, don't worry, we definitely won't get mad over something like this. Mommy and Daddy are still waiting for you, right? Let's hurry up with the bedtime story. We'll be good," they said.
The three children lay in their beds.
Since Xiao Bao was a girl, Lin Yi had deliberately moved her bed away from her brothers' beds.
The storytelling began, and Lin Yi, with much emotion and emphasis, narrated a tale similar to 'The Ugly Duckling.'
By the time he closed the book, he realized that the three children had already fallen asleep.
After turning off the light for them, Lin Yi returned to the bedroom he shared with his wife.
Once back in their bedroom, he discovered that Han Xuewei had already snuggled into bed.
Lin Yi tiptoed onto the bed and embraced Han Xuewei from behind.
Han Xuewei, sensing Lin Yi's return, immediately nestled into his embrace.
"Why did you come back so late? Aren't you usually quite quick? Did the children take longer to fall asleep tonight?" she murmured drowsily.
She was actually very sleepy, but had been holding out so she could go to sleep after Lin Yi came back.
"Today, while I was reading the story, I didn't notice the children had fallen asleep, so I finished the story before coming back. Are you very tired? Go to sleep now. Shall I hold you?"
Lin Yi's hand gently patted Han Xuewei's back, comforting her.
Soon, Han Xuewei drifted off to dreamland, and Lin Yi fell asleep with her.
The next morning, Lin Yi was awoken by a clattering noise coming from outside.
When he emerged from the room, he discovered that all the commotion was caused by Wang Sheng.
This guy, whether on a whim or because his brain had short-circuited, had decided to make them breakfast.
But since he hardly ever cooked, he had no clue how to go about it, thus the scene that morning.
The entire kitchen was nearly blown to bits by Wang Sheng's efforts, causing Lin Yi a headache, so he retreated back into his room.
Han Xuewei also woke up and came over to rub her eyes. She looked at Lin Yi with sleepy eyes and asked him what had happened.
"Nothing much, just that guy outside got some crazy idea to make us breakfast, but that guy has never set foot in the kitchen before. Alright, alright, you don't need to worry about it, if you're still sleepy just go back to sleep."
Today was Han Xuewei's last day off, and also Lin Yi's last day to complete his task.
Today, they definitely had to spend quality time at home with the kids.
With such a loud noise, Han Xuewei was no longer sleepy and got dressed and up.
It seemed like the cooking was still going to be left to her.
However, when Han Xuewei saw the disastrous state of the kitchen, she dismissed that thought.
They might as well order takeout and also find a cleaning service to tidy up the kitchen.
"Don't do such things in the future, okay?"
During breakfast, Lin Yi felt it was necessary to discuss the matter with Wang Sheng.
"I was just trying to be nice, I just messed up, that's all. I didn't do it on purpose."
Wang Sheng still had the look of someone who thought he was completely justified, as if he had done nothing wrong. Why couldn't he be criticized for it?
Lin Yi had to turn around his thinking on the matter.
"I know you didn't mean it, but a mistake is a mistake. I'm not asking you to restore the kitchen back to its original state, which is already quite generous of me. Don't push your luck. Using our kitchen without the owner's permission is illegal, do you understand?"
Lin Yi spoke to Wang Sheng in a very stern tone about the incident.
He wanted him to take this incident seriously and ensure it wouldn't happen again.
"Can you not make such a big deal out of this? I just wanted to make you breakfast as a way to thank you, but I didn't expect it to be so hard."
Wang Sheng felt that Lin Yi was making too much of the situation. He had only wanted to express his gratitude,
not commit something illegal, as Lin Yi was suggesting.
"Even if you wanted to thank us, you should have asked for our permission before doing any of it. You used our kitchen without asking and caused us significant damage. I could totally seek compensation from your family, you know?"
When he heard that Lin Yi wanted to contact his family, Wang Sheng suddenly panicked.
How could he contact his family?
That's absolutely unacceptable!
He was already in such a tense situation with his family. If Lin Yi contacted them, he couldn't imagine what kind of scene it would cause.
"Alright, alright, I know I was wrong. Punish me if you must, just stop nagging, but definitely do not inform my family. Lin Yi, you should know my situation. Why are you doing this? Are you deliberately trying to embarrass me?"
Lin Yi suddenly found himself at a loss for words. Why on earth did he take on such a disciple who simply couldn't understand what others were saying?
Han Xuewei saw that the two were about to start arguing and quickly stepped in to mediate.
"Your master didn't mean that. He just wanted you to understand that you should always get consent from others before doing something, especially since you were using our kitchen, not your family's. You need our permission to use it, understand?"
Han Xuewei spoke gently and softly to Wang Sheng.
Wang Sheng finally nodded stiffly.
"You stay in your room today. When you've thought things through, then you can come out. Wang Sheng, you should know that I let you stay by my side because I wanted to teach you something, not for you to keep acting the way you did before."

chapters.title: Chapter 318 The Best Companion
chapters.content:
Lin Yi spoke with a stern tone,
as if he were disciplining his own son.
Before him, Wang Sheng really seemed like a small student who had made a mistake.
Previously, there had been some resentment in his heart.
But now, it seemed, he had been completely tamed by Lin Yi.
"Which, which room should I go to?"
His voice had started to turn weak.
Under someone else's roof, how can one not bow their head? Surely, Lin Yi understood this better than anyone.
"The study on the second floor. Go to that room and when you've thought things through, then come find me. Understood?"
"Okay, I understand."
After he spoke, he turned and left the place.
His defeated silhouette was apparent to anyone watching.
"Aren't you being a bit too harsh? And, I just feel like he seems somewhat mentally deficient."
"Mentally deficient? He's completely undeveloped, a total infantilized adult.
"If he really is an infantilized adult, then why are you keeping one by your side? Don't you think that's an inconvenience?"
"No, you're wrong. Actually, keeping him by my side serves my purpose. After all, he is the Wang Family's only youngest son, and also the person whom the old master loves the most."
As Lin Yi spoke, there seemed to be a glimmer in his eyes.
He must have had some trick up his sleeve.
In fact, Han Xuewei understood that there was a relationship of mutual use between him and Wang Sheng.
"I advise you not to act rashly. Moreover, if there is any risky behavior, it will be too late to regret it by then. Do you understand?"
"Don't worry, I naturally have a sense of measure. By the way, where are we going today?"
"Going out again? I'm not going anywhere today. Yesterday was absolutely exhausting for me."
"Mommy, Daddy said we're going out, we're going out."
"Yeah, Mommy, Daddy said so, why can't we go out then?"
"But, I don't want to go out."
Suddenly, Xiao Bao spoke up, and everyone's gaze turned to the little girl.
She was clearly different from her two brothers, and she was also very quiet.
On the contrary, the two brothers, always lively and wild when playing, were the wildest.
"Xiao Bao, tell Daddy, why don't you want to go outside?"
"Because, we already went out yesterday, and there are a lot of germs outside, viruses, and if we go out like this, they can easily enter our bodies."
"How could they enter our bodies so easily? Xiao Bao, tell Daddy, don't you want to go to the amusement park?"
"I'm not going, I'm not going to the amusement park."
"Then, do you want to go to the zoo? Daddy will take you to the zoo today, how about that?"
"No, I don't want to see animals either; I just want to stay at home with Brother and with Mommy and Daddy, and we can play games, tell stories, and watch cartoons together."
"Ah, those things again?"
Da Bao seemed somewhat reluctant upon hearing this.
But everyone was clear that in this family, the most cherished was probably this little sister.
"Okay, now your sister has said she wants to stay at home and have Mommy and Daddy keep you company properly. What are your thoughts, you two?"
"Alright, as long as Mommy and Daddy are with us, it doesn't matter where we go. So how about we play hide and seek?"
The eldest broached his own idea at this moment.
The second one always followed the eldest's lead.
So, when he finished speaking, he just nodded vigorously, which could be taken as raising both hands in approval.
"And you, Xiao Bao?"
She was the youngest, and it was also necessary to seek her opinion; otherwise, if there was any disagreement, this child might start a half-day fuss.
"I, I have no problem with that, sure, let's play hide and seek."
"Hehe, good, good, then we'll play hide and seek. This time, let's play rock-paper-scissors, and whoever wins will seek all of us. Of course, the playing area is confined to inside the house; we absolutely don't go into the yard, okay?"
"Okay, sure, no problem, let's do it."

chapters.title: Chapter 319 This is not cheating
chapters.content:
Several children, already impatient, rushed to join the game.
Once they started playing, it really took up the whole morning.
Sometimes, being with the children, one feels how time flies by swiftly.
These three kids could indeed bring them endless joy.
Although the three children were born on the same year, month, and day, the difference in their birth times was merely half a minute or even, in some cases, three to five minutes.
Yet, their personalities were completely different.
Wang Sheng spent half a day in his room.
He kept reflecting on his actions during this time.
Why did dad always talk about his two older brothers? And why was he always the disappointing one?
No, he had to achieve something, only then would the old man look at him with new respect.
Wasn't the old man always saying Lin Yi was not a simple man? So, if he really started following Lin Yi, perhaps he could change everything.
"Okay, if that's the case, I have made up my mind. From now on, no matter how Lin Yi criticizes or insults me, I will not have any retort."
After coming out of the room, he immediately saw a cute little girl standing at the door.
Wang Sheng recognized her as their youngest daughter.
He smiled slightly; to tell the truth, Wang Sheng wasn't really interested in children.
But now it was different; this was his master's child, so by seniority, she was also his junior sister.
"What's wrong? Why are you standing here alone? Where are your dad and mom?"
"Dad, mom, and brother, they're all hiding. We're playing hide and seek. Uncle, what are you doing?"
"Hide and seek? Have you found them yet?"
At this, it seemed he had touched on a sore spot for little Treasure, as she slowly lowered her head.
"Okay, if you haven't found them yet, how about Uncle helps you look for them?"
"That's not cheating, is it?"
Little Treasure blinked her big watery eyes, then curiously asked.
"How could that be cheating? Besides, they didn't say you can't ask for help. Come on, let's find them together."
With Wang Sheng's help, they quickly found everyone.
And in the blink of an eye, it was already noon.
"Come on, follow me to the study."
Lin Yi knew that by this time, Wang Sheng must have figured things out.
During the game, he had seemed to truly see Wang Sheng's talent.
He certainly took good care of the three children.
Once in the study, he simply gestured to the seat opposite him, and Wang Sheng got the hint and sat down.
"Lin Yi, no, Master, I've actually thought it over. I want to stay by your side and learn more. So from now on, whatever task you assign me, I will do it. Is that okay?"
Lin Yi just smiled.
"I'll tell you, it's not that simple to stay by my side, you know?"
"Fine, no problem. No matter how hard it is, I'm sure I can handle it. Just tell me, where do I start?"
"Well, if that's the case, how about this: starting tomorrow, I'll take you to the company to get a general feel for things. Afterward, you can buy some groceries from the market, come home, cook, do the laundry, and take care of the kids."
"What did you say?"
Wang Sheng thought he had heard wrong.
He had stayed here with the purpose of learning some skills, not to become a nanny.
This was obvious, Lin Yi was deliberately making things difficult for him.
Fine, since he had made up his mind, and Lin Yi was testing him, he definitely wouldn't disappoint him.
"What? Did you not understand? If you can handle it, you can stay. Otherwise, sorry, but I can't help you."
"Okay, I agree, but I'm not very familiar with the household yet. Could I take a quick look first?"

chapters.title: Chapter 320 All for the Child
chapters.content:
"No problem, there are a total of three layers here; feel free to look around and browse. Also, I will write down everyone's preferences on paper later. You must understand them clearly, got it?"
"Okay, Master, I got it. I'll get busy now."
Having said that, Wang Sheng left the study.
Watching his retreating figure, Lin Yi could only helplessly shake his head.
He knew what was on that man's mind and the nature of his desire for revenge.
At this moment, staying in the hotel any longer was becoming unbearable for Wang Guixiang.
She couldn't keep waiting like this. If she waited any longer, she feared she might go insane.
"Mommy, when can we go out?"
She and her child had hidden themselves in the hotel room for three whole days.
She was afraid that once she showed herself, Zhao Guangchen would be relentless in his pursuit of her.
That scoundrel, like a fly, indeed made her feel disgusted.
"Okay, then for your freedom, I'm willing to risk it. Today, I'm going to have a proper talk with her."
"Mommy, who are you going to talk to?"
"Xiao Bao, be a good boy. Watch some TV or play on the phone in the hotel. Mommy will go out for a bit and will be back soon. Then we can leave this place, okay?"
"Really, Mommy?"
Hearing this, his eyes lit up.
After all, he was just a child and didn't want to be confined to a room for most of his time.
"Don't worry, Mommy keeps her promises."
"Then, shall we pinky swear?"
"Sure, pinky swear. No backing out for a hundred years, come, let's seal it with a kiss."
After some cajoling, Wang Guixiang packed up briefly and then left straight away.
Just a moment ago, she had already messaged Zhao Guangchen, and the two agreed to meet under the flagpole in a square, just as they had done before.
This was the same place of their first date, bringing back those memories.
Except now, these memories seemed not to bring happiness but rather painful reminiscence.
From afar, she could see Zhao Guangchen standing under that flagpole.
He was holding two cups of coffee in his hand.
He knew Wang Guixiang's tastes very well, and also remembered that he was the one who bought this kind of coffee when they first met.
"What, trying to evoke old feelings?"
Upon arriving, Wang Guixiang seemed unappreciative of his gesture.
"It's nothing. I just feel that, after so many years, I can clearly remember the scenes of us meeting here."
"Yeah, in the blink of an eye, it's been seven years already. Seven years isn't just a moment's time."
"Right, for me, it really feels like such a long time."
"Yeah, it's because it was so lengthy that you gradually lost confidence in me, lost interest. Am I wrong?"
"What's past is past, there's nothing more to say. Come on, taste it. Is it still the same flavor as before?"
The words of Wang Guixiang made Zhao Guangchen feel somewhat embarrassed.
He was struggling to save face.
He knew that if he hadn't brought the trouble on himself from his actions outside, perhaps none of this demise would have befallen him.
Wang Guixiang just lightly sniffed the coffee, then took a small sip, savoring it in her mouth.
Indeed, the flavor was pure and unchanged from those days.
"I know, you asked me here today to lay it all out on the table, then to get me to sign the papers as quickly as possible, right?"
Zhao Guangchen didn't wait for Wang Guixiang to speak but instead took the initiative to say it all.
This surprised Wang Guixiang. What was with this man? Had he changed? Or had he suddenly developed a conscience last night and truly felt sorry for what he'd done to her?
"Heh, what? Got smart, have you? You're right, that's exactly what I mean. Tell me, what are your conditions?"
"I don't have any conditions. Moreover, as I told you before, I've decided to leave with nothing. Here's the divorce agreement I've already written," he said.
With that, he took a prepared agreement from his pocket and placed it in Wang Guixiang's hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 321 The Final Farewell
chapters.content:
```
Wang Guixiang just stood there dumbfounded, as if, indeed, she was a bit dazed.
What was going on with this man? Before, he was trying to harm her, but now, why such a sudden change in attitude?
This indeed made it somewhat difficult for Wang Guixiang to accept.
"Are you sure?"
"Yes, I've thought about it for a long time. I'm sorry, I sincerely apologize for my previous reckless actions. I just hope that from now on, you can live well and take good care of our child."
"What's wrong with you?"
Zhao Guangchen used to oppress her relentlessly, but now, this sudden change in attitude left Wang Guixiang feeling like she couldn't quite catch up.
"Nothing's wrong. I've made up my mind. If that's the case, then let's start over from scratch. I plan to leave this city and seek opportunities elsewhere. If I ever make something of myself, I will definitely come back to visit you and the child."
"Okay, perhaps, this is for the best. I wish you a safe journey."
"Thank you."
After saying that, he nodded, and just as he was about to turn around and leave, it seemed as if he suddenly remembered something, and so he came back again.
"What are you doing?"
Chen Sihui felt anxious. He wasn't going to go back on his word, was he? And she already had the agreement in her hands.
Her heart was suddenly gripped with tension, and she clutched the agreement tightly.
That was her "Magical Treasure;" she would not give it up for anything.
"Don't be so nervous. I won't go back on my word. Since it's my decision, no one can change it. I just hope, before I go, could I have a hug?"
Wang Guixiang hesitated.
It seemed like there was no longer any feeling between herself and that man.
Should she hug him like a stranger?
All right, even if it's a mechanical hug, she would fully cooperate with him.
She reached out her hands, then, stepped into Zhao Guangchen's embrace.
At that moment, she felt his body was cold and chilly, devoid of any warmth.
Perhaps, his heart, like his body, was the same—already thoroughly chilled through.
"Alright, I wish you all the best, goodbye."
After speaking, he turned without looking back and left the place.
Wang Guixiang faintly felt as if, there was a tingling sensation at the top of her head.
Could it be that she caught a chill?
She frowned suspiciously, then shook her head vigorously.
Impossible, there shouldn't be anything wrong.
Thinking this, Wang Guixiang felt much more relieved.
Now, being able to leave this man was indeed a significant relief for her.
Your journey continues at empire
Wang Guixiang took out her phone because she knew this news should be told to Lin Yi first.
"Hello, what's up?"
Lin Yi had been in the study this whole time and now received a call from Wang Guixiang.
Could it be that Zhao Guangchen was planning to do something again? Either way, he was fully prepared, so he would be able to handle the situation.
"Lin Yi, thank you so much. He has now signed the divorce papers."
"What did you say? He agreed to sign? How did he change his mind so quickly?"
```
"I'm not clear on the matter either. It's like he's become a completely different person. Anyway, he has handed the agreement over to me. He said he's ready to move to another city and start anew."
"What on earth is he up to with this mystery?"
Lin Yi's brows were tightly knitted together.
He was filled with suspicion about this matter.
"It doesn't matter what his intentions are; in the end, he has decided to let me go. Whatever you say, I should be thanking you. The child and I can start a new life again."
"Alright then, be careful and contact me if anything comes up."
"Okay, I got it. Let's leave it at that."
After finishing, Wang Guixiang hung up the phone.
At this time, Lin Yi was sitting behind his desk, lost in thought.
Wang Guixiang left the square.
In a corner of the square, a man had been hiding here all along.
It was only after he left that this man blended into the crowd.
Indeed, this person was Zhao Guangchen.
The smile on his face now was completely stacked, and it was very obviously a sly one.
That evening, Lin Yi finally finished his day's duty of taking care of the child.
In the past, he hadn't found it so tiring.
The brief reunion made him feel as if closeness wasn't close enough.
But now, several days of continuous high-intensity physical activity truly left him both physically and mentally exhausted.
Fortunately, with Wang Sheng's help in the afternoon, it indeed lightened his load.
After all, the system had told him before that as long as he was with the child, it shouldn't matter what he did.
At the very least, so far, the system had not issued any warnings to him.
"What's up? Tired?"
Han Xuewei quietly walked over and then sat beside him.
He looked back and saw Wang Sheng squatting on the ground, playing house with the kids.
"Come upstairs with me for a bit. I've got something I want to discuss with you."
"Okay, I understand."
Moreover, it was rare to see Lin Yi so solemn.
This also meant that at this moment, he probably had something in mind, and it wasn't convenient to reveal too much in front of Wang Sheng.
"What's with the secrecy?"
"We've been at home with the child for a full three days. By tomorrow, it should all be back to normal, right?"
"Yes, I know what you're trying to say. You're planning to send the child back, aren't you? Don't worry, this time, I definitely won't stop you."
"No, I don't want to send the child away. Moreover, I've finally realized caring for a child is really tiring, and I'm worried about your parents' health."
"Yeah, I've thought about that too. But your parents are busy, aren't they? There's no helping it, for now, we can only hope this. I just hope the kindergarten hurries up and reopens so we can have some relief."
"I inquired today, and basically, it can be finished by next week."
"What did you say? It can start next week? Is that true?"
When she heard this, Han Xuewei was genuinely excited.
She had been looking forward to this day because she knew that only by sending the child to kindergarten would everything get back on track.

chapters.title: Chapter 322 Wang Guixiang Gets into Trouble
chapters.content:
"I've already contacted the principal, and they've confirmed we can send the child back to class next Monday," Lin Yi said.
"That's great, so now there are only three days left, aren't there?" Han Xue responded.
"That's why I've decided there's no need to send the child over for these three days; it's not worth the back-and-forth hassle," Lin Yi explained.
"What will you do then? Can you continue to stay? You haven't been to the company in three days," Han Xue asked worriedly.
"I must go back to the company tomorrow. Three days have already passed, but I want to keep the child at home, and I also want to keep Wang Sheng here," Lin Yi asserted.
"What did you say? You want him to stay with the child?" Han Xue questioned.
"I'm giving him a task, and it's also a test. If he wants to stay by my side, then he must pass this test," Lin Yi explained confidently.
"But, wouldn't that be inappropriate?" Han Xue doubted.
"What? Haven't you noticed? He spent the whole day with the child today, and the kids really enjoy his company. Perhaps, it's a case of great minds think alike," Lin Yi observed.
"Still, I'm worried about the child," Han Xue admitted.
"I know what you're worried about, but rest assured, I've got the house under 24-hour full surveillance; there won't be any accidents. Plus, this gives me a good chance to test him out," Lin Yi reassured.
"Testing him? Are you using your child's safety as a test? Don't you think that's going too far?" Han Xue argued anxiously.
Han Xuewei was getting anxious.
After all, she knew exactly how they had met Wang Sheng.
"Xue Mei, there's no need to panic. It won't come to that, and besides, he wouldn't dare do such a thing right now. He doesn't dare cross me, understand?" Lin Yi said with confidence.
"How can you be so sure?" Han Xue asked.
"I've thought it through thoroughly; there's absolutely no problem. I can assure you of that with all my heart. Can you trust me?" Lin Yi implored.
"Your assurance? That there won't be any accidents with the child within three days?" Han Xue pressed.
"Absolutely not. I've told you, I have complete control over this house at all times; there won't be any mishaps," Lin Yi guaranteed.
"Fine, if you've already decided, then go ahead with your plan. To be honest, I would also prefer for the child to stay at home, rather than with my parents. They really spoil him too much," Han Xue agreed reluctantly.
After all, she was a university student.
So naturally, when it came to educating her child, she was inherently sensitive to it.
"Alright, let's settle this matter then. Tomorrow morning, you do your things and I'll do mine; we'll leave the house in his charge. However, if you miss the child, you can always check the surveillance cameras anytime. Isn't that more convenient?" Lin Yi suggested.
Yes, that point made a lot of sense.
She had previously wanted to install surveillance in her parents' house, but her mother was adamantly against it.
It felt to them as if they were being monitored, which is why the installation never happened.
But now, she could finally enjoy her freedom again.
Perhaps, staying at the school would give her more peace of mind.
Wang Guixiang returned to the villa with the child.
Although it was now empty and the former feeling of warmth had vanished completely,
she knew this marked a new beginning for her.
The child, on the other hand, was quite happy, running around the room; after all, he had lived there for years and was familiar with everything.
"Slow down, honey. Mommy will check the kitchen to see if there's something to eat and then make you a dessert, how about that?" Wang Guixiang offered.
"Oh, yes, please! After the dessert, I can go back to sleeping in my little car bed," the child exclaimed excitedly.
"Alright, I'm off to the kitchen then," she said.
But after just a few steps, Wang Guixiang felt a sudden dizziness.
And then, she collapsed to the floor.
The loud noise startled the child.
He turned back and saw, to his horror, that his mother had already fallen to the ground.
"Mom, Mom, what's wrong with you?"
He rushed forward and then began to shake Wang Guixiang's body vigorously.
But he found that Wang Guixiang had no consciousness at all, and her eyes were also tightly closed.
"Mom, Mom, don't scare me, Mom, please don't die."
He was shouting loudly.
But there was no response from anyone, after all, there were only the two of them, mother and son, left in the house.
The child, while crying, took out Wang Guixiang's phone.
He had no idea who he should call.
He just operated the phone randomly, and finally, a phone number was actually dialed.
And this number, it was the last one Wang Guixiang had called, and the person on the other end was Lin Yi.
Lin Yi had already been preparing to go to bed and rest, but upon seeing the call, he felt something was odd.
Hadn't everything ended already? Could it be that Zhao Guangchen had done something again?
"What's wrong? Is there something the matter?"
Hearing this, Han Xuewei, who was lying beside him, just looked at him curiously and asked.
Your journey continues with empire
"Oh, it's a call from Guixiang, not sure what it's about. You go to sleep first; I'll take a call, what's up?"
He answered the phone quite naturally.
But what Lin Yi heard was just a child's cry.
And judging by the sound, it seemed truly miserable.
"Don't panic, don't cry, tell uncle what happened to your mom? Let your mom take the phone."
"Mom? Mom, Mom's dead."
"What, what did you say? Mom's dead?"
"Yes, Mom, Mom's dead."
The child kept repeating this sentence continuously.
Lin Yi sensed that something was definitely wrong,
"Tell uncle, where are you now?"
"In, in the living room."
"Good, stay there, don't go anywhere; Uncle will be there right away."
He hung up the phone in a hurry.
"What's wrong? Has something happened?"
By this time, Han Xuewei had already sat up in bed.
"It could be an emergency with Wang Guixiang; I don't know what's going on. You stay at home, and I'll go check."
"Should I come with you?"
"No, I can't leave the three kids alone at night, so you stay home. I will contact you if anything happens."
Indeed, one couldn't just leave the three children alone at home late at night.
Moreover, he had no idea when he would be back if he went, and she themselves had to attend school the next day.
Having no other choice, she had to let Lin Yi leave on his own.

chapters.title: Chapter 323 Injected with Drugs
chapters.content:
Lin Yi rushed frantically to the villa.
The villa's main gate was tightly closed at this time.
Having no choice, Lin Yi had to go around to the back door and then climb over the wall, finally managing to jump into the courtyard.
As he burst into the living room, he saw Wang Guixiang lying on the ground.
He tried to feel for her breath with his hand and realized that her breathing was extremely faint; without careful examination, he wouldn't have been able to detect it at all.
"What on earth happened to your mother?"
"I don't know, I don't know if mom is dead?"
"Alright, stop worrying about that for now, hurry up, I'll take you and your mom to the hospital."
Lin Yi couldn't pursue the cause here and all he could do was to get her to the hospital, then decide what to do next.
Enjoy new tales from empire
Soon, Wang Guixiang was taken into the emergency room.
Lin Yi waited outside quietly with the child.
"What did you and your mom eat tonight?"
"We, we had takeout, and I ate, I ate a lot of hamburgers."
"What about your mom? What did she eat?"
"Mom, mom also ate hamburgers."
"That's not right, both of you ate the same thing, and the child is fine, how could an adult possibly have a problem?"
"Could there be another reason?"
His mind was wildly speculating.
Finally, after waiting for nearly 40 minutes, Lin Yi saw the doctor coming out from inside.
"Doctor, how is she doing?"
"She has been injected with a drug which is why her brain has begun to atrophy."
"You, what are you saying? Injected with a drug? What drug?"
"It's a kind of medication that controls the brain's nerves, but if injected into a healthy person without any illness, it will inevitably have a significant impact on the brain's central nervous system."
"And, the consequences? What are the consequences?"
"The worst-case scenario is death, but right now she's not there yet, just that she will remain in a coma for the time being."
"So, when will she be able to wake up?"
"That, I don't know, and it depends on the patient's will and the development of subsequent treatment."
"So she's still in danger now?"
"That should be the situation at present, but rest assured, we will actively pursue treatment."
"Wait a minute, you just mentioned she was injected with a drug. Where was it administered?"
"That, we have not found out yet, and the people inside are carefully examining it, I believe, the result should come out very soon."
"Can you find out when she was injected with the drug?"
"We can make an estimate, and then, based on the speed of her blood flow, we should be able to calculate that it was probably in the afternoon."
"Afternoon?"
He frowned slightly.
He remembered clearly that Wang Guixiang had just called him that afternoon.
She had mentioned that she had signed the divorce agreement with Zhao Guangchen, and the last person she was supposed to meet that afternoon was Zhao Guangchen himself.
"Okay, doctor, I'll leave her in your hands, please take good care of her, and don't worry about the money, you must try your best, do you understand?"
"Don't worry, we will certainly do our utmost, but we also hope that you, as family members, will prepare for the worst. Okay then, I must go attend to it now."
After finishing the conversation, the doctor hurried back into the emergency room.
He was convinced that this incident must be inextricably linked to Zhao Guangchen.
"Hei Lang, where are you?"
He picked up the phone and directly dialed Hei Liang's number.
"Big brother, I'm at home now, what's up?"
"No matter what method you use, even if it means digging three feet into the ground, you must find Zhao Guangchen for me."
"Okay, I understand."
Hei Lang had dealt with Zhao Guangshen before.
He knew this man was not that simple.
If Lin Yi was calling him in the dead of night like this, he believed that Zhao Guangchen must have done something.
Unfortunately, at this very moment, Zhao Guangchen had already boarded a plane and flown to another country.
So, Hei Lang's search here was utterly fruitless.
It wasn't until 2 a.m. that he finally arrived at the hospital to see Lin Yi.
He saw that Lin Yi's complexion was not looking good.
"How did it go, did you find him?"
"Big brother, we were too late. He boarded a plane this afternoon. I guess he must be overseas by now."
"Damn it, to let him escape. I didn't expect him to be so ruthless, to harm his wife in the final moment."
"Big brother, what should we do now? Moreover, I'm not sure where exactly he has gone. If necessary, I can go abroad and bring him back."
"There's no point now. If he wanted to leave, he probably didn't plan to come back. He just wanted to destroy everything."
"Destroy everything?"
After saying this, Hei Lang lowered his head.
"Hei Lang, have you thought of something?"
He looked up and asked Hei Lang.
"If he really wants to destroy everything, then who caused all this? Doesn't he know?"
"Are you saying, he should be targeting me?"
"Yes, it's very likely he's targeting you, but the key question now is how exactly is he planning to deal with you? It seems like he's only targeting Wang Guixiang right now."
At this point, Hei Lang seemed to be confused again.
Lying here was clearly Wang Guixiang, not Lin Yi.
And if he wanted to target Lin Yi, it didn't seem to result in this.
"How else could he target me? I suppose it's just his final struggle before death."
"Anyway, big brother, I still want to remind you to be careful."
"Don't worry, I know what to do."
Just as he finished speaking, he saw two uniformed people approaching him.
In the dead of night, those who come here are seldom well-intentioned.
"Are you Lin Yi?"
"Yes, I'm Lin Yi."
"There's a matter that requires your cooperation with our investigation. Please come with us now."
"What? You need me for an investigation? May I ask what this is about?"
"That, you'll naturally understand once you're there. I want to know, what is your relationship with Wang Guixiang?"
"I, I'm just friends with her, there's no special relationship."
"Alright, I understand. Then please hurry up and make arrangements. By the way, who is this child?"
Just then, they also noticed a child lying on a lounge chair in the corner, apparently already asleep.
"Oh, he is Wang Guixiang's son. Right now, there's no one to take care of him."
"Oh, don't worry about that. We will arrange someone."
With that, he signaled to someone beside him, and quickly, that person went over and picked up the child in his arms.

chapters.title: Chapter 324 Another Lin Yi?
chapters.content:
"Big brother, this..."
Hei Lang seemed to have never encountered such a situation before.
If it were someone else, Hei Lang would have stepped forward a long time ago.
But in this situation, he knew that if he were to forcefully negotiate, he would likely get himself in trouble too.
"Comrade, look, can I explain things to my brother here? After all, when I leave, the company still needs some explanation."
"Alright, then hurry up. We'll wait for you here,"
The other party seemed quite reasonable, promptly agreeing to the request.
Just this alone made Lin Yi feel that the situation probably wasn't that serious.
Maybe it was because Wang Guixiang's incident was reported, so he was just being asked to come in and cooperate with the investigation.
Lin Yi pulled Hei Lang with him and walked to a corner.
"Big brother, what's going on here? And how come he suddenly came to find you? I feel like it's not that simple," Hei Lang said.
From the moment he heard about the situation until now, Hei Lang's heart had never relaxed.
He felt that Zhao Guangchen's actions meant that the target must be Lin Yi himself.
And Wang Guixiang was merely incidental, a sacrificial lamb.
"I'm not sure myself. Maybe it's just routine cooperation with an investigation," Lin Yi said.
"Big brother, you have to be careful. Also, should I contact some people for you on the outside?"
"We don't need to do that for now. And don't let your sister-in-law know about this, got it?"
"Got it. Anything else I should know?"
"If I can't come out by tomorrow, contact Wang Sheng for me."
"Wang Sheng? Why bother him?"
"Have you forgotten? What does Wang Sheng's big brother do?"
Upon saying this, it seemed to remind Hei Lang.
Right, Wang Sheng's big brother was a well-known lawyer.
If Lin Yi really couldn't get out, then probably only a lawyer would be able to see him,
Although Lin Yi hadn't assumed the worst, he still had to prepare for the worst-case scenario.
"Okay, got it."
"One more thing, if I don't come back, no one is allowed to leave this place unattended. Stay in the hospital 24/7 to ensure that Wang Gui's treatment goes smoothly," Lin Yi instructed.
"Okay, I know," Hei Lang responded, nodding vigorously.
Hei Lang never refused anything Lin Yi asked of him.
Afterwards, Lin Yi followed the two uniformed officers and left the place.
When he arrived at the interrogation room, it was already the middle of the night.
Yet, Lin Yi didn't feel the slightest bit sleepy.
He was just very curious about what there was about himself that could be investigated.
He had been asking repeatedly in the car, but those people were completely tight-lipped, revealing nothing.
"Come, sit over there," they said as soon as they entered.
As soon as he stepped in, their expressions turned stern, which put some pressure on Lin Yi.
He looked back and saw a metal chair behind him, clearly meant to restrain suspects.
"I, should I sit here?" Lin Yi asked.
"Otherwise, what? You want to sit here instead of me?"
Lin Yi just smiled.
Beggars can't be choosers.
No matter how high and mighty one might be outside, everyone ends up the same way once inside.
He went over obediently, and then a comrade came over and locked the clamp around him.
He was firmly secured to the chair.
He was beginning to feel more and more like he wasn't there to cooperate, but rather that they were suspecting him.
"When did you meet Wang Guixiang?" they asked.
"I've known Wang Guixiang for a long time, and our relationship has always been good. What's up? Are you maybe suggesting that Wang Guixiang's poisoning has something to do with this?" Lin Yi inquired.
"Oh, it seems you know what we want to ask without us saying it," they noted.
"You can't suspect that her poisoning has anything to do with me?" Lin Yi asked.
"Whether it does or not, we will investigate. I just want to ask you, where were you this afternoon?"
"This afternoon? I was at home, I didn't go anywhere."
"At home? Who can vouch for you?"
"Naturally, my family can. My children, my wife, they were all at home," Lin Yi replied.
"Family testimony definitely doesn't count. Can anyone else vouch for you besides your family?"
"Apart from family?"
At that, Lin Yi furrowed his brows.
Probably only Wang Sheng then.
But in the current unclear situation, he wasn't willing to involve Wang Sheng so quickly.
"Comrade, I'm telling you, I really didn't go anywhere today, and I haven't left the house for several days," Lin Yi explained.
"Is that so? Then what is this about?" they questioned as one of them operated a laptop and quickly turned the screen around.
He clearly saw that it was a square.
Someone was wandering around the square.
He could clearly see that this person was, this, wasn't this Lin Yi himself?
Lin Yi thought he might have seen it wrong, so he widened his eyes.
The clothes, the silhouette, the pants, even the shoes were exactly like his own.
"What do you think? Seen it clearly? Who is this? Didn't you say you were at home?"
"Yes, I was indeed at home, but I can tell you with certainty that this person is definitely not me," Lin Yi insisted.
Lin Yi saw very clearly that the video timestamp was from today at 2:30 PM.
He distinctly remembered at that time; he was playing games at home with his child. How could he possibly be in two places at once?
Unless he knew the Doppelganger Technique, or he had an identical twin brother.
"And did you see? He never showed his face the entire time."
"Yes, indeed, that has not happened, but I'll tell you, those who want to engage in criminal activities, how could they show their face to everyone? And he knows, in public places like this, there are definitely surveillance cameras."
"Just based on a silhouette and a set of clothes, you can conclude that this person is me?" Lin Yi challenged.

chapters.title: Chapter 325 I Have the Right to Remain Silent
chapters.content:
"Of course not, and of course, we have other evidence in our hands."
"What other evidence do you have?"
"That, I do not need to tell you, but rest assured, we do have some leads. Otherwise, we would not have easily invited you over. Tell me, what sort of grudge do you have with Wang Guixiang?"
"Me, with her? I have no grudges against her, and you can ask around, including some people close to her."
"The people close to her? Whom are you referring to? Is it Zhao Guangchen?"
At this point, Lin Yi suddenly paused.
Right, how could he have forgotten such a key person.
Before Zhao Guangchen left yesterday, he had actually laid such a big trap for himself.
It was obvious that it was a trap meticulously designed by him.
"I think you'd better find Zhao Guangchen, because all of this was masterminded by him."
"However, as far as we know, Zhao Guangchen boarded a plane at 4 p.m. today."
"Right, he already boarded a plane. Isn't that fleeing the crime? Moreover, don't these things explain everything?"
"Why would you want to harm Wang Guixiang?"
"What are you saying? I harmed her? Let me ask."
"Yes, I'm asking you, why?"
"I haven't harmed her, and I definitely won't admit to things I haven't done."
At this moment, Lin Yi's tone was very firm.
How could he possibly harm this woman easily?
In the past period, everything he did was actually to protect this woman.
"So, you don't want to cooperate anymore, is that it? Let me ask you again, were their marital conflicts caused by you?"
Lin Yi was somewhat stunned by this.
How did they even unearth the marital discord?
It was clear that they must have conducted a lot of investigative work beforehand.
Could it be that Zhao Guangchen had left them some clues before?
"Regarding your question, I have the right to remain silent, and I want to see my lawyer."
"All right, calling for a lawyer is no problem. We can arrange that for you. Do you have a designated lawyer?"
"Yes, I have already had someone outside start to contact them for me, so, for now, I will not answer any more of your questions until my lawyer arrives."
"Okay then, you think it over. Besides, we need to remind you, leniency for those who confess, severity for those who resist. If these things really are rock-solid evidence, even 10 lawyers might not be able to help you clear the charges, understand?"
"I can also tell you, I will absolutely not admit to things I haven't done. The upright need not fear a crooked shadow."
"All right, but I've seen too many people like you. Everyone has the same attitude when they first come in. If that's the case, then you can sit here and reflect on it."
With that, the two men stood up.
And then, they turned and left the room.
Lin Yi was left alone in the cold room.
At this time, Lin Yi was still immobile, forced to maintain the same posture.
He began to feel anxious and uneasy inside.
He was not clear on what evidence the opponent had on him.
But one thing was clear, they definitely wouldn't have trapped him here without substantial evidence.
Normally, the detention time should not exceed 24 hours.
Meaning, they would naturally release him once the time was up if they had no other direct evidence.
The key question was, what could that direct evidence be?
Lin Yi spent the entire night lost in such speculations.
After waking up in the morning, Han Xuewei felt her eyelids twitch a few times.
She turned around and saw that Lin Yi really had not returned home all night.
However, this had often happened before, so she was no longer surprised by it.
She picked up the phone to call Lin Yi's mobile phone.
But strangely, she was greeted with a message that the call could not be connected.
That was odd, even if he had other things to deal with, his phone should be available.
"Mommy."
As she was lost in thought, the three children suddenly burst into the room and then all flung themselves onto her.
"What's the matter, not behaving again? Didn't mommy tell you? Today, mommy has to go to class at the university, so I can't play with you anymore."
"Mommy, we just wanted to play with you a bit more before you left."
Han Xuewei smiled helplessly, then picked up her phone to check the time.
No, she really didn't have any more time to play, or she would be late for her first class again.
"No, no, I really don't have time now. Mommy needs to wash up and rush to the university. You must listen to uncle at home, okay?"
"Mommy, where's daddy?"
"Daddy is busy and has stayed at the company, so he will naturally come back later. You don't need to worry so much, just be good at home, eat well, understand?"
"Okay, mommy, we will be good, we're going now."
The eldest really acted like the eldest.
With a wave of his hand, his younger siblings followed him, scurrying out of the room.
The mornings were always so busy, so much so that she couldn't afford to be distracted by other things.
Still, Han Xuewei had a vague sense of worry.
No way around it, after today's classes, she would try to contact him again. If she still couldn't reach him, she would make other plans.
Wang Sheng, like a nanny, took care of the meal for the young and old in the house and then took the children to play in the downstairs plaza for a while.
Now it was already 9 a.m.
It looked like he had to go to the market to buy some groceries, otherwise, he wouldn't be able to prepare lunch on time.
"You three little rascals, come here, stand in line."
Wang Sheng waved at them.
The kids were quite cooperative.
They lined up in front of him in an orderly fashion.
"Remember, you are only to play with these toys at home now. Uncle will make a trip to the market and I will be back within half an hour. None of you are allowed to leave this room, got it?"
"Okay, uncle, I got it."
"Uncle, but, but my little brother doesn't listen."

chapters.title: Chapter 326 Contact the Lawyer
chapters.content:
"I'm telling you, if anyone doesn't listen to me today, once we get back, I'm going to spank them, and furthermore, when I come back, I'll bring each one of you a lollipop. If you don't behave, that person will get nothing."
"Oh, that's great, that's great, we'll have lollipops."
"So, what are you going to do?"
"Uncle, we'll definitely behave and just stay right here without going anywhere."
"Good, that's what I like to hear. Alright, I'm off now."
Wang Sheng smiled and finally took off the apron he had been wearing.
After coming out of the villa, he let out a long sigh.
The once proud third young master of the Wang Family, when did he ever fall into such a state?
"Wang Sheng."
Just then, a woman's voice suddenly rang out.
This voice, it did indeed sound familiar.
He turned around to see, and there in the corner, was none other than Han Xuemei.
Wang Sheng was a bit surprised. When did Han Xuemei manage to find this place?
He quickly walked up to her and then pulled Han Xuemei into a corner to hide.
"How did you come here?"
"I should be asking you that. How come you are here? Do you know whose house this is?"
"Of course I do, isn't this Lin Yi's house?"
"Exactly, so why would you be here?"
"This, well, it's a long story. I can't explain it in just one or two sentences. But, give me a few days and I promise I will give you an ultimate answer. How about that?"
"Didn't you already come here yesterday? And you didn't leave last night, did you?"
What on earth was going on with Han Xuemei, and how did she manage to investigate his whereabouts so thoroughly?
"Yes, I did stay here. But I can tell you, I have my reasons. I know what I'm thinking and what I'm doing better than anyone else, understand?"
Han Xuemei, she actually knew everything already.
This person stayed by Lin Yi's side and even claimed Lin Yi to be her master.
Isn't that the epitome of betrayal?
Initially, she had wanted to use Wang Sheng to teach Lin Yi a lesson, but now it seemed that this dream had once again been shattered.
"You've really opened my eyes. Fine, just stay here and be a good lackey."
As soon as she finished speaking, Wang Sheng's phone suddenly started to ring.
"Hold on a moment, let me finish this call and then I will continue talking to you."
Wang Sheng didn't want to show any signs of distress in front of the girl he admired.
He just frowned a little, as the number on the phone was indeed unfamiliar.
His other hand was tightly holding onto Han Xuemei, not wanting her to leave.
"Hello, who's this?"
"Is this Wang Sheng?"
"Yes, I am Wang Sheng."
"I'm Hei Lang."
"What, what did you say?"
"I said I'm Hei Lang, did you hear me?"
"Oh, I, I heard you, heard you. What's up, is there a problem?"
Even though Lin Yi had not met Hei Lang more than twice, he knew that Hei Lang was one of Lin Yi's biggest bodyguards.
Wang Sheng was very clear that many things below were accomplished by relying on this person.
"Find a way to contact your elder brother, then have him call me as soon as possible."
"Contact my elder brother? What happened? Is there something wrong?"
"Quit the nonsense, this is President Lin's order. I'm just asking you, are you going to do it or not?"
"Alright, alright, I'll do it, I'll do it. I'll contact him right away, and I'll have him call you, right?"
"Yes, right now. Remember, it must be quick."
"Okay, I've got it."
After saying that, Hei Liang hung up the phone.
"Let go of me, I have to leave. And if you want to stay here as a lapdog, then continue doing so."
"Lin Yi seems to have run into trouble."
Wang Sheng's gaze was somewhat blank; then, he turned to Han Xuemei and said.
Han Xuemei was desperately trying to break free, but upon hearing this phrase, it seemed to captivate her suddenly.
"What did you say? Did I hear you wrong, Lin Yi is in trouble? What happened to him?"
"That, I'm not sure. But what I do know is that Lin Yi left the Lin Family late in the night yesterday. After that, where he went, I have no idea, and he hasn't returned even now."
"Then who was the person who called you? Was it Lin Yi?"
"It wasn't Lin Yi, it was Hei Lang, the one who's always by Lin Yi's side. I believe you are aware of who he is."
"Hei Lang? That guy again, what does he want from you?"
"He wanted me to contact my elder brother."
"Contact your elder brother? Who is your elder brother?"
"My elder brother is a lawyer."
"Lin Yi is looking for a lawyer now, what does he actually want to do? And it's not even Lin Yi who called you. He couldn't really be under someone else's control, could he?"
Han Xuemei really couldn't think of any other better reason.
If one were to ask, who was Lin Yi, under normal circumstances, who would have the power to control him?
"I think it's best for you not to contact your elder brother right now."
"Why? He already said so over there."
"He said, and so you have to contact him?"
"I know what you're thinking; you just don't want to deal with these issues, do you? But I'm telling you, in this world, my elder brother isn't the only lawyer. If they can't reach him, naturally, they will contact someone else. It's better if my elder brother goes; that way, I might also get some more information."
What Wang Sheng said was indeed genuine.
As expected, Han Xuemei was completely clueless, having not realized this point at all.
"Oh, then hurry up and contact him. At the very least, we need to find out what has happened to this man."
"No worries, I will call him right now."
Upon saying that, he took out his phone and dialed his elder brother's number directly.
The Wang Family's three brothers actually all knew about the existence of Lin Yi.
Furthermore, they understood the importance of Lin Yi's role.
Apart from Wang Sheng, who had always been reluctant to acknowledge Lin Yi's authority, the others had been quite submissive towards him.
After the lawyer received the call, he hurriedly contacted Hei Lang and then rushed to the place where Lin Yi was currently detained.
Here, after a brief exchange with them, he finally got to see Lin Yi.
At this moment, Lin Yi had been locked up here for a full eight hours.
This whole night, Lin Yi remained in the same posture, truly undergoing torture.

chapters.title: Chapter 327 Became a Suspect
chapters.content:
"What's the situation with you?"
Upon seeing him come in, Lin Yi looked as if he had seen hope.
"After they brought me here yesterday, they said I had harmed Wang Guixiang, but I really didn't do it. However, what's strange is that it seems like they have some evidence."
"Yes, they not only have video evidence, but they also found related drugs during a search of your company. Moreover, these drugs match exactly with the ones found in Wang Guixiang's system."
