"What are you talking about? They found it at my company?"
"Yes, from your company, and specifically inside the safe in your office. Initially, there were five in the box, but coincidentally, now there are only four left."
"That's impossible. How could there be such things in my office? And what exactly are those drugs?"
"As for what they are, I haven't figured it out yet, but they should have the lab results soon. Tell me, did you really do it?"
"I truly didn't do it. How could I possibly have harmed Wang Guixiang? Besides, I've been helping him all along."
Lin Yi grew anxious, feeling as if jumping into the Yellow River wouldn't wash him clean.
"Then why does the surveillance footage capture your likeness?"
"I've seen the surveillance footage too. But I can tell you, what they captured was just a silhouette. I'm telling you, Zhao Guangchen, whether in terms of height or build, resembles me very closely. So, I suspect that person was him."
"Zhao Guangchen, always Zhao Guangchen. They mentioned him this time too, saying that before boarding the plane, he delivered a letter of accusation, detailing the whole ins and outs of the affair."
"Nonsense, he's simply distorting the facts."
"So, I've already negotiated with them. Although they don't have any direct evidence, after paying a deposit, I can bail you out. Let's plan everything after we get out."
"Okay, I understand."
After speaking, he simply nodded his head. After waiting for a few minutes, a person walked in and he signed and applied his Hand Seals.
Subsequently, the shackles on Lin Yi were quickly unlocked.
Lin Yi gained his freedom, then stretched his waist. No matter what, at least now he could finally breathe free again.
As for the development of events afterward, all plans would have to wait until after getting out.
"Let's move quickly and leave."
Really, he didn't want to stay in this place a moment longer.
It's hard to describe the feeling—is it fear, or a sense of injustice?
"Sorry, you can't leave just yet."
At that moment, several uniformed people blocked them at the doorway again.
"I've already processed the bail, and according to your requirements, I've also paid the deposit. May I ask why we can't leave?"
While speaking, the lawyer showed them the bail document, gesturing with it in front of them.
"Initially, it was just a case of intentional injury, but we just got news from the hospital—Wang Guixiang is no longer alive."
"What did you say? Wang Guixiang, she's dead?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi's eyes widened in shock.
He had never imagined that Wang Guixiang would depart this world so quickly.
He hadn't had the chance to inquire into the particulars of the matter.
"Yes, she's dead. So now, you are a suspect, and the alleged crime is intentional homicide. According to the law, people suspected of intentional homicide are not eligible for bail. Sorry, please come back with me."
With that said, the officer pulled out a pair of handcuffs from his pocket.
Throughout his time here, they had never cuffed him.
But now it seemed the nature of the crime had changed.
The cold handcuffs were swiftly secured on Lin Yi's wrists.
He had never thought he would one day find himself in such dire straits.
"Don't worry, I'll apply for a search warrant on the outside. Inside, make sure you cooperate with them. And remember, don't talk carelessly about things you haven't done, understand?" Your adventure continues at empire
Lawyer Wang was well aware of the severity of the situation.
Now, getting him out was an utter fantasy.
He could only do his best, maneuvering from the outside,
Watching as his back receded, he could only shake his head helplessly before quickly leaving the place.
The first thing he did upon leaving was to directly call the old man.
Because he knew that the situation was beyond his control now.
If it was just up to him alone, it was unlikely he could clear Lin Yi's name.
The old man, after hearing about the situation, was truly astounded.
So all the evidence pointed toward him, suggesting things were very unfavorable for him now?
"Yes, that's right. Including the video and the drugs, everything points to Lin Yi. I'm sorry, what should we do now?"
"Lin Yi couldn't possibly have done this. Moreover, when he talked to me before, he mentioned this woman, saying she was really pitiable. How could he possibly strike at such a pitiful person?"
"Of course, I understand. You've already told me all the ins and outs of the matter. I suspect Zhao Guangchen set up a trap before he left. Go to his office and search thoroughly. Also, gather a list of everyone who has access to his office and investigate them all. If Lin Yi said there were no such drugs there before and they've suddenly appeared now, it means someone tampered with things.
That person is key, and we must find them."
"Yes, I think so too. But given my current identity, trying to do that is, I'm afraid..."
After all, he was a lawyer.
Anything illegal or overstepping boundaries was certainly out of his reach.
The reason he called the old man was because he knew only he could handle these matters.

chapters.title: Chapter 328 Evidence
chapters.content:
```
"Okay, I understand. You can go back now and wait for my message."
Lawyer Wang merely let out a long sigh of relief.
With the old man's assurance, he believed that the road ahead shouldn't be too difficult to travel.
"How is it? Any news?"
Han Xuemei had been waiting with Wang Sheng for news.
"There's news. He has been detained on suspicion of intentional murder."
"Suspected of intentional murder? Haha, that's great, really great. Lin Yi, Lin Yi, you never expected to have such a day, did you?"
Of course, Han Xuemei was overjoyed as well.
"What, are you happy about this?"
Wang Sheng, on the other hand, felt a mix of emotions in his heart, an indescribable feeling.
He looked at the woman with suspicious eyes and furrowed his brows.
"What's the matter? Isn't this something worth celebrating? Besides, you considered Lin Yi a thorn in your side before, and likewise, he was a thorn in my flesh too."
"But I always feel that he must have been wronged and, moreover, he was clearly at home yesterday."
"Who cares if it was him or not? Doesn't he deserve this for how he usually acts so arrogantly?"
"What do you mean? You're not thinking of saving him, are you?"
"Me, save him? I would need the capability to do that. Let me tell you, my grandfather is already aware of this. If he decides to intervene, I'm afraid it won't be so simple."
"What? Your grandfather is going to intervene? What can he do? Could he possibly overturn the charge?"
"If Lin Yi truly didn't do it, I trust that with my grandfather's ability, he definitely can overturn everything."
"No, that absolutely cannot happen. You must stop your grandfather at all costs. Now that we finally have this opportunity, if he is released, there won't be another chance like this."
"Heh, you are thinking too simply. Alright, I need to hurry back to make lunch for the kids, else they'll have nothing to eat at noon."
"What? At a time like this, you're still thinking about cooking?"
Upon saying that, Han Xuemei's eyes suddenly lit up.
It seemed as if she had an idea.
"Ah, that's right, is there no one at his home now?"
"Right, there's no one. What about it?"
Wang Sheng was curious.
When he had left earlier, he had already explained everything to Han Xuemei. Why was she purposely bringing up this topic again now?
"That's perfect. I haven't seen the kids in a long time. It's a good chance for me to spend some quality time with them."
"What, what are you saying? You and the children? Do you know them?"
"What, you don't know yet? Fine, I'll tell you. The children's mother is Han Xuewei, and I'm Han Xuemei. Do you think I know them?"
"What? Are you, are you sisters?"
Wang Sheng's eyes widened.
"Of course we're sisters. Otherwise, how could it be possible? Come on, take me inside; I'm going to meet with the children."
Since they were relatives, Wang Sheng didn't seem to have a reason to refuse.
After all, she was the children's aunt.
Especially after seeing the children, he felt that they were not at all strangers to her.
```
However, Wang Sheng could distinctly feel a trace of evasion in the child's eyes.
Forget it, no use worrying about that now; it was getting late, and if he didn't start cooking, the child would really go hungry.
Wang Sheng turned and walked into the kitchen.
And the moment the kitchen door closed, Han Xuemei's face revealed a sinister smile.
The old man always acted quickly and decisively.
He mobilized all his people that morning and conducted a thorough search throughout the company.
Soon, he locked onto an important figure.
The old man was squatting with a few people at the bottom of the residential building in the neighborhood.
"Are you sure? He's already gone upstairs?"
"Yes, we're sure, he's already gone up, and if our guess is correct, he should have booked a flight and will be leaving here soon."
"Fleeing from guilt, I'd like to see how exactly he plans to leave."
"Old man, look, that's him."
Just then, one of his companions suddenly pointed to a thin man coming out of the building.
He was carrying a large suitcase, and when he got to the door, he kept looking around.
"Go, bring him here."
"Okay, old man."
No sooner had the words left his mouth than several people rushed down from the car.
The thin man realized something was wrong, but by then it was already too late.
Explore more stories at empire
Soon, they brought him before the old man.
"Who are you? What do you want?"
He struggled, clearly not understanding what was happening.
Yet, he had a vague feeling that it was related to something he had done before.
"Are you the company's security guard? Lift up your head for me to take a look."
Upon hearing a very old voice, he trembled and finally lifted his head.
With delicate eyebrows and clear eyes, he indeed looked the part of talent.
However, it was a pity that at such a young age, he had committed such a deed, which probably wouldn't bode well for the rest of his life.
"I'm asking you, who put the injection in Lin Yi's office?"
"What? Injection in the office? I, I don't know what you are talking about, and, I don't even know him in normal times."
"Stop feeding me these useless excuses. If I've brought you here, it's because I certainly have direct evidence. Now, take a look at this."
With that, the old man took out a segment of video and played it in front of him.
He clearly saw his own figure entering the range of the video recording.
"Impossible, this, this can't be."
He was puzzled; he had made sure all video surveillance was cut off when he entered, so why was there still footage of him?
"What's the matter, didn't see that coming? Let me tell you, the net of law is vast yet misses nothing—there's one camera that wasn't connected to the main line but to the emergency power, so it never got cut off. And it happened to capture your figure. Now, what do you think will happen if I submit this piece of evidence?"
"I, I was wrong, I was wrong, please, spare my dad. He didn't pay me much money; I, I'll cough up all the money."

chapters.title: Chapter 329 Wang Guixiang Is Dead
chapters.content:
"Alright, save those words for them. Let's go; it's time to see him."
As he spoke, the old man simply gestured forward, and shortly after, the car sped away.
An hour later, after a series of questions and with the crucial evidence chain broken, his status as a suspect seemed to be increasingly blurry.
In light of this situation, they had no choice but to arrange bail for Lin Yi temporarily.
Of course, Lin Yi would still have to cooperate with the ongoing investigation, so, in principle, he was not yet truly free.
Seeing the old man waiting for him outside, Lin Yi felt a warm current flowing through his heart at that moment.
"Thank you, old man. This time, without you, I'm afraid it would have been very difficult to clear my name."
"Heh, it's nothing, just lending a hand. Besides, don't worry. Leave the rest to the boss; he's made all the preparations."
While speaking, he glanced to the side.
The middle-aged man wearing glasses, so genteel in his appearance, really seemed quite different from the old man.
Lin Yi remembered feeling doubtful the first time he met him.
How could the old man, a character so commanding in the underworld, possibly have such a scholarly son?
"Lin Yi, rest assured about this case. I have a hundred percent confidence that I can clear your name. Next, we just need to gather some other evidence, so there's no need for you to worry. I'll contact you if there's anything."
"Alright, you've worked hard."
"No worries. Now, I need to hurry and handle some other procedures. You guys chat, I'll be right back."
After finishing his words, he turned again and re-entered the room.
"So, what are your plans?"
"Heh, I never imagined that a little security guard could have easily outsmarted me."
"That's why you must always be wary, especially of the people around you."
"Yes, I've learned my lesson from this blunder and also figured out what's really going on."
"Zhao Guangchen, what do you plan to do?"
"He's already gone abroad. Do you think I have any power to bring him back?"
"That's not for sure. I'm telling you, he's just waiting for the right opportunity. If it arises, maybe he'll come back very soon."
"What do you mean? What opportunity?"
Lin Yi seemed puzzled, his eyes wide as he asked the old man.
"He's always been hoping for your death, hasn't he? If you were convicted now, I believe there'd be no stumbling block in this city to hinder him."
"Old man, are you saying you want to release fake news?"
"Exactly, because only then could we entice him to show himself."
"And, if he doesn't come?"
"I've already investigated. He's definitely coming back. His family hasn't left here yet."
As the old man spoke, it seemed like there was a hidden meaning in his words.
"Old man, what do you mean? I'm telling you, you absolutely can't involve family in underworld matters, do you understand?"
Lin Yi had always been such a person.
He could handle whatever came his way, but he would never make life difficult for others.
After hearing this, the old man nodded satisfactorily, patting his shoulder gently.
"Good, young man, do you know why I'm willing to help you? It's because you have the same air about you that I had when I was young. Rest assured, I won't trouble their family, nor will I do anything."
"Old man, I want to manage this matter myself."
"Can you handle it on your own?"
"Don't worry. Dealing with Zhao Guangchen won't be so difficult."
"Alright then, I understand. If you need anything, contact me anytime."
"Okay, thank you, old man. Someday, I will surely come to express my gratitude."
"Heh, enough of that. If you really want to thank me, give me a break on those business deals, at least."
The old man, in the end, had still brought up business.
After all, his family had indeed faced difficulties in their dealings before the cooperation.
"Don't worry, anyone else might not get a pass, but for you, old man, it will always be green lights at my end."
"Eh, by the way, I heard Wang Sheng is with you?"
Just before leaving, the old man suddenly thought of his least promising young son.
"He's at my home now. Sorry about that, don't blame me. I'm trying to help you discipline your son."
"Fine, however you want to do it, it's your matter; it has nothing to do with me. If you can turn him around, I would be the one owing you gratitude. Remember, if he needs a beating, beat him; if he deserves scolding, scold him. We'll meet again someday."
Leaving behind a burst of hearty laughter, the old man turned and left.
At that moment, Lin Yi looked up at the sun in the sky.
The sunlight was just right, warm and comforting on his skin.
He let out a long sigh, cherishing the sense of freedom breaking through.
"Guixiang."
Suddenly, she came to his mind.
Without hesitation, Lin Yi made his way directly to the hospital.
"Boss, you're out?"
Hei Lang had been waiting at the hospital entrance.
He had already received the call on the way, and was surprised that Lin Yi had got out so quickly.
"We'll talk about my case later. What happened to Guixiang?"
"She suffered brain death this morning, and respiratory failure ensued. The doctors tried hard to resuscitate her for half the day, but in the end, she couldn't be saved."
"What a pity, such a pity. Where's the body now? In which room?"
"The body is still in the morgue, and they say they need to perform a forensic autopsy."
"Good, let them do the autopsy. There's definitely more to it than we think; it's not as simple as it appears."
"Boss, you're okay, right?"
"For the moment, I should be fine. But the investigation into the case isn't complete. And now, with Guixiang's sudden death, the nature of the case has naturally changed." Experience more content on empire

chapters.title: Chapter 330 Swear an Oath
chapters.content:
"Then, then it has nothing to do with us."
"Rest assured, if it's not my doing, ultimately, it won't involve me either. You've had a hard night, once you get back, make sure to catch up on some sleep."
"Big brother, I'm not tired yet, just let me know if there's anything else I need to do."
"For now, there's no need, and besides, Wang Guixiang's affairs still cannot be settled for the time being, right, what about the child?"
"Oh, the child, I've already delivered her to her parents' home."
"How are her parents holding up?"
"Extremely grieved, it's clear they can't accept this reality."
"Ah, there are few greater tragedies in this world than the elderly burying the young. I'm afraid no one could come to terms with it, it's only with time that the pain can gradually be washed away."
Lin Yi was indeed moved.
Moreover, he felt deep sympathy in his heart.
Just yesterday, a perfectly fine woman was still on the phone celebrating her new lease on life with me.
And in the blink of an eye, she'd gone to heaven.
Who could possibly come to terms with such a psychological shock?
Accompanied by Hei Lang, Lin Yi arrived at the morgue.
No matter what, it was only right to see this old friend off personally.
The moment the white sheet was lifted, Lin Yi truly felt as though his heart was breaking.
She lay there so peaceful, as if merely asleep.
Such a young child, now not only without a father, but even her mother, the one she relied on, was gone.
"Guixiang, remember this, I must avenge you. And I swear I won't stop until I catch Zhao Guangchen."
In front of Wang Guixiang's body, Lin Yi silently made a vow.
Wang Sheng had prepared all the meals and then brought them to the table.
"Alright, kids, you can all come down to eat now, Xue Mei, Xue Mei."
Just a moment ago, they were all clearly in the living room when I entered the kitchen.
But now, at this moment, how could they suddenly have disappeared?
He called out in the room for a while but there seemed to be no response at all.
Wang Sheng looked up, puzzled.
"What's going on, could they have gone out to play?"
He opened the window and looked out into the small square, but since it was mealtime, there were no children in sight.
Very strange indeed.
Muttering to himself, he then headed upstairs.
"Han Xuemei, Han Xuemei."
Calling her name, he walked straight into the children's bedroom.
There, Wang Sheng saw the two children lying asleep in bed.
But apart from these two children, where was the little girl? How had she disappeared?
"Wake up, wake up."
He hurried over and began shaking the children's bodies.
Finally, Da Bao and Er Bao opened their eyes.
They sat up in bed, rubbing their bleary eyes.
After a while, they yawned deeply.
"You two, where's your sister? Where did she go?"
"Where did my sister go?"
Da Bao was still groggy from sleep, seemingly unable to grasp what Wang Sheng was asking.
"Yes, I'm asking you, where's your sister? Weren't you all playing with your auntie?"
"Oh, I remember now, just now, auntie gave us some juice to drink, and then... then we fell asleep, and after that, I don't know what happened."
"What juice?"
Wang Sheng heard this and then turned back to look.
Indeed, there was a glass of juice on the table.
He quickly walked over and held it under his nose to take a sniff.
Of course, he couldn't smell anything.
If someone had indeed put a sedative or sleeping pills in there, it would likely be undetectable.
"Okay, you all just stay here and don't go anywhere; I'll be back shortly."
It was only at this moment that Wang Sheng realized the matter was probably quite troublesome.
It was clear that the girl must have been taken away by Han Xuemei.
Damn it, he had actually overlooked this detail.
If Han Xuemei hated Lin Yi so much, then his children might be implicated as well.
If Lin Yi really came back, how would he explain everything?
Wang Sheng, frantic, prepared to go out and search.
As he walked, he repeatedly tried to call Han Xuemei directly.
As one would expect, how could Han Xuemei possibly answer at a time like this?
After the phone rang for a while, she simply hung up.
And when he called again, he was greeted with the sound of the phone being turned off.
"Wang Sheng, what are you doing?"
He had just reached the doorway when he almost bumped into Lin Yi's arms.
"Oh, no, nothing, I've just been to the market, buying groceries, my phone, my phone seems to be lost."
"What? Your phone is lost?"
"Yes, that's right, my phone is lost. The food, I've already cooked it, master, you should hurry up and eat, I'll be back in a moment."
Wang Sheng didn't want to spill the beans here.
Because he knew that once he did, he wouldn't be able to shirk responsibility.
All he could do now was to get away from here as quickly as possible, then find Er Bao's whereabouts as soon as he could; only then could he provide a final explanation to Lin Yi.
Wang Sheng today seemed indeed a bit oddly restless.
Just as he was about to leave, Lin Yi grabbed him and pulled him back.
"Master, what's wrong with you?"
He seemed somewhat panicked and uneasy.
After all, he had done something guilty.
Lin Yi patted him down and immediately took out the phone.
"Wasn't your phone lost? What's this?"
It was all over now.
It truly was a situation of 'speak of the devil and he shall appear.'
With the phone laying there, he seemed to have no ground for argument at this point.
Wang Sheng lowered his head, and Lin Yi could see it right away.
Clearly, he was trying to leave in a hurry and didn't dare meet Lin Yi's gaze.
"Tell me, what happened?"
"Goddamn it, I'm talking to you, didn't you hear?"
Hei Lang was not known for his good temper.
And he had never thought highly of Wang Sheng.
As he spoke, he stepped forward and grabbed Wang Sheng by the collar.
Wang Sheng's body struggled a bit.
But there was not a trace of fear in his eyes.
He glared at Hei Lang, looking him straight in the eye.
"What? What do you want to do? Want to have a go? If you're not convinced, let's have a fight."

chapters.title: Chapter 331 Little Treasure Is Gone
chapters.content:
"Alright, cut it out. Do you realize what time it is? Let him go now."
Hei Lang stuck out his tongue, then finally released him.
"What exactly happened?"
"Master, I'm so, so sorry."
"What's wrong? What's happened? Where's the child? What happened to the child?"
He immediately realized that this had to be related to the child.
Otherwise, Wang Sheng wouldn't be adopting this attitude.
"Xiao Bao, Xiao Bao, she's lost."
"What are you saying? Lost? How did she get lost? When did she get lost? Why did she get lost?"
"Blame me, it's all my fault. I, I trusted that woman too much. I never expected, she, she actually, she actually took Xiao Bao away."
"Woman? Which woman? Explain yourself."
Xiao Bao was lost, this was a serious problem.
Lin Yi's heart exploded with panic.
This was his most beloved little daughter, and he wouldn't let it go if anything happened to her.
"It was, it was Han Xuemei."
"What? Han Xuemei? How could she have come here?"
"It's all my fault, I was too gullible. I really thought she was just playing with the children, and after all, they're familiar with each other."
"When did this happen?"
"Probably, probably about twenty minutes ago."
"Hei Lang, hurry up. Organize all the manpower. Search for miles around, turn everything upside down if you have to, but find that woman."
"Okay, boss, I got it."
Hei Lang understood the seriousness of the situation and didn't linger at all, frantically getting up and leaving.
"And the other two children? Where are they now?"
"They're in the room. Moreover, that woman gave them some sedatives earlier, but thankfully, they've woken up now."
"So, she only took the third one away, right?"
"Yes, she only took away one daughter."
"This woman, what does she want to do?"
While speaking, Lin Yi took out his phone.
"Master, don't make the call. I estimate, she surely won't answer your calls. I've already tried a moment ago."
"Do you know if she has any place to stay around here?"
"That, I'm not really sure. I only met her at a bar before."
"I'm telling you, if anything at all happens to the child, Wang Sheng, I will make sure you regret it deeply."
"Yes, yes, Master, give me a chance. I'll go look for her right now, immediately."
"Fast, I'm telling you, if you can't find her, don't bother coming back to see me."
"Okay, okay, I got it."
He left scrambling and tumbling out of there.
Now that such a grave incident had occurred, he really didn't trust anyone else with the children anymore.
Lin Yi could only go back to the room for now to keep an eye on the other two children.
"Daddy, you're back. But we don't know where little sister has gone."
"Little sister, did she go out to play with your auntie?"
The two children were so innocent and naive.
They had no idea that their little sister was actually in grave danger.
Faced with their questions, Lin Yi actually had no way to answer them.
He felt somewhat guilty.
How could he have entrusted his child to such an unreliable person?
He looked back at the table, which was now full of cooked dishes.
"Haven't you two not eaten yet?"
"Um, we haven't, Daddy. Can we eat together?"
"I already ate when I came back from the office. You two be good and go eat your meal."
"But what about Sister? She hasn't eaten yet, and look, there are her favorite shrimp."
"Don't worry, Sister won't go hungry. Alright, go eat your food, be obedient."
"Oh, okay."
The two children were somewhat disappointed.
But in front of Lin Yi, they didn't show too much dissatisfaction.
Lin Yi's heart had already flown out.
If something really happened to the child, not only would he feel remorse, but he also would not be able to explain it to Han Xuewei.
Time ticked away, second by second.
He felt each day was like a year, unbearable to live through.
Every few minutes, he checked his phone.
He was afraid of missing any calls.
Finally, the phone rang; it was Hei Lang calling.
Compared to Wang Sheng, he certainly trusted Hei Lang's speed of action more.
"Hello, Hei Lang, how is it going?"
"Boss, I've almost searched everywhere nearby, but there's still no news of this woman."
"What? Still nothing? Where could she have gone? And with a child, the target is so obvious."
"Right now, I'm hacking into the surveillance network, trying to see if I can find any trace of this woman. Hey, don't move."
At that moment, Lin Yi clearly heard Hei Lang seem to say something.
"Hei Lang, what's wrong? Did you find something?"
"Boss, I... I saw her. She was in a small alley near the house, then she got into a black car."
"A black car? Is it a taxi?"
"No, from the looks of it, it should be a ride-hailing car."
"A ride-hailing car? Then, what about the license plate number?"
"License plate number? Boss, the angle of this camera doesn't capture the license plate at all. Don't worry, let me check the other surveillance. Here, I'll switch over."
Hei Lang continued searching while the call remained connected.
Lin Yi needed to stay constantly aware of the situation on their end.
"Boss, if she goes further in that direction, she'll enter the surveillance blind spot."
"What did you say? A surveillance blind spot?"
"That's right, we only know that she must have headed southeast, but whether it's east or south, that's not clear."
"Don't give up searching. Keep going, and even if it's like looking for a needle in a haystack, you must sort it out. Understand?"
"Ok, Boss, I got it, don't worry."
After finishing, Hei Lang hung up the phone in a hurry.
Lin Yi heaved a long sigh.
"Lin Yi."
Suddenly, a voice came from mid-air.
He looked up; it must have been the in-house surveillance.
It must be Han Xuewei, who finished her class and had come online to check on the children at home.

chapters.title: Chapter 332 Hidden Place
chapters.content:
```
As a result, he only saw Lin Yi and the two children, but there was absolutely no sign of Xiao Bao.
"Ah, she went outside. What's wrong?"
Lin Yi's speech began to falter.
"What's going on? Why are the three of you at home? Where's Wang Sheng, and Xiao Bao? Where did they go?"
"Hey, isn't this it? Xiao Bao was being fussy during her meal, so I asked Wang Sheng to take her out for a walk. Don't worry, she did eat a bit, even though it wasn't much."
"Being fussy during meals? That doesn't sound right. Xiao Bao never fusses when eating."
"I don't know what's up today. Maybe something about the food Wang Sheng made didn't agree with her. It's okay, they'll be back soon. Kids are like that. They fuss a bit and then they're fine."
Han Xuewei didn't say anything.
Ever since her class, she'd been feeling restless.
She had thought that perhaps something had happened on Lin Yi's end.
But when she saw Lin Yi on the surveillance camera, she realized that something must have happened to her own child.
"Da Bao, tell Mommy, where's your sister?"
"Sister, she went out with Auntie."
"What auntie?"
She was even more confused.
Aside from herself and Xiao Bao, there was, in fact, no third woman in the house.
Lin Yi was getting anxious.
He should have taken the two children straight to his room. That way, they wouldn't have had the chance to answer.
"Lin Yi, tell me, what exactly happened?"
"Alright, Xue Mei, I won't lie to you. Your child was taken away by someone."
"What did you say? Han Xuemei, how did she come to our house?"
"That, I'm not sure about. This was also my mistake. She took advantage of Wang Sheng and then she got into the house, and afterwards, she took the child away. But, don't worry, I've already arranged for people to go looking."
"Wait for me, I'll be right back."
"Xue Mei, Xue Mei."
He hadn't even finished speaking when the monitor suddenly seemed to have been cut off.
Some things, even if you try to hide them, are probably impossible to keep secret.
After half an hour, he hurried back home.
"How is it? Did you find anything?"
Upon arriving, Han Xuewei was still breathless.
You could say she ran all the way, sprinting into the house when she reached the entrance.
"Currently, there's still no news. Hei Lang has already arranged for people to search there. However, I feel like Xuemei probably wouldn't hurt the child."
"Yes, I also know she wouldn't hurt the child, but I'm afraid if she takes the child and leaves the city, then where should we go looking for them?"
As Han Xuewei spoke, she couldn't hold back her tears and they started to fall.
"I'm sorry, it's my fault. I... I didn't take good care of the child. I'm sorry, it's all my fault, all my fault."
```
"Alright, talking about this now is meaningless, oh, I just remembered something."
It was as if Han Xuewei suddenly thought of something at that moment.
"What, you remembered something?"
"I recall, on the outskirts of town, Han Xuemei has a farmhouse, and moreover, she rented a house there specifically when she was at odds with our parents. It seems, she even signed a ten-year contract on the spot."
"You mean to say, she might take the children and hide there? But then, who knows about that place?"
"Ordinarily, only she would know, but I inadvertently found a contract in her backpack, that's how I came to know the location."
"Then what are we waiting for, let's move, we're pressed for time!"
With those words, he prepared to take Han Xuewei away from there.
But at that moment, Lin Yi remembered there were still two children at home.
It would be terrible if one child was found but something happened to the other child here.
However, at this critical time, he couldn't possibly run back and forth here with the children.
"No way, the children must be sent back, this time to my dad's company."
Lin Yi made up his mind.
During this period, dad's company had been launching a major project, so he hadn't disturbed him.
But at present, the most convenient and fastest way was to send them to dad's company and have him arrange things properly.
"If you send the two children over now, won't dad worry?"
"When the time comes, I will explain it to him. Besides, the route to that farmhouse passes by dad's company. Da Bao, Xiao Bao, come, let's go out together."
"Dad, mom, where are we going? Are we going out to play again, or are we going to find sister?"
"You two will go to the company first and let grandpa play with you, but remember, absolutely do not tell grandpa too much, got it?"
"Dad, why? And sister went out to play with the auntie, why can't we tell grandpa?"
"Da Bao, Xiao Bao, you've grown up now. If you ever want to play with your sister again, then I must keep this secret, understand?"
The children may be naive, but they understood one principle.
The three siblings must not be separated.
"Lin Yi, what's the hurry, bringing the kids to my company? Why didn't you take them home? Your mom is at home."
Lin Yi's father had rushed out of the conference room after receiving the call.
"Dad, I can't explain in just a few words, something's up with the third one, so Xuewei and I need to hurry over to handle it. We can't take the two kids with us."
"What, what happened to Xiao Bao? Is something wrong?"
"Nothing serious, just some issues with the kindergarten admission. There are some problems now, never mind, I'll come to pick them up in the evening."
"Lin Yi, what on earth happened? If there's a problem, you've got to tell me."
"It's really nothing, dad, truly. Alright, alright, both of you behave and listen to grandpa, okay? We've got to go."
Lin Yi truly couldn't wait a moment longer.
Once in the car and the door was shut, the vehicle sped away.
Watching the receding figures, Lin Yi's father sighed helplessly.
"Da Bao, Xiao Bao, did you tell grandpa where your sister went?"

chapters.title: Chapter 333 Confirming the Location
chapters.content:
"Grandfather, my sister doesn't know either; Dad said he didn't know where he went."
"Really?"
"Really, Grandfather, Grandfather, is this, this your company?"
Children are really smart.
He racked his brains to steer away from the subject.
But the grandfather was still somewhat uneasy.
He picked up the phone and then dialed a number.
"Hello, it's me. Yes, Lin Yi's car is now heading southeast. You need to arrange for someone to follow them quickly. Remember not to alert him. If we really need help, you guys must come to assist. I understand.
Okay, let's go upstairs then Grandfather will take you to a big playroom inside the company, and we'll have a good time, how's that?"
"Oh, yes, yes, Grandfather, we want to go play, we want to go play."
Lin Yi made all the arrangements and took his two grandsons straight back into the company.
"Hurry up, hurry up."
On the way, Han Xuewei kept urging him.
He really wished that car could turn into a rocket and just fly straight there this instant.
"Don't worry, we'll be there soon. After this intersection, then another crossing, we should be at that place."
"I really don't know how the child is now, and whether she has had anything to eat or not."
"Don't worry, they knew Xue Mei before, and besides, Xue Mei is targeting me now; she definitely shouldn't hurt the children."
Lin Yi was helpless and could only keep comforting her.
After arriving, the two of them parked the car from a distance.
When they reached the door, they took a look.
The door lock was actually open.
Explore more adventures at empire
Clearly, someone had already been here and locked the door from the inside.
"You wait here; I'll check around and see if there's a chance to climb over the wall from here."
"I'm telling you, don't alert her, and also, Xue Mei has very extreme ideas. If she hurts the children, it would be a real trouble."
"But if I don't go in, I can't be sure of everything."
"Don't worry, I know what I'm doing."
With those words, she looked around carefully.
Then, Han Xuewei walked over to a large tree.
She reached out and plucked a few leaves from the tree.
In her hands, these leaves quickly took on a peculiar shape after a few casual movements.
"What is this?"
"Never mind that for now, just wait over there."
Saying this, she put the object in her mouth.
Unexpectedly, a strange melody began to drift from the leaves.
Afterward, Han Xuewei swiftly tucked the leaves into her pocket.
"Listen carefully, see if there's any noise inside."
Even though Lin Yi didn't know what her actions meant,
he could guess it was a way to find out certain things.
He pressed his ear against the crack of the door.
Sure enough, he heard the sound of a little girl crying from inside.
Although the sound was faint due to the distance, it was still audible.
"I heard the child crying, could it really be Xiao Bao?"
"Yes, it's Xiao Bao's voice, it used to be the sound she feared the most. Whenever she heard it, she would cry incessantly."
"Then, now that we're sure Xiao Bao is here, what are we waiting for? Shouldn't we just go in?"
"No, you can't go in now."
"Why not? Why can't we go in?"
"Although I've never been to this courtyard before, houses like these in the suburbs usually have secret passages or basements. I'm afraid if we barge in rashly, finding her later will become even more troublesome."
"I understand what you mean, you wait here."
With that, he walked to the side and took out his cellphone.
Now that they had confirmed the exact location, it was time to see who could bring more people.
A short while later, Lin Yi came over.
"Okay, I've called Hei Lang, and they should be able to surround this place in 10 minutes. Then there won't be any unexpected incidents."
"If that's the case, then there couldn't be a better outcome."
"Don't worry, Xue Mei, rest assured, there definitely won't be a problem. Just now, we could still hear the child's noise, right?"
"I know."
Han Xuewei just nodded vigorously.
But in reality, the fear in her heart had never truly dissipated.
Approximately 10 minutes later, Hei Lang arrived with a large group of men.
In fact, Lin Yi didn't recognize many of the people there.
"Big Brother, I've called everyone over. Is it this courtyard?"
"That's right, it's this courtyard. I don't know if there are any other exits inside, but you need to encircle every area tightly now, and remember, not even a fly should get through."
"Alright, Big Brother, don't worry."
Having said that, Hei Lang walked over and began giving out orders.
Soon, the entire courtyard was completely surrounded by their forces.
Seeing all this, Lin Yi's heart gradually calmed down.
If that's the case, catching Han Xuemei shouldn't be too difficult.
He turned to look at Han Xuewei standing beside him.
He noticed that her complexion was still somewhat pale.
Clearly, she had not snapped out of the shock from earlier.
"Xue Mei, are you okay? Otherwise, let me go instead. After I bring the child over, you take her straight home. I'll handle the situation here."
"What... what do you plan to do?"
Han Xuewei seemed somewhat anxious,
After all, no matter how outrageous Han Xuemei's actions were, she was still a relative. She didn't want to watch her tumble into doom with her own eyes.
"I'm not planning to do much. As long as she releases the child without fuss, I certainly won't make things hard for her. But she needs to be taught a lesson, nonetheless."
"It's okay, I'll go with you. Besides, it'll be easier to talk with me there."

chapters.title: Chapter 334 Threat of Kidnapping
chapters.content:
Lin Yi did not object, he simply nodded, indicating his tacit agreement to the matter.
Hei Lang followed behind the two of them and then went straight to the front gate.
"Han Xuemei, Han Xuemei."
Lin Yi didn't even knock on the door, instead, he shouted loudly toward the courtyard.
At that moment, inside the room, it was indeed Han Xuemei with Xiao Bao and the two of them.
And just before, she had been tirelessly negotiating.
Her goal was to leave the city with the child as soon as possible.
She was very aware of Lin Yi's powerful capabilities within the city.
If she couldn't leave by any chance, then they would soon find out where she was.
Upon hearing the voice outside, she became panicked.
"Daddy, it's Daddy's voice."
Xiao Bao was very clever and recognized the voice immediately.
"Daddy, Daddy."
She screamed at the top of her lungs, then shouted loudly toward the outside.
"Shut your mouth."
Han Xuemei, truly irritated, then grabbed her and covered her mouth with her hand.
Xiao Bao struggled desperately here.
Slap, slap.
Han Xuemei reached out and smacked her bottom hard twice.
At this, Xiao Bao burst into tears with a wail.
The crying quickly reached Lin Yi's ears.
No, she couldn't wait any longer, if she continued to wait, she feared she wouldn't be able to save her own life.
"That's enough, open the door."
Stay tuned to empire
Lin Yi took two steps back and then turned to look at Hei Lang and said.
"Okay, big brother, leave it to me."
For Hei Lang, this was a piece of cake.
He stepped forward, then kicked the door open with one strong kick.
Several people rushed into the courtyard in a panic.
And just then, Han Xuemei had already walked out from the room.
In her hand, she held a knife, and it was pressed against Xiao Bao's neck.
"Xue Mei, Xue Mei, please don't do anything rash."
After witnessing this scene, Han Xuewei became incredibly agitated.
"Mommy, Mommy, save me."
Xiao Bao continued to struggle, completely unaware of what was happening.
"Xiao Bao, be good, don't move, don't move at all, understand?"
Lin Yi did his best to soothe Xiao Bao's emotions here.
He was also worried that if the child kept on like this, it might exacerbate Han Xuemei's current mood.
And if Han Xuemei decided to do something rash under these circumstances, Xiao Bao would really be in trouble then.
"Xue Mei, if you have a problem, come at me. She's just a child, and besides, she used to call you 'Auntie' so affectionately."
"Heh, what's the matter, realizing the value of kinship now? When you were pressuring me back then, why didn't you think of that?"
"Xue Mei, I never intended to drive you to your death, and everything I did before was under the instruction of your parents. So, I haven't really done anything."
"Haven't done anything? I'm already reduced to this state. I'm crying out for help, but heaven doesn't hear, and earth doesn't respond. Do you think there's still a need for me to keep living?"
"Xue Mei, let's talk about this. And we can start all over. What do you want? Money? I can give you money. How much do you want?
I can give it to you right now."
As he spoke, he gestured towards Hei Lang.
Hei Lang quickly took out a checkbook he carried with him and placed it in Lin Yi's hands.
"Money? Do you really think that some things, once lost, can still be bought back with money?"
"I know that, but isn't that what you're lacking right now? Besides, with this money, you can leave this place and start a new life. From now on, we'll go our separate ways and have nothing to do with each other."
"Fine, if that's the case, then give me 50 million."
At this, Lin Yi's hands suddenly stopped moving.
50 million, this girl really asks for the moon.
"Fine, 50 million it is. I'll give it to you."
Lin Yi just nodded his head and then took out the checkbook, casually signing his name before writing down the amount.
"See? I've written the check already. Can you put the child down now?"
"Heh, Lin Yi, do you really think I'm stupid? The moment I put the child down, you'll snatch the check from me. Do you think I would do that?"
"What else do you want? You just want the money, right? I've given you the money now, can't you let the child go? Don't worry, I guarantee I won't touch a penny of it."
"Your guarantee? Your guarantee is worth shit. I'm telling you, get me a car right now."
"Do you realize? What you're doing is kidnapping, coercion, it's illegal."
"Illegal? In my current situation, do you think whether it's illegal or not still matters to me?"
"Alright, don't be rash. You want a car? Fine, go, prepare a car and bring it to the door."
"Big Brother."
Hei Lang merely lifted his head to look at him.
In truth, from Hei Lang's perspective, they could just forcefully snatch the child out of her hands.
But the knife was dangerously close to the baby's neck.
He was also worried that in the struggle, they might harm the child, and that would be a disaster.
"Go, bring the car over. Do you understand?"
"Okay, I got it. I'll go right now."
After saying this, Hei Lang hurriedly left the courtyard.
"Xue Mei, why must you do this?"
Han Xuewei crouched down suddenly and then, with a broken heart, she uttered these words before bursting into loud sobs.
"Xue Mei, honestly, I don't want this either. If it wasn't for your husband forcing me, I wouldn't have come to this. Rest assured, as long as I can leave here safely, I will definitely ensure the child's safety and bring him back to you unharmed."
"Xue Mei, how about I become your hostage? You put the child down, and I'll go with you. I'll make sure you're safe, and then I'll come back."
"No way, I can't trust anyone right now. The only thing I trust is the little girl in my hands."
"Big Brother, the car is here."
Very quickly, Hei Lang came back.
Afterward, he placed the car keys in Lin Yi's hands.
"See? The car keys are right here."
"Everyone, step back."
"Alright, alright, we are stepping back, everyone step back. Be careful, please be very careful."

chapters.title: Chapter 335 Saving Little Treasure
chapters.content:
They spoke while simultaneously retreating backward.
"I'm telling you, don't play any tricks."
Just then, Han Xuemei seemed to suddenly think of something, and quickly turned her head to look behind her and at the roof.
The people brought by Hei Lang had now nearly completely surrounded the place.
If there were any abnormal movements, they would probably swarm in at once.
"Everyone up there, listen well, without my command, no one is allowed to make a rash move, got it?"
Lin Yi shouted loudly from above.
Han Xuewei held the child tightly in one arm and had the other arm firmly around her neck.
They made it to the doorway.
The car was parked right there.
Han Xuemei's plan was simple, once she was in the car, she would push the child out and then speed away from this place.
But then she thought better of it, realizing that it wouldn't work.
If they chased after her in a car, in the end, it would still result in the same outcome.
It seemed the only option was to safely get herself to a certain place and then find a way to send the child back.
"Is it okay now? Can I let her go now?"
Lin Yi, throughout, did not dare leave the area, always maintaining a safe distance from her, and moreover, he did not want to aggravate her emotions at this time.
"Ah!"
At that moment, she suddenly let out a scream.
Immediately after, they saw a distinctly visible pebble fall to the ground.
Following that, the knife in her hand and the child were both thrown to the ground.
Seeing the opportunity, Hei Lang hurriedly rushed forward and firmly seized control of the woman.
"Xiaobao, Xiaobao, are you alright?"
Han Xuemei was the first to rush over, then tightly embraced the child in her arms as if terrified something else might go wrong.
Lin Yi simply looked up and around.
It was clear that someone had deliberately shot at her with a slingshot.
If that was the case, there would probably be no one else but that person involved.
"Big brother, what's happening here?"
"I reckon my dad's men must be nearby. Anyway, the child is safe now. You need to arrange for someone to escort your sister-in-law and the child back home. Make sure to escort them personally, understood?"
"Alright, I understand, you come here."
Hei Lang then called over one of his men.
Next, they arranged for another car to take the mother and daughter away from the scene quickly.
"Heh, you're quite something, I didn't expect there'd be someone helping you in the shadows. Fine, today is just my bad luck, do as you wish, I'll leave it to you."
"What I wish to do? Han Xuemei, do you really think I can do anything to you?"
As she spoke, she suddenly bent down and pulled Han Xuewei up from the ground.
Then, Lin Yi struck her face hard with several backhand slaps.
"Remember, I'm returning everything to you today. From now on, we're even. If you dare to trouble my family again, rest assured, I won't let you off easily. Let's go."
"Big Brother."
Hei Lang had not had enough of the fight, initially thinking that since they had captured everyone, there ought to be some punishment. He did not expect it to be resolved so quickly.
"No need to say anything else, get in the car, we're going back."
"Sure, I understand. Friends, get on the bus."
At his command, everyone left the place in a hurry.
Han Xuemei was left alone, disheveled in the wind.
He quietly took a few steps back, then collapsed onto the doorstep.
Han Xuemei took out her phone, and then, turned it back on.
Soon, a phone call came through,
The caller was none other than Wang Sheng.
Wang Sheng had not given up during this ordeal, tirelessly dialing the number over and over.
"Han Xuemei, where are you now? And the child? Is the child with you?"
"The child has already been taken away by them."
Upon hearing this, Wang Sheng finally let out a long sigh of relief.
His heart felt as though it had been in his throat just moments before.
He was genuinely concerned that something unexpected might happen, and if it did, he feared that even jumping into the Yellow River would not wash away the accusation.
"Han Xuemei, oh Han Xuemei, why did you have to be so impulsive?"
"If I weren't impulsive, what else do you think I could do? I'm in a desperate situation and have nothing left."
"What do you mean, 'nothing left'? Haven't I told you? You can follow me. As long as you agree, I will definitely help you get your revenge."
"What do you mean? You've already become her disciple, and yet, you're still thinking about revenge? Stop deceiving me."
"Do you really think that I am willingly staying by her side? I'm telling you, only by knowing the enemy and yourself can you win every battle."
"What, do you want to be an 'undercover brother' or something?"
"Exactly, that's what I mean. As long as I get some key things, and secure the interests of our Wang Family, I will definitely bite back."
"Are you sure?"
Upon saying this, Han Xuemei seemed to suddenly discover a new world.
She widened her eyes, then repeatedly asked.
The word "revenge" was deeply rooted in Han Xuemei's heart, absolutely indissoluble. Discover hidden content at empire
"Yes, I can do it on the condition that you follow me. I will definitely help you with this."
"Fine, I agree. But remember, Wang Sheng, as a man, you must keep your word."
"Don't worry, I will definitely keep my word. Where are you now? I'll come to find you."
"I'll send you my location on the phone in a moment. Remember, come alone, do not bring anyone else, do you understand?"
"Don't worry, I know what to do."
After that conversation, Wang Sheng hung up the phone and quickly received an address on his mobile.
He merely smiled slightly, then got up and left the place.
Finally, it was a family reunion for Lin Yi.
"Right, remember during this time, you must arrange for more people, especially around the villa. No matter where your sister-in-law and the children go, there must be someone closely following them, got it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 336 Continue Cooperation
chapters.content:
"Don't worry, big brother, I've already made arrangements, and absolutely nothing will happen to sister-in-law again,"
"Alright, let's leave it at that for now. You go ahead and tend to your things, we have some issues to discuss."
After finishing his sentence, Lin Yi waved to him, then quickly dashed away from the villa.
"Da Bao, Er Bao, Xiao Bao, the three of you now go upstairs and have a good sleep. After you wake up, you can play again. Mom and Dad have some important things to discuss, understand?"
"Okay, we understand."
Da Bao and Er Bao had just played very happily at Grandpa's company.
It seemed they had already forgotten about their sister's disappearance.
That's how children are, after all; in the blink of an eye, they might leave these important matters behind their minds.
After dinner, the three children held hands and went to their room on the second floor.
In fact, Han Xuewei knew what he wanted to say without Lin Yi having to speak.
"I've already told the school, I can't go for the next few days; otherwise, I definitely won't have peace of mind."
"What do you have to be unsettled about? I've told you before, today was an accident. If you're really not at ease, then no, I still should send the children to my parents' place."
"I think that's the only way. Didn't you say classes are resuming next week? Now, having Wang Sheng look after them for these days is really unreliable. Right, where's Wang Sheng?"
At that moment, Han Xuewei also suddenly recalled that she hadn't seen him since they got home.
"I don't know, and I don't know where he's gone to. Forget about him; right now we can't manage that much. Also, there's another thing - Wang Guixiang is dead, did you know?"
"What, what did you say? Dead? What happened?"
Han Xuewei was genuinely stunned upon hearing this.
She had never imagined that such a woman would disappear from this world so quickly.
"It must have been Zhao Guangchen, he did something to her before he left that injured her central nervous system. So, she passed away early this morning. Now, what should we do next? And where has Zhao Guangchen gone?"
"He must have already run away by now, but don't worry, I must take revenge on her behalf."
Your next on empire
"What do you plan to do?"
"You don't need to worry about that. Right now, you should focus on your studies. Finish it off as soon as possible, then we can make other arrangements."
"Okay, I understand. But no matter what you decide to do, make sure you stay safe, got it?"
"Don't worry, I know what I'm doing. Now, I need to take care of some business at the company. Just stay at home. I've arranged for Hei Lang to add more men outside; be assured, there won't be any safety issues."
"Right, Xue Mei, what do you plan to do about her?"
"Just let her fend for herself. Now, I have completely lost faith in her, and besides, she can't stir up any major trouble anymore. Just leave her to her own devices."
Han Xuewei naturally found this to be the best outcome.
After all, she is family, so at such a time, if she were to be utterly destroyed, it would feel like there would be no way to explain things to her uncle.
The first thing Lin Yi did when he returned to the company was to make arrangements for the factory.
Zhou Kongshan's eyes widened over the phone; he felt that Lin Yi had changed considerably this time.
"What did you say, renew the contract with them? Didn't you say that our cooperation with the Wang Family was almost over just a while ago?"
"This time, it was Old Master Wang who saved me. Without him, I wouldn't have been able to get out so quickly. Just follow my arrangements, and supply them with the best products first."
"Alright, alright, since you have given the order, there will definitely be no issue. By the way, the formula you asked me to find last time, have you obtained it yet?"
"There should be no problems. At the earliest, tomorrow, I can have it in your hands. Then, we can start mass production. No, don't start mass production."
"Heh, I understand your plan, you're aiming for a scarcity marketing strategy, right? Don't worry, I have control over it, and after production, I'll store it in the warehouse, well hidden from sight."
"Good, just go ahead with the arrangements, then. As soon as the products are shipped out, send a few boxes my way. I want to see the market response and their feedback first."
"Rest assured, I know what to do. I'll be waiting for your formula."
"Alright, let's end it here."
After that, he hung up the phone.
Since he had promised the Old Master, he had to deliver on it.
The least of his concerns now was settling his lawsuit.
If that matter couldn't be resolved, it would likely always weigh on his mind.
However, it has to be said that Wang Sheng's efficiency was quite commendable.
He had been running about, using the Old Master's connections, and now had gathered ample evidence, all of it pointing towards Zhao Guangchen.
As a result, within two days, the suspicions on Lin Yi were entirely cleared.
The case had now moved on to the next stage. They must wait for Zhao Guangchen to show up; only then could they bring him to justice.
After being busy for a couple of days, Lin Yi felt that he could finally take a breather for a while.
Finding some time, he went to the Wang Family.
Over these days, he hadn't seen Wang Sheng.
Unaware of where the man had gone, he thought it was an excellent opportunity to see what he was up to after getting to the Wang Family.
"President Lin, please come in; the Old Master has been waiting for you in his room,"
After arriving at the Wang Family's residence, a servant was there waiting, presumably the Old Master had made prior arrangements.
Familiar with the way, he went directly to the study on the second floor.
Every time he came here, it seemed their meeting place was always in the study, the only way to ensure the privacy of their conversation.
"Lin Yi, you're truly a man of your word. We have already received the order. This time, I must thank you for saving us from a disaster."
"It is what I should do. Moreover, after this cooperation, I have realized that our partnership is indeed very necessary."

chapters.title: Chapter 337 Disguised
chapters.content:
"Yes, I mentioned it to you before, but you seemed to have looked down on our Wang Family." Lin Yi said.
"Not at all, Master, I really didn't mean it that way. You know that there is a problem with the efficiency at the factory site, and moreover, with such bulk purchasing, I simply can't produce enough. Also, if the market becomes too saturated, the value of this medicine will drop to nothing. Do you understand?" Xue Mei responded.
"Starvation marketing, right? I have been tired of that trick for years. But I think there's no need for that. It feels like a necessity of life, and so the demand should be continuous." the old master replied.
"Regarding this matter, I will negotiate thoroughly with the factory. If increased production capacity is needed, the family head should provide it." Lin Yi assured.
"Right, you've made so much money in the blink of an eye. Investing some of it in the factory is necessary, don't you think?" the old master urged.
"Hmm, I will consider that issue. By the way, Master, I am here for the lawsuit, and I deeply thank you for your help. Also, there is another matter, where is Wang Sheng? I haven't seen him around these past few days." Lin Yi inquired.
"Wang Sheng? Wasn't he with you?" the old master asked.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi slightly furrowed his brows.
He hadn't seen Wang Sheng in days, and he thought he might have been sticking close to Lin Yi.
But unexpectedly, even the old master hadn't seen him, indicating clearly that Wang Sheng had once again disappeared without a trace.
"He left at noon that day and hasn't come back since. I have no idea where he went. I thought he had already returned to the Wang Family." Xue Mei said.
"No, he hasn't come back at all. This damn guy, who knows what he's gotten into now. Don't worry, I will find him as soon as possible." the old master promised.
"There's no rush. Moreover, I feel that he hasn't truly settled down. So Master, you really need to re-educate him in this regard." Xue Mei suggested.
"Sigh, he's my most disappointing son, and it seems he's the only one among my three sons who doesn't give me any peace of mind. Rest assured, I know what to do. I'm sorry for troubling you." the old master apologized.
"Not at all, these matters are also my responsibility. By the way, is there any news on Zhao Guangchen's side?" Lin Yi asked.
"I've already spread the word far and wide, and we have pretty much confirmed that you are the suspect. I believe he should receive the news very soon."
Your next chapter awaits on empire
"What about his family? Are they being watched?"
"We've had people on watch all this time, but since he left, there's been no contact with his family, and he's a very cautious individual."
"Will that guy come back at all?" Lin Yi questioned, his brow unintentionally furrowing.
He was probably more aware of Zhao Guangchen's predicament than anyone else.
If something extra happened at this time, he wouldn't be able to save him.
"I will keep a close eye on this issue. Moreover..." the old master began to say but was interrupted when his phone suddenly rang.
He looked at the caller and then signaled Lin Yi with his hand before answering the call.
"What's the news?" Lin Yi pressed.
"Sorry, we've found out that Wang Sheng got off a plane just now, but after he deplaned, he disappeared."
"What do you mean, disappeared? What happened, weren't we watching him closely?" Lin Yi asked, clearly agitated.
"Yes, we've been monitoring the area, but after he entered the restroom, he never came out. Our people went in afterward and found he had vanished."
"Damn it, he escaped." the old master cursed.
"Master, what should we do now?" Lin Yi inquired.
"Continue searching, we must find him," the old master commanded.
"Understood, I'm on it." Lin Yi acknowledged.
After hanging up, the call ended.
Lin Yi listened to everything clearly.
Zhao Guangchen had now returned.
At this critical moment, he had unexpectedly come back. It was unclear what he intended to do now.
"Did you hear that?" the old master asked.
"I heard it," Lin Yi confirmed.
"The man is back, but I sense that he could be very dangerous, so you must be careful."
"I know, I'm not worried about my safety, and I've already made arrangements for my family. It's just that I don't know when we can bring him back. In such a big city, finding one person can be incredibly difficult." Lin Yi sighed deeply.
Hiding, after all, seemed quite feasible in myriad places.
"No worries, I'll deploy a lot of manpower and find him as quickly as possible. Rest assured, it's not just us looking for him; the relevant departments are too, given he's a murder suspect."
"Right, I assume he can't keep hiding for long. Alright, Master, I have some matters to attend to at the company, I have to leave now." Lin Yi said.
"Okay, I won't see you out. I'll contact you if there's any news." the old master replied.
Lin Yi nodded and then left the Wang Family directly.
To say he wasn't worried was impossible.
He was more concerned than anyone.
As for his children and Han Xuewei, he wasn't so worried.
After all, with so many people guarding them, it was unlikely they would run into trouble.
But he was unclear about what Zhao Guangchen was planning with each move he made.
Da Hua Mall.
At that moment, Wang Sheng, following Han Xuemei, was entering and leaving the mall as a couple, which they'd been doing now for several days.
In a coffee shop, she anxiously waited until finally, she saw Wang Sheng approaching from a distance.
"So, is it confirmed?" she asked.
"Relax, it's confirmed. It's definitely him," Wang Sheng assured.
"He's got guts, coming back at this time. Doesn't he know that everyone's looking for him?" Han Xuemei wondered aloud.
"Exactly, which is why he's the key figure in this affair. If they get their hands on him, then our end would be sealed." Wang Sheng mentioned.
"What should we do? Should we make a move to help him out first?" Han Xuemei suggested.
"That's what I was thinking. Come on, I've already figured out where he is; let's move quickly." Wang Sheng said.
"Alright, let's go now," Han Xuemei said, finishing her coffee in one gulp, and then the two of them took the elevator out of the coffee shop.

chapters.title: Chapter 338 I Want Your Technology
chapters.content:
```
Wang Sheng, with Han Xuemei, wound their way through the mall until they finally stopped in a basement level 2 parking garage.
"What's up? Is he here?"
"Based on the timing, he should be about here by now, he should be arriving soon. Do you think that's him?"
Just then, he suddenly spotted someone wearing a baseball cap and carrying a large backpack.
The figure descended from an emergency exit.
At a glance, this was someone suspicious.
Under normal circumstances, people would take the elevator, but this person had circumvented it, clearly to avoid being seen by surveillance cameras.
"Him, how did he become like this? Is this still Zhao Guangchen?"
From a distance, Han Xuemei could see that this person seemed to have altered his appearance.
"He must have used some Disguise Technique, so even among a crowd, he might not be recognized easily."
"This guy is really smart, using the Disguise Technique, but unfortunately, I've seen through him. Yes, it must be him."
"Okay, I understand. Let's go now."
After speaking, Han Xuemei followed Wang Sheng toward the man.
As they were about to approach him, Zhao Guangchen paused for a moment.
Logically, he couldn't even recognize himself in the mirror, what did these two people want with him?
He just kept his head down, walking towards his car, hoping to slip by unnoticed.
"What are you doing?"
At that moment, he saw the two people suddenly block his path.
Just raising his head to look at them, their gazes quickly interlocked.
"Zhao Guangchen, quite a transformation, I bet even your mother wouldn't recognize you now?"
Han Xuemei said with a sneer.
"How did you know?"
"Never mind how I know. Cut the chatter and come with me. There are people searching for you everywhere outside. If you go out now, you'll be spotted in no time."
"How, how did you know that?"
"You don't need to worry about how I know. If you trust me, get into the trunk of our car now; that way, you won't draw attention."
He looked up, skepticism evident in his eyes.
Should he trust these two people?
Especially Han Xuemei, with whom he had been previously.
But now it was clear that Han Xuemei had turned to another man's arms.
He believed that this man must have some value for her to choose him.
At this point, he had no other choice.
The only thing he could, and had to do, was trust them.
Soon, the three of them drove away from there.
As they left, he noticed many people outside, looking around everywhere, even inspecting each car that passed by carefully.
After confirming there was no one, they let their car pass.
With him inside, the car headed straight to a farmhouse in the suburbs.
They had already searched this place before, so for the moment, it should be relatively safe.
"How is it? Not too bad right? It might not measure up to your previous residence, but it's a place you can settle down."
Experience tales at empire
Once inside, Han Xuemei looked at him and asked.
"What do you mean? Are you planning to hide me here?"
"Right now, this is the safest place, where no one would notice you. Plus, nobody would guess that I could hide you here."
"Hide? Why hide? I've heard the case is closed."
"'Closed,' my foot! Do you think everything you've heard is true? Those are false rumors. Let me tell you, his people are untouched, and now all evidence points towards you. Besides, I can tell you that Wang Guixiang is dead."
"What, what did you say? Dead?"
At this, he widened his eyes in shock.
He had no idea about Wang Guixiang's current situation.
He had thought she was still in the hospital and hadn't taken the time to find out more since he had arrived.
"Yes, dead. Now, you probably couldn't even dream that you've become a suspected murderer."
"Are you saying that all this is a trap they set up just to lure me back?"
"That's right, and you came back too quickly. Let me tell you, re-entering the country is an impossibility for you now, so you have no choice."
Han Xuemei pressed him, closing in with every word, cornering Zhao Guangchen.
He had no room to maneuver and seemed to have no choice but to follow the woman's arrangements.
"So what's your plan for hiding me, and what's your ultimate goal?"
"We want the technology in your hands. If we really want to defeat Lin Yi, we must seize that technology."
"Technology?"
At this, Zhao Guangchen slightly furrowed his brow in difficulty.
He hadn't brought anything with him before he left, except for money and the secret formula.
He was well aware of how crucial this formula was for his own importance.
If he ever wished to make a comeback, this thing was an essential part.
"Let me tell you, stop thinking about anything else. If you want to pull this off, you'll need that thing."
"Why should I trust you?"
"Because you're currently wanted for murder, and I can offer you a complete change of face. Do you believe me?"
Finally, Wang Sheng spoke.
Upon hearing this, Zhao Guangchen seemed somewhat disbelieving.
To completely change one's appearance – how could that be easy?
A simple disguise might be feasible, but to truly transform – he doubted the feasibility.
"What do you mean?"
"In the coming period, we will carry out a complete makeover on you, turning you into a character we need, a brand-new individual. From now on, Zhao Guangchen will cease to exist."
"You? Do you have the capability to do this?"
"I can't vouch for anything else, but I can assure you of this one thing. However, it requires your full cooperation."

chapters.title: Chapter 339 In-depth Research
chapters.content:
"Even if I undergo plastic surgery to change my appearance and then become someone with a new identity, what do you want to do next?"
"Next, I want you to establish a company. After that, we won't do anything else but focus on producing this elixir. Eventually, we will become Lin Yi's strongest competitors. We will gradually crush him and even achieve the goal of acquiring his company. That is our ultimate aim."
Over the past few days, Wang Sheng and Han Xuemei had actually thought through many things.
To truly defeat Lin Yi, relying solely on these underhanded tricks would be utterly ineffective.
After all, Lin Yi was a smart man. If he could be defeated by such means, then it would be far too simple.
Therefore, they had to tackle the root of the problem, which meant swallowing up his company. By then, Lin Yi would truly be deep in debt and completely penniless.
"The idea isn't bad, but do you really think it'll be that easy to execute?"
"As long as you cooperate, plus with your patent technology, I believe we can definitely succeed."
"What about funding? Where do you plan to get it from?"
"Don't worry about the funding. We will handle all the investments. You only need to bring your technology as a share. You will get your shares as well."
"This is getting more and more interesting. So does that mean I really have no other choice?"
"None. This is the only path you can take right now. Otherwise, you're free to leave at any time, but imprisonment is an inevitable consequence that you can't avoid."
At this point, Wang Sheng truly reminded Zhao Guangchen,
If he didn't cooperate with them, it seemed he could only spend his days behind bars.
Furthermore, he might not even need to stay in prison; he could very likely end up paying with his life.
In order to save his own life, he now had no choice but to trust them.
"Fine, no problem. As long as you get me out, I will cooperate with whatever you want to do next."
"Good, with your word, I'm content. I know how to arrange things. Just wait here patiently for the next couple of days, and soon, we will bring the doctor over."
After Wang Sheng finished speaking, he turned back and looked at Han Xuemei standing beside him.
"Remember, no tricks, and ultimately, you can't escape my Five Fingers Mountain."
After leaving these words, the two turned around and left the house.
After they left, Zhao Guangchen hurriedly walked to the front and then kept watch at that spot.
Finally, when he saw their car leave the area, he finally let out a long sigh of relief.
It seemed that they probably wouldn't betray him, after all, he still held a certain value to them.
He truly felt that the tables had turned over the years.
Previously, he could control Han Xue Mei; now, the roles had completely reversed.
There was no choice, under someone's roof one had to bow their head.
"That plastic surgery, the 'Disguise Technique,' is it really reliable?"
On the road, Han Xuemei simply raised her head and looked at Wang Sheng as she asked.
This 'Disguise Technique' was something she had only read about online before, even appearing in some novels.
But was it truly possible to achieve in real life?
"It shouldn't be a problem. I've been researching this for the past two years."
"What? What do you mean it 'shouldn't be a problem'? Weren't you confident about it already?"
"This technology is still under discussion. Moreover, we've never found a suitable test subject. This time, isn't this man the perfect test subject?"
As Wang Sheng spoke, he turned back and smiled meaningfully.
"You mean, he's going to be our first test subject?"
"Right, our very first test subject. If this project turns out to be a success, then we can strongly promote it. After all, not many people are willing to go abroad for plastic surgery."
"When you put it that way, you're actually quite incredible."
Maybe it was in this moment that Han Xuemei realized she had really found the right support this time.
Luckily, Wang Sheng didn't have a family, so there wouldn't be a repeat of what happened with Wang Guixiang last time.
Han Xuemei was sitting in the passenger seat, and from there, she could just turn her head and see Wang Sheng's profile.
In fact, if one looked closely, this man really was quite handsome.
Compared to Zhao Guangchen, maybe he didn't possess the same polished maturity.
But there certainly were shining qualities about Wang Sheng.
This was something Han Xuemei was very clear about.
"What's up? Am I mesmerizing you?"
Wang Sheng had noticed with his peripheral vision that Han Xuemei had been watching him.
"Heh, it's nothing. I just think you're quite fascinating. Who would have thought that there are still people researching the Disguise Technique?"
"Yes, by normal standards, it should be an ancient secret technique. Also, from a common person's point of view, these kinds of things don't exist anymore, right?"
"Right, in my opinion, they no longer exist and such plots can only be found in novels or television dramas."
"Let me tell you, the human body structure is truly worth studying. Until now, so many scientists still haven't completely figured it out, or else we wouldn't have so many incurable diseases and cancer patients."
"Yeah, up to now, that remains one of the greatest medical challenges in the world."
"That means, the composition of the human body is actually very complex. So, in this case, even if one can change their facial appearance, I think that's not inconceivable. The key is that you must continue to delve into it."
Experience new stories on empire
"Right, researching, only through research can one understand all of this. I want to ask, how long has your team been established?"
"It's been around two years since I started secretly researching in the shadows. Furthermore, I won't hide it from you; I've already made some progress. However, these changes have only been realized on animals so far."
"On animals?"
"Yes, I didn't have the right research subjects, and it's also impossible to test on humans lightly. So, it's always been done on animals, and now, it's pretty much without any issues."

chapters.title: Chapter 340 Speaking Without Keeping Your Word?
chapters.content:
"If it can be achieved in animals, then perhaps it can also be a breakthrough in humans, right?"
"Logically speaking, that should be the case, but actually, many experimental stages are only done on animals, and humans might have different reactions. This we cannot know."
"So, Zhao Guangchen's appearance this time has coincidentally aided your scientific research, is that how I should understand it?"
"Yes, if I can overcome this hurdle, then I can say I am invincible. If I solve problems that many in the world cannot, then what's a minor figure like Lin Yi to me?"
Indeed, looking at it now, it seems Wang Sheng no longer regards Lin Yi as a concern.
"By the way, you've been with me these past two days, busy with Zhao Guangchen's matter, so what about Lin Yi? Hasn't he contacted you?"
"Him? He wouldn't contact me proactively. Let me tell you, if I stay away from him, it's probably exactly what he wants."
"What about next? Will you go back to his side?"
"Of course. If I don't return to his side, how can I gather more information from him? By the way, you might have to suffer a little during this period."
"Me?"
Han Xuemei just stared with widened eyes, not understanding what this 'suffering' might entail.
Was she really going to have to endure hardship for some reason?
It's likely that Han Xuemei couldn't handle that kind of suffering at all.
"Don't be so nervous; what I mean is, you now have to hide yourself away and make sure no one knows of your whereabouts."
"Oh, that's what you mean. I think that Lin Yi shouldn't be paying much attention to me for the time being, right?"
"That may not necessarily be the case. Let me tell you, he's currently searching everywhere for Zhao Guangchen, and he might accidentally find you in the process."
"No worries, I naturally know my limits in this matter."
"All right then, where are you going now?"
"I don't know. I definitely can't go back to my previous residence, and recently, I've been staying in hotels. You could say it's a life of constant upheaval."
In fact, Han Xuemei said this deliberately.
She was actually hoping that this man would provide her with a place to stay.
Only with a secure base could she plan and orchestrate everything.
"Well then, it just so happens that I have a vacant property that has been unused for a long time now. Although the house isn't very large and might not compare to the villa you used to live in, it does have all the necessary amenities. If you don't mind, you could stay there for a few days."
"Okay, no problem. Will you come to see me tonight?"
Suddenly, Han Xuemei looked at Wang Sheng with a seductive gaze.
Wang Sheng just felt like he had been electrified.
In front of this woman, he was completely defenseless.
Even a mere glance or a subtle movement from her could utterly mesmerize him.
"As long as I have time, I will definitely come."
"Good, then it's settled."
After speaking, Han Xuemei just smiled and then turned to look out the window.
The life at Lin Yi's end seemed to be moving forward in an orderly fashion, step by step.
However, there was always one thing gnawing at his heart, and that was where on earth Zhao Guangchen had gone.
The old master had already sent out forces, and of course, he hasn't let Hei Lang idle either, constantly searching for his whereabouts.
Regrettably, it seemed like this person had evaporated from the face of the earth and disappeared completely.
Early in the morning, Lin Yi arrived at the company.
