Suddenly, an idea came to his mind.
So, he took out his cellphone and made a call directly.
"Hello, Manager Zhang."
"Oh, President Lin, what's up? Go ahead."
"How's the elixir selling these past two days at the pharmacy?"
"President Lin, honestly, ever since the elixir hit the market, it has been a blazing success, now basically sold out."
"I'm not looking for a rough approximation; I want to know exactly how much was sold, the total amount, and the total revenue. Send me the report as soon as possible."
"Okay, I understand."
After saying that, the other party hurriedly hung up the phone.
About five minutes later, a financial report arrived on his phone.
Lin Yi clearly saw the numbers.
They had truly doubled and were even close to tripling.
This matched exactly what he had agreed upon with the system previously.
"System, are you there?"
Seizing a moment of solitude, Lin Yi called out softly.
"I'm here, go ahead."
"Our deal from before, are you still keeping your word?"
"Which deal?"
"Come on, don't you remember telling me before that all I needed to do was double the efficiency, and then you would share the recipe with me?"
"Oh, it's not convenient right now."
"What do you mean, 'not convenient'?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was just surprised and widened his eyes.
He felt that his previous communications with the system had always been met with prompt responses and compliance.
Yet this time, it unexpectedly rejected him.
Moreover, it was a condition of exchange that he had fully met.
If that was the case, was the system just playing with him? Continue your journey with empire
With this thought, he felt slightly uncomfortable.
"But that's what we agreed on before. You're saying it's not convenient now, but then why did I bother doing all this in the first place?"
"Because, you haven't completed your task yet."
"Not completed? How have I not completed it? I've already sold the elixir as required, and even boosted its sales by so much, a number that has never been reached before. What have I failed to do?"
"There's another recipe that you haven't acquired yet, so without that recipe, you can't possibly get the elixir's formula."
"Another recipe? Which one? Aren't most of the recipes under your control?"

chapters.title: Chapter 341 Did You See Through It?
chapters.content:
"Now, there is another medicine, actually, its function and efficacy are generally the same, and moreover, it is right by your side, I have warned you about it before."
"By my side? Warned me?"
After hearing this, Lin Yi simply furrowed his brows in difficulty, as it seemed he truly had no significant memory of what had been said.
"I can't remember, can you give me a hint?"
"This person is far away on the horizon yet close right before your eyes, but now, it's as if he has vanished from the face of the earth."
"The person you're talking about, it couldn't be Zhao Guangchen, could it?"
At this point, Lin Yi suddenly realized all of it.
Now, the one who had vanished as if into thin air, it seemed, was indeed only Zhao Guangchen; no one else was like that.
"Right, because in Zhao Guangchen's hands, there is another recipe, almost identical to ours. He can also produce a medicine, and moreover, its recipe is even more top-secret than ours."
"What? He has another recipe? Where did he get it from? Could it be, does he also have a system inside his body?"
"No, he is just an ordinary person. He obtained that recipe from a master in a remote and dense forest 15 years ago."
"Then, that master, who exactly is he?"
"That, I cannot disclose. If necessary, I will naturally guide you to him in the future. Your goal is to get that recipe, otherwise, our troubles will only multiply."
"Troubles? What troubles? He merely has the recipe, but if he doesn't know how to produce and research it, then what's the use? In his hands, I'm afraid it's probably nothing more than a piece of waste paper, right?"
"Zhao Guangchen is absolutely not simple, and furthermore, he is currently preparing something even bigger. So, you must be extremely cautious."
This was a warning message from the system for himself.
Previously, the system had issued several warning messages to him.
And most crucially, every warning message it issued was one hundred percent accurate.
That meant that Zhao Guangchen's affairs had probably already been anticipated by the system.
If that was so, could it be that this person was indeed going to cause major trouble for himself in the future?
"System, can you give me some more hints?"
"This constitutes cheating, constitutes cheating; system warning, system issues a warning."
Suddenly, a beeping sound emitted from within his body.
Hearing this sound, Lin Yi felt a headache coming on.
Every time he tried to ask for more information, his body would immediately react like this.
"Fine, fine, I won't ask anymore. So what you're saying is, Zhao Guangchen will present a major threat to me in the future, right?"
"Hint completed, please complete the mission as soon as possible. After the mission is completed, the system will transfer a reward of 50 million to your account."
"Fifty million?"
It was another monetary reward. Enjoy new adventures at empire
Actually, for Lin Yi, the concept of money was almost non-existent.
It seemed like every time, the system would randomly dole out a large sum of money, and all this money still lay securely in the bank account.
Lin Yi really had no use for it, and plus, he didn't have many expenses in his daily life.
"System, system."
He softly called out twice; now, the system had once again settled into a deep sleep within his body.
Well, since it had come to this, and after all, those hints were given.
Then next, it seemed, the only person he had to focus all his effort on dealing with was indeed Zhao Guangchen.
He had never considered this person a threat before, but unexpectedly, in the future, he might become the greatest threat to himself.
Just then, Lin Yi heard knocking at the door.
"Come in," he called out.
He glanced up to check the wall clock; it was already 10:30 in the morning.
The person entering was Hei Lang.
Seeing Hei Lang's current state, Lin Yi could guess that he probably hadn't found the person they were looking for.
"So, you haven't found the person, right?"
"No, we've sent out all our people. Every place he used to frequent, including all connections related to him, we've checked everywhere and haven't seen him at all."
"That just proves, after he came to this city, he never contacted anyone and instead found a place to hide straight away."
"Big brother, do you think he has seen through our scheme?"
"I reckon if he's not stupid, he definitely knows by now. But it's not a solution for him to keep hiding away in one place. I believe he will eventually surface."
"What about now?"
"Still focus on those key areas, and since those are the most likely places for him to appear, ensure you arrange people to keep watch. The moment you spot him, contact me immediately."
"Okay, I understand, big brother."
"By the way, have you contacted Ling'er about the pharmacy?"
"Ling'er, I haven't contacted her yet, why do you ask?"
"Well, Zhou Kongshan can handle almost everything at the pharmacy by himself. It's somewhat untimely to keep Ling'er by his side all the time. Arrange for Ling'er to come to me as soon as possible; I am in need of people right now."
"But, Ling'er seems to be researching something. I heard her mention it the last time I came in."
"Whatever she's researching, she'll have to put it aside for now. Our current top priority is to find Zhao Guangchen."
"Big brother, is Zhao Guangchen really that scary? Besides, I'm usually with you, and I believe he definitely won't pose any threat to you."
"I'm not worried about him posing a physical threat to me. What I'm worried about, forget it, you wouldn't understand even if I told you. Just follow my instructions."
"Alright, I got it, I'll arrange for Ling'er to come over as soon as possible."
After saying this, Hei Lang hurriedly got up and left the place.
Ling'er was an exceptionally intelligent girl.
She had been gathering herbs with her master in the mountains since she was a child. You could say she was proficient in the characteristics of all kinds of herbs.
Young as she was, she could already independently complete many scientific research tasks.
Truth be told, having Ling'er was like receiving a treasure bestowed by heaven for Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 342 The Elixir Incident
chapters.content:
He had always been carefully protecting Ling'er, never allowing her to show her true face to the world.
But this time, they had reached a critical moment.
The company needed someone to manage it, and currently, all business affairs were concentrated in his own hands.
If Ling'er could appropriately help him share some of the burden, he felt that he could split his attention to other matters.
In the dead of night, Lin Yi sat alone, leaning against the head of the bed.
He turned around to check, and saw that Han Xuewei had already fallen fast asleep.
For some reason, he felt his mind was in chaos. Continue reading at empire
It seemed that many threads had not been completely sorted out.
He quietly got out of bed and checked the time—it was already 2:30 in the morning.
In another two or three hours, dawn would break, and he feared that another night would have passed him by in vain.
Just then, Lin Yi's phone suddenly buzzed with a vibration.
He quickly turned to look and saw the screen light up with a familiar number.
Yes, he saw clearly, it was Hei Lang.
In the dead of night, Hei Lang typically wouldn't disturb him unless absolutely necessary.
Unless, it was an emergency.
Grabbing his phone, Lin Yi hurriedly left the room.
"Hello, what's up?"
"Big brother, there's trouble. Something bad happened; hurry to the People's Hospital."
"What? What happened now? Who's in the hospital?"
Lin Yi was somewhat surprised after finding out.
It seemed that troubles with those close to him had never ceased.
"It's not one of our people. It's the customers who bought medicine from our store. They're all poisoned now and have been brought to the hospital. Ah, big brother, another one just came in; there are already 13 of them now."
"What are you saying? Poisoned? This, this can't be possible. We've always been using these herbs without any issues before."
Lin Yi indeed found it hard to accept the fact.
The medicines had been tried and tested countless times, and every single one was proven to be completely non-toxic.
Even when mixed together, they were not supposed to produce any toxicity. How could such symptoms suddenly appear out of nowhere?
"I don't know the details, big brother. It's best you come quickly."
"Okay, I understand. I'm on my way."
He knew that this time the situation had become very serious.
If the people were only mildly poisoned, they might recover quickly after a couple of days in the hospital and some IV fluids.
But the critical issue was the impact on his reputation—it was likely to be significant.
He absolutely couldn't allow this situation to continue developing.
Without having the time to greet Han Xuewei, Lin Yi rushed to the People's Hospital.
By that time, People's Hospital was already ablaze with lights.
He saw ambulances coming and going, one after the other.
And each person that got out seemed to have only one action—they were continuously clutching their stomachs with their hands.
"Big brother, we're over here."
Just then, he heard someone calling his name from behind; the voice was very familiar—it must have been Hei Lang.
He turned around and saw someone standing in a corner under a streetlight, in a blind spot of the courtyard.
Hei Lang was standing there, and there seemed to be someone else with him. He just waved at Lin Yi.
Quickly, Lin Yi stepped forward.
Standing beside him was the manager of the pharmacy.
"What's going on? What's the situation now?"
"President Lin, it's a relief you're here, and I can't handle these matters anymore."
"Enough, stop talking nonsense. Tell me what exactly is happening."
"At 8:00 tonight, I received a call that people had symptom of vomiting and diarrhea after taking our Elixir. They've been brought to the hospital, so I treated it as a routine incident and didn't disturb you."
"And then?"
"Later, I realized it wasn't that simple because within a short two hours, one after another, more than a dozen people came, all of whom had taken our Elixir. So, I concluded that this must be a case of mass poisoning."
"That's impossible. Our medicines don't have any issues. They had been tested before leaving the production line; this situation simply couldn't occur."
"But the key point is that the incident has already occurred. President Lin, what should we do?"
"Currently, what diagnosis have the doctors given?"
"Doctors? After all the patients arrived, they all underwent stomach pumping, and now, they are on IV drips. But, it seems like the symptoms haven't completely subsided for some of them. A few, due to severe illnesses or other underlying health issues, have been transferred to the ICU."
"What? There are those who've been moved to the intensive care unit?"
Lin Yi was only too familiar with that place.
He knew it was like the gate to the underworld for human life.
If you could walk out of there successfully, you'd definitely be a big winner in life.
However, unfortunately, about 80% of the people who went there, probably wouldn't come out in one piece.
"Yes, they were just rushed into ICU. They had previous health conditions, so the effects of the medicine seem to have suddenly worsened their illnesses. The others are relatively stable."
"Has this been reported?"
"Of course, with an incident this big, the hospital couldn't possibly conceal it. I guess that as soon as it gets light, people will come looking for me. President Lin, what should we do in this situation?"
The manager Liu was somewhat anxious.
He was the legal representative of the pharmacy.
So, if anything went wrong, he was certainly the first person to be held accountable.
In normal circumstances, Lin Yi ought to be able to disassociate himself from the incident.
But regardless, this was his own person, so under these circumstances, Lin Yi wouldn't back down.
"You don't need to worry for now. First, take a rough count of the number of people, then understand the symptoms of each one. Better yet, I'll come with you."

chapters.title: Chapter 343 Mass Poisoning
chapters.content:
"President Lin, you, you going at this time, it's best if you don't show your face, right?"
"Don't worry, most people are not aware of my identity, and they only recognize you. So right now, many people should recognize you instead. Hei Lang and I will handle this matter."
"What about me?"
"You don't need to do anything. First, go back to the pharmacy, and then save all the video surveillance systems. I believe someone will investigate this sooner or later."
"Okay, I got it. I'll go arrange it right now."
"One more thing, make sure to save the surveillance recordings, and then gather all the staff together. No one can leave; just wait inside the pharmacy. I estimate that people will be coming to look for us as soon as day breaks."
"Okay, I understand."
After finishing speaking, he hurriedly left the hospital.
Watching his departing figure, Lin Yi could only shake his head helplessly.
One crisis had not subsided before another erupted.
The matter of Zhao Guangchen had not yet settled, and now, such a major incident had occurred?
A mass poisoning event, and the number of poisoned individuals might already be in the dozens.
He was unclear how many more there would be behind them.
If this scale were to expand, even if heaven itself were backing us, I'm afraid, it would still be unsustainable.
"Alright, let's go check out the situation inside."
As he spoke, he walked into the emergency hall with Hei Lang.
By this time, the hall was already overcrowded.
Bed spaces were tight to begin with, and with so many patients rushed in over a short period, the hall had become very busy.
Some, having no place else, lay directly on the ground, where they began receiving treatment.
Seeing this scene, Lin Yi truly had an indescribable feeling.
The purpose of creating these medicines was to benefit mankind. If it really brought them such immense suffering, then he truly felt like a monumental sinner.
"Hey, what are you doing? Are you a family member?"
Just then, a nurse approached him and asked while looking at him.
The nurse wore a mask covering her face securely.
But her eyes sparkled with brightness, and from this alone, it was clear she must be an extraordinarily beautiful woman.
"Oh, this is the thing, I'm in charge of the drugstore, so I wanted to come and see what the situation was like."
"The drugstore's manager? Oh, were those medicines bought from your place?"
"Yes, that should be the case, so our leaders sent us down to see what the situation is now."
"I'm asking you, where is your drugstore manager? Ever since the incident, he hasn't shown up. Are you not taking people's lives seriously?" Stay connected via empire
The nurse's tone of voice suddenly heightened.
Moreover, during her speech, she attracted the attention of several family members.
"You're from the drugstore?"
After hearing these words, those few people came walking over together.
Originally, they were looking for the source of the problem here and had not expected him to walk right into their midst. If that was the case, there was no way they could let him off easily.
"I'm just responsible for investigating this accident, so I'm not very clear about the details of their sales. Don't get agitated. If there's an issue, you can tell me about it."
"Responsible for investigation? So you're saying this matter is under your control, right?"
"Oh, you can understand it that way, and if there's any compensation needed later, I will be mediating and arranging for it."
"Let me tell you, my wife took that damned medicine of yours, and now she's ended up in this state. Who's going to bear the loss?"
A middle-aged man stood up and yelled loudly at him.
"Right, my child as well, young and following your lead, taking what damned Elixir you produce. Now, they've ended up in the hospital."
"What are they even doing? I think what they produce is not any good Elixir but just poison."
"Yes, you deserve to be cut to a thousand pieces."
The crowd became more and more excited as they spoke, and soon Lin Yi was surrounded by them.
A whole circle of people, all understandably, seemed as if all the troubles had started because of him.
But Lin Yi always met them with a smile, and the smile on his face never faded.
He knew that even if he had mouths all over his body, he wouldn't be able to clear up this matter.
And their emotions, including their psychological state at the moment, Lin Yi had great sympathy and could understand.
Hei Lang dared not act rashly.
If he really showed off his strength, these people wouldn't be a concern for him.
But the key issue was that they were the victims now. If he took a stand at this moment, it would definitely have a profound impact on Lin Yi's affairs.
"Enough, enough! What's the point of you all fussing here? How are we supposed to administer treatment? I think you all should say less, and besides, hasn't he already spoken? He's just in charge of the investigation; he's not the one responsible. What's the point of going back and forth here?"
Just then, that girl suddenly stood up.
At that moment, Lin Yi felt as if he was wrapped tightly by a little sun,
"Alright, alright, disperse, everyone. But did you take note of the issues we've reported?"
"Yes, yes, I've taken note of everything. For now, you should focus on your treatment without worrying about the medical expenses. We will have someone come over to cover them in advance."
"Nonsense, of course! The incident started because of him; should we have to pay the money instead?"
"Alright, take good care of your family members and get them treated quickly. Don't worry, I will resolve this issue for you as soon as possible."
Lin Yi was finally rescued from the crowd by the little nurse.
He felt as if the circle he had just been in was suffocating, even stifling the air around him.
He took a long breath of relief and helplessly turned to look back at the little nurse.
Unknowingly, he had broken out in quite a sweat.

chapters.title: Chapter 344 Encounter with a Noble Patron
chapters.content:
Could it really be extreme nervousness?
At the scene, he didn't feel that way at all; maybe it was because he was the one facing difficulties.
"I'm sorry for causing you trouble."
He walked up to the young nurse and said.
At that moment, he saw a name badge on the chest of the young nurse, bearing the name Liu Yao.
What made Lin Yi feel that Jing Ya was composed was that she turned out to be an intern.
"Come on, don't just stand around here, and what's more, some family members are agitated. If you show up now, who knows what they might do to you? Come on, go back to the office with me."
The girl was quite eager to help.
Perhaps she felt that Lin Yi was quite innocent as well. After being scolded for no reason by so many people just a moment ago, probably anyone would struggle to bear it all.
Before leaving, he gave Hei Lang a sign.
Hei Lang naturally stayed behind to continue monitoring the situation, while Lin Yi followed Liu Yao into her office.
To call it an office, though, it was more of a rest area they used on a regular basis.
The room was not large, about five or six square meters in size.
In the corner, there was a single bed and a simple wardrobe inside.
Near the door, there was an old desk with a computer that seemed to be from another era on it.
"Alright, take a seat over there."
Liu Yao pointed to a sofa next to her, and Lin Yi simply nodded in acknowledgment before finally plopping down on it.
"I really am sorry for causing you so much trouble, and if it weren't for your intervention today, who knows how these people would have treated me."
"Ah, I can understand their feelings, but after all, you are innocent. At first, when I saw you, I thought you were the one who sold the drugs to them, so my tone might not have been great. I'm sorry about that."
With that, they removed their mask.
A faint smile quickly spread across their face,
And two dimples appeared on their cheeks.
"Have you been here all evening?"
Lin Yi felt that he was actually quite lucky.
If he had just tried to probe that doctor, maybe they really wouldn't have revealed much to him.
But now, fortunately, he could probe this young nurse and perhaps even manage to uncover some things.
"Yes, I was supposed to have a night shift tonight, and it was supposed to be a light one. I even prepared these things."
As she spoke, she gestured towards the bed,
Lin Yi saw a tablet computer and a big bag of snacks there.
Probably, she planned to watch TV series while eating snacks, basically standing duty here.
"There's nothing I can do, I didn't want this to happen either.?"
"Since the first patient came in at 8:30, up to now, 37 people have been admitted, and among them, six people, due to some underlying diseases, are currently under observation in the ICU. The remaining 31 are gradually stabilizing, and by tomorrow night, they should be completely recovered."
"What exactly is happening this time?"
"According to some of the patients' blood work and biochemical reports, we can roughly deduce that there is some drug in that medication that has a stimulating effect on their organs, causing these effects."
"What? Some kind of drug?" Experience more tales on empire
"Yes, but as to what specific drug, the lab hasn't given a definitive answer yet. At the earliest, it would probably be in about two days from now."
"The drug formulation, I've already checked it before, there are absolutely no problems, and every single ingredient, on taking it out, causes minimal to no harm to the human body, even negligible damage."
"So how are you going to explain all this now? Come on, stop speaking on their behalf; I know you must have taken a lot of money."
What, does she really see him in such a light?
Did he really look that desperate for money?
So thinking of this, Lin Yi could only smile helplessly.
"I'm just doing something I ought to do, and uncovering the truth in time to announce to society is also a responsibility I should fulfill."
The words Lin Yi spoke were firm and resolute.
The nurse had been all smiles just a moment ago, but at his words, she suddenly froze.
"I've never asked who you really are. You aren't a journalist, are you?"
"Hehe, as for my identity, I believe you'll come to know it over time. For now, I just want to know the full extent of the situation. Is it really that serious?"
"Looking at it now, these remaining 31 people are still stabilizing; there shouldn't be any major problems."
"And what about the poison screening? No results yet? How can you be sure that all of them have taken the same drug?"
"We've already conducted clinical inquiries, so each person has taken the drug, and all of them took it around noon today, which is why such a large-scale poisoning incident occurred."
"What did each of them eat for dinner tonight? You've asked about that, haven't you?"
"Of course, I've asked. With so many people involved, their meals were miscellaneous, not related at all, so it's not directly connected to food."
After saying that, Lin Yi simply nodded.
By now, he could almost confirm that this incident was related to his Elixir.
But as to which link had the problem, he was still not entirely clear.
"Additionally, there's one more detail I noticed when I was conducting these questionnaire surveys."
"Oh, what detail?"
Saying that, Lin Yi suddenly became vigilant.
Because a minor detail could potentially change the entire complexion of the event.
"I had asked these people where they bought the drugs, and 17 of them said their point of purchase was the same place—the pharmacy here."
With those words, Liu Yao took out a card from her pocket, which clearly had the name of a pharmacy written on it.

chapters.title: Chapter 345 Betrayal
chapters.content:
This pharmacy, Lin Yi had actually heard about it before, but there wasn't much interaction between them.
That's not right. If we're talking logic here, all the medicine should have been sold exclusively at our own pharmacy. So why did it appear here too?
"Are you sure they all bought it from this pharmacy?"
"Yes, they bought them all from this pharmacy, and the price was the same as ours. At least, here you don't have to queue up, and they offer a delivery service to your door."
After listening, Lin Yi just silently nodded his head, and by the end, he etched the name of this pharmacy into his mind.
"Alright, now I understand. I'm really sorry for troubling you for so long."
"What, you're planning to leave?"
"Yes, basically there's nothing more to ask about here, and I still have lots of follow-up work to deal with. I must make some arrangements and preparations in advance."
"Okay, I get it. Go ahead with what you need to do. Don't worry. I'll do my best to take good care of things on the hospital's end."
Lin Yi couldn't quite put his finger on what he felt for this girl.
It was just that she seemed gentle, kind, and naturally intelligent.
When Lin Yi left the hospital, daylight had already broken.
Unbeknownst to him, he had spent an entire night there.
But it couldn't be helped; a problem had arisen, and he had to be involved to see it through.
"By the way, Hei Lang, come with me."
At the hospital entrance, it was as if Lin Yi suddenly remembered something.
"Brother, should I leave now? Didn't you say I should keep watch here?"
"It's nothing. I've already arranged for that woman to handle things. I believe she should be able to help us."
"You mean, that nurse?"
Hei Lang was somewhat surprised.
They didn't know each other, and entrusting such an important matter to her was honestly something even Hei Lang wouldn't be comfortable with.
"Right, it's her, didn't you notice? The little girl is quite serious and responsible, especially fair and just, so she won't slack on us."
"Well, in that case, okay."
Since Lin Yi had already said this, Hei Lang didn't really have any room for rebuttal.
He just gave a slight nod, essentially agreeing to the situation.
Once the two men got into the car, they headed straight for the pharmacy.
At this point, the pharmacy had long since shut its doors for good. Find exclusive stories on My Virtual Library Empire
After all, with such a big incident, how could it possibly stay open for business?
He walked up and knocked on the door.
"Who is it? We're closed now."
He heard Manager Liu's voice coming from inside.
"It's me, open the door."
"Oh, is it President Lin? Please wait a moment."
No sooner had he spoken than he walked up to the door and opened it from the inside.
After entering, he glanced around. All the employees, as he had arranged before, were now waiting there.
"President Lin, how's the situation at the hospital?"
"Currently, a few critical patients are still in the ICU, and some situations are unclear."
"And what about the others?"
"The others, if nothing else comes up, should be out of danger by today. After two more days of observation, they should be able to be discharged."
At this point, Manager Zhang just let out a long breath of relief.
"Ahh, we're finally able to dodge this bullet."
"Dodge? How can you dodge? I ask you, has anyone contacted you today?"
"They did. They came here early in the morning, took some samples, and then asked me to cooperate with the investigation, saying that without permission, I'm not allowed to leave."
Lin Yi nodded.
In fact, according to legal procedures, that should be the case.
After all, he was directly responsible; he had to show a spirit of accountability, and absolutely could not shirk it.
"You guys go back first. The pharmacy will close for the next few days, but rest assured, your salaries will be paid as usual. Once everything is resolved here, wait for further notice by phone."
He walked forward and addressed the other staff in the store.
They stood up, nodded in agreement, and then quickly took their belongings and left.
After all, no one wanted to get mixed up in this mess.
With such a critical issue involving loss of life, if it really were related to them, how could they explain it to those impacted?
Everyone had their own plans in mind.
So, having them leave now was probably the best solution for them too.
With everyone else gone, only Hei Lang, Lin Yi, and Manager Zhang were left.
"Come, sit down."
"President Lin, is there something you need?"
He noticed that when Lin Yi spoke, his expression seemed very serious, prompting him to worry that perhaps Lin Yi had discovered something.
Seeing this, Lin Yi suddenly strode forward and fiercely slapped him twice across the face.
This took Manager Zhang by surprise, and he could only cover his face with his hand, appearing quite aggrieved.
"President Lin, why did you hit me?"
"Hit you? I'm so angry right now I could kill you. Tell me, what's the deal with the drug prescription rights?"
"What, what drug prescription rights?"
"What? You're still denying it? Don't think I don't know; previously, you secretly passed on the business to some obscure pharmacy. And it's their store that had issues during the sales process; do you understand?"
"But, but I was just trying to expand our sales volume and coverage. Besides, President Lin, didn't you say that we needed to double our sales in a few days? There was no way our store could handle it all."
"Even if the store couldn't handle it, you should have found another way, even if it meant delaying things. But how could you just casually sell such important goods to other pharmacies?"
"They offered to take on a large order and took nearly a third of the medicine from us all at once, which greatly alleviated our sales pressure."

chapters.title: Chapter 346 Ling'er's Support
chapters.content:
"I feel like you must have made a decent amount of money from this whole situation, right?"
Lin Yi's words really hit the nail on the head.
This manager really did receive a sizable kickback from the distribution rights.
"But, but I did it all to solve my sales problems, and, and I never imagined such a big issue would arise!"
"I have already investigated, and this incident originated from those drugstores. It proves someone accessed that drugstore and tampered with something inside."
"What is the nature of this situation, and specifically, what kind of tampering took place?"
"As of now, I can't say for certain. I've already sent someone there to collect samples, and once we have them, we'll test them thoroughly at the factory."
"President Lin, can you, can you please let me go? I truly had no idea it was this serious. What do you suggest we do now? If it's a matter of compensation, fine, I'll pay the money, I will."
"It's no longer a matter of money. I'll tell you, just covering the medical expenses for the thirty-something people in the hospital I can handle for now, but the real issue is the six people in the ICU. If something were to happen to them, we could be looking at a lawsuit over human lives, you understand?"
"President Lin, please, please save me. Everything I did, I did for you."
Upon reaching this point, Manager Liu also realized the gravity of the situation.
With a thud, he fell to his knees and clung to Lin Yi's legs, desperately pleading.
Hei Lang stepped forward and kicked him away.
Enjoy new tales from My Virtual Library Empire
"I'm telling you, speak if you have something to say, but keep your hands to yourself."
"Alright, alright, I understand, I understand, President Lin, think of something, please."
"At this point, there's not much else I can do. Old Liu, how long have you been with me?"
"President Lin, about six years, I believe."
"In those six years, I've treated you like a brother. Have I ever done you wrong during that time?"
"No, President Lin, you've never treated me poorly."
"Good, knowing that I have never wronged you, why would you betray my trust this time?"
"President Lin, I didn't. I say it again, this time I was only trying to boost sales, and I was doing it to quickly achieve the goals you set."
His words made sense.
Actually, Lin Yi understood all too well.
He was merely too eager for success and took a bit of a shortcut.
But he never ever imagined this shortcut would lead them into such a desperate situation, something that probably no one saw coming.
"Let's wait for the drug samples to come over first. If we're able to identify any tampering with them, well, it couldn't be better."
At the moment, Lin Yi had no better solution.
He could only cooperate with the investigation and hope that those affected would be lucky enough to recover and be discharged from the hospital soon. Perhaps then, the impact of this event might be somewhat lessened.
During this process, Hei Lang received a phone call. Apparently, the person sent to collect the drug had arrived.
He went outside and brought the medication back in.
The Elixir was packaged exquisitely, and if one were to judge solely by its appearance, no one would suspect tampering as there seemed to be no opportunity for it.
It was entirely sealed within a small box, surrounded by sealing wax.
If this wax were to be tampered with, then naturally, one would notice the discrepancy upon opening it for consumption.
Just having received it, Lin Yi felt the situation was indeed quite tricky.
He quietly opened one and examined it carefully in his hands.
There appeared to be no change, and it looked exactly the same as the pills he had previously obtained from the factory.
"This is strange. If someone wanted to tamper with the medication, where would they even have the opportunity to do so?"
"Exactly, big brother. With such a tight seal, how could there be any tampering? Could there be another way?"
"What other way could there be? It seems we might actually need to go back to the factory and break down the ingredients again?"
At this point, Lin Yi began to feel a headache coming on.
Now, he had no choice but to seek help from Zhou Kongshan.
"Ah, right, didn't you say that Ling'er was coming over?"
Hei Lang suddenly reminded him of this detail.
"Yes, how could I forget about her? Quick, call Ling'er and tell her to hurry over."
"Okay, got it."
As he spoke, Hei Lang took out his phone and walked to the side.
Perhaps, with Ling'er's assistance, they could quickly resolve the matter without going through the factory. After all, she had been closely involved in the development of the drug from the start; she was a research scientist and the medication was like her own child.
No one understood it better than she did.
About thirty minutes later, Ling'er hurried to the site from the company.
Today, Ling'er was once again dressed in black and always exuded a sense of competency.
"Hmm, President Lin, what's the situation?"
Ling'er knew that being called over so urgently meant there was an important matter at hand.
The company was already in disarray, and if the problem were with the medication, then the entire company would have to be thoroughly scrutinized.
She had been occupied with managing company affairs and had not anticipated needing to delve into this situation.
"Take a look, this is a sample from another drug store."
"Another drug store? What do you mean?"
Ling'er asked, her brow furrowed with confusion.
Because, when the drug left the factory, they had made it clear that it had to be sold exclusively.
They absolutely did not permit any distributor to handle it, otherwise, the drug's formula might leak out.
Ling'er had always treasured the formula like a precious gem, guarding it with the utmost care.
"Let me explain the situation to you later. It was a mistake made by Manager Liu, but I have already punished him for it. For now, let's not discuss that."
After hearing this, Ling'er looked up and then at Manager Liu
She had no recollection of this man, as she had always worked behind the scenes in research and development, not knowing much about the sales personnel at the front end.

chapters.title: Chapter 347 Took the Wrong Medicine
chapters.content:
"Alright, Director Li, what is it you wanted to talk about?"
"This came from over there, and moreover, I went to the hospital last night and made some inquiries. Basically, all the people who were poisoned this time obtained their medications from a pharmacy. Don't you find that to be quite a coincidence?"
"Are you implying that other people who took medication from our place didn't show any adverse reactions, but only those specific individuals did? Is that what you mean?"
"Yes, that's exactly what I mean."
"So it seems you're suggesting that someone has tampered with it here, right?"
"I'm currently suspecting that someone has tampered with the medication here, so I have no way to discern for certain, and I had to ask you to come over and thoroughly check the Elixir. If it comes to it, we'll have to go back to the factory and test it again in the research laboratory."
That was precisely what Lin Yi least wanted to do.
Once in the research lab, the process would take at least three to five days before they could detect anything.
After hearing this, Ling'er simply nodded her head and then stepped forward to place the unopened boxes of medicine in front of her.
Ling'er carefully observed them and then took out a magnifying glass from her pocket.
She scrutinized it over and over, but it seemed there was nothing suspect to be seen.
Then, with a puzzled look, she opened the box and took out the sealed smaller box within.
Checking the sealing wax around it, she could be certain that there were no signs of it having been opened.
This meant that the medication should be intact.
"This, are you sure it was brought back from over there?"
"Absolutely, it was brought from there without a doubt."
"The medication should be untouched, and if I'm not wrong, this medication was probably stored in the warehouse, not on the open shelves."
"Stored in the warehouse, you mean to say, if the medication in the warehouse hasn't been tampered with, then the altered products should be those placed on the shelves. Can I understand it like that?"
"That's all we can assume for now, because I've carefully checked and there's no way anything could get inside this packaging, and this small box is completely isolated from the outside. Unless, of course, there was an issue during manufacturing."
"Impossible, the manufacturing process is tightly controlled by just you and Zhou Kongshan. Our store has never had any problems either."
"Therefore, it must be those on the shelf that were problematic, so taking this sample is pointless."
At this point, Lin Yi nodded, feeling that Ling'er's analysis was indeed logical.
He looked up at Hei Lang.
Hei Lang had been listening to their exchange and only when he realized that all of this might have stemmed from his own oversight did he respond.
"Oh, don't panic, the guy is still outside, I'll call him over right away."
Hei Lang hurriedly opened the door and then called a thin man in.
"Tell me, where did you get this pill from?"
"Well, it was from their pharmacy. Why, is there a mistake?"
"The medication isn't wrong. I'm asking you, when you took the pill, was it placed on the shelf or did you get it from the warehouse?"
"From, from the warehouse."
As expected, Ling'er had guessed correctly.
"I'm telling you, you must take from the shelf. Taking samples from the warehouse is pointless. Go, make another trip."
"From the shelf? But as far as I remember, the shelf was basically empty, there was nothing there."
"What do you mean nothing?"
"Yes, I already looked around the shelf and didn't find what we needed, which is why I took it from the warehouse."
"So, you're saying that everything on the shelf has already been sold?"
"Yes, everything's been sold."
This really left Lin Yi in a difficult position.
If that was the case, how was he supposed to obtain a sample of the compromised medication?
"Ah, I remember now."
Just then, Lin Yi had a sudden flash of inspiration, as he thought of someone.
Yes, that person was Liu Yao.
Now, she was the only one in the hospital and also had the earliest access to the patients.
He believed that not every patient would have bought just one box; there must be those who bought extra, and surely some of these extra purchases remained unopened. For them, these unopened ones could be the most crucial evidence.
Fortunately, Lin Yi had taken down the nurse's phone number previously, or else he'd really be at a loss now.
"Hello, this is Lin Yi, the one who met you in the hospital just now."
At this moment, Liu Yao had just finished her night shift.
Under normal circumstances, she might have already left the hospital, but today was exceptional, with many patients still needing care, so she hadn't left yet.
"Oh, it's you. Don't worry, the patients here are all very stable now."
Ling'er hadn't thought much about it; she just assumed that Lin Yi was inquiring about the patients' conditions again.
"No, that's not it, I'm not asking about that. I have something else I need to ask you. Can you find a patient you talk to more, someone you get along well with, and does any patient have any leftover medication that you could bring me?"
"Medication? You mean the poisoned ones? Why do you want that?"
"I need it, and we need to conduct our own investigation."
"Alright then, I'm about to leave here. Where are you? I'll bring it to you." Read the latest on My Virtual Library Empire
"That, shouldn't be necessary, and anyway, just wait there, I'll send someone to pick it up. All you need to do is hold onto the medication."
"No need to wait for you guys, who knows when you'll come. Just tell me where you are?"
"I'm at, I'm at Jinsui Pharmacy. Is that convenient for you?"
"Jinsui Pharmacy? Haha, what a coincidence, Jinsui Pharmacy is just below my apartment."

chapters.title: Chapter 348 You Trickster
chapters.content:
"What, what did you say? You live in Jinhe Bay community?"
Actually, Lin Yi did know something about the house upstairs.
Moreover, the storefront he rented was associated with this community, as it was its ground-floor business, and they were developed by the same developer.
"Of course, I'm on my way home, so I'll just bring it to you. Wait for me, I should be there quickly."
Afterward, Liu Yao hung up the phone.
Lin Yi finally breathed a sigh of relief. If he could successfully receive it, then the results of their investigation should take a significant step forward.
Liu Yao did not disappoint and quickly obtained the pill. Then she hurriedly delivered it here.
"Go, take this and get it to Ling'er as soon as you can, then have her check it out."
"Okay, I got it, President Lin."
After speaking, Manager Liu hastily took the pill and entered the room inside.
There was a small testing station inside, where they kept some simple tools, so at the very least, Ling'er could be put to use now.
Liu Yao was just looking around the pharmacy.
"Heh, I know, you just finished a night shift. You really worked hard last night. Go and get some rest soon. If there's anything, I'll contact you again. I'm very thankful for your help this time."
Lin Yi sincerely said to her.
And, after all, what followed were their internal affairs, which would be somewhat inconvenient to discuss if Liu Yao, an outsider, was present.
"Who exactly are you?"
Liu Yao suddenly stopped and looked at Lin Yi.
"Me? I'm Lin Yi, haven't I already told you my name before?"
Lin Yi found it interesting. Why did this young girl keep asking about this information over and over? Could it be that she had noticed something off?
"If I'm not wrong, these pharmacies should belong to you, right?"
"What did you say?"
Lin Yi remembered clearly that he indeed hadn't revealed anything about this issue before.
How could she make such an inference now? What basis did all of this rest on?
"I mean, this pharmacy should belong to you, right?"
"How does it belong to me? Moreover, isn't the business license out there for everyone to see? Look at the representative listed on it."
While speaking, Lin Yi pointed towards the wall.
But Ling'er didn't even look in that direction.
"I used to come down to buy medicine at this pharmacy often, and I know the person you were just with. He must be the manager of the pharmacy, but he called you President Lin and was very respectful in front of you. It's obvious that you must be his direct superior."
Lin Yi simply had no way to answer this statement.
Clearly, Liu Yao was smart and had analyzed everything logically.
No matter how he tried to explain, it probably wouldn't matter.
Lin Yi felt somewhat embarrassed and smiled faintly before quickly turning his head away.
"Well, well, let's talk about this later. I'll explain things to you properly later, and..."
"You liar."
Suddenly, those words escaped from Liu Yao's mouth.
"Me, a liar? What have I lied about? Did I con you out of money? Or was I trying to seduce you?"
He genuinely found it amusing.
How had he been labeled a liar?
He recalled carefully, from the moment he met this girl yesterday until now, it seemed he hadn't said a single word he shouldn't have.
"I was wondering, who would be so kind as to care about this matter. Turns out, it's all about your own interests. To think I even introduced you to so many things last night. Really, you're an unscrupulous businessman."
With that, Lin Yi was taken aback.
So she was blaming him for these issues.
"Liu Yao, I'm not sure what you're thinking, but let me tell you, my medicine has no problems, and the issue stems from elsewhere, not this pharmacy. You know this because you're the one who informed me about it."
"Even if the problem didn't originate from this pharmacy, the key question is, weren't those medicines also distributed from here?"
"Yes, I admit they went out from here. But, there are no problems with any medicine bought in my pharmacy; only the ones from that other pharmacy caused issues. Now, tell me, who should take responsibility for this?"
"In any case, it's your affair. The medicine is still produced by you. Whatever you say goes."
"Rest assured, I will indeed give a proper answer to the patients at the hospital. Even if it's not our fault, I'll undertake all costs, including any damages for psychological and work losses. You can count on that."
Your next read is at My Virtual Library Empire
"Me, rest assured? What does it have to do with me? And I haven't taken any such elixir, let alone a 'Youth-Preserving Pill'. I think that's just some deceitful nonsense."
"Alright, let's not talk about this now. Once the investigation's results are out, I'll naturally explain everything to you."
"No need. Stop right there. You don't have to explain anything to me, and you don't need to settle this matter with me. I am just a nurse, saving lives and aiding the injured is my job, my duty. Enough, I don't want to go back and forth with you unscrupulous businessmen. I have to go."
After saying this, Liu Yao swayed her body and hurriedly left the pharmacy.
Watching Liu Yao's retreating figure, Lin Yi shook his head helplessly.
He had always been very cautious in his dealings and never felt capable of deceiving anyone.
Yet now, being accused by a young girl like this truly made him feel innocent inside.
"Bro, you okay?"
Hei Lang might be rough around the edges, but sometimes, he could quickly tell when something was off with Lin Yi.
"It's fine, nothing major. Let's go in and have a look."
No sooner had he spoken than his phone rang. Lin Yi looked down and saw it was Han Xuewei calling.
She must have seen the relevant news coverage, which is why she was aware of the situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 349 Increased by 0.01 Grams
chapters.content:
"Hello, Xue Mei."
No matter what, she was his wife, and he owed her an explanation. After all, in the next few days, he was likely to be continuously busy with this matter and unable to take care of things at home.
"What's going on? I've seen the news on the internet about that medication having issues. What... what exactly is happening, is it serious?"
"I'm already dealing with it, so when I left last night, I didn't have time to tell you. How's the child?"
"Don't worry about the child; everything's fine. They are with our parents."
"And you?"
"Where are you? I'll come to you."
"You better not come. Under these circumstances, you can't help here. You should go back to school and attend your classes."
"But if I don't go, my heart, my heart won't be at ease."
"There's nothing to be at ease about. Now go to your class. I'll take care of the rest."
"Hello? Hello?"
Han Xuewei held the phone, but no matter how much she called, it seemed that Lin Yi had already hung up.
She shook her head helplessly. At this moment, Han Xuewei was standing opposite the pharmacy.
She was well aware that Lin Yi must be inside the pharmacy; she had already seen his car there.
But Han Xuewei knew that Lin Yi was a very strong-willed person, and sometimes, he didn't want her to get involved in many things.
So she definitely had to give him that much respect.
Since Lin Yi didn't agree to let her be involved, Han Xuewei could only offer her assistance in secret.
In fact, Han Xuewei had already found out that those people should be in the emergency room of the People's Hospital.
So she hurriedly took a taxi directly to the hospital.
Lin Yi entered the room and saw that Ling'er had been closely examining the pill under a microscope.
Lin Yi didn't make a sound because he knew that these people don't allow interruptions during their busy times. He just quietly sat down in a corner of the room.
After waiting for about 20 minutes, Lin Yi saw Ling'er slowly close the experiment table and then stand up.
"Ling'er, how's the situation?"
He was excited and quickly approached her, hoping to get a complete answer from Ling'er.
"This medication has indeed been tampered with."
"What did you say? It really has been tampered with? Have you found out? What did they add to it?"
"At the moment, I'm not sure what's been added, but I've discovered this. Take a look."
While speaking, she took out the complete medicine box again.
Lin Yi just glanced down at the box, which appeared no different from the outside.
"There doesn't seem to be any difference?"
"No, look closely here."
As she spoke, she took out a magnifying glass and placed it over the medicine box.
Through the magnifying glass, Lin Yi saw a tiny needle hole on the top edge of the medicine box.
"What's this about?"
"After I took it, I looked at it once and indeed found a needle hole. Also, I found a very small hole in the sealing wax inside."
"So, you're saying that someone used a special syringe and then, added some unclean substances to this, and that's why the toxicity of the drug was enhanced?"
Find your next adventure on My Virtual Library Empire
"Yes, that should be the case. And, President Lin, take a look at this."
As she spoke, Ling'er placed the pill on the electronic scale.
It showed 1.83 grams.
This was a very precise scale, capable of measuring to 0.01 grams, used only in their usual research and development of these drugs.
Because these drugs have their specific dosage standards, sometimes even 0.1 grams can be lethal.
"Hmm, I see."
"Now, take a look at this."
Continuing, Ling'er took another pill and placed it on the scale.
Then, after a careful glance, it showed 1.84 grams.
"This pill, it seems to be 0.01 gram heavier than the other, isn't it?"
"Yes, it's 0.01 gram heavier, and this is the extra 0.01 gram of substance that was added. Do you understand?"
"I understand now, all the problems stemmed from this 0.01 gram."
"Exactly."
"So, what exactly is this 0.01 gram of substance?"
"President Lin, I think even if we find out what this 0.01 gram is, what would be the point? It's meaningless. The main issue shouldn't be wasting our time figuring out the drug, but finding the person who poisoned it. Who could that be?"
"The poisoner, the poisoner."
President Lin kept muttering this term.
Why would someone target his drug?
Could it be a business rival from before?
But that seemed unlikely; though there had been some business disputes over the past two years.
He had completely resolved them, and essentially, he was able to coexist peacefully with the locals.
"I've got it, Ling'er. You've really helped me out this time. You're not needed here anymore; I'll have Hei Lang take over the investigation."
"Okay, I understand. But I'm not much help anyway. I can still help you temporarily manage the company's affairs."
"Alright, this task is something only you can do. I'll make other arrangements myself."
After finishing, Ling'er stood up, nodded to him, then greeted Hei Lang and quickly got up and left.
"It seems we must find this person."
"Yes, we must find this person."
"President Lin, have you considered the possibility that it might be Zhao Guangchen?"
At this point, it seemed to remind Lin Yi.
But now, Zhao Guangchen knew that everyone was looking for him.
Given the circumstances, he should be hiding well; he couldn't possibly appear at this time.
"I think he must be crazy to show up in public at this time."
"But it's not for certain, is it? Who knows what the situation might be."

chapters.title: Chapter 350 Understanding
chapters.content:
Continue reading at My Virtual Library Empire
"Whether it's him or not, you must arrange for someone to investigate as soon as possible. These matters can't be delayed. We must find out the results quickly, otherwise, we have no way to explain ourselves."
Hei Lang left hurriedly from here.
After arranging everything, however, Lin Yi's heart remained suspended.
He knew that things were far from as simple as he had imagined.
Something must have happened; otherwise, everyone wouldn't be groping in the dark.
Sitting in the pharmacy, he truly felt a flood of thoughts.
This pharmacy was the starting point of his business; could it actually become the end as well?
He certainly didn't want to see such a thing happen.
Manager Zhang was beside him, not daring to make a sound.
After all, the incident had started because of him.
After waiting for a long time, he carefully approached and then arranged a cup of tea for Lin Yi, placing it in front of him.
"President Lin, please calm down. No one wanted this to happen; it was indeed an accident. But I know that I should take all the responsibility. However, we also need to find the person who poisoned them quickly. As for how you want to punish me afterward, I'll leave it to you."
Manager Zhang was rather composed.
After all, he had been with Lin Yi for so many years, and he understood well what kind of person Lin Yi was.
At this time, he absolutely couldn't show any sign of backing down.
The more he backed down, the more certain it was that Lin Yi would rescue him.
Instead, he had to stand up bravely; maybe, Lin Yi would really forgive him.
As for Manager Liu, Lin Yi had always rated him highly.
The reason he slapped Manager Liu so urgently was due to the emergency of the situation this time.
If Manager Liu hadn't taken it upon himself to delegate all these tasks, perhaps this wouldn't have happened.
Even now, Lin Yi indeed felt some regret.
If he hadn't been so stringent with his demands at that time, maybe Manager Liu wouldn't have done so.
After all, Old Liu had been with him for six years, and Manager Liu had always been devoted and loyal in his work, never having any ulterior motives.
"Come on, sit down and let's talk."
Lin Yi sighed deeply with profound meaning and then waved him over.
At this moment, Manager Liu seemed indeed a bit fearful.
He still felt his ears ringing.
"President Lin, if you have anything to say, just say it here, I am listening."
"Heh, you don't need to be so nervous. I was indeed impulsive just now, and I'm sorry for that. I apologize to you for that."
"President Lin, no no no, you don't need to, you don't need to; after all, I was the one at fault first, and you were very anxious at that time, I can understand."
"Alright, sit down and let's talk."
Seeing Lin Yi's attitude at this time, and at this moment, Manager Liu finally took a long breath of relief, at least Lin Yi wasn't pressing him at every step.
"I know that you have indeed worked hard for the pharmacy over the years, and I remember all this."
"President Lin, if it weren't for your good leadership, maybe I couldn't have done so much. But today's outcome, I really didn't expect."
"Alright, since it's already happened, I don't want to blame you anymore. I won't hold this matter against you. But remember, learn from this and think carefully before doing anything in the future."
"Yes, I understand."
"Besides, these medicines are our exclusive secret formulas, unobtainable anywhere else. You represent my influence; if you were to open up this agency situation, wouldn't the whole market be thrown into chaos?"
"But have you considered if we rely solely on this pharmacy to sell, our productivity is ultimately limited, and our sales capacity won't be able to reach that point either."
"I never thought about relying on all this to make money. I just want it to truly benefit humanity. I haven't considered the rest, especially money, and I don't regard it as a problem."
In this regard, Lin Yi's disagreement with him was indeed substantial.
Manager Liu felt that if you run such a pharmacy, a company, and even have a pharmacy below, it is equivalent to pursuing a traditional and integrated development.
Inevitably, in the end, the business needs to expand further.
But in these six years, Lin Yi seemed not to show any signs of expansion.
Given his current financial strength, opening a few more branches would be a very normal thing to do.
But Lin Yi had not done so.
Manager Liu had never questioned him, so there must be reasons and rationale for his actions.
"Actually, I know what you are thinking, but blindly expanding the business isn't necessarily a good thing. I feel that I can fully manage a company, a pharmaceutical factory, and a pharmacy by myself. If I really had several more, then it would certainly be more than I could handle."
"Hmm, if you say so, it makes sense, but you could also hire some professional management teams from outside. They would take good care of your business."
"Heh, those people out there, I don't trust at all. And with medicines like these, just giving out one agency right has led to such a big accident. If I opened it up completely to the market, do you know how many problems could follow?"
Yes, that was a reasonable point.
Manager Liu, having been in the business world for so many years, naturally understood this principle very well.
"President Lin, let me express my stance: I'll follow your orders no matter what. If you tell me to go east, I definitely won't go west. If you don't want to expand the business, I'll just make sure to take good care of this shop for you."
"This shop, sigh, let's not talk about this anymore."
Lin Yi just sighed deeply and afterward, surveyed the pharmacy thoroughly.
He seemed to have an inkling that the outcome of this matter might not be as simple as he had imagined.

chapters.title: Chapter 351 Wang Sheng Takes the Opportunity to Return
chapters.content:
At present, all of this is not very clear, so he dares not rashly speak out.
"Alright, you should also go home and rest for a bit now. The investigation on this side should be proceeding step by step, and I will find the poisoner as soon as possible."
"So if we find that person, can we formally clear our suspicion?"
"We can indeed clear our suspicion, but the key issue is that in the end, we will definitely still be the ones compensating. We must follow up on this."
Manager Liu didn't say anything, just lowered his head.
"Then, what do you think, maybe I should also put in some money, but it can't be too much, I just bought a house and I'm a bit financially strained."
He hesitated and stumbled before finally getting these words out.
Taking money from him was like cutting flesh from his body.
"No worries, I can handle this amount of money. Keep your money for yourself, alright? If there's nothing else, then I'll take my leave first. Tidy up the pharmacy again, check everything, and then leave this place. Remember, make sure to lock the door."
"Sure, I understand, President Lin. Shall I see you out?"
"No need, I can manage on my own."
After saying this, he nodded his head, then stood up and left the pharmacy.
Hei Lang had already driven the car away.
Therefore, if Lin Yi wanted to return, he had to solve it by himself.
He didn't want to return to the company for now, as Ling'er was watching over it. He just wanted to stroll around and look around.
For so many years, all his focus was on his business, seemingly forgetting to pay attention to the development of this city for quite a long time.
At that moment, inside a 4-bedroom 2-living room house.
Han Xuemei was pacing back and forth inside, anxious.
She also saw the news this morning.
She felt surprised, and before, she had heard from Lin Yi that the Elixir was very successful and would absolutely not have any problems.
But now, with such a big incident occurring, it seemed like actually a piece of good news for her.
Only now, she was not clear about the specific situation outside.
Although she had opened the internet and searched for many related news stories, the progress of the event seemed not to be updated in time online,
and under her current circumstances, Wang Sheng had told her that she couldn't go out casually.
Experience new tales on My Virtual Library Empire
She could only ask Wang Sheng for help, asking him to come over and meet with her as soon as possible,
In fact, Wang Sheng originally planned to go to Han Xuemei's place.
It was because Lin Yi was now in such a big mess, and he likely needed people by his side at that time.
So, Wang Sheng could take this opportunity to get close to Lin Yi, which wouldn't arouse any suspicion and might even earn his goodwill.
After weighing his options, he still chose to go to Lin Yi's place.
He could only call the woman.
"What's happening? I've been waiting for you for a long time here. Why haven't you arrived?"
"I can't make it now, something big has happened at Lin Yi's end, so I must rush over as soon as possible. If you have something to say, just say it briefly over the phone."
"I know, what I'm asking about right now is that matter. What exactly happened?"
"They say it's medicine poisoning, haha, but isn't this exactly the outcome we wanted to see? He's probably swamped with lawsuits now."
"Yes, the outcome is not bad, but the main issue is, how could someone as cautious as him let such a big thing happen?"
"That's why, I find this matter strange too, and that's why I am going over to investigate. If there's any news, I'll come and meet with you tonight."
"Alright, then I understand. By the way, Zhao Guangchen called me earlier, saying that no one has rushed over there yet."
"Oh, they should be there this afternoon; they are coming from out of town, and they need to prepare some instruments and equipment."
"Okay, fine, then I know what to reply."
"Just keep him steady for now, wait for the news here. If everything goes smoothly, I should be able to see you tonight."
"Okay, I understand, then be careful. I will wait for you here tonight."
Her words seemed to carry a profound meaning.
Moreover, they were filled with ambiguity.
Just hearing her voice made Wang Sheng's heart start to feel uneasy.
He even wanted to rush home impulsively and press this woman beneath him.
But he knew that reason ultimately could not allow such an action.
After all, there were big matters waiting for him, and he could not ruin his lifelong affairs because of a woman.
When Wang Sheng found Lin Yi, he was outside of a plaza.
He was puzzled, as at that time, he was neither at the company nor at home, nor in the pharmacy.
Why would he linger alone in a plaza?
"Master."
Wang Sheng walked quickly towards him and then called out to him.
Lin Yi just looked back at him.
"Where have you been these past few days?"
"Master, I've been hiding these past few days, seeking some peace and cutting ties with some previous matters. Master, I am now ready to fully devote myself to your side."
"In the future, don't call me Master."
"Master, what do you mean? Is it because of this that you are expelling me from the sect?"
"Wang Sheng, don't be so dramatic. We never really had a master-disciple relationship to begin with. If you are willing to stay by my side, I would hope you could help me with some tasks, but beyond that, I don't need you to do anything else, and I can't teach you anything."
"Then, what should I...?"
"You need not call me Master. If you are willing, just call me Brother Lin from now on."
"Alright, Brother Lin, I'll call you Brother Lin. I've read about the events in the newspaper. If it weren't for this incident, I wouldn't have shown up so soon. Brother Lin, just tell me what needs to be done."
"So, you're ready to come back to my side now?"
"Where else could I go if not here? If I go back to my family, the old man will surely be relentless. It might be better to be by your side; the old man should be more at ease."

chapters.title: Chapter 352 Wang Sheng's Tender Land
chapters.content:
At this juncture, Lin Yi actually didn't have that many thoughts running through his mind.
He truly did not expect that Wang Sheng would reveal so much craftiness in his presence.
If he had known it was like this, he surely wouldn't have kept such a dangerous element by his side.
"Yes, I am indeed a bit short-staffed right now, and if you could dedicate yourself to the task, then I would be willing to entrust you with it."
"Great, Brother Lin, just tell me what I need to do."
"Right now, the hospital is still short-staffed, and moreover, we need someone capable of communication; ultimately, negotiations for compensation and various expenses will probably start soon. Can you take care of this matter?"
"Alright, no problem, I will talk to them, and when it comes to negotiating about money, there definitely won't be any issues. You can rest assured that I'll press the costs down as low as possible."
"No, I don't want you to press it to the lowest; I want you to try your best to meet their needs, and if the demands aren't too excessive, try to satisfy each and every one. In addition, there are several patients in the intensive care unit that you have to keep a close eye on for me."
"Okay, I understand. You can rely on me to complete it."
"Alright, if that's the case, you can head over there."
"But Brother Lin, this Elixir—its sudden emergence of toxicity—if it's like this, don't we need to investigate everything?"
"That I naturally have arranged for. You don't need to worry about it."
"Okay, I understand. I'll go to the hospital right now."
Wang Sheng agreed very readily.
Because he knew that it was not the time for him to argue about anything.
Being allowed to stay by his side and given some tasks was already a stroke of luck amidst the misfortune for him.
If it were someone else, perhaps they would have kicked him out of the loop completely for disappearing without notice these past few days.
But Lin Yi didn't do that; what he valued was precisely Lin Yi's soft-heartedness.
However, he still felt some resentment in his heart.
Because it was obvious that Lin Yi did not truly consider him as one of his own.
The most critical thing was, the core task, he was not asked to undertake—Lin Yi had probably handed it to Hei Lang by his side.
And this task of going to the hospital, to be honest, apart from being able to know the progress of the patients, he wouldn't be able to uncover anything else.
"Forget it, to have gotten this far in the situation is already not easy."
At 9:00 p.m., after he finished all the work at the hospital, he dragged his weary body back to his original residence.
And at that time, Han Xuemei had already been waiting there for a long time.
"My dear, you finally came back. I've been waiting here for you all night; the meal is ready."
Han Xuemei spoke and pointed in that direction, and indeed, several dishes were prepared.
But at this moment, Wang Sheng had no appetite for a feast at all.
Over the afternoon, no, even adding all night to it, Wang Sheng felt his mouth, including his brain, had never stopped.
Even though he was always at the hospital, attending to all sorts of matters and recording their requests one by one was extremely exhausting for him.
"Hmm, no, I don't think I can eat; I'm truly very, very tired."
Continue your saga on My Virtual Library Empire
While speaking, he collapsed onto the sofa as if he never wanted to leave that spot again.
"Tired, are you? Come, let me give you a massage."
Han Xue Mei was quite considerate. After all, as a woman who made a living with her body, she at least had this skill.
Han Xue Mei laid Wang Sheng down on her thighs and then placed her hands on his shoulders, gently kneading them.
And it turned out that this woman really had some skills; after a few kneads, Wang Sheng actually began to feel sleepy.
"Did you learn this before?"
"Yes, when I was with Zhao Guangchen, I learned this; he had specifically arranged it so that I could massage him when he was tired."
"I didn't expect you to be so good at it; after a few presses, I feel much more comfortable."
"Right? That's why you must come to me when you feel tired in the future. I'll definitely make you comfortable, and tonight, I will make you comfortable as well."
Han Xue Mei suddenly lowered her voice, then leaned her mouth close to his ear, lightly breathing out.
At that moment, Wang Sheng's masculinity was once again unveiled.
The feeling of weariness completely vanished, and he pressed Han Xue Mei beneath him.
As their eyes met, he could clearly hear the shy moans coming from Han Xue Mei.
"Hey, what are you doing? Why are you so rough? Can't we, we go to the bedroom instead?"
"No, I can't wait any longer."
With those words, he pressed his mouth against hers.
Inside the room, naturally, ensued a moment of springtime passion.
After everything was over, he just leaned back on the sofa and then lit a cigarette.
Han Xue Mei came over and softly leaned against him, sliding her fingers constantly across his chest.
"How about it, is everything settled over there?"
Han Xue Mei was a very smart person.
Upon arriving here earlier, she had actually wanted to inquire about Lin Yi's affairs, but she feared that doing so might backfire.
After all, Wang Sheng was already weary to that extent; logically, she should be sympathetic rather than focusing on that matter.
So, after that bout of intimacy, Han Xue Mei finally voiced the doubts in her heart.
"It's still the same really, and that man—he doesn't trust me at all."
"Which man? Are you talking about Lin Yi?"
"Yes, Lin Yi."
"What happened? Did he assign you any tasks? Or is it that he didn't keep you around at all? But that's not right; if he hadn't kept you around, where would you have spent the afternoon?"
"He did keep me on, but he only gave me some trivial tasks. He had me handle the post-incident compensation work at the hospital."

chapters.title: Chapter 353 Zhao Guangchen Goes Out
chapters.content:
"The hospital's post-incident compensation, oh, you mean the patients' conditions?"
"Yes, actually I want to look into the person who poisoned them. I really want to know, who could hate him so deeply, and also, who would be so bold?"
"Lin Yi, as far as I know, he has always been a very cautious person. He would certainly not hand these matters over to you easily, so you don't need to worry about it."
"But now, he's handing over the compensation work to me. It really makes no sense. All I have to do is distribute the money to these people, that's it."
"Can't you think of a way to stir up the relatives' emotions, and then, get them to keep making a fuss about this matter?"
Han Xuemei's intentions were definitely malicious. She just hoped that the bigger the trouble, the better. The more it became unmanageable, the happier she would feel inside.
"No, that's not right. If it gets too big, in the end, he won't be able to focus on it at all, and it would just wear him down completely."
"Wear him down? Wouldn't that save us a lot of trouble?"
"No, what I want is to personally, little by little, with my own means, crush him, not the current situation. Besides, he has plenty of money. If he throws money at the problem, not one person will make a peep, you believe me?"
"You mean to say that even if you incite them, you won't be able to stir them up?"
"Yes, don't think that Lin Yi is a fool. Can I do it alone? I'm telling you, he must be doing a lot of work in secret. If it's just me alone, I simply can't have that big of an impact. So, I better not thoughtlessly give it away, letting him find out."
Upon hearing what Wang Sheng had said, Han Xuemei carefully reminisced and felt that indeed, there seemed to be some truth in his words.
"Right, if you hadn't said that, I'd feel like my idea was quite naive. Alright then, we'll proceed according to your plans. By the way, about that matter, do you have any leads?"
"I've been stuck in the hospital all day; how would I have any leads? I have no idea what's going on."
"I've thought back carefully about the enmity he's accumulated over the past few years. However, in the last year or two, he has already managed to smoothly resolve most issues. Moreover, his business only involves selling these Elixirs, with no conflicts in other areas."
"So you're saying that in society no one should be targeting this Elixir, right?"
"That's very possible."
"That's really strange then."
At this point, Wang Sheng was also curious. He just furrowed his brow, finding some matters truly incomprehensible.
Who could it be that harbors such deep hatred against him?
Just then, Wang Sheng's phone suddenly rang.
He picked it up and saw that it was a call from his own people.

To her, the hand didn't feel warm at all.
She had thought he would gently rub her stomach, but unexpectedly, he just kept his hand there for about forty to fifty seconds.
But now, touching his hand, it didn't seem to be that warm.
"What's going on?"
"Nothing much, just treating some of the illness in your body."
"Treating illness? Since when do you have this ability?"
"Just happened to be convenient. Just now, it was a bit cold outside, and I know you often suffer from stomachaches, so wasn't it all just an educated guess?"
"Really?"
Han Xuewei was indeed somewhat skeptical.
Saying that her stomach was prone to pain was indeed true, and after all, she had been married to him for so many years.
If he didn't even know that much, then he truly wouldn't be a qualified husband.
"Yeah, now that the pain is gone, aren't we able to continue?"
Lin Yi did not want Han Xuewei to know that he now unexpectedly had this ability.
If she were to find out, most ordinary people simply wouldn't be able to accept such a reality.
"Oh, alright, let's continue. You were saying you want a career change, what do you want to do?"
"I want to be a doctor."
"What did you say? A doctor?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei's eyes widened once again in surprise.
"Yes, a doctor."
"Are you joking? You've never even studied in that field, and you don't have any theoretical knowledge. How can you just become a doctor?"

chapters.title: Chapter 359 Are they selling dog meat under the guise of selling sheep?
chapters.content:
"What I want to do is be that kind of barefoot doctor."
"Barefoot doctor? I get it, you mean someone without a license who goes around treating people, is that right?"
"Exactly, that's what I mean. Do you think I have the ability to get any kind of license now? I simply can't."
"So what are your actual skills? How can you treat people? Moreover, if you can't cure someone and end up causing disability or injury, won't that lead to even bigger problems? No, no, this is absolutely unacceptable."
Lin Yi had just shared his idea when Han Xuewei quickly contested it.
"How will I know if I don't try?"
"What's there to try? So, just because you warmed up my stomach earlier, you think you're some kind of miracle doctor?"
"Heh, that's not it. I'll have you know, I just got in touch with Zhou Kongshan this afternoon."
"Oh? What did he say? Is the factory unable to produce now?"
"Yes, indeed they're unable to produce. Besides, there's a batch of medicine stockpiled that I have to find a way to sell, right?"
"I see. You want to use the guise of a barefoot doctor to sell these elixirs to the people who need them, don't you?"
"Exactly, what else? You're smart."
"But you can't just rush into this. And what if something really goes wrong?"
"Don't worry. If I'm not absolutely sure about a patient, I definitely won't act rashly. Besides, I'll have a professional by my side just in case."
"I still think it's risky, even if it's just to avoid wasting those elixirs. I feel like you're oversimplifying things."
"At the moment, it's only a preliminary idea in my mind. Whether or not it can be implemented, that's another matter entirely. Besides, even if I decide to do this, I certainly won't be using that kind of guise."
"If not that guise, then what? Are you planning to bait and switch?"
Hearing Han Xuewei use that term, he felt that it perfectly described his current situation.
"Right, bait and switch. At this point, I have no other choice; that's all I can do." Find adventures on My Virtual Library Empire
"But by doing this, aren't you just..."
"Taking a risk, you mean?"
Without Han Xuewei needing to say it, he knew she was about to stress something to him again.
"Since you already know, why would I still do it?"
