"I have no choice. If I don'Transform, how am I supposed to feed so many people below me?"
"A factory, a company, and a pharmacy – when all those staff are added up, that must be at least a hundred people, right?"
"A total of 178 people."
"178 people, are you kidding me? How can you support 178 people? Just by being a doctor and earning that money?"
"I certainly can't support that many people. At least, most of the sales staff at the company, pharmacy, and factory can't be retained."
"Then what do you want to do?"
"All I can do is make my best effort, then gather a portion of the people to stay by my side, otherwise, the team will fall apart."
"Actually, I've wondered before if we couldn't just do some legitimate business."
"Legitimate? What do you mean by legitimate business? Xue Mei, do you think the sales work I do is illegitimate?"
"That's not what I mean, I just feel that..."
Han Xuewei herself couldn't articulate the thoughts in her heart.
Anyway, from the very beginning, she wasn't sure whether she would truly approve of the path Lin Yi had taken.
"It's getting late, hurry back to rest. And I'll emphasize again, stay out of the hospital business. If you still listen to me, you should return to school as soon as possible and finish your studies."
"I understand."
Han Xuewei did not speak. She just nodded silently.
Because she knew that no matter how much she said in front of Lin Yi at that moment, it wouldn't make any difference.
"What about you? Aren't you going to rest now?"
"I probably can't sleep at the moment. I want to think more carefully about what the future holds. Don't worry, I'll always prioritize my safety. Not just for me, you know. Don't I have you and the three children to consider? Why wouldn't I take care of you?"
These words truly struck a chord in Han Xuewei's heart.
If Lin Yi really thought like that, maybe their journey wouldn't be so difficult.
"Still, I respect your thoughts and your choices. Go to sleep early."
After leaving those words behind, Han Xuewei turned and went back to her room on the second floor.
Even after returning to her room, Han Xuewei's heart still hadn't settled.
She was constantly worried about Lin Yi's current situation.
Just now, her phone kept vibrating.
Han Xuewei had sneakily taken a glance; it was a call from Lin Yi's father.
This was the usual way things were dealt with in their family.
After all, Lin Yi was just like his father: both were stubborn and didn't like being managed too much.
So, whenever there was something to discuss, his father-in-law would typically call his daughter-in-law's phone.
Han Xuewei listened for a while, there was still no noise outside, probably he was still sitting in the downstairs living room.
"Dad, what's up?"
"Are you still at school right now?"
"No, I've come home. I was talking with Lin Yi just now, so it wasn't convenient to answer your call."
"Then does that mean, you've already started discussing this issue?"
"Yes, we have indeed talked about it."
"And what about Lin Yi? What is he thinking now?"
"He wants to transform and lead everyone to start over."
"What? Keep going? When he wanted to buy those supplies, I already told him that this industry is ultimately unstable."

chapters.title: Chapter 360 New Mission
chapters.content:
"Yeah, I've talked to him about it before, but he just wouldn't listen. He's dead set on continuing down this path."
"Sigh, speaking of my son, I really have nothing to say. Our family certainly has the means, and he could live a comfortable life without doing any of this."
"Dad, we've already told him all of this before, but you know what Lin Yi is like, don't you?"
"Xue Mei, actually, I have a request."
"Okay, Dad, just tell me what it is."
"I'm really worried about him being out there on his own, so, after you graduate from school—oh, right, aren't you guys about to graduate?"
Everyone in the family was aware of Han Xuewei's school situation, including the timeline for her graduation.
"There are two more months left. Actually, there isn't much to do in the final month. In two months, we'll take the exams and, if I pass, I'll graduate successfully."
"Will there be any issues on your end? If so, just let me know. I'm quite familiar with the dean of your college, and I can put in a good word for you if necessary."
"Dad, there are no issues. Didn't I tell you before? Even if I were to go, I would definitely make my own way."
"Xue Mei, you've never disappointed me, and I know you're capable in this regard. I just hope that after you graduate, you can return to his side."
"Return to his side? Dad, I don't understand, aren't I already by his side?"
"No, that's not what I mean. I mean for you to go assist him. Whatever he does, you need to keep a close watch for me."
"That?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xuewei did hesitate.
Truth be told, she had considered this idea before, but worried that, given Lin Yi's temperament, he might not so easily agree to it.
"I'm getting on in years, and he's my only son. I truly don't want him to continue down this road. If you're by his side, perhaps he will make more rational decisions, and I can rest easy."
"I'll think about this carefully. After all, everything I do is for his benefit."
"Good, if that's the case, then I won't bother you any longer. Oh, and about the child, rest assured, I'm feeling my age now and not as capable as I once was, so I'm planning to step back soon. After that, your mother and I will devote ourselves entirely to helping you with the child. You can count on us."
His words were like a soothing pill for Han Xuewei.
"Okay, I understand. Thank you, and Mom, for taking on this burden."
"Alright, let's not talk about that now. You should also get some rest soon. Remember, if there's anything wrong with Lin Yi, you must inform me promptly, understood?"
"Got it, I'll let you know. Oh, and thanks for last time."
Saying this, Han Xuewei seemed to suddenly remember something.
Last time, when little Bao was taken away by Han Xuemei, someone had secretly helped out.
Although Lin Yi hadn't talked to her about it after he returned, she knew that the person who had helped must have been him.
"Heh, it was nothing. Besides, I'm always keeping an eye on your actions. If anyone tries to harm my grandson, then I'll stake my life to fight them."
"Don't worry, nothing like that will happen again."
"Okay, we can communicate timely if anything comes up."
After finishing these words, the call ended.
The conversation left Han Xuewei's heart in a tight knot.
If that's the case, does she really have to follow her father-in-law's suggestion and go to his side after she graduates?
Forget it, thinking about this now is meaningless. After all, there are still two months left.
In two months, if the situation changes, maybe Lin Yi will see the difficulties and give up everything to return to his family life.
This outcome is also a possibility.
While Han Xuewei hoped for this, she knew the chances were incredibly slim.
It wasn't until midnight that Lin Yi finally made up his mind.
He was determined to continue down this path, to go further and further as a doctor and benefit humanity and society.
Just as he was about to get up and head back to his room to rest, his body started to beep again.
The system couldn't have timed it any better.
He had all night to stay here, so why hadn't it shown up until now?
"System, I'm here, go ahead."
"System, assigning you a new task."
"Okay, tell me, what's the task?"
"Assume a hidden identity and help the dying."
"What do you mean, 'hidden identity'?"
"Conceal your identity, aid the dying and injured. The system will grant you new skills at the appropriate time to facilitate your continued development. For now, your initial task is to treat five patients with bone injuries."
"Bone injury patients?"
"Task confirmation, task confirmation, starting from tomorrow, beep beep beep beep."
After uttering his last words, the system quickly disappeared within him once more.
This time, the system completely altered his course.
Initially, it had him persist in producing and selling elixirs.
But this time, it shifted gears, assigning him to act as a doctor to treat the sick and injured, requiring the healing of five patients with bone injuries.
If that's the case, once these five bone injury patients are treated, new skills might be granted, right? Stay tuned with My Virtual Library Empire
Thinking of this, Lin Yi felt a surge of excitement.
He had such high expectations for the system.
It always provided him with new energy at crucial moments.
With that thought, he suddenly had an epiphany.
No wonder the system had been silent all night, waiting to appear only after he made his decision.
It proved that the system was always monitoring his thoughts.
If his mind strayed off course, the system might detect and correct it timely.
If that's the case, he believed his journey in medicine would proceed much more smoothly.

chapters.title: Chapter 361 Zhou Kongshan's Proposal
chapters.content:
Early the next morning, he groggily opened his eyes.
He smelled something like the fragrance of milk from the table beside him.
Lin Yi opened his eyes and rubbed them.
"Xue Mei?"
He glanced over and at that moment, Han Xuewei, already neatly dressed, was standing by his bed.
He sat up from the bed and noticed that a cup of milk had been placed on the table beside him.
"I wanted to tell you that I need to rush back to school."
"Alright, alright, then you should head back."
"Also, I want to reiterate that no matter what you do, I will always support you wholeheartedly."
"Your words are enough for me; don't worry, I will definitely not let you down."
After leaving these words behind, she turned and disappeared from his view.
Well, now that he had a new goal, he knew that there should be no more obstacles in the way.
He summoned all his people, and then at 9 a.m., he had gathered everyone in the company.
But this time, he was more cautious and did not call Wang Sheng over.
He always felt that Wang Sheng's heart was not truly with him.
If Wang Sheng remained completely dedicated to the development of things later on, perhaps he could draw him back in time.
However, he wasn't going to do that just yet.
Sitting here were all the people who had fought the business battles with him over the years.
Apart from Hei Lang, the rest were Ling'er, Zhou Kongshan, and Manager Liu.
"Alright, now that everyone is here, what I want to discuss today is about the future development of our company. You all understand what has been happening during this period, right?"
After saying this, he looked at everyone, and they simply nodded in agreement.
They actually realized that things didn't seem to be going well.
When they first arrived at the company, they noticed that there was already no one working there.
This was also due to the emergency notice Lin Yi had issued the night before, telling the staff to go home and rest for the time being and wait for their call or another outcome announcement.
"I know what everyone is thinking, and with a total of 178 people in the company, solving their livelihood problem is a big trouble we're facing right now."
"President Lin, besides this, can't we do anything else? Can't we think of ways to bring this Elixir factory back to life?"
The least willing to accept this was Zhou Kongshan.
He felt he had invested the most effort into this factory.
When the factory was just starting, the Refinement of Elixirs was a 24-hour non-stop operation.
To ensure the quality of the Elixirs, Zhou Kongshan also spent 24 hours in the workshop, eating and drinking there.
After each Refinement, he would carefully check it, as if caring for his own child.
But now, at the growth stage of his "child," it was on the verge of being nipped in the bud. How could any parent not feel heartache over this?
He didn't have high hopes; he could even accept a temporary closure for a month, two, or three, but the permanent loss of the factory was indeed a heavy blow to him.
"Old Zhou, I know what you're thinking, and to be honest, you have invested more heart and soul than even me into this factory. But there's no way around it—under these circumstances, we can't possibly continue to operate and produce these medicines, or we would be doomed."
"Sigh, actually, I've thought about this, and I know it won't be that simple. But what about all these employees? How can we explain this to them?"
"Old Zhou, rest assured about that. I've made all the necessary preparations for them. Also, I'm having the finance department calculate everyone's severance pay. Once we've completed the calculations, I will compensate them at the original valuations. Don't worry, I won't let you be in a difficult position."
"So, this factory is definitely gone, right?"
"Basically, there's no room left."
"Can't we be a bit more flexible?"
"What do you mean by flexible? How can we be flexible?"
Lin Yi, intrigued, didn't understand what Zhou Kongshan was thinking at this moment.
"If we can't produce medicine, we can always produce something else, right? We can't just suffocate here."
"Produce something else? What do you want to make?"
"Elixir production workshops are generally very similar to toy assembly lines. All we have to do is make some modifications, and it won't cost you much, probably around 100,000 yuan, to completely convert them."
"Are you suggesting we change the production line to a toy production line?"
"Yes, because it's unrealistic to change it to anything else. When I ordered this equipment before, I already understood that essentially, their principles are the same, and the process is one of assembly. However, some tools are different, so just a few modifications are necessary, and then we'll have two brand-new toy production lines."
After saying this, he just looked up at Lin Yi,
Because Lin Yi had never considered focusing on the production and management of toys.
Explore stories at My Virtual Library Empire
Hadn't he decided just the night before that he was going to practice medicine and help the dying and the injured?
And now, to have him produce toys—this was something he had never thought about.
"What you're proposing is a big change, and even if we start producing toys, where would our supply come from? And our orders? We don't know anything about that."
"Everything is possible when we make an effort. Who was born knowing how to do business? We can learn slowly. Even if it means making a loss in the early stages, we can probably break even Later Stages."
"Let's delay this discussion. For now, let's set aside the factory. The issue affecting the most employees now is your Elixir shop, isn't it?"
"Actually, there aren't many people in my shop. Including myself, there are only seven people in total. If President Lin can take care of them properly, there shouldn't be any problem, and it won't be that difficult."

chapters.title: Chapter 362 Transforming the Toy Factory
chapters.content:
"Okay, including the same severance pay as the toy factory's, which is three times their company's, and then, I will ensure that the funds reach their accounts as soon as possible."
"Okay, that's fine. The key issue is the inventory of medicines. How should we deal with them? And the total value of these medicines is quite a significant figure when added up."
"For now, the medicines will be temporarily sealed and stored together with those of the toy factory. Let's quickly get this door sealed off and, from now on, prevent any further involvement with us."
"Alright, understood. What about me, President Lin?" Find your next read at My Virtual Library Empire
This was the issue that Manager Liu was most concerned about.
Dismissing these employees wasn't a problem for him, as long as he could still remain by Lin Yi's side. He believed that one day he would have his chance to rise through the ranks.
But he also feared that Lin Yi might seize this opportunity to kick him to the curb, especially since this whole major incident had occurred due to him.
He had prepared himself for the possibility that if Lin Yi had decided not to keep him around, he definitely wouldn't stay shamelessly.
"Manager Liu, regarding you, you were in charge of sales in the early stages and are familiar with the business. In the later stages, perhaps, you could still be of use, so for now, you'll stay."
"President Lin, are you serious?"
When Manager Liu heard this, he truly felt a mixture of surprise and gratitude.
He had made such a grave mistake, yet now Lin Yi was willing to look past it and keep him by his side once again, which was indeed a significant gain for him.
"The reason I'm keeping you is because you still have some use. That's why I'm letting you stay. Also, I want to tell you that I don't keep idlers around. If, in the future business, you are unable to prove your worth, I'm sorry, but you'll also have to leave."
When Lin Yi spoke, his attitude was very determined.
Everyone knew that this was just the kind of person Lin Yi was: ordinarily attentive and careful with them, but very serious and earnest about crucial matters.
"Rest assured, President Lin, I absolutely will not let you down."
"Then there should be no problem here. The rest is all about the company's affairs. About the company, I had already temporarily laid them off yesterday, so I'll take responsibility for this side of things. If it gets too much for me to handle, Ling'er, you can give me a hand then."
"Okay, I got it."
"And Brother Lin, what about me?"
Hei Lang noticed that after going round the room, everyone else had been given tasks, but he seemed to have been left out.
"What, you need me to make arrangements for you? You just need to stay by my side to handle some special tasks; the rest has nothing to do with you."
"Okay, that's no problem, but what kind of special tasks?"
"Just go outside and find five patients with bone injuries."
"What? Five patients with bone injuries? What are you planning to do?"
"Don't worry about what I'm going to do. Just find me those patients with bone injuries, but do not bring them here by force for now, as it would be too conspicuous. Just get their home addresses when the time comes."
"Brother, what are you...?"
Hei Lang was utterly confused.
He had no idea what kind of "medicine" Lin Yi was brewing up.
Why all of a sudden does he need to find five patients with bone injuries? What connection do they have with him?
As far as he remembered, the elixir they were producing didn't seem to have much to do with bone injuries.
"No need to say anything, no need to ask anything, just do as I say. Five patients with bone injuries, no more, no less. Got it?"
"Okay, I understand. I'll go right now."
Once Hei Lang received his mission, he hurriedly left the conference room.
In fact, if Hei Lang stayed, he wouldn't be much help with the business discussions – traditionally, he had been a bodyguard, always by Lin Yi's side.
When Lin Yi encountered trouble or danger, Hei Lang would step up, but in usual business operations, it was rare to see Hei Lang around.
"Did everyone understand what I just mentioned? Moreover, within two days, do you think you can conclude these matters?"
"I'm absolutely sure there won't be a problem on my end. I believe the pharmacy staff already have an idea in their minds, so a simple conversation should do, especially since there's compensation involved."
"President Lin, I don't foresee any problems on the company's side either. I already discussed it with them over WeChat yesterday. They generally have a sensible attitude and definitely won't make trouble."
"What about you, Old Zhou?"
After the two had expressed their stance, Zhou Kongshan had been silent.
"My opinion is that we can't fire all the workers. At minimum, we have to keep half of them. If we really are going to switch to producing toys, we'll definitely need workers. Just a few of us can't handle everything."
"Converting to toy production…"
This phrase kept emerging in his mind.
He remembered the system had alerted him yesterday that if he really wanted to do all this, he had to hide his identity.
That meant even if he was curing people, he couldn't let anyone know he was playing the role of a doctor.
If, according to what Zhou Kongshan suggested, they converted the place into a toy factory, would that really conceal his identity?
The most convenient part was that the machinery for making the elixir was quite similar to that for producing toys. Although it would require an additional investment of 100,000 yuan, this was a relatively minor sum for him.
"You've all heard what Old Zhou said, what do you two think? Come on, voice your opinions."
"Well, I don't know much about producing toys, but if you really want me to sell toys and break into the market, I think I can make it happen."

chapters.title: Chapter 363 Exposed by Ling'er
chapters.content:
Manager Liu slapped his chest and assured.
In fact, for him, whether it was selling medicine or toys, it was much the same: merely finding customers from the outside.
As a sales genius, and having scrambled in the business world for so many years, he was quite familiar with the operational routines of the city.
"If it can be produced, are you confident that you can establish a certain market presence?"
"That, there's no problem, but the key point is, our toys must have a unique selling point. Only then can I be confident and guarantee this.".
"Alright, once this matter is over, you and Brother Zhou sit down and have a good talk. One in charge of production, the other of sales. The two of you need to take care of this for me. Of course, I don't need too many orders in the early stage, just enough to keep the factory running."
"President Lin, does that mean you've decided to keep this factory?"
"Brother Zhou, since you've said so much, if I were to forcefully shut down the factory, wouldn't you curse my ancestors for eight generations?"
No sooner had he finished speaking than everyone burst into laughter, leaving Zhou Kongshan a bit embarrassed.
"No, no, President Lin, I would never do that. I will follow your arrangements, but I am speaking up for these workers as well."
"Yes, you speak for the workers, and I must also speak for you. How about it? Any difficulties?"
"No difficulties at all. There's some funding left in the factory at the moment, and refitting the production line shouldn't be a big issue. I'll make it a priority."
"Good, then there's one more thing for the two of you. At the toy factory, help me set up some spacious offices – and the area must be large."
Continue your adventure with My Virtual Library Empire
"President Lin, what, what are you going to do?"
Zhou Kongshan was curious. He didn't know why he wanted the offices cleared out and what he planned to do with them.
"Of course, I'm going in. And since the company is closed and the pharmacy is out, renting these houses is pointless. Let's put them back on the market."
"Oh, are you going to work in the factory? Okay, no problem."
"Work? No no no no, you misunderstood. It's not for work. You just need to clear out the space for me, including whatever is needed inside – I will arrange that myself."
"Not to interrupt, President Lin, but aren't you going to the factory to manage it? And aren't there just desks and things inside?"
"No no, I'm not asking for that. Moreover, the location you find for me must be in a quiet and inconspicuous place."
"President Lin, if that's the case, I might as well find you a patch of empty space in the factory to build a new room for you."
"Heh, don't mention it, that actually is a great idea. Let's go with that."
Zhou Kongshan had said this casually, but to his surprise, Lin Yi took it seriously.
Well then, since the boss had spoken, under the current circumstances, erecting a room surely couldn't be stopped.
Besides, with a bare room, it seemed Lin Yi would have to prepare the interior by himself.
"President Lin, now that you've delegated these tasks, what do you plan to do?"
"What I do has nothing to do with your toy factory, so you don't need to know too much. All you need is to hold the fort for me; the rest doesn't concern you."
"Alright, we understand."
After Zhou Kongshan finished speaking, he just turned to look at Manager Liu.
He felt Manager Liu was truly full of questions and seemed to want to get to the bottom of things right there.
"Hey, Manager Liu, I have some things I need to discuss with you in detail. Shall we go to the factory now and talk on-site?"
"Oh, that's fine, that's fine. I'll go with you now. President Lin, you don't have any more business here, right?"
"Nothing more, there's nothing left. You two can go get ready. Also, about the factory matters, make sure to get it sorted for me, got it?"
"Got it, see you President Lin."
Finally, with all matters more or less handed off, the two men turned and left.
Now, only he and Ling'er were left.
Actually, Ling'er had always sensed something odd about him, his mood seeming a bit erratic.
"You definitely have something on your mind, President Lin. Are you keeping something from them? And it feels like the toy factory is just a façade, and what you're doing is selling dog meat under the guise of lamb."
Sure enough, Ling'er never let him down.
Her words struck the heart of the matter, and her keen insight saw through his actions and inner thoughts.
"Ling'er, to me, I did not keep you by my side in vain. Yes, using your sister-in-law's expression, it's exactly that: 'selling dog meat under the guise of lamb.'"
"But what does this 'dog meat' actually consist of? And just now, I heard you ask Hei Lang to find five patients with bone injuries. Does that mean, your intention is to practice medicine and save lives?"
"Right, Ling'er, you're correct. I've kept quiet about this in front of them because I wanted to keep this secret safeguarded. I just want to do these things undercover."
"But as far as I know, Brother Lin, you have no knowledge of medicine at all."
"Sigh, that was just because I hadn't studied it before. Actually, I have always had some interest in it, so I just learned but didn't tell you all."
"Why, though, are you specifically looking for patients with bone injuries?"
"Because I'm most proficient and familiar with the human skeletal and meridian systems. So, I want to start from the basics and work up from there. Gradually, we'll expand our medical scope."
"Then, what can I do?"

chapters.title: Chapter 364 Dealing with the Aftermath
chapters.content:
"Ling'er, your role is extremely important, let me tell you, your role is to utilize the most natural medicines we have to help treat these people, so I must have you," he said.
"Natural medicines? But at this time, they are really hard to find. What you can see on the streets are mostly finished western medicine products, and those traditional Chinese medicinal herbs are rarely used by anyone now. Even if they are used, they are mostly processed into patent medicines, but their ingredients have completely changed from what we used to know."
After saying this, Ling'er let out a long sigh.
Ling'er could remember the scenes of picking herbs with her master in the deep mountains and forests. Read new chapters at My Virtual Library Empire
She knew that only the medicinal herbs had the most astonishing effects and that their side effects on the human body were almost zero.
However, now the ingredients of both Chinese and Western medicines, although comprehensive and effective, also had significant side effects, which was a pressing issue.
"So, you've had such a plan in mind all along, including me, I still think your actions are somewhat risky, and you don't have a clue about medical treatment."
After hearing this, Lin Yi merely smiled.
These were the people around him, and their actions were essentially out of concern for him.
"Enough of this, you don't need to worry so much about these matters. You just need to focus on what you have to do next."
"I don't know what I'm supposed to do next. Anyway, I'll just follow your arrangements."
"Hmm, do you know the location of Xi Lian Mountain?"
"Xi Lian Mountain? I reckon I could walk there with my eyes closed. Of course, I know the place. Moreover, it's a natural pharmacy in itself but, in the last two years, due to a dramatic increase in wild animals, the number of people going there has dwindled, and it has even started to become deserted."
"I want to go with you to Xi Lian Mountain to gather some of the more precious Chinese medicinal herbs which will undoubtedly be of great use to us in the future."
"Hmm, I certainly want to go, but isn't it somewhat dangerous for us to just head there?"
"We'll talk about the dangers later. Just be prepared, we may need to move out at any time." "Alright, I'll definitely be ready on my side."
"Then that's settled, go handle the company's layoff matter, try to appease the staff as much as possible, bring this matter to a close as soon as you can, and then we'll move over to the factory area."
"Okay, got it."
After instructing her on the last matter, Ling'er stood up and left.
No sooner had she left, Wang Sheng came over from the other side.
Actually, Wang Sheng had been waiting outside for a long time.
He knew that some people were secretly discussing something important inside, but they hadn't called him over.
Clearly, they didn't regard him as one of their own.
Wang Sheng, too, had waited until Ling'er came out to avoid the awkwardness before he got up and entered.
Seeing Wang Sheng come in, Lin Yi was not surprised in the slightest.
He knew he couldn't keep Wang Sheng in the dark forever, but under the current circumstances, he still hoped Wang Sheng would keep his distance.
"Brother Lin."
After coming in, he called out to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi simply nodded, then gestured to a seat in front of him.
Wang Sheng took a seat at once.
"Brother Lin, were you holding a meeting just now?"
"Yes, we were discussing some matters. What's up?"
This Lin Yi, unexpectedly, was so forthcoming.
Wang Sheng thought that Lin Yi would at least save him some face, or at the very least, make up some other excuse to gloss over the matter.
But to his surprise, Lin Yi was so blunt, laying everything out in the open.
"Oh, so with such an important issue at hand, Brother Lin, why didn't you let me know? At the least, I could have come here to offer some advice?"
Wang Sheng was truly shameless to the extreme.
He knew face was of no use now; the key was to stay close to him, only then could he find out more information.
"After all, you've just joined my side, and it hasn't been long. You know too little about my company's affairs, so calling you over would have been meaningless. Tell me, what are you doing here?"
"Nothing, I just wanted to see what your next arrangements were, and besides, I've almost taken care of the aftermath at the hospital, just waiting for you to transfer the funds."
As he spoke, Wang Sheng placed a detailed list in front of Lin Yi.
Lin Yi glanced at it; there were various accounts, not too many. It would probably take him about an hour to transfer all the money.
"And the private settlement agreements? Have they all been signed?"
"Rest assured, everything is ready."
Wang Sheng truly came prepared, taking out all the documents and laying them out in front of Lin Yi.
Lin Yi, still somewhat concerned, scrutinized the documents carefully, afraid of overlooking something.
After all, he was bidding farewell to a chapter of his past, so everything had to be clear-cut; otherwise, if there were lingering ties, he wouldn't be able to move forward.
Wang Sheng, observing his attitude, was filled with seething fury.
He wished he could reveal all the secrets in his heart, but he couldn't; he had to endure and keep hiding in his current position.
Finally, Lin Yi finished reviewing all the reconciliation agreements.
"Hmm, not bad; everything has been signed, and there are no issues. Once we transfer the money to them, we'll have nothing further to worry about, right?"
"That's exactly the case."
"By the way, weren't you the only one at the hospital before? Han Xuewei was also there assisting you, but why didn't you mention this?"
As he spoke, Lin Yi began transferring money to the accounts while asking.
Wang Sheng was taken aback for a moment, because Han Xuewei had specifically told him not to reveal this matter to Lin Yi under any circumstances.

chapters.title: Chapter 365 Tempering Wang Sheng
chapters.content:
But now, Lin Yi had taken the initiative to ask about it. Clearly, he must have already known the ins and outs of this matter, which is why he came to ask me.
"But it was sister-in-law who told me, and she said not to tell you, so I didn't speak recklessly."
"Heh, you're quite obedient at this time. Didn't see you being so obedient before, did I?"
"Brother Lin, I, I didn't mean that. I was afraid that it might lead to conflicts between you and your wife. Then, wouldn't I become the sinner of all time? So, it's better to mind my own business rather than meddling. I really didn't say too much."
"Alright, there's nothing for you here now, you can go back. You've been worn out these past few days, take a good rest."
"Brother Lin, I'm not tired, not at all tired. Just tell me, what else needs to be done next?"
Wang Sheng truly seemed very determined, as he had made up his mind that no matter how Lin Yi tried to send him away, he absolutely could not leave.
He already had a plan in mind; he knew that at this time, he was supposed to end all business here, as he had already heard such news yesterday.
Suddenly, Lin Yi looked up at him.
"Are you sure you're not leaving? I'm telling you, I'm really about to have nothing left, and the company has already reached the brink of bankruptcy."
"No problem, Brother Lin, as long as there's food for you, leaving just a bit of soup for me is enough."
"Heh, really, enough with that. Do you know about the pharmaceutical factory from before?"
"Oh, you mean the factory where you produced medicine?"
"Yes, that place."
"I know, what about it?"
"You are to go there now, assist Manager Liu and Manager Zhang, and complete the factory's transformation."
"What? A factory transformation?"
"The pharmaceutical factory definitely can't continue as is, and can't start producing Elixir again, so, we're planning to transform entirely to toy manufacturing. If you're willing to stay, then stay there, responsible for some sales, running errands, that sort of thing."
"There's nothing else?"
"Sales, running errands?"
Wang Sheng felt somewhat amused inside.
Who did he think he was? How had he ended up in such a state?
"What, you want to do something else? Right now, all that I can let you do is just that. Beyond these tasks, there's nothing else you need to deal with."
"Oh, okay, then I understand."
At that moment, Wang Sheng looked somewhat dispirited, clearly not satisfied in his heart.
This kind of person was somewhat reluctant.
"Wang Sheng, I've always told you that you won't get much by my side, and your father could certainly give you important tasks on his side. Could it be that you're really underutilized here? You'd better seriously reconsider."
Actually, President Lin's attitude was very clear.
It was, I don't keep idlers here; if you want to stay, then start as a worker at the toy factory from the ground up.
If you don't wish to stay, that's exactly what I want anyway; I don't want to keep a young master around me.
"Brother Lin, don't worry. Whatever you ask me to do, I will comply unconditionally, including going to the toy factory."
"Heh, good, then off you go. I'll give Zhou Kongshan a call."
"Okay, I got it. So I should head there now, right?"
"Exactly, everything here has been wrapped up; you go over there and see the new toy production business."
"Alright, I understand."
After Zhou Kongshan finished speaking, he stood up and left the conference room.
Watching his retreating figure, Lin Yi couldn't help but shake his head in resignation. He really couldn't understand; what was his purpose for staying by his side?
Fine, whatever his purpose was, in any case, it didn't matter much to Lin Yi anymore.
From now on, his main focus was on treating patients, and any other matters wouldn't be related to him at all.
He could only leave Wang Sheng to stay at the toy factory, and he wouldn't let him interfere with anything else.
In that case, even if Wang Sheng had some purpose, it seemed like it wouldn't make any difference.
At the toy factory, with Zhou Kongshan and Manager Liu overseeing, he guessed that Wang Sheng was no match for them anyway.
"Hello, Old Zhou."
He picked up the phone and directly dialed Zhou Kongshan's number.
"Ah, President Lin, go ahead, what do you need?"
"It's like this, I'm sending someone over. When he arrives, just give him some tasks, then have him help you with some odds and ends."
"Oh, another person is coming over? Who is it?"
"Wang Sheng, the one I mentioned to you before."
"What, him?"
"No choice, he's been clinging on like a stubborn plaster, already stuck to me. His father did me a favor; at this point, I can't just cast him off. If he really wants to stay, then have him thoroughly tested at the toy factory."
Enjoy exclusive adventures from My Virtual Library Empire
"Okay, I understand, isn't it just employing someone? That's my strong suit."
"Alright then, I'll leave it to you. If there's any progress on your end, just update me in time."
After that, he hung up the phone; essentially, all arrangements that needed to be made had been handled.
The next steps were to see how things progressed with Hei Lang, and indeed, this business had to go ahead.
But in his heart, Lin Yi was still somewhat worried.
After all, he wasn't a specialist, and dealing with patient situations professionally, one must have someone to assist.
Just then, Liu Yao suddenly came to mind.
Exactly, Liu Yao was a nurse ready at hand, and having worked in the emergency department before, she could probably handle any patient with ease.
However, Liu Yao had some misunderstandings about him before; calling her over now, he truly didn't know if she would agree?
No matter, everything was manageable.
Wang Sheng spent a whole day at the toy factory in a daze.
He felt dizzy from busyness.

chapters.title: Chapter 366 Another Purpose
chapters.content:
```
This wasn't someone sent to supervise him at all; it was turning oneself into free labor, being ordered around here and there.
He had countless complaints in his heart, but he had no way to express them all yet.
It wasn't until 10:00 PM that he dragged his tired body back home.
Han Xuemei was completely unaware of what had happened today.
She always thought that Wang Sheng, remaining by Lin Yi's side, was plotting something big.
"What's wrong, why are you so tired? Is it because there's been some new development?"
Stay connected through My Virtual Library Empire
"Development my ass. He's already set up that toy factory."
"What? A toy factory? What does that have to do with him?"
Han Xuemei was also confused upon hearing this.
Going from selling medicine to suddenly selling toys was a drastic change, indeed.
"You wouldn't believe it even in your dreams, but his factory that used to produce medicine is now getting ready to transform into a toy factory. Right now, it's undergoing renovation, and I estimate that, at the fastest, it could be done in a week."
"Oh my goodness, is it really going through a transformation? If it's going to sell toys, it seems like it won't have anything to do with us in the future."
"I don't believe he would just give up everything like that. And just to make toys? I think that's somewhat unlikely."
"So you mean to say, he still has some other plan?"
"He definitely has a plan, and, they held a secretive meeting before. Unfortunately, they didn't let me attend it, so I have no idea what they discussed."
"What about the other people then? His previous company and the former toy factory had so many workers - have they all been let go now?"
"Aside from the toy factory, where half of the people were retained, the rest of the companies, including the pharmacy and the other half of the toy factory workers, have basically all been sent home."
Han Xuemei didn't understand why she suddenly felt a sense of disappointment upon hearing this.
Indeed, in this situation, it was unlikely she could do anything else.
The only thing she could do was to follow their development and continue to wait here.
Transforming into making toys seemed to have nothing to do with her at all.
If that was really the case, could it be that her desire for revenge had completely disappeared?
"So, you're at the toy factory now?"
"Yeah, since I wanted to stay by his side, he actually kicked me to the toy factory. Haha, treating me as free labor, today really wore me out."
"Then I think, staying on at the toy factory really doesn't make any sense. It might be better for you to properly explore your fighting skills again in this area. Don't worry, with my support, you'll definitely be okay."
"No, if I can't see his true intentions, I absolutely can't leave there. Besides, I always feel that Lin Yi is up to something secretive; he must be plotting something behind the scenes."
"Right, I think so too. But the key issue is, he doesn't trust you at all. Kicking you to the toy factory, how will you be able to investigate then?"
"You say that, but today I discovered something very important."
"Oh? What is it?"
Han Xue Mei became somewhat excited upon hearing this.
Any piece of information was crucial for them, so he wouldn't easily let go of anything.
"Today I heard that in a southeast corner of the factory, they're planning to build a two-story building with completely open rooms. From what I could gather, it's probably meant for Lin Yi."
"An office for Lin Yi?"
"Since when does an office have all of its rooms knocked through? Besides, there are vacant offices over there, but they're not being used. Instead, they're building a new one."
"Does that mean he's preparing to conduct some activities there?"
"Very likely. Could it be that he's going to secretly develop some elixirs there?"
"That's possible, after all, it's his specialty and also his old line of business. I'm not sure if he could truly give it up."
"So, I feel it's necessary to stay here. Although I won't focus on that direction, I can still pick up on some things from the comings and goings."
"Hmm, if that's the case, it's indeed necessary. Oh, how's the situation over there progressing?"
What Han Xuemei was concerned about was the situation with Zhao Guangchen.
After all, if Zhao Guangchen couldn't come forward, their plans couldn't proceed.
In essence, everything was ready except for the right opportunity.
"I made a call today to check; they say the cooperation so far is good, and the medicine has already entered the body. At the very least, changes should be noticeable in about seven days."
"Then, should I go take a look?"
"No, you can't see him during this transformation process. Besides, if you saw him now, you might not be able to accept his appearance. Everything is gradually changing."
After hearing this, Han Xuemei simply nodded in agreement.
She couldn't be concerned with so much. As long as they could completely transform him, their goal would easily be achieved.
Hei Lang had been searching for patients with bone injuries these past few days.
He had never paid attention to such matters before, and now, suddenly being assigned such a task indeed made it difficult for him.
Asking him to inquire about a person, or to investigate other matters, that was easy to handle.
But searching for patients, he really found it challenging.
Hei Lang squatted at the side of the road, with a cigarette in his mouth, drawing on it hard.
Suddenly, a thought flashed through his mind.
Right, why hadn't he thought of the hospital?
If he found the orthopedics ward in the hospital, most of the people there would probably be suffering from bone issues and hence been admitted.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 367 Hei Lang is Detained
chapters.content:
Why bother looking here and there on this road?
Right, that's exactly how it should be.
With that thought, he stubbed out his cigarette forcefully on the ground, and then hurried towards the People's Hospital.
The orthopedic department of the People's Hospital was actually a fairly well-known local division, currently serving as a core business of the hospital.
Moreover, most of the hospital's income actually came from the orthopedics department.
Here, it could be said that beds were hard to come by,
Under normal circumstances, unless it was very serious, unless surgery was needed immediately, you would need to queue outside and wait.
At the very least, it would take about a week before you could actually be admitted.
After arriving here, Hei Lang truly felt an overwhelming sense of overcrowding.
Inside, people were packed tight, everyone was shoulder to shoulder, and even, strange smells could be detected everywhere.
Hei Lang subconsciously covered his nose and mouth with his hand, and then walked towards the corridor ahead.
He had just walked a short distance when he stopped; he found that this should be a bungalow.
He looked through the glass and glanced inside; yes, he was right—most of the people in there had bone injuries, either on their legs or arms, all wrapped in bandages, some even suspended above their beds.
There you have it, a room full of patients.
But the key question was, how should he resolve the issues with these patients?
Besides, people were being well taken care of here. If he tells them, and then, could he take them away? Do you think they would believe all this?
"What are you doing here?"
Just then, Hei Lang suddenly turned his head and noticed a woman speaking to him.
He paused to recall carefully; this woman seemed familiar.
Originally, Hei Lang was a straightforward and careless person, and moreover, he didn't have much interest in women.
So even if a beauty stood in front of him, perhaps, by the second time they met, he might completely forget her.
He looked down at the name tag hanging on her chest.
It clearly read, "Liu Yao."
A realization suddenly dawned on him—oh, it was Liu Yao, the nurse he had met in the emergency room that night, and also, the one who had brought the Elixir to him.
"Hey, what are you doing here? Weren't you, you were in the emergency room, right?"
"Emergency room? That was because I was on night shift, temporarily assigned there. I'm supposed to be in orthopedics. By the way, why did you come here? Are you injured?"
Liu Yao looked Hei Lang over with curiosity.
From the looks of it, his arms and legs were fine; there was obviously nothing wrong with him.
Continue your journey with My Virtual Library Empire
"Oh, no, I, I came here to... oh, I came to find someone."
"Looking for someone? Who are you looking for? Tell me the name, and I'll check for you,"
Hei Lang's mind indeed wasn't working very sharply.
After coming here, he said he was looking for someone.
Clearly, she was a nurse here, and probably every detail about any patient was recorded by Liu Yao.
"Oh, no need to check, I'll go over there, I know he's just in the ward up ahead, and then, I'll have a few words with him and be on my way. You don't need to worry about it,"
"Wait a minute."
Hei Lang had just prepared to leave the place as if fleeing for his life, but at that moment, the woman stopped him again.
"What now, is there anything else?"
"You look all sneaky, definitely up to something. Tell me, did Lin Yi arrange for you to do something?"
"No, this, what does this have to do with Big Brother? And besides, it's just some private matters of my own. Can't I visit a friend when I come here?"
"Visit your friend? And yet you're sneaking around so? Fine, didn't you say it was the ward up ahead? Come, I'll go with you."
Anyway, she had just finished making her rounds, and the potions that needed to be hung had already been hung.
She had plenty of free time, but she just wanted to see how Hei Lang would step by step be exposed by her.
"Oh, you, go about your business, don't bother about mine, and besides, my...
"What's the matter? Have I hit the nail on the head? Is it that Lin Yi arranged for you to come here? But what did he send you to do? Come on, tell the truth. If you don't, I'll call security."
"Goodness, stop it, okay? I, I really, alright alright, I won't look anymore, okay? I'm leaving; I'll leave right now."
"Leave? Where do you think you're going?"
Liu Yao's stubborn temper had indeed flared up, and she suddenly blocked his way.
"What, what are you trying to do?"
"If it were a man in front of him, Hei Lang wouldn't hesitate and would likely have knocked him out with a punch.
But now, she was a woman.
And Hei Lang's biggest taboo was to never hit a woman.
So, in this moment, he was truly panicked.
The closer she got to him, the more Hei Lang felt an increasing discomfort.
With each step, Liu Yao cornered Hei Lang more and more until she had him trapped in a corner.
"You, what are you doing? I, I already said I'm leaving."
"Go? I won't let you. Come with me, or else I'll start screaming, and then, I'll accuse you of indecency."
Truly, this was a woman's trump card.
Hei Lang instantly caved.
"Alright, alright, where, where do you want me to go?"
"Come with me."
As she spoke, Liu Yao had him follow her step by step, until at last, they turned a corner in the corridor and entered a room.
The room was not very large, and it was adorned in a very kawaii style.
Everything inside, from the bed sheets to the curtains, and all other items, was pink.
Clearly, this was probably where the woman usually rested.
This was also a single dormitory, and it seemed that besides her, there were no other people in the room.
"Alright, now that I'm here, what do you want to do? Please, I have a lot of things waiting for me outside, I don't want to waste time here, okay?"
"If you want to leave, call your master now and have him come pick you up."
"What? My master?"
"Heh, sorry, I've been watching too many period dramas. I mean, call that Big Brother Lin Yi, and tell him to come get you. Otherwise, you're not leaving."

chapters.title: Chapter 368 Cold Attitude
chapters.content:
"There's no need for this, and besides, don't I know my way around?"
"You may know your way, but the key issue is that I don't trust you. You've been sneaking around the hospital, who knows what bad things you're up to? No way, you're not leaving unless he takes you away; otherwise, we'll call the police."
"Alright, alright, I got it, I'll make the call now, okay?"
Hei Lang became even more timid at this moment.
He most certainly didn't want to escalate these matters.
After all, Lin Yi was already immersed in a heap of lawsuits; bringing more trouble his way could really put him beyond redemption, even if he were to jump into the Yellow River.
"Hello, boss, where are you?"
At this time, Lin Yi was still in the company.
Although the company was empty, with not a soul around.
He still felt a sense of attachment to this place.
He was indeed going to officially leave this afternoon, but at the very least, he wanted to say a final farewell to the place.
"Oh, I'm at the company, getting ready to grab some stuff and then head over to the toy factory. What's up? Is something the matter?"
"Boss, can you, can you make a trip to People's Hospital?"
"What? People's Hospital? What's there to do at People's Hospital? Did you get into trouble again?"
When Lin Yi heard this, he suddenly became alert.
He remembered clearly that the last phone call in the middle of the night had summoned him to People's Hospital.
And afterward, it triggered a chain of effects.
Now, another visit to People's Hospital, what could follow?
Hei Lang was hemming and hawing over the phone, never really clarifying what was going on.
Liu Yao, who was beside him, couldn't stand it any longer. She stretched out her hand and snatched the phone away.
"Listen here, Mr. Lin, I don't know what you're planning, but I do not permit him to loiter around here. If you know what's good for you, get over here quickly. I'm giving you 20 minutes, hurry up and come pick him up."
"Liu Yao?"
Lin Yi immediately understood that the woman on the phone was Liu Yao.
But he was puzzled, as he had clearly instructed Hei Lang to go outside and find patients with bone injuries. How did Hei Lang end up with Liu Yao? And even at People's Hospital.
"Yes, it's me. Hurry up and come over. If you can't manage that, I'll just send him somewhere else. I refuse to believe that no one can handle you guys."
"Don't be angry, don't be angry, I'm coming right away, right away."
With that, Lin Yi hung up the phone in a fluster.
And then, he received an address on his cell phone.
But this time, it wasn't in the emergency department on the first floor, but in the orthopedics ward on the eighth floor, room 819.
Suddenly, everything clicked in his mind.
Damn, it must be due to Hei Lang being instructed to find a patient with bone injuries. Perhaps he couldn't find one outside, so he went directly to People's Hospital instead.
If he could actually find one in the hospital, then what's the need to have Hei Lang go through all the trouble outside?
This guy was really too foolish. Now, there was no use in complaining. The priority should be to quickly get Hei Lang out and then figure out what to do next.
Liu Yao waited in the room for about 15 minutes.
He heard a knock from outside, and then Liu Yao went straight to the door and opened it,
Standing outside was Lin Yi. Lin Yi stuck his head inside to take a look, and at that moment, Hei Lang was sitting on the edge of the bed with his head down like a defeated general, his head hanging low.
"Big brother, you, you've finally come."
When he saw Lin Yi, he suddenly became excited.
These past 15 minutes had felt as long as a year to him.
Being with this woman, Hei Lang felt a suffocating sensation.
No matter how she spoke to him, Hei Lang always kept silent and maintained a certain distance from her.
"What does this mean? Why is he here?"
"You should ask your brother that. I also want to know, what is he skulking around our orthopedics department for?"
"Wait, you, what did you say, your orthopedics department?"
Lin Yi heard that clearly.
"Yes, our orthopedics department."
As she spoke, Liu Yao took out her work badge. It was then he noticed that at the bottom of the badge, there was a line of text that read "Orthopedics."
"You're an orthopedic nurse?"
"No kidding, of course I'm an orthopedic nurse."
"Then why did you appear in the emergency department before?"
"The emergency department? I was temporarily transferred down there. Besides, we nurses are on a rotational basis. Usually, after half a year, we'll switch to a different department. I'm currently in orthopedics."
"So you mean to say that you can handle the work in any department?"
"What's so difficult about that? We were trained as general nurses, not some specialist nurses." Read latest stories on My Virtual Library Empire
"That's great, really great, can I have a word with you?"
Lin Yi suddenly became cheerful.
He always felt this was like finding something effortlessly after a long and arduous search.
The system had just assigned him the task of treating patients with orthopedic injuries.
If he could have a nurse who understood medicine and how to care for patients by his side, then the task would be truly simple.
"Chat? What do I have to chat about with you? Did you think I called you here to chat? I want you to take your people away as soon as possible and, unless it's necessary, don't show up at the hospital again."
At that moment, Liu Yao's tone was very firm and cold.
In fact, this was all within Lin Yi's expectations.
He knew that this woman still had some complaints against him.
"Right, those people have already been discharged, you know that, right? And, I have already done the follow-up and compensation for them."
"You don't need to report that to me and I haven't looked into that matter. I don't want to know."
"How long have you been working here now?"
"About three to four years, why, checking up on me?"
"Aren't you happy working here?"
"Happy? What's there to be happy or not happy about? And isn't working here all about making a living? I don't see what the big deal is."

chapters.title: Chapter 369 Opportunities to Exploit
chapters.content:
With her words, Lin Yi finally understood.
"Fine, putting food on the table, tell me, how much does this hospital pay you each month?"
"What, you want to poach me? To have me produce Elixir for you? To sell medicine for you?"
"Selling medicine is unlikely now, and I believe you must have seen the news reports. This time, my license should be completely revoked, so I won't be working in this field anymore."
"Then why ask me about this?"
"I just want to tell you that I can offer you more, and then, I hope you can join me. Of course, the job you'd be doing would remain the same."
"Why should I work with you?"
"For no other reason than I can offer you a generous salary."
"Hah, that's laughable. What, you think offering me more money will make me respect you? Do you really think that's the kind of person I am? Sorry, I don't have the time."
His tone was truly firm, and he rejected the offer so quickly.
"I really, I truly do want to invite you sincerely. Furthermore, let me tell you, I am not the kind of person you imagine. I won't do anything illegal. I just hope you can seriously consider what I've said."
"There's nothing to consider. And I can give you a complete answer now, your invitation, sorry, I simply cannot accept it. Now, take this person and leave immediately."
"No, you haven't asked me yet, what exactly I do. Also, don't reject me so quickly, otherwise, you will definitely regret it."
"Regret? I have nothing to regret. And let me tell you, once I say something, I will absolutely never regret it. Now, please leave immediately. I don't want to see you anymore."
"Boss, let's, let's just go."
Hei Lang, standing on the side, couldn't bear to listen anymore.
It felt like a great insult had been suffered.
He didn't want the boss to endure such an insult, so he simply grabbed Lin Yi's hand and left the room directly.
Once they were outside the nurses' station, Lin Yi suddenly broke free from his grasp.
"Hei Lang, what are you doing? I am on proper business here, and I truly wanted to invite her sincerely."
"Don't you see? She's been hostile towards us all along. Therefore, even if you invite her, she will never agree. Why waste time here?"
"No, I feel that she is a very appropriate candidate. If we could really get her to join us, our matters would become much simpler."
"Boss, are you joking with me? If she won't sabotage our plans by coming over, that in itself would be great. And now, you actually want to rely on her?"
"Liu Yao, Liu Yao…"
Suddenly, Lin Yi heard someone calling Liu Yao's name nearby.
He just turned to look, and it was probably Liu Yao, who hadn't come out of the room yet.
He just pulled Hei Lang, quietly hiding on the other side of the nurses' station.
To really get this woman, it was necessary to truly understand her.
"Hey, where's Liu Yao? Have you seen her?"
Just then, upon hearing this, that person hurried out and looked around.
"Oh, Liu Yao, she was just here, seems like she went back to her own room. She's already switched all her medicine."
"Oh, this child, I was wondering where she was. I've already prepared her mother's medicine. I told her to take it straight back. Plus, it needs to be stored in a cold chain, go call her for me."
"Oh, got it; I'll wait for you, Dr. Wang,"
the girl said hurriedly, then rushed to her room.
Her mother's medicine?
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi simply furrowed his brows in confusion.
It clearly revealed to him a fact.
Liu Yao's mother must be suffering from some kind of illness.
And to be able to get medicine from orthopedics, could that indicate she was afflicted with some sort of bone disease?
"Let's go, we're leaving,"
he suddenly said, as if something had occurred to him, and quickly pulled Hei Lang along as they left the place.
All along the way, Hei Lang felt utterly befuddled.
He was supposed to stay there, but for some reason, triggered by something, they were now hastily pulling away.
It wasn't until they reached the hospital's main entrance that he finally let go of Hei Lang.
"Wait a second, we'll stand across the street from the hospital and watch; I reckon Liu Yao will come out soon,"
"Who's going to come out? Big brother, what do you mean by that? Besides, you're not making any sense, I don't understand at all,"
Hei Lang asked with a puzzled look, looking at Lin Yi.
"Enough, you don't need to understand, you just need to know what I'm doing. Come on, let's go across the street; there's a big tree there. We can hide behind it and shouldn't be spotted,"
He had barely taken a few steps when something suddenly came to mind.
Right, he recalled being told where she lived.
If they staked out that place, wouldn't that be like waiting for the hare at the stump?
This damn brain of his must really have been overused in the past few days, starting to lose its sharpness.
"Go, get the car,"
"Big brother, what are we going to do?"
"Hurry up, I told you to get the car, just get the car."
"Oh, okay, okay, I'm on it,"
Hei Lang simply obeyed; after all, there were many things he couldn't understand.
After getting into the car, he looked back at Hei Lang.
"Go to that pharmacy we visited before; the one in Jinwan Community, you know where that is, right?"
"Jinwan Community, I know it; oh, I get it, does Liu Yao live there?"
It was only at this moment that Hei Lang suddenly realized they were waiting for Liu Yao.
It seemed that deep down, he hadn't truly given up on everything.
"You're finally catching on. Drive, let's go straight there,"
While driving, Hei Lang carefully mulled over the situation but still felt there were some aspects he couldn't comprehend.

chapters.title: Chapter 370 Retracing the Old Path?
chapters.content:
"Big Brother, why are we going to that place now? Moreover, we only know that she lives in that community, but specifically which building, which apartment in the community she lives in, we have no idea about any of these details."
"We only need to wait at the entrance of the community for news, and we should be able to see him."
"Wait at the community entrance? How do you know she'll come back?"
"Didn't you hear the doctor calling out her name just now?"
"Oh, I heard it, but isn't it normal for a doctor to call a nurse's name? They all say that doctors are the masters, and nurses are the servants, so all she has to do is follow the doctor's orders."
"That's not what I'm talking about. What I mean is he just said that the medicine prepared for her mother is ready and cannot be stored for long; it must be delivered immediately."
"I, I didn't really pay attention. What about it?"
"Imagine for a moment, this medicine was prescribed by an orthopedic doctor. What do you think it treats?"
"Prescribed by an orthopedic doctor, it must treat bones, right?"
"Right, medicine for treating bones. And there's another thing, haven't you found it strange? She works here as an orthopedic nurse and with such advanced conditions, she could completely arrange for her mother to be hospitalized here, but why didn't she?"
"Maybe the illness is very mild and doesn't require hospitalization?"
"No, I don't think it's that simple. Plus, haven't you noticed that this young girl is actually very kindhearted?"
"Yes, from the beginning, Big Brother, you said she was very kind, but what does that have to do with her mother's illness?"
"I mean that she has always been living with her mother, and her mother's illness has probably been going on for a long time."
"I don't understand that."
"The doctor just now let something slip in his words, and generally, ordinary diseases don't require these kinds of special medications that need cold-chain storage. It must be some other illness."
"Other illness? But still something to do with bones?"
"Should be something to do with bones."
"Oh, Big Brother, I understand now. Are you suggesting she's one of those five people?"
"That's the idea."
"After you cure her, Liu Yao will be deeply grateful to you. Naturally, she will follow you. Is that what you are trying to say?"
"Haha, look at you, Hei Lang, getting smarter all the time, understanding things without them being spelled out."
"Big Brother, I think what you're saying is just a pipe dream."
Although he initially felt that Hei Lang's words were completely logical, this last statement made him feel utterly disheartened.
"What do you mean by 'pipe dream'?"
"It's simple. You're not thinking it through. With the situation as it is now, how could he possibly follow us? Besides, if the hospital doctors can't cure the illness, do you think you can, Big Brother?"
"Don't worry about it, I'll handle the situation when the time comes."
Hei Lang could only shake his head helplessly.
He felt more and more that he did not understand his actions.
But after all, he was his Big Brother, so he wasn't the sort to worry too much.
"By the way, where is your ring?"
As he spoke, Lin Yi suddenly turned his head and noticed that the large ring that was always on Hei Lang's hand was now missing.
That ring was given to Hei Lang a few years ago, and it was worth about 80,000 yuan.
But he seemed to have not worn it recently.
"Oh, it's nothing. I took it off yesterday, while I was showering, and forgot to put it back on."
"No, tell me where the ring really went."
"Big Brother, I..."
Hei Lang appeared hesitant to speak.
"It's okay, tell me, have you run into some trouble? These past few days, I've been busy with pharmacy and factory matters and haven't paid much attention to you."
"Big Brother, actually, it's nothing serious."
"Right, you haven't gone gambling again, have you?"
As he said this, it seemed to strike a chord with Hei Lang's sore spot; he just slowly bowed his head.
In fact, Hei Lang used to have a serious gambling problem and it was Lin Yi who had pulled him out of the gambling scene.
If, after a few years, he had taken up old habits, it would be quite a problem for Lin Yi.
"Haven't I told you before that you can't get involved with gambling? Itching to gamble again, are you?"
"Big Brother, I didn't mean to, but I was forcefully dragged in, I had no choice, I... I played with them all night."
"Forcibly dragged in? Look, your legs are part of your body, can they tie you up and kidnap you or what?"
"Big Brother, you don't understand, those people are really not to be trifled with, and back then, they were all in the same team as me, I couldn't bring myself to refuse."
"Who are you talking about?"
"About who? Big Brother, you don't know them. He's now in the underworld, and I didn't want to cause more trouble, so I just followed their lead and went gambling with them."
"And during the gambling, you pawned this ring, didn't you?"
"Sigh, not just the ring, now the house is mortgaged there too."
"What do you mean? The house has been mortgaged?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was shocked, wide-eyed.
In Lin Yi's opinion, Hei Lang shouldn't be lacking money.
His monthly salary for Hei Lang was about 20,000 yuan, sometimes even more.
And usually, there wasn't much for Hei Lang to do.
His expenses were for one person only, so they shouldn't be too high.
If he had managed to save up, at the very least, he should have around one or two hundred thousand yuan by now.
"Yes, I lost too much that time and, as you know, gamblers always think the more they lose, the bigger they should bet – just trying to win it all back in one go. Who would have thought I'd end up mortgaging the house too."
"Tell me, how much do you owe him? Now that you've mortgaged the house."

chapters.title: Chapter 371 Redemption of Hei Lang
chapters.content:
"Roughly, I guess it's over 500,000 in total."
"Over 500,000? How much over? 590,000 or 510,000?"
"It should be 550,000."
"550,000? Do you have any idea how much your house is worth on the market?"
"I know, it should be around 700,000 right now."
"So you gave him this money, and you don't think this is a losing deal?"
"Yes, I know, but for now, I'm just temporarily mortgaging the deed with him, and I'll sell this house very soon. After I sell it, then I'll pay him."
"After you sell the house, where will you live?"
"Haha, big brother, you don't need to worry about me. I'm all alone; I can make do anywhere. You don't need to be concerned about that."
He saw Hei Lang, who still seemed clueless up to this moment.
Just this alone was enough to make Lin Yi feel a bit angry.
"Hei Lang, do you remember what I told you before? Have you forgotten it all?"
"Big brother, I remember."
"If you remember, then why did you still enter that casino?"
"Big brother, I, I also have my own difficulties, and, ah, I can't explain it all in a word or two to you. Don't worry, I can solve this matter."
"You'll solve my ass. You solve it by selling the house and then paying others? You call that a solution?"
"But, but I have no other choice."
"That's not right. Over the past few years, I have also given you a lot of money, all added up should also be close to a million, right? Where did that money go? Where is it?"
"That money, I sent it all back home to my dad, and, moreover, a new house was just built back home. Add to that my brother's marriage, so basically I don't have any savings on hand."
As he said this, Lin Yi indeed felt a bit heavy-hearted.
Now, including his brother's family, they all needed him for support.
Just relying on farming those few acres of land at home, they really couldn't earn much money at all.
And most of Hei Lang's money was actually spent on his family, which Lin Yi truly admired.
"Fine, don't sell your house for now. After I've dealt with this matter, I will go with you to meet that person, and then we'll get your deed back."
"Big brother, you, you don't mind. This matter doesn't concern you."
"Nonsense, how can my brother's affair not concern me? Since you are like this to me, I, of course, can't just stand by and watch you get to this step. I'll help you pay off the 500,000 plus."
"Big brother."
"Enough, if you say any more nonsense, I might just kick you aside. Do you believe that?"
After saying this, Hei Lang could only silently nod his head.
But he felt as if something was whirling around at the corners of his eyes.
He was holding back that feeling, not wanting to be a laughingstock in front of Lin Yi.
Finally, the car reached the vicinity of that neighborhood.
There was a parking lot on the opposite side, where Hei Lang immediately parked the car.
"Big brother, should we wait here or go to the entrance?"
"Let's go, to the entrance of the neighborhood."
"Doing that, won't that just expose us?"
"He won't notice us, and besides, she was too flustered when returning the medicine. She won't be aware of her surroundings. The main issue is, we must keep up with her. We must know where she actually lives."
"Alright, no problem, I can definitely keep up."
As they spoke, the two of them had already arrived at the entrance of the neighborhood, and then they stopped behind a guard booth.
Lin Yi stretched out his hand and checked the time; it had been just 10 minutes since they left the hospital.
Normally, Liu Yao should be riding an electric scooter. If they maintained this speed, she should be able to get here in about 5 minutes.
Lin Yi was waiting patiently here; he knew that today's matter was of great importance to him.
If they could successfully achieve their goal, not only would they resolve the issue with the first patient, but they would also gain a very capable assistant. For him, it would be killing two birds with one stone.
It also laid a good foundation for things to come.
About six or seven minutes later, sure enough, he saw Liu Yao arriving on an electric scooter and slowly riding towards them.
He could see that she had a large cold chain box in front of her, placed in her scooter's basket.
"Go, follow her."
As soon as Liu Yao entered the neighborhood, he gave the order, and they hurriedly followed her in.
The neighborhood was actually quite old, and from the outside, it definitely looked rundown.
Following Liu Yao around the complex, turning here and there, they finally stopped in front of a building.
Lin Yi looked up; it was building number 7.
Subsequently, at unit 2, Liu Yao dragged the cold chain box and went straight in.
"That's good enough. I can't go up now. You go up first and find out which floor and apartment it is. Then come down and meet up with me. Got it?"
"Okay, I got it."
Hei Lang nodded. After all, tracking people was one of his skills, and he would never let anyone detect his presence.
Lin Yi waited anxiously below.
He looked up at the building; it seemed to have about seven floors.
And each of these floors should have three apartments, all told there should be about 21 households.
Actually, if they searched each home or asked around at the entrance, they probably could find out.
Seeing his behavior, he must have lived here for some time.
Presumably, the neighbors, to his left and right, would have some understanding of his family's situation.
Just as Lin Yi was contemplating these issues below the building, he saw Hei Lang coming down from above.
"Well done, how did it go?"
"Big brother, I tracked her down. She's on the 7th floor, middle apartment."
"7th floor, it's the top floor, huh?"
"Right, the entire floor."
"Then did you see anything else?"
"Nothing else. She took out her keys, opened the door, and went straight in. After that, she did not come out. Big brother, what do we do now?"
"What else can we do? Of course, we go straight up. Come on, follow me."

chapters.title: Chapter 372 Miserable Family Circumstances
chapters.content:
While speaking, he brought Hei Lang with him and swaggered directly into the apartment building.
After reaching the 7th floor, Lin Yi also felt as if he was panting.
It had been a long time since he had climbed stairs, and previously, even when entering and exiting the company, there were elevators waiting.
Finally, Lin Yi arrived at the middle apartment of Unit 7, where he pressed the doorbell next to it.
The doorbell sounded rather old, and moreover, its tone was intermittent as if unable to keep up.
"Coming, coming,"
Liu Yao's voice was quickly heard coming from inside.
Subsequently, Liu Yao opened the door from inside.
She never expected to see Hei Lang and Lin Yi; clearly, the appearance of the two men left Liu Yao somewhat flabbergasted.
She had never thought that these two would actually follow her all the way here and find her home.
"What are you doing?"
Liu Yao seemed very wary.
After all, those with good intentions do not come knocking, and she believed their visit surely did not bode well.
"What, we're already at the doorstep; don't tell me you still don't want us to come in?"
"I don't know you, and I'm not that familiar with you either, so you don't need to come in, right?"
"Auntie, auntie,"
While speaking, Lin Yi called out into the interior.
He believed that if this Liu Yao was a very kind person, then her mother couldn't be far off.
"Who is it, Yaoyao?"
"Oh, mom, it's nothing, got the wrong person,"
While speaking, Liu Yao turned around and then frowned, lowering her voice.
"Leave quickly, if there's something to discuss, we can talk downstairs, don't disturb my mom's rest."
"Auntie, we've come specifically to see you,"
"Oh, Yaoyao, let them in quickly,"
The voice was heard once again.
Liu Yao just glared at him fiercely.
She had never thought Lin Yi would play such a trick on her.
"I'm telling you, say what you need to say and don't say what you shouldn't. I'm giving you five minutes, after that, leave immediately,"
"Fine, fine, five minutes it is,"
While speaking and smiling, Lin Yi slipped into the room.
Just looking at the house from the outside, it indeed seemed somewhat shabby, but the interior still appeared to be passable.
It certainly couldn't compare to the homes of the very wealthy, and he could tell that the furniture here was indeed somewhat worn.
The place was cleaned spotlessly, obviously the home of a woman who loved cleanliness.
Upon entering the main hall, he glanced inside.
He saw someone lying in the bedroom inside.
As expected, he had guessed correctly; she was lying in bed all along, which also proved that she must be immobile.
Just as he reached the doorway, he saw a wheelchair placed there.
This time, things couldn't have worked out better for him. Indeed, if this was the case, Lin Yi could really make good use of his "divine eye strategy" ability to see just how far he could get.
"Auntie, hello,"
While speaking, he walked forward.
He saw lying in the bed, a middle-aged woman with a kind and benevolent face.
However, her appearance at the moment seemed to have almost nothing in common with Liu Yao.
Could it be that Liu Yao looks like her father?
Lin Yi felt something was odd.
"Oh, who are you?"
The woman quickly propped herself up and then looked at Lin Yi as she spoke.
"Auntie, we are Yaoyao's colleagues and also her friends, so we came over to visit you."
"Oh, is that so, ah, look at that, I'm really troubling you all. Please, take a seat, Yaoyao, go, go pour some water."
"Oh, I got it, Mom."
Yaoyao's voice came from outside.
Who knew what she was doing outside at this time.
However, although Liu Yao was reluctant, it seemed that she complied with everything this woman uttered,
"Auntie, how have you been feeling lately?"
Lin Yi looked up and noticed a thick blanket covering her lower body.
"Hey, it's the same old situation. And, I've been relying on medication all year round, I think there's no need for treatment anymore."
"Mom, what are you saying?"
In the midst of speaking, Liu Yao came in holding a tray with two cups of tea on it.
She then placed the tea on the side table.
"You two help yourselves if you want to drink."
"Yaoyao, what kind of attitude is that? They've come to see Mom, how can you behave like this?"
The woman seemed to sense that Liu Yao's mood was a bit off, so she deliberately scolded her with annoyance.
"Mom, we're already very close, it's nothing. They were just passing by and decided to drop in and see you."
"Oh, well, that's really great. Look at that, you even came up to see me personally, I'm so embarrassed."
While speaking, Lin Yi began to sense that something was not quite right.
Although he kept saying he was here to visit the patient, he hadn't brought anything, his hands were empty.
Even buying a few apples would have been acceptable.
But, he had come in such a hurry that he hadn't realized this.
He turned his head and whispered something to Hei Lang.
Hei Lang nodded his head, stood up, and left the place.
"Hey, what's wrong with him?"
"Oh, nothing, my car is parked downstairs. I was worried it might block someone, so I asked him to move it to another spot. Auntie, what's the situation with your legs now?"
"What? Hasn't Yaoyao told you?" Stay connected via My Virtual Library Empire
She raised her head and then looked at Lin Yi as she spoke, after finishing, she glanced at Liu Yao next to her.
"Well, you know, when we're together, Yaoyao rarely talks about these family matters, so I am not very well-informed."
Just then, he glanced down.
He noted that now he could see her thigh through the blanket.
On the inner side of her thigh, Lin Yi could clearly see a long scar.
It must be at least a dozen centimeters.
It looked like that area had undergone surgery.
Then, the issue must lie there.
When he looked further down, he found another scar on her calf.
It was winding, just like a caterpillar.
"Auntie, how was the situation after the surgery?"

chapters.title: Chapter 373 Osteosarcoma
chapters.content:
