When he had said this, the woman simply looked up at him.
"You say you haven't told me, yet you've already told me everything, it's still the same, isn't it? This disease of mine just can't be completely cured."
Liu Yao, however, could not understand.
She and Lin Yi had met no more than two or three times, and moreover, she had never mentioned anything about her family.
How could he possibly know that mom had surgery?
Just then, the door to the room was knocked.
"Yaoyao, see who it is? The neighborhood committee said they would come over today, asking you to go fill out a form, and then, to apply for something for me."
"Oh, can I go tomorrow?"
"How can it wait until tomorrow? They're already here at the door; if you don't handle it now, this matter will just drag on endlessly."
"Oh, okay, I understand, you wait here."
With that, she softly whispered a message to Lin Yi.
Liu Yao was truly worried that Lin Yi might say who knows what while she was out.
But there was no helping it, the situation was laid out right now, if she didn't go, the issue would never reach an end.
Finally, the room quieted down.
After seeing this, Lin Yi simply nodded and then stood up, moving to the side of the bed.
"Auntie, to speak frankly, I'm also a doctor. However, your daughter doesn't think highly of my medical skills. My visit this time is really just to see your condition with my own eyes, to see how far it's progressed."
"You, what are you saying? You're a doctor too?"
Upon hearing this, she slightly furrowed her brow, giving the impression that she really didn't seem to feel like he was a doctor.
"Yes, auntie, don't you believe that I am one?"
"No, not at all, it's not that I don't believe you, but my illness..."
"Auntie, don't worry. If you trust me, could you lift the blanket so I can take a look at your leg?"
"Oh, you want to see my leg? Okay, then take a look."
As she spoke, she pulled the blanket to the side.
The two legs were quickly revealed.
But when he saw this scene, Lin Yi truly felt a heart-wrenching sensation.
The numerous large and small scars on them were countless.
Furthermore, each scar varied in length and even in shape.
Afterward, he took a deep breath and placed his hand on the leg.
Suddenly, a clear image appeared in Lin Yi's mind.
He passed through the layer of skin, then into the muscle, then the blood vessels, and finally, he arrived at the bone.
Lin Yi noticed that several bones had white patches on them, clearly indicating that there had been surgeries performed there before.
On the other side, Lin Yi saw some protruding things, situated right on top of the leg bone.
After examining all this, a clear term surfaced in his mind.
"Osteosarcoma."
Yes, osteosarcoma.
Previously, he was very unfamiliar with this disease.
But now, what appeared in his mind seemed to suddenly bring back all the unfamiliar things.
This is a malignant disease.
Under general circumstances, patients keep relapsing, tumors keep reappearing, and all they can do is undergo continuous surgeries, continuous incisions, and continuous chemotherapy to suppress the growth of these cancer cells.
"Auntie, is your right leg feeling a bit uncomfortable now?"
Suddenly, Lin Yi looked up at the woman and asked.
"This, you, how did you know?"
This really surprised her. Enjoy new chapters from My Virtual Library Empire
Her leg had been uncomfortable for the past couple of days, but she had never mentioned it to Liu Yao,
because she knew that once she did, there would be only one outcome, which was more surgery.
This family was not wealthy to begin with, and now, after surgeries one after another, they were basically left penniless, and even Liu Yao had accumulated a lot of debt outside.
"You just tell me, do you have this symptom? And sometimes, do you feel a pain like a needle prick, right here?"
As he spoke, he pointed near the lower part of his knee.
"Yes, yes, young man, how did you know?"
"How I knew, Auntie, you don't need to worry about that. But I do have a way to alleviate these symptoms, I just don't know, do you believe me?"
"But, what about now?"
"Auntie, I know what you want to say, you're worried about money, aren't you? Rest assured, my treatment method is absolutely different from the ones before. I will not ask you for any money; I will treat you for free. What do you think?"
"This, what you said, is it true?"
"However, this treatment might take several days, and I can't guarantee to eradicate it completely, but at the very least, it can definitely solve some basic symptoms."
"Okay, then tell me, what should I do?"
"Auntie, do you have an embroidery needle for doing quilts or clothes at home? Preferably a longer, slightly thicker one."
"Oh, yes, we have that. It's right there, on top of that wardrobe. Young man, I'm really sorry, look at my foot, I can't help you with that."
"It's fine, you don't need to worry, I know what to do."
With that, Lin Yi went forward and reached out to the wardrobe.
Then, he pulled out a very old box.
He opened the box and glanced inside; all sorts of embroidery needles were laid out there.
He nodded in satisfaction and finally picked out an embroidery needle.
Then, he looked around.
"Auntie, do you have a lighter?"
"A lighter, oh, I remember now, we don't have a lighter, but there are matches over there in the kitchen."
"Good, I got it, Auntie, just wait a moment please."
With that, Lin Yi turned around and entered the living room.
He looked around briefly, and it seemed that one corner indeed looked like a kitchen.
Turning on the light, Lin Yi went in and took a look.
It was absolutely bare.
One could only see that it was very tidy, but the facilities inside were extremely simple.
He saw a steamer on the side.
Lin Yi opened the steamer to look inside, on top, there was a bowl of food, likely leftovers from yesterday.

chapters.title: Chapter 374 Dominated by the Brain
chapters.content:
Only some vegetable soup remained, but it hadn't been thrown away, clearly indicating their current lifestyle must be quite frugal.
After seeing all this, Lin Yi's resolve strengthened even more; this girl, he thought, was someone he had to help.
Now that her family was in this situation and she still could empathize enough to help others, such girls were truly rare.
Then, he found a box of matches in a corner.
In fact, an image of what to do had roughly formed in his mind.
It's just that he was unclear about the significance of his actions.
However, his brain was constantly compelling him to carry on, perhaps only by proceeding could he discover what the ultimate outcome would face.
He lit a match, and then, ran an embroidery needle through the flame thoroughly.
This must serve the purpose of disinfection.
Upon returning to the room, he glanced over and saw a bottle of alcohol and iodophor by the window, presumably left there by Liu Yao.
He picked them up, finding them to be conveniently useful.
"Auntie, during the process, there might be some pain, but you must endure it, understand?"
"Young man, what, what are you going to do? Are you, you going to perform acupuncture on me?"
"It's not acupuncture. If I'm not mistaken about your current condition, it's probably relapsed."
"Right, I didn't even need to get an X-ray to know, it's definitely relapsed, and this sensation is exactly like the previous times it happened."
"My goal now is to resolve this relapsed lesion first, then we can address the systemic issues."
"Can you really solve it with just an embroidery needle?"
"Auntie, rest assured, if you trust me, then go ahead and try. But I won't force you, if you feel uncomfortable with it, I'll stop right now."
Saying this, Lin Yi looked up at the woman.
Stay connected with My Virtual Library Empire
He could guess that inside, the woman was probably struggling greatly.
Ask yourself, if it were you suffering from such an illness and a stranger suddenly arrived at your home claiming he could treat you, how much credibility would that claim hold?
"Sigh, I've been tormented by this pain for so many years that I've grown accustomed to it, and I know I can't hold on much longer."
"Auntie, don't talk like that, you must stay positive about treatment, and while I dare not promise to eradicate the lesion, I am certain that delaying its progression is completely doable."
Lin Yi was merely saying this.
He did not know much about sarcomas, but based on his current approach, he was certain he couldn't completely eradicate it for her.
"Alright, you might as well treat me as a dead horse you're trying to cure, and young man, proceed with confidence."
With those words, Lin Yi felt as if he had taken a heart-relief pill and finally let out a long sigh of relief.
"Okay, Auntie, if it really hurts later, just tell me."
Lin Yi, after all, was performing treatment for the first time, so even now, his grip on the procedure wasn't firm.
He was unclear about the force he should use when inserting the needle. Moreover, where should he insert it and what to do after? All of these were blank in his mind.
He just felt something within his brain continuously urging him to proceed this way.
Finally, the woman leaned back a bit, in doing so, she could better expose that particular area.
Lin Yi took out the acupuncture needle, and at this moment, his hand began to tremble.
Damn, in this state, how could he treat anyone? If he couldn't hold the needle steady, he was likely to become a laughing stock.
But unexpectedly, just as he thought this, his hand suddenly steadied itself firmly.
Moreover, he skillfully took out some iodine and alcohol from beside him and started to meticulously wipe the area over and over.
All these actions were completed extremely proficiently, to the point where Lin Yi himself was unclear as to how he had managed them.
In the end, the needle, led by his hand, arrived at the patient's affected part.
That's right, Lin Yi saw very clearly, it was truly as if the needle was moving his hand, not the other way around,
Finally, the needle gently pierced the skin at one spot.
He heard what seemed to be a sound coming from the auntie's mouth.
He turned to look at her and just felt that her expression was somewhat unnatural.
"Auntie, you, are you alright?"
"No, it's just that it did hurt a bit when the needle first went in, but now, it's much more comfortable. Don't worry, young man, continue your treatment."
After hearing this, Lin Yi simply nodded. When he turned back, he saw that the needle had already penetrated over half its length into the skin.
Now, only a little part of it was held in his hand.
His hand was gripping it firmly, fearing that the needle might break inside.
Then, he felt a warm current hit him once again.
It was just like the last time when he was treating Han Xuewei's stomach, the warm current felt exactly the same.
He felt the needle begin to spin on its own within the skin.
In the end, Lin Yi just opened his eyes to take a look.
He discovered that the needle had penetrated the raised area.
Following that, it seemed to separate the layers within, as if peeling them apart.

The speaker was the child's father, who, while talking, took off his belt and handed it over directly.
Although a belt wasn't as good as a rope, it could still be quite useful in a critical moment.
Lin Yi used the belt to wrap the two boards tightly around the arm to secure them in place.

As he said this, even Lin Yi himself found it somewhat unbelievable.

Afterward, Lin Yi took out his two hands, one on the upper part and the other on the lower part of the arm.

"What technique did you use just now?"

"You don't have to lie to me. Who is your master?"
"My master?"
At this point, he was even more surprised.
It was obvious that he must have been misunderstood.
Although he was confident in his bone-setting skills, and the other party might believe he had a master behind his achievements.
"Old gentleman, if I said I don't have a master, would you believe me?"
"What? No master?"
At this point, Dean Lin merely paused for a moment.
It seemed he did not quite recognize Lin Yi.
What did this mean? Could it really be that he believed Lin Yi was a genius who learned without a teacher?
"Yes, I really don't have a master."
"So all this, you learned on your own?"
"All of it I learned on my own, and I don't have any other hobbies. I just like to delve into this field."
"Come here, look at this."
The old man seemed to suddenly become interested and eventually took a book from the side table and placed it in front of Lin Yi.
It was an ancient book, and even the binding was completely different from modern books.
Lin Yi didn't understand why he was handing him this book at this moment. Your next on My Virtual Library Empire
He just looked up at Dean Lin with a puzzled expression.
"What do you mean by this?"
"Open it and look at page 8."
"Page 8?"
He murmured to himself, then flipped through the book, one page at a time.
As he turned the pages, Lin Yi was extremely careful.
Clearly, it must be an ancient tome, at the very least decades, if not a century old.
And the pages were even starting to yellow.
While flipping through, he could hear the crisp sound of the pages.
Lin Yi was really worried that the book would be ruined in his hands, making him a real sinner.
Upon reaching page 8, he saw a picture.
This picture seemed to be a completely hand-drawn depiction of the human body's meridian system.
But this was indeed challenging for him.
Previously, Lin Yi had a complete picture of the human skeleton in his mind.
However, when it came to the meridians, he had absolutely no understanding.
"What is this?"
"Look, this is a complete diagram of the human body's meridian network, which actually corresponds exactly to our bone structure. Now, I have a question I've been studying for many years, and I simply can't understand it."
As he said this, it seemed like Lin Yi fully grasped the situation.
Was Dean Lin testing him or discussing certain issues on his own?
If it was a test, he was afraid that he wouldn't be up to the challenge.
Even if it was to discuss certain issues, he would be helpless because Lin Yi was utterly unfamiliar with the meridian system.
"Dean Lin, please speak frankly."
"Look here, this Tianchi point, should be in the direction of the body's correct bone positioning, right? But if you trace it down, it should lead to the muscle sour point of the body, so what is the corresponding relationship between them? If you try to connect the two, could it pass through the second bone, allowing the meridian blood flow to move away through that place?"
The series of professional terms he used made Lin Yi somewhat baffled.
He slightly frowned.
"Dean Lin, your question is a bit too profound for me, I really don't understand it."
"What do you mean you don't understand? But just now, your actions didn't seem to suggest that, and without more than a decade of practice, the operation you performed earlier simply couldn't have been done."
"But, but regarding your question, I really haven't studied that."
"Impossible, anyone who has studied human skeletal structure must also learn about the meridian system, stop deceiving me."
"Dean Lin, I really... how about this, give me some time to think it over because this question of yours is really quite sudden."
"No need, you don't have to answer right now. Just tell me, can they be connected like that or not?"
"I'm sorry, Dean Lin, I really can't answer you. I must go back and think it over properly before I can tell you the answer."
"How long do you need?"
"That, I'm not sure. Maybe soon, or maybe it will take a long time. As soon as I figure it out, I will contact you immediately."
Hearing his words, Dean Lin indeed seemed somewhat disappointed.
He had thought that he could discuss some issues with this young man, but unexpectedly, he received such a response from him.
"Well then, perhaps I asked too much of you. Forget it, let's not talk about it anymore, have some water."
At this moment, how could Lin Yi possibly drink?
He felt like a primary school student in front of this man.
"Old gentleman, if it had been you just now, would you have been able to complete the bone-setting?"
"Well, if it were me, definitely no problem. To be honest, if you hadn't stepped forward then, I would probably have done so."
"So have you been studying this all along, or did you already know it when you were the dean?"

chapters.title: Chapter 381 The Remaining Scar
chapters.content:
"This should be considered a method of traditional Chinese medicine, and as you can see, the arrangement of this room is very typically Chinese." Lin Yi said.
"Absolutely, I've noticed that too. And everything here, including the herbs and the smell, complements one another perfectly."
"To be honest, I have nothing against Western medicine. I just feel that we need to pick up what our ancestors have left behind. Only by mastering these can we pass on our spirit, don't you think?"
"Ah, elder, if you put it that way, I really do agree. You're right, I believe the same. Traditional Chinese medicine has its merits, and at the moment, I'm researching the location of Xi Lian Mountain."
"What, what did you just say? Xi Lian Mountain?"
Upon mentioning this, he frowned slightly.
"Yes, Xi Lian Mountain. It's been nearly 10 years since anyone has ventured in there. I believe there must be an abundance of precious herbs inside."
"You're right, the place has always been known for its herbs, particularly the rare and valuable ones. But the problem is you can't just walk in there. I advise you not to take the risk."
"Elder, if I don't take the risk, then how can I bring these things out to benefit humanity?"
"Young man, inevitably full of youthful vigor. However, I too experienced that same spirit ten years ago."
"What do you mean?"
"Look at this."
As he spoke, Dean Lin stood up and abruptly removed his shirt.
He did look rather thin and frail.
But Lin Yi could clearly see distinct tears and scars on his arms and chest.
"What, what is that?"
Seeing them, he was genuinely shocked.
"This is the consequence of my impetuous venture into the mountains."
"You mean, you were attacked by wild beasts?"
"Exactly. I was fully prepared, convinced I could avoid the beasts. But in the end, I still failed."
Witnessing these painful remnants, Lin Yi, to be honest, started to waver.
Was it due to his lack of preparation, or were there indeed dangers lurking within?
After all, no one had ever successfully penetrated this forbidden zone of life.
But the words had been spoken, and all plans were in place. If he were to back out now, Lin Yi felt it would be such a waste.
"So, having seen these scars, do you feel a bit of fear now?"
While speaking, Dean Lin put his clothes back on.
"This happened 10 years ago, right?"
"Yes, 10 years ago. I wasn't exactly young then, but I was driven. I knew of the valuable medicinal herbs that grew there. Bringing them back could enormously benefit humanity. That was the hope that drove me."
"That's how I feel now. But from what you say, the place sounds truly terrifying."
"Yes, it is extremely daunting. Honestly, I even planned to circumnavigate it, and I managed to get a map of Xi Lian Mountain."
"A map? You have a map?"
At this point, he opened his eyes wide in astonishment and saw Dean Lin speak.
Lin Yi was very unfamiliar with Xi Lian Mountain, aware of its existence yet clueless about the situation inside.
"Indeed, I had a map. But I destroyed it a few years ago. Holding onto that map always led my thoughts back to everything that happened, so I chose not to cling to any hope."
Hearing this, Lin Yi felt it was such a shame.
If he could obtain that map, it might have greatly assisted them.
But then again, hadn't Dean Lin gone through the same? Even with that map, he hadn't managed to make his way into Xi Lian Mountain.
"Dean Lin, may I ask how far you got before the wild beasts attacked?"
"Let me think. I walked about 20 minutes inside, not all that far really. And the region of Xi Lian Mountain is quite vast, most of the herbs are in the innermost parts. I barely reached an outer edge."
"You mean you went in there alone?"
"No, I had two companions."
"And what about them?"
At this point, Dean Lin sighed deeply and inadvertently glanced towards a corner.
Following his gaze, Lin Yi saw that in that corner were two photographs, each with a tablet placed in front of it.
Seeing this, Lin Yi suddenly panicked.
"They...?"
"Yes, I was the only survivor. And if I hadn't run fast, I guarantee I'd be reduced to just another photo by now."
Lin Yi wasn't sure how to describe what he felt inside.
It was a threat to his very life.
"Dean Lin, what I find curious is how you got the map in the first place, given that no one knew the topography of Xi Lian Mountain at the time?"
"That's thanks to one of them, the one on the left. Do you see?" Explore more stories at My Virtual Library Empire
Lin Yi looked up to see a man who appeared to be around 40, not very old.
He wasn't sure if it was just the photo that made the man look young, or if he was indeed that young.
"Ah, I see. Are you saying he was the one who provided the map?"
"His ancestors were hunters. His great-grandfather has been in and out of Xi Lian Mountain many times, which is why this route map was passed down."
"But I heard that Xi Lian Mountain wasn't like this many years ago."
"True, back then the wild beasts weren't as ferocious, and there weren't as many of them. So, some hunters, especially those with exceptional skills, could manage relatively easily."

chapters.title: Chapter 382 Not a Simple Character
chapters.content:
"Well, it looks like, for now, this is the only situation we can have."
"So, if you really do have this idea in mind, I'd advise you to give it up, don't take risks. You're young. You don't want to leave your life there, do you?"
Lin Yi didn't say anything. He just smiled awkwardly.
"All right, Director Lin, I have some things to take care of, I need to get to them quickly. When I can find the time, I'll come and visit you properly."
"Fine, you go ahead."
After saying this, he just nodded his head, and then quickly stood up and left the place.
In fact, the sense of fear in his heart had never completely subsided.
The mysterious old man he met today indeed made Lin Yi see things in a new light.
Up to now, he could still picture the old yellowed book the old man had shown him.
It's just that, unfortunately, with his limited knowledge, he really had no way to solve everything.
Otherwise, he probably would have earned Director Lin's respect right then and there.
After leaving the place, just as he was entering the community gate, Lin Yi happened to see a familiar electric bike coming his way.
The person was Liu Yao.
Liu Yao pulled up to Lin Yi, hit the brakes, and then hurriedly jumped off the electric bike.
"Eh, what are you doing here?"
"Nothing much."
"Is there something wrong with my mom?"
Liu Yao seemed to become somewhat frantic.
In her mind, Lin Yi shouldn't be so familiar with the people here, and he only knew about her family situation.
If Lin Yi was here now, could it mean that something had happened to her mother?
"You don't need to be so nervous. I came here for nothing else but to meet an old man just now."
"An old man? What old man?"
"Well, I'd have to ask you, is there a Director Lin in your hospital, who lives in this community even now?"
"You, you mean, you mean Old Lin?"
"Oh, that must be it, probably. He seemed to imply that he was one of the directors of your People's Hospital, wasn't he?"
"He's not just any director. He was the founding director of the People's Hospital; he built it with his own hands."
"Oh, I see. No wonder, I guess, he must be quite powerful then."
"And another thing, he is a very famous traditional Chinese medicine expert, and even now, his reputation is internationally acclaimed. You haven't heard of him, have you?"
"What? He's that famous? What's his full name?"
"His name is Lin Genghua." Find adventures at My Virtual Library Empire
"Lin Genghua?"
Lin Yi just muttered the name to himself, but, after all, since his previous studies were not in this field, he was still relatively unfamiliar with all of this.
"How do you know him? And how did you suddenly end up at his house?"
"Heh, it was just a coincidence, a chance encounter. So, I stopped by his house for a short visit. Alright, I have some things to attend to, I need to rush back now, can't talk anymore."
"Then when will you come to treat my mom for the second time?"
"It should be tomorrow, or the day after," Lin Yi said. "Don't worry, I'll contact you in advance."
"And what about me?" Weiwei asked tentatively.
"For the next two days, you should start to hand over your duties at the hospital. Also, if you're going to resign, it's time to submit a resignation report, that is, if you're certain about this decision."
"Okay, I understand," Weiwei replied.
After speaking, Liu Yao simply nodded her head.
In fact, after returning to the hospital, she shared the news with a close friend, who also felt it was somewhat unbelievable.
They thought this might just be a coincidence and advised Liu Yao not to miss out on her promising future because of it.
After all, not just anyone can enter the People's Hospital so easily.
Now, having finally gotten this opportunity and having worked her way up to this point, if she persevered, she might very well become a head nurse.
And then, her salary would be even higher.
Watching Lin Yi leave, Liu Yao wandered home as if in a trance.
"Mom, Mom," she called out softly upon arriving.
As she approached, she saw her mother lying weakly in bed, with her eyes closed.
"Mom, what's wrong?" she asked, worried.
In truth, she had been very anxious these past two years, always fearful that her mother would suddenly faint one day.
She knew that osteosarcoma was extremely dangerous and that if her mother fell into a coma, waking up again could be very difficult.
"Ah, what's the matter?" Mother Liu slowly opened her eyes and looked up.
Finding her mother awake relieved Liu Yao immensely.
"You're okay?"
"Oh, it's nothing. I was just reading a book and suddenly felt tired. Really, I've gotten old. I used to love reading, but now I get sleepy as soon as I pick up a book," Mother Liu said with a faint smile.
"What do you want for dinner tonight?"
"Anything's fine. Weren't there some leftovers from last night? Let's just reheat those. Oh, and you should eat something more nutritious. Look at you, you've gotten so thin recently."
"I'm fine, besides, I'm actually trying to lose weight."
"Enough with the diet excuse all the time. And stop saving all the good food for me. Your mother understands everything," Mother Liu chided gently.
"Mom."
Upon hearing all this, Liu Yao felt an immense pain inside.
She couldn't quite describe the feeling, but for years, she'd been struggling to hold everything together.
Honestly, she never asked for much. All she prayed for was that her mother could stay with her a few more years.
As a nurse, she was well aware of the severity of the illness and knew they probably didn't have much time left.
Suddenly, an idea flashed through her head.
This time, it felt like a gamble.
If she really chose to believe in Lin Genghua's words, then there might be hope for her mother's disease.

chapters.title: Chapter 383 Confirmed Cured
chapters.content:
```
But if she chose not to believe in Lin Yi, then Lin Yi had completely deceived her.
Liu Yao's heart began to waver with indecision.
"Mom, do you have anything to do right now?"
"Anything to do? What could there be? I'm just sitting here, what could I possibly have to do day after day?"
"If you have nothing to do, I can take you to the hospital. It's a good time right now, the hospital's shift has just ended, and I can ask a colleague to do a CT scan for you."
"A CT scan? What do we need that for? It's just wasting money at the hospital. Besides, didn't your friend cure me already?"
"Just because he says 'cured' here, does that mean it's cured? We have no idea what it actually looks like on the imaging. So, I have to verify it before I can rest easy."
"Yaoyao, are you telling your mother that you don't believe your friend at all now?"
"I can't quite describe the feeling, but for safety's sake, and if there's a need to consider further treatment, then we must confirm this matter."
"Mom knows that you're worried. Well, if that's the case, let's go have a look and see what's happening. At the very least, it will help me understand some things."
Liu Yao nodded as she spoke, then helped her mother up and put her in a wheelchair. After that, she headed straight for the hospital.
After their arrival at the hospital, it was already 6:00 p.m.
Liu Yao had already greeted her colleagues in the CT room before coming. Upon arrival, they didn't have to wait, and she immediately wheeled her mother in.
It was already that time of day, and with two CT machines available, they were indeed not busy.
After placing her mother on the CT bed, she paused only briefly before swiftly entering the control room.
The CT machine started to work slowly, and when it reached the lower leg area, a colleague just paused there.
"Look, it's this area."
That colleague, pointing at something white on the screen, said.
"Oh, I see it."
"I compared it with the previous films, and this spot wasn't there before. This indicates it might have only recently recurred. However, it's strange, why can't we see any trace of the osteosarcoma?"
While speaking, she began to search carefully.
But other than the healed wounds, she didn't see anything else.
"It's not just this spot; look at this area right next to it, do you see it?"
"I see it, and that area seems to be smaller than the previous one, right?"
"Yes, it's clearly smaller, and it must have just developed. But why can't we see those traces?"
"Do you mean this thing?"
"This, it looks like a scar from surgery, but that's not right. I have already examined your aunt before, and there were no signs of surgery, this is really strange."
"Okay, I understand. Xiaomei, can you please not mention today's events to anyone else?"
"Yaoyao, what exactly happened? If there's something going on, you have to talk about it. You can't handle it all alone."
In fact, many colleagues in the unit were aware of Liu Yao's current situation.
They were all quite sympathetic towards this girl who had struggled so hard for so many years, and who was so filial.
"Heh, it's nothing, there's nothing for me to handle."
"By the way, do you want me to display the results of the scan?"
"No need. We have already seen everything in the imaging. Besides, we're just here through a backdoor, so let's not waste any more materials."
"But don't you think it's strange? There's a scar from surgery in this area, but there hasn't been any surgery done here."
"Heh, that's not necessarily true. Maybe the doctors opened it up from the front before and then did something else, that could be a possibility."
"Oh, if you say so, it might be possible. After all, we aren't very familiar with surgery procedures."
"Exactly. That's why I wanted to check to see if there were any signs of a relapse in my mom."
"Don't worry. I've already scanned her from head to toe. As it stands, it seems fairly stable."
"Good, then thank you very much."
After finishing, Liu Yao nodded and then wheeled her mother straight out of the hospital.
On the road, she couldn't help but feel a secret joy.
Unexpectedly, Lin Yi was indeed a very capable person.
It seemed she had truly underestimated him before.
"Yaoyao, I didn't want to ask in the hospital, but what's the situation with your mother now?"
"Mom, you were really cured today. Moreover, there's a mark left over there. My colleague scanned your entire body and there are no signs of recurrence at all."
"Look, it's really miraculous. And I really didn't expect that someone so young could possess such a high level of skill. Yaoyao, with this outcome, does it mean there's real hope for your mom?"
"Mom, you definitely have hope. Moreover, we could have managed with medications alone before, but now with his assistance, I believe there's even a chance for a cure."
"That's wonderful, really wonderful. Honestly, I was a bit desperate before, but now, it seems like I've been given new hope. I want to be there to see you get married. I want to walk you down the aisle myself."
"Mom, don't worry. It's not just about getting married; after I have children, I'll need you to help look after them."
"Heh, aren't your demands a bit too high? How can your mom with this leg help you look after children? "
"Mom, that's not necessarily true. If Lin Yi can get rid of this problem, I believe it won't be too difficult for you to stand up again."
"But I have been lying in bed for so many years, isn't it too difficult to think about standing up again?"
"Not difficult. I don't think it's difficult at all. As long as you have the confidence, I will find a way to help you stand up again."
Saying this, she looked at her mother with great emotion.
At this moment, Liu's mother was moved to tears.

chapters.title: Chapter 384 Bring More People
chapters.content:
Two people had never been so excited in all these years.
Near dusk, Lin Yi made a phone call to Hei Lang.
"Hello, how's the preparation on your side?"
"Brother, rest assured, everything is already prepared, and there are also some equipments that should arrive tomorrow morning. Probably before tomorrow noon, all things should be complete. It's just up to you to decide when you're ready to set off."
"How many people are you planning to bring this time into the mountains?"
"How many people? I haven't planned to bring anyone along, Brother. Aren't they just a few fierce beasts? With my current ability, there should be no problem. I alone should be enough to protect you."
"That won't do. It won't just be me; Ling'er will be there as well. Moreover, the two of us going in wouldn't make any sense. We wouldn't be able to recognize those precious medicinal herbs."
"Oh right, Ling'er will be there too, no worries. I'll find another brother who's good with his hands, and then let him tag along. Wouldn't that be more secure?"
"I think one person is too few. If it won't work, could you arrange for some more brothers?"
"Arrange for more? But, but I haven't prepared that much stuff."
"If you haven't prepared, then go prepare again. At the very least, you must bring five people, plus you that makes six."
"Alright, there definitely won't be any issue with manpower."
"Remember, you must pick some with good skills, understand?"
"Alright, don't worry. By the way, Brother, when are you planning to set off?"
"That, I haven't decided the specifics yet. Be ready at any time. I will contact you before we set off."
"Okay, let's leave it at that."
After that, the call was disconnected.
Lin Yi looked up at the wall clock; it was already 7:00 PM.
He was unclear about how things were being handled at the company, and he also hadn't been in contact with Ling'er.
Suddenly, Lin Yi thought of Dean Lin.
After all, Dean Lin had shown him a human body meridian chart, but he himself couldn't understand it. He guessed that Ling'er might understand some of it.
Thereupon, Lin Yi took out his phone and dialed Ling'er's mobile number.
"Ling'er, where are you now?"
"Oh, I've just come out from the company. I've settled all the company matters and finished all the procedures. From now on, we have nothing to do with that place."
"Great, are you busy with anything right now?"
"Me? I'm not busy with anything. What's wrong, President Lin?"
"Come over to my place. There's something I want to talk to you about."
"Oh, okay, I understand. I'll head over now. By the way, have you eaten, President Lin?"
"Not yet. When you're on your way, could you pick up something? We can eat a little at my place and chat while we eat."
"Alright, I got it. By the way, how about your wife and child? Are they at home? If they are, I'll buy more to take over."
"No, my wife is at school, and she probably won't come back tonight. The child is still over at my parents'."
"Okay, got it."
After that, Ling'er hung up the phone.
About 20 minutes later, Ling'er arrived.
She had simply bought some takeout, and then the two of them sat at the dining table and began to eat.
"When you finished with the company this afternoon, did everything go smoothly? And the compensation money, has it all been transferred?"
"Don't worry, I've arranged everything. And the staff members below are basically content; they are quite satisfied with the compensation amount."
"Good, I've done my best. I never thought the company would encounter such a big issue so suddenly, all of it beyond my expectation."
Even now, mentioning it, Lin Yi still felt a sense of regret, but there was nothing he could do. After all, what had happened had happened, and what could he do about it now?
"President Lin."
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi suddenly gestured with his hand.
Now, he wasn't running any company, and he always felt that the title was like an insult to himself.
"Stop, I'm telling you, the company is gone. Don't call me that anymore. I'm not a president any longer."
"Then, what should I...?"
"How about this, just call me Brother Lin. That sounds more cordial."
"Alright, Brother Lin. What I mean is, since it's all happened, don't dwell on it anymore. Look forward, and besides, don't you have a new goal for development now?"
"Right, there is indeed a new goal. This afternoon, I contacted the pharmaceutical factory. Look at me, getting used to old habits. It's not a pharmaceutical factory anymore; it should be called a toy factory."
"Oh? How are things going over there now?"
"They have started organizing. I estimate that in about three or four days, things should proceed as planned. Also, Manager Liu has already started to explore the market."
"That's good. Then everything from now on should go more smoothly, right? So, I think you don't need to worry so much."
"By the way, Ling'er, there's something I've never asked you. Are you familiar with the human body meridian chart?"
"The human body meridian chart? Of course, I'm very familiar with it. It was part of my basic skills course. Also, my master started me off with the human body meridian chart."
"Then, is there any essential connection between the human body meridian chart and the human skeletal system?"
"Of course, there is. Moreover, they complement each other. Each point is interconnected. What's the matter, Brother Lin, do you want to learn it?"
"Not to learn it. This afternoon, darn, I can't recall all of a sudden. Let me find it for you."
While speaking, Lin Yi took his laptop and began to search for the human body meridian chart.
However, after searching through all the charts he could find, he still couldn't locate the one he'd seen at Dean Lin's that afternoon.
"Brother Lin, what exactly are you looking for?"
Ling'er, who had waited for quite some time and had seemingly not seen the result she'd anticipated, asked anxiously.
"I, I can't quite put my finger on it, but I've flipped through all the human body meridian charts here, and none of them match the chart I saw. That one was completely hand-drawn."

chapters.title: Chapter 385 It's Actually the Martial Uncle
chapters.content:
"What did the hand-drawn images look like?"
"Now, I can't quite remember, but these things looked somewhat similar, yet completely different from it."
"Are you speaking of the human body's meridian illustrations?"
"What human body meridian illustrations? How is that different from a meridian map?"
"The human body meridian illustrations remain a very mysterious treasure to this day, and moreover, I have never seen it in all these years, though my master mentioned it to me before."
"What's so mysterious about it? Besides, science has advanced so much these days. It shouldn't be hard to draw it out, I think."
"Right, under normal circumstances, it wouldn't be hard, but to draw with such detail is really very difficult; it's essentially a lost art. Are you implying that you... you've seen it?"
"Yes, I've seen it, but it's not quite the same as what you're describing."
"That's impressive. Maybe I can understand a bit and then sketch a rough outline for you. Take a look and see if it matches the shape, but don't pay attention to the specific contents inside; I can't articulate them."
"Okay, go ahead and draw."
With that, Ling'er stood up, then grabbed a pen and a piece of paper from the side.
Afterward, she began to sketch on it.
Although it was somewhat rough and squiggly, it indeed resembled the shape.
But when Lin Yi saw it, he felt a strong sense of familiarity.
Clearly, it bore the same shape as what he had seen that afternoon, but the specific details still didn't quite match up.
"Hmm, the way you've drawn it, I indeed feel there are some similarities, like this area that's raised, and, sigh, this area that dips in."
"Brother Lin, where did you see it?"
"In the hands of an old man, and moreover, that book was very old, seemed to be at least a hundred years old."
"Brother Lin, could I meet him?"
Ling'er seemed truly excited upon hearing this.
Lin Yi didn't quite grasp what excited her so much; however, he was well aware of Ling'er's deep research into this field.
To him, these items might just be paper, but to her, they might indeed be treasured like jewels.
"It should be no problem, and moreover, he came over today and spoke a lot of strange things that I just couldn't understand at all."
"Where is he located?"
"Right in the Liu Yao Community."
"Can we hurry over now?"
"Now?"
At this point, Lin Yi frowned slightly and glanced at the clock, which didn't seem too late; it was just 8:00 PM.
If they hurried over, he believed the old man would not yet be resting.
"But is there something urgent? Do we need to go today?"
"I can't wait another moment, and if it's really that illustration, then forget it, explaining this to you now won't make sense. I just ask that you truly bring me to him."
"Okay, no problem, I'll take you there now."
Although Lin Yi didn't understand why Liu Yao was in such a rush, he knew Ling'er was a person who acted with great discretion.
Under normal circumstances, Ling'er wouldn't act so impulsively.
Lin Yi seems to understand that Ling'er's visit this time would definitely bring a breakthrough in this matter.
However, he didn't know if Ling'er could fulfill the request that Director Lin had made at the time.
In a hurry, he took Ling'er with him, and half an hour later, they arrived at Jinwan Community.
After arriving here, Lin Yi checked the time—it was exactly 8:30.
So Lin Yi rang the doorbell.
Because when he had just come over from the yard, he saw the lights in the living room and study were still on, which meant that the old man probably hadn't gone to bed yet at this time.
"Coming, coming."
As expected, an elderly voice came from inside.
At that moment, Ling'er seemed very nervous.
Lin Yi turned back to look at her.
It was just a visit to meet someone; was there a need to be this nervous? Therefore, Lin Yi indeed found her current behavior somewhat incomprehensible.
Soon, the door was opened.
When the two of them appeared in front of Director Lin, the old man was just slightly taken aback.
He hadn't expected Lin Yi to show up at this time, and moreover, to bring along a young girl.
Upon seeing the old man, Ling'er simply sized him up before furrowing her brow tightly.
"Director Lin, I'm sorry for disturbing you so late," said Lin Yi.
"Oh, it's nothing, it's nothing, come in, please," replied Director Lin.
With that, he let the two of them in.
Similarly, they once again entered the study, and the two of them sat side by side opposite old Lin.
"It's the same tea from this morning. Here, have some first," Director Lin said while enthusiastically pouring tea from the pot into their cups.
Ling'er simply observed the house carefully before taking a deep breath.
"Pure carmine mixed with musk, and then, a few other herbs have been added that could intoxicate the brain and nerves."
All of a sudden, Ling'er came out with this statement.
Old Lin was stunned.
He looked up at Ling'er.
"Then, if those ingredients are removed, what would it become?" he asked.
"It would nourish the meridians. Moreover, in this way, it would very likely have a supplementary effect on the human veins," she replied.
"Good, interesting. Now let me ask you another question: if I were to take out the herbs used exclusively for sedation, what effect would that have?"
"Then, it would probably be impossible to stay in this room because the emitted substance would be entirely a type of stench, even mixed with some carbon dioxide."
"What's your name?"
"Director Lin, my name is Ling'er."
"Ling'er?"
Upon saying this, old Lin involuntarily furrowed his brow slightly.
"Is your surname Wang?"
"Correct, my surname is Wang."
At this point, Director Lin seemed to suddenly become excited.
"Do you know who I am?"
"I just feel a sense of deja vu, and it seems to somewhat match with someone my teacher mentioned," she said.
"My name is Lin Genghua, but in the past, I was known in the martial world as Lin Zhongzi."

chapters.title: Chapter 386 Extraordinarily Gifted
chapters.content:
As the discussion reached this point, Ling'er suddenly stood up.
Then, she took two steps back, let out a ordinary sigh, and knelt down on the ground with both legs.
This scene unfolded rather hastily, so much so that even Lin Yi was caught off guard.
He simply couldn't understand why Ling'er would suddenly perform such a grand gesture at this time.
If that was the case, could it be that there was some kind of deep connection between them?
Lin Yi didn't dare to stay seated, so he quickly stood up and moved away from the spot.
Since they already knew each other, there was no need for him to stay there to introduce them. "Great Uncle Master, please accept a bow from your disciple's nephew."
"Hehe, come on, stand up and talk."
"As you command, Great Uncle Master."
One was the Great Uncle Master, and the other was the disciple's nephew.
Lin Yi had never imagined that the situation would turn out like this.
"Great Uncle Master, how have you been lately? It seems that almost 30 years have passed since I last saw you."
"That's right, when I saw you back then, you were but a needy infant, and later, I learned that you became a disciple of my junior brother."
"Indeed, I have often heard my master mention you, but I have never seen you in person."
"That's because I had some disagreements with him in our pursuits, and he did not wish to leave the mountains, preferring to continue passing on his skills there."
"I once heard from Master that you, Great Uncle Master, have never taken on a disciple in your life and that you dedicated yourself entirely to the development and research of traditional Chinese medicine."
"It's just a hobby of mine. Although we did not share the same interests, our purpose was completely the same: to save lives, help the injured and benefit the people."
After saying this, he stood up and casually pointed to the side.
"I believe, you should be quite familiar with him, right?"
He turned his head and then glanced at a photograph over there.
When Ling'er saw this, she simply nodded silently, and soon, tears quickly began to fall.
"Ling'er, what, what's going on?"
Lin Yi was somewhat surprised and also at a loss as to what was happening.
"Actually, you have already met him this morning. He was the man I spoke of who provided me with maps. In fact, he is Ling'er's biological father."
Explore stories on My Virtual Library Empire
"What, what are you saying? Old Lin, he is Ling'er's dad?"
"He is my dad, but unfortunately, he was attacked by a wild beast during a herb gathering expedition in the mountains 10 years ago, and since then, I have never seen him again."
"Ling'er, I blame myself for this. I was incapable of protecting your father back then, and up to this day, I still feel very guilty in my heart."
"Great Uncle Master, please don't mention it anymore, it has been so many years, and it was indeed an accident, something no one could have guaranteed against."
"Ling'er, how are you doing now? Where are you living at the moment?"
"Great Uncle Master, it might seem like a coincidence, but when I first started, I was a nurse at the People's Hospital."
"What? You, you're at the People's Hospital? I, I had no idea."
He was surprised, his eyes widened, and indeed, he was somewhat flabbergasted.
"Uncle Master, after all, you've been retired for so many years and the People's Hospital has gone through so many changes, it's quite normal if you haven't heard about me given the numerous staff changes."
"Yes, since I left and came out of the mountains, the name had already changed, and even if you knew I was the hospital director, you probably wouldn't know who I was."
"That's right, I did see your photo in the hospital records, but I didn't know that person was you. After all, I was too young at that time to have any memory of you."
"But what about the two of you?"
He looked up, then glanced at Lin Yi and Ling'er.
Because it seemed like there wasn't much connection between the two.
"After leaving the People's Hospital early in my career, I then went to Brother Lin, and since then, I have been responsible for the research and development of medicine. The Youth-Preserving Pill that was previously released on the market, in reality, was our research work."
"Good, that pill is excellent. I knew of it before and thought it might be a scam selling fake medicine at first, but after I bought one and studied it carefully, I found it indeed had the desired effect. Young man, was it you who developed it?"
While speaking, Director Lin turned to look at Lin Yi.
"Yes, I developed it."
"Very well, to be able to develop such a medication is truly astonishing, and without decades of expertise, I fear it wouldn't have been possible. You indeed are a genius."
"By the way, Director Lin, about that human meridian chart you showed me earlier, I wasn't able to assist you with it, but I believe Ling'er should have no problem."
"Hehe, Ling'er will definitely have no problem. If she followed her master, her Basic Skills would probably have begun with what she learned from that meridian chart."
"Great Uncle Master, regarding that book, I have actually heard of it long ago. However, I have never seen it over these years. If possible, could I have the honor of inspecting it?"
"Sure, no problem, just give me a moment."
While speaking, Director Lin turned around and carefully took out the book from a bookcase nearby.
Ling'er carefully held the book in front of her like it was a precious treasure and gently stroked it over and over with her hands.
"It appears that the rumors are indeed true, and I had never thought that in my lifetime, I could actually touch this book. This truly is a great fortune in life."
"Take a look at the content on page 8 that I mentioned to everyone today. I haven't completely grasped it yet, and for the previous pages, it took me seven years of work to understand them."
"What? Seven years?"
Ling'er had probably not anticipated that the content would be so complex.
Afterwards, she directly turned to the content on page 8 and looked at it carefully.
The two of them started to discuss softly there.

chapters.title: Chapter 387 This Book is for You
chapters.content:
Sitting beside Lin Yi, he felt somewhat ill at ease.
After all, when it came to these matters, he really had no way to join in on the discussion.
All he could do was sit silently, savoring his tea, occasionally standing up to stretch his legs around the area.
Finally, he saw the two people stop and also heard the hearty laughter of Director Lin.
He looked up at the wall clock; it was already past 10 pm.
The two had been discussing here, unaware of the time, for an hour and a half.
For them, time seemed to fly by, but for Lin Yi, it truly felt like an ordeal.
Even, he began to feel a wave of sleepiness wash over him.
Unconsciously, he let out a long yawn.
"Hehe, sorry about that. As soon as we met, we found so much in common to talk about, we kind of left you out."
"It's okay, it's okay, I wouldn't understand those things anyway."
"But, I find it curious that you seem to know a lot. Since you understand drug development and the human skeletal chart, why are you so unfamiliar with the human meridians?"
"This..."
Lin Yi hesitated for a moment, unable to answer the question.
He couldn't possibly admit that it was the system within his body that had granted him this half of his abilities, while the other things hadn't been given to him at all. Most likely, no one would believe such a tale if he told it.
"Alright, if you don't want to answer that's fine. I understand you must have your reasons, don't worry, I won't press you further."
"Thank you, Elder Lin."
Lin Yi truly admired the old man.
He hadn't tried to force an answer out of him and hadn't dug further.
To him, that was enough respect.
"Ling'er, I never expected you to be so gifted, and that you would study the book so thoroughly. It seems I truly am old, and that the new waves indeed push the old ones forward, serving no further purpose."
"Master, you mustn't say that. The inventions you've created are still displayed at our sect."
"Haha, this guy, I didn't expect you to think about these things. By the way, where is he now?"
"Master has always been accustomed to wandering the four seas and never appeared for many years. The only time was the year before last when he sent me a letter, saying he was living well."
"Good, good, that's just his character. But for him, it's probably the greatest blessing."
"Master, do you have any plans for what's next?"
"What plans can I have? Just to live out my days here in peace. As I'm getting older, my health is becoming even more important. So, I'll give you this book."
"You, what are you saying? You're going to give it to me, elder?"
Startled, Ling'er's mouth hung open, never having imagined such a precious book could fall into her hands, let alone become its owner.
"Yes, I'm giving it to you. I'm of such an age now; I doubt I'll accomplish any more great deeds. In your hands, it might have a better effect. Study it well; it's fated to be with you."
"Apprentice-niece thanks you, elder."
"Alright, enough of that. Since we're family, we needn't be so formal. I believe your father's spirit can rest in peace now."
Explore more at My Virtual Library Empire
"That's right, ever since my father passed, I've been more determined, dedicating myself to our goals. After so many years, I've achieved some success, especially with Brother Lin, who has shared much with me."
Lin Yi never forgot who had helped him.
He too could recall how Brother Lin had brought him out into the world.
"Good, seeing the accomplishments of you two today, honestly, it excites me inside. But today, he told me, you want to go to Xi Lian Mountain, is that it?"
He brought the question up once more.
After all, for all of them, it was a great challenge, so, honestly, Lin Yi didn't want to bring up the matter at the moment.
"Yes, Brother Lin and I discussed going. Xi Lian Mountain has many regular herbs. If we could take them out, we probably could accomplish a lot. And when the herbs interact with each other, they could create a new type of herb, truly an unprecedented event."
"Yes, I know that too. But do you know just how dangerous Xi Lian Mountain is?"
"That, I'm well aware of."
"So, are you still willing to go? I urge you not to, and not to waste your lives for nothing."
"Elder Lin, honestly, if you tell me not to go, I'm sure to be unwilling."
"Yes, I understand that, but..."
"Elder Lin, please, no more. Brother Lin and I made our decision together. No matter how dangerous it is ahead, we will make sure to be thoroughly prepared. And now, with more advanced technology, dealing with the fierce beasts of the primeval forest isn't so difficult."
"Are you, are you sure you want to go?"
"Yes, I'm sure. It's my life's work, and I will never easily give it up."
Upon saying this, Elder Lin sighed deeply, apparently having some regrets about their decision.
"If you really want to go, I might not be able to offer much, but wait, let me get something for you. Keep it with you; maybe it will come in handy later on."
With those words, Elder Lin stood up and went into the other room.
"Ling'er, what is he going to fetch?"
"I'm not sure, but the elder has always been a person of respect. So, my master often mentioned him back in the day, and I believe he wouldn't harm us; rather, he would provide the greatest help."
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi simply nodded his head.
If the old man could provide them with some clues at this time, it indeed could be a huge help to them.

chapters.title: Chapter 388 Delivering the Map
chapters.content:
After a while, he saw him take out a piece of yellowed paper from inside, and moreover, the paper was folded in half, making it impossible for anyone to know what it was without unfolding it.
"Elder, what is this?"
"This is the hand-drawn map from those years, and it's very, very formal. As far as I know, this is the only copy in existence."
"Brother Lin, you, you told me that the map had been destroyed, didn't you?"
Lin Yi remembered very clearly that he had indeed told him so this morning, which seemed to mean that he had been tricked at that time.
"If I hadn't said that, how could you possibly have given up on this matter? But I realized that I was wrong. Even saying that, it seems that your confidence hasn't wavered, so I had no choice but to take it out."
As he spoke, Dean Lin spread out the hand-drawn map and placed it on the table.
Lin Yi and Ling'er hurriedly looked down, seeing the map was drawn in great detail. It showed several routes down the mountain, several routes up the mountain, and the exact location of these pathways, marked very clearly, save for a large question mark in the final area.
"Dean Lin, what does this mean?"
Lin Yi looked up and asked the dean.
"That is the undeveloped area, and also the most dangerous region. It is rumored that many standard medicinal herbs are concentrated there."
"Are you saying that if we want to go in, we must pass through this place and go all the way to the deepest part of the mountain?"
"Yes, only then can you get the most valuable medicinal herbs. Otherwise, the herbs you collected earlier won't be of much use."
"Okay, I understand. I will take good care of this map. Also, after so many years, has there been any change in the topography of the mountains?"
"Even if there have been changes, they are basically minor variations. You just need to remember to enter through this spot. Back then, I took this route, and roughly here, I encountered some fierce beast attacks, after which I didn't continue any further."
As Brother Lin spoke, he used his hand to point out various places on the map. Enjoy new stories from My Virtual Library Empire
Lin Yi silently committed all these details to memory.
"Good, this map is indeed very powerful, and we will bring it with us when we enter the mountain. I believe it should be helpful."
"The same advice as always, be very careful. If you feel that you cannot proceed any further, you must retreat in time. Besides, it's better to prepare more manpower. Back when we inherited this task, I think we were a bit hasty and didn't prepare thoroughly in advance."
"Don't worry, this time, I will make all the necessary preparations. Otherwise, I wouldn't act rashly."
"Good, with your word, I am satisfied. Let me know if there's anything else I can assist with."
"No, elder, you just wait patiently here. After we enter the mountain, we will survey all the areas and then draw a more detailed map. That is the only way to truly benefit future generations."
"Very well, I have great confidence in you and fully support you."
"Alright, Dean Lin, it's already so late, we shouldn't disturb your rest any longer. We will visit another day if there are matters to discuss."
With those words, the two of them stood up, ready to leave.
"Elder, take good care of your health. I will come to visit you from time to time on behalf of my master to fulfill my filial duties."
"Hehe, I know you are busy, but whenever you have the time, come over for tea and a chat. I believe it can provide you with new insights."
"Very well, then I shall take my leave now, farewell elder."
Dean Lin escorted them to the door, then, with a wave of his hand, he watched as they disappeared from his sight.
Once outside, Lin Yi could clearly feel that Ling'er was indeed very excited.
Because her smile seemed to never fade.
It was as if she hadn't seen her family for many years, and now she finally had that feeling of reunion.
"Ling'er, you're in a good mood now, aren't you?"
"Yes, why? Have you noticed it?"
"Yes, I have. You seem to have not been this happy for a long time."
"Right, it has indeed been a long time since I felt this happy. I'll tell you, this elder to me, has been a significant mentor. Whether it was my father or my master, they always looked up to the elder as their example, so in my heart, the elder has always been like a god to me."
"By the way, about your father and your master, and the elder, were they really that close?"
"Yes, very close. And you know, back then, my father didn't go into hunting but stayed by the elder's side and had some accomplishments."
"What a pity."
"There's nothing to pity, it was all an accident. But Lin, have you really made up your mind?"
"Made up my mind about what?"
"About entering Xi Lian Mountain. Didn't you hear the elder? Xi Lian is extremely dangerous."
"Oh, that. Well, he already mentioned it to me this afternoon. He even showed me the wounds on his body from when he was torn by beasts; it was really shocking."
"Right, so knowing that, do you still want to go?"
"Of course, this is what I plan to do next. Moreover, if we didn't have this information, our journey ahead would likely not go smoothly."
"And what about Hei Lang? Is he ready?"
"Don't worry, I've asked Hei Lang to arrange for enough manpower. Together we'll enter the mountain, and I estimate we should be able to come out in about two or three days."
"Okay, I understand, but I advise you to explain things well to your wife and children before you leave."
"Explain? How should I explain, that I'm going on a death mission? I could never say that to them. I'll have to find another reason. Otherwise, with my wife's temperament, she surely won't let me leave."

chapters.title: Chapter 389 Inspecting the Toy Factory
chapters.content:
"But, deceiving sister-in-law like this, is it really okay?"
"Heh, it's nothing. Sometimes, a little deception can actually make our relationship more stable. Alright, there's no need for you to worry about these trivial matters. It's also getting late, so I'm heading back now. You be careful on your way home."
Brother Lin and Ling'er parted ways at the entrance of the residential area, each returning to their own home.
Early the next day, Lin Yi directly rushed to the site.
At the toy factory, all the work was slowly progressing.
Half of the workers had already been sent home, and their respective compensation had been fully paid out.
So, the work that followed should be able to proceed smoothly.
Zhou Kongshan and Manager Liu knew he was coming, so they specially rushed to the entrance to wait for him.
"President Lin."
Upon seeing him arrive, Zhou Kongshan hurriedly approached.
"I already told Ling'er yesterday, from now on, there will be no President Lin. If you feel like it, just call me Brother Lin. Oh, of course, that doesn't include you, Old Zhou, since you're older than me. I should really be calling you Brother Zhou, and you can just call me by my name."
"Alright, Lin Yi."
"Sigh, that sounds most familiar. By the way, how is the progress with the factory building over there?"
"Don't worry, everything is proceeding step by step, and we've already got a preliminary scale set up. Also, I've drafted a blueprint; take a look. If there's anything you feel isn't right, we still have time to make corrections."
As he spoke, he handed over a blueprint and placed it in front of Lin Yi.
Lin Yi took a look. Overall, it was designed according to his own ideas, with hardly any major changes.
"Good, we've been working together for so many years; don't I trust you to handle things? Just go ahead with this design. What's the current progress?"
"Almost there. It should take about another week or so and it should be completely up. And as you said, you wanted nothing inside, so this time it's actually simpler for me."
"Right, there's one more thing you need to help me with, and that's to design a sterile room of about 20 square meters inside that room."
"A sterile room?"
"Yes, that place needs to have no contact with the outside world whatsoever, and we need a vacuum system, plus another system to increase oxygen levels."
"What do you need this for?"
"Don't worry about what I'm going to do with it. Just take care of these tasks. You don't need to manage the rest. When the time comes, just give me the keys, and then you can devote all your attention to the toy factory."
"Alright, alright, I got it. I'll make sure to emphasize the requirements to the workers again."
"By the way, Manager Liu, how's the market been these past two days? Noticed any progress?"
"Not bad, overall, the progress has been quite noticeable. In particular, I've negotiated two toy processing orders these last couple of days. Although the profit isn't very high, I think it should be sufficient for our initial phase."
"Good, I trust your ability to get things done. Just carry on with your plan. By the way, where's Wang Sheng? How's he been these past two days?"
"He's doing fine. This guy is really giving it his all here. I sent him to the workshop early in the morning to keep an eye on things. Basically, he can handle any task he's given."
"That's good, but remember, there are things you can tell him, and things that you can't share too much with him. Got it?"
"Understood, I know. Do you want me to take you to the workshop to take a closer look?"
"No need, I couldn't be more familiar with the pharmaceutical factory here. I'm actually more interested in that room of mine."
"Okay, I'll go there now."
As he said this, Zhou Kongshan nodded and then led them towards a corner inside.
In fact, as soon as he arrived, Wang Sheng had already received the news.
He was planning to be prepared here, to perform well in the workshop, so that this person might think more highly of him.
"Brother Wang, Brother Wang, they've gone towards the southeast direction. Right now, over at the construction site."
A younger brother quickly ran in and reported.
Wang Sheng was a smart man. Since his arrival, he had made good relations with several people here.
Of course, it was all under the premise of using money to win them over.
At that moment, Wang Sheng was busily making a show of his efforts. Upon hearing the news, he just paused.
Why hadn't things gone according to his plan?
"What? They went over there, with all those people?"
"All of them went over there and didn't stop here."
"Damn it, I thought they would come to the workshop to take a look. It seems my guess was right; this guy's heart isn't set on the toy factory at all."
"So, Brother Wang, should we keep watching?"
"No need. Since they're going, I'll go over there and see what kind of medicine they're actually selling."
Wang Sheng stood up, a cunning smile creeping across his face.
Even now, feeling sidelined, he had never given up on these matters.
Even if they were temporarily not revealing any information to him, Wang Sheng would still continue down this path.
Because he knew that the more secretive they were, it only proved that they were hiding a lot of secrets at this time.
In fact, when Lin Yi arrived at this place, he was quite satisfied with the area.
Zhou Gongshan had always been reliable in his work.
He wanted to leave everything in his care, one to manage the overall operation of the pharmaceutical factory, and the other, Ling'er, to still be responsible for the development and quality control of the medicines here.
The two of them could be said to work seamlessly together.
He saw that the workers on the construction site were busily at it.
It was truly a very lively scene.
"Seeing this, the progress must be really swift, so all I can do now is wait patiently, right?" Stay updated via My Virtual Library Empire
"Exactly, you just need to wait patiently, and there should be no problem. Another three to five days of rushed work, and it should be possible to get it done in time."
Zhou Kongshan was definitely confident about this, as both the workers and the financing were fully in place.

chapters.title: Chapter 390 Astonishing Discovery
chapters.content:
Previously, the pharmaceutical factory had been doing quite well, so it can be said that it was thriving. On most accounts, there was still a lot of surplus money.
"Brother Lin, Brother Lin."
Just then, Lin Yu suddenly heard someone calling him, so Lin Yi turned to look back.
He hadn't expected that someone had hurried over, dusty and travel-worn.
Seeing this, Lin Yi felt a wave of worry wash over him.
How did this guy get the information so quickly? And he had only just arrived here not too long ago, so someone must have reported his whereabouts to him.
"Brother Lin, look, you're here, why didn't you give me a heads up? Plus, I should at least report the factory's situation to you."
"Haha, no need, they've just reported to me. How about you? Are you adjusting well here?"
"Yeah, it's okay, pretty good actually, and you know, now that I have stuff to do, I really don't feel that empty anymore. All of this, I owe to you, Brother Lin."
"Well, that's not entirely the case. As long as you can stay here earnestly, then I and the old man will have something to report back. So, there's nothing else going on, right?"
"Oh, Brother Lin, I've mostly arranged the things on the production line, and soon, they can start doing things on their own. I only heard that you were coming over, so I had to come and greet you. Is this, are you building a house?"
As he said this, Wang Sheng looked around, perplexed.
"Yes, we are building a house."
"But the way it's being built, that's not going to work."
"What? What's not going to work?"
"Look at this section, you can't lay the foundation like this. Don't you know what used to be underneath here?"
At this point, Lin Yi paused suddenly.
He had no idea about any issues with the foundation, and although he had often come to the toy factory in the past, he didn't know the lay of the land here very well.
Continue reading at My Virtual Library Empire
"I don't understand what you mean. Are you saying there's a problem with the foundation?"
"If I'm not mistaken, this place used to be a waste pit, and it's since been filled in, right?"
After hearing this, Lin Yi turned his head and then glanced at Zhou Kongshan, who was standing there.
In fact, Wang Sheng had already done his homework thoroughly. After entering this place, he made sure to understand all facets of its history and development.
For Wang Sheng, the idea that 'knowing the enemy and knowing yourself, you can fight a hundred battles without disaster' was fundamental.
Only by understanding the whole picture could he discern the motives behind these people's actions.
"Yes, you're right, this area was indeed a waste dump, and all the construction debris and some pharmaceutical waste were thrown here, but now it's been filled in, so there shouldn't be any issue."
"Filled in and done with it? You might not understand this, but let me tell you, if that's the case, it might look alright on the surface for now, but as time goes on, this foundation will inevitably collapse."
"What? Collapse? That can't be possible. The foundation has been filled in well, and I've used several different types of soil."
Zhou Kongshan, in fact, didn't understand much about construction. He just vaguely knew that to build a house here, he had to bury those previous materials.
So, he didn't think much about it, just felt that laying a good foundation and then building up, layer by layer, should be fine.
"No, if you do it this way, it won't work. Moreover, it's completely different from the solid underground soil of the past. That kind of soil gets firmer over time, but if the waste underneath is left for too long, it will eventually undergo a fermentation process. And after a few years, it might turn to ashes.
Just imagine, if all that material disappears, won't all the soil you've filled in collapse?"
After he finished speaking, Lin Yi carefully mulled it over. Although he wasn't sure if what he said was true, the conditions he described seemed to match the situation.
"You mean to say you understand this kind of thing?"
"I wouldn't say I fully understand it, but in the past, I worked on some projects with the old man, and I picked up some basic knowledge. If you don't believe me, ah, come here."
Just then, he spotted a person in a white hard hat, constantly directing on the site.
Clearly, this person must be the on-site construction manager, who under normal circumstances just needs to arrange for the workers and doesn't have to work himself.
"What's the matter, is there something I can help you with?"
He hurriedly came over, presuming that they were probably visiting to check on the project's progress.
"Oh, are you in charge of this construction site?"
"Yes, I am. Are you here to look at the project's progress? There, as you can see, we have people working in three shifts, day and night. Give us three to five more days, and the main structure will definitely be up. You can rest assured about that."
He just thought that these people must be concerned about the progress of the project.
Like many, they might rush the work, but each step must be well-compressed. Otherwise, in the end, the house could become dangerous.
"I'd like to ask, did you conduct any actual surveys on the landscape or the foundation before coming here?"
"That, no, we didn't, and moreover, it's all soil, right? I even specifically asked at the time, and it should've been fine."
"Soil? Wait, didn't you realize? This used to be a waste pit that was later filled in."
"What? A waste pit? You didn't tell me anything about that."
Upon hearing this, the construction site manager suddenly widened his eyes, then asked Zhou Kongshan.
"This, I've already filled it in, what else is there to explain?"
"Factory Director Zhou, oh, Factory Director Zhou, you've put me in a tight spot. Don't you know that if there's really a pile of rubbish underneath, just filling it in with soil is not enough, because in a few years, the foundation will sink entirely."

chapters.title: Chapter 391 Entering the Situation
chapters.content:
As expected, what he described was essentially identical to what Wang Sheng had described earlier.
"You, what did you say? It needs to sink further?"
