chapters.title: Chapter 393 Another New Development
chapters.content:
"Yeah, you go on out; I don't need anyone for now,"
"Oh, then, then I got it, Mom. You just stay here, I'll be back in a bit. I'm going to prepare some food for you in the kitchen."
While saying this, Liu Yao turned around and left, closing the door from the outside as she went.
"Young man, what do you think should be done next?"
As he spoke, he lifted his blanket, and once again his legs were exposed to Lin Yi's view.
"Auntie, you don't have to worry about anything. Just lie here, close your eyes, and conserve your energy. As for what to do, I will tell you when it's time."
"Alright, I understand."
After all, Lin Yi's every word was now taken by him as gospel truth.
Having said that, his eyes began to sweep the room.
After scanning the room, Lin Yi suddenly noticed that there appeared to be faint traces of radiation on the bones.
This wasn't right. The last time he was here, these marks hadn't been present. How had they appeared?
Besides these marks, Lin Yi didn't find any other suspicious areas.
At this point in his mind, a clear plan had formed, which meant that the previous affected area needed to be injected with something more to stabilize it, ensuring it wouldn't relapse so quickly.
However, he hadn't figured out the radiation issue just yet. Following that thought, he reached out and gently pressed on the leg.
As soon as Lin Yi's hand touched the skin, he suddenly felt his entire right hand becoming stronger, and it seemed like his strength had never been this great before.
But once this power had taken form, it shot straight into his leg bones.
"Ouch."
At that moment, the elder made a sound, clearly indicating that the treatment was painful.
"Auntie, are you okay?"
"No, it's just that I felt a deep, drilling pain suddenly. But now, it seems that the pain has vanished."
"Don't worry, I'm treating you right now. The symptoms should start to subside in a bit. Just be patient."
After finishing, the woman nodded slightly and then closed her eyes to continue enduring the pain.
To tell the truth, the pain was still there, but it had lessened a lot compared to before.
After 10 minutes, Lin Yi finally felt that the previous area had been smoothed out by his efforts.
He gave it another look and, indeed, the white scar that was there before had vanished.
It seemed that it probably wouldn't recur in that spot again.
However, as his gaze left the leg bone, Lin Yi noticed that there seemed to be a red glow flickering persistently around the ankle.
But Lin Yi didn't understand what it meant.
After all, the last time he had scanned her leg bone, this hadn't occurred, yet now it was clearly a new symptom.
Finally, he placed his hand on that spot on the leg bone and pressed down hard.
"Auntie, does this spot hurt?"
"When you press like that, it seems, well, there really is some pain."
"And what about this spot?"
He moved again to an adjacent spot, using the same amount of pressure, and pressed down.
"This place doesn't feel much, but there is some pain, not as much as the other spot, but it seems, it should be lighter."
"So, you're saying that this spot hurts quite a bit, right?"
"Yes, it could be pretty bad."
At this point, Lin Yi seemed to be gradually coming to an understanding.
If this was the case, then the area glowing red would likely be where the osteosarcoma was about to form.
It appeared that this disease was indeed very dangerous. Just after they had gotten rid of it in one area, it seemed as though the next step would be its emergence in another organ. It was truly like wildfire that couldn't be extinguished, spring breeze only brought it back to life.
Only, it hadn't fully manifested at this point. If it had, he would have a way to deal with it.
But how should he resolve it when it hadn't appeared yet?
His mind suddenly became a blank slate.
That wasn't right. In the past when faced with difficulties, the system would always provide certain prompts within his neural pathways.
However, it didn't seem to be doing so now.
He was unclear on what the system was up to at this time, and under these circumstances, he wasn't able to directly converse with the system.
He just felt that if a problem had arisen in this area, it should be nipped in the bud as early as possible. By doing this, he would also lighten his treatment burden down the line.
"Okay, Auntie, I've finished with you for now. Essentially, the area that had recurred has been completely eliminated, and from now on, it won't recur again," he said.
"That's great, young man, your medical skills are truly impressive."
"Heh, I wouldn't say they're impressive, it just happened to fall right into my wheelhouse. By the way, Auntie, have you been to the hospital these past few days?"
He suddenly asked this question.
At that moment, Liu Yao's mother didn't react at all and casually agreed to his statement.
"Yes, I went. It was that afternoon, Yaoyao accompanied me."
"Oh, I see."
After saying this, he just nodded.
Now, he finally understood why there were signs of radiation on her leg bone—it meant that Liu Yao had indeed taken her to the CT room.
He believed Liu Yao's intention was simple: to figure out if he had deceived her, if he had truly cured everything.

"All right, Auntie, that concludes today's treatment. In the future, there might be a few more sessions, and then the intervals between treatments will gradually lengthen. You must promise me, Auntie, to eat well because only then can I continue to treat you properly. Otherwise, there's nothing I can do. Do you understand?"

"So what now? The guy's vanished into thin air. It's unclear where he's hiding or even what kind of plan he's concocting."
Having said this, Lin Yi felt somewhat worried himself.
Until now, he felt the debt of Wang Guixiang's vengeance unavenged, and honestly, he always felt somewhat guilty about it.
"Sigh, by the way, I just remembered something. How is her child doing now?"
"After sending him back to his hometown, there has been no news."
"Remember, I've been busy lately and haven't had the time to care. You find a way, even if it means going to his hometown, leave them more money. Remember, leave a good amount of money."
"Sure, don't worry, Brother Lin, I know what to do."
"Good, then go take care of it. We'll stay in touch if anything comes up."
"Okay, I'll take my leave then."
Having said that, Hei Lang hurriedly got up and left.
In a darkened room at that moment, Zhao Guangchen had not left for several days.
These past few days, he felt as if he had entered Hell from the living world.
The agony, each day, made him wish for death.
He even dared not look at himself in a mirror. He had once secretly taken a mirror to see his reflection and felt like he had turned into a completely disfigured version of himself.
His face was covered with scars, and he had no idea how all those crumpled features came to be.
He was skeptical whether these people could really help him. If they couldn't, wouldn't he become the greatest casualty?
Caught up in his chaotic thoughts, the door suddenly opened.
He had not left the room for days.
He wanted to leave but was unable to. The room had been put under surveillance, and the door was locked from the outside.
Even the room's windows had been sealed. They said that under his condition, he absolutely could not be exposed to sunlight, not even to artificial light.
Meaning, since his arrival, all the electrical circuits in the room had been officially cut off.
He could barely make out two people in protective suits approaching him.
"What, what are you going to do again?"
Zhao Guangchen had no ability to resist, and he just shouted loudly.
"It's time for your medication, and this injection too needs to be given. You'd better cooperate, then we won't need to force you."
"I won't take it, I can't continue like this; I feel like if this goes on, I will definitely die at your hands."
He was just roaring with all his might while his body shrank back into the corner.
The two people, despite the darkness around them, could see each other.
They exchanged glances, for they had experienced his non-cooperation before. Of course, they would have to exhaust other methods to reluctantly make him comply.

chapters.title: Chapter 397 Intense Resistance
chapters.content:
It was clear now that he was in no condition to continue.
"I'm telling you, don't come any closer. If you do, I'll die right in front of you," he warned.
As he spoke, Zhao Guangchen suddenly pulled out a lump of iron from beside him.
When he brought the object out, both of them were indeed startled.
They shone a weak flashlight on it for a moment and there was no mistake, he was indeed holding a block of iron.
Moreover, at that moment, the iron block was positioned right above Zhao Guangchen's head, as if it would come crashing down if they attempted to approach.
It was unclear where he had found the iron block; they had already checked thoroughly before, and there shouldn't have been any dangerous items in the room.
"Don't be so agitated. Whatever it is, we can talk it over slowly," they attempted to soothe.
"Talk it over? How? I've been in here for so many days, and my life is worse than death. I know you're just treating me like a lab rat, aren't you?" he retorted.
"No, it's because treatment always requires time, and we've used an enhanced injection on you this time. We believe it should be able to alleviate your current pain," they explained.
"I don't believe your lies. I'm telling you, I want to see that person— I need to see them," he insisted loudly.
Zhao Guangchen knew that all of this was arranged by Wang Sheng behind the scenes, but Wang Sheng hadn't shown up at all these many days.
"Alright, alright, calm down. We'll call them right away. Just set that thing down and then slowly make your way over to me. Rest assured, we won't touch you," they promised.
"I'm telling you, don't even think about getting me to give this up. Once I give it up, I'll have nothing left in my hands, so back off," he asserted.
"Okay, we'll back off. Just don't get agitated right now, stay calm," they said, retreating towards the door and eventually having no choice but to temporarily leave the room.
Once the room fell back into darkness and silence, Zhao Guangchen let out a sigh of relief.
He gripped the iron block tightly in his hand, which he had managed to collect over several days from the position of his bedside.
Without this item, he feared that today's injection would have definitely hit him for sure.
After the two of them exited, they immediately donned heavy protective suits and set off.
"What do we do now? His emotions are so agitated, and if we really get close, he could swing that thing at us, ruining all the work we've done up to now," they worried.
"Yeah, we can't explain this to them either. Let's make a call and ask him to come over quickly," they decided.
Your next read is at My Virtual Library Empire
"Okay, I got it," one replied and nodded before stepping aside to make a phone call.
At that moment, Wang Sheng and Han Xuemei had just eased into each other's embrace.
Just then, the annoying ring of the cellphone sounded again, causing Wang Sheng to rise from the bed with irritation.
"What's wrong, dear?" Han Xuemei asked as she wrapped her arms tightly around his neck, not wanting him to leave.
"It's so late, nobody would be contacting me unless it's an emergency. Let me just take this call, don't worry, my dear," he assured her.
The two had been inseparable these past days, as if unable to live without each other.
"What's up?" he asked when he saw the phone number, sensing there must be some development; otherwise, they wouldn't be disturbing him at this hour.
"You should come here. He's being very uncooperative and agitated, and tonight's injection has to be administered, or else our prior efforts will be wasted," the voice on the phone conveyed.
"What? Uncooperative?" he repeated in surprise.
"Extremely uncooperative," the voice affirmed.
"What's the situation? Wasn't he cooperative all these past days?" he questioned.
"We didn't want to bother you, so we didn't say much before, but he's actually been quite uncooperative all along," they disclosed.
"So, what's the progress now?" he inquired.
"We indeed failed previously, but now we've found a new corrective measure. However, he's not allowing us to proceed with the experiment on him, so we can't obtain the real experimental data we need," they explained.
"What do you mean you failed?" he said, shocked, as Han Xuemei sat up in bed, slipping on her robe once more.
"So you're saying it definitely failed?" he sought confirmation.
"Then what do we do now?" he asked with concern.
"Right now, explaining over the phone isn't enough; you'd better come over in person. We can explain it to you face to face, and you'll understand what's happened," they suggested.
"Okay, okay, I understand. Wait for me; I'll be right there," he replied hurriedly.
"What happened?" Han Xuemei expressed her worry when she saw Wang Sheng end the call, guessing something adverse had occurred.
"Zhao Guangchen seems uncooperative, and they can't treat him now. They need me to go there personally," he explained.
"What? Uncooperative? What happened?" she pressed for details.
"Apparently, the experiment failed before, and now they've taken a corrective measure, but it seems Zhao Guangchen can't accept it," he elaborated.
"Then I'll go with you," she offered.
"What? You're coming with me?" he questioned.
"Yes. You hardly know him, and maybe it'll be easier to talk to him if I'm there. I suspect he actually wants to see me," she deduced.
When Han Xuemei reached that conclusion, Wang Sheng pondered it and realized she might indeed be right.
He had hardly any interaction with that man, and if anything unexpected happened now, he really couldn't afford the consequences.
Hurriedly, they dressed and vanished into the night.
By the time they arrived, it was already 11:00 PM.
He knocked on the courtyard gate, and soon someone came and opened the door for them.
"How has it been these past couple of days? Any issues from outside?" he inquired.
"Rest assured, it's been very quiet, and we haven't been disturbed by anyone," they were reassured.

chapters.title: Chapter 398 Backing Down
chapters.content:
Wang Sheng finally nodded in relief. In fact, he had arranged everything, including the people outside. No one was allowed to approach the vicinity of the courtyard.
After entering the room, he saw all the equipment lit up, and in front of him, there was a very strange device on display.
The device was still operating, and the noise was so loud that it was quite bothersome.
"What's the situation now? And, why did it fail this time?"
Wang Sheng walked forward and asked.
"Previously, the experiments we conducted on animals had always shown positive reactions, but this time, experimenting on a human subject, things did not go smoothly. I suspect that there might be an issue with the dosage of the drug or the method of its preparation."
"If you realized there was a problem, why did you still proceed with it?"
"But, we had never tested on humans before, this was the first time."
"So, what exactly does this so-called failure entail?"
"His entire face has disintegrated, and, at that moment, I had not anticipated it. I didn't expect the injection to have such a pronounced effect on his face."
"Weren't there other drugs before?"
"Yes, indeed, there were other drugs. When we administered them, they seemed to have no effect, or rather, I am beginning to doubt whether he ingested them at all."
"What? Don't you monitor him every time he takes his medication?"
"At the beginning, we did follow along, but later, he simply wouldn't let us stay nearby. However, every 10 minutes when we went in, the medicine bowl was always empty, and no traces of spilled medicine were found in the room. So, we are fairly certain that he must have ingested it."
"What do you mean by 'must have ingested it'? Don't you realize that this man is very cunning, and under these circumstances, you're simply not in control of him?"
"That's why I had no choice but to call you, Mr. Wang. What do you suggest we do now?"
"I understand. For now, don't do anything. By the way, how much time do we have left?"
"Before dawn, we must administer this injection. Moreover, the previous drug won't last much longer. If we delay further, I fear that even this injection will no longer be effective."
"Before 5 a.m.?"
Having said this, Wang Sheng nodded and then checked the time. Fortunately, there was still plenty of time for him.
"Is there no electricity in the room?"
"We've cut the power because, during treatment, it's best to avoid exposure to daylight as it could have a deleterious effect on the skin."
"Then how are you supposed to talk to him in the dark?"
"Mr. Wang, I advise you not to turn on the lights and talk to him. It would be extremely terrifying to see him in the light."
"What's so terrifying? I've seen pretty much everything over the years. If we can't use lights, can we use something else? What about candles?"
"Candles might work. Although they are dimmer, they won't cause as much damage to his skin."
"Okay, prepare some candles. Go, bring them to me. I'll go in and talk to him while you wait outside."
After speaking, one of the researchers turned and found a whole candle from under the lab table, then lit it with a lighter.
When the two approached the door, they simply exchanged glances, and Han Xuemei nodded slightly.
Finally, she took out the key and unlocked the chain lock.
"Who are you?"
Zhao Guangchen inside remained very alert.
Hearing someone enter, he asked anxiously.
"It's me. Don't panic, I'm Han Xuemei."
"Han Xuemei, oh good, now you are doing this to me?"
Zhao Guangchen suddenly charged out, startling Han Xuemei so much that she quickly hid behind Wang Sheng.
"I'm warning you, don't mess around, or don't blame me for not being polite."
Wang Sheng simply extended the candle toward Zhao Guangchen and said.
In that moment, Zhao Guangchen truly softened.
After all, they were surrounded by their people. If it had been just Han Xuemei alone, perhaps he could have managed.
A man must bow under the eaves, and upon seeing this, Zhao Guangchen slowly stepped back.
He could see from Wang Sheng's eyes, that fierce and malicious aura.
Stay connected through My Virtual Library Empire
Watching his attitude toward Han Xuemei, it was clear that the two of them must be involved now.
Reflecting on his own glorious years, he now felt a pain that was unbearable.
Seeing him soften, Wang Sheng finally took a deep breath. To be honest, he did not want to confront this person for real.
Furthermore, having conducted secret experiments for many years, he had always hoped to find a suitable subject, while not violating legal and moral principles.
And now, a test subject had practically delivered himself, so Wang Sheng really didn't want the subject to be ruined at this moment.
"I know what you're thinking right now. If you trust me, we can sit down and talk slowly."
"Trust you? On what basis should I trust you? After all, we've only met once. Why should I trust you?"
"I know you don't trust me, so today I brought Xue Mei especially. I believe the relationship between you two surely transcends mine, right? Come on, let's sit down and talk."
Wang Sheng said, placing the candle on a nearby table.
Even though the light was dim, under the circumstances, it was quite adequate for them.
Once seated, Han Xuemei suddenly realized that Zhao Guangchen's face had become disfigured beyond recognition.
Moreover, if he were to go outside looking like this, he would probably scare everyone away.
Han Xuemei was indeed shocked, having not seen him for just a few days, and now he had transformed into this state.

chapters.title: Chapter 399 I Talk to Him
chapters.content:
The handsome and dashing face that existed before had now completely disappeared.
"You told me you could help me change my appearance, but now? I've been stuck in this hellish place for a full five days, and during these five days, I've watched my face being devoured bit by bit by those bacterial agents. Do you think I can go out and face people looking like this?"
"Let's set all of that aside for a moment. Just look at yourself now. Once you're outside, tell me, who could possibly recognize that you were once Zhao Guangchen, the wanted criminal, the murderer?"
"Ha, a wanted criminal? A murderer? Fine, I'd rather be shot dead by those people, or captured by them. I don't want to live a life that's worse than death."
"I'm telling you, any treatment process takes time and effort, and right now, you are at a critical moment. If you can't even accept this, then how can you change your basic appearance?"
"Change, how to change? Besides, I now feel that my face can no longer hold up. If this continues, I'll surely end up dead here."
"No, that absolutely won't happen. I'm telling you that our current strategy is to first bring you to a high starting point, and now, we've gradually started restoring the appearance of your face. Eventually, when these scars are repaired, a new person will emerge, understand?"
"A new person will emerge?"
Hearing this, Zhao Guangchen just frowned in suspicion. He didn't know whether the words of the man in front of him were true or false, or whether he was being deceived entirely?
"That's right, just like that. If you really believe me, this injection is something you must take."
"Tell me, how long will it take exactly?"
"Judging by the current progress, I estimate at least half a month, around 20 days or so. I believe you'll definitely be able to see the light of day again."
"See the light of day? What reason do I have to believe you?"
"I have nothing to guarantee this with. But I can assure you that, at my place, you will absolutely not be disturbed by outsiders. Moreover, I can definitely guarantee your safety. Do you really want to be caught as soon as you go outside and then lose your freedom?"
"Losing freedom, while perhaps pitiful, at least I can still look at myself in the mirror and see what I actually look like."
"Does that mean you can't accept this needle and the experiment?"
"Yes, I can't accept it."
"Fine, if you don't accept it, that's okay too. You can leave whenever you like, and I won't stop you. But think carefully about how you're going to live the days ahead."
Wang Sheng didn't have such concerns. Moreover, he knew that at this moment, Zhao Guangchen couldn't leave this place.
If he could leave, the world would probably descend into utter chaos.
After speaking, he stood up and walked to the door, suddenly flinging it open.
A beam of light from outside shone in directly.
Zhao Guangchen, who hadn't seen such brightness for a long time, was undoubtedly struggling to adjust. He quickly retreated backward and finally hid himself in a gloomy corner.
"Close the door, close it now!"
"Do you see? This is your current situation, you can't even stand the sunlight, not even a bit of light. Tell me, what can you do after leaving this place?"
"Get out, all of you, get out."
Zhao Guangchen roared loudly.
Wang Sheng stepped forward, wanting to continue speaking, but at that moment, Han Xuemei gently pulled him back.
He turned to look at Han Xuemei, uncertain of what she meant at this time.
"You go out. I'll talk to him."
"What, what did you say?"
Wang Sheng was indeed worried. It was clear that this man's emotions were out of control, and if he acted impulsively now, the consequences could be unimaginable.
Moreover, everyone was painfully aware that he was a murderer. If he went mad, there was no telling what he might do.
"Don't worry, I'll be fine."
"No, it's too dangerous for you to be alone."
"If there are two of us here, we can't do anything. Besides, it's not possible to persuade him under these circumstances. Only I can gradually talk to him and at least reach his heart."
"Under his current state, he is incredibly emotionally unstable and could lash out at you at any moment."
"It's okay, I know him too well. If you're not at ease, do you have any means of self-defense?"
As he said this, he glanced over there.
Then he waved at the researchers on the other side and whispered in their ears. Soon after, one of them handed him a small telescopic stick, which he held in his hand.
"Hold on to this. It can defend against Zhao Guangchen when it comes to the crunch. Plus, pressing this button will emit an electric shock, which could also bring him down," he explained.
"Okay, I understand. Now, can you relax?"
"I'll be right at the door. If he shows any signs of discomfort, you must shout loudly. We will all rush over immediately and subdue him."
"Alright, I've got it."
Enjoy new tales from My Virtual Library Empire
"Also, I heard just now that he has a metal object in his hand. If you find the right moment, try to take it back, because that thing is too dangerous."
"Fine, I'll do my best."
Han Xuemei was touched by Wang Sheng's deep concern for her.
He repeatedly instructed her about the details and only then entered the room.
Of course, she closed the door from inside afterward to make him let down his guard.
"Mr. Wang, is he alright?"
The people standing outside were impressed by the courage of the woman who entered the room alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 400 Painful Experience
chapters.content:
"There shouldn't be much need for adaptation, the two of them are rather familiar with each other. Let's just stay by the door. If there's any commotion, we'll be ready to rush in at a moment's notice."
"Alright, I understand."
After finishing their conversation, they took their belongings, brought over a stool, and sat directly by the door.
"Now, it's just me who has come in. If there's anything you want to talk about, the two of us can sit down and have a proper chat. Isn't it what you've always wanted, to have a chat with me?"
As Han Xuemei spoke, she boldly walked inside.
"Where is he? Where did he go?"
"He is currently outside the door. Besides, I understand that you might not want to reveal your feelings in front of others. It's okay, now it's just me. Can you tell me what's on your mind?"
After she said these words, Wang Sheng seemed to still be somewhat disbelieving, slowly poking his head out and then glancing outside.
The room was empty except for Han Xuemei. True to her word, the others hadn't followed her in.
Feeling relieved, Zhao Guangchen stepped out from the darkness.
Then, he sat down near the bed.
"I want to ask you, did you ever love me?"
"If I said I never loved you, that would be lying. Yes, I truly loved you. But after what you did, you left me deeply chilled. Now, I don't have the slightest feeling for you anymore."
"Heh, I understand. Actually, I'm very much aware of my actions. But there was no choice; under those circumstances, if I hadn't made a decision, I might not have come to this point."
"Yes, you certainly have persisted until today, but what's the result? You're living in exile now, and you can't even dare to show your face in the daylight."
"Maybe, this is all the retribution I deserve. Alright, with your words, I'm already content. At the very least, we once had an intense relationship, right?"
"Those are all things of the past, I don't want to talk about them now. Moreover, my wholehearted intention right now is to stand with you, so that together, we can fight side by side and defeat Lin Yi. Don't you want to see that outcome?"
"Lin Yi?"
At the mention of this name, his brow wrinkled slightly. This man, he had never once forgotten.
If it had not been for Lin Yi instigating Wang Guixiang behind the scenes, he believed he would never have come to this point so quickly.
Thinking of Lin Yi, Zhao Guangchen felt so much hatred his teeth clenched, his fists tight.
He swore that if Lin Yi were ever to appear before him, he would not hesitate to lunge forward, pin him down, and beat him fiercely.
"You hate him, I hate him too. If it weren't for Lin Yi, I wouldn't be in this situation today. So, if you want to defeat him, you must pick yourself up again."
"Pick myself up? How? You can see my face now, right? You know better than anyone what my face looks like." Discover more content at My Virtual Library Empire
"Yes, your face is indeed a mess, almost too hard for anyone to look at. But this is a process. Every treatment requires such a process. After all, the procedures of treatment have their ups and downs. So in this situation, you should trust them."
"Trust? How can I trust them? They promised I wouldn't suffer too much pain, but do you know? Every single night I feel as if there are 10,000 ants gnawing on my face, such unbearable pain that I've wished for death."
"Okay, I can relay your suffering to them, see if they can alleviate your pain in other ways. But the premise is, you must cooperate. Now things have come to this, if you don't cooperate, then your face might stay like this forever."
"What do you mean?"
"What I mean is, you must cooperate as soon as possible. Only then is there hope to change your face back. But if you give up now, then there's no hope at all. And don't worry, those people have been doing this for many years, their techniques are quite mature. I advise you, it's best to risk it all this one time."
"Risk it all? What if I truly fail in the end?"
"If you fail, it won't be much worse than it is now. Is there an outcome worse than the current one?"
Yes, what Han Xuemei was saying was true to the word, and indeed it struck a chord in his heart.
At that moment, Zhao Guangchen fell silent. In her heart, Han Xuemei felt somewhat smug.
She was very clear that at this time, he must have taken her words to heart. If that was the case, then what followed should be easier to handle.
Seizing the moment, Han Xuemei gently approached and suddenly grabbed his hand.
At this instant, Zhao Guangchen felt as if he had been electrified.
It had been so long since he had touched this woman, and now he felt somewhat inferior.
He kept withdrawing his hand, but after Han Xuemei insistently struggled, his hand was firmly anchored there.
"You don't have to hide. Moreover, no matter what you become, I still clearly remember our life together. We should have a new beginning. Don't you agree?"
"You and him?"
"That's right, I've already gotten together with him, but even though we are together, I believe our hearts are still in unison. If you trust me, you should join us. When the time comes, we'll defeat Lin Yi together. Isn't that the result you want to see?"
"I want to, I dream of it."
"In that case, I think you should accept their treatment. Trust me, I would never harm you. If I had wanted to harm you, then the moment you stepped into this city, I would have handed you over to the authorities, or perhaps even informed Lin Yi of your whereabouts. I believe all of this would then have been over."

chapters.title: Chapter 401 Persuasion Succeeded
chapters.content:
"So, what you're saying is that I'm still of use to you, aren't I?"
"If that's how you want to understand it, I can't help it, but I'm telling you, I won't harm you."
"Alright, I understand."
"What about now?"
"It's fine, let them in. Since things have already come to this point today, just like you said, even if I were to run away now, what could possibly happen? I believe it wouldn't be any better than the current situation."
"Okay."
After finishing her words, Han Xuemei stood up. She just let out a long sigh of relief, having finally dealt with this man.
"What's in your hand?"
At this moment, Han Xuemei noticed that his right hand was always hidden at his side.
She remembered that when she first arrived, someone had already told her that he should have a weapon in his hand. Now, she believed it must be in his right hand.
Following that, Zhao Guangchen straightened out his hand, and sure enough, the size of a fist, a piece of metal now lay in his palm.
Then, Han Xuemei reached out and took the piece of metal from him.
Continue your adventure with My Virtual Library Empire
After all, this was a weapon. If he kept holding onto it, their plans would likely be affected.
But he clutched it tightly, seemingly unwilling to let go.
"What are you doing?"
"Stop holding onto it. This thing is very dangerous, whether for others or for you. Trust me and hand it over."
"But..."
"I know what you want to say. You just want something that can ensure your safety, right? Let me tell you, holding onto this is meaningless. If they wanted to destroy you, could you really take on so many people outside with whatever you have in your hand?"
"Yes, I know I can't."
"Right, if you trust me, give it to me. In return, I'll talk to them about leaving you a phone. If you feel unwell at any time, just call me and I'll clarify the situation."
At this point, Zhao Guangchen truly began to waver.
She seemed to have opened up very generous conditions for him and indeed struck a chord with him.
Gradually, his grip loosened, and taking advantage of the moment, Han Xuemei snatched the metal piece from his hand.
Han Xuemei put her other hand on his shoulder and patted it gently.
"Don't worry, everything is moving in a positive direction. The plan will definitely succeed. Trust me."
After leaving these words, she turned and left the room.
The moment the door opened, Wang Sheng hurriedly rushed up.
The conversation between the two people in the room was not very clear to him.
After all, they were separated by a door, and they had deliberately lowered their voices when they spoke.
He could only vaguely hear that the two were indeed communicating, but he wasn't clear about the specifics.
"Are you okay?"
He suddenly rushed up and gave Han Xuemei a thorough once-over.
"Heh, what could possibly be wrong with me? Aren't I fine? You're talking about this thing, aren't you?"
As he spoke, he took out the metal piece, and another scientist immediately took it into their hands.
"That's right, this is it. If we didn't have this, we might have already given him the injection."
"I've already talked him through it, though. I advise you to be gentler with him. He can fully cooperate with you; you don't need to resort to force anymore, got it?"
"You mean he's willing to accept it now?"
"Yes, he's willing. Go on in."
"Great, this is perfect, let's hurry, get ready."
The syringes they had were now ineffective.
Once these things are opened, they can only be maintained for a few short minutes.
If they are not injected into the human body within a few minutes, they will lose their intended effect completely.
Even worse, they could produce other side effects, an issue they have always been unable to explain.
Watching them hurriedly make preparations, the two scientists then entered the room.
Outside, only Wang Sheng and Han Xuemei were left.
"Impressive, I never thought, sending you here, would actually make him listen to you."
"Of course, I have always said so. I also made it clear to him that if he refuses to settle this matter, even if he were to leave, he wouldn't achieve anything good. So, he tends to listen to what I say."
"Good, if that's the case, then all the better. This time, you've made a significant contribution; don't worry, I'll definitely remember it."
Wang Sheng excitedly took Han Xuemei's hand. She didn't reply, just flashed a faint smile.
She knew that all this was within her control; at her current capacity, she couldn't stir up any trouble.
If she wanted to sort things out, she would need to start with this man, Wang Sheng.
After about 20 minutes, two scientists came out from the room.
But looking at their expressions, it seemed the treatment went relatively well.
"How did it go, all settled?"
"Don't worry, it's been injected. We also added a sedative in case his emotions got out of control, and now he has fallen asleep."
"Okay, so what happens after this injection?"
"If all goes well, his facial nerve tissues will start to regenerate. Later stages of treatment will include some minor facial adjustments, and then we can create a perfect face."
"Good, if that's so, nothing could be better. In about 10 days or so, can you finish this task?"
"Based on the current progress and the additional aid of some of our infrared medical equipment, I estimate that in about 10 days, it should be possible."

chapters.title: Chapter 402 Pulling Tricks
chapters.content:
"That should be completely enough, right, which means he can show his true face then?"
"Almost, but some minor adjustments might still be needed in the later stages. However, it's just a matter of medication adjustment, basically, there shouldn't be any problems."
"Great, that's excellent. If that's the case, I'll start making other preparations. You guys have worked hard. If there's anything else you need, just get in touch with me anytime."
"Don't worry, Mr. Wang, the scientific funding you provided us before has been greatly appreciated. Honestly, we're very thankful. Otherwise, we might all be deemed lunatics by now."
"Hehe, what are you talking about? I always believed you would be successful, not lunatics. Besides, if there were a mad scientist, then he must be a madman."
Laughter rang out warmly from within the room.
It wasn't until around 2 a.m. that he left there with Han Xuemei.
On the road, Han Xuemei had a question she wanted to ask Wang Sheng.
How had he come into contact with this scientific research? And he knew that, once the research was successful, it would likely be a game changer for their upcoming ventures.
"Hmm, what's up? Is there something on your mind?"
Wang Sheng, who was driving, was quite attentive and had already noticed the subtle change in Han Xuemei's demeanor.
"Nothing, I was just wondering about what they said to you earlier, about whether you were providing significant scientific support in the earlier period."
"Yes, when I first encountered this project, I felt it was quite fantastical."
"If it was fantastical, then why did you provide them with such substantial financial support?"
"Because I really needed the money at the time, and if I didn't use this project as a cover, there's no way my dad would have given me the funds."
"I get it now, you inflated the numbers to get the funds, right?"
"That's right, that was my thinking back then. But unexpectedly, they grew quietly over the years, and I had even forgotten about it at one point."
"It turns out you accidentally made the right investment this time."
"Exactly, that's what I mean. Now I have nothing else but the resources of the people around me and this medical team at my disposal."
"Like them, I think they should be able to change a lot. By the way, have you considered introducing this to the world? If it's successfully marketed, it could bring you profits far beyond what you're seeing now."
"No, this research is too substantial, so I'm keeping it under wraps for now, otherwise, it would definitely cause an uproar."
"Are you planning to keep it under wraps indefinitely?"
"Definitely not. I'll use it in other ways, and private transactions are likely to entail less risk than public ones. After all, not everyone can truly accept a change of face."
After saying this, Han Xuemei carefully contemplated the matter.
It seemed that Wang Sheng's words did have insight.
If that was the case, then all she needed to do was continue following Wang Sheng's instructions, and there shouldn't be any major problems.
"Ah, right, I haven't told you yet, you know Lin Yi has started to let me take charge of the construction in the toy factory," she mentioned.
"The toy factory?"
Han Xue Mei wasn't really interested in what was happening there.
She knew that the toy factory was just a façade and that it wouldn't cause any significant stir.
So when Wang Sheng spoke about it, she couldn't quite understand it. Could it be that Wang Sheng couldn't distinguish reality?
Could a mere toy factory excite him so much?
"What, do you think this matter doesn't have much to do with me, huh?"
"Yeah, the toy factory business isn't that significant. Even if he handed you the whole factory, what would that amount to? I don't think it means anything really."
"You're wrong. If I really did take over from Li Chao, then I might have missed out on something vital, but the point is he's handed over the new construction to me."
"The new construction?"
"Yeah, did you forget? I told you before, Lin Yi had Zhou Gongshan build a second-layer small building in a corner of the factory area. He also had special requirements, that no decorations are to be made inside, and everything has to be done his way."
"Oh, now I remember. You did mention that to me before,"
In that moment, Han Xuemei seemed to finally grasp it all. She indeed had heard him mention this before.
However, at that time, she hadn't taken it seriously, treating it as a minor aside and quickly forgetting about it.
"Are you saying that you suspect the house has a special purpose?"
"I've been observing. Even when he came here, he didn't go to the toy production line workshop but directly to the construction site. This means the place must be very important to him."
"So, what exactly is he planning to do with this house?"
"That, I don't yet know. So now I've started to take over the project. Don't worry, I'll leave a way out for myself." Continue your adventure with My Virtual Library Empire
"You mean to tamper with that house?"
"Not just tamper, but after the tampering, no one will detect it. Whatever he does inside, whatever he says, his every move will be fully under my control."
After saying this, Wang Sheng just smiled knowingly, and at this moment, Han Xuemei truly understood what this man was thinking.
"Oh, I see. If that's the case, are we not in the position of 'the early bird catches the worm'?"

chapters.title: Chapter 403 Taking Advantage of Han Xuewei
chapters.content:
"That's right, the early bird catches the worm, and, you might never have dreamed that I'd tamper with this house."
"Perfect, if that's the case, we can start by putting pressure on him through a company in the early stages, and Later Stages, we can use this house to truly monitor their every move. At that point, everything will be at our fingertips."
"As for the company, actually, I've been thinking, since he's not in the pharmaceutical industry anymore, what can we do to really disrupt him?"
"Disrupt him? Haven't we already agreed on that? We're going to create a company, especially one involved in healthcare and pharmaceuticals."
"I've lost most of my interest in these areas now, and I feel that he might not be so interested in them either."
"Then what else do you want to do? Plus, we've already found the right candidate. Even if we don't step in, I believe everything can be taken care of."
"Ah, I can't think of anything now, my head's a mess, I don't know what to do, but it's okay, let me find some time to properly sort all this out."
"If it really doesn't work out, then we might consider his dad's company."
After saying this, Wang Sheng suddenly slammed on the brakes and eventually pulled over to the side of the road.
"What did you just say?"
"I mean, if we can't find a way to infiltrate his defenses, we might start with his dad's company. Let me tell you, that's a massive family business, and they are truly wealthy, but all that money comes from his father's company."
"You're saying, if we can't find a breakthrough with him, then we should break through via his father, right?"
"Yes, that's exactly what I mean, and it's only by doing so that we can completely enrage him, step by step, because only then can he quickly fall into our trap."
"Hmm, if you put it that way, it does seem like a really good plan, doesn't it?"
After speaking, Han Xuemei just yawned deeply.
After all, she had been busy all night and hadn't had any time to rest.
"What's wrong, tired?"
"Hmm, you know, I really am a bit sleepy."
"All right, I'll take you home, and then you should get a good sleep. I have to go oversee the foundation work at the construction site today, so I won't sleep for a while. I'll just freshen up a bit and head straight over."
"It's okay, I don't seem to be of much help to you here anyway, so I might as well go back. Oh, and if there's anything I can help with, just let me know."
"Ah, there is indeed one thing that comes to mind."
Just then, an image flashed suddenly in his mind.
After all, he was quite unclear about Lin Yi's whereabouts.
Wang Sheng had devoted all his energy to the toy factory and hadn't shared any external matters with Lin Yi.
"What is it? Just tell me."
"This is something that it seems only you can find out. I simply can't."
"Fine, as long as it's within my power, I'll do it. Just tell me what you need."
"It's just that these people are acting all secretive. I don't know what they're up to or where he's planning to go recently."
"Where's he going? What, are they planning to leave the city?"
"They're likely to leave. I heard them discussing it before, saying that they'd be away for a few days, so I want you to find out where exactly they're headed."
"How can I find that out for you? You know with my current situation with Lin Yi, anything I say, he surely won't trust easily."
"Yes, he surely won't trust you, but don't forget, there's someone else, that person is your dear little sister."
"Are you talking about Han Xuewei?"
"Yes, Han Xuewei. I think if you can get the information from her, it would be a very important matter for me. It might have a decisive impact on our next moves."
"But I'm worried that they won't trust me, and after all, I took away their youngest daughter before. I don't think he will forgive me so quickly for that."
"A man might not forgive, and probably will hold onto the grudge for a long time, but it's different between you two. After all, there's a blood relation between you. I believe that with your behavior, you should be able to move her."
"I understand your point. Let me think it over properly, how I should approach it. Give me some time, and I should be able to deliver for you."
"Good, I'll leave this matter in your hands. I might be at the construction site these next few days, probably won't be able to come back, so we'll keep in touch over the phone."
The two of them quickly reached an agreement in the car, and then he drove Han Xuemei straight home.
As for Lin Yi, he had already made all the preparations; he just felt that something seemed to be missing.
In the morning, he received a call from Han Xuemei.
"Xue Mei, what's up?"
"Oh, something came up suddenly at school today, so classes were canceled. So, I plan to head back for a bit. Should I pick up the kids today?"
"The kids? No, better not pick them up just yet. I have something I want to tell you about. By the way, where are you now?"
"Oh, I'm in the car right now, I guess in about half an hour, I should be back in the city."
"That's fine, then come straight home." Your journey continues with My Virtual Library Empire
"Home? Right now? Are you at home?"
"Yes, I'm at home. There's something I need to discuss with you. Hurry back, and we'll talk when we meet."
"All right, I understand."
After saying this, Han Xuewei hurriedly hung up the phone.
Even though she was unclear about what exactly the man was planning, she knew that his seriousness about discussing this matter indicated its importance.

chapters.title: Chapter 404 Concealing the Truth
chapters.content:
Half an hour later, the two met at home on time.
Han Xuemei looked back and noticed that beside her, there was actually a suitcase.
It appeared to be something Lin Yi was preparing to use for a trip.
"Hmm, are you going out?"
"Yes, indeed, I'm heading out."
"Where to?"
"Xi Lian Mountain."
"Xi Lian Mountain? What is that place for, what are you doing there?"
Han Xuewei was quite unfamiliar with this place.
"Oh, it's just an ordinary mountain."
"Ordinary mountain, what are you doing there? Is there some business?"
"Yes, there's a bit of business, but, if I explain too much, you won't quite understand. Let me put it this way, I might go and look for some medicinal herbs, and, estimating, it should take a few days before I can return."
"Gathering herbs? Is that something you need to do personally?"
"Hehe, I'm just idle, and the toy factory is still in the midst of operation, and it's not yet possible for you to step in and get it on the right track, so I thought I'd go along with them to have a look, and while at it, also take the opportunity to relax a bit."
Lin Yi was very clever; he didn't reveal his true intentions.
He certainly couldn't say that he was about to embark on an adventure, even more so that there was a possibility that he could lose his life there.
If that were the case, once this woman found out, she likely would not let him off the hook.
"Oh, okay then, roughly how many days will you be gone?"
"I estimate about five days or so, it's hard to say for sure, maybe longer if the scenery on the other side is exceptionally good."
"You're living the life, aren't you, now even having the leisure to travel on holiday?"
"Hehe, if your courses weren't so intensive right now, perhaps I would have taken you with me. Don't worry, this time I'm just doing preliminary reconnaissance. If all goes well, when we find the time, how about we take the kids and stay there for a few days?"
"Sure, certainly no problem. Oh, by the way, I called our dad today and told him the kids are all doing well. In a couple more days, they should be starting school. Should we bring the kids back directly?"
"Of course, we should bring them back. There's nothing much for them to do there anymore, and, to be honest, it's quite tiring for my parents to keep looking after them."
Lin Yi always cared deeply for his parents. He knew his father was always managing a company outside and could be said to be very busy.
Now, with his mother at such an age, watching one child shouldn't be an issue, but to suddenly take care of three children, that indeed posed a significant challenge for her.
"But, how come I get the feeling from our father that he is planning to retire?"
"You what? Retire? Didn't he say before that he wanted to keep working for a few more years? Why now, at this point in time, does he want to step down? Could it be because of the kids?"
"I guess he might want to enjoy the pleasures of family life, after all, he's been working for so many years."
"No, he can't retire now, and besides, his company has reached a crucial point in its development. He's invested his life's work in it, and if he steps down now, wouldn't all his previous efforts be wasted?"
"I'm not sure about that, I only heard him mention it in passing over the phone, that's why I'm telling you."
"Alright, I'll discuss this matter with him further."
Just as the two were talking, suddenly the sound of the doorbell came from outside.
"I'll go open the door."
Han Xuewei quickly stood up and walked towards the door.
Actually, under normal circumstances, it is quite rare for anyone to come and disturb them at their home.
After all, their social circle outside isn't too extensive, and usually, any affairs are directly settled outside.
When Han Xuewei walked over and opened the door, she was truly dumbfounded.
Because standing outside was none other than Han Xuemei.
Carrying bags big and small, it seemed she had brought quite a lot of stuff.
"Xue Mei, you, how come you're here?"
Honestly, Han Xuewei was quite surprised by her appearance today.
Between them, there was such a deep-seated grudge, and now, she had actually taken the initiative to visit, indicating she must have changed her mindset.
"May I come in?"
She spoke hesitantly and after a couple of sentences, lowered her head.
"Of course, you can, what's there to ask, come on in, quickly."
Han Xuewei has always been a warm-hearted person and had never truly held a grudge against her sister.
"My goodness, if you're going to come, just come, why bring so much stuff?"
While speaking, Han Xuewei helped take some of the things from Han Xuemei's hands.
Honestly, even after sharing the load, she still felt the bags were heavy.
"Oh, I didn't know what the kids liked, so whatever I saw, I basically bought one of each."
"My, you're too kind, come on, let's get inside."
"Are you alone at home? Where are the kids? Are they here?"
"Oh, the kids aren't here, but, Lin Yi is, Lin Yi, Lin Yi, Xue Mei is here."

While talking, the two casually entered the living room.
When Han Xuemei heard Lin Yi was at home, she suddenly got cold feet.
"What is this situation?"
She frowned in discomfort.
She had thought that Han Xuewei would be alone at home at this time. If Lin Yi was there, would her plan still come to fruition?
Yet, considering she had come all this way, if she left upon hearing Lin Yi was home, it would seem rather impractical.
Lin Yi came out from the room at that moment, surely not expecting this woman to come of her own accord.
"Why are you here?"
In Lin Yi's voice, there was indeed a tone of disdain.
After all, Lin Yi's impression of this woman had never been good.
Furthermore, Han Xuemei had previously taken away his most cherished younger daughter, so that matter was still fresh in his memory.

chapters.title: Chapter 405 Kneeling and Admitting Mistakes
chapters.content:
"Oh, you guys, are you busy? Oh, if you're busy, I'll just come back another day. Just keep these things for now. Xue Mei, I'll be going then."
Han Xuemei really wanted to take this opportunity to leave as soon as possible.
But just as she turned to leave, Han Xuewei grabbed her. "
"You've already come, why not sit down for a bit? Lin Yi, what kind of attitude is that?"
"Oh, it's nothing. Since you've come, go ahead and take a seat. Well then, come in as a guest."
With that, Han Xuemei had no choice but to stop declining.
She just felt somewhat uncomfortable in her body and even a bit uneasy.
After entering, Han Xuemei just sat on the sofa in the living room, her hands constantly crossing and uncrossing in front of her.
"Here, do you want a glass of water or a drink?"
"You don't need to fuss over me, I won't drink anything. I just came over, just to, you know, to check on the kids."
"Check on the kids? Which kid do you want to see? Or is it that you want to take that kid away again?"
Lin Yi spoke with definite sarcasm, and this time, his words seemed to carry a great deal of irony.
"No, no, that's not what I meant, Lin Yi. The incident last time, I admit, I was indeed a bit impulsive, and now, reflecting on it, I truly regret it very much."
"Regret? So, you've come to your senses now, have you?"
"I'm sorry, really sorry, I know I've done many wrong things before, but last time, you let me off so easily, and for that, I'm very grateful."
"I don't know what your real intention is for coming here this time, but I'm telling you, keep away from my family. If you ever do anything to harm them again, I definitely won't let you off easily this time."
"You can be assured, I won't do it again, I absolutely won't. I came here today sincerely to apologize to you, really, truly Lin Yi."
"Enough, I don't want to hear all this. If you're willing to stay, then you two sisters can have a good chat. Remember, don't get any funny ideas."
"Where are you going?"
"I've got some things to take care of outside, I already told you about them. Alright then, I'll be heading out."
"Oh, okay, I'll walk you out."
As they talked, Han Xuewei stood up and afterward, the two of them went into the courtyard.
"I'm telling you, this woman coming here, she may not have any good intentions, so you better be careful."
"Ah, didn't you see? Her attitude today seemed quite sincere, I guess she must have come to her senses."
"If she's truly come here to apologize, I can accept that, but what I'm afraid of is that she might have other ulterior motives."
"She shouldn't. After all we've been through, I believe she must have grown up and matured a bit."
"I hope so, but still, keep your eyes open, okay?"
"Fine, I got it. Don't worry. Oh, and if something comes up, you call me. When you're out and about, take care of yourself. Add more clothes if it gets cold in the mountains."
"Enough with the nagging already, I'm off. You take care at home."
While talking, the two of them waved goodbye, and finally, Lin Yi got up and left.
Returning to the room, he saw Han Xuemei still sitting uncomfortably in the same spot.

"Oh come on, Lin Yi's already left, why bother? Come on, have some water."
"Really, I feel so embarrassed, especially seeing Lin Yi. I, I didn't even know where to put my face."
"It's all in the past, I don't want to talk about it anymore. Let's just act like none of it ever happened, okay?"
"Xue Mei, do you really, do you really feel that way?"
"Of course, if I didn't think so, do you think I'd give you the chance to come into our house? If I've let you in, then that means I've not taken the whole incident to heart."
"Xue Mei, I, I really, I'm really thankful to you. I did so much in the past, and you, you forgave me time and time again."
"Have you forgotten what we are to each other? If you were just a stranger, do you think I would have forgiven you?"
"Yes, it's because of our relationship that I find it even harder to face you."
After saying this, Han Xuemei suddenly stood up and knelt down on the floor.
"What are you doing? Sister, get up please."
Clearly, Han Xuewei was not prepared for this action and didn't understand why she was kneeling.
"Don't touch me."
She suddenly pushed Han Xuewei aside.
"What are you doing? Stand up and talk."
"Just let me say it this way, I'll feel a bit better after getting it off my chest. Otherwise, the guilt will eat me up inside."
"But I can't really take in what you're saying if you're kneeling and I'm standing."
"Even if you can't take it in, you have to listen. Once I finish saying this, then I'll stand up, okay? Just give me this chance."
"Alright, alright, go on, say it. Whatever it is, just be brief."
"Actually, I've been quite jealous of you since we were kids."
"Since we were kids?"
"Yes, you've always been better than me in every aspect and your family conditions were much better than mine, so I've always been resentful inside. At home, you were the example they always put before me."
"I understand. I think my uncle mentioned this to me before."
"Yes, that's when the bitterness began to twist inside me. So, I targeted you at every turn, including as we grew up. This time too, I targeted you."
"But I really didn't do it on purpose. Sister, I... I never thought to make them compete with you like that, and had I known, I would never have allowed it."
"Xue Mei, there's no need for you to explain. I understand. It's just your nature, and yes, you are brilliantly talented. Honestly, I've come to realize this time how foolish I've been. With all the effort I put into ensuing you, I could have been doing something worthwhile. Why be antagonistic towards you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 406 Return to Hometown in Glory
chapters.content:
"Yeah, Sister, if you think that way, then I can really rest assured."
"So, starting from today, I plan to start afresh, I'll no longer rely on those men, I'm prepared to rely on my own abilities to live well."
"Good, if that's the case, then it couldn't be better. Alright, have we finished talking now?"
"Sister, can you really forgive me?"
"Yeah, I've already forgiven you. Get up already, if you keep kneeling like this, I really won't be able to forgive you."
With Han Xuewei's repeated persuasion, she finally got up from the ground.
"Alright, even though you've forgiven me, I know Lin Yi won't forgive me. Never mind, I don't expect anything, from now on, I will slowly show my changes, I will make him gradually realize that I have been changing continuously."
"Don't worry, Lin Yi is not that kind of person, and at the beginning, he was just a little angry, he didn't expect you would actually use the child as leverage, so he had some trouble accepting it, you understand?"
"Yes, I was the asshole at the beginning. Let's not talk about the past anymore, just like you said, I don't want to mention it again."
"That's right, you shouldn't mention it anymore. By the way, have you thought about what kind of job you want to find?"
"I haven't thought about it yet. Now, so many years after graduating from college, I don't even know if I can still use my major, but I will try my best to find something."
"By the way, haven't you gone home these past few days?"
"Go home? How can I show my face at home? Now, my parents treat me like an enemy. But, I will slowly change the way they see me."
"I advise you, it's better to go home once. Actually, your uncle, he is really worried about you."
"Sigh, let's talk about that later, if you ask me to go home now, I have no face to see them. Once I am stable on my own, then naturally I will pay a visit."
"Well, then, you manage that yourself."
"Sigh, by the way, I just saw him with a suitcase, is he preparing to go on a business trip? Is there anything happening with the company?"
"Company? What, you don't know the situation with the company?"
"Oh, that, I saw on the news, the company should have had its license revoked by now, so what is he doing now, he needs to develop new projects, right?"
"Who knows, he might just want to get away for a break, since that's the case, I don't want to stop him anymore."
Seeing her say this, Han Xuemei didn't continue to ask further.
Because she knew asking too much now might arouse her suspicion.
So, Han Xuemei changed the topic and chatted about other things here.
Most of the content was just trivial idle talk, and her real intentions were not at all under her control.
Just as everything was going smoothly, the return of a woman seemed to completely shatter everything here.
This person was Li Jingwen.
Li Jingwen had been away from here for several years, and one could say that when she stepped into her hometown once again, she truly felt everything had changed.
Li Jingwen at this moment, dressed in a beautiful dress, was also pushing a red suitcase beside her.

Just the suitcase alone appeared to be of immense value.
Just then, a man in black hurried up to her.
"Miss Li, you must be tired."
As he spoke, he reached out and took the suitcase from her.
"I really didn't expect that after a few years apart, so much has changed here now."
"That's right, Miss Li, the airport began construction officially just the second year after you left, we're now only in one of the terminals. There, the international arrival and departure terminals, they are all over there, and moreover, the scale is even bigger than here."
"Incredible, it seems like returning to my hometown was indeed the right choice, coming back here should allow my career to soar even further."
"Absolutely, Miss Li, I've already taken care of all the office setups, including all the paperwork issues, now, it's just waiting for you to have a proper look at the company."
"There's no rush for that. By the way, how is the situation I asked you to look into?"
After getting into the car, Li Jingwen sat in the back and took out her laptop, working on something on it, then spoke to the person in front.
"Miss Li, just as you instructed, I inquired carefully, and here are some detailed documents."
After saying this, he handed a document to Li Jingwen.
The document appeared to be quite long, with perhaps at least a dozen or twenty pages.
Moreover, it was filled with dense text, and even some photos were pasted on it.
Li Jingwen read through all the material carefully, and then her brows began to furrow gradually.
"This is the real situation?"
"Yes, this is the situation, and as for his current predicament, this is how it is."
"And his family? Did you find out his home address?"
"Yes, it's already been found, it's in the last section, that's his current home address."
"What about the previous company?"
"That company has already terminated contracts with them, it should be gone, and it seems that the toy factory is in the midst of transforming, it's just not yet officially on the right track."
"So you mean, he's now backed into a corner, can I understand it that way?"
"Actually, in a way, you could say that. Although the previous issue ultimately didn't have a big connection with them, I feel it still affected his reputation somewhat. To establish a foothold and reputation in this city in the future, I think it will be extremely difficult."
"I didn't expect he would fall to where he is today. Good, this is actually quite interesting. Sigh, by the way, the woman you mentioned, that's his wife, right?"
At that moment, Li Jingwen was holding a photo in her hands, indeed, the person in the photo was Han Xuewei.
As Lin Yi's ex-girlfriend, she was actually always very interested in his personal life.

chapters.title: Chapter 407 Change of Plan
chapters.content:
She even felt some regret, why had she suddenly decided to leave this man all those years ago?
Had she not left him, perhaps, she wouldn't have achieved what she did today.
But it was only after leaving him that Li Jingwen realized how important this man had been in her heart.
Career and love, perhaps, couldn't be truly had at the same time.
But her triumphant return today might completely change that situation. Continue your journey with My Virtual Library Empire
Li Jingwen took out her phone and directly dialed Lin Yi's number.
Lin Yi was outside handling other matters when suddenly, his phone started ringing.
He frowned slightly. He had made up his mind that he would depart this afternoon but this call, perhaps, could change his travel plans.
He looked at the number; it was unfamiliar, and he was absolutely certain he had never seen it before.
Forget it, at this moment, answering an unfamiliar call could plunge him into panic. Better out of sight, out of mind. Ignoring the call might be the best state of affairs.
In the end, he hung up directly.
But unexpectedly, the phone rang over and over again, insistently.
Clearly, the caller was determined to reach him and probably wouldn't rest until they did.
"Hello, who is this?"
Lin Yi's tone didn't sound too friendly.
"Hehe, what, after so many years, have you even forgotten my voice?"
After that sentence, Lin Yi was stunned.
Indeed, he heard clearly; the person was Li Jingwen.
Years had passed, yet her voice was etched in his mind.
As it floated to him again, Lin Yi felt as if that voice had been reactivated.
"Li Jingwen, where are you? I thought you were abroad all this time?"
"I am abroad, what about it? Are you free? I'd like to meet with you this afternoon."
"This afternoon?"
"Yes, this afternoon. Moreover, I want you to know what exactly happened back then. If you want to unravel this mystery, meet me today in Room 1801 at the Xiangjiang Hotel. I'll be waiting for you there."
"Hello, Li Jingwen."
As he spoke, he picked up the phone and shouted insistently.
But, it seemed she didn't intend to give him any chance to talk further; the line was abruptly cut off.
When he redialed, he was met with a busy signal.
He was sure about the voice, and he could almost certainly confirm that the person on the other end of the call was Li Jingwen.
But why had she chosen this moment to appear?
Did this mean his plans for the day were indeed about to change?
The events of several years ago remained a significant unresolved issue for him.
He needed to understand what exactly had happened.
If he couldn't resolve this issue, he might spend his life plagued by this melancholy.
It seemed all his plans were to be set aside for this.
"Hey, Hei Lang, it's me."
"Oh, what's up?"
"Listen, you go ahead with Ling'er. You two head to Qingfeng Town first. Find a few rooms there to settle down temporarily. If nothing unexpected happens, I should be able to catch up with you tomorrow morning."
"Bro, are you saying you're not coming with me today?"
"That's right, I've got something urgent to deal with and probably can't leave. Also, my suitcase is with Ling'er; take it with you. We'll discuss the rest when we meet."
"Alright, I got it, bro. Do you need me to arrange for some guys to stay with you?"
"No need, I've got some private matters to settle. I should be able to catch up tomorrow."
"Ok, then let's leave it at that. We'll talk more after we get there tomorrow."
Hei Lang had already made all preparations; even he and Ling'er had been waiting here.
But unexpectedly, a single phone call could change everything.
"What's happened, isn't he coming?"
"He won't be traveling with us today, he said he would join us tomorrow morning in Qingfeng Town. In that case, we'll go ahead and get settled. We can also inquire about the basic situation of the town, so we don't need to go in circles later."
"Hmm, alright then, let's do that."
The two of them didn't think much of it and considered it quite ordinary.
After all, Lin Yi often had many dealings outside, and getting entangled in some matters was understandable.
After arranging everything, Lin Yi rushed to the Xiangjiang Hotel in a bit of a panic.
But upon arrival, the receptionist informed him that Room 1801 had been booked but no one had checked in yet.
Could it be that she wasn't at the hotel when she called him?
Since she said she had booked a room, she should be able to get there quickly.
With that thought, he settled in a corner of the lobby with a cup of coffee, contentedly awaiting her arrival.
He lost track of time as he flipped through a magazine repeatedly.
Then he heard a scraping sound of metal on the floor.
Lin Yi looked up and saw an old man with white hair, using a walking stick, slowly approaching his area.
From his attire and demeanor, dressed in a suit and carrying himself with a certain presence, Lin Yi guessed he was probably some kind of businessman.
Surprisingly, the man chose the seat opposite him, and soon a server came over to take his order. After a quick point at the menu, the server left.
The man was directly across from him and Lin Yi felt a warm sensation on his forehead, an indication that his "Heavenly Eye" might be opening again.
True enough, a minute later, Lin Yi could clearly see that there was actually a steel pin running through the old man's knee.

chapters.title: Chapter 408 Boring Speculation
chapters.content:
Behind the iron nail, there was a red object that seemed to be constantly emerging.
What on earth was this thing?
At this moment, Lin Yi felt something was strange.
Moreover, looking at the state of his bones now, they should be fairly well developed and quite normal.
Judging by the situation, it seemed likely that the injury wasn't too old; if it had been long-lasting, then the bones definitely wouldn't look like this.
At this point, the surrounding blood had begun to show blockage upon reaching here.
And when blood couldn't flow through, it was bound to start swelling the nearby muscle tissue, bringing toxins that couldn't be completely flushed out.
He noticed signs of healing in the man's muscle tissue, indicating that someone had tampered with the area.
Based on current observations, it seemed probable that a surgery had been performed.
A spark of inspiration hit his mind.
Anyway, staying here was a waste of time without any significance, and it seemed that the tasks promised by his system were still unfulfilled.
The system required him to treat a total of five patients with bone conditions, and so far, he had found two.
If he could resolve this man's issue, that would make three.
Lin Yi was well aware that some things in life could not be forced.
If he were to forcefully search for these people, they might not cooperate; instead, finding them naturally through everyday life could provide a fortuitous opportunity.
So, he approached the man with a smile.
As soon as Lin Yi arrived, the man simply looked up at him.
The man seemed wary of the sudden appearance of this stranger.
"What do you want?"
The moment the man opened his mouth, Lin Yi could tell immediately that this was not a local.
The words the man uttered were very stiff, indicating he likely hadn't lived domestically for many years.
"Excuse me, may I sit here?"
"It's inconvenient."
The old man's tone seemed very firm.
This made Lin Yi feel as though he had just been turned away at the door, wondering what to do next.
He just smiled awkwardly. Should he just let it go?
That wasn't like him at all. If he were to give up, he wouldn't be Lin Yi.
"You don't need to be so guarded against me; I'm not here for anything. I'm also waiting, and if I'm not mistaken, you're here waiting for someone too, right? And whoever it is, they're not likely to arrive any time soon."
After he finished speaking, the old man slowly put down the book he was holding.
"What do you mean?"
"Since you arrived here, about 10 minutes have passed. During this time, you've been holding a cup of coffee and your book hasn't left your hand, obviously killing time."
"Heh, I didn't expect you to be so observant, but does that mean I should trust you?"
"I'm not asking for your trust. I just happened to pass by and noticed some issues with you, so I wanted to discuss them."
"Issues? What issues do I have?"
"Unless I'm mistaken, your right knee had surgery about a month ago, didn't it?"
"Heh, even a fool could see that. I'm using crutches, so clearly there's some problem with my leg. However, about the surgery—oh, I get it, you figured I must have had surgery because of my limp?"
"No, your surgery was right here, and the incision was made in this spot if I'm not wrong."
He gestured on the inner side of his own leg.
Upon seeing this, the old man suddenly widened his eyes in surprise.
Because everything Lin Yi said was an accurate fact, and the man had never imagined that this stranger, without revealing anything, could understand the details of his injuries so thoroughly.
So who was this person, and how could he know all of this?
"Who are you, really? Have you been following me before?"
"I haven't had the time to follow you; today is my first visit here. And I'm also waiting for a friend who won't arrive until six in the evening, so I took the opportunity to observe your condition out of boredom."
"Alright, then tell me, besides these, what else have you noticed?"
"Just below your knee, at this tendon and bone area, there must have been a steel nail driven in—no, not one but two—and next to it, a steel plate extends out. I believe I'm correct."
"How do you know this?"
"Also, I can infer that there's some edema around you, and surely you must feel a kind of pain or at least discomfort near the lower side of your knee, am I right?"
Lin Yi had rather accurately recounted the man's current condition in just a few sentences.
Every word matched exactly what was happening to him.
"Come, sit, let's talk while sitting."
The old man was genuinely intrigued by him.
A total stranger had an uncanny understanding of his physical condition as if he had scrutinized it closely.
The most crucial point was that his surgery hadn't been performed domestically, so even an investigation within the country wouldn't yield any information.
Seeing that the man finally believed him and allowed him to sit, Lin Yi knew they could continue their conversation.
"So, do you believe me now?"
"I'm just very curious; these details aren't documented anywhere in the country, and even if you had investigated, you couldn't have found out. Besides, I'm wearing pants, so you can't possibly see the condition inside, right?"
"You don't need to doubt that. I just want to ask if everything I just said was correct?"

chapters.title: Chapter 409 Accurate Judgment
chapters.content:
Lin Yi asked this question with some trepidation.
When he was talking about these matters, it was as though everything was pre-printed material, repeatedly leaping out in his mind.
In other words, it was a simple task for him to recite these details in sequence, and by doing so, he could fulfill his role.
"You're absolutely right, my surgery was performed just like that, involving a steel plate and two steel screws, and, incidentally, the operation was performed right here."
"It appears my speculation should be correct, but now, do you know why, after all this time, your leg is still in a state of swelling and also experiencing some mild pain? This is actually not a complication left by the surgery."
"What, not a complication from the surgery? Then what is going on?"
"It's because during the surgery, they completely missed a very slight soft tissue injury on the inner side of the bone. They didn't notice it, and therefore overlooked that spot, resulting in your leg's continued inability to fully function."
"So, is there any way to solve this problem?"
"Of course, there are solutions, it's just that it seems a bit inconvenient here. If you trust me, I can treat you."
"Alright, no problem, give me a quote."
"Quote?"
"Yes, you're going to treat me, right? Don't you need some form of compensation? Okay, no problem. Just make my leg fully recover, and how much money do you want? I can agree to anything."
"Haha, now it's not about the money. I'm telling you, I've never thought about asking for money from you. I'm only pointing this out because I noticed the surgery wasn't perfect."
"Fine, if it's convenient for you now, can you follow me to a room?"
The elderly gentleman looked at his wristwatch; it was now 3:00 PM.
He had almost three hours until the person he had an appointment with would arrive.
That is to say, within these three hours, he should be fully capable of dealing with this young man.
At the very least, he should be able to get some answers from him.
"Alright then, I shall respectfully comply. You lead the way."
As he spoke, Lin Yi gestured with his hand, then pointed ahead.
With his assistance, the elderly man limped along and followed him straight into the elevator.
At the moment, they were on the topmost floor, the 28th.
Room 2801 was a High Level and most modern presidential suite.
This was also a way the wealthy asserted their status when they came here.
After entering the room, the opulence inside was something Lin Yi had truly never experienced before.
The facilities inside the room were very complete, and all the living necessities one could think of were available.
After the elderly gentleman brought him in, he merely moved the briefcase to the side.
"Come, please sit down."
He indicated a seat, and Lin Yi sat down on the sofa.
He naturally seated himself across from Lin Yi.
"You tell me, how do you need to be treated? Do you need any surgical equipment, or something else? If necessary, I can make arrangements to have it delivered here."
It seemed that he wasn't just making empty threats,
and judging by his demeanor and presence, he probably had the capability to mobilize such resources in this venue.
"Actually, I don't need much, and it's not anything outrageous, I carry it with me all the time, but I'd like to conduct a thorough examination, if that's alright with you?"
"Sure, no problem."
"Before we proceed with any treatment, could you tell me how your leg originally got injured?"
"I was in a car accident before, and both of my legs were trapped between two seats, leading to comminuted fractures."
"I understand."
After hearing this, Lin Yi nodded, now having a general understanding of his condition.
Then he extended his leg, and promptly rolled down his trousers from his leg.
A very obvious scar was visible on his leg.
He just looked down, carefully examining the scar on the sofa.
Lin Yi took a quick glance, noting that there were 17 stitches in total.
The surgery at that time must have been significant.
It seemed to have been a major procedure.
Afterward, he simply placed his hand over the scar, gently stroking it.
Soon, a clear image formed once again in his mind.
