This time, due to the direct touch, he could clearly see a small white object near the location of the steel screw, which was the cause of the red light he had observed previously.
It appeared to be a bone fragment that had been retained and had gone undetected at the time.
However, the fragment was enveloped by surrounding muscle tissue and blood. Without a meticulous examination, it would be very difficult to detect.
"Pressing down on your bone now shouldn't cause too much pain, should it?"
"No, there's still a bit of mild pain, but it's mostly bearable. It's just that I still can't exert any force with my leg."
"The reason you can't exert force isn't due to the bone naturally being hard, but rather inflammation in the muscles of your body, in addition to the swelling caused by it."
"So, is there any other way to help me?"
"The problem shouldn't be too big. I'll take another look, but during the treatment, you might feel a slight sensation, so I hope you can endure it."
"Don't worry, no problem."
As he spoke, he extended his hand and began searching for a real entry point into the area.
However, the image that had formed in his mind halted all his further actions.
Because he was distinctly aware of the appearance of a sharp scalpel in his mind.
This indicated that if he wanted to proceed with a solution, the scalpel would be necessary.

chapters.title: Chapter 410 A Reliable Assistant
chapters.content:
If surgery is involved, then inevitably, some specialized equipment will be necessary. Or perhaps, these are beyond the capabilities of ordinary people.
Initially, I believed that with my abilities I should be able to resolve it, but now it seems unlikely that this issue can be resolved without surgery.
Should I really perform this surgery on him?
If so, do I truly possess the ability?
Moreover, is this patient genuinely that important to me?
"What's wrong? Is there a problem?"
Seeing Lin Yi silent here, as if the old man were growing anxious,
after all, now there is someone who can actively describe his own symptoms, and it seems he has quite a good understanding of his condition.
Finally, Lin Yi made up his mind.
Opportunities are fleeting, and encountering such a patient with a bone injury is not so easy.
"I just need a few things, and I have to make an incision in your area, but don't worry, it'll be a very small wound that doesn't require stitching."
"Okay, if you can do it, then there's no problem."
"But I can't complete this alone. So, give me some time; I'm going to make a call and have someone bring over some equipment, and then there'll be someone to assist me."
"Sure, definitely no problem. Tell me where the person is, and I'll arrange for a driver to pick them up right away."
"That won't be necessary; her workplace isn't far from here. Wait here for a bit."
He couldn't think of anyone else; the only person he could think of was Liu Yao, who had just agreed to assist him. "Hello, where are you?"
In fact, this question was redundant; under these circumstances, Liu Yao should certainly be in the hospital.
"Oh, I'm at the hospital. What's up?"
"Are you available right now? If so, come to the Xiangjiang Grand Hotel, I'm in room 2801."
"What, what did you say? Xiangjiang Grand Hotel? In broad daylight, why, why are you asking me to come to a hotel?"
Liu Yao was indeed surprised.
She didn't understand what Lin Yi was up to at the moment, and it seemed rather inappropriate to suddenly invite a girl to a hotel.
"Stop asking so many questions. If you trust me, then hurry up and come over; if you can't make it, I'll find someone else."
"Alright, I, I understand; I'll be there soon."
"Also, on your way here, try to bring a set of surgical instruments, brand new ones, and make sure they are absolutely reliable. Understand?"
"Okay, I got it."
Why would Liu Yao pass up such a great opportunity?
Having been filled with curiosity about Lin Yi, now she finally had a chance to get close to him and naturally, she intended to firmly grasp this opportunity.
About fifteen minutes passed before Lin Yi heard knocking from outside, and he swiftly walked over and opened the door.
He saw Liu Yao holding a black plastic bag, which obviously contained the surgical tools he needed.
Lin Yi just glanced inside; apart from the instruments, there were also items like alcohol and surgical thread—it seemed she had thought of everything very thoroughly.
"What's the matter? Why did you ask me to come here? And are you planning to perform surgery on yourself?"
Having been asked to bring surgical instruments, Liu Yao felt there must be a reason.
Could it be that this guy was actually going to perform surgery?
"Here's the situation: there's a patient with a bone injury, and now I need to help him. So, I need a professional nurse to manage the process to avoid the risk of infection in the wound."
While explaining the situation, they went inside the room.
Liu Yao looked at the old man with white hair, guessing he must be around 70 years old.
However, looking at his overall physique, he seemed relatively robust, except for his leg.
"Alright, tell me what you want to do, and I'll assist you."
"Have you been in an operating room before?"
"Of course, every time surgery was done on a patient with a bone injury, I always assisted the doctors, so I'm quite familiar with all these procedures. You're not planning to perform surgery, are you?"
At that moment, it seemed as though she suddenly realized something.
"Yes, surgery is indeed the plan."
"But under these circumstances, how, how are you going to perform surgery, especially with such rudimentary conditions?"
"No worries, I have my ways. But after the surgery, about the stitching and some other issues, you'd have no problems, right?"
"If the instruments are all adequately provided, I definitely won't have any issues, but given your current conditions..."
"What, is it going to be difficult?"
"Difficult, there'd be some to an extent."
"I'm just asking if you can do it or not?"
"If you can manage on your part, then naturally I'll have no issues on mine."
Liu Yao was that kind of person.
The more challenging it was, the more she wanted to take it on.
However, the key issue was that it now involved a person's physical safety, and she really dare not readily agree to him.
"No problem, rest assured, if I wasn't confident, I definitely wouldn't do this," she said and followed him, stepping forward.
"Come, lie down on that bed."
"Are you planning to make an incision here?"
"If you're willing to let me treat you, then I will make the incision. It's a very minor surgery, don't worry. It won't take long and might even avoid the need for stitches."
At this point, the old man was indeed hesitant.
He had never thought of having a stranger perform surgery on him.
But he had conveyed his condition so precisely, and generally, nobody could do that.
Just this alone made him admire Lin Yi greatly, so he might truly choose to trust him at this moment.
"Hmm, alright, I'll leave my leg in your hands. I want to see what kind of results you can achieve."

chapters.title: Chapter 411 Brain Controls Both Hands
chapters.content:
Actually, during the conversation between the two of them, he had secretly made some preparations.
That is to say, should anything unexpected happen to him, it was likely that neither of them would be able to leave this room alive.
The room seemed very quiet, with no one around, but in fact, some people were already covertly lurking within these floors.
After he lay down, Liu Yao simply took out a white sheet and covered it over his thigh.
Of course, she cut open the area that needed surgery with scissors directly.
Witnessing her series of actions, he felt somewhat satisfied afterwards.
After all, he had always needed a professional of this sort.
And Liu Yao was precisely capable of fulfilling all of that.
Then, Liu Yao skillfully took out some disinfecting tools, including iodine and alcohol, and meticulously wiped them over his skin one time after another. Continue your journey with My Virtual Library Empire
Finally, Liu Yao had completed the pre-surgery preparations for this area.
At this moment, Liu Yao also let out a long sigh of relief.
She did not know why, but even though she had performed this task hundreds, if not thousands of times before, why did she feel so nervous this time?
Perhaps, it was because the person she was servicing this time was indeed very different from the others.
"Alright, I have finished the preparatory work on my end, now it's up to you to be ready," she said.
As she spoke, she took out a delicate tray and arranged the surgical tools that would be needed on it, one by one.
Lin Yi stepped forward and then looked down.
Unexpectedly, there were four scalpels just on the tray,
and moreover, each scalpel was completely different in shape.
At this moment, Lin Yi placed his hand above them, genuinely not knowing which one he should pick.
His embarrassed state at this moment was something that Liu Yao had already seen.
If it were any other doctor, they would easily pick out what they needed, but as for him, an outsider, this was indeed not something he could do.
Liu Yao even began to doubt whether the surgery could be carried out smoothly.
If it could not continue, what would the result be in the end?
This was something he had always been very concerned about in his heart.
Having no choice, he could only pick out one scalpel and hold it in his hand.
Lin Yi raised his head and saw that Liu Yao simply nodded at him, and finally, he took the scalpel and turned towards the elderly gentleman.
"Alright, when I make the cut later, it might..."
"Hold on, aren't you going to administer anesthesia?"
Just then, Liu Yao suddenly came over and whispered into Lin Yi's ear.
This was a critical step, and indeed, if one were to make a crude incision on human skin with a scalpel, it was likely that most people could not bear it.
Now, without any anesthesia, he was about to perform surgery on him, this was something that Liu Yao couldn't even imagine.
"Anesthesia, do you have anesthesia?"
"How would I have anesthesia? Anesthesia needs to be requested in advance, and personally, I can't provide it."
"Maybe then, we won't use it."
"What did you say?"
Liu Yao, after hearing this, was astonished and her eyes widened.
The two of them had been whispering to each other in low voices the entire time, so the person lying in the bed didn't notice what they were doing at the moment.
"Alright, don't worry about it. You just handle the follow-up work later. Leave the earlier matters to me," he said.
Seeing Lin Yi so confident, truth be told, Liu Yao was somewhat worried.
Because she simply had no idea what this man was planning in his heart.
Since he had already said this, all Liu Yao could do was to continue according to his wishes.
Anyway, she had already prepared everything that was needed for him; now, it was his turn to take over.
Lin Yi took out that knife, but just at this moment, he suddenly felt as if a very clear surgical procedure map had formed inside his body.
Every blood vessel was distinctly outlined along the inner wall of the thigh.
Lin Yi glanced down.
He knew exactly where the scalpel should go to minimize bleeding.
Unexpectedly, the system really did help him, so after Lin Yi saw all this, his heart gradually relaxed.
Saying he wasn't nervous was an impossibility just a moment ago.
Perhaps, he was more nervous than anyone else.
He took a deep breath and then looked at his hand; at this moment, there was no trembling at all.
Now, Lin Yi slowly began to form an idea in his mind; he knew that if this was the case, then the upcoming operation didn't need much of his own handling.
Because, at this moment, his hands skillfully obeyed the brain's commands, starting to proceed proficiently here.
He took a knife from the side and gently slid it down from there.
And finally, Lin Yi inserted a very fine catheter slowly into it.
He just turned his head to look at the old man's facial expression and found that it was not as painful as he had imagined.
This meant that his technique must be quite skilled; at the very least, it didn't cause too much disturbance for him.
Liu Yao, standing by the side, was watching him expertly control everything.
The speed of his proficiency, even, began to astonish Liu Yao.
That wasn't right, he was clearly just a man who previously ran a pharmaceutical company. How could he understand such operations?
Moreover, seeing his current technique, it should have taken 8 to 10 years of practice to achieve.
In this man, she really saw too many miracles that should not happen in everyday life.
Thinking this, Lin Yi's heart gradually began to steady.
Since he could complete all this proficiently, then he believed that the subsequent work would progress just as smoothly.
From this moment on, Liu Yao felt she must have chosen the right person to follow.
He harbored too many secrets, and these secrets would ultimately lead them on the correct path.
The wound was quickly opened, and soon he found that white object inside.
He took out a very small tweezer and gently pulled out the object.

chapters.title: Chapter 412 Completed Surgery
chapters.content:
```
When he brought the object up to his face, Liu Yao simply nodded.
For many years, he had been plagued by this very small object.
"Okay, this thing has now been removed, but as you can see, swelling has already started to appear around it."
"Exactly. It's a foreign body, its presence here means the body's constitution will naturally resist it, leading to swelling."
"All we need to do is eliminate this swelling, and the knee should gradually return to normal."
"Right, in theory, that's how it should work."
As they talked, he once again removed the catheter and replaced it with another traction cord, slowly feeding it into the leg.
At this moment, Lin Yi's hands moved with ease inside, and no one knew what kind of treatment he was administering.
What surprised Liu Yao even more was that normally, if surgery were performed in a hospital, it would certainly require constant imaging guidance.
Yet, here he was, without any imaging equipment; in fact, she noticed his gaze was fixed outside the window.
Just relying on his two hands, he began to skillfully manage everything here, something that, in the world, probably no one else could achieve.
So witnessing all of this, Liu Yao simply felt that this man must be a genius.
And as for how all of this was accomplished, to tell the truth, Liu Yao still hadn't quite figured it out.
Finally, the entire swollen tissue had been completely reduced, and then he let out a long sigh of relief.
This surgery had taken roughly around 20 minutes.
Lin Yi hadn't expected to resolve the problem, that had persisted for so many years, so quickly.
Next came the wound suturing and some disinfection and bandaging in the Later Stages, something he believed Liu Yao should be able to handle smoothly.
"So, can I teach you now?"
"There, you can get up now. Let me take care of the rest."
As she spoke, Liu Yao stepped forward and skillfully took out the needle and thread to begin suturing.
Suturing a wound is a basic skill for a surgical nurse.
Every nurse must learn this skill when entering the path of medicine.
After Liu Yao skillfully completed all this, she bandaged the area meticulously with intent.
The surgery could be considered a success.
"Alright, now that the surgery is essentially finished, you might still feel some minor pain, but that's no problem. By tomorrow, the pain should have completely disappeared."
You mean my leg is already healed?
There should be no issues now, at least not like before when you couldn't walk. And you can now carefully exert pressure. In fact, you can feel a significant difference."
With those words, he looked at the old man. The old man seemed somewhat skeptical, staring at him with uncertain eyes.
With such advanced technology abroad, they hadn't discovered any of this, so why could he identify it all with just his naked eyes?
To him, it seemed far too miraculous.
With the assistance of Lin Yi, the old man slowly got up from the bed and stood on the floor.
He tried moving his right leg, twisting it a bit. Although the wound was sore, the pain was completely different from what he had felt in his bone before.
He turned around in amazement, staring wide-eyed at Lin Yi.
"This is really... really okay now?"
"What? Now that you've actually felt it yourself, do you still doubt it all?"
"It's amazing, truly amazing."
"I'm telling you, this is the profound depth of traditional Chinese medicine. And there are many things that if you can't accomplish them one way, you can gradually make progress through Chinese medicine. So don't worry about it."
"Alright, alright, that's great, it's really great. This time, I must thank you properly. Just name your conditions."
"I've already said I don't have any conditions, and I don't need them. These things are just material possessions to me. Now, I have some business to attend to, so I can't stay any longer." Your next on My Virtual Library Empire
"But, what about my leg?"
"Don't worry. In three days, remove the bandage from the wound. Don't worry about the stitches inside; over time, they will gradually integrate as they are made of absorbable cotton thread."
"Okay, I understand. Young man, can you tell me your name?"
"My name isn't that important. You should just know that I can be there to assist you when you need it. Other than that, I ask for nothing. Liu Yao, let's go."
After finishing speaking, Lin Yi nodded to Liu Yao, who quickly and efficiently packed everything up, and then they left the place swiftly.
After they had gone, the old gentleman sat in the room for a long time, still unable to fully grasp what had happened.
No, his memory was clear: when that woman stood beside him, he had distinctly seen the back of her clothes, which seemed to reveal a white garment underneath, and it indeed bore the words "People's Hospital."
Probably, she had rushed out of the hospital so hastily that she hadn't had time to take off her work clothes.
If this Liu Yao worked at the People's Hospital, could it be that she was a doctor there?
No, if that was the case, he had to know who she really was, only then could he determine the extent of the help she could offer him.
With this thought, he checked the time. There was still some time before their departure, so perhaps he should wait patiently here a little longer, as the other person should be on their way already.
Driven by curiosity, he dialed the phone.
"Hello, where are you?"
"Boss Bai, I'm on the road, probably about a half-hour away from the hotel," came the response.
"Alright, then I won't wait for you downstairs. When you arrive at the hotel, come directly to my room. I'll brief you on the situation."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 413 Well-intentioned Lies
chapters.content:
"Okay, I got it, I'll come up to report to you in a moment."
After he finished speaking, he hung up the phone.
The one who answered the call was none other than Li Jingwen.
At this moment, she was hastily making her way to the hotel.
She kept checking the time and, as she had already made an appointment with the old man, she absolutely couldn't afford any deviation in timing.
Because Grandpa Bai always had a strong sense of punctuality, this was something Li Jingwen was very clear about.
Lin Yi followed Liu Yao out of the hotel, and then they returned once again to the hotel lobby.
He looked up at Liu Yao. After all, she was still working, and she had already sacrificed a lot by taking off work to assist him.
"Alright, you go back first. There shouldn't be anything else here, oh, right, can this set of instruments stay here for the time being?"
"Oh, that's no problem. We'll just need to report it to the storeroom, there should be no issue."
"Okay, then I'll trouble you with that. Alright, you hurry back and handle the hospital's handover work. I'm afraid that in a few days when I return, you won't have time to continue working there. You need to prepare for that in advance."
"Don't worry, I've already submitted my resignation. There definitely won't be any changes. It's just that I'm feeling a bit curious right now."
"Curious? What about?"
"You never worked in the medical industry before, so why are you now able to keep everything under your control?"
"Are you referring to the surgery I just performed?"
"Exactly. The expertise with which you performed the surgery isn't something an ordinary person could achieve. So, I am certain that you must have received some sort of professional training before."
"What professional training? To be honest, I've just slowly become proficient. These are skills I mastered many years ago, which I'm beginning to feel a bit rusty at now."
Lin Yi naturally wouldn't reveal his true situation and he believed that even if he did, these people would definitely not clarify everything.
"So, you mean to say that you've worked in the medical field before?"
"Yeah, it's probably been almost seven or eight years since I last touched these things. I used to be a doctor."
"What did you say? You're a doctor? Then, if that's the case, do you also have a medical practitioner's license?"
"Yes, I do have a medical practitioner's license, but I don't know if it's still valid."
"Normally, it's revalidated every three years, but the controls have been very strict these last two years, going through an annual revalidation. If you haven't been in touch for so many years, your medical license has probably expired by now."
"Right, it should have expired by now. So, strictly speaking, if I were practicing now, it would be without a license. Let's not talk about this anymore. If I have time later, I'll go and get a new one. Any other questions?"
"Oh, no, that's it."
"Okay, if there's nothing else, you should rush back."
"Alright, I know. I'll go first then."
Liu Yao seemed to have some other questions she wanted to ask, but for some reason, at that moment she felt utterly convinced and unable to voice her true thoughts.
The recent Lin Yi had told a kindly lie.
He had never thought about how he would explain these things to her.
Now, he could only follow closely and make her feel that she hadn't followed the wrong person.
"How is it, can you make it to the hotel in half an hour?"
Li Jingwen sat in the car, watching the traffic flow outside, which was moving slower and slower, and she began to feel anxious.
"It should be close, President Li. Half an hour, no, it should take less than that, we should arrive soon. We are just hitting the rush hour traffic, if it weren't for this time, we would have probably already arrived."
Li Jingwen kept urging on the way.
Finally, after about twenty minutes, Li Jiawen's car smoothly reached the hotel entrance.
Having entered the lobby, Li Jingwen looked to her left and right.
She did not expect to see Lin Yi seated there at first glance.
But apart from Lin Yi, she really didn't see anyone else.
It seemed that the old master must have returned to his room as he had said, and since he wasn't there, she could spend a little more time with Lin Yi.
Although time was very tight now, fortunately on the way there, she had managed to save 10 minutes.
She quickly walked towards Lin Yi.
The man behind her, carrying her suitcase, naturally stood to one side and began waiting patiently.
Upon hearing the footsteps, Lin Yi felt a vaguely familiar sensation, so he quickly stood and turned to look back.
It had been almost a full five years since he had last seen Li Jingwen.
Now she seemed even more mature, and from her attire, it was clear that she had done quite well for herself overseas in the past few years without any significant troubles.
"Heh, it's been a long time. You seem to be doing quite well for yourself now."
Lin Yi walked forward and stretched out his hand generously.
After all, they had a history together, and now that they were reuniting, there was no need to act like enemies.
"And you, aren't you the same? Only, you seem to have gone through a lot."
"Gone through a lot? I guess I'm just getting older."
"So, what are you doing now?"
Experience tales at My Virtual Library Empire
"What else can I do? I'm still in the old trade, working in pharmaceutical marketing. However, the company has encountered some issues lately, so I've stepped back temporarily."
"What? The company's having problems? Are they operating poorly? If you need funding, I can invest in you."
"Oh, that won't be necessary. I have ample funding on my side. Did you just get off the plane?"
"I just came over from the airport. You see, I haven't even had the chance to put my stuff in my room because I've been traveling in such a hurry."

chapters.title: Chapter 414 Temporary Alliance
chapters.content:
"Okay then, if that's the case, you go ahead up. I'll wait here for you. Once you're settled, we can have dinner together tonight."
"Tonight?"
After hearing that, Li Jingwen hesitated for a moment.
She didn't know if the old patriarch had any arrangements, but usually, the old patriarch only needed to explain the specific circumstances to her; he wouldn't get too involved with anything else.
"What's wrong? Do you have plans for tonight? Or is there someone here to welcome you back?"
"No, that's not the case. I've been away from this city for so many years, and those relationships are long gone. So, no one will remember me."
"Well then, if there's no one, it's perfect. I'll treat you well tonight. Also, I'm afraid I'll have to leave the city tomorrow. It'll be for a few days, and I probably won't have the chance to see you then."
"Alright, it has to be tonight then. Okay, wait here for me. We'll catch up properly over dinner later."
After saying that, she turned to look at Lin Yi and then quickly left the place.
The man behind her was closely following her.
Lin Yi felt that he must be doing pretty well.
When she arrived outside the room of the elder, she took a deep breath and then gave an instruction to her assistant.
The assistant quickly left the place because nobody would be with her when meeting this key figure.
She took her suitcase herself and walked to the door, then rang the doorbell.
After a little while, she heard the sound of the door opening, and right after, the door swung open. She saw the elder turn and go straight back into the room.
Li Jingwen, pushing her suitcase, entered the room and closed the door behind her.
"Elder Bai."
After entering the living room, she tossed her things to one side and then stood respectfully in front of Elder Bai.
"Good, not bad. It looks like your sense of timing hasn't changed. You arrived right at the last minute when you came in."
"Hehe, Elder Bai, after cooperating for so many years, I naturally understand how things work. I've brought you the items you wanted and the contract. I'll give them to you now."
While speaking, Li Jingwen stopped her suitcase and prepared to take some things out, but at this moment Elder Bai suddenly pulled her over.
She found herself leaning against Elder Bai's chest.
"Elder Bai, your leg, are you still hurt there?"
"How is it, have you missed me?"
"Elder Bai, look, I've just gotten off the plane and haven't had the chance to tidy up yet. I think I'm all sweaty."
Elder Bai just held her gently and then reached out to caress her face lightly.
"Still so charming. I've truly missed you these past few months."
"Stop joking, Elder Bai. By the way, how's your leg injury?"
Li Jingwen seemed somewhat uneasy and didn't want to get tangled up with such an old man.
"Oh, the leg... it should be pretty good overall. Plus, I encountered something very strange today, and I want to discuss it with you."
"Strange? What strange thing?"
"While I was waiting for you at the café downstairs reading a book, a young man came over and pointed out the cause of my leg injury. Then, just now upstairs, he performed a minor surgery on me. You can say the surgery was quite a success."
"What? He operated on you? In the room?"
"Yes, you wouldn't believe it, but he managed to do the surgery right there in the room. At the time, I hadn't expected it, but this really did happen to me and I witnessed the entire process. You can't help but believe it."
"My goodness, that's really a miracle doctor! How's your leg now? Besides the wound area being a little painful, I can't feel anything else. I believe that in a couple of days, the pain should mostly subside and this leg will be healed."
"Elder Bai, that's really something. And before, so many doctors abroad couldn't do anything, yet here we've found hope."
"Yes, who would have thought that what was hidden there was so profound? If not for him, I wouldn't have had any clue as to what was happening."
"How did he know?"
"I'm not sure, he just looked at me twice and quickly made his judgment. I guess he must have a good understanding of human anatomy."
Experience new tales on My Virtual Library Empire
"Elder Bai, what do you mean by telling me this?"
"This guy is an extraordinary talent, and he will be very useful for our next steps. So, I want to recruit him."
"I see, Elder Bai, you want me to investigate this man, right?"
"Yes, because I can't find any clues right now. The only thing I know is that an assistant following him is a girl named Liu Yao, and she was working at the People's Hospital. Hurry up and inquire at the hospital, find out who this man is, and see if he's a doctor at their hospital."
"Okay, I've got it. This should be simple. I'll take care of this for you tomorrow, how's that?"
"Tomorrow? What, do you have something else tonight?"
"Elder Bai, as you know, my roots are here. I haven't been back for many years and now that I'm here, I'd like to meet some old classmates. I've arranged to see them this afternoon."
At this point, Elder Bai seemed a bit displeased, but he nodded reluctantly.
After all, since she had already made arrangements, it would be somewhat excessive for him to insist she stay.
"Fine then. If it's an old relationship, then at the very least, it should be maintained. After all, in the coming years, we are likely to stay here."
When he finished speaking, Li Jingwen seemed a bit surprised.

chapters.title: Chapter 415 Memories of Those Years
chapters.content:
Lin Yi had clearly been assigned by the company to come here, and moreover, it seemed Mr. Bai was only here to deal with some matters and left quickly. So why did he also decide to stay?
"Mr. Bai, what did you just say, 'we'?"
"Yes, 'we', because I have decided I'm going to stay here as well."
"Mr. Bai, isn't there a lot for you to deal with back at headquarters? If you stay here, what about there? How will you manage that?"
"Over there, of course, someone will take care of it. I wasn't planning on staying, but I'm filled with curiosity about this young man. If I can really keep him for our use, then being here will certainly lead to great achievements. But don't worry, our company's current industries have no connection, I'll be working behind the scenes."
"Alright, I understand."
Li Jingwen didn't argue any further because she knew Mr. Bai had always been a man of his word who, once he deemed something necessary, left little room for negotiation.
"Mr. Bai, is there anything else you need here?"
"I've sent the arrangements for your daily tasks to your phone. Take a good look at them. These next couple of days, you must concentrate on finding that person quickly. After you find them, you can get busy with other matters. As for this end, I have my own plans."
"Alright, I understand."
After speaking, Li Jingwen nodded and then, upon opening the meticulous work schedule on her phone, it quickly leapt out at her.
However, over the years, Li Jingwen had always treated these tasks like a routine part of life, so to her, they were nothing unusual.
After Mr. Bai left, she checked the time; he had only used 35 minutes.
If it was just a matter of going up to freshen up and then depositing luggage, probably ten minutes would have been enough.
But so much time had been wasted, and it was unclear what was going through Lin Yi's mind at the moment.
Would he still hold a grudge like before, for dragging his feet and dilly-dallying in everything he did?
"Sorry to keep you waiting."
He swiftly reappeared before Lin Yi.
Lin Yi just looked up, and true enough, in the time he was upstairs, she had changed into a new set of clothes.
However, it looked quite rushed, it was clear she hadn't taken a shower.
"No problem, I was waiting for you, and besides, waiting for a beauty, what's there that can't be waited for? All set?"
"Don't worry, everything's settled. You tell me, where shall we go?"
"Since you've come back, naturally, it's about reliving the old days, experiencing the simple local customs here. Come on, I've already thought of the place."
With those words, Lin Yi stood up excitedly.
In fact, Li Jingwen's memories of their past experiences were deep-seated too.
At this moment, she felt this affair was no small matter, and surely, the first place she brought him had to be somewhere meaningful.
It was just that the two of them had far too many beautiful memories in this city.
On the way, Li Jingwen started reminiscing about all the little moments they had shared here in the past.
Finally, after about 20 minutes' drive, the car stopped next to a street.
Getting out here, Li Jingwen just glanced around and felt that everything seemed very unfamiliar.
"What, what place is this?"
She was curious and turned her head to ask him.
"How come, you don't remember this place at all?"
"No, if I'm not mistaken, this area should have been recently redeveloped, it just isn't the same as before."
"Right, this used to be a shantytown, remember?"
"Shantytown? Oh, I know now, is this 15 Chuanyin Road?"
Suddenly, that line popped into Li Jingwen's head.
"Correct, it looks like you still have a deep impression of this place."
Read new chapters at My Virtual Library Empire
"Of course, back then we would often come here. I remember there was a pickled fish restaurant, they were really good, but now, unfortunately, I guess it must have been demolished."
"It was demolished at that time, but later, the owner managed to set it up here again, barely maintaining. However, now it has a bit of a farmhouse feel to it. Come on, I'll take you there."
Saying this, Li Jingwen followed him, and they continued walking forward, passing through an alley before finally stopping in front of a courtyard.
The courtyard had an antique look, and compared to their previous experiences with shantytowns, it was far superior.
Actually, upon entering, Li Jingwen was immediately captivated by the scene inside.
She just looked around because all of it gave her a completely new feeling.
Although it seemed like the old memories were somewhat elusive, coming here should still help her understand.
"How about it? The environment is nice, right?"
"Yeah, it's really nice, much better compared to before. I just wonder if the taste is the same as it used to be?"
"It should be fine, the owner hasn't changed, so the flavor he creates shouldn't be different. I've already brought someone here once before, so I feel the taste is still the same as in the past."
"Brought someone? Who did you bring?"
At this, Li Jingwen seemed truly sensitive.
She just smiled and asked him, seemingly a casual question, but they both knew it had a deeper meaning.
"Oh, did I not tell you? A few years ago, I got married, and I now have three children, triplets at that."
"I had heard about it before, but having someone suddenly bring it up, I still feel like, well, let's leave it, it's all in the past now."
"Okay then, what about you, how are things going now?"
While talking, they sat down in a quiet corner.
The place was still somewhat serene.
Then, the owner came over, handed them the menu, and they confidently marked a few selections. Finally, the owner took the menu and left.

chapters.title: Chapter 416 The Cause of the Teacher's Death
chapters.content:
"I'm still the same, I guess, having been continuously fighting for my career these past few years, so, I basically haven't given my personal life any thought."
"That won't do, you're not getting any younger. You must at least count as a member of the eligible bachelors, right? I bet there's a line of people wanting to date you." Read latest stories on My Virtual Library Empire
"It's not that exaggerated, no one is really chasing after me. Besides, I haven't met the right person and I always can't forget the relationships from the past."
She spoke with profound meaning, and while she said this, she deliberately looked up to see Lin Yi sitting across from her.
Lin Yi, on his part, felt somewhat awkward.
After all, they had been passionately in love before, so now, when they met, he always felt unable to maintain the sense of normalcy expected between friends.
However, Lin Yi certainly had no other thoughts. He knew that he had to put the past behind him, and he would definitely not do anything to wrong Han Xuewei.
"I've told you before, what's past is past. Moreover, one can try to regain old memories, but lost feelings are definitely irretrievable."
"I know, you're scared, aren't you? Scared I'll snatch you away from your wife?"
"Haha, you still love to joke."
In the lull of their reminiscence, a dish of sour cabbage fish had been brought to the table.
"I didn't expect it to look exactly the same as before, and the taste is still the same."
"Come on, try it while it's hot. That's when it tastes best; it's just been drizzled with a layer of oil."
"Yeah, I know."
As she spoke, Li Jingwen couldn't wait to take her chopsticks, then picked up a bite and gently placed it in her mouth.
A look of satisfaction immediately appeared on her face.
"Hmm, it really hasn't changed at all, and it suddenly takes me back to the lifestyle of several years ago."
"Yeah, it hasn't changed at all, and this taste feels very, very familiar to me."
"Not bad at all. This meal you treated me to today was really worth it. Good, really good."
"By the way, there's something that's been on my mind for 5 years, and I've always wanted to ask you."
"Oh, ask me? What do you want to ask?"
Having said that, Li Jingwen put down her chopsticks and looked at him earnestly.
"Do you remember our teacher from back then?"
"Oh, I remember. But hasn't he passed away?"
"Yes, indeed he has. But all these years, I've never been able to let it go. I always felt that there was something odd about his death."
"Odd? What's so odd about it?"
"I can't quite put my finger on it, but it seems unrelated to his illness."
"No way, you, a pharmacist, and now you're playing doctor too?"
"I don't know, but ever since that time, I occasionally think of something. You were the last one to see him, and I wonder if there's anything else that might be suspicious?"
"No, although I was the last to see him, I wasn't the only one there. After celebrating his birthday, we all left, didn't we?"
"But he was fine before then, and I asked his wife; he was taking his medications regularly. So why did he suddenly die?"
This was a knot in Lin Yi's heart that he couldn't untangle.
Because on that night, Lin Yi was unable to attend the teacher's birthday due to something that came up last minute. And because of this, he never saw him again, which to this day he regretted.
Lin Yi knew he couldn't bring him back to life, so the only thing he could do was to investigate the true cause of his death.
"Maybe it was some acute symptoms brought on by the illness?"
"I remember he was buried soon after, right?"
"Right, he should have been buried. Besides, didn't they ask the attending doctor? Based on his other medical indicators, it was probably heart failure that he died from."
"Hmm, I remember that, and indeed he did have the tests done. But, I've seen reports saying that the chances of this disease leading to heart failure are really less than 1%, and over two years, I found a more suspicious point."
"Oh, what's that?"
"The teacher had liver disease, and also cirrhosis."
"Yeah, cirrhosis isn't unusual; many people develop this condition as they age."
"True, cirrhosis isn't fatal, but if a patient with this illness was also suffering from cirrhosis, their heart should have been fine."
"Are you suggesting he shouldn't have died from heart failure, but all the physiological evidence at the time pointed to it?"
"I just feel that it's all very strange, so I want to know what exactly happened that night, and how many people were there?"
"Let me think... you've got me trying to remember... I think there were 5 people, all classmates from our class. Do you remember them?"
"Oh, I know who they were."
"Yes, them. Is there a problem?"
"What did you guys eat that night?"
"What we ate? All the dishes were made by our teacher's wife."
"After eating those dishes, did anyone have any reactions?"
"Reactions? I didn't have any."
At this point, Li Jingwen just slightly furrowed her brows.
Suddenly, an image flashed through her mind, and she widened her eyes and put down her chopsticks.
"What happened, did you remember something?"
After reading this, he suddenly became tense and looked at her, asking.
"Now that you mention it, I really did remember something. Indeed, two people got sick with vomiting and diarrhea after they returned."
"Two people got sick?"
"Right, two people got sick, but the other three didn't have any issue."
"That's really strange. If two people showed symptoms, it must mean they ingested the same thing. Could there have been any difference in what the four or five of you ate?"

chapters.title: Chapter 417 Someone Poisoned
chapters.content:
"It's impossible. I personally tasted everything, including every drink; there couldn't have been any problem."
"Then why did those symptoms appear on them? Why didn't you show the same symptoms?"
"That, I don't know. At the time, I was also anxious about dealing with the teacher's passing, and since the others didn't exhibit symptoms, these matters were gradually forgotten."
"The two who showed symptoms, who were they? Do you remember?"
"That, I do remember. One was Shi Ling, and the other was Zhang Qiang."
"Do you have their information?"
"Where would I get their information? Besides, so many years have passed, I have no recollection at all. What's going on? What exactly are you thinking of?"
"I just feel that if that is really the case, then there must be something that could affect them internally but not you, which means their bodies must have something in common."
"Have something in common."
"Yes, that must be it."
"I still find this confusing. If they have something in common, then what does that explain?"
"It means that their bodies, ah, I can't explain it to you in just a word or two right now. Anyway, that's the situation. By the way, have you been in touch with his widow?"
"I've been abroad these past two years, and I haven't contacted her. What about you? Haven't you always been here? Haven't you kept in touch?"
"During the holidays, I did visit her. Seeing her always downcast made me feel sad, so after a while, I visited less often. However, I would still send her messages and visit to offer support."
"No way, you're not suspecting his widow, are you? I tell you, it's absolutely impossible. For all these years, she's been by his side, taking care of him. How could she possibly harm him?"
Li Jingwen, it seemed, couldn't make any sense of his words.
The teacher was a very good person, and in front of these students, his widow was like a mother to them, taking meticulous care of them whenever they visited their home.
Could it be that now Lin Yi had such great suspicions of his widow?
"No, no, that's not what I meant, and who I'm suspecting, it definitely wouldn't be his widow."
"Exactly, I was going to say. You are too heartless, after all she did for you. Do you still remember the pair of shoes she made for you?"
"I remember; I'll never forget. Even though those shoes are now worn out, I've never thrown them away. They have always been on display in my home's cabinet."
"So, after all this beating around the bush, what exactly are you trying to tell us?"
Li Jingwen seemed a bit perplexed.
With all she talked about today, she found it all somewhat unbelievable.
"I suspect that our teacher must have been poisoned back then."
"What did you say? Poisoned by someone else? That's impossible. Besides, he was such a good person, how could he have offended anyone?"
"That, I'm not sure about, but I always felt that there was something wrong with his death."
"How can you be so certain?"
"I'm one hundred percent sure. I didn't think much about it at the time, but later, after coming across a lot of information, I realized it couldn't be due to natural causes; it must have been an accident."
"So you're saying that there was something wrong with the meal we prepared that night?"
"Yes, it's very possible. That medicine might be harmless for you, but for someone with his illness, it would be a deadly poison."
"Who exactly was it?"
"Do you even need to ask? It had to be someone who knew the teacher very well because without knowing him, the person couldn't have conveniently put the medicine in the food."
"But I recall, that night it was just a few of us there, plus the teacher and his widow. I can't think of anyone else."
"I'm just asking if someone had entered the kitchen besides those few, or if someone had been to the teacher's house?"
At this point, Li Jingwen hesitated just a bit.
After all, so many years had passed, and asking her now, her memory was indeed blurry.
When she spoke just now, she was only trying her best to retrieve what fragmented memories she had.
After pondering for a long time, Li Jingwen just silently shook her head.
"Really, I can't think of anyone."
"Are you unsure whether someone came or can you definitively tell me that no one else was there that night?" Enjoy exclusive content from My Virtual Library Empire
"I can say with certainty that before we left, definitely no one else had been there, but after we left, I'm not sure. And it was after we left that night when the incident occurred."
"It couldn't have been after we left. Moreover, after the medicine enters the body, the 'Medicinal Effect' takes time to manifest. It would take around three or even four hours before you'd see any effect."
"Three to four hours, considering our dinner time, that aligns with when the incident was reported to me. So, this timeline basically matches."
Although Li Jingwen had never doubted this matter before, and even now as Lin Yi spoke, she hadn't considered it.
However, listening to Lin Yi's analysis, she felt it all made sense.
If that were true, could it be that they had been secretly plotted against?
"No one else went there, and the teacher wouldn't have poisoned himself, so even more unlikely is talking about his widow like that. Honestly, I believe the person who poisoned him is among us."
Li Jingwen suddenly expressed this bold idea.
Though it sounded absurd to him, even incomprehensible.

chapters.title: Chapter 418 Investigating Liu Yao?
chapters.content:
But it seems that apart from this explanation, no one could account for this matter.
Lin Yi didn't speak. He merely nodded slightly at Li Jingwen.
This was his tacit consent to everything, wasn't it?
"Oh my God, then, who could it be?"
"I don't know. It could be anyone, and at the same time, it could be no one."
"So you mean, even I might have drugged Master, right?"
"Until we truly find the person who did it, every one of you is a major suspect. So, for all these years, I've been wanting to understand this matter, but unfortunately, I've long since lost contact with those classmates."
"Not just you, I've also lost contact. Moreover, after so many years, do you think they still remember? What's the meaning of telling me this now?"
"No particular meaning. After all, you're a woman, and you had a pretty good relationship with those people back then, so..."
"So what? So you want me to help you find this person?"
"Yes, because you're the most suitable person for this. Of course, if you don't want to take on this matter, I absolutely won't insist. I just need you to tell me their backgrounds, and their current situations. The rest, you don't need to worry about."
"Background? After so many years, who knows if they're even still alive?"
As Li Jingwen spoke, she gazed indifferently out the window.
Actually, she had been happy about having a meal today.
But she never expected such a deep issue to be brought up. It seemed to be quite a blow to him.
No matter, everything depends on our actions, and this matter isn't urgent, after all, so many years have passed. Rushing wouldn't make any sense.
"No, I really want to ask you. Is there any point in bringing up this old matter after so many years? Furthermore, even if you suspect someone, after all this time, those evidences are long gone. Tell me, how are you going to prove anybody's guilt?"
"Firstly, I am a person who knows gratitude. My teacher died under unclear circumstances, and I will definitely not let it go easily."
"Secondly, even though many years have passed and the superficial evidence has likely disappeared, I tell you, the fundamental things must still exist."
"What do you mean by fundamental things?"
"Ah, how should I explain this to you? It's like something that's ingrained in the marrow, things that can never be completely eradicated."
"I get it. I'll do my best to resolve this for you."
Having said that, Li Jingwen just nodded.
Honestly, Li Jingwen had no real reason to refuse his request.
She always held her own fantasies about this man, but she also knew that even if she harbored fantasies, they could probably only remain as such.
Just then, Li Jingwen's phone suddenly rang. She picked it up and glanced at it.
"Haha, didn't expect she'd be pretty."
What Li Jingwen was looking at on her phone right now was Liu Yao's photo.
Having agreed to Mr. Bai's request to investigate this woman and the mysterious man's true identity, she had to clarify everything.
Therefore, before meeting up, Li Jingwen had already arranged for someone to go to People's Hospital and obtain Liu Yao's personal information. Explore hidden tales at My Virtual Library Empire
By following the vine to find the melon, she could naturally find the mysterious man associated with Liu Yao.
"What's wrong, who's pretty?"
All of a sudden, Li Jingwen blurted out such a sentence, which made Lin Yi feel quite puzzled.
"Haha, nothing much. I'm just investigating someone."
"Investigating someone? Who are you investigating? But, if you need help, I can offer my assistance."
"Right, how come I didn't think of you? No matter what, you've lived locally for so many years. You know about People's Hospital, don't you?"
"People's Hospital? I'm very familiar with it."
"Then, can you get in touch with those who handle personnel or archive management there?"
"Personnel and archive management? Tell me, what do you want to do?"
"I want to find a nurse from their hospital."
"A nurse? Which nurse?"
"That's the one I just had someone take a photo of. Take a look and see if you recognize her."
Li Jingwen then passed her phone over to him.
Lin Yi simply took the phone, without thinking much about it.
However, when he saw Liu Yao's photo appear on it, he felt genuinely astonished.
How come they were investigating Liu Yao all of a sudden?
"What's the matter, do you know her?"
Sitting across from him, Li Jingwen saw Lin Yi holding the phone, seemingly lost in thought.
"How would I know her? People's Hospital is so large, and probably has nearly five or six hundred nurses. How would I go about recognizing her for you? I don't know her."
"Don't know her? Do you know any doctors at People's Hospital? If you really know some, maybe, it would be easier to talk?"
"Doctors? There are a few doctors I have met before that I might know. Just tell me, what do you want with this girl?"
After all, they were investigating Liu Yao, and she was the person he was planning on employing next. Therefore, he must understand what this woman was doing now.
"Nothing much, it's just some other matter. She is not the goal, actually, it's someone close to her I want to find."
"Someone close to her? Who? A friend of hers? Or perhaps, her attending physician?"
"Oh, you better not get too involved in this. Since it's none of your business, you should stop asking so many questions. I'm just asking if you can handle it for me?"
"No problem, since you've already asked, I'll definitely take care of it for you. It's just finding a person, after all. It's a piece of cake for me."
"Great, if that's the case, I won't look for anyone else. At least this way, I can avoid taking a roundabout path. After all, having just arrived here, I worry about being deceived by others."

chapters.title: Chapter 419 Disappointing Answer
chapters.content:
"Alright, if you had said so earlier, I would have told you directly. There, put your phone away."
"What? Don't you need to take a picture of the photo alone? This way, you also prevent the chance of mistaking the person, right?"
"A girl like her, I can recognize her at a glance, don't worry."
"What's this? Do you still have such a strong guard against beauties?"
"That's not it. As long as I can help you find her, that's what matters. By the way, are you in a hurry for this?"
"Whether I'm in a hurry or not, as long as you give me an answer within a few days, that'll be fine."
"Alright, I promise you, but I have something coming up tomorrow that I need to leave for a bit, so I'll probably help you investigate when I get back in a few days. Is that okay to delay?"
"Sure, since you've already said so, I'm not in a rush at this moment. Just give me a result when you can."
"Alright, got it. By the way, how long do you plan to stay this time? Is it going to be like last time you were here on a trip, then leave after a few days?"
Lin Yi honestly hadn't thought that much about it.
After the two had broken up, actually, he had come back once before.
It was just that at that time, he didn't choose to meet with her.
And Li Jingwen didn't take the initiative to contact him either.
He had only heard from others that she seemed to have been here on official business, so it was probably about 5 days, and then she flew back overseas.
"Do you hope I'll leave after a few days, or do you want me to stay here for you indefinitely?"
Li Jingwen suddenly changed her usual demeanor, then smiled and said to him.
Lin Yi just gave an embarrassed smile.
If it had been the past, when they were dating, he naturally would have thought the longer the stay, the better.
But now, they both had their own lives, and Lin Yi really hadn't put this woman back in his heart.
"What do you want me to say about that? Besides, you have work and your own social circle. If you want to stay here, stay; if you don't want to stay, you can go back anytime."
"Over the years, it seems, you really haven't changed, and this answer of yours has left me somewhat disappointed."
"Disappointed? Why? Are you expecting me to tell you that I hope you'll stay?"
"You could hope for me to stay or to leave as soon as possible, either would be a complete answer. But you chose something in between."
"Actually, I should tell you..."
"Alright, alright, no more. I was just joking with you. Honestly, after coming back this time, I reckon I probably won't be able to leave anytime soon in the next few years."
"Oh, why's that?"
"The company is going to invest here, and several projects have already been settled, so I came earlier to start up some other projects. In Later Stages, a branch office should gradually be set up."
"Oh, I see. Well, that's good, 'falling leaves return to their roots', and after all, many connections are in this city."
"Yeah, I think so too. This way, it will be better for all of us."
As the two were talking, time had unknowingly passed by quite a bit.
The food in front of them had long been cleared away.
Though they were just eating, the truth was they hadn't drunk much of the wine set aside.
Both seemed preoccupied and couldn't really get the drinks down.
By the time they left, it was already 11:30 PM.
"What, you're going back to the hotel?"
"Yes, definitely going back to the hotel. You?"
"Oh, then since it's so late, I'll take you back to the hotel."
Lin Yi didn't respond to Li Jingwen's words, and he didn't tell her where he was staying either.
Actually, this was no secret.
Though Li Jingwen didn't have much clout locally, given her current abilities, this investigation would be a piece of cake for her.
After hailing a cab, he took Li Jingwen back to the hotel. Stay tuned for updates on My Virtual Library Empire
"Alright, it's getting late, and I need to leave early tomorrow, so I won't stay any longer."
"What, not even for a cup of coffee?"
"Heh, no need, no need. Coffee will keep me up even more, you're not just offering coffee, you're sabotaging me. Alright, then I'm off."
Lin Yi seemed eager to leave, and then he got up and left promptly.
However, he didn't actually walk away.
He just hid behind a lamppost not far off.
Because everybody knows, under a streetlight is actually the darkest place, so no one would notice him there.
He watched Li Jingwen standing at the door.
She didn't seem to have any intention of going back for quite some time.
Ever since Li Jingwen showed him a photo that day, he started to have such suspicions.
All these years, he hadn't visited this place, but now he suddenly began investigating Liu Yao; obviously, there was something going on.
The highest likelihood was that someone was directing her from behind the scenes.
Liu Yao was so naive; she definitely wouldn't have disputes with outsiders. The only reason they'd be investigating would be him.
If that was the case, he couldn't let Li Jingwen know that he was that person.
Lin Yi saw Li Jingwen finally turn around and then walk inside.
He hurriedly ran over to the spot right beneath her floor.
He knew which floor Li Jingwen was on, and from this spot, if she really went back to her hotel room, then the light in her room should be visible.
Lin Yi slowly sat down in a pavilion across the street and patiently waited there.
He kept checking the time; now, it had been exactly 7 minutes since Li Jingwen went in.
Normally, after entering, you wait for the elevator, then take it up, two minutes would have been more than enough.
Could it be that the elevator was especially crowded today?
There was a possibility, so Lin Yi began to wait patiently.
Time passed every second, and when Lin Yi looked at the time again, it had been a full 40 minutes since Li Jingwen went up.

chapters.title: Chapter 420 Salary of Twenty Thousand
chapters.content:
But she still hadn't turned on the light, which meant he hadn't gone back to his own room.
If he hadn't returned to his own room, then someone must be here, in this or some other room.
And that room was probably where Li Jingwen was looking for someone.
Who was this person? A mysterious man, or perhaps, his behind-the-scenes controller?
All of a sudden, something occurred to him.
That afternoon, he had treated an elderly man with white hair.
He did indeed fix the man's broken leg, but it seemed as though the old man took a strong interest in him.
However, judging by the old man's every move and his attire, he seemed to be someone with a background.
Could it be that he and Li Jingwen were already acquainted with each other?
If they were not old acquaintances, he wouldn't have entrusted such an important task of finding a nurse to Li Jingwen.
Could her boyfriend be that very man? Lin Yi hesitated for a moment.
At this time, Li Jingwen was at the peak of her career, and was young and beautiful. What reason could she have to seek out an old man like that?
He found it surprising since, according to Li Jingwen's taste, she would absolutely not be interested in that old man.
Could there be some other transaction between them?
Were these matters also indiscernible secrets?
Lin Yi pondered over it here again and felt like he hadn't really understood many things.
Forget it, if he couldn't figure it out, he felt there was no need to keep thinking about it.
But one thing was certain, he had to remind Liu Yao that she must delete all contact information about him in the coming days, and also, she must not meet with him.
Otherwise, those people would inevitably discuss the news of you going to meet him with old Liu.
He took out his phone and dialed Liu Yao's number directly.
Although he didn't know whether she was at home or at the hospital at this time?
The phone rang only a few times before Liu Yao's voice came through.
"Hello, what's up? Is there an emergency?"
Liu Yao was really frightened by his late-night calls, feeling that he must have something very important to discuss.
"No, I'm just asking where you are?"
"Oh, I'm at home. I'm not on night shift today, I will be tomorrow night."
"Okay, how are things going at the hospital now?"
"Almost done, I think. Plus, I've submitted my resignation notice. If everything goes according to the normal process, it should take about another 7 days or so, I guess, and then this will be settled."
"Seven days or so? No, that's too long. Tomorrow, you must leave that place."
"What do you mean, tomorrow? Why the rush? Aren't you guys not in dire need of people over there?"
"Don't worry about that, just do as I tell you. You need to leave as quickly as possible tomorrow, otherwise, it could be very dangerous for you."
"Dangerous? What kind of danger?"
Liu Yao was somewhat confused.
She thought as long as she did her job and worked her shifts, what danger could there be for him?
Therefore, what Lin Yi said to her today left her feeling bewildered.
"From now on, you're my person, so you just have to follow my instructions, okay?"
"Well, okay. I'll hurry up and hand things over tomorrow. I was thinking of finishing up everything at the end of this month." Your journey continues on My Virtual Library Empire
"These few days won't make a difference. Besides, I've already transferred 20,000 yuan to your account, consider it a prepayment of your salary for this month."
"What? Salary, 20,000?"
Hearing this, Liu Yao felt as if she had misheard.
Her monthly earnings normally amounted to roughly 10,000 yuan.
With just that, she was already very content.
But unexpectedly, upon reaching Lin Yi, her salary suddenly doubled to 20,000 yuan.
For Liu Yao, that was a surprisingly high salary.
"Yes, 20,000. If you perform well later on, I'll be ready to raise it at any time. For now, you don't have to go to work. Just stay at home and take good care of your mom, okay?"
"Okay, I got it."
"By the way, how has your mother been these past couple of days?"
"She's been alright, stable, and she hasn't mentioned any pain, but..."
"But what?"
"But last time, you pointed something out to me, and it seems like she really is showing some slight reactions. I'm thinking of taking her to get a thorough CT scan tomorrow."
"That area is unavoidable. If she is indeed showing some reactions, it probably means that it's progressing in that direction. However, getting a CT scan isn't that crucial. I'll take care of it when I get back."
"Okay, then I understand. Do you have any other instructions?"
Liu Yao spoke submissively.
First off, she was profoundly subdued by this man.
Moreover, he was her boss, so the subordinate speaking with her boss naturally showed that very clear attitude.
"Nothing more. Until I return, don't go anywhere, just stay at home. If you need to, you can go grocery shopping and tidy things up. Any other arrangements will wait until I get back."
"Alright, I'll do that."
"Then that's it, I won't bother you any longer."
After saying that, she hung up the phone directly.
The important matters had already been instructed, and although the woman had agreed to leave the task to him,
who knows if she might secretly start working on it again?
Moreover, obtaining Liu Yao's private photos was, frankly, a very difficult task.
Without some tricks, it was impossible to find such candid pictures from within the hospital.
The only ones available were probably just her wearing a nurse's uniform, posing for work photos.
He stayed a bit longer, and seeing that the light in his room was still off, he could only shake his head helplessly and leave the spot.
What good would any more waiting do?
Whether Li Jingwen returned to her room or not seemed to have little to do with him now.
Even if she had secret matters to attend to, she would definitely not tell him about them.

chapters.title: Chapter 421 Tools
chapters.content:
At that moment, she wasn't really in her own room but was with that person.
Li Jingwen sat up from the bed, then found a pajama and put it on.
Boss Bai seemed content.
He leaned back at the head of the bed, took out a cigar, and began to smoke it fervently here.
The two of them had long since developed this kind of relationship.
But what Li Jingwen couldn't understand was why he, at his age, always needed medicine to barely manage to be with her. What was the point of all this?
She truly despised this man.
But now, Li Jingwen couldn't afford to truly offend him.
Because she knew if she did offend him, there wouldn't be any good consequences waiting for her.
Even everything she had accumulated over the years could quickly be taken back.
This was a result Li Jingwen did not want to see in her heart.
"How was it, are you satisfied?" she asked as she turned her head to look at the man.
"Shouldn't I be the one asking you that question?"
"It's getting late, you should smoke less. And constantly relying on such drugs isn't a good thing eventually."
"What I do is my business. By the way, have you started the investigation I asked you to arrange?"
"Oh, you mean the nurse in the hospital?"
"Yes, that's the one."
"Someone has been sent to follow her, but it will probably take two days to get any results. Also, we need to track down that man through her, which takes some time."
"I don't care how you do it, no matter how much manpower or financial resources it takes. It's none of my business. I just need you to tell me the final investigation details about that man."
"Okay, I got it. Don't worry, I'll handle it soon. But give me a few days. Tomorrow, I've got two contracts and projects to discuss with them, and I'm really swamped."
"I know, you're talking about the development of that block in Jiangdong, right?"
"Exactly, that place. You know, over the years, many people have been eyeing it greedily. With our acquisition of it, I'm sure many people will be displeased, and I'm afraid there might be sabotage."
"You don't need to worry about that. I'll handle the external matters, you just need to manage the internal affairs well."
"Alright, I understand. So, what do you say?"
"Fine, go back to your room. You'll be busy with your things tomorrow while I'll arrange the other matters here."
Boss Bai, having already received what he wanted, had no further use for keeping the woman by his side.
Dragging her exhausted body, Li Jingwen returned to her own room.
She felt as though she had been treated like an object for sexual release, suffering utter humiliation.
Once back in her room, she took off her clothes and went straight into the bathroom.
Inside, she washed for nearly an hour.
Li Jingwen felt as if every inch of her skin was dirty.
Finally, Li Jingwen came out and changed into a clean pajama.
She casually threw the clothes she had just worn into the trash bin.
Every time after being with that old man, she would dispose of the clothes, feeling that wearing them was an insult to herself.
She took out a delicate little box from her suitcase,
and, upon opening it, she saw pink pills inside.
She had prepared this medicine abroad for a long time but had never used it.
When would she be able to put an end to all of this?
Every time, she would take out the medicine and look at it for a while, but her rationality quickly triumphed.
She put the item back in the suitcase and locked it up.
Things left unfinished abroad meant that she had to take action promptly in her home country.
After all, Boss Bai's influence was too significant overseas. Any opportunity could lead to being watched by these people.
Now, being here without much of a network may actually be a good thing for her.
Afterwards, she turned off the lights and lay down on the bed. The room fell into darkness and silence.
But Lin Yi's night was not so peaceful.
His mind was racing, pondering many things.
He sensed that Li Jingwen's success must be related to someone, for how could she, a woman alone, so easily establish her own domain abroad?
Could it be that the old man he had seen today was her upper-level boss or held some special relationship?
If that were the case, then why was he looking for him, and what was it all for?
He chose not to go home, having already agreed to go out with Han Xuewei, so he just found a hotel to muddle through the night.
He got up very early in the morning and sat idly in front of the desk.
The distance to Xi Lian Mountain was about a three-hour drive.
If he followed the previous agreement, he should probably leave in the afternoon.
But before leaving, he felt it best to take care of one last thing.
The safety of Liu Yao was something he had to consider. Find more chapters on My Virtual Library Empire
Moreover, he worried that this time he didn't know how long he would be gone, and given the capabilities of that woman and the old man, it wouldn't take many days for all his information to be uncovered.
Therefore, Lin Yi had to make arrangements and preparations in advance.
His true identity must never be revealed. Additionally, he knew he could never meet that man again.
He hired a computer hacker to break into the hospital's network system and clean out all the information pertaining to Liu Yao.
Liu Yao's employment records at the hospital had now been completely blanked out.
Even after completing all this, he still felt somewhat uneasy.

chapters.title: Chapter 422 Hurriedly Taken Away
chapters.content:
So, he took out his phone and directly called Li Jingwen's number.
At that time, Li Jingwen was busy with other matters, but seeing the call, he decisively stepped out and answered the phone.
Because it seemed that every call Lin Yi made to her was extremely important.
"Hello, what's up?"
"Oh, it's like this. Didn't you ask me to investigate that nurse? Unfortunately, the nurse has already resigned from the hospital."
"What did you say? Resigned?"
This news seemed somewhat unexpected to Li Jingwen.
Just yesterday during the investigation, she was still working at the hospital, and now, in the blink of an eye, she had resigned—what did that all mean?
Could it be that she had been startled by me? Had I already spooked her?
If that were really the case, then this investigation was more trouble than it was worth.
The key issue was, he had no way to explain this to the old man.
"Yes, resigned. I started to have people look into it first thing this morning, and they said she had submitted her resignation a week ago, so she's already left the hospital and has nothing to do with it anymore."
"A week ago?"
Li Jingwen thought carefully. The events had only happened yesterday, and a week ago she had already submitted her resignation letter, which clearly had nothing to do with her actions.
After realizing this, she felt somewhat reassured.
"Yes, a week ago. So now the lead is like a kite with its string cut—suddenly, we can't find it."
"What about her family? She must have a home address. Besides, she should have left a lot of information at the hospital."
"Ah, that's the thing. I feel there are some coincidences here. I also had people search for her detailed background information inside, but it turns out, all her information has been completely deleted."
"What? Deleted? That's impossible, right? Even if she resigned, the hospital would definitely have the original files. They absolutely wouldn't be deleted."
Of course, Li Jingwen couldn't understand all this.
In her eyes, this was something that simply couldn't happen, yet it was unfolding right before her.
"Really, it's really been deleted?"
"Could it be that the other party has noticed something? And they don't want us to proceed? So, that's why they did this? But it shouldn't be, by all accounts, I have only just begun a sideways investigation. It shouldn't cause such a big stir."
"Well, I'm not sure about that. So, when I learned all this, I immediately called you to discuss it."
"Okay, I got it. You don't have to deal with this matter anymore."
"What? Are you going to investigate it yourself?"
Stay tuned with My Virtual Library Empire
"Of course. I refuse to believe that this person could just disappear into thin air."
"What kind of 'Magic Power' does she have that draws you in? You just got here and started investigating her."
"It's not her that has the 'Magic Power,' it's the person by her side that has it. Didn't I tell you about him yesterday?"
"Who is the person beside her, exactly?"
"A man, and not just any man, but a very, very formidable one."
"Oh, is that so? Then how about this, I think of another approach to help you with the investigation from a different angle."
"No need. Just carry on with your work. Leave this matter to me."
Upon further thought, Li Jingwen felt that it might indeed be inappropriate to get him continuously involved in the matter.
Moreover, many things were quite different from what she had imagined.
"Alright then, if there's nothing else, I should hurry and leave. I have lots more to take care of on my end."
"Go ahead with your work. Let's leave it at that."
After saying this, the other party hung up the call.
However, through this call, he had a faint feeling.
If he didn't come back soon, it was likely that this woman would conduct a thorough investigation in this city. Then, Liu Yao's identity and her home address would eventually be exposed.
That wouldn't do, Lin Yi definitely couldn't let this information become public.
But now time was urgent, and the only choice he had was to leave with Liu Yao and his frail mother.
Although he knew it was somewhat absurd, to ensure their safety, he had no choice but to do so for the time being.
"Hey, Liu Yao, where are you?"
"Oh, I'm at home. Didn't you tell me not to go out if it wasn't necessary these past few days?"
"That's right, you pack a few changes of clothes for yourself and your mother, then come with me."
"What? Go with you? Where are we going exactly?"
"Never mind that, some urgent matters have come up, and I can't leave you here alone. I'll feel more at ease if you're with me. Don't worry, as long as you're by my side, you will be absolutely safe."
"I've been wanting to ask you, what exactly did I do? Why do we suddenly have to live like fugitives?"
This was something Liu Yao just couldn't understand.
She felt that her carefree life, just work and home, a simple routine—how could that possibly offend anyone?
But on the phone, she didn't ask too many questions.
Because she knew that asking too much might lead to Lin Yi scolding her again.
"Okay, got it."
After saying that, he hurriedly ended the call.
To leave immediately, she understood, but to also bring her mother along?
"Yaoyao, what's the matter?"
Hearing Liu Yao on the phone outside and the secretive tone of her voice, Liu's mother became suspicious.
"Oh, nothing. I just got a call; you might have to go out with me for a few days."
"What? Go out for a few days? What's the matter, are you going on a business trip?"
"Yes, it's for a business trip and also to get treatment for you. This time we're going with the new boss."
"Oh, you mean that young man from before?"
"Yes, that's him. He just called to have me get ready quickly. I guess he'll be coming to pick us up soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 423 Arranging for Zhou Xiang
chapters.content:
"But when you're all off to work, what is mom supposed to do following you around? Forget it, I won't go. You don't have to worry about me, I can manage on my own for a few days."
"No way, how could that be okay? You absolutely must come. If I leave you at home by yourself, I definitely won't feel at ease."
"Oh my, what's there to worry about?"
"No, no, I must hurry and pack."
"But what will I do there if you're all working?"
"Don't worry, since he asked me to bring you, he surely has arrangements made."
"Sigh, this young man, he really is a good person. Right, you told me yesterday that he gave you 20,000 yuan just like that, he hasn't even started working, and he already gave you this month's salary?"
"Yes, I was also surprised. Anyway, he gave so much all at once. Anyway, your daughter is now well-off so you can come with me, it'll be like taking a trip, sightseeing by the mountains and waters. After all, we haven't gone out together for so many years."
"Sigh, if you put it that way, indeed, it's about time for a good trip, to travel and ease our minds."
The old lady didn't think too much of it. Since it was her daughter's decision, she naturally wouldn't object to it.
After about 40 minutes or so, the doorbell rang outside.
He knew that by this time, Lin Yi must have already arrived. Fortunately, the things they were taking weren't too many.
"How's it, are you all packed?"
"Don't worry, everything's packed, I can leave at any time."
After hearing this, Lin Yi nodded, then went into the room inside.
"Auntie, are you all ready?"
Now, he seemed to talk more to her mother than to Liu Yao.
"Yes, yes, look, I was just telling Yaoyao. Here you are off to handle serious business, and you have an old fogey like me tagging along, what's that about? It seems a bit inappropriate, doesn't it?"
"Oh Auntie, what's inappropriate about it? This time I'm taking you out for the express purpose of relaxing and sightseeing in the small town, staying there for a few good days, while I'm off attending to my own affairs. Don't worry, most of the time it will be Liu Yao keeping you company."
"Ah, her, isn't she supposed to be busy following you guys?"
"Hehe, she naturally has her own work to do, but her job is very simple; it can mostly be handled from home. So don't worry about it, I've already made the arrangements on my side."
"I'm really sorry, young man, dragging you down with me being sickly like this, it's truly troublesome for you."
Discover stories at My Virtual Library Empire
"Auntie, what are you talking about? And this trip is also to help with treating your health. This way, you being by my side, I can keep an eye on some effects of the treatments at any time."
"Well, if you say so, that makes sense."
"Alright, if everything's ready, I'll carry you to the wheelchair now, and then push you downstairs."
"No, no need, I can... I can manage on my own, and..."
Before Liu Yao's mother could finish speaking, Lin Yi stepped forward, reached out, and picked her up directly onto the wheelchair.
After that, the group of them set off, taking a car straight to Xi Lian Mountain.
Along the way, the scenery could be said to be very beautiful.
Perhaps the old lady hadn't been out for the many years, she was curious and continuously watched outside the window, never turning her head away.
Lin Yi, sitting at the front, would occasionally listen to the mother and daughter chatting and laughing behind him.
Lin Yi immediately felt that his mood had indeed improved a lot.
Finally, after three hours, they arrived in the small town.
Although it really wasn't very large, it had a unique local culture and customs; the buildings here were all styled in antique architecture.
Hei Lang and Ling'er had been waiting here early on.
