He knew that Lin Yi had brought two additional people this time, and he had already briefed both of them over the phone.
"Big brother, you finally arrived, we've been waiting here for a long time."
"The trip was relatively smooth, although there was a traffic accident on the way that held us up for quite a while. Otherwise, we would have arrived much earlier. Auntie, please get out of the car."
As he spoke, he turned and carefully moved her from the car to the wheelchair.
"My, this environment, this is really nice. And look at that, isn't that a big mountain over there?"
"Yes, there are mountains all around us, and this place is practically at the foot of the mountain."
"That's so nice, and coming here, I can feel that even the air has a fresh scent."
"Is the room already arranged?"
"Don't worry, everything is ready. Because she has trouble walking, we arranged a room for her on the first floor."
"Good, Auntie, I'll take you to your room first, and then I have some other matters to attend to."
"No need, no need, with Yaoyao's help, I'll be fine."
Even though she said this, Lin Yi was resolute in pushing Liu Yao's mother into the room.
Though it was a small inn in town, it was still the most high-end one in the area.
The room was large, built mostly of wood, with a very meticulous design.
Upon their arrival, Liu Yao was deeply attracted by the unique decorations in this place.
This was clearly a vacation, not work, so now she completely understood the arrangement.
"Liu Yao, come on, Auntie will rest here a bit, you come out, I need to talk to you about some things to come."
"Oh, okay, I got it. Mom, wait for me, okay?"
"Go ahead, go ahead, hurry off and attend to your matters, don't worry about mom, I'm perfectly fine here by myself."
With that, she simply waved her hand, and eventually, the group walked out of the room.
"Big brother, what do you think we should do next?"
"We can't keep waiting, and I've brought an extra person this time."
"Just tell me what I can do."
"You don't need to do anything. Just stay here with your mom, and concerning what comes next, you aren't able to handle it at the moment anyway."
"But then aren't I just here for nothing?"
"There may be other things to do. Haven't I already prepared a laptop for you? And if we need anything, you can help us look up information on it, then tell me through this phone."

chapters.title: Chapter 424 Hunter
chapters.content:
Continue reading stories on My Virtual Library Empire
While speaking, Lin Yi placed the two satellite phones he had prepared in advance into her hands.
Actually, Lin Yi had a clear understanding in his mind.
If all three of them really entered the mountains, they would essentially be out of contact on the outside.
Now, having one person here to coordinate their efforts wouldn't be of much help, but at the very least making phone calls or getting online was something Li Jingwen must be able to do.
"Oh, no problem, rest assured, leave it to me."
"Besides, do you know why I was in such a rush to bring you here?"
When Liu Yao reached this point, she hesitated slightly.
On the way here, while admiring the scenery, she somehow forgot about this matter.
"Oh, right, I haven't asked you yet. Why did you rush to bring me back, what does it mean?"
"It's because someone was inquiring about your information, and, to be precise, they were not looking for you, but for me."
"Looking for you?"
"Yes, do you remember the old man we operated on yesterday?"
"Oh, of course, I remember. Could it be, could it be him? Oh no, it just dawned on me."
Having said this, Liu Yao suddenly seemed to realize something.
Lin Yi just slightly furrowed his brows, not knowing what she had just recalled.
"What is it?"
"When I went there yesterday, I was in a hurry, so I didn't completely take off the nurse's uniform. I just put on a coat hurriedly, but it was quite short."
"You mean to say, he recognized you through the clothes underneath, right?"
"Exactly, and I still had my work badge on, don't you remember?"
"Damn it."
At this point, Lin Yi cursed under his breath.
No wonder he went straight to the People's Hospital upon arriving.
Otherwise, it wouldn't have been so simple.
"I, I, did I, did I do something wrong?"
Liu Yao was truly scared now.
She didn't want to cause any trouble because of herself, and this incident happening before she even officially started working made her feel quite bad.
It's nothing, since things have come to this, and it's just a matter of being a day early or a day late.
"Then, what does he want by finding you?"
"I don't know his true purpose, but right now, I don't want him to know my real identity and background, so you must keep this to yourself."
"Oh, I understand, I understand, I won't tell anyone, dead or alive, you can count on me."
Now, Liu Yao felt truly relieved.
It seemed that Lin Yi wasn't overly blaming her for this incident.
"Alright, this is your task. Tomorrow morning, we might start heading into the mountains as soon as possible. By then, you'll do your logistical work here, and don't get involved in anything else, got it?"
"Got it, I understand. But do you need my assistance while you're in the mountains?"
"You stay here and take care of your mother. If needed, I will contact you using this satellite phone. Remember, unless I contact you, do not try to contact me, understand?"
The words of Lin Yi seemed completely secretive.
Actually, Liu Yao didn't understand what exactly he was planning.
However, there was always a question in her mind: the real purpose of these people going into the mountains.
This was something that constantly preoccupied her thoughts.
But Liu Yao didn't dare ask too many questions, especially since Lin Yi hadn't voluntarily told her.
If that was the case, there must be many things he didn't want her to know.
Now that she had chosen to follow him, there were some things she could ask about, but some questions weren't necessary to pursue any further.
"Alright then, you can go back. The rooms here have all been arranged for you. There won't be a problem even if you stay longer. They'll deliver meals to your room three times a day. When you're free, you can also take your aunt to explore this small town. Also, don't disclose my identity, understand?"
"Don't worry, I know what to do."
"Alright, go back then. It's late, and we still have some matters to discuss."
"Okay, then, you be careful on the road."
"Rest assured, I know."
After the conversation, he just nodded and then watched the woman enter the room.
The moment the door closed, he resignedly let go.
He turned around to look at Ling'er and Hei Lang, who had been by his side.
The two had been in this small town for almost a day and should have learned quite a bit about it.
"Let's go, let's go back to the room to talk."
With those words, the two of them stood up and went straight to the second-floor room.
"How is it, have you found out anything about the mountain in these two days?"
As soon as they sat down, Lin Yi got straight to the point.
He knew that whether it was Ling'er or the Hei Lang beside him, they had not come to this place with the intention to sightsee.
They must have been busy all this while.
"Big brother, we haven't stopped since we arrived here. Then, we started to gather information from around here, and finally, we found a local who used to hunt in the mountains."
"What? Went into the mountains to hunt?"
"Yes, that would have been about 15 years ago. We met this hunter and asked in detail about some situations in the mountains."
"Good, what did he tell you?"
"He said that the geological environment of Xi Lian Mountain is very complicated and that there are many swamps, as well as muddy trenches within. One could easily get trapped in the swamps if not careful."
"Hmm, that's within expectations. And after all, it's a deep forest. If left unentered by humans for many years, these swamps could only expand. What else?"
"The others are that when he entered the mountain then, the game wasn't so fierce, and a hunting rifle was enough to deal with it. But in the following years, it seems that Xi Lian Mountain became connected with another mountain behind it. Some animals from there started to come over here and gradually began to multiply and grow stronger."

chapters.title: Chapter 425 Visit Again
chapters.content:
"So, you're saying that since that time, no one has really been able to enter the deep mountains, right?"
"It's like anyone who goes in doesn't come out alive. Gradually, the people here started to develop a fear of these mountains, so no one attempts to enter them anymore."
"What about the prey, during normal times, don't they ever come out of the Xi Lian Mountain? Living at the foot of the mountain in this small town, isn't it just as dangerous?"
"That's the thing, I find it odd too. Moreover, for many years, they've been coexisting peacefully with the creatures in those deep mountains. If they don't disturb them by going into the mountains, those creatures certainly won't take a single step out."
"What about the hunter?"
"He is still at home, what about him, Big Brother?"
"I want to see him."
"What? You want to see him? He already told us everything we needed to know. Besides, anything you want to ask, you can ask me directly. I think there's no need for Big Brother to see him again."
"I mentioned before that it's best to find a local guide, and only with someone like that can we really familiarize ourselves with the environment here."
"That's impossible. They're filled with fear of those mountains, I could even see him trembling when I mentioned Xi Lian Mountain."
"Heh, that's because you didn't mention money to him. I believe that with a hefty reward, there will be brave men."
"You mean, you want to offer him enough money to join us in entering the mountain?"
"Exactly. The key point is that he was a hunter, which proves he has a hunting rifle. It's something readily available, and furthermore, those are things we can't use ourselves."
"If you're talking about that, I did indeed notice, because there indeed was a rusty hunting rifle hanging on the wall of his house."
"Right, that's what we're looking for. Without him, using the hunting rifle on our own is outright illegal."
"Alright, then let's go now."
"Let's go, we'll head over right now."
Having said this, the two men got ready to leave, but as they reached the door, Lin Yi suddenly turned to look at Ling'er, who was following behind him.
"Ling'er, you don't need to come with us, the two of us are enough."
"Okay, then I won't go."
"Additionally, you can't just idle around here either. You must get familiar with the various medicinal herbs in these mountains, because once we enter, identifying and collecting the herbs will be up to you, and we will be responsible for your safety."
"Alright, no problem, I'll do it."
"Good, then get busy. We should return soon, I estimate. That's all for now."
After giving instructions to Ling'er, Lin Yi left with Hei Lang.
When they arrived at the hunter's home, he observed that the man's living conditions were not as affluent as they had imagined. Continue reading on My Virtual Library Empire
After all, he used to make a living by hunting, so now that he couldn't go into the mountains for game, life must be difficult.
Once they reached the courtyard gate, he gently knocked on the door and heard a woman's voice from inside.
"Oh, hello, is Big Brother Lin in?"
While speaking, a woman had already opened the door from the inside.
They had come prepared, bringing many large and small gifts.
These people were naturally hospitable, and considering that the guests had come from afar and brought so many gifts, they were naturally not going to turn them away.
"Oh, you, I remember now, didn't you come by a couple of days ago? And who is this?"
"Oh, Sister-in-law, this is my Big Brother. He just arrived today and wanted to pay a visit and learn about the situation in detail."
"Oh, okay, that's fine, then please come in. Husband, husband!"
While speaking, the woman warmly welcomed them inside.
The yard did look a bit dilapidated, and at this time, a child was playing with mud inside.
"Who is it?"
"Oh, it's like this, the gentleman who visited you last time has come again."
"Oh, fine, then come in."
He sounded polite and did not say much else.
The two men entered the room.
After entering, Lin Yi glanced around and could see that the household was not doing too well.
"Why have you come again? Didn't we already talk about everything last time?"
"It's like this; this is my Big Brother. He just arrived here today, and there are some things he's not very clear on, so he wanted to come and ask."
"Ask? There's nothing to ask about. I haven't been near Xi Lian Mountain for over ten years, and I don't have a clue about what's happening inside now."
"There's no need to be so tense; I just wanted to chat with you."
As they spoke, Lin Yi sat down directly across from him.
"Speak, what else do you want to know? I'll tell you anything I know, but I'm sorry, if I don't know, I can't answer your question."
"I don't want to ask anything right now. I want you to come with me tomorrow."
"Come with you where?"
"Naturally, we're going into the mountains."
"Impossible. Xi Lian Mountain is a place where people go to die. How could I possibly join you in going into the mountain?"
"Last time, people died because you didn't have enough help or proper equipment. Now with these advanced equipments, rest assured, our safety can be guaranteed."
"I still won't go. Moreover, I already have a fear of that place. What do you mean by this?"
He hadn't finished speaking when he saw Lin Yi take out 10,000 yuan from his bag and place it on the table.
"This is a 10,000 yuan deposit. Once we safely return from the mountains, rest assured, I will give you the remaining 40,000 yuan. I just need you to accompany us into the mountain, and the 50,000 yuan is yours."
"You, you're giving me, giving me 50,000?"
As he spoke, he stared in surprise, then stood up from his seat.

chapters.title: Chapter 426 The Temptation of Money
chapters.content:
Their kind of family probably only has an income of about 10,000 yuan a year.
Yet now, by just entering the mountain, I could get 50,000 yuan. For me, this is simply a stroke of immense luck.
"That's right, I'll give you 50,000, and moreover, if our trip goes smoothly, maybe, I'll even add more later,"
"But..."
"There are no buts. I'm telling you, if you don't go, I can hire someone else. It's only because you have had rich experience in entering the mountains before, and also, seeing that you seem quite robust, that you can join us."
"What exactly are you guys going into the mountain for?"
"That, you don't need to worry yourself about. We naturally have our own plans. You just need to tell me whether or not you're going."
After saying this, the man indeed began to hesitate.
He slowly bowed his head.
Seeing this, in fact, Lin Yi inwardly chuckled.
This time, he didn't refuse him outright, which proved that he was struggling with a fierce inner conflict.
"I just looked over your family situation, it doesn't seem too good, and moreover, you have a son. There are big expenses ahead. If you help me this time, that money will be yours, and I believe it should be able to improve your family's situation."
"Besides, I see your wife doesn't have much of a job, and she probably just does farming or odd jobs here. This could also lighten her burden. What do you think? I feel this is all very worthwhile."
"You don't need to worry; I'm telling you, our gear is very modern, and totally safe."
Throughout his thought process, Lin Yi kept hinting at him from the side, his actual purpose being to persuade him to join him on the trip.
"How about this? I won't pressure you. There's still a lot of time before tomorrow. I'll wait in the yard while you think it over by yourself. I won't put that much pressure on you."
As he spoke, Lin Yi stood up, ready to leave with Hei Lang.
"Wait a minute."
He slowly turned his head, guessing that the man must have made a decision.
"Speak, what's your condition?"
"The 10,000 yuan deposit you're leaving now is too little. Plus, you must give me the payment in advance for me to go into the mountain with you."
"In advance?"
"Right, in advance."
"Heh, alright, I understand. I agree to give you the 50,000 yuan."
As he spoke, he took the rest of the cash from his bag, placing all several tens of thousands on the table.
"What time do we enter the mountain tomorrow?"
It seemed he had made up his mind completely.
After all, it was a risky job, but if he took this risk and succeeded, perhaps he couldn't save up 50,000 yuan even if he worked for several years.
"Tomorrow morning, as soon as it's light, we'll depart."
"As soon as it's light won't do; we have to be before daybreak."
"What do you mean?"
"The environment of Xi Lian Mountain is different from what you imagine. Moreover, around 6 or 7 in the morning, just as it starts to get light, a miasma will form, and in that fog, we won't be able to find our way out easily, so it's very easy to get lost inside."
"So, we're saying around 4 or even 5 AM?"
"4 AM is the best time. It won't take long from here to the base of the mountain, roughly 20 minutes."
"After 20 minutes, we can reach the base. Then what about entering the mountain?"
"After we enter, I know a trail up the mountain. We must make our way to that trail as quickly as possible. Additionally, between 4 and 5 in the morning, it's when the beasts are in their deepest sleep, so it's likely we won't encounter too many prey."
"Got it, I understand."
"One more thing I should remind you: the mountain environment is complex, and the temperature difference between day and night is quite large. Sometimes it rains when it says it will. So, including this aspect, you also need to prepare in advance, and tents are a must."
Continue your journey with My Virtual Library Empire
"Don't worry, everything is already prepared. You don't need to fret over these matters; anything else you want to advise on?"
"How many people are going?"
"We're three people in total."
"Three people, apart from you two, is there also that woman?"
After saying that, he suddenly thought of the day that woman came to see him, not just the sturdy man before him, but there was also a gentle and lovely woman by his side.
"Right, there's also a woman."
"No, taking a woman into the mountain is taboo, and they easily attract evil beings. We can't go like this."
"If we don't take her, the expedition has no meaning. And, I'm telling you, once inside the mountain, it's that woman who will carry out the work; none of the rest of us can do it."
"She has to go?"
"It's imperative she goes."
Seeing the firm stance at this moment, the hunter started to lose his resolve.
Since it was their request, and they offered him so much compensation, it seemed he truly had no reason to refuse.
"Alright then, if she has to go and also has a special task, I guess none of you can replace her, so we'd better be cautious."
"Another thing, how much time will it take to get deep into the mountains?"
"If all goes well, I estimate that we should be able to reach the deepest point before it gets dark tomorrow,"
"And if things don't go well?"
"That, it's hard to say. The environment and terrain in these mountains are very complex. I'm telling you, nothing is absolutely smooth. I guess it's going to take at least two or three days to get out."
After finishing, Lin Yi just nodded.
Then, he looked up at the hunting rifle hanging on the wall.
"Is that rifle yours?"
"Yes, it's mine. I used it for hunting in the past. It's been passed down to me from my ancestors. Don't be fooled by its rusty appearance; it's very reliable, certainly no problem for dealing with prey."
"You're bringing it tomorrow?"
"Of course, I'm bringing it. It's my lifeline, and I'll definitely keep it on hand. Plus, I'll bring enough ammunition."

chapters.title: Chapter 427 The Clever Han Xuewei
chapters.content:
"Okay, that's good, that's good. It's getting late today, and I won't disturb you any further. You all should rest early too, and we'll meet up first thing tomorrow morning."
After he finished speaking, the hunter escorted them out of the yard.
The moment the courtyard gate closed behind them, Lin Yi actually felt that his journey had not been in vain.
He could tell that this person truly had a deep understanding of the mountain.
Moreover, this time they had a map, as well as a living map; with these two combined, they could be absolutely certain that their route would be without issues.
He just hoped they would encounter wild beasts as little as possible, as only in this way could they ensure their personal safety.
"Big brother, you're really impressive."
"What's up?"
"I didn't expect that paying him money would make him agree so quickly, but don't you think you gave him too much this time?"
"Let me tell you, this is a life-risking job, and if you pay too little, we simply can't get much from these people, so this money, I'm telling you, is definitely worth it."
Find exclusive content at My Virtual Library Empire
"Yeah, that makes sense. However, the things he said today, seems like there was something he didn't mention. I could tell he still has some memories of the mountain environment."
"Let me tell you, the mountain is so vast, no matter how much it is developed, it will only grow trees and grass. Its fundamental geographical features won't change, you got that?"
"Okay, I understand. Anyway, with the equipment we have, I guess there shouldn't be much of a problem."
"I hope everything goes smoothly. Once it's over, let's hurry up and leave this town. I believe these medicinal herbs will be enough to last us at least a year or so."
"Got it."
As the two of them conversed, they had reached the hotel.
Today's running around had left him feeling quite tired.
Once he lay down on the bed, he softly closed his eyes and thought about the plans for entering the mountain tomorrow.
Just then, his phone rang. He looked at it; it was a call from Han Xuewei.
"Xue Mei, what's up?"
"Have you arrived there now?"
"Oh, yes, I've arrived."
"I only found out today that Xi Lian Mountain is off-limits, and that there are plenty of ferocious beasts inside. Isn't it extremely dangerous for you to go in there?"
Today, while browsing the internet, Han Xue inadvertently stumbled upon the name Xi Lian Mountain and then remembered that Lin Yi had mentioned he was going there, too.
Therefore, she felt he might have some adventurous action planned for this trip.
This thought made Han Xuewei start to worry, prompting her to hurriedly call.
"Haha, Xi Lian Mountain is not safe, but I'm not really going into the mountain. I'm just at the foot of it, where there is Qingfeng Town. I'm in the town now, and if necessary, I can start a video call for you to see."
"Okay, then start the video call."
It seemed like Han Xuewei really was worried about him.
Fortunately, he hadn't ventured into the mountain yet, so video chatting with them wouldn't be much of a problem.
He hung up the phone and immediately started the video call.
He saw Han Xuewei at home, with all three children gathered around her, as if they were all waiting to see their dad.
"Daddy, Daddy, Daddy!"
The children saw him on the phone and began to call out one after another.
"Ah, my darlings, hello, you guys should listen to Mom at home, or listen to Grandpa and Grandma, got it?"
"Daddy, where are you going to play?"
"Daddy has some business and came out to play for a while, but I'll bring you and Mom here later on. Look, let me show you where Daddy is staying now."
After speaking, he flipped the camera and showed his room in a circle.
"Wow, this room, this room is so big, and it really has a nice feel to it. Daddy, is this room?"
"Of course, it's a room. Doesn't it feel different from our room at home?"
"Yeah, it's different, and it feels like they are very different."
"Haha, right, there's a big difference. Come on, I'll show you what it looks like outside right now."
He walked to the window and pushed it open.
Even though it was past 8 o'clock, the small town still seemed to retain its lively atmosphere.
"Wow, it's so beautiful. Dad, what's that over there, that dark thing?"
"Oh, that's a big mountain, the one Mom was talking about. But that mountain has lots of fierce monsters, so we can't go into it, okay?"
"Oh, got it, Dad, you must be careful."
"Alright, I will be. You kids go and play nicely, I'm going to talk to Mom for a bit."
"Go on, go over there and play."
He heard Han Xuewei shooing the children away.
"Are you really just there playing with water by the mountain? Why don't I believe you?"
"There are some things I need to do, but I can't explain them all to you in a word or two right now. I'll explain everything to you properly once I'm back."
"Tell me, are you planning to take risks and go into the mountain?"
Han Xuewei seemed to have hit the nail on the head.
After all these years, she knew him very well.
"No, what mountain am I going into?"
"You're lying to me. I'm telling you, I checked a lot of information today, and there are legends about Xi Lian Mountain. They say that the mountain has become a scenic area, but deep inside the mountain, there are many precious medicinal herbs that no one has gotten for many years. And you, coincidentally, come from that industry, so I think your aim is the medicinal herbs."
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi indeed paused for a moment.
This woman was too smart; she had deduced his real purpose just from the information she had found on the internet.
But at this moment, he still couldn't admit any of it.
"Precious medicinal herbs? I'm telling you, I've known there are herbs in the mountain for a long time, but I'm not targeting them. Don't forget that I can't engage in the related medical industry right now."
"So what are you doing there?"

chapters.title: Chapter 428 Extracting Information
chapters.content:
"I came here to discuss something else; you needn't worry yourself with wild guesses. Look at me, aren't I perfectly fine? If it were unsafe, how could I possibly be staying in such a comfortable room?"
"When will you be coming back?"
"If everything goes smoothly, I guess I'll be back in two or three days, and then we'll see how things stand." Read exclusive adventures at My Virtual Library Empire
"Oh, okay, I got it."
"Right, and unless it's something urgent, don't call me these next couple of days. The signal here is sometimes erratic. It's fine in the hotel so I can take calls, but once I leave, I'll lose connection. There's Xi Lian Mountain nearby, which seriously blocks the signals. If there's anything, I'll get in touch with you."
"Fine, I understand. Just be careful and stay safe."
"Okay, I will. If there's nothing else, you and the child should rest early. That's all for now."
After finishing, he hurriedly hung up the phone.
He let out a long sigh. Lin Yi had truly experienced this woman's keen sense of observation.
And he knew that some things just couldn't be discussed any further. Talking too much would surely arouse suspicion.
Just now, he had nearly spilled all his affairs.
Unexpectedly, right after hanging up, he saw that Li Jingwen was calling again.
"Hello, what's up?"
"What are you doing? Who were you calling just now? I've been trying to call, but I couldn't get through at all."
"I was just discussing some other matters; go ahead, what's up?"
"Discussing other matters? Were you checking in with your wife?"
"Haha, stop it, what do you need?"
"Where are you right now?"
"Didn't I tell you? I'm on a business trip out of town. I should be able to return in a few days."
"Oh, I see. Today, I even went to ask around near the People's Hospital. Turns out, she indeed seems to have quit her job."
"Right, would I lie to you? I went over first thing in the morning the other day to inquire, and indeed, someone had deleted the records."
"Whoever this person is, they seem quite formidable, and they must have sensed my movements by now. Think about it, are there any major players in that area?"
"How would I know? Every day I just focus on selling and manufacturing drugs; how could I possibly be aware of such things? I'm not involved with the underworld."
"Oh, I see."
Li Jingwen seemed genuinely disappointed upon hearing this.
She had intended to get some information out of him, but it looked like he couldn't provide much help.
"Aside from that, have you found out anything else? Look, I'm free right now, tell me, and I'll help you analyze it."
"I also found out she has a mother. She's been living with her mother for years, and they're quite dependent on each other. Seems like her mother has been chronically ill."
"Not bad, you've managed to dig up quite a bit so quickly."
"Of course, do you need to ask about our efficiency?"
"Now that you know this, you should be able to find her home address, right? Why not go there directly?"
"Of course, we went there, but after knocking for ages, there was no one home. I heard from the neighbors that they left early in the morning with a lot of bags, not sure where they went."
Upon saying this, Lin Yi frowned in frustration.
Their actions were indeed much faster than he had anticipated.
They had so quickly found Liu Yao's home, and now this; bringing them over was more correct than ever.
"Could it be they already left the city?"
"That's precisely what I'm worried about. If they've left the city, then continuing my search is pointless. But it's strange to me, why leave in such a hurry?"
"That, I don't know. Maybe it was the man with her who helped her leave. Maybe he realized you were investigating him."
"It's terrifying. We had just left and our moves were all behind-the-scenes, yet he already sensed it. He must have significant power."
"Now you're like a kite with its string cut. What do you plan to do next?"
"I don't know. If this is the case, then I'll just have to keep searching thoroughly here and see if I can find this woman. If I really can't, then I might have to give up for the time being."
For some reason, when he mentioned giving up temporarily, Lin Yi felt somewhat relieved.
After all, there was still much he had to do, and hiding like this wasn't truly a solution.
Yet, he believed that once he returned to the city with Liu Yao, these people would quickly catch on.
He truly didn't know how to handle it then.
They already had her photo, and all they needed was to match it; after all, one can't change their appearance.
Even if you change your address, your lifestyle, or even your environment, you can't change your face.
"Why are you guys so anxious to find that person? Is she really so important to you?"
"I don't know, to be honest. She's not that important to me. I really don't want to focus on this right now."
"If she's not important to you, who is she important to then? Did someone ask you to do this?"
"Oh come on, don't ask so much about my business. How are things with you?"
"Oh, nothing, I'm doing well over here."
"That's good. We'll talk more when you arrive."
"Right, if you really can't find her, just wait for me. I'll think of something once I get back; after all, I've lived in that city for many years."
"Okay, I understand. For now, I'll just stall a bit there. Finding her like finding a needle in a haystack is so hard."

chapters.title: Chapter 429: 429: Great Fury
chapters.content:
Chapter 429: Chapter 429: Great Fury
“Alright, let’s leave it at that for now. If there’s anything else, we can get in touch later. Oh, and for the next few days, my signal might be bad, so if it’s not urgent, don’t contact me. After I’m out, I’ll get in touch with you proactively.”
“Okay, I got it.”
After that, the other party hung up the phone.
At this time, Lin Yi seemed to have fallen into deep thought.
These people were fierce in their approach, and he knew that continuing to hide was not a solution.
He had to strike back as soon as possible and make them give up looking for him. Only by doing so could he ensure his own safety.
But the key question was how to dispel their intentions?
Could it be that he had to expose himself?
Yes, to expose himself voluntarily.
Suddenly, he thought of this.
He believed it was all because the silver-haired old man was looking for him, and frankly, Li Jingwen had no interest in that mysterious man.
If he appeared on his own again, he could guess the real purpose of the old man’s desire to see him.
Forget it, now that he was already out, he could no longer let anything in this city disturb him.
He could only be single-minded, constantly moving forward, and only by doing so could he achieve his ultimate goal.
The truth was, the call from Li Jingwen was just to vent her frustration.
Because at this moment, Li Jingwen had already arrived at the hotel lobby and had not yet entered her room.
She knew that after returning, the first thing would definitely be to report to Grandpa Bai.
Grandpa Bai needed to know what she did every day.
This was something she disliked the most.
It was also to kill time, hoping to drag it out a bit longer. By then, if Grandpa Bai was indeed resting, she could smoothly escape today’s trouble.
She glanced at the clock and didn’t get up to head upstairs until 9:00 PM.
When she reached Grandpa Bai’s room, she took a deep breath and then pressed the doorbell.
She hoped for silence after ringing the bell so she could naturally return to her room and properly end the day.
But, unfortunately, the sound she hoped for did not occur.
“Just swipe the card and come in, I haven’t slept yet.”
By the sound of his voice, it seemed he had been waiting for her.
Li Jingwen wore a troubled look, really unsure how to explain the situation to him.
In the end, she pushed open the door and walked in.
She saw Grandpa Bai sitting on the sofa with an incense burner in front of him, wisps of Qing Yan gently swaying in the air.
“Grandpa Bai.”
She walked over respectfully and stood in front of Grandpa Bai.
“How was it, did things go smoothly today?”
“It was alright, the construction site negotiations have mostly been settled, and the workers can move in smoothly in the Later Stages,” she replied.
“Good, and what about the company’s office preparations?”
“I’ve been looking for a location all day, but I haven’t found any suitable places yet, so I guess it’ll take another two days,” she answered.
“Choosing a location needs careful consideration. Since that’s the case, I’ll be patient. After all, we don’t have that many employees right now.”
“Grandpa Bai, there’s one more thing.”
“Speak, what is it?”
Initially, he had considered hiding the news temporarily.
But Li Jingwen felt that if Grandpa Bai knew she had already grasped everything, her outcome would likely be even worse in the end.
“Today I found out that woman has already left the city.”
“What did you say?”
Grandpa Bai seemed somewhat in disbelief as he frowned and looked at her.
“I said, it seems that woman has already left the city.”
“Is this information accurate?”
“Accurate. She left this morning with her mother, carrying their belongings.”
Without another word, Grandpa Bai stood up angrily, then reached out his hand and struck his own face with force.
The slap made her feel somewhat dizzy.
Li Jingwen stumbled backward involuntarily and ended up holding her cheek with her hand.
She felt wronged.
But there was nothing she could do; Grandpa Bai was just that kind of person. When he truly became angry, no one could stop him.
“How do you handle things?” he demanded.
“I… I really didn’t,” she replied.
“Didn’t? If you didn’t, then how could she have left so hastily? You must have alerted her with your actions.”
“Grandpa Bai, I’ve been very careful, and I handle everything with utmost caution.”
“Useless, I really don’t see the point in having you around. All these years at my side, and you can’t manage such a small matter?”
She didn’t dare argue any further because if she did, her end would certainly be miserable.
“I’m telling you, you must find this woman by any means necessary, even if you have to search every inch. No, you don’t have to look for the woman, but you have to find that man for me.”
“That man?”
“Yes, that man. He was in the lobby that day, and his image was captured. If you can follow this lead, I believe the case will be much simpler.”
“But with just his appearance to go on, isn’t this still like looking for a needle in a haystack?”
“I don’t care how you do it, but you must find him for me. I don’t need to hear anything else.”
“Okay, I got it, Grandpa Bai. Is there anything else you need?”
“No, get back to your room.”
That sentence felt like a reprieve to Li Jingwen.
She felt she didn’t want to stay any longer with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 430: 430: A Good Medicine
chapters.content:
Chapter 430: Chapter 430: A Good Medicine
At this point, for her to be able to leave here smoothly was already a stroke of luck.
She hurried back to her room in haste.
After entering the room, she stood behind the door, gasping for air.
She went into the bathroom and checked her reflection to find that her right cheek had started to swell and redden.
Li Jingwen carefully took out some ointment and gently rubbed it onto her face.
These items were essentials and she would never be without them.
Because you never knew when Bai Ye might suddenly lose his temper, and by then, it would be unstoppable.
Bai Ye’s unpredictability and fiery temper had been quietly endured by Li Jingwen over the years.
For Li Jingwen, there was never a suitable opportunity.
If there had been even a slight chance, she would never have resigned herself to be under that old man’s thumb.
After coming out of the bathroom, Li Jingwen went back to her room.
She took out the mysterious box once more and caressed it in her hands, over and over.
The item was like a panacea which seemed to truly have a healing effect on her.
But if she actually took this step,
The consequences might be unimaginable.
Every time it came to this, to be honest, Li Jingwen was very worried.
Having struggled abroad for so many years, she did have some connections, but they were still weak.
And the old man had been toiling overseas for nearly 50 years; consider the difference between someone with 5 years and someone with 50 years of experience—how immense would it be?
Reason once again triumphed over impulse, and she carefully put the medicine back.
For Li Jingwen, today was destined to be a sleepless night.
She even began to miss the happy times she had spent with Lin Yi.
But unfortunately, back then she had only chased after fame and fortune, leaving Lin Yi alone in the city, resolute and changed.
Thinking back now, it indeed felt impulsive and she also had many regrets.
But what could such reflections change now?
After all, Lin Yi now had his own life, and to him, she was nothing more than a stranger.
Wang Sheng had been busy in the toy factory the whole day.
Today’s work had progressed quite smoothly; with him personally supervising, the foundation work was indeed very solid.
When he left the factory, he glanced in that direction.
He noticed the lights were still on in the office area.
This indicated that Manager Zhang and Zhou Kongshan, along with a few others, were probably still there.
No matter how busy they were, what did it matter to him? He had no connection to it.
Right now, his sole focus was to build those houses well, as it was the core of the core.
After leaving the factory, Wang Sheng checked the time and, before he knew it, it was already 10 PM.
He wondered where Han Xuemei was at this moment—was she not resting and waiting for him?
Curious, Wang Sheng took out his phone and called her directly.
However, all he heard was the busy signal.
What was going on? Wang Sheng frowned.
Given Han Xuemei’s current situation, there shouldn’t be anyone in the city initiating contact with her.
After 10 minutes, he called again, but the line was still busy.
Could it really be that something is going on?
I had planned to go back and rest well today, after all, I’ve been tired all day.
But I just couldn’t stop worrying about Han Xuemei, so I drove my car straight to the house in the suburbs.
Standing outside, I could see from afar that the lights were on inside,
proving that Han Xuemei was still at home at this moment.
But if she was at home, who could she have been on the phone with for so long?
I checked the time, and it had been a whole 40 minutes since I had called her.
I took out my phone and dialed again, but the busy signal was exactly the same.
A whole 40 minutes or even longer, who could this call be with?
I took out my keys and then entered the villa.
Afterward, I went straight to the room on the second floor.
Just as I arrived at the door, I could hear someone inside speaking in a hushed tone, as if they were constantly saying something.
But the soundproofing in the room was too good, so standing at the door I couldn’t hear anything,
Luckily, I pushed the door open directly.
At this moment, Han Xue was wearing a nightgown, lounging on the couch.
She had a facial mask on her face, and she was holding a cell phone in her hand.
When she saw me enter, it was obvious that Han Xue looked somewhat flustered.
“Oh, OK, I have something here, I’ll talk to you about it later.”
While she was speaking, Han Xue hurriedly hung up the phone.
“You, weren’t you not coming back tonight?”
“I’ve been calling you, look at how many missed calls you have.”
As I spoke, my tone was somewhat unhappy.
“Really, you called?”
She asked curiously while taking her phone, only to discover that there indeed were three missed calls, and the total time span exceeded 40 minutes.
“I’ve been busy, and the call just kept going on.”
“I’m asking you, who were you on the phone with?”
“With him.”
“Him? Which him?”
“Who else could it be? Zhao Guangchen.”
“What? Zhao Guangchen? You, why are you in contact with him again?”
I certainly hadn’t expected this; after all, they had been together before.
And now, this Han Xue was supposed to belong to only me.
No matter what, her contacting that man behind my back made me feel uncomfortable.
“I’m doing it to pacify his mood. Besides, no one else’s words can get through to him right now. I fear that only what I say can really reach his heart,”
“40 minutes, that’s probably even longer, right?”
“Yes, it was a full hour and 20 minutes.”
“My goodness, an hour and 20 minutes. What on earth were you talking to him about?”
“Of course, I was discussing the subsequent arrangements and plans with him, and then I gave him some earnest advice. I can feel that Zhao Guangchen now trusts me completely.”

chapters.title: Chapter 431: 431: Getting Something for Nothing
chapters.content:
Chapter 431: Chapter 431: Getting Something for Nothing
“Really? How’s the progress over there now?”
Wang Sheng also had his doubts.
But with what he said, Wang Sheng couldn’t help but believe him.
After all, there was an old acquaintance between the two of them.
And between them, he felt almost like a third party, as if to them, he was the true intruder.
“He said that the progress is fairly good for now. A few days ago, he still felt sharp pain in his face, especially at night, it was a clear feeling, but these last couple of days should have been a lot better.”
“And the wound? Has it started to heal?”
“Not bad, he mentioned that some areas that were deteriorating are now beginning to heal slightly.”
“Good, that means the injections are starting to work.”
“Right, so based on that calculation, wouldn’t he be able to get out in about 10 to 15 days?”
“About that, I’d reckon it’s possible.”
“Then what about the company out there, are you prepared?”
“Not yet, but registering a company, isn’t that a piece of cake?”
“But what industry are you planning to enter?”
“What industry? Of course, it’d be construction.”
“Construction? Why choose that?”
“Have you forgotten? Right now, we can’t figure out exactly what Lin Yi is up to, so I’m going to start with his family business.”
“I get it, you mentioned this before, but his family’s business has been rooted here for so many years, can a new company really compete with them?”
“Heh, maybe not on the surface, but behind the scenes it’s possible. Plus, you know, I heard that his grandfather has already started to step back.”
“What? Stepping down?”
“Yeah, supposedly to enjoy a life surrounded by his grandchildren, so now, he doesn’t manage the company at all, it’s just a vice-president in charge.”
“Does that mean this vice-president is someone we can deal with?”
“It’s fifty-fifty. I don’t know much about the vice-president, but I think, if that sly old fox steps down, tackling the company should be much easier.”
“Moreover, don’t you think that after all these years of stability here, he would never imagine that a new company would target him? So perhaps the element of surprise is in our favor.”
“That’s a clever approach, but I still feel it’s best to arrange everything in advance.”
“Don’t worry, that won’t be a problem.”
“Besides, if you’re serious about this, you’ll need a substantial amount of funds. Are you prepared for that aspect?”
Han Xuemei spoke the truth.
The issues she mentioned were indeed the difficulties they would face next.
Wang Sheng had been consumed with changing this person’s appearance and establishing the company but had forgotten that after its establishment, they would likely need a substantial amount of money to keep it going.”
He frowned, then sat down beside the sofa.
Han Xuemei, understanding as ever, simply walked over and nestled into his arms, then began to gently massage his shoulders and neck.
“No worries, we’ll take it slowly. By the way, your grandfather should have some funds available, right?”
“Impossible, the old man certainly won’t give me such a substantial amount of money. Maybe a small amount for turnover might be viable, but a large injection of funds would require overcoming some troublesome hurdles.”
“So if that’s the case, do we have any options left?”
For some reason, when Han Xuemei heard his response, she felt a sudden wave of disappointment.
She should have held high hopes for this man.
But now, in the face of capital requirements, it seemed they were all at an impasse.
Although Han Xuemei did have some savings, that amount of money was a mere drop in the bucket compared to the needs of the business.
“I don’t know, let me think it through.”
“May I ask, if we are serious about this, roughly how much capital would we need?”
Han Xuemei had never been in business, but having been around Zhao Guangchen, she had learned a thing or two.
She knew that without at least ten million, they wouldn’t be able to solve anything.
Especially when they’re up against a local leading enterprise.
“I estimate, at the very least, it can’t be less than a hundred million.”
“My goodness, a hundred million?”
Upon saying this, Han Xuemei opened her eyes wide in shock.
She had thought that thirty to fifty million might be enough to get by for a while, but it had to be no less than a hundred million.
“Yes, there must be a hundred million. With a hundred million in hand, I believe we’ve already won half the battle.”
“But have you considered where you’re going to get this hundred million from?”
“Pulling a rabbit out of a hat.”
“Pulling a rabbit out of a hat? I don’t quite follow.”
“Never mind that, just leave this matter to me. I will find a way to gather the funds. It will take some time, but let’s first sort out the preliminary work.”
Wang Sheng said so with a long sigh.
Han Xuemei was very considerate and didn’t continue to inquire further.
If he had promised that he could gather a hundred million, she believed he must have some other plan.
After all, his grandfather was also a very capable person, and for the family, supporting over a billion wouldn’t be a big deal.
“So, are you leaving tonight?”
“I have to go back, and I’m concerned that after he leaves, he might arrange someone to monitor me. I must make an appearance at my residence.”
“Monitor you? Why would he want to monitor you?”
“The closer they monitor me, the more it means that the project I’m handling must be promising.”
“So you mean the construction project, right?”
“Yes, I’m convinced that Lin Yi is planning some major changes in that building, but I’m still not clear on what kind of challenge he intends to undertake.”
“Alright then, if you believe there’s no issue with it, then just go ahead with it. I will provide all the support you need from here.”
“Okay, I need to hurry back tonight. Once I get through these next few days, and after he returns, I’ll come over to see you again.”

chapters.title: Chapter 432: 432: Han Xuemei Changes Her Heart
chapters.content:
Chapter 432: Chapter 432: Han Xuemei Changes Her Heart
“Okay, I understand. Just be careful,” she said.
As she spoke, she stood up and then stretched out her arms.
It was obvious that all she wanted was a loving embrace.
Han Xuemei was honest with Wang Sheng; she really didn’t know whether her feelings for him were true or false.
But at this stage, she had no one to rely on, except for this man.
After they kissed goodbye, Wang Sheng quickly stood up and left the place.
He stood outside the window and looked down continuously.
It was only after she saw Wang Sheng’s car leave that she let out a long sigh of relief.
Then, Han Xuemei quickly took out her phone and dialed Zhao Guangchen’s number once again.
“He has left.”
“Does he come here every day these days?”
“Not really, sometimes he comes, but sometimes it could be three to five days before he visits again.”
“What about the thing I told you? Have you thought it over?”
“That’s a bit too much for you to ask, and right now, we must rely on him, including financially where we are lacking.”
“Don’t forget that I have a formula in my hands, and once this formula hits the market, it can be worth at least a hundred million.”
Han Xuemei was aware that Zhao Guangchen had a valuable formula in his possession, but she had never imagined him revealing its worth to her.
“You’re not joking with me, are you?”
“Why would I joke about this? I’m very clear about how much the formula is worth, and you know, when I left, I didn’t take anything with me except the formula.”
“The problem is, we’re at an impasse right now.”
“Yes, we are indeed at an impasse, but I will force him to steer us back on track step by step, and when the time comes, kick this man to the curb. Don’t you see that we will then have everything?”
“Let me think about it.”
“What’s there to think about? We’re already in cahoots, and do you really think Wang Sheng is sincere about you? He’s just a rich playboy who will kick you to the curb the moment he gets bored with you.”
At this point, Han Xuemei couldn’t help but feel the irony.
Some things might be acceptable coming from others.
But to have such words come from a betrayer like him, frankly, it felt mocking to her.
“I know what you’re thinking. Are you dwelling on our past? Let me tell you again, my love for you was real, but I had to do what I did because Wang Guixiang had too much leverage over me, do you understand?”
“Going round in circles, spinning around, and in the end, we end up together? I feel like I can’t accept this.”
“If you can’t accept it now, you’ll come to accept it over time. Moreover, I won’t be Zhao Guangchen anymore; I’ll reappear before you with a new identity, and nobody will be able to stop me. Xue Mei, just think about the days when you were with me. Have I ever let you down?”
Indeed, his words were true.
During the time Han Xuemei was with him, it could be said that whatever she asked for, he would do his best to fulfill.
However, after some incidents happened, their relationship gradually grew distant.
“Let’s put aside all this for now. Besides, it’s still too early, and I reckon it will take at least two or three more months to get back on track. I’ll make a decision then.”
“Alright, as long as you take this matter seriously and consider it, rest assured I will fully cooperate with you, and these past two days, I have indeed seen some results.”
“Good, that’s good to hear. Okay then, it’s getting late, and I need to hurry up and sleep. If he calls again and finds the phone still engaged, I worry he might start suspecting something.”
“Don’t worry, there’s nothing to suspect. Besides, he knows that everything now is for the progress of his affairs. Moreover, I must appear to disregard his advice but must listen to you. Only through this will he realize how important your role is.”
“Okay, I got it. Let’s leave it at that for now.”
For some reason, at this moment, Han Xuemei felt her mind was in a whirl.
She had never expected this man to take the initiative to reconcile with her and even requested to get back together.
This was the news she had just received tonight.
Her initial reaction had been to reject him, but after hearing his reasoning, it seemed to her that what Zhao Guangchen had said made sense.
Perhaps Wang Sheng was just using her temporarily, but once she outlived her usefulness, what would Wang Sheng do then?
She simply couldn’t bear to think about it, and she dared not think about it.
Lin Yi felt groggy, alternating between waking and sleeping repeatedly.
When he once again picked up his phone, it was already past 3 A.M.
It wouldn’t do; their agreed time was 4 A.M., so he couldn’t sleep any longer—if he did, there’s no telling until when he might oversleep.
He quickly jumped out of bed and once more checked over the items he had prepared to take with him.
At 3:40 A.M., Lin Yi left the room on time.
Just after stepping out, he immediately saw Ling’er and Lang waiting for him.
“You guys, why so early?”
“Haha, we hardly slept all night, and we’ve been anxious about any unexpected changes to the plan.”
“What changes could there be? Things have already reached this point. Are all your equipment prepared?”
He did look truly black.
At this time, Hei Lang was carrying a bag on his back that really was enormous.
And just by looking at the bag, it seemed to weight at least around 80 pounds.
Moreover, he was also carrying a large suitcase in his hand.
This was all the equipment they had used over the past few days.
If they truly aimed for success, then these items were an indispensable part of their plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 433: 433 Departure
chapters.content:
Chapter 433: Chapter 433 Departure
“Don’t worry, I checked it over and over again last night, and there basically shouldn’t be any problems.”
“Alright, then let’s set out now. From here to that plaza, it should take us about 10 minutes to arrive.”
Both of them nodded, and then they followed him and left from here.
At this time, it wasn’t even dawn yet.
Even the moon and the stars were still visible.
However, it must be said that the air here is still very fresh.
Although it does feel a bit cold.
Just after coming out, Lin Yi felt a gust of wind blowing over, and it was the kind of bone-chilling cold wind.
Yesterday afternoon it hadn’t been so cold, it seems, just as the hunter had said, the temperature difference here between morning and evening is indeed very large.
“Did you both bring the clothes to fend off the cold?”
He turned around and then spoke to the two of them.
“Don’t worry, everything’s ready, I’m even wearing a down jacket.”
“Good, that’s good.”
He nodded, but still felt as if something had been left undone.
Lin Yi’s mind kept on this thought as they now arrived at the plaza.
There was absolutely no one on the plaza, and no shadow of anyone could be seen.
“Big brother, what’s going on?”
Hei Lang quietly moved forward, then checked the time—it was exactly 3:55.
He wanted to say, why hadn’t the hunter arrived yet; if they were supposed to leave on time at 4 AM, he should have arrived here a few minutes earlier, at the very least.
Only then would he feel that this person was somewhat reliable.
“No worries, let’s wait a bit more patiently, we haven’t reached the agreed time yet, have we?”
“Big brother, this guy wouldn’t deceive us, right? Also, we gave him so much money yesterday; if he fled from here overnight with his wife and children, where would we even begin to look for him?”
This had been Hei Lang’s worry the entire night yesterday.
He had mentioned this issue to Ling’er, and to be honest, Ling’er also felt that giving all the money to him was indeed an impulsive move.
“I’m telling you, don’t measure my gentleman’s stomach with your petty heart.”
Just then, a voice suddenly floated over.
They quickly turned their heads to look and, unexpectedly, a shadowy figure emerged from the corner.
He carried a long object on his back. Although it was too dark to see clearly, they could guess that it was probably the hunting rifle he was carrying.
Besides this, there was a satchel by his side, and what was inside that no one could tell.
“Hehe, sorry about that, I just didn’t see you, and they were making irresponsible remarks here, right? When did you arrive?”
“I’ve been here since 3:30, and I took the time to observe the weather, the stars, and today’s wind direction. I feel that we should take a detour into the mountains today.”
“What do you mean?”
“What I mean is, the previously planned mountain path we thought to take, I’m afraid we can no longer use it, because heading in that direction would lead us into severe weather.”
“What? Severe weather? Then what should we do?”
“It’s okay, there’s another way we can go. Just follow me when the time comes.”
“Oh, right, I haven’t mentioned it yet, but I have a map here, which I obtained through much difficulty.”
Only at this moment did he take out this precious map and then handed it over to the hunter.
After hesitating for a moment, the hunter accepted it with some uncertainty.
The mountains were always unpredictable; how could a map of it even exist?
The hunter opened the flashlight, unfolded the map, and took a glance.
The details could be said to be very clear, even specifying the exact locations of swamps, their directions, and the range of their size—everything was annotated.
“Where did you get this from?”
“That’s not something you need to worry about. What I want to know is, can it be of any use?”
“Of course, it can. Combined with the map in my head and this paper map, I tell you, we shouldn’t take any wrong turns on this trip.”
“Good, that’s a relief.”
This assurance was like a soothing pill for Lin Yi.
He had been worried that they would keep wandering around, unable to find their way out of these mountains.
Now, with a guide and this map, the matter seemed all but settled.
The group walked for roughly half an hour.
Gradually, they came upon a deserted grassland.
Looking back, the town had fallen into the distance and even into darkness, making its existence practically invisible.
“Once we cross this grassland, and then move forward, we’ll be able to reach the foot of the mountain.”
“This grassland?”
Seeing this, Lin Yi hesitated.
The grassland seemed overgrown; the grass was at least as tall as a person.
He truly didn’t know what might be lurking within.
If there was something hidden that suddenly attacked, their mobility and their ability to defend themselves would be compromised.
“Don’t worry, even if there is something in there, it should just be small inevitable animals, and I can handle them. Come here.”
As he spoke, he waved and finally took out a torch from his bag.
It was a common torch that Lin Ye had seen before.
However, what surprised him was that the torch’s head was wrapped with cloth, and the cloth was coated with a layer of light green powder.
Then, using a lighter, he swiftly ignited the torch.
They could see a wisp of Qing Yan smoke rising from the head of the torch.
At the same time, he smelled a kind of stimulating scent—indescribable.
“What is this?”
“It’s for driving away game. With it, snakes and small animals won’t even dare to approach, so we need it to lead us to the base of the mountain.”
“So with this thing, does it mean we can keep going with it all the way?”

chapters.title: Chapter 434: 434: The Fierce Beast Detector
chapters.content:
Chapter 434: Chapter 434: The Fierce Beast Detector
“No, you’re wrong. He can only replace some trivial things. However, when it comes to large prey, they pose no threat at all in this place. Therefore, when we light the torches later, we’ll only attract the attention of those game animals.”
Upon a careful analysis, it seems that what he said indeed made sense.
After all, Lin Yi was not a professional, and he was not very familiar with these things; hence, he only needed to listen to the arrangement and follow accordingly.
They had been walking for about fifteen minutes, and during this time, they really didn’t encounter any danger.
Yet, he occasionally noticed something that seemed to be crawling in the grass not far from him.
The wild grass kept swaying endlessly.
But he remained silent, aware that there must be something lurking nearby.
It was because of the very torch he had mentioned that these predators didn’t dare to approach carelessly.
Finally, they managed to walk out of that area of thick weeds without incident.
He saw that ahead it was pitch-dark, and he could see that the forest ahead was becoming denser.
“Is this Xi Lian Mountain?”
As he spoke, he took two steps back.
Lin Yi looked up and saw, indeed, before him towered the imposing Xi Lian Mountain.
The peaks within were rugged and appeared extremely perilous.
Standing outside, he could smell a faint stench wafting from within.
There were even some cries, but Lin Yi couldn’t discern what creature they belonged to.
“That’s right, this is Xi Lian Mountain. We’ll officially enter the mountain if we follow this path and walk deeper. What do you think? Can you smell it here?”
“I can detect it. It smells like the rot of a carcass, I guess.”
“Correct. That smell is always present here, and as we move deeper, it will become more pronounced. You all should be careful then.”
“Alright, let’s get ready.”
Having said that, he turned to look at Hei Lang.
Hei Lang then quickly took off his backpack and pulled out some black boxes, which he then distributed to each person’s hands.
“What is this?”
The hunter obviously hadn’t seen such an item before.
It appeared to be just a square box, but one could hear some kind of activity inside.
The more carefully one listened, the fainter the sound seemed to become.
“This is a high-intensity emitter, capable of mimicking the frequency spectrum audible to common animals. With this, we will be able to detect the presence of large game animals within a radius of 2 kilometers from us.”
“Really? Is it truly that remarkable?”
The hunter had always lived in the town and thus had never encountered such high-tech devices.
This device certainly seemed a revelation to him.
“Yes, it’s that amazing. How about it? I told you, with our equipment complete, we’re basically safe from harm.”
“Heh, it sounds nice, but I’m not sure if this device will prove truly useful at a critical moment. By the way, have you used it before?”
“This…”
Lin Yi did hesitate.
Apparently, this question was really unanswerable.
He hadn’t actually used it before, and this device was something he’d only seen praised in online reviews; indeed, it was the top-selling brand.
But whether or not it could provide a deterrent effect was another question altogether.
“What’s the matter, you haven’t used it before, have you? Come on, let me see what else you have in your bag.”
He suddenly took a keen interest in the contents of the backpack.
It probably contained an array of high-tech electronic devices, including some modern wilderness survival tools.
Hei Lang hesitated briefly, then looked up at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi nodded, after all, they were now comrades-in-arms, and it was acceptable to know what was in each other’s backpacks.
Afterward, Hei Lang went through the items in his bag with them, giving them a rough introduction to each item.
In any case, the hunter listened with a bewildered fascination, his eyes wide open with wonder.
“My God, I really didn’t realize that people have progressed to this extent.”
“Yeah, that’s why, with these high-tech gadgets arming us, we shouldn’t encounter any problems.”
“I hope so.”
“By the way, after looking at so many things in my bag, and not to mention, your own bag has been kept mysteriously heavy. I don’t know what you brought.”
“Mine? Even if I take mine out, you definitely won’t recognize it. It includes traditional repellents for mosquitoes and insects and even some for warding off violent beasts. So, it’s pointless for me to introduce it to you. When it’s time to use it, you’ll know,” the hunter maintained a mysterious air, yet Hei Lang didn’t show much interest in those things.
“Well then, shall we set off now?”
“Yes. Take these devices, and let’s head into the mountain right away.”
As they spoke, they started walking toward the heart of the mountain.
Perhaps it was psychological, but as Lin Yi approached the edge of the forest, he felt a shiver run down his spine.
Was it because of the cold weather?
No, he felt that his winter gear should have been thick enough.
Yet he still felt the cold seeping into his very bones.
By this time, it was almost 5:00 AM.
The sky outside was starting to brighten faintly.
He saw the hunter quickening his pace.
“Why? Why are we walking so fast?”
“I’ve already told you, around 6 o’clock, a toxic mist is likely to emerge. If that happens, we won’t be able to get out once it’s released.”
“Okay, got it. You two hurry up and keep up.”
He waved at the two people behind him, then continued walking deeper into the wilderness.
He didn’t know how long they had walked, but even Lin Yi started to feel his ankles aching from the strain.
After all, this was different from walking on a flat road; this area also had stones to step on and many uneven, pit-filled paths.

chapters.title: Chapter 435: 435: Ling'er Sprains Her Ankle
chapters.content:
Chapter 435: Chapter 435: Ling’er Sprains Her Ankle
“Oh no, help!”
Just then, suddenly, a scream came from behind.
In fact, one could guess with eyes closed that the person should be Ling’er.
Originally, Ling’er was a kind of fragile person, and, at this time, if one really had to walk this kind of path, then probably, a girl wouldn’t be able to persist for too long.
“What happened to you?”
“I, just now, I think I stepped on a rock, my, my foot, my foot is twisted.”
“What? Your foot is twisted?”
After the hunter came over, he only asked one question.
He had thought that women should not be allowed into the mountains, and moreover, once women entered the mountains, they would really slow down their pace.
“I said it, didn’t I? This woman is simply not suited, and look, we’ve barely started, we haven’t even reached 1/5 of the way. Further in, the paths will become even more difficult to navigate, even requiring some support to get through. I don’t know if you can really keep up or not.”
“Don’t worry, I can persist, I will definitely persist.”
As Ling’er spoke, she clenched her teeth and then, enduring the pain, stood up from the ground.
“I remember, you’ve got a walking stick with you, right?”
Lin Yi suddenly turned around and then said to Hei Lang.
“Oh, yes, brought it, brought it.”
While speaking, Hei Lang went over to retrieve a trekking pole and handed it to Lin Yi.
“Ling’er, how are you feeling, can you keep going?”
“Don’t worry, I can keep going, it’s much better with this thing.”
“Good, then can we continue now?”
“Let’s go, don’t let me hold everyone back.”
Although she was saying this, after all, she had hurt her foot, and they couldn’t possibly just leave Ling’er behind alone.
So, the pace of the entire team immediately slowed down.
Not knowing how long they had walked, suddenly they saw the hunter stop.
“Bad news, the thing I was worried about has still happened.”
He kept muttering to himself, and his facial expression seemed somewhat panicked.
“What is it, what’s wrong?”
“I’ve said it before, if we can’t continue walking out of here before 6 o’clock, then we’ll definitely be trapped in Xi Lian Mountain. Look at the time now, it’s already 5:55.”
As he spoke, he took out his watch to check the time.
Indeed, they were being held up because of Ling’er, but that didn’t result in any complaints towards another person.
Being a fragile woman herself, the fact that she could forcibly follow them into the mountain was already quite remarkable.
“No matter, we’ll confront the problem when it comes, for now, we can only wait for this noxious vapor to dissipate. Otherwise, I’ll carry you, and we’ll just speed up.”
“Let me tell you, as we accelerate, our breathing rate will also increase, and when our breathing quickens, we’ll inhale a lot of this gas, and then we will all start to hallucinate.”
“What, there can be hallucinations?”
He hadn’t even heard of such things before, but they were now being earnestly spoken of by the hunter.
“That’s right, hallucinations do occur, and moreover, since you’ve never experienced it, you don’t know how powerful this miasma can be.”
“Then, what do we do now?”
“The only thing we can do now is to try to breathe in less of this miasma and, moreover, wait until it passes before we proceed again. Ah, look there, is that a cave?”
As he spoke, he pointed in that direction.
Vaguely, Lin Yi saw that there indeed seemed to be an opening, but it wasn’t very large—if a person were to crawl through, they could barely manage to fit.
“Hmm, if I hide inside, it should be somewhat safer, right?”
No sooner had he finished speaking than the alarm suddenly started beeping.
Picking up the alarm, he gave it a puzzled look.
“Hei Lang, what’s happening?”
He turned around and asked Hei Lang.
Hei Lang shook his head slightly, then took the alarm and advanced a couple of steps forward only to find the sound growing stronger.
When he walked back, he noticed the sound getting weaker again.
“Big brother, if I’m not mistaken, the direction we just came from, the cave, there’s probably a wild beast inside.”
“What, a wild beast?”
Lin Yi felt that troubles really came in waves.
“Actually, without this detector, I just roughly surveyed the area, including the direction of that cave entrance, its orientation, and the vegetation around it—I deduce there’s likely a beast’s den, and inside, the number is definitely no less than two.”
“So, you’re saying that we can’t go inside, right?”
“If we don’t go inside, staying out here is just as deadly.”
“What? Still a dead end?”
“Didn’t I tell you? We simply cannot breathe it in large amounts, do you have one of those anti-poison masks? It could solve the problem.”
“I didn’t prepare for that, and I also lack experience in this regard.”
“Then there’s nothing more to say, we have no choice but to take a risk and move forward. Let’s head to the cave, it’s better than being poisoned to death out here.”
Judging by his suggestion, this miasma must be an extremely potent substance—even though Lin Yi had never encountered it before.
But he chose to trust the hunter, after all, he had extensive experience with prey.
He quickly approached the direction of the cave entrance.
Upon arriving there, he could distinctly feel a breeze blowing out from the cave entrance.
Oddly, however, the breeze was not at all cold; in fact, when blowing on his body, it felt quite warm.
“Why is it a hot wind?”
“Yeah, under such circumstances, it’s 100% certain there’s something inside. They must be living in a direction exposed to the wind, so the perpetually damp environment has caused this hot wind.”
“Do we still need to go inside?”
“Do you smell anything in the air now?”
“I do, there’s a sour scent.”
“That’s it, that’s the miasma. Remember, remember, never take deep breaths and try to talk as little as possible. Let’s go, into the cave.”
While talking, he took out the torch again and this time added a green powder to it before placing it on the burning end of the torch.

chapters.title: Chapter 436: 436 First Encounter with a Ferocious Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 436: Chapter 436 First Encounter with a Ferocious Beast
The hunter simply bent down and then, holding the torch, took the lead and crawled in.
“Big brother, what, what should we do?”
Hei Lang hesitated somewhat.
They had already said that there were definitely prey inside, but still, they resolutely crawled in.
Wouldn’t this be equivalent to them willingly walking to their deaths?
“Didn’t you hear what he said just now? If we stay outside, we’re just as dead. It’s better to go in and come up with a strategy. Maybe those beasts won’t even come near us?”
“It seems we have no other choice.”
Without hesitation, Hei Lang then dragged his own pack and directly squeezed into the cave entrance.
In an instant, all four of them had entered.
In front of him, he saw a very large cavern, and at that moment, he could clearly hear what sounded like the dripping of water.
“There’s a water source here, and I believe if we keep going upwards, there will be an underground river. If we follow this direction, we might even find another exit.”
The hunters quickly made an accurate assessment of the environment.
“You haven’t been inside this cave before, have you?”
“I used to take the detour path around the other side and never came this way, so I’m not very familiar with this cave, but I estimate that it must be at least 200 to even 300 square meters in size.”
“Hmm, I can feel it, even when we speak, the sound seems hollow, and there’s even some echo.”
“We’ll now follow the direction of the water flow and go that way.”
While talking, the hunter also pricked up his ears, listening attentively here.
“Oh, it’s over here.”
He quickly determined the direction.
Then the group quickly got to their feet and walked towards that place.
With a torch held in front, he could basically illuminate their surrounding environment.
He saw the area around was all bare rock, including the ground they were stepping on, which was also all stone.
After walking forward for a distance, suddenly, he saw several lights flickering straight ahead.
“What is that?”
“I’ve already said that there are fierce beasts inside, and if I’m not wrong, that should be their eyes.”
“What? Eyes?”
Lin Yi’s eyes widened in surprise.
He felt that those eyes were at least the size of apples.
Typically, beasts don’t have such large eyes.
This gives an idea of just how massive the creature must be.
Afterward, the group slowly came to a halt, leaning their bodies against a slab of stone.
Though there were no shelters here, leaning against the stone felt as comforting as swallowing a sedative pill.
“What do we do now?”
“Don’t you have some tools with you?”
“The environment nearby is complex, and the distance is considerable. Besides, there’s a warm air flow here, so I can’t shoot directly.”
Although Lin Yi didn’t quite understand what he meant, he assumed it was feasible since it was being suggested.
“Hei Lang, what tools do you have?”
“Oh, I have this.”
While talking, Hei Lang pulled something out of his bag that resembled a bow and arrow.
He felt that the arrowhead was extremely sharp, and if it really could penetrate him, it might be effective.
“Big brother, this one is fitted with an infrared night vision device. We just need to turn it on, and we can basically lock onto their exact position.”
“Good, if that’s the case, it seems this is the only thing we can use. By the way, does the arrowhead contain a tranquilizer?”
“Don’t worry, each one is armed with a tranquilizer, and even if they don’t kill them, they’ll drop right here.”
This had been specifically instructed to him by Lin Yi previously.
Because only by doing so would they feel doubly assured and at ease.
“You guys, what is this? And is this a bow and arrow? If it really is, I’m afraid it will have no effect whatsoever.”
The hunter beside them was obviously unfamiliar with this device.
He had seen basic bows and arrows before, but this seemed somewhat different.
Uncertain of what it was, he could only try to describe it that way.
“Oh, this is nothing like the bow and arrow you’re thinking of. Its penetration is extremely strong. If the penetration of an old-fashioned bow and arrow could reach 100 jin, then this one can exceed 1000 jin.”
“What? One thousand jin? Such enormous power?”
He was surprised to learn that such powerful devices existed outside.
Though it couldn’t rival his bullets, such penetration power was already incredibly strong.
“Because it’s an electronic launching device, it’s nothing like the bow and arrows pulled by hand, so, rest assured about this one.”
“I was saying, the hides of these beasts are extremely thick, and under normal circumstances, regular arrows wouldn’t even scratch them.”
“Yes, I understand that, which is why this bow and arrow is specially customized. Don’t worry, there will be no problems.”
“But from such a distance?”
Now, that was what he was grappling with.
The surrounding environment was so dim, he could only use the brightness of the beast’s eyes to determine its rough direction.
Yet, in that distance, what unpredictable factors could occur was completely unknown.
“Hmm, didn’t you see that there is a display screen on it?”
Lin Yi held the bow and arrow and then gestured in front of him.
“Hmm, I saw it, but what does it mean?”
“Come, let me turn it on for you, and you will see what it means.”
After speaking, Lin Yi simply pressed a switch on it, and quickly, the pitch-black screen began showing a black and white image.
Especially, he could clearly see two very large beasts directly in front of him.
He could make out their general outlines, but the hunter found it strange that there were some red things on the screen that seemed to be pulsating.
“What, what is that?”

chapters.title: Chapter 437: 437: Lin Yi is poisoned
chapters.content:
Chapter 437: Chapter 437: Lin Yi is poisoned
“Did you see it? This red thing here, this is its heart location, and what’s more, it’s detected by body heat, so it’s actually quite accurate.”
“Holy cow, this, this is amazing, with this thing, we’re practically invincible.”
“That’s why I wanted to show you the real power of this device today, Hei Lang, let me handle it.”
As he spoke, Lin Yi reached out his hand.
He had dealt with such gadgets before.
Therefore, he had control over how to operate it.
And finally, Lin Yi held it in his hand.
He simply aimed for the heart location of one of the beasts and then pressed the launch button.
The launch was incredibly fast, and they could hear a sound like a screech in the air.
Following that, they heard a dreadful scream from that direction.
In the end, everyone felt as if the whole mountain shook with the sensation of an earthquake.
He quickly picked up the scope again and looked over, he saw that one of them had fallen, but the other had disappeared without a trace.
Subsequently, he held the scope in his hand, searching around, but couldn’t catch a glimpse of the other beast.
“Damn it.”
He muttered under his breath.
Just now, he was too busy showing off and hadn’t anticipated such a strong reaction from the other beast.
“Quick, everyone be on alert, and if you spot any prey approaching from that direction, let me know immediately.”
After he finished speaking, the group huddled tightly together and began searching the area.
Normally, his eyes should light up, so if a light appeared nearby, he would be able to see it.
After all, the cave environment was rather dim, so even with a torch, it wouldn’t affect the brightness of the light.
“Nothing on my side.”
Hei Lang was first to report.
“I don’t have anything on my side either.”
“Same here, nothing.”
“Right, my direction is clear too.”
As they spoke, he nodded, confirming that all four directions were clear and that the prey hadn’t appeared.
However, this presented a great danger to them.
