The beast could leap out from the darkness at any moment, and with such a massive creature against their group of four, it would be incredibly easy for it.
“We’ve already taken down one of the animals, and if I’m guessing right, it was a pair, one male and one female. I don’t know about the other, but if it’s a male, its desire for revenge must be very strong, so we absolutely shouldn’t linger here long, we need to get away quickly.”
The hunter led them on as he spoke, continuing forward.
Following the river’s flow, they moved on, and although the path became rugged, they felt as if danger was receding step by step.
If they went any further, the path would become even narrower.
Hei Lang stood guard at the rear, with his back to them.
He was always alert, fearing that prey could attack suddenly. In that case, a quick press of the button should suffice to take down the brute.
“Look, there really is a river.”
On reaching the front, they crossed the path and indeed saw a small river.
Although the river was narrow, it seemed to have a very fast flow.
He looked in the direction pointed by his hand; the river was right before them, apparently flowing in from another direction.
“Do you mean we should continue upstream?”
“Yes, we must go upstream because the further up we go, the more it proves we are deep within Xi Lian Mountain. Otherwise, heading downstream will only take us further away.”
“Alright, since you have experience in this area, you lead the way. In your estimate, how long might this stream be?”
“Well, that’s hard to say. With these mountain streams, sometimes they can stretch for nearly several kilometers, but some, I’m afraid, are only a few hundred meters short. It’s really up to luck.”
As they talked, they continued walking forward.
Just then, as they followed the river upstream, Lin Yi suddenly stopped.
He looked down and saw that the water here was incredibly clear.
Moreover, as he walked here, the chill emitted from the water seemed to penetrate directly into his ankles.
He subconsciously reached out his hand and touched it.
The water was indeed ice-cold.
“What are you doing?”
Suddenly, the hunter seemed to realize something and turned back to look.
“It’s nothing, I just wanted to see how cold the water is.”
“Are you crazy?”
“What’s the matter?”
Lin Yi was just curious.
All he did was squat down to touch the river water. What’s so crazy about that?
“Do you know that these secluded mountain streams can be mixed with a large amount of poison, and by sticking your hand in there, you could very well be allowing poison to enter your body?”
“What? Poison?”
This was something Lin Yi had never considered.
It seemed to him like a tall tale.
“I… I didn’t hear you wrong, did I?”
“You heard me right. Quick, stretch out your hand.”
As he spoke, he quickly grabbed Lin Yi’s hands that had been soaking in the river.
Then, he lifted the torch and took a look.
The hunter saw that Lin Yi’s four fingertips that had been submerged were beginning to show some swelling.
“See that?”
He pointed to the spot on his hand and then explained to Lin Yi.
Only then did Lin Yi notice.
He gasped in shock, not expecting that just a brief contact would lead to this condition.
“Give me your torch, let me use it.”
Lin Yi extended his other hand and snatched the torch.
He bent down and held the torch over the river.
He clearly saw that, while the river was crystal clear, it was now visibly green.
“What is this?”
He turned back and looked at Ling’er.
Ling’er didn’t speak. In fact, she had been observing the river water all along.

chapters.title: Chapter 438: 438: Has the Heavenly Eye Failed?
chapters.content:
Chapter 438: Chapter 438: Has the Heavenly Eye Failed?
“Actually, when I first came in, I smelled a special scent, and I’ve been trying to figure out where exactly it’s coming from. Now, I finally understand.”
“You mean, the scent is coming from this stream?”
“Yes, it’s emanating from this river water. And judging by what you’ve just come into contact with and the current state of things, I suspect that you, you have been poisoned with Seven-Star Toxicity.”
“What? Seven-Star Toxicity?”
“Put simply, Seven-Star Toxicity is caused by a plant called Seven-Star Grass. This plant usually grows above rivers, soaking in the water for prolonged periods. The longer it soaks, the more poison is washed down by the water, and the entire river becomes poisonous.”
“So, what do we do now?”
“Fortunately, I have some medicinal herbs on me that can provide you temporary relief.”
“What, temporary?”
“Yes, the effect of these herbs will last for about six hours at most. But, if we can’t find an antidote within six hours, then this hand of yours can be considered completely useless.”
Ling’er spoke seriously, her expression stern and seemingly no joke.
Lin Yi felt his heart clench.
Just one touch had caused this severe reaction. If he had actually ingested the water, he’d probably be dead by now.
“What kind of antidote do we need?”
“A herb called Cat Spirit Grass. It’s a very precious medicinal herb. I’ve only read about it in books before, and I hope that we can find it here.”
“Alright, then let’s not waste any time and get moving.”
After Ling’er’s bandaging, she had tightly bound the area around his veins.
In this way, the poison could be effectively prevented from spreading through the bloodstream throughout the body, which would otherwise lead to death by poisoning.
Since someone had already been poisoned, their pace naturally quickened.
Ling’er’s ankle was already swollen and red, but even so, she continued to endure the pain and followed closely behind the others.
“Quick, dodge to the side!”
Suddenly, they heard Hei Lang shout loudly.
Since Hei Lang was always facing away from them, now, he must have spotted some danger.
Immediately after, they heard a loud roar.
Lin Yi instinctively pulled Ling’er, and with his other hand, he grabbed the hunter and retreated a couple of steps backward,
When they turned around, they saw Hei Lang act decisively, pressing the electronic button with a swift movement.
Suddenly, there was a scream, and the prey fell to the ground.
After seeing this, Lin Yi finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Since entering, there had been two ferocious beasts inside this cave, and now, they had eliminated them both.
That meant that for the time being, the cave should be relatively safe.
“Hei Lang, how is it, is it dead?”
“Big brother, don’t rush it, let me go and check,”
“I understand, but you have to be really careful, got it?”
“Don’t worry, I’ve now used this Life Detector and it seems he should no longer show any signs of life.”
Upon hearing these words, Lin Yi’s heart finally settled down.
The Life Detector was a highly precise instrument; if it couldn’t detect life, then there generally wouldn’t be any more life signs.
“Big brother, rest assured, it’s completely dead, my god, what, what is this thing, is it a bear?”
Hei Lang had never seen such a creature before.
Although it appeared furry like a big bear, he felt that it looked even more ferocious than a bear.
It was hard to define exactly what kind of hybrid it was.
However, these animals lived in the mountains all year round, and it was normal for some of them to undergo mutations.
“Forget it, stop looking at that thing. I reckon, the deeper we go, the more creatures we’ll encounter, so let’s not waste any more time.”
“Okay, big brother, are you alright?”
“No, I feel a bit numb and tingly in my whole arm. Ling’er, what’s going on?”
After he asked this, he suddenly paused.
“This, this isn’t right, is it?”
He supposedly had the Heavenly Eye, and just by opening it, he ought to clearly see everything including his own bones and blood flow.
Why did he see nothing today?
He rubbed his eyes hard, then continued to look at his fingers.
Other than the black wounds wrapped in bandages, he saw nothing.
“Heaven, could it be malfunctioning?”
He was puzzled.
“Are you okay?”
“Yeah, it’s nothing, let’s go. We should hurry and leave this cave. The poison should have dissipated by now, right?”
After saying this, the hunter simply raised his wristwatch to check the time, using the faint light of the torch.
“No, it’ll take at least half an hour more for the poison to fully dissipate, so if we go out now, we’ll still be trapped there.”
“Well, then, it looks like we can only resign ourselves to our fate.”
Having said this, he casually leaned against the wall and sat down.
Since they had already dealt with the two monsters, he believed there should be no further danger inside the cave.
“This won’t do, big brother, aren’t we just sitting ducks? No, I must go out, damn the poison! I’ll just run out there, find the medicine you need, won’t that solve everything?”
Hei Lang had always had an impulsive character.
And especially when Lin Yi was in danger, he would disregard his own life to save him.
“Nonsense, do you realize if we encounter real danger outside, who will come to save you? It’s already trouble for Ling’er to take care of just me, do you want to cause more trouble?”
“Big brother, but…?”
“But what? Didn’t I tell you the medicinal effect can last a full six hours? It’s barely been half an hour since it started, so there’s no need to worry. Rest assured.”

chapters.title: Chapter 439: 439 Successfully Finding the Exit
chapters.content:
Chapter 439: Chapter 439 Successfully Finding the Exit
Having said this, he did not continue any further.
He knew Lin Yi was just that kind of person; at this moment, he would rather bear the risk himself than let his brothers face such danger.
Several people then sat down around him.
“Ah, right, let’s check the map to see if this cave is marked on it,” someone said.
Suddenly, Lin Yi thought of this.
Since that hunter had no recollection of this cave, they could only rely on the map.
It was as if the hunter also suddenly remembered; he spread out the map again and placed it in front of everyone.
“Hmm, look, we should have come up this way just now. After coming up, there is a jungle here, and in this direction—ah, no, it’s not marked here.”
“I feel like we didn’t go very far inside, right? Could it be that we went too deep and the marked location is just all wrong?”
“Impossible, it absolutely cannot be wrong. Moreover, the situation is clear now; this place must have not been present before. Also, I want to ask, how old is this map?”
“It should have been drawn 10 years ago, but it could be older, that I can’t be sure of.”
“10 years ago? Do you know how much can change in 10 years? And before, there was an earthquake in these mountains.”
“What did you say? An earthquake?”
“Yes, we all knew when the earthquake happened. We even hoped that if it really was an earthquake, this whole area would become ruins, and all the ferocious beasts would be crushed inside. But unfortunately, our wish wasn’t fulfilled.”
“Are you suggesting that after the earthquake, things like the terrain might have slightly changed?”
“Some changes might have taken place, or sudden new features could have appeared, or some things could have disappeared, but overall, the layout shouldn’t have changed that drastically.”
Listening to the hunter’s explanation, Lin Yi nodded as if he understood, but he didn’t really grasp it.
In fact, he didn’t have many thoughts on the matter; his goal was one: to quickly enter deeper into the mountain and find what he sought. With that, his mission would be considered a great success.
Finally, after some discussion, the hunter stood up from the ground.
“Okay, if we go by the time of day, the mist should dissipate. If the sun can shine down, the miasma will surely not exist.”
The group, seeing hope, felt a slight relief at that moment.
They followed the hunter’s steps and once again began to move upstream along the river.
After some time to recover, Ling’er felt her feet gradually ease.
About 20 minutes later, they saw a sliver of light shining in from up ahead.
“Look, there’s really an exit here!”
The hunter excitedly turned back and told them.
Everyone hurried forward and looked up.
There was a hole above them, and it was definitely big enough for a person to get through.
But given the height, it would be indeed difficult to climb out from here.
“Hei Lang, do you have any tools?”
“Big brother, I did bring some, but the key issue is?”
“No worries, I’ll handle this job. Trust me, I’ll make sure you get out safely.”
As he spoke, the hunter took out a thick hemp rope from his bag.
To those used to professional climbing equipment, it indeed looked rather rough.
One end of his rope had a small iron hook, seemingly specially crafted.
“What do you mean?”
Seeing all this, Lin Yi gradually understood and knew what the hunter was planning to do next.
“That’s right, the area should be surrounded by trees. I just need to throw this up there. Once it wraps around a tree, that should give me enough opportunity to climb up.”
“But isn’t that a bit too risky?”
“Not at all; don’t worry, I have experience. Now, all of you stand back a bit, I’ll take care of the rest.”
Lin Yi nodded and then led the other two people to take a few steps back.
He watched the man tie one end around his waist, then flick his wrist in a small circular motion, and swiftly, he threw the rope towards the hole.
After it was thrown, he quickly tugged on it.
But the rope quickly fell back into the cave again.
This proved that his throw hadn’t been accurate.
Undaunted, he continued to blindly seek something reliable to latch onto.
Finally, after who knows how many attempts, he found something solid—it must have caught onto something.
“Good, there shouldn’t be any problem now. You guys wait here. I’ll go up first and check out the surroundings. Afterwards, I’ll pull you up.”
“Okay, buddy, be extra careful.”
For some reason, Lin Yi suddenly felt the hunter’s presence was making a real difference to their endeavor.
Anyway, the hunter moved quite agilely.
Despite some swaying in mid-air, with the help of his arms, he easily climbed out through the hole.
“How are things up there?”
“All good for now. It’s still safe. Just give me a moment to secure the rope again, and then you guys should come up quickly.”
“Why don’t you use mine? Mine is stronger.”
Hei Lang stepped forward, eager to help.
But Lin Yi immediately pulled him back.
“Let me tell you, some modern tools are just not as handy as the old traditional ones, especially in this environment. Your equipment wouldn’t be very effective here, got it?”
“Oh, okay, big brother, I got it.”
Hei Lang just stuck out his tongue and quickly stowed his gear back into his pack.

chapters.title: Chapter 440: 440: The Antidote in the Swamp
chapters.content:
Chapter 440: Chapter 440: The Antidote in the Swamp
With the power of a large tree outside and the hunter’s own skills, they were able to safely rescue everyone from the cave.
At this moment, they indeed found themselves in a jungle.
Moreover, if they were to go higher, it seemed that they could reach the peak over there.
The sun was already beaming through the leaves, shining down.
Now, the whole jungle felt relatively quiet.
However, they were very aware that some things were deeply hidden.
Now it seemed like a peaceful environment, but perhaps the next moment, they could encounter some kind of danger.
“Let me take a look at your wound.”
After Ling’er came over, she pulled Lin Yi aside and carefully checked the place she had hastily bandaged before.
The swelling had gradually subsided, but it had turned a black color.
“What’s going on, why did it change color?”
“It’s because the poison stayed here too long, so it slowly enters your muscles, and over time, it accumulates and turns this black color.”
“Is there any antidote later on?”
“Once we find that Cat Spirit Grass, your hand can still be saved.”
“Cat Spirit Grass, Cat Spirit Grass.”
“I remember this grass should grow in dark and also damp places.”
“Dark and damp? Could we be near a water source or perhaps near a swamp?”
“I’ve read in books before that failing to find abdominal muscles is indeed a very good choice. Right, where’s the map?”
“Oh, right here.”
While talking, the hunter took out the map again.
They spread the map on the ground, and Hei Lang naturally took on the duty of keeping watch.
“Do you see? We came up from this cave, and if we go around this circuit, we should be about here.”
The hunter identified an approximate location based on his sense of direction.
But whether this specific location could be reached none of them knew.
Lin Yi nodded.
He actually had quite a lot of trust in the hunter’s sense of direction.
To be honest, ever since coming in, Lin Yi felt a bit lost.
North, south, east, and west, he still hadn’t figured them out.
His past experience in wilderness survival must have been completely forgotten by now.
Even standing here, the dense foliage blocked everything tightly, making it impracticable to determine direction using the sun.
“Hey, big brother, I suddenly remembered, like you guys who work year-round at these posts, what do you rely on to discern direction?”
“Haha, isn’t that simple? Moreover, there are things all over the ground that can show the way, look at that tree.”
“The tree, what’s with the tree?”
He looked at the tree the hunter was pointing at and asked inquisitively.
“Just look at the tree’s growth rings and its appearance, and you can estimate the current orientation.”
“You can tell the direction from this big tree?”
Lin Yi, listening, couldn’t help feeling this was all rather far-fetched.
So, he quickly walked over and circled the tree thoroughly.
But in his view, it was just an ordinary big tree—nothing else unusual about it.
He really didn’t understand how these people could use the tree to figure out the direction.
“Alright, stop wasting your time there. I’m telling you, without several years of experience, you can’t make heads or tails of it. Even if I explained it now, you wouldn’t understand, get it?”
“Heh, okay, I understand. Looks like that is your wealth of experience, right?”
“It’s not just the trees, including the big rocks on the ground. Do you see? The moss on those rocks can also guide us in the right direction, so we don’t need to look at the sun in the sky. That means even on a cloudy or rainy day, you can easily find the correct direction.”
“What? These rocks, the rocks can tell direction? Oh dear, what you’re saying now is all Greek to me; anyway, it doesn’t have much to do with me, so I won’t think about it anymore.”
“So, regarding the matter of direction, naturally, I’m in control. You just need to tell me the next step, what place do we go to, and do we keep going that way or what?”
“Big brother, we can’t delay any further, and as I mentioned just now, I must find the Cat Spirit Grass.”
Ling’er stepped forward and then spoke to the hunter.
“So, you mean to say, other matters can be put on hold for now, and finding the Cat Spirit Grass is the most important task at hand?”
“Exactly, that’s what I mean. And his poisoned wound cannot be delayed any longer; the medicine I gave him earlier won’t last very long.”
“Okay, I understand. Just now I roughly mentioned to you, talking about a dark and damp environment, I tell you, in these deep mountains, if you are really talking about dark and damp, I guess it’s everywhere.”
“No, I need the darkest, dampest place.”
“You mean the swamp?”
“Swamp?”
Upon hearing this, Ling’er’s eyes widened in surprise.
“Yes, only under the conditions you described do swamps indeed meet the requirements.”
“Swamps, are swamps born of the Yin element?”
“Exactly, only swamps are born of the Yin element, and there should be a water source nearby.”
“Alright then, let’s head to the swamp.”
“But, you see…”
The hunter hesitated upon hearing this.
Clearly, the swamp was very dangerous for them.
If it wasn’t for the need to search for the item, it’s likely they would choose to skirt around the swamp and leave from this side.
“I know what you want to say, is it danger? Just tell me the general direction, and then you can stop when we get there. At that point, it will be my responsibility to search for the Cat Spirit Grass.”
“How can that be okay? Let’s just take one step at a time. Come on, if we’re going to the swamp, follow me; we’ll go up the mountain from this direction.”
With that, the hunter pointed straight ahead.
Lin Yi turned back, looked at the direction, and nodded in trust.

chapters.title: Chapter 441: 441: Strike While the Iron is Hot
chapters.content:
Chapter 441: Chapter 441: Strike While the Iron is Hot
“Hei Lang, check all the equipment, and also, do you have gear for the Swamp?”
“This, big brother…”
At this point, Hei Lang seemed suddenly at a loss.
He had anticipated various road conditions before, including some very complex situations.
But the one thing he hadn’t considered was the Swamp.
“Alright, alright, enough of that, let’s go. We’ll talk about it when we get there. Maybe we won’t need to get close to the Swamp to find these things?”
With these words, everyone nodded, and after that, they finally followed the hunter and headed deeper into the area.
Sure enough, the path they chose now was relatively smooth.
Although there were some uneven spots along the way, on the whole, they didn’t encounter any significant dangers.
After about an hour of hard travel, Lin Yi already felt as if he couldn’t keep up physically.
He turned his head to look at Ling’er; if he was struggling with his strength, how would Ling’er, just a girl, cope with all this?
Sure enough, he saw that Ling’er’s face was somewhat pale, and her breathing was noticeably labored as she walked.
“Big brother, can we stop for a bit? I really can’t keep up,” she said
As she spoke, she ran up to the front where the hunter was.
But when he thought about it, the hunter still seemed quite energetic, his expression unfazed and his heart steady.
“What did I tell you? Your physical strength is a burden, and we haven’t been walking for long. Are you already unable to persist?”
“You know we usually travel by car and rarely go hiking, and we’ve been trudging for over an hour now.”
“No wonder. Alright, then let’s take a brief rest, but we absolutely can’t rest for too long—ten minutes at most.”
“Okay, okay, ten minutes it is,” she agreed.
The thought of even a single minute of rest was welcome, not to mention ten minutes.
And everybody was well aware that right now they might be able to take a short break.
But if it were to get late, then resting for even an extra minute could invite danger.
“I’ll make it clear to you now, we’re not leaving this place today. So no matter how late it gets, no matter what happens, and no matter how tired you are, we must keep going. If we stop, danger could come at any moment.”
Sure enough, just after thinking about it, the hunter immediately shared this with them.
“Okay, I got it. And I’ve brought plenty of tents, so we should be able to set them up without a problem.”
“We’ll see how it goes. If we find a suitable place, we may be able to use the tents. But with the current conditions, putting up tents here would be like walking into a trap. Got it?”
As he spoke, the hunter looked nervously around the environment.
Lin Yi looked up and around; although there were trees all around, it was clear that setting up a tent here would make the place very conspicuous.
He nodded silently. In this complex wilderness, he had to be cautious and careful.
Fortunately, he felt that his decision to bring someone very familiar with the environment was very wise; otherwise, they might have found it very difficult to navigate this place.
“Alright, I’m good to go. Let’s hurry up. Big brother, how much longer will it take?”
Ling’er knew that she probably had the least endurance of anyone there, so as soon as she felt it was about time, she quickly stood up and spoke to the hunter proactively.
“Hold on, let me check the map. Hm, we’re at this spot right now, and then if we circle around this mountain range… right, behind these mountains, yes, here. It should take about 20 more minutes to get there.”
“Twenty minutes? Then let’s make one push and head straight there. You mean beyond that range, right?”
“Yes, didn’t I tell you? The hardest environment of the Swamp, and moreover, it thrives in shade.”
Lin Yi nodded and they all got to their feet and resumed their tough journey.
Hei Lang, on the other hand, was used to exercising regularly, and honestly, such a distance wasn’t much for him at all.
Overall, he felt relaxed, especially since he was also carrying a large bag on his back, the weight of which no one knew.
Finally, they saw a very peculiar hill in front of them, the landscape rolling and undulating, not looking very treacherous.
“Sigh, this place. Now we’ll go around from the side over there to its back, then we should reach the Swamp,” he explained.
“Do I feel a dampness on me right now?”
“Yes, we’re approaching a water source now, including the Swamp, which is why the air around here is humid,” the hunter confirmed.
While talking, they continued following the guide, circling from the other side of that hill, passing straight through.
“This… this doesn’t look like a Swamp. Have we gone the wrong way?”
After turning around, what he saw was simply an expanse of grassland.
Lin Yi thought they had taken a wrong turn. If that were the case, wouldn’t this hour and a half of travel have been a complete waste?
As he spoke, he walked forward, but at that moment, the hunter suddenly reached out and pulled him back.
At that moment, Lin Yi had already extended one leg. If he hadn’t been pulled back in time, he would have likely stepped onto that grassland.
“What is it, big brother? Is there a problem?”
He noticed that the hunter had pulled him back very forcefully,
making it clear that the hunter had sensed some danger.
So Lin Yi tensed up and looked ahead.
Beyond the grassland, he saw no signs of an unusual environment, which should have meant the area was safe. So why was he being so cautious?
“Are you all clueless? What you see is not grassland; it’s the Swamp.”

chapters.title: Chapter 442: 442: Finding the Antidote
chapters.content:
Chapter 442: Chapter 442: Finding the Antidote
“What, what did you say? The Swamp? This, this can’t be true, right? The swamps I’ve seen on TV before never looked anything like this.”
The hunter sighed helplessly, and then he picked up a stone from beneath him, and finally, he tossed it onto the grassland ahead.
Soon, the stone vanished without a trace, and after bubbling twice, there was no more movement.
When Lin Yi saw all this, his eyes widened in surprise.
My God, thinking about it now, I really feel some regret.
If I hadn’t listened to the hunter’s advice at the time and had just gone straight in, I might really be in trouble now.
Afterward, the hunter adjusted his stance and then looked at him with a smile.
“Now you understand the risks here, right? You could say it’s full of traps everywhere.”
“But why, why does the Swamp look like this?”
“Because the terrain here is quite complex, so on the surface of the swamp, a lawn has appeared, which at first glance appears to have turned into a kind of moss—but in fact, what you see as grass is not grass at all.”
“Moss?”
“That’s right, you can take a look now, but remember, don’t reach in too deep or you might get sucked in completely.”
“Okay, I got it.”
After he finished speaking, Lin Yi simply nodded and then carefully leaned his body out, reached out, and gently took a bit from the top.
He felt it in his hand, and it was indeed very damp, and upon examining it closely, it was clear that it wasn’t grass.
It was just a layer of green, lush moss that, seen from a distance, looked like a patch of small grass.
“You’re right, if you hadn’t reminded me of this here, I really wouldn’t have noticed.”
“That’s why you must be extremely careful in this place, remember, don’t touch anything carelessly, got it?”
“Okay, I understand, so what now? What should we do?”
“I’ve found this place for you now, and I don’t know what that herb you’re talking about looks like. It’s up to you from here on.”
As he spoke, he turned his head to look at the young girl he had just conversed with.
Since arriving here, Ling’er had been silent and simply knelt at the edge, constantly observing.
“Ling’er, anything? Do you see it?”
He quickly turned his head back and spoke to Ling’er.
“Over there, that place, do you see it?”
While speaking, Ling’er stood up and then pointed toward the middle of the Swamp.
At that moment, Lin Yi could clearly see that in that spot there were a few things that seemed to be higher than the rest, and they looked like a kind of leaf, but upon closer inspection, they didn’t quite look like leaves but something yellow.
“I, I see it, you’re not telling me that thing is Cat Claw Grass, are you?”
“Yes, that’s Cat Claw Grass.”
“My God, this, isn’t this nonsense? And in that location.”
“Yes, right there. I told you before, it really likes this kind of moist environment, and it’s extremely pessimistic in that spot, right in the middle, seems like they really know how to choose.”
“Then, isn’t this absurd? How can we pick it from such a distance? Oh, I remember, there are ropes and hooks, I’m right, aren’t I?”
As he said this, he suddenly turned his head back to look at Hei Lang.
He remembered that Hei Lang had told him before that he was specially carrying this sort of equipment.
“That’s right, I brought them all, just wait a moment, big brother.”
Hei Lang said as he bent down and opened his backpack, from which he took out a piece of black equipment.
“Is this, is this the launching equipment?”
The hunter, seeing something novel once again, stepped forward curiously and asked.
“Yes, look here, there’s a scope, and you can just use the scope to see which spot to aim at. Press this switch, and the rope will fly straight over there. Then the hook will secure it tight.”
“My God, this, this is really too advanced, nice, this is really quite something.”
“No, you’d destroy the plant itself with these things, that’s not good at all.”
Ling’er suddenly said this, leaving everyone stunned.
“What? We just want that leaf, right? We just need to pull it over with the rope, isn’t that enough?”
“I need a whole, intact Cat Claw Grass, and I also need to take the roots and stems with it. The root and stem parts are also very important for using the plant as medicine, so none can be missing.”
“You, what are you saying? We need to pull it out by the roots? And there can’t be any damage?”
“In its root stem part, there’s a thin layer. That thin layer can be easily damaged. Once it is destroyed, the liquid inside will leak out, and once that happens, within a minute, the Cat Claw Grass will wither completely and will not have any effect at all.”
“There’s, there’s so much to consider with this?”
He had not expected this situation at all.
Moreover, what seemed like a very simple task to him—just using tools to catch the plant—turned out to be unexpectedly complicated.
“You’ve oversimplified things. If you do it your way, it won’t have any effect at all.”
“So, what do you suggest?”
“There’s only one way, fasten the rope to me and then I’ll swim over from here and preserve the plant with all my might, only that will do.”
“That’s impossible, it’s too risky for you to do that, if anyone goes, it should be me.”
Hei Lang was naturally the first to volunteer, standing up boldly.
Among those present, the strongest-bodied was probably Hei Lang.
His strength was indeed robust, but his weight was also very significant.
In this Swamp, he knew very well that the heavier one’s weight, the greater the chances of sinking.

chapters.title: Chapter 443: 443: Ling'er Takes Action
chapters.content:
Chapter 443: Chapter 443: Ling’er Takes Action
Even if these people try to pull someone ashore here, there’s no guarantee of safety.
“No, it’s too dangerous for you to do this,” he said.
“Dangerous? How? I’m sure I can handle it. Big brother, just relax; I’ll take care of this.”
“How much do you weigh?”
“I, I weigh 180.”
“Heh, you’re at 180, while I’m only 140. We differ by 40, so tell me, who is more suited for this task?”
“Big brother, this, this has nothing to do with weight, does it?”
“Of course, it does. If you’re heavier, you’ll sink faster. I’m right, aren’t I, old chap?”
With that, he turned to look at the hunter.
Upon hearing this, the hunter just nodded slightly.
“But to tell you the truth, no matter who goes down there, regardless of how light they are, even a very small leaf, once it goes down there, it might also sink into the Swamp. If that’s the case, I advise you all to think thrice before acting.”
“Think thrice before acting?”
“Right, given the situation, trying to retrieve that object from the middle of the Swamp is like a wild goose chase, so it’s best not to act rashly.”
“But if we don’t get that object, you’ll surely die this time; it is your only lifeline.”
Ling’er explained this point once more.
Honestly, Lin Yi certainly didn’t want to die. He hadn’t lived enough to leave his life behind here.
But under the shadow of failure, it seemed he had no better option.
“Enough, stop arguing; I’ll do it.”
“What? You’ll do it?”
When they heard what Ling’er said, they were all stunned and agape with surprise.
In the past, Hei Lang hadn’t interacted much with Ling’er, but he could feel that at this moment Ling’er was making a huge sacrifice.
She truly deserved to be called a heroine.
“Forget it, I can’t let all of you risk your lives because of me. If it’s not possible here, we’ll look elsewhere. Maybe we can find that object somewhere else?”
“Lin Yi, let me tell you, we don’t have much time left. In this current situation, if you go out to search again, you’ll probably waste a lot of time, and all that wasted time will consume your strength. Do you understand?”
“But…”
“No, I have a plan.”
“A plan? What plan do you have?”
“I’ve roughly estimated the Swamp’s overall width. It should be around 100 meters, right?”
“Yes, it’s 100 meters. And then what?”
“If it truly is 100 meters, then do you have a total of 100 meters of rope when all your ropes are combined?”
“That’s right. I’m asking you, do you have 100 meters?”
“That, don’t worry, when added up, there’s a total of 180 meters. I had already planned for this earlier.”
“Good, then if that’s the case, see that? There are big trees on the opposite side of the Swamp. Try to use your launcher to shoot the rope up there, then refix it on this side. You understand what I mean, right?”
“I get it; you’re suggesting we build something like a makeshift bridge here. Then one could pull on a rope and get close to that place, right?”
“Exactly, that’s the idea. That’s the safest and most appropriate course of action.”
“Old chap, do you think this will work?”
“It sounds like their plan has no issues, but I’m worried about whether doing so will bring other dangers.”
He could only seek the hunter’s opinion sitting beside him.
“When you get down to it, in principle, it should work, and indeed, it can be done. But the key issue is, I don’t know how well it will bear weight. And even if the rope is secured to the tree, I feel that if one person goes down, pulling on it like this, they’re bound to bob up and down.”
The hunter said this while picking up a rope and demonstrating, and indeed, everyone understood what he meant.
“No use delaying; under the circumstances, this is the only thing we can do, so I must do it myself.”
“What are you saying? Ling’er, how could I possibly let you take such a risk?”
“It’s not a matter of taking risks now. Let me ask you, just now you were talking to Hei Lang. Hei Lang is forty pounds heavier than you, but I am a full forty pounds lighter than you. So, my weight is the most appropriate.”
“Ling’er, it’s not okay.”
“Not just because of that; there’s another reason. Even if you were to go over, you wouldn’t know how to properly harvest it. If by your hand it gets destroyed, then even if you bring it back, it will be of no use to me. So, no one can replace me in doing this.”
This statement plunged Lin Yi into deep thought.
Indeed, when it came to knowledge about herbal medicine, he genuinely had none. So, he wasn’t sure if he could accomplish all this if he genuinely went over.
This was the concern that weighed on his heart.
“So, big brother, what do you think we should do about this?”
Hei Lang was also getting anxious. He thought this plan would probably ensure a certain level of safety, but now, it seemed there was no hope for that.
“Ling’er, are you sure?”
“If you delay any further, it might be completely over. It’s your life; the choice is yours, whether you live or die.”
“But Ling’er…”
“Alright, enough. Let’s move quickly. Are you confident you can shoot the rope over to the tree on the other side?”
“That shouldn’t be a problem. With the aid of this sight, it should be doable.”
“Then go ahead; fasten it to the tree right now. Afterward, secure it on both ends. Don’t worry, as long as it’s firmly fixed, I’m sure there won’t be a problem.”
At this point, it seemed they had no better option, so they could only proceed according to Ling’er’s plan.
And finally, Hei Lang started to work according to Ling’er’s instructions.

chapters.title: Chapter 444: 444 Brave Forward
chapters.content:
Chapter 444: Chapter 444 Brave Forward
Soon, a long rope was set up, and he gave a hard tug, sensing the tautness was probably adequate.
“Ling’er, can you really handle this?”
Up to this moment, Linyi’s heart was still suspended with worry. He was always concerned that Ling’er simply couldn’t cope with everything at this point, which would make things much more troublesome.
“Don’t worry, whether I can or can’t, I have to,” she said confidently.
“Here, Ling’er, put this on.”
While speaking, Hei Lang walked over and attached another device around Ling’er’s waist, providing an extra layer of safety insurance.
“Okay, I didn’t expect your equipment to be so complete. But with this setup, I think you all can feel reassured. If something unexpected happens to me, you can continue to pull me back and control my body, right?”
Ling’er said this jokingly while speaking with Lin Yi.
Although everything was ready and all preparations were in place, Lin Yi still felt a diligent concern.
Given the current situation, he couldn’t opt for anything better and could only continue down this path.
“Ling’er, be extra careful. If you notice anything wrong, hurry back, understood?”
“You don’t need to tell me that. I know what to do. Plus, I can’t just watch you disappear in front of me. The antidote is right before our eyes, so no matter the difficulties, I must overcome them and retrieve the antidote,” she declared.
These were Ling’er’s last words before leaving, and then her crystalline form grasped the rope and started to slide downwards.
At first, everything seemed to go smoothly; she was submerged in the swamp only up to mid-thigh.
“Ling’er, how are things feeling?”
“Not bad, the swamp is really cool, and my legs below feel numb, but it’s okay, I can handle it.”
“Pay attention to see if there’s any kind of downward pull?”
“Downward pull?”
Upon hearing the hunter’s reminder, Ling’er slightly frowned and then flexed her legs.
She found movement in the muddy swamp difficult, but the downward pull the hunter spoke of was not something she felt.
“No, it just feels like stepping in mud, and it’s really hard to move my legs. If it weren’t for my hands pulling on the rope, I probably couldn’t move at all.”
“Good, if there’s no pull, it’s somewhat safer. Just be careful,” the hunter said, relieved.
Lin Yi sensed an implication in the hunter’s words and was sure the man was hiding something.
“I want to ask, what exactly is this ‘downward pull’ you mentioned?”
“I’m worried that, over time, large vortices might form beneath the swamp, and once they do, the downward pull would be substantial.”
“Then, what would happen in such a case?”
“All these ropes above would simply not be enough to secure the entire swamp and it would get sucked into the vortex.”
“Why didn’t you say so earlier, when we first arrived?”
“It came to mind suddenly; I remembered during the slide that my grandfather once told me about a hunter from our village who encountered this situation and never made it out of the swamp.”
“It can’t be, it definitely won’t happen.”
“Yes, I hope not. I observed this swamp earlier and it seems rather calm. If there were any undercurrents, I believe I would’ve noticed them. Don’t worry.”
Although the hunter said this, Lin Yi couldn’t shake the feeling he was merely trying to soothe his own emotions.
But with no better option available, he was left without choice.
His heart hung suspended. He looked back at Hei Lang and noticed the burly 1.8-meter man also seemed confused.
Eventually, after about fifteen minutes, they saw Ling’er reach the edge.
And now, the “Cat’s Claw” herb was within easy reach for him.
“Ling’er, how are you doing?”
He shouted loudly towards her, and Ling’er turned her head, then gently waved at him.
Afterward, Ling’er used her method to place the two Cat’s Claw herbs into a special container.
“I’m all set here; you can start pulling me back now.”
Upon hearing this, Zhao Dong felt a surge of excitement.
This was perhaps the happiest news since they had entered the mountains. If they could really retrieve her successfully, then the initiative would be entirely in their hands.
They just needed Ling’er to cooperate mildly, and without much effort, she would likely reach the shore easily.
He and Hei Lang began to pull on the rope relentlessly.
They could definitely feel some resistance and realized that if it were just her body, it probably wouldn’t have been so strenuous.
This proved that the swamp below must be quite tranquil, exerting significant drag on her body.
As Ling’er steadily drew closer to them, their hearts swelled with excitement.
“Ling’er, just hold on a little longer, you’re almost there,” she said, wiping the sweat from her brow, trying to encourage Ling’er.
“Ah!”
Suddenly, they heard Ling’er shout out loud, and instantly, the motion stopped.
Right after that, everyone could clearly see Ling’er’s entire body starting to slide downwards.
“Ling’er, hurry, hurry up,” he cried out, unsure of what had happened, quickly turning to Hei Lang.

chapters.title: Chapter 445: 445: Returning from Gathering Herbs
chapters.content:
Chapter 445: Chapter 445: Returning from Gathering Herbs
At this time, the hunter had also joined their team, and the three of them were frantically pulling on the rope.
Ling’er’s body kept slowly sinking, and now it had reached her waist.
The boggy swamp that had covered just her knees before was clearly sinking more rapidly as not even a minute had passed.
“What, what’s going on?”
“Don’t know, can’t worry about that now, hurry, we need to act fast. If we don’t pull her back, she’ll be completely swallowed by the swamp. By then, even if we did manage to rescue her, it would be a dead end.”
The hunter seemed to have realized the gravity of the situation they were facing this time.
It was indeed somewhat different from what he had encountered before.
“Ling’er, don’t be scared, hold on.”
The group kept encouraging her nonstop.
Finally, Ling’er began drawing closer to them. By this time, the swamp had risen to her chest.
Now, they were less than 20 meters from the shore.
The three were almost exhausted, as the constant downward force combined with the resistance of the swamp itself made pulling an arduous task.
Ling’er was just clenching her teeth tightly, using the last bit of her strength in a desperate attempt to free herself.
Finally, just as the swamp reached up to her neck, they reached out, grabbed Ling’er by the hand, and pulled her whole body out of the mucky swamp.
Now, her entire body was covered in mud.
“Ling’er, are you, are you alright?”
Lin Yi noticed that Ling’er’s face was a bit pale.
Was it just the shock from the fear that had welled up, or was there indeed difficulty breathing inside the swamp?
After she got onto the shore, Ling’er began gasping for air in great heaves.
“I’m okay, just now inside, I nearly felt suffocated. If, if you had gone further in, I think I might have passed out.”
“As long as you’re okay, that’s good, that’s good. Now, what should we do?”
He turned around and then addressed the hunter standing behind him.
“Quick, like I told you before, there’s definitely a river nearby. We need to hurry and take her there to wash off whatever is covering her body. Furthermore, I have no idea if this stuff is poisonous.”
“Okay, where’s the river? Which way?”
The hunter surveyed the area, then quickly, they pinpointed a target.
“Yes, that direction, let’s move it.”
As they spoke, they carried Ling’er’s body and ran hectically toward that direction.
After running for a few minutes, they began to hear the distinct sound of flowing water.
It seemed the hunter’s judgement was sound; they had likely found the river’s source here.
True enough, after getting through a small thicket, they saw a small river with exceptionally clean water.
“Wait, this water, it’s not poisonous, is it?”
He recalled a previous situation when he had tried the river water and ended up getting poisoned; if the same thing happened now, wouldn’t that be a catastrophe?
“Don’t worry, this water is definitely safe. We must hurry and clean off the mud from her body.”
Talking while they worked, they retreated to the riverside and started washing the mud from her body with their hands and other tools they had at hand.
After a thorough 20-minute wash, she was clean again, but her body had started to shiver from the cold.
Ling’er shivered continuously, her lips turning somewhat pale.
“Quick, get a fire going, warm her up, or she’ll get sick.”
While speaking, the hunter frantically got a fire started, and soon enough, the flames were burning strongly.
It was at that moment, Lin Yi finally let out a long sigh of relief as he felt his body temperature return to normal.
“How are you feeling, Ling’er, better now? You don’t feel as cold anymore, right? Otherwise, we could find a sheltered spot to change your clothes.”
“No need, that would be too much hassle. With this fire here, I should dry off quickly. Right, I need to hurry and treat you.”
Ling’er had not forgotten about this matter, and despite the harrowing experience they’d just been through,
she also knew they had to move on from past events and that there were people waiting for her help.
She then carefully picked up the two cat’s claw herbs and held them in her hands.
If you looked closely, they seemed like ordinary plants albeit with a somewhat strange color.
“So, I just eat this straight away?”
“How can you eat it? This isn’t meant to be eaten. Do you remember the juice I told you about? The juice underneath needs to be drunk; you drink it and then I will pour the rest over, and afterward, we can place it in the wound.”
“Oh, I see, then what are you waiting for? Go ahead and do it.”
“Not yet, it hasn’t lost its freshness. We have to wait, uh, telling you all this, you wouldn’t understand. Now, we should wait about 15 minutes or so, then it’ll be ready to use. Meanwhile, I need to prepare the preliminary steps, so just wait patiently over there for now.”
Ling’er always preferred to work without disturbances, so she just pointed in a direction and then, along with Hei Lang and the hunter, sat down in a corner.
Now, he had to have a serious talk with the hunter about what exactly had happened.
“She had come and gone by the same path, so why didn’t anything happen on the way there, but on the return trip, this situation suddenly arose?”

chapters.title: Chapter 446: 446 Closing Reaction
chapters.content:
Chapter 446: Chapter 446 Closing Reaction
“Perhaps it’s a kind of closure reaction. Maybe, all these years, no one has ever experienced it inside this swamp, so it must have formed a sealed vacuum inside.”
“A sealed vacuum layer, which means that there are such things beneath us, right?”
“Exactly, that’s the idea, but you might not have noticed, at the front position of this isolation layer.”
As he spoke, he pointed in that direction.
“Hmm, I see it, what next?”
“Next is the fact that this place has shown signs of destroying the vacuum layer, and moreover, it could cause that enormous pulling force to suck things back in again. So, by the time they crossed this spot, they had already awakened them.”
“I get it, that must be the reason. But now that I think about it, I really had some thoughts. If we were a little slower in our actions, could she have fallen through here completely?”
“Yes, as long as her entire body, including her neck and everything below, were to sink further in, then basically there would be no place to dissipate it, because beneath, a vortex space has already started to form.”
It seems that a grave danger was indeed encountered, but there was no choice, since they had just gone through it, they felt there was no need to linger on it here. In the end, they still managed to escape this calamity successfully.
“I think we ought to avoid these swamps next. They seem far too dreadful.”
Lin Yi said, took a glance back, and then gestured with his hand.
The hunter seemed to understand his intention and subsequently pulled out the map again.
He roughly checked the swamps marked on the map. They were supposed to be recorded, but it was unclear whether this area belonged within their currently defined range.
“Older brother, can you check if this swamp is marked on there?”
The hunter hadn’t really looked at the map and just helplessly shook his head.
“What do you mean? Are you saying that this swamp isn’t marked on the map at all?”
“When I saw the swamp just now, I compared it with the map. The swamp shown here and its location are completely different, so this place must not have been charted.”
“So, to your knowledge, aside from this spot, are there many more swamps within Xi Lian Mountain that haven’t been discovered yet?”
“Yes, that’s right. Furthermore, the vast number of swamps are also very well hidden.”
“I’ve counted roughly on the map, and there should be a record.
It’s not just a few. Let me tell you, there must be many more, so we need to be extremely careful on the road ahead, and we must absolutely avoid getting close to this area, understood?”
“Don’t worry, after all we’ve experienced. But some things really are well hidden. If you hadn’t been so quick to pull me back just now, I might have been the one to fall in by now.”
“That’s why you can’t continue on this path, you have to stay close to them.”
“Okay, I got it. Which direction should we take next?”
“Do you see that? This area here completely blocks that way, we can’t get through. If we could get past here, I feel it would indeed be a very sharp weapon.”
“So if this route is impassable, do we have to backtrack and then take another direction?”
“Yes, that seems to be the case. Don’t hurry, let’s first treat your wound, but we must be prepared to spend the night in the wilderness. Looking at the situation, we can’t leave the mountains.”
While speaking, Lin Yi glanced upward. According to the sun’s position, it was clear that it was around 12 noon.
“Alright, I’m ready over here. Lin Yi, come here,”
Ling’er suddenly spoke. Lin Yi nodded and then quickly moved to her side.
Truth be told, Lin Yi was very nervous at this moment.
It wasn’t that he didn’t believe in Ling’er’s medical skills; he knew that for many years, she had been studying these medicinal herbs. Therefore, he understood that she should be clear about the medicinal effects and their applications.
However, it was his first time experiencing such special medicinal herbs in the deep, old forests, which made Lin Yi quite nervous.
He walked over and looked down to see that Ling’er had divided the medicine into two portions in front of her.
One portion was placed in one corner, while the other was set aside. From the outside, however, there didn’t seem to be any significant difference.
“Why do you need to divide it into two portions?”
“The medicinal effect of Cat’s Claw Herb is very potent. I can only try and see if one portion works. If one isn’t effective, we might have to use all of the medicine.”
“Are you saying that even if I take all of this medicine, it may not have a decisive effect?”
“No, it will definitely be effective. But as for the dosage, I am still exploring. Additionally, I can tell you that Cat’s Claw Herb is actually a poison.”
“What, what did you say? Cat’s Claw is a poison?”
Lin Yi truly hadn’t considered that. When he heard it, his eyes widened in surprise as if he couldn’t believe it.
“That’s right, it is indeed a poison. Normally, its medicinal effect requires special usage. If there isn’t anything else, this medicine would definitely not be used.”
“So that’s how it is. Then, could this medicine cause other side effects in me?”
“Don’t worry, you’re poisoned right now, and this poison can neutralize the toxins in your body. There’s a saying, ‘fight poison with poison,’ but I can’t guarantee the proper dosage.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi just smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 447: 447 Medicinal Effect
chapters.content:
Chapter 447: Chapter 447 Medicinal Effect
He just found it very interesting and had not expected that for such a long time, he had actually become a little white mouse in his hands.
But there was no choice; in the deep mountain forests, he had no better medical means, and also, he had always wondered about one thing: why, after coming here, did his system seem to have completely disappeared?
He wasn’t clear whether the system was just asleep or if it had suddenly left him.
If that were the case, all the effort he had put in, along with the many arrangements he had made, would mean nothing once he returned. Then, how would he explain himself?
Now, he couldn’t worry about that. Just as Ling’er had told him, at this moment, it was most important to preserve his own life.
He simply followed Ling’er’s instructions and then applied some of the herbs to the wound while placing the rest in his mouth.
He chewed lightly, but immediately, a bitter taste surged to his heart.
Pain seemed to twist Lin Yi’s features, which Ling’er naturally understood.
“I know this stuff must taste awful, but there is no other way,” she said. “Bitter medicine is good for your health, so even if it tastes bad, you have to bear with it and swallow.”
“But I was just thinking about something. If I eat it now, then, will it actually have any effect? And how long will the medicinal effect last?”
“Normally, within 10 minutes, it will surely take effect. Don’t worry, I will help you monitor this.”
“Can I, can I drink some water?”
“No, you absolutely cannot drink water with this medicinal effect. If you use water, it will produce a chemical agent inside that will neutralize some of the toxins, which means that the medicinal effect of the medicine will certainly not be achieved.”
“Okay, I understand.”
After hearing this, Lin Yi nodded vigorously because he did not dare doubt any of it.
Now, there was no way to question it all, and even if he did, nothing could be truly completed.
He wouldn’t trust anyone else at the moment; the only one he could trust was Ling’er, who was now his sole reliance.
Finally, Lin Yi swallowed everything, but the bitter taste still echoed in his mouth.
He really wanted to grab a canteen and gulp down some water to relieve this temporary agony.
However, Ling’er had made it very clear that he must not drink water, at least not within the first 15 minutes, and even if he wanted to drink, he must endure.
At this time, Lin Yi felt as if there was a warm current surging through his body, and a sensation of burning heat slowly began to rise.
“Why, why do I feel so hot?” he asked.
As he spoke, he looked up at Ling’er.
Ling’er furrowed her brows slightly and examined the wound carefully.
She noticed some black coloration starting to fade, which proved that the two toxins were beginning to neutralize each other in the body and that the combination process was bound to stimulate the human body.
Such high fever and temperature response were the most basic manifestation of this stimulation.
“Don’t worry, the area has started to shrink. See?” she said.
After hearing this, Lin Yi looked down and, indeed, the color that had been pitch-black before was now noticeably lighter.
He checked the time; less than 5 minutes had passed since he took the medicine, which meant the medicinal effect was already working in his body.
“It seems effective after all. So based on this, do I no longer need to take the rest of the medicine?”
Lin Yi didn’t want to eat any more, as the taste was unbearably awful and he had no wish to experience it a second time.
“Wait a bit and let’s see how it goes,” Ling’er suggested. “If it hasn’t completely receded, you’ll definitely need to take a second dose. But you won’t have to take as much as before. I’ll divide this into two portions. Later, taking just one should suffice.”
With that, Ling’er bent down and began to meticulously divide the herbs on the ground into two portions.
Lin Yi didn’t want to eat any of it, whether in one part or two. Even a mere mouthful was incredibly unpleasant for him.
Finally, he felt the feverish heat begin to subside.
“Hmm, I feel much better now,” he admitted.
Lin Yi immediately reported his true condition to the other person, who, after a brief consideration, nodded in satisfaction. She then carefully examined his arm.
“Do you see? The color is completely gone now, which proves that the ‘cat scratch herb’ has taken effect on your body,” she informed him.
“That’s great. Then, does that mean I don’t need to take a second dose of the medicine?”
“Based on the current situation, it shouldn’t be necessary. However, I will still store these carefully, just in case we come across a similar situation in the future. Then we can use it straight away, and you probably won’t find it as painful as this time,” she reassured.
“Alright, Ling’er, no matter what, you’ve done a tremendous job,” he praised. “Let’s see how you’ve made a complete recovery now.”
While speaking, he approached and began to show off the results, with Ling’er responding with just a nod and a smile.
It was the first time Lin Yi had truly experienced Ling’er’s Immortal Kung Fu. He had never imagined before that a delicate and frail woman could be capable of such proficiency.
“This lady, you truly are a rarity in this world. Plus, being so far away, just one glance allowed you to identify the nature of the herbs and apply them correctly to the wound. Honestly, this is exceedingly rare even in our village,” he marveled.
“Hehe, it was mostly a fluke. Also, I’ve read quite a lot before, so I’ve seen many things, and naturally, I came to understand the properties of these herbs,” Ling’er modestly replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 448: 448: Regroup and Prepare to Launch
chapters.content:
Chapter 448: Chapter 448: Regroup and Prepare to Launch
“Under normal circumstances, can the Cat’s Claw Herb actually be found in the wild anymore? Or rather, can it be purchased from somewhere?”
The hunter was now filled with curiosity about this herb, and moreover, having taken it immediately after being poisoned, it had such a great effect. If this were sold, it would likely be a truly good medicine.
If one day I really do come back here or encounter the same situation as Lin Yi, then I could use it for treatment.
“This thing cannot be bought in the open market. It can only be found in the deep forests and particularly damp and cold locations, which makes it extremely rare.”
“Then, if we were to sell it, could it fetch a high price?”
The hunter was truly preoccupied with money, which was vitally important for those living in the countryside.
They all understood that with money, they could do as they pleased; without it, they would be truly stuck. Even a modicum of basic life security might be unattainable without it.
“Let me tell you this, this one Cat’s Claw Herb, if it were available in the market, could easily sell for at least 10,000 yuan without any problem.”
“What, what did you say? This, this thing can sell for 10,000?”
He was simply too astonished, and for a hunter, such talk seemed like a complete fantasy.
To him, this was just an ordinary plant, yet now it could fetch such a high price, a concept he found hard to accept.
“Right, when I say 10,000, that’s the price when it can’t even be found in the market. If there were to be market inflation, its price could probably go even higher.”
“I see.”
After listening, the hunter just nodded, but his eyes seemed to linger on another Cat’s Claw Herb inside Ling’er’s backpack.
“Alright, our work here is nearly done, and it’s already the afternoon. Shouldn’t we move on? And if night falls early, shouldn’t we hasten our pace?”
At that moment, Lin Yi felt much lighter and believed they wouldn’t face any further complications, prompting him to speak up.
“Yes, we should be moving on. Wait, let me check the map to see which direction we should head.”
Lin Yi, in fact, was also feeling somewhat lost at that point.
Afterward, he took out the map and began to carefully cross-reference it with their current situation.
Just then, his eyes suddenly widened.
Noticing his reaction, Lin Yi quickly approached, curious about what might be happening.
“What’s wrong, is there a problem?”
“No, it’s just that I feel like there’s always a discrepancy between your marked positions and the actual locations. And the direction of the discrepancy seems consistent.”
“What do you mean?”
“Let me explain. According to the map, this swamp should be in this location, but now it’s directly across from this mountain peak. Look, how much is it off by on the map?”
While explaining, the hunter gestured over the map.
Although Lin Yi didn’t quite understand these things, the discrepancy was quite obvious now; it appeared to be about 200 meters off.
“Yes, that’s about right. According to this scale, it should be a 200-meter shift. What’s happening?”
“I’m not sure. The mountain environment here is very complex. And after so many years of plate movement, I don’t know if there’s been a general shift. If there has been a shift, then there may be more dangers beneath us—a complete unknown.”
“So, do we just continue with the error, knowing it’s a consistent 200-meter shift? Can’t we just move 200 meters in that direction and then follow the map’s correct positions?”
“In theory, that’s not feasible. So, we must keep following this path and move on. You see? This is the way up the mountain.”
“Right, I noticed. The higher we go, the more rugged the mountain roads will likely become.”
“As the paths become more rugged, the journey down will be tough, so prepare yourselves. We will probably have to camp overnight near Bai Zhen and won’t see the middle of the mountain until we’ve reached it.”
“Okay, I don’t have a problem. What about you, Hei Lang? Are you fine? And Ling’er, can you keep up with your stamina?”
“Don’t worry, I should be fine.”
“Good, let’s get going then.”
After Lin Yi said this, he picked up his belongings, and the group proceeded in the direction the hunter had indicated.
About an hour into their trek, they began to feel the difficulty of the journey increasing.
As they ascended, it became tougher to breathe, as if the surrounding air didn’t want to be inhaled.
“What’s going on? I feel like it’s getting hard to breathe.”
Lin Yi, gasping heavily, turned to speak to another person.
“This is caused by a special terrain in the mountains; just past this gully, the air will become more abundant. We need to hurry through here or we’ll definitely faint and might never leave this spot.”
“But we’ve been walking for an hour, and everyone is nearly drained. Can we keep going? And according to the map’s discrepancies, how much farther do we have before we’re past this section?”

chapters.title: Chapter 449: 449: Preparing to Set Up Camp
chapters.content:
Chapter 449: Chapter 449: Preparing to Set Up Camp
“Probably around one kilometer left.”
“One kilometer?”
After saying this, the person clenched their teeth tightly. One kilometer was definitely a distance they could endure.
However, if it had been on a flat road, there would surely have been no problem, but now they were traveling through rugged paths surrounded by wild undergrowth. While walking, they also had to be vigilant of the environs, fearful of sudden attacks from wild beasts.
It seemed that Lin Yi had also noticed, but at this moment, his expression should have shown something, yet he just walked over and lightly patted the other on the shoulder.
“Don’t worry. Based on my experience, this area shouldn’t be too dangerous. Moreover, we haven’t really entered deep into the mountains yet. It’s only in the deeper parts that fierce animals make their den.”
“Then how far are we from that place now? How much further do we have to go?”
“That’s hard to say. And according to the map, we need to cross those two peaks ahead to reach our destination. But rest assured, we definitely won’t make it there tonight.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi could only sigh. If that was the case, they could only do their best and continue in the direction they were supposed to go.
However, Lin Yi was still worried about Ling’er’s situation.
Since Ling’er was a girl who was having a tough time on this difficult mountain path, he was really concerned that she wouldn’t be able to keep up with her energy by the end.
“Hei Lang, are you alright?”
“Oh, don’t worry. I’ve still got plenty of strength left, and this distance shouldn’t be a problem for me.”
When Hei Lang spoke, there was truly no change in his complexion.
And Lin Yi knew very well that Hei Lang had abundant physical strength. This small exertion probably meant nothing to him.
“It’s settled then. How about this? You give me your bag, and you carry Ling’er. I’m worried she won’t be able to make it on her own.”
“No need. I can carry my own bag and also carry her. There won’t be any problem. Come on, Ling’er, climb onto my back.”
Hei Lang was quite forthright. Then, he promptly stooped down in front of Ling’er.
When Ling’er heard this, she was taken aback for a moment.
“This… this isn’t appropriate, is it?”
“What’s inappropriate? You’re the only female in our team, so if we don’t protect you, who will we protect? Besides, you’re our priority. If you are already exhausted when we go deeper into the mountains, our venture there would be pointless. So, you must do as I say.”
Lin Yi added on the side, because at this point the situation was indeed such.
Moreover, to be honest, Ling’er felt that she couldn’t keep going much longer.
Even for one kilometer, she was afraid she couldn’t make it to the end without stopping to rest; only by resting could she get a momentary relief.
If this was the case, there was no need for her to persist, so she leaped up and jumped onto Hei Lang’s back.
The distance of one kilometer actually wasn’t too long for them, but since they didn’t necessarily have to hurry, it took them about fifteen minutes to successfully make it through.
Suddenly, the path ahead became more level. Although it was still somewhat craggy and winding, at least it wasn’t as difficult to navigate as before.
“Alright, we’ve finally made it out; now, we can take a short break. But we can’t linger too long because, according to the climate changes at this mountaintop, I estimate we have at most one hour before darkness falls completely.”
“What did you say? Only one more hour?”
While he spoke, he looked at his wristwatch.
It was only just past 3 p.m. now. If there was one more hour, it should be around 4 p.m. How could it possibly get dark at 4 p.m.?
Even considering the current weather, he thought it wouldn’t get dark until about 6:30 p.m.
“No, didn’t you get the time wrong?”
He doubted and then looked up at the hunter to question him.
“I know what you’re thinking, but I’ll tell you that the weather in these mountains is anything but normal, including when it gets dark. It’s usually very short during the day, and by 4 p.m. you can basically see nothing. Around 3:30 p.m. you’ll start to feel the darkness creeping in.”
“Then, we only have an hour left, so what are we waiting for? We need to hurry to find a flat spot to set up camp.”
“No rush. I have already spotted a good area. Even though it feels a bit windy here, if we walk that way for about ten more minutes, we should reach a suitable spot. By the way, are your tents all prepared?”
“Yes, everything is ready and they’re very simple to set up. Basically, it takes about five minutes to put one up.”
“That’s good. I think now you can take a rest here. And seeing this brother carrying Ling’er for so long, I’m worried about his strength keeping up.”
The hunter mainly addressed Hei Lang, but to be honest, Lin Yi wasn’t at all worried about Hei Lang’s stamina.
He knew that no one in the group could surpass Hei Lang in physical strength, so he felt there was absolutely no issue in that regard.
“Don’t worry, there’s definitely no problem here. And you don’t even know about his strength yet? In the end, if he really needs to burst out, you probably won’t even stand a chance.”
“Oh? Is that so? Well then, let’s hurry and prepare for what we need to do tonight.”
After finishing speaking, he looked around. Although this area was flat, he still felt that something about this place wasn’t quite right.

chapters.title: Chapter 450: 450 Is this a swamp again?
chapters.content:
Chapter 450: Chapter 450 Is this a swamp again?
“What’s wrong? Is there a problem?”
Lin Yi looked around; everything seemed the same to him so, generally speaking, there wasn’t much of a difference as far as he was concerned.
“No, it just feels like there’s something strange about this place. I didn’t have this feeling before, but now, as we walk this way, it seems somewhat abnormal.”
“Abnormal, you mean to say there’s something not right nearby? If there’s really something, then we should hurry and leave this place.”
“It’s not that. It’s not any sort of fierce beast, but I am worried—ah, I can’t quite express the feeling. But now, there’s no time to allow it; we can only stay here for the time being.”
“Why is there no time? Isn’t it an hour away from getting dark? Moreover, if we go now, I’m afraid it would all be too late, wouldn’t it?”
“Right, I’m worried about that issue, so I feel we shouldn’t move anymore. If we change locations again, who knows, he might sense some area.”
However, upon thinking it over, Lin Yi found that what the hunter had told him made sense, and given the circumstances, he guessed he couldn’t think of a better idea himself.
If there had been even a slight chance or a solution, he certainly wouldn’t have taken this risk.
“Well, alright, I hope your intuition is wrong—and you haven’t been here for so many years.”
“Yes, I feel that way too. And my intuition isn’t necessarily correct. Come on, let’s walk a bit further and get around these big trees. Usually under such circumstances, there should be flat ground beyond them based on experience.”
In Lin Yi’s view, what the hunter said was still quite credible.
After all, he had rich experience in entering the mountains, but the key concern was whether he, after all these years without entering, was truly still as familiar with everything in the deep mountains as he used to be.
He was worried about these things in his heart and had no idea what to do.
So, Lin Yi had no choice but to follow the hunter’s steps, moving forward step by step.
He took two steps forward, then looked back to see if there was anything else dangerous around them.
Luckily, after they bypassed this cluster of trees, they quickly came upon a flat piece of land.
After seeing this place, he suddenly felt that everything seemed much clearer before his eyes.
This stretch of grassland really gave him hope for life.
After spending almost an entire day in the jungle, Lin Yi felt an almost unbearable pain.
But now, in this moment, it seemed like something was constantly changing.
“Hold on a moment.”
Suddenly, Lin Yi seemed to think of something and shouted loudly to everyone.
The hunter was just curious, then turned back and looked at him.
In this environment, he hadn’t detected any danger; could it be Lin Yi had just discovered something hazardous?
“What is it, did you find something?”
“Look, this grassland.”
“Yes, it’s a grassland. Didn’t I tell you? After getting around this area, it turns into a flat grassland.”
“No, this, this couldn’t be a swamp, could it?”
Once bitten by a snake, one fears a well rope for ten years; now, as soon as Lin Yi saw a grassland, he immediately associated it with a swamp.
When the hunter heard this, he laughed heartily.
This sudden laughter made the atmosphere around them seem to relax a great deal.
“Man, you’re just too nervous. Besides, I can still tell the difference between a real grassland and a swamp. This is pure grassland. If you don’t believe me, look.”
To verify his own claim, the hunter casually walked forward, then leapt with his whole body and jumped onto the lawn.
Of course, he landed solidly on the ground without any sinking force.
“See? This is grassland, and absolutely safe at that.”
Upon seeing this, Lin Yi suddenly let out a long sigh of relief.
If it really was so, then it seemed his concerns were largely unfounded.
“Alright then, if that’s the case, let’s hurry up and take out the tents. Let’s work together to set them up—how many tents are we putting up?”
“Big brother, I’ve only got two tents.”
“What? Only two tents?”
At this point, he frowned slightly.
“Yes, big brother. And the tents are quite large; I couldn’t possibly carry more. I thought Ling’er would have one tent, and I’d share one with you—that, who knew you?”
He said, looking up at the hunter.
The implication was clear: he hadn’t anticipated a fourth person joining them. Had he known earlier, he would have brought three tents.
“Well, let’s leave it at that. Ling’er can have a tent to herself, then. Alright, the three of us can squeeze into one tent, how about that?”
“I’m a bit scared to be alone.”
Ling’er suddenly objected.
Indeed, in the deep forest, a girl—even if she were to stay next to them—a mere tent separating them in the end would not be reassuring for her.
“Then Ling’er, if you don’t mind, I’ll share a tent with you. Then, brother, you and Hei Lang can share one. How does that sound?”
Naturally, this arrangement was the most appropriate, and Ling’er had a very good impression of Lin Yi. After all, among the three, she was most familiar with Lin Yi.
Without further ado, the three of them got to work and set up the tents there.
And truth be told, whether it was space or warmth, the tents were really very good.
“That’s what I say. City folks sure know how to enjoy life, talking about going out for picnics and barbecues and lying in tents at night to watch the stars. Seems like that feeling is going to be satisfied today.”

chapters.title: Chapter 451: 451: Sound Asleep
chapters.content:
Chapter 451: Chapter 451: Sound Asleep
“If that’s the case, stargazing and having some food, I’m quite willing to do that. It’s just that I’m not sure if there will be any danger tonight.”
“Looking at the situation, there shouldn’t be much danger. Alright, it’s been a tiring day and it looks like darkness is falling soon,” Heavenly Eye observed.
As he spoke, he looked up and gestured at his surroundings; sure enough, as he had said, the sky was beginning to darken.
The sunlight that had been visible just moments ago had now disappeared.
And the grassland became quiet all at once.
“Well then, let’s sit around here for a while, light a campfire, and plan our route for tomorrow. After that, we can have some food and get a good night’s sleep. We’ll deal with everything else when tomorrow comes.”
As they talked, the group walked over, and Hei Lang took out some items he had prepared in advance. Then, Lin Yi and the hunter collected some dry firewood from nearby.
After lighting the campfire, they instantly felt warmer and much more secure.
While eating their meal, they sat around the fire, planning the next day’s journey.
Of course, the ones feeling the most pressure were probably the hunter and Lin Yi.
The two acted as guides, and every step they took next could potentially be dangerous – it was all under their control.
“Take a look, should we take this road tomorrow? From what I see, going around this way seems like the most convenient route into the deepest part of the mountains,” Lin Yi said, examining the map before turning to ask for the hunter’s opinion.
After all, his own opinion was one-sided, and it was likely that only the hunter in front of him could make the final decision.
The hunter took the map and scrutinized it, but he seemed to disagree with the proposed route, shaking his head slightly.
“If you take this path, it looks quite problematic. Haven’t you noticed? This entire area is marked as unknown territory. So, it’s likely unsafe to approach from any direction.”
Yes, Lin Yi knew this all too well. There was a blank space on the map with a large question mark, an area they had never explored before.
“However, we still need to head into this area eventually. And as far as I know, the most valuable medicinal herbs are all found here, in the most dangerous but valuable place.”
“Yes, I am aware of the situation, but your route is definitely not possible. Look at the surrounding areas.”
“Oh, I see now. There seem to be some marshes and lakes around here, right?”
“The closer we get to water and marshland, the more unsafe our situation becomes. Water is the source of life and is likely to attract wild beasts.”
“Didn’t you say that wild beasts only appear deep in the mountains?”
“Yes, that’s generally true. However, we can’t rule out the possibility that they come out at night or during the day to hunt or search for water sources.”
“So, are you suggesting that our only viable routes are these two?”
“Correct, these two paths seem to lead inside, but I’ve walked down this one before, many years ago. I don’t recall much, but this other route is completely unfamiliar to me.”
“Then let’s choose the one you’re more familiar with, the one you’ve traveled before. Even if you don’t remember much now, maybe things will come back to you once we get there?”
“I hope so. Alright then, I’ll continue along that route tomorrow.”
As he spoke, the hunter yawned deeply and then, looking at his watch, realized that it was already 7:00 pm.
Although nightlife hadn’t truly begun, in the middle of the wilderness, this time already felt very late.
“Ah, I can’t help it anymore, I’m too tired. I need to take a moment to return to the tent and rest. If you guys want to keep talking, you can continue here for a while, but make sure not to stay up too late, it wouldn’t be safe.”
After a whole day of hard work, even a hunter with great stamina would find himself exhausted by now.
The hunter picked up his trusty rifle and crawled into his tent.
Lin Yi glanced back; even though he was lying on the ground, his grip on the rifle was still tight.
It seemed he was always on alert.
In such an environment, everyone had to remain vigilant at all times.
“Ling’er, are you tired? If you are, you should also head back to the tent to rest. After all, we’ve been on the move all night.”
“I’m okay for now, not too tired. Do you think our journey tomorrow will be as smooth as today?”
“Smooth? Do you consider today’s journey smooth?”
“Yes, I think it went very well. We encountered danger on the way, but we resolved it quite easily. It’s been a very successful trip so far.”
“Well, if you put it that way, then yes, it’s been quite successful indeed. How about you?”
“Me? I’m fine, big brother. I’m still full of energy. Even if you let me go back to Zhenfeng to sleep, I might not be able to fall asleep.”
