“Even if you can’t sleep, you’d better try to get some rest soon. With it being so late at night, I worry that the fire might attract wild beasts. So we should put out the fire soon and quietly slide into our tents. Maybe we’ll be able to get through the night safely.”
Indeed, as Lin Yi said these words, he used the word ‘maybe’.

chapters.title: Chapter 452: 452: The Hunter Has Disappeared
chapters.content:
Chapter 452: Chapter 452: The Hunter Has Disappeared
Because he was clearly aware that sometimes some things are simply unknown, completely unexpected.
“Alright, big brother, if you hadn’t said that, I wouldn’t even be feeling sleepy. But now that you mentioned it, I do feel a bit drowsy. Fine, let’s hurry back to the tents and get some rest. We’ll set off early tomorrow morning.”
After speaking, the individuals in question sprang into action, after fully entertaining their guest and friend, they each entered their respective tents.
“Ling’er, you sleep over there. I’ll sleep next to you. Besides, I’m not that sleepy yet. I’ll think about tomorrow’s matters for a bit longer. You should rest up soon because if you’re also going into the deep mountains tomorrow, your role could be very significant. By then, you’ll be the most important person. Understand?”
This was something Lin Yi understood well about their current situation; it seemed like they lacked the confidence to handle it well.
Therefore, no one knew what exactly would happen tomorrow.
Lin Yi just nodded, and he understood that the situation did not permit him to think too much. The only thing he could do was to go along with the wishes of the others.
Then, he had to focus his mind on the emptiness ahead so that he could perform some major role when the time came.
Though he felt somewhat weary after lying down, he also started to feel sleepy overtaking him.
As this thought crossed his mind, he gently closed his eyes, not expecting to quickly drift into a dream.
Gradually, Ling’er began to sleep soundly, her breathing becoming more pronounced,
Lin Yi glanced back at her and then quietly shook his head.
The girl looked quite adorable.
Just a while ago, she adamantly declared she didn’t want to sleep here and was not tired at all, but as soon as her head hit the pillow, she fell fast asleep as if exhausted from the day’s activities.
After all, the achievements of the day weren’t something anyone could easily claim.
Lin Yi wasn’t planning to stay awake any longer. He believed there would be a tough fight awaiting them the next day. Moreover, he felt that as they moved on, their journey would likely become more and more difficult.
While the opportunity was present, he needed to rest up properly. Only by seizing the time to recharge could he hope to get through it all.
In the end, slowly, Lin Yi also succumbed to sleep.
He didn’t know how long he had been asleep when he suddenly felt as if someone was calling his name.
Lin Yi woke up abruptly from his sleep.
He thought he was dreaming, but when he saw Hei Lang in front of him, he was indeed surprised.
Moreover, when he looked outside and saw darkness all around, yet noticed Hei Lang’s anxious expression, he sensed that something must have happened.
“Hei Lang, what’s wrong?”
He purposefully kept his voice low, wanting to know what had happened without waking the still sleeping Ling’er.
“Big brother, it’s not good. I got up in the middle of the night to relieve myself and found that the hunter has disappeared!”
“What do you mean disappeared?”
Upon hearing this, he suddenly became tense.
It was the hunter who had led them to this point today, and if he had vanished now, the path ahead would likely be even more difficult.
The key question was, where had the hunter gone?
Had he left on his own and been gone for a while, or had he departed due to some other reason?
Regardless of the answer, the hunter’s disappearance was a bad turn of events for them.
“When did you notice he was missing?”
“Big brother, I just noticed a moment ago. I looked around, and it’s pitch black everywhere. I don’t know where he could have gone, so I rushed here to tell you.”
“What’s going on? What’s happened to you guys?”
Just then, Ling’er suddenly woke up. Although the two men tried to cover their bodies, they still disturbed the sleeping Ling’er.
“Oh, Ling’er, it’s nothing. Go back to sleep.”
“There must be something wrong. Tell me, what has happened? Where is the hunter? Where did he go?”
Ling’er quickly realized that only Hei Lang and Lin Yi were present and, by their panicked looks, she guessed something must have occurred.
Now that the hunter was not here, could it mean that something had happened to him?
She didn’t dare continue with that thought, knowing that if the hunter was indeed in trouble, their journey ahead would be extremely difficult.
Moreover, all of them had been sleeping in the tents, so why was it that only the hunter was affected? Why was there no sign of trouble for the rest?
“Alright, Ling’er, there’s no point in hiding it from you any longer. Hei Lang discovered that the hunter was missing when he got up in the middle of the night to pee, but no one knows where he has gone.”
While speaking, Lin Yi glanced at the time. It was precisely 1 a.m.
It was the dead of night, likely the most dangerous time in Xi Lian Mountain. Where could he have gone?
“Quick, let’s search around here quietly to see if he’s perhaps answering nature’s call?”
“Remember everyone, be very quiet. If we make too much noise, we might attract the attention of the predators.”
Lin Yi was still carefully instructing them, realizing that if the hunter wasn’t here now, he would have to take the burden upon himself.
The group stealthily emerged from their tents and looked around quietly.
In this pitch-black environment, it took roughly a minute for their eyes to adjust to the dim light.
Now they could see some details outside.
The surroundings were as silent as when they first arrived, and no human figures were visible.

chapters.title: Chapter 453: 453: Can't Find Anywhere Around
chapters.content:
Chapter 453: Chapter 453: Can’t Find Anywhere Around
“Brother, brother.”
Lin Yi lowered his voice, and then softly called out here.
The night was extremely silent, so at this time, even if he shouted, if he wasn’t far away, he should have been able to hear it completely.
“Brother, brother.”
Without seeing any response, Lin Yi continued to call out here.
“Stop yelling. I guess he must have already left this place.”
Ling’er quickly made a judgment.
At this moment, it was as if something suddenly occurred to her.
“Oh no.”
She yelled loudly, and at last, hurried back into the tent.
Lin Yi looked up, and it was obvious that the two of them had no idea what had happened. Why had she become so tense all of a sudden?
“What, what’s wrong with him?”
“I don’t know. Let’s go take a look inside, I guess Ling’er must have thought of something.”
To tell the truth, the two followed Ling’er straight into the room.
At this time, they saw Ling’er sitting in front of her own tent, then she took out that special storage tool, which was now completely empty inside.
In fact, Lin Yi remembered very clearly that he had just put the last lot of cat’s paw grass into this box in the afternoon.
But now, not only the hunter was missing, the cat’s paw grass had also disappeared. Could it be that the hunter had stolen the cat’s paw grass?
“What, what happened here? How did it suddenly disappear like this?”
“I know now. This afternoon, the hunter had also asked me about the value of this thing if it were taken to the market. Could it be he really harbored evil intentions and then stole it?”
“You can’t be serious. Didn’t you tell him this afternoon? It’s worth about twenty thousand or so—is it possible that just for that amount, he slipped away quietly?”
“What else could it be, then? Now, the man is gone, and the cat’s paw grass is gone too. Where else could he have gone?”
“That really is a bit uncertain.”
He had never imagined that the hunter would steal something and plunge them into dead silence.
“If that’s the case, then this matter is really troublesome for us.”
“How come I feel like that’s not like him? Besides, he might have been a bit greedy for money before, but not to the extent of leaving us in danger, outright taking our stuff without rhyme or reason, right?”
“Not necessarily. Big Brother, you’ve said before that the situation with this hunter is more complicated than we think, and who knows what’s in his mind. If tempted by this money, couldn’t he make such a choice?”
“If he wanted to harm us, he would have a thousand ways to do so, but he didn’t do anything like that in broad daylight. Instead, he chooses to leave with the cat’s paw grass at night, at such a dangerous time—I tend to think he must have had something he needed to do.”
“Something to do? What else could he possibly have to do?”
“Oh no, I know where he went.”
At this moment, Lin Yi suddenly had an idea.
“Big Brother, have… have you thought of something?”
“This afternoon, the swamp we visited—I guess if I’m not wrong, the hunter must have gone back there.”
“What? Why would he go there in the dead of night, and besides, the swamp environment is so treacherous—could there be some misunderstanding here?”
“No, if I’m not mistaken, at that time, the cat’s paw grass had not been completely picked.”
Having said that, Lin Yi turned his head to look at Ling’er, who just nodded slightly.
That afternoon, indeed, she had seen about six or seven plants, but she hadn’t counted the exact number.
Moreover, Ling’er had always been ungreedy. She felt that these things growing there were more valuable than being held in her own hands.
“If you’re saying that, then it seems to make sense. Moreover, I can tell you that cat’s paw grass can only retain its full potency for about three days. After that time, if you take it out, it’ll just be an ordinary piece of grass with no value whatsoever.”
“But the main issue is, you didn’t tell him that. So they think this stuff is very valuable, and that’s why they’re taking the risk to pick it in the middle of the night, even taking the cat’s paw grass from you, just to make sure they don’t pick the wrong thing.”
“Big Brother, so what should we do?”
“We can’t just do nothing. In the middle of the night, we absolutely cannot leave someone in danger. And let me tell you, it’s extremely dangerous in there. So many of us almost had trouble, let alone him being alone?”
“Don’t tell me you’re saying we should go back there now to find him?”
“Exactly, we must find him. After all, we are a team, and at this time, if something really happened to him, our subsequent journey would be even more troublesome. It’s not just for his sake, but also for our own. Do you understand, Hei Lang?”
In truth, Lin Yi’s words were also very clear.
He hoped Hei Lang would understand this principle. He knew that Hei Lang was always eager to serve himself, but if it was these people’s matters, he feared they truly wouldn’t be taken seriously.
“Alright then. Since Big Brother you have already said so, we can only return to that place in the dead of night.”
“Ling’er, what I mean is, if it’s not possible, you should stay here. I promised to stay here with him tomorrow, and I feel this place is generally quite safe overall.”
In fact, Lin Yi’s thinking was quite straightforward. Now that these people had already started taking risks.
And clearly, this time, if they really encountered problems, then it would be a very risky act for them.
He didn’t want to cause harm to Ling’er because of this matter. If something unexpected happened to Ling’er, then their plan to enter Xi Lian Mountain might have to be prematurely ended.

chapters.title: Chapter 454: 454: The Hunter in Danger
chapters.content:
Chapter 454: Chapter 454: The Hunter in Danger
“Do you think it’s safe to leave me here in the dead of night? I might as well stick close to you guys. That way, I’d feel more at ease, and we could look out for each other.”
Lin Yi didn’t want to say anything else, and he knew that looking out for Ling’er meant the big men would have to take extra care of her.
But there was no helping it. Thinking it over, he realized that the request from the others was not unreasonable at all, reflecting the genuine situation they were in.
“Alright then, let’s each grab our gear and hurry out of here. By the way, Hei Lang, do you remember the route we took this afternoon?”
Since it was carried out in total darkness, his memory of this afternoon’s route was indeed vague.
But he knew that Hei Lang had an exceptional memory, and once he had traveled a route, he could usually remember it quite well.
“Don’t worry, I made some marks along the way, so we shouldn’t have any problems. Just follow me, and I think in about half an hour or so, we should be able to get there.”
“I really don’t know when this guy left, nor do I know if he is in a safe situation right now. If something has indeed happened to him, we won’t have any way to explain it to his wife when we get back.”
“Are we in a position to worry about that much? We’re doing everything we can now to rescue him. If we can’t manage even that, then there’s truly nothing we can do to help.”
After finishing, they were resigned to their situation and finally, the three of them set out on their dark journey.
The journey was surprisingly smooth, without encountering much. As the hunter had told them, they were likely still on the outskirts of Xi Lian Mountain.
They hadn’t ventured into the deep mountains, so it was possible that the ferocious animals hadn’t yet detected their intrusion into their territory.
“Big brother, it should be here.”
Upon arrival, he pointed ahead, as he could see a patch of moonlight shining down on the swamp.
In the morning, this place looked like a grassland, but now it was clear that what lay before them was indeed a swamp.
“Look at this.”
He pointed to something nearby, and as they all turned to look, they indeed found a hunting rifle.
Since the rifle had been left here, it meant the hunter must have entered the swamp at that time.
But how exactly did he manage to enter the swamp in the middle of the night? Wasn’t that extremely dangerous?
“Big brother, has he really gone in?”
“I think he has gone in already, and look how neatly he placed the gun, close to a corner of the wall. It proves that he didn’t fall in from outside but entered deliberately and methodically.”
“But this is a swamp. How did he get in?”
“That, I’m not sure of, but if that’s the case, I’m certain he must be somewhere around here.”
“Brother, brother!”
At that moment, he shouted loudly towards the swamp.
He was well aware that screaming could startle the surrounding beasts, but at that moment, he couldn’t care less.
Since they had made it this far, there was no turning back now.
But as his echo rang out, Lin Yi heard no response from the hunter.
What’s going on? Could something truly have happened?
He furrowed his brow in worry, knowing that in such an open environment, his loud voice should definitely be heard by the hunter if he was nearby.
Could it be that the hunter really had an accident?
Anxiety started to settle in his heart, mixed with regret about not insisting they share a room that evening, which might have prevented the hunter from leaving so easily.
But then again, that didn’t seem right, and the fact that the hunter had brazenly entered their tent to take a Cat’s Paw Herb, plunging him into such a deep realm, was something irreversible for him.
He was about to speak again when he suddenly heard a strange noise ahead, as though someone was struggling in the swamp.
“Brother, is that you?”
Since he couldn’t think of anyone else there, and at this time, the only one likely to make a sound probably was the hunter.
“Quick, save me!”
He heard the hunter’s voice coming through, and he vaguely made out a dark figure ahead, bobbing up and down in the swamp.
“Quick, Hei Lang, hurry up and get the rope!”
Lin Yi turned around swiftly, thankful that Hei Lang had come prepared and had taken the rope straight off his waist, throwing it accurately to the struggling shadow.
With a gentle pull, he felt like he hadn’t caught anything solid.
“How is it? Did you catch it?”
“I’ve got it, hurry, don’t waste time.”
The hunter’s body seemed to get heavier, and as they processed this, they quickly picked up the pace, pulling him out of the swamp step by step.
But the closer they got to the end, the greater the force seemed to be, as if pulling Ling’er, though it felt stronger than the resistance Ling’er had posed.
Finally, with an enormous effort, they managed to pull the man out of the swamp.
The moment they emerged, Lin Yi was shocked because they saw blood on the lower part of the hunter’s legs, and it seemed like the bleeding wouldn’t stop,
“Ling’er, what… what happened?”
He turned his head to look at Ling’er, who quickly approached and checked the wound.

chapters.title: Chapter 433 Departure
chapters.content:
"Don't worry, I checked it over and over again last night, and there basically shouldn't be any problems."
"Alright, then let's set out now. From here to that plaza, it should take us about 10 minutes to arrive."
Both of them nodded, and then they followed him and left from here.
At this time, it wasn't even dawn yet.
Even the moon and the stars were still visible.
However, it must be said that the air here is still very fresh.
Although it does feel a bit cold.
Just after coming out, Lin Yi felt a gust of wind blowing over, and it was the kind of bone-chilling cold wind.
Yesterday afternoon it hadn't been so cold, it seems, just as the hunter had said, the temperature difference here between morning and evening is indeed very large.
"Did you both bring the clothes to fend off the cold?"
He turned around and then spoke to the two of them.
"Don't worry, everything's ready, I'm even wearing a down jacket."
"Good, that's good."
He nodded, but still felt as if something had been left undone.
Lin Yi's mind kept on this thought as they now arrived at the plaza.
There was absolutely no one on the plaza, and no shadow of anyone could be seen.
"Big brother, what's going on?"
Hei Lang quietly moved forward, then checked the time—it was exactly 3:55.
He wanted to say, why hadn't the hunter arrived yet; if they were supposed to leave on time at 4 AM, he should have arrived here a few minutes earlier, at the very least.
Only then would he feel that this person was somewhat reliable.
"No worries, let's wait a bit more patiently, we haven't reached the agreed time yet, have we?"
"Big brother, this guy wouldn't deceive us, right? Also, we gave him so much money yesterday; if he fled from here overnight with his wife and children, where would we even begin to look for him?"
This had been Hei Lang's worry the entire night yesterday.
He had mentioned this issue to Ling'er, and to be honest, Ling'er also felt that giving all the money to him was indeed an impulsive move.
"I'm telling you, don't measure my gentleman's stomach with your petty heart."
Just then, a voice suddenly floated over.
They quickly turned their heads to look and, unexpectedly, a shadowy figure emerged from the corner.
He carried a long object on his back. Although it was too dark to see clearly, they could guess that it was probably the hunting rifle he was carrying.
Besides this, there was a satchel by his side, and what was inside that no one could tell.
"Hehe, sorry about that, I just didn't see you, and they were making irresponsible remarks here, right? When did you arrive?"
"I've been here since 3:30, and I took the time to observe the weather, the stars, and today's wind direction. I feel that we should take a detour into the mountains today."
"What do you mean?" Enjoy exclusive chapters from My Virtual Library Empire
"What I mean is, the previously planned mountain path we thought to take, I'm afraid we can no longer use it, because heading in that direction would lead us into severe weather."
"What? Severe weather? Then what should we do?"
"It's okay, there's another way we can go. Just follow me when the time comes."
"Oh, right, I haven't mentioned it yet, but I have a map here, which I obtained through much difficulty."
Only at this moment did he take out this precious map and then handed it over to the hunter.
After hesitating for a moment, the hunter accepted it with some uncertainty.
The mountains were always unpredictable; how could a map of it even exist?
The hunter opened the flashlight, unfolded the map, and took a glance.
The details could be said to be very clear, even specifying the exact locations of swamps, their directions, and the range of their size—everything was annotated.
"Where did you get this from?"
"That's not something you need to worry about. What I want to know is, can it be of any use?"
"Of course, it can. Combined with the map in my head and this paper map, I tell you, we shouldn't take any wrong turns on this trip."
"Good, that's a relief."
This assurance was like a soothing pill for Lin Yi.
He had been worried that they would keep wandering around, unable to find their way out of these mountains.
Now, with a guide and this map, the matter seemed all but settled.
The group walked for roughly half an hour.
Gradually, they came upon a deserted grassland.
Looking back, the town had fallen into the distance and even into darkness, making its existence practically invisible.
"Once we cross this grassland, and then move forward, we'll be able to reach the foot of the mountain."
"This grassland?"
Seeing this, Lin Yi hesitated.
The grassland seemed overgrown; the grass was at least as tall as a person.
He truly didn't know what might be lurking within.
If there was something hidden that suddenly attacked, their mobility and their ability to defend themselves would be compromised.
"Don't worry, even if there is something in there, it should just be small inevitable animals, and I can handle them. Come here."
As he spoke, he waved and finally took out a torch from his bag.
It was a common torch that Lin Ye had seen before.
However, what surprised him was that the torch's head was wrapped with cloth, and the cloth was coated with a layer of light green powder.
Then, using a lighter, he swiftly ignited the torch.
They could see a wisp of Qing Yan smoke rising from the head of the torch.
At the same time, he smelled a kind of stimulating scent—indescribable.
"What is this?"
"It's for driving away game. With it, snakes and small animals won't even dare to approach, so we need it to lead us to the base of the mountain."
"So with this thing, does it mean we can keep going with it all the way?"

chapters.title: Chapter 455: 455: The Hunter Is Poisoned
chapters.content:
Chapter 455: Chapter 455: The Hunter Is Poisoned
Ling’er discovered that there seemed to be a very long wound on her calf.
She had no idea what could have caused the wound, but the situation was urgent. If it wasn’t treated promptly, she feared he could bleed out and die right there.
Ling’er quickly took some hemostatic herbs from her medicine box and gently placed them on the hunter’s wound.
“How is it? Is his condition serious now?”
“I don’t know the extent of the wound yet, but from what I see, it seems to be very deep. Let’s hurry back and find a quiet place to treat him.”
“Okay, I understand. How about you?”
As he spoke, he lowered his head and then glanced at the hunter lying on the ground.
The hunter just nodded slightly in response.
“This is the mystery hidden in the Swamp.”
“You, what are you saying? What mystery?”
“Mystery hidden here, there’s a mystery hidden here.”
He murmured these words over and over, and at this point, Lin Yi felt that he seemed to be in an abnormal state of mind.
“Brother, brother. What do you mean by that?”
“Mystery hidden here, there’s a mystery hidden here.”
He kept repeating these words.
“You say, what, what’s going on?”
“He’s starting to talk nonsense, and I can feel that he must have been poisoned. Quick, there’s no time to lose, and every minute is a great challenge for him.”
“Okay, I got it.”
After saying that, he nodded, then signaled to Hei Lang, and the two of them carried the hunter on their shoulders, struggling toward the location of their tents.
Along the way, he was mumbling something indistinctly, but no one could make out the words.
Lin Yi felt that he was truly lapsing into unconsciousness and might not have fully realized it yet.
In the end, with the support of a few people, they returned to the tent.
Fortunately, this place was relatively quiet for now.
“Quick, get some water over here to wash off all the mud on him, and then we can dress his wounds here again.”
Hei Lang nodded, then rushed off quickly. Afterwards, with Lin Yi’s assistance, they stripped the injured leg bare.
Thankfully, they carried some water with them and used it to thoroughly clean the wounded leg.
Once clean, the wound was clearly exposed. Though the bleeding had stopped, they could see something white inside.
“What’s this… this thing?”
After seeing this, Lin Yi had an ominous feeling. The stark whiteness—could it be that the bone was exposed?
“That is human bone.”
“You, what are you saying? The injury has reached the bone, so his wound…”
“The wound is very severe. I didn’t notice all this in the dark environment before. I didn’t expect it to be this bad. Quick, bring me my medicine box.”
While he spoke, he quickly went over, then got the medicine box ready and placed it above,
Then they applied some herbal medicine bit by bit on top and used gauze to wrap the area completely.
After finishing everything, he just sighed deeply.
“How is it now?”
“No good, the conditions are too basic here, we can’t draw out the toxins from his body, and look here…”
At that moment, Ling’er suddenly saw that where the wound had been bandaged with white gauze, some green liquid had begun to seep through.
“What’s this? This doesn’t look like blood.”
“Right, it’s not blood. If I’m not mistaken, this must be a toxin. He must have encountered some poisonous substance in the Swamp, and it is likely what caused this wound.”
“Then how do we detoxify him? Can the cat’s claw herb be used?”
“Cat’s claw herb isn’t very effective against this toxin, which is quite stubborn. We’ll need to go back to the Swamp.”
“What are you saying? Go back to the Swamp?”
“Yes, you’ve never heard that Sword Spirit — or smart people — usually find that substances can counteract each other. So, from the Swamp, there should be something that can treat the toxin in his body.”
“But why didn’t you say so earlier?”
“I wasn’t aware of it before. Now, we must go back immediately.”
“Alright, I’ll go with you.”
“You?”
At this, he frowned, appearing troubled.
“What’s the matter? Am I not capable?”
“There’s no need for you to go now; Hei Lang can accompany me.”
“Should I just stay here and take care of him?”
“Right now, there’s nothing you can do to help.”
“Then there you have it. If that’s the case, we’ll both accompany you. When we first pulled him from the Swamp, there was a lot of resistance. If it’s just one person, indeed it will be difficult.”
“Fine, then we wait for the moment. I’ll temporarily seal his Extraordinary Meridians to prevent the toxin from spreading to every part of his body. If it reaches his heart, then we’ll really be in trouble.”
“If not, we should take him with us. I’m worried if we all leave and something happens, it would be a mess.”
After much deliberation, Lin Yi still felt it wouldn’t be quite right to leave the hunter alone.
“Hmm, alright. If we do that, once we get the Antidote, I can detoxify him immediately without delay, which might be more effective. I understand, I’ll make some arrangements for him now, and then we can depart any time.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi just stood up and nodded, but he was feeling very anxious.

chapters.title: Chapter 456: 456: Deciding to Give Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 456: Chapter 456: Deciding to Give Up
Afterward, he clenched his teeth firmly and then gently wiped his forehead.
He looked again at the injured part of his leg, but it was exactly the same as the scene he had just seen; there was no change at all.
It was really strange. Before, he clearly had the “Heavenly Eye” ability, and he could use it. At least here, he could see everything.
But why can’t he use anything now? Could it be that his body was completely ruined?
“Big brother, are you okay?”
Hei Lang noticed him, looking a bit surprised, wondering what was going on in his mind?
“Oh, it’s nothing. You stay here and help him. I’ll be waiting outside my tent for you guys. Once they’re done, we’ll hurry up and set off,” Lin Yi said.
“Okay, I got it.”
After that, Hei Lang nodded and Lin Yi quickly got up and left the place.
When Lin Yi stepped outside alone, he looked inside. The two people were busy working, and at this time, probably no one cared what he was doing.
Lin Yi just went to a corner, and then took a deep breath.
Since entering the mountain area, he hadn’t tried to communicate with the system. He wondered, could he awaken the system again?
He suddenly realized that if the system could reappear in his body at this time, it would play a decisive role for him.
He was naturally hoping for these things to happen, but he couldn’t guarantee whether it could be successfully accomplished.
“System, system, are you there?”
He whispered here, but before when he called out, there would definitely be an unusual response in his body. However, this time Lin Yi felt that his body, in every aspect, was very calm.
This also proved that the system wasn’t hearing his call, or even if it did, it wasn’t willing to respond to him.
“System, what’s the matter with you? Everything I’m doing now, step by step, was arranged by you, so why have you been dropping out of contact since we entered Xi Lian Mountain?”
“System, do you know? I need you now. My teammates have fallen. If I don’t release these abilities soon, I fear we all will end up in a desperate situation.”
“System, are you still there?”
Lin Yi kept calling out here, but it was as if the system had completely disappeared from his body.
Seeing this situation, in fact, the most prevalent feeling in Lin Yi’s heart was despair.
“Big brother, we can go now.”
Somehow, the two had already come to his side.
In fact, Hei Lang had noticed Lin Yi muttering to himself, but no one understood what he was actually saying.
Maybe, because he was under a lot of pressure recently, that’s why he spoke those words.
But under the current circumstances, Hei Lang knew that some things just couldn’t be fully controlled by them.
“Nothing, sometimes I just wonder if my choice is really right.”
“What do you mean? Big brother, you suddenly say this, and I feel somewhat puzzled. What do you mean?”
“I’m just thinking, maybe my choice this time is wrong, and if this mistake occurs, I fear we all will repeat the same mistakes.”
“Big brother, what are you talking about, all of a sudden? Are you feeling scared or terrified?”
That was Hei Lang’s first reaction because in his opinion, Lin Yi would never back down for such reasons.
But now he had done just that, so no matter what, Hei Lang couldn’t understand it.
In his heart, Lin Yi was like a mighty god, and under these circumstances, he shouldn’t feel this way.
“Sigh, I can’t exactly say why, but right now I feel like my choice is wrong. Let’s do this: after rescuing this hunter, let’s not go any deeper tomorrow and quickly retreat from the deep mountain.”
“Big brother, are you joking? We’ve put in so much effort and planned so many things, all for this moment, haven’t we?”
“Yes, in principle, that’s true, but with the current situation, we simply can’t accomplish all that.”
“Why? Big brother, just because we’re facing difficulties now? Let’s not forget, we’ve had numerous difficulties before.”
“Enough, let’s not talk about it anymore. I’ve decided. We can change our approach. We don’t have to get these precious herbs from here.”
As Lin Yi spoke, he looked up at Ling’er standing beside him.
He just felt that at this moment, Ling’er seemed somewhat dissatisfied with his current thoughts.
He understood because this time, Ling’er was very keen, knowing that if they really could get these medicinal herbs now, it would be a huge breakthrough for her subsequent research work.
But the key issue was if he truly lost his own system, then the things to follow would become more troublesome, and it wouldn’t be possible to go on as smoothly as before.
“Ling’er, I actually know what you’re thinking, but I feel that it’s too difficult for us to go into the mountains this time. I’m afraid that before we even get there, all of our lives would be left here. Don’t you think that by doing so, the loss would outweigh the gain?”
“But haven’t we already considered this before? And we know that the environment is extremely dangerous. Can’t we take the risk?”
“Taking risks is possible, but I’ve come to understand that I really can’t joke with your lives. My life is not that valuable and even if there was a problem, I wouldn’t care about all this.”

chapters.title: Chapter 457: 457: The Lifesaving Medicine
chapters.content:
Chapter 457: Chapter 457: The Lifesaving Medicine
“But, why does it seem like you suddenly changed your mind? Is it because of his situation that you’ve been affected?”
Ling’er just felt that everything had been fine, and all their hearts were set on entering the deep forest, but now, at this moment, he had unexpectedly changed his mind.
“I can’t explain it all in a word or two. Let’s wait until we leave this place, and then we can make plans. Right now, our main task is to save him; we can discuss the rest after dawn.”
Lin Yi didn’t want to delay any further here, and he felt that lingering on would be utterly meaningless.
So, they quickened their pace and returned to the swamp area.
They had been back and forth in this place several times now, so they were very familiar with the route by now.
After arriving here, the shimmering surface of the swamp was once again in front of them, and it seemed to have no significant difference from before.
This was what Lin Yi couldn’t seem to understand.
“Alright, Ling’er, I’m here now. So, where do you suggest we start our investigation?”
“It’s obvious. When we called out to him, he didn’t respond in time. It was only later that he suddenly appeared struggling in the swamp, which proves that everything probably happened within the swamp, right?”
“That’s right. That should be the case.”
“Do you have a strong flashlight?”
“Oh, I have one here, just a moment.”
Hei Lang said, nodded, then reached into his bag, pulled out a big strong flashlight, and turned it on.
As soon as the flashlight came on, the whole swamp was as bright as day, extremely clear, and all objects were visible before everyone.
“Where do you want to start looking?”
“He was just in that position, see it?”
At this moment, he clearly pointed to a particular area, which still seemed to have a red color that had not faded away.
“Oh, I see it. That red area, is that the hunter’s blood?”
“Yes, it’s his blood. So, if that’s the case, look over there now.”
Ling’er said this and pointed in another direction. She noticed that there were indeed a few plants there that seemed to be growing particularly well.
“Do you see it? That flowering area?”
“I see it, yes, there are flowers, but what sustains them in this swamp?”
“Didn’t you realize which way the blood was flowing?”
“Flowing direction?”
Upon saying this, he slightly furrowed his brow because he didn’t quite understand what she was getting at.
Then, he carefully examined that red area.
He noticed that the swamp began to show some movement, and during this movement, the blood continuously swirled nearby.
Finally, it all collected within that flower, and soon, the blood quite disappeared.
“I, I saw it. They, they seem to be absorbed by that flower? Can I understand it that way?”
“Didn’t you feel that the bud was especially bright and vibrant?”
Indeed, had Ling’er not reminded him again, he would have completely missed these details.
“I saw it, it’s indeed very bright and the color is very vivid. Normal flower colors shouldn’t be like this, right?”
“Exactly, that’s what I meant. So, under these circumstances, we can’t wait any longer. And now, can you understand one thing?”
“I get it. You mean that the bud grows so big because it is nourished by human blood?”
“Yes, that’s right.”
“But that’s not right, either. No one has come to this place for many years. What has it been consuming all this time?”
“Perhaps, usually, prey come here.”
“Prey? You mean carnivores?”
“Yes, that’s likely. But as you can see, the bud now appears smaller than the ones before, which proves that the prey also realize that this place is not easy to approach, so they have not appeared.”
“We can’t worry about that now. Just tell me, is that bud life-saving medicine?”
“Yes, that’s it.”
“Good, then I understand. Is there a way to pick it?”
“It shouldn’t be too difficult.”
“Alright, find a way to get it, and pull it to shore. Maybe, it can be useful.”
After hearing this, Hei Lang nodded, then sought Ling’er’s opinion.
After all, Ling’er was the Collector here, so she would be the most clear about how to harvest this thing and what its effects would be upon collection.
Seeing Ling’er nod her head in agreement, Hei Lang realized that they would probably retrieve the object soon.
In the end, Hei Lang used a launcher and easily pulled the flourishing flower out by its roots directly from its spot.
Once he had done this, Ling’er quickly stepped forward and then looked down.
Yes, even now, it seemed the substance was still fizzing and emitting something.
Ling’er knew this was the life-saving medicine. She hurried over to the hunter, unraveled the gauze on his body, and then soaked his wound with all the liquid.
“You mean to say that by pouring this liquid into his wound, you can gradually eradicate the venom?”
“Yes, that should be it. Don’t rush; let’s watch a little longer.”
With that, guided by her indication, they began to wait patiently.
After about five minutes, they witnessed the wound starting to show signs of healing, and even the green liquid that had flowed out before now had completely disappeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 458: 458: The System Reappears
chapters.content:
Chapter 458: Chapter 458: The System Reappears
After seeing these circumstances, Ling’er let out a long sigh of relief. It seemed that all her conjectures were completely without issue, and moreover, all of it was founded on solid reasoning.
“Alright, now looking at the situation, there shouldn’t be much of a problem. Later Stages, I’ll use some other medicines to treat his wounds. I believe they should heal pretty quickly.”
“But what exactly caused this?”
“That’s hard to say. In such deep and remote forests, anything is possible. It could be a ferocious predator, or a vicious plant, that much is uncertain.”
“Then let’s hurry up and get back to the tent. We’ll discuss everything else afterwards.”
“Wait a moment, let me see what this is.”
Just then, Ling’er seemed to suddenly notice something glittering on the glistening surface of the swamp, possibly something that had been twinkling all along.
This place was where she had just come into contact with that flower.
If so, could it be something that had fallen from the flower buds?
Ling’er had always been cautious in her actions, so upon realizing all this, she indeed felt a bit nervous and quickly made her way back towards the edge of the swamp.
Once there, she saw something that appeared very hard, and under the moonlight, it looked like the face of a diamond, indeed emitting a very brilliant light.
Just as he was about to reach out and grab it, suddenly, she saw a dark shadow appear before her.
Following that, she felt her arm being vigorously pulled.
Ling’er instinctively shouted out loud, and fortunately, Hei Lang reacted rapidly. He grabbed her firmly around her waist and began to drag her desperately outwards.
But in front of them was a massive beast that had seized his arm, and if they persisted, it was very likely that it would drag them all into the swamp.
“Big brother, quick, think of something!”
He shouted loudly. At last, the man looked around, pulled something resembling an iron core from his bag, and with all his strength, Lin Yi hit the dark massive beast repeatedly.
And in an instant, Lin Yi clearly heard a strange cry in mid-air, and quickly, the surface of the swamp was disturbed by waves, then it completely vanished without a trace.
After seeing all this, Lin Yi let out a long sigh of relief. Although he didn’t know what it was, they had for the moment seemingly escaped a disaster.
“Are you alright?”
He turned to look and found that her hand was now a bloody mess, and at this moment, she had completely passed out.
“Ling’er, how do you feel?”
He vigorously shook Ling’er’s body, but at this moment, she had no response whatsoever.
“Quick, hurry back to the tent, Ling’er’s condition is very critical.”
As he spoke, he immediately picked up Ling’er and the two of them quickly ran towards the tent.
After reaching the place, they gradually became aware that Ling’er had already lost consciousness.
Subsequently, Lin Yi used the supplies from the pack to give Ling’er a simple dressing.
He was not a doctor after all, and he was unclear about how exactly to handle the situation.
“It’s no good, the situation is very urgent. Under these circumstances, we must get to a hospital, we need to evacuate from here overnight.”
“Evacuate? Now, we’re evacuating right now?”
Upon hearing this, Hei Lang was indeed surprised.
How long they had walked into the depths, they dared not even imagine, and what might happen next, no one could know.
“Yes, now, because the situation has become very urgent, we can’t wait any longer, we need to hurry up.”
“Okay, I got it.”
Although Hei Lang was not clear about the specific emergency at hand, judging by the current circumstances, he guessed that they could no longer delay.
He quickly started preparing the equipment here, when suddenly Lin Yi felt a warmth on his forehead.
Following that, he could clearly see at the spot in front of him, where Ling’er was injured, there appeared to be a bone fracture.
He was surprised, as the system had clearly not been awakened a moment ago, and this function had completely disappeared.
Why did it suddenly reappear at this moment?
To confirm this, Lin Yi quickly stepped forward and observed carefully.
Yes, he saw it clearly, there should be a fracture at the wrist.
“Wait a minute.”
He extended his hand and then gestured to Hei Lang.
Originally, Hei Lang had already started to pack up the tent, but after hearing what Lin Yi said, he was puzzled about what new emergency had cropped up.
“Brother, is there something else?”
“For now, let’s not leave.”
“What? Brother, you, you’re saying we’re not leaving?”
“Right, let’s not leave for now, do this, go wait for me by the tent over there, and then, keep an eye on the hunter’s condition. If there’s no problem, guard this place for now, I’ll do a quick check on Ling’er first.”
“Oh, okay, I got it.”
Although this made Hei Lang even more confused.
He really didn’t understand what medicine Lin Yi was selling in his gourd, saying they’d leave one moment and then not the next, and now, what exactly did he want to do?
Forget it, it really wasn’t necessary to continue with these things here because he felt continuing the conversation seemed pointless.
Afterwards, he followed Lin Yi’s instructions, got up, and left from this place, walking directly into the adjacent tent.
Lin Yi seemed to be starting to feel something now, even though he didn’t know how much help the system might be this time, but at the very least, it proved the system was apparently still alive within him.
“System, is that you?”
After Hei Lang had left, Lin Yi tentatively asked in the tent.
“It’s me, I’m here.”
“Damn, where have you been these past two days? Why couldn’t I contact you?”
“Scenario restrictions, unable to appear.”
“What do you mean, ‘scenario restrictions, unable to appear’? I don’t understand.”
“Execute task, save lives and heal injuries.”
After hearing this, Lin Yi felt as though a lot had suddenly become clear to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 459: 459: New System Task
chapters.content:
Chapter 459: Chapter 459: New System Task
However, the words spoken by the system now indeed filled Lin Yi with awe from head to toe.
At the very least, it proved that the system had not left him.
As for what kind of situational constraints he was under, and how that led to its inability to appear, Lin Yi couldn’t understand any of it anyway.
As long as it could manifest within his body, allowing him to exert his unique abilities, Lin Yi felt very content inside.
“You mean to say, you want me to help Ling’er heal her injuries?”
“Upon successful aid, the system will unlock new skills for you.”
“What kind of abilities will be unlocked?”
“Saving lives and helping the injured, please execute the task immediately.”
After hearing this, Lin Yi could only smile wryly.
Every time, the system seemed to maintain a sense of mystery when it appeared.
And that sense of mystery seemed never to have truly disappeared from the beginning to the end.
“Alright, I understand.”
And finally, he heard its first sound, and then, the system seemed to quiet down within his body once again.
He took a deep breath, relieved that the system could still appear in time, which meant that Ling’er should be alright.
However, he was still somewhat worried inside.
After all, he was not a surgeon, and when it came to treating such wounds, he did not know if he had the ability to do so.
If Liu Yao were here at this time, perhaps she really could have provided him with the greatest help,
But now, unfortunately, bringing Liu Yao over was simply impractical.
Having thought this, he had no choice but to act independently this time.
After crouching down, he simply closed his eyes and then reached out to gently caress the area where his hand was injured.
Following that, when he opened his eyes, he clearly saw the shape of the bones inside Ling’er.
He saw that in the position of two of the bones, there was an obvious displacement and dislocation.
This must have occurred during the pulling process, having yanked her bones out forcefully.
Upon realizing this, he felt unbearable pain.
One could imagine how much pain Ling’er must have endured at that time.
And at that moment, after letting out a scream of agony, she fainted on the spot.
Now, Lin Yi realized that it wasn’t just fainting but passing out due to excruciating pain.
Soon after, a very clear skeletal diagram appeared within his body.
Of course, regarding the treatment of the bones, the details were also displayed very clearly in Lin Yi’s mind.
At this moment, his hands felt completely out of control, and then his fingers began to move back and forth.
Even now, he was unclear about what exactly he was doing.
But at the final step, Lin Yi clearly heard a “click” sound.
Following that, when he looked over, he found that the skeleton had been completely exposed.
Now, all the bones had been fully joined together.
Having seen this step through, Lin Yi finally let out a long sigh of relief.
The process just now felt like he was entering a dream; he had no clue what had actually happened.
He wiped the sweat that had appeared on his forehead with his hand.
Glancing at the time, it had been 40 minutes since he had started treating her.
In those 40 minutes, he was even unaware of what he had been doing.
The next problem to address was likely her external wounds.
But why did he suddenly feel a slight fever in the palm of his hand?
Could it be that this was a key feature of healing wounds?
Subsequently, Lin Yi instinctively placed his hand over Ling’er’s injury.
Although Lin Yi knew that such direct contact might cause pain, fortunately, Ling’er was still unconscious at the time, and perhaps she had no memory of any of this.
She was muttering under her breath, praying silently in the hope that it all would end smoothly.
He then felt a warm current continuously flowing down from the palm of his hand.
Unable to resist, he opened his eyes and bent down to take a sneak peek.
Only then did he realize that the bleeding from the wounds seemed to have stopped.
It was a very strange occurrence; did his hand also have hemostatic capabilities now?
The temperature of his fingers had reached its limit, and Lin Yi was well aware that the normal human body temperature was 37 degrees Celsius; any temperature beyond that would be noticeably hot to the touch.
But there was no choice; to treat Ling’er, he had to endure it all.
The temperature began to drop gradually.
His other hand pressed down on the one that was healing; he feared that because of the burning sensation, he might suddenly pull away from the injury.
It felt as though he was holding a furnace in his hand.
Unsure how long the process lasted, he found himself drenched in sweat, as if he could hardly hold on any longer.
Suddenly, he heard a scream from Ling’er.
Afterward, he quickly moved his hand away.
When he looked again, Lin Yi found that the wounds had completely sealed shut.
Although there were still some visible cracks, at least they had begun to show signs of healing.
However, a tiny amount of blood was still seeping out, but Lin Yi knew this was essentially harmless.
With this assurance, at least Ling’er’s life had been saved.
“Ling’er, how are you feeling?”
Lin Yi saw that Ling’er had opened her eyes weakly at that moment.
“I… I feel like the wound is very painful.”
“Don’t worry, I’ve just finished treating you. Now, the wound shouldn’t be a big issue, and I’ll just need to bandage it up simply.”
Ling’er, hearing Lin Yi’s words, seemed somewhat disbelieving.
She had no idea when Lin Yi had acquired such an ability.

chapters.title: Chapter 460: 460: Treating Ling'er
chapters.content:
Chapter 460: Chapter 460: Treating Ling’er
Finally, Ling’er reached out her hand, and then, glanced at it.
The hands she had just seen were a blur of blood and flesh, but now, they seemed to have been completely mended.
Although there were still visible scars, for her, this was already a remarkably good recovery.
“This, this is, did you heal this?”
He was surprised, and then just curiously widened his eyes, looking at Lin Yi as he spoke.
“Yes, I healed it. How is it, shouldn’t be any problem now, right? Also, these wounds might look a bit cracked for now, but don’t worry, given time, they’ll slowly fade.”
“You, when did you, when did you learn to do surgery for external injuries?”
“Well, I can’t quite tell you that. Besides, I have some special…, never mind, you won’t understand even if I tell you. Come on, all I need to do now is dress these wounds for you. Right, don’t you have some anti-inflammatory medicine over there?”
“Yes, it’s in my bag. Then, you see there’s white powder, if you can spread some of that powder over these wounds now, it not only acts as an anti-inflammatory and analgesic but even promotes the regeneration of cells.”
As he spoke, Lin Yi walked over and then, according to Ling’er’s instructions, sprinkled the white powder all over the wounds.
Afterward, he took out a white bandage and carefully wrapped Lin Yi’s hands until they were fully dressed.
“How is it, feeling better now?”
Well, would you believe it, the pain really did decrease a lot, and there didn’t seem to be any major problem anymore.
While speaking, Ling’er tried to stretch out her hand, wanting to move it around, and found that at this moment, mobility didn’t seem to be greatly restricted.
“So, my hand, my hand should be fine now, right?”
“Don’t worry, there’s no serious problem.”
“That’s great, you really saved me this time, and what exactly happened just now? Why do I feel like something bit me?”
“Right, when you were about to leave the Swamp, suddenly, a large monster appeared. It just bit your hand and then tried to drag you further inside.”
“Are you saying it tried to pull me into the Swamp?”
“Yes, that’s likely the case. Therefore, we desperately pulled you up and in the end, we managed to get you out, but unfortunately your hand…”
“What about before? The monster the hunter encountered, is it the same as what we imagined?”
“Exactly, it should be the same. Moreover, I suspect that you got some sweat or fluid on you from its injury at the time, which attracted the monster’s emergence.”
“Right, where is that hunter now?”
“Don’t worry, thanks to your special medicine, he’s gradually stabilizing. Rest in your tent for now, and we’ll make further arrangements after dawn.”
“No, I have to go over and see.”
“No need, as I’ve told you, if I can handle a severe wound like yours here, do you think his injury might encounter any further complications?”
As Lin Yi spoke, he just smiled slightly.
Then Ling’er thought carefully, and it seemed she could only agree.
Such a function for treating and recovering from wounds was seemingly beyond the reach of ordinary people.
Now, she was filled with curiosity about Ling’er.
Actually, ever since she worked at the pharmaceutical factory, she had felt unclear about where Lin Yi got his formulas from.
Moreover, these formulas were beyond her imagination.
These herbs, when combined, turned into a new kind of medicine, which then exhibited powerful effects.
That was something Ling’er had always been unable to comprehend,
But having experienced this trip to Xi Lian Mountain, her sense of mystery surrounding Lin Yi had intensified once again.
“Well alright, you’re right, after such a long night, I truly feel exhausted both physically and mentally. I’ll rest well, and if anything happens, wake me up.”
“Yes, yes, sleep well. When you wake up, there should be no problems. Alright, I’ll stay outside, and if there are any issues, I’ll come over immediately.”
Having said that, he gently patted her shoulder, then placed a blanket over her back.
After that, Lin Yi stepped out of the tent.
Outside, the night was still pitch black.
However, what dangers were lurking under this quiet night? That was something Lin Yi could not begin to fathom,
All he knew right now was that he must get through tonight safely, only then would he know what to do next.
“Mission accomplished, continue the work of saving lives and attending to the injured.”
All of a sudden, the system made an announcement.
Upon hearing it, Lin Yi was momentarily stunned.
That wasn’t right. The system had clearly told him earlier that once he healed Ling’er, he would immediately be granted a new skill.
But why hadn’t this skill been bestowed yet?
Was it possible that his task wasn’t thoroughly completed?
Yet, Lin Yi had just examined closely with his Heavenly Eye and found that the palm of the hand was completely mended, and the wound had been connected.
So, what was still unfulfilled?
Could it be that Ling’er’s wound hadn’t fully recovered?
If that were the case, it seemed they would have to wait longer.
Never mind, it was a promise from the system to him, and Lin Yi felt that it ought to uphold that promise.
Through his long dealings with the system, he had pretty well understood its character and the frequency of its appearances.
Then, Lin Yi turned around and walked into the nearby tent.
Upon entering, he saw the hunter apparently talking to Hei Lang.
“Big brother, are you alright?”
Seeing Lin Yi coming in, Hei Lang quickly stood up from the ground and looked at Lin Yi with concern.
“Oh, nothing much, old brother, are you okay?”

chapters.title: Chapter 461: 461: The Hunter's Candor
chapters.content:
Chapter 461: Chapter 461: The Hunter’s Candor
He walked over and saw that the hunter’s spirit had recovered somewhat.
Although he had not fully returned to a normal state, at the very least, it seemed there should not be any major problem now.
“I’m so, so sorry, this time, I’ve really caused you all a lot of trouble.”
“Enough, save those words for later, you should lie down first, I’m going to check your wound now, see what’s the situation.”
“You, you’re going to look at my wound?”
After hearing this, the hunter showed a surprised look.
He had thought that within this team, the only one who could possibly save him was that little girl.
Moreover, he had heard Hei Lang give him a simple description earlier, about the dangers they had encountered in order to save him.
Therefore, when he saw Lin Yi, the hunter indeed felt guilty emotionally, and even, somewhat dared not face him.
Under Lin Yi’s instruction, the hunter lay down again.
Lin Yi examined carefully and found that the hunter’s vital areas had actually not been hit, and at the very least, the bones were intact.
It’s just that his wound was rather deep, which was why it appeared quite horrifying.
Fortunately, Ling’er had already treated him in time, and with Lin Yi’s additional treatment, he believed the hunter’s leg could probably regain normal function by tomorrow morning.
Afterward, Lin Yi extended his hand, and the warm current surged out once again.
Lin Yi kept moving back and forth over the wound.
“What, what is this? Why do I feel, feel some pain in my wound, and even a bit of heat?”
“It’s okay, this is a normal reaction, just hold on for a bit more, in a little while, it should not be a big issue anymore.”
Although the hunter did not quite understand, when he saw Lin Yi speaking seriously, without any sign of joking, it proved that what was happening must be real.
Obviously, even now Lin Yi had no idea what kind of treatment he was performing.
But he trusted the guidance assuredly, with the system continuously assisting inside his body in silence.
Every movement of his hands was actually coordinated by the brain, and this brain, at that very moment, simply wasn’t under any external control.
Finally, Lin Yi saw that the temperature in his fingers had gradually begun to subside, which meant, the treatment was nearing its end.
In the end, they heaved a long sigh of relief, then lifted his hands off.
However, to prevent the hunter from thinking too much, Lin Yi decided not to remove the bandage right now.
Because, once removed, it would be clear that the wound inside had completely healed, and the hunter would definitely find it unimaginable.
He also worried that after the hunter went back, he might describe the events that had happened at Xi Lian Mountain to others, which could potentially endanger Lin Yi’s situation.
“All right, it should not be a big issue anymore, now, does it feel less painful than before?”
“You’re right, it really is. And now the pain is at least bearable. When I was chatting with that brother just now, I felt an excruciating pain, but it has nearly disappeared now.”
“Good, if all goes well, you should be able to get up and move around normally after tomorrow’s sunrise.”
“What, what did you say? Get up and move around normally, that, that’s impossible, isn’t it? I heard from that brother that my wound seemed pretty severe.”
The hunter could hardly believe it, and although he hadn’t seen his own wound, he knew he had been through a lot in that swamp.
He only had a rough idea from the intermittent account Hei Lang had given him, including the terrible state he was in when he was rescued, which was still vivid in his memory.
“It wasn’t that terrible. After all, they were just flesh wounds; the blood loss was severe at the time, and when mixed with the mud from the swamp, it looked frightening. But with timely cleaning, there should not be a big problem. Don’t worry; it definitely won’t affect anything.”
Upon hearing this, the hunter still appeared somewhat skeptical as he kept examining his leg, rotating it here and there.
“By the way, bro, now that we have some downtime, I want to chat with you. Why aren’t you sleeping in the tent in the middle of the night? What were you doing in the swamp?”
At this point, the hunter suddenly stopped his movements and lowered his head in embarrassment.
“I’m really sorry, it’s my bad for being too greedy, but as you know, I have only this one son, and I don’t want him to live in this village all year round like me. I want to make some money to send him to the city, to give him the best education, so that I can do right by my child.”
Upon saying this, he sighed helplessly. Regarding these rural aspirations, Lin Yi understood them all too well.
After all, who doesn’t come from farming ancestry a few generations back? His own family background wasn’t that great either, so concerning his current genuine intentions, Lin Yi felt a deep understanding in his heart.
“Yes, I can understand what you’re saying, but the key issue is, if you want to make money, you must go through proper channels. If you take such risks, don’t you realize you could lose your life?”
“My life isn’t worth that much. If I really lost it, as long as these herbs can be preserved, I believe my family would be able to live worry-free.”
“You’re wrong. Let me tell you, these herbs will wither completely just by staying in the deep mountains for two days, and you won’t be able to get a good price for them in the market, do you understand?”
“But, but before, that girl told me they’re priceless in the market.”
“Yes, they are priceless, but that’s if you have the professional equipment, the kind for preserving freshness. Do you have such tools?”

chapters.title: Chapter 462: 462: Bestowing New Skills
chapters.content:
Chapter 462: Chapter 462: Bestowing New Skills
“Preservation tools?”
“Yes, with the current environment and temperature, if you hold onto it for a day here, let alone a day, perhaps in half a day, I’m afraid it will become completely unusable. If you really have professional preservation tools, then if you put it inside, perhaps, it might still last a few days. When you take it to the market, you could sell it for a good price.”
“Really, do we really need that?”
“What else? What do you think, that once you take it out, you can easily sell it? It’s not that simple. If it were, then all of us could make money and become rich.”
“I’m also to blame for being a country person, and having little experience, not knowing that there is so much to this. If I had known it would be like this, I would never have taken this route.”
“What I’m saying to you today isn’t meant to blame you. Moreover, I understand everything you’re thinking of now. At that time, I actually saw your family situation. Rest assured, after this matter is finished and we’re out, I will still give you money, and by then, it will be enough for your child to go to school in the city.”
“Are you serious, are you really serious?”
When he heard this, he genuinely felt overwhelmed.
After all, he had made a serious mistake here. If these people really stopped trusting him, he could understand all of it.
But now, having voiced all his concerns and to hear that none of it mattered anymore.
So, he started to worry a little inside.
Could it be that they really stopped trusting him?
Therefore, when Lin Yi finished speaking to him, he instead felt that these people still deeply trusted him.
“Right, as long as I’ve promised something, I can definitely do it. As long as we get out safely, rest assured. Sending your child to the city for school, I’ve got it covered. My word is my bond.”
“Good man, good man, I, I thank, I thank you.”
The hunter began to rise from the ground, overcome with emotion, probably wanting to kneel before him, but Lin Yi simply extended his hand and pressed him back down.
“Have you forgotten what situation you’re in? Your wound has just been bandaged. If you move too much, I’m afraid the wound might reopen, and I can’t guarantee it then.”
“Oh, right, right, it’s all my fault, okay, I know, I know.”
“Alright, if you truly wish to repay me, then on this journey through Xi Lian Mountain, you must give it your all. Try to ensure that all of us can leave here safely.”
“Don’t worry, even if I have to leave my life here, I will make sure you all leave safely. Because I know, the only one who can bring happiness to my family is you, my benefactor.”
“Enough, don’t mention it. Now, it’s already late, take your time and rest.”
“Okay, I got it. Tomorrow, we’ll get up early. Let me think tonight, where we should start looking.”
As he spoke, the hunter took out that map from his bosom again and placed it under a rechargeable lamp.
“What, aren’t you going to rest?”
“Rest? I already had enough sleep just now, and I usually sleep little when I’m home anyway. Don’t worry about me, you all just take care of your own business. If you’re sleepy, go ahead and take a nap there.”
At this moment, the hunter seemed to have made up his mind and didn’t expect to continue sleeping here.
After thinking about it, he just helplessly shook his head and then got up to leave the tent.
For Lin Yi, today was definitely going to be a sleepless night too.
Because he had practically given up on everything and was ready to leave Xi Lian Mountain, but unexpectedly, just as he was about to give up, everything suddenly came back to him.
This change felt so swift that he himself had trouble accepting it.
Under the early moonlight, he could still feel the specks of moonlight sprinkled over him.
He didn’t know how much further they had to travel, nor what dangers might await them.
But Lin Yi firmly believed in one thing, with the system and the support of the people around him, they should be able to get through this journey smoothly.
“Ding ding ding.” Lin Yi’s body began to sound an alarm. When he heard this familiar sound, he suddenly became excited.
Because he knew something very clearly, every time assignments like this occurred, the system would randomly grant him a skill.
He really had no idea what skill the system had assigned to him this time.
“Mission complete, system awards a bonus of 50,000 yuan, and imparts the Divine Skill ‘The Hand of the External Sage’.”
“What? The Hand of the External Sage?”
Lin Yi was somewhat perplexed and confused.
“This skill, in the future, you should slowly come to experience its benefits. Also, you should have noticed just now that your hand seems to have a magical power. That’s the ability attached to you by the system.”
At this realization, Lin Yi suddenly had an epiphany.
No wonder, he had felt a warm current flowing through his hand, and it had miraculously healed the wounds together.
Could this be the so-called Hand of the External Sage? If it really has that function, then it feels a bit too powerful for him.
Now Lin Yi understood the skeletal structure of the human body, including how each bone fit together, and on top of that, he now had the power to heal externally—wasn’t this a combination of internal and external skills?
He was quite excited inside.
It seemed that the system was continuously granting him new abilities, and these skills were gradually making him stronger.
“In the face of danger ahead, will you be able to provide assistance to me?”
“System, system, you’re gone again?”

chapters.title: Chapter 463: 463 Danger Ahead
chapters.content:
Chapter 463: Chapter 463 Danger Ahead
He said a sentence, just wanting to ask and see, what kind of path the system could point out for him next, but he found that the system had once again disappeared from his body.
In fact, Lin Yi understood this; after all, he wasn’t born with this thing, but rather it was imposed upon him later in life.
So, there were some paths that he had to tread by himself, but when truly at an impasse, he believed that the system would certainly come to his rescue.
“Big brother.”
Just at this moment, he suddenly heard a voice, so he quickly turned around to look.
Lin Yi discovered that at some point, Hei Lang had come to his side, and he was completely oblivious to all of it.
“Hei Lang, when did you come out? Didn’t I tell you? You should rest in the tent, have a good rest. You’ve also had a long day today.”
“Big brother, I just can’t sleep, and moreover, as soon as I lay down, I feel very tired, but no matter how I try, I can’t fall asleep. So, I thought I might as well come out and chat with you for a bit.”
“Then, when did you come out?”
Lin Yi felt a bit nervous as he didn’t know how much Hei Lang had overheard while he was conversing with the system just now.
Although Hei Lang was his closest brother, and their relationship had already grown so close,
he still didn’t want to disclose certain things and always felt that once spoken, those concepts would seem completely unacceptable to them as ordinary people.
“Oh, I just came out not too long ago. Big brother, have you been under a lot of pressure lately?”
“What do you mean, under a lot of pressure?”
After listening to what Hei Lang said, Lin Yi suddenly became nervous. Hei Lang would definitely not just casually ask such a question without having his own thoughts.
“Big brother, today I’ve noticed several times that you’ve been murmuring to yourself, as if you were talking to someone.”
“Really? I, I wasn’t aware of that at all.”
“It was very obvious. At that time, both Ling’er and I noticed it, and just now, I felt like you were whispering to yourself.”
“Then what did I say? Did you hear it?”
“No, I couldn’t make out what you were saying, you just kept muttering indistinctly.”
“Oh, that’s possible, I guess.”
“Big brother, you can’t take on everything yourself, and if there are any difficulties, I can help you, carry the burden together.”
“Yes, I know, I know.”
“Big brother, if you continue like this, I really won’t know what to do. If there’s any pressure or burden, just say it out loud; if I can help you, I definitely will without any hesitation.”
“Don’t worry, if I need your help, I definitely won’t be shy about it.”
“Big brother, why did you suddenly propose giving up today? And then, just as suddenly, you proposed to continue standing guard? What exactly is on your mind? Tomorrow, are we going into the mountains, or are we leaving them?”
“Into the mountains.”
Lin Yi responded quickly. Now that the system had appeared, and although the two people by his side had experienced some tribulations, they were now, essentially, up and okay.
“Good, since you want to go into the mountains, then I will definitely accompany you. Just, I hope that you won’t say halfway through that you want to leave or anything like that.”
“Don’t worry, that absolutely won’t happen this time, and we must enter deep into the mountains to get what we want.”
“Good, with your word, I can completely relax.”
“Alright, since you are reassured, then you have no need to stay here any longer. Hurry back to the tent and get some good sleep.”
“Okay, I understand, well then, big brother.”
Just as he was about to turn around and leave, all of a sudden, Hei Lang saw something that appeared to be a couple of lightbulbs, continuously shaking in the direction right in front of him.
Due to his experiences in the cave during the daytime, he could instantly identify that this thing was likely a kind of magical beast.
At this moment, he was right behind Lin Yi, so Lin Yi was completely unaware of any of this.
“Why are you still standing there? Didn’t I tell you? Hurry back.”
“Big brother, don’t move.”
Hei Lang lowered his voice as much as he could and then said seriously to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi immediately stopped moving, his brow furrowing slightly.
He saw that Hei Lang’s eyes were fixed on the side of his body.
It was clear that there was something potentially dangerous at his side.
He didn’t dare to move even slightly.
“Is there something there?”
“I can’t see clearly.”
“Right now, how far is it from me?”
“Probably about seventy to eighty meters away.”
“If I move now, will it move with me?”
“I don’t know; its eyes seemed to be moving a moment ago.”
“What about now?”
“Right now, it’s not moving.”
“Is it coming forward at all?”
“No, not a bit, but I can see very clearly.”
“Are the eyes big?”
“Not as big as the ones we saw before, but, I guess, not too small either.”
“I’m going to try to move my body a bit now; you pay attention to its movements. If it really pounces, you must warn me immediately, understand?”
“Okay, I know, big brother, please be very careful.”
Now, it wasn’t only Lin Yi who felt hesitant to move forward, even Hei Lang was not daring to move too close.
With none of their tools on hand, if that prey turned to counter-attack all of a sudden, their bare-handed combat power as werewolves would hardly be enough to withstand it all.
Lin Yi took a deep breath, thinking that he would have passed the night smoothly, but unexpectedly, he still faced such danger.
Now that Hunter and Ling’er were inside the tent, he didn’t dare to disturb them carelessly.
He also feared that a loud noise might wake the prey, and then the four of them would likely not escape misfortune.
He only shifted his body forward ever so slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 464: 464: A Huge Hedgehog?
chapters.content:
Chapter 464: Chapter 464: A Huge Hedgehog?
“Anything moving behind us?”
“No, still nothing. Big Brother, the frequency at which you’re moving now shouldn’t be an issue. If you just slowly turn your body around, that should do it.”
Lin Yi just slowly nodded. He had already figured out the pattern—these small movements were unlikely to catch that guy’s attention.
He turned bit by bit, a movement that would normally take less than a second to complete, but after turning around, it took him a full half minute.
Finally, he got a clear view of the prey behind him, and at that moment, the prey was still lingering not far from him.
“Is that a patch of grass over there, if I remember correctly?”
“Yes, indeed, it’s a patch of grass.”
“Then if I’m not mistaken, he should be in the grass right now, right?”
“Yes, I know he’s in the grass, but I don’t know when he might suddenly attack. If we can’t defend against that, we’ll really be in trouble.”
“How did he find this place? Never mind, let’s not talk about that now. You go back to the tent quickly and take out all your tools because I think we have to take him down.”
“Okay, I understand.”
As he spoke, he glanced this way because he saw that the tent entrance was only about 10 meters away.
To cover 10 meters in the past was nothing at all, even a large stride would have sufficed, but now, under these circumstances, Hei Lang truly felt like he was getting much older.
Lin Yi, on the other hand, remained standing upright the entire time because he found that as long as their movements were not too abrupt, that thing would keep watching them motionlessly.
Therefore, it seemed like the situation had reached a deadlock, but luckily Lin Yi was mentally prepared in advance. If it was going to be this persistent, then he had to continue to endure.
Out of necessity, Lin Yi sat down on the ground. Standing was draining.
Suddenly, he saw that guy move forward two steps, but after slowing to a stop, Lin Yi noticed that he too had completely stopped moving.
Having seen this, he breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed that sitting down had indeed attracted that guy’s attention.
After waiting for an unknown length of time, Lin Yi now felt something gradually approaching him. Turning around for a look, he discovered that it was Hei Lang at his side.
Hei Lang was lying flat on the ground, and of course, he kept the bag he carried tightly clutched in his hand.
“Hei Lang, why are you lying here?”
“Big Brother, I feel it now—we can’t afford to stand up and walk. If we do, we’ll definitely disturb him, but lying still on the ground doesn’t seem to alarm her.”
“So you mean to say, he might not see us if we’re lying flat on the ground, or that he subconsciously doesn’t perceive us as a threat because we’re not aggressive, is that what you’re suggesting?”
“Exactly, that should be the case.”
“Well, looking at it this way, it seems we really need to go over there, but first, we should deal with his physical problem.”
“Don’t worry, I know what to do.”
After speaking, Hei Lang nodded, then took a set of tools out of his carry-on bag.
He placed these tools on the ground in front of him.
Now, lying flat on the ground, his actions seemed even more cautious and steady.
He aimed at the object and then pressed the trigger. Quickly, he saw something white fly out from in front of his eyes.
Then there was a muffled sound.
But he heard no loud cry follow.
Afterward, the two bright spots disappeared.
Hei Lang nodded slightly, guessing that his strike likely had a decisive effect.
“How is it? What’s the situation now?”
“I’m not sure, but to be safe, Big Brother, wait here; I’ll go over and check.”
“What? Check it out? At this time, going over there, wouldn’t that be like walking into a tiger’s den? What if he’s not really dead, or is just feigning death?”
“It should be fine. I used an anesthetic solution earlier. Even if it doesn’t kill him, the anesthetic taking effect in his body should have some impact. Don’t worry, it should be fine.”
With those words, Hei Lang crawled up from the ground and gently patted off the dust on himself.
He moved his body slightly and noticed that the bright spots still hadn’t reappeared.
“Good, if that’s the case, then it proves our situation is still within a safe range for now.”
He walked over, and then, he quietly approached the patch of grass.
As he came closer to the grass, he saw a black mass, which at the time was lying on the ground.
But Hei Lang felt that this black mass was still moving up and down—it seemingly hadn’t completely died.
Gathering his courage, he turned on his flashlight.
To his surprise, hidden in the grass was a giant hedgehog.
It seemed to have some spines on its body, but comparing it to the hedgehogs they’d seen before, it didn’t quite match up.
However, now with his flashlight, he could see it was definitely not dead.
Clearly, its thick spines had shielded it from the blow, but the tranquilizer had penetrated its system.
That’s why it was in such a state now.
Using the tool in his hand, Lin Yi gently prodded it and found no significant reaction.
Moreover, it was huge; if it truly was a hedgehog, then it might well be dubbed the king of hedgehogs.
“Hei Lang, what’s happening over there?”
As Lin Yi waited here, after what felt like ages, it seemed Hei Lang still wasn’t moving at all, so he began to get impatient.
He also worried that Hei Lang might experience some mishap, and with two people already injured, if another was hurt, even Lin Yi himself would find it hard to bear.

chapters.title: Chapter 465: 465: Both Fully Recovered
chapters.content:
Chapter 465: Chapter 465: Both Fully Recovered
“Big brother, it’s nothing; he’s already fainted. If you’re worried, you can come over and take a look,”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi quickly rushed forward.
By the light of the flashlight, he immediately noticed that this thing was indeed very strange.
“Is this, is this a hedgehog?”
“What else? Just now, I was also wondering whether this was a hedgehog. If it’s not, then what could have those spikes on it?”
“I remember seeing something in this jungle before, a creature with spikes on its body… it’s called a porcupine, have you heard of it?”
“Oh, I do know about that, but this clearly isn’t a porcupine.”
“Right, if you put it that way, it indeed doesn’t look like a porcupine, and porcupines don’t have this kind of appearance.”
“Exactly, so it’s probably not… ”
“Forget it, let’s not trouble ourselves with what it is. Just toss it here.”
“Toss it here?”
“Yeah, didn’t you see it’s completely unconscious? Oh right, how long can your medicine last?”
“If it goes well, I estimate it should last about a day. It probably won’t wake up by tomorrow morning.”
“That’ll do then. Let’s just leave it here for now, and when it gets light tomorrow, we’ll tell the hunter and see if he recognizes it. If its meat is edible, maybe we can improve our living conditions.”
After saying that, Lin Yi just smiled faintly.
