“Right brother, now that you mention it, I hadn’t thought of that. But let’s not do that. I have some canvas bags over there. I’ll put it in one and seal it up so that it can’t escape.”
“Alright, if you want to do that, then do it here. I can’t anymore; I need to rush back and rest. There’s a lot to do when day breaks.”
“All good, big brother, I’ll handle this, and I’ll be right over after I finish up.”
After arranging everything here, Lin Yi turned and went straight back to the tent.
At that moment, he entered Ling’er’s tent.
He found Ling’er sleeping soundly; perhaps, after being tossed around all day and sustaining some injuries, she was now sleeping very sweetly.
He didn’t want to disturb her, so he quietly lay down in a corner.
He slept soundly until daylight.
When he opened his eyes, Lin Yi could clearly feel that sunlight was already shining in from outside.
Lin Yi just stretched out languidly and saw that Ling’er was still not awake.
Never mind, it’s better to let her sleep if she wants to. Sleeping a bit longer may even help her recover her strength.
So Lin Yi quietly left the tent and immediately saw the hunter standing outside, lost in thought as if contemplating something.
“Old buddy, how’s it going, awake now? There shouldn’t be any problems now, right?”
He rushed forward excitedly. His leg had been so severely injured the day before, but now, after a night’s rest, he found his leg had significantly recovered.
The hunter merely turned his head and then suddenly knelt down before Lin Yi.
“Old buddy, what are you doing? Get up, get up, come on, get up.”
Some things, he didn’t understand why the hunter would suddenly do this. Could it be because he didn’t show respect last night, so he was making up for it with this big gesture?
“You really made me re-evaluate you guys. And my leg, which was seriously injured, I found is almost healed this morning.”
“What? Completely healed?”
Saying this, Lin Yi quickly looked down, but his leg was still obviously wrapped in gauze, albeit thinner than yesterday.
The hunter just smiled and then unwrapped the gauze.
Now, the wounds on his leg were indeed healed, as if by magic every trace of harm had disappeared.
But looking closely, one could still see that this place must have sustained some injury.
“Do you see it now?”
“Oh, I see it, but what’s so strange about it?”
“What? Normally, a small wound wouldn’t heal for three to five days. That’s quite normal, right? But now, such a long wound has healed overnight. Don’t you think it’s all a bit too magical?”
“What’s so magical about it? Isn’t that normal?”
“No, in my view, it’s far from normal. Most people can’t achieve this, not even doctors in hospitals can guarantee it.”
“That’s not necessarily the case. You shouldn’t jump to conclusions and can’t say for sure that it’s like that.”
“Anyway, what I realize now is that there’s definitely something extraordinary about you guys, and you’re not ordinary people.”
“How can we not be ordinary people? If we’re not ordinary people, would we be Immortals?”
“You’re almost not too different from Immortals, but don’t worry, I understand what you’re trying to say. Having experienced all this, I absolutely won’t speak of it to anyone. Rest assured, even after I leave, I will keep my mouth shut.”
Actually, Lin Yi understood this too. He too hoped that these people wouldn’t talk about it because, otherwise, it would surely bring him more trouble.
“Alright, as long as you understand. Moreover, I can only tell you that our method of treatment may be a bit different from those used in hospitals. We choose to follow a different path, which might be why the wounds heal somewhat faster for us.”
“Okay, I got it. I won’t ask too many questions.”
“Ah, by the way, where’s Hei Lang?”
“Oh, he’s sleeping soundly. He probably went to bed too late yesterday, so when I got up this morning and saw he was still quiet, I didn’t disturb him.”
“Alright then, are you hungry? If you are, there’s some food over there. We could eat something.”

chapters.title: Chapter 466: 466: This is the God Hunter
chapters.content:
Chapter 466: Chapter 466: This is the God Hunter
“It’s okay, I’ll talk about it later; after everyone gets up, we’ll eat together.”
“Right, you hardly slept at all last night. Have you thought of a rough route for us to take now?”
“Basically, I’ve pretty much figured it out, and we can just take this path up today.”
As he spoke, he pointed to a small path behind the jungle.
Because it was very late when they arrived here yesterday, the weather outside was a bit hazy, so he hadn’t noticed that there was a trail at this place.
This path looked somewhat rugged, and indeed, it appeared to be quite steep.
“Is this the mountain road we’re taking?”
“Yes, this place should be passable, and if we go from here, we should reach the summit of this peak. Then we can overlook everything.”
“Good, your plan sounds solid. When the time comes, we’ll just go through here.”
“Bro, you guys are up.”
Just then, Hei Lang came out from inside, stretching languorously.
“Ling’er, you’re up too.”
It was indeed a coincidence. Just as he stepped out of the tent, he saw Ling’er coming out too, and both of them made the same motion.
“Ling’er, how’s your injury now? Does it still hurt?”
“It doesn’t hurt anymore, no problem now.”
After saying this, Ling’er just smiled faintly and then flexed her hand.
It seemed that her motor functions had not been restricted in any way.
Relieved by this, Ling’er felt that the efforts she had made before were not wasted.
“Alright, since everyone’s awake, let’s hurry to get some food to come back with. And Hei Lang, pack up the tent.”
“Oh, right, Brother, about the game we caught last night, how are we handling it today?”
“Game?”
After a night’s rest, Lin Yi seemed to have gradually forgotten about it.
“Yes, the game. Don’t tell me you’ve forgotten about it?”
“Hey, if you hadn’t mentioned it, I really might not have remembered, right, right, I remember now. Indeed, there was such a thing. So, did you really bring it back?”
“Of course, I just put it on this side of the tent, come, I’ll get it for you.”
While speaking, he walked over and then went around to the other side of the tent.
The hunter frowned doubtfully and then looked at Lin Yi.
“Game? What game? Did you encounter any danger after I went out last night?”
“Yes, we found a monster in the bushes, but thankfully it didn’t attack us. Then, for safety sake, we shot it dead.”
“Shot it dead?”
“Oh, no, no, it wasn’t really shot dead, more like it was knocked out. Right now, it should still be unconscious.”
“What kind of thing was it?”
“Can’t say for sure. When I first saw it, it seemed like some kind of hedgehog, but on closer inspection, it looked a bit different from a hedgehog.”
“You mean it had spikes like a hedgehog, but was bigger than a hedgehog, right?”
“Well, not just a bit bigger, but significantly larger. Come here, take a look.”
Just then, Hei Lang was seen dragging a large canvas bag over from the other side.
“Wow, this thing is really quite heavy. If we had killed it, there would be enough meat to last us a few days.”
As he spoke, Hei Lang dropped the canvas bag on the ground.
The group quickly approached, then bent down to take a look.
The creature inside did indeed seem enormous.
And normally, game isn’t this large.
But compared to what they had encountered in the cave before, it probably wouldn’t be as huge.
After seeing this, the hunter became even more apprehensive.
So, he quickly took a couple of steps back.
“All of you, step back.”
“What? Step back? It doesn’t have any combat power now. We should be fine surrounding it here. It was just me who stuffed it into the bag yesterday, right?”
Clearly, Hei Lang didn’t understand, and he didn’t grasp what this stepping back meant.
“No, what I mean is, under the current circumstances, we can’t just wait here, especially since we don’t know if it still has any attack power.”
“I guess there shouldn’t be any problem. I didn’t notice anything like that when I observed it yesterday.”
“Better safe than sorry. Step back a bit further for safety. I have a lot of experience dealing with such creatures. Come on, let me handle it.”
After saying this, the hunter pulled out his hunting rifle, adopted a cautious posture, and held it close to his chest.
Seeing this, Lin Yi understood that it was all for the best and said nothing.
He just moved his body back a bit.
“Alright, let’s follow his advice and move back a bit. That way we can keep ourselves safe.”
Ling’er and Hei Lang followed suit, retreating a couple of steps back.
Then, the hunter gradually bent down and opened the canvas bag.
Inside it seemed dark, as if there was something there, but it was unclear what it was for.
The hunter took out a sharp knife from his backpack, and then carefully slit the canvas bag open.
“Hey, that’s mine.”
Hei Lang seemed somewhat distressed by this.
In these circumstances, he hadn’t wanted to damage the canvas bag, especially since finding a canvas bag in these deep woods was not easy.
Watching it being cut open, he truly felt reluctant.
“Well, it’s just a bag. Let it go, and besides, he’s doing it for safety’s sake. The way you packed it yesterday was indeed a bit reckless.”

chapters.title: Chapter 467: 467: Face on the Belly
chapters.content:
Chapter 467: Chapter 467: Face on the Belly
Lin Yi could tell what was occupying Hei Lang’s mind at this time.
However, in front of these matters, the canvas bag seemed to be not so important after all.
After seeing this, Hei Lang did not continue to speak; he just obediently nodded.
Then, the canvas bag was fully opened. Now, that grey thing was completely exposed in front of everyone.
It was only at this moment that Lin Yi realized it wasn’t black but rather a grey thing.
It was covered with spikes all over its body.
It was really indescribable what it felt like; people with trypophobia would certainly be very uncomfortable upon seeing it.
If it really was a normal prey, perhaps it wouldn’t create such an effect.
At the very least, its body size was probably as big as twenty or thirty hedgehogs.
While everyone was observing, the hunter suddenly took a few steps back and then fell to his knees with a thud.
Seeing this, everyone truly didn’t understand what was happening.
“You, what’s wrong with you?”
He was curious and approached the hunter to ask.
“You guys, you are really causing trouble. Do you not realize the big trouble we’ve gotten ourselves into?”
Looking at Lin Yi’s state at that moment, it did not seem like he was joking with them.
“What? What big trouble? What do you mean by that?”
“You, don’t you all know what this is? This is the Hunting God.”
“What? What Hunting God? What’s a Hunting God?”
“Quick, all of you kneel down right now, or none of us will leave here alive.”
When the hunter spoke, his voice was almost a roar.
The crowd didn’t understand at all what had happened.
Why should they suddenly kneel to such an ugly creature?
These people simply couldn’t comprehend it in their hearts.
But seeing the hunter’s state, they also began to realize that they shouldn’t let this go easily at this time.
“Big brother, what does this mean?”
“Enough, don’t say anything else. I reckon you have caused trouble this time. Quick, just kneel down as he says.”
“What? Kneel to it?”
“We’ll talk about it later, quick, kneel down now.”
Hearing Lin Yi speak, and seeing that Lin Yi was the first to kneel down with a thud in front of the prey.
“Hunting God, we are so sorry. We are ignorant and have offended you. If you are unhappy, I hope you won’t take offense and will spare us. I will offer you nice things during festivals.”
The hunter knelt and prayed with his hands together, muttering under his breath.
“Hunting God, please don’t be anxious. Let me first quickly check. It doesn’t seem like there is any serious problem with the wound.”
While speaking, he approached.
“Wait, come back here.”
After saying this, they suddenly heard the hunter shout loud.
The hunter was startled; he didn’t understand what was going on.
“What, what are you doing?”
“Don’t go near it now, it’s not some Hunting God, I recognize it. It’s a very unique creature that was described in a book I saw before.”
“What are you saying? A unique creature, what creature? It clearly is the Hunting God.”
“You might call it a Hunting God, but its scientific name should be ‘monkey-faced pig.’
“What? Monkey-faced pig?”
“You might not have noticed, and what you see is only its body. It actually has its own face, which is under its neck, close to the belly area.”
“What are you saying? Its face, its face is on its belly?”
Lin Yi had never seen such a strange creature, and upon hearing this, he felt the explanation seemed preposterous.
“That’s right, it’s on the belly.”
“Then, can we see it now?”
“Don’t rush, let me check first what the situation is.”
While speaking, the hunter stepped forward and reached out his hand. Suddenly, the other hunter rushed over and pulled him back.
“What, what are you doing? I’m telling you, we had the lord’s warriors before, and it’s not okay to offend it lightly, especially, you should not touch it with your hands.”
Upon hearing this, Ling’er just felt it was somewhat ridiculous.
And she was left with a disdainful smile on her face.
“Regarding this, I’ll explain it in detail to you later. Don’t worry, you’ll understand it all later, and then you’ll know the reason behind all of this.”
“What do you mean? I still don’t quite understand.”
“I’ll tell you all about it in a moment, just relax. There is absolutely no danger in touching it, and I can also tell you that this animal is completely harmless to us.”
“What? Harmless? But my grandfather once told me that it can’t be offended, if it ever is, our whole family won’t have peace for generations.”
“Maybe that’s just an ancient legend. I had heard of this legend before coming here. Don’t worry, I’ll explain it all to you in a moment. Right now, I need to make sure its life is safe.”
As he said this, he reached out his hand to feel around its belly area.
“All is well for now, it doesn’t seem like there is a big problem, and its breathing is still stable for the time being. Oh, that thing inserted in its belly, what did you smear on it?”
“Oh, that thing, we normally use it outdoors, so it should be quite safe, but the Medicinal Effect is strong. If it’s not disturbed beforehand, I reckon the effect will last until later this evening before it completely goes away.”
“Alright, I understand now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 468: 468: Hei Lang Poisoned
chapters.content:
Chapter 468: Chapter 468: Hei Lang Poisoned
After hearing his response, Lin Yi simply nodded lightly and then walked over.
“Good, now observe his breathing and overall condition, both seem quite stable, there should be no issues. Now, take this chance to get a closer look at him while he’s still unconscious,” he said.
As he spoke, he turned the prey’s entire body over.
Indeed, when everyone saw the face hidden beneath its belly, they were all astounded and speechless with surprise.
“This, isn’t this almost like a human face?”
“You can’t say it’s just like a human face, at the very least, doesn’t it sort of resemble a monkey’s face?”
“Right, right, if you put it that way, it does seem somewhat like a monkey, but it’s something between a monkey and a human face.”
“Actually, it belongs to a species of mammal, but in general, it’s rarely seen by people and can only be encountered in desolate, uninhabited places.”
“Shout, why does it appear so mysterious in such places?”
“Because the animal’s entire body is a treasure and even the feces it excretes are a very special kind of medicine.”
“Are you saying that its feces are medicinal?”
“It has been recorded in books, and indeed, every organ inside its body is valuable. Therefore, for us medical researchers, it stands before me like a small treasure trove of medicine.”
“Then why, did people previously spread rumors that it was a kind of deity of the hunt?”
“That is because it protects some animals.”
“Protects animals?”
“Yes, because in its world, all animals are harmless and can live in harmony without any animal being able to harm it.”
“That’s right, not just you, I also feel that given the state of its body, no animal can harm it. If something were to bite it, I fear the entire face would be involved and damaged.”
“Yes, it’s precisely because of such unique bodily characteristics that when it encounters danger or fear, its entire body will curl up into a ball, much like a hedgehog does. However, its spines are even harder and sharper than those of a hedgehog, you can touch it to see how formidable it is.”
As he said this, Lin Yi was the first to boldly reach out his hand.
However, as he approached, he still felt somewhat apprehensive.
Nevertheless, he endured and then extended his hand to take the object directly in his own hands.
This was no ordinary spine; touching it felt like a dagger, extremely sharp.
“My goodness, this, this is too hard, right?”
“Yes, in this case.”
“Big brother, when I pulled it out yesterday, you had no idea. Look at the puncture wounds on my hand.”
While he spoke, he stretched out his hand and showed it to everyone present.
When Ling’er saw this, her complexion suddenly changed, and she quickly pulled his hand toward her.
“Right now, do you have any particular sensation?”
“Sensation? I don’t feel anything, what’s wrong?”
“It’s bad, your wounds, there are so many, it’s very clear that its venom has already penetrated your body.”
“What are you saying? It, it has venom? That, that’s impossible, you told me before, didn’t you? If its entire body is a treasure, how can there possibly be venom?”
“The entire body may be a treasure, but when it faces danger, feels fear, or when its own body falls into an unconscious state, its body will automatically secrete a fluid. This fluid would then automatically spread to the very edges of its spines, so wherever it pricks something, the venom will enter the body from there.”
“And now, me?”
“How many hours has it been since last night?”
Ling’er asked urgently, her expression grave, as if she wasn’t joking around with them at all.
“Um, just wait a moment, let me calculate, from last night to now, um, roughly about 7 hours or so.”
“7 hours, the golden rescue period is supposed to be within 10 hours. Good, then everything should still be manageable. Hurry, quickly bring over my medicine box.”
After Ling’er finished speaking, she looked up and instructed Lin Yi.
Lin Yi hadn’t completely grasped what had happened yet and had no idea what was going on.
“What do you mean? You need the medicine box?”
“Yes, hurry, there’s no time to waste.”
“Okay, okay, I got it.”
Having said that, Lin Yi dashed into the tent and, following Ling’er’s instructions, brought out the medicine box right away.
Ling’er quickly got to work, taking out several strange bottles from the box, then taking out some medicines from them.
“Ling’er, are you mistaken? But I don’t feel anything at all right now.”
“That’s exactly it, in the early stage of this venom’s effect, you won’t notice anything at all, and your body won’t react in any noticeable way.”
“What about the later stages? What reactions will occur then?”
“Once the medicinal effect continues to a certain degree, around 9 hours, you will start to feel freezing all over, and in the end, your whole body will contort into a ball.”
“And after that? Just cold?”
“Not just cold. The cold is only an early stage symptom, but then you will experience high fever, and even if the antidote is truly effective, it won’t be able to be administered, as no antidote will have any effect on you.”
“So are you saying that once poisoned, if it’s been over 10 hours, there’s no hope for me?”
“Yes, essentially there’s no hope, but according to one page in the historical records, there is something that’s considered medicinal, a very, very rare item that up until now, no one has seen.”
“If no one has seen it, then how can he know that this thing can be used medicinally, can counteract this medicinal effect?”
“Because every medicine, including its roots and everything else about it, is clearly documented. So, under these circumstances, if the records can document these things, then that explains it all.”

chapters.title: Chapter 469: 469: The Balance Must Not Be Broken
chapters.content:
Chapter 469: Chapter 469: The Balance Must Not Be Broken
As she talked, Ling’er skillfully bandaged the wound, and at this moment, Hei Lang started feeling pain in his wound.
“I, I now, I seem to be feeling something, could it be because of the medicine?”
“That’s right, if you hadn’t been treated with medicine, you probably wouldn’t feel anything, but this sensation appearing now is a normal reaction; it proves that the toxins in your body haven’t reached their peak concentration. Don’t worry, there shouldn’t be a problem.”
With Ling’ers assurance, he naturally stopped worrying and felt that this matter should be coming to an end.
After a few minutes, Ling’er had expertly wrapped his entire hand in bandages.
Now, with layer upon layer of gauze bandaged around, it indeed gave him a great sense of security.
“Is it done now?”
“Yes, it’s fine now, and once the medicine slowly enters your bloodstream, it will combine with the toxins. I believe it won’t take too long for you to fully recover.”
“Then, when can I take off this gauze?”
Hei Lang just felt that this thing wrapped around his hand was quite bothersome and useless.
“Probably after an hour. You can remove it then. It’s wrapped up now to prevent the medication from leaking out, ensuring it can fully treat the wound.”
“Ok, I got it.”
After finishing the conversation, Hei Lang nodded with relief, and Linyi, standing beside him, let out a long breath of relief. After all, Ling’er had once again saved them all.
“Ling’er, is the poison really that strong?”
“Yes, it’s exactly like that, and you wouldn’t have guessed, right?”
“Right, I didn’t expect it, not only does this fellow have an interesting appearance, but he also possesses so many treasures. If that’s the case, why does he also have such potent poison? It seems all the preparations we made earlier were necessary, weren’t they?”
“This represents the most extreme form of human desire, and I tell you, this is also a physiological state formed over many years. With so many treasures upon him, he naturally wouldn’t let others easily take them away. Hence, this kind of subconscious self-protection mechanism.”
“I see, that’s what it means.”
“Exactly, so for us, this creature is of utmost importance.”
“So, you mean to say, you’re thinking of taking him back for research?”
“This…”
Ling’er hesitated at this point.
She was unsure whether she could really take these items away.
Honestly, if it were purely up to her, she would want to keep it because he was filled with treasures from head to toe.
“What’s the matter? Having second thoughts? Or are you worried… Oh, brother, do you think it would be very dangerous to do so?”
“Yes, because we used to revere him as a deity, and if we had just inquired properly, we wouldn’t have been attacked by him.”
“No, you’re wrong. It wasn’t that he wouldn’t have attacked you, but rather, he simply wouldn’t. The only reason he would have attacked is if you were destroying his territory or upsetting the ecological balance. Only then would he take an offensive stance.”
“I understand now. For all these years we’ve been misled by superstitions, none of us realizing the true reason behind it. If only you could’ve come here a day earlier, maybe all these mysteries could have been unravelled.”
“I had always heard legends and had a rough idea about this creature. When I first saw it, I immediately felt there was something profound about it, so I watched carefully from the ground. Indeed, after checking several characteristics, I understood that it was the special creature mentioned in ancient texts.”
“So that’s how it is.”
“Yes, do you remember when he made a strange call earlier, which could lure away most prey?”
“Oh, I know about that. So we call him the Hunter God, and it seems in his world, there’s no concept of danger as everything appears harmless in his eyes.”
“Right, that’s because he is a guardian spirit of such kind.”
“Then, if you were to take him, wouldn’t this place lose its equilibrium?”
“That’s what I’ve been grappling with. If he’s truly a rarity here, then the impact of breaking this balance could be substantial.”
“If this balance were disrupted, what would be the outcome for all of us?”
“For many years, you’ve lived in harmony with all that exists within Xi Lian Mountain, with no creature ever troubling you, did they?”
“I’ve mentioned this before. As long as we don’t attack them, they will never invade us.”
“It’s only because of his presence that this peace hasn’t been broken. If it were to be shattered, then could the safety of the common folk indeed be guaranteed? I myself can’t assure that.”
In fact, at this moment, his heart was in turmoil.
If he were to ignore all caution and forcibly take this creature away, he might harvest a multitude of valuable medicinal resources from it.
But with the gain would come the violation of nature’s peace.
Nature is sacred and equitable; to violate it is to risk the security of human lives. That was his primary concern.

chapters.title: Chapter 470: 470: Feces as Medicinal Material
chapters.content:
Chapter 470: Chapter 470: Feces as Medicinal Material
“So, are you saying that we really can’t take this with us?”
“What I mean is, although I really want it and I know its benefits, the key issue is that I can’t just take it away so easily. Otherwise, I’m afraid both of us would regret it for the rest of our lives.”
Although the hunter did not speak, upon hearing these words, he felt that this group of people didn’t seem like the business-minded type he had imagined.
They really had come here just to extract some rare medicinal herbs from plants, without any intention of disturbing the balance of this natural ecosystem.
Otherwise, those people would probably have taken it away at all costs, because it’s very likely that this item would secure them a worry-free life for the second half of their years.
“Alright then, I respect your choice, and after hearing your analysis, I do believe that this is indeed the case. So, if that’s how it is, let’s just release it.”
“That’s why I say, releasing it is the best outcome for us, but I have another idea.”
“Oh? What’s the idea?”
“If he’s really appearing around here, then his nest must not be far away. So, if I’m not taking him away, I’m thinking of taking some of his dung because it has a miraculous effect on clearing heat and detoxifying.”
“Dung? That shouldn’t be a problem, right? If we can collect a lot, can’t it also be preserved?”
“No problem at all. I have a preservation box that should do the trick, so nobody needs to worry about that anymore. Plus, this kind of dung usually remains effective for a pretty long time.”
“Then, how should we deal with it after taking it out?”
The hunter’s curiosity surfaced once again as he looked at her inquisitively, but this time, upon hearing the question, Lin Yi just shook his head slightly.
“What, you’re thinking of making a fortune with it? Let me tell you, if someone who doesn’t know its worth gets it, it’s utterly worthless on the market. And the way to use this medicine is quite intricate; it’s not something a layperson can manage, so you’d better not get any ideas about it.”
When the hunter heard this, he merely gave an awkward chuckle, almost feeling like he’d become a greedy scoundrel.
“No, no, that’s not what I meant. I was just asking casually.”
“If you’re really interested, I’ll leave you some prepared mixtures before I leave. You can use them directly then.”
“Great, if that’s the case, it couldn’t be better.”
“Well then, should we start looking in the direction of its nest now and then send it back? That way, we could take the opportunity to collect some dung.”
“I have no problem with that.”
“Me neither.”
“But we’ve been bustling around for so long without breakfast. Aren’t you all a bit hungry?”
“I can’t eat anyway. If you guys want to eat, go ahead. I’ll just wait for you here.”
“Forget it, I don’t feel like eating either.”
Seeing everyone’s state, Lin Yi wished they would eat more so their stomachs would be full, allowing them to travel at a moment’s notice.
Because no one knew what dangers they would encounter next.
If these dangers were to persist, then ensuring three meals a day would remain uncertain.
Seeing the unanimous sentiment, it seemed unnecessary for him to eat alone, especially since they carried food with them and could snack later if they got hungry.
“Alright, let’s hurry up and pack up the tents, then we can get moving.”
“Okay, I got it, big brother. Give me 10 minutes, and I’ll be done.”
For Hei Lang, such tasks were a breeze, and he never let anything actually fall to the ground.
“Bro, does this mean we need to replan our route now?”
“Exactly. Since she wants to find the nest, I think we should put our ascent on hold. Plus, if we can find this stuff, it will certainly help us later on. So let’s start searching from over by the bushes.”
“Alright, while he’s packing up the tents, let’s go over there and quickly analyze the terrain. Then we’ll know where to enter directly.”
After speaking, he just gave the hunter a nod, and then the two of them headed straight over to the grassy area.
The grass here was about waist-high, thick, and dense, appearing as though there wasn’t any clear entry point.
Seeing this, he actually felt a headache coming on, unsure whether such a place could provide a firm footing for them.
“If only there was a large grass cutter now, I’d drive the machine and just flatten everything. Then, everything would be exposed.”
“That’s not okay. Doing that would destroy everything.”
“So, isn’t it unsafe for us to just blindly enter such deep brush?”
“Right, it does seem unsafe from the surface, and we can’t just walk in. Plus, do you see? Thankfully, this stretch of brush isn’t too extensive, and it’s unlikely he lives in the brush. Typically, it should be behind the brush.”
“So, what do you think he’s doing coming here in the dead of night?”
“If I’m not mistaken, he’s probably come out to forage or maybe he’s discovered something. So he came over to explore and never expected to be wounded by unexpected visitors.”
“It’s okay, at least I didn’t hurt him. Besides, even if we wanted to, it doesn’t seem that easy.”

chapters.title: Chapter 471: 471 Found Footprints
chapters.content:
Chapter 471: Chapter 471 Found Footprints
“We’ll wait a bit and then follow this path,” Lin Yi said as they prepared to move on. “And look, considering his size, if he walked through here, maybe we could find some traces. Look here, could this be it?”
Just then, the hunter seemed to suddenly discover something and quickly bent down to speak with them.
Following the hunter’s pointing finger, Lin Yi looked over and indeed, there was a very distinct footprint at the spot.
He carefully recalled the hooves of the prey they had just been pursuing and concluded that they appeared roughly the same.
“Yes, almost certainly, these must be his tracks.”
“Then, it’s likely they were left yesterday evening. With the wind and sandy soil here, in half a day’s time everything would be covered up. Afterward, searching for these traces will truly become much more difficult.”
“Alright, we shouldn’t waste any more time here. The longer we delay, the more troublesome our task will become.”
While speaking, Lin Yi turned to look back, where Ling’er and Hei Lang were fully equipped and had packed up all their gear, ready to go.
“Come over.”
Lin Yi waved them over, and the two ran towards him.
“Ling’er, check this out. Are these the footprints we’re looking for?”
Ling’er bent down to carefully examine them, then nodded.
“Look, the direction of the footprints is coming this way, so we just need to go in the opposite direction. I believe that should lead us to where its den is located.”
“But if there really are a lot of these so-called ‘monkey-faced pigs’ in the den, will they hurt us?”
“I’ve already told you, as long as we don’t show too much hostility, they definitely won’t attack us. We just need to proceed with caution and there should be no problem.”
After finishing these words, everyone simply nodded in agreement, and then they followed Lin Yi’s lead, walking step by step towards their destination.
Passing through that area, it seemed that the path ahead had become much wider.
They hadn’t found this route yesterday. If they had, it appeared they might have elected to continue their search here.
Now, it was Hei Lang’s turn to take the lead. Not only was he carrying a large package, but he was also dragging a big object with a rope.
Every few steps, Hei Lang would turn to look behind, as if worried that the thing being dragged would suddenly wake up and attack him.
However, he was reassured by the knowledge that the medicinal effect was potent—usually, it was quite reliable.
They continued forward for an unknown duration when suddenly, Hei Lang felt something wasn’t right. The object he had been dragging effortlessly now seemed to struggle against the rope.
Thinking it had caught on something, he turned back for a look and to his surprise, the prey had suddenly sat up and was glaring at him ominously.
“Not good, it’s awake! Everybody, hide!”
He shouted loudly and quickly let go of the rope in his hands.
It was only then that the others realized what was happening and turned to look back.
The prey eyeballed them for a few moments before turning and running toward a different corner of the forest.
“Quick, let’s chase it down! The direction it ran off to must lead to its den!” the hunter shouted, prompting the group to sprint behind him.
Keep in mind, humans have just two legs, whereas that beast had four to run with on the ground.
Before long, the creature had vanished into a small grove, as if swallowed up by the forest.
Once they reached the grove, they could no longer distinguish any sign of its presence, and everyone stood there gasping for air.
Firstly, to observe their surroundings and determine the direction, and secondly, to recover from the physical exertion.
“Where, where did it go?”
“It must have gone inside. I’ve read some documents before; it likes to live deep within the jungle, so I reckon we might find some traces of it here.”
“If we go by its habits, is there a chance we’ll encounter other dangers near its den?”
“That’s hard to say. The books previously didn’t have much recorded on this matter, after all, there have been very few who have ever seen it.”
“No more idle talk, now that we’re already here, even if there’s a mountain of blades or a sea of flames ahead, we have to jump in even with our eyes closed. Let’s go; we’ll discuss further once inside.”
After all, Lin Yi had made up his mind, fortified by his Divine Skill and the support of the system.
With so many allies, including the medically knowledgeable Ling’er, he felt their group was the best combination available.
Glancing back at the others, it seemed they raised no objections to his decision.
They embarked on their journey once more, advancing into the mysterious forest ahead.
A few steps in, Lin Yi sensed an eerie silence enveloping the environment.
It was so quiet that even the sound of insects was absent; Lin Yi couldn’t hear any, heightening his tension.
He looked back very carefully at the hunter and saw the man’s hands clenched tightly around his hunting rifle, a clear sign that his feelings were similar to Lin Yi’s own.
“What’s going on?”
I’m not sure, but there’s one thing I know; a tranquil surface of a lake is often deceptive of the dangerous currents beneath.
“So you mean to say, within this forest, there might be some hidden dangers?”
“I don’t know for certain, but haven’t you noticed? Ever since we entered the mountain, we’ve never encountered such a quiet environment.”
“Yes, it’s eerily quiet here. It’s so silent that even our breathing seems loud and clear.”
“What could be in here?”
At that point, even the hunter seemed to grow apprehensive.

chapters.title: Chapter 472: 472: Enshrouded in Mystery
chapters.content:
Chapter 472: Chapter 472: Enshrouded in Mystery
After all, he had accumulated a lot of experience venturing into the mountains over the years, but it seemed he had never really paid attention to all of this and didn’t know how it had happened.
Moreover, he was now leading so many people. If it turned out he had judged the direction incorrectly or taken the wrong path, then he would indeed become a sinner for eternity.
He started to feel conflicted inside, but, under the circumstances, he could no longer make any other choice.
They had come this far already; retreating was absolutely out of the question.
“Otherwise, shall we go back?”
It was Lin Yi who, at this moment, suggested beating a retreat.
Because of this silence, there was a growing sense of unease inside him.
“How can we go back? Didn’t the girl just say? Even her droppings are a precious herb. After this, we definitely won’t find another place like it, especially since we were lucky enough to come across such a treasure today. Do you understand?”
“Yes, I also feel it’s a stroke of luck, but we can’t take such a huge risk. Inside here, there’s something…”
For some reason, after he said this, he felt as if a chill was descending on him.
And that hair-raising sensation immediately enveloped his body.
“Forget it, I can’t worry about it too much now. Even if there are problems ahead, we must grit our teeth and push through, continue moving forward. Just now, it should have been in this direction, right?”
With that, he pointed ahead in a certain direction, at which Lin Yi hesitated for a moment.
Because he remembered clearly, when that creature charged into the jungle, it was so fast it just vanished from sight.
How could it be possible to determine its direction now?
“Hmm, you’re guessing, right?”
“I’m not guessing. Look at the sun above,” he said.
Speaking, he looked up at the sun which was hanging directly overhead.
And truly, the weather today was quite good, seemingly providing a great assurance for their jungle expedition.
“Yes, I see it now. What about it? Does it make any difference?”
“Let me tell you, the problem is right here.”
“Here? What does it have to do with it?”
“You didn’t know? Actually, all prey are supposed to be deep in sleep when the sun rises in the morning.”
“Ah, I know this from the books. Didn’t you tell me before? These animals are mostly nocturnal, and night is when they are most active.”
“Yes, and for this reason, when they choose their dens, they generally face away from the sun. So, I can now be pretty sure that it’s not in this direction, but rather behind us.”
“You mean, its cave is towards the east?”
“Right, it’s towards the east because the sun rises from the east, so, in that direction, there can be no sunlight whatsoever.”
“Well, with your analysis, it does seem to be the case. So, should we head east all the way and expect to find something?”
“Generally, that’s the idea, but we’ll have to make a specific judgment based on the actual situation. Okay, if there’s nothing else, everyone keep listening, and remember not to get too far apart from one another.”
The hunter still seemed a little uneasy, so he continued to give instructions before they set off.
A few people were essentially walking shoulder to shoulder as they slowly moved forward.
After they had walked for a while and looked back, they distinctly saw a white mist rising behind them.
Yet when they had come in, they had not seen anything of the sort. What could all this mean?
“Brother, what is that thing?”
He quickly nudged the hunter in front of him, who seemed not to have encountered anything like this before, so he hurriedly looked back.
His eyes just widened in astonishment and then he involuntarily took two steps back.
“My goodness, how did this thing appear again?”
“Oh, I remember now. Isn’t it the miasma we encountered when we first entered the mountain? You mean to say, this kind of miasma is actually poisonous, right?”
“No, this isn’t miasma. Look closer.”
“It isn’t miasma? Isn’t this precisely miasma?”
Lin Yi seemed somewhat confused; in his perception, this looked exactly like what he had seen upon entering the mountain.
Moreover, in his view, there was no significant difference.
Why, then, did it seem to have undergone such a drastic change to him?
“But from what I see, it does feel like miasma, doesn’t it?”
“No, it’s absolutely not miasma. Haven’t any of you noticed?”
He said this as he looked towards Hei Lang and Ling’er, who were standing aside.
“I feel like this fog is thicker than the ones before, and the color seems whiter too,” Ling’er observed.
Her attention to detail was better and, being a girl, her insight was often superior to that of the men.
“Exactly, you’re right. This is definitely not miasma; instead, it’s a kind of mist,” he said.
“Mist?”
“Yes, this kind of mist is actually quite common in the jungle. But under normal circumstances… well, I explain this now, you wouldn’t understand anyway. I can only tell you that the area covered by this mist is going to get larger and larger. Soon, we will all be lost in this expanse of jungle.”
“You’re saying it will make us lose our way, right?”
With that sentence, Lin Yi truly understood.
Good heavens, it was hard enough to find one’s way in this place, but if this mist came and disoriented them at this moment, then their troubles would become even more complicated.
“Indeed, it will make us get lost, including all the ways I mentioned before for discerning direction—they’ll all become useless, and we won’t be able to tell where we are headed anymore.”

chapters.title: Chapter 473: 473: Only Safe When Burrowed into the Hole
chapters.content:
Chapter 473: Chapter 473: Only Safe When Burrowed into the Hole
“Then, if that’s the case, don’t all of us fall into a dire situation? Also, if such a problem were to envelop us, how long might it take?”
“If we were to fill this entire jungle, I estimate, about an hour should be enough, but if it really does fill up, then waiting for it to dissipate, at the very least, will take about three days before it completely clears away.”
“What, what did you say? Around three days? If we really encounter this inside the forest, doesn’t it mean we’ll never be able to get out in these three days?”
“Correct, we truly won’t be able to exit, and moreover, this fog consumes oxygen. Eventually, it will produce a large amount of carbon dioxide, meaning we won’t even be able to ensure our breathing.”
“Then, what are we waiting for? Let’s hurry and run away from this place, or, otherwise, shall we go back?”
“I just estimated a while ago, it should be about 20 minutes since we entered, and we have absolutely no sense of direction anymore.”
“Does that mean, we can only keep moving ahead, and then, go through here?”
“Correct, this is the only way out. If we go through here, perhaps, we might still have a sliver of a chance, so the way back is definitely not an option.”
“Then let’s not wait anymore, hurry up and go in this direction, besides, isn’t this the den of that thing?”
“We surmised as much before, but forget it, we can’t worry about that now, we need to hurry and keep moving forward, we can only take it one step at a time.”
The hunter was now also beginning to panic.
He remembered that in the past few years when he ventured into the mountains, he had never encountered such danger, but now, it seemed these things were becoming more trivialized.
Their pace began to quicken, and every few steps, Lin Yi would look back vigilantly.
He didn’t know whether the fog would keep following him, and if it did, how much longer could they last?
He just felt that the speed of the fog seemed to be increasing, even beginning to surpass their own.
“Quick, look over there, is that the place?”
At that moment, the hunter seemed to suddenly spot a downward tunnel entrance in front of him.
Moreover, the entrance appeared quite large. If one were to pass through here, they should be able to find a hiding spot.
A few people quickly walked up to it and observed the area.
The ground was covered with footprints everywhere, clearly indicating that more than one snub-nosed monkey had been here.
“That’s right, this must be the place. Inside here is definitely their den.”
“Then let’s not waste time, let’s just crawl in, right?”
“What, what did you say? Crawl inside?”
Hearing this, Ling’er’s eyes widened in astonishment.
“That’s right, we have to crawl in, and considering the current situation, haven’t you seen it? The rate at which the mist is dispersing has become faster. Even if they chase us, by the time we can’t escape, they would have completely devoured us.”
“But if we do so eagerly, won’t we be entering their territory? What if they attack us proactively, then what shall we do?”
“We can’t worry about that now. Right now, going forward is death, but heading inside we might still have a fighting chance. Besides, if we don’t show too much hostility, perhaps just staying at the edge, maybe they really won’t attack us first. Isn’t that what you said?”
At this, the hunter looked at Ling’er.
Yes, Ling’er had indeed said this, but everything was deduced from what was recorded in books.
No one could guarantee whether their nature had changed after living here for such a long time.
“We can’t wait any longer, if we do, we’ll even lose our way to this entrance. I can’t, I must go in first.”
The hunter said, and without further discussion, was the first to crawl into the tunnel.
Lin Yi was really troubled. He didn’t know if the path ahead was one of life or death.
Thus, all he could do was grit his teeth and leave everything to fate.
“Forget it, I can’t worry about that now. I’ll go in first, and once we’re inside, we’ll figure out what to do next.”
He was the second to dive in.
As for Hei Lang, there was no need to say more. Since his brother had already gone in, he would definitely follow closely behind even if he knew there was a dead end ahead.
“Ling’er, I urge you to come in as well. It’s probably even more dangerous outside, just follow behind me.”
Ling’er could only nod her head in fright.
She was starting to regret her decision.
Why did she ever suggest such an idea.
If it weren’t for her suggestion, perhaps they would have already left this area by now.
But now, it was her words that had trapped them here.
When everyone entered the cave, they realized how vast it actually was.
And it was unknown which parts were connected to the outside, so it didn’t seem as dark inside.
They had heard something resembling the sound of water dripping.
At that moment, the cave became very quiet and there was a damp sensation in the air.
Inside, there was no trace of any foul smell.
“You know, the air here actually seems quite good, and we don’t smell the rotten odors that we did in the previous caves.”
“Hmm, I noticed that too. If the cave is this big, could we possibly find another way out from here?”
“Yes, the literature mentions that a clever rabbit has three burrows, so maybe these creatures also have a second exit?”
“Does that mean if we follow that exit, could we potentially leave here safely?”
“Exactly, that’s what I mean.”
“But by doing this, wouldn’t we be violating our initial principle? Initially, we only agreed not to go deeper in, right? If we go deeper, wouldn’t they see us as invading their territory?”
Ling’er kindly reminded them, but now, they had no way out.

chapters.title: Chapter 474: 474 Blocking the Way
chapters.content:
Chapter 474: Chapter 474 Blocking the Way
If we try to leave now, that place, I believe, should already be enveloped.
“Big brother, I took a look, and now, outside is a vast expanse of white everywhere. As soon as we go out, we will definitely lose our sense of direction,”
Sure enough, they had just entered the cave and, in fact, had not even been inside for a minute when the mist slowly swallowed up everything around them.
“Alright, in that case, there’s no turning back for us now. Hurry up and pack all our gear,”
Although they didn’t know whether that thing would attack them and they also knew it was very valuable, under these circumstances, they still had to prioritize their lives.
The hunter naturally held onto the shotgun, while Hei Lang pulled out several handy tools from his bag and placed them in everyone’s hands.
“It’s the same old drill, let the oldest brother lead the way at the front, then I’ll follow from the back, and you two walk in the middle. This way, we can look after each other,”
“Hey, do you see that? There’s a rock wall here. We should stick to this wall as we walk; that will ensure that we are absolutely safe on this side,”
“Do you all find it strange? After we came in, we noticed that it was completely empty. If they were indeed here, shouldn’t we have noticed something by now?”
“Honestly, stop guessing. I’m turning on the bright flashlight now, and basically, we can see everything in the cave clear as day,”
Hei Lang seemed to be getting impatient, and he also knew that this was probably the most direct approach.
“No, remember you must not use the bright flashlight. Plus, this kind of bright light is the most likely way to alarm them. If they all attack at once, we won’t have anywhere to hide,”
The hunter immediately rejected his foolish idea.
Hei Lang simply nodded; he had actually just wanted to voice his discontent.
“Hei Lang, let me tell you, down here you must follow orders precisely. If you take any action on your own, it could bring danger to everyone’s lives. Do you understand?”
“Sure, I understand, big brother. Don’t worry, I won’t make any decisions rashly,”
“Older brother, do you mean to say that for now, our only option is to keep going down this path?”
“That’s right, just keep going down this road, and who knows how much farther we have to go forward?”
“Then there’s no other way; let’s just walk on and see,”
While talking, they continued to walk forward.
But the further they went, the more they could feel that the air in this place was becoming damper.
And even the sound of flowing water seemed to grow louder.
“Look, there’s a river here!”
At that moment, they suddenly came across a river, rapidly flowing right through this place.
Just looking at this river, it was indeed quite broad.
At the very least, it was probably twice as wide as a swimming pool.
“My goodness, this, this underground, could there be such a, such a big river?”
“Unless it’s an underground river.”
The hunter stood by and slowly said.
“An underground river, but as far as I know, underground rivers should only be visible when you’re about 30 meters beneath the surface. But are we that deep now?”
“When we were coming down just now, weren’t we continuously descending?”
“I, I really didn’t notice that.”
Lin Yi just frowned, realizing he hadn’t paid attention to that detail.
“If we were indeed continuously descending, then where have they arrived at now? No one knows,”
“I’m guessing we must have been going downwards and, without realizing it, we’re now deep underground.”
“So those things are hidden in the depths?”
“That’s also a possibility. I’m not sure of the specifics since I understood so little about them before,”
“Now there’s a river blocking our way, and if we try to continue forward, we simply can’t cross,”
“Hey, big brother, we’re almost out of water. Why don’t we refill a bit here?”
“Old brother, is that okay?”
“In principle, it should be fine, and given how deep this place is, I believe these river waters are likely protected,”
“No worries. Whether there’s contamination, we’ll know as soon as we see it,”
Ling’er stepped forward and pulled a small flashlight from her pocket.
The flashlight’s beam was very faint, so she gently shone it on the river’s surface.
Ling’er could see that the water was incredibly clear and could even occasionally spot some small fish swimming by.
“I see fish swimming down there,”
“Good, then if there are fish, that means the water should be safe. Come on, let’s fill all our containers with water,”
After saying this, they went over, took off their gear, and filled their water bottles to the brim.
In addition, they scooped up the water with their hands and drank their fill with much gusto.
“Really, this water is so sweet and cool,”
“Man, that feels good. I haven’t felt this way in a long time,”
“It’s true, after drinking it, I feel really comfortable on the inside,”
“This is like the well water from before. The more like well water it is, the sweeter it tastes. Anyway, I’ve been used to drinking this kind of water at home since early on,”
The hunter looked at them and knew that these city folks probably had never experienced all of this before.
“Older brother, aren’t you going to drink a little? It’s really good,”
After Lin Yi and the others finished drinking, they noticed the hunter had yet to move and was just filling his water bottle.
“I won’t drink now; the water at home is like this. Don’t worry; it should be fine. How about everyone? Are you done drinking?”
“Yeah, we’re done,”
“Good. Let’s make haste and think about how to get across from here,”

chapters.title: Chapter 475: 475: Unable to Take the Water Route
chapters.content:
Chapter 475: Chapter 475: Unable to Take the Water Route
Actually, this seemed to pose a significant challenge for Lin Yi.
Because just looking at the size of the river, it shouldn’t be considered small.
Could it be that all of them needed to swim across this river?
He himself didn’t have a problem, but he was worried about Ling’er who wasn’t familiar with swimming at all.
“Do we have to swim across this river?”
“If we don’t swim, there is another way. If we follow the river upstream, I estimate
there should be a place on the edge where we could cross by walking along it,”
“Exactly, so if that’s the case, can’t we just detour around it like that?”
“But if you detour like that, I’m afraid it will exhaust our strength, whereas if we pass through here, perhaps the energy consumption wouldn’t be as great.”
The hunter was sincerely discussing this matter.
He also took into account everyone’s physical strength, which he feared some might not be able to keep up with.
If they continued to walk upstream, the mountain paths would become even more dangerous.
Moreover, heading into those remote corners seemed to increase their risks more and more.
“Ling’er, as far as I know, you’re not familiar with swimming, right?”
“That’s right, I’m indeed a landlubber.”
“Then that settles it. We don’t need to consider it further. Brother, as per your idea, we will go upstream along this river, and I believe we can get across from the top.”
“But the crucial issue is, after getting across, how much space will there be on the other side? And where exactly are these items hidden? Honestly, it’s getting more and more difficult to search for them.”
“There’s no use hesitating anymore. If we keep hesitating, I’m afraid all of us might die here,”
suddenly said Hei Lang from the back.
At that moment, nobody paid attention, but after hearing this, they abruptly turned to look.
They noticed that a mist had started to spread from behind them.
Although the color was still quite faint, they knew that the longer the time passed, the entire fog would envelop the cave.
By then, it would likely be a certain death for them.
“Brother, we can’t hesitate any longer. We must hurry, and moreover, we are now racing against time.”
“Okay, okay, I know. I myself have no problem. Just, never mind, let’s take it one step at a time. Hurry, pack your things quickly; we need to move upward.”
Upon this command, everyone followed the hunter’s lead and, resolutely, they began to trek upstream.
Perhaps, the hunter’s concern wasn’t unnecessary; moreover, as they moved further upward, they found the path becoming increasingly difficult.
Even with every step taken, it felt like they were stepping on a very hard surface.
Pain accompanied that feeling.
“Ling’er, are you alright?”
He was still quite worried about Ling’er, so he turned back and took her hand, asking.
“Oh, it’s nothing, I, I can keep going.”
Although Ling’er said this, one could see that beads of sweat as large as beans were already streaming down her forehead.
It was obvious that everyone was enduring significant pain.
He looked back at Hei Lang, whose complexion didn’t seem so good.
“Ah well, maybe we can think of it as a kind of foot massage therapy, isn’t reflexology just like this?”
“Stop talking nonsense. How can reflexology be like this? And didn’t you see, some of these things are angular. Stepping on them, our feet’s pressure points won’t be able to endure it for long.”
“There’s no other way, and now we need to save our lives. Look, these mists are already behind us and are continuously spreading upwards.”
In the midst of speaking, they indeed saw that it was the actual situation.
“Ling’er, how about I carry you on my back?” suggested Hei Lang suddenly, as he walked over and spoke to Ling’er.
Ling’er’s head shook vigorously like a bobblehead.
“No, absolutely not. It was okay for you guys to carry me on regular paths, but on this kind of trail, with the added weight of me, the pain on the soles of the feet would become unbearable.”
“Don’t worry, I’m a grown man; I’m sure it’s no problem.”
“No, it’s out of the question. Even if I can’t hold on myself, I can’t drag you down with me. I’m starting to regret why I chose to bring you guys in search of these things.”
As Ling’er spoke, she clenched her teeth tightly.
She truly did regret her earlier decision.
If it was all for obtaining these items, making everyone suffer this pain, she genuinely felt uneasy.
“Ling’er, you shouldn’t think like that. Ever since we entered the mountain, wasn’t it to obtain these things? If we can discover something useful on the road ahead, no matter how difficult it is, we must get our hands on it. So, don’t say anything. As long as you know the value of it, I will get it,” assured Lin Yi.
“Enough talking, we must hurry on our way,” the hunter said urgently upon seeing them chatting there.
“Don’t worry; I know what to do. Even if I have to grit my teeth, I will endure it. Let’s keep going; I can handle it.”
Lin Yi could only nod his head, though he knew that this feeling wasn’t something one could overcome simply by bearing down.
But after observing her, Lin Yi felt Ling’er was indeed extraordinary.
Most girls would have collapsed by now, yet she persevered, which was admirable.
After a while, everyone genuinely felt that if they took one more step forward, they would likely collapse from the pain right there. It was not an exaggeration at all.
Lin Yi then sat down on a comparatively flat area.
If even Lin Yi was struggling to endure, what about Ling’er?
He took off his shoes and saw that in such a short amount of time, blisters had already formed on his feet.

chapters.title: Chapter 476: 476 Malfunction
chapters.content:
Chapter 476: Chapter 476 Malfunction
“Ling’er, your foot, could it also be like this already?”
He looked up and said to Ling’er.
“I, I should still be okay.”
Ling’er insisted on not taking off her shoes and socks, but in truth, everyone understood that her condition at this moment couldn’t be good.
“That’s fine, now that I see we’ve reached a higher elevation, the fog has stopped advancing. Perhaps, we can make a brief stop, and then, everyone can take a moment to regroup.”
After hearing this, Lin Yi’s heart also seemed to gradually settle down.
“Ling’er, take off your shoes.”
“It’s not necessary, right?”
Ling’er seemed to still be dodging all of this.
“No, hurry up and take them off. If it’s really an injury, now that we’re here, we can use medicine and maybe it will get better. Otherwise, the situation will only worsen.”
Under Lin Yi’s insistent demands, Ling’er finally removed her shoes.
The mangled sight immediately presented itself before Lin Yi.
To be honest, he couldn’t identify what he was feeling inside.
Was it that piercing pain or the feeling of heartache?
“Ling’er, why, why didn’t you say anything?”
“It’s nothing, maybe it’s because it’s been a while, and now, it’s somewhat numb. I can’t really feel the pain anymore.”
“If you keep this up, this foot, this foot might not be salvageable! Quick, bring the medicine box over.”
He turned his head and instructed Hei Lang, who quickly brought the medicine box over.
Lin Yi was still capable of treating and bandaging the wound simply.
“You, you be gentle, Lin Yi.”
When he sprinkled the medicinal powder onto the wound, he only heard some groans from Ling’er.
“Just bear with it a bit.”
As Lin Yi spoke, he carefully and gently finished bandaging Ling’er’s wound.
Now, Ling’er’s entire foot was securely wrapped by him, but looking at the situation, trying to walk any further would likely be extremely difficult.
“With your condition, you can’t go on.”
“What? Can’t go on? That won’t do, we can’t stay trapped here.”
“No, I should carry you, or rather, Hei Lang and I can take turns carrying you. Would that be alright?”
“Brother, don’t worry, I have absolutely no problem, and moreover, there’s no need for you to, I can handle it alone.”
“Enough, stop trying to be strong. Now’s not the time for you to be stubborn.”
“I’m truly sorry, it’s my fault for holding everyone back.”
“You shouldn’t say that.”
No sooner had Lin Yi finished speaking than he suddenly felt a warm flow across his forehead.
Thank goodness, could it be that Heavenly Eye has opened again?
If that was the case, could it once more assist him in healing her wounds more swiftly?
“Ling’er, wait a moment, stretch your foot out to me.”
Lin Yi felt the warm flow moving along his body, then merging into his fist.
If that was the case, it would likely be a great help in healing the wound.
Ling’er just curiously looked at him, recalling the events of the previous night.
She truly felt that Lin Yi, in her presence, had become more and more mysterious.
If that were so, then Lin Yi must hold some power in his hands.
She curiously extended her foot to him once again.
And then, he placed his hand over her wounded injury.
He immediately felt a warm current continuously pouring into it.
“Do you feel the wound getting warm?”
“Oh, I do, and it’s very distinct.”
“Good, that’s good. Just bear with it a little longer, it will be over soon.”
He nodded gently, thinking to himself that the system had never let him down, and at this moment, it still provided him with the greatest convenience.
“How come I feel like the warm current has disappeared?”
Suddenly, Ling’er lifted her head and asked him curiously.
“What did you say? The warm current disappeared? That, that’s impossible.”
Because Lin Yi could clearly feel that the warm current was still focused at the palm of his hand.
But why didn’t it seem to have the same effect inside Ling’er’s body?
“Really, it felt like it suddenly vanished, and it’s somewhat different from last night’s sensation.”
“Is it, different?”
“It really is different.”
He raised his hand again and took a look.
Lin Yi noticed that his palm was starting to sweat and was slightly turning red, but beyond that, he couldn’t detect anything abnormal.
“That’s not right, it feels the same as last night to me.”
“But I clearly feel it’s different.”
“Don’t worry, I’ll try again. Let’s see if the warm current feels the same this time as the last,”
Lin Yi said, somewhat in disbelief, and so, he reached out his hand again and placed it on Ling’er’s wound.
“How about now, do you feel it?”
Ling’er just shook her head softly.
“No good, still no feeling, not a bit of warmth.”
“How about now? Still nothing?”
He readjusted the position of his hand.
“Nothing, still no feeling.”
Seeing this situation, Lin Yi could only sigh, and ultimately, he withdrew his hand.
“What’s going on with you?”
“I’m not sure, why does it suddenly feel like all my abilities have vanished?”
“Could it be that you’re too exhausted? Why don’t you rest a bit and recalibrate your state of being.”
“Alright, it’s nothing.”
He merely brushed it off with his words, but his heart began to feel anxious.
What exactly was this situation,
And moreover, these special abilities seemed to be flickering in and out of existence on him.
This wouldn’t do at all, if it really was like this, then it might cause lots of delays later on.
“Big brother, what’s wrong with you?”
Hei Lang, seeing him sitting in silence without speaking and looking rather unwell, thought he might be feeling uncomfortable or perhaps it was blisters on his feet causing him pain.
“Oh, I’m fine, big bro. Are we about done here, should we continue moving forward?”
“I’m definitely alright here, it’s up to you guys.”
“Then how much further do you reckon before we reach the edge? I think we’ve been walking on and off for over an hour now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 477: 477: It's Actually a Dead End
chapters.content:
Chapter 477: Chapter 477: It’s Actually a Dead End
“Hmm, an hour and twenty minutes, I saw the time just awhile ago, wait, I’ll go have a look,”
As the hunter spoke, he stood up and walked towards the middle of the river.
He estimated the river’s width with a glance and then compared it to the downstream section.
“It seems to be getting narrower, if we keep going, I estimate in less than half an hour we should reach the upper end.”
“Great, we can almost see hope now, come on, I’ll carry you.”
It was as if at this moment, his body was filled with vitality once again.
He reached out his hand and pulled Ling’er up.
“No, no, that’s absolutely not okay. If you’re carrying me, it’ll be a bigger burden. Instead, let’s try this, after you treated me just now, I do feel a lot better, though it still hurts a bit. If you both support me, one on each side, that should work.”
“Is that possible? Can we manage that?”
“Don’t worry, it’s absolutely no problem. If you each take one side like that, you can share the pressure between you.”
Ling’er came up with a good idea, and indeed, it was something they could manage quite easily.
He nodded to Hei Lang, then they stood on either side of Lin Yi.
The group continued to move forward with difficulty.
As the hunter had said, in probably less than 20 minutes, they actually saw the upper edge.
Water trickled down from above.
“What, what’s going on here?”
As he said this, he suddenly turned and looked at the hunter.
He noticed the hunter also looked perplexed.
Normally, since they were moving against the current, they should have reached the water’s source.
And the water’s source should have been in an even deeper place, but now they felt as though they had been climbing upward.
“If that’s the case, then could it be that this river is not really an underground river?”
“Hmm, I’ve noticed as well. There seems to be something wrong. This doesn’t seem like the kind of underground river we imagined it would be.”
“If it were an underground river, the water should come from the deepest point. Why is it flowing down from here? If we go upward, could it be a waterfall or maybe a mountain spring?”
“It doesn’t look like a mountain spring, nor does it look like a waterfall. The flow is too slow to be a waterfall.”
“This is really strange. If it’s not groundwater, nor a spring, then where is this water coming from?”
“I feel like the topography here is indeed strange. I’ve always had the impression we were going upward, but actually, we must be heading deeper. Feel it for yourselves.”
While speaking, the hunter took a deep breath and looked around.
In fact, the surrounding environment was largely the same as when they first arrived.
They didn’t notice anything unusual, just that the feeling of cold dampness seemed to intensify.
“Aside from feeling a bit colder and my body somewhat damp, I don’t notice anything else.”
“That proves we are indeed going down.”
“But I clearly saw us going up; going down should be easier.”
In Lin Yi’s opinion, one’s own body is the most honest.
It should respond to any sensations, and it certainly wouldn’t be as it seemed now.
“I’m not sure either. All these years, I’ve never encountered such an anomaly. I feel that we can’t stay long in this cave; we should speed up, get around this spot, and see if there’s any other way out beyond.”
The hunter dared not delay any longer in this place, and he couldn’t easily make judgments about this unclear geological condition.
When they bypassed the river, they discovered that there was a dead end beyond it.
The hunter seemed to not believe it and walked forward, knocking on the wall forcefully with the tools he carried.
But there was no result whatsoever.
“How about it, can you break through?”
“No, these stones are incredibly hard; it’s impossible to break through.”
“That’s enough, do you have any machines on your end?”
“No, I don’t have any machinery capable of breaking through these stones, and I can tell they are extremely tough.”
“That’s troublesome. If we keep going around in circles like this, it seems as though we’ve entered a dead end, and from here, there’s no way forward.”
To the left is the river they just passed.
Now, they were forced into the furthest, most marginal spot.
Lin Yi wasn’t ready to give up, not yet. After so much hardship and covering such a long distance, could it really be that their entire journey had been a mistake?
“This isn’t right. Based on previous estimates, there should be a way around from here, which means the direction of the river must be wrong.”
“Does that mean we’ve gone the wrong way?”
“It’s very likely.”
Even though they had prepared for the worst, when the hunter uttered those words, it truly disheartened everyone.
“But that doesn’t make sense. If we had gone in another direction from where we were before, the river would only widen, and we would still end up at the river’s end. If that’s the case, how do we leave? Don’t tell me we have to go back the way we came?
“Going back the way we came is impossible, and even if we did, I’m afraid it wouldn’t be for another three days.”
“What? Three whole days? Does that mean all of us are trapped here for that long?”
“If we don’t go back the way we came, then it looks like we have no other way out.”
After the hunter spoke, everyone fell silent.
Having walked so long, had they really reached a dead end?

chapters.title: Chapter 478: 478: The Path Underwater
chapters.content:
Chapter 478: Chapter 478: The Path Underwater
None of them wanted to confront everything that was happening.
“It’s impossible, absolutely impossible, huh, wait, that’s not right.”
As he spoke these words, Lin Yi suddenly seemed to realize that something was indeed strange.
“What’s the matter, is there something wrong?”
“We’ve basically covered the entire cave, so why didn’t we see that so-called monkey-faced pig after entering? Where are they hiding?”
Right, everyone had been focused on making their way through and paying attention to the dangers around, yet this point had been completely overlooked.
“Exactly, could it be that this isn’t their lair? No, that doesn’t make sense, this should be their lair.”
“Then it’s strange, where are these creatures? Could it be that they can ascend to heaven or burrow into the earth?”
“Ascend to heaven or burrow into the earth? That’s unlikely, but there could be another possibility.”
The hunter seemed to have thought of something suddenly.
Following his gaze, he looked over and found that the hunter’s eyes were fixed on the river’s surface.
“Are you suggesting that they might be in the water?”
“It might not be that they live in the water, but I have a feeling that there is another way out inside this water.”
“Another way out?”
“Yes, remember what I told you earlier? We’re going in the opposite direction, and while we think we’re ascending, we’re actually descending, right?”
“That’s correct, so if we follow this logic, by entering the river, we should be going deeper, but it’s very likely that we could come out through this river.”
“Right, this river could only be another plane. If we follow it down, I believe we could find another exit beneath that will lead us out of this cave.”
“So there’s another possibility, which means that the monkey-faced pig might live in another space within this water?”
“It should be like this.”
“Well then, it looks like we just need to go into the water to find out if all of this is true.”
“But the key question remains, is there any danger in the water? And what kind of danger could there be? All of this is an unknown factor.”
“From what I know, if the monkey-faced pigs really use this place as a frequent passage, then there might not necessarily be any danger nearby. Perhaps, this part of the river is the safest.”
The hunter’s words seemed to awaken everyone.
“Big brother, let’s not talk anymore, I’m the best swimmer here, let me go down and check it out first.”
Hei Lang volunteered and stood up.
However, Lin Yi was still somewhat apprehensive. After all, he didn’t know what he might encounter below.
If it were above ground, with so many people helping to devise plans, they might be able to cleverly avert the danger.
But now, facing this situation, he felt it was a bit tricky.
“Hei Lang, it’s not that I don’t trust you, but going down there alone in this environment, I’m indeed worried.”
“Big brother, what’s there to worry about? Do you want to go down instead? Do you think you’re a better swimmer than I am?”
What Hei Lang said was the truth; Lin Yi couldn’t compare to Hei Lang in that regard.
Hei Lang had received some professional dive training, so for him, the stillness of the water, moreover being quite placid, shouldn’t pose a problem.
“But I don’t know the situation below. What if something unexpected happens? Can you handle it alone?”
“Ah, don’t worry about it. We also have communication equipment down there. If I encounter any danger, you’ll pull me back up using the rope, can’t you?”
“That’s a plan, but the key issue is…”
“Big brother, don’t hesitate anymore. Otherwise, you might as well not send me down, and we’ll just wait here for three days and nights. Then we’ll make a decision. Do you think that’s a good idea?”
Hei Lang was using reverse psychology again.
Because everyone, especially Lin Yi, was clear that waiting here endlessly wouldn’t lead to any results and might only bring endless danger and disaster to them all.
“Older brother, what do you think?”
He sought the hunter’s opinion once again.
“I think his plan is worth a try, and as of now, it’s the only one we have. He looks quite strong; he should be able to cope. Moreover, under such a calm water surface, there shouldn’t be too much danger lurking.”
“Alright, if that’s the case, Hei Lang, make preparations swiftly. Remember everyone, if you find you can’t hold on anymore, you must retreat immediately. Got it?”
“Don’t worry big brother, I know what to do.”
Hei Lang spoke while taking his professional equipment out of his pack and, lastly, tied a thick rope around his waist.
“Big brother, leave this thing here. If I encounter any danger, I’ll press the transmitter inside, and the red light will come on here. Then you just pull the rope tightly and drag me back, alright?”
“Okay, no problem.”
He nodded his head, then whispered a few more words of caution into Hei Lang’s ear. Finally, with a dive, Hei Lang plunged into the river.
“Your brother here has really helped you a lot, hasn’t he?”
After Hei Lang entered the water, the hunter turned back to Lin Yi and said.
“That’s true, he has helped me a lot, and indeed, he is a very valuable person beside me. Older brother, tell me the truth, how dangerous is it in there really?”
The reason he hadn’t discussed much with Hei Lang was that he didn’t want to burden him with too much to think about.
“Honestly, it’s fifty-fifty.”
“Older brother, what do you mean by fifty-fifty? Didn’t you just say that under such a calm surface, there shouldn’t be too much danger?”
“Well, that was just a figure of speech.”
“He’s already gone down; there’s no point in saying these things now, and among the four of us, who do you think is up to the task, you or me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 479: 479 Everyone Gets into the Water
chapters.content:
Chapter 479: Chapter 479 Everyone Gets into the Water
This sentence is indeed unanswerable.
But Lin Yi would rather not go that route; he would rather have everyone die here than let one of his brothers take the risk alone.
But all of this was already a bit too late.
He saw the rope continually slipping downwards.
He glanced at the scale on it, which was now almost at 8 meters.
This meant that the depth of the river was at least over 10 meters.
However, gradually, the sinking speed began to increase.
Lin Yi grew anxious and also had no idea what the situation was like below.
“Bro, what’s going on?”
“If I’m not mistaken, he shouldn’t be sinking anymore; he’s probably moving forward. Look at the speed of the rope—it’s clearly different from before. And also, consider the angle issue.”
The hunter’s observations were still quite meticulous.
After his reminder, Lin Yi carefully recalled and felt that this seemed to be the case.
He silently counted in his head here—one meter, two meters, three meters.
Finally, when the rope had slid down to 27 meters, it seemed to suddenly stop.
He turned around warily to look at the hunter.
Of course, the hunter had been paying attention to this the whole time.
However, he noticed that the entire river surface was calm and quiet, with no ripples at all.
“Don’t worry, I guess he must have found the spot.”
No sooner had he spoken than the red light started flashing.
“Quick, hurry up, pull it back.”
Lin Yi shouted loudly, then the two of them grabbed the rope tightly and began to quickly reel it back in.
During this process, there was no such obstacle.
It even felt like the rope was being pulled up rather smoothly.
Finally, they saw Hei Lang emerge from the river surface, showing his head.
Excited, Hei Lang just waved at them.
The two men sped up once more.
“Hei Lang, are you alright?”
When Hei Lang climbed up the bank, Lin Yi asked nervously.
Hei Lang simply wiped his face with a hand, then spat a mouthful of water out.
“Big brother, how long was I down there?”
“I just checked, roughly, a full seven minutes.”
“Seven minutes, that’s about the limit. Any longer and I probably couldn’t have held on.”
“So, what’s the situation down there?”
“Big brother, just like you said, after going down about 7 meters, I found I couldn’t go any further, and then I started swimming forward.”
“And then?”
“After swimming for a while, I saw some light coming through, so I started swimming upwards, and sure enough, there seems to be a space there where we can get through.”
“What else did you see over there?”
“That’s all; I didn’t dare linger there any longer, so I hurriedly pressed this communicator and came over to report to you the situation below.”
“Bro, what do you think about this?”
“My guess is pretty much the same. If so, it seems we all have to enter this river to leave here successfully.”
“Is there really no other way?
The hunter just helplessly shook his head.
“Is it dangerous down there?”
“The water flow is very gentle, just like a dead pool, there’s really no danger at all.”
“So, roughly, how long do we need to hold our breath?”
“For me, it was a round trip. A round trip took a bit over 7 minutes, so in at most 4 minutes, we should be able to get across.”
“Alright, if that’s the case, it seems we have to go in together.”
“Big brother, I’m fine, it depends on the condition of your wounds now.”
“It’s OK, a little water on the wound, and then after we get across, we can take other remedial measures. Don’t worry about that, bro, are you OK?”
“I’m definitely fine. Not just holding my breath for 4 minutes, but 6, 7 minutes would also not be a big problem.”
