“Ling’er, what about you?”
“Me? I should be able to, I think.”
“Don’t worry, I have a little piece of equipment here.”
As if he suddenly remembered something, Hei Lang bent over and took out a very small bottle from his backpack.
“What is this?”
“This is an emergency oxygen bottle I prepared in advance, but it doesn’t contain much oxygen, only enough for one person to use.”
“Oh, I see. OK, Ling’er, take this, and if you really can’t hold on, open the valve. Then you’ll be able to breathe freely.”
“But, isn’t that somewhat inappropriate?”
Ling’er just felt that this should be someone’s life-saving tool, and if it were wasted by her, it would seem somewhat unjustifiable.
“What are we waiting for? Don’t beat around the bush. As long as we leave this place safely, I believe we can escape from this cave.”
“OK, I understand. Bro, let’s start carrying out our tasks. Hei Lang, bring over all the ropes and join them. Then the four of us can be connected together.”
“Big brother, I think it’s best not to be linked together.”
As Hei Lang said this, Lin Yi frowned slightly, feeling that there was nothing wrong with what he had said.
But why would he say that?
“Hei Lang, what do you mean?”
“No offense, but if we were really connected together, in the end, if one person gets in trouble, I’m afraid it would affect everyone, and we might not even have the chance to rescue them.”
Lin Yi truly had no experience with wilderness survival.
He felt that there might be some logic to what was being said.
But for safety’s sake, he still sought the hunter’s opinion.
“That’s right, your brother has a point. We can’t possibly all be connected; we need to go separately. We just have to hold on to each other’s ropes, and that will serve as a support. We can’t do anything beyond that.”

chapters.title: Chapter 480: 480: Collecting Feces
chapters.content:
Chapter 480: Chapter 480: Collecting Feces
“Alright, I got it. We’ll do it your way. Come, Ling’er, let me tie the rope around you.”
While talking, he took out the thickest rope and directly looped it around Ling’er’s waist.
Then, one by one, everyone jumped into the water.
Of course, to ensure everyone’s safety, and since he himself couldn’t come along, he just held on tightly to the hands of Lin Yi and Hei Lang.
The two of them were moving continuously forward, propelled by their legs and one arm.
Fortunately, the hunter’s swimming skills were quite good, always leading the way in front of them.
The deeper they went, the more they felt the buoyancy becoming stronger.
Especially for Ling’er, who was naturally light, there was even great resistance when they tried to pull her down.
Lin Yi exerted all his strength, desperately swimming in that place.
He had to keep his body upright as he sank downwards, only when he reached the bottom could he continue forward.
He looked back at Ling’er, who was puffing her cheeks; evidently, she was starting to have trouble holding her breath.
But it was no matter; he still had an oxygen bottle in his hand that could help her cope for a few minutes.
He quickly removed the cap from the oxygen bottle and placed it beside Ling’er’s mouth.
Ling’er just stared with wide eyes in surprise.
Actually, she didn’t want to use the oxygen bottle at all; she wanted to rely on her body’s stamina to see how long she could last.
Ling’er vigorously shook her head and then prepared to retreat, but she felt Lin Yi holding her hand tightly, pulling her forward.
Forget it, she was already starting to struggle anyway. If she didn’t use it, and something else went wrong, that would be troublesome.
Finally, Lin Yi saw a beam of light shining down from above his head.
Just as Hei Lang had described to him before, this place indeed led to the outside.
He got excited and began to swim forward desperately.
Since he could no longer see the hunter’s figure, he assumed he had already reached the shore.
At last, he touched a large rock and started to swim upwards.
When his head emerged above the surface, he took a long breath of relief.
The breath he had been holding in was almost too much, nearly preventing him from swimming to the surface.
“Ling’er, are you alright?”
“I’m fine, I was breathing smoothly underwater the entire time.”
“That’s good.”
He nodded, then followed Hei Lang to pull Ling’er toward the shore with them.
The group quickly clambered out of the water onto the bank.
They were completely drenched, but at that moment, they weren’t concerned about that.
They turned to look at the vast space they had come into; after arriving here, the air around them seemed to become much fresher all at once.
“Is it not as cold here as before?”
She furrowed her brows suspiciously, then muttered to herself.
“That’s right, this place, we must have swum upwards for a distance already.”
“Upwards? But, we felt like we were going down?”
“That’s why I said, all the sensations this environment gives you are completely wrong, which means they should all be the opposite.”
“Anyway, no matter what, we’ve successfully left that cave. At the very least, this place isn’t affected by the fog. Look there, that’s connected to the surface.”
He looked up and saw that right above him, there indeed was a large gap.
Moreover, at this moment, the sunlight was shining down through this gap without any obstruction.
Yet, this distance from the top of his head was at least about 30 meters.
Just by human effort alone, it would be impossible to get up there.
As long as it’s connected to the surface, then it must lead to an exit. We probably should keep moving forward.”
“Look, what’s that?”
Just then, Ling’er suddenly seemed to have discovered something.
Everyone followed her gaze, and then, they looked over to see that on the other side of the water, it seemed like there were some lights constantly flickering.
Because it was against the light, they couldn’t see very clearly.
“That, isn’t that the monkey-faced pig we’re looking for?”
“I feel like it should be. It seems we’ve found the right place this time; they really do live in these waters.”
“Then we absolutely can’t approach them. If they’re like that, we should maintain our posture and keep moving forward. Also, if they’re living here, take a look over there.”
Before Ling’er could finish speaking, she suddenly pointed excitedly at a large rock ahead.
Lin Yi could see clearly, noticing some dark brown objects below, and they were roughly shaped like small spherical balls.
“Is this, this their droppings?”
“Yes, that’s their droppings.”
Ling’er was really excited; she quickly went over, picked up some of the droppings, and kept sniffing them under her nose,
Hei Lang saw this and just frowned slightly.
It was just the feces from an animal; it was hard to understand why one would put it under their nose—could it really smell that good?
“Hmm, this, don’t you find it stinky?”
Curiosity eventually led him to walk over and then look at Ling’er as he asked.
“Hehe, this is different from what you imagine. I don’t know if you have ever had civet coffee?”
“Oh, of course, I’ve had that. What, can this be drunk too?”
“Right, same principle. Civet coffee has no stench at all; it’s just a clear smell. If you don’t believe me, smell this stuff.”
Without another word, Ling’er lifted it and moved it right under his nose.
Originally, Hei Lang was somewhat disgusted and prepared to step back, but Ling’er’s movement was faster, pressing it right under his nose.
Suddenly, his expression turned to one of surprise.
Then, he took a deep breath.

chapters.title: Chapter 481: 481 What is the Target?
chapters.content:
Chapter 481: Chapter 481 What is the Target?
“Ah, you, you’re really on to something, this is indeed that fragrance, but, what kind of fragrance is it?”
“Sandalwood.”
“Yes, yes, yes, it’s sandalwood, absolutely right, it’s the scent of sandalwood.”
“It seems that we didn’t make a mistake this time, this is truly a great treasure.”
As Ling’er spoke, she began collecting from the ground.
“Big brother, isn’t this just magical? How could the crap of an animal be, you know, not only useful, but also fragrant?”
Hei Lang was completely baffled and then he turned to Lin Yi and said.
“Yeah, maybe this is what’s special about this animal. Anyway, if we proceed like this, we should be fine.”
“Actually, this is just nature’s peculiar way of giving back and, after you ingest these things and they go through a process of digestion and refinement, it’s quite possible they could benefit humans in a different way. Nature is actually very fair and just to everyone.”
Hei Lang just frowned, as he didn’t quite understand this.
After all, being a straightforward warrior, these refined words were nothing but gibberish to him.
“Heh, just remember that if civet coffee can be drunk, this means this thing can also be taken into the human body, you get me?”
“Yeah, that I understand. Hey, are we almost done?”
Ling’er had collected a lot of stuff and stored it outside her backpack.
If there were much more, it might become a hassle to carry out, at the very least, it could become a burden.
“Yeah, that should be enough. We’ll process these back home and they should keep for a long time, this is indeed rare.”
Ling’er was still immersed in this joy.
Perhaps, those who are not in the trade could never understand her excitement at this moment.
“Ling’er, are you done?”
Lin Yi seemed very tense the whole time.
He clearly saw that those things never vanished and were eyeing this spot greedily.
Perhaps, because these people hadn’t approached, they hadn’t launched an immediate attack.
“Oh, we’re good to go.”
Finally, Ling’er stood up and then carefully closed her backpack.
“Alright, if we’re all set, then let’s hurry and leave. Big brother, lead the way.”
After speaking, the hunter nodded and then hurried forward.
However, upon reaching this area, it really felt like the terrain had become much smoother.
Compared to the path they had just tread, it was indeed much easier.
“Big brother, something’s not right, stop walking.”
Suddenly, Lin Yi at the back sensed something off and gave a friendly warning.
The hunter gradually halted his steps, then turned around to see. He noticed that those pig-faced monkeys were closely following them.
And they maintained a certain distance, as if surveilling them, waiting for the moment they would leave this area.
“What’s going on? Why are they following us? Normally speaking, I haven’t encroached on their territory.”
“Not encroached on their territory? Every spot here is theirs, how could they let us go easily?”
“But no, didn’t you say earlier that as long as we don’t attack them first, they wouldn’t notice all this?”
The hunter curiously addressed Ling’er.
Ling’er found it really hard to respond.
After all, everything she knew was from books; she had never experienced such situations in reality.
“I, I’m not sure about this, I’ve never encountered anything like it.”
“So, if we don’t move, they won’t either?”
“That should be the case, but the key problem is that I cannot just stand still forever. If they keep chasing us like this, I’m afraid they might suddenly attack, and our situation would become even more troublesome.”
Now, those few prey had come into the light, so they could see them very clearly.
Lin Yi counted in his mind, there were six in total.
If any one of them made an aggressive move, the four of them would most likely not be able to withstand it,
“What should we do, big brother? Think of something, quick.”
“If it really comes down to it, we might just have to kill these few prey.”
“No way, that’s absolutely not an option. If they die, Xi Lian Mountain will quickly lose balance, and your whole village won’t stand a chance then.”
Of course, Ling’er was against that idea.
“But if we don’t deal with them, then they might just take care of the four of us. Tell me, should we save them or ourselves?”
“Is there really no other way? Or maybe a more moderate approach?”
“Could it be because you took their stuff and they don’t want to let you leave?”
“Impossible! It’s just some excrement, it’s not something they would care about.”
“Maybe they have such a peculiar character, so they refuse to let it all go. Otherwise, try leaving the bag here and see if they’ll let us leave?”
“What? Leave, leave the bag here? This, that’s not possible, there are many important things inside this bag.”
“Now, we’re just testing to see where their target really is. Do it for now.”
Upon hearing the hunter’s words, Ling’er indeed felt troubled. She looked up at Lin Yi as if seeking his opinion.
“I think what the big brother is saying makes sense, and we’re just probing now, not really leaving the bag behind. Put it down here, and then, let’s try to move forward.”
At this point, it seemed Ling’er had no other choice but to follow their suggestion and gently placed the bag on the ground.
Then, they started moving forward again.
But after walking a bit, they discovered that those few prey were still not letting them go.
“No good, it seems their target is not the bag.”
“This is truly strange, if it’s not the bag, then what does it mean? Is it because we’ve invaded here, so they consider us invaders?”

chapters.title: Chapter 482: 482 Protecting the Young
chapters.content:
Chapter 482: Chapter 482 Protecting the Young
“This, is not necessarily set in stone.”
“Then it looks like we have no choice but to take the risk when the time comes, we’ll just have to compete with them on speed.”
“You’re joking, they have four legs, we have two, how could we possibly compete with them on speed? It’s absolutely impossible.”
“But standing here at an impasse isn’t a solution either.”
“I think I understand now.”
Just then, Ling’er suddenly murmured a sentence, and this one sentence seemed to give everyone hope instantly.
“Ling’er, do you have an idea?”
“Yes, I’ve realized something, look behind them.”
As she spoke, she pointed in that direction, and everyone followed the direction of her finger to look again.
They noticed that behind those six prey, there were indeed two very small creatures following.
“Those must be their offspring, but, it doesn’t seem to have much to do with the situation, does it?”
“I see them now, two cubs, but what does that tell us?”
“If they are cubs, I suspect that if we go further forward, we might be entering their den”
“Do you mean to say, the real den might be over there, and that there might be others there, is that what you mean?”
“I guess that’s what it means. Now, let me go get my bag, and then, we’ll change direction to see if it’s true.”
Lin Yi nodded, agreeing that what she said seemed to make sense.
Then Ling’er quietly walked over, bent down, and put the bag back on her shoulders.
They changed direction and walked in a different direction.
“Look, they really didn’t follow.”
She pointed excitedly in that direction.
“It seems that Ling’er’s deduction is correct, which also proves that if we go forward, there should be more of their cubs. Therefore, they are instinctively not wanting us to get close to this area. Fortunately, we did not move too fast.”
“Brother, if that’s the case, if we continue to go forward, won’t we also be unable to leave this place just the same?”
“If that place is where the den exists, then I might have made a wrong guess about our direction again, which means this path should be passable.”
“But, the more we walk towards this side, it seems the environment is getting darker, isn’t it?”
Lin Yi also felt something odd.
Normally, he should be walking towards a brighter place, and the further that way he went, the darker the environment seemed to become.
If this was indeed the case, then he could almost conclude that their direction must be wrong.
“But that place is already occupied by them, do you think we can still get through there? If we invade their territory like this, they will definitely attack us together.”
“Then, if not, walking this way might very well be a dead end too.”
“Of course, at least now it’s proven that walking this way should be safe. Haven’t you noticed? They are no longer standing in the original place.”
Upon saying this, the hunter gestured backward with his hand.
“Isn’t it? Now those massive creatures are just standing there idly, as if these few people in front have nothing to do with them anymore.”
After listening, Lin Yi just let out a long sigh.
Now, these people were bypassing the broad, sunny path and insisting on taking a dark, narrow alley instead, but there was no choice, the situation forced them, and he too was compelled.
“I understand now, in their case, they probably prefer to live in such bright places. Moreover, this place is absolutely quiet, so they’ve already occupied it. However, if there is an exit there, I don’t think they would necessarily choose that spot.”
After hearing Ling’er’s words, Lin Yi thought carefully.
“You mean the exit; if it were there, they wouldn’t be near it, is that what you mean?”
“Right, all the light we see is shining down from directly above our heads, and other than that, there are no other places that can transmit light. Haven’t you noticed? Going forward is not where their light source is.”
“Well then, we can keep guessing, but it’s pointless, so let’s just move forward and see if we can find any other paths.”
As they spoke, everyone once again set out on their journey.
After walking some distance forward, they began to feel the surrounding environment gradually darkening.
It had even reached the point where they couldn’t see their own hands before them.
“Brother, should we light some torches? Plus, in this environment, we can’t see anything at all. If there really is something down here, there’s no avoiding it.”
“I’m really worried that if we light torches, it might attract the attention of other things.”
“Don’t worry, as long as they are here, that means this cave should still be safe.”
“So if this place really is safe, can’t we take a break again, adjust our state, and then move forward a bit further?”
Lin Yi truly felt exhausted, especially the wound on his foot, which was still aching faintly.
He thought that not only himself, but Ling’er must also be gritting her teeth and persevering.
Although it was still daylight outside, under these circumstances, he felt that if they could stop for a while in a safe and relatively secure environment, it should be alright.
“Resting again now?”
It was actually the hunter who felt the request was inappropriate.
He had only slept through the previous night.
Now that they had just begun their journey, did they have to rest again here? The hunter really didn’t know how much longer this might delay them.
“What does everyone think?”
Seeing the hunter somewhat disagreed with the idea, he began to seek the opinions of Hei Lang and Ling’er.
“I also think there’s no need to rest, we should hurry and break out of here. It’s been almost two days since we entered the mountain; we can’t stay here too long, can we, Hei Lang?”

chapters.title: Chapter 483: 483: Something Is Not Right
chapters.content:
Chapter 483: Chapter 483: Something Is Not Right
“Anyway, I’m fine with whatever everyone decides; if you guys want to rest, I can rest too, and if you want to keep moving, I’ll go along with that as well. Either way, I have no issues.”
Hei Lang always had this kind of attitude.
“Alright then, since that’s the consensus, let’s continue on our way. But I do feel that it’s exceedingly dark here. How about we light a torch as Ling’er suggested? Since the creatures live around here, I believe the surrounding area should be relatively safe.”
Once again he made this suggestion. Although hunters are usually cautious, he found it difficult to navigate in the pitch-black environment.
He simply nodded, and then took out one of the torches.
“Or maybe we don’t need a torch? We have lighting equipment here that could illuminate our path, isn’t that more convenient than a torch?”
“That won’t do. In this environment, it’s not about what’s convenient. This torch has been specially treated, and small prey won’t dare to come near it. Besides, even if there are larger creatures around, they are unlikely to approach us because of the torch. That’s why sometimes, things that are too new might not be usable here.”
The hunter quickly refuted Hei Lang’s suggestion.
Eventually, the torch was lit, and its faint glow truly illuminated the surroundings.
Lin Yi glanced around, and although he couldn’t see clearly into the distance, at least he could see that he was indeed at a crossroads.
Everything around him was desolate; nothing else was detected.
“Ha, in my opinion, this light hardly makes any difference compared to the darkness.”
“What do you mean?”
“Without light, perhaps there’s still a glimmer of hope in one’s heart, perhaps something to see. But now, after lighting up the area, take a look at our surroundings.”
“No matter, the more difficult the road, the more likely we are to find an exit.”
“Bro, do you have a plan?”
“There was a time before when I was in the deep mountains, I encountered a situation where it was pitch black inside a cave, but still, I managed to find my way out. You have to believe we can do this.”
“But now that I think about it, something still seems a bit off.”
“Off? What’s off?”
“Think about it, if there’s an exit, why would those creatures go through the water and then back out through that same hole? Couldn’t they take a shortcut?”
“A shortcut?”
Upon hearing this, the hunter slightly furrowed his brow; it seemed that he had not truly considered this point before.
“Yeah, these creatures have been living here for more than a year or two, definitely. They must know the area better than we do. If that’s the case, then there must be an entrance or exit here, and they would undoubtedly know it better than any of us.”
“So what you’re suggesting is that this place is absolutely enclosed, absolutely safe, and that’s why they chose to build their nest here? When they need to go out to hunt, they simply swim through the water and then enter that cave.”
“Exactly, strictly speaking, this is like a cave within a cave, so if I had to guess, this must be an entirely enclosed cavern.”
“If that’s the case, then we’re indeed in trouble.”
As he spoke, he paused and frowned.
“Yes, this is indeed troublesome.”
“If we can’t make it through the front, are we expected to turn back? Apart from wasting time and energy, the key issue is that even if we turn back now, we might not be able to make it out.”
After all, the hunter had already said that even if the mist dissipates completely, it would take at least three days. Could they really afford to wait here for three days?
“Oh man, as far as I’m concerned, there’s a solution to everything. If it comes down to it, we’ll just climb up from there.”
Hei Lang seemed impatient, and so he turned around and pointed in the direction they had come from.
“You mean, we all climb up through that hole where the sunlight comes in?”
“Exactly, what else can we do? Moreover, from what I’ve seen, the height isn’t a problem if I use my grappling gun, and it should work. We can give it a try.”
“You know, if you put it that way, that actually sounds like a good plan. Bro, what do you think?”
“If it were the old days, I’d have given up on this, but now that you guys have such sophisticated equipment, I think it’s worth a try. Moreover, that spot would allow us to bypass their nest without disturbing them.”
“Then what are we waiting for? Let’s hurry and see if we can figure out a way.”
As he spoke, Hei Lang seemed unable to wait any longer and quickly turned around, hurrying back in that direction once more.
Finally, after arriving there, Lin Yi nervously glanced to the left and noticed that those creatures were not present. Perhaps they had gone back to their nest to check on their younglings.
If that was the case, his situation might be a bit safer.
“Hei Lang, what do you think of this situation?”
He looked up continuously as if he was estimating the distance or looking for a breakthrough point from his position.
“I’ve taken a rough look, and it seems that the height should not be an issue. The rope is about 100 meters long, so we should definitely be able to manage that.”
“But the key is, is there a place up there sturdy enough to anchor to?”
“Big brother, take a good look at this hole. It’s just big enough for one person to pass through. If we find something long enough to brace against the sides of the entrance, we can definitely make it work.”

chapters.title: Chapter 484: 484 Remote Treatment
chapters.content:
Chapter 484: Chapter 484 Remote Treatment
“Something long? So, you’re saying it has to be sturdy enough for sure, sturdy enough to withstand a person’s weight at least, and what about this thing?”
As he spoke, he then took a climbing stick out of his hand.
This one is specially made of alloy, and moreover, its quality is extremely stable.
“This could work, but the main issue is, how should I get it up there?”
“You have a crossbow, right? Then use the resistance from that to carry it out. Although, it might not necessarily work, but the key question is, how long will it take?”
“Okay, I understand, I’ll just go and try.”
After finishing speaking, Hei Lang tucked the stick in his hand and then began to try moving it over and over.
Anyway, there wasn’t much help he could offer here, so after that, he pulled Ling’er and stepped back a couple of paces.
“Ling’er, after taking these things back, will they be of some use?”
“Of course, if I refine them a bit and then dry them, they can be preserved for a long time. These items are definitely rare medicinal herbs.”
“That’s great. It looks like this trip wasn’t in vain for us after all, even just for getting these things. Besides, you wouldn’t normally find this stuff outside, right?”
“How could you? These creatures are only recorded in very ancient books, and it seems like they’ve been extinct for a very long time, very few people have ever seen them.”
“Even the hunters who used to go mountain hunting in the past, I reckon, probably haven’t seen them either, because this place is so remote and they’re hidden in a cave underwater. Regular folks would definitely not come here.”
“So, no matter what, we just happened to catch all this by a fluke.”
“Hopefully, I also hope this can go smoothly and let us get those things quickly so we can then hurry out from here—”
“Right, where’s Liu Yao?”
As she reached this point, it seemed like Ling’er suddenly thought of something.
They had been out for two full days, and during these two days, they had not proactively contacted Liu Yao. They were unsure of her current situation.
“Ah, if you hadn’t mentioned it, I would have genuinely forgotten about that. Yes, Liu Yao… I wonder if her mother has had any flare-ups in the past couple of days. I need to call her and ask about the situation.”
While talking, he walked over, then took a specially made phone out of his backpack.
It was a phone that connected via the satellites above, which he had already explained to Liu Yao.
He would contact Liu Yao through it if there was any need.
He dialed a number skillfully, and then patiently waited.
After the phone rang for a while, he heard a woman’s voice come through,
“Hello, I’m Liu Yao.”
“Oh, Liu Yao, it’s me, Lin Yi.”
“Oh, Lin Yi, you finally called. I’ve been waiting here for two days, and I had no idea what situation you guys were in. How is it now, is everything safe?”
“Don’t worry, there aren’t any major problems. Just ran into some trouble the past couple of days, so I got delayed and couldn’t contact you.”
“It doesn’t matter, as long as you are safe, that should be fine.”
“By the way, how’s your mother doing?”
“My mom? She’s—she’s okay, I guess.”
Liu Yao’s hesitant voice over the phone clearly indicated that she was hiding something from him.
“Then let your mom take the phone, I want to ask her about her condition.”
“Oh, no need, my mom isn’t here right now.”
“Not there? Your mom has trouble walking, how could she not be there? Tell me, is something wrong?”
“Oh, you—don’t worry about it, I can handle it myself.”
“Handle it? How can you handle it? Tell me, is that condition acting up again?”
“Yes, it did flare up, and last night, my mom was in pain the whole night.”
“Why didn’t you tell me sooner?”
“But I didn’t know how to contact you.”
Listening to Liu Yao’s aggrieved voice on the phone, Lin Yi suddenly realized.
Right, he only said to leave the phone behind and wait for his call, never thinking to tell her how she could reach him or how to contact him.
“Besides the pain, is she experiencing any other symptoms?”
“No—oh, right, the pain spot, when I checked yesterday, I found it was a bit warm. I think it might be an abscess.”
“In that case, do you have any emergency supplies with you?”
“Emergency supplies, what kind of supplies?”
“Like, say, a scalpel.”
“Me? What would I be doing bringing a scalpel out here, oh, wait, I recall now, I actually do have one with me.”
Upon saying this, Liu Yao seemed to be suddenly reminded, as if she had not taken the situation seriously before.
And she had never considered that she might need those things at a time like this.
“You brought it then?”
“Yes, I have it on me.”
“Let me tell you what condition your mother is in.”
As he said this, Lin Yi suddenly felt a jolt.
It was obvious that he had formed a clear picture in his mind.
And at this moment, it was precisely Liu’s mother’s ankle.
Lin Yi realized that indeed there was a swelling there, and inside, a lot of fluid had accumulated.
In just a short two days of not seeing her, he hadn’t expected that the swelling could develop so fast. Her pain was caused by the pressure from the fluid accumulation, causing her such pain.
It was strange; he wasn’t even on the scene, so why was he able to see such a clear image?
“Why are you still letting her sit?”
“What are you talking about? How do you know she’s sitting?”
When Liu Yao heard this, she suddenly realized that something was indeed amiss.
She quickly looked back and then scanned the room.

chapters.title: Chapter 485: 485 Solving Problems
chapters.content:
Chapter 485: Chapter 485 Solving Problems
Could it be that Lin Yi still had cameras set up in his room at this time?
That would be somewhat unethical. If it really was the case, then wouldn’t I have absolutely no privacy?
“You don’t need to look everywhere, I didn’t install cameras. I just think that if his pain is getting worse, having him sit in a wheelchair won’t solve anything. You must make her lie down flat right now, and also, elevate her feet a bit higher than the level of her body.”
“Oh, alright, I got it. What next?”
“I’m telling you, the pain is happening because there has been a build-up of a lot of fluid there. So, find a way to use a scalpel to drain the fluid out from there. After that, stitch the wound closed, and I’ll do the rest when I get back.”
“Is it that simple?”
...
“Yes, it’s that simple. Once you let it out, your mother should be able to get some relief. At the very least, she can hold on for another two to three days. If it’s really unbearable, don’t you have painkillers? Let her use those now. I estimate that I should be able to return in another two or three days.”
“Alright, I understand. You guys be careful and make sure to stay safe.”
After finishing the conversation, Liu Yao then hung up the phone.
“What’s up, is it your boss again?”
Mother Liu, sitting across the room, had been listening to the conversation all along.
“Mom, I know what to do now. Here, let me help you. You should lie down on the bed now, and then, I’ll find a pillow to prop up your feet.”
“What? Lie on the bed? Will lying on the bed stop the pain? Wasn’t it still hurting all night long last night when I was in bed?”
“Mom, don’t worry about it. He already told me on the phone what to do. He said if we do this, it should help alleviate your pain, although in a bit we’ll have to make a small cut at the ankle. You’ll have to bear with it.”
“Never mind a small cut, if you took off my whole leg right now, I wouldn’t mind. Besides, I find it a burden on me anyway.”
“Come on, Mom, let’s not talk about that now. Hurry up.”
While speaking, Liu Yao walked over and helped her mother up before she lay down on the bed.
Liu Yao did everything according to Lin Yi’s instructions, after all, as a nurse by training, this sort of thing should be well within her capabilities.
As Liu Yao made the incision, she felt a faint ache in her heart.
This was the first time she was using a scalpel on her mother, and she never imagined that performing surgery on a family member could feel like this.
“Mom, try to bear with it. I know it’s going to be painful, after all, we don’t have any anesthetics.”
“It’s okay, this degree of pain is nothing to your mother.”
The old woman clenched her teeth tightly but did not make a sound.
As soon as Liu Yao made the cut, she immediately saw a yellowish fluid surge out from within.
“Is this, is this all fluid buildup?”
She looked puzzledly at the draining fluid, then at the injured part of the ankle.
“I’m not sure.”
“How are you feeling now?”
“I don’t know, and I don’t understand why, but after you cut it open, it feels like there’s much less pressure. At least, it doesn’t feel as unbearably swollen anymore.”
“I see, so it looks like his plan was right. You mean, it was the buildup of fluid inside that created pressure, which is why you were in such unbearable pain?”
“Is that so? That’s great, it seems that your boss is really something else.”
More than that, for Liu Yao now, it felt like her trust in him had reached a divine level. There had never before been such a mysterious man appearing in front of her.
The ability to remote guide, or with just a few hints about the condition, he could immediately infer the real situation of the patient. This was something Liu Yao hardly dared to believe.
Finally, all the fluid was drained out, and Liu Yao saw that her mother really did feel much better.
“Mom, how do you feel now?”
“Really, so much better. Except for a bit of pain at the site of the incision, but I can tolerate all of that.”
After hearing this, she breathed a sigh of relief. Regardless, the immediate tricky situation had been handled.
“What’s the matter? Did something really go wrong with her mom?”
Upon seeing Lin Yi make the call, Ling’er walked over to inquire.
Just now, while Lin Yi was on the phone, he had been keeping an eye on Hei Lang’s actions. Although Hei Lang had been trying almost seven or eight times by now, he still hadn’t succeeded once.
“Yes, indeed there was a problem. The thing I was worried about still happened, which means we really can’t afford to waste any more time lingering here.”
“Right, hasn’t Hei Lang been trying his best? But with the height and the narrow gap of that opening, all he can do is keep attempting. I think eventually he will succeed in hooking onto it.”
“All right, let’s hope for the best now then.”
After saying that, Lin Yi simply nodded. However, deep down he was truly puzzled.
Normally, he could only make inferences once he saw the patient.
But now, even being so far away, he could clearly visualize her injuries. Could it be that his skills had improved once again?
But this upgrade seemed to have come without any prior notice from the system, which was exactly why he was so baffled.
However, with so many people around, Lin Yi couldn’t express his thoughts and had to wait for a less crowded moment to inquire.
“Big brother, it’s done.”
Suddenly, Lin Yi heard Hei Lang exclaim excitedly, and then he and Ling’er walked over there.
“Isn’t that right? Now the climbing stick has been wedged into the mouth of that opening, and when pulled hard, it seems to hold up quite well.”

chapters.title: Chapter 486: 486: The Hidden Peach Blossom Land
chapters.content:
Chapter 486: Chapter 486: The Hidden Peach Blossom Land
“That’s great, then if that’s the case, come on, Ling’er, you go up first.”
He felt that, under the present circumstances, climbing up now would probably be a bit safer.
“Ling’er, you see I’ll secure you, then I’ll pull from this end, and you try to use a bit of strength. It’s different from usual, so you must exert yourself, understand?”
“I don’t think that will work. It’s better for one person to go up first, to have someone ready to help from above. So we definitely need someone strong, then the rest of us can support him from below. I believe this is the most secure way.”
A hunter nearby gave a suggestion, and after careful thinking, it seemed he might be right.
“Yes, if that’s the case, it can work. You go up first, you help manage us. I will go up last, Lin Yi, you second, and big brother, you third.”
...
“Alright, alright, alright, I’ll follow your arrangement, that will do.”
In fact, the hunter was very excited at this time and had never imagined such a difficult feat could actually be achieved by their group.
So it wasn’t until this moment did he gradually realize that these people were certainly not talk without substance, and they must have their own plans and arrangements for coming here.
Afterwards, Hei Lang nodded, then using his own strength, climbed straight up to the top of the mountain.
Once he reached the top, he felt the air around him freshen considerably, after all, being cooped up in a cave, the circulation of air was definitely very poor.
“Big brother, I’m up now. There’s nothing around, and there are flowers blooming everywhere. It’s truly beautiful.”
After hearing this, he just nodded slightly.
“Big brother, what’s the situation? Could there really be such beautiful places in these mountains?”
“Well, it’s possible, and places like this are rarely entered by people. Maybe there really is such a beautiful spot. Oh right, let me remind you, do not casually touch those flowers. Let’s wait until we’re all up and check out the situation.”
“Alright, I got it. Come on, let’s see who the second person is.”
Hei Lang merely nodded, and then threw the rope down again.
“Ling’er, you go up. He will pull you up from above while I support you from below; this way, you can save some energy.”
Ling’er quickly nodded, then fastened the rope around her waist.
He felt that in these past two days, it seemed like all their time was spent coming and going on the road, without accomplishing much else.
They ascended in sequence, Ling’er, the hunter, with Lin Yi being the last to go up.
When everyone had climbed up, Lin Yi turned to look behind and sure enough, as Hei Lang had said, the mountainside was full of blooming flowers and the scent of flowers was truly overwhelming.
“It’s actually true, how come there are so many flowers here?”
They felt that after walking such a long, dark path, they suddenly seemed to have entered an isolated paradise. This environment did indeed bring them a sense of elation.
“Come, I’ll look at the map to see exactly where we are.”
As he spoke, the hunter took out the map once more.
Finally, he looked at it carefully, and after checking their surroundings, he nodded.
“I see now, it looks like our descent into this cave was not in vain.”
“Big brother, what do you mean?”
“Come here, look at this place.”
As he spoke, he pointed to a location on the map.
Lin Yi bent down to look and noticed that the area he was pointing at seemed to be a flat piece of land, and furthermore, it was all filled in.
“Oh, didn’t we say before? The places marked with question marks should be the deepest basement layers, which have not been explored and about which we really have no idea.”
“Look at all the places in front of that; they all have reference points, either mountains or trees. And now this piece of land isn’t even marked on the bottom. Do you understand what I mean?”
“Big brother, are you saying that this area hasn’t appeared on the map and that it might be the place marked with a question mark that we noted earlier?”
“Look over there.”
With that, he stretched out his hand and pointed behind them.
He noticed that indeed there was a small mountain, and it looked neither too big nor too small.
“Now see if there is a corresponding place on the map for that mountain.”
“Oh, I see it, just opposite us. If that’s the case, have we now actually entered the deepest part of the mountain?”
“Exactly, to be honest, we’ve been walking around in circles, in fact, we have already taken a shortcut, otherwise, who knows how long it would’ve taken us just walking on our own feet and how many dangers we would’ve faced on the way.”
“So, this deepest place turns out to be so beautiful.”
Lin’er couldn’t help but exclaim at this site.
It’s the places least visited by man that one discovers such beauty.
Which means that this place has never been mined by anyone. The more it’s like this, the more precious it becomes to them.
“But what about the herbs we’re looking for?”
“We should now be at the edge of the center of this area. So, if we circle past this stretch of grass and continue forward, I reckon we should be able to reach the core area. However, what’s actually there, we probably can’t know until we get there.”
“No matter, since it’s come to this, let’s just go ahead and see if we can reach the innermost core today, the very deepest part.”
“Okay then, it seems everyone is full of ‘Combat Power’, so let’s all check our belongings again to see if anything is missing.”
After the hunter finished speaking, everyone began to check their equipment. Really, it was all carried on their own backs and never left their hands, so how could there be any chance of something being lost?
“Big brother, there’s no issue here, shall we move forward then?”

chapters.title: Chapter 487: 487: Expelling the Poisonous Gas
chapters.content:
Chapter 487: Chapter 487: Expelling the Poisonous Gas
“Let’s go, right, let’s check out the flowers and plants over here and see what the situation is really like.”
The hunter seemed to have developed a great interest in these flowers and plants, so he got up and walked over.
Approaching the edge, the scent of the flowers became even more pronounced. He just lowered his head deeply and took a deep breath.
But he hadn’t fully inhaled that breath when he suddenly collapsed to the ground.
“Big brother, big brother.”
Seeing this, he had no clue what had happened and quickly rushed over.
...
“Hurry, that place is poisonous, drag him over here quickly and try not to breathe deeply.”
The hunter quickly determined the situation and turned to look back before swiftly turning around and leaving the patch of flowers.
“What do you mean? Is this place poisonous?”
“Yes, it’s very likely poisonous. Come, let me check him out.”
As she spoke, Ling’er walked over and carefully examined the hunter.
But she felt that, aside from his rapid breathing, there were no other obvious symptoms.
Ling’er simply examined his pupils and noticed there were no signs of dilatation.
It seemed to be just a temporary unconsciousness, but what kind of toxic gas had caused it?
At that moment, Lin Yi clearly saw a stream of black gas constantly roaming inside his body.
He just frowned slightly. Could this be the poison he was talking about? And now, he was seeing it with his own eyes.
Deep inside, Lin Yi actually felt a surge of excitement.
“He must be poisoned. The situation here is dangerous, we need to leave this area quickly. Hei Lang, you take care of carrying him, and let’s quickly get around this cluster of flowers and head inside.”
“Alright, I understand.”
After speaking, Ling’er nodded and then bent down to carry the hunter on her back.
This place didn’t seem very large, so they only walked around for about fifteen minutes before the cluster of flowers vanished behind them.
Moving forward, it felt like the sky suddenly darkened.
And ahead, no trees could be seen, only desolate stones scattered chaotically.
Even if they were to walk through this, it would presumably consume a considerable amount of energy and time.
“How can the weather change like this?”
Hei Lang glanced back curiously.
But he noticed that the place behind him was still bathed in sunshine, while only this area seemed to be shrouded in dark clouds.
Hadn’t the hunter mentioned it before? The mountain weather was always unpredictable, and it was unclear what was influencing it.
“Why do I feel such a gloomy sensation here?”
“Heh, when I approached just now, I had already sensed it. And if I’m not mistaken, this place is probably the core area.”
“But there’s not a single tree around, not even grass, let alone looking for any herbs. Are we heading in the wrong direction?”
“I’m not sure, after all, I’ve never been here before. Never mind that, let’s prioritize reviving him right here on the edge.”
While speaking, Hei Lang placed the hunter back on the ground.
Lin Yi walked over to examine the hunter carefully. His vital signs were all relatively stable, but the black gas seemed to have never stopped moving within his body.
Now, he could clearly see that the flow of gas had reached the location of his head.
“Let me use some herbs on him, then he should be able to recover from the heat and detoxify.”
“That won’t be necessary, I have acupuncture needles with me. Hand me those needles.”
“What? Acupuncture?”
Upon hearing this, Ling’er felt curious.
She had thought that treating him with traditional herbs would have brought him close to recovery.
But now, Lin Yi was proposing a different method of healing, and she didn’t know who to listen to for the right course of action.
“Yes, I know what the situation is. Come on, bring those items here. He has indeed inhaled some poison gas, and this gas has entered his brain. We just need to release this gas and I believe he should wake up quickly.”
“What kind of gas? Can you actually see it?”
“No, it’s just a feeling. Let’s hurry up.”
Ling’er’s question wasn’t something that Lin Yi could answer, especially since he didn’t know how to respond.
Ling’er just nodded, and finally, she quickly brought the toolkit to Lin Yi.
He took out a long, thin needle, then began searching for the right point to insert it in the head.
He wasn’t very practiced at this, but he recalled there seemed to be a map of acupoints formed within his body previously.
Lin Yi noticed a spot at the top of the head, slightly to the left, that was emitting a faint red light.
Could this be the hint the system was giving him? Was this the most appropriate point for the needle?
Upon this realization, he didn’t hesitate and then inserted the needle steadily and gently.
In the past, he had some experience to draw upon, so he didn’t feel it was too difficult.
After all, his brain was commanding his nervous system, meaning all actions were being carried out without his conscious control.
Even if he closed his eyes, he could probably do it accurately.
Once the needle was in, he could clearly feel a flow of air watching him softly underneath, which he believed to be the toxic gas.
Then, with a few simple manipulations inside, he suddenly yanked the needle out from the top of the head.
What followed was a spurt of blood.
Just a second or two later, the bleeding stopped.

chapters.title: Chapter 488: 488 Forbidden Area
chapters.content:
Chapter 488: Chapter 488 Forbidden Area
“All right, does anyone have any hemostatic medicine? Put it on him.”
“I have some here.”
As he spoke, he walked over and gently sprinkled some white powder on the very fine needle hole.
Ling’er found it strange. If the needling had been done properly, at the correct acupoints, there shouldn’t have been any bleeding. Could it be that he had made a mistake this time? However, she didn’t voice her thoughts.
Seeing Lin Yi’s fully confident demeanor, she could now more or less guess what was going on.
“Is it all right now?”
...
“There should be no problem. Give it a minute or two and he will recover quickly. Just push him a bit and he should wake up.”
“Big brother, big brother.”
Ling’er, being a girl, didn’t take action herself; instead, Hei Lang went over.
Slowly, the hunter indeed opened his eyes.
And then he looked around.
“What happened to me?”
All of a sudden, the hunter sat up from the ground, then looked around at everyone. Clearly, he felt that all eyes were on him.
“You inhaled something just now near the flowers and it seems you were poisoned.”
“What? Poisoned? Oh, I remember, there was a very pungent smell, and after I went in, I knew nothing more. Are you saying I inhaled poison gas?”
“Yes, it was poison gas, but it’s already been taken care of. There’s no problem now.”
“What do you mean ‘taken care of’?”
“Yes, taken care of. So, rest assured, get up and move your limbs, see if there’s any impediment.”
The hunter felt that it was almost unbelievable.
If he had really been poisoned, it would have taken at least half a day to recover. But how had everything been resolved so quickly?
The mysterious aura of the man and woman before him completely filled his inner world.
After moving around a bit on the spot, he found that his limbs weren’t hindered, which meant his body hadn’t suffered any other harm.
“Oh, it’s nothing. I feel like there’s no problem at all now.”
“That’s good to hear. Remember, that place looked mysterious and often hides dangerous things. Those flowers might look pretty, but they’re actually very strange and filled with toxins.”
“Yes, I was careless. And when I approached, I did wonder if the plants could be poisonous. Although I was considering that possibility, I never expected the smell to be toxic. I’ve never experienced anything like this before.”
“Didn’t you say you came across a toxin before?”
“Yeah, when we first entered Xi Lian Mountain, there was a toxin, wasn’t there? I’ve told you about this, but those were flowers.”
“Since that poison gas was able to get into Xi Lian Mountain, I believe it might be pervasive in certain areas. Maybe it contaminated these flowers and they absorbed the poison, which they then released, endangering things around here.”
“Yes, it seems to be the case. And we’ve seen there’s no damage around here, so that proves not even the larger beasts dare to come close. This place is a definite no-go zone.”
“Indeed, it looks like a no-go zone. I didn’t expect this area to have so many of them, one after another. Just thinking about it gives me a headache.”
“Let’s not think about it, it’s pointless. By the way, where are we?”
After saying this, the hunter suddenly realized how unfamiliar the environment really was, including the temperature and the conditions, which were completely different from before.
“Right, I was about to confirm that with you. Doesn’t this look like the middle of the deep mountains, the very core and innermost area?”
“Looking at the environment, it seems so. Look, there’s not even grass here, not to mention trees.”
“Exactly, and that’s what puzzles me. If we can’t even find these things, where would the medicinal herbs grow?”
“If we move forward, there’s still a long way to go, so we must get through this area to find out what lies beyond.”
“But looking at this situation…”
Lin Yi hesitated, feeling that even if they moved through, they would likely face significant resistance, unlike the smooth progress they had made earlier.
Even though Lin Yi didn’t finish his sentence, the atmosphere already carried a negative pressure for all of them.
The hunter didn’t say anything, just shook his head helplessly, then stepped forward.
He patted Lin Yi’s shoulder gently twice with his hand.
Without saying a word, Lin Yi felt the weight of those pats as a significant gesture of support.
“Little brother, I told you before that entering Xi Lian Mountain isn’t as simple as you thought. Yet you were keen to enter. What now? Are you thinking of backing out?”
“No, I never thought of backing out. It just seems wrong if these things cost all of us our lives.”
“For now, we’re safe, and what we’ve been through so far hasn’t been much for me. But the real danger is in understanding what lies ahead, got it?”
“You mean deeper inside?”
“The most beautiful places often hide the most dangerous things, so no matter what we face moving forward, we must grit our teeth and persevere. Otherwise, none of us will make it out alive, understand?”

chapters.title: Chapter 489: 489: The Difficult Stone Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 489: Chapter 489: The Difficult Stone Path
The words of the hunter were certainly not without merit.
Lin Yi could understand this.
Before, he had such a wealth of experience, and in it, probably only the hunter himself truly grasped what he had been through.
“Brother, if it were me, I’d say stop thinking about anything else, just charge straight ahead, and strike while the iron is hot to see if we can quickly grab those things. If we manage to, then perhaps, if we’re lucky, we won’t encounter a single thing.”
“Right, this brother speaks the truth. If we’re lucky, maybe we won’t run into anything, but if we’re not fortunate, perhaps…”
The hunter did not continue but managed an awkward smile.
...
“Alright, since you all are so energetic, let’s go all out and charge straight in. Though the path isn’t easy, if we grit our teeth, we can still persevere. Let’s go, Ling’er, you okay?”
“Don’t worry, I absolutely have no issues.”
Ling’er just smiled, though she said this, deep inside she was already at her limit.
If it wasn’t because she needed to collect these things, probably not so many people would have accompanied her to such a place.
They began climbing over the rocks.
The rocks were uneven, and in some places, sharp objects protruded.
You had to navigate around them to pass through smoothly.
“Ling’er, are you alright?”
Suddenly, Lin Yi saw that Ling’er had slipped, and immediately, he rushed over to pull her up from below.
But because he was off-balance, he too fell onto his hands.
He felt a stabbing pain in the area of his buttocks.
A cry of pain escaped his lips.
“Brother, what happened?”
Hei Lang quickly went over, but since he had some experience with such things, the trek didn’t seem as agonizing as they had imagined.
“It’s nothing, just took a fall.”
“Big brother, you… you’re bleeding.”
Hei Lang saw that from the area of his buttocks, there seemed to be blood flowing out, and then he was lifted from that spot.
Only then did they realize that there was a hard rock below, with a sharp point like that of a sword.
Clearly, it had pierced straight into Lin Yi’s buttocks.
Lin Yi just smiled, then reached his hand down to the area below, and sure enough, there was indeed blood flowing out.
Unexpectedly, instead of encountering danger, he had wounded himself.
“Big brother, let’s apply some medicine, shall we?”
“No need to worry, just a minor cut. Ling’er, are you okay?”
He noticed some scrapes on Ling’er’s leg area, evidently from the sharp rocks just now.
“It’s nothing, it’s nothing. If you’re alright, then what’s a few scratches on me? Let’s keep moving.”
“When you walk, you must be careful. Some of the rocks are covered with moss and are slippery when you ascend, so we must choose the smoother rocks with nothing on them to walk on, understand?”
The hunter’s caution was not without reason; just now, they had indeed overlooked this.
It looked like lush greenery, but once you stepped on it, it was extremely slippery.
“I’m puzzled; this is the same world, so why is this place so damp, dark, and moist?”
As Lin Yi walked, he looked up, wondering why under the clear sky there was such a peculiar environment.
“I’m not sure either. I’ve only heard the older generation say that the land nurtures its environment, so under such circumstances, sometimes it’s truly incomprehensible since nature is so miraculous.”
“Yes, indeed it’s amazing. And such an environment, I have never encountered before. Ah, look over there, what’s that?”
While talking, they suddenly noticed a tree-like object had appeared ahead.
The big tree, although not very tall, stood erect there.
“Something’s off. Just now, I clearly didn’t see anything, and we’ve only moved forward a bit. Normally, if there was something here, we should have seen it long ago.”
“Could it be that we just didn’t notice it earlier?”
“One person missing something is alright, but for all of us to miss it? No good, something’s wrong here.”
Before they had finished speaking, suddenly, they saw the tree move ever so slightly under their watchful eyes.
It was then that they realized it wasn’t a tree at all—it was clearly a beast that had made its appearance.
Following that, the tree-like creature turned around, and they noticed it was something that resembled a tree.
It was covered in green, and its skin color was virtually identical to the bark of a tree, except for the top of its head, which seemed to have sprouted some green splits.
As it turned towards them, they could then clearly distinguish the nose and eyes in the middle of its face.
It bared its teeth and scowled, clearly regarding the group as its prey.
Lin Yi had genuinely never seen such a thing before, not even in books or on television.
“What… what is that?”
“I don’t know either; I have never seen it before. Quick, find somewhere to hide.”
Looking around, there was nowhere to hide—it was empty all around with only large rocks.
Soon they watched as the creature slowly approached them.
It wasn’t very fast, so the group just slowly backed away, watching what unfolded before them.

chapters.title: Chapter 490: 490 Shooting the Monster
chapters.content:
Chapter 490: Chapter 490 Shooting the Monster
This environment, if they wanted to run, it was simply impossible to achieve; on the contrary, running would only make it easier for them to fall to the ground.
“Quick, get everything ready.”
Just at this moment, a hunter suddenly shouted, and then he raised his hunting rifle and took aim at that creature.
Upon seeing this thing, that creature just paused for a moment, and then quickly ran several steps in the opposite direction.
It was very fast, so fast that it had outpaced the swing speed of the hunting rifle.
The hunter quickly turned the gun around, but found that by the time he had the muzzle aimed at the prey, it had once again run off in another direction.
...
This went on back and forth, countless times.
“Don’t move for now, this kind of tossing and turning is simply no solution.”
Lin Yi reached out his hand and pushed the hunter beside him.
At that moment, the hunter only paused.
Actually, he just wanted to take aim at this prey and fire, but who knew that it would keep jumping around here.
“If we don’t take it down, we simply can’t move forward.”
“But like this, it’s ultimately not a solution, don’t you see? It’s been dodging the hunting rifle the whole time; clearly, it must know this is a weapon that’s bad for it.”
“Then what do you suggest we do?”
“Currently, I don’t have a good solution either, let’s see if we can think of some other way to lure it away.”
“Lure it away? What could we do? Are we really going to rely on food as bait?”
“Ah, right, now that you mention it, using food as bait might just be a good idea?”
“Are you saying, throw the food far away, then let it go search for the food while we take the chance to leave from here or something?”
“Yes, exactly that.”
“You’re thinking too simple. Surviving in the wild is definitely different from domesticated animals, it’s not a dog. If you give it something, it might leave, but it might not really do it.”
“That’s not necessarily true, besides, you also don’t understand what exactly this thing is, right?”
“I indeed haven’t seen it before, haven’t even heard of it. Look, from a distance, it just looks like a tree, but now that we’re closer, it’s clearly not.”
“Get some food out.”
Lin Yi turned his head and then spoke to Hei Lang.
Although Hei Lang also couldn’t understand his behavior, it seemed that under these circumstances, there wasn’t a better solution.
“Big brother, do you think this method will work? Moreover, this is our human food after all; it might not be effective for it.”
“How can you know without trying? Come on, hand it over to me, let’s see if there’s any canned food.”
“There is canned food.”
As he spoke, Hei Lang took out a fast-food can from the bottom and put it in front of him.
Lin Yi took it in his hands and shook it gently, then opened it, and quickly a pungent delicious scent wafted up.
“I wonder if this creature is carnivorous? If it’s really a herbivore, then I’m truly out of options.”
While speaking, he emptied the can and then threw it far away, toward another direction,
but that thing didn’t move at all.
It seemed as if it wasn’t interested in anything he had to offer.
When Lin Yi saw all this, he gradually realized his action was probably superfluous.
“Look, big brother, I told you, throwing those things wouldn’t have any effect at this time.”
Lin Yi’s brow was tightly furrowed, as though he hadn’t really come to realize all that was happening before his eyes.
“It’s strange, with not even a bit of attraction, could it be that it is really a herbivore?”
“That’s right, if it is a herbivore, then perhaps fundamentally it poses no threat to us, can’t we just walk past it then?”
“Just to be safe, we still can’t do that, and besides, we know too little about it, old brother, what do you think?”
“I’m completely out of ideas; I’ve never seen such a thing before, otherwise, I might just shoot it and settle the matter.”
While speaking, the hunter once again picked up the hunting rifle and aimed it at the prey.
But strangely, this time, the prey did not move.
Seizing this opportunity, the hunter suddenly pulled the trigger.
A bullet swiftly shot out, and with it, the prey collapsed to the ground.
It didn’t struggle in the slightest.
Although he felt it was a pity, and he also didn’t know what the other intended to do, now that it had been shot down by them, Lin Yi still felt a strange sensation in his heart.
“Well, it’s finally taken care of.”
After speaking, the hunter let out a long sigh of relief.
“Let’s go, we’ll go see what exactly it is.”
With that, everyone followed Lin Yi and walked forward.
All of them were closely following behind, and in fact, everyone was filled with curiosity about the creature, eager to discover what secrets it hid.
It was only after they approached that they realized its entire body was covered with bark-like material.
Moreover, its head was shaped like a triangle.
Such an odd creature, Lin Yi probably never imagined in his life that he would encounter one.
He just curiously reached out to touch its skin, but the hunter promptly grabbed him.
“What are you doing?”
“Nothing, I just wanted to feel if its skin is very rough.”
“Whether it’s rough or not has nothing to do with you; don’t you forget? Curiosity could be lethal here.”
The hunter still had a profound memory of the recent events.
His reminder wasn’t for no reason. So, when Lin Yi heard it, he simply nodded lightly.
“Alright then, these things are of no use to us anyways, let’s keep going forward. What’s that?”
Before he finished speaking, Lin Yi suddenly widened his eyes in horror.
Because he now saw, from all sides, were so many creatures, and all of them looked exactly the same as the one lying on the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 491: 491: Gave Up the Pursuit
chapters.content:
Chapter 491: Chapter 491: Gave Up the Pursuit
“What on earth is going on here?”
He was very surprised, and then, he opened his eyes and looked at them.
“Damn it, could it be that gunshot disturbed these things? If it really saw its companion dead here, would it launch a frenzied retaliation against us?”
“We can’t stay here, this environment is too dangerous. Let’s hurry and get out.”
“Retreat? Are you joking? How can we get out under these conditions? We’ve finally made it in here.”
“But look at how many there are. Did you count them? One, two, three, four… oh my god, a total of 11.”
...
The hunter had a terror-stricken look in his eyes. He had never faced such a formidable show of force before.
This experience would probably be unforgettable for him for the rest of his life.
“Hey, do you feel it? Their movement is very slow.”
“Yes, I see it now. It seems like they’re slowly testing everything out. And before, when I fired the shotgun without looking, it seemed to dodge left and right with incredible speed.”
“Do we have any other weapons?”
He turned around and then looked at Hei Lang.
“There are some weapons, yes, but with so many targets, we can’t manage them all. If we catch one, what about the rest? Won’t they just surround us here?”
Now was the most difficult time to make a choice, and Lin Yi’s mind couldn’t conjure up any good ideas.
He just looked around frantically, and at that moment, it seemed as though he suddenly thought of something.
“What do you think about the steps we’re on? If we find it uncomfortable to stand here, what about them?”
“Them? I think they’re quite enjoying it. Don’t let their tough skin fool you. Stepping on these might feel like a massage to them.”
“So that means they should be adapted to this environment. In that case, maybe we should head that way instead?”
As he spoke, he pointed to his right.
“That direction? But didn’t you notice? That way seems even darker.”
“The darker the place, the safer it might be for us. Let’s all head there, and for now, don’t run. Everyone, try to move as slowly as possible.”
They all couldn’t understand what Lin Yi was thinking at that moment, but seeing his secretive demeanor, they figured he must have an idea.
Since there was no better plan at this point, why not just follow his lead? Maybe it would yield an unexpected outcome.
The group started to walk backwards step by step.
He noticed that even though they were retreating, those creatures were still not letting them go, although their advance seemed a bit faster than before.
“How far do we have to go to get past this?”
“It should be about there, about one kilometer by estimation now.”
“One kilometer, okay, we’ll hang on for this one kilometer. Otherwise, none of us will make it out alive.”
“Brother, what exactly are you planning? And besides, all this walking back and forth seems pointless. Won’t they just eliminate us here anyway?”
“I feel that their skin has blended in with this environment. Clearly, this area must belong to them. If we leave this area, I don’t think they’ll harm us.”
“No way, just by leaving like this, they won’t harm us? Brother, aren’t you oversimplifying things?”
Hei Lang, for one, couldn’t understand. It all seemed as surreal as if none of this had ever happened.
“No, no, no; perhaps the reality is more straightforward than we think. That’s why I believe this action might just be our best bet. Didn’t you see? Even as we’re retreating, they don’t seem bothered and haven’t hastened their pace. They’re probably just forcing us to leave step by step.”
“If that’s the case, and if it is that simple, then let’s pick up the pace a bit. Besides, we’re about to leave this area.”
With that said, everyone gradually quickened their pace. And sure enough, even as they hurried, those on the other side seemed to be slowing down even more.
As a result, the distance between them started to grow, and it seemed to be getting larger and larger.
Eventually, he felt that the ground underfoot had become much flatter. Lin Yi looked down and realized he was now on a grassy field.
Looking further ahead, he was stunned to find that those creatures had turned around and were heading in a different direction.
After seeing all this, Lin Yi finally let out a long sigh of relief.
“Oh my god, that’s a relief. They didn’t catch up after all.”
“It seems, brother, your guess was right. They just wanted to force us out of their territory.”
“But why didn’t they come to this area?”
“Not sure, maybe they find it uncomfortable to step here, which could be why they didn’t follow.”
“No, I have this feeling there’s another reason they don’t come here.”
“Another reason? What could that be?”
“I can’t quite put my finger on it, but it’s a strange feeling that I’ve never experienced before.”
“Brother, aren’t you overthinking it?”
“No, I’m not overthinking.”
While talking, Lin Yi shook his head and lifted his eyes to look around.
It was now night, and the environment had grown very dark.
However, the darkness was not so great that you couldn’t see your hand in front of you. At least here, there was no need for torches to roughly see the surroundings.
“It seems that this place is not entirely flat, and looking over there, do you see? There seems to be a mountain.”
In the darkness, their vision was not very good. But following the direction he pointed, they could vaguely see a dark mass that seemed rather tall.

chapters.title: Chapter 492: 492: The Fake Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 492: Chapter 492: The Fake Mountain
“Oh, I see it now, there really is a mountain. So if that’s the case, at this deepest level, there’s still another mountain. Then what could be inside this mountain?”
“I don’t know, but somehow, I always feel that somewhere inside that mountain is exactly where we need to go.”
“You mean to say we ultimately need to enter that mountain? But we are already on Xi Lian Mountain.”
“Think of it as a mountain within a mountain. I reckon if we go from here, by the looks of it, it shouldn’t be too far. Let’s move forward and explore.”
It seemed that Lin Yi’s courage had indeed grown considerably at that moment, and he followed the others forward.
But this time, it was Lin Yi who took the lead, with the hunter following closely behind, as if struggling to keep up with the pace.
...
I really didn’t understand what was up with this guy.
The hunter murmured to himself, puzzled. Previously, he had been the one leading the way, but now it seemed like Lin Yi had suddenly become excited.
“Let’s not go any further.”
Suddenly, he heard the hunter shout from behind, and Lin Yi turned around curiously to look at him.
“What’s wrong? Hasn’t the path been smooth all along? Are you saying we should keep waiting instead of going now?”
“Just look up ahead, and you’ll understand.”
With that, the hunter pointed in that direction.
The hunter had always been looking down, cautious of the terrain beneath them, and had never looked up ahead.
But now, he realized that the mountain seemed to have suddenly become distant.
“What in the world is going on?”
Thinking he had seen incorrectly, he rubbed his eyes.
When he opened his eyes and looked carefully again, there was no mistake, the mountain seemed further away, and even his vision was starting to blur.
“What exactly is happening?”
“I’m not sure, but what you saw just now probably wasn’t a mountain at all, but rather an illusion formed by mountain mist. That’s why, the more we walk towards it, the further it seems because the mist is constantly spreading.”
“Are you saying that’s not a mountain? But look at its undulating shape, isn’t that a mountain? It basically looks just like the mountains we’ve seen before.”
“Even if it looks the same, what we’ve seen should also be an illusion, and if we keep going this way, who knows how far we’ll need to go? I can sense that we’re headed in the wrong direction.”
The hunter had actually felt something amiss as soon as he had indicated that direction.
However, he hadn’t figured out precisely what the problem was, so he let himself continue to be led forward.
Upon realizing this, he just shook his head frantically because he felt that everything was indeed different from what he had imagined.
“Big brother, are you saying I went the wrong way?”
“The further you go this way, the greater the distance feels. Normally speaking, we should have reached the deep edge by now, and we shouldn’t have to go too far inside to see it. But don’t you see? You’re actually turning in another direction now.”
“That means I’m completely off course.”
“Right, from what I can tell, that’s indeed the case, so we absolutely can’t continue forward. If we do, I’m afraid we won’t achieve anything.”
“So you’re suggesting I haven’t changed direction yet?”
“Yes, you need to change direction, and we have to continue along the way we were going just now.”
“But, it feels like you simply can’t go through if you head forward.”
“That’s how it is in the mountains; the easier a path feels, the closer it may lead you to danger’s edge. If a road feels tough to traverse, that place might actually be safer.”
“Big brother, what kind of nonsense is that? It sounds confounding.”
“Don’t talk, look straight ahead.”
At that moment, the hunter suddenly lowered his voice and then pointed straight ahead.
They turned around slowly to look and saw something black in front of them, with two objects resembling small lanterns swinging back and forth.
Without a doubt, seeing such things in this environment meant they were likely facing some kind of ferocious beast or monster.
“Damn, that one seems to be quite big.”
“Exactly, that’s why I think it’s impossible to proceed here. We need to retreat slowly. No, it’s too late.”
The initial idea was for everyone to back out step by step, just like they had dealt with the previous prey. But then they noticed the large creatures suddenly began to move quickly.
Ultimately, two legs are no match for four, and before they could react, Lin Yi felt something graze his hand.
He quickly looked down and saw that it seemed his palm was scratched by its claws.
In the end, that creature just stood to the side and continued observing them.
“Big brother, are you alright?”
It appeared that Lin Yi was the only one injured in the group.
Because Lin Yi had been at the forefront, he was the first to encounter this adversary.
“Damn it, that beast scratched me.”
“Big brother, are you okay?”
“This isn’t the time to worry about that. This creature seems aggressive. Quick, prepare all weapons.”
With that, they all hurriedly took out their weapons.
In the end, the hunter reacted the fastest. He aimed at the prey and then pulled the trigger.
A loud bang ensued, but to their shock, the creature in front of them didn’t move at all.
“Big brother, what’s going on?”
“It’s not even scared of guns, and clearly, I hit it. But now it doesn’t budge.”
“I have no clue. Could it be invulnerable to blades and bullets? No good, I have to take another shot just to be sure.”
The hunter seemed incredulous and fired the trigger again, but the result he got was the same as before.

chapters.title: Chapter 493: 493: Vanished into Thin Air?
chapters.content:
Chapter 493: Chapter 493: Vanished into Thin Air?
“Crap, this thing seems to be completely useless against that guy.”
“It’s fine, let me give it a try.”
After saying that, Hei Lang took out his own item and shot it straight towards its position.
But he found that, just as they had thought before, the outcome did not match their expectations.
Because he saw that the creature remained motionless, and then they heard a loud roar.
The roar sounded like that of a tiger—could they have really encountered a tiger here?
...
“Damn, it’s not a tiger, is it?”
“No matter what it is, right now, none of our stuff can kill it. Quick, let’s head back, I think I saw a rock over there. Let’s hide behind it for the time being.”
As he spoke, the hunter quickly made his way to the spot, and they could sense that the creature was chasing them once again.
He heard Hei Lang, who was at the rear, suddenly shout, clearly having been attacked by it.
“Hei Lang, how are you doing?”
No one dared to stop; they just turned their heads to see that Hei Lang was now slowing down even as he walked.
“Boss, don’t worry about me, it’s nothing. That beast scratched me, but it’s just a flesh wound, I assure you.”
Although he said this to reassure Lin Yi, he had already experienced all this himself. While it was indeed painful when he was first scratched, overall, it was something a man could endure.
Now, he too knew that even if these men were hurt, they had no choice but to keep moving, because any further delay would likely increase the threat and danger to them.
In the end, he made his way to the rock and finally, they all hid behind the large stone.
After hiding, they looked back and it seemed that the creature had not followed them.
The group started to breathe heavily, and at that moment, Lin Yi took the opportunity to look down.
He discovered that the wound seemed to have stopped bleeding.
If that was the case, then probably the creature hadn’t applied too much force when it scratched him, merely grazing the surface. So, while it felt terrifying at the time, it now seemed perhaps not as frightening.
“How are you?”
He turned back and then asked Hei Lang, who was standing beside him.
“Ah, didn’t I tell you? You need to squat down. Standing up like that makes you an easy target.”
“Oh, okay, I got it.”
Hei Lang just nodded, but as he squatted down, he felt excruciating pain.
“Hei Lang, what’s wrong, where did you get hurt earlier?”
“Haha, boss, I’m embarrassed to say, it attacked my behind, so when I squat, it’s really painful, I can’t take it.”
“Hei Lang, how about this, I’ll help you check it out. If it’s bad, we have some anti-inflammatory and hemostatic medicine here. Applying some should solve the problem.”
Ling’er said to Hei Lang, but he wagged his head like a rattle-drum.
That area was a person’s private part, how could he take it off and reveal it in front of a girl.
“Ling’er, don’t worry about it now. Later, when we find a safe place, I’ll take care of the rest. Don’t be fooled by Hei Lang’s rough exterior, he’s actually quite shy.”
“Big brother, stop it.”
“Alright, alright, I’ll stop. Old brother, how is he, where is he now?”
“I’ve been watching the whole time, but I can’t find him anywhere, and I have no idea where he’s gone.”
“That’s not right, normally, when we ran here, he should have followed.”
“Yes, normally that would be the case, but…”
As the hunter was speaking, he seemed to sense something was off and suddenly turned to look behind him.
And that moment truly made his blood run cold.
Because he saw that the creature was right behind him, eyeing him menacingly.
“Run!”
The hunter shouted loudly, then grabbed his belongings from the ground and started to sprint away.
The hunter was quick to react, but that swiftness drew the creature’s attention.
It quickly circled around the three of them and ran in the direction where the hunter had vanished.
“Crap, we’re really in trouble this time. Quick, we have to catch up or else the odds might be deadly for us.”
Lin Yi became increasingly anxious, and setting aside everything else, they sprinted in that direction.
But he realized that the creature disappeared from his sight very quickly, which meant that its running speed must have been extremely fast.
After running a distance, he stood panting heavily and surveyed the surroundings, only to find nothing there.
“This is strange; where have they gone?”
He murmured to himself while Hei Lang and Ling’er caught up.
“Big brother, where are the people? The hunter, where did he go?”
“I’m not sure. How could they disappear so quickly? Normally, he can’t outrun it.”
“Big brother, this, could there be an accident?”
“An accident? What accident?”
“Couldn’t it have taken him away because it caught him, and that’s why it left this place, so we can’t see anything here?”
After hearing this, Lin Yi just frowned, feeling that this reasoning indeed made some sense. And if that were the case, then it might be very difficult for the hunter to return.
Although he knew entering the mountain was highly risky, given the current situation, he did not want to take any more risks, because he was aware that too much adventuring could ultimately cost them their lives.

chapters.title: Chapter 494: 494: Discovery of Collapse
chapters.content:
Chapter 494: Chapter 494: Discovery of Collapse
And this time, if the hunter had truly met with an accident, then it was likely he wouldn’t be able to explain himself for venturing out today, and for the rest of his life, he would feel restless inside.
