“We need to hurry and find him, where on earth could he have been taken? Moreover, only by finding him do we stand a chance of rescuing him in time.”
“But the key issue is, we don’t even know where he went, so where should we start looking for him?”
“Impossible, absolutely impossible. Even if he was taken away, could there really have been no movement at all? I didn’t hear the slightest sound, not even a loud shout.”
Right, Lin Yi was also pondering this point.
If he had indeed been taken away, then he should have struggled, he should have called out, but of these things, Lin Yi and the others heard nothing at all.
...
“Let’s keep moving slowly forward and see what the situation is exactly.”
He only knew they had disappeared in this direction, but where exactly had they gone? That, nobody knew.
“Big brother, look over here quickly.”
All of a sudden, it seemed as if Hei Lang had discovered something, so he excitedly shouted over that way.
Eventually, he hurried over and saw Hei Lang standing by a collapsed area.
He saw that a dark gaping hole had appeared in this place, and the hole’s entrance was not small in size.
“What is this, isn’t this a trap?”
“Impossible, this place has been deserted year round, haven’t the hunters mentioned this before? How could there be a human-set trap here? This can’t be a trap.”
“If it’s not a trap, then what on earth is down there? They couldn’t have fallen in, could they?”
“If you put it that way, it seems like it’s indeed a possibility.”
While speaking, Hei Lang stood curiously at the edge, then tried his best to discern what was below.
But it was pitch black, impossible to see anything at all.
“Big brother, how about we turn on a flashlight and look inside?”
“Don’t rush, let me see what the situation is first.”
As he spoke, he bent down and looked inside; it was so dark, one couldn’t see one’s hands in front of one’s face, nothing to observe.
“Older brother, older brother, can you hear me speaking?”
He just shouted loudly down below.
He could even hear his own voice.
But no response was heard at all.
“Older brother, can you hear me?”
Lin Yi, up to now, still refused to give up. He felt that this person must have fallen in here, and if that was the case, he only needed to search this area, believing that he should be able to find him.
“Big brother, given the depth down here, if one truly fell, it would indeed be very difficult.”
Actually, Hei Lang had already thought of this, but he hadn’t fully expressed it.
He just felt that saying so might make everyone unable to accept the reality, after all, the hunter was very important to them.
“Even if there’s a sliver of hope, I must rescue him.”
Anyway, Lin Yi was determined, considering that the person had come for his sake, and now, if his life was lost here, he would feel like the loss was too great.
“Big brother, such a deep place, if you really want to go down, I’m afraid it’s impossible, and besides, the situation down there is an unknown.”
“No matter the situation, we must try to figure something out, we can’t just give up because we are unaware, can we?”
“Big brother, I don’t want to give up either, but look, let me test its depth first.”
Having said that, Hei Lang gritted his teeth and then pulled out a very long rope from his bag.
Then, he attached something resembling a camera to the other end of the rope.
“What is that?”
“You could think of it as a camera, and as it goes down, I’ve marked off how many meters on the surface, and when it reaches the bottom and can’t move, it can also emit a signal. Then, from this terminal up here, I can receive its signal.”
In the midst of speaking, Hei Lang took out another device from the other side, holding it in his hands, and now the screen was pitch black.
“Is your method reliable? And won’t it waste time? Right now, every second that ticks by is extremely dangerous for him.”
“Big brother, I know you’re anxious, but if he were to encounter danger, he would have likely met it by now, so we can’t risk moving ahead blindly. We just don’t know what the situation is down there.”
Though Lin Yi was anxious, Hei Lang somehow became more rational.
He knew that under these circumstances, one couldn’t just rashly enter this place.
In this pitch-dark environment, and moreover, just how deep down it went was unknown.
Helplessly, Lin Yi could only shake his head and then patiently waited for Hei Lang’s final survey data.
Hei Lang picked up the rope and started quickly feeding it downward.
After sending it down a certain distance, Hei Lang stopped.
“How is it?”
“Big brother, it’s reached the bottom. Observing the data here, it should be around 13 meters.”
“What? 13 meters?”
At this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but stare in shock.
Knowing that 13 meters is about the height of 4 or 5 floors.
If one fell from there, it’s feared that even if not fatal, one would end up disabled.
No wonder he shouted for so long here and received no response at all.
“Then, quickly check what’s down there. Can your device see clearly?”
“Big brother, I’m currently adjusting its angle. I believe if there are no special circumstances, we should be able to see clearly, ah, take a look here.”
Just then, he saw patterns emerging on the screen and after flashing a few times, the signal suddenly cut off.
“What’s the matter, why did it suddenly cut off?”
“I’m not sure either, I’ve never encountered this before, big brother, don’t worry and let me adjust it again.”

chapters.title: Chapter 495: 495: There Was a Reaction Down There
chapters.content:
Chapter 495: Chapter 495: There Was a Reaction Down There
While speaking, Hei Lang began to operate on the screen, but no matter what he did, he still couldn’t receive any signal.
Seeing that there was no activity on Hei Lang’s end, Lin Yi really started to get anxious.
“Stop messing with it, is it possible that your device simply doesn’t work?”
“Big brother, if you said my other stuff didn’t work, I might admit it, but this, I paid a high price for. It can’t be useless. Before, I even used it to go down a deep well, and there were no problems at all.”
“Then why can’t it receive any signal here now?”
“I don’t know. I keep feeling that the signal is being interrupted, which proves that something down there is blocking the signal. Therefore, the signal can’t be transmitted up here, and as a result, I can’t see the real-time video from below.”
...
“Something down there? What could it be?”
“This, I’m not sure about. Normally, these geological structures wouldn’t block signals unless there’s a magnetic field down there that could shield them.”
“Magnetic field? Are you saying there’s a magnetic field down there?”
“I can’t be sure, and I don’t know much about this area, but I can definitely feel that the signal has been blocked.”
“It’s a height of over ten meters, wait a minute.”
He hadn’t finished speaking when suddenly, as if he heard something, Lin Yi quickly bent his whole body down, then leaned over the edge of the pit.
“Little brother, is that you?”
He heard it clearly; there was a faint voice coming from below, and it seemed to be that of the hunter.
“Big brother, it’s me. How are you doing right now?”
“The environment down here is very dark, I can hardly see anything, but I think I might be injured and can’t move for now.”
“Big brother, what about that thing?”
“I don’t know. When I fell down, I passed out for a moment. When I woke up, it seemed to have disappeared.”
“What? Disappeared? Did it fall down with you?”
“It should have.”
“Big brother, don’t panic. I’ve just lowered a rope down. I don’t know if you’re able to see it.”
“No good, it’s too dark down here, I can’t see. But I seem to see some light to the front right of my body. What is that thing? Don’t rush me, let me take a good look.”
“Big brother, stop looking for now, find the rope. We’ll pull you up first.”
“No, right after I came down, I smelled something odd here.”
“What? The smell is off? Could there be something down there?”
“I can’t tell exactly what it is, but it seems like the scent of herbs, yes, that’s it, a strong medicinal smell. Right, I see it now; there’s a large patch of weird-looking plants right in front of me.”
Hearing this, Ling’er suddenly got excited.
“You, you’re not mistaken, right? And it really smells like herbs down there?”
“Yes, it’s truly a strong medicinal herb scent, and there’s a lot of it, a big patch right in front of me.”
“Great, I think we might have really come to the right place.”
“Are you saying that all the rare herbs we were searching for are all underground?”
“Yes, very likely.”
“But that shouldn’t be the case. Normally these herbs need sunlight for growth. How can they grow in such dark conditions underground?”
“There’s no way to explain that, but I can tell you that some plants prefer shade to sunlight. The cat’s claw herb I helped you find before can’t be found at all under the sunlight.”
“So, are you saying we must go down there?”
“Exactly, we must go down there.”
“Okay then, if that’s the case, Hei Lang, get ready.”
“Big brother, we still don’t know what the situation is down there. Didn’t you hear what he said? He said that the prey fell down with him, which means that thing is also down there.”
“Hei Lang, what are we here at Xi Lian Mountain for?”
“Of course, it’s to look for those valuable medicinal herbs, isn’t it?”
“Right, didn’t you hear what he said? Now, we’ve found those things down below.”
“But big brother, he’s a layman, and are we really going to go down there just based on his few words, in such dark conditions? Don’t you think that’s too reckless?”
“I don’t think there’s anything reckless about it. If he can smell that scent, I believe there must be something down there.”
“Because he smelled that scent, we all have to take the risk? Otherwise, let’s do this: you two don’t go down yet, I’ll go down by myself to confirm what’s down there, then we can decide.”
“You? You go down, what can you figure out? If we place a plant here, can you tell if it’s a medicinal herb or just ordinary grass? Can you tell the difference?”
“This…”
When Hei Lang heard this, he indeed felt hesitant.
Right, he was just an outsider and knew absolutely nothing about these things.
“So, we came here with this goal in mind. Now that we’ve discovered the target, there’s nothing more to say.”
“Alright then, big brother, if you’re set on this, then there’s no problem. But I have one condition.”
“Good, tell me.”
“Since we’ve confirmed that the hunter shouldn’t be in any danger, even if he’s hurt, it’s probably not too severe. So, I’ll go down first.”
“You go down first, what do you want to do?”
“I’ll go down to ensure there’s no danger. Afterwards, you and Miss Ling’er can go down. Otherwise, I won’t allow it.”
“Hei Lang, what do you mean? Can’t you understand what I’m saying now?”
“Big brother, it doesn’t matter what you want to say, but my only goal is to ensure your safety. So I have to go down and confirm that it’s safe before I’ll allow you go down.”

chapters.title: Chapter 496: 496 Not in the Same Space
chapters.content:
Chapter 496: Chapter 496 Not in the Same Space
“Nonsense, aren’t you putting yourself in a deadly situation with such talk?”
“I don’t mind, my life was given to me by you, big brother. So what does it matter whether I live or die? Therefore, you must agree to this.”
“Hei Lang.”
“I think Hei Lang makes a valid point. For weaklings like us, even if we go down, we won’t be able to resolve any danger we encounter. On the other hand, Hei Lang can handle it, so you should just let him do it.”
Ling’er walked over and then whispered something in his ear.
How could Lin Yi not understand Hei Lang’s good intentions? He just felt sorry for such a brother. If he truly lost his life over this matter, Lin Yi would find it unbearable.
...
Since Ling’er had already spoken, and under this choice, he seemed to have no option but to trust Hei Lang.
“Then remember, you must be very careful and bring more equipment with you when you go down.”
“Don’t worry, big brother, I know what to do. Besides, I haven’t lived enough yet, I don’t want to be buried so soon.”
“Hei Lang, stop talking nonsense. Rest assured, there will definitely be no problems.”
“Yes, yes, I know, big brother, don’t worry about it.”
As he spoke, Hei Lang began to set up his surroundings.
After securing the rope in one place, he then tied the other end around his waist.
After that, he descended carefully along the rope.
As soon as he went down, he only felt as if he was stepping into a puddle of mud.
Then, he turned on his flashlight.
Sure enough, he now realized that he had indeed fallen into a mud pit.
However, fortunately, this area of the mud pit didn’t pose any great danger.
At the very least, standing on it, he should not sink down.
“How’s it going? Are you down?”
He heard Lin Yi’s voice coming through.
“Big brother, I’ve come down already, I’m in a patch of mud.”
“What? A patch of mud? Then, then you have to be careful, it’s not the Swamp, is it?”
Lin Yi was somewhat worried.
After all, the incident with the Swamp last time was still fresh in everyone’s memory.
“Relax, I’ve stepped on it, the bottom is solid. Big brother, big brother, where are you?”
He shone his flashlight, scanning the area, but he couldn’t find any trace of the hunter.
“I’m right over here, do you see me?”
The voice came through quite clearly.
Following the voice, he searched carefully again.
“Big brother, I can’t see you, all around me is mud, and also, where is that smell you were talking about?”
This was the real reason Hei Lang had gone down.
He wanted to determine if the scent the hunter mentioned really existed.
Right after descending, he hadn’t smelled it, only a musty scent in the air.
“I’m right here.”
“Where? I can’t see you. Can you see me? I have a light on, my flashlight’s on.”
“Flashlight? No, I don’t see any flashlight.”
“What? My flashlight is very bright, you can’t see it?”
Hei Lang really felt it was too strange.
The flashlight was already very bright.
Normally, after he fell down, he should be nearby, definitely not too far away.
Unless someone deliberately moved him.
But that’s not right either, even if they took him away, then the voice still sounds so clear.
He should be right beside me.
“This is really strange, can’t you see me either?”
“That’s right, I can’t see you.”
“But, I hear your voice as if it’s very close to me.”
“Yes, so I find it odd too.”
“What’s the situation down there?”
Lin Yi heard their vague conversation, but he didn’t hear it very clearly.
“Big brother, I’ve come down, but I’ve looked around and haven’t found any trace of him.”
“What did you say? No trace found, that’s not right, didn’t we hear that he was down below?”
“That’s why it’s such a strange thing, including the flowers and grasses he mentioned, including those scents, I didn’t smell anything at all.”
“Hei Lang, did you not search carefully enough?”
“Big brother, I’ve already inspected the surroundings, and there’s nothing but mud, it seems like it’s just a mud pit.”
After hearing all this, Lin Yi just frowned.
It’s obvious that the direction is completely wrong.
But, if it’s wrong, then where is the voice coming from?
“Hei Lang, untie the rope, I must go down, it won’t do, otherwise we won’t be able to find him.”
“Big brother, how about this, I’ll go check around first.”
“What else are you going to look at, didn’t you say the whole surroundings are a mud pit now?”
“Alright, big brother, be careful.”
Anyway, within the two minutes that Hei Lang came down, he didn’t perceive any danger.
Then, they untied the rope again.
He saw the rope being quickly pulled up.
“Ling’er, you stay up there for now, later, after pulling up the rope, tie it around your waist and then come down.”
“Okay, I got it.”
After saying that, Lin Yi nodded, and then followed the same steps Hei Lang had taken to re-enter the cave.
“Big brother, I’m here.”
Thankfully, Hei Lang saw him at first glance and then helped him stand in the mud pit.
He untied the rope from his body and looked in the direction of the light.
Just like what Hei Lang had described, all around was a mud pit, pitch-black with nothing visible at all.
“Older brother, where are you?”
“I’m listening, go ahead.”
“Right now, I’m in a mud pit, is there a mud pit around you?”
“Mud pit? There’s no mud pit here, this place is somewhat damp, but there’s no mud pit.”
“Older brother, we might not be in the same space.”
“What, not the same space? How can that be?”
“Don’t panic for now, besides those, can you find any other markers?”
“No use, I can’t see anything here, and moreover, I think my leg is hurt, walking is a bit difficult, just wait a moment, I’ll try to walk around and see.”

chapters.title: Chapter 497: 497: Long-Distance Conversation
chapters.content:
Chapter 497: Chapter 497: Long-Distance Conversation
“Brother, don’t move yet,”
Lin Yi heard him. The man said his leg was injured, and indeed, trying to stand up could be very dangerous for him.
“Alright then,”
He heard the hunter’s voice clearly once again.
In fact, just moving a little was a big challenge for the hunter.
If he wasn’t mistaken, his own thigh likely suffered a fracture or some other kind of injury.
...
But in this darkness, he couldn’t determine that.
“Big brother, what should we do now?”
“Don’t rush, let me take a good look,”
As he spoke, he crouched down, then put his hand into the mud trap.
And the depth just covered his wrist.
After pulling his hand out of the mire, he inspected it closely, noting it was covered in black mud that must have been accumulating there for a long time.
Even, it smelled somewhat foul.
He pressed firmly and then stood up, stomping his feet twice, but found the ground beneath was very solid.
“Brother, speak to me again,”
He once again spoke into the void.
“Okay, did you hear what I said?”
The voice, as usual, was still crystal clear.
It was as if this person was right in front of him, but he couldn’t see anything before his eyes.
Could this be some kind of spatial voice transmission?
Yet, when he thought about it, that couldn’t be right. If they were truly in different spaces, normally, the voices wouldn’t carry over.
“What’s the situation?”
Just then, he felt Ling’er arriving beside him, and he turned his head to glance at her.
Ling’er untied the rope from her body, then turned to look around.
“Why is everything a mud trap here? And didn’t he say there was a scent of medicinal herbs? But why can’t I smell it?”
“Yes, I felt the same when I first came down.”
“How about now, can you find me?”
The hunter’s voice came over once again, Weiwei helplessly shook his head; so far, he hadn’t found anything.
It seemed that what he needed to do next was to keep searching the surrounding area to see if he could discover anything else.
“Brother, I still haven’t spotted any trace of you, but don’t worry, I reckon there must be another entrance. You must have fallen in through that spot,”
“Oh, okay, I understand. Just be careful, all of you.”
“Who are you talking to?”
Ling’er suddenly turned around and asked Lin Yi.
“I was talking to that hunter. What’s up, didn’t you hear him?”
“What? What hunter? I just saw you here talking to thin air. Hei Lang, did you hear it?”
Upon hearing Ling’er’s words, Hei Lang just silently gazed at him.
Then, he just gently nodded his head.
“You’re not going to tell me that you only heard big brother’s voice and didn’t hear the hunter’s voice at all?”
“I really didn’t hear it. I only heard his voice, not a second person’s. Are you guys joking with me?”
For some reason, when Ling’er said that, she suddenly felt a chill running down her spine.
Could it be that she was actually seeing a ghost?
Both men could hear it, but she couldn’t hear anything at all.
If nobody could hear it, then maybe her ears were the problem, but how could she hear one voice and not the other?
“Ling’er, are you sure you didn’t hear anything?”
Lin Yi didn’t think Ling’er was joking with him.
And under these circumstances, who would be in the mood for jokes?
Ling’er didn’t answer; she just shook her head slightly.
“Brother, can you hear me speaking now?”
“Oh, I can hear you, brother, go ahead.”
“Did you hear Ling’er speaking just now?”
“What? Ling’er was speaking? You mean that girl? Did she come down too?”
“What do you mean? You didn’t hear her voice?”
“No, wasn’t that just you speaking with the brother? There wasn’t another person’s voice, was there?”
“Ling’er, speak again.”
“Hey, Hunter Big Brother, can you hear me? Can you hear me speaking? I’ve come down.”
Ling’er continued speaking there.
“Brother, did you hear that?”
“No, I didn’t hear anything. What am I supposed to hear if you just called me?”
“Big brother, this is bizarre, what’s happening?”
Hei Lang and Lin Yi were the clearest about everything that had occurred so far.
But all of this seemed inexplicable.
“I’m not sure either. Right now, they can’t hear each other’s conversations, but they can hear ours. What does that tell us?”
“Big brother, isn’t this like seeing a ghost? Moreover, we can clearly hear both of them, but they can’t hear each other. What does this mean?”
“Don’t worry, let me think, my mind is a mess. So much has happened all at once, I really can’t figure it out.”
Lin Yi said this as he closed his eyes slightly and began pacing back and forth in the mud.
Ling’er was utterly confused and didn’t know what had happened. Coming here, she suddenly felt as if her ears weren’t as reliable as before.
She knew Lin Yi was thinking, but as he did, Ling’er’s ears were constantly alert for any slight sound around them.
She could hear what seemed like the sound of dripping water in the distance that appeared and disappeared intermittently.
“Hei Lang, did you hear that? It seems like there’s the sound of water dripping.”
“Yes, I heard it too when I came down. But if you’re still for a bit, you might not hear it as clearly. You can hear that sound now, but you can’t hear his clear conversation?”

chapters.title: Chapter 498: 498 Magnetic Field Interference
chapters.content:
Chapter 498: Chapter 498 Magnetic Field Interference
“I really can’t hear it.”
“That’s really strange. Let’s see what big brother has to say about it later. Don’t panic. If something like this can happen, there must be a reason for it. And maybe this reason can be clearly explained, or maybe it can’t be clearly explained.”
Hei Lang didn’t understand at all what was happening, so he kept saying these ambiguous things.
“Now, I think I understand what’s going on.”
Lin Yi suddenly stopped, then looked up at the two of them and said meaningfully.
“Big brother, what do you mean? Did you think of something?”
...
“Now, I just thought of a reason. And this is the only reason that can really explain it. That is to say, the pattern of sound waves when she speaks is not on the same frequency as when a man speaks. Moreover, this frequency cannot propagate in this space, so the hunter’s words can’t be heard by Ling’er.”
“I still don’t quite understand.”
“That is to say, the frequency at which women speak to men is different, and there is a strict distinction between them in their daily lives. It means that, right now, only the original sound can propagate in this space, but a woman’s voice might be a few pitches too high, so the sound can’t break through.”
“Oh, I think I understand what you mean. Are you saying that because the channels are different, so they don’t align? Is that how I should understand it?”
“Yes, you can understand it that way.”
“But if it’s explained that way, it can explain why Ling’er can’t hear what the hunter is saying, but why can’t Ling’er hear what the hunter is saying either?”
“That might be because his voice line is impaired during transmission, and perhaps the pitches are distributed too low, maybe not reaching the limit value needed, and that’s why this phenomenon occurs.”
“What exactly is obstructing all of this? Now I get it, no wonder my device stopped working as soon as it got here; this proves that there must be a strong magnetic field underneath us interfering with the transmission of these sound waves. Isn’t that what you mean?”
“If you explain it this way, then it basically can, but looking around, everything seems to be mire. So, where exactly is the emission point for this sound wave?”
“Where it is doesn’t matter that much anymore. The key issue is how did he manage to enter another space? If we really want to find him, we must locate this place.”
Ling’er added this.
Although what Lin Yi had just said gave her an ambiguous feeling, she always felt that having some explanation was much better than having none at all.
“He fell straight down from above, and normally, he should be right at our position, but he’s not here, which proves that there is another fact; it’s very possible that he is in a space beneath us.”
“A space below?”
“Yes, the space below. The space above can be seen at a glance, so it’s impossible for anything to be hidden there. Therefore, there must be another space below.”
“Then, if there really is another layer of space, how should we go down? And how did he manage to go down so smoothly? Don’t forget, when he came down, he was completely unconscious.”
“Yes, this is something that I find very hard to understand. Could it be related to the disappearing beast?”
“The disappearing beast?”
“Yes, since coming here, it has completely vanished. And since his descent, what has he been doing all this time? It seems as though no one knows.”
“Are you saying that it took him to another space, and the space he is in now should be the same one that the beast occupies? Is that how I should understand it?”
“Yes, that should be the case.”
After reaching this point, it seemed as if all the mysteries suddenly unraveled, and everyone gradually relaxed.
Although they now understood what was going on, the critical question was how they should follow this clue to search further. This was the most important point.
“I think if he could pass through here, then there must be an entrance. So where is the entrance? We could look into that.”
While talking, Lin Yi started searching around.
He took out a powerful flashlight and illuminated the entire surrounding area of the cave.
He found a spot where there was a noticeable indentation.
Furthermore, the stones all around were protruding, except for this indented spot, which proved that there must be some mechanism or secret passage there.
He quickly approached the spot, and although Ling’er and Hei Lang did not understand what was happening, they knew from his fast actions that he must have found some clues.
As he got closer, he realized that this stone really was indented.
This was clearly out of place with the surrounding environment, so Lin Yi attempted to reach his hand behind it.
He found that it was indeed very deep inside.
Even when he reached in, he realized that the space had no end he could reach.
“Come, give me the flashlight.”
He looked back and gestured to Hei Lang, who promptly handed over the flashlight.
Finally, he turned on the flashlight and shone it directly inside.
But the inside was completely dark and appeared to be an infinitely extending space downwards. Unfortunately, he could see nothing.
However, the width of this space was limited, and his head couldn’t be fully extended into it, or else Lin Yi would certainly have wanted to find out more.
“Brother, brother.”
Just then, he heard the hunter’s voice coming through again.
“Big bro, go ahead, I’m listening.”
While responding to him, he carefully observed the inside to see if there was anything that would allow him to break through.
“Did you shine the flashlight inside?”
At this point, Lin Yi suddenly paused.

chapters.title: Chapter 499: 499 The Real Entrance
chapters.content:
Chapter 499: Chapter 499 The Real Entrance
It was quite clear that it was the light he had just shone in that allowed him to see.
“Big bro, what about now?”
Lin Yi immediately turned off the flashlight.
“Now, now it’s gone?”
“What about now?”
He spoke as he turned on the flashlight once again.
...
“Oh, I can see it again now, it’s right above my head.”
“Okay, big bro, I think I’ve got a rough idea of the place now. Don’t rush it, let me look around and think about how to break through. I’ve confirmed there’s definitely a space extending downward here.”
“Alright, alright, no need to hurry; I’m safe for now, and I haven’t detected anything around here.”
“Okay, got it.”
After speaking, Lin Yi nodded and then turned to look at Ling’er and Hei Lang standing behind him.
“Big brother, you really guessed it right. There is indeed a space below, but how on earth did he get in through such a small entrance?”
“How he got in, I don’t know, but now we can be sure that he must be on the layer below, and the noise just now must have been transmitted through this spot.”
“If the sound was transmitted from here, it wouldn’t be so clear, and Ling’er should have been able to hear it too. Ling’er, come try listening again.”
Ling’er was skeptical about the events that had unfolded today and felt they were somewhat inexplicable.
He simply leaned close to the spot, pressed his ear hard against the edge of the opening.
“Big bro, could you say something for a sec?”
“Alright, I’m speaking now, can you hear me?”
Ling’er suddenly turned around, visibly excited.
“That’s it, I heard it! Really clearly, but it seemed like it was coming from a great distance.”
“That’s right. It looks like some kind of magnetic field was blocking the sound waves before, and now that we’re up here, we’re facing the waves directly. That’s why we can see everything clearly. Oh, and now that there’s no magnetic interference, can we use that device?”
Lin Yi suddenly turned around, then looked at Hei Lang with excitement.
Hei Lang nodded, having overlooked this detail until now.
“If that’s the case, then I have to give it a try and see if I can break through to the lower level with this setup.”
He then took out the device again, hooked it with a piece of rope, and slowly fed it in.
After pushing it a certain distance, he felt a sudden emptiness, suggesting that there must be a space below.
Hei Lang operated the machine simply a few times, and soon a clear image appeared.
Beneath him, there was indeed a vast cave, where he saw a deep layer filled with all kinds of flowers and vegetation.
“Look quick, isn’t this, isn’t this what we’re searching for?”
Ling’er couldn’t hide her excitement upon glimpsing the scene.
Never had she imagined these things appearing so vividly before her eyes.
And what did it all imply? Frankly, to imagine the reality was daunting at this stage.
“Good, it seems our speculation was correct, this place does hold these things. Now, look further down to see if you can spot the hunter’s location clearly.”
In the end, Hei Lang adjusted the angle, and they realized there was indeed someone lying in the center, apparently injured on one leg.
“Do you see him?”
“I see him; it’s definitely him.”
“Sigh, now head over there. It’s time to use this machine to observe the entire cave closer and see if there are any dangers.”
As they spoke, the camera angle was adjusted once more, but as Hei Lang turned back to it, everyone’s eyes widened in shock.
They clearly saw several of those creatures sprawled in one corner.
The very monsters that had been chasing them before had been hiding in this spot.
He quietly counted; there appeared to be four of them.
Their bodies were huge, and compared to the size of a tiger, they seemed to be twice as large,
At that moment, they were all lying down, clearly enjoying the peaceful afternoon.
They seemed to be sleeping soundly.
“Are they asleep?”
“Yes, they are indeed asleep, and so our deduction is completely accurate. They must be hiding in this cave.”
“But big brother, don’t you find it strange? If this place is their lair, from where did they enter? Moreover, the collapse was sudden. If it hadn’t collapsed this time around, where would their true entrance be?”
“Their real entrance definitely isn’t here, but maybe they’re familiar with the environment and entered their lair from below after the collapse.”
“That suggests there might be another exit on that side.”
“Search the cave thoroughly once more, if it’s as you say, we might be able to locate a general direction.”
“Okay, big brother, don’t worry; let me adjust the angle again. It looks like this cave isn’t very big.”
While saying this, Hei Lang began to operate the equipment once again.
Everyone kept a close watch on the screen, peering intensely when the camera settled at a certain angle, waiting for and then scrutinizing any reactions within the cave.
“Hey, look there.”
Just then, they saw behind those plants what seemed like an opening.
And judging by the shape, it could perfectly allow the entry and exit of one of those creatures.
“That’s it, right there.”

chapters.title: Chapter 500: 500 Why Not Hurt Him?
chapters.content:
Chapter 500: Chapter 500 Why Not Hurt Him?
“If that’s the position, then it should correspond to an area to our rear-right.”
“Right, if we shine a light from this position, maybe we’ll find the entrance.”
“Then what are we waiting for, big brother, let’s hurry over there.”
“Can this thing be connected wirelessly?”
“Yes, it can be connected wirelessly.”
“Then now, fix the camera in this position, and hold the controller in your hand while we search together. When the time comes, see if we can observe the situation below. Once we confirm it’s safe, we’ll go down from here.”
...
“Okay, I understand, big brother.”
After speaking, he nodded, performing some simple operations, and then the group went straight towards the rear-right direction.
The group was always stepping in the mire, and it felt like there was no place to stand on except for this expanse of mire.
Luckily, the mire wasn’t very deep, so there was almost no resistance when they moved.
After walking a distance, they were surprised to find that there actually was a downward passage here.
Because it was quite dark at the time and they were walking against the light, they wouldn’t have found this entrance if they hadn’t circled around the cave completely.
“Look, it should be right here.”
“Yes, it’s here. Now observe the situation over there.”
As he spoke, he turned on the camera and began to scrutinize the feed.
The creatures were still in deep slumber.
“Big brother, it’s okay, they’re still sleeping.”
“Good, if they’re asleep, we should be safe for now. But I just thought of something.”
“Big brother, what did you think of?”
“I was thinking, why he was taken from here and, after being taken, wasn’t harmed but rather left to one side. Afterwards, they simply went to sleep here. What does all this suggest?”
“It suggests that they might not be interested in humans, but are unsure whether we’re suitable as their food or not?”
“Not necessarily. Maybe they had already eaten their fill before, so they just left us here for when they get hungry again, or they might be doing something else.”
“So, we absolutely can’t let them wake up. If they do, could it be very dangerous?”
“Yes, it should be like that. Moreover, we have been talking quite loudly just now, but we haven’t disturbed them at all. This proves that their auditory system isn’t very developed or they are in a deep sleep.”
All of this was Lin Yi’s speculation; after all, he hadn’t experienced anything like this before, so it was all conjecture.
“Big brother, I think trying to guess back and forth here is meaningless. Let’s hurry down, because only by rescuing him and collecting those plants can we be sure if anything useful is found. Ling’er, take the time to quickly pick what you can. We can’t come back here; it’s too dangerous.”
Hei Lang’s judgment was sound, and facing just one prey in front of him was already something he couldn’t handle, let alone four of them—it was unimaginably difficult.
Lin Yi didn’t say anything but simply nodded, and then they all started heading downward.
Going down, they felt as if they were spiraling down, as if they were continuously rounding bends.
Finally, they appeared behind those plants.
Lin Yi looked back.
Now, he was truly fascinated by these things, and then he turned to look at Ling’er.
Ling’er couldn’t suppress the joy in her heart and hurriedly went over, squatting down to start examining plant by plant closely.
“Ling’er, how long do you think you need?”
“I estimate at least half an hour, if not I can’t be completely sure, so I must examine carefully.”
“Ling’er, I’ve had a look and it seems the varieties aren’t too many. Go through them one by one, and I believe you should be able to find what you’re looking for.”
“Okay, I know what to do.”
“Then stay here for now. Remember, you’re absolutely not allowed to leave without our permission. We’ll try to rescue the hunter first and then plan the next steps.”
“Alright, I got it. You guys go ahead.”
Ling’er was already squatting there, then began to take out paper, pen, and a magnifying glass, diligently cross-referencing everything.
Lin Yi and Hei Lang signaled each other, and then they quickly stood up and walked inside.
“Bro, is that you?”
Having reached this point, they had already turned off their flashlights, fearing that the bright light would disturb those creatures.
“Yes, it’s me. Don’t move now and don’t make any noise. We’ve pinpointed your approximate location, and we’re heading towards you, so absolutely do not move or speak. Those creatures are not far from you, about 20 meters ahead.”
Upon hearing all this, the hunter was momentarily stunned.
He’d been here at least 20 minutes already. Why hadn’t he heard a thing from those creatures? It turned out they’d been close by all this time.
So, now he dared not speak anymore.
Through the remote control of the camera, they could clearly see the details within the cave.
It was indeed this high-tech equipment that gave them the feeling of temporary safety.
“Big brother, quick, crouch down.”
He suddenly heard Hei Lang whispering in his ear and, with a gesture, they both hurriedly crouched down on the ground.
Then, the screen was placed in front of Lin Yi.
He saw one of the creatures stirring, as if about to awaken. It moved its body and was just about to lower its head again.

chapters.title: Chapter 501 - 501 The Camera is Turned On
chapters.content:
Chapter 501: Chapter 501 The Camera is Turned On
Suddenly, he stood up from the ground and then, he looked over in this direction.
At that moment, Lin Yi was truly terrified. He had no idea what he should do. If this creature really discovered them, their escape would be extremely dangerous.
He didn’t even dare to breathe heavily, just trying his best to keep his body low.
Fortunately, right in front of him was a large rock, which under normal circumstances, should have kept him hidden.
Unless, their sense of smell was exceptionally keen, and they could detect the scent of an intruder, in which case, things would really become troublesome.
The two of them were just waiting patiently here.
...
They saw the prey stand up, then pace back and forth in the area.
At that time, his heart felt as though it had climbed to his throat; he was really worried it would suddenly come towards them.
Thankfully, after pacing around twice, the creature didn’t seem to notice anything amiss and settled back down.
Since it was a high-angle camera and in such an environment, the footage wasn’t very clear; they could only tell he was there, but whether his eyes were closed remained unclear.
Just now, as that monster walked back and forth, Lin Yi realized it was a strange, indescribable creature.
Its neck was long, somewhat like a giraffe’s, but not quite as lengthy.
The creature’s face was triangular, similar to that of a horse, yet the chin area formed an inverted triangle.
Its limbs were clearly very strong, and it didn’t have fingers, just smooth, bare palms placed on the ground.
Its entire body displayed a bright patterned appearance, and the fur seemed very sleek and shiny.
At the back of its body, there was a short, thick tail.
The tail was roughly the length of a palm, so such a small tail seemed somewhat disproportionate to the rest of its body.
“Are they asleep?”
He murmured quietly into Hei Lang’s ear.
Hei Lang couldn’t confirm their status either. He was just trying to adjust the camera’s focus, hoping to see what state they were truly in.
But no matter how he adjusted it, he seemed unable to get a clear view, considering the distance had its limitations.
“No use, I’ve tried my best. Can’t make out their actual situation.”
“It’s fine, even seeing this much is pretty good.”
“Big brother, what do we do next?”
“For now, we can’t move. Moreover, if he’s trying to sleep, it likely requires a process, so let’s wait a bit more patiently, big bro, big bro.”
He called out softly in his location.
Because the hunter was now so close, almost within arm’s reach.
“I’m listening. Have you arrived? And I see a faint light over there, is it behind the rock?”
“That’s right, big bro, I’m right here. Just wait patiently a bit longer; I’ll pull you over in a moment, then we’ll figure things out.”
As he spoke, he glanced at Hei Lang. Hei Lang volunteered to go, and then handed the screen to Lin Yi.
“Big brother, you watch this. If you see any danger, notify me immediately. I’m going to crawl over there bent over at the waist, then drag him back.”
“Alright, be careful.”
Hei Lang nodded, then laid his entire body flat on the ground.
He moved slowly across the ground, inching forward in a prone position.
Lin Yi just held the screen in his hands but could feel his palms starting to sweat.
He couldn’t quite describe the feeling, except that his heart was incredibly tense.
The enormous creature opposite them was truly unexpected; if it reacted, he feared they would all die right there.
This was precisely the outcome Lin Yi least wanted to see.
A sense of fear was ever-present within him.
Lin Yi had only one thought: to get what he needed as quickly as possible and then leave this damned place.
Luckily, as he made his way, he saw that the four creatures seemed to remain completely still throughout.
Gradually, Hei Lang began to approach the hunter.
“Big bro, big bro.”
He kept his voice down, and hearing the sound, the hunter quickly looked back.
He could see Hei Lang reappearing before him. Actually, at that moment, the hunter also felt a rush of joy and relief.
In the past twenty minutes, he hadn’t felt much fear.
It seemed to him he was simply in a dark space, and there was no immediate danger.
But knowing that these four prey items were less than fifty meters away brought his anxiety to a peak.
However, it was a relief to see his rescuer, which meant he could probably get out safely.
“I’m here.”
“I see you. Keep your body as low as possible, and I’ll drag you forward. That way, we won’t be easily spotted.”
“Okay, got it.”
Dragging him forward might be uncomfortable, but under the circumstances, there were no better options.
Walking upright on both legs was simply impossible.
He felt as though one of his legs had completely ceased to function.
Initially, there was severe pain, but now even that sensation had faded away.
He leaned back, reached out his hands to grasp both arms of the hunter, and pulled tightly enough to lift his body slightly off the ground.
Doing so reduced the friction of his back against the ground.
With his other leg intact, he began walking forward step by step, using it to assist.
The short distance of a dozen meters felt like an eternity to the hunter.

chapters.title: Chapter 502: Send the Hunter Up First
chapters.content:
Chapter 502: Chapter 502: Send the Hunter Up First
Finally, Hei Lang successfully dragged him to the back of the stone.
At this time, Lin Yi had already walked over. He put the screen on the ground again, intending to check the hunter’s injuries.
However, he found that no matter what he did, this time he could not concentrate, and even the Heavenly Eye did not truly open this time.
He just knitted his brows in suspicion. This was obviously a return to the awkward situation they had faced in the beginning.
It was really incomprehensible—was the system being lazy, or did it sometimes refuse to release everything to him?
Anyway, there was an indescribable feeling.
...
He looked down and saw that there indeed seemed to be bloodstains around the area of his groin, but what the condition of the bone inside was like, he dared not imagine.
“Brother, was this where you landed?”
“Yes, it should be here, and it should have been a side landing. Otherwise, there wouldn’t be injuries in other places, only here.”
Lin Yi truly could not imagine.
It must have been a fall from a height of more than ten meters, and the whole body had come down sideways, with all the weight concentrated on the groin area.
He knew that every bone in the human body had its limit of endurance.
Once that limit was reached, no one could change what happened.
“Brother, don’t worry; the light and conditions here aren’t very good. After we get out, I’ll examine your wound properly. Rest assured, with me and Ling’er here, we will definitely be able to leave safely.”
“Good, I absolutely trust you both. So, can we go now?”
“Yes, if there’s no problem on Ling’er’s end, we can go. That’s right, maintain your position from before and drag him in the direction of the cave entrance.”
“Okay, I got it, big brother. You go ahead, and I’ll follow slowly from behind. Just keep an eye on our surroundings.”
“Don’t worry, I know what to do.”
He nodded, then glanced at the time. It had been nearly 13 minutes since they had entered the cave.
Ling’er would need about half an hour more, so if they proceeded now, they would probably have to wait a bit longer.
He walked slowly ahead, occasionally stopping to look back at Hei Lang and the hunter following behind.
Finally, Hei Lang managed to drag the hunter to the entrance of the cave.
Turning to look back, he saw Ling’er still amidst the myriad of flowers, studying the various plants carefully.
If Ling’er couldn’t finish now, then there wasn’t much point in so many people staying here.
On the other hand, time was on their side since the four prey had not fully woken up yet—they might still be able to escape from this place.
“Hei Lang, follow the cave entrance up, and then do your best to get him up there. The rope is still here, right? You go up first and then pull the hunter up.”
“Big brother, what about you?”
“I will wait for Ling’er. Once she’s finished, we’ll immediately go and meet up with you. For now, take care of him and get him up.”
“Big brother, this…this doesn’t seem quite right? Moreover, leaving just the two of you here, what if something happens? Won’t you two be in danger then?”
“Rest assured, there shouldn’t be any major issues. Besides, Ling’er is about to finish up. If you’re worried, leave me some tools. If it comes to it, after you’ve settled the older brother, come back down and meet with us. Wouldn’t that work?”
“Or else, we could just all go together.”
Hei Lang was still somewhat worried.
After all, in his eyes, Lin Yi was completely defenseless and would be unable to protect himself if any danger arose.
“Don’t you see what’s happening? With Ling’er in this state, if real danger comes, we’ll hardly manage to protect ourselves, let alone her. So, while it’s safe, take the opportunity to get out. Only then can we truly ensure our safety, understand?”
After Lin Yi said this, Hei Lang thought it over carefully and realized that it really was the case.
“All right then, big brother. I know what to do now. I’ll hurry and get him up there.”
While speaking, he hoisted the entire body of the hunter onto his back and then walked towards the exit.
At this point, seeing that the two had safely left, Lin Yi finally breathed a sigh of relief.
He went over to Ling’er and then squatted down completely.
Then, Lin Yi took out the screen to take a look. Those four guys were still sleeping soundly, which clearly indicated that they had not been disturbed.
“Ling’er, how are things on your end?”
“I’m still looking. You’d be surprised, there are indeed quite a few precious herbs here.”
“Ling’er, don’t just look; if you really need them, gather them quickly. We’re going to leave here soon, and this place is somewhat dangerous. I can’t wait here forever.”
“I know, I am fully assessing the situation before selecting the more valuable items to take with us. So, please be patient.”
In Lin Yi’s view, everything should be taken up to understand its true value.
And even if identification was needed, it could be done after reaching the surface, removing the necessity to linger here too long.
But after all, he wasn’t the harvester, and the real harvester was Ling’er, so naturally, she had her own approach to it.
Lin Yi nodded, refraining from further comment, and sat down on the ground, his eyes never leaving the screen.
He watched as those few continued to sleep deeply, shifting their heads now and then to adjust their position.
The more they did so, the safer Lin Yi felt it must be.
Everyone said how dangerous it was in here, but from Lin Yi’s perspective, what danger was there, really?

chapters.title: Chapter 503 - 503 Picking Failure
chapters.content:
Chapter 503: Chapter 503 Picking Failure
It’s just that those people weren’t so lucky, but now they have these high-tech toys, and they themselves are rather fortunate. So, under these circumstances, it seems nothing can stop them.
Although he also felt very anxious inside, at this moment he dared not rush Ling’er.
After all, it was indeed impolite to urge her while she was earnestly identifying the medicine, and he also feared delaying Ling’er’s progress.
He just waited patiently here, and his eyes never left the screen.
Finally, he seemed to hear some noise coming from Ling’er’s side.
“Ling’er, how is it going?”
...
“It’s done, I’ve now identified the ones we can take, there should be about 8 types of herbs.”
“Only 8 types of herbs? That few? Moreover, there seemed to be quite a lot of herbs today.”
Lin Yi really couldn’t understand, and indeed, with so many herbs, why would Ling’er only choose to take 8 types?
“Because the others are all deadly poisons, so they cannot serve the purpose of healing wounds or saving lives for us. Although they are also very, very rare poisons, I think that taking them away will, after all, harm society and humanity. So, we simply abandoned the thought.”
“Are you saying that there are some poisons here besides the normal herbs?”
“That’s correct, each one complements the others, and having grown together over the years, they seem to have coexisted peacefully, which should be due to their restraining the spread of toxicity,”
“Then if that’s the case, wouldn’t taking away these poisonous herbs also have some other uses?”
“There’s not much meaning to it. I’ve carefully assessed just now, and basically, those poisons pose a deadly risk to the human body, so we don’t have the chance to heal wounds or save lives.”
“Then, with only 8 types, how much help will they be to us?”
“With these 8 herbs, I can prepare various other medicines, and, extending from that, it’s probably not just as simple as that amount.”
“Alright then, if you can take more, try to take as much as possible, and I feel that place, you can only enter once. If we enter a second time, I’m afraid, it won’t be so simple.”
“Don’t worry, I know what to do.”
After speaking, Ling’er bent down.
She located one particular herb, and, with herbs like these, they must be uprooted completely to be effective.
Just taking the top or the middle part wouldn’t be of much use, so thinking of this, she bent over and prepared to uproot it.
Ling’er pulled hard, finding, perhaps her strength wasn’t enough, and it felt like the root was deeply embedded.
“What’s wrong, Ling’er, do you need help?”
Lin Yi, standing by her side, seemed to notice that she was facing some difficulty, but was unclear where this difficulty stemmed from at this moment.
“This herb seems to grow in a very deep spot, and no matter how hard I pull, I just can’t uproot it completely, unlike the other things I’ve picked before which were quite different.”
“As you’ve said before, these are all very, very rare, so I guess they grow deeply. Well, I still have some tools with me, let’s start by digging around the soil, and then uproot it.”
“Soil? This isn’t soil, it’s grown on a very hard rock.”
“What did you say? On a rock?”
Lin Yi had never heard of such things growing on rocks.
In the past, he only knew some things could entirely grow out of rock crevices, which was already not easy for them.
But now, that it could grow on a rock face, seemed truly unimaginable.
“Yes, indeed, about this matter, allow me to explain it to you slowly afterward, I anyway understand the principle.”
“Then let me come over, and the two of us can try together, this way, we should be able to help each other out.”
“Come over here.”
As they spoke, Lin Yi placed the screen aside, and then entered the midst of the flowers.
He saw that the last one he was pulling up was about thirty to forty centimeters tall.
At its top was a spherical fruit and there were no flower buds. What he wanted was likely inside the fruit.
“Can’t we just take this fruit and leave?”
“What I want now is the whole plant, and I want to try and see if it can be regrown in a specific environment, which would provide us with a continuous supply in the future.”
“Oh, you want to do that, well in that case, it looks like we must uproot it entirely so that we can transplant it successfully once we’re back, I understand now, I’ll count to 3, then we’ll pull together.”
As he spoke, Lin Yi placed his hands over Ling’er’s, and then said, “1, 2, 3.”
Finally, they both pulled with all their might, and it had to be said that combined, their strength was considerable.
Together, they uprooted the plant in one go, and just as they did, suddenly the cave shook.
Could his strength truly be that great? Could a single plant trigger the shaking of an entire cave?
As Lin Yi wondered about this, he turned his head and suddenly heard some unusual cries not far away.
Damn, did they wake up?
Thinking this, Lin Yi hurried over and picked up the screen from the ground, taking a quick look, sure enough, now the four preys had all risen from the ground and were heading their way.
“Run, Ling’er, they’re coming!”
He shouted loudly, but as they rushed toward the exit, suddenly, a massive stone fell from above, completely isolating the two of them there.

chapters.title: Chapter 504: The Safest Place Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 504: Chapter 504: The Safest Place Here
“What, what’s going on? Why has the Daoist Sect’s door closed?”
“I’m not sure either. Did we activate some kind of mechanism? Could it be that we triggered something when we were pulling up these herbs?”
“What do we do now?”
Seeing the situation, Ling’er panicked all of a sudden, then she quickly turned her head to look behind. She noticed that their four prey had already stationed themselves predatorily behind them.
They were almost without escape and could only hide behind this stone door, curling their bodies as much as possible.
Of course, Lin Yi, acting on instinct, shielded Ling’er tightly behind him, not daring to let her show any part of herself.
...
After all, he had already been injured once before and knew that the creatures’ claws were very powerful. If they attacked, he would have virtually no chance to escape.
“Big brother, what’s happening? Why, why is it blocked?”
And at this time, Hei Lang had also rushed over from the other side, but when he arrived, he found his way blocked by a stone door.
“I don’t know. When we pulled out a herb, suddenly, the door closed, and now, all of them, they have all come to.”
“What did you say? All, all of them have woken up? Big brother, what, what do we do now?”
At that moment, he truly panicked, and in this state of panic, he simply did not know how to rescue his big brother.
“You need to calm down now. Remember, you told me before that you carried some smoke grenades, right?”
“Yes, I did bring some.”
“Listen to me, act fast and throw a smoke grenade from the position where we set up the camera earlier. This could temporarily disrupt their vision.”
“Big brother, it’s not just about disrupting them. Now, isn’t it disrupting you too?”
“We have no choice. If it disrupts, so be it. The most important thing is to save our lives. Quick, you must act fast.”
Hei Lang scrambled to run from there, but the scene within was not as simple as they had imagined.
Now, he was cornered, and that thing could easily attack him if it approached.
He quickly surveyed his body, turned his back to them, and then clutched Ling’er tightly in his arms.
Ling’er only felt something graze her back, followed by a piercing pain.
“Are you okay?”
Of course, Ling’er saw everything clearly; she was facing the creatures and saw one of them stretch out its huge paw and fiercely swipe at him.
“It’s okay, for now, I can still hang on.”
“Quick, let’s find a place to hide over there.”
Without further discussion, Ling’er pulled him towards that direction but during their run, he felt another claw strike the right rear side of his body.
By now, Lin Yi was beginning to understand.
The creatures were truly terrifying, but the horror lay in their use of their paws to attract his attention, rather than devouring or biting him outright.
If that was the case, was this really good news for Lin Yi?
In their panic, they hid directly among the flowers and grasses.
Their purpose was simple: to hide in the foliage, hoping to avoid the creatures for the time being.
Soon, the prey turned around, and approached them, but upon reaching the edge of the flower patch, they suddenly stopped in their tracks.
Lin Yi saw it quite clearly; they retreated a few steps backward, without mistake.
“What’s happening?”
He turned back and asked Ling’er, curious.
Ling’er just shook her head blankly, not understanding the situation that was unfolding.
“It seems like they’re fearful of this place, and now that we have entered, they don’t seem to know what to do.”
“Yes, that must be it, but we can’t go on like this. If we can’t open the door, we’ll also die trapped here.”
Just then, a white mist began to drift into the cave.
And the mist started to grow thicker.
Lin Yi knew that the smoke grenade was taking effect.
Once the smoke completely enveloped the area, they could hardly see anything at all.
Even if someone stood in front of them, it was not certain they would be seen clearly.
Lin Yi’s hand never let go of Ling’er because once released, it would be impossible to find her again.
“What should we do now?”
“Don’t worry, the smoke grenade’s effect should last about three minutes, so we must use these brief minutes to hide in a safe place. Only in this way can we prevent them from attacking us again.”
“Safe? I think the safest place is right here, isn’t it? And don’t you see? They’re frightened of this place; we should be fine if we stay here.”
“Are you saying we should still hide here?”
“Yes, we stay hidden here, and we must figure out how the stone door’s mechanism was triggered. I suspect it has something to do with these herbs.”
“Then this time, we’re really in trouble.”
This time, Lin Yi faced a choice like never before.
Although he came for these precious medicinal herbs, now he found himself in such a state. It seemed that he might not be allowed to take them with him after all.
“The main issue is, the herbs have already been plucked. How are we supposed to return them? It’s an impossible task.”
Ling’er said with concern.
In fact, Lin Yi felt the same. He also knew that they were truly in a predicament.

chapters.title: Chapter 505: There's Actually a Secret Room
chapters.content:
Chapter 505: Chapter 505: There’s Actually a Secret Room
Three minutes is a very short time, and in the blink of an eye, that layer of white fog had disappeared once again.
He looked up and glanced in that direction. He noticed that the prey was still standing there, as if they had no intention of leaving at all.
“Did you see? They are planning to trap us here, and if this goes on for too long, we will be unable to leave at all.”
“We must find a way to leave here quickly, but the key question is, how should we go about it?”
“Now, luring them away is not impossible. The main issue is that even if you do lure them away, we still have no way to leave, so this is a critical problem.”
“What should we do then? After the stone door falls, they can’t get out either. Could it be that they have a second exit?”
...
“A second exit? It’s unlikely, but I know there must be a way to open the stone door.”
That’s what Lin Yi was thinking. He believed that if the door could come down, it wouldn’t be possible for them to trap everything inside without a way out.
They must have their own method of opening it. Nature is indeed so miraculous.
But it was obvious that this mechanism had been set up by someone a long time ago. Normally, nature wouldn’t leave such traps.
“At this point, we have no better options. Don’t rush me, let me think a bit longer.”
Anyway, staying in this environment was relatively safe for the time being. At least in the short term, they wouldn’t launch any attack on him.
“Big brother, how’s it looking? Are we safe now?”
Lin Yi heard a voice floating down from above, it must be Hei Lang waiting for news.
“Don’t throw any more smoke grenades in here, it’s meaningless. We’ve found a safe place amidst these bushes, they don’t dare get close to this grass.”
“Big brother, it’s no solution to keep at a standoff like this. We must find a way to get out soon.”
“I know, I’m trying to figure out a way. If the mechanism can be activated to come down, then there must be a way to open it. I’m still figuring it out, so don’t worry, I’m quite safe for the moment.”
As he spoke, the activities above ceased, and Ling’er then examined the injured area on Lin Yi’s back.
His entire back was injured, with some blood seeping through the surface.
However, she was not very sure how serious the injuries were.
“Should I apply some medicine for you first?”
“There’s no need for that now. In this situation, applying medicine is not the priority. Finding a way to get out of here is the hard truth.”
Ling’er nodded and said no more.
She began to regret a little, was it because she had pulled out that herb that such serious consequences ensued?
“Ah, take a look.”
Suddenly, Ling’er seemed to have noticed something and pushed Lin Yi to tell him about it.
In truth, there was no need for Ling’er to mention it, for Lin Yi had already noticed it; he saw one of the predators lowering its head and slowly nibbling on the herbs on the ground.
After a few bites, it stepped back, and then the second predator took its place.
This went on in a cycle.
After all four of them had eaten, they lay down as if continuing their vigil.
“They’re actually eating this stuff. Could it be these are their food—herbivorous animals?”
“No wonder we couldn’t lure them with anything, and after capturing the hunter, they didn’t take any action. Could it be we guessed right, they are some kind of herbivores?”
“They’re not just simple herbivores; they seem to specialize in eating these medicinal herbs. No wonder they look so peculiar, having been steeped in these herbs for years.”
“But if that’s the case, dealing with them might really be troublesome.”
“If we take all of this away, they would lose their means of survival. So to them, these are like deities, there’s no way for them to break through.”
“Right, so that means…”
Lin Yi stopped there because he seemed to have felt a protruding spot on the ground.
He wondered, could this be the switch for the mechanism?
He pressed hard, but there was no response.
“What is it, did you find something?”
“Over here, I found a rock sticking out, I’m not sure if it’s a switch for a mechanism. No worries, if it won’t press down, I’ll try sliding it to the side and see what happens.”
Eventually, using his method, he pushed the stone hard.
In the process of pushing, he used a lot of force, and finally, he was surprised to find a stone door behind him slowly opening.
Lin Yi turned around in astonishment. Inside, it was pitch-black, and nothing was visible.
The two just looked at each other.
The door was behind the bushes, and it was clear that only they could enter it easily now.
“What is this place?”
“I don’t know. We’ve encountered another mechanism. Clearly, it wasn’t just the four of them living here, there must have been other humans. It’s just unclear what they were up to.”
“Maybe all the secrets lie beyond this door.”
“Exactly, that must be the case.”
“Hei Lang, Hei Lang, can you hear me?”
He looked up and shouted loudly into the air.
“Big brother, I’m on watch here, what’s the situation over there?”
“Oh, I’ve found a secret chamber. I’m going into the chamber with Ling’er now. Once inside, we’ll see if there is any other way to resolve this. So, you wait patiently above, take good care of the hunter, got it?”
“Big brother, this… I’m really not at ease with this.”

chapters.title: Chapter 506: Stone Coffin
chapters.content:
Chapter 506: Chapter 506: Stone Coffin
“If you’re still not reassured, there’s no other way. Besides, you can’t even come in. Go and keep watch over the hunter. You two can’t have any more accidents. Once I break free from here, I’ll contact you quickly. That’s all.”
“Big brother, big brother.”
Hei Lang continued to shout here, but Lin Yi didn’t listen to him anymore and Ling’er walked directly into the secret room.
Just after the two of them stepped in, the door quickly shut behind them.
The moment it closed, they were once again plunged into darkness.
Lin Yi just turned his head to look and saw that the door had locked him in here.
...
He didn’t know whether rushing in here so rashly was right or wrong.
Suddenly, Ling’er laughed softly.
And the helplessness in that laughter was certainly discernible.
“No, what’s wrong?”
In the pitch black, Lin Yi turned and then asked.
“I just feel it’s really quite absurd. We’ve forced ourselves into this abyss time and again. Now, we don’t even have a way out. We’re completely locked in this room.”
“That’s not necessarily true, and sometimes in despair, hope can still be seen. Don’t worry, I remember I took some lighting tools.”
While saying this, Lin Yi reached into his bag and fumbled around.
Sure enough, he actually found a flashlight.
This was given to him by Hei Lang when he first arrived, but for such a long time, there was never a chance to use it—his own flashlight was unused.
Then, he turned the switch on, but the light was clearly quite faint.
“What’s going on with this? Wasn’t the flashlight very bright just now?”
“Damn it, the battery Hei Lang gave me seems to not have been fully charged, and I’ve been using his all along.”
“Well, let’s just make do with what we have.”
While talking, Ling’er comforted him.
In the end, Lin Yi took the dim flashlight and shone it around the room.
To his surprise, he found candlesticks all over the walls and large candles on top of each.
He suddenly grew excited.
If there were no flashlight, he still had some lighters on him, and with these, he could completely light up the room.
“Ling’er, wait here. There are candles all around. If we light them, we will be able to see the whole room clearly.”
As he spoke, he nodded lightly, and then quickly went forward to light the candles on the candlesticks with his lighter.
All things became clearly visible in front of them.
He saw at a glance that they were in a perfectly square room.
In the very center of the room lay a rectangular block of stone.
He didn’t understand what it was, and it oddly resembled a coffin.
“Could this be a stone coffin?”
“What do you think this is?”
“I’ve been thinking about that too, and I feel like it’s most likely a coffin.”
“If it’s a coffin, then who could the owner be?”
He walked over gently and examined the large stone carefully from all sides.
Only then did he notice some very strange characters carved on it.
However, these characters and symbols were unrecognizable to them.
He took a closer look and saw a crack in the middle of the stone, clearly indicating that two stones were pressed together.
He pushed hard, but it didn’t budge.
“Don’t move it anymore, it’s very likely the master of this tomb is inside.”
He looked up and pointed in that direction, discovering there was also a stone table in front, next to which stood a stone Taishi Chair.
The carving was quite clear, and even with today’s technology, the craftsmanship might not be able to achieve such an effect.
He approached the stone table, which seemed to serve as a memorial tablet. He examined it closely, but the text was still not clear to see.
It appeared that after many years of erosion, the characters had started to deform.
“This should be a memorial tablet, and the name of the owner must be on it, but it seems too weathered to read clearly now.”
“Exactly, that’s the idea.”
“Who exactly lived here for so long? And those flowers and plants outside, could they truly have been planted by him?”
“That’s a possibility too. Hey, what’s that?”
As he spoke, he suddenly looked down and noticed there was another layer beneath the stone table.
Inside was a square iron box, corroded all over, probably stored for many years without any historical verification.
Lin Yi bent down and took the box out straightforwardly.
He found the box wasn’t locked and such a box was not seen in modern society.
“This box must be very old,” he surmised.
“You’re right, I remember seeing something like this in a book. It must be an ancient container used to store medicinal herbs, and it’s probably over a thousand years old,” she stated.
“Are you sure? How would they store herbs in it?”
“Absolutely, I’m a hundred percent certain. I’ve seen records of it in an old book.”
“If that’s the case, this thing is probably not as simple as we thought. This place must have existed for thousands of years, which history has yet to verify.”
“Verifying that is useless. If there really were medicinal herbs stored here, after thousands of years of change, they would probably have lost all significance.”
He looked around, and there were no traps anywhere to be seen.

chapters.title: Chapter 507: 507 An Ancient Book
chapters.content:
Chapter 507: Chapter 507 An Ancient Book
He actually placed it on top of the stone table, and then, gently opened the cover.
Unexpectedly, after a thousand years, he discovered that the lid could still be used, and, moreover, it didn’t take too much effort to open.
It’s just that some rust spots directly fell off from it.
He clearly saw that a book was placed on top, and looking at the book’s appearance, it had completely yellowed, the paper must have become very brittle by now.
“Don’t touch it yet.”
Lin Yi was just about to stretch out his hand to take the object, but upon hearing Ling’er’s reminder, he quickly withdrew his hand.
...
“Ah, did you think of something? Or is there something you need to explain under these circumstances?”
“What’s the matter? Is there a problem?”
“Right now, you can’t just touch it with your hands, and after so many years of oxidation, the paper has become very brittle. A slight mishap could very likely cause the paper to crumble.”
“Oh, then do you have a way?”
“Don’t worry, I brought professional tools.”
Ling’er was quite professional. The tools she carried were originally for picking medicinal herbs because sometimes these herbs are truly precious and even a slight mishap could potentially destroy them.
She took out a pair of specially made gloves, which were completely snow-white, with only two raised areas at the base seemingly apparent.
Lin Yi naturally didn’t know what these were used for, but since they were brought here, they must have a special purpose.
He put the gloves on his hands, then gently took the object out of the box.
The process was like handling a rare treasure, being extremely careful and not containing a single flaw.
Lin Yi did not dare to make a move throughout the entire process, having little understanding of these items himself. If he were to cause the book to be ruined due to reckless behavior, he would indeed regret it later on.
Finally, after placing it on the table, he let out a long sigh of relief.
At last, he had taken it out, believing that the information recorded within must contain some crucial clues.
Ling’er’s movements were careful, using her special methods, she then directly turned to the first page.
Soon, some text became visible, which was completely different from the characters carved into the stone sarcophagus.
Though some characters were hard to discern, she could generally make out their meaning.
“This is a record about this cave.”
“What? Can you understand what it says?”
To Lin Yi, these all looked like special symbols, and he had no way to identify them clearly.
“I can make out some of it because I’ve encountered some ancient manuscripts that came from the Outer Regions before, so I’m somewhat familiar with the text, which luckily matches this one.”
“Then what about the text on the sarcophagus and on that placard? Didn’t you say you couldn’t recognize it before?”
“Those are entirely different scripts; I’ve never seen them before. But the font used in this book was prevalent during that period, and when recording medicinal herbs, they primarily used this script, so I can distinguish it.”
“Alright then, what does it say?”
“It says that they discovered a special environment in this cave previously, describing it as extremely damp, suggesting that these conditions are suitable for cultivating some medicinal herbs.”
“So, he used this place as a sort of backyard garden, specializing in cultivating these materials.”
“Don’t rush me; let me try to grasp the contents of this book. There isn’t much, so I’ll carefully read through it once more and then tell you what it means.”
“Alright alright, no hurry, take your time. After all, we’re trapped here, but for now, this environment is very safe. Maybe you’ll find some clues in these ancient tomes that could help us get out of here. I’ll patiently wait here while you continue looking around.”
With that, Ling’er just nodded and then sat down on the stone chair, starting to read carefully.
When he first took it out, Lin Yi had already noticed that the book wasn’t very thick—approximately twenty pages or so.
If she reads it word by word, it will certainly take some time; after all, it’s not modern writing, so Ling’er couldn’t readily discern it.
Taking advantage of this, Lin Yi began to approach the stone sarcophagus to carefully inspect it.
He felt that these ancients were truly full of wisdom, and he wondered how they entered here and how the lid was sealed again afterwards?
Presumably, some people came after to tend to these tasks?
In the past, he had never encountered such a place, and it was so mysterious that ordinary people had never come here.
After walking around the area for a while, Lin Yi found nothing in the end, so he headed towards the wall.
He realised that the entire room must have been specially decorated, with special symbols and patterns added to the stone walls.
He looked closely, feeling that the paintings on it were not baseless, and that the depicted subjects must all be special.
Finally, after studying it for a while, he understood that it was a drawing of a medicinal herb, illustrating the entire growth process from planting to full growth.
Although he couldn’t understand the text, he could clearly discern these drawings.
After so many years of sedimentation, he found that the paintings were still incredibly clear.
Yet, it didn’t seem like they were etched with anything, but rather painted with some special pigments.

chapters.title: Chapter 508: 508 The Mural on the Wall
chapters.content:
Chapter 508: Chapter 508 The Mural on the Wall
He touched it with his hand and realized that there was no sign of fading at all.
In some places, the colors were still very distinct.
He couldn’t understand what kind of substance the person had used that allowed these to exist here for thousands of years without any change.
Sometimes, indeed, the wisdom of the ancients is hard for people to comprehend.
Finally, he shifted his position and only then did he notice that the entire walls around him were covered with these symbols and texts.
Essentially, after every interval, there seemed to be a detailed record; he estimated that there were about 13 murals in total.
...
Each mural likely represented a different kind of plant, but he didn’t know much about them.
Lin Yi took out his phone and clearly photographed each image one by one onto his phone.
He did not know what future use they might have, but he felt it would be a waste to leave them here.
Moreover, it was incredibly difficult to get here, having come in risking their lives.
At this moment, he had to photograph all these important things.
If he himself couldn’t take them, then he had to make sure to save all this information.
Perhaps later, they would prove to be very useful.
At the end, Lin Yi went to the center and photographed the stone coffin and the strange symbols on it onto his phone.
After turning around, there seemed to be no other valuable things in the room.
He let out a long sigh, and then searched carefully inside to make sure he had not missed anything.
When he had been walking in circles, Lin Yi had noticed that aside from this stone door, there weren’t any other mechanisms set up.
That is to say, this was the only door through which they could leave; to get out, they had to open this door.
Now, since he couldn’t find the location of the mechanism, all hopes rested on that ancient book.
He believed that the person who left this book definitely had a purpose, including the external situations and how to escape this place, which should all be written within it.
He came over, then sat on the steps, waiting silently.
He didn’t know how much time had passed, but Lin Yi’s mind never stopped working, constantly thinking about what to do.
Of course, he was worried.
Just then, his phone suddenly rang; although there was no signal in this environment, they were using a special form of communication which should allow contact even within this place.
He glanced at the screen; it should be Hei Lang calling, probably worried after seeing that he had been inside for so long without a sign.
“Hey, boss, how’s it going? I’ve been yelling for a while now, but I didn’t hear any response from you, are you alright?”
Turns out, the stone door sealed so well that he hadn’t heard any sounds coming from outside while in the room, even though it was very quiet.
“I’m now inside the secret chamber; I can’t hear each other’s voices, so don’t stay there.”
“What’s happening outside now? What about those four guys? Are they still there?”
“Yes, they watched us enter the secret chamber, so they have been waiting outside in the bushes. I just checked the screen, and they are still there.”
“Boss, what should we do now? How can you come out?”
“I’m not sure. This looks like an Ancient Tomb, and I think what I’ve found is a stone coffin that’s just lying here, but we can’t open it.”
“What? A coffin?” There’s a crypt? Are there other things?”
“No, nothing else, no other things. There’s only one ancient book with detailed records, and Ling’er is decoding the text on it now. I believe, if we can decipher it, it may help us advance our situation.”
“So, boss, what should I do now?”
“Don’t do anything; go find a safe place to hide for now. Also, if that door somehow can’t be opened, I trust those four guys won’t be able to leave either, so for the time being, your situation should be relatively safe.”
