“I told you, it’s not right to leave you both alone. If I were there, maybe we could come up with a plan together. Besides, I have many tools with me. If it comes to it, we could just blow the door open.”
“I’m telling you, don’t do anything rash. The underground environment is very dangerous, and we don’t know if there is anything load-bearing around here. If a collapse were to happen because of this, none of us would be able to escape. Do you understand?”
He knew about Hei Lang’s impulsive nature and also that Hei Lang was completely considering his wellbeing.
“Okay, boss, I understand.”
“Alright, hurry and go with him to a safe place. If everything goes well, I believe we can get out soon. Remember, don’t do anything until I’m out. Do you understand?”
“Okay, I got it.”
After the conversation, Hei Lang nodded and finally hung up the phone.
He stood at the entrance to the hole, took a long breath.
Just a stone’s distance away, and he couldn’t break through.
In fact, he had been very anxious just moments before, ready to blow the place open, but after listening to Lin Yi, he also felt that the act would indeed have been reckless.
Then, he got up and left the spot, making his way back to the safe mud pit outside.
He saw the hunter lying there, obviously in pain at the moment.
“How are you doing?”
“I feel the pain starting again, and it’s really unbearable.”

chapters.title: Chapter 509: 509: Mountain Suppressing Divine Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 509: Chapter 509: Mountain Suppressing Divine Beast
He lowered his head to glance at the wound, noticing it was still bleeding.
“I don’t have the knowledge of first aid, and I only have some hemostatic medicine here. I’ll wrap it up for you temporarily; we’ll have to wait for the two of them to come out before we can treat you,” she said.
“I know. How are they doing now?”
“They said they’ve entered a cryptic room, and the sound insulation is so good in there that I can’t talk to them. I can’t get in, so all we can do here is patiently wait.”
“What? There’s a secret chamber inside that cave?”
“Yes, and according to my brother, there seems to be a stone coffin in there, probably with someone inside, but no one knows how many years it has been buried there. By the way, how long has Xi Lian Mountain been around?”
...
“As far as I can remember, it’s always been here. Moreover, my great-grandfather’s generation has lived in this mountain by hunting, so it’s probably been around for a long, long time.”
“Then, regarding this deep mountain, are there any other legends? Or has anyone stayed in a cave for a long time, have you heard any such news?”
“No, I’ve never heard of such things. And I didn’t even know that people lived here. This area used to be forbidden, so nobody was able to come in.”
“That’s really strange. If no one has entered this area for so many years, why would there be a secret chamber in there? And why did he die here, and who buried him after his death?”
“No one can explain that. Maybe, we can only find out what happened in that room after your brother comes out.”
The hunter was genuinely interested and wanted to know everything.
Having lived at the base of this great mountain for so many years, one can say that generations have relied on this mountain for sustenance.
But now, with such mysterious events happening inside the great mountain, this probably holds profound significance for them.
“You’ll just have to hang in there for now. Fortunately, those things are trapped below, so they can’t come out. As long as we leave this area, we should be relatively safe.”
The hunter didn’t continue; he simply nodded. Now, the pain in his body was gradually lessening.
He believed he could hold on until that moment.
After all, to have fallen from such a height and to have miraculously survived was already incredibly fortunate for him.
At this moment, Lin Yi remained trapped in the secret room, waiting patiently.
He was far from anxious; he had been somewhat anxious before, but now that he was in this room, he seemed to have become much calmer all of a sudden.
Lin Yi knew that no matter how long the wait, in the end, there would only be one outcome: they still wouldn’t be able to escape this secret room.
Finally, Lin Yi saw Ling’er stand up from the stone bench and then stretch a big yawn.
He checked the time; an entire hour had passed since then, slipping by unnoticed.
“Ling’er, how did it go, have you finished looking at everything?”
“Yes, I’ve finished looking,” she replied.
“So, what now? What did you see in there? And, is there anything valuable?”
“What’s recorded inside is all valuable, so it seems we should be able to leave here smoothly this time.”
Ling’er spoke with a smile beginning to form on her face.
This confirmed that their ideas were sound and that they would likely be able to realize everything soon.
“Then, tell me quickly, what happened, and what kind of person was he?”
“Let me put it this way—he used to be a hunter,” she said.
“What? A hunter?”
“Yes, but as for the timeline, since some of the text is unclear to me, I can’t infer precisely, but I can estimate that it’s been several hundred years from now.”
“If that’s the case, then it really has been a long time. Alright, tell me in detail, what exactly is the situation.”
“What is recorded is why he came here, what happened after he arrived, and why he was trapped here, never leaving the place.”
“Why? Why did he come here?”
“He said he was just searching for a game animal when he ventured alone into Xi Lian Mountain, but the deeper he went, the more trapped he became, staying here for a total of 17 days.”
“What? Seventeen days, which means that he wasn’t here during those 17 days, right?”
“Right, he wasn’t here, and he seemed to be searching for a secret. He discovered Xi Lian Mountain had a secret and that the Divine Beasts guarding the mountain were the four creatures that appeared before me.”
“Divine Beasts? You mean, the whole of Xi Lian Mountain was under their guardianship?”
“It was guarded by them. Moreover, he had discovered that if those beasts were lost, and he felt that if those four Divine Beasts weren’t subdued, then the villagers around Xi Lian Mountain would cease to exist.”
“You’re saying he protected everyone in the village. So, does that mean he was likely someone from our village?”
“Right, he once noted that he was from our village, probably from a wealthy household, with plenty of fertile land, but the specifics weren’t recorded in great detail; he merely mentioned it in passing.”
“So, his intention for coming here was truly to earnestly protect the common people?”
“That seems to be the gist of it. And what I gather from this is that a long, long time ago, the villagers were constantly suffering immense disturbances from Xi Lian Mountain. To resolve this, he braved the mountain alone.”

chapters.title: Chapter 510: 510: Guiding the Escape
chapters.content:
Chapter 510: Chapter 510: Guiding the Escape
“And then? Did he discover that the root of all these issues was due to these four Divine Beasts?”
“Yes, precisely these four Divine Beasts. These creatures were continuously disrupting the peace in nature, driving wild animals into a corner with no escape, forcing them to run to the town in search of a place to live.”
“So, if you put it that way, these four fellows must be quite formidable, right? If he could drive away all the Divine Beasts around here, then, presumably, they must have some ability. But why didn’t he show any of it in front of me?”
“That’s because, after hundreds of years of evolution, they have begun to regress. Their previous ferocious instincts have now disappeared.”
“What do you mean? I still don’t quite understand.”
“He was trapped in this room, and he began to study carefully how to trap these four Divine Beasts here, to allow them to coexist peacefully in Xi Lian Mountain and survive forever.”
...
“From my point of view, the fundamental solution to this problem is to disrupt the peace here, meaning the four Divine Beasts must die here. Only then can we achieve safety.”
“You’re wrong. It’s precisely because these four Divine Beasts exist here that the other animals don’t dare leave Xi Lian Mountain easily, for they all feel a sense of fear towards these Divine Beasts.”
“If that’s the case, they can check and suppress each other, then why exterminate them? And why trap the four Divine Beasts?”
“Because he needed the four Divine Beasts to guard Xi Lian Mountain. Therefore, he had to figure out a way to trap them in a certain space.”
“Has he achieved this now? And if so, why then do we still encounter them outside? They should have been permanently sealed in this environment.”
“So, he began to cultivate certain things, making them develop a dependence necessary for their survival.”
“Are you referring to the Herbs planted outside?”
“Exactly, these are the Herbs he planted here. He hadn’t thought it through at the time; he just felt that these things could gradually tame them and slowly weaken their natural toxicity, eventually transforming them into herbivorous creatures.”
“Meaning, those four monsters we saw before have been eating these things, with the aim of survival.”
“Right, that’s the idea. But in the process of planting these Herbs, he had already discovered that due to the unique environment and special structures, coupled with the continuous consumption by those creatures, generation after generation, these Herbs slowly evolved into precious medicinal materials.”
“And him? Has he never left this place from beginning to end?”
“He was always dedicated to this research, spending his entire life alone in this place.”
“So that means, we still can’t take those things outside with us lightly, right?”
“Correct. He actually wanted to convey this to us. If, one day, someone could come here, it would certainly be for these precious Herbs. He merely wanted to warn us that if those Herbs were ever taken away, then the entire natural world would completely lose its balance, and everyone in the town would be destroyed in an instant.”
After saying this, Lin Yi truly felt a great sense of regret.
Fortunately, they hadn’t acted hastily. If they had taken everything away, it might have resulted in catastrophic damage.
“Is there anything else?”
“Besides these, he mentioned that he had set up some traps and mechanisms; including ones that would be triggered the moment we start to pluck these Herbs, causing a stone mechanism below to be activated and sealing the path completely.”
“Did he say how to open it?”
“He did give a solution, including for this door. All the secrets are on this stone coffin.”
“What? On the stone coffin?”
“He roughly sketched a diagram on top of it, and after studying it carefully, I found that it corresponds to a painting on the right side of the stone gate. Starting from the left, the fourth character symbol is actually a triggerable spot.”
Upon saying this, Lin Yi seemed unable to contain his excitement, and quickly walked forward.
He looked carefully and upon counting to the fourth symbol from this side, he noticed that this particular symbol was indeed strange.
The detail was clearly etched, but it appeared much deeper and was more pronounced than the others.
If one didn’t inspect it closely in this spot, perhaps he would never have noticed this difference.
“Sigh, Ling’er, you’re not wrong. Everything he said was right; there’s definitely something off about this spot.”
While speaking, Lin Yi reached out to press it, but Ling’er suddenly stepped in and pushed Lin Yi aside.
“Don’t be in such a rush now.”
“What do you mean?”
“If you press it like that, then we’ll have to go back out and face those four Divine Beasts.”
“Oh, you’re right. It seems I’ve oversimplified things. Did he say how to deal with the monsters?”
“He mentioned that the monsters have a distinct reaction to one particular fruit. According to his description of the fruit’s shape, I noticed one like that in the thicket, though it’s located quite deep and out of reach.”
“You mean to say, we just need that fruit for you to use, and then we can take the opportunity to leave?”
“Yes, that’s the idea. He told me that using this is the only way to escape from here.”
“I see. Could you roughly tell me the position of that fruit? When we get out later, it should be the first thing we pick.”
“It should be on the right-hand side of the stone door. As soon as we get out, we should be able to see it immediately; it’s very conspicuous. He deliberately grew it here with the aim of saving his own life one day.”

chapters.title: Chapter 511: 511 Escape from the Secret Room
chapters.content:
Chapter 511: Chapter 511 Escape from the Secret Room
“Did he ever say exactly how he died?”
“Maybe he passed away peacefully in his sleep. After all, the inscription was quite serene, and he lived here for a full 50 years.”
“My god, 50 years. That’s really quite a stretch to endure.”
“Right, so not just anyone could do it. That’s why, after seeing these things, I realized some things can be obtained, but some should never be acquired.”
“Does that mean, on this trip to Xi Lian Mountain, we can’t take anything from here?”
“Correct, there’s no way to take anything with us.”
...
“No, I don’t think that’s the case.”
“What do you mean?”
“Have you seen the walls around us?”
As he spoke, he gestured around them.
All of Ling’er’s attention was focused on the book at that moment; she hadn’t noticed anything amiss with the walls of the room.
“The walls?”
Ling’er muttered to herself and then walked over to the walls, where she indeed found many symbols and some drawings.
“This… this looks like a method for planting plants, doesn’t it?”
“Exactly. He etched the method here. If that’s the case, we need to find the right environment and then plant the precious herbs out there using his method.”
“That’s great, then. I’ll record this right away.”
“No need. While you were browsing the text, I’ve already taken pictures of all the murals and inscriptions on the sarcophagus. We can study them in detail once we’re outside.”
“Ok, then. It seems it’s time for us to leave this place.”
Lin Yi nodded in response, took a deep breath, and then turned to look at Ling’er.
“Are you ready?”
He knew that once they left this time, it had to be in one go, and if they managed to complete everything successfully, then the light of victory would be theirs.
Ling’er nodded but didn’t speak. She stepped forward and gently pressed a spot.
To their surprise, the mechanism was incredibly responsive. The area she pressed sank in immediately,
and they heard the massive rumbling of stones. It felt as if the entire room was shaking.
Lin Yi clearly saw the stone door opening again.
It appeared they had not been deceived.
“So, we can leave now?”
“Yes, we can leave.”
Lin Yi walked over and carefully placed the book back on the metal box.
“Ling’er, what are you doing? Don’t you want to take the book with you?”
“Take it with me? Why should I? If someday other people find their way here and discover this book, it could save their lives.”
Upon reflection, what Ling’er said made sense.
In their moment of need, this book had indeed been their lifesaver. It seemed the person had foreseen all this and that someday someone would enter this room.
After replacing all the items, they moved quickly and both walked out through the stone door once more.
As soon as they stepped out, Lin Yi noticed the candles inside the room went out instantly, and the stone door began to close slowly again.
This closure might last many years, but perhaps one day, it could be opened again. Lin Yi wasn’t interested in those sorts of investigations, so he didn’t want to delve into the matter any further.
Then, as the book had mentioned, he took a final look around and noticed several red fruits.
The color was indeed very enticing.
“Is this what he was talking about?”
“Yes, it should be.”
Lin Yi approached and carefully plucked the fruits, one by one, holding them in his hand.
Upon touching the fruits, he felt the divine beasts grow restless, indicating the fruits were significant to them.
“So, what’s the situation now?”
“Didn’t you hear that noise just now?”
“Oh, I think I did. Has the door opened over there?”
“I guess it has. Now, when I count to three, let’s throw the fruit as far as we can, distracting them. Then we can make our escape.”
“Got it.”
“1, 2, 3.”
On cue, they swung their arms and threw the fruits with all their might into the abyss.
As expected, the divine beasts were lured by the fruits and rushed toward them.
In the instant they vanished, Lin Yi led the others in a sprint through the passage and out of there.
The moment they escaped, the stone door slammed shut once more.
As it sealed, Lin Yi finally breathed a sigh of relief, feeling as if a huge weight had been lifted from his chest.
“So, it’s closed just like that? Remember, it didn’t close when we first came in; it was open.”
“That proves they’ve lived here long enough to figure out how to manipulate the mechanism. They might find a way to get out.”
“It’s a pity, though. Such important things are left there, but we couldn’t take any of it.”
“Yes, it’s a pity. But at least we’ve maintained the natural balance. This means the local people can continue to live on, relying on this great mountain.”

chapters.title: Chapter 512: 512 Waiting for Dawn
chapters.content:
Chapter 512: Chapter 512 Waiting for Dawn
“Forget it, let’s not talk about that now. Let’s hurry over and meet up with the two of them. I guess they must be getting very anxious waiting here.”
As he spoke, he quickened his pace. By now, they had entered the muddy swamp.
In the distance, he saw a light flickering continuously, likely indicating Hei Lang and the hunter.
“Hei Lang.”
Lin Yi called out loudly, and Hei Lang immediately turned his head to look.
He ran towards them quickly.
...
He hadn’t expected that they really did it, and moreover, they had escaped from that place with ease.
“Big brother, are you alright? Did you two really make it out?”
He looked Lin Yi up and down and noticed that there were no apparent injuries on him.
After all, the injury Lin Yi suffered was on his back.
Lin Yi nodded.
“Ling’er, are you okay?”
He saw that Ling’er was still breathing heavily, clearly exhausted from running so fast.
“I’m fine. Let’s hurry and leave this place, and moreover, we definitely should not linger here.”
“What about the things you brought with you?”
“Let’s explain after we get out of here. Hurry, we need to move quickly.”
Hei Lang nodded, then immediately led them to rendezvous with the hunter.
In the end, with Hei Lang and Lin Yi cooperating, the four of them made it back above ground once again.
Once they arrived, they all felt a great sense of relief.
Now, the sky was beginning to darken, and surprisingly, they had been down there the entire day.
“Brother, looking at how it is, we won’t be able to leave tonight. We’ll have to find a place to camp temporarily and then leave Xi Lian Mountain as soon as day breaks tomorrow.”
The hunter didn’t say anything; he had sensed something ever since they’d surfaced—that these people must have thought of something significant, otherwise, they wouldn’t just give up easily.
He guessed something must have happened below, or perhaps there was some other matter that held everything up.
Despite the pain around his hip, he turned to look around.
The area was relatively flat and seemed suitable for setting up a tent to spend the night.
“Let’s camp here; we can’t go any further. After all, this is their restricted zone, and I’ve realized something.”
“Brother, what did you think of?”
“I now realize that the entities below are immensely powerful; that’s why fierce beasts don’t dare come near that region. Otherwise, this place wouldn’t be so well preserved.”
“Right, so that means this place should be the safest for us. Is that a correct understanding?”
“You can understand it that way, so let’s set up camp here. But for safety, we should all stay in one tent, so if something happens, we can look after each other.”
“Okay, that works. Hei Lang, set up a tent, and let’s move in as quickly as possible.”
“Alright, I got it.”
After speaking, Hei Lang began to busily set up the camp.
While he was busy, Ling’er dressed Lin Yi’s wound on his back, simplifying the treatment since it was more of a flesh wound and not particularly difficult to handle.
Lin Yi’s issue was resolved, but the key question now was, how to deal with the hunter’s injury?
Once Hei Lang had the tent up, darkness had completely fallen, and they quickly moved inside.
“Brother, lie down here; let me check your wounds first.”
As he said this, he went over to try and use his Heavenly Eye to unlock the acupoints, but he discovered that the Heavenly Eye was failing him again at this moment.
The more urgent the need, the less it seemed to offer assistance; sometimes he found it quite infuriating.
“How is his condition?”
Ling’er noticed he had been standing there confused for quite a while and was unsure of the situation.
“Right now, I can’t make a good judgment, and the injury seems complicated.”
“So what should I do now?”
“Ling’er, do you have any medicine for setting bones or remedies for fractures?”
“I do have some, which should help with minor cracks or fractures, but if his bone is completely broken, then that’s truly troublesome, and I fear my medicine won’t be effective.”
“Even if it might not be effective, it could still have some effect. Let me apply the medicine, and tomorrow we must hurry away from here and back to town where I can properly treat him.”
“Okay, understood.”
Ling’er was unsure why at that moment he couldn’t harness his talents.
Ordinarily, he was capable of all that, but now, he had come to a halt,
In the evening, they lit a bonfire, which served to keep them warm and repel other things.
They didn’t dare to all sleep at once, so Lin Yi and Hei Lang kept watch by turns.
During the night, Lin Yi briefly briefed them on the events below, but without going into great detail.
Lin Yi felt that under these circumstances, they shouldn’t know too much.
After all, it was a secret, and one day, if they truly reached this place, that’s when they would truly understand everything about what happened back in those days.”
“Big brother, are you okay?”
Suddenly, without knowing when, Hei Lang approached him from behind and asked.
“Yes, I’m fine.”
“Do you think we’ll be able to leave smoothly tomorrow?”
“Don’t worry too much, it should be fine.”
“By the way, big brother, what exactly did you encounter below? And, I heard you discovered an Ancient Tomb. If it is a tomb, was there anything else inside?”

chapters.title: Chapter 513: Seriously Injured
chapters.content:
Chapter 513: Chapter 513: Seriously Injured
“Inside, there were only stones, and also, just the body of the tomb’s owner. Although I didn’t lift the coffin lid, I can conjecture that, if he hadn’t left us some clues back then, perhaps, Ling’er and I would still be trapped down there.”
“So you mean, it was actually them who saved us, right?”
“Yeah, it was them who saved us. Otherwise, with our abilities, we wouldn’t have been able to do all this.”
“Brother, why don’t you rest for a while? I can’t sleep anymore. I reckon in another two or three hours, it will be dawn. Once it’s light out, we need to leave.”
“Okay, I understand. Actually, what I’m most worried about now is the hunter’s injury.”
“Brother, didn’t you just check?”
...
“Yes, I did check, but right now, I can’t solve it at all. Only after we leave here will I be able to treat him. However, I’m worried that if we delay further, his injuries could lead to complications.”
After saying this, Lin Yi shook his head helplessly, feeling that sometimes, in the face of natural disasters, he was truly powerless.
Tonight, he had called upon the system countless times, but found that it never truly manifested itself within his body.
Unknowingly, the sky had started to brighten ever so slightly.
They quickly packed up their belongings and then took down the tent.
Since the hunter was injured and unable to leave on his own, they had no choice but to take turns carrying him, advancing with difficulty.
Fortunately, along the way, they finally had smooth sailing and did not encounter any further disruptions of that sort.
When they reached the Swamp, Lin Yi felt that they were getting closer and closer to the exit.
“Alright, we can take a short break now. According to our progress, in about an hour, we should be able to leave the mountains.”
Lin Yi truly felt worn out.
Though they hadn’t encountered any danger on the road, the key issue was that taking turns carrying the hunter was also a significant challenge for them.
Just after sitting down, he suddenly heard a beeping sound coming from within his body.
It seemed the system had come to life once more.
He swiftly stood up and walked over to the hunter’s side.
The hunter just looked up curiously, not knowing what he was about to do.
“Don’t move.”
He told the hunter, who, although not understanding his intention, followed his advice and slowly stabilized his body.
The hunter could see clearly that the bones in his hip area were obviously misaligned, and the two sections of bone had completely separated.
Just looking at the bones, it was truly severe, and behind the bones, he also saw some white fragments.
It was clear these were bone shards left from when the bones had shattered.
If he wanted to reposition the two bones correctly, he was actually capable of doing it.
In Lin Yi’s mind, a clear composition diagram began to form, but he needed some tools for the job, which he didn’t have at the moment.
Just as he had thought, at this time, the only option was to leave as quickly as possible.
“Go and see if you can find two sturdy sticks. Remember, they must be strong and preferably straight.”
“Brother, what are you going to do?”
“Don’t worry about it, just hurry and do as I said.”
“Okay, I got it.”
Hei Lang nodded and then quickly went off in that direction.
“Brother Lin, come over here and see if I’ve been hurt in this spot.”
Lin Yi heard Ling’er calling him over.
But as they had traveled this way, it seemed Ling’er hadn’t sustained any injuries.
Could it be that he hadn’t noticed?
He quickly went over and looked at Ling’er with concern.
“Ling’er, what’s wrong? Are you feeling unwell?”
“Brother Lin, look at this spot.”
Ling’er said as she stretched out her hand.
But he saw that on Ling’er’s delicate arm, there was no sign of injury whatsoever.
“Don’t turn around now. I called you over because I wanted to confirm with you whether his injuries are serious.”
That was it. Ling’er was actually worried about the hunter’s condition.
And indeed, if the situation was dire, such a burden on his conscience could indeed exert even greater pressure on him.
“From what I see, some of the bones are completely fractured, and there are also compound fractures present.”
“Then, what does that mean? Could it cost him his life?”
“Life, certainly not, but I’m just worried that even if I reconnect it, in the end, he might not be able to exert much force on this leg.”
“That won’t do, Brother Lin. He’s the main provider for his family. If he were to be seriously injured, then his whole family would probably fall apart.”
“I’m also aware of that, which is why I’ve been so hesitant. Just now, I only managed to stabilize it with two wooden planks. It’s already been delayed by a day and a night, and if we keep delaying, we might really be helpless.”
“Brother Lin, if even you say so, does it mean…?”
“We can’t care about that right now, we need to focus on doing what we can, and in the end what results we get, we’ll just have to leave it to fate.”
Ling’er nodded slightly.
His heart was always kind, and he didn’t want anyone to face such dangers in front of him, or else he would feel guilt in his heart.
Hei Lang quickly returned from there, carrying two sticks that were both straight and tough.
Sometimes, he truly admired Hei Lang; he always managed to accomplish what others couldn’t.
“Brother, here you go.”
“Find some bandages and come over here, then press against his body. I need to secure this in place to prevent any displacement while walking.”
Hei Lang nodded and then squatted down, cooperating with Lin Yi as instructed.
“Big bro, I’m going to apply force, which might hurt a bit, so just bear with it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 514: Could it be a Python?
chapters.content:
Chapter 514: Chapter 514: Could it be a Python?
Although the process was indeed painful, the hunter still gritted his teeth and cooperated with everything.
“Done, your side is now temporarily stabilized. Although there’s still some pain for the present, rest assured, once we reach the town, I’ll do everything possible to treat you,”
The hunter did not speak, he simply nodded slightly.
However, Lin Yi could clearly see that the hunter’s lips had turned somewhat deathly pale.
“Alright, do you guys have any other issues? If not, let’s push on with effort and head directly out of this deep mountain,”
“Don’t worry, I’m fine now, big brother,”
...
“Okay then, Ling’er, how about you?”
“Brother Lin, I’m also fine, we can go,”
Lin Yi nodded his head, then packed up the things, and the group set off toward the direction out of the mountain.
“Big brother, look, isn’t this already the edge of the mountain?”
Suddenly, Hei Lang said excitedly to him.
Because they had indeed passed this way before, and Hei Lang had specifically left a mark at the side of the road, which was the first mark he made after entering the mountain.
This proved that they were now about ten minutes or so away from the mountain entrance.
Lin Yi looked and then nodded excitedly. After all, having gone through these two days and nights was indeed a significant challenge for him.
“Alright, now we finally see hope. No matter what, you must rest well tonight in the inn, dispelling all of the fatigue from the past few days,”
“Yes, big brother, we’re nearly there now, I really can’t wait to go back, have a good meal, drink a little alcohol, and get a good night’s sleep,”
“Hehe, don’t worry, I’m certain your wish will be fulfilled today,”
“Brother Lin, what’s that over there?”
At that moment, Ling’er seemed to have discovered something and pointed towards the direction ahead while speaking to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi originally hadn’t noticed anything at all, since he felt that having arrived at this place should be entirely safe.
When they had entered the mountain, it was actually such a situation.
Within the first hour of entering the mountain, there was hardly any sign of danger.
After all, those things were hiding deep inside the mountain, and at this edge, there were very few creatures to be seen.
He simply looked curiously in the direction Ling’er pointed, as he now saw something in the underbrush that seemed to be slowly writhing.
There was clearly no wind around, yet he could see that the grass was continuously fluttering messily in the air.
Lin Yi frowned, could it be that at the very exit, they were going to encounter such an obstacle?
“What is that thing?”
“Not sure, but the grass itself is very short, and something is moving through it; could it be a snake or something like that?”
“Oh, if it’s a snake, then it’s much easier to deal with.”
Having said that, he just let out a long sigh.
Because dealing with one or two pythons shouldn’t be much of a problem for him.
“Brother, if it’s snakes we’re talking about, leave this matter to me.”
You should know, Hei Lang is an expert in snake hunting, and has even received professional training. He has no fear whatsoever of these cold-blooded creatures.
“Sure, elder brother, you rest here for a bit while I go over and see what exactly is going on.”
“Alright, then be careful.”
As he spoke, he moved the hunter back to a position near a rock.
That way, his entire body could lean against the rock, and other parts of his body wouldn’t need to exert too much force, which, overall, would be more relaxing for him.
Hei Lang walked over and then took some professional tools out of his backpack.
Lin Yi felt fairly at ease with all this.
Because he had previously witnessed Hei Lang’s abilities firsthand, so he had no doubts in this regard.
“Hold on a second.”
Just as Hei Lang had all his gear ready and was about to head over, suddenly, the hunter called out loudly.
At that moment, everyone stopped.
“Elder brother, you don’t have to worry. My brother here is a snake-catching expert. Even if it’s pythons, there shouldn’t be much danger for him.”
“No, something’s not right about this.”
“What? What’s not right?”
Although others didn’t quite understand, seeing the hunter’s cautious demeanor, they concluded that they probably ran into some troublesome situation this time.
“If I’m not mistaken, it must be an extremely venomous snake.”
“What? An extremely venomous snake? Are there any venomous snakes in this area? But venomous snakes shouldn’t be a problem either. I’ve been trained to capture venomous snakes before, just by pressing down on a few crucial parts of them. Then, their venom can’t be released at all.”
“No, if I’m right, this venomous snake’s entire body is covered with venom. If you really approach its body, even the slightest touch of its secretions could be fatal for you.”
“Are there such dangerous venomous snakes here?”
“There are, right here in Xi Lian Mountain.”
“Elder brother, are you just guessing this out of thin air?”
“No, I just glanced over there and saw something green flowing inside for a moment. I suspect that it’s that kind of snake.”
“Have you seen it before?”
“I’ve never seen it before, but other hunters who went into the mountains with me have. And the two people who saw it… none of them came out.”
“Are you saying that they all died from this kind of venomous snake?”
“Exactly. All died from the venomous slime on the body of the snake. You should know, for a hunter in the deep forests, encountering venomous snakes is basically daily business.”
“Right, if that’s the case, shouldn’t it be even simpler for me to handle it? Why then, does it seem like such an immense challenge for them?”
“That’s because this venomous snake cannot be touched at all. Even with advanced equipment, there’s still no way to avoid touching its body surface. If that happens, once contact is made, things become much more troubling.”

chapters.title: Chapter 515: The Characteristics of a Venomous Snake
chapters.content:
Chapter 515: Chapter 515: The Characteristics of a Venomous Snake
“You mean I can’t get close to him at all, right? As long as I do, I’ll be in danger?”
“Yes, that’s what I mean.”
“But how can you be so sure?”
“Look quickly.”
Hei Lang had wanted to keep asking, but suddenly, he saw the hunter’s horrified eyes, and then the hunter pointed behind Hei Lang’s body.
He quickly turned around to look and now, a large green python appeared before him.
...
Its entire upper body rose upright, and honestly, Hei Lang had never seen such a color on any creature before.
And just like the hunter had described, its whole body seemed to be covered with slime, and even now, when it rose, things continuously fell off its body into the underbrush.
“What, what’s going on?”
Hei Lang had never in his life encountered such a python, one that could even drip liquid automatically from its body.
Generally, snakes are cold-blooded animals, and their skin surface should be very cool, but this one seemed completely different from normal snake species.
“As far as I know, this python hasn’t been seen for about 20 years, which means it’s been 20 years since anyone has seen this kind of python. Unexpectedly, we encountered it right at the exit.”
“Bro, do you have any solutions then?”
“For now, there is no good solution. All we can do is leave this place as fast as possible and go back into the deep forest.”
“What, you say go back?”
Lin Yi really couldn’t accept this reality.
It had not been easy to decide to come out, and now they were at the edge, almost within reach.
But now, with the giant python lying in front of him, any attempt to break through would surely disturb it and cause contact.
They still had some distance from the python, so standing here without moving forward might mean the danger wasn’t that great yet.
“Yes, if we rush forward now, we will ultimately fall into their trap, and our situation will become even more dangerous.”
“But when we came just now, it didn’t seem to appear here. Why did it show up now?”
“That, I don’t know. I don’t understand much about this python, including its habits and usual habitat. These, I know nothing about.”
“Is there no other way to leave Xi Lian Mountain besides this route?”
“We entered through this path, and now that we’ve come this far, even if we want to take a detour, we must go back in again. Then, we must choose another suitable exit to leave.”
“It’s unlikely to go back in. We’re almost there; who knows what we’ll encounter if we go back? We’ve been very lucky to get this far.”
Lin Yi simply couldn’t accept this.
He had thought there might be some danger on this outing, but he hadn’t expected the journey out of the mountain to go so smoothly.
Now, it seemed as if everything was waiting for him; he couldn’t make this decision blindly.
“For now, I don’t have any better ideas. Unless you guys can think of something else, if we just walk out like this, he will surely attack us, and then all of us will die here.”
“Are all the fluids dripping from his body highly toxic?”
“Yes, all are poisonous, and they quickly penetrate our skin and mucous membranes, then slowly enter our blood vessels, and subsequently, spread throughout our bodies.”
“His way of envenoming is truly unique.”
“Yes, that’s the characteristic of this poisonous snake, so you can’t touch it at all, including your previous claims of being tough, in front of him, you’re nothing.”
“Big brother, then what do we do?”
At first, Hei Lang was enthusiastic and confident.
But after hearing what the hunter had to say, everyone gradually realized that some things weren’t as simple as they’d imagined.
Lin Yi frowned, pacing back and forth on the spot. He felt it was as if this creature had purposefully blocked his path out of nowhere, and honestly, he was really not willing to accept that.
Does it really mean following the hunter’s advice and going back?
He didn’t want to do that. Going back in and trying to come out again might not be so simple.
“What tools do you have in hand now?”
He suddenly stopped walking and then spoke to Hei Lang.
“Oh, big brother, take a look, these nets and other stuff, see, they’re all laid out here.”
Hei Lang dropped all his snake-catching tools on the ground, then introduced them to Lin Yi one by one in detail.
Some things Lin Yi had experienced before, and he had heard about them.
But some, he was seeing for the first time.
“With these tools, can you take out this snake without touching it?”
“Normally, it should be possible, but I can’t guarantee 100% that we could avoid contact if we really took action against its surface.”
“So, you’re saying that if we want to go through with it, we’d still have to take a risk?”
“Yes, there’s a chance we won’t touch it if he doesn’t struggle too much, but I think the likelihood is very small. And with his large body, I couldn’t possibly control it all at once.”
“I’ve seen your tools; although some are indeed advanced, we have no other choice under these circumstances. So now, we only have the option to get out of the mountain as quickly as possible and then think of other solutions.”

chapters.title: Chapter 516: This is the Green Wilderness
chapters.content:
Chapter 516: Chapter 516: This is the Green Wilderness
“Brother, what can we do now? You said it yourself, he’s completely blocked this place off.”
“No, not necessarily. I won’t believe that he’ll keep persisting here forever. He has to go out to hunt, has to return to his own den, so I think the most appropriate method would be that after he leaves, we make our move again.”
“But the key question is, when exactly will he leave?”
“That, I do not know. Maybe soon, or perhaps he’ll stay a few more hours, or even until tomorrow before he leaves. No one can be sure.”
Lin Yi still felt that continuing like this was ultimately not a good solution. If they wanted to completely resolve the issue, they essentially had to make their own sacrifices.
“Could it be that we really have to go back into the mountain? What do you two think? What’s your opinion?”
...
This time, Lin Yi really couldn’t make up his mind and could only seek the opinions of others.
“Big brother, I don’t have any objections, but the key is, if we don’t try and just retreat like this, don’t you think it’s a bit too regrettable?”
“Try? How to try? Didn’t you understand what Brother Lin just said? If you could completely avoid its skin and not come into contact with it, perhaps that may solve the problem.”
“I really regret not bringing a protective suit now. If I had one, my body wouldn’t be exposed, and I could confidently deal with her.”
“There’s no point in talking about that now. No, we should hurry and retreat, but let’s not go too far. We’ll find a place nearby to set up a temporary camp, and then just keep an eye on their movements,”
“Ah, right, Brother Lin, do you think he’ll launch an attack on us if we don’t provoke him or disturb him here?”
“Under normal circumstances, he probably won’t, but we still need to deal with the specific situation as it arises.”
“The creature you’re talking about, is it called ‘Green Miasma’?”
Suddenly, Ling’er spoke up.
“Green Miasma?”
“Yes, Green Miasma. I remember reading something related in a book once. It said that this python is full of venom, and that it seeps out from its skin.”
“Oh, you do describe this characteristic in detail, but as for the specific name, no one knows that.”
“Ling’er, do you know about it?”
“I seem to recall, I did see in a book that the Green Miasma’s venom is very potent, even more so than that of a cobra’s.”
“What else? Is there any other relevant information?”
“The rest is about how this creature is naturally sedentary and doesn’t like to move. Even if it does move, it will be extremely slow, and most of the time, it lives among the grass.”
Lin Yi nodded, but felt that the information Ling’er provided was basically of little value.
“Also, I remember, the insides of this Green Miasma can be used as medicinal ingredients.”
“Are you saying this toxic creature can be used as medicine? Isn’t that nonsense?”
“No, although its venom permeates from inside out, its own viscera are very well preserved and are a precious medicinal material.”
“Now that you mention it, I think I’m actually quite interested in this snake. We’ve been through the mountains and apart from finding some feces, we really haven’t found anything valuable. So, should we try to take this snake back with us?”
The idea was already forming in Lin Yi’s mind. Although he knew catching the snake would be fraught with difficulties, he was still hopeful.
“Brother Lin, I’d advise you against it. We’ve narrowly escaped death and are about to get out. We can’t keep waiting here.”
“Right, we absolutely can’t keep waiting. Don’t forget, we might manage to wait here for a day or two, but the hunter can’t wait. His injuries are really serious. He must get back to the town and use some special equipment to be properly treated.”
At that moment, a thought suddenly crossed his mind, and he turned to look at the hunter leaning against something nearby.
The hunter could only helplessly shake his head. Actually, from their conversation, he could already guess that this time his chances were probably slim.
“But we absolutely can’t risk everyone’s lives because of me, right?”
“No, we absolutely can’t wait any longer, no matter what, we must find a way to drive it away.”
“Drive it away? Do you have any ideas?”
“Didn’t he just say it? He said its movement is very slow, so I can try to lure it away. Then we can leave here quickly. I believe that as long as we get out of Xi Lian Mountain’s range, it probably won’t come out.”
“Isn’t that even more dangerous? Big brother, let me do it.”
“Hei Lang, you can’t. You’ve already sacrificed a lot, and although you’re quite agile, when it comes to running, I’m not much worse than you. Besides, those two people and including that guy need someone to carry them on their back. If I carry someone, I won’t be able to run very fast.”
“Big brother…”
“Don’t say any more; I’ve decided to do it. Come, give me all your tools. There’s no use for you to keep them here. I believe he will shift his target to me.”
While talking, Lin Yi quickly went over and shouldered all the items on his back.
“Brother Lin, be careful. If it doesn’t work out, we should just wait a bit longer. Maybe he’ll leave soon?”
“We can’t take any more chances. I feel that we’ve already run out of luck in these deep mountains, so it’s unlikely we can do much now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 517: Are Snakes Afraid of Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 517: Chapter 517: Are Snakes Afraid of Me?
“But…”
“Enough, there are no buts. You must speed up here, you have to find the best opportunity, and then quickly leave this place. Rest assured, after I distract it, I will also head out and try to meet up with you all as much as possible. Have faith, fortune favors the brave. My time isn’t up yet.”
Lin Yi’s words were only meant to comfort them, yet whether he could get out himself remained an unknown answer.
He didn’t know if he would be able to make it through this ordeal, but he was clear about one thing: he was the team leader, and when it was time to sacrifice, he had to make that sacrifice.
He couldn’t hear the advice of the others, and then, he quickly walked past them.
When Lin Yi got closer, he noticed that the giant python merely lowered its head to glance at him, that disdainful look in its eyes, as if it had not taken him seriously until now.
...
At that moment, Lin Yi was still some distance away from the python. He turned around and then started to run a few steps in that direction.
After he had run a few steps, he looked back and saw that the giant python had just twisted its head to watch him, but it was entirely unmoved by his actions.
Was passing by like this really not enough to draw its attention? With this thought, Lin Yi bent down, picked up a stone from the ground, and hurled it forcefully at the animal’s body.
This time, it seemed he truly angered it. The giant python opened its gaping maw and, with a leisurely slithering, turned its entire body around.
In doing so, he had indeed successfully attracted its attention.
In that instant, Lin Yi felt that his previous efforts had not been a sacrifice in vain.
So Lin Yi started to run quickly. He noticed that the snake was persistently chasing him from behind.
However, just as Ling’er had mentioned, its movements were quite slow, so if he really sped up, he could leave the snake far behind.
But he worried that once the snake lost its target, it might turn its attention back and return to its original position.
He would take a few steps, then pause.
Just then, he began to feel some pain in his back—the wound that Ling’er had bandaged earlier had split open due to his running.
At this time, Lin Yi noticed that the python had started to twist its body again, this time swaying backwards a bit.
After seeing all this, he was incredulous.
Could it be that the python had seen through his tactic? And did it know that he was trying to lure it?
Normally, snakes didn’t have much in the way of conscious thought. How could it be so clever?
Moreover, having lived in the wild all its life with no interaction with humans, it shouldn’t be able to foresee this.
He stopped in curiosity. He noticed that the python indeed had a fearful look in its eyes.
Just now, its entire body had been leaning forward, and from time to time, it would open its gaping mouth, flick its tongue, seemingly flaunting some skill it possessed.
But now, at this moment, the snake seemed much more subdued, its entire body in a recoiled state.
Could it be that something even more frightening appeared behind him?
He quickly looked back, but the area in front of him was peaceful and quiet.
Without any signs of abnormalities, then why this reaction?
With this thought, Lin Yi slowed down and then cautiously took a couple more steps forward.
However, as he moved forward, he noticed that the snake was continuously pushing backward.
What was it afraid of?
In Lin Yi’s heart, he began to carefully ponder this matter.
“Big brother, big brother.”
Just then, Lin Yi suddenly heard a voice calling him from over there.
He quickly turned around and saw that the one running towards him was none other than Hei Lang.
“Hei Lang, what’s happening? Didn’t I tell you to take this opportunity to leave quickly?”
He was somewhat anxious. This was an excellent chance, so why hadn’t they left the place yet?
“Big brother, don’t worry, I’ve already arranged for them to move forward.”
“What do you mean ‘arrange for them to move forward’? Are you joking? The hunter himself can hardly walk; are you expecting Ling’er to carry him on her back?”
“No, big brother, don’t worry. I’ve already avoided that place, and I’ve found a cave entrance further ahead. I just temporarily stashed them there. I came over to fetch you to see if you need any help on your side.”
“A cave entrance? What cave entrance?”
“I’m not sure, it’s just a cave, and at that time, the hunter said it was relatively safe, so there shouldn’t be any problems with them hiding there for now.”
Upon hearing this, he simply nodded.
“Hei Lang, I’ve discovered something very strange now. This snake, it keeps avoiding me.”
“What? Avoiding you? Big brother, are you kidding? Are you suggesting that the snake is afraid of you at this time?”
“I don’t know if it’s afraid of me, but it was indeed chasing me just now, but at this moment, it is avoiding me.”
As he spoke, he turned his head and took another look.
But when he made eye contact with the snake, the snake’s body visibly leaned forward a bit, and then it opened its massive, gaping maw.
“Big brother, this… it’s not going to eat me, is it?”
“Strange, it wasn’t like this when I approached earlier. Move back a bit.”
Could it be that he had encountered something a moment ago that had led to this misunderstanding?
While speaking, he took two more steps forward, but when he advanced, the snake’s body again leaned backward in retreat.
Immediately after, its body began to slowly shift a few steps in the underbrush.
“Do you see that?”
Lin Yi turned back, then pointed to the scene that had just occurred, and said to Hei Lang.
“Big brother, what’s going on?”
“I’m not sure either. When you move forward, it wants to attack you, but when I move forward, it retreats. Could it be that it’s afraid of something?”

chapters.title: Chapter 518: Afraid of Your Blood?
chapters.content:
Chapter 518: Chapter 518: Afraid of Your Blood?
“Big brother, is he really afraid of you?”
“Normally, he wouldn’t be, but just now, over there, he wasn’t like this.”
“When did he suddenly become like this?”
“Just now, when I was running over there, then I suddenly felt some pain in my back, probably because the bandaged wound had split open, so I stopped, and it was then that I unintentionally discovered this scene.”
“Hold on, you’re saying the wound on your back, come, let me have a look.”
As he spoke, Hei Lang walked behind him, then took a look and sure enough, during the intense running, his wound had indeed split open, and now fresh blood was seeping out again.”
...
“Big brother, you’re bleeding from your back.”
“Oh, I know, it’s normal. The running must have torn the wound open again. It’s alright, I’ll just have to re-bandage it when we get back.”
“Big brother, could he be afraid of that thing?”
“You mean the wound on my back?”
“Big brother, have you forgotten what you told me?”
“Told you, told you what?”
Lin Yi just felt that he had said too much to Hei Lang, but what specifically was he referring to?
“You said that those four animals inside were the Guardians of the Mountain.”
“Yes, indeed, the Leaders of the Mountain.”
“Now, one of the Mountain Leaders has injured you. If that’s the case, then he should recognize this wound, and if so, could he be fearing this wound?”
“This, this can’t be, are they really that formidable? And now, just a wound on my body could instill fear in these ferocious beasts?”
“If that’s the case, I think we should give it a try.”
“Try? Try what?”
“I’m thinking, if he really did scratch you, then something from the body of the Mountain Leader must have mixed into your wound, and the blood that’s flowing out of it could just be the Magical Treasure to restrain him?”
It had to be said, at this moment, Hei Lang really did have a sudden burst of inspiration.
In the past, Lin Yi would never have believed such a claim.
It was simply absurd.
But after experiencing the events at Xi Lian Mountain, he was starting to feel that such a thing was indeed possible here.
What strange things couldn’t happen in this world? It was just that their usual knowledge was too shallow.
“You’re saying, the blood from my body has a kind of deterrent effect on him, or is it that some scent in the blood is similar to the scent from those Divine Beasts before? Is that how I should understand it?”
“Whether it’s a scent or something else, I don’t know. But I believe there’s that kind of connection between them, sort of akin to what we humans call a sixth sense, you know?”
“Oh, I get it. If you put it that way, there really seems to be something to it.”
“Big brother, do you want to do an experiment?”
Hei Lang suddenly spoke to Lin Yi with a hint of mystery.
“An experiment, what experiment?”
“We could try to see if he really is afraid of the blood. If you want to do this experiment, you’ll have to bear with it while I take some blood from your back.”
“Okay, no problem.”
Lin Yi was also interested, and he had heard that the python was crucially important to their medicinal work. Therefore, he was eager to deal with it.
After all, having such a venomous snake lingering here posed a considerable threat to anyone entering the mountain.
In the end, Lin Yi turned around, allowing Hei Lang to gently extract some blood from the wound on his back.
Although it was indeed painful, he thought solving such a significant issue made the pain seem trivial.
“All done, big brother.”
Hei Lang picked up a special device, and Lin Yi saw that it indeed contained some fresh blood.
“So, what’s your plan?”
“What else can I do? I can only toss this stuff onto him from a distance and see what kind of reaction it provokes. But keep in mind, this is all uncertain, so you’d better stand back to avoid any sudden attacks from him.”
“What? A sudden attack? That seems incredibly risky for you.”
“Don’t worry, I will be at a safe distance, and I’ll use another launcher to accurately hit him. Rest assured, I know what I’m doing.”
While talking, Hei Lang took out a launcher from his backpack.
Then he placed the special container at the tip of the launcher—with just a pull of the trigger, it would shoot towards its target.
With the device in hand, he felt more at ease.
Even if it reacted suddenly, based on its speed and the distance, it should be difficult for it to chase them.
The two of them retreated a few steps and then hid behind a big tree.
“Big brother, are you really ready?”
“Don’t worry, I’m really fine.”
“Alright, then I’ll fire now.”
After saying that, Hei Lang aimed at the python.
He saw that the python seemed utterly unmoving, apparently puzzled by their sudden retreat.
Just then, he pressed the trigger, and suddenly, the object flew towards the python’s body.
And immediately after, the giant snake started writhing at high speed in the grass as if stained by something.
It seemed as if something had hit its body, but clearly, all they saw was the cap falling onto it, and eventually, the cap dropped to the ground.
However, it was quite possible that the blood had already contaminated its skin.
“Big brother, look, he really seems to be in pain.”
He said excitedly, pointing towards it, and of course, Lin Yi saw the scene clearly too.

chapters.title: Chapter 519: 519: Getting Rid of the Green Wilderness
chapters.content:
Chapter 519: Chapter 519: Getting Rid of the Green Wilderness
If that’s the case, then my deductions must not be too far off—that is, he must still harbor a deep-seated fear of this thing.
“Let’s go and see what the situation is.”
“Anyway, seeing how much he’s already suffering, I believe it shouldn’t pose any danger to them.”
The two of them mustered their courage and then proceeded to walk forward.
When they reached the edge, he saw that the python seemed to be gradually losing its strength; moreover, its entire body was now slowly sprawled on the ground.
Inclusive of its movement speed, which was also starting to slow down gradually.
...
“This can’t be right, just a bit of blood, and it’s this deadly?”
“That’s hard to say. And if that’s really the case, could he now be going over to that thing because of this?”
“I think we should strike while the iron is hot and apply a bit more of this stuff to him. Let’s put him out of his misery. Plus, didn’t Ling’er mention? His internal organs are of great use to us. I think…”
“Okay, let’s do that then. Come on, you continue.”
Lin Yi made up his mind and then turned around.
According to his thinking, he squeezed out some more blood from his wound.
However, due to the length of time he had been injured, it was now quite difficult to draw blood.
Finally, after much effort, he managed to collect about 5 milliliters of blood.
He then took those 5 milliliters of fresh blood and sprinkled it on the python once again.
But this time, it was clear that the snake’s twisting wasn’t as violent as before, and the blood seemed to have a lesser impact on it than before.
Its entire body had now contorted into a ball, and after waiting about 5 minutes, he saw the snake gradually stop moving.
“It can’t be dead, can it?”
“I think that’s the case. So, if so, now should be our best chance today.”
“What are you planning to do?”
“Don’t I have a weapon? I’m going to pin it to the ground and then check its condition.”
“Good, but be careful.”
“I know.”
With that said, he once again approached, first finding something long to probe its body, and discovered it didn’t budge at all.
Afterward, Hei Lang applied all his tools to it.
Throughout the process, the snake didn’t attempt to struggle at all.
It seemed their deductions were likely correct.
Finally, he seized the crucial spot and pierced straight through with a sharp sword.
Again, without the slightest movement.
After witnessing all this, Lin Yi finally breathed a sigh of relief. No matter what, they had thoroughly defeated the snake.
“Alright, Brother Lin, it’s safe now.”
He turned back and Lin Yi quickly ran forward to check and found that the snake indeed had stopped moving.
“That’s great. In that case, can we now start retrieving those things from its body?”
“That’s the idea, but don’t forget, the hunter mentioned before that we shouldn’t directly touch its skin.”
“Right, we can’t touch the skin directly, so how should we handle this? How about this, let’s call Ling’er over, the two of us can’t make up our minds on our own.”
“Okay, I understand. Brother, wait here for a bit, and I’ll quickly bring Miss Ling’er over.”
“Hey, and since it’s inconvenient for the hunter, let him stay hidden there for the time being. When we return, we’ll tell him about the situation here.”
“Got it.”
As he spoke, Hei Lang ran off toward the exit in a fluster.
Lin Yi watched carefully the entire time.
He found that apart from its very rare color, it didn’t seem too different from an ordinary python.
He could still see that the mucus was floating on its skin, but now the activity of this mucus was becoming increasingly weak.
Could it be that the python had lost its vitality and therefore the mucus had stopped flowing as well?
All of this was unfamiliar to him; only after Ling’er’s return could they really begin to analyze everything.
About 10 minutes later, he saw Ling’er, panting heavily, running over with Hei Lang.
When Ling’er arrived in front of the python, she was stunned in shock.
Ling’er never imagined that two people with no significant strength, who were ostensibly helpless against a python, could now have effortlessly killed it.
On the way over, she had already heard a rough description from Hei Lang.
The most effective thing must have been the blood flowing out of the wound earlier.
“Brother Lin, are you saying that your blood truly has a lethal effect on these animals?”
“I believe that must be the case, otherwise it wouldn’t have had such a significant outcome.”
“Now I’m beginning to understand why we’ve had a smooth journey so far. Is it because the animals didn’t dare approach us after seeing these wounds on us?”
“Hmm, if you put it that way, there indeed might be such a possibility. But no matter what, we’ve now successfully dealt with it, so what’s the next step?”
“Before, the mucus on its skin was active. At this moment, are we unable to approach it?”
“But isn’t it already dead? If it’s dead, could the toxicity also gradually diminish?”
“That’s uncertain; sometimes, this venom might linger in the air for a long time.”
“Then, what do we do about this? Didn’t you say before that some of its organs are quite rare and even considered precious Chinese medicinal materials? I think, having never seen them for so many years, now that we have the opportunity, we should take all of these things with us.”
“Yes, we must take them, don’t worry, I know how to retrieve them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 520: 520: Leave the Hunter
chapters.content:
Chapter 520: Chapter 520: Leave the Hunter
As she spoke, Ling’er took a pair of thick gloves out of her bag.
These gloves could completely isolate her skin once worn on the hands.
“You’re relying on this thing?”
“Yes, I’m relying on this. Moreover, I have the corresponding surgical knives. After making an incision in its body, I can easily retrieve those things.”
“Ling’er, you have to be very careful, okay?”
“Don’t worry, I know what to do.”
...
“Otherwise, let me do it. You direct me, tell me where to cut, what to take.”
Hei Lang was worried, too. For a girl to cut open a snake like that, it was something most girls simply couldn’t do.
“Hehe, don’t worry. I’ve done this before. You don’t need to worry about me.”
Ling’er didn’t seem afraid at all, she just smiled and then walked towards the body of the snake.
However, for safety’s sake, the snake had been secured by them, so even if it suddenly woke up, it seemed incapable of writhing its body.
Watching Ling’er expertly handle everything was really an eye-opener for Lin Yi.
“My goodness, big brother, what has Ling’er been through before? Look at the speed of her cutting, including the speed of her hands, it’s really very fast.”
“Yes, I’ve noticed that too. Before, I only knew that Ling’er studied medicinal herbs, but I didn’t expect her to be so skilled in this regard.”
“She truly is a talent. After we return, we must cultivate her well.”
“Do I even need to say it?”
The two of them were chatting away when Ling’er came over from the other side.
In her hands, she now held a bulging plastic bag wrapped object.
“These things must be kept fresh. Now, we must leave quickly. Within an hour, these must be put into a refrigerator. Only then can they be of use.”
“Alright, one hour should not be a problem. Let’s go back, no more delays.”
With those words, they quickly headed towards the exit once more.
The hunter had been hiding at this spot. After they returned and met up with the hunter, they finally left Xi Lian Mountain smoothly.
When they re-entered the small town, Lin Yi truly felt an indescribable sense of relief.
“Okay, now that we are back, no matter what, these two days are something I’ll never forget in my lifetime. I need to hurry home. Please, just drop me off at my place.”
Up to now, he was still lying on Hei Lang’s back, and they had even made a special effort to drive a car here, so their action should be much more convenient.
“Big brother, I think there’s no point in you going home now. Just come back to the inn with me. After all, I need to treat your wounds.”
“But wouldn’t it be more convenient if I went home?”
“Not really, and your wife would probably worry even more if she saw you in this state. Better to settle down in the inn, let me treat your wounds properly, and once you’ve fully recovered, then you can go home, right?”
“But that’s going to take a long time, right? They say it takes a hundred days to heal from bone and tendon injuries, I can’t possibly stay in the inn for three months.”
“Big brother, it’s not as complicated as you think. Don’t worry, it won’t take too long, I can get you back on your feet quickly. Do you trust me?”
“This…”
The hunter did hesitate for a moment.
He was eager to return home and now that they had finally arrived at their doorstep, the fact that he still couldn’t go back was hard for him to accept.
“Big brother, just listen to our big brother here. Moreover, could we possibly harm you? At the very least, you need to be healthy when you return home, so your wife and children can rest easy. Does that make sense?”
“Sigh, anyway, it’s indeed like that, they can’t help much if they go back now. Alright then, but this time, it seems I’m really imposing on you.”
“Hehe, big brother, what are you talking about? Under these circumstances, how could it be considered imposing? If it weren’t for my affairs, you wouldn’t have suffered so much injury, so I have taken charge of your case.”
“Alright, then let’s hurry back to the inn, and you arrange another room for me. Remember, this room must be in a quiet corner, alright?”
“Okay, I know, big brother. Keep going forward and we should arrive in about 10 minutes.”
“Good, then speed up.”
With that, he nodded his head, and the car sped toward the inn.
After 10 minutes, the car stopped right on time at the inn’s entrance, and Hei Lang directly carried the hunter down from the vehicle.
Then, he quickly arranged a room there and settled the hunter in.
“Big brother, rest here for a bit, I have some things to take care of, I’ll give you instructions, and then I’ll come over to treat your wounds soon, okay?”
“Okay, I understand, go ahead with your business.”
After saying goodbye to the hunter, he swiftly left the room.
“Ling’er, you’ve really been worn out these past few days. And about those things, I’ve already informed the owner, they will provide you with a refrigerator. If you need to do any research, just go back to your room and study. I won’t need you for the next two days.”
“But what about his wounds?”
“Don’t worry, I know what to do. Moreover, with Liu Yao here to assist me, I believe there shouldn’t be any big problems.”
“Alright, then I understand. If you need anything, just contact me quickly.”
After the instructions, Ling’er was reassured and nodded, then returned to her own room.
Now, only Hei Lang and Lin Yi were left.
“Big brother, are you going to see Liu Yao?”
“Yes, I’ll go see how she is. Besides, her mother’s issue hasn’t been resolved yet. Now, this is the urgent matter.”
“Are we really planning to continue staying in Xi Lian Mountain? Can’t we trust them to go back to the city and then treat them there?”

chapters.title: Chapter 521: 521 Special Exam
chapters.content:
Chapter 521: Chapter 521 Special Exam
“`
“The journey is long, and their injuries do not allow for any further tossing about, so we must continue to rest at Xi Lian Mountain for a few more days.”
“Okay, I understand.”
“Alright, Hei Lang, you’ve been busy for two days, and you were indeed exhausted from carrying the hunter over here just now. Tonight, you should have a good drink, eat more, and then relax. If anything comes up, I will come to your room to find you.”
“Alright, Brother, I’ll stay in my room and won’t go anywhere. Call on me anytime if you need.”
“Got it, I know.”
...
Having finally arranged for everyone to return to their rooms, Lin Yi felt much more relieved.
He didn’t go straight to Liu Yao’s room; Lin Yi just wanted to have a real, profound conversation with the system.
Over two days, he had noticed that the system could indeed bring many changes within his body and would sometimes reveal itself, but also hide away at times.
So, the first thing he needed to do now that he was out was to figure out what kind of changes the system was actually making within his body.
“System, are you there?”
After returning to his room, Lin Yi checked around and then locked the doors and windows again before sitting down to talk with the system.
Right after he said this, his body immediately started to beep, clearly indicating the system had responded to him.
“I’m here, Master. Speak.”
“What’s going on? Why were you sometimes appearing and sometimes not over these two days at Xi Lian Mountain?”
“Xi Lian Mountain is rich in Yin energy, and the energy is very enveloping. Moreover, at the deepest layer, there are magnetic fields present, so it is not convenient for me to appear. If I do appear, it could greatly interfere with your body.”
“You mean to say, if you appear in that environment, it would affect my body?”
“Correct. The influence would be significant and could even sever all your skills, so we only choose to appear when it’s appropriate.”
“And now? There’s no problem now, right?”
“Now, everything has returned to normal.”
“Good, then let me show you the condition of the hunter’s wounds. Although you provided me with a treatment scheme, I feel that it’s indeed a challenge for me to carry out, as I have never experienced performing surgery before.”
“This is a special test corresponding to the system. If you succeed this time, then the five bone injury patients mentioned by the system will be considered as having completed the task.”
“Correct, I’ve also calculated this number. But the key issue is that it doesn’t seem so easy to accomplish on his side. Moreover, many specialized instruments are involved, and whether we can even get these in this small town is another question.”
“The test only specifies the content; you figure out how to research and provide all the necessary equipment yourself. The goal is to complete the surgery before noon tomorrow, and the system will open up a special channel for you.”
“What special channel?”
“Wait for task completion, beep beep beep beep.”
After a few beeps, the system disappeared once again.
Lin Yi sighed helplessly, even though he now understood that it hadn’t appeared in his body at the time probably for his own good.
But now, it indeed presented him with a significant challenge.
His mind started racing rapidly, and the specifics of each professional surgical instrument were now clearly displayed in his head.
He wrote down each item one by one according to his memory.
Then, he went straight to Liu Yao’s room on the first floor.
He knocked gently on the door, heard Liu Yao respond from inside, and then hurried over.
When Liu Yao opened the door and saw Lin Yi in front of her, she was clearly taken aback.
“Boss, you, why are you here?”
“How is it, what’s your mother’s condition now?”
“These past two days, using your method, the pain has indeed been alleviated somewhat, but I feel that we can’t continue to delay this matter.”
“I know, let me check the wound first, and then stabilize it for now. We’re still stuck in this town for the next few days.”
“But if this continues, won’t it delay my mother’s condition?”
“Don’t worry, I have it under control. If it’s really unavoidable, I’ll arrange for her to leave first.”
After saying this, Liu Yao simply nodded her head.
She now truly trusted Lin Yi.
She felt that this man had his capabilities, but as to where exactly these abilities came from, that was still a mystery to Liu Yao.
In the midst of their conversation, Lin Yi had already entered the room.
“Auntie, I’m back.”
He hadn’t yet seen anyone, but his voice had already carried in.
“Oh, young man, you’re back, huh? Have you been very busy these past few days?”
By this time, Lin Yi had already reached the bedside.
He first looked down at the ankle, and as expected, there was redness, indicating inflammation had likely begun at the site.
“Auntie, I’ve been busy with other things these past two days and haven’t had the time to take care of you. Does your wound still hurt?”
“It doesn’t hurt anymore, not at all. In fact, it’s much less than the pain I used to experience before. Back then, it was sheer agony.”
“Auntie, you don’t need to be so nervous. Now that I am back, and we are conveniently in this small town, you should rest well for a couple of days, and I will take good care of your health.”
“That’s great, with your assurance, I can completely relax. But you just got back and probably have many other things to arrange, right? I’m not in a rush here. For now, I can certainly last for a few days.”
“Auntie, that won’t do. I’ve come especially for your illness. Auntie, if you don’t mind, could you take a nap now?”
“Take a nap?”
Liu’s mother was taken aback upon hearing this.
A nap? What did he mean by that?
She had just woken up, so why was she being asked to sleep again?
“Auntie, I need to treat you, so I need you to be asleep. Only then can I proceed.”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 522: 522: The Surgery Proceeds
chapters.content:
Chapter 522: Chapter 522: The Surgery Proceeds
“Oh, I see, but I’ve just woken up and I’m not the least bit sleepy,” she said.
“Don’t worry, Auntie, I’ll take a look for you. Moreover, I also know hypnotism. Do you believe me?”
“Hypnotism? Young man, you’re really something, aren’t you? Not only can you heal and save people, but now you even know hypnotism.”
“Auntie, if you don’t believe me, then I can let you give it a try. Come.”
With that, Lin Yi took off an ornament from around his neck and placed it in front of Liu Yao’s mother.
The trinket just swayed in the air.
...
“Auntie, my thing will keep swinging. Then, focus your mind on it, just watch it, and think of nothing else. Then, you will fall asleep very quickly, alright?”
“Hehe, interesting, this is really interesting. Alright, today I will see what real hypnotism is all about.”
Liu Yao’s mother was quite cooperative, and deep in her heart, she truly didn’t believe what Lin Yi was saying.
In fact, how could Lin Yi know anything about hypnotism? He was definitely going to use some other method to make her sleep temporarily.
He didn’t want anyone to know he had such an ability.
“1, 2, 3.”
He began to count slowly, and at that moment, he extended his hand and placed it on Liu Yao’s mother’s wrist.
Lin Yi simply located a few key acupoints and then lightly pressed down on them.
When he counted to 8, he saw that Liu Yao’s mother had already fallen into a deep sleep.
Seeing all this, Lin Yi finally breathed a sigh of relief. It seems the instructions given to him by the system were without any problems.
“Okay, your mother is now asleep. Go and bring over all the tools you carry with you.”
“What are you going to do?”
Liu Yao had watched the whole process very clearly and, in her eyes, this was not any kind of hypnotism at all.
Because Liu Yao had clearly seen his finger movements.
At that time, he must have induced a temporary coma in her mother through several acupoints.
“Nothing much, of course, I’m going to treat her wound. It has metastasized and relapsed, so we must solve this problem.”
“But if this malignant cycle continues, in the end, it can’t solve the fundamental issue.”
“Yes, I know all that. So I must control the growth rate of these tumors in her body.”
“Do you have a way?”
“A way, as of now, I haven’t figured it out yet. But don’t worry, I will think of something very soon. I already have a general target in mind, but talking about it is meaningless. The most important thing right now is to alleviate her current pain.”
“Before, I followed your method and drained some of the fluid from inside, and just as you said, it was all yellow viscous liquid.”
“That’s the build-up of fluid inside. If a large amount of fluid accumulates, it can greatly suppress and paralyze the vascular and nervous systems, thus causing a painful effect in the human body.”
As he spoke, he skillfully took the scalpel in his hand.
However, he suddenly paused, feeling that his brain was completely blank.
Just a moment ago, a clear picture had formed in his mind.
He just needed to make an incision here and then insert his scalpel to directly remove the recurrent tumor from its root.
Under normal circumstances, this would be considered major surgery even in a hospital.
But under such conditions, to complete it perfectly was indeed a major challenge for Lin Yi.
“Are you sure you’re going to operate on my mother?”
“If I wasn’t sure, do you think you could do it?”
“But by doing this, could you harm her other organs, and in such an environment?”
After all, Liu Yao was a professional nurse, so she understood a lot about this field, and she could definitely keep up with Lin Yi’s basic theoretical knowledge.
“Don’t worry, I know what to do. Also, there’s one more thing I need your help with. Before we start, you must disinfect and sterilize the area. I see it’s already inflamed, so make sure you disinfect thoroughly during the procedure.”
“That shouldn’t be a problem. Moreover, doing such things is second nature to me. The main thing is the cutting later on.”
“Don’t worry, I’m very clear about what to do, so you should step back for now.”
As he spoke, Lin Yi motioned for Liu Yao to step back two steps.
Liu Yao, though she had her doubts and maybe could believe what he said before, now faced the question of whether he could really perform such a major tumor removal surgery by himself?
Liu Yao disinfected the area over and over with the medications and some instruments she carried with her.
“Alright, my work here is done.”
“Then stand back.”
“What? You’re doing this directly? I didn’t even bring a hemostat.”
“Hehe, hemostats are something that Western medicine uses. They have no significance for me.”
“So what will you do?”
“I have a few clamps like this that should do the trick.”
With that, he took out some clamps from among the surgical instruments.
Liu Yao was familiar with all this, and typically such clamps are used during surgery for pain management.
But to her, using them for hemostasis was truly unprecedented.
Yet, she didn’t dare say more, because seeing Lin Yi’s confidence, she felt she could take a gamble.
After all, Lin Yi had indeed alleviated a lot of her mother’s pain before, and if not for him, even the hospital might not have been able to resolve it.
At this moment, the picture reappeared clearly in Lin Yi’s mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 523: 523: Removing the Tumor
chapters.content:
Chapter 523: Chapter 523: Removing the Tumor
He knew that, before all the preparatory work was completed, that image should appear and disappear intermittently, not so clearly etched in his mind.
Now, with all the disinfection work done, he already had the necessary conditions for the surgery, so there shouldn’t be much problem with making an incision at this time.
He began to operate skillfully, and as soon as he made the first cut, blood swarmed out.
For Lin Yi, this wasn’t so frightening. He simply took out a few clamps and then called out a few positions, pressing down directly on them.
It was truly miraculous, and Liu Yao, standing beside him, widened her eyes.
The few simple clamps, when operated in his hands, were so deft.
...
Next, Liu Yao miraculously saw the blood from the wounds gradually stop flowing.
Finally, he used the alcohol beside him to easily clean off all the blood on the wounds.
Then, he continued to peel back layer by layer.
