When the tumor inside was clearly revealed, Lin Yi finally let out a sigh of relief.
Although the growth wasn’t very large, about the size of a peanut in the hand,
even so, it was a malignant tumor, and if it were to spread, it could be life-threatening.
He uprooted the thing from the opposite side.
When taking it out, he took a special look, and then threw it directly into the surgical tray beside him.
“Okay, I’ve finished my work on this side now. Next, the suturing work, I believe, shouldn’t be a problem for you.”
“Good, I understand.”
Although Liu Yao was filled with doubts, under the current circumstances, she couldn’t inquire too much.
So, she stepped forward to take over the task and began suturing proficiently.
The whole process took only about 10 minutes.
After everything was done, he used a piece of gauze to wrap the area completely.
“Okay, I’m done over here.”
Turning around, he saw Lin Yi observing the tiny tumor closely.
“What’s the issue with this one?”
“This thing, as long as it can survive in the human body, should contain a substance that allows it to persist, if we could find this breakthrough, maybe we could control the tumor.”
“You mean to say, you want to analyze it based on its own cellular characteristics? Let me tell you, such things have been tried in chemical labs before, but the chance of success is nearly zero.”
“Heh, that was them, and besides, our approach is definitely different. You teach me to do this, now find a specimen container to seal it up, and I will find a way to research it when I go back.”
“Research? How? In this environment?”
She was puzzled, and the task seemed to akin to the histological examination routinely performed in hospitals.
Only Liu Yao didn’t understand, with no equipment at all in this place, how could all this be accomplished?
“This, you don’t need to worry about. Leave the rest to me.”
Seeing Lin Yi so confident, she didn’t argue, but simply took out a specimen bag from her own surgical kit and then packed the dissected material into it.
“Okay, there should be no problem with this. I will use ice to temporarily preserve it. Tonight, I need to give it some serious thought.”
“You mean, by studying this, you think you can find a way to tackle the cancer cells in my mother’s body?”
“Eradicating it completely is not likely, I can only say I will try to slow it down, even prevent it from progressing, and maximize the longevity of a cancerous existence.”
“Living with cancer, I’m telling you, this topic was brought up many years ago, and it is completely related to a person’s unique constitution. Sometimes, a person’s constitution can adapt to it all, but sometimes it just can’t.”
“This, naturally, you don’t have to tell me, I know what to do.”
“Good, then I understand. What do I need to do next?”
“Nothing for now, wait until your mother wakes up, which should be tonight. By then, all her pain should completely vanish, just let her continue taking the medication as before. I’ll give you a response as soon as possible in the next few days.”
“Okay, I understand.”
With a light nod, Liu Yao felt the stone hanging in her heart seemed to suddenly drop in that moment.
She didn’t understand why this man had such great ability.
In the hospital, a surgery that required an hour of preparation and process was completed by him in 20 minutes.
And that too, in such challenging conditions.
She was worried that this wouldn’t lead to infection of the wound?
If an infection occurred, it would be quite troublesome – something Liu Yao had experienced before at the hospital.
“Alright, we’ve finished here. Plus, I have something else to do, and look at this.”
As he spoke, Lin Yi took a list he had written from his pocket, laid it out, and then placed it in front of Liu Yao.
Liu Yao reached out to take it, glanced over it quickly, and understood everything listed. These were common medical instruments used in surgery.
“Has someone been hurt? Is it a bone fracture?”
“Heh, smart, seems like you’re a true professional nurse. That’s right. Let me ask you, aren’t these items needed for surgery?”
“Indeed, they are all professional surgical instruments used for fixing broken bones, not something usually found on the market, as there’s a professional procurement process for them.”
“If it were you, could you help me secure these items?”

chapters.title: Chapter 524: 524 Equipment Arranged Properly
chapters.content:
Chapter 524: Chapter 524 Equipment Arranged Properly
“If I really manage to get them, it might not be very hard, but given the current situation, if I go back now, wouldn’t it be a bit inconvenient?”
Liu Yao looked back and saw her mother lying in the hospital bed.
Her mother had just finished surgery and was at risk of developing complications afterward, so leaving her now was indeed impossible.
“No need, you just tell me if there’s a way to find all these items.”
“That, there’s no problem with. After all, I’ve been working in the hospital for so many years and I’ve had contact with the suppliers who provided these instruments before, so getting them should not be too difficult.”
“Good, then just follow the list and get 10 sets of each item, right?”
...
“What, what did you say? Get 10 sets? Why do you need so many of these? What exactly are you planning to do with them?”
Liu Yao felt surprised upon hearing this.
In her opinion, these items were only used during surgeries and for people with severe bone injuries.
But now she noticed that everyone here was unharmed. Could it be that he had other plans?
Besides, if he really ordered all these items, it would undoubtedly be a significant expense.
“You don’t need to worry about that. These are things we’ll need to have on hand in the future. By the way, you must be familiar with how to use each instrument, right?”
“Basically, yes. After all, I worked in orthopedics for two years and have experienced surgeries of all sizes, around a hundred in total.”
“Good, with you by my side, I can rest easy. Hurry and gather these items for me as soon as possible. Once you’ve contacted the supplier, tell me how much it’ll cost, and I’ll transfer the money to your account. Also, the professional surgical tools you brought with you seem somewhat incomplete. Make sure to replenish them, since, as a nurse, you should get what you need as soon as possible.”
“Are you asking me to prepare a procurement list?”
“Yes, draw up the procurement list for me as quickly as possible. Will one hour be enough?”
“Heh, I don’t need an hour, half an hour will be sufficient.”
“Alright, half an hour it is. I’ll wait for you here. Just write it down and get back to me quickly.”
“Okay, just give me a moment.”
After finishing the conversation, Liu Yao nodded and then quickly went to the desk, took a piece of paper and a pen, and started listing everything earnestly.
After all, these were specialized items. If Lin Yi were to do it, perhaps he wouldn’t have been able to handle it.
He could miss some small but important details.
While he was writing, Lin Yi paced back and forth in the room.
He was thinking about the right person for the job.
Now, it was definitely impossible for Liu Yao to leave.
After all, there was another major surgery to prepare for, so only with Liu Yao around could he truly be helped.
Furthermore, her mother’s injuries had not yet completely stabilized. Though Lin Yi was sure it wasn’t a problem, considering Liu Yao’s state at the time, she probably still had some distrust toward him.
So, asking her to leave now was out of the question.
But then, who should take on this task? Could it require Zhou Kongshan himself to make a trip?
Zhou Gongshan had many factory-related matters to arrange.
It was at that moment Lin Yi thought of someone—Wang Sheng.
He had always been a playboy, and more than once had expressed a determination to stand firmly with him.
Lin Yi figured that sending Wang Sheng to deliver the items shouldn’t be too difficult.
“Done, I’ve finished.”
Suddenly, he heard Liu Yao speak and he quickly went over to take a look.
Her paper was densely filled with many listed items.
“All these items, how much will they cost altogether?”
“If we opt for high-quality, it should be around 200,000 yuan.”
“Alright, I’ll give you 300,000 yuan. Handle this as quickly as possible and see when we can get the delivery, preferably tonight. I can accept any price.”
“Tonight? Alright, I’ll see if I can ask the supplier to expedite the delivery.”
As she spoke, Liu Yao walked over and took out her mobile phone, dialing a number.
Being in the hospital industry and having dealt with them before, as well as placing an order now obviously interested the suppliers.
“Alright, I’ve contacted them. At 6 p.m. tonight, we can exchange the goods on time.”
“Good, that’s all I need to know. As for the rest, I don’t need you to handle it. Just send me his contact information.”
“Fine, I’ll send it to your phone in a moment.”
“Tonight, make sure to look after your mother, and if there’s any issue, come find me on the second floor. I’ll be in my room for the evening.”
“Okay, I got it.”
After speaking, he nodded his head and then left the room directly.
Back in his own room, Lin Yi immediately dialed Wang Sheng’s number.
At the moment, Wang Sheng was still at the factory.
For the past two days, he had been pondering where Lin Yi had gone and why there was no word from him.
Wang Sheng had even tried to find an excuse to inquire with Zhou Kongshan about Lin Yi’s whereabouts but soon realized that Zhou Kongshan was tight-lipped and would not reveal much.
He was somewhat frustrated as he couldn’t proceed with his own matters.
Just then, Wang Sheng’s phone suddenly rang. He glanced down and saw it was a call from Lin Yi.
Wang Sheng immediately felt excited.
Being contacted by Lin Yi at this moment must mean there was something important entrusted to him.
This was also an excellent opportunity to get closer to Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 525: 525 Direct Docking
chapters.content:
Chapter 525: Chapter 525 Direct Docking
“Brother Lin, where have you been? These past two days, I haven’t seen you at the factory at all.”
“Oh, I’ve been out and about; got some things to take care of. Also, there’s something I need you to do for me, you must make a trip tonight.”
“Sure, no problem, Brother Lin. Just tell me, what do I need to do?”
“I’ll send a phone number to your mobile in a bit. At 6 PM tonight, meet up with them at a designated place, you need to pick up a shipment. Then, take this shipment to a town as fast as you can. Wait, I’ll send the location to you shortly.”
“Oh, a shipment, is it? Alright, I got it. Send it to me now and I’ll contact them right away.”
“Good, I’ll do that. Remember, this shipment is really important to me. It has to be delivered to me before midnight tonight, got it?”
...
“Don’t worry, Brother Lin. Even if it means going without food, drink, or sleep, I won’t delay your business.”
“Alright, that’s settled then.”
Lin Yi immediately hung up the phone, and soon after, he received a message on his mobile.
He glanced at it; it was a phone number, and what’s more, the address was for a medical equipment company.
Medical equipment, now that was strange to him.
What on earth was he doing so secretively? And, he had him pick up a shipment—could it be that this shipment was the so-called medical equipment?
For safety’s sake, he still decided to confirm with them over the phone.
He got a general idea of what they intended to purchase and what it all entailed.
It was all stuff used in surgeries.
Doubts began to form in his mind. He couldn’t fathom what Lin Yi was up to this time, what he was “selling” inside his gourd.
Grabbing the phone, he dialed Han Xuemei’s number immediately.
At this moment, Han Xuemei was still in the villa, waiting for the news from here.
These past two days, things on that front had been moving along rather smoothly, and Zhao Guangchen’s face had essentially healed completely.
In two more days, after another observation period, if no issues arose, Zhao Guangchen would officially present his new face to the world.
“Hello, Wang Sheng.”
Han Xuemei, seeing Wang Sheng’s call, guessed that he probably wanted to see her tonight; after all, he had been busy with the factory these two days.
“Do you know if Lin Yi had any connections with hospitals before?”
“Connections with hospitals? What kind of relationship with hospitals could he have? Wasn’t he previously dealing with medicinal materials? But as far as I know, he never supplied to hospitals. There were hospitals that tried to do business with him, but he turned them all down.”
“To your knowledge, does he, or anyone around him, know how to perform surgery?”
“Perform surgery? How could that be possible? I’ve never heard of him having such a skill; he most likely doesn’t. What’s going on?”
“He called me to deliver a batch of medical equipment before midnight tonight. I had a look, and it all seems to be stuff needed for surgery.”
“That, I’m not sure about. By the way, where are you supposed to deliver it to?”
“A small town. He’s already sent me the location.”
“Oh, so what are you planning to do?”
“Of course, I’ll hurry to deliver it as he instructed. Also, I was thinking about checking over there tonight, but it looks like I won’t be able to make it now. You go ahead and meet with Zhao Guangchen as soon as possible. Check on his recovery and if everything looks good, tell him to prepare and get accustomed to his new identity quickly.”
“Okay, I got it. I’ll take care of it. When are you planning to be back?”
“Once I’ve delivered these items, I don’t think he’ll keep me long. I believe I should be able to get back by dawn tomorrow.”
“Then be careful. If it’s not possible, just stay over there for the night. There aren’t any projects at the factory at night, so you can stay there. And the next morning, it won’t be late to come over.”
“That’s…”
“And tonight, you might get a chance to get close to him and pry some information out of him.”
“Hmm, when you put it that way, it actually makes sense. Alright, I know what to do now. You be careful too.”
“Don’t worry, I know what to do.”
After finishing the call, Han Xuemei hung up the phone.
She let out a long sigh of relief. During this period, she felt as if she were imprisoned, constantly monitored by him.
The time she had spent with Zhao Guangchen before, though brief, and despite being betrayed by that man behind her back, she indeed enjoyed the process.
She truly didn’t dare to contemplate what could happen if she continued her involvement with this man. This uncertainty really frightened her.
Fortunately, due to the intense activity of the past few days, and his constant focus on the factory, she finally had a chance to contact Zhao Guangchen.
So, Han Xuemei picked up the phone, dialed the number, and called right away.
“Hello, I’ll come over tonight directly.”
“What? You’re coming over tonight? I thought he was coming tonight.”
“He had an urgent matter and probably can’t make it, so I’ll come to discuss with you. By the way, how’s your recovery been the last two days?”
“Not bad, but sometimes, when the sunlight is too strong during the day, I still feel a burning sensation on my skin. Don’t know what it’s about.”
“Have you told the others about it?”
“I mentioned it to them, and they said they’d change my medication tomorrow and let me test it again in the sunlight.”
“Alright, let’s talk more when I get there.”
“Sure, I’ll wait for you tonight.”
After the conversation ended, the person on the other end hung up.
Having made the arrangements, Wang Sheng informed the construction site and hurried off towards the shipment meeting point.
Even though he knew it was quite early to be going, he couldn’t shake the feeling that being proactive might make it easier to argue his case.
After returning to his room, Lin Yi stored the removed item directly in the cold storage.

chapters.title: Chapter 526: Reporting Safety
chapters.content:
Chapter 526: Chapter 526: Reporting Safety
He was now a mess of thoughts, but deep down, something was guiding him, making him feel that it was very necessary to keep hold of this thing.
It was just that his current abilities didn’t yet allow him to do it all.
However, since he had already promised Liu Yao to take on all these responsibilities, he was determined to fulfill his promise.
After finishing those tasks, he simply waited patiently because it seemed like there was really nothing left to do.
Everything that needed to be arranged had been taken care of, and at this time, he thought of Han Xuewei.
He hadn’t taken the initiative to contact Han Xuewei these past days, but now he finally had time to check on her situation.
...
Lin Yi picked up the phone and dialed Han Xuewei’s number directly.
The call connected after just a few rings.
In fact, Han Xuewei had been waiting for Lin Yi’s message these past days, and if Lin Yi didn’t call her, she didn’t dare to disturb him on her own initiative.
“Hello, Lin Yi, where are you now?”
“Don’t be so anxious. I’m still in that town.”
“Have you finished your work?”
“The earlier tasks are all done, and I’ve successfully returned to the town. So, I’m calling you to let you know that I’m safe and sound. No problems here. By the way, how’s the child?”
“The kids are with our parents. I was actually thinking of bringing them back, but our dad wanted to take them to the amusement park, so I’ve left them there for now.”
“Hehe, isn’t it true that dad is now putting all his focus into this?”
“Yes, I can see that. The old man is probably truly enjoying being with his grandchildren, so he keeps refusing to let me pick them up.”
“What, is he really considering letting go of all his company’s responsibilities?”
“I don’t know, but it seems like that’s what he wants to do.”
“Ah, that’s not good. Now is a critical period for the company’s development, and after our dad has invested so many years of effort into it, I don’t want to see all his hard work go to waste.”
“Then, I guess you’ll have to have a proper talk with him when you get back.”
“Yeah, that’s what I was thinking. By the way, how’s your academic work going?”
“Don’t worry, no problems at all. By the middle of this month, I can take my final exams. Once they’re over, I won’t have to study anymore.”
“Good, I’m glad to hear you’ve managed to finish everything smoothly.”
“Right, everything is going okay on your end?”
“Rest assured, the progress here is rather smooth. By the way, has Han Xuemei contacted you these past days?”
For some reason, Lin Yi always felt that although Han Xuemei had seemingly given up in attitude, he was still worried she might cause some sort of trouble elsewhere.
And with him being out of the city these past days, if she did stir up any trouble now, it would be quite difficult to resolve.
“Don’t worry, she hasn’t reached out to us, and I don’t know where she has gone, so I haven’t contacted her either. Is there a problem?”
“No, it’s not that. I just wanted to see what her current situation is like.”
“Don’t worry. Seeing how sincerely she admitted everything last time, I think she probably won’t be plotting anything else.”
“We may not harbor malicious intentions, but we must always be vigilant. Do you understand?”
“Okay, okay, I get it. Anyway, when are you coming back?”
“Well, I’ll probably need another three or four days.”
“What? Why so long?”
“Yes, there’s still some work to wrap up here, and I’m rarely relaxed. It’s not often I get to unwind, so once I’m back, I’ll be buried in work again. So, I don’t want to miss this chance.”
This was also an excuse Lin Yi gave, and he always felt that coming up with such a reason would make it somewhat more acceptable for Han Xuewei.
“That makes sense. Given how constantly busy your work has been, relaxing for a bit is indeed a good suggestion. Alright then, I won’t bother you any longer. Knowing you’re safe and sound, I can finally rest easy here.”
“Alright, then I’ll fill you in with the details when I get back. Also, once dad takes the kids to the amusement park, seize the chance to bring them back. And I’ve noticed that if he really is looking after the kids all the time, he’s definitely going to let go of the company.”
“The problem is, they don’t listen when I say that.”
“Do your best for now. When I get back, I’ll deal with it.”
“Okay, then please be careful and we’ll stay in touch if anything arises.”
After this exchange with Han Xuemei, Lin Yi felt much lighter. At least under these circumstances, he no longer had to bear any psychological burdens.
He took a deep breath and checked the time; it was just past 4:00 PM.
If he went by the normal schedule, he would receive the goods by 6 PM, and around 10 PM, Wang Sheng should be able to arrive at the town on time.
It seemed that another sleepless night loomed ahead for him.
He stretched leisurely. Having been in the town for several days, he realized he hadn’t really taken the time to explore.
Previously, Ling’er and Hei Lang mentioned to him that the town’s nightscape was stunning, with all the lights illuminating at night, creating a bustling scene.
It appeared he could take this opportunity tonight to enjoy a good stroll.
He didn’t want to bring Hei Lang along; after working continuously for several days, Hei Lang too deserved a good rest in the room.
After coming out of the room, he glanced around, only to see Ling’er standing in the corridor as if lost in thought.
“Ling’er, didn’t I tell you to rest in the room? Why have you come out again?”

chapters.title: Chapter 527 - 527 Liu's mother test subject?
chapters.content:
Chapter 527: Chapter 527 Liu’s mother test subject?
“Hehe, it’s nothing. Just thinking about those things gives me a headache.”
“Headache? What’s wrong? Didn’t we get everything back?”
“Yes, the feces I told you about before.”
“Oh, I remember. Didn’t you say that it needed some refinement after getting back? What’s the matter, have you encountered difficulties in the refining process?”
“I found out that there is a problem with some of the components. So I must go back and get some specialized equipment to conduct the experiments. Right now, there really is no other way.”
“Oh, I see. Can you afford to delay a few more days? Otherwise, you can leave first, and I’ll arrange for a car to take you directly.”
...
“No need. These items can be stored indefinitely. So I’ve already safely stored them. You don’t have to worry about that.”
“That’s good. By the way, do you have something on your mind, or did you just want to come out for some fresh air?”
“Nothing much, just feeling a little suffocated in the room.”
“I was thinking of taking a walk around the town. What do you think, are you interested?”
“Hehe, Brother Lin, you should go by yourself. My mind is a mess right now, and I’m pondering over a lot of things. After going back, I’ll have a whole pile of troublesome matters waiting for me.”
“How about I come into your room and we chat for a bit? Are you interested?”
“Chat with me? Sure, what would you like to talk about?”
“It’s not very convenient to talk here. Shall we go into the room to chat?”
Actually, at this moment, Lin Yi was struck by a sudden idea.
After all, Ling’er had always been dedicated to the research of these drugs. If that was the case, he felt that he should really sit down with Ling’er to discuss Liu Yao’s mother’s medical condition.
Regarding the treatment, he was definitely capable, but when it came to the use of medication and the understanding of pharmacodynamics and pharmacokinetics, no one could surpass Ling’er.
He followed Ling’er into her room, and she then poured a cup of tea for him, placing it in front of him.
“Brother Lin, what is it you wanted to talk about? Go ahead.”
“About Liu Yao’s mother’s illness, do you have any understanding from before?”
“Oh, that. I do know a bit about it. Is there something wrong?”
“What do you think about her condition?”
“What else is there to think? It’s cancer. So far, it remains an insurmountable issue in medicine.”
“And what do you think is the cause of this issue?”
“It’s quite obvious. These cancer cells are simply normal cells of the body that, after experiencing certain environmental changes, mutate and thus become malignant.”
“Yes, so why can’t we target these malignant cells and then take some treatment measures against them?”
“That’s not so simple because these cells are closely related to other cells. When we eliminate these cells, other cells are also affected. Ultimately, the cure can be worse than the disease.”
“But as far as I know, there seems to be an option of targeted therapy in this world.”
“Yes, this targeted drug was also developed by them later, aimed at certain mutations in cancer cells, for instance, some prominent changes. If they’re pronounced enough, we can use this type of targeted medication to directly eradicate these cancer cells. And so far, the results are actually quite good,” Lin Yi said.
“Then why can’t we continue in this direction to look for solutions? Maybe we could overcome this problem,” Brother Lin replied.
“It’s not that simple,” Lin Yi said. “Besides, some cell mutations occur due to specific environments and special reasons. It’s not like every cancer patient can easily do all of this. It requires some genetic testing and certain conditions to be fully compatible.”
“Have you done any research in this area?” Brother Lin asked.
“I did study it before, using some expensive traditional Chinese medicinal herbs to simulate their living environment and see if it was possible to achieve a restraining effect,” Lin Yi replied.
“And now? Have there been any results?” Brother Lin inquired.
“As of now, the results are negligible. Besides, if I really want to do it, I must find a suitable donor and then cultivate that environment within their body,” Lin Yi explained.
“Cultivate an environment?” Brother Lin questioned.
“Exactly. My idea is to create a specific environment and then induce some kind of mutation in these cells. With that, we could use the corresponding herbal materials and then kill them off one by one,” Lin Yi elaborated.
“Isn’t that just the methods of Western medicine you’re talking about? Using those targeted medications?” Brother Lin challenged.
“No, no, no, what I intend to use is definitely not the targeted drugs of Western medicine. Although Western targeted drugs do have specific targets for eradication, the main issue is that when they enter the human body, they still affect normal cells to a certain extent,” Lin Yi clarified.
“So you’re talking about using purely traditional Chinese medicine methods to directly treat the pathology?” Brother Lin speculated.
“That’s the idea. But the problem now is that I can’t find an appropriate subject for the experiment, so my ideas can’t be realized,” Lin Yi said with a sense of frustration.
“What do you think about Liu Yao’s mother’s condition? Is she suitable for your experiment?” Brother Lin inquired.
“What are you saying? To conduct experiments on her mother? That’s absolutely out of the question. Besides, this lab is all unknown territory,” Lin Yi protested.
“No, it’s unknown because it was under your control before. But if it were up to me, maybe things wouldn’t be the same,” Brother Lin suggested confidently.
Ling’er listened to this conversation, thoroughly confused.
However, the trip to Xi Lian Mountain really gave her a whole new perspective on Lin Yi.
She gradually realized that Lin Yi must be hiding many skills.
And he probably wouldn’t show these abilities until the very end.
But the conversation today couldn’t be without basis.
She knew that Lin Yi was someone who deeply valued life; he would never use someone so lightly for an experiment.
Unless he was absolutely certain in his heart.,
“Brother Lin, what exactly do you mean? Can you be clear?” Ling’er asked.
“To tell the truth, I have researched this kind of project before, and actually, my thoughts are quite similar to yours,” Brother Lin confessed.
“Brother Lin, are you saying that you also thought about killing the cells this way?” Ling’er inquired.
“What I had in mind wasn’t to kill them with medication, but to use a specific environment to cultivate these cells. Since they can devour normal cells, then by following the rule of nature where the big eats the small, don’t you think this should maintain balance?” Brother Lin speculated.

chapters.title: Chapter 528: The Best Collaboration Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 528: Chapter 528: The Best Collaboration Plan
“So what you’re saying is that you can cultivate other cells within the body, and then, these cells could eat up all the cancerous cells?”
“Yes, that’s exactly what I mean.”
“If that’s the case, what about these cells? How are you going to deal with them? Won’t they similarly pose a threat to the body?”
“These cells will have to be suppressed with medication. So, I’ve been researching which drug could both nourish and also destroy them?”
“Using traditional Chinese medicine ingredients to cultivate such cells, then destroying them with the same, is that what you mean?”
“Right, that’s what I’m trying to say, but because my knowledge is limited, including some pharmacological aspects. I don’t know much, so this idea has always remained in my head, never truly taking form.”
...
“Brother Lin, if that’s what you’re saying, it seems like I’m starting to remember some things. If that’s the case, I think we might have a direction for our research.”
Ling’er suddenly became excited.
After all, a problem that had stumped them for years seemed to have made some progress at this moment.
“Heh, is that so? Then in that case, do you think we could formally collaborate?”
“Absolutely, that’s definitely possible. You can teach me about the medication, but when it comes to application on the human body, I’m afraid I couldn’t do it alone.”
“Rest assured, I know how to proceed, and I’m also quite familiar with some of the body’s structure. We will avoid critical tissues. If we really can’t control these cells, they shouldn’t cause too much damage to the body; at the very least, everything must be within a controllable range.”
“Good, if that’s what you’re saying, then our task should become much simpler.”
“Right, that’s the message. So, our conversation today is no pie in the sky. Once we get back, we’ll have to start working on this.”
“But do you know? If we really are going to research this, we will need a strict laboratory, and only in such an environment can we carry out these experiments.”
“Don’t worry, do you know why I had those buildings constructed at the toy factory?”
“Several buildings? Oh, I see, you did build several buildings. Are you planning to use them as labs?”
“Yes, that’s the idea. In the future, all our research directions and locations will be in that laboratory. I’ll construct the most luxurious and best-equipped facility in the world there. Of course, our research will continuously support the study of traditional Chinese medicine.”
“Good, the field of traditional Chinese medicine is indeed profound. Even our ancestors haven’t fully understood it all, so there’s a lot for us to gradually research.”
“Alright, in that case, prepare the relevant materials. If we really need any special equipment, make sure to tell me in advance. Once we go back, we’ll start working on it immediately.”
“Okay, Brother Lin, I got it. I’ll draft a detailed plan tonight, and once you review it, if there aren’t any problems, we’ll proceed according to the plan.”
“Ling’er, that’s impressive. I didn’t expect such versatility. You can even produce a plan.”
“Brother Lin, don’t make fun of me. I can manage this much, but I’m afraid I’m not as knowledgeable as you are in other areas.”
“No need to be so modest. We each have our strengths. Also, do you know why I’ve kept Liu Yao close by?”
“I know. I’ve noticed Liu Yao’s importance as well, including some basic suturing skills and surgical techniques, which neither of us can perform.”
“Yes, only Liu Yao is capable of that. So we each take what we need, get it?”
“I understand. Don’t worry, I’ll take this seriously.”
“That’s settled, then. After sharing all this with you, I feel like I have a direction now. I’ll head to the town to look around some more and return as soon as possible to arrange tomorrow’s tasks.”
“Alright, Brother Lin. I’ll get the plan ready tonight. By the way, when do you plan to treat Hei Lang?”
“His case is complicated, and tonight I’m expecting a shipment of surgical equipment. It’s not that I’m planning to operate on him—only then can I help him recover.”
“What? Another surgery, Brother Lin, are you sure? If you’re actually going to operate, that could be a major undertaking.”
“Don’t worry. I know what I need to do, and there’s no need for you to worry about that aspect.”
“Okay, Brother Lin. With your word, I understand.”
“Well then, go rest in your room. Don’t stay up too late. It’s okay, you can take a few more nights for the plan. After all, the factory isn’t fully built yet, so we still have time.”
“It’s best to strike while the iron is hot. And right now, I already have a rough plan in mind.”
“Good.”
After finishing the conversation, he simply nodded and then quickly left the room.
For some reason, stepping out from there, Lin Yi suddenly felt an epiphany.
If they were to follow their plan, their path ahead should become a bit smoother.
When he came out of the room, the sky had already started to grow dark.
He walked the town, admiring some of the streetlights and the beautiful scenery in the distance.
There were people coming and going, but Lin Yi’s heart wasn’t really there.
It was as if these external things completely overshadowed his inner thoughts.
He aimlessly wandered back and forth.
The town itself wasn’t big, and after walking for about an hour, he could cover the whole place.
When he returned to the inn, it was just 8 p.m.
He went to Hei Lang’s room, but as he stood outside the door, he could smell a strong scent of alcohol coming from within.
This guy must really be drinking.
He shook his head helplessly, though it was probably time to let Hei Lang relax a bit, considering there were many tasks ahead for him.
Passing by Ling’er’s room, he glanced in and saw a vague silhouette sitting in front of the desk, seemingly writing something.

chapters.title: Chapter 529: Private Conversation upon Meeting
chapters.content:
Chapter 529: Chapter 529: Private Conversation upon Meeting
When Lin Yi witnessed this scene, he felt an inexplicable pain in his heart.
In the past, when Ling’er had been at the pharmaceutical factory, Lin Yi didn’t interact with her much.
But still, he had heard from Zhou Kongshan how Ling’er was a very diligent and dedicated person.
This trip to Xi Lian Mountain, coupled with Ling’er’s behavior over these past few days, truly revealed her shining attributes.
Such an excellent talent, Lin Yi had to cultivate her; otherwise, it would be a great loss for his future endeavors.
He really wanted to knock on the door and remind Ling’er to rest early.
...
But he knew that at this moment, Ling’er probably couldn’t afford to give up.
Sometimes, it is like that with people; sudden inspiration strikes, and if not pursued, it may quickly vanish.
Lin Yi could only shake his head helplessly and then returned to his own room.
Han Xuemei arrived punctually at the secret research base at 7:00 p.m.
She first greeted the two people, after all, she had been here more than once before, so she could move about without any hindrance.
“Where is everyone? Inside?”
“Oh, yes, inside. They’ve just finished eating and are now resting.”
“Alright, I know. Oh, Wang Sheng told me to come over and relay some information to him.”
“Okay, then you go ahead.”
After saying this, she nodded and walked directly to the inner room.
Pushing open the door, the room was still as damp and dark as before.
He really couldn’t understand why they had put it in such an environment?
Perhaps for safety reasons, or perhaps for other reasons.
“You’ve come?”
The moment Zhao Guangchen saw Han Xuemei, he hastily stood up from his seat.
It seemed he had just eaten a bowl of noodles and was now digesting them here.
He knew it wouldn’t take long. Judging by Han Xue’s personality, she surely would have arrived quickly.
“I just asked, you’ve just had your meal, right?”
“Yes, I’ve just eaten, and I’ve just cleared away the bowls and chopsticks.”
“How have you been feeling these past couple of days?”
“Heh, how could it be? It’s just that, living like a subhuman in this place. But what can I do? I must grit my teeth and persevere.”
“I know it’s hard on you, but you should be able to see the light of day soon, and your current appearance?”
At that point, Han Xuemei just frowned slightly.
At this moment, his appearance had completely changed to that of another person.
There was not a trace of the previous Zhao Guangchen left on him.
Although there were still some minor flaws in some areas, overall, the transformation could be considered quite perfect.
“Don’t mention it, sometimes when I look in the mirror, I even scare myself. This wasn’t what I used to look like, now it’s like looking at a stranger.”
“It’s okay, once you get used to it after a while, it might get better.”
“Yes, I’m also trying to adapt myself to this every day. So, the first thing I do every morning when I get up is look at myself in the mirror for half an hour, trying to immerse myself into this new role.”
“Don’t worry, everything will turn out well.”
“By the way, why did Wang Sheng suddenly stop coming? Didn’t he say he had important matters to instruct me on today?”
“Yes, he was initially supposed to come, but he got a call this afternoon.”
“What call was so important? Was it his old man calling?”
Over the past few days, through conversations with Han Xuemei and the other two people outside, Zhao Guangchen had learned a bit about Wang Sheng’s family background.
So, when he learned all this, he gradually stopped resisting,
Since he was completely isolated now, if he could rely on Wang Sheng, perhaps, he really could open a new path for himself.
“It wasn’t his old man. It was Lin Yi who called.”
“What? Lin Yi? Where is he now?”
“Oh, I haven’t had a chance to tell you yet, but Lin Yi has been away on a business trip these past few days, so he suddenly needed Wang Sheng to rush a shipment, though I’m not clear about the details.”
“So, he’s out of town? And he’s having Wang Sheng deliver for him, deliver what? Is it so urgent that it needs to be sent overnight?”
“Yes, from what I’ve heard from Wang Sheng, it’s a batch of surgical instruments.”
“Surgical instruments? What does he need surgical instruments for at this time?”
“I’m not sure. When he called me tonight, it was completely unclear what was happening. He even asked me if this person used to perform surgeries.”
“What surgeries could he possibly know? Moreover, he’s only been known for concocting some folk remedies from who knows where and researching some miraculous pills in the past, he couldn’t do anything else.”
“That’s why it seems all so strange, but right now we’re just speculating out of thin air, discussing this has no point.”
“Yes, the most important thing right now is that I should quickly adapt to this new role. That way, I’ll be able to stand against him. By the way, didn’t Wang Sheng say he was keeping an eye on the factory?”
“Yes, he’s been at the factory these past two days and has successfully infiltrated their ranks; they even bring him along for their meetings now.”
“Heh, I never thought Lin Yi would slip up. He couldn’t have dreamed that Wang Sheng was a double agent.”
“Let’s hope so. Hopefully, they don’t discover Wang Sheng’s identity too soon. After all, him being on the inside makes everything we do a little easier.”
“Right, that’s what I think too. Oh, you mentioned earlier that Wang Sheng said he had something very important to discuss with me tonight, what was it?”
“Oh, you see, I just came in and got carried away talking and completely forgot about it. Here, take a look at this.”
While speaking, they reached into their pocket and pulled out a white envelope, which they then placed in front of him.

chapters.title: Chapter 530 - 530 Wang Sheng's Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 530: Chapter 530 Wang Sheng’s Plan
Zhao Guangchen just took it, then pinched it, and felt that there was something hard inside, like cards. Could it be that these were bank cards meant for him?
“What does this all mean, are they actually giving me money to spend? He thought that things couldn’t be that simple.”
Curiosity prompted him to open the envelope again, and then he poured out the contents.
He clearly saw that among them was an ID card, the other two were bank cards, and there was also a phone card.
Zhao Guangchen picked up the ID card and found that the photo on it was his current appearance.
He remembered that someone had taken a photo of him yesterday, which must have been used for this purpose.
...
Zhao Guangchen picked up the ID card and looked at it carefully, and the name Zhao Sen was written on it.
“Ha, from Zhao Guangchen to Zhao Sen, it looks like they’ve just shortened the name by one character, but the changes implied here are actually huge.”
“You mean to say my name is Zhao Sen from now on?”
“Exactly, this is your brand new identity. Those two bank cards are also issued under the name Zhao Sen.”
“Is there any money in the bank cards?”
“No, right now they are both empty.”
“What’s the point of giving me these cards? Does he want to monitor my accounts? Couldn’t I just get them myself?”
“This was specifically instructed by him. No matter what you do, whether it’s transferring money or making purchases, all transactions must go through these two bank cards.”
“Heh, so this is just another way to keep tabs on me. Alright, I’ll follow his wishes. It’s quite interesting, I never thought that a name I’ve had all my life would end up being changed to Zhao Sen.”
“I think a name is just a code, not that important, right?”
“Yes, I know the name isn’t that important, but what about my identity?”
“This is your identity.”
He took out a shiny business card from his backpack and placed it in front of Zhao Guangchen.
He looked down and saw that it belonged to a real estate company, and he was supposedly the company’s chairman.
“Real estate company?”
“Correct, this is a company he has established for you with his own capital. Now, the whole company revolves around you, with no connection to him. The company is funded with five million yuan.”
“What does this mean? Didn’t we agree? You wanted to go against Lin Yi, to set up a real estate company—what is this? Besides, the real estate business has nothing to do with the industry Lin Yi is currently engaged in. It’s completely unrelated.”
When Zhao Guangchen saw all this, he felt somewhat unable to comprehend it.
If one truly wanted to confront Lin Yi, one would have to venture into the pharmaceutical industry, or at least something related to it, to be even remotely connected.
But now, it was a completely unrelated industry, and he really didn’t understand what Zhao Guangchen was thinking.
Was he being overly naive, or did he simply not realize the seriousness of the situation?
“Actually, I didn’t understand it at first either, but after Wang Sheng explained it, I thought his actions were quite meaningful.”
“What do you mean?”
“Think about it. If you’re in the pharmaceutical business, Lin Yi would notice you as soon as your company starts up. But as a real estate company, Lin Yi won’t pay any attention to you, am I right?”
“Yes, after all, it’s a completely unrelated industry. Plus, in this city, countless companies pop up every day. How could he possibly notice every single one?”
“Exactly, so this is the first step as a decoy. The second step in running a real estate company has deeper implications.”
“I don’t quite understand.”
Zhao Guangchen shook his head slightly upon hearing this.
Han Xuemei smiled,
“What? Have you forgotten already? Can’t you recall what this real estate company has to do with the Lin Family?”
“The real estate company’s connection to them? Oh, I remember now, their family is in the real estate industry, aren’t they?”
“Right, that was his point. And he’s not planning to strike at Lin Yi directly, but rather at Lin Yi’s family business. Only by doing this can he completely eliminate the root of the problem, you understand?”
“Heh, I must say, Wang Sheng is quite clever. He’s actually making his move from the back. Normally, you would surround from the front, but he’s encircling from the rear. It seems he’s taken a shortcut.”
“Anyway, given the current situation, that’s probably his intention. So, I think we can follow this path.”
“Hmm, if you put it that way, I’m actually intrigued. However, I haven’t had much experience with the real estate business before. I’m not sure if I can manage it well.”
“Wang Sheng said his family owns several pieces of land, and if he goes into business, his big brother and the old man will certainly support him fully. So, you don’t have to worry about the business side of things, just be the figurehead here and help him manage those matters.”
“Alright, I understand. In that case, I’m just a puppet, and the real puppet master should be Wang Sheng.”
Zhao Guangchen said somewhat self-deprecatingly.
In truth, his current predicament was more troublesome than anyone else’s.
Before, he had been so powerful and commanding, but now he found himself under the thumb of a young man.
Moreover, he was just a puppet, just directed to go east without the slightest possibility to go west.
Han Xue Mei suddenly stood up and looked outside anxiously,
“I know. At this time, they’re usually over there. They can’t hear our conversation, so don’t worry.”
“But when you speak here, you still need to be somewhat careful. I know you’ve got a lot on your mind, but under these circumstances, you really don’t have a choice, do you understand?”
“Yes, I understand. I basically have no choice. There’s no chance for me to be picky. Right now, I’m just content to have an identity and something to eat.”

chapters.title: Chapter 531: All Given to You
chapters.content:
Chapter 531: Chapter 531: All Given to You
“What now? Are you preparing to give up again?”
“How could I not? At this moment, there’s nothing I can do.”
“No, you’re wrong. In fact, there’s a lot you can do. Once you enter this company, you can gradually transfer its ownership to yourself. Then, we’ll be able to kick Wang Sheng out with a single kick.”
“It’s easy to say, but I’m afraid it’s not that simple to do. Moreover, Wang Sheng is not a fool; he will definitely not let us manipulate him like that.”
“You’re right, Wang Sheng is indeed not a fool, but I tell you, in business, he truly is weak.”
“What do you mean?”
...
“I’ve discussed these matters with him before. I found that his insights are very limited. Right now, he still trusts me completely. So we can take advantage of that, align our external and internal strategies. I believe it won’t be long before the company is in my name.”
“If you put it like that, it does seem quite interesting. But how long do we have to wait for this to happen?”
“That depends on how quickly things progress on Wang Sheng’s end.”
“Keeping tabs on his affairs is simple.”
“Indeed, we must seize everything that’s ours to take, including the Lin Family’s company. If we can hoard that as well, then our company will become even stronger. At that time, kicking Wang Sheng out, I believe no one will be able to interfere.”
Upon hearing this, Zhao Guangchen was merely astonished as he looked at Han Xuemei.
Honestly, he hadn’t expected this at all.
But the key issue was that his current strength didn’t allow him to act on it yet.
Now, Zhao Guangchen could see it clearly; Han Xuemei really was ambitious.
To think that she could deliver such a grand plan with ease.
It seemed that he had indeed underestimated her before.
But this was also good. Now that he had such a woman by his side to support him, perhaps in the end, he really would have a chance.
“Are you sure that if we do this, our situation will be safe?”
“Don’t worry. Since I’ve thought this out, I will definitely ensure our safety first, then act. But for now, we must grow stronger continuously, make ourselves more powerful. Only then will we not be afraid of them.”
“Yes, we suffered a loss for that before.”
“That’s why this time you must be thoroughly prepared, and absolutely can’t make the same mistakes as before.”
“I understand.”
“See, staying by his side now is genuinely painful for me. He watches over me as if I were a prisoner. I’m not allowed to step outside and must stay in that house all day. I’m truly done with that kind of life.”
As Han Xuemei spoke, her expression seemed genuinely pained.
She was a woman yearning for freedom, used to being free, and now confined like a canary in a cage; she couldn’t bear such a life.
Zhao Guangchen stepped forward and tentatively stretched out his hand, gently placing it on Han Xuemei’s hand.
This was the first real physical contact he had with Han Xuemei since that incident.
He was still afraid that Han Xuemei would push him away since he had caused her so much harm before.
Unexpectedly for Zhao Guangchen, Han Xuemei did not do so but instead, grasped his hand tightly.
At that moment, he felt that this woman must be using him.
“Xue Mei, I know you’ve suffered, and if I hadn’t treated you that way before…”
“Enough, don’t say anything. When you treated me that way, you were probably just trying to protect yourself.”
“You’re right, if it wasn’t for self-preservation, I never would have treated you that way. I’m sorry for what happened in the past; I offer you a sincere apology. But watch how I behave from now on, I won’t treat you like that again, and I will cherish you, hold you high within the palm of my hand.”
“Are you starting with sweet talk again?”
“No, I’m really not being insincere. I know that my position today is inseparably linked to you. Once we have this company under our control, I will definitely cede the chairman’s position to you and support you from the side.”
“What do you mean? You’re giving up the chairman’s seat too?”
“After all these years, having come so far, I’ve put everything into perspective. I feel that being able to have you by my side, looking after you, is already a great happiness for me. The company chairman, these are but empty honors. If you’re willing to stay, I’ll give it all to you.”
Although Han Xuemei knew that his words were half-truths, and which parts were true or false needed careful discernment,
no one could understand a woman’s heart. Even knowing it was a lie, hearing it still made her very happy.
“Alright, those are matters for later. What’s most important now is that you must seize the time to get out of here. And do you really want to live in this dark, damp environment forever?”
“I don’t, I definitely don’t. As for this place, I’ve had more than enough.”
“That’s settled then. You need to hurry and cooperate. And looking at your face, it has almost completely recovered. Could it be you’re ready to start anew in a day or two?”
“They told me that tomorrow they’re changing my medication and then I’ll spend another two hours under the sun. If there are no issues confirmed, this experiment will be considered a success.”
“That’s excellent. I’ve been waiting for this day.”
“It’s getting late; you should hurry back. If you can’t be found tonight, suspicions might arise.”
As Zhao Guangchen spoke, he looked at the time; it was already past nine o’clock.
Unknowingly, the two of them had been talking for almost two hours.

chapters.title: Chapter 532 - 532 Safe Delivery
chapters.content:
Chapter 532: Chapter 532 Safe Delivery
Zhao Guangchen felt that these two hours had passed incredibly quickly, vanishing in the blink of an eye.
Usually, when one is alone here, even a single minute feels as long as a year.
Perhaps it was because he had found a confidant, or maybe because he saw the dawn of victory right before his eyes.
“Rest assured, I’ve already told him, and he might not come back tonight.”
“I advise you, at this critical time, it’s best not to be careless. What if, he suddenly pulls a surprise move? By then, wouldn’t all this become troublesome?”
“Hmm, your reminder is indeed timely. If you really do take over this company, I’m afraid our dealings won’t be as overt as they are now.”
...
“Don’t worry, I know what to do, and besides, if we need to communicate, we can do so privately. But, as I’ve said before, it’s better for you to contend with Wang Sheng and make sure the contact person seeks you out, not him. If they look for him, the target would be too obvious, and once he gets in touch with the other side, there would be no way to stay hidden.”
“Exactly, that’s what I was thinking too. So, once this matter is over, I’ll sit down and have a proper talk with him and then ask for his opinion. That way, if the two of us join forces, it will be much more convenient.”
“Alright, I’ve got it. You hurry back now, and we’ll talk more about this in the future.”
After finishing, Han Xuemei simply nodded and then stood up and left the room.
Once the woman had left, Zhao Guangchen looked at his new identity and helplessly shook his head.
Regardless, he had now completely evaded all the previous dangers.
The Zhao Guangchen who was being hunted and wanted by everyone had now disappeared from the world.
From now on, a brand new Zhao Sen would emerge in this city.
He believed that it wouldn’t be long before he would be invincible and take control of everything, and by then, he could easily kick Wang Sheng to the curb.
This feeling of avenging past humiliations was something Zhao Guangchen had never truly experienced in his life.
Around 9:30, Lin Yi’s phone rang; he glanced at it and saw that it was a call from Wang Sheng.
It seemed that, compared to Lin Yi’s earlier expectations, the call had come half an hour early.
But Wang Sheng’s little trick was something Lin Yi was very clear about.
He knew that at this time, Wang Sheng was just trying to perform well in front of him.
The goal was to win his absolute trust.
To be honest, up until this moment, Lin Yi had not fully trusted Wang Sheng.
Only, at the moment, there were too few people at his disposal, so he had no choice but to reactivate Wang Sheng.
However, no matter what he did, he always held some reservations in front of Wang Sheng.
At least, until he fully trusted him, he definitely would not be spilling his heart out to him.
“Hello, Wang Sheng, how’s it going? Have you arrived?”
“Oh, Brother Lin, I’ve already arrived. I’m just above the town. I think I can see the inn entrance from here. Where are you?”
“The car is with you, right?”
“Yes, the car is with me.”
“Do this: continue past the inn, there’s a small alley. Go straight through it, and inside there’s a warehouse door. Wait there for me, I’ve already made arrangements, and I’m coming down now.”
“Alright, I’ve got it.”
After saying that, Wang Sheng promptly hung up the phone.
Lin Yi tidied up briefly, and then he quickly went down to the first floor.
He gently tapped on the door.
Because if they were to inspect the goods, then it had to be Lin Yi himself to do it.
No one else knew much about these medical devices.
After all, it was his first purchase, hence he definitely needed to verify everything carefully; at the very least, he couldn’t allow any issues to arise with these surgical instruments.
“Coming.”
He heard footsteps inside, and after that, the door was opened and he saw Liu Yao standing there in a set of pajamas.
“How is it, has aunty gotten any better?”
“Oh, she’s much better, she even had a bowl of millet porridge tonight.”
“Good, that’s great. Is aunty asleep now?”
“Oh, she’s asleep. What’s happening? Is there something you need?”
“The goods have arrived. Could you help me take a look at the goods? If there’s no problem, we have to accept the shipment.”
“Oh, okay, then I’ll go change clothes.”
“No need, it’s just in a nearby warehouse. I’ve already spoken to him, so you just need to take a quick look. If there’s no problem, you can come back.”
“Fine, I got it.”
Liu Yao nodded, then gently closed the door from outside.
The two of them walked along the alley, and from a distance, they saw a truck parked there.
And a man stood by the side of the road.
In his mouth was possibly a lit cigarette, flickering continuously in the darkness.
“Brother Lin.”
From afar, Wang Sheng had already spotted them and quickly jogged over.
“Alright, you’ve worked hard tonight.”
Lin Yi approached him and patted Wang Sheng gently on the shoulder.
“Ha, Brother Lin, what hard work is there? It’s just following the truck. Besides, I felt like it didn’t even take much effort. Come on, Brother Lin, don’t you want to check the goods?”
“Of course, I do. Come on, open it up and lay it all out.”
With that, Wang Sheng walked over, opened the back of the truck, and straight away, revealed the contents.
Inside, the goods were stacked in crates. He checked and saw there were four in total.
He signaled to Liu Yao, who then proceeded to open the crates one by one and began checking the contents carefully.
“How is it? All went smoothly on the road, right?”
“Yeah, it went pretty smoothly. Plus, around this time of night, there’s hardly anyone on the road. So, I kept urging the driver to hurry, to go faster. Otherwise, if it delayed your business, wouldn’t it be troublesome?”
“Ha, good. But you’re really speedy, you arrived at least half an hour earlier than I expected.”
“That’s right, the task Brother Lin entrusted to me, I will definitely give it my all to accomplish it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 533 - 533 Driven Away
chapters.content:
Chapter 533: Chapter 533 Driven Away
“Alright, now you wait a bit, and then after he completes the inspection over there, if there are no issues with the goods, you guys can leave.”
“Okay, I understand.”
Wang Sheng nodded, but seeing the meaning in Lin Yi’s expression, it seemed as if he had no intention of having him stay behind.
If this was indeed the case, it looked like he would have to leave with the vehicle tonight.
However, deep down, Wang Sheng was somewhat unwilling.
He wanted to stay by Lin Yi’s side and try to find out where these surgical instruments were actually going.
...
If they were only being stored in the warehouse overnight, there was no way he could find out clearly without staying behind.
His mind was racing, searching for an appropriate reason to stay that would not arouse any suspicion from Lin Yi.
“Brother Lin, I’ve checked it over, all the surgical instruments should be fine, so the quality is definitely not an issue, and they’re all top-notch goods.”
“That’s great, so you’ve already checked them, right?”
“Yes, I’ve checked them, and you can accept the delivery now.”
“Okay, I’ve got it, Liu Yao, thank you for the trouble, coming out to inspect the goods so late at night. Hurry back, and I’ll contact you tomorrow morning.”
“Okay, I got it, Brother Lin. Then please take care.”
As she spoke, Liu Yao bid farewell to Lin Yi and then departed from there.
As Liu Yao turned to leave, Wang Sheng had been paying close attention to this woman all along.
Beforehand, he only knew about a Ling’er at Lin Yi’s side, but who was this woman exactly? He honestly couldn’t quite figure it out.
Back at the factory, Wang Sheng had never seen this woman either—it was like she suddenly appeared out of nowhere after coming to this town.
Lin Yi signed his name on a delivery note and then handed it to the driver.
“Master, please be careful on the road back, and there’s no hurry to deliver now. Just drive slowly, putting safety above all else.”
“Okay boss, don’t worry, I’ve driven plenty of night routes, so this is nothing to me.”
Lin Yi nodded his head and then turned to glance back at Ang Sheng.
He saw Wang Sheng standing there the whole time, not knowing what he was currently pondering.
He quietly walked up behind Wang Sheng and then patted him on the shoulder.
“Brother Lin, how’s it going? Has the inspection been completed? If there’s any issue, I’ll contact them right away.”
“Rest assured, there’s no problem with any of the goods. You’ve worked hard; hurry back so you can get a good night’s sleep.”
“What? Me, go back?”
“Otherwise, what are you going to do here if you don’t go back?”
“It’s not that, Brother Lin, didn’t you encounter some issue here? If needed, I can stay behind.”
“No need, the factory project still requires your oversight.”
“Don’t worry, I’ve already instructed the project manager at the factory thoroughly; there won’t be any issues.”
“By the way, how’s the progress on that project going now?”
“If we keep up with the current schedule, I estimate we should be able to rush it out in about half a month or so.”
“Half a month? That’s a bit long, can’t it be moved up a bit?”
“Brother Lin, you’re really putting me in a difficult position. Half a month is already a limit, don’t forget that we had to redo all the foundations not too long ago.”
“10 days, can it be done in 10 days?”
“10 days?”
Wang Sheng’s eyes widened.
For him, time was indeed a significant challenge.
Even rushing work day and night might not get it done in 10 days.
“Alright then, since you request it, I’ll think of a way, try my best to get it done.”
“It’s not about trying to get it done, you must complete it. Do you have the confidence?”
“Alright, Brother Lin, I understand. I’ll definitely finish it and absolutely won’t let you down.”
“Good, I knew I wasn’t wrong about you.”
“Brother Lin, there aren’t any issues, right? And how did you suddenly get into dealing with medical instruments out of the blue?”
“Oh, it’s fine, just a friend who needs them, so I’m simply responsible for supplying them, nothing else.”
“Oh, I see, Brother Lin, don’t trick me. If you really run into any trouble, you must tell me. I can leave things temporarily there, and I can help share some of the burden here.”
“No need, with Hei Lang and Ling’er here, I have enough hands. Besides, I won’t be staying here for long, just for two or three days, maybe three or four days at most. I’ll be back soon, and we’ll meet up at the factory then.”
“Alright then, I understand, Brother Lin. Just take care of yourself and call me if anything comes up.”
“Okay, I will. Take care on the road, and thanks for your efforts.”
As he spoke, he merely waved his hand toward Wang Sheng.
Wang Sheng felt completely disheartened.
At this moment, he truly realized it was impossible for him to stay behind.
It seemed like he had not fully earned Lin Yi’s trust yet, and the excuse Lin Yi gave him—that all this was for a friend—was something he could not believe. Things couldn’t be that simple.
In the blink of an eye, he got into the vehicle, which then sped away into the darkness.
About five or six minutes into the drive, he signaled to the driver, and the vehicle came to a stop by the side of the road again.
“What’s going on?”
The driver was puzzled; under normal circumstances, all affairs should have been dealt with. Could it be that Wang Sheng had unfinished business?
“Sorry about this, Master, something just came up that I urgently need to take care of. Could you wait for me here for a bit?”
“In this darkness, how long am I supposed to wait for you? Besides, the later it gets, the easier it is to get drowsy while driving.”
“I know, I know, my apologies, Master.”
While saying this, Wang Sheng took two 100-yuan notes from his pocket and placed them in front of the driver.
“Master, take these, buy a few packs of cigarettes, and then if you feel drowsy, you can smoke one to perk up.”

chapters.title: Chapter 534: Find Liu Yao
chapters.content:
Chapter 534: Chapter 534: Find Liu Yao
“Since there was money involved, naturally, the driver wouldn’t have anything more to say.”
“Alright, alright, I got it. Hurry up, then, can you be back in half an hour?”
“Yes, yes, absolutely no problem.”
Having said that, Wang Sheng hurriedly jumped out of the car and ran towards the inn.
After arriving, he observed the surroundings and found that Lin Yi had already returned to the inn and there was no sign of him outside.
He quietly entered the inn and walked straight to the front desk.
...
“Hello, sir, are you looking to stay at the hotel?”
“Oh, it’s like this, I’m looking for someone. Could I take a look at your check-in records?”
“Sir, I’m really sorry, but we can’t disclose that information to you, and as you know, it’s all about customer privacy.”
“I know, miss. To tell you the truth, I had an argument with my wife, and then she ran off by herself. I am really a bit worried, which is why I’ve come here.”
“Are you sure she’s staying in this town?”
“I’m a hundred percent certain. I’ve already checked her ticket purchase record. She’s definitely in town, and I’ve heard that there’s only your inn here, so I think she might be here.”
“But with so many guest records, how can I let you look through them all? Sir, please don’t make me do something difficult. I understand your feelings, but you may want to think of another way. If it doesn’t work out, you can take the legal route, and we will certainly assist with the investigation.”
“Don’t be like that. It’s just a small family matter. If I startle other people, wouldn’t that just complicate things? Miss, I’m really sorry, but as you can see, I’ve come here late at night, it’s not easy for me. Please, can you make an exception?”
As he spoke, he carefully pulled out a wad of prepared renminbi from his pocket and placed it in the woman’s hand.
At that moment, the woman just froze.
She had not expected this man to be so generous, and by the feel of it, there were at least 1000 yuan.
“What is this, what is this for?”
“I’m really sorry, really sorry. I know you have your own rules and regulations, so I’m asking for a bit of flexibility.”
The woman instinctively pulled her hand back.
But as she did so, she also took the money with her.
Wang Sheng could only see her hands moving under the counter, not quite sure what she was doing.
“Oh no, I can’t, my stomach hurts. I need to go to the bathroom. Sir, please wait a moment.”
Suddenly, she let out a pained groan and quickly ran off from there.
Wang Sheng, of course, knew she was purposely giving him an opportunity.
And it showed that the attendant was quite smart.
Later, she would have the perfect excuse that she had covertly checked the information herself and that it had nothing to do with him.
Seeing his chance had come and that by now, there was no one in town anymore, so no new guests would be arriving at the inn, Wang Sheng began carefully looking through the records at the counter.
He estimated that the inn had only issued keys to 34 rooms at the moment.
By the looks of it, the business was doing quite well.
He quickly found the rooms of Hei Lang, Ling’er, and Lin Yi – all of which were on the second floor.
But where was that woman staying?
He found it strange.
He only found their check-in date.
Finally, he noticed that on the first floor, there was a room whose booking time coincided exactly with when Lin Yi’s room was booked.
Their check-ins were just a minute apart.
If that was the case, then it was almost certain that the room was inhabited by the woman who had come with him.
“Liu Yao.”
Wang Sheng memorized the woman’s name and noted that Liu Yao was accompanied by another woman, probably her mother.
He then carefully checked again and discovered that at that time, only these two people were registered, with no others appearing.
After seeing all this, Wang Sheng let out a long sigh of relief, feeling confident that this woman was his target.
Since he had found the information, he then restored everything back to the way it was and left the inn.
Although he wasn’t sure what the relationship between the woman and Lin Yi was, he felt that by keeping her with him at this moment, and also having her take charge of the goods inspection, her status was definitely not simple.
After getting into the car, they started driving towards the city.
Under normal circumstances, it would take about 4 hours, but since it was late at night with little to no traffic, the driver sped along, so they should arrive around 1:00 AM.
He checked his phone and saw it was already 11:00 PM.
He called Han Xuemei again.
Han Xuemei had just finished bathing and was preparing to go to bed when she suddenly received a call from Wang Sheng.
Normally, if Wang Sheng was really staying with Lin Yi, he definitely wouldn’t have called her at this time.
After all, he absolutely could not let Lin Yi know that he and she had such a private connection.
“Hello, what’s up? Why are you calling so late?”
“Where are you now?”
“Me? I’m at home.”
“Good, wait for me. You get some sleep now; I should be back around 1:00 AM. We’ll talk when we meet.”
“What? 1:00 AM? You, how come you’re coming back? Weren’t you supposed to stay there for now?”
“Never mind that, I’ll explain in detail when I see you. Wait for me at home. We’ll chat when we see each other.”
“Alright, got it. Be careful on the road.”
After that, Wang Sheng hung up the phone.
After receiving the call, she felt a certain heaviness in her heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 535: 535: Investigate This Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 535: Chapter 535: Investigate This Woman
It wasn’t that she didn’t want to see the man; she merely felt relieved that she had come home early tonight. However, if it turned out that she was indeed late, she simply wouldn’t be able to explain herself properly to Wang Sheng.
It seemed that Zhao Guangchen was experienced in this matter and it was a good thing she had listened to him. Otherwise, tonight would have probably been a hassle for her.
Lin Yi returned to his room, where everything was now ready. Lying in bed, he still felt restless, tossing and turning without sleep.
He had no idea how long had passed when he picked up his phone to check the time—it was already midnight.
Yet, he felt not the slightest bit tired.
Previously in the mountains, he had gone about two days and nights without rest. Under normal circumstances, he would have been fast asleep by now.
...
Perhaps his mind was just too full of thoughts.
Since he couldn’t sleep, Lin Yi decided to simply sit up in bed.
After that, he sat by the window, looking out at the night sky.
At this point, the entire town had settled into a peaceful tranquility.
Everything was pitch black, except for some distant lights still flickering.
He had no idea whether he could carry out tomorrow’s task smoothly and had no confidence in the upcoming surgery.
The system had been quiet tonight, not seeking him out at all.
Normally, on the eve of a big battle, the system would at least give him some instructions, but this time it had changed its pattern.
Could it really trust him so much with the current situation?
Well, that was fine. He felt that ever since he discovered this system within him, he had hardly done anything dreadful.
Even if there were things he wasn’t sure about, he could still resolve them quickly with the system’s help.
He believed that the road ahead should only get smoother.
With that being the case, what did he have to worry about?
He just laughed helplessly. Maybe he was just overthinking.
Sometimes, he would dwell on things that hadn’t even happened yet.
If that was the case, it would inevitably interfere with some of his own matters—a mindset he absolutely couldn’t afford to have.
Lin Yi silently admonished himself in his heart, and before he knew it, the latter half of the night had arrived.
He started to feel genuinely sleepy and yawned deeply.
Then, he went to his bed, closed his eyes, and soon fell deep into sleep.
Han Xuemei was lying in bed, but in fact, she hadn’t fallen asleep at all.
After receiving that phone call, she had constantly been pondering what Wang Sheng could possibly want to discuss with her.
Was there a sudden change in his circumstances, or did he have a new idea?
Anyway, since lying down, Han Xuemei felt she couldn’t sleep soundly.
After an indeterminate amount of time, she suddenly heard the sound of a door opening outside.
Han Xuemei was startled and immediately sat up in bed.
She checked the time on her phone—it was already 1:20 a.m.
It seemed that, just as Wang Sheng had said, he would arrive around 1 o’clock as promised.
Han Xuemei got up and left her room.
“You didn’t sleep?”
Wang Sheng had just entered and turned on the light, only to see Han Xuemei already coming out from inside.
“No, I’ve been tossing and turning in bed, unable to fall asleep. What’s going on with you? Why do you have to come back in the middle of the night?”
“Didn’t I tell you? You were supposed to get two hours of sleep.”
“Heh, just because you said to sleep, does that mean I can? Besides, it’s not that easy to fall asleep. I’m not tired anyway; let’s sit down and tell me exactly what the situation is.”
As she spoke, Han Xuemei walked over and sat down near the sofa.
After sitting down, Wang Sheng lit a cigarette.
From his manner, it appeared that things were not going as smoothly as he had hoped.
“What do you mean, has he stopped trusting you now?”
“I feel that he never really trusted me from the start.”
“How could you tell? Did he prevent you from handling this matter?”
“Although I delivered the goods to him, when I requested to stay, he said there was no need for me to remain. With Ling’er and Hei Lang by his side, that was enough.”
“That’s it, but then again, at this point, you probably haven’t become someone he truly trusts.”
“But if he doesn’t treat me as one of his own, why would he assign me to oversee such a project?”
“This project, exactly what kind of project is it? You’ve found out by now, haven’t you?”
“I still can’t bring myself to imagine what it is, and when I asked him why he was transporting these medical devices, he told me a friend had commissioned him to buy them. I think that’s just a lie.”
“A friend bought them? Heh, I doubt anyone believes that.”
“Exactly, it seems he doesn’t even bother to spend the time to lie to me anymore.”
“Did you notice anything in the town?”
“No, I stayed in the town for less than half an hour, so I have very few clues.”
“Who was there? Aside from Lin Yi, were Ling’er and Hei Lang also there?”
“Yes, and there was a mysterious woman. Oh right, speaking of her, I think I managed to find some leads.”
“Oh? What woman? It’s not Han Xuewei, is it?”
“No, if it were Han Xuewei, wouldn’t I know? It’s definitely not his wife; it’s another woman.”
“Another woman? Who is she? Have you figured out anything about her background?”
“No, I have no recollection of this woman before, so I can assure you that she definitely hasn’t appeared before.”
“I’ve paid attention to his affairs before too, and he is very cautious when it comes to relationships with women. If you’re sure that this woman hasn’t appeared before, then this suspicion arises: she must have joined recently.”

chapters.title: Chapter 536: 536 No Way Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 536: Chapter 536 No Way Back
“That’s right, that’s exactly what I mean. This woman is named Liu Yao. If she joins their team at this time, I believe that her presence would have a decisive impact on their affairs.”
“So, if that’s the case, can’t we start by targeting this woman? That way, we might be able to trace back and find out what’s really going on.”
“That’s exactly what I was thinking. But now, I only have her photo and her name. Beyond that, I know nothing. I want to ask, how should we go about tracking her down amidst this sea of people?”
After saying this, Lin Yi sighed deeply.
At the time, he had imagined it would be simple, just figure out the woman’s identity, and then they would quickly find out what they were up to.
The key issue was that now, none of this held any significance for him.
...
Moreover, uncovering their true intentions seemed an impossible feat.
“Liu Yao, how about this: you leave this matter to me. I’ll find a way to track down this woman. After all, the factory still needs your help over there, so you can’t leave this place behind.”
“The factory affairs? I’ll tell you, I really can’t leave them behind. And, do you know what Lin Yi told me tonight?”
“What did he say?”
“He demanded that I complete construction within 10 days. My God, isn’t that just nonsense? Right now, even with round-the-clock overtime, it would probably take about 15 days. And now he’s asking to cut another five days off. This is something not even an Immortal could accomplish.
“Why is he so eager to have the house? What does he really want to do with it?”
“I don’t know. I always have this vague feeling that the medical equipment he’s buying must be connected with the house he wants to build.”
“But why go through such a roundabout way? Why not just move them directly?”
“Don’t forget, it’s not just you in this factory. I’m here too, and there may be others as well. Doesn’t it seem less secure to do things this openly?”
“You mean, he’s worried that these items will draw attention, so he’s going the extra mile to deflect suspicion. That way, even when this batch of goods shows up here, no one will link it to today’s events.”
“Right, that’s where Lin Yi’s intelligence truly lies. And all these detours ultimately serve one purpose. I guess he must be working on saving and helping people.”
“What? Saving and helping? But as far as I know, he doesn’t have a clue about medicine. He’s just able to produce some Elixirs, and most of those are completed with Ling’er’s help. He only provides a simple idea.”
“Perhaps, that idea could solve all problems? I’m not going to ponder this issue anymore. After all, it’s set in stone. Could I really demolish the house now?”
“It’s not going to happen, but his demand that you finish construction within 10 days, can you do it?”
“To be honest, by normal standards, it’s impossible. If that’s the case, it looks like I’ll have to think of an alternative.”
“An alternative? What could you possibly do?”
“Don’t worry, there’s always a solution. Plus, back when I followed the old master, I’ve experienced rushing deadlines before. But then, the quality of the house can’t be guaranteed.”
“If the quality isn’t guaranteed, let me tell you, doing that could very well get you kicked out of the game, you understand?”
“Kicked out of the game? Why would he kick me out? Besides, right now I’m just working ahead to finish the project as he wishes. If so, he should be thankful to me. Why would he kick me out then?”
“You’re wrong. Lin Yi is a very cautious person. If you deliver the project ahead of time, he’ll definitely inspect the house’s quality. Then, he’ll have professional inspectors come to check the structural quality. If there’s the slightest error, then he might just kick you to the curb and never give you another chance.”
Hearing Han Xuewei’s analysis, he pondered carefully, and it seemed to make sense.
If that’s the case, it seems that I mustn’t proceed in that way for the time being.
“What do you suggest I do? I’m already in too deep. If you say I should back down now, do you think I’d face an ugly end?”
“Backing down is definitely not an option. Didn’t you say there was a way to get the schedule ahead? So, this is your test. No matter what you do, you have to ensure the quality and speed up the schedule. Only that way can he fully trust you.”
Upon hearing this, Wang Sheng mulled it over. He wasn’t oblivious to this reasoning.
But if that was the case, it looked like he would have to take a different approach, and perhaps, it might just be feasible.
“Alright, let me think of something. Tomorrow, I will find someone to assist me. After all, I can’t do it on my own. By the way, did you see him today?”
“I’ve met him already.”
“How’s the situation?”
