“It feels like it’s improving day by day. Plus, he mentioned there might be an allergic reaction to one of the medications. But the other party has agreed to formulate a new medicine for him, to be tested tomorrow. If there are no issues, the treatment could possibly end the day after tomorrow.”
“The identification documents I asked you to give him, including two bank cards, have you already handed them over?”
“Don’t worry, I’ve given them to him. Plus, I’ve informed him of his new identity—he’s the chairman of a real estate corporation.”
“Good, then let’s hurry up. We can’t delay this matter any longer. Plus, a couple of days ago, I made arrangements for the company, including having everything prepared. We’re just waiting for him to go there and take up his post.”

chapters.title: Chapter 537: 537 Mysterious Operating Room
chapters.content:
Chapter 537: Chapter 537 Mysterious Operating Room
“Are you saying that your company is all ready to go?”
“Of course, if you’re putting on a show, you do it properly. Moreover, I’ve made arrangements for all the operational staff inside the company. Now, we’re just missing a chairman.”
“Alright, I’ve got it. But, if you’re in such a hurry to get going, do you already have a target in mind?”
“That’s right, it’s the development direction of the land in Southern City.”
“The Southern City plot? I remember, that was previously designated for educational use.”
“Yes, educational land. That’s why this time, I want to have a serious contest with the Lin Family over it.”
...
“But, when it comes to educational resources, we are far inferior to them. Don’t forget, Lin’s father was once a leading figure in the field of education.”
“I’m well aware of that. However, if the use of this land changes completely, then tell me, will his theories still be applicable here?”
“A change in land use requires many conditions to be met before it can be processed, and under normal circumstances, it’s definitely not feasible.”
“I get that. Since I have decided to do this, I certainly have my ways. You don’t need to worry about it.”
“Then, I also hope that this matter can be carried out smoothly.”
“Rest assured, I will force every member of the Lin Family out of this business circle step by step. By the way, looking at the situation, are they still cooperating with us?”
“From what I can see, they are still fairly cooperative.”
“That’s good. Make sure to stabilize their emotions, and remember, he is a key figure. Whatever we do, we have to put him at the forefront, and he absolutely must not have any accidents, got it?”
“I understand.”
“Alright, I’ve almost finished what I needed to tell you. It’s getting late, so I need to hurry and take a shower, then get some sleep. I must get to the construction site as early as possible tomorrow to arrange these things.”
After Wang Sheng finished speaking, he stretched languidly. The hustle and bustle of the day and night had indeed left him exhausted.
Merely on the road, almost eight or nine hours had already been wasted.
The next morning, Lin Yi got up early from bed.
At this moment, he already had a rough plan in mind.
However, the system hadn’t officially started yet, to provide him with a clear surgical map.
If that map were to come out, then he believed the following surgery would likely go very smoothly.
But after all, this would be the biggest surgery he had ever been through.
So, such a thing was definitely not to be underestimated.
He had also rented the warehouse next door, using these past few days to prepare it for the surgery.
Lin Yi came out of his room and turned to look back, seeing Hei Lang and Ling’er standing in the corridor, seemingly having waited for quite a while.
He checked the time; it had just turned 6:00 in the morning.
“You guys, why are you up so early?”
“Brother Lin, I’ve been up for a while. I knew there was important work to do today, so I couldn’t risk oversleeping. I’ve been waiting here early on.”
“Ling’er, what about you? You seemed to have gone to bed late last night?”
“Me? I didn’t sleep at all.”
“What did you say? You didn’t sleep? Did you spend the whole night planning?”
“Yes, the planning is done. But now, I can’t show you until you come back and this matter is dealt with. Then we can sit down and discuss it in detail. Tell me, are you preparing to treat him today?”
Actually, without saying much, others could guess what his next strategic target would be.
“Yes, it’s time to treat him, and we can’t delay this matter any longer. By the way, where is Liu Yao? I need her assistance to complete it.”
“Don’t worry, Brother Lin, I’ll go call her right now.”
“Then, after you’ve called her, go straight to the warehouse next door. I’ve already made arrangements there, and we’ll perform the surgery in that location. But remember, you must not make a spectacle of it; do not let anyone know, got it?”
Lin Yi knew that the matter he was dealing with had to be conducted covertly.
If it were to be made public, his reputation could have been compromised a long time ago.
Then, many more people would be paying attention to him, and anything he wanted to do would become very difficult.
Afterwards, he went with Ling’er to the warehouse once again.
Upon entering the warehouse, Ling’er was truly amazed and widened her eyes in surprise.
It was her first time entering this warehouse, and she had no idea it had been transformed into this.
At the center, there was a plastic sheet that seemed to enclose a specific space.
Ling’er approached and noticed the layers of plastic sheeting that tightly sealed off the area.
Clearly, it was intended to be a makeshift sterile operating room.
And right above the center, there were actually two shadowless lamps.
Although it couldn’t compare to hospital conditions, honestly, under such circumstances, having such an operating room was already quite impressive.
“Brother Lin, when did you prepare all this?”
Ling’er truly didn’t know when Lin Yi had made all these secret arrangements.
As she remembered, she had arrived here with Hei Lang, and then upon seeing Lin Yi, they had together entered Xi Lian Mountain.
And now, to find all these preparations here was indeed surprising to her.
“Heh, I asked Hei Lang to prepare everything here in advance, just in case of an emergency.”
“In advance? When exactly? You know, the hunter was only recently wounded before this. Did you foresee all of this?”
“Not foresee? I always felt that once we went to Xi Lian Mountain, it was unlikely that we would all come out unscathed. I just hoped that I would be the one standing here to perform the surgery, because only then could I save your life. Understand?”

chapters.title: Chapter 538: 538: A Bit Worried
chapters.content:
Chapter 538: Chapter 538: A Bit Worried
“So, you knew all along that someone was definitely going to have an accident?”
“You could call it intuition, I guess. Anyway, I had him prepare all this stuff in advance. I never thought it would actually come in so handy today.”
As he spoke, he walked up to the wall and pressed a switch. Quickly, the shadowless lamp emitted a bright light.
Right after that, the warehouse door opened, and he saw Hei Lang following the hunter and Liu Yao as they walked in together.
At this moment, the hunter was still lying on Hei Lang’s shoulder.
“Brother Lin, how has the night been?”
...
“Still hurts. Other than the pain, I don’t feel much of anything else.”
“Alright, Brother Lin, you prepare yourself first. I’ll work out the details here, and I’ll arrange the surgery for you as quickly as I can. Okay, just carry him to the bed inside.”
“Okay, I got it, Brother Lin.”
With that, he nodded, then carried the hunter straight into the sterile operating room.
Just after putting the hunter on the bed, the hunter suddenly seemed to become nervous.
This was clearly about having surgery on himself.
If that was the case, why not take himself to a better-equipped hospital? Could it be that they had no money?
Impossible. These people definitely wouldn’t lack money. But then, why would he put himself in such a rudimentary environment? If something were to go wrong, it would be no joke—he’d be gambling with his life.
“Brother.”
As Hei Lang was about to leave, he suddenly reached out and grabbed Hei Lang’s hand tightly.
“What’s wrong? Don’t be so nervous. Besides, you can trust my brother’s skills. You’ve probably heard about what he did in Xi Lian Mountain.”
“Yes, I am not doubting your brother’s medical skills, but the key issue is that he’s about to operate on me. This could be a big deal. If something goes wrong, wouldn’t I be risking my life here?”
Hei Lang could understand the hunter’s anxiety.
He felt that probably anyone in this position would not be able to wait here calmly.
“Brother Lin, rest assured, there are absolutely no problems with what my brother does. Moreover, since he has set up complete surgical conditions, it shows that he is one hundred percent confident. Also, do you know that last night, a batch of medical equipment was delivered? Now it’s all stored right here in this warehouse.”
“Yes, I noticed when I came in just now. There are four boxes over there, and it looks like they’re medical equipment. Is all this stuff for use on me? What exactly is wrong with me?”
The hunter suddenly became puzzled.
He knew his condition wasn’t simple, but as for the specifics, he was still in the dark.
“How could it be? We’ll use it for other things too, and not all of it will be on you. Just wait here peacefully. They’ll be ready soon and will come in.”
Hei Lang didn’t continue the conversation. He felt that sometimes too much reassurance might actually have a counter effect.
“Brother Lin, he seems a bit emotionally unstable.”
As soon as Hei Lang stepped out, he saw Lin Yi outside, giving instructions.
“It’s fine. He’ll settle down soon. Besides, it’s his first time undergoing surgery. He must be feeling somewhat anxious. I’ll handle this.”
“Okay, Brother Lin, is there anything else I should do?”
“During the surgery, we need absolute quiet in the vicinity. So, you don’t need to do anything, just stand guard at the warehouse door. No one is allowed to come close.”
“Okay, that’s not a problem. Brother Lin, how long will it take approximately?”
“I’m not sure. I have never done this type of surgery before and don’t know how long it will take. By the way, Liu Yao, based on your experience, how long will this surgery take to complete?”
“That depends on what kind of surgery you’re doing. Tell me, where is his injury, and what preparations do you need to make?”
“This…”
At this, Lin Yi hesitated for a moment.
How would he know what preparations there were? Even the surgery plan was still a complete blank in his mind.
“I guess the bone is broken, and then, they need to be connected back together.”
“You’re not kidding me, are you?”
Liu Yao, after all, was a professional. As soon as she heard this flustered response, she knew there wasn’t a complete plan in mind.
“Why would I joke with you? Now that it’s come to this, do you think I would joke with you?”
“You’re about to perform surgery, and you don’t even have a plan? Also, look at these items, how are you planning to fix them, with a steel plate or with wire? Haven’t you thought about that?”
“How to fix it, I don’t know… What do you think, are plates better, or screws?”
“Brother Lin, please stop teasing me, okay? I’m just a nurse, and I’m here to assist you. You should be the lead surgeon. If you don’t even have an idea about this, then I think you better not do the surgery.”
Liu Yao’s thoughts were simple.
No matter the size of the surgery, or its complexity, the key issue was that you, as the lead surgeon, must maintain a sober attitude.
“You must prepare, and know exactly what you are going to do and what comes next. The lead surgeon must have all the plans clear in their mind and nothing can be missed.”
“Okay, stop teasing now. Hurry up and tell us, what’s really going on? And I know, you must already have a plan, right?”
Ling’er, standing on the side, hurriedly interrupted.
She knew that the question Ling’er was asking might be impossible for Lin Yi to answer.

chapters.title: Chapter 539: 539 Just a Minor Surgery
chapters.content:
Chapter 539: Chapter 539 Just a Minor Surgery
Until now, it had always been a mystery to her; sometimes, Lin Yi’s methods really seemed beyond belief.
“Alright, enough playing around. I know exactly what needs to be prepared. Come, bring me those surgical instruments.”
As he spoke, he pointed in a direction, and ultimately, Ling’er and Liu Yao brought over some commonly used surgical tools.
The moment Lin Yi touched the surgical instruments, he suddenly felt as though his entire mind had cleared up.
One by one, the tools started to flash through his mind.
“Surgical forceps, scalpel, hemostatic pump, compression cord…”
...
He began to recite these specialized terms one after another.
Liu Yao just coordinated with him, repeatedly checking the surgical tools.
After he had spoken these words, he took a long breath on the side. It seemed that he had just been joking around earlier, and about these things, he probably knew them better than anyone else.
“I have already checked everything. Not a single instrument is missing.”
“Good, I know. We start preparing for the surgery now. Let’s go to the operating room.”
“Wait a moment.”
Just then, Liu Yao suddenly stopped him.
“What’s the problem now?”
“Don’t you need to wear a surgical gown?”
“Right, you didn’t mention that, and I really had forgotten. By the way, did I buy that in the things I got?”
“Yes, everything has been prepared. Just give us a moment.”
With that, she quickly went over and started to search through the items.
“Brother Lin, can you be more professional? Your attitude can easily cause her to be suspicious.”
Seizing the opportunity, Ling’er came over and whispered these words in Lin Yi’s ear.
“She’s suspicious? Don’t you have any doubts about my skills?”
He turned his head to look at Ling’er and asked.
“Me? I have no doubt at all about your skills. Moreover, I know that if you’ve decided to do a surgery, it’s almost a sure bet that it won’t fail.”
“Ling’er, sometimes you shouldn’t trust someone too much. Trusting too much may not always bring you good things, understand?”
“That’s not necessarily true; in fact, I truly trust you now, and I know you can do it.”
“Here we go, one gown for each person.”
Amidst the conversation, Liu Yao came over with three prepped surgical gowns.
“I didn’t think of it before purchasing these sterile gowns. Liu Yao, you’re quite thorough, aren’t you?”
“Of course. It’s equipment to protect others and ourselves; it’s very common. I bought 20 sets at the time, thinking it should last us a while.”
“Good job. With things like these, if you can think of them, make a list as soon as possible to see what else is needed. Once we get back to the city, we’ll probably need many more things.”
“Back to the city? What are you planning on doing?”
“You will naturally find out when the time comes. Alright, is everyone ready?”
As they spoke, they all donned their protective gowns.
Ling’er followed by Liu Yao nodded, and then he walked directly into the operating room.
Having just entered, it was clear that Ling’er had been growing impatient from waiting.
He had been waiting almost 20 minutes.
And with each passing minute, it seemed, the wait became a torturous ordeal.
He had no idea what the others were doing; had they forgotten about him?
When he saw Lin Yi reappear before him, his heart started racing again.
“Bro, are you really going to do the surgery today?”
“Don’t worry, it’s just a minor surgery, and only through this can your leg fully recover. Otherwise, you won’t be able to walk for the rest of your life.”
“Are you saying my leg injury is that serious?”
This was the first time the hunter heard Lin Yi mention the severity of his injury in front of him.
It seemed that Lin Yi had intentionally avoided the topic before, but now he had laid it all out, which meant he must have been making preparations.
“I have a feeling that my injury this time is not light. If that’s the case, there’s no need to comfort me. If it’s hopeless, then don’t waste time here.”
The hunter seemed a bit agitated after hearing this.
Lin Yi was starting to regret telling him the truth, but he felt that not telling him would make it impossible for him to accept the situation all at once.
“Brother, do you trust me? If you do, I promise I’ll get you back on your feet, nearly indistinguishable from a healthy person.”
“Is that really possible?”
“You can count on it. When I say something, it can be done. Now, just listen to me and have a good sleep here. When you wake up, all this gloomy weather will have passed.”
He spoke with conviction.
Though the hunter hesitated for a moment, he didn’t say much more but took a deep sigh.
Then, he closed his eyes lightly.
Lin Yi quickly reached out his hand to press lightly on several of his key acupoints.
After massaging for about a minute, they heard the snoring start.
“Hehe, Brother Lin, you really have a unique method of inducing sleep.”
“There are several pressure points on the human body that can stimulate brain nerves. Once the brain nerves are fully relaxed, the person enters a state of deep sleep. So now is the perfect time for us to perform surgery.”
“But how long can this sleep state last? If it’s too short, I’m afraid we won’t be able to complete the surgery.”

chapters.title: Chapter 540: 540 Skilled Surgery
chapters.content:
Chapter 540: Chapter 540 Skilled Surgery
“I estimate it’ll take about two to three hours; there shouldn’t be any major issues. Alright, we’ll start the surgery on him now. His injury is located on the left hip, here. Liu Yao, you’re in charge of disinfecting this entire area.”
“Okay, I understand.”
In fact, Liu Yao had already prepared and then she began to repeatedly wipe the wound area.
When she finally exposed the entire area, she found that there indeed was a very deep wound.
It might have been due to the bleeding over the past two days, and now, it had begun to crust over.
At this moment, she suddenly felt a flash in front of her eyes, and then, the condition of the bones inside became clearly visible.
...
Afterwards, a complete surgical plan formed in her mind.
Of course, this included some specialized surgical instruments, such as a steel plate used to connect the two bone fragments and two screws—everything was already laid out.
Next, Lin Yi began to operate with practiced ease.
His proficient movements left even Ling’er and Liu Yao standing beside him dumbfounded.
Through the entire process, Liu Yao simply followed him quietly.
When Lin Yi reached out his hand, Liu Yao immediately knew what he would do next, and then she placed the ready instruments into his hand.
This process took about 20 minutes in total.
Even Lin Yi had not expected the surgery to go so smoothly.
During the surgery, his mind was completely blank.
He didn’t know what exactly he was doing.
He couldn’t remember how he had performed the familiar movements, where he had started, or how the screws were screwed in place, including how the steel plate was fixed. He couldn’t recall any of it.
Only at the end did he suddenly pull himself back into the real world in his mind.
He looked at the area that was now completely fixed by him; the two bone fragments had been perfectly joined together.
He then carefully rewrapped the layers.
“Okay, now it’s time for suturing.”
“Brother Lin, are you sure you’re done?”
Liu Yao’s eyes widened in surprise; she simply couldn’t believe such a complex bone-setting surgery had taken less than half an hour.
If this had been done in a hospital operating room, it would have taken at least two hours minimum.
Moreover, usually two surgeons would be needed, and that was the bare minimum.
Not to mention the nurses and the anesthesiologist. After such a surgery, the OR would typically have at least seven or eight people to maintain the whole procedure.
But now, it was basically just the two of them operating, with Ling’er merely observing; in fact, she hadn’t helped with the procedure at all.
“Yes, it’s done. Let’s suture it quickly.”
“Okay, I understand.”
Though it all felt somewhat incredible, she still hurried to suture the wounds as instructed.
“Is it done now?”
“Yes, it’s finished.”
“Now, I need you to prescribe a formula for him, make sure to include the best bone-healing medicines.”
“Okay, no problem.”
Ling’er readily agreed.
“According to you, with the post-surgery condition and the medicine he will be taking, how many days do you think it will take for him to recover?”
“Brother Lin, this can’t be rushed, and as you know, bone and sinew injuries need at least three months. If we add in the help of these traditional medicines, I estimate it will be about one to two months, which should be sufficient.”
“One to two months won’t do; it’s too long. He must be able to stand again within a month.”
“What? A month? Isn’t that too fast? Besides, bones need a certain amount of time to grow. If you force rapid growth, do you think the bones will just follow your orders?”
“During the surgery just now, I already fused the bones tightly together. I believe they are perfectly bonded now, and they just need to grow a bit more to be completely connected.”
“But that process requires time.”
“No worries, it won’t take too long, and we can accelerate the process with catalysis.”
“What? Accelerate with catalysis?”
“Alright, no point explaining this to you as you won’t understand. For now, the two of you step outside. I’ll wake him up and then have a few words with him.”
As he spoke, he waved his hand.
Liu Yao wasn’t sure what Lin Yi planned to do next, but seeing his demeanor, she guessed he must have his own arrangements and plans.
She wasn’t asked to leave for any other reason, but because he was going to perform a special treatment.
This bone fusion surgery was the final step in bone healing, and apparently, the system had intimated that this procedure must not be disclosed to anyone.
Although the position was already fixed, the bones had not yet completely fused together.
An ordinary bone and sinew injury, hence the saying ‘heals in a hundred days’, is essentially just a process of mutual fusion.
Lin Yi was now determined to hasten this process, to quickly bond the bones, so recovery could be expedited.
He extended his hand, feeling his palm as hot as if holding a small furnace.
“System, am I over his wound right now?”
“Yes, you’re above his wound. Press down hard and rub your hand up and down, reaching into the deepest layer.”
“Okay, I understand. I’ll do my best.”
While speaking, Lin Yi followed the instructions and placed his palm over the recently sutured area.
He began to vigorously rub the spot.
Even though he had no idea what effect this would have, he trusted the system’s commands and was confident there wouldn’t be an issue.
“How’s it looking?”
After about ten minutes of waiting, feeling his hand really burning up, he started to doubt whether his own body might catch fire if he continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 541: 541 I Will Keep It Secret
chapters.content:
Chapter 541: Chapter 541 I Will Keep It Secret
“Okay, it’s almost done now. At this point, about seventy to eighty percent of the bone has reconnected, and there’s still about thirty percent that needs to heal on its own. This process should take roughly a week or so to complete.”
“So, can he start moving around now?”
“Small movements should be fine, but large or rather intense movements, the nerves in his leg bones definitely can’t withstand that yet, at least not without a period of adaptation.”
“Alright, I got it.”
“Also, you must continue to supplement with the traditional Chinese medicines you mentioned earlier. Only by doing this can Eastern and Western medical approaches be combined effectively, allowing him to recover as quickly as possible.”
“I understand, thank you for your hard work.”
...
“This task has been completed perfectly. Now, you are awarded a Primary Level surgery room.”
“What? What surgery room?”
He seemed not to have heard clearly, a Primary Level surgery room? Could it be that surgery rooms are ranked into Primary, Intermediate, High Levels?
Every time, when he wants to ask for details and understand what’s going on, the system disappears into his body once again.
Lin Yi could only shake his head helplessly,
And wonder where exactly this so-called Primary Level surgery room is.
He looked around and saw that he was still in the same makeshift and rudimentary surgery room.
Nothing else had changed.
“Brother, brother.”
He gently nudged the hunter’s shoulder.
Feeling that the man was still in a deep sleep, Lin Yi then used a few acupoints to slowly wake him up.
The hunter gradually opened his eyes.
It felt as if he had slept for a very, very long time, and during his sleep, he seemed to have had a dream.
“How am I doing?”
That was the first thing he said when he opened his eyes.
“Don’t worry, you’ve been treated already, and if all goes well, you should be fully recovered in a week.”
“What did you say? A week?”
The hunter felt it was utterly unbelievable.
He had never imagined that a bone injury could recover in just seven days.
For him, it was simply miraculous.
“If you don’t believe it, now I can help you up, and you can try walking around a bit. It shouldn’t be too painful.”
“I’ll give it a try.”
The hunter still couldn’t believe it all.
Because, to him, such a thing was as fanciful as a fairy tale.
Now, the impossible seemed about to happen right before his eyes, and he truly found it hard to accept.
“You don’t need to be so nervous, and now you can carefully feel whether the wound hurts less than before the surgery?”
He turned his head and then spoke to the hunter.
Actually, during the process of helping the hunter out of bed, Lin Yi had already sensed that the hunter was being extremely cautious, as if he were indeed afraid of being injured again.
“Now that you mention it, it really does remind me. Yes, it doesn’t seem to hurt as much as before.”
“That’s why I told you, I’ve already reconnected the bones inside. As long as you don’t make any excessive movements, you should be fine. However, I still suggest you rest in bed; it will make the recovery even smoother.”
With Lin Yi’s assistance, the hunter slowly got to his feet.
At the initial contact with the ground, he was somewhat nervous.
But after firmly standing on the ground, other than a slight pain, he really didn’t feel much else.
“Come on, try moving your feet a bit. Now, let’s walk out of there on our own.”
“Now? Can I really do it?”
“Rest assured, there’s no problem, but remember to take small steps. Don’t stride too large, because the bones have just been reconnected. I’m worried they might come apart if the steps are too big.”
“Okay, I understand.”
The hunter nodded and then began to shuffle forward bit by bit.
It was the same sensation as before, a slight pain, and his leg felt a bit numb, but there were no other discomforts.
Turning back, he looked at Lin Yi with astonishment.
“I’m really, I’m really okay?”
“I’ve already told you, there’s no problem. How do you feel, good, right?”
“Fantastic, really fantastic. You, you’re amazing, this, this is just like magic.”
The hunter began to heap endless praise, right then and there.
Afterward, he followed Lin Yi step by step out of the operating room.
When the hunter stood before Ling’er and Liu Yao, the two of them were astonished and speechless.
Just a while ago, he had been carried in, and now, he was walking on his own?
“Brother Lin, what’s going on?”
“I already told you, after rejoining the bones, he could immediately get up and move around. However, he still can’t engage in excessive activities; he’ll be fully back to normal in one week.”
“How did you do it?”
Liu Yao had observed many surgeries, so when she saw all this, she simply couldn’t believe that it was all happening right in front of her.
Because, every surgical procedure has its recovery period.
And now, it seemed that the recovery period had been completely bypassed; the process had directly healed him.
“Never mind how I did it. I’m just asking you, can he walk around now?”
Liu Yao, still in shock, just nodded vigorously.
“Alright, now that the surgery is done, it’s up to you to decide. Do you want to stay in the inn for a few more days, or do you want to go home now?”
“If it’s really like this, I think I can go home. And, if I recuperate at home for seven days as you’ve suggested, there should be no problem.”
“Good, Brother, no matter what, I have only one request regarding our trip to Xi Lian Mountain.”
“I understand, I will keep it completely confidential.”
He hadn’t spoken yet, but it seemed that the hunter had already understood what he was about to explain.
“Besides that, there’s also…”

chapters.title: Chapter 542: 542 Preparing to Set Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 542: Chapter 542 Preparing to Set Off
“Additionally, I will absolutely keep my mouth shut about any behaviors I witness and will definitely not speak to outsiders about them, including the surgery you performed for me. I won’t let a third person know about it.”
Lin Yi simply nodded in satisfaction. It seemed that the hunter was indeed able to see things clearly,
“Ling’er, have you written up the prescription?”
“Don’t worry, I have already written it. Here is the prescription.”
With those words, Ling’er placed a prescription in Lin Yi’s hand.
Lin Yi glanced down and saw densely written characters, listing around twenty types of herbs.
...
“Brother Lin, I’ll arrange for Hei Lang to gather all the herbs for this prescription. Then, take two doses a day for seven days, and naturally, your leg will fully recover. Understood?”
“Yes, yes, I understand. No need, no need to trouble Brother Hei Lang. Just give me the prescription, and I’ll have my wife buy them in town.”
“No need for that, we will prepare it for you, and then, deliver it to you. Hei Lang.”
He spoke and then shouted loudly towards the outside.
Hei Lang opened the warehouse door and hurried in.
“Big Brother, how is it? Can you, can you stand up?”
Hei Lang had just come in and hadn’t realized yet when he approached and saw the hunter standing up unharmed.
“Hehe, what can I say? Your Big Brother is indeed your Big Brother, truly impressive. Although I still can’t walk like a normal person now, being able to recover to this stage is already very, very good.”
“Amazing, this is too amazing. Big Brother, just tell me.”
“Gather all the herbs listed on this prescription, then, send the hunter back home and take the herbs along for him. Also, the items I asked you to prepare?”
“Oh, I got it.”
Saying this, Hei Lang directly took a bank card out of his pocket and placed it in Lin Yi’s hand.
“Brother Lin, keep this well.”
“What does this mean?”
“This is an extra reward for you, and also, the immense pain you suffered this time was caused by me, so consider it a bit of compensation. There’s a total of 100,000 yuan on this card.”
“This, this really isn’t necessary, and besides, the price we discussed for going into the mountain wasn’t this one.”
Lin Yi knew that 100,000 yuan was a dream figure for people living in this small town.
Even, he dared not even think about it.
“Brother Lin, take it, you deserve it. Moreover, I said before that if this mountain trip went smoothly, I’d give you an extra reward, so this is your reward. Keep it, it may be useful in the future.”
“But, but it seems we didn’t gain much from the mountain trip, and, the items you wanted, we didn’t manage to obtain either.”
“Maybe, we’ll have another kind of gain. Nevertheless, we still feel that the trip to Xi Lian Mountain was worthwhile. Brother Lin, if I have time in the future, I will definitely come to the town to visit you properly.”
“Sure, sure, sure, so you mean to say you’re preparing to leave, right?”
“Yes, now in the town, all matters are essentially settled, so I must leave as soon as possible.”
“Alright, then I won’t keep you any longer. I know that people like you are really busy on a normal basis. If it were not for this mountain trip, perhaps you wouldn’t have come here at all. OK, same as before, be sure to let me know if you come here again. I’ll host you properly.”
“Alright, let’s leave it at that. Go now, send Brother Lin home, and then come back to meet us as quickly as possible.”
“I understand, Big Brother.”
Hei Lang nodded his head, then supported the hunter as the two of them left the place.
Lin Yi just looked back at the empty warehouse.
Although it was a very simple lab, it seemed to have successfully pushed him to another peak in his life.
“Brother Lin, do you mean we’re heading back now?”
“Yes, we’ve already delayed too long in town, there’s no need to stay any longer. Let’s all adjust today and leave early after we get up tomorrow morning.”
“Tomorrow? Can’t we leave today?”
Ling’er seemed anxious to return.
She felt that in this place, all conditions completely mismatched, and even if she wanted to carry out some research, she was utterly limited in her ability.
“Oh, I remember now, Ling’er, you still have to go back to do that herbal analysis, right?”
“Right, I feel that it’d be better to deal with it as soon as possible, preferably not to delay any longer.”
“Well, if you say so, then we really can’t delay. Let’s wait for Hei Lang to return. After he’s back, we’ll hurry, and then we can leave this afternoon. By nightfall, we should be able to make it.”
“OK, then we’ll go back first to pack our things. Also, what about this place?”
“This place, I will arrange for others to take care of it and ensure that no one will detect that surgery was performed here.”
“Alright, I understand. We’ll hurry back to pack, Liu Yao, let’s go.”
After finishing speaking, he left with Liu Yao.
Now, in the empty warehouse, only Lin Yi remained.
He really couldn’t describe the feeling; it’s as though he now felt truly filled with power.
One problem after another was solved by him, which should be a good reward for himself.
No matter what, even though the trip to Xi Lian Mountain had some twists, he felt he had gained a lot.
Furthermore, he had unlocked some new skills here, including the so-called Primary Level operating room by the system; he still wasn’t clear about what exactly that was.
Forget it, perhaps once back in the city, all questions will be answered.
Hei Lang returned after about half an hour since the town wasn’t very big, so going to and fro wouldn’t take too much time.
When he arrived, he saw that everyone had packed their belongings and appeared to be waiting for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 543: 543: Probing for Information
chapters.content:
Chapter 543: Chapter 543: Probing for Information
“Brother, are we leaving right now?”
“Yes, don’t delay any further. After we return, Ling’er has a lot to do, so let’s set off as soon as possible.”
“Okay, I understand. I don’t have much with me, I can leave at any time now.”
“That’s fine. By the way, could you settle the bill downstairs and then find a car, so we can leave this place as quickly as possible?”
“Got it.”
After Hei Lang spoke, he quickened his pace again and then left directly.
...
“By the way, since it’s already this time of day, I think we should have a meal here; there probably won’t be a chance to eat on the road. Eating should be quick too, is that alright with you, Ling’er?”
“We still need to eat, at the very least, an hour or two won’t cause much delay.”
“That’s settled then. Let him take care of the bill while we grab something to eat below. Once we’ve finished eating, we’ll set off right away.”
The three of them came down from the second floor, and went straight into the lobby on the first floor.
These past two days, all of their meals and drinks had been taken care of here, and the taste was quite fitting for the place.
They ordered a few dishes and some bowls of rice. All they wanted was to eat quickly and then leave without delay.
Just then, a sudden commotion erupted on the scene.
Lin Yi turned around out of curiosity and saw an elderly man lying on the ground.
Upon seeing this, a feeling of instinctual concern surged within him.
He gave a signal to Liu Yao, and the two squeezed their way through the crowd.
After arriving, Lin Yi took a quick look and saw that the old man appeared to be around 60 years old and had fallen into a state of unconsciousness.
“From what I can tell, it should be a sudden issue related to a heart or brain embolism,” Liu Yao whispered in Lin Yi’s ear.
“It’s okay, saving lives is what we should be doing.”
As they were preparing to step forward, suddenly, a young man burst through the crowd.
He quickly knelt beside the elderly man and pressed his ear against the man’s chest.
After listening for a moment, he moved two fingers repeatedly over several areas on the man’s chest.
“Young man, are you a doctor?”
One person, sensing that something might be amiss, asked.
Normally in such cases, either CPR or artificial respiration would be performed.
Yet, this man was sliding his hands around, and it was truly unclear what he was doing.
“Don’t worry. I’m very familiar with this kind of situation; there’s no danger. He will wake up soon,” he reassured.
As he spoke, everyone’s gaze turned to the elderly man on the ground.
Unexpectedly, just as he said, after a few simple maneuvers, the elderly man slowly opened his eyes.
“Sir, can you hear me speaking?”
The young man leaned in and spoke loudly.
The old man merely nodded gently.
“What happened to me?”
“Tell me, sir, have you had heart problems before? Any heart attacks?”
“Yes, I have had them before.”
“And if I’m not mistaken, you’ve also had heart stents put in before, right?”
“Correct, I had two heart stents placed five years ago because of heart attacks.”
“Oh, I see. One of your stents may have shifted for some reason, and there’s some fluid accumulating around your heart bag now. You need to get to a hospital quickly for a check-up; only then can your recovery be ensured.”
“What did you say? Fluid accumulation? The stent isn’t working?”
“Yes, that seems to be the case. So, you need to hurry. Where are your family members? Contact them for you to be picked up.”
“Oh, okay, I understand.”
With that, the old man took out a phone from his pocket and shakily dialed a number.
After about ten minutes, they saw a middle-aged man rushing in frantically with several others.
“Dad, what’s wrong with you?”
The middle-aged man quickly approached and knelt down to check on his father.
“It’s okay; thanks to this young man, I was brought back. He was saying something about my heart stent?”
“Dad, didn’t I tell you? Your heart stent needs to be replaced soon. Why are you still running around?”
“So, my heart stent has really failed?”
“Yes, it has. Didn’t I inform you about that?”
“Ah, my memory might really be failing me now. I’ve completely forgotten what you told me.”
“Dad, let’s hurry to the hospital now. Young man, I’m really grateful. Could you leave a name or phone number?”
“No need, no need. It was just a helping hand. You should hurry along. And with his condition, it’s just a simple procedure. He should be out of the hospital in about three days. Also, about the fluid in the heart sack, you should tell the doctors not to drain it. Draining it might hinder his heart recovery.”
“What did you say?”
“Just convey what I said to the doctors, and they should understand how to proceed.”
“Okay, I understand.”
After the conversation, several people carried the old man away and left the place.
The crowd that had gathered to watch dispersed, finding no more excitement to witness.
During the rescue, Lin Yi watched everything carefully. He was truly impressed by the young man.
He noticed that the youth seemed to be a backpacker, carrying a large backpack on his shoulders.
His attire clearly set him apart from the people of the town. He must have been traveling alone or had some other purpose for coming to the small town.
In the end, Lin Yi glanced over and saw the young man returning to his seat, as if he had ordered a bowl of noodles. There was also a cold dish in front of him.
“You guys go ahead and eat, I’m going to go over and probe into his background.”

chapters.title: Chapter 544: 544 This is a Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 544: Chapter 544 This is a Master
“Brother Lin, how did he perceive something so miraculous? Moreover, just by listening here, he could immediately diagnose the symptoms, exactly as his son described.”
“This man must have a significant background, and I feel that he didn’t come to this town for no reason. Everyone, do you think his purpose is the same as mine?”
After saying this, suddenly, several people became vigilant.
After all, there had been a cautionary tale before; he truly did not wish for such a young person to have his life senselessly buried in the deep mountains.
Lin Yi’s original intentions were good.
However, seeing how young he was and yet so capable, he did not want to waste such a talented individual.
...
“We’re still not clear on the specifics. You guys wait here for me. I’ll go over and try to inquire if he can reveal some information to me.”
“Boss, I think it’s unnecessary. Given his caution, your approach will certainly attract attention now.”
“Didn’t you notice? During the treatment just now, the people around here seemed very indifferent, and no one cared about the treatment process at all. They just wanted results.”
“Yes, I noticed too. It seems that only a few of us paid attention to him. Then, Brother, do you want me to accompany you?”
“We aren’t threatening anyone, so why would you follow me? Stay here, I’ll be right back.”
Having said that, he stood up and walked over to the corner table.
From a distance, he saw the young man simply bowing his head, eating the noodles on the table.
And from time to time, he took out his phone to take a glance, as if waiting for some message.
“Would it be convenient if I sat down?”
He approached the man and then spoke to him.
The young man just looked up at him and his brows quickly furrowed.
“What, are there no tables left here? Aren’t there many seats available?”
“Just now, during the rescue, I already noticed you. Could we sit down and chat?”
“Haha, there’s nothing to talk about.”
His expression was indifferent, and after saying this, he continued to eat his meal without looking up.
Ordinarily, being able to hear the injuries inside his body with just one ear was definitely not something ordinary people could do.
The young man continued to eat, seemingly disinterested in what he was saying.
The more indifferent the person, the more curious Lin Yi became about him.
He felt this man must have some special talent, and if indeed he could be of use, his own future endeavors might proceed much more smoothly.
“The human heart, on the surface, has seven acupoints. Just now, you only applied three of them, so I understand you cleared only his heart and lung veins. I am correct, right?”
When he said this, the man suddenly paused.
Then, he looked up curiously at him.
In fact, Lin Yi was not very familiar with these matters; these images had just suddenly appeared in his mind, which is why he articulated it so clearly.
“Acupoints are ranked differently, and the acupoints of the ascending and descending meridians are completely separate, but only the Central Meridian can communicate up and down.”
The man finally spoke, making Lin Yi feel like he had found an opportunity to press further.
“No, I disagree. Although the ascending and descending meridians seem numerous on the surface, the human body’s acupoints form an arc. Starting from the first acupoint, I believe it is possible to reach the last acupoint. That is the so-called inheritance of the meridian.”
“Interesting.”
The man smiled upon hearing this, then shook his head slightly.
“So, regarding this theory, how much do you know?”
“Earlier, if I hadn’t intervened, were you about to come forward to help?”
“Yes, I was about to make a move, but I didn’t expect you to act faster than me, thus not giving me a chance.”
“Well, it seems I’ve been brandishing a sword before Guan Yu. I must have made you laugh this time.”
“Not at all, your abilities are also very impressive, which is why I noticed you. Could I have the honor of knowing you briefly, my name is Lin Yi,”
As he spoke, Lin Yi quickly extended his hand, as if to formally introduce himself.
“My name is Sun Le.”
“Sun Le?”
“You seem like a backpacker. Are you traveling alone?”
“Yeah, it’s somewhat like traveling.”
“But this town is not a particularly famous attraction, so what’s there to visit here?”
“Aren’t you in this town as well?”
“True, but I’m not the same as you. I have some matters to attend to in this town.”
“What matters? Did you enter Xi Lian Mountain?”
Suddenly he said this, and Lin Yi’s eyes widened at him.
Aside from their group and the hunters, no one else should know of his trip into Xi Lian Mountain.
So how could this information have been leaked? Had he inadvertently revealed it himself?
He began to worry internally and felt that what the man said could not be without basis.
“How did you know that?”
Lin Yi seemed very nervous as he looked at him and asked.
“Haha, no need to be so tense. If my guess isn’t wrong, have you been wounded by the Divine Beasts inside the mountain, three inches below your back?”
Good heavens.
Lin Yi felt that all of this was incredibly surreal.
If he had not entered Xi Lian Mountain, how could he possibly know about the mountain’s Divine Beasts?
In his eyes, it was simply unfathomable.
“Young man, could we step aside to talk?”
“There’s no need. I think we already crossed paths on a narrow road. Some things don’t need to be spoken too clearly. Moreover, I know what you are up to, so I can understand.”

chapters.title: Chapter 545: 545: Saving Sun Le
chapters.content:
Chapter 545: Chapter 545: Saving Sun Le
“So tell me, what is it that I do?”
“This, there’s really no need to go into detail, right? Actually, the path we both take should be considered the same, it’s just that, the methods and means we use are completely different. You admire your own set of theories, but, I admire my own theories.”
“Right now, I’ve really become very interested in you. Can’t we sit down and have a good discussion about this?”
“I think, that’s unnecessary. You’ve also been to Xi Lian Mountain, I believe, you understand the situation there better than anyone else, don’t you?”
“Why, without entering Xi Lian Mountain, are you so knowledgeable about it? Could it be that you’ve entered it before?”
“This, forgive me, but I can disclose no further. If there’s nothing else, then, I’ll be leaving first.”
...
After finishing his words, the young man took the paper from the table, wiped his mouth, and then quickly left the place.
Watching his retreating figure, Lin Yi truly shook his head, feeling helpless.
Truly a very distinctive person, and, looking at it this way, trying to make a breakthrough with him seems utterly impossible.
“Big brother, what’s the situation, why did he leave?”
“There’s no way to talk, and, he simply ignored me.”
“Big brother, if it doesn’t work out, let me make a move, just grab him and bring him back, then, keep hitting him until he submits.”
“Nonsense, do you think we’re a bunch of robbers? Such actions are simply impractical.”
“I was just saying, besides, with his pretty-boy face, I reckon he couldn’t even take one punch.”
“Enough, since he has no intention to continue any contact, then, there’s no point in wasting time here. Has everyone finished eating?”
“Yes, we’re all done.”
He looked down and saw that now, everyone’s bowls were empty and the dishes had almost been wiped clean.
“Is the car ready?”
“It’s been arranged, it’s waiting outside right now.”
“Good, let’s get in the car now.”
After that, several people picked up their luggage and directly made their way to the car at the entrance.
For some reason, when leaving the town, he suddenly felt a lot more relaxed.
“Big brother, look over there.”
Just then, as the car happened to pass a small alley, it was clear that there seemed to be a group of people surrounding someone in a fight.
“The ethos of this small town doesn’t seem as good as we imagined.”
Hei Lang, sitting in front, murmured to himself.
“No, Master, please back up.”
“Reverse the car?”
“Yes, reverse, just to the entrance of that alley. I want to have a look; I feel like I recognize that person.”
“Big brother, you recognize that person? Who is it? Is it a hunter? Impossible, he’s resting at home right now.”
“No, I think I caught a glimpse, it looked like that young man.”
“What? Him? No, that can’t be possible.”
“Not sure, quick, reverse the car back.”
The driver nodded and then pressed down on the accelerator. Soon, the car stopped at the entrance of the small alley.
He took a closer look. Right now, roughly 5 or 6 people were surrounding one person.
And, he was very familiar with that person’s backpack; it was the same one that the young man had been carrying earlier.
He was just clenching his backpack tightly with both hands.
But he felt that it was impossible to escape the encirclement.
“Hei Lang, find a way to get him out,”
“Okay, I got it.”
Hei Lang nodded, having not exercised his body for a long time. These people, in his eyes, were utterly insignificant.
He quickly jumped down from the vehicle.
“Hey, what are you doing?”
He stood at the entrance of the alley and then shouted loudly inside.
The men were just stunned for a moment, then turned their heads to glance back. They saw an inconspicuous person whom they didn’t seem to recognize—at least they hadn’t interacted with him before.
“Listen here, we’re discussing something and it’s none of your business. If you don’t want to get beaten up, scram,” one of them said.
“Oh, I quite like what you’re saying. Tell me, how do you ‘scram’?”
Hei Lang’s unfazed gaze drifted over, and then he steadily walked towards them.
“Damn, there’s really someone seeking death. Since you’re throwing yourself into the lion’s den, then Grandpa here can’t forgive you. Brothers, get him,” the man ordered with a wave of his hand.
The men immediately turned their guns around, aiming at Hei Lang.
Hei Lang just stood still, and in no time at all, he effortlessly took down the whole group.
It took less than 30 seconds, and soon, the four men were lying on the ground, howling in pain.
“Really, I didn’t want to resort to violence, but seeing how uncouth you all are, it seems I have no choice but to step in. Young man, come here,” he called out.
Suddenly, he pointed his finger and directed it towards the man.
“Are you talking to me?” the man asked.
“Yes, you. How did you offend them?”
“I… I don’t know. It seems they targeted me as soon as I came out.”
“Enough of that, this area isn’t safe. Hurry up and get in the car.”
“Get in the car?”
“Yes, that car outside.”
As he said this, Hei Lang pointed outside.
The man in black glanced that way and noticed that Lin Yi was sitting in that car.
He nodded frantically. If these people were to blockade him here again, the notion of escaping would be mere fantasy.
So he quickly turned around and jogged towards the vehicle.
Hei Lang followed closely behind, taking a seat in the passenger’s side.
“Big brother, it’s all taken care of,” he said to Lin Yi.
“There were no casualties, right?”
“Don’t worry, I just flexed my fingers a bit; it wasn’t lethal.”
“Alright, I know. Keep driving.”
Lin Yi wasn’t a local, so he didn’t want to cause unnecessary trouble at this moment.
Now that they had rescued him, the three of them needed to leave quickly.
“Where are you guys headed to?” the rescued man asked.
“Xiangcheng.”

chapters.title: Chapter 546: 546 Sun Le was taken away
chapters.content:
Chapter 546: Chapter 546 Sun Le was taken away
“Xiangcheng? Let me down.”
“If I let you down now, those guys will surely launch a counterattack. By then, you definitely won’t be able to leave this place.”
“But I can’t just blindly leave with you. Besides, I still haven’t completed my task.”
“Task? What task?”
“I can’t tell you that. Driver, stop the car.”
He shouted loudly.
...
The driver only glanced at him through the rearview mirror.
He knew that he was hired by this group of people, and he was just someone they picked up along the way, so naturally, the driver didn’t take his words seriously.
“Tell me what the task is, I can help you complete it. After that, I’ll get you out of here as quickly as possible because it’s not safe here anymore.”
“I know it’s not safe, but I didn’t expect everything to happen so fast. Moreover, if I don’t get this done, then this time, it would be a waste for everyone.”
“Driver, pull over.”
After saying that, he nodded his head to signal, and at last, the driver stopped the car at the edge of the road.
“Liu Yao, Ling’er.”
He looked back at the two of them.
“Brother Lin, just tell us, we’re listening.”
“There’s been a change of plans. I can’t go back with you now. I’ll have this driver take you two straight back, and then you can arrange the next steps. Hei Lang and I will probably be delayed here a bit longer.”
“Brother Lin, are you going with him?”
“Yes, to save a person to the end, to send Buddha to the west. So, until I can safely get this young brother out of here, I definitely won’t be at ease.”
“Okay, I understand. You two be careful. After we go back, we’ll contact you.”
“Alright, got it.”
After he finished speaking, he just nodded his head, then gestured to Hei Lang, and the two of them jumped off the car.
Hei Lang took out a stack of money from his pocket and then threw it next to the driver.
“Master, I’ll settle the fare in advance, and the rest is a tip. There are several women above, please ensure their safe delivery, okay?”
“Sure, sure, don’t worry, I will definitely deliver them safely to their doorstep.”
“Okay then, you guys go ahead, be careful on the road.”
He waved his hand, and the driver hit the gas pedal; the vehicle sped away.
Although Hei Lang didn’t know what Lin Yi planned to do by staying here, he knew that whatever decision Lin Yi made would have its reasons and purpose.
“What does this mean?”
“Nothing, brother. As I said earlier, if I intend to protect you, I must see it through to the end. Whatever it is you want to do, without our help, I think you’d definitely fail.”
“Heh, that’s laughable. Do you really think I’m completely helpless?”
“Then how would you explain what just happened earlier?”
“Perhaps it was just a coincidence. Besides, I don’t want any of you interfering in my affairs.”
“Fine, you said it yourself. I respect your wishes. Can we go now?”
“Big brother, what… what are you planning to do?”
Hei Lang was suddenly confused.
It was clear that the driver had just been sent away, and now they weren’t going with this man to do the job anymore.
Was it just to stay idly in the town?
“Quit the chatter, follow me.”
Lin Yi lowered his voice, and Hei Lang nodded before following closely behind him.
After walking forward for a while, Lin Yi suddenly darted into a narrow alleyway.
Then, from this vantage point at the edge, they continued to watch the opposite location from afar.
Lin Yi noticed that the young man had been waiting here all along.
He seemed to be clueless too, not knowing where to start with these affairs.
“Big brother, does this mean we’re just going to watch him covertly?”
“If I’m not wrong, those guys will have follow-up actions. And at this moment, he will definitely be in great danger.”
“Then if it’s dangerous, why do we have to leave him? Staying by his side would make things more secure, wouldn’t it?”
“He thinks he can succeed without us, right? If that’s the case, let him truly experience what it takes to succeed.”
“Brother Lin, it’s your smarts again, we’ll just watch here.”
After saying that, the two of them continued waiting.
About five minutes later, he just took out his cell phone and made a couple of calls.
Not knowing who was on the other line, after the calls, Sun Le turned and walked towards the town center square.
“Big brother, he’s leaving?”
“Don’t worry, it’s not that simple. If it were me, after this failure, I definitely wouldn’t just let it go.”
Unexpectedly, just as Lin Yi’s words ended, suddenly a white van came roaring from a distance.
And as soon as it reached him, the vehicle abruptly stopped.
Two masked men then charged out of the van and dragged him onto the vehicle.
“Big brother, they’ve taken him.”
The whole event caught them off guard; even Hei Lang hadn’t expected these guys to act so quickly.
“Did you get the license plate number?”
“Brother Lin, I got the plate number, but what good does that do? I’m doubting whether that’s their car at all, and that’s up for debate.”
“Never mind that, you remember the plate number, right?”
“Yes, I’ve got it memorized.”
“I didn’t expect it, but it seems I just want to leave this town. However, the less I’m allowed to do so, it seems we’ll indeed have to continue waiting here.”
“Big brother, what do you mean? Are you saying you want to rescue him?”
“He came here today definitely with a purpose. And he could describe everything about Xi Lian Mountain in detail without ever setting foot there, which proves he’s certainly no ordinary man.”

chapters.title: Chapter 547: 547: The Most Formidable Master Jin
chapters.content:
Chapter 547: Chapter 547: The Most Formidable Master Jin
“But the key issue is that we’re strangers here in this town, and we simply don’t have any idea where to start our investigation.”
“That group of people looked like locals to me, and I guess they were specifically targeting him.”
“Alright, what do you suggest we do then?”
“Right now, we don’t know anyone here, except for the hunter himself.”
“Big brother, are you suggesting we get information from the hunter?”
“Yes, I want to see if we can get some leads from him. After all, these things are not too big, if there’s any disturbance, I believe the hunter will have heard something too.”
...
“So it looks like we’re going to have to make a bold attempt. Should we go now?”
“Yes, let’s not waste any more time. Also, buy something decent like fruits as a gift on the street since we’re paying a visit.”
“Okay, got it. I remember there’s a shop nearby where we can just pick up something.”
After the conversation, Lin Yi nodded, and then the two of them headed towards the hunter’s home.
Even though they didn’t know who had taken the young man away, he felt these people must be significant and not as simple as they had imagined.
The person who opened the door was the hunter’s wife.
When she saw the two men, she obviously froze for a moment.
How much money he had given their family was something the hunter had clearly told his wife upon returning.
So seeing them was like seeing their benefactors, she felt truly grateful.
“Boss, um, you’ve arrived, come in, please come in, get the child’s father, the child’s father?”
The woman warmly ushered them into the yard.
“What are you shouting for? I can hear you.”
“You, you must look, look who’s here.”
It was at that moment that the hunter slowly sauntered out of the room.
When they saw the hunter and Hei Lang standing before them, he was visibly surprised.
After all, they had just met this morning—why would they come to see him again so soon? What was the matter?
“Little brother, how come you’re here?”
“Heh, I wanted to pay you a visit. We were passing by your house. Is it convenient?”
“Convenient, convenient, come in quickly, pour some tea.”
“No need to fuss, we just want to have a quick word with you, and then we’ll leave right away.”
“Oh, what is it? Tell me. Oh right, I’ve already got the medicine, and I’ve told my wife to prepare it on time for me.”
He pointed to the pile of herbal medicines on the table, then spoke to Lin Yi.
“Great, but I’m not here about your leg injury today. I have another question I want to ask you.”
“What’s this about asking questions, little brother? We’re familiar enough with each other. Just say what you need, and if I know anything, I’ll tell you everything.”
“Alright, I want to ask, is there someone particularly powerful in this town?”
“Someone particularly powerful? What do you mean?”
“I mean, in every place, there’s usually a gang, or someone who can call the shots.”
“Are you referring to the town mayor?”
“The mayor? No, besides the mayor, is there someone whose reputation exceeds his?”
“In that case, I’d say in this town, it’s got to be Master Jin.”
“Master Jin? Who is he?”
“They call him Master Jin, but in fact, he’s not very old—probably just over 30. He started out in the transport business in this town.”
“What about now?”
“In the beginning, when he was just past 20, he used to gather agricultural products from various households in town and then rent a truck to transport them to the city. He earned simply by marking up the prices.”
“Having such an idea at that time proves that his brain is definitely not simple.”
“Simple or not, I don’t know, but one thing’s for sure: over the past few years, they have indeed made a fortune with their business. Later, he even established his own company and other businesses in this place.”
“And then?”
“After that, he naturally dominated the local market. I tell you, everything in our town, if it’s to be shipped out, has to receive Master Jin’s approval. Without it, no one can transport anything. Do you understand?”
“Impressive, so this guy really is a big deal.”
“Not so much a big deal but just very ruthless in business. I’ve heard that once, armed with just a kitchen knife, he fought off 18 men by himself, which has become a legendary tale to this day.”
“Impressive indeed. By the way, where does Master Jin usually hang out?”
“Normally, he’d be at his own private estate.”
“His estate? Where is it?”
“Remember we met up at the square last time?”
“Yes, at the square. Head southwest from there for about 10 minutes, and you’ll see a huge estate. That’s where Master Jin lives.”
“An estate? I had no idea there was one here.”
“Whether it’s an estate or not, what difference does it make? That place is his private property, so us ordinary folks don’t dare to get close.”
After listening to the hunter’s introduction, he felt as though he was slowly starting to get a grasp on things.
“Oh, I see. Besides that, are there any local snakes or similar figures around here?”
“No, that’s about it. The entire town is under Master Jin’s control, and anyone under him, no matter how powerful, would just be one of his henchmen.”
“Alright, I understand. Brother, I won’t disturb your rest any longer.”
“Wait a moment.”
Just then, the hunter suddenly stood up and looked up at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 548: 548: Turned Away at the Door
chapters.content:
Chapter 548: Chapter 548: Turned Away at the Door
“What’s up, anything else?”
“Brother, I still advise you, Mr. Jin is not someone you can provoke. If there’s no relation, it’s best not to mess with him; otherwise, when trouble comes, I’m afraid you won’t even be able to leave the town.”
“Heh, thanks for the heads-up, big bro. Don’t worry, I know my limits.”
“Alright, if you need anything, contact me in time.”
“Alright, big bro, I won’t bother you any longer then. I’ll leave it at that.”
After bidding farewell to the hunter, Lin Yi left the yard with Hei Lang.
...
“Hei Lang, did you hear that?”
“Hehe, of course, I heard it. What ‘legend’, a kitchen knife repellin’ eighteen men, he’s never seen me. I could take on fifty by myself with ease.”
“This time, we might really have to rely on you. You remember the place he mentioned just now, right?”
“I remember it, big brother. You mean we head straight to that estate now?”
“Exactly, directly to the estate. Since it’s like this, we’ll find him directly, and I believe, all the mysteries should unravel.”
“Alright, I got it.”
Hei Lang just nodded. Although he knew that heading there might not yield any results, he only needed to do as Lin Yi commanded.
Before, it was because he hadn’t inquired about this matter, but now that he knew, he realized the place was not hard to find at all.
Lin Yi walked in the direction the hunter had indicated and, before long, saw a very large estate appear before him.
There was even a large archway in front of the estate.
It was rare to see such grand households in the town.
“Big brother, this is damn impressive.”
Even Hei Lang, who was worldly, had never seen such a majestic archway.
It was inscribed with the golden characters “Jin Mansion.”
“Seems like we’ve got the right place this time.”
“Big brother, I feel that if we rush in recklessly, we may not be able to meet him in person.”
“Who knows, let’s try and see.”
Hei Lang was helpless, feeling they were facing an insurmountable barrier. Eventually, the two of them continued walking forward.
No sooner had they stepped under the archway than two men in black descended from above, blocking Lin Yi’s path.
“Stop, what are you doing?”
The two men spoke with a harsh tone.
“Oh, it’s like this. Please announce that we have something important for Mr. Jin to handle.”
“Something important for Mr. Jin? Have you made an appointment with him beforehand?”
“An appointment has been made.”
“Made an appointment? What is your name?”
“Lin Yi.”
“Wait a moment.”
Lin Yi thought that he could simply say a few words and fool the men.
But to his surprise, after he finished speaking, one of them pulled out a tablet and began to carefully check the names of the visitors.
“I’ve looked all around here, and there’s no Lin Yi, you must be lying to me. Tell me, what is your real purpose?”
“Sorry about that, I must’ve remembered wrong. Right now, I really have urgent matters, I’d like to meet Mr. Jin, so please announce my arrival.”
“I told you, without an appointment, no one can see Mr. Jin. If you know what’s good for you, leave this place quickly.”
“How can you talk to my big brother like that, are you seeking death?”
Hei Lang, who had been standing behind, couldn’t stand it any longer, took a couple of steps forward, and stood in front of Lin Yi.
“What do you mean, brother? Looking to have a go?”
The two were tasked with guarding the entrance to the estate, so naturally, they were not afraid of Hei Lang.
“Come on, let’s give it a try if it’s not too much trouble.”
“Enough, no fighting.”
Suddenly, Lin Yi shouted, and Hei Lang reluctantly stepped back.
Yet his fists were clenched tight, ready to launch an attack at any moment.
“Big brother, is there really no room for negotiation? We truly have very important matters with Mr. Jin.”
“I’ve told you, Mr. Jin isn’t someone you can just see whenever you want. Leave this place quickly and pretend nothing happened today.”
“Alright, I understand. Well then, we’ll leave.”
Lin Yi had just arrived, only to be turned away.
However, he should have been very clear in his mind.
To meet such a significant figure was probably not as simple as he had imagined.
“Big brother, are we really going to just walk away? Aren’t we going to try to force our way in?”
“How do you think their martial arts compare?”
“This…”
Hei Lang hesitated upon being asked this question, as if he really didn’t know how to answer.
To be honest, without having fought with the two, he could only make a rough guess based on their steps and posture.
“Both are light on their feet, and when they move, you can feel that they have practiced Qinggong. If so, they must be skilled fighters. But if I were to make a move, I’m not sure they’d be a match for me.”
“Are you confident you can beat them both?”
“Big brother, that shouldn’t be a problem. Should we go back then?”
“No, I was just wondering if you are confident you could take them. So what if a few more like them jumped out, could you still handle it?”
Hei Lang didn’t know how to respond, his mind quickly trying to figure out how to extricate themselves from this.
“Besides, did you take a careful look? On the left, there seems to be traps set up.”
“What? Traps?”
Hei Lang had been focusing only on the two men in front of him and hadn’t noticed whether there were any traps around.
However, with this reminder, he started to grasp the situation.
“Are you saying you noticed something earlier?”
“Yes, I’ve been watching. There must be traps around, and if they’re activated, neither of us will be able to escape, no matter how high your martial arts skills are. We’ll fall right into their net.”

chapters.title: Chapter 549: 549 Going to Cause Trouble
chapters.content:
Chapter 549: Chapter 549 Going to Cause Trouble
“Big Brother, if you hadn’t mentioned it, I truly wouldn’t have noticed that.”
“The moment I walked under that archway, I already noticed that there were launching devices all around it.”
“Then it’s lucky I didn’t force my way through. Otherwise, it would have been a bit troublesome.”
“Right, so as I said, no matter how skilled you are in martial arts, you’re completely helpless in the face of such mechanisms.”
“But Big Brother, are we really going to give up just like this? Aren’t we supposed to meet Boss Jin? If we don’t see Boss Jin, how are we supposed to rescue that person?”
“No worries. If we can’t meet Boss Jin, then we’ll just force him to show himself.”
...
“What do you mean?”
“Come, follow me.”
Lin Yi said with a mysterious smile and hurried off, with Hei Lang following closely behind.
Dodging left and right, Lin Yi led Hei Lang into a secluded alley.
After walking a considerable distance, they stopped in front of an imposing gate.
Turning back, Hei Lang realized that they were at a transport company.
And inside the yard, many trucks were parked.
“Big Brother, why have we come here?”
“Don’t you remember? That guy told us he monopolized all the transport businesses in this town, so this company must be his.”
“Oh, you mean this company belongs to that Boss Jin? If that’s the case, why are we here? Do you think he’s here?”
“No, we’re here to cause trouble. Only by doing this can we truly force Boss Jin to appear.”
“Cause trouble? But there must be quite a few of his thugs hiding inside, right?”
“That’s why we have to act fast. And after making a scene, we must leave immediately. We can’t get caught in a fight. Got it?”
“Big Brother, I have no problem with that, but what about you?”
Hei Lang turned to look at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi surely didn’t have the ability to escape if surrounded.
“What? Do you really think I’m going to do this myself? I’m just leading you here, then you’ll handle the rest.”
“Heh, Big Brother, I got you. Find a place to wait for me. It won’t take long, definitely within 10 minutes I’ll have it sorted.”
“Sounds good. Just remember, be fast, clean, and quick to run. Understood?”
“Alright, I got it. You go ahead, Big Brother.”
Hei Lang nodded and then slipped his hands into his pockets.
Normally, he carried some self-defense tools in his pockets, including a steel telescopic baton.
Lin Yi quickly darted out from the narrow alley.
Leaving him behind for such a task.
In fact, Lin Yi was well aware that for someone like Hei Lang, this was hardly a challenge.
Moreover, if Boss Jin wasn’t there, even the security on site wouldn’t be able to handle Hei Lang.
Just imagine, with such power in this town, who would dare to make trouble here?
Boss Jin probably couldn’t even dream that two young outsiders could destroy his factory.
Afterward, Hei Lang quickly climbed over the wall and into the factory grounds.
Just as he landed, two drivers were momentarily stunned, failing to react immediately.
Hei Lang was incredibly fast, a result of his past training. He quickly pulled out his baton and smashed it down on the window of one of the trucks.
This commotion finally alerted the others who came pouring out of the buildings.
“Stop, what are you doing?”
The two leaders hurriedly approached.
However, Hei Lang was much faster than them in his response.
He swiftly moved to another truck and started smashing again.
The people began to swarm him, but Hei Lang simply hopped from one truck roof to another, eluding their grasp.
He was willing to destroy windows and the like, then quickly moved on to another vehicle.
Back and forth like this, after a short while, and within just two minutes, he had damaged more than a dozen trucks.
Finally, he saw the wall, leapt over it, and made his swift escape.
“Hurry, chase after him.”
He could hear the people shouting behind him, but he didn’t take them seriously, and in a puff of smoke, he vanished from their sight.
He quickly arrived at the spot he and Lin Yi had agreed upon. Lin Yi was sitting leisurely on a bench with a cup of milk tea in his hand, patiently waiting.
“Big Brother, it’s done.”
“I knew it. Your talent for destruction is top-notch. How many did you get?”
“I didn’t count exactly, but probably around twenty or so.”
“Not bad at all. There’s no doubt about it, let’s move on to the next spot.”
“Big Brother, another place?”
“Of course. Boss Jin has more than this in the area. Plus, while you were smashing those trucks, I got some more info. There’s a restaurant nearby that’s supposed to be one of his businesses, and it’s also the best in this town.”
“A restaurant? Are we going to smash that too?”
“Just a symbolic thrashing, don’t overdo it, or they might make us pay for the damages.”
“Big Brother, do you think this piecemeal approach will actually make him show?”
“I think it shouldn’t be a problem. He won’t be able to wait for long. Soon, the news will reach Boss Jin’s ears.”
“All this trouble for an unknown young man, I feel like we’re going a bit too far?”
“No, it’s not too much at all. I’m telling you, everything we do is worth more than it seems.”
“Well, if you say it’s worth it, then I trust there’ll be no issues. So, let’s do it your way and head to that restaurant now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 550: 550: Smashed Five Stores
chapters.content:
Chapter 550: Chapter 550: Smashed Five Stores
While speaking, he simply nodded his head and then followed Hei Lang once more, hurrying to their next destination.
Upon arrival, it was still the same scenario, and the time was not mealtime, so the restaurant was basically empty.
Only a few service staff and chefs were sitting there, leisurely playing cards.
“Sorry, we haven’t started business yet. If you want to eat, you’ll have to wait until at least 5 p.m.”
Thinking that Hei Lang had come to eat, a server approached, speaking with enthusiasm.
Hei Lang just smiled and then made his way straight to one of the tables.
“Hey, mister, I told you we’re not open yet. Right now, we can’t provide you with anything. Why don’t you try somewhere else?”
Without saying a word, Hei Lang turned around and suddenly glared at the server.
The server was just startled, stepping back two paces, not knowing what this person in front of him wanted to do.
But seeing his menacing appearance at this moment, it was likely he was up to no good.
“What are you doing? Come over here, we have troublemakers.”
In that moment, the server realized what was happening and started calling for others.
Several chefs then walked over towards them.
But Hei Lang was not about to give them any chance, and during this commotion, he flipped over the tables inside.
“Dammit, they’re here to cause trouble. Quick, catch him!”
Suddenly, a chef shouted loudly, but in reality, upon entering, Hei Lang had already noticed a large window right in front of him, and he swiftly leapt out from this windowsill.
He didn’t give anyone a chance to chase after him, and by the time the others came outside, the man had already vanished.
“What’s going on here?”
“Don’t know, get in touch with them quickly. Damn, they’re really asking for it, they even dare to mess with Boss Jin’s shop now.”
These people, actually accustomed to the peace on the streets, knew that this shop should not be a target for trouble.
But now, someone fearless enough to stir up trouble had come, so they had no choice but to make a distress call.
With vigorous effort, Lin Yi and Hei Lang managed to smash four shops.
Adding a factory to the tally, by now, Boss Jin must be furious to the point of exploding.
After leaving the last shop, Lin Yi finally took a long breath of relief, and then he checked his wristwatch, noticing it was already 4:00 p.m.
“How was it, feeling good?”
“Heh, Brother Lin, you’re right, this feeling is really exhilarating, and it’s been a long time since I’ve had this sensation.”
“I told you it would be no problem.”
“What’s next? Are we going to keep going to another place?”
“No more, five shops are enough; it’s almost time. Let’s just wait patiently here. I estimate that in half an hour at most, these guys will find us.”
“Brother Lin, how could he possibly know where we are?”
“Don’t forget what Boss Jin does for a living, and his men are all over this place. Once they figure out our background, finding us is as easy as flipping his hand for him.”
“Then, what will they do once they catch us?”
“Relax, by now, Boss Jin is full of interest in me. He will definitely bring me over for a thorough questioning, and by then, I’ll naturally get my chance to get close to him.”
“Okay, but Brother Lin, have you considered one thing? If you just go to see him like this, do you think Boss Jin would agree to release someone just because you asked, especially since you’ve smashed up so much of his property?”
“Don’t worry, I naturally have my ways.”
“Alright, I understand that. Now all we can do is wait here.”
With that said, he turned to glance back, then pointed toward a bench, and the two of them quickly headed over.
During Lin Yi’s wait, his phone rang. Looking down, he saw it was Liu Yao calling him.
Based on the timing, Liu Yao should have already returned to the scene by now.
If they managed to arrive safely, at the very least, he could truly relax.
“Liu Yao.”
“Brother Lin, we’ve arrived.”
“Oh, that’s good. Was the journey smooth?”
“It went very well, I’ve returned home with my mom, and Ling’er has already gone back to the factory.”
“Okay, I got it. Don’t worry about anything else, just take good care of your mom at home.”
“Brother Lin, where should I go these next few days? Should I also go to the factory?”
“No need. When I’m not around, you’re free to do as you please. If I’m here, just stay by my side. If needed, I will contact you by phone.”
“Alright, I understand. Brother Lin, why do I feel something is odd?”
“Odd? What’s odd about it?”
“I sense that there are many strangers around the house, some of whom I’ve never seen before.”
“Strangers? What do you mean? Isn’t it normal for strangers to appear in your community?”
“It should be normal, but I just have this feeling that these people are oddly out of place.”
“What do you mean? Are you saying someone is watching you?”
“Yes, that’s the feeling I have.”
“Who are they? Can you see anyone suspicious at home right now?”
“Right now, I can’t see anything. I just feel that the square is filled with a lot of strange people, constantly walking back and forth, so I’m not clear on the situation.”
“Liu Yao, listen to me, don’t go anywhere, lock your doors and windows, and I will arrange for protection as soon as possible.”

chapters.title: Chapter 551: 551: Waiting to be Caught
chapters.content:
Chapter 551: Chapter 551: Waiting to be Caught
“Protection? Brother Lin, what exactly is going on? Why would someone suddenly want to harm me?”
“Well, I’m not clear on that either, but since you have this feeling, I think we’d better be careful. Maybe your feeling is wrong, but as long as you’re with me, I won’t allow any deviations, got that?”
“Okay, Brother Lin, now I get it. Before you mentioned it, I didn’t sense anything, but the moment you brought it up, I started feeling this creepy sensation on my back.”
“Enough, don’t think too much about it. When the time comes, I’ll arrange for someone to protect you as soon as possible, that’s it.”
After finishing, Lin Yi hung up the phone.
He turned to look at Hei Lang sitting next to him.
“By the way, can you arrange for a few people in Xiangcheng?”
