“No problem, all our guys are in Xiangcheng, and I also have a few of my own brothers. Tell me, big brother, what do we need to do?”
“I suspect Liu Yao might be targeted.”
“What? Liu Yao is targeted? But why would anyone target her, a mere nurse from out of the hospital?”
“I don’t know either, and the more I think about it, the weirder it seems. Normally, those people should be following me.”
“Following you? That’s also odd, Brother Lin, who would be after you?”
“I’m not sure, but I always feel it must be related to that old guy.”
“Old guy? Which old guy?”
“Before I came here, I met an old man. Ah, forget it, it’s pointless to talk about this with you now, but I need you to ensure that Liu Yao and her daughter are protected.”
“Sure, no problem, I’ll just make a call to arrange it.”
“Go ahead, tell them to be careful, and if they feel unsafe, move them to a secure location, and hold off until I get back to handle things.”
“Okay, got it.”
After saying this, Hei Lang nodded, then picked up the phone and walked over to the side.
A few minutes later, Hei Lang came back looking quite relieved.
“How did it go, everything arranged?”
“Rest assured, everything’s perfectly taken care of, there won’t be any problems.”
“Good, I hope we can expedite our matters here, too. If we keep delaying like this, even we won’t be able to afford it, we’ve spent too long in this small town.”
“Yeah, it’s been far too long, it all seems so meaningless, but since you say it’s worth it, big brother, I’ll keep waiting as you say.”
“Sigh, look at these people over here.”
Just then, they saw a few people approaching from the other side, seemingly just chatting and strolling leisurely towards them. From the outside, there seemed to be nothing unusual.”
“Big brother, what do you mean?”
Because this place itself is a public area, it’s quite normal for people to come and go.
He couldn’t tell what was going on.
“Do you think those people look like they’re coming for us?”
“For us? Big brother, they just seem like passersby.”
“No, I have a feeling they’re significant. What do you think? Can you handle them by yourself?”
“Big brother, that’s way too easy, right? I can stand still and finish them off with one hand.”
“But remember, if it turns out they are really here for us, you absolutely must not resist, you must remember this. And do not expose your own strength, understood?”
“You mean I need to let them take me without a fuss?”
“Yes, if you even slightly resist, we might not have such an easy time meeting him afterward.”
“Alright, I understand.”
After speaking, Hei Lang nodded, then looked over in that direction.
At that moment, he made eye contact with one of them.
That person’s eyes emitted a strong sense of killing intent.
This suddenly made Hei Lang realize that what Lin Yi had told him was indeed not without reason.
It proved that those people really came for him.
Shortly thereafter, those people made their way right to him.
“There are a lot of people around here, and I don’t want to cause a scene. If you know what’s good for you, you’ll stand up and come with me now.”
Before Lin Yi could react, he felt something hard press against his back.
It was clear that the other party had come with weapons.
“Fair enough, I’ll offer no resistance, and I hope you’ll be merciful.”
“Cut the talk and stand up, move!”
“Okay, I get it.”
Lin Yi simply nodded, yet he didn’t feel the slightest fear.
He believed everything was under his control, and that he had no reason to be afraid.
Guided by these men, they slowly walked out from there.
As they reached the street, Lin Yi saw a white van parked there.
Then, two men pushed them into the van.
“Here, put this on.”
“Is this really necessary?”
Seeing this, Lin Yi could only shake his head helplessly.
What they handed over were two black cloths clearly meant to blindfold them, indicating the path they were about to take must be kept secret from them.
But the estate was just there, and if they were going to meet Boss Jin at this time, they surely had to enter the estate. Could it be that even the route to the estate must be kept from their knowledge?
“Enough talk. If you want to live, put it on now.”
“Fine, fine, don’t rush me, I’m putting it on.”
Lin Yi knew when under someone’s roof you must bow your head, so he had to fully cooperate with them. Only by doing so might he have a chance of meeting Boss Jin smoothly.
With no other choice, the two of them reluctantly put the black bands over their eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 552: 552 Exposed
chapters.content:
Chapter 552: Chapter 552 Exposed
They only felt that the car was moving forward continuously and that, moreover, the road was smooth with hardly any bumps.
Lin Yi roughly estimated that the car had been driving for about 10 minutes.
Soon, he felt that the car had come to a steady stop.
“Come, get out of the car.”
Immediately after, he felt someone grab his arm and then forcefully pull him from the vehicle.
Under the guidance of two people, they felt themselves walking forward for about another 5 minutes.
During this time, he heard that the surroundings were very quiet, and he could smell a strong fragrance of flowers.
They continued forward, encountering another set of stairs, which he then climbed step by step.
Two people came over and removed the black cloth from their faces.
When the blindfold was first removed, Lin Yi seemed to have some trouble adjusting to the light around him, then vigorously rubbed his eyes.
He saw clearly that he was now standing inside a resplendently golden hall.
The sheer size of the hall made it feel almost unimaginable to him.
All around, the decorations were lavish and regal.
In the central position, Lin Yi saw a young man holding a white dog in his hands.
His hand continuously stroked the fur of the dog.
“Kneel.”
Suddenly, two people rushed over and kicked forcefully at his legs.
Lin Yi was completely unprepared and fell to the ground with a thud.
Hei Lang, however, didn’t go down so easily. After all, he was battle-hardened, and even after a couple of kicks to the knees, his legs felt as hard as stone.
He was momentarily stunned, then signaled to a person beside him.
After two people exerted themselves for quite a while, they looked back at Hei Lang, and Lin Yi gave him a look.
Only then did Hei Lang relax a little, and afterward, he was also forced to the ground.
“Friend, I don’t think there’s any need to treat us this way. Moreover, we can stand here and talk to you. Why do we have to kneel?”
“Damn it, you’re really courting death. Don’t you know who you have offended? The person in front of you is Master Jin.”
At this, Lin Yi lifted his head to take a look.
Since he had come in, that person had never looked at him properly, and he had been looking down all the time.
It seemed like the dog he held in his arms was more important than the two of them.
“Master Jin, are you Master Jin?”
He just felt somewhat surprised.
Although the hunter had told him earlier that Master Jin was not very old and that he was called Master Jin simply as a term of respect.
“What, do I not deserve this name?”
Finally, he spoke.
His voice sounded genuinely magnetic; therefore, he lifted his head to look at Lin Yi.
Quite a handsome face it was, and fair and delicate at that.
It made him feel as if this person had never been through any hardships.
That’s not right.
Memories began to flicker in his mind.
The hunter had described that at that time, he must have done a lot of business, and moreover, he should be a person who had traveled far and wide.
At the very least, he wouldn’t be in the state he was in now.
Therefore, he could tell at a glance that this person was definitely not Gold Master.
“Heh, there’s really no need, my men have already been detained by you, and my goal was to meet Gold Master. What, don’t I even have that qualification?”
“Cut the crap, isn’t Gold Master the one sitting in front of you right now?”
“Don’t lie to me, it might fool somebody else, but you see, I’m definitely not Gold Master,”
Lin Yi seemed to be very certain.
Even Hei Lang standing by the side was starting to feel uncertain.
At the time, he remembered the hunter had once told him that Gold Master should look quite young, and according to the hunter’s description, this young man in front of him largely fit the bill.
Why was Lin Yi so sure that all this was not his doing?
“Damn it, I think you’re really asking for it.”
A man in black suddenly charged forward.
“Wait a minute.”
The young man just waved his hand, then stepped forward.
He sized up Lin Yi from head to toe.
“Who exactly are you?”
“I’m just a guest who has come for a visit. I’ve already told you, I have important matters to discuss with Gold Master. Please go and notify Gold Master.”
“Let me tell you, I am Gold Master. If you have something to say, say it directly to me. I’m giving you the chance now.”
“Heh, save it. If that’s the case, then I’d rather not say anything because you are definitely not Gold Master. Since you all have no sincerity, Gold Master, I know you’re in this room. If you truly intend to meet me, then show yourself.”
He shouted loudly toward the empty living room.
At that moment, Hei Lang was just stunned.
He quickly glanced around, half-expecting someone to actually be there.
But after a full search, he found that aside from himself, the room was empty, with no one else to be seen.
So, Hei Lang found Lin Yi’s actions at that moment somewhat strange.
“Heh, it seems like you really won’t cry until you see the coffin. Someone, teach him a lesson.”
The man had already decided it all.
Originally, he wanted to test the other’s authenticity.
However, he didn’t expect to be completely disregarded, a huge insult to him.
Now, with the master’s command, the thugs were probably going to show their true skills.
Upon seeing this situation, Lin Yi knew he couldn’t keep waiting here; otherwise, he would definitely end up worse off.
“Hei Lang, it’s your turn now.”
He quickly dodged backward and then took cover behind Hei Lang.
Hei Lang had been waiting for this moment for a long time.
When that group had captured him, he felt anger in his heart and wanted to teach them a lesson.
But the key issue was that just now Lin Yi had told him not to act rashly and ruin everything, so he had restrained himself for the time being.
“Alright, big brother, don’t worry about it now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 553: 553: Announcing Oneself
chapters.content:
Chapter 553: Chapter 553: Announcing Oneself
Hei Lang readily agreed, then with a leap, he soared into the air.
The several men in black present, totaling six, never imagined that this man, who often stood before them, would actually display his Qinggong.
“Quick, be on guard.”
Suddenly, one of them seemed to sense that something was amiss.
He shouted loudly, but the warning was too late.
Hei Lang’s speed was incredible; he spun down from mid-air and, with an outstretched leg, kicked the men to the ground.
And eventually, Hei Lang landed firmly in the center of the living room.
The young man took two steps back; he had never imagined that such a skilled fighter would be following this lean man.
“A bunch of trash, get up.”
He yelled loudly, and the group, enduring the pain, got to their feet.
Two of them even pulled out daggers from their clothing.
“Oh, I didn’t expect you to be armed, but this is even better, more fun to be had.”
Hei Lang was not the least bit afraid; he charged once more, and the men couldn’t even see his movements clearly.
They felt as if their arms were about to be snapped off.
Soon, a pained groan resonated.
Afterward, two daggers clattered to the ground.
The other two men, seeing the situation was bad, knew that if things continued this way, they too would end up on the ground.
They advanced and hastily dragged their two companions to the side.
“People, come quickly.”
The man who claimed to be Mr. Jin, sensing trouble, shouted loudly for help from outside.
Soon, a group of goons rushed in.
All of a sudden, the room was packed with people; Lin Yi carefully looked around and estimated there were about twenty.
The leader was a slender man who, judging by his appearance, probably had some martial arts skills.
He sized up Hei Lang and then approached him.
“May I ask which Sect does the gentleman come from?”
“The Xiaoyao Sect of Mount Lushan.”
After Hei Lang announced his affiliation, the listener hurriedly stepped back.
“May I ask which lineage you are a disciple of?”
“Heh, I’m but a humble disciple under the Fairy of the Xiaoyao Sect.”
“What did you say, you’re a disciple of True Person Luyao?”
“That’s right, it’s me.”
“What are you all waiting for, attack already.”
Originally, the young man had brought these goons in to deal with this problem; but, after hearing him reveal his Sect and master, he could barely contain himself.
“My apologies for the offense.”
The leading man simply clasped his fists and bowed, then with a gesture to Hei Lang, quickly walked past to the middle-aged man’s side.
Hei Lang merely looked at him with a sense of self-satisfaction.
Because, as long as he announced his own name, these people would generally be somewhat fearful.
Of course, if he could know all this, that would prove he too was a figure in the Jianghu, and moreover, his sect would likely have substantial deterrent power.
“What’s the situation?”
He slightly frowned, and then spoke to the man.
“The Xiaoyao Sect from Mount Luyao is not something we can provoke, and he is a disciple of True Person Luyao. With my ability, I simply cannot deal with him.”
“You, what are you saying? Even you can’t deal with him, then, what about the others?”
“The others, let’s not even mention them. Even if we bound ourselves together, I’m afraid we’d still be no match for him. Young master, it’s best to think thrice before acting, otherwise, we might suffer a heavy loss.”
“Is what you’re saying really true?”
“Yes, it’s true beyond a doubt. Just now, the moves he showed, I could tell, definitely come from the Xiaoyao Sect. Even though our sect is at odds with his, in terms of status, I am three times his junior. According to the ranks within our teacher’s lineage, I should respectfully call him ‘Grandmaster’.”
“Is it really that serious?”
“Yes, it’s that serious. So, it’s best not to let him make a move again; otherwise, we will be the ones to suffer.”
“Then, what should we do now?”
“The best approach now is to stabilize them temporarily and try not to let them make a move. Otherwise, in the end, we will surely be at a great disadvantage.”
“Alright, I understand. Take our men and hurry out, but still, take precautions before it’s too late. Set a watch at the entrance and then reveal all our mechanisms one by one.”
“Rest assured, I’ll arrange everything outside.”
“Good, then you may withdraw.”
After he finished speaking, he nodded and finally gave the order for the men to leave the room.
Lin Yi just felt something was strange.
Hei Lang hadn’t even made a move, so how had he managed to retreat these people so quickly?
Could it be that the name Hei Lang had just revealed really held such great power over them?
Lin Yi couldn’t help but start to feel excited.
If that was the case, it seemed the following matters would turn out to be smoother and even simpler.
“Hehe, young brother.”
His demeanor changed, and a smile appeared on his face once again.
“What, is there something you want to say?”
“I think, since a visitor has come to our door, such an inhospitable welcome is not how I, Jin Ye, usually conduct myself.”
“Hehe, no need to keep calling yourself Jin Ye. Moreover, if I’m not mistaken, you are not Jin Ye at all, so let’s not waste time here. Hurry up and bring out the real Jin Ye, shall we?”
“Whether I’m Jin Ye or not, you will naturally come to understand later. But right now, there’s one thing I’m focused on.”
“Oh, please, feel free to speak.”
“Since you have taken the initiative to come to us, I advise you to restrain yourself a bit. Moreover, I’m giving you a little face right now, so it’s best if your men refrain from acting rashly. In a moment, I will give you a clear response.”
“Alright, no problem. As long as you guys are respectful and courteous to us, my people will definitely not cause trouble.”
“Good, then you all wait here and rest for a bit, I will be right back.”
After speaking, he instructed the people by his side briefly, and afterwards, two people swiftly accompanied her as they departed from the scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 554: 554: The Real Master Jin
chapters.content:
Chapter 554: Chapter 554: The Real Master Jin
There were two other people in the room, but they just watched from a distance, not daring to easily approach.
“Big brother, this way.”
Hei Lang pointed towards the center of the room, then spoke to Lin Yi.
“How could we do such a thing? After all, we are guests, we shouldn’t steal the limelight from the host. Let’s sit down below.”
He pointed to a sofa, Hei Lang nodded, and the two walked over.
“Hei Lang, what exactly is happening?”
“That guy, he might also be from a prestigious lineage, but our Xiaoyao Sect is well-known in the martial world, and now I’m True Person Luyao’s disciple. So, if he knows even a little about the rules here, he’d know he’s no match for me.”
“Not bad, Hei Lang, I’ve never really heard you mention these things before.”
“Haha, those are all things of the past, and it’s been almost 10 years since I left the sect, so it’s better not to bring them up. By the way, big brother, where do you think they have gone now?”
“I’m afraid they’ve gone to meet the real Mr. Jin. Then they’re going to discuss the matter with him. If everything goes as expected, Mr. Jin should show up later and meet with us.”
“Really? Are you saying you’re certain he’s not Mr. Jin? But didn’t they tell us earlier that Mr. Jin is a young man?”
“I’m afraid everyone in town has been deceived by them. Besides, think about it, does all his energy match his current appearance?”
“Experience? Appearance?”
Hei Lang just frowned with difficulty.
He felt that he indeed hadn’t quite grasped what was being said.
“Are you saying there’s a difference there?”
“Yes, the difference is huge. If he had truly been through those hardships and created this commercial empire himself, he would not look like this. I’ve looked at the man carefully, he hasn’t been through any crises, and obviously, with his delicate, well-cared-for look, he should be a rich second generation.”
“Oh, I see. Big brother, you observe quite carefully. Otherwise, we really would have been deceived by them.”
“That’s why we must always be careful and cautious in everything we do. Do you understand?”
“Okay, I got it, big brother.”
Hei Lang nodded; in truth, when he first started following Lin Yi, he had great admiration for this ‘big brother’.
Although Lin Yi didn’t have any martial arts skills, he owed his life and gratitude to Lin Yi from their past, something Hei Lang likely would never forget.
Thus, Hei Lang had made up his mind very early that in this lifetime, he would follow no other, and he would never stray half a step from Lin’s side.
The young man hurried out from inside.
“Where is the old master now?”
“The old master is still in the back garden, where he might be interrogating that guy.”
“It looks like this person is really tough to deal with, I can’t deceive him. And with my current ability, I can’t control everything.”
“Should we seek instructions from the old master?”
“Exactly, we need to consult him now. Arrange for everyone to be on guard around the perimeter, just in case. Although we may not be a match for him, we have more people, and with traps around here, I believe we should be able to hold on for a while.”
“Okay, I understand.”
“By the way, one more thing, unless I command otherwise, no one is allowed to provoke him. If he makes any demands, try to accommodate them to the best of your ability to keep the situation stable. Got it?”
“Okay, I understand, young master.”
The man nodded cautiously.
It was known that Mr. Jin had been running things on his own in this town for many years, and frankly, had never suffered such a humiliation before.
This suddenly left his people feeling somewhat at a loss.
The young man hurried towards the back.
In the back garden, there was a very concealed house, rarely visited by anyone in normal times.
Only Mr. Jin himself had the privilege to enter this room.
As he arrived outside the door, he saw two men standing at the entrance, apparently standing guard there.
“Young master, what’s going on?”
As he walked over, one of the men stepped forward and asked.
“Is the old master still in the room?”
“Yes, the old master is still there.”
“There’s been some trouble outside, I must see the old master.”
“Right now?”
“Yes, right now. It’s urgent, and that man has significant influence. I can’t hold him off anymore.”
“Okay, I understand. Follow me.”
It was unusual for the young master to speak with such urgency, something they had never encountered in the past.
He quickly led him into the room.
In the empty room, there was a large screen in the center.
Behind the screen, a young man was kneeling,
His head hanging down, and he seemed to have lost all will to fight.
On the other side of the screen sat an elderly man with white hair.
In his hands was a teapot,
And from the marks on the teapot, it seemed to be quite old.
“Ling’er, what brings you here?”
“Grandfather, there’s been some trouble outside, I need to speak with you further.”
“Okay, I got it. Take him away, and without my orders, no one is to attend to him, understood?”
“Yes, old master, I got it, come with me.”
With those words, he grabbed the man and dragged him out of the room.
“Ling’er, rushing in such a panic, how unseemly. Didn’t I tell you that no matter what happens, you should not panic? I expect you to take over for me in the future.”
“Grandfather, I know, but there’s a young man outside now. He’s actually very poor, and he has a skilled person with him who has already repelled my men. He says he must meet with you.”
“Meet with me? Why does he want to meet me? Wasn’t it you he was supposed to meet?”
“Yes, grandfather, but he saw through me right away. He said I’m not the real Mr. Jin. He wants to meet the real Mr. Jin, so now I’m struggling to hold him off, and I’ve come to see you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 555: 555: You're an Impostor
chapters.content:
Chapter 555: Chapter 555: You’re an Impostor
“What? He saw through you? How is that possible? For all these years, no one in town has been able to see through that.”
“Yes, Grandpa, so I feel that this person must be someone with a significant background. What should we do now?”
“Where is he now? In which place?”
“He, he’s currently sitting in the front hall. I’ve arranged for others to set up traps outside the door, but I’m worried that, with the ability of the expert by his side, they may not be able to deal with everything.”
“What about Chang Le? Isn’t he there?”
“It was Chang Le who told me, and moreover, Chang Le said a few words to him. That person by his side claims to be from the Xiaoyao Sect of Leshan.”
“What did you say? The Xiaoyao Sect of Leshan? Are you sure you didn’t hear it wrong?”
“I really didn’t hear it wrong, and also, I heard their conversation very clearly. I realized something was not right, so I came to tell you.”
“The Xiaoyao Sect of Leshan, they have been missing in the martial world for so many years. I never expected their descendant to appear again.”
“No, the person looking for you is not the one from the Xiaoyao Sect of Leshan. I’m referring to another person by his side.”
“Whoever it is, people from the Xiaoyao Sect of Leshan are definitely not to be underestimated. And let me tell you, the Xiaoyao Sect is a very powerful sect. Even if we in the Jin Mansion unite, we might not necessarily be their match.”
“Grandpa, are they really that strong?”
“Indeed, they could be a supreme expert of unparalleled prowess. Over all these years in the martial world, there have been very few news of them. Even 30 years ago, as long as someone from the Xiaoyao Sect announced their name, everyone else would be scared witless.”
“Wow, that’s really incredible, isn’t it?”
“It’s true. So we must be cautious. Now, you wait for me in the room. I’ll go meet this young man.”
“Grandpa, please be careful.”
“Don’t worry. Since he’s come to see me, there must be some matter, so between him and me, there should still be room for discussion.”
“Okay, I understand. Then I’ll go back to the room to wait. If anything happens, you must tell me, Grandpa.”
“Rest assured, I know what to do.”
After Mr. Jin finished speaking, he just nodded, and then, he left the room.
Indeed, just as Lin Yi had guessed, this man was the real Mr. Jin.
And the one who had appeared before was just his grandson.
In order to hand over the entire Jin Family’s business to him, he had always been quietly working behind the scenes for many years.
He had never considered that the real purpose was to enable him to take full control of the enterprise.
However, now that this person had suddenly appeared, he definitely could not let this disrupt all his plans.
“Master, what’s the situation?”
It seemed that the two people by his side had been with him for nearly over 20 years.
In terms of martial arts, they were both top-notch experts.
They usually were responsible for the old master’s safety and did not interfere with anything else.
“A person from the Xiaoyao Sect of Leshan has appeared.”
“What? The Xiaoyao Sect of Leshan? That’s impossible. On the martial world, they’ve been gone for so many years. In my opinion, it seems somewhat unlikely, but he really did mention the name of the sect.”
“Perhaps, he is just pretending?”
“That’s why you two will come with me to see what’s going on. I will not show myself right now. If it is confirmed that he is from the Xiaoyao Sect of Leshan, I will appear then. If he is not, you two will handle the matter.”
“All right, I understand.”
After the two people finished speaking, they nodded and then quickly followed the old master toward the central main hall.
He pushed open the door and then immediately saw the two people sitting inside.
One of them was frail and short, looking much like a pale scholar.
The other seemed robust and muscular. Presumably, the one who announced himself from the Xiaoyao Sect of Leshan should be him.
Lin Yi observed these people.
He felt that, whether in terms of dress or appearance, neither matched the temperament of Mr. Jin.
He sensed that there must be something else going on here.
Even more likely, these two people might be the ones Mr. Jin had sent to test him.
“Let’s see, which one of you claims to be from the Xiaoyao Sect of Leshan?”
One of the men approached, then looked at Hei Lang and asked.
“Hehe, I’m not capable enough, but yes, the person who mentioned his master’s name is indeed me.”
“Oh, you belong to the Xiaoyao Sect? Then let me ask you, what is your relationship with True Person Lexian?”
“Regrettably, True Person Leshan is my master.”
“Your master?”
“Yes.”
“You say he is your master, and so he is? Then let me ask you, where is your master now?”
“I apologize, but I cannot tell you. Moreover, many people in the martial world are searching for his whereabouts, so I absolutely will not reveal this to you.”
“Hehe, if you won’t reveal it, then that proves you are a fake.”
“Whether I’m a fake or not, I believe you have your own way of verifying. And since you can say my master’s name, I believe you also must be a member of the martial world, right?”
“Yes, I am indeed part of the martial world. So, I want to see where this impostor really comes from. Let me ask you, the Xiaoyao Sect of Leshan has a unique martial arts technique. I don’t know if you have mastered it?”
“Unique martial arts? Hehe, I think it’s not necessary to use our unique martial arts to deal with you. The basic skills are enough to handle someone like you.”
“Quite a big talker, come on, show me what you’ve got.”
As they spoke, he suddenly charged forward.
Lin Yi quickly took two steps back.
He felt that the man’s speed was like a shadow, moving so fast that he disappeared from his sight in a flash.
In that moment, Lin Yi hesitated. Where did he go? How did he vanish just like that?
Following that, he looked as Hei Lang quickly dodged, turning his body and aiming a kick behind him.
It was only at this moment that Lin Yi realized that the man had evaded behind him with just a sidestep.

chapters.title: Chapter 556: 556: Such Impressive Qinggong
chapters.content:
Chapter 556: Chapter 556: Such Impressive Qinggong
“Impressive, such incredible Qinggong, no wonder he dares to claim he’s from the Yueshan Xiaoyao Sect?”
Lin Yi thought to himself in amazement.
“Indeed, since you’ve discovered my presence, then I can’t let you remain in this world.”
Following that, he uttered a cold snort and violently swung his arms outward.
Instantly, his clothing transformed into numerous fine threads that, under his control, flew towards Lin Yifei.
Lin Yi’s reaction was swift as he immediately dodged to the side.
...
Though these threads were few, their power was immense, surely causing injury upon impact.
And at that moment, the man also leaped up and pounced directly forward, his right leg shooting out in a vicious kick toward Lin Yi.
Seeing this, Lin Yi immediately retreated several steps, and then, with a flick of his finger, sent a steel needle flying straight through the man’s knee.
“Ah…”
With a scream of agony, the man fell to his knees, the severe pain causing his body to tremble as sweat poured from his forehead, dripping onto the ground.
“Heh, you’re hardly a challenge,” Lin Yi said with a laugh and then twisted the guy’s arm forcefully.
“You, let me go,” the man struggled and said.
But Lin Yi simply couldn’t be bothered with him and dislocated his arm without a second thought.
“Ah…”
Following that, Lin Yi picked up a dagger and casually sliced it across the man’s wrist.
Blood immediately began to flow, dripping onto the ground below.
“Let me tell you, today, we have come for revenge, and anyone who stands in our way will be considered our enemy,” Lin Yi stated indifferently.
“What do you want to do?” Another man asked, watching the two and frowning even deeper.
At this time, Lin Yi smiled, “Nothing much, we just want to let you know what happens to those who offend our Xiaoyao Sect.”
Lin Yi stared at the two men, his expression cold.
“Haha, young man, I know what you’re trying to do, but let me give you a piece of advice: give up your delusions. Our Yueshan Xiaoyao Sect is not something you can insult,” one of the men said.
“Let me tell you, our Yueshan Xiaoyao Sect is quite renowned in the Jianghu,” the man added.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi laughed and said, “Heh, who are you trying to scare? Your sect, still calling itself the Yueshan Xiaoyao Sect, do you think I’m a fool? Our Xiaoyao Sect is secluded from the Jianghu, while you’re nothing more than Loose Cultivators wandering around.”
With that, Lin Yi took the forged invitation he was holding and flung it at their feet, “My master said that as long as one isn’t blind, they would recognize this immediately.”
The man picked it up and looked at it, then shook his head, “Heh, it seems the legacy of your Xiaoyao Sect is almost lost, even if I gave this to you, you wouldn’t be able to discern its authenticity.”
“My master once taught me that everyone in this world is good at pretending. This invitation might just be the work of a con artist, and you’re likely just hired killers paid by this scammer,” Lin Yi said with a sneer.
“Not only have you tricked us out of our money, but now you even dare to covet my things, my master’s possessions—how could the likes of you even touch them?”
As he spoke, Lin Yi stood up and launched an attack on the two men.
Though the martial arts of these two were of lower standard, the fact remained that they were skilled fighters.
Their movements were elusive and their speed was astonishing, making it nearly impossible for Lin Yi to track them.
“Hmph, no matter what, my master is a grandmaster-level figure. If you don’t want to die, you best surrender willingly,” Lin Yi observed, noting that the actions of the two were becoming more and more unpredictable.
“Hmph, it’s true that your Xiaoyao Sect has decent martial arts, but unfortunately, you’re too young. My disciple and I have lived for hundreds of years,” a middle-aged man said.
“Hmph, lived for hundreds of years? Pft, do you even deserve to live that long? You’re just struggling to stay alive.”
Lin Yi said contemptuously.
“You little brat, you’re really asking for death by insulting our ancestor. Do you believe I can slice you in half with one swing of my sword?”
The nearby young man bellowed angrily.
“You can try, see if you can even touch me.”
Lin Yi replied fearlessly.
After hearing that, a fierce light flashed in the young man’s eyes.
He drew his longsword from his waist and aimed it at Lin Yi.
“Heh, come on then, if you’ve got the guts, try to chop me down.”
Lin Yi said disdainfully.
Upon hearing this, the young man clenched his teeth, and the veins on the hands holding the sword hilt bulged.
“Just you wait.”
The young man shouted angrily, and then, putting all his strength into his hand, he thrust forward, and immediately a fierce Sword Qi burst forth from the tip of the blade, heading straight for Lin Yi.
“Hm?”
Upon seeing this, Lin Yi narrowed his eyes.
It seemed this young man was quite strong indeed, worthy of being a disciple of the Xiaoyao Sect.
Lin Yi refused to be outdone, a mischievous smile appeared on his lips, and with a tight grip, a streak of black and white lightning appeared in his palm.
Boom!
The next second, Lin Yi threw a punch, and the black and white lightning exploded from his fist, charging straight towards the young man.
The young man’s face turned pale in shock.
He hastily retreated, dodging this attack.
“Hmph, what kind of Cultivation Technique is this? Why is it so strange?”
The young man frowned and said.
He could tell that the move Lin Yi had just used seemed like some sort of Magic.
But they had never heard of any Magic that could transform someone’s attack into Magic itself.
This was simply outrageous.
“Demon, you’re nothing but a demon.”
At this moment, the middle-aged man looked at Lin Yi with immense fear and exclaimed.
After hearing these words, a disdainful curve appeared on Lin Yi’s lips, and with a flick of his hand, a burst of flames condensed out of thin air.
In Lin Yi’s hand was a blazing ball of fire.
“Heh, this is my Fire Attribute Cultivation Technique, known as the Sky-Scorching Flaming Palm.”
Lin Yi said with a cold laugh.
Then, he fiercely swung his right hand out.
Instantly, a blistering flame arrived in a flash, striking the middle-aged man’s chest like a meteorite.
Ah!
At that moment, the middle-aged man let out a piercing scream.
Afterward, his whole body was enveloped by the flames, and as they seared him, his clothes were completely burned away, leaving his body charred.
Ah!

chapters.title: Chapter 557: 557 It's Just Trash
chapters.content:
Chapter 557: Chapter 557 It’s Just Trash
The middle-aged man, under the torment of flames, let out a heart-wrenching, ear-piercing howl.
At this time, his body, under the burning of the flames, began to become fragile.
Soon, the middle-aged man’s body was burnt to ashes.
“Hmph! Ignorant fool, the cultivation technique my master taught me is not something you can insult,”
Lin Yi said coldly.
“You, you’re a demon,”
...
Another person, with a face full of terror, stared at Lin Yi.
“A demon?”
Lin Yi was taken aback.
“Do you have any idea what kind of power the Xiaoyao Sect is?”
The young man snorted coldly and said, “My master is the sect master of Xiaoyao Sect, Xiaoyao zi!”
“Oh? So it’s Xiaoyao zi.”
After hearing that he said he was Xiaoyao zi, Lin Yi was also taken aback and then nodded his head.
“Xiaoyao zi? Never heard of him, just another piece of trash,”
Lin Yi said indifferently.
“You, you, you’re asking for death!”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, the young man immediately became furious.
“Hehe, looking for a fight? I’m always up for it, but are you sure, can you really beat me?”
Lin Yi said with a slight smile.
“You… you…”
After seeing this scene, the young man was instantly at a loss for words.
What Lin Yi said was indeed the truth.
“Since you’re unwilling to hand over the antidote, then I have no choice but to kill you.”
After finishing speaking, Lin Yi walked straight towards the young man.
Seeing this scene, the young man immediately started panicking.
“Uncle-master, save me!”
The young man cried out in utter terror.
However, Lin Yi paid no attention to him, and with a slap, struck the young man.
The young man, being hit by such a slap, was sent flying five or six meters away, crashing into a wall, and directly passed out vomiting blood.
The young man was clearly not lightly injured and probably wouldn’t wake up anytime soon.
Looking at the young man unconscious on the ground, the middle-aged man’s face turned ashen, his eyes flashing with intense hatred.
“I will never let you go!”
The middle-aged man glared fiercely at Lin Yi and said.
Lin Yi shrugged.
“Sorry, it’s not about me letting you go, it’s about you letting me go!”
Lin Yi said with an unconcerned demeanor.
“Hmph, don’t think you can escape our Xiaoyao Sect’s pursuit.”
The middle-aged man glared at Lin Yi, grinding his teeth.
“Well then, let’s wait and see!”
After finishing speaking, Lin Yi turned and left the scene.
Watching Lin Yi’s departing figure, the middle-aged man’s face grew darker.
“Master, what should we do now?” the young man asked, seeking the middle-aged man’s advice.
The middle-aged man said in a cold voice, “First go back and report, tell them to increase manpower and continue searching those bones.”
Hearing the middle-aged man’s words, the young man nodded and then led a few fellow disciples away from the place.
As he watched their departing figures, Lin Yi’s brows furrowed slightly.
Lin Yi didn’t want to stop them from seeking those bones, but he didn’t like the idea of his possessions coveted by others.
Therefore, if they failed to retrieve the bones of those people, he would also take some other measures to ensure they disappeared from this world.
With that thought, Lin Yi made a silent decision in his heart.
“I will let you live a little longer,” Lin Yi muttered to himself.
Afterward, Lin Yi left directly.
In the days that followed, the area remained calm and uneventful, which eased Lin Yi’s mind somewhat.
He was no longer the Lin Yi of the past; if he encountered danger now, he could escape swiftly.
Under Lin Yi’s protection, no one dared to make a move against the town for the next two days.
Lin Yi could finally breathe a sigh of relief.
“Lin Yi, we should leave this city now!”
That evening, after dining with Chen Hao and Zhang Feng, the trio planned to leave the small town and return to their own town.
After all, they had already stayed in this place for a long time; if they didn’t go back soon, followers from the Xiaoyao Sect would likely come looking for trouble.
Although their strength was formidable, they were no Heavenly Emperor realm cultivators, but merely ordinary Martial Saints in the Saint Realm.
The Xiaoyao Sect, after all, had three cultivators of the Heavenly Emperor realm.
Now, they stood no chance of resistance.
“Okay, let’s head back now,” Zhang Feng agreed with a nod.
Chen Hao also nodded in agreement.
Consequently, the three of them packed up and left the place.
“By the way, Lin Yi, people in this city seem to be talking about something,” Zhang Feng suddenly mentioned.
“What’s that?” Lin Yi asked curiously.
“Recently, a group entered this small town and killed many people,” Zhang Feng recounted.
“Oh? Is that so?”
Lin Yi’s eyebrows lifted slightly as he heard Zhang Feng’s words.
“Yes, and those people were disciples of the Xiaoyao Sect. They say the disciples were carrying tokens of the Xiaoyao Sect, so many people are wary of provoking them,” Zhang Feng explained.
“Xiaoyao Sect’s tokens?”
A certain image flashed in Lin Yi’s mind.
“You mean Xiaoyao the Eccentric?”
“Right, the Patriarch of the Xiaoyao Sect, Xiaoyao the Ancestor!”
“I didn’t expect Xiaoyao the Eccentric from the Xiaoyao Sect to have come to this city,” Lin Yi said.
“I don’t know about that; I just heard about it. I found out yesterday that the patriarch was looking for their remains, and I wanted to tell you right away.”
“Oh, then let’s head back.”
Lin Yi’s expression showed a trace of interest upon hearing this.
Xiaoyao the Eccentric, was a powerhouse in the Heavenly Emperor realm, and it was rumored that he was once a formidable figure within the Xiaoyao Sect.
However, he fell into disfavor with someone from the Heavenly Court, was thrown into the Heavenly Prison, and eventually suffered a fate worse than death.
It was said he was tormented for thousands of years, died a miserable death, and not even his complete corpse was left intact.
As a result, the disciples of the Xiaoyao Sect believed that Xiaoyao the Eccentric deserved severe punishment from the Heavenly Court, or it would be a disgrace to their whole sect.
Though the Patriarch of the Xiaoyao Sect was killed, his remains were never retrieved by the Heavenly Court.
After such a long time, Lin Yi wondered what the patriarch intended. Could he truly be content with death, to the point of leaving no remains behind?
“This old monster definitely won’t be satisfied with death; he will surely find every possible way to take revenge on the Heavenly Court, even to the extent of seizing treasures from the Heavenly Court,” Lin Yi speculated, his eyes flashing coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 558: 558 No Fondness at All
chapters.content:
Chapter 558: Chapter 558 No Fondness at All
Lin Yi had no fondness for the carefree old monster at all.
Moreover, he knew that the carefree old monster had come here with him before and had even attempted to kill him, but in the end, he was defeated by Lin Yi and met with a tragic fate.
If it weren’t for his good luck in encountering a master named Li Yunlong who helped him, he probably would have died long ago.
Thinking of the carefree old monster, the corners of Lin Yi’s mouth couldn’t help but reveal a trace of scorn.
“Hehe, you old thing, just wait for me to return!”
Lin Yi thought to himself with a sneer.
...
…
Over the past two days, they had been racing towards the town.
During these two days, Lin Yi, Chen Hao, and Zhang Feng had stayed in their rooms without going out.
Throughout these days, they had been cultivating in their rooms.
Moreover, their strength had improved quite rapidly; in just two short days, Lin Yi’s strength had already reached the Eighth Layer of the Nascent Soul Stage and was subtly, increasingly close to the Ninth Level.
Although Chen Hao and Zhang Feng didn’t have Lin Yi’s bizarre energy absorption rate, their strengths weren’t far apart either.
Lin Yi’s strength breakthrough filled them with fighting spirit.
“Finally, we are nearing the town.”
A glint of light flashed in Chen Hao’s eyes, as the town was his goal.
This town was their destination; they were returning to their ancestral home to see their mothers.
“It’s been so long since I’ve been back; we’re finally going home.”
Chen Hao sighed and said.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi also felt wistful.
For hundreds of years, Lin Yi hadn’t visited his parents either. Not only that, he had gone through a lot, and so he missed them terribly.
“Yeah, it’s been so long since I’ve seen my parents, I wonder how they are now.”
Lin Yi sighed and said.
As he finished speaking, Zhang Feng comforted him, “Don’t worry, Brother Lin, I think your parents will be very happy with you.”
Lin Yi heard this and shook his head slightly, remaining silent.
His parents certainly hoped that he would find his own happiness, but his happiness was something he could never regain.
This time, his parents probably wouldn’t stop him either.
He believed that if his parents knew he had found someone he liked, they would definitely bless him and not stand in his way.
Between them, there was only a blood relationship, and it couldn’t be called love.
Naturally, these were thoughts Lin Yi would not share with Chen Hao.
“Let’s go, let’s head back!”
Lin Yi spoke indifferently, taking the lead and flying outside.
“Alrighty!”
Zhang Feng immediately nodded and followed behind Lin Yi, flying out as well.
This time, they did not return via the Teleportation Formation as before, but instead used their Flying Swords, rushing towards the direction of the town at high speed.
“Brother Lin, are we returning now? I can’t wait to go back and see my parents!”
Zhang Feng said.
“Yes, I think after we arrive in town, we can visit your parents and clarify this matter with them then!”
Lin Yi nodded and said.
“That would be great; I was worried you might not want to meet my parents or go there.”
Zhang Feng said cheerfully.
“Don’t worry! Since I’ve promised, I won’t go back on my word. When we get to town, I’ll come to your house to see. If there’s a suitable opportunity, I’ll explain things to your parents.”
Hearing this, Zhang Feng finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Afterward, the three of them continued to fly.
After half a day’s journey in the air, at last, they caught sight of the small town’s outline.
The town was not particularly far from their own, just two hundred kilometers away, which they would reach shortly.
There was still some distance between the town and where Lin Yi and the others lived.
However, this journey of over two hundred kilometers took them two days.
“We can finally go home.”
Looking at the increasingly closer small town, both Zhang Feng and Lin Yi were thrilled beyond measure; they were filled with emotion, as their hometown was within this town.
“Hahaha, we’re finally going back!”
Gazing at the familiar silhouette of the small town ahead, Zhang Feng and Lin Yi burst into hearty laughter.
Lin Yi and Zhang Feng slowly descended from the sky.
“Eh, how come there’s still no one to greet us at the door?”
As soon as they landed in the town, Zhang Feng noticed that it seemed utterly silent, bereft of any signs of life.
They arrived at the entrance of the small town, looked over it, and still saw a desolate scene.
The town appeared very ancient but exuded a sinister vibe, as if it wasn’t as tranquil as it seemed on the surface.
“Could it be that this town hasn’t seen a visitor for centuries?”
This thought made both Lin Yi and Zhang Feng highly suspicious.
Exchanging a glance, they both saw a hint of confusion in each other’s eyes.
“It seems we need to go in and investigate.”
Zhang Feng spoke with a determined tone, clearly intent on seeing this through.
“Let’s go, let’s head in.”
Lin Yi nodded, then led Zhang Feng as they stepped into the town.
As soon as they entered, they were instantly surrounded by a group of people.
“Kid, who are you, daring to stir up trouble in our town?”
A man in black led the group, with a sullen face and eyes bulging fiercely.
Looking at this fellow, both Zhang Feng and Lin Yi felt disdain in their hearts.
“Hmph, who I am is none of your business. Hasn’t anyone visited your town?”
Zhang Feng scoffed coldly.
“How dare you! To speak to me in such a manner is to disrespect our Town Lord. Today, I shall teach you what real respect is!”
The man in black roared, ready to make a move.
“Beat it if you don’t want a beating, or don’t blame me for not being polite!”
Lin Yi’s eyebrows knitted slightly as he swept a cold glance over the man in black and spoke in a frosty tone.
At that moment, the man in black shuddered, his gaze filled with deep fear upon meeting Lin Yi’s eyes.
In his memory, never had someone dared to speak to him with such audacity.
Although this young man’s strength didn’t seem formidable, that cold gaze sent shivers down his spine.
Nevertheless, the humiliation he felt lasted only a moment before the man in black regained his composure.
“Hahaha! Such arrogance, telling me to beat it. Who do you think you are?”
The man in black laughed loudly as he struck with a palm, aiming for Lin Yi’s face.
A cold glint flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes.
This fellow did have considerable strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 559: 559: There are actually two brushes!
chapters.content:
Chapter 559: Chapter 559: There are actually two brushes!
Lin Yi’s right hand swept through the air, and a streak of azure light emerged, transforming into a cyan long spear that thrust toward the black-clothed man’s arm.
“Clang!”
A sound of metal clashing rang out, and the black-clothed man was sent retreating dozens of meters.
The black-clothed man exclaimed in alarm, looking at Lin Yi with a face full of shock.
“You bastard, to actually have some skills!”
The black-clothed man’s eyes were cold as he stared at Lin Yi with a heavy expression.
...
“You’re quite impressive too, to actually be at the Fifth Rank Martial King Realm!”
Lin Yi’s eyes sparkled with a thread of sharpness.
This black-clothed man was actually four levels higher than Lin Yi, which made Lin Yi extremely cautious.
“Hmph, boy, I’m telling you, you’d better know what’s good for you, and kneel down here to admit your fault. Otherwise, I’ll make sure you die a miserable death!”
The black-clothed man roared with fury, his eyes flashing with intense killing intent.
Hearing this, Lin Yi simply smiled lightly, his eyes brimming with scorn.
“Hmph, I want to see who’s going to die a miserable death!”
Lin Yi bellowed and threw a punch, blasting it toward the black-clothed man.
Seeing this, the black-clothed man, unwilling to show weakness, also threw a punch toward Lin Yi.
The clash of their fist forces produced a thunderous boom, sending a wild gale that snapped all the nearby trees.
Although this clash was only a probe, both used every trick in the book, eager to gauge the other’s strength.
But the results disappointed them both.
The black-clothed man’s strength turned out to be on par with Lin Yi’s.
This surprised Zhang Feng quite a bit; he hadn’t expected to have misjudged the situation.
“Hmph, turns out you’re not that great. You can’t even beat me. It seems the Town Mayor has really been toying with us!”
Lin Yi snorted lightly, speaking with dissatisfaction.
He had been prepared to search the Town Mayor’s Mansion in hopes of finding some treasure. Perhaps then, he could improve his cultivation. But now, his thoughts were fully focused on the Town Mayor’s Mansion, and he had no intention to bother with anything else.
“Boy, you can’t blame the Town Mayor. The Town Mayor possesses Great Divine Power, a force you cannot contend with. Even if you are formidable, how could you ever compete with the Town Mayor?”
The black-clothed man spoke.
Hearing this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but curl his lip; he didn’t believe the Town Mayor was just an ordinary person.
“Hmph, there’s no need to keep flattering the Town Mayor. Even if he is an ordinary person, he’s not someone trash like you could deal with. Today, I’ll teach you, this rotten guy, a lesson, so you’ll think twice before bullying the people of our small town again!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly and once again swung the longsword in his hand, charging at the black-clothed man.
The black-clothed man, seeing Lin Yi rush over, hurriedly tried to dodge.
But his speed was not even close to Lin Yi’s level.
Very quickly, Lin Yi caught up with the black-clothed man and swung his longsword once more, slashing at him.
In his panic, the black-clothed man didn’t dare meet the attack head-on. Suddenly, a huge blade appeared in his hand and he viciously chopped down at Lin Yi.
“Clang!”
A massive metallic collision sounded, sparks flying and deafening everyone.
Lin Yi’s body drifted backward, while the black-clothed man was sent back more than ten steps before he stabilized himself.
“You… how are you so strong?”
The black-clothed man looked at Lin Yi with a face full of astonishment and disbelief.
Lin Yi smiled faintly, a cold light flickering at the bottom of his eyes.
“Hmph, if that’s all the ability you have, I advise you to leave this small town as soon as possible and stop embarrassing yourself here!”
Lin Yi sneered coldly, his figure suddenly flickered and vanished once more.
This time, when he reappeared, he was already behind the man in black.
“You!”
The man in black turned around, looking at Lin Yi with eyes full of shock.
He had thought that this young brat was just a weakling without much strength.
To his surprise, the boy’s speed was so fast that he couldn’t react in time.
The man in black’s expression changed, and he no longer dared to be careless. He quickly drew out a huge sword and thrust it toward Lin Yi’s chest.
The longsword in his hand was pitch-black, emitting a faint chill.
As the longsword cut through the air, a sharp gust swept toward Lin Yi.
The man in black was using a technique powered by a Mysterious Weapon, terrifying in its might—this was an Intermediate Grade Mysterious Weapon.
The man in black unsheathed his longsword and thrust it toward Lin Yi’s heart.
Lin Yi was startled and hurriedly dodged.
But just as he had dodged, the man in black took advantage of the momentum to sweep his sword horizontally.
“Clang!”
The longsword struck Lin Yi’s Qinglong Crescent Blade, making a crisp sound as a powerful force transferred up to Lin Yi’s wrist.
Lin Yi felt his wrist go numb, nearly unable to hold the Qinglong Crescent Blade, almost letting it fly out of his hand.
He hastily retreated, and the Qinglong Crescent Blade in his hand dropped to the ground as well.
“What’s the matter? Boy, do you realize the gap between us now? Let me tell you, the Town Mayor’s strength is extraordinarily terrifying. He is the overlord of this region, and you commoners will never compare to him!”
The man in black said arrogantly.
Lin Yi’s face turned somewhat ugly, knowing that what the man in black said was true.
However, this made him very uncomfortable.
“You bastards, only bullying the weak and fearing the strong, you are not fit to be the Town Mayor’s lackeys!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly and once again raised the Qinglong Crescent Blade, attacking the man in black.
Lin Yi held the longsword and executed the Nine Yang Sword Technique.
This Nine Yang Sword Technique was the cultivation technique Lin Yi was most skilled at, with tremendous power.
“Hmph, with your pathetic swordsmanship, you think you can harm me? Ridiculous!”
The man in black sneered with disdain, the longsword in his hand vibrating as he launched an attack at Lin Yi.
The man in black’s longsword, with its piercing wind and endless murderous intent, struck at Lin Yi as if to tear him apart, an overwhelming pressure bearing down on him.
Lin Yi’s eyes remained calm, facing the fierce Sword Qi without panic, he raised his Qinglong Crescent Blade and struck fiercely at the man in black.
“Ting-a-ling!”
Lin Yi’s Qinglong Crescent Blade collided with the man in black’s longsword, producing a clear metallic clang.
Sparks flew, and Lin Yi’s Qinglong Crescent Blade was actually split right through by the man in black’s sword.
The man in black’s longsword continued to hack toward Lin Yi without stopping.
“This is impossible!”
The man in black cried out in disbelief.
His longsword, being of Mysterious Weapon Level, couldn’t possibly be blocked by Lin Yi’s flesh, no matter how astonishing his defensive power might be.

chapters.title: Chapter 560: 560 A Look of Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 560: Chapter 560 A Look of Shock
However, Lin Yi’s flesh was far tougher than that of a Mysterious Weapon Level blade; the man in black’s sword strike hadn’t left a scratch on him.
“This kid is not simple at all!”
The man in black furrowed his brow, showing a look of shock in his eyes.
“Hahaha!”
Lin Yi suddenly burst into loud laughter, his voice filled with disdain as he mocked, “To think you’d dare to use such a shoddy weapon, the Town Mayor really overestimates you!”
After saying that, Lin Yi suddenly threw the Qinglong Crescent Blade in his hand towards the man in black. It flew at him with such speed that it seemed not of human capability, but more like a cannonball.
...
The man’s face changed abruptly; although he was strong, he had no understanding of Martial Arts, and couldn’t use them as proficiently as Lin Yi.
Therefore, when the Qinglong Crescent Blade approached him, he could only hastily reach out to grab it, catching the blade in his hand.
However, his palm was wounded, dripping with blood; his flesh was even starting to rot.
The man in black shouted and quickly let go of the Qinglong Crescent Blade, wiping off the blood on his hand.
“Damn it!”
The man in black cursed under his breath and glanced at Lin Yi before quickly fleeing towards the Town Mayor’s Mansion.
“Thinking of running? It’s not that easy!”
Lin Yi called out coldly and immediately gave chase.
With the Qinglong Crescent Blade in hand, he chopped fiercely at the man in black.
“Boom!”
The Qinglong Crescent Blade struck the ground hard, creating a trench several meters deep right in front of him.
Lin Yi moved with extreme speed, and in a blink of an eye, was right behind the man in black.
Hearing the sound of something cutting through the air from behind, the man quickly turned around, and seeing Lin Yi chasing after him, his heart panicked.
In haste, the man waved his hand, and a talisman flew out from his sleeve, transforming into a ferocious tiger in the midair that pounced towards Lin Yi.
The tiger, with bared teeth and claws, let out a roar that seemed to shake the heaven and earth as if to tear the sky asunder.
Lin Yi narrowed his eyes slightly, and his Qinglong Crescent Blade danced in the air, creating a vortex that swallowed the charging tiger.
“Roar!”
The tiger roared incessantly within the vortex but was unable to break free.
“Hmph, a mere trifle!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, and swung the Qinglong Crescent Blade once more.
“Puchi!”
The Qinglong Crescent Blade cleaved the tiger in half, blood spraying wildly, splattering the entire courtyard.
Seeing this, the man in black gasped in shock, a deep sense of dread filling his heart.
“This kid is too formidable! He blocked my attack with such ease!”
Trembling inside, the man in black thought.
“What does your Town Mayor think he is, daring to mess with me? It’s simply courting death!”
Lin Yi sneered.
“Kid, I was rash today and shouldn’t have provoked you. How about you spare my life?” the man in black said through gritted teeth, feeling extremely humiliated inside.
He had originally planned to kill Lin Yi and then the Town Mayor, seizing the Qinglong Crescent Blade and the Town Mayor’s Token.
With that accomplished, his mission would be complete, and he could return to the town.
I never expected to encounter a powerful person like Lin Yi.
Although he practices the Yin Yang Technique, his strength is insufficient, and he can only use some basic martial arts.
Lin Yi said with a cold laugh, “Spare your life, Who do you think you are? A rat? I am not so easily bullied!”
As Lin Yi spoke, a towering battle intent burst forth from his body, soaring to the sky as if it were tangible sword intent shooting upwards.
He stepped forward and charged directly at the man in black, swinging his Qinglong Crescent Blade fiercely.
The man in black’s eyelids twitched wildly as he hurriedly dodged.
His legs, however, moved involuntarily toward the back, wanting to distance himself from Lin Yi.
“Since you so desire my life, I will show you what true blade intent is!”
Lin Yi sneered, his body disappearing from where he stood once again.
Seeing Lin Yi vanish abruptly, the man in black was overcome with alarm, aware that Lin Yi’s sword intent was formidable, but he hadn’t anticipated it to be so intense that it could traverse through space!
His face changed dramatically, not daring to delay, he immediately took out a Copper Coin, muttering words under his breath.
Under his control, the Copper Coin flew into the air.
Afterward, the man in black threw the Copper Coin to the ground, and suddenly a dazzling light flared up, forming a light screen that protected him within.
The glaring light scattered, enveloping the man in black.
A layer of black light also appeared on his body, encasing him in protection.
Seeing this situation, Lin Yi’s heart sank. He was very puzzled as to what the man in black was doing.
Upon closer inspection, Lin Yi realized the radiance emanated from the Copper Coin, not from the man himself.
“So that’s how it is!”
Lin Yi understood and nodded silently, realizing that this method was indeed effective. It could reduce a lot of trouble, eliminating the need to worry about being entangled by these people, unable to escape.
“Kid, I’d like to see how you will kill me!” the man in black shouted angrily from within.
The light was summoned by the man in black using a Formation, calling forth a type of puppet.
As long as the puppet was not slain by Lin Yi, the man in black could stay young forever, but if the puppet was killed by Lin Yi, the man would grow old and eventually die.
“You think to trap me with a formation, but I too can use formations to kill you!”
Lin Yi’s lips curled into a smile. With a flick of his right hand, he materialized the Qinglong Crescent Blade in his grasp and swung it down.
As the Qinglong Crescent Blade struck down, a vicious behemoth’s phantom appeared in the air, ferociously brandishing its claws and teeth with a terrifying sharpness as it pounced towards the man in black.
This was an attack secret technique called ‘Dragon Tiger Battle’ that Lin Yi had seen in ancient texts.
A fierce tiger materialized behind Lin Yi, roaring and baring its teeth as if ready to devour its prey!
“Such a method for attack can only trap the enemy and poses no threat to me!” Lin Yi remarked with a cold laugh, swinging the Qinglong Crescent Blade once more.
“Bang!”
The Qinglong Crescent Blade collided fiercely with the dark tiger, creating a burst of brilliant sparks. The blade’s edge left a long gash across the tiger’s chest.
“Ah!”
The man in black let out a miserable scream, stumbling backwards several steps.
“Don’t think such tactics will befuddle me,” the man in black roared, his face deathly pale.

chapters.title: Chapter 561: 561 Extremely Fast Speed
chapters.content:
Chapter 561: Chapter 561 Extremely Fast Speed
The Runic Copper Coin in his hand flew above his head once more, activating the Formation again, and immediately, beams of golden light shot down, transforming into ropes.
They bound toward Lin Yi with incredible speed, tightly securing his limbs and preventing him from moving.
“Hmph! You think you can hold me?”
Lin Yi let out a cold laugh as he swung the Qinglong Crescent Blade in his hand.
Instantly, the blade’s light surged, like a Flood Dragon emerging from the sea, sweeping across and severing all the ropes in a blink of an eye!
“You wanted to kill me? Then let me kill you instead!”
...
Lin Yi sneered coldly, his figure as fast as lightning, and with a slash of the Qinglong Crescent Blade, he left a pitch-black trail in the air.
“Ah!”
Lin Yi charged again, his figure flickering and appearing beside the man in black like a specter.
His speed was too fast, too quick for the man in black to even respond!
With a single slash, a line of blood appeared on the neck of the man in black, and blood gushed forth.
The man in black’s pupils shrunk dramatically, his face filled with disbelief. He stared wide-eyed at the bloody hole in his neck, panic-stricken.
“You… you actually killed me!”
The man in black struggled to utter these words, then collapsed with a thud, never to speak again.
After the man in black was killed by Lin Yi, the light barrier from the Copper Coin also dispersed.
The body of the man in black also tumbled down.
Lin Yi sheathed the Qinglong Crescent Blade, jumped, and descended from the air to land beside the body of the man in black.
At this moment, all the Copper Coins on the man’s body were slashed to pieces by Lin Yi and had fallen to the ground.
Lin Yi bent down to pick up a Copper Coin and carefully inspected it, finding that it was a coin covered with cracks, seemingly enduring thousands of years.
“It seems, this must be the legendary Immortal Artifact.”
Lin Yi slightly furrowed his brows, not expecting to find an Immortal Artifact here, much less a damaged one!
Without giving it much thought, he immediately pocketed the Copper Coin and once again took to the skies, heading toward the depths of the valley.
He needed to find a cave dwelling or a treasure site quickly, then enter the cave to obtain its treasures.
“Can’t delay any longer, or if that old man recovers, I won’t be able to escape his pursuit!”
A chill ran through Lin Yi’s heart as he stomped on the ground and rapidly ran deeper into the valley, vanishing from everyone’s sight in the blink of an eye.
Shortly after Lin Yi disappeared, those who had been surrounding and attacking him swooped down from above the valley, standing before the body of the man in black.
“You imbeciles, to be killed by a mere Martial Apprentice, you’ve thrown the face of our Demon Sect!”
The Demon Sect disciple cursed loudly, his face gloomy and full of rage.
“Senior brother, let’s chase!”
Upon hearing this, the others roared angrily, deploying their Qinggong and giving chase.
“Master, let’s chase too!”
One of the men in black hastily called out. Along with that Demon Sect disciple, the six of them headed in the direction Lin Yi had disappeared, intent on capturing him and bringing him back.
The other two men in black searched around the valley for any trace of Lin Yi.
Although they had not discovered any trace of Lin Yi, there were some marks in the soil and vegetation around the valley, which clearly indicated that the recently slain person had been cut by a Qinglong Crescent Blade.
“I don’t believe that you can hide forever, one day, I will tear you to pieces!”
One of the black-clad figures clenched his teeth and growled, his eyes filled with intense hatred, treating Lin Yi as if he was his sworn enemy.
Another person nodded and said, “That’s right, Master, once I capture that little mongrel, I’ll torture him well, let him know the consequences of offending our Demon Sect!”
As the disciples of the Demon Sect tracked through the depths of the valley, they cursed through gritted teeth.
In the valley.
“Eh? No one’s here?”
Suddenly, Lin Yi stopped, turned around, and looked deeper into the valley.
To his left, there was a hidden woodland, which Lin Yi had discovered through the trees.
The black-clad figure should have been killed by him, yet Lin Yi still couldn’t find any trace of the Demon Sect disciple.
“It’s strange, that Demon Sect disciple’s cultivation is not as good as mine; he couldn’t have gone far. Why can’t I find him?”
Lin Yi frowned, unable to sense the aura of the Demon Sect disciple, as if the person had vanished into thin air.
“Could it be that the Demon Sect disciple’s escape technique is extremely powerful, allowing him to vanish over a short distance without a trace, so I cannot sense his aura?”
Lin Yi muttered softly.
After thinking for a while, Lin Yi shook his head, convinced that the Demon Sect disciple couldn’t escape, especially since he had just slain a Martial Ancestor.
The Demon Sect disciple certainly wouldn’t dare to flee and must be hiding somewhere, waiting to fall into his net.
However, he was currently unable to sense the Demon Sect disciple’s aura and thus, could not lock onto it.
Having figured this out, Lin Yi prepared to continue deeper into the valley, hunting for his prey.
Lin Yi walked into the woodland, heading towards the densest part of the forest.
“Hmm? Someone’s been here?”
Suddenly, Lin Yi halted, surveying his surroundings with a look of puzzlement in his eyes.
“Could the Demon Sect disciple be hiding nearby?”
Lin Yi speculated, his gaze sweeping around.
“Eh? Whose figure is that?”
Lin Yi’s eyes suddenly brightened as he caught sight of a familiar figure in the underbrush ahead!
There lay a black-clad figure in the bushes, motionless, seemingly unconscious.
“That Demon Sect disciple is actually passed out in the underbrush?”
Surprise flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes; he had thought the Demon Sect disciple’s escape technique was formidable enough to avoid his detection.
But unexpectedly, the Demon Sect disciple lay unconscious right under Lin Yi’s nose in the underbrush!
“Although this Demon Sect disciple is not weak, he stands no chance against me. If it were someone else, they surely would have noticed him, but he lies unconscious in the underbrush, unseen by all.”
“If this Demon Sect disciple truly is attempting to escape, wouldn’t that save me a lot of trouble? All I would need to do is kill him.”
Lin Yi’s gaze was icy, his face shrouded in a murderous aura as he stared at the Demon Sect disciple.
In Lin Yi’s heart, the death sentence for the Demon Sect disciple was already decided. Killing this Demon Sect disciple would credit Lin Yi, and not only would the Demon Sect not seek revenge, they would reward him handsomely, perhaps even sending an elder to personally recruit him.

chapters.title: Chapter 562: 562 Where to escape!
chapters.content:
Chapter 562: Chapter 562 Where to escape!
After all, Lin Yi’s potential was extremely terrifying; given time, he was certain to surpass those top monstrous geniuses.
Though this disciple of the Demon Sect was also strong, he was still a far cry from those top monstrous geniuses and wasn’t worth mentioning.
“Whoosh whoosh whoosh…”
Suddenly, several figures dashed over from a distance, unmistakably the disciples of the Demon Sect!
Lin Yi looked at these five disciples of the Demon Sect with a slight frown, a cold light flickering in the depths of his eyes.
“Lin Yi, you actually dare to come back; I want to see where you could escape to today!”
...
“Hmph! I knew you would show up here, today I must grind your bones to dust!”
The Demon Sect’s disciples glared at Lin Yi with extreme ferocity, their eyes filled with a chilling murderous intent.
“Lin Yi, I didn’t expect you to have escaped, but you don’t realize that your death is destined. Today, we will grind your bones to dust!”
The leader among those Demon Sect disciples glared at Lin Yi with murderous intent flooding his eyes, the killing aura enveloping him.
“Hmph!”
Lin Yi sneered, not taking them seriously at all.
Although Lin Yi was unaware of the exact background of these Demon Sect disciples, he believed that with just these disciples, they weren’t a threat to him. As long as he used his thunderous methods, he could wipe out these Demon Sect disciples in one fell swoop; they were simply unworthy of consideration!
“There is a smell of blood here; you killed that disciple. Have you already killed his companions too?”
Lin Yi suddenly asked with a somewhat cold tone, as if probing something.
“That’s right! We have indeed killed that person. His cultivation was too high, and he managed to escape. We chased him all the way but failed to catch up, so we had no choice but to come back,” replied the Demon Sect disciple with a cold glance at Lin Yi, his tone full of mockery.
“You were lucky to have escaped. However, since you have come here, you might as well stay,” Lin Yi said indifferently.
“Humph, such arrogance. Who do you think you are to defeat all five of us? You’re dreaming!”
The Demon Sect disciple burst into an angry shout upon hearing these words.
In his eyes, Lin Yi was just a cultivator at the peak of Martial Ancestor realm, and with just the strength of the peak Martial Ancestor realm, how could he possibly be their match?
“You are a disciple of the Demon Sect; don’t you know who I am?” Lin Yi said lightly.
“Who are you?” The Demon Sect disciple was taken aback.
“Have you ever heard of the ‘Heavenly Demon Sect’?” Lin Yi asked in return.
“Heavenly Demon Sect! You’re from the ‘Heavenly Demon Sect’! You’re actually a disciple of the ‘Heavenly Demon Sect’!”
The Demon Sect disciple exclaimed, his eyes filled with shock and wariness. He had not expected Lin Yi to be a disciple of the ‘Heavenly Demon Sect’, no wonder he was so powerful, and could even easily break into the depths of the Heavenly Sword Mountain!
“I am a disciple of the ‘Heavenly Demon Sect.’ For you guys, it’s a death well deserved,” said Lin Yi coldly as he surveyed them, a wicked smile curling up at the corner of his mouth.
“Impossible, impossible, you clearly have only the strength of the peak Martial Ancestor realm, how could you possibly be a disciple of the ‘Heavenly Demon Sect’? You must be spouting nonsense!”
The Demon Sect disciple panicked, denying it immediately.
“Heh, have you ever heard of a Martial Ancestor at the Peak realm being able to injure a half-step Divinity Transformation Realm expert?”
Lin Yi sneered disdainfully.
“You are correct, there has been none,” the disciple from the Demon Sect shook his head, but then suddenly raised his head, his eyes filled with a crazed look.
“Since you are a person from the ‘Heavenly Demon Sect,’ we are enemies of the ‘Demon Sect,’ and today, you must die. Otherwise, the entire Heavenly Sword Mountain range will not be at peace, so I must kill you today!”
The disciple of the Demon Sect said through gritted teeth, a towering murderous intent surging from his body!
“Is that so? Since that’s the case, then I am very much looking forward to our battle!” Lin Yi said coldly, his gaze indifferent and ice-cold.
Lin Yi knew if he did not quickly resolve these five disciples of the Demon Sect, what awaited him would inevitably be a bitter fight!
Lin Yi had already decided, no matter the cost, he must slay all five disciples of the Demon Sect, he absolutely could not let them leave this place alive!
“Haha, since that’s the case, then don’t blame me for not being polite! I will make you taste the suffering of a fate worse than death!”
The disciple from the Demon Sect sneered viciously, a surging Demonic Qi rose around him, enveloping his figure and making his appearance ferociously monstrous!
“Since that’s the case, then let me see just how much strength you really possess!” Lin Yi shouted coldly, his eyes sharp as lightning, fixing on the Demon Sect disciple.
The Demon Sect disciple snorted coldly, his palm waving, and a pitch-black long knife emerged from within his body, held in his hand, and then with a flick, he swung the knife down, a black blade light howling towards Lin Yi!
The black blade light was extremely fast, producing an ear-piercing sonic boom, ferocious and swift like a meteor streaking across the sky!
This move was the Demon Sect disciple’s strongest attack, greatly powerful, a single swing tore open the void, ripping a pitch-black gap that faintly emitted bursts of chilling wind!
“Swoosh!”
The black blade light flashed by, and in an instant, it had already reached Lin Yi!
“Hmm?”
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s heart tightened; he had not expected the Demon Sect disciple to be so powerful, having already stepped into the half-step to Divinity Transformation Realm. Such a speed of cultivation was too fast, utterly terrifying!
“Brother Lin! Get out of the way! His knife is terrifying!” Someone beside the Demon Sect disciple shouted in alarm, hastily warning him.
“Boom!”
But at that moment, a powerful aura exploded forth, a golden Protective Shield rising from Lin Yi, enveloping his figure!
“Bang!”
A loud noise resounded as the pitch-black long knife collided with the Protective Shield, creating terrifying fluctuations, and visible ripples spread out in every direction!
“Bang bang bang…”
“Rumble!”
Series of muffled sounds came, and the faces of the Demon Sect disciples changed drastically. They had not anticipated that Lin Yi could actually withstand their combined strike, which filled them with dread and their expressions turned extremely solemn.
“You really are a bunch of trash, all together come at me!” Lin Yi sneered, saying, “Come on then, I want to see just how strong you really are, to see if you can beat me!”
Lin Yi exuded an imperious aura, the energy bursting from him not at all inferior to the disciples from the Demon Sect, leaving the many Demon Sect disciples in shocked disbelief.
“Lin Yi, you are indeed very strong! But no matter how strong you are, you still cannot escape the fate of death! Today will be the day you die!”
The Demon Sect disciple bit his teeth, a vicious light flashing in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 563: 563 Golden Glow
chapters.content:
Chapter 563: Chapter 563 Golden Glow
“Die? It’s not certain who will die yet!” Lin Yi sneered, his body also bursting forth with a dazzling golden radiance.
He activated his “Vajra Body”, his muscles bulging like they were cast from iron, emitting an extremely terrifying aura.
“Kill!”
A Demon Sect disciple growled and charged towards Lin Yi first, swinging his long saber directly at Lin Yi’s chest.
Lin Yi sneered, his right fist clenched tight, a terrible force, like a tide, bursting forth from his fist and surging towards the Demon Sect disciple.
“Bang!”
...
A violent collision sounded as Lin Yi’s fist clashed with the Demon Sect disciple’s long saber, sending the saber flying away.
The Demon Sect disciple’s arms trembled slightly, feeling a numbness in his limbs.
Lin Yi’s condition was similar, although he did not retreat, he also didn’t gain the upper hand.
Lin Yi had not expected that this Demon Sect disciple could be so powerful, actually able to block his punch!
Although the Demon Sect disciple was at the Second Layer of the Nascent Soul, Lin Yi could feel the surging, vast True Essence Fluctuation from him.
Clearly, this Demon Sect disciple had stepped into the Divinity Transformation Realm, and his strength was even greater than the previous Fourth Layer Nascent Soul Demon Sect disciple, reaching the peak of the Divinity Transformation Realm, just half a step away from successfully advancing to the Fifth Layer!
The Divinity Transformation Realm, that was equivalent to the strength of the Fifth or Sixth Layer of the Nascent Soul!
This also meant that the strength of this Demon Sect disciple was comparable to a Seventh Layer Nascent Soul being!
“Brother Lin, you must be careful!”
The Demon Sect disciple’s face showed a trace of solemnity; he had not expected Lin Yi to block his strike, and it seemed he was not at a disadvantage!
“I want to see just how many strikes you can withstand!”
The Demon Sect disciple snorted coldly, swinging his long saber to continue his assault on Lin Yi, attack after attack, the dense saber lights raining down like drops of rain, dazzling to the eyes.
“What a terrifying attack, it’s making my eyes blur!”
The saber technique of the Demon Sect disciple was extremely fierce, each strike faster and more ruthless than the last!
Such a terrifying attack, if not for Lin Yi having the protection of a strong body like the “Vajra Body”, he simply couldn’t withstand such an assault!
“Spurt!”
Another slash, a mist of blood sprayed out, a chunk of flesh was cut from Lin Yi’s shoulder, and bright red blood spurted out!
A piece of flesh was chopped off Lin Yi’s left shoulder, gory and bloody, with blood spurting out!
Lin Yi groaned, feeling a sharp pain on his shoulder, his face also showing a hint of agony.
“Hmph, Lin Yi, let’s see how long you can block for, you definitely can’t avoid this one!”
The Demon Sect disciple snorted coldly, once again swinging his long saber towards Lin Yi.
“Clang clang clang!”
Several more strikes, the dense saber lights fell like rain, chopping down on Lin Yi.
“Spurt!”
“Spurt, spurt, spurt…”
Blood splattered everywhere, Lin Yi was hit by several slashes, his body marked with numerous cuts, bleeding profusely.
“How is this possible? Lin Yi is injured so badly!”
“Can Lin Yi’s strength really be greater than that of a Fifth Layer Nascent Soul?”
“How can this be!”
Seeing this scene, those Demon Sect disciples all widened their eyes, full of disbelief.
