Lin Yi’s body was terrifyingly strong, even when they cut him, he could quickly recover, yet this time, Lin Yi was slashed leaving many wounds!
They had never thought that Lin Yi could be so seriously injured!
The Demon Sect disciple stared at Lin Yi with eyes brimming with mockery, said, “Lin Yi, weren’t you very arrogant? Now, I will let you understand what true strength is and drive you into utter despair!”
Having said that, he once again swung the long saber in his hand, furiously slashing towards Lin Yi’s chest!
“Swoosh!”
Just at this critical juncture, Lin Yi’s figure abruptly vanished, and in the next moment, he reappeared behind the Demon Sect disciple, delivering a kick.
“Boom!”
The Demon Sect disciple screamed in misery, his body flying backward and smashing heavily against the mountain cliff, causing the cliff to collapse!
“Hiss!”
Everyone inhaled sharply, their eyes filled with shock.
“Such terrifying speed!”
“Lin Yi is incredibly powerful, how did he dodge such a terrifying attack!”
“I want to know that too!”
The Demon Sect disciple clambered up from the rubble, his body covered in dust, his clothes in tatters, with many areas revealing stark white bones.
The disciple wiped the fresh blood from the corner of his mouth and looked up at Lin Yi, his eyes burning with rage.
He had never imagined that Lin Yi could be so strong, to the point that he had suffered severe injuries after merely three moves!
He felt humiliated, infuriated!
“Lin Yi, I will remember this grudge! I will definitely kill you!” the Demon Sect disciple uttered through gritted teeth, a murderous look in his eyes as he glared at Lin Yi.
“Heh heh! I’m waiting for you to kill me,” Lin Yi replied with an indifferent smile.
Although Lin Yi was on the defensive in this battle, he did not panic. On the contrary, he grew braver as the battle progressed because he could clearly feel
his strength had reached the Nascent Soul Seventh Layer, and he was even on the verge of breaking through to the Divinity Transformation Realm, just a hair’s breadth away.
Therefore, Lin Yi was quite delighted, his strength finally making significant progress.
And this significant progress was the effect of his cultivation of the “Vajra Body”!
“Rumble!”
A loud boom, and the Demon Sect disciple lunged at Lin Yi once more.
“Ha!”
Lin Yi shouted lightly, and his body swelled in an instant, transforming to a height of two zhang.
Lin Yi’s frame became overwhelmingly muscular, and his entire being exuded a mighty and unrivaled aura, his body gleaming like metal, radiating dazzling golden light.
Lin Yi’s fist, accompanied by a swath of golden lightning, hammered out directly.
“Boom!”
The Demon Sect disciple was blasted away by Lin Yi’s punch, his body hitting a large tree in the distance and snapping the ancient trunk!
“Rumble!”
“Puh!”
The Demon Sect disciple spat out blood, his body reduced to a bloody pulp, all of his bones broken, and his organs severely damaged!
The might of a single punch, strong enough to potentially overcome even a Nascent Soul Eighth Layer cultivator, proved too much for the disciple, who was annihilated into nothingness.
Such power was truly astonishing!
One punch, slaying a Demon Sect disciple!
And this disciple’s strength was at the very peak of the Nascent Soul Sixth Layer, only a step away from the Nascent Soul Seventh Layer!
Yet even for a cultivator at the peak of the Nascent Soul Sixth Layer, it was impossible to kill another cultivator at the same peak with a single punch!
Lin Yi’s strength was terrifyingly formidable!

chapters.title: Chapter 564: 564: A Naturally Endowed Genius!
chapters.content:
Chapter 564: Chapter 564: A Naturally Endowed Genius!
This is simply monstrous, a genius touched by heaven itself!
The Demon Sect disciples looked at Lin Yi, their faces filled with intense fear.
“I don’t believe it, I refuse to believe it!”
One of the Demon Sect disciples roared in madness, unwilling to be killed in a flash like that!
“Buzz buzz buzz!”
A ring-shaped treasure shot up from his body into the sky, spinning in the air and forming a circle that enveloped him within.
...
Afterward, the Demon Sect disciple formed hand seals, and a mass of black mist gushed out from his body, wrapping around the ring and merging him with it!
The mass of black mist kept tumbling, with strands of black qi drilling out from it, turning into numerous black snakes that coiled around the Demon Sect disciple, continuously devouring his Nascent Soul.
Lin Yi frowned slightly when he saw this scene.
He discovered that the Demon Sect disciple also possessed a kind of evil Nascent Soul secret technique.
This Nascent Soul secret technique was called the “Soul Possession Technique”!
This technique could take over a cultivator’s physical body and Nascent Soul, making them his own, and as long as the person who was possessed was still alive, the taken Nascent Soul would never die!
“Damn it, what is this Nascent Soul secret technique!”
Watching the Demon Sect disciple use the Soul Possession Technique, Lin Yi’s expression slightly darkened.
“Possession, possession!”
“I’ll take over you, your physical body, Nascent Soul, and even your soul will belong to me!”
The Demon Sect disciple’s eyes were blood-red, his features fierce, as he bellowed to the sky, the black qi on his body growing thicker and his figure swelling up, rapidly becoming a colossal beast.
“Lin Yi, I’ll tear you to pieces, devour your Nascent Soul and physical body!”
“Boom!”
The Demon Sect disciple leapt up, lunging at Lin Yi to kill him.
His speed was extremely fast, reaching Lin Yi in the blink of an eye, with claws and teeth bared, striking at Lin Yi.
“Scram!”
Lin Yi roared, his right fist thundered out, bringing a torrent of Fist Force that collided with the Demon Sect disciple’s attack, creating a blinding flash of light!
The Demon Sect disciple was blown away by this powerful force, crashing to the ground in the distance, his body directly shattered by Lin Yi’s punch.
Such was the power of Lin Yi’s punch, so formidable that even cultivators of the Nascent Soul Realm at the Ninth Level dared not withstand it.
Seeing this, the Demon Sect disciples were petrified with fear and fled in all directions.
Lin Yi snorted coldly, his figure flashed as he pursued and killed all the fleeing Demon Sect disciples!
“Huh!”
Lin Yi let out a sigh of relief.
It was fortunate his physical body was strong enough; otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to withstand that punch just now and might have been blown apart and died a violent death.
Lin Yi collected his thoughts and took away the Storage Bags of these Demon Sect disciples, and he also placed their bodies in a Storage Ring for later disposal.
Having collected so many resources, Lin Yi felt extremely content, his gaze then turned to the remaining Demon Sect disciples, his eyes growing cold.
Those several hundred Demon Sect disciples saw this and their faces changed, retreating one after another.
Without any hesitation, Lin Yi took a step forward, his figure abruptly vanished from the spot, reappearing in the sight of everyone.
The several hundred Demon Sect disciples, seeing this, immediately showed panic on their faces.
“Lin Yi, don’t push us too far, even if we suffer heavy losses today, we will fight you to the death!” the Demon Sect disciple shouted angrily, his eyes glinting with a ferocious light and his body surging with intense killing intent, clearly prepared to go down with Lin Yi.
“Don’t be rash!”
“Don’t be rash!”
The several elders hastily attempted to appease the situation.
But the Demon Sect disciples wouldn’t listen; they attacked Lin Yi one after another, trapping him within a Formation.
As the Formation operated, it sealed his body inside, making it impossible for him to escape.
“Kill him!”
“Don’t spare his life!”
“His cultivation is too terrifying, we absolutely can’t let him leave alive!”
“If we kill him, he will definitely seek revenge!”
The elders spoke in quick succession, urging their disciples.
They knew how formidable Lin Yi was, if they let him leave alive, he would become a major thorn in the side of the Demon Sect!
The Demon Sect disciples all nodded and then charged to kill Lin Yi.
Each one of them being cultivators at the Nascent Soul Realm level, their combined power was extremely terrifying; even Lin Yi dared not confront them head-on.
However, Lin Yi wasn’t worried about these Demon Sect disciples.
Because all these Demon Sect disciples were cultivators at the Nascent Soul Realm, and he was merely at the first level of the Nascent Soul Realm, the disparity in strength was too great.
Therefore, Lin Yi didn’t fear these Demon Sect disciples; he merely needed to lure them out and then extinguish them all in one fell swoop.
So, Lin Yi dragged out the engagement with these Demon Sect disciples, not in a hurry to slay them.
“Swoosh!”
“Swoosh!”
“Swoosh!”
Lin Yi’s figure moved like lightning, weaving through the space and luring the Demon Sect disciples into a nearby forest, drawing them over.
“Whoosh whoosh whoosh…”
In a flash, Lin Yi arrived at the edge of the forest, with one stomp, the entire woods exploded, and a massive cave appeared beneath Lin Yi’s feet.
Lin Yi leapt up and dove into the cave, disappearing from everyone’s sight.
“Chase!”
Seeing Lin Yi flee into the cave, the Demon Sect disciples were enraged and immediately followed into the cave.
They wanted to capture him before he could react!
But once they were inside the cave, they discovered that Lin Yi was nowhere to be found.
They searched all over but couldn’t locate Lin Yi, which made them look unsettled and feel that something was amiss.
They had clearly seen Lin Yi rush out from within the cave, so how had he disappeared so suddenly?
Could it be that Lin Yi had hidden deeper inside the cave?
That couldn’t be right; there was a Restriction deep inside the cave, how could Lin Yi possibly evade the Restriction and escape?
“Wrong, I can feel that guy’s presence, there’s definitely something wrong with that cavern in the depths of the cave!” one Demon Sect disciple said gravely, sharing his thoughts.
“Let’s go, we must immediately rush to that cavern!”
“Go!”
“Swoosh swoosh swoosh swoosh…”
The Demon Sect disciples rose into the air one after another, rushing towards the cave’s perimeter, wanting to reach the cavern inside and capture Lin Yi!
After Lin Yi entered the cavern, he immediately set up a Teleportation Talisman, activating the cavern’s Teleportation Talisman, transporting them to another cavern.
“The Demon Sect disciples are already on a manhunt, it seems the guardians of the caverns have been dealt with!” Lin Yi thought to himself.
The guardians of the cavern must have been killed by the Demon Sect disciples; otherwise, they couldn’t have been taken care of in such a short amount of time.

chapters.title: Chapter 565: 565 Grim-faced
chapters.content:
Chapter 565: Chapter 565 Grim-faced
The Demon Sect disciples, after a relentless pursuit, finally cornered Lin Yi into that cave dwelling.
“Swish, swish, swish!”
The Demon Sect disciples, one by one, with a fierce look on their faces, launched their attacks toward Lin Yi.
“Hmph!”
Lin Yi sneered, summoned the Chaotic Sword, and slaughtered the Demon Sect disciples on the ground. Then, with a flicker of his body, he disappeared into the depths of the cave.
Although the Demon Sect disciples wanted to stop Lin Yi, they couldn’t intercept him due to his overwhelming strength and incredible speed.
...
“Lin Yi, stop right there, or I’ll take your life!”
The Demon Sect disciples roared furiously, their faces fierce and their eyes filled with hatred, as if they wished they could rip Lin Yi apart.
“Haha, come on then, who dares to catch me?” Lin Yi taunted.
“I will!”
Suddenly, a young man dressed in green robes, with handsome features, stood up. He looked at Lin Yi with a cold gaze. A vast fluctuation emanated from his body, causing the very space to tremble, seemingly unable to withstand the young man’s pressure.
That young man was none other than the number one genius of the Demon Sect, Han Lin!
His cultivation had already reached the Sixth Layer of the Nascent Soul Realm, and his combat power was formidable.
“Han Lin, you’ve advanced? Your cultivation speed is also way too fearsome!” Lin Yi stared at Han Lin, saying with surprise.
Han Lin was the second strongest expert of their Demon Sect, and his cultivation talent was extremely astonishing, having reached the peak of the Early Stage of the Ninth Level of the Nascent Soul Realm, on the verge of breaking through to the peak of the Ninth Level.
“Enough talk, let me see what skills you’ve got!” Han Lin snorted coldly, swinging a magic artifact as he charged towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi struck out with his palm, and a wild surge of True Yuan erupted from it, transforming into a massive palm print that bore down on Han Lin with a thunderous crash.
“Buzz!”
The magic artifact was instantly shattered by Lin Yi’s palm print, turning into dust that filled the sky.
“No good, he actually possesses a set of High Grade treasures!” Han Lin’s complexion changed drastically, and he hastily retreated.
The power of Lin Yi’s set of High Grade treasures was extremely formidable, making even the Intermediate Grade treasure in his hands far inferior.
“Is that all the tricks you have?” Lin Yi said indifferently, lifting his hand again and reaching out towards Han Lin.
Han Lin saw Lin Yi’s hand coming for him, and his expression changed drastically. He swung the magic artifact again, as terrifying forces burst forth, transforming into several dragons that rushed towards Lin Yi.
But with a single palm strike, Lin Yi dispersed all the dragons.
“No!”
Han Lin screamed in horror, his face turning pale as he was thrown back once more.
However, Lin Yi was right on his heels and grabbed him in his hand before tossing him onto a nearby stone table.
On the table lay lumps of flesh so mangled they were indistinguishable, still wet with blood that emitted a pungent, nauseating stench.
Han Lin was thrown onto the stone table.
“I want you dead!”
A chill spread across Lin Yi’s face as he reached out abruptly and grabbed Han Lin’s neck before squeezing forcefully, twisting off Han Lin’s head.
“Ugh…ugh!”
Han Lin’s head was torn off, with blood spilling everywhere. The sight was gruesome, causing his stomach to roll, almost making him vomit.
“Damn it, this Han Lin is too horrifying, my strength is no match for him, his cultivation is just too strong!”
Lin Yi’s expression was distorted with discomfort, and he felt extremely aggrieved inside.
He had originally hoped to use the restrictions of the cave dwelling to defeat Han Lin.
But Han Lin’s power was too terrifying; he had been defeated in a single move.
Such strength had already surpassed the Nascent Soul Realm, reaching the Early Stage of crossing tribulations!
And Lin Yi was merely a Golden Core Realm martial artist.
Compared to Han Lin, he was worlds apart!
Lin Yi’s power was only at the Nascent Soul Realm, far too inferior to Han Lin, and impossible to make a comparison, much like the gap between a common child and a grown, strong man, insurmountable.
“Brother Lin Yi…”
Zhao Xueru, standing by Lin Yi’s side, couldn’t help but cry out upon witnessing this scene.
Her face too turned ugly with worry.
“Don’t worry, he won’t hurt you.”
Lin Yi comforted her softly and then turned around to face Han Lin, “You have two choices. First, hand over all your storage rings and storage talismans. Second, well, take your own life.”
“Take my own life? You want me to commit suicide?” Han Lin snorted coldly.
“Exactly, and if you disagree, I’ll make sure you die a painful death,” Lin Yi said calmly, his voice filled with a hint of murderous intent.
Han Lin, hearing Lin Yi’s words, shuddered, feeling an unprecedented fear.
He was a cherished son of heaven, the Saint Heir of the Tianyuan Sect, his status incomparably noble!
Now being coerced by Lin Yi to commit suicide, how could he be willing?
Yet he did not dare to defy Lin Yi’s will.
He knew that if he did not agree with Lin Yi, he would indeed suffer terrible torture and die a tragic death.
“I’ll hand them over!”
Han Lin eventually agreed. He took out all his storage rings and placed them on the ground.
These storage rings and storage talismans were all his gains from his venture outside and were of great value.

chapters.title: Chapter 566: 566 Spoils of War
chapters.content:
Chapter 566: Chapter 566 Spoils of War
Moreover, he had slain quite a few Demon Beasts within the secret realm, and these items he had obtained were all his battle spoils, so Han Lin wasn’t particularly pained by the loss of this wealth.
“Alright, since that’s the case, let’s go. There’s no need for you to linger here too long, lest the night brings more dreams. It’s best to leave this place early,” Lin Yi said with a chuckle.
A sly smile of triumph appeared on his face, making Han Lin itch to rush forward and tear Lin Yi to pieces.
Han Lin didn’t want to stay here any longer, competing with Lin Yi in a battle of wits and courage.
He knew that with his own strength, defeating Lin Yi was simply impossible. Not only was Lin Yi overwhelmingly powerful,
but he also had an ace up his sleeve, an ace that could kill him instantly!
...
Han Lin had no choice but to compromise, for he had to compromise; otherwise, he would surely be tortured to death.
“Fine! We’ll leave this place right now,” Han Lin said in a deep voice.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi nodded slightly and, with a fluttering figure, swiftly walked towards the exit.
Having left, Lin Yi took his group of disciples and disappeared from Han Lin’s sight.
“Brother Lin Yi, why did you let that man go? He’s a heinous criminal, he killed so many of our fellow sect members. How can we not seek revenge?” a disciple asked with confusion, clearly not understanding.
The others all wore puzzled expressions, evidently just as unclear as to why Lin Yi had let go of the perfect opportunity to kill Han Lin.
“Because I sensed a formidable danger. His background is extremely terrifying. I’m no match for him!”
Lin Yi spoke.
As soon as these words came out, everyone was stunned.
This was the first time they heard Lin Yi utter such words; what a rare occurrence!
“Don’t think too much. He is the benefactor who saved Tianyun Star. We can’t just kill people willy-nilly!” Lin Yi said indifferently.
At his words, no one dared to speak, but their hearts were filled with doubts.
They weren’t fools; Lin Yi’s previous statement was clearly a lie!
As the Saint Heir of Tianyuan Sect, how could he be afraid of a human cultivator?
However, they didn’t have the courage to question Lin Yi, only suppressing their doubts silently.
Han Lin followed behind Lin Yi without uttering a word.
“Your name is Han Lin, right? Don’t worry, I will avenge you,”
Upon exiting the cave dwelling, Lin Yi suddenly stopped, turned around, and looked at Han Lin with a light smile.
Han Lin’s heart skipped a beat, and he couldn’t help but guess silently.
Was Lin Yi trying to make amends, or did he have another purpose?
“What are you trying to do?”
Han Lin asked, watching Lin Yi warily.
“I don’t want to do anything. I just genuinely want to help you get your revenge,” Lin Yi replied lightly, a shallow smile on his face.
“Hahaha, how ridiculous!”
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Han Lin couldn’t help but laugh.
This guy actually wanted to help him get revenge?
Han Lin found it extremely laughable.
“You think you want to help me get revenge? Have you lost your mind?” Han Lin sneered with a mocking laugh.
“Yes, I have indeed lost my mind, thinking I would want to help you get revenge.”
Lin Yi’s smile remained undiminished as he said, “You don’t need to provoke me. Provoking me will only make you die even faster!”
With that, Lin Yi took out a Flying Sword from his Storage Ring and threw it to Han Lin, saying, “Take it. This Flying Sword is a low-tier Earth Rank Spiritual Artifact. It should protect you.”
Then, with a flash, Lin Yi disappeared from the spot.
As Han Lin caught the Flying Sword, a surge of ecstasy welled up inside him.
Being a Body Refiner, what he lacked the most in his Body Refinement Realm was a Flying Sword.
And now, Lin Yi had actually offered him a high-level Earth Rank Spiritual Artifact willingly.
Although this Flying Sword is only a low-rank Earth Rank Spiritual Artifact, it is certainly no ordinary piece.
The price of this Spiritual Artifact would definitely be astonishing, with a value that could be described as priceless.
“Thank you, Senior Brother Lin Yi, for this generous gift!”
Han Lin’s heart swelled with joy, but he still feigned composure on the surface.
“All right, this Spiritual Artifact is yours now,”
After saying these words, Lin Yi’s figure disappeared once more.
Looking at the Flying Sword in his hands, Han Lin’s lips curled into a sinister smile, and a glint of greed flickered deep in his eyes.
How could he not be overjoyed at Lin Yi giving him such a Spiritual Artifact?
“Hmph, I really want to see just what tricks you are trying to play,”
Han Lin chuckled coldly and put the Flying Sword into his storage ring.
Then, he quickly left the area.
…
Lin Yi, leading the disciples of Tianyuan Sect, quickly left the valley.
Lin Yi moved swiftly, and in the blink of an eye, they arrived in the area where the Tianyuan Sect was located.
He led the disciples of Tianyuan Sect swiftly into the sect’s premises.
At that moment, a disciple hurried into the chamber of an elder and reported, “Elder, Senior Brother Lin Yi has returned.”
Upon hearing this, an elderly figure with white hair and a flowing white beard walked out of the house and approached the disciple.
The old man was clad in blue, his aura robust, and his profound eyes carried an intimidating chill.
He was an elder of Tianyuan Sect, also the Supreme Elder, with a lofty status and high prestige.
This person was none other than Li Xuanfeng, the Supreme Elder and Sect Leader of Tianyuan Sect.
“What? Lin Yi has already returned to the sect?” Li Xuanfeng was taken aback by the news.
He had originally thought that Lin Yi would stay outside hunting the Alien Race, but unexpectedly, Lin Yi had returned.
“Did you say Lin Yi has returned to the sect? Did he come back alone?”
Li Xuanfeng asked, a hint of anger in his voice.
“Yes, Senior Brother Lin Yi came back alone,” the disciple quickly nodded.
Upon hearing this, a ruthless light flashed in Li Xuanfeng’s eyes as he sneered, “So he has really come back. I knew it; how could he give up slaughtering so easily?”
“Regardless of his plans, I must stop him as soon as possible!” Li Xuanfeng pondered for a moment before speaking.
After speaking, his figure flickered, and he chased in the direction Lin Yi had left.
Lin Yi absolutely shouldn’t be allowed to continue his killing spree; he must be taken down, never to walk this world again!
Li Xuanfeng’s body turned into a streak of light, pursuing Lin Yi with incredible speed.
“Whoosh!”
He weaved through the void at an exceedingly fast pace.
Lin Yi also sensed someone tracking him, so his speed increased even further, making his movement technique incredibly swift.
The speed of both surpassed the speed of sound, vanishing in a flash, leaving behind trails of afterimages in the void.
Lin Yi continued to speed towards the depths of Tianyuan Sect without stopping, his pace getting faster and faster.
“Senior Brother Lin Yi, how can you be so fast?”
That disciple exclaimed in surprise.
His Cultivation was not much different from Lin Yi’s; both were at the Ninth Level of Foundation Establishment.
Yet Lin Yi was even faster than him!
“No, at this rate, we won’t be able to catch up with Senior Brother Lin Yi. If we keep fleeing like this, he will soon have lost us completely, and then we shall be in trouble.”

chapters.title: Chapter 567: 567: Gritting His Teeth, He Made a Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 567: Chapter 567: Gritting His Teeth, He Made a Decision
The disciple thought for a moment, then clenched his teeth and made a decision.
If that’s the case, then I’ll no longer run. Once I break through to the Golden Core Stage, I will definitely surpass Brother Lin Yi!
With that thought in mind, the disciple’s figure flashed as he fled toward the distance.
Lin Yi also noticed that disciple, a strange arc forming at the corners of his mouth.
“Hehe, thinking of running away?”
Lin Yi’s lips slightly parted, revealing a cold smile.
...
Lin Yi’s figure flashed, instantly chasing after the disciple and stopping at a distance behind him.
“Brother Lin Yi, I know you’re stronger than I am, but I don’t believe I will lose to you!”
The disciple said coldly.
“Not bad! Worthy of being the genius ranked two hundred and fifty-fourth, indeed extraordinary. However, do you think you can escape from me?” Lin Yi said with a playful look on his face.
The disciple’s face immediately became awkward.
Although he was confident in defeating Lin Yi, he didn’t have the absolute certainty that he could win against him.
After all, Lin Yi was a monstrous presence, his Cultivation having reached the Seventh Layer of Qi Condensation.
Lin Yi’s Realm was two minor levels higher than his, and with his Cultivation at only the Third Layer, how could he possibly be a match for Lin Yi?
“Brother Lin Yi, what exactly do you want to do?”
The disciple shouted coldly, asking.
Lin Yi didn’t answer immediately but instead surveyed the surrounding environment.
Lin Yi had recorded this area’s details before leaving, so he knew very well what kind of treasures were nearby.
“Hehehe, within this mountain range, there’s a huge treasure repository, if you can find the treasures, maybe I’ll consider letting you off!” Lin Yi said with a faint smile.
“A treasure repository?”
Upon hearing these words, the disciple immediately showed an ecstatic look.
“This is the treasure I’ve dreamed of obtaining; I can’t believe Brother Lin Yi stumbled upon it! I’m so lucky!”
He said excitedly, his face filled with elation.
Lin Yi’s gaze swept around and spotted a huge stele in the distance with a line of characters etched into it.
“There’s a huge treasure repository in this mountain range where you can choose the items you need!”
“As for the reward, follow the instructions within this Jade Slip!”
The disciple looked at the stele that Lin Yi was pointing to and hurriedly walked up to it.
“Alright, I’ll be leaving first. I hope we meet again soon. At that time, I’ll bring you a big gift!”
Lin Yi laughed heartily and turned to leave.
Watching Lin Yi’s retreating figure, the disciple’s eyes revealed a trace of resentment, muttering to himself: “Lin Yi, don’t blame me, it’s your fault for offending someone you shouldn’t have, no one else is to blame for this.”
After Lin Yi left, he did not immediately return to Tianyuan Sect but wandered around the vicinity.
On his way, Lin Yi saw many people, but none of them showed any hostility towards him; on the contrary, some even took the initiative to seek acquaintance.
Among these people, one man greeted Lin Yi.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, I’ve heard that Tianyuan Sect’s internal strife is quite severe, you must be careful!”
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, I’m Li Xuanfeng, you can call me Brother Li!”
“I am Yang Yu, a genius disciple from our Tianyuan Sect!”
Seeing Lin Yi alone, these individuals took the initiative to come up and chat with him.
They were all Core Disciples within Tianyuan Sect, each with extraordinary talents and quite famous in the Immortal Cultivation World; naturally, they knew who Lin Yi was.
Lin Yi, upon seeing this, gave a slight nod but did not engage with these people.
Those people, seeing Lin Yi’s attitude, showed a hint of embarrassment on their faces before bidding farewell in succession.
Lin Yi, at that moment, also left to continue the search for treasures around him.
His target was the greatest treasure of the Tianyuan Sect.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, don’t say we didn’t warn you. Us core disciples of the Tianyuan Sect have a very special status within our sect. If you suffer under our hands, you’ll have only your own bad luck to blame.”
“Haha, Junior Brother Lin Yi, you’d better be careful!”
Their faces all bore thick mockery, as if ridiculing Lin Yi.
Lin Yi, upon hearing their words, simply gave them an indifferent glance, unmoved.
This scene immediately infuriated those people.
“Damn it, we were giving you face by not holding it against you! And you dare treat us with such an attitude?”
“Lin Yi, I advise you to scram quickly, or else we’ll make you regret it!”
The people cursed angrily, seething with rage.
Having been pampered by the Tianyuan Sect since childhood, they had never suffered such indifference from anyone, much less be humiliated by someone from the sixth layer of Qi refinement.
Moreover, this junior dared to look at them with such eyes, which was truly infuriating!
“Scram?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s smile suddenly vanished, turning grim, “You trash actually think I’m easily frightened? There’ve been too many who wanted to kill me; I’ve lost count of how many times. Who do you think you are for me to fear? I’ll let you know the price of offending me, hmph!”
Having said that, Lin Yi no longer paid them any attention, his body soared up and rushed into the mountains.
His target was exactly the huge treasure house.
“Damn it, Lin Yi, you dare insult us, we’ll definitely take our revenge and kill you!”
These core disciples were livid, shouting behind him.
Lin Yi ignored them and headed straight towards the peak of the mountain.
After searching the mountain for a while, he finally discovered a concealed cave entrance with a formation set up at it, the aura here was also distinct from the rest.
“It must be a Teleportation Formation!”
A trace of joy immediately appeared on Lin Yi’s face.
This was an enormous cave dwelling, which surely hid extremely precious treasures!
Without hesitating, Lin Yi hurriedly dashed into the cave dwelling.
“Buzz~”
After Lin Yi rushed into the cave dwelling, he was suddenly pulled by a force of suction.
“Eh? What’s happening?”
Lin Yi was surprised and quickly mobilized his True Yuan to resist the force.
However, the suction became more and more terrifying and powerful, and Lin Yi’s cultivation was unable to withstand it.
“Damn, what is this thing, it’s so powerful!”
Lin Yi couldn’t help but curse silently, yet he didn’t stop moving forward.
“Boom!”
Just then, the cave dwelling suddenly exploded, transforming into a ball of flames that shot up into the sky.
And on the other side of the dwelling, a figure appeared.
It was a man clad in white, wearing a purple crown, with a tall and upright figure, his face as fine as jade. His eyes were like bright stars, flashing with captivating light.
At a glance, one could tell that this man was a master, and the aura he emitted was astonishing.
Seeing this man, Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat.

chapters.title: Chapter 568: The Treasure We Found
chapters.content:
Chapter 568: Chapter 568: The Treasure We Found
“Who are you? This treasure was discovered by us; what does it have to do with you!”
Lin Yi warily looked at the man.
The man gave a cold laugh and glanced at Lin Yi indifferently, “You don’t deserve to know who I am, but you must pay a price!”
“What?”
Lin Yi frowned, sensing arrogance and threat in the tone of the other party. This attitude extremely displeased Lin Yi.
He had never been spoken to like this from childhood to now, yet this person not only said it but also showed contempt.
...
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed, filled with a glint of killing intent.
“What do you want to do?”
Lin Yi looked at the man, his voice icy as he asked.
“What do I want to do? Aren’t you very powerful? I’m waiting here for you. I’d like to see if you can break through the restriction I left in such a short time!”
The man stared at Lin Yi, his lips curling into a mocking smile, his eyes full of provocation and disdain.
Seeing the man’s attitude, anger surged in Lin Yi’s heart. A cold light flashed in his eyes, and he strode meteorically toward the man.
“You want to challenge me?”
Lin Yi confronted the man, questioning him with a cold voice.
His figure was tall and straight, standing like a towering Demon King, with an overwhelming killing intent surging around him.
“Brother Lin Yi, it’s not that I look down on you, but there’s simply no comparison between us. You should back down while you can!”
The man gently shook his head, looking at Lin Yi with eyes full of contempt and disdain.
Lin Yi boiled with anger, his eyes seething with murderous intent, and his figure, swift as lightning, charged toward the man.
“Hmph! Child’s play!”
The man scoffed, his right leg lifting and delivering a fierce kick.
His kick, imbued with a vast and boundless power, struck out like a mighty dragon.
Lin Yi’s pupils shrank, and his body violently flew backward, crashing hard against the stone wall.
“Pugh!”
He spat out a mouthful of blood, his expression extremely ugly.
Pain seared through his right arm, his entire palm shattered by the kick!
“Lin Yi, your attack power is too weak! You’re not worthy to be my opponent!”
The man snorted coldly, his tone carrying an inviolable pressure.
Lin Yi clenched his fists tightly, his teeth grinding audibly, his face ashen with frustration.
“Hmph, I’d like to see just how powerful you really are!”
Lin Yi gritted his teeth, his eyes emitting a sharp glint as he charged at the man once more.
The man smiled coldly, “Child’s play, it won’t withstand a single blow!”
“Boom!”
Lin Yi engaged in a fierce battle with the man, and for a time, neither could gain the upper hand.
“Boom!”
Suddenly, the man kicked out, sending Lin Yi flying backward, landing hard on the ground, vomiting blood once again.
“You were so arrogant, so very arrogant, weren’t you? Didn’t you want to fight me? Why stop now?”
“Hehe, did you think I was just toying with you just now? That was merely a casual move I made! If I wanted to kill you, it would only take one strike, and you would undoubtedly die!”
“What? One move could kill me instantly!”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s face changed slightly, and a surge of shock rippled through his heart, his heart beating wildly.
Although he was confident that he could slay some ordinary Pill Condensation Realm experts, compared to the man in front of him, he was far inferior.
This strength completely surpassed Lin Yi’s expectations!
“Lin Yi, I advise you not to delude yourself, just concede gracefully,” said the man. “Don’t force me to act. If you get hurt then, I won’t take responsibility.”
The man’s words once again filled Lin Yi with rage.
“Not take responsibility? Fine, since you don’t want to take responsibility, then hand over your life!”
Lin Yi was completely enraged.
He had never suffered such humiliation before!
He was a genius, and he had never allowed anyone to look down on or scorn him!
A glimmer of cold light burst forth from Lin Yi’s eyes, his speed suddenly increased, and in an instant, he was in front of the man, swinging his fist down at him.
“Boom!”
The fist wind howled, carrying the force of tens of thousands of pounds, like Mount Tai collapsing, terrifyingly powerful.
Lin Yi had struck without any reservations, unleashing the most powerful strength he possessed.
“Hmm? You actually dare to clash with my fist using your physical body?”
The man’s pupils contracted as he watched Lin Yi approaching him head-on, a look of surprise evident in his eyes.
Lin Yi, seeing the man’s surprised expression, let a disdainful smile appear on his lips.
“You are mistaken, it’s not that I’m clashing with you using my physical body, but that I am pounding your head with my fist. That is my true strength!”
“Haha, good, good, good!”
The man, seeing that Lin Yi actually dared to clash fists head-on with him, burst into laughter.
Hearing the man’s laughter, Lin Yi’s face showed a mocking sneer.
“Not only did I clash with your fist with my physical body, but I also let you experience what it feels like to be overpowered by physical strength!”
“Rumble!”
The next moment, the man’s fist collided fiercely with Lin Yi’s, and a thunderous roar burst forth.
“Bang!”
Lin Yi’s body was sent flying backward by the force of the man’s fist and crashed to the ground.
Meanwhile, the man’s arm also trembled, apparently injured as well.
However, the man’s expression looked extremely calm as if the recent event hadn’t harmed him in the slightest.
“Such incredible defensive power!”
Lin Yi, seeing that his punch hadn’t managed to injure the man at all, couldn’t help but show a look of shock on his face.
One should know that he was already at the peak of the Ninth Level of Cultivation while the man’s cultivation was only at the Fifth Level, yet he was able to withstand his punch!
Lin Yi knew that even a powerhouse at the Eighth Layer of Cultivation might not be able to block his punch.
And yet, this man used only his physical body to block Lin Yi’s punch, which was an incredible feat!
“Alright, your attack is over, now it’s my turn to make a move!”
The man looked at Lin Yi coldly, then slowly stepped toward him.
Lin Yi’s expression changed slightly as he saw the man approaching.
“Lin Yi, I’m telling you, this is the Sword Tomb, and you’re no match for me. Just kneel and submit,” said the man, as he arrived in front of Lin Yi, his tone ice-cold. “Otherwise, I won’t mind killing you myself!”
Upon hearing this, a resolute light flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes.
“No matter how strong you are, you can’t expect to take anything from me!” Lin Yi snorted.
He got up from the ground, a determined sparkle in his gaze.
The man was far too powerful, and Lin Yi wasn’t confident he could defeat him. Therefore, Lin Yi could only choose to flee. Only by fleeing could he survive.
However, leaving the Sword Tomb wasn’t so simple, for hundreds of Sword Pavilion experts guarded the perimeter, their Cultivation at least at the Third Layer of the Pill Condensation Realm, with even one powerhouse at the Sixth and Seventh Layer standing guard.

chapters.title: Chapter 569: Cultivator of the Fifth Layer
chapters.content:
Chapter 569: Chapter 569: Cultivator of the Fifth Layer
Lin Yi, although able to easily slay cultivators of the Fourth and Fifth Layer in the Pill Condensation Realm, found it nearly impossible to kill a Sixth Layer powerhouse, especially within the guard troops of the Sword Sect.
Therefore, Lin Yi had to temporarily avoid the sharp edges and wait until he found an opportunity to defeat the Sixth Layer guardian and thus acquire the treasure.
The man looked into Lin Yi’s eyes and said in a cold voice, “I advise you not to struggle in vain, otherwise, when I make my move, it won’t be so easy.”
“Oh? How do you plan to make your move?”
Lin Yi raised an eyebrow.
“Quite simple. I will use your fists to break your legs, cripple your Dantian, and turn you into a waste. Then you will do whatever I want, including giving up your life.”
...
The man sneered.
He looked at Lin Yi with a venomous gleam in his eyes.
“Haha! Very well, I accept! But I hope you will not go back on your word.”
Lin Yi, upon hearing the man’s words, didn’t hesitate to nod in agreement.
He extremely disliked the man, but he also knew that if he did not acquiesce to the man’s wishes, the man would certainly cripple his cultivation. By then, he would truly be nothing but a waste.
So, Lin Yi had no choice but to agree.
A surge of resentment filled Lin Yi’s heart, wanting to take this opportunity to vent it all out in battle.
“Hmph, since you are willing to do this, then make your move. Let’s see whose fists are stronger. I certainly won’t hold back!”
“Swish!”
As soon as his words fell, the man’s figure flickered, charging straight at Lin Yi, with a sharp gleam in his eyes like two blades, aiming straight for Lin Yi’s forehead, intent on a fatal strike!
Lin Yi’s pupils constricted at this sight.
The man’s fists were phantom-fast, approaching him in an instant.
Lin Yi’s expression grew solemn.
“Ha!”
With a low growl, Lin Yi abruptly raised his right arm, a faint golden light shining on his fist, and then he ruthlessly slammed it into the man’s attacking fist.
“Boom!”
Fist met fist, erupting in a loud clash, and both staggered backwards several zhang, with Lin Yi retreating more steps and blood spilling from his mouth, a wary glint in his eyes.
“Is this your strength? It’s nothing special.”
The man steadied himself and sneered at Lin Yi, his eyes filled with mockery.
“Is that so? Then try this!”
Lin Yi sneered coldly, his body abruptly stepping forward, and his right leg lashed out swiftly.
“Swish!”
His right leg turned into a blur as it swiftly swept towards the man’s abdomen.
“Hmph! Overestimating yourself!”
Seeing this, the man sneered disdainfully and clenched his right hand tightly around his left fist, meeting Lin Yi’s striking right leg head-on.
“Boom!”
There was a loud sound.
The man took three steps back from Lin Yi’s kick, a sharp pain coursing through his right arm, feeling as if it was about to break.
A look of shock flashed across the man’s face; he had not anticipated Lin Yi’s immense strength.
“I refuse to believe that I, a Fifth Layer cultivator in the Body Refinement Phase, cannot handle you, a mere Second Layer youth!”
A vicious look glinted in the man’s eyes as he let out a loud roar, True Yuan sweeping wildly within him, gathering on his fist as he aimed another ferocious blow towards Lin Yi’s abdomen.
“Boom!”
Lin Yi retreated some distance, arms feeling a faint pain, but he disregarded it. Instead, his eyes flickered with excitement, because this proved he had mastered a fist technique.
“Next, it’s time for me to truly display my Fist Technique!”
Lin Yi clenched his fists tightly, emanating an overbearing and wild aura. In his pitch-black, profound eyes, a dazzling brilliance burst forth.
“Break for me!”
Lin Yi roared lowly, his legs suddenly stomping the ground, his body leapt up directly, soaring like a great roc, he lunged toward the man.
His right leg, carrying a terrifying surge of air, lashed out violently toward the man’s chest with a sweep, its speed like lightning.
“Bang!”
Lin Yi’s right leg crashed fiercely into the man’s chest, making a muffled sound. The man’s body shook, his face turned pale, and he was sent flying backward, slamming hard into the ground.
“Pfft!”
The man spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, his face covered in a mask of pain.
“Hiss~”
Seeing the man spitting blood, all the surrounding cultivators drew a sharp breath.
The man had actually been defeated, and defeated so miserably at that!
“So ferocious, he actually sent the man flying with a single move.”
“Who in the world is this Lin Yi? Why is he so monstrously powerful!”
All the people around were incredibly surprised, their eyes showing a look of shock.
“Good! Very good!”
The man struggled to rise from the ground, a fierce gleam bursting forth from his eyes. He looked at Lin Yi, and bellowed with rage.
“This time, I will not hold back. You are surely going to die!”
The man swung his fists, hurling a ferocious punch toward Lin Yi.
This punch contained a robust force, its power overwhelming.
Lin Yi did not dare to be careless. He quickly jumped backward to dodge the punch, then lifted his leg to kick at the man.
“Thump!”
This time, the man did not evade, instead taking Lin Yi’s heavy punch head-on, his right arm bursting apart.
“Splurt!”
The man spat out another mouthful of blood, his body once again sent flying backward, crashing down heavily on the ground, and he passed out completely.
Lin Yi finally stopped attacking, his gaze coldly fixed on the man lying on the ground.
This was the first time since he had joined the Sword Sect that he met a real challenger!
Just now, the man’s attack was too strong. Had it not been for Lin Yi’s Eighth Layer Body Refinement Phase cultivation, he would have likely been defeated by his opponent.
“That was close!”
Lin Yi patted his chest, wiping the sweat from his forehead. He hadn’t expected his opponent to be so powerful. Had it not been for his Eighth Layer Body Refinement Phase cultivation, he would have probably been killed with a single palm strike!
“Boy, I’m giving you one last chance! Kneel before me and admit your wrongs, and perhaps I’ll spare your dog life!”
The man slowly stood up from the ground, his gaze icy cold as he looked at Lin Yi.
“Pah!”
Lin Yi spat out disdainfully.
“You refuse a toast only to drink a forfeit. Since that is the case, don’t blame me for being ruthlessly destructive!”
The man’s gaze turned cold. With a flick of his right hand, a dagger appeared, streaking toward Lin Yi.
“Whoosh!”
The dagger tore through the air, emitting a faint sound of breaking the silence, and fiercely stabbed toward Lin Yi’s heart.
The dagger’s sharpness surpassed that of an ordinary one, capable of cutting through the glass of a car, absolutely extreme in its sharpness.
“Kid, die for me!”
The man sneered, convinced that Lin Yi would not be able to avoid it.

chapters.title: Chapter 570: Caught Off Guard
chapters.content:
Chapter 570: Chapter 570: Caught Off Guard
His dagger was capable of piercing through the flesh of a Seventh Layer Martial Artist during the Body Cultivation period—it absolutely could have penetrated Lin Yi’s heart and instantly killed him!
“Hmph!”
However, just when the man thought he had already won this wager, Lin Yi let out a cold snort and swung his right fist violently. With a punch, he unleashed a formidable Fist Force, which deviated the man’s dagger and then heavily struck the man’s abdomen.
“Crack!”
The punch landed on the man’s stomach, causing his belly to shatter open, and the man was blasted away by the terrifying Fist Force, crashing harshly into a distant wall. He spat out fresh blood and was already knocked unconscious.
“This guy is actually a physical prowess expert!”
...
Lin Yi was immensely shocked; the opponent’s physical strength had reached the pinnacle level of a physical prowess master! This outcome caught Lin Yi off guard.
Although his Fist Force was incredibly powerful, against a physical prowess master, it was nothing more than chicken ribs—an inherent physique of a physical prowess master could not be surpassed so easily.
“It seems the Sword Sect truly is a den of hidden dragons and crouching tigers!”
Lin Yi sighed audibly, then walked over to the man, extended his foot, and stomped ruthlessly on the man’s chest.
The man’s chest caved in immediately, and he couldn’t help but spit out another mouthful of blood.
“How about it? Ready to give in? Beg for your life now, and I might consider sparing you.”
Grinding his teeth, the man glared at Lin Yi with resentment and asked coldly, “If you beg me right now, I might consider sparing you.”
“Scram, I don’t need your pity,” Lin Yi replied coldly.
Hearing this, the man’s expression grew even darker. He hadn’t expected Lin Yi to be so obstinate—preferring to be humiliated rather than lower his head and beg him.
This time, he was truly angered.
From a young age, when had he ever had to lower himself like this? But today, he had done so, only to be mocked by Lin Yi, whom he deemed a waste.
“Since that’s the case, I’ll no longer hold back. Today, I’ll make you understand what regret means!”
A fierce deathly aura emanated from the man’s body, which contorted violently, transforming him into a skeleton that then slapped down on Lin Yi’s head.
“Slap!”
Lin Yi was sent flying, crashing to the ground, with fresh blood spurting from his mouth.
“You think you can stir up troubles just because you have some strength? In my eyes, you’re nothing but an ant, not worth mentioning at all!”
Lin Yi wiped the blood from the corner of his lips, snorted coldly, and scrambled up from the ground, his figure leaping up, ready to leave the place.
He was not a fool; having already had a falling out with the man, he definitely could not continue to stay there or, sooner or later, the man would seize an opportunity to kill him.
“Hehe, thinking of escaping? There’s no way out!”
Seeing Lin Yi trying to flee, the man sneered and in a flash, positioned himself behind Lin Yi, sending a palm strike toward Lin Yi’s back.
Lin Yi was far from being a match for the man and had no way to block the attack, instantly feeling the sound of his bones breaking.
“Bang!”
Lin Yi’s body was sent flying and harshly smashed to the ground, vomiting another mouthful of fresh blood, his complexion even paler, his breath extremely weak.
“Did you think you could create waves with a bit of strength? In my eyes, you are just an ant, absolutely insignificant!”
The man sneered again, his body rushing toward Lin Yi once more, preparing to finish him off.
Lin Yi lay on the ground, extremely pale, with cracked lips, looking very ragged as if he could die at any moment.
“Kid, today I’m going to show you just how big the gap between us is!”
The man sneered, his palm shooting out suddenly to grasp Lin Yi’s shoulder.
Crack!
A crisp bone-breaking sound echoed as the man’s hand crushed Lin Yi’s scapula, rendering his left shoulder utterly useless!
“Ah!”
Lin Yi screamed miserably, but he was utterly powerless to resist; the adversary’s speed was too fast for him to even react.
“Haha, your body is just too fragile!”
The man laughed wildly as he swiftly appeared in front of Lin Yi.
He threw a punch towards Lin Yi’s head, aiming to kill with a single blow.
But at that moment, a strong sense of impending danger suddenly rose in his heart, causing his body to shudder violently.
“Bang!”
His fist was intercepted by a palm, shattered by the force, sending him stumbling backwards three steps, a look of shock spreading across his face as he stared intently at the owner of the palm.
His pupils dilated, a tremendous sense of fear overwhelming him, freezing him in place.
“Who are you? Why are you meddling in my business?”
The man’s voice trembled.
He saw the newcomer clearly now—a youth, tall and slender, with handsome features. But those eyes… they were filled with a sharp, lethal intent.
“My name is Lin Yi, from the imperial city of Tianyuan Country.”
Lin Yi gave the man a dismissive glance, his tone icy, “You tried to kill me just now, so I had to stop you. Otherwise, you’d be the one dying right now!”
“What? You’re Lin Yi? You… you actually returned alive?”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, the man trembled, his face a picture of disbelief mixed with deep fear and astonishment.
“Surprised, are you?” Lin Yi arched an eyebrow, casually glancing at the man.
The man swallowed hard, his voice strained, “No… not really, just didn’t expect you to still be alive!”
Lin Yi didn’t speak. He looked rather pale, blood oozing continuously from his mouth, his weakness apparent.
“Kid, you’re seriously injured! I have a bottle of elixir here, take it. I’ll help you heal.”
Seeing how severely Lin Yi was injured
Lin Yi shook his head, declining, “No need. What are these injuries? A few days’ rest should suffice.”
“Kid, you don’t understand the importance of an elixir to a martial artist! Without the elixir’s aid, your injuries will not recover so quickly!”
Seeing Lin Yi refuse, the man’s face grew dark. He was determined to take the elixir by any means necessary!
He knew Lin Yi’s identity was certainly no simple matter; possibly someone cultivated by a major sect or family, possessing many treasures. Furthermore, with Lin Yi’s handsome appearance, once his cultivation reached its limit and he successfully broke through to the Martial King Realm, he could become a legend.
By then, his name wouldn’t just be known in Tianyuan Country; even in the Eastern Wasteland, and perhaps even the Southern Desolate, he would make a significant mark!
He truly desired that elixir, it could be lifesaving.
“Elixirs are indeed precious, but my life is more important. I would rather die than consume the elixir.” Lin Yi’s reply was cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 571: 571 Not Looking for Trouble
chapters.content:
Chapter 571: Chapter 571 Not Looking for Trouble
“Kid, I advise you to hand over the elixir obediently. I won’t kill you, but my brothers won’t let you off this easy. They all have bad tempers, and once they get angry, it won’t be as simple as just crippling you.”
The man threatened.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s brow furrowed slightly.
He indeed wanted to leave this place alive, but he didn’t want to cause trouble.
Although he was extraordinarily talented, possessed unmatched medical skills and artifact refining techniques, he was not arrogant enough to oppose these people, as it would only invite more terrifying trouble.
“Since you refuse to hand over the elixir obediently, I have no choice but to take it myself. I hope you won’t blame me.”
...
The man let out a sinister laugh, extended his right hand, and reached for Lin Yi again.
Lin Yi’s gaze sharpened, he gritted his teeth, and with a stomp of his foot, his body burst forward, dodging the man’s attack.
“Think you can run away? It’s not that easy!”
The man sneered and rapidly pursued Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s body flickered, deploying the Wind-style Movement Technique.
His figure became elusive, making it impossible for the man to predict his movements, leaving him no choice but to closely follow behind.
The two of them, one in front and one behind, quickly disappeared into the night, their destination unknown.
Lin Yi was sprinting ahead while the man was relentlessly chasing after him with tremendous speed.
Along the way, Lin Yi constantly tried different means to shake off the man but the man was getting closer and closer, his face adorned with a ferocious smile.
“Lin Yi, you’re forcing my hand. Do you think you can escape?”
The man said with a menacing smile, radiating a fierce aura.
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s steps faltered, and a chill surged in his heart; the man’s speed was truly too fast, and his understanding of martial arts far exceeded Lin Yi’s. If he didn’t take action now, what awaited him would be a disaster.
With this in mind, Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed, a cold glint flashing in their depths.
“Since you’re courting death, you can’t blame me!”
Lin Yi thought to himself.
The next moment, he pushed off fiercely from the ground, his speed surging!
Whoosh!
His figure vanished from the spot in an instant, reappearing behind the man!
“Kid, courting death!”
Feeling the strong wind from behind, the man quickly turned around, slapping with his palm, trying to stop Lin Yi from continuing his attack.
But Lin Yi didn’t give him the chance, delivering a sword strike that landed directly on the man’s chest!
Splash!
A muffled grunt sounded, and a long wound immediately appeared on the man’s chest, blood spraying out.
With a successful strike, Lin Yi’s body shot out instantly, fleeing towards the distance, vanishing without a trace in the blink of an eye.
“You!”
The man roared angrily. He could not have imagined that Lin Yi could move so fast, that he could so easily injure him, not even grazing his clothes!
Lin Yi’s figure flashed, reappearing a kilometer away in an instant, but there were no buildings around, just open space and darkness, without any other structure in sight!
“Kid, you think you can escape into here and I wouldn’t be able to do anything about you? You’re far too naive!”
The man sneered coldly, leaping forward in pursuit of Lin Yi, his speed even faster than Lin Yi’s!
“Be careful, that kid is also very fast!”
At that moment, the voice of the Heavenly Demon Sect’s ancestor sounded.
“Hm? Is he also from the Heavenly Demon Sect? Why is he tracking me?”
Lin Yi asked, puzzled.
“Unclear, but we better get out of here quickly. The aura of the Heavenly Demon here is very thick and staying too long will affect you.”
The ancestor of the Heavenly Demon Sect replied.
“Okay!”
Lin Yi nodded and accelerated once more.
This man not only possessed First Level strength but also Second Level; his speed was incredibly fast as well. The distance between them kept growing, but they still had not completely lost the men.
Lin Yi was extremely anxious in his heart.
But at this time, he couldn’t stop; if he did, he would surely be attacked by the man.
The aura of the Heavenly Demon here was special, affecting the flow of Inner Strength. If he stopped, his True Qi would be easily absorbed.
Generally, True Qi couldn’t be converted to True Qi through any means, so True Qi was extremely important for a True Qi Master. If his Inner Strength were entirely devoured, his power might stagnate.
Lin Yi gritted his teeth in frustration, but there was nothing he could do. Under the current circumstances, he couldn’t let this man catch up to him. He had to keep dodging, making it impossible for his pursuer to catch him. As long as the man didn’t catch up, he would find a way to escape.
However, just as Lin Yi finished thinking, his body stiffened.
“Damn it!”
Lin Yi’s face changed drastically, for he felt that the True Qi in his body was starting to diminish slowly, and at a very slow rate. If he didn’t replenish it in time, it would probably all be gone soon!
“Damn it!”
Lin Yi cursed under his breath and immediately swallowed a Healing Pill.
The Elixir melted in his mouth, and Lin Yi’s True Qi recovered.
“Haha!”
At that moment, the man caught up, laughing loudly, “Kid, now that you’re without the protection of True Qi, let’s see where you can run!”
Lin Yi glanced at him coldly and said, “You’re no match for me. If you don’t believe me, just try!”
With that, he stomped on the ground and surged forward explosively with one step, instantly darting a hundred yards and closing the gap between them even more.
The man’s face darkened, watching Lin Yi coldly, a glint of cold light flashing in his eyes. With a flicker of his figure, he too pursued, his speed even faster than Lin Yi’s by a fraction!
“Kid, no matter how fast you are, you won’t escape from the palm of my hand. Die!”
The man roared, launching himself at Lin Yi again, swinging his fist like a hammer, smashing down at Lin Yi!
The fist carried a fierce wind, whistling as it came down, with ferocious momentum!
The sound of the punch resonated, tearing through the air, creating a piercing screech as if it was going to pierce the atmosphere and shred everything.
The impact of this punch was like the thunderous boom of thunder.
Facing this punch, Lin Yi’s pupils shrunk suddenly, and his expression changed.
“Crap, I’m too slow!”
Lin Yi felt annoyed at himself, realizing that if he had been just a bit faster, he would not have been caught, and this man wouldn’t have been a match for him.
But now it was too late for regrets. He could only resist with all his might and divert the strength of the punch!
His body twisted suddenly, sidestepping with the speed of lightning, but the man’s attack followed and landed on his chest!
Bang!
Lin Yi’s body was thrown violently backward, crashing heavily against a tree trunk.
With a loud crash, the entire tree collapsed!
Pu-chi!

chapters.title: Chapter 572: 572: Almost Fell Down
chapters.content:
Chapter 572: Chapter 572: Almost Fell Down
Lin Yi coughed up a mouthful of fresh blood, his body swayed for a moment, and he nearly collapsed.
“Hmph, did you think you could avoid my attack just like that? That’s pure wishful thinking. Show yourself!”
The man snorted coldly, clasped his hands together, and two streams of Qing Yan appeared, immediately smashing towards the ground!
Crack!
The two streams of Qing Yan instantly burrowed into the surface, and then the ground split open with a fissure two feet deep!
Upon seeing this, Lin Yi was greatly shocked and immediately leaped high into the air.
...
Bang! Bang! Bang!
But before he could steady himself, the crack below him widened once again, and eventually, the entire mountain range collapsed!
“What’s happening?!”
Lin Yi was taken aback.
“Boy, this is the Heavenly Demon Sect’s Heavenly Demon Shattering Technique. It’s designed to refine the body and can cause a person’s skin to burst open. Now you have no defenses, and if you are affected by this Heavenly Demon Shattering Technique, there is absolutely no hope of survival. Just give up!”
The voice of the Heavenly Demon Sect’s ancestor rang out.
After hearing the explanation from the Heavenly Demon Sect’s ancestor, Lin Yi’s expression turned ugly. He had not anticipated that he would be forced back by the man’s Heavenly Demon Shattering Technique, and moreover, he had nearly had his skin blown apart after being struck.
This time, Lin Yi was really panicked, as this was no joking matter.
“Boy, don’t bother trying in vain, you can’t escape. Just surrender quietly!”
The man walked up to Lin Yi with a cold smile, looking down on him from above, his eyes glittering with a cold murderous intent, as if he wanted to devour Lin Yi.
Lin Yi looked at him indifferently and said, “Is that so? Well, that’s not necessarily the case!”
“Boy, let’s see how long you can run!”
The man roared and reached out a hand, grabbing at Lin Yi’s neck, intending to crush him.
At that moment, Lin Yi suddenly propelled his legs with force, and his body soared up, evading the man’s grasp.
However, the man did not give up on capturing him and stepped forward once again, swinging a claw towards Lin Yi’s head!
“No good!”
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s face changed drastically, quickly dodging to the side.
But the man had already anticipated his move, and just as his palm was about to seize Lin Yi’s head, Lin Yi’s body suddenly leaped up, avoiding the man’s attack.
Right after Lin Yi’s body leaped into the air, the man slapped him down, crashing him to the ground.
Veins were exposed on the man’s palm, indicating the terrifying energy it contained.
He charged towards Lin Yi once again, aiming to knock him down!
“Boy, you’re seeking death!”
With a sinister smile, the man stepped on Lin Yi, pinning him to the ground. A gust of wind blew over Lin Yi’s body, fluttering his clothes with a snapping sound.
At that moment, Lin Yi couldn’t hold back any longer and spat out a mouthful of blood.
It was then that Lin Yi felt, his body was suppressed by the man; his very skeleton was on the verge of being crushed!
“Is this the extent of your strength? You haven’t even forced me to exert my full power, what a disappointment!”
The man looked at him with mockery, his expression extremely indifferent.
His own strength was not weak, but Lin Yi’s was also extremely formidable; the difference between the two men’s strengths was minimal.
“Boy, don’t blame me. If you have to blame anything, blame your weakness!”
The man’s eyes brimmed with intense murderous intent.
At this moment, he seemed to transform into a devil, hell-bent on slaying Lin Yi!
“Is that so?”
Lin Yi cracked a smile, yet it carried a chilling undertone.
On seeing Lin Yi’s smile, the man instantly felt that something was amiss—he sensed Lin Yi’s thick aura of murderous intent!
Though the aura was incredibly faint, it made his heart twitch violently.
A chill went through his heart, secretly regretting his earlier decision!
He should have killed Lin Yi directly from the start; perhaps he wouldn’t have had to risk letting Lin Yi escape. Now, he had inadvertently brought trouble upon himself!
“Boy, don’t mess around! If you dare, I guarantee you’ll wish you were dead!” the man huffed coldly.
“I know!”
Lin Yi smiled lightly and said, “Since you’re unwilling to hand my body over to me, then let me destroy it!”
No sooner had he spoken than Lin Yi’s figure trembled violently, and a mass of black flames surged out, instantly enveloping his body and roaring into a blaze!
“You wouldn’t dare!”
The man was shocked, his complexion turning deathly pale!
“What wouldn’t I dare? If you try to stop me, I’ll burn this body right now. And then, you’d be buried along with it!” Lin Yi said with a cold laugh, his words thick with threat, seemingly reminding the man not to act rashly.
Upon hearing this, the man felt his heart pound violently!
“Boy, don’t go crazy! I admit, I’m no match for you, I concede now. Just hand this body over to me, and I promise I won’t lay a finger on you!” the man hurriedly pleaded.
But Lin Yi was not swayed by his entreaty and still sneered coldly, “Heh, thinking about surrendering now is too late. If you dare to make a move, your body will shatter in an instant, I guarantee it!”
Confidence was laced through Lin Yi’s words.
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, the man’s face darkened, and a strong sense of fear surged within him.
He knew of Lin Yi’s nature—if he didn’t act according to Lin Yi’s wishes, Lin Yi was absolutely the type to follow through with his threats.
Moreover, even if he were to hold back his strength now, it was doubtful he could defeat Lin Yi.
For Lin Yi possessed not only immense talent and insight but also formidable strength. Additionally, he commanded a mysterious and peculiar power that allowed him to control flames and even use Divine Sense, giving him the capacity to challenge those beyond his Realm—an existence as aberrant as a demon!
“Boy, don’t push me! You should know I am a revered member of the Heavenly Demon Sect. If you anger me, your end will be most unpleasant! I advise you not to provoke me further, or you’ll certainly die!” The man’s face darkened menacingly, his tone laden with a deep threat.
“Oh? What of it? If you want to strike at me, then I’ll also have to kill you—that’s you forcing my hand!” Lin Yi said, a trace of severe coldness surfacing in his eyes as he fixed his gaze on the man, his murderous intent unabated.
“A bold move!” the man retorted with an ironic laugh. “Since that’s the case, then don’t blame me for being heartless!”
With that, the man raised his right fist and blasted it toward Lin Yi.
Boom!
His fist landed heavily on Lin Yi’s chest, obliterating Lin Yi’s heart and causing blood to spurt from his chest, splashing on the ground, staining the lawn red, creating a chaotic mess with the dirt.
“Boy, now that you’re dead, I can claim this body, and that settles things between us. We’re even—no debts owed by either side!” The man’s face carried a smile, and he tightly clenched his fist as if celebrating the impending conquest of Lin Yi’s body.

chapters.title: Chapter 573: 573: Blood for Blood!
chapters.content:
Chapter 573: Chapter 573: Blood for Blood!
“Hmph, a draw? Impossible, this time, I must make you pay, make you repay this blood debt in blood!”
“Hmph, so be it, then meet your death!”
A murderous frenzy blazed in the man’s eyes.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
A bolt of thunder split from the clouds and instantly struck the man’s fist, sending him reeling back from the thunderous blow!
“Damn it!”
...
The man cursed, his figure rapidly retreating.
Lin Yi’s figure also vanished on the spot, and when he reappeared, he was behind the man, his right hand raised, a black longsword appearing in his grip.
“Die!”
Lin Yi growled low, swinging the longsword at the man’s shoulder.
That slash, as quick as lightning and extremely swift, reached the man’s back in an instant!
Feeling the sharpness of Lin Yi’s slash, the man was horrified, didn’t dare to counter it head-on, and turned to sweep his sword horizontally, trying to ward off Lin Yi’s strike!
Bang!
The man’s sword clashed with the edge of the longsword, emitting a massive collision sound, sparks flying everywhere, the two forces locked in a standstill midair!
“How can your body be so strong? I clearly reduced my cultivation by one-third, yet you still manage to block my attack!” the man was shocked.
“I’m an Alchemist, naturally, I have some special methods. Haven’t you heard an ancient saying? ‘There’s always someone stronger, heavens beyond heavens!'”
Lin Yi dismissed him with disdain and continued wielding the black longsword, slashing at the man.
The man kept swinging his longsword in defense against Lin Yi’s onslaught, feeling his arms numb and his bones as if they were about to shatter!
“Ahh!!”
The man screamed in agony, panic in his eyes, his clothes torn to shreds, blood pouring out.
“Kid, I’m begging you, give me your body! Otherwise, you’ll definitely suffer divine retribution, die without a complete corpse!”
Lin Yi laughed coldly, “Hahaha! You’re right! If I truly suffer divine retribution, then I would indeed be done for! That’s why you must die!”
Lin Yi sneered repeatedly, his black longsword cutting wildly, black thunder emanating from the sword, enveloping the man.
“Kid, you’ve brought this upon yourself!”
The man ground his teeth, feeling completely suppressed by Lin Yi, unable to resist!
Boom!
Lin Yi’s black longsword struck heavily on the man’s back, nearly severing his spine, sending him flying and crashing heavily to the ground.
His body writhed violently, trying to stand, but utterly unable to, he could only lie prostrate on the ground, frothing at the mouth, his body convulsing.
“You’re finished, kid! I will make sure you die with nowhere to bury your corpse!”
Blood kept spilling from the man’s mouth as he glared with bulging eyes, as if he wanted to devour Lin Yi alive.
“I will not die!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, a chilling light flickering in his eyes.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh…
Golden armor on Lin Yi’s body shone brightly, a cascade of dazzling golden light emerging, the power of the sacred!
This was the power of the Sacred Golden Force!
The golden light blossomed, enveloping Lin Yi within it, making him appear as if a deity!
“Sacred power? How is this possible? How can I feel this power? Could he be hiding some Divine Weapon? How can this be? How could a mere mortal possess such power!”
Waves of shock surged through the man’s heart as he couldn’t believe the terrifying sacred power within Lin Yi, something he’d never heard of before.
“Hmph, no matter what tricks you have, you won’t escape this calamity!”
“Oh? How would you know without trying?”
Lin Yi looked at the man indifferently.
Lin Yi had his own plans in mind. If the man could help him enhance his cultivation, then Lin Yi wouldn’t relentlessly pursue his end.
If the man refused Lin Yi’s conditions, Lin Yi would tell his parents about the incident, wanting them to teach the man a lesson and make him regret provoking Lin Yi, as a form of punishment!
“Hmph, since you want to try, then I’ll oblige you to the end!”
The man bellowed angrily, leaped toward Lin Yi, and swung his longsword, attempting to slay Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s body turned into a streak of black light, dodging the man’s attacks, but he just couldn’t escape them no matter how hard he tried!
The man’s swordsmanship was too fast, shockingly so, leaving Lin Yi utterly unable to resist; he could only fight back desperately.
Clang clang clang…
A series of metallic clangs reverberated through the void, deafening!
Lin Yi battled with the man in the air, neither able to gain the upper hand.
Before long, the man’s mouth was stained with a few drops of blood, his injuries getting more severe!
“Kid, let’s see how long you can last!”
The man sneered, feeling increasingly strained. If this continued, he feared he couldn’t hold on much longer!
Lin Yi frowned secretly as well. He felt that his strength was not yet sufficient to defeat his opponent.
“It looks like I must use some of my trump cards.”
A thought flashed through Lin Yi’s mind, and a strange light flickered in his eyes.
“Kid, let’s see how you escape this time. Your battered body absolutely cannot withstand my Immortal Sword; you might as well surrender quietly to avoid suffering!”
The man’s face twisted into a ferocious expression as he swung the Immortal Sword in his hand, chopping towards Lin Yi’s body.
Ding!
A crisp sound rang out as Lin Yi’s Protective Aura Shield shattered!
“Haha, let’s see how you fend off my attack now!”
The man laughed triumphantly, knowing that Lin Yi’s Protective Aura Shield was left with only a thin layer. Once this shield was shattered, Lin Yi would be nothing but a useless being, utterly unable to take a hit.
“Oh? Are you sure you can break my Protective Aura Shield?” Lin Yi sneered coldly.
“What?” The man’s complexion changed drastically, and a look of horror flashed in his eyes.
Lin Yi’s right arm lifted slightly, his palm opened, and a terrifying force of attraction burst forth from his palm.
Whoooosh!
The Immortal Sword in the man’s hand abruptly flew into Lin Yi’s palm. Lin Yi, holding the Immortal Sword, slashed towards the man!
“No good! How is this possible? He can actually control the Immortal Sword!”
The man’s pupils dilated, his eyes flashed with indescribable shock.
He knew that if the Immortal Sword pierced his chest, it was certain death, for the sword was meant specifically to slay enemies!
“No!!!”
The man let out a hysterical roar, clenching his longsword tightly and stabbing forward with all his might, attempting to stop the blow.
But no matter how the man struggled, it was to no avail!
The longsword still pierced into Lin Yi’s arm.
Splat!
The skin on Lin Yi’s arm was penetrated, and blood gushed out from the wound.

chapters.title: Chapter 574: 574: Significant Reduction in Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 574: Chapter 574: Significant Reduction in Strength
“Not good, this sword is a Divine Weapon!”
Shock filled Lin Yi’s heart, but he did not show it. The man’s strength had greatly diminished, and Lin Yi just needed an opportunity to defeat him.
Whoosh!
Lin Yi’s form darted forward, once again lunging at the man, his longsword thrusting towards the other’s chest.
At this moment, the man was too weak to dodge!
Pu chi!
...
The longsword pierced the man’s heart!
His eyes widened in disbelief, but the light in them gradually faded. His body slowly dropped to the ground, landing with no breath left in him.
Lin Yi sheathed his sword and staggered, sitting down on the ground with a look of exhaustion on his face.
The Golden Crow Flames within Lin Yi vanished, replaced by a black spear with a tip flashing golden light. The body of the spear was wrapped in billowing black mist as if a Demon God were about to emerge from within.
Lin Yi felt the Golden Crow Flames inside him boiling as though they were about to burst through his flesh and out of his mind.
The sensation was agonizing for Lin Yi, almost as if it were tearing his body apart!
Lin Yi clenched his teeth and forcibly suppressed the Golden Crow Flames, preventing them from erupting from his mind.
Though the power of the Golden Crow Flames was terrifying, Lin Yi’s body was quite special, and the flames could not harm his flesh!
“This Immortal Sword truly is powerful. Had I not possessed the bloodline of the Golden Crow, I would have been overwhelmed long ago. This sword is surely no ordinary Immortal Sword, but at least a weapon of Treasure Level! Alas, its master was simply too dreadful, incapable of even harnessing half of my strength!”
Lin Yi sighed, looking utterly pale.
The battle had consumed too much!
“Lin Yi, are you all right?”
To the side, Meng Qi rushed over to the collapsed Lin Yi, her voice full of concern.
“I’m fine.”
Lin Yi gestured with his hand, knowing his condition was far from good.
“That’s good. I was worried something would happen to you.”
Seeing Lin Yi unharmed, Meng Qi finally let out a sigh of relief. Knowing that both she and Lin Yi were safe, her pent-up worry fully dissipated.
Lin Yi stood up, looking at the man lying on the ground, his eyes flickering with a cold murderous intent, “I’ll take this sword, now get out of my sight!”
Saying this, Lin Yi reached out towards the man.
Swoosh!
At that moment, a sharp chill emanated from the man, his palm striking out to repel Lin Yi.
Lin Yi scoffed in disdain, his own palm shaking fiercely as the longsword sliced through the air, appearing instantly in front of the man and stabbing viciously into his body.
The man let out a pained scream. His body twitched once, then fell silent, gradually turning to ash.
The man was slain by Lin Yi, yet Lin Yi remained completely unharmed.
“Lin Yi, congratulations on obtaining a Treasure Level Immortal Sword of extraordinary quality. You may now wield it as you please!”
A system prompt sounded.
Lin Yi nodded, pulling the Immortal Sword from the corpse. Then, a Storage Ring dropped in front of Lin Yi.
Lin Yi picked up the Storage Ring and inspected it thoroughly only to discover it contained one million Low-Grade Primordial Stones.
Lin Yi clicked on the Primordial Stone count panel and saw that the total number of Primordial Stones had reached twelve million. He was immediately elated beyond expectation; this time, he had made a fortune!
“One million Low Grade Primordial Stones, even if converted into Immortal Stones, would probably be over a hundred million Immortal Stones. I really hit the jackpot this time, and what a hefty profit it was—so exhilarating!”
Lin Yi was filled with emotion and extremely satisfied. He could now purchase some Elixirs to recover his strength.
“Lin Yi, let’s leave this dangerous place quickly. You’re injured; you should take an Elixir and rest right away,”
urged Meng Qi.
“Alright, you stand guard outside. If I come to, call out to me immediately!”
Lin Yi nodded. His injuries were very serious, and he needed to heal as soon as possible.
Afterward, Lin Yi took out a bottle of Elixir and swallowed it, beginning to treat the injuries within his body.
As the Elixir entered his stomach, he immediately felt a warm force suffusing his body, helping him rapidly heal his wounds.
Lin Yi activated the [Healing Technique] skill, and the many concealed injuries on his body were quickly mending.
Soon, all of Lin Yi’s injuries had fully healed, and his body was brimming with surging life force.
“I really didn’t expect the Immortal Sword to be so powerful, even capable of healing the injuries within me. It looks like this Immortal Sword is far more valuable than I initially estimated,”
Lin Yi thought to himself, feeling somewhat excited.
Lin Yi put away the Immortal Sword and continued on his way.
Before long, Lin Yi had returned to his residence.
“Lin Yi, you’re back?”
Just as Lin Yi stepped into the room, he heard a sweet and pleasant voice.
The voice belonged to Liu Yue’er.
Liu Yue’er was dressed in a white gown, her large watery eyes fixed on Lin Yi.
At the moment, Liu Yue’er was sitting cross-legged on the bed, her body emitting a faint fragrance, like a budding orchid exuding an attractive scent, tempting one to draw closer and pluck her.
“Yeah,” Lin Yi nodded.
Seeing Lin Yi’s condition, Liu Yue’er immediately realized what was going on, and a slight blush appeared on her pretty face.
“Lin Yi, how did you end up like this, and how come your injuries are so severe?” Liu Yue’er asked with concern.
“It’s nothing, just a few minor wounds,” Lin Yi waved his hand, unconcerned.
“Why has your strength increased so much all of a sudden? Could it be that you encountered danger while outside?” Liu Yue’er inquired.
“No, I just had some good luck this time,” Lin Yi explained.
Seeing that Lin Yi did not wish to say more, Liu Yue’er did not press further but instead admonished with care, “Lin Yi, as long as you’re alright, then I’m relieved.”
“Yeah, by the way, Sister Yue’er, I have a favor to ask of you,”
Lin Yi nodded, suddenly speaking up.
“Oh, what is it?” Liu Yue’er asked, puzzled.
“Sister Yue’er, my strength has improved very rapidly lately, and my body has also become exceptionally weak. Having just been attacked by enemies, I plan to go into seclusion and cultivate for a few days. After my injuries have healed a bit, I intend to go out and seek adventure. What do you think?” Lin Yi said.
“Oh? Lin Yi, you want to go out and seek adventure?” Liu Yue’er was puzzled.
“Yes, my strength has grown rapidly, but my state of mind is still at the peak of the Foundation Establishment Stage. So, I plan to take this opportunity to venture out and elevate my state of mind to the Golden Core Stage, which would then make my strength even stronger,” Lin Yi explained.
