Upon hearing this, Liu Yue’er was slightly startled, then she nodded and said, “Lin Yi, your decision is the right one. If you were to always stay inside, your strength would never progress further. Since you have such ambition, I naturally support you. When are you planning to go into seclusion? Do you need me to accompany you?”

chapters.title: Chapter 575: 575 There are more important things
chapters.content:
Chapter 575: Chapter 575 There are more important things
“`
“No need. You have more important things to do now, and I need to protect Meng Qi during my seclusion. She is from Yunlan Sect, and I must take good care of her. If anything happens to me, you would undoubtedly seek revenge from Yunlan Sect.”
Liu Yue’er hesitated upon hearing Lin Yi’s words. Indeed, she had more pressing tasks at hand and couldn’t leave either.
“In that case, I will protect her for you during your seclusion. No matter what, I will do my utmost to ensure her safety,” Liu Yue’er said.
Lin Yi nodded, “Thank you for that, Sister Yue’er.”
“It’s okay. No one in Yunlan Sect would dare to bully you,” Liu Yue’er replied with a shake of her head, her face beaming with a bright smile.
...
Lin Yi nodded again, “Then I’ll have to trouble you.”
“Hehe, what’s with the courtesy?”
Liu Yue’er waved her hand and smiled sweetly at Lin Yi.
“Well then, I’m going to start my seclusion now. You should go back and rest,” Lin Yi said.
“All right, and don’t forget to eat the food I’ve brought for you. I’ll be going now.”
As she spoke, Liu Yue’er’s figure flashed, and she left Lin Yi’s room.
Lin Yi closed the door and began to regulate his breathing.
The seclusion lasted for five days.
Lin Yi had nearly recovered from his internal injuries and was ready to set out.
“I am now at the peak of the Foundation Establishment stage. With two more days, I could break through to the Golden Core stage and then venture out. This way, I’ll be safer while traveling,” Lin Yi thought.
On the evening of the sixth day, Lin Yi arrived at Meng Qi’s room.
Meng Qi had awoken. Seeing Lin Yi enter the room, she immediately stood up, walked towards him with a big smile, and cheerfully called out, “Junior Brother Lin!”
Lin Yi nodded, “Senior Sister Meng Qi, I am leaving for two days. I’m going on a journey. When I’m out, I hope you can take good care of Junior Sister Meng Qi.”
“Mm, don’t worry. As long as I’m here, I definitely won’t let anything happen to her!” Meng Qi promised earnestly.
Relieved by Meng Qi’s promise, Lin Yi knew she was a kind-hearted girl who would never deceive him.
“Then I’ll leave her in your care, Senior Sister Meng Qi,” he said, nodding.
“It’s no problem at all. I’m doing it for your sake,” Meng Qi laughed.
Then, bidding farewell, Lin Yi left the inn.
On his way, Lin Yi had already booked a plane ticket, heading straight for the airport, preparing to board a plane to venture into the Demon Clan’s secret realm.
After Lin Yi left, Liu Yue’er came to his room.
“Eh? Where’s Lin Yi? Where did he go?”
Liu Yue’er looked around but couldn’t find any trace of Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi, why did you run off?” she murmured to herself, looking worriedly at Lin Yi’s door before finally sighing and walking away.
Lin Yi had left the inn and bought a plane ticket to Northern Desolation at the airport, preparing to venture there.
On the plane, Lin Yi recalled his recent cultivation experiences. His head felt heavy, as if he was about to fall asleep, but he clenched his teeth and persisted, daring not to sleep.
With his current strength, he had no chance against a Nascent Soul stage cultivator. If he fell asleep and was sneak-attacked by one, it would be very troublesome.
“`
Lin Yi dared not be careless, nor could he take anything lightly; he had to live cautiously and carefully.
Throughout the journey, Lin Yi remained highly vigilant, fearing he might encounter any danger.
Just as Lin Yifei’s plane was about to land, he suddenly sensed someone approaching.
This sense of crisis was very strong, startlling Lin Yi, who hastily opened his eyes.
Sitting not far to Lin Yi’s left, there were two people, a man and a woman, among whom the woman was about the same age as Liu Yue’er, with a slender figure, a beautiful face, and a pair of clear eyes that gave a pure impression.
“Lin Yi, why are you on the plane, and how did you know I was coming here?”
Seeing Lin Yi stand up from his seat, Liu Yue’er asked in a hurry.
Lin Yi was slightly taken aback, wondering if this girl could be Liu Yue’er?
However, upon reflection, he felt it was somewhat impossible; Liu Yue’er would absolutely not have followed him to the Northern Desolation.
Seeing that Lin Yi didn’t answer her, Liu Yue’er grew anxious, calling out continously, “Lin Yi, Lin Yi, say something, how did you know I was coming here? How did you know that I would come to the Northern Desolation with you?”
Lin Yi, hearing Liu Yue’er’s words, couldn’t help but frown.
He looked at the girl, who was staring at him without blinking.
Naturally, Lin Yi recognized who this girl was; she was the same one who had dined with Meng Qi before.
Seeing the girl looking at him, Lin Yi felt a sense of helplessness.
It turned out that this girl was also a cultivator, and her cultivation had reached the peak of the early Golden Core Stage, slightly higher than Liu Yue’er’s.
Such cultivation was considered quite formidable within the entire Yun Jian Mountain range; Lin Yi wondered which peak’s disciple she might be.
Could the two of them be sisters by cultivation? Lin Yi guessed.
“Are you two cultivation sisters?” Lin Yi asked with curiosity.
The girl shook her head, “We’re not sisters, I’m a senior disciple.”
Lin Yi heard this and couldn’t help but become a bit surprised.
“You are a senior disciple, then who is she?” Lin Yi pointed at the young girl next to the woman.
“Her name is Liu Qingyan, and we are from the same sect,” the girl replied.
“So, you are Senior Sister Qing Yan,” Lin Yi nodded, then said to Qing Yan, “Senior Sister Qing Yan, may I ask what brings you and her to the Northern Desolation this time?”
Senior Sister Qing Yan, both last names were Qing; could they be relatives? Lin Yi considered the possibility but didn’t delve deeper as his relationship with Liu Yue’er wasn’t that intimate.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, you don’t need to worry about our business; we’re here to help you,” she replied.
“Help me?” Lin Yi, puzzled, asked, “Help with what?”
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, don’t ask what it is for now; you’ll understand once you get to the Northern Desolation. I can’t explain it right now; you’ll know once we arrive.” Senior Sister Qing Yan shook her head.
“Alright,” Lin Yi nodded.
After chatting for a few more moments, Lin Yi stood up and left, embarking on his journey to the Northern Desolation.
Lin Yi’s cultivation speed was incredibly fast; he reached the intermediate Foundation Establishment Stage in just two days and his Primordial Energy was abundant. He felt he could attempt to break through to the later stages at any time, even reaching the Nascent Soul Stage.
However, Lin Yi wasn’t in a rush to make a breakthrough since he still needed to consolidate the cultivation he had just achieved in the Foundation Establishment Stage.
In those two days, Lin Yi had roamed the Northern Desolation for quite some time and gained a lot, making him somewhat familiar with this unfamiliar land.

chapters.title: Chapter 576: 576: An Extremely Vast Continent
chapters.content:
Chapter 576: Chapter 576: An Extremely Vast Continent
The land of the Northern Desolation is vast, occupying about two-thirds of the entire Tianyuan Continent, a tremendously large landmass.
The Spiritual Energy in the Northern Desolation is scarce and not suitable for cultivation, only fit for ordinary Immortal Cultivators to survive.
But Lin Yi was no ordinary man.
His Cultivation had reached the Foundation Establishment Stage, he possessed formidable Physical Body Power, and had even comprehended the Metal Attribute’s Thunder Lightning Mystique, enabling him to unleash terrifying Thunder Power. To his enemies, he was undoubtedly a nemesis.
In the Northern Desolation, Lin Yi had collected some materials and refined a set of armored vestments that, when worn, doubled his defensive power. Even when encountering a Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator, he would not be injured, and his Attack Power had also increased significantly.
After donning this set of armor, Lin Yi gathered several precious Primordial Stones and refined a piece of Treasure Level supreme grade treasure clothing, which was extremely sturdy.
...
Furthermore, it had strong defensive power, enough to withstand the attacks of Divinity Transformation Stage powerhouses, making it a fine life-saving tool that could preserve his life in moments of life and death.
The value of this set of helmets and armor was enough to make a Loose Cultivator wealthy, and naturally, Lin Yi was very fond of it and kept the set of armor.
After gathering his spoils of war, Lin Yi left the Northern Desolation.
“Phew… finally left the Northern Desolation,” Lin Yi sighed deeply, murmuring to himself.
Soon after Lin Yi emerged from the Northern Desolation, Liu Yue’er caught up to him.
“How did you know that I would appear in the Northern Desolation?” Liu Yue’er was somewhat curious.
Lin Yi explained with a smile, “Your scent is very distinctive to me; I remember it clearly.”
“Oh, I see,” Liu Yue’er said, suddenly enlightened.
Then, as if recalling something, her expression turned serious, and she said to Lin Yi, “Junior Brother Lin Yi, do you remember the Flame Crystal Core I gave you last time? This time, I’m taking you to see a senior who can save you.”
Lin Yi nodded, replying, “I remember, I owe Senior Liu a favor for that.”
“Good, then let’s go now,” Liu Yue’er said.
Lin Yi looked around and then asked, “Where are we heading to?”
“We’ve been ordered by our sect leader to head beyond the Northern Desolation to the Barbarian Wasteland.”
“The Barbarian Wasteland?”
“The Barbarian Wasteland is the most mysterious region of the Barbarian Tribes, a completely enclosed space filled with storms and various Demon Beasts, fraught with danger. Inside are many precious treasures and abundant Spiritual Medicine.”
“Are these things useful for Cultivators?” Lin Yi asked in surprise.
The name of the Barbarian Wasteland was well-known, and this was Lin Yi’s first time hearing the term; moreover, it was filled with danger.
The Demon Beasts and plants inside the Barbarian Wasteland were the sacred objects of the Barbarian Tribes, imbued with massive amounts of Spiritual Power, many of which had nourishing effects on Cultivators and could even enhance Cultivation.
To Lin Yi, the Barbarian Wasteland was quite intriguing.
Wanting to see the sacred ground of the Barbarian Tribes for himself was only natural for Lin Yi.
“The Barbarian Wasteland is one of the more dangerous places among the Barbarian Tribes. You’d best not venture recklessly, or it could be life-threatening,” Liu Yue’er warned.
“Thank you for your concern, Senior Sister Liu Yue’er, but I’ve decided to take a look at the Barbarian Wasteland myself,” Lin Yi said.
Liu Yue’er sighed and said, “You are truly stubborn. If I don’t stop you, you’re definitely going to barge into the Barbarian Wasteland.”
“If that’s the case, then I’ll venture in and see for myself what the Barbarian Wasteland is really like,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“You… are so obstinate. Very well, then I’ll join you in this venture,” Liu Yue’er declared.
“How could that be possible? What if there’s danger when you go to the barbaric ancient domain? You should stay in Yunzhou,” Lin Yi quickly refused.
“No way, I must do this. Don’t worry, as long as I’m here, there absolutely won’t be any danger,” Liu Yue’er said with full confidence.
On hearing this, Lin Yi was taken aback and looked into Liu Yue’er’s beautiful eyes, thinking that this woman indeed had the spirit of a gallant warrior.
After some thought, Lin Yi said, “Since that’s the case, very well, I’ll agree to this.”
Liu Yue’er was very relieved to see Lin Yi agree.
“Let’s go,” Lin Yi said and then flew off into the distance at a great speed.
Liu Yue’er also followed closely behind Lin Yi, racing toward the depths of the Northern Desolation.
For this trip to the barbaric ancient domain, Lin Yi didn’t ride a flying creature, as he couldn’t use lightness skills while on it, so he traveled using his movement technique instead.
Lin Yi was very fast, he kept on rushing at full speed, continuously flying northward.
During this process, Lin Yi also found that the Heaven-Earth Vital Energy here was very similar to that of Earth where he used to live.
Here, too, was filled with dense Heaven-Earth Vital Energy, even purer and denser than other places. Cultivating here for just one day could significantly enhance one’s strength and there was even the possibility of breaking through to the Nascent Soul Realm.
The Spiritual Energy here was even more abundant than the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Energy on Earth. Cultivating in this place could make one’s Cultivation level increase tens of times faster than an average person.
After sensing the dense Spiritual Energy, Lin Yi couldn’t help but get excited. This environment was undoubtedly a superb place for him to cultivate in.
While on the move, Lin Yi absorbed the surrounding Spiritual Energy, and his Cultivation level increased rapidly.
“The Heaven and Earth Spiritual Energy here is just too good. Cultivating here for one day could elevate my Cultivation to the Peak of the Golden Core Early Stage,” Lin Yi said in surprise.
Lin Yi had always wanted to find a place rich in Spiritual Energy to cultivate properly, but he found the Spiritual Energy here to be so dense that he had no choice.
Now, this place had become his best Cultivation Field.
By cultivating here, his Cultivation level could grow rapidly, not only enhancing his strength but also helping his parents recover.
“Hmm?”
Lin Yi suddenly stopped.
His eyebrows slightly furrowed.
Up ahead, there were two massive presences.
“This presence, it actually has the pressure of the Golden Core Stage.”
“Are these two Golden Core Stage Cultivators coming for me? Who are they?”
Lin Yi ceased his steps, slightly on guard in his heart.
His senses told him that the strength of these two Golden Core Stage Cultivators was very formidable, not to be trifled with.
“No matter who they are, I’m not afraid. Now that I’m already a Golden Core Stage Cultivator, even if the two of them are peak experts of the Golden Core Stage, I won’t fear them,” Lin Yi calmed himself.
Although he didn’t know the identity of the other party, Lin Yi was not afraid.
“Kid, hand over your Storage Ring, or don’t blame us for being ruthless,” said one of the Golden Core Stage Cultivators, a skinny young man with a sharp gaze staring at Lin Yi.
Behind him stood three elders clad in black robes with icy expressions. These three elders were all at the peak of the Nascent Soul Stage, with extremely powerful auras.

chapters.title: Chapter 577: 577: Guessing Very Accurately
chapters.content:
Chapter 577: Chapter 577: Guessing Very Accurately
“So, it’s me they’re after. Could it be for my Storage Ring?” Lin Yi speculated.
Lin Yi’s guess was very accurate, for the thin young man was indeed the cultivator Lin Yi had encountered in Yunzhou City.
“Hahaha, kid, you’re in luck to have run into us two,” Li Hao, a Golden Core Stage cultivator, burst into wild laughter.
Lin Yi’s frown deepened.
He had guessed correctly; these two old men at the peak of the Golden Core Stage had indeed come for his Storage Ring.
These Golden Core Stage cultivators were all people with a certain status.
...
Moreover, their strength was very formidable.
“Two Golden Core Stage cultivators at the peak, this is indeed troublesome,” Lin Yi thought to himself.
Although his combat power was strong, he was not entirely confident about dealing with these two old men at the peak of the Golden Core Stage.
“Kid, hand over your Storage Ring, and then cripple your own cultivation. We’ll let you live,” the thin young man said arrogantly.
Lin Yi cursed inwardly and retorted, “Who are you to make such demands? What right do you have to do this?”
The thin young man shouted angrily, “Who are we? You don’t deserve to know. If you know what’s good for you, hand over the Storage Ring. Otherwise, we won’t hesitate to kill you, and you won’t even have the chance to cry.”
“If you want to snatch my Storage Ring, then present your evidence first!”
Lin Yi’s tone was still calm, neither humble nor arrogant.
This attitude, on the other hand, caused Li Hao to falter.
A dark-clothed elder by Li Hao’s side spoke, “Kid, don’t be so arrogant as to refuse a toast only to be forced to drink a forfeit.”
Li Hao nodded and said, “You’re right, but I advise you to surrender quietly. Otherwise, we won’t mind getting rough. When the time comes, the wealth inside your Storage Ring will belong to us.”
“Why should I give you my Storage Ring?” Lin Yi looked indifferently at Li Hao.
“Hehe,” the thin young man chuckled coldly. “If you won’t give it to us, then I’ll have to kill you.”
Lin Yi shook his head noncommittally.
“Hmph, you’re courting death, kid. Since you’re begging for it, I’ll oblige and send you on your way.”
Having said this, the thin young man took out a Storage Ring and casually broke the restriction on it. He then started taking out items and placing them inside a Spatial Ring.
Lin Yi observed clearly; within were piles of Spirit Stones, Spirit Grass, Spiritual Medicine, and other treasures, all rare varieties of Spirit Grass.
“Good grief, this turnout is not bad at all,” Lin Yi thought to himself with inner joy.
“Kid, if you don’t hand it over, you’re challenging us!”
“The few of us brothers hate nothing more than someone who doesn’t follow our orders!”
It was clear that these two Golden Core Stage cultivators had come prepared, and their target was Lin Yi’s Storage Ring. They were very strong and would be difficult to deal with.
“I don’t need your protection, I just want to cultivate quietly.”
Lin Yi began to fly forward, no longer paying attention to the two Golden Core Stage cultivators.
“Humph! If you refuse a toast only to be forced to drink a forfeit, then don’t blame us!” Li Hao snorted coldly and then waved his hand at two dark-clothed elders beside him.
Understanding the signal, the two dark-clothed elders immediately took action, each conjuring a Flying Sword and launching an attack at Lin Yi.
“Hmph!” With a cold snort, Lin Yi’s figure flashed and vanished from the spot.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh.
Two figures rushed over from both sides, but they couldn’t catch even a trace of Lin Yi.
After their attack missed, the two immediately changed their positions and continued the pursuit, but they still couldn’t catch up to Lin Yi, who instead shook them off.
While fleeing, the two men in black robes cursed angrily, “How can this kid be so cunning?”
“This kid is not simple, his strength is very strong, I’m afraid he has already reached the level of Great Perfection in the Nascent Soul Stage, we are no match for him, let’s leave this place quickly,” one of the men in black robes said.
“Indeed, we should hurry back to our sect to report this. The sect master will definitely be able to handle this situation,” the other man in black robes nodded in agreement.
Just then, Lin Yi suddenly appeared behind the two of them.
“Hm?”
Seeing Lin Yi’s sudden appearance, both were incredibly shocked.
They hadn’t expected that under their watchful eyes, Lin Yi would appear out of nowhere.
This was truly inconceivable.
“There’s no use in trying; you simply can’t catch up to me,” Lin Yi said indifferently, looking at the two with disdain in his voice, “Your speed is too slow, trying to catch up to me is just a waste of time.”
Hearing this, the expressions on their faces changed dramatically.
The two of them, at the peak of the Golden Core Stage, chasing down a minor cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage, such a situation could only happen in TV dramas.
But this youngster had casually neutralized the attack from both of them, which shook them to their core.
“Who exactly are you?”
The skinny young man asked, looking at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi smiled faintly and said, “My name is Lin Yi, from the Lin Family of the Southern Desolate.”
“What? The Lin Yi of the Southern Desolate Lin Family? Who is that?” The skinny young man exclaimed shockingly, his eyes wide as saucers, staring at Lin Yi as if he had seen a ghost.
He simply couldn’t imagine how a small Qi Refinement Realm cultivator could be Lin Yi from the Southern Desolate Lin Family, how could their direct lineage possibly allow a Qi Refinement Realm cultivator to become the Young Clan Chief?
This was absolutely impossible!
The behavior of the skinny young cultivator greatly annoyed Lin Yi.
“You don’t need to know who I am, you just need to know you’ve offended someone you shouldn’t have,” Lin Yi glanced at the skinny young cultivator with a hint of threat in his tone.
“Hmph! A mere ant at the Qi Refinement Realm dares to threaten me? You are too arrogant!” The skinny young cultivator snorted angrily.
With a very gloomy face, he said, “If you are willing to submit to our Li Family, perhaps there’s a way for you to live. Otherwise, our Li Family will definitely not let you off lightly.”
“The Li Family? Hehe, I thought it was some hidden power. Turns out it’s just some Loose Cultivators and you still fantasize about dominating the entire Southern Desolate?” Lin Yi shook his head.
“Kid, you’re courting death!” Having heard Lin Yi insult the Li Family, Li Hao was immediately enraged, his figure flashed, and he arrived in front of Lin Yi, punching fiercely.
“Boom!”
Lin Yi only felt a dizzying blur before his eyes as his body was knocked back several steps, a throbbing pain emanating from his internal organs.
Li Hao’s strength was incredibly terrifying, definitely at the Ninth Level of the Vein Condensation.
“Such formidable strength,” Lin Yi thought internally.
“This punch was because you forced me to use all of my strength,” the skinny young man’s eyes burst with a fierce glare.
“Boom!”
Another punch, and Lin Yi was once again sent flying.
“Bang!”
Lin Yi crashed heavily against the wall, blood trickling from the corner of his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 578: 578: Utterly Defenseless
chapters.content:
Chapter 578: Chapter 578: Utterly Defenseless
The frail young man’s eyes lit up with joy when he saw Lin Yi vomiting blood. He immediately pounced, kicking Lin Yi in the abdomen and sending him sprawling to the ground, blood spilling from his mouth.
“You little beast, this punch is to teach you a lesson on behalf of my master. Remember, you’ve offended the Lin Family of the Southern Desolate, and you’re as good as dead,” he said.
“I don’t care if you’re Lin Yi of the Southern Desolate Lin Family. Today, you must die!” he declared.
“You and your Li Family won’t live to see another day!” he threatened.
The two young cultivators relentlessly beat Lin Yi with fists and feet, beating him senseless without the ability to fight back.
Lin Yi’s face and body were covered in countless wounds, but he still clenched his teeth and persisted, not uttering a single word.
...
The two young cultivators saw Lin Yi’s unyielding demeanor and a tinge of reluctance flashed across their faces.
After all, Lin Yi was merely a cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage. Although he was exceptionally talented, compared to Li Hao, the gap in strength was simply too great to mention.
“Sigh, this kid has decent strength. It’s a pity he’s going to die like this!” one of them lamented.
“This kid is highly talented and is bound to have a limitless future. Maybe we should spare his life and take him into our Li Family. He would definitely be highly valued in the future. That way, as he rises through the ranks, we too would rise and even soar to new heights. Wouldn’t that be wonderful?” the other contemplated as they continued their assault and greed danced across their faces.
Lin Yi lay on the ground, letting them beat him, his face always wearing a scornful smile.
To Lin Yi, these two young cultivators were nothing more than clowns, not worthy of his concern.
“Not bad, you’re indeed an extraordinary talent!” commended one of the attackers.
“Too bad you’ve run into our Li Family,” he said smugly.
“I really want to see how capable you are of withstanding the Li Family’s Three Hundred and Sixty-Eight Palms!” the other mocked as they continued to beat and ridicule him, treating Lin Yi as if he were a mere clown.
“I don’t care who you are or how powerful you are; today, you’re doomed to face calamity!” one declared.
“Boom!”
Lin Yi received another punch from Li Hao. He couldn’t dodge in time, and his ribs shattered, a fresh gush of blood spurting out as he passed out.
Severely injured, Lin Yi lay on the ground, gasping for breath.
“Haha!”
“This kid is finally down!” they exclaimed with glee.
“This time, let’s see how he can escape!”
“No matter what, we’re going to kill this brat today!” they resolved.
“Let’s go! We can’t stay long in a public place like this,” one of them suggested.
“Alright!”
Seeing that Lin Yi had fainted, the two young cultivators stopped beating him and quickly left.
After they were gone, a figure appeared silently next to Lin Yi. It was none other than his master, Ye Feng.
Ye Feng glanced at the unconscious Lin Yi, a cold light flashing in his eyes.
He squatted down, picked up Lin Yi with both hands, and then vanished from the room.
Not long after Ye Feng left, the two young cultivators returned.
They approached Lin Yi’s bed, took all his belongings, and then left.
At that moment, Lin Yi, lying in bed, suddenly opened his eyes, his face showing a hint of bitterness.
“The Li Family truly is one of the oldest hidden powers in the Southern Desolate. Even their disciples are so powerful. It’s terrifying to think about the kind of response I would get if the patriarch of the Li Family were to see me,” he pondered.
“It looks like I’ll have to find a secluded place to recover from my injuries before I can plan my next move,” he decided.
Thinking this, Lin Yi took out several healing elixirs from his Spatial Ring and quickly recovered after consuming a few.
He took out a piece of paper from his Storage Ring and recorded all its contents.
He tore the paper into powder and threw it into the trash can.
After finishing these tasks, Lin Yi stood up, ready to leave.
But just at this moment, a voice sounded from outside the door.
“Kid, where do you think you’re going?”
“Weren’t you told to stay put right here? Where are you running off to?”
Upon hearing these words, Lin Yi’s brows slightly furrowed, and he turned to look outside the door.
Two young men in white clothes were standing before him. One was about twenty-seven or twenty-eight years old, with a handsome appearance and a tall, slender figure, exuding an air of grace.
The other seemed a little older, in his forties, with a burly figure and a face covered in mean flesh, looking quite ferocious.
Hatred filled both of their eyes as they looked at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s frown deepened. He recognized these two men; they were the ones from the auction hall.
One was called Li Wenshan, and the other, Li Hao.
Their cultivation was at the Eightfold Qi Cultivation Realm, quite powerful, but not terrifying to him, so he hadn’t taken them seriously.
However, Lin Yi’s power had greatly diminished, and he did not wish to engage them in combat again, hence he planned to leave.
“I am leaving, do not try to stop me.”
“We might not stop you, but, I want to tell you, if we decide to catch you, it would be as simple as squashing an ant.”
“Heh, I’m well aware of that.”
Lin Yi let out a cold laugh, “However, my advice to you is not to act rashly. If you provoke me, you might not be able to handle the consequences.”
Having said that, Lin Yi turned around and left the restaurant.
“Hmph, just a pathetic little cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage and he dares to threaten me?”
“I’ve got this kid’s life in my hands!”
“This time, I will take him back to the Li Family and let the family head deal with him personally!”
Li Hao, watching Lin Yi leave, a sinister smile appeared on his face.
After leaving the restaurant, Lin Yi headed towards a desolate small town nearby.
He needed to find a place to recuperate as soon as possible.
Lin Yi arrived at an inn in the small town and rented a room where he sat down to heal his injuries, planning to recover his strength and then seek revenge.
…
“What?!”
“Kid, did you really dare to injure the Li Family’s young master Li Hao?”
“Who are you, to dare hurt someone from the Li Family?”
Just as Lin Yi entered the inn, a cacophony of noise erupted inside it.
Hearing these noises, a chill surfaced on Lin Yi’s face.
He took out a black card from his Spatial Ring, on which were the words “Ye Feng.”
Carrying the black card, Lin Yi walked into a room, the only private room in the inn, usually reserved for esteemed guests only.
“Kid, what is that card?”
A burly man approached Lin Yi, his gaze falling on the black card in Lin Yi’s hand, his tone heavy with hostility.
“You don’t recognize this card, and I have no interest in explaining it to you.”
“But I’m warning you now, if you dare to trouble me again, I won’t hesitate to kill you all!”

chapters.title: Chapter 579: 579: Combat Power is Simply Abnormal!
chapters.content:
Chapter 579: Chapter 579: Combat Power is Simply Abnormal!
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the burly man burst into laughter, “Kid, you think you’re fit to kill us? Stop joking!”
Before the burly man finished speaking, a powerful aura burst forth from his body, slamming viciously towards Lin Yi.
This man was at the peak of the Eighth Layer of Qi Refinement, just one step away from condensing his Nascent Soul, and his combat power was freakishly strong!
This man’s strength was far superior to Lin Yi’s, and Lin Yi was definitively not his match.
But Lin Yi was no ordinary person; he had an elixir.
That elixir, which he had acquired from Li Hao, was a supreme grade Spirit Replenishing Pill, its effects even better than Spirit Stones, and it was something he urgently needed at this stage, so he swallowed ten pills in one go.
...
These ten elixirs were enough to elevate Lin Yi’s cultivation to the Fifth Layer!
And at this moment, Lin Yi was breaking through to the Fifth Layer!
“Boom!”
True Qi within Lin Yi’s body surged violently, turning into streams of Sword Qi, fiercely slashing at the forceful power that was coming at him.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Lin Yi clashed with the man, and he was sent flying away in an instant.
“Ah! You little brat, you can actually withstand my attack; no wonder you dared to speak of killing us.”
The burly man was extremely surprised, apparently not expecting Lin Yi to be so formidable as to take his attack.
All of this completely exceeded the burly man’s expectations.
“Hmph, since you know you’re no match, just give up and get captured, waiting to be taken away!”
The burly man let out a cold shout, lunging at Lin Yi once again.
The corner of Lin Yi’s mouth drew a mocking arc as he poured out all the remaining Spirit Stones from his Storage Bag onto the table.
Seeing the table filled with Spirit Stones, the burly man’s eyes blazed with intense desire, as this catch was going to get him a lot of good stuff!
Without any hesitation, the burly man pounced, directly snatching the Spirit Stones from Lin Yi’s hands.
But by then, Lin Yi had already silently retreated.
“Huh? The kid ran away?”
“He actually escaped!”
“Damn it! Chase after him! We must catch this brat and then thrash him severely!”
“Hurry, chase! Chase!”
“Kid, we will never let you go, never!”
The burly man shouted angrily while in pursuit, his voice filled with rage.
But they failed to notice that on a hidden path, a handsome young man in green was strolling leisurely.
Lin Yi’s steps were slow, moving one step at a time, as if enjoying the scenery.
“Whoosh! Whoosh!”
“Pfft!”
Suddenly, a whooshing sound reached his ears, followed by a gust of wind that struck hard against his back.
Lin Yi groaned, a look of pain crossing his face.
Lin Yi’s body inclined forward, finally hitting against a thick wall.
“Ow, that hurts! It’s killing me!”
Lin Yi’s face turned pale as he clutched his chest, muttering under his breath.
“Hmph, smelly brat, you got lucky this time, but next time you won’t be so fortunate.”
“Get out of my way!”
Anger appeared on Lin Yi’s face, and he abruptly lifted his right leg, kicking viciously at the person’s abdomen, which sent the man flying and crashing to the ground, rolling in a mess, vomiting blood.
The man got up and quickly ran away.
“You can’t escape.”
Lin Yi smiled and stepped forward, continuing to walk towards the front, his gaze falling on the black-robed figure ahead.
Seeing Lin Yi staring at himself, the black-robed figure immediately became alert.
“Kid, I advise you to behave and come back with me willingly, or else don’t blame me for being rude!” the black-robed figure threatened.
Lin Yi smiled lightly, “Oh? How exactly are you going to be rude?”
“Heh,” the black-robed figure sneered darkly, “Kid, you’ve got some nerve! You actually dare to provoke me?”
Lin Yi was taken aback and asked in confusion, “What do you mean? Why would I provoke you?”
The black-robed figure smiled and said, “It seems you really don’t know what’s good for you. Well, let me tell you, you’re already in the palm of my hand. No matter how much you struggle, you can’t escape from my grasp because from today onwards, you are an ant in my hand. I only need one finger to easily squash you!”
After hearing the black-robed figure’s words, Lin Yi laughed out loud.
“I think it’s you who wants to squash me. Aren’t you the one struggling under my palm right now?” Lin Yi said with a cold laugh.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the black-robed figure’s face stiffened.
“Kid, don’t be arrogant! I’ll definitely crush your bones later and make your life worse than death!” the black-robed figure said angrily.
Lin Yi smiled and ignored the black-robed figure’s rant.
At this moment, seeing that Lin Yi had no reaction, the black-robed figure felt a sudden surge of irritation.
“Kid! Kneel down and admit your mistakes! I might spare your life! Otherwise, I’ll tear you to pieces!”
The black-robed figure glared at Lin Yi malevolently.
“Alright then, since you want me to kneel, I’ll kneel.”
Having said that, Lin Yi indeed knelt in front of the black-robed figure.
Seeing this, the black-robed figure smiled triumphantly, “That’s right, kid! That’s exactly what I want, for you to kneel before me! Haha!”
The black-robed figure felt extremely satisfied, as if he had already seen Lin Yi kneeling before him and begging for mercy.
“Too bad, I don’t plan on doing as you wish.”
Lin Yi suddenly stood up and waved his hand in front of him.
“Huh? What do you mean?” The black-robed figure was taken aback and looked at Lin Yi with some surprise.
“This time I win. I’m going to extract your soul now and turn it into my puppet so I can control you.”
Lin Yi said with a smiling eye, condensing a spirit knife in his hand and slashing towards the black-robed figure’s forehead.
“You! Despicable!”
“Despicable my ass! I’m going to show you right now why I fight!”
Whoosh!
The spirit knife fell, and the black-robed figure let out a wretched scream as his soul was directly separated from his forehead, floating in midair.
“Kid, you dare!”
The black-robed figure’s complexion changed drastically as he roared in anger.
“What’s there to dare!”
Lin Yi sneered, condensing another spirit knife in his hand and chopping fiercely towards the black-robed figure’s forehead.
“Stop!”
Just as Lin Yi was about to strike again, a loud shout came from afar.
“Hm?”
Lin Yi slightly furrowed his brows and stopped his movement, looking towards the source of the voice.
The owner of the voice was the burly man who had just been sent flying by Lin Yi. His complexion was incredibly ugly now; he hadn’t expected that he would lose to a young boy.
“Hmph! Kid, you just wait. Once I find the clan leader, I’ll make sure you’ll wish to die but won’t be able to!”
The man dropped these harsh words and left straight away.

chapters.title: Chapter 580: 580 A Hint of Embarrassment
chapters.content:
Chapter 580: Chapter 580 A Hint of Embarrassment
Lin Yi also couldn’t be bothered with the man’s threats.
“Eh? This person, isn’t he the black-robed figure who blocked us at the cave entrance earlier? How did he suddenly get here?”
At that moment, Lin Yi noticed the burly man and couldn’t help asking, filled with curiosity.
The figure in the black robe stopped, his face revealing a hint of embarrassment.
“Hehe, I was watching you outside the cave earlier, and when you didn’t come out, I went in to have a look. Turns out you were up to no good in there, so I listened in from outside.” The black-robed figure said with an awkward laugh.
Lin Yi smiled and replied, “So that’s what happened. Well, I still owe you my thanks. If it weren’t for your help, I probably wouldn’t have escaped so easily!”
...
Hearing Lin Yi’s thanks, the expression on the black-robed man’s face grew even more awkward.
“Kid, don’t mention it.” The black-robed figure waved his hand and then changed the subject. “Kid, what did you find in the cave?”
“A person’s head!” Lin Yi said.
“A person’s head?” The black-robed figure’s face turned stiff, and he asked in confusion, “You saw a person’s head in there?”
“Yes.”
“Then, did you see who the person was?”
“No, it was just a head.” Lin Yi shrugged.
“What a shame, that was a cultivator’s Nascent Soul!” The black-robed figure said with regret, shaking his head.
Lin Yi sighed as well, saying, “Yes, it’s a pity. If it had been a woman’s, then I could have refined her Nascent Soul, and with that, my strength would certainly increase once again!”
“You sure are a toad lusting after swan meat!”
“You’re the toad, your whole family are toads!”
The black-robed figure was scolded by Lin Yi, and his face turned a few shades redder, but he didn’t dare talk back since he was well aware of the gap between them and Lin Yi.
He was now like fish on the chopping board, at the mercy of others.
“Alright, let’s leave this place now, and when we leave the village, I’ll take you to meet our clan’s Young Clan Chief!”
Lin Yi nodded and did not refuse.
Shortly after, the two disappeared from the area.
Elsewhere.
In the valley, the onlooking crowd dispersed after seeing Lin Yi and the black-robed figure vanish.
However, just at that moment, a figure suddenly rushed from afar at a high speed and arrived in the blink of an eye.
This person was the brother of the man from before.
Upon arriving, the man began to search all around, looking for traces of Lin Yi and the black-robed figure.
“Damn it! That brat slipped away again! But I will definitely not let you off. Once I catch you, I’ll make sure you taste my wrath!” The man swore through clenched teeth, his eyes flashing with ferocity.
He was the village chief, named Wang Qiang.
Wang Qiang came to a house and saw the corpse lying on the bed.
His face ashen, he stared at the corpse with eyes full of murderous intent.
“Father, rest in peace. I swear I will avenge you!”
As he spoke, Wang Qiang walked towards the corpse, intending to bury it.
But at that moment, Wang Qiang suddenly stopped in his tracks, his gaze fixed on his father’s head, his eyes filled with shock and horror.
“My God, who did this!” Wang Qiang exclaimed in horror.
The wound on his father’s head was too deep, someone had actually sliced off a piece of skin with a sword, and the shape of that wound was exactly the same as the attack from Lin Yi just moments ago.
“Who could it be? Is it them!?”
As Wang Qiang thought of this, his body trembled, and he hurriedly ran out to report the matter to his father.
Soon, inside a grand hall of the village.
An elder slowly opened his eyes, and upon seeing Wang Qiang sitting in front of him, frowned and said, “Qiang’er, what were you doing running over there just now?”
When Wang Qiang heard his father’s questioning, a bitter look appeared on his face, and he recounted what had just happened.
The elder’s face turned extremely dark upon hearing the account.
“Such audacity! How dare someone kill my brother!” the elder growled.
Hearing the elder’s words, a brawny man beside him immediately chimed in, “Indeed, the Young Clan Chief deserved to die!”
This brawny man was Wang Qiang’s grandfather. After giving birth to them, he and Wang Qiang’s mother had left.
Hence, Wang Qiang and his father had always been raised by the clan chief, and he had always revered his own father as his mentor.
Seeing that his grandfather and his own father were on the same page, Wang Qiang felt a sense of relief in his heart.
“Father, just now, Lin Yi killed several people in our village, and he has already fled. We must inform the clan chief immediately and ask him to send an expert to capture Lin Yi, so he may receive the most severe punishment and avenge our father!”
Wang Qiang spoke righteously, his gaze filled with indignation and loathing.
“There’s no need to rush this matter. Lin Yi has already slain two geniuses in our clan. His strength must have reached the Marrow Refining Realm, or even surpassed it!”
“That powerful?”
“Of course, our clan chief is at the peak of the Nascent Soul realm in Alchemy. I believe our clan chief’s strength is beyond what ordinary people can imagine. Once our clan chief makes a move, Lin Yi will certainly find it impossible to escape; his death is certain!”
“Great! I knew your strength was extraordinary, Father, and you would definitely be able to capture Lin Yi!”
Wang Qiang said obsequiously, knowing that if his father made a move, Lin Yi was surely doomed. He decided that he had to perform well within the clan so that perhaps the clan chief might even consider promoting him to clan chief in time.
“Alright, go prepare yourself. The clan chief will personally seek out that Lin Yi later, and the experts in our clan will undoubtedly take action as well,” the elder said, waving his hand.
“Yes, Father! I’ll go prepare right now. We must bring Lin Yi back!”
Wang Qiang nodded and turned to walk outside.
“Clan Chief, are you really planning to personally apprehend Lin Yi?” the elder turned his head to look at Wang Qiang’s father and asked.
“Mhm, Lin Yi has slain several people from our clan. I must capture him and bring him to justice. We absolutely cannot spare this man!”
The elder nodded slightly upon hearing this.
“Since the Clan Chief has decided, I won’t say any more.”
“You may leave now,” the elder gestured with a wave of his hand, indicating it was time for the other to depart.
Wang Qiang’s father nodded and turned to walk towards the door.
“This time, I’m going to see just how capable Lin Yi really is, to even target the clan chief’s son. I must let him know just how formidable our clan chief is!”
Stepping out of the door, a bitter and malevolent glint flickered in Wang Qiang’s eyes.
He harbored intense hatred toward Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 581: 581: Hiding in the Ceiling Beams
chapters.content:
Chapter 581: Chapter 581: Hiding in the Ceiling Beams
In Wang Qiang’s eyes, his own father was like a god, and being the son of his father was equivalent to being his father himself. How could he tolerate someone insulting his father?
Lin Yi and Xiao Yuxin had not left; they were hiding on the roof beams.
They heard the discussions outside and had clearly heard the conversation between Wang Qiang’s father and his grandfather, realizing that Wang Qiang’s grandfather was a high-level expert of the Soul Refinement Realm.
Lin Yi and Xiao Yuxin were secretly alarmed, having not expected that a hidden expert of the Soul Refinement Realm would be in this village.
Although Wang Qiang’s father was only a Martial Artist of the Soul Refinement Realm, he would have no trouble dealing with them.
“Miss, what do we do now?” Xiao Yuxin asked.
...
“The only option now is to run. Only by running can we save our lives,”
Lin Yi took a deep breath and said.
At his words, Xiao Yuxin fell silent, knowing that Lin Yi was right.
If they continued to stay in this village, they would eventually be hunted down by the Wang Family. They had been on the run for years and were already exhausted. If they were caught now, they would surely die.
“Let’s go! We’ll go find your uncle!”
“Okay.”
The two of them walked towards the Wang Family residence.
“Uncle.”
As they entered the Wang Family home, they called out to a lavishly dressed young man.
“Yu Xin, Xiaoyi, what brings you here?”
Uncle Wang’s face immediately burst with surprise at the sight of the two.
He was quite fond of his niece Lin Yi because of her exceptional talents. In his eyes, Lin Yi was like a rising star with limitless future potential.
And Wang Xiaoyi was his grandson, whose Cultivation might be average, but who also had outstanding talent.
Therefore, Uncle Wang also doted on him.
“Uncle, we’ve run into trouble!”
Lin Yi got straight to the point.
Uncle Wang’s expression turned puzzled upon hearing Lin Yi’s words.
“What trouble?”
“That…” Lin Yi hesitated.
Seeing this, Uncle Wang’s brow furrowed.
“Xiaoyi, what exactly happened? Is it that Lin Yi? Has he caught up to you and harmed you?” Uncle Wang asked.
Hearing Uncle Wang’s words, Lin Yi’s face fell as she relayed the entire situation to him.
After listening, Uncle Wang’s expression turned stern.
“Hmph, that brat dares to target my Xiaoyi, I must eradicate him to seek justice for you!”
Uncle Wang snorted coldly.
“Uncle, you mustn’t act impulsively!”
“Why? Are you afraid of that Lin Yi?” Uncle Wang asked, bewildered.
“Afraid? How could I be afraid? I’m just worried you might get hurt. You’re my grandfather, the person I respect the most. If you were injured, I would feel incredibly guilty!” Lin Yi hastily explained.
“You child, I’m not someone who doesn’t understand these things. You just stay safe at home, and leave the rest to me,” Uncle Wang said with a smile.
Lin Yi nodded, then turned to look at Wang Xiaoyi beside her, saying, “Xiaoyi, let’s go!”
Upon hearing this, Wang Xiaoyi didn’t say much and followed Lin Yi as they walked towards the distance.
Uncle Wang watched their departing figures, his expression growing solemn.
“Patriarch, what do we do now?”
The elder turned his head to look at Wang Qiang’s father.
Upon hearing this, the corners of Wang Qiang’s father’s mouth curled into a faint smile.
“Since this Lin Yi dares to target my son, it means he still has the strength to fight. If we take action against him now, he might strike back. We will observe the situation quietly for now and wait for my son to make a move,” he said.
The elder was slightly taken aback by Wang Qiang’s father’s words but then nodded in agreement.
“Well then, since the Patriarch has decided, I am reassured,” he said.
Uncle Wang watched Lin Yi’s departing figure with a soft sigh, murmuring, “It’s such a pity, I really wanted to tear that Lin Yi to pieces. But now, I’m afraid that’s not possible.”
With another sigh, Uncle Wang then returned to the house.
…
Lin Yi and Xiao Yuxin returned to the inn.
Neither of them rested as they began to discuss escape routes.
They both knew that they had no chance of contending against the experts of the Soul Refinement Realm, so escape was their only option.
“Xiaoyi, are you confident you can escape from here?” Xiao Yuxin asked.
Knowing that Lin Yi possessed incredibly fast speed, she was very hopeful about the escape plan, as their chances of successful escape were slim.
“I’m not very confident right now, but don’t worry, I have a secret technique that can allow me to burst forth with a speed many times faster than an ordinary person in an instant. As long as I give it my all, I should be able to escape. It’s just that I’m worried, once I use that technique, it might raise his suspicions,” Lin Yi said.
“Then what do we do? We can’t just sit here and wait for death, can we?”
“Of course not, we’re not sitting around waiting for death!”
“So what’s your plan?”
“Don’t rush, let me explain it to you slowly…”
Lin Yi shared his thoughts with Xiao Yuxin, and upon hearing his idea, she widened her eyes in disbelief.
“Lin Yi, are you joking with me? You actually want to use your best speed to escape. Isn’t that looking for death?”
“Who said I’m looking for death? As long as I get away, they definitely won’t be able to find me, and then you’ll be safe as well!” Lin Yi said.
“How is that possible?”
“Why isn’t it possible?”
“This…”
Lin Yi’s plan was wildly insane, nearly defying the heavens.
If Lin Yi were an ordinary person, his plan might have some chance of success, but Lin Yi was the young master of the Lin Family.
The Lin Family could be considered the number one great clan in Tianyuan City, with vast influence; something not a regular family could stand against.
“Yu Xin, rest assured, I have a way to ensure your safety,” Lin Yi said, patting his chest with full confidence.
“Your plan is to have your grandfather take you to settle the score with Lin Yi and capture him?” Xiao Yuxin asked, frowning.
Lin Yi nodded, saying, “Exactly, that’s what I’m considering.”
“Alright then, I believe you have a way!” Xiao Yuxin said.
Lin Yi nodded and then bid farewell to Xiao Yuxin, leaving town alone to start looking for Lin Yi, with Xiao Yuxin following behind.
On one hand, he was to protect Xiao Yuxin, and on the other, he allowed Xiao Yuxin to interact with Wang Xiaoyi to see if she could ferret out some information.
After leaving the Wang Family, Lin Yi immediately activated the Communication Jade Token.
He was ready to contact someone.
“Lin Yi, you’ve finally remembered to contact me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 582: 582: Good Relationship
chapters.content:
Chapter 582: Chapter 582: Good Relationship
“`
A magnetic voice resounded, it was Lin Yi’s second senior brother, Lin Xuan’s voice.
“Hehe, Xuan Brother, long time no see!” Lin Yi said with a slight smile.
“Long time no see, but why did you suddenly think to find me?” Lin Xuan said with a smile.
Lin Xuan and Lin Yi had a good relationship; moreover, Lin Xuan was his master’s disciple and the person he respected the most.
“Xuan Brother, I have something very important to tell you!”
...
Lin Yi said mysteriously.
“Oh? What’s so important?”
“Xuan Brother, I’m now outside of Tianfeng Town, come out quickly!”
“What? You’re outside, what are you doing outside?”
On hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Xuan was instantly startled.
“I…”
“What? Can’t you let me know? Are you deceiving me?” Lin Xuan said in a stern tone.
Lin Yi inwardly cursed Lin Xuan for being cunning, but, to get Lin Xuan’s help to escape, he still gritted his teeth and bore it, saying, “I’m outside to escape.”
“Escape? What has happened that’s causing you, the young master, to run away?”
Lin Xuan raised an eyebrow, looking quite displeased.
“I don’t have time to explain in detail right now, Xuan Brother. Just come out quickly, if you don’t come, I won’t tell you!” Lin Yi said.
Hearing this, Lin Xuan snapped, “Fine, if you insist that much, I won’t ask further. But remember, we are allies, no matter what danger you face, just give the word and I’ll definitely help you!”
“Xuan Brother, thank you!” Lin Yi said earnestly.
After hanging up the Communication Jade Token with Lin Yi, Lin Xuan quickly left the Cultivation Room and darted towards the outskirts of the town.
…
“Lin Yi, you actually dare to show up in front of me? Truly courting death!”
As soon as Lin Xuan appeared, a cold voice sounded near his ear—it was Lin Yi’s grandfather, Lin Ba.
“Grandfather, I know you practice a secret technique, and I have no desire to fight with you. Just one question, where is Lin Yi?” Lin Xuan said in a deep voice.
“You’re in such a hurry to find Lin Yi? Could it be that you’re here for revenge?”
Lin Ba narrowed his eyes, his gaze icy as he looked at Lin Xuan.
“Grandfather, there’s no need to hide it from me. Actually, you’ve long guessed that Lin Yi is nearby, you just haven’t exposed me. I’ve come back this time to have you hand over Lin Yi,” Lin Xuan said in a deep voice.
Lin Yi was a very important person in Lin Xuan’s eyes. How could he stand idly by when Lin Yi was in trouble?
“Hmph, I, Lin Ba, have spent a lifetime in battle for my country. How can I allow others to harm Lin Yi? If you insist on saving Lin Yi, then I will kill you!”
Lin Xuan let out a cold snort, his killing intent clear.
“You…”
Lin Xuan was furiously enraged, not having expected the old man Lin Ba to be so despicable and shameless, even thinking of laying a treacherous hand on him. This was beyond his imagination, and his heart filled with rage, wishing to rush forward and fight Lin Ba to the death. But reason told him that he must not be so impulsive.
“Lin Xuan, if you think of opposing me, it’s futile. I have cultivated the Nine Revolutions Golden Bell Shield and the Nine Revolutions Blood Demon Technique, my defensive power is astonishing. I do wonder how you could possibly deal with me?”
Lin Ba looked at Lin Xuan arrogantly, as if staring at a dead man, a cold smirk appearing at the corner of his mouth.
“You!” Lin Xuan’s face changed color.
“`
He naturally knew how formidable the Nine Revolutions Golden Bell Shield and the Nine Revolutions Blood Demon Technique were. These Cultivation Techniques were the unique expertise of Lin Yi’s grandfather, who could be considered the number one master in Tianfeng Town, with supremely powerful strength.
Even Lin Xuan didn’t have confidence in defeating him, let alone himself?
“Lin Yi, I advise you not to waste your effort. No matter how powerful your Martial Arts are, they’re useless in front of me. Just accept your death obediently!”
Lin Ba sneered coldly, his figure flickering as he rushed to attack Lin Yi.
At that moment, Lin Xuan also reacted. He hurriedly executed the Nine Revolutions Blood Demon Technique, injecting the True Qi from within his body into his blood vessels, using every trick in the book, and launched an assault against Lin Ba.
“Lin Yi, although your Nine Revolutions Blood Demon Technique is not bad, after all, you are just a child, and you have not been practicing for a long time. I am not afraid of you at all.”
Lin Ba struck out with a palm, dissolving Lin Xuan’s attack.
Upon seeing this, Lin Yi quickly retreated to one side, and then took out three Talismans and threw them out. The three Talismans emitted dazzling light, turning into meteor-like streaks as they shot explosively around.
“Lin Yi, doing this will only waste your Talismans. You’re no opponent of mine. If you know what’s good for you, hand over Lin Xuan to me, and I might spare your life.”
Lin Ba immediately taunted upon seeing Lin Yi’s action.
“Hmph, just because you’re not my match doesn’t mean you deserve to own Lin Yi. If Lin Yi wishes, I can kill you at any moment, but if he doesn’t want me to, then you can forget about getting him!”
Lin Yi replied coldly.
“Hmph! Lin Yi, you’re really asking to drink a penalty shot since you’ve refused a toast!”
Lin Ba, angered, trembled, and punched towards Lin Yi.
Upon seeing Lin Ba’s attack, Lin Yi didn’t dodge; instead, he chose to meet it head-on.
“Boom boom boom boom!”
Several muffled thunderous noises echoed.
Lin Yi’s body was sent flying, blood spitting from his mouth.
Lin Yi’s body was relatively frail, incapable of withstanding an attack from Lin Ba, and was heavily injured by the strike.
“Hahaha… Lin Yi, now you understand what the gap between us is, right?”
“Hmph!”
“Lin Yi, don’t delude yourself with the idea of contending with me. I am not a match for Lin Yi, whose True Qi is far too dense, and my Physical Strength is nowhere near as good as his!”
“Yet, my Cultivation Technique is the most suited for killing. Your Cultivation might also be high, but your Physical Strength is not as good as mine, so you can’t possibly be my opponent!”
Lin Ba laughed heartily.
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s eyes surged with cold light, murderous intent evident in his heart, yet he said nothing.
“Lin Yi, I know you certainly have many secrets you don’t want others to know about, don’t you? Rest assured, once Lin Xuan dies, I will cover up those secrets for him, so he will never know!” Lin Ba said.
“Lin Ba, by doing this, you’ve deeply intensified the conflict between us. We must have a showdown!”
Lin Xuan said coldly.
“So what? I can make Lin Xuan shut up forever!” Lin Ba said, with a hint of ruthlessness flashing in his eyes.
Startled, Lin Yi quickly responded, “Lin Ba, don’t mess around. Lin Xuan is my own brother. If you dare to harm his life, I will not let you go!”
“Heh, Lin Yi, do you really think I am threatening you? If I truly wanted to kill him, do you think he could escape?”
“I know you don’t believe me, but I can’t be bothered to explain further. I’m sending you on your way now; you can rest in peace!”
As Lin Ba spoke, he took a step forward, reached Lin Yi’s side, swung his arm, and prepared to chop off Lin Yi’s head, ensuring his definitive fall here.

chapters.title: Chapter 583: 583: Is there an expert offering guidance?
chapters.content:
Chapter 583: Chapter 583: Is there an expert offering guidance?
Lin Yi, seeing the situation, displayed a look of panic on his face; he knew Lin Ba meant what he said and would follow through with his threat.
However, Lin Yi’s head did not move at all.
Lin Ba saw Lin Yi’s reaction and a hint of confusion appeared on his face. He simply couldn’t understand why Lin Yi was not afraid of death. It was indeed bizarre. Could there be a master behind Lin Yi guiding him?
With this possibility in mind, Lin Ba became somewhat wary. He did not dare to behead Lin Yi right away, but instead slapped him on the shoulder, knocking him out.
Then, he picked up Lin Yi.
Looking at the unconscious Lin Yi, his expression became much more solemn, for he couldn’t guarantee Lin Yi’s true strength.
...
Thus, he had to be cautious, lest Lin Yi’s master find out that he had killed Lin Yi; that would certainly bring him no end of trouble.
However, now that he had killed Lin Yi, there was no need for so much concern anymore.
After Lin Yi lost consciousness, Lin Ba removed his storage ring.
The storage ring was filled with Lin Yi’s wealth, all of which he had accumulated while with the Lin Family Clan.
Lin Yi put all these treasures into his Qiankun Bag and quickly left the place.
After his departure, Lin Ba immediately carried Lin Yi towards the outskirts of the Lin Family Clan. His current task was to get Lin Yi away as fast as possible to avoid his master’s wrath.
Soon, Lin Yi arrived outside the Lin Family Clan. Outside the gates, a group of guards stood watch, their strength considerable with each being an Innate Realm Martial Artist.
“Halt, you can’t enter here, get lost!”
Upon seeing Lin Yi, the guards promptly shouted out.
Lin Yi sneered and said, “I don’t care who you are, but if you try to stop me, don’t blame me for being impolite!”
“What an audacity!”
The group of guards, enraged upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, quickly brandished their longswords and struck at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi saw the incoming longswords and a cold light flashed in his eyes.
He reached out his hand, and a tremendous gust of wind surged from his body, repelling the longswords with such force that they were sent flying and dropped to the ground.
“You, you actually have the strength of the Innate Realm? Who, who are you really? How can you possess the Cultivation of the Innate Realm?”
One of the guards was shocked, his face turning ashen.
“Who I am is not important. What is important is that you scum are not worthy of knowing my name. Get lost, or you’ll end up like him, killed by me!” Lin Yi snorted coldly.
“Damn it!”
“Don’t be afraid, we are the Guard Captains. This brat is Lin Yi; he’s just at the early stage of the Innate Realm, whereas we are at the peak of the intermediate stage!”
The Guard Captain hastily shouted.
Hearing these words, Lin Xuan let out a sigh of relief inwardly, thankful that the Guard Captains were Martial Artists of the intermediate stage of the Innate Realm. Otherwise, it would be impossible for him and Lin Xuan to defeat Lin Ba.
“Lin Yi, don’t be too arrogant. I am the Guard Captain of the Lin Family Clan, and you cannot possibly be my match. If you surrender now, I’ll spare your life. Otherwise, you’re doomed to die today!”
The Guard Captain said coldly.
“Your life? You’re really too naive. Do you think you have the right to take my life?”
Lin Yi laughed loudly, took a step forward, arrived in front of the guards, raised his right foot, and kicked fiercely at the chest of the Guard Captain, sending him flying and tumbling to the ground – vomiting blood.
The Guard Captain suffered such a severe injury that his face turned unbearably pale.
He never imagined that his side would be so easily defeated, unable to withstand even a single move from the opponent.
“How can this be?”
“He, he’s just at the early stage of the Innate Realm, while I’m at the peak of the intermediate stage. How could I possibly lose?”
The shock on the Guard Captain’s face was unmistakable; he simply couldn’t believe the outcome.
“Hmph, did you really think your trash could trap me? You’re far too naive. Today, I’ll dispose of all your rubbish, so you can’t trouble anyone else!”
A chilling murderous intent flickered in Lin Yi’s eyes as he sneered coldly.
“Such arrogance. I’ll show you our power!”
“Kill!”
A Guard Captain roared, leading the rest of the guards in a charge toward Lin Yi.
Lin Yi scoffed disdainfully.
“Seeking death!”
With a flick of his sleeve, he struck out with his palm, instantly crushing a guard’s head. Then, like a specter, he vanished, reappearing behind another guard and delivering a punch that killed him on the spot.
In the blink of an eye, two martial artists at the early stage of the Innate Realm had died by Lin Yi’s hand, their bodies falling to the ground, blood spilling everywhere, a stark scene of desolation.
Lin Yi let out a cold laugh, then leaped forward, continuing his dash ahead.
He needed to find a hidden place now, to kill Lin Yi and leave no witnesses; otherwise, the news about him would spread, and surely a great number of powerful figures would track his whereabouts—he did not wish to be exposed again.
“Lin Yi, you can’t run. Soon, I will send people to hunt you down, and you will definitely be caught by us!”
“You trash, you are not even fit to oppose me. Do you think you’re worthy to be my enemies? I could slap all of you to death with one hand!” Lin Yi said with a sneer, his tone filled with disdain and mockery.
No sooner had he finished speaking when the sound of slicing through the air suddenly erupted, and blades stabbed toward him.
“Hmph! Petty tricks. Break!”
Lin Yi sneered, his hands moving in unison, sending out waves of palm winds that swept around him, neutralizing all the blades.
“You trash think you can kill me? You’re really overestimating yourselves.”
Lin Yi sneered.
“Lin Yi, today you won’t escape even if you had wings!”
At that moment, a sinister voice reached him, and a group of black-clad, masked individuals appeared beside Lin Yi.
Lin Yi turned his head to see that these individuals were all dressed in black, with only their faces exposed.
“It’s the people from the Black Demon Sect!”
Lin Yi’s gaze swept across them, realizing that they were all martial artists of the Innate Realm, and there were as many as thirty of them.
“Lin Yi, today marks your end!” the masked figures said with continuous cold laughter.
They had received the news early on that someone had intruded into the Lin Family Clan, and they had hurried over.
However, they hadn’t expected Lin Yi’s combat power to be so terrifying that he easily killed the guards.
That was to be expected, though, as he had now reached the peak of the early stage of the Innate Realm; these people were merely Houtian Warriors, so how could they possibly be his match?

chapters.title: Chapter 584: 584: The Huge Palm Imprint
chapters.content:
Chapter 584: Chapter 584: The Huge Palm Imprint
“Haha, you bunch of trash also want to kill me? That’s hilarious!” Lin Yi burst into laughter.
“Kill!”
“Kill him!”
The group of men in black roared in unison, then charged toward Lin Yi, each unleashing every trick up their sleeves, displaying their formidable strength.
“A bunch of trash!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, swinging his palm across the air, unleashing a vast surge of Spiritual Power from his hand that transformed into a giant palm imprint, bearing down on these people.
...
Bang bang bang!
The power of this palm was no small feat, instantly smashing these people into a mushy paste, their blood spattering on the ground.
“How is this possible, how is this possible!”
The remaining guards saw Lin Yi killing these Innate experts and were petrified, their faces filled with shock and disbelief.
“Now, it’s your turn!”
Lin Yi scanned the crowd with his gaze, and his figure suddenly vanished from the spot.
The next second, Lin Yi’s speed abruptly increased, instantly appearing beside these people, slapping out a palm and turning them all into a mash of flesh, a pile of rotten meat.
“You trash, is this all you’ve got? Utterly pathetic. If I come before you, I guarantee you’ll all turn into a pile of sludge!”
Lin Yi sneered disdainfully and then darted forward in a sprint.
Seeing Lin Yi’s vicious methods, the group turned deathly pale with fright, and they all used their Secret Techniques to flee, terrified that Lin Yi would chase after them.
Finding this quite amusing, Lin Yi relentlessly pursued the group of guards.
He was now a Martial Artist of the Innate Realm, while these guards were merely at the Early Stage of Innate Realm; killing them was a piece of cake for him.
“Damn it, how much strength does Lin Yi have?”
“Could he be at the level of a Houtian Ninefold Warrior?”
“Impossible, even a Houtian Ninefold Warrior wouldn’t be this formidable. Could his cultivation speed be faster than Houtian Martial Artists?”
“No matter how fast his cultivation speed, he’s still just an Innate Martial Artist, and his strength is at most around the fifth or sixth Level of Houtian. We are over thirty people here, enough to take him down!”
“Right, even if Lin Yi is stronger than us, we have strength in numbers, he can only surrender!”
“Exactly, we’ll strike together, kill him, and snatch his Storage Ring!”
The people discussed noisily, exuding an air of assured victory.
“Thinking of killing me? Delusional!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly.
The very next moment, a terrifying aura burst forth from inside him, a raging wave of energy surged out like a vortex, enveloping the entire space in an instant, drawing in every attack.
“What!”
All were stunned, dumbfounded by the sheer strength of Lin Yi, who could swallow even their combined attacks.
“You, you’re an Innate Martial Artist? How can you be an Innate Martial Artist!”
A man in black trembled, his face full of fear, unable to comprehend how Lin Yi could possibly be an Innate Martial Artist!
An Innate Martial Artist was, in their eyes, a high and mighty existence, far removed from the mortal world, never to appear amidst the common dust of the earth!
“You all deserve to die!”
Lin Yi bellowed furiously, his figure shifting, and in an instant, he was in front of the man in black, his hand striking out toward him.
Slap!
A crisp slap sounded, and the man in black was sent flying, crashing into a building and demolishing the entire structure.
“You, you dare to hit me?”
“I’m going to kill you!”
“I’m going to kill you!”
These black-clad assailants roared angrily as they charged towards Lin Yi, their eyes filled with hatred.
Lin Yi ignored the black-clad assailants, his toes tapped the ground, and his figure swept forward, appearing instantly in front of one.
Smack!
Lin Yi swung another slap, sending the assailant flying away.
This black-clad assailant flew seven or eight meters before crashing to the ground, spitting blood and dying on the spot.
“Ah!”
Another black-clad assailant, upon seeing this, couldn’t help but scream, his legs went soft with fear, and he didn’t dare make another move.
Lin Yi didn’t spare them a glance, heading straight for the next person, and with a slap, killed him as well.
His actions utterly intimidated these men, causing the group of black-clad assailants to dare not attack any longer; their faces turned pale, their eyes filled with an intense fear, not daring to make another move, only praying in their hearts, “Please don’t kill me, please, I want to live!”
Lin Yi paid no heed to their pleas, continuing forward, slaying each guard with a slap, and in the blink of an eye, the ground was littered with corpses, the grass soaked red with blood.
“You all deserve to die!”
Lin Yi’s gaze was icy to the extreme, his killing intent towering, inspiring dread in those who saw it, as if a god of slaughter had descended upon them.
When the black-clad assailants heard Lin Yi say this, they grew even more afraid, never having expected Lin Yi to actually kill them; they shivered all over, their faces showing despair.
“What do we do, what do we do? What should we do now?”
“Don’t kill me, I am willing to surrender to you, please spare me, I beg you, spare me!”
“I beg you, please don’t kill me!”
All these black-clad assailants knelt on the ground, wailing continuously, terrified by Lin Yi’s ruthless methods; where was their earlier arrogance and domineering behavior now?
“You think of surrendering to me now? Too late, you must die!”
Lin Yi roared, his arm swinging, and a streak of sword light sliced down towards the group of black-clad assailants like lightning.
Splash!
Blood splattered everywhere as Lin Yi slaughtered the entire group, leaving no survivors, not a single one!
“Lin Yi, you are too domineering, actually killing them all!”
“They were masters of the Innate Realm, even our Sect Elders would treat them with great respect, and you, a junior, dare to kill them!”
An elder stood up, his face immensely dark, his tone filled with rage.
In their Sect, there were several older Innate Martial Artists whose strength was not weak, ranking around one hundred in the Innate Sect, equivalent to Sect Masters and Elders in status, but now, they were killed by a mere youth.
For the Sect, this was a great humiliation!
“Who the hell are you to speak to me like that, believe it or not, I will kill you right now!”
Lin Yi glanced at the elder and spoke indifferently.
“I admit you are very strong, but our Sect has two Innate Martial Artists as guardians, do you dare kill me?”
The elder looked confident.
“Heh, since that’s the case, then I will kill you!”
Lin Yi sneered, his eyes flashing with a cold light, his killing intent chilling.
“You, you actually dare to kill me?” The elder suddenly panicked, turned white as a sheet, and immediately turned to run, not daring to confront Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 585: 585: Trembling All Over in Fear
chapters.content:
Chapter 585: Chapter 585: Trembling All Over in Fear
“Running away?” Lin Yi sneered and in a flash, was beside the old man, raising his hand to chop at the old man’s head.
The old man shook in terror and hurriedly took out an elixir to consume. He circulated his cultivation technique, and his body trembled; suddenly, his aura soared, and his figure swelled to several times its original size in the blink of an eye, erupting with an astonishing presence.
“I am now at the peak of the Innate Second Layer Realm; you can’t kill me!”
Seeing Lin Yi halt the pursuit, the old man breathed a sigh of relief and said with smug satisfaction.
Innate Second Layer?
Lin Yi frowned slightly.
...
Even though the old man had greatly increased his strength, Lin Yi knew he could still defeat him with one move; there was no need for concern.
“Hmph, when I say I will kill you, I will. When I say I will kill you with one move, I definitely can!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly and once again slapped towards the old man.
Boom!
Lin Yi’s palm contained boundless might; a terrifying wind howled into being, lifting sand and stones off the ground into a swirling dance, his momentum overwhelming.
Seeing this, the old man’s eyes revealed deep terror as he quickly mobilized his cultivation technique to defend against the palm.
Boom!
A loud noise rang out as the old man’s body was sent flying, smashing through several large trees and spewing fresh blood.
Thud!
The old man fell to the ground and, after scrambling back up, immediately fled.
Lin Yi gave chase immediately, punching him and sending him soaring through the air; another kick knocked him out cold.
Afterward, Lin Yi walked over, grabbed the old man by the neck, lifted him up, and tossed him onto a large tree, tying him up tightly.
“Now that I know where you and your people come from, I must deliver you to the sect and have you executed!”
Lin Yi dropped the old man to the ground and coldly scanned the black-clad men.
“No, please, Young Master Lin Yi, spare my life, I know I was wrong; please let me go!”
“Spare me, I too realize my mistake, I will never dare to provoke you again, spare my life!”
“I am willing to join your sect!”
“I am willing to submit to you!”
“Please, let me go!”
The black-clad men, terrified by Lin Yi, surrendered one after another, all with faces of sorrow and fear.
“Thinking of submitting to me now, what were you doing earlier?”
Lin Yi glanced at them, utterly disdainful.
The old man, seeing their state, couldn’t help but shake his head, feeling that this group had completely lost face; it was a disgrace!
“Lin Yi, you’ve killed so many people, are you not afraid of divine retribution?”
“Aren’t you afraid of the sect’s vengeance?”
A man in black yelled out.
“I, Lin Yi, am not afraid because I simply do not take any power into consideration!”
Lin Yi’s gaze swept over the group of black-clad men with icy intensity.
“What? You’re not afraid of any sect?”
“Don’t go too far; a sect is not something you can provoke!”
“Let us leave the mountain at once!”
Provoked by Lin Yi’s words, the group of black-clad men glared at him with fury.
“Hmph, now you remember I’m an outsider? Where were you earlier?”
“You scum deserve to be killed, the more the better. Let the world know that you’re not only failing to protect the Huaxia lands but causing disaster and plunging the world into fire and water. You are all sinners who should be put to death!”
Two cold glints shot from Lin Yi’s eyes as a piercing aura emanated from his body, sweeping across the room and causing the men in black to tremble, their faces showing horror.
“What, what is going on? How can this guy be so strong?”
“My god, am I blind? He’s clearly only at the First Layer of Cultivation. How can he possess such a terrifying aura? It’s simply inconceivable!”
Everyone was petrified by the aura that Lin Yi released.
Lin Yi moved in a flash to one of the men in black, grabbed his throat with one hand, and lifted him off the ground.
Crack!
Lin Yi twisted the man’s neck without hesitation, blood gushing as his neck contorted grotesquely, dead beyond any doubt.
Seeing Lin Yi so easily kill a Second Layer Martial Artist sent by their own Sect, the remaining dozen or so men in black were scared to the point of wetting themselves.
“Not only have you failed to protect the Huaxia lands, but you’ve also brought calamity to the country and misery to countless people. Today, I enact justice on behalf of heaven to rid Huaxia of you. I advise you to cooperate willingly; otherwise, your fate will be unspeakably tragic. I will make you wish you were dead!”
Lin Yi’s gaze was icy as he spoke each word deliberately.
“We wouldn’t dare, we wouldn’t dare!”
“Young Master Lin Yi, as long as you don’t kill us, we will do anything you ask!”
Everyone hastily said.
Seeing this, Lin Yi nodded slightly, “Then hand over your identity tokens and Jade Pendants.”
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the men in black were overjoyed, and they each took out their possessions and handed them over to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi examined an identity token, confirmed their identities, and then returned the tokens to them.
Then he looked at another identity token.
“So they are disciples of the Sect, no wonder there are so many people here. Shameless, trying to occupy this place!”
Lin Yi cursed inwardly as he read the names and surnames on the identity token.
“Alright, you can get lost now!”
Lin Yi waved his hand dismissively.
“Yes, yes, yes!”
The dozen or so men in black rolled and crawled away, fleeing as if their lives depended on it, terrified that Lin Yi might change his mind and decide to kill them.
After the group had fled, Lin Yi approached the old man, grabbed his throat, dragged him down from the tree branch, and slammed him hard onto the ground.
The old man was thrown into disarray, seeing stars and spitting out several mouthfuls of blood.
“Cough cough cough!”
The old man clutched his chest, coughing violently with a pale face, as if his bones were shattered, in extreme agony.
“Now, are you ready to tell me where that ‘Sword Saint’ is?”
Lin Yi pulled up the old man and stared at him coldly as he asked.
The old man’s complexion changed, and he inadvertently stepped back several paces.
“Hmph, you refuse to speak? Don’t forget what you are. You’re a Sect disciple, and I’ve killed your Sect Master’s own grandson. The Sect will not let this go. I will ascend the Sect and wipe out all of you, leaving no survivors!”
A chilling look flashed across Lin Yi’s face, his voice terrifying like a demon from Hell.
The old man’s body shook, his face full of dread as he looked at Lin Yi and wryly said, “Brother Lin Yi, you can’t blame me for this. We were ordered to act and dare not conceal the truth or deceive you. Even if you kill me, you won’t be able to find the Sword Saint!”
“Oh?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 586: Profound Foundation
chapters.content:
Chapter 586: Chapter 586: Profound Foundation
“Then you shall answer a few questions for me honestly!”
“Yes, yes, yes!”
“This Sword Saint, who exactly is this esteemed figure?” Lin Yi asked coldly.
“That… That Sword Saint is a master of the Sword Emperor Realm, said to be an elder of the Tiangang Sword Sect!”
The old man swallowed hard, his voice trembling as he spoke.
“Tiangang Sword Sect?”
...
At these words, a trace of confusion flashed across Lin Yi’s eyes.
The Tiangang Sword Sect was the only super sect on the vast lands of the Southern Border.
With a long heritage and profound foundation, the Tiangang Sword Sect was a renowned great sect of the Southern Border, enduring through endless years, and possessing a high status and influence in the region.
Not only did the Sect boast the presence of a Sword King, but it also had a Sword Emperor – a master of the Sword Emperor Realm whose formidable strength was well known throughout the Southern Border.
“Your so-called Tiangang Sword Sect, is it the same as the Tiangang Academy?”
“Yes, yes, that’s right, it is the Tiangang Sword Sect!”
Source: , updated on ƝοѵǤᴑ.сᴑ
The old man kept nodding, his expression one of fright.
“Then why is he called the Sword Saint?”
Lin Yi asked again.
“Because the Tiangang Sword Sect has a close connection with the Sword Saint!”
The old man replied.
“Tiangang Sword Sect, Sword Saint… could it be a direct succession, like master and disciple?”
Lin Yi speculated in his heart, his brow furrowing.
“Brother Lin Yi, do you have any other questions?” The old man asked, looking at Lin Yi.
“Since you have such a deep relationship with the Sword Saint, why come here to cause trouble?” Lin Yi asked, frowning.
