“Hehe, because we didn’t know that Brother Lin Yi had already made a breakthrough from the Body Refinement Phase to the Soul Refinement Realm. We were ordered to test Brother Lin Yi’s strength, and if it were lacking, we would have captured you to be dealt with by our Sect Leader!”
The old man explained.
“Hehe, I see, so you’ve really gone to great lengths, even risking your own lives!”
Lin Yi chuckled, then flipped his hand and a pill fell into the old man’s mouth; he then stuffed the Elixir into the old man’s mouth.
“Is this… is this an Antidote?”
Seeing the pill that Lin Yi took out, a look of shock passed through the old man’s eyes; he looked at Lin Yi incredulously, obviously recognizing the pill.
Lin Yi nodded lightly and said, “Correct, this is a Detoxification Pill I refined!”
Having said that, Lin Yi turned to leave.
“Wait!”
Seeing Lin Yi about to depart, the old man hurriedly called out to him.
“Is there something else?”
Lin Yi turned around, looking at the old man, his voice calm.
“Brother Lin Yi, we were sent by our Sect to assassinate you, but we didn’t really intend to kill you. We hope Brother Lin Yi won’t hold a grudge against us!” the old man said.
“Hehe, are you saying you won’t kill me now?”
Lin Yi started to laugh.
“Mhm, we will not kill Brother Lin Yi!” the old man nodded.
“Since that’s the case, why won’t you let me leave?” Lin Yi continued to ask.
“This…”
The old man hesitated, not knowing how to respond.
“I’ll ask you again, are you or are you not sent by a Sect? Are you after something I possess?” Lin Yi asked coldly.
“Brother Lin Yi, I truly have no intention of targeting you. I’m just following orders, so please forgive me, Brother Lin Yi, and don’t take your anger out on us. We promise not to disturb you here again!”
The old man hurriedly said.
Hearing the old man’s words, half of Lin Yi’s suspicions disappeared, and looking at the old man, he sneered, “You’d better not be lying, if I find out you’re lying, you will die a miserable death!”
After speaking, Lin Yi turned and left.
“Brother Lin Yi, rest assured, we really won’t bother you again!” the old man said from behind.
Lin Yi no longer paid attention, quickly walking toward the outskirts of the forest, soon disappearing without a trace.
Watching Lin Yi walk away, the old man wiped the sweat from his forehead and let out a sigh of relief, muttering, “That was close, I’ve narrowly escaped a calamity!”
Lin Yi walked on, pondering over the matter of the Sword Saint in his mind.
This Sword Saint was an elder of the Tiangang Sword Sect, possessing extraordinary strength. Lin Yi didn’t know what kind of organization Tiangang Sword Sect was, only that it was very powerful, certainly much stronger than Tianyuan Sect.
What kind of Sect was the Tiangang Sword Sect? Lin Yi was a bit curious.
Lin Yi shook his head, casting aside these distracting thoughts, and quickened his pace, heading to the city center to buy a horse to ride to Tianyuan Sect.
In the vast lands of the Southern Border, Lin Yi only recognized one horse.
He immediately went straight to an inn, where he found a horse and bought it for three hundred Spirit Stones.
After buying the horse, Lin Yi immediately set out for Tianyuan City outside the city walls, planning to head to Tianyuan Sect after entering Tianyuan City.
He needed to hurry to Tianyuan Sect to inquire about the Sword Saint of Tiangang.
In this time, as he wandered the Immortal Cultivation World, he had made many friends and also encountered some enemies, all of whom wanted the treasures he possessed. And he wasn’t someone to be trifled with, as no matter who the other party was, they would suffer and pay the price!
Lin Yi found an inn outside the city to stay, then went to the nearby shops and selected a carriage for the journey.
The carriage was made of animal hide and looked luxurious, with a steep price.
Lin Yi rented the carriage and also bought some essentials, as well as dry food and water flasks, just in case.
“Whew!”
Lin Yi rode the horse, galloping away.
Inside Tianyuan City, Lin Yi found a restaurant, ordered a table full of delicious dishes, and waited for daylight while eating.
This time, Lin Yi didn’t go to the auction and didn’t attend the grand auction event.
His strength had now reached the peak of the Ninth Level of the Foundation Establishment Stage, just a step away from breaking through to the Golden Core Stage.
So, for the time being, Lin Yi had no plans to make the breakthrough to the Golden Core Stage.
Moreover, Lin Yi had no plans to seek out heavenly materials and earthly treasures to enhance his own strength anymore.
If one were to say what Lin Yi’s greatest reliance was, it would undoubtedly be his natural talent, the Heavenly Fire within his body, the Heavenly Thunder Body Tempering Technique he practiced, combined with that purple lotus, Lin Yi’s strength was simply defying the heavens!
Lin Yi was waiting for the right moment, planning to start secluded cultivation when his strength reached the Golden Core Stage.
One year, two years, five years…
Five years passed in the blink of an eye, and one day, Lin Yi suddenly felt a surge of rich Heaven-Earth Vital Energy flowing into his body from all directions, making his physical body brim with fullness. A faint purple glow appeared on his body’s surface, making him look like an Immortal.
Lin Yi knew that he had finally stepped into the Cultivator’s Realm of the Golden Core Stage.
In the Tiangang Secret Realm, absorbing a large amount of Heaven-Earth Vital Energy for cultivation, the pace was naturally much faster, and Lin Yi’s strength soared rapidly.

chapters.title: Chapter 587: Grasping the Sword Intent
chapters.content:
Chapter 587: Chapter 587: Grasping the Sword Intent
Lin Yi slowly opened his eyes, a glint of cold light flashing within.
“Brother Lin Yi!”
“Brother Lin Yi!”
Just as Lin Yi had opened his eyes, he saw seven or eight youths surrounding him, their faces displaying ingratiating smiles.
“Who are you? What do you want?”
Lin Yi coldly swept his gaze across the circle of seven or eight youths and asked in a deep voice.
...
These youths were not weak in their abilities, all around the Ninth Level of the Foundation Establishment Stage, among them one man’s cultivation was even at the Early Stage of Foundation Establishment, and he had also grasped the path of the sword, understood Sword Qi, extremely formidable!
“We are disciples of the Tiangang Sect, my name is Wu Ming, a disciple of your Sword Sect’s swordmaster, and my master is the Sword Saint!”
One of the youths declared.
Upon hearing Wu Ming’s words, Lin Yi felt a chill in his heart, not having expected that this Wu Ming would actually be a disciple of the Sword Saint, a cultivator of the terrifying Mahayana Realm.
“Brother Lin Yi, don’t blame us for bullying you. You are aware of the grievances between our Tiangang Sword Sect and your Tianyuan Sect. My master has deep-seated hatred for you, so he will definitely seek revenge. Just surrender without a fight!”
Wu Ming said with a smiling face, seemingly not the least bit worried that Lin Yi might try to run away.
Source: , updated on Ɲ0νǤᴑ.ƈο
“Heh, Tiangang Sect, I’ve indeed heard of it!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, glancing indifferently at Wu Ming.
“Humph, knowing our Tiangang Sect is good, that’s right, come with us!” Wu Ming said.
“Leave? Do you have the qualifications to make me leave?” Lin Yi said indifferently.
“You!”
Wu Ming’s face darkened, murderous intent bursting forth from his eyes as he said, “Fine, Brother Lin Yi, since that is the case, I will not stand on ceremony any longer!”
As soon as Wu Ming’s words fell, he drew his longsword, which emitted slivers of sharp Sword Qi, slashing towards Lin Yi, the Sword Qi crisscrossing like a raging Flood Dragon.
Swordsmanship!
This was a type of swordsmanship, an exclusive move of Sword Sect cultivators!
Although Wu Ming’s Sword Qi was only around the Eighth Layer of the Foundation Establishment Stage, it contained an immensely terrifying force!
“Your swordsmanship is indeed not bad, but in front of me, you still have a long way to go!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly and threw a punch, shattering the Sword Qi!
“This! This is impossible, how can this young man be so powerful?!”
Wu Ming exclaimed in surprise, his face full of shock as he looked towards Lin Yi, finding it incredibly hard to believe.
“I told you, I am here to kill you!”
Lin Yi coldly shouted, his figure flickering as he charged towards Wu Ming, his palms striking out continuously, unleashing waves of terrifying True Yuan force!
What Lin Yi was utilizing was the “Sword Form” from the “Sword Canon”.
The power of the swordsmanship was formidable; the average person could not withstand it.
However, in front of Lin Yi, everything was futile; he easily countered the “Sword Form”.
Wu Ming reacted swiftly, dodging in an instant to avoid Lin Yi’s attack and sending out a slash of sword light towards Lin Yi.
The sword light was as fast as lightning, flashing by in an instant!
“Whoosh!”
Lin Yi’s body seemed to turn into nothingness, and when a gust of wind passed, he reappeared right in front of Wu Ming.
“What?!”
Wu Ming cried out in alarm, his pupils dilating, his eyes filled with shock and panic.
He felt the oppressiveness of death!
“Bang!”
Wu Ming’s sword struck Lin Yi’s shoulder, but was caught by Lin Yi’s claw-like grip on the blade itself, breaking the sword forcibly. Then, Lin Yi’s other hand reached out, grabbed Wu Ming by the throat, and lifted him off the ground.
“Thud!”
An unimaginably terrifying force was transmitted, instantly sending Wu Ming flying several meters away, crashing through a few tables.
Wu Ming fell to the ground, coughing incessantly, with several broken bones throughout his body. The pain was unbearable. He lifted his head, his eyes filled with terror.
Lin Yi’s strength was indeed too formidable.
With a single move, Lin Yi defeated Wu Ming and then walked over to the group of youngsters, staring at them with a cold and icy gaze.
These youngsters were all petrified with fear and dared not speak.
They had already seen Wu Ming’s strength; he was a Foundation Establishment Early Stage cultivator. But Lin Yi’s cultivation had reached the peak of the Qi Cultivation Stage, a whole level higher than Wu Ming. Such a gap was simply insurmountable.
“Scram!”
Lin Yi said icily, releasing a majestic aura from his body that made everyone on the scene tremble and turn pale, quickly fleeing the restaurant in terror.
“Sigh~”
Once everyone had left, Lin Yi let out a deep sigh, feeling somewhat exhausted.
Lin Yi had just used more than a dozen secret techniques, and the amount of True Yuan consumed was enormous. But he still didn’t back down and resolutely stayed, wanting to see what the youngsters were really up to.
At that moment, a voice suddenly echoed in Lin Yi’s mind.
“Host, you have acquired a thousand Point Credits!”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was momentarily stunned.
“Ding, you have obtained a hundred thousand Point Credits and can exchange them for the mission item ‘Nine Revolutions Coagulating Blood Pill’. Do you wish to exchange?”
As the name implies, the Nine Revolutions Coagulating Blood Pill is an Elixir that can help one consolidate their Dantian and enhance their cultivation.
However, exchanging for one Nine Revolutions Coagulating Blood Pill requires two hundred thousand Point Credits!
“Exchange!”
Lin Yi did not hesitate and immediately made the exchange!
Afterward, Lin Yi sat down to recover.
A flame emerged on Lin Yi’s body, burning fiercely, exuding a warm aura that was soothing to the soul.
This flame was Lin Yi’s Spiritual Power.
Spiritual Power, for a cultivator, is like water and food; it can help rapidly replenish the Spiritual Energy depleted from the body.
However, Spiritual Power is the most precious thing to the body, because it can be slowly restored through cultivation. Unlike Spirit Stones and Spiritual Medicine, which are difficult to come by, once consumed, they are seldom able to be replenished.
Although the recovery speed of Spiritual Power is fast, it isn’t sustainable; after all, Lin Yi’s cultivation is only at the Qi Cultivation Stage, so his reserve of Spiritual Power is limited and cannot be used eternally.
“Brother Lin Yi!”
Suddenly, a soft and sweet voice rose from beside him.
Lin Yi turned his head and saw Lin Xueyao standing there, her beautiful eyes filled with a tinge of shyness and apprehension, as if expecting something.
Lin Xueyao, the youngest genius cultivator of the Lin Family, was also one of the candidates for Lin Yi’s fiancée.
“Sister Xueyao, why are you here?” Lin Yi asked.
Lin Xueyao blushed, lowering her head, “Brother Lin Yi, I missed you, so I came looking for you. I didn’t expect to actually find you here, and you even injured Senior Brother Wu Ming.”
“Hmph, I didn’t want to kill him, but he came to me looking for trouble so he can’t blame me!” Lin Yi scoffed coldly, his tone icy and devoid of any emotion.
“Brother Lin Yi, why did you want to kill Wu Ming? He didn’t offend you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 588: Noble Demeanor
chapters.content:
Chapter 588: Chapter 588: Noble Demeanor
“I did not offend him; I just wanted to teach him a lesson! But he dared to target me and even attempt to kill me, so he became my enemy, and that’s why I must kill him!”
“Brother Lin Yi, actually Brother Wu Ming was just confused for a moment. He didn’t know I was from the Lin Family; he only wanted to protect me,” Lin Xueyao urgently pleaded for Wu Ming’s mercy.
Upon hearing Lin Xueyao’s words, Lin Yi gave a cold laugh and said, “Lin Xueyao, I warn you, Wu Ming is my enemy; you’d better stay away from him!”
After Lin Yi finished speaking, he turned around and prepared to leave without caring about Lin Xueyao’s expression. Yet, as soon as he stepped out of the room, he encountered someone.
This person appeared to be around thirty years old, handsome, and imposing, clearly a wealthy young master.
Lin Yi was slightly startled when he saw him and immediately narrowed his eyes.
...
The newcomer was Yang Hong, the mayor of Qingshan Town.
In the town, Yang Hong wielded great power. Even his father, Yang Tianxiong, had to show him respect. Furthermore, in Qingshan Town, Yang Hong was nicknamed “Green Wolf”. He was the town’s vicious dog, robbing the villagers of their money, bullying men and domineering over women. He was utterly wicked.
Following Yang Hong were two strong and tough-looking young men, fierce and brutal, a group of villains who went unpunished in Qingshan Town.
Upon seeing Lin Yi, a sly look flashed in Yang Hong’s eyes.
Yang Hong said, looking at Lin Yi, “Boy, I didn’t expect you to dare to anger this young master. It seems you won’t recognize what’s what until you’re taught a lesson!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly without speaking; he just stepped forward, emanating a chill that involuntarily made Yang Hong and his men shiver.
Source: , updated on ƝοѵǤᴑ.ƈο
“What, what are you doing? Don’t mess around!”
Yang Hong swallowed hard, fear in his heart, and stumbled a few steps backward, pointing at Lin Yi, stuttering, “You, don’t mess around! Do you know who I am?”
Lin Yi grabbed Yang Hong’s arm and twisted it fiercely.
Crack!
Yang Hong’s arm twisted grotesquely out of shape.
“Aiyoo!”
Yang Hong screamed in agony, his face betraying a shade of panic.
He was a martial artist at the early stage of Foundation Establishment, yet Lin Yi dared to treat him this way. He could not fathom where this youngster had gotten his courage from.
The strength of Lin Yi was undoubtedly superior to his.
“Lin Yi, you, you dare to cripple my arm; you’re dead! You’re dead for sure!” Yang Hong pointed at Lin Yi, with growing panic on his face.
“Is that so?”
Lin Yi sneered and then suddenly reached out a palm toward Yang Hong’s chest, grabbing at him from afar.
Bang!
Yang Hong felt as if his chest had been struck by a sledgehammer; his body immediately flew out and slammed into the wall, blood spraying from his mouth.
Spurt!
Yang Hong fell to the ground heavily, spewing a large pool of blood, his condition looking particularly bleak.
“You, who exactly are you? What exactly do you want to do?” Yang Hong lay on the ground, a picture of helplessness, asking in a panic.
Lin Yi did not speak but slowly squatted down, placing a foot on Yang Hong’s neck.
Yang Hong felt as if a mountain was pressing on his neck, unable to breathe. He couldn’t muster the strength to struggle and felt like his neck was about to snap.
“Lin, Brother Lin Yi, spare my life! I was wrong! I won’t dare to do it again!”
Yang Hong shouted in terror, his face full of despair.
“It’s too late to beg for mercy now!” Lin Yi sneered coldly and suddenly lifted his foot!
Crack!
Crack!
Crack!
A series of bone-crushing sounds came from Yang Hong’s body.
Crack crack!
Crack crack!
Yang Hong’s body crumbled inch by inch.
Lin Yi withdrew his foot indifferently, patted his clothes, and walked outside.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi!”
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, save me!”
The flesh on Yang Hong’s body disappeared in an instant, turning into nothingness, leaving only a ghastly white skeleton lying on the ground, looking eerily terrifying.
For a moment, the entire yard fell silent; no one spoke, only the rustling sound of the wind blowing through the leaves continuously echoed in the yard.
Lin Yi had just stepped out of the house and was about to leave when he suddenly heard someone calling him.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, why are you leaving so quickly, you haven’t eaten yet?” A young man ran out and blocked Lin Yi’s path; it was Lin Xueyao’s classmate, Zhang Qiang.
Lin Yi glanced at Zhang Qiang and spoke indifferently, “You are?”
Zhang Qiang said with a smile, “Junior Brother Lin Yi, my name is Zhang Qiang, I am your senior. We knew each other from school, it’s just that I never had the chance to talk to you before, let’s have dinner together.”
Lin Yi frowned and replied, “Sorry, I’m not hungry.”
Zhang Qiang said, “Junior Brother Lin Yi, don’t be so cold, we’re also fellow villagers after all. You won’t even give me this bit of face, will you?”
“Fellow villagers? You think you’re worthy to call yourself my fellow villager? We’ve just met for half a day,” Lin Yi said scornfully.
“Half a day is enough!” Zhang Qiang chuckled and said, “Junior Brother Lin Yi, let’s have dinner together!”
“I’m sorry, I don’t want to dine with strangers; let’s forget about it.”
Lin Yi shook his head and turned to leave.
Seeing Lin Yi so unappreciative, a cold light flashed in Zhang Qiang’s eyes, and he cursed inwardly, “You little brat, just wait, I’ll see how I deal with you!”
After leaving the room, Lin Yi made his way toward the school cafeteria. He planned to grab something to eat before heading to the cultivation room to practice the “Seven Demon Forms.”
In Qingyang City, a gathering place for geniuses, the more talented a person, the more popular they become, for in Qingyang City they have great prospects; both their cultivation level and future achievements far surpass those of the average martial artist.
When Lin Yi first entered Qingyang Academy, he was just an ordinary person, not even considered a martial artist.
But in just a few months, he rose from a completely foundationless ordinary person to become one of the academy’s top geniuses. The hardships he endured, except for those who have experienced it themselves, are forever unimaginable in their bitterness.
Lin Yi arrived at the cafeteria, found a seat by the window, summoned a waiter, ordered a meal, and began to eat.
While eating, Lin Yi kept his head down, continuously eating, seemingly not noticing the movements around him.
His ears moved slightly, his gaze constantly attentive to the sounds around.
Just then, a young man dressed in black martial attire suddenly approached him, looking down at Lin Yi from above.
Lin Yi looked up slightly and saw the young man clearly: a very handsome youth, but with a pale face and trembling legs, clearly sickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 589: Outraged
chapters.content:
Chapter 589: Chapter 589: Outraged
This young man is named Zhao Wenhao, a member of the Zhao Family.
Although Lin Yi didn’t like to stir up trouble, it didn’t mean he would swallow insults. His character was such that if someone respected him an inch, he would respect them a foot.
“Why are you looking at me like that? You wouldn’t be trying to hit on me, would you?” Lin Yi sneered.
Upon hearing this, Zhao Wenhao immediately became furious, “You little brat, how dare you flirt with me, believe it or not, I’ll have someone teach you a lesson right now!”
“Oh, really? I would like to see whether you strike first, or I do!” Lin Yi sneered coldly and directly took out his phone to dial a number.
“Hello, President Wang, I’m in Qingyang City. Where are you right now?”
...
On the phone, a man’s voice with a hint of flattery responded, “Haha, who do I think it is? It turns out to be young master Lin. Why didn’t you come to see me when you arrived in Qingyang City?”
Lin Yi chuckled, “I just got to the academy and heard that President Wang, you are extremely busy, so I didn’t want to bother you. I just heard that your son was injured by someone, is that true?”
“It is indeed true, but it wasn’t my son who got hurt; it was a friend of my son’s. I am currently seeking justice for him.”
Lin Yi said, “I see. Then President Wang, where are you now? I’ll come over to see you!”
“Haha, that would be truly appreciated. I’m in a restaurant over on Qingyang Street, come over!”
“Alright, I’ll come find you now!”
Source: , updated on Ɲονǥο.сᴑ
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi stood up and walked toward the exit.
As Lin Yi left, Zhao Wenhao’s face clouded over, he watched Lin Yi’s retreating figure with a venomous gaze and said coldly, “You little rat, just you wait. Once I find evidence, I’ll make sure you’re dead!”
Lin Yi left the cafeteria and arrived at Qingyang Street. At the entrance of an inn, he saw the restaurant President Wang had mentioned.
Lin Yi walked in and noticed that the inn’s decor was luxurious. Some of the servers were wearing uniforms, giving the place the air of a high-end, classy hotel.
Inside the hotel, a group of youths was gathered around a table, drinking.
“Uncle Wang, you invited us brothers out for a meal and even gave us gifts. We’re extremely grateful. Today, you must drink with us. No going back until you’re drunk!”
“Haha, of course. Today, we won’t return until we’re drunk!”
President Wang laughed heartily, lifted his cup, and shouted, “Come on, let’s drink!”
“Drink!”
The youths raised their cups and downed their drinks in one go.
Lin Yi found a corner, ordered two bowls of rice, and began to eat.
“Eh? Lin Yi, what are you doing here?” At that moment, a familiar voice rang out.
Lin Yi turned his head and saw Li Mengting’s beautiful and delightful face.
“Lin Yi, I heard that you’ve returned, so I came to see you,” Li Mengting said with a smile, her beautiful eyes filled with curiosity as she looked at Lin Yi, “How come you’re at Qingyang Academy, and even became a teacher to the students?”
“Let’s talk about those matters later. Right now, I need to finish my meal quickly and then go find President Wang,” Lin Yi waved off her question and continued to eat.
“Hmm?” Li Mengting was taken aback momentarily.
Lin Yi looked up and said, “What? Don’t believe me? Then come with me for a meal, and you can ask President Wang yourself.”
Li Mengting hesitated for a moment, then said, “Alright, but you have to be quick. President Wang is already waiting for me.”
Lin Yi nodded and continued to focus on his meal.
The two made their way to Qingyang Street and saw Zhao Wenxiong, Zhao Wenhao’s father, who was also dining there.
Upon seeing his father, Zhao Wenhao quickly stood up and said, “Dad, you’re here too?”
“Mm,” Zhao Wenxiong nodded, “Wenhao, have you offended someone? You mustn’t bully others just because you have power. You are the eldest young master of our Zhao Family, and you absolutely must not let others look down upon us.”
Zhao Wenhao snorted coldly and said, “Dad, rest assured, I will definitely find the culprit!”
“Wenhao, let’s not worry about this matter anymore, let Dad handle it!”
Zhao Wenhao snorted coldly again and said, “Hmph, fine, I’ll wait and see!”
Lin Yi glanced at both of them but couldn’t be bothered to interject, walking straight up to General Manager Wang.
“General Manager Wang, I have long admired your reputation and am truly fortunate to meet you today,” Lin Yi said with a beaming smile.
General Manager Wang was slightly taken aback and looked at Lin Yi with puzzlement.
He didn’t remember ever meeting Lin Yi before. What was going on?
“Lin Yi, you are…”
Lin Yi smiled and said, “Hello, I am Lin Yi, a teacher at Qingyang Academy, currently serving as a teacher for the students!”
Upon hearing this, General Manager Wang suddenly understood and exclaimed, “Ah, Teacher Lin, it’s a pleasure to meet you, I have heard much about you!”
“I’ve come to seek your help in using your authority to investigate who dared to harm my student. I want to know, who dared to hurt my student!”
Upon hearing this, General Manager Wang’s eyes widened slightly, “What? Someone dared to hurt your student? Who is this person?”
Lin Yi said indifferently, “I don’t know him. It was his companion who injured my student, and he has already left Qingyang Academy. I’m still unaware of his identity, but since he has left Qingyang Academy, I believe you, General Manager Wang, can certainly find out.”
General Manager Wang nodded and said, “Mm, no problem at all, I will definitely get to the bottom of this. Don’t worry!”
“Good, then we shall take our leave,” Lin Yi said.
Lin Yi bowed slightly and turned to leave.
General Manager Wang suddenly stood up and asked Lin Yi, “Teacher Lin, do you happen to know Zhao Wenhao?”
Lin Yi paused and turned back to look at General Manager Wang, “I don’t know Zhao Wenhao. I’m just here at Qingyang Academy on business and haven’t had any dealings with him.”
“Well, that’s good then!” General Manager Wang sighed in relief. He didn’t want to get entangled in some groundless accusations that might hinder his career.
“All the better then,” Lin Yi nodded, “I’ll be on my way, and we can talk another day.”
After finishing his words, Lin Yi turned and left.
Watching Lin Yi’s retreating figure, Zhao Wenhao’s eyes flashed with malice, and he sneered, “Hmph, Lin Yi, you like to put on an act, don’t you? Go ahead then, I want to see how long you can keep it up!”
“Wenhao, you mustn’t act rashly,” Zhao Wenxiong furrowed his brows, warning Zhao Wenhao. “This is not child’s play; you must be very careful!”
“Dad, rest assured, I know what I’m doing. Just be at ease!” Zhao Wenhao said with a sneer.
“I hope so,” Zhao Wenxiong sighed, his eyes filled with helplessness.
The Zhao Family was an Immortal Cultivation Clan with a profound legacy, but that was all, limited to being just an Immortal Cultivation Clan. Compared to the other major Cultivating Immortal Families, they still fell short by a large margin.

chapters.title: Chapter 590: Mediocre for a Lifetime
chapters.content:
Chapter 590: Chapter 590: Mediocre for a Lifetime
The Zhao Family, living a life of mediocrity, ultimately became the weakest lineage within the Immortal Cultivation Clan, even the bottommost rung.
“Let’s go and find my Uncle Wang!”
“Right!”
Lin Yi and Li Mengting arrived at a room.
Upon seeing Li Mengting, Uncle Wang’s face lit up with an enthusiastic smile.
“Well, if it isn’t the Li Family’s beloved daughter, Li Mengting! What brings Miss Li to my humble abode?”
...
“Uncle Wang, you’re too kind. I’ve come today mainly to ask for your help in investigating a boy named Lin Yi, to see who he really is,” said Li Mengting straightforwardly.
“Oh? You want Uncle Wang to investigate that lad?” Uncle Wang frowned slightly, but then his smile returned, “That’s an easy task; Uncle Wang guarantees it’ll be taken care of effectively.”
“Great! Then I’ll have to trouble Uncle Wang with this!”
“Oh my, think nothing of it, just a simple effort. Miss Li, is this your fiancé? He looks quite handsome and dashing indeed, a perfect match of hero and beauty, truly made for each other!”
Li Mengting laughed, “Uncle Wang is joking. He’s just a friend of mine.”
“Oh? A friend?” Uncle Wang questioned, “How come I have never seen Miss Li’s friend before?”
Source: , updated on Ɲ0νǤօ.ᴄο
“Uncle Wang, he’s a senior of mine. He doesn’t come out very often, so you definitely wouldn’t recognize him,” explained Li Mengting with a smile.
“I see, no wonder. But Miss Li, don’t let this young man deceive you; he’s no good!”
At hearing this, Lin Yi’s mouth twitched slightly—it was indeed the first time he’d been publicly called a bad egg.
Lin Yi hadn’t expected his reputation to have sunk so low, but he couldn’t be bothered to care too much about it now; he was here to handle matters. As for Zhao Wenhao, they’d settle accounts slowly in time.
“Hehe, Uncle Wang, rest assured, I’m aware of that,” Li Mengting chuckled.
Seeing this, Uncle Wang didn’t say much more. He just ordered a waiter to bring a piece of paper and a pen, wrote down his contact information, and then let Lin Yi and Li Mengting leave.
After Li Mengting’s departure, Lin Yi asked, “Mengting, shall we go find that Zhao Wenhao now?”
“Yes,” Li Mengting nodded.
The two made their way to the courtyard where Zhao Wenhao resided.
Upon reaching Zhao Wenhao’s door, Lin Yi raised his hand and knocked, “Boom boom boom.”
The sound of knocking reached Zhao Wenhao’s ears, irritating him a bit.
He looked out the window and saw a white-robed youth standing before him. Though the face seemed unfamiliar, he felt a strange sense of recognition, as if he’d seen him somewhere before.
But Zhao Wenhao couldn’t recall at the moment; after all, they had met only a few times, and besides, Lin Yi had his hat pulled down low.
“Who is it?”
asked Zhao Wenhao.
“It’s me!”
“Oh? Lin Yi?” Hearing Lin Yi’s voice, Zhao Wenhao suddenly remembered, “Oh, it’s you! What are you doing here?”
“Zhao Wenhao, I have come today with orders to take your life, so it’s best you surrender willingly, otherwise, you should know the consequences,” Lin Yi said with a cold laugh.
Zhao Wenhao burst into hearty laughter, “Hahaha, Lin Yi, haven’t you forgotten? You’re still no match for me, Zhao Wenhao!”
Lin Yi shook his head, “No, no, Zhao Wenhao, I haven’t forgotten you, but that Lin Yi isn’t me. Lin Yi is another one of my identities, he’s just a regular high school student, and yes, an alchemist.”
Surprise flashed in Zhao Wenhao’s eyes, “What? You’re an alchemist?”
“That’s right, you guessed it, I am an Alchemist,” Lin Yi responded indifferently, “So, Zhao Wenhao, you’d better surrender now. Otherwise, wait for my retribution!”
“Retribution?” Zhao Wenhao snorted coldly, “With just a newly-entered Martial Artist like you? I don’t even take you seriously!”
“Then try me!”
As he spoke, Lin Yi swung his right hand, unleashing a ferocious power that slammed into the table in front of Zhao Wenhao, instantly shattering it into pieces!
“What? What Martial Arts is this?” Zhao Wenhao’s pupils shrank suddenly, a trace of horror rising in his heart.
Zhao Wenhao was a Six-Star Alchemist, and his strength was the same as Lin Yi’s Cultivation, so he wasn’t afraid of Lin Yi at all. However, he hadn’t expected Lin Yi to use such a domineering move against him; he couldn’t believe his eyes!
“How is this possible? How can a mere Alchemist have such a terrifying maneuver? Could it be that Lin Yi is a Martial Ancestor?”
The more Zhao Wenhao thought about it, the more uneasy he felt. He quickly retreated from the room and shouted to a guard, “Men, capture this person immediately and torture him for information!”
“Yes!”
The guard, taking the order, moved with frightening speed.
Zhao Wenhao, on the other hand, clenched his fists, his heart filled with rage.
He was a distinguished Seven-Star Alchemist in the whole of Tiandu City, yet had been threatened by an ordinary person!
How exalted was his status? And now, he had been humiliated by a young brat, which filled Zhao Wenhao with indignation.
“Lin Yi!”
Zhao Wenhao roared in anger, his figure flickering as he charged straight toward Lin Yi.
Lin Yi, seeing Zhao Wenhao suddenly burst out, was momentarily stunned before quickly responding, dodging to the side to avoid Zhao Wenhao’s attack.
“Hmph, Lin Yi, I admit you’re quite formidable, but don’t you think that you can win against me! Today I will make you understand that offending our Zhao Family will get you nowhere,” Zhao Wenhao sneered.
Lin Yi showed disdain, “The Zhao Family, who do you think you are? Even with the Zhao Family behind you, so what? If you dare to kill me, be prepared to bear the brunt of my wrath!”
“Seeking death!”
Upon hearing this, Zhao Wenhao was furious, cursing aloud as he stomped on the ground. His body shot out like a cannonball towards Lin Yi, swinging his fist that carried a whistling wind!
“Hmph, you think you can compete with me with your subpar skills?”
As Lin Yi saw it, he scoffed, unfazed.
Lin Yi’s palm struck out, condensing a mass of black mist in the center of his palm and slapping it onto Zhao Wenhao’s fist, sending him flying backward.
“Bang!”
Zhao Wenhao crashed to the ground heavily, his Qi-Blood churning in his chest, a sweet taste in his throat as he spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, his face filled with disbelief.
Lin Yi’s Cultivation was terrifying!
His cultivation had reached the Peak of the Martial Artist Realm, yet he couldn’t withstand even a single palm from Lin Yi!
“Lin Yi!”
Zhao Wenhao struggled to his feet, glaring at Lin Yi, grinding his teeth.
“You want to kill me, but you don’t have the ability,” Lin Yi said dismissively.
Hearing this, Zhao Wenhao’s anger flared even more. He leapt up, ready to attack Lin Yi again, but unexpectedly, Lin Yi’s figure suddenly appeared behind him, and with a slap, Lin Yi sent Zhao Wenhao flying once again.
“Pff!”

chapters.title: Chapter 591: Irreconcilable!
chapters.content:
Chapter 591: Chapter 591: Irreconcilable!
Zhao Wenhao spat out another mouthful of blood, his body slamming against the wall beside him.
“Lin Yi, I will never coexist with you!” Zhao Wenhao gritted his teeth before turning to leave, unwilling to entangle further with Lin Yi.
Zhao Wenhao moved with extreme speed, and in just a moment, he vanished without a trace.
“Hmph, to think of killing me, you should first check if you’re even qualified!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, then sat down on a chair and took a few sips of tea.
“Phew, that was close!” Lin Yi let out a relieved breath, “Luckily, I discovered his identity in time. Otherwise, I would have been in danger. It’s good that I was prepared, or it really would have been troublesome.”
...
“Hmph, since you are so arrogant, I’ll make sure you pay the price.”
Lin Yi muttered to himself, and then he picked up the phone from the table and dialed a number.
“Hello, who is this? What do you want?”
An aged and deep voice came through the receiver, the very phone Lin Yi had bought at the auction house.
Lin Yi said, “I have an urgent matter to discuss with you.”
“An urgent matter?”
Source: , updated on ƝονǤօ.ƈ0
The person said, “I cannot see you right now. If you have something to discuss, tell that Zhao Wenhao to contact me, and he can arrange a meeting with me.”
“That won’t be necessary. I’ll come to see you in person. My name is Lin Yi, do you understand?”
“Lin Yi?”
On the other end of the line, the person went silent for a while before saying, “So you are Lin Yi. No wonder you dare to be so brazen. You are an alchemist; I’ve heard about you. Your talent is remarkable, but you should understand that in Tiandu City, I am the emperor. In this city, I am the ruler. If you anger me, I will make sure you regret it.”
“Are you so fearless because you rely on the might of the Zhao Family?”
“No, I am fearless all on my own!”
“Very well, then let me see for myself what abilities this local emperor has!” Lin Yi said.
“Ha ha, I’m looking forward to seeing your performance,” the man replied.
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi took a deep breath, then stepped out of the inn and made his way toward the Zhao Family estate.
“Who are you?” The guards of the Zhao Family mansion, seeing Lin Yi breaking in, immediately drew their weapons and blocked Lin Yi’s way.
“Hmph, I am Lin Yi, here to see your young master,” he stated.
“You wait here!”
Seeing that the comer’s cultivation was in the Alchemist Realm, the guards did not dare to neglect their duties, and immediately ran into the estate to inform Zhao Wenhao.
Lin Yi did not pay attention to them and walked straight into the hall, where he saw Zhao Wenhao.
On seeing Lin Yi, Zhao Wenhao’s brows furrowed slightly, “How did you find me?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi sneered, “I come to Tiandu City, and you think I wouldn’t know your details? If I couldn’t even find out about you, what would I be doing here?”
“Oh? How did you learn about me?”
“The Zhao Family’s Zhao Wenhao, it was you who sent people to assassinate me, right?” Lin Yi asked.
“Hmph, since you’ve figured it out, I might as well admit it. Yes, I was the one ordered to kill you! But I didn’t handle this matter personally, it was my father who sent me!” Zhao Wenhao stated.
“Since it was your father who sent you, that makes it even less likely that I’ll let you live!” Lin Yi’s gaze turned icy as he stared at Zhao Wenhao.
“Want to kill me?”
A mocking smile appeared on Zhao Wenhao’s face, “With just an alchemist like you? I advise you not to overestimate yourself. It would be wiser to surrender willingly!”
Lin Yi laughed coldly and without responding, he took a step forward, appearing right in front of Zhao Wenhao.
He extended his right hand, suddenly thrusting it out, transforming it into an eagle’s claw, and in an instant, it gripped Zhao Wenhao’s throat.
“Crack!”
With a twist of his wrist, Lin Yi snapped Zhao Wenhao’s neck!
“Boom!”
Zhao Wenhao’s body fell to the ground, severed in two.
“To die so quickly, such a useless fellow.”
Lin Yi shook his head and then rummaged through Zhao Wenhao’s body, retrieving a token.
The token contained information about Zhao Wenhao. After glancing at it, Lin Yi tossed it aside.
“Zhao family, I will make sure you wish you were dead, sooner or later!”
A cold, murderous intent flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes as he spoke, then he strode away quickly.
…
“Lin Yi, are you alright?”
As soon as Lin Yi had left the hotel’s main entrance, a group of people stopped him.
Lin Yi took a closer look and realized it was the Zhao Family’s guards who had stopped him!
Each of these men was mighty in strength; the least of them were in the Alchemist Realm, and their cultivations were formidable, all at the fifth level of physical refinement!
“Young man, be smart and hand over Young Master Zhao! Otherwise, do not blame us of the Zhao family for our ruthless methods!”
The Guard Captain, who was at the sixth level of physical refinement, stared coldly at Lin Yi, threatening him.
“Heh, just you people?”
Lin Yi snorted, not taking them seriously, and coldly said, “I’m in a good mood today, so I won’t bother with you. Now get lost!”
“Hmph, young man, don’t be insolent!” the sixth-level Guard Captain retorted coldly, “If you don’t hand over Young Master Zhao today, I will ensure you cannot return!”
“Well, I’m looking forward to it,” Lin Yi responded indifferently.
“Very well, your arrogance will be your downfall. Today, I must teach you a lesson!”
The Guard Captain coldly snorted, immediately attacked, and sent a palm strike towards Lin Yi.
Seeing this, Lin Yi remained calm and returned a palm strike of his own.
“Rumble!”
The two forces collided, causing a thunderous blast to erupt.
The Guard Captain at the sixth level of physical refinement was knocked back three to four steps by Lin Yi’s move, blood trickling from the corner of his mouth.
The Guard Captain looked at Lin Yi with eyes wide and disbelief, “You… how can you possess such formidable strength?”
Lin Yi smiled faintly, “Why wonder at my strength being so great?”
“How is this possible? You’re simply an Alchemist, how can you have such tremendous strength? How did you achieve this?”
“That’s simple. Because I’ve cultivated the ‘Soul Refinement Technique'”, Lin Yi said with a faint smile, slowly speaking.
“Soul Refinement Technique?”
“That’s right. It’s a terrifying cultivation technique. Although I haven’t yet mastered it, I’ve grasped some of its basics, which are quite powerful,” Lin Yi said calmly.
“Grasped the basics?” Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, the Guard Captain was utterly astounded, “How can that be? That’s absolutely impossible!”
“Nothing is impossible!”
Lin Yi gave the Guard Captain a cold glance, then turned and walked away, no longer paying attention to the sixth-level Guard Captain as he moved forward.
After being stunned for a moment, the Guard Captain suddenly came to his senses and hurriedly followed.
“Young man, stop right there! Don’t think that having some strength gives you the right to run wild in Tiandu City; you’re not worthy!” the Guard Captain said coldly.
“If you dare stop me again, I will kill you first, and then I will kill Zhao Wenhao!”
Lin Yi paused, turned his head, and his gaze swept icily over the Guard Captain as he threatened coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 592: 592: Unappreciative
chapters.content:
Chapter 592: Chapter 592: Unappreciative
The Guard Captain’s face changed, then he gritted his teeth and said, “Alright, kid, you’re quite arrogant, but let’s see what skill you have to kill young master Zhao!”
“Attack, all of you together, take him down!” the Guard Captain roared.
“Yes, Guard Captain!”
Hundreds of Martial Artists at the sixfold level of physical refinement echoed in unison and then charged towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi sneered, “Since you don’t know how to appreciate kindness, I’ll just have to send you off to the afterlife myself.”
As soon as Lin Yi finished speaking, he lashed out with a palm strike, sending two of the sixfold physical refinement guards flying. Then, with another palm strike, he blasted another two away.
...
“You’re not my match!” Lin Yi said indifferently, sweeping his gaze over the crowd before his form surged, and he threw a punch at the twenty-odd sixfold physical refinement guards rushing towards him, knocking each one of them to the ground with a single punch!
The remaining guards at the sevenfold, eightfold, and ninefold levels of refinement all looked at Lin Yi in shock and horror.
“This is bad!”
“Run!”
“Hurry and run, he’s too strong!”
The remaining sevenfold, eightfold, and ninefold guards turned and fled, no longer daring to face Lin Yi head-on.
“Trying to leave? Too late!”
Lin Yi’s form flickered, and he appeared in front of them. With a palm strike, he crushed the head of a sixfold guard.
“Ah!”
“Spare me!”
Seeing this, the sevenfold Guard Captain was terrified and quickly knelt down and begged for mercy.
Lin Yi looked on disdainfully, “Your master Zhao Wenhao didn’t beg for mercy, so who do you think you are? Today, I’m only killing those who deserve to die!”
“Our Zhao Family is the Zhao Family, you are you, Zhao Wenhao is Zhao Wenhao, I am I, we should not be mentioned in the same breath.”
As the Guard Captain spoke, he suddenly bellowed, “Kill! Kill him for me!”
“Kill!”
The remaining sixfold guards drew their swords and charged toward Lin Yi with a resolve to accept death.
Lin Yi sneered, “You’re truly courting death!”
“Kill!”
The guards lunged at Lin Yi with their swords.
Upon seeing this, Lin Yi scoffed, “Overestimating your own abilities, since you’re so eager to die, I’ll grant your wish.”
Before the words fell, Lin Yi swung his fists at the guards.
Bang bang bang!
Lin Yi’s fists, filled with terrifying True Yuan power, caused the guards to be continuously pushed back, utterly unable to resist; they were directly sent flying, with their blood spilling all over the ground.
These guards were very weak and couldn’t withstand Lin Yi’s onslaught, continually vomiting blood and groaning on the ground.
“You… you’re just a minor Alchemist, aren’t you? Who exactly are you? How could you possibly have such formidable strength?”
Seeing how easily Lin Yi dispatched the guards sent by Zhao Wenhao, the Guard Captain’s face darkened, fear flickering in his eyes as he trembled and asked.
Lin Yi shook his head slightly and said, “I don’t know! But what’s certain is that you are all going to die today!”
“Impossible! How could you possibly be a sevenfold powerhouse!”
The Guard Captain of the Sixfold Body Cultivation shouted loudly, appearing very astonished.
Lin Yi sneered, “You guess!”
“You… you are really at the Sevenfold Body Cultivation?”
The Guard Captain of the Sixfold Body Cultivation’s face changed, and a strong unease arose in his heart.
Lin Yi’s strength was too formidable, far beyond his expectations. Such a person, even in the Tiandu Academy, would belong to the top echelon, definitely not someone he could afford to provoke!
And this guy, he actually concealed his strength. Who in the world is he?
The Guard Captain pondered and suddenly remembered something, his face dramatically shifting as he exclaimed, “You… you are not Lin Yi?”
Lin Yi was slightly startled, then laughed heartily, “So you do recognize me!”
The face of the Guard Captain went through a series of changes between pale and flushed, his eyes filled with horror and dread.
“Lin Yi, you actually are Lin Yi!”
This Guard Captain finally realized why Lin Yi had become a master of the Fivefold Body Cultivation at such a young age. It was because Lin Yi was a prodigy, ranked second among the monstrous talents of the young generation in East State, with an extremely terrifying talent.
The Tiandu Academy once started an assessment, and many large families in East State recommended their children or geniuses. Even the weakest from their families could enter the Tiandu Academy, and a peerless monster like Lin Yi was naturally able to join.
“You… what exactly do you want to do?”
The Guard Captain looked at Lin Yi and couldn’t help swallowing.
“What do you think?” Lin Yi’s mouth curled into a strange arc.
The body of the Guard Captain stiffened, and a chill rose in his heart as he trembled, “You, you wouldn’t be thinking of seizing the Town Government Jade Token of Tiandu City?”
“What’s your guess?” Lin Yi narrowed his eyes slightly, staring at the Guard Captain, “Now, I’ll give you another chance. Submit to me, become my slave, and I assure you a way out. Otherwise, don’t blame me for not being polite.”
The Guard Captain’s face fluctuated upon hearing this. He hadn’t expected Lin Yi to actually plan to snatch the Town Government Jade Pendant, an extremely important treasure.
If the word got out, it would probably cause a huge commotion. At that time, the high ranks of the entire Tiandu Academy would send people to hunt him down and tear him to pieces. How could he wish for that?
“No! No! I don’t want to be a slave! I want to be under your command, please take me in. I will repay your kindness.”
The Guard Captain pleaded urgently, his eyes showing a trace of desire.
“Oh, is that so?”
Lin Yi was taken aback upon hearing this, then showed an expression as if he half understood, “Then be my subordinate, be my dog. What do you say to that?”
“Of course, yes!”
The Guard Captain nodded repeatedly, heaving a sigh of relief inwardly. As long as Lin Yi was willing to spare him, he didn’t mind being Lin Yi’s dog.
“Then I’ll reluctantly take you in.”
Lin Yi smiled faintly and commanded, “Starting today, I order you to tell me everything you know about Tiandu City! If you dare to lie to me, you should be aware of what I’m capable of.”
The Guard Captain felt a sudden tightness in his chest upon hearing Lin Yi’s words and hastily responded, “I wouldn’t dare to lie. I’ll tell you everything. Please just spare me.”
“Very well!”
Lin Yi smiled lightly and said, “Then speak.”
“I, my name is Wang Haoyu. I am an Inner Sect Disciple of Tiandu Academy. Today I led the guard team here to capture Lin Yi and was preparing to take him back to Tiandu City. Our mission is to apprehend Lin Yi and confiscate his possessions.”
Wang Haoyu spoke, glancing at the stunningly beautiful maid beside Lin Yi, a gleam of greed flickering in his eyes.
This maid was a Martial Artist at the peak of the third rank of the Heavenly Spirit Realm, and she also possessed a powerful set of Combat Techniques, with Combat Power comparable to a fourth-level Cultivator of the Heavenly Spirit Realm. The sight of her stirred Wang Haoyu’s ambitions, as he yearned to try his luck.
Wang Haoyu finished speaking, his gaze fixed intently on Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 593: 593: Keeping a Low Profile Before!
chapters.content:
Chapter 593: Chapter 593: Keeping a Low Profile Before!
Lin Yi looked at Wang Haoyu with a slight lift of his eyebrows and a cold laugh in his heart, “This guy, turns out to be an Inner Sect Disciple of Tiandu Academy, no wonder he’s so arrogant! Hmph! Looks like I’ve been too low-profile before!”
“Big Brother Lin Yi, he, he wants to take advantage of you, do you want to kill him?”
The little fox suddenly spoke.
Lin Yi furrowed his brow, a hint of suspicion rising in his heart, “How do you know?”
“Have you forgotten? I am a genius girl; I can see through all the auras around you.”
“So that’s how it is.”
...
Lin Yi suddenly understood, then sneered, “A mere Inner Sect Disciple of Tiandu Academy dares to covet my wealth, he’s really seeking death! Rest assured, I won’t kill you, but I will leave you a big gift.”
As soon as Lin Yi’s voice fell, a black mist condensed a sharp blade in the palm of his hand, slashing towards Wang Haoyu.
This strike was extremely powerful, enough to split mountains and shatter rocks. Wang Haoyu, sensing the terrifying power of this strike, showed a look of fear on his face.
Although Lin Yi’s strike was merely a probing attack, it contained an unfathomable meaning. Wang Haoyu couldn’t resist at all and watched helplessly as the blade struck his body. His eyes filled with fear and unwillingness, he screamed in his heart, “No, no, spare me, please spare me! I am willing to be your ox and horse, just please don’t kill me, don’t kill me, I beg you!”
However, it was all too late.
Lin Yi’s strike fiercely landed on Wang Haoyu’s neck, blood spurting out wildly. Wang Haoyu’s eyes bulged, dying with his eyes open, and he fell to the ground.
Lin Yi glanced at Wang Haoyu and sneered coldly, “Such trash, daring to touch my property, is utterly overestimating himself!”
The little fox saw this, pursed her lips, and said, “Master, you’re really mean.”
Lin Yi rolled his eyes upon hearing this and said unhappily, “What did you say? Who told him to have designs on my treasure? Wouldn’t it be a loss not to teach him a lesson!”
“Hehe!”
The little fox chuckled and said no more.
Lin Yi walked over to Wang Haoyu, kicked him a couple of times, and said, “Hey, wake up, wake up!”
Seeing that it was futile, Lin Yi kicked him a few more times, but Wang Haoyu still showed no signs of waking up.
“It seems, he’s dead as can be!”
Seeing this, Lin Yi shook his head and then turned to leave.
“Big Brother Lin Yi, wait for me!”
Just as Lin Yi was about to step away, a delicate girl’s voice came from behind him.
Turning his head, Lin Yi saw Wang Qian’er, the girl called Wang Qian’er, running over and clutching his sleeve, looking at him with a mischievous smile, “Big Brother Lin Yi, do you not want me anymore, do you not like me anymore?”
Seeing Wang Qian’er, Lin Yi was startled, thinking to himself, “This Wang Qian’er couldn’t possibly be thinking of acknowledging me as her big brother, could she? If that’s the case, it would be troublesome; this girl is just too willful, she’ll definitely not be easy to deal with in the future!”
Although Lin Yi thought this way, his face still wore a smile as he patted Wang Qian’er on the shoulder, “Qian’er, stop it, hurry back so your parents won’t worry about you.”
“No, no, I want to be with Big Brother Lin Yi.”
Wang Qian’er pouted, her expression pitiful, looking very endearing.
“Big Brother Lin Yi…Big Brother Lin Yi…would it be okay if I called you brother-in-law?”
Lin Yi was speechless, cursing in his heart, “This girl really is a strange creature, calling me brother-in-law, is she playing with me? But I must say, the title does sound quite pleasant.”
“Alright, sister Qian’er, since you’ve called me that, I’ll acknowledge you as my sister.”
Lin Yi said cheerfully.
Hearing this, Wang Qian’er immediately clapped her hands happily, “That’s great, Brother-in-law Lin Yi, then I won’t stand on ceremony anymore.”
“Hehe!”
Lin Yi smiled and shook his head.
“Lin Yi, big brother, I’ll head back first, so I won’t disturb you and Sister Lin Yi’s intimate time,”
Wang Qian’er winked teasingly and then hopped into the house, closing the bedroom door behind her.
Seeing Wang Qian’er’s behavior, Lin Yi sighed helplessly.
Wang Qian’er was indeed a mischievous girl, but after all, she’s just a fox spirit, and her parents were just ordinary humans.
Although Wang Qian’er looked just like a human, her identity as a member of the Demon Race was set in stone.
“Alas!”
Lin Yi shook his head, thinking to himself, “I hope this little girl can change her naughty nature.”
Lin Yi looked around and realized that, apart from him and the little fox, there were no other people left in the entire town.
“Little fox, it’s just us left in this town. Our haul this time is quite substantial, enough to buy some things. I wonder if we can exchange it for some money!”
Lin Yi rubbed his hands together and chuckled.
“Sister Lin Yi, whatever money you want, just take it. Qian’er guarantees I won’t stop you,”
the little fox said with a laugh, looking quite like a big spender.
“Ha ha! Then I won’t be polite,”
Lin Yi said delightedly, immediately taking out two shiny silver coins and tossing them onto the table.
The two gold coins emitted a dazzling light, causing Lin Yi’s eyes to dazzle and his head to spin, but he didn’t mind at all as he grabbed the two silver coins from the table and said, “Hmm, not bad, they’re worth two hundred silver coins in total, perfect for buying some things!”
Lin Yi grabbed the two gold coins and was about to head outside when suddenly, a figure blocked his path.
Lin Yi’s brow furrowed at this, and he shouted angrily, “Who is this bratty girl blocking the way? Get lost at once, or don’t blame me for being rude!”
“You, you…”
After hearing Lin Yi’s words, the little fox was at a loss for words, glaring at Lin Yi, puffing with anger, not knowing what to say, but still stubbornly standing her ground without any intention of moving aside.
“Little girl, I’m asking you one last time. Are you still going to go against me? Are you not afraid that I’ll kill you?”
Lin Yi looked at the little fox and sneered, threatening her.
“I… I’m not afraid. I’ll stop you, and I want to go shopping with you, to buy clothes, to buy food!”
The little fox said stubbornly, a determined light flashing in her eyes, which shook Lin Yi and secretly impressed him with how stubborn the little girl was.
“If you don’t get out of the way, then don’t blame me for not being polite!”
Lin Yi said gravely.
“Humph, I won’t leave. You want to kill me? Go ahead and try!”
The little fox retorted, staring defiantly at Lin Yi, with a look that said she was not budging.
“Lin Yi, brother, this little fox is so cute. Just take her with you,”
At that moment, Wang Haoyu came out of the house, stood beside Lin Yi, clung to his arm, and smilingly looked at the little fox.
“This… this… What’s going on here?”
Lin Yi was taken aback.
“Hehe, brother-in-law, isn’t the little fox cute? With her, you won’t be lonely anymore!”
Wang Qian’er looked at Lin Yi with a sly expression, her eyes full of anticipation.
“Cough cough, well, Sister Qian’er, you see, we two guys, we’ve only known each other for a day, and it’s not like what you’re imagining, so I think you’ve misunderstood,”
Lin Yi quickly waved his hand and said with a wry smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 594: 594: Stubborn Look
chapters.content:
Chapter 594: Chapter 594: Stubborn Look
“No, no, it’s not like that, brother-in-law, you should take me with you, Qian’er won’t mind.”
The little fox saw this, hurriedly shook her head, and promptly spoke up.
Seeing the little fox being so stubborn, Lin Yi couldn’t help but smile wryly, but found it hard to just leave her behind, so he said, “Alright then, since Qian’er sister wants to follow me, I’ll just have to make an effort and take you with me.”
Lin Yi thought to himself that as long as he was careful not to get entangled by Wang Qian’er, he probably wouldn’t encounter any danger.
“Yay, Lin Yi brother is the best.”
Upon hearing his words, Wang Qian’er cheered, hugged Lin Yi tightly, and planted a big kiss on his cheek, saying, “Lin Yi brother, you’re so nice, I really like you.”
...
“Uh…”
Lin Yi was immediately stunned, touched the cheek that Wang Qian’er had kissed, and looked dumbfounded.
“Lin Yi brother, you’re blushing!”
Wang Qian’er noticed the faint blush on Lin Yi’s cheeks, felt a surge of joy, and chuckled softly.
“I’m… I’m not.”
Lin Yi quickly wiped his cheek, trying to appear calm, but inside he was thinking, “My first kiss was supposed to be saved for marriage, how could I just let someone take it like that, no, I must retaliate, I have to settle the score with her.”
“Qian’er sister, we’ve had a good haul this time, let’s get out of here and find a safe place to celebrate properly.”
Lin Yi said with a smile, pulling the little fox along as he prepared to leave, but Wang Qian’er suddenly stopped in her tracks.
“Huh, Lin Yi brother, where’s your clothes? Why have you changed into a set of black clothes? Are you going to participate in some competition? You seldom wear black, I remember you always liked wearing white, why have you suddenly switched to black?”
“Uh…”
Hearing the little fox’s words, Lin Yi was momentarily stunned.
“Lin Yi brother, tell me quickly, what are you planning to do? Did someone bully you about your clothes?”
Seeing this, Wang Qian’er immediately became anxious.
Lin Yi saw her concern and quickly waved his hand: “No, I just encountered a little thief, that’s all. Qian’er sister, don’t worry about it.”
“Really? Where is that bad guy? Did he do something bad to you? Let me help you teach him a lesson!”
Wang Qian’er said, brimming with righteous indignation.
“Uh… no, really, there’s nothing.”
Lin Yi reassured her, shaking his head repeatedly, while inwardly he complained, “This nosy girl, why is she so meddlesome? She is really like a busybody.”
“Okay then, Qian’er sister, now that you know about these treasures, there’s no need to keep shopping. You should go back to your room and rest.”
Seeing the little fox so determined to follow him, Lin Yi was troubled, so he simply gestured for her to return to her room to rest.
“Fine, Lin Yi brother, I’ll trust you this once, but if you dare to lie to me in the future, I won’t let you off!”
Wang Qian’er pouted, speaking menacingly to Lin Yi, but there was a clearly playful and naïve tone in her voice, which made Lin Yi feel awkward.
“Alright, I promise I will never deceive you!”
Lin Yi hastily pledged, patting his chest.
Upon hearing his promise, Wang Qian’er smiled sweetly and ran off to her room, not forgetting to remind Lin Yi to get some rest and not to overwork himself.
Watching Wang Qian’er’s retreating figure, Lin Yi couldn’t help but smile wryly, muttering to himself, “Ah, Qian’er sister, you must never fall in love with me.”
Afterward, Lin Yi and the little fox returned to their room together, washed up, and lay down on the bed to cultivate.
The next morning.
When Lin Yi opened his eyes, Wang Qian’er was lying on the bed, sleeping sweetly.
“Hoo!”
Lin Yi let out a long breath and sat up in bed, gazing at the sleeping Qian’er with a softness in his heart. He couldn’t help lowering his head and gently pressed a kiss onto her tender, pink lips.
“Hmm?”
Just then, Wang Qian’er suddenly awoke. Discovering Lin Yi’s action, her pretty face blushed slightly as she coyly said, “Brother Lin Yi, why are you doing this? I was still sleeping and you stole a kiss, I could accuse you of harassing a chaste woman.”
“Hehe.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but laugh and said, “Sister Qian’er, I didn’t mean to, I just didn’t want to wake you up, did I?”
“Hmph, no matter what, I won’t forgive you.”
Wang Qian’er huffed, “Not only did you bully me, but you also stole a kiss. You’re really bad, Brother Lin Yi, I won’t talk to you anymore!”
“Uh…”
At these words, Lin Yi suddenly froze, his face showing an innocent expression, and he thought to himself, “Not talk to me, does this girl plan to cling to me for life?”
Lin Yi felt indescribably gloomy and thought, “Could it be that this girl has fallen for me and doesn’t want me to leave, so she plans to pester me forever?”
The more Lin Yi thought about it, the more surprised and afraid he became.
“Brother Lin Yi, what’s wrong? Why do you look so strange—don’t you like me?”
Seeing Lin Yi staring at her with a mix of complex emotions in his eyes, Wang Qian’er couldn’t help but ask in confusion.
“Uh… like, how could I not? Sister Qian’er, you’re so beautiful and have such a wonderful personality, any girl would like you.”
Lin Yi quickly answered.
“Hehe, then why don’t you hurry up and wash so we can get to the important matters of the day!”
Upon hearing his words, Wang Qian’er couldn’t help but speak sweetly.
Lin Yi, upon her words, quickly stood up and headed toward the bathroom, yet the image of the girl from last night flickered in his mind, a trace of puzzlement crossing his face.
“Could this girl be the girlfriend of Brother Lin Yi that Qian’er was talking about? But why would Sister Qian’er call her a ‘little fox’? Could she really be a fox?”
Lin Yi pondered this as he freshened up.
When he had finished washing and dressed in clean, sharp clothes, and emerged from the bathroom, he discovered Wang Qian’er sitting in front of the vanity mirror, flipping through something inside a delicate wooden box.
“Sister Qian’er, what are you doing in front of the mirror so early?”
Lin Yi saw her looking through an old-fashioned sandalwood box and couldn’t help but ask curiously.
“Hehe, Brother Lin Yi, guess what treasure is in this box?”
Wang Qian’er lifted her head and said to Lin Yi with a beaming smile, her face illuminated with the triumphant joy of a cheeky little girl.
“I don’t know, how would I know?”
Lin Yi shook his head in response.
“Hehe, Brother Lin Yi, if you don’t know, that’s just ignorance on your part. This is really a treasure.”
Wang Qian’er said with smug pride.
“Oh? What kind of treasure is it? Don’t keep me in suspense, tell me!”
Lin Yi was incredibly curious. Although he knew Wang Qian’er was very clever, when it came to what exactly was inside the box, he had no idea.
“Hehe, then close your eyes first.”
Seeing his eager look, Wang Qian’er couldn’t help feeling secretly delighted. She playfully winked at him, her face brimming with satisfaction.
“Uh…”

chapters.title: Chapter 595: 595: Even More Curious Now
chapters.content:
Chapter 595: Chapter 595: Even More Curious Now
Seeing this, Lin Yi became even more curious, but he only hesitated for a moment before slowly closing his eyes.
Just as Lin Yi closed his eyes, Wang Qian’er’s gaze suddenly sharpened, and her right hand reached into the wooden box.
Lin Yi saw her sudden move, a serious expression flashed across his face, and he hurriedly opened his eyes.
“Lin Yi, open your eyes and look.”
Wang Qian’er urged, while opening the box.
Upon hearing her, Lin Yi quickly looked inside the box, and his pupils instantly shrunk, his handsome face filled with shock.
...
Inside the box was a necklace, and this necklace was exactly like the one Wang Qian’er was wearing around her neck. The two necklaces joined together, forming a dragon pattern that was lifelike, as if it were actually alive, emitting a golden glow.
However, the necklace Wang Qian’er wore around her neck paled in comparison to this dragon-patterned necklace.
“Qian’er, what exactly is this necklace?”
Lin Yi asked, astonished, filled with confusion.
“Hehe, Lin Yi, why don’t you guess?”
Seeing Lin Yi unable to guess, Wang Qian’er immediately asked with a playful smile on her face.
“I can’t guess, but I bet the one you’re wearing is a fake,” Lin Yi said as he shrugged his shoulders and smiled.
“Lin Yi, how did you know?”
Upon hearing this, Wang Qian’er’s smile froze, and she showed a look of disbelief.
“Because I’ve been looking for a long time, that one on your neck is a fake.”
Lin Yi spoke earnestly, then added, “Right, Qian’er, the one you’re wearing must be from my mother, right?”
“Yes, my mother is a very powerful Artifact Refiner, and she gave me this Magic Artifact as a birthday gift, Lin Yi, you like Artifact Refining, don’t you?”
Wang Qian’er nodded, then took out a beautifully crafted jade box from inside the box and handed it to Lin Yi, saying, “Here, a gift for you.”
“Ah? You’re giving me one too?”
Lin Yi was taken aback when he saw the jade box she handed him.
“What? You don’t like it?”
Seeing Lin Yi’s astonished expression, Wang Qian’er immediately frowned, her tone a bit displeased.
“It’s not that I don’t like it; it’s just too valuable. I’m truly overwhelmed and dare not accept it!”
Lin Yi waved his hand, hastily refusing.
He hadn’t found his parents yet, and if he accepted another gift like that, he feared that it might lead to a conflict with the Lin Family again.
“Hmph, Lin Yi, do you think this gift is too valuable? Actually, I was shocked when my mother gave me this gift, I had no idea it would be such a precious treasure,” Wang Qian’er said with a pout and dissatisfaction.
“No, no, that’s not what I think.”
“Humph!”
Wang Qian’er glared at him and placed the jade box back on the table.
“Alright, since this gift is too valuable, then I also can’t accept it. Qian’er, please take it back.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi bit his lip and pushed the jade box on the table towards Wang Qian’er.
“Hmph! Lin Yi, are you saying you disdain the gift I’m giving you because it’s too cheap? You don’t have to accept it if you don’t want it, I just can’t believe you wouldn’t like it.”
Wang Qian’er saw that Lin Yi was actually pushing her gift back, and immediately pouted, her face brimming with grievances as she spoke.
“No, no, Qian’er please don’t misunderstand, your gift is very precious, I like it very much, I’ve accepted it.”
Lin Yi, seeing her looking so aggrieved, couldn’t bear to see her adorable appearance, hurriedly waved his hand and said.
Seeing that he had accepted her gift, Wang Qian’er’s face finally burst into a happy smile. Then, she took the box, walked over to Lin Yi’s side, took his arm, and said with a laugh, “Brother Lin Yi, since you like it, from now on you have to take good care of me and you’re not allowed to bully me.”
“Ahem…”
Lin Yi, hearing this, almost spat out a mouthful of blood, and then with a whole head of black lines, looked at Wang Qian’er and said, “Qian’er, you really shouldn’t joke about such things. We’re in a sibling-like relationship now; how could I possibly bully you? Don’t worry.”
“Brother Lin Yi, you say we’re like siblings, but how can this be? I don’t care, from now on you must call me sister, remember that.”
Wang Qian’er pursed her lips, saying seriously.
“Uh… What do you mean by that? We’re clearly not biological siblings, and you still want me to call you sister? You’re getting a bit too greedy,” Lin Yi said, feeling a sense of awkwardness when she mentioned “biological siblings” and couldn’t help but shiver, quickly adding.
“Hmph, doesn’t matter, the fact is I’m your sister and that’s indisputable.”
“Fine, if that’s the case, let’s get back to the main point, Qian’er. What kind of treasure is this? Why would you use jade to carve such an exquisite necklace? I’ve never seen anything like it,” Lin Yi shifted the topic, his most pressing desire being to understand the origins of the necklace.
“Brother Lin Yi, I only received it today as well, I’m not trying to hide anything from you. Don’t you like this necklace?” Wang Qian’er pouted, her face full of dissatisfaction.
Seeing this, Lin Yi immediately felt a headache coming on and hurriedly explained, “Of course not, I like it, I really like it!”
He certainly didn’t want his girlfriend to get angry over this, so he quickly tried to please her.
“Hmph, since you like it, then you have to take good care of me from now on, you’re not allowed to bully me, otherwise, I might not give you any gifts in the future!” Wang Qian’er said, looking triumphant as Lin Yi made his promise.
“Okay, okay, I promise you, I will take good care of you from now on, and I won’t bully you!”
Lin Yi nodded eagerly in agreement, then he asked about the origins of the necklace, but Wang Qian’er kept her lips sealed and refused to tell Lin Yi, so he had no choice but to let it go.
“Qian’er, let’s head back to the room now, it’s getting late, and we have class tomorrow. If we’re late, I’m afraid the teacher will criticize me,” Lin Yi changed the subject.
“Oh, then I’ll head back to my room first.”
Wang Qian’er nodded and then left the private room.
After Wang Qian’er left, Lin Yi finally let out a sigh of relief.
“Phew, luckily Qian’er didn’t actually give me the necklace, otherwise I would’ve been so embarrassed.”
Lin Yi patted his chest and muttered to himself.
“Huh? What’s in this jade box?”
Just as Lin Yi breathed a sigh of relief, about to head back to his room, he suddenly discovered that the jade box had vanished!
How could the jade box disappear? Could the necklace just vanish into thin air?
Lin Yi quickly directed his gaze towards the white box on the table and, upon closer inspection, he was shocked to find that the box had disappeared at some point.
“Impossible, impossible, the box was clearly on the table when Qian’er gave me the gift. Why has it suddenly disappeared? Is it an illusion of mine?
Or did Qian’er deliberately leave the box here, waiting for me to come and open it? That doesn’t seem like Qian’er’s style at all.”

chapters.title: Chapter 596: 596: Doubts Suppressed at the Bottom of the Heart
chapters.content:
Chapter 596: Chapter 596: Doubts Suppressed at the Bottom of the Heart
Lin Yi quickly shook his head, suppressing that doubt in his heart.
“Forget it, since it’s not here, I’m going downstairs to look for it, I refuse to believe that every student in our class can afford to buy gifts, leaving just me without one!”
Lin Yi thought for a moment, then took the ornament and left the private room, heading outside.
Just as Lin Yi had stepped out of the private room, a door nearby was also pushed open, and a young man dressed in luxurious clothing, with a well-proportioned figure, emerged.
The young man walked with a light and silent step, as if he weighed nothing at all, as though he were weightless.
Behind him followed two bodyguards, both dressed in black, wielding firearms, looking mighty and extraordinary, yet not affecting the young man’s dashing and elegant demeanor.
...
“Huh? Who is this young man? He has such a strong presence, no wonder he can move around the campus so freely!”
As soon as Lin Yi stepped out, he noticed the young man and felt a bit of a shock.
Although he himself was quite skilled, and there were countless people more formidable than him, he had not realized that, apart from himself, there was such a formidable presence hidden within the academy.
“Lin Yi brother, is that guy the one I often mention to you?”
At that moment, a sweet voice came from the side.
It turned out that the girl was none other than Lin Yi’s deskmate, Wang Qian’er.
“Yes, that’s right, he’s my deskmate, named Ouyang Minghao, one of the campus hunks of our batch.”
“Ouyang Minghao, he’s one of our school’s hunks?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was startled, not expecting Wang Qian’er’s deskmate to be such a big school beauty, no wonder he was surrounded by a group of girls the day he entered the classroom.
“Yes, Sister Qian’er, how do you know him, how did you meet him?”
“Well, it’s not difficult to meet him, you see. It was just a chance encounter, he invited me to a basketball game, then we became friends, and later we even went to the amusement park and spent the whole night there, that’s how I came to know him.”
As Wang Qian’er spoke, her cheeks blushed slightly.
Hearing this, Lin Yi rolled his eyes and cursed inwardly, “Damn, you’ve only just met him, and you already spent the whole night at the amusement park with him? You’re way too bold.”
Although he knew that such things were common, after all, Wang Qian’er was his fiancée, and he was a normal male, naturally he also wanted to go to the amusement park with a beautiful girl.
“Hehe, I’m not bold, it’s just that when he invited me to join, I went. I’m not short of money, and since I don’t need to spend any, why should I refuse?”
As Wang Qian’er spoke, she took Lin Yi’s arm, smiling and asking, “Lin Yi brother, what do you think of my suggestion?”
“Haha, no problem.”
Lin Yi nodded and said, “Then I’ll play along to the end.”
…
The next day, Lin Yi arrived at school early for class, and it wasn’t long before Wang Qian’er entered the classroom as well.
When the two walked into the classroom side by side, they immediately attracted the attention of many.
“Wow, it’s Lin Yi, Lin Yi has come to class too, why is he sitting with Wang Qian’er?”
“Lin Yi, are you hiding some secret from us?”
“Yeah, why did you come to class with Wang Qian’er? Didn’t you two break up?”
…
Suddenly, a bunch of gossip-hungry boys and girls crowded around, bombarding him with questions.
On hearing this, Lin Yi’s brows immediately furrowed. The news of his breakup with Wang Qian’er had already spread throughout the entire Jing City Academy. Now these people were saying they had gotten back together, wasn’t that just blatant lying?
“I broke up with Wang Qian’er, and it had nothing to do with her proposal!”
Lin Yi said coldly.
He certainly wouldn’t foolishly admit he was Wang Qian’er’s boyfriend, as that would get him into trouble.
“Yeah, right, who would believe you? Weren’t you still saying last night that you wanted to pursue me?”
Wang Qian’er pouted and said, “Have you forgotten so soon? I certainly won’t forget. I still want to marry you!”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was taken aback and then gave a bitter smile, “We’ve already broken up, it’s impossible for us to continue seeing each other, there’s no possibility between you and me!”
As he spoke, Lin Yi turned away, unwilling to say another word to Wang Qian’er.
“Hey, hey, hey, Lin Yi, I haven’t agreed to marry you yet, and you’re so eager to break up with me, you really are a jerk!”
Seeing Lin Yi act this way, Wang Qian’er couldn’t help but stamp her foot in anger.
At her words, Lin Yi’s body shuddered slightly, his face showing a trace of pain.
“What’s wrong with you, did I say something incorrect?”
Seeing Lin Yi remain silent, Wang Qian’er asked worriedly.
“No, you’re right, it’s my fault, I’ve let you down. I’m a jerk, I’m scum!”
Lin Yi roared lowly, turned his back, and no longer paid attention to Wang Qian’er.
Watching Lin Yi in such sorrow, Wang Qian’er was startled. It was the first time she had seen Lin Yi so heartbroken, and she was somewhat confused.
Was this still the charming and unrestrained Lin Yi?
Was this still the Lin Yi who dared to argue with the principal?
Was this still the Lin Yi who could make the Fist Path club members fear him?
Wang Qian’er was somewhat disbelieving of her own eyes. She kept rubbing them, hoping to be sure that what she was seeing was not an illusion.
“Alright, stop rubbing, I’m for real!”
Seeing Wang Qian’er acting like that, Lin Yi couldn’t help but give a bitter smile.
Indeed, he had changed a lot, no longer as confident as before, nor as arrogant and domineering as before.
But in his heart, he still harbored admiration and affection for Wang Qian’er, so he was still unwilling to give up, still thinking of taking Wang Qian’er back.
“Oh, Lin Yi, sorry, I didn’t know you…”
“Qian’er, actually, my breakup with Wang Qian’er has nothing directly to do with her. It’s all my own fault.”
Lin Yi said with a bitter smile, explaining, “If I had realized my feelings earlier, if I hadn’t meddled with Chen Yuxin, maybe I would have already become Wang Qian’er’s boyfriend by now.”
“What? You broke up with Wang Qian’er because of Chen Yuxin? Lin Yi, have you gone mad? Are you looking for death? Wang Qian’er’s father is the chairman of Chen Group; by doing this, aren’t you afraid of Uncle Chen coming after you?”
“Hmph, as if Wang Qian’er’s father could fight me?”
Lin Yi scoffed, saying, “I’m not afraid of Uncle Chen, I’m not afraid of the Wang Family either. I’m just not willing to give in. I like Chen Yuxin, I want to pursue her, but she’s with another man, and he’s Wang Qian’er’s boyfriend. I really want to kill him.”
“You’re really too impulsive.”
Wang Qian’er sighed and advised, “Lin Yi, I know you like Chen Yuxin, but Chen Yuxin doesn’t like you. She’s with you only because of her family’s interests.”
Wang Qian’er said, her tone carrying a hint of disdain.
“I know, and it’s very clear to me. I also know that I don’t deserve her, but I don’t want to give up like this. I really love her!”

chapters.title: Chapter 597: 597: Really Want to Pursue Her
chapters.content:
Chapter 597: Chapter 597: Really Want to Pursue Her
Lin Yi shook his head and sighed, saying, “Wang Qian’er, you know, we both used to like Chen Yuxin. We both liked her. So, I really want to pursue her, to let her know my heart.”
“Alas, it’s a pity, a real pity, Wang Qian’er once liked Chen Yuxin, too. But since Chen Yuxin liked Li Yunfei, Wang Qian’er could only give up.”
As Wang Qian’er spoke, she sighed, and a few tears slid from the corner of her eyes. At that moment, her heart was indeed filled with sadness; after all, the person she had once liked, liked someone else, which was sad for anyone.
Wang Qian’er’s words immediately triggered memories for Lin Yi.
All three of them had once liked Chen Yuxin, but it was Wang Qian’er who first liked Li Yunfei, while he liked Wang Qian’er.
He had never expected that Wang Qian’er would actually like Chen Yuxin, and in the end, the two of them broke up.
...
“Qian’er, you say Chen Yuxin doesn’t like me, why would she like Li Yunfei? They’re not even alike!”
“That’s…”
Hearing Lin Yi say this, Wang Qian’er was at a loss for words, not knowing how to answer his question.
Wang Qian’er didn’t know why, but she just didn’t want to tell Lin Yi that there was a reason why she and Li Yunfei were together.
“I don’t know either. Anyway, she likes Li Yunfei.”
Wang Qian’er thought it over and could only give that answer.
After hearing this, Lin Yi didn’t ask further but redirected the conversation, shifting the focus.
“Qian’er, did you ask me to come here because you have something on your mind?”
“No, I just wanted to see you. I felt like we hadn’t seen each other for such a long time, so I invited you to watch our game!”
Wang Qian’er said cheerfully, and taking out several sets of clothes from her bag, she handed them to Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi, brother, put these on. Once you’re changed, I’ll take you to the basketball competition our class organized. Remember, you have to win; we’ve put a lot at stake!”
“Yeah, I’ll give it my all!”
Lin Yi nodded and then took the basketball uniform from Wang Qian’er’s hands and put it on.
“Lin Yi, you look incredibly cool in that basketball uniform,” Wang Qian’er exclaimed when she saw him dressed in a black sports uniform.
“Ha, thank you for the compliment, but this outfit doesn’t suit me!” Lin Yi responded with a laugh.
