After putting on the black sports outfit, Lin Yi looked especially sharp, exuding a sunny and handsome aura, and with his already tall and imposing figure, the outfit added to his charm.
Truly the princess of the Wang Family had a unique eye for style.
After checking himself out in the mirror, Lin Yi approached Wang Qian’er and asked, “Does it look good?”
“It looks great. It’s my first time seeing Lin Yi, brother, dressed like this. You look incredibly handsome; just incredible!” Wang Qian’er said excitedly.
Looking at the excited and pleasantly surprised Wang Qian’er in front of him, Lin Yi couldn’t help but smile and say, “Shall we start now then?”
“Of course, Lin Yi, brother. You’re our class’s team captain this time. You have to perform well and strive for the championship. I’m really looking forward to it!” Wang Qian’er said excitedly.
“Yes, I definitely will. Let’s go!”
“Alright, let’s head out!”
With that, Wang Qian’er took Lin Yi’s arm and started to lead him out the door.
Looking at the delicate hand that was grasping his arm, Lin Yi paused and then chuckled, “Qian’er, could you not hold my arm, please? It doesn’t seem quite right.”
Wang Qian’er quickly let go of her hand and said coquettishly while blushing, “Humph, I don’t care, you have to play games with me more often from now on, otherwise, I’ll stop talking to you.”
“Okay, I promise you!”
After hearing Wang Qian’er’s words, Lin Yi’s heart was instantly filled with helplessness.
Wang Qian’er was a very lively and adorable girl. Although she could be willful and stubborn, deep down she still had a pure and kind heart. She was indeed a completely lovable girl.
It was only because she had fallen for Chen Yuxin that she became willful and stubborn, but inside she also harbored a sense of defiance and pride.
Caught between the two, Lin Yi didn’t know what to do for a moment.
The two left the dormitory building, got into Wang Qian’er’s car, and headed for the basketball court.
The basketball court was located on the southern side of the campus, and Wang Qian’er’s car was parked near a commercial area close to the South Gate.
No sooner had the car entered the South Gate than they encountered several vehicles coming head-on.
Inside the car, Lin Yi, Wang Qian’er, and Chen Yuxin all looked at the group of men and women approaching them, unsure who they were or why they would dare to provoke them.
Seeing the aggressive approach of the others, Wang Qian’er couldn’t help but frown.
“Eh? Who are they? Daring to come here and cause trouble, what does this mean?”
Wang Qian’er asked in surprise, looking at the men and women outside the car window.
“Qian’er, these are the people I mentioned to you last night, the same ones, the fiancé of the Chen Family’s young miss, Chen Yuxin!” Lin Yi explained.
“Fiancé?”
Upon hearing this, Wang Qian’er was immediately not pleased.
“What fiancé? Brother Lin Yi, he doesn’t like Chen Yuxin, and he doesn’t like me either. He’s just using us as a shield!”
Hearing Wang Qian’er’s words, Lin Yi was taken aback for a moment.
Lin Yi thought to himself, “It seems what Qian’er says is true. No wonder Chen Yuxin suddenly disappeared last night.”
“What do you mean, Chen Yuxin disappeared?” Wang Qian’er said in astonishment.
“Yeah!”
“How did she disappear?”
“Last night we participated in a game together. I was playing basketball with Yu Xin, and perhaps Yu Xin wasn’t that familiar with the game, so we lost. But there’s no need to be angry about losing, yet she just ran off and left the basketball court alone.”
“You’re saying she walked away all by herself? Where did she go? Did she leave any contact information?” Wang Qian’er asked urgently.
Lin Yi shook his head and said, “She didn’t leave me any contact information, and her phone was turned off too. I think she must have been taken away by people sent by her father.”
“What? Taken away by her father? Why would her father do that? He’s supposed to love Chen Yuxin dearly, how could he possibly kidnap her?”
Lin Yi said with a bitter smile, “Do you know that Chen Yuxin’s father doesn’t truly love her? His only intention is to use Chen Yuxin to achieve his own goals. Chen Yuxin is just a pawn for her father; his aim is to bankrupt the Lin Family and then devour our wealth.”
“That’s too much, how can he do such a thing? They’re blood relatives, how could he bring himself to do this?”
After hearing this, Wang Qian’er’s heart surged with anger, wishing she could confront him and give him a piece of her mind.
“Qian’er, you need to calm down,” Lin Yi advised.
“Brother Lin Yi, where are they now? Take me to them, I must avenge Yu Xin!” Wang Qian’er said, clenching her fists.
“I understand, I’ll take you there now!”
Having said that, Lin Yi started the car and drove towards the direction of the other party, soon disappearing from view.

chapters.title: Chapter 598: 598: Will Suffer Retribution!
chapters.content:
Chapter 598: Chapter 598: Will Suffer Retribution!
At that moment, Wang Qian’er’s phone suddenly rang with the tone of an unfamiliar number.
Wang Qian’er hesitated for a moment before pressing the answer button.
“Hello, hi!”
“Qian’er, where are you? Yu Xin is in our hands,” came a middle-aged man’s sinister and icy voice from the phone.
“What, Yu Xin is with you? What do you want? Don’t you harm Yu Xin. Hand her over to me; I will definitely rescue her!” Wang Qian’er exclaimed anxiously upon hearing the man’s words.
“Hehe, I want to make her our wife!”
...
“Ah, no, Yu Xin cannot be your wife, you beasts, you will get your retribution!” Wang Qian’er said in panic upon hearing his words.
“Haha, retribution? Retribution? That’s something that’s only become popular in the last few days, I’ve already experienced it, and I’m not afraid to tell you that today is the day retribution arrives.
I’ve had people prepare drugs for when you all come over. A large group of drug traffickers will surround you, and then, as we said, you’ll be dead!” the middle-aged man said triumphantly.
“You, you, you… you are utterly mad, I won’t let you get away with this, I won’t let you succeed!”
Wang Qian’er shouted furiously and then hung up the phone.
“What’s wrong, Qian’er?” Lin Yi asked.
Wang Qian’er took a deep breath and said, “Lin Yi, I have to go save Yu Xin, we are just about to go to the hospital!”
“Hm?”
Lin Yi was slightly taken aback, then asked, “Aren’t you afraid they have an ambush waiting?”
“Not afraid!”
“Then why don’t you first check on Yu Xin at the hospital? Aren’t you good friends?”
“That, it’s because Yu Xin is more important to me than anything else in my eyes,” she said.
Hearing Wang Qian’er’s words, Lin Yi was slightly stunned, and a warmth surged in his heart, and he couldn’t help but smile.
“Qian’er, thank you.”
“Thank me for what? You are my Lin Yi, it’s only right that I help you!” Wang Qian’er said with a smile.
“Yes, it’s only right; I am your Lin Yi brother.”
…
Lin Yi’s car sped along, quickly arriving at Nanjiang Medical University, and then he hurried with Wang Qian’er straight to the Nanjiang Military Court.
Outside the Nanjiang Military Court, Lin Yi stopped the car.
Then he and Wang Qian’er entered the military court.
After arriving at the military court, Lin Yi separated from Chen Yuxin.
“Yu Xin!” Lin Yi approached Wang Qian’er’s side and called out to Chen Yuxin.
“Lin Yi, you’re finally here, I’ve been waiting for you for so long,” Chen Yuxin said excitedly as she ran up to him.
“What are you waiting here for? Weren’t you picked up by my dad already?” Lin Yi asked, puzzled.
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s question, Chen Yuxin pouted her lips and said, “Dad picking me up was only temporary, he doesn’t acknowledge me anymore. I am now just an abandoned child; I’ve been thrown out of the house.”
“Yu Xin, don’t cry, you still have me. I will always be by your side,” Lin Yi comforted. “After we graduate, I will help you return to school. Believe in me, and we will definitely be able to get you back into school.”
“But Dad doesn’t believe me at all right now, and he won’t allow me to look for work anymore,” Chen Yuxin said in a low cry.
“Stop crying. I’ll take you out now. I must restore your student status and then get you back to school,” Lin Yi said determinedly. “Believe in me, as long as the two of us are together, we will definitely be able to return to school.”
“Okay, I’ll listen to you. Let’s go!” Chen Yuxin nodded and replied.
Seeing this, Lin Yi immediately showed a satisfied smile.
Then, the two of them walked out of the military court.
No sooner had they walked out than they found a large group of reporters gathered at the entrance of the courthouse.
Upon seeing this, Lin Yi immediately grabbed Chen Yuxin’s hand and quickly passed by the reporters, then got into a black Audi car with Chen Yuxin and sped off toward the outskirts of the city.
Lin Yi took Chen Yuxin to an abandoned factory on the outskirts of town, and the reporters, seeing them get into the black Audi, began filming with their cameras.
Lin Yi glanced at the reporters through the rearview mirror, then stepped on the gas pedal and left the abandoned factory behind.
“Yu Xin, where are we headed now? I’ll take you to my place,” Lin Yi said.
“Okay!” Chen Yuxin nodded her head.
Lin Yi parked the car in a high-end residential area, then led Chen Yuxin to his room, opened the door, and the two walked in.
“Yu Xin, you go take a shower first, I’ll be over in a bit. Rest up!” Lin Yi told Chen Yuxin.
“All right, Lin Yi, hurry up!” she replied.
“Okay!” Lin Yi responded and quickly left the room.
After freshening up, Chen Yuxin sat on the bed, lost in thought. She was in deep conflict about what she should do.
All she could think about was Lin Yi’s image; her feelings for him had long surpassed those of ordinary friendship.
But now, she had no choice but to reject Lin Yi’s marriage proposal. She could not bear to see him get hurt again.
After thinking it over for a long time, Chen Yuxin finally made a decision: she had to leave Lin Yi and let him completely forget about her.
From now on, she would be alone, without friends, a reality she couldn’t accept at all.
But then, standing up and walking to the window, Chen Yuxin opened it. A cool breeze blew in, waking her up and cementing her resolve: from now on, she would no longer love Lin Yi, nor would she be his girlfriend anymore.
Not long after Chen Yuxin made up her mind, Lin Yi came down the stairs.
Seeing Chen Yuxin’s silhouette, Lin Yi guessed that she was about to do something foolish and quickly walked toward her.
“Lin Yi, where are you going?” Chen Yuxin asked, turning her head in confusion.
“Yu Xin, what are you planning to do? You can’t do anything foolish! Do you want to worry me to death?” Lin Yi said urgently.
He was truly afraid, for if Chen Yuxin really did something foolish, what would he do?
Fear filled Lin Yi’s heart. He didn’t want to imagine what foolish thing Chen Yuxin might do, as the thought of that pain was something he neither wanted nor dared to experience.
“I’m not planning anything silly; I just want to go to the bathroom. I don’t want to stay here anymore; I need to get some fresh air,” Chen Yuxin said, shaking her head. “I don’t want to be trapped in this place.”
“You absolutely cannot go,” Lin Yi said, shaking his head. “Your ankle is sprained. Where do you think you’re going to go? After you’re discharged, I’ll take you to some fun places!”

chapters.title: Chapter 599: 599: The Independent Director's Girl
chapters.content:
Chapter 599: Chapter 599: The Independent Director’s Girl
“Lin Yi, brother, I’m really okay now, don’t worry about me. Weren’t you going to take a shower? Go ahead, don’t waste any more time,” Chen Yuxin said with a smile.
Seeing Chen Yuxin’s insistence, Lin Yi nodded and said, “Alright, then wait for me at home, I’ll be back soon.”
“Okay!” Chen Yuxin nodded with a smile.
Lin Yi then went into the bathroom to shower.
After Lin Yi had showered and changed his clothes, he hurried back to the room where Chen Yuxin was.
“Yu Xin, are you done showering?”
...
Seeing Lin Yi return, Chen Yuxin nodded and said, “Yes!”
Lin Yi then walked over to Chen Yuxin, gently touched her soft hair, and said tenderly, “Alright, let’s go.”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, Chen Yuxin nodded and replied, “Okay! I got it!”
With that, Lin Yi took Chen Yuxin’s hand and they left the room together.
Under Lin Yi’s guidance, they made their way to Lin Yi’s home.
It was a two-story villa, with all the decorations inside a pure white color, very simple and bright.
Lin Yi’s parents had passed away long ago, leaving only Lin Yi living by himself.
And Lin Yi’s sister, Lin Mengfei, was a very independent and sensible girl who usually worked at the company and rarely came home.
Chen Yuxin was also Lin Mengfei’s cousin. They were quite familiar with each other at the company and would occasionally go shopping together.
“Lin Yi, brother, is this your home? It’s really beautiful, different from the ordinary houses at school,” Chen Yuxin said in surprise after walking into the house.
“Hehe, of course, my home environment is very elegant. It’s a luxury suite I specially purchased. I personally designed all the decorations inside!” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“That’s amazing, Lin Yi, brother, you’re really talented!” Chen Yuxin praised sincerely.
“Heh heh, don’t make fun of me. Actually, you’re quite something yourself. In college, you’re at the level of a campus belle, a goddess in everyone’s eyes, the people’s goddess!” Lin Yi scratched his head and said with some embarrassment.
“I’m not that great, I’m just lucky!” Chen Yuxin shook her head.
“Lin Yi, brother, come in and rest a while!” Chen Yuxin said.
“Okay, Yu Xin, thank you. How’s your leg? Is it okay?” Lin Yi asked quickly.
“It’s okay now, it doesn’t hurt much anymore,” Chen Yuxin shook her head.
“That’s good to hear, Yu Xin. Tonight, I’ll sleep here with you so I can be at ease,” Lin Yi said with a slight smile, then entered the house.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Chen Yuxin’s face blushed as she coquettishly retorted, “Who asked you to stay here and sleep with me? Go sleep on the sofa in the living room. It’s late, you must be tired too, go rest.”
“No need, I’ll just sleep here,” Lin Yi shook his head and said.
“Lin Yi, brother, don’t be stubborn. Please go to the living room. Although this is your house, there are boundaries in male-female interactions; we can’t be too close. Even if we’re very close, it’s not right. You understand?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was momentarily stunned, but quickly recovered.
Chen Yuxin was right; after all, she was still underage, and having had a relationship with her, he really shouldn’t be too presumptuous.
With this in mind, Lin Yi nodded and said, “Okay then, I’ll sleep in the living room. You should rest early too!”
With that, Lin Yi went to the sofa in the living room.
He then lay down on the sofa and soon closed his eyes.
“Yu Xin, you go to sleep first, I’ll wait for you in the living room,” Lin Yi said.
“Alright, you rest up too, good night!” Chen Yuxin finished speaking, turned, and went into her room.
After Chen Yuxin entered the room, Lin Yi rolled out of bed, drew the curtains, and then lay down on the sofa, covering himself with the blanket, ready to go to sleep.
However, just as Lin Yi had laid down, a loud bang suddenly erupted, followed by a dark figure pouncing towards Chen Yuxin’s bed.
“Ah! A ghost! Help!
Chen Yuxin was startled, then screamed out.
“Yu Xin, don’t scream! It’s me!” Lin Yi quickly explained.
“So it was Brother Lin Yi, you scared me to death.” Chen Yuxin breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing Lin Yi’s voice.
“Don’t be scared, I just wanted to tease you, there’s no need to be frightened, I’ll get rid of it right now,” Lin Yi said as he sat up from the sofa.
Lin Yi then walked to the door, opened it, and stepped out of the room.
Outside, Lin Yi didn’t see Chen Yuxin but instead saw a big fat black cat.
At this moment, the big fat cat lay on the ground, seemingly knocked out by Lin Yi.
“Oy, what a dumb cat!” Lin Yi sighed, then went over to the big fat cat and picked it up.
After that, Lin Yi tossed the big fat cat into the kitchen, shut the kitchen window, ensuring the big fat cat could never escape.
Having done all this, Lin Yi returned to the room and walked to the bedroom.
“You’re awake!”
“Yeah! Brother Lin Yi, why did you come out without wearing shoes? You might catch a cold,” Chen Yuxin said.
“I heard you screaming just now and immediately came to see what was wrong, not expecting to encounter a silly cat that almost scared me to death.”
“Yeah, I didn’t expect my scream to be so loud, it scared me to death!” Chen Yuxin stuck out her tongue, displaying an adorable expression.
“Haha, it’s alright, it’s alright,” Lin Yi laughed heartily.
“Brother Lin Yi, who caught the big fat cat?” Chen Yuxin curiously asked.
“Well, I caught it. It was a black dog, I just used the black dog to scare it,” Lin Yi replied.
“Oh, I see, Brother Lin Yi is so smart,” Chen Yuxin clapped her hands in praise.
“Of course, that’s a given,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Let’s eat, I’m starving, I almost passed out from hunger.”
“Yeah, okay.”
The two of them went down the stairs together, moving toward the dining table. Chen Yuxin sat down in a chair and said to Lin Yi with a smile, “Brother Lin Yi, come sit down and eat, I made a lot of food for lunch today, it should be enough for us.”
“Yeah, okay!” Lin Yi nodded his head and sat down.
Seeing the table full of dishes that he liked, Lin Yi felt a warm feeling in his heart.
“Yu Xin, thank you. When I have time, I’ll bring you here to eat,” he said.
“Mhm, okay!” Chen Yuxin agreed obediently, nodding her head.
Seeing Chen Yuxin’s docile demeanor made Lin Yi feel very comfortable, and his mood was exceptionally pleasant.
After Lin Yi and Chen Yuxin had finished eating, they went back to their rooms to rest.
The next morning.
“Huff… finally got a good sleep!” Chen Yuxin rubbed her eyes and opened her sleepy eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 600: 600: A Teddy Bear
chapters.content:
Chapter 600: Chapter 600: A Teddy Bear
Last night, Lin Yi stayed by Chen Yuxin’s side all night, helping her dispel her fears so that she could sleep very soundly, without having to worry about being haunted by ghosts in the middle of the night.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi sat on the couch watching television.
“Eh, isn’t this Chen Yuxin’s room? No wonder I didn’t hear Chen Yuxin asking me to get up last night, she was sleeping by herself!”
Lin Yi thought to himself and then looked out the window, noticing Chen Yuxin standing on the balcony, looking at him.
Lin Yi waved at Chen Yuxin, signaling for her to come in quickly.
After that, Chen Yuxin ran back into the room and approached Lin Yi.
...
“Yu Xin, you seem to have slept pretty well!” Lin Yi said to Chen Yuxin with a smile.
“Yeah, not too bad,” Chen Yuxin nodded in reply.
“Yu Xin, look, this is what you woke up to see this morning.” Lin Yi finished speaking and handed the stuffed teddy bear he was holding in his hands to Chen Yuxin.
“Oh, a gift from Brother Lin Yi, it’s so pretty!” Chen Yuxin said in surprise.
“Yeah, it’s a bear. Do you like it?” Lin Yi asked.
“I love it! I love teddy bears the most, and this one is the most beautiful teddy bear I’ve ever seen!” Chen Yuxin exclaimed excitedly.
“Well, if you like it that much, then you should take good care of it. Otherwise, if it gets lost in the future, you’re going to feel heartbroken,” Lin Yi said.
“Mhmm, I know, I will treasure it!”
“Good, that’s great!” Lin Yi said with a slight smile.
Just then, Lin Yi’s cell phone started vibrating.
“Eh, who could that be calling?” Lin Yi felt in his pocket, pulled out his phone, and saw that the caller ID showed Old Man Wang.
“It’s Old Man Wang calling, probably for something. Let me take the call!”
After speaking, Lin Yi pressed the talk button.
“Hello! Old Man Wang, is there something you need me for?”
“Lin Yi, there’s something I want to ask you about. Last night I heard Chen Yuxin shouting in her room, were you in her room?”
“Yes, Yu Xin was scared of a black cat last night, and then I went into her bedroom and caught the black cat for her. I’ve already taken the black cat to the pet hospital,” Lin Yi said truthfully.
“Okay, I understand.”
Then, they hung up the call.
“It looks like Old Man Wang definitely wants something from Yu Xin. I’ll go see him right now,” Lin Yi thought.
Thinking this, Lin Yi left the bedroom and went to the living room.
By this time, Chen Yuxin had already gotten up and was organizing her clothes.
“Brother Lin Yi, you’re awake!” Chen Yuxin said with a sweet smile.
“Yeah, I am. I’m off to school now. You rest well, and I’ll come see you again next time!” Lin Yi said.
“Okay!” Chen Yuxin nodded, then watched as Lin Yi left.
“Brother Lin Yi, I’m going to school too!” Chen Yuxin said, looking at Lin Yi’s disappearing figure.
Afterward, Lin Yi drove to the school entrance.
Lin Yi parked his car at the school gate and went straight inside.
As soon as Lin Yi entered the campus, he saw many students gathered chatting.
Lin Yi glanced around and noticed that most of the students were male and rather sleazy.
“Hmph, these disgusting ruffians, I need to teach them a lesson!” Lin Yi thought to himself, feeling a surge of anger inside.
“Damn, that pretty boy sure looks handsome!”
“Not bad at all, not only is his skin fair, but he is so young!”
“Looking at his physique, he is top-notch, he must be impressive, I’ve decided, I’m going to seduce him today, and then I’ll have him wrapped around my finger!”
“Hmm, right! If you want to hook him today, you need to pay attention to your dressing, you have to make yourself look pretty, don’t let him see through you too easily!”
“Exactly, just do that, seduce him first no matter what.”
As Lin Yi listened to these whisperings from the boys, he walked toward the teachers’ office area.
Soon, Lin Yi arrived at the teachers’ office area, then pushed the door and entered the staff room.
Upon entering the classroom, he saw Old Wang chatting with the other teachers.
“Old Wang, what did you want to see me about?” Lin Yi asked.
“Lin Yi, about last night’s incident, it was you who did it, wasn’t it?” Old Wang asked, looking at Lin Yi.
“Uh… sort of!” Lin Yi hesitated for a moment, then admitted.
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s admission, Old Wang furrowed his brows and asked, “Why did you do that?”
“I just wanted to punish that little black cat, so I did a little something, I didn’t hurt anyone!” Lin Yi explained.
“Hehe, Lin Yi, you really are amusing. What was your reason for doing it?” Old Wang chuckled and said.
“Well, I just find that black cat so annoying, and it also harmed Yu Xin, so I tossed it into the lake,” Lin Yi laughed and said.
“Really?” Old Wang asked with a chuckle.
“Of course it’s true, Old Wang, what’s with you? Why are you so doubtful?” Lin Yi said with confusion.
“Oh, I just wanted to ask, why would you throw the little black cat into the lake?” Old Wang asked with a smile.
“Because it’s ugly, I was afraid it would scare Yu Xin.”
“Ugly? I think it’s quite cute!”
“Uh, Old Wang, could it be you’ve been charmed by that little black cat?” Lin Yi laughed.
“Lin Yi, enough about that, I need to talk to you.”
“Sure, go ahead.”
After pondering for a moment, Old Wang then said to Lin Yi, “Lin Yi, I heard from Yu Xin that you’re going to take her as your disciple?”
“Yes, indeed, I’m preparing to take her as my disciple,” Lin Yi said with a slight smile.
“I know that, but you should consider it carefully, taking a girl as an apprentice, there are many male students who won’t be happy about it!” Old Wang said.
“I’ll choose my own disciple however I want,” Lin Yi stated indifferently, with a nonchalant demeanor that left others guessing what exactly he was thinking.
“Okay, then!” Old Wang didn’t say more, after all, Lin Yi had grown up, and he couldn’t control Lin Yi forever, it was up to Lin Yi to make his own choices.
“By the way, I’ve come to you today to discuss something, the final exams start tomorrow, and you may have to participate; how are you planning to arrange your exams?” Old Wang asked.
“I’ve already prepared for tomorrow’s exam subjects, don’t worry, I’m confident I can pass with flying colors!” Lin Yi patted his chest and said confidently.
“Good, I’ll go help you sign up tomorrow!”
“However, remember, your score tomorrow can only ensure a top three rank in the class, the rest will be zero, you should consider what to do about that!” Old Wang reminded him.
“I know, I’ll do my best tomorrow, I guarantee there won’t be any issues!”
“Alright, then I’ll be at ease.”
The next day.
At six o’clock in the early morning, Lin Yi was woken up.
As soon as Lin Yi woke up, he saw Zhang Yuxin doing her morning wash.
At that moment, Zhang Yuxin was wearing a pink tracksuit, which made her look incredibly cute, almost irresistibly bite-sized.

chapters.title: Chapter 601: 601: Can't Take It
chapters.content:
Chapter 601: Chapter 601: Can’t Take It
Lin Yi swallowed and cursed inwardly, that girl’s chest is way too big!
Zhang Yuxin seemed to have felt Lin Yi’s gaze and turned her head to give him a sweet smile.
At the sight of that smile, Lin Yi almost spat out blood.
Lin Yi quickly shifted his gaze away.
This girl was truly a stunner—if she ever seduced him, that would be disastrous.
Lin Yi thought to himself.
...
After Zhang Yuxin had finished freshening up, she sat down to eat breakfast at the dining table.
At that moment, Chen Yuxin suddenly looked up and asked, “Hey, Lin Yi, I’ve told the teacher about last night’s incident. How are you planning to handle it?”
Hearing this, Lin Yi almost choked and coughed a few times.
“You said you’ve told the teacher? Are you out of your mind? Do you have any idea who the teacher is, how could you carelessly talk about it? If the teacher blames us, can you handle it?” Lin Yi said helplessly.
“It’s precisely because I’m afraid he’ll blame me that I told the teacher. If he wasn’t going to blame me, I wouldn’t have told him!” Zhang Yuxin said with utmost seriousness.
“You, you just can’t do this!” Lin Yi sighed and then said, “Well, since you’ve said it, you won’t be in any danger. I won’t go to the test tomorrow, let’s just skip it!
“Really not going?”
“Yeah!” Lin Yi confirmed decisively.
“Okay then!”
“That… don’t come looking for me today. I have things to do tomorrow!”
“What will you be doing?”
“I’m going shopping; I want to make a sumptuous breakfast with my own hands!” Lin Yi said with a smile, then stood up and walked outside.
“Okay, sure!”
Lin Yi walked out of the house and then hailed a taxi to head downtown.
“Sir, could you please slow down a bit? I need to go to the supermarket. I’m going to buy some ingredients today because school is starting tomorrow, and I want to prepare a sumptuous breakfast for my junior sister!” Lin Yi told the driver.
“Sure thing, no problem.”
A few minutes later, Lin Yi’s taxi arrived downtown.
“Sir, thank you!” Lin Yi said to the driver.
“Sure, you’re welcome. Just remember to tip more next time!” the driver said with a laugh.
“Sure, I’ll definitely give a tip!”
Lin Yi got out of the cab and headed towards the supermarket.
“Lin Yi, how come you’ve got time to come to the supermarket today?” Zhang Yuxin asked.
“I’m free today, so I thought I’d come by and have a look,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“So you’re here to shop for groceries to cook?”
“Yes!” Lin Yi replied.
“You can cook?” Zhang Yuxin widened her eyes in surprise.
Lin Yi was slightly startled, then nodded, “Um, I can cook a bit!”
“Then make something for me to eat!”
“Alright! Then come with me!” Lin Yi said.
“Okay!” Zhang Yuxin nodded in agreement.
And so, Lin Yi and Zhang Yuxin both entered the supermarket.
Although the supermarket was small, it was bustling inside. The shelves were filled with an array of items including fruits, vegetables, and other various foods.
Lin Yi looked around and found many things he did not recognize, unsure where to start.
Lin Yi didn’t linger here but walked further inside with Zhang Yuxin.
Shortly after, Lin Yi arrived at a large supermarket with Zhang Yuxin, where he purchased many food ingredients and some seasonings.
At this point, Zhang Yuxin could tell that Lin Yi was completely clueless in the kitchen.
“Lin Yi, you’ve bought so many vegetables. Can the two of us finish them all?” Zhang Yuxin asked with doubt.
“Of course, we can finish them. I’m a master chef, and making a rich breakfast is really simple,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Pfft, I’ve never seen anyone so skilled in cooking!” Zhang Yuxin snorted.
“If you want to know, I’ll let you witness my cooking skills!” Lin Yi laughed.
“Pfft, who’d want that!”
“I’m going to show you anyway!” Lin Yi declared.
“Then hurry up and cook!” Zhang Yuxin said.
“Sure!” Lin Yi replied with a slight smile, then began to pick out ingredients.
Zhang Yuxin watched Lin Yi’s back and couldn’t help but laugh, before she started to select vegetables.
Lin Yi bought some meat, vegetables, tofu, seafood, and more, then started to bustle around in the kitchen.
Zhang Yuxin quietly watched from the side as Lin Yi cooked.
It had to be said, although Lin Yi looked very ordinary, even a bit sloppy, Zhang Yuxin was still conquered by the delicious food he made.
Even though Lin Yi’s cooking skills were average, the food he made was quite tasty.
Once the egg soup was done, Lin Yi brought a pot of stewed eggs to the table and asked Zhang Yuxin, “It’s ready, shall we start eating?”
“Mmm, it smells so good. What kind of egg soup is this? It smells delicious!” Zhang Yuxin asked as she sniffed the aroma.
“Egg soup. I’ve been simmering it for over two hours!” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“You’re so amazing, you actually simmered it for more than two hours?” Zhang Yuxin said, surprised.
“Yes, I used to be a kitchen idiot, but now I’m a great chef!” Lin Yi laughed.
“You’re still a kitchen idiot, you’d be laughed to death if others heard that; your skin is so thick!” Zhang Yuxin said, laughing.
“My skin can’t be thicker than yours; not only is your skin thick, but your mouth is pretty sharp too. I’m no match for you!” Lin Yi retorted.
“Hmph, I’m not arguing with you, I just find it odd!” Zhang Yuxin said with a laugh.
“Hehe, don’t worry, today I just want to show off my cooking skills, so don’t you say anything to distract me!” Lin Yi chuckled.
“Got it!” Zhang Yuxin stuck out her tongue and laughed in response.
Lin Yi picked up his chopsticks, picked up a chicken leg, and placed it into Zhang Yuxin’s bowl, saying with a smile, “Try it and see how it tastes?”
“Good, it’s quite tasty,” Zhang Yuxin complimented.
“Then eat more, I spent over an hour on it!” Lin Yi said proudly.
“Didn’t you say you were a kitchen idiot? How did you become so skilled all of a sudden?” Zhang Yuxin curiously asked.
“Hehe, my current cooking skills have improved a lot from before, so just eat without worry!”
The delicious dish Lin Yi made was specifically with ingredients he bought from the supermarket the night before and took an entire afternoon to prepare.
“Then thank you so much, your cooking is really delicious, even better than my mom’s!” Zhang Yuxin exclaimed.
“Really? Your mom knows how to cook?” Lin Yi asked, surprised.
“My mom knows how to cook, but it’s not tasty, and sometimes it’s not hygienic. She wouldn’t even eat it herself. Every time I ate her food, she always scolded me,” Zhang Yuxin sighed.
“Hehe, that’s because she doesn’t have taste, unable to appreciate your delicious food,” Lin Yi laughed, “By the way, what’s your name?”
“I’m Zhang Yuxin!” Zhang Yuxin said, “Oh right, I still don’t know your name!”
“I’m Lin Yi!” Lin Yi laughed.

chapters.title: Chapter 602: 602: Will Not Break Faith
chapters.content:
Chapter 602: Chapter 602: Will Not Break Faith
“””
“Lin Yi, why don’t you have the surname Li?” Zhang Yuxin asked curiously.
“What’s the difference between surnamed Lin and Li?” Lin Yi wondered.
“I mean, why isn’t your surname Li?” Zhang Yuxin explained.
“Haha, just because I’m surnamed Lin doesn’t mean I have to be surnamed Li. Look, I’m also surnamed Zhang, aren’t I?” Lin Yi said.
“Yeah, that’s true!” Zhang Yuxin nodded.
...
“Alright, let’s eat before it gets cold!” Lin Yi said.
“Okay!” Zhang Yuxin nodded and began to eat the delicious breakfast Lin Yi had made.
After the meal, Zhang Yuxin went back to school, and Lin Yi went to the hospital.
On the way to the hospital, Lin Yi called Ye Qianying to tell her that he would join Zhang Yuxin for lunch today and that he would bring her a gift.
Ye Qianying was very happy to hear this news from Lin Yi. After all, she also wanted Lin Yi to be with Zhang Yuxin.
Lin Yi arrived at the hospital, then went to Ye Qianying’s ward.
At the moment, Ye Qianying was sitting on the bed, watching a TV drama.
Lin Yi pushed the door and walked in.
Seeing Lin Yi come in, Ye Qianying immediately stood up, walked toward him, grabbed him, and said, “You’re finally here. I thought you weren’t going to come!”
“What are you talking about? I’m not someone who breaks his word,” Lin Yi said with a wry smile.
“I was afraid you had forgotten again!” Ye Qianying mumbled with a pout.
“Don’t worry, I always keep my promises. I will do what I promised you!” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“That’s good!” Ye Qianying smiled, let go of his hand, and sat down on the sofa.
“Do you have any plans for today?” Lin Yi asked.
“I don’t have any plans today. As long as you’re here, any plans are fine!” Ye Qianying said with a smile.
Lin Yi felt a warm surge in his heart when he heard Ye Qianying say that.
“Then, I’ll go prepare a gift for Zhang Yuxin now, and I’ll bring her to visit you in the evening. You just rest well!” Lin Yi said.
“Okay, you go ahead!” Ye Qianying nodded.
“I’ll be off then.” After saying that, Lin Yi left Ye Qianying’s ward.
After returning to Zhang Yuxin’s ward, Lin Yi called Zhang Yuxin.
When Lin Yi called Zhang Yuxin, she had just finished her class.
“Hello, you’ve reached Zhang Yuxin!” Zhang Yuxin answered the call.
“Yuxin, it’s Lin Yi!” Lin Yi said with a laugh.
“Oh! You’re Lin Yi?” Zhang Yuxin was surprised. She hadn’t expected Lin Yi to call her today, and now he had taken the initiative to ring her up. Moreover, Lin Yi knew her name, which really took Zhang Yuxin by surprise.
“Yeah, I’m downstairs at your place right now. Whenever you’re free, I’ll come to pick you up. You can come down now,” Lin Yi said with a laugh.
“Okay, sure!” Zhang Yuxin replied, then hung up and left the classroom.
After leaving the classroom, Zhang Yuxin saw Lin Yi leaning against a car, smoking. As Zhang Yuxin approached Lin Yi, the cigarette in his hand had just burned out.
“Ah, I’m sorry, I didn’t notice your cigarette had burned down,” Lin Yi quickly snuffed out the cigarette, apologetically saying.
“It’s okay!” Zhang Yuxin shook her head.
“””
“Yu Xin, can you get in the car now? We’ll head straight to the supermarket to buy some stuff, and then go to the hotel,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Okay then!” Zhang Yuxin replied and took her seat in the passenger’s side.
Afterward, Lin Yi started the car and drove towards the city center.
“Lin Yi, you didn’t come all this way just to see me, did you?” Zhang Yuxin asked curiously.
“Of course not, my visit was to buy some things as well; you’ll find out when I give you your gift,” Lin Yi replied with a smile.
“You know how to shop? Why haven’t I heard about this before?” Zhang Yuxin expressed her surprise, as she had thought Lin Yi didn’t know how to shop.
“Of course I know how to shop. What do you think I am, you? Someone who only knows how to eat, drink, and have fun!” Lin Yi said disdainfully.
“Why are you talking about me like that? Do I really only know how to eat, drink, and have fun? Are you saying you’re not happy to see me?” Zhang Yuxin said, feeling wronged.
“No, no, that’s not what I meant. It’s just that I think you’re a bit lazy,” Lin Yi said.
“Hmph, you just don’t want me to visit! Well, I’ll visit you anyway and see if you dare to mock me!” Zhang Yuxin said and turned her head away, refusing to look at Lin Yi any longer.
Lin Yi, seeing Zhang Yuxin behave this way, couldn’t help but be torn between laughter and helplessness.
“My dear sweet baby, don’t throw a tantrum. I really came all the way here to give you a gift,” Lin Yi coaxed.
“Is your gift just clothes for me?” Zhang Yuxin said, unsatisfied.
“No, this gift isn’t simple at all!” Lin Yi replied with a mysteriously teasing smile.
“What trick are you pulling now? Tell me, or I’ll get angry!” Zhang Yuxin said, persistently.
“Hehe, don’t be in such a hurry. You’ll find out what I bought for you in a bit, and you’ll definitely like it,” Lin Yi assured her.
“Stop beating around the bush. Tell me quickly, what gift are you planning to give me?” Zhang Yuxin asked eagerly.
“You’ll find out shortly after you see it!” Lin Yi said, maintaining the mystery.
“Come on, tell me what it is already. You’re being so secretive; I’m really curious about what gift you have for me!” Zhang Yuxin urged him.
“You’ll find out in a bit!” Lin Yi said with a laugh and didn’t reveal the gift to Zhang Yuxin.
“Hmph! Even if you don’t tell me, I can guess. It must be something expensive, and since you’re not short on money, it’s bound to be something pricey,” Zhang Yuxin said with a disdainful snort.
“Hehe, you don’t need to guess. Just sit tight, I’m about to give you something really valuable!” Lin Yi said with a laugh, then stepped on the gas, speeding forward.
The car weaved through the city streets and soon entered the suburbs, driving further and further out.
“Why do I feel like we’re getting more and more remote?” Zhang Yuxin asked curiously.
“Hehe, this is a place I spent quite a bit of money on. Nice scenery, isn’t it?” Lin Yi said with a laugh.
“The scenery is beautiful indeed, but there are hardly any people around. I hope you’re not planning to trick me into coming here and then… get rid of me,” Zhang Yuxin said with a frown.
“How could that be? Why do you underestimate me like that? I, Lin Yi, am not such a tasteless person; how could I possibly do such a thing!” Lin Yi protested.
“Then why have you brought me to this place? You’re not really planning to… you know, get rid of me, are you?” Zhang Yuxin said, her eyes widening as she stared at Lin Yi.
“Hehe, of course not! Don’t think such terrible things; I’m not that kind of person,” Lin Yi assured her with laughter.
“So where exactly are you taking me? I’m really hungry now; my stomach is growling. If you don’t take me to eat soon, I’ll just go back to school on my own, and don’t you regret it!” Zhang Yuxin threatened.
“Hehe, threatening me like that is utterly futile, you know!” Lin Yi replied, still chuckling.
“Humph! I’m not talking to you anymore; I might just die from anger!” Zhang Yuxin huffed.
“Alright, alright, we can stop just up ahead,” Lin Yi laughed and parked the car, then opened the door and stepped out.

chapters.title: Chapter 603: 603: Playful and Cute Appearance
chapters.content:
Chapter 603: Chapter 603: Playful and Cute Appearance
Zhang Yuxin stepped out of the car, looked around, and upon finding that there weren’t many people around, she immediately ran towards Lin Yi and asked, “Lin Yi, why did you bring me to this place? You have to be clear, okay?”
“Ha ha, now you know to be scared, but you just said I lacked taste!” Lin Yi laughed.
“I said I lacked taste, but I still believe you wouldn’t hurt me, so I’m willing to go crazy with you just this once.” Zhang Yuxin giggled, her face filled with a mischievous and cute expression.
“I never said I would hurt you, I just wanted to give you a very precious gift,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“A precious gift?” Zhang Yuxin asked in confusion.
“Mhm, get out of the car now!” said Lin Yi as he pulled Zhang Yuxin into the house he had bought.
...
Lin Yi took Zhang Yuxin by the hand into the room, then took out a red cloth and covered her head with it.
“What are you doing?” Zhang Yuxin asked, puzzled.
“You’ll know in a moment, hurry up and close your eyes!” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Oh, then I’m closing my eyes. You’d better wake me up quickly; I don’t want to be sold off by you so inexplicably!” Zhang Yuxin pouted and said.
“All right, I’ll wake you up soon. I promise you’ll be satisfied!” Lin Yi laughed.
“Okay, then I’ll trust you for the time being,” Zhang Yuxin said.
“Heh heh, that’s my good girl!” With that, Lin Yi yanked off the red cloth from Zhang Yuxin’s head, revealing her face.
At this moment, Lin Yi’s gaze fell on Zhang Yuxin’s face, his eyes filled with fascination and intoxication, unable to move away for a long time.
“Lin Yi, what are you looking at?” Seeing this, Zhang Yuxin couldn’t help but reach out to touch her face and asked with some confusion.
“Uh… well, I’m just marveling at your beauty, I’ve never seen a girl as beautiful as you, and you’re also so kind and so smart. I really admire you, so I want to give you a gift,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Oh, since you admire me so much, just give me this gift then,” Zhang Yuxin said.
“Haha, my treasure is clever! I won’t hold back anymore. The gift I’m planning to give you is a ring, and it’s the ring you like!” Lin Yi laughed.
“A ring? You want to give me a ring?” Upon hearing this, Zhang Yuxin was immediately startled.
“Yes!”
Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Are you really telling the truth?” Zhang Yuxin was still somewhat incredulous.
“Am I, Lin Yi, the kind of man who likes to lie and fool girls?” Lin Yi laughed, “Don’t worry, I won’t deceive you. This ring is for you, and if you find it ugly, you can throw it away.”
“No, how could I throw it away, it’s my favorite style of ring, and I really like it, so I won’t throw it away!” Zhang Yuxin quickly said.
“That’s right. Hurry up and put it on then, and I’ll take you home!” Lin Yi said.
“How should I tie it on?” Zhang Yuxin asked.
“Stretch out your hand to me!” said Lin Yi.
Zhang Yuxin stretched out her hand to Lin Yi.
“Come on, lift up your hand.” Lin Yi placed his hand on Zhang Yuxin’s jade wrist, and helped her remove the glove.
“What’s this for?” Zhang Yuxin exclaimed in surprise.
“Your hand is too delicate, and it’s not easy to wear the ring while wearing a glove. Let me help you put it on,” Lin Yi said.
Zhang Yuxin didn’t refuse and stretched out her hand, placing it in the palm of Lin Yi’s hand, allowing him to slide the ring onto her finger.
Soon, the two of them took off the necklace from Zhang Yuxin’s neck and put it on her ring finger instead.
“How does it look? Pretty?” Lin Yi asked with a smile.
“Beautiful, very beautiful, it’s even more sparkling than diamonds, I really like it!” Zhang Yuxin said happily.
“Well, as long as you like it!” Lin Yi laughed, “Let’s go then!”
“Okay!” Zhang Yuxin agreed.
“Wait a second, I haven’t changed my clothes yet!” Zhang Yuxin suddenly remembered she was still in her current outfit and hadn’t changed yet!
“It’s fine, that dress looks quite suitable on you,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“I still want to change into another dress, you won’t oppose that, will you?” Zhang Yuxin cooed.
“You little rascal, there’s no dealing with you, fine, go and change quickly. Remember to put on a sexy dress, I don’t want you going out like this and have other men staring at you,” Lin Yi said.
“Alright, I’ll go change right now,” Zhang Yuxin said and then turned to enter the bathroom.
“Lin Yi, wait for me outside, I’ll be out as soon as I’ve changed!” Zhang Yuxin called out to Lin Yi.
“Okay!”
Lin Yi agreed.
Zhang Yuxin took more than half an hour in the bathroom and finally came out wearing a strappy short dress. As soon as she emerged, Lin Yi was stunned.
Zhang Yuxin was truly too beautiful, especially after putting on the strappy dress, her exquisite figure was subtly revealed, making one involuntarily swallow and almost wanting to pounce on her there and then.
Seeing Lin Yi, a hint of red blossomed on Zhang Yuxin’s cheeks, but she didn’t shy away and instead took big strides towards him.
Lin Yi, surprised by Zhang Yuxin’s boldness, quickly took a few steps back.
“Hey, Lin Yi, what are you backing away for, I won’t bite, I’ve come to play with you!” Zhang Yuxin said.
“Uh… You’ve come to hang out, but why are you dressed like that?” Lin Yi asked.
“What’s wrong with how I’m dressed? I think it looks really nice!” Zhang Yuxin laughed.
“Uh, I just think it’s quite revealing,” Lin Yi said somewhat awkwardly.
“This isn’t revealing, but I still like wearing dresses because this one was given to me by you, and I find this dress very pleasing to the eye!” Zhang Yuxin said.
“You…” Lin Yi was left somewhat speechless by her words, managing only a wry smile.
“Lin Yi, do you think it looks good?” Zhang Yuxin walked up to him, looked down at her feet, and asked.
“Ahem, yes, it really looks good, your skin is so fair and delicate, the dress makes you look exceptionally beautiful, like a fairy, probably capturing the hearts of many young men!” Lin Yi said.
“Really? I also think it looks very nice!” Hearing Lin Yi’s compliments, Zhang Yuxin’s face beamed with a radiant smile.
“Your skin is so nice, surely the dress will look beautiful on you, come on, let me take you home first, then you can change it off, and we can head back after that,” Lin Yi said.
“Okay!”
Lin Yi took Zhang Yuxin away from the hotel and then drove back to his own villa.
All the way, Zhang Yuxin kept asking Lin Yi, “Lin Yi, which city are you really from? Why are you so amazing?”
“I come from the capital!” Lin Yi said with a laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 604: 604: I Must Surpass You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 604: Chapter 604: I Must Surpass You!
“Your dad is really awesome!” Zhang Yuxin said.
Lin Yi smiled and shook his head, “No, my dad is my mom’s husband and a soldier; my mom is also very impressive, so I am as well.”
“So that’s how it is!”
Lin Yi drove the car into the yard, stopped, unlatched his seatbelt, opened the door, got out of the car, and walked into the yard.
“Lin Yi, you’re back so early? Weren’t you supposed to be busy with some things?”
As soon as Lin Yi entered the house, he heard Li Wanru calling from the living room where she was watching TV.
...
“Yeah! I took care of everything!” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Oh!”
Afterward, Li Wanru walked out of the living room, stood beside Lin Yi, and looked at his profile. She suddenly realized that his nose bridge was high and well-defined, his face handsome and refined. Although not traditionally handsome, his appearance was very comforting and had a distinctive appeal.
Feeling Li Wanru’s gaze on him, Lin Yi turned his head and asked, “What is it? Did you discover something?”
“No, I was just thinking when I will become as awesome as you,” Li Wanru said shaking her head.
“Heh, I can’t guarantee that. You’ll have to work hard; otherwise, you’ll never catch up with me,” Lin Yi said.
“Hmph, who’s afraid of who? I will definitely surpass you!” Li Wanru glared at Lin Yi and huffed.
“I look forward to it!”
“Hmph, I won’t talk to you anymore, I’m going to cook,” Li Wanru glared at Lin Yi one more time and then turned to head toward the kitchen.
Lin Yi didn’t mind her and sat down on the sofa instead.
Zhang Yuxin, wearing a suspender dress, stood next to Lin Yi, her long slender legs accentuated by the light, appeared irresistibly enticing, her legs even longer and straighter, as if they could easily stir deep desires in a man.
Lin Yi couldn’t help but swallow a gulp of saliva.
He felt his blood beginning to boil.
“Why are you staring at me like that? Is there something dirty on my face?” Zhang Yuxin, feeling Lin Yi’s stare, became somewhat shy and lowered her head.
“No, how could there be anything dirty? You are the most beautiful girl I have ever seen,” Lin Yi said.
“Stop it, who would believe you!”
“Haha!”
Lin Yi laughed and shook his head, choosing not to speak anymore.
“Lin Yi, sit here for a while, I’ll go make you some tea, and after that, we can have a drink!”
“Alright, go ahead and brew it, call me when it’s ready!” Lin Yi replied.
“Um, got it!”
Lin Yi had been sitting for just a moment when he saw Zhang Yuxin walk out of the kitchen with a cup of fragrant green tea.
“Wow, it smells amazing!”
“Does it? Then I’ll have a taste.”
“Here, Lin Yi, try the tea!” Zhang Yuxin offered the cup to Lin Yi and said.
“Hmm!”
Zhang Yuxin brought the cup to her lips, took a sip, and then held it to her mouth.
Lin Yi, not to be outdone, downed the green tea in the cup in one go.
“Lin Yi, try the tea I brewed for you,” Zhang Yuxin said after setting the cup on the table and pouring another for Lin Yi.
“Hmm, really tasty, this tea is so fragrant!” Lin Yi said.
“That’s right, my mom had it shipped from overseas, it has a very unique flavor!”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was taken aback.
He had never expected Zhang Yuxin’s mother to even know a tea master.
“Lin Yi, try the steamed stuffed buns I cooked, they’re really delicious!” Zhang Yuxin added.
Lin Yi took the tea bowl, smelled it, then took a sip, and expressed his admiration, “This is indeed great tea, even better than those Huaji Galaxy varieties I saw online, no wonder the stars from Huaji Galaxy love drinking this kind of tea!”
Lin Yi had a poor impression of Huaji Galaxy, but he was very interested in tea.
“Lin Yi, my mother has an exceptional talent for the art of tea. If you’re interested, she can teach you sometime,” Zhang Yuxin said.
“Really?” Lin Yi was surprised, having not expected Zhang Yuxin’s mother to be so accomplished in the art of tea.
“Mhm!”
Zhang Yuxin nodded emphatically.
Lin Yi immediately yearned to learn from Zhang Yuxin’s mother.
“Okay, I’ll pay a visit to Auntie sometime!”
“Sure!” Zhang Yuxin happily agreed.
“Lin Yi, let’s go have dinner!”
“Alright, you go get your shoes down, and I’ll help you carry them!”
Lin Yi helped Zhang Yuxin with her shoes, handed them to her, and said, “Let’s go!”
“Mhm!”
Zhang Yuxin acknowledged and then walked towards the staircase, with Lin Yi following behind, carrying her high heels.
Lin Yi carried the high heels to Zhang Yuxin’s bedroom, placed them on the bed, and said, “Yuxin, you go change. I’m going to take a shower.”
“Okay, I’ll wait for you!” Zhang Yuxin said with a smile.
Lin Yi entered the bathroom and closed the door.
Zhang Yuxin changed into a loose T-shirt, jeans, and canvas shoes, then stepped out of the bedroom and headed for the kitchen to start cooking.
Soon, the meal was prepared.
Zhang Yuxin served the food on the table and began to eat. Lin Yi finished showering and came out of the bathroom.
After the shower, Lin Yi felt a warm flow within his body, making him feel refreshed and filled with vitality.
“Phew~! After taking a cold shower this time, I feel much more comfortable!”
Lin Yi sat at the table to eat.
“Taking a cold shower this time made me feel much more alert!” Lin Yi remarked.
“Yeah! Lin Yi, you’ve been so busy practicing Martial Arts these past few days, I haven’t had the chance to talk to you!” Zhang Yuxin said.
“Talk about what? Martial Arts? Or your chest?” Lin Yi glanced at Zhang Yuxin’s prominent peaks and teased.
“You rascal, hurry up and eat!” Zhang Yuxin’s face turned red as she chided him softly.
Zhang Yuxin and Lin Yi started chatting casually in the living room.
As they talked, Zhang Yuxin suddenly remembered the time Lin Yi had bullied her and asked, “Lin Yi, do you still remember the time you bullied me?”
“You mean that time? Of course, I remember it. I’m really sorry about what happened that day! I didn’t expect that you had such formidable strength!” Lin Yi said.
“Hmph! You make it sound so easy! You have to make it up to me for that day’s events, or I’ll tell my mother,” Zhang Yuxin stated.
“Alright, how would you like me to make it up to you?” Lin Yi asked.
“It’s simple, from now on we’ll practice Martial Arts together,” Zhang Yuxin said with a smile.
“Practice Martial Arts?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was taken aback for a moment.
“What’s the matter? You don’t want to? Or are you afraid you’ll lose to me?” Zhang Yuxin challenged.
“Is there a need for me to be afraid of losing to you? It’s just that I don’t have time to practice Martial Arts with you. You won’t mind, will you?” Lin Yi said.
“It’s okay if you don’t have time to practice Martial Arts with me, I’ll have plenty of time to accompany you later on.”
“Okay then, I’ll reluctantly agree to it. From now on, I’ll practice Martial Arts with you!”
“Mhm, Lin Yi, do you want to eat your fill and drink plenty so you can continue practicing Martial Arts?” Zhang Yuxin looked at Lin Yi and asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 605: 605: Drinking Tea
chapters.content:
Chapter 605: Chapter 605: Drinking Tea
“I’m not hungry, I just had a meal. Let’s continue drinking tea!” Lin Yi shook his head and said.
Lin Yi looked at the teaware on the table. There were a lot of cups, and they were all quite old, some even split in half.
“I’m going to wash the dishes!” Lin Yi tidied up the teaware on the table, then stood up and left the dining room for the kitchen.
Lin Yi cleaned up the dishes and utensils, and then started to wipe the table and wash the dishes.
Zhang Yuxin just watched Lin Yi, curious about why he was learning Martial Arts, but she didn’t dare to ask. She knew there were things not meant for her to know, so even with intense curiosity, she refrained from questioning Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi, what are you doing?” Zhang Yuxin asked.
...
“Washing dishes!” Lin Yi replied.
“We don’t have that many dishes at home, you couldn’t have washed them all, could you?” Zhang Yuxin asked doubtfully.
“Yeah, I washed them all. I want to turn them into a beautiful scene!” Lin Yi said seriously.
“A painting of what?” Zhang Yuxin asked.
Lin Yi didn’t answer Zhang Yuxin but instead, dumped the leftovers from the dishes into the trash, then reached his hands under the tap.
“Whoosh”
Water flowed over Lin Yi’s hands, quickly wetting his sleeves.
“Lin Yi, what are you doing? Take your hands out quickly!” Seeing this, Zhang Yuxin hurried over to Lin Yi’s side.
“I’m rinsing the dishes!” Lin Yi explained.
“You’re crazy, it’s so cold, why are you washing dishes! Take your hands out, I’ll get you a clean set of clothes, what if you catch a cold!” Zhang Yuxin grabbed Lin Yi’s arm, persistently persuading him.
“No worries! I’m not cold, I feel quite warm actually, not cold at all!” Lin Yi said.
“How can that be, you’re not even wearing a top right now!” Zhang Yuxin said anxiously.
“I’m really not cold, truly, I’m just wearing shorts right now!” Lin Yi explained with a grin.
“No way! I can’t let you stay in the fridge, I have to take you out!”
Having said that, Zhang Yuxin grabbed Lin Yi’s arm, pulled him out of the kitchen, and came to the door outside.
“Lin Yi, don’t move!” Zhang Yuxin rolled up Lin Yi’s sleeve and found that his elbow was already showing bruises. She quickly grasped Lin Yi’s arm and said, “What happened to your arm?”
Only then did Lin Yi notice the bruising on his elbow, and he immediately frowned, cursing inwardly, “Damn! How did I bruise my elbow, what if it scars, my good looks would be ruined!”
Looking at Zhang Yuxin, Lin Yi chuckled and comforted her, “It’s okay, just a minor injury, it’ll heal in a few days! Don’t worry!”
“What do you mean ‘just a minor injury’? It looks quite serious, and it doesn’t seem light!” Zhang Yuxin glared at Lin Yi, then said.
“Really, it’s nothing!” Lin Yi said with a shake of his head and a smile.
“You don’t believe me, let me show you!” Zhang Yuxin said, then she placed Lin Yi’s arm on her shoulder and turned it over.
There was a deep bite mark on Lin Yi’s arm. Seeing the bite mark, Zhang Yuxin’s expression turned sour. She bit her teeth together, looking at Lin Yi with a face full of sorrow.
With a helpless expression, Lin Yi had no choice but to expose the injured area to Zhang Yuxin.
“So ugly!” Looking at Lin Yi’s wound, Zhang Yuxin couldn’t help but comment.
“Miss Zhang, don’t be picky, the wound really isn’t a big deal,” Lin Yi said.
“No, we must get this treated at the hospital! Otherwise, it will definitely leave a scar!” Zhang Yuxin said seriously, her concern for Lin Yi genuine.
Lin Yi thought for a moment. Though his wound didn’t hurt, it was itchy and uncomfortable, so he had no choice but to say, “Alright then, since you insist, let’s go to the hospital!”
Upon hearing this, Zhang Yuxin’s heart leaped with joy. She quickly grabbed Lin Yi’s hand and ran out of the house, wanting to get him treated at the hospital as soon as possible.
“Miss Zhang, slow down! I can’t keep up with you!” Lin Yi said.
“No problem!”
Zhang Yuxin held Lin Yi’s hand and sped up towards the door, both of them dashing along, quickly reaching the bus stop and hailing a car to get on.
“Driver, please take us to the nearest hospital, thank you!” Zhang Yuxin told the driver.
“Oh! Okay!” the driver said, pressing the gas pedal and heading towards the city.
Inside the car, neither Lin Yi nor Zhang Yuxin spoke, remaining silent the entire way.
“Lin Yi, how did you get hurt?” Suddenly, Zhang Yuxin broke the calm.
“Uh… I went to a bar and ended up running into a gang of thugs robbing the place. They took my wallet and ID, so I called the police on them, and they were caught. At that moment, some people attacked me from behind, and one of them kicked me, and that’s how this happened!” Lin Yi answered indifferently.
Zhang Yuxin was shocked by Lin Yi’s words, as she had never imagined that Lin Yi would encounter such danger, nearly getting kidnapped.
It makes sense though; a handsome guy like Lin Yi, with his dashing looks, would attract attention wherever he went. It was not surprising that he could inadvertently provoke a criminal, but thankfully, he wasn’t kidnapped, or he might have ended up dead at the hands of those thugs.
“I was really scared to death, do you know that? I was so frightened just now!” Zhang Yuxin said, patting her chest.
“I was scared too!” Lin Yi said.
“Alright, let’s not talk about this anymore. Sit tight and don’t move!”
“Okay.”
Lin Yi did as told and sat on the seat without fidgeting any further.
“Lin Yi, do you have money right now?” Zhang Yuxin asked.
“Yeah. Why, are you going to buy medicine for me?”
“Not to buy medicine, to see a doctor for you!”
“To see a doctor for me when my wound is already healed?”
“You are injured, you need treatment!”
“Then let’s go to the hospital!”
“Your wound has already scabbed over, there’s really no need for a hospital!”
“But I still have other things to do! I can’t just stay at home with this wound, that would be too boring, and it would also be a waste of money. So, I must find something to do, or else, wouldn’t I go mad from boredom?”
“Don’t worry about that. I’ll find you a job. I’ll arrange everything for you, just focus on your recovery. I’ll take care of your work!”
“Okay, go ahead and arrange it! I’ll be fine!”
Zhang Yuxin didn’t say anything else but turned her head and looked out the window, pondering something—what exactly caused Lin Yi’s injury. Could it really have been those robbers? Or was there something more? She felt certain that Lin Yi was hiding something from her.
“Lin Yi, I have to ask you something. Tell me the truth!” Zhang Yuxin suddenly turned her head and looked at Lin Yi.
“What is it?”
“Did you inflict that wound on yourself?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was stunned, not expecting Zhang Yuxin to suddenly ask such a question. But he quickly recovered and said, “I cut it myself, what about it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 606: 606: I Will Take Good Care of Myself
chapters.content:
Chapter 606: Chapter 606: I Will Take Good Care of Myself
“How could you do something like this? Don’t you know it could have been life-threatening?” Zhang Yuxin asked angrily.
“Hehe, I’m not a child, of course I understand the danger. Look, I’m fine, aren’t I? Besides, the knife wound wasn’t serious; see, I’m still jumping around,” Lin Yi said with a laugh.
“Hmph, you knew it was dangerous but you still didn’t listen to my advice. What if something had happened to you?” Zhang Yuxin said reproachfully.
Hearing this, Lin Yi was deeply moved. He looked at Zhang Yuxin and said, “Miss Zhang, you really are a kind-hearted girl. I will remember your help for the rest of my life!”
“I don’t need you to remember me. I just hope you won’t take any more risks in the future!” Zhang Yuxin said with a pout.
“Hehe, don’t worry, I absolutely won’t put myself in danger again. I will definitely take good care of myself and stay safe!” Lin Yi said with a smile.
...
“Good! I’ll bandage your hand first, but you mustn’t move, okay?” Zhang Yuxin said, taking a bottle of iodine solution from the car, followed by a roll of gauze, and began to bandage Lin Yi’s arm.
Zhang Yuxin’s movements were very gentle; while bandaging, her tone was as tender as if she were speaking to a loved one.
Lin Yi felt very sweet inside, but he deliberately said, “Ouch, Miss Zhang, that hurts. Be gentler, please!”
“Oh, I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’ll be gentler!”
“Ow, Miss Zhang, why are you being so forceful? Isn’t this like murdering your own husband?” Lin Yi cried out, pretending to be in pain.
“It’s your own fault for being reckless. I told you not to move and you just wouldn’t listen!” Zhang Yuxin gave Lin Yi a white look and said.
“Alright, alright, I was wrong!”
Lin Yi said and then shut his mouth, putting on a pitiful face as if he really was in great pain, and even more, he began rubbing his right arm.
“There, done!”
“Thank you, Miss Zhang. You really are too kind!” Lin Yi opened his eyes and praised her with a beaming smile.
“Don’t flatter yourself. Hurry up and take off your clothes!” Zhang Yuxin said with a blushed face, clearly uncomfortable with this kind of talk, which was why she blushed.
“You want me to take off my clothes?” Lin Yi pointed to himself.
“What else? Are you going to undress yourself, or shall I help you?” Zhang Yuxin said, while she lifted the medicine powder in her hand in a threatening manner, “If you want to keep feeling pain, I can oblige!”
“Fine, fine, I’ll do it myself!”
Seeing Zhang Yuxin with a teasing smile on her face, Lin Yi did not tease her any further. He began unbuttoning his suit, revealing his muscular chest.
“Wow!”
Upon seeing Lin Yi’s chest, Zhang Yuxin couldn’t help but exclaim, having never seen such a majestic and impressive chest. Her eyes were glued to Lin Yi’s pectorals, imagining what it might feel like to touch them with her own hands.
“Have you seen enough?” Lin Yi teased as he caught Zhang Yuxin’s gaze sweeping over his chest.
“What’s there to look at? I’m admiring, okay? Don’t you know the difference?” Zhang Yuxin glared at Lin Yi and thought to herself, why are you so annoying? I said I was admiring and you have to remind me. So annoying!
“Haha, I really like you when you’re like this. I wonder if Miss Zhang likes it as well?” Lin Yi asked with a mischievous smile.
“Like my foot! You hoodlum, just put your clothes on!” Zhang Yuxin’s face turned even redder with Lin Yi’s teasing.
“Haha!”
Lin Yi’s laughter spread down the street, and Zhang Yuxin’s face became as red as an apple.
The two engaged in a playful verbal spar, laughing and talking all the way, creating a harmonious atmosphere. At that moment, Zhang Yuxin felt that she was very close to Lin Yi, perhaps even a hint of romance between them.
“What are you two talking about?”
Just then, a puzzled voice suddenly came from behind Zhang Yuxin.
Hearing this, Lin Yi and Zhang Yuxin both turned to look behind them, only to find that the van parked behind them had come to a stop, and four young men had gotten out. Among them, a slim youth upon seeing Zhang Yuxin and Lin Yi’s faces, showed a look of amazement, his eyes not willing to move away for even a second, as he stared at Zhang Yuxin with infatuation.
“Who are these people?”
Lin Yi and Zhang Yuxin exchanged glances, both displaying confused expressions.
They had never seen these four people before.
“Excuse me, young man, can I help you with something?” Lin Yi asked.
“You’re Lin Yi, right? We’re sent by the mayor to supervise your treatment. We hope you will cooperate with our work!” said the slim youth.
“Oh, so you’re sent by the mayor. Where will you be taking me for treatment?” Lin Yi asked quickly.
“We will take you to the hospital, your injuries need to be dealt with promptly to avoid infection,” the slim youth replied.
“Is that so? But, I’ve already bandaged my hand and I can walk too!” Lin Yi said.
“No, you must go to the hospital immediately!” insisted the slim youth as he pushed Lin Yi towards the van without further explanation.
“Hey, what are you doing? I still need to take a bus to the city,” protested Lin Yi.
“Take a bus? With your injuries, you definitely can’t take a bus, you must go to the hospital immediately!”
“Then… then… I’ll just go to the hospital with you guys!” Lin Yi finally conceded.
At that moment, Zhang Yuxin also hurried over and said to Lin Yi, “Brother Lin Yi, you shouldn’t go. I would feel so guilty if you were seriously hurt!”
Hearing Zhang Yuxin’s words of concern, Lin Yi felt warmth in his heart, but he still refused her, saying, “Don’t worry, I’m aware of my own body. My physical strength is many times that of an ordinary person, so this little injury is nothing to me!”
“You…”
Zhang Yuxin, seeing Lin Yi’s stubbornness, didn’t know what to say and could only sigh helplessly.
“Wait a minute, I still have things to buy!”
Seeing this, Lin Yi quickly spoke up and then turned to enter the mall.
“This guy is really an oddball, even has that kind of quirk!” the slim youth muttered, shaking his head in disdain, as he watched Lin Yi’s disappearing figure.
“Don’t mind it too much. Let’s hurry to the hospital!” the tall and beautiful lady urged.
“Okay!” the slim youth nodded.
Soon, the three of them drove to the hospital and found a hospital room, ready for Lin Yi to receive treatment there.
“Lin Yi, I’ll wait for you outside. If you need anything, just call us. My name is Wang Haitao, this is my colleague Li Mingliang, and this is our boss’s daughter, Zhang Yuxin. Zhang Yuxin, this is my business card,” a young man in a suit and wearing gold-rimmed glasses said as he handed his business card to Lin Yi.
“Thank you, but you can just wait outside the door for me; I’m not used to having people come in, I’d feel uncomfortable,” Lin Yi said with a slight smile, politely declining Wang Haitao’s offer.
“That… okay then,” Wang Haitao did not insist, understanding that it wasn’t appropriate to enter a stranger’s room.

chapters.title: Chapter 607: Not Allowed to Go Anywhere
chapters.content:
Chapter 607: Chapter 607: Not Allowed to Go Anywhere
Wang Haitao and Li Mingliang exited the room, and only then did Lin Yi close the door behind them.
“Lin Yi, that person seemed pretty fierce; I’m worried you will be at a disadvantage!” Zhang Yuxin expressed her concern.
“Don’t worry, I have my ways,” Lin Yi said with a smile. “Alright, don’t fret anymore. I’m going to change my clothes and then head out. My mission this time is to ensure your safety, so you must stay in the ward, don’t go anywhere, understand?”
“Mhm, you can count on me, Lin Yi! I understand!” Zhang Yuxin nodded repeatedly, her expression growing solemn.
Seeing Zhang Yuxin obediently nod in agreement eased Lin Yi’s concerns. He turned and entered the bedroom, took off his clothes, and changed into a white lab coat.
After that, Lin Yi locked the room from the inside and then picked up a black cloth bag from under the bed. He opened it and took out a silver needle, then pulled out another one.
...
Lin Yi first dropped a speck of blood into the silver needle, and then, with a squeeze, the needle suddenly shot out a dazzling golden light.
“Such impressive needling techniques, this must be the legendary ‘Five Poison Gold Needles’, right?”
Zhang Yuxin was incredibly shocked by this scene. She didn’t expect that Lin Yi would have such exquisite acupuncture skills, making it no wonder he dared to claim he was immune to all poisons.
“Indeed, it is the Five Poison Gold Needles. I’ve tested it a few times, and the effects are quite remarkable. Unfortunately, my Inner Strength is still too weak, so for now, I can only unleash half of its potential,” Lin Yi said, a hint of disappointment showing on his face.
“But that’s enough!” Lin Yi put away the silver needle, then dressed neatly and walked out of the bedroom to Zhang Yuxin’s side. He took her small hand, “Yuxin, just stay here, don’t go out!”
“But I’m worried something will happen to you!” Zhang Yuxin still seemed very concerned.
“It’s okay, nothing will happen to me!” Lin Yi reassured her with a slight smile. “Now, don’t worry!”
After speaking, Lin Yi, holding Zhang Yuxin’s hand, left the room and headed to the hospital’s first-floor lobby.
At the moment, the lobby was crowded with many patients.
Lin Yi and Zhang Yuxin attracted quite a bit of attention as they made their way through.
This was the hospital’s first-floor lobby, bustling not only with patients and doctors but also with nurses and other medical staff. Their responsibilities included conducting physical examinations and treating illnesses and also helping patients check for various medical conditions.
“Eh? Aren’t you that guy called Lin Yi?”
“Yeah, what’s he doing here?”
“I don’t know what he’s up to, but it looks like he’s sick, or else he wouldn’t come to the hospital!”
Patients who looked rather ill started to talk among themselves upon seeing Lin Yi.
Lin Yi ignored their comments and approached a registration desk, asking, “Nurse, hello, I’d like to have a full body check-up, could you please arrange that for me?”
“What kind of examination would you like?” a nurse asked.
“A full body check-up,” Lin Yi replied. “I don’t have any issues with my body, but I don’t know why I suddenly fainted. I want to check if there’s something wrong with my brain or if I’m injured. This way, patients can be treated early and prevent the condition from worsening!”
“Are you sure you want to do this full body check-up?” the nurse asked again.
“Yes, I’m sure. How much will it cost?”
“Let me ask first how much you need. Just let me know the amount, and I’ll contact other specialists to see if they’re willing to do the test for you!”
“Hmm, thank you. Here’s eight hundred yuan, please take it for now. I will come to pay later!” Lin Yi handed eight hundred yuan to the nurse.
At that moment, Zhang Yuxin also came over and asked, “Lin Yi, are you really okay? Don’t lie to me!”
Lin Yi touched Zhang Yuxin’s forehead and said, “Silly, your brother Lin Yi’s body is so great, there’s definitely no problem. Don’t worry!”
“Brother Lin Yi, then you must be careful! Don’t let your body get any hurt!” Zhang Yuxin said, “You have to take care of yourself!”
“Yeah, don’t worry, I will!” Lin Yi patted Zhang Yuxin’s shoulder.
“By the way, Brother Lin Yi, my body also has no problems, so why did I faint?” Zhang Yuxin asked doubtfully, “Could it be because of the night I got drunk?”
“How could there be anything wrong with your body? I’ve checked it already!” Lin Yi said with a slight smile.
“Then what exactly happened?” Zhang Yuxin questioned, “Could someone have ambushed me?”
“I’d like to know who did it as well!” Lin Yi snorted coldly, his eyes flashing with intense killing intent.
“Brother Lin Yi, I think you should see a doctor to check your body; you might find something unexpected!” Zhang Yuxin reminded Lin Yi.
“Okay, I’ll go later!” Lin Yi nodded slightly, already pondering his next move.
Lin Yi and Zhang Yuxin chatted together on the way to the payment counter.
“The two of you, may I ask which check-up you would like to have?” a nurse walked up to Lin Yi and Zhang Yuxin and inquired.
“Hello, we would like to have a full body check-up!” Lin Yi responded.
“Alright, follow me please,” the nurse nodded and headed to one side, leading Lin Yi and Zhang Yuxin towards a consultation room.
Inside the consultation room, several doctors were seated; they were the doctors the nurse mentioned earlier.
“Are you Lin Yi?” one of the doctors asked, looking at Lin Yi.
“Yes!” Lin Yi nodded.
“Then stretch out your hand!” the doctor instructed Lin Yi.
Lin Yi stretched out his right hand.
“Do you have a birthmark on your wrist?” the doctor studied Lin Yi’s wrist carefully before asking.
“Hmm, I’m not sure what it is, I’ve been feeling somewhat uncomfortable lately. I thought it was an overdose of medication, but now I don’t know the reason!” Lin Yi shook his head.
“Oh? When did you get this birthmark?” another doctor asked.
“About more than a year ago,” Lin Yi thought for a moment, then answered.
“How long has this birthmark been there, can you tell me?”
“I’m not quite sure; it’s like it appeared out of nowhere. Sometimes it suddenly shows up on my left arm, and sometimes it hides itself!” Lin Yi explained.
“This birthmark is no simple matter; it’s an unusual phenomenon, which indicates it could very well be some kind of special curse spell. If you cannot remove this birthmark soon, it might affect your lifespan!”
“A curse?” Lin Yi’s face changed slightly upon hearing this, but then he regained his composure and asked, “Doctor, do you think there will be any danger in removing this birthmark?”
“That wouldn’t be the case!” the doctor said, “But your birthmark might not be something you want to keep around!”
“Should I leave this city immediately, get far away from this place?” Lin Yi frowned and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 608: The Situation Isn't Too Serious
chapters.content:
Chapter 608: Chapter 608: The Situation Isn’t Too Serious
At this time, Zhang Yuxin hurriedly said, “Lin Yi, brother, you can’t leave. Don’t you want to find that person? If you leave, who will you look for?”
“But, this birthmark, if it stays by my side, it’s really detrimental to me!” Lin Yi said.
“Don’t worry, if you leave, something might happen, but if you stay in this city, it might be very safe!” Zhang Yuxin said.
“But…” Lin Yi wanted to say something else.
“That’s decided then!” At this moment, the doctor who had been quiet suddenly spoke up, “From now on, just stay here for the time being, I will treat you!”
“But, this birthmark of mine, if it continues to stay on my body, I’m afraid I…” Lin Yi said.
...
The doctor shook his head and said, “It’s okay, as long as you listen to me and don’t mess with it, your condition isn’t too serious and won’t affect your cultivation!”
“Well, okay, then I’ll trouble you, anyhow, I must thank you!” Lin Yi thought about it and ultimately couldn’t bear to refuse the doctor’s kindness.
“Hmm, since you agree, then do as I say. Later, I will do a checkup for you, but I suggest you first go to the lab for a physical examination to ensure your body is unharmed!”
“Okay!”
“Sir, may I know your surname? My name is Wang Wenqiang, I am the chief physician at this medical research institute!” The doctor said with a slight smile as he introduced himself.
“Dr. Wang, hello, my name is Lin Yi!” Lin Yi said.
“Good, then let’s go to the lab for tests first, in this way, you don’t have to worry about your condition!” Dr. Wang said with a light smile.
“Hmm!” Lin Yi nodded and followed behind Dr. Wang, walking towards the outside.
During this time, Zhang Yuxin tightly clutched the corner of Lin Yi’s clothes. Obviously, she was also afraid of losing Lin Yi, so she was very worried that something would happen to him and did not dare to let go.
Lin Yi knew that Zhang Yuxin was worried about him, so he didn’t pull his arm away, letting her hold onto him.
Lin Yi and Dr. Wang arrived at the lab.
“Doctor, please give my friend a full body examination, my body doesn’t have any abnormalities!” Lin Yi said to the young man.
“Hmm, no problem!”
“Then I’ll be troubling you, Dr. Wang!”
Lin Yi said, and after that, the three of them entered a room and underwent a series of examinations.
After the examination, Dr. Wang pulled out a report and handed it to Lin Yi.
“Congratulations, you have had a three-year pregnancy experience, and the birthmark on your body has been contaminated by your blood, which needs to be immediately removed!” Dr. Wang looked at Lin Yi and said gravely.
“Three years of pregnancy experience?” Lin Yi’s face changed slightly upon hearing this, “Dr. Wang, are you sure I have had a three-year pregnancy experience?”
“Hmm, I have detected it. If I’m not mistaken, someone executed an evil method on you around the age of four or five, which changed your physique and caused you to have this birthmark at that age,” Dr. Wang nodded and said.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s face showed a look of surprise.
He had not expected that he actually got pregnant around the age of five or six.
“How did you get pregnant?” Dr. Wang asked.
“I don’t remember, I only remember that I lost my memory in a car accident and then have been recuperating in the hospital ever since!” Lin Yi said.
“Hmm, so, have you remembered anything? For instance, do you have any special items on you?”
“Special items?” Lin Yi muttered thoughtfully, then said, “I don’t have special items on me, there are only two exceptional things that I possess. One is the ‘Xuanming Divine Skill’ manuscript, which I have cultivated to the Seventh Layer but could not progress any further, and the other is this jade amulet on my body!”
“What? A jade amulet?” Dr. Wang’s eyes widened in surprise.
“Yes, a jade amulet!” Lin Yi nodded.
“Alright, I understand, I’ll remove that birthmark for you right now!” Dr. Wang said.
“Thank you, Dr. Wang!”
“No problem, it’s a small effort!” Dr. Wang smiled, “I’ll start treating you now, and I hope you can cooperate with me!”
Lin Yi nodded in response.
“This is a Pain-Relieving Needle. You can keep it in your mouth; it will help ease the pain,” Dr. Wang handed over a needle.
Lin Yi took the needle, bit his finger to squeeze out a drop of blood, placed it between his teeth, and then swallowed the needle.
This needle was made from the gall of a rare, poisonous snake. Its gall had a strong medicinal effect against pain. As long as the toxins were absorbed and combined with the Pain-Relieving Needle, Lin Yi wouldn’t have to endure so much pain.
And Lin Yi could use the Pain-Relieving Needle to alleviate the pain in his body.
“Lin Yi, I have removed the birthmark for you, but I need to perform a full body examination on you again!”
“Okay!” Lin Yi complied, and Dr. Wang began to examine him.
Dr. Wang took his stethoscope and examined Lin Yi’s physical condition carefully.
Half a minute later.
“Dr. Wang, how is my physical condition?” Lin Yi inquired.
“Lin Yi, although I’ve removed your birthmark, your body is in very poor condition. I suggest that you don’t take any medication during this time, as it could easily harm your health,” Dr. Wang said.
“Dr. Wang, does this mean my body can’t heal?” Lin Yi was startled at this revelation.
Dr. Wang fell silent for a moment, then sighed and shook his head, “I’m sorry, Lin Yi, this is the first time I’ve encountered such symptoms, so I’m really helpless!”
“Then, Dr. Wang, do you know of any physicians or traditional Chinese medicine practitioners with exceptional skills who could take a look at me?” Lin Yi asked.
“For a condition like yours, I suggest you seek out people from the Ancient Martial Arts Families of Huaxia; they might be able to help you!” Dr. Wang advised.
“People from the Ancient Martial Arts Families of Huaxia… I don’t know many of them. Besides, they live in seclusion in the deep mountains, not exactly places where I can see them whenever I wish,” Lin Yi frowned and said.
“Lin Yi, although the people from Ancient Martial Arts Families of Huaxia rarely show themselves, they all share one characteristic – they are extremely protective of their own. If you seek them out, I believe you should be able to meet them,” Dr. Wang said.
“Dr. Wang, I want to know whether my condition can recover,” Lin Yi asked.
