Dr. Wang pondered for a moment and then spoke, “I think with a condition like yours, it’s best to regulate your body as soon as possible, otherwise the consequences will be very serious.”
“How serious could the consequences be?” Lin Yi asked.
“Lin Yi, I can’t say for sure right now, but you’d better seek advice from other traditional Chinese medicine practitioners, they should be able to help you!” Dr. Wang said.
“Okay, then please arrange it for me quickly, so that I can recover as soon as possible!” Lin Yi said.

chapters.title: Chapter 609: Contact as Soon as Possible
chapters.content:
Chapter 609: Chapter 609: Contact as Soon as Possible
Doctor Wang nodded, “Okay, I will contact them as soon as possible!”
Afterward, Doctor Wang led Lin Yi out of the medical office.
Once Doctor Wang had left, Lin Yi immediately took out the small bottle of Pain-Relieving Needles that Doctor Wang had given him.
Lin Yi poured out one, held it up to his nose, and sniffed, discovering a fragrance that was refreshingly overwhelming, quite pleasant indeed.
“Hmm, how fragrant!” Lin Yi nodded and said.
Then, Lin Yi put away the Pain-Relieving Needle and, after storing it, couldn’t help but feel puzzled, “What kind of effect will this Pain-Relieving Needle have on my birthmark?”
...
“Ah, let’s not worry about it for now, once I’ve recovered my strength, everything will be resolved smoothly!” Lin Yi muttered to himself.
In the following days, Lin Yi stayed in Doctor Wang’s office, waiting for the treatment to end.
During these days, Lin Yi didn’t go to school; he stayed in the hospital, waiting for the Pain-Relieving Needle given by Doctor Wang to take effect.
The Pain-Relieving Needle had been made from a peculiar herb juice, and after consuming it, Lin Yi felt the pain throughout his body substantially lessen.
This herb juice was also quite remarkable. After consuming it, the places on Lin Yi’s body which had been irritated by his birthmark actually began to heal.
These healed areas made Lin Yi feel extremely refreshed, very comfortable.
And Lin Yi had benefited a lot from this Pain-Relieving Needle, gaining a deeper understanding of his own strength.
Lin Yi’s realm had already reached the peak of the Earth Rank ninth level.
Under normal circumstances, to break through the peak of the Earth Rank ninth level, one must consume those precious herbs, but now, Lin Yi could directly swallow Elixirs to advance his realm by leaps and bounds!
Lin Yi’s realm had now firmly stabilized at the peak of the Earth Rank ninth level.
“Hmm, it looks like I need to hurry up and refine some Elixirs!” Lin Yi said, “This Golden Core is still not completely integrated. If I can refine all of its properties, my strength will reach the Heavenly Rank Realm!”
Once he breaks through to the Heavenly Rank Realm, his strength will definitely become even more formidable, and he might even possess moves that surpass Heavenly Rank Martial Arts. By then, even when facing an average Heavenly Rank Martial Artist, he would not have the slightest fear!
Lin Yi decided to focus on refining the Golden Core during this time.
Lin Yi stayed in the medical room overnight, and early the next day, he returned to school.
That night, he didn’t waste any time, cultivating furiously in his room.
Every day, he would refine some Elixirs to increase his Inner Strength, and in this process, he gradually mastered certain subtleties.
“Huff!”
Lin Yi exhaled loudly, the Gang Qi in his body circulated, and a scorching aura burst forth from his Dantian.
“Huff!”
Lin Yi’s figure flashed, and he disappeared on the spot.
When Lin Yi’s figure reappeared, he had already reached the third floor and had entered the Cultivation Room.
In the Cultivation Room, Lin Yi sat cross-legged on the ground, a faint mist swirling around inside his body, his skin glowing translucent and lustrous like jade, astonishingly beautiful!
Inside Lin Yi’s body, that golden sphere continued to spin.
Outside Lin Yi’s body, floated a layer of light cyan mist.
This light cyan mist was the True Qi Lin Yi had cultivated.
At this moment, Lin Yi’s strength had already reached the peak of the Heavenly Rank seventh level.
If other martial artists witnessed this scene, they would be utterly astonished.
Heavenly Rank Level Seven Peak!
In Hua Country, this could be considered the mark of a genius. Yet, Lin Yi was only twenty-five years old and had achieved such remarkable feats. How could other martial artists bear this?
Moreover, the current Lin Yi wasn’t even using any special moves or techniques.
The martial arts Lin Yi had previously used were the most basic, but even these simple moves were terrifyingly powerful.
Lin Yi now understood that the birthmark on his body was definitely a treasure!
Lin Yi’s mind gradually immersed in the golden orb located at his dantian.
Inside the golden orb, the golden elixir was emitting bursts of golden light, which continuously struck Lin Yi’s body, making him feel extremely comfortable.
“Boom!”
Suddenly, at that moment, the golden orb in Lin Yi’s dantian began to shake violently, and a golden beam of light shot up from the orb, smashing the chandelier on the ceiling into powder, scattering it down.
Above the golden orb, strands of golden light began to emerge continuously, eventually condensing into auspicious clouds that circled and danced above the orb.
“Eh? What’s going on? Why is there such a change all of a sudden?”
Lin Yi, feeling the changes coming from the golden orb, was slightly stunned.
The golden orb was drawn from the Spiritual Spring Pool inside the Dragon Ring Space, and the golden energy contained within was extremely rich, a coveted treasure for all artifact refiners.
Moreover, the energy within the golden orb was vast, enough to support a martial artist’s cultivation.
The material of this golden orb was extraordinary as well, woven from the Golden Silkworm Thread spat out by golden silkworms—it could protect martial artists and also withstand their attacks!
Lin Yi hadn’t expected that this period of closed-door cultivation would bring such tremendous benefits.
At this moment, Lin Yi was filled with anticipation for the golden orb.
This golden orb was an invaluable treasure of the Refining Sect!
Just then, a rumbling sound suddenly erupted, and the auspicious clouds hanging in mid-air gathered toward Lin Yi, eventually merging into the space between his eyebrows.
In that instant, a golden vertical eye appeared between Lin Yi’s brows!
“What is this!?” Lin Yi exclaimed in surprise.
He felt as if there was something new in his mind, but couldn’t quite grasp what it was, retaining only a vague impression.
“Could this be the Artifact Refining Technique of the Refining Sect? No! Although the Refining Sect’s techniques are powerful, they couldn’t have turned this golden orb into an eye, could they?” Lin Yi murmured to himself.
Afterward, Lin Yi opened his eyes and carefully observed his body.
At this time, Lin Yi felt his body was much lighter than before, as though he possessed endless strength.
Lin Yi extended his left hand and swept it through the air, and then he felt gusts of wind slashing through the air, making “whoosh whoosh whoosh” sounds.
“So powerful!” Lin Yi said excitedly, “This golden orb actually made my body even tougher!”
Even Lin Yi was surprised to discover that his body seemed to have undergone a qualitative change!
“Is this the Artifact Refining Technique passed down by the Refining Sect? Truly impressive!” Lin Yi thought to himself with admiration.
“Big brother Lin Yi!”
At that moment, Lin Yi heard the sound of Xiao Lin calling out to him. He turned his head to see Xiao Lin rushing in from outside.

chapters.title: Chapter 610 - 610 Striving to Cultivate
chapters.content:
Chapter 610: Chapter 610 Striving to Cultivate
Seeing Lin Yi, Xiao Lin immediately ran over in delight and threw herself into Lin Yi’s arms, hugging him and said with a smile, “Lin Yi, brother, you’re really amazing! You actually managed to break through to the seventh level of the heaven stage and reached the peak of the seventh level of the heaven stage!”
“Aren’t you also about to break through the eighth level of the heaven stage soon?” Lin Yi stroked Xiao Lin’s head, saying with a smile.
“Hehe.” Xiao Lin giggled bashfully.
“By the way, Lin Yi, brother, I heard from outside just now that you are a Martial Artist! And apparently, a genius too? Is that true?”
Lin Yi nodded and said, “It’s true, I indeed am a Martial Artist. I don’t know if you believe that or not.”
“Wow! Lin Yi, brother, you’re really too awesome! In that case, could Lin Yi, brother, actually exchange blows with Grandpa?”
...
“However, I’ve heard that Grandpa is an Innate Martial Saint and he is currently breaking through the Martial King Realm! Lin Yi, brother, you’re still one step behind though. But still, you’re really strong now!”
Xiao Lin, brimming with excitement, pulled Lin Yi along, bouncing and hopping around.
Looking at Xiao Lin’s happy face, Lin Yi couldn’t help but smile and also felt a touch of pride swell in his heart.
“Xiao Lin, in the future, you must practice hard like me and strive to break through to the Innate Martial Saint Realm as soon as possible! That way, the two of us can help Grandpa!” Lin Yi said.
“Yes, I will definitely practice hard!” Xiao Lin nodded vigorously.
After playing with Xiao Lin for a few more minutes, Lin Yi set her down and reminded her to practice diligently.
“Yes, I will try hard,” Xiao Lin nodded.
“Speaking of which, where did you run off to earlier? Why couldn’t I find you after searching for so long?” Lin Yi asked.
“I went to take a bath, and then I went off to sleep!”
As she said this, Xiao Lin suddenly covered her mouth and exclaimed, “Ah! I forgot to change my clothes! Lin Yi, brother, I’ll put on some clothes right away, I’m going to take a bath!”
Xiao Lin ran out the door, and in a little while, she came running back.
Seeing Xiao Lin like this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but laugh.
“Lin Yi, brother, let’s go out to eat!”
“Yeah, sure.” Lin Yi nodded in agreement.
Afterward, Lin Yi and Xiao Lin together went out of the bedroom and headed towards the dining establishment outside.
“By the way, Lin Yi, brother, do you want to have a cup of tea and rest a bit first?”
“No need, I’m not thirsty,” Lin Yi shook his head. “Let’s hurry and go.”
“Okay.”
Xiao Lin nodded, looped her arm through Lin Yi’s, and the two headed towards the stairway entrance.
The architecture of this villa was very quaint and elegant. Along the way, there was moss everywhere, and the walls were overgrown with green vines. The whole villa had an ancient charm and seemed to carry a sense of time-worn beauty.
At that moment, Xiao Lin suddenly stopped, pointed at a door ahead, and said excitedly, “Lin Yi, brother, that’s a snack shop near our school—it has really great flavors!”
Saying this, Xiao Lin pulled Lin Yi over.
Lin Yi followed Xiao Lin, arriving in front of this small shop that was decorated with an old charm.
“Welcome!”
At that moment, a uniformed waitress approached with a sweet smile and spoke to Lin Yi and Xiao Lin.
“Lin Yi, brother, look how busy our shop is. This is the most special food in our town!” Xiao Lin said proudly as she explained.
“Alright, Xiao Lin, no need to keep praising this place,” Lin Yi shook his head, then moved aside and sat down, looked at the waitress with a smile and inquired, “May I know if you have your shop’s signature dish? I’d like to try your shop’s signature dish, is that possible?”
“Of course, that’s possible,” the waitress nodded. “Please wait a moment.”
Then, the waitress went out and not long after, she brought back an old woman.
“Esteemed guest, here is the signature dish you ordered, our restaurant’s specially prepared ‘Candied Pork Knuckle’ for our distinguished customers. Please enjoy your meal,” the old lady said respectfully as she handed the menu to Lin Yi.
“Hmm,” Lin Yi nodded, took the menu, flipped through it, and then began to order.
“Hello, I’d like five pounds of poached chicken, a plate of braised pork, a serving of spicy hot pot, and a bowl of soup,” he instructed the waiter.
After Lin Yi finished ordering, he instructed the server.
“Please wait a moment, sir. I’ll go to the kitchen and prepare it right away.”
With that, the server left the private room.
Afterwards, the room quieted down.
Weiwei looked at the dishes on the table, suddenly feeling ravenous, and couldn’t help but swallow her saliva.
“Weiwei, want to eat?”
Seeing Weiwei’s famished appearance, Lin Yi asked with a smile.
“Yes!” Weiwei nodded vigorously.
Lin Yi smiled faintly and picked up a piece of chicken with chopsticks, placing it into Weiwei’s mouth.
“Mmm! Delicious!” Weiwei chewed vigorously, saying happily.
“The signature dishes here really do taste amazing!”
As she spoke, Weiwei kept serving Lin Yi food, happily eating.
Lin Yi burst into laughter, touched by the affectionate scene, feeling an infinite warmth in his heart and a sense of happiness in being cared for.
“Alright, Weiwei, don’t eat so fast, take your time,” Lin Yi said, patting Weiwei on the shoulder indulgently.
“Uh-huh,” Weiwei obediently agreed.
Then, the two continued to eat.
Weiwei’s way of eating was as adorable as ever, like a greedy little kitty, enjoying the food immensely and eating to her heart’s content.
Lin Yi chuckled and began to enjoy his meal in earnest.
At that moment, as Weiwei watched Lin Yi eat with relish, she too swallowed her saliva, her eyes wide with anticipation, staring at Lin Yi enthralled by the sight, as if he were an incredibly handsome man, captivatng her attention.
Lin Yi ate quickly, devouring the food with great speed; in no time, the table was stacked with a great variety of dishes.
“Yummy,” Weiwei smiled gleefully and then stood up, ready to clear the plates.
Lin Yi quickly stopped Weiwei’s action, saying, “Let me handle this. You go watch TV, and I’ll have it cleaned up in a bit.”
“Okay, Lin Yi, you are so amazing,” Weiwei nodded, saying, “Then I’ll go watch TV. Make sure to finish all this food, there are a hundred and fifty-six dishes here, and you’ve swept them all up!”
Lin Yi nodded with a smile and proceeded to clear the plates.
Once Lin Yi had everything tidied up, he finally sat down and began to enjoy the deliciousness Weiwei had brought.
The meal took a full half Hour.
After eating many delicious dishes and feeling full, Lin Yi prepared to pay the bill and leave.
It was then that Weiwei suddenly called out, “Lin Yi, there are eighteen thousand yuan on your bank card, but you have to pay three times the amount first!”
Lin Yi nodded and took out the bank card from his pocket, handing it to Weiwei.
Weiwei looked at the bank card in Lin Yi’s hand, hesitating to take it.
She did like money, but she wasn’t a spendthrift. She never spent money recklessly, as her parents gave her an allowance.
So, she didn’t rush to use the card, but instead asked, “Lin Yi, there are eighteen thousand yuan in here. How about I keep it safe for you, and return it to you later?”

chapters.title: Chapter 611: Gold Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 611: Chapter 611: Gold Card
Lin Yi chuckled, stretched out his hand, and patted little Lin’s head, saying, “No need, this card is for you, spend as much as you want.”
Upon hearing this, little Lin immediately broke into a delighted smile and hugged Lin Yi affectionately, exclaiming, “Brother Lin Yi, I’m so touched! You actually gave me a gold card; I won’t have to worry about running out of money anymore!”
Lin Yi, wearing a small smile upon hearing little Lin’s words, then said, “Little Lin, I will be going away for some time to gain experience. When you graduate, report to the Imperial High School.”
“Ah, where are you going, Brother Lin Yi?”
Little Lin asked in surprise, “Is it very dangerous?”
“Not dangerous, but it does require strong practical combat skills and Combat Skills,” Lin Yi said with a smile, “Moreover, I plan to venture out, so I’ll leave first. Next time I see you, I’ll bring you back a gift.”
...
“Mm, Brother Lin Yi, I’ll wait for you at school to come back,” little Lin said with a sweet smile.
“Alright,” Lin Yi softly promised.
“Mm, I’ll go find my dad, then buy some clothes for you. Brother Lin Yi, you must wait for me to come back!”
After speaking, little Lin stood up from the chair, bouncing and skipping out.
Watching little Lin’s antics, Lin Yi couldn’t help but shake his head slightly, showing an expression of helplessness.
He knew that little Lin wanted to pick clothes for him.
“Sigh.”
Lin Yi let out a light sigh.
But this little girl is still so adorable.
Little Lin walked out of the private room and immediately ran to the counter; she grabbed a tissue to wipe her mouth and then took a drink from inside and started drinking.
After finishing the drink, little Lin ran back into the private room, picked up a cup, filled it to the brim with water, and headed straight for Lin Yi.
“Brother Lin Yi, your cup is empty; you should drink some water,” little Lin called out as she ran and then rushed to Lin Yi, shoving the water into his hands before darting away.
“Hehe.”
Lin Yi smiled helplessly, deciding to take the water and drink.
After a few sips of water, Lin Yi set the cup down.
Then, Lin Yi took out his phone and dialed Qin Feng’s number.
At that moment, Qin Feng was at home watching TV with Li Yunqian.
“Hello?” Qin Feng answered the call.
“I’ve taken care of little Lin’s issue,” Lin Yi said in a calm voice.
“That fast?” Qin Feng was taken aback and then quickly understood, asking, “Where are you now? Should I come pick you up?”
“I’m at the restaurant of the tavern,” Lin Yi said.
“Alright, wait there for me, I’ll be right there,” Qin Feng said, and then hung up the phone.
After putting down the phone, Qin Feng saw Li Yunqian still looking at him with anticipation and explained, “A student just called, said her classmate needed a ride, so I’m going out for a bit.”
“What?” Upon hearing this, Li Yunqian, somewhat disappointed, said, “I was thinking of cooking for you and watching a movie together. Isn’t this going to fall through again?”
Qin Feng said with a smile, “No worries, you can do it next time; I’m not in a rush.”
“Oh, that’s true,” Li Yunqian nodded and said, “Then I’ll accompany you. We haven’t gone shopping together in a long time; let’s enjoy a good day out.”
“Then thank you for that.”
“You’re welcome, let’s get going!” Li Yunqian said, picked up her handbag, and pulled Lin Yi out of the apartment.
After Lin Yi and Li Yunqian left the apartment, they casually wandered the streets before arriving at a shopping mall.
Lin Yi had been to this mall once before—it was his first venture in the capital city that actually made money.
This mall specialized in women’s underwear, cosmetics, perfume, and some women’s clothing among other luxury items. It also designed clothing and jewelry for some celebrities. It was very expensive, but incredibly popular.
Lin Yi and Li Yunqian entered the mall and casually strolled through the lingerie section.
Lin Yi looked at the rows of beautiful lingerie, his eyes flickering slightly.
The lingerie, whether in terms of style or color, was very much to Lin Yi’s aesthetic liking.
For some reason, Lin Yi always found these pieces of lingerie particularly beautiful, and he couldn’t help wanting to buy a couple of sets to wear himself.
“Eh?”
As Lin Yi hesitated, he suddenly noticed a white lace slip dress.
The white slip dress was very cool and highlighted a woman’s delicate and translucent body to the fullest.
Seeing this slip dress, Lin Yi couldn’t take his eyes off it.
In his memory, there seemed to be a piece of lingerie like that, a white slip dress worn by Su Ya—it was absolutely stunning!
Thinking of this, Lin Yi immediately picked up the white slip dress and started trying it on himself.
“Hmm? How about it, does this slip dress suit me?” Li Yunqian, seeing Lin Yi take out a slip dress, couldn’t help but ask curiously.
Lin Yi nodded and then handed the slip dress to Li Yunqian.
Li Yunqian took the slip dress, looked it over carefully, then smiled and said, “It really is beautiful! Lin Yi, why don’t you wear this slip dress then?”
“That doesn’t seem quite right,” Lin Yi shook his head and said.
“What’s wrong with that? You’re not short on money, and besides, I’m a girl, there’s nothing shameful about girls’ underwear,” Li Yunqian said, and threw the white slip dress over to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi, with no other choice, finally put on the white slip dress. However, the slip dress was rather short, exposing his chest and bottom completely.
“Lin Yi, I think you should put this on!”
Li Yunqian, holding the slip dress, dangled it in front of Lin Yi and then looked at him with a mischievous smile.
Lin Yi was stunned, looked down at his chest and bottom, then said with a wry smile, “Are you sure you’re not just teasing me?”
“How would I dare to tease you?” Li Yunqian pouted.
“You’re teasing me now,”
Lin Yi rolled his eyes and then took off the slip dress and placed it on the sofa next to him, saying to Li Yunqian, “Alright, pick whatever style you like, feel free to choose.”
Hearing this, Li Yunqian immediately went to another rack of clothes and began to search for her desired garments.
Before long, Li Yunqian had selected five or six items, and eventually chose two black slip dresses and a purple-red long-sleeved shirt.
She had Lin Yi try on two articles of clothing, then asked the clerk to pack them up for Lin Yi, intending to have them delivered to his home.
The two pieces of clothing, a black slip dress and a purple-red long-sleeved shirt, looked like they could be a couple’s outfit and were very form-fitting.
Both pieces were tight, outlining the sinuous curves of the female figure, and the couple’s outfit in particular showcased Lin Yi’s perfect physique, provoking unbidden thoughts and endless daydreams.
“This outfit really suits you so well!” Li Yunqian said with a beaming smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 612: Some Things Are Forgotten
chapters.content:
Chapter 612: Chapter 612: Some Things Are Forgotten
“Hehe, yeah, it does suit me pretty well,”
Lin Yi nodded and smiled as well.
Glancing at the black slip dress he wore, a thought suddenly occurred to him, so he turned to Li Yunqian and said, “Yun Qian, I just remembered something I forgot. Wait here for a moment, will you?”
With that, Lin Yi turned and walked out of the mall.
After Lin Yi left, Li Yunqian looked at the couple’s outfit in front of her and couldn’t help but feel puzzled, wondering what Lin Yi could possibly be so busy with.
Could it be a date with another woman?
...
As she thought this, an image of Lin Yi embracing a woman appeared in Li Yunqian’s mind, and her face involuntarily showed a trace of sadness.
Li Yunqian couldn’t help cursing herself, “Really, what nonsense are you thinking of!”
Lin Yi left the mall and headed straight to the side of a luxury car.
He reached out and tapped on the car window.
“Boss, do you need anything?” The car window rolled down, revealing a handsome and attractive face.
Lin Yi pointed at the two pieces of lingerie in front of him and asked the driver with a smile, “How do these clothes and this piece of lingerie look?”
At his words, the driver’s eyes lit up immediately and, looking at the two pieces of lingerie Lin Yi pointed to, he praised with a click of his tongue, “These two pieces of lingerie are really beautiful! Not only are they sexy and charming, but they’re also very form-fitting. Wearing them, you’d look absolutely perfect. I bet even men would be attracted to you.”
“Really that good?” Lin Yi said, suddenly a bit surprised. He hadn’t expected the lingerie to be so popular.
“Absolutely true,” the driver assured him.
“I’ll take them. How much?” Lin Yi asked the driver.
“They’re complimentary, you only need to pay for them, and then you can swap the slip dress back,” the driver said with a smile.
Lin Yi nodded, then took out his wallet from his pocket and handed over two thousand yuan to the driver.
The driver took the money and then smiled at Lin Yi before starting the car and heading in the direction of the Lin Family.
“Sigh…” Watching the car grow smaller in the distance, Lin Yi couldn’t help but let out a sigh, filled with emotion. He never imagined that after spending a few years abroad, he’d changed so much. He not only met Sister Xu Qing, but now he also had money to buy clothes and could even casually give away a slip dress.
Lin Yi shook his head, ceased dwelling on it, and stepped into the mall to choose the clothes he would wear that evening.
While browsing the items in the mall, Lin Yi casually picked up a black slip dress and walked to the counter.
Seeing Lin Yi with the slip dress, the counter clerk immediately approached him with enthusiasm, “Hello, sir. Are you looking to buy a slip dress?”
Lin Yi nodded and said, “Yes, please wrap it up for me.”
“Alrighty!” The counter clerk responded promptly, took the money from Lin Yi, and began to wrap up the black slip dress for him.
Soon after, Lin Yi put on the black slip dress.
He looked at himself in the mirror and noticed that his reflection seemed no different from usual.
With a thought, a wisp of golden Mana surged from between his brows, creating a golden screen of light.
Afterward, the hairs on Lin Yi’s eyebrows and skin emitted a faint luminescence, and his skin itself seemed to become as white and radiant as jade.
Looking at his reflection, Lin Yi couldn’t help but reveal a shocked expression.
He hadn’t expected that this change would be so noticeable!
But that was good; his increased strength meant that his Combat Power would be a lot higher in the future.
“Sir, I have wrapped up the slip dress for you. Just a moment, and I will deliver it to your home,” said the counter clerk, having packed the slip dress.
“Thank you,” Lin Yi replied, giving the counter clerk a slight smile.
With the black slip dress hanging on his arm, Lin Yi walked out of the store.
“Brother Lin, you’ve finished buying clothes, are you going out for a walk?”
As soon as Lin Yi stepped out of the store entrance, Xu Qing ran up to his side.
Lin Yi shook his head and said, “I have some matters to attend to and need to head out, so you go home first. Remember not to snack too much, okay?”
“Oh…”
Xu Qing nodded her head even though she really wanted to go shopping with Lin Yi, she knew he genuinely had things to take care of, so she didn’t insist.
Looking at how well-behaved and understanding Xu Qing was, Lin Yi couldn’t help but smile slightly.
This little girl is getting more and more obedient.
With that thought in mind, Lin Yi couldn’t resist pinching Xu Qing’s tender cheeks.
“Stop it!” Xu Qing said, her pretty face blushing as she pouted and swatted away Lin Yi’s “devil’s claw.”
Lin Yi smiled faintly and said, “Alright, I must be going. Bye!”
After speaking, Lin Yi waved goodbye to Xu Qing, turned, and walked towards the BMW X5 parked by the roadside.
Inside the BMW X6 sat two bodyguards.
Both bodyguards were wearing sunglasses; upon seeing Lin Yi approaching, they quickly got out of the car and respectfully bowed to him, “Young Master!”
“Follow behind me.”
Lin Yi spoke indifferently, then opened the car door and got in.
“Yes, Young Master!”
The two bodyguards hastily responded, then went around to the back of the car, took their seats in the front passenger area, and started the car to follow behind Lin Yi.
Sitting in the car, Lin Yi looked through the rearview mirror at the three black Bentley sedans closely following behind and a bad premonition arose in his heart.
“Who has sent these people?” Lin Yi couldn’t help but frown.
In the past few days, he had been attacked several times, but those incidents were always resolved by the Lin Family’s people. However, these individuals kept following him, which seemed more than coincidental.
After pondering for a while, Lin Yi dialed a number.
“Hello, Dad, it’s me. Someone’s tailing me,” Lin Yi said with a grave tone.
“Oh? Is it that serious? Be careful then; I’ll arrange for someone to protect you discreetly,” his father responded with immediate concern.
“Alright, I’ll hang up now,” Lin Yi said, then ended the call.
Hanging up the phone, chills began to surge in Lin Yi’s heart.
It seems they’re targeting me.
But who could have sent them?
Lin Yi was utterly baffled.
“Young Master, should we send someone to investigate?”
At that moment, the bodyguard sitting on Lin Yi’s right suddenly spoke up, asking him a question.
Hearing this, Lin Yi immediately waved his hand and refused, “No need, you guys don’t have to worry about this; I’ll handle it myself.”
“Yes,” the two bodyguards, upon hearing this, quickly bowed their heads, not daring to object.
Afterward, Lin Yi focused intently on the road ahead, speeding along the way.
Soon, Lin Yi’s car stopped in front of the Lin Family’s gates.
“You guys go back first,” Lin Yi said to the two bodyguards beside him.
“Yes, Young Master!” The two bodyguards, upon hearing this, nodded their heads, opened the car doors, got out, and waited respectfully at the entrance.
Lin Yi stepped out of the vehicle and walked straight into the villa.
As Lin Yi entered the living room and saw Xu Qing playing video games, he walked straight upstairs without a word.
“Brother Lin Yi, I was having fun playing, why did you come to disturb me?” Xu Qing looked up, saw Lin Yi approaching, and immediately pouted unhappily.

chapters.title: Chapter 613 - 613 No Abnormalities Around
chapters.content:
Chapter 613: Chapter 613 No Abnormalities Around
“Alright, alright, I’ll stop bothering you,” Lin Yi, seeing Xu Qing’s expression, couldn’t help but chuckle, and then he spoke.
“Hmph, that’s more like it!” Xu Qing, upon hearing this, immediately broke into a wide smile.
Looking at Xu Qing, this lass, Lin Yi felt a warm feeling in his heart. This was his dear little sister, after all!
“Xu Wen, Xu Wen!”
Just then, the villa’s door was opened, and Xu Wen’s mother called out a few times, but didn’t see Xu Wen’s figure.
“Where has that girl Xu Wen gone now?” Xu Wen’s mother asked in confusion, seeing Lin Yi.
...
“Mom, Xu Wen might have gone out to play with me,” Lin Yi said with a slight smile, then continued, “You should sit and rest for a while, I’ll go look for her, she’ll be back very soon.”
“Hmm, go ahead,” Xu Wen’s mother nodded and responded.
After speaking, Lin Yi turned and walked towards the door.
His gaze swept around the villa, didn’t notice any abnormalities, so he relaxed and was ready to go out to look for Xu Wen.
“Ouch!”
Just at that moment, a sudden pain came, making Lin Yi cry out involuntarily.
It turned out that just as Lin Yi had stepped out of the villa’s main door, he felt an intense pain in his ankle.
“My leg…” Lin Yi looked down at his legs, then his eyes widened in horror.
“Why are my legs swollen? Could these people really be out to cripple me?” A chill rose in Lin Yi’s heart.
He was a doctor and could feel his legs seemingly losing sensation, and they were rapidly decaying, emitting a foul stench as the flesh rotted away.
“This won’t do, I have to leave quickly, otherwise my legs will be ruined,” Lin Yi thought in a panic.
So, disregarding the pain, he started to sprint away, hoping to get away from this place as soon as possible.
The moment his foot crossed the threshold, he felt a heart-piercing pain and his entire body stumbled and fell to the ground.
“Hiss… that hurts so much…” Lin Yi gritted his teeth, his heart seething with anger.
He had been pampered since childhood and had never suffered like this.
He got up from the ground, enduring the pain, and continued to run forward, but his legs just wouldn’t obey him.
“THUD!”
At that moment, a huge stone flew towards him and struck him on the head, leaving his head buzzing incessantly, nearly knocking him unconscious.
“Damn it! Who’s so despicable!” Lin Yi cursed through gritted teeth, enduring the pain.
His eyes could hardly see anything clearly anymore, and he could only grope in the darkness, running towards the direction of the gate.
“BANG!”
Just as Lin Yi reached the gate, another huge stone flew viciously towards him, hitting his left arm and causing a shocking wound.
“Ah!”
Lin Yi could not help but scream in pain, sweating cold sweat.
His legs felt as though they had been brutally chopped off, the pain causing his whole body to go numb.
And the pain not only didn’t subside but became even more intense, a fine layer of sweat beads covered Lin Yi’s forehead.
Moreover, sweat beads also appeared on the tip of his nose, dropping down one by one, seeping into his clothes.
At this moment, his hands clenched tightly into fists, veins popping out, the knuckles turning white.
Lin Yi felt a deep sense of powerlessness.
“No, I am a doctor, I can definitely cure my own illness, I can definitely return to my previous condition, definitely!” Lin Yi told himself.
Just then, he suddenly noticed that his left arm had already started to decay, with a ghastly stench wafting up to his nose, a sensation that made one want to vomit.
Seeing his hands turn like this, Lin Yi shouted in alarm, “Damn it, my hands have become so rotten.”
“My hands, my hands…”
At this sight, Lin Yi couldn’t help but panic.
His hands were his most prized weapons; if they were destroyed, what would he do with his life?
He couldn’t accept this!
He hadn’t yet married or had children; he couldn’t just let himself become useless.
“I must heal my hands, I must!”
Lin Yi chanted to himself, his expression gradually becoming resolute.
“I can’t give up!”
Lin Yi muttered a few words to himself and immediately sped up to run forward.
Soon, he made his way through the hall and ran out of the villa.
At that moment, the air outside felt especially refreshing, and the sunlight, warm and comforting.
Lin Yi stretched out his arms, savoring this fulfilling sensation.
Lin Yi thought to himself, “This truly is an ideal place for cultivating; no wonder so many powerful people wish to practice here. The air is so pure, it’s practically a holy ground for cultivation.”
Inside the villa, he felt the air was filthy, as if surrounded by dark mist, preventing him from absorbing the world’s Primordial Energy, which he disliked immensely.
But now, outside the villa, he immediately felt the fresh air revitalizing both his body and spirit.
In just a short while, Lin Yi passed through the garden and arrived at the road outside the villa.
There was a grassy area, open, lush, and cool, bringing a sense of boundless joy to one’s soul.
Lin Yi took several deep breaths of the fresh air, his complexion instantly flushing with color.
“Great, this is wonderful; I can finally breathe freely!”
Lin Yi rejoiced internally.
Then, he looked at his left hand.
His right hand had been smashed by the boulder, split into two halves, with the bloody severed limbs scattered on the ground, too ghastly to behold. The rot on the wound had worsened and spread to Lin Yi’s shoulder.
His face instantly went as pale as paper, and his body shook unsteadily.
“Ah! Why am I so weak that I can’t even bear such a small wound?”
Lin Yi felt indignant, his expression extremely pained.
It seemed as if his hands’ bones were ruined, utterly devoid of any strength, and his Inner Strength was completely gone, causing Lin Yi a deep sense of defeat.
“What should I do now? Am I just supposed to wait for death? I can’t accept this, I absolutely can’t give up, I must not give up!”
Lin Yi chanted to himself, his eyes lighting up suddenly as he thought of something.
“Right, the healing arts, can’t I control that power with my medical skills? As long as I master them, my hands won’t be useless!”
Thinking this, he immediately took out his phone and dialed the teacher’s number.
“Hello, who is this?” a voice came from the other end of the phone, the teacher’s voice.
“Hello, teacher.”
“Oh, Mr. Lin, I’m sorry for disturbing you so late, do you need something?”
“Teacher, my hands, my hands have become like this. I wanted to ask whether you could help me restore my hands? Please, I beg you!” Lin Yi pleaded.
“Ah, Mr. Lin, how did you end up like this?” the teacher exclaimed in shock.
“Sigh! Teacher, I won’t lie to you, some people ruined my hands, and that’s why they’re like this. Can you help me?” Lin Yi asked urgently.
“Mr. Lin, rest assured, I will do my utmost to heal your hands. I will save them; do not worry, wait for my news!”

chapters.title: Chapter 614: Heaven Is Truly Helping Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 614: Chapter 614: Heaven Is Truly Helping Me
The teacher pondered for a few seconds, then immediately agreed with solemnity.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was overjoyed and quickly expressed his thanks.
Shortly after, the teacher hung up the phone.
With the phone call ended, a relieved smile appeared on Lin Yi’s face.
“There’s finally hope,” Lin Yi murmured to himself, and a smile also emerged on his face.
Lin Yi took a deep breath and walked towards the villa he lived in.
...
By now, Lin Yi had returned to his normal complexion and demeanor, and he did not bear any foul odors.
After he entered the room, he immediately closed the door, sat down with his legs crossed, and began to circulate his medical knowledge.
“Medical knowledge really is a cure-all, I only need to use it once, and my hand will fully recover!” Lin Yi thought excitedly as he saw his hands slowly regaining their previous condition, and soon, they would be completely healed!
He couldn’t help feeling grateful, “Fate is on my side, this is really too good, my hands finally have hope of recovery.”
A joyful smile spread across his face.
At this moment, he suddenly remembered the dream he’d just had.
“Weren’t my hands transformed into this state, how come they are recovering?” Lin Yi wondered.
His consciousness once again entered the dream.
In the dream, the pillars had returned to normal.
Lin Yi’s feet were still suspended in mid-air, and he stood in place without moving.
Before him was the enormous stele; around its edges, the cracks in the giant Stone were rapidly healing.
This scene was incredibly eerie and sent shivers down one’s spine.
At that moment, the stele suddenly burst into a mass of white light, and then it fiercely turned into ashes and became dust.
After the stele disappeared, a figure stepped out from the void—it was Lin Yi’s master.
“Congratulations on learning this secret tome, ‘Yin Yang Medical Tome,'” the old man said with a smile.
He had a tall stature and ordinary appearance, but he carried an air of authority.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi immediately knelt before the elder, saying, “Thank you for your teaching, Master, I will diligently cultivate and never fail to appreciate your great kindness!”
The elder waved his hand and said, “No need for formalities, since you’ve taken me as your teacher, you are my disciple, just call me ‘Master’ from now on.”
“Master, your disciple Lin Yi,” Lin Yi said respectfully.
“Haha! Good, good, good!” The elder was extremely happy, tears twinkling at the corners of his eyes.
“Lin Yi, your hand has been destroyed. In the future, if you want to recover, I’m afraid you can only rely on your medical skills,” the elder said.
Lin Yi nodded, “Thank you, Master. I will definitely work hard to recover as soon as possible!”
“Hehe!” The elder nodded his head.
Then, the elder turned and left.
Lin Yi watched his master’s figure receding into the distance until he vanished from sight, and only then did he turn and head back to the villa.
“Phew!”
Lin Yi let out a heavy sigh of relief, the worry and tension on his face gone, replaced with joy and a relaxed smile.
“Haha, medical knowledge really is a cure-all, I truly am a genius blessed by the heavens. My strength now is far greater than those exceptionally gifted students,” Lin Yi thought to himself joyfully.
Although Lin Yi knew how precious medical knowledge was, and that such miraculous powers were extremely valuable and irreplaceable once depleted, he still felt somewhat reluctant to use them all up.
However, thinking of his hands being able to recover, he didn’t feel as pained.
His current strength, although not on par with those super geniuses, still ranked among the talented, and it was not just himself, he was surrounded by so many students with outstanding talents. As long as they continued to work hard, they too could catch up to him.
Therefore, he didn’t need to rush or give up on his grand plans of immortal cultivation just because his medical skills were inferior to those super geniuses.
Thinking this way, his confidence surged, and his heart was no longer as restless as before.
He walked to his bedroom, lay down on the bed, and fell asleep.
The next day, when Lin Yi woke up, he saw that his hands were able to move again.
He immediately got up, went to the living room, and found that his hands had fully recovered to their original state, without even a scar left behind. He couldn’t help but feel very surprised and excited.
“This is really great, finally no longer having to endure that pain, it’s truly amazing,” Lin Yi thought contentedly.
At that moment, there was a knock on the door of the villa.
“Knock, knock, knock…”
The knocking echoed in Lin Yi’s ears.
“Who is it?” Lin Yi called out.
“Young Master, this old servant has come to serve you breakfast,” the voice of the butler came from outside.
“Understood,” Lin Yi nodded, then opened the villa’s main door.
The butler walked in, holding breakfast in his hands, presenting it with utmost respect.
Seeing the butler like this, Lin Yi also found it hard to believe that his butler could show such a side.
“Young Master, please enjoy your meal!” The butler set the dishes on the table and said.
Lin Yi stepped forward and saw that the meal was lavish, filled with all his favorite dishes.
“Who made this?” Lin Yi asked.
“It was prepared by Uncle Wang in the kitchen. I asked Uncle Wang to prepare breakfast, so I came over to serve the Young Master,” the butler responded.
“Oh, I see, come and sit down to eat with me, no need to be formal,” Lin Yi invited the butler.
“Thank you, Young Master!” After expressing his thanks, the butler sat down beside him.
“Right, Uncle Wang, this is the ointment those three thieves bought for me yesterday. Please help me apply it,” Lin Yi suddenly spoke up.
Uncle Wang took the ointment, nodded, and said, “Alright, I’ll go apply it to the Young Master now!”
“Okay!” Lin Yi nodded in response.
“By the way, Young Master, if there is anything else you need, I’ll go and fetch it for you,” the butler continued.
“No trouble needed, I’ll just rest here, you go buy some groceries,” Lin Yi shook his head and said.
“Alright, then I will go purchase the groceries. You just wait, Young Master,” Uncle Wang said.
“Okay.”
Subsequently, Uncle Wang turned and left the villa, heading to the nearby market.
After Uncle Wang had left, Lin Yi began to close his eyes and regulate his body, adjusting his state to the best it could be.
Before long, a delicious smelling roasted meat was brought back by Uncle Wang.
Lin Yi started to eat, enjoying the tasty roast and sipping on delicious milk, feeling extremely comfortable and at ease, thoroughly enjoying the meal. When he finished, he felt his body filled with powerful energy, warm all over, as if he were soaking in a hot spring.
“Mmm, the effect is good, this feeling is truly wonderful!” Lin Yi thought to himself, feeling pleased.
Although his hands had recovered, he was in no hurry to use his medical skills. He wanted to wait until his injuries had completely healed before starting to treat his hands, because he was somewhat looking forward to that magical power.
…
A week later, Lin Yi’s hands had completely returned to their original state, without any scars left. His skin was smooth and tender, like satin, making him look like a twenty-year-old young man.

chapters.title: Chapter 615: The Cheeks Have Also Returned to Their Original State
chapters.content:
Chapter 615: Chapter 615: The Cheeks Have Also Returned to Their Original State
Lin Yi’s cheeks had also returned to their normal appearance, looking even younger than the average youth.
However, his eyes had turned silver, shining like bright jewels.
Lin Yi reached out to touch his eyes, revealing a satisfied smile on his face.
In this world, there were still many things that could be healed, including Lin Yi’s hands.
He was capable of using medical skills, but he didn’t want to arouse suspicion, so he had no choice but to hide his hands to avoid giving himself away.
Of course, he would occasionally use his medical skills to treat those injured fingers.
...
His right arm, although not very agile, was not disabled.
“Young Master, you’re looking more handsome by the day. My young master is so beautiful,” Uncle Wang exclaimed after seeing Lin Yi’s eyes.
“You’re quite the sweet talker, aren’t you?” Lin Yi said with a slight smile.
“Young Master, this old servant isn’t just flattering you. As my family’s young master, you naturally deserve all the praise, otherwise, our family’s face would be lost,” Uncle Wang said with a laugh.
“Alright, stop flattering me, I’m starting to feel embarrassed,” Lin Yi waved his hand.
“By the way, you said you had something to report? What is it?” Lin Yi looked toward Uncle Wang and asked.
“It’s like this, I have a matter I’d like to discuss with the Young Master,” Uncle Wang said.
Lin Yi nodded: “Speak.”
“The old master said that since your strength has improved somewhat, he wants you to inherit the family business. Hence, he wishes to meet with you,” Uncle Wang said.
“My father? Does he need something from me?” Lin Yi frowned slightly, asking with some confusion.
“The old master did not specify anything, just that he wants to see you, Young Master,” Uncle Wang replied.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi pondered for a moment and then said, “Since he wants to see me, then I’ll go. However, you must tell him first that I am still a bit inconvenienced.”
“Young Master, I understand,” Uncle Wang nodded in agreement before leaving the villa to find Xia Hailong, the head of the Xia Family at the City Lord’s Mansion.
“Young Master, I’m heading back now. If you need anything, just call for me. I’m at your beck and call!” Uncle Wang said to Lin Yi as he was leaving.
“Alright, go on with your tasks. Don’t worry about me,” Lin Yi said.
Afterward, Lin Yi continued to meditate and recuperate, elevating his condition to its peak.
His injuries had mostly completely healed, and he could use his medical skills normally, but he still decided not to use his hands immediately. He would wait until the injuries were fully recovered before using them again.
…
City Lord’s Mansion.
Xia Hailong, the head of the Xia Family, was a man in his fifties with quite a heroic appearance.
At the moment, he was sipping a cup of tea.
Then, a middle-aged woman carrying a tea pot walked in, holding a piece of paper in her hand.
She handed the paper to Xia Hailong and said, “Family Head, this is a note from Lin Yi.”
Xia Hailong looked up at the note in the woman’s hand and took it from her.
He unfolded it and took a look, then a smile appeared on his face.
At that moment, his face lit up with a radiant smile.
“Hahaha… Excellent! Excellent! I never expected to have such a remarkable grandson,” Xia Hailong couldn’t stop smiling.
“Lin Yi truly is the lucky star of our Xia Family. In that case, I’ll immediately arrange for someone to bring him into the city!”
Xia Hailong gave his instructions, his tone brimming with excitement.
“Yes, family head.” The middle-aged woman bowed and accepted the orders before she withdrew.
This time Lin Yi had come to the capital for some important matters, so he did not want to delay and had to take care of things as soon as possible.
When Lin Yi left the villa, he left Uncle Wang there to take care of his illness because, after all, his identity was no longer what it used to be; he was now a High Level Alchemist.
He did not want to reveal that he knew medical arts.
He did not want others to know he had medical knowledge, because once it was found out, his situation would be very dangerous; he might even bring trouble upon the entire Xia Family.
This was not something Lin Yi wished to see happen.
After leaving the house, Lin Yi headed straight for the courtyard where Xia Hailong lived.
At this moment, Xia Hailong was sunbathing in the garden, savoring his tea.
While drinking tea, he admired the scenery around him, appearing at ease and exceedingly content.
“Young master, you have arrived.” Xia Hailong immediately rose to his feet to greet him upon seeing Lin Yi.
“Uncle Xia, you have worked hard during this time,” Lin Yi said to Xia Hailong.
“Hahaha, what hardship are you talking about, child? It is my honor to be able to help you, I am very pleased”, Xia Hailong laughed heartily.
“Then I will gratefully accept your kind offer,” Lin Yi also said with a smile.
Both of them looked at each other and burst into hearty laughter.
Lin Yi was still very grateful to Xia Hailong; after all, without Xia Hailong’s care, his body probably would have collapsed long ago, and he wouldn’t have been able to cultivate to his current Realm.
“Uncle Xia, did you summon me here for something important?” Lin Yi’s laughter subsided as he inquired.
Xia Hailong nodded and said, “That’s right, I had recently offended a noble, angered them, and was pursued. Now, I have escaped to the capital and am in hiding, so I decided not to visit you before your return, to avoid them finding me and so you could recuperate in peace.”
“Oh, I’m already aware of this matter,” Lin Yi said.
Although Lin Yi had only just arrived in Huaxia, he had some knowledge of the situation. Xia Hailong had offended a noble, and moreover, a formidable one.
He knew that this was definitely trouble.
Moreover, Lin Yi was puzzled about the identity of this noble and their motives for going to such lengths to deal with him. This noble’s strength must be considerable, but Lin Yi did not know who this noble was.
This time, he came to the capital not only to find his mother, Xia Yueqin but also to look for news about her, yet he didn’t even know his mother’s name.
“Lin Yi, are your injuries healed now?” Xia Hailong suddenly asked Lin Yi.
Lin Yi was taken aback, then replied, “Almost.”
His injuries were indeed healed; though the wound still throbbed faintly, it was no longer a serious issue, and he was fully recovered.
“In that case, you can accompany me back to the capital tomorrow,” Xia Hailong said.
“That’s fine, but Uncle Xia, I have a request I implore you to grant,” Lin Yi said.
“Whatever it is, just say it. As long as I can do it, I will certainly satisfy you,” Xia Hailong said with a bold laugh.
“I wish to participate in the auction competition hosted by my maternal grandfather,” Lin Yi stated.
His grandfather was the Medicine Saint Lin Xuan, and naturally, Lin Yi wanted to win the championship’s reward.
“Oh, that matter. I promise you, as long as you can win the championship of the second round of competition, you will be allowed to enter the Inner Sect. Then, you can spend some time studying there,” Xia Hailong said.
“Thank you, Uncle Xia. I will not let you down when the time comes,” Lin Yi said.

chapters.title: Chapter 616 - 616 Back to the Rental House
chapters.content:
Chapter 616: Chapter 616 Back to the Rental House
“All right, then let’s get ready, we’ll set off early tomorrow morning,” Xia Hailong said with a smile.
“I’ll take my leave now, see you tomorrow,” Lin Yi said.
After bidding farewell, he went straight to the house he had rented, as he needed to rest for the night; he still had things to handle early the next morning.
The next day.
As soon as day broke, the Xia family’s servants had already made preparations, and Xia Hailong had also led everyone to board the flying machine, departing from the capital city toward the house rented by Lin Yi.
The flying machine sped through the air extremely fast, and in just a few breaths’ time, it came to a halt at Lin Yi’s rented place.
...
“Lin Yi, I’m ready,” Xia Hailong said from the doorway of the flying machine.
“Great, thank you,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
With a leap, Lin Yi also jumped onto the flying machine.
“Lin Yi, rest assured, with the Xia family’s guards protecting you, you will absolutely face no danger,” Xia Hailong said.
Lin Yi nodded slightly and replied, “Then I must thank Uncle Xia. By the way, Uncle Xia, I’d like to attend the auction organized by my grandfather—could you trouble yourself to get me a ticket?”
The reason Lin Yi wanted to attend the auction was that he wanted to be part of such a large-scale event, and moreover, he did not wish to be recognized as someone from the Xia family, as that would not be beneficial for him.
He intended to conceal his identity, which was why he wanted to participate in the auction.
Hearing that Lin Yi wanted to participate in the auction, Xia Hailong’s face lit up with joy.
“Lin Yi, you honor my Xia family by inviting me to the auction, so I shall reluctantly accept,” Xia Hailong said with a laugh.
He hadn’t expected Lin Yi to suggest attending such a grand auction.
One must know that although Lin Yi was in Huaxia, he was not an ordinary person but the heir of a Martial Arts family; such large-scale auctions would undoubtedly attract many powerful individuals.
Those strong individuals were at the very least Cultivators of the Foundation Establishment Stage, and there would even be old monsters of the Golden Core Stage and Nascent Soul Stage.
Only the most elite sects had the qualifications to attend such grand auctions.
Lin Yi, as an heir to an ordinary minor sect, wanted to join such a grand auction, shocking Xia Hailong.
He realized that Lin Yi must have achieved considerable gains along his journey, and so wanted to use this opportunity to get closer to Lin Yi, creating a favorable impression in front of him for the Xia family’s people, so that in the future, it would be of greater help to them.
Naturally, Lin Yi did not see through Xia Hailong’s intentions.
“Then we won’t stand on ceremony!” Lin Yi chuckled and said.
“By the way, Lin Yi, have your wounds healed?” Xia Hailong looked at Lin Yi’s arm with concern.
On hearing this, Lin Yi nodded and responded, “Yes, it’s healed now, Uncle Xia, don’t worry.”
“That’s good to hear,” Xia Hailong said with a smile. “Then I’ll head off first, see you tomorrow.”
“See you tomorrow,” Lin Yi nodded, sending off Xia Hailong and the others.
After Xia Hailong and the others had left, Lin Yi entered his space.
Inside the space, his Spiritual Energy had recovered a lot, and his Soul had received ample nourishment, so Lin Yi’s Spiritual Sense had become even more powerful.
Lin Yi extended his Spiritual Sense to check his room and found a red envelope on his bed and a note pressed under his pillow.
Lin Yi picked up the red envelope, opened it to look inside, and there were several thousand spirit stones.
His eyes lit up at the sight of the several thousand spirit stones.
Several thousand spirit stones, for Lin Yi, were simply a tremendous amount of money!
Lin Yi immediately put the spirit stones into his storage ring and stowed them away.
Then, he took the note in his hand and unfolded it to read.
This note was left by Xia Hailong.
“Lin Yi, you’re an alchemist, you must work hard to break through to the Golden Core Stage within three years. By then, the status of our Xia Family will be different, and your status in Huaxia will also rise, making the Xia Family able to help you a lot. I hope you remember my words today.”
Lin Yi was deeply moved by this letter. He hadn’t expected Xia Hailong to care so much about him; it was truly surprising and made him feel favorably towards Xia Hailong.
Lin Yi refolded the letter, put the note back, and prepared to leave to get ready for the auction items.
Just as Lin Yi was about to step out of the room, he suddenly remembered something.
A peculiar expression appeared on his face as he muttered to himself, “Yu Qing is still sleeping lazily in the room, what should I do? I wonder how her injury is healing?”
After thinking it over, Lin Yi took out a piece of healing medicine from his storage ring and delivered it to Yu Qing’s room, saying, “Yu Qing, take this first; it will help your injury heal faster.”
Yu Qing, hearing Lin Yi’s voice inside, was overjoyed and immediately ran over to open the door.
Lin Yi was taken aback when he saw Yu Qing running out. She was dressed in red, looking enchantingly beautiful. Her skin was as fair as snow, her figure stunning, with two towering peaks standing proudly at her chest, radiating a mature charm.
Lin Yi swallowed hard, overwhelmed by the fullness of Yu Qing’s chest, and he exclaimed, “Indeed a great beauty!”
“Lin Yi, you finally deigned to come see me!” Yu Qing pouted playfully.
“Er, here I am, haven’t I? Yu Qing, has your injury healed?” Lin Yi asked.
“Yes,” Yu Qing nodded. “Much better, I will eat this now, and then we can go shopping afterward. This is a lot of money; you won’t mind me spending too much on shopping, will you?”
“No, buy whatever you like, Yu Qing. After all, our Lin Family is wealthy. No matter how much you spend, it’s no problem,” Lin Yi said with a laugh.
“Really?”
“Of course, it’s true. Could I be lying to you?”
“En, Lin Yi, you’re the best!”
“Yu Qing, how are you feeling now?” Lin Yi asked with a smiling gaze.
“Hmm, Lin Yi, I feel much better now, just like a moment ago!” Yu Qing said with a sweet smile.
Yu Qing was indeed telling the truth. When Lin Yi treated her wounds yesterday, infusing her with spiritual power and essence blood, she felt comfortable all over, light as if she had no strength at all.
Of course, Lin Yi didn’t know that Yu Qing was just severely injured, hence her physical weakness, but his medical treatment had completely healed her injury.
That was also one of the reasons why Lin Yi could become the future heir of the Lin Family; after all, his medical skills were superb, top-notch in the Xia Family as well, and with him taking action to treat Yu Qing’s injury, naturally, there was no problem.
Lin Yi nodded and said, “Alright then, I’ll be going now.”
Lin Yi turned and left.
He didn’t stay any longer because he had to go back and find Li Mengyao, to tell her about this and, by the way, to also inform her that his spiritual energy had fully recovered.

chapters.title: Chapter 617: Able to Cure the Disease
chapters.content:
Chapter 617: Chapter 617: Able to Cure the Disease
He wanted to tell Li Mengyao that he could not only heal Xia Yuqing’s injuries but also cure her illness.
Lin Yi returned to his room, checked the time on his phone, and discovered it was already one o’clock in the morning.
“It’s already midnight, eh? I wonder if Li Mengyao has gone to bed. Should I go and see her?” Lin Yi pondered.
After some thought, Lin Yi took out a Message Jade Token and directly transmitted his Divine Sense through it.
The Message Jade Token belonged to a friend of Lin Yi’s, whose name was Li Feiyan.
After receiving Lin Yi’s Message Jade Token, Li Feiyan immediately called him to her room.
...
“Lin Yi, do you have time right now? I have something to discuss with you. Let’s meet at a tavern in Tianfeng City,” Li Feiyan said.
“Sure, no problem!” Lin Yi was slightly startled but didn’t ask further and agreed right away.
“Then let’s meet in a bit!” After saying this, Li Feiyan hung up the Message Jade Token, then changed into a clean set of clothes and stepped out of her room.
Lin Yi also changed clothes and then left his room.
After arriving at the tavern, Lin Yi met with Li Feiyan. Both were dressed in men’s clothes, but Li Feiyan was a woman, and a great beauty at that. Lin Yi’s eyes lit up when he saw her.
“Eh, who are you? Do you know me?” Li Feiyan asked Lin Yi.
Lin Yi glanced at Li Feiyan and chuckled, “My name is Lin Yi. I’m from the Li Family, and I am Li Yuqing’s fiancé.”
When Li Feiyan heard the words “fiancé,” her eyes widened in disbelief, “Brother Lin Yi, are you saying you’re Sister Yuqing’s fiancé?”
Lin Yi nodded, “Yep, that’s right. What about it?”
“This, this is too unbelievable,” Li Feiyan shook her head.
“You don’t believe it?” Lin Yi blinked.
“Of course, I believe it,” Li Feiyan said.
“Then why wouldn’t you believe me?” Lin Yi asked, puzzled.
“Because, you look to be only around twenty years old, you look much older than Sister Yuqing!” Li Feiyan frowned as she spoke.
“I’m one year older than her. You can tell that too, pretty good eyesight,” Lin Yi complimented.
“It’s not that my eyes are sharp, it’s because Sister Yuqing usually dresses as a man, that’s why I couldn’t tell! But, Brother Lin Yi, how is your Cultivation so high?” Li Feiyan wondered.
Lin Yi chuckled, “Haha, actually, my Cultivation is not just high, my Combat Power is also very formidable! Did you see just now, when the magical beasts were chasing you, you nearly got bitten to death? I could kill each of those magical beasts with one slap,” Lin Yi said with a mischievous grin.
“Wow, Brother Lin Yi, you’re incredible, a real top-notch expert! What level are you?” Li Feiyan exclaimed in surprise.
“I won’t hide it from you. I’ve already reached the Ninth Level of Huayuan realm. Looking at me now, do I look like someone who hasn’t practiced anything?” Lin Yi said with a sly smile.
“Wow, that’s frightening. No wonder Sister Yuqing likes you. Not only are you handsome, but you also possess such formidable strength!” Li Feiyan said.
“Alright, enough with the flattery, let’s go inside and talk,” Lin Yi said.
“Sure, okay.”
Afterward, Lin Yi and Li Feiyan continued their discussion as they walked. They talked about their childhood, growing up, and the present. Lin Yi shared stories from his childhood, mentioning how naughty he used to be, often bullying his little brothers. He recalled an incident where he beat up a little boy until his nose was blue and face swollen.
Li Feiyan said that when she was a child, Lin Yi just couldn’t help but tease her. Li Feiyan said she was mischievous and troublesome as well and even got into fights with a bunch of little brats.
As they talked, they arrived at the entrance of a restaurant and walked inside.
Lin Yi ordered some dishes, then started chatting with Li Feiyan again.
“Lin Yi, you don’t look much older than me, so how can you be so strong? You’re really amazing!” Li Feiyan looked at Lin Yi with admiration and said.
Li Feiyan’s eyes were watery, making her look exceptionally clear and beautiful. Her features were very delicate, especially those eyes which seemed to possess a magical power that made people fall into them and struggle to escape.
“That’s my secret, I can’t tell you, so don’t ask,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Alright, never mind then,” Li Feiyan said, pouting.
Lin Yi and Li Feiyan chatted idly for a while when suddenly, Li Feiyan saw a note on the table. She picked up the note and unfolded it to read.
After reading the content of the note, Li Feiyan immediately showed a shocked expression.
“Lin Yi, is this your note?” Li Feiyan looked up and asked.
Lin Yi glanced at the note and nodded, “Yes, I left it here. It’s from Yu Qing, for you to give to your father.”
“Oh, it’s from Yu Qing for you to pass on to me, what did she ask you to give?” Li Feiyan asked curiously.
“She asked me to give this to your father.” Lin Yi took a stone out of his storage ring and placed it on the table, sliding it toward Li Feiyan.
Li Feiyan took the stone, and upon opening it, she immediately noticed the writing on it. After reading the inscription, she couldn’t help but be startled and then looked at Lin Yi excitedly, “Lin Yi, is this true? That’s wonderful, thank you!”
“What’s there to thank me for? It’s what I should do. You’ve helped me quite a lot, so giving you this is only right,” Lin Yi said with a laugh.
“Lin Yi, you’re really great! I’ll be sure to serve you wholeheartedly in the future, I’ll never betray you!” Li Feiyan said solemnly.
“Haha, okay then, let’s agree on that!” Lin Yi laughed heartily.
“Sure!” Li Feiyan nodded vigorously.
After they ate, Lin Yi and Li Feiyan talked about his cultivation for a while, and then Li Feiyan left because she had a performance.
Once Li Feiyan was gone, Lin Yi returned to his room, sat cross-legged on the bed, and prepared to cultivate.
Lin Yi’s method of cultivation was drastically different from others; although Lin Yi also used medicinal ingredients for cultivation, he did not pick herbs and refine elixirs to consume like the other cultivators.
Lin Yi harvested a precious spirit grass, then placed it into a refining cauldron and refined two spirit pills before stopping.
Then, Lin Yi closed his eyes and began the refinement of the spirit pills.
After the two spirit pills were refined, Lin Yi stored them in his storage bag and continued to cultivate.
Lin Yi didn’t know when he had woken up, but when he opened his eyes, it was already dark outside.
Lin Yi looked out the window, which was open. He got up, walked to the window, and saw Li Feiyan patrolling the streets, looking spirited and energetic, clearly having rested well the night before.
“Fei Yan, it’s almost dawn, let’s go back,” Lin Yi called out.
Li Feiyan responded and turned to look at Lin Yi, a glint of astonishment flashing through her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 618: The Idol of Humanity!
chapters.content:
Chapter 618: Chapter 618: The Idol of Humanity!
“Lin Yi, brother, you’re so handsome! I’ve never seen a man more handsome than you, and you’re so amazing, you’re truly an idol of humanity!” Li Feiyan exclaimed.
Hearing Li Feiyan’s words, Lin Yi felt somewhat gratified. He looked into Li Feiyan’s eyes and smiled slightly, “That’s right, I am a hero of the Human Clan, the unparalleled in ages, of course, I’m handsome!”
“Tsk, a hero of the Human Clan, what’s so good about humans? All they do all day is farm or brew and sell liquor, they have no real skills at all, not even the ability to plant a Spirit Fruit tree, and yet you call yourself a hero!” Li Feiyan disdainfully said.
“Uh, I’m a hero of the Human Clan, so none of those heroes from the Demon Race are any good?” Lin Yi rolled his eyes.
“You’re the one who’s not any good, all of you humans are bad eggs, and you’re the worst!” Li Feiyan said angrily.
“Alright, if you say humans are the worst, then tell me, which bird from the Demon Race is good? Do you think the Demon King is good, or is the queen of the Demon Race better?” Lin Yi teased.
...
“Hmph!”
Li Feiyan let out a cold snort, not wanting to interact with Lin Yi.
Lin Yi was all smiles; it seemed that the long conversation he had with her today had been rather effective.
As they talked, they made their way back to Lin Yi’s home.
Li Feiyan returned to her boudoir, then started to dress up and apply makeup.
After finishing her makeup, Li Feiyan changed into a new outfit and, after getting dressed, she walked out and saw Lin Yi sitting on the sofa.
“Hey, Lin Yi, brother, why aren’t you going back to cultivate?” Li Feiyan asked curiously, looking at him.
“Well, I’m not really in the mood to cultivate right now, I thought I’d stay home and watch some TV,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Alright then, I’m leaving,” Li Feiyan said.
With that, Li Feiyan walked upstairs.
Li Feiyan had walked a few steps but then turned back and ran to Lin Yi. She grabbed his arm and said with a sweet smile, “Lin Yi, brother, would you come shopping with me? Let’s have some fun together!”
“Sure, where do you want to go? Let’s buy some stuff first,” Lin Yi said, looking at Li Feiyan.
“That sounds great!”
Li Feiyan nodded happily, then, holding Lin Yi’s arm, they both walked downstairs together.
Lin Yi and Li Feiyan shopped for half the day, bought a lot of stuff, and after that, they headed towards Li Feiyan’s home.
As soon as Lin Yi arrived in front of Li Feiyan’s house, he saw Li Feiyan’s parents and her sister Li Xiaoman sitting in the courtyard, looking very anxious as they paced back and forth.
Seeing Li Feiyan’s parents pacing back and forth in the courtyard, Lin Yi couldn’t help but wonder, “Uncle, auntie, what are you doing?”
Li Feiyan’s father heard Lin Yi’s voice, turned around, saw it was Lin Yi, and hurried over, saying, “Lin Yi, you’re back? Is there something wrong?”
Lin Yi shook his head and replied with a smile, “Nothing’s wrong, I just came to see you, auntie.”
“Oh, I see. Well, you go inside and rest for a bit. We’ll serve the food shortly!” Li Feiyan’s father said with a smile.
“Alright.”
Lin Yi said, then followed Li Feiyan’s parents into the house.
Li Feiyan’s parents took Lin Yi to the living room for tea and a chat, which lasted until past eleven o’clock at night before Lin Yi left.
Early the next morning, Lin Yi arrived at the shop, where the shop assistant greeted him warmly, “Good morning, Young Master Lin!”
Lin Yi nodded with a smile and walked in.
Li Feiyan was cultivating inside the shop when she saw Lin Yi walk in, her cheeks involuntarily blushed.
Seeing Li Feiyan’s rosy cheeks, Lin Yi couldn’t resist teasing, “Fei Yan, you look beautiful today!”
“`
“Stop being so slick, just set everything up quickly, you have to go to work soon!” Li Feiyan said, annoyed.
“Mhm, I know. You just keep cultivating at your own pace, I’ll head back to work now!”
After saying this, Lin Yi turned around, left the store, and returned to his own home.
“Eh, Lin Yi, why are you back?”
As soon as Lin Yi entered the door, he saw the two elders of his household.
“Dad, Mom, I’m off today, so I came back,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“There’s nothing much for you to do at home, just take a good rest. Later, your dad is going to attend an event at the municipal party committee, so you should go with him,” his mother said.
“Alright, got it.”
“Then I’m off now!” Lin Tianhai, Lin Yi’s father, said.
“Bye, Dad, Mom!”
Just as Lin Tianhai was about to step out to the stairwell, he suddenly turned back to Lin Yi and asked, “Oh right, Lin Yi, when are you going to start dating Fei Yan?”
“Cough cough, Dad, I’m still not too sure if Fei Yan actually likes me,” Lin Yi said, scratching his head embarrassingly.
After hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Tianhai was taken aback and said, “Fei Yan doesn’t like you?”
“Well, Fei Yan likes me, but I’m still not certain if she really likes me, so for now, I’d rather not tell her my true feelings, to avoid hurting her,” Lin Yi explained.
“I see. Then I wish you luck in winning the lady’s heart as soon as possible,” Lin Tianhai patted Lin Yi on the shoulder and said.
After Lin Tianhai had left, Lin Yi returned to his room, sat on the chair, and began to cultivate with his eyes closed.
The day went by very quickly, and when Lin Yi woke up, he stepped out of his room and looked at the empty mansion, feeling a sense of loneliness in his heart.
However, Lin Yi didn’t mind it; he freshened up and then stepped out of the house.
Upon leaving the yard, Lin Yi made his way to the municipal government office.
On the way, Lin Yi encountered many colleagues who all greeted him warmly.
“Lin Yi, you’re back?”
“Lin Yi, you’re back?”
“…”
Lin Yi greeted everyone while making his way to the office, which made them treat him with even more respect.
Once at the office, Lin Yi turned on his computer and checked some information about cultivation methods.
His gaze then shifted to another computer beside the one he was using.
“Hmm, didn’t expect this computer to be so expensive, must be imported from abroad. I haven’t seen this model before, it’s worth at least six or seven hundred bucks!” Lin Yi thought to himself.
Lin Yi switched on the computer, logged into a game, and started clicking around, choosing to level up.
After entering the game, Lin Yi arrived at a valley and saw three monsters inside it: two looked like wolves, one like a bull, and another like a bear.
Lin Yi glanced at the monsters’ attributes and was astounded. Both monsters were level forty-nine.
Level-forty-nine monsters were no joke, each of them likely had around fifty thousand health points. If Lin Yi encountered even one of them, it would be tough to deal with.
“I only have twenty-three Qi-Blood left now. To face these three monsters will take some time, but if they all attack at once, even if I were powerful, I’d just get instantly killed,” Lin Yi thought to himself.
“Looks like I really need to find some help!”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 619 - 619 No Monsters Found
chapters.content:
Chapter 619: Chapter 619 No Monsters Found
Lin Yi thought about it and began to search for traces of monsters in the vicinity. He searched in the valley for a long time but found no monsters.
“What’s going on?” Lin Yi was puzzled.
Just then, Lin Yi suddenly noticed a gray little thing crouching in a corner of the valley. He saw the gray thing and couldn’t help but stop in his tracks and walked over.
Upon closer inspection, Lin Yi realized that what was squatting in the corner was a gray snake with a sharp tooth on its head, and its mouth was wriggling, showing a hungry look, its eyes fixed on Lin Yi.
“What kind of snake is this?” Lin Yi wondered silently.
At that moment, the snake seemed to sense Lin Yi and immediately rose from the ground, ready to launch an attack on Lin Yi.
...
“Damn, it can bite?” Lin Yi was startled to see the gray snake hissing, but he quickly recovered.
“Hmph, I want to see how formidable you are. I don’t believe you can bite me to death!” he muttered to himself.
Thinking this, Lin Yi immediately took out a Silver Needle.
With a “whoosh”, a Silver Needle struck the gray snake’s tail.
The gray snake felt the pain and quickly shook its tail to fling the Silver Needle away, then continued to charge toward Lin Yi.
“Hey, pretty clever!” Lin Yi sneered coldly, taking out a silver dagger, and then stabbed viciously at the gray snake’s belly. Instantly, a spray of blood burst out, splashing all over the valley.
The gray poisonous blood sprayed across the area, and Lin Yi quickly put away his dagger and started to run.
“Roar”
The injured gray snake was instantly enraged, hissing continuously as it pursued Lin Yi.
The gray snake was incredibly fast, and although Lin Yi had Qinggong skills, he was still quickly caught up to by the relentless pursuit of the gray snake. Lin Yi, left with no choice, could only run desperately, dodging the gray snake’s pursuit.
In the midst of his flight, Lin Yi found that no matter which direction he ran, he was always intercepted by the gray snake.
Lin Yi watched the gray snake unwillingly, stabbing with his sword while fleeing, but each time the snake dodged easily. Frustrated and embarrassed, he cursed, “Damn beast, don’t push me!”
Right then, Lin Yi saw a dark figure flashing past behind a tree not far ahead, then quickly disappearing.
“Who’s there? Come out!”
Lin Yi shouted, chasing after the direction where the shadow had vanished.
“Roar”
Lin Yi had only chased for a short distance when a roar suddenly came from the bushes ahead. Then, a gray python shot out from the foliage, its gaping mouth biting toward Lin Yi.
Lin Yi quickly dodged, but the gray python’s speed was incredibly fast. After dodging, the python sprang out again, biting at Lin Yi’s neck.
“Fuck, still daring to bite me, see if I don’t slaughter you!”
Lin Yi cursed angrily, raising the Silver Short Sword in his hand, and stabbed directly into the python’s belly.
“Ow!”
The python let out a painful howl, then quickly retreated.
“Haha, you want to fight me? Die!” Lin Yi laughed loudly, gripping the Silver Short Sword, took a step forward and charged up, swinging the Longsword and chopping at the python.
The python hurriedly dodged, and Lin Yi’s slashing attack missed. Then, he swung his sword again.
But this time, the situation was different from before. Lin Yi swung his sword, and it didn’t harm the python at all.
Upon seeing this situation, Lin Yi couldn’t help but wonder, thinking, “What’s happening here? Is this giant python not afraid of my Silver Gleam Sword? Or, does it have extremely high defense?”
“Impossible, my attack power is definitely not low. If this giant python really had high defense, it would have died a long time ago. How could it still be alive!”
Lin Yi pondered for a moment, then set aside his worries and looked at the giant python with excitement.
The python was also staring at Lin Yi, and as it saw Lin Yi continuously swinging the Silver Short Sword, it seemed to be very fearful and kept trying to avoid him, but its enormous body was simply too large to get away.
“Puchi!”
The short sword in Lin Yi’s hand ruthlessly plunged into the python’s body, and blood immediately flowed out, dyeing the soil red.
“Aowu, that hurts!”
With a pained roar, the giant python struggled incessantly, trying to escape Lin Yi’s attack.
“Hahaha, it seems your defense really is high!”
Seeing that his sword had pierced into the opponent without inflicting fatal damage, Lin Yi couldn’t help but get excited.
At that moment, Lin Yi noticed the constant struggle and quickly put away his short sword. He then leaped up, gripping the Silver Short Sword, and stabbed towards the python’s head. Suddenly, a white light flew out, and with a flash, the Silver Short Sword plunged directly into the python’s skull.
“Bang”
A muffled sound echoed as the python’s head shattered instantly, blood splattered, and Lin Yi was drenched in scarlet.
Lin Yi, seeing that his sword had pierced through the python’s head, was stunned; he hadn’t expected the sword to have such an effect.
The blood of the python dripped onto Lin Yi, and immediately, a putrid stench permeated the air, making anyone who smelled it gag involuntarily.
“What a foul stench!”
Lin Yi frowned, immediately holding his breath to forcefully control his nausea, preventing himself from vomiting.
He quickly took out a Potion from his backpack and drank a few mouthfuls, which made him feel much better.
The Potion was something Lin Yi had bought last night to treat Zhao Bingning’s injuries. It was extremely effective for internal injuries and could relieve fatigue after taking just one dose.
Zhao Bingning had bought this Potion for Lin Yi, so he usually didn’t have the heart to use it, but today he was compelled to take it due to the circumstances.
After swallowing the Potion, the color gradually returned to Lin Yi’s cheeks, and his body felt much more comfortable.
“Phew!”
After consuming the Potion, Lin Yi finally breathed a sigh of relief. He looked up and found that the giant python was thoroughly dead.
The python’s carcass was two meters tall, entirely black, and emitted a faint rotten smell. Its snake eyes were wide open, filled with unwillingness.
At this moment, a grey little monkey suddenly emerged from Lin Yi’s clothes.
This little monkey was all white and fluffy, with a monkey face and a slender frame but incredibly cute. It was dressed in a pristine long skirt, wore a ring on its hand, and had jet-black hair flowing down like a waterfall, swaying in the air, very adorable.
When Lin Yi saw the little monkey, he couldn’t help but be slightly startled and exclaimed, “Holy crap, another little monkey? Could it be a pet of the giant python?”
The python might have had many pets, but Lin Yi had only seen three to five smaller pythons in the vicinity; he had never seen a giant python that was a little monkey.
Lin Yi carefully observed the little monkey and found that it was just an ordinary monkey without anything strange.
“Forget it, since it’s just an ordinary little monkey, there’s no problem!”
Upon seeing the python’s death, Lin Yi intended to collect his spoils and leave. However, when his gaze fell upon the python’s carcass, he suddenly froze, his eyes bulging with an incredulous expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 620: Some are Coveting Eagerly
chapters.content:
Chapter 620: Chapter 620: Some are Coveting Eagerly
“Eh? How could there be a demon core after this monstrous python has died?”
