Lin Yi saw that inside the belly of the python, there was a demon core the size of a fist lying there. The demon core was blood-red throughout, containing extremely pure Blood Essence Power. This power was so concentrated that Lin Yi couldn’t help but salivate over it.
“Never mind, since I’m just picking up a bargain, there’s no need to covet this demon core.”
Lin Yi picked up the demon core and put it into his storage ring, then turned around, ready to leave.
But just at that moment, he suddenly discovered a special metal plate inside the body of the python. The metal plate was engraved with some strange patterns.
“Hmm? The patterns on this metal plate look so familiar! Could it be… this is…”
...
Lin Yi suddenly remembered something and hurriedly took the metal plate out.
The patterns on this metal plate were very similar to those on another metal plate he had seen before; it was a metal pattern that looked like a huge sword. However, this sword seemed much rougher in appearance.
“This is… a celestial artifact from Heavenly Sword Mountain!”
Upon seeing the appearance of the sword, Lin Yi was immediately overjoyed. He couldn’t believe his luck in coming across a celestial magic artifact.
“Haha, I’ve actually encountered a celestial magic artifact. It looks like I’m really going to make a fortune today!”
Lin Yi shouted excitedly.
Although he was a poor boy, he knew the prowess of celestial magic artifacts, which were extremely rare and valuable treasures.
Such celestial magic artifacts were pricy, one could sell for millions, and there might even be more expensive offers.
This time, Lin Yi had stumbled upon a celestial magic artifact, which made him extremely excited.
Celestial magic artifacts were legendary in the whole of Huaxia, aside from the Imperial Family owning some, they were practically storied existences.
And celestial magic artifacts possessed incredibly powerful forces; even powerful beings in the Great Grandmaster Realm might lack the confidence to overcome it.
Therefore, such celestial magic artifacts were exceedingly precious treasures in the entire Immortal Cultivation World. Moreover, their value far exceeded the imagination of ordinary people, and they were the coveted treasures of countless cultivators.
Celestial magic artifacts were a very special kind of weapon that could transform into weapons, armors, magic robes, and so on. Once used, their power was limitless.
The higher the quality of a celestial magic artifact and the more it was used, the greater its power. If the refinement of such a celestial magic artifact fails, it could explode, destroying the artifact and even injuring the owner of the weapon.
It could be said that these celestial magic artifacts were the most lethal magic artifacts, and even warriors at the Martial Emperor Realm would probably have to avoid their edge when faced with them.
At first, when the news that Lin Yi had obtained a celestial magic artifact spread, it caused a huge commotion.
Moreover, the celestial magic artifacts obtained by Lin Yi were quite few in number, which made him lack attack-type magic artifacts. Now that he had obtained a celestial magic artifact, he naturally felt very happy.
Right away, Lin Yi put the celestial magic artifact into the storage ring.
Although Lin Yi’s storage ring also had the function of storing items, the capacity of these rings was too small, and since storage rings are spatial devices that cannot contain living creatures, they simply couldn’t accommodate such large treasures.
“I need to find a bigger storage ring as soon as possible!”
Lin Yi thought to himself, “If I had a huge storage ring, I would be able to store a tremendous amount of items.”
Thinking of this, Lin Yi quickly checked his storage ring. He found that the storage ring had a certain amount of space. However, it could only contain living things, such as common mystical beasts and spirit pets, which ordinary people simply couldn’t accommodate.
“I need to find a larger storage ring, but I don’t have the money to buy one right now. What should I do?”
“Maybe, I’ll try to see if I can refine these demon beasts and then gather them all into my storage ring. That way, I could accommodate living things.”
With this thought in mind, Lin Yi began to attempt.
He took a demon wolf out of his storage ring and then threw it directly back into the storage ring.
This scene made the little Ling’er by his side somewhat dumbfounded. However, being an old creature that had lived for hundreds of years, it quickly regained its composure and wasn’t too surprised.
Because it had witnessed Lin Yi’s capabilities and knew that Lin Yi owned a storage ring, and now Lin Yi was doing something that surprised it.
“Eh? My storage ring can actually contain living things now, and even this giant python can be taken in. I really succeeded!”
Lin Yi was very excited.
The giant python was truly huge, measuring over two meters long. Ordinary storage rings couldn’t possibly accommodate such a large python; only someone with a space ring like Lin Yi could succeed in storing it.
“It looks like I really stumbled upon a treasure this time! I’ve made a fortune!”
Seeing the giant python enter his storage ring, Lin Yi couldn’t help feeling extremely pleased. He immediately sat down cross-legged and began to cultivate.
In this forest, he was currently just a Martial Artist at the early stage of the Eighth Layer in his Qi practice, with limited strength. Therefore, he had to cultivate diligently, striving to reach the Ninth Level of Qi practice as soon as possible so he wouldn’t be bullied here.
And a heaven-class magic artifact was a treasure he had to obtain at this stage. He had to successfully refine a heaven-class magic artifact.
“I have to refine a defensive heaven-class magic artifact first!”
With this thought, Lin Yi began searching for materials suitable for refining his heaven-class magic artifact, and before long, he found some spirit grass and began the refinement process.
The heaven-class magic artifact was a longsword, six meters in length and four meters wide. The entire longsword was azure blue, engraved with many runes and totems, radiating a strong azure light, and an intense aura emanated from the sword.
“I’ll refine this longsword and name it Qinglong Sword!”
Thinking this, Lin Yi took out the Qinglong Sword.
It was an azure longsword carved with many azure patterns, incredibly beautiful, and it emitted an intoxicating fragrance. An extremely strong Sword Intent was released from the blade, which made Lin Yi unable to help but be slightly enthralled by it.
This Qinglong Sword was a Spiritual Artifact of very high quality and a heaven-class Magic Artifact!
“A heaven-class magic artifact, I have to study this carefully.”
Lin Yi glanced at the Qinglong Sword with a spark of brilliance in his eyes, then closed his eyes and focused, taking out the Qinglong Sword.
“Hum~”
As soon as Lin Yi held the Qinglong Sword in his hand, it started to tremble violently as if it wanted to break free from Lin Yi’s grasp and escape from his palm.
Lin Yi quickly grasped it in his hand and observed it carefully.
This Qinglong Sword was light green overall, the blade was incredibly sharp, and there were rings of purple runes on the body of the sword, clearly indicating it was an artifact inscribed with runes.

chapters.title: Chapter 621: Activating the Five Spiritual Energy Beads
chapters.content:
Chapter 621: Chapter 621: Activating the Five Spiritual Energy Beads
This Qinglong Sword is definitely an attack-type Spiritual Artifact, and its power is extremely formidable; Lin Yi estimated that even at its weakest, the sword’s attack power could match the blow of a Foundation Establishment Second Layer Peak expert!
“Hmm, looking at it, this sword isn’t too bad. As long as I can absorb and integrate the power of the runes into this longsword, I believe the power of my Qinglong Sword will become even more terrifying,”
Lin Yi gazed at the Qinglong Sword, a burning desire flashing in his eyes.
“I wonder how strong my physical body and the Thunder True Essence within me are now. I hope they don’t disappoint me,”
With that thought, Lin Yi immediately spurred the five Spiritual Energy beads in his Dantian into action.
“Buzz~”
...
The five Spiritual Energy beads in his Dantian suddenly trembled, and then True Essence crazily poured into the Qinglong Sword from them.
Instantly, Lin Yi felt the Qinglong Sword vibrate continuously under his control, a very special feeling traveling up from the blade.
“Is this a heaven-grade Magic Artifact? This sensation is indeed extraordinary; this sword is much more powerful than ordinary Magic Artifacts. I am currently just an eighth-layer Cultivator; if I could own a heaven-grade Magic Artifact, wouldn’t that be like having a powerful weapon?!”
Lin Yi thought to himself with a smile spreading across his face.
Lin Yi continued to stimulate the True Essence beads, and before long, a rich surge of Spiritual Energy burst out from the Qinglong Sword. Lin Yi felt as if his body was filled with electricity, very comfortable, and he couldn’t help but moan.
“Fantastic!”
Lin Yi roared inwardly.
The power felt so comfortable that his whole body felt incredibly refreshed as if he had been reborn, his body feeling much lighter.
This surge of Spiritual Energy crazily coursed through Lin Yi’s body, remodeling it. Every inch of his skin and each bone underwent a transformation, and the skin on his body became more delicate and tougher by far. Even ordinary weapons would find it difficult to cut through his bones now.
Lin Yi’s physical strength now far exceeded that of a normal twelfth-layer Martial Artist by many times!
“So satisfying, this feeling is too great. With this, I am much safer here!”
Lin Yi couldn’t help but feel emotional. Although he was just an eighth-layer Cultivator, he could now challenge experts at the Foundation Establishment Second Layer and even those at the Third Layer.
Such a thing simply did not exist in the Immortal Cultivation World, only in novels, but Lin Yi was experiencing it firsthand.
Moreover, now that he possessed the Qinglong Sword, except for Martial Artists at the Seventh Layer of Foundation Establishment, not even heaven-grade Magic Artifacts could necessarily hurt him. Besides, the Qinglong Sword had another effect: it could weaken the opponent’s attack power.
Now, Lin Yi’s physical strength was ten times that of a normal eighth-layer Martial Artist. How terrifying that was! Even a Martial Artist at the Ninth Level of Foundation Establishment would struggle to break through his defenses with such a level of protection.
“Haha, my physical strength has now become incredibly strong, with this, I truly have a solid footing in the Immortal Cultivation World,”
Lin Yi cheered inwardly.
Lin Yi looked at the Qinglong Sword in his hands, his face lighting up with joy. He was in need of a handy Spiritual Artifact and now, with the Qinglong Sword, he could use it to slay Demon Beasts, obtain Demon Cores, Demon Beast Crystal Stones, and even use the Qinglong Sword to hunt down powerful experts of the Demon Race.
“Well, since that’s the case, then I shall refine this Qinglong Sword!”
No sooner had Lin Yi thought it than he immediately began the Refinement of the Qinglong Sword.
“Swoosh!”
Under Lin Yi’s control, the Qinglong Sword flew into the air and hovered above his head.
Lin Yi formed hand seals and a stream of True Qi surged into the body of the Qinglong Sword. At once, the Qinglong Sword began to shake violently, and a series of terrifying sounds of sword cries came through as if it was about to pierce Lin Yi’s eardrums.
With a shift in mindset, Lin Yi felt the Qinglong Sword grow continuously larger, expanding from the size of a palm to two feet long and eventually transformed into a broadsword.
“Swoosh!”
Lin Yi directly threw the Qinglong Sword into its sheath, and he also tossed this long knife into the sword bag.
“Buzz!”
The Qinglong Sword hovered within the sword bag, with its blade slightly trembling, emitting a buzzing sound. Wisps of Qing Yan smoke arose from the blade, appearing extremely eerie.
“This sword can now be called the ‘Azure Dragon Treasure Sword’. Truly worthy of being a heaven-tier Magic Artifact, such power is indeed astonishing,”
Lin Yi thought to himself. Then, he transferred everything in this cave into the sword bag and placed the Qinglong Sword back into the bag as well.
After Lin Yi had taken care of all these items, he prepared to leave the forest.
“Boom!”
Suddenly, a thunderous roar sounded from the sky, followed by rolling dark clouds that shrouded half of the sky.
The members of the Demon Race in the vicinity of these mountains scrambled towards the distance to avoid being affected.
Before long, a bolt of lightning struck, blasting a part of this valley and revealing an entrance to an abyss.
The entrance to this abyss was extremely deep, and once one entered, they would never return.
“The demon creatures in this valley were actually struck dead by lightning, how bizarre,”
Lin Yi looked at the abyss, puzzled in his heart.
Then, with a flash of his form, he plunged into the abyss, disappearing from his original spot, plummeting downward.
As Lin Yi fell, he felt a chill on his skin; he knew that the temperature below must be very low, causing him to feel cold.
“How refreshing!”
Lin Yi exclaimed. The temperature below was extremely low, and his clothing had long been covered with ice and snow, with a thick layer of ice encrusting his body. Even an ordinary person falling into this icy world would have probably frozen to death.
Lin Yi dared not linger; he desperately continued to fall downward.
Soon, Lin Yi reached the bottom, and by this time, his robes had already been dried by the cold wind, and the temperature of his body gradually recovered.
“Huuff, huuff…”
Lin Yi gasped for air. He swayed his body and returned to his human form, then, looking around, he saw the valley was extremely vast, stretching for hundreds of meters wide, and all around the valley, there was a white expanse of fog, seemingly endless at a glance.
“I wonder where this valley actually leads,” Lin Yi pondered.
After taking a few breaths, Lin Yi gradually adapted to the surrounding environment. He then mustered Spiritual Energy to form a protective barrier around his body, wrapping himself with it. As a result, his skin turned fiery red, as though it were made of condensed flames.
Lin Yi’s speed suddenly increased, and in the blink of an eye, he flew into the air and began to plummet rapidly downward.
The fog below grew thicker, and the air seemed to contain a certain force, a force that appeared to be repelling the presence of Cultivators.
Lin Yi’s speed slowed down, and the protective barrier around his body also started to weaken, gradually dimming.
Lin Yi’s expression changed slightly, and he swiftly employed the Earth Escape Skill, disappearing from mid-air instantly.
“Splashing…”
Suddenly, his body plummeted, and beneath his feet appeared pools of black water, emitting a foul stench.
“Sss… so smelly!”

chapters.title: Chapter 622: Somewhat Embarrassed
chapters.content:
Chapter 622: Chapter 622: Somewhat Embarrassed
Lin Yi sharply inhaled a cold breath; his clothes were completely soaked, and his body was covered in mud and sand, making him look like a mud monkey, somewhat bedraggled.
“It seems there’s danger.”
The expression on Lin Yi’s face was extremely somber; he hadn’t expected to encounter such peril shortly after arriving in the Demon Realm.
He channeled the “Five Elements Secret Tome”, starting to mobilize the Power of the Five Elements as he slowly moved through the void.
However, the danger this time wasn’t merely from the surroundings; Lin Yi felt as though something was chasing him from behind.
Lin Yi looked back and was startled to see a huge crocodile fiercely pursuing him, refusing to let go.
...
“This is a Black Jiao Snake, not only is its venom powerful, but its body is enormous, possessing immense strength and quick speed. Even a martial artist at the Foundation Establishment Stage, if caught by one of its claws, would probably be seriously injured!”
Lin Yi was shaken, cursing inwardly, “Why are there so many snakes in this place, and moreover, they’re all from the Demon Race!”
“Roar!”
The Black Jiao Snake bellowed furiously as it suddenly shot forward, biting towards Lin Yi’s neck with lightning speed, too fast for anyone to react.
The mouth of the Black Jiao Snake, with its gaping jaws, looked extremely ferocious, and it emitted a nauseating stench.
“Hmph!”
Seeing the Black Jiao Snake biting towards him, Lin Yi was calm and composed. He simply extended a finger and flicked it casually.
“Boom!”
A muffled sound rang out as a golden light shot forth from his fingertip, instantly shattering the Black Jiao Snake’s head; the Golden Needle then viciously pierced into the snake’s brain, a violent force surged into its mind, destroying all of its brain matter.
A one-strike kill, Lin Yi’s strength had indeed become much more formidable than before. Although he was only at the Sixth Layer of Qi Cultivation, his current strength was comparable to a martial artist at the Eighth Layer peak of Qi Cultivation.
“Phew…”
Watching the dead Black Jiao Snake, Lin Yi took a long breath of relief.
His attack had been formed using Spiritual Power, which was far stronger than any of his normal moves.
“The temperature here is too low; I need to leave this accursed place as soon as possible,” Lin Yi frowned and pondered.
Although his strength had greatly improved from before, he still needed to be cautious, especially since he was in the Demon Realm where one could be ambushed at any moment.
“Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!”
At that moment, a cold wind suddenly rose from all around, followed by swarms of black bats rushing out from every direction, swooping down to attack Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s heart chilled as he crouched slightly and then leaped up; his body spun in mid-air like a top, rapidly rotating.
The air around Lin Yi’s body twisted, making cracking sounds. As he spun, air vortices formed, rushing towards him.
Lin Yi condensed Air Knives out of the air vortices and directly slashed at the black bats, immediately killing a swarm of them as blood rained down, spattering on the ground.
“These bats seem to be very afraid of the Air Knife,” Lin Yi muttered to himself, speculating.
Although these bats were many times stronger than Lin Yi, they were quite fearful of the Air Knife, which was why they had managed to survive in the Demon Realm.
These bats didn’t seem to have Spiritual Wisdom; they relied solely on instinct to seek food, attacking prey on sight.
Lin Yi’s figure flickered rapidly in mid-air, dodging while simultaneously swinging out a series of incomparably sharp Air Blades, slicing through the surroundings.
“Ssssss…”
The black bats were easily sliced in half by the Air Blade, splattering blood everywhere and staining a large swath of the swamp red.
Soon after, the surrounding area finally quieted down, and other than some rotting trees, there was nothing else in existence.
Lin Yi stood in the middle of the swamp, took a deep breath, and washed the filth from his body before changing into a clean set of clothes and then walked out of the swamp.
After he left the swamp, Lin Yi discovered a mountain valley in front of him.
The valley wasn’t very high, but it was quite vast, a full thirty zhang tall, with a huge waterfall crashing down from the middle of the mountain, soaking the entire valley.
The airflow here was extremely chaotic, filled with all kinds of miasma that made one nauseous and difficult to endure.
“What a strange place, indeed.”
Lin Yi frowned and shook his head, pondering secretly in his heart.
The atmosphere of this place was too oppressive, nearly like Hell on Earth. He even wondered if it was impossible to survive in this hellish place, for one would eventually suffocate.
On the ground of the valley, there was a huge circular pit, emitting wisps of black smoke, resembling a gigantic furnace that sent waves of heat rushing towards him.
“Is this the Earth Fire Pond?” Lin Yi asked, staring at the pit.
As Lin Yi approached the Earth Fire Pond, he saw countless black bats loitering around, covered in scale armor, extremely ugly in appearance, yet very powerful, all having reached the Seventh Layer of cultivation.
Near the Earth Fire Pond, there were also several corpses; all these bodies belonged to the Demon Clan, all at the Eighth Layer of cultivation and had been dead for a long time. Their physical bodies had withered into a pile of white bones, appearing extremely terrifying.
Lin Yi was amazed by the strength of these demon creatures, having lived here for a thousand years.
He wondered how the Demon Clan managed to cultivate and endure for a thousand years, unwilling to leave this place.
“Could it be the heritage left by the ancestors of these demon creatures?” Lin Yi thought of something, and his eyes suddenly lit up.
“If that’s the case, it would be incredibly valuable, maybe I could even get some Spirit Grass,” Lin Yi said excitably.
The strength of these demon creatures was immense; if he could get a piece of Spirit Grass, he would be able to refine Elixirs and increase his Cultivation.
“Let’s go, let’s not waste the bodies of these demon creatures.”
Having said that, Lin Yi prepared to collect all of the bodies of the demon creatures.
However, just as Lin Yi was about to gather all the bodies of the demon creatures, suddenly, a series of roars emanated from the Earth Fire Pond.
The corpses of the demon creatures trembled upon hearing the roars, seeming somewhat afraid.
“No way, can the corpses actually be scared?” Lin Yi looked at the bodies of the demon creatures with a baffled face, feeling quite helpless in his heart.
“Roar! Roar!”
The roaring became louder and louder, and then demonic flames burst through the ground, setting it ablaze, making the air around the Earth Fire Pond scorchingly hot.
These demonic flames could burn the ground to ashes, showing just how powerful the demon creatures were!
Seeing the abnormality of the Earth Fire Pond, Lin Yi was greatly alarmed and hurriedly ran away, not daring to stay a moment longer.
The demonic flames were incredibly formidable, and even Lin Yi didn’t dare to confront them head-on.

chapters.title: Chapter 623 - 623 Disappeared from View
chapters.content:
Chapter 623: Chapter 623 Disappeared from View
Lin Yi’s figure was like lightning, vanishing from sight in the blink of an eye, leaving only a fading shadow behind.
The demon flames did not pursue but instead shrank back into the Earth Fire Pond, filling it up and returning to stillness as if nothing had happened at all.
After running a distance, Lin Yi gradually slowed down, panting heavily with lingering fear in his heart.
The flames from the Earth Fire Pond were too terrifying. Lin Yi kept activating his Spiritual Qi Defense, but still felt his skin burning and a fiery pain. If it weren’t for his unique physical body, he probably would have been roasted by now.
“That was close, lucky I ran fast, or I’d be grilled meat by now,” Lin Yi patted his chest, silently congratulating himself.
Lin Yi knew all too well that if he had stayed in place, he would certainly have ended up as roast pork.
...
Those demon flames were truly terrifying.
“Fortunately, this is the lair of the Old Demon of Black Mountain. If it were someone from outside, they would probably have been burned to death by now,” thought Lin Yi, still shaken.
Although he was a cultivator and did not fear fire, he would be helpless against demon flames.
“Forget it, I should find some treasures before returning. That way, I can grab a few more valuable artifacts!” Lin Yi thought and turned, heading in another direction.
Lin Yi wandered around the lair of the Old Demon of Black Mountain for a while, and finally found in a stone chamber many demon cores—more than thirty. The poorest quality core was of Low-Grade Demon Core level, worth as much as two million Low-Grade Demon Crystals.
Besides, Lin Yi also discovered many other treasures, all materials for Artifact Refining, which even included a Soul Refinement Sword!
This was a long saber forged from millennium cold iron, with a blade so sharp and a silver glow so bright that it was no lesser than a High-Grade Spiritual Artifact.
Furthermore, the quality of this long saber was not low; it was an Intermediate-Grade Spiritual Artifact.
This surprised Lin Yi greatly.
He had not expected the Old Demon of Black Mountain to obtain such a thing.
Lin Yi was amazed but did not pay it much attention.
Because he had too many materials on hand, he really did not lack these few treasures.
“Let’s collect some items first, then go check out the other treasures,” he thought.
“Right, that’s decided!” Lin Yi said and began to gather the demon cores, Soul Refinement Sword, long saber, as well as numerous ores and materials.
These were all treasures, and the quantity was ample, making the collecting process very fast.
“Huh?”
Suddenly, Lin Yi saw a golden shard among a pile of discarded ores.
“This shard should be a fragment of an Elixir. I was just worried about not being able to refine elixirs, but now it’s great, I’ve got another Elixir fragment. I can ask the old monster what this Elixir actually is and whether it’s useful to me,” Lin Yi thought excitedly, his mood immediately brightened.
Lin Yi picked up the golden shard and held it in his palm, examining it closely to see what kind of Elixir it was.
But to Lin Yi’s surprise, this Elixir seemed quite ordinary with nothing special about it.
Lin Yi held it in his palm and observed carefully, but still, there was no reaction.
“Could this really be the so-called trash, a useless defective product?”
“Sigh, seems like I’ll only be able to find a decent Elixir when I get a chance in the future, you never know.”
Outside the Black Mountain demon’s cave dwelling.
“Lin Yi, you finally came out. I was worried just now, thinking you might have gotten trapped in Black Mountain demon’s cave and couldn’t get out.” Seeing Lin Yi emerge, Zhang Fei hurried over with a smile and said cheerfully.
“You with the crow’s mouth, I hope you don’t call me Junior Brother Lin next time. It makes me uncomfortable all over,” Lin Yi said, curling his lip.
Zhang Fei scratched his head with a somewhat embarrassed smile, “Hehe, Junior Brother Lin, don’t mind me. I was just kidding. But, I really didn’t expect you to actually come out alive from the Black Mountain demon’s cave. It looks like Junior Brother Lin is indeed very strong.”
“Haha, Senior Brother Zhang is too kind. You’re also quite strong, and together, we shouldn’t have any trouble dealing with that Black Mountain demon,” Lin Yi said with a chuckle.
“That’s for sure. Moreover, I have to thank Junior Brother Lin for sending me back to Black Mountain demon’s cave. Otherwise, I really wouldn’t know when I could have gotten out,” Zhang Fei said gratefully.
“It’s what I should do.”
“However, Junior Brother Lin, I thought I heard you call my name just now. What’s that all about?” Zhang Fei looked at Lin Yi with confusion and asked.
“Uh, I forgot to tell you. When I called out just now, I was saying my own name, Lin Yi, not calling ‘Junior Brother Lin,'” Lin Yi said awkwardly.
Zhang Fei was stunned after hearing this and then became furious. “Oh, Junior Brother Lin, so you were tricking me. You dared to make a fool of me!”
Lin Yi hurriedly explained, “No, no, I wasn’t playing a trick on you, Senior Brother Zhang. I really did call you ‘Senior Brother Zhang,’ but because I didn’t call your name right then, you might have thought I got it wrong. Please don’t be mad, Senior Brother Zhang.”
Zhang Fei snorted coldly, “Hmm, the nerve you have to argue! Just now you called ‘Zhang Fei,’ and now I’m Lin Yi. Those are two completely different names. You said you didn’t call my name, but I’m not deaf; I heard it clearly.”
“Err, that… could you please forgive me, Senior Brother Zhang!”
“Humph, it seems you really had ill intentions. You were playing around with me, weren’t you?!” Zhang Fei accused angrily.
“It’s a misunderstanding, Senior Brother Zhang, I genuinely had no intention of making fun of you. I indeed didn’t call your name just now. It’s just that you were too engrossed in the Black Mountain demon’s cave, so you didn’t pay attention,” Lin Yi said, lying without a blush or a skip in his breath, not needing to think twice.
“Hmm, that’s slightly better. Looks like I have to keep an eye on you from now on. You are a cunning and deceitful fellow with an unrighteous heart,” Zhang Fei said.
“Haha, Senior Brother Zhang, you flatter me! I’m actually quite shy,” said Lin Yi with a grin, feeling extremely pleased with himself.
Zhang Fei was indeed easy to fool. It seemed that having him around would save a lot of trouble in the future.
“Humph, I wasn’t complimenting you. You’re the one who admitted to being sly and cunning. I don’t care, from now on, just call me ‘Senior Brother Zhang,’ okay?” Zhang Fei said haughtily and persistently.
“Alright, alright, Senior Brother Zhang, you’re impressive, okay?!” Lin Yi said, a mournful look on his face.
“Haha! You’re really funny, Junior Brother Lin!” Zhang Fei laughed uncontrollably, feeling thoroughly delighted, as Lin Yi was just too hilarious in his eyes.
Lin Yi paid no attention to Zhang Fei and continued searching for treasures inside.
Inside Black Mountain demon’s cave, there were all sorts of precious items, including extremely valuable Elixirs, some of which were essential materials for refining Nascent Soul Pills and Gathering Yuan Pills.
Some were materials used by Cultivators at the Nascent Soul Stage, and others were materials for crafting talismans at the Nascent Soul Stage realm. There were also materials used in the Immortal Cultivation World to refine high-level Elixirs.

chapters.title: Chapter 624: A Wide Variety of Things
chapters.content:
Chapter 624: Chapter 624: A Wide Variety of Things
In short, the cave-dwelling was virtually teeming with treasures in all shapes and sizes, offering something for every persuasion.
Lin Yi’s eyes went wide at the sight, wishing he could haul everything here back with him.
“This Black Mountain demon is simply too wealthy!” Lin Yi couldn’t help but feel profoundly moved.
You have to understand that the elixirs Lin Yi carried were at least of the Nascent Soul Stage, a kind not particularly rare, yet still immensely precious, and beyond the reach of ordinary Body Refinement Cultivators.
But now, in the lair of the Black Mountain demon, there was an abundance of such coveted elixirs.
This Black Mountain demon was indeed overtaken by greed.
...
Lin Yi thought to himself secretly.
As Lin Yi rummaged through the belongings of the Black Mountain demon, he quickly looted some treasure.
However, Lin Yi’s looting was not without cost, as he needed to pay a price, like handing over a century-old Black Lotus.
Lin Yi took out a century-old Black Lotus and handed it to Zhang Fei.
“Junior Brother Lin, what’s this?” Zhang Fei asked in surprise, not quite understanding Lin Yi’s gesture.
“Take this Black Lotus and consume it. I believe that with your talent and resources, you will certainly break through to the Nascent Soul Realm,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Black Lotus?!,” Zhang Fei exclaimed with his mouth agape, “Junior Brother Lin, where did you find such an amazing thing?”
“Well, Senior Brother Zhang, I’ll be frank with you. I entered the cave dwelling of the Black Mountain demon from outside and obtained a lot of treasures, so I collected some to give to you,” Lin Yi said as he handed over the Black Lotus.
“Wow, Junior Brother Lin, you’re really incredible to have such a heaven-defying opportunity. I’m so envious! If I had as great fortune as you, I probably would have broken through to the Nascent Soul Realm long ago,”
Zhang Fei said enviously, his eyes full of longing and admiration.
“Alright, alright, stop flattering me now. I’ve got things to do. I’ll take my leave,” Lin Yi said, waving his hand and turning to leave.
“Hey, Junior Brother Lin, wait for me.”
Zhang Fei hastily followed after him.
“Senior Brother Zhang, I’ve still got things to attend to. Let’s chat another day.”
Zhang Fei, with no other choice, shook his head helplessly and followed Lin Yi back.
Upon returning to the cave dwelling of the Black Mountain demon, the two resumed their search.
“Eh?! There’s a piece of black jade here!”
“This black jade is rather peculiar!”
“Eh? What’s that?”
“The surface of this black jade seems to contain an exceptionally dense spiritual energy!”
Lin Yi discovered a piece of black jade, which was pitch-black as ink, radiating a thick, black glow.
“What kind of black jade is this?”
“So strange! This black glow seems to have a demonic nature!”
Lin Yi remarked in astonishment as he looked at the black jade.
“Don’t know, I’ve never seen such black stones either,” Zhang Fei shook his head, clueless about what it was. However, this black stone seemed to be beneficial to his physical body as well, and he also desired to claim it.
“`
“Junior Brother Lin, this black stone is also useful to me. Do you think this stone has any effect?” Zhang Fei inquired.
“Hmm, this stone is beneficial for you, it is called a Heavenly Thunder Stone, which can attract heavenly tribulation, benefiting your physical cultivation,” Lin Yi explained, and then added, “However, I advise you to give it up. This stone is too valuable; it’s simply not something a cultivator of my cultivation can possess.”
Upon hearing these words from Lin Yi, Zhang Fei was momentarily stunned, feeling very disappointed; he hadn’t expected the black stone to be so powerful.
But then again, it made sense. How could anything referred to as a treasure by the old demon of Black Mountain be ordinary? It was no wonder Lin Yi had said so.
“I’ll take this black stone then, thank you, Junior Brother Lin.”
“Sure, Senior Brother Zhang. You take it. This stone doesn’t have much effect on you, and I don’t want to take advantage of you,” Lin Yi said, shaking his head.
“Alright, since Junior Brother Lin is so generous, I’ll accept it,” Zhang Fei said with a relieved smile and then stored the black stone away.
As the two continued their search for treasures on their journey, they finally reached the cave dwelling of the old demon of Black Mountain after half a day.
Protected by a barrier, they could only observe the cave from a distance.
Countless Spirit Grasses and some materials hung on the walls of the cave dwelling.
Inside the cave, there were many spiritual beasts, some of low rank, some of intermediate rank, and some of high rank; there were even a few Demon Beasts.
Seeing these spiritual beasts and Demon Beasts, Lin Yi couldn’t help but marvel at the wealth of the old demon of Black Mountain, owning so many high-rank spiritual beasts and Demon Beasts.
In the cave dwelling of the old demon of Black Mountain, there were also Pill Furnaces, Magic Artifacts, and other items, some of which Lin Yi had previously acquired.
“Senior Brother Zhang, there are some Elixirs here; take them for your own use,” Lin Yi said, handing several bottles of Elixirs to Zhang Fei.
“Junior Brother Lin, how could I accept this? I came here just to help you refine the black stone; it’s rightfully yours since you obtained it,” Zhang Fei hastily declined.
“Haha, Senior Brother Zhang, don’t be polite. I acquired these from the cave dwelling of the old demon of Black Mountain. You can take them without any reservations. Moreover, you should keep these Elixirs for your own refinement; they will help with your cultivation,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
After thinking it over, Zhang Fei felt that Lin Yi had a point and accepted his gift.
“Well then, Junior Brother Lin, I shall gratefully accept.”
“Haha, Senior Brother Zhang, let’s go in.”
Entering the cave dwelling, they found a small square surrounded by a variety of weapons: swords, knives, axes, bows and arrows, hammers, and more.
“Junior Brother Lin, you take your time to choose; I’ll stand guard outside,” Zhang Fei said before retreating from the cave dwelling to stand at the entrance, vigilantly watching for any creature that approached.
Just as Zhang Fei stepped out of the cave dwelling, he noticed a three-meter-long black Flood Dragon nearby, its body pitch-black as ink, with three pairs of giant fleshy wings gliding within the cave dwelling.
This three-meter-long black Flood Dragon had reached the Seventh Layer of the Nascent Soul Stage.
Spotting the black Flood Dragon, Zhang Fei was shocked and thought, “The old demon of Black Mountain, damn it, this serpent is his spirit pet!”
Seeing this three-meter-long black Flood Dragon, Zhang Fei was horrified and hastily retreated out of the cave dwelling.
“Roar!”
No sooner had Zhang Fei retreated from the cave dwelling than he heard a roar from within, and the black Flood Dragon pounced at him with incredible speed.
“This black Flood Dragon is a spirit pet, but its combat power is not weak; its attack power can even be compared to a cultivator at the peak of the Ninth Level of the Nascent Soul Realm!” Seeing the Flood Dragon lunging at him, Zhang Fei was shocked, his face turning pale.
“Run!”
The thought flashed through Zhang Fei’s mind, and he immediately turned and ran, sprinting toward the distance. He dared not clash head-on with the black Flood Dragon, not believing himself to be its match, so he could only flee.

chapters.title: Chapter 625 03-25 - 625 Unwilling to Pursue
chapters.content:
Chapter 625: Chapter 625 Unwilling to Pursue
After pursuing for a few steps, the black Flood Dragon stopped in its tracks; it also sensed that Zhang Fei had escaped and was unwilling to give chase since its target was the black stone all along.
“Brother Zhang, when the time comes, just do as I’ve taught you,” throw the black stone directly into the dark waters, and the stones in the water will automatically change color to match the blackness of the waters!” Lin Yi shouted from inside the cave dwelling.
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s reminder, Zhang Fei committed it to memory.
“Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!”
“Boom, boom, boom!”
Just then, a series of thunderous noises came from within the cave dwelling, and immediately after, the entire mountain began to shake.
...
Zhang Fei’s heart jolted with alarm, and he hastily looked up towards the mountain, only to see the whole structure was collapsing bit by bit, as if it were about to fall down!
“What’s happening…” Zhang Fei wondered, puzzled.
At that moment, an overwhelming oppressive force came bearing down, enveloping his entire body and making it difficult for him to breathe.
“Brother Zhang, quickly get on my back, hurry onto my back!” Lin Yi yelled out.
“Oh oh.” Zhang Fei quickly responded, rushing behind Lin Yi and crawling into his robes, pressing tightly against Lin Yi’s back, not daring to move.
At this moment, he could feel a warm sensation from behind, giving him a surge of safety.
Source: , updated on Ɲονց0.сο
With a fierce clap of his palms, Lin Yi’s body shook, and Zhang Fei who was on his back leaped up, flying towards the depths of the cave dwelling.
Lin Yi propelled forward like a shooting star, rapidly streaking through the inside of the cave dwelling.
Zhang Fei stood on Lin Yi’s back, the scenery flashing by so impressively fast it shocked him.
He hadn’t expected Lin Yi to be so fast, several times quicker than himself, causing him to feel dazzled.
“This Lin Yi is becoming stronger and stronger,” Zhang Fei marveled inwardly.
Lin Yi swept swiftly through the cave dwelling; despite his speed, the Black Mountain fiend’s abode was too vast. It took him a good while, half an incense stick’s worth of time to traverse the periphery of the cave dwelling, passing a cliff and arriving at a black waterfall, which was the black pool.
“The black water inside the waterfall is the Spiritual Liquid, drinking up all this water will increase one’s Primordial Energy,” Lin Yi explained.
“So it is,” said Zhang Fei, somewhat worried as he spoke. He still didn’t know how much Spiritual Liquid was contained within the waterfall.
“Don’t worry, it’s no big deal, just drink all this water,” Lin Yi said as he gestured with his hand, taking the black stone from Zhang Fei and flying towards the waterfall.
The black stone fell into the waterfall and disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Lin Yi looked at the black stone in his hand and inwardly rejoiced; he knew this stone was the origin of the pool’s water. If he could assimilate this water, his strength would surge immensely, maybe even propelling him into the Gathering Yuan Realm.
Zhang Fei also noticed the black stone in Lin Yi’s hand, his eyes lighting up as he said, “Brother Lin, is that the black stone? Have you already assimilated it?”
“Yes, I have swallowed the black Spiritual Liquid within. I have now advanced to the Fifth Layer of the Condensing Veins Phase,” Lin Yi nodded in affirmation.
“That’s fantastic! Congratulations on advancing to the Fifth Layer of the Condensing Veins Phase,” Zhang Fei exclaimed joyfully.
“Ha ha, Brother Zhang, not every cultivator who advances to the Fifth Layer of the Condensing Veins Phase can do it as casually as I did. It’s practically a miracle. I think you must be much more powerful than me,” Lin Yi teased with a laugh.
Zhang Fei scratched his head, smiling somewhat sheepishly.
“By the way, Brother Zhang, I came out here mainly to get something for you. You stay here, I will come back to find you,” Lin Yi cautioned.
“Uh-huh, Brother Lin, what are you going to do? Do you need my help?” Zhang Fei asked with concern.
Lin Yi shook his head and said, “I can take care of this matter myself, no need for you to worry.”
Having said that, Lin Yi put Zhang Fei down on the ground and then with a soaring jump, he flew into the waterfall.
“Plop!”
Lin Yi plunged into the waterfall, splashing up a large cloud of mist, and in the blink of an eye, sunk to the bottom of the pool, leaving only his head exposed above the water.
“Junior Brother Lin, I’ll wait for you outside the cave!” Zhang Fei shouted down to the bottom.
“Alright!” Lin Yi responded and then ignored Zhang Fei, continuing to dive to the bottom and began devouring the black water of the pool, absorbing the Spiritual Energy within it.
Zhang Fei watched Lin Yi, who had already sunk to the bottom of the lake, shook his head, and flew towards the middle of the mountain. He was planning to wait outside that cave for Lin Yi’s return.
The Spiritual Power in the water was so rich that Lin Yi kept absorbing the Spiritual Power from it, feeling as though his body was undergoing a transformation.
Lin Yi absorbed for a full quarter of an hour before he crawled out from the bottom of the pool.
Lin Yi looked at the pool and saw that the water, which had been so rich in Spiritual Energy, had been completely drained by him, leaving it clean and devoid of a single drop.
“My constitution is really too good, having absorbed so much Spiritual Power all at once,” Lin Yi thought to himself.
“Junior Brother Lin, the Spiritual Energy in this pool was incredibly rich. If only I could keep absorbing Spiritual Energy like that, it would be great, but alas, I am not qualified!” Zhang Fei sighed at the cave entrance.
Having absorbed the pool water, Lin Yi flew back to the mouth of the cave, refilled the pool with water into his Storage Ring, and placed a Defensive Prohibition around the edge of the Storage Ring to prevent the water from seeping in again.
Afterward, Lin Yi took Zhang Fei and flew down towards the foot of the valley.
“Senior Brother Zhang, wait here for me. Don’t leave, or you might encounter danger,” Lin Yi advised before turning and flying away.
After Lin Yi left, Zhang Fei sat down cross-legged on the ground and closed his eyes.
Lin Yi quickly reached the entrance of the cave.
As he just arrived at the entrance, he saw two giant centipedes perched on the wall at the entrance, watching him warily.
“These two venomous insects must have been left here by the Old Demon of Black Mountain, what should I do now?” Lin Yi muttered to himself as he eyed the two giant centipedes.
“Lin Yi, you dare to barge into my cave without permission, you’re dead meat!” At that moment, a weird voice rang out.
“Whoosh!”
Just then, a figure burst out from the cave entrance of the Old Demon of Black Mountain, turning into a streak of black light and charging towards Lin Yi.
“Swoosh~”
This person was extremely fast and reached Lin Yi’s side in the blink of an eye, clawing at Lin Yi’s shoulder.
Lin Yi was prepared, holding the black stone in his hand, he swung it forward fiercely.
Black light burst forth from the stone, colliding with the person’s attack and enveloping them in darkness.
“Boom!”
The black light erupted, successfully blocking the attack.
The attacker’s figure paused, their face slightly changing, and then, as the black light dissipated, the person walked out from the darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 626 03-25 - 626: Unfathomable Cultivation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 626: Chapter 626: Unfathomable Cultivation!
This was a burly man of towering stature, his face crisscrossed with fierce scars, and his skin dark as ink. A Black Demon Serpent King coiled menacingly across his chest, exuding an aura of ferocious brutality.
Especially his eyes, glittering with a cold, icy gleam, reminiscent of a wild beast lurking in the grass, sent shivers down one’s spine.
“That is the Black Demon Serpent King.”
The moment Lin Yi laid eyes on the Black Demon Serpent King, he instantly recognized it from the “Blood Moon Manual” he had seen before.
This Serpent King, rumored to be an ancient and exotic species, possessed formidable strength, comparable to a Ninth Level Cultivated Martial Artist in the Ethereal Void phase, with immeasurable Cultivation!
Lin Yi hadn’t expected to encounter the Black Demon Serpent King here, but this also proved that the Black Mountain demon was indeed powerful, having managed to tame such an ancient and exotic species.
...
Moreover, it seemed that the Black Demon Serpent King had even acquired a sliver of Spiritual Wisdom, and learned some Divine Skills, which was quite formidable.
“Black Mountain demon, you are indeed here, I have come,” said Lin Yi indifferently, his gaze fixed on the Black Mountain demon as he spoke with detachment.
“Hmph, you brat, you actually dare to trespass into my territory, are you not afraid I will kill you on the spot?” the Black Mountain demon glared furiously at Lin Yi, his voice cold and threatening.
“Heh, Black Mountain demon, I advise you not to act rashly. I am now your savior; should you dare to kill me, my father will never let you off,” Lin Yi sneered in response.
Despite his young age, Lin Yi commanded a deterrence not inferior to that of the Black Mountain demon, a pressure that made the demon feel a hint of dread.
Lin Yi, noticing the Black Mountain demon’s apprehension, let a cold smile play on his lips, then turned and stepped into the cave abode.
Source: , updated on ƝᴑνǤο.сο
“Stop right there!”
The Black Mountain demon roared furiously, his voice thunderous and deafening.
“Black Mountain demon, what exactly do you want? If you keep blocking my way, don’t blame me for turning hostile!” Lin Yi turned back and said coldly, a chilling killing intent flickering in his eyes.
“You little whelp, you dare to threaten me? How arrogant! Do you even know who I am? How dare you threaten me?” he burst into a furious bellow upon hearing Lin Yi’s words.
“Heh, Black Mountain demon, who you are has nothing to do with me, are you scared?” Lin Yi said with a faint smile.
The Black Mountain demon faltered, as Lin Yi pierced through his inner fears, his face reddening as he hastily retorted, “Who said I’m afraid? I’ll have you know, I am the Black Demon Serpent King, the Black Mountain demon. If you kneel and beg for mercy now, I might consider leaving your corpse intact!”
“Heh, Black Mountain demon, you really are shameless, but I really don’t want to kill you right now,” Lin Yi said lightly, his demeanor calm and unruffled.
“Haha, you little pest, you won’t kill me? Then let’s see whose fist is harder!” The Black Mountain demon, upon hearing this, was immediately consumed by a surge of rage, and he threw out a punch.
“Whoosh!”
With that punch from the Black Mountain demon, the space within the entire cave seemed to twist, creating ripples that spread out in all directions.
“Boom!”
“Pfft!”
The punch landed on Lin Yi, sending him stumbling back several steps. Then Lin Yi spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, as blood oozed from his lips.
Upon seeing Lin Yi injured, the Black Mountain demon was overjoyed and took a large stride forward, closing the distance in one step and unleashing another palm strike.
Lin Yi once again spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, his body flying backward and smashing two steles before finally coming to a halt.
“Hahaha, kid, it looks like I guessed right; you really don’t have what it takes, even if you take out that black stone, you can do nothing against me,” the Black Mountain demon laughed uproariously, looking at Lin Yi spewing blood.
“Black Mountain demon, don’t go too far!” Lin Yi gritted his teeth and shouted.
“Bully you? Haha, you’re not even worthy of that. I could crush you like an ant with just one finger,” the Black Mountain demon laughed arrogantly.
“Black Mountain demon, do you think I’m a three-year-old child? Do you really take me for a fool?” Lin Yi glared at the Black Mountain demon, saying, “If you were really that capable, why would you send minions to chase after me?”
“Hmph, boy, since you knew my minions were after you, why didn’t you run away? Clearly, you fear death and dare not escape, only able to obediently meet your end. Just admit it, this time you’re undoubtedly doomed to die!” Black Mountain the Demon sneered at Lin Yi, his words dripping with mockery.
“Black Mountain the Demon, since you claim to have sent your minions after me, then you might as well call them over now, and let me see what they’re capable of,” Lin Yi said indifferently.
“Fine! I’ll call them over and let them show you what’s what!” Black Mountain the Demon nodded, then with a flick of his hand, a swirl of black mist surged, condensing into a man in blue clothing with a snake tail and a pair of wings on his back.
This man looked to be in his twenties, with a handsome face and a tall, burly frame, appearing quite dashing.
He wore a black robe, and there were two pairs of pitch-black wings on his back.
“I pay my respects to my lord.”
The man bowed deeply, his respect absolute.
“Hei Feng, this brat is yours to deal with. Capture him alive for me and throw him into the Black Prison!” Black Mountain the Demon commanded.
“As you command, my lord,” Hei Feng said, bowing with a fist over his heart.
“Hmph, boy, soon you’ll taste Hei Feng’s prowess and see how he toys with your life,” Black Mountain the Demon sneered, a glint of mockery flashing in his eyes.
“Hmph! Black Mountain the Demon, I’m curious to see what tricks you can pull off!” Lin Yi also scoffed, his eyes filled with contempt.
“Brat, you’ll soon know the extent of my Hei Feng’s power,” Hei Feng said, looking at Lin Yi with a cold voice.
“Hei Feng, kill this brat, don’t leave him a dog’s life!” Black Mountain the Demon waved grandly.
“Yes, my lord!”
Upon hearing the order, Hei Feng immediately responded, transforming into a streak of light that lunged at Lin Yi.
“Hmph! Petty tricks, and you presume to match me? Die!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, his body suddenly shuddered, and a rich Dark Aura enveloped him.
Under the cloak of this Dark Aura, Lin Yi’s body suddenly grew several feet taller, and his aura dramatically intensified, becoming immensely powerful, like a demonic god, awe-inspiring and fearsome to all who looked on.
“What… what kind of monstrosity is this?”
Black Mountain the Demon was taken aback, startled by the eerie scene before him, his face showing surprise as he looked at Lin Yi.
“Die!”
Lin Yi lifted his foot, stepping through the void, moving towards Hei Feng with teleport-like speed, and threw a punch. A torrential fist intent burst from Lin Yi’s fist, as though it could destroy everything!
“What? What kind of Martial Arts is this?”
“Impossible, the Fist Technique he just used was clearly only a common one, how could its power be so tremendous!” Hei Feng felt the terror of Lin Yi’s Fist Technique, cried out in alarm, but was too late to evade.
“Boom!”
With that one strike, Lin Yi carried boundless terrifying force, punching out and instantly piercing through Hei Feng’s Protective Gang Qi, striking Hei Feng’s chest, and directly blasting his body to pieces, scattering into a shower of blood rain.
“Hei Feng!”
“Lord Hei Feng!”
Witnessing this scene, those under Hei Feng’s command all showed stunned expressions, waves of shock rolling in their hearts.
“Hmph, is this the strength of Lord Hei Feng? Pathetic!” Lin Yi sneered with disdain and turned to fly deeper into the cave.

chapters.title: Chapter 627 03-25 - 627: Couldn't Snap Out of It for a Long Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 627: Chapter 627: Couldn’t Snap Out of It for a Long Time
The Black Mountain old demon stood dumbfounded on the spot, unable to regain his senses for a long time, his eyes wide with disbelief.
Hei Feng, that was his personal bodyguard, the most capable subordinate by his side.
Hei Feng was half a step into the realm of immortals, with combat power comparable to the Nascent Soul Stage—indeed a renowned figure within Black Mountain City.
But this young man in green, with just one punch, had instantly killed Hei Feng; it was horrifying, terrifying!
Could this young man in green truly possess some peculiar secret technique, as the rumors suggested? Otherwise, how could he have such heaven-defying strength!
“Black Mountain old demon, I advise you better release me. Otherwise, I won’t be courteous. I can assure you, if I weren’t in this ancient cave, I would have slain your people long ago.”
...
Lin Yifei arrived at the cave entrance and said indifferently to the Black Mountain old demon inside, his tone calm and unwavering.
“Hmph, boy, don’t be arrogant. I will capture you now, and then have Hei Feng refine you!”
“How daring!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, a formidable dark aura burst forth from his body, enveloping the entire cave and causing the temperature within to plummet.
“This kid’s dark aura is terrifying, even more sinister than that of the Black Mountain old demon. No wonder he dares to provoke the Black Mountain old demon!” The Black Mountain old demon was inwardly aghast, his eyes filled with panic.
This surge of dark aura made the Black Mountain old demon feel icy cold all over, as if suffocating.
Source: , updated on ƝονǤօ.ƈᴑ
He didn’t dare to delay, his figure flickered, and he vanished from the cave entrance in an instant, leaving no trace behind.
Although the Black Mountain old demon was more powerful than Hei Feng, he did not possess Dark Divine Power and could not use the dark aura. Therefore, under the oppression of the dark aura, he felt as if he had sunk into a quagmire, his movements became sluggish, and his speed was greatly reduced.
“Hmph!”
Seeing the Black Mountain old demon flee, Lin Yi snorted coldly, his figure also disappeared from the cave.
Shortly after the two vanished, Hei Feng appeared in the cave.
Hei Feng’s gaze swept around, but he could not find any trace of the Black Mountain old demon.
“Where is the Black Mountain old demon?” Hei Feng asked with a frown.
“Lord Hei Feng, we just saw the Black Mountain old demon leave with that young man. We don’t know their destination,” Hei Feng’s subordinate hurriedly reported.
“Hmph! Can he run away? I’ll pursue immediately!”
Having said this, Hei Feng’s figure also flashed, disappearing without a trace.
With Hei Feng taking the Black Mountain old demon away, Lin Yi continued to move forward in the cave.
The Black Mountain old demon’s strength was far beyond that of Hei Feng. He was incredibly fast and disappeared from Lin Yi’s sight in almost the blink of an eye, leaving Lin Yi staring dumbfounded at the place where the two had departed.
“Damn it! How can the Black Mountain old demon be so fast? My speed can’t even catch up with him!” Lin Yi frowned and said.
Although he could shrink the ground beneath his feet to cover a kilometer in an instant, he was leagues behind the Black Mountain old demon.
“My speed cannot fully burst forth. To completely unleash it, I need to consume a large amount of blood essence and Soul Power. Right now, I simply can’t do it.” Lin Yi shook his head.
“However, the Black Mountain old demon’s Physical Body has been taken by me, and he will surely hate me to the bone. Once he knows my whereabouts, he will surely strike at me, so I must improve my strength as soon as possible.”
Thinking this, Lin Yi quickened his pace and moved forward.
“Eh? This cave is strange; I can’t seem to reach the end, as if blocked by a Great Formation, unable to move forward!”
Not long after, Lin Yi halted, his brow slightly furrowed, his expression turning serious.
“It seems to be a trapping Formation; I can only proceed to the next area by breaking through the Formation.” Lin Yi pondered for a moment, then with a thought, a dazzling Purple Gold Thunderbolt burst forth, transforming into a silver-white armor that covered his body, with a purple Divine Sword suspended above his head.
“Buzz!”
The Purple Gold Thunder and the silver-white thunder merged into one, forming a Thunder Lightning Divine Sword radiating purple thunder light!
This was a set of purple gold armor he had plundered from within the cave dwelling, boasting astonishing defensive power and possessing some amplifying functions, able to enhance attacks, enhance defenses.
“Go!”
Lin Yi let out a low shout, stimulating the Thunder Lightning Divine Sword and slashing fiercely forward, a huge purple gold sword light roaring out, directly cleaving towards the spatial barrier ahead.
“Bang!”
A loud collision sounded as the sword light struck the spatial barrier, which instantly shattered, revealing the scene ahead.
In front of him lay a pitch-black corridor, and in front of the pitch-black corridor stood a massive stone door, engraved with a pitch-black demonic beast totem, emitting waves of dark mist, rendering the entire corridor chilling and terrifying, filled with an eerie aura that made one’s skin crawl.
“Is this a maze?”
After seeing the scene clearly, Lin Yi could not help but frown.
A maze!
This was a maze!
Within the pitch-black corridor in front of Lin Yi, there were stone chambers, each embedded with various restrictions.
These stone chambers were all built from different types of stones and were extremely hard, containing terrifying power, forming a highly dangerous maze.
Once someone entered the stone chamber, they would be trapped to death, never able to leave again, perhaps remaining there forever until death or devoured by those dark and evil creatures.
“It seems that to enter the maze, I must first dismantle the restriction. Once I have destroyed all the restrictions within the maze, I will be able to leave the maze.”
Lin Yi pondered for a moment before he had an idea in mind.
“Swoosh!”
Lin Yi stepped forward and appeared inside a stone chamber.
“Boom!”
Within the chamber, the stone walls trembled as huge black boulders fell from above.
These black boulders were all piled up, reaching hundreds of feet tall, densely packed, blocking out the sky above Lin Yi.
“What a massive cluster of black stones, it looks like a giant mine pit.”
Lin Yi surveyed the stone chamber in front of him and secretly marveled.
This giant mine pit was over a hundred feet wide and five to six hundred feet tall, plunging down hundreds of feet deep, appearing extremely vast.
Putting his hand on the wall of the mine pit, Lin Yi felt the stone was ice-cold and incredibly hard, worthy of being a huge mine pit.
Lin Yi circulated the Mysterious Technique within his body, and immediately streams of purple gold thunder surged out, intertwining before him to form a purple gold thunder net.
“Rumble!”
The purple gold thunder net covered the entire mine pit, instantly encompassing everything within it, causing the stone walls to be covered with thick thunder snakes.
Under Lin Yi’s control, the purple gold thunder net swiftly contracted, collecting all the black stones, but he was unable to fit them all into the Purple Gold Gourd. Instead, they were trapped outside the Purple Gold Gourd.
“Phew, it’s a good thing I refined the Purple Gold Gourd into a sacred treasure, otherwise, I wouldn’t be able to take these black stones!”
Lin Yi breathed a sigh of relief, thinking to himself.
“Since this mine is so huge and the black stones inside are extremely sturdy, I might as well use this place to cultivate inside!”
Determined, Lin Yi sat down cross-legged, his feet hovering in the void, running the Cultivation Technique, absorbing the thunderous forces from heaven and earth, tempering his physical body.
Lin Yi’s body, after being tempered by the Purple Gold Thunder, had become incredibly tough, his physical body incredibly strong to the extreme, on par with a Cultivator at the Seventh Layer of the Divine Origin Realm.
Lin Yi’s True Yuan surged wildly, wreaking havoc within his body like a vast ocean, with waves of immense power sweeping through his entire body.

chapters.title: Chapter 628 628: Emitting Dazzling Brilliance
chapters.content:
Next to Lin Yi, a myriad of black stars danced, emitting dazzling light, enveloping him in a galaxy world.
Brilliant light radiated from Lin Yi's body, and some of the black stars around him broke away from the earth and floated over, entering the sea of stars.
Lin Yi sat cross-legged in place, continuously channeling the power of the stars into his body, constantly tempering his physical frame.
"Zizz, zizz!"
Strange noises came from within Lin Yi's body, like electricity crackling, emitting grating, piercing sounds that made the hair on his skin stand on end, and he couldn't help but shiver with cold.
On Lin Yi's body surface, a faint purple glow could vaguely be seen.
This was Lin Yi's physical body undergoing transformation.
His physical body was transforming into a purple gold color; he had attained the Purple Gold Immortal Body!
The Purple Gold Immortal Body could withstand more violent thunder strikes, and also resist most of the thunder without being hurt!
"Hmm? These black stars actually contain an extremely rich thunder attribute power, and not just one of them. The thunder attribute power in this mine pit is too violent, if I cultivate here, I'm afraid I will be killed by the lightning!"
Feeling his Purple Gold Immortal Body undergoing an insane transformation, Lin Yi's expression instantly became solemn.
This kind of transformation gave Lin Yi a sense of crisis.
The Purple Gold Immortal Body was a ninth grade immortal technique, extremely difficult to cultivate. It required absorbing endless thunder, taking in its violent power, so as to enter and transform into the Purple Gold Immortal Body!
If Lin Yi couldn't absorb any of the thunder power, he feared it might backlash against him and cause his body to explode and die.
"Forget it, I should first find that tomb chamber, and then look for other stone doors. Finding the door should allow me to enter the chamber smoothly and then absorb the thunder to temper my physical body!"
With a thought, Lin Yi left the stone chamber.
Lin Yi walked around inside the stone chamber, searching for the stone doors.
In this stone chamber, each door had a large "Restriction" character on it, sealing the doors. Lin Yi couldn't open them rashly, lest he disturb the tomb chamber beyond.
"Eh? How come there are two stone chambers?"
While Lin Yi was searching for the tomb chamber, he suddenly discovered an abnormal situation.
In the center of those two chambers, there was a massive stele!
"These two steles are quite peculiar, seemingly engraved with something?"
Lin Yi's gaze flashed, and he hurried forward to examine the text on the steles.
"Stele: Ancient Texts."
These three simple and archaic characters were engraved on the stele, very plain, with no special embellishments. Yet, mysterious ancient runes were inscribed on it, appearing extremely mysterious, seemingly related to some secrets recorded in the tomb.
"A stele? To have such a strange stone in the tomb, I must take it back for study."
Lin Yi's eyes lit up, storing the stele into his storage ring, then he quickly headed for another stone chamber.
This time, Lin Yi didn't stay long inside before finding a stone chamber.
The chamber was pitch-dark, without the slightest light penetrating inside.
Lin Yi stood in front of the stone door, released the Purple Gold Gourd, and lifted the restrictions on the two stone doors.
"Whoosh!"
As the stone doors opened, a wave of cold air rushed forth.
In the stone chamber, there was a cave, dark as ink, where one couldn't see their own fingers, and it was impossible to discern the surroundings.
Inside the cave, huge blocks of black stone were placed, each carved with ancient and complex runes, from which an archaic aura leaked out.
Lin Yi observed the black stones carefully and found that their material was somewhat similar to black crystal, yet also somewhat different.
"Could these black stones all be some precious Black Crystals?"
Lin Yi guessed in his heart, suddenly taken aback. He had not expected that within these black stones, such precious materials were hidden. If he could refine and absorb all these Black Crystals, perhaps he could enhance his Physical Body!
These Black Crystals all contained immense Thunder Power, truly a treasure.
Lin Yi was tempted.
If he could refine and absorb all these Black Crystals, he might be able to break through to a new level with his Purple Gold Immortal Body.
Without hesitation, Lin Yi released the Purple Gold Gourd and collected the Black Crystals into it.
Inside the Purple Gold Gourd, Purple Gold Thunderflame burned continuously, destroying the Black Crystals and melting them into droplets of black liquid, which were then funneled into Lin Yi's Dantian.
"Hmm? It seems to be some kind of Elixir, delicious in taste and containing a strong life essence. I wonder if it could help further enhance my Physical Body," Lin Yi wondered with curiosity, but still collected the black medicinal liquid and swallowed it down.
Once the black medicinal liquid entered his stomach, it was enveloped by black flames and then began to burn.
In the process of burning, the black Elixir began to decompose, turning into clouds of black mist that merged into Lin Yi's flesh and bones.
This black mist turned into wisps of energy, constantly infiltrating Lin Yi's flesh and bones, tempering his Physical Body and strengthening his veins.
A strong Medicinal Effect spread throughout Lin Yi's flesh and blood.
Lin Yi felt his Physical Body undergoing a rapid transformation, becoming more robust, and his flesh and blood even more refined.
"Indeed a good item. If I could absorb more of such medicine, my Physical Body might transform and ascend to the Ninth Grade Immortal Artifact," Lin Yi rejoiced in his heart.
If his Physical Body could reach the level of a First Grade Immortal Artifact, within the younger generation of Heavenly Sword Manor, surely no one would be his match any longer!
This way, he wouldn't have to fear those disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect!
"Hmm, there are still quite a few Herbs here. Why don't I gather them all," Lin Yi thought to himself and began to pick the Herbs.
In this valley, Lin Yi encountered many Herbs, but they were not considered rare. Only the extremely precious Herbs were worth his effort to pick.
One by one, Lin Yi harvested the Herbs and sent them into the Qiankun Immortal Ring, planning to bring them back to his master, Ye Changkong, for Refinement into Elixirs.
"Boom, boom!"
Suddenly, the entire valley echoed with the sound of muffled thunder, and waves of black Demonic Qi surged skyward from the entrance, causing palpitations!
Lin Yi was startled.
This situation felt very ominous to him!
"What is this Demonic Qi doing here?"
Lin Yi's mind was shaken. He quickly projected his Divine Sense to look outside, wanting to see what was happening.
At this look, Lin Yi's face instantly showed a look of utter horror.
At the entrance of the cave, a black-robed youth was suspended mid-air. He wore black clothes, had his hands clasped behind his back, and his face bore a fierce expression as he howled at the sky.
Next to this black-robed youth, a giant python was coiling around, and a man in a black robe stood on the python's head, looking down at Lin Yi with a sneer.
The aura emanating from the black-robed youth was extremely strong and terrifying, frightening even Lin Yi.
The black-robed man was none other than Liu Yun, the eldest disciple of the Heavenly Sword Sect!
And the man standing atop the giant python's head was Li Yuan, the third disciple of the Heavenly Sword Sect, also an extremely formidable expert.
These two had been guarding this place all along, waiting for Lin Yi in the depths of the cave dwelling.

chapters.title: Chapter 629 629 Lurking in the Shadows
chapters.content:
"Lin Yi, you truly didn't disappoint me. I thought you would run away! Ha ha! Unexpectedly, you dared to come here; truly foolish. Do you really think you can escape with your life before me? Ha ha!"
Liu Yun laughed wildly.
"Liu Yun, so it was you. You despicable cowards, how dare you block this place!"
Fury flickered in Lin Yi's eyes. He had not anticipated that Liu Yun would have been lurking in the shadows all this time, wanting to kill him to silence him!
The giant serpent behind Liu Yun was actually a demon beast, and furthermore, a demon snake with its whole body covered in scale armor, radiating an aura of evil.
With a shake of the demon snake's body, a cloud of black qi spread out, forming a black vortex, trying to draw Lin Yi toward it.
That black vortex was extremely terrifying, its breath suffocating. Even Lin Yi's soul was nearly drawn into it.
"Such a terrifying aura, what kind of demon beast is this? Why is it so bizarre!"
Lin Yi was greatly shocked in his heart.
"Lin Yi, you trash, dare to intrude into my cave abode; you're really courting death!"
Liu Yun bellowed furiously, "Will you capture yourself quietly or do you want us to take you by force?"
"Hmph! Want to capture me? What a fool's dream! Both of you come at me, even if I have to stake my life today, I must slay this damned bastard!"
Lin Yi sneered coldly.
Both Liu Yun and Li Yuan became furious at those words.
"Hmph, since you refuse the toast only to drink a forfeit, then go to your death!"
Liu Yun roared, and with a sweep of his hand, the giant python by his side opened its huge gaping mouth and bit viciously, swallowing Lin Yi whole.
Lin Yi's body was consumed by the python.
"Boom!"
Lin Yi's body exploded, turning into a spray of blood that splattered on the ground.
"Lin Yi!"
Seeing that Lin Yi had been devoured, Zi Yan, Yang Ying'er, and Zhao Qian'er all turned extremely pale, with teary eyes.
"Hmph, just a little beast, daring to offend us both. He's dead now; it doesn't matter at all."
Liu Yun sneered disdainfully.
Although Liu Yun was a cultivator, he had not entered any immortal cultivation sect, so he was not qualified to enter Holy City; moreover, he was in the outer areas without much influence.
In the Holy City, the Heavenly Sword Sect was considered a major sect with immense power. Although he had some skill, he was just an average disciple, unable to provoke the powerful members of the Heavenly Sword Sect, only hiding here waiting for an opportunity.
They had been waiting for such a long time and finally found their chance.
While Lin Yi was gathering herbs, the two men silently sneaked into the cave. At the cave entrance, they left behind two puppets. The moment Lin Yi fled the cave, the puppets followed him, waiting for the perfect moment to attack.
The two puppets stood guard outside the cave for half a day, only following Lin Yi after he left the valley, ready to make a move.
The two had already predicted that Lin Yi would not dare to resist, which is why they were so brazen, adopting an arrogant demeanor, all to humiliate Lin Yi.
Unfortunately, the puppets did not kill Lin Yi; instead, Lin Yi killed them!
"Damn it, that little beast's movement technique is too fast; we can't get close to him!"
Liu Yun's face darkened; he had thought he could capture Lin Yi easily, but instead, Lin Yi had escaped, shaming him.
"Hmph! It's only because that little beast is too lucky, managing to escape from our attacks by chance, but he is not invincible. Later, when you capture him, we will torture him slowly, flaying and slicing him thousands of times!"
Li Yuan said with a chilling tone.
Liu Yun nodded, his gaze icy cold.
He and Li Yuan, one on the left and one on the right, surrounded Lin Yi's cave, their postures declaring a vow to guard this cave to the death.
They both knew that Lin Yi was a natural-born genius, and if they allowed Lin Yi to escape, he would definitely grow stronger in the future, which would be a disaster for the Heavenly Sword Sect.
They had to snuff him out before he could fully grow!
"These two men, they really deserve to die!"
A cold light flickered in Lin Yi's eyes, his face as cold as ice.
"Brother Lin, these two are too cunning. If you want to escape from their clutches, I'm afraid it'll be very difficult."
Zi Yan said worriedly; she knew that Lin Yi's cultivation was still very weak and that he was certainly no match for Liu Yun and Li Yuan when they joined forces.
"Hmph, I don't believe that with my own strength, I can't defeat them. However, I need to bide my time for now, recover my strength, and then seek an opportunity to take them both out in one fell swoop!"
Lin Yi thought coldly to himself, paying no further attention to Zi Yan and Zhao Qian'er.
"Sister Zi, Sister Qian'er, Brother Lin shouldn't have any trouble. His cultivation is quite high, so there's no need to worry too much."
Yang Ying'er tried to reassure them softly, but her face remained very tense, seemingly still worried.
Zi Yan nodded her head silently, saying no more, but her heart was constantly concerned about Lin Yi, fearing he might be harmed.
With Lin Yi's cave surrounded and the two puppets killed by him, Liu Yun and Li Yuan felt extremely frustrated but dared not to act rashly. After all, Lin Yi's strength was not weak, and if they acted carelessly, they would surely face his counterattack.
There was a formation protecting the cave, so they could only watch helplessly as Lin Yi left.
Although they despised Lin Yi deeply, they didn't dare to take the risk to intercept him, to avoid the formation's backlash and injuring themselves.
After Lin Yi left, the two returned to report the matter to their master.
"Lin Yi?"
Upon hearing the news, a shadow of seriousness crossed the old hag's brow. She pondered for a moment before saying to Liu Yun, "You must take people and kill Lin Yi immediately. There's absolutely no way we can let Lin Yi leave the Holy City alive!"
"Yes, Master!"
Liu Yun quickly agreed with great respect and then led hundreds of Heavenly Sword Sect's disciples towards the Holy City, ready to kill Lin Yi.
With the strong power and numerous disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect, Liu Yun was confident that he could kill Lin Yi!
In Lin Yi's cave dwelling, Lin Yi sat cross-legged on a large stone.
In the center of the cave, three pieces of Spiritual Medicine were laid out, each pitch black and exuding a strong aura of life – they were the Ninth Rank Black Lotus Fruit. On another side was another piece of Spiritual Medicine, also pitch black like jade, one of the Wood-Attribute Spiritual Medicines from the Five Elements.
As for the other Spiritual Medicine hanging from that tree, they were all collected by Lin Yi.
These Spiritual Medicines were the essential ingredients for the refinement of Ninth Rank Elixirs. If he could refine all these ingredients into Elixirs, Lin Yi's combat power would soar far beyond any previous level.
What Lin Yi lacked most now was combat power!
"It seems I need to continue collecting Spiritual Medicines; otherwise, after I improve the quality of the Elixirs, I may not be able to kill those two!"
Lin Yi mused to himself as he started to collect all three Spiritual Medicines, placing them into his Storage Ring.
Just as he was about to put the Spiritual Medicines into the Storage Ring, suddenly, the Storage Ring began to tremble violently.
Lin Yi was startled and cursed in his mind, quickly ceasing his collection of Spiritual Medicines and opening the Storage Ring to investigate.
"This..."
Lin Yi looked at the three medicinal ingredients inside the Storage Ring, his face turning pale instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 630 630: Pondering in Secret
chapters.content:
"How is that possible? Weren't all three Spiritual Medicines exhausted during our last hunt? How could they suddenly appear? Could it be that someone got ahead and snatched these three medicinal herbs?"
Lin Yi's heart was filled with shock, and with disbelief, he stared at the three Spiritual Medicines in his hand, his mind went blank.
"Regardless, these three Spiritual Medicines are very important to me; I must urgently send them back."
Lin Yi pondered in secret for a moment, then took out the three Spiritual Medicines.
He was very clear in his heart that if these three Spiritual Medicines were lost, his path of cultivation would also come to an absolute end, his Cultivation would no longer advance, and might even regress!
"I must hurry back to my sect and deliver these three Spiritual Medicines to my master!"
Lin Yi's mind raced, and he immediately ran outside.
"Brother Lin, what's wrong? Why did you suddenly run off?"
Seeing Lin Yi suddenly running out, Zi Yan and Zhao Qian'er were both stunned and asked in confusion.
"Zi Yan, Sister Qian'er, I'm sorry, I have to return to the sect immediately. You two stay in the cave, don't come out lightly in case someone catches you!"
Lin Yi left these words behind and ran out immediately, disappearing into the night.
Zi Yan and Zhao Qian'er exchanged glances, both revealing a hint of confusion.
"Zi Yan, Sister Qian'er, what are you doing?"
Just then, a shout came from outside the cave from Liu Yun.
Hearing Liu Yun's voice, both Zi Yan and Zhao Qian'er's complexions changed slightly.
"Lin Yi shouldn't be in any trouble, right? Liu Yun is sinister and vicious, if they find out we've been secretly gathering these three Spiritual Medicines, they definitely won't let us off."
Zhao Qian'er's face had a slight change as she whispered.
Zi Yan didn't speak, but she prayed in her heart that Lin Yi would be alright.
Although their interactions with Lin Yi weren't deep, from their encounter that night, she felt that Lin Yi was a person of kindness and passion, and they didn't want anything bad to happen to him!
Zi Yan's heart was filled with anxiety, wishing she could leave this mountain immediately and return to Lin Yi's side to protect him.
"Zi Yan, Sister Qian'er, is there something wrong? Why do you look so pale?"
Liu Yun, seeing the poor expressions on both Zi Yan and Zhao Qian'er, asked with concern.
"Ah! Brother Liu Yun, it's nothing! We were just a bit tired just now, but we're fine now, let's continue gathering Spiritual Medicine."
Zi Yan panicked for a moment, then immediately calmed down and smiled as she shook her head.
