Zhao Qian'er also smiled and nodded; although she didn't know how much of Zi Yan's words were true, seeing Zi Yan act this way, she also echoed a few words.
"I see. Sisters Zi Yan and Qian'er, you've worked hard these days. Here are the three Spiritual Medicines for you, take them and use them. Whether you can break through or not is up to you now."
After Liu Yun spoke, he handed the three Spiritual Medicines over to Zi Yan and Zhao Qian'er.
"This..."
Zi Yan and Zhao Qian'er both hesitated, unsure of what to do.
"Zi Yan, don't hesitate, these Spiritual Medicines are for you, take them and use them."
Zhao Qian'er urged, not wanting to miss out on the three Spiritual Medicines.
Zi Yan looked at Zhao Qian'er, seeing the longing in her eyes, and then nodded her head, smiling as she accepted the three Spiritual Medicines.
"Alright, you two hurry up and use them. I'll be waiting for you at the entrance of the cave."
Liu Yun waved his hand and then left.
Zhao Qian'er and Zi Yan nodded at each other, promptly swallowed the Spiritual Medicine, and began to cultivate to absorb its effects.
Seeing this, Lin Yi's heart slightly relaxed, and he too left the entrance of the cave, heading back in the direction of the Saint Demon Palace.
After Lin Yi returned to the Saint Demon Palace, he went straight to the residence of the ancestor of the Saint Demon Palace.
The ancestor of the Saint Demon Palace's dwelling was a separate building. Arriving there, Lin Yi discovered many attendant disciples standing outside, including an elder among them.
Inside the dwelling of the Saint Demon Palace's ancestor.
The ancestor of the Saint Demon Palace sat on a chair with his eyes closed, resting, while several disciples stood beside him. All these disciples had been participants in the previous trial, and among them were three who had been part of the group of attendant disciples attacked in the Saint Demon Mountain Range.
"Ancestor of the Saint Demon Palace, we were defeated by a kid named Lin Yi. He has completely disgraced us, please administer punishment!"
An attendant disciple said bitterly, looking at the ancestor of the Saint Demon Palace with resentment.
The other attendant disciples also stared at the Saint Demon Palace's ancestor with indignation.
Previously, Lin Yi's cultivation had been weak, and the Saint Demon Palace's ancestor couldn't be bothered with him. But Lin Yi's cultivation increased manyfold all at once, causing them to lose face, and so these attendant disciples directed their ire at the Saint Demon Palace's ancestor, believing that it was his failure to discipline them properly that led to their great loss in the trial.
The ancestor of the Saint Demon Palace opened his eyes upon hearing this, and an indifferent and ruthless gaze swept over the attendant disciples.
A shock ran through the hearts of these attendant disciples, and an involuntary chill made their bodies tremble.
"Do you wish to seek death? You are not our disciples at the Saint Demon Palace, so why should we stand up for you, why should we seek justice for you! Hmph! If you wish to live, it would be best for you to avoid provoking that Lin Yi from now on. Otherwise, even I won't be able to save you!"
The ancestor of the Saint Demon Palace gave a cold look to everyone, and his icy voice filled the room, causing everyone to shiver.
Hearing the words of the Saint Demon Palace's ancestor, the faces of the crowd changed repeatedly.
"Yes, yes, thank you for your teachings, your protection, and your grace, Ancestor of the Saint Demon Palace!"
Everyone repeatedly bowed, expressing their gratitude to the Saint Demon Palace's ancestor.
"Hmm."
The ancestor of the Saint Demon Palace responded dispassionately and closed his eyes again, seemingly falling asleep.
Seeing this, everyone sighed helplessly in their hearts. Not knowing what else to say, they turned and left the dwelling of the Saint Demon Palace's ancestor.
After everyone had left, the Saint Demon Palace's ancestor slowly opened his eyes again, watching the backs of the departing people. A chilling cold smile emerged on his lips, "Lin Yi, do you think that just because the trial is over, you can be safe? Hehe, too naive. I will make sure you understand what true despair is."
...
Lin Yi returned to the Saint Demon Palace and headed straight toward the dwelling of the Saint Demon Palace's ancestor.
He wanted to inquire about the elixirs from Liu Yun, but the instant he was about to enter the dwelling, he suddenly felt rigid, as if restrained by an invisible force. His legs seemed to be locked in place and he was unable to move forward, forced to stay where he was.
"What's happening?"
Lin Yi was shocked.
Then, he heard a majestic voice enter his ears.
"Lin Yi, you have finally returned."
Hearing that voice, Lin Yi suddenly froze.
Turning his head, Lin Yi saw the Saint Demon Palace's ancestor standing outside the dwelling, looking extremely pale, with a stooped figure, as if he would collapse with the slightest breeze.
Moreover, the ancestor's body trembled as though enduring tremendous pain; sweat poured down his forehead, and his face was pallid and bloodless, looking extremely weak, as if he were ill.
Seeing this, Lin Yi frowned, his expression becoming solemn.

chapters.title: Chapter 631: The Chaos of Internal Spiritual Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 631: Chapter 631: The Chaos of Internal Spiritual Power
Lin Yi’s Divine Sense swept over the body of the grandmaster of the Saint Demon Sect and found that the Spiritual Power within was in disarray, as if he had suffered a great battle.
Moreover, the grandmaster’s Cultivation was plummeting rapidly. It seemed that his injuries were more serious than anticipated, perhaps to the point of being completely worn out, with the danger of falling at any moment!
Seeing this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but frown. He knew that the grandmaster must have done this to help him seize that Divine Medicine.
“Grandmaster, why do you do this? Is it worth it? I don’t need your help at all; by doing this, aren’t you harming yourself?”
Lin Yi said with a frown.
“Haha, do you think I’m doing this for myself? You’re wrong; it’s for the Saint Demon Sect, for you, my disciple. I’m willing to sacrifice my life!”
The grandmaster of the Saint Demon Sect laughed heartily as his face was filled with determination.
As the grandmaster spoke so candidly, Lin Yi was deeply shaken; he hadn’t expected the grandmaster to be so magnanimous. This kindness was something he couldn’t repay in a lifetime!
“Grandmaster, since you’ve said so, I won’t be overly modest. Whatever your command, I, Lin Yi, will go through fire and water without hesitation!”
“Haha! Good! Very good!”
The Saint Demon Sect’s grandmaster couldn’t stop laughing upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, clapping his hands while doing so.
“Alright, since you’ve agreed, I have nothing more to caution you about. If you ever seek help in the future, you can come to me, and I will do my utmost to assist you!”
The grandmaster said cheerfully.
Lin Yi nodded and accepted the offer.
“Then I will take my leave. Rest well!”
Lin Yi bid farewell with a cupped fist salute and turned to leave.
“Wait!”
Suddenly, the grandmaster called out to him.
“Do you have any further instructions, Grandmaster?”
Lin Yi turned his head to look at the grandmaster.
After a moment of silence, the grandmaster said, “Lin Yi, I have something to tell you, but this matter must remain between us. You absolutely must not let it out, or else all the disciples of the Saint Demon Sect will be killed.”
“Don’t worry, Grandmaster; I won’t divulge such a matter. You can be assured.”
Lin Yi quickly gave his assurance, then turned and left the place.
Watching Lin Yi’s departing figure, the grandmaster’s lips curled into a strange smile and he muttered, “Lin Yi, oh Lin Yi, I hope you will remember my words. If you don’t keep your promise, I won’t be so kind to you.”
…
Lin Yi emerged from his cave dwelling and saw the empty space outside, with not a single disciple practicing. A sense of loss surged in his heart. He had wanted to find Liu Yun and Liu Ruxue to inquire about the Elixir but had not expected that there would be no one here.
Lin Yi shook his head and headed toward his residence, preparing to practice.
Back at his place, Lin Yi began circulating his Cultivation Technique to absorb Yuan Force and recover the spent Yuan Force.
In recent times, within the ancient bronze city, Lin Yi had been frantically absorbing and refining the Heavenly Crystal Stone.
Despite the limited amount Lin Yi could absorb, the immense Spiritual Power contained in the Heavenly Crystal Stones had led to a rapid improvement in his strength. Now, he was a practitioner at the Seventh Layer of the Foundation Establishment Stage, just a step away from the Eighth Layer. Once Lin Yi made the breakthrough, he would be able to enter the Ninth Level of Foundation Establishment.
Foundation Establishment, as the name suggests, refers to the Realm of reaching the Foundation Establishment Stage in cultivation.
This also meant that Lin Yi’s power was about to increase significantly!
Lin Yi had been continuously devouring and absorbing Primordial Crystal Stones, cultivating at an extremely rapid pace, continuously enhancing his cultivation. It was only when midnight arrived that Lin Yi stopped his cultivation to begin meditative breathing exercises, preparing to continue his cultivation the next day.
The night quickly passed by.
As dawn broke and the first ray of sunlight spilled in, Lin Yi slowly opened his eyes, a sharp gleam passing through them. He exuded a rich aura, clearly indicating that his cultivation had reached the peak of the Seventh Layer in the Foundation Establishment Stage!
Lin Yi stood up and stretched his body.
“Unknowingly, I have already spent three months in the Bronze Ancient City; I wonder how Liu Yun and Liu Ruxue’s injuries have healed.”
Lin Yi muttered to himself softly and then began walking outside the cave dwelling.
As soon as Lin Yi appeared, he saw several reverent elders from the Law Enforcement Hall guarding the entrance of the cave dwelling, their eyes filled with awe when they looked at him. After all, the power Lin Yi displayed in last night’s great battle had completely exceeded their expectations.
And the old ancestor of the Saint Demon Sect had been defeated by Lin Yi and even had his Dantian destroyed, turning him into a cripple.
The performance of Lin Yi gave the elders of the Law Enforcement Hall a glimpse of dawn.
In this world, there is no shortage of monster-level geniuses, and as long as Lin Yi continues to grow, he will inevitably become a pillar of the Saint Demon Sect and the sect will certainly flourish even more.
Upon seeing Lin Yi, the reverent elders of the Law Enforcement Hall immediately bowed respectfully and said, “Uncle-Master Lin Yi, good morning!”
Lin Yi nodded slightly and responded softly, then stepped out of the cave dwelling.
In front of the elders from the Law Enforcement Hall, Lin Yi didn’t dare to act too arrogantly, lest these elders feel disrespected by him.
However, Lin Yi’s attitude made the elders feel a chill in their hearts and deepened their reverence for him.
When Lin Yi appeared outside, a group of disciples from the Law Enforcement Hall quickly gathered around.
“Brother Lin Yi, you’ve finally returned!”
“Brother Lin Yi, what Cultivation Technique were you cultivating in seclusion this time? You even managed to chase away the old ancestor of the Saint Demon Sect?”
“We’ve all heard about it. It was Brother Lin Yi who led us to victory in this battle. That’s really amazing!”
Everyone spoke excitedly, with expressions of excitement on their faces, and their admiration for Lin Yi was extreme, to the point of prostrating in respect.
“Cough, cough!”
Lin Yi cleared his throat and then spoke, “My fellow brothers and sisters, you’ve all worked hard. You should go back and rest for now. I am going to cultivate now.”
“Of course! Brother Lin Yi, you keep up the good work in your cultivation and don’t let down the great expectations the old ancestor has for you!”
Everyone nodded hurriedly and turned to go back to their places to rest.
Lin Yi didn’t delay any further and turned to go back inside the cave dwelling to begin his cultivation.
During his time in the Bronze Ancient City, Lin Yi had already reached the bottleneck of the Seventh Layer of the Foundation Establishment Stage, and now he seized this opportunity to make a breakthrough.
Lin Yi sat cross-legged on the ground, invisible fluctuations spreading all around, and soon began to assault the bottleneck.
Boom!
As time passed, Lin Yi’s aura became increasingly terrifying. The Yuan Force within his body surged like rivers and lakes, wave after wave.
With a deafening roar, the barrier was instantly shattered, and Lin Yi’s cultivation directly entered the Eighth Layer of the Foundation Establishment Stage!
After his breakthrough, Lin Yi did not linger and immediately rushed out of the cave dwelling to a mountain peak, preparing to impact the Ninth Level of the Foundation Establishment Stage. Once he made this breakthrough, he would be a powerhouse of the Foundation Establishment Stage.
As the Yuan Force infused into him, Lin Yi’s body gradually swelled up, turning round and robust, as thick as a barrel, looking very mighty.

chapters.title: Chapter 632: Golden Armor Body Protection!
chapters.content:
Chapter 632: Chapter 632: Golden Armor Body Protection!
Lin Yi’s skin shimmered with a dazzling luster under the wrap of golden muscles, as if it were a piece of jade, extremely bright and eye-catching.
At this moment, Lin Yi resembled a giant, his entire body ensconced in a rich metallic luster, looking like a Golden Armored War Divine.
“Golden Armor Body Protection!”
Lin Yi bellowed, a blinding golden light erupted from his body, and subsequently, a suit of golden armor enveloped him, wrapping his entire body.
Following that, the Yuan Force within Lin Yi surged once again, and from within his body came sounds like muffled thunder; he emitted a vast aura of might, like a divine presence descending, making the disciples of the Law Enforcement Hall feel an oppressive heaviness.
Lin Yi’s body radiated an astonishing aura as his cultivation broke through, his strength now many times greater than before.
“Golden Armor Body Protection!”
Lin Yi roared again, and another rumbling sound came from within his body, the effect of the Golden Armor Body Protection still ongoing.
At this moment, Lin Yi felt that his Yuan Force had become many times more condensed than before, and his physical body power had also increased manifold.
“Senior Brother Lin Yi is so powerful, my cultivation is only two realms below his, and yet Senior Brother Lin Yi’s training speed is simply too fast.”
“Not only is Senior Brother Lin Yi exceptionally talented, but his strength is extraordinary too, his potential is truly astonishing.”
The crowd opened their mouths one after another, their eyes flashing with excitement and shock.
“Alright, my fellow junior brothers and sisters, it’s time to gather at the martial training field, today I will teach you a sword technique called Sword Intent Technique, which can enhance our attack power, unparalleled in might, you must remember it well!” Lin Yi announced loudly.
The crowd hastily responded, affirming that they would not forget.
“All right, now I’ll teach everyone some other Cultivation Techniques and Combat Skills. Listen closely,” Lin Yi continued.
Lin Yi began to detail all the Cultivation Techniques and Combat Skills he had comprehended, and everyone listened attentively.
In just over an hour, the time passed quickly and everyone listened with keen interest. They mulled over the swordsmanship and Fist Path taught by Lin Yi, engraving this memory deep into their hearts, never to forget.

chapters.title: Chapter 633: Class Dismissed
chapters.content:
Chapter 633: Chapter 633: Class Dismissed
“I’ve already shared all of this combat experience with everyone. You must make good use of it and not let it go to waste,” Lin Yi finally concluded his lecture.
“Don’t worry, Brother Lin Yi,” they assured. “We will definitely make good use of it and won’t let you down.”
The crowd spoke in unison, their tone resolute, vowing solemnly.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s expression finally relaxed. He nodded and said, “It’s best if you understand. Now, I can be at ease.”
After speaking, Lin Yi turned and left, exiting everyone’s sight.
Watching Lin Yi’s retreating figure, the shock in everyone’s hearts lingered, unable to dissipate for a long time. They were all pondering over the swordsmanship Lin Yi had taught, wondering what it was that made it so powerful, leaving them utterly astonished.
“We must diligently practice this swordsmanship!” everyone affirmed in their hearts.
Next, Lin Yi began to teach them sword moves, sharing some techniques and combat methods within immortal cultivation that greatly benefited everyone. Since they were all cultivators, they didn’t need to practice any other cultivation techniques, so they just listened and understood.
Lin Yi stood outside the courtyard, calling into it.
“I’ve already had breakfast. Come on in,” Xia Yuyan’s voice came from inside.
“Oh, okay, thank you, Sister Xia Yuyan,” Lin Yi replied, pushing open the gate and walking into the courtyard.
Inside the courtyard, Xia Yuyan was sitting by a stone table, sipping tea, gracefully enjoying the brew.
“Sister Xia Yuyan, you’re up very early!” Lin Yi sat down beside her and asked, “How are you feeling now?”
Last night, Lin Yi had given Xia Yuyan Life Spring Water to drink; now, her injuries were all healed, her Qi-Blood extremely vigorous, and even her figure had slimmed down a lot, making her appear even more beautiful.
Looking at Lin Yi, she spoke softly, “I’ve recovered quite a bit, and I feel much more comfortable. I’m not in pain all over like the past few days.”
“That’s good to hear,” Lin Yi said with a smile. “After today’s auction, I will take you away from this place and find a place for us to live in seclusion and recover slowly.”
Upon hearing this, a hint of loss flashed across Xia Yuyan’s face. “Lin Yi, are you going to abandon me?” she asked.
“Eh, how could I abandon you? You are so beautiful; I really can’t bear to abandon you!”
“If that’s the case, why would you leave me?”
Suddenly, Xia Yuyan looked aggrieved, her eyes reddening as she gazed at Lin Yi, appearing somewhat pitiful.
Seeing Xia Yuyan’s forlorn expression, Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat, and he awkwardly touched his nose, saying, “Isn’t this because I’m worried about your safety?”
“Lin Yi, why are you so concerned about my safety?”
Xia Yuyan stared at Lin Yi, her eyes brimming with tears, as if Lin Yi had done something wrong.
Confronted with Xia Yuyan’s pitiable appearance, Lin Yi felt his resolve softening and explained, “Well… I am your senior brother, after all. If I don’t care about you, who will?”
Lin Yi had barely finished speaking when Xia Yuyan glared at him fiercely, huffing and saying, “Hmph, Junior Brother Lin Yi is really cunning!”
“I…” Lin Yi opened his mouth, not knowing how to refute.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, are you really so heartless to abandon me?”
Xia Yuyan said, with tears pattering down, looking extremely sad, which made Lin Yi’s heart tighten. He waved his hands hurriedly, “Don’t cry, how could I bear to abandon you? It’s impossible for me to do that.”
“Then why do you still want to leave this place?” Xia Yuyan lifted her head, her eyes brimming with tears as she looked at Lin Yi, her face full of accusation.
“That’s… that’s because I’m worried about you. You’re still injured, and I can’t stay in this place for a long time. I can’t take care of you indefinitely, and since you haven’t cultivated martial arts, you must leave to seek opportunities in the Immortal Cultivation World to improve your strength,” Lin Yi said.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, are you really unwilling to stay here for a while longer to be with me?” Xia Yuyan asked.
“No, the opportunities in the Immortal Cultivation World are too great. They are too important for me, I can’t delay.”
“But we’ve known each other for a year already! How can you abandon me?” Xia Yuyan continued to look at Lin Yi with a pitiful expression.
Lin Yi felt his heart soften uncontrollably as he looked into Xia Yuyan’s eyes, which seemed to have the power to hook a man’s soul.
Lin Yi shook his head, saying, “Senior Sister Xia Yuyan, please don’t do this. If you keep it up, I might actually fall for you.”
“Hehe!” Xia Yuyan suddenly broke into laughter amid tears, saying, “Junior Brother Lin Yi, I understand now. I know you’re abandoning me because I’m a demon race woman, but once I become the demon race queen, I can change my identity. I won’t be any princess, and you won’t need to avoid me anymore, because… I love you.”
“What?” Lin Yi was suddenly taken aback, his heart pounding violently.
Lin Yi had never expected Xia Yuyan to confess so suddenly, leaving him unprepared and unsure of how to respond.
Xia Yuyan, seeing the look on Lin Yi’s face, knew he liked her and felt very happy inside.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, I know you must still have many doubts in your heart, unsure of how to explain. Why not listen to my explanation before you decide what to do with me?”
“Senior Sister Xia Yuyan, alright, go ahead,” Lin Yi nodded.
Xia Yuyan took a deep breath and recounted everything that had happened the day before. Finally, she sighed softly, saying, “Junior Brother Lin Yi, even though you saved my life, it wasn’t because you loved me.”
“I know I cannot compare to Sister Su Ruoyan or Sister Lin Shihan in charm, and you never truly had me in your heart. But, Junior Brother Lin Yi, we’ve known each other for over a year. Do you really have the heart to leave me alone and walk away from here?”
“Senior Sister Xia Yuyan, that’s not what I meant,” Lin Yi said anxiously.
“Whatever you mean, you just don’t want to stay with me.”
Xia Yuyan’s tone became angry as she spoke, her eyes turning red, with tears rolling down her cheeks.
“I…” Lin Yi felt that no words could defend him.
At this moment, Li Xue, who had been on the side, suddenly stood up and approached Xia Yuyan.
Xia Yuyan, who was sobbing with her head down, was startled when Li Xue rushed over. She quickly wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes and looked up at Li Xue, asking, “Sister Li Xue, what are you going to do?”
Li Xue walked up to Xia Yuyan, gave her a cold look, and said, “Do you even have to ask what I’m going to do? How dare you take advantage of the time when Senior Brother Lin was in seclusion to try and seduce him?”
“I… I…”
Xia Yuyan opened her mouth but didn’t know what to say in her defense, for indeed she harbored ulterior motives towards Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 634 - 634 Ulterior Motives
chapters.content:
Chapter 634: Chapter 634 Ulterior Motives
“I warn you, if you try to seduce Junior Brother Lin again, don’t blame me for being rude to you.”
With that, Li Xue left the pavilion.
Seeing Li Xue leave, a hint of resentment flashed in Xia Yuyan’s eyes.
“Hmph, Lin Yi, I will never let you slip through my fingers!”
Li Xue walked into Lin Yi’s room and sat on his bed, her face showing a trace of coldness.
Li Xue took out a jade bottle, poured out an elixir, and then threw it into her mouth, swallowing it down.
After taking the elixir, the intense poison inside Li Xue’s body was immediately alleviated by a lot, and she felt much more comfortable.
“Huh?” Suddenly, Li Xue’s gaze fell on Lin Yi’s clothes and, noticing several bloodstains, she was startled and exclaimed, “How could this be, has Lin Yi been injured?”
Thinking this, Li Xue quickly walked up to Lin Yi and reached out to feel his pulse, trying to ascertain if he had been injured. However, as soon as she touched Lin Yi’s body, a strange power suddenly entered her body.
“This… this…” Li Xue panicked and quickly retreated to one side.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, are you alright?” Li Xue asked.
Hearing Li Xue’s inquiry, Lin Yi shook his head slightly and said, “I’m fine.”
“That’s good!”
Li Xue breathed a sigh of relief and said, “You rest for a while, I’ll call you when it’s time to eat!”
“Okay!” Lin Yi nodded his head.
Seeing Lin Yi agree, Li Xue turned and walked to the door, then locked it from the outside.
Li Xue didn’t lock the door completely but observed the room through the crack of the door. If anything went wrong with Lin Yi, she would burst in to save him.
“This woman is truly crazy, she actually locked the door from the outside. Isn’t she afraid that Junior Brother Lin Yi might take the opportunity to escape?”
As Li Xue observed everything inside the room, she thought to herself.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, you sleep for now, I’ll call you for dinner.” Li Xue said.
Lin Yi lay on the bed with an indescribable feeling in his heart. He didn’t know how to face Xia Yuyan. He had an affection for Xia Yuyan, but the truth was Xia Yuyan was Lin Yi’s senior sister, leaving him with no choice and giving him a lot of distress.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, are you alright?” Seeing that Lin Yi said nothing, Li Xue walked into the room and asked with concern.
“I’m fine,” Lin Yi replied faintly.
“Are you really okay? Your complexion seems a bit off,” Li Xue asked with a frown.
“Yes, my injury is recurring, so I’m a bit tired. I need to rest.”
“Oh, then you rest.”
Li Xue nodded her head and turned to walk outside.
Once Li Xue had stepped out the door and closed it behind her, Lin Yi opened his eyes and stared at the night sky outside the window, his eyes filled with confusion.
“Sigh!”
He let out a gentle sigh.
“Forget it, since I can’t refuse her, let her follow,” Lin Yi murmured softly, a feeling of guilt in his heart.
Lin Yi didn’t want to reject Xia Yuyan, but he also couldn’t defy his master’s command, so he could only make her suffer for a while.
“I just hope she doesn’t let Master down.”
Lin Yi muttered to himself in his thoughts.
…
After leaving Lin Yi’s courtyard, Xia Yuyan didn’t depart but stood quietly in the pavilion.
“Junior Brother Lin, you don’t want to bother with me, do you? You don’t like me, and I won’t force you, but I will definitely not give up on you. I will make you realize who is truly worthy of you,” Xia Yuyan spoke to herself.
“Junior Sister Li Xue, why haven’t you left yet?” At that moment, the wooden door of the pavilion was pushed open and Li Xue walked in.
Li Xue cast a glance at Lin Yi and scoffed, “Junior Brother Lin, I am your Senior Sister. Isn’t it inappropriate for you to address me this way?”
Lin Yi was taken aback, then touched his head awkwardly.
“If I don’t call you Senior Sister Li Xue, what should I call you?”
“Senior Sister Li!” Li Xue said.
“Senior Sister Li, I’m sorry, I was too excited just now. I shouldn’t have called you Senior Sister Li Xue, and I’m not used to it either. Just call me Junior Brother!” Lin Yi apologized.
“Okay, then let’s do as you say,” Li Xue nodded and said.
“Senior Sister Li Xue, I want to ask you, have you seen any trace of my master these past few days, or do you know where he has gone for his training?”
Lin Yi asked, his heart filled with hope that Li Xue could provide him with news of his master.
“No, Junior Brother Lin, why? You want to find my master to know her circumstances?” Li Xue looked toward Lin Yi and inquired.
Lin Yi nodded and said, “Yes, I have a very important matter to discuss with Master.”
“Hehe, well I don’t know where she has gone. She often goes out to train besides her cultivation practices. I advise you not to waste your effort looking for her.”
Lin Yi furrowed his brows slightly, unsure of what to do next.
“Oh right, Junior Brother Lin, didn’t you say you had an ancient manuscript called the ‘Muscle-Tendon Change Classic’? Can you take it out for me to see?” Li Xue suddenly asked.
“The ‘Muscle-Tendon Change Classic’?” Lin Yi looked puzzled at Li Xue and said, “I haven’t seen the ‘Muscle-Tendon Change Classic’ these past few days.”
“You haven’t seen it? Are you sure? Then where have you hidden it?”
Lin Yi shook his head, indicating that he really hadn’t seen the manuscript.
Seeing that Lin Yi did not appear to be lying, Li Xue suddenly felt puzzled, not understanding why Lin Yi would lie?
“Never mind, I also don’t know where my master has gone. I’ll ask her when she gets back!”
Li Xue shook her head and then left the pavilion.
After Li Xue left, Lin Yi continued to meditate and recuperate.
This battle had caused Lin Yi great consumption. Although he had not been injured, the Spiritual Power in his body was depleted and needed to be restored quickly.
Lin Yi closed his eyes and circulated the Spiritual Energy within his body, slowly regulating it.
In a short while, a cloud of white mist emerged from his body, becoming denser and finally forming a white lotus flower.
Lin Yi used a secret technique from the ‘Muscle-Tendon Change Classic,’ concentrating all the Spiritual Energy in his right arm, forming a white protective shield around it.
At that moment, Lin Yi, with his eyes firmly closed and seated in a lotus position on his bed, resembled a Buddha.
After some time, the white lotus flower around Lin Yi dispersed, revealing his true form.
Enveloped by a white halo, Lin Yi at that moment looked like a Buddha, exuding an aura of extraordinary dignity and sanctity.
Lin Yi was like a statue, showing no sign of life’s fluctuations, yet emitting a vast, majestic presence, like a tall mountain weighing down on Li Xue, causing her heartbeat to quicken and her breathing to become difficult.
“Junior Brother Lin, what are you doing?”
Li Xue couldn’t help but ask in amazement.
“Is this the effect of the ‘Muscle-Tendon Change Classic’?”
Li Xue thought to herself.
“No wonder I feel Junior Brother Lin has become different. It turns out it’s because he has been cultivating the ‘Muscle-Tendon Change Classic.'”
“Junior Brother Lin’s talent is truly astonishing!”
Li Xue quietly admired while also feeling a strong sense of jealousy.
“Junior Brother Lin, you really are amazing!”
Li Xue’s eyes shone with intense admiration as she silently said in her heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 635: A Genius with Exceptional Talent?
chapters.content:
Chapter 635: Chapter 635: A Genius with Exceptional Talent?
…
Time flew by, and three days passed quietly.
One evening, Li Xue came to Lin Yi’s room once again.
Lin Yi was meditating with his eyes closed when suddenly, Li Xue knocked on the door.
Hearing the knock, Lin Yi opened his eyes, then stood up, walked to the door, and opened it.
“Sister Li, it’s so late, is something the matter?” Lin Yi asked with curiosity.
“Lin Yi, I heard that you are now my junior brother. I wonder, what level have you reached?” Li Xue looked at Lin Yi and asked.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but smile wryly.
“Sister Li, how come you don’t even know my level?” Lin Yi said, shaking his head.
Li Xue was taken aback and asked in confusion, “Junior Brother Lin Yi, what do you mean by that?”
Lin Yi smiled and said, “Sister Li, you should also be aware of my age. I am only twenty years old, two years younger than you.”
“Are you saying that you’re an exceptionally talented genius?”
Li Xue looked at Lin Yi with surprise, her eyes filled with shock and envy.
“Yes, Sister Li, you mustn’t underestimate me. I’m a very powerful genius. Not only do I possess strong martial arts, but my cultivation speed is also extremely terrifying, and even faster than you can imagine. I’ve already reached the fifth rank of Martial Apprentice, and I am also an alchemist!”
“You, you are actually that amazing?” Li Xue’s eyes widened as she stared at Lin Yi in astonishment.
Lin Yi simply shrugged his shoulders and said, “Actually, my cultivation speed amazes me as well. I never expected that in just two short months, I could cultivate from an ordinary person to the Martial Apprentice Realm. This rate of cultivation is simply unbelievable!”
After a moment of contemplation, Li Xue said, “I remember last time at the auction, I saw you acquire a Blood Coagulation Pill. Where is it now? Could you lend it to me to have a look?”
“No problem!”
Without a second thought, Lin Yi agreed, and with a flick of his wrist, a Blood Coagulation Pill appeared in his hand.
Seeing the Blood Coagulation Pill in Lin Yi’s hand, Li Xue was even more astonished.
How did Lin Yi manage to refine a Blood Coagulation Pill in such a short period of time?
Could it be that he has already broken through to the Martial Ancestor Realm?
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, your cultivation truly scares me!”
Li Xue stared at the Blood Coagulation Pill in Lin Yi’s palm, her face turning somewhat pale, as she said.
“I can’t help it, I am naturally intelligent, and my cultivation speed has always been faster than that of ordinary people,” Lin Yi said with a shrug.
Li Xue was inwardly shocked but maintained a nonchalant facade as she said, “With your excellent talent, isn’t your master worried that you’ll encounter calamities if your cultivation level increases too rapidly?”
“Calamities? Are there really calamities in this world?”
Lin Yi retorted. He had never considered the existence of calamities. After all, those who pursue immortal cultivation have a long life expectancy, and they gain much from their practice, so even if they do encounter any calamities, there are ways to withstand them.
Hearing Lin Yi’s response, Li Xue was even more astonished.
Lin Yi’s words clearly expressed disbelief in the existence of dangers in the world, an attitude of extreme arrogance that made Li Xue quite displeased.
However, Li Xue dared not say anything.
Lin Yi’s background was too strong, and she was just a novice. She simply had no strength to confront Lin Yi.
Seeing that Li Xue did not respond, Lin Yi casually said, “Oh, by the way, Sister Li, I have something else to take care of, so I’ll take my leave now!”
After speaking, Lin Yi was ready to leave, but Li Xue hastily called out to him, saying, “Wait! Junior Brother Lin Yi, I have a favor to ask of you.”
Lin Yi stopped in his tracks and asked with curiosity, “Sister Li, what is it? Just say it, and I will certainly help you if I can!”
Li Xue nodded and said, “Junior Brother Lin Yi, can you teach me how to identify poisons?”
“Poison?”
Lin Yi was taken aback for a moment and said, “Poison? This stuff doesn’t have much effect on cultivators, why do you want to learn it?”
“This…”
Li Xue hesitated, not knowing how to explain to Lin Yi, so she could only say, “Junior Brother Lin Yi, there are a few elders in my family who have been poisoned. Our clan has researched many methods, but none have cured them, so we want to find some poisons to help them.”
Lin Yi suddenly realized and said, “So that’s the case, it’s simple, I have studied on my own, and I can also prepare some Antidote!”
“You, you also understand medicine?” Li Xue’s eyes widened as she looked at Lin Yi.
“Of course!” Lin Yi nodded.
“That’s wonderful, Junior Brother Lin Yi, since that is the case, I wonder if you could assist me in obtaining a batch of poisons to save my family’s elders!”
“The quality of these poisons is quite good, and I do have many here; wait for me, I will go back and get them!”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi immediately agreed without hesitation.
“Thank you, Junior Brother Lin Yi!”
Li Xue hurriedly bowed in gratitude.
Lin Yi waved his hand and then returned to his own dormitory.
After Lin Yi got back to his dormitory, he took out the Blood Coagulation Pills and began to sort them one by one, placing them into jade vials.
“Li Xue, when your elder wakes up, you must personally deliver these to him, I have other matters to attend to, so I won’t accompany you any longer.”
Having sorted the Blood Coagulation Pills, Lin Yi then left the dormitory and walked towards the direction of the herb garden.
He needed a substantial amount of herbs to refine Blood Coagulation Pills, so Lin Yi had to go to the herb field to collect them.
After leaving the dormitory and entering the herb garden, Lin Yi began to pick various kinds of herbs.
“Hmm? What kind of herb is this? I have never seen it before?”
Suddenly, a strangely shaped herb caught Lin Yi’s attention.
This herb lay in a seemingly disordered fashion on the ground, yet it was the only one that Lin Yi recognized as a true herb.
However, although Lin Yi was not familiar with this kind of herb, he knew its value was not cheap.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, what kind of herb is this? I’ve never seen it before either.”
At that moment, a surprised voice came from beside him.
Upon hearing it, Lin Yi looked up and saw Li Xue standing at the edge of the herb field.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, this herb seems to be of high quality. I want this herb!”
Li Xue looked at the plant exuding a faint fragrance in the herb field, her heart filled with excitement.
“No!”
Lin Yi flatly refused.
“What, what did you say? Junior Brother Lin Yi, I must have this herb! If you’re willing to give this herb to me, then consider it a favor you’ve done for me. If there’s anything you need help with in the future, I will certainly assist!”
“Sorry, but I said no and I meant it. I will not give you this herb.”
Lin Yi shook his head, his tone very firm.
“Why? Junior Brother Lin Yi, I am sincerely asking you, why do you refuse me?” Li Xue was taken aback, somewhat failing to understand Lin Yi’s actions.
“As I said, this herb is of no use to me,” Lin Yi repeated.
Li Xue’s complexion darkened, slightly angered, but she was an astute woman and quickly realized something.
She snorted coldly, “Junior Brother Lin Yi, if you don’t want to give me the herb, then naturally I have my ways of obtaining it. I am an Artifact Refiner, and it’s quite easy for me to refine some medicine cauldrons and the like!”

chapters.title: Chapter 636: Look Down on Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 636: Chapter 636: Look Down on Me?
“You can give it a try, and if you can refine some medicinal cauldrons, I will give you the herbs!” Lin Yi said unhurriedly.
“Are you looking down on me, Junior Brother Lin Yi?”
Li Xue’s pretty eyes turned cold, and her tone carried a hint of anger as she spoke.
“Senior Sister Li, I am not looking down on you; I simply do not wish to give them to you!” Lin Yi said calmly.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, you’re going too far. You know very well how much I love artifact refining, yet you insist on refusing me. Do you think you’re better than me?”
“I do not think I’m better than you, but I indeed have a way to refine some rather powerful Refining Magical Treasures!” Lin Yi declared.
“Don’t be too arrogant, Junior Brother Lin Yi. You’re only a Second-Level Artifact Refiner. How could you possibly have a way to refine powerful Refining Magical Treasures? I advise you to give up early. I’m set on having this herb!” Li Xue said with a cold laugh.
“I also advise you to dismiss that thought early on. Among your elders, how many possess the talent for artifact refining? Your childish tricks are of no use to them; if anything, they will only laugh at you,” Lin Yi said tranquilly.
Li Xue was brought to a halt. Although she disdained Lin Yi in her heart, what he said was the truth—if any of her elders had talent, they wouldn’t be confined to bed, unable to get up.
“Forget it. It seems that I won’t be getting this herb!”
Li Xue sighed and prepared to turn away and leave.
“Senior Sister Li, don’t be hasty to leave. I have other good things that I want to give you!”
Lin Yi suddenly called out to Li Xue.
“Other good things?”
Li Xue’s expression turned to one of curiosity. She had no interest in the so-called good things Lin Yi mentioned but couldn’t help her curiosity as she asked, “Junior Brother Lin Yi, what good thing do you have to give me? Please don’t tell me it’s a Primordial Crystal or a Spirit Sword!”
Lin Yi smiled slightly and said, “Senior Sister Li, you’ve guessed it right!”
“Oh my God, Junior Brother Lin Yi, I thought you wouldn’t give me any good things. You better not disappoint me!”
Upon hearing this, Li Xue exclaimed in surprise.
“The thing I’m giving you this time is absolutely unique and will surely surprise you!”
“Oh? What is it? I’m eager to see it now!”
Li Xue said with a face full of anticipation.
Lin Yi discarded the herbs and took out three jade bottles, which he handed to Li Xue.
“What is this?” Li Xue opened the jade bottles with confusion and was immediately startled by the contents. A golden pearl fell out, shimmering with golden brilliance.
The golden pearl exuded a rich medicinal fragrance making one feel refreshed with just a whiff.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, what is this? Why is it so enticing?”
Li Xue stared at the golden pearl and asked.
Lin Yi chuckled and explained, “This is a pill I’ve refined called the Nine Revolutions Rejuvenation Pill, a Healing Holy Pill!”
“Nine Revolutions Rejuvenation Pill!?”
Upon hearing the name Nine Revolutions Rejuvenation Pill, Li Xue’s eyes instantly lit up, and she exclaimed, “It’s really the Nine Revolutions Rejuvenation Pill, fantastic! I never imagined that Junior Brother Lin Yi could refine such a miraculous elixir! Junior Brother Lin Yi, you truly are one of the people I admire the most. I didn’t expect your alchemy skills to have reached such a realm!”
“It was all due to a fortunate coincidence that I obtained an alchemy method, and this pill was something I came across by chance, so I took the opportunity to refine it,” Lin Yi said with a mild smile.
“I believe in you, Junior Brother Lin Yi. I trust you and will cherish the Nine Revolutions Rejuvenation Pill you’ve given me. I hope it will be useful to me and allow me to recover my strength quickly!”
As Li Xue spoke, she carefully put the pill into her bosom, and her expression softened greatly.
“Sister Li Xue, then you should go back first; I need to continue with my alchemy!” Lin Yi said.
“Alright, then you keep up the good work!”
Li Xue nodded and then turned around to leave.
Watching Li Xue’s retreating figure, Lin Yi’s lips curved into a smile.
The reason he had disclosed Li Xue’s Alchemy Refinement technique was to seek revenge!
Lin Yi knew of his own grudge and that he had always been pursued by assassins, yet he couldn’t find the killer. However, Li Xue could, because she had a group of ancient ancestors behind her!
Whenever Lin Yi thought about the ancient ancestors behind Li Xue, he couldn’t help but feel a sense of dread.
However, he was not afraid of the ancient ancestors behind Li Xue. He had enough confidence to confront that old monster.
The only person he dreaded was that old monster, the Artifact Refiner. As long as he could find him, he would have a chance to defeat him and take back what belonged to him!
“I’ll just leave this herb with you for now. Whenever you figure it out, come and exchange it!”
After saying these words, Lin Yi focused his attention on refining Elixirs once again.
While refining the Nine Revolutions Rejuvenation Pill, Lin Yi did not forget to practice the “Supreme Body Refinement Technique.”
As time passed, Lin Yi finally cultivated the “Supreme Body Refinement Technique” to the Eighth Layer!
Lin Yi opened his eyes, and two sharp divine lights shot from them.
“The Ninth Layer, physical refinement complete!”
Lin Yi took a deep breath, feeling the powerful strength coursing through his body, and felt a secret joy.
He knew that once he cultivated his physical refinement to perfection, he would be able to perform the “Nine Dragons Refining Shape.”
At that time, he could transform into nine Flood Dragons, assuming the form of nine-headed Flood Dragons.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, are you refining Elixirs? May I come in and sit?”
At that moment, a pleasant and melodious voice came from outside, and following that, an absolutely beautiful girl in purple garb appeared in Lin Yi’s line of sight.
She had an exceptionally beautiful face, with fair and delicate skin, curved eyebrows, and long eyelashes fluttering like little fans, which made her appear extremely lively.
“Sister Li Xue, please come in and have a seat!”
Lin Yi quickly got up to warmly greet her, and then he added, “This room is a bit small; I hope Sister Li Xue can excuse it!”
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, you’re really humorous. This place is very nice, not small at all!” Li Xue said with a smile.
Seeing her expression, Lin Yi sneered inwardly.
His room was, in fact, very luxurious, something ordinary people couldn’t afford at all.
Lin Yi glanced at the room and then led Li Xue outside.
As Li Xue walked through Lin Yi’s room, she felt it was incredibly opulent, and her admiration for this alchemy genius grew even more.
After arriving outside in the courtyard, Li Xue asked Lin Yi, “Junior Brother Lin Yi, how long does it take you when you refine Elixirs? I can hardly wait!”
“It’s hard to estimate, I don’t know how long it will take me to refine them,” Lin Yi said indifferently, then ignored Li Xue and started refining Elixirs.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, do you have any Pill Formulas for alchemy you could sell to me? I’m willing to pay a good price!” Li Xue asked.
“I don’t have any Elixirs at the moment, but if someone is willing to pay a high price, I might consider selling!” Lin Yi thought for a moment, then said.

chapters.title: Chapter 637: Words Never Lie!
chapters.content:
Chapter 637: Chapter 637: Words Never Lie!
“Really?” Li Xue’s eyes immediately lit up.
“Of course, it’s true. I, Lin Yi, never lie when I speak!” Lin Yi nodded affirmatively and then took out the “Alchemy” and handed it to Li Xue.
Upon seeing the “Alchemy,” Li Xue’s eyes widened.
“Is this the ‘Alchemy’? Lin Yi, Junior Brother, how many elixirs can this alchemy provide for me, and how many can I sell?”
Li Xue was so excited after seeing the book Lin Yi handed her that she almost jumped up, grabbing and flipping through it right away.
Lin Yi had a face full of black lines and said, “Sister Li Xue, please give the book back to me first, and then we can talk about it slowly, okay?”
“Not okay, not okay, I don’t want to delay even for a moment, I must see what wonders this book contains.”
Li Xue shook her head, continually shaking the “Alchemy” in her hand as if she wanted to throw the book away.
“This pill formula is based on the materials of a Ninth Grade elixir, then combined with nine types of herbs for refinement. These herbs are all thousands of years old, so the medicinal effect is quite strong, and the value is quite high. It could sell for at least tens of thousands of Spirit Stones, and if we can buy in batches, we should be able to sell for several million Spirit Stones!”
Lin Yi said with an indifferent face, casually speaking.
“What? The price of one furnace of elixir is so expensive? Several million Spirit Stones? Who would be willing to spend so much?”
After listening, Li Xue immediately exclaimed in shock.
“Regardless, I still want to purchase this elixir!”
She read it over and over again and finally finished.
Then, she turned her gaze back to Lin Yi, her expression full of expectation, and asked, “So, how many Spirit Stones are you planning to sell it for? Can you tell me the price?”
“My requirement is very simple. I only need one-fifth of the herbs listed in this pill formula. The rest I’ll leave to you,” Lin Yi said.
“Lin Yi, Junior Brother, do you really plan to give me that one-fifth?”
Shocked, Li Xue asked.
“Hmm, have you finished reading the pill formula? What do you think after reading it?” Lin Yi nodded slightly and said.
“I think the price of this elixir is very low; it can even be described with being able to earn several million Spirit Stones with just one book of elixirs. I can also do this business, but my request is very simple, just that one-fifth is all I need.”
After thinking for a while, Li Xue straightforwardly said.
“Hehe, since that’s the case, I’ll sell it to you at the regular price. This book is yours now, you can take it back and study it!”
Lin Yi smiled and then handed the book to Li Xue.
“Great, thank you Lin Yi, Junior Brother! I’ll take this book and leave now!”
“Hmm!”
Li Xue thanked him and then turned to leave.
Lin Yi stood at the door, watching Li Xue’s departing silhouette, his lips curling up into a slight smile.
This Li Xue, she really is a treasure!
Lin Yi thought to himself.
After Li Xue left, Lin Yi closed the door and continued to close his eyes to begin refining elixirs.
Lin Yi was already an Alchemist and had quite a profound understanding of alchemy, so his process of refining elixirs was well-practiced and fast; he quickly refined sixty Four-Pattern Pills.
“Phew!”
Lin Yi let out a long breath.
“As expected of the Nine Cauldrons Sacred Ground, it truly lives up to its reputation. Even refining Four-Pattern Pills takes about three months.”
Lin Yi sighed inwardly. Refining elixirs for such a long time had even tiresome for him.
“Phew!”
Lin Yi exhaled deeply once more, then immediately began refining Six-Pattern Pills.
To refine Sixty Six-Pattern Pills, Lin Yi refined over two hundred, and only then was the process complete.
Lin Yi tidied up the elixirs; he was then ready to rest. But just then, Li Xue knocked on Lin Yi’s door again.
Lin Yi furrowed his brows, opened the door, and found Li Xue was still standing at the entrance.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, I have something I want to discuss with you,” Li Xue said as soon as Lin Yi opened the door.
“What is it?”
“It’s about my father, he asked me to find you and inquire if you are free, he wants to discuss a matter regarding the pill formula with you.”
“Oh? Then let’s go,” Lin Yi nodded and agreed.
Lin Yi put away all his materials for refining elixirs, then stepped out of the house with Li Xue.
Li Xue led Lin Yi towards the City Lord’s Mansion’s council hall.
As Lin Yi and Li Xue walked out of the house, they saw several young men waiting nearby.
Several of these youths were in their early twenties, the weakest of whom was at the early stage of Foundation Establishment, and among them were two strong practitioners of the Golden Core Realm!
When they saw Lin Yi and Li Xue come out from the house, their gazes immediately fell upon Lin Yi.
Li Xue recognized the identities of these youths at a glance and instantly trembled with fear, her complexion turning ashen.
“This is one of my cousins; they are all from my Li Family!” Li Xue hastened to introduce them.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, this is my cousin Li Tianhai, his name is Li Tianyu.”
Li Xue pointed to Li Tianhai and Li Tianyu, then to the rest of the youths, as she introduced them.
“Li Tianyu, this is my senior brother Lin Yi, he’s the cousin of Senior Brother Lin Yi and also a member of our Li Family.”
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, these are the people from our Li Family!”
Li Xue introduced each one to Lin Yi.
“You few are from the Li Family?” Lin Yi looked them over with a glance, asking in a lukewarm tone.
He didn’t have much of a liking for these youths, especially Li Tianyu, who seemed carefree and carried himself like a spoiled son of wealth.
Lin Yi couldn’t help but remember that Li Tianyu, who was also a wastrel.
“Indeed, we are from the Li Family!”
One of the youths coldly snorted as he spoke.
“So you are from the Li Family!”
Lin Yi, upon hearing this, couldn’t help but laugh disparagingly, saying, “Judging by your attire, you seem quite wealthy, managing to afford a Seven-Star Pill, not bad at all.”
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, you…you should not look down on others too much. Although I can’t afford a Seven-Star Pill, in our family, many are Artifact Refiners, and they can each refine a Magic Artifact!” Li Tianyu said indignantly.
“A Magic Artifact?” Lin Yi was taken aback for a moment, then laughed heartily.
“Ha! What’s so special about Magic Artifacts? As if you lot are worthy of owning Magic Artifacts, pah!”
Lin Yi spat disdainfully.
Lin Yi’s unkind words turned the expressions of those youths to an iron blue.
“Good! You have spine, so refine a Magic Artifact yourself and let’s see if you can best me!” Li Tianyu couldn’t contain his anger and snapped back, issuing a challenge.
“What I choose to refine is none of your business; you should worry about yourself instead, lest you get killed by someone else!” Lin Yi retorted dismissively.
“You!”
“Young Master Li, don’t stoop to his level, he’s just a country bumpkin, a rube. If you argue with him, wouldn’t that lower your own status?” Li Xue interjected, trying to calm the situation.
“Heh, I would actually like to see how he refines a Magic Artifact; he claimed to have already refined a Low-Grade Spiritual Artifact, hasn’t he? I wonder if that’s true!” Li Tianyu snorted coldly, goading on the conversation.

chapters.title: Chapter 638: How Arrogant Can He Be
chapters.content:
Chapter 638: Chapter 638: How Arrogant Can He Be
“Lin Yi, just hurry up and craft a Magic Artifact, I’m eager to see what kind of ability you really have to be able to craft a Low Grade Spiritual Artifact!”
Another young man, upon hearing this, also sneered.
“Haha, I don’t need any Spiritual Artifact to assist me in refining Magic Artifacts, and moreover, I don’t even need to craft this Artifact.”
Lin Yi replied with a faint smile.
The reason he said this was to see how arrogant these young people could be!
“Haha, anyone can brag, but where did you get this Spiritual Artifact from?”
“Exactly, don’t think that just because you’ve refined a sword, you can start boasting. I really want to see if you can actually craft an Artifact.”
“I just don’t believe you can craft a Low Grade Spiritual Artifact!”
The crowd, hearing this, scoffed, not believing Lin Yi could actually craft a Low Grade Spiritual Artifact.
“Whether I can craft a Low Grade Spiritual Artifact or not, why don’t you give it a try?”
“Let’s see it then; I truly want to see how you craft it!”
Li Xue also chimed in from the side. She did not believe Lin Yi could craft a Low Grade Spiritual Artifact either.
“Miss Li, please take me to your family’s Refining Room; I will start refining there!” Lin Yi said mildly.
“Alright, follow me!”
“Come with me!”
Li Xue led Lin Yi to the Refining Room, had him sit at the Refining Platform, and then had people fetch materials to start preparing the Artifact Refining ingredients for Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi, let me tell you, the Magical Treasure you’re going to refine is called the ‘Ice Dragon Whip.’ It is an extremely powerful Magical Treasure from the Ancient Era, with astonishing power!”
“All you have to do is channel Spiritual Energy into the Ice Dragon Whip, then whip it forcefully, and it will emit the sound of a dragon’s chant!”
“Moreover, it can release the cold energy within the Spiritual Artifact to freeze enemies. If you manage to refine it successfully, the Ice Dragon Whip will belong to you!”
“However, I must remind you that you can’t lose; if you lose, there will be a price to pay!” Li Xue warned again, worried that Lin Yi would lose the competition and be defeated by Li Tianyu.
“Don’t worry, since I’ve promised the Li Family, I will definitely do my utmost. There’s no way I’ll lose the competition,”
Lin Yi said, nodding lightly, his eyes flickering with determination. Clearly, he was confident of victory in this competition.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, we’ll wait and see if the Artifact you refine is really as powerful as the rumors say.”
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, I hope you won’t disappoint me!”
“Rest assured, we’re all waiting to see for ourselves!”
…
The young people, having heard Lin Yi’s words, all sneered with disdain, not believing that Lin Yi could really refine a Low Grade Spiritual Artifact.
Lin Yi ignored the group of young people and focused on refining his own Elixirs.
At this moment, he had entered a Selfless State, with his mind filled only with the process of Elixir Refining, not wanting to bother with anything else.
Li Tianyu and the other young members of the Li Family stood silently on the side, watching Lin Yi refine the Elixirs.
“Senior Brother Lin Yi, you might as well come clean about where you bought that Pill Furnace, maybe I’ll consider letting you off the hook and not hold it against you!”
“Yes, just bring out the Pill Furnace, and I’ll spare you. How about that?”
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, if you’re willing to admit defeat gracefully, then I may consider sparing your life!”
…
The youths couldn’t help but mock and laugh when they saw Lin Yi had actually managed to refine a pill furnace, believing he was just wasting his time. However, they were unaware that the elixir Lin Yi produced was collected from a mountain peak, thus no one could see the elixir’s preciousness.
“Hmph!” Lin Yi snorted coldly, directly swallowed the Nine Revolutions Infant Transformation Pill, and immediately entered a Selfless State.
Lin Yi’s mind had now plunged into the Dantian, engaging in refinement.
Inside Lin Yi’s Dantian, it was pitch black, not a sliver of light to be seen.
His soul had also fallen into a wonderful state of clarity, as if he had entered a strange realm.
In Lin Yi’s sea of consciousness, a golden pill was rapidly spinning – the Nine Revolutions Infant Transformation Pill that Lin Yi had refined. It emitted a dazzling light that shone throughout Lin Yi’s sea of consciousness.
In Lin Yi’s sea of consciousness, an image appeared: a vast expanse of void with ancient and mysterious patterns floating in the air. Each pattern was imprinted with various mysterious runes and looked like a giant formation.
This formation was spiral-shaped, and within each spiral, there seemed to be slender lines, like those of a complex formation, baffling to comprehend.
On those formations, Lin Yi saw intricate texts that seemed to possess an inexplicable allure. With one glance, he felt an irresistible urge to memorize them and intensely study them.
This was an image of the Nine Revolutions Infant Transformation Pill, and it was in his sea of consciousness, which shocked Lin Yi.
“What kind of formation is this? Why does it look so familiar?”
Lin Yi murmured to himself. The more he looked at the formations, the more familiar they seemed, yet he couldn’t recall where he had seen or heard about them!
Lin Yi tentatively activated the complex formations, and suddenly, they began to move as if alive, with the text on them constantly changing as if practicing something.
“What kind of formation could this be?”
Lin Yi couldn’t help but stare carefully at the formation. The more he watched, the more he felt a sense of familiarity, as if he had seen this type of formation before.
The more Lin Yi observed the text on the formation, the more familiar it felt, as if he had personally walked to the center of the formation and seen its core.
“Boom…” Suddenly, the intricate formations in the formation vanished, transforming into a powerful suction force that surged towards Lin Yi’s body.
“Ah!”
“Damn it, what is this thing?”
“Ah!”
“Help, my arm is getting sucked in, help, someone help…”
This abrupt change immediately terrified everyone present, who started screaming and fleeing, not daring to approach Lin Yi for fear that the horrifying suction force would pull in their bodies.
Lin Yi’s face underwent drastic changes. He hadn’t expected that as the complex formations disappeared, such a terrifying suction force would suddenly assault him.
Lin Yi could not care about refining low-grade spiritual artifacts at this moment; he quickly took control of his body and started running the Divine Refinement Technique, rapidly stabilizing his body to prevent the suction force from invading it.
However, the suction force was too terrifying. Even as Lin Yi ran the Divine Refinement Technique, he still sustained some damage.
The suction force, coursing through Lin Yi’s skin, entered his body and wildly ravaged his internal organs and meridians, sending constant waves of pain throughout his entire body.
“Pfft!”
Lin Yi spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, his face displaying a pained expression.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, I had already said that your cultivation is too low; you can’t bear this kind of terrifying suction force. Hurry up and hand over the Alchemy Furnace to avoid suffering!”
“Haha, Junior Brother Lin Yi, stop struggling. Just admit defeat graciously. Didn’t you say you would teach us a lesson? How about it? Are you going back on your word?”
“Hmph, just come at me together, and let’s not waste any more time.”
Lin Yi’s face turned ashen, and he spoke through clenched teeth.
He hadn’t expected that right after he had refined the Nine Revolutions Infant Transformation Pill, he would face such a situation. It was an insult to him and a contempt for his abilities.

chapters.title: Chapter 639: Weapons Drawn
chapters.content:
Chapter 639: Chapter 639: Weapons Drawn
He no longer cared about refining the Nine Revolutions Infant Transformation Pill and abandoned it, deciding to battle with the group of young martial artists.
“Hmph, Lin Yi, you’re truly seeking death, then I shall grant it to you!”
“Lin Yi, I will make you wish for death, make you beg for life without getting it, beg for death without achieving it!”
“Haha, let’s see how well you fight!”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, everyone became furiously angry, each speaking with resentment, having decided to tear Lin Yi to shreds.
The trainees summoned their weapons, attacking Lin Yi, each with a fierce expression on their face, intent on turning Lin Yi into tiny pieces.
Although these young martial artists came from all over the continent, they were all super geniuses of the Martial Venerable Realm, with extremely formidable strengths. Each had unique techniques and moves that could kill a ferocious beast in one hit, their might extremely astonishing!
Facing the attacks of the young trainees, Lin Yi showed no fear, likewise unleashing his own ultimate moves.
He manipulated his hands to form seals, casting one complicated seal after another. Mysterious ripples formed in the palm of his hands, and a powerful force erupted forth, reaching out in all directions, sending huge stones flying!
“Boom, boom, boom!”
The huge stones burst into pieces, setting off brilliant fireworks in the sky!
“Rumble…”
“Spurt, spurt, spurt…”
As Lin Yi and the young trainees began their battle, the range of impact from their fight grew wider and wider. In no time, countless bursts of energy brilliance splattered out, causing the entire valley to tremble, and a succession of booming sounds rose from the depths of the valley.
Around Lin Yi’s body, terrifying waves of energy continuously rippled out. Wherever these ripples passed, everything crumbled to dust; the trees were crushed to residue, and even the hardest rocks were ground into powder.
Energy waves surged into the sky, making the entire valley shake, as though it was on the verge of collapse.
“Boom!”
Suddenly, a loud noise came through as the mountain walls burst open, turning into a cloud of dust flying toward Lin Yi!
The boulders fell like a blanket over the sky, whistling down toward Lin Yi!
The density of the dust was enormous, like a meteor shower, densely falling and submerging Lin Yi’s figure in a blink of an eye.
Lin Yi immediately activated his Cultivation Technique, running the Divine Refinement Technique. Wave after wave of mysterious fluctuations emitted from his body, enveloping him in protection.
Mysterious patterns flickered on Lin Yi’s body, shielding him thoroughly.
“Boom!”
A thunderous sound echoed in the void as a massive cliff was leveled to the ground, and yet Lin Yi was enveloped in a mysterious barrier, unaffected by the dust that pounded against his body.
Lin Yi’s complexion was pale, blood spilling from the corner of his mouth, clearly indicating that the injury was very severe, even affecting his Dantian Qi Sea.
Lin Yi knew he had to quickly absorb the energy within his body, otherwise he would definitely burst and die.
“This bastard, actually able to block my attack, who on earth is he? How could he block all our attacks? How could his physical body be so strong?”
At this moment, the group of young martial artists finally realized the crux of the problem. They looked at Lin Yi with eyes full of shock, their faces filled with confusion and questions.
Lin Yi’s physical body was indeed too horrific, far surpassing ordinary martial artists by too much. Even these young martial artists could not compare to Lin Yi.
Though they were all Martial Venerables, their physical bodies and cultivation had not yet reached the true peak; they could only be regarded as mid-level martial artists at best.
So, they had no way to contend with Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s strength was too formidable, so overwhelming that it took the breath away from these Martial Venerables, filling them with a profound sense of helplessness!
But how could they simply resign themselves to this?
These individuals were all peerless geniuses from various continents, proud and arrogant, unwilling to be challenged so easily by others!
Therefore, upon witnessing Lin Yi’s incredible prowess, they all wished to defeat him, to prove their own strength and make Lin Yi kneel at their feet!
Hence, they once again swung their fists and longswords, charging at Lin Yi, intent on seizing this chance to bring him down!
“Hmph, since you refuse to see reason, then I will show no mercy,”
Lin Yi, watching the dozens of Martial Venerable students attacking him, snorted coldly and immediately demonstrated a powerful Cultivation Technique. As it was activated, his entire demeanor suddenly changed, and a vast and majestic pressure burst forth.
The dozens of Martial Venerable students all stopped in their tracks in that moment, feeling the threat emanating from Lin Yi’s presence, their hearts filled with shock.
“What terrifying pressure, this is…”
“How can his aura be so frightening?”
“Could he be a master of the Martial Saint Realm?”
The Martial Venerable students looked at Lin Yi with horror-stricken faces.
“Your attacks are too weak. I do not even need to use True Yuan to defend against you. I can easily dispel your attacks and even counterattack,”
Lin Yi sneered, his eyes narrowing slightly as he exuded a strong murderous intent!
These dozens of young students, although all first-rate geniuses, were no match for Lin Yi, who could annihilate them with a simple move.
“Lin Yi, don’t be so arrogant. Even if you’re a Martial Saint today, if we all band together against you, we refuse to believe we can’t take you down!”
“That’s right. Your strength is too great, none of us can match you individually, so we’ve decided unanimously to join all young Martial Artists to besiege you, and see how you escape this time!”
The dozens of young Martial Artists all showed ferocious expressions, harboring one thought in their minds, to kill Lin Yi!
In their eyes, although Lin Yi was very strong, he had no significant background, a lone warrior in battle, how could he possibly stand against all of them united.
“I don’t care who bands together first, I’m going to kill all of you now, so you’ll know the consequences of offending me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 640: No Loss At All
chapters.content:
Chapter 640: Chapter 640: No Loss At All
The dozens of young trainees, one after another, launched attacks on Lin Yi with overwhelming momentum, but each attack was dissolved by Lin Yi, leaving him unscathed.
“What kind of monster is this kid? How can his body be so strong?”
“Our joint efforts are futile. We should split up and then attack him together!”
“That’s a good idea. Once we split up, we can join forces to launch an attack. Together we will attack Lin Yi, and he surely won’t be able to withstand it.”
“Right, after we split up, we’ll have the chance to come together. By then, he won’t dare to be careless!”
“Good, let’s do as you say and spread out to attack.”
The group of young trainees quickly scattered in all directions, then broke into one hundred and eight small teams and charged at Lin Yi.
“Think you can escape? Not so easy!”
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly, and his body moved like lightning. In the blink of an eye, he caught up to the one hundred and eight small teams and struck at the young trainees.
Bang bang bang bang bang…
Lin Yi’s speed was terrifying. Every time he struck, he would send the young trainees flying, all of them sustaining serious injuries.
However, the young trainees did not back down; they continued to attack Lin Yi desperately, vowing to slay him or be eliminated themselves.
“Hmph, killing me won’t be that easy!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, his body emitting sharp, unparalleled Gang Qi that swept toward the young trainees, blocking all their attacks.
Lin Yi threw punch after punch at the young trainees, causing them to spit blood and fly backward.
“Lin Yi, you really are strong, but you can’t possibly kill so many of us. You’d better surrender quietly, to avoid suffering!”
The young trainees all glared at Lin Yi, gritting their teeth.
“Heh, I, Lin Yi, have never been afraid of hardship. If you want me to surrender, then you’d better be prepared to be killed by me!”
Lin Yi’s lips curved into a smile, and with a cold laugh, he swung his fists again, hammering at the dozens of young trainees.
Seeing Lin Yi attack once more, the several dozen young trainees all roared furiously, and then they once again launched attacks at Lin Yi.
Bang bang bang bang!
As Lin Yi punched, he sent the young trainees flying, injuring them all and leaving the several dozen young trainees without the ability to fight.
“You bunch of trash, not the slightest challenge at all.”
Lin Yi shook his head and remarked.
“Damn it, Lin Yi, don’t be too arrogant. When we join forces to attack you, you’ll be crying!”
“Hmph, what’s the use of talking tough? When we come together to attack you, let’s see how you’ll defend!”
“Exactly, when we unite and attack you at the same time, you’ll realize how strong we are.”
These several dozen young trainees were all outstanding individuals from the young academy, with the strength of half-step Pill Condensation Realm martial artists, which made them powerful figures within the academy.
When they attacked Lin Yi together, their presence was overwhelming, causing the entire valley to tremble.
“Since you’re so eager to seek death, I’ll oblige you.”
Lin Yi’s lips bore a hint of a wicked smile as his aura suddenly surged, and in an instant, he surpassed his previous cultivation level, reaching the peak of the Sixth Rank of the Soul Refinement Realm!
“Lin Yi, you broke through? You actually managed to break through under these circumstances?!”
“How is that possible? How could you break through to the Sixth Rank of the Soul Refinement Realm in such a short time?!”
“No, it’s absolutely impossible. Lin Yi, you must be lying, certainly trying to mystify us.”
At this moment, those dozens of young cadets were all incredibly shocked. They couldn’t believe that Lin Yi’s cultivation had increased so drastically; they thought Lin Yi was deceiving them.
“I have no need to waste time with you. Since you all wish to die, I will fulfill your wish!”
With a touch of indifferent smile at the corner of his mouth, Lin Yi’s figure suddenly flickered, vanishing from the spot.
Bang!
The next second, Lin Yi appeared in front of one of the young cadets, striking out with a palm and sending the cadet flying, blood spurting wildly, knocking him unconscious.
Bang Bang Bang Bang!
Lin Yi’s figure flashed and instantly appeared in front of a cadet, palm following palm, striking the cadet unconscious and sending him flying too, plunging him into a total blackout.
In just a few seconds, Lin Yi had knocked those dozens of young cadets to the ground, all severely injured and completely unable to get up.
Despair, anger, and horror covered the faces of those cadets, their eyes all become dull.
They could never have imagined that despite all of them banding together, attacking Lin Yi in unison, they were unable to kill him.
Instead, they were defeated with a single move by Lin Yi, many getting thrown off with that one strike. Wasn’t that terrifying?
The power Lin Yi possessed was too heaven-defying.
“Now, it’s your turn.”
Looking at the young cadets, a trace of mocking appeared at the corner of Lin Yi’s mouth, his eyes freezing to the extreme.
“Lin Yi, you… you’d better not mess around. Our master is the Great Elder of the Purple Moon Dynasty! If you dare kill us, you’ll have to bear the consequences!”
A young cadet looked at Lin Yi with a hint of panic on his face.
“Haha! The Purple Moon Dynasty? What of it?”
On hearing this, Lin Yi immediately sneered, saying, “Even if it’s the Purple Moon Dynasty, so what? Your master won’t be able to avenge you. Just wait for me to torture you to death!”
Lin Yi sneered and said, “You young cadets are all untrustworthy people; you’re not worthy of making an eternal oath! You, scum, also making an eternal oath?”
“I know your hearts are not in the right place, so I won’t bother with you anymore. Now, I’m going to exterminate all of you, eliminating evil for all eternity!”

chapters.title: Chapter 641 - 641 Unrighteous Intentions
chapters.content:
Chapter 641: Chapter 641 Unrighteous Intentions
Lin Yi leapt forward, arriving in front of the young disciples, slapping them down one after another, toppling them to the ground.
With relentless slaps, Lin Yi inflicted severe injuries on the young disciples, robbing them of their ability to move, unable to evade Lin Yi’s attacks.
“Lin Yi, how…how can you be so ruthless, intending to utterly annihilate us? Don’t forget, our master is the Great Elder of the Purple Moon Dynasty—if he finds out, he will not let you off!”
“Lin Yi, if you dare kill me, the Purple Moon Dynasty absolutely will not let you off!”
“Lin Yi, you won’t die a good death, you won’t die a good death!”
The young disciples cursed Lin Yi one by one, wishing they could tear him apart alive.
“Hahaha, all you can do is threaten me with this, no wonder your Cultivation is so pathetic, not even close to my match!”
Lin Yi looked at the young disciples, scoffing with derision.
“Lin Yi, you despicable and shameless bastard, how dare you harm us—you will definitely meet a bad end!”
Those young disciples glared at Lin Yi with gritted teeth, eyes almost bursting, wishing they could shred Lin Yi to pieces!
“Is that so? I’ve been waiting for this moment, waiting for a very long time, too long—my patience has almost run out,”
“Since that’s the case, I will not hold back any longer!”
Lin Yi looked at the young disciples, his face showing a hint of cold cruelty.
Lin Yi punched a young disciple in the chest, obliterating his heart.
Splat!
The young disciple fell into a pool of blood, dead beyond any doubt.
“Lin Yi, you won’t die a good death, you damn scoundrel, how dare you hurt my brother—I won’t let you die well!”
Another young disciple, while falling into the bloodbath, also roared insanely, raging to the skies.
As an older brother, how could he not be enraged, witnessing his dearly loved younger brother being so brutally killed?
“You are all no good, it wasn’t me who killed your brother, don’t falsely accuse me!”
Lin Yi sneered coldly.
“Whether you admit it or not, it’s ultimately you who maimed all of us brothers. Even if we die, we absolutely won’t let you off!”
The young disciple’s gaze was icy, filled with intense hatred.
Lin Yi looked at him, shaking his head with a laugh, “You guys are truly foolish to the extreme, wanting to drag me down even in death. Let me tell you, even if you want to die, you have to ask if I agree to it first!”
In Lin Yi’s eyes flickered a chilling light, as a surge of formidable Yuan Force emanated from his body, manifesting into the phantom of a Demon God beside him.
Lin Yi struck down with his palm, instantly turning the young disciple into a pile of mush!
“You…you actually killed my brother?!”
“I will kill you, I must kill you, I will smash your body into ten thousand pieces, crush your bones and scatter your ashes!”
The remaining three young disciples, upon seeing their brother being smashed into a meat paste by Lin Yi, had their eyes turn blood-red, bellowing in fury.
“Heh, want to kill me? Your strength is far from enough to kill me!”
Lin Yi chuckled coldly, then with a single step, he moved through the air, appearing in front of the young disciple’s head, grabbing the young disciple’s skull and crushing it with force.
Thud!
The young disciple’s head burst open, spewing blood and grey matter, creating a large crater on the ground and scattering it all around.
In a single encounter, a young disciple of the academy, with the Cultivation at the Sixth Layer Realm, was instantly killed by Lin Yi, a clear display of absolute dominance!
“You… you actually killed my brother! Lin Yi, may you die a terrible death!”
The other two young apprentices, upon witnessing this scene, had their minds shaken, their faces turned pale, and they looked at Lin Yi with fear in their eyes.
“I will die a terrible death? Let me tell you, if you don’t cease your actions and continue to insult me, I won’t mind wiping you out!”
Lin Yi’s eyes were ice-cold, with a frightening chill emanating from his body.
The two young apprentices felt this intense killing intent and could not help but tremble, immediately kneeling on the ground, begging Lin Yi for mercy, “Senior Brother Lin Yi, we were wrong, we dare not insult you any longer, please spare us, spare us, we beg you…”
“Hmph, I just want an explanation right now. If your explanation doesn’t satisfy me, then, I won’t mind getting rid of you all!”
Lin Yi looked at the four kneeling young apprentices and coldly warned them.
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, the four young apprentices trembled with fear.
They knew that Lin Yi was determined to kill them, and they did not dare to defy him anymore. They all knocked their heads on the ground urgently, begging for mercy, “Senior Brother Lin Yi, we won’t make wild statements or slander you anymore, we beg you not to kill us, please!”
“Hmph, since you won’t speak, then I won’t be polite either!”
Lin Yi’s expression grew colder, and then he reached out his hand towards the Dantians of these young apprentices.
“Aaaaah!”
Pitiful screams erupted from the mouths of the four young apprentices, their Dantians destroyed, completely losing the qualifications for cultivation, with no hope of becoming immortals, and they could only live as ordinary mortals.
“Senior Brother Lin Yi, please don’t cripple us, I’m willing to submit to you, please don’t destroy my Dantian!”
“Senior Brother Lin Yi, please, any punishment is enough, just don’t destroy my Dantian! I don’t want to be an ordinary person!”
The four young apprentices had their Cultivation crippled by Lin Yi, turning them into ordinary people.
“I don’t need your loyalty, I only want you to do one thing for me.”
Lin Yi looked at these people and spoke indifferently.
“Senior Brother Lin Yi, just say the word. As long as it’s within our power, we will go through fire and water without any hesitation!”
“Yes, Senior Brother Lin Yi, we are all willing to undertake any risk!”
The other young apprentices quickly expressed their willingness.
“Good, since that’s the case, I won’t mistreat you. Just hand over your Identity Jades to me, and I will let you go, and even give you a sum of money so that you can escape far away and leave this place!”
Lin Yi said.
“What?”
The four young apprentices showed a shocked expression when they heard this.
They could never have dreamed that Lin Yi would actually ask them for their Identity Jades, and for a moment, they couldn’t understand what Lin Yi was planning to do.
“What, you’re unwilling? If you’re unwilling, then I have no other choice, I can only kill you once more, only hoping that you won’t cry and wail when the time comes!”
Lin Yi sneered, making a move.
His right hand’s five fingers transformed into five extremely sharp sword beams, slashing towards the necks of the four young apprentices.
