As Lin Yi made his move, they had already reacted, immediately using various techniques to defend against Lin Yi’s sword.
Thwack!
All four young apprentices were sliced in half by Lin Yi’s sword.
Blood spurted out, staining the ground red.

chapters.title: Chapter 642: Lowered by One Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 642: Chapter 642: Lowered by One Realm
“Although my Cultivation is one Realm lower than yours, it’s still such an effortless task to deal with you. If my Cultivation breaks through to the Foundation Establishment Stage, wouldn’t I be even more terrifying? Who in this world would then be my opponent?”
Lin Yi’s eyes twinkled with excitement.
His speed of cultivation was so fast, entirely due to the pileup of those heaven and earth treasures. Without them, he couldn’t have possibly cultivated to the later stages of Foundation Establishment, let alone defeat experts of the Second Layer of physical refinement across several tiers.
And the main reason he could enhance his Cultivation was precisely those heaven and earth treasures, which repaired soul injuries and increased Cultivation, among other things. These treasures had made his soul several times stronger, allowing his Cultivation to improve so rapidly.
But such an enhancement was only a temporary boost. As his Cultivation increased, his soul would gradually weaken, reverting to its previous state.
However, none of that mattered. As long as Lin Yi’s Cultivation was high enough, he wouldn’t fear the consumption of soul power.
“Brother Lin Yi, you really are too formidable, truly a prodigy bestowed by heaven!”
“Brother Lin Yi, we’re convinced!”
The faces of those four young disciples revealed shock and admiration.
“Since you’re convinced, then from now on, you are my servants. Should I encounter any danger, you must serve me without shirking or complaining. Should you defy me, you’ll be executed on the spot. Do you understand?”
Lin Yi stared at the four young disciples, his eyes brimming with killing intent.
“Understood, understood, whatever Brother Lin Yi says, we’ll do it! We will follow you to the death without a word of complaint!”
“Us too!”
“Me too!”
The young disciples nodded in agreement, one after another.
“Well then, bring out your Identity Jade that you carry on you, and then get lost with them. Never set foot in this city again; if you dare to enter, you’ll be summarily executed!”
Lin Yi said indifferently.
“Brother Lin Yi, we’ll leave this place now and never trouble you again, we will absolutely not step foot here ever again!”
The four young disciples all nodded, immediately taking out their Identity Jade.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
After handing over their Identity Jade, the four young disciples fled in panic, as if afraid that a moment’s delay would lead Lin Yi to kill them.
“Alright, you all leave. From today on, I, Lin Yi, am the boss of this city. From now on, I am the guardian of Southern Desolate City! You will also join me to dominate Southern Desolate City! Hahahaha!”
Lin Yi laughed arrogantly.
At this moment, he exuded an air of condescension that overlooked everything, like a War God descending, his aura towering.
“Congratulations, Brother Lin Yi. From now on, we , the people of Southern Desolate City, will also be able to possess an Identity Jade. I believe Brother Lin Yi will surely protect Southern Desolate City!”
Those four young disciples, seeing Lin Yi in such an imposing manner, were all extremely excited and bowed respectfully to him.
Lin Yi waved his hand and said, “There’s no need for such empty formalities, just scram! I need to peacefully enter seclusion now. I hope you do not disturb me. Should I find out you disturb my cultivation or plan to scheme behind my back, I will take your lives!”
The four young disciples hurriedly nodded and left with respect.
“Lin Yi, I truly admire you so much!”
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, from now on you’re one of us, a resident of Southern Desolate City, your glory and splendor shall not be infringed!”
“Brother Lin Yi, rest assured, we will definitely follow you to the death!”
After the four young disciples left, Lin Yi was surrounded by the people of Southern Desolate City. They bowed to him one after another, ceaselessly voicing their admiration. They looked up to Lin Yi with adoration, as if worshiping him as a deity, their eyes filled with endless respect and affection.
“You don’t need to worship me like this, as long as you follow my orders, I will not treat you unfairly!”
Lin Yi waved his hand.
“Brother Lin Yi, you are our hero in Southern Desolate City, and you will always be the idol in our hearts. From now on, you are the city lord of Southern Desolate City, and we are willing to become your subordinates!”
“Yes, to become your subordinates!”
“From now on, Southern Desolate City will be your staunch supporter!”
The citizens clamored one after another.
“Good! Then I won’t be modest. From now on, I am the city lord of this city, and I hope you will all obey me and not disappoint me!”
Lin Yi said loudly.
“We know what to do!”
The citizens answered in unison, their eyes filled with determination.
“Hmm!”
Lin Yi nodded and then turned to walk into the city.
Before long, he found a secluded courtyard and sealed it off.
Inside the rooms of the courtyard.
“You four, go and find me an Immortal Elixir. As long as you help me find the Immortal Elixir, I will reward you with a Divine Artifact, as well as the Cultivation Technique and Divine Skills secret technique I just obtained!”
“Yes, we know what to do now!”
The four young disciples nodded one after another, indicating they knew what to do.
“Good, you may withdraw for now. I need to cultivate properly and strive to make a breakthrough to Nascent Soul as soon as possible, and then head to Central Region to capture the legacy of Central Region City.”
Lin Yi waved his hand and said.
After he finished speaking, he sat cross-legged and began to regulate his breathing to recover his damaged body.
Over these years, he had been diligently practicing the Chaotic Heavenly Emperor Art, and whenever he made any progress, he would immediately push the art to its limits, reaching the Nascent Soul Realm.
Lin Yi’s cultivation speed was incredibly fast. Racing along the way, he ventured through Southern Desolate City, slaying Demon Beasts everywhere he went.
In the blink of an eye, five years passed, and Lin Yi’s cultivation in Southern Desolate City had already reached the peak of the Golden Core Realm, just a hair’s breadth away from the Nascent Soul Realm.
“Brother Lin Yi, over these years, we have discovered several ancient ruins which contain many rare and exotic treasures. As long as you can enter, we are certain to obtain some good things. We want to sell these treasures for Spirit Stones.”
One day, the four young disciples appeared again, arriving at Lin Yi’s doorstep.
“Oh? What kind of ruins are these? Let’s go take a look.”
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s spirit was immediately lifted, and he stood up to walk outside.
In Southern Desolate City, there are many cities, and the largest one is Central Region City.
There are three major forces in Central Region City: The four sects of Central Region–
Northern State, Purple Mist Sect; Southern State, Qing Luan Palace; Northern Sea, Heavenly Demon Pavilion.
Central Region City, Purple Mist Sect.
Southern Desolate City, Qing Luan Palace.
Any one of these four forces is among the top powers in Southern Desolate City, and they all have the support of a super sect behind them.
The Southern Desolate City where Lin Yi and his companions are now located is a city under Northern Sea City, and the strongest power in Northern Sea City is one of the four great sects of the Northern Region–Purple Mist Sect.
Purple Mist Sect is the second largest sect in Southern Desolate City, surpassed only by Qing Luan Palace. It is also the largest force in Southern Desolate City. Its influence spreads throughout the entire Southern Desolate City, a presence that all look up to.

chapters.title: Chapter 643: The Citizens of Southern Desolate City
chapters.content:
Chapter 643: Chapter 643: The Citizens of Southern Desolate City
Lin Yi and the four people following behind him made their way towards the central area of Southern Desolate City.
In the central square of Southern Desolate City, a multitude of people gathered. These people were the citizens of Southern Desolate City, all congregated here to watch various contests and engage in friendly sparring and exchanges.
“Southern Desolate City, I came here to participate in the martial arts tournament, but I haven’t entered the top hundred yet, so I don’t have the qualifications to participate for the time being,”
“I’ve heard about that. It’s said that the purpose of this martial arts tournament is to select the top ten individuals to receive rewards,”
“The top ten individuals will be able to go to Central Region City to comprehend inheritances!”
“Indeed, inheritances are something countless cultivators dream of obtaining. Anyone with a bit of aptitude wishes to gain some inheritance. It’s just a pity they lack any aptitude and can’t enter the heart of the martial arts tournament. Otherwise, they definitely could gain greater benefits!”
There was a buzz of discussions among the crowd.
Having heard their conversations, Lin Yi also became aware of their identities. It turned out that many among these citizens had come to participate in the martial arts tournament but failed to enter the top one hundred and also missed the chance to receive an inheritance, so they could only watch from the sidelines.
Lin Yi glanced at the citizens and an idea formed in his mind.
He was just about to go out to find some Spirit Grass and Immortal Flowers to help these citizens improve their cultivation and enhance their strength when a familiar figure suddenly appeared in his mind, the merchant he once traded Soul Pills with, named Li Dahai.
“Li Dahai, you’re here!”
Seeing the merchant, Lin Yi’s mood lifted greatly. He hurriedly called over to Li Dahai and asked, “What brings you here?”
“Hehe, Young Master Lin, you’ve finally returned. I’ve been waiting here for you for a long time. I heard that you were going to participate in the martial arts tournament, so I specifically came to watch,”
Li Dahai said with a chuckle, displaying great enthusiasm.
“What is the martial arts tournament?”
Lin Yi looked at Li Dahai with confusion, not understanding what the martial arts tournament was.
“Young Master Lin, are you still not aware?”
“I really don’t know. What exactly is this martial arts tournament? I heard it’s somewhat like a grand feast, offering considerable benefits,”
“Young Master Lin is indeed well-informed. This martial arts tournament is a grand event held by our Southern Desolate City, occurring once every five years. With each edition, there are many outstanding disciples who are attracted here, and numerous treasures that they collect, leaving only the final victors,”
“So it is. I heard that each edition’s champion receives an Immortal Fruit and a hefty reward,”
“Indeed, Young Master Lin is truly blessed to have such generous rewards within reach,”
Li Dahai said, thumping his chest with pride.
“Immortal Fruit? What exactly is that fruit like?”
Lin Yi asked with interest, his curiosity piqued about the Immortal Fruit.
“Young Master Lin, you might not know, but the Immortal Fruit is an extremely rare type of Spirit Fruit, grown in the Immortal Realm. It can help people rapidly improve their cultivation. Due to its rarity, it’s even more precious. Furthermore, the denizens of the Immortal Realm enjoy consuming Spirit Fruits, as it allows them to quickly enhance their cultivation,”
Li Dahai explained, his tone tinged with a hint of envy.
“Then, what color is this Immortal Fruit exactly?”
Lin Yi continued to ask.
“It’s a yellow fruit, named Yellow Lotus Immortal Fruit,”
“Yellow Lotus? A yellow Immortal Fruit… somehow that feels a bit odd to me,”
Lin Yi touched his nose, murmuring to himself.
Even though he wasn’t very familiar with Spirit Grass, the name of this Immortal Fruit was still new to him.
“This Immortal Fruit is borne of the Golden Tree, hence its name, the Yellow Lotus Immortal Fruit, but the Golden Tree has been dead for tens of thousands of years now, leaving behind only Golden Tree Leaves and a withered branch, how could it still bear Yellow Lotus?”
Li Dahai shook his head and smiled bitterly, not very confident about the Yellow Lotus Immortal Fruit.
Lin Yi nodded his head, he didn’t take the Yellow Lotus Immortal Fruit too seriously, because in Lin Yi’s eyes, this Yellow Lotus Immortal Fruit was just an ordinary Immortal Elixir.
“Young Master Lin, are you here to participate in the martial arts tournament?”
Li Dahai suddenly asked.
“Yes, I am here for the martial arts tournament, but I have not yet entered the top ten ranks.”
“Then, Young Master Lin must be careful. In the martial arts tournament, there are some monstrously talented individuals who can easily defeat cultivators at the peak of the Martial Venerable realm.”
Li Dahai warned, speaking sincerely and with great concern for Lin Yi.
Lin Yi nodded, indicating he understood.
“Young Master Lin, do you have any plans?”
“This, I am aiming to secure a spot in the top ten so I can see if I can enter Central Region City to comprehend the legacy. This way, I can rapidly improve my strength and then I will be able to participate in the martial arts tournament, which will also be a way to earn some resources for myself.”
Lin Yi spoke, his eyes flickering as he pondered.
His main reason for participating in the martial arts tournament was to rapidly improve his strength and strive to comprehend the legacy left behind in Central Region City by the Sword Saint as soon as possible. By doing so, he would have more aces up his sleeve and be able to gain a foothold within Central Region City.
Lin Yi’s words brightened Li Dahai’s eyes, and his attitude towards Lin Yi changed greatly. He quickly said, “Since you have this intention, Young Master Lin, let me arrange it for you. I will take you to see the martial arts tournament now, and you can take a seat in the spectator stands for the time being!”
“That would trouble you, Steward Li!”
Lin Yi expressed his thanks, and then he walked over to the spectator stands to start watching the martial arts tournament.
Li Dahai settled Lin Yi in the spectator stands before he immediately left to take care of the arrangements for the martial arts tournament.
“Lin Yi, you’ve finally come back, I was worried to death about you.”
Just then, a familiar voice rang in Lin Yi’s ear. Turning his head to look, he saw a familiar silhouette—it was Li Dahai.
“Uncle Li, I’m fine, you needn’t worry.”
Lin Yi said with a smile. Seeing Li Dahai, he was very happy; after so many days without seeing him, Lin Yi had missed Li Dahai as well.
“By the way, Uncle Li, did you just mention the martial arts tournament? Is there something special about this tournament?”
Lin Yi inquired.
“Mm! Lin Yi, let me tell you something important, but you must not get too excited after hearing it!”
Li Dahai looked around, lowered his voice, and said to Lin Yi.
“What’s so important? Just speak frankly, don’t be so nervous.”
Lin Yi said with a laugh, thinking to himself that the martial arts tournament must indeed be unusual.
Li Dahai took a deep breath, lowered his voice, and said to Lin Yi, “I heard that this martial arts tournament is held only once every twenty years, and each time, it selects a group of top talents. In the end, it decides who will achieve the top three ranks of the tournament and win that reward.”
“That impressive? Then I do want to see it for myself.”
Lin Yi was astonished and became even more curious about the martial arts tournament.
“I’ve heard that the rules of the martial arts tournament are extremely strict. Once you fail a challenge, you will be disqualified from competing, and you might even be subjected to punishment. Have you considered not participating in the martial arts tournament?”
Li Dahai advised.

chapters.title: Chapter 644: Absolutely Will Not Lose the Match
chapters.content:
Chapter 644: Chapter 644: Absolutely Will Not Lose the Match
“It’s fine, I’m confident I can take the first place in the martial arts tournament. I want to give it a try!”
Lin Yi smiled slightly.
“In that case, I will take you to the arena of the martial arts tournament now. I hope you don’t get defeated by someone else; that would be too embarrassing.”
Seeing Lin Yi’s resolute expression, Li Dahai could only nod and agree.
“Rest assured, I absolutely will not lose the competition. I am still looking forward to taking part in the martial arts tournament and getting into the top three.”
Lin Yi spoke with a solemn promise.
“Alright then, I’ll take you there.”
“Let’s go then.”
Li Dahai led Lin Yi toward the direction of the martial arts tournament.
The two arrived at the site of the martial arts tournament.
The martial arts tournament was held in a valley outside the city. In the center of the valley stood a massive square, a hundred meters tall, filled with stages and arranged with formations to prevent chaos during the competition.
This huge square was the main venue of the martial arts tournament.
After arriving at the square, Lin Yi and Li Dahai found an open rock to sit on.
There were quite a few people on the square, all watching the competition stages, wishing to participate in the martial arts tournament.
Around the competition stages, numerous crowds gathered, all fixed on the matches.
Many people also crowded below the stages.
“Shopkeeper Li, I want to go up and watch the matches.”
Lin Yi looked at Li Dahai and said. He wanted to go to the stage to observe the matches.
“Alright then, you go on up, Master Lin. I won’t accompany you to watch.”
Li Dahai nodded and then left.
Lin Yi stood up and walked toward the upper area.
The staircase was circular, with red carpet laid on it, and the walls on both sides of the carpet were inlaid with numerous Luminous Pearls, casting a gentle glow, making the square very bright.
Lin Yi ascended the stairs slowly, his eyes filled with curiosity. He had never been in such a scenario before and wanted to see what this competition was all about.
Lin Yi climbed the large circular staircase slowly and stood at its peak, overlooking the entire scene of the competition.
“Are the fights here really different from the competitions elsewhere? I remember the past fights were all about simplicity, with no fancy moves, just a pure contest of martial arts. Why is this martial arts tournament made so complicated?”
Lin Yi thought to himself.
“Hmm?”
Suddenly, he noticed two men in green chatting in the distance. Their attire seemed to mark them as enforcers of the martial arts tournament, but these two enforcers were tall and thin, dressed in black robes, carrying long whips, and exuded an intense aura of lethal intent.
“Could it be that this is the way the martial arts tournament conducts its competitions?”
Lin Yi felt puzzled and couldn’t help but cast his gaze toward the two enforcers.
As the two enforcers chatted, they suddenly looked in Lin Yi’s direction and revealed a hint of mockery and sneer.
“Hmph, another youngster who overestimates himself.”
“I tell you, definitely another one coming to meet his death. We’ve encountered countless such cases along the way.”
“Alas, how can there be so many useless people in this world? This youngster, at first glance, is an idiot. I bet he doesn’t even know what this place is.”
The two law enforcers shook their heads and sighed.
Meanwhile, at this time, the few judges on the gigantic competition stage had begun announcing the rules.
“In the first round of the Martial Arts Tournament, the rule is to determine the opponent by drawing lots. With a total of ninety-eight participants, the competition is divided into ten matches. Each match prepares only one person, and each person is granted a rest time of a single incense stick. After one incense stick’s time has passed, the drawing of lots and matches will commence.”
“Before the conclusion of the drawing lots, all participants in the competition may choose their own opponents or issue challenges to any contestant. As long as your adversary accepts your challenge, you qualify for a victory in that match.”
After these judges had finished announcing the rules, the competition began.
Lin Yi glanced at his number plate, which bore the words “Lin Yi”.
“Hmm? It’s actually my opponent? Very well, let’s have a match now!”
Lin Yi felt a burst of excitement in his heart. He no longer needed to watch the other matches; he directly put the number plate into his bag and stretched his right hand into his sleeve to search. Before long, Lin Yi pulled out two small porcelain bottles from his sleeve.
“Lin Yi, these contain the poison I’ve refined. Take one pill, and the antidotes are within these two elixirs.”
At this moment, Weiwei transmitted his voice to Lin Yi, instructing him to swallow the elixir.
Lin Yi nodded and brought the elixir to his lips.
After swallowing the elixir, Lin Yi felt a hot stream surge through his body. It rose from his dantian and instantly spread throughout his body. Lin Yi felt wonderfully relieved, as if all the fatigue from his body had vanished.
“Eh?”
Suddenly, Lin Yi’s head jerked, feeling that the primordial energy within his body had notably strengthened, transforming him into a peak cultivator of the Innate realm. His eyes widened in astonishment.
“What’s going on, what happened? How did my primordial energy increase? Could it be because of the two Marrow Cleansing Fruits I took?”
Lin Yi was puzzled in his heart, but at this moment, his match was about to start. Lin Yi couldn’t delay any further and quickly focused his attention on the platform.
At that moment, the Martial Arts Tournament match also began, and Lin Yi cast his gaze towards his opponent.
Across from Lin Yi stood two men: one in yellow garb—a handsome young man with a face full of arrogant disdain—and the other, a gray-clothed elder.
The gray-clothed elder seemed to be in his fifties or sixties, but his actual appearance was that of a man in his forties, looking around thirty years old.
Moreover, his cultivation had reached the early stage of the Innate realm, considered quite powerful, while the gray-clothed elder was at the intermediate stage of the Innate realm, also a formidable combatant.
These two were regulars at the Martial Arts Tournament and had spent nearly two hundred years here, possessing unparalleled experience. Many had fallen to them in the tournament.
“Lin Yi, today, let us experience your esteemed methods!”
At this time, the yellow-clothed youth spoke, looking at Lin Yi with a face full of scorn.
Lin Yi glanced at him and said indifferently, “Alright, I too am quite eager to experience the esteemed methods of the Martial Arts Tournament.”
Lin Yi said this and stepped onto the platform.
As the two ascended the platform, the match began.
“Swoosh!”
The gray-clothed elder, like a specter, charged at Lin Yi, his long whip lashing fiercely towards Lin Yi’s chest. He unleashed his strongest attack as soon as he made a move.
“Swish!”
A pitch-black whip, like a venomous snake, whipped towards Lin Yi’s chest. This one strike had the power to pierce through metal.
Lin Yi narrowed his eyes and clenched his fists, punching forward vigorously with both hands. Two gusts of wind howled forth, meeting the approaching whip head-on.
“Boom!”
The gusts of wind collided with the whip, causing a loud explosion, and then the wind was dissipated by the whip.

chapters.title: Chapter 645: Hard to Deal With!
chapters.content:
Chapter 645: Chapter 645: Hard to Deal With!
“Eh? This person actually managed to catch my whip, not bad in strength.”
At this moment, surprise colored the face of the man in grey.
Lin Yi didn’t continue to punch this time, instead, he pushed his speed to the utmost, leaving afterimages in the air as he rushed towards the man in grey.
“Bang!”
Lin Yi’s fist hammered into the man in grey, but it didn’t bring him the slightest injury.
Lin Yi’s brows furrowed slightly, not expecting the man in grey to be so tenacious and strong, not easy to deal with at all!
Bested in a move, the man in grey swiftly retreated, his body turned, and his arm swung the Long Whip like a venomous snake lashing out, directly stabbing towards Lin Yi’s waist with a layer of fine barbs on the whip, sharp enough to pierce a stone slab!
“Hmph!”
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly with a chill, his figure suddenly accelerated, directly dodging the man in grey’s attack, then reached out to grab him.
Lin Yi’s hands clawed, and he grabbed the Long Whip, then pulled, attempting to take it away.
The man in grey’s figure swayed, his movement technique elusive, with a sidestep, he avoided Lin Yi’s grab.
Lin Yi’s claw grasped at nothing but air, a miss that left him somewhat annoyed. His figure leapt fiercely, pouncing towards the man in grey.
Clearly prepared, the man in grey whipped even more furiously upon seeing this, like a venomous snake, entwining Lin Yi and binding him tightly, trapping his hands so he couldn’t break free.
“Hehe!”
The man in grey chuckled coldly, then with a fierce flick of his wrist, he slammed Lin Yi down onto the platform with his whip.
“Hahahaha! This kid was actually thrown off the platform by me, so shameful!”
At this time, the crowd of onlookers, seeing Lin Yi thrown off by the man in grey, all couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
“I think this kid is definitely headed for a miserable defeat, no hope left!”
“Indeed! Such a joke, thinking he could compete in martial arts with us?”
“Heh, even if he managed to beat those two old men, so what? He’s ultimately just a commoner; in my view, he’s still rather weak.”
The crowd jeered, looking at Lin Yi with disdain in their eyes.
“Lin Yi, just admit defeat, you can’t possibly be his match.”
Watching Lin Yi thrown onto the platform, Yang Xuan also shook his head, speaking to Lin Yi.
“I haven’t said I’d admit defeat. It’s just that my strength is too poor, not suited for competing on the platform. It’s better to wait until I advance to a higher level!”
Lin Yi looked at Yang Xuan as he spoke.
“What? You won’t admit defeat?”
“Are you stupid? Don’t you know you’ve already been eliminated? This is the Martial Combat Conference; you’re not the match of these experts. Even if you admit defeat, it will do nothing. Do you really not accept your fate?”
“Exactly! Better admit defeat quickly, to avoid being killed off!”
…
Hearing that Lin Yi refused to admit defeat, the onlooking crowd showed contempt on their faces, continuously pressuring Lin Yi to concede.
“Lin Yi, stop struggling; there’s no way out for you here!”
“Lin Yi, you can’t match us, you should just surrender obediently.”
Some people, seeing Lin Yi’s refusal, took turns advising him to give up.
“I don’t want to give up, and I can’t give up!” Lin Yi shook his head, indicating his attitude of not conceding, and then turned to look at Yang Xuan and asked, “Brother Yang, what would happen if I were to give up?”
Upon hearing Lin Yi ask such a question, Yang Xuan was startled and didn’t understand why Lin Yi would suddenly ask this. After thinking for a bit, he said, “Nothing much, just elimination, that’s all.”
“Elimination, huh? In that case, let’s continue then. Let me see what impressive skills you have.”
“Good, I had the same thought. Today I am going to show you just how vast the gap between you and me really is!”
Lin Yi nodded, his expression calm and untroubled.
Although he wasn’t as strong as these people now, that didn’t mean he had no way to defeat them, because his movement technique was rather tricky, and his speed was outrageously fast. In the martial arts competition, he hardly needed to spend much time to secure victory.
Yang Xuan nodded and stopped wasting words. Holding his long spear, he charged toward Lin Yi.
Seeing Yang Xuan charging at him, Lin Yi showed no panic, merely lifting his foot lightly, then stepping forward, his figure agile and his movement technique as fast as a ghost, unpredictable and hard to guard against. Yang Xuan’s offensive was fruitless, and then he was evaded by Lin Yi.
Seeing Lin Yi dodge his attack, Yang Xuan couldn’t help but be shocked. He hadn’t expected Lin Yi’s reaction speed to be so fast, it was simply astonishing.
“Lin Yi, are you playing hide and seek?” Yang Xuan asked.
“You’ve got it right!” Lin Yi answered.
“If that’s the case, then don’t blame me for not being polite. Get ready to die!”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, Yang Xuan immediately became enraged, his long spear sweeping across like a Swinging Dragon’s Tail, stabbing toward Lin Yi with an aggressive and powerful momentum.
Witnessing this scene, Lin Yi couldn’t help but secretly admire: Great spear technique! This stab, like a Flood Dragon swinging its tail, the power terrifying, unmatched in ferocity.
“Good!”
Lin Yi roared, grabbed the other end of the long whip with his right hand, and threw a punch with his left hand toward the long whip.
“Bang!”
Their fists collided, and a terrifying force erupted, deafening as if thunder exploded in the sky.
Lin Yi’s fist felt a bit numb from the shock, and his body retreated continuously, almost falling to the ground.
At this time, Lin Yi’s eyes turned grave.
“This guy named Yang Xuan is indeed deserving of his rank as the fourth master on the Heavenly List, so powerful! I didn’t gain any advantage just now. His strength really should not be underestimated,” Lin Yi silently thought to himself, not daring to look down on this guy, Yang Xuan.
Yang Xuan was also secretly surprised. He hadn’t expected this youngster, Lin Yi, to be so formidable. Having just exchanged blows for a brief moment had already made him feel uneasy.
However, recalling how he had been chased by Demon Beasts in the Qingyun Mountain Range, nearly dying, and later being besieged by a group of ferocious beasts, Yang Xuan filled with resentment.
“I must eliminate this youngster, otherwise I’ll never be able to surpass Xiao Chen and Chen Chen, let alone exceed them!” Yang Xuan thought to himself and then attacked again.
“Good!”
Seeing Yang Xuan attack once more, Lin Yi nodded and then also threw another punch to meet him.
Yang Xuan was very fast, the spear in his hand like a black dragon sweeping toward Lin Yi.
“Clang!”
The two spears collided once more, Lin Yi and Yang Xuan both slid backward, steadying their stance simultaneously.
“Brother Yang, I have already mastered the sixth form of the Wind Spirit Technique, the Wind Spirit Force. Now that I’m about to use this move, I wonder if you can withstand it?” Lin Yi said with a slight smile.
“Don’t worry about that. Although your move is fast, my speed isn’t slow either. You can’t attack me at all,” Yang Xuan said.

chapters.title: Chapter 646: The Body Transforms into an Afterimage
chapters.content:
Chapter 646: Chapter 646: The Body Transforms into an Afterimage
“Then let me show you what Wind Spirit Force is!”
Lin Yi roared, his body instantly turned into a blur, and he charged toward Yang Xuan.
“Whoosh!”
Lin Yi’s movements were erratic and incredibly agile, his speed so fast that it caught Yang Xuan off guard.
Yang Xuan hadn’t expected Lin Yi to be so quick, but after all, his cultivation was much higher than Lin Yi’s. In terms of speed, he still held a slight edge over Lin Yi.
“Boom!”
Lin Yi lashed out with a whip kick, knocking the long spear out of Yang Xuan’s hands, and then landed a palm strike on Yang Xuan’s chest.
“Pfft!”
Yang Xuan spat out a mouthful of blood, his body like a kite with a broken string, flying backward and crashing heavily to one side of the arena.
“How… How could this happen?”
Seeing Yang Xuan being sent flying by Lin Yi’s strike, everyone was shocked, their faces filled with disbelief; they simply couldn’t imagine how Lin Yi, a young master with much lower strength than Yang Xuan, could defeat Yang Xuan with a single blow.
Watching Lin Yi defeat Yang Xuan with one move, all the competitors were astounded, their eyes wide and filled with disbelief.
“Worthy of the Seventh Form of the Wind Spirit Technique, indeed very impressive.”
Lin Yi thought to himself.
The move he had just used was the Fifth Form of the Wind Spirit Technique, “Wind Spirit Palm.”
Ever since Lin Yi began cultivating the “Wind Spirit Technique,” he had been contemplating the use of Wind Spirit Palm. Although this martial arts technique was very powerful, it consumed a great deal of Spiritual Energy and True Yuan.
Although Lin Yi was a cultivator, he didn’t have True Yuan in his dantian, so he could only absorb the surrounding Spiritual Energy through his cultivation technique before he could use the Wind Spirit Palm.
The Wind Spirit Palm Lin Yi had just executed was only at half strength, deploying merely two-thirds of its power.
If Lin Yi used the Wind Spirit Palm with full force, he could probably defeat Yang Xuan in one hit.
Looking at Yang Xuan, Lin Yi’s gaze was filled with pity, for he knew that Yang Xuan was utterly finished.
“This guy, he’s finally done for!” Lin Yi thought to himself, revealing a faint smile. He had won this duel.
At that moment, the referee announced the result, “Congratulations to Lin Yi for the victory!”
Lin Yi walked over to Yang Xuan, patted his shoulder, and said, “Yang Xuan, your strength is indeed formidable, but in my eyes, it’s still too weak. However, considering we’re from the same group of competitors, I won’t bother holding a grudge. I’m sending you off to paradise now!”
Lin Yi stretched out his palms toward Yang Xuan, and in the center of his palms, a golden-red flame burned, emitting a scorching heat.
“Is that… Spiritual Fire!?” Seeing the Spiritual Fire burning in Lin Yi’s hands, Yang Xuan’s pupils shrank, his face filled with disbelief as he spoke.
After hearing this, Lin Yi laughed heartily and said, “How about that, scared now? This is the power I possess. Now die!”
“You… Who exactly are you? How can you possess such heaven-defying talent!”
Looking at the Spiritual Fire in Lin Yi’s palm, Yang Xuan’s complexion turned pale. He hadn’t expected someone in this world to cultivate faster than him, especially without using a Spiritual Artifact.
“You don’t need to know that, because you’re about to meet the King of Hell.”
After hearing Lin Yi’s words, Yang Xuan felt a chill in his heart, knowing for certain he was defeated. Yet, there remained a bit of unwillingness; he had some regrets for not being able to meet Xiao Yu’er and many words he wanted to say to her, but he had no chance now. Such was fate; he could not change it, only accept it.
“Just… Just kill me then!”
Seeing Yang Xuan capitulate, Lin Yi couldn’t bother to waste more words, and he immediately struck, his palm landing on Yang Xuan’s head. Yang Xuan passed out immediately, his body collapsing limply on the ground.
“Whooosh… ”
Lin Yi gasped heavily, sweat from his forehead streaming down as he panted continuously. His face was as pale as paper, and the use of the Wind Spirit Force had clearly taken a heavy toll on him, leaving his body severely depleted.
“Brother Lin Yi, how are you feeling?”
The people beside Lin Yi, seeing his condition, hurriedly expressed their concern.
“It’s nothing, just a bit exhausted from using all my strength. I’ll be fine after some rest,” Lin Yi shook his head, waved his hand at everyone, and said.
After that, Lin Yi went to another platform and said to the few people there, “Let’s continue the competition.”
“Brother Lin Yi, are you sure you’re okay? Should I take your place in the competition?” a young man asked.
“No need, you’re also badly injured, don’t push yourself. You’re much stronger than me, how could I possibly be a match for you?” Lin Yi said.
This young man was Ye Feng, who had fought with Lin Yi earlier. Hearing Lin Yi’s words, he couldn’t help but give a wry smile: “Brother Lin Yi, don’t put me down like that. If you haven’t recovered from your injury, you will surely lose, and then I won’t have the face to stay here.”
“Haha, don’t worry! Haven’t I not lost yet? Stop worrying and get ready for the next round of the competition,” Lin Yi said with a hearty laugh.
Then, Lin Yi left the platform to heal his injuries.
Watching Lin Yi’s retreating figure, the others showed a hint of envy and admiration on their faces.
At that moment, a man in green robes slowly approached Lin Yi and, looking at Yang Xuan lying on the ground, still bleeding, said, “Lin Yi, did you really cripple him?”
“Yes, he doesn’t deserve to be my opponent, and I had no need to spare his life,” Lin Yi replied.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the man in green robes was slightly startled, then shook his head and walked away.
The gap in strength between him and Lin Yi was too great; he couldn’t help Yang Xuan at all and might even hold Lin Yi back, which was the last thing he wanted.
…
Yang Xuan’s wounds gradually healed, but he did not wake up and remained unconscious. The intense pain emanating from his body was almost unbearable.
“Damn, how can this kid endure so much pain?” Lin Yi frowned, mumbling somewhat displeased.
Lin Yi knew that Yang Xuan was feigning it, but he didn’t expose him since Yang Xuan still had some use to him, a great deal of it, in fact.
“This kid is really tough. My Wind Spirit Technique had no effect on him! It seems that only fire-type spiritual energy will have an impact on him,” Lin Yi sighed inwardly.
Lin Yi took out a Spirit Stone and consumed it, then sat cross-legged behind Yang Xuan, his arms flailing wildly.
“Swoosh swoosh swoosh…”
In between the swings of Lin Yi’s arms, numerous fierce gusts of wind appeared in the air, each with tremendous attack power, heading straight for Yang Xuan.
“Boom boom boom~”
The platform where they were was instantly destroyed by the gusts of wind.
Seeing Yang Xuan’s condition, Lin Yi’s lips curled into a cold smile as he muttered, “Hmph… Yang Xuan, now you will face my fury! You are doomed to fall, hahaha!”
“Bang!”
Lin Yi’s fist smashed into Yang Xuan’s chest, sending a wild surge of energy in all directions, whipping up dust that made it impossible to see.
When the dust finally settled, Yang Xuan’s body was floating in the air, appearing extremely battered.
“How is that possible?”
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s face froze, and he immediately started shouting.
Yang Xuan was actually unscathed? Lin Yi found this almost unbelievable. He knew the sheer strength of the Wind Spirit Technique he had used and how powerful his attacks were, but Yang Xuan seemed to be completely unaffected, which was incredulous to Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 647: The Secret is Too Precious
chapters.content:
Chapter 647: Chapter 647: The Secret is Too Precious
One should know, Yang Xuan’s condition right now is very unstable, if it wasn’t for Lin Yi timely withdrawing his attack power, I’m afraid he would already be dead.
“You… how can you possibly be unharmed?” Lin Yi looked at Yang Xuan and asked in surprise.
He clearly remembered the might of his move, which was so powerful that even an average Martial Ancestor level expert getting hit by it would cough up blood and die, not to mention Yang Xuan who was just in the Martial Apprentice Realm, how could he withstand it?
Yang Xuan did not pay attention to Lin Yi’s question, but checked his own condition. His state had also returned to its best, and he felt that his strength seemed to have increased a lot, which made him reveal an astonished expression.
“Could it be that the light inside my body caused this? I was absorbing its energy just now, so that must be why I have such a strong defensive ability!” Yang Xuan mused internally.
Having realized all this, Yang Xuan’s heart was filled with shock. This secret he had only shared with Yang Ziyan and had not told anyone else, because this secret was too precious. Once leaked, it would undoubtedly cause a great uproar.
Although Yang Xuan’s strength had increased quite a bit, his combat ability was still far from sufficient, so it was not the time to expose it.
“Alright, since you’re fine, go down and rest for now!” Lin Yi said. He also wanted to see if Yang Xuan still had any moves up his sleeve.
Yang Xuan nodded, not caring about his injuries, and quickly jumped off the arena.
…
“Hu~ Finally dealt with that.” Lin Yi breathed a sigh of relief after seeing Yang Xuan leave, a faint smile appearing on his face.
Then, Lin Yi’s gaze swept over the others and he said, “Who else wants to challenge me? Speak all at once!”
At this moment, Lin Yi’s demeanor was very domineering, exuding a temperament that seemed to rise above everyone else.
With Lin Yi saying this, those who had originally been eager to challenge him also quieted down.
It was then that Lin Yi’s sight suddenly fell on Ye Xuan, who still stood in place without the slightest movement, his face turning dark as a cold light flickered in his eyes.
“What’s the matter? Are you waiting for me to challenge you first before you dare to make a move? Or are you afraid of me?” Lin Yi asked coldly.
Ye Xuan, seeing the chill in Lin Yi’s eyes, was taken aback, not expecting Lin Yi to be so arrogant as to disrespect him, his own teacher, to such an extent. This displeased Ye Xuan greatly.
“I am not afraid of you, it’s just that your realm is too low. I have no interest in dealing with a trash at your level. If you wish to challenge me, then wait until you reach the Martial Emperor Realm!” Ye Xuan said calmly and confidently.
“Hmph! How dare you, I should kill you right now!” Lin Yi, hearing Ye Xuan insult him, became enraged and his figure moved to rush towards Ye Xuan, but after moving just two steps, he suddenly stopped.
“This…”
Lin Yi’s face showed horror as he looked at his legs and then back at Ye Xuan, his eyes filled with shock and bewilderment.
Lin Yi had clearly already rushed out of the arena, but now he was still atop it. How could this be?
“Are your legs having some problem?” Lin Yi looked towards Ye Xuan and asked.
“Indeed!” Ye Xuan looked at Lin Yi and said indifferently.
“Not only is your foot broken, but it’s also been bitten by a venomous snake. How did you manage that?” Lin Yi asked in surprise, and simultaneously he carefully scrutinized Ye Xuan, trying to find any weakness on him.
“Heh!” Ye Xuan sneered, “What’s so strange about that? Don’t overestimate yourself!”
After saying that, Ye Xuan turned around, preparing to leave. Seeing this, Lin Yi hurriedly extended his hands to stop Ye Xuan.
Lin Yi looked around at the crowd, then whispered to Ye Xuan, “Your identity can’t be this simple, right?”
The reason Lin Yi dared to ask so boldly was that he knew Ye Xuan couldn’t be simple.
“Whatever you say,” Ye Xuan said to Lin Yi, responding indifferently.
“Fine! I’ll just spare your pathetic life for now,” Lin Yi said coldly as he looked at Ye Xuan.
“Hmph!” Ye Xuan sneered with disdain, showing absolutely no concern for Lin Yi. In his eyes, Lin Yi was nothing more than early-stage Martial Ancestor trash; it would be a cinch for him to kill Ye Xuan.
“You’re not scared?” Lin Yi asked, looking at Ye Xuan in disbelief.
“No matter what you say, today you must die!” Ye Xuan retorted with a cold laugh, his eyes conveying a chilling intent to kill.
Lin Yi was momentarily taken aback by Ye Xuan’s gaze, then sneered, “What an arrogant brat. Do you really think with your paltry strength you can kill me? That’s pure fantasy!”
While taunting Ye Xuan, Lin Yi slowly began to retreat, attempting to leave the competition arena, but Ye Xuan was not about to let him get away so easily.
“Bang! Bang!”
Ye Xuan’s figure abruptly vanished and reappeared beside Lin Yi. He then threw a fierce punch at Lin Yi’s stomach.
Upon seeing this, Lin Yi immediately raised his hands to block. He didn’t try to dodge; he believed that Ye Xuan wouldn’t really strike to kill him.
Seeing Lin Yi’s reaction, a hint of mockery flashed in Ye Xuan’s eyes. He hadn’t used his full strength, just testing Lin Yi.
“Boom!”
Lin Yi blocked Ye Xuan’s punch, but then Ye Xuan’s figure vanished again, and when he reappeared, he stood behind Lin Yi.
Lin Yi, hearing the sound of air being split beside his ear, tensed up and swiftly turned his head, but it was already too late. Ye Xuan’s right fist squarely hit his head, sending his body flying before it crashed heavily against the wall. He spat out a mouthful of fresh blood and collapsed on the ground, convulsing.
A one-punch knockout!
Ye Xuan knocked out Lin Yi with a single punch!
That punch left everyone around dumbfounded.
Lin Yi was the weakest among all those present, and they hadn’t expected him to be knocked out by Ye Xuan with just one punch.
Lin Yi possessed the cultivation of a Martial Sovereign at the peak of the Sixfold Heaven Realm, yet he couldn’t withstand a single blow from Ye Xuan. What did that imply?
Although Lin Yi got knocked out by a single punch from Ye Xuan, Ye Xuan didn’t have much of an advantage, as after all, Lin Yi’s cultivation was a level higher than his own.
Ye Xuan looked at Lin Yi with a taunting smile, “I don’t think you qualify as my opponent anymore, so why don’t you just obediently hand over your body to me.”
After speaking, Ye Xuan stepped forward to Lin Yi, grabbed him by the collar, hoisted him up, and threw him outside the competition area, onto the ground.
Ye Xuan then stepped onto Lin Yi’s chest.
Ye Xuan’s toe lightly touched Lin Yi’s chest as he sneered, “You better scram while you can; otherwise, you’ll end up just like Lin Yi—dead by my hand.”
“Hmph! You’re too arrogant!” Lin Yi, looking at Ye Xuan, said coldly, “I’ll admit you’re strong, but don’t forget, my background is not something you can afford to provoke. You better know your place and leave quickly, or your fate will certainly be worse than mine!”
Laughter erupted around them as Lin Yi’s words fell.
“Hahaha…”
“Has Lin Yi lost his mind? Isn’t his background one of the three major forces in Dongling City, the Lin Family? The Lin Family is no ordinary clan in Dongling City; they are one of the three major powers. Could there be someone more formidable than the Lin Family?”
“Hahaha… Lin Yi is hilarious, isn’t he?”
“It’s not just a master Lin Yi has behind him; he also has a Martial Saint at the Ninefold Heaven level.”
“I knew it; how would a mere early-stage Martial Ancestor dare to be so rampant in front of Lin Yi? With just a word from Lin Yi, the Lin Family could send a Martial Saint expert to kill him. He definitely won’t live long!”

chapters.title: Chapter 648: Oblivious to Life and Death!
chapters.content:
Chapter 648: Chapter 648: Oblivious to Life and Death!
“This kid is really looking for death. I don’t know which family he comes from, but he has offended the Lin Family of Dongling City, completely oblivious to the danger he’s in!”
‘Heh heh… Not only did this kid offend Lin Yi, but he also offended the entire Lin Family of Dongling City. I’m afraid he won’t be able to get along in Dongling City anymore.’
‘Alas! It’s really a pity for this young man. He’s young and capable, but having met Lin Yi, he’s as good as dead!’
The people around, upon hearing that Ye Xuan had crossed the Lin Family, shook their heads in dismay.
“Lin Yi, you are a disciple of the Lin Family of Dongling City, right?” Just as everyone was feeling sorry, a clear voice suddenly rose from behind, turning heads to discover that the speaker was the young man who had just defeated Lin Yi. They were shocked—how did this kid get over here?
“Who are you?” Lin Yi asked with a cold face, staring at the young man.
“I am Bai Wujie, from the Bai Family.” The young man slowly declared, his tone full of arrogance and dominance, clearly holding a significant status within the Bai Family.
“The Bai Family?” Lin Yi’s face changed; he had heard of the Bai Family’s reputation. Supposedly, his father had some connections with the Bai Family, so he knew of Bai Wujie.
He certainly couldn’t afford to offend someone from the Bai Family!
“What are you doing at my martial arts competition ground?” Lin Yi demanded coldly. He didn’t want to entangle with someone from the Bai Family, for he knew that even if he defeated Ye Xuan, Bai Wujie would find reasons to deal with him. He didn’t want to invite trouble from the Bai Family.
“Lin Yi, don’t play dumb. You clearly wanted to challenge me just now, that’s why you said those words. You think I don’t know?” Bai Wujie looked at Lin Yi with a teasing smile.
“Well then, let’s call our grudge settled. I can’t be bothered to haggle with you anymore,” Lin Yi said, looking at Bai Wujie.
“Settled? Haha… You wish it were that simple. Whether we are settled is up to me. I’m telling you, unless you compensate me with five million today, you’re not going anywhere. Otherwise, just wait for retaliation, and don’t you regret it then,” Bai Wujie menacingly warned Lin Yi.
Five million yuan was no small sum. If Lin Yi had to pay out five million, he truly couldn’t afford it.
But when comparing his dignity and his life, all of this was dispensable. When it came to preserving his life, what was five million yuan?
“Fine! I’ll pay you, but this kid must die!” Lin Yi finally agreed to compensate Bai Wujie with five million after taking a deep breath.
“Relax, I, Bai Wujie, do not kill the innocent. Besides, he is the disciple of my friend. How could I possibly kill him?” Bai Wujie said to Lin Yi with a smile.
Having said this, Bai Wujie gestured to several people beside him.
Those people quickly retrieved a bank card from the Storage Ring and handed it to Lin Yi for the transaction.
“Let’s go!” Bai Wujie instructed those around him.
“Yes, let’s leave!” The people nodded in unison and then headed outside.
Seeing this, Ye Xuan was furious.
Lin Yi had actually used money to buy his life. Such brazen behavior was intolerable, and he couldn’t swallow his pride without giving Lin Yi a lesson!
Seeing Bai Wujie and his group about to leave, Lin Yi began to feel anxious.
He had only been focused on teaching Ye Xuan a lesson and hadn’t considered how to resolve the issue. If Bai Wujie and the others left, his situation would truly be dreadful!
With this in mind, Lin Yi called out hastily, “Hey, fine, I’ll say it, okay? This kid is an enemy of the Lin Family. Lin Yi wanted to kill him, so I fought him. I wasn’t intentionally provoking you!”
Lin Yi’s statement had everyone around him widening their eyes in disbelief as they looked at him.
It turned out that Lin Yi had fought with Ye Xuan solely to save his own life.
So there was a grudge between Lin Yi and Ye Xuan, which explained why they couldn’t stand Ye Xuan—it was all because of Lin Yi’s provocation.
Bai Wujie slightly furrowed his brows, somewhat unable to fathom Lin Yi. Moments ago, they had been fighting fiercely, so why was he backing out now?
“Hmph! Lin Yi, does what you say even matter?” Bai Wujie said in a deep voice, “Regardless, you’ve already offended him, and now reconciliation is impossible!”
Lin Yi looked at Ye Xuan, his face turning pale. He knew he couldn’t escape this time. Ye Xuan was his nemesis, as was Bai Wujie, and now that the two had joined forces, he saw no way out for himself.
Lin Yi gritted his teeth, his eyes filled with intense murderous intent as he looked at Ye Xuan. Ye Xuan was his Achilles heel, not to be touched, or else he would surely be killed in Ye Xuan’s rage.
“Bai Wujie, do whatever you want! I agree!” Lin Yi growled through clenched teeth, “But you must ensure he doesn’t kill me, otherwise, even if I become a ghost, I will not let you go!”
Hearing this, Ye Xuan immediately let out a mocking laugh. Lin Yi was quite cunning, knowing even how to threaten others!
“Lin Yi, do you think you’re still in a position to negotiate terms with me?” Bai Wujie’s expression grew utterly dark, his voice cold as ice.
Ye Xuan watched coldly from the sidelines. He didn’t know what enmity Lin Yi had with Bai Wujie, but since Bai Wujie was opposing him, he would have to face the consequences. He wouldn’t let anyone bully him!
“Bai Wujie, don’t scare me. Although I know I can’t beat you, you are definitely no match for me. You want to kill me? No way, unless I die!” Lin Yi spoke coldly too.
“Fine, Lin Yi, since that’s the case, I’ll see you off!” Bai Wujie coldly declared, his voice carrying a chilling tone that made one shiver involuntarily, their hair standing on end as if they were in an ice cellar.
As Bai Wujie finished speaking, he suddenly made his move, and a massive wave of air burst forth from his fist, slamming towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi, watching this powerful current, his eyes flickering with shock, felt the energy contained within and knew he was unlikely to escape this fate!
Lin Yi didn’t dare hesitate. He immediately circulated the Spiritual Energy within his body, forming a huge Defensive Barrier in front of himself.
Boom, boom, boom!
With a series of explosions ringing out, Lin Yi’s Protective Shield instantly shattered, and that terrifying force hit him directly.
With a thud, Lin Yi’s body was blasted away, landing on the ground and spitting out mouthfuls of fresh blood, obviously seriously injured.
And yet, Bai Wujie didn’t pursue him, merely standing there quietly, wearing a face of mockery.
“Young Master Bai, what do you mean by this?” Lin Yi looked at Bai Wujie, his expression as dark as it could get.
“Nothing much, just feel like killing you!” Bai Wujie took step by step towards Lin Yi. With every step he took, Lin Yi’s face grew paler, the fear in his eyes more apparent.
“Bai Wujie, don’t push people too far!” Lin Yi shouted in anger.
“Pushing people too far?” Bai Wujie laughed out loud, then suddenly kicked out fiercely towards Lin Yi’s chest, kicking him onto the stage, where he smashed down and fell flat on his face.
Lin Yi’s face turned even paler, as he struggled to get up, then glaring at Bai Wujie with a face full of rage.
He hadn’t expected that, in his own Lin Family, he would suffer a fall here.

chapters.title: Chapter 649: Unexpectedly Stumbled Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 649: Chapter 649: Unexpectedly Stumbled Here
Lin Yi wanted to say something, but he didn’t speak out because he knew it was meaningless. The most important thing for him now was to save his own life; as for his life and death, he no longer cared in the slightest.
“Still not convinced?” Bai Wujie approached Lin Yi step by step, coldly asking without a hint of warmth in his voice.
Lin Yi shook his head without saying a word.
“In that case, go die!” Bai Wujie said chillingly, lifting his right leg high and savagely striking Lin Yi’s shoulder.
Lin Yi could no longer control his body; he spat out a mouthful of fresh blood and was flung away. He rolled several times on the ground before coming to a stop, laying there, gasping for air.
Just one move from Bai Wujie had seriously injured him, a strength that terrified him to his core!
“Lin Yi, let’s go!” Bai Wujie said coldly and then led everybody away from there, leaving Lin Yi collapsed on the ground with blood still at the corner of his mouth.
Lin Yi cast a cold glance at Lin Yi on the ground, then followed Bai Wujie.
Lin Yi and Bai Wujie entered the private room with Lin Yi still sprawled on the ground, his face pale, shooting a look full of hatred towards Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi, you are already a cripple. Stop obsessing over Lin Yi; you no longer have anything to do with him,” Bai Wujie said indifferently as he glanced at Lin Yi.
“I don’t care who sent you, but today, even if I die, I won’t give up the pursuit of Lin Yi. Don’t you dare try to stop me!” Lin Yi declared resolutely, staring at Bai Wujie.
“You…” Bai Wujie was nearly rendered speechless by Lin Yi’s words.
“Brother Ye, let’s go outside!” Bai Wujie looked at Lin Yi and said slowly.
Lin Yi nodded. He didn’t say anything but left immediately.
Lin Yi’s gaze was fixed tightly on Lin Yi, seething as he stared at him.
His eyes filled with a cold murderous intent as if he wanted to tear Lin Yi apart and then slowly torture him to death.
Lin Yi remained silent, only thinking to himself, “Lin Yi, I, Lin Yi, will definitely kill you, definitely!”
“Lin Yi, do you have any last wishes?” Lin Yi suddenly stopped walking, turned around and looked at Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi, you…” Lin Yi hadn’t expected Lin Yi to turn around at this moment, and he was somewhat surprised.
Lin Yi smiled. He looked at Bai Wujie and asked playfully, “Young Master Bai, what is Lin Yi’s last wish? Can I help him fulfill it?”
“Of course, his last wish is to find you and kill you as his revenge!” Bai Wujie’s voice was accompanied by an overwhelming murderous aura, and his eyes turned cruel.
A scornful smile appeared on Lin Yi’s face as he looked at Lin Yi and said, “I think you’re mistaken, I’m not Lin Yi, I’m Lin Yi’s brother, Lin Yi is my younger brother!”
Lin Yi was stunned, his eyes filled with confusion as he murmured to himself, “My last wish was to have him kill you for me? Did I really do that?”
Seeing the change in Lin Yi’s expression, Bai Wujie internally breathed a sigh of relief.
“Young Master Bai, did you call Lin Yi to kill me? Or did you want to use him as a pawn?” Lin Yi asked Bai Wujie.
“I didn’t want to use him as a pawn, but yes, I called Lin Yi to kill you. Is that satisfactory?” Bai Wujie challenged, looking at Lin Yi.
“Oh, so that’s how it is. No wonder Young Master Bai is so generous!” Lin Yi said, feigning sudden understanding with a knowing look on his face.
“Hmph!” Bai Wujie snorted coldly, not continuing the discussion with Lin Yi and instead turned to leave.
Lin Yi watched Bai Wujie’s retreating figure, a sly sparkle appearing in his eyes, wearing a ferocious smile on his face.
He stood up and walked over to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi arrived in front of Lin Yi and looked down on him from a height, speaking in a sinister voice, “Lin Yi, I’m going to let you taste what it’s like to wish for death. Hahaha.
I will personally peel your skin off, tear it off piece by piece, and then roast it over a fire! Hahaha, what an exciting game this is!”
Lin Yi grew increasingly excited as he spoke; he couldn’t help but tremble.
Lin Yi coldly glanced at Lin Yi and said indifferently, “You really are a freak.”
Lin Yi snorted coldly and threw a punch towards Lin Yi’s abdomen.
Bang!
Lin Yi’s abdomen was struck, and his entire body was sent retreating several steps backward.
Lin Yi’s speed was fast, his fist wind kicked up a whirlwind that blew against Lin Yi’s body.
Lin Yi sneered, “Now you know how formidable I am? Let me tell you, Lin Yi, you’re no longer the lofty Lin Yi. You are now nothing but trash, and even trash without any use. With just a flick of my fingers, you would die.”
“Is that so?” Lin Yi said with a sneer.
“Of course it is. If you don’t believe me, I will deal with you first, then take care of the others,” Lin Yi said as he launched another punch.
Boom!
This time, Lin Yi did not dodge; he chose to take the hit directly, enduring Lin Yi’s strike head-on.
He felt an intense pain all over his body as if his internal organs were shattered, and he vomited several mouthfuls of fresh blood.
Lin Yi’s strength was indeed formidable.
“Lin Yi, I really did not expect your strength to be so formidable. I truly admire you. But as much as I admire you, you still can’t kill me!” Lin Yi said with a serious look on his face.
“What? I can’t kill you? Then how could you possibly kill them? Could they be even stronger than me?” Lin Yi looked at Lin Yi with disbelief, his fists swinging once again.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Lin Yi’s fists came like a tempestuous storm towards Lin Yi.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Lin Yi’s defensive power was not very high; after being struck by Lin Yi’s punches again and again, he eventually couldn’t withstand it and was sent flying backward, finally smashing into a wall with fresh blood spilling from the corners of his mouth.
Watching Lin Yi fly backward, Lin Yi’s face darkened.
“Hmph, it’s just a body. I can kill him just the same,” Lin Yi said while looking at Lin Yi.
“Do you really think you can kill me?” Lin Yi asked Lin Yi.
Lin Yi sneered, “Of course I can kill you!”
Lin Yi shook his head: “Unfortunately, you don’t have the ability to kill me!”
Lin Yi said coldly, “You really think I can’t kill you?”
Lin Yi nodded, “Yes, I truly believe that you can’t kill me.”
“Since that’s the case, then don’t blame me for being rude!” Lin Yi said as he was about to rush towards Lin Yi.
But as Lin Yi had just taken a step forward, he suddenly stopped, then turned his head to look to the side, his expression turning into one of terror.
Lin Yi, watching Lin Yi, had a look of horror in his eyes: “No! Impossible, this can’t be possible. How could I not kill you? How can you be so strong? It’s impossible for you to possess such immense power. Absolutely impossible.”
Lin Yi stared at Lin Yi in terror; he couldn’t believe that the person before him was so strong!
His strength had already reached the Peak of Earth Martial Realm, and he was only a step away from the Great Perfection.

chapters.title: Chapter 650 - 650 Out of Options
chapters.content:
Chapter 650: Chapter 650 Out of Options
But that one step was like a chasm he could not cross, no matter how hard he tried, leaving him utterly confounded.
At this moment, however, the young man before him actually struck his stomach with a punch, causing severe pain that made it feel as though his belly was about to burst.
His stomach had actually been injured by Lin Yi’s Fist Force!
How could this be possible?
His power had reached the Peak of the Earth Martial Realm, bordering on the Heavenly Martial Realm. He could even match some geniuses in a fair fight, yet this young man had managed to hurt his stomach with a punch to this extent, which was utterly terrifying!
This was the strength that a cultivator at the Peak of the Earth Martial Realm should possess!
Who in the world was this person?
Why had he never heard of such a young man before?
Where did this monstrous figure spring from?
“How about it? Do you still want to kill me?” Lin Yi sneered, a mocking expression appearing on his face, “If that’s the case, then let me send you on your way!”
Boom!
Just as Lin Yi was preparing to flee, an overwhelmingly fierce aura bore down on him, making his legs go weak, almost bringing him to his knees. Sweat beads the size of soybeans rolled down his forehead and his breathing grew rapid.
When Lin Yi lifted his head, he saw a young man in a black robe appearing before him.
His pupils shrank to the size of pinpoints as his heart thumped wildly.
The black-robed man didn’t even bother giving Lin Yi a glance, simply waving his hand, and Lin Yi felt his neck being seized by something.
With a slight tightening of the black-robed man’s palm, Lin Yi instantly felt asphyxiated and hastily pleaded for mercy, “Please, I beg of you, let me go, I beg of you to spare me.”
Tears streamed down Lin Yi’s face.
This man in the black robe was too terrifying; just one move and he was immobilized, completely powerless to resist.
The black-robed man gave a cold snort, “Scram!”
“Thank you, Senior, thank you, Senior!” Lin Yi quickly got up from the ground and ran outside.
“Lin Yi, I have already warned you not to provoke me, but you wouldn’t believe me; you even dared to be disrespectful towards me. Now, I will kill you and avenge them!” the black-robed man said coldly, and a clump of black fog appeared in his hand, projecting a powerful, destructive aura over Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s body was instantly enveloped in the black fog, which quickly condensed upon him, sending chills down his spine.
“Save me! Someone save me, please, I beg you to save me!” Lin Yi struggled desperately.
But the black-robed man simply extended his hand gently and grabbed Lin Yi’s neck, pulling him in front of his face, “Lin Yi, you killed him, so I will bury you with him.”
Lin Yi looked coldly at Lin Yi, “Such trash is not worth regretting over his death.”
“Really? Then let me bury you with him!” said the black-robed man as he exerted force in his arm, intending to snap Lin Yi’s neck.
Lin Yi was petrified with fear, being just an ordinary person with no combat experience whatsoever.
So, at this moment, Lin Yi’s mind went blank, devoid of any thought.
But just then, a sharp sword light flashed by.
Lin Yi’s head was chopped off, his brains splattering everywhere!
Lin Yi looked coldly at the man in the black robe, his eyes filled with intense murderous intent, “Since you’re seeking death, you can’t blame me. You killed my brother, so let me do the same to you!”
As he spoke, Lin Yi had already executed the second move of the Wind Thunder Sword Technique. With a slash, a longsword descended from the sky, cutting toward the head of the man in black.
This strike of Lin Yi’s contained a force of two to three thousand pounds, far surpassing that of ordinary martial arts.
But the man in the black robe remained calm as ever. He raised his hand, and the longsword was intercepted.
“Hmph! You think you can harm me with that? Dream on,” the man in the black robe sneered coldly.
“Is that so? Then let’s see how many times you can block this sword!” Lin Yi said calmly, his figure disappearing on the spot and quickly reappearing behind the man in the black robe, holding the Wind Thunder Sword and thrusting it again.
The Wind Thunder Sword carried a hint of lightning, with terrifying destructive power that made the man in the black robe frown. He couldn’t defend against such a sword light; this young man was too terrifying.
The man in the black robe gritted his teeth, knowing that continuing like this would surely lead to his death, but he was not willing to give up.
He flung his right hand, hurling the longsword at Lin Yi, while his left hand swiftly slapped toward him.
“Clang, clang, clang…” The longsword in Lin Yi’s hand collided with the man in the black robe’s right hand, emitting a crisp sound, but Lin Yi didn’t give an inch. His feet were firmly planted on the ground, his entire body hugging the earth.
“Such immense physical strength!” Lin Yi couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise. The body of the man before him was terrifying, at least twice as strong as his own.
Was this even a human body?
If Lin Yi was a fierce tiger, then this man was simply a wild beast.
“Boy, you’re the first one to make me use my secret technique. There is a lot about you that excites me. I will enjoy playing with you!” The man in the black robe laughed heartily, his figure flickering, and in a blink, he appeared behind Lin Yi, his hands like eagle claws, viciously grabbing toward Lin Yi’s neck.
Lin Yi’s face showed shock, and he quickly tried to dodge, but he was too slow and got caught by the man in the black robe.
“Die!!!” The man in the black robe roared, his hands tearing fiercely, and Lin Yi’s neck was brutally snapped.
Lin Yi’s body fell heavily to the ground, blood spraying from his chest.
The man in the black robe looked down at Lin Yi.
Weiwei was petrified, seeing Lin Yi killed had completely stunned her. She couldn’t believe her eyes as she gaped at the body on the ground, wanting to scream out loud, but in the end, she could only let out a pitiful wail.
“I’ll kill you, kill you!” Weiwei’s voice was trembling, furious, and hoarse as she frantically lunged at the man in the black robe.
The death of Lin Yi was a good thing, but the current Weiwei was too weak to do anything to the man in the black robe.
But the man in the black robe paid no attention to Weiwei and continued walking toward Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s death had caused a huge shock to the man in the black robe, a chilling murderous intent exuding from him. He watched Lin Yi in disbelief, extremely shocked inside!
He had never expected that Lin Yi’s physical body could be so terrifying, something even he could not achieve.
The reason he dared to make a move on Lin Yi, and even kill him, was primarily because he had an artifact that could conceal his presence.
As an Artifact Refiner, he had powerful means of concealing his presence, which even cultivators at the Divine King Level had difficulty sensing.
Yet, even so, he was defeated by Lin Yi, who had killed him with a sword. It was truly unbelievable.
“Not bad, really not bad!” The man in the black robe suddenly laughed.
Weiwei did not understand whether the man in the black robe was praising or mocking him. However, whether it was praise or mockery, Weiwei felt an immense danger.

chapters.title: Chapter 651: No Deep Hatred
chapters.content:
Chapter 651: Chapter 651: No Deep Hatred
Lin Yi retreated while asking in horror, “Who are you? Why do you want to kill me? I don’t have a deep hatred with you, why are you trying to murder me?”
“You and I indeed do not have a deep hatred, and I have no need to kill you. But, I want you to pay the price!” The black-robed man’s eyes were full of coldness and murderous intent. He looked at Lin Yi with eyes as sharp as swords, making Lin Yi feel a wave of cowardice.
Lin Yi was terrified, not knowing how to cope.
Just then, a scream came from nearby.
Lin Yi was startled and looked toward the sound, seeing a figure screaming as it was being swallowed by a giant snake.
Lin Yi’s eyes widened as he saw the python swallowing down Lin Yi whom he had just killed.
Lin Yi had come back to life.
Lin Yi was utterly despairing, he hadn’t expected that the Lin Yi he had just killed would have a chance to be resurrected!
“Lin Yi, you bastard, I’ll fight you to the end!” Lin Yi cried out, attacking the giant snake frantically.
However, Lin Yi was not afraid at all; instead, he stepped toward the black-robed man. Watching Lin Yi attack the giant snake with madness, the black-robed man was not scared at all; on the contrary, he revealed a cruel smile.
“You killed my disciple, I killed your apprentice’s relatives. We have an irreconcilable enmity between us; you’re doomed!” The black-robed man said with a cold laugh.
“Heh… I wasn’t killed by you, but was eaten by that giant snake. Do you think that by killing my disciple, I would have no way of dealing with you? I’ll tell you, I still have help!” Lin Yi said with a cold laugh as he saw a black light rush into the ground’s rocks.
“Boom!”
With a low roar from the black-robed man, the entire massive rock shook and cracks started to appear.
More and more cracks appeared, and in the blink of an eye, a huge black dragon soared into the sky, flying towards Lin Yi and the black-robed man.
“What… What is this?” Lin Yi’s body shuddered, his eyes filled with fear.
“This is the sacred dragon of the Dragon Clan!” The black-robed man said with a sneer.
“What? The Dragon Clan’s sacred dragon? Are you the Holy Emperor of the Dragon Clan?” Lin Yi squinted his eyes, staring at the black dragon.
“Correct, I am the Holy Emperor of the Dragon Clan. If you want revenge, wait for your next life, hahaha…” The black-robed man laughed arrogantly, with a triumphant expression.
“Holy Emperor of the Dragon Clan! You’re at least the Holy Emperor, and yet you strike at a nobody like me; you’re really not keeping it classy.” Lin Yi said with a cold laugh, not scared at all.
Lin Yi’s words drew the attention of the martial artists around them. They all looked over, wanting to know what had happened.
Lin Yi no longer cared about losing face and hurriedly explained loudly, but despite talking for a long time, he didn’t make any sense.
“Look, that’s the Black Dragon King! Said to be the Holy Emperor of the Dragon Clan’s mount, very powerful!”
“Yes, yes, the Black Dragon King is very fast. Even I can’t catch up with it. It can swallow a Martial Emperor Realm martial artist whole without batting an eye. We better run!”
“Run my ass! We’ve been locked on by the Black Dragon King; there’s no escape!”
“Yeah, not only is the Black Dragon King fast, but it also has a strong defense. Cultivators of the Martial Emperor Realm generally can’t break its defense. We better leave here quickly.”
…
While the crowd discussed, they all ran away towards the distance.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s heart almost stopped. Was Lin Yi actually the disciple of the Holy Emperor of the Dragon Clan? Didn’t that mean Lin Yi’s strength would surpass his own?
No, he couldn’t be killed by Lin Yi; otherwise, the Dragon Clan would surely exterminate him!
Lin Yi urgently shouted, “Wait for me, I’ll escape with you. I am a disciple of the Dragon Clan’s Holy Emperor, they won’t kill me, save me!”
“A disciple of the Dragon Clan’s Holy Emperor? Are you sure you’re a disciple of the Dragon Clan’s Holy Emperor?” The people around gave Lin Yi a disdainful look.
“Of course, I am. I’m the only disciple of the Dragon Clan’s Holy Emperor. If I were lying to you, may lightning strike me dead,” Lin Yi said hastily.
“If that’s the case, then we’ll believe you this time,” a middle-aged man said after standing and pondering for a moment.
The others agreed, and they all rushed toward Lin Yi.
Seeing that Lin Yi was still there, he breathed a little sigh of relief.
“Young Master Ye, hurry, your strength is too weak now, you’re no match for the Dragon Clan, go quickly, we’ll protect you, and we won’t let anyone bully you!” one of them said urgently.
“Young Master Ye, you are our benefactor, wherever you wish to go, we’ll take you,” another said.
Lin Yi shook his head, “Thank you for your kindness, but I have some matters to attend to, I’m not leaving, thank you all!”
“But you…”
“Young Master Ye, have you lost your will to live, let us take you away from here!”
“Young Master Ye, you must realize that the Dragon Clan’s strength is too formidable. Even if we take you away from here, it’s not certain that you would be able to leave Dragon Valley; I advise you to just follow us obediently!”
“If you come with us, not only can we offer you the best treatment regarding food, shelter, and clothing, but we may also even help you enhance your strength!”
The people continued, hoping Lin Yi would change his mind and leave with them.
Lin Yi still refused, speaking indifferently, “You don’t understand, the grudge between me and the Dragon Clan, you have no clue!”
Lin Yi did not want to let others know about his relationship with the Dragon Clan. He wanted to fight using his own strength, not wanting to implicate others or the Dragon Clan.
“Young Master Ye, we truly want to help you. Please trust us, we can indeed ensure your safety!” they pleaded sincerely, with a steadfast look in their eyes.
Lin Yi looked at them and asked faintly, “What help can you possibly offer me?”
“As long as you come with us, we can surely help you. Moreover, I am certain that your current cultivation places you among the strong, even within our sanctified ones!”
“And Young Master Ye, don’t you want vengeance? You absolutely cannot compare to the strength of the Dragon Clan’s Holy Emperor!”
“With us taking you, we can definitely be of help!”
“If you follow us, not only can we help you enhance your strength, but within the Immortal Domain, you can surely dominate!”
…
Suddenly, these people were all advertising incessantly, continuously tempting Lin Yi, hoping he would go with them. After all, the Dragon Clan is the Dragon Clan, Lin Yi is human, they are human, the Dragon Clan is the Dragon Clan, how could Lin Yi compare with the Dragon Clan’s Holy Emperor?
Lin Yi shook his head, “I have no interest in what you’re saying.”
“Young Master Ye, you… ah, since you are obstinate, then we have no choice but to offend!” The look in the eyes of Lin Yi, who was at the side, was filled with hatred and murderous intent: “Lin Yi, today, you are surely going to die, just wait for your death!”
As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Yi pounced on the martial artists.
Although Lin Yi was not the disciple of the Dragon Clan’s Holy Emperor, his mentor was indeed the Dragon Clan’s Holy Emperor, and his strength was absolutely not simple!
Furthermore, the relationship between Lin Yi and the Dragon Clan was unusual. If they managed to kill Lin Yi, the Dragon Clan would not be able to do anything to them!
While massacring, Lin Yi thought, and the fury in his heart burned relentlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 652: Collapsing to the ground repeatedly
chapters.content:
Chapter 652: Chapter 652: Collapsing to the ground repeatedly
But he had forgotten just how strong Lin Yi was!
Lin Yi was only at the intermediate stage of being a Holy Emperor, while Lin Yi had already reached the peak of the Holy Emperor stage and wasn’t far from the later stages—the gap between them was like the difference between heaven and earth!
Despite Lin Yi’s formidable strength, it was a pity that he was facing Lin Yi. Whether it was speed or method of attack, Lin Yi wouldn’t be weaker than Lin Yi.
Lin Yi instantly killed a warrior at the intermediate stage of the Holy Emperor with one move, then sent Lin Yi flying with a punch!
Lin Yi fell to the ground, crying out in agony, with blood streaming from the corner of his mouth.
Terror and shock filled Lin Yi’s eyes!
He had not expected that in just three short days, Lin Yi’s strength had grown so tremendously.
No wonder those people had said that Lin Yi possessed the strength to contend with a Dragon Clan’s Holy Emperor.
“You said you had ways to help me, why haven’t you done it?” Lin Yi stared at the few remaining people and reprimanded, his voice cold and sinister.
“Young Master Ye, it’s not that we don’t want to help you, but that we truly have no way!” The leader, an old man, sighed and then said, “Young Master Ye, we really have no other options, you might as well come with us. The Dragon Clan is a force we cannot provoke!”
“Lin Yi, just come with us. We will send you to the Dragon Clan as quickly as possible, otherwise if the Dragon Clan comes searching, we will all die here.”
The others also pleaded with Lin Yi one after another, earnestly hoping that Lin Yi would follow them.
“Enough, say no more. I absolutely won’t go with you; it’s not that I’m selfish, but the Dragon Clan is too powerful!” Lin Yi waved his hands and rejected them, “No need for further words. I don’t care what methods you use, but tonight, I must leave Dragon Valley. Whoever stands in my way, I’ll kill them!”
Having said that, Lin Yi’s figure flickered and he quickly disappeared in front of those people, rushing toward the depths of Dragon Valley!
“Damn it!” Lin Yi cursed fiercely as he watched Lin Yi’s retreating figure. His expression was savage, his eyes filled with intense anger. Clenching his teeth, he roared word by word, “Lin Yi, just you wait. Sooner or later, I will make you kneel and beg for mercy at my feet!”
Just as Lin Yi’s voice fell, suddenly, an immense oppressive force came from afar.
Lin Yi looked up and saw two gigantic black holes suddenly appear in front of him, frantically swallowing everything around!
“This… this is a space rift, the Dragon Clan’s space tear!” A Holy Emperor was terrified, his eyes filled with fear as he looked at Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi, be careful. This is the Dragon Clan’s space tear, a very terrifying martial arts technique. Even the Dragon Clan’s Holy Emperors are reluctant to use it. This move is extremely horrifying; it can instantly kill a warrior at the Holy King Realm!” Lin Yi shouted loudly at Lin Yi, his face as pale as paper.
“Lin Yi, you must be careful. This time, you are really doomed. The Dragon Clan is not something you can provoke. Don’t blame me—I don’t want to kill you. I’m worried if the Dragon Clan’s Holy Emperor finds out, once I’m dead, the Dragon Clan certainly won’t let us off. We will all be exterminated. I’m sorry, Lin Yi!”
“Lin Yi, we’re going to leave now!” After saying that, Lin Yi and the others disappeared on the spot in the blink of an eye.
“The Dragon Clan? The people of the Dragon Clan, what of them?” Lin Yi snorted and didn’t pay attention, entering Dragon Valley in an instant!
