At the bottom of Dragon Valley lay a gigantic canyon. This canyon was vast and long, with numerous giant beasts active within it, as well as all sorts of Demon Beasts, even including some at the Holy Level—making it look extremely intimidating. Dragon Valley must be a place of treasures.
Lin Yi saw some Demon Cores, as well as many Elixirs, heavenly materials and earthly treasures, even a lot of precious items at the level of Holy Artifacts. These things were all worth a fortune!
Lin Yi’s eyes turned red—these were all things he needed!
“Damn, why is the bottom of this valley so terrifying? No wonder the Dragon Clan forbids us from coming here!” Lin Yi stood there, glancing around with lingering fear, mumbling to himself.
“Lin Yi, you should leave quickly. This place really isn’t for ordinary people. I advise you to run away as fast as you can, maybe you can still avoid the Dragon Clan’s pursuit!”
“In Dragon Valley, danger lurks everywhere. A moment’s inattention can tear apart the void, utterly crushing you, and not even your Nascent Soul may remain intact.”
“At the bottom of this valley, there are many powerful Demon Beasts hidden, even those with Holy Emperor Level strength!”
“I urge you to leave sooner!”
Standing by Lin Yi’s side was a very young Martial Artist from the Dragon Clan named Lin Xiang, who was the leader of the Dragon Clan’s team for this mission.
“Lin Yi, we really should leave quickly. If we’re discovered, you’re dead for sure!” Lin Xiang also looked seriously at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi narrowed his eyes slightly, gave Lin Xiang a look, and said nothing as he continued walking toward the depths of Dragon Valley.
“Lin Yi, don’t be so stubborn anymore, or you’ll certainly regret it!” Lin Xiang said, becoming somewhat anxious.
“I just have to come, otherwise, are you guys going to stop me? Since you’re not going to stop me, why the idle talk? Why don’t you lead the way?” Lin Yi snorted impatiently, his tone full of threatening intent.
The threat from Lin Yi took Lin Xiang and the other Dragon Clan Martial Artists aback.
Lin Xiang looked at Lin Yi and eventually shook his head in resignation, then turned to the other Dragon Clan Martial Artists and said, “Take Lin Yi to find treasures!”
Although the Dragon Clan’s Martial Artists were reluctant, they had no other choice but to obediently take Lin Yi to search the area for treasures!
“Lin Yi, is the matter just over like this? I really overestimated you. I thought you were a true man, but it turns out your courage is really small. I didn’t even kill you, yet you betrayed me in return. This time, I misjudged you!”
“Lin Yi, I’m warning you, I don’t like betrayal. If you dare to betray me again, you will most certainly die!” Lin Yi’s voice rang out, causing Lin Yi’s body to involuntarily shudder.
“Lin Yi, I know I was wrong. I’ll never betray you again, I swear… I will never do it again…” Lin Yi hurriedly apologized.
Lin Yi was truly afraid!
Lin Xiang and the others saw this and felt extremely discontent in their hearts.
Lin Yi was the Saint Heir of the Dragon Clan, the most dazzling figure among the younger generation of the Dragon Clan. Now, he was apologizing on his knees to Lin Yi, a mere ant. This was a total loss of face for the Dragon Clan!
“Good that you understand! Let’s go, to the treasure area, and I hope you keep your word!” Lin Yi snorted and continued toward the interior of Dragon Valley.
Lin Xiang fell silent, leading Lin Yi quickly into Dragon Valley!
Lin Xiang and the others followed behind. Their strength was not weak, each following behind Lin Yi, they entered the interior of Dragon Valley!
The area was filled with thick fog, so dense that one could barely make out anything, with only a faint glimmer of light penetrating through!
“Lin Yi, are you sure there are treasures inside? This place seems pretty terrifying!” Lin Yi asked quietly.
“There should be, but where exactly the treasures are, that still depends on luck!” Lin Yi said in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 653: Continue to Accelerate Pace
chapters.content:
Chapter 653: Chapter 653: Continue to Accelerate Pace
“Yes, let’s hurry in!” Lin Yi nodded and continued to quicken his pace, swiftly moving toward the depths of Dragon Valley.
Lin Yi and the others quickly followed behind, proceeding deeper into Dragon Valley. The further in they went, the stronger the aura of Primordial Energy became. Lin Yi’s breathing grew exceptionally smooth, his physique seemingly enhanced significantly, and his strength felt as if it had increased considerably.
Lin Yi’s power had grown a lot.
The others with Lin Yi were no exception, their strengths had improved as well. However, the Primordial Energy in the depths of Dragon Valley was so intense that they had not broken through, temporarily lingering at the early stage of the Sixth Rank of the Heavenly Holy Realm, just a step away from reaching the intermediate stage!
After entering the interior of Dragon Valley, a massive cave appeared before Lin Yi and his companions.
The sight of the cave instantly captivated Lin Yi and the others.
“Lin Yi, that cave is the treasury of the Dragon Clan!” Lin Yi took a deep breath, his excitement palpable for the treasures within Dragon Valley, after all, it was the Dragon Clan’s treasury!
Lin Yi gazed at the cave. The area of the cave was vast, nearly the size of a small sports field, filled with faint traces of blood. It seemed like there were many Demon Beast corpses, as well as a great number of Divine Beasts, scattered around with blood flowing among them.
A smirk passed over Lin Yi’s lips, he muttered to himself, “This Dragon Valley truly is a treasure trove, not only filled with treasures but also teeming with Demon Beasts! It looks like I’m going to make a fortune today, hehe…”
A slightly sinister smile curled the corners of Lin Yi’s mouth.
Without delay, Lin Yi walked toward the interior of the cave.
“Lin Yi, you guys stand guard outside, don’t let anyone approach, or they shall be killed without mercy!” Lin Yi suddenly commanded the Dragon Clan Martial Artists behind him. These Martial Artists were of the Fifth, Sixth, and Seventh Rank of the Heavenly Holy Realm, reasonably strong but incomparable to Lin Yi and thus not worth mentioning.
“Yes, Young Master!” The numerous Dragon Clan Martial Artists answered respectfully, then retreated to the perimeter.
After entering the cave, Lin Yi found it pitch black inside. His eyes shimmered faintly, looking around.
In the center of the cave, there was a stone platform about ten meters in size. On the platform rested a stone sarcophagus, carved with lifelike patterns of the Dragon Clan, almost as if they were real living creatures, which left Lin Yi utterly astonished, as he had never seen anything like this before.
“What is this thing?” asked Lin Yi in surprise.
“This is a Dragon Bone, the legendary Dragon Bone, a body part from an existence terrifying beyond the Holy King Realm!” Lin Yi quickly explained.
“That’s incredible, a Dragon Bone from the Holy King Realm! The treasures inside must be plentiful!” Lin Yi’s eyes nearly popped out of their sockets.
“Yes!” Lin Yi nodded, his eyes shimmering with greed: “This Dragon Bone contains a vast amount of the Dragon Clan’s essence, which can escalate our power to new heights, and may even offer us a chance to reach the Holy Emperor Realm!”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Yi’s heart began to thump wildly, the excitement was too much for him.
“Let’s go, let’s hurry up and take a look!” Lin Yi inhaled deeply and strode forward.
Just as Lin Yi approached the sarcophagus, suddenly, an incredibly powerful Dragon Might emanated from it.
The Dragon Might seemed capable of shattering everything, intimidating Lin Yi and his companions.
Lin Yi quickly stopped in his tracks, his expression exceedingly awkward, cursing inwardly: Why would there be something so terrifying inside this Dragon Sarcophagus?
“Lin Yi, what’s wrong?” Seeing Lin Yi halt, Lin Yi rushed to inquire.
“The thing inside the Dragon Sarcophagus is too powerful, I’m afraid none of us can withstand it. Let’s get out of here fast!” Lin Yi hurriedly explained.
A look of disdain flashed between Lin Yi’s brows, he snorted, “Keep bragging! I want to see how you’ll withstand whatever’s inside the Dragon Sarcophagus.”
“Let’s go, no more nonsense!” Lin Yi, too impatient to bother with himself, waved his hand grandly and, along with his companions, swiftly vanished from the spot.
As soon as Lin Yi and the others disappeared, the dragon coffin abruptly opened its eyes, and two beams of ghastly blue light shot out, enveloping the surrounding space. That unsurpassable Dragon Might spread out in all directions!
For a moment, all the Demon Beasts and wild beasts in the vicinity were terrified, lying prostrate on the ground, shivering uncontrollably, not daring to make a move!
The terrifying aura within the Dragon Tomb was truly frightening, paralyzing them with fear!
No sooner had Lin Yi and the others vanished than they were almost knocked off their feet by the horrifying Dragon Might, each of them pale-faced as they stared at the mouth of the cave before them.
“Lin Yi, are you sure the Dragon Bones of the Dragon Clan are inside?” Lin Yi asked gravely after they had regained their balance, his heart filled with unease.
If it were true that the Dragon Clan had a being of the Holy King Realm, Lin Yi and the others probably wouldn’t even have the ability to flee!
After all, Lin Yi couldn’t even defeat a practitioner in the early stages of the Heavenly Holy Realm, let alone confront an existence of the Heavenly Holy Realm, even with the help of his companions.
“This is a Dragon Bone left by my ancestors, there should be no mistake, and this Dragon Bone has been stored for thousands of years, it will definitely not decay!” Lin Yi said firmly, his eyes glued to the stone coffin.
“Then let’s go in!” Lin Yi nodded and with a grasp, a Flame Dragon appeared directly under his command.
The Flame Dragon roared, its flames burning more and more fiercely.
Lin Yi was the first to step forward, striding directly into the stone coffin, followed by the others who also stepped in, following closely behind Lin Yi.
Just as Lin Yi entered the stone coffin, it suddenly closed and began to slowly rotate.
At the same time, Lin Yi’s view was suddenly filled with a stone chamber about three meters in length and width, totalling more than a hundred square meters.
The entire stone chamber was empty, with nothing inside, except for the walls, which were covered in murals depicting various kinds of Demon Beasts, dragons, Divine Beasts, and other odd-shaped things.
Lin Yi scanned the murals and found that these images were almost identical to the murals he had seen in the world of “Nine Emperors”, all depicting patterns of Divine Beasts.
“Lin Yi, look at these murals, they are the most powerful warriors of the Dragon Clan, this is the Dragon Bone left by my ancestors, this is the Dragon King, this is…” Lin Yi explained while taking out a Jade Slip and handing it to Lin Yi.
“Dragon Bones, real Dragon Bones, and they are of Dragon King level, this… this is too great, our luck is beyond heavenly!” Lin Yi said, filled with excitement as he took the Jade Slip.
Lin Yi and the others were also very excited, as they had always wanted to find Dragon Corpse, and they never expected they would actually find it.
For them, Dragon Bones were incredibly important!
Lin Yi looked towards the stone bed beside the Dragon Bone, which was the only place in sight with a stone table on top.
That stone table was laid with a variety of alcoholic dishes, teas, and pastries.
“Lin Yi, let’s eat!” Lin Yi and the others looked towards Lin Yi, their eyes burning with eagerness.
Without hesitation, Lin Yi picked up some chopsticks and began to taste the delicacies!
The food was exceptionally delicious, especially the aroma of the dishes, which tempted the appetite.
Lin Yi and his companions feasted joyously, for these delicacies were of great benefit to their cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - 654 The Sudden Disappearance of the Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 654: Chapter 654 The Sudden Disappearance of the Sword
Just then, suddenly, a sword on the stone table inexplicably disappeared.
“How is that possible?!” Lin Yi and the others exclaimed, their eyes widening, their faces filled with disbelief!
The sword that had been on the stone table had vanished into thin air!
The expressions on Lin Yi and the others’ faces changed!
“What’s going on here? How can these things just disappear out of nowhere?”
“Could there be some hidden mechanism beneath this stone coffin?”
“No, if there were something else hidden beneath the stone coffin, why would it disappear?”
“Lin Yi, these objects are definitely not simple. I think we’d better evacuate quickly. We don’t have the means to protect you from these things, you better go!” Lin Yi said loudly, urgency in his voice.
“Since we’ve already come in, why leave? I’m quite curious about what lies beneath the dragon coffin. Could it be that the items on top of this coffin are related to me?
I’m really looking forward to finding out what kind of fate lies behind the dragon coffin!” Lin Yi narrowed his eyes slightly, a confident smile curving his lips as he spoke lightly.
Lin Yi’s gaze rested on the stone coffin, feeling certain that there must be something interesting beneath it, perhaps some useful information to be gained!
“Lin Yi, let’s go down into this stone coffin together!” Lin Yi suddenly looked up and said to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s tone was imperious and brooked no argument, but Lin Yi wasn’t angry.
He now admired and was grateful to Lin Yi; not only had Lin Yi saved him, but he had also helped him come here. Naturally, he was willing to join Lin Yi in entering beneath the stone coffin.
Lin Yi and the others continued to move forward, and after they entered beneath the stone coffin, it stopped spinning.
Just how big was this stone coffin? Lin Yi and the others didn’t dare to guess.
For beneath that stone coffin was a boundless black hell!
Above that black hell were many blood-red flames, giving off a very eerie and terrifying appearance!
“What… what is this place?” Lin Yi couldn’t help but shiver, fear flooding his eyes.
“It must be the abode of a powerful being who has fallen. There must be treasures inside,” Lin Yi said in a deep voice. “But now is not the time to explore for treasure. The main thing is to quickly gather the resources available.”
That said, Lin Yi and the others continued to scavenge for treasures, although they did so slowly.
Because they knew this cave was vast and filled with danger.
They had to collect enough benefits before they could explore further.
After searching the area for a while, Lin Yi and the others had no gains.
“What is this place? Could it really be an abode?” Lin Yi frowned in annoyance, murmuring to himself as he sought answers, but still he found none!
“Lin Yi, don’t worry. I feel the energy inside me crazily increasing, as if there is some force impinging on my body,” Lin Yi suddenly said to Lin Yi.
He had felt his strength visibly enhancing while consuming energy, which excited Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi, has your body been transported to the Divine Domain?” Lin Yi blinked, suddenly excited, asking without reservation.
“Yes, I’ve been transported to the Divine Domain!” Lin Yi nodded, then added gravely: “Lin Yi, this is my first time entering the Divine Domain. Moreover, I came from the lower martial plane to the upper martial plane, so don’t tell me you guys don’t understand some basic knowledge about the Divine Domain!”
Lin Yi’s statement left Lin Yi and the others utterly dumbfounded; they were at a loss!
They all knew that the Divine Domain was an incomparably mysterious place, a super plane, and the most prosperous and powerful place in the entire universe.
But even though they had heard of the existence of the Divine Domain in the lower Martial Plane, they didn’t know how vast the Divine Domain really was!
Moreover, they had heard that the Divine Domain was an ultra-large plane, the core region of the Divine Realm!
How many experts, forces, and races there were in the Divine Domain was even more unknown to them.
However, Lin Yi, this kid, claimed that after entering the Divine Domain, it was just an ordinary plane in the lower Martial Plane, which… wasn’t that a bit too exaggerated?!
“I… I…” Lin Yi’s eyes flickered with excitement and adoration.
He took a deep breath, took a deep breath, suppressed his excited emotions, took a deep breath, continued to take a deep breath, took a deep breath!
“Lin Yi, I think you’ve been shocked into stupidity?!” Lin Yi couldn’t help but tease with a laugh.
Lin Yi’s face changed abruptly, somewhat embarrassed and uncomfortable, but he still firmly shook his head and said seriously, “Lin Yi, I know your talent is frighteningly strong, and you have many secrets unknown to others, but even so, you mustn’t be so arrogant, understand?
I don’t believe you have the strength to compete with some of the high-level geniuses in the Divine Domain, I don’t believe it!”
“Alright, I got it! No need to say more!” Lin Yi said helplessly, shaking his head.
He hadn’t expected Lin Yi to be so stubborn, so he stopped explaining.
Lin Yi and the others walked towards the innermost part of the stone coffin, and finally, a stone coffin appeared in Lin Yi’s line of sight when they reached deep inside.
The lid of that stone coffin was inlaid with a Luminous Pearl the size of a fist, emitting a soft light that made the entire coffin glitter brightly.
This stone coffin was pure black, and the lid was also pitch-black, but the blood and fresh blood on it were black as well.
“This is Dark Blood!!!” Suddenly, Xiao Xiao shouted excitedly, his voice full of excitement, exhilaration, and trembling.
Lin Yi and the others paused, their eyes fixated on the blood and fresh blood on the stone coffin.
Their facial expressions changed dramatically, their eyes filled with incredulity and shock; they simply couldn’t believe that this dark blood was actually blood.
One must know, this blood was condensed from a dark aura of death!
Generally speaking, the bodies of the deceased were composed of dark aura of death, but to have so much dark aura of death on this stone coffin was simply unbelievable.
“This… this…” Lin Yi and Xuanyuan Sword Soul were also beside themselves with excitement.
There must be many treasures inside this stone coffin, and certainly extremely precious ones.
“Lin Yi, if I’m not sensing it wrong, the space inside this coffin is vast, probably covering several tens of thousands of square meters!” Xuanyuan Sword Soul suddenly said.
“I can also feel that the space inside the coffin is very large, and I can even sense a trace of spatial power flowing!” Lin Yi nodded in agreement.
Following their conversation, everyone became extremely excited.
They hadn’t expected Lin Yi to have such intuition; they even doubted if they were overthinking and whether there was any treasure here at all.
Lin Yi was relying on his intuition to judge the space inside the coffin; they weren’t prophets and naturally couldn’t do that.
But Lin Yi believed in Lin Yi’s intuition, his feelings were always very accurate, never wrong.
“Let’s open this coffin and see what treasure it contains!” Lin Yi suddenly said.
“Open it!” Lin Yi took a deep breath and spoke in a deep voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 655: Not Just the Things Inside
chapters.content:
Chapter 655: Chapter 655: Not Just the Things Inside
Instantly, Lin Yi and the others stepped forward, weapons in hand, and began to attack the coffin, all wanting to open it.
However, the stone coffin was too massive, and their attacks had no effect on it, leaving only marks that did not damage it.
“What… what do we do now? This is black blood!” Lin Yi became anxious and somewhat at a loss, as a martial arts enthusiast, he did not want to give up this opportunity before him.
“Such a huge stone coffin must contain more than just what’s inside, and since the coffin is stained with black blood, it’s very likely everything inside is covered in black blood!” Lin Yi narrowed his eyes, his gaze flickering as he spoke in a deep voice.
Although Lin Yi could not control the black blood, its properties were fused with his soul, making him extremely sensitive to the black blood.
“Lin Yi, how did you sense the black blood on this coffin?” Xuanyuan Sword Soul asked curiously.
Lin Yi recounted all his experiences in this valley, and everyone, including Xuanyuan Sword Soul, was extremely shocked.
“That powerful? If that’s the case, there could be a substantial amount of this black blood!” Xuanyuan Sword Soul said gravely, “I guess that this black blood might be the blood of some ancient beasts or unearthed from ancient relics, possibly the blood of ancient Divine Beasts and ancient demonic beasts.”
Lin Yi’s eyes lit up, and with Xuanyuan Sword Soul’s words, he felt he had some certainty.
“I want everything in this stone coffin!” Lin Yi declared abruptly.
Lin Yi and the others were all stunned; they didn’t know what Lin Yi wanted the black blood for, given that it was so precious.
“Lin Yi, I need the contents of this coffin for my cultivation!” Lin Yi suddenly said in a firm voice.
“Cultivation?!”
“Lin Yi, you… you… you’re not planning to use the black blood for cultivation, are you?” Lin Yi’s eyes widened in disbelief.
“That’s right, the black blood. It’s such a treasure, it would be a pity not to use it for cultivation!” Lin Yi chuckled, his eagerness to increase his strength as quickly as possible shining through.
The corners of Lin Yi and the others’ mouths twitched, their hearts about to leap into their throats.
This little rascal, he actually wanted to use black blood for cultivation, this… this… this was madness!
Not just them, even Long Ji and Xuanyuan Sword Soul were shocked, staring at Lin Yi in disbelief, their eyes filled with astonishment.
Lin Yi wanted to cultivate using the black blood, but wasn’t this approach too risky?
What was Lin Yi thinking? Why would he consider such a thing? Was he not afraid of dying?
“Never mind! “Lin Yi suddenly clenched his teeth and said firmly, “Since we’ve found this place, it means we’re destined for the black blood, so I must take it. Only then can our strengths improve, and we might have a chance of leaving this accursed place alive.”
“That’s right, Lin Yi, we must not only take the black blood but also uncover the secrets of this place. We can’t waste this opportunity!”
“That’s right, in doing so, we might find a way to leave here.”
“Whatever the cost, I’m willing to try!”
Xuanyuan Sword Soul and Long Ji and the others also spoke up, clearly agreeing with Lin Yi’s approach.
“Lin Yi, we need some materials and medicinal herbs, do you have any?” Lin Yi inhaled deeply and continued to ask.
“Materials?”
“How much do you need?” Lin Yi was taken aback.
What does Lin Yi need so many materials for? Could it be that Lin Yi intends to use them for alchemy? That seems unlikely, right?
“A hundred stalks of Purple Gold Grass, ten jin of Metal Element, three bottles of Heavenly Spirit Liquid!” Lin Yi said solemnly.
“This… this much?” Even Lin Yi was stunned upon hearing the numbers he quoted, his complexion slightly uneasy, “Where can I get so many of these things!”
Purple Gold Grass is an extremely rare medicinal herb that can be used for the cultivation of martial cultivators in the Divine Martial Continent.
Heavenly Spirit Liquid is the main ingredient used for the refinement of Heavenly Soul Pills, and its price is extremely terrifying. Even a superpower like Lin Yi could not produce so much Heavenly Spirit Liquid!
“I know there are many places that have these kinds of medicinal herbs, but those places are dangerous, and what we need are Purple Gold Grass and Heavenly Spirit Liquid, I need some heavenly and earthly treasures!” Lin Yi said indifferently.
“Heavenly and earthly treasures?” Weiwei said with a bitter smile. Are there really heavenly and earthly treasures in those places? The chances of those places having heavenly and earthly treasures are almost zero!
The places Lin Yi spoke of, he had never visited; how could he possibly obtain so many heavenly and earthly treasures?
“I can help obtain these materials and Heavenly Spirit Liquid for you, but I can’t guarantee that I will be able to find them all. All I can do is try my best to help you find them,” Lin Yi sighed helplessly.
“Thank you!” Lin Yi said earnestly, “Lin Yi, our relationship is very good, I’ve always considered you a friend, and now, I need your help!”
Lin Yi was taken aback for a moment, then nodded seriously, “Alright, I will definitely find those things for you, I must make you stronger!”
After that, under the leadership of Lin Yi, a group of them continued deeper into the cave dwelling. Along the way, they encountered many dangers and obstacles, but thankfully Lin Yi had the Devouring Flame, so they were quickly resolved.
“There are some treasures here, Lin Yi, let’s collect some first!”
“Don’t waste these good things.”
After Lin Yi and the others entered a house, they found many treasures inside, all of which were high-level holy artifacts.
“Brother Ye, all these items are yours; we will not embezzle a single one!”
“That’s right!” Xuanyuan Sword Soul also said, “We will not embezzle any of the items!”
“Brother Ye, me too!”
“As will I!” Long Ji also said with a smile.
“Alright!” Lin Yi nodded slightly and then glanced at everyone, saying with a smile, “This place is in ruins, no one dares to mess with these things, so you can pick whatever you want. I don’t mind, as long as you don’t put me at a disadvantage!”
Long Ji, Long Teng, and Long Xiang felt complicated. Although they already knew that Lin Yi and Xuanyuan Sword Soul were brothers, they still found Lin Yi to be quite cunning.

chapters.title: Chapter 656: 656: All High Grade Immortal Artifacts
chapters.content:
Chapter 656: Chapter 656: All High Grade Immortal Artifacts
“You all don’t just stand around here; come with me. These items I’ve obtained won’t be of much use to you if you take them,” Lin Yi spoke up.
“How… How can we accept this?” Lin Yi was slightly embarrassed. Although he really wanted to take them, he was concerned about upsetting Lin Yi and Long Chen.
“What’s there to fuss about? We are brothers; we share both our fortunes and misfortunes. Just take them!” Lin Yi snorted.
Lin Yi nodded his head, accepted the heavenly materials, Divine Weapons, Elixirs, Divine Beast bones, and so on, all 53,360 pieces of them, all High Grade Immortal Artifacts!
“All these things now belong to me; don’t you guys fight over them!” Lin Yi said with a laugh while stashing them into his Spatial Ring, these items would be enough for him to use for several years!
Lin Yi and the others were all flabbergasted, how… how could this be okay?
Yet Lin Yi remained indifferent: “It’s fine, I can refine so many heavenly materials and Divine Artifacts. A little more makes no difference; we are brothers, just take them and use them. Don’t refuse, I’m taking these things!”
“This…” Everyone looked at each other, their hearts filled with waves of excitement.
Lin Yi’s intentions were very clear, he didn’t want to take advantage of the heavenly materials and Divine Artifacts.
“Alright then, all these things are given to you!”
“Indeed, we can’t carry them anyway, they are all yours!”
“Hahaha… Lin Yi, you are too generous. Giving all these things to you, what will we have left to take?”
“I don’t want it either, just let it be!”
“You take it!”
……
Lin Yi and the others one by one threw their treasures to the ground, giving them all to Lin Yi. Their hearts were deeply moved. Lin Yi had done so much for them; how could they not feel grateful?
Although Lin Yi and his companions were not lacking in wealth, they would never disdain these items, as they were things money couldn’t buy.
Lin Yi wasn’t pretentious, and with a wave of his hand, he took them all. Then, he continued toward the depths ahead.
Before long, Lin Yi had reached the deepest part of the mountain belly.
Inside the mountain belly, there were countless passages, with many treasures within them, some of which were even of high levels.
These treasures were all sealed, but as long as some seals were lifted, the items would be exposed to the air—truly priceless!
“Lin Yi, there’s a cave here, with a staircase leading to the mountain top. I remember this staircase should lead to the ancient battlefield, but I’m not exactly sure where,” Lin Yi suddenly pointed to a spot and said. He had just discovered that cave.
“The ancient battlefield?” Lin Yi’s eyes lit up: “Then let’s go up now!”
After Lin Yi spoke, he was about to lead everyone up, but Lin Yi shook his head: “Lin Yi, you stay here, I’ll go on ahead!”
“You… Didn’t we agree that we would come together this time?” Lin Yi was surprised: “Why are you going up there by yourself?”
“Lin Yi, your strength has already reached the Peak of the Heavenly Rank Later Stages, and besides, you have so many heavenly materials. It’s not suitable for us to follow you!” Lin Yi said earnestly: “I and Xuanyuan Sword Soul need to attend to some private matters, as do Long Chen and the others. Please take care of this place for a while. I will take these treasures and discuss with Xuanyuan and the others before giving them to you!”
Without waiting for Lin Yi to respond, Lin Yi left with Xuanyuan Sword Soul and the others!
Lin Yi was somewhat speechless; they had actually left him behind here. It was indeed a lack of loyalty, but his face soon lit up with joy because Lin Yi and Long Xiang had already walked far away.
They must have had something important to do; otherwise, they wouldn’t have left him behind.
With this thought, Lin Yi couldn’t help but speed up, heading straight for the ancient battlefield.
Along the way, Lin Yi also encountered many cultivators, some of Heavenly Rank, but they were all of the lower Heavenly Rank. They did not dare to provoke Lin Yi and could only avoid him from a distance.
“Lin Yi, did you get a lot of treasures?” Lin Yi walked at the forefront, asking as he walked, his voice filled with uncontrollable excitement.
“Of course,” chuckled Lin Yi, “my strength is no ordinary thing now. I can kill fighters around the Ninth Level of Tianwu Realm, and those of Heavenly Rank are even easier to deal with. The treasures of this ancient battlefield are all mine!” Lin Yi’s face shone with excitement.
“That may not be the case,” Long Ji said indifferently, then said nothing more and continued walking ahead.
Long Yue and the others didn’t speak either, just staring at Lin Yi, their eyes filled with envy.
Lin Yi just smiled and shook his head; they knew Lin Yi was powerful. But Lin Yi had only just reached the later stages of the Ninth Level of Tianwu Realm, which was quite different from them. They still had hope to catch up with Lin Yi.
Soon, the group entered a grand hall!
Inside the hall, various items were laid out. Many people were frantically scouring for treasures. Their clothes were tattered, and they were covered in blood, looking somewhat terrifying.
“This… these are the elites of the Demon Race; they’re all trapped here!” Lin Yi exclaimed in shock.
Lin Yi was also taken aback. The Demon Race? Weren’t those Demon Beasts dead? Could it be that they were trapped because of their fear of the Demon Race’s strength?
“Their power has been suppressed by the Demon Race, leaving them only at the Early Stage of the Tianwu Realm, with no ability to resist. Having been trapped here, there are only two outcomes,” Lin Yi said solemnly, “either submit to the Demon Race or become their slaves, and perhaps they could preserve some of their bloodline.”
“I understand!” Lin Yi nodded. Lin Yi was reminding him that if he encountered the Demon Race, he must not show mercy but suppress them completely and take away all the treasures on them. That way, the Demon Race would have no ability to seek revenge.
Lin Yi’s hint not only enlightened Lin Yi but also gave him a new perspective on the Demon Race.
Aren’t the Demon Race supposed to be very powerful? Whether it was the Demon Emperor or the Heavenly Emperor, they were both extremely formidable beings, but they could do nothing against Lin Yi, proving that the Demon Race was not on the same level as Lin Yi in terms of overall strength.
With this thought, Lin Yi grew even more eager to improve his own strength. He had to become much stronger.
Lin Yi surveyed his surroundings; many places were empty, with no one in sight, clearly looted. There were not many people here, and those who were, had been killed by Demon Beasts, leaving no trace.
“Lin Yi, what are you looking for?” Xuanyuan Sword Soul asked.
“I’m looking for the Demon Race’s treasury!” Lin Yi said with a smile, “After so many years, I don’t know if the Demon Race’s vault is still here, but I must search well!”
“I found it!” A flash of surprise crossed Lin Yi’s eyes.
“Where?” Lin Yi asked eagerly; he had long wanted to find the location of the Demon Race’s treasury. That way, he could rapidly become stronger. This trip to the ancient battlefield would definitely not be in vain.
Lin Yi handed a jade box to Lin Yi and said, “This is the key to the Demon Race’s treasury!”
“Key!” Lin Yi took the key, and suddenly a mysterious power surged through him, seeming to have a certain attraction.
“What is this treasure?” Lin Yi asked, brimming with excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 657: 657: Many Mysterious Things
chapters.content:
Chapter 657: Chapter 657: Many Mysterious Things
“I won’t tell you, just hold on to this key for now. Your current strength isn’t enough to open the Demon Race’s vault. Wait until you reach the Heavenly Rank!” Lin Yi shook his head slightly, then continued on his way.
“Lin Yi, we picked this up from a Demon King of Heavenly Rank!” Lin Yi took out a black Token.
This black Token was only the size of a palm, emitting a dark sheen, looking as though it was cast from black iron. Yet upon it were etched some strange Runes, seemingly containing many mystical secrets.
At first glance, this black Token appeared rather ordinary, but the moment Lin Yi held it in his hand, he felt an oddly familiar sensation, as if he had merged with it.
Lin Yi gazed intently at the black Token in Lin Yi’s hand, “What exactly does this black Token represent?”
Lin Yi smiled faintly, “I won’t tell you. You just need to know that this Token can open the treasure vault of the Demon Race. Let’s hurry to find the Demon Race’s vault; so many days have passed, who knows what state the vault might be in now!”
Lin Yi nodded, stored the black Token in his Storage Ring, and then led Xuanyuan Sword Soul and the others on their way!
After another three to four days, Lin Yi and his group finally came to a valley.
This valley was vast, with very luxurious buildings occupying a quarter of it. Moreover, many people were patrolling inside the valley, with the weakest among them being strong practitioners at the peak of Sixth Rank Heavenly Martial Realm, and there were not a few who were at the later stages and peak of the Eighth Rank.
“Lin Yi, this valley is a forbidden territory of the Demon Race, not allowing outsiders to enter. We can only circle around the outskirts and then have to leave,” Lin Yi took a glance at the Demon Race individuals within the valley and suddenly stopped.
“Why can’t we go in?” Lin Yi asked, puzzled.
“Because there are many Heavenly Weapons inside this valley. We must have them to enter the valley. As soon as we go inside, those Heavenly Weapons will attack us on their own, so we can’t force our way through!” Lin Yi spoke earnestly.
“Heavenly Weapons attacking? That powerful?” Xuanyuan Sword Soul asked in surprise.
“Yes, the power of Heavenly Weapons is extremely formidable. Once touched, even a being of Heavenly Rank could be seriously injured, or even die!” Lin Yi took a deep breath and continued, “Lin Yi, you need to find a way to get some Heavenly Weapons!”
“Are Heavenly Weapons that easy to obtain?” Xuanyuan Sword Soul gave a bitter smile.
“Sorry, but if you want one, I can help you get one. I am an Artifact Refiner, and crafting a Heavenly Weapon is no problem for me!” Lin Yi said with a smile, seeming not to pay much attention to Heavenly Weapons.
“Then I thank you!” Lin Yi chuckled. Since Lin Yi said so, it meant he had a way.
“Lin Yi, I’ll go ahead then!” Saying this, Lin Yi quickly ran towards the valley and soon disappeared into it.
Lin Yi sprinted into the valley, racing along. His speed was not the slightest bit inferior to that of Xuanyuan Sword Soul!
Lin Yi stood there, his heart pounding incessantly, his breathing gradually becoming ragged, for he was seeing one Heavenly Weapon after another.
The value of Heavenly Weapons was immense. These were Heavenly Weapons!
Heavenly Weapons, like Divine Weapons, were extremely expensive, and these were all Demon Emperor Level Heavenly Weapons. Lin Yi only needed one to sell for an astronomical price!
Lin Yi didn’t know how many Heavenly Weapons were in the valley, but to him, they were exceedingly precious!
Lin Yi wasn’t greedy; he collected all the Heavenly Weapons and then headed towards the other side of the valley.
Along the way, Lin Yi encountered quite a few members of the Demon Race, but he easily evaded them all.
Lin Yi could not help but admire his own strength and courage.
“Little brother, you came from an inferior plane, right?” At this moment, a sleazy-looking middle-aged man blocked Lin Yi’s path.
This man was a Heavenly Rank powerhouse, and there were quite a few people with him, all of whom also had Heavenly Rank cultivation. Their faces were very unpleasant and angry.
These individuals from the Demon Race were wearing the armor of their race, which looked very domineering. The gazes they directed at Lin Yi were filled with murderous intent.
“What do you want?” Lin Yi frowned, wondering whether these demons were looking for trouble with him.
“You just arrived and started snatching our Demon Race’s heavenly treasures, are you tired of living?” a Demon Race expert yelled loudly.
“Heavenly treasures? I do not understand what you’re talking about!” Lin Yi snorted coldly, playing dumb while also surveying the situation around him.
“You don’t understand? Hmph… We have already investigated your identity. You are from an inferior plane, a country bumpkin who has just arrived in the Demon Realm not long ago. We, the Demon Race, dominate this realm. Whatever our people want—do you dare to not sell?”
“You should have some of our Demon Race’s heavenly treasures on you. Hand them over, and I will spare your life!”
A Demon Race individual loudly berated, the murderous intent in his eyes growing even more intense.
“Indeed, you are from an inferior plane, and we of the Demon Race can take any heavenly treasure from your body without allowing you to refuse!” Yet another Demon Race individual shouted loudly, his voice booming and deafening.
“Hmph, what do you think you are, to think you can take things from my hands?” Lin Yi sneered, “You sure are bold. Do you really think I’m afraid of you? However, I can’t be bothered to stoop to your level. Now, may I go?”
“No, you may not. Hand over the heavenly treasures, and we’ll let you leave!” One of the Demon Race powerhouses directly blocked Lin Yi’s path.
“Get lost!” Lin Yi shouted angrily, and in the same second, he threw a punch.
Lin Yi moved as fast as lightning, reaching the Demon Race individual who had blocked his way in the blink of an eye.
The Demon Race man had no time to react and only felt a pain in his neck as his entire body was thrown flying and then harshly slammed into the ground, blood spraying out like it cost nothing—dead.
This scene left everyone shocked and dumbfounded!
How could this youngster from an inferior plane possess such terrifying strength?
They were Heavenly Rank strongmen, after all!
Even without using martial arts, they should have been able to kill this lower plane youngster with ease.
Yet this youngster had killed one of them with a single punch, and so effortlessly at that. It was simply too horrifying.
“Young Master Ye’s strength is indeed terrifying,” a Demon Race man at the peak of the intermediate stage of Heavenly Rank said solemnly, “However, I advise you to obediently hand over the heavenly treasures on you, so that our Demon Race can spare your life. Otherwise, we will personally slaughter you, and you won’t even be able to find your body when the time comes!”
“Haven’t I already handed over the heavenly treasures? What kind of attitude is this? Are you still forcing me?” Lin Yi raised an eyebrow and gave the Demon Race man a cold glance.
“Hmph!” The Demon Race man shouted angrily: “We are doing this for the good of our Demon Race. If you do not give them up, we will surely annihilate you, and all your family members will be killed—do you believe that?”
“Hahaha… What a bunch of pitiful wretches! I truly feel sorry for your Demon Race!” Lin Yi mocked loudly: “Your Demon Race is but a slave organization under the Demon Emperor, and your ancient ancestor is the Demon Emperor!”

chapters.title: Chapter 658: 658: Head Completely Exploded
chapters.content:
Chapter 658: Chapter 658: Head Completely Exploded
“What did you say? You… say that again?” The Demon Race individual suddenly got greatly alarmed, their face flushing red and their eyes nearly bulging out.
“I said you all are a bunch of slaves, and your ancestor is the Demon Emperor!” Lin Yi roared loudly, his voice filled with disdain.
The head of that Demon Race individual completely exploded, their eyeballs and ears burst apart too, their body convulsing wildly as blood gushed out as if it cost nothing, until finally, after a few more convulsions, the body lay still, devoid of life.
With one move, he had killed a member of the Demon Race, which was quite shocking to Lin Yi.
However, what was even more frightening was the group of Demon Race individuals beside that man, all of whom changed their expressions drastically.
“Damned lower-plane native, I will kill you, kill you…”
“You actually killed one of our people, I will tear you to pieces…”
“Damned native, do you have a death wish daring to kill one of our people?”
The Demon Race individuals all began bellowing, their faces contorted with ferocity, their murderous intent chilling and immense, sending forth a terrifying aura that nearly made Lin Yi gasp for air.
“All of you come at me together! Otherwise, you won’t stand a chance!” Lin Yi spoke gravely, his eyes flashing with a cold glint.
“Hmph, courting death!”
“A bunch of lower-plane ants daring to challenge us, simply seeking their own death, kill!”
“Let us join forces to kill this lower-plane ant and establish our Demon Race’s might!”
“Kill him and earn merit for our Demon Race, a reward of a rare treasure awaits!”
“A hundred Demon Crystals, rewarding a thousand at once!”
The group of Demon Race individuals all roared excitedly, their eyes filled with anticipation and excitement, thinking of earning merits and obtaining better treasures. Who could resist such a temptation?
“Since you all wish to die, I will oblige you, don’t blame me!” Lin Yi shouted, his body suddenly surged forward.
“An arrogant fool, you think you alone can kill us Demon Race individuals?”
“Hmph, how laughable!”
“Kid, you are too arrogant!”
“We are all of Heavenly Rank strength, do you really think you can kill us with one punch? Dream on!!!”
The group of Demon Race individuals laughed coldly, as they indeed were beyond the capacity of Lin Yi to kill.
“If you insist on courting death, I will oblige you, die!” Lin Yi stopped wasting words and made his move, his fist wrapped in the golden phantom of the Divine Dragon.
In that punch, Lin Yi exerted eighty percent of his strength.
Boom boom boom…
The punch swept through the air with a roaring wind, carrying terrifying power as Lin Yi’s fist hammered down on the Demon Race individuals fiercely.
“What? Such a terrifying attack with just one punch, impossible… this…” In an instant, the complexions of the Demon Race individuals all greatly shifted.
They never expected Lin Yi’s strength to be so fearsome.
“Die!” Lin Yi’s fist mercilessly struck the nearest Demon Race individual, and immediately, a mouthful of blood was spat out as their body was flung to the ground, severely injured and unable to resist further.
The remaining three Demon Race individuals all turned a pale shade, shocked to their cores, yet not afraid.
“Let’s attack together, join forces and we don’t believe you can kill all of us!” The other three Demon Race individuals exchanged looks and decided to fight to the death.
“Not one left!” Lin Yi took a deep breath and roared, stepping swiftly like lightning, his fist smashing out, carrying powerful spatial tremors and tearing forces.
“Kill!”
“Die!”
“Damned native, die!!!”
The Demon Race man bellowed loudly and, together with the other two, they all struck at once, combining Divine Skills and weapons to furiously bombard Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s body flickered, dodging one wave of attacks, then another, continuing to evade.
“Hmph, do you think you can escape?” the Heavenly Rank powerhouse snorted, his body twisting as he suddenly lunged at Lin Yi’s back.
At the same time, the other two Demons did the same, striking towards Lin Yi’s back. If Lin Yi were hit, it would mean certain death.
A sinister killing intent flickered in their eyes.
“Hmph!” Lin Yi snorted disdainfully, a trace of scorn crossing his lips as his body flickered again, dodging another wave of attacks and continuing to evade.
“Damned native, don’t act so arrogantly. The three of us together will make sure you can’t escape, die!” the Demon Race man roared, his eyes wild with madness and greed, as he envisioned Lin Yi being beaten to death by their joint assault.
“Die!” In the next second, the Demon Race man had positioned himself behind Lin Yi, his hand somehow clutching a long spear.
This spear was a special weapon of the Demon Race, about fifteen meters long, jet black in color, radiating a bone-chilling coldness, with the tip glinting with a hint of cold light.
The instant the Demon Race man thrust his spear, its tip aimed straight for Lin Yi’s back.
A faintly mocking smile crossed Lin Yi’s face—he truly thought this Demon Race man had no idea what was coming to him!
Then, in the next second, Lin Yi spun around, his body a blur, and threw a punch.
Bang!!!
Lin Yi’s punch landed squarely on the chest of the Demon Race man.
Although Lin Yi hadn’t used any power or technique, simply in terms of physical strength, he was still far stronger than the Demon Race man.
Therefore, his punch went straight through the man’s chest, piercing through his body.
This scene left the Demon Race man in shock, his eyes filled with horror.
He couldn’t believe that his attack had been so easily countered by Lin Yi.
How could this be possible?
He was a member of the Demon Race, with physical strength surpassing that of his peers—even high-level fighters of the same rank might not withstand him.
But now, he had been killed by a single punch to the chest, which was too much of a grievance; he was unwilling to accept it.
He couldn’t understand how he, a powerhouse at the peak of the Second Layer Heavenly Rank, could be killed by a human at the first level of the True Immortal period?
This couldn’t be true; it simply had to be a trick, a ploy by Lin Yi, a cunning scheme!
“I’m not content, how can you kill me? How can you kill me?” the Demon Race man roared in disbelief.
“Heh heh…” A playful look appeared on Lin Yi’s face as he mocked lightly, “Who do you think you are? Do you fancy yourself as a genius? Don’t forget, you didn’t even touch a single hair on my head!”
“It’s impossible… impossible…” the Demon Race man shook his head, unwilling to believe, refusing to accept defeat.
He was one of the Demon Race’s most outstanding talents; how could he possibly die at the hands of a native? It was too much to bear!
Whether he was willing to accept it or not, that was the reality.
Lin Yi stepped forward, his foot pressing down on the Demon Race man, then grabbed his neck with one hand: “Now, do you have any last words?”
“If you kill me, even if you are a genius of the Divine Land Continent, our clan leader won’t let you go.”
“Moreover, you will be pursued by the entire Divine Land Continent!”
“You will die, assuredly at the hands of our Demon Race!”
“But, I believe that before you die, you will first be killed by your own kin. Then, I can use your bones to reclaim what I have lost!”
The eyes of the Demon Race man glinted with viciousness as he suddenly began to laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 659: 659: Talent that Commands Admiration
chapters.content:
Chapter 659: Chapter 659: Talent that Commands Admiration
Lin Yi was startled, “Oh? You mean, not only do you want to die, but also want to take revenge on my family members?”
“Hahahaha… Did I say anything wrong? Are you not just relying on your little abilities and cunningness? Otherwise, on what grounds did you kill my companion?”
“Is it just because you are a genius? Your talent and strength are indeed admirable!”
“Unfortunately, you’ve encountered me, the strongest genius of the Demon Race, and you will pay the price for your actions!”
“I will let you know what kind of existence you have provoked!”
The member of the Demon Race burst into laughter, eyes filled with excitement; his body trembling, seemingly unable to wait for this moment to arrive.
“If that’s the case, then I shall grant your wish!” Lin Yi’s eyes held a trace of murderous intent, “You are not worthy!”
As Lin Yi’s words fell,
An invisible force erupted from beneath Lin Yi’s feet.
Immediately after, the Demon Race individual’s body abruptly floated up, then inch by inch, fell from the air and ultimately crashed heavily onto the ground.
To send a member of the Demon Race flying with a punch, even shattering his body, what terrifying might was this, what kind of power?
“No… it’s impossible… What is happening? How can this be? My cultivation speed has been defying the heavens, yet why is it still not as fast as this youngster’s?”
“No… I can’t accept this, I can’t!”
“No… I don’t want to die, I don’t want to die…”
The individual from the Demon Race couldn’t believe it; he stared at Lin Yi relentlessly, screaming and roaring, but unfortunately, his life had ended, and there were no answers.
With a wave of Lin Yi’s hand, those Demon Race individuals, who were scared stiff, were taken into his Dragon Scale Arm.
“You bastard, you actually killed the leader of our clan, you killed our clan leader!” shouted the leader of those three Demon Race individuals, eyes filled with rage and resentment.
“You useless trash, get lost before I slap you to death if you delay my business any further,” Lin Yi glanced at the Demon Race individuals and scolded.
The faces of the Demon Race individuals went pale, and they shuddered before hurrying away.
Lin Yi then walked towards the giant Blood Pool, ready to absorb the essence of the Blood Pool.
The blood in the Blood Pool was extremely vivid, rich, and filled with an otherworldly beauty; Lin Yi couldn’t help but inhale deeply.
“Such comfortable blood, this must be the legendary strongest blood of the Demon Race, right?” Lin Yi murmured to himself, his face showing some excitement.
He knew this blood was extremely precious and rare, a benefit he obtained from that Demon Race individual.
Lin Yi continued walking forward, advancing towards what lay ahead.
Soon after, Lin Yi encountered two more members of the Demon Race, one at the Intermediate Stage of Heavenly Rank and the other at the Early Stage.
These two seemed to also want to snatch the essence of the Blood Pool from Lin Yi’s hands; both had ugly expressions, their eyes fixed on the essence of the Blood Pool in Lin Yi’s hands.
“Hmph!” Seeing those two, Lin Yi snorted, a glint of killing intent flashing in his eyes, “Seeking death!”
Lin Yi charged directly at the two individuals, his speed incredibly fast; in the blink of an eye, he was in front of them, throwing a punch.
“Bang bang bang…” With dull thuds, Lin Yi’s fists squarely hit the faces of the two Demon Race individuals, completely knocking them out.
Lin Yi’s speed was too fast, too ferocious; the two Demon Race individuals couldn’t even react before they lost consciousness, their faces swelling like pig heads, blood dripping.
Lin Yi devoured all the essence of the Blood Pool into his body, then sat cross-legged, beginning to operate the Divine Dragon Phantom Cultivation Technique, frantically absorbing essence and Yuan Soul Power.
Lin Yi’s martial cultivation talent wasn’t bad, so consuming these essence and Yuan Soul Power was an immense help to him.
Lin Yi was frantically absorbing, while those members of the Demon Race were also crazily devouring those essences and Yuan Soul Power.
These essences and Yuan Soul Power were indeed treasures among treasures for them, the Heavenly Rank powerhouses.
They were at the Heavenly Rank!
Such a huge piece of fat meat was right in front of them, yet it had been so simply and brutally taken away by Lin Yi.
“Kid, we’re just unlucky this time!” the boss said in a deep voice, “I won’t let you off! ”
As soon as his words ended, Lin Yi’s fist attacked again.
“Bang, bang, bang…” Punch after punch, Lin Yi’s fists rained down on him like raindrops.
“No… don’t hit anymore, we surrender…” Finally, the boss became afraid and shouted for mercy loudly.
“Too late. If you’ve done something wrong, you should face the consequences!” Lin Yi snorted and then smashed another fist onto the boss’s head.
Instantly, the boss’s head burst open like it had been hit by a shell, turning into fragments.
And for the remaining members of the Demon Race, it was no exception; Lin Yi showed no mercy, killing them all without even letting their Yuan Soul Bodies escape.
Afterward, Lin Yi started to cultivate in the cave, continuously absorbing the essences and Yuan Soul Power from the Blood Pool.
No one knew how long it had been.
“Huff, huff…”
Suddenly, the sound of panting came through.
The sound was incredibly rapid.
“Who’s there?” Lin Yi’s eyebrows shot up, his voice full of caution.
He didn’t know how many members of the Demon Race were still hidden around him, but if someone was approaching him, it meant that there must be many from the Demon Race lurking nearby.
“Heh heh… we’ve come to catch you!” The voice grew clearer, “Lin Yi, you really did a good job injuring the second prodigy of our Demon Race. Now the war between the Demon Race and humans is inevitable!”
“Hmph, that’s your own problem, it has nothing to do with me!” Lin Yi snorted. He wasn’t afraid because he was absolutely confident he could kill the Heavenly Rank expert before him.
“If it really has nothing to do with you, then leave this cave now and we won’t pursue this. Otherwise, the only path for you is death!”
“Of course, you could also choose to join us.”
“Our Demon Race will not mistreat any of our own. If you leave now, I guarantee no one will chase you. But if you don’t leave, then we’ll have to take action. No matter the outcome, it won’t be in your control,” said the invading Heavenly Rank expert.
Lin Yi slightly narrowed his eyes, staring at the invading Heavenly Rank expert.
Although this person was from the Demon Race, Lin Yi was not afraid of him.
His martial cultivation strength was the strongest in the Demon Race, and he was a peak expert in the Heavenly Rank. In the entire Demon Race, he counted as one of the very best.
So, Lin Yi was not worried at all.
“Kid, think it over carefully. It’s not only you in this cave, there are other members of the Demon Race,” the invading Heavenly Rank expert said with a cold laugh, a chilling light flickering in the depths of his eyes.
“What do I want, do I ever need to guess? Do you think I need to consider it?” Lin Yi said with a chuckle, speaking indifferently.
The invading Heavenly Rank expert was first taken aback, then burst into laughter, “Kid, you’re quite arrogant, but I like it!”

chapters.title: Chapter 660: 660: A Formidable Character
chapters.content:
Chapter 660: Chapter 660: A Formidable Character
“Enough with the nonsense, let’s see if you’ve got what it takes!” Lin Yi scoffed disdainfully, then leaped forward, charging at the invading Heavenly Rank expert with incredible speed.
“What guts!” The Heavenly Rank expert was startled and dodged Lin Yi’s attack with a swift movement, then shouted with a roar, “I’m going to tear you to pieces!”
The Heavenly Rank expert transformed into a streak of golden light, hurtling towards Lin Yi with extraordinary speed, bringing with it an overwhelming oppressive force, and was about to reach Lin Yi in an instant.
At this moment, Lin Yi had already absorbed all of the primal essence and Yuan Soul Power, and his body moved, vanishing from the spot like lightning.
“Hmph, petty tricks, take this!” The invading Heavenly Rank expert bellowed angrily, stabbing his longsword into the ground, then he took to the air and once again slashed down towards Lin Yi.
His speed was extremely fast, and even Lin Yi had to admit it was terrifying!
This Heavenly Rank expert was a formidable opponent, and if Lin Yi hadn’t made a breakthrough, he probably would have had a tough battle.
But now, he had reached the Heavenly Rank Realm, and even in a battle with this Heavenly Rank expert, he was confident of victory.
However, defeating him would still take no small amount of time!
A cold smirk crossed Lin Yi’s lips.
“Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh…” In the next second, Lin Yi’s figure appeared above the Heavenly Rank expert’s head.
Lin Yi’s movements were like a specter, rapidly maneuvering above the Heavenly Rank expert, his fists raining down one after another, causing the expert’s cheeks to throb painfully.
Although the Heavenly Rank expert could fend off Lin Yi’s attacks, his actions were very sluggish.
“Boom, boom, boom…” Lin Yi punched continuously, employing his movement technique with each blow landing solidly.
Lin Yi was extremely fast, and even though the Heavenly Rank expert could block a punch from Lin Yi, he couldn’t block a kick.
Before long, the Heavenly Rank expert was kicked away by Lin Yi and smashed heavily against a wall.
“Pfft!” The invading Heavenly Rank expert spat out bright red blood, his complexion pale, his eyes filled with fear.
He had never imagined Lin Yi could be so fast, and that he would be unable to block Lin Yi’s attacks. The shock was immense.
Lin Yi truly had an extraordinary talent, worthy of being called a genius monster!
“Feeling arrogant now, are we?” Lin Yi stepped forward, staring at the invading Heavenly Rank expert.
“Youth, I admit defeat. Our Demon Race does not bully the weak, and I believe you are not a bad person, so I’m willing to join you and fight alongside you!”
The Heavenly Rank expert hastily said, his eyes flashing with excitement. He was no fool, knowing that his strength was by no means a match for Lin Yi.
If the fight continued, he would only face certain death.
So he simply chose to submit to Lin Yi, after all, he wanted to return to the Demon Race alive.
“Good, I am Lin Yi. You can call me Young Master Ye, or you can call me Boss. Let’s do this, I’ll give you a name, from now on you’ll be called Brother Ye!” Lin Yi said with a smile.
The invading Heavenly Rank expert nodded: “Brother Ye!”
“Just stick with me, I’ll take you to play with the Demon Beasts of the Demon Race!” Lin Yi chuckled.
“Ye… Boss Ye, you… you’re really going to take me in?” The Heavenly Rank expert’s eyes were brimming with ecstasy, he couldn’t believe Lin Yi would really want him, it was almost too good to be true.
“Of course. I, Lin Yi, don’t joke about such matters, rest assured!” Lin Yi smiled and then turned, heading towards the cave entrance.
“Wait, Boss Ye, wait for me!” The Heavenly Rank expert hurried to catch up.
“Youth, was what you just said true? Can I really join your Tianhu Manor?” The invading Heavenly Rank expert asked.
“Of course it’s true, just follow me!” Lin Yi said with a nod and a smile.
“Alright!” The Heavenly Rank expert nodded and followed Lin Yi towards the entrance of the cave.
The two moved with incredible speed, and in the blink of an eye, they were standing at the mouth of the cave!
At this very moment, within the cave, approximately three to four thousand experts of the Demon Race had already gathered.
“Young Master Ye!”
“Big Brother Ye!”
…
“Brother Ye, all of this was commanded by the higher-ups of our Demon Race, we hope you can understand!” The Heavenly Rank expert bowed his head, not daring to look at Lin Yi.
“The higher-ups of your Demon Race, what level expert are you?” asked Lin Yi.
“I am at the Early Stage of Heavenly Rank!” the man hurriedly answered, his voice full of respect.
“The people of your Demon Race are truly cunning!” Lin Yi sneered and let out a snort.
The man fell silent, not daring to say anything, because the gap between Lin Yi and them was like heaven and earth. No matter what he said, it was useless; it was better to wait until Lin Yi became stronger before discussing this matter.
“Who is your target?” asked Lin Yi.
“The Demon Emperor, my lord!” the man hurriedly replied.
“I see,” Lin Yi nodded, then continued to ask, “Tell me, aside from yourself, are there any other Heavenly Rank experts among your Demon Race?”
“Yes!” The man nodded rapidly.
“So you’re saying that you have five or six Heavenly Rank experts!”
“Yes!” The man nodded again, his eyes flashing with surprise.
He hadn’t expected Lin Yi to know even this.
“You have five or six people?”
“Yes!”
“Very well, since there are five or six Heavenly Rank experts, then you will join me in fighting our way out!” Lin Yi said gravely, his eyes shining with a sharp light.
With so many Heavenly Rank experts, they were more than enough to obliterate the Demon Emperor Palace, it was just uncertain whether they would actually come out.
However, even if they didn’t come out, they probably wouldn’t dare to make any rash moves.
After all, Lin Yi was not only a Heavenly Rank expert, but his strength was also immensely powerful.
Even if the old monsters from the Demon Emperor Palace came out, they might not be a match for Lin Yi!
“Yes, my lord!” the man hurriedly agreed.
“You lead the way, I’ll follow. If you dare to pull any tricks, I will definitely make you die right here!”
Afterward, Lin Yi looked at the man with a chilling voice.
“Please rest assured, Young Master Ye, we are the finest of the Demon Race’s younger generation; we would never resort to trickery!” The man nodded quickly, yet he had some doubts in his heart. This youngster’s strength was too formidable; with such skills, he could easily destroy him, why would he need to resort to any tricks?
“Let’s go!” Lin Yi said indifferently and quickly left the Demon Race’s cave with the man, heading towards the Demon Emperor Palace.
At this moment, inside the Demon Emperor Palace!
“What? Are you saying someone has invaded the Demon Race’s cave dwelling?” The Demon Emperor, who was sitting with his eyes closed in the great hall, suddenly opened his eyes, which flickered with excitement and fury.
It had been a long time since he had encountered such an opponent; he had even forgotten that there were such powerful cultivators in this world.
And now, someone had dared to intrude into the valley of the Demon Race, which was utterly detestable. If he didn’t catch this invader, he felt it would be a disgrace to his name.
“Yes, Your Majesty the Demon Emperor, the strength of that person is terrifying, and we are no match for him!” the Heavenly Rank expert hurriedly said.

chapters.title: Chapter 661: 661 Startling Fears
chapters.content:
Chapter 661: Chapter 661 Startling Fears
When he spoke, he stuttered somewhat; after all, Lin Yi’s strength just now was too terrifying, and even now, he couldn’t help but shudder at the thought.
“What strength is this, to be so terrifying? Could it be even greater than mine?” the Demon Emperor asked, frowning.
He knew his own strength well; he was the strongest young master among the Demon Race, and his name was renowned throughout the history of the Demon Race.
But even with such strength, he was still no match for the other party.
He had never heard of such a terrifyingly strong young master before; could it be a hidden master?
Impossible!
If it were a hidden master, why would they venture out here?
In this world, there were many hidden young masters, and their Realms were not inferior to his, but why had he never seen them?
“That man is extremely handsome, with a pair of purple eyes that are very captivating!” the man hastily said, “Furthermore, he is dressed in black and carries a sword on his back. His strength is unfathomable, at least on par with the Demon Emperor himself!”
“What? He is a disciple of the Demon Emperor? If he is the Demon Emperor’s disciple, why would your Demon Race attack him?” the Demon Emperor asked, shocked; his body shivered.
The Demon Emperor!
This was a legendary figure, the founder of the Demon Race, the progenitor of the Demon Race.
If this man was really the Demon Emperor’s disciple, wouldn’t his strength be against the heavens?
“We don’t know either!” the man shook his head helplessly, “This person is very odd, it seems he has never left the Demon Race’s cave, but he can come and go freely within the Demon Race’s stronghold.”
“And it seems he has many subordinates, each of them no weaker than me!”
“If we do not unite, we simply can’t match him!”
Having said that, the Demon Race expert stood in place, waiting for the Demon Emperor’s command.
“Contact the other members of our race; I want everyone to join this battle and then annihilate this youngster in one fell swoop!” the Demon Emperor took a deep breath, suddenly looked up towards the distance, his eyes flashing with determination and resolve.
The expert hesitated for a moment, although his relationship with the Demon Emperor was decent, he could even say that he owed him a life-saving debt.
But now their strength was not strong enough, it was not advisable to go into battle, and this young man was clearly their enemy of life and death!
This enemy’s strength was far too great, they were not at all a match for him.
“What, are you afraid?” the Demon Emperor narrowed his eyes slightly, scanning the Demon Race below Demon Emperor Mountain, and shouted solemnly.
The Demon Race expert immediately knelt on one knee, roaring with a loud voice, “Demon Emperor, your subordinate is willing to lead all of our people and the Demon Emperor Palace to resist humanity!”
“Very good, your performance is commendable, you shall stay and continue to serve as the gatekeeper of Demon Emperor Mountain!” the Demon Emperor laughed heartily.
“Yes!” the Demon Race expert nodded again.
Being a gatekeeper of Demon Emperor Mountain was the most dangerous job, but it was also the safest profession; if one could survive, there was a chance to become a member of the Demon Race, and if one died, they would turn to ashes.
“Hahaha…” the Demon Emperor laughed loudly, his laughter full of endless self-confidence.
Now that he had the help of these members of the Demon Race, he believed he would surely win this time.
“Demon Emperor, your strength has reached the Peak of the Early Stage of the Demon Emperor Realm; our men are all at the strength level of half-step Immortal Emperors. This time, I expect that there will be very few experts from the Demon Emperor Palace,” the Demon Race expert said.
“Hmph, no matter how many come, as long as they dare to show up, they will all be annihilated, without leaving a single survivor!” the Demon Emperor snorted coldly, his eyes flickering with ferocity and murderous intent.
“Yes, I’ll go and relay the order immediately!” the Demon Race expert nodded and stepped back, turning to rush towards the valley outside of the Demon Race.
Lin Yi stood outside the cave, a faint murderous intent flickering in his eyes.
He knew that he had to make a breakthrough as soon as possible. Only by ascending to the Holy King level could he truly control his own life. At that point, even when facing immortals, he wouldn’t need to be afraid.
“Hmph, Demon Race, before long, I will trample down the Demon Race and decimate all your masters!” Lin Yi growled low, then headed toward the cave.
…
On the other side of Demon Emperor Mountain, after Lin Yi entered, he headed straight for the valley of the Demon Race, moving very quickly.
A few members of the Demon Race followed beside him, each with a look of wariness, fear, and awe in their eyes, because Lin Yi gave them an unfathomable impression, someone they could only look up to.
Lin Yi was very close to the valley, not far from Demon Emperor Mountain.
He stood at the entrance of the valley and didn’t rashly enter it. Instead, he stood quietly—for he wanted all the Demon Race masters from the Demon Emperor Palace to appear!
A faint cold smile crossed Lin Yi’s lips; he didn’t believe the Demon Race masters from the Demon Emperor Palace would be so foolish as to show themselves all at once in front of him.
After all, the Demon Emperor Palace is the sacred place of the Demon Race. They certainly wouldn’t want their masters to be killed by Lin Yi, so they definitely would have made other arrangements.
Moreover, this is Demon Emperor Mountain, a forbidden area for the Demon Race. The masters of the Demon Race wouldn’t show up just like that. There are formations in place, and they definitely wouldn’t dare come in rashly, but rather they would have set up many formations around the outskirts. As soon as someone entered, they would be detected, and the Demon Race masters could arrive quickly.
As expected, Lin Yi waited at the entrance of the valley for two to three hours, and finally saw batch after batch of Demon Race masters coming in.
The one leading them was the Demon Emperor himself.
Lin Yi slightly raised an eyebrow; he recognized this Demon Emperor. Of course, he didn’t take this Demon Emperor seriously, but the few people beside the Demon Emperor made him feel an inexplicable sense of oppression.
These four individuals were all trusted subordinates of the Demon Emperor, each one exceeding the Immortal Emperor in strength. This power was enough to crush any Immortal Emperor of the Demon Race!
This was the true strength of the Demon Emperor Palace!
“Hahaha… boy, I bet you didn’t expect this. The Demon Emperor is already here. Are you prepared to surrender yourself? Maybe I will consider sparing your life!” the Demon Emperor shouted loudly, his voice filled with arrogance.
The Demon Race masters standing beside the Demon Emperor also taunted Lin Yi loudly:
“Boy, weren’t you arrogant? Why don’t you keep that arrogance going?”
“Hehe… boy, you’re afraid to die now, aren’t you?”
“Let me tell you! Even if you ran away, you couldn’t escape from Demon Emperor Mountain. You might as well surrender obediently!”
“I advise you not to resist in vain. Our Demon Emperor won’t kill you, but our Demon Race’s masters will not be merciful!”
“I advise you, just give up your resistance!”
A group of Demon Race masters relentlessly mocked Lin Yi, seeming to have found a target to vent their frustrations.
Once the members of the Demon Race found a target to vent on, they would mock the other party without restraint, even killing them directly to relieve their anger and feel satisfaction!
“Oh really? Well, you all can try!” Lin Yi suddenly spoke up.
“You… what did you say?” One of the Demon Race masters changed his face drastically.
“I said, if the masters of the Demon Race are so brave, then come at me!” Lin Yi said coldly.
At these words, the Demon Race masters were all dumbfounded, completely clueless about Lin Yi’s intentions. What was he planning to do?
Was Lin Yi offering himself up on a silver platter, or was he courting death?

chapters.title: Chapter 662: Ruthless and Merciless
chapters.content:
Chapter 662: Chapter 662: Ruthless and Merciless
“Heh heh… truly seeking death!”
“Since that’s the case, don’t blame us for being ruthless!” the Demon Emperor coldly snorted, “Take down that brat for me!”
“At your command, Lord Demon Emperor!” a group of experts of the Demon Race shouted loudly.
In an instant, dozens of experts from the Demon Race surged forward, enveloping Lin Yi.
However, at this moment, Lin Yi suddenly disappeared and reappeared behind one of the experts of the Demon Race.
Just as this expert of the Demon Race was about to turn around, he felt a pain in his neck, his eyes widened, then he collapsed to the ground, dead as dead can be!
Lin Yi then indifferently cleaned up the aftermath; although these experts of the Demon Race were formidable, they were no match for him.
Without the Demon Race experts noticing, Lin Yi smashed their heads with a punch, then collected their corpses into his Spatial Ring.
Lin Yi’s figure flickered rapidly, flying towards a valley in the mountains of the Demon Race.
Before long, Lin Yi saw that the valley was filled with experts of the Demon Race; they numbered more than two hundred, each exuding a powerful aura.
“These members of the Demon Race are very powerful; it seems that if I kill these experts, my deterrence in the Demon Emperor Palace will greatly increase as well.”
“However, I need to first see which of these members of the Demon Race has the strongest power? If their strengths are similar, then I’ll finish them all in one go, slaughtering them all!”
Lin Yi murmured to himself.
Next, Lin Yi went on a killing spree, with incredible speed. Every punch he threw resulted in a swath of Demon Race experts being killed and devoured.
In just ten minutes, he had already killed nearly two thousand Demon Race experts. Yet none of the experts had noticed that Lin Yi had already reached their rear, and many were even talking to Lin Yi.
“Great Elder, I think this kid has gone mad; he’s actually come to kill us directly, totally oblivious to life and death!”
“Hmph! He’s courting death. Once our lord arrives, it will be his end. I think he must have known that this is the Demon Emperor Palace, and that’s why he dared to barge in so recklessly!”
“Right! Great Elder, do you think this kid can match our lord? Our lord’s power is not just as simple as this!”
“Hahahaha… Is that even a question? Our lord possesses combat power surpassing that of an Immortal Emperor. How can this brat with such a weak realm be our lord’s opponent?”
“Hehe… once the lord captures him, I’ll torment him properly before letting the lord personally take action, tearing this brat’s flesh into pieces and throwing it into the ocean to feed the fish!”
The experts of the Demon Race were all chattering away, as if they had already foreseen Lin Yi’s grim fate and viewed the scene of Lin Yi’s death.
Lin Yi’s expression, meanwhile, grew darker and darker; he had not expected the experts of the Demon Race to be so confident.
He was now at the realm of the Ninefold Heaven of the Immortal Emperor; these experts of the Demon Race had at most the strength of around the Sixth or Seventh Layer of the Immortal Venerable, not qualified to battle him at all.
But Lin Yi would not kill them; he needed to use them to attract the attention of the Demon Emperor, to have the Demon Emperor come to him!
“Lin Yi, today we’ll capture you, letting our lord personally deal with you, to peel off your skin and then throw you into the ocean!”
“Not only is this brat not afraid of us, but he also dares to provoke us; he’s really tired of living!”
The experts of the Demon Race talked and laughed, all feeling certain that Lin Yi was doomed today.
“Lin Yi, I advise you to join our Demon Race. Your reputation on the Tianyuan Continent is considerable, and I believe the experts of the Demon Race will surely reward you handsomely!”
“If you leave now, we can still save you some face!”
“Otherwise, you have nothing but a dead end!”
“Listen to me, if I die, you’ll all be dead for sure. I’ll hang your heads on the trees and let all the experts of the Demon Race know just what kind of trash you are!” Lin Yi suddenly turned his head, staring at these Demon Race experts and shouted loudly.
In an instant, the eyes of all the Demon Race experts were filled with furious flames, as they had never been humiliated like this before!
“Boy, do you really think we of the Demon Race dare not kill you?!”
“Kid, today you must die!”
“I’ll skin you alive and pull out your tendons!”
The Demon Race experts roared loudly, one after another, their momentum ferocious.
“If that’s the case, then come at me together!”
“Come on, all of you!” Lin Yi sneered, his figure flashing as he disappeared from the spot once more.
Lin Yi was simply too fast, these Demon Race experts could not catch even a glimpse of his figure.
When Lin Yi reappeared, he was already above the heads of the Demon Race experts. He swung down a punch that directly hit the head of one.
That person didn’t even have a chance to dodge and was instantly killed by Lin Yi’s punch, his head bursting open with blood and brain matter splattering everywhere, his entire skull and brains being flung outward.
Lin Yi’s speed was just too fast, and his punches were incredibly precise, instantly bursting a person’s head with a single blow.
Immediately afterward, Lin Yi continued his assault, successively killing three to five Demon Race experts.
The remaining Demon Race experts’ expressions drastically changed. They all knew how formidable Lin Yi was; with three to four hundred of them dead in a blink, how could they not be afraid?
“Damn human, you dare to kill our Demon Race. Your sin is unforgivable, and even dying ten thousand times would not be too harsh!”
“Everyone, together now, kill him and avenge our brothers!” A leading figure of the Demon Race, a big man, stepped forward.
Instantly, the remaining dozen or so Demon Race experts all rushed at Lin Yi, attacking while roaring loudly, “All of you, attack! Kill this human, kill this human and we’ll have accomplished a great feat. We’ll have a chance to be admitted into the Demon Emperor Palace!”
Upon hearing this, the eyes of the Demon Race experts lit up, their pupils turning red with excitement!
They were all from the Demon Race, lofty beings. How could they not covet the opportunity to be admitted into the Demon Emperor Palace?
Moreover, the temptation of the Demon Emperor Palace for these ordinary Demon Race experts was too great. This time, they had to capture Lin Yi and refine him, forcing him to submit completely at their feet.
“Dammit!” Lin Yi cursed, these cultivators of the Demon Race were truly shameless beasts! They actually wanted to capture him and offer him to the Demon Emperor, an unforgivable act.
In that same second, Lin Yi dodged, his figure flashing as he evaded the attacks of these Demon Race experts. His speed was ever-increasing, and in the blink of an eye, Lin Yi appeared beside another person, his fist smashing out and hitting directly on the person’s chest!
The power of Lin Yi’s punch was terrifying, the person didn’t even have a chance to resist and was directly crushed to pieces, blood and flesh flying everywhere, a gruesome sight to behold!
The remaining Demon Race experts were shocked, each one’s expression drastically changing. With three to four experts dead in just an encounter, how could they not be astonished?
“Damn it, everyone, attack together!” A leading Demon Race figure shouted.
Suddenly, the remaining Demon Race experts took action, each of them exerting their utmost abilities, attacking Lin Yi madly.
