Although Lin Yi was formidable, he was after all one person. Moreover, he did not possess any special Cultivation Techniques and could only rely on his physical body to fight hard. He found it difficult to defend against so many.
For a time, Lin Yi was at an absolute disadvantage, suffering blows on all sides.
If this continued, Lin Yi would eventually be defeated, and that would spell trouble!

chapters.title: Chapter 663: The Humans Who Haven't Been Weaned Yet
chapters.content:
Chapter 663: Chapter 663: The Humans Who Haven’t Been Weaned Yet
“Kid, you might as well give up already, you can’t beat us. Our Demon Race has a history of over thirty million years, with profound depths of strength. How could someone as inexperienced as you even compare?”
“If you know what’s good for you, you’ll surrender quietly, and perhaps we’ll spare your life!”
“Otherwise, we’ll have no choice but to eradicate you!”
The leader of the Demon Race coldly stated, his eyes brimming with mockery.
“Heh… Thirty million years? Thirty million years ago you were all just a bunch of newborn babies!”
“And now, you’re nothing more than dogs of the Demon Race. I truly don’t understand where you get the courage. This is Demon territory, Humans can’t just come and go as they please!”
“If you wanted to capture me, you should have done it outside the city gates, right? And yet you run into the city to kill me, isn’t that utterly stupid? Isn’t that seeking death?”
“Also, do you really think this is the Demon Realm? This is Demon City. You cause trouble here, aren’t you afraid of the Demon Beasts inside coming out? When that happens, you won’t even know how you’re going to die!”
“Hmph! Enough talk, we are here to capture you, I am here to kill you, and whoever dares to stop me will die!”
The male leader of the Demon Race’s face darkened instantly as he bellowed loudly.
The next second, Lin Yi suddenly laughed, “Really? Then I would like to see what you’re capable of!”
With those words, Lin Yi’s body flickered with light, and the next second he disappeared, only to reappear behind the leader of the Demon Race.
The man was shocked, his speed was fast, but he had not anticipated that Lin Yi’s speed would be even faster.
“Lin Yi, I’m going all out, you won’t think of capturing my brother!” The man roared loudly, then suddenly lunged at Lin Yi, trying to break Lin Yi’s shoulder and break free from Lin Yi’s grip.
“Heh…” Lin Yi let out a cold laugh and suddenly struck the man’s back with his palm. Instantly, the male leader of the Demon Race turned pale, spewing a mouthful of fresh blood, staggering almost to the point of falling to the ground.
“How… how is this possible?” The man looked at Lin Yi, his face filled with shock, asking in disbelief.
Lin Yi’s skills were so good that he had defeated him with just one move?
Yet Lin Yi sneered, “How is it impossible? No matter if you are a skilled fighter of the Demon Race or a genius of the Human Clan, today I will capture you and present you to the Demon Emperor himself for judgment, to have you die by His Majesty’s hands!”
As he spoke, Lin Yi’s hands shot up, then thick black fog swirled around both hands.
The dense black fog took shape in the air, and the phantom of a huge black bat appeared on Lin Yi’s arms.
Lin Yi jerked violently, and the phantom of the black bat flew towards the Demon Race expert in the distance.
The phantom of the black bat was incredibly fast, reaching the face of the Demon Race expert in a blink of an eye, then viciously biting into the man’s neck!
“Aowu!”
The Demon Race expert emitted a miserable cry as Lin Yi tore his body apart. This kind of tearing pain was excruciatingly unbearable.
The Demon Race’s bodies were frightfully strong, but their bones were fatally weak.
This painful stimulus nearly made the Demon Race expert faint.
“You wanted to kill me, didn’t you? Come on then!”
Lin Yi stood at a distance, looking at the Demon Race expert torn in two, sneering coldly.
Lin Yi’s gaze was filled with icy disdain as he spoke, considering the Demon Race expert no different from an ant, something he could crush at will.
The body of the Demon Race expert was completely shattered, leaving only a head, his face full of rage and despair!
He never imagined he would die at the hands of such a young member of the Human Clan!
Lin Yi’s strength was beyond imagination, not only incredibly formidable but also possessing such bizarre Martial Arts, he was practically a monster!
“You… you will not die well, I will not let you go!” the devoured expert of the Demon Race roared loudly.
“Heh heh… Do all of your Demon Race like to curse others? You are all a bunch of despicable and shameless rats, you do not deserve to live in this world, so, there is only one outcome for you, and that is death!”
Lin Yi sneered coldly, his eyes filled with an icy, heartless glow.
As he spoke, Lin Yi suddenly made his move. His fists fell like raindrops, with black lightning flashing continuously around them, the crackling sound causing one’s heart to tremble.
“No… please… don’t…” The lead expert of the Demon Race finally became afraid, his eyes wide open and filled with fear.
He had never encountered such a powerful human. Lin Yi’s fists were like a meat grinder; in just a moment, the leading male of the Demon Race was killed under Lin Yi’s fists.
This scene was truly shocking. After all, Lin Yi was just an early-stage Martial Cultivator with Divine Skills!
It was incredible that he killed an expert of the Demon Race in the later stages of Divine Skills with just one punch!
“This… how is this possible, Young Master Ye, how did you do this?”
“How can your strength be so great? Could it be that you’ve been hiding your true power?”
“No… no… You must have used some kind of secret technique to achieve this.”
“Right, it must be so. You certainly have some hidden method. We’ve all fallen into your trap this time, Young Master Ye, please spare us your hands, and let us go!”
“We were wrong, we were wrong, we were wrong…”
The remaining high-ranking experts of the Demon Race looked at Lin Yi with eyes full of fear, knowing that they had encountered a formidable enemy, one they could not stand against!
“You should not have killed my brothers. They were not wrong; the wrong ones are you, the Demon Race!” Lin Yi snorted and then, with a wave of his hand, all of the remaining high-ranking experts of the Demon Race were reduced to ashes.
Lin Yi did not linger and turned to leave.
“Brother Ye, wait for us, we will follow you!”
“Yes! Brother Ye, we will all follow you!”
Lin Yi had barely walked a hundred meters when he heard the shouting of those high-ranking experts of the Demon Race behind him. At that moment, they had truly submitted, wanting to surrender to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi paid them no heed and quickened his pace, speeding towards the south.
……………
On Demon Mountain, in front of several grand halls, the Demon Emperors were discussing something.
At this moment, the Demon Emperor was conversing with a middle-aged man.
“Big brother, this matter is really thorny, do you know how strong that person is?” The face of the Demon Emperor was somewhat somber as he spoke gravely to the middle-aged man.
“Big brother, don’t worry! I will handle this matter properly!” the middle-aged man said with a deep voice.
“Good, that would be best!”
“Big brother, if that is the case, then I shall take my leave first!” The middle-aged man said and was about to leave.
“Hold on!”
Suddenly, the Demon Emperor spoke.
The middle-aged man stopped in his tracks, somewhat puzzled. Didn’t the Demon Emperor want him to investigate this matter? Why had he changed his mind now?
“Big brother, you don’t need to worry about this matter; I have already made arrangements!” the middle-aged man said blandly.
“Oh? What makes you so confident?” the Demon Emperor asked, slightly taken aback.

chapters.title: Chapter 664: Breathing Somewhat Rapidly
chapters.content:
Chapter 664: Chapter 664: Breathing Somewhat Rapidly
“It’s about that human kid; big brother, I believe you will find that human kid very interesting.” The middle-aged man smiled slightly before turning and striding away.
“Who exactly is this kid? Could it be the human girl that brought him back?”
The Demon Emperor muttered to himself, somewhat puzzled, but he quickly shook his head, “Naturally, I can’t get involved in this matter, after all, I’m not familiar with this kid!”
……………
Meanwhile, Lin Yi ran wildly, only stopping after a full day and night to find a desolate place, where he then sat down to meditate.
“Huff huff huff…” At this moment, Lin Yi’s breathing was a bit hurried. The battle he had just fought had drained quite a bit of his True Qi, and he needed time to recover.
“Young Ye, are you okay?” Xuanyuan Sword Soul asked with concern upon seeing Lin Yi’s condition.
“I’m fine, I can handle this level of injury!” Lin Yi shook his head. Although he was exhausted, and even standing was somewhat difficult, he still held strong.
“Since that’s the case, then this young master will help you adjust your breathing!” Xuanyuan Sword Soul chuckled; he was also curious to see just how powerful Lin Yi could become.
Suddenly, Lin Yi felt a powerful surge of True Qi being transmitted into his body, and a warm energy circulated through his limbs and bones.
“Ah, that feels so good!” Lin Yi couldn’t help but moan; he felt extremely comfortable all over.
“Not bad, kid!” Xuanyuan Sword Soul said approvingly after giving Lin Yi a look, “This True Qi has a tremendous effect on you, but don’t be greedy. You need to know when to stop. If you absorb it all, I’m afraid your strength won’t increase any further.”
“Alright, I understand!” Lin Yi took a deep breath and continued to close his eyes and cultivate.
Time passed by, second by second, and in the blink of an eye, three days had gone by!
Lin Yi felt as if there was a force of energy running wildly within his body; he had an extremely comfortable feeling.
“I really didn’t expect that such a short three days would boost my strength so much!”
“If I hadn’t rested, eaten, or slept these three days, I probably could have reached the early stage of the Xuan level!”
“But, this speed and efficiency are still incomparable to before. After all, my True Qi was somewhat lacking in the last three days!”
“However, with the assistance of Xuanyuan Sword Soul, the super Alchemist by my side, I can save a lot of time!”
“I just wonder if that girl will be able to keep up with my pace!”
Lin Yi’s lips curved into a faint smile. The existence of Xuanyuan Sword Soul was undoubtedly an extremely heaven-defying presence.
If Lin Yi were to take Xuanyuan Sword Soul to the Tianyuan Continent, and once his identity was revealed, his status would soar.
After all, the Tianyuan Continent was not like the Immortal Realm, which revered cultivation resources. It was a world where the strong preyed upon the weak, where everything relied on the fists’ might. The so-called supremacy of strength was a universal rule there.
“Young Ye, you’ve really struck it rich this time!”
Xuanyuan Sword Soul laughed heartily, and pride filled his laughter.
“It’s all thanks to you. If it weren’t for your help, I wouldn’t have achieved what I have today!” Lin Yi said with a wry smile.
“Kid, there’s no such thing as a free lunch in this world; you have to pay the price!” Xuanyuan Sword Soul said in a grave tone.
Lin Yi nodded slightly, “I understand that, rest assured, I won’t forget the kindness you’ve shown me!”
Xuanyuan Sword Soul fell silent, comforted somewhat by Lin Yi’s promise.
Just then, Lin Yi’s expression suddenly changed, and his eyes snapped open.
“What’s wrong, Ye lad? Is there danger?” Xuanyuan Sword Soul hurriedly asked.
“Danger? Heh… there’s some trouble, but it’s not yet at the point of threatening our lives!”
“However, I still don’t want to collide with those people, so, the only option is to hide!” Lin Yi said in a deep voice.
“In that case, we should hide inside the spatial tunnel, wait for that group of people to go far away, and then leave the spatial tunnel!” Xuanyuan Sword Soul suggested.
“Hmm, I also think so, but this spatial tunnel should be sealed by a formation, right?”
“Not only is it sealed, but there are also very strong Formation Restrictions, and it’s going to be difficult to break through!”
“However, although the formation is very powerful, it’s not infallible. I can use my connection with the door of space to directly break through!” Lin Yi said in a heavy tone.
“Lad, are you sure you can do it?” Xuanyuan Sword Soul couldn’t help but worry.
“I am the top formation grandmaster in the Tianyuan Continent, such a small matter, is nothing at all!” Lin Yi raised his eyebrows slightly, full of confidence.
Immediately after, Lin Yi’s soul and the connection to the door of space became even more intimate, and Lin Yi’s complexion also became more rosy!
Soon, Lin Yi’s connection to the door of space was completely finished!
“I have opened up the spatial tunnel, lad, let’s hurry up!” Xuanyuan Sword Soul urged.
Lin Yi took a deep breath, then stood up and walked towards the mountain range. After only a few steps,
Lin Yi stopped, then looked towards the distant mountain wall.
“Ye lad, what are you looking at?” Xuanyuan Sword Soul asked curiously, and at the same time, he too looked at the distant mountain wall, but found nothing unusual.
“I’m wondering, why are we trapped here instead of being sent through a Teleportation Formation or by other means!” Lin Yi murmured to himself.
As Lin Yi spoke, he looked towards the distant mountain wall again. Unbeknownst to him, upon closer inspection, he was startled.
There on the distant mountain wall, there was a huge circular formation pattern, and above the formation, there was a massive rock, which was precisely what blocked their path.
“Could it be…” Lin Yi suddenly thought of something.
He remembered, a huge vortex, a dark hole on the large stele, was the Teleportation Formation, just sealed by the formation!
Lin Yi’s gaze flickered uncertainly, his mind filled with thoughts. He felt like he was missing something, but he couldn’t grasp that moment of epiphany.
“Ye lad, what are you thinking about?” Xuanyuan Sword Soul couldn’t help but ask.
“I can’t quite put my finger on it!” Lin Yi shook his head: “Perhaps I’m too tired, my mind is a bit of a mess!”
“You rest for a while, I will help you to investigate if there is anything special about this mountain, and then we will think of a way to get out!” Xuanyuan Sword Soul said in a deep voice.
Lin Yi didn’t waste words, nodded, sat down cross-legged, and then entered the cultivation state.
As the cultivation continued, Lin Yi’s state of mind slowly returned to calm. He knew that in such a situation, as long as he continued to break through and cultivate, he would eventually return to his peak strength.
Meanwhile, that group of people had already reached the foot of the mountain.
“Is this the mountain where those two experts reside?” the young man in blue clothes asked with some excitement.
“Yes! I have seen it with my own eyes!” the burly middle-aged man next to him said in a heavy tone: “There is indeed an expert stationed here!”
“Should we find someone to test them out?” the young man in blue continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 665: Forcing Your Way In Is Seeking Your Own Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 665: Chapter 665: Forcing Your Way In Is Seeking Your Own Death
“No need to probe, I am certain that those two are definitely beyond the Martial King Fifth Layer. If we try to force our way through, it will be a death wish!”
“These two seniors are hermit experts, no matter what we do, it’s impossible to disturb their cultivation, unless we have enough strength!” the burly middle-aged man spoke in a deep voice.
“Should we continue to move forward?” the young man in blue hesitated!
“Let’s keep going! We cannot offend these two formidable people; otherwise, all of us might suffer!” the burly middle-aged man said gravely.
“Yes!” The young man in blue nodded and then continued walking toward the mountain peak.
“Eh, there’s something wrong with this place!” Just as he stepped onto the mountain range, the young man in blue suddenly shouted aloud.
“What’s the problem?” the burly middle-aged man frowned and asked.
“Look, there are so many footprints here!” the young man in blue pointed to a spot and said. There were a number of footprints there, and those footprints were not small!
The burly middle-aged man observed carefully and indeed found some deep footprints. The footprints looked very light, and if one did not examine carefully, they wouldn’t even be noticed.
“Let’s search again carefully, we cannot waste this opportunity; if there are treasures, we will definitely find them!” the burly middle-aged man said with a heavy voice.
So, they started searching again, searching tirelessly until they finally found some clues, and ultimately, their gaze settled on a large rock.
The surface of this large rock was covered with some dust, clearly, it hadn’t been cleaned for many years.
This made everyone a bit puzzled, wondering how Lin Yi could possibly set up a formation here!
However, they did not rush forward but first checked the surrounding environment, ensuring there were no other dangers before they began to cautiously approach and inspect.
“It seems like there is some form of energy fluctuation on this large rock, but what kind of energy could it be?” the burly middle-aged man wondered, staring at the rock, sensing faint traces of energy fluctuation on it.
“It’s a formation!” the young man in blue suddenly said.
“What? A formation?” The complexion of the burly middle-aged man changed drastically, and he exclaimed, “Haven’t we entered into an illusion formation? How could there be a formation here?”
“Have you forgotten the illusionist we encountered earlier?”
“He is an illusionist, not an array master. His use of formations is rather powerful, but the attack power of his formations isn’t that great. If he wanted to harm us, we wouldn’t even have the chance to fight back!” the young man in blue said in a deep voice.
“Are you saying that this formation was created by the illusionist?”
“Yes!” the young man in blue nodded firmly: “I checked carefully just now, and the formation carries no lethality; you could even say it has no attack power at all, just some energy fluctuations. That’s why I said this mountain peak is very strange, and we must be cautious!”
“Hmm, I understand!” the burly middle-aged man took a deep breath, then continued to walk forward.
Soon, they arrived at a valley. The valley wasn’t large, only about five hundred meters in diameter, but it was extremely quiet, so quiet that not even the sound of insects or birds could be heard!
“I sense danger; we must not act recklessly!” the burly middle-aged man spoke gravely.
“Is there really a formation here, and a formidable one at that?” the young man in blue also had a solemn expression.
The two of them cautiously moved forward, walking while carefully inspecting their surroundings, afraid of any oversight!
And just after they left not long ago, Lin Yi suddenly opened his eyes, his gaze deepened as he murmured to himself: “What a powerful formation!”
“Lin Yi, you’re awake!” Just then, Xuanyuan Yuqing’s voice came from the side, followed by Xuanyuan Yuqing walking over, she grabbed Lin Yi’s arm.
“Hmm, I sensed a trace of danger just now, but it’s gone now!” Lin Yi lifted his head slightly and said with a smile, his complexion somewhat pale.
“Lin Yi, were you injured just now?” Xuanyuan Yuqing asked hurriedly.
“It’s nothing. I wasn’t hurt!” Lin Yi smiled and then asked, “How come you’re here?”
“We were waiting for you!” Yu Qing looked at Lin Yi and suddenly said.
“Waiting for me?” Lin Yi was puzzled.
“Lin Yi, we ran into some danger on the hilltop just now, so we decided to wait for you here. If there’s any danger, you could help us. After all, the two of us are not good at fighting. In case of any danger, we would still need you to rescue us!”
“I see!” Lin Yi suddenly realized and then said, “Let’s go then!”
As Lin Yi spoke, he led Yu Qing towards the front, while at this time, the young man in blue stood with his group in the distance, his gaze burning with intensity as he watched Lin Yi.
Lin Yi moved slowly, his face still pale, but he was calm, with an indifferent air about him.
Step by step, Lin Yi drew closer until he was only three to four hundred meters away from the burly middle-aged men and the others.
The corner of the young man in blue’s mouth curled into a cold smile before he said, “We’ve finally waited for you, kid. Let’s see how long you can last!”
After speaking, a glint of greed flashed in his eyes. With a wave of his arm, he led more than ten people, himself included, charging towards Lin Yi, their eyes full of greed.
“Hmph!” With a snort, Lin Yi’s figure flashed. In the next second, he disappeared, and when he reappeared, he was already behind the burly middle-aged man.
“Not good…” The burly middle-aged man was shocked as he turned and threw a punch behind him while bellowing, “Get lost!”
“Bang!”
As his fist smashed out, space itself vibrated; visibly, the space was shattered by the punch, forming a pitch-black fissure.
However, at the moment Lin Yi’s fist collided with it, he was actually sent flying, blood spraying from his mouth as he fell heavily to the ground, landing in a complete mess!
Lin Yi actually blocked the other man’s punch!
Lin Yi actually blocked the other man’s punch!
How was that possible? The other person was a Martial Artist at the Peak of Primordial Yang!
Lin Yi was only at the Early Stage of Primordial Yang, and the other person’s cultivation was a whole rank higher than Lin Yi’s. How could it be blocked by Lin Yi?
“Who… who exactly are you?” The burly middle-aged man stared at Lin Yi, his face ugly with confusion. Lin Yi’s strength was too strong, unbelievably so, like a dragon among men. But this dragon seemed to be merely a snake, and not a real dragon.
“Take a guess?” Lin Yi chuckled.
“You… such an arrogant brat!” The burly middle-aged man was furious. He sprang to his feet and said, “Since you’re courting death, then I’ll grant your wish!”
As the burly middle-aged man spoke, his aura climbed higher and higher. His cultivation had reached the Later Stages of Primordial Yang. His speed was incredibly fast, and in the blink of an eye, he was beside Lin Yi.
“Let’s see how you’re going to grant my wish!” Lin Yi laughed heartily. Suddenly, a terrifying pressure erupted from him, and his fist smashed heavily toward the burly middle-aged man’s head.
“Bang!”
One punch hit the burly middle-aged man’s forehead, splattering his brains, killing him so thoroughly there was no coming back.
After that, Lin Yi looked at Xuanyuan Yuqing and the young man in blue, smiled, and said, “You’re not bad, I like you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 666 - 666 Array Plate
chapters.content:
Chapter 666: Chapter 666 Array Plate
Xuanyuan Yuqing and the blue-robed youth’s faces were filled with ecstatic joy, as they had been scared out of their wits just now, for Lin Yi’s power was simply too defying, even if they joined forces, they would probably not be Lin Yi’s match!
And now, Lin Yi could effortlessly annihilate a stalwart middle-aged expert like that.
However, they were not too excited, after all, they knew that they could catch up with Lin Yi so quickly mainly because of this Array Plate. If it were not for this Array Plate, how could Lin Yi have arrived here so quickly?
The effect of this Array Plate was too powerful, almost unbelievable, yet Lin Yi had done it.
“We don’t even know the name of this Array Plate, we just found it to be miraculous, so we collected it!” Xuanyuan Yuqing spoke up.
“Then I will accept it first, from now on, you and Yu Han can hang out with me, from now on, you are my women!” Lin Yi chuckled with a smirk, and then suddenly added, “But rest assured, I won’t treat you badly!”
Blush crept over the cheeks of Xuanyuan Yuqing and the blue-robed youth, although they had known Lin Yi for some time, and their relationship had become very intimate, they still felt somewhat shy.
“You… you rogue, how dare you take advantage of us!” Xuanyuan Yuqing exclaimed with a coy indignation.
“Sister Yuqing, it’s normal for him to want to take advantage of someone as beautiful as you are!” the blue-robed youth said with a smile.
“You… you bastard!” Xuanyuan Yuqing exclaimed, stamping her foot in frustration.
Lin Yi laughed heartily and then said, “Your strengths are not bad, but you are only at the early stages of Primordial Yang, still far off the mark. The resources I provide will definitely allow you to advance rapidly!”
“Really? That’s great!” Xuanyuan Yuqing and the blue-robed youth both rejoiced, “As long as we can advance, we will certainly surpass those old monsters, and we can even have our revenge!”
While speaking, Lin Yi suddenly took out a bottle of Elixirs from his bosom and handed it to them.
“These are Healing Pills that I’ve refined, you two should take them quickly, the most important thing for you now is to enhance your strength!” Lin Yi said seriously.
“Lin Yi, we will surely work hard!” Xuanyuan Yuqing and the blue-robed youth seriously took the Elixirs.
“Mhm, I believe in you!” Lin Yi laughed, “By the way, aren’t there many people who want to cause me trouble?”
“This is what happened, a kid has been chasing after you before, then we went to look for you, but we couldn’t find any news. Later, that person’s sect suddenly appeared, claiming he wanted to challenge you!”
After Xuanyuan Yuqing briefly explained, the blue-robed youth then said, “I want to have a spar with you, I want to win against you!”
“All right, are you ready then? If you are, I will join you for some fun!” Lin Yi said with a smile, and at the same time, his eyes flickered with a thick fighting spirit and confidence.
The blue-robed youth frowned slightly, “Do you have the courage to fight with me?”
“What’s there to be afraid of?” Lin Yi huffed, and suddenly added, “No matter the outcome, from now on, we are brothers!”
“Okay!” the blue-robed youth took a deep breath, “But I won’t hold anything back either!”
The blue-robed youth said this and suddenly vanished from sight in the blink of an eye!
When he reappeared, he was already behind Lin Yi.
The blue-robed youth was emanating a faint gray radiance, moving incredibly fast.
With a lift of his arm, a clump of gray fog emerged in the palm of his hand, this fog vaguely releasing some strange aroma.
This gray fog drifted toward Lin Yi, moving swiftly, and in the blink of an eye, it had reached behind Lin Yi, then stabbed towards Lin Yi’s back!
This gray fog was poisonous, once touched by it, Lin Yi’s skin would rot, and gradually deteriorate and die.
And within the gray fog, there was a kind of deadly poison. Ordinary people would immediately have the poison enter their marrow and then die completely. Lin Yi was no exception.
But Lin Yi was not an ordinary person!
“Lin Yi, be careful, there’s a toxin in the gray fog!” Xuanyuan Yuqing suddenly cried out in alarm. Her voice was loud, seeming to carry a sense of fear, but more so, it was filled with concern and worry.
“Don’t worry!” Lin Yi said with a slight smile, then turned to glance at Xuanyuan Yuqing, “Is everything ready? I’m going to make a breakthrough!”
“A breakthrough?” Xuanyuan Yuqing narrowed her eyes slightly as if she had realized something.
“Lin Yi, are you going to make a breakthrough right now? Don’t you need to prepare?” Xuanyuan Yuqing asked.
“Your things are all here, you help me guard, I’ll make my breakthrough here, and no one will be able to disturb me!” While speaking, Lin Yi threw the Space Ring to Xuanyuan Yuqing and the blue-clothed youth. Then Lin Yi sat down cross-legged and began to circulate the True Qi within his body.
Lin Yi’s current realm was at the early stage peak of Primordial Yang, just half a step away from the later stages!
Lin Yi was at the strength of the Primordial Yin period, and moreover, his strength in the Primordial Yin period had just stepped into the Primordial Yang period. Hence, Lin Yi’s combat power was not very overwhelming; and now, Lin Yi needed to use the bloodline power of Xuanyuan Yuqing to allow himself to advance.
Of course, if he could further improve Lin Yi’s strength, he naturally would be even happier!
Right then, Lin Yi closed his eyes and began to cultivate.
Xuanyuan Yuqing and the blue-clothed youth looked towards Lin Yi with faces full of worry, involuntarily clenching their fists, hoping that Lin Yi could break through smoothly.
As time passed by, Xuanyuan Yuqing and the blue-clothed youth didn’t utter a word. They just stood not far from Lin Yi, watching him cultivate there.
They were very worried about Lin Yi making a breakthrough here.
However, since Lin Yi had spoken thus, they were at ease, after all, Lin Yi was a mythical venerable, even on the Xianwu Continent, he was considered among the top masters!
The moment Lin Yi closed his eyes to cultivate, countless Primordial Crystals flew out quickly around him.
All these Primordial Crystals were the innards and flesh of Primordial Yang period Demon Beasts, up to several hundred in number, and all of them were of not low quality!
These Primordial Crystals were condensed out of True Qi by Lin Yi, a so-called Void Transformation, as long as Lin Yi’s mind willed it, these Primordial Crystals would directly vanish into the air, not arising a bit of attention from others.
“These Primordial Crystals, they should be enough for my breakthrough to the later stages of Primordial Yang, right?” Lin Yi murmured to himself.
As Lin Yi’s mind controlled them, the surrounding Primordial Crystals seemed to come alive, heading straight for Lin Yi’s body!
The Primordial Crystals continuously entered Lin Yi’s body, and his aura rapidly increased, quickly reaching the early stages of Primordial Yang!
Lin Yi continued to run the Primordial Energy in his body, incessantly striking against the barrier of the later stages of Primordial Yang.
Time and again, Lin Yi’s pace quickened.
At last!
“Later stages of Primordial Yang peak!” Lin Yi opened his eyes with a fierce combat readiness in them. He could clearly feel that the True Qi inside his body was much more abundant than before, and his Nascent Soul was also much clearer.
“Kid, your speed is quite fast indeed,” Xuanyuan Yuqing’s voice came through just then.
“You’re not weak, reaching the later stages of Primordial Yang so quickly!” Lin Yi paused briefly before he complimented.

chapters.title: Chapter 667: Wait and See!
chapters.content:
Chapter 667: Chapter 667: Wait and See!
“Of course, who do you think I am? I am none other than Xuanyuan Yuqing, the most outstanding prodigy of the Xuanyuan Clan. You’d better take good care of me in the future! If you dare to bully me now, I’ll tell my father and have you captured and taught a lesson!” Xuanyuan Yuqing pouted.
“Hahaha… All right! We’ll just have to see about that!”
“I want to see just how powerful you’ve become!”
“My power might soon surpass yours, and it may even surpass that of your ancestors!”
Lin Yi laughed heartily, and then suddenly embraced Xuanyuan Yuqing, pulling her into his arms and planting a kiss on her red lips.
“Mmmhmm…” Xuanyuan Yuqing was stunned at first, then she struggled, but soon she stopped resisting and became completely immersed in Lin Yi’s embrace!
It was a long while before they parted lips.
By then, Xuanyuan Yuqing’s lips were swollen and still damp with Lin Yi’s saliva.
“Yuqing, you taste absolutely delicious, I’m so in love with you!” Lin Yi said with a smile, “Let’s continue, I’m breaking through right now!”
“Mhm, okay!” Xuanyuan Yuqing nodded shyly. Although she liked Lin Yi, being kissed by him still made her terribly embarrassed.
“Break through!” Xuanyuan Yuqing gently stepped back to give Lin Yi enough space!
Afterward.
Lin Yi took a deep breath, adjusted his mindset, and continued to operate his cultivation technique, voraciously devouring those Primordial Crystal Stones.
Lin Yi was crazily absorbing these Primordial Crystal Stones, and before long, he had completely absorbed them!
At that moment, Lin Yi’s body was radiating golden light, making him resemble a Buddhist deity, exuding a holy aura.
A faint white halo was swirling around Lin Yi’s face.
Lin Yi’s face was sharply defined, with a high and straight nose and very sensual lips that made one unable to resist the urge to bite.
The Lin Yi of that moment seemed mysterious and powerful, untouchable, inviolable, and absolutely majestic.
Xuanyuan Yuqing watched Lin Yi, captivated, her heart racing faster and her cheeks burning hot!
“What do you think? Am I handsome?” Lin Yi suddenly looked up, gazing deeply at Xuanyuan Yuqing with a mischievous smile.
“Young Master Lin, I love you!” Xuanyuan Yuqing’s cheek flushed a deep red, then she abruptly declared four words.
“Ah… What did you just say?” Lin Yi was startled, then he excitedly asked.
“I said I love you. You’re my boyfriend, so of course I should love you!” Xuanyuan Yuqing spoke earnestly.
“Haha… That’s wonderful, I’ve finally heard you call me your boyfriend. From now on, you are my girlfriend, and I will protect you well!” Lin Yi was overjoyed, holding Xuanyuan Yuqing tightly, his excitement boundless.
“Mhmm, I know!” Xuanyuan Yuqing nodded sweetly, radiating happiness on her cheeks.
“By the way, Yuqing, once I finish cultivating, I’ll take you to meet my family. My parents have always hoped that I’d bring a girl home soon, it’s just that you’ve always refused to agree!” Lin Yi said excitedly.
“Ah? This…” Xuanyuan Yuqing’s face turned slightly red, with some hesitation, after all, it was her first time interacting intimately with the opposite sex.
“Don’t worry, my parents really like you, they will definitely agree to our marriage,” Lin Yi said with utter conviction before lowering his head and added softly, “Actually, I like you too. You’re so beautiful and have such a great figure. To be your boyfriend, I’m one hundred and twenty percent willing, it’s just that I….”
“It’s just that you’re afraid others will laugh at us, right?” Xuanyuan Yuqing asked softly.
“Yes,” Lin Yi nodded.
Xuanyuan Yuqing suddenly laughed, saying, “Silly, we haven’t done anything wrong, why should we care about others laughing at us? And if anyone dares to laugh at me, then I’ll punch their teeth out, letting them learn why the flower is so red!”
“Haha, you’re right. You are the princess of the Xuanyuan Clan, and you’re my girlfriend, Lin Yi. Anyone who dares to mock you, I’ll make sure they regret it!” Lin Yi said with a heroic spirit.
“Alright, since you want to cultivate, then let’s cultivate together. That will increase our efficiency a lot,” Xuanyuan Yuqing proposed with a smile.
“Yes!” Lin Yi nodded emphatically.
The two sat down cross-legged on the ground and began to circulate their cultivation technique.
This technique was known as the Nine Dragons Xuantian Technique, a supremely terrifying martial arts technique, rumored to have been created by an unparalleled powerhouse from ancient times. The power was immense and, most crucially, the difficulty in cultivating it was very high!
No one in the history of the Xuanyuan Clan had ever succeeded in mastering it, as it was a dual cultivation technique that required both cultivators to have matching body constitutions. A slight mismatch could lead to the failure of the technique, and in severe cases, even bodily explosion and death!
Lin Yi and Xuanyuan Yuqing both had cultivated the Xuanyuan Clan’s dual cultivation technique, their body constitutions complemented each other perfectly. Thus, when they practiced the Nine Dragons Xuantian Technique, there was no need to worry about any issues or adverse reactions!
The two immersed themselves wholeheartedly in the cultivation, with Lin Yi’s realm climbing rapidly. Xuanyuan Yuqing’s realm was also surging upward swiftly, breaking through to the peak of the Seventh Rank of martial master, then to the Sixth Rank of Martial Ancestor, the Fifth Rank of Martial Sovereign, and the Third Rank of Martial King!
In just one day, Lin Yi had cultivated the dual cultivation technique up to the Eighth Layer!
The Ninth Level!
Lin Yi’s realm had now reached the peak of the Sixth Rank of martial master!
At that moment, Lin Yi stopped cultivating and opened his eyes!
“Lin Yi, do you feel like your body is filled with an endless surge of power now?” Xuanyuan Yuqing suddenly asked.
“Yes, this feeling is simply too amazing, I’ve never felt this great before!” Lin Yi laughed heartily.
Lin Yi’s current condition was much stronger than before. There was limitless energy contained within him, a kind of power that seemed capable of destroying everything, making people instinctively fear and hesitate to come close.
“My cultivation has also improved somewhat,” Xuanyuan Yuqing also said in surprise.
“Haha, yes, your cultivation has advanced to the Martial King Realm, and my realm has also risen to the First Rank of a Martial King. I think, during this period, we should be able to defeat Martial Sovereigns!” Lin Yi said, laughing.
Lin Yi’s realm had now reached the Ninth Rank of the Martial King Realm, and Xuanyuan Yuqing had also broken through to the Seventh Rank of a Martial King. With this progress, even if they encountered a Martial Venerable Realm powerhouse, Lin Yi and Xuanyuan Yuqing now had the resources to contend with them.
“Yes, we must work hard on our cultivation during this time,” Xuanyuan Yuqing nodded.
“Me too, I want to become stronger, to protect you, to make sure no one can bully you ever again!” Lin Yi clenched his fist, speaking resolutely.
“I believe that as long as we keep cultivating diligently, one day, we will become even more powerful!” Xuanyuan Yuqing declared.

chapters.title: Chapter 668 - 668 Face Turns Incredibly Weird
chapters.content:
Chapter 668: Chapter 668 Face Turns Incredibly Weird
“Mm!” Lin Yi nodded again.
After chatting for a while, Xuanyuan Yuqing suddenly thought of something and hurriedly asked, “Lin Yi, did you encounter the demon beast while you were out gaining experience? And, did you come across the Demon Beast King?”
Lin Yi shook his head upon hearing this and said, “It wasn’t me who encountered it; I found you in a cave.”
“A cave? What cave? I don’t remember us ever going to any cave!” Xuanyuan Yuqing said with confusion.
“That cave, it must have been where the Demon Beast King was hiding,” Lin Yi said.
“So it was the lair of the Demon Beast King, no wonder I couldn’t find that place.”
“I still don’t know, how exactly did you run into the Demon Beast King, and what was its strength?” Xuanyuan Yuqing continued to press.
She really didn’t believe that the Demon Beast King would arbitrarily pick on her, a human.
Lin Yi fell silent for a moment, then said, “The strength of the Demon Beast King should be at the peak of the Holy Level.”
“Holy Level peak?! You actually fought with a Holy Level peak?” Xuanyuan Yuqing exclaimed.
Lin Yi nodded with a smile and said, “Yes, that’s why I ran away, but in the end I was almost killed by the Demon Beast King in pursuit. Luckily, I had some good fortune and was rescued by an elder, who even sent the elder back, and together they managed to slay the Demon Beast King!”
“So that’s what happened!” Xuanyuan Yuqing suddenly realized after hearing Lin Yi’s recount of the Demon Beast King’s deeds.
That’s when both of them fell silent.
“Right, how did you turn into a fox again?” Xuanyuan Yuqing suddenly thought of an important matter and asked Lin Yi.
Lin Yi gave a bitter smile upon hearing this and said, “Actually, this fox isn’t just any ordinary fox. It is a kind of demon beast, an extremely rare one at that. It possesses strong energy within its body, making it an excellent demon beast for cultivation!”
“But then I ran into the Demon Beast King, and my physique was somewhat similar to that of the fox’s. So, we ended up fighting together. My strength wasn’t enough to contend with the Demon Beast King, so I had to flee. There was nothing I could do; who made me physically weak?”
Listening to Lin Yi’s explanation, Xuanyuan Yuqing’s expression became incredibly strange. She looked at Lin Yi and asked, “Since you have some similarities with the Demon Beast King, your lineage must be quite noble, right? Does your clan’s lineage share some similarities with that of the Fox clan?”
“Indeed, it is so,” Lin Yi admitted, “The degree to which my lineage is close to that of the Fox clan is probably due to our ancestor. This is because my father is the king of the Fox clan!”
“Ah! The king of the Fox clan?” Xuanyuan Yuqing was suddenly stunned.
The king of the Fox clan!
Xuanyuan Yuqing held a pivotal position within the Xuanyuan Clan and could be considered a princess of the clan. She had been exposed to various secrets of the clan since childhood, yet she was not clear about the deeds of the Fox clan, and she had absolutely no impression of the king of the Fox clan!
But now, Lin Yi was telling her that she herself was the king of the Fox clan!
“How could this be?” Xuanyuan Yuqing whispered to herself.
“What’s wrong?” Lin Yi couldn’t help but ask out of curiosity.
“It’s nothing, nothing,” Xuanyuan Yuqing waved her hand and said.
“Oh,” Lin Yi nodded, not speaking any further.
“Don’t worry about my lack of strength. I will improve my power as soon as possible and then come back for you. I hope you can help me during this time to enhance my strength,” Xuanyuan Yuqing said.
Lin Yi agreed without a second thought, “Of course.”
Upon hearing this, Xuanyuan Yuqing revealed a radiant smile.
The two looked at each other and smiled, then sank into silence. For a moment, neither of them spoke.
“Lin Yi, are you still in Demon City?” Xuanyuan Yuqing asked.
“No, I’ve left Demon City already. I want to go back to our Lin Family for a visit,” Lin Yi replied.
Hearing this, Xuanyuan Yuqing asked with some confusion, “Did something happen to the Lin Family?”
“Yes,” Lin Yi nodded and briefly explained the situation of the Lin Family. After listening, Xuanyuan Yuqing couldn’t help but sigh, “So that’s what happened. No wonder you’ve been disappearing all this time. I thought you were avoiding something, but it turns out there was such an issue.”
“Yes, our Lin Family is in a very dangerous situation right now. I want to go back and see if I can help in any way,” Lin Yi said.
Hearing Lin Yi say this, Xuanyuan Yuqing hesitated.
“Don’t worry, my father and a few elders are still holding fort at the Lin Family. It should be fine,” Lin Yi assured, “Besides, I want to know what exactly happened. Could it be that someone is taking advantage of our plight to take over the Lin Family?”
“That doesn’t seem likely,” Xuanyuan Yuqing shook her head and objected.
“Not likely? Why would that be?” Lin Yi asked, bewildered.
“Because I’ve just awakened from the inheritance of the Demon Emperor, and my father has awakened too. They are aware of everything, including the danger we are currently facing, so you don’t need to worry,” Xuanyuan Yuqing said.
“Oh, I see,” Lin Yi nodded, no longer speaking.
Afterward, the two fell into silence.
Before he knew it, Lin Yi had already returned to the entrance of his own cave dwelling, while Xuanyuan Yuqing also returned to hers.
“It’s been a long time since I’ve been back. I really miss it. Regardless, let’s see what’s going on with the family first,” Lin Yi murmured to himself, then walked into his cave dwelling.
Inside the cave dwelling, Lin Ao and the others had already returned.
Seeing everyone gathered there, Lin Yi couldn’t help but ask curiously, “Why have you all come back so early?”
“Because of you!” Lin Ao gave Lin Yi a glare, “Do you even know how many days you’ve been away? We’ve been almost beside ourselves with worry!”
Lin Yi scratched his head and said, “Well, I was in the midst of breaking through in seclusion, so I didn’t notice what was happening outside. I’ve now successfully advanced to the Nascent Soul Stage. I didn’t intend to be away for so long; I just didn’t expect that my seclusion would last this much time, causing you all to worry.”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Ao was a bit shocked and exclaimed, “You’ve already broken through to the Nascent Soul Stage?!”
“Yes,” Lin Yi nodded and said.
“You actually managed to advance from the Golden Core Stage to the Nascent Soul Stage in such a short time. Isn’t the speed of your strength increase a bit too exaggerated?” Lin Ao said.
Lin Yi gave a bitter smile and said, “I didn’t want it this way either, but my path in immortal cultivation has always been challenging, so the improvement of my cultivation tends to slow down.”
After speaking, Lin Yi couldn’t help but feel emotional. If he had such resources back in Lingxu Mountain Range, his cultivation speed would definitely be faster, and perhaps he would have reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage by now.
However, all of that was mere fantasy. In this world, there is no Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Lin Yi didn’t know how far he had walked on the path of immortal cultivation, but he had never given up,
“Sigh…” Lin Ao sighed and said no more.
Seeing Lin Yi like this made everyone feel somewhat sad.
“Lin Yi, have you collected all the items left behind by the Demon Emperor this time?” Lin Ao asked.
Lin Yi nodded in response, “Yes.”
“Good, bring them out for us to take a look,” Lin Ao said.
“Yes,” Lin Yi nodded, then handed over a Storage Ring.

chapters.title: Chapter 669: Feeling a Burst of Joy
chapters.content:
Chapter 669: Chapter 669: Feeling a Burst of Joy
Looking at the storage ring, Lin Ao couldn’t help but feel a surge of joy. He reached out to take the storage ring and then began to meticulously examine it; he checked the storage ring also to see what items were contained within.
After going through everything, Lin Ao opened Lin Yi’s storage ring and saw a mountainous pile of treasures inside, all of which were the Demon Emperor’s legacy.
“Did you collect all these treasures?” Lin Ao exclaimed as he looked at the items inside.
Lin Yi nodded and said, “Mhm.”
“These things, they’re enough for you to use for a lifetime,” Lin Ao said, looking at Lin Yi.
Hearing Lin Ao’s words, Lin Yi couldn’t help but feel startled.
“What, do you think it’s too much?” Lin Ao asked, puzzled by Lin Yi’s reaction.
“No, not at all,” Lin Yi quickly shook his head and said.
“Then why do you look so worried and troubled?” Lin Ao inquired.
“It’s just that I don’t know how to use so many items; my cultivation is only at the Foundation Establishment’s later stages, I can’t possibly use them all up!” Lin Yi explained.
Hearing this, a smile couldn’t help but appear on Lin Ao’s lips, “Are you silly? You can give it all to the Lin Family; you are the only one with such wealth in the Lin Family right now. You are the Lin Family’s pride, and these treasures are extremely valuable assets to the entire Lin Family. You are the hope of the Lin Family now! Naturally, the Lin Family has the right to retain these treasures. You can hand them over to the clan for safekeeping.”
Upon hearing Lin Ao’s words, Lin Yi had a sudden realization.
“Right, how did I not think of that?” Lin Yi slapped his forehead and then called out joyfully.
Seeing Lin Yi’s expression, Lin Ao, Lin Xue’er, and the others couldn’t help but show a hint of helplessness.
“Hahaha.” Lin Yi suddenly laughed, having thought of something, and couldn’t help but ask, “Right, you all have already reached the Shape Transformation Phase now, what about my physical body?”
“Your physical body?” Lin Ao couldn’t help but roll his eyes and said, “Your physical body was destroyed by the Demon Emperor long ago.”
“What? Destroyed?” Lin Yi was shocked.
“You should have thought, with the strength of our ancestral patriarch, would he let you live? That’s absolutely impossible,” Lin Ao stated.
Only then did Lin Yi come to understand and he let out a wry smile.
Lin Yi now had no cultivation at all, and despite possessing a wealth of treasures, they were of no use to him. All he had was a mortal physical body, albeit a powerful one, and nothing else—Lin Yi was keenly aware of this.
“However, even though I have no cultivation, I still possess some combat power,” Lin Yi confidently declared.
Lin Yi felt somewhat relieved that he still had some Divine Skills; otherwise, he really couldn’t imagine what he would become.
What were Lin Yi’s Divine Skills?
His Divine Skill was the power of Divine Sense!
Even though Lin Yi didn’t know the full extent of the uses of Divine Sense, he felt that the power of Divine Sense must be terrifying.
Divine Sense, as the name implies, can detect the weaknesses of an enemy and can even directly attack the opponent. Such power of Divine Sense can definitely be considered a heaven-defying level Divine Skill.
The reason Lin Yi could decimate Demon Beasts and other creatures was precisely because of his formidable Divine Sense.
Although the power of Divine Sense was strong, it couldn’t be used lightly, after all. This Divine Skill could only be used once, and it required immediate recovery after using it to avoid backlash.
Moreover, although the power of Divine Sense is mighty, it also requires a great deal of consumption. Therefore, Lin Yi’s strongest trump card is now his Divine Sense.
Lin Yi is currently a cultivator. His Soul Realm has reached the Divine Splitting Phase. Therefore, Lin Yi’s Soul Power is already equivalent to a cultivator in the Divine Splitting Phase, making him quite formidable. This is also one of the reasons Lin Yi is brimming with confidence.
“Not bad!” After hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Ao nodded, “While you can’t use these Divine Skills, I think they’re more than enough to deal with ordinary cultivators. You can try to apply these skills in other areas, such as Talisman Making, Artifact Refining, and Alchemy.”
Lin Yi nodded upon hearing this, very satisfied with his own Divine Skills.
“Alright, now I will help you store all these items in the Storage Ring. You place these Storage Rings into the Storage Ring, and I will take them back to the family,” said Lin Ao as he proceeded to store the Storage Rings within his own.
“Thank you for your trouble,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“No need for thanks, from now on you are a benefactor of our Lin Family,” Lin Ao said with a smile.
Hearing Lin Ao’s words, Lin Yi nodded with a smile.
…
Lin Yi’s cultivation had been crippled, so now he was just an ordinary cultivator. Lin Yi didn’t know if the Lin Family would still want him, a useless person, but he didn’t care. He already had so much wealth that he could squander it to his heart’s content. He no longer wanted to pursue cultivation. Instead, he intended to enjoy life and live like an ordinary person.
In the following days, Lin Yi quietly stayed within the Lin Family, not wandering around anymore.
But one day, while Lin Yi was cultivating, he suddenly felt a formidable aura rapidly approaching the Lin Family.
Lin Yi immediately stopped cultivating, opened his eyes, and looked towards the entrance of the Lin Family, his pupils suddenly contracting.
“This aura, it’s actually a Nascent Soul master! And not just any, but a high-level expert in the Intermediate Stage!” Lin Yi’s heart was shaken.
What was going on?
Lin Yi was full of confusion.
However, he didn’t hesitate and immediately rushed into the Lin Family hall, and upon entering, he saw a man on the dais.
Lin Yi’s gaze sharpened as he stared at the Nascent Soul Stage expert.
Lin Ao had also sensed the presence of a Nascent Soul Stage expert in the hall, and his expression darkened. He looked at the man in the hall and demanded sternly, “Who are you? Why are you here?”
“You’re Lin Ao!” The Nascent Soul Stage man glanced at Lin Ao and stated, “I am an elder of the Lin Family, sent here to take over the position of Family Head!”
“Lin Family?” Upon hearing this, Lin Ao immediately furrowed his brows, “Why would the Lin Family send you to take over the clan? Are you aware of how many people in our family died at your hand? Do you realize how much trouble it will bring to the Lin Family once the news of these deaths reach them? Do you understand how severe the crime of Lin Yi murdering the clan leader is?”
“I cannot be bothered with all that. I am here under the orders of the Family Head,” said the Nascent Soul Stage expert.
“You!” Angered by these words, Lin Ao gritted his teeth, “Alright, very well. Since you are so obstinate, you can go to hell!”
As he spoke, Lin Ao stretched out his right hand towards the Nascent Soul Stage expert.
Lin Yi knew that Lin Ao was determined to take action against him this time.
Lin Yi hadn’t expected Lin Ao to actually make a move, intending to withdraw from the situation as he didn’t want to get the Lin Family involved in this matter.
But just as he was about to leave, suddenly, Lin Yi noticed Lin Ao seemed to hesitate. He didn’t know what was restraining his actions.
Lin Yi watched for a while and finally discovered the cause. It turned out to be the Nascent Soul Stage expert, holding a piece of paper in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 670: Can't Wrong Him
chapters.content:
Chapter 670: Chapter 670: Can’t Wrong Him
Seeing that piece of paper, Lin Yi knew what it was about.
So it was this.
This paper was a letter written by Lin Yi himself.
“Lin Ao, if you don’t believe it, you can check for yourself,” said the Nascent Soul Stage expert.
Upon hearing this, Lin Ao snorted coldly, took Lin Yi’s letter, opened it, and read it carefully.
“Indeed, it was written by Lin Yi!” Lin Ao’s eyes narrowed after he finished reading, and he snorted coldly, “Lin Yi is indeed the young master of the Lin Family, but I can’t wrong him without reason. I’ll take this letter for now and make a decision later.”
As he spoke, Lin Ao placed Lin Yi’s handwritten letter back into Lin Yi’s storage ring.
The Nascent Soul Stage expert, seeing this, didn’t say anything and turned to leave.
Lin Yi, witnessing this scene, quickly called out to him.
Lin Yi said, “Wait!”
“Lin Yi, what else do you want to do?” The Nascent Soul Stage expert turned back and looked at Lin Yi with a cold tone and a hint of chill in his eyes.
“Nothing, I just wanted to invite you to dine together,” Lin Yi said. “It’s been so long since we’ve met, shouldn’t you have a meal with me before sending me back?”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, the corner of the Nascent Soul Stage expert’s mouth curled into a faint mocking smile. He chuckled coldly, “Dine? Do you think you, a piece of trash, are worthy of dining on my Lin Family’s feast?”
“Heh, even trash is human, do you think everyone is like you, less than even an ordinary person?” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Hmph! I don’t have time to waste on you, an existence as insignificant as an ant. You’re not worthy of my precious time,” said the Nascent Soul Stage expert, who then turned and left directly.
Lin Yi watched the Nascent Soul Stage expert’s departing figure and sneered. He then quickly followed.
However, not far had the two traveled when they encountered Lin Yi’s second uncle coming from the opposite direction.
“Second Uncle!” When Lin Yi saw his second uncle, his face showed a respectful expression.
Lin Yi’s second uncle was surnamed Lin, named Lin Tianyu, and was the second brother of Lin Ao.
“You’re back too? Have you forgotten the task the patriarch gave you? You shouldn’t have come back on your own!” said Lin Tianyu.
Lin Tianyu was also a Nascent Soul early-stage expert, significantly stronger than Lin Ao.
“Father already knows about my ventures outside. He asked me to return to take charge. I dare not defy Father’s will,” explained Lin Yi.
“Father is really confused. This small matter could have been handled by someone else. He insisted on sending you, all because he was worried you would offend the elders,” Lin Tianyu said with a frown. “You too, your current strength is only at the Nascent Soul Stage, and that Nascent Soul Stage expert is at Intermediate Stage. He could crush you easily, you should go back and cultivate behind closed doors, striving to break through to the Golden Core Stage soon. Only then will you have the strength to contend with him.”
“You’re right, Second Uncle. I understand. I’ll return to closed-door cultivation immediately and won’t delay much,” Lin Yi said.
“Good, then you should hurry,” Lin Tianyu said.
“Alright, I’ll take my leave now,” Lin Yi said and then turned and left directly.
“Hmph, what a waste, to believe that person’s words so easily, utterly foolish. But this works out for me, as it won’t ruin our plans,” Lin Tianyu thought to himself with a cold snort as he watched Lin Yi’s retreating figure.
…
Lin Yi returned home, and Lin Ao did not reprimand him but simply instructed him to cultivate behind closed doors and wait to emerge until Lin Yi had broken through to the Golden Core Stage.
And Lin Yi did not let them down, achieving a breakthrough to the Foundation Establishment Stage within a mere three days.
Seeing this, Lin Ao was amazed at Lin Yi’s talent, truly the most outstanding genius of the Lin Family! He hadn’t expected that in just three days, Lin Yi could make such progress; he even suspected Lin Yi of hiding his true power, otherwise, how could he have improved so much in merely three days!
However, he didn’t consider other aspects, he simply felt that Lin Yi’s tremendous strength was his own natural talent, rather than assistance from the Lin Family behind him.
“It seems I still need to find someone to secretly protect Lin Yi, to prevent others from exploiting any weaknesses!” Lin Ao contemplated quietly in his heart.
Lin Ao also had no doubts about the speed of Lin Yi’s cultivation; he did not suspect any covert help from the Lin Family.
After all, he was well aware of his own family’s situation. Although there was a Lin Yi, Lin Yi’s strength was hardly noticeable, and being someone without any foundation or background, why would he care?
Thus, Lin Ao let Lin Yi go out and experience the world, not intervening in his affairs but allowing him to cultivate on his own.
And the results of Lin Yi’s adventures proved that he was a very smart child, not disappointing Lin Ao.
Moreover, in the past few days outside, Lin Yi had impressive achievements, even he himself didn’t know that he had actually killed a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator.
As a result, Lin Yi’s cultivation had also advanced to the early stage of the Nascent Soul Realm, surpassing all his previous levels of cultivation.
At this moment, Lin Yi also developed a deep hatred for the Lin Family.
That night, Lin Yi once again arrived at the valley.
It had already been set with restrictions by Lin Hong, Lin Yi’s father Lin Ao’s father.
Lin Yi stood at the entrance for a long time, took a deep breath, and then knocked on the door.
“Come in!” Lin Hong’s deep voice came from inside the room.
Lin Yi pushed open the door and walked in slowly.
Lin Hong was sitting in a chair drinking tea. Seeing Lin Yi enter the room, he frowned slightly and said, “Who let you in? Haven’t I said that you shouldn’t come to me unless it’s something important?”
Lin Hong clearly had not forgotten the incident that had happened in the ancestral hall during the day and was still holding a grudge.
“I just wanted to see how you were, sir, and to report on recent events within the Lin Family,” Lin Yi said.
“Oh? What matters do you need to report to me?” Lin Hong asked. “What did you do outside?”
“Reporting to father, while I was outside, I encountered a master, who is my mentor. He taught me a secret technique, and I have now reached the Nascent Soul Stage,” Lin Yi said.
Upon hearing this, Lin Hong was also taken aback, not expecting that Lin Yi would have such an experience outside and would learn such a powerful cultivation technique.
“Where did you learn this cultivation technique?” Lin Hong asked, with a touch of envy in his heart.
“A friend of mine passed it on to me,” Lin Yi said.
“Oh? This friend of yours, is it a man or a woman?” Lin Hong asked.
Lin Yi was slightly startled by the question, then answered, “An old man.”
“An old man?” Lin Hong repeated with mild surprise, then asked, “What is the cultivation of your friend?”
Lin Yi shook his head, saying, “I’m not sure about the details.”
“Never mind. Since you’re only at the Foundation Establishment Stage and he has passed on the cultivation technique to you, there must be no mistake. Take care of yourself!” Lin Hong waved his hand and said.
“Father, there’s another matter I would like to discuss with you, hoping you can agree,” Lin Yi continued.
“What is it? Speak,” Lin Hong said, clearly becoming impatient.
“It’s like this,” Lin Yi began, “I want to make my way in the world outside. This trip out was only for the purpose of cultivation, and I won’t be returning. I don’t wish to be disturbed by anyone and hope father can agree.”

chapters.title: Chapter 671 - 671 Send People to Guard
chapters.content:
Chapter 671: Chapter 671 Send People to Guard
“I agree!” Lin Hong nodded and said, “Do whatever you want to do! As long as you don’t cause any trouble, I will absolutely not interfere!”
“Yes, Father!” Lin Yi bowed and responded.
Following that, Lin Yi left the Lin Residence and headed to the outskirts of the city, where he then found an inn to stay in.
After Lin Yi entered the city, Lin Hong had one of the Lin Family elders take Lin Yi away from the family and to a nearby mountain.
This mountain, known as Wanmo Peak, stood at the summit of a large mountain. Formations surrounded it from all sides, capable of withstanding attacks from any cultivator at the Nascent Soul Stage—it was indeed a treasured site.
“The people of the Lin Family are bold indeed, to have built such a place here. Aren’t they afraid of stealth attacks?” an elder remarked.
Lin Hong waved his hand dismissively and said, “They may not be afraid, but I am. They are the foundation of our Lin Family. If they were to be damaged, our Lin Family would have to perish along with them.
That’s why I would never allow such an event to occur! I will assign people to guard this place, and if anyone tries to attack, I will make sure they don’t return!”
“Yes, I understand!” The elder nodded and said.
After instructing about a few other matters, Lin Hong then left.
Lin Yi didn’t idle either and began to cultivate there.
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, you have been here for a while now. Do you know that your grandfather has been in seclusion for over two years? It’s time for you to return.”
While Lin Yi was cultivating, a middle-aged cultivator approached and spoke to him.
Lin Yi opened his eyes and said, “I already know. I’ll talk about it when I return from outside!”
“Hmm, okay then! Take care of yourself!” The middle-aged cultivator said and then left.
Lin Yi continued his cultivation, and time flew by. In the blink of an eye, he had reached the peak of the Fifth Layer of the Nascent Soul Stage.
Lin Yi stopped cultivating and left the inn, heading towards Wanmo Peak.
After searching around Wanmo Peak for many days, Lin Yi finally found Lin Hong’s dwelling place.
Looking at the towering and magnificent mountain range before him, Lin Yi couldn’t help but feel moved. The foundation of the Lin Family was indeed robust; all those who resided on Wanmo Peak were masters at the Nascent Soul Stage.
Just then, Lin Yi suddenly heard sounds coming from afar, growing clearer and clearer.
Lin Yi immediately ran to investigate and found that the sounds were coming from the summit of the mountain, so he dashed up to have a look.
Climbing up the peak, Lin Yi discovered that Lin Hong’s residence was at the highest point of the mountain. Moreover, the courtyard’s gate was locked. Lin Yi tried to open it but was unable to; the lock wouldn’t budge.
“Damn it!”
Lin Yi cursed under his breath and prepared to leave, but just then, he suddenly heard footsteps approaching.
Lin Yi’s expression changed slightly upon hearing the footsteps. He quickly hid and held his breath, watching intently as the footsteps grew closer to him.
After a moment, a middle-aged man dressed in a blue robe appeared in Lin Yi’s sight, and he immediately recognized him—it was his grandfather, Lin Hong.
At that instant, Lin Hong also saw Lin Yi and quickened his pace, soon reaching Lin Yi’s side.
When Lin Hong saw Lin Yi, a look of joy appeared on his face. However, he quickly suppressed the smile and looked at Lin Yi indifferently before saying, “What are you doing here?”
Upon hearing those words, Lin Yi’s face stiffened, and he explained, “I… I was just out for a walk…”
“Out for a walk? Hmph! Don’t think I don’t know, you unfilial son. Is it that you’ve betrayed the Lin Family and are trying to flee, seeking a life of ease on the outside?”
“I haven’t! I’m not that kind of person!”
Lin Yi quickly shook his head in denial, but his eyes flickered, and he couldn’t look directly into Lin Hong’s eyes.
“If you’re not that kind of person, then tell me, why did you come out here? Don’t you know that Wicked Demon Peak is forbidden territory and not to be tread upon lightly?” Lin Hong interrogated.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi inwardly groaned. He hadn’t expected that Lin Hong would have guessed that he would leave the Lin Family.
Lin Yi felt secretly relieved that Lin Hong hadn’t told the family head about this. Otherwise, with his grandfather’s character, once he found out Lin Yi had betrayed the family, he would certainly be severely punished.
However, Lin Yi didn’t dare to tell the truth now, so he said, “Grandfather… I really didn’t know. One night, I saw it by accident. I thought it seemed like fun and wanted to give it a try. Only when I reached Wicked Demon Peak did I discover that the Formation there was formidable. I couldn’t just force my way through, so I could only retreat.”
“Is that really so?” Lin Hong huffed coldly, obviously not believing him.
Seeing this, Lin Yi grew anxious and hastily said, “Grandfather, these are my true thoughts, I didn’t lie to you!”
“Hmph!”
Lin Hong hmphed coldly, then declared, “Alright, no need for further explanation. You no longer need to think about running away. You should obediently stay here at Wicked Demon Peak. Until you break through to the Divinity Transformation Stage, you are not allowed to leave Wicked Demon Peak!”
“This…”
Lin Yi’s face changed, looking unwillingly at Lin Hong.
Seeing that, Lin Hong coldly rebuked, “What, you’re not willing? Did you not hear what I said?”
“I did!” Lin Yi replied through clenched teeth.
“That’s good!” Lin Hong said blandly, “You just focus on cultivating well here at Wicked Demon Peak! Once you’ve broken through to the Divinity Transformation Stage, then you can leave.”
“Yes!”
Lin Yi said with his head lowered, feeling very frustrated inside. However, he dared not defy Lin Hong, fearful that Lin Hong would become angry with him, which would make his days even more difficult.
What Lin Yi didn’t know was that his actions had greatly disappointed Lin Hong, leading to a feeling of aversion in his heart, making Lin Yi’s future journey all the more difficult.
“Alright, you may go back now!” Lin Hong waved his hand, signaling Lin Yi to return and rest.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi could only turn around and go back to his room.
Lin Yi lay on his bed, tossing and turning, unable to sleep.
Lin Yi thought to himself, “What exactly is the Lin Family doing? Why are they confining me here? Why can’t I even go outside to have a look?”
His mind was filled with doubts.
He had been staying here for a month, spending each day either eating or cultivating. With the assessment coming up in just a few days, Lin Yi had to grasp every moment to enhance his strength to avoid embarrassment.
Early the next morning, Lin Yi got up early, washed up, and stepped out of his yard into the courtyard.
“Grandfather, I’d like to go out and have a look,” Lin Yi said.
“Didn’t you say you were cultivating?” Lin Hong asked, “What do you want to go out for?”
Lin Yi replied, “I’ve been cultivating for so long, I need to relax a bit!”
Lin Hong frowned as he glanced at Lin Yi, then coldly chuckled, “If that’s the case, then I shall accompany you on a trip outside.”
“Sure!”
Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat when he heard this, but he kept his composure on the surface.
Lin Hong also gave Lin Yi a look but didn’t say anything, then led Lin Yi away from the Lin residence.
Lin Hong took Lin Yi out of the Lin residence, heading towards the outer fringes of Wicked Demon Peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 672 - 672 Dense Woods
chapters.content:
Chapter 672: Chapter 672 Dense Woods
The environment on the outskirts of Myriad Demons Peak was extremely barren, and ordinary people who entered seldom came out.
Lin Yi also understood why his grandfather wanted to confine him here.
Following Lin Hong, Lin Yi headed north, and soon, they arrived at a forest.
The forest was vast and dense, with lush leaves blocking out the sunlight.
At that moment, a gust of wind blew, and the leaves rustled incessantly, making Lin Yi feel an intense chill.
“Let’s go!”
Lin Hong led Lin Yi forward for a distance, until they came under a Sky-reaching Ancient Tree. The ancient tree stood a thousand feet tall with a trunk as wide as a barrel, and its canopy spanned a hundred meters.
Moreover, surrounding this Sky-reaching Ancient Tree were countless branches and leaves, enveloping the entire tree and forming a massive green barrier, which shrouded the entire Lin Mansion within it.
Lin Yi, looking at these branches and leaves, was also secretly alarmed.
“Grandfather, what is this ancient tree?” Lin Yi asked curiously.
“This Sky-reaching Ancient Tree is the Lifebound Treasure of the Myriad Poison Ancestor.”
Lin Hong said, “The Myriad Poison Ancestor is the most dangerous demon beast in Myriad Demons Peak. There are many fearsome demons and spirits here. If you get entangled with these demons and spirits, even I won’t be able to save you! Therefore, in this vicinity, you are prohibited from moving around at will.”
“So this Sky-reaching Ancient Tree is actually the Lifebound Treasure of the Myriad Poison Ancestor!” Lin Yi was secretly shocked in his heart, “The Myriad Poison Ancestor is a half-step Divinity Transformation Stage level superpower, and also possesses the Myriad Poison Skill. If he targets me, I’m definitely doomed!”
Although Lin Yi was a cultivator, he had only made a breakthrough not long ago and his foundation was somewhat weak. Before reaching the Divinity Transformation Stage, he was utterly incapable of withstanding the Myriad Poison Ancestor’s attacks.
“The Lifebound Treasure of the Myriad Poison Ancestor is this Sky-reaching Ancient Tree?” Lin Yi asked.
“Yes!” Lin Hong nodded, “The Myriad Poison Ancestor is also a significant figure in Myriad Demons Peak, but the demons and spirits here are powerful, and his Lifebound Treasures are few, so I’m not sure which one is his Lifebound Treasure.”
Lin Yi said, “Then you take me to find the Lifebound Treasure of the Myriad Poison Ancestor. I don’t believe the treasure of the Myriad Poison Ancestor is just on this Sky-reaching Ancient Tree.”
“Exactly! That’s what I think too, which is why I brought you here, to let you search for it yourself,” Lin Hong said, “The Lifebound Treasure of the Myriad Poison Ancestor is definitely above Myriad Demons Peak, go find it yourself!”
“Yes, Grandfather!”
Lin Yi replied respectfully and then started to sprint.
Myriad Demons Peak was fraught with dangers, and one false step could cost a life. Naturally, Lin Yi had to be extremely cautious and careful, not daring to be negligent. He could not afford to get injured; otherwise, he would truly be trapped to death on Myriad Demons Peak.
Lin Yi was clever, carefully avoiding dangers along the way, and swiftly arrived in the depths of Myriad Poison Peak.
The valley within Myriad Poison Peak was very spacious. Lin Yi sprinted rapidly, weaving through the valley.
Suddenly, Lin Yi felt as though he had encountered an obstruction.
This obstruction was very powerful, and Lin Yi found it impossible to get past it.
The obstruction was a Defensive Array, set up in the deepest part of Myriad Poison Peak. If Lin Yi didn’t know the weak spots in this Formation, he would have no way to get in.
However, Lin Yi wasn’t foolish. Upon seeing this Formation, he immediately thought of a plan.
“To get in, I must get through this Formation,” he mused. “Only by getting through this Formation can I reach the inside. But now, since the Formation is in the deepest part, even if I enter, I have no way to get through. I must break this Formation first.”
After pondering for a while, Lin Yi found the flaw in the Formation.
Seeing the flaw in the Formation, Lin Yi immediately smiled, knowing how to break it.
Lin Yi looked at the Formation in front of him, thinking about how to break it.
“How to break it?”
Lin Yi muttered in his mind, “This Formation is powerful, and many parts of it I’ve not seen before. It won’t be easy to break it.”
Lin Yi thought for a long time but couldn’t come up with a perfect solution.
Just as Lin Yi fell into silence, he looked at the Formation before him and suddenly, his eyes lit up with an idea.
“How about this!”
“I’ll break the Formation before me first, and then enter it. As long as my movement technique is fast enough, I should be able to safely escape even if I encounter danger. That way, I won’t have to worry about being trapped inside.”
With that thought in mind, Lin Yi began to attempt to destroy the Formation in front of him.
Lin Yi circulated the Yuan Force within his body and then executed a secret technique, his most powerful one, known as the “Thunderfire Technique.”
Once the Thunderfire Technique was deployed, a surge of thunder erupted from Lin Yi’s body, and a mass of blue electricity rapidly condensed in his palm, before he fiercely struck out at the Formation.
“Boom!”
A loud noise thundered as blue lightning and purple light burst forth simultaneously.
After the Thunderfire Technique was unleashed, it instantly hit the center of the Formation and, in the blink of an eye, the Formation was blown to pieces and vanished.
This scene left Lin Yi utterly astonished.
“Is this the Thunderfire Technique?” Lin Yi murmured to himself.
Lin Yi knew the Thunderfire Technique was incredibly powerful, but he hadn’t expected it to break the Formation in one move, which was simply unbelievable.
“The power of the Thunderfire Technique is indeed astonishing. It broke the Formation in one fell swoop; truly worthy of being the Myriad Demons Sect’s third Great Divine Power!” Lin Yi exclaimed in amazement.
Although the Thunderfire Technique was powerful, Lin Yi didn’t feel like his strength had increased much; instead, he felt quite weakened.
Lin Yi knew this might be because he had just advanced in rank and had not yet adjusted. After he became more familiar with the Thunderfire Technique, his combat power would surely rise substantially.
After the Formation dispersed, Lin Yi rushed towards the Lifebound Treasure of the Myriad Poison Ancestor.
Although Lin Yi had not broken through to martial master, in Myriad Poison Peak, he had no equals.
Soon, Lin Yi arrived in front of a grand hall.
Observing the hall carefully, Lin Yi noted that its entrance was adorned with colorful flags, each depicting a variety of poisonous insects and beasts.
Many guards stood outside the grand hall, each clad in armor and wielding weapons, their expressions stern. At a glance, their aura was formidable.
In front of these people, Lin Yi felt as insignificant as an ant, with the guards appearing as untouchable gods.
This place was the Myriad Poison Lair, the Lifebound Treasure of the Myriad Poison Ancestor.
“What kind of treasure could the Myriad Poison Ancestor’s Lifebound Treasure be, to be so formidable!” Lin Yi wondered in surprise.
However, despite his surprise, Lin Yi was not the least bit intimidated and prepared to force his way in.
Lin Yi approached the hall and then stepped directly inside. The hall was filled with a nauseating stench, making Lin Yi’s head feel somewhat dizzy.
The air inside the hall contained a corrosive force so intense that Lin Yi felt uncomfortable all over, as if his clothes were being dissolved.
Lin Yi quickly activated his protective Yuan Force to resist this corrosive power.
While maintaining his protective Yuan Force, Lin Yi cautiously advanced forward.
“Squeak squeak squeak!”
A dark shadow leapt out from within the hall and pounced towards Lin Yi.
It was a glossy black rat, standing one meter tall with a gaping maw that looked utterly ferocious.
The rat had sharp teeth and its mouth was filled with numerous pointed poison needles. As it leaped forward, it immediately employed a series of bizarre and deadly poison needle techniques against Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 673 - 673 The Number of Poisonous Mice is Quite Large
chapters.content:
Chapter 673: Chapter 673 The Number of Poisonous Mice is Quite Large
Lin Yi looked at the poison rat, a glint of coldness flashing in his eyes, and then he directly swung his palm, smashing the poison rat into pieces, leaving no trace of its bones.
“The physical defense of this poison rat is extremely strong, but its toxicity is very powerful. If I were to be tainted by even a drop, I would also meet an untimely death!”
Lin Yi felt wary, but he didn’t shrink back, continuing to move forward.
“Squeak, squeak, squeak!”
“Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!”
Poison rats one after another sprang out from the darkness, ceaselessly attacking Lin Yi.
There were simply too many poison rats. Lin Yi dared not be careless, only able to keep dodging, but although the poison rats were formidable, their speed and attacks were far inferior to the Thunderfire Technique.
The speed of the Thunderfire Technique was extremely fast, and the poison rats couldn’t keep up. Lin Yi quickly arrived at the deepest part of the Myriad Poison Lair.
Deep within the Myriad Poison Lair was a stone chamber, where there was a gigantic round black boulder. Atop the boulder was a bead emitting a dense poisonous mist.
“The Myriad Poison Bead!”
Seeing this bead, Lin Yi couldn’t help but exclaim out loud.
Lin Yi had never heard of the Myriad Poison Bead, but the rich medicinal fragrance emanating from it made him realize that this was indeed the Myriad Poison Bead!
“Is this the Myriad Poison Bead?” Lin Yi couldn’t help becoming excited, looking at the bead with great desire in his heart.
The Thunderfire Technique within Lin Yi’s body started to circulate.
As the Thunderfire Technique circulated, Lin Yi felt as if he was filled with endless strength.
“Hahaha! I have finally cultivated the Thunderfire Technique!”
Lin Yi was ecstatic, and then a hint of ruthlessness appeared on his face.
He was now in need of combat experience, and with the astonishing power of the Thunderfire Technique, if he could master it, he would certainly be able to sweep across the Tiangang Realm powerhouses.
“Now that I have such a Divine Skill like the Thunderfire Technique, my next step will be to storm into the Myriad Poisons Sect, find the sect master, slay the old Poison Master, seize the Myriad Poison Bead, and then completely destroy the Myriad Poisons Sect!”
Infinite ambition rose in Lin Yi’s heart.
Lin Yi made up his mind secretly; he had to eliminate the Myriad Poisons Sect as quickly as possible.
“I must collect all of the old Poison Master’s treasures!” Lin Yi silently said to himself.
Lin Yi’s heart was filled with endless desires; he was thinking about going to slay the old Poison Master at once.
“Old Poison Master, your treasures are as good as mine!” Lin Yi swore silently in his heart.
A sharp light shot from Lin Yi’s eyes.
After that, Lin Yi continued to walk forward, coming to the depths of the great hall.
