In the great hall was another door. Lin Yi walked up and gently pushed it open, immediately seeing a narrow and dark passage inside, with a faint layer of cyan smoke curling up above it.
On both sides of the passage were strange statues; some exuding an evil demonic Qi, some in the likeness of humans, others resembling the Demon Race, and there was even one that was a dragon covered in scales with nine tails.
Lin Yi felt that the aura of these statues was extremely terrifying; each one possessed no small measure of cultivation, and Lin Yi even suspected they might be figures of the elder level from the Myriad Poisons Sect.
Without any hesitation, Lin Yi stepped into the passage.
After entering the passage, Lin Yi’s body was enveloped by gusts of cold wind, followed by a sensation of icy chilliness.
At the end of the passage was a long corridor which seemed to lead nowhere at the end, but on both sides of the passage were lanterns embedded, lighting up the entire corridor as bright as day.
The long corridor took Lin Yi nearly half an hour to traverse before he reached its end.
At the end of the corridor, Lin Yi found a stone door, upon which three ancient and simple characters were carved: Myriad Poisons Palace.
This palace appeared grand and majestic, but it was void of any decorations; it looked simple, giving off a desolate and dilapidated impression, a sense of loneliness and boundlessness, weighing heavily on one’s heart.
Lin Yi put his hand on the palace’s stone door and then pushed it open with force.
As the stone door opened, a vast room was revealed, filled with many objects. There was a giant stone platform with jade boxes placed on top, emitting a faint fragrance of elixirs and strong fluctuations of spiritual power.
In this room, there were numerous jade bottles and elixirs; these bottles contained precious and rare Spirit Pills, while inside those bottles were millennium-old ginseng.
“Who would have thought that the Myriad Poisons Palace actually contained millennium-old ginseng? It seems that the ancestor of Myriad Poisons really was as wealthy as a nation!”
Lin Yi couldn’t help but remark.
Millennium-old ginseng was a treasure among spirit grasses, an extremely rare spiritual medicine, so rare that even the leader of a small sect might not have the privilege of possessing it.
However, as precious as these spirit grasses were to Lin Yi, they were not what he needed the most. What he needed most now was the antidote from the millennium mother!
Without delay, Lin Yi grabbed one of the jade bottles, poured out the antidote from the millennium mother, and took it into his mouth.
After consuming the antidote from the millennium mother, Lin Yi felt an immense comfort throughout his body, warmth spreading to every part.
Lin Yi felt as though all the pores on his body had expanded dozens of times in an instant!
“Indeed worthy of being a divine herb, the medicinal effect of the millennium mother is terrifyingly powerful, so strong. If I consume all the millennium mother, the Thunderfire Technique within me will reach a new peak, and its power will increase once more!”
Lin Yi exclaimed.
After taking the antidote from the millennium mother, Lin Yi’s body became even more formidable.
At this moment, Lin Yi’s body had become much stronger than the ordinary Vajra Imperishable Body, and his physical body had undergone earth-shattering changes.
At this moment, Lin Yi felt his physical body had surpassed that of a normal martial artist!
Lin Yi felt a boiling fervor throughout his body, feeling as though he could punch through heaven and earth with a single fist.
His physical strength was now comparable to that of an Immortal Artifact!
Lin Yi did not linger; he continued to move forward.
Lin Yi walked slowly, stopping every once in a while. When he reached the tomb of the Myriad Poisons Sect’s ancestor and sensed the presence of the sect leader, he headed straight towards the tomb.
The door to the tomb was open, and Lin Yi pushed it open as he arrived at the entrance.
Lin Yi walked into the tomb and reached its end.
At the end of the tomb was a spacious stone chamber, with a large bed in it, and on the bed lay a middle-aged man.
This middle-aged man was dressed in a gray robe, had a thin frame, and his face appeared extremely aged. His eyes were slightly closed, making him look as if he had long passed away.
The middle-aged man lay on the stone bed without any signs of life, emitting a strong scent of decay, indicating he had been dead for a long time.
“Myriad Poisons Ancestor!”
After a careful investigation, Lin Yi confirmed this was indeed the Myriad Poisons Sect’s ancestor.
“Is this the Myriad Poisons Ancestor? It seems the Myriad Poisons Sect isn’t so extraordinary after all.”
Lin Yi said with a disdainful curl of his lip.
The Myriad Poisons Ancestor was a renowned figure on the Myriad Poison Island, known as the number one in Poison Technique, whose reputation even eclipsed that of the Poison Master.

chapters.title: Chapter 674: Myriad Poisons Secret Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 674: Chapter 674: Myriad Poisons Secret Technique
The Poison Master was an unparalleled sovereign of poison on Wan Du Island, whose poison techniques were inherited in a continuous line, yet the founder of Wan Du Island was none other than the ancestor of poison.
It was a disciple of the poison ancestors who taught all the disciples of Wan Du Island the Myriad Poisons Secret Technique, and thus the poison techniques of the Myriad Poisons Sect came into being.
“It seems that this ancestor of the Myriad Poisons Sect only had this much capability,”
Lin Yi shook his head. He felt that the founder of Wan Du Island didn’t live up to the title of the poison ancestors—this old fool was too greedy for wealth, and had actually spread the Myriad Poisons Sect’s secret technique to outsiders, leading to the sect’s decline.
However, the founder of Myriad Poisons Sect had already died, and the sect itself was in disarray, so Lin Yi now intended to uproot the Myriad Poisons Sect entirely!
Founder of Myriad Poisons, meet your death!
Lin Yi sneered, his figure flashed, and he instantly appeared beside the corpse of the founder of Myriad Poisons, reaching out to grab a millennia-old relic.
Lin Yi threw the millennia-old relic into the Thunderfire Crystal Core within his body, then circulated the Thunderfire Technique, absorbing and refining the medicinal power of the millennia-old relic.
The Thunderfire Technique within Lin Yi burst forth, unleashing terrifying power, and his aura soared from the Ninthfold Martial Apprentice to the Peak of the Martial Master, becoming even more ferocious and domineering, with surges of thunderous power.
This was a sign that the Thunderfire Technique had broken through to the Fifthfold!
Lin Yi’s Thunderfire Technique had finally broken through, and now, his Thunderfire Technique had even surpassed the Sixfold, reaching a terrifying realm.
“The strength of this founder of Myriad Poisons is not weak after all; he was able to merge the medicinal power of the millennia-old relic into his own body, causing his Myriad Poisons Power to advance by leaps and bounds,”
Lin Yi inwardly praised.
After the breakthrough of Lin Yi’s Thunderfire Technique, the thunderous power in his body grew even more violent, like a vast sea of thunder, surging tumultuously.
Lighting coursed over Lin Yi’s body, and circles of electricity enveloped him.
Lin Yi felt the electricity traveling inside his body and was a little excited, feeling an endless power filling him up.
The bones of the founder of Myriad Poisons were tossed by Lin Yi into his storage ring.
Lin Yi scoured all the treasures of the Myriad Poisons Sect from within the storage ring, and then he left the tomb, heading in the direction of Myriad Poisons City.
Myriad Poisons City, situated to the due south of Wan Du Island, with the tomb of the founder of Myriad Poisons lying to its north.
After returning to Myriad Poisons City, Lin Yi immediately found an inn to rest.
This was a common inn, capable of housing four people, totaling eighteen individuals.
The inns within Myriad Poisons City were all run by impoverished families, and those who stayed there were usually martial artists from medium-sized forces, who lived near Myriad Poisons City on normal days.
As soon as Lin Yi stepped into the inn, he immediately attracted the attention of many people.
Lin Yi had a tall and straight figure, with an ethereal temperament that seemed otherworldly, attracting everyone’s gaze as soon as he appeared.
“So handsome, he makes immortals look bland by comparison, hundreds of times more so.”
“Who is he, and why does he seem so strange? How come we’ve never seen him before?”
“Indeed! I wonder from which faction this formidable figure hails. He seems very powerful, and I feel like he’s hiding endless secrets.”
“He must have an extraordinary background; I bet he comes from the Heavenly Demon Domain!”
…
Many martial artists were speculating and appraising Lin Yi.
Upon hearing the conversations of the people around him, Lin Yi paid no attention and headed straight upstairs.
“Young master, hello, is this your first time in Myriad Poisons City? Our hotel has a lot of delicious food; are you interested in trying some?”
Just then, a head suddenly popped over Lin Yi’s shoulder.
A middle-aged man said with a smile.
Lin Yi looked up at this middle-aged man and noticed that he was skinny, with narrow eyes and a sullen face, exuding an evil aura. His clothes were disheveled, revealing a large expanse of skin on his chest.
This person didn’t look like anything good, and Lin Yi had no interest in him, so he said indifferently, “Sorry, I don’t like eating. Just get out of the way.”
“Oh dear, is the young master afraid there’s something wrong with our food and drink? Don’t worry at all, there’s absolutely no problem. Just come up with me and try it, I guarantee you’ll fall in love with the food here, and after eating you definitely won’t want to leave.”
The middle-aged man continued to persuade.
“I said I don’t like eating, don’t bother me!”
Lin Yi barked coldly.
“This…”
The middle-aged man was stunned; he hadn’t expected this youth to be so arrogant, to actually dare curse at him.
“This is Myriad Poisons City, not a place for you to act wildly!”
“Little brother, I advise you to leave Myriad Poisons City quickly, or if you anger the City Lord, I won’t be able to save you.”
A tall young man also stood in front of Lin Yi, looking at him with a threatening face.
“Scram!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, and slapped out a hand, a wildly powerful force blasting forth, sending the two men flying away.
The two flew out of Myriad Poisons City’s range and crashed heavily to the ground, spitting blood, unconscious.
Both were Seventhfold Martial Apprentices, yet neither were Lin Yi’s match, defeated by him with just one move.
The power of Lin Yi’s move instantly intimidated all the surrounding Martial Artists, leaving everyone shocked, staring at Lin Yi with their mouths agape.
Fear was evident in their eyes.
“Damn, this young man is so fierce!”
“Who on earth is he? So formidable, to send a Seventhfold Martial Apprentice flying with a single slap, just too powerful.”
“Could he be that youth, Lin Yi, who killed the twelve guards of the Demon Emperor Palace and then killed the Demon Emperor himself?”
“Impossible, how could such a young man possess such great strength? He must be a fake, we absolutely cannot believe this!”
“Yeah, definitely a fake!”
The numerous Martial Artists around were all discussing fervently, surprised at Lin Yi’s strength yet disbelieving it was really him.
Lin Yi couldn’t be bothered to waste words with these people and walked away directly.
Lin Yi entered a mansion, and the Martial Artists guarding the entrance hastily saluted upon seeing him come in.
“Young master, do you require any services?”
Lin Yi ignored them and proceeded towards the center of the mansion.
Lin Yi arrived at a pavilion, sat down, and began to seclude himself for cultivation.
During his seclusion, Lin Yi constantly refined the energy within his Dantian, all the while cultivating the Myriad Poisons Scripture.
Once the Myriad Poisons Scripture reached the First Layer, the efficiency of cultivation increased significantly, achieving the Third Layer in just one month.
A month later, Lin Yi successfully cultivated the First Layer of the Myriad Poisons Scripture.
The Second and Third Layers were increasingly beneficial to Lin Yi, and he successfully cultivated them in just one day.
After ending his cultivation, Lin Yi left the pavilion, strolled around Myriad Poisons City for a bit, then left, ready to depart from Myriad Poisons City.
In Myriad Poisons City, within the island of Myriad Poisons Island.
The island covered an extremely vast area, with buildings hundreds of feet high, grand and superb, with many houses. However, it was empty, with not a single Martial Artist in sight, just black lines stretching down from the sky like snakes, winding forward.
Lin Yi flew through midair, weaving through the black mist.

chapters.title: Chapter 675 - 675 The Clouds and Mist are Very Strange
chapters.content:
Chapter 675: Chapter 675 The Clouds and Mist are Very Strange
These black clouds of fog were incredibly sinister. The moment Lin Yi stepped onto them, black poisonous fog spewed out, eroding his body and corroding his physical form.
“This Myriad Poisons Island is indeed no ordinary place!”
Lin Yi sprinted through the air, continuously heading forward. His speed was extremely fast; there was hardly a sign of him pausing, swiftly flying through the pitch-black area.
“Whoosh!”
Just then, a white figure suddenly flew over from a distance, moving incredibly fast.
Lin Yi looked up and immediately made out the incoming figure as a gigantic white crane.
This huge white crane was enormous, measuring twenty to thirty meters in length and exuding an icy chill all over. Its body was covered in scales, which made it look exceptionally tough.
Lin Yi hadn’t expected to encounter a spirit beast here, and a powerful one at that. He instantly became alert.
“Brat, get lost quickly. This is not a place for you,”
the white crane shouted in a sharp, ear-piercing cry, its voice filled with authority.
Lin Yi narrowed his eyes, staring at the white crane, and said, “I’m here on urgent business. I hope you won’t stop me.”
“Haha, you sure have a big mouth for a youngster, daring to talk to me in a commanding tone. But I’m not buying it; I’m sending you off right now!”
With a roar, the white crane fiercely opened its mouth and spat out a cloud of white poisonous fog.
The fog spread through the air, turning into venomous snakes that lunged at Lin Yi with bared fangs.
“Hmph!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, flicked his fingers, and the venomous snakes were instantly shattered. Then, with a stomp of his right foot on the ground, he surged towards the white crane in an instant.
The white crane, seeing Lin Yi daring to attack directly, immediately flapped its wings to ascend to the sky, hoping to dodge Lin Yi’s strike.
But Lin Yi’s reaction was also exceedingly fast. He flew straight up into the sky, waved his hands, and two longswords flew out from his sleeves, piercing the crane’s abdomen and head, respectively. Then, Lin Yi grabbed onto the legs of the white crane.
The white crane let out a piercing scream, struggling midair, but Lin Yi held on to the legs without letting go, pulling hard, causing the crane’s body to sway violently.
With a powerful fling, the white crane’s body fell from the sky and crashed to the ground.
Although the white crane’s body was huge, it was after all just an ordinary demon beast and couldn’t withstand Lin Yi’s strength.
Lin Yi stepped on the back of the white crane and punched its head, smashing the crane’s skull.
Bright red blood splattered across the earth, and a huge head fell to the ground, appearing quite horrifying.
The white crane had been killed by Lin Yi, who then jumped down from its body.
“Whew!”
After the white crane’s corpse fell to the ground, it instantly turned into thick blood that spread across the earth, presenting a shocking sight.
The surrounding demon race creatures, seeing the white crane killed outright by a human, were struck with extreme horror.
This white crane was notoriously fierce in Myriad Poisons City; if anyone dared to provoke it, it would not hesitate to kill and even destroy their homes.
Yet, now it lay dead at the hands of a human, an outcome they found unbelievable.
“Oh my god! This human actually killed the holy beast, the white crane of the Myriad Poisons Sect! This is going to turn the heavens upside down!”
“Let’s run!”
“This is a holy-level demon beast! How did that human do it? His speed was so fast, he appeared beside us in a flash, killing the white crane. What do we do now?”
“Oh Lord! This is the first time I’ve encountered such a situation!”
The group of demon race creatures around were in complete panic, fleeing quickly in all directions.
These creatures all headed towards the Myriad Poisons Palace in flight, no longer daring to linger.
“Whoosh!”
“Swoosh!”
“Swoosh!”
Lin Yifei soared toward the Myriad Poisons Palace, his speed now several times faster than before. The demon race members ahead had no chance to keep up with him and were left far behind one by one.
Arriving at the front of the Myriad Poisons Palace, Lin Yi looked up at the towering mountains before him, his gaze growing much more solemn.
Outside the Myriad Poisons Palace stood a giant stele reaching a hundred meters high, carved with ancient and weathered designs, and bearing the three large characters “Myriad Poisons Palace.”
“Is this the Myriad Poisons Palace?”
Lin Yi murmured to himself, knowing he had to force his way into the palace. He needed to find that human youth to ascertain his whereabouts; otherwise, the boy was sure to die.
Gazing at the colossal stele, Lin Yi took a deep breath and stepped onto the stone stairs.
The stairs were incredibly smooth, devoid of the slightest trace of lines, with only two neat rows of large characters.
There were ninety-eight steps in total. Lin Yi ascended one by one, and with each step, his face turned a shade uglier.
He was aware of his own insufficient strength, and climbing these ninety-eight stairs was nothing short of a disaster for him at this moment!
Lin Yi gritted his teeth and forcibly took another step forward, finally reaching the last step and standing atop the stairs.
“Rumble!”
The stairs trembled, and then a large gate opened, gusts of wind blowing out from within, carrying a stench.
That wind felt as heavy as a thousand pounds, causing even Lin Yi to gasp for air, his face turning crimson.
Lin Yi’s figure swayed slightly, nearly toppling over. He hastily steadied himself and then stepped into the austere and substantial stone gate.
“Splash!”
The stone gate slowly closed, blocking out the wild wind.
Inside the gate lay a long corridor. Lin Yi followed it forward, and after a walk of more than ten minutes, he encountered a massive stone door.
The material of this stone door was very unusual; it resembled a gigantic boulder and appeared to be formed from limitless flames.
Lin Yi, startled by the heat emanating from the door, discovered that its temperature was even more terrifying than his own flames, burning fiercely. He dared not make any reckless moves and cautiously approached the door.
“Bang!”
Just then, the stone door suddenly burst, turning into a fiery blaze that rushed toward Lin Yi.
“Hiss!”
Feeling the heat wave, Lin Yi’s clothes caught fire, his pores constricted as if he was about to be cooked.
Fortunately, he immediately circulated his cultivation technique and dispelled the searing heat.
“Such terrifying heat, this flame is even more frightening than the Metal Attribute Gang Qi in my body,” Lin Yi muttered in awe as he regarded the door.
The stone of the door was extraordinarily special, capable of incinerating his Gang Qi, a wonder beyond comprehension that amazed him.
Lin Yi cautiously neared the stone door, intending to enter.
“Boom!”
Lin Yi pushed against the door with his hand, and it emitted a muffled sound, then began to slide to the sides.
With the door’s movement, a pitch-black entrance was revealed, from which a stream of black fog emerged—a strange Demonic Qi.
“Hm?”
Lin Yi frowned slightly, surprised that the stone door could open and even more by the presence of Demonic Qi. He wondered what could possibly be inside.
He cautiously entered the black stone gate. Inside, a strange fluctuation was transmitted, suggesting a mighty power rampaging within, suffocating.
Lin Yi’s Divine Sense swept inside, feeling as though a small stream had entered the sea, unable to stir any ripples at all.
When Lin Yi’s Divine Sense caught sight of the scene within the cave, he was instantly stunned, his eyes widening in disbelief as he stared at the scene before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 676: Growing Wary
chapters.content:
Chapter 676: Chapter 676: Growing Wary
In the center of the cave, there was a giant pearl, as big as a basketball, perfectly round and translucent, its surface covered in runes and enveloped by a thin membrane.
Surrounding the pearl, a youth in a gray robe, with a hunched figure, sat cross-legged. He was very thin, resembling a skeletal frame with bones jutting out, and ghostly blue flames flickered in the hollows of his eye sockets.
This youth exuded an evil aura, putting Lin Yi on alert; he sensed that this youth was no ordinary person.
That youth was the young man of the Human Clan he had been searching for.
Lin Yi didn’t act rashly; he stood still, watching the youth, his heart pounding.
He had never seen such an ugly youth before; could such an ugly being really be human?
Noticing Lin Yi, the youth opened his eyes, his lips curling into a cruel smile.
“You’ve finally come!”
The youth’s voice was hoarse, like that of a dying old man, somewhat grating to the ear.
“Did you kill my child?” Lin Yi snorted coldly.
“Haha! Hahaha! I killed him, he had it coming, no one else to blame!”
Upon hearing this, the youth burst into laughter, then suddenly stood up and walked toward Lin Yi, with each step, his aura grew stronger, causing palpitations.
“Kid, your Cultivation is not bad, to have set foot on these stone steps, but you’re still too green, you can’t withstand a single punch from me!”
“Buzz!”
No sooner had the youth finished speaking than he swung his fist towards Lin Yi, his fist crackling with purple lightning as if thunderbolt raced across his knuckles.
The Fist Force struck the stone steps, shattering them, and fractures spread out, looking terrifying.
“Thump! Thump!”
The youth’s fist smashed viciously onto Lin Yi’s chest, blasting him through the air in an arc.
Lin Yi’s chest ached intensely, his internal organs shifted, his breastbone fractured, and he spat out a mouthful of blood.
“Pfft!”
Lin Yi spat out several mouthfuls of fresh blood, his complexion turned pale, and his eyes filled with fury and intent to kill.
“I will avenge my child no matter who killed him!”
Lin Yi yelled angrily, and then stood up and pounced towards the youth.
“Bang!”
Just as he pounced, he collided with the youth, and they both went flying backwards, falling to the ground, kicking up dust.
Both individuals were covered with wounds and bleeding, looking extremely ragged.
Lin Yi’s face was smeared with dirt, his hair disheveled, his clothes torn, and he looked grimy and bedraggled.
“Pfft!”
Unable to help himself, Lin Yi coughed up blood, then looked down at his right arm to see that it was charred black, oozing black fluid; his bones were crushed.
A bitter expression crossed Lin Yi’s face; he knew his injuries were severe. His Physical Body was highly resistant to damage, such that even those at the Peak of the Immortal Venerable Realm would struggle to injure him.
Yet this time, his body had sustained injuries, worsened by just having ascended to the Immortal Venerable Realm, making the injuries more severe.
“Your Physical Body is quite sturdy, too bad, today there’s only one outcome for you, and that is death!”
The youth sneered, then rushed forward once again to strike Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s expression changed drastically; he quickly dodged the youth’s attack, silently cursing at how formidable this youth was—he was no match for him.
“Whoosh!”
Just then, a flash of insight crossed Lin Yi’s mind.
He suddenly recalled the identity of the youth—could this youth be the Young Master from the Demon Realm?
“That can’t be right; he’s clearly a Cultivator from the Human Clan, how could he possibly be the Young Master from the Demon Realm? Hasn’t the Demon Realm been exterminated?”
Lin Yi shook his head, feeling that he had thought too simply. That youth definitely wasn’t the Demon Realm’s Young Master, it was just that he looked too much like him, so people could recognize him at a glance.
“Kid, what are you thinking about? Not only is your physical body robust, but your mind seems a bit foolish too. I’ve already said I am the Demon Realm’s Young Master, yet you still don’t believe it. You are so foolish that I’ll help you by smashing your head and see how you can still be so arrogant!”
The youth said with a sinister tone. Then, he swung his fist and charged at Lin Yi once again, with speed more than twice as fast as before.
“Damn it!”
Lin Yi cursed silently in his heart. He hadn’t expected the youth’s speed to have increased to such a terrifying level, it was simply horrifying.
Lin Yi hurriedly dodged, but he couldn’t evade the youth’s attack. In just an encounter, Lin Yi was struck in the abdomen by the youth and knocked back against the wall, slumping to the ground.
Lin Yi was covered in scrapes and streaked with blood, looking rather disheveled.
“Pfft!”
Lin Yi spat out another mouthful of fresh blood.
The youth raised his pair of incredibly coarse hands again and slapped them down on Lin Yi’s chest, flinging him once more to the ground.
This time Lin Yi was kicked seven or eight times by the youth before the tumbling ceased.
“You’re really weak, not even able to withstand one of my moves! Do you want to end yourself, or shall I do it?”
The youth sneered coldly, his eyes filled with a mocking light.
“Dream on! You think you can defeat me? That’s the talk of a lunatic! I want to see just how strong you can be!”
Lin Yi stood up, a ferocious look on his face as he glared at the youth. Then, his body transformed into a golden light and vanished in an instant.
The youth’s eyes hardened. He couldn’t see Lin Yi’s figure, but he felt a dangerous aura envelop him, sending shivers down his spine.
“This feeling is so unfamiliar!”
The youth frowned and then shook his head.
“Whoosh!”
Suddenly, a silver light slashed through the void, speeding towards the youth with a velocity faster than lightning, leaving no time to react.
“Not good!”
The youth was startled and immediately turned to dodge Lin Yi’s attack, but his body was half a beat too slow. Lin Yi’s strike hit his shoulder mercilessly.
“Crack!”
His shoulder instantly collapsed, blood spurting out and drenching him like a blood-soaked specter, terribly fearsome.
The youth gritted his teeth in pain, his eyes bulging as he looked toward the direction from which the silver light had come.
He saw a man in flowing white robes hovering in the void, looking down at him with cold indifference.
“Who are you? How dare you attack me!”
The youth stared at Lin Yi and asked in a deep voice.
“Lin Yi! I am the one here to deal with you!”
Lin Yi’s face was filled with cold murderous intent, and a terrifying killing aura burst forth from him. If looks could kill, the youth would have been slain a million times over by now.
“Lin Yi! I’ve never heard of you!”
The youth’s expression was slightly odd as he glanced at Lin Yi, then shook his head. “So you’re Lin Yi?”
“That’s right, it’s me!”
Lin Yi nodded and said, “And you’re the Demon Realm’s Young Master?”
“Good that you know. If you know what’s good for you, you’d better scram while you still can. Perhaps in a good mood, I’d spare your miserable life!” The youth glanced indifferently at Lin Yi and continued, “If you don’t leave, I’ll kill you!”
“What if I don’t go?”
Lin Yi’s figure shot forward like a meteor, charging directly towards the youth.

chapters.title: Chapter 677: 677 Resentment and Reluctance
chapters.content:
Chapter 677: Chapter 677 Resentment and Reluctance
“Seeking death!”
The youth coldly huffed, raising a palm and fiercely slapping it down.
A resplendent Fist Qi burst forth from his palm, shrouded in a dense black mist, from which a clump of dark clouds emerged, and a pitch-black dragon appeared, roaring as it charged out of the Fist Qi toward Lin Yi’s chest.
“Bang!”
The Fist Qi struck Lin Yi’s body hard, sending him flying, spitting out blood again, his body trembling, with piercing pain coursing through him.
“Aaah! I can’t accept this, I won’t accept it!!!”
Lin Yi’s eyes were bloodshot, filled with venom and unwillingness, his heart overwhelmed with rage and sorrow. He was unwilling to accept this truth, yet he had to.
“Boom, boom, boom!”
Lin Yi’s body repeatedly slammed against the wall, his bones crackling with explosive sounds, blood spurting from his body, staining his clothes red.
“Hahaha…”
Lin Yi burst out laughing, lying on his back on the ground, his eyes wide open, blood oozing from the corner of his mouth, his gaze brimming with hatred and defiance.
“Lin Yi, I’d like to see what grounds you have for your arrogance now!”
The youth sneered, his killing intent growing stronger.
“You… you will not die a good death!”
Lin Yi glared at the youth, his eyes full of hate and resentment.
The youth sneered, completely disdainful of Lin Yi’s words.
“Rumble!”
Suddenly, Lin Yi’s body shook, and it exploded. A fist imprint blasted through his body, pulverizing chunks of bone, completely shattering his physical body.
The youth’s body also turned into a mist of blood in an instant, devoured by the fist imprint and then disappearing without a trace.
“Huff, huff…”
A gust of wind blew by, scattering the remaining dust.
Everything seemed as if it had never happened.
“Lin Yi, didn’t you think you were strong? Didn’t you want revenge? Now, I’m sending you to see the King of Hell, and your physical body belongs to me! Hahaha…”
The youth stood up on a pile of rubble, his right arm still dripping blood, with a trace of blood at the corner of his mouth.
He stuck out his tongue, licked his lips, and showed a wicked, bloodthirsty grin, his eyes narrowed into slits emanating a sinister charm.
“Lin Yi, let’s see how you continue to run rampant from now on!”
His body suddenly soared into the air, heading straight for a distant city at a speed as swift as the wind, vanishing into the night in the blink of an eye.
The moment the youth left, Lin Yi struggled to get up from the rubble, his bones nearly all broken by the Fist Qi, his body convulsing continuously.
Lin Yi endured immense pain, struggling to stand up, his body trembling. It felt as though all his internal organs had shifted, causing stabbing pains.
But Lin Yi still firmly got to his feet, staggering toward the town.
He needed to treat his injuries quickly, he could not delay any longer, or else he would surely die.
Lin Yi’s form rapidly moved, his speed like a streak of lightning.
In just a moment, Lin Yi’s figure arrived at the town.
Within the town, a large crowd gathered, and upon seeing Lin Yi’s arrival, they all turned to look.
Lin Yi could not afford to care about that, surging with a layer of holy light, his physical body instantly healed, returning to its original state.
Afterward, he immediately ran into a pharmacy, took out a pile of elixirs, and swallowed them.
Although he had recovered his strength, he had not yet returned to his peak, so he could not use any martial arts or practice any cultivation techniques. Therefore, he needed to cultivate and recover his strength as quickly as possible before he could continue fighting.
There were no shortages of alchemists in this town.
When those alchemists saw Lin Yi taking the elixirs, they were somewhat puzzled, but they did not stop him.
No matter how puzzled they were, they could not stop Lin Yi’s determination to buy herbs, so they could only let Lin Yi purchase them.
It took Lin Yi a full two days and nights to repair the damaged meridians within his body.
Lin Yi took out some gold coins from his storage bag and then headed towards an inn.
Lin Yi did not rush to buy herbs but stayed in the inn for three to four days. After fully recuperating and returning to his prime, he left the inn.
“Young Master, are you really certain you want to leave? This place is very close to the outskirts of the Eastern Wasteland, and there are many ferocious beasts around. Once you encounter them, you will certainly be torn to shreds!” The inn’s attendant, seeing Lin Yi’s intent to leave, hurriedly spoke up, his tone filled with concern.
“Yes, I’m sure,” Lin Yi nodded, his eyes flashing with determination, “You help me purchase all these herbs. I need to refine a batch of healing pills.”
“Refine healing pills? Such pills require a large amount of precious spirit grass, and the time consumed in their refinement is also very long. Why don’t you reconsider, young master?” The attendant advised, his demeanor still gentle and humble.
Lin Yi waved his hand and refused, “No need, I have thought it through. I want to refine healing pills.”
“If that is the case, I won’t stop you. I will purchase all the herbs you need. Take care on your journey!”
Lin Yi nodded with a smile, thanked the man, and then left the inn.
Walking down the street, Lin Yi’s face was extremely grim. In his mind, the image of that young man could not help but surface.
The youth looked to be about sixteen years old and seemed young, but his strength was incredibly formidable. He managed to defeat Lin Yi with ease, which was unbelievable. Lin Yi could hardly accept that he was defeated so thoroughly, that he had died like that when he had not lived enough!
No, I definitely can’t die. I must survive, stay alive, and one day when I become even more powerful, I will kill him and avenge my clansmen! Lin Yi clenched his fists, thinking to himself resolutely.
Lin Yi headed south and after half a month’s journey, finally reached his destination, the Heavenly Mountain Sect.
Outside the Heavenly Mountain Sect, a large number of cultivators had gathered, thousands of people crowded outside, discussing something.
Everyone’s gaze was focused on a sky-reaching ancient tree outside the Heavenly Mountain Sect, their expressions filled with excitement.
“The Heavenly Mountain Sect has appeared!”
Someone shouted, and immediately captured the attention of countless people.
“The Heavenly Mountain Sect has finally decided to make an appearance! It’s said that this time they will be recruiting disciples, and those who are successfully recruited will receive a generous reward!”
“Should we give it a try this time?”
“I want to go too, but we don’t have money!”
“I have money, I have a lot of money!”
A crowd of people gathered at the doorway of the Heavenly Mountain Sect, talking excitedly, some nervous, but even more were excited and thrilled.
“Lin Yi, the Heavenly Mountain Sect is finally revealing itself. We must hurry to the Heavenly Mountain Sect!”
Then, a voice sounded, and everyone looked towards where the voice was coming from.
Looking in the direction of the voice, Lin Yi saw a familiar figure standing at the front of the crowd, it was Ye Chen.
“Brother Ye, you’ve come,” Lin Yi said, a trace of joy flashing in his eyes.
Since Ye Chen’s arrival in the Eastern Wasteland, he had not been in touch with Lin Yi. He hadn’t expected to meet him again so soon.
“Heh, of course, I had to come. Otherwise, if I missed this convocation of the Heavenly Mountain Sect, I might never get another chance to see the entrance to the Heavenly Mountain Sect,” Ye Chen said, facing Lin Yi with a radiant smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 678: 678: Ninefold Divinity Transformation Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 678: Chapter 678: Ninefold Divinity Transformation Realm
“Let’s go,” you said.
Ye Chen and Lin Yi walked side by side toward the Heavenly Mountain Sect, and a crowd of cultivators dispersed to clear the way for them.
“Lin Yi, I’ve heard you’ve advanced to the Ninefold Divinity Transformation Realm, congratulations indeed! You’re really in the spotlight now, even knowing the entrance to the Heavenly Mountain Sect!” Ye Chen looked at Lin Yi with a look of envy on his face.
“Hahaha, that can only mean that I have extraordinary talent, which is why I was able to find such a great place to cultivate,” Lin Yi laughed heartily, clearly very proud.
“Brother Lin, I’m truly happy for you. I wonder if I could become your disciple and learn your medical arts?” Ye Chen looked at Lin Yi with a face full of longing.
When Lin Yi heard Ye Chen ask this, he was stunned for a moment, his face turned extremely odd, then he bitterly smiled, shook his head, and said, “Brother Ye, by saying that, you make me feel like an outsider. I, Lin Yi, rarely take on disciples, but if you’re willing to become my disciple, that’s no problem.”
Upon hearing this, Ye Chen immediately exclaimed with ecstasy on his face.
“Master, I want to take you as my teacher!”
“Become a disciple!”
“Become a disciple!”
Suddenly there was a burst of cheering around them, everyone went mad, all rushing toward Lin Yi.
Lin Yi looked at the eager faces around him and suddenly felt an overwhelming pressure.
At that moment, he suddenly felt an icy breath. He looked up and saw a figure in black slowly walking on air toward him. Under the cover of the black robe, a pair of eyes sparkled with cold indifference, making one’s whole body chill.
Lin Yi’s face stiffened, looking somewhat troubled. He hadn’t expected that figure to track him down so quickly, and to have reached the Heavenly Mountain Sect so fast; and that he even knew his master was someone called Ye Chen—this was simply too bizarre!
He knew he was thoroughly defeated this time.
“Hmph, Lin Yi! I didn’t expect you to still be alive, that you didn’t die among the Demon Clan, it seems I underestimated you,” the figure in the black robe snorted coldly, staring at Lin Yi with coldness.
There was a purplish scar on his face with sunken eyes; within the sockets, two flames burned, giving him a somewhat eerie appearance.
This person was the figure in the black robe, the very one who had personally killed Lin Yi’s master, and then had people track down Lin Yi’s whereabouts.
The color of Lin Yi’s face turned incredibly dark when he heard the words of the figure in the black robe.
“Lin Yi, you should know about the emergence of the Heavenly Mountain Sect this time, right? Although your strength is impressive, in the Heavenly Mountain Sect, you’re still not considered a genius, only I can become the true successor of the Heavenly Mountain Sect!” The figure in the black robe looked at Lin Yi, his eyes deep and cold, as if he could see through everything.
“What do you want?” Lin Yi asked solemnly, looking at the figure in the black robe.
“It’s simple, hand over your Nascent Soul, and I can forgive your rudeness,” the figure in the black robe said, not hiding the murderous intent in his eyes, speaking coldly.
“I won’t hand over the Nascent Soul because it’s my lifeline, my life; I cannot hand it over!” Lin Yi shook his head, answering decisively, without any hesitation.
“Hmm, you refuse a toast only to drink a forfeit. Then don’t blame me for being rude!” The expression of the figure in the black robe changed, and his tone became instantly cold and ruthless.
“I also want to see what strength you have to take my lifeline!”
Lin Yi shouted coldly, his mana circulating within him, his whole body bursting out with dazzling golden light. He looked like a golden furnace, full of blazing might.
“Your strength has indeed improved, which is why you were able to escape from the hands of the Demon Clan’s army, but unfortunately, you are still no match for me.”
The figure in the black robe saw Lin Yi erupting golden rays of light and froze for a moment before revealing a sneering smile, speaking disdainfully,
“I know you’re strong, but in the face of an insurmountable gap in strength, even the most powerful cultivation is insignificant. You won’t take my life today!” Lin Yi snorted coldly as the mana inside his body began to circulate wildly, a faint golden glow emanating from his skin. Threads of mana wrapped around him like golden threads, making him appear even more divine.
The golden light radiating from Lin Yi seemed to illuminate the entire sky, making the clouds shine, and it was incredibly beautiful.
“Heh, if you refuse to see reason, then don’t blame me for being ruthless!”
The figure in the black robe snorted coldly, a murderous intent emerged in his eyes, and then he looked towards the several young men beside him and said, “Fellow Daoists, would you be willing to help me capture this little beast?”
Upon hearing the words of the figure in the black robe, the four young men immediately responded in unison, “We are at the Deputy Sect Master’s service!”
These people were all disciples of Heavenly Mountain Sect and naturally knew of the grievances between the Heavenly Mountain Sect and the Demon Clan. Upon seeing Lin Yi, they were filled with hostility, and now that they were asked by the figure in the black robe to capture him, they were more than eager to comply.
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s expression changed slightly. That figure in the black robe was indeed arrogant to have several Heavenly Mountain Sect disciples attempt to capture him!
“You pack of dog slaves, as a disciple of Heavenly Mountain Sect, how dare you come after me? If you know what’s good for you, get lost!”
“Ungrateful wretch, watch as we cripple you today!”
The young men were furious and all charged at Lin Yi.
Seeing this, Lin Yi frowned deeply, feeling a surge of imminent danger in his heart. He knew he had to fight for his life, otherwise he would surely fall into these men’s hands, and the secrets he carried would be revealed.
He took a deep breath as mana surged wildly into his Dantian. He had to launch his most powerful strike to annihilate these men, to protect his Nascent Soul from being taken.
“Kill!”
A roar erupted as he suddenly lunged forward, transforming his hand into a claw and striking forward, a burst of golden Gang Qi shooting out, forming claw marks in the air and raking towards his adversaries.
The young disciples, who were at the Foundation Establishment Stage, stood no chance against Lin Yi. They couldn’t withstand his attacks, and were sent flying, blood spraying from their wounds as they were badly injured.
“Puchi!”
Lin Yifei closed the distance and unleashed another Claw Technique, aiming to tear the figure in the black robe to shreds.
But this time he hit nothing but air.
For the figure in the black robe had disappeared without a trace at some unknown time.
“Eh, that guy has vanished; could he be hiding?” Lin Yi looked around in confusion, unable to spot the figure in the black robe, his expression growing serious as he knew how fearsome this adversary was.
He had just casually sent four young disciples flying, and with only a slight use of Divine Skills, he had injured the four. This showed how terrifying his strength was.
“Such terrifying speed, this figure in the black robe is too fearsome. Could he be a Golden Immortal Realm expert?”
Lin Yi’s expression became solemn as he looked in the direction where the black-robed figure had disappeared, silently pondering.
“Lin Yi, you might as well surrender!” The voice of the figure in the black robe came once again from behind Lin Yi.
“You think I’m afraid of you?” Lin Yi turned around, snorted coldly at the figure in the black robe, and threw a punch towards him.
“Boom!”

chapters.title: Chapter 679: 679: Stir Up Huge Waves
chapters.content:
Chapter 679: Chapter 679: Stir Up Huge Waves
A fist smashed into the void, revealing fissures in space, from which surged a violent energy, rippling in concentric circles like waves on water.
Spreading in all directions, it raised towering waves, tsunami-like, with an intimidating roar.
“With this punch, I want to see what tricks you have up your sleeve to catch my fist!” roared the figure in the black robe, his eyes filled with mockery as he reached out and grabbed Lin Yi’s incoming fist, then fiercely pulled back.
“Crack”
Lin Yi’s arm was torn off by the figure in the black robe, and fresh red blood spurted out.
“Ah!”
Lin Yi screamed in agony, his face twisted in pain as the excruciating pain from his arm made his whole body shake uncontrollably, sweat covering his brow.
“Hahaha, this is the consequence of offending my Heavenly Mountain Sect. Lin Yi, do you still dare to resist now? If you surrender now, I might spare your life; otherwise, I’ll cripple your hands and your Dantian, making your life worse than death!”
The figure in the black robe laughed heartily, his eyes gleaming colder and more ferocious, like a demon filled with intense malice.
“Good, very good. You impress me with your brazenness!”
Lin Yi gritted his teeth, looking at the black-robed figure and said, “If you’re not afraid of my father coming after you, just try to capture me. I absolutely won’t resist in the slightest. But I don’t know how my father will punish you!”
“Heh heh, your father? What does he count for? Do you think I will listen to him just because he says something? Although my Heavenly Mountain Sect is only a minor sect, we fear no one!”
The figure in the black robe laughed heartily, with a trace of mockery in his eyes.
“Fine, if that’s the case, then just wait. My father will surely avenge me!”
Lin Yi’s eyes flashed coldly as he stared at the black-robed figure, his tone icy.
“Hahaha, revenge? We’ll see who ends up killing whom. But don’t worry, your father will surely die by my sword!” the figure in the black robe laughed loudly.
His words brimmed with confidence, as if he had the right to say them.
Upon hearing this, a cold curve formed at the corner of Lin Yi’s mouth.
“You are indeed confident, but unfortunately, you’ve encountered me. Today, you are doomed not to escape!”
“Whoosh!”
Lin Yi’s figure flashed, darting forward.
He was fast, instantly appearing in front of four young disciples.
“Bang Bang Bang!”
Lin Yi extended his hand, seizing the necks of the young disciples, lifted them all at once, and threw them to the ground, saying coldly, “You trash dared to provoke my Heavenly Mountain Sect. What if I killed you? Do I need a reason to kill?”
The four young disciples lay on the ground, looking at Lin Yi standing in the distance, all showing panic and fear. They knew they had messed with a formidable being that day.
And at that moment, they finally understood why they hadn’t detected the presence of the figure in the black robe earlier when Lin Yi’s cultivation was still lower than theirs — the figure had already left, hiding in the shadows.
The strength of this figure in the black robe was terrifying; even Lin Yi couldn’t sense his presence. One could imagine how formidable the figure was, probably even more powerful than the Heavenly Mountain Sect’s two elders.
It was even possible that he was a Nascent Soul Early Stage expert, but that was unlikely, since Nascent Soul stage experts didn’t come around easily.
“You… you’re Lin Yi?”
One of the young disciples asked tentatively, looking at Lin Yi with trepidation.
These four young disciples were the same ones who had bullied Lin Yi in the tavern back then, and now that Lin Yi had caught them, they turned pale.
Lin Yi nodded and said indifferently, “That’s correct, I am Lin Yi!”
“You… what do you want to do? I warn you, this is within the influence of our Heavenly Mountain Sect. If you dare to cause trouble, my father will certainly kill you!”
“Kill me?” Lin Yi sneered, “With your Heavenly Mountain Sect? Let’s not even mention your petty cultivation, even those two Nascent Soul Stage experts can’t do anything to me!”
“What?”
Upon hearing these words, the faces of the four Heavenly Mountain Sect disciples drastically changed, fear evident in their eyes as they looked at Lin Yi, unable to believe that he could actually defeat those two Nascent Soul Stage experts. It was simply unimaginable.
But this was the truth from Lin Yi; even if their parents joined forces, they might not be a match for him. This was a fact.
“Impossible, you could not possibly defeat those two Nascent Soul Stage experts!” One of the Heavenly Mountain Sect disciples shook his head, a trace of horror flickering deep in his eyes.
“Don’t waste your energy struggling, you can’t escape!” Lin Yi said coldly, “I would advise you to surrender without resistance, otherwise, I will have to slay you all!”
After speaking, his body flickered as he charged into the crowd, sending several young men flying.
“Boom!”
A burst of brilliance flared as Lin Yi held a silvery-white sword in his hand, slashing toward the four young men.
“Ahhh!”
Instantly, shrill screams echoed through the air.
Lin Yi was incredibly fast, and with each thrust of the Silver Moon Sword, a life was taken. With one swing, four people lay dead on the spot.
“Don’t kill me, please don’t kill me, I am willing to follow you, just please don’t kill me!”
“Ah! My father is Li Hong, an Inner Sect elder of the Heavenly Mountain Sect, he won’t let you get away with this if you kill me!”
All four young disciples were terrified, continuously begging for mercy and trying to use the threat of their fathers to intimidate Lin Yi.
“Even if your fathers really came, so what?” Lin Yi snorted coldly, his wrist turning as the tip of his sword drew an arc and pierced directly through the chest of a young man.
“Ah!”
The young man screamed, clutching his chest as blood kept pouring out. The life in his eyes gradually faded, and he died, utterly dead.
The remaining three were utterly petrified at the scene.
This Lin Yi was too terrifying; they were no match for him at all.
“You three remember this, if I ever find out that any of you dares to bully my junior sister, I will annihilate your entire Heavenly Mountain Sect!” Lin Yi swept his gaze over the four young men and spoke indifferently.
All four of them were shocked and quickly knelt on the ground, repeatedly kowtowing, “We won’t dare again, please spare us!”
Seeing this, Lin Yi nodded slightly, reined in the murderous intent emitting from him, and said coldly, “Fine, now all of you back off. I need to deal with that black-robed figure first, move back!”
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the four of them quickly moved back.
“Hmph!”
Seeing the four men retreat, Lin Yi snorted coldly, his gaze falling upon the black-robed figure as his expression subtly changed.
He could sense that the black-robed figure was powerful, certainly no less than the Golden Core Stage cultivators he had just slain, a master even more formidable than Lin Yi himself.
Moreover, the power was much greater than that of a Golden Core Stage cultivator, definitively multiple times stronger than a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator.

chapters.title: Chapter 680: What Exactly is the Origin?
chapters.content:
Chapter 680: Chapter 680: What Exactly is the Origin?
Lin Yi was able to sense the power of the black-robed figure because they had used a secret technique to conceal their aura, which is why Lin Yi had not detected them sooner.
“What is the origin of this person? How can they be so powerful!”
Lin Yi felt a surge of astonishment and suspicion. As he watched the black-robed figure, his expression grew tense with grave seriousness—he had indeed never seen such an individual before.
“Lin Yi, you want to kill me?” A cold glint flashed in the eyes of the black-robed figure as they spoke, “If you don’t kill me today, then I will have to kill you!”
“Hahaha!”
Upon hearing the words of the black-robed figure, Lin Yi could not help but burst into unrestrained laughter, his gaze haughty as he said, “You want to kill me? What makes you think you have the right to say that? Show me your trump card, or else I will cripple you!”
“Since that’s the case, then let me show you my true power!”
With that said, the black-robed figure extended a hand and violently reached forward.
The hand appeared ordinary at first glance, but it contained a terrifying power that seemed capable of piercing through the void, shattering everything!
“Buzz!”
In the next instant, Lin Yi felt his bones emit a series of brittle sounds, as if a layer of glass had shattered, almost unable to withstand the strain.
“Splurt!”
Lin Yi spat out blood, his body flying backward, crashing against a tree nearby.
“How can this be!” Lin Yi’s face revealed a look of shock; he had not expected the black-robed figure to be so formidable, pushing him to this extent. This black-robed figure was definitely not an ordinary Nascent Soul Stage cultivator!
“No good! This person is too powerful. Even if they have hidden their cultivation, they are still beyond what I can handle!” Lin Yi warned himself internally.
He could feel that the black-robed figure was much stronger than he was; if he didn’t escape, he would surely die here without a chance of luck.
“Swoosh!”
Without a word, Lin Yi transformed into a blur, fleeing towards the distance.
“Hmph!”
Seeing this, the black-robed figure let out a cold snort, a chill of murderous intent flashing in their eyes. Their right hand reached out, fingers spread like five sharp daggers, piercing through space to viciously snatch at Lin Yi, attempting to drag him back.
Lin Yi’s face changed drastically as he sensed the terrible murderous intent within the grasp, his heart pounding with the sense of a life-threatening crisis.
“Damn it!”
Lin Yi cursed inwardly, pushing his cultivation technique to its limit, accelerating to maximum speed. In the moment the fingers closed in, he escaped from his original position, narrowly avoiding the attack.
“Whew!”
Seeing that Lin Yi had narrowly dodged his strike, surprise flickered through the black-robed figure’s eyes.
“Eh, he actually avoided it. No wonder he dares to be so arrogant here!” The black-robed figure’s eyes shone with surprise.
They didn’t truly intend to kill Lin Yi just then, but rather to probe him. After all, Lin Yi’s identity was special, and they needed to figure out which elder of the Nascent Soul Stage from Heavenly Mountain Sect he was closely related to—perhaps they could extract some information from him.
Yet, Lin Yi’s strength was beyond their expectations.
They had thought that they could suppress Lin Yi with a single move, but to their surprise, Lin Yi had managed to dodge it, causing them some astonishment.
“This person’s combat ability is no simple matter!” thought the black-robed figure.
By this time, Lin Yi had finally escaped the pursuit of the black-robed figure and arrived in front of a stele. He kicked it, shattering it, then picked it up.
Clutching the stele, Lin Yi looked at the text in the center, felt a slight movement in his heart, and then stored the stele in his Storage Ring before continuing to fly forward.
The black-robed figure did not pursue, but their eyes, fixing on Lin Yi’s retreating figure, were filled with murderous intent.
Shortly thereafter, his form flashed, and he found himself directly behind Lin Yi. He stretched out his hand, turning his fingers into claws, and grabbed toward Lin Yi’s neck.
“Swoosh!”
However, just as his fingers were about to grasp Lin Yi’s neck, Lin Yi’s figure suddenly vanished into thin air.
“Hmm? Is this a Teleportation Talisman?” The figure in the black robe furrowed his brows, utterly astonished.
“I’ve said it before, you must die today!”
At that moment, a chilling voice arose beside the ear of the figure in the black robe, causing his complexion to abruptly change.
“Whoosh!”
As he came to his senses, a piercing gust of wind assaulted him, and Lin Yi’s fist had already appeared in front of him, sending him flying with a brutal blow!
The figure in the black robe crashed to the ground, coughing up a mouthful of fresh blood, his face deathly pale, shock written all over it.
“How did you do that?”
He truly couldn’t comprehend what had just happened. How could this youth’s speed be so astonishingly fast that he could appear before him in an instant? It was simply inconceivable and utterly baffling!
“Hehe, this is a secret technique, not something you mortals could understand,” Lin Yi taunted with a sneer and then charged at the figure in the black robe.
His Physical Body Power was unmatched, and his speed had reached a terrifying degree. As he swung his iron fists, they were trailed by blurs, pummeling the figure in the black robe with a momentum akin to thunderous force.
“Hmph!”
The figure in the black robe let out an angry roar. He ferociously swiped his right hand at Lin Yi’s iron fist, attempting to block it, but to his dismay, he failed!
“Boom!”
A tremendous, muffled boom resounded as the figure in the black robe was hammered right in the chest by Lin Yi’s iron fist.
“Crack!”
A crisp sound echoed through the heavens.
After Lin Yi’s iron fist struck the chest of the figure in the black robe, a sound of shattered bones burst forth, turning the robe-wearer’s face ghostly white as blood seeped from the corner of his mouth. His chest heaved with turbulent Qi-Blood, and his face turned pale.
“You!”
The figure in the black robe’s gaze trembled as his face darkened to the extreme.
Although Lin Yi had only used eighty percent of his strength, the sheer power of it surpassed even that of a Peak Early-Stage Nascent Soul cultivator, potent enough to blow up a mountain with a single punch!
“My strength is much greater than you imagined. No matter what secret technique you use, you’re still going to die!”
Lin Yi’s expression turned grim as he hadn’t expected to so easily injure a Peak Nascent Soul Stage cultivator with his punch.
His strength was far greater than that of a Peak Early-Stage Nascent Soul cultivator. If he were to use the Sixthfold Divine Skills of the Fourth Layer from the Divine Phoenix Technique, he could even burst a Peak Nascent Soul Stage cultivator’s body into a cloud of blood mist with a single punch.
“Hmph, no matter what secret technique you have, today you’re destined to die!” the figure in the black robe snorted coldly, his complexion so dark it seemed it might drip water.
The figure’s form suddenly turned into a swirl of black mist, enveloping his body in inky vapors that emanated thick black Qi, akin to an apparition.
“Whoosh!”
Lin Yi’s gaze intensified as he frantically looked around, trying to find traces of the man in black, but saw nothing.
“Could it be my imagination?” Lin Yi frowned, filled with doubt.
But at that moment, the man in black suddenly emerged from a boulder beside him, extending his arm, grabbing Lin Yi’s neck, and yanking him off the ground only to fiercely slam him back down, shattering the solid rock beneath them.

chapters.title: Chapter 681: Fell Into a Mess
chapters.content:
Chapter 681: Chapter 681: Fell Into a Mess
“Puchi,” the figure in the black robe spat out another mouthful of fresh blood, his complexion becoming even paler.
Lin Yi was thrown into disarray, feeling dizzy. He quickly steadied himself, narrowing his eyes as he glared at the black-robed figure in front of him, his expression darkening.
“You actually managed to dodge my Soul Searching Technique?”
The black-robed figure’s face was unsightly as he stared at Lin Yi, a hint of fear flickering in the depths of his eyes.
“Soul Searching Technique?”
Hearing these three words, a shiver ran down Lin Yi’s spine.
“Could it be that you’re from the Demon Clan?”
“That’s right, I am of the Demon Clan, and more so, I am the sworn enemy of you human Cultivators. Lin Yi, you might as well give up your life obediently!”
With a cold laugh, the black-robed figure’s body suddenly trembled, black mist swirling around him as his skin instantly turned dark and shiny, as if cast from black metal, filled with a terrifying murderous aura that was suffocating.
The black qi emanating from him merged with the surroundings, making it impossible to detect his presence, but Lin Yi knew this was a sign of his growing Cultivation.
“So, you are a Demon Wolf!”
Lin Yi watched the black-robed figure warily.
This Demon Wolf’s aura was truly terrifying, far surpassing the realm of the later stages of Nascent Soul.
“Knowing I’m a Demon Wolf, why don’t you just surrender?”
The black-robed figure shouted coldly, his eyes icy.
“Expecting me to surrender without a fight? Dream on!” A cold glint flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes. He knew the black-robed figure from the Demon Wolf Tribe was powerful, and he wasn’t foolish enough to think he could defeat a Demon Wolf. He simply gave up struggling, letting the black-robed figure take control of him.
“You little brat have some sense,” the black-robed figure remarked, his expression softening slightly.
“Speak, who exactly are you?” Lin Yi asked indifferently, not showing any fear despite being captured by the black-robed figure.
After hearing this, the black-robed figure’s gaze wavered, seemingly wary of Lin Yi’s strength.
“Fine, since you want to know, I’ll tell you. My name is Mo Long!”
The black-robed figure slowly said, “Thousands of years ago, the Human Clan allied with the Demon Race to attack the Demon Clan, seizing the Demon Clan’s territories and forcing all of its people into the Demon Realm. Since then, the Demon Clan has been living in obscurity, hidden in these desolate mountains, passing down their legacy from one generation to the next.”
Lin Yi was shocked upon hearing this.
Thousands of years ago, that was just shortly after his birth.
He never imagined the Demon Clan had been lurking beside him for millennia. Were his strength not formidable, he likely would have become a puppet of the Demon Clan long ago!
“Is your Demon Clan really that powerful?” Lin Yi inquired.
“Indeed, our Demon Clan was established by the combined forces of the Human Clan and Demon Race. Moreover, over the years, both the Human Clan and Demon Race have been steadily growing in power. Were it not for the sparse Spiritual Energy in the Demon Realm, they would have likely surpassed the Demon Clan by now!” Mo Long snorted coldly.
“I see, but even if your Demon Clan is strong, we of the Human Clan have the Nine Heavens Academy, and your Demon Clan can’t do anything to us!” Lin Yi said lightly.
“Hmph! What is the Nine Heavens Academy? If it were truly capable, the Human Clan and Demon Race wouldn’t have been so desperate as to rely on the Demon Clan for protection. Moreover, not many of the disciples from the Nine Heavens Academy are that strong!” Mo Long snorted.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s expression became slightly strange, but he said nothing.
After all, this was his first time stepping into Human Clan territory.
The Nine Heavens Academy, within the entire Tianzhou, could only be considered a second-rate power. Compared to the Demon Clan, the gap was indeed significant.
“Young man, I advise you to hand over your storage ring obediently, and perhaps I’ll spare your life!” Mo Long sneered, his gaze fixed on Lin Yi as he spoke coldly.
Lin Yi’s expression grew slightly heavy, his eyes coldly fixated on his opponent, “Are you truly forcing me to strike you down? Do you not fear death at my hands?”
“Hahaha, if you kill me, you won’t survive either!” Mo Long laughed loudly, “If you dare to kill me, our Demon Clan will surely come out in full force, attacking the Jiuzhou Holy Academy, massacring the Human Clan and Demon Race, making their blood flow like rivers, leaving no peace for even chickens and dogs!”
Hearing Mo Long’s words, Lin Yi’s face turned even colder.
“Very well, then just wait.”
Lin Yi sneered, saying, “I’d like to see if your Demon Clan truly has the ability to annihilate us!”
“Heh, you won’t shed tears until you see your coffin, kid. Let’s see how arrogant you can be!”
Mo Long roared, his body shaking as the evil aura inside him surged wildly, turning into black fog that enveloped him.
Following that, his aura climbed higher and higher, and in the blink of an eye, he had broken through the peak of the later stages of the Nascent Soul Stage, reaching the Great Perfection of the Nascent Soul Stage.
The Great Perfection of the Nascent Soul Stage was equivalent to the peak of the later stages of the Divinity Transformation Stage!
Lin Yi’s pupils contracted sharply, feeling the surging power within Mo Long and that overwhelming evil aura, his heart clenched violently.
The Great Perfection of the Nascent Soul Stage was definitely more terrifying than the Great Perfection of the Divinity Transformation Stage.
“Kid, let’s see how long you can remain arrogant!”
Mo Long laughed loudly, forming hand seals with both hands, driving the Demonic Qi in front of him, turning it into a huge black palm print.
Boom!
The tremendous palm print struck the ground, causing the earth to shake violently.
The land was barren, with only a deep crater left by the impact.
“Die!”
Mo Long shouted, his body erupting in a dazzling black light, as the huge black palm print whistled through the air, smashing down towards Lin Yi with a terrifying pressure that twisted the air itself.
“Die!”
Lin Yi shouted, a purple glow appearing on the surface of his body, likewise a giant palm print surged forward to meet the black palm print, colliding with it.
With a series of thunderous noises, the black palm print instantly disappeared into the void. Lin Yi’s body trembled, a trickle of blood spilling from the corner of his mouth as he slid backward several steps before finally coming to a halt.
“How can this be?”
Lin Yi was dumbstruck.
He had thought that he had pushed his power to the limit and should have been able to slay the figure in the black robe, but unexpectedly, the figure was so formidable that a mere casual palm strike had injured him.
“You little bastard, let’s see where you can run to this time!” Mo Long said ominously, waving his hands and instantly sending two more pitch-black hand seals slamming towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s face grew solemn.
These two pitch-black hand seals contained terrifying energy fluctuations, and even an average Foundation Establishment Cultivator could hardly escape doom, to say nothing of Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi!”
At this critical moment, a familiar voice reached his ears.
“Master!”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s gaze suddenly shot upwards. He saw a figure in white appearing out of nowhere, none other than Lingxiao Sword Venerable.
Lin Yi’s face lit up with excitement, he rushed to say, “Master, you’ve finally arrived!”
Lingxiao Sword Venerable scanned his surroundings, his eyebrows slightly furrowed, and soon his expression turned extremely ugly.
He saw that around the spot where Mo Long stood, a huge Formation had been cast, shielding against the black hand seals that were hammering down, unable to penetrate.
On the periphery, and near Mo Long, there floated two figures in the air, the old man whom Mo Long had killed and his two disciples.

chapters.title: Chapter 682: The Spell Changes in Hand
chapters.content:
Chapter 682: Chapter 682: The Spell Changes in Hand
Lin Yi saw this and his eyes flickered slightly.
“You little bastard, today is your day of death!”
Mo Long snorted coldly, changing the spell in his hand. Black demonic flames tumbled and transformed into a three-zhang-long black spear, thrusting violently at Lin Yi.
Seeing this, Lin Yi dared not neglect, hastily summoning the Crimson Blood Sword to block the spear, then striking the cloaked figure with a fist, shattering it.
“Plurgh!”
Mo Long spat out a mouthful of fresh blood and staggered.
Lin Yi pressed his advantage, brandishing the Crimson Blood Sword, chopping off one of Mo Long’s arms. Blood splattered out and drenched the ground.
“You little bastard, how dare you injure me, I will kill you!”
Mo Long roared in anger, his body suddenly leapt, jumping directly into the mid-air, looking down at Lin Yi from above.
“You little bastard, I will let you know the consequences of offending our Demon Clan!”
Mo Long sneered, the black spear in his hand trembling. Carrying a terrifying murderous aura, it stabbed towards Lin Yi.
“Hmph, let’s see if you’re capable!”
Lin Yi snorted, circulating the Spiritual Power within his body, the Crimson Blood Sword burst into dazzling golden light.
“Heavenly Slash Sword Technique, first style, Extinction of Heaven and Earth!”
Lin Yi cried out lowly, and with one slash, a gigantic heavenly sword descended from the sky, cleaving at Mo Long.
“Just as expected from the first style of the Heavenly Slash Sword Technique, this power is just like a Divine Sword, its might far beyond your imagination!” Mo Long’s face turned dark, his eyes flashing with intense light, as he retreated rapidly.
“Think you can run? No way!”
Lin Yi sneered, the Crimson Blood Sword shot out sword beams, instantly penetrating Mo Long’s back and a massive heart was propelled from his chest cavity.
Mo Long’s eyes bulged, his mouth gaping, he tried to cry out, but found himself unable to speak, his gaze gradually dimming.
In the end, Mo Long’s body slowly fell from the sky.
“Master!”
Lin Yi’s face suddenly changed, transforming into a streak of light as he quickly dived towards the falling figure.
“Kid, trying to leave?”
On the other side, a man in a blue robe suddenly appeared beside Lin Yi, pummeling him with a fist.
Lin Yi’s face changed slightly, hurriedly dodging with his movement technique.
But the blue-robed man was too powerful, and as soon as Lin Yi dodged, the man reappeared behind him.
“Boom!”
The man landed a punch on Lin Yi’s back, knocking him forward as he spat out fresh blood and his body flew backwards, crashing to the ground and kicking up a cloud of dust.
“Ptooie!”
A mouthful of scarlet blood sprayed out of Lin Yi’s mouth, staining the soil red.
“Is this the extent of your strength?”
Lin Yi wiped the blood from his lips, looking up at the blue-robed man with a hint of wariness in his eyes.
The blue-robed man hovered in mid-air, looking down at Lin Yi below.
“Kid, if it weren’t for some good fortune you’ve had, you would have been killed by me long ago, would it be your place to provoke me now?”
“Is that so?”
Lin Yi sneered, “Well I’d like to see what kind of methods you have that can kill me!”
The blue-robed man’s eyebrows knit slightly: “I’ve already told you, do not foolishly oppose me, but you insist on being stubborn, so don’t blame me for being heartless and ruthless!”
No sooner had his voice fallen than a terrifying aura exploded from the body of the blue-robed man, enveloping the entire sky.
“Rumble!”
As the blue-robed man’s aura was released, the sky suddenly thundered, and countless electric snakes danced wildly.
The clouds in the sky quickly gathered together to form a vast net, like a black hole, engulfing Lin Yi on the ground below.
“Rumble!”
“Ah!”
“Crack!”
“Crack!”
A series of deafening sounds thundered across the sky, with streaks of lightning splitting the night, illuminating the stars above for a moment, an incredibly terrifying sight.
The world was pitch-black, save for the constant dance of lightning that lit up both the heavens and the earth.
Lin Yi found himself amidst it all, feeling the pain that racked his body, his eyes narrowed into slits.
“Boy, just accept your death peacefully, you simply cannot withstand my divine skills!” roared the man in the blue robe, his voice echoing through the heavens and earth, resounding far and wide.
“Divine skills, you say? I am eager to see what they are, to be so bold as to strut before me!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, waving his right hand. The Five Elements condensed in his palm into five sharp daggers that, against the backdrop of the night, glinted with a cold and chilling light that made one shiver.
“Whoosh!”
The daggers broke through the air, heading straight for the man in the blue robe.
“Trifling tricks!”
The man in the blue robe snorted disdainfully, reaching out with his right hand and grabbing at the Five Elements in the void, seizing them firmly in his grasp.
“Boom!”
“Hum!”
With a forceful squeeze, the man crushed the Five Elements with ease.
“What?!”
Lin Yi’s eyes widened in shock.
This man in the blue robe was formidable indeed; the Five Elements were the foundation of his cultivation in the Five Elements Techniques, and yet the other had crushed them so easily.
Could the man also be a master of the Nascent Soul Stage?!
Lin Yi was immensely shaken, but at that moment, he did not panic. Instead, he retreated explosively, preparing to flee.
He was no fool; if the opponent could crush the Five Elements barehanded, it meant he possessed a physical strength far superior to Lin Yi’s. Such a formidable foe was definitely not someone he could handle at the moment.
Lin Yi fled, his figure flickering and vanishing repeatedly, leaving the man in the blue robe unable to pinpoint his location for a time.
“Hmph, I refuse to believe that I can’t catch you!”
The man in the blue robe cursed angrily, stepping into the void and speeding forward rapidly.
As he chased after Lin Yi, the man in the blue robe wielded his divine skills to attack, crushing all the surrounding vegetation to smithereens.
For a time, the valley was strewn with severed limbs and broken bodies.
“Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!”
One muffled thud after another rang out, as Lin Yi’s body was struck by flying rocks, blood spurting wildly, yet he still desperately flew onwards.
“Rumble!”
Suddenly, a purple thunderbolt struck down, sending Lin Yi’s body flying and crashing to the ground, his body convulsing non-stop and his clothes torn to shreds.
“Puh!”
Lin Yi coughed up a large mouthful of blood again, his face deathly pale from severe injuries.
“Hmph, I refuse to believe that this won’t kill you!”
The man in the blue robe bellowed, unleashing an extremely fierce divine skill. A gigantic ring appeared around his body, shimmering with a brilliant metallic luster, as if containing a power that struck terror into hearts and dared not be underestimated.
“Rumble!”
The ring spun twice above Lin Yi’s head before crashing down on him with the speed of lightning.
“Rumble!”
The ring collided with Lin Yi’s body, smashing him deep into the earth.
“Cough cough…”
A copious amount of blood spilled from Lin Yi’s mouth, his face as pale as death. He had sustained extremely serious injuries, his Qi-Blood in complete turmoil, and his body paralyzed from the impact.
Lin Yi gritted his teeth, struggling to rise from the ground, looking up at the sky with a fierce light in his eyes, “Man in the blue robe, just you wait, one day, I will avenge today’s humiliation!”

chapters.title: Chapter 683: 683: The Icy Gaze
chapters.content:
Chapter 683: Chapter 683: The Icy Gaze
The man in the blue robe snorted coldly, disdainfully saying, “Little beast, although your strength is not bad, in front of this old man, you are but an ant! Even if you flee to the ends of the earth, this old man will find you and make your life worse than death!”
The gaze of the man in the blue robe was icy cold, with a thick intent to kill as he looked down at Lin Yi on the ground. The murderous intent in his eyes grew more intense, as if he could hardly wait to have Lin Yi flayed and quartered.
Lin Yi’s strength was not weak, but in front of him, he was less than an ant.
Deciding in his heart, the man in the blue robe resolved that after dealing with this little mongrel, he would personally capture this little beast and slowly torture him to death.
With this thought, the figure of the man in the blue robe flickered, turning into a wisp of Qing Yan that dissipated into the night, leaving silently.
…
“Huff Huff…”
Lin Yi gasped as he stood up, his gaze icy as he stared at the receding figure of the man in the blue robe, his face filled with anger and killing intent.
“Damn old coot, once I break through to the Nascent Soul Stage, the first thing I will do is to kill you!”
Lin Yi was filled with indignation, but what he didn’t know was that the man in the blue robe had already ingrained him in his heart.
…
Lin Yi left the forest and entered an abandoned, desolate city. The city walls had largely collapsed, and all that remained were some broken walls and ruins. The city was a mess, and the air was filled with the foul stench of rot.
This city was an abandoned ancient town that was once a cultivator’s place of cultivation, but now, it had been taken over by others.
“Swish!”
Lin Yi’s figure dashed, swiftly entering a residential house.
“Young man, where are you from? Why did you run into our village?”
An elderly woman in her sixties or seventies lay on a bed inside the house. She appeared weak and frail, her face covered with dust and wrinkles, making her look extremely gaunt.
“I come from outside,” Lin Yi said indifferently.
The elderly woman nodded, a worried look in her eyes as she said, “Alas, you better leave quickly, this place is not safe!”
Lin Yi shook his head at her words, saying, “Granny, don’t worry about me, I’m not in danger.”
“Alas…” the elderly woman sighed and said, “I know you are no ordinary person, but this place is too dangerous. You should leave quickly and stop concerning yourself with us.”
“Granny, I’m here looking for someone. Could you tell me if there is a young man named Li Yu in your village, and where he is?” Lin Yi asked.
The elderly woman was taken aback, looking at Lin Yi with confusion, “Why are you looking for Yu’er?”
“Yu’er? Is he your grandson?” Lin Yi’s eyebrows knitted slightly, thinking to himself, “Could it be I’ve guessed wrong, and that Li Yu is not a person from our village but a disciple of another group?”
“Yes,” the elderly woman nodded and said, “Yu’er is, indeed, my grandson. He disappeared a month ago, and it’s been nearly three months since he last returned to the village. Everyone is very worried. I hope you can find him quickly.”
“Disappeared? What happened?” Lin Yi wondered, but he didn’t continue to ask the elderly woman about Yu’er and instead left the house, heading outside the village to look towards the village.
“This village has been occupied by these people, and the villagers, unwilling to mix with them, all fled,” the elderly woman said, sitting on the bed with a touch of sadness in her eyes.
Lin Yi’s gaze swept around the village and finally settled on the mountain range to the northeast of the village, a trace of sharpness flashing deep in his eyes.
“The village chief’s place is there. Let’s go, I’ll go check it out first.”
With that, Lin Yi’s body moved, heading toward the northeast direction of the village.
Before long, Lin Yi arrived at a cave, an ancient and weathered one, filled with the fluctuations of Formation Restrictions, clearly unattended for a long time.
“Is this the village chief’s home?”
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly, a chill flashing in them.
“The village chief’s home is in the south of the village. I need to head south for a distance to see if there are any other villages.”
Lin Yi thought to himself.
“Whoosh!”
Lin Yi’s figure leaped forward, directly jumping into the cave.
“Swoosh!”
Lin Yi darted through the cave, and shortly after, he arrived inside a courtyard.
“Indeed, there is a strong Restriction aura here, no wonder all the villagers are trapped within this ancient castle.”
Lin Yi speculated silently in his heart, then he activated his Divine Sense, exploring the surroundings.
“Hmm?”
Suddenly, Lin Yi’s gaze sharpened, fixing on a particular direction, his lips slightly parting.
