There, stood a stele, with an inscription that read, “This stele is a Heavenly Stele, containing endless Profound Mysteries. One can comprehend the Profound Mysteries within it. If one can gain the inheritance of these Profound Mysteries, their Cultivation will increase significantly!”
“The Heavenly Stele, comprehend the Heavenly Stele!”
“Haha! Heaven truly aids me, I’ve been fretting over how to uncover the secrets of this ancient city, and to think the village chief would actually place the Heavenly Stele here, it’s practically delivered to my doorstep!” Lin Yi was thrilled with excitement.
The Heavenly Stele is a Heavenly Stele, the highest category within heavenly steles, containing many wonders. However, the ancient city was nothing but ruins without any treasures, so Lin Yi did not bother studying those other heavenly steles, but headed straight for this stele.
“Swoosh!”
Lin Yi approached the stele and gently patted it.
“Buzz!”
Suddenly, a strange fluctuation spread out, and a vague figure appeared on the stele, wearing a black robe and a conical hat, with a tall and straight stature, exuding a terrifying pressure that made one feel suffocated.
“It’s him, the village chief!”
Lin Yi’s pupils constricted as he stared at the blurry figure before him.
The figure resembled that of an old man, but it emitted fluctuations that made Lin Yi’s heart palpitate, giving him a profound sense of danger.
“This is a Cultivator!” Lin Yi inwardly exclaimed, with shock in his eyes.
His Divine Sense probed, and he discovered that the person on the stele had unexpectedly reached the later stages of the Foundation Establishment!
“How formidable!”
Lin Yi privately thought, “Who exactly is this person? Why would he appear here? Did he see me? If he’s a Cultivator, why hasn’t he concealed his aura?”
“No, that’s not right! This aura, he truly isn’t a Cultivator!”
Lin Yi suddenly realized something, his heart pounding, his eyes filled with shock and dread.
“He must have hidden his presence; otherwise, my Divine Sense would not have failed to detect his existence.”
Lin Yi pondered over this person intently, sensing a hint of threat.
This person could very well be a fearsome Super Powerhouse in the Mahayana Realm; otherwise, he would never have escaped his Divine Sense and evaded its probing.
“It seems I need to be cautious this time. However, since this person has set up this place as a village, he must have his concerns.”
“If I can identify his worries and resolve them, perhaps I can smoothly enter this ancient city.”
Lin Yi contemplated, but he didn’t act immediately because he wasn’t sure how powerful the person before him was. If he acted rashly and angered him, that would be bad.
After a moment of silence, a cold smirk flashed through Lin Yi’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 684: 684: Arrogant and Domineering Aura
chapters.content:
Chapter 684: Chapter 684: Arrogant and Domineering Aura
“Hmph! He’s merely a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator. If I wanted to kill him, it would be as easy as turning over my hand, why should I be afraid?”
Lin Yi sneered in his heart, his aura surging with wild arrogance. He took a step forward and headed into the depths of the cave.
“Whoosh!”
“Bang!”
Suddenly, an extremely sharp attack came from the side, carrying a terrifying gust of wind and violently striking Lin Yi, causing him to stagger back several steps, blood spilling from the corner of his mouth, his body trembling, with his clothes torn and ragged.
“Who’s there!?” Lin Yi roared angrily.
“Boom!”
At that moment, a figure slowly stepped out of the darkness, a man in a green shirt appeared in Lin Yi’s vision.
He had handsome features, eyes cold as ice, and the corner of his mouth held a cruel smile. With one stride, he crossed hundreds of meters of distance, appearing right in front of Lin Yi.
“It’s him, it’s actually him again!”
As Lin Yi recognized the man’s face, a sharp light flashed in his eyes.
This man in the green shirt was the white-haired old man Lin Yi had encountered outside!
While Lin Yi did not remember his face, he remembered the man’s aura, because it emitted a pressure that thrilled Lin Yi’s heart!
“You are the one who just entered the village. I didn’t expect you could make it here, quite impressive!” the man in the green shirt said, his tone calm.
“You’re the village chief!”
Lin Yi’s expression changed.
Although he did not recognize the man in the green shirt, he could be certain that this man was no ordinary cultivator. The aura he exuded was definitely that of a Tribulation Crossing Realm cultivator, and not just any cultivator, but one at the peak of that realm.
The peak of the Tribulation Crossing Realm was an extremely formidable existence. A mere flick of his hand was enough to slay an ordinary Core Formation cultivator, and even killing a cultivator at the early stage of the Tribulation Crossing Realm was no issue at all.
“Correct,” the man in the green shirt nodded lightly.
“Since you’re the chief of this village, I want to ask you why you expelled everyone from the village and turned it into this state?” Lin Yi asked.
“Hehe, so that’s what you wanted to ask. It’s simple. Thousands of years ago, an ancestor of our village trespassed into the territory of a member of the Demon Race. His strength was too great, we of the Human Clan had no way to contend, so we sealed up this village, letting it slowly decline,” the man in the green shirt explained with a smile.
“Demon Race?”
Lin Yi’s eyebrows rose.
“You know of the Demon Race?” the man in the green shirt asked, somewhat puzzled.
“Of course! I not only know of the Demon Race, but I am also their sworn enemy!” Lin Yi sneered, his eyes filled with a cold murderous intent.
“Oh? You are the sworn enemy of the Demon Race? Then why didn’t you kill him and instead saved him?” the man in the green shirt inquired.
“Because he is the reincarnation of the Demon Emperor. I do not wish to confront him head-on,” Lin Yi said coldly.
“I see.”
The man in the green shirt nodded, then added, “I advise you not to meddle in the affairs of our village, otherwise I will not be polite to you.”
“Hehe, I also have a warning for you, it’s best not to harbor the intent to kill me. Should you dare to make a move against me, even if you are the reincarnation of the Demon Emperor, I wouldn’t mind scattering your soul to the winds!”
Lin Yi glared coldly at the man in the green shirt, his aura bursting forth with extreme sharpness. With one step, the entire cave trembled violently, as if it could collapse at any moment.
“Hmm?”
The man in the green shirt frowned.
“Hmph! A mere ant dares to speak to me with such an attitude. Since you wish to die, then I shall grant your wish.”
A chilling killing intent flashed through the man in the green shirt’s eyes as he reached out with his right hand and grabbed at the air, conjuring a Qingfong Sword. A fierce sharpness radiated from the sword, causing Lin Yi’s hair to stand on end and sending stabbing pains throughout his body, making him extremely uncomfortable.
“Pfft!”
With a flick of the sword, a beam of sword light slashed toward Lin Yi’s chest at an extreme speed, like a meteor falling, too fast to describe.
Lin Yi’s gaze sharpened as he chose not to confront it head-on. Instead, he shifted his body to the left, narrowly avoiding the sword light.
“Whoosh!”
The sword light grazed past Lin Yi’s body, leaving a deep mark on the mountain wall and even cleaving it open.
“So fast!”
Lin Yi was startled.
Although the man in the green shirt was not a Foundation Establishment cultivator, his speed was so fast that it took Lin Yi by surprise. Furthermore, his swordsmanship was extremely cunning and tricky, leaving Lin Yi somewhat caught off guard.
“This guy, he’s definitely a master, and a strong one at that.”
Lin Yi was inwardly shocked.
“What did you just say?”
At that moment, the man in the green shirt suddenly spoke, staring coldly at Lin Yi, “Enemy of the Demon Race? Don’t you know that the Demon Race has already been annihilated? You actually want to kill him now, could it be that you wish to provoke a war between him and me?”
“Heh, an enemy of the Demon Race?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but laugh.
“How could I possibly be an enemy of the Demon Race? I’m just an ordinary passerby. How could I have any relation to the Demon Race?” Lin Yi said indifferently, “Your talk of an enemy of the Demon Race, is there some misunderstanding?”
“Humph, do you think you can fool me with your words? Let me tell you, no way! The hatred of the Demon Race cannot be provoked by anyone; if you are an enemy of the Demon Race, then today I must eradicate you completely!”
“Haha! Eradicate? If you want to kill me, you better weigh your own capabilities,” Lin Yi scoffed with disdain.
“Hmph, then today I will test your weight!”
The man in the green shirt gave a cold shout as his aura burst forth like a volcanic eruption, instantly reaching the early stage of the Tribulation Crossing Realm. His presence was wildly ferocious, making Lin Yi feel suffocated.
Lin Yi’s eyes flickered; he could clearly sense the terror of the man in the green shirt. If he were to compare himself, he would likely fall far short.
But Lin Yi was also extremely intelligent and steadfast in mind, knowing that he was not on the same level as his opponent, and certainly not his match. Therefore, he was not about to seek death.
He sneered inwardly, ignoring the other’s threats.
“What, scared now?”
The man in the green shirt seemed to sense Lin Yi’s thoughts and taunted, “If you submit to me now, I can spare your life. But if you continue to be stubborn, I will have to slay you here to avoid you ruining my plans!”
At these words, Lin Yi burst out laughing.
Is this person brain-dead? Does he truly not know Lin Yi’s identity?
Lin Yi might not know, but his master certainly did!
“Heh, reincarnation of the Demon Emperor? How have I never heard of such a title? Could it be that you’re trying to deceive me?”
The man in the green shirt sneered, utterly disbelieving that Lin Yi could be the reincarnation of the Demon Emperor.
He well knew that the reincarnation of the Demon Emperor was a peerless talent not seen in eons, with overwhelming cultivation and extraordinary abilities. How could someone be casually addressed as the Demon Emperor?
Moreover, even if he truly were the reincarnation of the Demon Emperor, what of it? He stood backed by a powerful being, whose cultivation far surpassed Lin Yi’s, and with Lin Yi merely at the Bone Tempering realm, he was no match in any case!
“You don’t believe it? Good! Then I will prove it to you!”
Lin Yi was too lazy to explain any further.

chapters.title: Chapter 685: 685: Early Stage of Tribulation Crossing
chapters.content:
Chapter 685: Chapter 685: Early Stage of Tribulation Crossing
His aura suddenly soared, and the spiritual energy in his dantian went into a frenzy. A golden dragon-shaped phantom appeared, its brilliance dazzling, and its claws swinging fiercely as if a Divine Dragon had come into the world. He launched a punch towards the man in the green shirt.
The man in the green shirt’s pupils shrank, and his heart tightened.
He had never expected Lin Yi to conceal such strength!
Given that his own cultivation was at the early stage of Transcendance Tribulation, only half a step away from Foundation Establishment, under normal circumstances, Lin Yi should have had no chance of being his opponent. Yet now, things were different.
“Such tremendous power, truly worthy of the Demon Emperor’s reincarnation!” the man in the green shirt thought, shocked. Meanwhile, a glint of greed flashed in his eyes.
He was indeed wary of Lin Yi’s power, but not because he feared it—rather, he wanted to take Lin Yi as his servant, to become his own subordinate.
In this way, he could control the other’s life and death at will, turning him into his puppet!
The force of Lin Yi’s strike was peerlessly powerful, with a might supreme enough to tear through the void itself.
However, Lin Yi had not made his move with full force.
He was no fool. Although the man in the green shirt was only at the early stage of Transcendance Tribulation, he was nevertheless a peak powerhouse at that stage. If Lin Yi killed him outright, it would likely attract a lot of trouble.
Therefore, in making his move, he did not unleash his full strength but simply pushed his physical power to the extreme.
Boom boom boom…
The man in the green shirt exchanged several tens of moves with Lin Yi, but still Lin Yi maintained the upper hand, leaving his opponent increasingly astonished.
This guy’s strength was simply too incredible!
It should be noted that he ranked eighth among the Demon Race. Moreover, he practiced a special cultivation technique, making his own cultivation more formidable than others. Despite this, he could not suppress the other as easily as Lin Yi did or even gain the upper hand against Lin Yi.
This was simply unbelievable!
“No, I must capture him quickly!”
The man in the green shirt gritted his teeth, his figure moved, transforming into a mass of black clouds, shooting straight into the sky, chasing after Lin Yi to kill him.
“Heh, you’re no match for me; just surrender quietly,” Lin Yi said with a smile, his voice full of confidence.
“How arrogant!”
The man in the green shirt sneered repeatedly, his speed getting faster and faster, catching up to Lin Yi in the blink of an eye.
“You wish to run? Then I shall send you to your demise!”
The man in the green shirt roared, stretching out both palms. A swirl of Yin Yang Dual Qi tumbled between his hands, slapping towards Lin Yi.
Yin Yang Dual Qi is the origin of everything, possessing extreme corrosiveness. Even Demon Beasts at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, upon encountering it, could have their physical bodies corroded away, turning into pus and vanishing from this world!
Lin Yi’s complexion changed slightly. He hurriedly performed the Nine Palatial Movement Technique to dodge the attack of the man in the green shirt and leaped out, hiding within a towering ancient tree.
“Eh? He actually fled!” The man in the green shirt’s brows furrowed, obviously not expecting Lin Yi to have dodged his attack.
“Not bad at all, avoiding my attack like that. Impressive, truly worthy of the Demon Emperor’s reincarnation, but, your strength is still not enough!”
The man in the green shirt scoffed coldly, his hands forming seals, and the Yin Yang Dual Qi roiled ceaselessly. It condensed between his palms and quickly formed the Yin Yang Twin Swords.
Raising his right arm, the man in the green shirt released the Yin Yang Twin Swords as a ray of light shooting towards Lin Yi. The sword qi was imposing, carrying a chilling intent to kill that made Lin Yi’s hair stand on end!
Lin Yi didn’t dare to be negligent, throwing both fists out to fiercely collide with the Twin Swords!
Clang clang clang…
As Lin Yi clashed with the Yin Yang Twin Swords, intense sounds erupted, but the sharpness of the Twin Swords was even more formidable than Lin Yi had imagined. They actually tore through Lin Yi’s fists and aimed straight for his chest!
“Damn it!”
Lin Yi’s expression greatly changed, he hadn’t expected the Yin Yang Twin Swords to possess such terrifying might.
But he was no pushover either. With a single movement, his figure suddenly vanished from the spot, dodging the attack of the Yin Yang Twin Swords, and then with a powerful kick, a vast explosion of force erupted, fiercely striking the swords!
Thud!
A muffled sound traveled outward.
“Hm? You actually managed to dodge the swords’ attack, not bad, but let’s see how you dodge this!”
A cold smirk appeared at the corner of the man in green’s mouth. He clapped his hands together and two more Yin Yang Twin Swords condensed into being, carrying a dense malevolence as they shot towards Lin Yi from two different directions!
“What a devious move, actually capable of using the swords’ might to amplify their power!”
Lin Yi’s expression darkened, his eyes sparkled, suddenly he smiled and said, “How about this—if you return the swords to me, I will let you go, how about it?”
Upon hearing this, the man in green let out a scornful laugh, “I will not return the swords to you! Unless you die!”
The man in green huffed coldly, waving his arms, the Yin Yang Twin Swords transformed into a streak of light shooting towards Lin Yi, their speed growing even faster.
“If that’s the case, then I won’t hold back!”
Lin Yi’s expression turned icy as he punched out, sending the Yin Yang Twin Swords flying, then his figure flickered, charging straight at the man in green. An Overlord Fist blasted forth, a vast and majestic force surged outwards, enveloping the entire void, causing the primordial energy of heaven and earth to twist!
“What?!”
The man in green’s face turned pale with shock as he sensed Lin Yi’s punch barreling towards him, a strong sense of danger welling up inside him.
“Shatter for me!”
The man in green roared furiously, swinging his arms, condensing two Yin Yang rivers between his palms, enveloping the Yin Yang Twin Swords, continuously rotating and grinding against them. However, the swords were too fast and simply unstoppable.
Before long, the Yin Yang Twin Swords broke through the blockade of the dual rivers, hammering towards Lin Yi’s chest.
Lin Yi’s face tensed, he performed a series of hand seals, casting out three formation runes.
These were three ancient formation runes, emitting a faint purple mystical glow. They kept revolving between Lin Yi’s palms before ultimately forming a Third Grade Formation.
This was a Third Grade Formation that Lin Yi had just recently started to learn.
As the formation came into existence, three massive stone platforms appeared out of nowhere, positioned in front of Lin Yi, shielding his body.
“A Third Rank Formation?! Impossible!”
The man in green shouted, his eyes bulging with disbelief as he stared at Lin Yi’s formation.
These stone platforms were part of the Third Grade Formation he had just finished setting up. He considered himself among the top figures of formation masters, yet Lin Yi’s cultivation in formations had already reached such a level.
This was utterly astonishing; how many years had Lin Yi cultivated for his cultivation in formations to be so high?
“Impossible!”
The man in green bellowed, his eyes shooting out two beams of cold light, his body emanating a sky-high killing intent!
“Since that’s the case, then I shall take you down first!”
The man in green’s figure flashed, charging towards Lin Yi. His speed was even faster than the swords, flashing to Lin Yi’s side in an instant, both hands grasping the Yin Yang Twin Swords as he sliced down towards Lin Yi’s neck.
Seeing this, Lin Yi was equally unyielding. His hands tightly clenched into fists, he hammered towards the man in green’s hands.
Both fists collided with each other, and instantly, a terrifying shockwave of force swept out, causing the surrounding void to tremble, as cracks began to appear in the fabric of space.
“Crack!”
A crisp fracturing sound came from Lin Yi’s fist, followed by droplets of blood spurting out, sprinkling downwards and staining the ground red.

chapters.title: Chapter 686 - 686 Not Afraid in the Slightest
chapters.content:
Chapter 686: Chapter 686 Not Afraid in the Slightest
“Your strength is commendable, to be able to resist the power of my two Magical Treasures, but with such strength alone, you stand no chance against me!”
The man in the green shirt gave a cold laugh and struck out at Lin Yi with his palm.
“Though you are powerful, it won’t be easy for you to kill me!”
Lin Yi’s gaze was icy, showing no fear whatsoever.
Boom!
The next moment, the man in the green shirt’s attack landed on Lin Yi, sending him flying through the air in an arc before crashing heavily into the ground, causing a hundred-meter tall hill to collapse.
“Lin Yi!”
Seeing this scene, everyone’s faces changed as they shouted in alarm.
“It’s nothing, just some minor injuries. Don’t worry about me!”
Lin Yi spat out a mouthful of blood, stood up, and shook his head.
“Lin Yi, are you alright?”
“Lin Yi!”
Li Ruoxi, Zhao Qian’er, Li Mengqi, and others asked anxiously.
“I’m fine, don’t worry. I won’t let them hurt you.” Lin Yi dusted the dirt off his clothes and looked toward the man in the green shirt, his face darkening.
“Lin Yi, this person is very strange. Don’t confront him head-on, or you’ll definitely be at a disadvantage!” Zhao Qian’er warned.
Lin Yi nodded and said, “Don’t worry, I understand. No matter how powerful this man in the green shirt is, today, he will not leave here alive!”
A chill flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes as he locked his gaze on the man in the green shirt and began to walk slowly toward him.
“What are you trying to do? Do you still think you can resist?”
Seeing Lin Yi approaching, the man in the green shirt’s expression changed slightly. He could feel that Lin Yi truly wanted to kill him!
“Resist? That’s not it at all!” Lin Yi shook his head and declared, “Today, I will kill you!”
Lin Yi spoke with extreme determination, as if harboring a will to execute his intent without fail.
At these words, the man in the green shirt was taken aback and then burst into a loud laugh.
“Lin Yi, you are too arrogant. Do you really think you can kill me? I am a freak of a generation, a genius with exceptional talents. After several decades of cultivation, within the Martial Saint Realm, I have hardly met any match. Even when facing a Martial Emperor, I can hold my ground. Moreover, you’re already injured; you simply cannot kill me!”
The man in the green shirt spoke arrogantly, his body possessed by an extremely violent power that seemed ready to burst forth!
Inside the man in the green shirt was a roaring demon beast, ferocious in appearance with bared teeth and claws, emitting an overwhelming malicious aura!
His skin was dark green, and a greenish mist emanated from his body. Wisps of smoke rose up, clearly the result of being corroded by poison, which was nauseating to behold!
“Just a Three-Star demon beast, what’s there to boast about? You think I can’t kill you?”
Lin Yi let out a cold laugh as a powerful aura exploded from him. A mass of black and blue Demonic Qi surged upwards, enveloping his entire body like a giant black hole, concealing Lin Yi’s true form from sight.
“What is this?!”
The man in the green shirt’s face changed drastically, displaying a look of shock.
The black and blue Demonic Qi swirling around Lin Yi felt eerily familiar to the man, as if it was a power similar to his own!
What in the world was going on?
“This is the Five Elements Demonic Technique I’ve comprehended. Once activated, it can summon a demon lord within me! This is a unique ability of mine that you cannot possibly imagine. Now, I’d like to see just how strong your Cultivation really is!” Lin Yi said coldly as he stared at the man in the green shirt, the murderous intent on his body growing even more intense.
The man in the green shirt felt a chill in his heart as he sensed the dense killing intent emanating from Lin Yi and his face involuntarily changed color.
This was an extremely dangerous person, his battle experience vast beyond measure, he saw through Lin Yi’s true strength at a glance.
This guy was no simple matter, not only had his Cultivation reached the Peak of Martial Sovereign, but his combat power was also exceedingly formidable, which he found hard to believe!
“Kid, since you’re so powerful, I will grant you an opportunity!”
The man in the blue shirt turned his eyeballs, as if he had thought of something, suddenly cracked a smile, “But before that, you must pay the price with your life!”
He suddenly lifted his right foot, drawing a blue circle in the void, then stamped his foot fiercely onto the ground.
A strong wave emanated from under his foot, transforming into blue orbs of light, enveloping his right leg completely, plunging his entire being into a bizarre state!
Seeing this, Lin Yi frowned slightly, sensing the destructive power contained within those blue orbs, he couldn’t help feeling alarmed!
“Five Elements Escape Technique·Five Elements Dragon Escape!”
The man in the blue shirt roared, his right foot stomping down hard, and the ground shook violently as a blue light flickered and charged towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi was shocked and hurriedly used the Five Elements Dragon Escape to dodge the man’s attack in the blink of an eye.
Five Elements Escape Technique, escaping through the five elements, fast as a shooting star, lightning-speed movement!
Lin Yi’s figure vanished from that spot, the blue orbs shot past, striking the valley floor, creating a deep pit, the soil overturning, the ground cracking!
The speed of Lin Yi’s Five Elements Dragon Escape was incredibly fast, leaving a long trail behind in the sky.
The man’s expression changed as he swiftly moved on the spot, dodging the incoming Five Elements Dragon Escape!
“Bang bang bang…”
One thunderous boom after another rang out, the blue orbs hurtling forward, destroying Lin Yi’s Five Elements Dragon Escape and forcing the man back.
“Is this your so-called trump card? It’s far too weak!”
In a flash, the man appeared beside Lin Yi, his right fist carrying a terrifying wind, and he slammed it towards Lin Yi.
Seeing this, Lin Yi refused to show weakness, swinging his fist as well to clash head-on with the man’s!
Their fists collided, emitting a grating sonic boom, the explosion of light illuminating several yards around them!
“Puh!”
A spurt of fresh blood sprayed out as Lin Yi was sent flying backward, crashing to the ground with a thud.
“How is this possible, I was actually defeated by him?”
Lin Yi looked incredulously at the front of his shirt, where a massive fist imprint had appeared, faint Demonic runes shifting on it, instilling dread!
“How could this be?!”
“How did Lin Yi lose?”
The surrounding Cultivators were all stunned; Lin Yi’s loss was beyond their expectations, it even gave them a sense of the absurd.
The man in the blue shirt looked down at Lin Yi, his face colored with a hint of mockery.
“Hahaha, Lin Yi, that’s all you amount to, such a weak attack and you are already defeated! To me, someone like you is nothing but an ant, easily squashed with a single punch! You could never kill me!” the man taunted.
“You talk too much, it’s time to end this!”
Lin Yi stood up, his face dark and grim.
“Kill!”
A glint of icy intent flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes, his figure flickered, and he appeared in front of the man, then he suddenly raised his fist and smashed it down hard towards man’s head.

chapters.title: Chapter 687: A Face of Disbelief
chapters.content:
Chapter 687: Chapter 687: A Face of Disbelief
The man in the green robe sensed the horrifying aura emanating from Lin Yi that made his heart palpitate. He swiftly dodged, but still, it was too late. Lin Yi’s punch landed fiercely on his forehead, smashing the man’s head to pieces.
“Bang!”
The man’s physical body was annihilated by Lin Yi’s punch!
Lin Yi’s body flashed, reappearing in the distance.
“Green Robe Senior Brother is dead?”
“How did this kid do it? He’s clearly just at the peak of Martial Emperor, so why could he effortlessly slay Green Robe Senior Brother?”
The crowd was utterly shocked, their faces filled with disbelief as they stared at the scene.
They had never imagined that Lin Yi would counterattack so forcefully, killing the man in the green robe, chilling their hearts with dread!
“Green Robe Junior Brother, dead!”
The man in the white robe flickered with complicated emotions in his eyes, looking at Lin Yi with a sense of wariness.
He never expected that in just half a year, Lin Yi’s progress would be so immense, possessing such combat power that even he felt a shiver of fear.
“This kid cannot be left alive. If he continues to grow, he will create endless problems for us. He must die!” said the man in the white robe, his gaze coldly fixed on the distant youth, wishing to kill him immediately.
The death of the man in the green robe had completely enraged Lin Yi, bringing a surge of killing intent to his heart!
Lin Yi’s figure moved swiftly, rushing towards the group of green-robed disciples.
Upon seeing this, the green-robed disciples promptly fled.
Lin Yi snorted coldly as his hands manipulated a spell. The Yuan Force within him whirled crazily, streams of golden light circulating in his body, as dazzling, brilliant Sword Qi condensed around him.
“Sword Qi! This kid’s Sword Qi has actually been cultivated to such a level!”
“It’s too terrifying. This is the first time I’ve seen someone elevate their Sword Qi to this extent, this kid is simply a monster!”
“Run, don’t stay here!”
Scared out of their wits by this sight, everyone quickly fled from the area.
Seeing Lin Yi approaching, the green-robed elder did not care about face and, with a flash, disappeared before Lin Yi.
Seeing the green-robed elder flee, Lin Yi’s expression turned cold, but he no longer paid attention to the green-robed disciples, instead continuing his pursuit of the elder.
Although the green-robed elder possessed profound strength, he was ultimately only a Martial Ancestor realm Martial Artist, no match for Lin Yi. In front of Lin Yi, he was like a fly, unable to escape.
The green-robed elder was relentlessly pursued by Lin Yi, eventually stopping.
“You little beast, don’t think you can kill me today. Even if I have to fight to the death, I will kill you!”
The green-robed elder’s eyes shot out cold beams, as his figure suddenly sped up, rushing in front of Lin Yi. He raised his right palm and struck towards Lin Yi.
“Boom!”
Lin Yi, fearless, countered the green-robed elder’s punch, his body abruptly sent flying several meters away.
The green-robed elder’s face changed slightly, his eyes revealing a flash of shock. He had not expected Lin Yi to withstand his punch and even rebound it, which surprised him.
The green-robed elder cursed inwardly. He had not expected this young man’s strength to be so monstrous. It seemed he had met his match, and this would not be easy to resolve!
“Green Robe Senior Brother! Run!”
Seeing this, the crowd shouted one after another.
Hearing their cries for help, Lin Yi’s mouth curled into a cruel smile. His figure flashed, charging once more at the green-robed elder.
“Green Robe Senior Brother, this fool does not know life from death. You must not let him off!”
“Green Robe Senior Brother, this man must be killed!”
All the people cried out in unison, excitement evident on their faces.
The formidable strength of Lin Yi filled everyone with a touch of despair, but they were not willing to give up just like that.
“This kid is indeed powerful, but if you can’t kill me, I’ll exhaust you to death, even if it takes my last breath. I don’t believe I can’t outlast you; let’s see whose patience is greater!”
The man in the green shirt gritted his teeth, his facial muscles twisting as strands of black mist rose from the surface of his skin, turning his entire face so dark that it was unbearable to look at directly.
The aura of the man in the green shirt surged upward, and a towering pressure emanated from his body.
“This is… this is a Heritage Secret Technique!”
The man in the white robe’s face suddenly changed drastically, his heart shaking.
“Brother in the green shirt actually used the Heritage Secret Technique!”
“Brother in the green shirt actually succeeded in cultivating the Heritage Secret Technique!”
The faces of the crowd were filled with astonishment. They all knew how formidable the Heritage Secret Technique was; once deployed, it was extraordinarily powerful and terrifying!
The man in the green shirt’s strength had become much greater than before, his momentum overwhelming, with black mist wafting from his body, stirring fearsome fluctuations.
With a palm strike toward the void, the void itself shook violently, an invisible force spreading in all directions, space rupturing, endless spatial turbulence raging like a series of gigantic volcanic eruptions, terrifying in its might, striking fear into the hearts of all.
Lin Yi’s expression changed, and he quickly retreated backward.
“Boom boom boom!”
“Bang bang bang…”
The spatial turbulence swept in, breaking hundreds of ancient trees nearby into dust, and thick vines burst out from the ruins, twisting toward Lin Yi to strangle him.
Lin Yi’s brow furrowed, his hands swept across, and a sharp Sword Qi materialized out of thin air, sweeping across and severing the vines, tearing them into dust. Then, with a wave, a vast sword shadow swept out, slashing horizontally toward the man in the green shirt.
“Clang!”
The sword shadow collided with the black mist, making a metallic clash, and sending out dazzling sparks.
“Hmm? Blocked it?” The man in the green shirt was surprised to see his attack parried by the sword shadow.
A hint of astonishment flickered in Lin Yi’s eyes. He had not expected the man in the green shirt’s attack to possess such terrifying force that even a Low-Grade Spiritual Artifact would struggle to withstand it, yet the man in the green shirt had easily defended against it.
This greatly shocked him and made him even more certain that this man in the green shirt was a Martial Emperor.
“No wonder the man in the green shirt is so powerful, so he’s a Marshal Emperor!”
“This guy really lucked out, encountering a Martial Emperor powerhouse. Otherwise, he’d never have escaped the man in the green shirt’s pursuit!”
“Thank goodness the man in the green shirt was distracted by this guy, otherwise, he’d surely be dead by now!”
Having witnessed the fearsome prowess of the man in the green shirt, everyone’s eyes bulged with terror, feeling endlessly relieved.
“Kid, this is a Bloodline Secret Technique our Heavenly Demon Valley has inherited for countless years, you can’t possibly withstand it. Just give up and be captured!” the man in the green shirt said with a cold smirk, looking at Lin Yi.
“Is that so? I don’t think I’ll fall to you!”
Lin Yi’s lips curled into a smile, his figure flickered, and he closed the distance to the man in the green shirt in an instant. A domineering punch landed on the man’s chest, sending him flying backward.
Spurt!
The man in the green shirt vomited blood, his face deathly pale. He stared at Lin Yi furiously, his eyes filled with viciousness, “Damn you, you dared to hurt me, you’re dead meat!”
The man in the green shirt’s face went livid, his eyes bloodshot, burning with fury, wishing he could tear Lin Yi into a thousand pieces.
Lin Yi watched him coldly, saying, “For now, I’ll spare your life, but sooner or later, I will come for you.”
“Hmph, talk about it when you have the ability, just hope you don’t fall into my hands!” the man in the green shirt’s face darkened as he snorted coldly and disappeared in a flash.

chapters.title: Chapter 688 - 688 Staring to Lock On
chapters.content:
Chapter 688: Chapter 688 Staring to Lock On
The old man in the blue robe left, and Lin Yi let out a sigh of relief, feeling a wave of fear in his heart.
Just now, he had executed the second form of Overlord Fist, converging all his Primordial Energy, Spiritual Energy, and the strength of his Physical Body into his right arm, bringing his body to a new peak.
If he hadn’t done so, he certainly wouldn’t have been able to withstand that move of Overlord Fist a moment ago, and he would have been strangled into nothingness by those frenzied vines.
After the old man in the blue robe left, Lin Yi reined in the killing intent on his body and returned to the spot where he had stood before the crowd.
Seeing the old man leave, everyone’s eyes were filled with wariness.
The terrifying strength of Lin Yi’s Physical Body had left everyone in the crowd utterly awe-struck.
Although the old man in blue was powerful, he was no match for Lin Yi’s Physical Body, and Lin Yi had injured the old man in their first encounter.
Such power made everyone take notice.
After injuring the old man in blue, Lin Yi turned his gaze to the other two elders in blue robes.
The two elders felt a shiver run through them as Lin Yi’s icy gaze locked onto them, causing their bodies to tremble slightly, and fear to rise in their hearts.
“Boy, I’ll let you off today, but you’d better not show your face on this continent again!”
“We’re sparing you this time, but our Heavenly Demon Valley will definitely not let you off!”
Seeing Lin Yi staring at them, the two hurriedly spoke up to warn him, their tone cold and merciless.
“Hah, nor will I spare any of you from the Heavenly Demon Valley, because you all deserve to die!” Lin Yi said coldly.
“You’re asking for death!”
“Scoundrel!”
Enraged by his words, the two elders burst out with a fierce aura and charged at Lin Yi.
The two attacked from the left and right, trying to encircle and kill Lin Yi.
Their attacks were terrifying and powerful, presenting Lin Yi with a tremendous crisis.
“Kill!”
Lin Yi shouted coldly, swinging his fists to meet them head-on, fending off both attacks, and using the rebound force to swiftly retreat.
Seeing Lin Yi resist their combined attack, the old man in the blue robe and the other two were taken aback, their faces filled with awkwardness, and they cursed inwardly, calling the youngster too sly since he didn’t fight them head-on!
“You two intercept that kid; I’ll go after this little beast!”
“Alright, leave it to us!”
The two elders nodded at each other and quickly split up to chase after Lin Yi.
Seeing this, Lin Yi felt elated in his heart.
It was just as he wanted, for them to split up.
“Swoosh!”
He employed the shrinking ground into inches technique, stepping on void, and in the blink of an eye, his trace vanished.
“Chase!”
One of the elders sped up and instantly caught up with Lin Yi.
“You two old things, you’d better look after yourselves first!”
Lin Yi stopped, turned around, looked at the two elders, sneered, clenched his fists tightly, and smashed a punch towards them.
Seeing this, the elders hastily swung their palm blades to chop down, but Lin Yi dodged and landed a punch unobstructed on one of their chests, directly sending him flying.
On the other side, after punching one elder away, Lin Yi immediately charged at the remaining one and threw another punch.
“Bang!”
The man was hit and flew backwards, slamming hard against a stele, which then shattered to pieces.
“How could this be? How is his strength so formidable? Both of us are no match for him!” the elder in the blue robe was horrified, eyes wide with shock.
“What do we do now, what do we do?” the elder in the black robe turned pale with fright, his eyes filled with despair.
Ignoring their fright, Lin Yi took a step and appeared in front of the elder in the blue robe.
“What, what do you want to do?”
The elder in the green robe exclaimed in alarm, protecting his chest with both hands, as if he were defending his chastity with his life.
“What do I want to do, what do you think?”
Lin Yi sneered, reached out to grab the elder’s shirt collar, then yanked him backward fiercely, flinging him away like trash.
The elder in the green robe hit the ground, his body aching all over, tears welling in his eyes, and blood trickling from the corner of his mouth, evidently severely injured.
Lin Yi snorted coldly, a punch thundering out, smashing the elder’s head to pieces, blood spraying and staining a large swath of ground, a shocking and gruesome sight.
“Phew!”
Having disposed of two elders, Lin Yi took a deep breath, his expression finally turning grave.
Because of the battle with these two, Lin Yi had already sensed the true strength of their power.
“They actually both possess Holy Rank peak cultivation, and have even reached the high-level Realm of the Holy Rank!” Lin Yi was extremely surprised.
One must know that cultivators at the high-level Realm of the Holy Rank are very rare, there might not even be one among a hundred, and those at the peak of the Holy Rank have almost all broken through to the Supreme Realm.
These two’s achievement of Holy Rank peak cultivation was already the limit, going further, they would likely have to cross a huge threshold to become true Supreme Realm powerhouses.
“If they break through to the Supreme Realm, that would be terrible!”
“It seems the only way to eliminate the risk is to kill this person.”
With this thought, Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly as he looked ahead.
“Don’t be arrogant, thief, today you will surely die!”
A person in black clothes flew towards him from a distance, his body flickering mid-air at an incredibly fast speed, instantly appearing in front of Lin Yi.
“It’s him!”
Seeing this, Lin Yi frowned.
He hadn’t expected to encounter him again.
This person in black was none other than the man who had previously tried to kill him.
“That’s right, it’s me!” The man in black looked at Lin Yi with eyes full of chilling murderous intent.
“So you’re the one who wants to kill me. I haven’t even come to settle the score with you, and now you’ve delivered yourself to my doorstep!” Lin Yi sneered.
“You’re seeking death!”
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the man in black’s eyes shrank slightly, a cold glint flickering at the bottom of his eyes.
“Since you seek death, I shall grant it!”
“Swoosh!”
Lin Yi’s form flashed, appearing directly before the man in black, swinging his fist toward the man’s head.
The man in black, seeing Lin Yi’s move, hastily dodged, but it was still a step too late. He was hit by Lin Yi, sent flying, and slammed hard into a stele. The stele crumbled, dust rose, and his body tumbled out from the stele and fell to the ground.
“Pfft!”
The man in black spat out a mouthful of blood, his body swaying unsteadily, his complexion deathly pale.
He had just been struck by Lin Yi with a mysterious technique. Although he had blocked it with his arm, he still suffered severe damage. Now he was at the end of his strength and could no longer contend with Lin Yi.
Seeing this, Lin Yi showed a puzzled look and asked, “What’s the matter? How did you get injured?”
“Hmph, you forced my hand!”
“Rumble!”
The man in black suddenly stood up, his expression fierce, and his body exuding a strong aura, as if he had suppressed his injuries and was restored to his original state.
“How is this possible?! He can actually suppress his injuries?”
“No wonder he’s so arrogant, it seems he had already prepared for this, we’ve all underestimated him.”
“It looks like we’re in for some dire straits this time!”
The surrounding elders were all greatly shocked, their faces extremely grim.

chapters.title: Chapter 689: Fatal Heavy Damage
chapters.content:
Chapter 689: Chapter 689: Fatal Heavy Damage
The strength of this man in black was clear to them all; he had already reached the high-level Holy Realm, merely a hair’s breadth from the peak of the Holy Rank.
Although Lin Yi was quite formidable, after all, he had just broken through recently, and he was far from a cultivator of the high-level Holy Realm. How could he possibly withstand the man in black?
Lin Yi looked at the man in black, his eyebrows slightly raised.
“What are you trying to do?”
“You’ll know soon enough!” The man in black sneered coldly, his eyes brimming with intense hatred.
“Boom!”
Once again, he swung a punch toward Lin Yi, the Qi Force surging like a flash flood, sweeping toward Lin Yi, leaving him no chance to resist.
Faced with such a ferocious attack, Lin Yi didn’t dare to resist head-on; his figure trembled and he vanished from the spot, reappearing a hundred meters away.
Lin Yi flashed behind the man in black, pushed off the ground with both legs, and soared into the air. His right fist thundered out, transferring a terrifying force that, with a whistling wind-breaking sound, smashed towards the back of the man in black’s head.
The punch was too fast; the man in black couldn’t even dodge in time, so he could only lift his left hand to meet it.
“Crack!”
“Ahh!”
The sound of bones breaking was followed by a scream of agony.
The arm of the man in black was blasted to pieces by the punch, blood spurted out, and a bloody hole was revealed.
“Hiss!”
Seeing this, the man in black gasped in shock, enduring the severe pain while swiftly retreating several steps, looking at Lin Yi with wary eyes, his face filled with terror.
“You trash!”
Another cultivator at the peak of the Holy Rank cursed in anger and charged forward swiftly, his leg whipping savagely towards Lin Yi’s waist.
This strike was extremely fast; if it hit, Lin Yi’s waist would definitely be broken, and he would be sent flying to the ground, suffering a fatal blow.
“Get lost!”
Seeing this, the man in black quickly pounced over, embracing Lin Yi in a hold, wrapping his arms tightly around Lin Yi’s waist.
Lin Yi leaned back and slapped a palm towards the head of the man in black.
In this move, Lin Yi did not harness his Primordial Energy, but relied solely on the strength of his physical body; naturally, the power was greatly reduced. The man in black couldn’t withstand it at all and was sent flying, crashing down on the ground, spitting out several mouthfuls of blood, his face as pale as paper.
“Hahaha, just as I said, how could a mere Spiritual Embryo Realm cultivator be a match for us; he was easily defeated by me!”
Seeing this, the surrounding cultivators rejoiced, taunting one after another.
“Brother Lin Yi, how are you? Are you hurt? Let me heal you!”
The Third Elder of Qingyun Sect hurried to Lin Yi’s side, helping him up with a look of concern.
“I’m fine, I don’t need your help. You go deal with that man in black, I can hold on a bit longer!”
“Alright, be careful!”
“Rest assured, a mere high-level Holy Rank, they can’t trouble me!”
Lin Yi waved his hand.
Seeing this, the Third Elder of Qingyun Sect could only temporarily abandon the idea of treating Lin Yi and turned his attention to the man in black.
“Little brat, do you think we are so easy to deal with? Just with you alone, even if you defeat us all, you will never be able to revive your mentor!”
“Heh, I’d like to see who gets defeated by whom. Today, your entire force must be annihilated!” Lin Yi’s mouth curved into a mocking arc as he spoke indifferently.
“How audacious!”
“You’re talking nonsense!”
“I think you’ve really gone mad, spouting such arrogant words, it seems like you really wish to court death!”
“You little beast, you truly deserve to die!”
The other Elders scolded one after another.
Lin Yi heard the words, flashed a cold smile, and paid no further attention to the crowd, instead fixing his gaze on the man in black.
“Boy, I admit, you are indeed strong, and you’ve scared me. However, even with your strength, do not fancy escaping from our Qingyun Sect today. Surrender obediently, and I can spare your dog’s life, else I’ll make you regret ever coming into this world!”
The man in black gnashed his teeth, his eyes filled with fury as he stared at Lin Yi and said coldly.
“Is that so?”
Hearing this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but sneer contemptuously. His gaze suddenly hardened, and the aura about him surged to its strongest state, his presence boiling over like a volcano erupting, power flooding the space with overwhelming force.
“Boom!”
“Boom!”
“Boom!”
“Boom!”
…
As Lin Yi’s aura intensified in an instant, those around him felt a crushing pressure enveloping them, as if the weight of Mount Tai bore down upon them, making it hard to breathe.
This pressure was so terrifying it made their souls shiver with fear.
They had never encountered such oppression before.
“Thump! Thump! Thump!”
The few elders knelt down directly, their faces pale as paper, sweat beading on their foreheads, their bodies trembling profusely, breathing heavily, unable to utter a word. They could only lie prostrate on the ground, shaking miserably.
“Not bad, you few still know what’s good for you. Since you’re so sensible, I might just spare your lives. Kneel now and kowtow to apologize, and I might even let you live!” Lin Yi looked at those kneeling and begging for mercy, his face showing a mocking smile while he spoke calmly.
Kneel and beg for mercy?
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, these elders felt humiliated.
All super-strong cultivators of Holy Rank High Level, when had they ever knelt before anyone? But now, faced with Lin Yi’s threats, they were forced to beg for mercy; one can imagine the humiliation in their hearts.
This humiliation filled them with anger and resentment!
“Humph! Dream on!”
“We will not beg for mercy!”
“We’d rather die than kneel to you!”
The five or six elders, teeth clenched, had a look of defiance, preferring to be killed rather than kneeling to beg for mercy.
“Very well, since you are so stubborn, I’ll see you off. Save the trouble of you causing more disasters in the future!” Lin Yi, seeing the five or six elders’ persistence, his eyes flickered with a cold chill as he spoke ominously.
No sooner had his voice faded than he sprang into action, rushing towards the cultivators nearby.
Lin Yi’s movements were unpredictable, like a ghost, his speed reaching the limit. In an instant, he was in front of three elders, swinging a punch that sent them flying.
“Bang!”
“Bang!”
“Bang!”
“Bang!”
…
The three elders smashed through the walls and plummeted underground, blood spraying out, lives hanging by a thread.
“Ah, how can I die like this!”
Seeing Lin Yi’s ferocity, the man in black was taken aback, his eyes bulging open, and he roared ferociously before charging at Lin Yi.
“If you want to kill me, you better weigh if you’re worthy!”
Watching the man in black charge towards him, Lin Yi chuckled coldly, his eyes glinting with a frosty light.
Lin Yi’s speed was astonishingly fast. He threw a punch, carrying with it the might to tear heaven and earth apart, rending the space and forming a fist imprint that smashed toward the man in black.

chapters.title: Chapter 690: Fists Collide
chapters.content:
Chapter 690: Chapter 690: Fists Collide
“Bang!”
The black-clothed man’s Fist Force collided with the fist imprint, erupting with a deafening roar. Following that, his body was blasted away, blood spewing from his mouth as his face displayed a look of horror and despair.
“How… How is this possible?”
“This kid’s Physical Body is actually so formidable, he actually withstood an attack from the high level of Holy Rank, impossible, how is this possible!”
The black-clothed man looked at the dark silhouette flying into the distance, his heart filled with intense unwillingness and shock, his eyes brimming with disbelief.
“I had already warned you, yet you chose not to believe. If you kneel and kowtow to admit your mistake now, maybe I will consider sparing your lives. Otherwise, don’t blame me for being merciless!”
Lin Yi stood in mid-air, looking down at the black-clothed man, speaking in an even tone.
The black-clothed man’s eyes, filled with dark intent, stared fiercely at Lin Yi, his gaze overflowing with boundless hatred.
“Since you are stubbornly courting death, then you can only go to die!”
Lin Yi’s eyes were incredibly sharp; his body suddenly swelled, becoming extremely huge, like a mountain. His aura was overwhelming, as if a Demon King had descended!
“Boom!”
“Boom!”
“Boom!”
Lin Yi’s feet stomped, his form as swift as lightning, catching up to the black-clothed man. His fists thundered out one after another, the wind from his punches howling, incredibly destructive, making the black-clothed man extremely flustered and unkempt.
“Ah, what kind of Demon Beast are you, to be so powerful?”
“Ah!”
The black-clothed man screamed in agony under Lin Yi’s beating, his body scarred with several deep, bone-exposing wounds, blood flowing profusely, a ghastly sight to behold, agony extreme. Yet Lin Yi continued relentlessly, his Fist Force raining down like a storm.
Under Lin Yi’s assault, the black-clothed man accrued several more wounds, drenched in blood, his predicament beyond wretched.
He could bear it no longer, his body trembling violently as he let out a pitiful wail.
“What are you others waiting for, hurry up and kneel, head-butt the ground, admit your wrongs!”
“Exactly, we can only choose to admit our mistakes now, otherwise, we really will end up buried here!”
“No, I refuse to kneel, I will never kneel!”
Seeing the heavily injured, pathetic state of the black-clothed man, the remaining four elders’ faces changed dramatically, their eyes filled with terror as they roared out.
“Since you are seeking death, then I won’t be polite anymore, die!”
Lin Yi sneered, the murderous intent on his face was undisguised as he pounced towards the black-clothed man.
Lin Yi’s Realm had reached the Perfection of Martial Sovereign, but his true strength was not limited to this.
“No… Ah!”
The black-clothed man let out a wretched scream as his body shot backwards, crashing violently into the ground, creating a deep pit, blood gushing wildly, dying his whole body red.
Looking at the man lying there, barely alive and no longer capable of resistance, the complexions of the other elders turned exceedingly grim, their bodies shaking involuntarily.
“Who… who exactly are you, how do you have such terrifying strength?”
“Yes, how can you possess such formidable power?”
“Could it be that you are…”
One of the elders seemed to have thought of a very bad possibility; his complexion changed drastically, and he suddenly retreated.
The other two elders were also visibly shocked, their bodies trembling violently.
They were not fools; they naturally understood that Lin Yi’s survival in their hands was no fluke.
“Now, it’s your turn!”
Lin Yi paid no heed to the remaining four elders, his gaze fixating on the last three elders.
“No, don’t! Please, don’t kill me. As long as you spare my life, I’ll agree to your demands!”
One of the elders looked at Lin Yi with a Pale face, shaking as he spoke, his eyes filled with terror and fear.
Upon hearing this, the faces of the other two elders instantly turned into a picture of panic and unrest.
“Spare you? Heh, when you killed my family, when you murdered my parents, why didn’t you think of sparing me then?” Lin Yi said with a wry smile, his voice dripping with cold derision.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the remaining three elders turned ashen, their bodies trembling violently, clearly terrified.
Lin Yi’s parents had been killed by their own hands. Had it been anyone else, they might have gone mad, but Lin Yi did not. Instead, he had become even stronger, now possessing such terrifying strength.
“Who exactly are you, and why do you have such dreadful power? We don’t know you at all, where did you come from?”
“That’s right, who are you, and how can you have such formidable power?”
One of the elders asked, his voice quivering with doubt.
“You dared to kill my family, you dared to murder my parents. Don’t you know who my parents were? Even the head of the Imperial Sect would have to respectfully call me a senior. And you dared to lay a finger on them; you truly deserve to die!”
Lin Yi’s tone was gloomy, exuding a chilling aura, and he emitted an unmatched killing intent that made one’s heart quake.
“What, your parents were…”
Another elder’s expression froze, his eyes reflecting shock, then his face revealed a hint of fear and regret as he quickly begged for mercy, “Senior, you are generous and forgiving. We realize our mistake now; we truly do!”
“Senior, please forgive us!”
The other two elders also looked at Lin Yi with faces full of fear, incessantly pleading for mercy.
They finally understood why the younger disciples had been so terrified of Lin Yi; they were simply no match for him.
Moreover, they now realized that they had made such a foolish mistake. Not only had they failed to deal with this youth, but they had also provoked such a terrifying enemy. It was essentially a death sentence!
“Hmph, you’ve come to your senses now? But sadly, it’s too late!”
Lin Yi said with a cold snort as he looked at the pleading elder.
Then, he swung his arm, and golden flames burst from his right hand, immediately enveloping the remaining two elders.
“Boom!”
The two elders were wrapped in flames and instantly turned to ash, their bodies disintegrating without a trace, their deaths terribly gruesome.
Watching the two elders vanish into ash, a grim killing intent flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes before he turned and left.
After Lin Yi left, the elder who had been incinerated by Lin Yi’s flames was forgotten in the ruins, completely disappearing without even leaving residue behind.
A night passed and the sun rose gently, shining upon the land, reviving all things with life, teeming with a scene of thriving prosperity.
In a luxurious mansion somewhere in the city, a middle-aged man sat in the chief seat, his face marked with seriousness as he looked down at the numerous elders below.
“Who exactly was that young man yesterday?”
“That young man was too powerful; we had no strength to resist at all, and he even said that he was an elder of our Holy Religion. Who is he really?”
“Who exactly is this young man?”
“I am not clear either, but I felt a sense of familiarity from him, as if I had experienced it somewhere before, but I can’t remember where exactly it was.”

chapters.title: Chapter 691: Fallen into Deep Thought
chapters.content:
Chapter 691: Chapter 691: Fallen into Deep Thought
“Could it be that I’ve seen him somewhere?”
“Maybe, I can’t quite remember either, after all, it’s been a long time.”
“Hmm, perhaps I really have seen him somewhere.”
Listening to his subordinate’s report, the middle-aged man fell into deep thought.
After a long while, he slowly opened his eyes, a glimmer of contemplation flashing in them, and said, “If I remember correctly, that young man seems to be one of the hidden Great Elders of our Holy Religion, called Lin Yi.”
“Lin Yi? How did he come to be in our Holy Religion, and why is he so formidable?”
“I’m not sure, but I’m certain that this matter must be Lin Yi’s doing, otherwise, how could he be so strong?”
“But wasn’t he in secluded cultivation? How could he possibly make a breakthrough?”
“Indeed, he was clearly a waste, and his cultivation aptitude was very poor, how did he manage to make a breakthrough?”
“Could it be a blessing in disguise?”
“Perhaps.”
The other elders discussed in low voices, their faces filled with intense shock.
“Lin Yi, Lin Yi, is he that Lin Yi?”
An odd light flickered in the middle-aged man’s eyes as he murmured to himself.
“Lin Yi’s rate of cultivation is very fast, and his combat experience is also extremely rich; he’s the most outstanding among us.”
“If it weren’t for his low cultivation and weak strength, we would not have ended up in such a sorry state!”
“What should we do now? Just let him keep causing trouble in the Holy Religion?”
“Hmph, no matter what, our Holy Religion is a huge entity, not comparable to ordinary forces. Even if Lin Yi has the backing of that Lin Family ancestor, we have nothing to fear. Moreover, Lin Yi has no backing now!”
“Exactly, Lin Yi has no backing, he’s just a kid who has recently stepped into the Martial Venerable Realm, we don’t need to be afraid of him. As soon as the Great Elder makes a breakthrough, we’ll be able to suppress him easily!”
“That’s right, when we band together, it will be a piece of cake to deal with that kid!”
“Haha, exactly, if we join forces, we will definitely suppress Lin Yi and make him pay for his arrogance!”
Hearing the discussions of his subordinates, a hint of excitement surfaced in the eyes of the middle-aged man. He then turned to an elder and instructed, “Send a message for me, call for the Great Elder, we need to discuss a plan on how to deal with Lin Yi!”
“Understood!”
The elder took the order and left.
As the elder departed, a storm aimed at Lin Yi was slowly brewing.
…
Lin Yi was unaware of the matters concerning himself, as he was still troubled over how to break through the Martial Sovereign Realm!
His physical body had already reached the Martial Sovereign Perfection, but his cultivation had yet to break through, his physical body was so strong that it had reached a bottleneck.
To break through the Martial King Realm, he needed to shatter this bottleneck to have any hope.
But his cultivation was so poor that it was impossible to impact the Martial King Realm.
So, Lin Yi decided to strike while the iron was hot. He aimed to first improve his cultivation to the Martial Monarch level and then attempt to break through the Martial Sovereign Realm.
With this in mind, Lin Yi immediately entered secluded cultivation, ready to enhance his strength and improve his cultivation as quickly as possible to break through the bottleneck.
He sat cross-legged on the bed, running his cultivation technique, stimulating the Yuan Force within his body to madly surge toward his Dantian, starting to merge into his Nascent Soul.
“Hum!”
In his Nascent Soul, the mysterious Nascent Pill trembled slightly and then burst into a brilliant and dazzling light, absorbing the Yuan Force in Lin Yi’s body and converting it into its own energy.
After devouring Lin Yi’s Yuan Force, the glow on the surface of the Nascent Pill became even brighter, shining like a proud sun.
Lin Yi’s Nascent Soul was also crazily absorbing the Spiritual Energy of heaven and earth, turning it into Yuan Force that surged into his body, causing his Cultivation to climb steadily, breaking through the bottleneck in one go and reaching the Martial Master Peak.
“I’ve broken through, finally broken through—I’ve finally ascended to the Martial Warrior Realm!”
Lin Yi was secretly thrilled in his heart, his heart thumping non-stop, and his face was filled with a joyous smile.
Although he had known that his breakthrough would surely be extremely difficult, perhaps requiring many long years, at this moment, he couldn’t help feeling immensely excited.
After all, all this had come too fast, and he had made rapid progress!
“Hoo~”
Feeling the power inside his body, Lin Yi took a deep breath, calmed his emotions, and slowly exhaled a turbid breath, revealing a smile on his face.
This moment, he had finally made a successful breakthrough!
“I’ve finally reached the Martial Warrior Realm, and my strength is so firmly powerful!”
“I finally have the power to protect myself, no longer the pitiable ant I once was, now capable of self-defense!”
The joy on Lin Yi’s face grew increasingly intense.
“All this, I owe it to those people from the Lin Family.”
“If the Lin Family hadn’t been destroyed, I would probably still be the pathetic waste I was.”
“However, now I no longer need to rely on the Lin Family, and this time, my goal isn’t the Lin Family, but the entire Holy Religion of the eastern continent!”
Lin Yi clenched his fists, a sharp look flashing in his eyes.
“However, I still need to find a place to break through, otherwise, with my current strength, I’m afraid it would be difficult to contend with the experts of the Holy Religion.”
A serious look appeared in Lin Yi’s eyes as he thought to himself.
Lin Yi knew that his strength was not yet enough to contend with the Holy Religion, he needed a safe place to enhance his abilities.
“Now, I’ll head over there.”
Thinking this, Lin Yi’s figure swayed, and he disappeared from the room.
And just as his figure vanished, the elders who had been tracking him immediately appeared outside the doorway, looking at the place where Lin Yi had disappeared, a cold murderous intent surfacing on their faces.
“Humph, how dare he break into the Holy City, we will definitely not let him get away with this.”
“This time, our Holy Religion’s strength will surge once more, and then, we’ll annihilate the Lin Family together.”
“Haha, I want to see how many dogs run away this time!”
“Lin Yi, let me be the one to deal with you!”
“Lin Yi, wait for your death!”
These elders of the Holy Religion, being Martial Emperor Level existence, were extremely powerful. They all knew of Lin Yi’s strength, so once Lin Yi escaped, he would definitely pose a great threat to them.
Therefore, they decided that this time, they must eliminate Lin Yi; otherwise, he would bring them huge trouble.
“Swoosh!”
Just then, the elders of the Holy Religion left the room one after another, chasing in the direction where Lin Yi had disappeared.
“Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh…”
The elders of the Holy Religion, each with rapid movement techniques, disappeared from the Holy City in the blink of an eye, pursuing in the direction Lin Yi had fled.
“Humph, these Holy Religion scumbags, if they want to court death, then I’ll give them a surprise!”
Lin Yi returned to his room, immediately locked the door, then sat down cross-legged and started to circulate the “Taiji Yin Yang Technique.”
As he operated the “Taiji Yin Yang Technique,” a light cyan mist started emanating from his skin.
As time passed, this mist gradually increased and eventually merged together, forming a cyan mist that revolved around Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 692: 692 Difficulty Breathing
chapters.content:
Chapter 692: Chapter 692 Difficulty Breathing
The blue-fogged qi looked rather strange, yet the terrifying energy it contained was incredibly shocking, making Lin Yi’s body tremble slightly. He felt as if he was being oppressed by something, making even breathing difficult.
“No, I can’t withstand this level of oppression.”
Lin Yi clenched his teeth, enduring this suffocating pressure with tenacity.
“This should be a tribulation from the Heavenly Dao.”
The thought flashed through Lin Yi’s mind.
“Boom! Rumble!”
Lin Yi felt the pressure inside his body growing stronger and stronger, as if all his meridians were about to burst, causing him excruciating pain, and large beads of sweat appeared on his forehead.
Lin Yi’s face turned pale, his eyes full of pain, and a trace of fresh blood spilled from the corner of his mouth.
“I can’t give up, I must hold on.”
Lin Yi thought to himself, gritting his teeth and getting through this ordeal.
Tribulations, manifestations of the rules of heaven and earth, anyone who faced them would suffer the wrath of thunder if they were the least bit careless, leaving them with no place for their body to rest in death.
These clouds represented the punishment of the Heavenly Dao on the weak; its rules absolutely must not be defied.
Lin Yi’s body was suppressed by the rules of heaven and earth, which meant he had no choice but to endure the waves of tribulation.
However, Lin Yi’s willpower was incomparably strong. Not only did he get through it all, but also, under the tempering of the tribulation, he cultivated the “Yin Yang Technique” to an even higher level, thereby greatly enhancing his strength once again.
“This time, I will definitely overcome the tribulation and step into the Martial Sovereign Realm!”
Lin Yi gritted his teeth and thought.
He also understood that if he couldn’t make it through the tribulation this time, he would have to remain at the Martial King Realm.
“This time, I must hold on!”
“I won’t lose!”
Lin Yi’s eyes brimmed with a frenzied light.
“Roar!”
A roar emanated from Lin Yi’s throat, shaking even the space around him.
A terrible demonic aura started to emanate faintly from Lin Yi’s body.
His eyes were now completely overtaken by the Demonic Nature, making him look like a bloodthirsty demon.
“Rumble!”
Just as Lin Yi was preparing to face the last tribulation of the Bone Tempering Stage, suddenly, the whole void began to shake. Countless dark clouds gathered, and lightning tore across the sky in a wild dance.
“Crack! Crack…”
The thunder exploded, and lightning struck down like giant serpents, spreading out in all directions, turning everything they touched to ashes.
Lin Yi stood rooted to the spot, his body enveloped by dark qi, clearly enduring the baptism of the tribulation.
His whole person was wrapped up tightly, his clothing torn to pieces, leaving only a short-sleeved shirt, showing off his strong, muscular chest.
However, to others, this scene appeared incredibly bizarre and frightening, as if Lin Yi was entwined by a giant serpent, sending chills down their spines.
“I wonder if I can get through the tribulation this time?”
Lin Yi murmured to himself, his heart, however, glowing with hope because he felt he could survive the tribulation smoothly this time.
“Boom!”
As Lin Yi considered his tribulation, suddenly, a lightning bolt descended from the sky, striking fiercely into the ground beside him, scattering sparks and charring the ground black, leaving a huge crater, which was extremely terrifying.
“Hiss…”
Lin Yi gasped in shock—this tribulation was that fearsome!
“Boom! Rumble!”
A powerful oppressive force then surged from all directions, weighing on his body, making his movements excruciatingly slow.
“Rumble!”
Then another bolt of lightning streaked across the sky, hitting the ground near Lin Yi and throwing up a shower of sparks which turned the soil red, emitting a scent reminiscent of roasting meat, whetting one’s appetite.
“Truly worthy of being a heavenly tribulation, such terror.”
Lin Yi looked at the scorched earth beneath him, feeling the temperature around him rising significantly, and he couldn’t help but click his tongue in wonder.
He felt the power within him being constantly consumed. This heavenly tribulation was too strong, its might too terrifying, giving him an inexplicable sense of crisis.
If he couldn’t successfully transcend this tribulation, it was very likely that he would be blown apart alive by its formidable power and meet an untimely death.
However, Lin Yi knew that if he really couldn’t endure it, he would become just a speck of dust in history, just like the three disciples before him.
Lin Yi was not willing to give up!
He was unwilling to choose to give up unless absolutely necessary.
“Whoosh!”
Just as Lin Yi was preparing to continue enduring, suddenly, he felt a gust of wind blow over his head. He abruptly looked up, only to see a pitch-black lightning bolt flashing in the sky, slashing fiercely towards him.
“Ahh!”
Lin Yi cried out, hastily raising his fist to meet it.
“Boom!”
The heavenly tribulation fell, striking Lin Yi’s arm with a fearsome force, instantly exploding with a thunderous roar that made Lin Yi stagger back several steps, nearly shattering his body into pieces.
“Pfft!”
Lin Yi spat out a mouthful of blood, his complexion pale, his legs trembling continuously.
Lin Yi felt as if his bones were about to fall apart.
His body felt as though it had been sliced by a thousand knives, a tearing pain radiating throughout.
But his heart was still filled with reluctance, filled with stubbornness, filled with fighting spirit!
“I will not admit defeat!”
Lin Yi growled, his entire body glowing, radiating blinding golden light, as if he were an indestructible vajra, brimming with infinite vitality.
“Heavenly tribulation? No matter what, I will not easily submit!”
Lin Yi’s eyes burst forth with a sharp glint, and deep within them, a golden flame danced, as if it could burst through his pupils at any moment.
In his eyes, he was no longer a mere mortal, but a true War God, invincible in battle!
“Be extinguished!”
Lin Yi bellowed, his right hand sweeping out, and instantly, a golden palm emerged from within him, transforming into a blazing sun, burning all things in the world.
“Bang!”
The golden palm mercilessly grasped towards the void, tearing it apart.
“Boom!”
The void trembled, and streaks of black lightning fell from it, striking the golden palm, only to be melted away by it in an instant.
Afterwards, the palm directly clutched a bolt of lightning, gripping it fiercely in hand.
Lin Yi’s gaze was fixed on the sky, his eyes flashing with an intense light. The golden radiance around his body grew even more intense, as if the power of the entire world was continually flowing into him.
“Shatter for me!”
With a mighty effort, Lin Yi’s hands tore apart the very fabric of the void.
“Crack!”
The space itself began showing cracks, as if it were on the verge of shattering.
“Good!”
A sharp light burst forth from Lin Yi’s eyes; he had finally succeeded!
“Boom!”
At that moment, another bolt of lightning appeared in the sky above, slashing viciously towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi clenched his fists and launched a punch straight into the sky, colliding with the bolt of lightning.

chapters.title: Chapter 693: 693: Not Crossing the Heavenly Tribulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 693: Chapter 693: Not Crossing the Heavenly Tribulation
“Boom!”
A violent explosion sounded as the purple orb was blasted into nothingness by a punch from Lin Yi, turning into a purple mist that disappeared without a trace.
With this strike, Lin Yi ultimately didn’t make it through. He had failed to pass the heavenly tribulation.
“Boom! Boom! Boom!”
Just as Lin Yi’s body was about to collapse, five great mountains appeared behind him, enveloping him within their presence.
The five mountains each took a position, blocking his limbs, waist, shoulders, and other vital points.
The thunder struck these mountains, producing a series of explosive sounds, making the mountains tremble as if they were about to crumble at any moment.
“Crack! Crack! Crack…”
Finally, the mountains could not withstand the attack of the heavenly tribulation. They all cracked under its fury, and Lin Yi himself could no longer bear the terrifying might of the heavenly tribulation. Blood spewed from his mouth as he fell straight from the sky.
“Ah!”
Lin Yi crashed to the ground, his body struggling violently, emitting scream after scream.
“Rumble!”
In the sky, several more claps of thunder from the heavenly tribulation sounded, sending Lin Yi flying once again, crashing onto the mountains in the distance.
“Boom! Boom!”
Lin Yi, struck by terrifying bolts of lightning, rolled over and over across the landscape, leaving destruction in his wake.
Lin Yi’s injuries were severe; his entire body was covered in blood, and he was at his last gasp as if he would completely perish the next second.
“Brother Lin!”
“Lin Yi!”
“…”
Seeing this scene, all the disciples were stunned, each one panicking, unable to believe what was happening before their eyes.
They originally thought Lin Yi was undoubtedly doomed since his Cultivation Realm was too weak to withstand the power of the heavenly tribulation, but to their surprise, Lin Yi forcibly bore it.
“Brother Lin Yi has actually withstood the heavenly tribulation; he really withstood the attacks of the tribulation!”
“He’s too powerful, too defying!”
“Brother Lin Yi is indeed peerlessly talented. I said it before; he is the most monstrous genius of our academy. How could he perish so easily! He’s bound to successfully transcend the tribulation!”
A crowd burst into excitement, looking at Lin Yi, who was riddled with injuries from the lightning, with tears brimming in their eyes.
Although, in their hearts, Lin Yi had done nothing wrong and had even saved them, under the heavenly tribulation, they still hoped that Lin Yi could successfully transcend it.
After all, the more powerful Lin Yi was, the better he could protect them.
“Hahaha, he did it, he succeeded!”
Suddenly, Chen Feng was overwhelmed with excitement, holding his head with both hands and laughing ecstatically.
“I knew I saw it right. Brother Lin Yi indeed has the potential to transcend the heavenly tribulation!”
“Brother Lin Yi, you must keep going; I’m waiting to see you rise under the heavenly tribulation and lead our academy to its former glory!”
“Brother Lin Yi, you are the pride of our academy, and we will always support you!”
“We are all your die-hard fans; we support you!”
“Lin Yi, hang in there!”
“Come on! Come on! Come on!”
The crowd shouted in unison, their voices spreading and echoing throughout the valley, reaching Lin Yi’s ears, making him feel a familiar warmth and comfort inside.
Lin Yi stood up, his fists clenched tightly, a tremendous aura bursting forth from within him, soaring up to the heavens as if he were an invincible overlord standing above the clouds.
“Rumble!”
At this moment, another bolt of lightning struck down, and Lin Yi once again condensed a huge rock to block this heavenly tribulation.
However, although Lin Yi had blocked the heavenly tribulation, his condition was very wretched, his body covered with scars and wounds, bearing hundreds of fist and foot imprints, looking extremely tragic.
Lin Yi sat cross-legged on the ground and began to operate his Cultivation Technique.
“Boom rumble!”
Thunder struck once again, hitting the top of Lin Yi’s head, splitting his skin and flesh, leaving him in a bloody mess.
This heavenly tribulation was extremely terrifying, not only containing the power of thunder but also carrying an exceedingly strange energy fluctuation that made it impossible to avoid.
The wounds on Lin Yi’s body were sustained inadvertently.
The injuries Lin Yi had were too severe, already exceeding the limit he could bear; if not treated promptly, he was afraid he would fall between heaven and earth, turning into a pile of char.
“No, I must treat this quickly!”
Lin Yi clenched his teeth and persisted, constantly operating the Cultivation Technique, frantically absorbing the Primordial Energy between heaven and earth.
The Heaven-Earth Vital Energy surged continuously into Lin Yi’s Dantian, then transformed into Yuan Force, infusing into his meridians, blood, and bone marrow.
Lin Yi’s injuries were healing continuously, and they were recovering at a rapid pace.
After the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, Lin Yi’s injuries had healed.
At this moment, Lin Yi opened his eyes, and two beams of light shot out, like Divine Swords piercing the sky.
“This heavenly tribulation truly is much more difficult than I imagined!”
A trickle of fresh blood escaped from the corner of Lin Yi’s mouth, his face pale, but at this moment, he was full of excitement, his heart filled with anticipation.
“The power of the heavenly tribulation is extremely terrifying, and its attacks are profoundly mysterious and unpredictable, impossible to guard against. I must quickly adapt to these powers!”
Lin Yi took a deep breath and closed his eyes again to meditate.
The power of the heavenly tribulation was too strange; Lin Yi did not know what form the tribulation’s attacks would take. He could only continue to adapt, to explore, to find out the method of the heavenly tribulation’s attacks.
At this moment, another bolt of lightning descended from the horizon, striking directly down, hitting the top of Lin Yi’s head.
Lin Yi raised his right arm to block this thunderbolt. His body trembled slightly, nearly being killed by the thunder.
Lin Yi couldn’t help but let out a sigh of relief. Luckily, his Physical Body was incredibly strong; otherwise, if it were an ordinary Qi Cultivation Stage disciple, they probably would not be able to withstand the heavenly tribulation’s attack and would be incinerated to ashes.
However, even so, Lin Yi’s right arm was covered in dark streaks, the wounds extremely ferocious, striking fear into the hearts of onlookers.
“It seems that to overcome this heavenly tribulation, I will have to exert a great deal of effort!”
Lin Yi sighed and continued to cultivate, constantly reinforcing his Cultivation.
Lin Yi kept cultivating, continuously solidifying his strength.
Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, three months had gone by. His strength had once again improved, reaching the Peak of the Second Layer of the Qi Cultivation Stage.
“Boom!”
Suddenly, a booming sound echoed in the void as a bolt of lightning descended from the sky, striking Lin Yi.
“It’s coming!”
Lin Yi’s complexion changed; he had already felt that the heavenly tribulation was about to descend. The lightning contained a powerful force, seemingly capable of destroying heaven and earth, causing Lin Yi to feel a chill of fear.
“Boom!”
The thunder struck, hitting Lin Yi directly. His body shook, and he spat out blood, almost fainting.
The power of this thunderbolt was much stronger than the previous one, almost beyond Lin Yi’s endurance.
