“Not good! The power of the heavenly tribulation is no longer within me; if this continues, I will eventually be struck dead by this tribulation!”
Lin Yi’s face was very pale, full of panic and fear.
Lin Yi was extremely anxious in his heart, but his Cultivation Realm could no longer be improved and was simply unable to withstand the power of the heavenly tribulation; this time, he was sure to die.

chapters.title: Chapter 694: 694: The Fierce Onslaught of the Heavenly Tribulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 694: Chapter 694: The Fierce Onslaught of the Heavenly Tribulation
“What should I do? This Heavenly Tribulation is overwhelming, and no matter what, I can’t withstand it. Am I really going to die?”
Lin Yi’s heart was filled with worry.
The Heavenly Tribulation was a power feared by all living beings, and Lin Yi was no exception.
Within his body, the Thunder Power had already dissipated, and now he struggled to even move a finger. He was on the verge of failure.
“No, I can’t fail!”
Lin Yi roared in his heart, desperately driving his Cultivation Technique, frantically absorbing the Primordial Energy between heaven and earth.
But the absorption of Primordial Energy inevitably had its limits. His strength had already improved to the Early Stage of the Eighth Layer, but he still couldn’t fully absorb the power of the Heavenly Tribulation.
At that moment, the might of the Heavenly Tribulation grew even stronger, striking directly towards Lin Yi, engulfing him within it.
“Aaah!”
Lin Yi let out a skyward howl, a soul-tearing scream.
This wave of the Heavenly Tribulation’s power was countless times more formidable than the previous one, leaving Lin Yi utterly unable to resist.
Just then, the power of the Heavenly Tribulation fell upon him, obliterating his body into fragments, not even leaving bone shards behind, instantly turning into a mist of blood that filled the sky.
“He’s dead!”
Lin Yi’s soul, wrapped in a bolt of lightning, dissipated instantly, and following the pulverization of his body, turned into a blood mist that spread all around.
“Senior Brother Lin Yi, he was actually struck dead by the Heavenly Tribulation!”
“Such a pity, he had just become the top expert of our school, and now, he’s fallen like this!”
The students, witnessing Lin Yi being split into a mist of blood by the lightning, felt a deep sense of regret and sorrow, with tears welling up in their eyes.
At that moment, a beautiful youth in red clothes emerged from the crowd. He was Lin Yi’s junior brother, Li Siqi.
“Senior Sister, Senior Brother, he…” Li Siqi’s eyes were filled with tears, looking pitiful and sorrowful.
Lin Yi was quite famous within the academy, the dream lover of all the male students, and even an idol to the female ones. But now, this exceptional, handsome, and highly talented prodigy was dead!
How could people not grieve?
“Junior Brother, mourn with restraint,” Lin Yi’s junior sister comforted Li Siqi.
Lin Yi was an alchemist, but because of mediocre aptitude, he failed to achieve immortality and ultimately perished under the Thunder Tribulation, with no bones left, even his Nascent Soul obliterated by the Heavenly Tribulation.
However, this news had not spread because within the academy existed a mysterious organization. They controlled countless powerful sects, even managing to manipulate vast sects and demonic cults, so no one dared to let the news out.
“Sigh, junior brother died a terrible death!”
“Junior Brother had excellent aptitude, a truly Heaven-sent genius; he could have been our master in the future. Who would have thought that he would suffer such divine punishment!”
“Senior Sister, who did this?”
“I’m not sure, but I’ve heard you had a close relationship with this person. Could you take me to ask them?”
The red-dressed girl named Liu Qinglan’s eyes flashed, she was silent for a long moment, and then she nodded, “Okay!”
“Mhm!” Li Siqi nodded firmly, “But before that, I must find the jade pendant my master left me!”
“The jade pendant that Master left you? Why would Master leave you the jade pendant?”
“Because this jade pendant is helpful to my cultivation, it was a gift from my Master!”
Li Siqi explained, “So, before I break through to the Sixth Layer, Master won’t allow me to leave the sect!”
“I see!”
Liu Qinglan nodded, “Alright, since this jade pendant is very important to senior sister, I will join senior sister in searching for it!”
“Then I thank senior sister very much!” Li Siqi spoke, her gaze towards the distance revealing a deep hatred, “Junior brother, rest assured, I will definitely avenge you! I must avenge you!”
Liu Qinglan and Li Siqi exchanged a smile, both young girls filled with hatred in their hearts, their eyes brimming with murderous intent!
…
One month later.
The sky was overcast with thick clouds, lightning flashed, and thunder roared as if the world had changed its color.
In the sky, a thunder pool floated, abundant with thunder power that surged from within.
Inside the thunder pool, Lin Yi sat cross-legged atop the pool, enveloped in purple lightning. His physical body had been completely shattered, leaving only his soul, but he still absorbed the primordial energy from the heavens and earth, healing his injuries as well as his energy.
Within his dantian, the Nine Revolutions Golden Pill had been completely refined by the power of heavenly tribulation, turning crystal clear and golden, much like a glassy, golden bead.
On the surface of the Nine Revolutions Golden Pill, one mysterious rune after another flickered—these runes were all where Lin Yi’s Primordial Spirit resided.
And within these runes, thunder streaked, as if thunder dragons were rampaging.
In the center of this thunder pool, a ball of purple flame undulated and burned fiercely, illuminating the thunder pool with unparalleled clarity.
“Boom~~!”
A series of loud rumbles spread; a voice echoed in Lin Yi’s mind: “Heavenly Thunder Body Refining Technique, begins!”
“Heavenly Thunder Body Refining Technique?” Lin Yi looked up at the sky in confusion, as an ancient seal emerged on his forehead, inscribed with an old-fashioned rune.
Lin Yi carefully examined this rune and discovered that it shared the same patterns as the Heavenly Punishment Thunder Seal.
“So this is the Heavenly Punishment Thunder Seal? It seems that master’s speculation was indeed correct, the Heavenly Punishment Thunder Seal, is an ancient divine artifact!”
“The Heavenly Punishment Thunder Seal is able to temper the physical body, making it stronger, and it also contains a hint of Divine Thunderous Nature, which can amplify a person’s thunder attribute soul.”
“As expected of an ancient divine artifact, truly extraordinary!”
“However, this Heavenly Punishment Thunder Seal seems quite unstable, at risk of collapsing at any moment. If I were to use the Heavenly Punishment Thunder Seal, I would definitely suffer from the backlash of thunder punishment!”
Lin Yi pondered inwardly.
The Heavenly Punishment Thunder Seal, containing the power of heavenly punishment, possessed infinite might, but Lin Yi’s cultivation was too low to use it. As soon as he employed the Heavenly Punishment Thunder Seal, he would have to endure endless thunder tribulations, and the seal could only enhance the power of thunder tribulation for a short duration, about half an incense stick’s time.
After an incense stick’s time, the Heavenly Punishment Thunder Seal would explode, and then Lin Yi would truly be done for!
This was also the reason why Lin Yi hesitated and was reluctant to use the Heavenly Punishment Thunder Seal!
“Forget it, it won’t do, better wait until Foundation Establishment Realm. Once I succeed at Foundation Establishment, the Heavenly Punishment Thunder Seal will no longer be dangerous!”
Lin Yi thought to himself, and then he continued to cultivate, absorbing the thunder power from the heavens and earth, healing his physical body.
One month later.
“Boom!”
A thunderclap exploded in Lin Yi’s mind, nearly splitting his skull, blood streaming down, but this blood was all absorbed by the thunder power, turning into primordial energy!
In the span of a month, Lin Yi’s body had almost completely recovered!
Not only that, the strength of his physical body and the thunder power had reached an extremely terrifying level.
“Hahaha, finally broken through to the Seventh Layer of the Foundation Establishment Realm!” Lin Yi laughed wildly, leaping out from the thunder pool; the injuries on his body had vanished without a trace.
“With this breakthrough, my cultivation has increased significantly. Although I can’t compare with Nascent Soul Stage experts, I should be able to contend with peak Mid-stage Nascent Soul experts.”
Lin Yi clenched his fist, bursting with endless fighting spirit and will to battle; with a push of his legs, he shot into the skies.

chapters.title: Chapter 695 - 695 695 Battle Will
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 695: Chapter 695: Battle Will Chapter 695: Chapter 695: Battle Will This time, Lin Yi’s speed increased to its utmost, becoming several times faster than before!
His speed had enhanced not just by three or four times from before!
“Not bad, after cultivating the Fourth Form ‘Myriad Retribution Sword’ and the Tiangang Sword Technique Fifth Form ‘Thousand Swords Unleashed’, as well as the Sixth Form ‘Sword Qi Omnipresent’, my strength has increased remarkably swiftly!”
A smile appeared on Lin Yi’s face as he felt extremely delighted in his heart, “Now that I am a Nascent Soul Intermediate Stage cultivator, I am only a step away from the later stages!”
In his heart, he was already imagining the kind of power he would possess after breaking through to the Nascent Soul later stages.
“Huff…” Lin Yi took a deep breath, and a vast and imposing energy suddenly surged from his body.
He stretched out both hands, and two longswords appeared in them.
“Myriad Swords Unleashed!”
Lin Yi uttered a low shout, brandishing the twin swords, with Sword Qi soaring into the sky, slashing fiercely toward the space in front of him.
“Whoosh~”
Immediately, the sword light shot up into the sky, like countless stars plummeting, attracting all the spiritual energy within the entire cave dwelling to converge on Lin Yi’s two longswords, making them even more dazzling and eye-catching!
And all this happened in the blink of an eye; Lin Yi’s movements were too fast, so fast that they were hard to catch with the naked eye, one simply could not discern his actions!
The two longswords fiercely struck the rock walls outside the cave, emitting a violent roaring sound, deafening!
The mountain cliff, under Lin Yi’s fearsome attack, was directly cleaved by him to form a long gorge, with the mountain shaking.
“This powerful?”
Lin Yi’s heart chilled for a moment, and with a thought, the two longswords returned to his hands.
This time, he did not rush out of the valley, but sat cross-legged there, running the Tiangang Sword Technique, madly absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth to replenish his consumption, converting the spiritual energy between heaven and earth into the Primordial Energy he needed, and storing it in his Dantian!
“Buzz!”
The spiritual energy of heaven and earth flowed turbulently downward, being absorbed by Lin Yi into his body and transformed into his Primordial Energy!
Afterward, he lifted his arms and pushed his palms forward, a terrifying sword light tearing through the void, shuttling from it, cleaving open the entire heaven and earth!
This move was called Myriad Swords Unleashed!
Lin Yi had performed this technique countless times and was already adept at it!
“Hmm? This spiritual energy is actually weakening!”
Lin Yi felt that his spiritual energy was depleting at a terrifying rate!
“No, I can’t continue cultivating like this, my spiritual energy has already depleted too much, if I keep going, I might even be able to defeat a Foundation Establishment later stage powerhouse!”
Lin Yi wanted to leave this place, but there was a Formation guarding this cave dwelling, preventing him from leaving.
“No matter what, let’s test the defense of this cave dwelling first, see if I can break through!”
Lin Yi thought to himself and then, his figure streaked towards the stone table at the center of the cave dwelling.
“Bang!”
As soon as Lin Yi got close to the stone table, the table shook violently, emitting a piercing noise, and instantly shattered into pieces.
Lin Yi took a look, a hint of surprise flashing across his face, because the stone pieces did not scatter, but in the blink of an eye, reassembled back together!
“What a magical Formation!” Lin Yi couldn’t help but exclaim in admiration.
“Eh?”
Lin Yi suddenly noticed, at the moment of shattering, the stone table actually produced a certain resonance.
This resonance was very faint, but Lin Yi still felt it, it was generated by the Formation of this cave dwelling, there was indeed a Formation set up within it!
Moreover, it was a high-level formation!
Lin Yi’s heart stirred, and he immediately sank his consciousness into the depths of his sea of knowledge.
Very soon, in the deep recesses of the sea of knowledge, the layout of the cave dwelling appeared. In Lin Yi’s consciousness, everything about the cave dwelling unfolded, even every corner!
Inside the cave dwelling, various materials for formations were placed. There was a small Mist Marsh Formation, a huge crystal ball, and all sorts of strange platforms.
“Indeed, the owner of this cave dwelling is a powerful figure!”
Lin Yi marveled in his heart.
“However, since such a formation is in place for protection, then the owner of the cave dwelling should not be in any danger. After all, the formation was personally set up by a powerful figure and should not be something ordinary people could break,” Lin Yi thought to himself.
“I think this powerful figure must be extremely astute to have set up such a terrifying formation to protect the cave dwelling from being occupied by others.”
Lin Yi mused internally and then withdrew his consciousness.
His gaze swept towards the center of the cave dwelling, where a small blade of grass was growing. It was so tiny that its roots were not visible.
But its rhizome was rooted on the ground, seemingly absorbing the purest spiritual energy between heaven and earth.
“Is this the Myriad Images Spirit Grass?” Lin Yi was incredibly excited in his heart.
“This is a very precious medicinal ingredient. It’s hard for ordinary people to find one, and I didn’t expect to stumble upon it, and such a large one at that. Such a rare treasure, I’ll harvest it. From now on, this cave dwelling will belong to me. Heh, I guess I can consider myself a powerful figure now!”
Lin Yi was overjoyed in his heart and hurriedly plucked the Myriad Images Spirit Grass, carefully storing it inside the Qiankun Ring, then left the cave dwelling to return to his own.
A day passed in the blink of an eye.
Lin Yi stayed inside his cave dwelling for the entire day.
The next day, he tried the Myriad Images Spirit Grass again, but still, there was no effect. The Myriad Images Spirit Grass was like a stone, completely immobile!
“What’s going on? Why won’t the Myriad Images Spirit Grass respond to me?”
Lin Yi was full of doubts in his heart.
“Perhaps, the restrictions of this cave dwelling are too strong, and it’s not listening to me,” Lin Yi thought to himself.
“It seems I must find a way to break the restrictions of the cave dwelling!” Lin Yi pondered in silence.
“I remember seeing a cultivation technique in ancient texts, designed specifically to break restrictions and shatter the prohibitions of a cave dwelling!” Lin Yi recalled.
“This technique is the Nine Yin Scripture, an immortal cultivation technique that includes methods to break through formations. However, the resources it requires are immense.”
Lin Yi frowned to himself, knowing that if it were an ordinary cultivator, they wouldn’t have any means to contend with such a matter.
“Never mind, let’s try it first!”
Lin Yi gritted his teeth and began to study the secrets of the Nine Yin Scripture.
Lin Yi mobilized all the spiritual power in his body, condensing it into a protective shield around him.
“Whoosh!”
Lin Yi released his soul, carefully observing his surroundings.
“Eh?”
Soon, Lin Yi discovered that there was an incredibly dense concentration of spiritual energy near him, like a vortex, furiously pouring into his body and making it grow stronger!
The robes on Lin Yi’s body swelled, as if they were about to burst at any moment, and a faint red halo began to emerge at the bottom of the robes.
“Huff, huff…”
The red halo grew more and more intense, more and more dazzling, forcing Lin Yi to squint his eyes!

chapters.title: Chapter 696 - 696 696 Just One Step Away
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 696: Chapter 696: Just One Step Away! Chapter 696: Chapter 696: Just One Step Away! “Is this… a breakthrough? Am I about to break through?”
Lin Yi’s eyes widened in sheer surprise and delight.
Lin Yi’s cultivation had already reached the peak of the Early Golden Core Stage, just a step away from the Foundation Establishment Stage!
If he could break through, his cultivation would advance to the Intermediate Foundation Establishment Stage!
Though the difference between the Early Foundation Establishment Stage and Intermediate Foundation Establishment Stage seemed like half a step, it was actually ten or a hundredfold!
In the Immortal Cultivation World, cultivators at the Foundation Establishment Realm were considered supreme experts!
And cultivators at the peak of the Early Golden Core Stage were top-notch experts who could contend with those in the later stages of the Golden Core!
In the Immortal Cultivation World, the divide between the Golden Core Stage and the Foundation Establishment Stage was known as an insurmountable gap, a chasm no Golden Core cultivator dared to cross.
But now, Lin Yi felt that he was just a step away from reaching the Intermediate Foundation Establishment Stage!
Lin Yi knew that as long as he could increase his strength slightly, he would be able to assault the Intermediate Foundation Establishment Stage!
In the Intermediate Foundation Establishment Stage, he could use the True Essence of the Five Elements, making his attacks overwhelmingly powerful and unmatched within his realm!
Moreover, Lin Yi’s Five Elements Attribute had all reached the level of the Fire of the Five Elements!
For Lin Yi, this was an inversion of the natural order, capable of boosting his combat power by dozens, even hundreds of times—a truly terrifying move.
“Boom!”
Lin Yi, feeling the surge of spiritual energy within him, was filled with excitement.
Without hesitation, Lin Yi continued to run his cultivation frenetically, absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth around him, causing every inch of his skin to emit a dazzling light, filled with an endless sense of power!
A day went by, and Lin Yi had completely drained all the spiritual energy from his body.
Lin Yi felt his physical body become incredibly tough and immensely strong, and his constitution also became more formidable!
Lin Yi knew that, from now on, his body would fear no sword or attack!
“With such a powerful body, if I were to encounter a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, I could effortlessly slay them. Such an invincible body is truly unmatched; no one can harm me!” Lin Yi thought to himself.
“I shall cultivate in this cave for some time!”
Thinking thus, Lin Yi decided to go into seclusion in this cave for a while.
Lin Yi sat crossed-legged within the cave, beginning to absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth.
The space inside the cave was vast, spanning two thousand square zhang. Although Lin Yi sitting crossed-legged made it seem somewhat cramped, this was nothing to him since he had a Storage Bag that could hold an entire mountain range—an absolutely wonderful asset for Lin Yi!
“Buzz!”
Lin Yi’s body trembled as he opened his Storage Bag and then, he absorbed all the spiritual energy within the entire cave into the Storage Bag!
After absorbing the spiritual energy of an entire cave, Lin Yi’s body grew even more formidable, and the layer of light on his skin shone even brighter.
Only then did Lin Yi realize that this layer of light was not only a protective shield but could also absorb all the energy between heaven and earth, and the speed at which it absorbed this energy had become incredibly fast!
“With this going on, my strength will definitely increase substantially!” Lin Yi was overjoyed.
“Boom!”
Lin Yi threw a punch, impacting the layer of light outside the cave, immediately causing the layer of light to tremble violently and send out ripples of waves!
Lin Yi felt as if his fist had struck an impenetrable wall of copper and iron; he could not breach the layer of light. Even his arm was numbed by the immense rebounding force of the light, causing it to tingle painfully.
Lin Yi stumbled back several steps, his face etched with astonishment.
This shield was incredibly sturdy!
Shock wracked Lin Yi’s heart.
Lin Yi took a deep breath, adjusted the spiritual energy within his body to the optimal state, and then suddenly stepped forward, unleashing a punch.
“Boom!”
A muffled sound reverberated as a powerful force transmitted from Lin Yi’s fist, creating a wave of energy that swept away in all directions, destroying all of the nearby trees!
The might of Lin Yi’s punch was terrifying; with one blow, he caused the surrounding mountains to crack, and a huge fissure extended from the ground, cleaving the valley in two.
“Haha! I’ve finally reached the Third Layer of the Foundation Establishment Stage!” Lin Yi was overwhelmed with excitement.
That punch was the power only someone at the Third Layer of the Foundation Establishment Stage could unleash, and Lin Yi had achieved this level!
Lin Yi’s fist had become harder, and his strength had increased!
Feeling this overbearing strength, Lin Yi was incredibly refreshed; he felt that his physical body had grown stronger and his flesh had become harder.
At this moment, Lin Yi charged out of his cave dwelling once again.
Lin Yi wanted to find a place rich in spiritual energy to cultivate the True Essence of the Five Elements and increase his strength!
In these mountains, Lin Yi didn’t encounter many Demon Beasts, so there wasn’t much danger.
Soon, Lin Yi arrived at a region abundant in spiritual energy, where the spiritual energy was incredibly dense.
There, a lake lay, its waters so blue and crystal clear you could see to the bottom, resembling a clear turquoise pond; above the lake floated white stones emanating a faint glow, mist rising from them, making one feel refreshed and extremely comfortable!
Lin Yi stood by the lake, quietly observing it, basking in the dense spiritual energy, and felt a profound sense of satisfaction; he could tell this was a precious site for Immortal Cultivation.
“The spiritual energy here is dozens of times stronger than that in my cave dwelling,” Lin Yi felt deeply moved, “If I cultivate here, reaching the Seventh Layer of Qi cultivation wouldn’t take long, and I’ll be able to advance to the Foundation Establishment stage!”
“Hmm? What’s this?”
Just then, Lin Yi suddenly sensed something was off.
Lin Yi noticed that the once calm lake began to ripple, followed by waves starting to churn, and the mud at the bottom of the lake began to roll upwards.
Underneath the surface of the lake, a terrifying suction force appeared, trying to pull Lin Yi into the depths!
“What’s going on?” Lin Yi frowned slightly.
With a slight sway of his body, Lin Yi escaped the suction force and landed somewhere else.
“Swish, swash…”
The sound of moving water rose, and from within the lake, a colossal creature emerged in front of Lin Yi.
“What is that thing?”
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s eyes widened slightly in surprise.
There, a gigantic serpent appeared, its skin lustrously dark, more than a meter long, its body covered with scales, and measuring about three meters in girth. Its head resembled that of a crocodile.
“Is this a Flood Dragon?” Lin Yi marveled inwardly.
“Hiss…”
As Lin Yi stood in awe of the colossal creature, its body suddenly leaped at him.
The huge serpent’s forked tongue flicked out, dispersing a nauseating stench.
“Not good!” Lin Yi quickly moved to dodge, avoiding the attack of the venom.
However, Lin Yi had overlooked something; with only the strength of the Second Layer of the Foundation Establishment Stage, he couldn’t possibly evade the Flood Dragon’s assault.

chapters.title: Chapter 697 - 697 697 Failed to Inflict Heavy Damage on the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 697: Chapter 697: Failed to Inflict Heavy Damage on the Flood Dragon Chapter 697: Chapter 697: Failed to Inflict Heavy Damage on the Flood Dragon The Flood Dragon opened its mouth to bite down, aiming a huge, sharp fang straight for Lin Yi’s neck.
“Damn it!”
Lin Yi cursed, hurriedly shifting to the side, narrowly evading the giant fang.
Seeing its bite miss, the Flood Dragon became furiously violent, twisting and turning its body as it charged towards Lin Yi. It opened its huge jaws wide, spewing out a pitch-black smog that turned into a sharp blade and fiercely struck towards Lin Yi.
Upon seeing this, Lin Yi quickly clenched his fists and smashed a punch towards the Flood Dragon’s head!
Boom!
The fist struck the Flood Dragon’s skull with a bone-crushing sound, and Lin Yi’s fist shattered upon impact.
The Flood Dragon’s skull also collapsed under Lin Yi’s punch, splitting into two!
With a wretched scream, the Flood Dragon was sent flying backwards, crashing into a large tree in the distance.
Seeing this, Lin Yi was shocked.
He felt that his punch could have easily shattered a car!
However, this punch only wounded the Flood Dragon and did not seriously injure it!
Lin Yi’s strength had increased too much!
Just how powerful was Lin Yi’s fist?
Lin Yi himself wasn’t sure.
By that time, the Flood Dragon had gradually picked itself up and charged towards Lin Yi once again. This time, its eyes were filled with boundless rage.
“This Flood Dragon is a Sixth Rank, equivalent to the strength of the Seventh Layer of cultivation. Although my physical body is strong, it’s difficult to contend with a Sixth Rank Flood Dragon!” Lin Yi guessed within his heart.
At that moment, Lin Yi could not care for anything else; he quickly pulled out the Jiuyou Sword, performed the “Yin Yang Bagua Technique” with all his might, and fiercely attacked the Flood Dragon with the power of the Jiuyou Sword.
Though the Flood Dragon’s body was strong, it still suffered a severe injury under Lin Yi’s assault and lay on the ground wailing pitifully.
Seeing this, Lin Yi rushed forward, planting his foot firmly on the Flood Dragon’s head and clamping its body tightly between his legs, pinning it to the ground to prevent its escape.
With a flick of his wrist, the Jiuyou Sword tore through the sky, stabbing fiercely towards the Flood Dragon’s chest!
Sizzle!
The sword tip sliced through the Flood Dragon’s extremely tough scales, blood spurting out continuously.
“Ah!” The Flood Dragon roared in pain, exhaling a puff of black smoke.
Lin Yi’s sword stabbed fiercely into the Flood Dragon’s chest, piercing its body and causing blood to drip steadily down the blade.
The Flood Dragon wailed incessantly.
Seeing this, Lin Yi snorted coldly and increased the force of the Jiuyou Sword, peeling off pieces of the Flood Dragon’s scales one by one!
Blood continued to drip from the Flood Dragon’s body, staining the bushes, the surface of the lake, and also the clothes on Lin Yi’s body.
“Ah, damn it, you dare to hurt me, I will kill you!” The Flood Dragon bellowed, its eyes bloodshot with fury.
Seeing this, Lin Yi quickly lifted his foot.
“Hiss…” The Flood Dragon inhaled deeply, its forked tongue flickering out menacingly and hideously!
“Where’s my sword?” the Flood Dragon growled deeply.
“It’s now inside my Storage Ring,” Lin Yi said indifferently.
As Lin Yi spoke, he reached out to grab the Qiankun Bag.
The Qiankun Bag, Lin Yi’s initial cultivation tool for martial arts, had been modified by him to become a Magic Artifact!
Lin Yi took out the Qiankun Bag and, with a swift hand gesture, threw it out, sending it flying into the Flood Dragon’s mouth.
Blurt!
The Qiankun Bag was swallowed by the Flood Dragon, which then let out a roar of excitement and snapped its blood-filled jaws shut, biting down hard on the Qiankun Bag.
“Roar!”
Just at that moment, the Flood Dragon let out a mighty roar, causing the entire python to tremble violently.
Following that, with a flick of its massive serpentine body, the Flood Dragon threw the Qiankun Bag out, which crashed harshly onto the ground.
The Qiankun Bag bounced a few times on the ground, stopped trembling, and then returned to normal.
“Roar!”
This time, the Flood Dragon didn’t rush to attack Lin Yi but started rolling on the ground instead, its belly swelling up as if something was about to explode.
“Not good, that Flood Dragon is going to explode!”
Seeing this, Lin Yi quickly used Qinggong to escape to a distance.
“Roar!”
Just as Lin Yi steadied his stance, a series of roaring sounds suddenly came from beside him, and immediately following, an enormously thick python shadow charged toward Lin Yi.
This Flood Dragon was incredibly fast and in the blink of an eye, it was already in front of Lin Yi.
Lin Yi looked up and saw that this Flood Dragon had a pair of dragon horns growing on its forehead!
The dragon horns were azure in color, and densely covered with dragon scales.
The dragon’s head was also about four or five inches tall, with its mouth wide open, its fangs sharp and emitting a cold and grim light.
Startled by the sight of the huge azure horned python, Lin Yi quickly calmed down.
As a Martial Artist who had encountered countless Demon Beasts, he naturally knew the Flood Dragon’s weakness, which was exactly what Lin Yi could counter.
“Go!”
With a thought, Lin Yi summoned the Jiuyou Sword into his hand, brandished it a few times, and slashed toward the Flood Dragon.
The Jiuyou Sword struck the Flood Dragon’s body, severing its waist!
The Flood Dragon’s body was cut into countless pieces by Lin Yi, and blood rained down all around!
As the blood splashed into the grass, it immediately caused a large amount of flowers and plants to wither.
These flowers and plants, even though they contained poison, decayed instantly upon contact with this fresh blood.
Seeing this, Lin Yi thought to himself, “Indeed, it’s a brutally virulent poison! If I accidentally get some on me, I’ll be in danger!”
Taking a deep breath, Lin Yi glanced at the distant Flood Dragon corpse and couldn’t help but sigh, “No matter what, it seems this Flood Dragon shouldn’t have been killed!”
The Flood Dragon was too powerful, and Lin Yi’s current Cultivation level wasn’t enough to confront it. If he could develop his Inner Strength, he might be able to fight the Flood Dragon and kill it.
However, as a mere Martial Artist currently unable to cultivate Inner Strength due to the vast resources required, achieving this was not something he could reach in a short time.
After the Flood Dragon died, the scales it dropped were collected by Lin Yi into his Storage Ring.
“Lin Yi, let’s hurry and leave this accursed place,” Bai Feng said.
Hearing Bai Feng’s words, Lin Yi’s brows slightly furrowed as he felt puzzled, wondering why Bai Feng would actively follow him.
Could it be for revenge?
It seemed unlikely. While Lin Yi was a Cultivator, he had no significant backing or power, and it didn’t seem necessary for Bai Feng to offend the Flood Dragon and the Demon Race for his sake.
“Let’s go.”
Without paying further attention to Bai Feng, Lin Yi directly rode the wind and flew forward.
Lin Yi sped towards the east, and soon after, he saw the city ahead; they had finally escaped the danger.
At the city gates, numerous people had already gathered, all looking terrified at the distant city, as if waiting for something, and in front of them, a squad of Demon Race cavalry was slowly approaching.
“What’s going on?” Lin Yi was somewhat clueless.
He observed that on the city walls, numerous human Cultivators had been sealed.
These Cultivators, one after another, were pale and trembling, clearly having been captured by these members of the Demon Race.

chapters.title: Chapter 698 - 698 698 The Attire of the Demon Race
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 698: Chapter 698: The Attire of the Demon Race Chapter 698: Chapter 698: The Attire of the Demon Race Lin Yi carefully observed the expressions of those human cultivators, all of whom seemed anxious, worried about something, or afraid of something.
Moreover, the attire of these human cultivators was that of the Demon Race, as if they had been organized by some demon organization specifically to escort human cultivator slaves.
“These beasts!”
“It’s just too cruel!”
“These demons, they simply don’t regard us human cultivators as anything!”
Looking at the group of human cultivators who were bound on the city walls, Lin Yi’s eyes grew heated, and his heart was filled with rage.
The behavior of the Demon Race had completely incensed Lin Yi.
“Roar!”
Just then, a roar resounded from the front.
“Not good! The Flood Dragon is coming!”
Upon hearing the roar of the Flood Dragon, those human cultivators blocking the city walls panicked and fled in haste, fearing that if they were too late, they would be devoured by the group of Flood Dragons.
“Thinking of running?”
“No one is getting away!”
The Flood Dragon let out a roar, then opened its mouth wide and exhaled a thick fog, enveloping the whole area in its mist.
The fog spread out, obscuring everyone’s vision, and none could see clearly.
Lin Yi stood in place, silently calculating the distance of the Flood Dragon from himself, and then, with a flash of his figure, he chased after the Flood Dragon!
“Boom!”
Lin Yi pursued the Flood Dragon at an extremely fast speed, and in the blink of an eye, he had soared above the Flood Dragon’s head, raised the Jiuyou Sword in his hand, and with one strike, severed the dragon’s head.
“Splash”
Lin Yi slaughtered the Flood Dragon and then extracted its inner core from its body.
This inner core emitted strong fluctuations of spiritual energy, stirring some excitement in Lin Yi.
“To actually obtain a Seventh Grade Flood Dragon inner core! I’ve struck it rich this time!” Lin Yi rejoiced in his heart.
He had killed Flood Dragons before and picked up several of their inner cores, but the spiritual energy contained in those Flood Dragon inner cores was too little and paled in comparison to the one he got from the giant crocodile he had killed.
“Haha! I have really struck it rich this time!”
“I’ve also found a treasure!”
Lin Yi was ecstatic in his heart.
This Flood Dragon inner core contained a hint of the demon blood essence, which was an absolute treasure for Lin Yi.
“Roar, roar, roar…”
After Lin Yi killed the Flood Dragon, the group of demon cavalry immediately let out a series of neighing sounds and rushed towards the Flood Dragon’s corpse.
“Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh, swoosh”
All of these demon cavalry took out their bows and arrows, drew their bowstrings, and fired a volley of arrows at the Flood Dragon’s corpse.
One by one, the demon cavalry shot their arrows into the Flood Dragon’s corpse, followed by a series of explosions that shattered the pile of flesh!
Lin Yi watched this scene from the side, also feeling quite emotional.
The archery skills of these demon cavalry were just too poor, unable to even destroy those chunks of flesh—it was truly a waste among wastes!
“Boom! Boom! Boom!”
Just then, a resounding rumble came, as carriage after carriage was pulled up to the city gates.
Lin Yi saw this scene, his eyebrows arching slightly, without needing to say anything, he knew that these must be the conveyances of the Flood Dragon, sent to transport the humans.
Within these carriages, Demon Cultivators were packed, including the elderly, children, and male cultivators, all tightly bound and completely unable to break free.
Seeing this, Lin Yi shook his head.
To the Flood Dragon, these human cultivators were merely prey, utterly worthless!
Lin Yi, uninterested in meddling any further, turned to leave, but at that moment, he heard a familiar voice behind him.
“Brother Lin, we meet again.”
Turning around at the sound, Lin Yi saw Li Wenchang approaching at a leisurely pace, flanked by three senior members of the Demon Race.
Seeing Li Wenchang, Lin Yi was slightly taken aback and said, “Brother Wenchang, what’s going on here? What happened?”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s question, a bitter smile appeared on Li Wenchang’s face as he said, “Brother Lin, I won’t lie to you, our target this time is this city. We are acting under the orders of His Majesty the Flood Dragon King to capture all human cultivators and bring them back to the Demon territories.”
“The Demon Race’s orders?” Lin Yi’s eyebrows twitched slightly.
This Flood Dragon King, he’s so arrogant!
“Brother Lin, the order from the Demon Race this time is of great importance and allows no refusal. You are now the leader of the humans and must obey as well,” Li Wenchang said, his tone carrying a hint of threat.
Lin Yi snorted coldly and retorted, “I refuse. Do you Demons not fear the rebellion of human cultivators? Do you not fear that we human cultivators will unite and exterminate your Demon Race?”
“Hahaha, Lin Yi, you’re too funny! Do you think your human cultivators dare to defy us Demons? With twenty million cultivators, do you think your humans stand a chance against us?” Li Wenchang burst into laughter.
Twenty million Demon Cultivators!
Lin Yi’s heart chilled, thinking to himself: This is big trouble.
“Our Cultivation surpasses that of many of your powerful human cultivators, do you think you can withstand us?” Li Wenchang continued.
“If human cultivators can’t withstand you, do you think your Demon Cultivators can withstand us? That’s impossible,” Lin Yi said as he stared coldly at Li Wenchang.
“You don’t believe it?” Li Wenchang sneered.
“Try me, I, Lin Yi, never fight a battle I’m not sure of winning!” Lin Yi declared.
“If that’s the case, then join us in the assault,” Li Wenchang said with a cold smile. “Under the rule of the Demon Emperor, our Demon Cultivators will surely become the most powerful race. Then, all human cultivators will have no choice but to submit to us, not the other way around.”
“Fine! Then I shall see what you are capable of,” Lin Yi said with a cold smile. “You all wait here for a bit; I’ll find a place to rest and restore my Mana before engaging with you.”
“Good!” Li Wenchang nodded and said, “During this time, we Demon Cultivators will scout around to see if your humans are active nearby. Once we find any trace of you, your situation will become very difficult!”
“Heh, rest assured, I’ll be mindful of that,” Lin Yi said with a slight smile before turning away.
Lin Yi returned to the inn and began seclusion to recover his strength.
Although he was at the peak of the Nascent Soul Stage, this battle had taken a severe toll on him; if not for his robust Cultivation physique, Lin Yi might have already been injured, or even perished in the fray!
“No, although my Cultivation has reached the peak of the Nascent Soul Stage, I’ve only just broken through and it’s not yet stable. I need to continue strengthening my Cultivation; only with sufficient strength can I handle any forthcoming dangers,” Lin Yi thought to himself.
“What I need to do now is to concentrate the True Yuan in my body as much as possible, to increase my Combat Power. Once my strength is sufficient, I will then seek out the Demon King!” Lin Yi thought to himself.
“Phew!”
Lin Yi took a deep breath and slowly started to circulate the True Yuan within his body, forming a layer of faint golden Gang Qi glow on his skin, protecting his body from external harm.
Time flew by, and half a month had passed.

chapters.title: Chapter 699 - 699 699 Secretly Heaved a Sigh of Relief
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 699: Chapter 699: Secretly Heaved a Sigh of Relief Chapter 699: Chapter 699: Secretly Heaved a Sigh of Relief During this time, the human cultivators had all fled, and the number of demon cultivators was dwindling, but Lin Yi had not received any reports from the human cultivators. Clearly, the demon cultivators had not captured them.
“It seems that those demon cultivators haven’t caught them, I can now recover in peace,” Lin Yi thought to himself with a sigh of relief, preparing to condense the True Yuan in his body into pearls to purify it further.
“Whoosh~”
Suddenly, the sound of wind whooshed past Lin Yi’s ears, accompanied by a strong gust of air.
Lin Yi immediately opened his eyes and looked into the distance, only to see an army of the Demon Race rapidly approaching.
“Eh? There are so many demons?”
Lin Yi was surprised.
The number of these demons was twice as many as Lin Yi had expected, at least five thousand!
These demon forces, dressed in exquisite leather armor, ridden on mounts that were all snow-white exotic beasts, their bodies shimmered with white light. As they charged through, they distorted the space around them.
Looking at this situation, it seemed that a large number of demon cultivators were rushing in this direction!
What was happening? Could it be that the Demon Race was about to go to war with the human clan?
As Lin Yi pondered this question, he saw that the demons had already arrived above him.
“Hm? What’s going on?”
After getting a clear look at the demon cultivators below, Lin Yi was startled.
“These demon cultivators?”
Lin Yi’s eyes widened in shock.
The demon cultivators below were actually human cultivators!
And all of these demon cultivators were at the later stages of Foundation Establishment!
There were over five hundred Foundation Establishment later stages!
Lin Yi had seen only a few Foundation Establishment later-stage demon cultivators, each one at the peak of their power, so the arrival of so many at once was truly frightening.
“Why do these demon cultivators appear to be in a mood to accuse and punish? Could it be they are after me?” Lin Yi wondered, speculating in his mind.
Just then, he heard the demon cultivators below shouting in unison, “Human cultivators! Surrender immediately and kneel! Otherwise, we will kill you, take your treasure, and destroy your villages!”
“Hmph!” Lin Yi snorted coldly, his heart full of anger.
He had thought that these demon cultivators were merely looking for trouble with him, but now it seemed he was wrong.
Clearly, these demon cultivators were targeting the human cultivators!
Lin Yi looked at the over five hundred demon cultivators below with an icy expression and said, “We human cultivators have no quarrel with you. By doing this, what exactly is your purpose? Have you been wronged in some way?”
The demon cultivators sneered.
“No quarrel? Hahaha!”
One of the demon cultivators stepped forward, laughing as he looked at Lin Yi, “Do you know how many of our people have died during this period? Do you know how heavy the casualties have been for our race?”
“Do you know how many of our people you human cultivators have killed?”
“You don’t know! You don’t deserve to know, because you human cultivators, you all deserve to die!”
“All deserve to die?”
Lin Yi frowned, thinking to himself, “Could there be a feud between their tribes?”
After a moment of thought, Lin Yi said, “No matter what has happened between you, I will not get involved in your dispute. I just hope you can spare me a way to live!”
“Hahaha! Lin Yi, stop pretending!”
“If it wasn’t for you human cultivators pushing our demon cultivators to a dead end, would we demon cultivators launch an all-out attack on you?”
The person sneered, “Don’t think we don’t know your tricks; we just can’t find you for the time being. So, we had to come to your village, slaughter these human cultivators, then steal their treasures and elixirs before returning to our Demon Race’s territory!”
“So that’s how it is!”
Lin Yi finally understood what had happened, the Demon Cultivators had launched a full assault on the human cultivators, who, in response, counterattacked and annihilated them.
“Since you want to rob us of our possessions, I won’t go easy on you either,” Lin Yi said after a long silence, finally making up his mind. He knew that this situation was inevitable, but if he were to back down, he’d become the public enemy of all human cultivators!
If that was the case, he would have to fight with all he had!
“Human cultivators, heed my command and fully resist the Demon Race’s assault!” Lin Yi yelled out, his voice spreading across the entire mountain range, letting all the cultivators from the Immortal Cultivation Sects know and quickly assemble in this direction.
“Boom! Boom! Boom!”
Powerful currents of air burst forth as the human cultivators all gathered here, forming several defensive Great Formations to protect themselves tightly.
“Hmph!”
“If you want to play, then I’ll play along!” Lin Yi snorted coldly and then pulled out a bronze staff. With a wave of his hand, he hurled a black massive boulder into the midst of the Demon Cultivators’ army, creating a huge gap.
“Roar!”
“Roar!”
Seeing this, the Demon Cultivators were furious and rapidly cast spells, launching attacks towards Lin Yi.
“Bang!”
“Bang!”
“Bang!”
“Bang!”
Although the Demon Cultivators’ cultivation was not as strong as Lin Yi’s, they were, after all, Demon Cultivators at the peak of the later stages of Foundation Establishment, with extremely terrifying magical might. Lin Yi could not block their attacks and hastily activated the mana in his body, turning into a streak of light and fleeing into the distance.
“Where do you think you’re running to?!”
“Human cultivator, don’t think you can escape from our grasp!”
“Kill!!”
“Kill!!!”
The Demon Cultivators pursued Lin Yi as he fled, but after chasing him for a distance, they failed to find any trace of him and were greatly perplexed, hesitant to continue the pursuit.
Lin Yi took advantage of the chaos to escape.
He needed to leave immediately because those Demon Cultivators were likely targeting him.
“It seems that the conflict between Demon Cultivators is not as simple as we imagined,” Lin Yi thought to himself with a sigh. He then considered, “If I can’t resolve this crisis, then it will forever follow me.”
Lin Yi thought for a moment and immediately took out two Jade Talismans for communication. After crushing them, he quickly embedded the pieces into the bodies of the Demon Cultivators.
“Roar, roar!”
The Demon Cultivators, sensing the Jade Talismans that Lin Yi had implanted in their bodies, were overjoyed.
“Lin Yi, this little thief, must have realized our intentions, which is why he’s trying to call for help!”
“Hahaha! Those human cultivators will surely be easily slaughtered by us. Once Lin Yi is dead, the army of human cultivators will be leaderless, reducing the losses for our Demon Race by half!”
“Exactly, exactly, we must hurry back to our clan and share this great news with others. Then, our Demon Race’s people can recover their primordial energy!”
…
Lin Yi planned to use the hands of the Demon Cultivators to eradicate the human cultivators, so he wouldn’t have to worry about the human cultivators attacking their village anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 700 - 700 700 Constantly Changing Positions
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 700: Chapter 700: Constantly Changing Positions Chapter 700: Chapter 700: Constantly Changing Positions And his goal was achieved, as those Demon Cultivators indeed did not attack his fellow Human Clan cultivators.
“Swoosh! Swoosh!”
Lin Yi’s figure blurred as he took flight rapidly, reaching an astonishing speed. In the blink of an eye, he had flown tens of thousands of zhang away.
Those Demon Cultivators watched Lin Yi speeding away, greed flashing in their eyes as they began to search for his traces.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi was continuously changing his position, not daring to pause for even a moment.
Lin Yi had to avoid the attacks from those Demon Cultivators against the Human Clan cultivators while also being on guard against those Demon Cultivators. It was still better for him to not show himself before he had completely shaken them off. Otherwise, it was all too easy to draw the attention of the Demon Cultivators, and he might even risk being besieged by them.
Lin Yi knew that if he showed himself, he would fall into a perilous situation.
A quarter of an hour later, Lin Yi had left the area where the human cultivators were gathered and flew towards the territory of the Demon Race.
No sooner had Lin Yi taken off than a mountain suddenly fell from the sky, striking exactly where Lin Yi had just been. In an instant, the ground was smashed into a huge pit, with soil and rocks flying, and dust billowing.
Lin Yi looked up and upon seeing the owner of the mountain, his face slightly changed. He then transformed into a cloud of mist and quickly fled.
“Hmm? Human cultivator, you actually dared to run away! I want to see where you can escape to!”
“Hmph! Human cultivator, stop right there!!!”
“Damned human cultivator, today I will tear you to shreds!!!”
Those several Demon Kings roared furiously, shocked to see Lin Yi actually making a run for it; they chased after him together.
Lin Yi’s speed was incredibly fast, and in the blink of an eye, he had covered several thousand meters.
“Roar!”
“Roar!”
“Roar!”
The several Demon Kings, seeing Lin Yi flee, were furious and used their full power to cast spells, chasing after him.
Lin Yi took a glance and seeing the Demon Kings catching up, a grave look appeared on his face. Yet he did not slow down, continuing to fly into the distance. He was secretly relieved that he had not used the Light Escape Technique when he chose to run earlier, otherwise, he would have certainly been caught by those Demon Kings.
“Phew!”
Lin Yi took a deep breath, pushed his Spiritual Power to the limit, and then hastened his speed, disappearing from his original spot in an instant.
The several Demon Kings, although very powerful, could not match Lin Yi’s speed. In the blink of an eye, he had already widened the gap between them.
“Hmph, I want to see who can catch up to whom!” Lin Yi sneered coldly, his speed increasing even further.
Soon, the several Demon Kings started to lag behind.
This time, their target was Lin Yi, and they dared not be the slightest bit negligent, all exerting their strongest powers and reaching their utmost speed in the full pursuit of Lin Yi.
Lin Yi muttered coldly in his heart, not daring to ease off, moving at full speed. With each step, he covered more than ten zhang, and while fleeing, he also released his Divine Sense, carefully searching for traces of the Demon Cultivators, without any laxity.
He had to shake off those several Demon Kings as quickly as possible.
However, as soon as Lin Yi released his Divine Sense, he immediately sensed an extremely dense demon aura chasing after him from behind. Whirling around, he saw that the Demon Kings had caught up.
Frowning, he allowed a cold murderous intent to flash across his eyes, his figure shuddering as his speed suddenly increased several fold. He turned into an afterimage, instantly traversing several hundred zhang and fleeing in one direction.
“Damn!”
Seeing those Demon Cultivators biting at his heels, Lin Yi felt a surge of anger, but without any hesitation, he immediately pushed his extreme speed to the limit. His speed shot up several fold, like a spectral apparition, fleeting and elusive, he raced to the land of the Demon Race.
Those several Demon Cultivators, seeing Lin Yi’s figure vanish from their sight, showed a trace of irritation in their eyes.
“No good, that human cultivator has escaped!”
“Damned human cultivator, you won’t be able to escape!”
“Find him for me!”
“At all costs, he must be captured, or else we’ll be the laughingstock of those old relics of the Demon Race!”
“Damn it!”
The Demon Cultivators were filled with indignation, but they were helpless and had no choice but to continue searching for Lin Yi.
Seeing that his escape plan had failed, Lin Yi couldn’t help but chuckle bitterly, “I didn’t expect these guys to actually hunt me down. It seems that shaking them off is practically impossible!”
“Since there’s nowhere to run, then I simply won’t run. I can’t escape anyway!”
“Rather than running away, I might as well fight them!”
With a thought, Lin Yi stopped in his tracks, his eyes flickering with a cold murderous intent.
“Whoosh whoosh whoosh!”
As Lin Yi turned around, his figure suddenly changed, instantly transforming into a black dragon with a body length of a hundred meters.
This black dragon looked exactly like him, save for the wings, which were not golden, but otherwise it was identical to his appearance.
“What is this?”
The Demon Cultivators, seeing the transformation on Lin Yi, were all shocked, their faces filled with astonishment.
The Demon Cultivators, seeing that the dragon’s appearance was the same as Lin Yi’s, were all stunned, and their expressions became exceedingly strange.
Lin Yi’s body clearly emitted a thick aura of Dragon Might. Although it was only a wisp, it still made this group of demons feel tremendous pressure.
“Damn it! What the hell is going on?”
“That human Cultivator actually transformed into a dragon?”
“He can become a dragon??”
The many Demon Cultivators had looks of shock on their faces, full of confusion, not understanding what was going on and how Lin Yi suddenly became a dragon.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi, with a detached expression on his face and eyes filled with cold murderous intent, twisted his body as if to tear apart the very fabric of the void.
“Boom boom boom!”
Lin Yi’s scales trembled, and a terrifying aura of energy burst forth from his body. His stature grew larger and larger, eventually reaching nearly ten thousand meters in length.
A pitch-black giant serpent appeared behind him, coiling around his back and shaking his body, emanating a wave of destructive might.
“Hiss!!”
Seeing Lin Yi’s transformation, the Demon Cultivators all gasped in shock, their eyes brimming with intense horror.
After transforming into a dragon, Lin Yi exuded an immensely powerful aura from head to toe, giving them all a suffocating sense of crisis.
The Demon Cultivators felt the terrifying threatening presence emanating from Lin Yi’s body, their faces growing solemn, their hearts filled with fear.
“Not good! His transformation into a dragon will increase his speed a lot, and his strength will also rise. We might not be able to match him!”
“Retreat! Retreat quickly!!”
“Do not engage!!”
“This giant serpent is too powerful! We are no match at all!!”
The Demon Cultivators were greatly startled, their faces ashen with fear, feeling the immense threat, they panicked and turned to flee, scattering in all directions.
“Roar!”
A resonant dragon’s roar sounded, deafening to the ears.

chapters.title: Chapter 701 - 701 701 The Great Restorative Item
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 701: Chapter 701: The Great Restorative Item Chapter 701: Chapter 701: The Great Restorative Item The Demon Cultivators heard that sound, their hearts violently spasming, and their bodies couldn’t help but shudder with immense fear as they hurriedly fled toward the distance.
Those Demon Cultivators fled faster than rabbits and vanished in the blink of an eye, nowhere to be seen.
Lin Yi watched the direction in which the group of Demon Cultivators fled, a sneer of contempt flashing across his lips, “These wastes, to think they’d be scared into running away!”
“Hmph!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly and slapped his Qiankun Bag at his waist, taking out all the treasure medicines from inside.
Lin Yi retrieved a large amount of Demon Race treasure medicines, precisely seven plants, all of which were Sixth Rank treasure medicines, carrying an extremely rich abundance of Spiritual Energy and Life Force.
For a Cultivator like Lin Yi, who was highly sensitive to Soul Power, these were simply great tonics, and he stored all of them inside his Storage Ring.
After doing all this, Lin Yi put all of these Demon Race treasure medicines into the Storage Ring.
Having finished these tasks, Lin Yi finally turned around and flew toward the direction where the group of Demon Cultivators had fled.
Lin Yi’s speed was incredibly swift, his body flashing a thousand zhang in an instant, and almost in the blink of an eye, he was right behind those Demon Cultivators, opening his massive Dragon Mouth and devouring them.
The group of Demon Cultivators, desperately running for their lives, suddenly heard the sound of a dragon’s chant, terrifying them so much that their bodies trembled, nearly causing them to fall flat on the ground.
“What, what is this sound?”
“Could it be a Demon Clan’s beast roaring? How is that possible? Shouldn’t the beasts of the Demon Clan stay in the forest? How did this giant python make its way into the depths of the forest? This is the battlefield where the Demon Race clashes with the Demon Clan!!”
These Demon Cultivators were scared out of their wits, filled with terror in their hearts, not daring to stop, and continued to flee desperately forward.
“Buzz!”
Lin Yi’s body suddenly shrank, returning to his original form, back to a normal state.
Once the Dragon Might dissipated from Lin Yi’s body, those Demon Cultivators ceased their flight and turned their heads to look in Lin Yi’s direction.
Lin Yi’s appearance also returned to its previous state, his clothes ragged and bloodstained, his hair in disarray, his body full of wounds, but emanating a ferocious and overwhelming aura.
“Damn Human Clan brat! How dare you transform into a dragon!!!”
“Human Clan brat, today happens to be your lucky day having run into us Demon Race, but you’ll definitely meet your demise here!”
“If we don’t slay you today, where is the majesty of our Demon Race!”
“Attack together, spare no cost to kill this brat. I want to excavate his Dragon Bone to use for Refinement of Magic Artifacts!”
Those Demon Cultivators clenched their teeth with hatred, their eyes filled with resentment and the intent to kill.
“Good!”
“Kill him, avenge our Demon Race!”
All the Demon Cultivators roared in unison, bursting forth and charging at Lin Yi, their eyes brimming with murderous intent.
“Kill!!!”
All of those Demon Cultivators waved their weapons, attacking Lin Yi with frenzy.
The group of Demon Cultivators were all at the Peak of the Ninth Rank, while Lin Yi’s Realm had just barely stepped into the Nascent Soul Stage, a difference of two Great Realms, putting the two on completely different levels.
Therefore, Lin Yi did not take those Demon Cultivators seriously.
“Roar!”
“Howl!”
A Demon Cultivator rushed forward to Lin Yi, a claw aiming straight for Lin Yi’s head to strike down.
Lin Yi raised his right palm and threw a punch to meet the incoming attack. With a muffled bang, the sound echoed throughout the entire valley, and a huge burst of light exploded forth.
Lin Yi and that Demon Cultivator were both sent flying dozens of yards away.
“Bang! Bang! Bang!”
The Demon Cultivator smashed through five trees in succession before he stabilized his figure. However, he staggered and nearly fell to the ground, his face deathly pale. His eyes were fixed on Lin Yi with a look of residual fear.
“Damn Human Clan brat, I admit, I underestimated you, but it’s impossible for you to kill me. I am a half-step Nascent Soul Great Demon, you definitely can’t kill me!!!”
The Demon Cultivator smiled coldly, forming hand seals. A burst of Monster Flame sprang from his palm, coalescing into a large fiery demon wolf behind him, which howled to the sky with an earth-shattering roar, its form as fast as lightning, pouncing towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly, a cold light flashing in his gaze as a mocking sneer appeared at the corner of his mouth.
His figure flickered and vanished, only to reappear behind the demon wolf the next moment.
The Demon Cultivator’s complexion underwent a drastic change. It was too late to dodge, as Lin Yi’s Dragon Claw reached out and crushed his shoulder.
“Aah!”
A painful wail rang out, the Demon Cultivator screaming incessantly, his body trembling violently.
“Aah!”
The Demon Cultivator howled again, his shoulder bone shattered.
The Demon Cultivator’s body went limp, falling to his knees.
“Thud!”
The Demon Cultivator lay on the ground like a dead dog, writhing in agony, his body convulsing.
The Demon Cultivator cried out in pain, his body shaking and twitching, and he continuously emitted painful moans from his mouth.
“As expected of a half-step Nascent Soul Great Demon of the Demon Race, the physical body is indeed strong. But to think he couldn’t withstand this move of mine, and I even held back. Otherwise, this strike would have crushed his body!” Lin Yi muttered to himself inwardly.
After that, Lin Yi threw away the demon wolf and walked forward to take the Storage Bag from the Demon Cultivator.
“Aah!”
Seeing his Storage Bag taken away, the Demon Cultivator immediately roared in frenzy. However, he was pinned down by Lin Yi’s giant claw and couldn’t fight back. He could only watch Lin Yi take away the Storage Bag.
“Hmph!”
Lin Yi glanced at him, snorted coldly, and turned to fly out of the valley.
Watching Lin Yi’s retreating figure, the group of Demon Cultivators were all filled with immense anger, wishing they could chase after him and tear Lin Yi to shreds right away.
“Damn it!!!”
The Demon Cultivator gritted his teeth, wishing he could rush over and fight Lin Yi to the death, to slay Lin Yi.
But in the end, he held himself back.
“Hmph! Human Clan kid, do you think you’re safe just because you escaped?” The Demon Cultivator’s gaze was dark, his eyes rolling around as if concocting some sinister scheme.
“Human brat, you’ve killed so many of our Demon Race brethren, you must pay the price today!”
“Just you wait, once our Demon Race arrives, we will surely crush your body into thousands of pieces, incinerate your bones and scatter them to the winds, you will never find peace in death!” The group of Demon Cultivators cursed Lin Yi fiercely, their eyes filled with resentment and the intent to kill.
The Demon Race is a group of bloodthirsty monsters, and once incited, they truly could kill Lin Yi to avenge their comrades.
“Since you so wish to seek death, then I shall oblige you!”
Lin Yi’s eyes were chillingly cold as he sneered. Then a dragon’s roar echoed, transforming into a golden dragon-shaped light that charged towards the group of Demon Cultivators.

chapters.title: Chapter 702 - 702 702 Offering Up Ones Own Magic Artifact
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 702: Chapter 702: Offering Up One’s Own Magic Artifact Chapter 702: Chapter 702: Offering Up One’s Own Magic Artifact The group of Demon Cultivators’ faces changed dramatically as they each brought out their Magic Artifacts and launched an attack towards Lin Yi.
Their strength was far from mediocre, and when they unleashed their Magic Artifacts, the power was terrifying. Furious energy burst forth from the artifacts, compressing the air until it exploded, sweeping towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi sneered and with a leap, dodged the attacks of these Demon Cultivators. His figure weaved through the air, leaving behind afterimages that flashed, making it impossible to discern which was real and which was fake as he dodged around the group of Demon Cultivators.
The group of Demon Cultivators were taken aback, then burst out in curses, “Despicable Human Clan scum, I’m going to tear you to pieces!!!”
“Hmph!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly and suddenly appeared behind a Demon wolf, kicked out fiercely, and sent the wolf tumbling to the ground, spitting blood heavily as it crashed down.
Another Demon wolf roared angrily and opened its mouth to spit a cloud of black mist at Lin Yi, but Lin Yi suddenly reached out and grabbed the wolf by the neck, preventing it from releasing the poison fog.
Lin Yi’s Dragon Claw swiftly reached out, grabbing the Demon wolf by the neck and twisting sharply.
Crack!
The Demon wolf’s neck was twisted and broken instantly. The beast let out a pitiful howl before it died completely.
Once again, Lin Yi displayed his terrifying combat power, practically a one-shot kill!
The group of Demon Cultivators watched Lin Yi’s actions with changing expressions.
“This guy is a freak!”
“Too powerful! We are no match for this guy at all!”
“What should we do? How should we deal with this guy?”
“The Demon Sea is not far from here. With his strength being so formidable, it would definitely be dangerous if he entered the Demon Sea. Are we really going to lead him into the depths of the Demon Sea?”
“But if we don’t lure this Human Clan brat into the depths of the Demon Sea, our Demon Race will also suffer heavy losses. If the clan leader finds out, we will be punished!”
“Damn it! What should we do?”
“Are we really going to let this Human Clan brat venture into the Demon Sea just like that? With his strength, he’s bound to gain many treasures once inside. Can we really stop him?”
“Are we to just let him enter the Demon Sea? If he gets in there, won’t our Demon Clan be facing extinction?”
“But if we don’t draw this Human Clan kid into the Demon Sea, then our people will be completely annihilated!”
“No! We can’t just watch him leave!”
…
The group of Demon Cultivators discussed amongst themselves with very ugly expressions.
“Heh, what a bunch of fools!” Lin Yi’s mouth curled up, exposing a mocking smile. With a thought, he summoned the Qingjiao Sword.
With a whoosh, the Qingjiao Sword turned into a phantom shadow of a green dragon, hovering at Lin Yi’s side.
“Qingjiao, come and help!”
Lin Yi shouted loudly, and the Qingjiao Sword hummed, radiating streams of green light that turned into a green spear in Lin Yi’s hand.
“Awoo!”
A gigantic beast, over five zhang tall and muscular in stature, with a green body, appeared. It opened its jaws wide and howled skyward.
Suddenly, a powerful sucking force emerged out of nowhere, enveloping everyone.
“Damn! What the hell is this thing?”
“Why do I feel like my body isn’t responding?”
“Damn it! I can’t even stand properly, shake that monster off quick!”
“No, we can’t seem to move at all!”
…
The demon cultivators cried out in alarm, their eyes shimmering with panic as they struggled fiercely, attempting to resist the sucking force with all their might as their spiritual power churned wildly within them.
But, the sucking force was just too great, and they were unable to withstand it.
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang…
They were sent flying, blood spewing from their mouths.
Lin Yi sneered, then moved swiftly to attack again, stepping repeatedly on the demon cultivators who fell beneath his feet and eliciting pained grunts with each relentless stomp.
“Didn’t you want to hunt me down? So, how come you’re so easily defeated by me now?”
Lin Yi looked down on them from above with disdain, sneeringly said.
At that moment, the demon cultivators’ faces were extremely unsightly, filled with humiliation, their hearts brimming with hatred toward Lin Yi, wishing to dismember his body into ten thousand pieces, but could do nothing as Lin Yi was simply too fast for them to catch.
Even the wolf of the Demon Emperor’s peak realm couldn’t possibly catch up with Lin Yi.
“Human, dare you humiliate us so, our demon race will never let you off! The elites of our demon race will soon arrive, and by then, even if you had wings, you would not be able to escape. You will be hunted down by our experts and never be reborn!”
The demon race leader, teeth clenched in anger, glared at Lin Yi with an intense blaze of rage in his eyes, swearing in his heart that he must grind Lin Yi to dust to alleviate the hatred simmering within him.
“Is that so? Then I’ll simply wait for the arrival of your demon race’s elites,” Lin Yi replied with disdain, giving the demon cultivators a sweeping glance.
“Despicable human brat, don’t be too arrogant! Once our clan leader arrives to capture you, turning you into a puppet, you’ll live a fate worse than death!” the demon race leader roared, a vicious glint flashing in his eyes as he stared at Lin Yi, and wished desperately to dismember him.
“Heh, we’ll see when the time comes,” Lin Yi replied with an indifferent smile, not taking the matter to heart.
“Hmph! Let’s go!”
With a wave of his hand, the demon race leader led the demon cultivators racing towards the depths of the Demon Sea, quickly disappearing without a trace, as if they’d never been there.
“Those demons are really crafty, actually running away.”
“Damn it! This grudge, we must avenge sooner or later!”
“No need to rush, they won’t be able to get away! I believe they’ll be turning up on our doorstep very soon for us to properly deal with them!”
“Exactly!”
“But now, let’s first remove the restrictions on us, I’m about to suffocate!”
“Yeah, remove the bindings, or else we’ll suffer the backlash!”
Lin Yi nodded at their words, lifting the restrictions, rescuing the multitude of demon cultivators, and lifting the restrictions from them.
Once the restrictions were lifted, the demon cultivators were overwhelmed with emotion, looking at Lin Yi with red-rimmed eyes.
“Human lad, I almost died at your hands just now! I thought I was a goner for sure, but you ended up saving me in the end. You are truly magnificent!”
“You’re nothing less than a savior to our demon race; had it not been for you, our demon race would have been wiped clean by this group of demons!”
“Human lad, if you ever need assistance from our demon race in the future, just come to us. Our demon race will certainly help you without hesitation!”
“Yes, you are the savior of our demon race. If not for you, we too would have hardly escaped death. You are an honored guest of our demon race, and we must protect you with all our might!”
…
The group of demon cultivators spoke excitedly, their eyes full of gratitude when they looked at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi waved his hand and said, “You don’t need to thank me so much; it’s what you deserved. If not for me, you would’ve died by the hands of the demon race’s experts long ago. So, I don’t owe you anything; instead, you should cherish your lives now and enjoy them to the fullest.”

chapters.title: Chapter 703 - 703 703 Bending Over to Pay Respects
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 703: Chapter 703: Bending Over to Pay Respects Chapter 703: Chapter 703: Bending Over to Pay Respects “Yes, Human Clan boy!”
“Yes, Human Clan lad!”
The many Demon Cultivators respectfully called out, their eyes filled with admiration.
“Alright, now that you’ve been released from your restraints, you should hurry back,” Lin Yi said.
“Thank you, Human Clan lad!” The group of Demon Cultivators bowed to Lin Yi in unison before turning and leaving.
Watching them go, Lin Yi let out a sigh of relief, his body wavered, and he once again landed on the ground.
By that time, the group of Demon Cultivators had already run far away.
“Eh? What’s this, a cave?”
Lin Yi suddenly discovered there was a small cave here, and with a puzzled frown, he walked towards it.
Soon, he entered the small cavern.
It was a very small valley, but it had many branching paths.
“It looks like this cave is where the Demon Cultivators hide treasures or other riches. I wonder what treasures this little cavern holds?” Lin Yi thought to himself.
Though he didn’t lack wealth, he still hoped his Cultivation could break through to the Holy King Realm. By then, the treasures he owned would become even more precious. Therefore, he was very interested in the treasures inside this valley.
“This small cavern has three paths leading to three different caves. Which one should I choose?”
Lin Yi silently contemplated in his heart and then focused his attention on the three different cave entrances, starting to make his choice.
Each of these caves was surrounded by a thin mist, emitting a faint, eerie fluctuation.
Lin Yi released his Primordial Spirit power to carefully observe the three caves.
After a moment, Lin Yi finally confirmed that all three caves were filled with a thick Demon Beast aura!
“These three caverns are the Black Serpent Cave, White Tiger Cave, and Vermilion Bird Cave, definitely filled with the Demon Race’s wealth and abundant at that, all of them from Demon Beasts of at least the Seventh Rank,” Lin Yi thought to himself.
“No matter, I’ll explore first and then decide!” Lin Yi said in his heart, taking steps into a cavern leading to the Black Serpent Cave to search for the treasures within.
As Lin Yi entered the Black Serpent Cave, he immediately felt a chill hit him, a cold and damp breath enveloping the surroundings.
This Black Serpent Cave was even more spacious than the other two, perhaps as wide as a thousand feet, with many Demon Beast corpses lying on the ground. These Demon Beasts were mostly at the Shape Transformation Phase, some even reaching half a step into becoming a Demon Sovereign, and there were also some at the peak of the Shape Transformation Phase, but they had still fallen.
However, these Demon Beasts were among the best of the Demon Race, and their Demon Cores were of immense value, a rare find.
Lin Yi’s gaze swept over these Demon Beast corpses, calculating in his heart. If he were to refine all these Demon Cores, his Cultivation would definitely improve, and his strength would increase tremendously. By refining all these Demon Cores, his strength could at least reach the Peak of the Later Stages of the Spirit Transformation Realm!
Furthermore, on these Demon Cores, he could temper his Physical Body, making it even stronger, and his Combat Power would also receive a huge boost!
However, the Demon Beast aura on these Demon Cores was strong; he couldn’t act rashly. He would have to wait until the Demon Beast Essence contained within the cores was fully refined before making his move!
Having thought this, Lin Yi stopped searching for these Demon Cores.
“Forget it, don’t hurry to harvest them. My Physical Body is too weak right now; if I forcibly try to refine the Demon Cores, I might suffer a backlash,”
Lin Yi shook his head, planning to leave this place first.
“Hmm? What is this?”
Just as Lin Yi was about to leave, he suddenly discovered a palm-sized jade pendant. The entire pendant was pitch-black, oval-shaped, and engraved with intricate patterns, exuding an air of ancient heaviness.
This jade pendant was pitch-black and crystal clear, with five blood-red pearls inlaid on it, making it appear particularly peculiar.
These five blood-red pearls were solidified from the blood of demon beasts, representing the essence of their blood, imbued with tremendous energy. Consuming this demon beast blood would allow cultivators at the peak of the Early Stage of Divine Sense to improve by one or two small realms!
Moreover, this blood had an astonishing restorative effect for demon cultivators!
If someone could consume a drop of this blood, they would immediately recover from their injuries!
Of course, a single drop of this blood was also very expensive, beyond what ordinary people could afford.
“The material of this jade pendant is extraordinary, and it contains the bloodline of a demon beast. I wonder what effect it has.”
Lin Yi grasped the pendant and examined it closely.
“Where did this jade pendant come from? I seem to have seen this kind of pendant somewhere before, but I can’t remember where at the moment.”
Lin Yi frowned and scrutinized the jade pendant in his hand.
“This jade pendant harbors an extremely vast demonic aura; I wonder which demon beast’s demon core it was refined from? And the energy contained within this demon core must be quite immense; I wonder if I can absorb it?”
Lin Yi pondered in his mind.
Although he could use his Primordial Spirit’s power to absorb the energy from the demon cores of these beasts, such absorption was inefficient, and it also required a large amount of spirit stones to sustain, which was simply not cost-effective!
“Well, although this jade pendant contains huge demonic energy and power, it is only a half-step away from a Holy King-level demon core. If I absorb it, there shouldn’t be a problem!” Lin Yi thought secretly.
Then, Lin Yi took the demon core and began to absorb the energy within the demon beast’s demon core, transforming all that energy into his own soul power.
It must be said, the energy within the demon beast’s demon core was extremely vast, comparable to the energy within an ordinary person’s body, and perhaps even more potent.
Lin Yi converted all that energy into soul power, causing his soul power to grow even more rapidly.
“Hmm? How strange, this demon core keeps getting bigger, something seems off here.”
Suddenly, Lin Yi realized that his soul power was continuously increasing, and in no time, it had reached about twice its original size.
“Could it be that this demon beast’s demon core has absorbed my Primordial Spirit’s power?” Lin Yi was overjoyed.
The soul power contained within a demon core is different from that of Primordial Spirit. Primordial Spirit is composed of Divine Sense, whereas a demon core’s soul power is made from the demon beast’s core itself, both types of power originating from the soul.
If it were an ordinary soul, which is just a common force, it naturally couldn’t absorb the energy of the demon core. However, this demon beast’s demon core contained a potent force of soul power, allowing it to help Lin Yi absorb the energy within the demon core and make his Primordial Spirit increasingly formidable.
“This demon beast’s demon core is indeed extraordinary, not only containing soul power but also immense demon beast essence!” Lin Yi exclaimed in amazement, his heart racing with excitement.
As his soul power increased, his physical cultivation also grew continuously, exuding an enormous and formidable aura around him.
This mighty aura made the temperature of the entire space start to decline.
Lin Yi stood in the depths of the Dark Abyss, his eyes shining brilliantly like stars, sparkling with dazzling light!
“Such a formidable soul attack technique, if cultivated to a high level, its power will be extremely terrifying!”
Lin Yi secretly marveled in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 704 - 704 704 Not Well Consolidated
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 704: Chapter 704 Not Well Consolidated Chapter 704: Chapter 704 Not Well Consolidated However, Lin Yi didn’t use that technique; his Soul Power had just broken through to the Early Stage Nascent Soul and wasn’t yet consolidated, so he couldn’t easily use such powerful offensive spells.
“Eh? Where are the bones of those Demon Beasts after they died? Why haven’t they been absorbed by this cave mansion?” Lin Yi wondered.
“Perhaps the cave mansion was built to protect these Demon Beasts,” Lin Yi speculated.
Just then, his Soul suddenly sensed a terrifying aura rushing towards him!
“Who?!”
Lin Yi’s Divine Sense spread out, instantly capturing that terrifying aura.
It was a huge black python, its body extremely long, almost reaching the edge of the cave. Its tail was very long, like a Long Whip, swinging and causing rocks at the entrance of the cave to fly away, resulting in a cloud of dust, as if heavenly punishment had descended.
“Is that a Demon Python?”
Lin Yi looked at the enormous black python with vigilance in his eyes, immediately locking on with his Soul Power, enveloping the python, and then charged towards it.
The black python’s Cultivation was at the Later Stages Nascent Soul, a king among the Demon Beasts and a poisonous snake at that, known for being very sly.
Whilst locked by Lin Yi’s Soul Power, the black python felt a sense of danger, wanting to escape, but its body was already restrained, completely unable to move.
“Roar!”
The black python opened its mouth and hissed, a mass of black fog gushing out, striking towards Lin Yi.
