Lin Yi sneered, stomped his right foot in the void, and his figure surged out instantly, appearing beside the black fog, and then lifted his leg, kicking fiercely.
With that kick, imbued with his power, there was a loud bang, directly bursting the black fog!
After the black fog exploded, Lin Yi threw another punch.
With this punch, a golden colossal fist, carrying the oppressive might that could destroy everything, slammed into the black fog, completely shattering it!
Then, the black fog dispersed.
Lin Yi once again stepped into the cave. He looked around but didn’t see the black-robed man, his heart puzzled, “Could the black-robed man have already left the cave? But he surely would not give up on the treasures of this mansion, otherwise he wouldn’t have set traps outside to wait for me.”
The black-robed man’s trap-setting methods were very cunning, but it also gave Lin Yi a glimmer of hope, allowing him to escape a calamity, instead of being killed.
“It seems that there must be treasures hidden within this cave mansion, surely related to the owner of the mansion. No matter what, I must break in and explore, who knows, I might even find a chance,” Lin Yi decided in his heart.
With his mind made up, Lin Yi took steps towards the entrance left by the black-robed man.
Lin Yi was extremely fast, his figure a blur, and he pierced through the black fog to arrive at the area where the black-robed man had set the trap.
Lin Yi stopped at the entrance to the cave mansion, looking at the ancient and vicissitudes of the mansion before him, somewhat disheartened.
The scale of this cave mansion was vast, larger than the one Lin Yi had been in before. The walls of the mansion were engraved with ancient characters, carved with various Runes, mysterious and unknowable, giving one a very strong sense of oppression, as if it could suppress everything.
Lin Yi’s gaze swept around, searching within the mansion.
In the center of the cave mansion was a hall, at the tip of which a tremendous Luminous Pearl was inlaid, radiating brilliant light that illuminated the mansion.
Inside the hall were dozens of skeletal remains. The chests of the skeletons were all pierced, exposing the hearts inside, but by this time the hearts had long ceased to beat.
On these skeletons, there were various sword marks, some very long, some very short, showing that these wounds were fatal!
These skeletons were all of the Demon Race, slain by that black-robed man.
Lin Yi’s heart shook.
How terrifying was this robed man, that even demon beasts of the Demon Emperor Level were slain by him?
“It seems that truly hidden within this cave dwelling are treasures. This item might even save my life.”
Lin Yi thought to himself and immediately walked towards the depths of the hall.
The hall was exceedingly spacious. As Lin Yi walked through it, it was as if he had entered another world, one without darkness, only sunshine.
There was a door inside the hall.
Lin Yi reached out and knocked on the door, from within came an aged, hoarse voice, “Come in.”
Hearing this voice, Lin Yi pushed open the door and entered. His gaze swept around, finally resting on the black stele in the center of the hall.
In the center of the black stele was a black jade token, with a pattern engraved on it. This pattern was exactly the blood-red demonic face that Lin Yi had seen earlier, except the blood-red demon’s face had disappeared, replaced by a human face!
And this human face, it was Lin Yi’s!
“What’s going on?”
Lin Yi’s eyes widened in disbelief at the scene before him.
His identity was clearly that of an ordinary youth, so how did it morph into the visage of a blood-red skeleton, and what did this stele signify?
Lin Yi’s mind was filled with confusion. Suddenly, many questions arose in his mind, but he was unable to answer them right away. He quickly closed his eyes, calmed his mind, and concentrated, striving to sort through the confusion.
But Lin Yi’s soul power could not touch this blood-red stele at all.
This blood-red stele seemed to contain an extremely terrifying binding force that prevented him from touching it.
Lin Yi tried several times but was unable to disperse this binding force.
“No wonder the master of this cave dwelling was unwilling to enter this valley. This blood-red stele is definitely his way of deception. He must have used some method to change the original appearance of this cave dwelling, which is why it remained unnoticed by anyone.”
“However, now that I have entered this cave dwelling, I want to see how long you can trap me!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly in his heart, continuing to observe the stele.
“Hm?”
All of a sudden, Lin Yi noticed from the corner of his eye that a line of blood-red characters had appeared on the stele!
“Blood Sacrifice Ceremony!”
These blood-red characters were like living things, wriggling and changing continuously on the stele.
At this moment, a flash of shock, even panic, crossed Lin Yi’s eyes.
“This blood-red stele can actually write!”
Lin Yi exclaimed inwardly but remained composed, staring intently at the blood-red stele, eager to find out what exactly it was revealing.
“Who left behind this blood-red stele, and how could they control the blood-red demon?”
Lin Yi was filled with doubts. He recalled the robed youth he had encountered in the valley earlier, a man at the peak of the Primordial Divine Realm, with terrifying strength who could easily slay a martial artist at the eighth layer of the Primordial Divine Realm. So what was the level of this blood-red stele?
These questions, Lin Yi could not figure out at all.
However, he was not afraid. With the blood-red stele as a barrier, he did not believe the robed man would stay outside forever, waiting for him to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 705 - 705 705 Activating the Myriad Transformations
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 705: Chapter 705: Activating the “Myriad Transformations Art Chapter 705: Chapter 705: Activating the “Myriad Transformations Art Lin Yi continued to stare at the blood-colored stele, trying to make out the content inscribed on it.
On this blood-colored stele, it seemed as if blood was flowing faintly across it, emitting a strong scent of blood.
Lin Yi stared at the blood-colored stele when suddenly he felt a slight movement in his heart. He reached out his palm and pressed it against the blood-colored stele, and instantly felt a force from the stele.
A mysterious force repelled him, and at the same time, this force seemed to want to break through Lin Yi’s physical body, tearing his flesh apart!
Lin Yi was shocked and quickly circulated his Cultivation Technique, invoking the “Transformation Scripture” to withstand this force.
Boom!
The blood on the stele instantly turned into a towering blood wave, surging out from the stele and forming a heavenly sea of blood, dyeing the entire hall blood-red.
Lin Yi was taken aback as the blood turned into a towering sea, corroding the walls of the grand hall, with a large amount of magma splashing out, setting the hall ablaze.
“What a formidable power. What on earth is this that possesses such terrifying strength?”
Lin Yi was immensely shocked in his heart and hurriedly invoked the “Transformation Scripture” to resist.
Lin Yi’s “Transformation Scripture” had been cultivated to the Ninth Level of Perfection, yet under the onslaught of the blood-colored stele, it still seemed to be on the verge of failing.
“Ah!”
Lin Yi screamed in agony, his body shaking violently. His clothes were completely corroded by the towering sea of blood, leaving his skin bloodied and blackened, as if corroded with numerous tiny holes. As blood dripped into these holes, it immediately seeped in.
Lin Yi’s skin, after being soaked by this blood water, immediately turned black.
Lin Yi felt the pain and couldn’t help but let out an angry roar, invoking the “Transformation Scripture” and executing a move from the “Sky Gang Five Elements Sword Qi,” splitting the omnipresent blood water.
Although Lin Yi dodged the blood water, his hands were corroded in an instant, revealing his pale jade-like wrists and shoulders.
On Lin Yi’s arms, black smoke rose in thin tendrils, with strands of Qing Yan smoke, his skin corroded with blood holes from which blood gushed out, completely corroding his entire arm.
Lin Yi was horrified and quickly circulated his Cultivation Technique to heal his wounds, but the situation did not improve.
“Although my strength is now much stronger than when I first entered, this stele is too terrifying. It can actually injure my physical body!”
Lin Yi felt his injuries and was incomparably astounded.
At that moment, the stele surged with another tide of blood water, enveloping the entire stele and forming a blood pool, encasing Lin Yi within!
Lin Yi suddenly felt a chilling wind blowing, making him feel cold all over as if he were in a millennium-old cold pond, shiveringly cold.
“This is a kind of cold air; this cold air is very strange, actually capable of freezing someone’s physical body!”
Lin Yi’s heart tightened, and he quickly circulated the True Yuan in his body to expel the cold air within, not allowing it to invade his body.
At this time, Lin Yi realized that this cold air was not ordinary but was transmitted through the bloodline, and it also carried a special oppressive force that made it hard for him to breathe.
“Bloodline? Could this be some type of bloodline power?”
Lin Yi was puzzled.
His gaze turned to the blood-colored runes on the stele.
He saw that the blood-colored runes on the stele, as if coming to life, started to flicker with beams of red light, forming different characters that jumped and shimmered upon the stele.
Lin Yi’s pupils constricted as he sensed the characters leaping on the stele contained a very strong fluctuation of blood energy that was unsettling.
“Blood energy, it’s actually blood energy!”
Lin Yi was incredibly shocked.
He had once listened to his father describe that within the blood, there were many things: life, wisdom, strength, and cultivation. There were even countless powerful demon beasts, but he had never heard his father mention the existence of bloodlines!
“What bloodline does this stele belong to?” Lin Yi frowned.
“Bloodline power, this bloodline power, could it be related to the ‘bloodline’ mentioned in the legacy?”
Lin Yi was shocked, his heart set churning with waves, unable to calm down.
It was said that the place mentioned in the legacy was a site from ancient times containing great treasures and secrets. However, it was fraught with dangers and crises. It was rumored to host many powerful demon beasts, fierce birds, and even terrifying Demon Kings!
Although the site was incredibly alluring, no one dared approach it, save for a few powerful human beings, who would seek the treasures and secrets within.
Rumors from the end of ancient times told of people who accidentally stumbled into the site, but unfortunately perished, leaving not even bones behind. In the end, nobody knew what the site truly contained, nor what exactly lay within it.
“Perhaps, within that site, there really is something that could rival the legacy. Otherwise, why would so many powerful beings want to explore the site.”
Lin Yi’s eyes lit up, shining with a fervent glow.
He was in need of an item that could rival the legacy, and this Blood Sha Stele was undoubtedly a treasure, a godsend in this snowfall for him.
“Since that’s the case, I might as well put it in the storage bag. This time, I came for the Blood Sha Stele!”
As soon as Lin Yi formed the thought, he prepared to take the Blood Sha Stele, but at that moment, a deep roar echoed in his mind.
Lin Yi’s heart went cold, and he promptly stopped his action, looking up at the stele.
At that moment, two large characters appeared on the stele.
[Blood Sha Tomb]!
Lin Yi’s heart trembled, and his face suddenly changed drastically.
The stele was clearly marked with these words, obviously a warning to him!
“What does this mean?” Lin Yi frowned, speechless. “There’s actually a tomb here? What’s going on? Could there be some terrifying creature inside this tomb?”
Lin Yi couldn’t help but speculate that this tomb might be the remains of some ancient ferocious beast.
In ancient times, there were countless types of ferocious beasts, each with their own bloodline inheritance, strong and fearsome. If one could learn from them, it would surely greatly enhance one’s combat power.
As for Lin Yi, who had come far on the path of immortal cultivation, if he wanted to rapidly improve himself, apart from absorbing heavenly materials and precious herbs, he also needed continuous battle and experience to advance his realm and gain cultivation resources.
However, this method was extremely slow. To elevate one’s realm, the only way was through killing, defeating enemies with a higher realm than one’s own, and seizing their treasures and resources.
And now, Lin Yi had just encountered these two large characters on the blood-colored stele.
“No matter, I’ll first take this blood-colored stele. Once I leave that place, I’ll find a way to explore this place and see what’s really here.”
Lin Yi thought to himself and reached out for the cluster of bloodlight!
The bloodlight vanished, and so did the blood-colored stele.
“Hum!”
Suddenly, the stele once again burst forth with a blinding red light, which enveloped Lin Yi completely.
Enshrouded by the light, Lin Yi exclaimed in shock. He felt as though he was in a furnace, his inner power surging wildly, as if trying to break free from the confines of the bloodlight.
“What’s going on? Is my body going to collapse? What’s happening?”
Lin Yi panicked and quickly tried to use his inner power to resist this force, but it was to no avail.

chapters.title: Chapter 706 - 706 706 Spiritual Energy Protects the Heart
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 706: Chapter 706: Spiritual Energy Protects the Heart Chapter 706: Chapter 706: Spiritual Energy Protects the Heart His blood power was being devoured by the blood light bit by bit, his skin cracking open in patches, as blood constantly spilled out like a fountain.
“Pfft!”
Suddenly, Lin Yi spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, his complexion instantly turned pale, and his body swayed, almost falling to the ground.
“Not good, this stele is actually sucking my blood dry. If I don’t use Spiritual Energy to protect my heart soon, I might be drained completely, and then I’ll die!”
Lin Yi panicked, quickly circulated his heart, and frantically urged Spiritual Power to resist the Bloodline Power coming from outside.
But the power inside him was too weak to withstand the erosion of that Bloodline Power.
“Bang!”
“Thump!”
Lin Yi knelt down on both knees, his knees sinking deep into the floor, his entire body kneeling on the ground, convulsing all over, in extreme pain.
Lin Yi’s face turned ashen, his forehead covered in sweat, his body trembling incessantly.
He was gripped by boundless fear, sensing the danger of death!
He was unwilling to die like this!
The rage in Lin Yi’s heart burned fiercely, he wanted to resist, but he found he couldn’t do it, the blood light was too overbearing, sucking out all the blood inside him!
The blood left in him was no longer sufficient to sustain his life, if he didn’t quickly use Spiritual Power to heal himself, he feared he might die in this cave!
“What exactly is going on?”
Lin Yi was surprised, his heart filled with confusion and panic.
Suddenly, a black mist emerged, enveloping the space above Lin Yi’s head, a thick stench of blood exuding from the black fog, so intense it made one want to vomit!
This black mist seemed to be the aura of some creature, making one instinctively want to stay far away!
“Ahhh!”
Feeling the horror of that black mist, Lin Yi couldn’t help but scream, filled with fear and dread. This black mist gave him a feeling of extreme danger, it was definitely not something ordinary, most likely a very powerful being!
“No, it’s not something ordinary, it must be some powerful Demon Beast!”
Suddenly, such a thought surfaced in Lin Yi’s mind.
Lin Yi remembered that on Earth, some powerful Demon Beasts liked to hide their aura, then lay in ambush to attack ordinary Cultivators. That was the nature of Demon Beasts.
However, the aura in this black mist was different from ordinary Demon Beasts; it was an extremely evil and terrifying aura, making Lin Yi feel unparalleled fear.
“Could it be the Blood Demon Clan?”
Lin Yi speculated.
The aura of the Blood Demon Clan was similar to that of the Blood Fiend Sect, but there were differences; after all, the Blood Fiend Sect’s aura was Blood Fiend Energy, whereas the Blood Demon Clan’s aura was an incredibly intense Blood Fiend Energy.
The Blood Demon Clan was terrifying and possessed a bit of Bloodline Power, but it was extremely evil. Once they cast a Blood Curse, they could absorb the life force of living beings to strengthen their own power, which was why Lin Yi’s initial judgment was the Blood Demon Clan.
But what exactly was the Blood Demon Clan?
Lin Yi’s heart was filled with confusion.
He didn’t understand why the Blood Demon Clan would target him!
The Blood Demon Clan was the most evil group of beings on this continent.
Although they were only left with a wisp of remnant souls, their bloodlines remained extremely powerful and pure. Once they set their sights on someone, hardly anyone could escape. They would either be possessed, drained of bloodline power, or have their physical body devoured!
Lin Yi did not know whether there was an existence of the Blood Demon Clan within this Ancient Tomb; that was why he wanted to enter, to figure out why all of this was happening.
“Roar!”
Just then, a terrifying roar exploded from within the black fog, like a wild beast furiously roaring, the sound filled with rage and violence, sending a shiver through Lin Yi’s body.
“Boom!”
An immense pressure emanated from the black fog, oppressive like a great mountain bearing down.
Lin Yi felt as though his body was about to explode, his blood boiling as if it were, his strength suppressed to an extreme.
Lin Yi’s face drastically changed as he quickly mobilized the Spiritual Pearl in his dantian. The pearl released a surge of effusive blood energy that rapidly enveloped his body, dissolving the oppression of this force.
But that blood energy was too overwhelming and completely incapable of suppressing this formidable presence.
The oppressive force was simply too terrifying, even the blood within Lin Yi’s body felt its suppression.
“Boom!”
Suddenly, a black serpent shot out from the fog, circling above Lin Yi’s head, and from its mouth shot a blood-red bolt of lightning, which thunderously struck Lin Yi’s body.
“Aah!”
Lin Yi let out a piercing scream, his body trembling violently as if being torn apart countless times, his clothing shredded to reveal a perfect physique, the veins on his skin bulging and turning purple as if struck by lightning.
“Ah! Am I going to die?”
A boundless fear surged in Lin Yi’s heart, but he knew he could not give up, for to do so would mean never waking up again.
Lin Yi was not willing to die.
“Swish!”
Suddenly, the Spiritual Pearl once again emitted a faint golden light, enveloping Lin Yi within it, withstanding the barrage of the blood-red lightning.
“Boom!”
The Spiritual Pearl released a burst of golden light once more, and within the golden radiance flowed vast Spiritual Energy, falling like a waterfall into Lin Yi’s body, aiding him in suppressing the blood-red lightning, sparing him from the terrifying attack.
“What’s the deal with this Spiritual Pearl? How can it help me withstand blood-red lightning?”
“I remember, when I was on Earth, I had seen Spiritual Pearls, but none could withstand this blood-red lightning!”
“Could it be that this Spiritual Pearl has gained Spiritual Wisdom?”
Lin Yi was puzzled, but he knew that now was not the time to question why the Spiritual Pearl was so powerful; he had to overcome the crisis at hand.
“Ah!”
A tormenting roar echoed far and wide as Lin Yi felt his body was being torn apart.
The excruciating pain made Lin Yi shiver all over, his teeth grinding so hard that they drew blood, his face pale, large beads of cold sweat seeping from his forehead, his body in unbearable agony, as if a knife were slicing through his flesh, tearing at his very being.
Lin Yi endured the pain, but he dared not stop; he knew that if he did, he would surely die.
He now needed an opportunity to strengthen his physical body to be able to contend with the blood-red lightning!
Lin Yi’s eyes were tightly closed, his fists clenched, every muscle in his body tensed. He was desperately squeezing every bit of his potential, continually enhancing his physical body.
At this moment, within his body rolled wave upon wave of incredibly potent blood energy, transforming into streams of True Yuan, surging towards Lin Yi’s dantian, condensing within it to form a pillar of True Yuan!
Amidst that blood-red lightning, Lin Yi sensed an immense danger looming over him, a menace that involuntarily made him draw a sharp breath, his entire body feeling icy cold as if teetering on the brink of death.

chapters.title: Chapter 707 - 707 707 Always on the Verge of Being Devoured
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 707: Chapter 707 Always on the Verge of Being Devoured Chapter 707: Chapter 707 Always on the Verge of Being Devoured Lin Yi’s heart surged with unease, feeling as if he could be devoured at any moment, turned to ash, and die an untimely death.
He knew he had encountered an immense crisis.
“Boom!”
A violent roar erupted, and that blood-colored lightning struck down once again.
This time, the blood-colored lightning was fiercer than before, and its might was even more terrifying, like a massive hand smacking down hard on Lin Yi.
“Damn it!”
Lin Yi cursed inwardly, but there was no way for him to fend off this blood-colored lightning.
“Boom!”
“Pfft!”
The blood-colored lightning struck Lin Yi, shattering his chest, causing severe damage to his internal organs, and he spit out a mouthful of fresh blood, his complexion turning pale.
“Thud!”
Lin Yi fell to the ground, collapsing on the earth as his body shook violently, his physical body rapidly deteriorating, feeling as if he were about to shatter to pieces!
“No, I can’t die, I absolutely can’t die!”
Lin Yi gritted his teeth and persisted, disregarding his internal injuries, and with great difficulty, he lifted his hand to draw a strange rune on the ground. It was an ancient and weathered rune; when Lin Yi’s fingertips touched it, the rune automatically activated, integrating his blood into it.
And at that moment, the blood-colored lightning struck again!
Lin Yi’s eyes suddenly widened as he sensed a sliver of danger, but instead of stopping, he sped up the activation of the ancient rune. Ancient characters emerged, wrapping around the old rune, making it more complex. Strands of blood-colored light radiated from the ancient rune, forming a wall of blood that blocked the blood-colored lightning from the outside!
“Boom, boom!”
“Bang!”
Two sounds rang out, the old rune finally withstood the blood-colored lightning and began to dissipate.
The blood-colored lightning thwarted, Lin Yi finally breathed a sigh of relief, but his inner True Yuan had been exhausted.
His body became weak, not even having the strength to stand.
“Buzz!”
The ancient rune once again emitted a blood-colored brilliance, enveloping Lin Yi and restoring a bit of his strength.
“Whew!”
Lin Yi exhaled a breath, feeling utterly powerless, unable to lift even a single finger.
“What is the origin of this ancient rune? How is it so powerful that it can withstand the assault of the blood-colored lightning!”
Lin Yi looked at the old rune, full of doubts in his heart.
“Could it be that the ancient rune is also a Spiritual Treasure?”
Lin Yi speculated in his mind; if it truly was a Spiritual Treasure, then its level would be very high, at least equivalent to that of a Holy Artifact!
The value of such a Spiritual Treasure was extremely high, even more precious than some Divine weapons.
“Perhaps, I should find it!”
Lin Yi thought to himself silently.
The ancient rune seemed somewhat familiar, with a sense of deja vu, but not too familiar. He couldn’t remember at the moment.
Lin Yi turned his gaze towards the Immortal Elixir stone. That piece of Immortal Elixir stone was his only hope now.
Lin Yi stared at the piece of Immortal Elixir stone with gritted teeth, not wanting to miss this opportunity.
“Huff!”
Lin Yi took a deep breath, striving to calm himself and maintain a sense of composure. He infused a strand of Soul Power into the Immortal Elixir stone, controlling it to fly towards him.
The Immortal Elixir stone flew into the space between Lin Yi’s eyebrows.
“Hum!”
A blood-red sphere slowly emerged at the spot between Lin Yi’s eyebrows, emitting a malevolent blood-colored light that caused hearts to palpitate.
Images began to appear in Lin Yi’s mind.
It was a pitch-black starry sky, where each and every star shone brilliantly, emanating a mysterious aura that seemed to contain the Laws of Heaven and Earth.
Within this starry sky, Lin Yi saw a palace, a magnificently vast structure standing amidst the cosmos, radiating intense mystical fluctuations.
“This palace, could it be that mysterious one?”
Lin Yi speculated in his heart. He felt that the palace was intricately linked to his physique, as if there was some special connection ordained by fate, but the connection was too nebulous to grasp. Nevertheless, he could clearly sense that mysterious and powerful force.
“Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!”
Lin Yi’s body swayed slightly as he stood his ground, his pupils emanating a purple light that enveloped him, making him appear as if he were a Demon King descending to earth, exuding an infinite deterrence that was daunting to witness.
And under that deterrence, those blood-colored lightnings were forced to halt their barrage, no longer daring to approach Lin Yi.
Although this power was not as great as Divine Skills, it nevertheless possessed the might to destroy everything!
“Boom, boom, boom!”
The blood-colored lightning continuously bombarded around Lin Yi, but each strike was vanquished by the ancient Runes he had unleashed, eventually dissipating into nothingness.
Lin Yi kept running and escaping within the Star Domain, but his injuries were too severe, rendering him unable to deploy Divine Skills, and he could only rely on his movement technique to dodge the blood-colored lightning.
Lin Yi felt the True Yuan within him rapidly depleting, yet he still persevered, wanting his willpower to drive away the blood-colored lightning and save his life.
The might of the blood-colored lightning was terrifyingly formidable!
Under the assault of the blood-colored lightning, Lin Yi felt as if his internal organs were burning, as though they were about to burst apart.
Such pain was unbearable for ordinary people. Several times Lin Yi nearly lost consciousness, but each time he would stubbornly brace himself and endure the agony through gritted teeth.
“Boom!”
Suddenly, a Jade Pendant inside Lin Yi lit up, unleashing a mysterious force that enveloped him, aiding in neutralizing that horrific power.
It was the Divine Emperor Body Protection Technique, a defense technique taught to him by the Heavenly Emperor and extremely powerful.
“Boom!”
The blood-colored lightning struck the Jade Pendant, blasting it to pieces.
Lin Yi was shocked, a fiery rage swelling in his heart. He knew this was the Heavenly Emperor’s protection; had it not been for the Heavenly Emperor, he would have been pierce by the blood-colored lightning long ago.
“Heavenly Emperor! I have noted this debt of vengeance. Once my strength is sufficient, I will certainly seek revenge! Rest assured, I will not let you down!”
Lin Yi roared inwardly, fiery determination glaring from his eyes. He was determined to find the mastermind behind his suffering and torment them severely!
He would absolutely reduce them to ashes!
Lin Yi’s gaze gradually became serene as he began to ponder. If he could increase his cultivation speed, then he would surely be able to break through to the Ninth Level Peak of the Spiritual Spring Realm. At that time, he would have the confidence to contend with those Blood Clan Saint Heirs!
He was determined to kill every one of those Blood Tribe Saint Heirs, to avenge the Heavenly Emperor!
Lin Yi’s eyes were sharp, his killing intent chilling to the bone. His gaze scoured the Star Domain, searching for traces of the Blood Clan.
“Hmm?”
Lin Yi’s eyebrows twitched slightly, his eyes revealing a hint of surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 708 - 708 708 Ferocious Beast
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 708: Chapter 708: Ferocious Beast Chapter 708: Chapter 708: Ferocious Beast Not far from Lin Yi, within that Star Domain, a group of Blood Clan Saint Heirs were in pursuit of a monstrous beast, drenched in its blood.
This blood-soaked beast was none other than the half-step Holy Master monstrous beast Lin Yi had once slain. It was massive, with a body length exceeding a hundred zhang, and its skin was riddled with blood-drenched scars, presenting a fearsome and horrifying sight.
“The strength of that monstrous beast is very powerful, and it exudes a strong aura, seemingly that of a Holy Master,” Lin Yi thought to himself with a solemn expression.
The strength of the monstrous beast was too formidable; Lin Yi was no match for it now.
“Roar!”
The blood-soaked beast let out a ferocious bellow as bloodlights surged over its body, transforming into blood arrows that shot into the void.
“Bang bang bang!”
In an instant, the void was filled with dense blood arrows that penetrated that part of the Star Domain, and from those blood arrows blood-colored lightning burst forth, sweeping in all directions, causing everything in its path to shatter into dust, including the ancient trees within the Star Domain, which also disintegrated into powder.
“What a terrifying attack method, the power of this monstrous beast is simply too dreadful!”
Lin Yi’s complexion paled, and he felt a shiver of cold.
Around the body of the monstrous beast, circles of bloodlight shined like a massive protective God pattern, securing it tightly.
The bloodlight flickered, and the blood arrows burst forth, all landing on the protective God pattern, causing the bloodlight to dim and eventually disappear.
“Owoo!”
The monstrous beast let out a deep growl, glancing at Lin Yi with its blood-red eyes before continuing to flee into the distance.
Its speed was extreme; in the blink of an eye, it had crossed tens of billions of kilometers.
“Such incredible speed; I can’t keep up with it at all. Do I just let it go like this?” Lin Yi furrowed his brow, a look of frustration on his face.
“Hmph! Once my cultivation reaches the Holy Master Realm, I will certainly be able to defeat it. Then, I can kill it and avenge the Heavenly Emperor!”
Lin Yi swore silently in his heart, with fierce determination flashing in his eyes.
Lin Yi leaped up to a large tree and sat cross-legged, beginning to circulate his Cultivation Technique.
“Boom!”
Behind him, a golden Divine Dragon Phantom manifested, and above his back, three golden columns of light soared into the sky.
“Swoosh swoosh swoosh!”
The three golden columns of light hung down like three golden waterfalls from above Lin Yi’s head, transforming into three Golden Lotuses.
Subsequently, Lin Yi’s body began to swell, his bones making crackling sounds as his body quickly grew taller. In the blink of an eye, his height reached over a dozen meters, and his frame became more robust, a vast, ocean-like aura radiating from him.
Lin Yi’s skin gleamed with the luster of the Metal Attribute, his muscles bulged with explosive strength.
Lin Yi exuded a wild aura, like a revived War God, with a punch capable of tearing the heavens apart and penetrating the universe!
Lin Yi’s cultivation had advanced from the Second to the Third Layer of the Saint Heir Realm!
The Third Layer of the Saint Heir Realm was equivalent to the Seventh Layer of the Martial Ancestor Realm in humans!
In this Star Domain, such cultivation could already be considered invincible. Even those in the Holy Master Realm would be no match for Lin Yi.
Moreover, Lin Yi’s strength had not fully stabilized, still at the Second Layer of the Holy Master Realm, so he could continue to improve.
During this period, Lin Yi had absorbed all the energy from the chunk of heavenly crystal ore. His Physical Body Power was rapidly increasing, and in just a few minutes, he had broken through to the peak of the Fourth Layer of the Holy Master Realm!
“Boom!”
Within Lin Yi’s Dantian, three columns of light bloomed with dazzling radiance. Hidden within those columns of light was a brilliant Divine Fetus surrounded by mysterious, fluctuating waves that enshrouded the Divine Fetus, making it even clearer.
Encircling that Divine Fetus, there were also two drops of golden Divine Liquid slowly revolving at the center, exuding a rich life force and containing colossal Medicinal Effect. The medicinal power within these two drops of Divine Liquid had become dozens of times more potent than before!
“These two drops of Divine Liquid are the divine power within those two supreme treasures!”
“These two drops of Divine Liquid must be a part extracted from the crystal ore when I just absorbed the divine power within it. Only the divine could possess such potent Medicinal Effect. If I consume these two drops of Divine Liquid, my Cultivation will surely skyrocket!”
Lin Yi’s thoughts moved, and he intended to swallow those two drops of Divine Liquid.
But just as Lin Yi was about to devour the two drops of Divine Liquid, they suddenly began to vibrate violently, struggling fiercely as if they wanted to escape.
“How is this possible?”
Seeing this, Lin Yi was stunned and found it hard to believe.
“Boom!”
Suddenly, in the sky, an ancient and weathered Altar emerged.
On the Altar, inscribed were some complex and obscure Runes, resembling a kind of taboo Runes, exuding a mysterious and unfathomable power, that instilled an involuntary palpitation in the hearts of those who felt it.
“What is that Altar?”
Seeing the ancient and weathered Altar, Lin Yi suddenly froze, his face filled with confusion.
The ancient Altar hovered in the sky above the crystal mountain range, emitting endless mysterious pressure, compelling one to prostrate in worship!
Lin Yi’s heart trembled violently, a hint of fear arising within him.
“Boom!”
From the ancient Altar, a destructive aura suddenly burst forth, as if it belonged to a primordial beast, carrying an unrivaled dominance.
This aura was akin to a Divine Mountain descending, bringing with it a force capable of annihilating heaven and earth, bearing down on Lin Yi.
“Bang!”
Crushed by this force, Lin Yi’s body was flung backward, crashing through mountain ranges.
Lin Yi spat out a mouthful of blood, his heart shocked and his face white as a sheet.
What was it within the ancient Altar that was summoning him?
This aura made Lin Yi feel a fatal danger, as if he were nothing but an ant before the ancient Altar, insignificant and lowly.
“Swish!”
Lin Yi’s body leapt up, flying and taking cover within the ancient Altar.
“Whoosh!”
Suddenly, from within the Altar, a burst of black light erupted and a monstrous claw reached out, grasping at the space beyond the Altar.
“Boom!”
The monstrous claw slammed down heavily upon the Altar, shattering it into pieces that drifted down.
“Boom, boom, boom!”
The space there violently shook, as if it could collapse at any moment and transform into Chaotic Space.
“What is that?”
“What kind of monster is this?”
“Such a terrifying monster!”
Lin Yi narrowed his eyes, a heavy feeling surging in his heart.
This time, the monstrous claw did not pursue further but stopped around five yards in front of Lin Yi.
The claw was pitch black, as if forged from some kind of black iron, emitting a cold and sharp aura that was frightening to behold. Its whole being exuded a sinister and ominous aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 709 - 709 709 The Colossus
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 709: Chapter 709: The Colossus Chapter 709: Chapter 709: The Colossus The demonic claw halted in front of Lin Yi and did not move further, as if it was vigilant against Lin Yi.
The owner of that pitch-black claw was a massive creature, entirely shrouded in darkness, with its body emitting a black fog that made it inscrutable.
This colossal creature, towering in stature, stood a hundred zhang tall, with a pair of huge horns that shone with a dim light, radiating an alarming authority, as its pitch-black eyes stared at Lin Yi.
“Roar!”
The black beast opened its gaping maw, issuing a thunderous roar that made one dizzy and disoriented.
“Such powerful Demonic Qi, such terrifying might, what kind of creature is this demonic beast?”
Lin Yi felt the oppression emanating from the massive creature, causing him to shiver with fear, his body trembling uncontrollably.
The black beast opened its mouth wide, and terrifying swallowing forces spurted out, charging towards Lin Yi.
“Buzz!”
Suddenly, behind Lin Yi, a phantom emerged, emanating a vast, infinite mystical force, standing in front of Lin Yi.
This phantom was a divine puppet of colossal size, a hundred zhang tall, wrapped in a faint divine radiance, exuding a mysterious aura that was startling.
The devouring power of the beast smashed against the divine puppet but was blocked, unable to advance even half a step further.
“Hmm? This is… this is a true divine puppet!”
Lin Yi’s heart shivered, and his expression grew solemn.
Around his body, mysterious runes flickered, with powerful forces circulating.
“Boom!”
The true divine puppet dashed forward, plunging into the belly of the beast.
At that moment, the demonic creature let out a scream, a shrill roar of agony.
“Aaah! My stomach, my intestines!”
The demonic creature wailed in pain, and from its pitch-black eyes, wisps of black smoke rose, billowing steadily.
From within its body came a series of bone-crunching sounds that sent chills down the spine.
“Pfft!”
The body of the demonic creature began to show trickles of blood, continuously oozing out, and the beast’s body burst into flames, turning into char in an instant.
A true divine puppet had easily slain a being comparable to the Holy Rank, shocking the heavens and causing everyone to tremble in awe.
“Phew!”
Lin Yi took a deep breath and inwardly heaved a sigh of relief. Although the divine puppet’s attack was terrifying, it hadn’t harmed him but had slaughtered the gigantic beast instead. Lin Yi suffered no loss, yet he was astonished.
“What exactly is in this altar that made that demonic creature so fearful? What is that demonic coffin? Why could even a divine puppet repel it? Could it be that buried within this altar lies an ancient emperor?”
Lin Yi pondered in his heart.
However, Lin Yi also knew that without sufficient strength, he simply couldn’t break into this mysterious altar, let alone obtain the treasure within the coffin.
With a thought, the immense and mysterious puppet disappeared from the spot, returning to the depths of Lin Yi’s consciousness.
“What is the origin of this mysterious altar? Could it be a Divine Tomb, or some ancient relic?”
Lin Yi frowned and pondered.
Divine Tomb, ancient relics, Divine Tomb, Immortal Domain, and so on, all were possibilities.
“Buzz!”
Suddenly, a divine light shot out from the altar, transforming into an ancient and mysterious portal, releasing vast and infinite mysterious fluctuations that seemed able to engulf everything!
The divine light broke through the void and shot towards Lin Yi, enveloping him within.
The next moment, Lin Yi felt the scenery before his eyes shift, and a strange sky appeared in his line of sight.
That expanse of the world was a vast and endless wilderness plain, with deserts everywhere. Looking around, the sky was filled with sand, and the earth was filled with desolation and silence, giving off an extremely desolate feeling that made one involuntarily shudder.
This was a desert, silent and lifeless, without even a trace of the breath of living things.
“Eh? What’s that?”
Lin Yi looked up and suddenly saw a blurry figure quickly moving away into the distance, his form ghostlike.
It was a person wearing a gray robe, stepping in bronze boots, carrying a longsword on his back, and holding a bronze spear in his hand, making a fast escape.
Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat, and suddenly remembering something, he quickly activated his Cultivation Technique, using shrinking steps, and followed swiftly, his speed incredibly fast.
A moment later, that blurry figure finally stopped, turned around to look back, and saw Lin Yi had followed.
“Who are you to have chased me here?” the blurry figure paused slightly and asked.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s heart stirred, and he said, “I don’t know you, nor am I lured here by you. I just disapprove of your actions, that’s all.”
“Hmph! You want to stop me, don’t you? I would advise you to scurry away quickly, and not to bring misery upon yourself!”
The blurry figure sneered, his tone filled with mockery and disdain.
Upon hearing this, a flash of anger crossed Lin Yi’s eyes. He moved and instantly appeared beside the blurry figure, his hand chopping down with a palm strike.
“Bang!”
The blurry figure was suddenly sent flying, spitting blood, and landed on the ground in a wretched state, rolling several times before coming to a stop.
The blurry figure was actually that Black Demon, but at that moment, it was at death’s door, its skin cracked, flesh blurred, blood flowing continuously and dyeing the ground red, a sight to behold.
The strength of this Black Demon was comparable to that of a Martial Sovereign at the half-step Martial Sovereign Realm, but at that moment, it could not withstand a single strike from a real divine puppet and was instantly killed!
“What exactly is the deal with this ancient city? Why do I suffer from some weird curses and attacks as soon as I set foot in it?” Lin Yi frowned, a bad premonition rising in his heart.
“Who are you? Why are you here?”
The blurry figure stood up, staring at Lin Yi with a cold gaze, and asked icily.
Silently, Lin Yi did not answer his question but instead asked, “Which ancient city’s guardian are you? I am a student from the fifth ancient city, here to partake in the assessment, but you lured me to this city.”
Lin Yi did not hide anything, speaking candidly about his identity.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the blurry figure’s expression paused slightly, and then he snorted coldly, saying, “No matter who you are, if you dare to intrude into our Divine Altar, you must stay.”
As he spoke, the figure reached out his hand and grabbed towards Lin Yi.
In his hand was a bronze spear, from which a terrifying sharpness emanated, like a Divine Dragon attempting to break through the heavens.
“This is the Divine Artifact Qing Ming Spear!” Lin Yi’s expression changed slightly as he quickly retreated, constantly dodging.
“Whoosh!”
“Crash!”
A swooshing sound followed by a crash rang out just as Lin Yi dodged away, and the bronze spear stabbed into the ground where he had just been standing, creating a crater with a fist impression.

chapters.title: Chapter 710 - 710 710 Breaking into the Divine Tomb
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 710: Chapter 710: Breaking into the Divine Tomb Chapter 710: Chapter 710: Breaking into the Divine Tomb Lin Yi’s heart was secretly shocked. The other’s strength was indeed much stronger than he’d imagined; this was a figure of the Martial Sovereign realm.
Although his current strength could contend with a Martial Artist of the Fourth Layer of True Yuan, he was certainly not the opponent of a peak Martial Sovereign cultivator; he might even be killed in an instant.
“You damn bastard, how dare you trespass into the Divine Tomb? Aren’t you afraid of retribution?”
The blurry figure bellowed angrily, once again swinging the Green Abyss Spear in his hand to strike.
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly, the Divine Spirit Runes within his body surged, activating the divine skill “Grand Thousand Charm Seal”.
That Divine Spirit Rune, under Lin Yi’s control, instantly flew out of his body and transformed into a giant avatar tens of thousands of feet tall.
This giant avatar’s figure was stout and robust, wielding a long sword, exuding a powerful and majestic presence.
His body, like a mountain, was covered with knotted muscles, brimming with explosive power.
“Roar!”
The giant avatar let out a low roar, raised the long sword in its hand, and slashed towards the blurry figure with terrifying Sword Qi, like a raging tide sweeping out, causing the surrounding space to vibrate, as if it were about to collapse.
This slash held a terrific power, with Sword Qi cutting across a hundred meters distance, shattering space, causing it to warp as if stars were falling, bringing with them a destructive force, intending to crush everything around it.
“What?”
The blurry figure’s complexion changed slightly, sensing a fatal danger. Its figure flickered, transforming into a stream of light, shooting backwards rapidly, trying to flee.
However, the blurry figure had only retreated a mere dozen meters or so before it was cleaved in two by the long sword in the hands of the giant avatar.
“Pfft!”
A spurt of fresh blood sprayed out, and a headless corpse fell to the ground.
“What, my soul? Where is my soul?!” The blurry figure suddenly cried out in shock, its voice full of terror and panic.
“Haha, your soul was extinguished by your Divine Weapon!” Lin Yi laughed loudly, his face showing a look of schadenfreude.
“You actually killed my soul! Damn it!” The blurry figure roared in anger, frantically slamming its hands on its chest, instantly breaking its ribs and spurting blood, soaking the ground red, a sight of extreme misery.
This blurry figure was a strong member of the Divine Race.
His cultivation had reached the Martial Sovereign Realm, a mighty entity among the Divine Race, a saint heir with a lofty status and identity.
This blurry figure was the Saint Heir of the Divine Race; once slain, it would be gravely injured, unable to cultivate, and ultimately perish!
“You dare to kill me? Do you know who I am? My father is a Saint Heir of the Divine Race. If you kill me, you will surely be punished by the Divine Race!” The blurry figure glared at Lin Yi with gritted teeth, roaring.
“So what if I killed you? I am of the Human Clan. If you killed me, what awaits you is the towering wrath of the Divine Race!” Lin Yi said, not concerned at all, with a cold snort, he took a step towards him.
The blurry figure’s pupils constricted sharply as a rich murderous intent surged, staring at Lin Yi and said, “You are a strong member of the Human Clan? Then do you know, my father is a mighty Martial Emperor, the Holy Master of the Divine Race. If I am killed, you will be punished, and even your family will be affected, leaving you in a fate worse than death!”
“So what if he is the Holy Master of the Divine Race? Does he dare lay a hand on my family?”
Lin Yi snorted with disdain, not putting the Divine Race in his eyes at all, and he felt an inexplicable fear towards the Divine Race, not daring to provoke this force.
“You!”
The blurry figure turned an ashen blue, not expecting Lin Yi to be so arrogant and bold as to actually challenge the Divine Race.
“If you dare to lay a hand on me, once my family arrives, your death is certain. They will never let you off!” That figure stared coldly at Lin Yi, threatening him.
A cruel smile appeared on the corner of Lin Yi’s mouth as he said, “And what if I don’t let you go?”
Upon hearing this, the figure became so angry that his face turned red and his eyes shot flames.
He had never thought that he, a Saint Heir of the Divine Race, would be threatened like this while walking on this ancient road. It was an extremely humiliating experience, feeling a loss of face, and a surge of indignation overwhelmed him!
“You’re courting death! I will kill you to avenge my kinsmen!”
The figure roared in anger, and a powerful aura burst forth, enveloping Lin Yi’s entire body as if trying to completely obliterate his soul.
Lin Yi’s soul was unmatched in strength. Soul attacks only managed to tear his skin, unable to break through his defenses, making him frown slightly, as a sense of shock arose in his heart from the terrifying power of the blurry figure before him.
“Boom!”
A colossal giant holding a long sword swept across the void, striking with the blade that turned the space to dust, crumbling everything to nothingness with terrifying force, sending out a horrifying slash that plunged towards the vague figure, sending it flying, blood splattering everywhere.
The figure was directly struck by the slash from the colossal giant, blood bursting forth like mist, torn apart, reduced to several pieces, and crashing onto the ground, smashed to a pulp.
“Puh!”
Lin Yi couldn’t help but spit out a mouthful of blood.
Although he was a cultivator of the Martial King Rank, his Divine Sense was only a bit stronger than that of a Martial King at the peak of the Early Stage, far too weak compared to a Martial Emperor. Against a Martial Sovereign, he didn’t even have the chance to fight back.
“So weak? Is this the strength of a Martial Sovereign Realm cultivator? I thought the Martial Sovereign Realm would be much more formidable, but it seems to be nothing special, easily smashed!” Lin Yi shook his head and sighed, looking down at the figure on the ground with a look of pity.
“Puh!”
Right after Lin Yi’s words fell, another mouthful of blood sprayed out, making his face extremely pale and darkly ominous.
“What is this thing, how can it be so powerful?”
He felt that the True Yuan within his body was nearly depleted. If the battle continued, he wouldn’t last much longer and defeat was inevitable!
“Damn ants, I will kill you, make you suffer unbearable torment until you die!” The figure struggled for a long time, but in the end, couldn’t stand up. It was just a vague shadow, but the voice was filled with venom.
“Then I’ll just have to wait and see. I hope you survive, so you can ‘teach’ me then!”
Lin Yi shook his head, his form flashed as he quickly fled, chasing after another figure, wanting to kill them.
“Don’t think you can escape!” The vague figure bellowed, shooting out rapidly, pursuing Lin Yi to kill him, his dark eyes brimming with a chilling coldness, the murderous intent soaring as if it could penetrate the entire valley.
Seeing this, Lin Yi moved swiftly, dodging the pursuing attacks of the blurry figure.
“Puh!”
“Thump!”
Lin Yi kept moving, dodging the pursuits of the blurry figure, with his injuries growing more severe, blood dripping down, his face pale, and his body becoming progressively weaker.
However, he still didn’t give up and continued to dodge the attacks of the blurry figure relentlessly.
“Ah!”
Suddenly, Lin Yi let out a loud shout, staggering a bit as his complexion turned deathly pale, and the robes on his right leg shattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 711 - 711 711 A Shocking Scene
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 711: Chapter 711: A Shocking Scene Chapter 711: Chapter 711: A Shocking Scene A ghastly wound was exposed, its flesh faint and jumbled, a shocking sight to behold, as strands of deep crimson blood trickled down, staining Lin Yi’s trousers into a patch of red, a horrifying and startling image.
“Ahhhhh!”
Lin Yi let out a skyward howl, his roar piercing and desperate, drawing the sideways glances of surrounding martial artists, who found it somewhat astonishing.
“It’s Lin Yi!”
“It’s that youth!”
“Wasn’t he participating in the martial arts exam? How did he appear here?”
The distant crowd recognized Lin Yi’s figure immediately upon seeing him.
“Lin Yi, why would he be here?”
“I don’t know, this place is the location of the martial arts examination grounds, what is Lin Yi doing here?”
“Could he be here for trials?”
“Trials? Impossible! Lin Yi is just an ordinary person, how could he possibly be here for trials!”
The distant crowd was abuzz with discussion, their voices reaching the heavens, enveloping both Lin Yi and that blurry figure, clear and loud, fueling the figure’s rage even further.
His clansmen had all met untimely deaths, his soul sealed within this body, and now his enemy Lin Yi had appeared at the martial arts examination grounds—how could he not be furious!
“Lin Yi, you deserve to die!”
That shadow grew fierce, erupting with an intense power that forced Lin Yi back, then the figure transformed into a burst of light, pouncing towards Lin Yi in an attempt to kill him.
“Whoosh!”
The blurry figure moved so swiftly that in the blink of an eye, it had closed in on Lin Yi, swinging its fist and launching a powerful blow at him.
Lin Yi was shocked and quickly brandished his sword in defense, clashing with the figure, their longswords jarring against each other, producing a harsh metallic clang painful to the ears. Lin Yi’s body was sent flying, his flesh ripped apart, blood spurting out.
“Bang!”
Lin Yi’s body smashed heavily into the ground, creating a crater and causing the earth to collapse downwards.
“Hahaha, you little bastard, let’s see where you can run now!”
The blurry figure laughed triumphantly, sensing victory.
“You want to devour my blood essence, don’t you? Come, devour it. Once you swallow it, you’ll be able to regain some strength, and then, you’ll have the confidence to kill me!”
Lin Yi laughed heartily, his face mocking as he looked at the blurry figure, laughing while he stimulated his True Yuan to heal his wounds swiftly.
“Excellent, excellent, your blood is indeed a fine treasure, worthy of the divine demonic lineage, filled with tremendous medicinal effect. It can not only enhance one’s cultivation realm but also increase the body’s defensive power, making oneself even more formidable!”
The blurry figure laughed heartily, moving rapidly towards Lin Yi, reaching out to grab his arm, intending to swallow Lin Yi whole.
“Scram!”
Lin Yi yelled furiously, his True Yuan circulating wildly within him, his body trembling violently as he repelled the blurry figure. Then, with a stomp, he stepped onto the void and vanished from the figure’s sight.
“Damn it!”
The blurry figure was extremely frustrated, its speed faster than Lin Yi’s, yet still unable to catch up with him, which made it extremely annoyed, grinding its teeth in anger, wishing it could carve Lin Yi into a thousand pieces.
“Lin Yi, once I recover my strength, I will crush you to dust!”
“Hmph, with just you, you’re not qualified!”
Lin Yi let out a cold laugh, scornfully looking at the blurry figure.
That figure’s face was contorted with anger, teeth clenched, wishing nothing more than to tear Lin Yi apart and consume him.
“I will kill you!”
He roared, opening his gaping maw to reveal chilling, sharp fangs and lunged to devour Lin Yi in one bite.
“Scram!”
Lin Yi, unflustered, lifted his leg and kicked straight out, hitting him right in the head.
“Puh!”
The blurred figure was sent flying, tumbling several times in mid-air before falling to the ground with a swollen nose and a bruised face, a streak of crimson blood oozing from the corner of his mouth.
Struggling a few times, the blurred figure attempted to rise but failed, ultimately lying on the ground, daring not to move, his ferocious eyes staring at Lin Yi, a hint of dread and fear surfacing.
“Lin Yi!”
At that moment, shouts came from the martial arts examination field, and a group of people rushed out.
Lin Yi turned to look and saw, in the center of the newcomers, Ling Fei, the second-ranked martial artist from the Heavenly Holy Sect.
“Ling Fei, right on time. Help me kill this despicable fool!” the blurred figure suddenly spoke.
At his words, Lin Yi’s brow furrowed slightly; recognizing the blurred figure, he felt a twinge of horror and wariness.
“What is your status, Lin Yi?” Ling Fei asked coldly, his eyes flashing with a murderous intent.
“Heh, you should know who I am,” Lin Yi replied with a light smile.
“You’re… Lin Yi!” Ling Fei’s expression changed drastically.
He hadn’t expected that the person before him was Lin Yi, the one famed as the second-ranked martial artist.
“Yes, it’s me.”
Lin Yi smiled faintly, saying, “I wonder what your identity is and what plans you have for trying to kill me?”
“Lin Yi, I am the Saint Heir of the Ling Family from the Heavenly Holy Sect, Ling Fei. How dare you kill a disciple of my Ling Family? Are you tired of living?” Ling Fei asked in a deep voice.
“Heh, should I tolerate it when your Ling Family disciples try to kill me?”
Lin Yi said with a light smile, looking at Ling Fei.
“What do you want, then?” Ling Fei inquired.
“What I want should be my question to you. What do you want?” Lin Yi replied coolly.
“What do you want?” Ling Fei’s face changed abruptly at the words, for he hadn’t expected Lin Yi to be so bold as to threaten him, which was tantamount to courting death!
Lin Yi snorted coldly, “I want your Ling Family annihilated!”
“Hmph!”
Ling Fei scoffed, “If you dare to do that, your fate will be truly tragic. Our Ling Family has five Saint Heirs. Combined, they are more than enough to obliterate the entire Lin Family!”
“My Lin Family has three Holy Kings!” Lin Yi snorted coldly too. Although he was the Young Master of the Lin Family, those in the Lin Family did not recognize him, let alone come out to protect him.
“Three Holy Kings?”
“Heh, Lin Yi, better save that tale to scare ghosts,” Ling Fei said with a derisive laugh. “Don’t think just because you’re the Young Master of the Lin Family you can do whatever you want. You killed many of our Ling Family disciples in the martial arts competition!”
“If you dare kill my Ling Family’s disciples, even if I have to exhaust every resource of my entire Ling Family, I will have you executed to avenge our disciples!”
“Ling Fei, it seems you’re pushing me to reveal my trump card. If you force me to use it, don’t blame me for exterminating the entire Ling Family, leaving none alive!” Lin Yi spoke coldly, his eyes brimming with killing intent as he stared at Ling Fei, radiating menace.
“Humph, I’m really curious to see what kind of trump card you have.”
Ling Fei snorted disdainfully, not intimidated by Lin Yi at all, because at the side of Ling Fei, the Saint Heir of the Heavenly Holy Sect, there were four or five other Saint Heirs, none of whom were weaker than Lin Yi, all having reached the Half-Step Holy King Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 712 - 712 712 Extraordinary Strength
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 712: Chapter 712: Extraordinary Strength Chapter 712: Chapter 712: Extraordinary Strength “All of you, together, take him down—kill him!”
Ling Fei commanded the others.
The rest didn’t waste words; they each brandished their treasures, attacking Lin Yi.
These individuals exuded an intense aura, all true Holy Rank peak powerhouses, possessing no ordinary strength.
“Brat, surrender your life!”
A man dressed in Purple Gold Armor bellowed, wielding a massive axe that he swung fiercely at Lin Yi. The axe sliced through the air, howling as it cleaved, its force formidable and its presence vast. If it were to hit Lin Yi, he would surely be split in two, his body pulverized.
“Overestimating your abilities!”
Lin Yi sneered in disdain, throwing his right fist forward to meet the mighty axe, ready to counter the blow with his bare fist.
“Boom!”
The axe clashed with Lin Yi’s fist, erupting into a heaven-shaking roar. The axe was sent flying, embedding itself into the ground with its blade broken in two.
Lin Yi’s right hand was slashed to the point of bleeding profusely, blood dripping steadily from his wrist to the ground, staining it red.
“What? You actually caught my axe with your bare hands?”
The Saint Heir stood agape, his eyes flashing with disbelief.
He had put forth all his strength, used every trick at his disposal, and yet he hadn’t harmed Lin Yi in the least.
“Indeed!”
Lin Yi nodded and said, “Your attack was of no use to me!”
“You… your physical body is so strong!” The Saint Heir was full of alarm.
He had cultivated a Secret Technique, his physical body powerful to the extreme, akin to a Holy Rank Treasure Body. Ordinary martial artists couldn’t withstand it. Yet now, facing a martial artist with a Holy Rank physical body, he couldn’t even take a single strike, which filled him with shock and fear.
“Lin Yi, since you refuse to drink a toast only to be forced to drink a forfeit, don’t blame me for being impolite!”
The Saint Heir’s face twisted viciously, his eyes gleamed with a cold killing intent.
“I, Lin Yi, have never feared anyone. The foundation of my Lin Family is over a hundred times stronger than yours, and even if you add up the foundation of your Ling Family, you’re still far from being a match to the Lin Family!” Lin Yi said coldly.
“Arrogant, you are too arrogant!” The Saint Heir roared in anger, his figure shimmering as he produced a black long spear in his hand. With a flick of the spear, it seemed to pierce through the void, producing a piercing, shrill sound.
Lin Yi snorted coldly, his body abruptly swelling in size, transforming into a thirty-foot giant resembling an imposing mountain. He threw a punch, unleashing a powerful force that made the long spear buzz and tremble, nearly collapsing.
Lin Yi’s punch was terrifying, like the pounce of a ferocious beast, chilling to the bone.
Seeing this, the Saint Heir’s pupils shrank, his heart filled with boundless horror. He quickly backed away, trying to dodge Lin Yi’s fist.
But Lin Yi was too fast; in the blink of an eye, he caught up to the Saint Heir, punching out with domineering ferocity, sending him flying.
“Phut!”
Lin Yi’s fist slammed heavily into his chest, shattering it. Blood sprayed as his internal organs were pulverized by the fist, killing him instantly.
The Saint Heir was directly blown to death by Lin Yi’s punch, his life force extinguished, unable to even utter a pained moan before he completely fell.
This scene made the other Ling Family disciples inhale sharply, a chilling coldness enveloping them.
“All of you, go to hell!”
Lin Yi roared, his body surging with golden light, Golden Dragons coiling around him, his aura awe-inspiring, chilling to the core.
He leapt forward, like a meteor falling from the sky, his punch exploding the remaining Saint Heirs!
Several Saint Heirs burst open, their blood misting up the sky, with Lin Yi’s momentum growing increasingly stronger, terrifying all the disciples of the Ling Family out of their wits, filling them with extreme fear.
Ling Fei’s face changed dramatically, panic etched across his features.
This Lin Yi’s combat power was so fierce!
In a single encounter, he had completely laid out the top-ranked disciples of the Ling Family, an utterly terrifying sight!
Ling Fei didn’t dare linger any longer, he quickly turned and fled.
“Think you can escape?”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, reaching out his right hand, transforming it from a palm to a claw and grabbing toward Ling Fei, like a Golden Dragon soaring through the skies, seizing Ling Fei’s shoulder and pulling him forward, pressing him face down to the ground.
Crack!
Ling Fei’s neck was twisted, his eyes wide in shock, his face filled with horror, his mouth slightly open, but no sound could escape.
Lin Yi placed a foot on his face, pressing it close to the ground, flattening his features.
“You little beast, you’re seeking death!”
Seeing this, another Holy Rank disciple exploded with rage, and with a great shout, a huge sword appeared in his hand, which he furiously swung at Lin Yi, the Sword Qi slicing through the air like a curtain, seemingly engulfing Lin Yi within.
“Get lost!”
Lin Yi bellowed angrily, his palms striking at the giant weapon, emitting a thunderous boom that was deafening.
The huge sword was sent flying, trembling violently as if it couldn’t withstand the powerful force.
This strike from Lin Yi was many times more terrifying than those of the few Saint Heirs from before. The Holy Rank disciple couldn’t bear it at all and was directly blown away, smashing through a mountain range and turning the rocks into rubble along the way.
“How could he be so strong? Could Lin Yi really be a Legendary Realm expert?”
“That doesn’t make sense, Legendary Realm experts wouldn’t appear in a small place like Heavenly Holy City, and he’s also so young!”
“Legendary Realm, such figures would have retired to seclusion by now, how could they appear in such a desolate place, and just a Holy Rank disciple at that, it’s contrary to common sense!”
“Let’s get out of here, don’t worry about him!”
The remaining Holy Rank disciples of the Ling Family were so frightened that they turned to run, knowing they were no match for Lin Yi.
“Where do you think you’re going, none of you are going to escape!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, leapt up, transforming into a Golden Peng with incredible speed, catching up to the fleeing Holy Rank disciples in the blink of an eye, and with one punch, sent them flying, spitting blood as their bodies were thrown onto a distant hillside.
Lin Yi did not continue to pursue, instead, he watched the Holy Rank disciples quietly, his eyes flickering with a cold murderous intent.
He knew those disciples of the Ling Family were not simple, and he had to quickly kill them all, or they would be a constant threat.
“Lin Yi, don’t go too far!”
Seeing Lin Yi kill all of them, Ling Fei was furiously enraged, his eyes reddening as a rich blue light surged from his body, his form swelling like an ancient bronze tree, exuding a terrifying pressence.
The Ling Family’s cultivation technique was very peculiar, revolving around the devouring of Primordial Energy. Once their technique of devouring Primordial Energy was activated, it could unleash immense destructive power, capable of consuming an opponent’s internal Primordial Energy.
This Ling Family technique was exceedingly domineering, requiring massive amounts of Primordial Energy to activate, which is why they had established their clan’s power here.
Ling Fei’s body was bursting with roiling energy, like a torrential river surging powerfully, drowning his surroundings.
Amidst the blue sheen of his energy shield, the Primordial Energy condensed into an ancient bronze tree, shining dazzling blue light, like a rising moon unleashing a heaven-shocking might, causing Lin Yi to feel a tremor in his heart.
“What is this technique? It has such a powerful energy fluctuation, absolutely terrifying!”
Lin Yi’s eyebrows raised slightly, sensing the fearsome nature of this Ling Family technique. Not daring to take it lightly, his entire body was covered in Golden Dragon Scale Armor, protecting him securely, as golden light flickered in his eyes, shooting forth two blazing beams of gold.

chapters.title: Chapter 713 - 713 713 Actually Knows How to Run Away
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 713: Chapter 713: Actually Knows How to Run Away Chapter 713: Chapter 713: Actually Knows How to Run Away “It seems your cultivation technique is quite extraordinary, why not take it out and let me have a look!” Lin Yi coldly stared at Ling Fei, uttering indifferently.
“Hmph! Want to see it? I just won’t let you!”
Ling Fei snorted coldly, unwilling to reveal his cultivation technique to Lin Yi for admiration because it was too heaven-defying, and he treasured it too deeply to share.
Should Lin Yi learn the brilliant uses of his technique, he might annihilate their Ling Family completely in the future; Ling Fei was not willing to take that risk.
“Hmph, then don’t blame me for showing no mercy!”
Lin Yi’s expression darkened slightly, his eyes emitting a sharp vicious gleam, his intent to kill overwhelming.
This disciple from the Ling Family actually refusing to reveal the technique greatly irritated Lin Yi.
Lin Yi snorted coldly, his figure leaped up, transforming into a golden divine light, rushing towards Ling Fei.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Lin Yi moved with ultimate speed, becoming a golden afterimage, consecutively slaughtering seven or eight holy rank disciples of the Ling Family.
Ling Fei’s eyelids twitched, his face turning pale; he hadn’t expected Lin Yi to be so formidable. His strength was not beneath his, and if they continued to entangle, Ling Fei himself would be the one to suffer!
The ancient bronze tree on his body suddenly erupted in ripples, keeping Lin Yi’s body at bay and hindering his advance.
Meanwhile, Ling Fei’s figure flickered, turning into a cyan afterimage as he fled towards the distance.
Seeing Ling Fei’s actions, Lin Yi’s expression changed slightly, surprised that Ling Fei knew how to escape.
Lin Yi’s speed was incredibly fast; in the blink of an eye, he caught up with Ling Fei. A large hand reached out, attempting to seize Ling Fei.
“No!”
Ling Fei screamed in terror, his figure dodging frantically, trying to avoid Lin Yi’s attack.
But his speed was no match for Lin Yi’s; Ling Fei was caught firmly in his grasp, crushed to pieces.
“All of you disciples from the Ling Family deserve to die, I will show no leniency!” Lin Yi declared in a low voice, his eyes shooting out cold golden light.
Golden Qi Force radiated from Lin Yi’s body, enveloping the Ling Family disciples, restraining them, rendering them immobile.
“You dare to kill the disciples of the Ling Family, we will never let you off the hook!”
Ling Fei shouted.
Lin Yi, however, sneered at those words, saying, “The Ling Family? Pah! I, Lin Yi, have never acknowledged the Ling Family, nor have I ever heard of them! What are they to me that I should take them to heart? Rest assured, today I will kill all of your Ling Family members, not sparing a single one!”
As soon as Lin Yi’s words fell, a blazing flame burst forth from his body, instantly reducing the holy rank disciples of the Ling Family to ashes, leaving no remains.
These holy rank disciples were among the most outstanding young talents of the Ling Family, each possessing their secret techniques, but against a freak like Lin Yi, they had no power to resist.
Their bodies were burned to nothingness, not even dregs left behind.
This time, not a single one of the Ling Family disciples survived, all were annihilated.
“Who are you really, and why must you be so aggressive?” Ling Fei asked, his face filled with horror.
Even though Lin Yi had slain all the Ling Family disciples, Ling Fei hadn’t lost his fighting spirit and remained vigilant, watching Lin Yi for a chance to escape.
“I am Lin Yi!” Lin Yi said indifferently.
“What? Lin Yi?”
Upon hearing this, Ling Fei’s pupils shrank suddenly, his eyes widened in disbelief.
“You’re actually Lin Yi, the one who defeated Lin Feng?!”
“So you’re Lin Yi, no wonder you have such an impressive track record, no wonder you were able to kill so many disciples of the Ling Family. It really hasn’t been easy!”
Ling Fei was hit by a storm of shock in his heart. He had never expected Lin Yi to appear so suddenly, let alone that he would kill all the disciples of the Ling Family, which was beyond belief for him.
“I killed your Ling Family disciples only to act as an instrument of Heaven, to rid the people of a menace, not as any disciple of the Ling Family. Don’t associate me with those beasts,” Lin Yi snorted coldly, speaking in an even tone.
“Hmph, even if you’re not a disciple of the Ling Family, by killing our disciples, you’re making an enemy of the entire Ling Family!” gnashed Ling Fei through his teeth, shaking with rage. As the direct heir of the Ling Family, he was used to calling the shots, but today he faced such a mortifying disgrace that left him feeling utterly humiliated.
Lin Yi looked at Ling Fei with a cold gaze and spit out a sentence icily, “Ling Fei, your character is truly detestable. Let me tell you, even if the old ancestor of your Ling Family himself comes, I wouldn’t be the least bit afraid. If you don’t bring out the Cultivation Technique today to exchange for my life, I will take yours.”
“What? Lin Yi actually wants my life?”
“This Lin Yi is too arrogant, not even afraid of our Ling Family’s old ancestor!”
“This Lin Yi… he really doesn’t know whether he’s alive or dead. Doesn’t he know that our Ling family’s old ancestor is the most formidable of them all? Even the elders of the Ling Family have to show some respect to our old ancestor, yet he dares to make such audacious statements, truly a recklessly bold man!”
“Does he really think he can leave safely after killing those few disciples of the Ling Family?”
The crowd was shaken, full of contempt for Lin Yi. They were deeply angered by his presumptuousness and their disdain for him grew even stronger.
Ling Fei’s face was a mix of stormy expressions. He too was enraged by Lin Yi’s words and secretly swore to himself that he would kill Lin Yi, tear his body into thousands of pieces, and avenge his fallen comrades.
“Lin Yi, I advise you to surrender peacefully to avoid suffering. I, Ling Fei, am not as despicable and shameless as some people. I don’t mind capturing you and sending you to the Ling Family to be punished!” Ling Fei said through clenched teeth, the murderous intent in his heart overflowing, wishing he could devour Lin Yi alive.
“Heh, if you have that ability, try it!”
Lin Yi sneered contemptuously, looking down on Ling Fei, his eyes filled with mockery.
Though Ling Fei was burning with rage, he was not foolish. He knew that Lin Yi was powerful and that he was no match for him. He had to keep his distance and wait for reinforcements.
Seeing this, Lin Yi didn’t waste words and his figure flickered as he lunged at Ling Fei.
Lin Yi was extremely ruthless in his moves, executing his attacks to perfection, each one filled with unparalleled lethality, aiming to take Ling Fei’s life.
However, Ling Fei was, after all, the pride of the Ling Family’s younger generation, powerful in his own right. He quickly stabilized the situation, repelled Lin Yi’s attacks, and counterattacked.
Bang bang bang!
Sounds of violent collisions erupted as Lin Yi and Ling Fei’s fists and palms struck each other, causing the void to shatter and unleashing a dazzling radiance.
Ling Fei’s cultivation had reached the Second Layer of the Pill Condensation Realm, his combat strength unparalleled, matching Lin Yi blow for blow. But Lin Yi was not at all weaker and even gained the upper hand, suppressing Ling Fei completely.
Ling Fei was suppressed so miserably by Lin Yi that his body couldn’t help but tremble, and his face turned pale.
Inside, Ling Fei was in a panic. He knew that if things continued like this, his defeat was certain, and he had to find a way to leave the place.
Ling Fei’s eyes darted around as he thought about how to escape. He knew that it would not be easy to run away from Lin Yi, who was so powerful.
But Ling Fei was also aware that his clan members must have been killed by Lin Yi. He couldn’t just sit and wait for death; he had to find a way to fight back, to kill Lin Yi and avenge his family members!

chapters.title: Chapter 714 - 714 714 Cunning and Deceitful Tactics
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 714: Chapter 714: Cunning and Deceitful Tactics Chapter 714: Chapter 714: Cunning and Deceitful Tactics At that thought, a powerful surge of anger welled up in Ling Fei’s heart; his mind whirled rapidly, and a spark of inspiration flashed through his mind, instantly concocting a scheme.
With this plan in mind, Ling Fei’s expression brightened, and a cold sneer surfaced in his eyes as he looked at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi could sense the change in Ling Fei’s expression and felt a strong sense of danger rising within him, cursing inwardly, “What is this kid up to? He wouldn’t be thinking of using some treacherous and scheming method to deal with me, would he?”
The more Lin Yi thought about it, the more his heart throbbed, but he also understood that he could not retreat even a step, because stepping back would allow Ling Fei to catch up, and then he would be fish on the chopping board, left to be carved at will.
“Ling Fei, since you refuse to submit to me, then I have no choice but to send you to the afterlife and avenge those sect members who died!”
Roaring inwardly, Lin Yi’s expression was dark as water, his killing intent sharp and fierce, and his gaze turned icy cold, as sharp as a blade’s edge, seemingly ready to cut down Ling Fei at any moment.
“Lin Yi, we’re having such a great fight; stop worrying about me. Let me kill this guy first!” Ling Fei shouted at Lin Yi.
Hearing Ling Fei’s words, Lin Yi couldn’t help but frown.
Ling Fei’s intention was already very clear; he wanted to take advantage of the battle between him and Lin Yi to kill Ling Fei and then seize the Ling Family’s sect-guarding Martial Arts from Lin Yi, making himself the only genius of the Ling Family and inheriting the position of the family head.
Such a tactic was indeed malicious and sinister.
But Lin Yi knew that he could not let Ling Fei succeed, otherwise his own death was certain; he could not let a threat become his biggest problem.
Seeing that Lin Yi was ignoring him, Ling Fei grew increasingly anxious, thinking to himself, “Could this kid really be plotting my demise?”
No, he absolutely couldn’t let him have his way, he had to find a way to stop him, to prevent him from succeeding!
Lin Yi thought to himself.
His arms shook, and two black dragons appeared out of thin air, writhing endlessly behind him, making sounds like peals of thunder, the noise rolling and unstoppable, causing everyone around to shudder in fear and feel an unbearable pressure, like being smothered.
“The black dragon is terrifying, it seems to be much more formidable than the previous one!”
“I remember this is a Martial Arts of Ling Fei, reportedly called ‘Demon Dragon Claw’. It is said to be the Martial Arts of a demon with boundless power. I wonder how many Martial Arts Lin Yi has truly mastered?”
“Lin Yi may be strong, but he’s really too young. Even if he’s mastered Demon Dragon Claw, can he really compare with Ling Fei?”
…
Witnessing the scene unfolding behind Ling Fei, the crowd burst into discussion, their eyes filled with intense surprise as they looked at Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi, I didn’t expect you to be so powerful, to have even learned Demon Dragon Claw!” Ling Fei, upon seeing the black dragon claw that had appeared behind Lin Yi, couldn’t help but exclaim in admiration.
“Ling Fei, I didn’t expect you to have mastered Demon Dragon Claw either. Its power is truly formidable, and if you’ve mastered Demon Dragon Claw, your combat power will certainly become even stronger!” Lin Yi said with a cold snort.
“Hahaha! Lin Yi, you’re not too shabby either! My Demon Dragon Claw is not weak, but I need more time to grasp its essence. However, as long as I master this Demon Dragon Claw, killing you should be no problem!” Ling Fei said with a laugh.
“Hehe, your Demon Dragon Claw is indeed powerful, but it also has a drawback; it can only be used once, and your consumption is too great. As long as you can’t recover in time, your defeat is certain!” Lin Yi said with a slight smile, his face wearing a hint of scornful amusement.
“What?” Ling Fei was taken aback, his face turning extremely ugly in an instant.
Demon Dragon Claw, as the name implies, is a manifestation of a giant dragon claw condensed from the Demonic Qi of a demonic beast, designed to grasp and kill the enemy and then devour their Yuan Force, blood, and essence blood.
But Lin Yi’s words about his Demon Dragon Claw having a shortcoming, implied it could only be used once.
This meant that Lin Yi could only use the Demon Dragon Claw once, which was practically disastrous news for Ling Fei.
