“Lin Yi, stop spouting nonsense. The Demon Dragon Claw is a secret technique of my Ling Family, how could it possibly have any flaws? Do you really think you can deceive me? You’re delusional. Now admit defeat!” Ling Fei, embarrassed and infuriated, barked angrily, his eyes turning bloodshot.
Ling Fei’s shamelessness had reached its limit; he still refused to give up!
“Is that so? Then let’s see just how effective your Demon Dragon Claw really is!” Lin Yi’s mouth curled up slightly, a hint of a wicked smile on his lips.
He moved his hands, and a pitch-black phantom of a demon dragon appeared behind him. The demon dragon let out a roar, its huge body stretching a hundred meters in length. It opened its massive jaws, lunging at Ling Fei as if to swallow him whole.
Seeing this, Ling Fei’s complexion also changed dramatically. He immediately channeled his Primordial Energy, wildly pouring it into his right palm and ferociously struck toward the demon dragon.
“Boom boom boom~~~”
The collision of two colossal forces in mid-air created a dazzling burst of light, vibrating the entire void as if it was on the verge of collapse.
Lin Yi’s Demon Dragon Claw was powerful, but Ling Fei’s Demon Tiger Claw was equally extraordinary. As the two martial arts clashed, the resultant noise was incredibly loud, reverberating throughout the arena, causing many people’s eardrums to ache and their hearts to shake incessantly.
“Bang!”
The two demonic claws collided once again, and this time Ling Fei’s Demon Tiger Claw had the upper hand, shattering the Demon Dragon Claw entirely.
With a successful strike, Ling Fei breathed a sigh of relief, thinking to himself, “Luckily I used all my strength just now, otherwise I would have let this guy escape!”
The Demon Dragon Claw indeed possessed overwhelming power; even Ling Fei hadn’t expected Lin Yi to have mastered it.
However, he was not concerned, for he had a trump card—his Divine Artifact.
The Divine Artifact was a legacy of his master, formidable in might and a Supreme Grade artifact, capable of defying the heavens. Once deployed, its power was terrifying to the extreme.
Therefore, Ling Fei was not the slightest bit worried; in fact, he felt confident he could kill Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi, do you think only your Demon Dragon Claw possesses Demonic Nature? I have my own!” Ling Fei scoffed coldly, his figure flickering as he suddenly appeared before Lin Yi, throwing a punch instantly.
Ling Fei’s fist, like forged metal, was filled with metallic properties, glittering with a dazzling golden light and exuding surges of Demonic Qi, roaring like a demon dragon as it charged towards Lin Yi.
Seeing Ling Fei’s attack, Lin Yi’s expression grew solemn. He joined his hands, casting a Defensive Technique.
“Thump thump thump…”
Their strong winds collided in the air, Lin Yi’s Defensive Technique instantly shattered, but Lin Yi himself was unharmed. He still stood in his original spot, looking coldly at Ling Fei.
“How is this possible? How can he be unharmed?!”
Witnessing this, Ling Fei’s pupils contracted, his complexion turning extremely gloomy, his eyes flashing with a hint of a sinister shade.
The Demon Dragon Claw Lin Yi deployed held tremendous power; once touched, it was meant to cause severe damage, but Lin Yi was inexplicably unscathed.
Could Lin Yi have cultivated a Cultivation Technique from the Demon Clan?
No, Ling Fei shook his head, dismissing the thought. He had clashed with the Demon Clan before and was quite familiar with them. He had never seen a Demon Clan’s Demon Dragon Claw hold such formidable power, even surpassing the one he had used.
“Could it be that he has truly mastered some kind of secret art from the Demon Clan?”

chapters.title: Chapter 715 - 715 715 Feeling Even Worse
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 715: Chapter 715: Feeling Even Worse Chapter 715: Chapter 715: Feeling Even Worse Thinking of these things, Lin Yi’s mood grew even worse. If Lin Yi had cultivated the Demon Clan’s secret techniques, his Demon Dragon Claw would probably not be a match for Lin Yi.
“Your Demon Dragon Claw is quite impressive, but I’m not bad either!” Lin Yi sneered, “The Demon Dragon Claw is indeed domineering, but I won’t be afraid of you, your Demon Dragon Claw is ineffective against me!”
Hearing this, Lin Yi immediately frowned, a hint of confusion flashing in his eyes, not understanding what Lin Yi was relying on.
However, Lin Yi was no fool; he quickly grasped the deeper meaning behind Lin Yi’s words.
Lin Yi sneered, “In that case, I’ll try your Demon Dragon Claw again!”
With that, Lin Yi once more launched an attack with his Demon Dragon Claw, clashing fiercely with Lin Yi once again.
Both unleashed their most powerful moves, fighting to an indistinguishable standstill, and for a time, neither could determine the victor.
To the others, it appeared as if Lin Yi and Lin Yi were equally matched, neither conceding defeat.
Seeing this scene, many people showed expressions of surprise.
“As expected of Lin Yi, his strength is indeed strong; even Lin Yi’s Demon Dragon Claw can’t do anything to him!”
“Although Lin Yi is only at the peak of Holy Rank, his power is extremely formidable; even Lin Yi can’t get the better of him.”
“Lin Yi’s strength is not inferior to Lin Yi’s; it won’t be easy for Lin Yi to win, but it also won’t be easy for Lin Yi to defeat Lin Yi!”
“That may not necessarily be the case; I think Lin Yi can defeat Lin Yi.”
The crowd buzzed with discussion, all debating the battle between Lin Yi and Lin Yi, the majority feeling that Lin Yi would emerge victorious.
This fight lasted several hours, yet no one was able to determine a winner.
During these hours, Lin Yi and Lin Yi didn’t unleash any killer moves, only continually countering each other.
Lin Yi’s attacks were fierce and overbearing, but his defensive techniques were even more exquisite. Lin Yi’s Demon Dragon Claw inflicted minimal damage on Lin Yi; conversely, Lin Yi repeatedly suppressed the Demon Dragon Claw.
After shattering Lin Yi’s attack, Lin Yi immediately urged his Martial Soul, unleashing the Demon Dragon Claw to attack Lin Yi.
“Boom!”
Lin Yi’s Demon Dragon Claw was once again blocked by Lin Yi’s Demon Dragon Claw.
“Hmph, it seems your attacks are useless against me; let’s see how much longer you can hold on!” Lin Yi snorted coldly as his body transformed into a streak of light, charging toward Lin Yi, hands clenching a hammer, and smashing down toward Lin Yi.
Lin Yi, unwilling to show weakness, once again executed his Demon Dragon Claw, clashing head-on with Lin Yi’s Demon Dragon Claw.
“Boom, boom, boom…”
Lin Yi’s Demon Dragon Claw collided with Lin Yi’s Demon Dragon Claw, the clash of the two demonic beasts causing fierce blows and emitting a tremendous sound. The air trembled continuously, as if it could barely withstand the force.
In that moment, the spectators were dumbfounded and incredulous.
None of them had expected Lin Yi’s Demon Dragon Claw to be so powerful that it could stand up to Lin Yi’s Demon Dragon Claw. Such a feat was extremely rare; even the average Saintly Lord was incapable of doing so.
As strong as Lin Yi’s defensive techniques were, they were ultimately at the early stage of the Holy Rank cultivation technique and paled in comparison to Lin Yi’s Demon Dragon Claw.
The gap in strength between the two was too vast. No matter how powerful Lin Yi was, he could not change this fact, so Lin Yi’s Demon Dragon Claw was more than enough to handle Lin Yi.
Watching Lin Yi unleash his Demon Dragon Claw, the eyes of those around were filled with shock and envy.
Lin Yi’s defensive technique grew increasingly thin under Lin Yi’s offense, steadily fading away, while Lin Yi’s attacks grew stronger, gradually gaining the upper hand.
“No, this won’t do. If this continues, my defensive technique will surely be broken through!”
Feeling that his defensive technique was about to be breached by Lin Yi, a hint of urgency flickered in Lin Yi’s eyes. Then, with a slight shift in his thoughts, a longsword suddenly appeared in Lin Yi’s hand. The sword resembled Lin Yi’s weapon, but upon closer inspection, one could see that it was different in shape.
This longsword was black, approximately three feet long, with a sharp edge that exuded bursts of icy chill.
Seeing this longsword, everyone’s eyes lit up.
“What a sharp treasure, Lin Yi actually possesses such good stuff!”
“Lin Yi’s luck is really good to have such a fine weapon, I wonder what this black longsword is called?”
“Black Evil Demon Sword!”
“So it’s called the Black Evil Demon Sword, such a domineering name!”
“Indeed, it is an ancient artifact; legend has it that this sword was the weapon of a Demon King, its power boundless, capable of destroying mountains and rivers with a single strike!”
“Lin Yi truly is lucky!”
Everyone exclaimed in astonishment, their gazes resting on the longsword in Lin Yi’s hands, revealing a hint of greed.
What a great item this Black Evil Demon Sword is!
If it were to be taken back, it could definitely be sold for a lot of money, enough to exchange for many resources, which would be of tremendous help for their cultivation!
At that moment, everyone began to scheme privately, preparing to purchase the longsword.
At this time, Lin Yi’s eyes focused, looking at the Black Evil Demon Sword in Lin Yi’s hands, his face showing shock.
“You actually have such a formidable treasure?!”
Seeing the Black Evil Demon Sword, Lin Yi’s eyes immediately narrowed, a hot fervor passing through them, his heart filled with astonishment, because in his view, the longsword in Lin Yi’s hands was simply an ancient artifact!
“Haha, are you envious? Then take it!”
Lin Yi, seeing the greed in Lin Yi’s eyes, couldn’t help but burst into hearty laughter; with a flick of his wrist, the Black Evil Demon Sword stabbed towards Lin Yi.
“Swoosh!”
The Black Evil Demon Sword instantly penetrated Lin Yi’s chest, blood spurting out and splattering everywhere.
“Ah!”
Lin Yi screamed in agony, a look of shock flashing across his eyes.
He never expected that he would be seriously wounded by Lin Yi!
Lin Yi’s attack was too swift; there was no time to react, and moreover, he dared not retract the Black Evil Demon Sword because if he did, his defensive technique would surely become ineffective.
“Damn it, this stinking brat actually injured me!”
Anger flashed across Lin Yi’s face; the Black Evil Demon Sword in his hand stirred viciously, and immediately a terrifying swallowing force emerged from his body, voraciously tearing at Lin Yi’s flesh, seeking to devour him.
Seeing the swallowing force of the Black Evil Demon Sword, everyone’s complexion turned pale.
Lin Yi’s defensive technique was already broken; if he was devoured by the Black Evil Demon Sword, he would undoubtedly be sucked dry, dead without a complete corpse!
Although Lin Yi’s strength was very powerful, the Black Evil Demon Sword in Lin Yi’s hands was too ferocious and mysterious, and his physical body simply couldn’t withstand it.
Lin Yi sought to seize the Black Evil Demon Sword while Lin Yi was being absorbed by it.
“Hmph! You think I don’t know what you’re thinking? Let me tell you, there’s no way you’re taking this Black Evil Demon Sword!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly; a layer of golden light surfaced on his body, enveloping him and shielding him from the Black Evil Demon Sword’s devouring force, which did not consume him.
“This kid can actually defend against the Black Evil Demon Sword?” Lin Yi’s complexion darkened, becoming somewhat unpredictable.

chapters.title: Chapter 716 - 716 716 Wait and See How Things Change
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 716: Chapter 716: Wait and See How Things Change Chapter 716: Chapter 716: Wait and See How Things Change He was just about to continue his assault, but at this moment, Elder Bai suddenly stopped him and shook his head at him.
Although Elder Bai didn’t understand the special function of the Black Evil Demon Sword in Lin Yi’s hands, he could see that Lin Yi was extremely wary of Lin Yi.
And Lin Yi was also somewhat cautious of him, so he decided to wait and see, to find out who was stronger and more formidable between the two of them!
“You wouldn’t be thinking of killing me, would you?” Seeing the murderous look on Lin Yi’s face as he stared at him, Lin Yi couldn’t help but ask.
“Hmph, how could I possibly kill you?” Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Yi’s face revealed a mocking smile, “However, if you were to kill me, you certainly wouldn’t survive either. There is only a matter of life and death between us, nothing else.”
“I understand. In that case, stop forcing me to make a move. You go first. I don’t want to be preempted by you when I make my move.” Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Yi’s face revealed a hint of playful amusement, looking at Lin Yi with a light smile.
“You! Fine, then I’ll make a move!”
Lin Yi was infuriated by Lin Yi’s words, a trace of ferocity flashed in his eyes, his figure moved, and he charged straight at Lin Yi.
Watching Lin Yi charge at him, Lin Yi showed no fear on his face, instead, he laughed, waving his hand as he looked at Lin Yi’s figure.
As he waved his hand, black demonic dragons appeared in the void, roaring and charging towards Lin Yi.
“Ao-hou!”
“Bang! Bang! Bang!”
Wherever the demonic dragons passed, the void burst, all matter was devoured, turned to ashes!
Seeing the demonic dragons lunging at him, Lin Yi’s expression slightly changed, he quickly swung his sword to slay them.
“Hiss! Hiss! Hiss!”
The demonic dragons spat out black flames from their mouths, incinerating Lin Yi’s body into nothingness.
“Worthy of being an ancient treasure, indeed formidable, my defensive technique is completely useless in front of it!”
Lin Yi’s expression was incredibly grim, looking at the demonic dragons, he knew very well that if he were to be struck by their attack, he too would likely encounter a disaster and be doomed!
He quickly retreated several steps, dodging the attack of the demonic dragons.
Seeing that Lin Yi actually avoided the attack of the black dragons, Lin Yi’s eyes flashed with surprise. Looking at Lin Yi, a trace of astonishment crossed his eyes, “Lin Yi, I didn’t expect your strength to be so formidable that you could avoid my attack. This is quite surprising indeed!”
“Hmph, that’s because this ancient treasure is too heaven-defying, otherwise, I’d have defeated you already. How could it be your turn to be arrogant?!” Lin Yi snorted coldly, but he was also quite amazed in his heart, not expecting the fierceness of the black dragons to be so formidable!
“No matter what, I must seize this ancient Demon Sword!”
Looking at the Demon Sword in his hand, Lin Yi’s eyes glittered with intense killing intent and greed, he thought to himself.
“Rumble!”
Lin Yi tapped the ground with the tip of his foot, his whole body shot up like a cannonball, charging towards Lin Yi.
“Bring it on!”
Lin Yi sneered coldly, also rushing towards Lin Yi.
Their figures were as fast as lightning, colliding together in the blink of an eye, producing a series of intense collision sounds.
“Boom! Boom! Boom!”
Both sides executed their strongest moves, and for a moment, it was a fierce fight with punches to flesh, the clashes sparking endlessly, causing one’s heart to throb uncontrollably.
Lin Yi’s Defensive Technique had already been broken through, and the black Demon Sword in his hand was also wrapped in black Demonic Qi, unable to break free, forced to endure the onslaught.
“Boom!”
A punch landed on the Black Evil Demon Sword, and Lin Yi’s body immediately flew backward, crashing to the ground, blood spilling from the corner of his mouth.
Looking at Lin Yi who was sent flying, Lin Yi’s complexion also turned somewhat pale.
Lin Yi was extremely powerful, and even with a treasure like the Black Evil Demon Sword, it was impossible to defeat him in a short time.
“Such terrifying defensive power, but my physical strength is also mighty. I refuse to believe that I cannot defeat you!”
The cold light flickered in Lin Yi’s eyes as his Primordial Energy wildly surged within him, and a horrifying power was released from his body, directly charging towards the black Demon Sword.
“Boom, boom, boom, boom!”
Lin Yi crazily executed his Martial Arts, punching the black Demon Sword repeatedly, and the black fog emitted from the sword shattered under his onslaught.
“Thud!”
Another fierce punch landed on the black Demon Sword, sending out a muffled echo as a terrifying gust of wind blew out from the sword, flipping Lin Yi’s entire body over.
“Cough, cough, cough!”
Lin Yi lay on the ground, coughing violently with his face full of shock, his eyes wide open in round disbelief.
“This ancient Demon Sword is just too terrifying; I’m no match for you, put it away now!”
“This is my talisman; I won’t hand it over to you so easily!” Lin Yi sneered disdainfully, looking at Lin Yi, “And I don’t believe, with my cultivation, that I truly can’t beat you!”
Indeed, Lin Yi was powerful, but his realm was only at the Ninefold Heaven of the Pill Condensation Realm, whereas Lin Yi had already reached the peak of the Eightfold Heaven in the Qi Refinement stage, merely half a step away from the Ninefold Heaven of the Pill Condensation Realm.
“Hmph! You think defeating me is that easy!” Lin Yi stood up, his eyes filled with intense killing intent.
“Then try me!”
Lin Yi sneered, charging forward to meet him head-on, swinging the Demon Sword again to slash at Lin Yi, with Demonic Qi billowing out like a black cloud that blotted out the sky.
Upon seeing this, Lin Yi’s eyes flashed coldly, and his figure swelled instantaneously into an enormous beast standing thirty feet tall, spouting a ball of purple-red flame from his mouth.
As soon as the purple-red fireball appeared, it instantly transformed into a purple python, opening its jaws and clawing as it lunged to bite Lin Yi.
“This beast is actually the ancient fierce monster, the Green Jiao; it looks like I’ve met my match this time!” Seeing the purple python, Lin Yi’s pupils shrank sharply.
The Purple Jiao was an ancient mythical beast, stronger than ordinary Demon Beasts by no small margin, definitely not something Lin Yi could contend with.
However, despite thinking this, Lin Yi showed no sign of retreat; his right hand formed a seal, his body emanated a dark ink-like radiance, and a black mountain surged from his body, pressing down towards the Purple Jiao.
“Boom, boom, boom!”
The mountains descended with a thunderous roar, and after a mighty tremor, the scales on the giant purple python were shattered and blood spattered in all directions.
“Roar!”
The wounded purple python let out a painful howl, its form shrank considerably, eventually becoming palm-sized and floating beside Lin Yi.
Looking at the purple python suspended in front of Lin Yi, Lin Yi’s eyes revealed a look of shock, cursing inwardly, “This Lin Yi actually has a mountain range!”
This mountain range was over five meters long, even bigger than the black Demon Sword in Lin Yi’s hands.
Shaken to the core, Lin Yi knew that if not for the mountain protecting Lin Yi’s body, that last strike would have been enough to completely destroy Lin Yi’s physical body.
Such strength was absolutely terrifying!
However, formidable as this Lin Yi was, he could not possibly withstand him. This time, Lin Yi was determined to defeat this Lin Yi and then snatch away the Demon Sword he possessed.
With that thought, his gaze became deathly grim, his hand gripping the black Demon Sword, his body slightly arched as he charged towards Lin Yi.
“Thud!”
Lin Yi thrust his sword, sending out a terrifying black Sword Qi, carrying extreme power that ruthlessly slashed across Lin Yi’s chest.
Instantly, numerous gashes blossomed on Lin Yi’s chest, blood flowing continuously, staining his clothes red.

chapters.title: Chapter 717 - 717 717 Unable to Change the Status Quo
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 717: Chapter 717: Unable to Change the Status Quo Chapter 717: Chapter 717: Unable to Change the Status Quo “Ah…”
A wave of intense pain hit, and Lin Yi couldn’t help but cry out loudly.
“Bang!”
Before Lin Yi could catch his breath, his fist blasted out again, sending Lin Yi flying through the air, crashing to the ground in the distance, spewing out a mouthful of fresh blood, his breath visibly weakened.
“How is this possible? This Lin Yi is clearly just a Body Tempering Realm sixfold heaven cultivator, how can he possess such formidable strength?” Watching Lin Yi lying on the ground vomiting blood, Lin Yi was shocked to his core.
Lin Yi’s strength was unambiguously clear to him, yet such a terrifying being couldn’t even withstand a single move from Lin Yi; wasn’t Lin Yi’s strength far too terrifying?
Lin Yi steadied himself, his eyes cold as he looked at Lin Yi, “Now, it’s my turn to make a move, isn’t it?”
“Hmph, save it, even if you’re strong, you can’t change the situation!”
Lin Yi’s eyes filled with an icy chill, as he spoke to Lin Yi, “I admit your strength is not bad, but you simply can’t block my move!”
“Is that so? Then taste my technique!”
Lin Yi’s strength was formidable, which was clear to Lin Yi, but although Lin Yi was powerful, he didn’t fear him.
“Whoosh!”
With a flick of his wrist, the Demon Sword instantly transformed into a black streak, slashing towards Lin Yi.
“Bang!”
Lin Yi’s blade clashed with Lin Yi’s Demon Sword, colliding to produce a thunderous roar. A vast power burst forth, spreading in all directions, and ripples appeared in the air, like water waves spreading outwards.
“Pfft!”
Lin Yi’s complexion slightly changed, as a scarlet stream of blood trickled down from the corner of his lips, his face pale, with blood continuously flowing from his mouth.
“How is this possible? I am at the Body Refinement Realm sevenfold heaven, how could this junior possibly be my opponent, how could I possibly be defeated?”
Lin Yi’s eyes widened in disbelief, staring at the scene before him, his heart stirred by monstrous waves, unable to calm down for a long time.
“Huff…”
Lin Yi took a deep breath, collecting the surging, overwhelming power within him, his complexion somewhat pale, as that last sword strike had exhausted a lot of his spiritual power.
But his heart was filled with excitement because he had successfully forced Lin Yi to use the ancient Barbaric Bull Fist!
“Barbaric Bull Fist’s second technique, Barbaric Overlord Fist!”
“Boom!”
Lin Yi gave a low shout, and a faint golden light enveloped his fist, as though he were a golden battle god.
“Bang!”
The fist collided with the purple Flood Dragon, immediately cracking its hide, emitting a cracking sound like that of shattering porcelain, and the scales on the body of the purple Flood Dragon fell to the ground one after another.
“With this punch, I’ve concentrated the power of the second technique of the Barbaric Bull Fist, along with a strand of my Barbaric Wilderness Force, you’re undoubtedly going to die, go to hell!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, and his fist brutally slammed into the purple Flood Dragon’s head.
“Rumble!”
The continuous booming sound filled the air, dust and debris clouded around Lin Yi, obscuring the view of the situation inside.
“Splash!”
From within the smoke, the sound of Lin Yi spitting blood could be heard, followed by a body falling to the ground from within the smoke.
The dust settled.
A corpse, riddled with holes, appeared before everyone’s eyes.
The body was covered in wounds, with blood streaming down.
“Is he dead? He’s really dead? Such a strong physical body, just how powerful was this Lin Yi’s body?”
Looking at Lin Yi’s corpse, everyone’s eyes were wide open, their hearts pounding violently.
Lin Yi, a young and renowned fighter from the Eastern Continent, had fallen just like that!
This scene was simply too hard for them to believe.
“This time, I finally won!”
A smile emerged on Lin Yi’s face as he turned and walked toward the small cottage nearby.
Within the cottage, he took out a crystal-clear Elixir and swallowed it. Immediately, his internal energy rapidly recovered.
Lin Yi, a Martial Artist at the Peak of the Body Refinement Realm’s Sevenfold Heaven, and also a cultivator of ancient martial arts, naturally had extraordinary physical power. Thus, even at his prime, facing Lin Yi would not be a disadvantage!
And now, he was injured, with only half his life left, but still not a match for Lin Yi.
Yet, he still achieved victory.
Because he had the strength to defeat Lin Yi.
“This time, you’re indeed very strong, but that is all!”
Looking at the corpse on the ground, a ferocious look appeared on Lin Yi’s face, his eyes dark and ominous.
He was very clear in his heart that if he continued to stay here, he would not live long, after all, Lin Yi’s strength was too terrifying.
“Whoosh!”
Lin Yi’s figure flashed as he quickly left the spot, disappearing into the night sky.
He must hurry back to his sect and report to his master, so that his master could send people to support him.
…
“Lin Yi’s strength is even greater than I imagined. This battle, I lost,”
“However, after this battle, Lin Yi will certainly attract the attention of other forces. With Lin Yi’s current strength, he is probably already strong enough to contend with some major forces. If I can kill Lin Yi before he rises, perhaps I could leap to become one of the top forces in the East Continent. Then, my power will become even greater!”
“Haha, in the end, I still made the best decision.”
“Lin Yi, this time you’re doomed. Once your power grows, I will eradicate your family without mercy. Otherwise, with your arrogant nature, I will eventually be bullied by you!”
…
“Lin Yi, don’t worry. After I kill you, I will slaughter all the people around you, and then you will be just a dead man,”
“Lin Yi, I will remember this hatred. You just wait for me. Once I step into the Third Layer of Qi cultivation, I will make sure you die a miserable death at my hands. That will be an honor for you!”
Lin Yi took a step and left the place.
“Lin Yi, once I step into the Third Layer, I’ll make you wish you were dead!”
Murderous intent flickered in Lin Yi’s eyes as he thought to himself.
…
“Swoosh!”
Lin Yi’s body swayed and appeared outside a mountain valley. His eyes scanned the surroundings, looking for a hidden place to take refuge.
“Whoosh!”
Suddenly, the sound of wind breaking resounded, and then, a figure appeared before Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s gaze sharpened, his eyes turned incredibility cold, filled with murderous intent.
This person was not someone else, it was the very Lin Yi he wanted to kill. At this moment, he had recovered his ability to move. Stepping forward, he came before Lin Yi and looked down on him with scorn, laughing coldly, “Lin Yi, you truly lost without injustice this time. Did you know? Your strength is nothing but that of an ant in front of me!”
Upon hearing these words, rage appeared on Lin Yi’s face, and his fists creaked loudly as he clenched them.
“An ant? You dare call me an ant? Then I’ll kill you right now and send you to accompany him!” Lin Yi roared, his arms swung violently, and his fist wind howled as he struck towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi was a Martial Artist of the Eightfold Heaven in the Body Refinement Realm, with naturally extremely terrifying power.
“Trivial skills of an insect!” Lin Yi snorted coldly, his foot raised, and a surge of force burst forth.
“Boom!”
Lin Yi’s right leg fiercely kicked out, hitting Lin Yi squarely in the abdomen.
Lin Yi’s body was sent flying, crashing through several towering trees, and he spat out a mouthful of fresh blood.
Lin Yan was defeated.

chapters.title: Chapter 718 - 718 718 No Way Out
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 718: Chapter 718: No Way Out Chapter 718: Chapter 718: No Way Out This time, Lin Yi had truly been defeated.
“So this is Lin Yi, without a shred of backbone, still daring to provoke me? Utter foolishness.” Lin Yi declared with disdain, scoffing as he swooped in front of Lin Yi and grabbed his throat.
Lin Yi’s face turned red, he struggled desperately, but to no avail.
Lin Yi was a Martial Artist at the Ninefold Heaven of the Body Refinement Realm, but in front of Lin Yi, he had no power to resist at all.
“Let him go, he is just a pitiful person.” Watching Lin Yi, a young man stepped forward and said, his voice filled with sorrow.
The young man was a Martial Artist of the Fivefold Heaven of the Body Refinement Realm; he had also been chased by Lin Yi for some time, but he wasn’t as powerful as Lin Yi, just cannon fodder.
“Hmph!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly and let go, saying in a cold voice, “Lin Yi, don’t come troubling me again in the future, otherwise, I’ll make you regret it!”
Lin Yi coughed a few times, his eyes filled with horror as he looked at Lin Yi.
Just now, if Lin Yi hadn’t released him, his head might have already ‘moved house’.
Although he prided himself on his strength, he was still no match for Lin Yi.
Lin Yi knew in his heart that he was no match for Lin Yi, and if he were to fight Lin Yi, he would surely die without a doubt!
“You can go now,” Lin Yi said.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Yi quickly fled.
“Your injuries haven’t healed yet; it’s not suitable for you to continue fighting. I will take you to recuperate first!” Lin Yi called out to Lin Yi’s retreating figure.
“Mmm!” Lin Yi responded, then escaped in another direction.
Lin Yi did not pursue, because his injuries were severe now, and if he were to fight Lin Yi again, he wouldn’t be sure that he wouldn’t be seriously injured once more.
His speed was very slow, not as quick as Lin Yi’s.
However, Lin Yi could still follow right behind Lin Yi.
…
“Lin Yi, why have you broken through so quickly? There aren’t many Martial Artists in this world whose talents surpass yours. How could you possibly have made such rapid progress?” Lin Yi ran wildly, unable to resist turning back to ask Lin Yi.
To him, Lin Yi was a threat that had to be eliminated, to leave no trouble behind, otherwise, he would surely become an enemy to Lin Yi.
“That’s, well, a secret, I won’t tell you for now,” Lin Yi replied with a faint smile. He knew that Lin Yi had no good intentions, but he wouldn’t reveal his identity directly. The more people who knew about such things, the more dangerous it became.
“I don’t want to know either, but since we’ve had the fate to meet, I’m willing to offer you an opportunity. This time, I will help you to advance to the Foundation Establishment Realm, to step into the Qi Cultivation Realm,” Lin Yi said indifferently, eyes filled with greed.
The Foundation Establishment Realm was a significant hurdle in the Qi Refinement Realm, also a watershed for Martial Artists in the Foundation Establishment Realm.
Although Lin Yi’s strength had reached the Ninefold Heaven of the Body Refinement Realm, there was still a gap from the Foundation Establishment Realm.
Lin Yi needed a lot of resources to advance to the Foundation Establishment Realm, and Lin Yi just so happened to be able to provide him with an abundance of resources.
“Why should I trust you?” Lin Yi glanced at Lin Yi, a cold smile in his eyes, he said faintly.
Lin Yi knew that Lin Yi certainly didn’t harbor good intentions.
Lin Yi was the older brother of Lin Yunfan, Lin Yi’s cousin, and Lin Yunfan was Lin Yi’s younger brother. Lin Yi surely wanted to use him to achieve Lin Yunfan’s goals, then have Lin Yunfan help kill him.
Lin Yi wasn’t stupid; he certainly wouldn’t be easily fooled.
Hearing Lin Yi’s rejection of his advice, Lin Yi’s complexion darkened, a surge of anger rising in his heart as he shouted coldly, “Lin Yi, I’m offering good intentions here, why won’t you appreciate it?”
“Good intentions?” Lin Yi scoffed with a cold laugh, “Such ‘good intentions,’ I’d rather not have!”
Lin Yi, this guy was too sinister, with a look of old cunning that was detestable.
Lin Yi, this bastard, had always coveted the things on Lin Yi’s person; once Lin Yi gained any advantage, he would definitely try to snatch it, unwilling to give anything to Lin Yi—this was Lin Yi’s true face.
“Fine, if you don’t want this kind of good intention, then I won’t keep you company!” Lin Yi snorted coldly and turned to leave.
He did not want to waste time with Lin Yi, use up his own energy; he’d rather return to the sect early to cultivate.
“Lin Yi, since you want to leave, I won’t force you, but I still advise you, it’s best to avoid troubling me in the near future, otherwise, I will annihilate you, make you disappear from this world forever!” Lin Yi threatened with a cold huff.
“Hmph!” Lin Yi snorted coldly and left without turning his head.
Watching Lin Yi’s receding figure, he shook his head with a sigh, “Ah, I really shouldn’t have let you go. Such a despicable and shameless villain, if not eliminated, will definitely become a blight in the future.”
Thinking of Lin Yi’s arrogant and domineering face from earlier, a towering wave of hatred rose in Lin Yi’s heart.
“Lin Yi, when you’re alone, I will definitely kill you!” Lin Yi gritted his teeth in secret.
Lin Yi returned to his room, sat cross-legged on the bed, and began to cultivate.
These days, he had been cultivating in the valley. Although his cultivation had not increased, Lin Yi believed that as long as he continued to cultivate, sooner or later, his strength could catch up with Lin Yi’s, perhaps even surpass Lin Yi.
Lin Yi was convinced that Lin Yi would sooner or later die at his hands.
Moreover, Lin Yi also believed that Lin Yi would be slain by him; between them, one would definitely perish!
Lin Yi cultivated; he did not want to miss any opportunity for cultivation.
Time flowed day by day, and Lin Yi’s injuries also gradually healed; his cultivation finally broke through to the Qi Cultivation Realm Sixfold Heaven.
Qi Cultivation Realm Sixfold Heaven was now very close to Sevenfold Heaven, and he could also use Spiritual Artifacts now, which was his greatest reliance.
In cultivation, unbeknownst to him, Lin Yi once again broke through to the peak of the Body Refinement Realm Fourfold Heaven!
“Finally, a breakthrough!” Lin Yi opened his eyes, his heart filled with excitement. During this time, he did not stop cultivating in the valley, and his rate of cultivation was much faster than outside.
“These days, I’ve broken through several Great Realms!” Lin Yi murmured to himself, very satisfied with his rate of cultivation and silently determined to work even harder in the future.
The path of cultivation not only requires a resilient will but also vast determination.
The fact that Lin Yi came this far proved that he indeed possessed strong determination; he could endure the bitterest hardships to achieve greatness.
“Lin Yi, I have now broken through to the Qi Cultivation Realm Sixfold Heaven, and you have broken through as well. Our bet ends here; from now on, let’s not interfere with each other’s business,” Lin Yi’s Communication Talisman chimed.
“Good, I’m waiting for you. I hope you don’t forget my words, otherwise, I won’t mind eradicating you completely!” Lin Yi sent a message back.
“Hmph, I won’t forget you either!” Lin Yi sent a message in return.
After receiving the message, Lin Yi stopped paying attention to Lin Yi and continued his secluded cultivation.
Lin Yi’s breakthrough, Lin Yi’s increase in cultivation, bolstered Lin Yi’s confidence.
Seeing Lin Yi’s performance, Lin Yunfan couldn’t help but feel slightly shocked; truly befitting of someone from a great family, to possess such determination.
Lin Yi’s potential was even stronger than Lin Yunfan’s.
“This Lin Yi, cannot be left alive,” Lin Yi pondered darkly.

chapters.title: Chapter 719 - 719 719 Becoming Even More Terrifying
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 719: Chapter 719: Becoming Even More Terrifying Chapter 719: Chapter 719: Becoming Even More Terrifying Lin Yi knew that if he allowed Lin Yi to grow, he would become even more terrifying and might even surpass him.
Therefore, Lin Yi decided to resolve Lin Yi as soon as possible.
…
“Lin Yi, the time for our battle has come!” Lin Yi thought to himself.
“I’d like to see how capable you really are!” Lin Yi sneered, his figure vanishing from its original spot, reappearing atop a huge boulder a hundred yards away.
“Swoosh!” Lin Yi’s figure flashed, appearing on the other side of the boulder, and once again using the “Shrink Ground into Inches” technique, he quickly departed.
…
Lin Yi, while rapidly moving forward and employing the “Shrink Ground into Inches” technique, extended the distance between them farther and farther, until at last, the distance between the two was a full three thousand miles.
Lin Yi was very fast and soon shook off Lin Yi; his body instantly disappeared from its original spot, returning to his house.
“Lin Yi, do you want to play hide and seek with me?” As soon as Lin Yi returned to his room, he immediately opened the door, saying with a sneer as he also opened Lin Yi’s room door.
“Lin Yi, what are you trying to do?” As the door opened, a young man rushed out from the room, his face showing a look of surprise and incomprehension at Lin Yi.
This person was none other than Lin Yi, who had ultimately not surpassed Lin Yi in cultivation.
“Lin Yi, you didn’t expect to still lose to me, did you!” Lin Yi’s face bore a cold smile.
“Me, lose to you? Impossible, you were just lucky. If you hadn’t launched a sneak attack, how could I have lost to you!” Lin Yi said with a sneer, “Lin Yi, don’t be arrogant. This time you’ve lost to me, but in the future, I will definitely take your life and avenge our master!”
“Avenge? Hah, do you really think your master Lin He can protect you?” Lin Yi said disdainfully, “Let me tell you, Lin He has already fallen. You will not see him again; he’s dead, dead by your hand!”
“What?” Lin Yi’s eyes widened in disbelief.
“Lin He, the master Lin He?!” The other companions in the room also exclaimed, faces filled with disbelief.
Lin He, being the second strongest in the sect, held a status just below Ling Yuntian, and had considerable influence in the sect. His fall was a major event for them, hence their immense shock.
“Hmph, you think these petty tricks can deceive me?” Lin Yi snapped back to reality and snorted coldly, clearly unbelieving.
“Lin He indeed has died!” Lin Yi said with a cold laugh, “However, he was not killed by me but by you, his treacherous disciple, am I right?”
“Impossible, my master couldn’t have been killed by you!” Lin Yi roared.
“Ha ha, whether you believe it or not, that is the truth. But rest assured, I will make sure to return your master’s body to the Lin Family!” Lin Yi laughed heartily, then using spatial teleportation, left Lin Yi’s room.
Lin Yi’s emotions fluctuated intensely; he didn’t believe Lin Yi would lie.
Lin Yi’s master had indeed been killed by Lin Yi, but it was also true that Lin Yi’s master had been killed by him.
However, the fact that Lin Yi’s master was killed by Lin Yi did not mean he would concede defeat, for he had his trump card.
He had an ace in the hole, an ace that could definitely save his master, preventing his needless death at his hands.
“My master, how could he possibly die, how could he die by your hand, all of this must be fake!” Lin Yi pondered deep within his heart, “It must have been you who killed my master, then blamed it on me, I don’t believe your lies!”
With this thought, Lin Yi prepared to seek out Lin Yi for clarification.
With a thought, Lin Yi’s figure instantly disappeared from the spot, pursuing in the direction Lin Yi had left.
Lin Yi’s cultivation was far inferior to Lin Yi’s; it was simply not possible for him to catch up with Lin Yi.
Moreover, the space power that Lin Yi carried far surpassed his, so catching up to Lin Yi was essentially impossible.
“Hmph, you want to kill me? Well, we’ll see if you’re strong enough!” Lin Yi sneered, space power surging around him as he instantaneously disappeared on the spot.
“Lin Yi, you can’t escape!” Lin Yi gritted his teeth, quickening his pace as he pursued ahead.
In his heart, Lin Yi was never willing to admit that his master, Lin He, had really been killed by Lin Yi.
Using the technique to shrink the earth to an inch, Lin Yi moved quickly, gradually closing the distance between him and Lin Yi, and in the blink of an eye, he had narrowed the gap by tens of thousands of meters.
“No, this can’t be possible, it just can’t be!”
Shock was evident on Lin Yi’s face. His speed was fast, but compared to Lin Yi, there was still a huge gap, which Lin Yi found unbelievable.
His heart was shaken, but Lin Yi was not worried in the least.
Because in his hand, he possessed a secret treasure capable of hiding one’s cultivation, which could cloak his power and remain undetected.
The distance between Lin Yi and Lin Yi was shrinking, with only tens of thousands of meters separating them.
Lin Yi continued his relentless pursuit of Lin Yi, anxiety welling up within him. He was desperate to settle the account with Lin Yi immediately, but he was helpless; he simply couldn’t catch up to Lin Yi.
Not long after, Lin Yi stopped chasing because he discovered that Lin Yi had once again vanished into thin air.
This left Lin Yi profoundly shocked, for he knew that if he continued the chase, he might still not catch up to Lin Yi and would be unable to trace him.
In front of Lin Yi, he seemed to have become completely invisible.
“Lin Yi, who exactly are you? How did you do this? Why can’t I catch you no matter what I do, how do you avoid my detection?” Lin Yi’s face was etched with deep confusion; he couldn’t understand how Lin Yi could achieve such a feat, remaining undetectable even to him.
“Who I am is not important, what matters is that I am your enemy!”
“You killed my master, and I will make you pay with blood for blood!” Lin Yi said through clenched teeth, as his figure flashed and disappeared once again.
“My enemy, what of it? Today, I will let you witness my prowess!” Lin Yi sneered with a thick murderous aura emanating from him, his entire being akin to a devil incarnate.
In front of him, Lin Yi was no match, Lin Yi could kill him with a single move, hence there was no need to use any more tricks; he could directly kill Lin Yi.
As Lin Yi fled ahead, he was oblivious to the fact that Lin Yi’s figure had quietly appeared behind him, and then, a terrifying attack slammed into his back.
Pu-chi~
Lin Yi spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, his whole body flying backward.
“Ah…” Lin Yi screamed, feeling a searing pain tearing through him.
He had just stood up from the ground when Lin Yi struck again.
“Ah…” Lin Yi howled loudly, his entire being plunged into madness.
Every move from Lin Yi brought excruciating pain to Lin Yi, covering him in blood, a ghastly sight to behold.
After just a few exchanges, Lin Yi was left battered and covered in wounds, with bones broken in several places.
Blood trickled from the corners of Lin Yi’s mouth, his complexion pale, drenched in blood. Although his cultivation was formidable, at this moment, he was completely devoid of any fighting strength. Lin Yi could easily kill him with a casual palm strike.

chapters.title: Chapter 720 - 720 720 Feeling Very Relieved
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 720: Chapter 720: Feeling Very Relieved Chapter 720: Chapter 720: Feeling Very Relieved “Who are you, and why do you treat me like this? Why!” Lin Yi screamed hysterically, filled with rage and unwillingness.
Lin Yi sneered, paying no attention to his cries.
Seeing this, Lin Yi didn’t dare to utter another word of nonsense, as he knew that if he continued, he might die at the hands of Lin Yi.
Lin Yi looked at Lin Yi’s pitiful state, his face filled with a faint smile of contentment in his heart.
This Lin Yi, relying on some martial skills, thought he could deal with himself.
Pity, he ran into me.
No matter how powerful Lin Yi’s cultivation was, he was still not a match for Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi, today, I will slay you, I will make sure you never find peace in death!” The eyes of Lin Yi blazed with murderous intent, filled with towering hatred.
His body suddenly lunged forward, pouncing towards Lin Yi.
“Don’t come over, don’t kill me, I am willing to submit to you, please let me go!” Lin Yi cried out in a hurry, his face full of begging as he looked at Lin Yi, terrified.
“Too late, since you’ve shown no mercy, don’t blame me for being ruthless. A despicable person like you does not deserve pity in death!” A cruel killing intent appeared on Lin Yi’s face.
“No, don’t…” Lin Yi shouted in panic, his eyes filled with terror, but Lin Yi had already charged over, giving him no time to react, his neck grasped by Lin Yi.
Crack!
Lin Yi crushed Lin Yi’s throat, Lin Yi’s eyes bulging with disbelief, and then, his expression gradually faded away.
Lin Yi died, just like that, dead by Lin Yi’s hands. Lin Yi didn’t bother with Lin Yi’s corpse, his figure flickered, entering the virtual space, and then he opened the system store.
Inside the system store, Lin Yi purchased a Restorative Elixir and swallowed it.
This Restorative Elixir could restore a martial artist to the full strength of their prime.
“Haha, Lin Yi, you are definitely going to die this time,” Lin Yi laughed heartily.
With his strength at its peak condition, Lin Yi, who had improved quite a bit, could also easily resolve any encounter with Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s cultivation was at the Intermediate Stage of Innate, but his physical body had already reached the Later Stages of Innate, even to the brink of half-step Foundation Establishment.
With such a body, combined with the cultivation of the Later Stages of Innate, even facing a Foundation Establishment Stage powerhouse, he would have the strength to fight.
“Lin Yi, do you really think you can deal with me?” Lin Yi’s gaze was chilling.
“Heh, Lin Yi, you truly didn’t let me down,” he responded.
Just as Lin Yi was about to make a move, an elderly voice echoed in his mind.
Hearing this voice, Lin Yi’s brow furrowed slightly.
Immediately, his gaze shifted to one side.
There, an old man was sitting.
“You are…” Lin Yi looked at the old man, his eyes revealing a touch of solemnity.
This old man was very advanced in age, but his eyes were bright and spirited as if flashes of lightning were flickering within them.
He sat there, and the temperature around him plummeted.
At this moment, Lin Yi truly took a good look at the old man.
The old man wore ordinary clothes, appearing quite average, just like a village farmer. His hair was gray, his beard snow-white, and his eyes deep and profound as if he possessed endless wisdom, able to see through everything in the world.
“My surname is Ye, with a single name ‘Shan’, and I am an elder of the Outer Sect of Yunxiao Sect, Lin Yi, I remember you,” the old man said indifferently.
“So it’s Elder Shan!” Lin Yi sighed inwardly, the Outer Sect elder of Yunxiao Sect had actually come to Jiangyang City.
This mountain elder was a master of the Innate Great Perfection level.
In Jiangnan Province, Lin Yi’s reputation was indeed formidable, and disciples of the Yunxiao Sect naturally had all heard of his fame. Not only that, Lin Yi had eradicated the Qingcheng Sect, which was an event that shook the entire Huaxia.
The people of the Yunxiao Sect had naturally been paying attention to the movements in Jiangnan Province. Lin Yi had created such a huge commotion at the Qingcheng Sect that they were well aware, yet they did not intervene.
After all, the Yunxiao Sect belonged to the ancient martial forces and disdained to partake in worldly strife.
However, this time Lin Yi was going to deal with Lin Yi, and the Yunxiao Sect naturally also received the news.
“Hehe, you killed Lin Yi, and I’m also relieved. After all, he was my disciple!” Ye Shan sighed lightly.
Ye Shan was Lin Yi’s master, however, his wife had died in childbirth, and Lin Yi’s mother also met with an accident and died during childbirth.
Lin Yi’s mother was his wife.
This matter had always been weighing on his heart. Now that Lin Yi had come seeking him out, how could Ye Shan let Lin Yi off easily?
Lin Yi fell silent. Lin Yi’s mother turned out to be Ye Shan’s wife. It seemed that Ye Shan could also be regarded as a man deeply in love.
“Lin Yi, you deserve to die!” A moment later, Ye Shan said in an ice-cold tone.
“I was wrong, please, I beg you to spare me.” Lin Yi cried and pleaded, “I was wrong, I will never dare to offend you again.”
“I won’t kill you, but I will destroy your dantian and turn you into a complete cripple,” Lin Yi said with an ice-cold voice.
“My dantian…” Hearing this, Lin Yi trembled.
His cultivation was at the Foundation Establishment Second Rank, but if his cultivation were destroyed, what difference would there be between him and a cripple?
“I will remove your cultivation, reducing you to a normal person, however, this is only temporary. You can continue to stay in the Yunxiao Sect as a menial disciple.”
“That condition isn’t bad,” Ye Shan nodded in approval.
“Fine, I agree!” Lin Yi said through gritted teeth.
His cultivation being destroyed, without a supply of cultivation resources, it wouldn’t take many years for him to die an unnatural death. It was better to stay in the Yunxiao Sect where he would at least have a meal to eat, which is more secure than being outside.
“Rest assured, I guarantee you can live a long time, you won’t have a short life!” Lin Yi said with a grinning and a radiant smile.
“Mm,” Lin Yi nodded in agreement, then immediately asked, “Did you bring the three herbs you mentioned earlier?”
“You guess!” Lin Yi squinted his eyes and said, “Don’t worry, I will definitely bring them to you because this is a deal, not only can it save your life, but you can also obtain an immense opportunity!”
“Good.” Lin Yi nodded, he also believed that since Lin Yi dared to promise, he certainly could do it.
“Can I leave now?” Lin Yi asked.
“Yes,” Lin Yi smiled, waved his hand, a gentle surge of primordial energy flowed, sending Lin Yi out of there.
“Eh, I’m actually out?” Lin Yi opened his eyes and looked around, but he did not discover anything unusual, which made him furrow his brows. Finally, he shook his head and left the place.
…
“Lin Yi is out!” As soon as Lin Yi left the room, in the room next to his, a group of people stood, their eyes brimming with intense excitement.
“Hmph, that kid is definitely dead this time,” a middle-aged man snorted coldly.
“Although he has some methods, facing so many martial artists in the later stages of Innate, he is no match at all,” another middle-aged man said.
“Hehe, once that kid dies, the Yunxiao Sect will surely change hands.”
“Yes!” The crowd discussed animatedly, their target was all Lin Yi.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 721 - 721 721 With Immense Prestige
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 721: Chapter 721: With Immense Prestige Chapter 721: Chapter 721: With Immense Prestige Night fell and stars dotted the sky, with a bright moon hanging in the heavens.
In Jiangbei City within a lavish residence, a young man, sword on his back, stood by the window, gazing out at the distant night view, a devilish curve forming at his lips, “That kid is finally going to die, it wasn’t in vain waiting for him here for so long.”
“I hope he won’t disappoint me!” the young man murmured.
In Jiangbei City, this young man was none other than the Sect Leader of Qingcheng Sect—Li Yunjie!
The Qingcheng Sect had a heritage spanning hundreds of years.
Located in Jiangdong, the Qingcheng Sect.
It was said that the founding grandmaster of the Qingcheng Sect came from Jiangdong and established the sect there.
In the land of Jiangdong, the Qingcheng Sect, a sect with a long-standing heritage, was born.
Li Yunjie was a grandmaster of his generation.
When he was young, his father passed away, and at the age of eight, his mother died, forcing him to leave the Qingcheng Sect.
In Jiangdong City, relying on himself, he carved out a realm for himself, becoming a Martial Arts Grandmaster.
At the age of ninety, he broke through to the Qi Transformation stage and became a grandmaster of his era.
Afterward, he stepped into the Martial Arts World, swept through the Martial Arts World, and eventually secured a place for himself in the Martial Arts World.
In the Martial Arts World, Li Yunjie possessed tremendous prestige.
Now, already in his fifties, he had long established a family.
However, he still hadn’t given up on seeking the pinnacle of martial arts.
Tonight, upon learning that Lin Yi had appeared, he decided to head to Jinhu Town to cut down Lin Yi.
At the same time, he also planned to take the treasures on Lin Yi.
He believed that these treasures were sufficient to enable him to assault the Innate Realm.
“Lin Yi, you’d better not disappoint me, or you will regret it!”
Li Yunjie’s eyes flashed with a bloodthirsty murderous intent.
“I must kill you!” he growled lowly, and with a leap, Li Yunjie jumped out of the window, his body soaring as he leapt from the building, rushing towards Jinhu Town.
…..
Jinhu Town.
Lin Yi walked out of the room.
He looked up at the sky.
“In the heavens, are there Immortals?” Lin Yi gazed up at the night sky.
He was filled with a multitude of feelings.
The path of martial arts was long and arduous.
Yet, Lin Yi was not afraid.
“If one can reach the ultimate in martial arts, why should there be fear?” Lin Yi mused quietly.
The path of martial arts became ever more difficult the further one traveled.
But Lin Yi did not shrink back.
Because martial arts was the only path that could change his destiny!
“Huff~~”
Taking a deep breath, Lin Yi stepped forward, walking towards the distance.
…..
Inside a villa in Jinhu Town.
Thump thump…
A series of urgent knocks sounded at the door.
“Who is it? I’m sleeping, let’s talk tomorrow,” a lazy voice sounded from inside the room.
“Hurry up and open the door!” an anxious voice called from outside the door.
“Get lost, I’m having a good time right now, who let you come and ruin my fun?” the irritated voice responded.
“Young Master, it’s really too dangerous, Lin Yi has already left the Yunxiao Sect,” outside, a man in black’s expression changed slightly as he urgently said, “Hurry up and get dressed, follow me, or you’ll die in here!”
“Humph, afraid of dying, then why practice martial arts at all?” a cold rebuke came from inside the room.
“Young Master, listen to me, this Lin Yi is not a simple man, once you fall into his hands, he will certainly kill you.”
The man in black outside the door was full of anxiousness.
“Young Master, please hurry and follow me!”
“Leave?” the person inside the house said impatiently, “Do you think he can kill me?”
“Ah, Young Master, Lin Yi’s strength is truly unmatched, even Lin Tian died by his hand. You absolutely cannot take this lightly,” the man in black urged anxiously.
“Heh, I, Lin Tian, a proud Qi Transformation Early Stage Martial Artist, would I fear him?” Lin Tian scoffed coldly, “I’m telling you, if you dare to prattle on, I’ll straight up slaughter you!”
His eyes glinted with a sinister and bone-chilling intent.
“Ah, if that’s the case, then I have nothing more to say,” the man in black sighed lightly, “It’s just a pity for the Young Master to have provoked such a ruthless person.”
“Enough, get lost quickly, and remember, you owe me a favor,” Lin Tian said coldly.
“Heh, rest assured, Young Master, I will keep this kindness in my heart,” the man in black chuckled, then turned and left.
“Lin Yi, I, Lin Tian, am destined to be the king of the Martial Arts World. If you dare to obstruct my path, then I will make your life worse than death!” Lin Tian’s eyes flickered with a dangerous light as he watched the departing man in black.
“Haha, this time, I really want to see how you’re going to make my life worse than death.”
…
“Hm?” Suddenly, Lin Yi’s eyebrows shot up.
Whoosh whoosh!
In that moment, he tapped his toes on the ground, executed the Wind Thunder Step, and vanished from his original position in an instant.
“Seeking death!” Instantly, Lin Tian’s eyes flickered with a ghostly light, “You can’t escape!”
“Whoosh whoosh!”
He leaped from the windowsill and executed a set of Fist Technique, speeding towards the distance, as fast as an ordinary person running at full speed, without any difference.
This Lin Tian was indeed a high-level master of the Qi Transformation Level.
….
In the villa that Lin Tian had left, a young man in white was lying on the couch, with two beautiful women kneeling on the ground beside him.
One was Li Qianwen, and the other was Chen Qianxue.
“Young Master, what should we do now?” the two women asked coquettishly, obviously, they were mistresses or something similar kept by the young man.
“Heh, no need to worry,” the young man said with a slight smile, “That Lin Tian is not someone easy to handle. Over the years, countless Martial Artists have died at his hands. If he wants to kill someone, it’s a cinch. Just serve me well.”
“Young Master is handsome and strong. In the future, you’ll be a Martial Arts Grandmaster!” Hearing this, the two women quickly flattered him.
“Heh, Martial Arts Grandmaster? In the future, I will flatten the entire Martial Arts World of Huaxia!” the young man said squinting, “I want to become the Martial Saint mentioned in the ancient texts of Hua Country!”
He was bursting with ambition, aiming to be the emperor of the Martial Arts World!
“My goal is not just that, I aim to dominate the entire world!” the young man continued.
“My goal is to have my son command millions of troops and subjugate the whole world to me,” the young man declared audaciously.
“My son, commanding the world?” On hearing this, both women showed a look of astonishment, their hearts filled with shock.
“Young Master really is extraordinary!” the two women admired in unison.
“Heh, all you need to do is what I’ve told you!” the young man laughed.
“Please give your orders, Young Master,” the two women said respectfully.
“Just keep me entertained, and when I get tired of you, you can leave,” the young man stated indifferently.
“Yes!” The two women’s hearts trembled, but they did not dare to retort, simply obediently acquiescing.
“Heh, not bad,” the young man let out a strange chuckle, then closed his eyes.
……………..
After leaving the hotel, Lin Yi headed to Golden Bay Park.
Golden Bay Park, famous in the Golden Sea region, was a tourist hotspot.
“Lin Yi, brother, do you think we’ll encounter Ling Zhensheng this time?” On a stone path in the park, Shen Xin hopped and skipped like a lively child.
“Ling Zhensheng, is he very impressive?” Lin Yi touched his nose, somewhat puzzled.
“Hehe, Ling Zhensheng is the big shot of the Golden Sea region. With a single stomp, the whole region trembles!” Shen Xin said with a playful smile, mentioning Ling Zhensheng.
“Is that so?” Hearing this, Lin Yi frowned slightly, “In that case, let’s use him as our first target.”
Ling Zhensheng must be eliminated; otherwise, he would become a threat sooner or later.
“Eh, isn’t that our dear Xin?”
Just then, a familiar voice came from up ahead.

chapters.title: Chapter 722 - 722 722 I Guarantee You Will Regret It
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 722: Chapter 722: I Guarantee You Will Regret It Chapter 722: Chapter 722: I Guarantee You Will Regret It A group of people approached from the front, led by a burly young man.
“Lin Yuhao?” Shen Xin’s brows furrowed, recognizing the thug from the Golden Sea area.
“Hehe, little Xin, you seem to be living quite well lately,” Lin Yuhao grinned, “Just look at you, all decked out in jewels. I’m really envious,” he said.
Lin Yuhao stared at Shen Xin’s prominent chest, unable to resist licking his lips, looking as if he wanted to pounce on her and devour her.
“Ptui, you lecher!” Shen Xin’s pretty face blushed with shame as she glared at Lin Yuhao and grabbed Lin Yi’s hand, attempting to leave.
“You think you can leave?” Lin Yuhao sneered, waving his hand, and several of his lackeys immediately intercepted them.
“What are you doing?” Lin Yi said in a deep voice.
“What do I want to do?” Lin Yuhao sneered, “You’ll find out what I want to do.”
“If you dare to touch me, I guarantee you’ll regret it,” Lin Yi stated coolly, his eyes as icy as a drawn sword.
“I’ll regret it?” Lin Yuhao scoffed, “And what are you exactly?”
“Lin Yuhao, don’t forget, my dad’s got my back. If he finds out you’ve been bullying me like this, he’ll definitely take care of you!” Shen Xin retorted angrily.
“Oh, is that so? Then I’ll make sure he can’t deal with me. I’ll make him personally admit that you seduced my brother,” Lin Yuhao replied with a faint smile, then his gaze swept over the onlookers, “Did everyone hear that clearly? If anyone dares to spread rumors, I’ll make them regret it!”
Whoosh~~
Instantly, the bystanders who were passing by hurriedly retreated, afraid of being caught in the middle.
“Miss…” Li Qianxue and Chen Qianxue, standing by, hesitated to speak.
“Hmph, my dad will handle this matter,” Shen Xin muttered.
“Hehe, Ling Zhensheng, oh Ling Zhensheng, you should have never hurt my son, let alone cause him to lose an arm. How could I, Lin Yuhao, spare you?” Lin Yuhao murmured.
Lin Yuhao once was a profligate as well, but later his father sorted everything out for him.
His father, the president of Lin Corporation, had a formidable background, and naturally, nobody dared to meddle with him.
“Kid, I’ve heard you’re pretty arrogant. Today, I’m going to see just how arrogant you can be,” Lin Yuhao’s lips curled into a cruel smile.
“Swoosh!”
Lin Yuhao pulled out a dagger and stabbed at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi, expressionless, faced the attack head-on.
Clang!
Lin Yi caught the dagger with his bare hands, and with a fierce tug, snatched it away.
Swish!
The next moment, Lin Yi lifted his leg and kicked Lin Yuhao’s abdomen.
Bang~~
With that kick to the stomach, Lin Yuhao was sent flying.
Splurt!
Falling to the ground, he spat out a mouthful of blood, his face contorted in pain.
This Lin Yi, he had defeated him in just one move.
“How is this possible?” Lin Yuhao couldn’t believe it. “How did he become so powerful?”
He was an early-stage Martial Artist, yet he lost to Lin Yi; he couldn’t believe this was true.
“A moment ago, you mentioned making someone regret. Now, it’s your turn to regret,” Lin Yi said as he walked slowly toward Lin Yuhao, his eyes dark and deep like a cold pond.
“You…” Lin Yuhao’s pupils shrank suddenly, and that look in Lin Yi’s eyes filled him with fear.
“Bang.”
In the next instant, Lin Yuhao lay beneath Lin Yi’s foot.
Crack!
A sound of breaking bones echoed as Lin Yi’s foot forcefully ground down.
“No… don’t kill me!” Lin Yuhao screamed in agony, realizing Lin Yi’s intentions.
“You just wanted to kill me a moment ago, didn’t you?” Lin Yi said indifferently, and then, with a horizontal sweep of his right leg, he struck Lin Yuhao’s neck.
Snap!
An immense force hit, rendering Lin Yuhao unconscious in an instant.
Looking at the unconscious Lin Yuhao, Lin Yi shook his head, “Such a waste doesn’t deserve to live.”
With that, Lin Yi turned and left.
…
“Xin girl, come eat with us, my parents want to meet you too,” someone suggested.
“No need, my boyfriend has come to find me, I’m going home.”
“Alright, remember to keep in touch.”
“I will.”
Shen Xin smiled sweetly, hugged Lin Yi’s arm, and ran ahead.
Watching the two figures disappearing into the distance, Lin YuHao’s eyes darkened with malice, “You bitch, I will make you regret this!”
After saying that, he took out his phone and dialed a number.
“Hello, Uncle Lin, this is Lin Yuhao!” Lin Yuhao’s face twisted with fury, “I want revenge against Ling Zhensheng, his daughter stole my fiancée and also caused me to lose a finger!”
“Haha, Yuhao, don’t worry, I will absolutely make the Shen Family bankrupt!” a deep voice responded from the other end of the phone.
After hanging up, Lin Yuhao sneered, “Ling Zhensheng, you pathetic man, you actually raised such a daughter!”
Having said that, Lin Yuhao sneered again, “I hope you don’t beg me. If you beg, I might consider sparing the Shen Family!”
“But if you refuse, heh heh…”
With that, Lin Yuhao ended the call.
…
On the other side.
Shen Xin pulled Lin Yi into the car and then started it up, speeding away.
Lin Yi did not stop her.
Although Shen Xin was willful, she was ultimately a kind-hearted girl.
“Phew, finally shook him off,” Shen Xin breathed a sigh of relief.
“Are those people your classmates?” Lin Yi inquired.
“Yeah,” Shen Xin nodded.
“It seems like they don’t welcome me very much,” Lin Yi said, shrugging his shoulders.
“That Lin Yuhao is really annoying, acting all high and mighty just because his dad is the chairman of Lin Corporation. We children from ordinary families should listen to him,” Shen Xin huffed lightly.
“I see,” Lin Yi simply nodded.
“Hmph, but we don’t have to be afraid. Once you successfully get into Nanyang University, we won’t have to act according to his whims,” Shen Xin pouted.
“Heh, that’s true,” Lin Yi nodded in agreement.
Shen Xin puckered her lips, her face full of grievance, and she swore to herself that she would never marry that Lin Yuhao.
“However, Lin Yi, let me tell you something, Lin Yuhao’s father is a member of the underworld,” Shen Xin suddenly said.
“What, the underworld?” Lin Yi raised an eyebrow.
“Yes, Lin Yuhao’s father is named Lin Qiang, and it’s said that his influence is vast,” Shen Xin confirmed with a nod.
“Heh, Lin Qiang?” Lin Yi cracked a smile, “I’ll remember him. Sooner or later, I’ll make him pay!”
“Yeah,” Shen Xin obediently nodded, then added, “But I think it’s best if you run for your life. Otherwise, if you offend him, you’ll certainly face a disaster.”
“Heh, run for my life?” Lin Yi smiled faintly then took out his phone and dialed a series of numbers.
Ding-a-ling-a-ling…
Soon, a lazy voice came from the other end, “Hello, who is it?”
“Wang Pengcheng, it’s Lin Yi!” Lin Yi squinted, “Where are you right now?”
“Lin Yi? Why would you suddenly call me?” Wang Pengcheng was obviously excited upon hearing Lin Yi’s voice, as Lin Yi had once saved him.
“I’m at the entrance of Jiang City Hotel, are you free to meet me?” Lin Yi asked.
“Free, totally free!” Wang Pengcheng quickly promised and then, as if he remembered something, said, “I’ll be right there.”
“Alright.” After speaking, Lin Yi ended the call.

chapters.title: Chapter 723 - 723 723 A Sense of Unexplained Loss in My
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 723: Chapter 723: A Sense of Unexplained Loss in My Heart Chapter 723: Chapter 723: A Sense of Unexplained Loss in My Heart “Are you and Wang Pengcheng close?” Shen Xin asked. “Why haven’t I heard about it?”
“We were college roommates,” Lin Yi explained. “He liked to party and often didn’t return at night, but every time he came back, he would bring a bunch of gifts and share the good stuff with me.”
“Oh.” Shen Xin nodded slightly, feeling a sense of loss in her heart.
She had met Wang Pengcheng in college, and back then, Shen Xin liked him, but Wang Pengcheng was a playboy who never actively pursued girls; instead, it was Shen Xin who chased after him.
Shen Xin felt that Wang Pengcheng liked her too, but their romance was obstructed by Wang Pengcheng’s parents.
Latter, Shen Xin dropped out of school, and she and Wang Pengcheng gradually drifted apart.
Shen Xin had always thought that Wang Pengcheng had forgotten about her, but to her surprise, that evening, Wang Pengcheng actually called her, and his tone was so polite.
“Is he deceiving me?” Shen Xin was apprehensive.
“I don’t want to miss this opportunity; I must give it a try!” Shen Xin clenched her fist.
Soon, Shen Xin drove to the entrance of Jiang City Hotel.
“We’re here, hurry and get down!” Shen Xin parked the car and rushed out.
“I’ll take you upstairs.” Lin Yi followed Shen Xin up the stairs.
Arriving at room 302, Shen Xin pushed the door and entered.
Inside the room, Wang Pengcheng was lying on the bed with a glamorous and beautiful woman beside him.
Upon Shen Xin’s entrance, the glamorous woman glanced at her, then spoke coquettishly: “Honey, there’s a beauty here.”
Shen Xin’s face turned red.
“Ahem, this is Shen Xin,” Wang Pengcheng coughed twice to introduce. “Xin Xin, this is my wife Chen Xue, you can just call her sister-in-law.”
“Um, hello sister-in-law,” Shen Xin said with a hint of shyness.
Chen Xue rolled her eyes and said, “Hubby, aren’t you going to introduce me to this handsome young man?”
“Him?” Wang Pengcheng glanced at Lin Yi and said indifferently, “A friend of mine.”
“Friend?” Chen Xue frowned.
“Yeah,” Wang Pengcheng nodded, “Xin Xin, she’s my girlfriend, Chen Xue. You two take care of each other in the future.”
“Girlfriend?” Shen Xin widened her eyes. “Wang Pengcheng, you actually have a girlfriend!”
“Oh Xin Xin, why so excited? Are you unhappy that I have a girlfriend?” Wang Pengcheng quirked his mouth.
“No… it’s not like that,” Shen Xin’s pretty face blushed even more.
“Alright, alright, I was just teasing you, look how scared you got, I was just joking,” Wang Pengcheng patted Shen Xin’s head. “Xin Xin, you go back and rest first, I’ll have a chat with my girlfriend.”
Biting her lip, Shen Xin puffed up her cheeks: “Were you really just teasing me?”
“Silly girl, you’re so cute, why would I tease you?” Wang Pengcheng ruffled Shen Xin’s hair.
Shen Xin muttered, “Okay then, I’ll treat you to dinner tomorrow since it’s the weekend.”
“Sure.”
“Bye!” Shen Xin waved her hand and turned to leave.
Stepping out of the hotel lobby, Shen Xin couldn’t help but take a deep breath; the scene just now made her feel dazed.
“Sigh, could I really be falling in love?”
…
“Young man, what do you want from me?” Shen Xin approached the Jiang City Hotel and knocked on room 303’s door.
Thud!
The door was forcefully opened from the inside, and then Lin Yi’s handsome, delicate face came into Shen Xin’s view.
Lin Yi was dressed in a white garment; his eyes, dark as ink, sparkled, and a wicked smile was drawn on his lips.
“You’re here.” Lin Yi took hold of Shen Xin’s soft, boneless hand and slowly walked toward the sofa to sit down.
“I’m a bit nervous,” Shen Xin bit her red lip, her cheeks flushed.
“Nervous? Why?” Lin Yi turned to look at her.
Shen Xin twisted uneasily and shook her head, “I don’t know, I just feel very nervous.”
Lin Yi laughed, “Since that’s the case, why did you dare to come find me? Aren’t you afraid I’ll eat you up?”
“Then eat me up.” Shen Xin smiled sweetly.
“Pfft—” Lin Yi chuckled as he lightly pinched Shen Xin’s nose, “I’m not a wolf.”
“Hee hee.” Shen Xin playfully stuck out her tongue, “You are a big bad wolf!”
“Hahaha…” Lin Yi laughed out loud, “If you say so, then sure!”
“By the way, why did you come looking for me?” Shen Xin blinked her eyes repeatedly.
“I want you to act with me,” Lin Yi said after pondering for a moment.
“Acting?” Shen Xin tilted her head and thought for a while, “You’re not planning to use me to lure some guy, are you?”
“It’s not about luring anyone; I really have something serious I want to ask for your help with!” Lin Yi said earnestly.
Shen Xin looked at Lin Yi with suspicion and, after a long pause, finally said, “What are you up to?”
“I want you to pretend to be my girlfriend,” Lin Yi said.
“Pretend to be boyfriend and girlfriend?” Shen Xin was stunned, “Aren’t you afraid people will misunderstand?”
“Don’t worry, they won’t misunderstand,” Lin Yi confidently said, “You just need to agree to it.”
“Aren’t you afraid this will put us both in an awkward situation?” Shen Xin furrowed her brows. She was a simple and kind girl and didn’t think too much about it, just felt that Wang Pengcheng’s actions were too childish.
“Don’t worry, I have a plan,” Lin Yi said with an easy smile, “You don’t need to worry about that.”
“What plan could you possibly have?” Shen Xin still frowned.
“You’ll know once you agree.”
“Alright then,” Shen Xin hesitated for a few seconds before nodding firmly, “I agree!”
“Hehe, that’s right, you’re truly my good sister,” Lin Yi said, satisfied as he patted Shen Xin’s head.
“Hey!” Shen Xin exclaimed with a yelp, dodging Lin Yi’s hand.
Wang Pengcheng stood up, “Alright, let’s go back then.”
“Don’t rush, you tell me first, what’s it all about?” Lin Yi asked.
“It’s nothing,” Wang Pengcheng waved his hand dismissively, “My mom wants me to take Chen Xue abroad for a trip to unwind and by the way, go on a honeymoon. I don’t want to go, but she is insisting, so I have no choice but to take you with me.”
“Oh, I see,” Lin Yi nodded slightly.
“By the way, you’re not tricking me, are you?” Shen Xin asked, “If Auntie finds out you lied to her, she definitely won’t let you off easily.”
“No, I won’t, don’t worry, I definitely won’t,” Wang Pengcheng vowed earnestly, “I could deceive anyone but not you!”
Shen Xin pursed her lips and nodded, “Alright then, let’s go back.”
“I’ll take you back,” Wang Pengcheng said, grabbing Shen Xin’s slender wrist and walking towards the exit.
“Give me your room card,” Lin Yi suddenly said.
“What?”
“My room card, I’m staying at this hotel and need to get it now,” Lin Yi shrugged.
Wang Pengcheng paused for a moment, then handed over the room card to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi took the card and walked into the hotel with Shen Xin.
“Why are you staying at a hotel?” Shen Xin was surprised, “My parents wanted us to go traveling.”
“Why stay at a hotel if we’re not traveling?” Lin Yi said with a faint smile.
Shen Xin blinked, feeling that something was off.
“Are you trying to pursue me?” Shen Xin suddenly asked.
Lin Yi paused, then laughed, “You’re overthinking it, I’m not that free.”
“Hmph, just keep pretending, who cares!” Shen Xin pouted.
“If you don’t believe me, so be it.”
Lin Yi headed straight for the elevator, and Shen Xin followed, muttering, “Stinking rascal!”
Ding dong—

chapters.title: Chapter 724 - 724 724 Cant Be Bothered with Him
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 724: Chapter 724: Can’t Be Bothered with Him Chapter 724: Chapter 724: Can’t Be Bothered with Him The elevator arrived, and Lin Yi stepped inside.
Shen Xin lifted her foot and followed in.
“Hey, don’t you need to change your clothes?” Shen Xin asked, puzzled.
“I’m not going to a banquet, so why change clothes?” Lin Yi shrugged.
Shen Xin was speechless and couldn’t be bothered with him, so she walked to another elevator.
The two took the elevator to the top floor, where Lin Yi swiped his card to enter the room and then closed the door behind them.
Click—
As the door closed, Lin Yi didn’t hear the sound of the lock; instead, he heard Shen Xin’s low exclamation behind him, “What are you doing?”
Lin Yi turned around to see Shen Xin had already stripped off her clothes, revealing her fair and luminous skin, with her chest rising high—her proud curves sparked endless fantasies.
“Hey, little Xin, what are you doing?” Lin Yi asked with a smile.
“Don’t mess around, I’m still an underage girl, you can’t do bad things to me!” Shen Xin warned, staring at Lin Yi.
“Uh…” Lin Yi was at a loss for words and then burst into laughter, “Little Xin, the way you’re talking, aren’t you an underage girl?”
“Of course!” Shen Xin lifted her chest, “I’m in my senior year of high school! I’ll be an adult soon.”
“So tell me, what will you do after you become an adult?” Lin Yi raised an eyebrow.
Shen Xin’s pretty face blushed slightly as she glared at Lin Yi and said shyly, “Of course, I’ll marry you!”
Lin Yi was taken aback, and then he laughed, “That seems about right, grow up fast then.”
“Annoying,” Shen Xin said with annoyance.
“See, you’re an adult now, aren’t you?” Lin Yi said.
“But you’re five years older than me,” Shen Xin pouted.
“What’s the problem with that? We’re going to get married anyway; it’s just a matter of time,” he replied.
“Hmph, how slick you are,” Shen Xin stamped her foot lightly, “And you should hurry up and take a shower.”
“Shower?” Lin Yi raised an eyebrow, “Are you sure you want me to take a shower?”
Shen Xin’s cheeks turned red, and she glared at Lin Yi fiercely: “Hurry up!”
“Alright,” Lin Yi shrugged and smiled, walking into the bathroom.
Watching Lin Yi enter the bathroom, Shen Xin quietly patted her hot cheeks: “Oh my, how embarrassing, how could I say such things… I’m so ashamed…”
Shen Xin covered her face; although she was usually bold and brazen, she had never been in a relationship, and her outburst was truly crazy.
“Ah, what am I thinking? That jerk, it can’t be him,” she muttered to herself.
“How could he possibly be my deskmate? Impossible.”
“Uh… No, that’s not right. I must have been drunk; otherwise, I wouldn’t have said those things,” Shen Xin shook her head vigorously.
“Forget it, I’m not going to think about it. Sleep, and we’ll talk tomorrow,” Shen Xin decided and rolled over in bed, closing her eyes soon after.
Lin Yi finished washing up in the bathroom, got dressed, and came out neatly.
“Are you done showering?” Shen Xin opened her eyes to look at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi scanned the surroundings and nodded, “Yeah, ready to go.”
“Let’s go,” Lin Yi walked over.
The two left the elevator, and Shen Xin linked arms with Lin Yi as they departed the hotel.
“Where do you live?” Lin Yi asked as they walked.
“What do you think?” she teased.
“Hmm, probably a guesthouse near the hotel, I guess.”
“Guesthouse?” Shen Xin sneered, “I wouldn’t stay in a guesthouse with you, you pervert.”
“You girl, what nonsense are you talking about?” he said.
“Look at your eyes, they’re practically glowing green.” Shen Xin said with disdain, “All you can think about is nonsense, shameless!”
“You…” Lin Yi was at a loss for words, this girl’s tongue was getting sharper, she was nothing like a girl.
“Alright, alright, I’ll stop teasing you. Let me take you somewhere.” Shen Xin said with a giggle, “There’s a big supermarket not far from here, I’m going to buy groceries.”
“Oh? To the supermarket, aren’t you tired?” Lin Yi shook his head, “Forget it, I’ll take you out to eat instead.”
“How could going to the supermarket be tiring?” Shen Xin retorted.
Lin Yi shrugged and said nothing, allowing Shen Xin to pull him along downstairs.
“By the way, how do you know Uncle Wang? Why would he come to you?” Shen Xin asked curiously.
“Uh, it’s a long story. Let’s not talk about it, let’s go, to buy groceries.”
Lin Yi took Shen Xin around the supermarket for half an hour before they finally picked everything out, and after paying, they drove to another nearby supermarket.
Shen Xin’s personality was completely different from that of her parents. She chattered away with Lin Yi the whole way, with Lin Yi occasionally chiming in. The atmosphere was actually quite harmonious.
“Lin Yi, what does your family do?” Shen Xin asked, tilting her head.
“Ling Corporation, my dad is the chairman of Ling Corporation. You’ve heard of it, right?”
Shen Xin thoughtfully said, “So you’re the young master of Ling Corporation, no wonder. But, you haven’t graduated yet? How come you’re already working?”
“Heh, it’s arranged by my dad, I had no choice.”
“Oh.”
“By the way, how about we get engaged when I graduate, okay?” Shen Xin suddenly leaned in close.
“Cough cough cough…” Lin Yi almost choked, “Cough cough cough, no rush, let’s consider it slowly.”
“You really drag your feet.” Shen Xin wrinkled her nose, “If you don’t agree, I’ll tell my dad.”
“You wouldn’t dare!”
“Just try me~”
Amidst their bickering, Lin Yi and Shen Xin arrived inside the supermarket.
Shen Xin pushed the shopping cart, chatting and laughing with Lin Yi as she diligently picked out vegetables.
“What would you like to eat?” Shen Xin turned to ask.
“Um, you pick for me.” Lin Yi said.
“Sure.” Shen Xin smiled sweetly and began to choose, quickly finishing up. Lin Yi carried the groceries and walked to the cashier.
“Sir, that will be one thousand in total,” the cashier said politely.
Lin Yi nodded, paid, and prepared to leave with Shen Xin.
Just as Shen Xin was about to reach for the receipt, a man and a woman suddenly rushed over and blocked her way. Both of them had fervent looks in their eyes, especially the man, whose gaze was filled with greed for Shen Xin, as if he wanted to leap on her and carry her away immediately.
