Shen Xin’s brows furrowed: “Are you sick?”
“Yo, little sister, you’ve got quite the temper. My name is Zhang Wei, and this is my girlfriend, Zhao Mengxin.” The young man introduced with a smile.
“Move aside, you’re blocking my way,” Shen Xin said coldly.
“Hey, don’t be so heartless. We know each other, let me treat you to a meal,” Zhang Wei said with a grin.
“I’m not interested.” Shen Xin glanced at the tattoo on Zhang Wei’s arm with disgust. It was horrendous, still smeared with blood, apparently fresh.
“You have to be interested today, you must accompany me or I’ll make you regret it!” Zhang Wei threatened, reaching out to grab Shen Xin’s waist.
Shen Xin frowned beautifully, slapping Zhang Wei’s face with a resounding smack that left him stunned, holding his face, eyes wide staring at Shen Xin: “You bitch, I’m going to kill you today!” He raised his hand to slap Shen Xin.
Shen Xin was startled and hastily dodged.
Bang!
A hand firmly caught Zhang Wei’s wrist, holding his hand in mid-air.
Zhang Wei looked up to meet a slightly sinister but handsome face, with sharp eyebrows slanting toward the temples, deep and abyss-like black eyes flashing with a sharp edge, as if hiding blades within, an overwhelming aura exuding, intimidating on sight.
Zhang Wei was shocked for a moment, then struggled fiercely: “Damn it, let go of me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 725 - 725 725 Call the Police if Theres Evidence
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 725: Chapter 725: Call the Police if There’s Evidence Chapter 725: Chapter 725: Call the Police if There’s Evidence Shen Xin sighed in relief, “Lin Yi, let him go, or you’ll be in trouble.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi slowly released Zhang Wei, who furiously rubbed his wrist and glared at Shen Xin with clenched teeth before shifting his target to Lin Yi, “You little punk, just you wait, I’m going to call the cops on you right now.”
Shen Xin sneered, “If you have evidence, then call the cops!”
“You fucking whore, you think I wouldn’t dare?” Zhang Wei gritted his teeth.
Leaning lazily on the shopping cart, leg propped up, Shen Xin said, “Don’t believe me? Then you can give it a try.”
“You just wait for me!” Zhang Wei cursed and spat out a harsh threat.
“Whatever,” Shen Xin waved dismissively. “Oh, and I forgot to tell you, my family is at the Jiangzhou Military Region General Hospital. If you dare call the cops, I guarantee you’ll be beaten beyond recognition, even by your own mother.”
“Military Region General Hospital!” Zhang Wei’s pupils shrank. “You fucking whore, don’t think I’m scared of you. If you’re so tough, then don’t leave!”
Shen Xin said disdainfully, “Why would I leave? I still need to buy groceries. Plus, I have to cook for you guys.”
Zhang Wei and Zhao Mengxin exchanged glances, both seeing the shock in each other’s eyes.
“Are you working here as a domestic helper?” Zhang Wei asked.
“What about it?” Shen Xin retorted, “Even if I were selling my body, it wouldn’t be to some piece of trash like you.”
“Hahaha, this chick is spicy, I like it. Come on, let’s go eat. Tonight, I’ll take real good care of you.” With that, he grabbed Shen Xin’s wrist and dragged her out of the supermarket, pushing her into a BMW X5.
Once inside the BMW X6, Zhang Wei stroked his chin, “This little chick isn’t bad-looking at all. Hey, no matter what, I’ll sleep with her first and talk later. A pretty girl like this is hard to find.”
“Hey Qiangzi, she looks pretty decent, how are you so sure she’s not a proper lady?” Zhao Mengxin asked doubtfully.
Zhang Wei chuckled sinisterly, “One of our classmates at school is her fan. He always brags about how pure and chaste this chick is. Today, I’m going to get a taste.”
“Haha, Qiangzi is always so badass.”
“Cut the crap, and let’s get going,” Zhang Wei urged.
Shen Xin’s face turned pale with rage, “Let go of me, or I’m calling the police!”
“Call the police? Hmph, even with the cops here, I can still get you locked up!” Zhang Wei said viciously.
“If you dare touch me, I’ll castrate you!” Shen Xin trembled with fury, “If you don’t believe me, just try it. I, Shen Xin, always keep my word.”
“Aiyoyo, such a spitfire. I love girls like you. Hey, sweetheart, come with me, and I guarantee you’ll enjoy it, hahaha…” Zhang Wei burst out laughing.
A cold light flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes as he said icily, “You’d better let her go.”
“And who the hell are you?” Zhang Wei glanced at him impatiently, “Beat it, this girl is mine!”
Shivering with rage, Shen Xin shouted, “If you dare touch a single hair on my head, I’ll kill you!”
Zhang Wei was taken aback for a moment, then burst into a maniacal laugh, “Hahaha… You crazy bitch, you know killing is illegal, don’t you?”
“You’re the crazy bitch, your whole family is full of crazy bitches, all of you!” Shen Xin cursed.
“Fuck, you slut!” Annoyed and embarrassed, Zhang Wei swung his fist toward Shen Xin, wind whistling with the punch.
Lin Yi, standing by Shen Xin, lashed out with a kick, sending Zhang Wei staggering backward into a nearby trash can.
“Fuck, just wait, I’ll definitely get back at you!” Zhang Wei said viciously as he picked himself up, trash can in hand, and fled, not forgetting to yell back, “Just you watch, I’ll make sure you’ve got no place to be buried!”
“Ptui!” Shen Xin spat.
“This guy’s brain is sick, isn’t it?” Shen Xin shook her head.
“Must have been drunk,” Lin Yi said. “Let me take you home. Where do you live?”
Shen Xin pointed toward the entrance of the high-class neighborhood not far ahead: “I live here.”
“Hm, I live there too,” Lin Yi said. “It’s on my way.”
“Oh,” Shen Xin murmured softly.
They entered the elevator and Lin Yi pressed the floor number, then suddenly said, “Your parents are quite strict with you, aren’t they? You didn’t sneak out, did you?”
“How did you know?” Shen Xin was surprised.
Lin Yi chuckled lightly: “Judging by the way you dress, it looks like you sneaked out to have some fun. Your parents must be really worried.”
“I’m already twenty-four years old, and they still control me so tightly. I don’t want to deal with them,” Shen Xin muttered.
Lin Yi shook his head inwardly. Although her parents weren’t the type to favor sons over daughters, they still didn’t take girls seriously. For a rebellious girl like Shen Xin, the education from her parents could hardly be considered anything but a failure.
Ding-dong—
The elevator stopped, Shen Xin stepped out, and Lin Yi followed behind.
Just as they entered the house, they heard Shen Xin’s mother’s shrill voice coming from the living room: “You two little rascals, even learning to lie and deceive now, saying something about studying abroad. I bet you went off to chase girls!”
“Auntie, you’re mistaken. How could we possibly go chasing girls when we actually went abroad?” Zhang Wei explained. “My mom needed me for something urgent last night, so I came back early.”
Shen Xin’s mother laughed coldly: “Your mom needed you? How would I know what for, I don’t believe it!”
“If you don’t believe me, there’s nothing I can do. My mom really did need me for something. Seriously, why would I lie to you? If you don’t believe me, you can call to check up on me,” Zhang Wei said.
Shen Xin’s mother frowned, wondering why she couldn’t reach them when she called earlier. So they were taking care of business, otherwise they would have come back sooner.
Shen Xin walked into the room and rolled her eyes at her mother: “Mom, stop making wild guesses. Zhang Wei is not that kind of person.”
“You sure are defending him. What exactly is going on between you two?” Shen Xin’s mother said sternly. “The Zhang family is well-off, they own a factory, and his father is also the chairman of a company. His father’s birthday is coming up, and our family received an invitation. You have to attend.”
“Why should I go? I don’t want to!” Shen Xin said dissatisfied. “I have nothing to do with him.”
“Nothing to do with him, so why were you hugging and being so close? And you let him kiss you, something I’ve never even allowed!” Shen Xin’s mother said angrily.
“You’re talking nonsense. When did I hug and get close to him? I just pushed him away, and he took the chance to take advantage. He’s such a jerk!” Shen Xin said angrily.
Shen Xin’s mother glared at her: “You have to go, whether you want to or not. If you dare not to, your father will scold you again, and we’ll see if you dare to skip class anymore. No more skipping class.”
Shen Xin glared back at her mother, fuming.
“Still glaring at me? I’ll tell your grandparents and have them send you to dance class!” Shen Xin’s mother threatened.
“No way!” Shen Xin immediately gave in.
“No tantrums. If you keep this up, you’ll never get married,” Shen Xin’s mother said. “Stay home and practice your dancing properly these days, and stop running around. Tomorrow I’ll take you to pick out a dress. You need to dress appropriately. I can’t let you embarrass the Zhang family at his father’s birthday.”
“I don’t want to,” Shen Xin said stubbornly.
“You must go, no refusal!” Shen Xin’s mother insisted. “If you don’t, I’ll tell your father right now to beat you until you can’t stand!”
Shen Xin clenched her teeth. All these years, whenever she dared to defy her parents, her father would beat her with a belt. She had been spanked from childhood to adulthood and was utterly terrified of her father.
“Just agree to it,” Zhang Wei advised from the side. “You know what your uncle is like when he gets angry. It’ll be miserable if you upset him.”
“I’ll think about it,” Shen Xin huffed, casting a casual glance at Zhang Wei.

chapters.title: Chapter 726 - 726 726 Two People Strolling in the Mall
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 726: Chapter 726: Two People Strolling in the Mall Chapter 726: Chapter 726: Two People Strolling in the Mall “All right, I’m off to shower and change into some clothes, this old suit is too ugly—throw it out, throw it out—I’m going to buy new clothes to celebrate your birthday tonight!” Zhang Wei charged into the bedroom excitedly.
“We’re going to go shopping too,” Lin Yi said.
“Sure,” Shen Xin replied with a giggle.
The two of them headed to a nearby mall, with Shen Xin linking her arm with Lin Yi’s as they strolled leisurely through the shopping center.
“Hey, look at that store over there,” Shen Xin said, pointing to a bridal photography shop.
“Do you like that style?” Lin Yi glanced over and asked.
“No, that’s a men’s clothing store. Let’s go pick out a couple of men’s shirts,” Shen Xin suggested. “I’ll help you choose some that look really handsome!”
“Heh,” Lin Yi couldn’t help but chuckle. Did Shen Xin really still care about such things?
“What’s so funny?” Shen Xin pouted. “I’m choosing for you, to prevent some woman from running off with you!”
Lin Yi shrugged. “I don’t need clothes, you can buy whatever you want. After all, my clothes don’t need washing.”
Shen Xin blinked her big eyes. “Are you rich or something?”
“You could say that,” Lin Yi smiled lightly. “My money is enough to support me.”
“Wow, you’re amazing,” Shen Xin said admiringly. “My brother and his friends all rely on their dad’s money. Our family relies on my dad’s earnings too. Sigh, I really wish I could make my own money.”
Lin Yi simply smiled and didn’t carry on the conversation.
They continued to browse when suddenly Lin Yi’s gaze was captured by an item on a mannequin outside a display window, and his eyes brightened instantly.
“Honey…” Shen Xin tugged at Lin Yi’s arm. “Take a look at this, you should try it on.”
Lin Yi turned to look and noticed that Shen Xin was also staring at the display window, her pretty face flushed with a hint of pink, incredibly gorgeous and stunning.
In the window hung a black slim-fit short-sleeved t-shirt with three bold, flamboyantly styled characters across the chest—”Couple’s Outfit.”
“How about this one?” Shen Xin asked, pointing at the clothes in the window.
“Good,” Lin Yi said with a smile. “Let’s get this one.”
Shen Xin’s face lit up with a sweet smile as she pulled Lin Yi towards the counter.
“Excuse me, sir, miss, what can I assist you with?” The sales assistant hurried over to greet them.
“Wrap up this piece of clothing,” Shen Xin directed, pointing at the couple’s outfit.
The sales assistant paused: “I’m sorry, but this item has already been sold.”
“Sold? I don’t care, I want this one,” Shen Xin said assertively. “Hurry up and wrap it up for me, I’m in a rush.”
The sales assistant gave a wry smile: “Sorry miss, our shop doesn’t have any other sizes at the moment. Could you perhaps look at other stores?”
Shen Xin pouted and turned to leave. She really hadn’t expected the clothing to have been sold so quickly. The store was a high-end bridal shop with costly items, and it usually didn’t serve customers on a regular day. What was happening today?
“Ouch.” Walking too hastily, Shen Xin twisted her ankle, frowning in pain, “Hiss~”
“Are you okay?” Lin Yi asked with concern, squatting down to examine her injury.
Shen Xin shook her head, rubbing her ankle.
Lin Yi stood up: “Then let’s not buy it, let’s go home and rest.”
“Okay,” Shen Xin replied.
Just as she took a step to leave, she heard a familiar voice behind her.
“Wait a moment.”
Shen Xin turned around and saw Song Yuwei approaching with the white and black patterned cheongsam in hand, and alongside her was Wang Hao.
Song Yuwei looked at her with a smile: “Shen Xin, long time no see.”
Shen Xin looked at her and replied coldly: “Song Yuwei, what are you up to now?”
“It’s nothing, just came over to say hello to you,” Song Yuwei snorted lightly, passing the cheongsam to the salesclerk, “Please wrap up this dress for me.”
The salesclerk took the cheongsam and politely thanked her, “Please wait a moment.”
“Hold on a second,” Shen Xin stopped the salesclerk and said to Song Yuwei, “Since we’ve run into each other, let’s have a meal together.”
Song Yuwei conjured up a sly smile, “Sure, then I shall graciously accept the invitation.”
The group found a restaurant to dine in, and the atmosphere during the meal was actually quite harmonious. Song Yuwei kept initiating conversation with Shen Xin, who merely responded with half-hearted replies.
Shen Xin knew that Song Yuwei certainly had no good intentions, but she was unable to refuse her at the moment.
After lunch, Song Yuwei took the initiative to suggest going shopping. Lin Yi didn’t want to participate, but Song Yuwei insisted on taking the two of them along, claiming she wanted to buy them something.
Shen Xin couldn’t outstubborn Song Yuwei and finally agreed to go shopping with her.
“Take a look at these, let me know which one you like,” Song Yuwei suggested several sets of men’s clothing.
Lin Yi looked at Shen Xin helplessly, “I’m fine with any.”
“You’re a man, of course, you have to buy men’s clothing!” Song Yuwei said matter-of-factly, “Besides, with your build and demeanor, these clothes will definitely look good on you, go try them on.”
Lin Yi hesitated for a moment, then agreed.
“Then go change, we’ll wait for you outside,” Song Yuwei left with a smiling face.
Lin Yi had no choice but to undress and enter the bathroom to change his clothes.
The man in the mirror, wearing a well-fitted white shirt, had a slightly open collar revealing a sexy clavicle, and the hem was tucked neatly into his waistline, highlighting his robust and slender build.
Black casual pants hugged his long, straight legs, with his feet in a pair of pure white sneakers, making him look handsome and dashing.
This man was, without doubt, outstanding.
But looking at him, Shen Xin couldn’t help but sigh, “Sigh.”
She reached out to touch his face and murmured, “Lin Yi, why are you always so outstanding? How can I give up on you…”
Her eyes slightly reddened, suddenly, her gaze landed on the bedside table, where there was a photograph.
Shen Xin’s eyes fell upon it, and her expression changed drastically!
In the photo was a young and beautiful girl with a ponytail, delicate features, dressed in a white dress, graceful and serene.
Shen Xin’s hand trembled as she slowly moved it to the girl’s face in the picture, caressing it as tears streamed down her face.
The girl in the photograph was Shen Xin’s mother.
Shen Xin’s mother, Xu Jiahui, once was a news anchor for the A City TV station, beloved by viewers for her sweet and adorable appearance, later passing away due to illness.
Shen Xin remembered that before her mother died, she had told her to be an ordinary girl, marry an average husband, and then live a happy life.
Shen Xin fought to suppress her heartache and lifted her head to wipe away the tears at the corner of her eyes.
Song Yuwei walked into the dressing room, and upon seeing her, immediately exclaimed in surprise, “Oh, so you had reserved this outfit first.”
After speaking, she smiled at Lin Yi, “Lin Yi, I had my eye on this outfit first.”
Lin Yi frowned slightly, “Sorry, the outfit has already been given away.”
“Given away?” Song Yuwei was taken aback and then said discontentedly, “How can you do this? Although we are old classmates, it was me who liked it first! And you’ve already changed into it!”
“I said it’s already been given away,” Lin Yi patiently explained.
“No way!” Song Yuwei stubbornly insisted, “Lin Yi, I must take this outfit with me, no matter the cost, I’m willing to pay!”
After speaking, she pulled out a bank card and threw it on the table, “Charge it!”
“Sorry, the outfit has already been claimed,” Lin Yi still maintained his stance.
Song Yuwei instantly became angry, “Lin Yi, are you doing this on purpose?”
Lin Yi raised an eyebrow, “Isn’t what I’ve said clear enough?”

chapters.title: Chapter 727 - 727 727 I want to reserve this dress
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 727: Chapter 727 I want to reserve this dress! Chapter 727: Chapter 727 I want to reserve this dress! “Fine, very fine!” Song Yuwei gritted her teeth fiercely and threw the bank card onto the ground, “Here’s ten million, more than enough for you to buy three or four pairs of underwear! Now get lost, I’m taking this dress!”
“Yuwei…” Shen Xin tugged at her arm.
She really hadn’t anticipated that Song Yuwei would actually put forward ten million.
Ten million was no small sum; it was all their savings. Song Yuwei’s generosity was indeed eye-opening.
Song Yuwei shook off Shen Xin’s hand, glaring at Lin Yi with venom, as if she wished she could tear him to shreds!
This damn bastard! How dare he play her like this!
He didn’t even like the dress; he just wanted to make her spend money!
Lin Yi looked at her with indifference, showing no sign of backing down.
Shen Xin sighed, knowing that Song Yuwei was stubborn, and if she really didn’t help her pay this time, it might affect their relationship.
“Alright, I’ll pay for him,” Shen Xin nodded.
Lin Yi’s gaze grew heavier, “I’ll pay.”
Shen Xin looked up in surprise, Lin Yi never lacked money, was he really willing to pay for a dress for her?
Song Yuwei sneered, “Ha, Shen Xin, you’re actually willing to spend so much money on this pauper? Are you in love with him by any chance?”
Shen Xin pursed her lips and remained silent.
Lin Yi glanced at her briefly, then said to the salesclerk, “Go ahead and swipe the card.”
“Oh, of course.” The salesclerk quickly processed the card and handed it to him, “Sir, here is the price of the clothes, please confirm it, and if there are any issues, feel free to contact me.”
Lin Yi took the card and glanced at it casually, “No problem.”
Before he finished speaking, Song Yuwei suddenly screamed shrilly, “Lin Yi, are you crazy! Do you know who I was going to buy this dress for?”
“Who?” Lin Yi seemed not to understand her words.
Song Yuwei clenched her teeth, “Su Mengyao!”
“Oh.” Lin Yi nodded indifferently, “That’s good.”
“Good, my ass!” Song Yuwei was furious, “Don’t you know that Su Mengyao is the actress I hate the most?”
Lin Yi frowned; he stared at Song Yuwei, “Are you very close to her?”
Song Yuwei scoffed, “You think I’m like you guys, chasing stars all day, with nothing in your heads but actresses! You have no idea how cheap she is! Back in school, she seduced teachers and even hit on the director of the teaching affairs office! She’s trash! I advise you to stay away from her!”
“What nonsense are you spouting!” Lin Yi’s expression suddenly turned grim.
“I’m not talking nonsense!” Song Yuwei roared, “You think I don’t know? She’s already betrayed you once, and you’re still foolishly fond of her? Are you blind?”
Lin Yi scoffed, “Then I have to ask you, how do you know her? What is your relationship with her?”
“Us?” Song Yuwei looked at him mockingly, “You guess.”
Lin Yi couldn’t be bothered to argue with her and turned to Shen Xin, “Shen Xin, let’s go.”
“Yeah.” Shen Xin nodded, ready to leave with Lin Yi.
“Stop right there!” Song Yuwei blocked their path, “I’m warning you, if you dare leave, we can no longer be friends!”
She threatened, “Don’t forget, we’ve been desk mates since our second year of high school! If it wasn’t for my parents helping you, your family would have been kicked out of school long ago! Now you’ve grown wings and turn your back on us!”
Lin Yi looked at her calmly, “You’re right, we should indeed be grateful to your parents. Without your help, where would we have gotten the money for tuition? So, I’ve always kept this kindness in my heart. Not only me but your brother and sister too, we all remember it well.”
“Lin Yi! What do you mean by that?” Song Yuwei’s face changed drastically!
Shen Xin suddenly laughed, she hooked her arm through Lin Yi’s, “Yuwei, let’s go, these stale matters are not worth mentioning.”
Lin Yi ignored Song Yuwei and left with Shen Xin.
“You two stop!” Song Yuwei stomped her foot in anger, “Just you wait!”
As soon as Lin Yi walked out of the store, Song Yuwei blocked him at the crosswalk, obstructing their way.
She stared at Lin Yi with disdain, “Lin Yi, do you really intend to cut ties with me?”
Lin Yi nodded, his voice distant, “Yes.”
The two had grown up together, closer than siblings.
But Song Yuwei had been spoiled since childhood, and with her family’s wealth, she bullied them.
Lin Yi looked at her with contempt, “I know you like me, but I will never like you, so please, give up on me.”
“Lin Yi, you!” Song Yuwei choked, then after a moment, she suddenly stretched out her right hand and grabbed Lin Yi’s shirtfront, “Leave the stuff behind, and I’ll let you go! Otherwise…”
She threatened coldly, “Otherwise I will call someone to beat you up right now!”
Lin Yi shrugged indifferently, “Suit yourself, you’re not going to make me pay these few hundred bucks anyway.”
Song Yuwei clenched her fists, “Fine, if that’s how it is, then I’ll see you in court!”
Having said that, she turned and ran.
Lin Yi shook his head, picked up his shopping bag, and stepped outside.
Just as he reached the door, suddenly a red BMW pulled up beside him.
The window rolled down, revealing Gu Jingran’s face.
Lin Yi was startled.
“Get in.”
Gu Jingran commanded tersely.
“Oh, okay.” Lin Yi hesitated for a second before opening the passenger door and getting in.
Gu Jingran started the car, stepped on the accelerator, and sped off.
“Why are you here?” Lin Yi frowned; he certainly hadn’t noticed the car earlier.
“Came to pick up something, thought I’d give you a lift home.”
Lin Yi nodded, then fell silent, sitting quietly.
Through the rearview mirror, Gu Jingran glanced at him, “Your injury… it’s nothing serious, is it?”
His tone was full of concern.
Lin Yi replied softly, “It’s nothing.”
He might have been tongue-tied, but that didn’t mean he was a fool.
Over the years, Gu Jingran had often taken him out for meals and drinks, and he had figured out Jing Ran’s temperament: blunt on the outside but soft-hearted within. As long as he didn’t provoke him, he wasn’t the type to get angry.
“How did you know I was hurt?” Lin Yi asked in confusion.
Gu Jingran replied with a smile, “I saw you carrying things this way just now, knew you were out shopping, so I followed you over. Your clothes are all branded; that outfit must have cost at least five or six thousand, looks like you’re not doing too badly with your salary, huh!”
“…It’s alright.” Lin Yi didn’t want to explain that he had earned the money himself.
“Lin Yi, are you in some kind of trouble? If you need help, just say so. After all, I owe you one, and if you run into any trouble, it’s only right that I help.”
Lin Yi shook his head, “I don’t have any trouble.”
After Lin Yi and Shen Xin got married, Lin Yi had been working hard to earn money.
Their quality of life was low; only one meal with meat and fruit was fixed per week, and they occasionally had snacks, but never more than a hundred yuan’s worth.
It had taken Lin Yi seven or eight years to save up for this suit and leather shoes.
He had thought that with their hard work, this outfit and these shoes would last a long time.
But he hadn’t expected that at this class reunion, they would all buy new clothes, and he even took off his own pants.
Unable to help himself, Lin Yi asked, “How come you all are willing to spend money now?”

chapters.title: Chapter 728 - 728 728 Cant Let Her Spend Money For Nothing
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 728: Chapter 728: Can’t Let Her Spend Money For Nothing! Chapter 728: Chapter 728: Can’t Let Her Spend Money For Nothing! Shen Xin curled her lips, “It’s all because of your sister! She said she wanted to break off ties with you, claiming that I am the homewrecker who destroyed your relationship. Of course, I couldn’t stand for that!
You two were childhood sweethearts; how could you possibly break up because of me? I figured I couldn’t let Shen Yan benefit from this, so I also bought clothes and bags—I won’t let her exploit me for my money!”
Lin Yi chuckled, “You, you’re just too naive! Your sister won’t let this go easily.”
Shen Xin was unperturbed, “I’m not scared of her at all!”
She glanced at Lin Yi beside her and suddenly asked, “By the way, did you ‘hit porcelain’ just now?”
Lin Yi expressed surprise, “How did you know?”
“I saw it just now. You knocked over her clothes. If you don’t admit it, she will definitely seek revenge on you,” Shen Xin said with concern.
“It’s fine,” Lin Yi said coolly, “If she wants to play, I’ll play along. It’s not the first time she’s done something like this.”
Shen Xin opened her mouth to speak but then hesitated.
With a sigh, she said, “Lin Yi, you’re my good friend, and I don’t want you to be deceived.”
Lin Yi lifted the corners of his mouth, “Don’t worry, I know what I’m doing.”
His gaze landed on the window, his eyes deepening.
Just then, a harsh screeching of brakes filled the air, accompanied by the sound of tires rubbing against the ground. It seemed as though the whole city shook, prompting the people inside the car to turn their heads and look out the window.
They saw a black Mercedes sedan come to a steady stop in front of Lin Yi’s car.
The car door opened, revealing a pair of shiny men’s leather boots, followed by legs clad in a dark blue, neatly pressed suit.
The man had a tall and well-proportioned figure, standing upright, his height of around one meter ninety making him someone to look up to.
He was stunningly handsome with sharp features, thick eyebrows, starry eyes, a high nose bridge, and thin lips pressed tightly together, exuding an air of frostiness that was daunting to others.
“Damn! So handsome!” Shen Xin’s eyes widened with excitement, “He looks just like a movie star!”
Lin Yi looked up, his heart rate quickening at the sight of the man in the car; even his breathing became rapid.
His gaze locked firmly onto the man.
The man casually pocketed one hand while with the other he took out a pack of cigarettes, drawing one to his lips.
The car was soon filled with the faint smell of smoke, making Lin Yi cough and his eyes water.
“Lin Yi, what’s the matter? Why are you crying?”
Shen Xin was terrified and in her panic, she quickly pulled out some tissues to offer to Lin Yi.
But Lin Yi waved them off, “I’m fine.”
He stared intensely at Gu Jingran, his throat dry.
“Gu Jingran, what are you doing here?” Lin Yi said through clenched teeth.
Gu Jingran raised an eyebrow, “I heard you were hospitalized, so I came to see you.”
Lin Yi balled his fists, “Stop pretending! You know I’m hospitalized, so you should stay far away. Showing up in my room now, are you here to humiliate me?”
Gu Jingran’s brow furrowed slightly; he slowly blew out a ring of smoke and said at a leisurely pace, “Lin Yi, you’re my wife, how could I possibly humiliate you?”
Lin Yi was silent for a moment before he slowly spoke, “Gu Jingran, let me tell you, I don’t need this! If you’re so ashamed of my poverty, then let’s divorce!”
Gu Jingran’s eyes darkened and he scoffed, “My woman, Gu Jingran’s woman, is off-limits to others.”
His tone was forceful and domineering, brimming with oppressiveness.
Lin Yi’s hands began to tremble uncontrollably.
His gaze fixed on Gu Jingran, “What do you mean by that?”
Gu Jingran’s lips curved into a smile; he extinguished the cigarette in the trash can, “It means we need to get married. Anyone who tries to stop us is an enemy of the Gu Family!”
Lin Yi froze, “Gu Jingran, we’re already divorced.”
Gu Jingran sneered, “Lin Yi, has your brain gone funny? Who told you we’re divorced? Which eye of yours saw that we’re divorced?”
Lin Yi’s grip tightened.
Gu Jingran continued, “The divorce agreement, I tore it up a long time ago, I never signed it, our marriage still exists.”
Lin Yi’s body stiffened, and his brain went blank for a moment.
So he had been hiding this all along, probably because he feared I would cling to him!
“Since you haven’t signed, then, the divorce agreement is invalid, Mr. Gu, please destroy this agreement,” Lin Yi said indifferently.
Gu Jingran raised an eyebrow, “I’ve told you, I have already shredded and thrown away the divorce agreement. If you don’t believe me, you’re more than welcome to search my house, or the law firm.”
Hearing his words, Lin Yi was completely dumbfounded. Why would he tell him this?
Shen Xin also looked completely lost.
Gu Jingran smiled, “Lin Yi, you drafted this agreement, didn’t you?”
Lin Yi nodded, “Yes.”
Gu Jingran said with a smile, “You are my wife, we share our property. Our assets are all in the bank account, the password is 123456789, both of our household registrations, both of our IDs, are all in there, you can check whatever you want.”
Lin Yi was stunned.
He hadn’t expected Gu Jingran to be so forthright.
“You…” he hesitated.
Gu Jingran’s voice came through clearly, “Lin Yi, the news of our marriage was personally told by your parents, we are legally married, so your things should naturally be left for me to keep safe.”
Lin Yi hung his head, “My parents just mentioned it casually, you don’t have to do this.”
“Lin Yi, I don’t want to wrong you, I know you love me, otherwise you wouldn’t have married me. Rest assured, I will take care of you, and after your health is better, we can consider having children,” Gu Jingran said.
Lin Yi bit his lower lip, not wanting to be entangled with Gu Jingran any longer, so he stood up, “I’m tired, I’m going to sleep.”
Gu Jingran also stood up and reached out to grab Lin Yi’s arm, “You’re still sick, let me take you back.”
Lin Yi shook off his hand, “Gu Jingran, my fever’s gone, you can leave.”
Gu Jingran’s footsteps paused, he looked at Lin Yi, his dark and deep eyes filled with a probing gaze, “Lin Yi, I hope we can start over, I don’t mind your past, but we are not suitable.”
Lin Yi lowered his head, unwilling to argue any further.
He turned to head upstairs, but just then, Shen Yan grabbed his arm, “Brother, what are you doing? Didn’t you promise me you wouldn’t see him again? How can you go back on your word?”
Lin Yi pushed Shen Yan away and looked at her, “Xin Xin, I won’t be with him, he’s not my type.”
“No way!” Gu Jingran immediately blocked him, “Lin Yi and I are husband and wife, all his belongings should belong to me, I won’t let you get your hands on them.”
Gu Jingran was adamant, he looked at Shen Yan, “And the same goes for you, your things are mine too!”
Shen Yan was taken aback, then she flared up, “Gu Jingran, how can you be like this?”
She spoke angrily, “Lin Yi, let’s go!”
Lin Yi nodded.
The two of them turned to leave.
However, Gu Jingran suddenly reached out and grabbed Lin Yi’s arm, his voice stern, “Lin Yi, tell me the truth, why do you want to divorce me?”
Lin Yi turned his head, looking at Gu Jingran, his eyes gradually becoming gloomy. He pulled a mocking smile, “Our marriage was nothing more than a transaction, Gu Jingran, have you truly forgotten what happened between us?
We despise and loathe each other, we’ll never be together in this lifetime, Gu Jingran, please stop bothering me, otherwise, I won’t mind if both of us go down together!”
Hearing Lin Yi’s threat, Gu Jingran laughed, “Ha, you want us both to go down together? Alright, Lin Yi, try it, I am actually curious to see, in the end, what will become of us if we both get hurt!”

chapters.title: Chapter 729 - 729 729 Dont Think About Getting Rid of Me
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 729: Chapter 729 Don’t Think About Getting Rid of Me Chapter 729: Chapter 729 Don’t Think About Getting Rid of Me Lin Yi clenched his fists tightly, “Gu Jingran, you’re despicable!”
Gu Jingran let out a cold laugh and spoke, “Lin Yi, you’re wrong. I’m much nobler than you. I married you, and all I need to do is to appease Grandma and Grandpa.
As for you, in addition to marrying into a wealthy family, you also need to take on the obligation of supporting your in-laws. You can forget about getting rid of me for the rest of your life, because you owe me!”
After saying that, he turned around and left.
Lin Yi stood on the spot, utterly dumbfounded.
Indeed, he was forced into marriage by his parents. They pressured him to marry the Lin Family’s precious daughter. Although Lin Yi was rather old, he was still wealthy and, coupled with his handsome looks and manners, the Lin Family agreed to let him marry Lin Yi.
After marrying Lin Yi, she brought him no benefits, and he approached the marriage casually, so in their three years of marriage, they never consummated it.
But what Gu Jingran just said, he married him, and he would help him strive in his career?
Lin Yi was indeed very capable, and with just a bit of effort, he could quickly reach his goals.
But he was burdened with the Lin Family’s debts, and over the years, with his difficult capital turnover, Lin Yi not only did not help, but even kept finding excuses to delay.
Lin Yi couldn’t understand, with all his excellence, why Gu Jingran would rather choose an ordinary person than want him?
For many years, Lin Yi had been enduring, wanting to break free from the shackles of the Lin Family with his own efforts.
But then, Gu Jingran suddenly came and told him they were married!
He was not willing!
Why should he bear such heavy debts, fight to build a career, and not be a vassal of the Lin Family!
Seeing Lin Yi’s expression, Gu Jingran knew what he was thinking.
A sly smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
He reached out to take the divorce agreement on the table and handed it to Lin Yi, “Lin Yi, take a look, your divorce terms. I didn’t take advantage of you, I’ve prepared all these items.”
Lin Yi took it over and flipped through it—inside was indeed the property distribution after their divorce with Gu Jingran.
After the divorce, Lin Yi would leave with nothing, all his property going to Gu Jingran alone, including the house, the car, the car keys, and so on.
Looking at the content, Lin Yi felt as if his heart was being pierced by something.
He gripped the paper in his hand and looked up at Gu Jingran, “Is it just for these things?”
Gu Jingran squinted his narrow, peachy eyes.
Gu Jingran laughed, he slowly spoke, “Yes, Lin Yi, we’ll divide these things equally. Yours and mine, we’ll split them half and half, that’s fair, right?”
After saying that, he looked at Lin Yi, “Lin Yi, you can go back and pack your things now. Tomorrow morning at eight o’clock, let’s meet at the entrance of the Civil Affairs Bureau.”
Lin Yi looked at him, “Okay.”
He tore the divorce agreement into pieces and threw it into the trash can.
Lin Yi turned and strode away.
Shen Xin quickly followed after him, “Brother, where are you going? Wait for me.”
After Shen Xin followed Lin Yi out, Gu Jingran’s face darkened. He stared in the direction Lin Yi left, muttering to himself, “Lin Yi, you can’t escape.”
After Lin Yi returned home, he locked himself in his room and remained silent.
Shen Xin was extremely worried, “Brother, what happened? Why do you want to divorce?”
Lin Yi didn’t speak. In his mind flash back the words Gu Jingran had just said, his eyes turned bloodshot as if he were provoked, and he suddenly smashed his fist onto the coffee table.
The cups on the coffee table shattered instantly, glass shards piercing into his palm, blood streaming.
Shen Xin was terrified, “Brother, are you okay?”
Lin Yi shook his head, his eyes moist.
Gu Jingran, I hate you!
—-
The next day, Lin Yi went to the Civil Affairs Bureau.
He sat in the chair, his heart filled with a jumble of different feelings.
He and Gu Jingran had been married for four years, and they had never been physically intimate. He didn’t want to compromise himself, yet, he couldn’t free himself from the Lin Family.
As Lin Yi was pondering, a fragrant breeze suddenly wafted in.
Lin Yi looked up and saw Shen Xin enter in a fiery and sexy dress. She took the seat next to Lin Yi, “Dear brother, I’m late.”
“It’s okay,” Lin Yi said. “I haven’t been here long myself.”
Shen Xin smiled sweetly, “Bro, you were drunk last night, so I made you some hangover soup. After we eat, I’ll accompany you home to rest a bit.”
Lin Yi nodded.
He had initiated this divorce.
All along the way, Lin Yi kept thinking, why did he suddenly want to divorce Gu Jingran?
If it were any other man, Lin Yi might have kicked him out and walked away by now, but it just had to be Gu Jingran.
This was the first boy he had ever liked, although even now he was still somewhat unclear whether he preferred boys or girls.
But one thing he was certain of was that Gu Jingran was the only man for him in this lifetime.
……
On the other hand, Ye Li returned home and took out her phone.
She called Lin Yi’s number, but after ringing for a long time, the voice on the other end informed her the phone was switched off.
Ye Li furrowed her brows in irritation.
She took out her phone and called Ye Mucheng, “Husband, why is Yi Yi’s phone switched off?”
Ye Mucheng immediately asked, “Hasn’t Yi Yi been in touch with you?”
Ye Li shook her head, “I called him yesterday afternoon, but Yi Yi didn’t answer, and when I tried calling him this morning, I couldn’t get through.”
Ye Mucheng suddenly panicked, “Mom, Yi Yi couldn’t be in any danger, could he?”
Ye Li comforted him, “Husband, don’t worry. Our Yi Yi is extremely clever; nothing will happen to him.”
Lin Yi was the sole heir of the Lin Family; everything of the Lin Family belonged to him. Who would dare touch him?
Plus, he had a younger brother. Lin Yi’s father wouldn’t let anything happen to him either!
However, Ye Mucheng’s worry did not subside.
“Mom, should we call the police? What if Yi Yi really is in some kind of danger?” Ye Mucheng asked, anxious.
“No need!” Ye Li promptly rejected the idea.
She said, “Lin Yi has been abroad all these years, not making many acquaintances. He must be fine; we shouldn’t worry for now.”
On the divorce agreement, Lin Yi had clearly written that all his assets would go to Gu Jingran.
When they got married, Gu Jingran had reminded Lin Yi that if he wanted a divorce, he would have to follow the agreement.
If he didn’t agree, then they wouldn’t divorce.
Lin Yi had no choice; he needed money, and that money had to come from Gu Jingran.
In this way, he wouldn’t owe Gu Jingran anything.
Having figured it out, Lin Yi also breathed a sigh of relief.
He sat on the couch, straightening his clothes and taking a deep breath before walking out.
As he reached the doorway, he saw Gu Jingran’s car parked by the roadside.
Gu Jingran stepped out of the car to smoke, his head bowed, inscrutable dark eyes revealing no emotion.
He heard the footsteps and looked up at Lin Yi.
Dressed smartly in a suit, with neatly combed hair and an extremely handsome face, especially his eyes, which were like the vast starry sky.
Seeing Gu Jingran, Lin Yi’s eyes filled with anger, he glared fiercely at him, then he pulled open the passenger door and sat down.

chapters.title: Chapter 730 - 730 730 Always Keeping Oneself Pure
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 730: Chapter 730: Always Keeping Oneself Pure Chapter 730: Chapter 730: Always Keeping Oneself Pure Gu Jingran extinguished the cigarette and then moved to the driver’s seat, sitting in the car.
The car started, and Gu Jingran turned his head to look at Lin Yi, asking, “Lin Yi, what was the reason for our divorce?”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, “You tell me.”
“Heh, is it because you despised me for being older?” Gu Jingran sneered, “I know you look down on me as a person.
But you also know, I am not lacking money, nor am I short of women. We’ve been together for three years, and I have remained faithful. Do you actually suspect that I have someone on the side?”
Lin Yi scoffed, “I don’t care, in any case, our marriage is unsuitable.”
Gu Jingran nodded, “Since that’s the case, let’s go find a lawyer to handle the divorce. I will leave without taking anything with me. As for your alimony, I can reduce it by half, and you will be responsible for the remaining half.”
Lin Yi’s face turned awkward, and he snorted coldly, starting to rest with his eyes closed.
Gu Jingran drove towards the civil affairs office.
Upon arriving at the civil affairs office, it was the peak hour for work, so there were especially many people queuing to process marriage certificates.
Lin Yi sat waiting, and when he looked at his watch and the hands pointed to 8 o’clock, he finally received the marriage certificate and handed it over to the staff member.
The two of them walked out with their little red books, and Gu Jingran said, “Lin Yi, let’s get a divorce. You can choose to divorce, and our joint property belongs to both of us. You can continue living in the Lin Family house or leave; this is your right.”
Lin Yi’s hand holding the divorce certificate trembled slightly.
He bit his teeth, “Gu Jingran, I’m telling you, divorcing you is the biggest mistake I’ve ever made.”
Gu Jingran raised his lip, “Is it? Too bad I am not willing to acknowledge that. We’re destined not to be happy, so let’s get a divorce after all.”
Gu Jingran got in the car, taking Lin Yi to the bank. He withdrew money, then went nearby and bought a car.
He handed the car keys to Lin Yi, “You can drive home yourself; I have something else to do.”
Lin Yi stared at him blankly, “What are you doing?”
Gu Jingran spoke indifferently, “I have other matters to attend to.”
He drove off into the distance.
Lin Yi stood there, his fists clenched tightly, his whole body emanating a cold aura.
He would not forget how Gu Jingran signed the divorce agreement without any hesitation, and he did not even blink an eye before signing his name.
In that moment, a great sorrow surged within Lin Yi’s heart.
This marriage had ended just like that.
He and Gu Jingran were divorced, which was supposed to be a cause for celebration.
Lin Yi’s parents were very happy when they learned of this news.
They called Lin Yi back for a meal, and when he got home, his mother couldn’t wait to ask, “How did it go? Did he sign?”
Lin Yi was silent for a moment before saying, “I divorced him.”
“Oh, that’s good, that’s really good! You’re finally free!” Lin Yi’s father, Lin Yongqiang, shouted excitedly, slapping the table, “Tell me, how much money did he give you?”
Lin Yi smiled bitterly, pulled out the divorce certificate from his bag, “The divorce certificate is all set, he said he’d leave without a single penny.”
After saying that, Lin Yi turned and went into the room.
Everyone in the living room was stunned; nobody had expected this outcome.
“What is this supposed to mean? Divorce and leaving without a penny, who does he think he is, thinking the Lin Family’s money comes from the wind?” Lin Yi’s mother, Liu Cuiping, sharply scolded.
Lin Yi’s father, Lin Yongqiang, sighed, “Shut your mouth! We won’t go through with this divorce!”
“No way!” Lin Yi and Liu Cuiping said in unison.
Lin Yi then said, “Dad, does what you just said still count?”
“It counts!” Lin Yongqiang replied enthusiastically.
“Alright, then I want two million!” Lin Yi said.
Liu Cuiping’s hair stood on end in an instant,
“Have you lost your mind? Why would you give him two million?”
“I was married to him for five years, I didn’t spend a penny of the bride price, didn’t receive a penny of the betrothal gifts, I didn’t gain anything, he leaves the marriage without a single possession, I want two million, what’s wrong with that?”
Lin Yi’s father, Lin Yongqiang, glanced at Liu Cuiping,
“Are you going to give it or not? If you’re not giving it, we can get divorced right now!”
Liu Cuiping trembled with rage, pointing at Lin Yi,
“Lin Yi, you beast, why don’t you just die!”
Lin Yi looked at Liu Cuiping,
“Don’t forget, you’re living off me. With your attitude now, believe it or not, I will kick you out?”
Liu Cuiping shuddered with fear at his threat, her eyes staring hatefully at Lin Yi.
“You, you…”
But Lin Yi couldn’t be bothered with her, turning his head to Lin Yongqiang,
“Dad, what do you say, give or not?”
“Give!” Lin Yongqiang spat out the word through clenched teeth.
His wife and children were all counting on him to make money, and as the only male heir of the Lin Family, the family business would definitely go to Lin Yi in the future, so Lin Yongqiang endured the pain and made the sacrifice.
He immediately made a call, instructing the company’s finance to transfer two million to Lin Yi’s account.
Having received the two million, a sneaky grin spread across Lin Yi’s face.
He took the money and took a taxi to the hotel.
Gu Jingran had already booked a room in the hotel, lying on the bed, he looked up at the ceiling, with Gu Yunqing’s face appearing in his mind.
Over the years, although they had not consummated their marriage, Gu Jingran had always cherished Gu Yunqing, holding her dear in his heart. In his lifetime, he married only her, his care for her never changed.
However, their marriage seemed doomed to fall apart sooner or later.
He and she should perhaps have let go long ago.
…
Chapter 6 Let’s Get Divorced
Chapter 2 Let’s Get Divorced
Lin Yi arrived at the hotel and headed straight to the eighth floor, pushing the door open into the presidential suite.
Gu Jingran was lying on the bed. Hearing footsteps, he frowned and lifted his head.
“What are you here for?” Gu Jingran’s tone was cold and hard.
Lin Yi didn’t say anything, holding the divorce agreement, he placed it on the bedside table.
Gu Jingran’s pupils shrank at the sight of the divorce agreement.
This man actually dared to propose divorce to him, such audacity.
Gu Jingran looked at him coldly,
“What? You want a divorce too?”
“Gu Jingran, over the years, I have given so much to you, and now you want to throw me aside with just one sentence?”
In Lin Yi’s tone, there was despair, like that of a wounded wolf.
Gu Jingran looked at Lin Yi,
“I don’t owe you anything.”
Having said that, he reached for the divorce agreement, then tore it up and threw it into the trash can.
Watching this, Lin Yi’s eyes deepened, and suddenly, a smirk crossed his lips,
“I get it, you proposing divorce to me is a sham, wanting to get rid of me for good, right? Gu Jingran, I’m your wife, we are husband and wife, if we don’t divorce, what else can we do? You are my husband, we must divorce.”
After speaking, Lin Yi walked out.
Lin Yi took out his phone and called Gu Jingran,
“Gu Jingran, don’t think you can escape my grasp, now that we are divorced, from now on, we are even.
You can look for other women, I don’t care, but you must return my belongings to me.”
“Also, don’t think you can just dump me after the divorce. Let me tell you, if you dare to abandon me, I guarantee, I won’t let it go easily.”
After speaking, he hung up the phone.
After hanging up, Lin Yi immediately blocked Gu Jingran and then pulled out his SIM card.

chapters.title: Chapter 731 - 731 731 Sinister Gaze
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 731: Chapter 731: Sinister Gaze Chapter 731: Chapter 731: Sinister Gaze His eyes shimmered with a vicious light as he coldly said, “You all wait for me, I definitely won’t let you off.”
The next day, when Lin Yi and Lin Yongqiang went to the civil affairs bureau to process the divorce, they were denied.
Lin Yi was furious. He pulled out his ID card and household registration, “I am Lin Yi, the son of the chairman of Lin Corporation. Don’t I even qualify for a divorce?”
An employee at the civil affairs bureau spoke, “We have already checked, and you indeed do not meet the conditions for divorce.”
Lin Yi angrily questioned, “What do you mean by this? It was my mother who told you to say this, wasn’t it?”
Lin Yi’s parents were both rural villagers with no formal education, not wealthy, yet they managed to send Lin Yi to school and also had another younger son.
One could say Lin Yi’s childhood was fairly poor.
If not for them, he might have starved to death on the streets long ago.
To such ordinary people, the most valued thing was the continuation of bloodline, and, more so, they believed that a son was an investment. They placed all their hopes on Lin Yi, wishing for him to stand out.
Hence, no matter what decision Lin Yi made, his parents would always stand behind him, supporting him.
It was precisely because his parents’ support that Lin Yi was able to successfully gain admission to the best university in the capital and then stayed in the capital. He took over the Lin family’s business, which he expanded rapidly, turning it into one of Hua Country’s leading enterprises.
Over the years, his parents constantly reminded him, “Yi Yi, our family’s future relies on you. You must work hard to achieve the heights our Lin ancestors reached, so that our family can climb to the peak.”
“Yi Yi, you are the pride of our Lin family. You must press on.”
Lin Yi’s parents kept encouraging him.
But all of this was not what he wanted, a fact Lin Yi understood better than anyone else.
The Lin family was nothing but nouveau riche. If not for capitalizing on his name, they could never have joined the ranks of the wealthy nor have reached their current status.
Gu Jingran had no relation to their family, and his grandparents were also void of any sentimental feeling.
Lin Yi grew up under his grandparents’ care and knew exactly their nature.
Yet, he still chose to honor them.
He even once thought that, in the future, even if he were to marry and have children, he would not mistreat them; instead, he would give them a lot of money.
But their greed exceeded his expectations. They conspired with outsiders to deceive him, plotting to take over his company and even causing the death of his son.
Lin Yi felt a chill in his heart.
Lin Yi sat on the couch, his hands clenched tight, fingernails digging into his flesh.
He closed his eyes, struggling to suppress the sorrow within him.
At that moment, his mobile phone began to ring, a string of unfamiliar numbers lighting up the screen.
Lin Yi hesitated for a moment before pressing the answer button.
As soon as the call connected, a gentle female voice came through, “Hello, Lin Yi, it’s me.”
“Xiao Mei? What do you want?” Lin Yi asked.
Li Xiao Mei spoke up, “Lin Yi, I called you yesterday. Why didn’t you answer?”
“Oh, I was busy yesterday, didn’t hear it,” Lin Yi replied.
Li Xiao Mei sighed, “Alas, after you left yesterday, Gu Jingran dumped me. Now he has found a new love. Lin Yi, please persuade him to come back and remarry me. We are about to have our wedding soon.”
Lin Yi’s hand clenched suddenly, his lips whitening slightly, but he bit back his anger.
He said indifferently, “Xiao Mei, is he marrying you again? Congratulations.”
Li Xiao Mei spoke, “Lin Yi, stop messing around, come and find him, I beg you.”
Lin Yi was silent for a moment, “Xiao Mei, you and Gu Jingran are both divorced, why are you still clinging to him?”
Li Xiao Mei started to cry with a sense of grievance, “Lin Yi, do you despise me now? Do you no longer want to be with me? In what ways do I not measure up to you, wuu wuu…”
Lin Yi listened to the sound of crying coming from the other end of the phone, frowning, “Xiao Mei, don’t cry, okay? Whatever it is, we can talk it over slowly.”
“Lin Yi, do you despise me for being poor? After we divorce, I will leave with nothing. I’ll transfer all my shares to your account. After we split, I don’t need your support; I can take care of myself. But, I want to take the child.”
Listening to Li Xiao Mei’s assertive tone, Lin Yi sneered, “Xiao Mei, that child isn’t mine.”
“What are you talking about? How could the child not be yours?”
Lin Yi said coldly, “The child is my sister’s.”
Li Xiao Mei was completely stunned on the other end of the phone, and after a long pause, she muttered, “Lin Yi, this joke isn’t funny at all.”
“The child is clearly Gu Jingran’s. How can you lie?”
“Xiao Mei, are you insulting me? Do you think I, Lin Yi, am a fool? Whether or not the child is Gu Jingran’s, he is a grandson of the Lin Family. You despise me for being poor, huh? Fine, I’ll give you three million, and you return the child to me.”
Lin Yi said calmly.
“You… Are you really willing to spend three million to buy this child?” Li Xiao Mei asked excitedly.
Lin Yi scoffed, “Heh, do you think I lack three million? The existence of this child is a disgrace. I wish he would disappear immediately.”
“Lin Yi, I promise you, as long as you’re willing to pay three million, I will send the child away,” Li Xiao Mei’s tone became much lighter.
Lin Yi snorted coldly, “Li Xiao Mei, do you think I’ll believe you just like that? Three million? You wish.”
“I’m telling you, Li Xiao Mei, if I don’t give you money, you’ll never even think of holding on to the Lin Family’s grandson.”
“Don’t forget, the Lin Family is under my father’s control, and although my father might be old, do you really think his authority is something you can shake?”
Li Xiao Mei became frantic, “Lin Yi, how can you force me like this? How can you bully me like this? Does your conscience not hurt? Aren’t you afraid of retribution from the heavens?”
Lin Yi ridiculed unapologetically, “Retribution from the heavens? As long as I, Lin Yi, am alive, that day will never come.”
Li Xiao Mei cursed furiously over the phone, “Lin Yi, I never thought you could be such a despicable person. Do you think I have no other options if you don’t give me the money?”
“Just you wait and see.”
After saying this, Li Xiao Mei hung up the phone fiercely.
Lin Yi looked at the disconnected call, a cold expression appearing on his face.
If Li Xiao Mei dared to play her hand, then he wouldn’t hesitate to oust her from the company and replace her with an obedient secretary.
After putting down the phone, Li Xiao Mei was in a frenzy, almost like she was possessed.
She was not willing to accept this; after going through so much hardship to finally marry Lin Yi, she absolutely couldn’t let Lin Yi ruin her happy marriage.
Li Xiao Mei took a deep breath and dialed Gu Jingran’s number, “Jing Ran, let’s get married, let’s get our marriage certificate right away, I don’t want to wait any longer, I love you.”
Gu Jingran sounded very impatient, “Li Xiao Mei, I am already married, we’ve registered, I won’t marry you again. I am going to find my wife.”
After saying that, Gu Jingran hung up the phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 732 - 732 732 Dont Want to Hold Back Gu Jingran
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 732: Chapter 732: Don’t Want to Hold Back Gu Jingran Chapter 732: Chapter 732: Don’t Want to Hold Back Gu Jingran Li Xiao Mei held her cellphone and angrily smashed it against the wall.
Over the years, she had followed Gu Jingran, and he had never touched her. She was already weary of it, and now, at forty years of age, she felt old and did not want to be a burden to him anymore.
Yet, Gu Jingran had actually betrayed her. At her time of greatest difficulty, he had abandoned her.
Li Xiao Mei’s heart was filled with resentment and grievances.
Just then, the door to the room suddenly opened, and a man walked in.
“Wife, what’s wrong? Who has made you angry?”
Li Xiao Mei looked up and saw Gu Jingran standing at the doorway.
Her tears began to flow as she threw herself into Gu Jingran’s arms and said with a pitiful voice, “Jing Ran, let’s get married. I love you. In this life, I belong only to you.”
Gu Jingran patted her on the shoulder and coaxed, “Alright, baby, don’t cry.”
Li Xiao Mei wiped the tears from the corner of her eyes and said, “Jing Ran, do you know? I just ran into Lin Yi. He said I’m not worthy to be your wife and even threatened me, telling me to get out quickly. He said his heart only has room for Gu Jingran. Aside from Gu Jingran, he will not love anyone else.”
Gu Jingran’s brow furrowed in an instant, “You ran into Lin Yi just now?”
Li Xiao Mei nodded her head.
“Jing Ran, you must believe me, I’m serious about you. We’ve been together for over a decade; you’re my only man. You can’t abandon me.”
Gu Jingran comforted her, “Rest assured, how could I bear to abandon you? I will work hard to earn you a rightful status and allow you to enter Lin Corporation with your head held high.”
Li Xiao Mei broke into joyful tears, “Jing Ran, I really love you to death.”
After hanging up the phone, Gu Jingran sat on the sofa, lost in thought.
Lin Yi was his childhood sweetheart, having grown up together since they were young, and he knew Lin Yi’s temperament better than anyone.
There was something fishy about this matter.
But even if Lin Yi did deceive him, there was nothing he could do. He owed the Lin Family too much, and if he refused to get divorced, he feared Lin Yi’s father would not let him off either.
That bastard Lin Yi, to think he had calculated against him like this. He would not let it go so easily.
Gu Jingran’s eyes darkened with a vengeful light, he must have his revenge on Lin Yi!
********
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi was seized by an inexplicable sense of worry. He picked up the landline and called Wang Zhigang.
Wang Zhigang was somewhat surprised to receive the call, as Lin Yi rarely took the initiative to contact him.
He answered, “Hello?”
“Wang Zhigang, how have you been lately? I’d like to have a talk with you.”
Lin Yi’s tone was quite calm, but it contained an undisguised assertion.
“I’m quite well, but Lin Yi, what do you want to talk about?” Wang Zhigang asked.
“Are you free now? Let’s meet up and chat,” Lin Yi said.
Wang Zhigang hesitated for a moment, “Wait for me, I’ll go drive. I’ll be at your place in twenty minutes, and we can talk once we meet.”
Lin Yi gathered his belongings and carried his suitcase downstairs.
He had packed light, just clothes and toiletries.
By the time he arrived at the agreed-upon teahouse, Wang Zhigang had been waiting for quite a while.
“Lin Yi, what did you want to see me about?” Wang Zhigang immediately asked.
“First, have a cup of coffee. I’ll explain slowly,” Lin Yi poured two cups of coffee and pushed one towards Wang Zhigang, “Brother Wang, do you have some free time recently?”
Zhi Gang looked at Lin Yi with a smile, “I’ve been free recently, just tell me what you need.”
Lin Yi lifted his coffee cup and took a sip, “Let’s get a divorce. I don’t love you, you don’t love me, we’re not suitable for each other.”
“Why, is it because of the woman you love? I can help you win her back,” Wang Zhigang said.
Lin Yi shook his head, “No, I love someone else.”
The time the two of them spent together did not make Lin Yi feel love for her, perhaps because it was a short time, so Lin Yi did not have strong feelings.
Zhi Gang laughed, “Lin Yi, you’re really something. You say you’ve fallen in love with someone else, then tell me who it is? You’re not talking about your husband, are you?”
Lin Yi lowered his head and remained silent.
Zhi Gang sighed, “Ah, don’t be upset, actually your husband doesn’t like you at all.”
Lin Yi was stunned and his eyes widened, “How could he possibly not like me?”
“Do you know how many girlfriends he has had? And do you know why he doesn’t like you? What happened to his first two girlfriends, how did they die?”
Lin Yi shook his head, “I’ve never paid attention to his private life.”
Zhi Gang continued, “Your husband is a typical playboy. Before you came along, he had several girlfriends, all of whom died. So, how could he possibly not scorn you?”
Lin Yi stopped talking.
He knew that Gu Jingran lived a life of dissipation, but he did not know how his girlfriends had died.
His mind was flooded with images of Gu Jingran embracing other women.
Lin Yi’s hand holding the coffee cup grew tighter.
Zhi Gang sighed, “Lin Yi, you should really listen to me, divorce your husband. You’re not worth his love like this. Since you’ve decided to be with me, you should consider me too. I don’t have a stable job yet, my parents depend on me, and with me, you at least won’t have to worry about food and clothes.”
Lin Yi glared at Wang Zhigang with gritted teeth and scoffed, “Let me tell you, Lin Yi would rather starve than be with you!”
Zhi Gang’s face changed, “Are you sure you want to choose to be with me this way?”
“I’m sure.”
“Then I will fulfill your wish.”
…
The conversation between the two ended on a sour note.
Lin Yi returned to the hospital.
Upon seeing his return, Mother Lin immediately came up to him and asked, “Yi’er, did your talk with your wife break down?”
“Mom, no, I agreed to divorce her,” Lin Yi answered.
Upon hearing that her son was finally willing to divorce, Mother Lin breathed a sigh of relief and said, “Then did you tell him?”
Lin Yi nodded, “I did, and he will come to me with the divorce agreement tomorrow, but I want to ask you, if we divorce, what will happen to the child?”
Mother Lin sighed, “Yi’er, don’t blame your mother for being heartless. Your father is lying on the bed, his life hanging by a thread. If you don’t gather the money soon, there’s no solution for the medical expenses, and your father will die.”
Lin Yi looked at Lin Guodong on the hospital bed, who was now unconscious, his body full of tubes.
Lin Yi’s eyes reddened.
He walked over, touched Lin Guodong’s forehead, he was burning up, his lips pale.
Lin Yi’s hands trembled as he reached out and caressed Lin Guodong’s cheek, “Dad, you always taught me to be a dutiful child. You said that as long as I took good care of you, we could live happily. Dad, I beg you to wake up, don’t leave me alone.”
Lin Yi was in agony, whispering over and over, “Dad, please wake up, I really don’t want to divorce you.”
Suddenly, the door of the ward was pushed open.

chapters.title: Chapter 733 - 733 733 Resignation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 733: Chapter 733 Resignation Chapter 733: Chapter 733 Resignation Lin Yi lifted his head, not expecting to see Zhou Jingru here.
Zhou Jingru stood in the hospital room, her eyes rimmed faintly red, “Lin Yi, what are you doing here?”
“I came to resign to my father, he’s already like this, there’s nothing I can do to help if I stay. I’m preparing to marry Zhi Gang. Give us your blessing.”
Zhou Jingru choked with emotion, “I figured out long ago that you’d be with Wang Zhigang. I know I am not good enough for you, but still, I can’t bear to see you hurt.”
Lin Yi took a deep breath, “Jingru, you have a future too, you’ll meet a man better than me.”
“But I don’t know if that man will cherish me, will love me, and if he will cherish me as much as he cherishes you.”
Lin Yi’s hand suddenly grabbed the edge of the table, his gaze sweeping towards Wang Zhigang with icy coldness, “I warn you, don’t touch my wife. If you dare lay a finger on her, I will kill you!”
Wang Zhigang’s eyebrows furrowed more tightly. Lin Yi was acting like a madman!
Wang Zhigang ignored him and turned to walk outside.
Lin Yi looked out the window into the night sky, tears streaming uncontrollably down his face.
In his life, the only love he had was with Gu Jingran. Now, he was about to lose it. How could he not be heartbroken?
Wang Zhigang left the hospital, got into his car, started the engine, and drove into the night.
Lin Yi returned to his apartment.
He sat on the sofa smoking.
When he was nearly done with a pack of cigarettes, his mobile phone rang. It was a call from Zhang Xiaoqing.
“Yi, I’m at home. Can you come back and keep me company? I’m a bit scared,” Zhang Xiaoqing coaxed.
Lin Yi exhaled a puff of smoke, feeling very irritated, but for Zhang Xiaoqing’s sake, he still hurried home.
When he reached the door, he saw Zhang Xiaoqing sitting on the sofa complaining, “Yi, where have you been? I’ve not seen you all day, and I couldn’t reach you on your phone.”
“Hmm, I was on a business trip. What’s up?” Lin Yi asked.
“Our school is organizing a trip to the suburbs. Let’s go together. I don’t have anyone to go with and I don’t like going without you. Come with me,” Zhang Xiaoqing said, pouting.
“Okay, I’ll return early tomorrow morning, and I’ll bring you a gift,” Lin Yi said.
“Great, I’ll be waiting for you.”
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi went back to the bedroom, packed his clothes, and put them in his suitcase.
The next day, Lin Yi bought his plane ticket. As he was about to leave the house with his luggage, Zhou Jingru grabbed his arm.
“Yi’er, where are you going?”
“I’m going on a business trip. I made ten thousand yuan this month, and I plan to use that money to travel.”
Zhou Jingru’s tears fell as she pleaded crying, “Yi, don’t go. Your dad needs you. He’s old now, I can’t let him lie alone in the hospital.”
Lin Yi also felt a pang of sadness as he looked at his father with reluctance. His eyes were closed, as if he were asleep.
“I’m not your biological son.”
Tears streamed down from Lin Yi’s mother’s eyes, “You are, you were born to me after ten months in the womb. How can you not recognize your mother?”
“Then why don’t you recognize my dad?” Lin Yi pressed further.
“Yi, I truly love your dad, but he… he doesn’t like me,” Zhou Jingru wiped her tears and said, “He always says you’re immature and scolds you. Your dad is a good person. I know, I know, he loves you the most, but you see, we respect each other. If he doesn’t like me, I can’t force him.”
“Why doesn’t he like you? You are beautiful, have a gentle and considerate personality, and you earn your own living. Where could you find such a good wife?” Lin Yi said with agitation.
Zhou Jingru gently wiped Lin Yi’s shoulder and said, “He likes quietness, he doesn’t like my noisiness, nor does he like my family background. I just hope to live a simple life with him, but he always disagrees, saying that we are not suitable for each other.”
“If we are not suitable, does that mean we have to give up on each other? What about my dad, can you bear to leave him lying in the hospital, waiting to die?” Zhou Jingru asked.
“But he’s already beyond help now, I must leave him. If anything happens to him, I absolutely can’t live alone. He can’t be so cruel as to take away my life,” Lin Yi said.
Zhou Jingru sobbed quietly, “Then you should go, don’t worry about me, I’ll be strong, I’ll cure your dad, I believe, Heaven won’t abandon me and your dad.”
“Jingru, thank you for all your sacrifices over these years, I’m leaving now.”
Lin Yi dragged his suitcase and walked toward the door, Lin father’s voice came over, “Yi’er, wait.”
Lin Yi turned around and looked at Lin father.
Lin father struggled to sit up, his chest wrapped in bandages, having just undergone surgery, he panted heavily and said, “Yi’er, listen to me, dad knows you like Zhou Jingru. When you return from your business trip, take Zhou Jingru abroad, go to Australia for a holiday for a few days, cultivate your relationship, and don’t let down the girl’s heartfelt affection.”
Lin Yi remained silent, his gaze fixed on the floor.
Lin father caught his breath and said, “I want to eat sweet and sour fish, go buy it for me.”
“Okay,” Lin Yi took the keys from the cabinet and opened the door.
As Lin Yi walked, he dialled Gu Mo’s number.
“Hello, Gu Mo, it’s me.”
“Brother Yi, I just took a shower, do you have any instructions?” Gu Mo asked coquettishly.
Lin Yi’s throat moved, “Are you free?”
“No, I’m shooting a film, I probably won’t be back for three days.”
“Then could you buy me a portion of sweet and sour spare ribs, my dad wants to eat it,” Lin Yi said.
“Oh,” Gu Mo answered, paused, and then said, “Brother Yi, about last night…”
“Last night you were drunk, I took you home, don’t worry about it,” Lin Yi said indifferently.
Gu Mo chuckled, sighed, “What I meant was, last night, I was not cautious enough and you didn’t have a good time. I’ll make it up to you when I get back tomorrow.”
“No need, we’re just friends.”
“Brother Yi, I won’t hold you back, I will also work hard,” Gu Mo promised.
“Focus on your shooting, we’ll have chances in the future, after all, we are media workers now, going to report on social news in the future,” Lin Yi consoled.
“Brother Yi, we are friends now, let’s work hard together, I will strive to become a worthy partner for you.”
Lin Yi did not reject her, “Okay.”
He hung up the phone, went to the market to buy sweet and sour spare ribs, and picked up a few bottles of beer on his way back.
He knocked on the door, “Jingru, let’s move out and live on our own.”
“Have you really decided?” Zhou Jingru asked, puzzled.
Lin Yi nodded, placed the sweet and sour spare ribs on the table, poured the beer to the brim, lifted his glass, and raised it high, “Jingru, I toast to you. Even though you haven’t taken care of me much, I am still grateful. If you are willing to be with me, I will spend my life with you, no matter whether we are poor or rich, I will respect you, love you, protect you.”
“Do you really want to marry me?” Zhou Jingru asked expectantly.
“Yes,” Lin Yi agreed without hesitation.
“Let’s register our marriage first, and after my dad wakes up, we’ll have the wedding ceremony, okay?” Zhou Jingru pleaded.
Lin Yi shook his head and said, “I can’t let you suffer, once my dad recovers, we’ll get married.”

chapters.title: Chapter 734 - 734 734 It Will Get Better
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 734: Chapter 734: It Will Get Better Chapter 734: Chapter 734: It Will Get Better “I’m not wronged, really, I’m not wronged at all, your father will understand,” Zhou Jingru said, standing at the head of Lin Father’s bed, holding his hand.
Lin Yi looked at Zhou Jingru, her eyes were swollen red, brimming with crystalline tears.
Lin Yi’s heart trembled slightly as he spoke, “I will try my hardest to make you happy, don’t be too sad, my father will surely recover.”
Zhou Jingru nodded, “I’m not sad, I just can’t bear to part with our child.”
“Once my father wakes up, we can take the child and go abroad together,” Lin Yi said.
Zhou Jingru wiped the tears off her face, took a deep breath, and revealed a radiant smile, “Then let’s go get our marriage certificate at the civil affairs office tomorrow, followed by a hospital visit to see if my father could wake up earlier.”
Lin Yi looked at Zhou Jingru’s smile, his eyes flashing.
He knew Zhou Jingru’s purpose was nothing more than to get the money, but Lin Yi would not let go easily.
He had already lost his mother, he couldn’t lose Zhou Jingru as well.
Lin Yi wrapped his arms around Zhou Jingru’s shoulders, soothing her softly: “Jingru, don’t worry, my father will definitely wake up, we’re still young, we have a long, long time ahead of us.”
Zhou Jingru leaned into Lin Yi’s embrace, tears streaming down from the corner of her eyes.
She had never dared to dream that she could marry Lin Yi.
She only hoped that Lin Yi could find a girl who loved him and cherished him, one who would lead a simple and happy life with him.
Lin Yi held Zhou Jingru in his arms, sitting on the sofa.
He watched the entertainment program on the television and suddenly remembered something, asking, “Jingru, do you know Lin Yuhan?”
Upon that name, Zhou Jingru paused for a moment, “What about it?”
Lin Yi curled his lips, “Have you ever heard of this person?”
“Who is she?” Zhou Jingru asked in surprise.
“A mistress who’s kept by someone, rumored to be a great beauty,” Lin Yi said sarcastically.
Zhou Jingru frowned, “Who are you talking about?”
“The sister of Lin Yiwen.”
“Yi Wenwen?” Zhou Jingru exclaimed in surprise.
Lin Yi looked at Zhou Jingru curiously, “What’s wrong? Do you know this person?”
“I don’t know her,” Zhou Jingru quickly denied.
“Yi Wenwen is the younger sister of Lin Corporation’s CEO Lin Zhenhua, the siblings have been close since childhood, I even attended Lin Yiwen’s engagement party with Gu Chenyi.”
“So it’s her? No wonder she looked somewhat familiar to me, I heard she and Lin Yiwen don’t get along.”
Lin Yi lifted the corners of his mouth, a cold light flashing in his eyes.
Lin Yiwen was Gu Chenyi’s fiancée, while Lin Yuhan was the Lin Family’s illegitimate daughter who was snatched away by Lin Yiwen from her man, the grudge was intense.
A crafty arch formed on Lin Yi’s lips, “Let’s go to the civil affairs office to get our marriage certificate tomorrow.”
Zhou Jingru didn’t argue and nodded, “Hmm.”
The next day
On their way to get the marriage certificate, Lin Yi received a call from Gu Chenyi.
“Lin Yi, I’m coming back tonight.”
Lin Yi’s expression grew solemn, he knew that Gu Chenyi was undoubtedly coming to settle accounts.
“Let’s go to register tomorrow,” Lin Yi said in a low voice.
“No, we must get the marriage certificate today,” Gu Chenyi insisted.
“I understand, but today is Zhou Jingru’s birthday, she needs to celebrate, she’s an orphan, I’ve been with her celebrating all day, so it’s not convenient to register today,” Lin Yi explained patiently.
Gu Chenyi listened to Lin Yi speaking like this, and his tone softened a bit, “What about tomorrow?”
“Tomorrow is the weekend, I can rest for half a day. By then, we’ll go straight to the Civil Affairs Bureau. After we get our marriage certificate, we’ll go register at a hotel,” Lin Yi said steadily.
“Fine then, if you dare to run away tomorrow, I will make sure you stay in Beijing forever,” Gu Chenyi warned.
Lin Yi pursed his lips, “Okay.”
Chapter 3 Is there really such a thing as true love in this world
“You’re not going to play tricks on me, are you?” Gu Chenyi asked suspiciously.
“What benefit would I get from deceiving you? Once we get our certificate, you’ll be my husband too, I won’t leave you.”
“Alright, I believe you,” said Gu Chenyi before hanging up the phone.
Lin Yi drove to the Civil Affairs Bureau, and as soon as the two of them got out of the car, Zhou Jingru’s phone rang.
“Husband, I forgot to bring the household registration book, I’ll go get it now,” Zhou Jingru said before hanging up the phone and then told Lin Yi, “Let’s go inside first.”
Lin Yi nodded, and the two entered the Civil Affairs Bureau.
Zhou Jingru was quick and soon had the marriage certificate in her hands.
“What do you plan to do?” Lin Yi asked.
Zhou Jingru’s gaze dimmed a bit. “I’m planning to go to France. I want to cure my father’s illness. I have to go to France. Will you come with me?”
“Wherever you wish to go, I will accompany you, as long as you want it,” Lin Yi said dotingly, caressing Zhou Jingru’s head.
Lin Yi took Zhou Jingru out to eat.
“Jingru, I’ll take you to the mall tomorrow. We’ll buy some clothes to change into. I’ve prepared a card for you. You can spend as you please. I’m temporarily a bit short on cash, but I will repay you slowly after I make some money.”
“No need, I’m not short of money,” Zhou Jingru shook her head, “Actually, I don’t love money as much as you think. I’ve never thought about asking you for money, don’t misunderstand.”
Lin Yi held Zhou Jingru’s hand, “I know you are not the type to covet wealth, but it’s for your good. If you don’t accept it, consider it a loan from me. If you ever need it urgently, I will return it double.”
“Since you insist, then I’ll keep it for you. When I meet the right person in the future, I’ll pass it on to him,” Zhou Jingru said generously.
Lin Yi lifted the corners of his mouth, believing that Zhou Jingru would meet the right man one day, but it definitely wouldn’t be him.
After eating, Zhou Jingru and Lin Yi went shopping and bought a bunch of things.
Lin Yi dropped Zhou Jingru off downstairs, and she snuggled into his embrace, “Lin Yi, have you been tired from work recently?”
“It’s okay. I’m a newcomer, there’s too much to learn, but it’s good to have your help by my side,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Lin Yi, after we get married, I’ll move here to live with you. Let’s rent a house together, so we don’t have to commute back and forth,” Zhou Jingru said gently.
Lin Yi nodded, “However you want to live, that’s how we’ll live.”
Lin Yi pulled Zhou Jingru into the car, and the two went home.
As soon as Lin Yi entered the door, Zhou Jingru took off her coat, revealing a white blouse beneath her chiffon shirt, paired with a black pencil skirt.
Her figure was slender and tall, her skin fair, and her features lovely and pure, much like the women from the water towns of Jiangnan, impossible to resist the urge to hold dearly and protect.
“Big Brother Yi, you go take a shower first,” Zhou Jingru said coquettishly.
Lin Yi smiled slightly, “Okay then, I’ll go take one first, and then call for you.”
Zhou Jingru stood in the living room, watching Lin Yi disappear into the bathroom, then she made a phone call.
“Hello, Auntie.”
Zhou Jingru spoke with a sweet smile.
“Jingru, how are things going with Chenyi?” Lin’s mother asked nervously.
Zhou Jingru bit her lip. “He’s agreed to come handle the marriage registration tomorrow. He got drunk today and didn’t touch me.”
“That’s good. Jingru, I know you don’t like Gu Chenyi, but if you don’t like him, don’t force yourself. You can cancel the wedding. Don’t ruin your whole life because of me,” Lin Yi walked out of the bathroom and saw Zhou Jingru.

chapters.title: Chapter 735 - 735 735 Dont Let Your Imagination Run Wild
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 735: Chapter 735 Don’t Let Your Imagination Run Wild Chapter 735: Chapter 735 Don’t Let Your Imagination Run Wild “You…” Lin Yi looked at Zhou Jingru in shock.
He had not expected that Zhou Jingru would betray him.
Zhou Jingru cast her eyes down, “There’s nothing between him and me, don’t worry.”
“You’re already legally married, and now you’re saying there’s nothing?” Lin Yi roared with anger.
Zhou Jingru’s eyes reddened, and she looked up, “Lin Yi, I don’t like him, he’s too domineering, always bullying me, and besides, he forced me to marry him. I didn’t agree, so he threatened me, saying that if I didn’t comply, he would go after my father.”
“I don’t want my father to go to jail; he’s already so old, I don’t want him to be imprisoned.”
Lin Yi was stunned for a moment, “Jingru, I’m sorry, I misunderstood you.”
“You haven’t wronged me; you are my benefactor, it’s I who have harmed you, I owe you an apology,” Zhou Jingru cried out.
Lin Yi hugged Zhou Jingru, “Silly girl, you are the girl I love most, how could I ever blame you? Don’t think nonsense.”
Zhou Jingru leaned against Lin Yi’s chest.
Lin Yi wrapped his arms around Zhou Jingru, gently patting her back, consoling her, “Jingru, rest assured, I will definitely marry you, we will surely be happy.”
“Lin Yi, you’re so good to me, how can I ever repay you?” Zhou Jingru looked up, gazing into Lin Yi’s deep eyes.
Zhou Jingru’s tears fell inside his neck.
Lin Yi’s throat bobbed, “Jingru, after we marry, I’ll work hard to make money. By then, I’ll provide for you, we won’t be poor again.”
“Okay, I will try my best to obtain anything you desire,” Zhou Jingru said obediently.
