Lin Yi lowered his head and captured Zhou Jingru’s tender red lips.
Zhou Jingru closed her eyes.
Lin Yi couldn’t bring himself to let go of her; his large hand roamed over her waist.
Zhou Jingru’s lashes trembled lightly, pushing against Lin Yi’s shoulders.
Lin Yi stopped the intimacy, looking at Zhou Jingru, “Don’t you like my kisses?”
“Lin Yi, we’re married, I hope that on our wedding night, you will respect me,” Zhou Jingru said with a hint of grievance.
“I won’t hurt you, you’re my first woman, I don’t have enough time to love you.”
Lin Yi picked up Zhou Jingru and walked toward the bedroom.
He laid Zhou Jingru down on the bed.
“Jingru, this time I’m not seeking physical possession, I just hope you can love me, I hope we can last,” Lin Yi said earnestly.
Zhou Jingru’s face flushed crimson, “Lin Yi, I want your heart, I don’t want to be a toy for you to vent your desires, I want to be with you for a lifetime, Lin Yi, I really love you, I don’t want to miss out on you.”
Lin Yi leaned down, capturing Zhou Jingru’s lips again.
Her mouth was soft, as if there was a “magic power” drawing him in, stirring up the desires deep within his heart.
His breaths grew heavier.
Lin Yi desired her, wanting her to completely become his own.
Zhou Jingru closed her eyes, savoring his pursuit.
Suddenly, he heard the sound of keys turning from outside.
Lin Yi startled and abruptly opened his eyes, he saw Zhou Jingru’s wrists were bound, the rope coiled around them, cutting into her skin, leaving red marks, blood flowing incessantly.
Lin Yi grabbed the rope, his voice sharp as he demanded, “What are you doing?”
Zhou Jingru’s lips curled into a mocking smile, “Did you think I would marry Gu Chenyi? Did you think I didn’t know you had me play a role? Lin Yi, I deceived you, we were just pretending to be a couple, I haven’t liked Gu Chenyi for a long time, there’s nothing between us, please don’t come to find me again.”
Upon hearing Zhou Jingru’s explanation, an inexplicable panic surged in Lin Yi’s heart.
His actions just now were impulsive, but at this moment, he felt a fearful and worried sensation.
“You lied to me!” Lin Yi roared in anger.
“Didn’t you already guess? Didn’t you already know I was lying to you? Why do you still ask me?” Zhou Jingru retorted.
“Are you crazy? I love you so much, how can you use me?” Lin Yi said excitedly.
Zhou Jingru wiped her tears and calmly said, “I know I owe you, but Lin Yi, you must keep this a secret. I don’t want my dad to lose his job because of me. I just want to take good care of my father.”
Lin Yi looked at Zhou Jingru, her large eyes filled with helplessness and sorrow.
He knew, over these years, it was Zhou Jingru who had shouldered everything. Her strength, bravery, and kindness were all an act.
In fact, she was more fearful and timorous than anyone, but she couldn’t show it. She was afraid she would fall apart.
“Jingru, I’m sorry, I misunderstood you,” Lin Yi said, holding Zhou Jingru’s hand with heartache, “I will definitely treat you well, I will earn money to support you.”
“Mm, I believe you,” Zhou Jingru said with a smile.
Lin Yi stripped off his clothes, climbed onto the bed, and held Zhou Jingru tightly, “Jingru, these past few years have been hard on you.”
Zhou Jingru curled her lips into a smile, “Being with you is the happiest thing in my life, I will never leave you, even if you don’t want me, I’m willing to protect you for a lifetime.”
Zhou Jingru took the initiative to kiss Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s heart rate accelerated, his body tingling all over.
He lowered his head and captured Zhou Jingru’s lips with his own.
Zhou Jingru turned over, pressing down on Lin Yi, a faint smile on her lips, “Lin Yi, I’ve finally waited for this day, let’s get married.”
Lin Yi, looking at Zhou Jingru’s smiling face, felt a warm surge in his heart.
So Zhou Jingru did want to marry him.
He kissed her back excitedly.
The two entwined in bed, the affair lasting who knows how long.
Lin Yi lay on the bed, looking at Zhou Jingru.
She slept with her eyes closed.
He couldn’t help but kiss Zhou Jingru’s forehead.
A thought flashed across his mind.
His wife, she was Zhou Jingru.
Zhou Jingru’s phone rang, disturbing the intimate atmosphere in the room.
Lin Yi saw it was a call from the Lin Family and hurriedly hung up.
Zhou Jingru turned over and continued to sleep.
“Hello, who is this?” Lin Yi cleared his throat and asked.
“Is this Lin Yi? How is Jingru doing? Are you at the hospital now?” Zhou’s mother asked anxiously.
“Auntie, it’s Lin Yi. Jingru has already fallen asleep, and I’m here with her,” Lin Yi said.
“Oh, is Jingru okay? I heard you had a fight with her, is it because of Gu Chenyi?” Zhou’s mother pressed.
“Yes, we did have a conflict. I don’t know how to make it up to her, so I’m not going back tonight,” Lin Yi said earnestly.
“It’s normal for you to fight. After all, you’ve been childhood sweethearts and your feelings run deep. Jingru is so naive. I heard that Gu Chenyi cheated, our Jingru is so unlucky,” Zhou’s mother said sympathetically.
Lin Yi frowned, he didn’t believe that Gu Chenyi would cheat. He and Zhou Jingru had been dating since their third year of middle school, and they had been together for five years.
He did not believe that Gu Chenyi would cheat.
“Auntie, I will be back tomorrow. I’m hanging up now,” Lin Yi said and hung up the phone abruptly. Looking at Zhou Jingru with a fierce gleam in his eyes, he hissed through clenched teeth, “Jingru, what the hell are you playing at? Do you realize you almost killed your brother just now?”
Zhou Jingru slowly opened her eyes, “I really want to be with you. I want to marry you. If I’m really pregnant, will you marry me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 736 - 736 736 The Doubts in My Heart Gradually
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 736: Chapter 736 The Doubts in My Heart Gradually Disappear Chapter 736: Chapter 736 The Doubts in My Heart Gradually Disappear Lin Yi paused for a moment, the doubts in his heart gradually vanished, he cradled Zhou Jingru’s cheeks, “Jingru, I will never let you down, you have to remember, you are the only woman in my life, Lin Yi’s lifetime one and only.”
Zhou Jingru smiled faintly, “I know, I know, Lin Yi, do you know? I’ve been waiting for these words, even though I’m just your kept mistress, but I love you, I don’t want to regret anything in the future, so I’d rather be your mistress.”
“Jingru, I will definitely treat you well,” Lin Yi promised.
“I don’t want your affection, I just want your money, what I want is money and status,” Zhou Jingru said calmly.
“I’m not short of money, however much you need, I will give it to you.”
Zhou Jingru shook her head, “I don’t want your money, you are a rich second-generation, your money belongs to you, I just want your love, Lin Yi, you don’t need to give me money or material things, all I want is your love.”
“You are the smartest and most beautiful girl I’ve ever met, you should have the best man, and I, I’m not worthy of you,” Lin Yi said, feeling guilty.
“I don’t despise you, you are the best man I’ve ever met, if you don’t agree to me, I will choose to commit suicide, you understand, I used to study law,” Zhou Jingru said decisively.
Lin Yi looked at her eyes, which were very sharp, not at all like she was joking.
Lin Yi’s heart shuddered, he was scared too, “Jingru, I will compensate you, I will definitely treat you well.”
Zhou Jingru leaned on Lin Yi’s shoulder, “Lin Yi, let’s get married, let’s not part anymore, our future, there’s a beautiful tomorrow.”
Lin Yi sighed, “What compensation do you want, as long as it’s within my power, I will try to satisfy you.”
Zhou Jingru looked up at him.
Lin Yi met Zhou Jingru’s gaze, “Whenever you’re willing, I’m always ready to register our marriage with you, but I hope you can consider me.”
Zhou Jingru curled her red lips, her eyes sparkling and clear, “Okay, Lin Yi, I want to be your wife, a qualified wife.”
Lin Yi nodded.
He picked up his phone and dialed his assistant, instructing, “Help me prepare two plane tickets to City A, the sooner the better.”
In the middle of the night
Zhou Jingru woke up and found the space beside her empty.
She glanced at her phone and saw it was already past nine in the morning.
She immediately got out of bed to wash up and change her clothes, then walked into the kitchen.
She saw Lin Yi was already neatly dressed.
Lin Yi stood at the door, looking at her tenderly.
She suddenly felt like crying.
Seeing that Zhou Jingru’s eyes had reddened, Lin Yi felt a pang in his heart, sat down next to her, wrapped his arm around her slender waist, and asked in a husky voice, “What’s wrong? Are you tired from last night? I’ll find your sister to take you to the airport.”
Zhou Jingru shook her head, “I’m fine, you go on ahead.”
Lin Yi glanced at his watch, “Why would you go to the airport so early?”
“You go back, I need to visit the hospital, my mother is still there, I can’t just neglect her,” Zhou Jingru said softly.
Lin Yi hesitated, “Then I’ll take you to the airport.”
“No need, you go back, I’m leaving now, so as not to hold up your work,” Zhou Jingru said considerately.
“Alright,” Lin Yi turned and left.
Sitting in the car, he thought of Zhou Jingru’s appearance from the night before and couldn’t help frowning.
He bought Zhou Jingru a long black down jacket.
He thought, she must be cold.
Lin Yi, carrying the gift bag, arrived at the hospital room door and knocked.
Zhou Jingru opened it from inside.
“You’re here so early, you must have had a tough night last night,” Zhou Jingru said warmly.
“How could I be at ease leaving when you’re not feeling well?” Lin Yi said with concern.
Zhou Jingru smiled and pursed her lips, “I’m fine, I took some medicine and went to sleep. You should head to the company now, drive safely, and don’t forget what you promised me.”
Lin Yi was amused by Zhou Jingru, and gently rubbed her cheek, “I know, I won’t go back on my word. I’m leaving now, you should rest early too. See you tomorrow.”
Zhou Jingru watched Lin Yi’s retreating figure with a sweet feeling in her heart.
She closed the door, turned around, and saw a document on the bedside table—the marriage agreement.
Lin Yi actually gave himself to her, this fool.
Zhou Jingru put away the marriage agreement; she didn’t want Lin Yi to have regrets.
Upon arriving at the office and dealing with some business matters, Lin Yi saw a card on his desk. He picked it up and checked it—there were four million inside.
He placed the card in the drawer.
“Director Lin, why are you still here?” Secretary Wang Min entered, speaking respectfully.
“Mmm,” Lin Yi responded indifferently.
Wang Min hesitated, wanting to report but fearing to anger Lin Yi. She lowered her head and continued, “These past few days, two major clients have come to our company to discuss business, one of them named Lin Yuhao. He came with a female companion, and it’s said that he’s our company’s largest shareholder. He has requested to meet you.”
Lin Yi was silent for a moment, then lifted his head to look at Wang Min, “I won’t see them, tell them I need to go abroad for a few days.”
“But…” Wang Min, seeing Lin Yi’s stern seriousness, dared not disobey, “Alright, I got it.”
Lin Yi looked out at the snowy scene outside the window, his deep gaze becoming extremely somber.
In his mind flashed a pair of bewitchingly charming eyes.
Those eyes—clear, pure, yet carrying a hint of seductiveness and enchantment, made it hard for him to look away.
Zhou Jingru was indeed a beautiful and sexy woman.
**
Gu Ziyi woke up, her body aching all over.
Last night was too crazy; Lin Yi was too intense, and she simply couldn’t cope.
After brushing her teeth and washing her face, Gu Ziyi walked into the bathroom.
As she was about to brush her teeth and wash her face, she heard footsteps outside.
Gu Ziyi got a start, quickly wiped off the toothpaste, and hid in front of the mirror, stealing a glance outside.
Lin Yi came in with a tray and placed it on the bedside table, “Hungry, right? Eat while it’s still hot.”
Gu Ziyi looked at Lin Yi in surprise, “Lin Yi, you’re thirty-five this year, right?”
“Yes, soon,” Lin Yi explained.
“No wonder you’re so anxious. Is it because you’re almost thirty-five and haven’t been with a woman, so you want to find one to relieve some pressure? I’m not exactly a respectable woman, and I haven’t graduated yet; I’m not suitable for marriage,” Gu Ziyi said, declining.
“You haven’t graduated yet?” Lin Yi was shocked, looking at the woman before him, “You married me without graduating, aren’t you afraid of wronging yourself?”
Gu Ziyi raised the corner of her mouth lightly, “I wouldn’t go so far as to say wronged. I’m an orphan; my father died early, and my siblings too, I grew up with my uncle. My uncle is very good to me. Although he has no son, he treats me as his own daughter, and I now have a grandmother and an aunt and uncle to take care of me.”
“You’re an orphan?” Lin Yi was shocked.
Gu Ziyi smiled faintly, “I was picked up by my grandfather when I was a child.”
Lin Yi stroked her head with pity, “I’m sorry, I thought I was your husband’s son.”
“Hehe, no problem, we’re secretly married. Once I graduate, I’d like to marry you and start a small family together,” Zhou Jingru envisioned.

chapters.title: Chapter 737 - 737 737 Holding a Grand Wedding
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 737: Chapter 737: Holding a Grand Wedding Chapter 737: Chapter 737: Holding a Grand Wedding “Okay.” Lin Yi affectionately scraped Zhou Jingru’s nose, “Then you rest up for now, and once you’re discharged, I’ll take you to a gathering. You wanted to meet friends from our circle, right?”
Zhou Jingru nodded happily, “Mm-hmm, you’re so good to me.”
She held Lin Yi’s hand and cooed, “Honey, are you about to get a promotion and a raise?”
Lin Yi laughed and rubbed Zhou Jingru’s forehead.
“We are secretly married, unless we have a grand wedding and announce it to the world. Otherwise, it remains a secret marriage. You don’t mind, do you?” Lin Yi sought Zhou Jingru’s opinion.
“I don’t mind at all, as long as you don’t leave me. Everything is fine. Besides, our child is over three years old now, and since we have our marriage certificate, we are husband and wife. There’s no need for publicity. I believe you, too, want our child to grow up healthy and happy.”
Lin Yi nodded.
He reached out to embrace Zhou Jingru, “Rest assured, I will always love you.”
Zhou Jingru leaned into Lin Yi’s arms, closed her eyes, and shed tears of happiness.
She thought, the biggest mistake she ever made in her life was agreeing to Lin Yi’s proposal.
Lin Yi was really good to her.
In these days, he had been by her side, tirelessly recounting their past to her.
If she could choose, she would be willing to stay by his side forever and grow old with him.
——
Lin Yi was in his office, dealing with documents.
He had just picked up a pen when the phone on the desk rang.
“Hello, who is this?” Lin Yi asked, picking up the receiver.
“Is this President Lin? I’m the secretary to Vice Mayor Li. Vice Mayor Li wants to meet with you. He’s waiting for you at the tea house in the southern district. Would it be convenient for you to come?”
Lin Yi paused for a moment, “All right, please convey my message that I’ll be right there.”
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi put down the pen in his hand. He walked over to the floor-to-ceiling window and looked out, a blanket of pristine snow covering the city’s bustle.
Lin Yi smiled, a slight curve on his lips.
The tea house in the southern district.
Lin Yi, wearing a black suit, walked briskly towards the tea house.
The tea house’s decor was luxurious and elegant, its antique carved wooden doors wide open.
Inside sat a man in his fifties or sixties accompanied by a young and beautiful woman.
The woman had flowing long hair, a slender figure, and a gentle demeanor, her face painted with heavy makeup, looking every bit the aristocratic lady.
She took a sip of tea and smiled elegantly, “Uncle Li, I’ve heard that there’s no corner of a wall that can’t be pried open. You shouldn’t back down just because he’s married.”
Lin Yi stood at the entrance, glanced at the woman.
The woman looked up, her eyes clashing with Lin Yi’s sharp gaze.
Lin Yi was taken aback.
Seeing Lin Yi, the woman immediately got up and approached him, “Brother Lin, so you’re here. I was just looking for you.”
Mayor Li also rose to his feet, “So President Lin knows the Lu Family’s daughter. Since you know each other, it makes things easier. Let’s sit down and talk, sit down.”
Lin Yi glanced indifferently at Lu Yao and sat down after pulling out a chair, “Miss Lu, I’m sorry, but I’m afraid I’ll have to disappoint you today, as I already have a fiancée.”
“Fiancée?” Lu Yao covered her mouth in shock, then quickly regained her composure, “Brother Lin, you must be joking.”
Lin Yi arched his eyebrows indifferently, “I’m not joking. How do you know me?”
Lu Yao gave an embarrassed smile, “Brother Lin, I grew up in Jingzhou, so naturally I know you.”
“Oh.” Lin Yi responded mildly, turning to Deputy Mayor Li, “Mayor Li, what brings you to see me today?”
Mayor Li heaved a sigh and said, “I wanted to ask what the investment plans of Lin Corporation are in Jiangyang? We are hoping to secure that piece of land in Jiangyang and were wondering if President Lin could perhaps facilitate an introduction?”
“You want to secure that piece of Jiangyang land?” Lin Yi looked at Mayor Li, “Is your government planning to build houses with it?”
“We have quite a few properties in Jiangyang that could be used for building shopping centers, hotels, and such. However, that land is extremely valuable and offers good policies. Therefore, I want to purchase it and transform it into a new type of wholesale shopping city. If we can secure that land, we will definitely make a fortune,” said Mayor Li with hopeful eyes as he looked at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi smiled slightly, “Mayor Li, does Jiangyang have any competitive bidding projects?”
“With the financial power and influence of Lin Corporation, if Lin Corporation is willing to help us, securing the land will be a done deal.”
“Mayor Li, I’m flying to City A for a meeting tomorrow. I’ll give you a response after that,” Lin Yi said diplomatically.
“Then, all right, President Lin, please do think it over,” Mayor Li said with a cheery smile.
Lin Yi saw off Mayor Li and sat back down on the sofa, hands in his pockets.
A shadow of grim determination swept across his eyes. He was resolved to win this project.
…
Early the next day, Lin Yi took a private jet to City A, and by evening, he had returned to the Empire Hotel.
Lin Yi pushed open the door of his room only to find another person lying on the bed. His heart tightened, and he quickly went over, grabbed the woman’s arm, and flipped her over.
With her back to Lin Yi, the woman’s sleeping face was peaceful, and her long eyelashes quivered like butterfly wings. Sensing Lin Yi’s presence, her eyes slowly opened.
“Who are you?” Lin Yi asked with a cold face.
The woman’s skin was exquisite, whiter than snow and seemingly fragile to the touch, emitting a faint, refreshing fragrance.
This scent was all too familiar to Lin Yi.
Her dark, deep eyes shone captivatingly, her red lips enticing. Her gaze was alluring, like that of a sly fox’s spirit-snaring stare.
Lin Yi released her arm, straightened up, his brow furrowed, “How come you’re here?”
“Lin Yi, why am I here? I’d like to ask you the same question. This is the Empire Hotel, a hotel, not a guesthouse. You burst into my room in the middle of the night and took off my clothes. What are you doing?” the woman demanded indignantly.
Lin Yi snorted coldly, “Are you blaming me?”
The woman glared at him with watery eyes, “Shouldn’t I blame you? I’m a girl who was brought into a room by a strange man in the middle of the night. Don’t you think you should take responsibility?”
Lin Yi curled the corner of his mouth, “You certainly are a girl, but you’re wearing a dress. I thought you were a man.”
He gazed at Lu Yao’s angry face, a sharp light flashing in his eyes.
He had a good memory, he remembered that he hadn’t touched her at all last night, yet here she was, dressed in a man’s shirt.
He may not like her, but he would never allow her to trample on his dignity like this.
Lu Yao was so angry she was grinding her teeth, “Lin Yi, you jerk! You took advantage of a girl and now you’re trying to turn the tables. I’m going to call the police!”
Lin Yi scoffed, “What are you, a mutt that just popped out of nowhere?”
As he spoke, he took out his cell phone to dial 110, “I’m in room 1809 at the Empire Hotel. Someone has forcefully entered my room and is attempting to assault me, please hurry over.”
After the call, Lin Yi hung up his phone.
Lu Yao collapsed onto the bed, “How dare you accuse me? I’ll sue you. I’m going to call the police right now, don’t think you can get away with this!”
Lin Yi watched Lu Yao dialing her phone and didn’t stop her, his lips curling coldly, “Go ahead, I’d like to see whom you can call. I’ll see you in court.”

chapters.title: Chapter 738 - 738 738 Invasion of Privacy
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 738: Chapter 738 Invasion of Privacy? Chapter 738: Chapter 738 Invasion of Privacy? Lu Yao’s hand stiffly raised, looking at Lin Yi, “You, you really want to accuse me? This is an invasion of privacy, and we would both be criminally liable.”
“Invasion of privacy? Lu Yao, when you were doing these sordid things, why didn’t you think about invading privacy? Now you’re actually blaming first?” Lin Yi said coldly.
Lu Yao stared blankly at Lin Yi, her eyes instantly turning red, “What sordid things have I done? I just wanted to be with you, and you actually insult me. Lin Yi, I really didn’t expect you to be such a despicable and shameless man!”
Lin Yi tilted his chin up, “You’re calling me despicable and shameless? Don’t forget, it was you who provoked me first.”
Lu Yao’s chest heaved violently, and she clenched her teeth tightly, “Lin Yi, don’t go too far. I, Lu Yao, have dignity too. If, you dare to touch me, I’ll kill you.”
Lu Yao’s eyes were bloodshot, and she clenched her fists, “Lin Yi, I don’t care about any past vanity you adored, but this time you must save my dad, otherwise, I won’t let you go even if I die.”
“Heh.” Lin Yi’s mouth curled up in scorn, “Lu Yao, stop pretending. I’ve investigated. You are the adopted daughter of the Lu Family, your father is Lu Wenbo, your mother is Lu Corporation’s employee. These three years, you’ve relied on the Lu Corporation to buy this house. Do you think I’m stupid? Tell me, would I marry you?”
Lin Yi’s mouth twisted into a mocking smile.
Lu Yao bit her lower lip, tears streaming down her face.
Lin Yi looked at her with disgust, turned around, left the bedroom, and closed the door.
Lu Yao sat on the edge of the bed crying, her sobs growing fiercer, until suddenly she stopped weeping.
Lin Yi’s words just now reminded her that she was nothing but a pawn. A pawn, even if she married Lin Yi, what use would it be?
Lin Yi was unwilling to marry her; if she married him, aside from his disgust, she would gain nothing.
Lu Yao wiped away her tears and decided she had to escape this hellhole quickly. She couldn’t let Lin Yi ruin her; she needed to flee, to get away from Lin Yi, this beast.
Lin Yi left the room and stood in front of the living room’s floor-to-ceiling windows, overlooking the hustle and bustle of country A.
He took out his laptop and opened a video.
The video showed a tall and handsome man.
Lin Yi’s hand clenched into a fist.
This man was Lu Yaning’s brother, Lu Muqing.
Lu Muqing was his senior, excellent since childhood, and one of the top talents of country A.
The Lu Corporation thrived under his management, becoming the richest family in the entirety of country A. Moreover, it was said that the Lu Family was preparing to hand over the company to him.
Unfortunately, the girl he liked was Lu Yaning, his fiancée.
Therefore, he rejected the Lin Family’s proposition of marriage.
Lin Yi watched Lu Muqing speaking on stage.
“Our Lu Corporation is a well-known enterprise in country A. In recent years, Lu Corporation has developed rapidly, and I hope our collaboration will be pleasant. At the same time, we will continue to maintain a strong partnership, wishing that Lu Corporation will grow even stronger in country A and lead the global economy to new heights.”
Lin Yi watched the man on the screen, his idol.
He had once wanted to collaborate with Lu Corporation, but the Lu Corp always kept a low profile, never involving itself in showbiz matters.
He had no choice but to start his own investment company and become an investor himself. Over the years, he had earned quite a bit of money and accumulated some capital.
For years, he had dedicated himself to charity. This time, he also wanted to donate 10 billion US dollars to children in poor mountainous areas, hoping they could escape poverty soon.
His money was meant to alleviate poverty in the first place.
Lin Yi opened a news media app and searched for Lu Corporation, then opened the official website of Lu Corporation.
It displayed detailed descriptions of all products under the Lu Corporation, including stocks, futures, securities, etc.
Lin Yi noticed that the Lu Corporation held 80 percent of its shares in its own name, while another 30 percent were in the name of a woman called Lu Yaning.
The 10 percent stake of the Lu Corporation in Lu Yaning’s name had always been vacant, unregistered.
Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat, the president of Lu Corporation did not bear the Lu surname; he was a Bai. That means he…
The shares of the Lu Family were his!
Lin Yi’s shock was evident as he lifted his gaze to his reflection in the mirror.
He bore an uncanny resemblance to that man, except that the man was much more handsome and slightly older.
Lin Yi clenched his fists, his eyes brimming with venomous resentment.
Lin Yi’s parents were orphans; he had been raised by his grandmother from a young age.
After his grandmother passed away and his parents died, his grandfather took Lin Yi away from the old house to set up their own household.
They rented an apartment, costing five thousand a month, which averaged out to a hundred a day.
Lin Yi had purchased a bachelor’s pad in the old city district and usually took care of his meals there.
Lin Yi’s mother had passed away from illness when he was eight years old.
His grandfather entrusted him to his grandmother’s care, and after she died, his grandfather remarried and sent Lin Yi to an orphanage. Lin Yi’s parents, with Lin Yi in tow, were self-reliant, raising him to adulthood.
From a young age, Lin Yi never enjoyed the warmth of family affection; his ties to the Lin and Lu families ran deep.
He hated the Lu Family, their wealth, and more than anything, his own identity.
He had always been trying, trying to change himself, struggling to become the best, to become an object of envy for the Lu Family. But in the end, it was all for naught. Not only had he not succeeded in changing himself, but he had also become a disgrace to the Lu Family, a laughingstock.
Lin Yi’s heart was filled to the brim with hatred.
He couldn’t be content with this. How could he be content when Lu Yaning was hailed as the number one beauty of country A, while he was just a poor kid from country A?
He wanted to shine as brilliantly as Lu Yaning, not remain the obscure Lin Yi.
He wanted to become the richest man in country A.
He wanted everyone to look up to him.
He wished to crush both the Lin and Lu families under his feet.
He had been enduring, persevering all along.
But Lin Yi found that he could no longer hold back.
This news was like a bolt from the blue; he couldn’t accept it.
After learning the truth, Lin Yi was extremely angry and in great pain.
Lin Yi spent two weeks consumed by anger, pain, and intense hatred.
During that time, he pondered endlessly on how to exact revenge on the Lu Family.
His goal was not just the Lu family, but to completely eradicate the Lu Corporation, to erase it forever from country A.
Lin Yi continuously schemed and planned.
Finally, one night, he found someone who looked similar to Lu Muqing.
It was a weekend.
Lin Yi had made arrangements to meet Lu Muqing at a bar for drinks.
The bar was noisy, and Lu Muqing was sitting on a sofa by the bar, leisurely swaying a glass in his hand.
Dressed in a black shirt and beige casual trousers, his delicate features were as if carved, his beautiful peach blossom eyes slightly upturned at the corners, drawing a captivating arc. His face was pale and thin, appearing somewhat frail.
Lin Yi took a seat opposite him and asked, looking at Lu Muqing, “What’s your name?”
Lu Muqing lifted his head and glanced at Lin Yi, “Lu Muqing.”

chapters.title: Chapter 739 - 739 739 Like a Madman
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 739: Chapter 739 Like a Madman Chapter 739: Chapter 739 Like a Madman “Lu Muqing? You’re Lu Yaning’s despicable cousin?” Lin Yi’s voice was as cold as a blade, and his tone was laden with a heavy scent of gunpowder.
Lu Muqing didn’t answer him, but kept his head down, drinking.
As Lin Yi observed Lu Muqing’s demeanor, his heart filled with even more rage. He stood up, walked over to him, and reached out to strangle his throat.
His grip was strong, and Lu Muqing found it hard to breathe.
His eyes reddened slightly and anger flickered within them, as he tried to slap Lin Yi’s arm away.
Lin Yi let go, his dark eyes burning with raging flames as if they were about to erupt.
“Do you love your sister that much?” Lin Yi said coldly, “I’ll tell you what, I’m going to kill your sister, get rid of you too, and then, send your bodies to the sea to feed the fish.”
A mocking smile played on Lu Muqing’s lips, and he stared at Lin Yi with cold eyes as if looking at a madman.
His voice was light and faint, but it carried a chilling undertone, “Do you think you can kill me?”
“Don’t forget, there’s something in this world called a gun.”
Panic flickered across Lu Muqing’s face as his eyes widened, “You…”
“Do you think you can stand against me with Lin Corporation on your side?”
“What… what do you want to do?” Lu Muqing grew anxious.
Lin Yi’s eyes gleamed with viciousness: “I want to send you to prison, to spend the rest of your life behind bars, with no hope of ever seeing the light of day again.”
“You wouldn’t dare!”
“Hahaha…” Lin Yi laughed wildly.
“Don’t be too smug,” Lu Muqing shouted angrily.
“Why wouldn’t I dare?” Lin Yi’s voice was utterly cold, “Don’t forget, you’re the most powerful man in country A. There’s nothing I want to do that anyone can stop.”
“You think I don’t know about all the disgraceful things Lin Family is doing behind the scenes? I’m telling you, you’ve made a mistake this time, and I won’t let you off.”
Upon hearing Lu Muqing’s words, Lin Yi burst into loud laughter.
“I’ve made a mistake? Do you have any evidence? If you have evidence, then investigate. What evidence do you have to prove I did anything wrong? Haha, you little brat, what do you know? Do you think everyone is like me? In it just for the money?”
Lin Yi’s eyes were filled with disdain as he looked at Lu Muqing as if he were looking at a fool.
“I’ll tell you, I’ve already brought down the Lu Family. All of the Lu Family’s assets have fallen into my name. Lu Muqing, I’ll tell you this, I want to destroy the Lu Family, I want my revenge.”
“In your dreams!” Lu Muqing’s eyes were filled with a sharp light, “Even if you’ve brought down the Lu Family, you won’t escape prison.”
“Stop trying to scare me!” Lin Yi said with contempt, “Do you think I’m a three-year-old child? I’ll tell you, I’m not afraid of anything anymore. Even if you talk till you’re blue in the face, there’s no use. The Lu Family will sooner or later be ruined by my hands, and by then, you just wait and cry.”
After Lin Yi finished speaking, he turned and left, leaving Lu Muqing alone in his spot.
Lin Yi walked out of the bar’s main entrance, where a silver-gray car stopped at his side.
Lin Yi opened the car door and got in. The car slowly drove away from the scene.
No sooner had Lin Yi got into the car than a knocking sound on the window reached him from outside.
Lin Yi looked outside to see a man in a suit standing by the car window.
Lin Yi rolled down the window and saw a man standing outside. The man looked at Lin Yi and said, “Mr. Lin, my young master invites you to dine.”
“Who are you?” Lin Yi asked warily.
The man said, “My young master’s surname is Lu. Mr. Lin need not worry; my master sincerely invites you for a meal, not with ill intentions but to seek advice. I hope Mr. Lin would do us the honor.”
Lin Yi’s brow furrowed slightly, he didn’t speak, but instead took out a cigarette and lit it.
Seeing this, the man hurriedly helped him light up the cigarette with a lighter.
Lin Yi took a deep drag of the cigarette and said, “Lead the way.”
After saying that, Lin Yi took another pull from his cigarette.
The man, seeing the situation, quickly opened the car door and got in.
The car started and drove forward.
Lin Yi, looking at the rapidly retreating streetscape outside, asked, “Where are you taking me?”
“To the Lu Family’s old mansion, the young master is waiting for you inside,” the man said.
“The Lu Family’s old mansion?” Lin Yi was somewhat surprised; he remembered that the first time he met Lu Muqing was in the president’s office of Lu Corporation.
“What, are you scared?”
Lin Yi shook his head, “What’s there to be scared of? I can’t wait to meet that legendary second young master of the Lu Family!”
Lu Muqing’s eyes narrowed slightly, a cold light flashed at the bottom of his eyes, but it quickly hid away.
The Lu Family’s villa covered a wide area; it was a manor-style villa, luxuriously furnished.
The car stopped in front of the villa, the man took the lead to get out, and respectfully opened the car door for Lin Yi.
Lin Yi got out of the car, looking at the glittering building in front of him, a trace of excitement appeared in his eyes.
He couldn’t wait to see that person; he wanted to see if that person was as he imagined, with extraordinary wisdom and strength.
The man followed Lin Yi and went inside together.
In the villa, Lu Muqing had been waiting in the living room for quite some time.
Standing next to Lu Muqing was an older man, likely in his thirties or forties, wearing gold-rimmed glasses and having a robust figure, clearly a bodyguard.
He was responsible for the security of Lu Muqing.
Lin Yi glanced at the bodyguard standing beside him and asked, “What relation is your young master to the Lu Family?”
“My young master is the president of Lu Corporation,” the bodyguard said respectfully.
“I see,” Lin Yi smiled and said, “I wonder, sir, why your young master is looking for me?”
“Mr. Lin, please,” said the bodyguard.
Lin Yi nodded and walked into the villa.
After entering the villa, he saw a young man in a white shirt and black pants from the back; his silhouette was tall and slender, looking very handsome.
This silhouette was so similar to the man he had seen on television.
A wave of excitement surged in his heart—could it be that this man was truly the future heir of the Lu Family, Lu Muqing?
At that thought, Lin Yi’s heart swelled with a strong desire; he wanted to see for himself just what kind of man could possess such a noble title.
Lin Yi walked toward Lu Muqing, standing behind him and clearing his throat lightly.
Lu Muqing heard the sound and turned to look at Lin Yi.
After seeing the young man’s appearance clearly, Lin Yi’s heart was instantly engulfed by towering waves.
The young man before him was indeed the man he wanted to meet!
Lin Yi was surprised to discover that this young man bore a striking resemblance to himself.
“Mr. Lin, my young master invites you over for a chat. How do you feel about that?”
Coming back to his senses from the shock, Lin Yi’s face carried a confident smile as he said, “Sure!”
“Please!” The bodyguard introduced him to Lu Muqing and then closed the door behind him.
In the room, Lin Yi looked at the man sitting on the sofa, his eyes sparkling with a fervent glow.
This man was indeed extraordinary!
Lin Yi walked up to the man and smiled, “So you are Lu Muqing, the young master of the Lu Family?”

chapters.title: Chapter 740 - 740 740 No Need to Beat Around the Bush
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 740: Chapter 740: No Need to Beat Around the Bush Chapter 740: Chapter 740: No Need to Beat Around the Bush The man lifted his head, his gaze indifferent as he looked at him, and spoke in an even tone, “Who are you?”
“Oh, you don’t recognize me? I’m Lin Yi!” After Lin Yi finished speaking, he looked at Lu Muqing and said, “You should have heard of my name, right?”
“Lin Yi?” The man murmured, searching his mind for the name Lin Yi.
“Correct, it is I!” Lin Yi declared.
The man looked at Lin Yi, silent for a moment, before saying, “What do you want from me?”
“I’d like to make friends with Young Master Lu,” Lin Yi said with a grin.
Upon hearing this, Lu Muqing’s eyes showed a hint of disgust as he said impatiently, “Mr. Lin, if you have something to say, just say it directly. There’s no need to beat around the bush.”
“Young Master Lu, are you in such a hurry to send me away?” Lin Yi asked with a smile.
The man said nothing more and instead picked up a glass of red wine from the table and began to drink.
His movement was very elegant, like a king, giving off an aura that made others feel the impulse to kneel and worship.
Lin Yi looked at the young man before him and inwardly sighed; it was no wonder Lu Muqing had the support of the Lu Family—he was indeed excellent, full of vigor, and truly capable.
Watching Lu Muqing leisurely savoring the red wine, a strong sense of competition rose within Lin Yi.
“I want to cooperate with Young Master Lu on big ventures!” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Cooperate?” Lu Muqing glanced at him, “What makes you think I would agree to cooperate with you?”
“On the basis that I share the same status as Young Master Lu,” Lin Yi said arrogantly.
Lu Muqing, hearing this, curled his lips into a mocking smile and said, “You think you share the same status as me?”
Lin Yi, feeling his temper flare upon hearing Lu Muqing’s arrogant and presumptuous words.
This man, dare to scorn him, did he think he didn’t exist?
“Lin Yi, although I do not know who you are, I want to tell you that it doesn’t matter who I am,” Lu Muqing said.
“Oh?” Lin Yi, feeling even more displeased, thought, what does he mean by this? Could it be that he looks down on Lin Yi?
Lin Yi asked, “So, Young Master Lu, what are your conditions for cooperating with me?”
“To cooperate with you would naturally be mutually beneficial. I want to know what Mr. Lin wants to do, and you should also have guessed what I want to do,” Lu Muqing stated indifferently.
Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat upon hearing Lu Muqing’s words; it seemed this man was not so foolish after all.
Lin Yi thought for a moment, then said with a smile, “Well, Young Master Lu, if we cooperate and develop the Lin Family’s influence together, I believe, in the future, the Lin Family’s enterprises could belong to both of our families!”
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lu Muqing snorted coldly, “Why should I cooperate with you? Who do you think you are to want to control the entire Lin Family’s enterprises?”
Lin Yi said, “Young Master Lu, that’s not right. Although I’m not from the Lin Family, I can still help the Lu Family develop the Lin Family’s enterprises.”
Lu Muqing chuckled disdainfully, “Heh, Mr. Lin, you’re not even qualified to talk about cooperation with me. You’re just a jumping jack. What makes you think you can cooperate with me?”
“Whether I’m qualified to cooperate with you, Young Master Lu, I believe I am!” Lin Yi said.
“Are you sure?” Lu Muqing asked in return.
Lin Yi confidently replied, “Of course! I think that with my reputation in the business world and the Lu Family’s influence in the political arena, I should be qualified to cooperate with Young Master Lu, right?”
Lu Muqing couldn’t help but laugh when he heard these words.
Smiling, he said, “Lin Yi, I think you may have misunderstood my intentions. I would naturally have no doubts about your reputation, but what qualifications do you have to work with me? Do you think I would cooperate with a nobody without any ability?”
“Mr. Lu, although you are the young master of the Lu Family, I feel that the Lu Family’s overseas enterprises aren’t strong enough for you to handle alone. I think it’s better for you to cooperate with me; I can greatly enhance your strength,” Lin Yi confidently stated.
Hearing this, Lu Muqing couldn’t help but let out a sneer, “You truly are arrogant. However, I don’t like working with people who overestimate their capabilities.”
“Mr. Lu, I disagree with what you’re saying. If I’m seeking to work with you, it’s certainly because I have something to rely on. And that something is the twenty-five percent of Lin Corporation’s shares that I hold in my hands!” Lin Yi declared.
The condition Lin Yi put forward indeed caught Lu Muqing’s interest.
The purpose of Lin Yi proposing this condition was actually to regain those twenty-five percent shares, which he had bought back with several billion US dollars. If he could get the shares back into his own hands, nothing could be better.
This was also why he had come to the Lu Family—for the relationship between the Lin and Lu families was one that spanned generations.
The Lu Family was a huge financial consortium with family assets exceeding ten billion; in Yanjing, they were a colossal entity, a vassal of the Lin Family.
Now holding twenty percent of Lin Corporation’s shares, it was tantamount to having thirty percent of the shares under his control; this would be incredibly beneficial for him in the future when managing the entire Lin Corporation.
Lu Muqing’s eyes narrowed as he looked at the other party, “Lin Yi, do you think I would cooperate with you?”
“What? You’re unwilling?” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Of course, I’m unwilling,” Lu Muqing replied. “However, my purpose in coming to Yanjing was to buy the stocks you have. If you’re willing to sell the shares to me, maybe I’ll consider the proposal you just made.”
Lin Yi raised his eyebrows and said, “Mr. Lu, what benefit is there for you in doing this?”
“I don’t lack money,” Lu Muqing responded. “I need a partner.”
After contemplating for a moment, Lin Yi said, “Since that’s the case, let’s each take what we need.”
“Good, that would be best,” Lu Muqing replied.
“So, when do we start our collaboration?” inquired Lin Yi.
“Tonight, at my villa. You can come to see me whenever you like,” Lu Muqing said. “I think, on my own turf, dealing with you won’t be a difficult task.”
Lin Yi felt a tinge of fear in his heart upon hearing Lu Muqing’s words.
He was aware of Lu Muqing’s capabilities.
Lin Yi didn’t immediately reply but pondered for a while.
After a short time, he looked up and said, “Mr. Lu, in that case, I’ll await your call in Yanjing.”
“I hope, Mr. Lin, that you won’t disappoint me!” Lu Muqing said, his lips curling into a smile as he looked at him.
“You won’t be disappointed, I assure you that I won’t let you down, Mr. Lu,” Lin Yi responded.
“Hmm, then let’s leave it at that, Mr. Lin. I have other matters to attend to and must take my leave now. Until next time!” Lu Muqing stood up and walked toward the door, “Oh right, I forgot to tell you, my name is Lu Muqing. In the future, don’t call me ‘Mr. Lu’; just use my name.”
“Understood, I’ll remember that,” Lin Yi quickly replied.
Lin Yi stood up from the sofa and watched as Lu Muqing walked away, a ray of darkness flashing through his eyes.
Lu Muqing, I will make sure you realize that missing out on me is a decision you’ll regret for the rest of your life.
A malicious expression appeared on Lin Yi’s face.

chapters.title: Chapter 741 - 741 741 Running into Trouble
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 741: Chapter 741: Running into Trouble Chapter 741: Chapter 741: Running into Trouble Lu Muqing stepped out of the hotel, got into the car, and instructed the driver, “Back to the Lu Family villa.”
“Yes.”
After Lu Muqing returned to the Lu Family villa, he went straight upstairs to wash up in his bedroom.
Lin Yi left the hotel and drove straight back to the company, planning to call a board meeting to discuss collaboration with Lu Muqing.
Once seated in the conference room, Lin Yi began, “Ladies and gentlemen of the board, I think the Lin Family has recently encountered a problem, and I believe this problem is not an ordinary one. Thus, I think it’s time we prepare comprehensively to face the enemy.”
The board members all looked towards Lin Yi. They clearly understood that all this had to do with the Lin Family; otherwise, Lin Yi would not have suddenly called a board meeting and spoken such disheartening words, but no one dared to say anything.
Because, currently, the strongest opponent of the Lin Corporation was the Lin Family itself.
“I wonder if President Lin has thought of a way to deal with Lu Muqing?” an elderly man asked, looking at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi said, “Lu Muqing is not a simple man. He has a wealth of practical experience. Although our Lin Family occupies a huge advantage in the munitions market, his military industry also holds a significant advantage over us. To defeat Lu Muqing, we must come up with a comprehensive plan and only then can we beat him.”
“President Lin, with the Lin Corporation facing a crisis, what are your plans?” a middle-aged man inquired.
Lin Yi was silent for a moment before replying, “I have already thought of a plan. However, I hope that all of you, the directors, will support me.”
“President Lin, please do give your orders. We will certainly assist you with all our might!” the directors said one after another.
Lin Yi, feeling somewhat comforted upon hearing this, said, “Now, I want you to keep a close watch on Lu Muqing. The moment he takes any action, inform me immediately. I will tell you how to contact him.”
“Yes!” the directors nodded.
Lin Yi watched them nod in agreement and sighed with relief, saying, “Alright, everyone, please continue with your work.”
Lin Yi’s gaze fell on the other shareholders of the Lin Family.
These shareholders were closely related to his father, which was why they could attend the board meeting.
Although these individuals were well aware that there would inevitably be a struggle between Lin Yi and Lu Muqing for the shares of the Lin Corporation, they were still brothers after all. If Lin Yi needed anything, they would still wholeheartedly offer their help, as this was the brotherly bond between them.
Therefore, Lin Yi had called them for a meeting to share the strategies he had devised and to seek their advice and assistance.
“President Lin, I believe that only you and I know about this matter,” a shareholder said. “I think that you are the only one who can handle this properly.”
“Indeed, President Lin, you must be cautious at this time and not act rashly,” another director added.
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly as he looked at the two directors and said, “Do you suggest that I give up on taking action against Lu Muqing? Impossible!”
Lin Yi spoke with firm resolve, evidently intent on securing a victory over Lu Muqing.
Seeing his determination, they knew that no matter what they said, Lin Yi would not change his mind.
“In that case, we can only respect your decision,” they said in unison.
“Right, then go back to your own affairs,” Lin Yi said.
The individuals stood up and left the conference room.
Lin Yi sat in his chair, fists clenched, with an exceedingly chilling expression. He was seething with hatred but felt utterly helpless.
“Dad, you must avenge me!” Lin Yi screamed internally.
He now only hoped that the Lin Family could return to normal operations soon, so that they wouldn’t have to worry about being overwhelmed by the Lu Family.
After having lunch, Lu Muqing and Xia Nuan went to the hospital together to check Xia Nuan’s wounds.
Since the location of the injury was quite concealed, Xia Nuan didn’t know that her wound had been treated and could only see the scar without any bleeding.
Xia Nuan asked the doctor, “How is my wound looking?”
“The healing process is going very well, however, you must be careful during this period, don’t get it wet, avoid eating spicy and irritating food, and above all, don’t let the wound reopen, or else you might need an amputation,” the doctor said.
Startled by the doctor’s words, Xia Nuan exclaimed, “Amputation?”
“Yes, amputation,” the doctor nodded and added, “The severity of your wound is such that if scarring continues to worsen, it could even lead to disfigurement and, what’s more serious, amputation would mean you can no longer become pregnant.”
“I… can’t become pregnant?” Xia Nuan’s eyes widened in shock, her face a picture of disbelief.
The doctor nodded again, “Yes, you should be emotionally prepared for this situation.”
Xia Nuan’s heart was on the verge of leaping out. How could this be?
How could she ever get pregnant?
No wonder he was so frenzied last night, it turned out that she simply couldn’t get pregnant.
Xia Nuan couldn’t help but recall the events of that night.
Lu Muqing kept demanding, while she was crying and pleading with him, yet he did not stop.
She couldn’t help but wonder, had she been on medication before?
The scenes began to flood Xia Nuan’s mind, causing her cheeks to flush with embarrassment and indignation.
“Then… why is my wound healing so slowly?” Xia Nuan asked in a soft voice.
“Your wound has affected your internal organs, and there’s fluid accumulation inside. If the fluid isn’t drained, your wound will have difficulty healing, and it might even never fully recover. However, these issues can be resolved, the main thing is to drain all the fluid from the internal organs,” the doctor explained.
“Drain it?” Xia Nuan asked.
“Yes, drain it!” the doctor nodded.
“But how can it be drained? My wound has already closed up,” Xia Nuan asked, puzzled.
The doctor laughed and replied, “Heh, your wound may have closed, but it hasn’t healed properly. This is something I can’t easily explain, I can only tell you that your condition is caused by this fluid. Once the fluid is drained, your body won’t have any more problems, and the fluid will even help your scars disappear without leaving a trace.”
Reassured by the doctor’s explanation, Xia Nuan said, “I see, thank you, doctor.”
“It’s part of my job,” the doctor smiled and replied.
Leaving the doctor’s office, Xia Nuan felt somewhat exhausted.
Lu Muqing asked her, “Tired? Why don’t you go back and rest for a while? Later, I’ll have Mrs. Li make you a nutritious soup.”
“No need, I don’t want to eat,” Xia Nuan shook her head.
“What’s the matter? Don’t you want to have my children, or do you not want kids at all?” Lu Muqing frowned and asked.
“How could that be? I just feel that with the injury on my leg, I’m not fit to be a mommy. I want to wait until my injury heals before considering it,” Xia Nuan said in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 742 - 742 742 Getting Closer
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 742: Chapter 742 Getting Closer Chapter 742: Chapter 742 Getting Closer Lu Muqing nodded, “Alright, once your injury is healed, we’ll have a child.”
Xia Nuan nodded, but her heart was filled with bitterness. The relationship between her and Lu Muqing had not yet blossomed into full fruition, and now they were talking about having children, which seemed to bring them even closer together.
However, she was very clear in her mind that this matter couldn’t be rushed.
After returning to the room, Lu Muqing went to deal with company affairs, while Xia Nuan lay in bed to rest and fell asleep without realizing it.
Lu Muqing returned to the room and saw the sleeping Xia Nuan, feeling a softness in his heart. He walked over, gently picked her up, and placed her on the bed, tucking her in and whispering in her ear, “Wife, goodnight!”
Then, he left her room and went to the study to handle the company documents.
He worked at his desk for the entire day, and by the time he returned to the bedroom, it was already around eight or nine in the evening.
When he pushed the door open to enter the bedroom, he found that Xia Nuan had already awakened.
He asked, “You’re awake, are you hungry? What would you like to eat? I’ll cook for you.”
Xia Nuan nodded, “Yes, please cook for me, I’m a bit hungry now.”
“Alright, just wait a moment,” Lu Muqing said and then entered the kitchen. He took out ingredients from the refrigerator, planning to cook them himself.
However, as soon as he opened the refrigerator, he saw that it was filled with all sorts of food ingredients, and all of them were nutritious supplements.
“These were all bought for you, to nourish your body and help with your injury,” Lu Muqing said to Xia Nuan.
Xia Nuan was startled, “Nutritional supplements bought for me? My injury isn’t serious anymore, do we still need to buy these?”
“Of course we need to buy,” Lu Muqing said.
Seeing his insistence, Xia Nuan could only helplessly nod, “Alright then.”
So, Lu Muqing got busy in the kitchen. He prepared the ingredients, then started to stew them in the pot.
Soon enough, the fragrance wafted to Xia Nuan’s nose, making her stomach growl even louder.
“I’m really getting hungry, hurry up, I can hardly take it!” Xia Nuan couldn’t help urging him.
Lu Muqing smiled, turned off the stove, brought the pot to the dining table, and stir-fried a few dishes before finally bringing them out of the kitchen.
Seeing Lu Muqing bring out the dishes, Xia Nuan couldn’t help but swallow saliva, “It smells so good!”
“Alright, try it and see how it tastes,” Lu Muqing passed her the chopsticks.
Xia Nuan picked up a piece of rib and put it in her mouth; instantly, her mouth was filled with the delicious rich flavor of ribs.
“Wow, it’s so delicious!” Xia Nuan complimented.
Lu Muqing watched her, a hint of amusement twinkling in his eyes, and then asked, “If you like it, I can cook pork rib soup for you every day. You should be very happy eating the meals I prepare for you, right?”
After thinking for a moment, Xia Nuan nodded, “Mhm.”
Lu Muqing was pleased with her agreement.
“Let’s get married then, let’s get married right away,” Lu Muqing said.
Xia Nuan looked up at him, “Married? Why get married?”
“To have children!” Lu Muqing stated matter-of-factly.
“Uh… to have children, let’s discuss that further. My leg is injured right now, I don’t want to have children,” Xia Nuan refused.
Lu Muqing furrowed his brow, “So you don’t want to have children because you don’t like them?”
“Not at all,” Xia Nuan immediately said.
“Then what kind of children do you like?” Lu Muqing asked.
After thinking about it, Xia Nuan said, “I like both boys and girls.”
“You like both boys and girls? Well, I can definitely provide a boy, but I wonder if I can at all help you have a girl?” Lu Muqing asked.
“I like both boys and girls. If you want, we can have one,” Xia Nuan said.
“Okay, I’ll listen to you, we’ll have a daughter,” Lu Muqing said seriously.
“But what if it’s a son?” Xia Nuan retorted.
“Then we’ll have a daughter!” Lu Muqing said without hesitation.
“…” Xia Nuan was speechless. How could this man be so domineering, just saying to have a child like it’s nothing!
However, Xia Nuan didn’t dwell on the matter any longer. Right now, the most important thing was to heal properly. Whether it was a boy or a girl, she would love her all the same.
Lu Muqing served the dish into a plate and handed it to Xia Nuan, “Come on, try it and see if you like it?”
Taking it, Xia Nuan’s eyes lit up, and she exclaimed, “Wow! It’s really delicious, I love it so much.”
Seeing how pleased Xia Nuan was, Lu Muqing’s face revealed an indulgent smile.
Xia Nuan stayed in the hospital for five days, and after those five days, she was finally able to get out of bed and walk. She gradually became more lively, though still a bit weak, but at least she wasn’t as immobile as at the start.
After staying at Lu’s house for a few days, Lu Muqing took Xia Nuan to the amusement park for several days.
It had been a long while since Xia Nuan had played like this, so naturally, she was very excited, and her wounds had almost healed.
When Lu Muqing took her to the amusement park, she wasn’t as nervous and clumsy as she had been at the beginning; instead, she sat beside Lu Muqing on the Ferris wheel, looking at the scenery below, feeling pleased.
The Ferris wheel slowly rotated, reaching the highest level quickly before descending slowly.
Lu Muqing pulled Xia Nuan into his embrace and whispered, “Nuan Nuan, what is there to fear when I’m with you?”
“I’m not scared,” Xia Nuan said.
“Really not scared?” Lu Muqing asked.
“Really not scared. I’m just a little tired and resting in your arms,” Xia Nuan said.
“Alright then, rest in my arms for a while, I’ll go buy the tickets,” Lu Muqing said.
“Mhm, you go ahead, I’ll wait for you here,” Xia Nuan nodded.
Lu Muqing nodded, then went to buy the tickets.
Xia Nuan closed her eyes and rested.
After a while, Lu Muqing had bought the tickets and came over from the nearby seats, saying to Xia Nuan, “Nuan Nuan, let’s go in.”
“Okay,” Xia Nuan opened her eyes and stood up.
The two entered the Ferris wheel’s lobby, where the seats all had safety bars, and ordinary people couldn’t get in at all, but for Lu Muqing, even without safety bars, he could move freely among them.
Lu Muqing found a relatively empty seat and sat down, Xia Nuan followed and sat down as well, then asked, “How long are you planning to stay here this time?”
“Three or four days. After three or four days, I’ll take you out to play again, okay?” Lu Muqing asked.
“Mhm, okay.”
The two chatted on the Ferris wheel for a while when Xia Nuan’s phone suddenly rang. She took out her phone and saw it was Lin Yi calling.
She hesitated for a moment, then pressed the answer button.
“Hello, Uncle Chen,” Xia Nuan called out.
After a moment of silence on the other end, Lin Yi spoke up, “Nuan Nuan, where are you now?”
Xia Nuan was taken aback, “I’m on the Ferris wheel, just strolling around. What’s up, Uncle Chen, did you need me for something?”
“Oh, no particular reason. I was just wondering if you had time to have a meal with me, and to chat a bit. Would you do me the honor?” Lin Yi asked.
“If Uncle Chen is inviting me to dinner, of course I would,” Xia Nuan replied immediately.
“Great, I’ll send the address to your phone in a moment, and you can come right over,” Lin Yi said, then hung up the phone.
Xia Nuan heard the beep of the disconnected call and was baffled. She didn’t know why Lin Yi wanted to invite her for a meal. Could it be because of the last time at Ocean Park?

chapters.title: Chapter 743 - 743 743 Not a Petty-minded Person
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 743: Chapter 743: Not a Petty-minded Person Chapter 743: Chapter 743: Not a Petty-minded Person Thinking of this, Xia Nuan couldn’t help but sigh. She found Lin Yi quite interesting for taking the initiative to contact her under these circumstances. Didn’t he worry about clashing with Lu Muqing?
Xia Nuan shook her head, feeling that Lin Yi probably wasn’t such a petty person.
“Nuan Nuan, what’s wrong? Who was that on the phone?” Lu Muqing saw Xia Nuan shaking her head and asked.
“It was Uncle Chen.”
“Oh? He’s invited you to dinner?”
“Yeah, he said he wanted to take me out to eat, and I agreed.”
“You should go. It’s a good chance for you to get out since you don’t have other plans. I’ll make sure Aunt Lee looks after you at home. Rest assured, I won’t let anyone bother you. Go ahead,” Lu Muqing said with a smile.
“Alright, then I’ll be going,” Xia Nuan nodded.
“Go on,” Lu Muqing said.
“Mm.”
After getting off the Ferris wheel, Xia Nuan called Lin Yi back.
As soon as the line connected, Lin Yi’s voice came through, “Nuan Nuan, where are you? I’ve sent the address to your phone. I’m waiting for you at the entrance.”
“Okay, I’m on my way,” Xia Nuan replied.
When Xia Nuan arrived at the Ferris wheel entrance, she saw Lin Yi’s car parked there.
“Nuan Nuan, over here,” Lin Yi called out.
Xia Nuan saw Lin Yi had already walked to the car, so she quickly made her way over.
“Uncle Chen,” Xia Nuan greeted politely. Although it was their second meeting, she felt a genuine warmth from Uncle Chen, so she had a very good impression of him.
“Yeah, Nuan Nuan, take my car,” Lin Yi said.
“Okay,” Xia Nuan nodded.
Lin Yi’s car had air-conditioning, which made it cool and comfortable inside. Xia Nuan found it very pleasant.
“Uncle Chen, what would you like to eat? It’s my treat!” Xia Nuan asked.
“Anything’s fine, I’ll have whatever you’re having,” Lin Yi replied.
Xia Nuan glanced at the menu and said, “Then let’s have spicy hot pot!”
“Sure,” Lin Yi nodded.
Xia Nuan added, “The taste of spicy hot pot is really fresh and flavorful, and it comes with soup and meats. It’s very delicious after you eat it.”
Lin Yi smiled and said, “Since it’s so delicious, you should eat a lot of it.”
“I will.”
“Then let’s head over now and start our meal,” Lin Yi suggested.
“Okay,” Xia Nuan agreed.
The two of them left the Ferris wheel and went to a nearby restaurant.
After they had ordered, Lin Yi asked, “Nuan Nuan, what brings you to the capital this time?”
“Oh, it’s nothing much, just wanted to relax in the capital. Staying at home all this time was suffocating,” Xia Nuan lied.
“I see. Well, when you have time, you should get out more,” Lin Yi laughed.
“Mm,” Xia Nuan nodded.
“By the way, I heard you’re working with Interpol now. Do you know what they do?” Lin Yi asked further.
“Uh, Interpol? I’m not quite sure,” Xia Nuan shook her head.
“In that case, after we’ve eaten, you should give me a tour of the Interpol training base, let me learn a bit too,” Lin Yi suggested.
After thinking it over, Xia Nuan replied, “Okay, sure.”
Soon, the dishes they ordered were served. Xia Nuan looked at the table full of dishes, swallowing involuntarily.
Although she enjoyed spicy food, she seldom ate it, but the offerings laid out before her were very tempting, sending her appetite surging.
Xia Nuan picked up the chopsticks, took a piece of braised beef and put it into her mouth. The beef tasted excellent, and it was fresh, tender, and juicy, offering an exceptionally smooth eating experience.
“How is it, do these dishes suit your taste?” Lin Yi asked.
“Yes, they’re delicious, thank you for your hospitality,” Xia Nuan said gratefully.
“Don’t mention it, as long as you enjoy the food, that’s what matters,” Lin Yi replied.
“Then I won’t hold back,” Xia Nuan said.
Xia Nuan took a piece of lamb meat, chewed it, and immediately felt its fragrant taste. She picked up another piece and put it in her mouth.
After eating, Xia Nuan gave Lin Yi a thumbs-up, “Uncle Chen, I find your cooking skills have improved greatly, on par with chefs from Five-Star hotels.”
“Hehe, I didn’t do much, it’s all self-taught. Moreover, the dishes here are quite spicy, which makes them very satisfying to eat. Nuan Nuan, if you like spicy food, eat more. It’s good for your health,” Lin Yi said.
“Okay,” Xia Nuan nodded, picking up a piece of beef and savoring its fresh and juicy taste, overwhelming her taste buds. She couldn’t help but sniff and said, “Uncle Chen, your cooking is really wonderful.”
“Haha, I’m glad you like it. If you don’t mind, next time you come to the capital, you can visit often. I’ll make sure to arrange the tastiest food for you,” Lin Yi offered.
Xia Nuan nodded, “I will remember your kindness.”
“Haha, can I take that to mean you already consider me as one of your own?” Lin Yi asked happily.
“Yes, I already see Uncle Chen as my elder,” Xia Nuan replied.
“Hahaha…” Lin Yi laughed heartily, “You calling me Uncle Chen makes me very happy.”
“By the way, Nuan Nuan, I still don’t know your surname,” Lin Yi suddenly asked.
Xia Nuan thought for a moment, “My name is Xia Nuan, Uncle Chen, you can call me Little Nuan.”
“Xia Nuan? That’s a very pleasant-sounding name,” Lin Yi commented.
“Thank you,” Xia Nuan nodded.
“No need for thanks. We’re about the same age, and I might ask for your help in the future, so I can’t be polite with you,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Alright, let’s not talk about other things for now, let’s drink,” Xia Nuan raised her glass and proposed.
“Sure.”
The two of them downed their drinks, and Lin Yi poured himself another glass of red wine.
Lin Yi looked at Xia Nuan and said, “Little Nuan, are you facing some difficulties?”
At his words, Xia Nuan’s face showed an embarrassed expression, for she indeed had troubles.
“It’s alright to tell Uncle Lin about it. Maybe I can help solve your problems,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
Xia Nuan nodded and recounted her situation with Jun Lin.
After listening, Lin Yi was silent for a moment and asked, “So, you’re saying your boyfriend is a soldier? And an officer at that?”
Xia Nuan nodded.
“Then your relationship must be quite challenging,” Lin Yi said with concern.
“It’s okay. As long as I can be with him, no matter how difficult, it doesn’t matter to me,” Xia Nuan replied.
Lin Yi nodded, then took out a card from his pocket, slid it across to Xia Nuan, and said, “This card contains some of my assets. Take it for now. You don’t seem like a girl who lacks money.”
“Uncle Lin, how can this be alright?” Xia Nuan said, declining the offer.
“It’s fine, just take it. If you run into any trouble later, you can come to me for help,” Lin Yi insisted.
“Uncle Lin, thank you for your kind offer, but you should keep the money. If I really need help, I will definitely come to you,” Xia Nuan said.
“Since you insist, then I won’t force it on you,” Lin Yi put away the card.
Seeing Lin Yi’s smile, Xia Nuan felt he was a good person and thought that if she ever encountered a problem she couldn’t solve, she would ask for his help.
“Uncle Chen, there are a few words I want to say to you, if you’re willing to listen?” Xia Nuan said.
“Sure, go ahead, I’m all ears,” Lin Yi replied.
Xia Nuan thought for a moment, then shared the story of her parents, concluding with, “Uncle Chen, my parents divorced when I was just born.
And my mother was injured in a car accident and lost her memory, while her husband married another woman. That’s truly cruel for a mother who has lost her memory.”

chapters.title: Chapter 744 - 744 744 Fate Plays Tricks on People
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 744: Chapter 744: Fate Plays Tricks on People Chapter 744: Chapter 744: Fate Plays Tricks on People After listening, Lin Yi sighed, “Alas, there are too many such incidents happening in society now. Some things can’t be blamed on others, but only on fate playing tricks on people. As time passes, these things will become unimportant. Don’t take it to heart anymore.”
Xia Nuan nodded and said, “Mm, Uncle Lin, I’m touched that you can say that, but I still hope you won’t forget the matter you promised to help my father with.”
“Rest assured, I definitely won’t forget. You should go back and rest for a bit,” Lin Yi said with a smile.
Xia Nuan nodded.
After sending Xia Nuan away, Lin Yi went to his study and made a phone call: “Hello, Boss? It’s me, Lin Yi. Are you still at home?”
“Yes, what’s the matter?” came the voice of Lin Yi’s superior, Wu Wenxuan, from the other end of the line.
“It’s like this, are you still at home? I want to ask you to do me a favor, I need to know the specific address of Xia Yuan, the president of Xia Group,” Lin Yi said.
There was a moment of surprise from Wu Wenxuan on the other end of the line—he had not expected Lin Yi to suddenly ask him to do such a peculiar task.
But Wu Wenxuan was a clever man who wouldn’t ask why. He simply said, “No problem, I happen to know someone who knows Xia Yuan. If you want to meet him, just wait for my notification.”
“Thank you, Boss. When I have the time, I must treat you to a good meal as thanks,” Lin Yi said.
“It’s nothing, we are partners. There’s no need for such formalities. Just remember I’m doing this for you because I should. Just wait for my notification with peace of mind,” Wu Wenxuan said.
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi took a deep breath. Although this task seemed simple, it was actually quite difficult to find Xia Yuan, the president of Xia Group.
Moreover, he didn’t know how Wu Wenxuan was actually going to contact Xia Yuan. What if he was rejected?
Lin Yi shook his head, not wanting to think too much. After all, his only intention was to find him, not to have him help with anything else.
With this thought, Lin Yi went to the kitchen and instructed the servants to prepare dinner.
He didn’t know how long had passed when Lin Yi received a call from Wu Wenxuan.
“Brother Lin, I’ve sent you the address of Xia Group. Check it for yourself,” Wu Wenxuan said.
“Thank you for the trouble.”
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi immediately dialed Xia Yuan’s number.
“Hello, may I ask who’s speaking?” A delicate voice came from the other end of the phone.
Lin Yi frowned upon hearing this and asked, “Who are you?”
“Oh, I’m your fiancée. Can’t you even recognize my voice?” the voice at the other end said with a tone of complaint.
As soon as Lin Yi heard the voice, he realized the identity of the phone owner—it was Xia Nuan’s best friend, also Wu Wenxuan’s fiancée, Su Mengyao.
Realizing this, Lin Yi was a bit embarrassed and didn’t know how to continue the call.
After thinking for a while, Lin Yi said, “I’m not Xia Yuan. I’m a friend of Xia Nuan. I’m currently at Xia Nuan’s home. Do you have time to join me for dinner?”
“Oh? What do you want with Xia Yuan?” Su Mengyao asked, puzzled.
“That…that’s none of your concern,” Lin Yi said evasively.
“Alright. I’m at home now. Come over,” Su Mengyao said.
“Okay.”
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi left the house and drove to Su Mengyao’s place.
Su Mengyao sat on the couch and watched as Lin Yi approached.
“Brother Lin, why don’t you call me Mengyao? My name is Mengyao, but you’ve never called me that.”
“Mengyao,” Lin Yi called out, awkwardly.
“Oh my, why are you being so formal, aren’t we friends?” Su Mengyao said.
“Mengyao, as long as you don’t mind,” Lin Yi said.
“Mind? Of course not, I’m very happy to know a talented person like Brother Lin,” Su Mengyao said.
“Thank you for your praise. The reason I came to see you is that I have a favor to ask of you,” Lin Yi said.
“What kind of favor?”
“Here’s the thing, I want to discuss a business deal with Xia Yuan, but I’m not very familiar with him, so I was hoping you could show me the way,” Lin Yi said.
“You want to find Xia Yuan?” Su Mengyao asked in surprise.
“Yes,” Lin Yi nodded and said.
“Are you sure?”
“Certain,” Lin Yi replied very confidently.
After pondering for a moment, Su Mengyao said, “The person you’re looking for is Xia Yuan, but you wouldn’t be acquainted with him, right? How come you want to find him?”
“How do you know I don’t know Xia Yuan?” Lin Yi asked.
Shaking her head, Su Mengyao said, “Brother Lin, not to hide it from you, I don’t know whether you’re acquainted with Xia Yuan. But if you’re thinking of talking business with him, I feel you shouldn’t seek him out lightly. Otherwise, I’m worried it might be dangerous for you.”
“It’s not about danger, but rather I want Xia Yuan to do me a favor. I need the platform of the Xia Group to help expand our company’s business. That’s why I want to talk to him. If the conversation goes well, I’ll try to persuade him to invest in our company. If it doesn’t, I can’t force him to do anything he’s uncomfortable with,” Lin Yi explained.
With a nod, Su Mengyao said, “If that’s the case, then I can try to help. But there’s an element of chance involved because Xia Yuan is not just any businessman. I can’t guarantee he’ll grant you this favor.”
“I appreciate the help,” Lin Yi said.
“What’s there to thank me for? You’re Xia Nuan’s most important friend. It’s only right for me to help you. Moreover, you have helped Xia Yuan before. I believe there’s a reason for your actions. If it’s because of money, then I’d advise you not to make such a foolish move again,” Su Mengyao warned.
“Thank you, Mengyao,” Lin Yi said gratefully. He had not expected Su Mengyao to be so sensible. She knew the foolish things he had done, and he would remember this kindness and repay it when the opportunity arose.
Su Mengyao smiled and said, “Don’t mention it. You’re Xia Nuan’s most important friend. It’s only right for me to help you. Alright, time’s about up. Go get ready, and once you are, I’ll take you to see Xia Yuan.”
“Alright, thank you,” Lin Yi said.
“There’s no need to thank me. We’re friends, and friends help each other out. Well, I’ve got another call to make, so I’ll hang up first,” Su Mengyao said and then ended the call.
Lin Yi hung up and immediately called his secretary, Li Hao, to bring the car over and get ready to go to the Xia Group.
Half an hour later, Lin Yi arrived at the base of the Xia Group building.
Seeing him, Li Hao quickly jumped out of the car and helped with the luggage, saying, “Young Master Lin, this is the Xia Group. Who are you here to see?”
“I’m looking for Xia Yuan, your chairman,” Lin Yi said.
“Very well, please follow me,” Li Hao said and then led Lin Yi toward the elevator.
Upon reaching the top floor’s CEO office, the secretary quickly stood up and slightly bowed, saying, “Young Master Lin, welcome. Please come in; the chairman is in his office right now.”
“Thank you,” Lin Yi said.
Lin Yi entered Xia Yuan’s office and found him reviewing documents at his desk.
Hearing footsteps, Xia Yuan looked up, saw Lin Yi, and his expression darkened slightly.
“Xia Yuan, long time no see,” Lin Yi said.
Xia Yuan too was surprised to see Lin Yi. Why had he come to see him? Wasn’t he with the Zhao Family’s daughter? What did Lin Yi want with him?
“Do you have business with me?” Xia Yuan asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 745 - 745 745 Drinking Coffee Together
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 745: Chapter 745: Drinking Coffee Together Chapter 745: Chapter 745: Drinking Coffee Together “Can’t I look for you if there’s nothing wrong?”
“Of course you can, but what could you possibly want with me?”
Lin Yi laughed and said, “Didn’t you say you wanted to have coffee with me? Well, here I am.”
Xia Yuan was taken aback, not expecting Lin Yi to suddenly bring this up. He couldn’t help but ask, “How did you know about this?”
“Who am I, have you forgotten? I’m Xia Nuan’s cousin. My informants are spread throughout Yanjing. It’s too easy for me to find out your whereabouts,” Lin Yi said.
“Hehe, so that’s how it is.”
“So what will it be? What would you like to drink, coffee? Tea? Or maybe wine?” Lin Yi smiled.
“As long as you’re treating, anything is fine,” Xia Yuan said.
Lin Yi nodded and replied, “Alright, it’s on me. Let’s go.”
The two of them came shoulder to shoulder to a coffee shop where Lin Yi ordered two cups of cappuccinos.
“Why are you looking for me? I thought you were the Zhao family’s heiress,” Xia Yuan asked.
“The Zhao family’s heiress? I don’t know her, I merely heard from my sister that you and Xia Nuan are good friends, so I wanted to come over to see for myself if you’re as wealthy as she mentioned,” Lin Yi explained.
“Haha, I didn’t expect Mr. Lin to be so humorous and funny, I like that.”
“Save your flattery. Come on, tell me, what’s your real purpose for meeting me? Do we have some business proposition to discuss?” Xia Yuan cut to the chase.
“Indeed, there is a business proposition, and it’s a big one at that. I’m hoping to partner with you. Are you willing to work with me?” Lin Yi asked.
Upon hearing this, Xia Yuan’s expression changed slightly, and he coldly laughed, “So that’s why you came to find me, for this business deal. You really think highly of me, even going so far as to come here in person. Are you trying to slap me in the face?”
“How could that be? I just think you’re a great person, and I trust my own judgment,” Lin Yi replied.
“What an honor it is to be praised by Mr. Lin. What kind of business are we talking about? Let’s hear it,” Xia Yuan asked coldly.
“Sit down first, and then I’ll go over it with you slowly,” Lin Yi suggested.
“Alright.”
They took their seats as host and guest respectively.
Lin Yi took out a piece of paper from her bag, placed it on the table, and pushed it towards Xia Yuan.
“What’s this inside your mysterious paper?” Xia Yuan inquired.
“It’s a project under the Xia Group that I need to bid for, and it’s a really big one, worth hundreds of millions. If we can secure this project, Lin Corporation will leap to become the number one enterprise in Huaxia. Take a look,” Lin Yi elaborated.
Xia Yuan picked up the paper and examined it closely before realizing that the name of the project was ‘Marine Century,’ the very project Lin Yi was interested in.
“The person in charge of this project is Xia Yuan?” Lin Yi inquired.
“Yes, he’s the one in charge. I’ve also heard this project is huge and very profitable, so that’s why I came looking for him, hoping he could help me get involved. If we succeed, our Lin Corporation can also become a globally renowned large group. When that happens, it won’t be so easy for your Xia family to suppress Lin Corporation,” Lin Yi said with pride.
Xia Yuan snorted coldly and said, “Are you threatening me?”
Lin Yi waved her hand and clarified, “Not at all, I’m just stating the facts. Xia Yuan, this project is extremely important to Lin Corporation, and our global influence is no small matter. I came to Yanjing for this project, so consider helping me out, won’t you?”
“I do want to do you this favor, Mr. Lin, but I can’t put myself at risk because of it. It’s too dangerous for me. So I can’t agree to this. I’ll have to discuss it with Xia Nuan when I get back. How about this, I’ll give you an answer tomorrow, okay?” Xia Yuan proposed.
Lin Yi looked at Xia Yuan and said, “That’s fine then. Think it over carefully, this is not a small deal. Make sure you give it some good thought.”
“I’m aware, and I’ll definitely try my best to secure this project. You can count on me, Mr. Lin,” Xia Yuan said.
“Alright, then it’s settled. I’m heading back now; you should rest early as well, good night.”
“Good night, I hope you’ll keep your word.”
“Don’t worry, I always keep my word, let’s go.”
After Xia Yuan and Lin Yi said their goodbyes, they left the café. Meanwhile, inside the coffee shop—
“Madam Boss, what’s the name of the person who came with Xia Yuan just now?” Xia Nuan asked.
“Oh, his last name is Lin, Lin Yi. I don’t know who he is, only that his relationship with Xia Yuan is unusual.”
“Lin Yi?” Xia Nuan’s brows furrowed slightly; she hadn’t expected her whereabouts to be discovered so quickly this time.
She wanted Lin Yi to find out exactly where she was so she could complete her plan quietly, but before she could make her move, Xia Yuan had already learned of her whereabouts.
“Lin Yi, I’m actually quite curious to see what tricks you’ll play this time.”
Xia Nuan thought to herself.
…
The next morning.
“Knock, knock.”
A knocking sound came, awakening the still-slumbering Lin Yi.
“Come in.”
A tall and slender figure entered. She was dressed very sexy, in a tight black leather jacket that showcased her curvaceous figure perfectly.
This person was Xia Xue, Xia Yuan’s sister.
Seeing Xia Xue, Lin Yi’s face instantly turned ice cold as he asked sharply, “What are you doing here?”
Xia Xue ignored Lin Yi and went straight to sit down on the sofa, saying, “Brother, I stayed comfortably at your place last night. Today, I’m planning to return to my own home, so I especially came to say goodbye to you.”
Lin Yi said, “Didn’t you have a fallout with your dad? Just go live with your parents.”
“It’s none of your business,” Xia Xue rebutted unhesitantly.
“It’s none of my business? Shouldn’t I care? I’m your brother!” Lin Yi said.
