“I don’t have a brother like you, don’t make unfounded connections! My father doesn’t acknowledge you as my brother at all. You might as well give up that idea early on, you’re wasting your efforts. No one is going to destroy my happiness!” Xia Xue declared.
“What do you mean by that?” Lin Yi asked.
“Exactly what it sounds like,” Xia Xue said.
Lin Yi let out a cold laugh and said, “It seems you still haven’t grasped the situation. We are on the same side now. You are not a match for Xia Nuan at the moment, but I’m your strongest backup. You’d better understand the situation clearly.”
“I don’t need to understand the situation, nor do I need your help. Just wait and watch the show, I’m going to show you that swallowing up Lin Corporation is absolutely impossible for you, and in the end, you’ll learn what regret means,” Xia Xue stated.
“Are you threatening me?” Lin Yi said angrily.
“Don’t get angry. What I’m saying is a fact. Don’t doubt my words, and don’t bother negotiating with me anymore. I won’t agree to your terms,” Xia Xue said.
“Xia Xue, I’m warning you again, don’t push your luck!” Lin Yi warned.
“I advise you to give up, you’re not my match,” Xia Xue said indifferently.
“Hmph, since you’re so confident, then try,” Lin Yi said coldly.
After speaking, Lin Yi turned and left the café, leaving behind an angry Xia Xue.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 746 - 746 746 Discussing Cooperation Matters
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 746: Chapter 746: Discussing Cooperation Matters Chapter 746: Chapter 746: Discussing Cooperation Matters The next day.
“Xia Yuan, do you need me for something?” Xia Xue said.
“I want to discuss some matters of cooperation with you.”
“What matters?” Xia Xue asked.
“It’s about this project, I suppose you know of it?” Lin Yi said.
“Yes, of course, I know.” Xia Xue nodded.
“Then you should also know, if our Xia Group secures this project, how much profit will I gain?
Our Xia Group’s products are very popular in this city, and we, the Xia Group, possess colossal influence in Yanjing.
You should be aware of what this project means for our Xia Group, right? If our Xia Group can acquire this project.
In that case, our company will grow even stronger, more powerful, but what about you? What will you gain? You are nothing but a pawn of our Xia Group!” Lin Yi said.
After hearing Lin Yi’s words, a flash of rage crossed Xia Xue’s eyes, but she quickly concealed it.
She said, “Lin Yi, don’t be too arrogant. Do you think I haven’t prepared for this time?
I have made full preparations. Do you think I will lose to you this time?”
“Humph, whether you are prepared or not is far from certain. You’d better cooperate with me obediently. If you try to play any tricks, don’t blame me for not being polite!” Lin Yi snorted coldly.
“Humph, I knew you were not harboring any good intentions, trying to pry words out of me. Not a chance,” Xia Xue defiantly said.
“Very good, then let us wait and see!”
Having said that, Lin Yi left the office.
After Lin Yi had left, Xia Xue’s gaze revealed a sneer of successful scheming.
Although Lin Yi seemed nice to her on the surface, in reality, he was using her to deal with Xia Nuan.
Xia Xue couldn’t help thinking that after so many years, Xia Nuan was still living freely out there, while her own life had been ruined by Lin Yi, and she held a deep hatred for Xia Nuan.
Finally, it was Xia Nuan’s turn to face disaster, as Lin Yi was about to make his move against her.
This time, she would not let Xia Nuan escape from her clutches.
She wanted Xia Nuan to fail completely and disappear forever from her sight, to make her understand that she was not someone to be trifled with.
Thinking this, Xia Xue dialed a number, saying, “Hello, it’s me, Xia Xue.”
After Xia Xue finished giving instructions, the person on the other end agreed to help and told her to rest assured.
All of this was the work of the dark forces supporting her.
A hint of cold light shot from Xia Xue’s eyes; her pent-up hatred was growing deeper, and she no longer wished to endure.
Moreover, her plan was almost in its final stages.
She decided to make Xia Nuan disappear from this world completely!
That way, she could get her hands on the Xia Family’s estate, and she could have everything she desired.
She wanted revenge on Xia Nuan, to see her ruined and disgraced, to make her understand the consequences of crossing her!
After leaving the company, Lin Yi did not immediately go to the hospital to see Xia Nuan; he wanted her to taste the bitterness he had once experienced.
Upon returning to the Xia Family home, Lin’s mother eagerly began relaying Xia Nuan’s various malicious deeds to Lin Yi.
After listening to his mother’s tales, Lin Yi’s eyes filled with a venomous look; all this was Xia Nuan’s doing!
“Mom, don’t worry, I will handle this matter myself, and I will personally send her to prison,” Lin Yi said firmly.
Upon seeing Lin Yi’s attitude, Lin’s mother was relieved. She feared that Lin Yi would be swayed by Xia Nuan and unwilling to take action.
Now that Lin Yi said he would personally act, Lin’s mother finally breathed a sigh of relief.
“Lin Yi, you must teach Xia Nuan a good lesson now, you must not let her off easily, let her know the consequences of offending me!”
Lin’s mother instructed.
“Hmm,” Lin Yi said.
Two hours later, Lin Yi went to the hospital and saw Xia Nuan, who was resting in the ward.
Seeing Lin Yi appear in her ward, Xia Nuan was also somewhat surprised. However, when she thought of Xia Yuan’s situation, her complexion instantly turned pale.
Lin Yi walked into the ward, coldly looking at Xia Nuan, and asked indifferently, “You’ve been doing quite well these days, haven’t you?”
“What do you want? I have nothing to do with you,” Xia Nuan replied coldly.
“Nothing to do with me? Then tell me, why did you abandon me in the first place?” Lin Yi asked.
“I didn’t abandon you, I had no choice but to break up with you,” she said.
Lin Yi said, “No choice? You had no choice but to abandon me? Then what was the reason you broke up with me at that time?”
“I’ve already ended things with you, I have no obligation to explain so much to you,” Xia Nuan said icily.
Lin Yi snorted coldly and asked, “Do you really not have any feelings for me? Did you not love me at all?”
“Of course not, I broke up with you because I didn’t like you. I didn’t like you, not because you were better than me, but because you simply weren’t worthy of my affection. I didn’t like you, so I broke up with you,” Xia Nuan flatly rejected.
“I don’t believe it, you clearly liked me. Why did you abandon me then? You’re just playing hard to get!” Lin Yi said coldly.
“I don’t know what you’re talking about!” Xia Nuan said.
“Xia Nuan, I know you’re feigning ignorance. You did this to gain Dad’s trust so that I would inherit the Lin Corporation in the future, right?”
“Lin Yi, whether you believe me or not, I’ve already said it, I didn’t do such a thing!” Xia Nuan said.
“Heh, Xia Nuan, I just knew you wouldn’t be so easily defeated by me. Unexpectedly, I’ve still seen through your ploy!”
Xia Nuan gave Lin Yi a cold glance and said, “Stop talking, I’ve already said it, I don’t love you, I don’t.”
“You say you don’t love me? Hahaha, Xia Nuan, I never thought you would be such a woman. When you proposed to me before, you said you loved me! What’s the matter now? Have you changed your mind?”
“The proposal was because I liked you, I hoped to marry you, but now there’s no need for that. There’s nothing between us anymore. I don’t need you to inherit the Lin Family Corporation, and I certainly don’t need you to inherit it, because I will make you pay the price!”
Xia Nuan said.
Lin Yi was shocked upon hearing Xia Nuan’s words. He never expected her to say such a thing; it was simply crazy.
How could he possibly allow his company to fall into someone else’s hands?
This company belonged to him; he was the chairman of the company. Xia Nuan was just an ordinary employee. How could she possibly inherit the company unless she had the ability?
Lin Yi said, “Xia Nuan, you indeed have some capability now to dare to say such things to me. Unfortunately, I’m not going to hand over my hard work so easily. Just wait for the punishment!”
After speaking, Lin Yi turned to leave, but at the moment he turned, two men suddenly charged from the side and stopped Lin Yi.
“Well, if it isn’t our young master Lin. What brings you to Xia Group’s territory? Quite a rare sight!” a man mocked.
These two men were security guards from the company’s security department. They usually enjoyed messing around with Lin Yi, and as a playful and reckless young master, he was notorious for his dalliances with various ladies.
Upon seeing these two men, Lin Yi immediately recognized their identities.

chapters.title: Chapter 747 - 747 747 Forcing to Take Over the Family
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 747: Chapter 747 Forcing to Take Over the Family Business Chapter 747: Chapter 747 Forcing to Take Over the Family Business Back when Lin Yi was still in high school, he was harassed by these two men, who then threatened him, saying that if he didn’t take over the family business, he would have to pay them a sum to get rid of them.
At the time, he was intimated by these two fuckers.
Later on, these two fuckers came back to him, forced him to take over the family business, had him become the president of Lin Corporation, and even demanded that he marry a good-looking beauty.
Lin Yi was cornered by them and told them that he didn’t like girls with heavy makeup, saying that he hated vulgar women the most, so he refused them and threatened them not to bother him anymore.
Afterward, Lin Yi’s father, Lin Yuanshan, had them leave Lin Corporation.
Unexpectedly, without these two people, Lin Corporation became an empty shell.
Lin Yi’s father was also furious and in a fit of anger, he moved out of the Lin Family villa to live elsewhere.
Because Lin Yi was kicked out of the house, his mother also divorced Lin Yuanshan.
And so, Lin Corporation collapsed.
This past memory is still vivid in Lin Yi’s mind, which is why he gets reminded of that unbearable past whenever he sees these two scumbags.
“You two bastards, I should have killed you back then!” Lin Yi said in rage.
“Hahaha, murder for life, debt for money, it’s only fair!” one of the security guards said with a smug smile, “I advise you to hand over Lin Corporation obediently to avoid suffering later. You should know, we aren’t merciful. We’ll show no mercy to our enemies!”
“Fine, then come and try, let’s see who’s the one to suffer!”
“You two sons of bitches, get him!”
“Yes!”
At the order, the two security guards immediately pounced on Lin Yi, throwing punches and kicks, causing Lin Yi to quickly be at a disadvantage.
Just when the two security guards wanted to teach Lin Yi a lesson, a crisp slap echoed through the air, followed by them getting slapped across the face.
“Ah, my face, it hurts like hell!” one of the guards said, touching his swollen cheek with a pained expression.
The other guard, too, was covering his face and angrily looked at Xia Nuan, saying, “You bitch, how dare you hit me!”
“Why can’t I hit you? I’ve already told you, I don’t love you, I will never fall for any of you, so we have nothing to do with each other. I hit you to teach you trash a lesson, to show you how low you are!” Xia Nuan said coldly and heartlessly.
After hearing Xia Nuan’s words, the two security guards got even angrier.
“You slut, how dare you insult me!”
“Damn it, I must beat you until you’re searching for your teeth on the ground today, to make you remember forever just how tough I am!”
Seeing this situation, Lin Yi also inwardly cursed, as it turned out Xia Nuan knew martial arts!
This was trouble!
No, I absolutely cannot let this bitch succeed. If she does, then I’m finished!
“Xia Nuan, you whore, how dare you hit my people. I tell you, I won’t let you off the hook! I’ll make you pay for hitting my people today!” Lin Yi glared at Xia Nuan furiously.
Xia Nuan looked at Lin Yi with disdain and said, “You want to take revenge on me? I’m ready anytime, but you’re not qualified yet. Now get lost, and if you appear in front of me again, I’ll show you my methods, not only will I make you scram, but I’ll also send you to prison!”
“You wouldn’t dare!” Lin Yi retorted angrily.
“What wouldn’t I dare to do? I am the proud daughter of Lin Corporation, even your father wouldn’t dare to touch a hair on my head!” Xia Nuan boasted arrogantly.
Hearing Xia Nuan’s words, the surrounding security guards also thought she was too arrogant; after all, Lin Yi was Lin Yuanshan’s son, their ultimate boss!
However, Xia Nuan was not afraid at all, which made them feel that she was truly a formidable person!
Lin Yi knew that Xia Nuan had some fighting skills, but in his view, she was just an ordinary student. How could she be that powerful?
So, Lin Yi wasn’t worried that Xia Nuan would call the police to arrest him.
“Hmph, since you have the guts, then I want to show you what happens when you anger me, Lin Yi,” Lin Yi said ominously.
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, Xia Nuan sneered dismissively and said, “I don’t know what kind of fate awaits me, but I’m sure you won’t live much longer!”
“Hmph, don’t be so smug. You think you can make me not live much longer? You’re just daydreaming!”
“Daydreaming? Aren’t you going to hit me? Well, go ahead and try!” Xia Nuan retorted coldly.
“I’m definitely going to make you feel my fist today!” Lin Yi said as he lunged at Xia Nuan.
Xia Nuan looked at Lin Yi with a cold laugh and said, “You’re too slow, and besides, you’re not in any condition to fight right now. But, since you’re so keen on getting beaten up, I’ll oblige you!”
After saying that, Xia Nuan charged at Lin Yi, raised her foot, and kicked heavily into Lin Yi’s stomach. There was a crackling sound, and Lin Yi’s stomach produced the noise of breaking bones, then he fell to his knees.
Lin Yi’s face turned pale, and large beads of sweat formed on his forehead.
Looking down at Lin Yi on the ground, Xia Nuan stepped on his back and scoffed, “How about that? Still want to fight?”
With difficulty, Lin Yi got up, glaring at Xia Nuan with teeth clenched and said, “You dare to injure my arm, I’ll cripple your limbs!”
Xia Nuan laughed coldly and said, “Cripple my limbs? Do you have the ability? You better take care of your own limbs first!”
As soon as she finished speaking, Xia Nuan kicked Lin Yi’s wrist, and immediately his arm was dislocated.
After the dislocation of Lin Yi’s wrist, his whole arm lost feeling, and the pain made his body convulse.
Xia Nuan sneered, “Now it’s not about me wanting to cripple you; you wanted to disable my limbs. You brought this upon yourself!”
Lin Yi was in so much pain that tears flowed out. He glared at Xia Nuan viciously and said, “You, you bitch, dare to hit me, I, I’m going to kill you!”
“Kill me? I’m really looking forward to seeing how you’ll manage that,” Xia Nuan said with a smile.
Grinding his teeth, Lin Yi said, “Just you wait!”
Having said that, Lin Yi turned and left!
After Lin Yi left, Xia Nuan turned to look at the security team leader and the security members.
The two security members, seeing this, panicked and quickly ran away.
“Hmph! Think you can run? Too late!” Xia Nuan said with a sneer.
At that moment, the sound of police sirens began to ring out.
The two security members had only gone a few steps when two police cars pulled up beside Xia Nuan and stopped.
The officers got out of their cars and took out handcuffs.
They had just received a report that a thief was beating up a young woman.
This young woman was Xia Nuan, whom they recognized, and her son Lin Yi was a member of their police station.
Therefore, this case had to be thoroughly investigated. They absolutely could not harbor criminals!
“You, who are you? Why are you taking me away? What are you going to do?” Lin Yi, seeing the police, immediately became flustered.

chapters.title: Chapter 748 - 748 748 Severely Beaten
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 748: Chapter 748: Severely Beaten Chapter 748: Chapter 748: Severely Beaten He had just been severely beaten up by Xia Nuan, and his arm still hadn’t fully recovered!
“We received a report that you assaulted a woman in a public place, so, we suspect you have a criminal suspicion, and we need to take you back to the police station for investigation!” the police said sternly.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was startled.
He hadn’t expected things to escalate to this extent; it seemed he was truly in trouble this time!
“What grounds do you have to take me to the police station for investigation? Do you have evidence?” Lin Yi asked.
“There’s no need for evidence, anyway, you’re just a thief, and our police naturally have the right to take you back for investigation.”
After saying this, the police immediately took Lin Yi into a police car.
On the way, Lin Yi still tried to resist, but unfortunately, these policemen were much stronger than him; he was no match for them and could only cooperate with the investigation meekly.
Lin Yi’s arm had been dislocated, so he couldn’t do anything, let alone make a phone call to his family.
Xia Nuan did not stop the police from taking him to the station.
This Lin Yi, truly unrepentant. How dared he lay his hands on Xia Nuan? How could Xia Nuan possibly let him off?
“Police uncle, I really don’t know what happened. I just had a verbal fight with him, and then I ended up like this. Please, I beg you, let me go. I will never dare to do it again!” Lin Yi pleaded tearfully.
“You will never dare again? Do you think we will give you another chance to harm Xia Nuan?”
When Xia Nuan heard her name mentioned by the police, her heart skipped a beat.
This was the second time she heard the police call her Miss Xia.
The first time the police called her Miss Xia, but this time, the police addressed her by her first name.
Xia Nuan’s gaze turned toward the policeman; it was none other than the officer who had come to her rescue last time.
“Was it you who saved me?” Xia Nuan asked, puzzled.
“Yes!” the policeman replied indifferently.
Knowing it was the police who had saved her, Xia Nuan felt an unusual emotion in her heart.
“Thank you for saving me. I will definitely remember this kindness!” Xia Nuan said.
“It’s nothing!” the policeman said coldly.
At that moment, Xia Nuan noticed a middle-aged man standing behind him, slightly older, probably the one who had led the police here to investigate Lin Yi.
“Lin Yi, do you have anything else to say?” Xia Nuan asked coldly.
“I, I haven’t done anything!” Lin Yi hurriedly said.
“Haven’t done anything? Humph! I’ll tell you, Lin Yi, for scum like you, I, Xia Nuan, will definitely not let you off easy! I’ve already called the police. Soon, they will send someone to arrest you. You’d better pray not to fall into their hands, or else I will make sure you will wish you could neither live nor die!” Xia Nuan said with a cold laugh.
“You’re talking nonsense! You’re making up lies! I haven’t done anything, why should I accept your threats?” Lin Yi said.
“You can deny it all you want!” Xia Nuan said coldly.
Seeing that Lin Yi was still being defiant, the police immediately handcuffed him.
Soon thereafter, Lin Yi was put into a police car and taken to the police station!
After being brought into the police station, Lin Yi never told the truth.
Xia Nuan sat quietly on the side, watching him remain obstinate and couldn’t help but secretly gloat.
Before long, Lin Yi’s father arrived!
“Dad, you finally came! Sob sob, I’ve been falsely accused of being a thief. Xia Nuan is behind all this; they’re framing me. I’m locked up in the police station. Get me out of here fast, or I’ll be locked up for life!” Lin Yi said.
“You scoundrel! Is that true?” Lin Yi’s father angrily said.
“Of course it’s true. Why would I lie to you? Xia Nuan, won’t you admit it?” Lin Yi pointed at Xia Nuan, his voice filled with rage, and asked.
Xia Nuan glanced coldly at Lin Yi and remained silent.
“Xia Nuan, do you have anything to say?”
Shaking her head, Xia Nuan said, “This is my issue, and it has nothing to do with him. Please do not take your anger out on him!”
“Hmph, you are husband and wife, and you’re protecting him like this. Is there something fishy going on between you two?” Lin Yi’s father asked coldly.
Hearing Lin Yi’s father say this, a surge of anger rose in Xia Nuan’s heart.
Lin Yi is nothing but a beast, to slander his own wife. He has insulted his mother and now seeks to tarnish his own father.
Xia Nuan swept her cold gaze around. This is a public place, and Lin Yi dares to publicly slander her father. It seems Lin Yi is really asking for trouble!
With that in mind, Xia Nuan suddenly charged over and fiercely slapped Lin Yi’s face.
Lin Yi’s father, not expecting Xia Nuan to dare strike Lin Yi in front of so many people, his expression changed, and without thinking, he swung a slap at Xia Nuan’s face.
Slap–
Lin Yi’s father gave Xia Nuan a heavy slap, and she staggered back three steps, almost falling to the ground.
Clutching her swollen cheek, Xia Nuan angrily stared at Lin Yi’s father.
This old fox!
“Lin Yi, I warn you, if you dare slander my parents again, I will surely make you suffer. Hear me loud and clear!” Xia Nuan warned.
Lin Yi, still dizzy from the slap, said defiantly, “It was obviously Xia Nuan who hit first. Why can’t I file a complaint?”
“Haha, Lin Yi, I don’t know what nonsense you are spouting! What do you mean by saying ‘I don’t know what nonsense you are spouting’?” Xia Nuan asked coldly, staring at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi was taken aback, then said, “So you admit it? You were the first to strike. What you did was against my right of self-defense, you are to be held responsible!”
“I might not have evidence to prove that I was the one who hit first, but I have evidence proving you deliberately hurt someone. You are obstructing justice; we will take you to the police station!” Xia Nuan said coldly.
Hearing Xia Nuan’s words, fear crept into Lin Yi’s heart, but he continued to deny it resolutely.
“You’re talking nonsense. I haven’t done anything wrong; why should I fear going to the police station?” Lin Yi exclaimed.
“Not afraid? Then go and explain to the police why you were stealing things in the hotel,” Xia Nuan said.
Lin Yi was speechless for a moment.
He had not anticipated that Xia Nuan would use the accusation of theft to pressure him. It was truly despicable.
“Lin Yi, I advise you to confess quickly, or you will be convicted. This is the only way I can help you. If you don’t confess, you can forget about ever getting out of prison,” Xia Nuan said.
Lin Yi looked at Xia Nuan, with ten thousand reluctances in his heart; he really didn’t want to reveal the truth.
But he had no choice; he didn’t want to go to jail.
“I—I admit, I did steal a necklace at first, but I only borrowed a dollar from you, I really didn’t steal!” Lin Yi said in a low voice.
“You’re saying you only borrowed a dollar from me?” Xia Nuan asked, surprised.
“Yes, the necklace wasn’t worth much, so I returned it to you. But I really didn’t steal!” Lin Yi explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 749 - 749 749 Retrieval of Surveillance Video
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 749: Chapter 749: Retrieval of Surveillance Video Chapter 749: Chapter 749: Retrieval of Surveillance Video “All right, we’ll just wait for the police to retrieve the surveillance video and see if there’s a trace of you stealing the necklace,” Xia Nuan said.
Lin Yi’s father hurriedly echoed, “Yes, once we look at the surveillance video, it will be clear that you were the one who stole that necklace. You’re turning black into white and confusing right and wrong, committing a crime!”
“Dad, how can you say such a thing? Don’t you know that with the internet being so developed, everything is out there? Even if you want to hide it, you can’t keep it secret,” Lin Yi said.
Lin Yi’s father was left speechless by Lin Yi’s retort.
“Hmph! Do you think your lies can deceive everyone? I’ve been displeased with you for a long time!” Xia Nuan snorted coldly.
“Xia Nuan, don’t get too arrogant!” Lin Yi’s father pointed at Xia Nuan, roaring angrily.
“I’m arrogant? Then have the police come and arrest me! Do you dare to catch me?” Xia Nuan coldly challenged Lin Yi’s father.
Lin Yi’s father glared furiously but dared not make a move.
Although Lin Yi’s father was a deputy mayor, he was just an ordinary official after all, nothing compared to the power wielded by Lin Yi’s grandfather!
“Hmph, just you wait. When the police come and the surveillance footage is examined, you’ll be waiting to get caught!” Lin Yi’s father said.
“Is that so? You think I don’t know that you’re just looking for excuses?” Xia Nuan scoffed.
“You! Hmph, in any case, you’ll see I wasn’t lying when you get arrested!” Lin Yi’s father said.
Xia Nuan didn’t bother to pay anymore attention to Lin Yi’s father and turned to leave.
Stopping in front of Lin Yi’s father, Xia Nuan looked at him coldly and said indifferently, “Lin Yi’s father, I think you’re a very reasonable person. You wouldn’t want me to get caught, would you? You should know that you can’t beat me!”
“You, you, don’t go too far!” Lin Yi’s father, livid with rage, pointed at Xia Nuan and cursed.
“I’m not bullying you, it was you who bullied me first. The actions of you and your son disgust me!” After saying so, Xia Nuan left without looking back.
“Dad, she’s too arrogant, we can’t let her go. Otherwise, I’m done for!” Lin Yi said anxiously, clutching his father’s sleeve.
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, a shock went through his father’s heart. It seemed that he really couldn’t afford to leave Xia Nuan as a loose end, otherwise, his son would surely get implicated.
Thinking this, Lin Yi’s father’s expression immediately turned solemn.
“Dad, I beg you, please save me, okay? I really don’t want to go to jail, I can’t be sent to prison! Dad!” Lin Yi pleaded desperately.
“Enough, you don’t need to say anymore, I know what to do!” Lin Yi’s father said.
“Thank you, Dad!” Lin Yi hugged his father excitedly.
Meanwhile, Xia Nuan, accompanied by Ye Yunlong, arrived at the police station, ready to report Lin Yi’s theft.
Xia Nuan and Ye Yunlong waited in the lobby of the police station, and Lin Yi’s parents arrived as well.
Seeing Xia Nuan and Ye Yunlong, they were filled with hatred, wishing they could kill the two of them.
“Officer, hello, I am Xia Nuan, the mastermind behind this incident. I have something to report and need your assistance with the investigation. I hope the police can help us thoroughly investigate this matter,” Xia Nuan said.
“You’re Xia Nuan? I remember, our city’s leaders, as well as the provincial leaders, have invested in this case, so the police must handle it seriously. Therefore, this woman must be arrested and punished,” the officer said coldly, looking at Xia Nuan.
“Why do you say I stole? What evidence do you have? If you don’t have evidence, then you can’t arrest me!” Xia Nuan said coldly.
“Exactly, it seems to me that you all just want to cover for Xia Nuan, to show her favoritism—such a thing you also dare to do,” Ye Yunlong added from the side.
Xia Nuan glared fiercely at Ye Yunlong, this disgusting man, actually daring to kick her when she’s down at such a critical moment!
“Who among you can prove that this woman stole something or was framed?” the police officer asked coldly, looking over Xia Nuan’s many friends.
“We can testify! This is our friend, Lin Yi!” Lin Yi’s father stood out and pointed at Lin Yi, saying.
“What evidence do you have that Xia Nuan stole your belongings?” the police officer asked back coldly.
Xia Nuan’s friends were suddenly at a loss for words. Should they tell them that Xia Nuan had done it? If so, wouldn’t Xia Nuan be arrested?
Xia Nuan’s friends looked confusedly at Lin Yi’s father and Lin Yi’s mother, unsure of how to respond.
This matter, they also dared not speak recklessly about.
Seeing no one dared to respond to her husband’s words, Lin Yi’s mother stepped forward and said to the police officer, “Comrade officer, my son Lin Yi indeed stole my diamond ring, but it was because he was bewitched by this vixen, and that’s why he committed the act. Please deal with it severely.”
“Hmph!” the police officer snorted coldly, looking at Xia Nuan, and said, “Do you have anything else to say?”
Looking coldly at Lin Yi and Lin Yi’s father, Xia Nuan said, “The stolen diamond ring from your son, was it that expensive pigeon blood ruby?
Then let me tell you, I have no desire for any of the Lin Family’s property, so I couldn’t possibly steal the Lin Family’s wealth.
Moreover, this matter—you’re not saying I’m a thief but rather that your son is guilty at heart because he stole your jewelry, and then he slandered me. Such behavior is illegal.”
“Pfft, sophistry!” Lin Yi’s father said while looking coldly at Xia Nuan.
“Whether it’s sophistry or not, we will find out soon enough,” Xia Nuan said coldly.
“Xia Nuan, you might as well stop putting on a show; you won’t be in trouble because I won’t allow anything to happen to you,” said Lin Yi’s father.
“Lin Yi, you may as well just hurry up and divorce me!” Xia Nuan demanded.
“Not a chance! Did you think I would divorce you?” Lin Yi countered.
“If that’s the case, then there’s nothing left to discuss. Better go home with me quickly to stop my parents from worrying—they are so old, I don’t want them to be distressed because of you any longer.
Moreover, with so many people present here, they will testify for us. Stop making a spectacle of yourself here and just hurry home with me,” Xia Nuan said indifferently.
“I will not go back!” Lin Yi said coldly.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s father turned to Lin Yi and said, “You take the child away first; I have some matters to discuss with Xia Nuan.”
Lin Yi’s father nodded, taking Lin Yi’s mother and leaving the police station.
“Dad, is it really okay for us to just leave like this?” Lin Yi asked.
“I know you’re reluctant to leave, I’m not forcing you; let’s go home first,” Lin Yi’s father said.
Hearing his father say this, Lin Yi could only nod in agreement and leave the police station with Lin Yi’s father.

chapters.title: Chapter 750 - 750 750 Acting Foolishly
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 750: Chapter 750: Acting Foolishly Chapter 750: Chapter 750: Acting Foolishly “Lin Yi, you’ve really baffled me with this matter. How could the Lin Family produce such disgraceful scum like you? It’s just embarrassing!” Lin Yi’s father angrily said from the backseat of the car.
“Elder, I admit this was my fault. I will capture Xia Nuan as soon as possible to clear your name!” Lin Yi said.
“Humph, you’ve gone too far this time! I don’t care what methods you use, you must capture this mastermind quickly, or else, don’t bother coming back!” Lin Yi’s father said coldly.
“Elder, please be assured, I will certainly capture Xia Nuan!” Lin Yi stated determinedly.
A smile finally appeared on Lin Yi’s father’s face upon hearing these words.
Xia Nuan, no matter how formidable you are, in the end, you can’t escape from being manipulated by me, Lin Yi!
Lin Yi’s father was secretly pleased.
Inside the police station.
“Xia Nuan, we will definitely handle this case fairly. Rest assured!” the police officer said.
“Okay, thank you very much!” Xia Nuan said with a slight smile.
Upon leaving the police station, Xia Nuan was upset. She had not expected Lin Yi to frame her as a thief on such an occasion, which infuriated her.
She would make Lin Yi pay the price.
“Lin Yi, you just wait!” Xia Nuan said through gritted teeth.
When she got home, Xia Nuan called Lin Yi, wanting to confront him about what had really happened.
“Hello, the number you have dialed is powered off.”
Xia Nuan’s brow furrowed. Could it be Lin Yi’s phone was switched off? How could that be? She knew some of his phone numbers; how could they be off?
“Lin Yi, I’m telling you, no matter what means you use, I will catch you today and get justice for myself!” Xia Nuan declared.
“You lowly bitch, I will make sure you suffer a fate worse than death!” Lin Yi cursed vilely at the other end of the phone.
“Alright, Lin Yi, stop your bluster and just admit your wrongs.” Xia Nuan said.
“Humph, even if I die, I won’t admit it!” Lin Yi said with a cold laugh.
Xia Nuan, hearing this, became furious. She thought Lin Yi was insane to utter such foolish words. Did he think there would be no responsibility after his death?
“Fine, if you’re going to be so stubborn, then go ahead and die. Do you think your crimes will not be pursued after your death? Humph, you’re awfully naive,” Xia Nuan scoffed.
Lin Yi was taken aback, not understanding what Xia Nuan meant.
“Stop your pretense here. I’m telling you, I’ve had people watching you for a long time. I will thoroughly investigate every move you make! Do you really think your cunning can deceive the heavens? You’re delusional,” Xia Nuan mocked.
“What? Watching me? You’ve been spying on me? Aren’t you afraid I’ll tell my mother?” Lin Yi said.
“Humph! Lin Yi, I’m not a fool. I know you wouldn’t do anything to harm our family, but I’m just afraid you might be desperate,” Xia Nuan threatened.
“Humph, what makes you think you have the right to threaten me? Let me tell you, even if you reveal our family’s secrets, what of it? I can still persuade my mother not to tell anyone about our family’s affairs, ensuring you’ll never be able to turn the tables!” Lin Yi said.
Lin Yi’s father also chimed in: “Humph, don’t waste your efforts. Both my wife and I will support my decision.”
“Don’t push me. I’m calling the police right now. I want to see what else your mob has to cover up!” Xia Nuan said with a cold snort.
Xia Nuan finished speaking and was about to take out her phone to make a call.
Lin Yi’s father and Lin Yi hurriedly tried to stop her, “You can’t call the police, you just can’t!”
Lin Yi’s mother said, “Xia Nuan, don’t think that just because you now have money and power, you can do whatever you want. Let me tell you, our Lin Family is not to be trifled with!”
“Hmph, your Lin Family is merely engaged in some legitimate business; do you think I’m scared of you? If you really aren’t afraid of me exposing this matter, then let’s give it a try. Let’s see who will have the last laugh?” Xia Nuan said.
“I’m telling you, our Lin Family is not to be provoked either. I advise you to leave our Yi’er alone. Otherwise, don’t blame us for being rude to you,” Lin Yi’s mother said coldly.
Xia Nuan gave Lin Yi’s mother a cold look, then snorted and said, “Hmph, I’ll wait!”
Seeing Xia Nuan’s disrespectful attitude, Lin Yi’s mother grew even more infuriated, thinking, “Just you wait. Once I’ve dealt with Xia Nuan, I’ll slowly take care of you, my unfilial daughter!”
“Fine, then let’s just wait and see. I want to find out what you can possibly do to us,” Lin Yi’s mother said.
“I just don’t believe that you can really do anything to me!” Xia Nuan retorted.
“Heh, regardless of what you say, it won’t make any difference!” Lin Yi’s father said with pride.
“Dad, why are you taking this brat’s side?” Lin Yi said discontentedly.
“You ingrate! Do you realize what you’ve done? And you still dare to throw a tantrum here? I warn you, if you speak out of turn, even I won’t be able to protect you!” Lin Yi’s father said.
“Dad, don’t you also wish me dead? Now that I’m already like this, what else do you want to do to me?” Lin Yi said.
“I’m telling you, if you dare to speak nonsense again, I will definitely teach you a harsh lesson!” Lin Yi’s father said.
Lin Yi felt wronged at this.
“Dad, can’t you treat me a little better? I was just momentarily bewitched and that’s why I did such a thing. I beg you to forgive me; I will definitely change, okay?” Lin Yi pleaded.
Lin Yi’s father didn’t speak, just looked at Lin Yi coldly, causing Lin Yi to feel somewhat uneasy.
“Dad, how can you just look at me like this?” Lin Yi said.
“How am I looking at you? I’m merely assessing whether you truly have any remorse!” Lin Yi’s father said.
“You, you…” Lin Yi was so angry that he couldn’t finish his sentence.
“Alright, you’d better think carefully about what you need to do. If you don’t show any remorse or refuse to repent, then don’t blame me for being ruthless,” Lin Yi’s father said.
“I understand! Dad, I will reflect on my actions. You don’t have to worry about me anymore,” Lin Yi said humbly.
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s father finally relented, knowing that if Lin Yi continued to create trouble, it would definitely lead to a major fallout, which would not benefit their personal or business affairs.
What he needed to do now was to completely drive Xia Nuan away from his son so that Xia Nuan would obediently comply and hand over the Lin Corporation.
“Remember what you’ve said today. If you dare lie to me, you should know my temperament,” Lin Yi’s father said.
Lin Yi knew exactly what kind of person his father was. Even though he was usually nice to him, he was aware that Lin Yi’s father didn’t have much affection for him.
Between the two of them, it was simply a union of interests.
Both were very greedy, wanting to obtain more.
Lin Yi’s father was very adept in this respect,

chapters.title: Chapter 751 - 751 751 Carefree Happiness
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 751: Chapter 751 Carefree Happiness Chapter 751: Chapter 751 Carefree Happiness So, Lin Yi’s father had always been carefree and happy, and since Lin Yi’s mother was very capable, his father never needed to worry that Lin Yi would be harmful to him.
“Dad, I understand, I will definitely not be like this in the future,” Lin Yi said hastily.
Lin Yi’s mother was very pleased when she heard what Lin Yi had said.
“Hmph, do you think I would really be at ease? If you dare to speak carelessly, I will absolutely make your death a miserable one!” Lin Yi’s mother said coldly.
Lin Yi involuntarily shuddered.
He had long experienced the attitude of his father toward him, his father was a very ruthless man.
Had it not been for Lin Yi’s mother’s vast business experience, she probably wouldn’t be standing here negotiating with them.
“Mom, please rest assured, I will definitely reflect on my mistakes. I promise not to disappoint you,” Lin Yi said.
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, his mother immediately felt at ease.
“Hmph, since that’s the case, you better reflect well, if I catch any leverage against you, you’re dead!” Lin Yi’s mother said.
Seeing this, Lin Yi did not continue to pay attention to his mother and instead went to Xia Nuan’s side, saying, “Xia Nuan, don’t be arrogant. One day, I will make you kneel before me and beg for mercy.”
“Haha, just you wait,” Xia Nuan said disdainfully.
After meeting with Lin Yi’s parents, Xia Nuan didn’t say much, just a few cold words before Lin Yi’s parents left.
After Lin Yi’s parents had gone, Lin Yi went to Yi Yi’s side and asked, “Yi’er, what happened just now? Why did you end up like that? Didn’t you promise me that you wouldn’t be so impulsive again? Look at yourself, what do you look like now?”
“Mom, it’s all Xia Nuan’s fault, it’s all because of Xia Nuan,” Lin Yi said bitterly, staring at Xia Nuan.
As soon as Lin Yi’s mother heard Lin Yi’s father bring up Xia Nuan, she couldn’t help but frown and said, “Stop bringing up Xia Nuan.”
“Mom, don’t forget, it was Xia Nuan who made me like this,” Lin Yi said.
“Hmph, I know that, I’m going to settle the score with Xia Nuan right now,” Lin Yi’s mother said.
Having said that, Lin Yi’s mother turned around and left to hold Xia Nuan accountable.
Xia Nuan knew her parents had come to hold her to account, otherwise, they wouldn’t have left in such a hurry, and with Lin Yi also there, Lin Yi’s mother wouldn’t have come running over so recklessly.
Xia Nuan knew that this time, she had truly angered Lin Yi’s family.
Xia Nuan sighed inwardly, then said, “Dad, Mom, I know I’ve really made a mistake this time. I shouldn’t have disregarded the feelings between siblings and hurt Yi Yi this way. I don’t expect you to forgive me, I just ask that you don’t hurt Yi Yi anymore in the future.”
“Hmph, you think we would let you off so easily? Don’t even think about it,” Lin Yi’s mother said angrily.
“Mom, don’t worry, I will correct myself in the future, I hope you can believe me,” Xia Nuan said.
Hearing Xia Nuan’s words, Lin Yi’s mother let out a sneer and said, “Hmph, someone like you will never be satisfied.”
With that, Lin Yi’s mother left striding away.
Lin Yi, watching Xia Nuan’s pitiable appearance from behind, felt a flicker of emotion, but he immediately returned to his previous demeanor.
After both Lin Yi’s father and mother had left, Lin Yi said to Xia Nuan, “Xia Nuan, you better be sensible. If you irritate me, you definitely will not end well.”
“Heh, I got it,” Xia Nuan said indifferently.
Xia Nuan knew she couldn’t escape.
Since that was the case, she decided to calmly accept the situation. As long as she didn’t go too far, they wouldn’t do anything to her.
“You child, why won’t you take advice?” Lin Yi’s father asked Xia Nuan in incomprehension.
“Dad, I do want to take advice, but I also know that sometimes, some things are beyond our control,” said Xia Nuan with a helpless sigh.
“Ah, we are getting old, and there are some things we can’t control anymore. You have to be careful, and from now on, you are not allowed to do this again,” Lin Yi’s father said to Xia Nuan sternly.
“Okay,” Xia Nuan agreed.
“Alright then, you should go back and reflect on this,” Lin Yi’s father said.
“Dad, then I will take my leave first,” Xia Nuan said.
“Go on, then,” Lin Yi’s father said, waving her off.
After Lin Yi had left, his mother came to his father’s side, complaining, “Old man, how could you treat Yi Yi like that? He is your son too.”
“Oh, you child, I’m doing this for his own good. There’s nothing I can do if he won’t listen to the advice. Besides, with the things he’s done, he’s asking for it,” said Lin Yi’s father.
Lin Yi’s mother wanted to say more, but in the end, she held back and kept her words unspoken.
“Let’s go, we should go back and talk about Yi Yi’s situation. Look at him, he’s already like that, and I don’t know what that girl Xia Nuan is thinking, getting so close with that kind of man, sigh,” Lin Yi’s mother said.
Even though Lin Yi’s father felt somewhat uncomfortable about the matter between Xia Nuan and Lin Yi, he was also aware that Xia Nuan was a very intelligent woman, so he didn’t blame her too much.
He too was a clever person and knew that he shouldn’t be overly harsh on Xia Nuan.
So, the two of them went home, planning to tell Xia Nuan all about the foolish things Lin Yi had done over the years to prevent her from making the same mistakes in the future.
When Xia Nuan returned home, she found Lin Yi’s father and mother sitting on the couch waiting for her.
Seeing the expressions on their faces, Xia Nuan knew they had sought her out today to lay charges against her.
Xia Nuan felt bitterness in her heart, realizing that this time she truly couldn’t avoid it.
However, Xia Nuan wouldn’t admit defeat so easily.
“Xia Nuan, you still know to come back?” Lin Yi’s mother said to Xia Nuan with displeasure upon seeing her return.
“I’m sorry, Uncle, Auntie,” Xia Nuan said respectfully to Lin Yi’s parents.
“Humph,” Lin Yi’s parents responded with a cold snort.
Lin Yi’s parents had a deep-seated hatred for Xia Nuan, especially Lin Yi’s mother.
Lin Yi’s mother had always adored him ever since he was a child, as Lin Yi was her only child.
Lin Yi was spoiled from a young age and had a somewhat willful personality. They rarely disciplined him, which led to Lin Yi’s character becoming extreme and nasty towards others.
He was also disrespectful to his own parents. Lin Yi’s mother was very angry but couldn’t bear to scold or hit him, so she could only try every means to punish him.
“Uncle, Auntie, you can say whatever you need to say. I will definitely listen to your reprimands. But I hope you can forgive Yi Yi,” said Xia Nuan.
“Humph, forgive? I don’t think you will ever forgive him. Stop with the pretense and acting; your uncle and I are not three-year-old children,” said Lin Yi’s mother.
Xia Nuan thought to herself that Lin Yi’s mother was quite shrewd; she had managed to guess all this. Indeed, she was a formidable character, someone Xia Nuan definitely couldn’t afford to offend in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 752 - 752 752 Refusing to Forgive
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 752: Chapter 752: Refusing to Forgive Chapter 752: Chapter 752: Refusing to Forgive Xia Nuan pondered for a while, then smiled and said, “Since you’re unwilling to forgive Yi Yi, I’ll go back to my room and rest.”
Having said that, Xia Nuan headed toward the staircase.
“You stop right there!” Lin Yi’s mother shouted.
“Auntie, I’m tired now; I want to rest,” Xia Nuan paused and said.
“Humph! Tired? It’s almost midnight, and you’re telling me you’re tired? Do you know how long your father and I have been waiting for you in the living room? And you say you’re tired, you’re really infuriating me,” Lin Yi’s mother said angrily.
Xia Nuan chuckled inwardly; these words were all taught to your daughter by you.
“Alright, alright, don’t be angry, I’m tired too, let’s all go rest,” Lin Yi’s father said to his wife.
Lin Yi’s mother glanced at Xia Nuan, then turned and went upstairs.
Lin Yi’s father looked at Xia Nuan, sighed, and said, “Xia Nuan, it’s not that I want to criticize you, but what Yi Yi did was wrong. Don’t be upset about it; go back to your room and rest. You still have to go to work tomorrow.”
“Okay, uncle,” Xia Nuan replied.
The next morning, Xia Nuan was woken up early by Lin Yi’s mother. Xia Nuan wondered if it was because she went to bed late last night that Lin Yi’s mother woke her up so early in the morning?
After getting dressed, Xia Nuan went downstairs and saw Lin Yi’s mother and Lin Yi sitting at the dining table, seemingly waiting for her.
Xia Nuan walked over, puzzled.
“Sit down, sit down,” Lin Yi’s mother commanded Xia Nuan.
“Oh,” Xia Nuan sat down and asked, “May I know why you wanted to see me?”
“It’s nothing much, just wanted to have a chat,” Lin Yi’s father said.
“Just a chat?” Xia Nuan was even more perplexed, but still sat down; she did want to hear what Lin Yi’s father had to say.
“Xia Nuan, how old are you this year?” Lin Yi’s father suddenly asked.
“Uh, I’m 17 years old this year,” Xia Nuan said.
“Which school did you graduate from?” Lin Yi’s father continued to ask.
“I’m a student at A City University,” Xia Nuan answered.
Lin Yi’s father asked further, “Then do you know that our Lin Corporation and Li Corporation are in competition?”
“I know,” Xia Nuan said.
“And do you know, our Lin Corporation and Li Corporation, whose companies they are?” Lin Yi’s father asked again.
“I know,” Xia Nuan continued.
“Then do you know which company has more wealth between our company and Li Corporation?” Lin Yi’s father pursued.
“I think I don’t know that,” Xia Nuan said.
After Xia Nuan’s response, Lin Yi’s parents’ expressions suddenly darkened.
Lin Yi’s mother said, “You don’t know? Then how come you’re working at Li Corporation? Don’t tell me it’s because Li Yuxuan has done you a favor, and that’s why you stay working at Li Corporation.”
“It’s not like that,” Xia Nuan immediately said.
She felt her words were somewhat incoherent.
Lin Yi’s mother kept pressing, “You say it’s not like that, so what is it like, then?”
“I work at Li Corporation because of work needs,” Xia Nuan replied.
Xia Nuan didn’t know how to answer, so she simply made up an excuse. Anyway, she couldn’t be certain whether Lin Yi’s parents would believe her story, and she also couldn’t be sure if they would choose to believe the excuse she concocted.
“Your excuse is too far-fetched, it’s simply not enough to convince us,” Lin Yi’s mother said.
“Then there’s nothing I can do, you won’t believe me anyway,” Xia Nuan shrugged and said.
“You, you’re really ungrateful!” Lin Yi’s father said.
“Haha, Uncle, it’s not that I’m ungrateful, it’s just that I’m really powerless,” Xia Nuan said with a smile.
Lin Yi’s mother, seeing Xia Nuan’s defiant attitude, suddenly became furious and said indignantly, “Good for you, Xia Nuan, we kindly invited you to our house for a meal, yet this is the face you put on.”
“I’m sorry, Auntie, I really didn’t mean to,” Xia Nuan hurriedly said.
She thought: How can Lin Yi’s mother be so unreasonable? I said I didn’t want to talk to them, and it’s one thing that they didn’t listen, but to blame me like this is truly tyrannical.
“You didn’t do it on purpose? Easy for you to say. Do you think you can just let it go? You have to compensate for the losses of Lin Corporation!” Lin Yi’s father said.
“I know, I will take responsibility for this,” Xia Nuan said.
“Take responsibility? How are you going to take responsibility? This is Lin Corporation’s money, do you think you can just compensate as you wish?” Lin Yi’s father asked.
“I will use all my savings to compensate Lin Corporation for the losses,” Xia Nuan said.
“Haha, all your savings? Although Lin Corporation isn’t very rich, a mere few tens of millions is but a drop in the ocean for us, what will you compensate with?” Lin Yi’s father sneered.
“Then, Uncle, how much do you want?” Xia Nuan asked.
“If you really want to make it right, then marry Lin Yi to Li Corporation’s Li Yuxuan,” Lin Yi’s father said.
“What? Marry Lin Yi to Li Yuxuan? Uncle, how can that be? Lin Yi’s only 18 years old,” Xia Nuan said in shock.
She had not expected Lin Yi’s father to make such a demand; it was simply too much. Her son was only just 19 years old, and now he was expected to take a wife, and to marry off his biological son to a married man, Xia Nuan found it completely unacceptable.
“Lin Yi’s only 20 years old, do you want him to marry so early?” Lin Yi’s mother said, “I tell you, if you don’t agree, Lin Yi will not be allowed back into the Lin Family’s house.”
“Auntie, I really don’t know how to answer your question, are you forcing me?” Xia Nuan said.
Lin Yi’s mother snorted coldly: “You realize that now?”
“Yes,” Xia Nuan nodded.
“Hmph! Well, it’s good that you know. This isn’t something you can just decide,” Lin Yi’s mother scoffed.
“Then what do you want me to do?” Xia Nuan asked.
Lin Yi’s mother glanced at her son: “I want five percent of Li Corporation’s shares.”
Xia Nuan was stunned; Lin Yi’s mother actually wanted shares of Li Corporation? How could this be?
Four percent of Li Corporation’s shares already accounted for more than eighty percent of the entire board’s shareholding; five percent of shares was a substantial amount of money.
“You want five percent of the shares, for what?” Xia Nuan asked.
“I want eight percent of the shares,” Lin Yi’s mother said.
“But Lin Yi is your own biological son, how can you treat your own child like this?” Xia Nuan asked.
Lin Yi’s mother said with disdain, “My own biological son? Haha, when did Lin Yi have a biological son?”
Hearing Lin Yi’s mother say this, Xia Nuan was dumbfounded; she hadn’t expected Lin Yi’s father to actually deny their relationship with Lin Yi.
“I will not marry Li Yuxuan,” Lin Yi said coldly.
“How can the son of Lin Corporation’s president not be a match for a girl from an ordinary family? We demand equality in social standing, do you understand?” Lin Yi’s mother continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 753 - 753 753 The Family Rules of Lin Corporation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 753: Chapter 753: The Family Rules of Lin Corporation Chapter 753: Chapter 753: The Family Rules of Lin Corporation “I know,” Xia Nuan said indifferently, “you’re right, I’m just a common girl, and the gap between me and the president of Li Corporation is too large.”
“Hmph, that’s the family rule of the Lin Corporation. Whoever I, Lin Yi, take a fancy to must marry Li Yuxuan,” Lin Yi’s mother declared.
“What if you took a fancy to someone else?” Xia Nuan asked.
“The person I set my sights on can never escape my control!” Lin Yi’s mother said with full confidence.
“Are you talking about the president of Li Corporation, Li Yuxuan?” Xia Nuan inquired.
“Exactly, him,” Lin Yi’s mother said proudly.
“But why do you set your sights on the president of Li Corporation? The president’s age is similar to mine; are you looking to find an old man to be your own husband?” Xia Nuan asked.
Her words undoubtedly touched on Lin Yi’s mother’s sore spot, and she roared, “What nonsense are you spouting? Are you cursing my husband to die?”
Lin Yi’s mother had an overbearing look that made one involuntarily a bit fearful.
But this fear did nothing to intimidate Xia Nuan, on the contrary, it made her feel rather amused.
“I’m not cursing your husband. I just want to know what exactly you see in Li Corporation?” Xia Nuan said.
“We’re not interested in the money of Li Corporation; we’re interested in the person of Li Yuxuan,” Lin Yi’s mother stated.
“Oh, I see, then I understand,” Xia Nuan nodded.
“Our family’s enterprises have never been sustained by interests alone. As long as we can form a marital alliance with Li Corporation, we’ll gain even more substantial funds to support the company’s operations.
Only this way can we grow stronger and stronger. I think you should understand such reasoning,” Lin Yi’s mother spoke.
Her words did carry some truth, but this so-called reasoning was, to Xia Nuan, an insult.
“However, Auntie, I really don’t like Li Yuxuan,” Xia Nuan said.
“Have you still not grasped the situation? The Lin Family isn’t about what you choose, but that you have to marry Li Yuxuan. You have to agree even if you don’t want to,” Lin Yi’s mother said.
Lin Yi’s mother was Lin Yi’s mother, she was a woman, and so was Xia Nuan; of course Xia Nuan wouldn’t agree to sharing her husband with someone else.
Just like the summer, she would rather divorce her parents than give herself to summer; therefore, she would never agree.
She was a woman with principles, and she wouldn’t allow herself to share her husband with others, just like with summer before.
If she were with summer, she would lose everything, so she couldn’t make such a decision.
“Auntie, let’s talk about this issue after you and my father get married. I’m still young now; I don’t want to talk about marriage,” Xia Nuan said.
“Hehe, young lady, you want to back out so soon?” Lin Yi’s mother scoffed with a cold laugh.
“I truly do not want to be with a man I don’t love. Please don’t force me,” Xia Nuan spoke faintly.
“I’m telling you, whether you like it or not, this marriage has already been decided. Unless you divorce Li Yuxuan, you’ll have to follow the rules of Lin Corporation,” Lin Yi’s mother declared.
Lin Yi also chimed in, “That’s right, the marriage is already set. No matter what, I won’t change my mind.”
Seeing the two people’s adamant refusal to compromise, Xia Nuan felt very anxious in her heart, yet there was nothing she could do. She could only take things one step at a time, first by buying time, letting the President of Li Corporation hurry up and acquire Li Corporation, then go from there. She believed that as long as she could stall for time, Li Yuxuan would sooner or later find out about this matter.
“Alright, Lin Yi, since your Lin Family has already fixed this marriage, we won’t stay any longer, or else people might misunderstand that people from the Lin Family don’t have any principles,” Lin Yi’s father Lin Zhenbang said.
Upon hearing that they couldn’t stay any longer, Lin Yi’s mother quickly said, “Then so be it, let’s leave it at that.”
Lin Yi’s father left with his wife, and Lin Yi followed them out. She knew that there would be no opportunity for her to perform tonight.
She also knew why her mother had suddenly changed her mind—it must have been because of the words Xia Nuan said earlier that angered Lin Yi’s mother, which made her become so extreme. But this wasn’t Xia Nuan’s fault, but the fault of these wealthy families’ people who didn’t consider others’ feelings at all.
After Lin Yi left, Lin Yi’s mother returned to her usual kind and loving expression, saying to Xia Nuan, “Nuan Nuan, you’ve had a hard time during this period. If you have time in the future, come over and keep your auntie company. I’ve been living alone at home, and it’s really very lonely.”
“I will, Auntie,” said Xia Nuan. “Actually, you don’t have to go through all this trouble; you can come find me at the company when you have time.”
“Yeah, that’s what I’ve been thinking too. I know you’ve always enjoyed working, and I don’t want to hold you up. All I hope for is that on the job, you look after Lin Yi a little more,” said Lin Yi’s mother.
Xia Nuan inwardly scoffed at such a request. It was really too much, but Xia Nuan wasn’t going to refuse it.
“Don’t worry, if Lin Yi has any trouble, I will definitely help him,” Xia Nuan said.
Hearing Xia Nuan’s response, Lin Yi’s mother was very satisfied, and then said, “Now that you’ve rested, I won’t disturb you any longer. Take care of your injury.”
Xia Nuan nodded, then saw off Lin Yi’s mother and returned to her room.
Although she was no longer in any danger, she still didn’t leave the villa for safety’s sake and continued to live inside the villa.
As soon as Xia Nuan entered the room, she saw Li Yuxuan sitting on the sofa reading a newspaper. She walked over and said, “Mr. Li, what are you doing here?”
“Came to see my fiancée,” Li Yuxuan said.
Fiancée?
Xia Nuan’s eyebrows slightly furrowed and said, “I have nothing to do with you anymore. Please don’t call me your fiancée in the future, and I am not your fiancée. Please have some respect for yourself, Mr. Li.”
Li Yuxuan tossed the newspaper onto the coffee table and said, “Miss Xia, don’t forget that last night you were sleeping in my bed. Now you’ve not only slept in my bed, you’re even clinging to me. What do you think should be done about this matter?”
Upon hearing these words, Xia Nuan couldn’t help but feel a surge of anger inside. She hadn’t expected Li Yuxuan to dare to bring up what happened the previous night. Wasn’t he humiliating her?
Even though what Li Yuxuan said was true, Xia Nuan still felt her cheeks burn.
“You… how can you be so shameless? It was because I was drunk that I did that. Now that I’ve sobered up, I’ve come to detest you, so even if you want to find someone to be responsible, don’t look for me,” Xia Nuan said.
“Responsible? Heh, Miss Xia, you are really naive. I, Li Yuxuan, never need to take responsibility when it comes to women. Any woman I set my eyes on, I will marry, including you, right?” Li Yuxuan said with a frivolous look, “I’ll marry whoever I want. You don’t get to dictate my marriage.”
“How can you speak like that?” Xia Nuan said angrily.
“What’s wrong with how I’m speaking? Miss Xia, please clear it up, it’s not me who’s speaking, it’s you,” Li Yuxuan said.
“You—I won’t argue with you anymore. In any case, I won’t marry you,” Xia Nuan said.
“Hmph, I’d advise you to be good and come back with me to the Li Family, otherwise, don’t blame me for being rude to you,” Li Yuxuan said.

chapters.title: Chapter 754 - 754 754 Extremely Thrilling
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 754: Chapter 754: Extremely Thrilling Chapter 754: Chapter 754: Extremely Thrilling “You dare!” Xia Nuan glared at Li Yuxuan, she could feel the intense murderous intent flashing in his eyes.
“Hahaha.” Li Yuxuan laughed uproariously, then said, “What wouldn’t I dare? I want to kill you and show you the consequences of angering me!”
Li Yuxuan’s eyes were filled with hatred, as if he were looking at the murderer of his own father, which made Xia Nuan’s heart tremble. She had not expected Li Yuxuan to be so ruthless, to actually want to kill her.
Seeing the frightened look on Xia Nuan’s face, Li Yuxuan felt an incomparable thrill in his heart. He wanted Xia Nuan to feel this fear, he wanted her to know his capabilities. Only by making her afraid, only by making her feel terror, would she submit to him!
This girl was just too beautiful, he couldn’t lose her, he had to have her!
“Hmph, you don’t have the qualifications to kill me,” Xia Nuan said.
She was a cultivator, and moreover, a high-ranking one. If Li Yuxuan really dared to kill her, he would certainly die without a doubt!
“Xia Nuan, I know you’re formidable, but do you really think you can kill me? Do you think I’m a fool? Let me tell you, even if you kill me, you won’t be able to escape. And we have a contract between us; you can’t escape!” Li Yuxuan said.
Hearing Li Yuxuan’s words, Xia Nuan’s expression also became serious.
Indeed, this time, she truly had no way to escape. Li Yuxuan was right; even if she killed him, there was a contract between her and the Li Family. If she violated the contract, the Li Family would definitely tear her to pieces. Therefore, she could not kill Li Yuxuan.
But what should she do now?
“Li Yuxuan, what will it take for you to let me go?” Xia Nuan asked.
“Is that even a question? What do you think?” Li Yuxuan said, “We’re engaged, and you’ve spent a night with me. Are you trying to deny it?”
Xia Nuan was silent, she knew Li Yuxuan was right. She was engaged to Li Yuxuan, but she did not want to marry him, yet she had no other option.
“Fine, I agree to your terms, but you must promise me one thing,” Xia Nuan said.
Li Yuxuan nodded and replied, “I promise you, but remember one thing, you must become my wife!”
“Impossible, I will never be your wife in this lifetime!” Xia Nuan said.
Upon hearing this, the rage in Li Yuxuan’s heart surged once more, and he said, “Fine, if you don’t agree, then I will kill you now and make you disappear completely. That way, I won’t have to worry about your safety anymore.”
Xia Nuan was stunned; she had never expected Li Yuxuan to turn his face so quickly, catching her off guard.
“Li Yuxuan, are you really going to do this?” Xia Nuan challenged.
“Indeed, you don’t know, the power of my Li Family is immense. If you dare to resist, I assure you that you will regret it deeply!” Li Yuxuan threatened.
Xia Nuan’s body was shaking; she had never felt the taste of being threatened before, yet Li Yuxuan’s words terrified her immensely.
She truly did not know what would happen if she became enemies with Li Yuxuan. Right now, all she wanted was to leave S City as quickly as possible and avoid the Li Family’s people.
Xia Nuan took a deep breath and said, “Fine, I agree to you, I can be your wife, but you must keep your word and never kill me.”
Li Yuxuan nodded and declared, “Good. From now on, we are husband and wife, regardless of how much grudges we’ve had in the past; they should all be expunged.”
Xia Nuan nodded, not uttering a word.
“My people are just upstairs, if you’re willing, I’ll take you to see him right away, have you meet him, and have him take responsibility for you,” Li Yuxuan said.
Xia Nuan was surprised; she hadn’t expected Li Yuxuan to resort to such tactics.
“Fine, I’ll go home with you!” Xia Nuan said through gritted teeth, “But first, I need to change my clothes.”
Li Yuxuan said, “You can wear my clothes.”
After speaking, Li Yuxuan turned around, went to the bedroom, got his own shirt, and threw it to Xia Nuan.
“Put it on, we’ll get in the car together,” Li Yuxuan said.
“I can do it myself!” Xia Nuan said.
“If you don’t wear it, I’ll just help you put it on!” Li Yuxuan said coldly.
Xia Nuan did not refuse and took Li Yuxuan’s shirt.
When Li Yuxuan saw Xia Nuan wearing his clothes, he couldn’t resist reaching out to touch Xia Nuan’s snow-white skin. His heartbeat accelerated, his breathing grew rapid, and his heart began to beat violently.
Seeing Li Yuxuan’s gaze constantly measuring her, Xia Nuan slapped away his wandering hands.
After his hand was slapped away, Li Yuxuan became a bit angry and said, “You cheap woman, how dare you hit me!”
“Li Yuxuan, what did you say? Did I hit you? It was clearly you who took advantage of my unpreparedness to launch a sneak attack,” Xia Nuan said.
Li Yuxuan was so furious that his chest heaved non-stop. He couldn’t believe that he, the great heir to the Li Corporation, had been struck by a young girl, and in his own bedroom at that!
“Xia Nuan, today I will let you see what it means to be a strong man!” Having said that, Li Yuxuan charged at Xia Nuan, then pushed her down onto the couch and fiercely kissed her on the mouth.
Xia Nuan struggled with all her might, but no matter how much she resisted, she was no match for Li Yuxuan.
After struggling for a while, Li Yuxuan finally released Xia Nuan’s lips and said, “How about that, now I am the strong one. You have to be my woman, and you must learn to listen to me, understand?”
“Pah!” Xia Nuan spat at Li Yuxuan and said, “I don’t need to learn your aggressive attitude!”
Seeing this, Li Yuxuan boiled with rage and said, “You bitch, how dare you spit at me! You’re looking for death!”
As Li Yuxuan raised his fist, preparing to smash it down on Xia Nuan…
“Stop!” Suddenly, a loud shout startled Li Yuxuan to the point where he almost fell on his behind, because that voice was too familiar—it was none other than Ye Haoran!
“Ye Haoran?!” Li Yuxuan’s body shuddered violently, unable to believe he was seeing Ye Haoran standing at the door.
“How are you here?!” Li Yuxuan asked.
“That’s what I should be asking you. What are you doing? Bullying my girlfriend? Are you tired of living?” Ye Haoran said darkly, already guessing that it was Li Yuxuan who had kidnapped Xia Nuan here to force her to marry him.
“I am forcing her to be my wife!” Li Yuxuan said.
“Hmph, you bastard, I didn’t settle the score with you because you saved my life. If it weren’t for the face of my master, I would have killed you already,” Ye Haoran said with a cold smile.
“Who is your master?” Li Yuxuan asked, in his eyes, Xia Nuan’s master must certainly be an old monster with terrifying cultivation.
“Hmph! You trash, you’re still not worthy to know who my master is. Now get out of here, or else I won’t be polite!” Ye Haoran warned.
Having heard Ye Haoran’s words, Li Yuxuan instantly trembled with rage, because he detected an intense disdain in Ye Haoran’s tone.
This was humiliation he had never experienced before!
All this time, it was the first time he had been insulted like this by someone of a lower rank than him! This shame, he would definitely not swallow!
“Ye Haoran, this is the Huashan Sect. How dare you speak to me like this? Don’t you know what my background is?” Li Yuxuan threatened.

chapters.title: Chapter 755 - 755 755 Not Taking Seriously
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 755: Chapter 755: Not Taking Seriously Chapter 755: Chapter 755: Not Taking Seriously “Your background? Haha! I really don’t know, but I do want to see what kind of background you have!” Ye Haoran snorted coldly, he wasn’t the least bit afraid of Li Yuxuan now.
After all, he also possessed twelve billion US dollars, and he was the president of Hualong Group. Where did this Li Yuxuan come from anyway?
Ye Haoran had heard about Li Yuxuan’s background, but he didn’t know exactly what it was.
Furthermore, Li Yuxuan’s power was only at the Martial King Realm, which Ye Haoran simply didn’t take seriously!
“Fine! Since you won’t drink a toast, you’ll have to drink a penalty then. Today I will show you my capabilities, I will definitely make you aware of my prowess!” Li Yuxuan said, and then he headed towards the door.
“If you don’t want to leave, then I’ll send you on your way and make sure you stay here forever,” Ye Haoran said coldly.
Seeing that Ye Haoran actually wanted to throw him out, Li Yuxuan trembled with rage, but he knew that he was no match for Ye Haoran right now. So, Li Yuxuan decided that after he married Xia Nuan, he would slowly torture her, making her suffer all kinds of humiliations!
With this thought, Li Yuxuan walked outside.
After he left the villa, he drove away.
Ye Haoran stayed in the villa’s living room for a while, then he looked at the time and walked towards the stairs.
He needed to rush to the Xia Group to pick up Xia Nuan’s mother!
When Ye Haoran arrived at the Xia Group building and saw that there were quite a few onlookers around the exterior of the Xia Group building, including several police cars, it made Ye Haoran frown.
“Could it be that Li Yuxuan really mistreated Xia Nuan?” Ye Haoran wondered to himself, wanting to enter the Xia Group building, but the police stopped him.
“Officer, please make an exception for me, I would like to see the wife of the chairman of Xia Group, Mrs. Xia,” Ye Haoran said.
“Sorry, this is an order from the higher-ups; we can’t do anything on our own, please understand,” the officer said.
With no other choice upon hearing this, Ye Haoran waited for Susan, the wife of the chairman of the Xia Group, to come out.
“Ye Haoran, I knew you would come,” Susan said with a smile, wearing a professional suit and smiling gracefully.
“You knew I would come, so you kidnapped Xia Nuan, didn’t you?” Ye Haoran asked accusingly.
“I kidnapped Xia Nuan only to help her regain her memory. I believe she will certainly remember me, don’t you think?” Susan said.
Ye Haoran sneered, “Ms. Susan, you’ve achieved your goal. Can you let Xia Nuan go now? I’m already here; you can release her.”
“No, I promised Xia Nuan I wouldn’t hurt her, and I keep my word!” Susan replied.
“How can you justify this to Xia Nuan? She has blind devotion toward you, yet you’re using such despicable means to coerce her!” Ye Haoran said angrily.
“Haha, my methods are despicable? Are your methods honorable? Didn’t you use force to take her away? Aren’t you despicable?” Susan retorted.
“I’m despicable? What about you? Is this your idea of being honorable?” Ye Haoran scolded angrily.
“I am honorable!” Susan said without hesitation, “You are the despicable one!”
Ye Haoran was infuriated by Susan’s words and said angrily, “Fine, then I won’t waste words with you. I’m taking Xia Nuan right now.”
Saying this, Ye Haoran reached out to grab Susan.
“You dare!” Susan scolded angrily.
Ye Haoran ignored Susan and continued to reach out for her.
Seeing Ye Haoran disregard her completely, Susan’s anger flared up in an instant, “Ye Haoran, you dare! I’m telling you, if you don’t release Xia Nuan today, I’ll make sure you die a miserable death!”
“Oh? I’m so scared! Bring it on! I’ll just stand right here waiting for you, let’s see what you can do to me!” Ye Haoran said disdainfully.
Seeing Ye Haoran’s arrogance, Susan couldn’t help but laugh in anger, “Ye Haoran, let me tell you, you think with your strength you can defeat me? Let me tell you, I am a Mysterious Rank expert, while you’re merely a Martial Apprentice Realm Martial Artist!”
Ye Haoran looked at Susan, sneered in his heart, So what if you’re Mysterious Rank? My Cultivation Technique is also Mysterious Rank, and I’m not a vegetarian either.
Ye Haoran said with a sneer, “Ms. Susan, not to hide it from you, my Cultivation Technique is also of Mysterious Rank. Do you think you have any chance of winning?”
Susan was startled at his words, “Is… is everything you said true?”
“What do you think?” Ye Haoran countered.
“Then let’s give it a try!” With that, Susan’s palms struck out simultaneously, bombarding Ye Haoran with blows.
Ye Haoran didn’t dodge or evade, but let Susan’s attacks hit him directly.
Seeing Ye Haoran so complacent, Susan was secretly thrilled, her palm winds became even faster and swifter!
Bang bang bang!
A series of muffled sounds erupted in the air, Susan’s palm winds striking at Ye Haoran like cannonballs, while Ye Haoran stood his ground, not dodging or flinching, just allowing Susan’s palm winds to hit his chest.
Bang!
Ye Haoran’s chest caved in instantaneously, and he was sent flying!
Ye Haoran fell heavily to the ground, coughing up a mouthful of blood.
Waves of intense pain emanated from Ye Haoran’s body, but he clenched his teeth and bore it because he had to protect himself and Xia Nuan! So, this pain was insignificant.
“Pfft!” Ye Haoran spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, struggled to get up, and then charged back towards Susan.
Seeing Ye Haoran’s injuries, Susan’s face lit up with joy, thinking to herself that Ye Haoran’s Cultivation wasn’t much after all; she had used all her strength, and yet she hadn’t been able to kill Ye Haoran!
As Susan was about to press her attack for a fatal blow, suddenly, a figure appeared beside Ye Haoran, then slapped him across the face.
Slap!
The crisp sound echoed throughout the courtyard, and blood flowed from the corner of Ye Haoran’s mouth.
Turning around, Ye Haoran saw that the person was Tang Anna! Ye Haoran was momentarily stunned, he never expected Tang Anna to suddenly appear before him!
“What are you doing?” Ye Haoran bellowed.
Tang Anna scoffed, then kicked Ye Haoran in the stomach, sending him flying. Moreover, Tang Anna used a Mysterious Rank Peak Cultivation Technique in her kick!
Ye Haoran crashed through two buildings before coming to a stop, spitting out blood as he lay on the ground, his eyes widening in shock.
“Who are you? How dare you hit me? Are you looking for death?” Ye Haoran roared furiously.
Although Ye Haoran didn’t use Primordial Energy, he could still use his physical body to resist the power of a Mysterious Rank Peak expert, and his physical body was even more terrifying than before. So, even if he was severely injured, Ye Haoran could still manage to stand up.
However, Ye Haoran had sustained serious internal injuries and would need time to recuperate; otherwise, there could be a risk to his life.
“Who are you? Why are you in my house?” Tang Anna asked.
“I’m a bodyguard sent by the Xia Family, we’re tasked to protect Xia Nuan!” Ye Haoran replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 756 - 756 756 No Fight No Acquaintance
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 756: Chapter 756: No Fight, No Acquaintance Chapter 756: Chapter 756: No Fight, No Acquaintance Upon hearing these words, Tang Anna’s expression became somewhat frozen; images of Xia Nuan being kidnapped by a group of people came to her mind, and ultimately, it was Ye Haoran who appeared and saved Xia Nuan, even killing a few of the kidnappers.
Tang Anna only knew of Ye Haoran because, during the time Xia Nuan was unconscious, she had gone to cause trouble for Ye Haoran at the medical hall, and at that time, Ye Haoran had also injured her.
Recalling this event, a blush of shame covered Tang Anna’s face; she had not expected that she would have acted so childishly at that time.
“I think you’ve misunderstood, Xia Nuan and I are just ordinary friends, I have no intentions of stealing her from you, and there’s no need for you to worry about me taking her away,” Ye Haoran said, looking at Tang Anna.
“You don’t? Then why did you want to have a one-on-one duel with me?” Tang Anna retorted.
Ye Haoran was taken aback by Tang Anna’s words, and then he said, “I just thought your martial arts skills were really pathetic, that’s why I wanted to have a little sparring with you.”
“My martial arts skills are pathetic?” Tang Anna was a bit slow to react at the moment.
“Yes, I can tell, your skills are very poor, and that technique you just used was the most basic Mysterious Rank Technique. I could easily defeat you any time!” Ye Haoran claimed.
Hearing this, Tang Anna immediately became furious, “Ye Haoran, you’re bullying me!”
“Haha! Tang Anna, your martial arts skills really are pathetic. I won’t take it to heart, but since you’ve made a move on me just now, we should really settle this account!” Ye Haoran declared.
“Alright, then you tell me, how should we settle this?” Tang Anna asked.
“It’s simple, I’ll let go of what just happened, I just hope that you won’t harass Xia Nuan in the future! Otherwise, don’t blame me for not being polite!” Ye Haoran stated.
Tang Anna was stunned, then a bitter smile appeared on her face, “Heh, it seems I’ve been meddling too much, what does your matter have to do with me!”
Hearing this, Ye Haoran looked at Tang Anna, and then said, “Tang Anna, don’t think I don’t know you like me. Liking me is your business, but if you hurt Xia Nuan, I absolutely won’t let you off!”
Upon hearing Ye Haoran’s words, Tang Anna couldn’t help but burst into laughter, her laughter was so intense that she quivered, and she said, “You’re too narcissistic, aren’t you? I like you? I like you? Do you even qualify? I just thought you were handsome, so I just wanted to teach you a lesson, that’s all. Who would like you? Stop being so full of yourself!”
Mockery was written all over Tang Anna’s face, she had never taken Ye Haoran seriously!
“Since you like your beauty so much, then go find some pretty boy, and stop bothering me!” Ye Haoran snorted coldly.
“A pretty boy? Indeed, I did have one, but unfortunately, I got tired of that pretty boy long ago. So, if you want me to go find a pretty boy, you first have to ask if I’m willing!” Tang Anna sneered.
“Pah!” Ye Haoran cursed softly, then said, “I think you’re nothing but a ****, all day long only engaging in these kinds of deeds, aren’t you tired?”
Ye Haoran’s words immediately enraged Tang Anna; she snorted coldly, then said, “You’re courting death!”
With those words, Tang Anna lunged at Ye Haoran. Her speed was incredibly fast; in the blink of an eye, Tang Anna was already in front of Ye Haoran, throwing a punch at him.
Ye Haoran hadn’t expected Tang Anna’s speed to be so fast; it seemed that her strength had reached the Transformative Realm Peak, otherwise, how could her speed be so incredibly fast.
Not daring to take her lightly, Ye Haoran quickly employed the Golden Bell Shield Iron Cloth Shirt while also channeling the Dragon Claw Technique. His hands formed a seal and grabbed towards Tang Anna’s arms!
Tang Anna had not expected Ye Haoran’s defense to be so formidable. She hastily retreated, dodging Ye Haoran’s attack, while Ye Haoran pursued the victory, launching a relentless onslaught of attacks that forced Tang Anna to defend and no longer dare to actively strike back.
“Although your martial arts are very adept, you simply cannot block me!” Tang Anna snorted coldly.
“Who says I can’t block you, I just don’t want to hurt you, that’s all!” Ye Haoran retorted.
“We’ll see about that!” Tang Anna chuckled derisively.
After her words, Tang Anna’s figure flashed, and she pounced toward Ye Haoran. Her pair of jade hands ferociously struck out at Ye Haoran, who, seeing this, quickly executed his Dragon Claw Technique. His fists met Tang Anna’s jade hands in collision.
Ye Haoran felt a jolt in his arm and couldn’t help but be surprised, Tang Anna’s strength was truly formidable!
“Ye Haoran, although my strength may not compare with yours, your power is far from matching mine. I’m telling you, among martial artists, I rank fifty-seventh on the leaderboard!” Tang Anna said with a cold laugh.
Raising an eyebrow, Ye Haoran remarked, “Oh? Am I not even a match for you then?”
“Hmph! You couldn’t even block one of my moves, and yet you dare claim you’re the fifty-seventh on the rankings. It seems you’re overblowing your achievements!” Tang Anna taunted.
Hearing Tang Anna’s words, Ye Haoran dismissively curled his lips and said, “I can’t be bothered with you!”
With that, Ye Haoran turned and left.
Watching Ye Haoran depart, Tang Anna’s lips hinted at an imperceptible smile.
The reason Tang Anna had helped Ye Haoran was that she realized he seemed different from ordinary people, possessing a mysterious power that could draw her attention.
Furthermore, she noticed Ye Haoran and Xia Nuan had a very close relationship. Therefore, if she wanted to help Xia Nuan, she needed to suppress Ye Haoran first, to show Xia Nuan his true nature.
What exactly was Ye Haoran’s true nature? Tang Anna had her speculations—she guessed that Ye Haoran might be a cultivator.
The reason Tang Anna focused on provoking Ye Haoran was to irritate him, prompt him to break through his mental defenses, and eventually reveal his secrets. If Ye Haoran spilled his secrets, she would find a way to confirm whether he was truly a cultivator.
