“Just wait until I knock you down!” Tang Anna watched Ye Haoran disappear into the night, a triumphant smile playing across her lips.
After leaving the school, Ye Haoran headed toward the hotel, intending to rest a bit. He planned to return to the capital the next morning, as the night’s events were a test for him.
Once Ye Haoran returned to his hotel room, he sat down cross-legged and began to regulate his breathing to recover his internal power.
“My physical condition is recovering quite well; otherwise, I couldn’t have sustained that battle, nor could my physical body have endured such immense pain. I’m not that fragile!” Ye Haoran murmured as he sensed the changes in his body.
Ye Haoran’s condition recovered rapidly, restoring him to peak condition. Now, he was preparing to attempt a breakthrough and enter the Martial Ancestor Realm.
“Break through the Martial King!” The thought popped into Ye Haoran’s mind.
Previously on Earth, Ye Haoran had taken several elixirs, whose potent effects helped him achieve a breakthrough to the Peak of Martial Ancestor. Now, by taking these elixirs again, he might be able to seamlessly advance into the Martial King Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 757 - 757 757 Confident
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 757: Chapter 757: Confident Chapter 757: Chapter 757: Confident Ye Haoran wasn’t without confidence either. He was certain that after taking several elixirs, he could break through to the Martial King Realm. By then, even if Tang Anna’s strength was formidable, he was sure he could defeat her.
“Hmm? Why haven’t I used my elixir yet, do I need to wait a bit longer?” Ye Haoran silently wondered.
However, he didn’t hesitate; he directly consumed those several elixirs, believing firmly that his strength would definitely improve again. By then, coupled with his own power, Ye Haoran was convinced that he would be stronger.
After taking the elixir, Ye Haoran began to adjust his breathing and started cultivating. He was at a bottleneck and needed to break through as soon as possible.
Just as Ye Haoran began to regulate his breathing, a knocking sound interrupted him.
“Come in,” Ye Haoran said indifferently.
“Knock, knock, knock!”
As the knocking resumed, a voice came from the door, melodic as a songbird.
“Is it you?” Ye Haoran frowned.
“It’s me, Ye Haoran!” the person outside said, “Where are you? I can’t find you!”
“So it’s you!” When Ye Haoran heard the knocking, he found it somewhat familiar, yet he couldn’t immediately think of who it might be.
“Ye Haoran, are you in your room? If not, I’m going to come in, okay?” the voice outside continued to inquire.
With a helpless eye roll, Ye Haoran opened the door.
“I’m right here!” Ye Haoran smiled upon seeing the woman standing outside.
“Haha, Ye Haoran, you finally showed up.” The woman outside laughed when she saw him, “I knew you wouldn’t leave me hanging, I knew you wouldn’t make me wait for too long!”
“I haven’t left you hanging; I just wanted to take a shower, so I was delayed!” Ye Haoran explained.
“Really? But I’ve been waiting for you for two to three minutes now; aren’t you a bit too slow?” The girl outside pouted.
Ye Haoran awkwardly scratched his head, “I really did go to take a shower!”
“You went to shower? Then why did it take so long?” The girl outside muttered. Seeing her, Ye Haoran felt a twinge of embarrassment, “That… I was gone for two to three minutes, you don’t mind, do you?”
“Why would I mind? I’m just curious why you took so long!” the girl outside said, puzzled.
“Ah, well, I might have stayed a bit longer in the bathroom, so it took that much time!” Ye Haoran blurted out a fib.
Ye Haoran wasn’t intentionally lying to the girl; he truly had only been in the bathroom for two or three minutes. In that time, Ye Haoran was cultivating his technique, using the power to restore his Qi-Blood to optimal condition, preparing for his breakthrough.
“Don’t lie to me, I don’t believe it!” the girl outside said with a scoff, clearly unconvinced by Ye Haoran’s words.
“Why would I lie to you? If you don’t believe me, just wait and see!” Ye Haoran chuckled, “I’m going inside first.”
Having said this, Ye Haoran turned to walk inside, but the girl stopped him.
“Hey! Don’t run off; tell me the truth first!” the girl demanded.
Ye Haoran stopped in his tracks, turned around to face the girl, and said earnestly, “I was just cultivating, so I got held up a bit. You’re not upset, are you?”
The girl outside shook her head, “I’m not upset, but I won’t let you in unless you explain it to me.”
“So what kind of explanation do you want to hear?” Ye Haoran shrugged helplessly and continued, “While I was cultivating earlier, I accidentally slipped into devilment, so it took me a while. Please don’t blame me, alright?”
“Oh, so that’s it; I thought you were hitting on some girl and that’s why you took so long to come out!” The girl outside huffed lightly.
“How could that be, how could I do something so tasteless!” Ye Haoran waved his hand, “And besides, why would I be with a girl like you? I’m afraid I would catch a stench.”
“You’re disgusting!” The girl outside was immediately displeased when she heard Ye Haoran speak about her that way, she stamped her foot and said: “Didn’t you want to know my name? Fine, I’ll tell you now, my name is Qin Yushi!”
Ye Haoran laughed, “Qin Yushi, nice name!”
“Hmph!” Qin Yushi snorted coldly, then she asked, “Can I come in now?”
“Of course, you can!” Ye Haoran was slightly startled, “Are you here to see me?”
Qin Yushi nodded and then said, “You just had a breakthrough, so I came to check on you and also to celebrate with you.”
“Celebrate?” Ye Haoran was a bit surprised as he looked at Qin Yushi, but then a slight smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, “Alright, then you come help me celebrate!”
“Hmm!” Qin Yushi nodded her head and then walked towards Ye Haoran’s room.
Qin Yushi sat down on the couch in the room and then took out her phone to dial Ye Haoran’s number.
As soon as the call connected, Ye Haoran’s phone started to ring; he took it out and saw that it was Qin Yushi calling.
Ye Haoran quickly put the phone to his ear, “Hello, hi.”
“What are you busy with, why didn’t you answer the phone for so long?” Qin Yushi said petulantly.
“I was taking a shower just now and didn’t notice the phone ringing,” Ye Haoran explained.
“Taking a shower?” Qin Yushi was surprised; she widened her eyes and looked around Ye Haoran’s room, “This is a girl’s boudoir, why are you taking a shower here?”
Qin Yushi was very surprised.
“Hehe, I just had a breakthrough and needed to cultivate; I’m currently charging toward the Martial Artist Realm!” Ye Haoran chuckled and then said.
“Martial Artist? Is the breakthrough very painful? Hold on a little, don’t be stubborn. I have some medicine here that can relieve the pain, do you want to use some?” Qin Yushi said with concern.
“No need, I can get through it on my own; you should go back to rest soon,” Ye Haoran said with a smile.
“Oh!” Qin Yushi made a sound of acknowledgment, “Then remember to take your medicine, I’m leaving, goodnight!”
“Yeah, goodnight!” Ye Haoran chuckled, then hung up the phone.
After Ye Haoran put away the phone, he entered the bathroom to wash up.
…
After finishing washing up, Ye Haoran came out of the room, he headed toward the living room; by this time, he had already changed into his pajamas.
Just having taken a shower, the faint scent of shower gel on his body was intoxicating to Ye Haoran.
Looking at Qin Yushi sitting on the living room couch with her legs crossed, Ye Haoran couldn’t help but swallow.
Even though he was a man, the sight of a beautiful woman made him drool, and this beauty was much more beautiful than Susanna, at the very least Susanna was a Lolita.
“Did you come out from the shower?” Qin Yushi saw Ye Haoran come out and quickly stood up.
Ye Haoran nodded, “Yes, what’s up, is there something?”

chapters.title: Chapter 758 - 758 758 Intentionally Looking for Topics
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 758: Chapter 758: Intentionally Looking for Topics Chapter 758: Chapter 758: Intentionally Looking for Topics “Oh, actually it’s nothing, just wanted to tell you that I’ve bought breakfast, it’s on the table, you better come eat!” Qin Yushi said with a smile.
“Thank you!” Ye Haoran smiled, then walked over to the dining table, sat down, picked up his bowl and chopsticks, and began to eat a piece of meat with great gusto.
“You should eat more slowly, no one is fighting with you for food, why are you in such a hurry!” Qin Yushi laughed.
“Heh, I’m not rushing, I always eat slowly!” Ye Haoran said.
“Then you should eat faster, it will get cold soon,” Qin Yushi glanced at the breakfast on the table and said.
“I’ll finish these few bites then eat, thank you, Yushi!” Ye Haoran said, smiling happily at Qin Yushi.
He thought Qin Yushi was really beautiful, if it were not for Ye Haoran being a man, he probably would not have been able to resist hugging her.
But Ye Haoran was a man, and he couldn’t hug Qin Yushi, so he could only look, touch.
“It’s fine, I’ve just woken up and haven’t taken a shower yet, I’ll bring it to you after I shower!” Qin Yushi said.
“No need! I will leave after I finish eating now!” Ye Haoran refused Qin Yushi’s kindness.
“Don’t be in such a hurry to leave!” Qin Yushi quickly called out to Ye Haoran.
Ye Haoran was a bit puzzled and asked, “Don’t tell me you want to keep me here for lunch?”
“Of course not!” Qin Yushi’s face turned red, then she said somewhat shyly, “Can you stay and talk with me for a while? I just woke up and have had no one to talk to, I’ve almost died of boredom!”
“Uh…” Ye Haoran was taken aback for a moment, then nodded and said, “Since you want to chat, I’ll accompany you for a bit.”
“Yeah!” Qin Yushi nodded, a smile appearing on her face, and then she sat beside Ye Haoran, picking up the newspaper on the coffee table to browse through.
“Yushi, what kind of magazines do you like to read?” Ye Haoran asked.
Qin Yushi looked up at these words, blinking her large eyes, she asked, “I don’t read those things, what I read are international magazines!”
Hearing this, Ye Haoran smiled. He knew Qin Yushi must have said this on purpose; this way, he couldn’t possibly ask her what kind of magazines she liked.
“Well then, since you don’t read them, what kind would you like to read?” Ye Haoran asked.
“Anything!” Qin Yushi said, “I’m not picky, as long as it can fill my stomach, I like to read everything!”
“Alright, then I’ll tell you about the history of Huaxia!” Ye Haoran smiled, “Our Huaxia has five thousand years of civilization history, and we Huaxia people are very smart and thoughtful, so our ancestors were all very excellent.”
Hearing Ye Haoran’s words, Qin Yushi nodded, indicating her agreement.
“Huaxia is an ancient nation with a profound culture, their wisdom is incomparable to that of ordinary nations, their heritage is very long-standing,” Ye Haoran continued to introduce.
“Seems like your ancestors were quite amazing!” Qin Yushi said.
“Yeah, my ancestors are indeed the great heroes of our Huaxia,” Ye Haoran said with a smile. “However, they also had many flaws, and these flaws were quite fatal.”
“Oh, let’s hear it then!” Qin Yushi said excitedly.
“Alright!” Ye Haoran consented with a nod, and he began to explain Huaxia’s history and culture to Qin Yushi.
Qin Yushi listened very attentively. She enjoyed listening, especially to Ye Haoran’s explanations, which attracted her even more, because all these things were unknown to her, hence she wanted to hear them.
For the entire morning, Ye Haoran explained to Qin Yushi for a long time. In between, he even had a cup of tea, of course, it was tea brewed by Qin Yushi, and it tasted good. It was a pity there was no alcohol, otherwise, he might have drunk a few cups.
“Phew! Finally done,” Ye Haoran took a deep breath, then said, “What I’ve told you is just the tip of the iceberg. After reading so many books, I believe you’ll have a deeper understanding of Huaxia’s history. However, some things I prefer not to talk about, so it’s best not to ask me about them.”
“Oh, I got it,” Qin Yushi said with a smile, “I just hope that one day, you could talk to me about the two of us!”
“Sure, next time you come to our class, I’ll definitely chat with you,” Ye Haoran said with a smile.
Qin Yushi nodded.
“I’ve got to go now, bye!” Ye Haoran stood up with a grin and walked towards the exit. Before leaving the room, he turned around and looked back at Qin Yushi.
Qin Yushi, under Ye Haoran’s gaze, felt her body warm up, and she bowed her head, not daring to look back at Ye Haoran.
“Sister Yushi, I’m leaving now, next time I come, I’ll buy you a lollipop,” Ye Haoran said with a mischievous smile, followed by a burst of laughter.
After finishing his words, Ye Haoran left, but he didn’t go far, just sitting on the staircase steps, watching Qin Yushi.
Qin Yushi’s face turned even redder and she glared at Ye Haoran fiercely.
Seeing how shameless Ye Haoran was, Qin Yushi felt somewhat dejected. This guy was such a rogue, daring to do that sort of thing in front of her, and in her own living room no less, directing such behavior at her, which made her very angry.
Qin Yushi cursed silently, “This scoundrel, he’s such a rogue!”
“No, I can’t stay with this guy any longer. I have to find an opportunity to shake him off,” Qin Yushi thought determinedly.
While Qin Yushi was thinking, suddenly her phone rang. She picked it up and saw that it was a call from Ye Haoran, which surprised her. Ye Haoran calling her – this was the first time. Could he be asking her out? No way, they had only met for the second time!
Qin Yushi hesitated for a moment, but eventually she pressed the answer button, “Hello!”
“Sister Yushi, where are you now? I’m coming to find you!” Ye Haoran said.
“What for? I’m at school!” Qin Yushi asked, confused.
“Oh, I’m downstairs!” Ye Haoran chuckled, “Let’s talk more later!”
After saying that, Ye Haoran hung up the phone and stood up from the staircase steps.
“This jerk!” Qin Yushi said angrily. She really couldn’t understand Ye Haoran. She hadn’t provoked him, so why was he always bothering her? Could it be that she was that beautiful? Or was it that her charms weren’t enough? The more Qin Yushi thought about it, the more frustrated she felt and decided that after class, she needed to have a talk with Ye Haoran.
The bell for class rang, and Ye Haoran walked into the classroom.
“Ye Haoran, why are you here again?” As soon as they saw Ye Haoran, the male classmates began to shout at him.
“Ah! Heh, I’ve come to pick up a girl!” Ye Haoran said, as he walked towards Qin Yushi.
Watching Ye Haoran approach, Qin Yushi’s cheeks flushed red as she said, “You… we are not that familiar with each other! You don’t need to come to the girls’ dormitory to pick someone up, right?”
Qin Yushi’s words pricked up the ears of the other Lin Yis in the class, and as they listened to what she said, emotions of envy, jealousy, and resentment arose within them. Damn it, why didn’t they have a great girl like her who liked them? Why was their luck not as good as Ye Haoran’s?
Seeing Qin Yushi’s expression, Ye Haoran laughed, “I’ve come to meet my classmate. We’re from the same dormitory. How familiar does that make us?”

chapters.title: Chapter 759 - 759 759 Two Fiancées
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 759: Chapter 759: Two Fiancées? Chapter 759: Chapter 759: Two Fiancées? Hearing Ye Haoran say this, Qin Yushi felt somewhat sweet inside, yet she still asked, “What’s your classmate’s name?”
Ye Haoran was in a bind, as he couldn’t really answer the question. After all, both Li Bingyan and Wang Yuqing were his fiancées; how could he tell someone else about this!
At this thought, Ye Haoran shook his head and said, “Never mind, I don’t know.”
“Hmph, if you don’t tell me, I can still find out. Let’s go, take me to him. Which dormitory is he in? I want to see which handsome guy has captivated our beautiful and kind little Yushi,” a girl said, smiling mischievously.
Hearing the girl’s words, Ye Haoran was at a loss for words. This girl, how could she speak so rudely? She really had no manners!
“You girl, how can you speak like that!” Ye Haoran looked at the girl and frowned as he said, “We classmates are all united and help each other. How can you talk nonsense like this!”
The girl was startled, then smiled and said, “Yes, I just like little Yushi! We are all grown-ups; can’t we fall in love? What’s wrong with me wanting to pursue the girl I like? What gives you the right to say I’m wrong!”
Seeing the girl’s arrogance, Ye Haoran was also infuriated. To be honest, Ye Haoran hated it the most when someone spoke to him with an aggressive attitude.
Moreover, the other party was a young girl, which made Ye Haoran even more repulsed.
Therefore, Ye Haoran directly said, “With that attitude of yours, do you even deserve to pursue little Yushi? You’re not worthy of her!”
Hearing Ye Haoran’s words, the girl immediately became angry and pointed at Ye Haoran, saying, “I’m not worthy? Who is, then? You?”
“It’s me. I’m the man most suited for little Yushi!” At that moment, a girl’s voice came from beside Ye Haoran. After speaking, the girl even threw Ye Haoran a coquettish glance, her manner oozing charm!
The girl’s looks were definitely not lacking, even quite beautiful, but Ye Haoran had absolutely no interest in her.
Hearing a girl speak to him like that, Ye Haoran’s expression immediately darkened. He looked at the girl before him and said coldly, “I advise you to give up early. You’re not worthy of little Yushi!”
“Heh, whether I’m worthy or not is not for me to say. I only know I like little Yushi! I’ll prove it to you!” After saying this, the girl walked away, swaying her hips provocatively.
Ye Haoran watched the girl’s retreating figure, frowning slightly. He looked at Qin Yushi and said, “I think that girl is not bad, pretty and well-built. Even though she’s not exactly Supreme Grade, I quite admire her character!”
Hearing Ye Haoran’s comments, Qin Yushi’s face immediately turned sour, “You think she’s pretty?”
“Yes,” Ye Haoran nodded. “Not only is she beautiful, but she’s also very straightforward in her speech. She has quite the personality; I like it!”
Seeing the earnest look in Ye Haoran’s eyes and hearing his words, Qin Yushi suddenly felt as if she had misunderstood him. His gaze just then contained not a hint of lewdness or lasciviousness; it was instead a pure admiration, no wonder she had thought him to be a lecher!
“Alright, let’s go!” Ye Haoran smiled and said.
“Let’s go, I want to find her and ask her myself! I really want to see who dares to covet my little Yushi,” Qin Yushi said, then turned and walked towards the outside of the dormitory building.
Ye Haoran watched Qin Yushi leave, shook his head, then also headed towards the girls’ dormitory.
Arriving in front of the girls’ dormitory, Ye Haoran knocked on the door, and it was quickly opened by a girl.
“Hello, I’m Qin Yushi’s teacher! I’m here to deliver fruits to our student, could you please pass them on to her?” Ye Haoran said.
“Oh, sure!” The girl saw it was Ye Haoran, immediately smiled in response, and then took the fruit basket he handed to her.
Ye Haoran smiled and nodded, then headed toward the stairwell. He knew that Qin Yushi lived on the second floor, and he also wanted to check on Li Bingyan and Wang Yuqing.
On the second floor, Ye Haoran found it to be quieter than the first floor. He entered a room and gently knocked on the door, which wasn’t long before it opened.
“Ye Haoran, what brings you here?” Wang Yuqing asked with delight upon seeing him.
“Are you getting used to living here? If not, I could arrange for someone to take you back,” Ye Haoran said with concern.
“Hehe, don’t worry, we’re doing quite well here, and our parents are very good to us,” Li Bingyan said.
“Well, that’s good. If you need any help, just ask!” Ye Haoran nodded and said.
“You should go back first. We can take care of ourselves!” Wang Yuqing said.
Ye Haoran looked at Li Bingyan and said, “Alright then, but remember to come to me for dinner after evening classes!”
After speaking, Ye Haoran went downstairs, leaving Li Bingyan there giggling.
On the other hand, once Ye Haoran had left, Qin Yushi immediately headed to the dormitory of that girl. Outside the girl’s dormitory stood two girls, both wearing pink dresses and possessing ample busts, with skin so fair and smooth that it made Qin Yushi involuntarily swallow her saliva.
Seeing Qin Yushi’s reaction, the two girls exchanged a glance, then walked over to her.
Confronted by two beauties in front of her, Qin Yushi felt slightly displeased, but she quickly returned to normal and smiled at the girl in front of her, saying, “Hello, you must be Li Bingyan, right?”
The two girls looked at each other and then nodded, “Yes, she’s our homeroom teacher!”
“Oh, I wanted to ask, does classmate Li Bingyan have someone she likes?” Qin Yushi inquired.
“What do you mean by that?” one of the girls said with disapproval.
“I mean, I’m wondering if you guys have someone you like. I’m Li Bingyan’s older cousin. If you like my younger cousin, I could put in a good word for you!” Qin Yushi said.
Hearing Qin Yushi’s words, the two girls blushed, and one of them said, “You’re thinking too much. We definitely won’t like your younger cousin!”
Upon hearing this, Qin Yushi burst into laughter and said, “Well, if you don’t like him, then let it be. But remember what I said, yeah?”
“Whatever you say!” the girl retorted, pushing Qin Yushi slightly, “You should go now. We don’t want to deal with a crazy woman like you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 760 - 760 760 Stars in Their Eyes
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 760: Chapter 760: Stars in Their Eyes Chapter 760: Chapter 760: Stars in Their Eyes Seeing her like that, Qin Yushi had no other choice. After all, she had no right to interfere with someone else’s personal life, especially since her relationship with Ye Haoran was merely that of a teacher and student.
They hadn’t developed any other kind of relationship, and Qin Yushi didn’t want to act irrationally because she didn’t want Ye Haoran to misunderstand her intentions.
So, without saying anything further, Qin Yushi turned and walked toward the classroom while the girl continued to tidy up her things.
“This girl, who does she think she is, being so shameless?” Watching Qin Yushi’s retreating figure, the girl named Huang Juan commented.
Hearing Huang Juan’s words, another girl nodded and added, “I felt it was strange too. The way she looked at us was as if she saw her sworn enemies. I really dislike her!”
“Hmph, let’s not bother with her anymore, let’s get back to our own business!” Huang Juan said and turned to leave.
“Do you think that girl just now might be in love with Teacher Ye?” someone asked at that moment.
Upon hearing this, Huang Juan and the three others were taken aback. “No way, are you overthinking this?”
“I’m not overthinking! Didn’t you see how she looked at Teacher Ye, with those peach blossom eyes?” Lin Yi remarked.
“Don’t make wild guesses, that’s impossible!” the others said in unison, rejecting Lin Yi’s speculation.
“How can you be so sure it’s impossible? How do you know that?” Not willing to be dismissed, Lin Yi retorted defiantly.
“If you don’t believe it, go ask Li Bingyan. See if it’s true!” Huang Juan suggested.
Hearing this, Lin Yi hesitated, then declared, “I’ll go ask Li Bingyan!” With that, he ran off towards Li Bingyan’s dormitory.
Meanwhile, inside her dorm, Li Bingyan was unaware that someone was eavesdropping outside her room, listening to her conversation with Ye Haoran.
“Knock knock knock~” Lin Yi tapped gently on the door of Li Bingyan’s dormitory.
Hearing the knocking, Li Bingyan was puzzled. Could it be Ye Haoran looking for her again?
“Who is it?” Li Bingyan called out.
“It’s me!” Lin Yi shouted.
Li Bingyan was surprised, then invited, “Please come in!”
Lin Yi pushed the door open, glanced around the room to find it empty, then entered. He saw a mound on the bed covered with a black comforter and wondered if Li Bingyan was under there.
Then Li Bingyan’s voice reached him, “Please sit down, what brings you here?”
Lin Yi was startled, “You’re sleeping. I won’t disturb you then.”
With that, Lin Yi prepared to leave. He was curious about how Ye Haoran was pursuing Li Bingyan, but he still believed Li Bingyan wouldn’t fall for Ye Haoran. After all, Li Bingyan was a big celebrity and quite proud too.
“Wait a second!” Li Bingyan called out.
Lin Yi stopped in his tracks, puzzled by what Li Bingyan wanted. Had she changed her mind and decided to be with him? The thought excited Lin Yi, and he asked, “Li Bingyan, have you had a change of heart? Do you want to be with me now?”
Hearing Lin Yi’s self-loving tone, Li Bingyan rolled her eyes, “I just want to ask you, do you like Bing Yan or not?”
Upon hearing Li Bingyan’s words, Lin Yi’s face immediately fell, “I don’t like Bing Yan!”
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Li Bingyan chuckled coldly, then said, “If you don’t like her, then why do you claim to be Bing Yan’s cousin? If you really didn’t like Bing Yan, you should have told me, instead of using the title of cousin to deceive people!”
“What’s wrong with being her cousin, I’m her real brother!” Lin Yi said with dissatisfaction.
“But you still don’t like her!” Li Bingyan sneered again.
“Alright, I like Bing Yan, okay?” Lin Yi said reluctantly.
“Since you know you like Bing Yan, then hurry up and make it clear to my cousin, don’t keep her thinking about my cousin. If you like her, I’ll bless you two!” Li Bingyan said.
“That…” Lin Yi looked at Li Bingyan, somewhat at a loss, but then, thinking of what Ye Haoran had said to him earlier, Lin Yi suddenly felt emboldened, “Bing Yan, let me tell you, I actually don’t like her at all. I saw how obsessed you were with Ye Haoran,
so I wanted to make him give you up and be with me. That way, I wouldn’t be taken away by you, and then I’d become your cousin-in-law!”
“I don’t understand what you’re saying!” Li Bingyan shook her head, indicating she didn’t understand any of it.
“You don’t need to understand, you just have to listen to me. Don’t worry, after I marry you, I will take good care of you, making sure you never have to worry about food or clothing!” Lin Yi said.
“You marry me? Hah, what makes you think you can marry me?” Li Bingyan said disdainfully.
“Of course because I’m your cousin!” Lin Yi declared proudly.
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, Li Bingyan couldn’t help but roll her eyes again, then said, “You have no shame, claiming to be my cousin, yet you use your cousin to threaten others!”
Hearing this remark from Li Bingyan, Lin Yi was furious, “Li Bingyan, you have a boyfriend, yet you’re with me. Aren’t you making your boyfriend angry?”
At Lin Yi’s words, Li Bingyan paused, then suddenly remembered about Ye Haoran, “Right, I do have a boyfriend!”
Seeing Li Bingyan’s reaction, Lin Yi thought she had finally admitted it and said with a smile, “Since you admit you have a boyfriend, why are you still clinging to Ye Haoran?”
“This is called foolish infatuation. The person I like has always been my boyfriend Ye Haoran, I never liked you!” Li Bingyan immediately said.
Hearing Li Bingyan’s words, Lin Yi became even more smug. He laughed loudly and then said, “It doesn’t matter if you don’t like me, I fell in love with you at first sight, I want you!”
Having said that, Lin Yi charged at Li Bingyan, intending to tackle her down.
But as soon as Lin Yi dived towards Li Bingyan’s bed, she suddenly stood up and launched a punch, sending Lin Yi flying out and crashing to the ground, blood trickling from the corner of his mouth.
“How dare you hit me, you shameless woman!” Lin Yi got up and pointed at Li Bingyan, cursing.
“Get lost, it’s none of your concern how I deal with my man!” Li Bingyan finished speaking and lay down on the bed, falling fast asleep, as if all that had happened had nothing to do with her.
Lin Yi’s face showed anger upon hearing Li Bingyan’s words. He hadn’t expected that, despite his kind intentions, Li Bingyan was not only ungrateful but also wanted to drive him away.
“I’m not leaving. You must stay with me tonight. If you don’t stay with me, I won’t leave. I want to sleep with you!” Lin Yi said in a huff.

chapters.title: Chapter 761 - 761 781 Sprinting Forward
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 761: Chapter 781: Sprinting Forward Chapter 761: Chapter 781: Sprinting Forward But Lin Yi didn’t give up, he still desperately ran towards the front, his speed now even faster than before.
But just at that moment, the mountain in front suddenly exploded, revealing a gigantic black bear over twenty-feet tall in Lin Yi’s path.
This black bear, covered in dark skin and brimming with muscles, exuded an aura of power. With its short, stout legs, each strand of fur stood erect like steel needles, giving off a cold glint like that of steel in the light.
In the eyes of the black bear, there was a savage light. It roared angrily and spewed a mouthful of black flame, attacking Lin Yi.
The column of black flame, carrying a destructive momentum, arced through the air and struck Lin Yi’s body.
Lin Yi’s clothes were instantly scorched by the black flame, and his body was pierced through, blood streaming down.
Lin Yi quickly took out the Elixir, swallowing it down.
But even after taking the Elixir, Lin Yi’s wounds did not improve.
This black bear was immensely powerful, and its black flame, being its life essence fire, was terrifyingly potent. Even a Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator would fall under its blaze, let alone Lin Yi, a mere Qi Cultivation Third Layer Cultivator.
“Roar, roar, roar!”
The black bear roared furiously, opening its mouth to spew out black fireballs, bombarding Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s body was hit with vicious wounds, but not once did he grimace, leaping up and continuing his escape.
“Roar!”
The great black bear roared, its mouth expelling clusters of black flames, bombarding Lin Yi’s body.
The temperature of the black flame was very high. Although Lin Yi’s Gang Qi provided some protection, the heat still scorched his body.
Wisps of Qing Yan rose from his body while streaks of blood surfaced on his skin, the blood continuing to flow down and staining his clothes red.
Lin Yi’s speed increased, and he finally escaped the black bear’s attack range.
“Phew…”
Lin Yi let out a long breath, looking at the wounds covering his body and inwardly lamenting.
This black bear was too formidable, with strength comparable to the Golden Core Early Stage. Even with Lin Yi’s Nascent Soul Stage combat experience, he felt somewhat at a loss.
Fortunately, inside Lin Yi’s storage ring, there was no shortage of healing pills, so he wasn’t in too much trouble.
But even so, the injuries he sustained had surpassed Lin Yi’s expectations.
After all, in the recent period, Lin Yi had been training his physical condition crazily every day to catch up with the other students, to the extent of even spending a fortune on Body Tempering Liquid.
Yet, even with that, his physical condition was only at the Qi Cultivation Second Layer.
If he encountered a Martial Artist at the Sixth Layer, Lin Yi was confident he could beat them, but if he faced one at the Ninth Level, Lin Yi figured he definitely couldn’t escape.
“It seems I need to enhance my strength as soon as possible,” Lin Yi murmured to himself.
At that moment, Lin Yi heard the sound of footsteps in the distance, signifying that someone was approaching and also speeding up.
“Who’s there?” Lin Yifei tensed up and looked ahead warily.
About five hundred meters away from Lin Yi, a group of figures dressed in standard black uniforms sped towards him, their chests embroidered with white and blue patterns and elegantly written characters.
“Huaxia Dragon Group!”
Lin Yi’s gaze sharpened, never having expected to encounter a team from the Huaxia Dragon Group.
The people from the Huaxia Dragon Group could be considered the strongest batch in the whole Hua Country, with formidable strength, even comparable to the Northwestern Military District.
Especially since within the Huaxia Dragon Group, there were many extraordinary characters, including numerous Golden Core Stage experts.
Hope suddenly surged in Lin Yi’s heart. If these Huaxia Dragon Group members were to lend a hand, they should be able to save him from this perilous situation.
With that thought, Lin Yi shouted toward the distant team members, “Seniors, please save this junior!”
Upon seeing Lin Yi, the Dragon Group members immediately stopped in their tracks.
“Eh? How did this kid end up in such a sorry state?” a Dragon Group member wondered aloud.
“Who cares? Let’s capture him and then ask about the situation.”
The Dragon Group members sneered and flew straight towards Lin Yi.
“Seniors, please save this junior!”
Seeing this, Lin Yi shouted urgently.
The cultivation of these Dragon Group members was formidable, with the weakest being at the peak of the Late Foundation Establishment Stage, and their captain had even reached the Seventh Layer of the Qi Cultivation Stage.
Their strength was simply overwhelming. Lin Yi’s heart nearly leapt out of his chest.
“Who exactly are you?” one of the Dragon Group members asked Lin Yi.
“I’m a student of the Huaxia Dragon Group, sent here on a mission by my instructor for training. However, I’ve been injured by a black bear, and I’m in great danger now. Seniors, please lend your aid and save me from this predicament!” Lin Yi said.
“Oh? A student of the Huaxia Dragon Group with injuries? Are you seeking death?”
Upon hearing this, the Dragon Group member’s brow furrowed, and an unhappy expression crossed his face.
They were all well-trained elites of the Dragon Group. Each year, they recruited outstanding students from all over the world, and their duty was to guard the national borders, allowing no one to intrude.
Anyone attempting to breach the borders would be severely punished!
“Yes, this junior is seeking death!” Lin Yi gritted his teeth, wishing he could rush forward and slay those Dragon Group elites right then and there.
“Hmm? You dare to defy your instructor’s orders? You must be tired of living,” one of the Dragon Group members scolded angrily.
“Hmph, what do you think you are, and what gives you the right to make decisions for your instructor? Is it that only they are permitted to kill at will, and you aren’t allowed to slaughter others as you please?” Lin Yi retorted furiously.
“You… you’re seeking death!”
The Dragon Group members, upon hearing that, immediately became enraged, each unleashing their formidable combat power.
These Dragon Group elites were all masters of the Foundation Establishment Stage, each one a first-class expert!
Even though Lin Yi possessed combat power matching the Nascent Soul Stage, facing so many adversaries left him without a chance of victory and even at risk of falling.
But Lin Yi was unwilling to just standby hopelessly.
“I’m going all out!”
Lin Yi’s eyes flickered with a plan, and he quickly took out a jade pendant, putting it to his lips and blowing fiercely.
At once, a series of clear flute sounds filled the air.
Lin Yi’s flute skills were mesmerizing. Even among disciples in the Qi Cultivation Stage, he was considered a top-tier talent, and the flute he played was a Spiritual Artifact.
Of course, such Spiritual Artifacts were not rare within the Huaxia Dragon Group, but those capable of using them were few and far between!
This flute was something Lin Yi had seen in ancient texts, crafted by an age-old grandmaster, capable of summoning an ancient Divine Beast.
Lin Yi had acquired this ancient Divine Beast from a historical site.
Lin Yi did not know the name of this ancient Divine Beast, as it had never appeared on the lands of Huaxia Country from its birth to maturity, only existing as an old and mysterious legend.
However, Lin Yi learned from ancient texts that this ancient Divine Beast possessed a power capable of contending against those in the Mahayana Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 762 - 762 782 Extremely Terrifying Magical Treasure
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 762: Chapter 782 Extremely Terrifying Magical Treasure Chapter 762: Chapter 782 Extremely Terrifying Magical Treasure Of course, only against ordinary Mahayana Realm powerhouses.
Even so, it was a very terrifying Magical Treasure for Lin Yi, and it was also one that could summon Divine Beasts from ancient times at will.
Lin Yi thought that once he had enough strength, he must find this ancient Divine Beast and see if he could tame it, then gift it to the Azure Dragon!
“Roar!”
A deafening roar pierced the skies, causing Lin Yi’s head to throb with pain.
“This sound, why does it seem like the roar of an ancient behemoth?” Lin Yi covered his ears, marveling in his heart.
Lin Yi had just been wondering where he had heard this sound before when suddenly, he remembered the records he had seen in ancient texts, filling him with immense surprise and joy.
“Could this be the legendary ancient Divine Beast, the Gluttonous Beast!?”
Lin Yi’s eyes bulged, his heart trembling violently with excitement, unable to contain himself.
The Gluttonous Beast was a legendary Divine Beast!
Ancient Divine Beasts possessed the Might to swallow heavens and devour earth, their strength was deemed invincible, capable of sweeping away experts of the same level with ease!
It was said that ancient Divine Beasts had a unique ability, which was to devour anything, including the Primordial Spirit!
Rumors had it that a single droplet of saliva from an ancient Divine Beast could destroy heavens and obliterate earth, a single mountain range could be destroyed in an instant, and the corrosive saliva exhaled from one nostril of an ancient Divine Beast could instantly level a city to the ground.
Ancient texts recorded that a single tongue of an ancient Divine Beast could easily tear apart a star!
This ability of the Gluttonous Beast was precisely the innate Divine Skill from the legends.
Lin Yi had not expected that he would be lucky enough to encounter an ancient Divine Beast!
“Hahaha, so this is the legendary ancient Divine Beast, my luck is really not bad, to be able to meet an ancient Divine Beast.” Lin Yi laughed heartily, extremely excited.
This trial was of great significance for Lin Yi and could even change his destiny.
If he could gain the recognition of the Gluttonous Beast, Lin Yi’s cultivation would undoubtedly become much easier and smoother in the future!
“Hmph, let’s see if you have the courage!”
One of the Dragon Clan members sneered, his figure leaping as he charged straight toward Lin Yi.
The Dragon Clan member was a burly man, standing two and a half meters tall, exuding a strong stench of blood that was nauseating.
This person had already broken through to the later stages of Foundation Establishment, and he was cultivating a Dragon Clan Technique, his strength was very formidable!
“Get out of my way!” Lin Yi shouted angrily, striking with his palm.
Although his cultivation was not as advanced as that of the Dragon Clan member, his physical strength had already surpassed that of first-rate cultivators. The power of this palm was many times stronger than that of an ordinary Early Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
“Boom!”
As the two clashed, Lin Yi was forced to retreat repeatedly, eventually falling to the ground.
“Pfft!”
Lin Yi spat out a mouthful of fresh blood.
“How powerful! This ancient Divine Beast is really not to be underestimated!” Lin Yi was shocked in his heart, “As expected of the legendary ancient Divine Beast, it is indeed too powerful, this one punch sent me flying, its strength is a notch above mine!”
Lin Yi couldn’t help feeling bitter—if it weren’t for the Jade Flute left behind by the ancient Divine Beast, he would have been slapped to death by that Dragon Clan member already.
Lin Yi stood up, wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth.
Despite his severe injuries, he still supported himself and fixed his gaze firmly on the Dragon Clan member.
Seeing Lin Yi stagging towards him, the Dragon Clan member couldn’t help but sneer: “Is this the extent of your strength, daring to challenge our Dragon Clan! You’re simply courting death!”
“Hmph, the one who’s courting death is you!” Lin Yi said coldly, “You idiot, haven’t you heard the saying ‘there are heavens beyond the skies, and people beyond men’?”
“Haha, do you think I’m a fool, that whatever you say goes?”
“I can’t believe that a mere Qi Refinement Realm ant like you would dare to be so bold as to brawl with our Dragon Clan!”
This Dragon Group member’s face was full of mockery, as if he was ridiculing Lin Yi for being an idiot, not worth mentioning.
“Hmph, if you don’t believe it, then try it out!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, looking at him disdainfully before swinging his right hand, and instantly, a longsword appeared in his hand.
“This is… a Divine Weapon!”
All those Dragon Group members stared at the longsword with burning gazes.
“This is indeed an Immortal Artifact!”
Lin Yi raised the longsword, and a pale golden light twinkled within it, emitting a powerful sword presence that shocked the entire audience.
Holding the longsword, Lin Yi struck out with it, and the air shrieked sharply. A sword beam as fierce as a Golden Dragon slashed towards the Dragon Group member!
Seeing this, the Dragon Group member’s pupils shrank; he dared not be negligent and quickly urged his True Qi, striking out with a palm.
“Bang!”
“Crack!”
Their palms collided, exploding and releasing a muffled boom, as a vast wave of energy swept out, blowing everyone’s clothes to flap loudly.
“Pfft!”
The Dragon Group member was shot backward, spitting out a mouthful of fresh blood.
Yet Lin Yi remained unmoved, standing firmly in the same spot.
“Worthy of being the offspring of the ancient Divine Beast Taotie, indeed formidable, but you still cannot trouble me!” Lin Yi grinned and stepped forward, closing in on the Dragon Group member.
With that step, Lin Yi moved with incredible speed. In the blink of an eye, he had crossed the distance and appeared before the Dragon Group member.
“What!?” The Dragon Group member was startled; he couldn’t understand how this minor Qi Refinement Realm cultivator had crossed such a long distance to come right beside him.
“Die!”
Lin Yi’s eyes were icy as he thrust with his sword.
“Swoosh!”
The sword beam tore through the void, filled with endless chill, attacking the Dragon Group member ferociously.
“Aah!”
Upon seeing the approaching sword beam, the Dragon Group member’s face drastically changed. It was too late to dodge, so he could only resist desperately.
“Bang!”
The sword beam struck the Dragon Group member’s body, producing a crisp sound.
The Dragon Group member let out a miserable cry as Lin Yi’s sword strike caused him to bleed from all seven orifices, his bones shattered, and he was cleaved in two, meeting a violent death!
This scene caused the Dragon Group members present to feel a shiver in their hearts, and they involuntarily took a few steps back, afraid to get any closer to Lin Yi.
The cultivation of the Dragon Group member just slain had reached the later stages of Foundation Establishment, ranking him as a first-class expert among these members, yet he had no power to resist and was killed in one move under Lin Yi’s hand!
Lin Yi’s single-move kill of the Dragon Group member made the others back off, not daring to launch another rash attack, only watching helplessly as Lin Yi walked towards the ancient Divine Beast Taotie.
“Don’t come any closer!”
“What are you trying to do? Looking for death?”
“Get the hell away from me, or don’t blame me for not being polite!”
The Dragon Group members shouted angrily, blocking Lin Yi’s path.
But Lin Yi turned a deaf ear and kept walking straight forward.
“Hmph! Since you don’t want to drink a toast, then don’t blame us for being unfeeling when forcing you to drink a penalty!”
“Kill!”
Seeing Lin Yi’s stubbornness, the Dragon Group member became infuriated, his legs slightly bent, he pushed off the ground, fueling his soles with a surge of True Qi and leapt violently towards Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 763 - 763 783 No Way to Resist
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 763: Chapter 783: No Way to Resist Chapter 763: Chapter 783: No Way to Resist “Boom!”
“Crack!”
The attack of the Dragon Group member was extremely swift, and Lin Yi had no way to defend himself, forced to choose evasion instead.
“Whoosh!”
“Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!”
The Dragon Group member’s body continuously darted about, flickering in front of Lin Yi like a ghost, both hands striking ferociously and relentlessly, bombarding Lin Yi’s body without respite.
Lin Yi’s body was constantly sent flying, and each time he landed, a spray of blood would burst forth.
Although Lin Yi was at the Ninth Level Peak of the Body Refinement Phase, he was vastly outmatched by the Dragon Group member and couldn’t withstand the attacks.
“Pfft!”
Another punch came, and Lin Yi was sent flying dozens of feet away, blood spilling from the corner of his mouth, severely injured.
“Hmph! This is the fate of overestimating oneself, like a mantis trying to stop a chariot!”
The Dragon Group member sneered, while speaking, he charged towards Lin Yi, intent on killing him on the spot.
But Lin Yi was not the least bit afraid; instead, he laughed coldly.
“Is that so? You think too little of me,” Lin Yi snorted coldly, his longsword gently waving in his hand, a sharp aura spreading out, causing the space around to tremble slightly.
The Dragon Group member was intimidated by Lin Yi’s aura, a hint of wariness rising in his heart, but still he said in a cold voice, “Childish parlor tricks!”
The Dragon Group member snorted coldly, ignoring Lin Yi, and continued to pounce towards him.
“Since that’s the case, let me show you my true power!”
A strong fighting spirit emerged in Lin Yi’s eyes, his True Qi surged within him, and his body radiated a dazzling golden glow, like a brilliant sun, illuminating the entire forest.
The Dragon Group member saw the change in Lin Yi and his face turned pale, his eyes bulging in round shock.
“What!? You’ve actually broken through to the Eighth Layer Realm of the Qi Refinement Realm!?”
The Dragon Group member exclaimed in shock.
The Eighth Layer of the Qi Refinement Realm!
What a terrifying realm that was!
The Dragon Group member was considered a rare genius on Earth and even within the entire Earth’s cultivation world, but only a rare genius indeed, nowhere near the realm of breaking through the Qi Refinement Phase.
“Incredible!”
“How could you have broken through to this level, who on earth are you?” the Dragon Group member said in awe.
“You don’t need to know who I am, all you need to know is that now, your end has come!”
Lin Yi’s expression was cold and indifferent, as was his tone, but his aura grew even more chilling.
“You impudent brat!”
“Today, you will die!”
The Dragon Group member roared in anger, his figure flashed, appearing before Lin Yi in an instant, his wrist flipping, unsheathing a long knife that was pitch-black and emanated a chilly sensation, as if it came from Jiuyou Hell, causing one’s heart to palpitate.
The long knife in his hand seemed alive, as if it possessed life, emitting a chilling coldness that trembled hearts.
Lin Yi’s expression remained unchanged as his body suddenly flashed like a bolt of golden lightning, disappearing from the spot in an instant, appearing behind the Dragon Group member the next moment, his longsword thrusting violently towards the back of the opponent’s head, its speed reaching the extreme.
“Clang!”
However, just when the longsword was about to pierce the Dragon Group member’s head, it was parried by another longsword.
A crisp clanging sound rang out, followed by the longsword being deflected off course, stabbing into the ground.
This sword was none other than Lin Yi’s Flying Sword.
“You think just because you’ve broken through to the Eighth Layer of the Qi Refinement Realm that you are invincible?” the Dragon Group member said with a cold laugh, “Let me tell you, you are still no match for me!”
“Hmph! Let me witness the gap between the Eighth Layer and the Ninth Level of the Qi Refinement Realm!” Lin Yi coldly shouted as the True Qi inside his body wildly circulated, causing his body to shoot up by three feet.
Countless golden Runes surfaced around his body, swimming like tadpoles around him, making him resemble a War God possessed, with his entire body radiating a brilliant golden radiance.
“Roar!”
Lin Yi let out a roar towards the sky, just like a Golden Armored War Divine descending upon the world, gripping the Flying Sword tightly with both hands and attacking that Dragon Group member once again.
The Dragon Group member’s expression slightly darkened as he swung his longsword, deflecting Lin Yi’s longsword.
“Bang!”
The next moment, Lin Yi’s palm struck the chest of the Dragon Group member, the fierce wind whirling around him causing his robes to flap loudly.
The Dragon Group member let out a stifled grunt, his mouth agape as he spat out a mouthful of fresh blood.
His face suddenly became extremely awkward, turning ashen, and looking rather ugly.
Lin Yi kicked that Dragon Group member in the belly, sending him flying several meters, collapsing two huge rocks and creating a deep pit, burying the Dragon Group member within.
Watching the Dragon Group member being knocked down by Lin Yi, the rest of the Dragon Group members revealed shocked expressions.
“What’s going on? Why has Lin Yi become so powerful? He clearly had just broken through, how could he possess such formidable strength?”
“Could he have taken an Elixir? But that kind of elixir isn’t readily available! Where on earth did this kid get it from?”
“Damn it, we’ve been tricked!”
Those Dragon Group members cursed angrily, each of them seething with rage.
“Lin Yi! How dare you ambush me! You deserve a thousand deaths! I will not let you off!” That Dragon Group member screamed furiously, crawling out from the rubble, his eyes bloodshot, wishing he could tear Lin Yi into pieces.
“I didn’t ambushed you, you’re just stupid!” Lin Yi casually responded.
“Damn, then I’ll disembowel you!” That Dragon Group member roared again, his longsword once again slashing towards Lin Yi.
“Hum!”
Lin Yi grasped his sword, his figure flashing to the side of the Dragon Group member, the longsword cutting through the air and leaving behind a long trail.
“Ah!”
The Dragon Group member screamed in pain as his right shoulder was sliced by the longsword, losing a piece of flesh, and the agonizing pain made his blood splatter, staining his clothes red.
He clutched his injured arm, glaring at Lin Yi with an unwilling look.
“Who is this Lin Yi? His strength seems to have improved a lot!”
“That move just now was very sharp, I sensed a dangerous aura!”
“Which sect does this Lin Yi belong to, why have we never seen him before?”
“This guy’s strength is so strong, we’re no match for him, let’s run away quickly!”
Seeing this, the group of Dragon Group members changed their expressions and fled for their lives.
“Think you can run away?”
Lin Yi sneered, his wrist flipping over, the longsword slicing through the air as he once again stabbed towards a Dragon Group member, moving as fast as a gust of wind.
The Dragon Group member dodged, but just as his body left the ground, he was slammed back to it with a brutal force.
“Spurt!”
The Dragon Group member spat out fresh blood, crashing to the ground in a deplorable manner, his eyes filled with resentment and anger, gritting his teeth, he said to Lin Yi, “Kid, I’ll kill you for sure!”
“Then give it a try!”
Lin Yi sneered coldly, scornfully glancing at him before once again executing his swordsmanship, slashing towards another Dragon Group member.
“Ah!”
That Dragon Group member screamed, having been pierced through by Lin Yi’s sword and nailed to a large tree.
The member’s face turned deathly pale, with blood continuously flowing from his body, his breath rapidly weakening, and finally, he exploded with a loud bang, turning into a pool of minced flesh.

chapters.title: Chapter 764 - 764 784 Tingling Scalp
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 764: Chapter 784 Tingling Scalp Chapter 764: Chapter 784 Tingling Scalp Watching the death of that Dragon Group member, the people present all felt a tingling on their scalps and a chill throughout their bodies, their eyes filled with fear and awe as they looked at Lin Yi.
“I’m no match for him!”
“I’m not his opponent!”
The group of Dragon Group members panicked, each turning to flee, fearful of being killed by Lin Yi if they were a step too slow.
“Trying to escape? Not so easy!” Lin Yi sneered, his longsword weaving through the air, its brilliance flashing. In the blink of an eye, another five or six Dragon Group members were slain, turning into a mist of blood.
One Dragon Group member, seeing his comrades annihilated, had his eyes nearly splitting with rage. He thrust his spear towards Lin Yi.
But Lin Yi moved, his longsword swinging with ease, effortlessly slicing through the spear and then with a few more strokes, cut down that Dragon Group member on the spot.
These Dragon Group members, although possessing powerful cultivation, were all at the Primary Level Qi Refinement Realm, while Lin Yi, albeit at the Later Stages of the Qi Refinement Realm, was undaunted, his sword dancing through his foes, slaying them all.
In just half the time it takes an incense stick to burn, all these Dragon Group members were killed by Lin Yi, with none spared.
“Brother Lin Yi, you’re so amazing!”
“Senior Lin Yi, you’re so cool!”
Ye Linlang, Yang Ying, and Liu Shihua, upon witnessing Lin Yi’s swordsmanship, killing the Dragon Group members, all started to cheer.
Lin Yi wore a faint smile on his face, looking at the corpses, he shook his head and said, “You guys go back and rest first! Leave the rest to me!”
“Alright! Then we’ll go back to cultivate!”
Ye Linlang, Yang Ying, Liu Shihua, and the others nodded and quickly retreated.
All those Dragon Group members were at the Primary Level Qi Refinement Realm, and Lin Yi alone was more than enough to handle them; they had nothing to worry about.
Lin Yi looked at the devastated street and corpses with a slight frown, a strong murderous intent rising in his heart.
These Dragon Group members were the elite of the unit. Once caught, they would be executed without a doubt, and the failure of their mission would certainly attract the attention of the National Security Bureau, which would be troublesome for him. Therefore, no matter what, he had to eliminate this group.
“It seems I need to find a secluded place to dispose of these bodies,” Lin Yi muttered to himself, then lifted his gaze to survey the area.
This place was already a desolate wilderness, and furthermore, a sparsely populated valley, totally unsuitable for dealing with the Dragon Group members’ bodies.
An idea suddenly flashed through Lin Yi’s mind—to hide the bodies in a cave.
As long as he entered the cave, Lin Yi could conceal them, ensuring no one would discover them.
With this thought, a trace of excitement crossed Lin Yi’s eyes.
Now that he had a solution, Lin Yi wouldn’t waste time. He immediately started moving, dragging the bodies of the Dragon Group members into the cave one by one, keeping them there, letting them stay in the cave while he took care of the matter, to later search for them.
After dealing with the Dragon Group members, Lin Yi prepared to leave. But just as he turned, he suddenly heard a commotion from afar.
“Stop your assault immediately, everyone there! Otherwise, don’t blame me for being rude!”
“I am a Huaxia police officer. If you continue to attack, I will call the police!”
“…”
Following the noise, Lin Yi saw that seven or eight police cars had appeared in the distance, and from those cars, twelve uniformed police officers disembarked. The officer leading them was holding a megaphone, loudly commanding the crowd of Dragon Group members.
The attire of these police officers was very uniform, each sleeve adorned with a gold star, the emblem of the special division of the National Security Bureau.
“These police officers have been sent by the National Security Bureau!”
Seeing those police, Lin Yi’s brow furrowed slightly. What brought them here all of a sudden?
“Could these police be dispatched by the Dragon Group?”
Lin Yi speculated in his heart, then turned to look at the Dragon Group members.
“Hmph, you bastards! Stop right now! Otherwise, don’t blame us for getting rough with you!”
“You people really have some nerve, daring to kill on the National Security Bureau’s turf!”
“This is a private matter for the Dragon Group, none of your business! If you know what’s good for you, get lost, or don’t blame us for being impolite!”
The Dragon Group members looked at the police with grim faces and snorted coldly.
“Dragon Group’s private matter?” The leading police officer sneered, “All of you from the Dragon Group are getting beaten to the ground, yet you still claim to be members? You’re just a disgrace, surrender now!”
“You!”
After hearing the squad leader’s words, one Dragon Group member’s face turned beet red, his eyes blazing with flames.
But none of them rushed forward; instead, they retreated dozens of meters.
“We’re pulling out!”
The rest of the dozens of Dragon Group members turned around and quickly left.
After those dozens of Dragon Group members left, their comrades’ corpses were quickly picked up by a swarm of people.
“It seems these members of the Dragon Group have indeed done quite a few bad things in this area!”
“I wonder what bad things they did this time to be hunted down to the point where even the laws of this country can’t protect them, utterly heartless!”
“Such people, if left alive, will become a scourge sooner or later!”
Lin Yi watched the backs of the Dragon Group members as they left and sighed softly.
Their actions this time had completely enraged Lin Yi.
Lin Yi was no fool; he knew he had many enemies within the Dragon Group, but very few were as utterly heartless as these members.
And this time, the actions of the Dragon Group members had clearly touched Lin Yi’s reverse scale.
“Lin Yi, what should we do with those corpses? Should we put them in the cave?”
Liu Shihua and others came from a distance, approached Lin Yi, and asked.
Liu Shihua and the others had been running all the way, also gasping for breath, their faces slightly flushed, and exceedingly attractive at the moment.
“Just put them in the cave, no need to worry,” Lin Yi said, waving his hand nonchalantly in response.
Relieved by Lin Yi’s answer, Liu Shihua and the others dispersed, continuing to scavenge the bodies of the Dragon Group members.
“Not bad, worthy of being my students, really impressive!”
Lin Yi admired Liu Shihua and the others with appreciation, then turned and walked to a tree, grabbed the trunk, and with a forceful twist, broke the whole tree in half; the broken branches fell to the ground.
Lin Yi threw these branches into the cave, and then returned to the apartment, back home.
Upon arriving home, Lin Yi glanced at his watch and found it was already midnight. He washed up and then lay in bed to sleep.
Lin Yi closed his eyes, silently recited an incantation, and stimulated his True Yuan to circulate his cultivation technique. The True Yuan inside his body surged wildly.
As Lin Yi’s True Yuan circulated, his internal injuries began to heal rapidly, and his shattered bones were quickly regenerating.
Lin Yi was shocked; he hadn’t expected his recovery from such severe injuries to be so fast, almost unbelievable!
At this moment, Lin Yi also felt a massive stream of True Yuan operating within him. He knew this was because the True Yuan within him had been fully restored, now absorbing the vast True Qi from the outside world to replenish the True Yuan he had lost during cultivation!
This was the form of True Qi!

chapters.title: Chapter 765 - 765 785 True Qi Nourishes the Meridians
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 765: Chapter 785 True Qi Nourishes the Meridians Chapter 765: Chapter 785 True Qi Nourishes the Meridians True Qi circulated within his Dantian, a vast stream of True Essence Power surged incessantly from within his body, sweeping through him like a tide.
His physique was rapidly improving, his skin became smooth and delicate, and the pores on his skin seemed to have become more sensitive!
This feeling was very comfortable, and Lin Yi enjoyed it very much.
The True Qi surged into Lin Yi’s body, continually nourishing the meridians within him.
Under the aid of the True Qi, Lin Yi’s physical body began to strengthen, his physique kept improving, his body’s defense became even more solid, and his build grew much larger than before.
All this was because Lin Yi had absorbed the Spirit Stones from the outside world, which caused his physique to grow increasingly stronger.
“I truly didn’t expect that this training session would bring such great gains, a significant improvement in my physique!”
As Lin Yi sensed the changes within his body, he couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise.
The True Essence flowed into Lin Yi’s body, continuously helping him to temper his physique, making the rate of enhancement much faster than before, and Lin Yi also felt that his True Essence Power was becoming more vigorous and condensed.
“The True Essence Power inside my body is more than three times stronger than before!” Lin Yi felt the change in his True Essence and couldn’t help feeling secretly delighted.
“The gains this time are truly enormous!”
“However, the biggest gain isn’t this!”
“The real gain this time is the body of the Dragon Group member!”
Lin Yi suddenly realized that his gains this time were not just these.
With a thought from Lin Yi, a black shadow emerged out of thin air, hovering in mid-air.
This was a giant python!
“A Dragon Soul?!”
Lin Yi cried out in surprise, he had not expected his gains this time to include a Dragon Soul.
In Lin Yi’s mind, the dire state of the Dragon Group members before their deaths emerged; their eyes were wide open, as if they had experienced tremendous fear before dying, their faces filled with horror, mouths wide open, as though they had many words left unsaid.
“Dragon Soul?”
“How did the Dragon Group members provoke another member?”
“Exactly how did these Dragon Group members die?”
Seeing the Dragon Soul, Lin Yi couldn’t help but ask.
“Master, we have been followed,” said the Dragon Soul faintly. Although it only had a head, it could still understand some of Lin Yi’s expressions and gazes.
“Followed? What do you mean?”
“We have been targeted, and a group of Dragon Group members have also been killed. Those people were all turned into a mist of blood by a single strike,” the Dragon Soul said slowly.
“These guys are so audacious, they actually dared to make a move on Dragon Group members!”
“Dragon Soul, who are those people? What background do they have? Why would they attack you, the members of the Dragon Group?”
“The members of the Dragon Group are the strongest combat force and the most mysterious combat unit; they have significant fame internationally.”
“Their combat power is exceptionally strong; once they engage in battle, they are bound to stir up a bloodbath. But how were they wiped out this time?”
“Dragon Soul, tell me in detail, what exactly happened this time?”
As Lin Yi listened to the Dragon Soul’s account, his doubts deepened, and he couldn’t help but ask.
“Master, this time it was a special forces unit sent by the Huaxia military,”
“The soldiers in those units are the elite of the elite. They have a kind of weapon that can increase a master’s strength by about ten times in a short period,” the Dragon Soul reported.
“And their strength has reached the Ninth Rank of the Innate Realm, even the Peak of Great Perfection, and once they fully unleash their power, their strength is comparable to a Qi Transformation Peak expert!”
“Their target this time is our Huaxia, aiming to annihilate us all!”
“This special division is called the Blood Demon Sect! Within the Blood Demon Sect, everyone is a demon who has successfully cultivated demonic techniques. These techniques are extremely malevolent, designed to devour the blood and souls of living people, absorbing the demonic nature within their flesh to greatly increase their cultivation, proving exceedingly sinister.”
“It is rumored that this time the grand commander of the Demon Clan within the Blood Demon Sect is an innate eighth rank powerhouse whose strength is unfathomably deep and extremely difficult to deal with.”
“Our Dragons group has clashed with him several times, facing constant life-threatening situations, and in the end, we could only escape after being defeated.”
“In this mission, they plan to use the opportunity to wipe out the Dragons group in one fell swoop, leaving none behind!”
Lin Yi gasped in shock upon hearing Longhun’s explanation, his heart filled with terror.
The Blood Demon Sect!
That was the most terrifying power in Huaxia!
In all of Huaxia, they possessed absolute formidable strength, and the Demonic Techniques they held were extremely evil. The demons they cultivated were even more powerful than ordinary Demon Beasts, which could hardly withstand their attacks.
“This operation seems to be fraught with unparalleled danger!”
Lin Yi’s heart was filled with trepidation, his brow furrowed, his mood heavy.
“Master, the people from the Blood Demon Sect are likely targeting us; otherwise, they wouldn’t have come after us.”
“Should we strike against the Blood Demon Sect first?”
“No need, for now, let’s not bother with them. Once I’ve raised my True Yuan to the Houtian seventh layer realm, I will leave the capital.”
Lin Yi shook his head and said.
“Master, are you planning to go to the capital to look for traces of the Immortal Cultivators?”
Longhun asked.
“Yes!”
Lin Yi nodded and said, “I’m going to look for some Immortal Cultivators.”
“Master, I advise you not to trouble those Immortal Cultivators. Their strength is extremely formidable, and they all possess combat power no less than that of an innate ninth rank!”
“They are all Immortal Cultivators from Huaxia. Once you provoke them, you will face their retaliation, and it will be very dangerous for you.”
“But I know, Master, that you definitely have a way to handle these matters.”
Longhun said, his tone very affirmative, showing a trust in Lin Yi.
“What can I do?”
Lin Yi said with a wry smile.
Indeed, Lin Yi had no solution at the moment. Although he possessed the cultivation of the innate sixth layer realm, he still had no chance against an eighth rank powerhouse.
Moreover, his strength had not yet completely stabilized.
Therefore, it was practically impossible for Lin Yi to snatch treasures from the hands of Immortal Cultivators.
“Master, you only need to plant my essence blood in your body, and I can provide you with pure True Qi, which will allow you to raise your cultivation in the shortest time.”
“At that point, you can easily defeat those innate eighth rank powerhouses and then snatch the treasures from them.”
“Later, we can join forces with other members of the Dragons group to confront the Blood Demon Sect together.”
Longhun spoke, his eyes glittering with a light, clearly having thought of a strategy.
Longhun, indeed deserving of his reputation as the King of War for Huaxia Country, was incredibly wise.
After hearing this, Lin Yi nodded slightly, holding much appreciation in his heart.
Subsequently, Lin Yi stored Longhun into the Storage Ring and left the cave.
He had already stayed in the cave for two days; he must make the most of his time to recover and cultivate, striving to improve his strength as soon as possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 766 - 766 786 Sitting in Silence for Two Days
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 766: Chapter 786 Sitting in Silence for Two Days Chapter 766: Chapter 786 Sitting in Silence for Two Days Lin Yi sat quietly in the mountain cave for two days and began to cultivate the “Tai Yin True Scripture.”
The cultivation technique of the “Tai Yin True Scripture” was formed by the essence of the Tai Yin energy.
As the Yin Yang Dual Qi in this space was exceptionally rich, it perfectly suited the cultivation of the “Tai Yin True Scripture.” Thus, Lin Yi sat in meditation within the cave to cultivate it.
The cultivation of the “Tai Yin True Scripture” went very smoothly.
Lin Yi sat cross-legged in the cave, circulating the Tai Yin energy as his body’s “Yin Yang Technique” began to revolve slowly.
Here, the “Yin Yang Technique” could be cultivated much faster than in the outside world.
Although Lin Yi’s cultivation time was extensive, only three hours had passed outside.
While cultivating, Lin Yi did not forget about refining elixirs.
In the cave, Lin Yi refined a total of one hundred elixirs, all designed to replenish the consumption of True Qi, costing him five Supreme Grade Blood Coagulation Pills!
After consuming the five Supreme Grade Blood Coagulation Pills, Lin Yi’s strength had greatly increased, reaching the Seventh Layer of the Houtian realm; breaking through to the Seventh Layer of the Xiantian realm was now only a step away.
“Now, my strength should be sufficient to confront the Blood Demon Sect,”
“However, I have not yet reached the Ninth Level of the Houtian, insufficient to slay a member of the Demon Clan at the Eighth Rank of the Xiantian,”
Lin Yi thought to himself, then prepared to leave.
No sooner had he stepped out of the cave than two disciples of the Blood Demon Sect approached him. Both were exceptionally burly, their bodies emanating an overwhelming murderous aura.
Both were at the Early Stage of the Houtian realm.
“Are you Lin Yi, the one who defeated the brothers of the Li Family? The Young Sect Master of our Blood Demon Sect has been waiting for a long time. Please, come with us to our Blood Demon Sect. Our sect leader wishes to see you,” they said bluntly as they approached.
The moment their words fell, the two Blood Demon Sect disciples took out a jade token carved with the four blood-red characters of the Blood Demon Sect.
“The Blood Demon Sect?”
Upon seeing the jade token, a trace of surprise flickered in Lin Yi’s eyes.
This was his first time hearing about the Blood Demon Sect.
“The Blood Demon Sect is an ancient sect in the capital, known to cultivate a Demonic Technique that can absorb the blood of the world and Refinement it into their strength. Hence, they are extremely formidable,”
“However, it is said that their strength has not yet reached the Eighth Rank of the Houtian,” Dragon Soul explained to Lin Yi.
“I see, no wonder they dare to be so arrogant,”
Lin Yi nodded his head, understanding the Blood Demon Sect without surprise.
He had not expected the Blood Demon Sect to be so brazen.
In the capital, there aren’t many masters, and for the Blood Demon Sect to be one of the four super Sects of the capital, their strength must not be underestimated.
“Since they wish to see me, then I must go,”
Lin Yi sighed inwardly.
He wished to raise his strength as soon as possible, eager for a decisive battle with the masters of the Blood Demon Sect!
Now, he could not contend with beings at the Eighth Rank of the Xiantian, so he had to be patient.
But, should he encounter beings at the Eighth Rank of the Xiantian, he would not mind battling with them, after all, the strength of the Blood Demon Sect was only around the peak of the Xiantian Eighth Rank, far inferior to Lin Yi.
With a thought, Lin Yi’s feet tread on clouds, and he shot off into the distance, his speed astonishingly fast, like a ghostly apparition.
Lin Yi quickly traversed a distance of several kilometers, arriving at the outskirts of the capital, into a manor.
Within the manor, there was a villa where many high-ranking masters were cultivating.
These people were all experts from the Blood Demon Sect, with cultivation at the peak of innate Seventh Rank and only half a step away from breaking through to the Ninth Rank of Houtian. Their strength was incredibly formidable!
All of them were sitting cross-legged on the ground, cultivating.
Their faces were somewhat pale, obviously due to their cultivation practices. They still had injuries that had not healed, so they couldn’t cultivate normally and had to cultivate on the ground instead.
Moreover, they were also worried about the outside, concerned that members of the Demon Clan might suddenly attack.
“Haha, Junior Brother Lin, have you finally decided to come out?”
Just as Lin Yi arrived at the place and before he could enter the manor, he was stopped by an elder.
“A senior from the Blood Demon Sect.”
Seeing the elder, Lin Yi knew he was a senior from the Blood Demon Sect.
The elder before him was the Young Sect Master of the Blood Demon Sect, Li Hong.
“Haha, Junior Brother Lin, the Young Sect Master of our Blood Demon Sect, Li Hong, has come in person to invite you. I hope you won’t refuse,” the elder said with a smile, looking at Lin Yi.
“I have already agreed to the invitation of the Young Sect Master of the Blood Demon Sect.”
Lin Yi stated indifferently, and then he walked towards the villa.
This manor belonged to the Blood Demon Sect, but he was not afraid.
His target was the Blood Pool of the Blood Demon Sect.
The Young Sect Master of the Blood Demon Sect was around forty years old, handsome and elegant, but there was a trace of wickedness between his brows.
“Junior Brother Lin, let’s go. This is our Blood Demon Sect’s Young Sect Master. Once you meet him, everything will become clear,” the elder explained to Lin Yi.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi nodded and followed the elder into the villa.
The decorations inside the villa were incredibly lavish and splendid, with priceless items displayed. However, Lin Yi didn’t even glance at them. His gaze fell upon a huge vat which contained a massive snake.
The giant snake was entirely red, as if forged from fresh blood, and it emitted a foul stench.
The python was massive, at least ten feet in size. It hissed with a scarlet tongue and its eyes, filled with a thirst for blood, stared intently at Lin Yi.
And beside this giant python, there were a number of human corpses, all of which had their flesh devoured!
Upon seeing the bodies of those devoured people, Lin Yi’s expression turned ugly.
He had not expected that within this manor, such a cruel scene would be hidden!
“Junior Brother Lin, this is our Blood Demon Sect’s Blood Pool. This is a Millennium Blood Jiao, the Sect-protecting Holy Beast of our Blood Demon Sect. It is usually kept locked underground. This time, our Young Sect Master has come to visit Junior Brother Lin and especially brought the Blood Jiao with him in hopes that Junior Brother Lin can help revive the Blood Jiao. Don’t worry, as long as you are willing to save the Blood Jiao, I guarantee that our Blood Demon Sect will certainly not treat you unfairly!” the elder quickly said to Lin Yi, noticing the displeasure on his face, and his own expression was eager to please.
Lin Yi shook his head and said, “The Blood Jiao is an innately different species; I simply cannot heal it.”
Lin Yi had seen the fierce nature of the Blood Jiao before, and although he possessed Divine Fire, he still could not heal the Blood Jiao, nor could he revive it. Thus, the Blood Jiao was useless to him, and trying to save it would be merely a waste of energy.
When the elder heard Lin Yi’s words, he was stunned for a moment, and then disappointment spread across his face.
The Blood Jiao was the guardian beast of the Blood Demon Sect, extremely important to them and a significant source of strength. He had originally planned to request Lin Yi’s help in healing the Blood Jiao, but now it seemed that he had to give up on this hope.
He sighed and said, “Junior Brother Lin, our Young Sect Master indeed values you highly. He even said that if you could heal the Blood Jiao, he would give you a treasure that would greatly increase the speed of your cultivation!”
“Oh?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was quite moved.

chapters.title: Chapter 767 - 767 787 Lavish Spending
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 767: Chapter 787 Lavish Spending Chapter 767: Chapter 787 Lavish Spending This Young Sect Master is truly generous!
For ordinary people, such a treasure is priceless.
However, he was well aware that these things were useless to him.
His strength allowed him to reach the Ninth Rank of Houtian in a short amount of time, and he had some mysterious secret techniques that could make him even more powerful. He didn’t need to rely on external objects!
Still, he asked, “What kind of mysterious item is the Young Sect Master talking about?”
The elder looked into Lin Yi’s eyes and said, “The Young Sect Master mentioned it is a ‘Yuan Yin fruit’!”
Yuan Yin fruit?
Lin Yi showed a trace of confusion on his face upon hearing this name.
He had never heard this name before; was it a treasure from some sect?
Just as Lin Yi was about to ask further, he suddenly felt a terrifying pressure rushing towards his mind!
That pressure was so formidable that Lin Yi’s heart shuddered, and he hurriedly activated the “Immeasurable True Qi Technique”!
It was only then that Lin Yi truly felt the terror of this pressure.
“Boom!”
Feeling this pressure, a layer of True Qi shield surged around him immediately.
This shield, formed by countless strands of True Qi, enveloped his entire body, protecting him from any dangerous attacks!
“Hmm?”
When the elder saw that Lin Yi had managed to withstand his attack, his face changed slightly and said, “I didn’t expect, Brother Lin, that you could withstand my move.”
Surprise colored the elder’s face.
To know, just a moment ago he had used all his strength, but he still hadn’t managed to harm Lin Yi at all!
Moreover, the True Qi shield emanating from Lin Yi’s body was intangible and insubstantial. His True Qi attack was all absorbed into Lin Yi’s body!
“What’s going on?”
Lin Yi was full of doubts.
Just now, he only felt a blur before his eyes, and the elder had rushed over and launched an attack. The speed was too fast for him to react.
And yet, he hadn’t seemed to feel that pressure, but it truly existed and threatened him.
“In this situation, it’s better to back off first. After all, this is the territory of the Blood Demon Sect.”
Lin Yi thought to himself. He didn’t have the courage to confront the Blood Demon Sect.
The Blood Demon Sect had two powerful elders at the peak of the Ninth Rank of Houtian. If it really came down to a life-or-death fight, he feared he would have nowhere to be buried!
“Brother Lin, wait a moment,” the elder called out to him.
“What’s wrong? Could it be that there’s really a treasure inside?”
Upon hearing the elder’s words, anticipation rose in Lin Yi’s heart as he also looked forward to the possibility of a treasure inside.
“Heh, Brother Lin, I won’t hide it from you, there indeed is a treasure inside. However, this treasure is too precious for our Blood Demon Sect, so we dare not use it lightly. That’s why we invited you over to take a look first.”
“But rest assured, I absolutely won’t let Brother Lin make this trip in vain,” said the elder as he took out a storage ring from his chest and handed it to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi saw the storage ring in the elder’s hand and a flicker of surprise passed through his eyes.
“This storage ring contains a spatial Jade Slip, within which are the Cultivation Techniques left by the ancestors of our Blood Demon Sect, along with many treasures,” explained the elder, handing the storage ring over to Lin Yi.
“Hmm, I understand. I will leave as soon as I’m done looking,” Lin Yi replied.
Lin Yi nodded and took the storage ring.
After receiving the storage ring, Lin Yi immediately closed his eyes and began to investigate the contents of the ring.
