Inside the storage ring was a jade slip, which contained the martial arts passed down by the ancestors of the Blood Demon Sect, as well as a variety of precious elixirs and cultivation techniques.
When Lin Yi saw these items, his eyes lit up.
Although Lin Yi’s resources for immortal cultivation were already quite rich, they were still just a drop in the bucket for his practice.
And now, Lin Yi finally saw a shortcut for his cultivation!
The stronger his strength became, the more treasures he could obtain, and he could also gain many benefits from the Blood Demon Sect!
“Hahaha, what great items!”
Lin Yi was extremely excited.
This storage ring was his second gift.
The treasures he had obtained in the Ancient Tomb were all from this ring, and this time, what he received would certainly be even more precious than those treasures!
“These items are the legacies of our Blood Demon Sect ancestors, and I think, Junior Brother Lin will definitely like them!” The elder saw Lin Yi’s expression and chuckled inwardly.
He had anticipated that this young man would be tempted by these treasures.
“Junior Brother Lin, these treasures are extremely precious to our Blood Demon Sect, and if the other members of our sect knew about them, I’m afraid it would bring about fatal disasters. So, I’d like to ask Junior Brother Lin to keep these items safe and not to disclose them.”
The elder looked at Lin Yi and spoke these words with great sincerity.
Lin Yi was slightly taken aback upon hearing this, his eyes filled with doubt as he looked at the elder.
Was what the elder saying true?
Were these treasures so precious to the Blood Demon Sect that they would kill for them?
Lin Yi didn’t believe it, but the elder seemed to not be lying, and his expression didn’t appear to be feigned.
“If that’s the case, then these treasures should all belong to your Blood Demon Sect.”
Lin Yi thought for a moment and then spoke.
“Junior Brother Lin, thank you for your understanding. You can rest assured that as long as you hand these treasures over to us, we will definitely take good care of them.”
Seeing this, the elder quickly expressed his gratitude.
“No need to thank me; I trust you!”
Lin Yi waved his hand and then put the storage ring into his own Storage Ring and immediately turned around to leave the place.
Lin Yi left the place.
After Lin Yi had left, the Young Sect Master watched Lin Yi’s retreating figure and revealed a cold smile, saying, “Hmph, a mere Qi Cultivation Realm Sevenfold ant daring to covet these treasures? He’s utterly ignorant of his own limitations!”
His eyes were filled with disdain.
In his heart, he thought, “Lin Yi, you’d better never appear in the Blood Demon Sect’s sight again!”
After leaving the place, Lin Yi headed straight for the Blood Demon Sect.
Lin Yi knew that the Blood Demon Sect had vast influence, and moreover, the cultivators of the Blood Demon Sect wouldn’t easily trust other cultivators, so to find an opportunity to obtain the treasures, he would first have to infiltrate the Blood Demon Sect.
Lin Yi’s figure traced an arc in mid-air, vanishing in an instant before the mountain gate.
…
Lin Yi left the mountain and headed towards the Blood Demon Sect.
The Blood Demon Sect was three to four million kilometers away from the mountain range Lin Yi was at, but for Lin Yi, that distance could be crossed in an instant; a few breaths were all he needed to arrive.
Moreover, this distance of three to four million kilometers had no impact on Lin Yi’s speed; after all, his speed was much faster compared to an ordinary cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Realm.
He sped along rapidly and soon entered the domain of the Blood Demon Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 768 - 768 788 The Mountain Peak was Shattered
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 768: Chapter 788 The Mountain Peak was Shattered Chapter 768: Chapter 788 The Mountain Peak was Shattered When Lin Yi had just arrived at the territory of the Blood Demon Sect, he abruptly stopped in his tracks, his eyes flashing with a cold light.
His hands formed seals, and a burst of golden light gathered between his palms, transforming into a massive golden sword that violently slashed down towards the front.
Boom!
As the golden sword cleaved down, the huge mountain was split apart, revealing a bottomless fissure.
A figure was shot out from the fissure, tumbling to the ground, and it was that severely injured elder!
The elder fell from the fissure, covered in blood, his complexion frighteningly pale.
Looking at Lin Yi, his face was full of shock as he gazed at Lin Yi, his eyes filled with horror!
Lin Yi’s sword strike was extremely powerful, actually forcibly ejecting him from the territory of the Blood Demon Sect!
“Damn it! Our Blood Demon Cave actually has a Formation guarding it, and my Spiritual Power has been sealed!”
The elder struggled to his feet, his eyes full of fear and resentment as he looked towards Lin Yi.
This youth was truly terrifying!
“Lin Junior Brother, just who are you? How did you manage to break into our Blood Demon Sect!”
“Hmph, who am I? I am an enemy of your sect!”
Lin Yi looked at the elder, his voice icy, his demeanor cold and ruthless as he spoke.
“What? You are an enemy of our sect? The Blood Demon Sect has never met you before; how could you possibly be our sect’s enemy?”
The elder’s eyes widened in disbelief upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, his face showing utter disbelief.
“Don’t forget, you previously said my flesh could be used to refine treasures. Your Blood Demon Sect wanted to utilize this as well to increase your strength, isn’t that right? That’s why you wanted to kill the disciples of the Blood Demon Sect!”
Lin Yi stared at the elder, his voice stern as he shouted.
The elder’s expression changed dramatically upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, his eyes brimming with fright.
He knew that everything Lin Yi said was true!
This youth was indeed as clever as the master of the Blood Demon Sect had said!
“Since you know about this matter, don’t blame me for being ruthless!”
The elder’s eyes narrowed slightly, and a rich, murderous aura suddenly erupted from him.
This aura seemed to freeze the entire void, turning it cold, the air filled with a bone-chilling coldness.
Lin Yi looked at the elder before him, without a trace of fear in his eyes, but rather a hint of mockery.
This elder of the Blood Demon Sect was only a ninth level peak existence in the Qi Cultivation Realm, not worthy of making Lin Yi afraid!
Seeing Lin Yi’s complete lack of fear, the elder’s rage grew even more intense.
This youth was unbearably arrogant!
“Lin Junior Brother, since you know these secrets, you should also be aware that you will definitely not escape the palm of my hand!”
The elder stared at Lin Yi, his voice low and full of killing intent!
His body slightly swayed, and a blood-red radiance surged from within him. He grew a pair of wings in an instant, and with a flap, he soared into the sky, flying thousands of feet away in a flash, heading straight for Lin Yi.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s eyes also slightly tightened, a serious look in his gaze.
The strength of this elder was much greater than that of the young man, clearly having cultivated some powerful Escape Technique!
Although Lin Yi had learned the Escape Technique, compared with the elder’s technique, it was still inferior, nowhere near comparable.
Lin Yi knew that he was no match for the elder, so he did not dare to delay, immediately urging his Primordial Spirit and summoning the Purple Flame Chariot!
Buzz!
The Purple Flame Chariot flew out, enveloping Lin Yi, who mounted the chariot and fled straight towards the outside of the Blood Demon Sect!
“Lin Junior Brother, do you think you can escape?”
The elder smirked with a mocking smile upon seeing Lin Yi’s action, and then with a wave of his wings, he instantaneously appeared next to Lin Yi, punching fiercely towards him.
“Boom!”
A flash of golden light directly breached the defenses of the Purple Flame Chariot, then swept towards the chariot’s compartment!
Lin Yi’s expression changed. He hadn’t expected the elder’s attack to be so powerful, nor had he anticipated his incredible speed; there was no way to dodge it.
Just then, Lin Yi suddenly took out an elixir and swallowed it.
This elixir, unmistakably a Vitality Replenishing Pill, replenished Lin Yi’s primordial energy, and at the same time, helped him recover from injuries swiftly.
The Vitality Replenishing Pill melted in his mouth as soon as he ingested it, quickly integrating into Lin Yi’s abdomen.
“Eh? This is actually a healing Vitality Replenishing Pill? Could it be… that you are a disciple of the Pill King Palace?”
Seeing Lin Yi take the elixir, the elder paused slightly, a trace of surprise in his eyes.
He hadn’t expected that Lin Yi would be a disciple of the Pill King Palace, and judging by Lin Yi’s manner, he must have refined a Vitality Replenishing Pill at least once!
“Hmph! Since you have discovered my identity, I can’t let you live. Your life ends here!” Lin Yi said, his voice icy cold.
The elder’s face darkened upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, his inner rage growing stronger as he snorted, “Hmph! You think you can stop me with this trash elixir? In your dreams!”
“If that’s the case, then just give it a try!”
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed, a cold smile hooking at the corner of his mouth.
He stretched out his hand and took out another talisman paper.
This piece of talisman paper contained the ancient spell “Destroy God,” an incredibly powerful force capable of easily eradicating a martial artist at the peak of the Ninth Level Qi Cultivation Realm!
Lin Yi threw the “Destroy God” talisman directly at the elder!
The elder felt the terrifying might of “Destroy God,” his expression turning serious as he flapped his wings, quickly dodging to the side.
Boom boom boom boom boom boom!
The “Destroy God” exploded incessantly in the void, its power immense, destroying thousands of trees in the surrounding area.
“Damn brat, I won’t spare you!” the elder roared with rage as “Destroy God” forced him into retreat.
“Old thing, today, I’ll send you to the afterlife!” Lin Yi sneered, throwing another talisman paper into the midst of “Destroy God.”
“Buzz buzz buzz buzz!”
As Lin Yi threw the two pieces of talisman paper, talisman symbols transformed into a mass of light fog, enveloping the elder, while “Destroy God” suddenly expanded to dozens of feet wide, emitting dazzling brilliance like a sun!
“What!”
“He has an even more powerful trump card!”
The elder was petrified with fear and hastily retreated.
But it was already too late!
“Destroy God” burst open, disintegrating into countless fragments that shot out in every direction, instantly covering tens of thousands of miles.
“Ahh ahh ahh!”
“Pffft!”
“Bang bang bang!”
“Bang bang bang bang bang!”
The fragments rained down like droplets, as pieces of flesh and blood burst apart.
Within a few hundred feet, chunks of bloody flesh flew chaotically under the rain of fragments, painting a gruesome scene.
“Ah!!” The elder screamed miserably as his body was torn into several parts, with flesh and blood raining down, splashing all over Lin Yi.
“Hahaha, old thing, you’re not as strong as me. Now, you have been completely slaughtered by me. Let’s see what you have to boast about now!”
Lin Yi laughed out loud as he took the elder’s storage ring, then turned and left the valley.
As Lin Yi’s figure disappeared into the distance, a series of thunderous roars echoed throughout the towering mountains.

chapters.title: Chapter 769 - 769 789 The Huge Crack
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 769: Chapter 789: The Huge Crack Chapter 769: Chapter 789: The Huge Crack This was the sound of a mountain range collapsing.
The peak crumbled, rubble flying everywhere; giant cracks spread out like a spider web in every direction.
Terrifying auras emanated from the ruins, with strong fluctuations of energy spreading out, causing hearts to tremble in fear.
Before long, the once majestic mountain finally ceased falling and turned into ruins, becoming an ordinary peak.
In the center of the wreckage lay a corpse, the very elder Lin Yi had just slain.
This elder was a cultivator at the Fifth Layer of Qi Refinement Realm, and moreover, he had practiced a powerful Swordsmanship known as the “Surging Waves Slashing Sword,” which was fearsome once unleashed.
This time, the elder hadn’t expected to fall at the hands of Lin Yi.
In Lin Yi’s grasp, he couldn’t even muster a resistance.
The elder had perished!
“Who would’ve thought I’d take down this old man so easily!”
“Brother Lin, you’ve indeed achieved a great feat this time; we must attribute great merit to you!”
“Junior Brother Lin Yi, you truly are a dark horse!”
“Junior Brother Lin, you’ve made significant contributions this time; I must tell Master, he’ll surely reward you!”
…
Seeing Lin Yi kill a Fifth Layer Qi Refinement cultivator so effortlessly, all the surrounding cultivators were shocked, their eyes filled with admiration.
Lin Yi smiled faintly and said, “Everyone has worked hard, I’m taking my leave first!”
Having said that, Lin Yi turned and left, disappearing from everyone’s sight.
After Lin Yi departed, the crowd also dispersed to continue their hunt for prey.
“Kid, just you wait, I will definitely take revenge on you!”
The elder, watching the figure fade into the night, had venomous spite flashing in his eyes.
He was a managing elder of the Tianxing Sect, a Vice Hall Master holding a high position, with considerable repute within the sect; he was someone people usually feared.
However, today, he had been slain by Lin Yi.
This was an immense humiliation; how could he let it go so easily?
Not long after Lin Yi had left, someone from the Tianxing Sect discovered the elder on the ground and immediately had him carried away.
“Uncle, how could you die here?”
At this moment, a female member of the Tianxing Sect, looking at the elder’s corpse, was shedding tears incessantly, her heart aching profoundly.
The elder, named Xu Tianxing, was her grandfather.
“Sigh, I had planned to go into closed-door cultivation for a year to attempt Foundation Establishment, but I didn’t expect this brat to come cause trouble at Tianxing Cave. I was caught off guard, and he slashed me into pieces with a single stroke!”
“Alas, I don’t know if my grandson is still alive; he’s still so young. If he’s in danger and I can’t help, it truly shames me.”
“Ah, Uncle, please don’t cry, we’ll definitely find the young master; he’s blessed with good fortune, he must be alright!”
The woman, seeing Xu Tianxing wailing endlessly, also felt unbearable and quickly comforted him.
“Yes, I believe my grandson will be alright, I believe!”
Xu Tianxing nodded repeatedly, hope gleaming in his eyes, and said, “You must take good care of my grandson, and ensure no harm comes to him!”
“Don’t worry, Uncle, I surely will!”
“By the way, Uncle, what is your esteemed name?”
“My name is Xu Tianxing, his name is Xu Tianxing, and they all call me Uncle Xu, you can call me Uncle Xu too!”
Xu Tianxing stared in the direction Lin Yi had left, his gaze complex, his eyes filled with hatred, and he ground his teeth and said.
…
After leaving the valley, Lin Yi returned to the courtyard where he resided.
Once he was back in his room, he took out Xu Tianxing’s ring and began to examine it.
Inside the ring, there were many treasures and elixirs, as well as spirit stones and such, all of considerable value.
Lin Yi took out a storage bag, opened it, and began to search for items like elixirs and spiritual artifacts to put into his pocket.
“Not bad at all, there are quite a few good items here. This old man was really loaded. The combined value of these items must be no less than a million spirit stones. Only a major sect like theirs would possess such huge assets. I’m really lucky to have obtained them!”
“Hehe, with two more months to go, I should cultivate diligently to break through to the fifth layer of the Qi Refinement Realm, and then participate in the Qi Refinement Trial.”
“Not only can I get a rich reward, but I can also earn points to exchange for quite a few powerful spiritual techniques. This is a great opportunity.”
Thinking of this, Lin Yi’s eyes shone with an unusual light, and he felt secretly delighted.
…
The next morning, before the sun had risen and the pale golden afterglow still spilled across the land, Lin Yi woke up early, freshened up, and headed towards the mountaintop.
“Eh, my Qingming Sword, it’s actually disappeared without a trace. Could it have fallen down the cliffs?”
“Could it be? An ancient divine weapon like the Qingming Sword falling off the cliff?”
When Lin Yi arrived at the summit, he discovered that the Qingming Sword was gone without a trace.
As the Qingming Sword was his weapon for battle, its disappearance was quite astonishing to Lin Yi.
Yet, he did not give up searching for the Qingming Sword and began to look around the mountain peak.
Unbeknownst to Lin Yi, in a cave on the mountain, a pair of cold eyes was watching him.
The owner of those eyes was the black-robed man who had pursued Lin Yi the previous night, the very same person Lin Yi had killed.
“Hmph, boy, you dare to kill a disciple of the Tianxing Sect, I will never forgive you!”
The black-robed man said coldly, his eyes full of vindictiveness, staring at Lin Yi as if he wanted to devour him.
The disciples beside him also harbored a look of deep resentment.
In their eyes, Lin Yi had already become a dead man.
…
“No, I can’t stay here, or they will definitely find me!”
Lin Yi wandered around the mountaintop for a while, then shook his head in the end.
He was not afraid of being killed by people from other forces, but if the people from the Tianxing Sect found him, he would surely be in grave danger!
With that in mind, Lin Yi prepared to descend the mountain, but after taking only a few steps, he stopped again.
“Right, this mission is the best chance for me to complete my task, if I don’t hurry, it might be too late!”
With this thought, Lin Yi changed his mind and continued to search the summit.
Soon, Lin Yi found another medicinal plant.
This plant, known as ‘White Jade Ganoderma,’ might not be considered precious, but for Lin Yi, it was just as useful as any other spirit grass.
“Hahaha, I’ve struck it rich! This mission not only earned me ten thousand Gathering Yuan Pills, but I also found an extremely valuable White Jade Ganoderma, truly hitting several birds with one stone!”
Overwhelmed with excitement, Lin Yi quickly picked a White Jade Ganoderma and then hurriedly left.
“Haha, Lin Yi, I told you your luck wouldn’t be that bad, you really do have heaven-defying luck along the way!”
After Lin Yi left, a voice rang in his ear, belonging to a person in black clothes and a masked face.
Hearing this, Lin Yi shivered all over, feeling a wave of fear in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 770 - 770 790 Masked Man in Black
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 770: Chapter 790 Masked Man in Black Chapter 770: Chapter 790 Masked Man in Black He suddenly turned his head and looked at the black-clad figure.
The black-clad person wore a mask, making it impossible to identify who it was!
His strength was formidable, being a Martial Artist at the Eighth Layer, and he possessed a unique aura, characteristic of the Demon Race. Lin Yi could not sense the other’s specific Cultivation, only feeling that his opponent was inscrutable, with strength definitely around the Ninefold of the Soul Condensation Realm.
Being in the Eighth Layer, he was already considered extremely formidable, yet the other had approached him silently, without his notice, which made Lin Yi feel a chill in his heart.
This time, Lin Yi finally understood what it meant for disaster to come from one’s mouth. His luck was indeed not very good; along the way, he had encountered three waves of skilled assassins, each one no trivial matter.
This made his desire for cultivating grow even stronger, as he had always wanted to enhance his own strength.
“Senior, I don’t know why you are tracking me. I have no acquaintance with you,” Lin Yi said, looking at the black-clad figure.
The black-clad person let out a cold laugh, his tone mocking, “Hmph, I may not know you, but I’ve heard your name. You’re Lin Yi, right? I’ve heard of some things you’ve done. In Qingyun City, you killed a disciple of our Tianxing Sect, and you also killed a Sixth Layer Elder.”
“I’ve also heard that you’ve injured the disciples of my Tianxing Sect, causing our Sect to lose face. We Tianxing Sect will not let you go!”
“Senior, I, Lin Yi, have never done anything to wrong the Tianxing Sect. Do not falsely accuse me, otherwise, I will not rest,” said Lin Yi angrily, staring at the black-clad figure.
He knew that the other was a formidable opponent, stronger than himself, but he showed no trace of fear, only becoming more enraged.
“Hmph!”
The black-clad figure sneered, a mocking glint in his eyes, “Indeed, you haven’t wronged our Tianxing Sect, but you have wronged our Sect Leader. If it hadn’t been for you offending the Sect Leader, how could he have personally come to Spiritual Spring City and executed the disciple of our Sect himself?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s face immediately turned pale.
He hadn’t expected this affair to be connected with Xiao Tianyu!
“You mean… Xiao Tianyu?” Lin Yi said in shock and doubt.
The black-clad figure nodded, “That’s right, who else but him? You offended the Sect Leader, he naturally won’t let you off!”
Lin Yi fell silent, his mind echoing with the words of the black-clad figure, unable to regain his senses for a long time.
After a while, Lin Yi gave a bitter smile and said, “If that’s the case, then come and kill me. If by some lucky chance I survive, I will surely repay the great kindness of the Tianxing Sect!”
The black-clad figure let out a cold snort, paying no heed to Lin Yi, and turned to leave.
Lin Yi watched the figure’s retreating back, a deep hatred and murderous intent flickering in his eyes.
“Xiao Tianyu, how despicable you are! I, Lin Yi, will never coexist with you, just you watch!”
Lin Yi clenched his fists, his face icy.
…
Meanwhile, having left the peak, Lin Yi flew towards the depths of the Lingxi Mountain Range, needing to quickly find a secluded place to refine the ‘Purple Thunder Bamboo,’ and then to undergo his Metamorphosis.
“Whoosh!”
“Swoosh!”
Lin Yi streaked across the Lingxi Mountain Range, his speed incredibly fast, covering a thousand meters in the blink of an eye, arriving at a gully.
Lin Yi took out the Purple Thunder Bamboo, then buried it in the rocks of the gully.
Once the Purple Thunder Bamboo was in the soil, Lin Yi felt a vast surge of Heaven-Earth Vital Energy flowing into it.
“Buzz~~”
The Purple Thunder Bamboo suddenly trembled, and then strands of Purple Thunder Vines drilled out from its trunk, winding and dancing around the mountain stream.
Lin Yi hurriedly controlled the Purple Thunder Vines to prevent them from utterly destroying the mountain stream.
At this moment, Lin Yi could clearly sense the wild energy contained within the Purple Thunder Bamboo. This energy was immensely strong, far more powerful than the energy he had absorbed before!
Lin Yi could not help but be shocked, never expecting that the Purple Thunder Bamboo held such an effect.
“I must completely integrate this energy to enhance my own strength. I will step Tianxing Sect underfoot and then kill Xiao Tianyu to avenge my parents’ death and wash away the hatred!”
A determined look appeared in Lin Yi’s eyes as he thought this to himself.
Over the years, he had indeed suffered enough oppression from Tianxing Sect; this time, he was determined to destroy Tianxing Sect and avenge his parents!
The humiliations he had endured, the contempt he had faced, all were thanks to Tianxing Sect; how could he contain his hatred?
Lin Yi collected his thoughts and then closed his eyes to sit in meditation, absorbing the energy from the Purple Thunder Vines.
He continuously absorbed the energy from the Purple Thunder Vines, raising his Yuan Force to the highest level, then channeled the Yuan Force into his physical body to temper it.
“Boom! Boom! Boom!”
As the energy of the Purple Thunder Vines flowed ceaselessly into him, Lin Yi’s physical body was continuously transformed, becoming stronger and more terrifying.
Lin Yi cultivated with complete focus, not daring to be distracted for a moment, fearing that any lapse in concentration would lead to failure.
This time, his successful breakthrough to the Soul Condensation Realm was all thanks to the Heavenly Thunder Tribulation; if the tribulation failed, his path in cultivation would come to an end.
While Lin Yi cultivated furiously, every creature in the Lingxi Mountain Range felt the immense pressure and aura and hid away, afraid to be killed by that overwhelming force.
Within the Tianxing Sect, many cultivators also sensed that pressure and the heart-palpitating aura.
“What is this aura? Why is it so terrifying?”
“Could it be the work of some Artifact Refiner refining a Magical Treasure? I have heard that the Magical Treasures crafted by an Artifact Refiner are very powerful, but they also produce a strong backlash. I wonder what this aura is all about?”
“It must be a Magical Treasure. Let’s hurry back to report to the Sect Leader so that he can send someone to investigate; maybe we can uncover some clues!”
“Yes, I think so too!”
“Let’s go!”
People were discussing animatedly and prepared to hurry back to report, but just as they were about to leave, a shadowy figure appeared out of nowhere in front of them, blocking their path.
“Who is it?” the crowd shouted in unison.
“Hmph, stand back, I have something to say to them,” the figure in black sneered, drifting down, a sharp aura spreading out, causing many cultivators to tremble with fear and scurrying away in retreat, scrambling and crawling.
The man in black swept his gaze towards Lin Yi and asked indifferently, “Who are you?”
Lin Yi raised his head and replied calmly, “Lin Yi.”
“Lin Yi?” The man in black furrowed his brow, remembering that Xiao Tianyu seemed to have died by this person’s hand. He had not expected that Lin Yi would venture into the Lingxi Mountain Range.
His gaze coldly fixed on Lin Yi, he asked, “What are you doing in the Lingxi Mountain Range?”
“I came here in search of a Purple Thunder Bamboo,” Lin Yi said.
“Looking for Purple Thunder Bamboo? Do you realize the value of the Purple Thunder Bamboo? Do you know how precious this particular Purple Thunder Bamboo is?” the man in black scoffed, his eyes narrowing slightly as the intent to kill surged.

chapters.title: Chapter 771 - 771 791 Get Lost Early
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 771: Chapter 791 Get Lost Early Chapter 771: Chapter 791 Get Lost Early “I am well aware, for I have come here to obtain the Purple Thunder Bamboo and then refine it into Elixir to avenge my parents!” Lin Yi sneered coldly.
The man in black, with murderous intent clear in his eyes, said, “Your parents are long gone! Your quest for the Purple Thunder Bamboo is nothing but a pipe dream. I advise you to scram while you can, otherwise, I’ll make sure you never rise again. I’ll make your death a miserable one!”
Lin Yi’s gaze remained calm, his tone dismissive, “Who do you think you are to threaten me? If you really want to stop me, then I’ll just have to knock you down first and take my time dealing with you later, so you can find out just how hard my fists are, whether they’re like steel!”
“Fine, you’ve got guts; I want to see if your bones are as tough as they claim, tougher than bronze walls and iron ramparts!” exclaimed the man in black, furiously. His body suddenly erupted with overwhelming killing intent that surged like a tide, enveloping the void.
Lin Yi felt the terrifying aura and became inwardly vigilant.
“This man in black seems to be at the peak of the Fourth Layer in his cultivation, and he’s wielding a High-Grade True Yuan weapon too. He’s no simple foe!” Lin Yi thought to himself.
“Hmph, little bastard, today I shall teach you, who knows nothing of life and death, a lesson on behalf of your parents!” the man in black huffed coldly, stepping on the void and instantly reaching in front of Lin Yi, swinging his palm down towards him.
Lin Yi’s pupils contracted sharply, his expression darkening suddenly, as he hurriedly circulated the True Yuan throughout his body and threw his fist to meet the attack.
“Bang!”
The collision of their fists produced a thunderous noise, deafening, with ripples spreading through the air in concentric circles, like spreading waves.
“Thump thump thud!”
Lin Yi retreated three steps in succession, feeling a throbbing pain in his chest.
The man in black also took three steps back to steady himself, his face a picture of embarrassment as he looked at Lin Yi incredulously; he couldn’t fathom how Lin Yi had emerged unscathed from his strike.
“How is this possible? He’s only at the Third Layer. How did he withstand my attack?” the man in black muttered to himself, his face full of disbelief, unable to accept that Lin Yi could withstand his blow.
“Kid, I didn’t expect you have some strength after all, but you’re unlucky to have met me, because I’m going to kill you!” A fierce glint flashed in the eyes of the man in black as he sneered.
“I’d like to see just how strong you really are,” Lin Yi said coldly, staring at the man in black, “If you can kill me, I’ll give you three High-Grade Spirit Stones as a reward, how about it?”
Three High-Grade Spirit Stones posed a massive temptation, causing the man in black’s heart to pound fiercely, but he quickly recovered his composure and snorted coldly, “I don’t need them because I’m not only going to kill you, I’m going to dismember you a thousand times over!”
“Oh? So you don’t want my Spirit Stones? In that case, I definitely can’t let you leave, otherwise, you’ll never give up trying to kill me,” Lin Yi shook his head and sighed.
“Since you refuse the toast only to drink the punishment, then don’t blame me for being ruthless!” snarled the man in black, his face twisted with ferocity.
He reached into his Storage Bag with his right hand, pulled out a dagger, and charged at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s eyes flashed, and a longsword appeared in his hands. He engaged in a fierce battle with the man in black but did not take the offensive, defending instead, for he knew that if he were to attack, he would certainly be killed by the man in black’s counter.
Lin Yi was clear about this principle, so as long as he refrained from attacking, he could avoid being assaulted by the man in black.
Furthermore, he wasn’t worried about the Purple Thunder Bamboo being stolen; since these people wanted to take it, they must know its preciousness and wouldn’t dare damage it carelessly.
Sure enough, Lin Yi’s guess was not wrong. With his defense in place, the man in black gained no advantage.
However, although Lin Yi was on the defensive, he always remained vigilant in his heart.
He was waiting for an opportunity, a perfect opportunity!
“Kid, do you think you’re safe just because you fended off my attack?” The man in black’s face was ice-cold as the dagger in his hand suddenly turned pitch black as ink, emanating an aura that made one’s heart skip a beat, stabbing towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s gaze was grave as he knew that if the man in black’s strike was successful, he would undoubtedly be defeated!
Just as thoughts were racing through Lin Yi’s mind, the man in black’s dagger was already rapidly closing in on him.
Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat as he hurried to propel his figure to dodge, but as soon as he moved, the man in black launched another attack.
“Swoosh!”
The man in black’s body moved like a ghost, incredibly fast, and in the blink of an eye, he was in front of Lin Yi with a dagger placed before Lin Yi’s neck, its edge shimmering. With just a bit more force, the man in black could cut Lin Yi’s neck and kill him right there.
“You think this move will be enough to kill me? You’re underestimating me by far,” Lin Yi retorted with a trace of mockery in his eyes and a cold laugh.
“Heh,” the man in black let out a cold laugh upon hearing those words.
“Kid, do you really think I have no way of dealing with you? Since you don’t wish to live, I’ll grant you death, and then carry your corpse back to the sect!” A fierce light flashed across the man in black’s face, his palm suddenly exerting force, ready to twist off Lin Yi’s head.
However, at that moment, Lin Yi suddenly kicked out at the man in black’s arm.
“Boom!”
The dagger in the man in black’s hand was kicked away by Lin Yi, flying off into the distance while the man himself staggered back, ending up sitting on the ground.
“You’re courting death, kid!” The man in black glared at Lin Yi, eyes filled with venomous resentment as his palm clenched into a fist, the veins on the back of his hand bulging.
“The one courting death is you,” Lin Yi said, a cold smile curling at his lips. “And I will send you to hell right now, so you’ll know I’m not to be trifled with!”
“Arrogant!” the man in black roared. “I’ll see who is sending whom to their grave!”
No sooner had he spoken than the man in black vanished on the spot.
Upon seeing this, Lin Yi’s eyebrows furrowed, and he immediately became vigilant, scanning his surroundings for the man in black.
Lin Yi was strong, but his cultivation was only at the Fifth Layer of the Divinity Transformation Stage, so his Divine Sense couldn’t cover such an extensive range.
“Kid, stop wasting your effort. I’ve already escaped from here long ago. You won’t be able to find me unless I show myself!” As Lin Yi was searching the area with his Divine Sense, the man in black suddenly appeared in front of him.
“Kid, now I’ll send you to join your parents in hell. They must be eager to see you, hoping you could avenge them!” The man in black’s dagger attacked once more, aiming precisely at Lin Yi’s throat.
Lin Yi immediately dodged.
His movements were so swift that the man in black couldn’t even catch hold of Lin Yi’s clothes. However, the man in black flipped his wrist, and the dagger changed direction, stabbing towards Lin Yi’s abdomen.
Lin Yi’s complexion changed, and he hastily retreated, narrowly avoiding the man in black’s attack.
“Eh? What’s this treasure?”
However, as soon as the man in black’s dagger veered off, Lin Yi noticed something. He quickly reached out and grasped the treasure chest in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 772 - 772 792 The Color of Greed
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 772: Chapter 792 The Color of Greed Chapter 772: Chapter 792 The Color of Greed “Hmm?” The man in black’s eyes lit up with greed when he saw Lin Yi’s actions.
“Kid, hand over the Purple Lightning Bamboo and come with me. I’ll let you die swiftly!”
“Haha, keep dreaming!” Lin Yi laughed heartily, his laughter thunderous and ear-piercing, causing everyone’s eardrums to ache.
The man in black’s face darkened, and his eyes shot fire as he glared at Lin Yi. “Do you really think you can dodge my attack?”
As he spoke, the man in black’s palm suddenly swung, unleashing a burst of blood-red Qi Force. The Qi Force, like a blood-colored Flood Dragon, bore its fangs and claws as it pounced toward Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s face changed dramatically as he hurriedly dodged, but he was half a beat too slow, and the Qi Force from his palm struck him square in the chest.
“Pfft!”
Lin Yi spat out a mouthful of fresh blood and fell backwards, crashing heavily onto the ground with blood spilling from his mouth and nose, his complexion ashen.
The man in black’s eyes filled with excitement at the sight.
“Kid, you’re as good as dead, you must die!” The man in black’s eyes shimmered with a fierce smile as he stepped forward and pounced towards Lin Yi.
“Hmph, nonsensical!” Lin Yi wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, his eyes blazing with intense murderous intent as he shook his arm, suddenly revealing an Elixir in his hand which he promptly stuffed into his mouth and swallowed.
This Elixir was a holy product for healing injuries, one that Lin Yi had bought in a small town previously and had been reluctant to use until now when it became unexpectedly useful.
“Bang!”
A burst of golden light exploded from Lin Yi’s body, and a giant golden phoenix phantom appeared behind him. A terrifying pressure spread, enveloping the man in black within it.
“What… what’s going on?” The man in black froze, his eyes bulging, staring at Lin Yi in disbelief.
A surge of immense power rose from Lin Yi, suppressing the man in black in his spot, preventing him from struggling free no matter how hard he tried.
“You’re no match for me. If you know what’s good for you, let me go, and I might consider sparing your life!” Lin Yi stood his ground, looking down from above at the man in black with a calm tone.
“Brat, how arrogant! Do you not know who you are facing? Do you not understand that what you’re doing is suicidal?!” The man in black’s face was ashen, his eyes dark and grim, as he glared hatefully at Lin Yi.
“Heh!”
Lin Yi let out a cold laugh, his tone icy as he taunted, “Weren’t you bragging about how tough you are? Why don’t you try it?”
“Scum!”
The man in black was so furious that smoke seemed to rise from his orifices, his face flushed and his muscles twitching as if he was on the verge of exploding.
“I’ll give you one last chance!” Lin Yi said indifferently.
“Dream on!”
With a cold shout, the man in black’s eyes flickered with intense madness as his body was cloaked in black armor, covering him entirely except for his head.
“Hmph, kid, do you really think you’re all that? In my eyes, you’re nothing but an ant, and I could crush you with the greatest of ease!” The man in black snorted coldly, his demeanor disdainful.
“Is that so? Well, I’m eager to see that!” Lin Yi spoke calmly, a cold light flashing in his eyes as he suddenly charged forward with lightning speed.
Lin Yi’s speed was astonishing; in the blink of an eye, he reached the man in black and extended his right palm, slamming it viciously towards him.
Seeing Lin Yi’s ferocious attack, the man in black’s eyes flashed with disdain. “Foolish!”
The man in black raised his left palm to block Lin Yi’s fist while his own left fist punched towards Lin Yi’s abdomen, aiming to puncture it.
“Crack!”
Lin Yi’s left shoulder bone shattered instantly, piercing pain spreading throughout his body from the shoulder.
“Hiss!”
Lin Yi couldn’t help but inhale sharply, his face turning pale, the expression ugly.
“Not bad!”
Seeing Lin Yi injured, the man in black revealed a trace of joy on his face, squinting his eyes, he snorted coldly, “Kneel down and kowtow three times, kid, and maybe I’ll spare your life!”
“Pah!” Lin Yi spat disdainfully, “This lady doesn’t need your charity!”
“Unrepentant. I’ll send you on your way then!” Enraged by Lin Yi’s defiance, the man in black’s body suddenly jerked, accelerating like a cannonball toward Lin Yi, his palm erupting with a burst of blood-red Qi Force.
“Boom!”
Space trembled, the void shattered, and the man in black’s speed was extremely fast, reaching Lin Yi’s side in the blink of an eye.
“Hmph, fool who seeks death!”
The man in black sneered coldly, clenching his right palm again and launching a mass of blood-red Qi Force toward Lin Yi.
Seeing this, a serious look flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes, he soared into the air, narrowly dodging the deadly strike.
However, at that moment, the man in black’s figure vanished into thin air.
A solemn color flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes, he hadn’t expected the man in black to be capable of teleportation.
The next instant, he suddenly heard the sound of wind breaking from behind, he hastily turned his head and saw the man in black’s left fist coming at him with a force that seemed to destroy everything.
“Not good!”
Lin Yi quickly ducked to the side, but the fist still struck him.
“Ptui!”
A mouthful of fresh blood spilled from Lin Yi’s mouth, his chest caved in, several ribs broken, his chest collapsed, and he was blasted into the ground like a cannonball, the earth trembling non-stop, dust flying, smoke rising.
“Hmph, even if you dodged one attack, you can’t escape. I’ll tear you apart now and refine your bloodline energy into mine!” The man in black stepped out of the dirt, grabbed Lin Yi, and pulled him out, sneering coldly, “Just surrender obediently, kid! You can’t escape!”
Lin Yi’s face turned pale, his heart contracted, his breathing became labored, and his complexion faded to an ashen color.
“Haha, weren’t you so tough, kid? Aren’t you unafraid of me? Then I’ll just kill you, your blood should suit me just fine!” Laughing wildly, the man in black picked up Lin Yi and sprinted off toward the distance, seeking to leave the city.
“Damn! Isn’t my blood useful to you?!”
Lin Yi raged inwardly, his heart pounding rapidly, his face deathly pale.
The man in black sneered, “Of course, this is a special kind of blood, only my own can unleash its power. You wouldn’t understand, your blood is like a cup of poison, only by drinking this cup of poison will your blood become mine, haha, I’ll make your blood the most delicious food!”
“No, I can’t let him get away!”
Lin Yi gritted his teeth, his eyes narrowed slightly, and his legs gave way, causing him to kneel on the ground.
“What’s the matter? Now you’re afraid? Weren’t you all high and mighty? I want to see how long you can hold out!”
Seeing Lin Yi’s action, a hint of disdain flashed in the man in black’s eyes, but he quickly concealed it deep within. Clearly, he still harbored some wariness toward Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 773 - 773 793 Not Worth Mentioning
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 773: Chapter 793: Not Worth Mentioning! Chapter 773: Chapter 793: Not Worth Mentioning! “You wait for me, once I recover my strength, I will slay you, ensuring that you’ll never find peace even in death!”
Lin Yi clenched his teeth in rage, his eyes ice-cold, his body filled with a towering killing intent. He stared at the man in black as if he couldn’t wait to cut him into a thousand pieces.
“Ha ha, boy, now you realize how formidable I am!” The man in black laughed uproariously, his face growing more triumphant, “I’ll tell you, my cultivation has reached half-step into the Nascent Soul Realm. Your little strength means nothing in my eyes!”
“What?” Lin Yi’s color drained from his face, a look of disbelief flashing in his eyes, “You’ve reached half-step into the Nascent Soul Realm?!”
“Ha ha!” The man in black laughed wildly, saying, “How about that? Shocking, isn’t it? Now you understand why I am called Black Demon, don’t you? Your cultivation might be higher than mine, but your real combat experience is too little. I could use any move to kill you instantly!”
“Is that so?” Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed, he took a deep breath and said, “Then, I shall prove with your blood whether your words hold any truth!”
As he spoke, a cold light burst from Lin Yi’s eyes, and his right hand swung suddenly, forming a series of terrifying Sword Qi out of thin air, enveloping the man in black like a giant net descending upon him.
“Sword Qi Domain!”
The man in black’s face changed. He hadn’t expected Lin Yi to be so powerful that he could release a Sword Qi Domain, and it was even a minor-completed one.
“Hmph, just a minor-completed Sword Qi Domain, it poses no threat to me!”
The corner of the man in black’s mouth curved in scorn, his right foot stomped the ground, and he shot towards Lin Yi like a meteor, his arm shaking as his palm turned claw-like, sweeping a bloody wind toward the Sword Qi Domain with a vicious slap.
“Boom!”
A muffled sound erupted as the Sword Qi Domain collapsed, easily destroyed by the man in black.
“Pathetic!”
The man in black sneered in response, taking a step forward, appearing in front of Lin Yi in an instant. His right fist, carrying a terrifying momentum, blasted towards Lin Yi with frightening speed and unparalleled power, causing hearts to palpitate.
“Boom!”
Lin Yi’s complexion changed drastically, hastily raising his fist to meet the man in black’s punch.
“Boom!”
Fist met fist, and both men staggered back two steps.
The man in black felt a numbness in the arm that had gripped Lin Yi’s fist; the vibration in his palm was so intense he almost lost his hold. His face changed, and he quickly withdrew his hand.
“Youngster, your physical body is impressive; I am surprised!” the man in black said with narrowed eyes, sizing up Lin Yi.
“Heh, no matter how formidable my physical body is, it’s useless. Your fists are also quite powerful!” Lin Yi’s expression remained calm. As he looked at the man in black, a strange light flashed through his eyes. Suddenly his body emanated a faint golden glow, within which was a dense True Qi, forming a protective shield around him.
Upon seeing this, the man in black’s expression darkened.
“Kid, have you gone mad?!”
“I’m not mad; I am gambling!”
Lin Yi shook his head, flipping his right hand to produce an Elixir and swallowed it.
“What are you doing?” the man in black frowned, sensing something odd about Lin Yi’s actions.
“This is an Elixir of mine, after taking it, I can temporarily suppress the backlash of my Bloodline Power!” Lin Yi spoke, a resolute light flashing in his eyes, “My blood cannot be yours, because I have something more important to seek. Hence, I cannot die!”
“Oh? What is this important thing you are looking for?” The man in black grew curious. He gave Lin Yi a look, and suddenly greed flashed in his eyes, saying, “In that case, I will imprison you first. When the time comes, you’ll be begging for mercy, and then, it will be of no use to beg however you want!”
“Heh, you think you can imprison me? Wishful thinking!”
Lin Yi sneered coldly, “Even if it costs me a severe injury, I’ll drag you down with me!”
No sooner had he spoken than the blood inside Lin Yi’s body began to boil tumultuously, burning hot as if a blaze was raging within him. It was frighteningly scalding, causing sweat to bead his forehead and convulsions to shake his skin. He felt like all his organs were close to being incinerated.
Clenching his teeth, Lin Yi’s consciousness became increasingly blurry, as if he were a puddle of mud, completely unable to muster any strength.
“What… what’s happening? Has my cultivation really fallen to the peak of Earth Rank?”
A terrible look crossed Lin Yi’s face as this thought dawned on him.
This time, he had truly met his downfall.
Not only was he severely injured, but his cultivation had also dropped to the peak of Earth Rank. Moreover, he couldn’t use his blood to heal his injuries; otherwise, the man in black might devour it.
“Kid, let’s see how much longer you can struggle!”
Seeing Lin Yi’s complexion grow paler as though he was nearing his limit, the man in black was in high spirits. He sneered coldly, “Do you think that’s enough to stop me? You’re overestimating yourself! I’ll shatter your physical body first, then refine your blood. When that’s done, my cultivation will surely increase significantly!”
With that, the man in black moved, transforming into a streaking meteor. In the blink of an eye, he was beside Lin Yi, lifting his palm for a sweeping slap.
“Slap!”
The crisp sound of a slap echoed as Lin Yi’s cheek was struck to one side, a red mark appearing as blood trickled from the corner of his mouth. His eyes were full of shock—he couldn’t believe that, with his cultivation plummeted to the peak of Earth Rank and overwhelmed by the man in black’s cultivation, he was losing to the man in black.
How could he accept this? He was a genius of his generation, destined to become the master of a heavenly force. Yet now, he was being defeated by the man in black.
“You can’t do this!” Lin Yi roared, his eyes reddened with humiliation and his pride trampled. He gritted his teeth, ready to perish together with the man in black.
“Hmph, you’re really stubborn. I’ll send you on your way now!”
The man in black’s gaze was icy as he let out a cold cry. A fierce punch that tore through the air surged towards Lin Yi.
This punch, swift as thunder, reached Lin Yi’s chest with incredible speed.
“No good!”
Sensing the imminent danger, Lin Yi’s pupils shrank, and his face turned a ghastly white. He couldn’t help but retreat backward, trying to dodge the man in black’s attack.
“Bang!”
A loud noise erupted, and Lin Yi felt a surge of blood in his chest. He couldn’t resist spitting out a mouthful of blood mist, his complexion turning deathly pale as blood oozed from his mouth.
“Hahaha!”
The man in black watched the disheveled Lin Yi and couldn’t help but burst into laughter. His fists rained down on Lin Yi like a tempest.
“Pfft!”
Lin Yi staggered backward, spitting out blood again and again.
Lin Yi felt his life force draining away rapidly. He knew his blood wouldn’t hold out much longer.
At that moment, the man in black’s fist landed on Lin Yi’s back. His face twisted into a hideous and terrifying expression as he said, “Stinking brat, die!”

chapters.title: Chapter 774 - 774 794 Unscathed
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 774: Chapter 794 Unscathed Chapter 774: Chapter 794 Unscathed The man in black’s eyes bulged as he threw all his might into a punch, hoping to shatter Lin Yi’s body and utterly annihilate him.
“Kid, go to hell!”
“Bang!”
The man in black’s punch struck Lin Yi, but Lin Yi’s body just trembled, completely unharmed, leaving the assailant dumbfounded, his face darkening immediately.
At that moment, Lin Yi’s body suddenly exploded, turning into a blood rain that scattered in all directions.
“Damn it, he still had a trick up his sleeve!”
A flash of shock and anger appeared in the man in black’s eyes.
Lin Yi had clearly been trying to escape, but in the end, he chose self-explosion.
Though the self-explosion was powerful, it couldn’t withstand the man in black’s attack.
The force of Lin Yi’s self-explosion was earth-shattering, but his physical body also sustained serious injuries. At that moment, he lay on the ground, trembling all over, his face as pale as death, looking extremely pained.
“Hmph!”
Lin Yi couldn’t help but let out a light grunt. It felt as if his body was being torn apart, the pain bone-deep and unbearable. If the battle continued like this, his death was certain.
However, Lin Yi refused to give up.
He was unwilling to just die!
“No! I cannot die! I mustn’t die!”
Lin Yi’s eyes were bloodshot as he gritted his teeth, enduring the intense pain and focusing his mind to run his Cultivation Technique to heal his wounds.
In a short time, his injuries visibly recovered at a remarkable speed.
Moments later, all his injuries had disappeared, and he felt the abundant blood and pure Primordial Energy within his body, which excited him so much he almost leapt up. He couldn’t help but roar, “The Heavens, grant me a new lease on life!”
Then, Lin Yi ran the “Taiji Xuanqing Dao” Cultivation Technique, absorbing the surrounding Primordial Energy, rapidly healing all the injuries inside his body.
After everything ended, Lin Yi’s Primordial Energy and injuries had fully recovered. His strength was also restored to about the Seventh Layer, and he was just a hair’s breadth away from making a breakthrough.
Hatred flickered intensely in Lin Yi’s eyes. He hated himself, the environment he was in, the man in black from this place, and even more so the two Immortal King Realm experts. He was seething with rage.
“Lin Yi, how much blood do you have left? Hand it over quietly!” the man in black demanded, looking at Lin Yi, “Otherwise, I’ll kill you on the spot!”
“No way!”
Lin Yi shook his head, stubbornly refusing.
“Boy, don’t force me to take action myself!”
The man in black’s face twisted with malice as he glared at Lin Yi, his tone icy. He pointed his finger at Lin Yi’s forehead, and a green strand of Qi shot out, piercing into Lin Yi’s brow.
A stabbing pain originated from Lin Yi’s brow as his consciousness became muddled and blurred.
“Hmph!”
The man in black snorted coldly, “Kid, I’m giving you a chance. Hand over the Bloodline Source Crystal quietly, and I might just spare your life!”
Hearing the man in black’s words, Lin Yi’s heart leapt with joy—his opportunity had come.
“Hmph!”
But he still put on a disdainful face and said, “As if you could kill me! If you want my Bloodline Source Crystal, unless you break through to the Holy Level, forget it!”
“Hmph, I’ll show you that there are always bigger fish in the sea!”
The man in black sneered coldly, his figure leaping into the air, transforming into a shadowy blur as he rushed toward Lin Yi. With a punch, he struck Lin Yi in the chest, sending him flying a hundred meters away.
Lin Yi spat out fresh blood as his chest caved in and his ribs broke.
“Boy, you’re already wounded, do you still think you’re my match? You still want to resist? I advise you to give up those foolish thoughts. Hand over the Bloodline Source Crystals obediently, or else, I’ll smash your body one fist at a time!”
“Haha!”
“Haha!”
Upon hearing the man in black’s words, Lin Yi burst into wild laughter, defiance filling his eyes as he said, “Do you really think I’m afraid? Don’t forget, I possess three Bloodline Source Crystals. By myself, I’m enough to contend with you. You thinking of killing me is nothing but a fool’s dream!”
“Oh? Three Bloodline Source Crystals? Hehe, who do you think you are? A mere Eight-Star Bloodline dares to be so arrogant. Today, I will kill you!”
The man in black smiled coldly once more and surged toward Lin Yi again, slapping out with his palm.
His palm slammed into Lin Yi, flipping him over and leaving a deep crater where his feet had stood, while Lin Yi lay twitching inside the crater.
“Cough cough, cough cough cough…”
Lin Yi struggled to his feet, coughing continuously.
Yet, Lin Yi’s gaze remained steadfast, filled with a mighty conviction.
His Bloodline Source Crystals, he could not possibly give them to someone else, as they were far too important to him.
They were his last bargaining chip, and should they be taken away, Lin Yi would be utterly finished.
The man in black gazed indifferently at Lin Yi, saying, “Boy, since you refuse the toast only to drink the forfeit, then I have no choice but to oblige you.”
After speaking, the man in black moved swiftly, charging at Lin Yi.
His speed was so fast that in the blink of an eye, he was upon Lin Yi, stepping on his chest and pressing him into the mud, preventing his escape.
“Ah!”
Unable to hold back, Lin Yi screamed as the man in black’s foot crushed into his organs, causing him immense pain, almost making him pass out.
“Remember this, boy, I will make you understand what despair means!”
Coldly looking down at Lin Yi, the man in black grabbed his neck and flung him to the side with a violent toss.
Lin Yi was thrown face first into the dirt, but still, he clenched his teeth and stood up.
“Boy, do you really think I can’t deal with you? Let me tell you, I can kill you with just one move.”
The man in black’s tone was utterly cold as he indifferently swept his gaze over Lin Yi, releasing a strong aura that pressed down on Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s body shook, feeling as if he were being torn apart.
Lin Yi couldn’t help but scream miserably, spewing a large mouthful of fresh blood.
However, he held on desperately, refusing to submit.
“So, you want to fight to the death with me? You want to take my Bloodline Source Crystal? I’ll grant your wish!” The man in black looked at Lin Yi with a scornful look in his eyes.
“No!” Lin Yi roared frantically, “I don’t need your Bloodline Source Crystal. I have my own, and it will help me become stronger and stronger. When the time comes, you will be no match for me, and I will kill you as easily as turning over my hand!”
“Your Bloodline Source Crystal? Haha, I can now responsibly tell you that your Bloodline Source Crystal cannot unleash its greatest power.” The man in black jeered, “Your Bloodline Source Crystal, although somewhat extraordinary, is nothing compared to mine.”
Lin Yi fell silent; he didn’t believe that his Bloodline Source Crystal was inferior to the man in black’s.
“I don’t believe it! I will evoke its greatest power!” Lin Yi bellowed, charging at the man in black once again.
The man in black glanced at Lin Yi disdainfully, his figure flickering to dodge Lin Yi’s attack, while simultaneously striking with his palm and pounding Lin Yi with a ferocious punch.

chapters.title: Chapter 775 - 775 795 No Match for the Man in Black
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 775: Chapter 795: No Match for the Man in Black Chapter 775: Chapter 795: No Match for the Man in Black “Bang!”
Lin Yi was sent flying backwards, spitting out another mouthful of blood.
His face twisted into a ferocious expression, his eyes filled with resentful poison.
His Bloodline Source Crystal, it actually couldn’t match this man in black!
“Kid, now, I’ll send you on your way!”
The man in black let out a cold laugh, his figure flashed, reaching Lin Yi’s side in an instant, and slapped Lin Yi’s body with his palm.
“Pfft!”
Lin Yi spat out blood once more as his body flew backwards again, crashing heavily onto a large boulder, causing a hole on impact, with blood continuously flowing out, staining his body blood red; his complexion turned even paler.
“No!”
Lin Yi screamed in madness; he couldn’t believe his Bloodline Source Crystal was inferior to this man in black’s.
“I’m going to kill you! I’m going to kill you!”
“Kill!”
Lin Yi rose again, drawing his Longsword from his waist, and charged at the man in black once more, his sword slashing down towards the man in black.
The man in black sneered, swatting Lin Yi’s Longsword away with a slap.
Afterwards, he punched towards Lin Yi again.
“Thud!”
Lin Yi was sent flying, spitting out another mouthful of fresh blood.
Lin Yi felt as if his bones were nearly disarticulating, his body trembling violently, his eyes bulging as though about to burst, yet his gaze revealed an unwillingness to accept this reality.
His heart was full of regrets and anger, but there was nothing he could do.
“Kid, you brought this upon yourself, don’t blame me, blame your fate for being such!” said the man in black coldly as he looked at Lin Yi, then kicked him once more.
“Bang”
“Ahh!”
At this moment, Lin Yi could no longer endure the terrifying force, his body kicked far away.
Lin Yi lay on the ground, continuously vomiting, feeling as if his insides were about to be shattered by the kicks.
Lin Yi lay there, coughing incessantly, with fresh blood overflowing from the corner of his mouth.
“Kid, do you still want the Bloodline Source Crystal now?”
With an icy smile on his face, the man in black looked down at Lin Yi, his words merciless and devoid of humanity.
“Ptui!” Lin Yi spat out the blood in his mouth, eyes brimming with hatred. He couldn’t believe his Bloodline Source Crystal was inferior to this man in black’s.
He believed in the power of his Bloodline Source Crystal, confident that it could unleash its greatest effect and kill the man in black!
“I won’t give up, no matter the cost, I will kill you!” Lin Yi said through gritted teeth.
“Boy, you really aren’t afraid of death!” The man in black looked at Lin Yi with frigid eyes.
“Humph! I’d rather die than submit to your vile Might.”
“If that’s the case, then go ahead and die!”
The man in black huffed, lifting his right leg and kicking towards Lin Yi’s head.
“Pfft!”
Lin Yi was kicked away, another mouthful of blood spewing out as his head was knocked askew.
Lin Yi felt his head was about to explode, his mind went blank, and his consciousness blurred.
Yet, he did not collapse. Instead, he summoned all his strength, got up again, and threw himself at the man in black, with an expression of resigned determination, his eyes blazing with an unwilling light, as if they were about to ignite.
“Die!”
The man in black kicked out at Lin Yi once again.
Lin Yi didn’t dodge, instead, slashing out with his sword.
“Pfft!”
Lin Yi once again spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, his arms directly kicked apart, blood spilling all over the ground.
But Lin Yi still got up and continued to fight with the man in black.
“I don’t believe my Bloodline Source Crystal is inferior to your Bloodline Source Crystal!” Lin Yi thrust his longsword through the chest of the man in black, piercing his heart.
At the chest of the man in black, a heart was still beating. The heart had been punctured, blood slowly oozing from it, yet his body still maintained a kind of balance.
A cold smile played upon his face.
“Kid, you have no hope left. Just accept your death obediently,” the man in black stared coldly at Lin Yi.
“Do you really think I’ll just sit back and wait for death?”
“Even if I die, I’ll drag you down with me!”
Having said that, Lin Yi suddenly produced a golden Bloodline Source Crystal.
As soon as the Bloodline Source Crystal appeared, a terrifying bloodline might emanated from it, instantly enveloping the man in black.
The man in black’s body trembled violently, bloodline patterns emerging on his skin. Following the appearance of these bloodline patterns, the Bloodline Source Crystal actually transformed into a black robe on his body.
Witnessing this scene, Lin Yi’s pupils couldn’t help but constrict.
“This, what is this?”
“Kid, your Bloodline Source Crystal is a bit more powerful than mine, but that doesn’t mean my Bloodline Source Crystal is weak. You can activate the might of your Bloodline Source Crystal, and I can do the same with the Bloodline Source Crystal within me!”
The man in black snorted coldly, the bloodline might on his body surged.
“Boom!”
The layer of black robe on the outside of the man in black’s body shattered.
The robe tore apart, releasing strands of energy from the Bloodline Source Crystal, which coalesced in mid-air, finally taking the form of numerous black bats.
These bats, large and small, swarmed densely, revolving continuously around the man in black.
Around these black bats was a ring of bloodline patterns, like a mountain range, a vast mountain, suppressing everything around it, causing palpitations.
Under Lin Yi’s gaze, the man in black opened his mouth to inhale, swallowing the black bats into his stomach, and then he punched out once more.
Suddenly, a punch hit the ground, and the ground collapsed instantly, a fierce storm sweeping through the area.
Lin Yi’s body was blown about by the wind, his clothes billowing with a rustling sound, his cheeks drenched in sweat.
The punch from the man in black contained a destructive force; Lin Yi simply couldn’t withstand it.
Lin Yi rolled over, dodging the strike.
“Pu!”
Lin Yi spewed out a mist of blood, his eyes filled with fear.
He knew that even though the punch from the man in black hadn’t hit him, he had almost been shattered by it.
Lin Yi stood up again, vitality streaming into his body, his injuries rapidly healing at this moment.
“Hahaha, kid, your Bloodline Source Crystal has still been taken by me,” the man in black laughed heartily, his hand reaching towards Lin Yi.
“You think I’m out of options?”
“Bloodline Source Crystal, explode!”
Lin Yi’s eyes flashed crazily.
“Boom!”
The Bloodline Source Crystal exploded once more, a bright red flame soaring up, burning fiercely.
Red flames instantly enveloped the man in black, one after another shooting towards him.
The man in black’s body swayed and then disappeared from the spot.
“Boom boom boom boom boom!”
The red flames all struck the ground, instantly burning the earth into countless huge pits.
“Hahaha! Kid, there’s more than just this in my body—Bloodline Source Crystal. Do you think you can harm me with just some flames?”
The man in black laughed loudly, charging towards Lin Yi.
“My Bloodline Source Crystal may not be as strong as yours, but I am not without opponents. However, I also possess other Bloodline Source Crystals, in fact, three kinds!” Lin Yi’s face revealed a strange smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 776 - 776 796 Sinister Smile
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 776: Chapter 796: Sinister Smile Chapter 776: Chapter 796: Sinister Smile “Oh? Then give it a try!”
A playful expression appeared on the man in black’s face.
Lin Yi took a deep breath, his body enlarging once more, with muscles bulging taut as if he were a copper-cast iron statue.
Following that, Lin Yi opened his mouth, actually tearing his own lips apart, with drops of crimson blood flowing from his mouth.
Drops of blood trickled down from the corners of his lips, falling to the ground.
Lin Yi’s complexion turned extremely pale, his body appearing weaker and weaker, even his breathing seemed to grow more rapid.
Lin Yi pressed his palm against his chest, placing his chest on the ground.
There were two massive holes at his chest, within which a massive vortex spun, at the center of the vortex, droplets of fresh blood surged.
That blood was the power of his bloodline.
“Explode for me!”
Lin Yi bellowed, and the power contained within those two drops of blood exploded.
“Boom!”
A destructive energy spread out, pulverizing everything in the vicinity, including the stele to dust.
And this power continued to spread, reaching places afar, spreading to cities, villages nearby, reaching the forests at the edges of the cities.
Lin Yi, seeing the buildings destroyed around him, flashed a hint of reluctance in his eyes. But then, remembering his relatives, his love, his homeland, and his hatred, his heart filled with endless rage!
“Ahh!”
He let out a sky-shattering howl, his aura suddenly increasing dramatically, a world-ending force bursting forth from within him.
“Ah!”
His face twisted into something ferocious, his muscles swelling, veins protruding like earthworms, filled with strength.
“Ah!”
The clothes on his body instantly turned to ash, leaving only a thin shirt. Pieces of scale armor, condensed by the power of his bloodline, covered his body, making him appear like a terrifying Demon God!
“Die!”
His eyes turned blood-red, the eyeballs a sheet of red, like two large light bulbs, daring not to be looked at directly.
Lin Yi’s figure suddenly burst forth, his speed indescribable, and in the blink of an eye, he appeared behind the man in black.
Lin Yi grabbed the man in black by the neck, lifting him up and then hurling him forward ferociously.
“Bang!”
The man in black slammed into the ground, creating a huge pit, the ground cracking upon his impact.
“Cough cough cough cough!”
The man in black coughed a few times, climbing out of the pit.
With a leap from the ground, the man in black flashed and reached mid-air, already at close quarters with Lin Yi.
“I’ve already got half of your Bloodline Source Crystal. I’d advise against any futile struggles. Not only can I kill you, but I can also kill all your other friends and family, leaving you eternally alone!”
His eyes glinted with a chilling intent.
His voice sounded cold to the extreme, as if it came from the deepest abyss of Jiuyou.
Lin Yi sneered, “People like you will meet retribution sooner or later, and one day you’ll die a terrible death!”
“I’m afraid you won’t have the chance to see it.”
“Is that so?”
Lin Yi’s tone carried a hint of mockery as his body suddenly disappeared from the man in black’s sight, reappearing behind him in the next instant.
“Thud!”
He kicked towards the man in black’s back.
This kick contained all his bloodline power, and when it connected with the man in black, it bent his spine.
The man in black cried out in pain as he fell heavily to the ground, his body curling up.
He clutched the spot where his ribs had been struck, the excruciating pain making him feel as though his spine had shattered.
Lin Yi looked at the man in black and said coldly, “Do you have anything to say now?”
“Ah!” The man in black screamed in agony, “I was wrong, I give up, I don’t want to die, please let me go, I’ll do anything you ask!”
“If I wanted you dead, would you have any chance at life?” Lin Yi spoke coldly.
“I…”
As the man in black prepared to plead for Lin Yi’s mercy, his words were cut off by Lin Yi, “If you continue to prattle, I will make you disappear from this world completely!”
“Ah! No! Don’t! I won’t do it again! I really won’t!” The man in black immediately shut his mouth, not daring to continue speaking nonsense.
The man in black looked at Lin Yi and suddenly asked, “Who are you exactly?”
“Who am I?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s expression became somewhat strange, and he stared at the man in black, “My name is Lin Yi.”
“Lin Yi…”
The man in black’s eyes widened as his pupils abruptly constricted.
“I… I know your name, you’re Lin Yi! The Lin Yi from my memory!” The man in black exclaimed, his face filled with disbelief, “How did you become like this?”
Lin Yi’s appearance hardly differed from the Lin Yi in his memory, and even the aura of intense killing intent emanated from him.
“I am Lin Yi! Do you want to know why I have become like this?” Lin Yi said with a sneer.
“I don’t want to know!”
“You don’t want to know, but I will tell you anyway!”
As Lin Yi spoke, he extended his right index finger and flicked it lightly. A ray of light flew out from the spatial ring on his hand, quickly enlarging until it transformed into a figure.
This figure appeared to be about three years old, with snow-white short hair, fair skin, long eyelashes, big eyes, a small nose, and plump cherry lips.
His cheeks looked like those of a porcelain doll, round and adorable, very lovable and endearing.
This child was none other than Lin Yi’s son, Lin Chenxi!
Since his birth, Lin Chenxi had been cultivating within Lin Yi’s body and had now reached the Nascent Soul Stage Sixth Layer.
“Daddy!” When Lin Chenxi saw Lin Yi, he immediately flew towards him and hugged Lin Yi’s neck.
“My good son!”
Lin Yi caressed Lin Chenxi’s smooth black hair and smiled.
“Daddy, you’ve finally come back!” Lin Chenxi looked at Lin Yi, his eyes brimming with tears, his voice choked with emotion.
He knew Lin Yi must be very tired, must have been severely injured, but he was powerless, only by becoming stronger could he protect his parents.
“Yes, I’m back.”
“I’ve missed you so much.”
“Daddy missed you too.”
“Daddy, how did you do it? To transform into a person with such power, even reaching the Nascent Soul Stage Eighth Layer.” Lin Chenxi’s eyes lit up as he asked.
Lin Yi smiled but did not answer Lin Chenxi’s question, instead he asked back, “You have already broken through to the Nascent Soul Stage Eighth Layer?”
“Yes, I was in closed-door cultivation, and my realm has broken through to the Nascent Soul Stage Eighth Layer,” Lin Chenxi nodded.
“Good, it’s great that you’ve cultivated to the Nascent Soul Stage Eighth Layer, your progress is rapid. With your current strength, you should be able to defeat experts at the Ninth Level of the Nascent Soul Stage. However, if you encounter an expert at the Ninth Level of the Nascent Soul Stage, you should still flee, don’t fight them head-on!” Lin Yi advised Lin Chenxi.
Upon hearing this, Lin Chenxi immediately frowned, “Daddy, what is the cultivation of that man in black?”
“Nascent Soul Stage Seventh Layer, his strength is even greater than yours! Although I now possess some combat skills, I’m still far from being able to defeat him,” Lin Yi shook his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 777 - 777 797 The Process of Conversation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 777: Chapter 797: The Process of Conversation Chapter 777: Chapter 797: The Process of Conversation Hearing Lin Yi’s reply, Lin Chenxi’s expression also grew somber.
“Dad, why did this person appear in our village?” Lin Chenxi asked again.
Lin Yi sighed and recounted the entire conversation he had with the man in black, including the words the man had said to him.
Fury and hatred filled Lin Chenxi’s face, he clenched his fists and said, “I must kill this villain! How dare he lay his hands on you, Dad, he must pay the price!”
Lin Yi smiled and patted Lin Chenxi’s head, saying, “I know.”
“Dad, don’t worry about me, I will protect you!” Lin Chenxi said.
Lin Yi shook his head and replied, “I don’t need your protection. I already possess the ability to protect myself. However, now is not the time to fight this man to the death; we should avoid him for a while and make plans later.”
Hearing this, Lin Chenxi did not continue to insist.
Soon after, Lin Yi and the man in black left the valley and came to a city near the village.
They arrived in town, found an inn, and rented a room.
After washing up and changing into clean clothes, Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi lay down on the bed to rest.
This night was destined to be sleepless.
The next morning, Lin Yi woke up early, freshened up, then went to the courtyard to exercise while checking his wounds. The slashes and scars from swords on his body had been treated by Lin Yi, leaving only some minor cuts which were not severe and would heal with some rest.
After completing his exercise, Lin Chenxi also got up and washed up.
After breakfast, Lin Yi took Lin Chenxi and left the inn to head to the county town.
Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi arrived at this city and entered a restaurant.
There were quite a few people in the restaurant, and as Lin Chenxi and Lin Yi walked in, they attracted the attention of the others.
“Esteemed guests, what would you like to have?”
The waiter, upon seeing Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi, hurriedly invited them to sit down.
Lin Yi ordered two breakfasts and then asked Lin Chenxi what he would like to drink.
“Anything is fine for me!” Lin Chenxi said.
Hearing this, the waiter immediately turned around, ran to the counter, and said to the owner, “Boss, two glasses of milk!”
“Two glasses of milk, please enjoy your meal,” the owner said to Lin Yi.
Soon, the waiter brought out two steaming glasses of milk from the kitchen.
“Please enjoy, let me know if you need anything else,” the waiter said to the two.
“Okay.”
Lin Yi nodded, picked up the milk, and tasted it in small sips. However, he was chatting with Lin Chenxi casually.
“Chenxi, you’ve now reached the fourth layer of the Nascent Soul Stage. Do you have any goals? Do you want to become even stronger?”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s question, Lin Chenxi’s eyes narrowed slightly, pondering his future goals.
“Dad, I want to go to the Heavenly Sword Sect to cultivate!”
“Oh? You want to go to the Heavenly Sword Sect for cultivation?”
“Yes, I want to cultivate. I don’t want to be an ordinary person my whole life, I don’t want to stay in the village forever,” Lin Chenxi said earnestly. “Dad, do you know how the people from the Heavenly Sword Sect view me? In our village, everyone sees them as ordinary people, only you are a cultivator, and a very powerful one at that.”
Lin Chenxi’s words caused Lin Yi to be taken aback, unsure of what to say.
“Father, I want to go to the Heavenly Sword Sect to study swordsmanship, Cultivation Techniques, and Martial Arts, as well as a lineage of Sword Dao. I wish to become an exceptional Sword Cultivator,”
Lin Chenxi earnestly said, “Father, what do you think?”
“Have you thought about the fact that if you want to become strong, you must go to the Heavenly Sword Sect to cultivate?” Lin Yi said.
“Heavenly Sword Sect? Where is it?” Lin Chenxi inquired.
“It is located in the northeast, home to a Sect called the Heavenly Sword Sect, which is one of the major Sects in our Huaxia. The Sect is controlled by a Sword Saint named Li Xiaoyao. This Sword Saint, it’s said, was a grandmaster in our Huaxia five hundred years ago. However, he left Huaxia later due to certain events and went to other countries,” Lin Yi explained.
“Sword Saint? Who is he?” Lin Chenxi asked.
“The Sword Saint is reputed to be an incredibly remarkable grandmaster with swordsmanship that surpasses many of Huaxia’s grandmasters,” Lin Yi claimed.
“Father, does that Heavenly Sword Sect have the Martial Arts I want to practice? Are there any powerful secret manuals? If so, I could become an apprentice and a disciple of the Sword Saint!” Lin Chenxi asked.
“Yes, the Heavenly Sword Sect indeed possesses secret techniques handed down by the Sword Saint. But I think you might be disappointed because the swordsmanship taught by the Sword Saint has, at its highest, only been mastered up to the first half. As for the latter half, no one has been able to comprehend it yet,” Lin Yi replied.
“The first half, I’ve already mastered! The latter half, I can cultivate as well!”
Lin Chenxi declared confidently.
“You say you’ve mastered it?” Lin Yi looked at Lin Chenxi and asked, “Have you truly mastered it?”
“Yes, I really have. The swordsmanship of that senior Sword Saint is incredibly powerful,” Lin Chenxi asserted.
“Well then, since you’ve truly mastered the Sword Saint’s swordsmanship, Father will not prevent you from going to the Heavenly Sword Sect to cultivate,” Lin Yi nodded and said, “However, you must remember that the Heavenly Sword Sect is a Sword Cultivation Sect, not a regular Sect. Once you join the Heavenly Sword Sect, you must follow your master’s arrangements and must not act recklessly on your own accord.”
“I understand all of that. Don’t worry, Father,” Lin Chenxi said solemnly, nodding his head, as he felt a certain awe towards the Sword Saint.
Seeing this, Lin Yi breathed a sigh of relief. He was worried that Lin Chenxi’s impulsiveness might cause trouble at the Heavenly Sword Sect, but fortunately, Lin Chenxi did not disappoint him.
“Father, we’ve come here to buy a few horses as well,” Lin Chenxi suddenly remembered his own horse.
Lin Yi smiled and shook his head, saying, “Chenxi, didn’t you say you could ride a horse? Could it be that you’ve forgotten? When you were outside, you rode several fine horses, so how could you have forgotten now?”
“I remember, Father,” Lin Chenxi said.
Lin Chenxi scratched the back of his head; indeed, he treated horse riding as a pleasure.
However, it wasn’t Lin Chenxi’s fault because he truly could ride a horse, but the time spent riding was too short to fully utilize the horse’s speed.
“Chenxi, Father will teach you a Sword technique, and once you’ve learned it, your ability to defend yourself will be greatly improved should you encounter any danger,” Lin Yi said.
“Father, I want to learn it too,” Lin Chenxi responded.
Hearing his father offer to teach him a formidable Sword technique, naturally, he wanted to learn.
“Good, Father will teach you,” Lin Yi said, “You see, the first move of the swordsmanship is called ‘Myriad Swords Return to the Sect.’ Pay close attention and see what effect you can produce if you execute this Sword technique.”
Lin Yi held a Longsword in his hand and infused Sword Intent into the technique, causing the blade to flash and transform into countless streaks of light attacking Lin Chenxi.
“Hmm? Such quick sword speed!”
Witnessing this move, Lin Chenxi’s eyes showed admiration. He knew that the power of this technique was tremendous, and if he did not utilize his full strength, he certainly wouldn’t be able to withstand it.
“This move, I’ve almost completely comprehended, so next, I will teach you the Second Form,” Lin Yi said as he passed on the Second Form of the swordsmanship to Lin Chenxi.
Having learned the Second Form, Lin Yi then proceeded to teach him the Third Form, the Fourth Form, and so on.

chapters.title: Chapter 778 - 778 798 It Took a Long Time
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 778: Chapter 798: It Took a Long Time Chapter 778: Chapter 798: It Took a Long Time Lin Chenxi, despite his exceptional talents, still required a considerable amount of time to learn from Lin Yi, taking seven or eight repeats to fully master the techniques.
“Chenxi, I’m going to teach you a move called ‘Wind Slash’,” Lin Yi said, “try practicing it now!”
“Swoosh!”
Lin Yi unleashed a fierce Sword Qi, which instantly cleaved through the void, creating a vast fissure.
And the fissure kept expanding, stretching out for thousands of feet.
“What an impressive swordsmanship!”
