Lin Chenxi praised inwardly, a look of delight appearing in his eyes. He discovered that the ‘Wind Slash’ swordsmanship was truly powerful—if he could execute it, the force would be tremendous.
“Now that you’ve learned the sword technique passed down by the Sword Saint, I plan to spend the rest of this money on this ‘Wind Slash’ sword technique!”
“Don’t look down on the amount, my son, it’s all the money I have left now. If I didn’t even have this little, I might as well not be alive,” Lin Yi said with a bitter smile, for he was completely broke.
“Dad, I won’t disdain it!” Lin Chenxi quickly responded.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s face showed a gratified expression. He patted Lin Chenxi’s shoulder and said, “Then Dad will leave first. Chenxi, I believe in your talent; you can definitely surpass your mother, you certainly can!”
“Dad, take care of yourself. Your injuries have only just healed; don’t overexert yourself!”
“Alright!”
Lin Yi nodded, left the teahouse, and then headed out of the city.
“Chenxi, are you going to look for your mother?” the waiter asked.
“No, I’ll go find her after I return.”
Lin Chenxi said.
Seeing this, the waiter didn’t dare to say more. After all, this was a matter between parents and it wasn’t his place to pry.
Lin Yi arrived outside the city, in a forest.
He reached the skies above a mountain range and then, with a forceful stamp of his feet against the ground, he shot towards the depths of the mountains like an arrow.
“Boom!”
A loud boom echoed from the valley, followed by a series of beastly roars.
This mountain range was the forbidden area of the Heavenly Demon King clan, to which Lin Yi belonged. The clan members of the Heavenly Demon King clan were all Demon Beasts, each one ferociously powerful, and their Cultivation levels extremely high. Among them, there were even mighty beings of the Demon Monarch Level.
“Roar!”
Another earth-shaking roar bellowed as Lin Yi saw a colossal creature emerge— the reigning beast of the Heavenly Demon King clan, a massive Golden Dragon!
Lin Yi, wielding the Qingfong Sword, charged towards the ruling beast of the Heavenly Demon King clan, his sword emitting a blinding Sword Qi. Wherever the Sword Qi went, the void shattered.
The ruling beast of the Heavenly Demon King clan, seeing a mere human rushing towards it, burst into a fierce rage. Its body leapt up like a cannonball hurtling towards Lin Chenxi.
“Bang!”
A loud crash sounded as Lin Yi was sent flying by the impact from the clan’s ruling beast, creating a deep crater in the ground, with the very earth trembling.
Lin Yi, however, got up and charged at the ruling beast of the Heavenly Demon King clan once more. He swung the Qingfong Sword down again, and a huge burst of Sword Qi slashed down, aiming straight at the creature.
The ruling beast of the Heavenly Demon King clan opened its huge maw to bite at the Sword Qi.
The two terrifying powers collided, and the beast from the Heavenly Demon King clan was repelled by the fearsome Sword Qi. However, it didn’t retreat far and continued to pounce towards Lin Chenxi.
“Whoosh!”
Lin Yi took a step forward and arrived next to the Demon King’s royal beast, his Qingfong Sword slashing down towards the body of the royal beast of the Demon King clan.
The royal beast of the Demon King clan twisted its body, dodging the sword strike, and then it pounced towards Lin Chenxi again.
At this time, Lin Yi also joined the fight.
The coordination between Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi was seamless, their battle far more in sync than that of the man in black robes.
“Bang Bang Bang!”
Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi continuously struck the royal beast of the Demon King clan, and after enduring Lin Yi’s sword, the creature suffered heavy injuries.
The swordsmanship of Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi grew increasingly familiar, and their coordination improved moment by moment.
Both Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi’s swordsmanship was incredibly powerful, making it difficult for the royal beast of the Demon King clan to withstand their sword moves.
Before long, countless wounds appeared on the body of the royal beast of the Demon King clan.
Overwhelmed by the sword techniques of Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi, the royal beast of the Demon King clan was unable to counterattack.
Its body trembling, the royal beast released a ring from its back, which then flew into the foreheads of Lin Chenxi and Lin Yi.
“Ding, congratulations to the host for obtaining ‘Ninth Rank High Grade Martial Arts’.”
“Ding, congratulations to the host for obtaining ‘Ninth Rank Low Grade Martial Arts’.”
The system’s notification sounded, which caused both Lin Chenxi and Lin Yi to be stunned.
Lin Chenxi and Lin Yi looked at each other and smiled joyously, having finally learned new martial arts!
Ninth Rank High Grade Martial Arts – these were martial arts of an extremely high level.
“Hahaha!” Lin Yi could not help but laugh heartily, for he had never imagined that he would one day acquire Ninth Rank High Grade Martial Arts, a stroke of sheer luck!
“Uncle Lin Yi, what’s going on?”
Lin Chenxi looked at Lin Yi, puzzled.
“Oh, nothing, I’m just feeling very happy,” Lin Yi responded with a cheerful smile, fully aware of how fortunate he was to have obtained Ninth Rank High Grade Martial Arts. Such techniques were incredibly rare even among the entire Demon Race, yet he had obtained one.
“Uncle Lin Yi, you don’t have to hide it from me, I know you must have encountered something good!” Lin Chenxi said.
“Alright, since you really want to know, I’ll tell you,” Lin Yi paused briefly before continuing, “Just now, I found a treasure in the cave, a treasure that can enhance the physical body!”
“A treasure?”
Lin Chenxi’s excitement soared upon hearing the word ‘treasure,’ for treasures were incredibly precious to any cultivator.
“Really?” asked Lin Chenxi excitedly. Although her cultivation was only at the Intermediate Stage of Earth Rank, she was already capable of using martial arts of that level.
“Of course it’s true!” Lin Yi nodded, taking out a storage ring and handing it to Lin Chenxi, “Inside this storage ring is a treasure. It contains a Heaven Fragrance Herb, one hundred Earth Element Grasses. Additionally, there’s a Spirit Stone – a Spirit Crystal, with ten thousand Spirit Stones inside it.”
Lin Yi listed the contents within.
“Spirit Crystal! Ten thousand Spirit Stones!”
Lin Chenxi gasped in astonishment as she looked at the items inside the storage ring – a colossal fortune, amounting to a hundred billion Spirit Stones!
A Spirit Crystal was worth fifty Low Grade Spirit Stones, and one could exchange it for two to three hundred Low Grade Spirit Stones. And Spirit Stone, of course, was the Lowest Grade of Spirit Stones – unaffordable for the average person.

chapters.title: Chapter 779 - 779 799 A Great Fortune
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 779: Chapter 799 A Great Fortune Chapter 779: Chapter 799 A Great Fortune Such a Spirit Stone, was definitely considered a great fortune, and now Lin Yi actually had a total of more than ten thousand Spirit Stones in his hands!
“Wow, so many Spirit Stones!”
Lin Chenxi couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise, she had not expected that Lin Yi could acquire more than ten thousand Spirit Stones, such a fortune was simply immense.
“Yes, this time I got a total of seventy to eighty million Spirit Stones, half of which are Spirit Pills, the other half are Spiritual Medicine.”
“In addition, there are a dozen or so Earth Rank Low Grade Spirit Stones, we can use these dozen Earth Rank Spirit Stones to buy Martial Arts, and then use Spirit Stones to purchase Spirit Pills, with this, our strength will surely increase,”
Lin Yi said.
“Yes, good! Then Uncle Lin Yi, let’s put these things away for now, to have them ready for when they’re needed.”
Lin Chenxi hurriedly stored the Spirit Stones, these Spirit Stones, she planned to sell at the market to exchange for Spirit Pills.
“Okay, now let’s find a quiet place, and then I will teach you how to refine these Spiritual Liquids.”
Lin Yi said, and, leading Lin Chenxi, they walked ahead.
Soon, the two of them left the valley and arrived at a nearby mountain peak.
Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi sat cross-legged on the cliff at the top of the mountain peak and began the Refinement of Spiritual Liquid.
They were both cultivators, and their Cultivation Methods were extremely domineering, so after ingesting the Spiritual Liquid, they would generate a strong absorbing force, which would cause their Physical Bodies to mutate, producing powerful energy.
And the Spiritual Liquid would be absorbed by both of them.
As the Spiritual Liquid entered their bodies, their skin slowly turned red and became more lustrous, as if coated with a layer of rouge powder.
With this, it became easier to absorb the Spiritual Liquid.
As the speed of absorbing the Spiritual Liquid increased, the muscles of both individuals slowly bulged, their bones gradually became thicker and harder.
Lin Chenxi’s Physical Strength grew even stronger, now reaching over three thousand catties.
Lin Yi was the same, his Physical Strength also reached around fifteen thousand catties.
The Physical Body Power of the two had reached a terrifying level.
“Good, now let’s begin, I’ll start the Refinement of Spiritual Liquid!”
Lin Yi stimulated the Spiritual Power within his body to its limit, and strands of robust Spiritual Power formed a vortex around Lin Yi, then spread out towards the surroundings.
The Spiritual Energy absorbed by Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi rotated within the vortex, finally merging into their bodies.
The surface of the skin of Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi was also glowing with a layer of blood light, this blood light was a strange energy produced within their bodies which could change their skin.
The skin of both Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi became much tougher than that of ordinary people, like metal, incredibly sturdy.
Lin Yi’s Physical Strength was quite special because his Martial Soul was of the Fire Element, so his Physical Strength was extremely formidable.
“Lin Yi, brother, how did your Physical Strength become so amazing?” Lin Chenxi asked in surprise, she found it very strange.
“Heh heh, that’s called talent,” Lin Yi said with a laugh.
As Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi refined the Spiritual Liquid, time kept passing.
Both were fully immersed in the Refinement of the Spiritual Liquid, their bodies emitting an incredibly rich fluctuation of Spiritual Energy, these fluctuations floating like a mist around the surface of their bodies.
Their bodies flickered with a faint red glow, their skin seemingly on fire, emitting a scorching temperature, as well as emitting a strong fragrance.
“Hmm, that smells so good!”
Lin Chenxi caught the scent wafting from Lin Yi, and her stomach immediately started growling loudly; she was extremely hungry and her belly was rumbling.
Lin Chenxi’s stomach growled, startling Lin Yi from his refinement of the spiritual liquid. Opening his eyes, he looked at Lin Chenxi and then laughed, “Chenxi, it seems your stomach is performing the empty fort strategy again! I had already guessed as much.”
“Hee hee, I really am hungry,” Lin Chenxi chuckled, then looked at Lin Yi and asked, “So, what should we eat now?”
“Hehe, we can have something to eat.”
Lin Yi smiled. “Given the distance to the nearest city, which is a day’s journey from here, we should go and look for food now.”
“Alright.”
Lin Chenxi nodded; she felt the pangs of hunger too.
Then, Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi flew up into the sky together, heading southeast.
…
A day later, they arrived at a desolate valley that was dotted with wilted wild trees. On these trees hung fruit that was black and discolored, and they let off a foul, putrid smell.
As Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi reached the area, they were immediately greeted with a nauseating odor. Lin Chenxi promptly covered her nose, frowned, and revealed a disgusted expression on her face.
Lin Yi, however, didn’t have much of a reaction; he knew that his constitution was special and might not be too affected by such smells.
“It’s so stinky, so unpleasant—this smell is twice as strong as the stench of corpses,” Lin Chenxi complained vigorously as she flapped her hands in front of her, as if to disperse the suffocating odor that made it hard for her to breathe.
“Chenxi, just bear with it for a bit. These black fruits are all toxic,” Lin Yi said.
“But it’s really awful!” Lin Chenxi protested.
“Alright, alright, don’t worry so much. Hurry up and pick these fruits. Then we’ll roast them and eat,” Lin Yi instructed.
“Okay,” Lin Chenxi nodded. She took out a short sword from her bosom and slowly approached the black fruit, her steps tentative.
Seeing this, Lin Yi shook his head and smiled bitterly, well aware of Lin Chenxi’s combat power in the forest.
Her fearsome combat power allowed her to easily slay even ordinary Sixth Grade Demon Beasts, yet now she was intimidated by those black fruits, which said a lot about how dreadful they were.
“These fruits must contain more than just toxins; they likely also hold powerful energy. I suspect that the fruits here are all precious spiritual medicines,” Lin Yi thought to himself. He then began to pick the fruits quickly.
In no time, he had harvested the fruits and stored them inside his storage ring. He also took out a huge jade box and packed the black fruits into it.
After completing these tasks, Lin Yi planned to return to the spot to wait for Lin Chenxi to return, but unfortunately, she did not come back. Reluctantly, he continued to search the vicinity for Spirit Grass, Spirit Fruit, and miraculous Spirit Pills.
He searched the valley for half the day but did not find any Spirit Grass or miraculous Spirit Pills.
However, he did discover some other spiritual medicines, such as certain herbs, which were poisonous but could increase a cultivator’s Soul Power.
Moreover, Lin Yi found some rare and valuable ores nearby, the kind that were scarcely found and incredibly precious.
Lin Yi didn’t waste any time. He immediately excavated the ores and then returned to the valley to gather them all together.
Lin Yi kept busy with these tasks all night, without any rest, until the sky began to brighten slightly, which was when he allowed himself a brief break.

chapters.title: Chapter 780 - 780 800 The Good Performance of Jade
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 780: Chapter 800: The Good Performance of Jade Chapter 780: Chapter 800: The Good Performance of Jade This time, his harvest was quite substantial, having collected a total of one hundred and seventy to eighty Spiritual Medicines, among which the grade of the Spiritual Medicine reached the peak of Ninth Grade, and the rest were all at Sixth Grade. This was indeed a very good result.
That night, Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi both cultivated in the mountain valley, refining Spiritual Liquid all night long. Although some was refined, Lin Yi did not refine all the Spiritual Liquid.
Since this place was the Demon Cave, fraught with danger, Lin Yi also didn’t dare to eat recklessly. Once he ate something that upset his stomach, the consequences were unthinkable.
The next day, the two continued on their way, with Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi cultivating while they traveled.
That evening, they encountered several waves of attacks by Demon Beasts. Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi each dealt with a monster, neither of them using weapons, but relying on their own strength to kill these beasts.
On this part of their journey, they encountered many spirit beasts, but these creatures posed no threat to either of them.
The journey was long, taking a full five to six days, but finally, they passed through the jungle and entered the periphery of the Demon Cave.
Along the way, they encountered several more attacks by Demon Beasts, but these creatures couldn’t even touch Lin Yi, who took care of them all.
During these five or six days, Lin Yi collected some Spiritual Medicines and herbs, in addition to hunting Demon Beasts to enhance his Cultivation.
It wasn’t just Lin Yi making breakthroughs in Cultivation; Lin Chenxi was also improving.
Lin Chenxi’s Cultivation was at the Innate Realm, but she had neither True Yuan nor Spells, so there were many insufficiencies in her practice, which needed time to be compensated for.
Now with so many Spiritual Medicines at hand, Lin Yi planned to help Lin Chenxi make a breakthrough as soon as possible.
“Chenxi sister, I have found a Spiritual Pond, and I plan to have you cultivate in seclusion there. Once you’ve broken through the Innate Realm, we can return to the Lin Family’s land, and you’ll be able to see your grandfather and father,” Lin Yi said.
“Okay, I understand. I’ll listen to you,” Lin Chenxi nodded and responded.
Lin Yi led Lin Chenxi to a creek, then moved the Spiritual Pond to the shore.
The water in the Spiritual Pond was half black-brown and the other half was clear and transparent.
Lin Yi placed Lin Chenxi into the Spiritual Pond, then he sat on the shore, cultivating while keeping watch over Lin Chenxi.
“Chenxi, cultivate well here, and don’t worry me,” Lin Yi advised.
“Yes! I know,” Lin Chenxi obediently nodded and then began to cultivate in the lotus position within the Spiritual Pond.
Seeing this, Lin Yi nodded and sat quietly on the shore, both cultivating and observing the surroundings.
The place was filled with poisonous miasma, and he had to ensure that Lin Chenxi wouldn’t be harmed by it.
And at this moment, Lin Yi was also considering how to leave this place next.
The area was filled with poisonous miasma, which also contained intense toxins, so Lin Yi didn’t dare to stay long.
If it hadn’t been for the presence of the miasma, which to some extent could contain the loss of Spiritual Energy, perhaps Lin Yi would have left already.
The miasma had no effect on Lin Yi and Lin Chenxi.
But for others, this miasma was like a deadly poison, making it difficult for them to breathe, and even leading to numbness in the body, turning into fools, living forever in the marsh unable to escape the fate of death. Such was the power of the poison.
“The poisonous miasma here is too intense; I can only last two to three minutes here, and if I stay outside the miasma, I can’t last long,” Lin Yi thought.
Lin Yi considered that the miasma was too dense; the longer he stayed outside it, the greater the damage to him. His body could even start to decay gradually, becoming shriveled and eventually disappearing.
Lin Yi didn’t dare to take the risk, so he had to leave the miasma and go somewhere else.
However, the Spiritual Energy here was so abundant that he couldn’t find other sources of Spiritual Energy for a while; he had to stay here for some time.
After carefully considering, Lin Yi felt that the efficiency of cultivating in this place was too low, and he didn’t know when he would be able to find other Spiritual Energy, so he planned to continue cultivating while searching for it.
Lin Yi thought for a moment, then stood up. He decided to hunt some fierce Demon Beasts.
“Roar.”
Just as Lin Yi stood up, he suddenly felt an extremely dangerous aura, followed by a tiger’s roar that echoed through the valley.
“What? A spirit beast has appeared?” Lin Yi’s expression changed slightly; he hurried towards the direction of the roar, with a longbow appearing in his hands, launching an arrow into the sky, hoping to alert the owner of the roar.
However, to Lin Yi’s surprise, the owner of the tiger’s roar seemed very cunning, actually dodging the arrow. Although the arrow didn’t hit the target, it infuriated Lin Yi instead.
“Damn you, beast, actually evading my attack. Take this!”
Lin Yi shouted angrily, drew his bow to the full, and shot an arrow at the owner of the tiger’s roar.
“Owww…”
The owner of the tiger’s roar sensed the danger and let out a miserable scream; its tail swept out and knocked away the arrow shot by Lin Yi.
“Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!”
Lin Yi flicked his wrist, and two more bows appeared in his hands. At the same time, he swallowed a Spirit Pill to increase his Combat Power.
“Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh.”
Lin Yi continuously shot a dozen arrows, but the owner of the tiger’s roar easily dodged all of them, unharmed.
Lin Yi’s expression turned grim; the owner of the tiger’s roar was very powerful, but Lin Yi was not afraid.
He didn’t believe he wasn’t a match for this tiger. Since he dared to come in, he hadn’t been afraid of anyone!
“Little girl, stop struggling. You might as well submit to me! Rest assured, I won’t hurt you. Just spend a session with me, and I guarantee you’ll be ecstatic!” the tiger, staring at Lin Yi, spoke in human language.
“Hmph, I don’t believe that you can really block my arrows. Get out of the way!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, his eyes sharpened, and the sword in his hand appeared again. He shot another arrow, this time much faster than the last one.
Moreover, this time, Lin Yi used a soul attack, which was many times more powerful than the last one!
“Bang, bang!”
The tiger had not expected Lin Yi’s arrows to be so formidable; it was shot and injured, its skin pierced!
“Owww!”
The tiger let out a painful roar. It hadn’t expected to be wounded by Lin Yi. Although it hadn’t been hit by the arrow, it still felt its skin being pierced, and the blood flowed freely, the pain immense!
Seeing that his arrow had severely injured the tiger, Lin Yi was very pleased, a smile on his lips: “This spirit beast, I claim it!”
Lin Yi, holding the bow and arrows, then quickly rushed forward, intending to cut the tiger’s throat, but at that moment, a beam of light shot from afar, shattering the arrow fired by Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 781 - 781 801 Whats the Background
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 781: Chapter 801: What’s the Background? Chapter 781: Chapter 801: What’s the Background? A streak of golden light landed on the body of the tiger, and its wounds rapidly healed back to their original state. Its face was a ghastly shade of anger, and it roared furiously, “Which bastard dared to ambush me? Show yourself!”
“Ha ha! I’m right here, do you want to catch me? With your strength, you can’t touch me!”
A wild and arrogant voice rang out, and a figure streaked across from the distance and landed in the valley.
This figure was short and clad in earth-yellow clothes, wrapped in a gray rope—none other than an old beggar.
“What’s the background of this guy? How did he appear here?”
Lin Yi furrowed his brow in thought, never having heard of such a character. However, this old beggar seemed very powerful, and his methods were formidable.
Lin Yi’s attacks had just been completely neutralized by the old beggar, leaving the tiger unharmed, not even slightly injured.
Lin Yi guessed that the old beggar’s strength had probably reached the level of a Spiritual Master.
“Boy, you still dare to come back? You’re definitely going to die today!” Seeing the old beggar’s appearance, the tiger immediately became enraged.
Lin Yi sneered coldly, “Hmph, you think you can talk to me like that? I’m going to slay you right now!”
Lin Yi’s figure moved, transforming into a gust of wind as he lunged at the tiger, pulling his longbow taut once again.
“Whoosh whoosh whoosh!”
A series of whistling sounds rose as hundreds of arrows shot towards the tiger.
Cold light flickered in the tiger’s eyes. Its figure moved and turned into a mist, dodging the arrows shot by Lin Yi while simultaneously snapping its jaws towards him.
“Boom!”
A loud noise ensued, and Lin Yi’s body was violently knocked back several steps, almost falling to the ground. But he steadied himself and raised his bow and arrows once more.
“Swish swish swish.”
Lin Yi released another volley of arrows, dense like rain, shooting towards the tiger.
The tiger was extremely fast, and Lin Yi’s arrows couldn’t hurt it. Although it wasn’t going fast, Lin Yi was helpless against it because its speed was just too swift.
“Roar!”
The tiger let out an angry roar, charging at Lin Yi like a crazed wild boar.
The tiger was terrifying, and Lin Yi could not withstand it, being forced into a pathetic flight.
“Roar!”
Seeing that Lin Yi could not match its speed, the tiger roared angrily, chasing after Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s speed was merely enough to contend with the tiger, unable to shake it off. Eventually, the tiger caught up to him and slapped him away with its paw.
This strike contained immense spiritual power; Lin Yi felt a severe pain in his chest, a mouthful of fresh blood spurted out, nearly causing him to faint.
“So powerful!”
Lin Yi was inwardly shocked, having never suffered such a severe internal injury before. Even when facing masters of the Heavenly Tribulation Realm, he was able to fight them. But now, he had been defeated by the claw of an ordinary spiritual beast.
The tiger leapt once more, preparing to pounce and devour Lin Yi.
But Lin Yi was prepared; he waved his hand, and his longbow shot out, firing nine arrows at the tiger’s vitals such as the ‘seven-inch’ and ‘eight-zhi.’
“Roar!”
The tiger, sensing the deadly threat, had no choice but to give up the chase and defend.
Its limbs fiercely pushed off, leaping from the ground. Its figure soared, hopping over the arrows shot by Lin Yi, and then it opened its wide jaws and inhaled the arrows!
“Hisss! Hisss! Hisss! Hisss!”
All the arrows were swallowed by the tiger.
“Hiss~!”
The arrows were incredibly small, yet the Spiritual Energy within them was exceptionally dense. Once that Spiritual Energy was refined, it would undoubtedly be of great help in cultivating, and moreover, this tiger would be devoured by them and become even more powerful.
“Brat, hand over all the valuable things you have to this old man obediently, or else, I will make your life a living hell!”
The tiger, while munching on those Spiritual Artifact level weapons, glared fiercely at Lin Yi.
“If you want my belongings, you don’t have the strength to take them. I advise you to submit to me obediently, and I might spare your life. Otherwise, I will make sure you will wish you could live or die!”
“Humph, little child, you’re just tough-talking. In a moment, I will tear you to shreds!”
The tiger roared angrily, leaped forwards, and pounced towards Lin Yifei, its incredibly sharp teeth aiming to tear into Lin Yi’s flesh!
Lin Yi, seeing the tiger’s assault, immediately used his movement technique to dodge the attack.
“Bang!”
The tiger’s body slammed viciously into the stone wall, creating a massive crater. The force of the impact sent the tiger rebounding back, harshly crashing onto the ground.
“Hmph! I’d like to see who dies first!” Lin Yi uttered coldly. He moved swiftly, vanishing from his spot. Taking up his longbow, he once again shot a volley of arrows at the tiger.
“Bang! Bang! Bang!”
With each shot, Lin Yi struck the tiger.
“Pfft!”
“Ah!”
The tiger let out a pitiful cry as it was hit.
Lin Yi’s Attack Power was just too strong. Not a single one of his arrows was ordinary—they were all Spiritual Artifact level and immensely powerful. There were many of them, and every arrow hit the tiger, inflicting injury.
“Roar Roar!”
The tiger let out a large cry, its eyes fierce, and its demeanor terrifying. It suddenly rose from the ground, every hair on its body standing on end, its bloodshot eyes looking extremely fearsome!
“Roar!”
The tiger roared furiously, opened its mouth wide, and spewed out a fireball, which hurtled towards Lin Yi with astounding speed and intense heat, immediately enveloping an area with a radius of fifteen meters!
“Not good!”
Lin Yi’s expression shifted slightly. He hadn’t expected the tiger to be so formidable, conjuring up such a terrifying attack that was almost impossible to counter.
He hastily tried to dodge using his movement technique, but his speed was simply too slow to avoid the fireball launched by the tiger.
“Boom!”
The fireball exploded, sending waves of fire surging, engulfing everything.
The magma, within this inferno, seemed to freeze into ice. Deep within this magma, Ice Crystals spun continuously, presenting a spectacular sight!
A cloud of smoke and dust billowed forth, with the giant Ice Crystal floating above the magma.
“Rumble!”
The magma shook violently and more of it spurted from its depths, shattering the gigantic Ice Crystal.
The tiger, upon seeing the huge Ice Crystal, was also startled.
“Roar!”
It let out a skyward roar and quickly fled into the distance.
“Where do you think you’re running!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly and immediately employed “Inch Closer”, appearing behind the tiger in an instant, bringing his blade down with a swift chop.

chapters.title: Chapter 782 - 782 802 The Tiger is Extremely Miserable
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 782: Chapter 802: The Tiger is Extremely Miserable! Chapter 782: Chapter 802: The Tiger is Extremely Miserable! That tiger sensed Lin Yi’s terrifying aura and was instantly terrified, its tail sweeping out, attempting to knock Lin Yi away.
But how could Lin Yi let it succeed?
Lin Yi’s figure flickered, easily dodging the tail’s attack, then once again displayed his movement technique, charging toward the tiger.
“Bang bang bang bang bang!”
Lin Yi’s punches and kicks, like raindrops, landed on the tiger, causing it immense pain. It let out a pained roar and struggled constantly, its scale armor cracking.
Lin Yi pressed his advantage, striking continuously, bombarding the tiger’s body, leaving it full of injuries and covered in bloody marks, appearing utterly miserable!
However, the tiger was too strong. Even though it was battered all over by Lin Yi, it never ceased its attempts to escape toward the distance.
Seeing the tiger fleeing, Lin Yi had a thought, and his longbow shot out a volley of arrows once again.
“Whizz whizz whizz!”
“Thud!”
The arrows pierced the air, emitting a piercing whistling sound.
This volley, consisting of over a dozen arrows, struck the tiger all at once, penetrating its scale armor and creating holes!
The tiger was in agony, letting out an angry roar as it rolled in the magma, its flesh constantly cracking!
Its body was burning, its fur igniting into flames.
It felt as if a ball of fire was burning.
“Roar!”
The tiger let out a miserable roar, filled with despair and fear.
The flames were from its scale armor and flesh burning on its body.
The tiger’s body no longer appeared as robust as before, even looking somewhat withered.
“This tiger has been burnt,” Lin Yi frowned, surprised. He hadn’t expected the tiger to be so resilient; even after being hit by arrows of Spiritual Artifact Level, it hadn’t been penetrated, but instead got burnt!
The tiger was tormented to near death, its body had shrunken considerably, the flames on its body had extinguished, and its body had dried up, looking like a dried corpse.
“This tiger is at the end of its strength.”
Lin Yi’s gaze landed on the giant ice sphere, eyes flashing with greed; a smile appeared on his lips.
“If that’s the case, let’s test my arrows on you!”
Lin Yi reached out and grasped the giant ice sphere, channeling Spiritual Energy into it.
“Buzz!”
A circle of golden light rippled from the surface of the giant ice sphere, enveloping it.
The next moment, the giant ice sphere suddenly emitted strands of cold air.
That chill rapidly spread, freezing the nearby magma, solidifying it into a vast expanse of white frost. Within this layer of frost, Lin Yi’s figure slowly floated up elegantly!
The tiger was encased in that huge ice block, frozen on the outside of the giant ice sphere.
Inside the ice sphere, the tiger had been frozen for centuries, its internal power almost completely sealed.
Although the tiger hadn’t yet died, its body barely emitted any signs of life, reduced to a mere skeleton!
“Roar!”
The tiger struggled, but its body, completely encased in ice, couldn’t break free.
“You sneaky little fella, resorting to trickery!” the tiger glared at Lin Yi furiously and said resentfully, “If it weren’t for you, how would I have been frozen like this?”
“Hehe, I’ve already told you, I won’t let you leave, this here is your burial ground!”
Lin Yi flashed a grin, his palm tightening as the ice began to melt, revealing the true form of the tiger, charred black all over, its body shrunk to several times smaller with only its head remaining in the ice block, looking extremely terrifying.
This was a Third Rank Demon Beast, incredibly powerful, but Lin Yi had severely wounded it with a Spiritual Artifact and then frozen it, causing its strength to plummet to its peak state.
The tiger was now trapped inside the ice block, devoid of any strength or special abilities, hence it was unable to break through the ice seal set by Lin Yi and would ultimately freeze to death.
Lin Yi waved his hand, shattering the ice block, and the tiger immediately fell to the ground, shivering all over.
Its body was scorched and bloody.
“You, you despicable human, I won’t let you go, once I recover my strength, I will definitely kill you,” the tiger roared furiously.
“I’ll be looking forward to that day when you regain your strength, but for now, you’d better contribute a little,” Lin Yi said with a cold laugh, grabbing the tiger and tossing it into a giant ice sphere.
That giant ice sphere, a massive ice globe, contained the tiger’s Demon Core.
“Whoosh!”
Lin Yi threw the giant ice sphere, and as it flew into the air, it rapidly expanded, becoming extremely large, engulfing the entire sea of magma beneath it, casting a huge shadow that obscured the sky.
“Roar!”
Tiger after tiger ran in panic, they knew what that thing was, knew it was their king, their guardian deity!
“Roar!”
“Roar!”
“…”
A group of tigers ran frantically, their eyes filled with fear and rage.
From within that vast shadow, angry roars resounded, striking fear into the hearts of the tigers.
An hour later, a tremendous roar came from the giant ice sphere, bursts of brilliant light exploded, illuminating the heavens and earth, and the tigers all lay prostrate on the ground, bodies trembling.
Their king had completely perished, dead within that giant ice sphere!
“Aooo!”
A massive Gold Lion raised its head and howled sorrowfully, its body emitting bursts of yellow light that evaporated all the surrounding ice into steam, disappearing without a trace.
Lin Yi retracted the Spiritual Artifact giant bow and looked around; seeing no threats, he turned and walked toward the exit of the cave.
After he left the cave, he found no tigers patrolling the area, and that tiger had also vanished.
That tiger had likely been killed directly by Lin Yi.
Lin Yi glanced at his storage ring, where a giant ice sphere was emitting intense waves of Ice Attribute Energy, containing immense Ice Attribute Energy.
That Ice Attribute Energy was extremely immense, and Lin Yi estimated that the energy could sustain his cultivation for fifty years!
“Haha, this trip has truly been fruitful, my strength has seen another increase!”
Lin Yi was overjoyed, storing the giant ice sphere, then returned inside the cave.
Once back, Lin Yi sat down cross-legged, ready to absorb the giant ice sphere.
That giant ice sphere, being the pinnacle energy of the entire magma lake, would definitely enhance Lin Yi’s cultivation substantially as he devoured it!
“Rumble!”
Lin Yi circulated his Cultivation Technique, absorbing the energy from the giant ice sphere and then beginning the Refinement of the ice sphere, absorbing and refining all the Ice Attribute Energy within.
“Rumble!”

chapters.title: Chapter 783 - 783 803 The Energy is Truly Formidable
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 783: Chapter 803: The Energy is Truly Formidable! Chapter 783: Chapter 803: The Energy is Truly Formidable! Lin Yi’s body was raging with Ice Attribute Energy, twisting and turning furiously inside him. Terrifying bursts of Ice Attribute Energy exploded within, flooding his entire being, making his physical body incredibly robust and his physique even more formidable!
“Is this Ice Attribute Energy?”
“Indeed, it’s very pure; no wonder such energy can assist Martial Artists in their cultivation!”
“It’s truly strong energy, befitting of a Third-Rank Demon Beast!”
“What terrifying power!”
…
Lin Yi exerted all his effort to activate his Cultivation Technique, beginning to absorb the power of the Ice Attribute Energy. He felt his physical body becoming stronger without cease!
His physical body had reached its limit, but the energy of the Ice Attribute allowed for an elevation in Lin Yi’s physical strength!
Under these circumstances, the Ice Attribute Energy within Lin Yi almost reached a state of saturation without any room for further enhancement, so Lin Yi temporarily ceased his cultivation.
What he needed now was to completely refine that powerful energy and then elevate his power again!
“Crack!”
Suddenly, the Purple Mansion within Lin Yi’s Dantian burst open fiercely, and torrents of purple liquid surged forth, all of which were Ice Attribute Energy!
Inside Lin Yi’s Dantian, two droplets of Ice Attribute Energy had accumulated. A single droplet was powerful enough to boost his strength by an entire realm. This energy was immensely formidable, comparable to the Fire Attribute Energy he had absorbed before!
Lin Yi’s power soared once again, advancing from the Eighth Layer of the Qi Refinement Realm straight to the Ninth Level!
“Whoosh!”
The moment the cultivation of the Eighth Layer manifested, Lin Yi’s aura abruptly intensified, distorting the air around him and creating fine ripples!
“Hoo…”
Lin Yi exhaled a breath of stale air, which evaporated all the moisture in the surrounding air upon contact with the void, leaving the environment around him cleaner and fresher.
Lin Yi’s heart surged with joy.
“This sensation is awesome; my current strength should be comparable to that of a cultivator in the later stages of Foundation Establishment, right?”
“Though it’s not quite on par with those in the later stages of Foundation Establishment, it’s not far behind.”
Lin Yi was thrilled in his heart.
Lin Yi had leaped from the Eighth Layer to the Ninth Level of Qi Refinement, considerably increasing his strength. Now, Lin Yi had the combat ability of a cultivator in the later stages of Foundation Establishment, yet he could contend against a Martial Artist at the Second Layer!
Lin Yi emerged from the cave and saw that there were no tigers or ferocious beasts outside; all the fearsome creatures had fled.
Lin Yi didn’t concern himself with them; after all, they wouldn’t dare return for revenge.
Lin Yi no longer considered these tigers a threat; in this world, no one could defeat him now.
Lin Yi left the cave and noticed many precious herbs along the way, all of which he gathered and stored in his Storage Ring.
While journeying, Lin Yi collected numerous herbs, and his Storage Ring was now piled high like a mountain with over a hundred thousand herbs!
Lin Yi’s haul was colossal; these herbs might be worthless to the common folk or low-rank Martial Artists, but to Lin Yi, they were treasures.
“With so many herbs, I plan to use them for refining Elixirs. What I’m most lacking now should be Spirit Stones and Spirit Grass.”
“Spirit Stones and Spirit Grass are useless to Cultivators, but to us ordinary people, they’re incredibly valuable.”
“Right now, I have one hundred Low-Grade Spirit Stones, as well as five hundred thousand Low-Grade Spirit Stones, leaving six hundred thousand Low-Grade Spirit Stones.”
Lin Yi tallied his wealth, his heart swelling with delight.
“Although I don’t have many resources on me, these medicinal herbs can improve my cultivation. Moreover, with so much of these herbs, I can exchange them for a large number of spirit stones! That’s what I need most urgently right now!”
“These herbs can be used to refine elixirs, so I can make elixirs and earn a significant amount of spirit stones!”
Lin Yi felt joy in his heart and immediately found a secluded valley to begin his cultivation, starting to refine elixirs and improve his own cultivation.
Before he knew it, five days had passed.
During this time, Lin Yi had consumed all of the ice attribute energy.
His physical body became even stronger, but the quantity of ice attribute energy remained scarce, leaving only a trace of faint ice-blue energy, insufficient for providing much power.
Moreover, it seemed that this blob of ice-blue energy could no longer offer much energy.
“Sigh…”
Lin Yi sighed, feeling somewhat regretful.
It was such a pity that such powerful energy couldn’t further evolve his physical body!
“Forget it, since the ice attribute energy can’t provide any more power, there’s no point in wasting it. I’ll go buy more spirit stones first!” Lin Yi thought to himself.
He then left the cave, ready to leave the forest.
Lin Yi sped through the forest, crossing mountains and ranges, racing toward the nearest city.
His target was a medium-sized city, home to many pharmacies and shops.
After running through the forest and sweeping across the sky for several hours, Lin Yi finally arrived at a medium-sized city named Black Rock City, where the architectural style was quite unique, unlike any other city.
Lin Yi’s speed was extremely fast. His pace was comparable to that of a Nascent Soul Realm expert, so he traversed the jungle in just a few strides, quickly reaching Black Rock City.
This was an ancient and robust city, with many shops lining the streets. The storefronts were small but filled with a variety of items, and many martial artists were trading.
In Black Rock City, Lin Yi didn’t see any cultivators because it was a very backward city. There were no more than twenty cultivators in the entire city.
“Why are all the cultivators here just ordinary people?” Lin Yi wondered, stepping into a shop.
“Young Master, what would you like to purchase?” The shopkeeper, an old woman around seventy years old with a kind face, asked with a smile.
“I’m looking to buy items related to artifact refining and alchemy. Do you have any?” Lin Yi inquired.
“So you’re looking to buy those items. Young Master, if you want to purchase artifact refining and alchemy materials, you can indeed come to me. I have many fine goods that will certainly meet your requirements!” the shopkeeper enthusiastically introduced.
“I have all the items that you might need, but what specifically do you have here?” Lin Yi asked.
“I have some materials for artifact refining and alchemy. These materials are quite expensive, but since you, Young Master, have reached the late stages of the Golden Core peak, you should have no problem refining artifacts and elixirs. Let me show you what we’ve got!”
The shopkeeper beckoned with a smile, “Someone, take these things to the storage room!”
A group of people carried several large boxes following the shopkeeper toward a storage room.
Lin Yi followed the shopkeeper to the storage room.
In the storage room, there were many different materials laid out, as well as various weapons like knives, bows, spears, and even a flying sword.
Lin Yi noticed that the weapons were intermediate grade, low grade, and high grade flying swords, and the spears and arrows were actually supreme grade spiritual artifacts.
“It seems that the quality of these materials and weapons is not bad. I’m fortunate to come across such good items. It looks like it will be necessary to hunt some demon beasts more often in the future,” Lin Yi mused to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 784 - 784 804 The Astonishing Sharpness
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 784: Chapter 804: The Astonishing Sharpness Chapter 784: Chapter 804: The Astonishing Sharpness Lin Yi picked up a Flying Sword and examined it carefully.
This Flying Sword was made from intermediate-grade spiritual materials, and its sharpness was extremely astonishing; it was also incredibly light. When it drew an arc in mid-air, its might was truly terrifying.
Lin Yi sighed, “The attack power of this Flying Sword is actually not weaker than some intermediate-grade Spiritual Artifacts!”
After giving the flying sword several thorough looks to ascertain its material, he put it away.
“Shopkeeper, are you selling this flying sword?” Lin Yi asked, looking at the shopkeeper.
“Of course, I’m selling! This is a flying sword, an intermediate-grade Spiritual Artifact, and it’s not cheap!” the shopkeeper said with a smiling face.
“Then I’ll take all of them.”
Lin Yi promptly bought all the flying swords, packed up these materials and weapons, and left Black Rock City.
After Lin Yi left, the shopkeeper’s face suddenly revealed a touch of chill.
“Hmph, I knew it, you came for my materials and weapons. I didn’t expect you to actually buy them. This time, no matter how high the price you offer, don’t even think about taking them away from my hands! Hmph!”
The shopkeeper’s face broke into a sinister smile.
Lin Yi returned to the Azure Dragon Academy and went to find his master.
“Lin Yi, you’ve been out for an adventure, and your strength must have increased. What did you gain?” The white-robed elder looked at Lin Yi with a smile and asked.
“Yeah, the gain is indeed quite substantial. However, my gains this time are mainly in Artifact Refining and Alchemy. I’ve refined a set of intermediate-grade Spiritual Artifacts level weapons.”
Lin Yi nodded with a smile, took out the flying sword in his hand, and handed it to the white-robed elder to see.
“Is this… an intermediate-grade Spiritual Artifact?!”
The white-robed elder took Lin Yi’s flying sword, examined it closely, and his eyes suddenly lit up. His eyes widened as if they were about to pop out, and he excitedly looked at Lin Yi, asking with a trembling voice, “How… how did you do it?”
Lin Yi smiled lightly and said, “You needn’t worry about that.”
Lin Yi knew that it was not advisable to reveal this matter and that he should not let his master know.
“Hahaha!” The white-robed elder suddenly burst into laughter, excitedly saying, “Good, good, good, Lin Yi, that’s fantastic. I didn’t expect you to actually refine an intermediate-grade Spiritual Artifact! Now our Azure Dragon Academy is going to see the rise of a master-level Artifact Refining Grandmaster. Do you want to learn the Artifact Refining Technique?”
Hearing that Lin Yi had refined an intermediate-grade Spiritual Artifact, the white-robed elder was obviously very excited.
Lin Yi shook his head and said indifferently, “I’m not interested in learning Artifact Refining right now. I just want to focus on my cultivation.”
“That’s good to hear. I was afraid you wanted to learn Artifact Refining Technique! You’ve gained a lot from your adventure outside this time. I’ve already arranged for you to enter the Treasure Pavilion tomorrow for your assessment. If you pass the assessment, you can officially become a disciple of our Azure Dragon Academy!”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was momentarily stunned.
This mission came too quickly and too coincidentally.
He had just gone out and was taken in by a power, then obtained an intermediate-grade Spiritual Artifact Flying Sword, and then another power took him in to enter the Treasure Pavilion and officially join the sect. This kind of good luck was truly unexpected.
“Master, I don’t want to go to the Treasure Pavilion just yet.”
After thinking for a while, Lin Yi still refused.
Although he was eager to join some significant power, there was no hurry.
“Not going to the Treasure Pavilion? Then what are your plans?” the white-robed elder asked.
Lin Yi pondered for a moment and said, “I plan to return to Qingzhou first, settle the affairs there, and then I will return to the Northern Desolation to continue exploring deeper in search of opportunities.”
“Northern Desolation, Northern Desolation… I have quite a few things to do there as well. If you come back, remember to look for me in the Treasure Pavilion. I will certainly provide you with the most favorable conditions.”
“Okay, Master, then I will take you up on your offer!”
Lin Yi nodded, storing all the materials and the Flying Sword into his Storage Ring, and then took his leave.
After Lin Yi left the Treasure Pavilion, he immediately used the Teleportation Formation to return to Qingzhou, back to the Azure Dragon Academy.
Lin Yi had just returned to the valley of the academy when he hadn’t even caught his breath, something shocking happened.
He saw the space around him distort, and from the void, an enormous cluster of purple flames rose, enveloping the entire valley within.
Standing outside the valley, Lin Yi felt a terrifyingly scorching heat surge from all directions, roasting his skin to the point of severe discomfort.
“What an intense heat, what’s going on?”
Lin Yi was utterly astounded.
This was a Fire Spell, an attack of the Fire Element, which was extremely domineering and terrifying, but also easily counteracted.
Moreover, these Fire Spells could burn everything, even the land could be scorched clean—truly a vastly dangerous entity.
Lin Yi quickly circulated the Ice Element within his body, resisting the scorching heat coming from all around.
But the spell was too terrifying. No matter how Lin Yi tried to harness the Ice Element, it was to no avail; the spell continued to rage on.
“I can’t use Ice Spells now, otherwise it might trigger Heavenly Fire Burning Body, the consequences would be unimaginable.”
“Now I can only try my best to defend against this Fire Spell’s attack.”
Lin Yi frowned in thought.
“Boom!”
Suddenly, the sea of fire roiled, countless flames condensed, forming a pillar of fire hundreds of meters long that blasted down toward Lin Yi’s head from the top of the valley.
“Damn it!”
Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat, and he immediately deployed a Space Spell to escape.
The column of fire struck the ground, shattering the solid rocks into powder.
Lin Yi had dodged and hadn’t been affected, but his face was filled with wariness.
“This flame is too powerful, I’m afraid even a cultivator at the Golden Core Stage wouldn’t be able to withstand it!”
Lin Yi couldn’t help but feel relieved, thankful that his Cultivation wasn’t at the Golden Core Stage; if it were, he would have been killed instantly by the fire.
“However, the temperature of this flame is really too high, if this continues, I will eventually be melted away.”
With a thought, Lin Yi took out an Ice Crystal from his Storage Ring. The Ice Crystal released a white light that enveloped the entire valley, blocking the flames. It also absorbed all the pressure of the flames, mitigating the damage from the fire.
Who knows how long passed, the temperature in the valley slowly decreased a lot.
“Phew, that was close!”
Lin Yi breathed a sigh of relief.
After putting the Ice Crystal back into his Storage Ring, Lin Yi looked up to the sky and noticed that there was a snowfall happening.
“It’s snowing!”
Lin Yi exclaimed in surprise at the snowflakes swirling in the sky.
The snowflakes fell, and soon the entire valley turned into a pristine white expanse, like a world of white.
It was a miraculous sight!
Lin Yi couldn’t help but reach out to catch a snowflake. The snowflake was cool to the touch and emitted a refreshing fragrance.
“Eh, what’s this?”
Lin Yi looked at the snowflake in his hand, somewhat puzzled.
Suddenly, Lin Yi’s eyes brightened. He saw a shimmering Ice Crystal with a cold glint—it was an Ice Crystal!
“This must be an Ice Crystal from the Northern Ice Land! No wonder it’s so beautiful!”
With a thought, Lin Yi grasped the Ice Crystal in his hand. It emitted a chilly sensation that made Lin Yi’s heart tremble violently, and his spirit shuddered, feeling very comfortable, as if he possessed the power to freeze everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 785 - 785 805 Conduct a thorough study
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 785: Chapter 805: Conduct a thorough study Chapter 785: Chapter 805: Conduct a thorough study “How beautiful this Ice Crystal is!”
Lin Yi couldn’t help but exclaim.
The Ice Crystal emanated a frigid aura, similar to the Cold Ice Crystal Stones Lin Yi had used before; both were extremely icy crystals.
“It seems that the Ice Crystal’s ability to suppress these flames is quite clear; now, I must thoroughly study it.”
Lin Yi stored the Ice Crystal in his storage ring, then left the valley and headed toward the town.
Lin Yi now needed to find an inn to rest, after all, he had spent five years in the Treasure Pavilion and had not returned home.
However, when Lin Yi arrived back in the city, he encountered trouble.
As soon as his carriage stopped, a group of black-robed and masked men rushed forward, blocking him in place.
One of the black-robed men approached Lin Yi’s coachman and said, “We are from the Heavenly Demon Sect. Your Qingyun Country’s Royal House and Qingyun Country itself are vassal states to the Demonic Cult. We are ordered to capture you. Get off the carriage quickly, or don’t blame us for not being polite!”
“What! You are from the Heavenly Demon Sect?!”
Upon hearing the words ‘Heavenly Demon Sect,’ the coachman’s face showed a look of shock.
Here, the members of a Demonic Cult almost always moved together, and they were quite arrogant and domineering; he had once witnessed the strength of the Heavenly Demon Sect.
The people from the Heavenly Demon Sect were overwhelmingly powerful and would kill resolutely at a moment’s discord, extremely ruthless.
“How about it? Get off, otherwise we will have to kill you!”
Another black-robbed man came forward and said.
“This…”
At this time, Lin Yi stepped forward and asked the two men in black robes: “I don’t know about the Heavenly Demon Sect, nor do I know Qingyun Country. Why should I go with you?”
Lin Yi had come to Treasure Pavilion just to get the Heavenly Thunder Grass; he did not want to get involved with the people from the Heavenly Demon Sect.
The two black-robbed men were momentarily stunned as Lin Yi stepped out.
One of them stared at Lin Yi for a long time before saying, “Who are you, daring to defy the Heavenly Demon Sect?”
Lin Yi, hearing this, laughed and said, “I’m just an ordinary cultivator. How could I possibly oppose a high-level Immortal Cultivation Sect like yours?”
The black-robed man was shocked.
The Heavenly Demon Sect was a very powerful existence throughout the Tianyuan Continent; he didn’t know if there were any branches of the Heavenly Demon Sect in Qingzhou City. If there were, wouldn’t it cause a mess?
“Hmph, since you’re just an ordinary cultivator, I’ll kill you first, bind your soul, and then take you back for the master to interrogate to see if you recognize this place!”
The black-robed man stared coldly at Lin Yi, a hint of murderous intent flashing in his eyes.
“No need, I know you are people of the Heavenly Demon Sect; I just want to get what I need. Please let me go.”
Lin Yi shook his head and spoke indifferently.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the black-robed man snorted coldly, “Let you go? Where would the dignity of our Heavenly Demon Sect stand then?”
“Dignity?”
Lin Yi shook his head slightly, smiled faintly, and said, “I’m just a normal cultivator, not a powerful major force among cultivators. I pose no threat to you whatsoever, and besides, I only want what I need. We don’t have to be enemies.”
“Heh, how ridiculous. Our Heavenly Demon Sect is a very powerful sect under the rule of your Qingyun Country. You, a mere ordinary cultivator, dare to disrespect our Heavenly Demon Sect. You’re truly seeking your own death!”
The man in the black robe, upon hearing Lin Yi daring to disparage the Heavenly Demon Sect, couldn’t help but coldly smile. A murderous glint flickered in his eyes as he swung his fist toward Lin Yi.
“Ha!”
Seeing the attack coming his way, a look of disdain appeared on Lin Yi’s face.
Lin Yi extended his right hand’s index and middle fingers, pointed at the black-robed man, and a streak of purple light instantly flew out, striking the man right in the chest. This caused the black-robed man’s body to instantly freeze, as if a Binding Spell had been cast, locking him in place, unable to move any further.
With just one finger, Lin Yi had subdued a Martial Artist at the peak of the Ninth Level of the Body Refinement Realm!
Witnessing this, the coachmen and grooms inside the carriage were all astounded, their eyes widened and mouths agape, exhibiting an expression of disbelief.
They had never imagined that this seemingly young man possessed such formidable strength!
“Ha, the people of the Heavenly Demon Sect really don’t regard Qingyun Country highly, daring to send someone to kill me?”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, stepped out of the carriage, approached the black-robed man, grabbed him by the neck, and with a twist, a snap sound was heard—the black-robed man’s neck was broken by Lin Yi.
Lin Yi tossed the body into the carriage.
Just as Lin Yi stepped out of the carriage, he encountered several men in red robes, swords in hand, surrounding him.
“Boy, who are you to dare kill our people? Are you seeking death?”
The man in red roared angrily.
“Oh? So you all are from the Heavenly Demon Sect?”
Lin Yi laughed softly, and casually asked.
“Boy, you even know of our reputation?!”
“If I didn’t know your reputation, how would I dare to kill indiscriminately in the Treasure Pavilion?”
Lin Yi shrugged, nonchalantly saying, “Why don’t you tell me which sect you belong to, or what you call your Heavenly Demon Sect?”
“You’re courting death!”
As soon as Lin Yi’s words fell, the red-robed man’s expression darkened greatly, his sword swung, aiming for Lin Yi’s brow.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s expression turned cold, and he looked at the red-robed man icily. He drew a line in midair with his finger, and suddenly, an invisible force emerged, blocking the man’s sword and preventing him from continuing the thrust!
The red-robed man was shocked, feeling the invisible force released by Lin Yi. Alarmed, he quickly withdrew his sword and took a couple of steps back.
Lin Yi glanced indifferently at the red-robed man, ignored him, and turned around, walking away.
Seeing that Lin Yi was not targeting him anymore and did not pursue further, the red-robed man turned his gaze toward the black-robed man.
“Big brother, what do we do now? This youngster must be hiding some secrets; should we kill him?”
The black-robed man gave Lin Yi a cold glance and said, “No rush, I want to see exactly who this saint or deity he is.”
Then, he told the several red-robed men, “Okay, let’s go back.”
Lin Yi walked out of the Treasure Pavilion, looked back at it with a cold smirk, and then headed north of Qingzhou City.
Deep inside a massive cave in the mountains behind the Treasure Pavilion, an old man with white hair and covered in blood, sat cross-legged on a boulder—it was the Supreme Elder of the Heavenly Demon Sect, Heavenly Demon Ancestor.
“Lin Yi, I didn’t expect you to emerge from that world so quickly.”
Heavenly Demon Ancestor opened his eyes and muttered, “But, all of this, is no longer the same era as before.”
Heavenly Demon Ancestor leapt down from the boulder and walked to the edge, gazing toward the distant Qingzhou City.

chapters.title: Chapter 786 - 786 806 Bustling and Lively
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 786: Chapter 806 Bustling and Lively Chapter 786: Chapter 806 Bustling and Lively “This mission, our Heavenly Demon Sect must succeed!”
…
Lin Yi made his way towards Qingzhou City, and after a day’s journey, he finally arrived at its outskirts.
Qingzhou City, the capital of Qingyun Country, was a colossal city filled with a vast population and dense with martial experts.
Although Lin Yi was powerful, entering the Qingyun Imperial Palace would probably take some time.
So, Lin Yi decided to stay outside Qingzhou City for the time being, planning to find an inn to lodge in for a while.
Wandering around Qingzhou City, Lin Yi found it to be bustling and lively, with a constant flow of people. It was extremely lively.
After having lunch in a little tavern, Lin Yi stepped out of the establishment, ready to continue strolling through the streets when he suddenly sensed a powerful presence following him. He raised an eyebrow, lightly tapped his toes on a nearby large tree, and leaped up, soaring toward the direction from where the presence was emanating.
Soon, Lin Yi arrived at the riverside.
There, drifting in the river, was a beautifully painted pleasure boat. On the boat, a ravishing woman in a black gauzy dress was standing at the edge, her gaze fixed on the distant horizon, her face marked with worry and concern.
She was none other than the leader of the Heavenly Demon Sect, Murong Xue’er.
Seeing Murong Xue’er on the riverbank, Lin Yi’s brows knit together slightly; he tapped his foot lightly again, descending directly next to her.
Lin Yi stood behind Murong Xue’er, watching her silhouette intently and said, “Murong Xue’er, I didn’t expect to find you here too this time!”
“Hm?”
Hearing Lin Yi’s voice, Murong Xue’er’s body jerked in shock, and she turned around, her face a bit pale.
Seeing Murong Xue’er, a mischievous smile appeared on Lin Yi’s lips as he gazed at her, asking casually, “Murong Xue’er, it’s quite a fate that we’ve met again. A destined encounter across thousands of miles, indeed.”
“Hmph, a destined encounter across thousands of miles?”
A surge of anger rose in Murong Xue’er’s heart, her eyes narrowing as she spoke through gritted teeth, “This time, I was lucky to escape; otherwise, I would have surely died by your sword!”
Hearing her words, Lin Yi laughed heartily, “Then you should be grateful to me! If it weren’t for me, you might have long since been dead!”
Murong Xue’er, upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, revealed a bitter smile, “Lin Yi, it seems you also do not wish to stay in Qingyun Country anymore, right?”
Lin Yi didn’t confirm or deny, but simply smiled slightly, responding with a question, “What do you think?”
Seeing Lin Yi’s attitude, Murong Xue’er’s face also showed a bittersweet smile, “Since you do not wish to stay in Qingyun Country, I will not force you. We shall meet again in the future!”
Lin Yi nodded slightly, “We shall meet again!”
As his words fell, Lin Yi turned to leave.
“Wait, let me accompany you for a part of your journey.”
Murong Xue’er suddenly spoke up.
“Hm?”
Lin Yi halted, puzzled, and turned around, his gaze resting on Murong Xue’er.
“I have a favor to ask you, I want you to help me with something,” Murong Xue’er’s eyes shone with determination.
Lin Yi’s brow furrowed, asking with curiosity, “You don’t hate me, so why do you want to help me? Could it be that you’ve really fallen for me?”
“Pah! How could I possibly fall for a villain like you? Don’t be so full of yourself!” Murong Xue’er glared fiercely at Lin Yi, her pretty face blushing as she scolded.
“Then why do you want to help me?”
Lin Yi asked, puzzled.
“Because I need to find something, but with my Cultivation not yet restored, I simply cannot brave the Qingyun Imperial Palace alone. Hence, I must ask you to help me,” Murong Xue’er explained, her head lowered and her voice soft.
“What’s the matter?”
Lin Yi asked.
“I’d like you to help me look for information about my mother. I believe you can help me.”
Murong Xue’er looked up, her gaze intense as she stared at Lin Yi.
“Your mother? What’s her name?”
Lin Yi inquired.
Murong Xue’er shook her head, “I can’t say that, but I believe you can help me find her.”
Hearing Murong Xue’er’s words, Lin Yi pondered for a moment before answering, “Alright, then let’s head to Qingyun Imperial Capital’s palace now!”
“Mhm.”
Murong Xue’er responded with a nod and began to walk ahead.
Lin Yi watched Murong Xue’er’s graceful figure, a flicker in his eyes before he followed her pace.
The two walked for a while until they reached a desolate wilderness, eerily silent all around.
“Do you know where the Qingyun Imperial Capital’s palace is?”
Lin Yi asked Murong Xue’er.
“How would I know that? It’s thousands of miles away from here to the Qingyun Imperial Capital’s palace. We’ve been walking all morning and haven’t seen a single person,”
Murong Xue’er replied, shaking her head.
Lin Yi frowned, thinking to himself: “Could it be that this is where Murong Xue’er’s father’s mansion is located, and we’ve come to the wrong place?”
“Lin Yi, no matter what you’re thinking, I need you to take me there now!”
Murong Xue’er suddenly turned back to face Lin Yi.
“Oh, alright.”
Lin Yi nodded, took Murong Xue’er by the shoulders, and soared into the sky, heading towards the direction of the Qingyun Imperial Capital.
The Qingyun Imperial Capital is the largest capital in the Central Region on this continent and also the biggest power. The Royal House of the Qingyun Imperial Capital controls ninety-nine percent of the continent’s wealth, power, and status.
And the Qingyun Imperial Palace is right at the heart of the Qingyun Imperial Capital, towering tens of thousands of feet into the sky, resplendent and majestic.
This imposing and magnificent Golden Throne Hall is indeed the Qingyun Imperial Palace.
Lin Yi held Murong Xue’er as they hovered above the palace, overlooking the glittering structure.
This majestic and spectacular palace was the most grandiose and magnificent building Lin Yi had ever seen, its grounds spanning over two thousand kilometers.
The buildings within the palace were each exceedingly opulent and luxurious.
The palace was heavily guarded by a ring of troops, each guard displaying formidable Cultivation, at least at the Eighth Layer of the Divine Condensation Realm, and even a couple at the Ninth Level patrolling around.
Furthermore, inside the palace were many high-ranking Samurai, these elite warriors all of Martial King Rank with remarkable Combat Power.
“The Emperor of the Qingyun Empire resides within the palace, all within his expected control,”
Lin Yi reflected, surveying the palace grounds.
Then, Lin Yi shifted his gaze to the very center of the palace.
At the heart of the Qingyun Imperial Palace lay a massive plaza, above which stood an enormous dragon-shaped statue.
That was the Emperor of the Qing Yun Country, who boasts a Cultivation at the Peak of the Martial Sovereign Realm. In Qing Yun Country, he is considered a formidable power.
Within the Qingyun Empire, the status of the Imperial Family far exceeds that of the ordinary noble families, the lowest-ranking households among them towering far above the common houses.
This is the adulation of the powerful.
Moreover, the Qingyun Empire had a rule: all descendants of the Royal House must train within the palace, live there, and cannot leave the palace. Otherwise, they would face punishment.

chapters.title: Chapter 787 - 787 807 Mother is Missing
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 787: Chapter 807: Mother is Missing Chapter 787: Chapter 807: Mother is Missing In the backyard of this royal palace, there were many houses.
These houses were where the younger members of Qingyun Country’s royal family lived.
Lin Yi, carrying Murong Xue’er, weaved through the alleyways of the backyard and quickly, the two arrived in front of a house.
“Lin Yi, wait here for me, I’ll go inside and inform my father that my mother has disappeared. You must help me bring my mother back,” Murong Xue’er said and then pushed the door open to enter the house.
Lin Yi looked at the closed door and thought to himself, “It seems that Murong Xue’er really is in a hurry, otherwise she wouldn’t have forgotten even to announce her arrival.”
With that thought, Lin Yi didn’t stay long and turned to leave, heading towards the exit of the palace.
After walking a distance, Lin Yi realized that Murong Xue’er hadn’t come out from the palace yet and wondered, “Eh, why hasn’t she come out yet? Could she be lost?”
“No, I recall when I entered the palace just now, nobody stopped me. Perhaps she has run into some trouble?”
Lin Yi frowned, a bad premonition rising in his heart.
“Forget it, I’d better leave the Qingyun Empire for now to avoid more complicated issues arising.”
With that thought, Lin Yi’s figure shifted and he quickly moved forward.
Soon, Lin Yi arrived at the border of the Qingyun Empire.
“This place is the border, an area where the border defense forces are stationed. Normally, outsiders aren’t allowed here unless they are Qingyun Empire’s princes or princesses.”
“I am currently posing as a student from the Qingyun Academy. If I show the token my master gave me, I should be able to enter the Qingyun Academy.”
“But now the Qingyun Academy is sealed off and there are tens of thousands of soldiers. If I rashly enter, it might cause unnecessary trouble.”
Lin Yi frowned thoughtfully and was about to leave.
Suddenly, a cold voice reached Lin Yi’s ears, “Lin Yi, I didn’t expect to run into you here!”
Hearing this, Lin Yi turned his head and saw Murong Xue’er standing on a nearby tree branch, her beautiful eyes glaring at him with a venomous expression.
“So it’s Miss Murong. What brings you here to wait for me?”
Lin Yi raised an eyebrow and noticed three people beside Murong Xue’er, two men and one woman.
The two men were dressed in black and had a fierce aura; their rugged faces exuded a chilly air.
The woman wore a pink silk dress, her face as lovely as a peach blossom, and there was a hint of allure between her brows.
All three were Lin Yi’s foes!
“Nothing? Haha, I’ve been waiting here for you for half a month, and you think you can easily get by with just saying ‘nothing’?”
“Since you dared to kill the prince, I certainly won’t let you go. Your crimes have now been exposed, and with just one word from me, I could have you beheaded for all to see!”
Murong Xue’er said angrily.
“Oh? Is that so? My crimes have been exposed? Don’t tell me you didn’t know I killed a prince of the Qingyun Empire?”
Lin Yi asked with a smile.
“Of course I knew, but now I have evidence proving that you are indisputably linked to this matter, and I will have your entire family executed!”
Murong Xue’er spoke through gritted teeth.
Seeing Murong Xue’er’s manner, Lin Yi knew she must have learned some of his secrets, but she hadn’t yet told her father. Clearly, this was because she feared her father might sacrifice himself to save her.
“Oh? What is the evidence?”
Lin Yi asked with interest.
“Hmph! You don’t need to worry about what the evidence is. In any case, you killed my nephew Murong Hao; your crime cannot be concealed, so your life must end!”
Murong Xue’er declared fiercely.
Lin Yi’s eyes deepened as he heard Murong Xue’er’s words.
This matter couldn’t really be blamed on him.
Although Murong Hao was a prince of the Qingyun Empire, he was Murong Xue’er’s cousin.
Originally, at Qingyun Villa, when Murong Hao bullied Murong Xue’er, Lin Yi had come to her aid, but at that time, Murong Xue’er had not appreciated his intervention.
Later, Lin Yi was chased by Murong Hao and was forced to hide in a creek behind the mountains of Qingyun Villa. Eventually, Lin Yi accidentally entered an Ancient Tomb and obtained the “Xuanming Nine Transformations,” which enabled him to successfully cultivate.
When Lin Yi had saved Murong Xue’er initially, she had despised him deeply, and even later threatened Lin Yi, calling him a spy of the Qingyun Empire.
From the beginning, Lin Yi had thought that one day he must kill Murong Hao to avenge his tarnished reputation.
But he hadn’t expected this opportunity to arise so soon.
Thinking of this, Lin Yi’s lips curved into a sinister smirk, saying, “What do you think, if I kill you here, would the Emperor of the Qingyun Empire trouble me?”
“Ha ha ha ha…”
“You are really foolish, do you think you can kill me? If you kill me, you would bring great disaster upon yourself from the Qingyun Empire. You aren’t even qualified enough to make my father personally take action, let alone confront the Qingyun Empire’s army!”
“Moreover, we have been constantly monitoring your movements. Any slight irregularity, and I will have someone capture you immediately!”
Murong Xue’er said with a face full of smugness.
“Heh, so that’s how it is. I thought so, how could the Emperor of the Qingyun Empire, because of a prince of the Qingyun Empire, offend me? You are indeed too naive.”
Lin Yi shook his head and sighed, a look of disappointment on his face.
Seeing this, Murong Xue’er scoffed dismissively, “What, my father’s power is that extensive? Not even he dares to offend you, let alone a minor prince like you!”
“Alright, let’s just leave it at that.”
Lin Yi waved his hand dismissively.
“I warn you, you’d better stay quietly in your residence in the coming days; do not wander around, or you will be responsible for the consequences!”
“And I advise you to summon my father soon, otherwise, once I expose your crimes, I assure you that your end will be unsightly!”
Murong Xue’er glared fiercely at Lin Yi, her tone filled with threats.
Hearing this, Lin Yi chuckled lightly and shook his head, “I am now your imperial brother, do you think you can do anything to me?”
As Lin Yi spoke, his figure flashed, instantly appearing beside Murong Xue’er.
“You! What, what are you doing?”
Seeing Lin Yi suddenly approaching her, Murong Xue’er instantly panicked and hurriedly backed away, her face filled with fright.
As she spoke, she continued to move backward.
Murong Xue’er had originally wanted to scare Lin Yi, hoping he would back off.
However, Lin Yi was not intimidated and suddenly grabbed Murong Xue’er’s jade arm, pulling her fiercely into his embrace, and then he lowered his head and kissed Murong Xue’er’s beautiful and lush lips.
“Mm!”
Murong Xue’er was stunned, not expecting Lin Yi to dare do such a thing.
Thinking of being kissed forcefully by a man, Murong Xue’er instantly felt a mixture of shame and anger, struggling hard.
Lin Yi, feeling Murong Xue’er’s struggles, intensified his assault on her tender lips.
Murong Xue’er was unable to resist Lin Yi’s onslaught and soon sank into a state of surrender.
After a long while.
Lin Yi released Murong Xue’er’s lips, smiling and said, “Xue’er, little sister, you just took advantage of me. How do you propose to compensate for my loss?”

chapters.title: Chapter 788 - 788 808 You are Shameless
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 788: Chapter 808 You are Shameless Chapter 788: Chapter 808 You are Shameless “You, you’re shameless!”
Murong Xue’er’s face turned beet red as she heard Lin Yi’s words. She glared at him, teeth clenched with anger, and denounced him.
“Ha ha ha!”
“So what if I am shameless? I could even be more shameless, like…”
Lin Yi chuckled slyly, his gaze lingering with ill intentions on Murong Xue’er’s chest.
“Like…”
“Like I could eat you up.”
“But then again, I am rather pitying and cherish the fairer sex. I wouldn’t take advantage of someone in danger. We can save this matter for later when we go back and enjoy it slowly, don’t you think, little sister Xue’er!”
Lin Yi said cheerily, his eyes continually roving over Murong Xue’er’s chest as if searching for a tempting delicacy.
“Rogue!”
“Scoundrel!”
Murong Xue’er trembled with anger, cursing through gritted teeth.
“My, my, how am I a rogue?”
“If you call me a scoundrel, then surely there are no good men left in this world?”
“I’m only interested in beautiful girls!”
“After all, how can you blame me? If anyone is to blame, it’s only because you’re too beautiful and I couldn’t help but admire you.”
“Who can blame you for being so beautiful, and me for liking beauties? I can’t help it!”
Lin Yi shook his head with a look of distress.
Hearing these words, Murong Xue’er’s cheeks turned even redder, wishing she could find a crack in the ground to crawl into.
This damned jerk, truly a vile rogue!
The more Murong Xue’er thought, the more indignant she felt, and she began to tear up.
Seeing this, Lin Yi quickly asked, “Oh, little sister, why are you crying? I didn’t mean to bully you; it’s just that seeing someone as beautiful as you, I couldn’t contain my impulses.”
“Besides, I am always sympathetic and cherish the fairer sex. I never harm the innocent.”
Lin Yi pretended to have a very understanding expression as he continued.
Hearing this, Murong Xue’er got even angrier, wishing she could bite him twice to vent her anger.
“Hmph, are you mocking me for being ugly?”
“But it’s no surprise; your taste in beauty isn’t the same as others’. After all, someone like you should only appreciate beautiful things!”
Murong Xue’er said through gritted teeth, her cute face filled with intense hatred.
“I say, why are you so unreasonable!”
Lin Yi rolled his eyes, his face full of helplessness.
“Hmph, I don’t care; I can’t face you now; I’m leaving. Tonight, I will come to find you, hoping that you’ll stand by what you said earlier.”
Murong Xue’er glared at Lin Yi and harshly dropped these words before running off, ignoring whatever Lin Yi was shouting behind her.
Watching Murong Xue’er’s retreating figure, Lin Yi felt depressed.
This girl is so stubborn, completely heedless.
But maybe it’s for the best. Since she’s bound to come looking for me eventually, better to hide now than be caught up later when it’d truly be troublesome.
Thinking this, Lin Yi made a firm decision in his mind never to provoke Murong Xue’er again.
This little miss is way too tricky.
Lin Yi shook his head, sighed, and left.
After leaving Lin Yi’s room, Murong Xue’er returned to her own room, locked the door, and then threw herself on the bed and began to sob heavily.
Murong Xue’er really liked Lin Yi, even to the point of madness.
Although Murong Xue’er’s father did not approve of the two children dating, she still persisted in her beliefs.
No matter what others thought or said, she always adhered to her principles and never gave up!
“Lin Yi, I just can’t let go easily!”
“Even if it kills me, I won’t let go!”
Murong Xue’er bit her lip, her eyes becoming more determined.
“I need you to know that I, Murong Xue’er, am not a woman to be trifled with!”
“I have my pride too!”
“Since you chose her to be your fiancée, I, Murong Xue’er, absolutely refuse to allow it!”
“No matter what, I must get you back!”
Murong Xue’er bit her lip, her gaze growing even more resolute.
Murong Xue’er didn’t know that, the moment she left, a dark shadow appeared in her room, and this shadow stood by the windowsill, silently watching Lin Yi’s room.
He watched Murong Xue’er leave, his brow slightly furrowed, his eyes flickering.
“It seems Xue’er really has fallen for that boy Lin Yi, it looks like stopping her from dating that boy will be difficult.”
“It seems I need to find the right moment to have a chat with Xue’er!”
The man in black sighed as he watched Murong Xue’er leave, then disappeared into the night.
“Hey, Xue’er, where have you been? I’ve been waiting for you for ages and haven’t seen you!”
Lin Yi sat at the dining table, legs crossed, enjoying the delicious dishes in his bowl with a contented expression.
“I don’t need to report to you where I go, and I’m not telling you where I’m going now!”
“Hmph, don’t give me that, let me tell you, no matter what, I’m not agreeing to it!”
Murong Xue’er snorted coldly, speaking bluntly.
“I wasn’t really asking for your agreement, I just wanted to ask.”
Lin Yi shrugged his shoulders, speaking indifferently.
“Go ahead and ask!”
“Well then, if you really want to date Lin Yi, what sort of price would you have to pay?”
Lin Yi looked at Murong Xue’er, his demeanor nonchalant as he asked.
“That’s none of your business, it’s my affair, I don’t need to report to you. Besides, to think that you can make me pay a price, that’s simply wishful thinking.”
“I’ll tell you, don’t even think about trying to control me!”
Murong Xue’er glared at Lin Yi fiercely, her tone icy and threatening.
What she hated the most was his carefree attitude, as if the whole world revolved around him, which really annoyed her, especially since she was already in a terrible mood, holding back frustration that she had nowhere to vent. Now encountering Lin Yi, he became a perfect target for her anger.
Seeing this, Lin Yi felt helpless, this girl really was difficult to handle.
“Fine, if you don’t want to talk, I won’t ask.”
“Hurry up and eat, I have things to do later and I don’t want you delaying my time!”
After saying this, Lin Yi couldn’t be bothered dealing with Murong Xue’er and began eating on his own.
