At the start of his meal, Murong Xue’er stared at him, seeing how happily he ate, looking so pleased with himself, she almost wanted to slap him away and enjoy the food herself, but considering she was a lady and didn’t want to seem like a shrew, she could only watch Lin Yi eat by himself.
Murong Xue’er felt a pang of jealousy, not content in her heart, and secretly swore that she would find an opportunity to show Lin Yi her strength one day.
Lin Yi, seeing the look on Murong Xue’er’s face, found it quite amusing. This little girl really was a little vinegar pot.
“By the way, Xue’er, I wanted to ask you, do you have a brother named Lin Feng whose cultivation is higher than yours?”
Murong Xue’er, upon hearing Lin Yi’s question, was initially startled, then her expression turned somewhat unnatural.

chapters.title: Chapter 789 - 789 809 Good Relationship
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 789: Chapter 809: Good Relationship Chapter 789: Chapter 809: Good Relationship “Lin Yi, brother, why are you asking these questions?”
“You’re not asking because you’re jealous of my good relationship with that guy, thinking of pursuing him, and thus intentionally causing me trouble, are you? Don’t worry, I will definitely persuade him to leave, so you don’t have to worry.”
Upon hearing Murong Xue’er’s words, Lin Yi couldn’t help but shake his head helplessly before speaking up, “That’s not my intention at all.”
“It’s just that I’ve heard, my fiancée Murong Xue’er and my cousin Lin Feng are first cousins.”
“I’m a bit confused about this relationship!”
Lin Yi spoke calmly, although he was somewhat puzzled, he didn’t voice his thoughts.
“You don’t need to worry about what kind of relationship he and I have; in any case, I definitely won’t let you pursue him.”
“We are just cousins by a coincidence, don’t get any weird ideas!”
Murong Xue’er, after hearing Lin Yi’s words, instantly showed a flash of panic on her face and hurriedly explained, then a hint of embarrassment passed over her face as she lowered her head and continued eating.
Murong Xue’er had not anticipated that Lin Yi would actually know her identity. Could it be that Lin Yi was also a member of the Murong Family?
“Hehe, since that’s the case, you should eat quickly before the food gets cold and doesn’t taste as good!”
“Mm, you better eat up too.”
“By the way, Xue’er, where shall we go to have fun today?”
Lin Yi looked at Murong Xue’er, who had eaten her fill, and asked with a smile.
“I won’t be playing with you today; I have things to do!”
“Tonight, I’m going to stay at my father’s place. You know my father is my dear uncle, and he has spoiled and doted on me since I was a child. I want to learn something from him, so you better not come and disturb me!”
Murong Xue’er finished speaking and, without waiting for Lin Yi to reply, hurriedly ran off, apparently to get ready.
Lin Yi watched Murong Xue’er’s retreating figure and couldn’t help but smile.
“Hehe, interesting, truly interesting. I’d like to see what sort of skills you, the genius miss of the Murong Clan, have to compete with me. I’ll be watching!”
A sly smile crossed Lin Yi’s face.
“Ouch, Xue’er, you have to help me with this!”
“I certainly don’t want to be bullied by those people in the family!”
“Otherwise, I’ll really be in for it!”
Lin Yi touched his nose and said in distress.
“Hmph, who asked you to bully me?”
“Who told you not to give me my birthday gift?”
“Now that I have my birthday gift, I’ll see if you dare to bully me again!”
Murong Xue’er hummed with much self-satisfaction, looking at Lin Yi’s back with an air of triumph as if she had the winning hand, not taking Lin Yi seriously at all.
Murong Xue’er hurried all the way back to her family home and went straight to her father’s residence.
At this moment, the patriarch of the Murong Family, Murong Hong, and several family heads were discussing something. Upon seeing Murong Xue’er return, they immediately stopped talking and stood up, looking at her.
“Xue’er, you’re back?”
“Did the mission go smoothly?”
Murong Xue’er’s parents immediately approached their daughter, holding her hands on either side with affectionate smiles, and asked her.
“It went rather smoothly, I’ve completed the task, and here are my report cards!”
Murong Xue’er handed a stack of thick test papers to her parents and then put away the papers.
Murong Hong took one look and couldn’t help but frown slightly, looking at Murong Xue’er with a puzzled expression, “Xue’er, are these all your scores? Why are they only a little over fifty points? Have your scores dropped too much?”
“No way, how could your grades drop this much?”
“I remember your scores were really impressive a year ago, where have you been this past year?”
Murong Hong looked at Murong Xue’er, questioning incredulously.
“Dad, wouldn’t you know by looking at it?”
Murong Xue’er handed the examination paper to Murong Hong.
“This…”
“This…”
Murong Hong, seeing the score on this examination paper, had an even more astonished look on his face.
“Xue’er, what… what’s going on here? Could it be that you failed?”
Murong Hong looked at Murong Xue’er with a worried expression.
Upon hearing Murong Hong’s words, Murong Xue’er pouted and muttered, “Dad, how can you doubt my character like this? I’m your precious daughter, don’t you believe in my abilities?”
“Hmph, let me tell you, I’ve got a good score of over one hundred sixty. If I hadn’t passed, how could I be eligible to enter Tianshan Academy?”
“Besides, the score written on this examination paper is enough for me to get into Tianshan Academy!”
Murong Xue’er was full of pride, arrogantly lifting her head and boasting to her father, feeling extremely pleased with herself.
“So that’s it, I was wondering how there could only be a little over fifty points on this paper!”
“You must have cheated, daring to cheat right in front of your dad, that’s going too far!”
Murong Hong exclaimed, his face suddenly showing a look of furious rage, and then he roared loudly.
“You… what did you say? I cheated? Haha, that’s a laugh. Why would I need to cheat? Is it because I’m a member of the Murong Family?”
“You waste, do I even need to cheat? If I had a waste like you, I’d rather be dead!”
Murong Xue’er was instantly furious upon hearing this, she slammed the table, glaring angrily at her father and yelled loudly.
“You… you dare to swear at your dad, you ungrateful girl, you’re totally lawless!”
“I’ll beat you to death, you ungrateful girl. How can you talk to your father like that? You disrespectful brat, watch me break your legs today!”
Murong Hong, upon hearing what Murong Xue’er said about him, was instantly livid, cursing while charging at Murong Xue’er.
Seeing her father charge at her, Murong Xue’er screamed in fright.
“Help, dad’s beating someone, help…”
“Quick, help!”
Upon hearing her, Murong Hong became even more enraged, his face dark with anger as he glared at his disappointing daughter, grabbed Murong Xue’er’s collar with one hand, and caught her, slapping her face fiercely.
“Slap!”
“Wah!”
“Dad!”
Murong Xue’er never expected her father would actually hit her and instantly burst into tears.
“I also want to ask you why you would sully yourself like this. You actually dare to insult your own father, are you trying to be rebellious?”
Murong Hong said, gripping Murong Xue’er’s shoulder tightly and tossing her to the ground.
“How can you do this, I… I didn’t do it on purpose!”
Murong Xue’er cried out while getting up, looking at her father with aggrieved eyes and shouted defiantly.
Hearing Murong Xue’er’s words, Murong Hong grew even more furious, pointing at Murong Xue’er and yelled loudly, “Not on purpose? Then why did you just admit to cheating, and accuse me of cheating too, you think you’re in the right now?”

chapters.title: Chapter 790 - 790 810 More and More Unruly
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 790: Chapter 810: More and More Unruly Chapter 790: Chapter 810: More and More Unruly “Well, well, Murong Xue’er, you really are becoming more and more unruly, daring to falsely accuse your own father. Today I must discipline you, you wild girl, and let you know that your dad is not someone to be trificked with!”
Murong Hong said, about to hit Murong Xue’er, but he was stopped by Murong Xue’er’s father.
“Xue’er, how can you say such things in front of your father?”
“Do you realize that such behavior is undutiful?”
“You are my daughter, Murong Hong’s daughter, and you must understand the importance of filial piety. If you can’t respect your father, I will never agree to let you enter the Tianshan Academy!”
Murong Hong glared at Murong Xue’er with eyes wide open, speaking word by word, his gaze fixed on her.
“What?”
“No way, I must stop you!”
Murong Hong looked at his son, his face suddenly showing anxiety.
“Dad, what are you trying to stop me from? Are you really planning to let me enter the Tianshan Academy?”
Murong Xue’er felt frustrated when she heard her father’s words, thinking how stubborn he was, insisting on her attending Tianshan Academy—truly unbelievable.
“Yes, now that you’ve passed the exam, I want you to enter Tianshan Academy.”
“You said you scored a hundred percent, didn’t you? Fine, I’ll let you take the assessment. If you can score more than fifty percent, I’ll agree to let you enter Tianshan Academy. But if you can’t even score fifty percent, then don’t blame me for driving you out of the family!”
Murong Hong spoke sternly; he certainly did not want Murong Xue’er to get into Tianshan Academy, as it was his biggest adversary.
“What? Dad, you’re totally out of line, you’re insulting my intelligence!”
“You’re actually asking me to score fifty percent? Even if I tried my hardest, I couldn’t score that!”
Murong Xue’er was dumbfounded when she heard that Murong Hong was requiring her to score fifty percent.
Her father was being too much!
She was his daughter, and to think he was making her aim for fifty percent just to take a test at the academy—wasn’t that an insult to her intelligence?
Instantly, Murong Xue’er felt her father was detestable, truly hateful.
“Hmph, you are my daughter, don’t I know your character? You like taking exams, right? Fine, I’ll let you take one this time. If you don’t score fifty percent, you are never to set foot in the Murong family ever again!”
Murong Hong looked at Murong Xue’er coldly as he spoke, his tone threatening.
After finishing, Murong Hong turned and left.
“Dad, are you trying to drive me away? I’m staying right here!”
When Murong Xue’er saw Murong Hong leaving, she stamped her foot and shouted at his retreating figure. She couldn’t afford to lose the rights of the Murong family; she needed their wealth.
“Hmph!”
Murong Hong stopped, turned his head back, and snorted coldly at Murong Xue’er, then left the room.
“I’m not going, I’m staying right here, and you’ll never get rid of me!”
Murong Xue’er watched her father’s departing figure and spoke angrily.
Murong Hong paid no attention to Murong Xue’er and turned away, leaving her boudoir.
“Ouch!”
Suddenly, Murong Xue’er squatted on the ground, holding her stomach.
“Damn, what’s going on? I’ve been eating too much these past days, got diarrhea—might really die from it this time?”
Murong Xue’er squatted on the ground, moaning in pain, thinking to herself.
She was currently suffering from bad gastrointestinal issues, the diarrhea was severe, and she was barely holding on.
But to avoid her father noticing, she had to endure the discomfort she felt in her body, clench her teeth and stay upright, refusing to fall down.
“Xue’er, what’s wrong?”
Murong Hong was busy handling official matters in the room when he heard a commotion outside. He immediately rushed out and was shocked to see Murong Xue’er squatting on the ground.
“I’m fine, just a little stomach discomfort!”
Murong Xue’er gritted her teeth and stood up, glanced at her father, and said softly. However, her complexion was exceptionally pale, and a trace of sweat was breaking out on her forehead.
“Xue’er, what’s wrong with you? Your face looks so awful!”
Upon seeing this, Murong Hong furrowed his brows, walked up to Murong Xue’er , and asked with concern, worry flashing in his eyes.
“It’s nothing, just ate too much and got diarrhea!”
Murong Xue’er braced herself, barely squeezing out a smile, and spoke to her father.
“Eat too much? I think you won’t shed tears until you see the coffin!”
“Now you come with me to the clinic!”
Murong Hong, hearing Murong Xue’er say she had diarrhea, immediately shouted in anger and reached out to help her.
“No need, I really am fine, don’t worry!”
Murong Xue’er, upon hearing her father’s scolding, suddenly became stubborn. She didn’t want her father to interfere.
“How can you say it’s nothing? You’re clearly sick. Hurry up and come with me to the clinic, or forget about entering Tianshan Academy!”
“Hmph, I simply won’t go!”
“Dad, don’t bully me. If you really want me to go to the clinic, then you also need to go to the clinic yourself!”
Murong Xue’er’s face turned red all of a sudden as she heard Murong Hong say she was sick. She retorted, defiance flashing in her eyes.
“Alright, alright, alright, it seems you really want to force me to take action. Well, then just wait to be taken to the clinic!”
Murong Hong, seeing that Murong Xue’er was still adamantly refusing to go to the clinic, became infuriated.
He had not wanted to lay a hand on Murong Xue’er, but seeing her so stubborn and unwilling to go to the clinic, he felt he had no choice but to take action.
“Someone, come here!”
Murong Hong shouted loudly towards the door.
“Father, what are your orders?”
Four male servants immediately rushed in and bowed respectfully to Murong Hong.
“Take Xue’er to the clinic for treatment!”
Murong Hong coldly scanned the four male servants and commanded them.
“Yes, young master!”
The four male servants said respectfully and then approached Murong Xue’er, extending their hands to grab her.
“Wait, what are you doing?”
“Xue’er, go and rest first. Daddy will come to find you.”
Murong Hong, seeing his daughter about to be bullied by the four male servants, immediately shouted out; he was not willing to let his daughter be bullied by his underlings.
“Daddy, I won’t go to the clinic. I want to stay here. No matter what you do, I won’t go to the clinic!”
“Do you want to lock me up here?”
Murong Xue’er, hearing her father intended to confine her within the Murong Residence, spoke furiously. She didn’t want to go to the clinic; she wanted to stay here.
“You, you’re really infuriating me to death!”
Murong Hong trembled with anger, having never seen his daughter be so stubborn.

chapters.title: Chapter 791 - 791 811 Not Going to the Medical Hall
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 791: Chapter 811: Not Going to the Medical Hall Chapter 791: Chapter 811: Not Going to the Medical Hall “What are you still gawking at? Hurry up and take Xue’er away!”
Murong Hong looked at his four subordinates and bellowed furiously.
“Father, I said, I won’t go to the medical hall. If you really want to force me, then you might as well just kill me. Since my illness hasn’t been cured all this time, waiting another day or two won’t make a difference!”
“I won’t let you threaten me with my own life. Do what you will—kill or carve—as I absolutely refuse to go to the medical hall!”
Xue’er shouted at her father, her voice laced with a crying tone, clearly struggling to endure her agony.
“You…sigh! You, girl, are driving me mad!”
“I really did not raise such a stubborn daughter!”
Upon hearing Xue’er’s words, Murong Hong shook his head helplessly, yet a cunning smile curled at the corner of his mouth. He knew that Xue’er dared not defy his wishes.
“Since you’re so persistent, then it’s out of your hands! Just stay at home!”
“Anyway, I’ll arrange for your matchmaking. Then I’ll see how you can escape!”
Murong Hong looked at Xue’er, snorted coldly, and said to her before turning to leave.
“Father, wait!”
Xue’er’s complexion turned ashen after hearing Murong Hong’s words. She wanted to stop her father, but it was already too late.
For Murong Hong had already walked out the door.
“My lord, what should we do?”
“Yes, my lord, if things continue like this, I fear our family’s finances will be exhausted. If we exhaust these funds, I fear our family will struggle to survive this crisis!”
“Yes, my lord, why not let Young Master Murong try? Although he’s young, his talent in cultivation is high, and he will surely help us survive this difficulty!”
Just as Murong Hong stepped out of the door, two maidservants hurriedly made suggestions to Murong Hong.
“What do you know? Murong Hong will not agree. Besides, do you think Xue’er is qualified to go to the medical hall?”
“Humph, just based on her? Our family’s pride, the daughter of Murong Hong, is not comparable to ordinary girls!”
“Even if she were to follow the disciples of those major powers, she would have to be their match!”
“Xue’er is absolutely no match for them!”
Hearing the two maidservants’ words, Murong Hong immediately glared at them displeasedly.
“What are you saying? Why wouldn’t Xue’er be a match for them?”
“Xue’er is a rare genius! She has great aptitude and, moreover, is stunningly beautiful. How can you belittle her?”
“Xue’er, let’s go, don’t bother with these servants!”
“Hmph!”
After hearing Xue’er’s words, Murong Hong snorted coldly, his expression extremely somber, and he turned and departed.
Murong Hong sped off to the head of the Murong Family’s courtyard, commanding the several guards inside: “Keep a close watch on Xue’er for me; don’t let her run off. If she does, you can all get lost!”
“Understood, sir!”
The five guards, upon hearing Murong Hong’s words, immediately bowed respectfully in response.
“Mm, go on then!”
“And I want you to have someone follow Xue’er in secret. If there’s any movement, report it to me immediately, got it?”
The guard nodded satisfyingly at the subordinate’s words and added another strict instruction.
“Don’t worry, my lord, I assure you we’ll keep a tight watch on the Miss!”
“Yes, sir!”
The five guards, receiving Murong Hong’s orders, responded in unison and then dispersed to attend to their duties.
Watching the five guards depart, a smug smirk crossed Murong Hong’s eyes. He loved to see Xue’er deflated—seeing her like that always put him in a particularly good mood.
“Murong Xue’er, just stay obediently at home!”
“I won’t let anyone insult you; just wait to marry my son!”
Murong Hong chuckled smugly to himself before he walked away to another place.
“Quickly go and see how the second Miss is doing!”
“I’m worried the master might have hit her!”
“The second Miss’s body is already weak. If she gets injured by the master, she may never be able to practice cultivation again!”
“The master really shouldn’t lay hands on the Miss!”

chapters.title: Chapter 792 - 792 812 Doubt
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 792: Chapter 812: Doubt Chapter 792: Chapter 812: Doubt “Master in this state, how will the young lady manage in the future?”
“Let’s go check on Miss soon!”
All the maids at the Murong Residence gathered around, chattering incessantly.
“Xue’er, get up quickly, today you are attending the banquet with father!”
Murong Hong had just stepped out of the room when he encountered Murong Xue’er, who was coming out of her room. He spoke to her affectionately.
“I won’t go, you go by yourself!”
Upon hearing Murong Hong’s words, Murong Xue’er immediately rolled her eyes and pouted, her tone full of reluctance.
“Xue’er, why are you so willful? You are the most beautiful, most outstanding girl in our Murong Residence. Whoever marries you will be blessed for eight lifetimes. How can you not cherish this?”
“Just obediently go to the banquet with father!”
“Otherwise, father will have no choice but to send you to the villa to learn martial arts.”
“What? You dare? You want to send me away?”
After hearing Murong Hong’s words, Murong Xue’er asked in surprise, her tone filled with unwillingness, yet her face showed fear.
“This is for your own good!”
“I don’t care, you can’t send me away!”
“Father, aren’t you afraid that Xue’er might be abducted by someone, or even killed by someone?”
“Father, let me stay in the mansion, okay? Just take back what you just said, I promise I won’t cause trouble anymore!”
After hearing Murong Hong’s words, Murong Xue’er immediately acted coquettishly, hugging Murong Hong’s arm with a pitiful look, begging for mercy.
“Humph, now you know fear, what did you do earlier? What did you do earlier? If you had listened to father, you would have gone to the banquet with us!”
Murong Hong snorted coldly, disdainfully speaking as his face was filled with anger, yet his eyes were full of indulgence towards Murong Xue’er, as if he would throw away his treasure and give his whole heart to his beloved daughter.
“Oh, I was wrong, I won’t cause trouble anymore, okay?”
“I promise! I will never cause trouble again, just let Xue’er stay by your side!”
“I really don’t want to go to any banquet, Xue’er really doesn’t like it, that banquet’s environment is too lousy!”
“Then which kind of event do you like, father will take you, you can choose any banquet you want!”
“No, I’ve already decided, father, don’t force me!”
Murong Xue’er immediately shook her head in refusal after hearing Murong Hong’s words.
“Oh, my precious daughter, this too is for your good!”
“I am doing this for your good, how can you refuse me?”
Murong Hong looked at his precious daughter with a bitter smile.
“You are doing this for my good? Then I needn’t marry into the Lin Family!”
“This is my only choice, apart from the Lin Family, I don’t want to have any connections with other men!”
Murong Xue’er spoke stubbornly.
“Alright, alright, if you are unwilling, father won’t force you, but you must promise father that if you marry someone else in the future, you must not lightly leave your home, otherwise, father will be angry!”
“I know, I will be careful in the future!”
“Then let’s set off!”
“Okay!”
“Father, wait, I still have a few words to say!”
“Father, I want to visit mother, may I?”
“This…”
After hesitating for a moment, Murong Hong nodded and said, “Alright!”
“Father, you are the best!”
“Let’s hurry!”
“Okay!”
Upon hearing Murong Hong’s agreement, Murong Xue’er immediately jumped around happily like a lively rabbit.
“Xue’er, slow down, don’t fall!”
“It’s okay, Xue’er is a level-one warrior, much faster than ordinary people, I won’t fall!”
“Alright, let’s hurry!”
“Father, wait a moment!”
“Father, Xue’er will wash up first!”
Murong Xue’er suddenly stopped and said to Murong Hong.
“Alright!”
“Wait a moment!”
“What are you doing?”
Watching Murong Xue’er’s movements, Murong Hong asked in confusion.
“I want to change into a different outfit and put on some light makeup to look good for the banquet!”
“Just wear this outfit, it’s nice!”
“But Xue’er wants to put on some light makeup, otherwise, I’ll be laughed at at the banquet!”

chapters.title: Chapter 793 - 793 813 Whats the Origin
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 793: Chapter 813: What’s the Origin Chapter 793: Chapter 813: What’s the Origin “You are my precious little girl, you don’t have to care about what others think. Even if others laugh at you, I will still marry you and take you home as my wife!”
“But this is a matter of my lifetime after all. I must get dressed up. If those people laugh at me, Xue’er will lose face!”
Murong Xue’er pouted as she spoke.
“Alright then, you hurry up and wash up. I’ll send two maids in to help you right away!”
“Ok!”
Seeing this, Murong Hong could only agree.
“Then I’ll leave now!”
“Mm!”
Murong Hong nodded and said.
“You go ahead!”
“Goodbye, Xue’er!”
“Daddy, goodbye!”
Murong Xue’er, waving her delicate little hands, bid farewell to Murong Hong.
“Daddy, goodbye!”
Murong Hong smiled at Murong Xue’er and then turned to leave.
…
A month later.
Murong Xue’er was wearing a light-yellow silk dress embroidered with gold thread and draped in a white fox fur cloak. She wore jewelry that appeared very precious and luxurious.
“Young Miss really is beautiful, worthy of being the one Young Master has set his heart on!”
The maid by her side couldn’t help but praise Murong Xue’er for dressing up so beautifully.
“Of course, I am Daddy’s precious daughter. Naturally, I can’t embarrass Daddy!”
Upon hearing her maid’s words, Murong Xue’er proudly lifted her head.
“Of course!”
“Not only is the Young Miss beautiful, but she is also smart and clever!”
“Miss is truly fortunate!”
The maid responded with a smile.
“That’s right!”
“However, what the hell was Lin Yi thinking? To actually want to break off our engagement. Does he truly not like me and wish to find another woman?”
“Damn it!”
“Hmph, if it’s really like that, I’d rather ruin my own life than marry Lin Yi!”
Murong Xue’er said through gritted teeth.
“Miss, don’t be angry. Lin Yi, that prodigal son, simply isn’t worthy of you. The reason he wants to break off the engagement must be because he’s too heartbroken from your rejection!”
“We’ll try to persuade him again. As long as you are willing to forgive him, he will surely come to apologize to you again, and he will be obedient to you in the future, never allowing you to suffer the slightest grievance!”
“Then I’m counting on you, Xue’er. I hope that by saying this, you can take it to heart!”
“Don’t worry, leave this matter to me!”
“I will definitely teach Lin Yi, that bastard, a harsh lesson, then make him realize how formidable I am. When the time comes, I definitely will not marry him!”
Murong Xue’er said indignantly.
“Rest assured, Miss. I will not let you down and will make sure everything is handled perfectly!”
“You can rest easy, Miss Xue’er!”
Upon hearing this, Murong Xue’er nodded with a smile.
“Mm, with you by my side, I feel at ease!”
“Miss Xue’er, you are really beautiful. Believe in yourself!”
The maid looked at Murong Xue’er with an ingratiating expression and flattered her cheerfully.
“Thank you for your praise, I dare not accept such an honor!”
Murong Xue’er humbly said.
“Miss Xue’er, you are too modest. Without you saving my life, who knows how many times I would have died; how could I even hope for your praise?”
“What you’re saying is too kind. Xue’er just happened to be there, you don’t need to take it to heart!”
“Alright, let’s go!”
“I will see you out of the residence!”
The maid said and then led Murong Xue’er away.
“Let’s go!”
“Miss Xue’er, please follow me!”
“Miss Xue’er, this way please!”
The maid led the way, and Murong Xue’er was taken to the city gate.
“Miss, after you!”
“Mm!”
Murong Xue’er nodded with a smile and walked towards the city.
“Wow!”
Just as Murong Xue’er walked through the city gate, she suddenly caught sight of a black luxury carriage outside the gate and her eyes lit up.
“What a beautiful carriage!”
Murong Xue’er exclaimed, looking at the black carriage at the city gate in surprise.
The carriage was incomparable in magnificence and very meticulously adorned, even the horses were purebred treasures, tall and majestic in form.
“Whose carriage is this, so beautiful?”
Murong Xue’er murmured in amazement to herself.
Murong Xue’er had never seen such a beautiful carriage, nor such a luxurious one. It was even more extravagant than the royal carriages!
Moreover, the carriage was extremely spacious; sitting inside felt like being in a palace on wheels.
Whose carriage could this be?
Why is it so magnificent?
“Miss, why have you stopped? Why are you standing still?”
Seeing Murong Xue’er standing in front of the carriage, motionless, the maid couldn’t help but ask.
“Uh, I… I was just admiring the beautiful carriage!”
Murong Xue’er blushed shyly as she spoke.
This was her first time ever to ride in such a beautiful carriage, and it was an exceedingly luxurious one at that.
“Hehe, it’s pretty, isn’t it? This carriage belongs to Lin Yi!”
“Lin Yi is the talk of Tianxiang Country, known as one of the four young noblemen of the capital!”
“Moreover, despite his youth, he has already reached the Martial Master Realm and will definitely be able to cultivate to the Martial Venerable Realm in the future. Miss, you’re really lucky to have such an outstanding man as your future husband!”
The maid said.
“Oh, is that so?”
“Then I must cherish this opportunity. If I could marry such an ideal man, it would be worth it even if I died!”
Murong Xue’er responded cheerfully after listening to the maid.
“By the way, what’s the identity of the owner of this carriage? How can he be so wealthy?”
“Such a magnificent and luxurious carriage, and to have such maids at his side!”
“What is Lin Yi’s background exactly?”
Murong Xue’er asked curiously.

chapters.title: Chapter 794 - 794 814 Employment Relationship
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 794: Chapter 814 Employment Relationship Chapter 794: Chapter 814 Employment Relationship “Hehe, Miss Xue’er, there’s no need to ask any further; you won’t be meeting the owner of this carriage anyway!”
“Moreover, I’m not entitled to know anything about him!”
“He is my employer, but there is no other relationship between us, just an employment relationship!”
“He hired me to accompany him for a while!”
The maid said with a smile.
“An employment relationship, an employment relationship, huh?”
“So it’s just an employment relationship between them!”
Enlightened by this revelation, Murong Xue’er immediately felt relieved.
“Yes, it’s merely an employment relationship between them!”
“So don’t get any wild ideas!”
Murong Xue’er nodded, then addressed the maid.
“Okay, Miss Xue’er!”
The maid responded respectfully.
Murong Xue’er nodded again and then stepped onto the bustling streets.
“Please take your time browsing, Miss Xue’er!”
“If there’s anything you need, just give an order, and this servant will immediately attend to it!”
“By the way, we have several pieces of jewelry that are selling quite well; if you’re interested, you might want to take a look!”
The maid pointed towards a line of products and introduced them to Murong Xue’er with a smile.
“Oh, is that so?”
Murong Xue’er’s eyes lit up, and then she looked at the merchandise.
The place was laid out with various pieces of jewelry—gleaming, multitudinous, and absolutely dazzling.
These items all looked extremely delicate, making it hard to take one’s eyes off them.
Although these items were not very expensive, they were pretty decent.
And the prices weren’t too high—the lowest was just one Purple Crystal Coin!
“This one, this one, this one, as well as this one, and this one… wrap them all up for me!”
Murong Xue’er pointed at the jewelry and told the maid.
“Yes, Miss Xue’er!”
“Miss, please wait a moment; this servant will wrap them up for you right away!”
“Mhm!”
The maid nodded, and then began packing the jewelry.
“Alright!”
“Miss, all the jewelry is purchased!”
After packing all the jewelry, the maid respectfully said to Murong Xue’er.
“Mhm, okay!”
“Let’s go now!”
“Yes, alright!”
The maid answered, and then led the way to the carriage.
Seeing this, Murong Xue’er quickly followed the maid.
“Hello, are all of these wrapped up?”
“Mhm! They’re all wrapped up!”
The maid turned her head and said to Murong Xue’er, “Please get in the carriage, Miss!”
“Okay!”
Murong Xue’er nodded and then quickly climbed into the carriage. Once inside, Murong Xue’er immediately lifted the curtain.
She was taken aback by the decorations inside.
“So luxurious!”
“Oh, my goodness!”
Murong Xue’er exclaimed.
Indeed, she had not expected Lin Yi to have such an opulent carriage, and for it to be equipped with so much jewelry; he was practically a rich man’s child.
Such a person, truly a child from a wealthy family, wielded great power!
“Hehe, if you think this carriage is comfortable and lavish, why not marry him?”
The maid said to Murong Xue’er with a laugh.
“I… I am not the frivolous type, I am pure and chaste!”
Murong Xue’er quickly shook her head upon hearing this, and said.
The maid was slightly stunned when she heard Murong Xue’er’s words, thinking to herself, “Pure and chaste, no wonder that young master named Lin Yi had no intention of marrying you. It turns out he prefers the company of men!”
Thinking this, the maid secretly decided, “I should also stay away from Lin Yi in the future, lest he takes a fancy to me!”
“By the way, Miss Xue’er, what did you want to ask just now?”
The maid suddenly remembered Murong Xue’er’s question and asked.
“I wanted to ask about the owner of this carriage!”
Murong Xue’er replied.
“The owner of this carriage is our Tianyuan Country’s wealthiest tycoon, Lin Yi!”
“In the entire empire, he is the only one who owns such a luxurious carriage!”
The maid said to Murong Xue’er with a smile.
“Wow, that’s amazing?”
“He truly deserves to be the empire’s greatest tycoon!”
Upon hearing this, Murong Xue’er couldn’t help but admire inwardly. Lin Yi’s strength was indeed formidable!
Moreover, Murong Xue’er finally understood why she always felt that Lin Yi seemed familiar. It turned out he was Lin Yi!
This explained why he looked so much like the prince!
“Do you know that prince? Who is he?”
Murong Xue’er curiously asked.
She had always wanted to ask about her relationship with Huangfu Yunlong.
But she hadn’t found the chance to ask in the past few days.
Now that the opportunity had presented itself, Murong Xue’er naturally wouldn’t let it slip by easily.
“I do know him!”
“Miss Xue’er, the prince you’re speaking of is our Tianfeng Academy’s Chancellor, Huangfu Yunlong!”
The maid said to Murong Xue’er with a smile.
“What? Huangfu Yunlong, the Huangfu Yunlong?”
Murong Xue’er asked in surprise, her eyes widening.
She could never have imagined that Lin Yi was Huangfu Yunlong, the Chancellor of Tianfeng Academy!
This…
Murong Xue’er thought to herself in amazement.
As she gazed at Lin Yi’s retreating figure, she thought, “Lin Yi’s identity is truly astonishing!”
“His father is Huangfu Yunlong, and he himself is a highly talented Artifact Refiner; no ordinary person could be mentioned in the same breath with him!”
Murong Xue’er mused.
“Then… doesn’t that make Lin Yi’s status even more distinguished?!”
Murong Xue’er asked in amazement.
“Indeed, his status is not much less than that of our academy’s chancellor, and he is also the chancellor’s only grandson!”
The maid nodded with a smile, and said to Murong Xue’er.
“So he’s from the Imperial Family!”
“Lin Yi really does have an extraordinary status!”
“Lin Yi is incredibly amazing!”
“I always thought that Lin Yi was just a commoner, certainly not someone from the Royal House. I never expected him to be a genuine member of royalty!”
“I’ve struck it rich this time, meeting such a powerful client, and he’s a prince of the Royal Family!”
“I must ingratiate myself with him!”
“If I become his wife in the future, won’t I be living in wealth and splendor?!”
“Yes, I must curry favor with this prince. If I become the princess consort, what an incredibly exhilarating situation that would be!”
Thinking about this, Murong Xue’er’s heart bloomed with joy.
She pictured Lin Yi’s handsome and graceful manner in her mind.
And she thought, “If I really become a princess consort, I will surely be the envy and the object of pursuit for countless men, with many falling at my feet, right?!”
“Humph, Lin Yi, just obediently become my husband!”
“I will certainly make you succumb to me!”
“Haha, such a life is exactly what I, Murong Xue’er, have been longing for. I must cherish it!”
With these thoughts, Murong Xue’er couldn’t help but shout excitedly.
At this moment, the carriage had already arrived in Tianfeng City.

chapters.title: Chapter 795 - 795 815 A Face of Dejection
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 795: Chapter 815 A Face of Dejection Chapter 795: Chapter 815 A Face of Dejection Murong Xue’er looked out at the bustling market and her face lit up with delighted surprise.
For she saw a sea of people, busy and bustling on the streets, much livelier than any commercial street she had ever seen before.
“Wow, there are so many people!”
As she spoke, Murong Xue’er excitedly pulled a maid down from the carriage.
The servant, pulled off by Murong Xue’er, suddenly wore a sullen expression.
Nonetheless, she obediently followed Murong Xue’er off the carriage.
She wouldn’t dare to offend Murong Xue’er!
At that moment, Lin Yi also came to the side of the carriage.
“Eh? Isn’t that Murong Xue’er? What is she doing here?”
Lin Yi wondered.
He hadn’t expected that Murong Xue’er would come to this place, and even sit on his family’s carriage.
“Sister Xue’er, what are you doing here?”
“I came here specifically to find you!”
“What are you looking for me for?”
Lin Yi asked, puzzled.
Although he and Murong Xue’er had a rather special relationship, he had never invited her to play at his house!
Why had she suddenly come over to his place?
Could it be that she wanted to cozy up to him in this way?
Thinking this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but sneer internally—he had seen too many such women, each one wanting to leverage his status to boost their own fame and soar to great heights.
But these women all failed!
Their goal was merely to use his influence and position.
Yet, he didn’t like such tactics at all.
This world is indeed so pragmatic, survival of the fittest, with respect for the strong.
If you have strength, have status, you are the boss, and others are slaves.
And others would also worship you as if you were their ancestor.
Because in this world where the strong are honored, he is a king!
He is the king of this world, he is the supreme ruler!
“Brother Lin, I came to bid you farewell!”
“Because I plan to leave the Tianfeng Empire and venture to other places, I’ve decided to go to another place that can help me become even better, so I decided to go there!”
“Brother Lin, I am leaving the Tianfeng Empire to seek my own opportunities!”
“Brother Lin, I know you are also a genius who wants to travel the world, but I believe you will surely succeed!”
“I’ll wait for you!”
Murong Xue’er said to Lin Yi with a smile.
“Sister Xue’er!”
“We are friends, there’s no need for formalities. I will definitely be there waiting for you!”
“I hope that one day we can reunite and then we can talk about the world together!”
“Yes! We will surely meet one day, and when we do, I will bring my wives and concubines, and the three of us together shall travel the world!”
“Haha, yes, I too hope for such a day!”
Lin Yi felt a bit of reluctance hearing Murong Xue’er say she was leaving.
However, since Murong Xue’er had said so, he wouldn’t contradict her.
He too hoped that one day he would meet the woman he loved and together they would travel the world and share its splendors!
Seeing Murong Xue’er so determined, Lin Yi didn’t try to convince her otherwise.
“Alright, Sister Xue’er, then it’s a promise!”
“If you ever need anything, just let me know!”
“We will always be friends, friends forever!”
Lin Yi assured Murong Xue’er earnestly.
“Yes, of course!”
“We will definitely be friends, for a lifetime!”
Murong Xue’er said with a laugh.
The two of them started to chat, but at that time, the maid standing by felt somewhat awkward, as she could not understand a word of their conversation. Moreover, their voices were loud, almost carrying across the entire street, and since she did not know which country Murong Xue’er was referring to, she could only listen dryly, unable to interject a single word.
Murong Xue’er also took notice of the maid.
She immediately began to introduce, “Brother Lin, this is my personal maid named Qing Luan, she is my personal maid!”
“Got it, I’ll remember that!”
“Miss Qing Luan!”
“Hello!”
“From now on, just stay by Xue’er’s side, then I can rest easy!”
“Yes, Young Master!”
The maid said respectfully.
Lin Yi nodded, then instructed the carriage to carry on.
The carriage continued moving in the southeast direction.
Onboard, Lin Yi and Murong Xue’er also began discussing their futures.
“Brother Lin, you are leaving the Tianfeng Empire, where are you planning to go?”
“Are you leaving the Imperial Capital?”
“Yes!”
“I am planning to head to Tianxing City in the northwest to see if I can build up my career there!”
“I believe my dream should be to become the most outstanding Artifact Refiner on the continent!”
“When the time comes, I can craft many high-level pieces of equipment, then surely I’ll be making a fortune, making my father look at me in a new light!”
“By then, I will have even the uncles in my family gaze at me with respect!”
“My future is definitely going to be brilliant, making them look up to me, not down on me!”
“One day, I will definitely become the king of this continent!”
Murong Xue’er was full of confidence in herself; she believed that, with her beauty and wisdom, she would definitely carve out a domain of her own.
She wanted to turn into a super beauty that everyone envied!
“Oh, so Xue’er also has this dream!”
“Xue’er’s ambition is truly remarkable!”
Upon hearing Murong Xue’er’s dreams, Lin Yi did not mock her but instead praised her.
He knew that although Murong Xue’er was a delicate girl, her thoughts were wilder than anyone else’s.
Therefore, Lin Yi didn’t think that Murong Xue’er would change her personality and become demure just because of that.
“Exactly!”
“My dreams have always been grand, haven’t they?”
“Furthermore, my dream is to become a top existence among humans!”
“And, I also want my husband to become a hero among humans!”
“Then my husband could hold his head high, making my parents see their son shining with a golden glow in their eyes!”
Murong Xue’er said proudly.
“Hahaha, I believe that Xue’er will certainly become a top Alchemist as well!”
“Then you will surely be acknowledged as an Alchemy Master!”
Upon hearing Murong Xue’er’s dreams, Lin Yi was also invigorated.
“Hahaha!”
“Then, we shall get completely drunk!”
“Alright! We’ll drink till we drop!”
Murong Xue’er said heartily, and she even specifically asked Lin Yi’s guard to buy alcohol!
She knew Lin Yi was particularly fond of drinking, so she conveniently sent the guard to buy some fine wine!
“Hahaha, we won’t stop until we’re drunk!”
“Then, we shall drink a toast of three hundred cups!”
Murong Xue’er said with a laugh.
“Mm!”
“Definitely!”
Lin Yi also nodded with a smile.
A hint of relief appeared in his eyes.
He had not expected that Murong Xue’er would so readily accept him as a friend!
Indeed, it was a surprising turn of events!

chapters.title: Chapter 796 - 796 816 Sincere Admiration
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 796: Chapter 816: Sincere Admiration Chapter 796: Chapter 816: Sincere Admiration “Brother Lin, when the time comes, let’s drink three hundred cups together!”
Murong Xue’er said with a smile.
“That’s a must, we’ll drink three hundred cups and not return until we’re drunk!”
“Mmm!”
“Well, I’ll drink one now!”
Murong Xue’er lifted a cup of wine, gestured towards Lin Yi, and Lin Yi, seeing this, also raised his own cup, and clinking their glasses together, they drank down!
“Great! Cheers!”
“Hahaha… Cheers!”
Murong Xue’er also laughed heartily, her laughter as clear and pleasant as a silver bell, sounding very nice!
“Xue’er’s singing voice is truly delightful, no wonder you’ve become the first beauty of the Tianfeng Empire!” Lin Yi sincerely praised.
“Hehe, Brother Lin is flattering me!”
“Actually, Xue’er is just a bit smart, I’m not as amazing as you!”
“I can only say I’ve been quite lucky to have met a very good master, who has taught me so much; otherwise, I wouldn’t have reached my current level!” Murong Xue’er humbly said.
“Luck?”
“Little sister Xue’er, you’ve always been very fortunate!”
“If it were someone else, they might not have the talent for alchemy like you do, or become an Artifact Refiner!”
“Plus, I believe that Xue’er will definitely become the strongest Artifact Refiner in the Tianfeng Continent one day!”
“By then, not only you but your husband as well is bound to benefit, courted by everyone, and even taken as a disciple by the Royal House, becoming the future Crown Prince!”
“Hehe, of course, by then, Xue’er’s husband will certainly also become the most formidable person in the Tianfeng Empire!”
“Hahaha… Haha…”
“Hahahahaha…”
After a few more drinks, they finished their meal and had a few more cups of wine, and then they stopped drinking.
By now, Murong Xue’er was already drunk and had fallen fast asleep on the table.
Seeing this, Lin Yi picked Murong Xue’er up and placed her on the bed to sleep.
He then sat down in a chair, took up a pot of tea, and leisurely enjoyed it!
Meanwhile, on the other side, Lin Yi was also in seclusion.
He had been in seclusion for half a year now and showed no signs of emerging.
Therefore, his father became somewhat anxious, fearing something had happened to him and sent people to search.
However, no news came back.
His father, along with Lin Yifei and others, were extremely anxious.
So they decided to register at the Tianfeng Academy before Lin Yi emerged from seclusion.
Lin Yi’s father sent someone to inform the Academy’s Vice-Chancellor, asking him to help with the admission.
Upon hearing the request, the Vice-Chancellor didn’t ask any further questions, after all, Lin Yi’s cultivation was evident for all to see.
Moreover, the Vice-Chancellor was quite familiar with Lin Yifei and others.
Thus, he didn’t refuse.
He, too, hoped that Lin Yi would break through the Martial Saint Realm sooner rather than later, as Lin Yi truly had excellent potential.
It’s just that before Lin Yi entered seclusion, he hadn’t mentioned wanting to go to the Tianfeng Academy.
And Lin Yifei and the others did not inquire further.
Lin Yifei hadn’t anticipated that Lin Yi’s breakthrough speed would be so fast; in just half a year, his strength had already advanced to the early stage of the Martial Venerable Realm.
Even though he was still far from the Martial Saint Realm, within it, there were few who could be his match.
This was why Lin Yifei was so confident!
“Lin Yi, since you’ve chosen this path, you must move forward bravely and never shrink back!”
“Only by continually breaking through can you survive better!”
“Don’t worry, no matter what dangers you encounter, you still have us!”
“We’re behind you, giving you support, so you have nothing to fear!”
“You must keep it up!”
Lin Yifei silently prayed for Lin Yi from the bottom of his heart.
He also looked forward to the day when he, too, could stand by Lin Yi’s side and shelter him from the wind and rain!
“Brother Lin, Xue’er really admires you!”
“Xue’er has never seen such an outstanding man like you!”
“Xue’er loves you so much!”
“Brother Lin, remember, you must stay alive and take good care of yourself and Xue’er!”
“Brother Lin, take good care of yourself!”
Murong Xue’er said with a face full of affection.
“Sister Xue’er, I will definitely keep your words close to my heart,” Brother Lin replied.
“Don’t worry, Sister Xue’er,” Lin Yi said with a resolute face to Murong Xue’er. “I will take very good care of you, cherish you, and not let you suffer any harm!”
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Murong Xue’er’s heart turned sweet!
Lin Yi was so gentle that it filled her with happiness and sweetness.
Moreover, the fact that such a wonderful man like Lin Yi was her fiancé made Murong Xue’er feel incredibly honored!
She was also very grateful that she had met Lin Yi before he had left the Tianfeng Empire.
Otherwise, Murong Xue’er might not have been Lin Yi’s fiancée now but just an ordinary woman!
“Sister Xue’er, come, let’s drink!” Lin Yi said, seeing that Murong Xue’er was silent, offering her the cup of wine in his hand.
“En, let’s continue drinking!”
Murong Xue’er took up the wine cup, clinked it against Lin Yi’s cup, and then they continued drinking!
Seeing her mood brighten, Lin Yi felt much better himself, and he felt somewhat comforted in his heart.
He knew that Murong Xue’er had fully accepted him!
“Brother Lin, your capacity for alcohol is incredible,” she said, “you’ve been able to drink more than ten cups in a row!”
“How can you be so amazing!”
“Brother Lin, if you don’t mind, would it be okay for Xue’er to bring you wine every day in the future?”
“Brother Lin, just tell Xue’er what wine you like, and I will bring it to you every day!”
Murong Xue’er gazed at Lin Yi with her big, blinking eyes.
Lin Yi looked back at Murong Xue’er’s beautiful eyes and felt a stirring in his heart.
Murong Xue’er’s beauty could be considered the beauty of Tianxiang Country!
Although the girl didn’t have a city-upending figure, she was absolutely beautiful as a celestial being and truly fit for a princess from a great clan!
This was the very reason Lin Yi found himself attracted to her, and it was indeed because of Murong Xue’er’s beauty!
However, Murong Xue’er had not yet come of age and was still under sixteen years old.
And Lin Yi was only twenty-five years old at the moment!
According to custom, he wasn’t at the age to start a family and shouldn’t be engaged to Murong Xue’er!
But Lin Yi couldn’t wait any longer!
So, he had simply gotten engaged to Murong Xue’er.
After all, he didn’t care who he married!
“Alright, Sister Xue’er, then you should come often to drink with me!” Lin Yi said, smiling, his face also showing a smile.
“We can discuss cultivation together!”
He felt that Murong Xue’er was like a pure and kind young girl, who could learn a lot by being with him.
And he didn’t mind teaching Murong Xue’er cultivation!
Because Lin Yi believed in his abilities!
If he was willing to guide her in cultivation, her cultivation would surely soar, making her a Martial Ancestor Realm superpower.
Murong Xue’er also knew her own capacity for alcohol; she was the type to fall after just one cup!

chapters.title: Chapter 797 - 797 817 Great Admiration
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 797: Chapter 817: Great Admiration Chapter 797: Chapter 817: Great Admiration But today, she felt that Lin Yi’s drinking endurance was just too incredible.
She was already drunk.
But he remained sober!
This left her utterly shocked!
And also filled her with immense admiration.
“Mm, Brother Lin, can you teach me Cultivation Technique?”
Murong Xue’er was also looking forward to Lin Yi teaching her Cultivation.
Plus, she was eager to find out what kind of heights she could reach in the future!
And Lin Yi did not disappoint her.
Lin Yi explained Murong Xue’er’s Cultivation Method to her.
After listening, Murong Xue’er looked at Lin Yi with gratitude, her eyes filled with admiration.
Lin Yi’s explanation was incredibly detailed!
This gave Murong Xue’er limitless aspirations for her future.
“Brother Lin, wouldn’t it be great if I could become a Martial King Realm expert!”
“Then, I wouldn’t need to worry about others bullying our Lin Family anymore!”
Murong Xue’er excitedly said to Lin Yi.
And upon hearing Murong Xue’er’s words, Lin Yi too smiled.
“Heh heh, you are the young lady of the Lin Family,” he said, “how could you possibly be bullied, and who would dare bully our Lin Family?”
“Our Lin Family is the most formidable presence in the entire Beicang County, no one dares to provoke us!” Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Mm! Brother Lin, you’re right, our Lin Family is so formidable, no one dares to mess with us!”
“We will be the rulers of the Lin Family in the future!”
Murong Xue’er said, also with a smile.
A smile appeared on Lin Yi’s face, and his heart was filled with joy.
Because he had finally married such a formidable wife, his own status would greatly increase, and even becoming the strongest person in Beicang County was not an impossibility!
Moreover, he would have a father-in-law at the Martial Sovereign Realm in the future!
Then he would truly be the number one expert in Beicang County!
At that time, he could marry into a Martial Sovereign family just like Lin Yixin!
He and Lin Yixin would indeed be a perfect match, a match made in heaven!
Thinking of all this, Lin Yi’s face showed an infinite smile.
Lin Yi also knew that Murong Xue’er and he were truly a match made by heaven.
He believed that Murong Xue’er would be a good wife, a virtuous and beautiful wife!
“Brother Lin, I have a favor to ask of you!”
“I was wondering if Brother Lin could grant my request?”
“You say it, as long as it’s within my power, I will do it!” Murong Xue’er looked at Lin Yi and said.
And upon hearing Murong Xue’er’s words, Lin Yi also said softly, “Sister Xue’er, feel free to ask anything!”
“I heard that Brother Lin, you have a very beautiful girlfriend, is that true?”
“Is she really that beautiful?”
“Yeah, Brother Lin, that girl is really beautiful!” Murong Xue’er said.
She had a favorable impression of Lin Yi.
Since childhood, Lin Yi has always been the center of attention!
And around him were always many beautiful girls!
All these girls were the ones Lin Yi liked!
This made her feel a bit jealous.
She also knew that her relationship with Lin Yi was nothing more than that of siblings.
But deep down, she still hoped to have some special relationship with Lin Yi, to make herself feel a bit more at ease.
“Yes, that girl is very pretty, and she’s also very well-behaved and sensible!”
“You can rest assured, I will not let her down in the future!”
Lin Yi said with a smile.
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, Murong Xue’er was also able to put her mind at ease!
And seeing that Murong Xue’er was reassured, he too revealed a bright smile.
Murong Xue’er chatted with him for a while, then went back to her room to rest!
She needed to recuperate, after all, she had drunk a whole bottle of alcohol, and now the effects were somewhat fading.
“Lin Yi, are you telling the truth?”
“Is that girl really pretty, and well-behaved?”
After Lin Yi entered the room, Murong Xue’er’s maid hurriedly came up to him, asking excitedly.
Having heard her young mistress’s words, she trusted what Lin Yi said completely, and didn’t dare to doubt!
“Yes, it’s true. Her name is Murong Xue’er, and I’ve just recently met her!” Lin Yi said.
“She is indeed a very smart girl!”
“And also very gentle and kind!” Lin Yi added.
“And she has no cultivation at all! She hasn’t practiced any martial arts, and only relies on her fists to defeat a few opponents!”
“Don’t be fooled by her appearance; look how good her figure is!”
With that, Lin Yi pulled Murong Xue’er out to show off her physique.
Murong Xue’er was taken aback for a moment, then laughed, but her smile was also tinged with shyness.
She knew her figure was indeed great!
Thus, she was willing to show off her physique.
And seeing Murong Xue’er’s delicate face, Lin Yi’s breath tightened; he was so taken aback that he couldn’t believe her figure was so impressive!
This was the first time Lin Yi had seen such an impressive figure on Murong Xue’er.
His heart was filled with admiration, and at the same time, he silently vowed that he would definitely make his fiancée his woman!
Because he knew that Murong Xue’er’s parents would surely support her, so he now had to make a good impression on both of them!
“Brother Lin, what are you staring at, come and sit inside the room quickly!”
Seeing Lin Yi staring blankly at her chest, Murong Xue’er’s face turned crimson, and she hurriedly spoke.
“Haha, I’m not looking at anything, not looking at anything!”
“I’m going to sleep in the room; I will send someone to notify you, and tomorrow we will have guests visiting the Lin Family. You should get up early and prepare!” Lin Yi said as he walked into the room and shut the door.
And Murong Xue’er was waiting inside the room!
Just as Lin Yi lay down, Murong Xue’er’s personal maid ran over to tell her that a group of people was looking for Lin Yi, and they said it was very important.
This left Lin Yi somewhat puzzled; could it be that his little junior brother had come looking for him?
But no matter what, Lin Yi had to go and see!
And, Lin Yi was also curious to find out who this so-called junior brother really was!
Lin Yi immediately dressed neatly, then walked toward Murong Xue’er’s courtyard.
Soon, Lin Yi arrived at the courtyard where Murong Xue’er lived!
The courtyard also featured a small building.
Many guards stood in front of the small building, which appeared to be Murong Xue’er’s protectors!
This made Lin Yi somewhat envious!
However, Lin Yi was a very prideful person!
He would definitely not rely on his family’s power, the rights of the Murong Family, or depend on his father’s strength. He wanted to use his own abilities to conquer those people and protect the ones he wanted to protect.
Moreover, his prowess within the Murong Family was considered quite impressive already; if it weren’t for his father, it would not have been possible for him to achieve such heights!
Although Murong Xue’er’s father held a high position within the Murong Family, even at the level of an elder,
that didn’t matter to him!
Because he was also a member of the Lin Family, he had the right to strive for what he wanted!
However, when Lin Yi arrived at the courtyard, his eyes narrowed suddenly!

chapters.title: Chapter 798 - 798 818 Tight Security
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 798: Chapter 818: Tight Security Chapter 798: Chapter 818: Tight Security “Eh?”
“There’s actually a Formation in this courtyard?”
“And it’s a Ninth Rank Formation at that, really quite extraordinary!”
“No wonder the guard is so strict here, turns out there’s such a Formation protecting it, truly remarkable!”
Seeing the Formation in front of the courtyard, Lin Yi couldn’t help but express his admiration.
“Brother Lin, there is indeed a Formation in my courtyard, but how did you know?”
“Could it be you’ve been here before or perhaps, you’ve visited this place!”
Murong Xue’er curiously looked at Lin Yi and asked.
Lin Yi did not hide the truth from Murong Xue’er and honestly said, “Yes, I often come to your courtyard, and I frequently cultivate here!”
“Oh? Is that so?”
“I’ve never heard about a Formation in this courtyard, and I don’t understand why you’d say that.”
“Could it really be that you come here to cultivate?”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s explanation, Murong Xue’er asked curiously as well.
Lin Yi nodded and then said, “Yes!”
“Then why do you know about the existence of this Formation?”
Murong Xue’er pressed on with her questions.
Lin Yi wasn’t sure how to respond; he certainly couldn’t say it was because he’d seen it while studying the art of Formations!
Saying that would definitely make Murong Xue’er wary of him, and then it wouldn’t be easy to pursue her!
So, Lin Yi simply shook his head and replied, “I don’t know!”
“I was just guessing. I don’t know anything about Formations, I’ve never learned them. I’ve just seen this kind of Formation in books. I’ve been to this courtyard before, and for some reason, there’s a Defensive Array on the courtyard walls. After seeing this Formation, I surmised there must be a Formation inside the courtyard, too!”
“And besides, I’d guess there’s probably an ancient imperial palace or something like a royal mansion within the courtyard, otherwise why would there be a Defensive Array?”
Lin Yi explained.
“Really? Brother Lin is amazing!”
“Then Brother Lin, do you know how many powerful guards are inside the courtyard?”
“For example, my father, he’s a High Level Martial King, and I am a peak-level Samurai! And there are also a few guards who are High Level Martial Kings!”
“If my guards were to take action, I believe those bad guys wouldn’t be able to stir up any waves at all!”
Murong Xue’er said with pride.
Hearing Murong Xue’er’s words, Lin Yi was genuinely astonished; he had not expected that so many powerful individuals were hidden within Murong Xue’er’s courtyard!
To think that Murong Xue’er’s courtyard contained an ancient imperial palace and a royal mansion, and even a guard at the Martial Emperor Realm!
These facts alone were enough to make others wary!
Lin Yi was shocked deep in his heart!
“So it turns out Murong Xue’er’s courtyard harbors such powerful guards!”
“It seems the Murong Family’s power is quite impressive!”
Considering this, Lin Yi felt a sense of envy.
After all, this was a Formation he hadn’t been able to break through since early in his learning!
“But who set up this Formation?”
“And how could he be aware of its presence?”
Lin Yi felt increasingly perplexed.
What kind of family was the Murong Family, capable of possessing such formidable guards?
Lin Yi’s gaze toward the courtyard was filled with envy and admiration.
He now truly wished he could be like his father, possessing such formidable strength!
“Brother Lin, let me take you inside!”
“But I’m not just taking you into my courtyard, I’m taking you into my room, which is not the same as this courtyard!”
Murong Xue’er explained to Lin Yi.
“Hmm?”
“Isn’t this the courtyard?”
Hearing Murong Xue’er’s explanation, Lin Yi was taken aback for a moment, and then he realized!
“That’s right, my room is also on the second floor!”
“However, on the third floor, there is a loft in my courtyard, and my room is right next to the loft. Come with me!”
Murong Xue’er said.
After she finished speaking, she took the lead towards the loft.
And Lin Yi hastily followed her.
“Wow, this architecture is so beautiful, truly a sight for sore eyes!”
“Xue’er, the layout here is so lovely!”
Lin Yi felt his spirits lift as Murong Xue’er led him to a courtyard.
Because the courtyard was just too beautiful!
In the courtyard, many rare and exotic herbs were planted, some of which grew on trees, appearing especially lush, and the courtyard was filled with many flowers, greeting anyone who entered with a mild and refreshing fragrance that was pleasing to the heart and mind.
Here, you seemed to be able to hear the birds chirping among the flowers, smell the fragrance in the air, catch the scent of blooming blossoms, and even taste the sweet aroma of the flowers.
In this courtyard, there was also a stream, babbling gently, with a few goldfish swimming in its waters.
At this moment, Lin Yi felt that his luck was just too good.
He had just arrived here and had already met Murong Xue’er, which made Lin Yi even more curious about her family background.
What kind of family was the Murong Family?
Why did her family have so many formidable experts?
And such a beautiful courtyard, as well as such high-level formations.
And such strong protectors!
This made Lin Yi even more eager to know what sort of heritage and status the Murong Family really had!
“Brother Lin, please wait here for a moment. I’ll finish processing these herbs and then take you to visit my room,” Murong Xue’er said cheerfully to Lin Yi.
“Sure! I’ll wait here for you!”
“I also want to see how beautiful Xue’er’s courtyard is, hurry up!”
“You go ahead and deal with the herbs; it will be just a moment!”
Lin Yi made himself comfortable, sitting on a stone bench with his legs crossed, enjoying the beautiful courtyard.
“Brother Lin, don’t be fooled, my courtyard may be beautiful, but I do not live here!”
“I reside in the City Lord’s Mansion; I am the legitimate daughter of the City Lord, and my parents live in the City Lord’s Mansion.”
Seeing Lin Yi’s admiration for the courtyard, Murong Xue’er explained.
“What? You’re the City Lord’s daughter?”
Hearing Murong Xue’er’s words, Lin Yi was momentarily stunned.
The City Lord’s daughter? That was practically the status of a princess! Moreover, he knew that the City Lord was a Martial Ancestor, a powerhouse at the Martial Venerable realm, undoubtedly a supreme expert!
“Xue’er, I had no idea your father was the City Lord’s daughter!”
“Truly unexpected, you come from such a background!”
“Your identity really is mysterious!”
Lin Yi couldn’t help but express his amazement.
Seeing Lin Yi’s reaction, a smile played on the corners of Murong Xue’er’s lips.
“Haha, my father usually keeps a low profile. He spends most of his time cultivating in the City Lord’s Mansion and doesn’t show up much, so we really don’t know what kind of person he is!”
“However, I think my dad must be even more formidable than me!”
Murong Xue’er said proudly.
Lin Yi nodded, his mind occupied with different thoughts. The City Lord was indeed more formidable than Murong Xue’er’s father because he was a super-powerful Martial Ancestor, while Murong Xue’er’s father was only at the sixth level of Martial Ancestor.

chapters.title: Chapter 799 - 799 819 Never Left the Cave
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 799: Chapter 819: Never Left the Cave Chapter 799: Chapter 819: Never Left the Cave Moreover, he still had much to learn.
For instance, Murong Xue’er’s father turned out to be the daughter of the city lord, and even held the honorary title of Princess Xue’er.
This identity was truly shocking!
Furthermore, according to Murong Xue’er, her father always lived in seclusion in a cave, never stepping out, except for his cultivation practices.
And Murong Xue’er recounted that when she was five, her father had left the Murong Family and headed for Tian Nan Province.
What was her father doing in Tian Nan Province? What was he up to?
Why didn’t he know any of this?
The more Lin Yi came to understand the Murong Family, the more he felt that there was nothing simple about them.
And this time, Murong Xue’er bringing him here likely had an ulterior motive; otherwise, there was no need for her to bring Lin Yi to the Murong Family.
“Brother Lin, when you come into my room later, you must keep it a secret! You absolutely must not let it slip!”
“If others find out that there’s a boy in my yard, it will definitely cause trouble!”
Murong Xue’er also reminded Lin Yi.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but nod.
“I understand!”
“I won’t tell anyone your identity!”
“Don’t worry!”
“However, you also know that some young people nowadays like to cling to the powerful. If your identity gets out, your fiancé might also be pursued by other men, and then I want to see what he’ll do!”
“If your fiancé is pursued by others, I would be quite happy to accommodate you two, I would spread the word about your situation, and then they would understand that Murong Xue’er is my, Lin Yi’s, woman, and none of them should even think of courting you!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, his eyes filled with a domineering air, exuding absolute authority!
“Brother Lin, you’re such a joker. This is the Murong Family, after all. Who would dare to bully me? If anyone dares to bully me, I would annihilate their entire clan!”
Murong Xue’er laughed at Lin Yi’s words.
Lin Yi smiled as well.
“Is that so? Xue’er, then I’m really looking forward to you wiping out all those men!”
“I just hope you can find a man who’s truly suitable for you; otherwise, I’m really worried!”
Lin Yi said with some concern.
He cared deeply for Murong Xue’er and was very attentive to her future. After all, she was from a family of formidable and unmatched strength, and the man she would marry would be no ordinary person.
“Brother Lin, rest assured. With a man as outstanding as you, how could I not fancy you? I will marry you sooner or later!”
“I believe that our union will be known by everyone in Martial Holy City!”
Murong Xue’er said with a smile.
At that moment, however, Murong Xue’er suddenly remembered something Lin Yi had mentioned earlier.
Her gaze involuntarily shifted to Lin Yi.
“Brother Lin, what did you just say? Did you say you were a Martial Saint Realm expert?”
“What? You’re a Martial Saint Realm expert!”
Murong Xue’er exclaimed in surprise, her beautiful eyes widening in shock.
She had never imagined that the Brother Lin she had always admired was actually a Martial Saint Realm expert!
This news was extremely shocking to Murong Xue’er and filled her heart with immense excitement.
“Yes, that’s correct! I am a Martial Artist of the Saint Realm, and I am also curious, are you a Martial Emperor expert or a Martial King?”
Lin Yi said with a smile.
He also wanted to know this, it was the biggest question on his mind!
“Martial Saint Realm expert! Martial Emperor? How could I possibly be a Martial Saint Realm expert? How could I be a Martial Emperor?”
“My father is only an expert of the Saint Realm, too!”
“Could it be, Brother Lin, that you are not just a Martial Saint Realm expert? Are you also a Martial Emperor Level powerhouse?”
Murong Xue’er asked, her face full of amazement.
“Well, but I am not yet an expert of the Martial Emperor Realm, I have just been promoted to Martial Emperor Realm not long ago!”
“However, my cultivation speed is now terrifyingly fast; I believe that my Combat Power will definitely be incredibly formidable!”
“Even, I can effortlessly kill a Martial Emperor at the Early Stage!”
Lin Yi said arrogantly.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Murong Xue’er was even more deeply shocked!
Isn’t that an exaggeration?
Generally speaking, the realms of Martial Artists are divided into four levels.
The first level is the Early Stage, the second is the Intermediate Stage, the third is the Later Stages, and the fourth is the Peak!
At the Martial Master level, the fourth stage is the Peak; at the Martial Sovereign level, the fourth stage is the Later Stages, and at the Martial Emperor level, the fourth stage is the Martial Emperor Peak, just one step away from becoming a Martial Saint!
Murong Xue’er was so shocked that she couldn’t speak.
The Saint Realm is a watershed, and the Martial Saint Peak is yet another watershed!
And now, her Brother Lin, Lin Yi, was actually a high-level expert at the Saint Realm, which shocked Murong Xue’er tremendously!
Moreover, Murong Xue’er could feel that the gap between herself and Lin Yi was still very large. When the two of them were together, it was truly hard to predict who would emerge victorious!
“Sister Xue’er, since I promised you that I would help you find my mother, I will certainly not go back on my word. After we return, I’ll help you track her down!”
“Then, we can quickly return to your father’s side, and arrange your marriage sooner!”
Lin Yi also said very seriously.
“Thank you so much, Brother Lin!”
Murong Xue’er also expressed her gratitude.
“Alright! Let’s leave this place first! We shouldn’t delay your father’s injury any longer; the sooner we get back, the sooner he can be treated!”
“Otherwise, his life expectancy won’t be long!”
Lin Yi also said with concern.
“Okay!”
“Then, let’s go!”
Murong Xue’er and Lin Yi walked one after the other toward the outside.
Soon, they arrived at the entrance of a mansion.
“Brother Lin, this is the place!”
Murong Xue’er pointed at the mansion and said.
The mansion was also a property of the Murong Family.
“Let’s go, we’ll go in now!”
Lin Yi smiled and proceeded to stride into the mansion with Murong Xue’er.
“Brother Lin, you go in first, I’ll wait for you here!”
“It would be more convenient this way!”
“No way!”
“We’ll go in together!”
Lin Yi flatly refused.
“Isn’t that inappropriate?”
“What if my father sees me with you? What should we do then?”
Murong Xue’er was also a bit worried.
She was afraid her father would get angry!
After all, the relationship between her father and Lin Yi wasn’t good at the moment, so she feared her father might misunderstand something.
She was very nervous.
“Rest assured, we’ll go to see your father now, and then we’ll have him confirm that we indeed are not enemies!”
“We truly are friends, brothers!”
“Besides, your father is not a petty man!”
“Just be at ease! We definitely won’t have any problems!”
Lin Yi said with a smile.
“Then let’s hurry in now. Whether they misunderstand or not, we must clarify!”
Murong Xue’er also said eagerly.

chapters.title: Chapter 800 - 800 820 Do Not Inquire
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 800: Chapter 820 Do Not Inquire Chapter 800: Chapter 820 Do Not Inquire After speaking, she couldn’t wait to pull Lin Yi into the mansion.
Murong Xue’er led Lin Yi into the mansion.
At this moment, her father, Murong Tianyu, was sitting in the main hall, discussing matters with the various elders of the Murong Family, and when Murong Xue’er and Lin Yi entered the hall, they too noticed the pair.
“Ah? Xue’er, Lin Yi, what brings you here? Could it be that you already know?”
Upon seeing Lin Yi and Murong Xue’er in front of him, Murong Tianyu was slightly taken aback.
How could these two children come here? Could it be that they already knew about the dispute he had with those few Martial Ancestors, and had they come to comfort him?
Murong Xue’er, hearing her father’s question, also quickly shook her head and said, “Father, you misunderstand, Brother Lin and I were not aware of your grudge with them, nor did we inquire about the matter between you!”
Murong Tianyu, after hearing Murong Xue’er’s words, looked at Lin Yi with astonishment, “Really? Young Master Lin, you really don’t blame us?”
“No blame, how could I? You were also doing it for my sake, and we are truly friends, we don’t care about these details!”
“Moreover, we now have to quickly leave Martial Holy City, so I don’t intend to hold you responsible for anything!”
Lin Yi said with a slight smile to Murong Tianyu.
“Well then, since that’s the case, I won’t say more. Xue’er, I’ll have someone send you out of Martial Holy City now!”
“Additionally, our streets in Martial Holy City do not permit fighting and brawling, if you have any matters, you need to go to our Martial Holy City auction house to negotiate and resolve them. If you have any difficulties, you can always find me, and I’ll help you resolve them!”
“I hope that you, Young Master Lin and Miss Xue’er, can understand!”
Murong Tianyu also spoke with a sincere expression.
Although Lin Yi was an innately talented Martial Venerable at the Ninefold level and their Martial Holy City auction house was not a place where ordinary people could cause trouble.
But in the current situation, if Lin Yi really was a magnanimous person, he would be willing to make friends with him.
“Understood, we’ll handle this matter!”
“Thank you!”
Lin Yi nodded his head.
“Heh, no need to thank me! This matter began because of me, I don’t want you to get hurt either,”
Lin Yi said, laughing and shaking his head.
“Then we will take our leave now!”
Murong Tianyu smiled and waved his hand, instructing one of his guards to lead Lin Yi and Murong Xue’er out.
Lin Yi also said to Murong Xue’er, “Xue’er, let’s not publicize this incident for now, let’s head back to your father’s mansion first!”
“Okay! I will listen to you!”
“Let’s go back and talk!”
Lin Yi nodded his head.
“Alright, Brother Lin!”
Murong Xue’er replied with a slight smile and then pulled Lin Yi along as they left.
Watching the two fading figures, Murong Tianyu’s eyes revealed a contemplative look.
These two were too peculiar, what exactly were their origins?
Why had he never heard of their names, who were their parents?
Such talents, why had he never seen them before?
Who exactly were these children, what really were their origins?
Why was their strength so formidable?
These were all things he wanted to know!
“No! I must find out the origins of these two kids!”
“But before that, there’s another matter I need to investigate!”
“I wonder what purpose they have in coming to us?”
Murong Tianyu also thought to himself.
“Let’s return to the estate!”
Immediately upon saying this, Murong Tianyu ordered his entourage and headed towards the grand courtyard of the Murong Family.
Lin Yi and Murong Xue’er followed the group from the Murong Family to the entrance gate of the mansion.
The Murong Family’s mansion occupied two-thirds of the entire City Lord’s Mansion, so it was extraordinarily large.
When Lin Yi and Murong Xue’er entered this mansion, they were amazed by the interior decorations; it was their first time seeing such a luxurious and magnificent estate that resembled a palace from a fairytale, splendid and imposing, inspiring awe in those who beheld it.
“How beautiful!”
“Our Murong Family’s estate truly is the best!”
Lin Yi’s eyes also sparkled with admiration; it was his first time encountering such a luxurious estate, and he felt dazzled by the sight.
“Yes, our estate is much larger than those of other noble families!”
“Brother Lin, do you like it?”
Seeing the look of envy on Lin Yi’s face, Murong Xue’er asked with a giggle.
“Hehe, I love it! Of course, I do!”
“This is my first time in such a grand estate in my life; it’s unbelievable!”
Lin Yi remarked with a sense of wonder.
“Haha, our estate is really expansive!”
“Moreover, inside there is a palace! This palace is known as the Martial Holy Temple. It is specifically used for hosting grand events, recruiting talents, and is a gathering place for major powers. Inside, you’ll find plenty of high-level Cultivation Techniques and Martial Arts!”
“As long as you join the Martial Holy Temple, you can learn some of the Cultivation Techniques and Martial Arts of the Temple!”
Murong Xue’er said to Lin Yi excitedly.
“Oh, is there such a place?”
“I’d really like to see it for myself!”
“Great! Let’s hurry over then, I want to witness the splendor of the Martial Holy Temple too!”
Lin Yi nodded and walked alongside Murong Xue’er towards their destination.
Soon after, Lin Yi and Murong Xue’er arrived at the grand entrance gate of the mansion.
The guard who was watching the gate, upon seeing Murong Tianyu, immediately opened it.
Lin Yi and Murong Xue’er followed the guard inside.
“Greetings, Martial Saint!”
The guard greeted Murong Tianyu with utmost respect.
“Mm! You may go about your duties!”
Murong Tianyu waved his hand dismissively, indicating for the guard to leave.
“Yes, Martial Saint!”
“We will take our leave now!”
The guard nodded his head and turned to walk away.
After the guard had left, Murong Tianyu turned to Lin Yi and Murong Xue’er and said with a smile, “Esteemed guests, please come inside!”
“Thank you, Uncle Murong!”
Lin Yi thanked him with a clasped fist and a smile, then led Murong Xue’er inside the Martial Holy Temple.
The layout inside the Martial Holy Temple was majestic; it was even more enormous than the mansion of the Murong Family, with many pavilions, towers, artificial hills, and waterfalls.
The Martial Holy Temple was also arranged with countless rooms.
Each room was attended by servants and maids, and each had a grand hall.
The decorations in each room were similar.
Lin Yi led Murong Xue’er to one of the most luxurious halls, where tables and chairs were set with tea and pastries, all prepared very completely, looking very comfortable and refined, fitting for a lady of Murong Xue’er’s gentle temperament.

chapters.title: Chapter 801 - 801 821 As Long As You Like It
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 801: Chapter 821: As Long As You Like It Chapter 801: Chapter 821: As Long As You Like It “Xue’er, please sit!”
“No need to stand on ceremony, help yourself to anything!”
“See what you like to eat here and feel free to take it!”
“Thank you, Uncle Murong!”
Murong Xue’er nodded politely, then walked to the side, picked up some pastries from the table, and began to eat.
“Miss Xue’er!”
“No need to be so formal, just call me Murong Tianyu!”
Murong Tianyu, seeing Murong Xue’er being so reserved, spoke up to her.
“Yes, Uncle Murong Tianyu!”
Lin Yi replied with a smile, also picking up pastries from the table to eat, and while eating, he praised, “Uncle Murong, these pastries are really delicious, sweeter and more delicious than any I’ve had before!”
“Hehe!”
“Master Lin, I’m glad you like them!”
Murong Tianyu, hearing this, nodded with a smile and responded to Lin Yi.
“Yes, Uncle Murong Tianyu, I won’t be shy then!”
“Anyway, I have to thank you for finding me such a good place. The environment of this mansion is really nice; I like it!”
“I’ll come here often for meals in the future and can play with Xue’er too!”
“Haha, I’m glad you like it!”
When Murong Tianyu heard Lin Yi wanted to stay frequently at the Martial Holy Temple, he laughed heartily and spoke to Lin Yi.
“We’ll leave it at that for now and go inside for a tour in a minute!”
Murong Tianyu nodded.
Afterward, the two chatted for a while and then walked toward the grand hall of the Martial Holy Temple.
At this moment, the grand hall of the Martial Holy Temple was already filled with people, most of whom were around fifty or sixty years old, dressed in uniform attire, and gathered in a circle around the hall, engaged in animated discussions.
