The atmosphere here was also very lively, and Murong Tianyu quickly noticed this, his expression immediately darkened, and he thought to himself: Damn it!
He realized someone was trying to seize all the Murong Family’s assets and occupy all its resources, which infuriated him.
“Master Lin, Miss Xue’er, feel free to choose any room!”
Murong Tianyu hurriedly said to Lin Yi and Murong Xue’er.
“Okay! Thank you, Uncle Murong!”
“Thank you, Uncle Murong!”
Lin Yi and Murong Xue’er also responded to Murong Tianyu.
Without any hesitation, Lin Yi and Murong Xue’er chose a room and walked inside.
“What exactly are these two people? So arrogant, daring to stay here in the Martial Holy Temple!”
“Hmph! They must not be ordinary people, definitely sent by some major family!”
“I didn’t expect to run into this; I won’t be polite now!”
A guard snorted coldly, a hint of murderous intent in his eyes as he walked toward that room, intending to rob it.
…
Martial Holy Temple Great Hall.
“Is that young man the owner of the Martial Holy Temple? Who is he?”
An elder of the Murong family saw Lin Yi inside the grand hall of the Martial Holy Temple, a flash of surprise in his eyes, and he couldn’t help asking.
“Ah! That’s the kid! I can’t believe he actually came to our Murong Family, and especially on the date the Martial Saint Conference was being held—he just barged in so boldly, it’s simply outrageous!”
“He did this to surely snatch our Murong Family’s resources! We must stop him!”
Another elder also spoke, frowning.
“This Lin Yi, I think he doesn’t know at all that our Murong Family has the Martial Holy Temple, so he is being so arrogant!”
“This person is like a country bumpkin, completely unaware of how powerful our Murong Family is! We have so many masters here, and he only has two people; how could we be afraid of him?”
“Indeed! However, he is too arrogant, does he not know the strength of our Murong Family? He is acting so recklessly!”
“He is seeking death! We will not let him go this time!”
The other elders also began talking, their tones filled with murderous intent.
At this moment, Murong Tianyu’s older brother also spoke up.
“Enough, stop arguing!”
“The Martial Holy Temple is personally attended by the Martial Saint, and no challenge is allowed!”
“If you don’t want to invite trouble, then don’t provoke him, otherwise, even our Murong Family cannot protect you!”
“Hmph!”
“Don’t forget, the Martial Holy Temple is personally attended by the Martial Saint; they control supreme power. If you don’t obey the rules, the Martial Saint will not care about your life or death!”
Murong Tianyu also scolded upon hearing this.
These elders, feeling very displeased upon hearing this, dared not say anything more, as the Martial Saint holds supreme authority in their hearts.
“Alright, today is the grand ceremony of the Martial Holy Temple, let’s not argue any further; we’ll settle accounts with that kid after the ceremony!
“Then, I want to see just what skills that darn kid has!”
“Yes, that wretched kid is utterly brash, daring to intrude into the Martial Holy Temple, and behaving so arrogantly in our Martial Holy City!”
The rest of the group of elders also began to curse and swear.
“Hmph, I want to see what skills this wretched kid has, daring to break into our Murong Family!”
Murong Tianyu, upon hearing this, his eyes also sparked with a flash of cold light, speaking coldly.
“Alright, stop arguing, after the ceremony starts, we will properly settle accounts with this kid!”
“At that time, I will personally capture this kid and tear him into a thousand pieces, to dispel the hatred in my heart!”
On the sidelines, Murong Xue’er, seeing Murong Tianyu and several elders arguing, secretly breathed a sigh of relief, feeling very worried.
After all, these elders are greatly skilled, and although Lin Yi is strong, he is still a Primary Level Martial Saint, facing these major powers, he is somewhat at a disadvantage.
She really fears these elders might harm Lin Yi.
On the side, Lin Yi’s gaze was also fixed on Murong Xue’er, as if he could see into what she was thinking.
“Miss Xue’er, don’t worry about me, with me here, they can’t hurt me!”
Lin Yi said with a smile, trying to comfort her.
Upon hearing this, Murong Xue’er’s face also flushed with a hint of red, then she lowered her head, afraid to look at Lin Yi, worried she might fall into his smile.
“Hmph! What are you two still doing standing there? Go prepare the food and drinks, and welcome the Martial Saint!”
An elder of the Murong Family also commanded sharply.
“Yes!”
Upon hearing the command, everyone immediately responded and hurriedly left to get busy.
Murong Tianyu and that elder, seeing this, exchanged glances and also left the area.
Just then, Lin Yi turned his head and looked towards Murong Tianyu, his eyes narrowing slightly and the corners of his mouth curling into a smirk, a mischievous sparkle flashing in his eyes.
Seeing Lin Yi’s expression, a foreboding feeling rose in Murong Tianyu’s heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 802 - 802 822 Unparalleled Strength
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 802: Chapter 822: Unparalleled Strength Chapter 802: Chapter 822: Unparalleled Strength At this moment, a voice reached Murong Tianyu’s ears.
“Murong Tianyu, I know your Murong Family is a powerful clan with enormous influence and unparalleled strength!”
“But I will absolutely not let anyone bully my woman! Today, I’m going to tell you that I, Lin Yi, am Murong Xue’er’s man! If you don’t believe it, feel free to test whether I am an enemy of the Murong Family!”
As Lin Yi finished speaking, his expression suddenly turned icy, and a terrifying killing intent began to emanate from him.
“What? You’re actually the Murong Family’s son-in-law?”
“How, how is that possible?”
When Murong Tianyu heard Lin Yi’s words, he was greatly shocked. He had not expected Lin Yi to be Murong Xue’er’s man, but he definitely did not believe Lin Yi’s words.
“Haha! Murong Tianyu, you are too naive! How could Murong Xue’er’s judgment be poor? And how can you be so sure he’s definitely a member of the Murong Family?”
“I advise you to better not doubt my man’s identity! Otherwise, when the time comes, your Murong Family might actually suffer a disaster!”
Murong Xue’er saw Murong Tianyu’s incredulous expression and sneered as she spoke.
“Murong Xue’er, I know you’re doing this to save Lin Yi!”
“But I hope you explain this clearly to us! How did you two meet?”
Murong Tianyu also stared at Murong Xue’er, a cold glint flashing in his eyes.
He absolutely could not allow Murong Xue’er to be with this boy, who was not only worthless but also had very weak strength.
He knew all about Murong Xue’er’s beauty and talent, and he really loved her. He definitely would not allow this boy to ruin the marriage alliance between him and Murong Xue’er and was even less willing to let this boy steal away his fiancée.
“Patriarch Murong, what do you mean by this? Do I need to explain my relationship with my boyfriend to you?”
Murong Xue’er retorted with a cold face.
“Hehe, Xue’er, since this boy is your boyfriend, then our Murong Family will naturally help you investigate clearly. I will give you an explanation in due course! Just wait here obediently!”
“Should your Murong Family dare to talk nonsense, we from the Martial Holy Temple would not mind wiping you off the map of Three Thousand City!”
After hearing these words, Lin Yi clenched his fists and a cold light flashed in his eyes. An intimidating aura emanated from him, one that was even more terrifying than that of a Martial Emperor at the peak.
Lin Yi, a martial artist in the Martial Venerable Realm, had not yet reached the status of a Martial Saint, but the aura emanating from him was incredibly strong, causing some elders to retreat several steps in fear.
Murong Tianyu’s heart skipped a beat at this intimidation, not having expected Lin Yi’s strength to be so formidable. A sense of hesitation suddenly rose in his heart; he did not wish to offend the Murong Family.
“Murong Tianyu, I warn you, I don’t want to fall out with your Murong Family, but if you dare do anything to my man, I, Murong Xue’er, will absolutely not let you off!”
“Moreover, if you dare to provoke my man again, I won’t be polite! My Murong Family is not one you small clans can trifle with!”
“So, if you have any sense, it’s best you don’t provoke the two of us!”
Murong Xue’er was equally unyielding and glared at Murong Tianyu, speaking coldly.
“Hmph, let’s go!”
Murong Tianyu’s face turned an ashen color, but he did not dare to stay any longer.
He was well aware of the strong families behind Murong Xue’er—a force not to be trifled with by someone like him, Murong Tianyu.
He had no desire to court disaster.
“Sister Xue’er, thank you!”
Lin Yi turned to Murong Xue’er with a grateful smile and spoke.
“All right, no need for formalities. This is what I should do. Let’s hurry and leave this place!”
Murong Xue’er shook her head, smiling as she spoke.
Lin Yi nodded, and immediately the two of them walked outside.
Upon seeing Murong Xue’er and Lin Yi leave, Murong Tianyu also breathed a sigh of relief and turned to leave, intending to discuss the matter with his father.
The banquet had thus come to an end; it concluded smoothly, leaving only the Murong Family members standing there with their expressions changing unpredictably, their thoughts unknown.
After Murong Tianyu left, he went to Murong Xue’er’s residence.
At this moment, after Murong Tianyu had departed, Lin Yi returned straight to his own room where he was staying.
As soon as Lin Yi returned, Murong Xue’er immediately threw herself into his embrace, her cheek against his chest, and softly said, “Lin Yi, I owe you so much for this time. Otherwise, I would have surely met a terrible fate. The elders of our Murong Family will certainly come after you!”
“It’s all right, I’m not afraid. As long as I’m by your side, I’ll protect you,” Lin Yi reassured, gently patting Murong Xue’er’s shoulder.
“Mhm.”
Murong Xue’er nodded slightly, a warm feeling welling up in her heart.
Lin Yi’s words had truly touched her, deepening her feelings for him.
“You should rest for now. Tomorrow, I will take you away from here. After we leave, you can go back to your Murong Family if you want.”
“This time, having helped me, my Murong Family will surely repay you!”
“This time, my Murong Family’s ties with the Martial Holy Temple have broken. In the future, if you seek to advance into the Southern Region, you’ll encounter difficulties, but my Murong Family can send some people to assist you.”
Lin Yi was silent for a moment before slowly speaking to Murong Xue’er.
“Really? Thank you so much. If you ever have any trouble, please tell me,” Murong Xue’er exclaimed joyfully upon hearing Lin Yi’s words. She knew that her boyfriend now truly considered her his woman, and if the Murong Family really sent people against him, he would certainly face great danger.
Lin Yi became even more gentle with her, bringing Murong Xue’er much comfort and the result she wanted to see.
“Don’t worry, you’re my woman, and no one will be allowed to harm even a single hair on your head! Just stay here and focus on your cultivation.”
Lin Yi stroked Murong Xue’er’s head, his face gentle as he spoke.
Lin Yi’s expression softened, his demeanor towards Murong Xue’er not like that towards other girls, but as if towards his own woman.
“Yes!”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, Murong Xue’er was touched deeply.
“You should rest. I’m going to cultivate!”
Having said that, Lin Yi stood up and walked towards the door, preparing to cultivate for a while to consolidate the Realm he had just broken through.
“Lin Yi, why are you cultivating so early? Don’t you want to stay with me?”
Murong Xue’er hastily asked as she saw Lin Yi leaving.
“No need!”
“This time, I’m going into seclusion to try and break through to the Spirit Emperor Realm, so I’ll be in seclusion for a while!”
Lin Yi shook his head, speaking indifferently.

chapters.title: Chapter 803 - 803 823 Will Encounter Many Difficulties
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 803: Chapter 823: Will Encounter Many Difficulties Chapter 803: Chapter 823: Will Encounter Many Difficulties “Spirit Emperor Realm?”
“Lin Yi, you are currently only at the second level of Martial Ancestor Realm, how could you possibly break through to the Spirit Emperor Realm? Moreover, with your aptitude, striving for the Spirit Emperor Realm will definitely meet many obstacles. Are you sure you want to do this?”
Murong Xue’er, hearing that Lin Yi was aiming to break through to the Spirit Emperor Realm, asked with some worry.
“I’m sure. Having already been elevated to the second level of the Martial Ancestor Realm, I feel that I should strive for the Spirit Emperor Realm!”
“I need to enhance my strength as soon as possible, in order to avoid facing danger again!”
Lin Yi nodded his head, his tone firm.
“Lin Yi, have you really decided to try and break through to the Spirit Emperor Realm? Have you considered waiting a bit longer? Perhaps, we in the Murong Family might have a way to help you.”
Murong Xue’er still did not give up. She began to persuade Lin Yi to stay and wait a bit longer.
Hearing this, Lin Yi smiled. He knew that Murong Xue’er was concerned about him; however, his current strength was already strong enough, and he felt he should attempt the Spirit Emperor Realm.
“No need. I don’t need anyone’s help anymore, and I believe I can break through the Spirit Emperor Realm without failing!”
“Alright, since you are so determined, I will not discourage you any further!”
“However, do you still remember the bet between us? If you break through to the Spirit Emperor Realm, you’ll have to fulfill your promise. From then on, you must obey my orders, got it?”
Murong Xue’er looked at Lin Yi, her teeth clenched.
“Hehe, let’s just wait and see!”
“When the time comes, I will definitely honor this agreement and not disappoint you.”
Lin Yi also smiled slightly, assuring Murong Xue’er.
Murong Xue’er nodded, thinking to herself in astonishment, “Lin Yi, this guy is really amazing; my Murong Family has offended such a prodigy!”
“I hope you can truly advance to the Spirit Emperor Realm!”
“Otherwise, my Murong Family will definitely suffer huge losses!”
She thought to herself, deeply worried about Lin Yi’s future.
“Yes, alright, you should rest early too. I am going to practice.”
Lin Yi nodded and spoke.
Then, he walked towards the room, sat cross-legged on the bed, and began to regulate his breath through meditation.
Murong Xue’er also lay down, her eyes flickering with an unusual gleam, thinking, “The Spirit Emperor Realm, what kind of realm is that? Can Lin Yi really advance to the Spirit Emperor Realm?”
“I hope you don’t disappoint me, otherwise, the people of my Murong Family will definitely kill you!”
…
Murong Xue’er thought for a long time but finally could not figure it out, so she could only sigh helplessly.
The following day, Lin Yi left early.
He knew Murong Xue’er would definitely continue practicing, since the spiritual energy inside her had almost recovered, and staying in the Murong Family would only be a waste of time.
However, this did not mean Murong Xue’er no longer had to worry about her safety. Lin Yi would still have people protect her to prevent any accidents.
After leaving the Murong Family, Lin Yi headed towards East Sea City.
East Sea City was one of the most prosperous places in Xi Lan Country, and the busiest city, where business thrived.
“Spiritual King Realm, I can definitely break through to the Spirit Emperor Realm! I will achieve the Spirit Emperor Realm!”
Lin Yi thought to himself, full of anticipation.
As Lin Yi was heading to East Sea City, he took out a voice transmission jade pendant to contact Lin Feng.
Soon, he received a message from Lin Feng.
“Master, your disciple is in East Sea City. Do you need something?”
Lin Feng received the transmission from Lin Yi’s Jade Pendant and promptly replied,
“Haha, disciple, your master has now found the secret manual for breaking through to the Spirit Emperor Realm. I plan to in seclusion for three days, and I need you to take care of Xue’er during this time.”
“With me away for these three days, I entrust Xue’er’s safety to you!”
“Alright, Master, don’t worry. I will take good care of Xue’er, and I also have something to tell you.”
Upon hearing Lin Feng’s response, Lin Yi also smiled and spoke,
“Master, please say whatever it is straight away.”
“Alright. My main goal for this seclusion is to successfully merge my Cultivation Method. My strength will increase many times over.”
“However, this requires a large amount of Spirit Stones, and I’m running out.”
Lin Yi spoke with some distress to Lin Feng,
“Spirit Stones? I actually have some here, enough to support your cultivation. I’ll take you there right now.”
Lin Feng was a bit puzzled; he had not expected that Lin Yi would need so many Spirit Stones for cultivation, especially that those stones were to come from him.
“Great, come over to me now, and I’ll head over to find you right away!”
Upon hearing Lin Feng’s words, Lin Yi was also delighted,
“Yes, I’m coming right over!”
Lin Feng answered.
After he hung up the transmission Jade Pendant, he immediately headed out to the Lin Family Auction House, which was located quite close to East Sea City and was the most renowned auction house.
The scale of the Lin Family Auction House was vast, occupying three whole floors of the auction house building.
After Lin Yi arrived at the Lin Family Auction House, he entered the premises, where the hall was filled with a variety of auction items, dazzling to the eyes.
Lin Yi looked at these various rare and strange auction items, somewhat mesmerized, yet he dared not buy anything recklessly.
Although the Lin Family Auction House was quite renowned in Xi Lan Country, the items here were not cheap.
Thus, Lin Yi only dared to look at some ordinary auction items.
“Mr. Lin, you’ve arrived?”
As soon as Lin Yi walked into the auction house, a woman dressed in purple blocked his path; she was extraordinarily beautiful, with a very voluptuous figure, and her chest was particularly well-endowed, clearly showing her mature feminine body and pretty face.
“Yes.”
Lin Yi nodded slightly.
“Mr. Lin, please wait a moment, I’ll go prepare a luxurious private room for you now!”
The woman said with a smile, then turned and left.
Lin Yi did not pay much attention and waited where he stood.
Before long, the woman led Lin Yi to a luxurious and elegant building.
Lin Yi followed the woman into the room, which was decorated sumptuously with several beautiful women serving inside.
“Mr. Lin, this is your luxurious suite; you can take your time to choose the items you like!”
The woman spoke to Lin Yi with a charming smile on her face.
“Oh, that’s good, you can go now.”
“I will call you after I’ve made my selections.”
Lin Yi waved his hand, indicating that she could leave.
“Very well, Mr. Lin.”
The woman, hearing Lin Yi’s instructions, bowed respectfully and closed the door softly as she left.

chapters.title: Chapter 804 - 804 824 Fear of Attracting Attention
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 804: Chapter 824: Fear of Attracting Attention Chapter 804: Chapter 824: Fear of Attracting Attention Immediately, Lin Yi also walked to the window and looked outside. From this room, he could clearly see the street view outside, and he could see it distinctly.
However, Lin Yi didn’t look too far because there were many people outside, and he feared attracting their attention, which might affect his Cultivation.
“Ah, the view here is indeed the best, and the environment is very comfortable as well. I must cultivate well here!”
Lin Yi, gazing at the street view outside the window, nodded slightly, expressing his appreciation.
He then began to select the items he needed.
Lin Yi examined these things with great care and detail.
“Eh? How come I see so many treasures, what are all these things? This one also seems pretty good, I wonder what it does.”
After a short while, Lin Yi’s eyes fixed on a black bead, surprise flickering in his eyes, and he began to hesitate.
This bead looked utterly ordinary, but Lin Yi felt it contained a mysterious aura, incredibly mystic, as if hiding a vast treasure within.
After seeing the black bead, Lin Yi couldn’t help but hesitate.
After all, Lin Yi was no ordinary person; every resource on him could be said to be extremely precious, and his assets were quite substantial.
Yet at this moment, he was still reluctant to use them, and he was not certain what this black bead was.
Lin Yi didn’t linger on this bead for too long; his gaze moved elsewhere, hoping to continue his search and perhaps find what he needed.
“No matter, buy it first, and think later!”
With the realization that he couldn’t keep searching, Lin Yi made up his mind, bought the items, and then decided to look for more leisurely.
After making up his mind, Lin Yi directly took out the remaining five million Gold Coins on him and bought an Intermediate Rank Immortal Artifact robe to wear on his body and took out two pieces of Lower Rank Immortal Artifact Armor to wear.
Then, he took out forty million Gold Coins and bought a few pieces of Upper Rank Immortal Artifact clothes.
With this, Lin Yi had fully transformed into a newly rich individual, and his attire was extremely luxurious.
“Boss, I’ll take this black bead and these items, wrap them up for me!”
Lin Yi called out to the woman behind the counter, and at the same time, passed her a bead emitting a faint glow.
Upon receiving the bead, a trace of astonishment crossed the woman’s face, but she quickly composed herself. After all, she was accustomed to big scenes, so she remained quite calm.
Then, she bowed to Lin Yi, “Mr. Lin, I will pack up these beads and clothes as quickly as possible and have them sent to your inn.”
Lin Yi nodded, then handed the Silver to the woman, and she left.
At this moment, Lin Yi had a wealth of fifty-five million Gold Coins on him.
Lin Yi felt his strength had improved considerably, and moreover, most of the fifty million Gold Coins came from his Spatial Ring.
Lin Yi didn’t care about these details. As long as his Cultivation skyrocketed, he could reclaim that wealth; he wasn’t short of that little money.
Afterward, Lin Yi’s gaze fell on the black bead in his hand.
A sense of anticipation rose in Lin Yi’s heart, wondering what magical properties this bead might have.
Looking at the bead in his hand, Lin Yi was extremely curious and wanted to discover what magical energy lay inside it.
He stretched out his hand, intending to grasp the black bead in his palm.
But this black bead remained motionless, completely beyond my control.
Still, Lin Yi did not give up and continued to exert his power, trying to absorb the bead into his body, but the bead did not budge.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s brows deeply furrowed together. What exactly was going on?
Could it be that the energy of this bead simply couldn’t be absorbed by me?
After failing to absorb the black bead, Lin Yi frowned, feeling somewhat disappointed and helpless.
However, he was neither discouraged nor impatient; after all, he was a well-informed person who knew there was always a way out of a predicament, so he did not lose heart.
“It seems this thing is not simple at all!”
Having realized he couldn’t absorb the bead, Lin Yi sighed.
He had no choice but to set this matter aside for the time being and study the bead more carefully later.
Afterward, Lin Yi left the shop and strolled down another street.
…
Time flew like an arrow, and in the blink of an eye, three years had passed.
During this period, Lin Yi’s life was very pleasant. Over more than three years, he healed his injuries and practiced his Cultivation Technique, significantly enhancing his strength.
This time, Lin Yi’s strength had increased tremendously, reaching the peak of the Early Stage of the Nine Tribulations, just a step away from the Intermediate Stage of the Eight Tribulations.
Such progress was truly terrifying.
“Huh!”
Standing in a tavern, Lin Yi took a deep breath and exhaled slowly, a look of satisfaction crossing his face.
Although he had spent a significant amount of Gold Coins during this time, he had earned fifty million Gold Coins in a little over three years, a feat he found quite unbelievable.
“This time, I’ve made a good profit, earning so many Gold Coins. Now, I must have over a hundred million in my possession.”
Thinking this, Lin Yi felt very pleased with himself and even more confident in his own strength.
“Now, it’s time to visit that antique shop.”
With that thought, Lin Yi got up and hurried down the street.
The antique shop was located in a bustling area of a town, and to get there, Lin Yi had to traverse the entire span of the town.
So Lin Yi had to spend some time on the journey.
Walking out of the tavern, Lin Yi strolled leisurely down the street, planning to explore the city and familiarize himself with the surrounding environment.
Walking onto the street, Lin Yi saw many people around. He entered a main road, slowly taking in the sights.
Lin Yi ambled down the street for a long time without spotting any special items, which made him somewhat frustrated. He didn’t understand whether there were any treasures in these shops at all.
“Ah, something’s not right. It seems like there are no treasures here! Could it be that there aren’t any other antique shops in this town?”
Lin Yi wondered to himself and couldn’t help muttering, confused.
Afterward, Lin Yi looked around again. Gazing at the shops, he found nothing of interest.
What he needed most now was time, to quickly recover from his injuries, or at least to a state that was nearly healed.

chapters.title: Chapter 805 - 805 825 Intense Interest
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 805: Chapter 825 Intense Interest Chapter 805: Chapter 825 Intense Interest Lin Yi then entered a large shop and took a seat next to a table.
He was ready to carefully observe his surroundings, looking for some useful treasures.
At this time, Lin Yi saw that the large shop had rows and rows of shelves. Atop the shelves lay a variety of treasures.
Lin Yi, eyes lighting up at the sight of the dense arrays of shelves, was intensely interested in the treasures this large shop displayed.
He stepped forward and began to inspect the treasures carefully.
Among the treasures were items akin to ancient weapons—a large saber, a short sword, and a bronze plaque, among other things. However, their quality was far inferior to that of his gold coins.
Many of the items were common goods, while others were rare treasures, including some precious items and even some scarce materials.
Yet, to Lin Yi, none of them seemed valuable.
Many of them were just worthless junk.
Though the treasures were desirable, they failed to catch his eye.
With a casual wave of his hand, Lin Yi swept all these treasures into his Qiankun Bag, thereby purchasing several items and passing the time.
After buying a few treasures, Lin Yi proceeded to another shop to see if there were any other good items stored there.
Upon arriving at the entrance of this next shop, he noticed two guards standing watch.
The two guards were very powerful, both exuding a faint murderous aura.
“Brothers, I’d like to take a look inside,”
Lin Yi approached with a smile and spoke.
This shop was not very large, only about ten meters wide, but it was beautifully decorated. It was clear at a glance that the owner was someone who valued elegance and grace.
“Get lost!”
The two guards spoke sharply, their voices icy and their tone filled with domineering authority.
“What? How dare you speak to me like that! Do you know who I am?”
Lin Yi, a bit angry upon hearing the guards, still managed to retain his final threads of reason and did not argue with them.
“No matter who you are, I advise you to leave immediately and not interfere with our business,”
the guards continued coldly, their tone threatening.
“Fine, fine, I’m leaving! You two, don’t get cocky. One day, I’ll make you kneel and beg for mercy at my feet.”
Lin Yi snorted disdainfully, then turned and walked away.
As he turned, a sinister look flickered across his face.
After Lin Yi turned around, the two guards exchanged a glance, revealing a scornful expression.
“Hmph, daring to threaten us, he really doesn’t know whether he’s coming or going! This kid really doesn’t understand his own capacity; he actually dares to provoke us, utterly ignorant.”
One guard sneered with a mocking look in his eyes.
“Hmph, this kid must have been scared off by us. I see this fella as nothing but trash, with no strength at all. He’s just relying on his background to be arrogant, but we can’t be bothered with him. All we need to do is scare this guy away, then he’ll be clueless!”
The other guard also scoffed, appearing indifferent.
After Lin Yi had left, the shop slowly began to bustle with activity.
The number of people in the antiques shop kept growing.
“You’re talking about these treasures; do they hold any value?”
“Hehe, value? My friend, don’t make me laugh. Now, among these items laid out here, which one is valuable?”
“However, I did hear some news that among these treasures, there’s a sword that is extremely rare and valuable.”
“I’ve heard about that too.”
“Then you might want to pick up this sword and have a look; perhaps there will be a pleasant surprise?”
“Alright, let’s give it a try!”
Immediately, the group of people began to pick up the swords and admire them.
There were seven or eight swords displayed here, each of them quite fine, showing many years of aging. These swords looked extraordinary, not like ordinary swords at all.
“Haha, these swords look quite remarkable. It’s my first time seeing so many treasured swords.”
“Mm-hmm, indeed, it’s also our first time seeing this many treasured swords.”
“Among these swords, there are many rare treasures as well!”
…
At this moment, some Martial Artists also began to discuss and comment, each showing great interest in these treasures.
“Boss, how much are these swords selling for?”
“Boss, how many grades are these swords?”
“Boss, how much does each of these swords cost?”
Lin Yi entered the shop and began to inquire about the prices of the swords.
However, the shop owners were not willing to engage with Lin Yi, shaking their heads one by one, not wanting to sell the swords they held. They did not want to offend anyone.
Lin Yi, looking at the shop owners, also felt a surge of anger. He turned around and ignored the shop clerks.
After Lin Yi turned his back, he began to search for a sword in one of the shops, hoping to find the sword he needed.
Meanwhile, when Lin Yi entered the shop, he also caught the attention of the surrounding people; after all, Lin Yi was handsome and very well-dressed.
Such a dashing man entering here naturally drew the crowd’s attention, causing the surrounding Martial Artists to look toward Lin Yi with great interest.
Under the gaze of some Martial Artists, he found the sword he wanted to find and picked it up to examine it closely.
Although these swords were ordinary, each blade emitted a faint white light. Within this white light, there was a trace of the presence of Space Law.
There was a sword that contained Space Law in this shop!
Lin Yi, looking at the sword in his hand, became excited, and a look of ecstasy appeared on his face.
“It’s true! Among these swords, there’s indeed a trace of Space Law, and it seems like this sword contains the Five Elements Law as well!”
Lin Yi exclaimed in astonishment.
“Huh? The Five Elements Law? That’s impossible, isn’t it? Could my eyes be deceiving me?”
Lin Yi thought to himself, his heartbeat accelerating considerably.
These swords actually contained Space Law!

chapters.title: Chapter 806 - 806 826 Mastering Space Law
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 806: Chapter 826: Mastering Space Law Chapter 806: Chapter 826: Mastering Space Law You should know that on the Tianyuan Continent, a sword imbued with the Space Law is already considered a supreme-grade sword.
Yet these swords even contained the Five Elements Law!
If I could refine the Space Law within these swords, wouldn’t I be able to control the Space Law, even utilize it!
“What should I do?”
Lin Yi was also somewhat anxious, thinking, “The power of the Space Law contained in these swords is immense. Once I refine these swords, I will be able to master the Space Law! By then, my strength will surely increase tenfold, absolutely incomparable to this old man in front of me!”
Thinking this, he became even more determined to refine these swords.
“Well, since this sword contains the Space Law, I must claim this Space Law sword.”
Lin Yi’s gaze sharpened, his mind made up.
Just as Lin Yi made up his mind, a youth in a flowing purple robe holding a longsword, tall and slender, approached from a distance. He looked refined and very much the elegant young master.
He saw that many martial artists had gathered in front of the shop and walked over.
After seeing Lin Yi’s appearance, the youth briefly paused, then frowned.
“Hmm? Who is this unfamiliar young man, and why is he here? What is his purpose?”
Upon seeing this youth, Lin Yi’s expression immediately darkened.
He hadn’t expected a stranger to appear here.
“Kid, I’m telling you, no matter who you are, I found this place first. I advise you not to interfere, or else you will pay a heavy price.”
Then, the shopkeeper eyed the approaching youth, scoffing forcefully and warningly.
Although the youth was handsome, the shopkeeper didn’t take him seriously.
After all, he owned several shops, all established by himself. Under his influence, he was not afraid of any young person.
“Oh? You mean you discovered this sword first?”
Lin Yi raised his eyebrows upon hearing the shopkeeper’s words and looked at him.
“Hmph, what else did you think? You greenhorn, don’t pretend to know everything. I don’t have time to gossip with you.”
The shopkeeper laughed coldly, not taking Lin Yi seriously at all.
“I don’t care who found this sword first; I just want to buy this sword. If you don’t agree, then I will have to forcibly take it!”
Lin Yi said calmly.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the shopkeeper also paused briefly, anger appearing on his face: “Hmph, you really are courting death. It looks like I need to teach you a lesson today!”
“Oh?”
Lin Yi smiled faintly, not taking the shopkeeper’s words to heart.
“Kid, you better scram. You’re not qualified to challenge me!” The shopkeeper glared coldly at Lin Yi, his voice icy, his eyes flashing with a murderous intent.
“Are you choosing to oppose me?” Lin Yi squinted and spoke to the shopkeeper.
“I just don’t like the look of you, punk. Want to let me punch you around?”
The shopkeeper spoke disdainfully, not paying any heed to Lin Yi’s words at all.
Lin Yi’s expression also turned somewhat grim.
“Are you really choosing to oppose me?” Lin Yi snorted coldly, staring at the shopkeeper.
“Hmph, of course I have to oppose you, otherwise, do you think I would waste my words on you?”
This boss still didn’t take Lin Yi seriously.
Lin Yi couldn’t be bothered to waste words on this boss either. With a wave of his hand, a black flame appeared in his left palm and shot towards the boss.
This was a kind of flame from the Power of Laws. Lin Yi’s cultivation had already reached the Semi-Saint Realm, and the attacks he released were naturally very powerful, sending the boss flying with a direct hit.
The boss flew backward, blood spilling from the corner of his mouth, clearly injured.
“You… you dare to hit me? I’m a disciple of Tianxing Sect! You actually dare to hit me! Just wait for Tianxing Sect’s revenge!”
The boss clutched his chest, glaring fiercely at Lin Yi.
“Heh, with someone like you, even if you’re from Tianxing Sect, I’ll still take you down! To me, people from Tianxing Sect are just a bunch of worthless dogs, easily suppressed!”
Lin Yi chuckled coldly, not taking the people from Tianxing Sect seriously at all.
“Hmph, do you think the threat of Tianxing Sect is something you can belittle? Kid, remember this, when Tianxing Sect steps in, you must kneel and beg for mercy! Otherwise, prepare yourself for the wrath of Tianxing Sect!”
“Ha ha, fine, let’s have a try then. I really want to see how strong your Tianxing Sect actually is!”
Lin Yi laughed heartily, not taking this person from Tianxing Sect seriously at all.
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, the boss’s face turned red, clearly infuriated.
At that moment, two guards standing beside the boss, also filled with anger, charged forward.
These two guards, one male and one female, both had cultivation in the Semi-Saint Realm, their strength far surpassing that of the boss, both at the early stage peak of Half-Emperor.
“Kid, you dare to injure our Young Master in Tianxing City, you’re seeking death! Prepare to die!”
These two guards were exceedingly fierce, their punches and kicks smashing towards Lin Yi.
“Boom!”
Seeing the two guards attacking him, Lin Yi also kicked out, a terrifying force of Soul Power bursting out instantly, neutralizing the attacks of the two guards before him and sending them flying.
“Hmph! A mere Half-Emperor dares to be arrogant in front of me! You’re truly courting death!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, looking disdainfully at the two guards.
“Hmph! Kid, with just your cultivation of half a step to the Supreme Grade, do you reckon you can compete with our Young Master for this sword? You’re truly ignorant of the heights of heaven and the depths of the earth. Today, you will realize the might of Tianxing Sect!”
“Kid, just surrender peacefully!”
After being repelled, these two guards didn’t care at all and charged at Lin Yi once again.
The two guards, one punch each, struck Lin Yi with a terrifying force, intending to take him down in one move.
However, their attacks failed to overcome Lin Yi this time.
“Boom!”
“Boom!”
“Boom!”
Lin Yi consecutively retreated but didn’t suffer any injuries.
Seeing this, the expressions of the two guards changed slightly, and a flash of surprise crossed their eyes.
“How is this possible!”
The two looked at each other, seemingly not expecting Lin Yi to be so formidable.
“This kid actually possesses a physical body comparable to a True Dragon, no wonder he is so arrogant!”
The two guards were secretly shocked, feeling some apprehension in their hearts.

chapters.title: Chapter 807 - 807 827 Indifferent to Background
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 807: Chapter 827: Indifferent to Background Chapter 807: Chapter 827: Indifferent to Background They were disciples of the Tianxing Sect, famous talents within their sect. Ordinary people wouldn’t dare mess with them.
But Lin Yi, standing before them, seemed to care little about the background of the Tianxing Sect and was ready to confront them, which made them somewhat apprehensive.
“You two are really noisy. I hate it when people prattle in my ear. Scram!”
Lin Yi narrowed his eyes, and his expression turned visibly sour as he looked at the two guards, his tone filled with a chilling coldness that was intimidating.
The guards were taken aback at this.
They were geniuses of the Tianxing Sect, highly respected on their own turf. Yet now, this young man dared to be so insolent.
They felt humiliated!
This was an insult to them!
“Boy, you’re seeking death! I’ll make you regret being born, daring to curse us like this. Today, I will teach you a lesson on behalf of our Young Master!”
The guards’ expressions darkened, filled with uncontainable anger.
“If you don’t want to die, then leave! Otherwise, don’t blame me for showing no mercy!” Lin Yi scoffed.
Having said that, Lin Yi also moved. He threw a punch, shining with a golden light, and blasted it directly at the two guards.
Seeing this, the guards’ faces drastically changed, and they quickly threw punches to counter Lin Yi.
“Bang! Bang!”
The two guards, fighting together, were actually pushed back by Lin Yi, their faces filled with shock and their eyes revealing astonishment.
“Kid, have you lost your mind? To raise a hand against us is to provoke the dignity of the entire Tianxing Sect. I wonder how long you can act so arrogantly!”
One of the guards coldly shouted.
“Tianxing Sect? I truly don’t hold it in regard. If you keep babbling, I won’t mind giving you a taste of a fate worse than death!”
Lin Yi didn’t care at all, just coldly staring at the Tianxing Sect guard before him.
“You dare treat the Tianxing Sect this way! Boy, I think you are tired of living!”
This Tianxing Sect guard, enraged by Lin Yi’s words, roared in response.
“I’ve never been afraid of anyone, the people of your Tianxing Sect included. To me, you are as insignificant as trash. I’m going to annihilate your Tianxing Sect right now!”
Lin Yi’s eyes glinted with cold mockery.
At this moment, Lin Yi had completely enraged the Tianxing Sect guard, causing him to lose his rationality, his eyes also blazing with fury.
“Good! Disciples of the Tianxing Sect have never feared anyone. Boy, today you’ll witness the might of our Tianxing Sect!”
The guard of the Tianxing Sect bellowed, his eyes also filled with fierce anger.
“Oh, really? Well, let’s see how strong your Tianxing Sect really is.”
Lin Yi’s gaze was indifferent, his eyes flashing with disdain, uttering no extra words.
“Boom!”
Lin Yi fiercely struck out with a palm towards the Tianxing Sect guard.
With his palm, a giant golden palm instantly formed, carrying an unrivaled domineering force, brutally crushing towards the Tianxing Sect guard.
“Boy, you still want to clash directly with me? You’re on a path to self-destruction! Break!”
The Tianxing Sect guard’s face subtly changed and spoke with a sinister expression.
On his right hand, a ball of intensely hot, red flames appeared, and under these scorching flames, the air around his body also crackled explosively.
Then, he fiercely chopped his palm down on the golden giant palm.
“Boom!”
A huge palm print was shattered by a guardian of the Tianxing Sect with a single strike, turning into a myriad of light that dissipated into the heavens and earth.
“This is the Tianxing Palm!”
Upon witnessing this scene, an elder of the Tianxing Sect recognized the Martial Arts used by the guardian, his face showing a tinge of shock.
The Tianxing Palm was a secret technique of the Tianxing Sect. Once executed, its power was shocking; even Martial Sovereigns at the fifth level of the realm dared not resist it directly because the power of the Tianxing Palm was too terrifying.
But now, it had been broken by a youth who was half a step into the Martial King Realm. This sufficiently proved Lin Yi’s strength—it was no simple feat.
“Who is this kid who can even break the Tianxing Sect’s exclusive Tianxing Palm? This is the Tianxing Sect’s unique Martial Arts; even Martial Artists at the eighth level of the Martial Sovereign Realm can’t break it.”
“No matter who it is, they must have an extraordinary background; otherwise, they couldn’t have easily decoded the Tianxing Palm!”
“The Tianxing Palm of the Tianxing Sect isn’t something just anyone can decode.”
…
Those around were all discussing, their gazes toward Lin Yi filled with deep confusion.
The Tianxing Palm of the Tianxing Sect was an extremely formidable Martial Arts, ranking highly even within the sect and considered a top-tier Martial Arts. This youth named Lin Yi could easily decode it, which was indeed impressive!
“Hmph! Boy, since you dared to strike against us, then wait for the wrath of the Tianxing Sect!”
The guardian snorted coldly, also showing some wariness in his eyes towards Lin Yi.
“Tianxing Sect? How impressive is that?”
Lin Yi sneered disdainfully, “Let me tell you, I, Lin Yi, am no ordinary Joe, and your Tianxing Sect isn’t such a great force either. I want to see what the Tianxing Sect can do to me!”
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the eyes of that Tianxing Sect guardian bulged, his face turning livid.
“If that’s the case, then die!”
“Whoosh!”
The next moment, the Tianxing Sect guardian transformed into a beam of light, rushing forward rapidly, a terrifying surge of power emanating from him.
Lin Yi showed no fear, his figure bursting forward to meet the charge, also using the Tianxing Palm.
“Bang!”
When the two collided, there was a loud boom, and then both of their bodies flew backward.
“So powerful!”
Lin Yi was startled, a serious look flashing across his eyes.
This guardian of the Tianxing Sect was indeed powerful; his cultivation had reached the Ninefold Peak of the Martial Venerable Realm, far surpassing ordinary Martial Kings.
“Hahaha! Good! Boy, you indeed possess extraordinary strength; this time I’ll let you experience the prowess of the Tianxing Sect!”
The Tianxing Sect guardian laughed heartily, a fierce expression surfacing on his face.
“Then let’s see how formidable the Tianxing Sect is!”
Lin Yi was also angered, a hint of killing intent flashing in his eyes.
He didn’t want to stir up trouble, but since the other party was provoking him actively, he wouldn’t hold back.
“Boy, today I’ll make sure you have no place to die! Tianxing Palm!”
The Tianxing Sect guardian roared. Flames erupted on his left hand, and a massive fiery red hand materialized from thin air, ferociously clawing towards Lin Yi.
“Mere child’s play!”
Lin Yi scoffed coldly, also delivering a palm strike. His palm turned into a giant golden hand colliding with the huge fiery red hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 808 - 808 828 The Power of Tianxing Palm
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 808: Chapter 828: The Power of Tianxing Palm! Chapter 808: Chapter 828: The Power of Tianxing Palm! “Phew!”
When Lin Yi’s Palm Force made contact with the opponent’s palm, it was absorbed by the opponent’s palm, and the flames burning on the opponent’s hand even deepened, seemingly refining Lin Yi’s Palm Force and converting it for their own use.
“Hmm? What’s going on! Could this Tianxing Palm really be so powerful?”
A shock surged in Lin Yi’s heart, and a solemn expression appeared in his eyes.
Although he had casually delivered a palm strike just now, Lin Yi knew well the strength of his own strike; it was definitely a formidable martial arts technique, and it might even be a very powerful Divine Skill.
But now, the opponent could actually devour his attack and even refine it, which greatly surprised Lin Yi.
This time Lin Yi did not dare to be careless, a wild aura emerged from his body. He clenched his fists tightly, and a faint golden glow appeared on his body’s surface, releasing a powerful oppressive force that swept towards the Tianxing Sect guard in front of him.
“Kid, let you taste the power of my Tianxing Palm!”
The Tianxing Sect guard also roared, operating the Tianxing Palm fully, and slammed down a huge hand as if a star descended, the space around trembling, making everyone’s breath hitch.
“Boom!”
The two clashed fiercely once again.
“Rumble…”
A series of violent explosions spread throughout the area, flipping everything around.
Cracks spread across the ground as the earth was torn apart, creating crisscrossing ravines like a dense spider web.
This time, Lin Yi was again knocked back flying, and the Tianxing Sect guard was also sent flying by Lin Yi’s Palm Force.
The Tianxing Sect guard’s face turned red, feeling as if many of his ribs were broken, and a dull pain emanated from his chest, almost making him vomit blood.
The power of the Tianxing Palm was indeed powerful, truly worthy of being a Tianxing Sect martial art.
Lin Yi was also secretly astonished; the power of this palm was much more terrifying than he had imagined.
“Kid, now you should believe in the strength of my Tianxing Sect. Kneel down and apologize obediently, and my Tianxing Sect might spare you and even give you a handsome reward. Otherwise, we will have to kill you!”
The Tianxing Sect guard gasped a few times before staring at Lin Yi with a chilling tone. He also had a glint of greed in his eyes.
“Hmph, even if I kneel and beg for mercy, you wouldn’t let me go!”
“I know you from the Tianxing Sect want to obtain the cultivation techniques and secret manuals on my body, but unfortunately, I will never tell you! Even if you defeat me, what then? You would still kill me! So, I don’t need to kneel and beg for mercy, even if I did, you wouldn’t let me go!”
Lin Yi shook his head, utterly unmoved.
“Kid, you really are stubborn! Since that’s the case, then don’t blame me for being ruthless!”
“Tianxing Sword Technique, Demonic Annihilation!”
“Whoosh!”
The Tianxing Sect guard also roared, and Runes appeared on his body which quickly transformed into a giant black longsword, carrying a momentum that could destroy heaven and earth, stabbing towards Lin Yi.
“This is… a Martial King High Rank Swordsmanship, what formidable power!”
The onlookers were tremendously shook by this scene.
“This sword is my strongest martial skill, its power is comparable to an Intermediate Grade Divine Artifact!”
The Tianxing Sect guard also wore a proud expression, knowing well that Lin Yi couldn’t withstand this sword.
“Is that so! Then just try it!”
“Hmph, seeking death, kid!”
The Tianxing Sect’s guard let out a cold snort as he fiercely slashed with his black longsword. A terrifying wave of Sword Qi instantly appeared and ruthlessly struck Lin Yi’s body, emitting a sharp whooshing sound through the air.
Lin Yi too was struck, his body slashing backwards and flying off, leaving behind terrifying cracks on the ground.
“This kid’s body is so strong!”
The surrounding crowd gasped in astonishment, their eyes filled with shock.
“Kid, you’re already injured like this, even if you weren’t, you definitely wouldn’t be my match!”
Seeing that his sword had struck Lin Yi but hadn’t split him in two, the Tianxing Sect’s guard couldn’t help but let out a cold shout.
“Hmph, let’s see who will be victorious!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, then with a push of his legs, he leapt up and charged towards the other.
From within his body erupted a blazing golden flame, emitting an intense heat that warped the void around, seemingly incinerating the very space.
Lin Yi clenched his fists tightly, his fists also emitting a brilliant light, like two suns scorching the void into a charred black, making a sizzling sound.
“Golden Blazing Overlord Fist!”
Lin Yi shouted deeply, stomped the ground with his right foot, and then transformed into a shooting star, rapidly charging towards the Tianxing Sect’s guard.
With this punch, Lin Yi delivered an unparalleled domineering aura, as if a golden crow were swooping down from the ninth heaven emitting a scorching wave of air.
“Hmph, even if you use this martial art technique, it won’t be enough to scare me, you will still be defeated!”
The corner of the Tianxing Sect guard’s mouth curled up in a sneer as he swung his sword.
“Tianxing Palm!”
A towering wave of Sword Qi burst from his hand, turning into an all-encompassing palm print that fiercely slammed towards Lin Yi, the intense heat distorting the surrounding space.
“Break for me!”
Lin Yi’s eyes widened suddenly, swinging a punch out that collided fiercely with the enormous palm print that eclipsed the sky.
“Crack crack!”
Two muffled sounds came from the void as two massive cracks appeared, looking like they were about to collapse at any moment, leaving the onlookers dumbfounded.
“Phew…”
Lin Yi also spat out a mouthful of blood, his face turning deathly pale as his body violently shook a few times. He then stumbled, nearly falling to the ground.
“How is that possible?”
The Tianxing Sect’s guard was stunned, his face turning ghastly pale as he displayed an incredulous expression; he couldn’t believe that his last sword move hadn’t instantly killed Lin Yi, instead causing him to get injured.
You should know, the move he used was Tianxing Palm, immensely powerful and unbearable even for a regular Martial Sovereign.
He never expected Lin Yi’s physique to be so exceedingly formidable that it could take his move head-on!
“Ha-ha, I have had my eye on using this move against you for a while now, and it finally comes in handy!”
Lin Yi laughed, then fiercely stomped the ground once more. With the rebounding force, he charged again towards the Tianxing Sect’s guard, his fists clenched, fiercely throwing punches out.
“Golden Flame Fist!”
“Bang!”
This time, both men used the same martial arts technique, their bodies pausing for a moment in the void.

chapters.title: Chapter 809 - 809 829 As Vulnerable as an Ant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 809: Chapter 829: As Vulnerable as an Ant Chapter 809: Chapter 829: As Vulnerable as an Ant Lin Yi’s body burst into a layer of golden flame, and within his arms, a small golden fist condensed before he violently smashed it into the guard from Tianxing Sect.
“Crack!”
The guard from Tianxing Sect let out a scream as his black longsword shattered into two pieces.
“Spurt!”
An uncontrollably fierce power burst forth from the body of the guard from Tianxing Sect, followed by a thud as he was smashed into a pit by Lin Yi’s punch, his body covered in blood.
In front of Lin Yi, this guard from Tianxing Sect was as fragile as an ant, completely powerless to resist.
This guard was one of the top prodigies among the younger generation in Tianxing Sect. Having cultivated to the Martial Emperor Realm for about three hundred years, he was a distinguished figure among the youth of Qingyang City.
Yet, this supreme talent of Tianxing Sect, in Lin Yi’s hands, was beaten like a dog, in utter disarray.
Witnessing this scene, everyone watched Lin Yi in horror, their faces filled with disbelief.
Lin Yi’s strength had always been among the top ranks of Tianxing City’s younger generation.
However, in this battle, he was defeated by a virtually unknown youth, and the defeat was utterly miserable.
“How… how is this possible?”
“How can Lin Yi be so strong? Although that guard from Tianxing Sect was only a Martial King Realm martial artist just starting in the realm, he shouldn’t have been unable to withstand even one strike from Lin Yi.”
Everyone was shocked by the scene, their faces filled with astonishment, unable to believe the outcome.
“You… you…”
The guard from Tianxing Sect crawled out of the pit, then looked up at Lin Yi, realizing that he had not sustained any injuries. His face turned a mix of green and red, looking extremely ugly. Pointing at Lin Yi, he was at a loss for words.
He had not expected that a Martial King could defeat him with a single punch, filling his heart with rage and humiliation.
“I told you, I won’t give you another chance this time!”
Lin Yi grinned, his face fierce, as he strode toward the guard from Tianxing Sect.
“I will tear you to pieces, skin and debone you!”
The guard from Tianxing Sect also roared, a terrifying murderous aura emanating from his body. With a wave of his hands, a pitch-black dagger appeared, emitting a chilling light, and lunged to stab Lin Yi.
“Child’s play!”
Lin Yi’s mouth curled into a sneer, his face showing scorn. His body surged forward, and his right fist thundered out, striking the dagger fiercely, immediately creating a sound like metal clashing.
“Boom!”
The pitch-black dagger was pulverized into dust by Lin Yi’s fist force.
“What?”
Seeing this, the guard from Tianxing Sect’s pupils shrunk, and his heart skipped a beat.
“How… how can this be!”
He couldn’t believe the outcome, his complexion turning deathly pale.
Lin Yi’s strength was overwhelmingly mighty.
“My punch really hurts.”
Lin Yi cracked a smile, then slapped toward the Tianxing Sect guard with a palm.
“Boom!”
The Tianxing Sect guard was completely unable to defend himself, managing only to lift his spear in a vain attempt to block Lin Yi’s arm, but Lin Yi’s strength was simply too overwhelming. His spear was shattered instantly by Lin Yi’s strike, and then Lin Yi grabbed the Tianxing Sect guard with his other hand and mercilessly hurled him into the distance.
“Bang!”
The Tianxing Sect guard smashed into the rocky cliff of the valley, creating a massive, deep crater in the extremely hard rock.
“Spurt!”
The Tianxing Sect guard spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, his complexion turned extremely pale, and after struggling for a moment, he was unable to stand up again.
Seeing their own guard smashed to death, the disciples of Tianxing Sect also fell into panic, trying to flee, but Lin Yi stopped them and killed them one by one.
In just a few breaths’ time, Lin Yi had slain dozens of Tianxing Sect’s guards, and every single guard was at least at the Martial King Realm, even including one at the Martial Monarch Realm.
All these Tianxing Sect guards were dead, and Lin Yi plundered all their possessions, taking away the elixirs from their bodies as well.
Seeing Lin Yi slaughter these guards, the watching disciples of Tianxing Sect were dumbfounded.
“This guy, he actually killed so many of our Tianxing Sect guards!”
“Lin Yi is too crazy, isn’t he? He’s killed so many of our Tianxing Sect guards just like that.”
“Lin Yi is too tyrannical, it’s like he doesn’t put anyone in his eyes.”
“Hmph, you’re really overestimating Lin Yi. At first, we thought he was just a wastrel son, but after seeing him defeat Li Tianfeng and fend off a Martial Artist of the Martial Emperor Realm, we realized we’d underestimated him.”
“Who knew we’d actually provoked a terrifying killing god, what do we do now? We’ve really made a mess this time!”
“Afraid of making trouble? Didn’t you hear clearly just now? Lin Yi is our enemy at Tianxing Sect; he won’t let us go. Now stop worrying and leave Qingyun Sect right away!”
“You’re right, we should leave immediately and seek help. Our Tianxing Sect has significant strength in Qingyun Sect, even Lin Yi must weigh his options!”
Watching the flock of Tianxing Sect disciples fleeing for their lives, the onlookers couldn’t help but sigh and shake their heads.
They knew that they couldn’t escape involvement in today’s events.
Moreover, even if the elders of Tianxing Sect learned of this matter, they wouldn’t be able to protect them.
After all, Lin Yi had instigated everything, and with a grudge against Tianxing Sect, there was no way the Tianxing Sect’s elders would stand up for them. Today, they were bound to be punished.
“Lin Yi, consider this impressive, but I’ll remember this incident. We Qingyun Sect won’t let you off!”
A girl in green clothes stepped forward, glaring at Lin Yi with gritted teeth and eyes shimmering with intense hatred.
“Oh? Is that so? Well, I’ll be waiting for Qingyun Sect’s retaliation then; hope it won’t take too long.”
Lin Yi gave a slight smile, looking at the girl and said lightly.
“You…”
The girl in green heard Lin Yi’s words, and her expression immediately darkened.
She also knew Lin Yi was right, as they of Qingyun Sect really couldn’t do anything to Lin Yi; they were no match for him.
Unless Lin Yi voluntarily gave up his revenge. But even if Lin Yi was willing to let go of revenge, the Tianxing Sect elders wouldn’t agree.
After all, it was an internal conflict within Tianxing Sect that led to the death of their guards; as such, how could the guards of Qingyun Sect live.
Moreover, they couldn’t be sure that Lin Yi, this harbinger of doom, wouldn’t come looking for them, especially since Lin Yi was a Martial King Realm being.

chapters.title: Chapter 810 - 810 830 No Such Kung Fu
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 810: Chapter 830: No Such Kung Fu Chapter 810: Chapter 830: No Such Kung Fu “You stay put in Qingyun Sect, otherwise bear the consequences yourself!”
The green-clothed girl glared fiercely at Lin Yi before turning around and leading the disciples of Tianxing Sect away from the area.
“Hmph!”
Lin Yi watched as the green-clothed girl led people away, scoffing contemptuously. However, he did not stop them nor did he continue to chase after the Tianxing Sect disciples. After all, it was impossible for him to chase them down endlessly; he did not have that much time to spare.
Yet, although Lin Yi appeared outwardly calm, he was very angry inside.
“Damn it, Tianxing Sect, I will remember this!”
Lin Yi cursed inwardly, but soon the anger on his face faded, replaced instead by a slight smile.
It seemed that after the deaths of the Tianxing Sect’s guards, Lin Yi’s strength had also increased significantly. He was now able to kill the average Martial King Realm martial artists from Tianxing Sect.
Moreover, Lin Yi discovered that the Tianxing Great Method was indeed a very strong Cultivation Technique. This method could even accelerate the progress of his Tianxing swordsmanship, though the increase in speed wasn’t too noticeable. Still, it was a significant help to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s current strength was already enough to contend with some of the Martial Sovereign Realm martial artists of Tianxing Sect.
“Lin Yi, are you alright? Let me take you back to your room to rest.”
Just then, a beautiful woman came over, displaying a gentle and virtuous demeanor, looking at Lin Yi with concern.
This woman was none other than Tang Yuhuan, Lin Yi’s former fiancée.
“Sister Yuhuan, no need, I can manage on my own.”
Lin Yi gently waved his hand, refusing Tang Yuhuan’s kindness, and then flew towards his own residence.
After Lin Yi left, Tang Yuhuan watched his departing figure, her eyes filled with complex emotions.
“Yuhuan, who exactly is this Lin Yi? Why even a behemoth like Tianxing Sect, and the high ranks within it, dare not provoke him? Can it be that Lin Yi is really like the rumors outside say, that he is a monster?”
Tang Yuhuan pondered, watching Lin Yi’s receding back and feeling puzzled.
“Perhaps, Lin Yi really is a monster.”
“My current strength has reached the peak of Half-step Martial Saint. Even on this continent, I am among the top-ranked. But even so powerful a sect as Tianxing Sect dare not provoke Lin Yi. Is he more frightening than the elders of Tianxing Sect?”
Tang Yuhuan wondered in her heart.
However, she also knew that Lin Yi would never reveal his true identity to her.
“Alas!”
After a long thought, Tang Yuhuan sighed and then turned to return to her room to rest.
After Lin Yi left, he went straight back to his residence.
By this time, those guards had all been killed by Lin Yi. After returning to his residence, he sat cross-legged on the bed and began circulating the Tianxing Sword Technique.
Lin Yi had already mastered the moves of the Tianxing Sword Technique, just not integrated them fully.
Moreover, the memories of the moves of the Tianxing Sword Technique lingered in Lin Yi’s mind. To learn this swordsmanship, he only needed to practice it a few times to master it.
The moves of the Tianxing Sword Technique were very powerful. Lin Yi felt that his own sword skills were still lacking in comparison, but he had no choice but to first cultivate the Tianxing Sword Technique to the highest realm and then slowly study other sword skills.
Lin Yi’s cultivation speed was extremely fast. Over the course of one night, he had already practiced the Tianxing Sword Technique to a highly accomplished level.
The next morning, Lin Yi slowly rose from his bed and, after dressing, stepped out of the house.
“Are you awake?”
At that moment, a young woman came over with a bowl of steaming white porridge.
“What’s your name?” Lin Yi asked the woman.
“My name is Lin Yaoqin, you can just call me Qin’er, I don’t really have any other name, everyone just calls me Little Qin!” Lin Yaoqin said with a slight smile, introducing herself to Lin Yi.
“Alright, I understand, I’m hungry now, could you get me something to eat?” Lin Yi nodded and spoke to the woman named Lin Yaoqin.
“Of course.”
Lin Yaoqin responded and then left the courtyard with a bowl of white porridge.
“Although those guards from the Tianxing Sect are dead, there must still be others from the sect who will seek revenge against me, so I need to be cautious and not act recklessly like last night; otherwise, I will definitely face retaliation!”
Lin Yi thought about his skirmish with the young martial artist last night and the strength of his opponent which made him somewhat worried. However, his own strength had improved significantly since last night, so he wasn’t too afraid of the experts from the Tianxing Sect.
Eventually, Lin Yi sat down and began to eat his meal methodically.
Lin Yaoqin’s cooking skills were decent. After finishing his meal and freshening up, he prepared to leave.
At that time, Lin Yaoqin suddenly blocked Lin Yi’s path, nervously asking, “Lin Yi, where are you going?”
“Uh, where else could I go? I’m naturally going to participate in the martial examination. Why, does Sister Qin’er have something to say?”
Lin Yi looked up at Lin Yaoqin, raising his eyebrows slightly.
“Ah? You’re going to take part in the martial examination?”
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Yaoqin exclaimed, then looked at him excitedly and somewhat incredulously.
She had never imagined that Lin Yi would participate in the martial examination this time; such an event had not occurred for decades.
Moreover, this martial examination was perhaps the last opportunity, as it aimed to select the strongest eighteen individuals under the age of a hundred from Tianyuan City to take part in an elimination tournament.
Lin Yi had to participate, so he needed to quickly find Lin Aoxue and explain the situation clearly to avoid any unexpected problems.
“Yes, I’m rushing to participate in the martial examination!” Lin Yi nodded.
“Lin Yi, can I go with you?”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s agreement, Lin Yaoqin immediately became excited.
“You? Go with me to the martial examination, what for?” Lin Yi looked at Lin Yaoqin with some surprise.
“I also want to go, I want to be in the top three, I also want to take part in that martial examination, and my current strength should already be at the first rank of the Tiangang Realm. I want to give it a try!”
Lin Yaoqin looked at Lin Yi and said earnestly.
“You, how could your strength possibly have broken through to the first rank of the Tiangang Realm, what level are you?”
Lin Yi looked at Lin Yaoqin, somewhat astounded.
The Tiangang Realm, across the entire Northern Region, was cultivated only by a handful of superpowers’ genius disciples.
These superpower entities, even the weakest, were first-class forces comprising genius disciples who mostly stood out from the Talent List.

chapters.title: Chapter 811 - 811 831 A Martial Arts Trial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 811: Chapter 831: A Martial Arts Trial Chapter 811: Chapter 831: A Martial Arts Trial So, if they wanted to enter a superpower, the minimum requirement was to be a strong warrior of the Sevenfold Earthly Bravery Realm.
But Lin Yaoqin was actually capable of reaching the First Rank of the Tiangang Realm. Lin Yi was even more surprised by her level.
“I—I don’t know either, but I want to enter the Tianxing Sect, I hope I can also participate in the martial arts trial!”
Lin Yaoqin bit her lip slightly and said to Lin Yi.
“If that’s the case, then come with me to the Tianxing Sect. You could help me, and I could also help you enhance your strength.”
Lin Yi nodded and then spoke to Lin Yaoqin.
“You—you agreed to help me? You are willing to help me? Really? That’s great!”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Yaoqin was immediately overjoyed.
Although her strength could not compare with the geniuses of those superpowers, her talent was excellent. She also wanted to obtain better resources within Tianyuan City to further cultivate and become even more powerful.
Lin Yaoqin’s qualifications might not be on par with those superpower genius disciples, but her strength was not that far behind theirs.
After all, she was considered a hero in the Northern Region.
As her strength grew stronger, she would have considerable influence in the Tianxing Sect and might even use her power to vie for some positions, enabling her to enter that superpower.
She had already considered all this, so she wanted to rely on Lin Yi as a backer to make her way in the Tianxing Sect.
“Well, many participants in the martial arts trial are geniuses from within the Tianxing Sect. I don’t want to conflict with others, so I don’t plan on causing trouble. I aim to achieve good results in this martial arts trial to enter the Tianxing Sect.”
Lin Yi nodded as he spoke.
In fact, Lin Yi also knew many participants were from major powers and attracting attention could be inevitable, something Lin Yi least desired.
“So that’s how it is!”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s explanation, Lin Yaoqin nodded.
“Well, since you are coming with me to participate in the martial arts trial at the Tianxing Sect, you should stay with me for a while. One month later, I will send someone to pick you up. During this time, just stay in your room and cultivate.”
Lin Yi looked at Lin Yaoqin and spoke.
“Okay,” Lin Yaoqin quickly nodded and then obediently stood aside.
Then, Lin Yi and Lin Yaoqin left the room and walked down the building. After exiting the tavern, they walked towards the street.
Inside the tavern, the proprietor, upon realizing that Lin Yaoqin was Lin Yi’s sister, was slightly stunned. He knew Lin Yi’s character was not someone who easily agreed to requests.
Moreover, Lin Yaoqin was so beautiful, and Lin Yi had never brought Lin Yaoqin out before, which greatly astonished the proprietor.
Lin Yi, with Lin Yaoqin in tow, quickly reached the side of the street. Just as Lin Yi was about to leave, his gaze suddenly fell on a black-clad man at the street corner.
The man, noticing Lin Yi’s gaze, also shifted his eyes onto Lin Yi.
The black-clad man was dressed in a black robe, his face veiled, revealing only a pair of pitch-black eyes.
“Hmph, I wondered why he looked so familiar. Turns out it’s you, you wretch. How dare you follow me?”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, then scoffed.
“Hmph, Lin Yi, I don’t care what background you have,” the man in black warned, “I advise you not to mess around, otherwise, you will definitely not be able to escape. My master is a disciple of the Tianxing Sect, and I think, with your reputation this time, you’ll definitely not be able to escape. It’s better for you to stop.”
The man in black swept a cold glance at Lin Yi and then spoke.
“So, you are a disciple of the Tianxing Sect,” Lin Yi said, “I want to ask you, who are you, and why are you appearing outside my Lin residence?”
“Hmph, my name is Ye Feng, from the Tianxing Sect!”
The man in black said indifferently. He then turned around and walked towards Lin Yaoqin, reaching out to grab her shoulder.
This act made some passersby show disdain.
The actions of the man in black were like those of a naughty child playing a prank on someone else. They all thought that Lin Yaoqin was Lin Yi’s sister and that Lin Yi was a core disciple of the Tianxing Sect. Hence, they did not speak out to stop him.
Just as the man in black was about to touch Lin Yaoqin’s shoulder, Lin Yi suddenly made his move, extending his palm and striking the man.
“Bang, bang, bang!”
A series of muffled sounds followed; with each hit, Lin Yi’s palm struck fiercely upon the man’s body, sending him flying and crashing into a building.
“Thud!”
The man, sent flying by Lin Yi’s punch, suddenly spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, his face turning pale, clearly injured.
“My sister is not someone who can be bullied at will.”
Having sent the man flying, Lin Yi then turned around and said to Lin Yaoqin, “Yao’er, this person is a prodigy disciple of the Tianxing Sect. You don’t have to be afraid of him; he wouldn’t dare to harm you.”
Lin Yi’s voice was filled with authority, seemingly exerting a strong oppressive force.
“Okay, brother,” Lin Yaoqin nodded.
Immediately, Lin Yi glared at the injured man in black and coldly shouted, “Get lost, don’t strut around in front of me. If I find you harassing my sister here, I will slay you right on the spot!”
“Lin Yi, don’t push your luck.”
The man in black glared back at Lin Yi and said coldly.
“Hmph, the one who is pushing his luck is you!” Lin Yi snorted coldly, then he turned to Lin Yaoqin and said, “Yao’er, let’s go back.”
With that, Lin Yi took Lin Yaoqin’s arm and left.
Watching Lin Yi’s departing figure, Lin Yaoqin felt a bit helpless. She knew Lin Yi’s temperament well; if she didn’t do as he instructed, he might actually kill the man in black.
Moreover, she knew that Lin Yi’s strength was indeed formidable; with his power at the Fifth Level of the Tianyuan Realm, he was able to defeat a Seventh Grade Spiritual Pill Master, certainly not a weak opponent, so she dared not defy Lin Yi and left the street with him, heading towards the Lin Family.
Watching Lin Yi and Lin Yaoqin leave, the man in black was livid, clenching his teeth in anger, but he did not dare to confront Lin Yi.
He understood that in Tianyuan City, Lin Yi’s influence was greater, and he was just an ordinary disciple, so he could only endure it.
“Damn it, I will definitely seek revenge,” the man in black thought to himself bitterly.
Soon, Lin Yi brought Lin Yaoqin back to the Lin Family, then returned to the academy. He wanted to continue his secluded cultivation, hoping to soon break through to the Ninefold Heaven of the Tianyuan Realm, then return to the Tianxing Sect to seek out the man named Ye Feng.
This man in black was Ye Feng, who had also received orders from Ye Feng to come and find Lin Yi.
Ye Feng knew that once Lin Yi arrived in Tianxing City, he would definitely come looking for him.
Thus, after Lin Yi returned to the academy, he immediately had people begin searching for news of Lin Yi, while also assigning an Inner Sect Disciple of the Tianxing Sect to monitor Lin Yi’s every move.

chapters.title: Chapter 812 - 812 832 Tracking Down
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 812: Chapter 832: Tracking Down Chapter 812: Chapter 832: Tracking Down Ye Feng believed that once the Inner Sect Disciple of the Tianxing Sect had thoroughly investigated Lin Yi’s whereabouts, he would tell him.
Lin Yi returned to the academy and started to focus on his cultivation earnestly.
He did not seek out Lin Yaoqin anymore but quietly stayed inside his room to cultivate.
For several days in a row, Lin Yi was in secluded cultivation, and the Tianxing Sect Inner Sect Disciple, assigned by Ye Feng, would monitor Lin Yi’s situation whenever he had the chance.
However, Ye Feng discovered that aside from practicing outside his room every morning, Lin Yi spent all other times cultivating and did not try to find Lin Yaoqin, which relieved Ye Feng.
“Lin Yi’s cultivation speed is quite fast indeed. Within just a few days, he has already reached the Third Layer of the Second Level. He truly is a young genius with exceptional talent,” Ye Feng thought highly of Lin Yi as he saw this.
“It seems I need to hurry up and increase my strength. Otherwise, once Lin Yi breaks through to the Tianyuan Realm’s Ninefold Heaven, I might not be his match anymore.”
Ye Feng thought to himself silently.
Although in terms of cultivation, Ye Feng was much stronger than Lin Yi, he still wanted to become stronger quickly. After all, only by being strong could he protect Lin Yaoqin properly.
Therefore, Ye Feng also began to cultivate desperately, continually absorbing the spiritual energy from spirit stones, making his cultivation become stronger and stronger.
Time passed day by day, and in the blink of an eye, a month had gone by.
In this month, Lin Yi finally broke through to the Third Layer of the Second Level, reaching the Fourfold Heaven of the Tianyuan Realm.
Lin Yi’s cultivation was already on par with a martial artist of the Sixfold Heaven of the Tianyang Realm, and it was even much stronger than that.
Not only that, since Ye Feng was helping Lin Yaoqin manage the Lin Family’s estate while cultivating over these days, he had also gained a lot of understanding of the Lin Family’s affairs. He had practically figured out everything about the Lin Family.
So, after Lin Yi broke through to the Fourfold Heaven of the Tianyuan Realm, Ye Feng’s mind was much more at ease, and his cultivation had also reached the peak of the Tianyuan Realm’s Fourfold Heaven, ready to step into the Fivefold Heaven at any moment—it was just a matter of time.
Lin Yi returned to his room and was about to start cultivating when Lin Yaoqin walked in.
“Daddy.”
Seeing Lin Yi return to his room, Lin Yaoqin called out.
Lin Yi stopped cultivating, looked at Lin Yaoqin, nodded slightly, and then asked her, “Yao’er, is there something you need?”
“Daddy, I heard you’ve returned to Tianyuan City? And you’re staying with the Lin Family?” Lin Yaoqin asked Lin Yi with a smile.
“That’s right, Yao’er, how did you know?”
Lin Yi asked Lin Yaoqin, puzzled.
“Daddy, have you forgotten I’m the Young Miss of Tianxiang Country? Of course, I knew you were staying in Tianyuan City. And all these matters were arranged by that guy named Ye Feng. You won’t blame me, will you?”
“How could I?” Lin Yi shook his head and said with a smile.
“Then I can rest assured. I was worried that you wouldn’t be happy with me meddling in these affairs,” Lin Yaoqin said with a sigh of relief.
Lin Yi chuckled and replied, “Silly child, why would you think that? You’re my daughter, and I will take care of your affairs—there’s no need to be afraid of me getting angry.”
“Mmm, then I’m relieved,” Lin Yaoqin said happily, and it was clear she was a very sensible child.
“Daddy, you didn’t come back this time just to find that man named Ye, did you? It was to find your disciple, wasn’t it?”
Lin Yaoqin suddenly asked, and with that question, Lin Yi’s expression instantly turned somber.
“Yao’er, don’t worry about this matter; just focus on your cultivation. The reason I’ve returned is to see just how strong that Ye family guy really is, daring to bully you. I definitely won’t let him off,” Lin Yi said with a grim expression on his face.
Lin Yi’s heart was filled with hostility towards Ye Feng.
In Lin Yi’s heart, he had very deep feelings for Lin Yaoqin, so he decided that no matter what, he had to teach that Ye Feng guy a lesson.
“Okay, I’ll listen to you,” Lin Yaoqin obediently said, and then she sat down by the bed.
“Yao’er, stay in Tianyuan City for this period, and don’t leave. Daddy will stay at the Lin Residence for two more days before leaving,” Lin Yi instructed.
“Okay, I got it. Daddy, you go ahead with your busy schedule!!!” Lin Yaoqin obediently agreed, then stood up and walked out.
Seeing Lin Yaoqin leave, Lin Yi sighed and soon left the room to walk outside as well.
Lin Yi had just gone out when he saw Lin Xuan coming back from outside.
Seeing Lin Xuan, he frowned immediately, snorted coldly at Lin Xuan, and then went straight to his own room without paying any further attention to Lin Xuan.
“Daddy…” Lin Xuan was stunned by Lin Yi’s indifference. He was perplexed; why had Lin Yi become so cold all of a sudden? He always had been very enthusiastic in treating him in the past. What was going on?
Not only was Lin Xuan confused, but Lin Yi was also baffled, as before, Lin Yi hadn’t been aware that his father-daughter relationship with Lin Xuan was very good.
Lin Xuan approached Lin Yi’s door and knocked, but Lin Yi simply did not open the door for Lin Xuan, seeming very displeased with him.
“Daddy, what’s wrong with you?” Lin Xuan said helplessly, staring at the door.
“Get lost!!!” Lin Yi’s angry voice came from inside.
Lin Xuan gave a wry smile, turned, and walked away, but after a few steps, he turned back to Lin Yi’s door.
Lin Xuan raised his hand again to continue knocking.
No matter what, he had to see his father. He had so many things he wanted to talk about with his father. He felt there were too many misunderstandings between them that needed to be cleared up.
This time, Lin Yi finally opened the door. Seeing Lin Xuan standing at his doorstep, Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed, flashing with icy murderous intent.
Startled by the murderous intent in Lin Yi’s eyes, Lin Xuan quickly said, “Daddy, I have a lot to talk to you about, and I hope you can give me a little time to clarify things.”
