“Hmph, no time. Get away from me, or else I’ll kill you,” Lin Yi stared fiercely at Lin Xuan.
Lin Yi’s tone was very firm, as if he had made a certain decision and was unwilling to waste another word on Lin Xuan.
Under Lin Yi’s piercing gaze, Lin Xuan’s heart contracted, sending a shiver through his body.
“Daddy, no matter how you treat me, I am still your flesh and blood. Can you really bear to strike me down? Do you really want to let the Lin Family come to an end like this?”
Lin Xuan’s heart was extremely turbulent, and he was in agony.
At his words, Lin Yi just gave a cold laugh and said, “My Lin Yi’s life has never had the possibility of coming to an end. If you were really my child, of course, I would take good care of you, but unfortunately, you are not. You are not at all.”
Lin Yi’s words made Lin Xuan’s face extremely ugly.
He was indeed not Lin Yi’s biological child. Lin Yi had been searching for his wife all these years, but he had never found her. Only recently had he discovered that his own wife was actually Lin Yi’s sworn sister.
How could Lin Yi’s sworn sister have married him?

chapters.title: Chapter 813 - 813 833 Always Searching for Wife
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 813: Chapter 833: Always Searching for Wife Chapter 813: Chapter 833: Always Searching for Wife Could there really be some relationship between him and Lin Yi’s mother?
“Ha-ha, Lin Xuan,” you should go back to training soon. Your current strength is still too weak. If you keep training, I’m afraid you won’t even be able to catch up with me.”
Lin Yi snorted coldly and then slammed the door shut, not paying any attention to Lin Xuan and left directly.
Seeing Lin Yi shut the door like that, Lin Xuan felt somewhat sad because of Lin Yi’s icy tone.
“Dad…” Lin Xuan murmured in a dispirited voice and eventually left sorrowfully, returning to his own room.
After returning to his room, Lin Xuan sat down and closed his eyes to begin training.
Although Lin Xuan didn’t know what was wrong, he only knew that as soon as he saw Lin Yi, he felt resentment in his heart. His heart was very uncomfortable.
Lin Yi watched Lin Xuan leave and did not interfere further. After all, he could not physically attack Lin Xuan now and could only silently warn him not to provoke his anger.
Before they knew it, it was dinnertime.
Lin Yi had his dinner and walked out of his room to Lin Xuan’s room. He arrived at Lin Xuan’s door and kicked it, but there was no response.
“Huh? Is the door broken?” Lin Yi was puzzled and then kicked it a few more times, but the door still did not open.
Seeing the door unresponsive, Lin Yi frowned and then kicked it violently with all his strength.
His fist clenched tightly, and then he smashed it furiously against the door.
Boom!!!
A thunderous sound, deafening.
Lin Xuan’s door was kicked off its hinges by Lin Yi in a single blow.
After being knocked off, the door struck the doorframe and shattered into several pieces. Lin Xuan also fell to the ground as a result.
Lin Xuan lay on the ground, blood oozing from the corner of his mouth, clearly, he had been severely injured by Lin Yi’s powerful kick.
Looking at the door he had kicked in, Lin Yi felt very happy.
Though he did not know why he felt so joyful, he really enjoyed this violent action.
“How… how could you do this!” Lying on the ground, Lin Xuan looked up at Lin Yi and couldn’t help but question.
“What do you mean, how could I do this? If I hadn’t done this, would you have thanked me? Hmph! I, Lin Yi, will never acknowledge you as my son!” Lin Yi snorted coldly, then turned around and left the place.
Seeing Lin Yi’s attitude, Lin Xuan was infuriated, but he was helpless.
In the Lin Mansion, Lin Yi was stronger than him. In front of Lin Yi, he could only bow his head.
He had to swallow his anger.
He felt indignant, but there was nothing he could do.
Lin Xuan had to suppress his inner anger, not letting on his identity, as Lin Yi might indeed order him killed.
Lin Yi’s power was too overwhelming. If Lin Xuan hadn’t reached the Golden Core Realm, he would have no power to resist and would have to be obediently slaughtered by Lin Yi.
“Dad, I will definitely train hard to meet your expectations soon, and then I will definitely help you reclaim what belongs to you,” Lin Xuan vowed determinedly in his heart.
After leaving the Lin Mansion, Lin Yi immediately went to Lin Aoxue’s yard.
Upon entering the yard, Lin Yi hurried straight to Lin Aoxue who was training inside the house.
“Aoxue!” Lin Yi shouted loudly.
Hearing Lin Yi’s cry, Lin Aoxue opened her eyes and was immediately startled when she saw him.
She had never expected Lin Yi to come looking for her. Why was he looking for her?
Could it be that he had discovered her affair with Lin Aotian?
“Why have you come?” Lin Aoxue asked.
“Of course, it’s something important; I have an urgent matter to discuss with you!” Lin Yi replied.
Lin Aoxue, after hearing Lin Yi’s words, slightly frowned, “What is it? Just say it!”
“I hope that you can break off your engagement with Lin Xuan and marry me instead!” Lin Yi said.
Lin Aoxue was taken aback, her beautiful eyes widened, and her face instantly turned pale.
She had never thought that Lin Yi would ask her to marry him.
“Aoxue, are you really going to get engaged to Lin Xuan?” Lin Yi asked displeasedly.
“This matter has nothing to do with you, please leave!” Lin Aoxue said, then she immediately stood up, ready to leave.
Seeing this, Lin Yi quickly blocked Lin Aoxue, “Aoxue, are you really going to break off the engagement with him?”
“Get out!” Lin Aoxue said.
“Do you really hate me that much?” Lin Yi asked.
“It’s not that I hate you, I just don’t want to be involved with you. Rest assured! Once I reach the Nascent Soul Stage, I will definitely propose to break off the engagement to my master, and I will explain everything to him at that time,” Lin Aoxue said coldly.
Hearing Lin Aoxue’s words, Lin Yi was also very angry, but he dared not do anything to Lin Aoxue.
“Fine! I agree to your terms, but first, you must break off the engagement, otherwise, I won’t be courteous to you later!” After saying this, Lin Yi also turned and left.
After Lin Yi left, Lin Aoxue sighed deeply. She was very troubled, never having expected Lin Yi to make such a demand.
She didn’t want to break off her engagement with Lin Yi because she had already fallen in love with Lin Xuan, so she had to keep him.
However, she couldn’t defy her master’s orders, hence she had to let Lin Xuan break off their engagement.
Just as Lin Yi had left, a cold gleam suddenly flashed in Lin Xuan’s eyes.
“Sister apprentice, since you wish so dearly to marry me, I will fulfill your wish! But don’t forget what you owe me. I want not only to marry you but also to imprison you by my side!” Lin Xuan thought to himself.
Lin Yi returned to his residence and thumped down into a chair.
His hands clenched tightly.
This Lin Xuan was really infuriating, daring to lay his hands on him!
However, Lin Xuan also had some abilities, managing to defeat him.
“Lin Xuan, this time, I want you dead!” Lin Yi snorted coldly.
Then, Lin Yi picked up a Jade Slip from the table and injected his Spiritual Sense into it.
Moments later, Lin Yi’s sinister voice echoed in a secluded hall, “Go and investigate Lin Xuan’s background for me, and get me the information on that girl!”
“Yes, young master!” an elder responded.
After the elder left the hall, Lin Yi’s gaze once again fell on the Jade Slip.
His eyes were full of ruthless intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 814 - 814 834 Eyes Filled with Icy Killing Intent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 814: Chapter 834: Eyes Filled with Icy Killing Intent Chapter 814: Chapter 834: Eyes Filled with Icy Killing Intent His eyes carried a chilling intent to kill.
“Lin Xuan, I absolutely will not let you go!”
Lin Yi murmured to himself, and immediately, a venomous look appeared in his eyes.
“Since you want to fight me so badly, this time, I’ll make you lose completely! I will personally take your life!”
A cold light flickered in Lin Yi’s eyes.
The figure of Lin Xuan slowly disappeared into the air.
The next morning, Lin Xuan arrived outside the City Lord’s Mansion.
Lin Xuan did not immediately enter the City Lord’s Mansion. He needed to adjust his mindset and then enter the mansion.
After all, he was now a member of the Lin Family, and if others saw him looking like this, it would certainly stir up gossip.
Lin Xuan found a secluded spot and began to regulate his breath.
Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, half a day had gone by.
Lin Xuan opened his eyes.
Then, he charged straight towards the City Lord’s Mansion.
The guards inside the City Lord’s Mansion were taken aback, then immediately shouted out, “Who goes there?”
“Lin Yi!” Lin Xuan uttered indifferently, before charging directly out.
Those two guards were simply no match for Lin Xuan.
They could only watch helplessly as Lin Xuan stormed into the City Lord’s Mansion.
“Lin Xuan?”
“Lin Xuan?”
Upon hearing the noise, the guards in the City Lord’s Mansion also ran out to see, and one by one, they were dumbfounded.
“That… is that Young Master Lin Yi?” One of them pointed at Lin Xuan and said.
“It seems so!” Another one nodded.
“How did he get in? Could it be that he was brought in by the young master?” One of them asked, puzzled.
“Who cares!” Another one spoke.
By this time, Lin Xuan had already walked briskly to the front of the main hall, anger flickering in his eyes. He lifted his head to look.
Lin Yi was sitting in the seat of honor, smiling at him.
“You really are bold, daring to ignore my words.” Lin Yi’s mouth curved into a smile.
“What do you mean, Lin Yi? Aren’t you afraid of causing trouble with this behavior?” Lin Xuan said coldly.
“Trouble? I would really like to know what trouble can cancel my marriage engagement.” Lin Yi sneered with mockery in his eyes.
“Lin Xuan, you don’t deserve my junior sister. If you still want to continue canceling the engagement with her, then kneel down and kowtow to me three hundred times, or else, don’t blame me for being impolite!” Lin Yi threatened menacingly.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the people around inhaled a breath of cold air.
This Lin Yi was too arrogant, actually demanding Lin Xuan kneel before him?
The many cultivators present also couldn’t help but whisper amongst themselves.
They felt very angry about Lin Yi’s behavior.
Lin Yi was really too arrogant!
Upon hearing this, Lin Xuan’s face also became extremely awkward, and at the same time, his fists clenched even tighter.
He really wanted to slap Lin Yi’s face.
“Kneel and bow my head? Lin Yi, I’m telling you, it’s impossible in this lifetime!” Lin Xuan snorted coldly.
“Is that so? Well then, don’t blame me!” Lin Yi sneered, and then he waved his hand.
“Swish swish swish swish swish!”
In an instant, dozens of black-clothed, masked men flew out from all around the City Lord’s Mansion.
These masked men, each of them wore an iron mask on their faces, hiding their appearances.
They each emitted an extremely dense Blood Fiend Energy and as soon as they appeared, they began to surround Lin Xuan.
“These people are Lin Yi’s personal bodyguards, with incredibly strong abilities!” Someone spoke up.
“I knew it, how could Lin Yi let Lin Xuan leave so easily, it turns out he was planning to deal with Lin Xuan ruthlessly!”
“Poor Lin Xuan, this time, I’m afraid he’s walking a path of certain death!”
The people around, upon seeing this group of masked men, also shook their heads one after another.
Lin Yi’s methods were indeed very vicious!
They all knew that Lin Yi had suffered several losses at the hands of the useless Lin Xuan, so he had prepared other ways to deal with him.
Lin Yi looked at the group of masked men around him and a cruel smile arose at the corner of his mouth.
“Kill them! Don’t leave a single survivor!” Lin Yi said coldly.
Following Lin Yi’s command, the masked men charged towards Lin Xuan.
The dozens of masked men, each holding weapons, had a touch of cold smile on their faces.
Lin Xuan looked at the group of masked men charging at him and frowned slightly.
He didn’t panic, because Lin Yi, being here, simply couldn’t hurt him.
Thus, Lin Xuan didn’t take Lin Yi’s words to heart.
“Lin Yi, since that’s the case, today I’ll let you witness my methods!” Lin Xuan huffed coldly, and at once, he lightly tapped with the tip of his foot.
His figure soared into the high sky, then his right arm violently stretched out, and he threw a punch!
“Bang!”
A dull sound erupted, and right after that, Lin Xuan’s right arm went right through the chests of the dozens of masked men.
“Ahh!” The dozens of masked men let out a piercing scream.
Their bodies, as if hit by a heavy blow, were sent flying backward.
Thump, thump…
In an instant, their bodies crashed outside the hall, all falling to the ground, not one able to stand up.
“You all go and join your friends,” said Lin Xuan, turning his head to look at Lin Yi with a cold voice.
“This, impossible! Who, exactly, are you?!” Lin Yi exclaimed in shock, and then, Dark Energy began to surge from his body.
“Dark Energy? Is this Lin Yi’s true strength?” Someone watched the scene in amazement, their eyes full of horror.
“Lin Yi, your methods may be despicable, but in my eyes, they are still not enough!”
Lin Xuan sneered, and countless Sword Qi surged from his body.
“Sword Qi?!”
Seeing this scene, Lin Yi’s face turned pale in an instant.
He had personally experienced the power of Sword Qi.
Such might was too terrifying.
“Lin Xuan, consider yourself lucky, I’ll spare your dog’s life today! But I won’t let you off easily, you just wait and see,” Lin Yi said through clenched teeth.
After saying this, Lin Yi turned around and left the place.
After Lin Yi left, the surrounding cultivators also started discussing among themselves.
“Lin Yi really is getting more and more arrogant, even daring to provoke Lin Xuan, it seems Lin Yi is tired of living.”
“That’s right, Lin Xuan’s performance at the Martial Arts Academy was impeccable, even surpassing the Academy’s headmaster. It won’t be easy for Lin Yi to defeat him!”
“This time, Lin Yi has probably really kicked an iron board!”
“I doubt it.”
“But with Lin Xuan’s strength being so strong, he mustn’t be an ordinary expert, right! This time, Lin Yi has probably really kicked an iron board!”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 815 - 815 835 Most People Are Relatively Optimistic
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 815: Chapter 835: Most People Are Relatively Optimistic Chapter 815: Chapter 835: Most People Are Relatively Optimistic For a time, voices of various discussions arose, but most people were still quite optimistic, believing Lin Yi would win.
It wasn’t just others; even the nearby Lin Ao thought so.
After all, he was very clear about Lin Xuan’s strength.
Lin Xuan’s power had reached the peak of the Fifth Rank of the Qi Transformation Realm.
Although it was only a one Rank difference, it was a difference between two major Levels.
The Fifth Rank of the Qi Transformation Realm and the Fourth Rank of the Qi Transformation Realm were not on the same level at all.
Lin Ao looked at the figure in the distance, his eyes flickering.
Lin Xuan was undoubtedly a formidable enemy.
At this time, those masked men also slowly retreated, making way for a path.
“Lin Xuan, you can get lost now!” Lin Yi’s face showed a hint of mocking sneer.
“Is that so? I never said I would ‘get lost’!”
“Since that’s the case, let me show you my power, let you understand what a true powerhouse is!” Lin Xuan sneered coldly, his eyes sparkling with brilliance.
His figure moved, charging directly towards those masked men.
Seeing this scene, the cultivators surrounding Lin Xuan all stepped back, not daring to advance.
“Seize Lin Xuan for me!”
Seeing that the masked men did not budge, Lin Yi’s mouth curled with a savage smile.
“Swoosh!”
Lin Yi waved his hand, and immediately about a dozen masked men rushed out together.
“All of you, attack together.”
A playful grin hung on Lin Xuan’s face.
“Seeking death!”
Hearing Lin Xuan’s words, the dozen or so masked men shouted angrily, the Longsword in their hands charging towards Lin Xuan.
“Swoosh!”
Lin Xuan’s figure flashed and vanished from the spot, appearing in front of one of the masked men.
His fist swung out fiercely, smashing hard into the masked man.
“Bang bang bang bang…”
The next moment, Lin Xuan fiercely attacked the chest of the masked man, blasting him away.
“Agh!”
The masked man sent flying by Lin Xuan let out a shrill scream, then instantly passed out.
At this time, Lin Yi’s eyes also widened, his face filled with shock.
How could Lin Xuan’s speed be so fast!
Who on earth was this guy?
Filled with endless doubts, Lin Yi did not hesitate; his figure flickered, charging again towards Lin Xuan.
Lin Yi’s body was like a phantom, appearing behind Lin Xuan in the blink of an eye.
Subsequently, Lin Yi’s hand reached out, grabbing directly at Lin Xuan’s head.
Seeing Lin Yi’s move, Lin Xuan did not resist, letting Lin Yi grab his neck.
“Crack!”
The next moment, the fingers that seized Lin Xuan’s neck harshly crushed Lin Xuan’s throat.
A bitter smile appeared on Lin Xuan’s face.
“I’ve lost,” Lin Xuan said indifferently.
Afterward, his body slowly fell from midair to the ground.
Lin Yi’s body stopped at this moment as well.
Looking at Lin Xuan lying on the ground, Lin Yi’s face was filled with endless rage.
In his eyes blazed an intense fury.
“All of you go to hell! Whoever dares to give up resisting is opposing me, is opposing Lin Xuan, and their end will be very miserable!”
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, everyone trembled, and soon, they all started to flee frantically.
These people, although sent by Lin Yi, were also fans of Lin Xuan!
If Lin Xuan were to die, wouldn’t they too suffer the consequences?
Therefore, they had to flee at once, or else Lin Yi would take out his anger on them, and that would be their doom.
So for a time, the masked men were fleeing frantically.
Lin Yi watched those fleeing with a smile growing wider on his lips.
This battle, he had won for sure!
…
“Look, Lin Xuan actually died by Lin Yi’s hand.”
“Yes! He was a Seventh Rank Qi Transformation Realm powerhouse!”
“I never expected Lin Yi to be this powerful!”
Seeing Lin Xuan’s death, everyone gasped in shock.
Many cultivators felt somewhat discontented.
Because for years they had been oppressed by Lin Yi, so they had long wanted to find an opportunity to get revenge, but Lin Yi was too strong, they simply had no way to do it.
But now it was different, Lin Yi had become a cripple, and Lin Xuan naturally had no concerns, so they naturally wanted to take a good breath of malice.
“Lin Xuan’s strength is very formidable, we’d better not provoke him.”
“Yeah, if Lin Xuan holds a grudge against us, that would be troublesome.”
Hearing the discussions of the people around him, Lin Yi’s heart swelled with a sense of pride even more.
His father, indeed, lived up to his reputation as the third-ranked genius, truly powerful.
“Don’t be too proud for too long, soon all your brothers and sisters will become the ghosts beneath your sword,” Lin Yi said, a cold smile on his face, seeing Lin Xuan’s expression.
“Lin Yi, you really deserve to die!” Lin Xuan said coldly.
“Lin Xuan, that line, should be what I say to you!” Lin Yi also wore a look of disdain, and then turned and left.
…
After Lin Xuan was killed, his entire team was annihilated.
Lin Yi, too, completely vented his anger.
Moreover, all the treasures on Lin Xuan’s body were also taken by him.
“Lin Xuan, I await your challenge!”
After Lin Yi left, a cold voice also entered the ears of the crowd.
All of this was part of Lin Yi’s plan.
“This guy is too despicable; he even killed Lin Xuan!”
“Yes, it’s really hateful!”
“Lin Yi, you really are a devil!”
Some of the masked people couldn’t help but curse, anger emerging in their eyes as well.
But in the face of Lin Yi’s power, what could they do?
“Don’t worry, they will soon go to accompany Lin Xuan.”
“Hmph!”
Lin Yi snorted coldly, and regardless of what those people thought, he directly left the place.
In his heart, he was still thinking about what just happened.
Lin Xuan’s strength really had exceeded his expectations!
And the fact that Lin Xuan could dodge his attack further proved that Lin Xuan had strength not inferior to his own.
“Lin Xuan, I wonder if you can withstand my sword!”
Lin Yi’s face carried a hint of a sinister shade.
Immediately, an ancient Bronze Sword appeared in his hand.
Terrifying fluctuations emanated from this sword, causing the surrounding void to tremble.
“Die!”
Along with Lin Yi’s thunderous shout, he slashed down with his sword, carrying a destructive power.
“Boom rumble~”
This sword contained terrifying power, as if it could obliterate anything in its path.
Once struck by this sword, if not dead, then severely injured.
“Boom!”
But at this moment, an enormous black shadow suddenly burst forth.

chapters.title: Chapter 816 - 836: A Young Man
chapters.content:
"What is that!"
Lin Yi’s pupils shrank, and he quickly stopped his attack.
For he saw a young man standing atop the dark shadow.
It was Lin Xuan.
At this moment, Lin Xuan’s face was filled with a cold and sinister gaze, looking at Lin Yi as if he were merely prey.
This sent a chill through Lin Yi’s body, a chill rising in his heart.
"You’re still alive?"
Lin Yi narrowed his eyes, his face filled with astonishment.
He knew that his last strike was powerful enough to instantly kill a Ninth Level Martial Artist of the Qi Transformation Realm.
Yet now, Lin Yi hadn’t managed to kill Lin Xuan!
"Yes, your strike didn’t kill me,"
"Your power is only slightly stronger than the Peak of the Fifth Layer of the Qi Transformation Realm."
Lin Xuan said with a cold laugh.
"Your power has actually increased to the Eighth Layer of the Qi Transformation Realm! You have ascended two realms in the shortest time!"
A look of disbelief flashed across Lin Yi’s face.
His own strength was at the Peak of the Sixth Layer of the Qi Transformation Realm.
Yet, he couldn’t defeat Lin Xuan of the Eighth Layer of the Qi Transformation Realm.
Moreover, the key point was that Lin Xuan had just suffered heavy injuries.
It almost seemed like a joke.
"Lin Yi, you are too foolish. My power had already broken through the bottleneck."
"Moreover, I have already formed my Nascent Soul. Both my physical body and Nascent Soul far exceed those of an ordinary Sixth Layer Martial Artist of the Qi Transformation Realm, so your attack can’t affect me at all."
Lin Xuan said calmly.
His body had already reached the Eighth Layer of the Qi Transformation Realm, and his physical strength was even several times stronger than that of a normal Eighth Layer Martial Artist!
"I see!"
Upon hearing Lin Xuan’s explanation, Lin Yi suddenly realized.
No wonder his sword had only managed to send Lin Xuan flying.
It seemed his own strength was still too weak.
"Since you have survived, there is no need for me to stay. I’ll send you to reunite with Lin Xuan!"
A bloodthirsty smile appeared on Lin Yi’s face.
Lin Xuan, he must be killed!
"Humph, it’s not certain yet who will die."
A mocking smile also appeared on Lin Xuan’s face.
"Humph, since that’s the case, I’ll kill you first, then kill them."
A cold murderous intent flickered in Lin Yi’s eyes.
Lin Yi was also preparing to make his move.
"Boom!"
Just then, an explosion sounded, echoing far and wide, causing all the cultivators in the city to look towards Lin Yi and the others.
"Eh? What happened?"
"Why did it suddenly explode?"
"Not sure, but something serious must have happened."
In the city, countless cultivators, all treasure hunters from other places, started to discuss.
However, they had never encountered such a scene before.
This piqued their curiosity, so they all quickly congregated towards that area.
Soon, many figures rapidly gathered.
When they saw the tragic sight in that direction, their faces revealed a look of shock.
The entire airspace had been leveled.
Everywhere, there were piles of rubble and broken wood.
The place had almost turned into scorched earth.
And there, bodies were lying around, all chopped up and shattered.
A stench wafted through the air, nauseating to behold.
This, indeed, was the trace left by a cultivator of the Seventh or Eighth Layer of the Qi Transformation Realm.
"What on earth is going on?"
"This airspace seems to be left by martial artists below the Seventh Layer of the Qi Transformation Realm, their strength at most reaching the Seventh Layer."
"These bodies do not seem to belong to those below the Seventh Layer of the Qi Transformation Realm, could something have happened?"
On the city walls, the cultivators all looked down in astonishment.
"Not good! That kid has escaped, I have no idea what happened here!"
Just then, a cultivator with a pale face and a frightened look shouted.
He had seen that even when Lin Yi and others teamed up, they could not take down Lin Xuan.
"Damn it!"
Hearing the cultivator’s words, a flash of anger also crossed Lin Yi’s face.
Although Lin Xuan was the weakest among them, he still could not kill him.
"Hmph, you’re lucky, but rest assured, I will definitely seek revenge on you."
Lin Yi snorted coldly, his figure flickered, and he disappeared from the spot.
He needed to report this matter to Lin Tianyu quickly and have Lin Tianyu dispatch a powerful cultivator to deal with Lin Xuan.
Not only Lin Yi, but Lin Tianyu had also received the news of Lin Xuan’s severe injuries and had immediately sent people to hunt down Lin Xuan.
After Lin Xuan was severely injured, cultivators rushed to the scene one after another, all of them with a mindset of watching the drama and waiting for the outcome.
"Boom! Boom!"
Soon after, Lin Yi arrived at the city gate.
He looked at the guarding cultivator, his eyes brimming with deep resentment, "Where is Lin Xuan, hand him over!"
"I don’t know what you’re talking about."
The guarding cultivator revealed a disdainful expression.
"You bastard, I’m asking you a question! Do you dare not answer?"
Lin Yi became furious.
His status and stature had never been scorned like this before.
"I really don’t know what you’re talking about."
"Don’t speak, then get lost!"
"I want to see what right you have to be arrogant in front of me!"
"You’re seeking death!"
Lin Yi roared, his aura exploding out, instantly enveloping the guarding cultivator.
"Pfft!"
The next moment, fresh blood spilled from the corner of the cultivator’s mouth, his face turning extremely pale.
"How... could this happen?"
The cultivator looked at Lin Yi, unable to utter a single word.
At this time, he felt as if something was blocking his chest.
He wanted to cough, but the cough brought up nothing at all.
And his body continued to crumble, turning to ash, completely dissipating.
"Ah!!!"
A horrifying scream resounded within the space.
Hearing that sound, the cultivators on the city walls also involuntarily shivered.
This guy was simply too brutal, even killing a mere guard.
"How ruthless!"
A group of cultivators cursed inwardly.
"Lin Yi! You bastard! I’m going to fight you!"
At that moment, the cultivator killed by Lin Yi screamed madly.
"You’re overestimating yourself!"
Seeing that the other party still dared to resist, Lin Yi sneered coldly.
The next moment, his figure flickered to the side of that cultivator.
Then, he slapped him, immediately turning the cultivator into a cloud of dust.
"How ferocious Lin Yi is!"
At that time, the cultivators on the city walls had their eyes wide open.
Lin Yi’s strength was truly terrifying!

chapters.title: Chapter 817 - 837: Two Figures
chapters.content:
"Where is Lin Xuan? Hand him over!"
"If you don’t, I’ll make you beg for life but crave for death!"
"Hand over Lin Xuan, and maybe I’ll consider sparing your life."
"..."
Lin Yi swept his gaze around the cultivators on the city walls, speaking coldly.
"Lin Xuan is my brother. If anyone is going to hand him over, it should be us!"
An icy voice followed.
Then, two figures leaped down from the city tower.
"Lin Ao, you’ve finally decided to show yourself."
Seeing the two figures, a vicious light flickered in Lin Yi’s eyes.
"I told you, Lin Xuan is my younger brother, and I will save him!"
"You won’t leave this place without handing him over!"
Lin Ao spoke sternly, exuding the dominaance of a king.
"The two of you, get out of my way. Today, I am determined—no one will stop me!"
"Otherwise, I’ll destroy this city."
Lin Yi let out a cold laugh, his gaze fixed icily on Lin Ao on the city tower.
"Do you really think you can destroy this city with your own strength?"
"I say you’re dreaming, overestimating yourself."
Beside them, Lin Ao’s mockery rang out.
"Where is Lin Xuan, hand him over! If not, I will make you beg for life but crave for death!"
"Ha ha!"
Hearing Lin Ao’s voice, Lin Yi also burst into derisive laughter.
His eyes filled with a cold murderous intent, staring at Lin Ao, he said coldly, "Lin Ao, since you’re seeking death, I’ll oblige!"
The next moment, he swung his fist ferociously towards Lin Ao.
"Seeking death!"
Seeing Lin Yi’s action, Lin Ao’s eyes also emitted a sharp glint.
Holding a long spear in his hand, his form flickered, and he engaged in a fierce battle with Lin Yi.
Their fight was earth-shattering.
The two figures constantly clashed, each encounter unleashing deafening explosions.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
The two exchanged blows while attacking.
The surrounding buildings turned to ruins under their combat.
And in the aftermath of their fight, the city walls were riddled with cracks, like a spiderweb.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
Lin Yi and Lin Ao, rampaging and creating towering waves.
But these waves only paused them momentarily before once again raging on.
"Ptui!"
Suddenly, Lin Yi spewed out mouthful of blood.
Lin Ao’s face paleed as well, and his body retreated significantly.
"You’ve lost!"
Lin Yi watched Lin Ao coolly, speaking indifferently.
"Have I?"
The corner of Lin Ao’s mouth revealed a mocking smile, "I have not yet exerted my full strength!"
Lin Yi frowned, sensing that an inexplicable power was continuously infusing into Lin Ao’s body.
This power was so special it caused a stinging sensation in Lin Yi’s soul.
"This..."
Lin Yi’s face changed dramatically, and then, his eyes conveyed a sense of horror.
He was all too familiar with this sensation.
He had seen it before!
His father had once used the same method to slay a Saint Heir level cultivator from the Lin Clan.
"Damn it, could it be... Lin Xuan was really captured by them?"
Thinking of this, Lin Yi’s expression grew even more distressed.
And just at this moment, a figure from a distance suddenly flew over.
"Young Master, Young Master, you have finally come out of seclusion!"
A strong oppressive aura exuded from the newcomer’s body.
This person was none other than the old crone who had fled with Lin Xuan from the Heavenly Star Academy.
"Is it you?"
Seeing the old crone, Lin Yi narrowed his eyes and immediately revealed a sinister smile.
"You old hag, I remember you promised me you would absolutely not help Lin Xuan."
"Now it looks like you have blatantly betrayed me!"
Hearing Lin Yi’s voice, a trace of regret flashed through the old crone’s eyes.
She hadn’t expected to end up betraying Lin Ao.
For her, this was an utterly humiliating disgrace.
"I, I didn’t mean to..."
Seeing Lin Yi’s expression, panic flooded the old crone’s heart.
She wanted to explain but didn’t know how, she just lowered her head, not daring to look Lin Yi in the eye.
"No matter whether it was intentional or not, it’s too late to change what happened."
"Whether you were forced or not, you must die!"
Lin Yi snorted coldly, his eyes twinkling with a cold glimmer.
The next moment, Lin Yi’s figure burst forth, holding a bronze ancient sword, slashing down at the old crone.
"No!"
Seeing this, the old crone also let out a cry of alarm.
A thin film surfaced over her body.
It was her cultivated Protective Gang Qi, capable of blocking an attack from someone at the Martial Venerable Realm.
However, against the bronze ancient sword in Lin Yi’s hands, the Protective Gang Qi shattered directly.
Lin Yi’s bronze ancient sword pierced through the old crone’s body, bringing up a spray of crimson blood.
The old crone’s body was cleaved away by Lin Yi with one stroke.
"Spurt!"
A deep, bone-exposed wound was left on the old crone’s chest.
Blood flowed down the wound, quickly staining the ground red.
Seeing this scene, not only Lin Yi but also the other Cultivators from the Lin Family regarded it with solemn eyes.
They knew that Lin Yi had not used his full strength just now.
Otherwise, with his power, he could have instantly killed the old crone!
However, even so, the old crone’s eyes still bore a hint of confusion.
Fear spread across her face.
"How could this be, I clearly dodged it, why am I still injured?"
She murmured to herself.
"Don’t ask me why, because that’s not something I can understand."
Watching this scene, Lin Yi said indifferently.
"However, your life, I will definitely not spare."
"Today, I will avenge Lin Xuan!"
Lin Yi’s eyes sharpened, and a thick murderous intent rose in that moment.
Then, he looked up at the sky, the killing intent in his eyes growing even more intense.
"I want to see just how long Lin Xuan can hold out in my hands."
"When his Primordial Spirit is completely extinguished, you will die along with him!"
As Lin Yi’s cold words fell, he suddenly surged forth, the bronze ancient sword in his hand sweeping out.
The sword’s radiance was brilliant, as if it could slash the heavens.
"Boom!"
A loud noise echoed through the void.
In the instant the sword’s radiance swept out, the Lin Family estate was also completely destroyed.
"Spurt!"
A figure was blasted away and crashed heavily into the ground.
That person was the old crone.
Blood spurted from her mouth, and her aura was extremely weak.
Seeing this, a cruel arc formed on the corners of Lin Yi’s mouth.
He walked up to the old crone, his eyes glinting with a venomous light.

chapters.title: Chapter 818 - 838 Completely Unprepared
chapters.content:
"I’ve said before, your life is mine to decide!"
After saying this, he stomped his foot onto the old crone’s head.
"Pfft!"
Blood spurted out from the old crone’s mouth.
"You... I am Lin Xuan’s mother! Killing me like this, Lin Xuan will never forgive you!"
Watching Lin Yi’s expression, a look of terror and rage appeared on the old crone’s face, as she screeched hysterically.
She had never imagined that Lin Xuan’s son would lay hands on her.
And moreover, she was caught completely off guard, directly getting rid of her.
"Don’t mention that bastard Lin Xuan."
Intense killing intent surged in Lin Yi’s eyes, as he said, "Back then, you promised me that you would never aid Lin Xuan, but now, you’ve broken your word! I will never let you off lightly!"
"Also, since you have chosen to betray Lin Xuan, you must pay the price!"
Lin Yi’s hand shot out suddenly, his fingers formed into a claw, fiercely pressing onto the old crone’s forehead, attempting to tear her head off.
However, at that moment, a purple light suddenly burst forth from the old crone’s eyes.
It was a purple flame, like purple thunder, enveloping her.
"Boom!"
The purple thunder raged, like a giant net, instantly enveloping Lin Yi within it.
Lin Yi’s pupils contracted sharply, a look of surprise on his face.
"So you are actually a Holy King, and you even have the Purple Flame Divine Thunder!"
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, a cold smile surfaced on the old crone’s face: "That’s right, I have long become a Holy King."
"However, even before Lin Xuan fell, I was already half a step away from the peak of Martial Sovereign."
"And you, merely at Sevenfold Heaven of Martial Sovereign level, simply have no ability to fight me, just surrender obediently."
The old crone let out a cold laugh.
Her voice was filled with mockery and disdain.
"Hahaha... how ridiculous."
"Half a step away from the peak of Martial Sovereign? A Holy King, so what? In front of me, everything is just an ant!"
"I will make you unable to live, unable to die!"
As his voice fell, Lin Yi swung his arm, and the purple thunder immediately receded.
"Bang!"
Accompanied by a crisp dull sound, the old crone’s head was crushed to pieces!
"Ah!!!"
A piercing scream erupted from the old crone’s mouth, filled with intense pain.
Looking at the old crone’s corpse, a trace of cold harshness appeared on Lin Yi’s face.
"Lin Xuan’s father is already dead, and now you too should go down to accompany him!"
After Lin Yi finished speaking, his hand lashed out, aiming for the old crone’s brow.
"Swoosh!"
Just as his hand was about to pierce into the old crone’s forehead, a figure shrouded in black robes suddenly appeared.
"Hm?"
Lin Yi’s expression changed slightly when he saw this.
But just as he was about to withdraw his hand, a black light suddenly appeared.
It was a black rune, sharp as a blade, instantly tearing open the void.
Immediately, the rune exploded, turning into a cloud of black smoke.
As the black smoke dispersed, Lin Yi’s figure disappeared.
"Hmph! Think you can escape?"
Just then, a cold voice suddenly emanated from all around.
Lin Yi’s face changed drastically, and his body abruptly halted.
The next instant, a blood-red longspear pierced through the air.
"Pu-chi!"
A fist-sized hole appeared in Lin Yi’s left shoulder.
Drops of blood crazily gushed out.
Feeling the intense pain from his left shoulder, Lin Yi’s face showed no panic.
"Lin Xuan!"
A cold and fierce light flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes.
Immediately, he threw the longspear in his hand harshly onto the ground.
Afterward, Lin Yi’s right foot stamped down fiercely, and a towering mountain peak that reached into the clouds was instantly crushed into flat ground by him.
"Lin Xuan, I will make you pay the price!"
Lin Yi said with a cold sneer.
At the same time, his figure vanished from the spot and he hurried back toward the Lin residence.
Lin Yi moved with extraordinary speed, and in the blink of an eye, he had returned to the Lin residence.
"What!?"
However, the moment he stepped into the Lin residence, he stood stock-still.
Because in the center of the courtyard lay a corpse.
It was an old woman, dressed in white, but her face was as pale as paper, devoid of any color, like a dead person.
And at her forehead, there was a hole the size of a fist.
Seeing this scene, Lin Yi’s eyes immediately turned fierce.
"Lin Xuan! I will make sure you have no grave to be buried in!!"
"Ahh!!!"
With a fierce roar, Lin Yi shot toward the outside.
Soon, Lin Yi’s figure vanished from sight.
Outside Lin Xuan’s villa.
Lin Yi’s figure flashed, and he entered the courtyard.
"Whoosh!"
He moved to enter the villa and take away Lin Xuan’s corpse.
"Whoosh!"
But just at that moment, a black radiance descended from the sky, enveloping Lin Yi within it.
This scene made Lin Yi’s expression change slightly.
Immediately afterward, he saw a man in a black robe standing at the center of the dark radiance.
The man in the black robe wore a silver-white mask on his face.
The mask emanated a chilling light.
"It’s you!"
Lin Yi narrowed his eyes.
Although, upon seeing that mask, a hint of wariness appeared on his face.
But even more so, there was disdain and mockery.
In his eyes, this man in the black robe was merely half a Martial Sovereign.
Thus, his strength was many times stronger than Lin Xuan’s.
"Heh, Lin Yi, it seems like you already know who killed my master," the man in the black robe said indifferently.
"But, even if you know, what can you do? Today, you’re destined to fall here."
"Lin Xuan will be killed by me sooner or later."
After saying that, he suddenly swung his hand, and a swirl of dark energy flew out from his sleeve, transforming into a black longsword.
Then, the black longsword suddenly shuddered.
A terrifyingly sharp and spine-chilling force immediately spread out.
The sword aura, like a pitch-black ribbon, was extremely swift.
It drew a graceful arc in the air.
"Swoosh!"
The tip of the sword aimed mercilessly at Lin Yi’s throat and thrust forward fiercely.
"Hmph, child’s play!"
Seeing this, Lin Yi snorted coldly and directly threw a punch to collide with the black sword aura.
"Clang!"
The next second, Lin Yi felt the sword aura was like hard metal, emitting a sonorous sound.
And his fist was numbed by the shock.
"So strong!"
"Who exactly is he?"
"This power is definitely that of a half-emperor level expert!"
Seeing the terrifying might coming from the black longsword, Lin Yi’s face became extremely grave.
"No matter who you are, you won’t escape my pursuit today!"
As he spoke, Lin Yi stamped his foot.

chapters.title: Chapter 819 - 839: Turning into a Cloud of Black Mist
chapters.content:
His figure charged out again, heading straight for the man in the black cloak.
Seeing this, a sneer of contempt immediately emerged in the eyes of the man in the black cloak.
His body suddenly trembled and instantly transformed into a cloud of black mist.
"Chi la!"
In the next instant, his figure appeared beside Lin Yi, his palm waving a black sword beam ferociously slashing towards Lin Yi’s chest.
Lin Yi’s eyes were icy, not attempting to dodge.
"Chi la!"
The sword beam descended, tearing a huge wound across Lin Yi’s chest.
Blood poured out like a waterfall, gushing frantically.
"Hm?"
Seeing this, the man in the black cloak’s gaze sharpened.
His face darkened because the wound, although not deep, was lethal.
"Have you... experienced a ’Bloodline Awakening’?"
Just as Lin Yi was about to use his Spiritual Power to heal the wound, a cold and merciless voice suddenly echoed in his mind.
"Bloodline Awakening!?"
Hearing these four words, Lin Yi’s eyes widened in shock.
In Lin Xuan’s memories, he only remembered that after breaking through to the Martial Ancestor Realm, his bloodline had completely awakened.
But in his memory, there was no information about this mysterious bloodline.
"Yes, that’s correct!"
"And it’s a bloodline that surpasses yours!"
A cold and arrogant voice resonated in Lin Yi’s mind.
That voice was unmistakably Lin Xuan’s.
"A bloodline that surpasses mine, who exactly are you?"
"Could it be that you are the direct descendant of the Lin Family spoken of in legends?"
Lin Yi’s pupils contracted slightly, his facial expression immediately becoming cautious and vigilant.
After all, to possess such power, aside from the direct descendant of the Lin Family he hypothesized, there couldn’t be a second person.
Moreover, even Lin Xuan’s grandfather was unaware of his bloodline awakening, yet this man before him knew.
This made it clear that the man’s origin was definitely terrifying.
"Ha ha, correct!"
"Since that is the case, I shall send you on your way!"
"Your bloodline awakening should still need some time before it fully awakens."
"So first, I’ll send you to join your family."
"And then, after your family has been exterminated, I will refine your soul into my puppet, and then I will bring you back to slowly torture you!"
"By then, your soul will be devoured and refined by me, doomed never to reincarnate."
Towards the end, the man in the black cloak’s voice suddenly became chilling.
"Humph, in your dreams!"
Hearing the other party’s words, Lin Yi snorted coldly.
His hands clenched into fists, the surrounding air seemingly freezing at that moment.
The next moment, Lin Yi transformed into a streak of light, pouncing towards the man in the black cloak.
"Humph, an ant trying to topple a tree!"
Seeing this, the man in the black cloak scoffed with contempt.
Then, the black longsword in his hand burst forth with a brilliant radiance, sweeping towards Lin Yi like a divine weapon.
"Boom!"
"Bang!"
When the two forces collided, an earth-shattering noise erupted.
Lin Yi’s figure was sent flying dozens of yards, crashing into a large tree.
"Cough cough..."
Lin Yi could not help but cough out several mouthfuls of fresh blood, his face turning extremely pale.
"How is this possible, I am at the Eightfold Heaven’s peak in the Martial Ancestor Realm."
"Even when facing a Martial Artist from the Ninefold Heaven, I have the power to fight, but why am I not his match!?"
Looking at the man in the black cloak, Lin Yi was utterly shocked.
His strength, though somewhat inferior to Lin Xuan’s, had reached the Martial Ancestor Realm at this age, demonstrating his terrifying talent.
But in facing the man in the black cloak, he found himself without the strength to counterattack.
"Just who is this man in the black cloak?"
"Why do I feel a sense of familiarity?"
Lin Yi thought darkly.
"Heh, boy, I advise you to just kneel down and submit to me!"
"Otherwise, you’re headed down a dead end!"
As Lin Yi pondered, the voice of the dark-robed man echoed once again.
Upon hearing this, a surge of anger welled up in Lin Yi’s heart.
"Dream on about submission!"
"I, Lin Yi, have always been one to defy the heavens."
"Even in the face of death, I will never give in!"
"And moreover..."
"Even if I were to truly die, I would not submit to you!"
At this point, Lin Yi’s gaze hardened in an instant, and a vast fighting spirit erupted from within him, sweeping across the heavens and earth.
"Boy, you really don’t know what’s good for you."
"Since you are so stubbornly misguided, I’ll have to personally send you to hell!"
"Swoosh!"
The moment the voice fell, Lin Yi’s speed surged explosively.
The next instant, his figure appeared next to the dark-robed man like a ghost.
His right leg kicked out directly at the man’s waist.
"Seeking death!"
The dark-robed man’s expression turned grim, and with a flash, he disappeared from the spot.
"Bang!"
The next moment, the figure of the dark-robed man appeared on Lin Yi’s left side.
His black longsword slashed down towards Lin Yi’s head.
Seeing this, the corners of Lin Yi’s mouth lifted slightly into a chilling smile.
Then, his figure flickered and vanished from the spot.
The black longsword missed its mark, and Lin Yi’s figure eerily appeared behind him.
"Bang!"
However, before Lin Yi could stabilize his figure, his head took a punch.
That punch, filled with extremely fierce strength, sent Lin Yi flying backward.
Lin Yi sat on the ground with a look of horror on his face.
Because he had realized that the dark-robed man was even faster than he was!
"What kind of cultivation technique is this?"
Lin Yi’s eyes were filled with intense wariness.
The dark-robed man was too strange.
If it weren’t for his transcendent and saintly spiritual sense, he probably couldn’t have defended against that move.
"Boy, you should now realize the gap between us, right?"
"Just submit obediently!"
"Otherwise, your fate will be extremely miserable!"
"However, if you are willing to submit to me, I might spare you!"
Lin Yi raised his head, his eyes coldly fixed on the dark-robed man.
"Impossible, you will never enslave me!"
Hearing the other party’s words, Lin Yi remained unyielding.
"Hmph, you refuse to eat a toast only to be forced to drink a forfeit!"
"Since it’s like this, then go to hell!"
"Bang!"
As the voice fell, the dark-robed man’s foot stomped on the ground, and instantly, the entire mountain trembled violently.
"Crack!"
The next moment, rocks exploded, and huge cracks spread in all directions.
The area immediately displayed a web of cracks, looking terrifying.
"Hmm?"
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s pupils instantly constricted.
"How is this possible?"
"My physical body power has already reached the peak of Martial Ancestor Eightfold Heaven, how could his punch throw me into such disarray?"
Lin Yi’s face was full of disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 820 - 840: Sincerely Submitting
chapters.content:
"Heh heh, boy, I advise you to simply submit to me!"
"Otherwise, you will certainly perish here today!"
The man in the black robe chuckled coldly, his voice filled with intense malice.
Upon hearing this, a serious glint flashed through Lin Yi’s eyes.
"Fine, then I’ll let you see, my true strength, Lin Yi!"
Lin Yi’s voice was ice-cold, his body emanating a dense murderous aura.
"Ha!"
The next moment, Lin Yi clenched his teeth fiercely, his inner power crazily surging.
A sound of dragon’s roar suddenly bellowed from within him, like a startling thunderbolt.
Instantly, Lin Yi charged ferociously towards the man in the black robe.
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
One after another, enormous booming sounds violently emanated from Lin Yi’s body.
Lin Yi’s entire skeleton crackled, and a thick metallic luster appeared on the surface of his skin—clearly, his bones were covered with hard metallic armor!
Lin Yi’s attacks, though seemingly simple, contained endless murderous intent.
The man in the black robe, not daring to be negligent, quickly waved his longsword in defense.
"Sizzle!"
"Sizzle!"
The next moment, Lin Yi’s figure collided with the body of the man in the black robe.
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
A series of collision sounds continuously echoed through the heavens and earth.
Thereafter, both figures rapidly retreated.
"Worthy of being my Seventh Rank, truly formidable. No wonder you dare to dominate this place!"
"However, your strength is still far too lacking!"
Lin Yi licked his lips, a cruel expression emerging on his face.
"I’ll let you witness just how powerful my Sixth Rank really is!"
"Whoosh!"
As his words fell, Lin Yi’s figure eerily vanished from the spot.
The next moment, Lin Yi’s figure startlingly appeared above the black-robed man’s head.
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
One dull sound after another kept coming.
Every time the black-robed man struck with his sword, Lin Yi dodged it, only to reappear again.
Their bodies alternated in a flash.
In just a brief moment, the two had collided hundreds of times.
"Boom!"
Eventually, the bodies of Lin Yi and the black-robed man collided in the void, cracking the void itself with each impact.
And both bodies involuntarily moved backward.
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
Both fell to the ground at the same time.
"Boy, do you know, in the Martial Sovereign Realm, those who can match up to the Eightfold Heaven of Martial Ancestor are few and far between!"
"You are one of them. I can spare your life, but if you remain deluded, don’t blame me for striking you down mercilessly!"
The black-robed man stood up, his eyes black as ink, staring intently at Lin Yi, with cold light swirling within.
"Heh heh, is that so?"
"I’d like to see just how many people have said the same to me before!"
"But, you should also see if you’re worthy to battle me!"
Lin Yi’s figure slowly rose from the ground.
"Ha ha ha, I’m not worthy? Kid, you’re too arrogant!"
"You don’t know how many assassinations this statement of yours will bring about?"
"You think, who are you? You think, a Martial King strongman would waste tons of time for a mere ant like you?"
"You’re wrong, they aren’t as foolish as you are!"
The man in the black robe laughed out loud.
"Oh? Who are they?"
Lin Yi’s brow slightly furrowed.
"I might as well tell you, they’re all super strongmen of the Martial King Realm!"
"Each and every one of their names is ’Black Demon Guard,’ possessing endless slaughter!"
"So, every single one of them is a devil who kills without batting an eye!"
Hearing this, a chill ran through Lin Yi’s heart.
"Unexpectedly, in the realm of the Martial King, there are such experts hidden; I have indeed underestimated you!"
The man in the black robe sneered.
Lin Yi, hearing this, didn’t speak but instead stared intently at the man in the black robe.
Although the opponent spoke with certainty, Lin Yi didn’t believe their words were completely true.
After all, within the Martial King Realm, besides Martial Venerable, there are many realms he was unaware of.
"Do you still remember, back at the Fengyun Academy, what the origins of those men in black were?"
The man in the black robe, seeing Lin Yi’s silence, continued.
After listening, Lin Yi’s face became clouded with uncertainty.
"You mean..."
"That’s right, their identity is that of Martial King!"
"As long as we can kill you, we can become strongmen of the Martial King!"
"By then, the power of the Martial King strongmen will be enough to suppress the entire Eastern Wasteland!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi was tremendously shocked.
"What kind of monster are you, to cause such rampant chaos!"
"The power of the Martial King is even stronger than our Martial Sovereign’s force, and moreover, Martial Kings possess an invincible status. Do you think, with your cultivation level, you can withstand them?"
"Moreover, as far as I know, they all have quite remarkable identities and statuses. Do you think they will casually step forward to assist you?"
"I think you’d better kneel down and beg for mercy early, to save yourself from physical agony!"
"Otherwise, when you die, don’t blame me for not warning you!"
The man in the black robe said mockingly.
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s heart also surged with towering rage.
"Hmph!"
"I also have a few friends who are Martial Kings. When the time comes, I will have you all wanted. Do you think they will just stand by?"
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the man in the black robe suddenly paused.
But soon, he regained his composure, his eyes filled with more taunting: "Ha ha, kid, you really are arrogant!"
"What about having friends who are Martial Kings? Even the Martial Kings are no match for us. What waves do you think you can make?"
The man in the black robe sneered.
"Is that so?"
Hearing that, Lin Yi smiled indifferently.
Immediately, his face showed an extremely mocking expression, saying, "It seems you still don’t know how terrifying this friend of mine is!"
"Hmph, although they are all extraordinary, they are still far from being my opponents!"
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the man in the black robe was briefly stunned, then his face displayed an amused expression, saying, "Oh, well, I’d like to see how you defeat them!
"But if you dare to use that Evil Technique, I guarantee you’ll live a life worse than death!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the man in the black robe leaped out of the cave and rushed off into the distance.
Watching the dark silhouette fade, Lin Yi’s eyes suddenly flashed with a chilling gleam.
"Evil Technique! Ha, quite an Evil Technique!"
Lin Yi roared low, a tremendous killing aura spreading out, destroying all the trees around him.
"Damn it, even resorting to using Evil Techniques!"
"It seems we are really going to have a showdown today!"
"If we truly come to blows, then death is certain!"
"But even if I die, I will take you down with me!"
"Black Demon Guard? Martial King? Ha ha!"
"After I crush you, I will go find them, to see how they will kill you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 821 - 841: The Valley Turned into Ruins!
chapters.content:
Having said that, Lin Yi took a deep breath, and then suddenly struck out with his palm!
Boom!
Instantly, a massive palm print roared out, fiercely striking toward the valley ahead.
That valley collapsed in an instant, turning into ruins!
Although Lin Yi’s attack wasn’t very powerful, it was still horrifying.
"What...what kind of Cultivation Technique is this?"
The man in the black robe trembled with fear as he witnessed the scene before him.
Lin Yi’s strength was clearly far superior to his, utterly beyond his ability to withstand.
Moreover, judging from the strength the other had just displayed, his power was definitely not as simple as that of the Martial Venerable Realm.
"Not good!"
"We must escape quickly!"
Thinking this, the man in the black robe suddenly transformed into a mass of black mist, frantically fleeing.
A trace of scorn flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes.
"Thinking of escaping now, aren’t you a bit too late?"
"My Cultivation Technique is called ’Myriad Thunder Retribution Palm’, can your speed outrun it?"
As he finished speaking, Lin Yi stepped forward, and his figure burst out explosively.
"No!!!"
A look of panic appeared on the man in the black robe’s face.
"Is my fate really so tragic?"
A cold smile appeared on the corner of Lin Yi’s mouth.
"No! I refuse to accept this!"
"With such against-the-heavens talent for cultivation, why must the heavens torment me so?"
"Heavens, open your eyes and see who I am, I am the favored child of the heavens!"
"Why? Why must I be reduced to this state today?"
"I hate you, I hate you!"
The man in the black robe let out a heart-wrenching scream, the sound so harrowing that it was unsettling to hear.
"Hehe, since you are so obsessed with this, I’ll leave your body behind!"
"I’ll make your death ugly, very thorough!"
Lin Yi coldly declared.
"Boom!"
A massive palm imprint, carrying the booming sound of thunder, fiercely struck the man in the black robe.
"No!!!"
A piercing scream sounded as the man in the black robe, under Lin Yi’s palm strike, turned into a mist of blood and dissipated.
And his Storage Ring burst apart.
Looking at the Storage Ring, a glint of eagerness flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes, but soon, his gaze moved to a pitch-black longsword inside.
"Is this your weapon?"
"Indeed, worthy of a Martial Sovereign Level blade, extraordinary indeed!"
"This Martial Sovereign Level longsword must have been transformed from a Martial Emperor Level demonic beast, containing extremely pure Soul Power!"
"With this, it’s akin to possessing a Martial Saint Level Demon Core!"
Lin Yi was exceedingly excited, his gaze then directly moved toward the cliff.
On that cliff, there were complex and mysterious patterns engraved.
And in the center of those patterns, a palm-sized black stone was floating.
"It is you!"
"Haha!"
Lin Yi couldn’t hold back his boisterous laugh, his eyes filled with excitement.
"This longsword is indeed a fine item, however..."
"But for me, it’s trivial, the most important thing is the Martial King!"
"Although this longsword is not bad, for me, it is not as valuable as a Martial King!"
As he finished speaking, two brilliant golden bolts of lightning burst forth from Lin Yi’s eyes, solidifying as they enveloped the black stone.
The next moment.
Boom~!!!
A deafening explosion rang out.
A sharp gleam flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes as his figure flickered, darting straight toward the black stone.
He planned to use the longsword to break through to the Martial Ancestor Realm.
...
Inside the valley,
The man in the black robe glared at the valley shattered by Lin Yi’s move, his face clouding over with a dark expression.
"Damn it, this little beast is too formidable, managing to defeat a warrior of the Martial Sovereign Realm!"
"If I were at my full strength, perhaps I could have fought him, but now, I find it difficult even to contend!"
The man in the black robe gritted his teeth.
He had thought that his status alone meant he needn’t fear anyone, but after witnessing Lin Yi’s strength, he finally understood what it meant when they said there were skies beyond skies and people beyond people!
"This kid is definitely no ordinary person!"
"By the looks of it, he must come from some ancient power and is surely not simple!"
"If I ever encounter him, I must avoid his edge, otherwise, I’ll really be in trouble!"
Thinking this, a hint of wariness flashed through the man in the black robe’s eyes.
"Hmph! Even if you are at the Martial King Realm, you are still an ant in the face of absolute power!"
"Once you step into the Martial Emperor Realm, I will kill you myself!"
"Then, not only you but the entire Lin Family will be buried with you!"
The look in the man in the black robe’s eyes grew even more ferocious.
His body emitted an overwhelming malice.
"Lin Yi, I will definitely seek revenge on you!"
After saying this, the man in the black robe turned and ran, disappearing in the blink of an eye.
"Hmm?"
"What is this smell?"
Suddenly, Lin Yi frowned, his face showing a trace of surprise.
"How foul!"
"This... this is the stench of a corpse, and from a dead zombie at that, the kind that couldn’t be deader!"
"What is this thing? How can such a monster exist?"
"No, this smell, it seems familiar. Could it be that beast?"
Lin Yi’s pupils sharply constricted as an image quickly surfaced in his mind.
"This beast seems to be the Dark Demon Dragon!"
"No, not just it; there are other monsters also known as zombies!"
"What on earth is going on in this world?"
"What world is this?"
Lin Yi’s heart was filled with shock.
Meanwhile, not far from him, a group of men in black was searching for his whereabouts.
"Big brother, I didn’t expect this kid to find this cave so quickly!"
"But his bad luck has led him right into our path!"
"Hehe! We’ve been lying in ambush here for a long time!"
"Later, I’ll make this little beast kneel before us and beg for mercy!"
The faces of the men in black showed an extreme bitterness.
They were all prodigies of their tribes, yet Lin Yi had beaten them severely, almost costing them their lives—a debt they were not about to forget easily.
"Shoot, someone is coming!"
"Quick, hide in the cave! We’ll retreat and come back to settle the score after we’ve recovered from our injuries!"
The leader of the men shouted, swiftly entering the cave.
The rest of the men in black hurriedly followed into the cave.
"These people seem to be here to kill me!"
Lin Yi watched the retreating figures of the men in black, his eyes narrowing slightly.
Although he couldn’t sense exactly how many there were, he could tell that there were at least a dozen, and each had reached the Martial Ancestor Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 822 - 842 A Disciple of a Certain Prominent Family
chapters.content:
"They must be disciples from a major family within the City of Celestial Wolves!
"However, their strength hasn’t reached the peak period’s standard, at most they can only be comparable to the Martial Monarch Realm!"
"No matter what, they are no match for me!"
"This matter is over for now, I’ll settle accounts with them if I see them again in the future!"
Lin Yi thought to himself.
"Huh? There’s still a human aura here!"
"Could it be that this little beast had just entered this cave dwelling and was being chased by humans?"
Suddenly, a young man dressed in black entered the cave, his face revealing a mocking smile.
His eyes were full of playfulness, looking at Lin Yi with amusement and scorn.
"Kid, you’ve got some nerve, daring to break into Myriad Ghosts Cave alone, and even daring to cultivate here. I really wonder where you got such courage from," the young man said, looking at Lin Yi coldly.
Hearing the youth’s mockery, Lin Yi did not speak.
Within the depths of his eyes, however, a cold light burst forth.
"Who are you?" Lin Yi asked.
He could feel that the young man before him carried the aura of a Martial Venerable, but because the distance was a bit far, he couldn’t determine the other party’s exact strength.
"Hehe, who am I? You’re not qualified to know!" the young man said with a mischievous curve to his lips.
"Oh?"
"Then where did you pop up from?" Lin Yi retorted.
"That’s none of your concern!" the young man replied impatiently, waving his hand. "I’m telling you, you’d better not have any ideas, or else I’ll make your life worse than death!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi shook his head slightly, his face showing indifference, "Since you’re unwilling to speak, then, I will have to explore on my own!"
With that, Lin Yi’s figure moved and he instantly disappeared from the spot.
"What?"
"How is he able to move?"
"No good, everyone be cautious, his speed is too fast, we can’t block him!"
"Run away quickly, his speed is truly terrifying!"
Seeing Lin Yi suddenly vanish, everyone panicked, all scrambling to flee in every direction.
Lin Yi, however, ignored them and continued to rush forward, arriving at a huge stone platform after a short while.
This stone platform was conical in shape, at least thirty feet tall, and engraved with peculiar patterns.
"What kind of formation is this?"
"How could such a thing exist!"
"This formation, it absolutely isn’t made by someone from this world!"
Lin Yi gazed at the stone platform before him, his face showing astonishment.
The stone walls around the platform were covered with various formation patterns, as if containing the secrets of heaven and earth.
"Hmm?"
"The material of this stone platform looks very similar to..."
After closely inspecting for a moment, Lin Yi’s face suddenly revealed an ecstatic expression: "Heavenly Spirit Stone!"
This huge stone platform, astonishingly, was made up of fist-sized Heavenly Spirit Stones, and from these stones, there was even an indistinct strong spiritual energy fluctuation, emanating from them, stirring waves in Lin Yi’s heart.
"Hahaha, Heavenly Spirit Stone, I, Lin Yi, have finally found you!"
"This time, I must absorb all these Heavenly Spirit Stones!"
Lin Yi laughed heartily, then sat directly on the stone platform, beginning to frantically absorb the spiritual energy from the Heavenly Spirit Stones.
"Hmm?"
Suddenly, a sinister voice came from afar: "I didn’t expect this little beast to be able to resist the erosion of those evil insects within the Myriad Ghosts Cave, and, it seems, he’s actually absorbing the spiritual energy from the Heavenly Spirit Stones!"
"Hmph, I refuse to believe he can withstand the attack of Myriad Ghosts Cave. These evil insects are treasures of our Blood Moon Sect; how could we allow you, a lowlife, to absorb them arbitrarily?"
"This lowlife must die!"
The sinister voice echoed piercingly in the cave.
They reached the area shortly after.
"Hmm? How is he not dead?"
The young man’s face flickered with surprise upon seeing the scene before him.
"You lot, go grab him for me, all the Heavenly Spirit Stones here will be yours!" the young man commanded, waving his hand toward the people beside him.
"Yes, Captain!"
Stirred by the words, their faces all showed excitement, their eyes shining brightly, almost lunging at Lin Yi immediately.
"Hmm? You lot, piss off!"
Suddenly, the young man’s expression changed drastically, glaring at the few black-robed young men by his side.
"Yes!"
The black-robed young men nodded repeatedly and scurried away.
"Damn, this lowlife is actually this powerful? However, this is the Myriad Ghosts Cave; I really want to see how capable he actually is!"
"This time, let’s see where you can run to!"
The young man sneered coldly.
Then, his expression abruptly darkened, and he transformed into a cloud of pitch-black mist, charging violently towards Lin Yi.
"You little rascal, how dare you sabotage my plan, I’ll make sure you suffer every torture Myriad Ghosts Cave has to offer!"
"You lowlife, after I tear you to pieces, then I’ll absorb those Heavenly Spirit Stones!"
"By then, my strength will surely increase significantly!"
The young man sneered viciously, a ferocious glint in his eyes.
The next moment, his body had already appeared behind Lin Yi, reaching out with both hands lunging for Lin Yi’s head.
This claw was incredibly fast, carrying a fierce wind with it!
However, at that moment, Lin Yi’s body vanished abruptly from his spot, reappearing behind the young man.
"Hmm? What kind of skill is this?"
The young man was taken aback.
Yet the next moment, his neck was seized by a pair of hands.
"You..."
Seeing this turn of events, his face was instantly filled with horror!
"How can you possibly be this fast!"
"My speed has already surpassed the sound barrier!"
"Could it be that in this world, there really exists someone faster than the sound barrier?"
The young man exclaimed in shock.
However, Lin Yi paid no attention to the young man’s cry of astonishment, and with a slight force of his right hand, he twisted the young man’s head to one side. At the same time, his fingers curled slightly, firmly grasping the young man’s throat.
"Gurgle~"
The sound of a throat constricting reverberated.
Lin Yi’s gaze was extremely cold, staring at the young man in front of him: "What did you just say?"
"No, no..."
The young man’s eyes showed extreme fear, frothing at the mouth, struggling fiercely, a sheer terror surfacing on his face.
His cultivation was not bad, but it was far inferior to Lin Yi’s; a mere slap from Lin Yi could burst his head.
At this time, Lin Yi’s face bore a cruel, cold smile.
"This is the death you sought yourself!"
"Since you wanted to kill me, then bear the consequences first!"
"Bang!"
With those words, Lin Yi unleashed a palm strike directly onto the young man’s forehead.
"Boom!"
A muffled sound echoed, and the young man lay there stiffly on the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 823 - 843 Incomprehensible
chapters.content:
"Hmph, you think you’re worthy of killing me?"
"My strength has reached the Void Transforming Realm, while you? You’re only in the Early Stage of the Bone Tempering Realm. How could you possibly be my match!"
The youth slowly opened his eyes, looking around, his eyes filled with deep confusion.
"Could I be seeing things? Why did I just feel a dangerous presence, but now, there’s no trace of it?"
The youth muttered to himself.
"Whoosh!"
At that moment, a sound of breaking air echoed.
The next second, the youth’s pupils suddenly dilated, his eyes filled with shock, "This..."
"Bang!"
"Ah!"
The youth’s throat burst open, blood splattering everywhere.
Lin Yi’s eyes shimmered with a cold light.
This youth was too annoying; Lin Yi couldn’t be bothered to waste words on him.
"Whoosh!"
"Whoosh!"
"Whoosh!"
Lin Yi’s feet tapped rapidly, shadows appearing and darting through the cave. Each step was accompanied by the screams of someone falling.
Within just three minutes, the entire cave, except for Lin Yi, was littered with corpses.
A playful expression hung on Lin Yi’s face.
"It’s been a while since I stretched my muscles!"
"These weaklings, I’ll use them for practice today!"
Having said that, Lin Yi’s body soared into the air, fleeing into the distance.
His body, like a spirit snake, covered kilometers in an instant, his speed indescribable.
Soon after, Lin Yi arrived at the outskirts of Myriad Ghosts Cave, looking at the dense mass of ghost creatures ahead, a playful smile appeared on his lips.
"Hehehe... These guys are all just fodder for death!"
"I was worried I wouldn’t find an opportunity!"
"Since it’s like this, I’ll have a good time playing with you all!"
While talking, Lin Yi’s body dived towards the dense forest below.
Before long, he had fully entered the range of the ghost creatures, and more and more ghost creatures started appearing before Lin Yi.
"Damn, how did this brat get in?!"
"How did he do it? It’s unbelievable!"
"How on earth did he manage that? Isn’t he just a cultivator at the Early Stage of the Bone Tempering Realm? How could he possibly have such speed!"
Looking at Lin Yi, who had suddenly appeared, all the ghost creatures almost dropped their eyeballs on the ground.
They all clearly felt that Lin Yi’s body didn’t seem like that of a cultivator in the Early Stage of the Bone Tempering Realm!
"Hmph, a bunch of ants, daring to try to deal with me!"
Lin Yi looked at the dense crowd of ghost creatures before him, his eyes flickering with a cold glint.
The next moment, his body leapt vigorously, plunging into the crowd.
"Bang!"
Lin Yi’s fist, like a cannonball, blasted out.
Each punch easily smashed a ghost creature’s head, blood splattering everywhere!
After a minute, the entire cave had turned into Asura Hell.
And Lin Yi, was leisurely strolling as if he hadn’t even considered those ghost creatures worth his attention!
"Damn!
"All of you, move out and kill this monster!"
Looking at the scene before him, the youth’s face had already turned deathly pale.
At this moment, a sense of panic finally rose in his heart.
He knew, today, he had encountered a formidable master!
Not only that, this master’s strength was possibly frighteningly potent!
Thinking of this, he didn’t hesitate to flee backward.
"You, trying to escape?"
However, at that moment, Lin Yi turned his head, staring coldly at the youth.
"Thump!"
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the youth was so scared he immediately knelt to the ground.
"Please spare me! I swear I’ll reform and become a better person!"
The youth wailed ceaselessly, his forehead drenched in cold sweat.
"You want to repent now, but I’m afraid it’s a bit late."
"I will tear you to pieces!"
"Ah!"
The young man let out a heartrending scream.
However, Lin Yi’s fist showed no mercy, still slamming into the young man’s skull.
"Bang!"
The young man’s head burst open like a watermelon.
Crimson blood sprayed everywhere, staining everything around him.
"This... this human’s cultivation has reached the Soul Refinement Realm?!"
"No! This isn’t the Soul Refinement Realm, this is the terrifying cultivation of the Nascent Soul Realm!"
"How... how is this possible?!"
"Is this human cultivator actually a monstrous being?"
"No!"
"We must immediately report this to the sect, and have the master intervene!"
A series of ghosts began to panic.
They had never witnessed such terrifying power!
"Hehehe... hehehehe!"
At that moment, Lin Yi let out an eerie laugh and then turned toward the demon beasts by his side.
"Let’s leave this place first to avoid being discovered by others."
"Yes, Master!"
Upon hearing this, the demon beasts immediately responded respectfully.
Then, Lin Yi’s figure quickly dashed towards the distance.
...
Deep in the mountains.
"Hmm?"
"So much has happened?"
Lin Yi frowned and then concealed his aura as he rushed toward a mountain peak.
The peak was in a state of chaos.
On top of the mountain lay dozens of corpses.
"Somebody must have been here, otherwise, why would there be so many traces?"
Lin Yi scanned the area and realized that it bore signs of a battle.
Among the remains, there were two storage rings.
"Huh? There’s also a storage bag!"
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly.
He reached out, grabbed the storage bag, and began to examine it.
The storage bag was quite ordinary, no bigger than a palm, containing hundreds of intermediate-grade spirit stones.
Such storage bags were not uncommon in the Ghost Realm, exchangeable for a mere low-grade spirit stone.
However, these items could only be stored inside storage bags and couldn’t hold other objects!
"Although these items are useless to me, they are quite good."
Thinking this, Lin Yi put away the storage bag.
Then, his gaze once again fell on the pile of corpses in the valley, his eyes slightly narrowing.
He knew there was something strange about this valley.
The next moment, Lin Yi stepped forward, coming directly to the mouth of the valley.
At the entrance, there was a huge black formation pattern.
The formation pattern emitted strange fluctuations, seemingly containing some kind of restriction.
Lin Yi’s eyes lingered on the formation pattern for a long while, then his lips slightly curled up, revealing a mischievous smile, "Since you so want to eliminate me completely, I shall fulfill your wish!"
As soon as he finished speaking, a violent suction force suddenly erupted from Lin Yi’s body.
"Whoosh!"
The next moment, Lin Yi’s figure mysteriously disappeared from the spot, appearing directly at the center of the formation pattern the next second.
As Lin Yi approached the formation pattern, its fluctuations became even more intense.
"Buzz buzz!"
The formation pattern faintly radiated waves of light.
This was the sign of a Teleportation Formation!
"There really is something strange here!"
"I wonder if this strangeness is connected to that little girl."
Lin Yi’s gaze slowly shifted to a stone at the center of the formation pattern, his eyes flashing with a sharp glint.

chapters.title: Chapter 824 - 844: Disappeared without a Trace
chapters.content:
"Whoosh!"
Lin Yi took a step forward and instantly appeared in front of the stone.
As Lin Yi stepped into the formation pattern, the light from the pattern suddenly burst forth, and in the next moment, Lin Yi’s figure had disappeared without a trace.
When Lin Yi opened his eyes again, he found himself standing in an unfamiliar place.
"Swish!"
Just then, Lin Yi suddenly felt a fierce wind attacking from behind him and quickly moved aside to dodge the attack.
The next moment, he saw a claw full of sharp fangs swinging towards him and viciously grabbing at the void.
"Boom!"
Lin Yi stamped his foot on the ground, and instantly, a wave of earthy yellow soil swept out, forcefully repelling the massive claw.
At the same time, a trace of shock appeared in Lin Yi’s eyes.
For the claw was made of rock.
However, the rock was as hard as iron.
"Hiss! Is this... a demon beast?!"
Feeling the terrifying pressure from the giant claw, a look of shock immediately appeared on Lin Yi’s face.
"Hee hee! Are you from the Human Clan? This is wonderful! I was just worrying about not finding someone! Your body is just what I need! Hahahaha..."
The monster’s laughter echoed across the sky.
Upon hearing this sentence, Lin Yi was momentarily stunned.
However, he quickly grasped the situation.
"Monster, so you have come for me!"
Lin Yi’s lips also curled into a smile.
"Hee hee, human cultivator, you are quite intelligent! However, now that you know our plan, you are doomed!"
The monster’s voice was chillingly cold, causing one’s skin to crawl.
"Hehe, since that’s the case, why bother with idle talk?"
Lin Yi shrugged nonchalantly.
"Hee hee! Since that’s the case, don’t blame me for being rude!"
The monster sneered, and its sharp claws suddenly transformed into razor-sharp blades that fiercely slashed towards Lin Yi.
Wherever the claw blades passed, space itself was torn apart.
"Hmph!"
Lin Yi snorted coldly, pushing off the ground with both legs, his figure shot towards the monster like lightning.
"Boom!"
Fists and palm met, causing a violent collision sound.
"Roar!"
The monster let out an angry shout, suddenly twisted its body, and lunged for Lin Yi’s neck.
"Get lost!"
Lin Yi’s arms, strong as clamps, held the monster’s right hand.
"Bang!"
Next, Lin Yi landed a punch on the monster’s chest, sending it reeling back several steps, blood spilling from the corners of its mouth.
"Roar!"
The monster let out a piercing scream as it rapidly moved backward and finally collided with the stone wall of the cave, barely managing to stop.
"What strong defense!"
Lin Yi’s pupils constricted, praising quietly in his heart.
To know, this monster’s cultivation was only at the Seventh Layer of the Foundation Establishment Stage, not much higher than his.
Yet, it could still withstand his full-powered punch!
Moreover, had the monster’s skin not been so tough, Lin Yi was confident he could crush it.
After all, his physical strength was called heaven-defying!
"Hee hee! Human lad, today, you will taste the might of this king!"
The corners of the monster’s mouth lifted into a bloodthirsty grin, and its aura grew increasingly ferocious.
"Boom!"
Instantaneously, an extremely terrifying spiritual power burst forth from its body, instantly spreading out.
"Roar!"
The next moment, the monster opened its mouth to spew out a black fog that instantly swept toward Lin Yi.
The black fog spread, blocking out the sun, and enveloped the entire valley.
Lin Yi’s expression immediately turned ugly.
This monster actually possessed a special devouring cultivation technique.
This devouring cultivation technique was named ’Yin Yang Devouring Technique’.
The Yin Yang Devouring Technique advanced its own strength by devouring the souls and power of others, and it could even devour souls!
This cultivation technique was what Lin Yi feared the most.
Because this technique not only had offensive capabilities but also had the effects of seizing and controlling others’ souls!
Such a technique, if it fell into the hands of cultivators, would be terrifying indeed!
"Break for me!"
Lin Yi clenched his teeth and his fists, and then suddenly shook.
A terrifying power burst forth from within him, tearing the Yin Yang Devouring Technique apart.
"Roar! Human, die!"
Seeing this, the monster’s eyes widened, and it let out a ferocious laugh.
The next moment, it swung its giant fists, smashing them fiercely toward Lin Yi.
"Bang bang!"
Lin Yi didn’t dodge; he punched back.
The collision of their fists caused a thunderous explosion.
The savage power tore through the surrounding area.
