"Crack! Snap!"
Where Lin Yi and the monster’s fists met, sparks flew, and a crisp cracking sound followed.
However, Lin Yi still stood firmly on the ground, while the monster staggered back several steps, its scales showing fine cracks, with blood crazily flowing out of them.
"How can this be!?"
The monster’s eyes widened in shock.
It had never expected Lin Yi’s strength to be so terrifying that even its own Yin Yang Devouring Technique could not overpower him.
"Hehe! Human, you are truly powerful! I admire you! So, just submit to me obediently! If you submit to me, then I will spare your life!"
The monster spoke tempting words to Lin Yi with a grin.
"Pah! Dream on!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi sneered and immediately bent his legs, springing forward like a cannonball, heading straight for the monster’s body.
"Swoosh!"
Lin Yi moved like a ghost, appearing beside the monster in the blink of an eye.
"Bang!"
A punch landed on the left side of the monster’s chest, directly shattering its heart.
The monster swayed, then fell to the ground, motionless.
Watching Lin Yi’s figure, the other cultivators each inhaled a breath of cold air.
"Hisss! So strong, he actually killed that monster!"
"How... how can we even fight?"
The faces of the cultivators were filled with fear.
"Swoosh!"
Just then, Lin Yi’s figure dashed towards another demon beast.
This beast was a large lizard that was two meters long.
The lizard’s body was as thick as a person, and it radiated strong fluctuations of spiritual power.
The single horn on the lizard’s head was flickering with brilliant light, clearly, it had successfully condensed a Magical Treasure.
Though this lizard was only at the Fifth Layer of the Foundation Establishment Stage, its combat power was no weaker than that of a Nascent Soul Early Stage powerhouse.
Moreover, the cultivators could sense that this lizard had developed some intelligence!
This fact alone was enough to show that this lizard was extraordinary!
"Boom!"
A deep, muffled sound emerged as a cloud of black mist burst forth from Lin Yi’s fists.

chapters.title: Chapter 825 - 845: The Massive Body of the Lizard
chapters.content:
"Sizzle!"
A flash of black mist instantly tore through the massive body of the lizard.
Its blood was then absorbed into Lin Yi’s body.
Inside Lin Yi’s physical body, a strange fragrance also began to emanate.
"What a powerful Spiritual Medicine!"
Lin Yi was slightly taken aback, then a rich color of joy surged in his eyes.
He had just devoured a Third Grade Spirit Grass and refined a drop of Nine Revolutions Chaos Liquid, and now he had consumed this lizard, achieving three gains in one fell swoop—he had struck it rich!
Thinking this, Lin Yi once again charged into the group of lizards.
After a fierce battle, those lizards were completely unable to resist Lin Yi’s assault and were slaughtered by him in an instant!
"Phew!"
Lin Yi stretched his limbs, a smile appearing at the corners of his mouth.
This time, although he encountered a bit of trouble, the gains were also considerable.
Especially those Demon Cores, each containing boundless Spiritual Power, were of great help to his cultivation.
"Hm?"
However, just then, a sinister gaze suddenly appeared behind Lin Yi, causing his expression to slightly change.
"Who?"
Lin Yi swiftly turned his head, his eyes revealing a sharp cold glint.
However, when he turned back and looked at the lizard behind him, he found that the lizard had completely disappeared.
"Could it be an illusion?"
Lin Yi frowned slightly, his heart filled with confusion.
What exactly was that lizard?
"No, that lizard was clearly a living creature!"
In Lin Yi’s mind, the eerie eyeballs of the lizard and that sinister voice flashed.
"Damn! How could I forget, these lizards have Spiritual Sense!"
Lin Yi cursed softly and then turned around, preparing to go back the way he came.
However, as Lin Yi turned around and took only a few steps, suddenly, his pupils contracted sharply.
He saw, in the distance, a man in white standing there, tall and straight, like a spear, standing upright as if he were a statue.
At this moment, the man was dressed in a white robe, holding a jade fan, his face extremely handsome, as if an exiled immortal had descended to earth.
"Who are you?"
Lin Yi stared at the man in white, a hint of wariness emerging deep in his eyes.
The man in white had an extremely strong aura, giving Lin Yi a very dangerous feeling.
"My name is Murong Feng, from the Kunlun Realm, a Young Sect Master from the Heavenly Martial Sect," the man in white said indifferently as he glanced at Lin Yi.
Kunlun Realm!
Hearing these three words, Lin Yi’s pupils sharply contracted.
"Are you from the Kunlun Realm?"
Lin Yi’s eyebrows furrowed tightly.
Although he had only been in the Secular World for a short time, he had some knowledge of the situation here.
The Kunlun Realm was an Immortal Cultivation Continent.
And this continent had a hundred and eight countries, with tens of thousands of major Sects managing hundreds of smaller Sects each.
Each Sect was quite powerful, perhaps even more so than the Sects of Kunlun!
Lin Yi had not expected a disciple from the Heavenly Martial Sect to appear on his territory.
"Heh, no need to be nervous, I’m not here to cause trouble, nor do I want to be your enemy. After all, you are only in the Golden Core Realm now, your strength is too weak, I wouldn’t want to be enemies with you!"
"If you don’t want to provoke me, then please leave! I do not welcome you here."
Murong Feng spoke indifferently.
"Leave?"
Lin Yi’s eyebrows twitched as a flash of anger rose in his heart.
He was Lin Yi, after all. In this Secular World, who else dared to look down on him besides his own master?
"Who do you think you are? I, Lin Yi, when I decide to leave, no one can stop me!"
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly, his tone laced with disdain and coldness.
"Oh? If that’s the case, then stay!"
"Swish!"
Murong Feng suddenly flicked the folding fan in his hand, and a sharp sword appeared.
This sword, entirely black, looked like a dagger and shone with a dark light.
"Swish!"
Murong Feng leapt up, his figure soaring towards Lin Yifei.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s expression also became serious.
"Swish!"
Lin Yi tapped the ground with the tip of his foot, his figure bursting out suddenly, a residual image flashing by, appearing in front of Murong Feng.
"Whoosh!"
His palm suddenly swung, turning into a residual image, and fiercely slapped at Murong Feng.
"Boom!"
However, Murong Feng’s figure abruptly became illusory, like a wisp of smoke, easily dodging Lin Yi’s attack and landing behind him, swinging his arm towards Lin Yi’s neck.
"Hmph!"
Lin Yi snorted coldly and swung his hand back, fiercely chopping down on Murong Feng’s wrist.
"Bang!"
However, when Lin Yi’s palm chopped down on the wrist of Murong Feng, it was like chopping on an iron plate, sending a painful shock through his hand.
"What Cultivation Technique is this?"
Looking at the vicious wound on Murong Feng’s wrist, Lin Yi couldn’t help but frown.
This Murong Feng possessed a terrifying defensive power comparable to that of a Nascent Soul Realm expert, which was simply unbelievable.
"I am the Young Sect Master of the Heavenly Martial Sect, naturally I have mastered a secret technique called ’Thousand Illusions Technique.’ Your attack, though powerful, is useless against me!"
"Swish!"
Murong Feng’s figure paused, and a mocking look appeared in his eyes.
Although he had cultivated the Thousand Illusions Technique, he had only learned the basics, and it was not his main cultivation method!
And this young man in front of him, whose Cultivation was merely at the Golden Core Realm, actually fancied breaking through his defense.
"Thousand Illusions Technique?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was also slightly taken aback.
He hadn’t expected that within this Secular World, there would be such a formidable Cultivation Technique.
It was known that the Heavenly Martial Sect was a super sect in the Kunlun Realm!
Reportedly, their influence was more extensive than five or six other sects combined, with the Heavenly Martial Sect being among the very top!
"Hmph, you think too much. Although the Thousand Illusions Technique is formidable, to me, it’s just a useless technique, so don’t waste your energy."
"Boom!"
However, just as Lin Yi’s words fell, a wild surge of energy erupted instantaneously.
"Bang!"
In the next moment, Lin Yi was sent flying backward, crashing to the ground.
His chest had collapsed, and he was bleeding profusely, presenting a shocking sight.
His face was pale as paper, and his gaze was fixed on Murong Feng.
"Indeed, a disciple of the Kunlun Realm, truly formidable!" Lin Yi gritted his teeth.
"It’s good that you understand," Murong Feng’s lips curled with a mocking sneer, "But indeed, you are a waste. If I wanted to kill you, it would be effortless!"
"However, that Storage Ring on you should be worth some money, I’ll let you go!"
Murong Feng licked his lips, his eyes filled with greed.

chapters.title: Chapter 826 - 846 Eyes Full of Greed
chapters.content:
This storage ring is indeed a treasure.
If he were to obtain it, he would definitely reap a considerable reward.
"However, don’t get too happy too soon, just you alone are not enough to deal with me!"
Lin Yi slowly climbed up from the ground, his face still pale.
Although his injuries were severe, they had not reached his core; therefore, they were not a major concern.
Nor had he expected that Murong Feng before him would possess such heaven-defying strength, forcing him into retreat again and again!
His strength was at the peak of the Golden Core Realm!
And Murong Feng was only in the Golden Core Realm!
This vast disparity caused a hint of alarm to surge in Lin Yi’s heart.
His gaze fell on the mountain range in the distance, feeling a prickling pain in his eyes.
He vaguely remembered that there seemed to be a valley filled with numerous Demon Beasts, whose power was extremely dangerous. If it weren’t for certain life-saving measures he possessed, he might have already perished in the jaws of Demon Beasts by now.
"You may go."
"I’m sparing your life," Murong Feng sneered coldly. "But I warn you, don’t even think about crossing me, otherwise, you will undoubtedly die."
After saying these words, Murong Feng’s figure also transformed into a streak of light, sweeping away into the distance.
"Hmph!"
Lin Yi coldly snorted, his eyes brimming with resentment. He turned to glance at the cultivators who were engaged in fierce battle in the distance, greed flickering intensely in his gaze.
He knew, if he could kill all those people, he would gain a lot of Spirit Stones!
"Whoosh!"
Lin Yi stomped on the ground with his foot, propelling his body like a cannonball towards the distance, vanishing from his original spot in the blink of an eye.
...
Lin Yi moved as fast as lightning.
And his target was the location where the group of cultivators was!
In Lin Yi’s eyes, these cultivators were but ants, easily crushed into dust with a mere slap of his hand.
"Whoosh!"
The next moment, he appeared in front of a cultivator at the Early Stage of the Golden Core Realm and sent a palm strike his way.
This cultivator had no chance to dodge and was sent flying with a strike.
"Pfft!"
Bright red liquid sprayed out, dyeing half of the sky scarlet, filling the air with a thick scent of blood.
And that cultivator lay on the ground, motionless.
"What’s happened? Is he dead?"
"An Early Stage Golden Core cultivator was instantly killed by an Intermediate Stage one?"
"This is terrifying, is this the foundation of Heavenly Martial City?"
The surrounding crowd all gasped in shock upon seeing this scene.
This Early Stage Golden Core cultivator was, in their eyes, already quite powerful. After all, dealing with an ordinary person was no issue at all.
Yet Lin Yi was able to instantly kill him with a palm strike!
Such power was truly terrifying.
"Swish!"
And in the midst of the crowd’s astonishment, Lin Yi’s figure flashed again, reaching another Early Stage Golden Core cultivator.
"Bang!"
He directly sent that cultivator flying with a palm strike, blood splattering across the sky.
Witnessing this scene, the eyes of the crowd nearly popped out of their sockets.
They couldn’t believe their eyes.
One punch to instantly kill an Intermediate Stage Golden Core powerhouse!
Moreover, this powerful cultivator at the Intermediate Stage of the Golden Core Realm was a woman?!
Lin Yi’s speed was too fast; even the powerful cultivator at the Intermediate Stage of the Golden Core Realm couldn’t keep up with his pace.
In just a brief moment, dozens of cultivators had fallen.
Not only that, but under Lin Yi’s hand, there wasn’t a single adversary worth a single strike.
"Brother Lin, how did you become so powerful? Could it be that you’ve improved your strength?"
"How is that possible? Didn’t you just advance to the Golden Core Realm not long ago? How could you be so formidable!"
The man who was sent flying also picked himself up from the ground, his eyes full of shock.
He hadn’t expected that in just a few short days without seeing Lin Yi, he would become so powerful.
Even he, a cultivator at the Intermediate Stage of the Golden Core Realm, couldn’t compete with him!
"I’m not sure myself, but these past few days, I’ve encountered a stroke of luck and made a breakthrough to the Intermediate Stage of the Golden Core Realm. My strength has also improved drastically!"
Lin Yi shook his head, then immediately fled into the distance.
He knew very well that staying here would only lead to death, and moreover, it would attract a swarm of Demon Beasts to besiege him.
He had to leave this place and find a quiet place to cultivate and restore his strength!
...
"Huff!"
A breath of foul air expelled, and Lin Yi’s face showed a bitter smile.
For so many years, he had tried various methods, but they had all been in vain. He had to admit that the gap between himself and Murong Feng was growing wider and had even reached an insurmountable chasm.
Moreover, a deep sense of defeat emerged in his heart, like a heavy stone pressing on his shoulders, making even his breathing difficult.
"Alas!"
Lin Yi sighed lightly, and then his eyes shimmered with a dense, venomous hue, "Murong Feng, since you are heartless, don’t blame me for being ruthless!"
"Since you like those things so much, I’ll just let you have them all stolen!"
After saying this, Lin Yi’s figure darted away toward the distant horizon.
Soon, Lin Yi arrived in front of a mountain range.
"Hm?"
Looking at the dense caves surrounding the mountain range, Lin Yi’s brow furrowed.
"What kind of godforsaken place is this?"
Uncertainty covered Lin Yi’s face.
However, without much hesitation, he directly entered one of the caves.
...
Elsewhere.
Murong Feng sped along and quickly returned to the Murong Family compound.
"Murong Feng!"
In a courtyard of the Murong Family, Murong Qingyi greeted Murong Feng with surprise and delight upon his return.
"I’m fine," Lin Yi said with a light smile, then turned to Murong Qingyi and asked, "How about you? Have your injuries healed?"
Murong Qingyi nodded slightly, a blush emerging on her pretty face, and she said in a low voice, "Thank you."
Her voice resonated with deep gratitude.
Although she was the most beautiful woman in Heavenly Martial City, it was also the first time she had received help from a man.
Lin Yi’s actions undoubtedly moved her.
Lin Yi smiled and said, "Don’t be so formal. If you encounter danger again, just call on me. I happen to be traveling nearby."
"Okay," Murong Qingyi nodded.
Murong Qingyi’s strength was quite weak. If she encountered danger, it would be difficult for her to withstand the attacks of cultivators at the level of the Golden Core Realm, and Murong Feng’s strength was obviously much stronger than hers.
Lin Yi’s face bore a smile, but his eyes sparkled with a sharp light as he thought to himself, "It seems I need to hasten my cultivation and improve my strength so that I can protect those I wish to protect!"
"Murong Feng, I’m going to cultivate now."
Murong Qingyi bit her lip slightly and said as she watched Lin Yi leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 827 - 847: Unaware of the Rules of Cultivation
chapters.content:
Although she did not understand the rules of cultivation, she knew that if she was seriously injured, it could very likely affect the progress of her cultivation.
"Alright, go in and cultivate," Lin Yi nodded.
"Boom, boom, boom—"
Just then, a series of loud booms came from deep within the distant mountains.
Hearing those booming sounds, Lin Yi was slightly startled, then lifted his eyes to look.
He saw several figures rapidly rushing out of the mountains, fleeing towards the distance.
His expression turned grave because those people were all Golden Core cultivators in the later stages!
Moreover, he noticed that their strength was quite extraordinary, all possessing cultivation at the Nascent Soul early stage!
"Could it be that Murong Feng, that good-for-nothing, has caused some disaster?" Lin Yi thought to himself.
Although he was not familiar with Murong Feng, they were, after all, from the same village.
What’s more, his qualification to enter the Jiuzhou Secret Realm this time relied on Murong Feng.
Thus, he felt somewhat guilty towards Murong Feng.
"It seems someone is pursuing Murong Feng."
Lin Yi murmured to himself, then prepared to leave.
Regardless of whether Murong Feng had encountered any trouble, he was not in a position to save him, especially since he possessed the power to protect himself.
However, before he could take a step, a ferocious oppressive force descended, making him involuntarily bend at the waist and kneel on the ground, his face flushing red and a mouthful of fresh blood involuntarily spilling out.
"How terrifying is this aura?"
A look of horror emerged on Lin Yi’s face.
He had never imagined that cultivators in the later stages of the Golden Core could be so fearsome!
He was completely unable to resist.
"Damn it, Murong Feng, what the hell are you playing at!"
Lin Yi roared, then his gaze turned to the distance, only to see a figure sweeping over from the far sky, and in an instant, it appeared in front of Lin Yi.
That figure’s strength was extremely formidable, actually a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator!
"Where is Murong Feng?" the powerful being scanned Lin Yi and coldly demanded.
"In my hands."
Lin Yi bowed his head and said, "If you wish to kill me, just do it."
The oppressive force from the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator made him dare not even stand, let alone resist.
"Release him!"
"I will give you ten Spirit Grasses, as long as you let him go, I promise I will not pursue your responsibility!"
"Ten Spirit Grasses for Murong Feng’s life!"
Suddenly, the eyes of the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator also shot out two bright beams of light, greedily staring at the Storage Ring in Lin Yi’s hand, his eyes flashing with fervor.
Lin Yi’s Storage Ring was indeed filled with a large amount of Spirit Stones!
His strength was already at the intermediate phase of the Nascent Soul Realm, and now, with these Spirit Stones, his power would definitely rise to another level!
Once he managed to break through to the later stages of the Nascent Soul Realm, then the entire Murong Family would be at his mercy.
And if his strength increased to the later stages of the Nascent Soul Realm, he could then enter the sacred land.
"Alright, hand over Murong Feng."
Lin Yi’s eyes lit up, knowing that Murong Feng’s life was finally saved, and he immediately handed over the Storage Ring in his hand to the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator.
"Good!"
Nascent Soul Stage experts’ eyes also surged with greedy flames as he reached for the storage ring.
"Humph!"
Suddenly, a cold snort sounded beside the ears of the Nascent Soul Stage expert, and subsequently, a figure appeared out of thin air.
"Who is it?!"
The Nascent Soul Stage expert was shocked. Just as he was about to make a move, he found a fierce palm strike coming towards him, causing his face to drastically change as he hurriedly circulated the True Yuan within his body to block the opponent’s palm strike.
"Bang!"
With a palm strike, the Nascent Soul Stage expert was knocked back several meters, and a trickle of fresh blood slowly streamed down from the corner of his mouth.
In his eyes, an elder in a black robe slowly emerged from the void, his face bearing a trace of icy coldness, his gaze fixed on the Nascent Soul Stage expert.
"Who are you, and why are you meddling?"
"Murong Feng, he is the young master of the Murong Family. If you dare to touch him, you will surely die!" the elder in the black robe declared coldly.
"Murong Feng, it’s actually his son!" The Nascent Soul Stage expert was momentarily stunned, then scoffed, "Murong Feng’s strength has only just reached the Intermediate Stage of Golden Core, while your cultivation has only just broken through to the later stages of Nascent Soul, right?"
"How can your strength possibly compare to his?!"
The Nascent Soul Stage expert said mockingly.
"If you don’t believe it, then just wait for your death!" the elder in the black robe coldly stated, "All of you, stay here!"
"Swish!"
After speaking, the elder in the black robe immediately attacked the rest of the group.
Seeing this, the group’s faces all changed color, and they quickly fled to avoid the black-robed elder’s attack.
"Seeking death!"
Seeing the group actually attempting to flee, the black-robed elder was uncontrollably furious.
He snorted coldly, flicked his finger, and a sharp gust of wind pierced the sky, directly smashing a Nascent Soul Early Stage expert into a pulp.
Seeing their companion killed, the remaining Nascent Soul Later Stage experts’ faces were also filled with rage.
"Murong Feng, you wait for me!"
Their eyes almost shot out flames as they each unleashed their Magical Treasures, turning them into various fierce moves, slashing towards the black-robed elder.
"Get back!"
The black-robed elder snorted coldly, flicked his finger, and a gust of powerful wind swept out, blowing that group of people away.
"Pfft!"
Several streams of blood sprayed out, and several Nascent Soul Later Stage experts had their dantians directly shattered, losing their combat power.
"Hisss!"
Seeing this, many surrounding experts all took a cold breath.
They originally thought that the Nascent Soul Later Stage expert was just extraordinary in origin, but now it appeared that he had clearly stepped into the later stages of Nascent Soul!
"I advise you all to surrender yourselves willingly," the black-robed elder said indifferently while glancing at the group.
Then he turned his gaze toward Lin Yi and said, "I give you one last chance, just release Murong Feng, and I promise, I won’t pursue your responsibility anymore."
"Haha, how ridiculous!" Lin Yi laughed loudly, "Your Murong Family might act tyrannically elsewhere, but here at the Qinglong Sect, you dare to snatch what is mine!"
"Today, I will act on behalf of the Murong family and clean up the house!"
Saying this, Lin Yi clenched his fists tightly, and the peak Nascent Soul Stage power within his body also began to operate wildly.
"Roar!"
The peak Nascent Soul Stage momentum exploded out, spreading like a tide, causing the surrounding space to tremble and become slightly distorted.
"Boom!"
The next moment, Lin Yi violently threw a punch, and a massive surge of fist wind, like a flood dragon emerging from the sea, tore through the heavens and fiercely struck the chest of the Nascent Soul Stage expert.

chapters.title: Chapter 828 - 848: A Beautiful Curve
chapters.content:
"Pfft!"
The figure of a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator was blasted out directly, drawing a beautiful arc in midair before crashing into the nearby forest.
All the trees there, under the influence of the cultivator’s power, turned into dust and dispersed into the air.
The Nascent Soul Stage cultivator was flung away, severely injured and on the brink of death.
"How about now, do you believe it?" Lin Yi asked indifferently, looking at the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator.
"Lin... Lin Yi!"
"How could it possibly be Lin Yi?!"
The eyes of the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator bulged out, his face full of disbelief as he stared at Lin Yi.
He had never imagined that the man he was chasing was actually Lin Yi’s father.
What a coincidence, wasn’t it?
"Heh, now, you should believe it, right?" Lin Yi said coldly.
"I believe... I believe it..." the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator swallowed hard, struggling to speak.
"You said the Murong Family was very domineering here. Why would anyone still dare to offend the Murong Family’s dignity?" Lin Yi sneered.
"The Murong Family isn’t without its weaknesses."
"Your weakness is that you are too proud, deeming yourselves peerlessly noble. In your eyes, we ordinary cultivators are nothing but ants."
"It’s precisely because they look down on us ants that they send us here to search for Spiritual Medicine," the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator said.
"Hmph!" Lin Yi scoffed coldly. "The Murong Family holds itself aloft, how could they look upon us?"
"They think we are just ordinary humans, but little do they know, each of us possesses extraordinary talents!"
"What right does the Murong Family have to look down on us?"
"This matter will definitely not end here!"
Saying this, Lin Yi stepped forward and delivered a kick that sent the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator flying.
"Thump!"
The Nascent Soul Stage cultivator crashed heavily to the ground, vomiting several mouthfuls of fresh blood, his eyes filled with intense shock.
He could never have imagined that an Early Stage cultivator could possess such terrifying strength.
"Any last words you want to say, members of the Murong Family?" Lin Yi sneered.
"There are... none!" the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator struggled to speak.
"Good, in that case, I don’t need to spare your life. Farewell!"
Lin Yi reached out with one palm, and a blazing flame appeared in his hand, then he fiercely slapped it down on the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator.
"Pfft!"
The chest of the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator caved in instantly, and a mouthful of dark red blood gushed out.
"No, don’t kill me, I am willing to redeem my faults, just spare my life!" After witnessing Lin Yi’s terrifying power, the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator finally completely submitted, constantly kowtowing to Lin Yi.
"Hmph!" Lin Yi snorted disdainfully, a mighty pure Fire Attribute Energy rapidly surged into the body of the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator through his palm.
"Ah!"
The Nascent Soul Stage cultivator screamed in agony, his body igniting into fierce flames and soon turned to ash, leaving nothing behind.
After dealing with the Nascent Soul Stage cultivator, Lin Yi then turned his gaze towards the many disciples of the Murong Family around them.
"Aren’t you kneeling yet?!" Lin Yi shouted coldly.
Hearing this, the disciples of the Murong Family all shuddered and quickly knelt down.
"You, stand up!"
"You, you two, stand up!"
Lin Yi shifted his gaze toward the other two Nascent Soul Stage powerhouses and said, "You two, kneel down for me."
"Yes!"
Hearing this, the two Nascent Soul Stage powerhouses dared not defy him and had to bow their heads and bend their waists, slowly kneeling down with their eyes filled with a deep unwillingness.
Looking down from above, Lin Yi watched the two men and said indifferently, "I’m only going to ask you once, kneel or not kneel!"
"I... we won’t kneel!" one of the Nascent Soul Stage powerhouses said through gritted teeth.
"Oh? You won’t kneel, is that right?" Lin Yi’s eyebrows raised, a cold glint emerging in the depths of his eyes.
"I’m telling you, our Murong Family is a top-tier clan within the Nine-Star Domain. If you dare to harm a single hair on me, our young master will definitely find you, settle the score, and exterminate your whole family!" another Nascent Soul Stage powerhouse shouted in anger.
"Heh, exterminate my whole family?"
"Then I shall wait and see, to see who exterminates whose family!"
During this conversation, Lin Yi’s figure burst forth, and with a single palm strike, he shattered that Nascent Soul Stage powerhouse into pieces.
This scene also caused the surrounding cultivators to pale in fright, everyone falling silent as if struck by a chilling winter.
A single person, capable of killing a Nascent Soul Stage powerhouse, such strength was simply terrifying!
At that moment, Lin Yi’s gaze turned toward the remaining disciples and demanded, "Who else defies me? Step forward."
"You... don’t act rashly!" Seeing this, the surrounding disciples immediately panicked, retreating continuously.
"Hmph!"
Lin Yi snorted coldly and said, "All of you kneel down right now!"
Hearing this, the crowd had no choice but to kneel one by one, their faces filled with fear and panic.
"Hmph!"
Lin Yi nodded in satisfaction and then looked toward the distant horizon, speaking lightly, "I’ve dealt with those people, now, it’s your turn!"
"You too, kneel down!"
Hearing this, everyone trembled.
"I, we also dare not defy you, can you let us stand up first?"
"Right, let us stand up, then we will kneel again, that should be fine, right?"
These people weren’t foolish; they too sensed Lin Yi’s terrifying power and dared not contradict him, only hoping to delay.
However, Lin Yi didn’t pay them any heed. With a single step, he appeared in front of a Nascent Soul Stage powerhouse.
The Nascent Soul Stage powerhouse was shocked by Lin Yi’s sudden appearance, his eyes filled with terror.
"What, what do you want to do?" the Nascent Soul Stage powerhouse stammered.
"What do I want to do? Weren’t you quite arrogant just now? What, scared now?" Lin Yi said casually.
"Hmph, Lin Yi, don’t push people too far!"
Hearing Lin Yi’s mocking tone, the Nascent Soul Stage powerhouse became furiously embarrassed.
"Push you too far?" Lin Yi said coldly with a smile, "Since that’s the case, today I will cripple you, and then cripple every last one of your Murong Family’s members. How about that?"
"You, you wouldn’t dare?!"
"You would do that?!"
The Nascent Soul Stage powerhouse, hearing this, was startled by Lin Yi’s words, his face showing a shocked expression.
Although he knew that Lin Yi was very powerful, he didn’t believe that Lin Yi could just wipe them all out—could he?
"What wouldn’t I dare?"
Lin Yi’s eyes were icily fierce, and a terrifying aura swept out from within him, enveloping the surrounding disciples.
"Pff!"
Instantly, those disciples from the Murong Family spat out a mouthful of blood, their eyes wide open, staring fixedly at Lin Yi, blood streaming from the corners of their mouths.

chapters.title: Chapter 829 - 849: The Dignity of the Murong Family
chapters.content:
"Our Murong family will never allow anyone to insult the Murong family!"
"Today, no matter what, I will preserve the dignity of my Murong family!"
As they spoke, the disciples of the Murong family were also circulating their True Qi, prepared to fight to the death and perish together with Lin Yi.
"Hmph, if that’s the case, then I’ll grant your wish."
Lin Yi also sneered coldly, and his right palm fiercely struck out.
Bang bang bang...
In an instant, a series of muffled sounds kept coming, those disciples of the Murong family were directly turned into minced flesh by Lin Yi’s single palm.
Effortlessly tossing those corpses into a Spatial Ring, Lin Yi then turned his gaze to those disciples with the weakest Cultivation, and said indifferently, "What about you guys? Do I need to take action personally, or will you choose for yourselves?"
"Brother Lin, I am willing to submit to you!"
"Brother Lin, please spare my wretched life!"
"Brother Lin, I am willing to surrender."
...
Those disciples of the Murong family who had originally intended to resist stubbornly, one by one, were scared out of their wits and knelt down, begging for mercy.
"Heh, I’m not interested in a bunch of trash. You, cripple your own Dantians and get lost," Lin Yi waved his hand dismissively and said.
"Ah?"
Hearing this, the disciples of the Murong family were instantly dumbfounded.
They had never anticipated that Lin Yi would be so ruthless.
Not only destroying their Dantians but also crippling their own Cultivation?
"Brother Lin, this..." those disciples of the Murong family with the weakest Cultivation couldn’t help but turn pale.
"What are you hesitating for? If you don’t want to cripple your own Dantians, then just get lost."
Lin Yi furrowed his brow and said coldly.
"You... let’s go!"
In the end, with no other choice, these disciples could only cripple their Cultivation before leaving.
Watching their disheveled escape, Lin Yi shook his head and sighed, saying, "Sigh, this is the Immortal Cultivation World, where the law of the jungle prevails. Without strength, one is destined to be bullied!"
"But you shouldn’t lose heart, after all, this is just the beginning!"
With that, Lin Yi led his disciples toward the direction of the city.
"Phew, thankfully Brother Lin didn’t kill us all; otherwise, that would have been a real problem."
"Yeah, Lin Yi is so fierce. He truly deserves the title of Jiuzhou Continent’s number one Artifact Refining Grandmaster, even those in the Qi Transformation Realm can be killed with one move. It’s terrifying!"
"Alas, only the peak powers of the Jiuzhou Continent can nurture such a character."
...
All the disciples were discussing animatedly, all feeling extremely fortunate.
They had never anticipated that they would encounter a super-powerful being in the Qi Transformation Realm.
Had it not been for their considerable strength, they would have likely become the souls under that young man’s sword by now!
What was even more shocking was that Lin Yi had crippled an elder of the Nine Cauldrons Sect!
This was far more terrifying than slaughtering all of them!
"Lin Yi, I will kill you!"
"I will also kill you, to avenge my father!"
"And you all, remember this well. If you see Lin Yi in the future, you better go around him, otherwise, you’ll end up like those people!"
Atop a mountain, the disciples of the Murong family stared at Lin Yi with furious eyes, teeth clenched in anger and shouting.
Lin Yi paid them no mind, leading his numerous disciples as he continued towards the direction of the Nine Cauldrons Sect.
"Brother Lin, that person doesn’t seem to have left the vicinity."
"Hm? He still doesn’t want to leave?"
Lin Yi also furrowed his brow slightly, feeling a touch of confusion in his heart.
Based on his estimation, that person should have left quickly, since his only target was the Nine Cauldrons Sect, and thus his only enemy would remain the Nine Cauldrons Sect.
Could it be that the person wasn’t that young man?
"Let’s go, take a look."
Lin Yi thought for a moment, and without much consideration, he continued flying towards the Nine Cauldrons Sect with a group of disciples in tow.
At this moment, within the grand hall of the Nine Cauldrons Sect, an elder from the Murong family sat in the highest seat, his expression dark.
"How goes it? Have your people captured Lin Yi?"
The elder’s eyes, fixed in a stern gaze, bore into the Murong family’s disciples as he asked.
"Reporting to the elder, he has not died. Instead, that youngster named Li Chen was captured by him."
"Oh?"
Upon hearing this, the elder’s eyes suddenly brightened as he said, "And where is he now?"
"It is said that they are hurrying back, and our men have already intercepted him."
"Mhm, good, very good!" The elder nodded, a cold smile emerging on his face as he said, "Hmph, Lin Yi, to think he could contend with me, is pure folly!"
He then cast covert glances towards the other elders.
The other elders immediately understood his silent command.
One elder slowly stood up, his gaze towards the Murong family disciples revealing a hint of cold sharpness.
"You, go and capture that wretch Li Chen!"
"We will bring Lin Yi here!"
...
"Hurry and capture that youngster Li Chen, and be quick about it!" The elder of the Murong family barked at the disciples.
"Yes!"
"As you command!"
Upon hearing his orders, all the Murong family disciples’ faces brightened with excitement as they hurriedly bowed and responded.
"Hmph, Lin Yi, this time, your death is certain!"
"I will let you taste the might of our Murong family, and this time, I will also have Li Chen’s body torn to shreds!"
The Murong family elder’s lips curled into a sinister smile as he pondered.
...
Nine Cauldrons Sect.
Lin Yi, leading his group of Murong family disciples, had returned to the sect. Upon entering, Lin Yi immediately spotted Li Chen.
In Li Chen’s hands, he carried the corpse of a man in a black robe, the man’s neck clearly twisted, and his body lying on the ground, unquestionably dead.
Seeing this, the Murong family disciples’ faces showed shock and alarm.
"Brother Lin Yi, what, what is that?"
A stammering Murong family disciple asked.
Lin Yi shook his head and said, "That is someone from the Nine Cauldrons Sect whom I’ve slain. For now, you all rest here. After I deal with some matters, I will bring that youngster over."
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the Murong family disciples could only nod their heads reluctantly.
"Brother Lin, please go ahead with your tasks, but please be careful. The people of the Nine Cauldrons Sect are not like us from the Murong family.
Without a significant amount of True Yuan, one wouldn’t dare to provoke that young man. If he really gets angered, that would be bad," said the disciples worriedly.
They well knew that the former Li Chen had crippled an elder of the Nascent Soul Stage from the Nine Cauldrons Sect.
"Don’t worry, I know my limits."
After speaking, Lin Yi led the disciples straight to the main hall of the sect leader.
At that moment, the elder from the Murong family was sitting inside the grand hall. Seeing Lin Yi approaching, a ferocious smile appeared on his face as he said, "Lin Yi, how did it go, did you catch Lin Yi?"

chapters.title: Chapter 830 - 850: Somewhat Hard to Believe
chapters.content:
Lin Yi nodded and said, "Caught him."
"Oh?" When the elder from the Murong family heard this, he was slightly stunned.
He had originally thought Lin Yi would use some method to capture Li Chen, but he had not expected Lin Yi to do so with such ease, which made it somewhat unbelievable to him.
Not only that elder but also the other elders had looks of surprise on their faces, obviously not expecting Lin Yi to have actually brought back Lin Yi. After all, just a moment ago, Lin Yi had been chased to the point of having no way to heaven and no door into the earth!
Moreover, Lin Yi had fled into the Nine Cauldrons Sect because he was being pursued, but where did this youth named Li Chen come from? Could it be that he had also joined the Nine Cauldrons Sect?
These thoughts inevitably arose in the hearts of the elders.
The elder from the Murong family looked at Lin Yi with a somewhat strange expression.
"Lin Yi, didn’t you say he was on his way back?" the elder from the Murong family couldn’t help but ask.
Lin Yi smiled faintly upon hearing this and said, "That Li Chen has already died under my sword."
"What did you say?" Hearing this, the elders from the Murong family all widened their eyes.
Lin Yi had actually slain Li Chen? And Lin Yi was a Sword Cultivator?
They found this hard to accept, after all, Li Chen was a Foundation Establishment Cultivator!
The Foundation Establishment Li Chen had actually been slaughtered by Lin Yi?
"Correct, he died under my sword," Lin Yi said with a light smile, continuing, "I’ve already informed the seniors from the Murong family to come and execute that beast Li Chen."
"What?" The elder from the Murong family’s face darkened instantly upon hearing this.
"Damn it!"
"Lin Yi, you really have some nerve, actually killing Li Chen!"
"Lin Yi, are you not afraid of death? How dare you defy the Sect Leader’s orders?"
The elders from the Murong family were furious, all aware of how important Li Chen’s existence was to their Nine Cauldrons Sect.
Therefore, once this news got out, it was bound to cause a huge shock.
And the Sect Leader of the Murong family would be even more infuriated.
The elders from the Murong family, one by one, had extremely ferocious expressions.
"I’ve already informed them, no matter what, today we must capture Li Chen alive at all costs!" Lin Yi’s voice also became icy cold.
The people from the Murong family nodded one after another upon hearing this.
"Right, since you dare to kill Li Chen, then we’ll first behead you, the traitor!"
"Yes, behead you, the traitor, and then capture that beast Li Chen!"
"Lin Yi, today we shall purge the Murong family of a traitor!"
The elders gnashed their teeth, their faces very fierce, as if they wished they could tear Lin Yi apart right now and then capture that kid Li Chen to hand over to the Sect Leader for judgment.
Lin Yi, upon hearing this, only traced a mocking smile around his lips.
"Lin Yi, let me tell you, today you must die here. Our Murong family will never allow anyone to defy the Sect Leader," an elder said to Lin Yi with a cold snort.
"Lin Yi, you are nothing but an ant, daring to defy the Sect Leader’s will? Today, even if so many of us join hands, we will definitely be able to kill you!" another elder said coldly.
Lin Yi watched their ferocious expressions without saying a word.
"Lin Yi, you are undoubtedly going to die today," an elder from the Murong family declared.
"Hahaha... Lin Yi, so you too have moments of fear?"
The elders, seeing Lin Yi like this, all began to laugh uproariously, as if they saw a comical scene before them, feeling extremely pleased.
Lin Yi looked at those mocking elders, his face still sporting a smile, as if he hadn’t heard a word.
Seeing Lin Yi in this state, the elders couldn’t help but show a trace of confusion on their faces.
Shouldn’t be, though. Li Chen as a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, while one realm lower than Lin Yi, shouldn’t be this afraid?
And it was at that moment, abruptly, Lin Yi moved.
His Blood Sword in hand suddenly swept through the air, unleashing a terrifying burst of Sword Qi that attacked the Murong family’s elders.
Lin Yi’s sword was drawn quickly and with fierce momentum, targeting one elder in particular.
That elder, seeing Lin Yi lash out so suddenly, was shocked.
"You little beast, you dare to attack me?" the elder bellowed, his palm flipping to condense a long spear instantly, thrusting it towards Lin Yi.
"Clang!"
Lin Yi’s longsword struck hard against the spear, emitting a crisp sound of metal clashing, and a powerful force exploded from the spear.
The elder was forced to retreat several steps, and disbelief flickered in his eyes.
At this time, the Murong family’s disciples also reacted, grabbing their weapons and charging towards Lin Yi.
Seeing the oncoming crowd, Lin Yi’s gaze gradually turned icy.
"Court death!" Lin Yi’s gaze swept around, eventually fixing on the elder.
"All of you, must die!"
Lin Yi’s voice was chilling, as if it were a cold breath from the underworld of Jiuyou.
Hearing this, a chill surged through the heart of the Murong family’s elder, causing his body to tremble and his internal Spiritual Power to roil violently.
"Such a terrifying killing intent," thought the Murong family elder to himself.
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, all of the Murong family’s people felt their hearts skip a beat.
"So arrogant, is this a provocation against our Murong family?" one elder showed a look of disdain, staring at Lin Yi and bellowed.
"Lin Yi, don’t you forget you’re a traitor, a betrayer of the sect, deserving of death."
"Now, you have been wanted by the sect master, do you think you can still leave?"
"Lin Yi, I advise you to surrender immediately, or what awaits you will be death, and it will be an irreversible one!"
The elders of the Murong family each spoke up.
Hearing these words, Lin Yi’s gaze grew colder.
He indeed was a traitor.
But he had never thought of giving up.
"You all deserve to die!"
Lin Yi’s form suddenly turned into a blur, darting towards the group of Murong family’s elders.
Seeing this, the elders’ expressions changed abruptly, quickly raising their spears to attack Lin Yi.
And the disciples of the Murong family also lifted their Magical Treasures, attacking Lin Yi.
"Lin Yi, I want to see just how powerful your swordsmanship really is," an elder holding a spear roared and thrust it towards Lin Yi’s body.
"Clang!"
Lin Yi’s Blood Sword collided with the spear, generating a piercing clashing sound.
"Huh? What’s going on?" The elder’s brow furrowed slightly, feeling a tingling in his arm. The power emanating from the Blood Sword startled him.
"Lin Yi, your swordsmanship has reached such a level? You’re only at the realm of Foundation Establishment!"
"Do you actually possess such profound swordsmanship?"

chapters.title: Chapter 831 - 851 Astonished Expression
chapters.content:
The elders of the Murong family all revealed expressions of shock, clearly having not anticipated this.
Lin Yi had used only two strokes of his sword to breach their defenses.
This left them somewhat in disbelief.
"How is this possible? This youngster’s strength, it actually increased so quickly?" An elder from the Murong family also showed a look of incredible disbelief, staring at Lin Yi and exclaiming.
The rest of the elders felt the same, their faces heavy with astonishment.
Lin Yi’s cultivation level was but at the level of the Void Refinement Realm, logically speaking, even if he had some special scriptures, they should not be this weak.
"Lin Yi, when exactly did you cultivate this technique?" An elder from the Murong family couldn’t help but ask.
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly, "Want to know the reason? Then go to hell!"
"Boom!"
With a fierce stomp of his foot, Lin Yi shot toward the Murong family disciples like a cannonball, bombarding them rapidly.
These disciples of the Murong family had cultivation levels at the early stage and peak of Void Refinement, all possessing the strength of these stages.
But now, seeing how ferocious Lin Yi was, they were all terrified to the point of their souls scattering.
Lin Yi’s body, like a meteor, moved extremely fast; in the blink of an eye, he had charged into the midst of that group, and those people didn’t even have time to dodge before they were directly cleaved by Lin Yi’s Blood Sword, with blood flying everywhere.
While the disciples of the Murong family were panic-stricken and trying to flee.
But how could their speed of escape compare to Lin Yi’s? They were quickly caught up to and one by one were slain by Lin Yi.
"Bang!"
When Lin Yi approached one of the Murong family elders, that elder’s long spear swelled in the wind, smashing toward Lin Yi’s chest.
"Bang!"
However, as soon as the long spear reached in front of Lin Yi, it stalled.
The spear was actually caught in Lin Yi’s hand, the elder unable to break free no matter what tricks he used.
"How is it possible? This youngster’s physical body, it’s actually this powerful?" The elder’s eyes widened, his face full of shock.
At this moment, Lin Yi’s lips curved into a bloodthirsty smile, his arm flexed slightly and he directly crushed the long spear to pieces.
Seeing this, the elder’s face went pale as he hurriedly turned and fled towards the distance.
"Bang bang bang!"
However, no matter how fast that elder fled, he wasn’t faster than Lin Yi, who in an instant caught up and grabbed his neck, hurling him straight into the mountain ravine.
The other Murong family elders, witnessing this, all displayed a trace of terror and scrambled to escape.
"Thinking of leaving? Too late!"
"Stay behind for me!"
Lin Yi scoffed coldly, flicking the blade of his sword and assaulted the Murong family elders.
"Sizzle!"
One after another, the Murong family disciples were sliced in half by Lin Yi’s Sword Qi, their screams echoing long in the forest, chilling to the ears of any who heard them.
The leading elder of the Murong family, his face ghostly pale, kept stimulating his True Yuan to defend himself while shouting loudly, "Big brother, save me!"
The "big brother" from the Murong family was currently battling with the clan’s disciples, hearing the elder’s cries for help, his face immediately darkened.
"Damn it!"
He let out a low shout and charged straight towards Lin Yi.
He knew that he could no longer afford to worry about anything else, he had to first kill Lin Yi, then go to rescue the other disciples; otherwise, the consequences would be unimaginable.
"Swish!"
And Lin Yi, seeing the Murong Family elder charging at him, flicked his wrist again, and a blood-colored Sword Qi burst forth once more.
The speed of the Sword Qi was extremely fast, and although the Murong Family elder did everything possible to stop it, he was still penetrated by the Blood Sword in the abdomen, and then, his head was chopped off by Lin Yi with a single sword strike.
"Puchi!"
Lin Yi, holding that blood-dripping head in his hand, casually tossed it aside against a boulder.
"Clatter!"
And at that moment, the body of the Murong Family elder directly fell into the valley.
His corpse, now stained red with fresh blood, looked like a blooming blood flower, displaying beautiful colors, yet so eerie.
After killing this Murong Family elder, Lin Yi turned his gaze towards the remaining disciples of the Murong Family.
"Kill!"
His eyes erupted with intense killing intent, and with a fierce wave of the Blood Sword in his hand, he reaped the lives of those Murong Family disciples.
"Thump!"
By now, the Murong Family disciples no longer had the will to resist; they knelt on the ground one by one, kowtowing and begging Lin Yi for mercy.
"Brother Lin, spare my life, I am willing to submit to you!"
"Brother Lin, please let us go."
Those Murong Family disciples, looking at the bodies strewn across the valley, began to have red-rimmed eyes.
They were, after all, leaders of a great clan, how could they have ever endured such humiliation?
Moreover, among these disciples, there were even those who had reached the Void Refinement Realm.
Yet now, they had been slaughtered cleanly by Lin Yi alone, and in the most straightforward and brutal manner, annihilating all of their clansmen.
How could they not fear?
"Hmph!" Lin Yi snorted coldly, directly planting the Blood Sword on the hillside, and stepped towards the Murong Family disciples, saying, "I, Lin Yi, never kill the innocent, so I will not take your lives. As long as you submit to me willingly, I will let you live."
This statement from Lin Yi made the Murong Family disciples sigh in relief.
They naturally understood that if they did not obey Lin Yi, their fate would be death.
"Lin Yi, since you have killed them, don’t even think of leaving alive."
An extraordinarily cold voice came through, and then a thin young man with a terrifyingly somber face walked over from afar.
Lin Yi looked at the young man and sneered, saying, "You want to kill me? You’re far from capable enough."
After finishing his words, Lin Yi flipped his palm and took out a yellow Talisman Paper, then crushed it.
A mass of purplish-black flames then surged out from the yellow Talisman Paper, burning towards the young man.
"What! To have such a treasure?" Seeing the purplish-black flames, the young man’s pupils shrank instantly, and his complexion turned dark in a flash.
He had not expected Lin Yi to possess such a powerful item.
Keep in mind, he was a strong practitioner of the Intermediate Stage of the Void Refinement Realm, yet those purplish-black flames made him feel a deep crisis.
"Whoosh!"
The young man gritted his teeth, immediately brought out a defensive artifact to ward off the purplish-black flames, and with a flicker, appeared in front of Lin Yi, his eyes filled with rage as he said, "You little beast, how dare you harm the people of my Murong Family, today I will surely take your head!"

chapters.title: Chapter 832 - 852: Keep Retreating
chapters.content:
"Claim my head? With your capabilities?" Lin Yi scoffed disdainfully at the young man before charging directly toward him.
The young man, seeing Lin Yi rushing over, coldly snorted and confronted him head-on.
At this moment, as Lin Yi and the young man closed in on each other, their attacks grew increasingly fierce.
Lin Yi’s swordsmanship was highly skilled, every move deadly. Each time he thrust his sword, he precisely targeted the young man’s vulnerabilities, forcing him to continually retreat.
The young man, watching Lin Yi, grew even paler and roared, "You little beast, go to hell!"
He bellowed while swinging the weapon in his hand.
"Buzz..."
Just as he made his move, waves of buzzing vibrations emanated, followed abruptly by a change in the young man’s expression. Then, he saw a blood-red longsword piercing down fiercely from the sky.
"Not good!"
At this sight, the young man’s heart lurched, and his eyes revealed an extreme fear.
With quick reflexes, he swung his weapon toward the Blood Sword, trying to chop it down.
"Boom!"
The moment the two made contact, a massive burst of spiritual power erupted, sending the surrounding mountains flying. The thunderous noise carried far and wide, deafening.
Both Lin Yi and the young man were thrown backward by the force.
"Pfft!"
As soon as they stabilized, they couldn’t help but spit out a mouthful of blood, their bodies faltering.
"How is this possible? This kid is just at the early stage of the Body Refinement Cultivator, how could he possess such formidable physical strength?"
The young man looked at Lin Yi, his expression even more shocked, then glanced at the sword in front of Lin Yi with deep wariness.
Though merely a common spiritual artifact, the terrifying pressure it exuded made his heart pound.
"What rank is this spiritual artifact?"
The young man’s eyes narrowed into slits, his gaze fixated on the sword.
"A spiritual artifact?"
Lin Yi looked at the sword in front of him, his expression somewhat odd, "This is a Holy Level spiritual artifact. Surprised?"
"Hiss!"
As soon as Lin Yi spoke, the young man sharply inhaled a breath of cold air.
"A Holy Level spiritual artifact? How is that possible!"
The young man stared at Lin Yi, his face filled with disbelief.
Ordinary spiritual artifacts were just low-rank spiritual artifacts.
But a Holy Level spiritual artifact was a truly top-tier magical treasure.
In the Immortal Realm, other than a few special forces possessing such spiritual artifacts, they just did not appear.
Yet now, Lin Yi holding a Holy Level spiritual artifact made the young man’s heart pound uncontrollably.
"Hehe, this sword is called the Bloodthirsty Sword," Lin Yi smiled as he looked at the young man.
The young man’s expression fluctuated rapidly.
He kept his focus locked on the Bloodthirsty Sword, seemingly contemplating something.
"This Bloodthirsty Sword was crafted by an alchemist who infused it with some precious herbs and then forged it using a special method."
Lin Yi explained lightly to the young man then said, "Now, let me show you just how sharp this Bloodthirsty Sword really is!"
"Whoosh!"
As soon as the voice fell, the Bloodthirsty Sword sliced through the air, leaving behind a bloody afterimage as it stabbed toward the young man.
The young man’s face changed slightly, and he quickly swung his weapon to block in front of his chest.
"Bang!"
In that moment, a terrifying spiritual power erupted from the sword, directly knocking the young man backwards.
"Spurt!"
The young man’s mouth tasted sweet, and a mouthful of fresh blood spurted out as he was sent flying backward, landing heavily in a clump of trees in the distance.
The young man’s strength was considered extremely high within the Divinity Transformation Realm, even comparable to a mid-stage Nascent Soul cultivator.
Unfortunately, he had encountered Lin Yi, a freak of nature.
"Thud!"
After the young man crashed to the ground, his face turned deathly pale, and his eyes filled with fear.
"You, who exactly are you? Why are you following us?" the young man asked Lin Yi, uncertain and alarmed.
Lin Yi’s identity made him suspicious. Could this youth be from a major sect’s direct line? Otherwise, how could he possess such a Spiritual Artifact?
Their Qingyun Sect also had nothing more than a Holy Level Spiritual Artifact.
This youth, wielding such a Holy Level Spiritual Artifact and possessing greater physical strength than him, was clearly a Body Refinement Cultivator.
Lin Yi glanced at him and said, "I am a disciple of the Heavenly Sword Sect. I came to the Southern Region searching for a Spirit Fruit, but I didn’t expect to be chased by a group of demonic beasts."
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the young man’s eyes widened in shock as he stared at Lin Yi and asked, "You are a disciple of the Heavenly Sword Sect?"
"Why? Do you know someone from the Heavenly Sword Sect?" Lin Yi asked, slightly frowning.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, a hint of apprehension flashed in the young man’s eyes, followed by a bitter expression as he said, "How could I possibly know someone from the Heavenly Sword Sect? I have seen disciples of the sect, but I have never seen him."
"Oh? Is that so? Then do you know where the Heavenly Sword Sect is located?" Lin Yi nodded and asked.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the young man hesitated for a moment and said, "The Heavenly Sword Sect is in the north, but it’s quite a distance from here and will take some time to reach. Moreover, the area is quite dangerous."
"Um, I understand. I just want to go there and see if there are any Spirit Fruits," Lin Yi said.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, a glint of intrigue also flashed through the young man’s eyes.
Lin Yi was strong, and as a Body Refinement Cultivator, if their Qingyun Sect could ally with the Heavenly Sword Sect, it might prove to be a significant advantage.
Thinking this, the young man’s eyes brightened as he quickly said, "In that case, let’s go together."
"Good!"
Lin Yi looked at the young man and said, "First, let me give you a bottle of elixir. Taking it will help heal your injuries."
With that, Lin Yi took out a bottle of Healing Pills and handed it to the young man.
"This is?"
"This is a Holy Level Healing Pill. After taking it, your injuries will immediately heal!"
Lin Yi’s words caused the young man’s face to instantly show a look of shock, and a trace of greed appeared in the depths of his eyes.
A Holy Level Healing Pill!
Such a pill would not be found in more than three pieces throughout Qingzhou.
"My young friend, you are too kind."
"There’s no need for thanks. I am only trying to help. If you don’t mind, I can help dispel the toxins in your body. However, I hope you keep our matter a secret. Otherwise, I fear the Heavenly Sword Sect will not let you off easily!" Lin Yi said coldly.
Hearing this, the young man’s face slightly changed as he looked at Lin Yi and said, "My young friend, please rest assured, I will absolutely not speak of this matter. I only hope you can promise me one thing!"
Lin Yi looked at the young man and said, "Speak."

chapters.title: Chapter 833 - 853: Nine Thousand Year Old Ice-Fire Ginseng
chapters.content:
"After you help me dispel the toxins in my body, I can give you a 9,000-year-old Ice-Fire Ginseng," the youth said, looking at Lin Yi.
A 9,000-year-old Ice-Fire Ginseng?
Hearing about the Spirit Grass that aged 9,000 years, Lin Yi’s eyes lit up, but soon, dimmed again.
Such a Spiritual Medicine, even in Qingzhou, was very expensive, not something ordinary people could afford.
"Although a 9,000-year-old Ice-Fire Ginseng is rare, it’s not unheard of in our Heavenly Sword Sect," the youth quickly added upon seeing Lin Yi’s disappointment.
"Really?" Lin Yi asked, his eyes brightening again, somewhat excitedly.
This Ice-Fire Ginseng held a fatal temptation for him.
"Really, I can stake my life on it!" the youth solemnly assured Lin Yi.
"If that’s the case, then I’ll believe you!"
"Alright, you can go now," Lin Yi waved his hand, dismissively indicating that he could leave.
Seeing Lin Yi’s attitude, the youth’s face stiffened, and then he stood up and said, "If that’s the case, I will take my leave."
The youth’s voice fell, and he turned and walked away.
Once the youth had left, a smile crept across Lin Yi’s mouth, and a cold light flickered in his eyes.
This youth, though a Nascent Soul at its peak as a cultivator, was negligible in Lin Yi’s view.
"It seems I still underestimated my own potential!"
"Whether it’s the Heavenly Sword Sect or Qing Yun Sect, in my eyes, they’re both merely ants."
"If that’s the case, then I shall let all of you disappear."
Lin Yi let out a cold laugh, his form suddenly leaping towards the distance.
...
"Hmm?"
Suddenly, Lin Yi halted his steps and looked up into the void.
"Is it him?" Lin Yi narrowed his eyes slightly as he watched the elder ahead.
He had just sensed a hint of danger, a threat on a soul level, so he immediately stopped.
"Could he also be from Qing Yun Sect? But why can’t I sense any aura from him?"
"He is a powerful being at the Transforming Divine Realm, his strength no less than mine."
"Although I am not as strong as him, I should still be able to escape."
"In that case, I’ll avoid the sharp edges for now, wait until my strength advances further, and then go back to confront these two."
"And this time, I must defeat that man in green."
Thinking this, Lin Yi’s eyes flashed with determination.
"Boom!"
The man in green looked at Lin Yi, his palm striking down, and immediately, a fierce surge of Spiritual Energy wildly swept toward Lin Yi.
"Hmph!" Lin Yi glanced at the man in green, his figure instantly bursting forward, swinging a punch toward the man in green.
"Bang!"
Lin Yi and the man in green’s Fist Force collided, generating a violent shockwave that sent both their bodies flying backwards, smashing through several mountain ranges.
"Pfft!"
Blood spat out, Lin Yi’s body heavily crashed onto the ground, a piece of broken rock piercing directly through his chest.
Lin Yi looked up at the man in green and sneered, "Injured by that?"
"Hmph, you little beast, daring to harm a person of the Qing Yun Sect. Today, I will tear you to pieces!" The young man’s face darkened, his aura bursting forth, enveloping Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s expression was also incredibly grim, he hadn’t expected this man in green to be so formidable.
Seeing the expression on Lin Yi’s face, the young man scoffed coldly, his body moving, and appearing right beside Lin Yi, lifting his leg, and kicking forcefully.
"Bang!"
Lin Yi threw a punch to meet the attack of the man in green, and the two collided.
"Crack!"
Instantly, a crisp sound of breaking bones emitted from Lin Yi’s arms, and pieces of bone protruded from his shoulders, sending piercing pain into his mind.
"How is this possible?!"
"I have already tempered my physical body to the Golden Immortal Body. How could I be heavily injured by a single strike?" Lin Yi’s eyes widened in horror as he stared at the man in green.
At that moment, Lin Yi finally realized how terrifying the man in green was.
"Haha, this is all you’ve got!" The man in green saw Lin Yi’s injury and was overjoyed, striking down with a fierce palm.
"Boom!"
Lin Yi’s body was sent flying again, and he spewed a mouthful of bright red blood before falling heavily to the ground.
"You little beast, this time, you’re definitely going to die." The man in green looked at Lin Yi and said with a cold sneer.
Lin Yi’s face was somber, not uttering another word, but he quickly got up, turned around, and rapidly fled toward the mountains.
Seeing this, the man in green showed a mocking smile, "Thinking of running?"
"Hmph, do you think you can escape?"
"My speed is considered first-class in Heavenly Martial Country."
"No matter how fast you are, you can’t outrun me!"
After saying these words, the man in green chased after him.
The figures of the two intertwined and collided mid-air, causing a series of loud explosions.
Soon after, both Lin Yi and the man in green came to a halt.
"You are indeed strong, but under my hands, you still can’t make any waves!" The man in green looked down at Lin Yi lying on the ground and said coldly.
"You are indeed strong, but you are no match for me. I advise you to surrender obediently, otherwise, I can cripple you!" Lin Yi said coldly.
"Hmph, you think I would be afraid of you?" The man in green scoffed and said, "Your movement technique is good, and your speed is fast, but my speed is even faster!"
After saying that, the man in green clenched his right hand, and a long spear appeared in his grasp.
"Whoosh!"
The spear quivered, turning into a cyan rainbow aimed at Lin Yi.
"Whoosh whoosh whoosh..."
At the tip of the spear, a piercing whistle kept erupting, as if it contained the power to destroy within the spear.
"Boom!"
Lin Yi quickly formed seals with his hands, and a purple Talisman emerged, then, under his control, it shot towards the man in green.
As the Talisman flew out, ripples formed in the surrounding space, and intense spatial ripples spread out instantly, causing the entire space to tremble violently.
The purple Talisman, carrying an extremely terrifying pressure, slammed toward the man in green.
"Break for me!" The man in green shouted, holding the long spear and fiercely thrusting it forward.
Instantly, a massive spear glow pierced the purple Talisman.
"Boom!"
The two Talismans collided, unleashing a terrifying storm of Spiritual Energy.
"Whoosh!"
The purple Talisman was instantly shattered by the attack from the man in green and turned into dust.
"What? How is this possible!"
The man in green, looking at the long spear in his hand, was full of shock.
"Your Spiritual Artifact is quite good; I’ll take it for now!"
As his words fell, the man in green directly swooped beside Lin Yi and grabbed him.

chapters.title: Chapter 834 - 854 Where did I offend you!
chapters.content:
"Ah!"
Lin Yi let out a miserable scream, his pale face rapidly turning an ashen shade of blue.
"Little beast, I’m sending you to Hell right now!" sneered the man in blue as he shook his long spear and ruthlessly stabbed at Lin Yi.
"Puchi!"
Lin Yi’s left arm was directly pierced by the man in blue, blood splattering forth.
"Who... who are you? What have I done to offend you?" Lin Yi gritted his teeth as he spoke, his eyes filled with reluctance.
"Who am I? I am the Young Master of the Qinglong Sect. You killed my son, do you think I would let you go?" The man in blue sneered as he looked at Lin Yi.
"What? You’re the Young Master of Qinglong Sect?" Lin Yi’s face turned pale upon hearing the man’s words.
Lin Yi hadn’t expected that killing the son of a Young Master would bring such horrific retaliation from the Qinglong Sect.
"Yes, I am Qing Yun, the Young Master of Qinglong Sect. Today, you’ll realize the consequences of angering my Qingyun Sect!"
Qing Yun sneered, then his gaze shifted around, "Everyone, come over here, this kid must die today!"
"Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!"
"Shua, shua, shua!"
The disciples of the Qinglong Sect swiftly flew out, landing in front of Qing Yun.
"All of you, capture that boy!"
Qing Yun glanced at the people, speaking indifferently.
"Yes!"
Everyone nodded respectfully, then turned their attention towards Lin Yi.
"Brother, I’m sorry, I don’t want to offend you either, but you were too greedy. I already agreed to hand over all these things to you!" Lin Yi looked at Qing Yun and said with a bitter smile.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Qing Yun’s face became increasingly mocking, "Do you really think I’m a fool? Did you think you could deceive me?"
"If you are willing to hand over these things, I might consider sparing your life. Otherwise, I’ll personally take action and kill you!"
Lin Yi shook his head, "These are the rewards of my risks; if you want them, go find them yourself!"
With that, Lin Yi closed his eyes, waiting for the other party to make a move.
"Hmph!"
Seeing Lin Yi’s attitude, Qing Yun snorted coldly, then swung his long spear, lunging at Lin Yi with the weapon.
"Bam, bam, bam!"
Three spear lights, swift as lightning and accompanied by a sharp breaking sound, shot towards Lin Yi.
"Puchi!"
All three spear lights pierced Lin Yi’s chest.
"Pu!"
A trickle of blood spilled from the corner of Lin Yi’s mouth before his body stiffly fell.
Lin Yi was dead!
Lin Yi’s body burst open, an Elixir falling to the ground.
"Hu!"
Qing Yun breathed a sigh of relief, reached out, grabbed the Elixir, and swallowed it.
"Lin Yi, don’t blame me, blame your own stupidity for daring to offend me. You brought this upon yourself!" Qing Yun glanced at his hands and sneered, then left the forest with his followers.
"Roar, roar, roar!"
Suddenly, a thunderous roar resounded, and a pitch-black crack in the void abruptly formed.
"Wash, wash, wash!"
Immediately after, a massive figure emerged from the crack.
"Roar!"
Upon its arrival, the creature let out an earth-shattering roar and immediately pounced toward Qing Yun and his men.
"Not good!"
Upon seeing the colossal creature appear, Qing Yun and the others’ faces all changed, and they hurriedly fled in all directions.
"Trying to escape? Not so easy!"
The colossal creature roared furiously, its tail sweeping a fierce wind that stirred the sky, sweeping Qing Yun and the others into the midst of the storm.
"Boom! Boom!"
"Crack!"
"Boom! Boom!"
"Puff!"
A series of explosions erupted, and within the storm, bursts of fire shot into the sky, instantly engulfing Qing Yun and the others, who disappeared without a trace.
Meanwhile, the giant monster stood outside the storm, coldly watching the flames die out.
...
Atop a mountain peak, Lin Yi was seated on the branch of an ancient tree.
His skin was charred black from burns, and his blood had long since dried up, giving him a particularly bleak and desolate appearance.
Lin Yi slowly opened his eyes and looked toward the distant horizon, his expression turning uglier than ever.
"Damn it! I’ve actually been captured by disciples of the Qinglong Sect!"
Lin Yi took a deep breath, his eyes filled with intense hatred and unwillingness.
"I will definitely have my revenge. One day, I too will slaughter all the disciples of the Qinglong Sect just like they did!"
Lin Yi said somberly.
"No, my strength isn’t enough right now. I’d better leave this place for now. However, having killed their disciples, they surely won’t let this go. This incident won’t just involve the Qinglong Sect’s disciples coming after me, likely the entire Southern Region won’t be peaceful!"
Lin Yi frowned, thinking anxiously to himself.
"It looks like the skies of the Southern Region are going to be chaotic. I hope Qing Yun doesn’t go too far. If he dares to harm my family, I will never forgive him!"
Lin Yi gritted his teeth, thinking fervently.
"Anyway, since I’m seriously injured right now, it’s not wise to stay here any longer."
Lin Yi sighed and then prepared to fly away into the distance.
"Roar!"
But at that moment, an angry roar suddenly echoed in Lin Yi’s mind.
"What’s going on?" Lin Yi frowned slightly, a look of confusion flashing in his eyes.
"Awooo!"
Just then, an even angrier howl came, and an immense oppressive force suddenly descended upon Lin Yi.
This terrifying pressure, as if originating from the Jiuyou Underworld, sent shivers down one’s spine.
Lin Yi’s expression changed abruptly, "Not good, I actually forgot to use the Soul Imprint and make the Soul Contract with them. It seems, it’s time they paid the price!"
Having said that, Lin Yi immediately activated the Soul Imprint.
"Awooo!"
A massive roar of a colossal beast suddenly resounded, followed by a terrifying giant python that abruptly emerged from Lin Yi’s sea of consciousness.
Lin Yi felt the presence of the colossal beast was many times stronger than before.
"Awooo!"
The terrifying giant python opened its huge mouth and lunged at the youth’s body.
"Not good!"
"Save me!" The youth’s face instantly turned deathly pale.
"Bang!"
The giant python slammed into the youth’s body, instantly tearing his flesh apart into a mist of blood that scattered down.
"Damn it, that snake is a demon python. Its strength is even stronger than mine; no wonder it acts so brazenly. It turns out, there’s a powerful demon python backing it!" Lin Yi looked at the giant python, his face darkening to an extreme, and a pronounced wariness surfaced in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 835 - 855 Skilled at Soul Attacks
chapters.content:
The Demon Jiao is a Fifth Rank Demon Beast, far more powerful than Lin Yi and, moreover, it excels at attacking the soul!
Lin Yi was acutely aware that he could not withstand even one move from the Demon Jiao.
"Lin Yi, you’re still alive!" The corpse of the young man dissipated, and a gloomy voice echoed in Lin Yi’s ear.
"Who are you? Why target me?" Lin Yi asked icily.
"Hmph, still asking who I am? Lin Yi, you killed a disciple of our Qinglong Sect. Naturally, I won’t let you go. Today, you must be punished," the sinister voice declared.
"Punished? Do you really think I, Lin Yi, am made of clay?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi snorted coldly, his eyes flashing with a chill: "The likes of you trash dare to dream of harming me? Utterly delusional!"
Finished speaking, Lin Yi suddenly lifted his foot and stamped fiercely on the ground.
"Boom!"
Instantaneously, the ground collapsed, leaving a massive hundred-zhang footprint spreading out from beneath the earth.
"Roar!"
Lin Yi bellowed lowly as he threw a punch.
"Bang!"
The enormous foot then collided with the Qinglong Sect youth.
"Crack!"
The crisp sound of breaking bones rang out, followed by the youth’s chest being smashed through completely.
"You... you..."
The youth from Qinglong Sect, with a face full of terror and eyes round with fear, stared fixedly at Lin Yi.
"You shouldn’t have messed with me. Since you want to punish me, bring it on!"
Lin Yi spoke indifferently.
"Roar!"
The Qinglong Sect youth suddenly let out an enraged roar, and an immensely powerful aura burst forth from within him, sweeping out in an instant.
That overwhelming force, like thick iron chains, locked onto Lin Yi tightly, preventing him from breaking free.
"Hmph, get lost!"
Lin Yi roared furiously, his figure blurred, transforming into a giant tiger, and he lunged with jaws wide at the Qinglong Sect youth.
"Thump, thump, thump!"
After a series of muffled sounds, the Qinglong Sect youth was torn to pieces.
Blood drenched the ground.
"Roar, roar!"
Just then, earthshaking beast roars suddenly echoed from the void.
Lin Yi looked up to see a huge figure in the void with a horrifying aura, rapidly closing in and bearing down on Lin Yi.
"Not good, it’s a Ninth Rank Demon Beast!"
"This guy’s presence is even more terrifying than the Qinglong Sect youth, and his strength is definitely comparable to a cultivator at the peak of the Foundation Establishment Later Stages!" Lin Yi’s face stiffened, a trace of shock flickering in his eyes as he quickly turned to flee.
Lin Yi knew that, although he had successfully advanced to the Third Layer of Qi Refinement, he still couldn’t contend with a Foundation Establishment Cultivator and had no choice but to evade for now.
"Hmph, run? Do you think you can escape?"
An icy voice suddenly rose behind Lin Yi.
Lin Yi turned to look, only to see a claw, carrying a vast wave of Qi, slapping down fiercely towards him.
"Not good!"
Lin Yi’s complexion changed drastically, and he swung his fists in an attempt to block.
"Boom!"
However, as soon as Lin Yi’s fist collided with the claw, it exploded, turning into a mist of blood.
"How is this possible? My physical defense couldn’t withstand a blow from a Foundation Establishment powerhouse!"
Lin Yi’s face again changed dramatically as he hurriedly channeled the Yuan Force within his body, pouring it frantically into his arms.
"Boom!"
"Crack!"
But even so, Lin Yi still couldn’t hold on, his legs snapped clean, his body sent flying backward, slamming harshly onto the ground.
"Ptui!"
Lin Yi spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, his face instantly turning ashen.
"How terrifying the power, this young man from Qinglong Sect is actually at the peak of the Later Stages of Foundation Establishment!" Lin Yi’s face was extremely grim.
Lin Yi never imagined that Qinglong Sect would send such a powerful young man to hunt him down.
However, luckily, he had fled quickly. If he had been even a step slower, he would have probably been killed.
"Lin Yi, it’s time for you to die!"
As Lin Yi was seized with fear, the young man from Qinglong Sect crossed thousands of meters in a single step, reaching Lin Yi and swung his palm violently towards him.
"Boom!"
Lin Yi quickly executed a movement technique, attempting to dodge.
But Lin Yi’s speed, in front of a cultivator at the peak of the Later Stages of Foundation Establishment, was still too slow.
"Ptui!"
Lin Yi sprayed out another mouthful of blood, his body thrown forcefully through the air.
"Plop!"
Lin Yi crashed heavily to the ground, a sharp pain instantly spreading throughout his body.
Lin Yi’s face was very pale, the corners of his mouth still dripping with blood.
"Cough cough!"
Lin Yi struggled to his feet, his complexion growing even paler.
"Although your strength is greater than that of the young man just now, you are ultimately still not strong enough. Even if you manage to escape today, you will not escape from the palm of my hand, because you are my prey!"
The young man took step after step towards Lin Yi, watching him with a cold sneer.
Lin Yi took a deep breath and slowly clenched the dagger in his hand.
He wasn’t foolish and knew that if the battle continued, there would only be one outcome — death.
"If you seek death, then don’t blame me!" Lin Yi scoffed coldly, his dagger suddenly slicing through the air, heading straight for the young man of Qinglong Sect, aiming to kill.
"Whoosh!"
Lin Yi’s movement was as fast as a ghost, almost in the blink of an eye, he was already upon the young man.
The expression of the Qinglong Sect’s young man changed dramatically, he desperately swung his huge fist towards Lin Yi.
But, how swift was Lin Yi?
In that instant, Lin Yi’s body, like a phantom, teleported beside the young man.
Lin Yi, with a fierce blow, hacked towards the young man.
"Ptui!"
Blood splattered, Lin Yi’s dagger plunged deep into the chest of the Qinglong Sect’s young man.
"You!"
The young man’s face took on an abrupt change, looking at Lin Yi with rage-filled eyes.
"Hmph, overestimating himself!"
Lin Yi shook his hand and pulled out the dagger.
Blood sprayed everywhere as the young man from the Qinglong Sect fell to the ground with a boom, lifeless.
"Hu!"
Seeing this, Lin Yi finally relaxed, the vigilance in his eyes dissipating.
Just moments ago, Lin Yi had been scared witless, thinking he was about to be crushed to death by the young man’s palm.
"Haha, that was close!"
"Thank goodness for that dagger, otherwise, I really might have been killed by that guy!" Lin Yi inwardly celebrated with relief.
"Eh? What’s this Jade Slip doing here?" Lin Yi suddenly noticed a Jade Slip lying on the ground and hurriedly picked it up, examining it for a moment.
The Jade Slip contained information about the Qinglong Sect disciple.
This included the disciple’s Cultivation Realm, among other information.
"This guy was actually at the peak of the Foundation Establishment Later Stages!" Lin Yi’s pupils contracted slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 836 - 856: Relying on the Support Behind
chapters.content:
"No wonder Qinglong Sect dares to be so arrogant — they have powerful backing!"
Lin Yi thought to himself and couldn’t help but exclaim, "A Peak Foundation Establishment expert at the later stages is indeed a rare existence even in the Southern Region!"
Lin Yi was weak, far too weak to contend with a peak expert of the later stages of Foundation Establishment.
And that young man from Qinglong Sect, he possessed power comparable to those at the peak of Foundation Establishment. How could Lin Yi possibly hope to survive?
