"Forget it, let’s just drop this mission!"
Lin Yi shook his head, gathered his things, and prepared to leave.
He knew he needed to leave this dangerous area as soon as possible, lest the disciples from Qinglong Sect arrive and ensure his death.
But just as Lin Yi turned to leave, a chilling aura enveloped him.
"Whoosh!"
The disciple from Qinglong Sect, holding a longsword, swept it directly across, the blade flashing brilliantly, bringing with it a fiercely intense gust aimed squarely at Lin Yi.
"Damn!" Lin Yi was startled and quickly employed his movement techniques to flick to the side.
"Whoosh!"
Lin Yi hastily retreated, but the assault from that young man from Qinglong Sect relentlessly followed.
With one swing of his sword, a whip-like sword light, carrying sheer force, burst towards Lin Yi.
"Whoosh!"
The sword light was too fast and also contained an endless oppressive force, making it impossible for Lin Yi to dodge.
"Pltht!"
Lin Yi could only grit his teeth and endure, but he still couldn’t help but spew a mouthful of blood.
Lin Yi’s physical body was too frail, simply no match for the sword of a peak Foundation Establishment expert.
But Lin Yi did not give up; instead, he clenched his teeth and desperately channeled his Spiritual Power, continuously pouring it into the dagger in his hand.
"Bang!"
The sword light directly struck Lin Yi’s shoulder, shredding his clothes and drenching him in blood.
"Puh!"
Lin Yi spewed another mouthful of blood.
"This time, even if I suffer dreadful injuries, I must kill you, or you will surely become a major threat to Qinglong Sect in the future!"
The young man from Qinglong Sect’s eyes oozed with ice-cold intent as he glared murderously at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s complexion turned ashen; knowing he was outmatched, he chose to run!
Yet, Lin Yi still underestimated the strength of that Qinglong Sect youth; as soon as he made his move, the young man once again intercepted him.
Lin Yi furrowed his brow, a bitter taste rising in his mouth.
"You want to escape? Sadly, it’s too late!"
The young man from Qinglong Sect sneered, lifting his right hand to reveal a sword radiating piercing cold brilliance.
That blade, extraordinarily sharp, emitted a chilling gleam.
"Whoosh!"
The Qinglong Sect youth, eyes cold and merciless, swung directly at Lin Yi.
"It’s over, my life is about to end right here!"
Lin Yi turned pale, a sense of despair welling up in his heart.
"Boom!"
Just when Lin Yi thought he was undoubtedly going to die, that extremely fierce sword light abruptly disappeared, and a severe pain instantly spread throughout his body.
Lin Yi quickly looked down to see a bloody gash on his right arm, flesh mangled and blood gushing forth.
"Such formidable skill!" Lin Yi was inwardly shocked, his eyes filled with intense apprehension.
"Lin Yi, this will be our last meeting, I hope you cherish your life!"
The young man from Qinglong Sect displayed a fleeting indifferent smile and spoke coldly.
"Thank you for the warning!"
"However... let me give you a piece of advice too, always leave a way out for others so we can meet on good terms in the future, otherwise, you will live to regret it!"
Lin Yi spoke with a heavy tone, coldly warning the other person, then turned to leave.
"Thinking of leaving? It’s not that simple!"
The youth from Qinglong Sect’s gaze turned icy, his right foot suddenly stepped forward, and in an instant, he caught up to Lin Yi like a cheetah.
"Bang!"
The Qinglong Sect youth’s right foot harshly stomped on Lin Yi’s left leg.
"Crack!"
A sound of bones breaking echoed; Lin Yi’s left leg broke immediately, blood spurting out.
"Hiss!"
Seeing his own left leg broken, Lin Yi’s face instantly turned deathly pale.
"You deserve to die!"
The face of the Qinglong Sect youth twisted ferociously as he lifted his foot again, aiming a kick directly at Lin Yi’s chest.
Lin Yi’s complexion changed; he knew that today, his chances of survival were slim.
"Boom!"
Just at this critical moment, the Golden Core inside Lin Yi finally activated, layers of golden radiance emerged on the surface of his body, making his skin appear more delicate.
"Splash!"
The Qinglong Sect youth’s kick landed on Lin Yi’s chest, caving it in.
Lin Yi immediately spat out a mouthful of blood, his body flying three to four feet away, crashing into a bush.
Lin Yi’s chest was sunk into the bush, streaks of blood flowed from the corners of his mouth, leaving him in a sorry state.
"You... you’re still alive?"
The Qinglong Sect youth was astounded.
Lin Yi slowly stood up, his lips somewhat purple, but the smile on his face remained bright.
"Hehe... how could I afford to die so easily?" Lin Yi said, grinning.
"You can still move!?"
"How are you still alive!? No... this is impossible!"
The Qinglong Sect youth’s eyes widened, his face filled with disbelief.
"Your strength is quite impressive, but killing me is impossible!" Lin Yi said proudly.
"No matter how you struggle, you can’t change your inevitable death!" the Qinglong Sect youth declared, his gaze icy as he stepped across the void and appeared before Lin Yi.
"Hum~"
The Golden Core inside Lin Yi instantaneously operated, healing some of his internal injuries.
"Whoosh!"
Lin Yi did not hesitate; he quickly withdrew and retreated.
"Humph! Stay here!"
The Qinglong Sect youth flashed and blocked Lin Yi, then threw another punch.
"Whoosh..."
This time, the Qinglong Sect youth released a punch combined with both azure and red Fist Qi, carrying immense force that instantly distorted Lin Yi’s expression.
This was an attack combining azure and red strikes; once hit, even if his physical defense was high, it couldn’t withstand it.
"Splat!"
Yet, Lin Yi did not dodge but instead took the punch head-on, then his body was blown away, blood spraying from his mouth.
Lin Yi’s body smashed through two mountains, falling down a cliff and immediately losing consciousness.
The massive azure and red Fist Qi from the Qinglong Sect youth completely pierced through a large mountain behind Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 837 - 857: A Rare Peerless Beauty
chapters.content:
Chapter 837: Chapter 857: A Rare Peerless Beauty
"Lin Yi!"
Seeing Lin Yi injured, Liu Feiyan’s lovely face also showed a trace of sorrow.
She knew Lin Yi was very strong, but after all, he was a cultivator at the peak of the Ninefold Heaven Innate Realm, how could he withstand the punch of that youth from Qinglong Sect?
"You... who exactly are you, why are you making things difficult for Brother Lin?" Liu Feiyan glared at the youth from Qinglong Sect, asking angrily.
The eyes of the Qinglong Sect youth glinted with cruelty and greed as he stared at Liu Feiyan, his gaze becoming hot.
Liu Feiyan was a peerless beauty, rare to see in a millennium, even considered one of the top figures within Qingyang Sect, and indeed, ranked within the top five in terms of strength in the whole Qingyang Sect.
If he could marry such a girl, his life would become incredibly wonderful.
"I... I am called Azure Dragon, my real name is ’Qinglong Ba’!"
Qinglong Ba said with a haughty air.
"So, you’re from Qinglong Sect. Why are you targeting Brother Lin?" Liu Feiyan pondered for a moment before asking.
"Because he is my enemy!"
Qinglong Ba sneered and said, "He is Lin Yi!"
Hearing the name Lin Yi, a shock crossed Liu Feiyan’s attractive face.
"What? He is Lin Yi?"
"How did he end up in this godforsaken place!? No wonder the people of Qinglong Sect want to besiege him!"
"Lin Yi’s strength isn’t weak, and moreover, he has two Divine Beasts with him, we can’t defeat him at all, only if we join forces with strong cultivators from other sects might we have a hope of exterminating Lin Yi!"
A flicker of worry passed through Liu Feiyan’s eyes, Lin Yi’s strength was too great, if his enemies united against him, then Lin Yi would surely die!
"Haha, Liu Feiyan, you needn’t worry about his safety, he is now a cripple, no matter how arrogant he once was, he won’t escape my grasp. If you’re willing to come with me, I will treasure you like a precious pearl!"
Qinglong Ba laughed heartily and then, his gaze burning, looked at Liu Feiyan, his eyes revealing lascivious intent.
Liu Feiyan frowned, glanced at Lin Yi, and hesitated in her heart.
Although Lin Yi was strong, when facing a peerless genius like Qinglong Ba, Lin Yi’s strength was just too weak!
"Feiyan, you needn’t worry about his life or death, he is now a waste!"
Just then, an old woman in white walked into the cave, looking at Lin Yi with a mocking expression on her face.
"Shut your mouth!"
Liu Feiyan immediately glared angrily at the old woman in white, shouting out loud.
The old woman in white was none other than the White-Clothed Holy Maiden, Liu Feiyan’s own grandmother.
"Feiyan, how dare you talk to me like that?"
The White-Clothed Holy Maiden, upon hearing this, was instantly displeased and said coldly, "You have no say in this matter! I just wanted to remind you that Lin Yi has been crippled, even if he’s from the Lin Clan, what of it? Are you going to give your life for a cripple? I think you should choose a more suitable man to follow, that’s the right choice for you!"
Hearing the words of the White-Clothed Holy Maiden, a mocking smile also appeared on the corners of Lin Yi’s lips.
He hadn’t expected that the White-Clothed Holy Maiden could be so selfish!
"Lin Yi, I’m telling you, Feiyan will absolutely not marry you, you can give up on that idea!"
Lin Yi was just about to speak, when he heard an icy voice coming from close by, followed by a graceful figure swiftly walking out of the cave, it turned out to be Su Yuhan.
"Little girl, who do you think you are, to talk like that? Believe it or not, I will pull out your teeth one by one!"
Lin Yi’s gaze swept indifferently over Su Yuhan.
Su Yuhan, upon hearing this, also let out a cold laugh and then said, "I am Lin Yi’s friend, you’d better restrain yourself, otherwise, Lin Yi will not let you off!"
"Pah! Lin Yi? Who do you think you are? A mere trash, I don’t even deign to glance at you!"
Lin Yi’s face was full of disdain, his eyes brimming with contempt.
"You..."
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Su Yuhan’s pretty face turned bright red with anger, wishing she could rush forward and tear Lin Yi to pieces.
"Yuhan!"
Liu Feiyan held onto Su Yuhan’s jade hand, stopping her.
"Lin Yi, since you want to deal with my junior brother Lin Yi, can we erase the grudges between us?" Liu Feiyan looked towards Lin Yi and said lightly.
"Erase the grudges? Haha... Our Qingyang Sect will not erase anything with a person who is about to die! You’d better obediently follow my orders, otherwise, I will make you wish you were dead, understand?" Qinglong Ba glanced coldly at Liu Feiyan and then said.
"Fine! As long as you can guarantee that Lin Yi’s life will not face danger. I agree!" Liu Feiyan clenched her teeth, then looked towards Lin Yi and said, "Junior brother Lin Yi, aren’t you very strong? Why have you ended up in such a sorry state?"
"My strength, in your eyes, has fallen to this extent?" Lin Yi gave a bitter smile and then shook his head.
He hadn’t expected that Liu Feiyan would actually go to such lengths to protect him.
"I certainly did not expect that in this world, there would be people who care about me, but... your actions are too despicable, you don’t deserve my concern in this lifetime!"
Liu Feiyan looked towards Lin Yi, her eyes full of resolute determination.
"Feiyan..."
Lin Yi opened his mouth, but his words trailed off halfway, his eyes flashing with complex emotions, and finally, he let out a sigh.
"Feiyan, you don’t need to sacrifice so much for me, I no longer have the right to have such an outstanding friend like you..."
"Humph! Lin Yi, is our relationship something you can cut off whenever you want? You want to reject it, just reject it?" Liu Feiyan let out a cold laugh and said.
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s body gave a slight shudder.
Indeed, he had once said that he would not fall for Liu Feiyan, but now, he found himself utterly unable to do so.
In the depths of Lin Yi’s heart, his affection for Liu Feiyan had taken root so deeply, forgetting her was nearly impossible!
Liu Feiyan’s love for Lin Yi had transcended so-called romantic love, it was more like an obsession.
And this obsession had already made Lin Yi’s heart incapable of detachment.
"Junior brother Lin Yi, no matter what you think, I’ve made up my mind about you! If you disagree, then I’ll just stay by your side forever. I’d like to see what you can do about it!" Liu Feiyan said firmly while looking at Lin Yi.
Hearing Liu Feiyan’s words, Lin Yi only felt his mind boom, his face turning pale.
How could this silly girl have developed such deep feelings for him?
"Feiyan, thank you!"
Lin Yi lifted his hand, wanting to grab Liu Feiyan’s wrist, but he caught nothing but air.
"Lin Yi, do you look down on me, think that I’m now a cripple? You can ignore me, but you can’t insult me, my strength is not weak! And besides, I am also a student at the Lingwu Academy!" Liu Feiyan said to Lin Yi, stubbornly.

chapters.title: Chapter 838 - 858: It Will Grow Up!
chapters.content:
Chapter 838: Chapter 858: It Will Grow Up!
"Feiyan, don’t say foolish things! Your strength is stronger than mine by a notch, but I also believe that one day, you will grow up!"
Lin Yi stretched out his hand and gently stroked Liu Feiyan’s smooth black hair.
Looking at Lin Yi, Liu Feiyan’s heart thumped wildly, her cheeks flushing red.
"Lin Yi, I will not leave Junior Brother Lin Yi, unless... unless he’s dead!"
Lin Yi’s words were like a sharp blade, piercing Liu Feiyan’s heart, making her struggle to breathe.
"I’ve said before, we are not meant to walk the same path. Following me will not bring you happiness! Feiyan, listen to my advice, give up on me. I am not worth it!" Lin Yi took a deep breath and said calmly.
Lin Yi’s voice was very low, but it had an intoxicating magnetism that made it hard for one to leave.
"Lin Yi, don’t talk nonsense! I truly adore you, and I don’t mind waiting until I’m stronger to marry you! Moreover, I believe that as long as I put effort into my Cultivation, I can definitely reach a level of strength equal to yours!"
"You..."
Looking at Liu Feiyan, Lin Yi didn’t know what to say.
"Don’t worry, as long as you agree to help my Junior Brother Lin Yi get through this crisis, I will always stay by your side and not disturb you and Sister Xue Wu!"
Liu Feiyan’s gaze was filled with hope as she continued to speak.
Looking at Liu Feiyan, Lin Yi couldn’t help but feel a deep sense of guilt.
Liu Feiyan, this kind and beautiful girl, how could he let her down?
Thinking this, Lin Yi let out a deep sigh, nodded with determination, and said, "Alright, what would you have me do?"
Upon seeing Lin Yi’s agreement, Liu Feiyan immediately showed a relieved smile and said, "It’s really nothing serious. You just need to cleanse the toxins from your body, and I can help you restore your Cultivation!"
Liu Feiyan’s voice carried a hint of excitement; clearly, this was her first time helping someone heal, and it was for Lin Yi, whom she cared about the most. Naturally, her heart was filled with immense excitement.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi shook his head and said, "I’ll have someone else resolve this, Feiyan. You should go back first."
"Why?" Liu Feiyan asked with a frown.
"Because I don’t want you to get hurt!"
Lin Yi said slowly, his voice gentle, yet it contained an undeniable authority.
"Lin Yi... I’m still weak, so please take good care of me, Senior Brother Lin Yi."
Liu Feiyan’s eyes hid a deep disappointment.
She had not expected Lin Yi to refuse even to give her a reason.
"That’s enough, Feiyan, there’s no need for formalities between us! Go back now!" Lin Yi said indifferently, his voice carried a hint of helplessness.
Looking at Lin Yi’s cold expression, Liu Feiyan felt her heart clench violently.
She was not willing to give up!
"Fine! I’ll leave, but once your Cultivation is restored, I will come to see you right away."
Liu Feiyan bit her lip, turned around, and quickly left Lin Yi’s room.
Watching Liu Feiyan’s retreating figure, Lin Yi’s brows furrowed tightly, feeling very uncomfortable in his heart.
"Feiyan... I’m sorry..."
Lin Yi murmured to himself, then shifted his gaze to the window.
"Lin Yi, don’t worry, I will avenge you! Those guys who dared to deceive my man, even if it means climbing a mountain of swords or plunging into a pot of oil, I will kill them!"
Lin Yi heard footsteps and then saw Ye Feng walk into the room.
"Ye Feng, what brings you here?" Lin Yi asked, looking at Ye Feng.
"I’m here to tell you bad news!" Ye Feng said with a smirk.
"Oh? What’s the bad news?"
Lin Yi asked with curiosity.
"Lin Yi, tonight you and Xue Wu will be moving into my house!"
Ye Feng chuckled and said,
"What did you say?!!"
An incredulous expression floated into Lin Yi’s eyes.
"Lin Yi, I said that tonight you and Xue Wu are moving into my house! The two of you, living in my house, that way, it’ll be more convenient for the three of us, won’t it?"
Ye Feng shrugged his shoulders and said.
"But, but..."
Lin Yi hesitated, looking at Ye Feng’s bright eyes, a sense of unease welled up in his heart.
Could this brat take advantage of me without me realizing it?
With this thought, Lin Yi suddenly felt a chill throughout his body.
"Alright! Stop with the ’buts.’ When I say move into my house, it will happen!"
Ye Feng rolled his eyes and said.
"Elder Brother Lin Yi, rest assured! I respect you just as much as I respect Master! So, you can move into our house without worrying, I won’t take advantage of you!"
As Ye Feng spoke, he walked towards the door.
Watching Ye Feng’s departing figure, Lin Yi finally let out a long sigh of relief, silently thinking to himself:
Good thing this brat isn’t a dissipated rogue!
...
"Kid, you’ve really hit the jackpot this time! Lin Yi has actually been subdued by you!"
"That’s right! Although Lin Yi is only at the fifth level of the Spiritual Vein Realm, he has tremendous potential. He is bound to become a master of the sect level in the future, and with Lin Yi, a Sevenfold Spiritual Vein Realm expert’s protection, which of those good-for-nothings would dare to provoke you?"
"Heh heh, naturally, Lin Yi is the Saint Heir of our Myriad Beast Valley. Those good-for-nothings, even if they had ten times the guts, wouldn’t dare to mess with us in Myriad Beast Valley, ha ha!"
...
"Master... how did you know Lin Yi is the Saint Heir? Could it be, all the Saint Heirs of Myriad Beast Valley look like him?"
Lin Yi emerged from the room and happened to run into Ye Feng, immediately asking.
"Lin Yi, neither Master nor I have misjudged you! You truly are the Saint Heir of our Myriad Beast Valley. It’s just that you’ve been staying in the Spirit Beast Mountains all along, so we never had the chance to meet you! However, now that you are the Saint Heir, Master and I will indeed support you wholeheartedly, hoping you won’t let us down!"
Ye Feng said with a smile, looking very affable.
Hearing Ye Feng’s words, Lin Yi’s face turned slightly red.
He knew that Ye Feng was telling the truth.
Ever since he was expelled from his family by his father, he had been cast out of his clan.
However, Lin Yi had not expected to meet Ye Feng.
"Sister Lin Yi, why are you crying? Could it be our Saint Heir doesn’t like you?"
Just then, a teasing voice suddenly rang out.
Ye Feng looked towards the source of the voice and saw that the speaker was actually Xiao Yun.
Xiao Yun’s handsome face wore a cynical expression, smilingly looking at Lin Yi, with a hint of mockery at the corner of his eyes.
"Xiao Yun, what do you mean by that? What do you have to do with me?"
Seeing Xiao Yun’s expression, Lin Yi immediately changed his face and rebuked him coldly.
"Heh heh, Lin Yi, is this how you treat your senior brother? Your attitude is really poor!"
Xiao Yun snorted coldly and said, "Don’t forget, this is my turf. If you continue to be so unappreciative, believe it or not, I’ll throw you out!"
Lin Yi’s expression grew uglier at Xiao Yun’s words.
"Xiao Yun, what do you mean by that? Don’t push people too far!"
Lin Yi bellowed in anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 839 - 859: Don’t Push People Too Far!
chapters.content:
Chapter 839: Chapter 859: Don’t Push People Too Far!
"Heh, too bullying? Lin Yi, have you still not understood the situation? I, Xiao Yun, am your senior brother, and the one who revived you. Can’t you understand what I’m saying?"
Xiao Yun looked at Lin Yi with a teasing smile in his tone.
"Hmph! Your medical skills are nothing special! If it weren’t for my unique constitution, how could I have woken up in just a few days?"
Lin Yi said, sneering.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Xiao Yun’s expression immediately darkened.
A trace of anger appeared on his face as he said,
"Lin Yi, my medical skills may not be great, but my cultivation talent is extremely strong! I’ve already reached the peak of the Sixfold Spiritual Vein Realm, just one step away from the Spiritual Spring Realm! Do you think, with my current talent, I can be compared to a half-baked practitioner like you?"
"Half-baked? Are you saying I’m not half-baked? Let me tell you, I’m not only at the Fivefold Spiritual Spring Realm, but also at the peak of the Sevenfold Spiritual Spring Realm!"
Lin Yi retorted angrily.
In Myriad Beasts Valley, everyone called him the Saint Heir, and he had always been a standout among the younger generation of Myriad Beasts Valley.
Yet, this Xiao Yun in front of him had repeatedly belittled him, making Lin Yi furious!
"Sevenfold Spiritual Spring Realm?" Xiao Yun smirked and said mockingly, "Your cultivation is probably more than just the Sevenfold Spiritual Spring Realm, right?"
"You!"
Lin Yi, his face red with anger, pointed at Xiao Yun and said, "Xiao Yun, no matter how powerful you are, this is the Spiritual Spring realm, and I am not your match!"
Having said that, Lin Yi turned and walked toward the exit.
"Hey! Lin Yi, why the hurry? I haven’t finished speaking yet!"
Xiao Yun grabbed Lin Yi’s arm and said, "You are the Saint Heir of Myriad Beasts Valley, and we are grooming you to be the next Valley Master of Myriad Beasts Valley! Therefore, I absolutely won’t allow you to do anything outrageous!"
Hearing Xiao Yun’s words, Lin Yi was immediately taken aback.
"What next Valley Master? That’s impossible!"
Lin Yi blurted out, despite being only twelve years old, his intelligence was far beyond other children of his age.
This was evident when he managed to enter the forbidden area of Myriad Demons Forest alone.
Lin Yi did not believe that Myriad Beasts Valley would let him inherit the position of Valley Master.
Therefore, he simply did not want to consider that possibility.
"You don’t believe it? However, you will soon believe what I’ve said! Come with me, Lin Yi!"
After speaking, Xiao Yun pulled Lin Yi toward one side.
Lin Yi, being dragged by Xiao Yun, did not resist and followed along.
"Xiao Yun, what exactly is it?" Lin Yi asked, frowning.
"I’ve already sent a message to Myriad Beasts Valley! I believe it won’t be long before they find me! I think those old fellows from Myriad Beasts Valley will definitely come in person!"
Xiao Yun said with a smile.
"The people you mentioned, are they the Valley Master?"
Lin Yi was taken aback upon hearing this.
Xiao Yun nodded and said, "Yes, besides the Valley Master, who else could dispatch so many people to Myriad Beasts Valley?"
"People from Myriad Beasts Valley are here?"
Just then, a series of footsteps sounded.
"Lin Yi, the Valley Master has arrived. Let’s go in first!"
Xiao Yun turned his head and smiled.
"Alright!"
Lin Yi nodded and followed Xiao Yun into the house.
Inside the house, there were dozens of elderly men, including two dressed in green robes.
"Xiao Yun, who are these two elders?" Lin Yi couldn’t help asking.
Xiao Yun smiled and said, "Lin Yi, these are the Third, Fourth, and Fifth Elders of Myriad Beasts Valley, the elite of the Valley!"
Lin Yi glanced at the Third Elder and Fourth Elder, his heart tightening slightly.
He knew that Myriad Beasts Valley was not like the small factions in the Spiritual Spring Realm that had declined!
Myriad Beasts Valley not only had a High Rank Martial Artist at the Eightfold Spiritual Vein Realm, but it also had a group of cultivators at the Spiritual Liquid Realm!
"Junior Brother Lin Yi, you have finally wakened! I thought you died in the Myriad Demons Forest!"
"You, scoundrel!"
"Slap!"
"Ah!"
"Brother Lin Yi!"
Both the Third Elder and the Fourth Elder were furious.
Since Xiao Yun was from Myriad Beasts Valley, they naturally did not dare to lay a hand on Xiao Yun, so the slap had landed entirely on Lin Yi’s cheek.
Lin Yi staggered backward and fell to the ground.
"Brother..."
Lin Yi cried out in grievance.
Lin Yi had not expected his master to suddenly strike him, and to leave him looking like this.
Lin Yi’s cheek throbbed painfully.
"Lin Yi, have you gone mad? How dare you disrespect the Young Valley Lord of Myriad Demons Valley?"
"Lin Yi, you traitor!"
...
Watching Lin Yi being hit, the rest of the disciples stood up one by one, angrily shouting.
Having been cherished by everyone in Myriad Beasts Valley since he was young, they had never seen Lin Yi being insulted, especially by the revered Young Valley Lord, so how could they not be angry?
"Brother, I..."
Lin Yi was just about to explain something.
At that moment, Xiao Yun spoke up:
"Everyone, there’s no need to be angry! Lin Yi was coerced by Lin Yi into agreeing to marry me, it was not his own willing decision. We can propose to dissolve the engagement to prevent her from being harmed in the future!"
Upon hearing this, everyone suddenly realized.
So, there were such hidden circumstances!
"Sister Lin Yi, did you hear? Don’t misunderstand! Xiao Yun made this decision only to protect your safety!"
Xiao Yun then turned to Lin Yi and smiled.
"I..."
Hearing Xiao Yun’s explanation, Lin Yi felt a warmth in his heart, yet did not know what to say.
"Alright, everyone, you must be tired, please rest! I will prepare a banquet, and tonight, Sister Lin Yi will stay in my room. It’ll be a good opportunity for us to have a long talk!"
Xiao Yun said before looking at Lin Yi again,
"Sister Lin Yi, since I’m hosting the elders and providing for Sister Lin Yi, there’s no need for you to worry. You better go back to your room and prepare for the Valley Master’s arrival!"
"Okay!"
Lin Yi nodded her head and then left the room with the Third Elder and Fourth Elder.
...
Myriad Demons City, one of the most bustling cities within Myriad Beasts City, was teeming with people.
At this moment, Myriad Demons City was crowded with countless cultivators, all of whom had come from nearby areas, all eager to see what this mysterious Spiritual Medicine Valley was really like.
"Lin Yi, when you meet the Valley Master later, remember to be very respectful and do not anger the Valley Master! Do you understand?" the Third Elder earnestly instructed before departing.
"Yes, Third Elder!" Lin Yi quickly nodded.
"That’s good!"
The Third Elder nodded with satisfaction, leading Lin Yi and rushing towards the direction of the Myriad Demons Hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 840 - 860: Completing the Mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 840: Chapter 860: Completing the Mission
Lin Yi’s cultivation was only at the Ninth Level of the Spiritual Vein Realm, so the Third Elder didn’t need to worry about him escaping.
"Valley Master, Lin Yi seeks an audience!"
The Third Elder approached the door and knocked on the stone door of the great hall, calling out loudly.
Moments later, the doors of the great hall were pushed open, and a tall, handsome young man walked out.
"Valley Master!"
Upon seeing the young man appear, the Third Elder immediately bowed deeply and greeted him.
The young man’s gaze was stern as he scanned over Lin Yi and said in a deep voice, "Lin Yi, you have returned!"
"Yes, Valley Master, I have successfully completed the task assigned to me by the sect!"
Lin Yi nodded.
"Good, go back and rest now!" the young man waved his hand and said indifferently.
"Yes, Valley Master!" Lin Yi quickly responded and then turned to leave.
Watching Lin Yi’s retreating figure, the Valley Master shook his head slightly and sighed,
"Lin Yi is a child of misfortune! I didn’t wish for him to suffer such torments, but what can I do?"
...
"Is Lin Yi actually an adopted child of the Valley Master? Our Valley Master is so young yet already a powerhouse of the Spiritual Liquid Realm, which is incredible!"
"The Valley Master adopting Lin Yi must surely be because he hopes that Lin Yi can repay him someday!"
"This time, the Valley Master personally coming to Myriad Demon Valley must be to seek a new Valley Master!"
"A new Valley Master of Myriad Demon Valley? That’s a powerhouse of the Spiritual Spring Realm!"
"A powerhouse of the Spiritual Spring Realm is merely our Valley Master. Aside from him, Myriad Demon Valley has an even more formidable figure, who you may not have heard of. His name is Valley King!"
"Valley King!"
"Yes, the Valley King! The Valley King is the founder of Myriad Demon Valley! When Myriad Demon Valley was established, the Valley Master was only at the First Layer of the Spiritual Vein Realm, yet in just a few decades, he has reached the Peak of the Spiritual Liquid Realm, just a step away from Perfection!"
...
Hearing these discussions, Lin Yi was deeply shocked.
"Myriad Demon Valley really is a legendary sect. The Valley Master’s power is terrifying, definitely surpassing that of my father!"
Lin Yi thought to himself.
Though Lin Yi had never met the Valley King, he had already heard about him.
Myriad Demon Valley had been established many years ago, and the Valley Master’s power was unfathomable, his combat power far surpassing that of the Valley Master of Myriad Swords Sect from years ago.
Initially, the Valley Master was a formidable figure who, in one fell swoop, killed the Myriad Swords Sect’s leader, Wan Tianlong, severely weakening Myriad Swords Sect.
The leader of Myriad Swords Sect was one of the top figures in Myriad Demon Valley, yet the Valley Master’s power surpassed Wan Tianlong, which was astonishing.
Such a figure, to be an old man alone?
"I wonder if we shall ever have the opportunity to meet this Valley Master again?"
Lin Yi couldn’t help but think.
"Lin Yi! What are you daydreaming about? Don’t you know the way?" Just then, an elder beside him chided.
Lin Yi started, then quickly came to his senses and hurriedly followed the elders ahead.
"This Lin Yi’s aptitude is quite good, though not as exceptional as Lin Yi, she indeed has a gifted talent. If she were to join Myriad Demon Valley, that would be even more impressive!" the Third Elder thought to himself.
Hearing this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but feel excited.
"This time, if I can join Myriad Demon Valley, I won’t have to worry about that other Lin Yi, nor will I have to fear being expelled from Myriad Demon Valley!" Lin Yi thought silently.
Before long, the grand hall of Myriad Demon Valley appeared in front of everyone, a majestic and imposing palace that from afar resembled a giant dragon coiled around mountains and rivers, imposing a majestic oppression.
"Myriad Demon Valley is indeed extraordinary!"
Feeling the ancient and weathered aura emitted by this massive palace, Lin Yi couldn’t help but admire in his heart.
"Greetings to the Valley Master!"
The Third Elder, Fourth Elder, and Fifth Elder bowed respectfully inside the great hall.
"Hmm! What are you old fellows doing here? And Lin Yi, what is this trash doing here?" A cold voice from inside the hall carried a dense killing intent.
"Valley Master, I have urgent matters to report!" Third Elder hastily said.
"You all may leave first!"
"Yes, Valley Master!"
Several elders responded and exited the hall.
"Lin Yi, come in!"
The voice of the Valley Master echoed through the hall, sharp and icy.
"Yes, Valley Master!" Lin Yi responded and quickly walked toward the hall.
...
"Lin Yi, have you returned?" Inside the hall, the Valley Master stood with his hands behind his back, his face icily observing Lin Yi.
"Valley Master, Lin Yi has completed the task assigned by the sect!" Lin Yi respectfully said.
"Oh?"
The Valley Master sneered, his gaze sizing up Lin Yi as he asked coldly,
"Did you say that your strength has reached the Second Layer of the Spiritual Spring Realm?"
Lin Yi hurriedly nodded, "Lin Yi has not deceived the Valley Master!"
The Valley Master snorted coldly and said, "Lin Yi, you indeed are clever. Our Myriad Demons Valley has a long history, yet it has never had a disciple with such exceptional talent as yours!"
"Valley Master flatters me, this is all Lin Yi should do!" Lin Yi said.
The Valley Master waved his hand, his gaze remaining on Lin Yi, and continued, "Lin Yi, since you have completed the sect’s task, you shall stay here!"
Upon hearing this, a flicker of joy crossed Lin Yi’s face, and he quickly knelt before the Valley Master, bowing his head and saying, "Thank you, Valley Master, for your kindness!"
"Lin Yi, from today, you are an Outer Sect Enforcement Team Member of Myriad Demons Valley! Your identity is known only to those within Myriad Demons Valley; no one else, not even the Valley King, is aware. Do you understand?" the Valley Master asked coldly.
Lin Yi hurriedly nodded, "Valley Master, I have noted it down!"
...
After Lin Yi left, the Valley Master’s brows were tightly furrowed, and a cold glint flashed in his eyes.
Lin Yi was an outstanding Martial Artist; if Lin Yi could successfully be accepted into their Myriad Demons Valley, the sect’s strength would surely increase significantly.
However, Lin Yi was the shame of Myriad Demons Valley; naturally, the Valley Master would not allow him to become a core disciple of the sect, just an outer disciple.
Moreover, the Valley Master had another consideration.
Lin Yi had no background in Myriad Demons Valley.
And Lin Yi was merely an outer disciple; they in Myriad Demons Valley were not interested in nurturing an unsupported outer disciple.
Because what they needed were outer disciples who could assist the Valley Master.
Not puppets.
Thus, the people of Myriad Demons Valley were so cold towards Lin Yi, this useless person, even desiring to utterly eradicate him.
It wasn’t the Valley Master’s fault; after all, in this world, the powerful are revered.
...
In a hidden place, a man in a black robe stood at the edge of a cliff.
The man in the black robe was the Valley Master of Myriad Demons Valley.
The man in the black robe wore a long black gown, his face handsome, his mouth curved with a slightly wicked smile as he looked into the distance.
"This Myriad Demons Valley isn’t simple at all!"
Suddenly, the space around him distorted and deformed.
Then, in the void, two figures appeared, a man and a woman.
"Master, this force of Myriad Demons Valley is extraordinary; we don’t know whether coming here was right or wrong?"
"Hmph!"
A sharp glint passed through the Valley Master’s eyes as he said, "What are you afraid of? They have far fewer people than our Myriad Demons Valley!"
"Master, our strength might not be enough to contend with them!"
"Hehe, don’t worry! I have already prepared a trump card!"
Saying so, the Valley Master pulled out a token from his sleeve. The token was pale cyan, emitting a dense spiritual energy. It seemed ordinary, yet it contained immense energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 841 - 861: The Sect Suppressing Order of Myriad Demon Valley
chapters.content:
Chapter 841: Chapter 861: The Sect Suppressing Order of Myriad Demon Valley
The man in the black cloak looked at the token and his eyes suddenly lit up with surprise, "The Myriad Demons Order?"
The Valley Master nodded and said, "Indeed! This is the Sect Suppressing Order of Myriad Demons Valley. With it, all the masters of Myriad Demons Valley must submit to it!"
"Ha ha!"
"Ha ha ha!"
Both the man and the woman burst into wild laughter.
Both of them were from Myriad Demons Valley and naturally knew the power of the Myriad Demons Order.
They had never imagined that their master would possess such a treasure.
At this moment, they felt a tremendous confidence, as if they could control Myriad Demons Valley themselves.
The Valley Master narrowed his eyes and pondered for a moment before saying, "However, we cannot act recklessly!"
"Why?"
"Although the Myriad Demons Order is powerful, within Myriad Demons Valley there are still some old fellows whose strength, I fear, is not weak!"
As the Valley Master’s voice fell, both the man and the woman were stunned, then a hint of apprehension flashed in their eyes.
"What should we do, then?"
"Wait. I want to observe and see if that bunch will be unable to restrain themselves from making a move!"
The Valley Master said ominously, a chilling light shining in his eyes.
...
In the main hall of Myriad Demons Valley.
In a large hall of a room.
An elder sat in the chief seat, his gaze turning to Lin Yi beside him and saying, "Lin Yi, your strength has been recognized by our Valley Master!"
"So, I hope you won’t cause any trouble for me next! Otherwise, even if you are a disciple of Myriad Demons Valley, you will not escape death!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi hurriedly kowtowed and said, "Disciple dares not! Disciple will definitely not dare!"
"Good!" The elder nodded in satisfaction and continued, "Lin Yi, there are over a dozen elders in Myriad Demons Valley, if you perform well, I will allow you to take the position of an elder within!"
"Disciple will certainly try his best!"
Lin Yi quickly replied.
The elder nodded, "Alright! Then you may leave now!"
Lin Yi stood up and respectfully said, "Disciple takes his leave!"
After Lin Yi walked out of the hall, his heart was filled with excitement.
He finally had the chance to become an inner elder of Myriad Demons Valley!
He felt fortunate in his heart that the Valley Master had taken notice of him; otherwise, he really wouldn’t know how to choose.
And he had to thank all those old fossils of Myriad Demons Valley!
Without those old fossils of Myriad Demons Valley, Lin Yi might still be a piece of trash!
"The Myriad Demons Order, indeed has a powerful effect. It is merely a token, yet it can instantly restore a person’s cultivation! What if those old fossils were to consume it? Wouldn’t that be even more against the heavens?"
"However, those old fellows from Myriad Demons Valley will certainly not allow them to consume it, after all, once the Myriad Demons Order is consumed, it will produce serious side effects, and moreover, this thing doesn’t have much effect on cultivation."
Lin Yi shook his head, stopping his thoughts there, and quickly walked towards the foot of the mountain.
"Lin Yi!"
Just then, a crisp voice entered his ears.
Lin Yi turned around and saw a young girl in red standing beside him.
The girl was extremely beautiful, with skin whiter than snow, willow-leaf eyebrows, phoenix eyes, cherry lips, and delicate features, as perfect as if sculpted, without a single flaw.
Her aura was like that of a lotus flower emerging from water, refreshing and ethereal, as if a celestial being had descended.
"Lin Yi, what were you thinking about just now?"
The girl opened her crimson lips to ask.
Lin Yi came back to his senses, smiled faintly, and said, "I was just thinking about some things, nothing in particular."
Hearing this, the girl looked at Lin Yi with curiosity.
Seeing the girl sizing him up, Lin Yi’s face reddened slightly, and he bashfully lowered his head, saying, "I apologize, I was rude. I should not have offended you!"
"It’s okay."
The girl smiled charmingly and said, "I forgive him, whoever it is!"
Lin Yi glanced at the girl and thought to himself, "This girl is really beautiful!"
"Lin Yi, what is your name?"
The girl looked at Lin Yi with a smiling expression and asked.
Lin Yi quickly answered, "Lin Yi."
"Lin Yi, what were you just thinking about? Can you tell me?" The girl’s eyes sparkled with curiosity as she asked.
"I was thinking about my hometown, where the sky is so beautifully blue!" Lin Yi looked towards the girl, with a hint of nostalgia in his eyes.
"Hometown? What about your relatives?" The girl pressed on with her questions.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi sighed and said, "My parents are no longer with us, they... they’re both dead!"
"Oh, that’s really unfortunate!"
The girl nodded slightly and asked, "So, what do you plan to do next?"
"I plan to find my sister!" Lin Yi said, his face showing a resolute expression.
"And what is your sister’s name?"
"Lin Mengyao!"
"Lin Mengyao?"
The girl repeated the name, her beautiful eyes revealing a look of shock as she said, "I didn’t expect that your name and the name of the Holy Maiden of our Valley of Ten Thousand Demons would be the same!"
"Your sister is called Lin Mengyao?"
"Yes!"
"Then she must be the sister you love the most, right?" The girl looked at Lin Yi with an envious expression in her eyes.
"Yes!"
Lin Yi nodded vigorously and said, "I am Lin Yi, and my sister’s name is Lin Mengyao!"
"Then you and your sister really have a fate! But she’s probably not in any danger, right?"
"Yes!"
Lin Yi nodded gently, his eyes filled with anticipation.
...
"What are the two of you doing?"
As Lin Yi and the girl were chatting and laughing, suddenly a voice entered their ears.
Both of them immediately stopped laughing and turned to look back.
They saw two figures slowly walking in from outside the cliff.
One was an old man in his sixties with white hair, but his complexion was ruddy and healthy, full of vitality.
The other was a middle-aged man in a white robe, handsome, tall and straight, with an extraordinary demeanor.
Upon seeing these two people, Lin Yi’s pupils shrank sharply.
Because these two people were the Valley Master and the Myriad Demons Envoy of the Valley of Ten Thousand Demons.
Moreover, their cultivation had doubled since before, reaching the Martial Ancestor Realm!
Lin Yi hastily stepped forward to bow with his hands clasped and said, "Greetings to the Valley Master! Greetings to the Myriad Demons Envoy!"
"Hehe, you need not be so formal. From now on, you will stay by my side," the Valley Master and the Myriad Demons Envoy said with a slight smile.
Lin Yi’s heart leapt with joy, and he quickly nodded, saying, "Thank you, Valley Master!"
"What is your name?" the Valley Master asked, looking at Lin Yi.
"Lin Yi!"
"Then follow by my side!" the Valley Master said with a smile.
"Yes!"
Lin Yi was thrilled, and his expression became even more respectful.
"Good. Let me introduce you, this is the Valley Master of the Valley of Ten Thousand Demons!" the Myriad Demons Envoy introduced.
"I pay my respects to the Valley Master!" Lin Yi said reverently.
"There is no need for excess formalities!" the Valley Master gestured dismissively.
"Go make the arrangements, tomorrow you will accompany me back to the sect to explain some of your family’s affairs. After you return, head directly back to your sect."
"Yes, Valley Master!"
Lin Yi nodded and then retreated.
"This Lin Yi is not simple at all!"

chapters.title: Chapter 842 - 862 Not Simple
chapters.content:
Chapter 842: Chapter 862 Not Simple
"Yes! I think so too. He’s not only extraordinarily talented, but also composed, perceptive, and of good character—humble yet confident—an exceptional gem indeed!"
"Yes! This time, he truly made a notable contribution!"
The Valley Master chatted with Lin Yi.
The Valley Master looked towards Lin Yi’s departing figure, his eyes flashing with profoundness.
"Lin Yi, although your name is quite ordinary, your aptitude is impressive. Would you like to follow me?"
The Valley Master looked at Lin Yi, his eyes showing a touch of gentleness.
"Valley Master, I’m willing!" Lin Yi nodded without hesitation.
He knew that by staying by the side of this supremely powerful Valley Master, he would have greater opportunities for advancement, he naturally wouldn’t refuse.
The Valley Master nodded in satisfaction and smiled, "In that case, go back and prepare now! Once you’re ready, return to the Valley with me!"
"Yes!"
Lin Yi bowed and then quickly left.
...
Lin Yi returned home immediately after leaving the Valley.
The Lin Family was his birthplace, his root; he had to go back because it was his home.
Upon arriving, Lin Yi found his sister and father sitting anxiously in the courtyard.
He quickly approached.
"Dad, Mom, I’m back!"
Lin Yi announced with a radiant smile.
Seeing Lin Yi, Lin Mengyao’s eyes became moist as she hugged him tightly.
"Brother, you’ve suffered during this time!"
Feeling the warmth in Lin Mengyao’s words, Lin Yi gently patted her on the shoulder and reassured, "Mengyao, it’s okay! Your brother is very capable, and our future will be promising!"
"Brother, you’re really amazing!"
Lin Mengyao admired, her beautiful face filled with happiness.
Lin Yi smiled slightly and turned his gaze towards Lin Tianxiong and Yang Xiumei. "Father, Mother, I’ve been in seclusion for some time; has everything been okay here?"
Lin Tianxiong and Yang Xiumei glanced at each other, their faces showing a hint of embarrassment, avoiding Lin Yi’s gaze.
Their cultivation resources had all been used up by Lin Yi.
Seeing their reaction, Lin Yi’s expression darkened, and he scolded, "Father, Mother, how could you deceive me? What exactly happened?"
Lin Tianxiong and Yang Xiumei hurriedly explained, "No, nothing! We’ve been cultivating very diligently these days!"
"Then why have you used up all the cultivation resources?" Lin Yi asked with a frown.
Lin Tianxiong and Yang Xiumei’s faces turned red, and they stuttered, unsure of how to respond.
"I don’t care, you must replenish them!"
Seeing their reaction, Lin Yi realized that they must have encountered some issues in their cultivation; otherwise, they wouldn’t have reacted this way.
Lin Yi didn’t bother to ask further, "Don’t speak for now, let me check the condition inside your bodies first!"
"Yes!" Lin Tianxiong responded quickly.
As Lin Yi examined the bodies of Lin Tianxiong and Yang Xiumei, he soon let out a sigh of relief as the concern vanished from his face.
"Don’t worry! There’s nothing seriously wrong with you internally. As long as you cultivate diligently from now on, you’ll be able to return to your original state," Lin Yi said.
"Really?" Lin Tianxiong and Yang Xiumei showed ecstatic expressions, overwhelmed with excitement.
"Mhm, really!"
Lin Yi nodded and continued, "During this time, you don’t need to work too hard. I’ll help you improve your cultivation while I’m here. The rest is up to you!"
"Yes!" Lin Tianxiong and Yang Xiumei excitedly nodded again.
"Alright! Rest now!"
After speaking, Lin Yi turned and left, disappearing into the night.
...
The next day.
Lin Yi went to the Valley.
"Greetings, Valley Master!" Lin Yi arrived before the Valley Master and bowed.
The Valley Master of the Valley glanced at Lin Yi, appreciation showing in his eyes.
"Your name is Lin Yi, right? I see your cultivation is strong. Would you be willing to join our Valley?" the Valley Master asked directly.
Lin Yi was slightly stunned, his expression froze, and he asked the Valley Master, "Valley Master, what do you mean?"
He hadn’t expected to encounter such an event just after escaping from the valley.
"I see that your cultivation is extraordinary, and I want to recruit you as a disciple of the Ten Thousand Beasts Valley! Are you willing?" the Valley Master said directly.
Hearing this, Lin Yi was greatly startled.
He had never imagined that the Valley Master of the Ten Thousand Beasts Valley would be so forthright.
"Valley Master, let’s discuss this matter another day! I have urgent business to attend to, so I must take my leave now!"
After saying this, Lin Yi tried to turn around and flee.
"Stop!"
The Valley Master of the Ten Thousand Beasts Valley called out indifferently.
Lin Yi paused in his steps, turned his head, and looked at the Valley Master.
"Are you unwilling to join the Ten Thousand Beasts Valley?" the Valley Master asked.
Lin Yi shook his head and said, "What kind of force the Ten Thousand Beasts Valley is, I know nothing about it. How can I become its disciple?"
Lin Yi was self-aware. With only the cultivation of a Fourth-Order Spiritual Warrior, how could he possibly be a disciple of the Ten Thousand Beasts Valley?
"Do you mean that becoming a disciple of the Ten Thousand Beasts Valley would make you one of us?"
The Valley Master asked, squinting his eyes.
Lin Yi nodded and replied, "Exactly!"
The Valley Master nodded and said, "Alright then! You may leave, and we will discuss this in the evening."
"Yes!" Lin Yi bowed and then left the place.
...
Lin Yi returned to the Lin Family.
"Young Master, you’re back!"
"Yes, where did you go? Young Master, do you know? The entire Lin Family has been in chaos these past few days!"
"Yes, the lord and lady were almost sick with worry, fearing that something might have happened to you, but now, you’ve finally returned safely!"
The people of the Lin Family greeted him with various questions.
Lin Yi smiled and said, "It’s okay! I’m back now!"
Seeing his response, they did not press further.
"Young Master, we’ll prepare the medicine for you right away!"
A maid said.
"No need!" Lin Yi interjected.
"What? How then?" the maid panicked.
"Don’t worry, I have a way!" Lin Yi smiled slightly.
"Oh? Really? Then please tell me, what is the way?" the maid asked eagerly.
"Ha ha!" Lin Yi chuckled lightly and said, "Just go about your business. I’ll have someone send over the medicine later!"
Hearing this, everyone did not ask further and went their own ways.
...
Dinner time.
After eating, Lin Yi entered his room.
He took out an elixir, consumed it, and began to close his eyes to nourish his body and consolidate his realm.
In three days’ time.
Lin Yi completely stabilized his cultivation and his strength surged, reaching a Five-Star Martial Artist.
After that, Lin Yi began his practice, refining the remaining Immortal Spiritual Power in his body.
In one night’s practice, Lin Yi refined all the accumulated Immortal Spiritual Power inside him.
Then, Lin Yi left his room and went to the Valley Master’s study.
"Knock knock knock!"
A knocking sound arose.
The Valley Master’s voice came through, saying, "Come in!"
Lin Yi pushed the door and entered.
"Valley Master, I have been in closed-door cultivation these past few days, so I haven’t visited until now. I have come back this time to request help with some matters from the Valley Master. I wonder if you could assist me," Lin Yi said, bowing respectfully.
"Oh? What matters?"
The Valley Master asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 843 - 863: Blue Lotus Flower
chapters.content:
Chapter 843: Chapter 863: Blue Lotus Flower
"I need to find a Spiritual Medicine, not sure if there’s any in the Myriad Monsters Valley. If not, I’ll have to go to another sect!"
"What Spiritual Medicine are you looking for?" asked the Valley Master.
"A Nine Leaves Grass, called Green Lotus. Do you have it in the Myriad Monsters Valley?" Lin Yi replied.
Upon hearing this, the Valley Master paused for a moment and said, "Nine Leaves Grass? I have heard of this Spiritual Medicine. It is said that this was a personal treasure of the first generation Valley Master of Myriad Monsters Valley thousands of years ago, extremely precious, only possessed by the elders of the Myriad Monsters Valley!"
"However, it was discovered a thousand years ago. But, since it was taken by a foreigner, that person never returned."
The Valley Master asked, "What do you need this Spiritual Medicine for? Are you planning to refine some Elixir?"
Lin Yi shook his head and said, "It’s not for me to refine the Elixir, but my master needs it to save his life, so I want the Valley Master to help me find the Nine Leaves Grass!"
Lin Yi’s master was none other than his father, Lin Hao!
The breakthrough Lin Yi had was all because of the Cultivation Technique "Myriad Manifestations Tome" passed down by Lin Hao!
Moreover, Lin Yi was a genius among geniuses, just taking three months to break through from the Fifth Rank Martial King to the Fourth Rank.
Unfortunately, Lin Hao’s life span was about to be exhausted, which is why he had Lin Yi leave their hometown.
"I’ll have someone look into this matter for you! But you should understand, the Nine Leaves Grass is a treasured item of the Myriad Monsters Valley, and ordinary people can’t obtain it! So, getting the Nine Leaves Grass will come at a great cost!" the Valley Master said slowly.
"I understand, as long as it can heal my master’s injuries, I am willing to pay any price!" Lin Yi said resolutely, clenching his teeth.
"Don’t rush to agree now. Wait till you come back, and I’ll consider this matter. If possible, I might take you into our Myriad Monsters Valley, what do you think?" said the Valley Master with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s face showed ecstatic joy.
This was exactly the outcome Lin Yi hoped for.
His master, Lin Hao, was the only family Lin Yi had.
He would not allow anyone to harm Lin Hao, not even his parents.
"Thank you, Valley Master! This time I have returned to hand the Nine Leaves Grass over to my master!"
After saying this, Lin Yi took out a Pill from his chest.
This Pill was the Nine Leaves Grass.
"Good, since you’ve made your decision, I’ll lend you a hand. Go and give the Nine Leaves Grass to your master!" the Valley Master nodded.
"Thank you, Valley Master! I’ll lead the way now!"
"Alright, let’s go!"
Upon saying that, Lin Yi and the Valley Master both walked down the mountain.
Soon, they arrived at the foot of the mountain.
On a desolate slope, there was a thatched cottage.
The cottage looked shabby and rundown, but the door of the cottage was made from special materials, exceptionally tough, able to withstand a full-force hit from a Martial Artist.
Lin Yi approached the front of the cottage and pressed his hand on the door.
A buzzing sound was heard, and the door of the cottage slowly opened.
Lin Yi and the Valley Master exchanged glances, both seeing astonishment in each other’s eyes.
To their surprise, what seemed like an ordinary door was made of special materials.
"Master, I’m back!" Lin Yi respectfully said.
Inside the cottage, Lin Hao was sitting cross-legged with a pale face, his eyes tightly closed, as though he was in deep sleep.
Lin Yi walked in.
"My disciple, you’re finally back! I thought you would stay on the mountain for a long time!"
Lin Hao opened his eyes, glanced at Lin Yi, and then sighed, continuing to speak, "Ah! I know you don’t want to burden your master, but I don’t want to see you like this! In just under three months, your demeanor has undergone a major change!"
"Master, I had no choice. If I continued to stay on the mountain, it would inevitably affect your healing!" Lin Yi said.
"Hmph! If it weren’t for your persistent desire to leave, I would have left long ago! Don’t forget the instruction your grandmaster once gave you!" Lin Hao snorted coldly.
Lin Yi felt guilty and lowered his head, remaining silent.
"Forget it! I won’t argue about that anymore. I know you mean well, and I won’t blame you. I only hope that you will protect yourself well!"
"Yes!"
"Your current strength has already reached the peak of Martial Monarch, and it’s unlikely that you’ll break through to Martial Sovereign. As for Martial Emperor, you still fall short! If you want to become a Martial Saint, it will probably take even more time, and your temperament needs more tempering."
"Master’s teachings are correct!"
"Mm!"
"You’ve come back this time to refine elixirs, right?"
"Yes, Master!"
"I just so happen to have two Sixth Grade Elixirs here, formed from the essence of my hard work! To show my gratitude for your contributions, I will give them to you!"
As he spoke, the Valley Master flicked his finger, and two pills exuding a faint fragrance flew towards Lin Yi.
The pills were golden yellow, with surfaces flowing with light.
They looked like two golden clouds, shimmering with dazzling brilliance.
"This elixir is called ’Golden Yang Pill’. After taking it, it can enhance your cultivation in a short time without leaving any side effects!"
"However, your body can only endure for about two years! After two years, you will have to recover on your own! This time, I entrust you to go and gather these two ’Golden Yang Pills’!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was overjoyed, repeatedly bowing and saying, "Thank you, Master. I will do my best to fulfill your wish!"
"Alright! Go and take care of it!"
Lin Yi turned and left, returning to the Myriad Demon Valley.
Although Lin Hao was seriously injured, his consciousness was still clear.
Seeing Lin Yi return, Lin Hao opened his eyes.
"Senior brother, why have you come back?"
"Junior brother, your injury hasn’t healed yet, why did you come back?"
"Senior brother, your sister has been worried about you for half a year at home. She dreams every night that you are being chased by a group of fierce beasts, eventually being torn apart by them. How could I rest easy leaving you alone here!" Lin Yi said.
"You... Silly child, don’t worry! Your master is fine!" Lin Hao smiled.
"This time I came back, I brought two Sixth Grade Elixirs. Take them and consider it a small gift from your master!" Lin Yi said.
"Sixth Grade Elixirs? You actually gathered Sixth Grade Elixirs again? Bring them out, let me see!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Hao’s eyes lit up, and he immediately stood up.
Lin Yi nodded and took out the two Sixth Grade Elixirs from his storage ring.
Lin Hao examined them carefully, only to see that the Golden Yang Pills had golden yellow medicinal liquid rolling on their surfaces, emitting a rich medicinal fragrance.
"Great stuff!"
"Senior brother, this is..."
"I won’t hide it from you, my injuries can only be sustained for two more years. After two years, I must leave the Myriad Demon Valley!"
"What?" Lin Yi’s eyes widened.
"The situation with your master this time is much more severe than ever before, even... it has reached the point where the oil is exhausted and the lamp is burnt out. If I can’t find a way to detoxify, then your master can only die!"
"How is that possible!" Lin Yi couldn’t believe that Lin Hao had reached the point where the oil was exhausted and the lamp burnt out.
"I am not lying to you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 844 - 864 Life Without Sunshine
chapters.content:
Chapter 844: Chapter 864 Life Without Sunshine
Lin Hao shook his head and let out a sigh, "I am someone who dislikes constraints; I just want to lead a life of peace and leisure! This time, the reason I chose to stay is that I’ve lived long enough; it’s time for me to enjoy life!
"I don’t want to live like before, in constant fear and endless darkness!" Lin Hao added.
Hearing this, Lin Yi fell into silence.
Indeed, Lin Hao had lived for over a hundred years; one could say he had lived long enough.
"Whether your master’s injuries can be healed, no one can say for sure! The only plan for now is to find the Jiuyou Demon Flower; only then might there be a chance to cure your master’s injuries!" Lin Hao said earnestly.
"The Jiuyou Demon Flower is the highest-level Spiritual Medicine in the Demon Realm; it is said to be the most precious Spiritual Medicine of the Jiuyou Demon Clan. However, this type of Spiritual Medicine has not been seen in the territory of the Myriad Demon Valley, so it’s essentially untraceable! Unless one who is fated happens to encounter the Young Master of the Jiuyou Demon Clan, perhaps then one might learn from him!"
"But meeting the Young Master of the Jiuyou Demon Clan is not so easy!" Lin Yi remarked.
"Perhaps so," Lin Hao said with a sigh.
"Master, you need not worry too much! That you managed to escape by chance and helped me break through my bottleneck, advancing to Martial King, is something we should both be grateful for!" Lin Hao said with a smile.
At these words, Lin Yi’s expression softened somewhat.
"Junior Brother, you’re right; your breakthrough to Martial King is truly remarkable! Do you know, your opportunity this time is no small matter! Our Myriad Demon Valley, throughout the eons, can be considered one of the forebears!" Lin Yi exclaimed.
Lin Yi was indeed talking about no small chance, because he learned of it from a once-in-a-generation genius of the Myriad Demon Valley, a disciple from a thousand years ago.
That genius was Lin Yi’s direct disciple and his only nephew, named Lin Xuan.
Lin Xuan had reached the Martial Venerable Realm a thousand years ago and even had his own estate, becoming one of the Martial Marquis powerhouses of the Myriad Demon Valley.
While cultivating himself, Lin Yi also took the time to ask for guidance from Lin Xuan.
Gradually, Lin Xuan took an interest in Lin Yi’s cultivation and thus taught him some secret techniques for training.
Although Lin Yi did not understand what Sword Intent was, he had grasped the essence of the Sword Path.
Seeing that Lin Yi was a cultivation prodigy, Lin Xuan took him as his closed-door disciple and personally started to guide his cultivation.
Under Lin Xuan’s tutelage, Lin Yi’s cultivation speed grew faster and faster.
A thousand years ago, Lin Yi’s Cultivation had already far surpassed Lin Xuan’s, but in terms of training, he was still relatively weak and his cultivation speed slow.
It wasn’t until he met Lin Hao and spent several years together that he slowly surpassed Lin Hao.
Lin Hao’s talent and aptitude were second to none in the entire Myriad Demon Valley!
But still, Lin Yi had not caught up with Lin Hao.
It was only after Lin Hao disappeared that Lin Yi came to understand.
Right then and there, Lin Yi decided to go into closed-door cultivation, both training and searching for Lin Hao.
Today, a thousand years later, Lin Yi’s strength had reached the later stages of Martial Sovereign.
And Lin Xuan had become the Martial Emperor of the Myriad Demon Valley!
To Lin Yi, the Lin Xuan of a thousand years ago was like an insurmountable chasm!
However, today, a thousand years later, the Myriad Demon Valley had surpassed its past self and showed an unprecedented prosperity that didn’t exist before!
One could say that the rise of the Myriad Demon Valley was completely natural!
"Senior Brother, should I now start closed-door cultivation?"
"Hmm, you start preparing for seclusion. Once you’ve broken through to the peak of Martial Sovereign, your master will tell you a piece of great news!" Lin Yi said.
Lin Hao nodded, then stepped into the secret chamber.
After entering the secret chamber, he immediately sat cross-legged in meditation!
This time, he intended to apply all his knowledge of swordsmanship to the cultivation of his Sword Sect Realm, aiming for a breakthrough!
A day later, Lin Hao opened his eyes.
He found that the primordial energy within his body had become much more abundant, as if it had suddenly become more condensed.
"Finally, I’ve broken through to the peak of the Martial Sovereign level!"
"The illness of my mentor has hope of being cured!"
A smile appeared on the corners of Lin Hao’s mouth, and he began to circulate the "Infinite Sword Tome."
On a mountaintop within Jiuyou Valley, an elderly woman was cleaning the vegetation in the ravine.
This old woman was the steward of Jiuyou Valley, Mother Zhang.
Although Mother Zhang’s status in Jiuyou Valley wasn’t particularly low, among the many elders, she was ranked at the bottom.
She was indeed over fifty years old.
Mother Zhang was one of the earliest followers of Lin Yi in Jiuyou Valley and one of the strongest in terms of cultivation. However, due to her advanced age, she could no longer continue her cultivation practice.
Therefore, the Valley Master of Jiuyou Valley had placed her in the backyard to take care of the greenery.
These days, Mother Zhang spent every day clearing weeds in the ravine and watering various fruits and vegetables.
Behind Mother Zhang were several towering trees.
These giants were ancient trees over tens of thousands of years old, each one’s value immeasurable!
Moreover, these towering trees bore purple-red fruits!
The flesh of these fruits contained pure spiritual power and were brought from outside the heavens by an elder of Jiuyou Valley ten thousand years ago.
These fruits could enhance the body, improve the Martial Soul, and were even more beneficial for cultivation!
However, since the fruits were so rare, the Valley Master of Jiuyou Valley had to forgo them, leaving only some Spirit Fruits for the disciples to consume!
Although these Spirit Fruits were difficult to ingest, they were incredibly precious treasures present-day after ten thousand years!
Because consuming a Spirit Fruit could bring substantial benefits, and even increase the chances of a breakthrough!
Lin Yi, ten thousand years ago, broke through to the Martial Saint level with just one purple-red Spirit Fruit, and even had the potential to break through the Martial Venerable Realm!
However, at that time, Lin Yi was just an average disciple without any fame.
Ten thousand years later, Lin Yi became the Valley Master of Jiuyou Valley, with formidable strength and a great reputation.
Back in the day, Lin Yi was also a peerless genius, but due to his defeat in a conflict with Lin Xuan, he ultimately perished.
Although Lin Yi had perished, as an elder of Jiuyou Valley, news of his death spread throughout the entire valley!
The people of Jiuyou Valley were filled with regret because Lin Yi’s cultivation was much stronger than Lin Xuan’s.
Regrettably, because of the conflict between Lin Yi and Lin Xuan, he fell completely, and this conflict plunged Jiuyou Valley into turmoil.
The elders of Jiuyou Valley were all speculating on what could have caused their Valley Master and the peerless genius Lin Xuan from ten thousand years ago to become sworn enemies, leading to the fall of Lin Xuan and their Valley Master’s ruination.
Among their speculations, it could have been that their Valley Master had a personal grudge with Lin Yi, which led to their fierce battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 845 - 865: Suspicions Spread Extremely Rapidly
chapters.content:
Chapter 845: Chapter 865: Suspicions Spread Extremely Rapidly
In the mouths of the disciples of the Valley of Myriad Beasts, they believed even more so that it was Lin Yi who, out of jealousy for their Valley Master, had deliberately planned and executed the murder of their Valley Master!
Not only that, but the other elders of the Valley of Myriad Beasts shared this train of thought as well.
However, there was not a single piece of evidence within the Valley of Myriad Beasts to substantiate this claim.
After all, there was nobody within the Valley of Myriad Beasts willing to bear such a heavy sin; for once one accepted such responsibility, their fate would be rewritten.
Thus, one suspicion after another spread throughout the Valley of Myriad Beasts, even escalating dramatically—to the point where even they themselves believed it to be true.
In the end, several elders were beaten to death by the disciples of the Valley of Myriad Beasts, and their bodies were subsequently thrown into the jaws of wild beasts.
This was because these elders and their disciples had made the wrong choices, leading to their ultimate demise.
For a while, within the Valley of Myriad Beasts, everyone was on edge!
And the death of Lin Yi had a huge impact on the entire Valley of Myriad Beasts!
Not long after, Valley Master Lin Yi mysteriously disappeared without a trace.
This secret was well-kept, known by only a handful of high-ranking officials, and even the guards by the Valley Master’s side were not privy to it.
Therefore, Lin Yi’s fall did not cause much commotion in the Valley of Myriad Beasts, leaving only a few elders feeling a guilty conscience.
Zhang Ma was one of the few servants responsible for cleaning up the mountain streams and also a confidante of Valley Master Lin Yi.
"Zhang Ma, I heard that Lin Yi’s death was no accident?"
That evening, a handsome young man approached Zhang Ma with his inquiry.
Zhang Ma glanced at the newcomer, who was a Two-Star disciple at the Martial King Realm, but she did not recognize him.
After all, the elders here mainly resided at the base of the mountain, seldom interacting with others, and even their Valley Master was rarely seen.
Nevertheless, Zhang Ma replied with great respect, "Reporting to the young master, Lin Yi did indeed die accidentally. He was injured during a conflict with Lin Xuan, and then his heart was pierced through, which led to his downfall."
"Oh?" The handsome young man’s brow furrowed slightly, a hint of cold light flashing across his face, and he said coldly, "Since that’s the case, then I shall avenge Lin Yi and cleanse his disgrace!"
"Young master, what would you like to do?" Zhang Ma asked respectfully.
"Quite simple, I will personally slaughter those few disciples of Lin Yi!"
This handsome young man was none other than the eldest of Lin Yi’s three disciples, Lin Yi.
And standing next to Lin Yi was a young man with a gloomy face.
At this moment, Lin Yi exuded a sharp aura, evidently a formidable martial artist.
This person was none other than the Third Elder of the Valley of Myriad Beasts, Lin Xuan’s biological brother, Lin Xuan!
Hearing this, Zhang Ma couldn’t help but sigh, "Alas, these three young masters were all favorite disciples of the Valley Master, and their strength is immensely powerful!"
"Zhang Ma, rest assured, I have a sense of measure," Lin Yi waved his hand and said indifferently.
...
In these days, Lin Yi had been in seclusion within the Valley of Myriad Beasts.
His identity was extraordinary, as a being of Martial Emperor Level, one of the elders of the Valley of Myriad Beasts!
Thus, when Lin Yi entered seclusion, who among the people of the Valley of Myriad Beasts would dare to disturb him?
Of course, there were exceptions, such as Valley Master Lin Yi, whose seclusion was a source of apprehension for many disciples of the Valley of Myriad Beasts.
As Lin Yi secluded himself, the Valley Master of the Valley of Myriad Beasts temporarily resigned from his position, entrusting it to one of Lin Yi’s Direct Disciples to manage the affairs of the Valley. Meanwhile, his other two Direct Disciples also returned to the sect, preparing to succeed the Valley Master’s position.
The Valley Master himself returned to his room.
Lin Yi’s room was constructed from a pile of huge rocks, exuding luxury and extravagance.
At the moment, Lin Yi was lying on a stone bed, resting with his eyes closed.
Embedded in his chest was a silver needle, slowly sapping his life force.
Lin Yi’s complexion was extremely pale; even with his eyes closed, he could not hide his haggardness and fatigue.
This silver needle was a protective amulet given to him by his master, the Valley Master of Wan Yao Valley—it could ward off all attacks!
And this silver needle, it was the treasured artefact that guarded Wan Yao Valley, as well as the foundation of the Valley’s strength.
But Lin Yi today was gravely injured, and if he were to delay any further, he feared he would indeed perish here, forever remaining in this world.
"Sigh, I’m really done for this time, I wonder if that bastard Lin Xuan is still on the mountain peak?"
Lin Yi sighed softly and then gently opened his eyes.
At that moment, his gaze landed on a bronze mirror beside him.
In the mirror was the reflection of Lin Yi, who could only give a bitter smile.
In recent days, the elders and disciples of Wan Yao Valley had taken turns calling on him, asking if he was still alive.
To this, Lin Yi could only shake his head, indicating he was already dead, but he did not inform those elders and disciples that he was still alive.
Because in their hearts, he was already gone, thus Lin Yi preferred to silently protect the Lin Family’s secrets and safeguard the Lin bloodline, preventing his clansmen from harm!
"I hope they can find a place rich in spiritual energy for cultivation, enabling them to grow quickly!"
Lin Yi murmured and then slowly closed his eyes.
"Bang bang bang!"
Suddenly, a series of urgent knocks sounded.
Lin Yi furrowed his brows slightly, then stood up, walked to the door, and pulled it open.
At the doorstep stood a young man.
The young man was not old, but his eyes were exceptionally cold, like twin swords, making one’s heart quiver.
Seeing Lin Yi appear at the door, he straightforwardly said, "The Valley Master requests your presence!"
"Hmm," Lin Yi nodded and then accompanied the young man towards the back courtyard.
Lin Yi knew Lin Xuan must have something to discuss with him.
Because Lin Xuan was the only person who dared to strike against him.
Lin Yi was very clear that this time Lin Xuan was sure to attempt to murder him!
And this time, his own strength was utterly compromised, incapable of stopping Lin Xuan’s actions.
Thinking this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but sigh.
Nonetheless, he clenched his teeth and followed the young man towards the back courtyard.
Moments later, they arrived in a courtyard.
Inside the courtyard, a middle-aged man was sitting beside a stone table, sipping tea.
While several others were bustling around with various tasks.
Seeing the young man, the middle-aged man stood up and bowed to him.
"I greet the eldest young master!"
This middle-aged man was Lin Yi’s direct disciple Lin Xuan. Although Lin Xuan was not of direct lineage, he was his only direct disciple and held considerable sway in Wan Yao Valley.
"Valley Master!" Lin Xuan also bowed, his attitude very respectful, "I have come here because there is a matter that requires the Valley Master’s consent."
"Whatever it is, Eldest Young Master, feel free to speak!" Lin Yi said with a smitten smile, his tone overflowing with indulgence.
"I wish to gather a batch of resources as a foundation for our Lin Family, may I?" Lin Xuan asked, his tone calm and unflustered.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat—resources of the Lin Family’s foundation!

chapters.title: Chapter 846 - 866: The Foundation of the Lin Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 846: Chapter 866: The Foundation of the Lin Family
This was his family, yet Lin Xuan called it the foundation of the Lin Family—could it be that Lin Xuan was truly a genius of his generation?!
At this thought, Lin Yi muttered to himself, "It seems that this eldest brother is no ordinary person either!"
Although Lin Yi was the Valley Master of the Myriad Demon Palace, his authority wasn’t very significant.
Therefore, he merely respected Lin Xuan, but he did not fear him.
However, if Lin Xuan really was the descendant or inheritor of some hermit master, then Lin Yi would have to seriously consider his position.
Thus, Lin Yi asked, "Lin Xuan, what resources are you looking to gather?"
"I need to collect a large amount of Spiritual Medicine!" Lin Xuan answered gravely, "This batch is the foundation of our Lin Family and must not be revealed to others."
Hearing this, Lin Yi understood Lin Xuan’s intention: "Alright, no problem, but this time, the quantity of resources is quite substantial and will take time to collect."
"Fine, I can give you three months’ time, and I hope you can transport this batch of Spiritual Medicine to the Myriad Demon Palace. However, the precondition is that you must ensure the safety of the Spiritual Medicine."
"Naturally!" Lin Xuan nodded and then asked, "Valley Master, Lin Yi would like to enter a healing retreat. Could you arrange a safe residence for me?"
"Certainly, I’ll arrange a secluded courtyard for you!" Lin Yi nodded.
Lin Yi’s small courtyard was not within the villa but at the base of the mountain, on an extremely desolate hillside.
This hillside was one of the forbidden areas of the Myriad Demon Palace, where Lin Yi liked to spend his time.
Because the scenery here was beautiful, the surroundings were quiet and serene, and it was very secluded, few people ventured here.
In this way, Lin Yi would be able to recover from his injuries in tranquility.
Moreover, there weren’t any significant events happening in the Myriad Demon Palace recently, so he had agreed to Lin Xuan’s request.
"Thank you, Valley Master!" Lin Xuan nodded, then turned and left.
After Lin Xuan had gone, Lin Yi’s gaze once again drifted toward the window and he muttered, "Lin Xuan, I hope you won’t disappoint me, or else..."
As Lin Xuan’s figure disappeared from view, Lin Yi closed his eyes again.
Before long, Lin Yi began to feel an intensifying pain in his mind, so he slowly stood up and walked into his bedroom.
The bedroom was simply furnished, yet well-organized and stylish.
Lin Yi sat cross-legged and began to meditate.
This battle had greatly impacted his spiritual power.
Although Lin Xuan had not taken actual action, only a wisp of his Divine Sense had materialized, Lin Yi still felt so suppressed that he found it difficult to breathe.
Lin Yi knew that Lin Xuan must have held back and had not used his full strength.
Therefore, Lin Yi had to make the most of every second, to recover from his injuries as quickly as possible.
Once Lin Yi’s spiritual power recovered, his Combat Power could instantly soar.
Hence, he needed to urgently heal his injuries.
As Lin Yi’s spiritual power entered his body, a tremendous suction force immediately absorbed all his spiritual power.
In Lin Yi’s mind, there was also a black vortex constantly spinning.
Lin Yi’s spiritual power followed the black vortex, rapidly streaming into it.
This vortex was like a massive black hole, endlessly devouring Lin Yi’s spiritual power.
Lin Yi could only resist this force instinctively.
Time slowly passed, Lin Yi’s complexion turned pale, and large beads of sweat slid down his forehead.
Blood also dribbled from the corner of his mouth.
The spiritual power spent in this battle was too much, and Lin Yi was beginning to feel overwhelmed.
Yet, this predicament made Lin Yi even more convinced that Lin Xuan was no ordinary disciple!
Lin Xuan’s cultivation was absolutely much more formidable than his, and perhaps, he had already reached the Martial Sovereign Realm!
After an unknown period, Lin Yi’s spiritual power was finally exhausted.
He opened his eyes, which flashed with thick horror, because this consumption was even more terrifying than when he had first arrived at Myriad Demons Valley!
"Whew..."
Lin Yi took a deep breath, raised his right hand, and wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth.
"I hadn’t expected that this battle would actually let me break through to the peak of Martial King," Lin Yi murmured to himself, "However, this breakthrough is merely that of a First Rank martial master."
"The peak of Martial King and the Martial King are only one realm apart, but unfortunately, it’s a step I cannot take; otherwise, I wouldn’t have wasted so much time..." Lin Yi shook his head with a trace of regret.
Between Martial King and the peak of Martial King was a chasm like that of a vast moat.
No matter how hard one tried, it could not be crossed.
But even at the early stage of Martial King, Lin Yi had no confidence he could defeat Lin Xuan!
After all, although Lin Yi was at the peak of Martial King, Lin Xuan was a genuine Martial Sovereign Realm powerhouse!
"I hope Lin Xuan succeeds in three months," Lin Yi sighed.
Lin Yi knew that Lin Xuan had high talent, but he couldn’t expect him to transform overnight into a phoenix rising to the top of the tree!
"Right, I still need to prepare for my trip to the Holy Domain," Lin Yi muttered quietly to himself.
These days, Lin Yi had been in seclusion, and his reason for closing off was to prepare for his trip to the Holy Domain!
Lin Xuan was also the genius that Lin Yi admired most!
Now, Lin Yi had become a steward of Myriad Demons Valley.
The Valley Master of Myriad Demons Valley was the direct grandchild of the Myriad Demon Ancestor.
