Therefore, Lin Yi was quite favored within Myriad Demons Valley. Even the Valley Master would treat him with great courtesy when they met.
Myriad Demons Valley was an affiliated force of the Holy Domain.
Within the Holy Domain, Myriad Demons Valley might not be the top force, but there were still many forces that feared it.
After all, within Myriad Demons Valley, there was a Martial Sovereign powerhouse!
That’s why Lin Yi dared to be so arrogantly domineering!
In Myriad Demons Valley, apart from the Holy Sect, the Martial Sovereign was the most powerful, even more formidable than the Martial Emperor!
Lin Yi had also considered whether he could become the direct disciple of Myriad Demons Valley’s Valley Master. Being the direct disciple of the Valley Master was like having the protection of the Holy Sect; who else would dare to bully him?
That’s why Lin Yi held Lin Xuan in such high esteem!
However, Lin Yi had not anticipated that Lin Xuan’s strength was so fierce, far beyond his expectations.
"Now that his strength has reached Martial Sovereign, he must not be far from Myriad Demon Palace!"
"Once Lin Xuan enters Myriad Demon Palace, then he will be a core disciple!"
"With such status, he will be more than enough to deal with me."
Lin Yi’s eyes took on a slightly chilly look.
Although Lin Yi couldn’t kill Lin Xuan, he could still threaten him.
This was Lin Yi’s plan.
Lin Yi’s goal was to become the Valley Master of Myriad Demons Valley!
So, Lin Yi had to enter the Martial Emperor Realm within three years successfully!
Otherwise, the elders of Myriad Demon Palace would definitely not let him off!
"This time, is my chance to break through to the Martial Emperor Realm!" Lin Yi clenched his fists, "I must make a breakthrough in one go, become an elder of Myriad Demons Valley, or even the direct disciple of the Valley Master!"
Lin Yi knew that within Myriad Demons Valley, there were countless resources.

chapters.title: Chapter 847 - 867 Absolutely Reluctant
chapters.content:
Chapter 847: Chapter 867 Absolutely Reluctant
So many resources, if he got his hands on all of them, his power would definitely increase greatly!
"It’s just that, with so many resources, I probably couldn’t bear it, I have to wait until I have broken through to the Martial Emperor Realm before I can even attempt to absorb those resources," Lin Yi muttered to himself, as he was far from being able to control so many resources yet.
Lin Yi also knew that achieving this step would be extremely difficult.
But Lin Yi was absolutely unwilling to spend his life in mediocrity!
"No matter what, I must strive to break through! I must become the Martial Sovereign of the Myriad Demon Valley!" A hint of madness showed in Lin Yi’s eyes!
This was an ambition, a pursuit for the future, a desire to become a Martial King!
Lin Yi knew that only by becoming an elder or a direct disciple of the Myriad Demon Valley would he possibly be able to advance at the Martial King level!
Lin Yi knew that the Martial King was a mountain that needed to be climbed, that required bravery!
He had to have enough courage to be able to climb that mountain!
And now, he had already traversed two mountains, yet he had only walked half of the journey.
Thus, he still had a long road ahead of him.
...
A month later.
Lin Yi’s figure silently appeared in the valley.
The valley, still like a barren mountain, was silent all around.
Only Lin Yi, with light steps, slowly walked towards the center of the valley.
"Hmm?"
Suddenly, a faint sound caught Lin Yi’s attention.
Lin Yi turned his head towards the direction of the sound.
"Is it a spirit beast?"
Lin Yi frowned slightly, thinking to himself.
For, he discovered that there was a person standing in the middle of the valley!
It was a young man in a green gown, handsome in appearance, with the air of a graceful young master, looking rather debonair.
"Eh, is that a spirit monkey?" Lin Yi’s eyes lit up.
His figure also instantly shot forth, landing beside the man in green.
"What are you doing here?" the man in green glanced at Lin Yi, asking coldly.
Lin Yi smiled and said, "I am Lin Yi, the elder brother of Lin Xuan!"
"What!? You are Lin Xuan’s brother?" the man in green was suddenly stunned.
Lin Xuan’s brother?
Hearing the man in green’s words, Lin Yi’s expression couldn’t help but brighten.
Because he knew Lin Xuan’s nature, which was very similar to his own.
Lin Xuan was also somewhat solitary and had a violent temper. Anyone who offended him, he would definitely not leave alive!
And his brother Lin Xuan, had a temperament even more like his.
The two of them were both cold and solitary!
Lin Yi knew that his brother and Lin Xuan had similar personalities, but there was one difference.
His brother was not alone.
Whereas Lin Xuan’s solitude had been nurtured from a young age.
Lin Yi looked at the young man in the green gown, a trace of coldness flashing through his eyes.
Lin Yi, although Lin Xuan’s elder brother, was a ruthless person.
This man in the green gown had dared to rebuke Lin Xuan in such a manner, which made Lin Yi very angry.
Moreover, it was clear that the man in the green gown did not pay any respect to Lin Yi.
His gaze didn’t even treat Lin Yi as a person!
"Lin Xuan, your brother? Hmph, that kid Lin Xuan doesn’t even qualify to be my master!"
The man in green chuckled coldly.
He naturally knew that among the disciples of the Myriad Demon Palace, only Lin Xuan was regarded by Lin Yi as his master; he was not at all surprised.
Lin Yi snorted coldly, "Although Lin Xuan might not qualify to be your master, I can!"
Lin Yi sneered, "I am now a Martial Venerable of the Myriad Demon Palace!"
"Haha!" Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the man in green scoffed in disdain, "Martial Venerable? Haha! Do you even qualify to be called a Martial Venerable of the Myriad Demon Palace?"
"Now, I am a Martial Monarch! You, still have a long way to go!"
The man in green, his face full of mockery.
Lin Yi, although a disciple of the Myriad Demon Palace, had practiced cultivation for too short a time. His foundation was unstable, so his strength had barely entered the Innate Realm.
Therefore, the man in the blue shirt looked down upon him with such disdain.
Upon hearing these words, Lin Yi was also taken aback.
He had not expected that his cultivation had already reached the level of a Martial Monarch!
Although it was only the early stage of Martial Monarch, the speed of his progress was extremely terrifying!
Such cultivation, placed within the sacred lands, was definitely top-tier!
However, among Martial Kings, it was just an ordinary existence!
Lin Yi could already be considered a top-tier powerhouse within the sacred lands.
"Martial Monarch? Haha! What a huge joke!" the man in the blue shirt scoffed coldly, before suddenly swinging his arms.
A fierce wind blew out abruptly, heading straight for Lin Yi like a whirlwind.
The wind, sharp as a blade, sliced through the air.
In that moment, Lin Yi’s clothes were instantly shredded!
Yet, Lin Yi was not at all panicked. His sword, in his hand, came out of its sheath in an instant, striking at the raging wind.
Sizzle!
The wind was severed by Lin Yi’s sword.
At the same time, the sword light also struck the body of the man in the blue shirt.
"Puff!"
The chest of the man in the blue shirt was pierced by the sword, and blood spurted out!
"What!?"
Seeing that his own sword had actually injured the man in the blue shirt, Lin Yi was also shocked.
Because the man in the blue shirt was a true Martial Monarch, yet he had been severely wounded by Lin Yi’s sword!
Lin Yi’s face suddenly turned ugly.
This was an embarrassing situation for him.
The man in the blue shirt was a Martial Venerable!
In the Myriad Demon Mountain Range, he was a top-tier powerhouse.
But now, he had been pierced through the heart by Lin Yi’s sword!
This was an immense irony!
Lin Yi felt as if all his strength had been drained from him.
"How about that, defeated by me, huh?" The man in the blue shirt looked at Lin Yi and mocked.
"You, you..." Lin Yi pointed at the man in the blue shirt, so angry he could hardly speak.
"Hmph!"
The man in the blue shirt snorted coldly, then turned and left.
"You just wait!"
"If you don’t die, I swear I’ll take your head!" Lin Yi shouted angrily, clenching his fists.
But the man in the blue shirt paid him no heed and walked straight ahead, disappearing from sight.
Lin Yi took a deep breath and glanced at the sky-reaching tree in front of him, then turned and walked outside.
His target was the Sky-reaching Ancient Tree!
Lin Yi had seen that there was a token on the trunk of the Sky-reaching Ancient Tree, engraved with a red flower.
It was Lin Xuan’s token.
Lin Yi wanted to take back this token!
Lin Yi was Lin Xuan’s elder brother!
How could he stand by idly at such a crucial moment?
"The trunk of this Sky-reaching Ancient Tree contains a strand of Innate True Yuan, and, in the center of the trunk, there is a Treasure Pill embedded!" Lin Yi looked at the trunk of the Sky-reaching Ancient Tree, his face showing a hint of joy.
Because the Treasure Pill in the middle of the trunk was an Innate Elixir!
Innate Elixirs were divided into six grades.
Each grade had different effects!
Moreover, the efficacy of each grade varied.
Lin Yi’s Innate Pill was a type of elixir that enhanced one’s realm, capable of helping a person break through to the realm of Martial Venerable within three months!

chapters.title: Chapter 848 - 868: Seize the Opportunity to Break Through
chapters.content:
Chapter 848: Chapter 868: Seize the Opportunity to Break Through
Lin Yi wanted to use the Innate Pill to break through to the Martial King Realm!
"Ha ha, this is a great item, I can take the chance to break through now!"
Lin Yi laughed loudly, then his figure flickered, and he jumped directly into the Sky-reaching Ancient Tree.
In the center of the trunk of the Sky-reaching Ancient Tree, an Innate Elixir was embedded, so Lin Yi directly swallowed it.
Lin Yi closed his eyes, started to circulate his cultivation technique, and began to absorb the essence of the elixir!
This was the fastest way to enhance his strength. Only by absorbing the entirety of the elixir’s essence could his cultivation be elevated.
"What a rich Innate True Yuan!"
"The medicinal effect of this elixir is many times better than I expected!"
Feeling the immense medicinal power of the elixir, Lin Yi couldn’t help but show a satisfied expression.
"Junior Brother Lin Yi, where are you?"
Suddenly, an urgent call from Lin Xuan was heard from a distance.
"It’s Senior Brother Lin Xuan!" Upon hearing this, Lin Yi was overjoyed and immediately sped up the process of devouring the elixir.
A while later, a dark silhouette appeared under the ancient tree, and it was indeed Lin Xuan.
"Senior Brother Lin Xuan!" Lin Yi called out excitedly as he looked at Lin Xuan.
"Where have you been playing again!?"
Seeing that Lin Yi was safe and sound, Lin Xuan sighed with relief.
"I, I went to comprehend Sword Intent," Lin Yi said, looking down, somewhat embarrassed.
"Sword Intent?" Lin Xuan was stunned for a moment, then frowned slightly, "Did you go to the Sword Tomb to comprehend Sword Intent?"
Lin Yi nodded, "Yes! I went to the Sword Tomb to seek some spiritual materials, trying to refine an immortal weapon!"
"Unfortunately, I wasn’t successful!"
Lin Xuan sighed, a look of regret on his face, "However, since you went to comprehend Sword Intent, you should focus even more on cultivating! Look, you’ve now reached the Fifth Rank of the Innate Realm, not far from the Martial Emperor."
"And that Lin Yi, although somewhat talented, is after all a Martial Ancestor and moreover, young, still needing some time before he can break through to Martial Emperor!"
"And you, now, have reached the Fourth Rank of the Innate Realm! You just need a few more days of cultivation, and you will be able to advance to the Martial Ancestor!"
Lin Xuan slowly said.
"Mm."
Lin Yi nodded, knowing everything Lin Xuan said was correct.
However, he always felt that there was something missing in his heart!
"Senior Brother, let’s go! I want to return to the family early!"
"Alright!"
Lin Xuan nodded, and the two of them proceeded together.
Half a month later.
Lin Xuan and Lin Yi finally returned to the Lin Family.
"You are Lin Yi? You finally came back!"
In the mansion of the Lin Family, a thunderous shout was heard, followed immediately by a young man rushing out from inside.
"Second Uncle, what are you doing?"
Seeing this young man, Lin Yi couldn’t help but ask.
"You still dare to play dumb with me!" The young man glared fiercely at Lin Yi and said, "Our Lin Family has had major events these days, and you still had the leisure to comprehend Sword Intent? I really don’t know what you are thinking."
"What did I comprehend?" Lin Yi asked, somewhat bewildered.
"You didn’t comprehend the Sky-reaching Ancient Tree or the Sky-reaching Ancient Wood but that Innate Pill! Do you even know what that Innate Pill represents?"
The young man stared at Lin Yi and said.
Hearing this, Lin Yi was taken aback.
"Do you mean, that Innate Pill can enhance the Martial King Realm?"
"Of course!" The young man nodded.
"But you wasted such a precious item; you really are too wasteful!"
The young man shook his head, showing a disappointed look, and said.
"That powerful?"
Lin Yi was startled when he heard the news.
This Innate Pill was incredibly precious to him.
After all, his father, Lin Xiaotian, was a peak Martial Sovereign, just one step away from becoming a Martial Emperor!
Lin Yi, currently at the Martial King Realm, if he took this Innate Pill, might just leap into the Martial Emperor Realm in one fell swoop!
Lin Yi couldn’t contain his excitement.
He knew that this was truly a great opportunity.
"Uncle, what exactly is this Innate Pill? Can you tell me more about it?" Lin Yi asked, looking at Lin Xuan.
"This Innate Pill, being a medicinal Elixir, is used by beings at the Martial Emperor Realm. Usually, only those below the Martial Emperor Realm are qualified to consume it!"
"This Innate Pill can allow one to instantaneously break through to the Innate Realm, and not only that, but it can also transform the very foundation of a person!"
"Transform the very foundation!"
Lin Yi’s eyes widened in disbelief as he looked at the Innate Pill.
Transforming the very foundation was something Lin Yi had only heard of in rumors.
Moreover, transforming the very foundation was not merely a breakthrough in Realm, but rather a breakthrough on a whole different level, and that was an exceedingly arduous task.
Thus, Lin Yi couldn’t begin to imagine his body transforming into an entirely different state!
"This is a once-in-a-millennium opportunity! If you consume this pill, I believe you’ll quickly break through to Martial Monarch! By then, even if you were a Martial King from birth, you could still make a name for yourself in the Lin Family!" Lin Xuan said excitedly.
Lin Xuan, as Lin Yi’s uncle, had high hopes for him and wanted him to be the future heir of the Lin Family!
Thus, Lin Xuan was determined to seize this Innate Pill!
After listening to Lin Xuan’s words, Lin Yi pondered for a moment.
"Alright!"
"If that’s the case, I’ll consume this pill!"
"Uncle, prepare a room for me, I’ll take it right away!"
"You this child... don’t you know how to be modest..."
Lin Xuan said helplessly, then left.
As he left, Lin Yi sat cross-legged on the bed and picked up the Innate Pill.
Lin Yi took the Innate Pill and swallowed it in one gulp.
As soon as the Innate Pill entered his stomach, it immediately transformed into a scorching medicinal fluid, swirling around in his Dantian.
Within the Dantian, the Innate Pill radiated dazzling light, like a sun, emitting a warm aura!
Meanwhile, the Innate Pill trembled continuously!
As if it could explode at any moment!
"What...what’s going on?"
Lin Yi was confused.
He felt as if the blood in his veins was boiling, and a surging power seemed ready to break through its confines and erupt!
"Not good!"
Lin Yi was terrified and quickly mobilized his True Yuan.
"Boom boom boom!"
"Boom!"
The Innate Pill, like a Flood Dragon, rampaged through his body, causing a thunderous noise.
"Ah ah ah ah!!!"
A terrifyingly intense pain swept over his entire body, making Lin Yi scream in agony.
Lin Yi felt as if every piece of muscle and every drop of blood in his body was being scorched by fiery flames.
"No! What’s happening, aren’t I a Martial King? Why am I feeling like this!?"
Lin Yi gritted his teeth, while frantically circulating his True Yuan to resist the excruciating pain, he also wondered.
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
...
The Innate Pill wreaked havoc in the Dantian, spurring countless storms!
Lin Yi felt as if his body was about to split apart!

chapters.title: Chapter 849 - 869: Find a Way to Stop
chapters.content:
Chapter 849: Chapter 869: Find a Way to Stop
"No! This can’t go on! I absolutely can’t let this continue!"
"I must find a way to stop it! Otherwise, when I completely explode, my physical body will surely be torn apart!"
Lin Yi gritted his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead as he muttered internally.
"My Innate Spiritual Body!"
Lin Yi’s eyes snapped open, his gaze sharp and piercing. He reached out and summoned a Spiritual Treasure!
"Suppress for me!" Lin Yi roared.
The next moment, the Spiritual Treasure burst with endless spiritual essence.
This treasure was a light blue throughout, clearly indicating its very high quality.
"Boom!" The Spiritual Treasure flew out, hovering above Lin Yi’s head, and unleashed unparalleled might!
Such might seemed determined to shatter the heavens!
Seeing the Spiritual Treasure, Lin Yi immediately revealed a hint of a smile.
This Spiritual Treasure was something he had obtained from a Monster Beast long ago.
At that time, the Monster Beast was weak, and Lin Yi had killed it and taken its Crystal Core.
Afterward, Lin Yi had also used this Monster Beast’s Crystal Core to cultivate for several years, his strength improving by leaps and bounds!
"Spiritual Treasure? This is a Spiritual Treasure!"
"I never thought I’d be fortunate enough to obtain a Spiritual Treasure!"
"If I can get this Spiritual Treasure, it will be a blessing for me!" Lin Yi said, unable to contain his ecstatic joy as he looked at the floating Spiritual Treasure radiating infinite might.
This Spiritual Treasure was an Innate Spiritual Treasure, possessing Spiritual Wisdom, and could help Martial Artists enhance their Combat Power—how heaven-defying was that?
Moreover, Lin Yi believed, if he could successfully refine this Innate Spiritual Treasure, it would transform qualitatively, and its power would increase several times over!
And the might of this Spiritual Treasure was so great it could even compare to attacks at the Martial Emperor Level!
What an incredibly heaven-defying existence!
Lin Yi’s heart surged with wild joy!
Moreover, at present, he was already at the peak of the Ninefold Heaven at the Martial Venerable Realm, just a hair’s breadth away from becoming a Martial King!
Once he advanced to Martial King, how formidable would he be?
"Haha, I’m about to break through!" Lin Yi yelled to the sky, his voice filled with ecstasy and excitement.
The next second, Lin Yi sat cross-legged on the bed and began to absorb the Innate Pill!
The Innate Pill, once ingested, transformed into a surge of pure Spiritual Power that rampaged through his body.
He also began to frantically operate the Innate Technique.
The Innate Technique, a supreme secret scripture created by a Martial Emperor!
Practicing the Innate Technique came with tremendous benefits!
No matter the injury, Realm, or Cultivation, one could easily recover!
And Lin Yi had now also fallen into deep cultivation.
In this world, there were countless geniuses, but those with the highest innate talents were few.
And the Innate Technique was one of them.
This technique, when cultivated, worked wonders, many times better than other Cultivation Techniques!
Therefore, while Lin Yi was cultivating, his form became gradually indistinct.
The Innate Pill within him was spinning rapidly, gradually digesting the Medicinal Effects of the Innate Pill inside him!
"Crack!" Suddenly, Lin Yi felt the bones inside his body making crisp sounds, followed by rapid mutation of his skeleton.
Originally, Lin Yi’s body was very sturdy, but with the bone mutation, his body began to expand, grow thicker and larger...
"Thump! Thump! Thump..." A series of dull sounds emanated from under Lin Yi’s skin, making anyone who heard them instinctively shudder!
Lin Yi felt his body seemed to be slowly transforming!
Moreover, he felt his muscles becoming harder.
"Crack!" Finally, Lin Yi sensed a bit of discomfort, and then, his muscles split open with crack after crack, and bright red blood started flowing out incessantly!
"Ah!"
Lin Yi let out a scream of agony, and then, his entire body looked as though it had been pierced through!
"Pfft!"
A large mouthful of vital blood spurted out, and the Qi-Blood within Lin Yi’s body rapidly dissipated.
In an instant, he had become a corpse.
"Rumble..."
Just as Lin Yi died, a massive bolt of lightning streaked across the night sky from above!
That lightning, as if tangible, seemed determined to pierce through the void!
Within the lightning was an incredibly terrifying pressure!
"Crackle and pop!"
"Crackle and pop!"
"..."
These lightning bolts, like bullets, rained down on Lin Yi.
"Boom!"
Lin Yi’s corpse was directly blasted into ruins, and then, struck by another bolt of lightning.
This bolt of lightning, immensely powerful, instantly cleaved Lin Yi’s body in two, turning it to ashes.
"Boom!"
Meanwhile, on the other side, a dense dark fog burst forth from the void!
The bolts of lightning, as if carrying the laws of the Heavenly Dao, descended directly, striking toward the dark fog!
The dark fog instantly transformed into a wisp of smoke, escaping towards the distance.
This fog was none other than Lin Yi himself!
"Damn it, to think that a Spiritual Treasure would appear, and land me in such a predicament, how am I going to dodge this disaster now?"
Lin Yi looked bitterly towards the distant void, endlessly regretful in his thoughts.
Lin Yi had not anticipated that he would encounter such a disaster!
Moreover, it was an extremely ominous sign!
Lin Yi had just progressed to a higher realm, without having mastered the new power; he dared not act rashly.
So he could only avoid the brunt for the time being.
But he never anticipated that the Spiritual Treasure would be so domineering, forcing him into such a sorry state!
"This Spiritual Treasure is too dangerous, it must be destroyed immediately!"
Lin Yi squinted his eyes, and immediately began to investigate the treasure.
But the Spiritual Treasure was extraordinary and mysterious, and not something a common person could investigate; only a Martial Saint had the opportunity to trace its origins.
"Damn it, what exactly is it?"
"Why does it feel even more formidable than those Holy Emperor weapons?"
Lin Yi frowned and pondered, but he could still not understand.
However, he couldn’t worry about that now and had to quickly find a safe place to reconsider his options.
And this Spiritual Treasure, indeed, caused a great shock within Lin Yi’s heart.
After sensing for a while, he astonishingly discovered that the Spiritual Treasure had no aura!
This Spiritual Treasure, just like a clump of dark soil, looked very ordinary.
But paradoxically, it was so overbearing that even a Martial Saint as formidable as himself was powerless against it.
"Hoo~"
"This Spiritual Treasure really is miraculous, hidden so deeply!"
"I wonder if there’s a drop of vital blood inside this Spiritual Treasure?"
"Perhaps there is; after all, that Spiritual Treasure is too powerful. If I consumed that vital blood, I could definitely break through to the Holy Emperor Realm!"
Lin Yi speculated secretly.
"I wonder what grade this Spiritual Treasure is!"
"If it’s a Holy Emperor Realm Spiritual Treasure, then I’ve struck it rich. Then, even when facing those old monsters at the Holy Emperor Realm, I would be confident to compete with them!"
"However, although this Spiritual Treasure is very powerful, it consumes spirit, vitality, and mind heavily. If I were to absorb the essence within this Spiritual Treasure, I fear I wouldn’t be able to sustain it for long!"
"Just how much is this Spiritual Treasure worth?"
Lin Yi sighed inwardly.
Although he possessed a Spiritual Treasure, and such a formidable one at that, just a drop of vital blood could allow a Martial Saint-level cultivator to break through a major threshold. This was simply an enormous fortune!

chapters.title: Chapter 850 - 870: The Goal of the Spiritual Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 850: Chapter 870: The Goal of the Spiritual Treasure
But now, with his body shattered, he could only watch helplessly. He would remember this debt.
"Whoosh!"
Suddenly, a streak of light surged toward Lin Yi’s Primordial Spirit.
"Eh, this Spiritual Treasure actually wants to seize my Primordial Spirit?!"
Lin Yi was immediately panicked; he had witnessed the power of this Spiritual Treasure, a force that could absolutely destroy the Primordial Spirit of a Martial Saint-level fighter!
And now, the target of that Spiritual Treasure was his Primordial Spirit!
"No!"
Lin Yi’s face filled with terror. He shouted urgently while frantically waving his arms to deflect the streak of light, then he quickly fled into the distance.
The Spiritual Treasure also stopped in the distance and then transformed into a human form.
A middle-aged man dressed in green clothes.
The man appeared to be in his forties, with handsome features, and his green robe gave him an exceptionally dashing appearance.
He held a folding fan in his right hand and wore a faint smile on his lips, displaying an elegant and lofty demeanor.
"Who are you? How did you get into my Primordial Spirit?"
Lin Yi stared at the middle-aged man and asked.
This man was actually Lin Yi’s Primordial Spirit.
"Heh heh, boy, I am your father. How dare you impersonate me?"
The man in green chuckled coldly.
"Father?!"
Lin Yi, upon hearing this, was instantly dumbfounded, his expression becoming somewhat strange. He could never have imagined that the man in green before him would be his father.
"You... are you really my father?"
Lin Yi’s complexion changed slightly, then he regarded the man in green with a mix of shock and uncertainty.
"Of course. If I weren’t your father, how could I have such a useless son like you? Moreover, I am the successor personally appointed by your dear father. Not only do you not respect me, but you even impersonate me. Truly a filial son!"
The man in green looked at Lin Yi with a dark expression, scolding him.
"So, it is like that. Thank you very much, indeed you picked me up."
Lin Yi nodded his head, then turned away, preparing to leave.
"Wait a minute, you stop right there!"
The man in green suddenly spoke.
"What, do you want to continue the fight?"
Lin Yi snorted coldly.
"Humph, you unfilial son, since you impersonate my son, you must bear the consequences!"
"I am the most powerful being in the Nine Heavens Holy Domain. If you wish to seek vengeance, go ahead!"
The man in green gave Lin Yi a cold look and said disdainfully, "My strength is a hundred, no, a thousand times greater than yours. Do you really think you can oppose me with your pathetic strength?!"
"Oh?"
Lin Yi raised an eyebrow. He had not anticipated that this man before him would possess such terrifying combat power; he had indeed underestimated him.
"Since it’s like that, this father will let you see just how formidable I am!"
While speaking, the man in green took a step and disappeared from Lin Yi’s field of vision. Then, with a flip of his hand, a long spear appeared in his grasp!
The spear was entirely red, and at its head was a red Flood Dragon!
The Flood Dragon was incredibly lifelike as if it even understood human speech!
That was none other than the Nine Heavens Holy King Spear!
The Nine Heavens Holy King Spear was a holy weapon personally forged by the Nine Heavens Holy King himself, with boundless power!
Furthermore, the Nine Heavens Holy King had infused it with the force of the Nine Heavens Holy King Seal!
This spear could wield the power of the Nine Heavens Holy King Seal!
"Youngster, today, I, your father, will send you straight to Hell!"
The man in green, holding the Nine Heavens Holy King Spear, declared arrogantly.
With the spear in his hand, he looked even more perfect!
"Is that so? Then let’s see how many times you can kill me!"
Lin Yi, unwilling to show weakness, also wielded the Nine Heavens Holy King Spear, meeting the challenge head-on.
Boom!
Suddenly, the sound of thunderous roars echoed between heaven and earth.
Two beams of light collided, causing the entire land to shake and crack.
"Hmm? He can actually withstand my attack. This kid’s strength isn’t bad. He’s not much worse than me!"
The man in green expressed his surprise.
"Hmph, it’s just luck, nothing more. If I were to make a move myself, even if you were hundreds of times more powerful, you’d still be no match for a single strike!"
The man in green said arrogantly.
"Is that so? Then make your move!"
Lin Yi’s eyes were ice-cold as he stared at the man in green, speaking indifferently.
"Fine! Just you wait!"
The man in green snorted coldly, and in an instant, his figure moved again, the long spear in his hand turning into dozens of afterimages, densely stabbing towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s expression changed slightly, and he immediately displayed the "Chaotic Devil Technique," forming a ring of golden-yellow light around him.
"Ting ting ting ting!"
The long spear struck the defense barrier Lin Yi had set up, emitting a series of crisp sounds as sparks flew, producing dazzling flashes of light.
"Haha! Your cultivation technique might be powerful, but it hasn’t reached the Heavenly Holy level. You’re no match for me!"
"If you think you can contend with me, you’re gravely mistaken. However, if you beg for mercy, I might consider sparing you!"
The man in green laughed aloud.
"Hmph! If you can kill me, I’ll kneel before you!"
Lin Yi snorted coldly.
"Kneel?"
The man in green was taken aback, his face darkening, "I, a mighty Holy King powerhouse, kneel before a nobody like you? Never!"
"So, what will it take for you to spare me?"
Lin Yi asked coldly.
"My demand is simple, kneel here and knock your head on the ground three times."
"Then, I will give you a superior Holy King artifact, making you the foremost under the Holy Kings!"
The man in green spoke indifferently.
"Hahahaha!"
Lin Yi laughed heartily, "Do you really think that just because you are a Holy King, I am an ant? What of a Holy King? Do you dare to kill me? If you dare, your end will be extremely miserable!"
Lin Yi sneered.
"You are so insolent!"
The man in green’s face turned angry, and the long spear in his hand burst forth with brilliant spear light, like swords, shooting instantaneously at Lin Yi.
"Hmph!"
Lin Yi threw a punch, directly hitting the tip of the spear.
"Bang!"
The punch collapsed, but the spear light was unharmed and continued to pierce through.
Lin Yi’s face changed as he swiftly retreated backward.
"You insignificant brat, I already gave you a chance, but you failed to grasp it. Now, I’m going to chop off your head and offer it to the spirit of the Nine Heavens Holy King!"
The man in green snorted coldly, then, his figure flashed, grasping the Nine Heavens Holy King Spear, he turned into a blur, lunging at Lin Yi once more.
"Get lost!"
Lin Yi bellowed, an immense aura bursting forth from his body.
A terrifying force erupted from within Lin Yi, as if a primordial beast was awakening, an oppressive weight that was suffocating, sending shivers through the soul.
Lin Yi’s body also rapidly swelled in size.
In the blink of an eye, he grew nearly five meters taller, towering like a giant tree, eclipsing the sky.
A tremendous aura burst from Lin Yi, his oppressive force growing exponentially stronger than before!
It was the pressure from Lin Yi’s Qi-Blood power breaking through to the verge of the Saint Realm!
"How is this possible? You’re only sixteen or seventeen years old, and you’ve broken through! What kind of monstrous cultivation technique have you been practicing to have advanced to the peak of half-step Saint Realm so quickly?"
The man in green’s face was filled with shock, a deep and profound wariness emerging in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 851 - 871: Not Worth Mentioning at All!
chapters.content:
Chapter 851: Chapter 871: Not Worth Mentioning at All!
"Hmph!"
Lin Yi snorted coldly, his eyes slightly closed as the Qi-Blood in his body crazily surged into the Nine Heavens Holy King Spear in his hands!
"Break for me!"
Then, Lin Yi barked out an order.
A formidable energy traveled from the Nine Heavens Holy King Spear into Lin Yi’s body.
Boom!
An astonishing energy burst forth from Lin Yi’s arms like terrifying Wind Blades, carrying the sharp sound of tearing through the air as they charged straight at the man in the green robe.
"Damn it! This brat’s Physical Body Power has actually increased so much!"
The facial expression of the man in the green robe suddenly changed drastically, then, his aura became incredibly solemn.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
The next moment, the spear erupted with beam after beam of exceedingly sharp spear radiance, slashing fiercely at the Wind Blades.
"Ptui..."
When the spear radiance collided with the Wind Blades, they shattered into pieces.
"You little bastard, do you think that just because you’ve broken through to the half-step Saint Realm, you’re qualified to confront me directly? Let me tell you, my Combat Power has already surpassed the Holy King Level, you’re simply not worth mentioning in front of me!" the man in the green robe shouted.
"Is that so?"
Lin Yi’s mouth curled into a cold sneer, "Since that’s the case, let’s see who’s better!"
With those words, Lin Yi lightly tapped with the tip of his foot, and his body quickly lunged forward.
The moment Lin Yi made his move, he concentrated all the Qi-Blood in his body to the extreme, his Physical Strength also reaching an optimal state!
"Die for me!"
Lin Yi roared, his right hand lifting up to strike at the man in the green robe!
"Bang!"
The man in the green robe hurriedly swung his spear to block.
A metallic collision sounded, and then, the body of the man in the green robe was directly sent flying by Lin Yi’s blow.
Puh!
The man in the green robe spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, his face filled with shock.
He never expected that his own Cultivation would be so feeble in front of Lin Yi.
"How, how is this possible?"
The man in the green robe looked incredulous.
"Nothing is impossible, as I see it, you are just so-so, nothing to be concerned about," Lin Yi said with a faint smile.
"Impossible, this is absolutely impossible, how can a mere half-step into the Saint Realm have such Combat Power? This is impossible!" the man in the green robe said, a dazed expression on his face, unable to believe his own eyes.
"Die for me!"
Lin Yi exclaimed coldly, rushing toward the man in the green robe again, stabbing out once more with his spear.
"Boom!"
The man in the green robe’s body was sent flying again.
"No!"
The man in the green robe’s complexion changed dramatically.
Lin Yi was simply too fast; he couldn’t even react in time.
"You’re going to die for me!"
Lin Yi barked, a terrifying momentum bursting from his body.
"Don’t kill me, I am the reincarnation of the Nine Heavens Holy King, his most loyal servant. If you kill me, you won’t survive either!" the man in the green robe exclaimed in terror.
"Nine Heavens Holy King? Who is that?" Lin Yi asked, raising an eyebrow coldly.
"The Nine Heavens Holy King is a powerhouse of the Holy King Realm! Moreover, he’s the senior disciple of the Nine Heavens Divine Mountain, ranked number one within the Holy King Realm!" the man in the green robe explained.
"So it is!"
Lin Yi sighed lightly.
So, that legendary Nine Heavens Holy King indeed existed.
Lin Yi’s shock was unimaginable.
That so-called Holy King was actually the first man below the Holy King!
Such strength was truly terrifying.
"If you spare me, once the Nine Heavens Holy King emerges from seclusion, he will surely spare your life; otherwise, you will undoubtedly die!" the man in green robes urgently said.
Although he was not afraid of Lin Yi, in front of the Nine Heavens Holy King, he did not dare to act rashly.
After all, he was merely a martial artist at the early stage of the Holy King level.
"Spare you?"
Lin Yi stared at him coldly, "You’re such trash that killing you would dirty my blade."
Lin Yi smiled coldly, and a terrifying Qi Force burst forth from the palm of his hand, slamming fiercely into the man in green robes.
"Pu!"
The Qi Force pierced straight through the chest of the man in green robes.
The man’s eyes widened, filled with fear and regret, but he ultimately did not utter a single word as death enveloped his body, causing his complete demise!
"Die!"
Lin Yi murmured softly.
Afterward, Lin Yi retracted all of his aura and slowly walked to the side, where he sat down cross-legged.
"I won’t make the same mistake again, I won’t underestimate my opponents anymore!"
Lin Yi murmured softly, his eyes twinkling with determination.
One night passed in the blink of an eye.
The morning sun shone upon the forest.
Lin Yi’s eyelids twitched slightly as he opened his eyes.
"Where is this?"
Lin Yi glanced around and, finding his surroundings unfamiliar, could not help but ask.
"This is Nine Heavens City; to reach Nine Heavens City from here, it only takes the time it takes for a stick of incense to burn."
Just then, a pleasant woman’s voice rang out, and right after, a beautiful woman in white appeared beside Lin Yi, her face adorned with a gentle smile.
This woman in white was none other than the mysterious woman in white Lin Yi had seen on the road.
"This is Nine Heavens City, so I’ve encountered her here? But... why is she here?"
Lin Yi’s brow furrowed as he looked at the woman in white.
The woman in white was the mysterious woman in white!
"Young master, have you heard of Holy King Hall?" the woman in white asked Lin Yi with a smile.
"Hmm? Why do you ask?" Lin Yi frowned and inquired.
"Holy King Hall is among the most mysterious forces in all the Myriad Realms of the Heavens. It’s said that within Holy King Hall, there are hundreds of martial artists at the Saint Realm and even dozens at the Heavenly Emperor realm, including the first disciple of the Nine Heavens Divine Mountain, the Nine Heavens Holy King!" the woman in white said slowly.
"Oh? The Nine Heavens Holy King? He’s a disciple of the Nine Heavens Holy King?" Lin Yi’s eyebrows raised slightly at the mention.
Sure enough, as a mysterious force, its strength was indeed formidable.
Martial artists at the Holy King Realm were among the top powerhouses in the entire Divine Domain.
"Yes, young master, I’ve heard that there are many treasures within Holy King Hall, and if you are lucky, you might even gain the favor of a Holy King and become his disciple!" the woman in white continued.
"Treasures? There are treasures in Holy King Hall?"
Lin Yi’s eyes immediately lit up.
"Yes, young master, it happens to be a fortunate coincidence that you can enter Holy King Hall, for every five hundred years, the Nine Heavens Holy King holds a trial. By passing the trial, you can enter Holy King Hall! Moreover, various treasures within Holy King Hall can be exchanged for Cultivation Techniques or Elixirs, and if you gain the approval of the Holy King, you can obtain some of these treasures!" the woman in white explained.
"Holy King Hall? It seems I really have to give it a try today!" Lin Yi’s gaze flickered as he pondered to himself.
He had already intended to seek mentorship under the Nine Heavens Holy King.
Now, hearing that treasures could be obtained, how could he not be tempted?
However, he did not immediately agree to the woman in white.
"As for this trial, I’ll trouble the young lady with it!" Lin Yi said to the woman in white, giving a polite bow.

chapters.title: Chapter 852 - 872: Some Worries
chapters.content:
Chapter 852: Chapter 872: Some Worries
He still harbored some concerns in his heart.
This Holy King Hall, although he did not know its exact location, he did know that it was extremely dangerous.
"Don’t worry, since I dare to take you to the Holy King Hall, I can certainly ensure your safety," said the woman in white with a smile.
"Alright, I trust you. Then let’s hurry on our way."
Lin Yi nodded and immediately stood up, following the woman in white as they hurried towards the Holy King Hall.
"By the way, miss, may I ask your name? I would like to thank you properly."
Lin Yi suddenly thought of something and asked.
The woman in white smiled charmingly, "My name is Su Ya’er. The people of Nine Hevens City call me Mrs. Su Ya. Young master, you may call me Sister Ya’er."
"Then I shall call you Sister Ya’er!"
"And you may call me Sister Su Ya in the future!"
Soon, the two of them had walked out of the woods.
As he walked, Lin Yi found that the environment here was quite beautiful, with the singing of birds and the fragrance of flowers making him feel very comfortable.
"Lin Yi brother, I live right next door to you. Feel free to come and visit whenever you’re free," Su Ya’er said to Lin Yi with a smile.
"Lin Yi brother?"
Lin Yi was slightly startled.
He found that the name Su Ya’er seemed much more intimate than that of ’woman in white.’
"Mhm!"
Su Ya’er nodded her head.
"Then, I’ll take my leave and trouble Sister Ya’er," said Lin Yi as he clasped his hands and turned to leave.
Watching his receding figure, a brilliant light flickered in Su Ya’er’s eyes.
"Is that Lin Yi?"
Su Ya’er bit her lip, her cheeks flushed with a touch of rosy color.
After leaving the small village, Lin Yi swiftly swept towards another mountain range.
The environment here was extremely beautiful, but within this territory, there were many powerful creatures.
Therefore, Lin Yi couldn’t fly at all; the only way was to travel on foot.
The laws of the great road here were very peculiar, as if there was an invisible thread linking everything, restricting Lin Yi’s cultivation.
The Heaven-Earth Vital Energy here was very rich, even richer than that of Nine Heavens City.
By absorbing the Heaven-Earth Vital Energy here, not only could Lin Yi increase his speed, but he could also comprehend the mysteries of the Heavenly Dao, which filled him with surprises.
"Lin Yi brother, it’s been half a month since you left. When do you plan to return?"
After Lin Yi had left, Su Ya’er came to the small cottage where he had been staying before.
Now, it was utterly silent.
"Lin Yi brother must have already left, right?"
Su Ya’er let out a slight sigh.
"However, I’m quite looking forward to the two of you meeting. When that time comes, I will certainly tell him everything I know."
Su Ya’er said to herself with a smile.
...
Three days later.
On a majestic mountain within the Holy King mountain range.
Currently, at the waist of the mountain, there was a huge stone gate.
This stone gate was a hundred feet tall and emitted a hazy radiance, appearing exceptionally sacred.
Standing before that stone gate were four people.
These four individuals were all tall and burly, dressed in golden armor with an overbearing aura exuding from them; their whole bodies radiated majesty, commanding respect without anger!
The four people standing there seemed like four behemoths, awe-inspiring and intimidating!
"Lin Yi!"
Suddenly, a voice rang out, breaking the silence.
"Swoosh!"
A shadow sped over from a distance.
"It’s Brother Lin Yi!"
Instantly, the four recognized Lin Yi approaching.
As soon as Lin Yi stepped through the mountain gate, their gazes fixed upon him.
"Haha, I didn’t expect we would meet again so soon!"
An old woman looked at Lin Yi, her eyes smiling as she spoke.
"Brother Lin Yi, this is the Fourth Elder of the Nine Heavens Divine Sect, Zhao Deming,"
explained a young man standing by.
"I’ve seen the Elders!"
Lin Yi bowed slightly.
"Haha, no need for such formalities, we dare not accept your grand gesture!"
Zhao Deming laughed heartily.
"Lin Yi, we’ve come to ask you about something. Do you know of a temple within the Holy King Hall called the Holy King Hall?"
Zhao Deming asked, looking at Lin Yi.
"Holy King Hall? Is there a Holy King Hall here?"
Lin Yi asked, perplexed.
"Yes, there is indeed a Holy King Hall here, and it’s a very mysterious one at that,"
added a young man standing next to them.
"I’ve never heard of this Holy King Hall!"
Lin Yi shook his head.
"Brother Lin Yi, are you truly unaware of the Holy King Hall?"
Zhao Deming raised his eyebrows slightly and probed further.
"Indeed, I do not know!"
Lin Yi nodded.
"Then do you remember the white-robed beautiful woman named Su Ya’er we met the second time we came here?"
Zhao Deming inquired.
"Oh, are you referring to that beautiful woman in white? That was when Su Ya and I had just arrived here, and we were chased by a group of ferocious demonic apes. We almost died!"
Lin Yi recalled Su Ya’er with a hint of embarrassment on his face.
It was his first time being in contact with a girl alone, but compared to other young women, Su Ya’er’s personality was quite different and refreshingly so.
"I see!"
"Then do you know what secrets are hidden within this Holy King Hall?"
Zhao Deming continued to question.
"I must confess to you all, I do not know,"
Liny Yi shook his head and replied.
It was his first time in Nine Heavens City, and he hadn’t paid much attention to the affairs of the city.
However, Su Ya’er had a deep connection with Nine Heavens City, which is why she might be aware of the secrets hidden within the Holy King Hall.
"Since Brother Lin Yi is not aware, we can’t force the matter, but you better return soon because we plan to head to the Nine Heavens Divine Palace!"
Zhao Deming pondered and then said.
"The Nine Heavens Divine Palace?"
"Could it be that the Holy King Hall hides the heritage items of the Nine Heavens Divine Monarch?"
Lin Yi’s eyes brightened as he thought to himself.
"Indeed, it is the heritage items of the Nine Heavens Divine Monarch! Our goal for this trip is to find the heritage items left behind by the Divine Monarch!"
Zhao Deming nodded.
"In that case, I shall take my leave!"
Lin Yi said as he clasped his hands.
"Wait, Brother Lin Yi, the Token of the Holy King of our Nine Heavens Sacred Sect is the token of the lord of Nine Heavens City. As long as you hold this Token, you can go straight to the Holy King Hall!"
Zhao Deming looked at Lin Yi and said with a smile.
"Then I thank the Elders for informing me of this news!"
Lin Yi said, clasping his hands.
"It’s the least we can do. If Brother Lin Yi is interested, you’re welcome to come and see us. We old folks can also tell you about Nine Heavens City,"
Zhao Deming offered.
"Great! I will definitely visit the Elders!"
Lin Yi nodded.
Following that, Zhao Deming, along with the other three, returned to Nine Heavens City.
Watching their retreating figures, Lin Yi smiled faintly and then stepped towards the Holy King Hall.
"Holy King Hall!"
Lin Yi looked up, gazing at the plaque of the Holy King Hall.
"I wonder what secrets are hidden in this place,"
he murmured to himself.
Lin Yi slowly walked towards the Holy King Hall, guessing at the secrets it might hold.

chapters.title: Chapter 853 - 873: A Splendid Golden Radiance
chapters.content:
Chapter 853: Chapter 873: A Splendid Golden Radiance
Before long, Lin Yi arrived at the entrance of the Holy King Hall.
Lin Yi took out the Saint King Order and sure enough, it was the Saint King Order from Nine Heavens City.
At this moment, he didn’t hesitate and pushed the door open to enter the hall.
Inside the hall, everything was resplendent with gold and jade, and the walls were carved with various lifelike paintings.
In the center of the hall, there was a table made of purple sandalwood, laden with Spiritual Tea, Spirit Fruits, and Spiritual Wine.
At that time, Lin Yi saw an elder leisurely brewing tea.
"Brother Lin Yi, you’ve arrived, please have a seat quickly!" Zhao Deming greeted Lin Yi as soon as he saw him.
"Thank you, Elder Zhao!" Lin Yi said, cupping his fists in salute.
"Brother Lin Yi, I heard you have successfully broken through to the Martial Sovereign Realm?" Zhao Deming looked at Lin Yi and asked.
"Um, it was just luck!" Lin Yi nodded.
"Brother Lin Yi, your performance in this Holy King Hall is truly astonishing!" "However, even though you have now advanced to Martial Sovereign, you are still a Martial King, and if you encounter a Holy Lord, you simply won’t be able to withstand them!" Zhao Deming shook his head.
"Heh, I’m well aware of my own strength, but my enemies are the leaders of the Nine Great Holy Nations, their Holy Lords are all emperor-level powerhouses, and I am but a mere peak-level Martial Sovereign. Besides myself, all I can rely on now is this Saint King Order!" Lin Yi said with a bitter smile.
"Brother Lin Yi, if you find yourself in danger, don’t hesitate to come to our Nine Heavens Sacred Sect. Even though we don’t have any Holy Lord powerhouses here, we do have many emperors, each one a peerless powerhouse. United, they could even stand against a Holy Lord!" Zhao Deming suggested.
"That won’t be necessary. My goal is those at the Holy Monarch Level, as for the Holy Lords..." "They are indeed my goal, but my aim is solely the Holy King Hall. If the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect truly wishes to help me, I will certainly remember the kindness!" Lin Yi replied.
"Good, with this word from Brother Lin Yi, our Nine Heavens Sacred Sect will surely support you with all our might!" Zhao Deming laughed loudly and said heartily.
Lin Yi and Zhao Deming chatted for a while before Lin Yi took his leave.
After leaving the Holy King Hall, Lin Yi went directly back to the courtyard where he was staying.
Inside the courtyard, there was a huge rock with two powerful characters inscribed on it: Holy King Mansion! "Holy King Mansion?" Lin Yi frowned slightly at the three characters on the stele.
"It seems that the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect really has placed the treasure of the Nine Heavens Divine Monarch inside the Holy King Mansion!" "But what exactly is inside?" "How could the treasure of the Nine Heavens Divine Monarch be simple?" Lin Yi pondered to himself.
"Well, since I’m free now, I might as well raise my cultivation to the peak of the Martial King Realm!" Lin Yi muttered to himself.
Following that, Lin Yi began his closed-door cultivation.
....
Elsewhere.
At this moment, not far from where Lin Yi was, atop a tall building.
"Holy Lord, that kid named Lin Yi actually refused to join our Nine Heavens Sacred Sect. He really doesn’t know what’s good for him. If it weren’t for the Holy Lord’s orders, we would have already killed this ignorant brat!" outside the Holy King Hall, the guards, upon seeing Lin Yi refuse to join the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect, were immediately infuriated, cursing angrily.
"Hmph, a mere junior dares to defy the orders of the Holy Lord, he’s really tired of living!" "Indeed, I’m actually quite looking forward to the scene of him being slain by the Holy Lord!"
"...."
The people of the Holy King Hall all sneered and jeered.
Not long after, Lin Yi completed his retreat, and when he emerged, his stature had grown even taller.
"Holy King Token...."
Lin Yi held the Holy King Token in his hand, murmuring to himself.
"I hope the elders of the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect will keep their word; otherwise, I will certainly not let them off easily!"
Lin Yi clenched his fist and let out a low shout.
"Alright, since our plan is complete, it’s time for us to retreat!"
A powerful figure from the Holy King Hall glanced at Lin Yi, then spoke up.
"Yes!"
The other powerhouses from the Holy King Hall nodded respectfully in response.
Immediately afterward, streaks of light shot up into the sky and in the blink of an eye, they had flown up to the clouds.
"Leaving just like that? How boring!"
Lin Yi watched the direction in which the group had disappeared, the corners of his mouth curling into a cold arc.
"My cultivation has already broken through to the early stage of the Martial Sovereign Realm. In a few more years, I should reach the intermediate stage. By then, even if I encounter a Martial Venerable powerhouse, I will have the power to defend myself!"
Lin Yi’s eyes flickered with a sharp glint.
....
Five days passed by in this manner.
During this period, Lin Yi visited the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect almost every day to discuss with Zhao Deming, hoping for their assistance.
Over these five days, Lin Yi also witnessed the depths of the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect’s foundation.
It was a force even more vast than the Holy King Hall, with almost every corner of Nine Heavens City housing a branch of the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect.
These branch members were all Holy Venerable powerhouses, each with an aura that was unfathomably deep; even Lin Yi felt a hint of oppression!
However, fortunately for him, the attitude of these branch members toward Lin Yi was not very friendly.
In their eyes, this youth’s potential was far too inadequate, hardly worthy of the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect’s inheritance, let alone being a Direct Disciple of a Holy King!
Therefore, their treatment of Lin Yi was indifferent.
However, none of this mattered to Lin Yi.
In his view, he just needed to reach the peak of Martial King Realm as soon as possible. After that, he could make use of the Nine Heavens Divine Monarch’s treasure and proceed to the Sacred Mountain of the Nine Heavens!
Lin Yi radiated a fierce killing intent, enveloping the entire Holy King Hall in a chill.
"Junior Brother Lin Yi, have you come to the Holy King Hall today to inquire about reaching the peak of the Holy Monarch Realm?"
At this moment, Zhao Deming emerged from the loft.
"Yes, indeed. To my knowledge, the peak of the Martial King Realm is an ultimate Realm; yet this Martial King Realm seems to have nothing special about it. I wonder if my current situation might be a little off, needing more cultivation time!"
Lin Yi nodded and said.
"Oh, that’s easy. I will take you to the Cultivation Room; you can start your cultivation there. When you reach the peak of the Martial King Realm, I will arrange for an old friend to lead you to the Cultivation Room, and he will provide guidance then!"
"Yes!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi immediately showed a look of joy and nodded in agreement.
Afterward, Lin Yi followed in Zhao Deming’s footsteps and entered the Holy King Hall.
.....
Inside the Holy King Hall, there were four grand halls, each containing countless meditation cushions.
In front of each cushion, a Jade Token was placed, inscribed with the addresses of various branches of the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect.
Each address represented the deacon of that branch!
"These Jade Tokens are Holy King Tokens; you just need to take one and enter any branch, and you will receive a Holy King Token!"
"Moreover, unless you die at the hands of those branch deacons, they will not take action against anyone, so rest assured!"
Zhao Deming explained.
"Understood!"
Lin Yi nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 854 - 874 Personally Teaching
chapters.content:
Chapter 854: Chapter 874 Personally Teaching
"You go inside, I’ll have our old friend personally instruct you for a while, I hope you won’t disappoint me!"
Zhao Deming looked at Lin Yi and said with a smile.
"Don’t worry, I will do my best to become a core disciple of the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect in a very short time!"
Lin Yi nodded his head.
"Good, then I’ll be waiting for you in the Holy King Hall!"
Zhao Deming nodded his head with a smile.
Afterwards, Zhao Deming walked out of the attic.
"Uncle Zhao, where are you going?"
At this moment, a few slightly older disciples from the Holy King Hall hurriedly followed him.
"The Holy King has summoned me, I must rush over immediately, you guys just keep good company with Brother Lin Yi!"
Zhao Deming called out without looking back.
"Yes!"
The disciples from the Holy King Hall bowed respectfully upon hearing his words.
"Let’s go inside, Lin Yi!"
Zhao Deming patted Lin Yi’s shoulder.
"Alright, Uncle Zhao!"
Lin Yi nodded and then followed Zhao Deming into the attic.
Inside the Holy King Hall, a vast space was divided into four areas.
To the far left was the training room, to the far right was the martial arts area, and in the middle were the Scripture Pavilion and the Cultivation Room.
"The Holy King has summoned you, you mustn’t make him too anxious, I notice his attitude towards you doesn’t seem very friendly; don’t forget, among those going to the Nine Heavens Sacred Mountain this time, there are nine Holy Venerables, all of them super beings who have reached the level of Martial Emperor!"
Zhao Deming glanced at Lin Yi and said lightly.
"Don’t worry, Uncle Zhao, I understand, but I also want to try and see what the situation in the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect is really like?"
Lin Yi nodded slightly and spoke.
"Alright, just be more careful on your own, no matter what happens, remember one thing, don’t act rashly!"
Zhao Deming admonished.
Lin Yi nodded.
....
Inside the Holy King Hall.
Lin Yi sat cross-legged on a cushion, his hands forming seals, beginning to circulate the "Myriad Laws to Primordial Art."
After a moment, he opened his eyes, a frenzied look appearing on his face as he said, "Finally, I’ve finally stepped into this realm, I wonder how strong my combat power is now!"
Excitement appeared on Lin Yi’s face, and he thought to himself with great excitement.
His recent arduous training not only hadn’t made Lin Yi feel a hint of fatigue, but on the contrary, his cultivation had increased at a rapid pace.
If Lin Yi’s current cultivation was the peak of a one-star Holy King, then now, his cultivation must surely be that of a two-star Holy King, or even, a three-star Holy King!
The speed of such cultivation was terrifying!
"Phew, this feeling is really wonderful, I will go to train now, striving to reach the Holy Monarch Realm as soon as possible!"
Lin Yi stood up, his figure flickered, and he left the Cultivation Room.
"Nephew Lin Yi, this is the Cultivation Room, here you can enter a cultivation state at any time!"
Zhao Deming pointed to the huge stone door in front of him and spoke slowly.
"Thank you, Uncle Zhao!"
Lin Yi nodded his head, then immediately pushed open the door and entered.
.....
Inside the Cultivation Room.
Lin Yi looked at the huge stone door in front of him, feeling slightly shaken in his heart.
"The Formation here can actually withstand the attacks of a Holy King’s Soul!"
"No wonder Uncle-Master Zhao said that my Cultivation is weak at its foundation and unsuitable for practicing the secret techniques of a Holy Venerable. It seems that Uncle-Master Zhao has indeed been overly generous with the resources he’s bestowed upon me!"
Lin Yi thought to himself.
However, he also knew that this was his destiny. Without such heaven-defying support, how could he have possibly practiced such a heaven-defying Cultivation Technique?
Lin Yi took a deep breath and then opened the stone door.
Bang! Bang!
Suddenly, a torrential surge of energy swept over Lin Yi.
Lin Yi quickly regulated the Spiritual Power within his body, steadying his mind and beginning his cultivation practice.
In Lin Yi’s view, his Combat Power now was many times higher than when he had just broken through to the Martial Sovereign Realm!
Moreover, Lin Yi discovered something else.
The Spiritual Power here was more than ten times denser than that of Holy King City, even comparable to that of the Nine Heavens Sacred Mountain.
This also resulted in a drastic increase in Lin Yi’s cultivation efficiency!
Lin Yi remained in closed-door cultivation until the morning of the third day, when he slowly opened his eyes.
Feeling the Spiritual Power within his body at its utmost, his heart couldn’t help but soar with boldness!
"I’ve finally solidified my Cultivation completely. My Combat Power should be on par with a Holy Lord of the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect, shouldn’t it?"
Lin Yi muttered to himself, and then he left the Cultivation Room.
"Hmm? Where’s Uncle-Master Zhao?"
As he walked out of the Cultivation Room, he didn’t see Zhao Deming anywhere, which made him wonder.
Just then, Zhao Deming’s voice rang out.
"Lin Yi, my nephew, you’re out!"
Lin Yi turned around and was immediately startled to see a green-robed man appear behind him.
This man had long black hair draped loosely, and his handsome face, with its distinct features, was filled with a gentle smile, exuding a refined elegance. He looked absolutely dashing!
This green-robed man was indeed Zhao Deming.
Seeing Zhao Deming, Lin Yi immediately paid his respects: "Greetings to Uncle-Master Zhao!"
Zhao Deming spoke with a smile, "You don’t need to be so courteous. Your strength may not be on the level of those genius disciples, but it is still above average. However, in a place like the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect, everything depends on strength. If it weren’t for the protection of a powerful expert like Uncle-Master Zhao, I’m afraid I wouldn’t have had the opportunity to guide you!"
Taken aback by these words, Lin Yi quickly responded, "Uncle-Master Zhao, you are being far too modest. With your strength, I have much to look up to!"
"Haha, I dare not accept such praise. I am but an Elder. Besides, I don’t have much time to stay in the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect anyway. You need not flatter me. After all, the gap in our strength is too vast, and you needn’t belittle yourself. I only hope you can cultivate quietly in the Holy King Hall without courting trouble!"
With a faint smile, Zhao Deming finished speaking and then turned to leave the Cultivation Room.
Watching Zhao Deming’s retreating figure, Lin Yi’s lips moved slightly, but in the end, he swallowed back his words.
"Indeed, I am not yet capable of contending with Uncle-Master Zhao, but one day, I, Lin Yi, will surely surpass him!"
Lin Yi said with a determined look in his eyes.
He knew that Zhao Deming had taken him as a disciple surely because of his potential and the Cultivation resources he possessed. Without this wealth to back him up, Zhao Deming would never have taken on such a disciple.
And he himself needed these Cultivation resources!
"Lin Yi, I am now going to take you to the Cultivation Field!"
Suddenly, Zhao Deming’s voice came once again.
"Alright!"
Lin Yi nodded.
Soon, the two of them arrived at a Cultivation Field within the Nine Heavens Sacred Palace.
Zhao Deming led Lin Yi to a stone platform and then said, "Nephew Lin Yi, sit down and rest for a bit!"
"Yes!"
Lin Yi complied and then sat down on the stone platform.
Looking at Lin Yi, Zhao Deming also showed a trace of relief on his face.
After glancing at Lin Yi, Zhao Deming picked up a Jade Token and tossed it to him, "This contains my cultivation experiences for you. Also, here is a Seventh Grade Sacred Medicine that you should take when you’ve just broken through the Holy Realm!"

chapters.title: Chapter 855 - 875: Considered as Assistance!
chapters.content:
Chapter 855: Chapter 875: Considered as Assistance!
"The value of this Seventh Grade Divine Medicine is even more precious than that of a common Eighth Grade Divine Pill, but for you now, it can only be considered as an assist!"
Zhao Deming said.
"Thank you, Uncle-Master!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi immediately stood up and respectfully spoke.
"Alright, now take your time to comprehend this Cultivation Technique. I’ll be leaving first!"
Zhao Deming said.
Lin Yi nodded his head and respectfully escorted Zhao Deming out of the Cultivation Room.
After Zhao Deming left, a grave expression suddenly appeared on Lin Yi’s face.
"Seventh Grade Divine Medicine, Seventh Grade Divine Medicine! This is of Seventh Grade Spirit Grass!"
"Although I have cultivated a part of the Holy Level Martial Arts, my cultivation still remains at the level of a Seventh Rank Saint. If I take the Seventh Grade Divine Medicine, perhaps, I could leap forward to become a Sixth Rank Saint. By then, even within the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect, I would be considered among the top genius disciples!"
"However, this Seventh Grade Divine Medicine is the treasure that countless Martial Artists dream about; I still need some time to digest it!"
"Now, let’s try to cultivate it once!"
Lin Yi’s thoughts stirred, and then he took out a Jade Slip, following the steps recorded within, he allowed his Spiritual Sense to penetrate into the Jade Slip.
Buzz!
In a flash, Lin Yi felt dizzy in his head.
It felt like his entire head was being torn apart, a fierce pain.
"This pain is probably even more intense than when I was on the Jiuzhou Continent!"
Lin Yi frowned deeply.
However, the sensation lasted only a brief moment before it disappeared.
By then, Lin Yi’s face had regained its calmness. After carefully checking the Jade Slip, he immediately closed his eyes and began to operate the Qiankun Art, frenziedly absorbing the surrounding Spiritual Energy.
Hu~
Lin Yi slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air, opened his eyes, and a sharp light flowed within his pupils.
"This Qiankun Art really is an excellent Martial Art which can not only enhance the Physical Body Power but also increase the speed of cultivation!"
Lin Yi was secretly astounded in his heart.
Afterward, he sat cross-legged and began cultivating the Qiankun Art.
"Eh?"
Suddenly, a sound of amazed exclamation rang in Lin Yi’s ears.
Lin Yi abruptly raised his head, and his gaze went into the distance.
He saw a man, dressed in a white robe, appearing at the entrance of the Cultivation Field.
The man had a tall figure and was quite handsome.
On his chest, he wore a fiery red lotus pattern.
"It’s Zhao Deming!"
Seeing the man, Lin Yi’s pupils suddenly constricted.
He had never expected to encounter Zhao Deming here.
Zhao Deming was the Eldest Senior Brother of the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect and was also an admirer of the Holy Maiden of the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect.
Lin Yi had also heard from the Holy Lord that Zhao Deming truly adored the Holy Maiden immensely.
"Lin Yi!"
And at this moment, Zhao Deming noticed Lin Yi.
With a step, he reached the entrance of the Cultivation Field.
Upon seeing Lin Yi, Zhao Deming’s face showed a look of astonishment.
"Unexpectedly, we could meet here, where have you been all this time, why haven’t you even stepped out the door?"
Zhao Deming’s tone carried a bit of reproach.
Lin Yi replied with a wry smile, "Disciple has been in seclusion cultivating within the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect and never had the chance to go out!"
"Oh?"
Zhao Deming raised an eyebrow slightly and said, "You weren’t afraid to go out, were you?"
Lin Yi shook his head and said, "My cultivation is too low; how dare I venture out?"
Zhao Deming looked at Lin Yi and said with a faint smile, "You sure know how to play the part!"
"I’m here this time to bring you something."
With that, Zhao Deming pulled out a jade token from his bosom and handed it to Lin Yi, instructing, "Take it with you, so that when you go out on your trials, you may have a smoother journey. This is a mission disseminated by our Nine Heavens Sacred Sect, and upon success, a handsome reward will be yours!"
"Disciple obeys!"
Lin Yi respectfully received the jade token and then gave Zhao Deming a cupped fist salute.
Zhao Deming waved his hand, and then, with a flash of his figure, he disappeared from sight.
...
In the blink of an eye, three years had passed.
During these three years, Zhao Deming would give Lin Yi a Seventh-Grade Divine Medicine every half-month to consume, rapidly enhancing Lin Yi’s cultivation.
However, due to the state of his cultivation, Lin Yi’s physical body remained at the realm of a Seventh-Rank Sacred Beast.
Even within the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect, such a speed of cultivation was extremely rare; at least, within the Sect, Lin Yi’s progress was the slowest.
Moreover, Zhao Deming’s attitude towards Lin Yi had become even closer, and they would even chat now and then.
This left Lin Yi filled with shock.
Nonetheless, he did not ask much, but diligently managed the affairs of the Nine Heavens Sacred Sect, after all, he still needed Zhao Deming’s care within the Sect.
"Over these three years, Lin Yi’s strength has also improved significantly, and now, he has reached the cultivation of a Two-Star Martial Emperor!"
Zhao Deming looked at Lin Yi, who was sitting cross-legged on the ground, cultivating, and a faint smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
He could feel Lin Yi’s respect for him, as well as Lin Yi’s loyalty.
It had to be said that this time, Zhao Deming’s gains were indeed plentiful.
"Lin Yi, have you finished cultivating?"
At this moment, a crisp voice suddenly sounded behind Zhao Deming.
Hearing this, Zhao Deming turned around to look at the newcomer.
It was none other than the Holy Maiden Chu Lian’er!
Zhao Deming hastily bowed and greeted her with a cupped fist, saying, "Holy Maiden!"
Chu Lian’er’s gaze swept over Lin Yi and immediately, a playful smile flashed across her beautiful, large eyes.
"Lin Yi, I’ve been planning to look for you these days!"
"For me?"
Hearing this, Lin Yi was startled.
"Yes!"
Chu Lian’er nodded and said, "I have been cultivating lately, hoping to break through to the Six-Star Holy King soon."
"However, this time, I’m planning to make a trip to the Southern Region to find an Alchemist, hoping he can refine an elixir for me!"
"I wonder, Lin Yi, would you be interested in joining me for the trip?"
As Chu Lian’er spoke, her lovely eyes turned to glance at Zhao Deming.
"Alchemist?"
Lin Yi raised an eyebrow and asked, "What kind of existence is an Alchemist?"
"An Alchemist is just that, an Alchemist, ranging from ordinary, high level, extraordinary, Immortal Pill, and Divine Pill, each representing different aspects of Alchemy, Elixirs, Pill Formulas, and Refinement techniques."
"Ordinary Elixirs are the low-grade Elixirs of First Grade, Second Grade, and Third Grade."
"High Level Elixirs are the mid-grade Elixirs of Fourth Grade, Fifth Grade, and Sixth Grade!"
"Divine Pills are the Sixth Grade and Seventh Grade Elixirs!"
"As for Immortal Pills, they are the Divine Medicines of Seventh Grade and Eighth Grade!"
"Immortal Pills are something all disciples of Nine Heavens Sacred Sect dream of obtaining, for only by reaching the status of a high-level Alchemist of our Sect can one be eligible to receive a Seventh Grade Immortal Pill!"
"The preciousness of Immortal Pills goes without saying!"
"And the Alchemist I’m seeking this time is to purchase a Seventh Grade Immortal Pill, hoping to use this as an aid to reach the Nine-Star Holy King realm as soon as possible!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi finally understood.
"Holy Maiden, the Alchemist you are looking for, wherever he is, just take me with you!"
Eagerness flickered in Lin Yi’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 856 - 876 Sincerity
chapters.content:
Chapter 856: Chapter 876 Sincerity
Zhao Deming laughed heartily, saying, "Alright, since Lin Yi, you are so sincere, I won’t beat around the bush any longer—let’s go!"
"Mm!"
Lin Yi nodded.
Following that, Zhao Deming’s figure moved and transformed into a streak of purple light, flying out of the cave dwelling and disappearing from sight.
Lin Yi quickly followed after, chasing up.
Throughout the journey, neither Lin Yi nor Zhao Deming spoke again.
Lin Yi knew that this trip to the Southern Region, Zhao Deming’s identity, was very important.
After all, the Seven-Star Alchemist was invited by Zhao Deming.
Therefore, Lin Yi wouldn’t take matters lightly under any circumstances.
Over two hours later, Lin Yi and Zhao Deming finally arrived above a desolate mountain range.
"Lin Yi, it’s just ahead. The Immortal Pill Alchemist is within this mountain peak!" Zhao Deming pointed at the mountain peak ahead and said in a deep voice.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi nodded and replied, "Thank you, Senior Brother Zhao!"
"No need for courtesy!"
Zhao Deming waved his hand and then turned his gaze towards the massive valley below.
Looking down, the valley was filled with Sky-reaching Ancient Trees.
"Lin Yi, let’s go down now!"
With that, Zhao Deming transformed into a streak of purple light and leaped directly into the valley.
"Whoosh!"
Seeing this, Lin Yi also immediately turned into a streak of green brilliance, shooting downward.
"Lin Yi, the Spiritual Energy here is very thin, I’m afraid it will be difficult to support your absorption of Heaven-Earth Vital Energy!"
"Therefore, we must choose a hidden spot to absorb the Primordial Energy!"
Zhao Deming said, and then his body trembled, causing the surrounding Primordial Energy to rush towards him like a storm, instantly forming a thin membrane around him!
"The conditions in this place are extremely harsh—if it weren’t for my Defensive Treasure Armor, I’m afraid I would have already been torn apart by those primordial energies!"
"So, to be cautious, Lin Yi, you must be prepared and not rashly absorb Primordial Energy!"
"Mm!"
Lin Yi nodded, saying, "Senior Brother Zhao, what should we do now?"
"First, stay in the depths of the ground nearby for a few days, then go out to find the alchemist!"
"It’s not easy to find an alchemist. Here, we’ll have to wait at least half a month, otherwise, even a First Grade Alchemist might not be found!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi nodded.
Indeed, he felt that finding an alchemist was not simple!
"Okay, then let’s stay in the vicinity for a few days!"
Lin Yi said.
Both their gazes were fixed on the vast valley ahead, eyes brimming with fervor.
In their gazes, both were exuding expressions of anticipation!
...
A night quickly passed.
The next day, Lin Yi took Zhao Deming and left the cave dwelling, rushing towards the wide stone path in the center of the valley.
"Lin Yi, we should first level this stone path!"
Zhao Deming looked down at the spacious stone path.
The stone path was roughly a few hundred feet in length and about ten feet wide, with extremely steep cliffs on both sides.
Moreover, next to the wide stone path, there was a row of massive stone walls that were enough to withstand full-strength strikes from ordinary cultivators.
"That’s right!"
"Let’s first level this stone path, and then later conceal it with Formation Restrictions!"
Lin Yi nodded, and his gaze narrowed slightly as he turned to look towards the distant cliffside.
That cliffside was about a dozen feet wide and over a hundred meters high, suspended in mid-air.
Surrounding the mountain cliff, a huge Formation emitted dense Formation fluctuations; it was clearly a high-rank Formation!
Yet, there were no formation bases around the perimeter of the Formation.
"Lin Yi, what are you trying to do?" Zhao Deming asked, puzzled.
"Without formation bases, how can we build a house?" Lin Yi asked.
Hearing this, Zhao Deming immediately understood Lin Yi’s intention, and with a smile, he said, "Lin Yi, rest assured, I possess a Formation technique that can mimic the aura of others and change that formation base into a formation eye!"
"However, this method of imitation requires a certain amount of spiritual power!"
"So, during this time, you’d better hurry and recover your strength, to avoid any danger in battle!"
"Understood!"
Lin Yi nodded, his eyes flashing with a hint of brilliance.
This Zhao Deming was truly a master of Formation, possessing such a heaven-defying Formation.
"Whoosh!"
As Zhao Deming spoke, he turned into a bundle of purple radiance, sweeping past Lin Yi’s side, and burrowed into the valley ahead.
Moments later, his voice came through, "Lin Yi, my Formation technique is called the Soul Capturing Array Technique!"
"Soul Capturing? What is that?" Lin Yi asked curiously.
The Soul Capturing Array Technique?
"The Soul Capturing Array Technique is one of my Zhao Family’s ancestral secret techniques!" Zhao Deming’s tone was filled with pride, as if showing off his excellence.
"Soul Capturing is a formidable Divine Skill that can capture an enemy’s Soul!"
"Once the Divine Sense of the person captured falls into it, they will be under a strange form of control!"
At this point, Zhao Deming paused for a bit before continuing, "After Soul Capturing, one can use the technique to erase all of the enemy’s memories!"
"This skill is incredibly powerful; even a high-level three-flower assembled at the peak might not be able to resist it!"
Lin Yi was inwardly shocked upon hearing this.
"I see!"
"Brother Zhao, who exactly are you dealing with right now?" Lin Yi couldn’t help but ask.
Hearing this question, a smile suddenly curled up on Zhao Deming’s lips.
"Hehe, Lin Yi, this is what I wanted to tell you!"
"It’s because I wish to perform a body snatching; after a successful body snatching, I can regain a new physical body!"
After saying this, he glanced at Lin Yi and added, "Lin Yi, are you willing to help me with this?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s face immediately showed a look of shock!
This was the most shocking thing Lin Yi had heard!
"Me? Can I help you with the body snatching?"
Lin Yi swallowed hard and said, "Brother Zhao, this is..."
He was interrupted before he could finish.
"Hehe, don’t worry, although our Zhao Family’s ancestors left orders not to publicize this matter, I can assure you that during the body-snatching process, I’ll do my best to keep it hidden from others!"
"Lin Yi, I only need you to extract my Nascent Soul from my body and seal it!"
"I only require the time it takes to burn a stick of incense, and after that, I can be reborn!"
Saying this, wisps of purple mist began to emanate from Zhao Deming’s body.
Then, he slowly ascended and landed on the immense stone path, sitting down cross-legged.
"Whoosh!"
Following this, Zhao Deming brought his palms together, closed his eyes, and a powerful surge of purple mist burst forth from within him, enveloping his entire body.
That purple mist constantly changed, ultimately forming a vortex that floated in mid-air.
At the same time, a strong aura also wafted from his body.
It was a suffocating, oppressive force!
"Indeed, it’s the Zhao Family’s Clan’s Secret Technique!"
"Brother Zhao, it seems that your Cultivation must have reached the Martial Venerable Realm!"

chapters.title: Chapter 857 - 877: Formed a Golden Lotus
chapters.content:
Chapter 857: Chapter 877: Formed a Golden Lotus
Lin Yi sensed the aura emanating from Zhao Deming and his face suddenly showed a hint of astonishment.
"Indeed, Lin Yi, your cultivation has also reached the Two-Star Martial King Realm!"
Zhao Deming spoke.
Lin Yi’s talent was exceptional, and under the nourishment of the Five Elements Qi, his strength had enhanced to the Two-Star Martial King Realm!
"Yes!"
Lin Yi nodded.
"Lin Yi, from now on, I am going to rely on your help!"
Upon saying this, Zhao Deming extended his right hand; his index and middle fingers slightly bent, his fingertips condensing a purple arc of electricity.
The arc of electricity appeared dark brown, like a venomous snake flicking its tongue, emitting a sinister and terrifying aura.
"Lin Yi, input my soul into the formation pattern inside your body, and then let it absorb my spiritual power!"
Zhao Deming instructed.
Lin Yi nodded, then immediately closed his eyes.
"Hum!"
Within Lin Yi, the soul tree trembled wildly.
"Swoosh!"
The next moment, the soul tree suddenly shook, and immediately a strand of golden soul flame burst forth!
These soul flames gathered above Lin Yi’s head, gradually forming a golden lotus.
The golden lotus emitted pale yellow rays of light.
The light grew increasingly intense and gradually, the golden light began to solidify.
Meanwhile, the giant soul tree before Lin Yi quickly grew larger.
