Eventually, it transformed into a towering ancient tree!
The phantom of the golden lotus floated above the golden lotus, emitting dazzling and brilliant golden rays!
The golden rays, like a radiant sun!
Those golden rays, as if possessed with Spiritual Wisdom, continuously circled around there.
The golden rays roamed relentlessly on the giant ancient tree.
Then, the giant ancient tree trembled violently, emitting a brilliant golden glow!
The brilliant golden glows frantically surged toward the roots of the ancient tree, making the entire tree become even more massive.
In an instant, a golden circular hole appeared at the base of the ancient tree.
Afterward, the golden rays continuously poured into that circular hole.
"Hum hum!"
"Humming!"
The ancient tree shook wildly, emitting a series of roaring sounds.
Inside the hole, a sharp and pungent smell incessantly wafted out, as if countless foul-smelling insects were crawling around.
Seeing the scene before him, Zhao Deming’s expression subtly changed.
"Is this the first step of soul transference?"
Zhao Deming murmured softly.
Then, a determined look flashed in his eyes as he shouted firmly, "Lin Yi, I’m ready, you can extract my Nascent Soul from my body now!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi nodded slightly.
Then, a fierce look flashed in his eyes, and he suddenly clenched his fist.
"Bang!"
"Puchi..."
In the next instant, the giant formation directly cracked.
After that, black and white interwoven runes rapidly emerged on Zhao Deming’s body, enveloping him within.
Lin Yi, startled, exclaimed.
"Senior Brother Zhao, what’s happening?"
"Lin Yi, this is the first step after soul transference; it requires a certain level of soul attack to completely destroy the Nascent Soul in my body!"
"Lin Yi, start now!"
Zhao Deming spoke as the black runes surrounding his body also rapidly pulsed, moving like living creatures.
Lin Yi took a deep breath, his eyes revealing a cold gleam.
Right after that, Lin Yi swung his right hand, and immediately two golden bolts of thunder descended from the sky, fiercely smashing toward Zhao Deming’s head.
Zhao Deming felt the strong wind coming from behind and, not daring to be negligent, immediately turned around to face it.
"Crack!"
With a crisp sound, the bolt of thunder instantly exploded!
"Boom boom boom!"
The exploding thunderbolts continued to burst, their power extremely astonishing, creating holes in the ground around them.
Zhao Deming’s body, meanwhile, staggered back seven or eight steps before he could stop.
"Spit!"
Zhao Deming spit out a mouthful of fresh blood, looking at Lin Yi with a pale face, his eyes full of horror.
The power of Lin Yi’s recent thunderbolt was astonishing.
Even he could hardly cope with it.
"Lin Yi, your Thunder Attribute soul is incredibly strong!"
"No wonder you dared to cause such a scene in front of the Jiuyou Demon Dragon!"
Zhao Deming looked at Lin Yi with eyes full of admiration.
You see, in the Zhao Family, disciples who possess the Thunder Attribute soul are not many!
Unless they are incredibly rare and exceptional, they aren’t worthy of becoming a core disciple of the Zhao Family.
"Lin Yi, quickly infuse your Thunder Attribute soul into my body, or else I will be devoured by those evil Nascent Souls!"
Zhao Deming’s voice carried a hint of urgency.
"Right!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi nodded and then began to mobilize his soul, starting to infuse it into Zhao Deming’s body.
Quickly, he noticed that Zhao Deming’s Nascent Soul was somewhat unstable.
"Lin Yi, quickly control that mysterious power and let it merge into my physical body!"
Zhao Deming’s voice seemed panicked, clearly finding the mysterious power somewhat difficult to handle.
"Alright!"
Lin Yi nodded his head, and immediately took control of his own soul, entering Zhao Deming’s sea of consciousness.
That mysterious power was also enveloped by Lin Yi’s soul.
The next moment, a harsh buzzing sound suddenly resonated within his sea of consciousness.
"Bang!"
As the buzzing sound emanated, a fine line of blood suddenly emerged at the center of Zhao Deming’s forehead.
Moreover, that line of blood kept expanding.
Zhao Deming’s Nascent Soul also began to collapse.
"Brother Zhao, hang in there, it will be okay soon!"
After saying this, Lin Yi again stimulated his soul, frantically drilling into Zhao Deming’s sea of consciousness, trying to control that bundle of mysterious power and merge it with Zhao Deming’s soul!
However, just as Lin Yi’s soul was about to touch Zhao Deming’s Nascent Soul, a pitch-black claw suddenly appeared out of nowhere, reaching for Lin Yi’s sea of consciousness!
"Who is it?"
Feeling the terrifying fluctuations coming from that black claw, Lin Yi was startled, and quickly retreated!
"Boom!"
That pitch-black claw landed on the spot where Lin Yi had just been standing, immediately stirring up a cloud of dust!
"Is it you?"
Seeing this, a look of surprise also appeared on Lin Yi’s face.
Because that pitch-black claw was unmistakably Zhao Deming’s Nascent Soul!
"Ha ha! Lin Yi, you have ultimately still lost to me, truly a disciple worthy of my admiration!"
"Lin Yi, you should now call me Brother Zhao!"
Zhao Deming said with a hearty laugh.
"Hmph, Brother Zhao, I’ll remember what happened this time!"
Lin Yi said coldly.
"What does it matter if you remember? You are now my puppet, Zhao Deming. What right do you have to fight against me?"
"If you are willing to join me, I will spare your life, but if you remain deluded, then today, you will undoubtedly die!"
Zhao Deming said ominously.

chapters.title: Chapter 858 - 878: Persisting in Error
chapters.content:
Chapter 858: Chapter 878: Persisting in Error
"In your dreams!"
Lin Yi cursed furiously, before flipping his palms suddenly, then a longsword hovered above the center of his palms.
The longsword was cyan-blue, engraved with numerous strange symbols, appearing extremely terrifying.
"You are a sword cultivator!"
Seeing the longsword in Lin Yi’s hands, Zhao Deming’s pupils contracted sharply.
"Lin Yi, I admit, I’m not as smart as you, but I’m not stupid either. Your tricks won’t affect me, so you might as well surrender obediently!"
"I can spare your life!"
"Hahaha..."
Lin Yi laughed loudly towards the sky.
"Lin Yi, what are you laughing at?"
"Do you think you’ve won? Don’t forget, I am a disciple of the Refining Sect. The Refining Sect is not something you can compare with!"
"The Refining Sect is a Three-Star Sect, and here, the Sect Master of the Refining Sect is a being at the Spirit Emperor Realm! What do you have to fight him with?"
Zhao Deming’s face was full of mockery.
"I told you, you don’t understand my methods!"
"Since you don’t understand, then let me show you what real Artifact Refining techniques are like!"
Lin Yi’s voice was cold, and murderous intent burst forth from his eyes.
In the next instant, the cyan-blue longsword transformed into a radiant light and directly entered Lin Yi’s glabella.
"This..."
Seeing this scene, Zhao Deming was momentarily stunned.
Because he discovered that there was an ancient seal in Lin Yi’s glabella!
"What, what’s going on?"
Zhao Deming asked somewhat dumbfounded.
"Brother Zhao, once you see this swordsmanship of mine, you will naturally understand everything."
"Now, it’s time for you to die!"
Lin Yi’s gaze was stern as he stared at Zhao Deming, and his figure gradually began to fade.
"Lin Yi!"
"No... don’t go!"
Watching Lin Yi’s figure gradually fading, Zhao Deming’s face was filled with intense pain.
"Brother Zhao, this is the last time I will call you ’brother’ because I am sending you to Hell!"
"Whoosh!"
As Lin Yi’s voice sounded, the next instant, the vanished figure condensed once again.
"Boom!"
Arcs of electricity flickered in his palms.
Seeing this scene, Zhao Deming shuddered all over and immediately bit the tip of his tongue, spraying a mouthful of blood onto the cyan-blue longsword.
The cyan-blue longsword immediately burst forth with dazzling, captivating light.
Meanwhile, Zhao Deming bit his index finger and drew a blood-red scar on his forehead.
Blood flowed, trickling down Zhao Deming’s cheeks and dripping onto the ground.
"Splash!"
A layer of blood mist spread out from Zhao Deming’s skin, enveloping his entire face.
The blood mist looked like blood-colored crystals, clear and translucent.
"What is Zhao Deming doing?"
"What is he doing?"
"Could it be that he’s destroying his Dantian?"
"Isn’t Zhao Deming a prodigy? Why destroy his Dantian?"
"Could this be... the jealousy of the heavens, destined to fall here?"
Seeing this scene, the crowd around them began to discuss, with surprise evident in their eyes.
"Lin Yi, your strength is indeed impressive, but today, you are still bound to die!"
Zhao Deming let out a low roar, and his body began to swell.
"Bang!"
The next moment, his entire body swelled to two meters tall, and then, he fiercely smashed a punch toward Lin Yi.
This punch encompassed an overwhelming momentum, as though it could shatter even space itself.
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly, and he immediately took a step forward, his figure instantly disappearing. The next moment, he appeared behind Zhao Deming, his hand gripping the azure blue longsword, which slashed at Zhao Deming’s back without any mercy, carrying a chilling breeze.
"Hmm?"
Seeing this, Zhao Deming furrowed his brows slightly, but there wasn’t much panic on his face. Instead, a cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth, and then he turned around, a punch meeting Lin Yi’s.
Their fists collided, and Zhao Deming’s face revealed a cruel, cold smirk.
Yet, the corners of Lin Yi’s mouth also carried a hint of mockery.
Their strength was nearly equal.
Zhao Deming could not overcome him!
"Bang!"
As the fists collided, a massive shockwave splintered in all directions, and the entire cave was blasted into collapse.
Then, within Zhao Deming’s eyes, emerged a horrified radiance.
"Impossible! I have already broken through the Eightfold Qi Realm, how can I not defeat you?"
Zhao Deming looked at Lin Yi with a face full of disbelief.
"Senior Brother Zhao, this is my trump card!"
Lin Yi said with a smile.
Then, Lin Yi’s expression turned extremely solemn, and from between his eyebrows, a dazzling radiance slowly rose.
"What is this?"
Zhao Deming’s eyes widened in alarm.
In his vision, a lotus phantom slowly bloomed, each petal that unfolded seemed to contain boundless mysteries.
At this moment, Zhao Deming felt as if what Lin Yi was using appeared to be an Immortal Cultivation Technique.
"Boom!"
"Pfft!"
Then, Zhao Deming heard a muffled sound, and his huge body was instantly blown apart.
"What?"
"He actually blew Zhao Deming into a pulp?"
The surrounding spectators, upon seeing this scene, were all somewhat dumbstruck.
"Lin Yi, I won’t let you off even if I become a ghost!"
From that cloud of blood mist, a piercing scream slowly emerged.
And as Zhao Deming’s scream rang out, the cloud of blood mist also slowly dispersed.
Lin Yi slowly opened his eyes, glanced at the body that had disintegrated into a pile of flesh, and a cold light flashed through his eyes: "Zhao Deming, consider yourself lucky this time, but next time, I will definitely crush you completely!"
"This move, my signature technique--’Nine Yang Annihilation,’ is meant to exterminate the enemy’s Primordial Spirit and cause them to completely dissipate into smoke and ashes!"
Lin Yi declared coldly.
This technique, although powerful, was also a Forbidden Technique!
Using this move not only caused great damage to the Primordial Spirit but also significantly weakened the caster’s own strength. If one couldn’t replenish enough power in time, there was even a risk of exploding and dying.
"My strength is ultimately too low; if my strength could reach the Ninefold Peak of the Qi Realm, it wouldn’t need to be so troublesome!"
Thinking of this, a deep hatred surged within Lin Yi’s eyes.
"Lin Yi, how dare you kill Senior Brother Zhao? Senior Brother Zhao is a top ten prodigy of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion’s Inner Court. Killing him will definitely provoke endless pursuits!"
Zhao Deming’s junior sister, the purple-robed old crone, seeing Zhao Deming chopped up by Lin Yi’s sword into a pile of gristle, immediately flew into a rage, her eyes brimming with killing intent as she stared at Lin Yi and shouted sternly.
"Oh? So what?"
"People from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion’s Inner Court?"
"Hmph, even if the elders of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion come in person, what can they do to me?"
Lin Yi retorted with a cold laugh.
He had already risked his life; what was the Spiritual Martial Pavilion to him?
"You!"
Seeing Lin Yi’s utterly unflinching demeanor, the old crone was also somewhat enraged and humiliated.
She was an elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion’s Inner Court, possessing formidable strength, but here, she had no room to exert any of it.
After all, not everyone from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion was like Zhao Deming and Li Tian, possessing a true soul imprint.

chapters.title: Chapter 859 - 879: Obstinate and Unenlightened
chapters.content:
Chapter 859: Chapter 879: Obstinate and Unenlightened
"Since you are stubbornly ignorant, don’t blame me for being rude!"
The old crone gave Lin Yi a cold glance, then with a flick of her horsetail whisk in her hand, a black Qi Force whooshed out.
This Qi Force, like a ferocious black snake, coiled towards Lin Yi.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s face suddenly changed.
This old crone was actually practicing a Dark System Technique!
In the Immortal Cultivation World, Dark System Techniques were also forbidden arts.
Because, in this world, there were many evil beings, all of which practiced Dark System Techniques!
Once contaminated by these evil beings, one would be eroded, and then controlled by them, becoming their slaves.
Thus, Dark System Techniques were the most difficult to cultivate!
"This old crone is indeed not simple!"
Lin Yi’s face was filled with seriousness.
"Hmph, Lin Yi, today I will let you see the might of our Purple Moon Sect!"
The old crone, seeing that her attack had locked onto Lin Yi, couldn’t help but sneer.
Lin Yi was just a newly initiated disciple. Even if his talent was against the heavens, he had just entered the Spiritual Martial Pavilion and his strength was far inferior to hers.
"Buzz~~~"
"Bang bang!"
Just then, a series of roaring sounds echoed, and Lin Yi struck with a palm.
On his palm, flames burned extremely fiercely, a tremendous energy crazily swept out from the center of his palm, turning into extremely hot fireballs.
Then, these intensely hot fireballs rapidly gathered together and exploded violently.
"These are all forced by you!"
Lin Yi sneered.
These fiery fireballs were all pure energy that Lin Yi had condensed for an hour.
The pure energy included the One Yang Finger from the Nine Yang Sky-Burning Palm, the Nine Yin White Bone Claw, and the Nine Phoenixes Returning to Nest Palm, among others. Moreover, these moves, which Lin Yi had mastered through cultivation, contained even more terrifying power!
And this was merely Lin Yi’s most ordinary attack.
"Boom!"
The attack released by the elder of the Purple Moon Sect collided with these fiery fireballs and immediately erupted into a heaven-shaking noise.
Then, flames that seemed like towering waves surged, engulfing the elder of the Purple Moon Sect.
One breath, two breaths, three breaths...
In the blink of an eye, the elder from the Purple Moon Sect was overwhelmed by the fiery flames, without even a chance to scream.
"What?"
Seeing this, the surrounding people also drew in a breath of cold air.
An elder of the Inner Court of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion died at the hand of a new disciple?
Isn’t that too exaggerated?
How old was Lin Yi?
Even if he was monstrously talented, he couldn’t possibly be this terrifying, could he?
It’s known that the elder from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion had lived for five to six thousand years and had reached the peak of the Sevenfold Qi Refinement Realm five hundred years ago, just half a step away from the Eightfold Realm, where one condenses the soul.
But now, she was still easily slain by Lin Yi!
Was Lin Yi really only in his twenties?
How could a disciple in his twenties from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion be so powerful?
This talent was simply too terrifying!
"You dare to kill an elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion!"
"Our Purple Moon Sect will never let you go!"
"You are doomed!"
The disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion couldn’t help but roar in anger at this moment, their eyes brimming with murderous intent.
Lin Yi had actually killed an elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion?
Moreover, they had all witnessed the elder of the Purple Moon Sect being slain.
Now, these disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion would have to bear the stigma of not following the rules!
Moreover, Lin Yi’s background was also terrifying; his family was one of the top forces of the Lin Dynasty!
Once Lin Yi’s parents or relatives came to the Spiritual Martial Pavilion to cause trouble, these disciples would definitely not have good outcomes!
"Heh, then try and see if you can kill me!"
Lin Yi lifted the corner of his mouth and said indifferently.
"Arrogant and conceited, since that’s the case, don’t blame us for teaching you a lesson!"
"Swish!"
A series of pitch-black light burst suddenly from their sleeves, finally converging into a pitch-black long spear, floating in the void, exuding a sky-shattering demonic might!
"Black Sha Spear Technique, Third Form—Mountain Splitting Cloud Cleaving!"
Accompanied by a loud shout, one of the elders of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion charged directly towards Lin Yi, his Black Sha Spear Technique carrying boundless might, piercing out instantly.
"Bang!"
Lin Yi’s eyes turned cold, and he stretched out his right arm, violently smashing his fist into the long spear.
"Boom!"
The black radiance bloomed, a wild power raged forth, compressing the surrounding air into nothingness, emitting a piercing screeching sound.
"Boom boom boom!"
Following that, Lin Yi punched again and again, his fist wind tearing the void, bursting forth with extremely sharp punches, each strike shattering the void.
The elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion had no power to resist under Lin Yi’s punches.
His black longsword was also violently shaken away.
The Protective Gang Qi on his body also completely collapsed at this moment, and he was sent flying backward, vomiting blood.
His face was as pale as paper, his form utterly disheveled, as if he was on the brink of the end, and any contact with Lin Yi’s fist would immediately result in his death.
An elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion, in front of Lin Yi, was as fragile as an ant!
"Who, who are you!?"
This elder of the Purple Moon Sect was also stunned, his face full of disbelief.
He hadn’t expected Lin Yi to be so powerful.
To send an elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion flying back, vomiting blood with a single punch.
"Who am I? I am Lin Yi! What’s the matter, don’t you recognize the elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion?"
Lin Yi paused slightly, asking somewhat confusedly.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the elder of the Purple Moon Sect was completely baffled.
"You are Lin Yi? The son of Lin Xuan, Lin Yi?"
The elder of the Purple Moon Sect widened his eyes, his expression one of disbelief.
"Nonsense!"
Lin Yi nodded his head.
"How did you make a breakthrough to become a disciple of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion? Weren’t you already advanced to the Qi Refinement Realm? How, how did you become so fast?"
The elder of the Purple Moon Sect clearly couldn’t believe this.
You have to know, Lin Yi had only entered the Spiritual Martial Pavilion a few days ago?
It hadn’t been long at all.
He was only in his twenties!
Reaching the level of a disciple of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion at this age, it was simply a miracle; such an achievement might not be found throughout the entire Southern Desolate Continent, right?
"Heh, why did I become strong?"
Lin Yi glanced indifferently at the elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion: "Go ask your fellow brothers of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion, then you will know why I became strong!"
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the elder of the Purple Moon Sect immediately fell into silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 860 - 880: Plunged into Silence
chapters.content:
Chapter 860: Chapter 880: Plunged into Silence
Lin Yi was indeed an abnormality. Just over a decade had passed, and he had already become a disciple of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion.
Moreover, his strength was growing at a terrifying rate. In just over a decade, he had reached the Fifth Layer of the Condensation Stage!
Furthermore, within just a few short years, he had not only become a disciple of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion but also one of its Core Disciples. Such a feat was unheard of!
"Lin Yi, I admit, your talent is very high, very outstanding!" said a voice.
"But since you killed a disciple of our Purple Moon Sect, you must pay the price for it!"
"Today, you must die!"
The elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion glared daggers, his hand sweeping through the air.
"Buzz~"
Soon after, several dozen other disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion also drew their swords. Over fifty longswords hovered in front of them, exuding a chilling coldness.
Each one of them wore the signature Battle Armor of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion. This armor was forged from solid metal, shining with a cold metallic luster under the sunlight, greatly enhancing its defensive power several times over.
These Battle Armors were their personal clothing.
On normal days, they would never deign to wear them. Yet today, they had been forced to don them.
Because today, they were on a mission!
And this mission was extremely dangerous!
"You think you can kill me?" Lin Yi said with some surprise as he looked at the hovering Battle Armor in front of him.
He had thought these disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion had come to help him, but it seemed that was not the case.
Moreover, these disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion actually wanted to kill him, which seemed somewhat unreasonable.
"Hmph, Lin Yi, no matter how abnormally talented you are, today, you must die!" sneered the elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion.
Immediately after, he too waved his hand.
Subsequently, the fifty longswords floating in front of him transformed into fifty streaks of light, shooting directly toward Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s eyebrows furrowed slightly, and he violently swung his fists, slamming them forward.
"Boom!"
A thunderous boom echoed.
The fifty longswords were shattered into fragments by Lin Yi’s punch, scattering debris all across the sky.
Not just that, but the terrifying force of the blow also shattered the surrounding stone slabs.
"This..."
"How is this possible?"
Seeing this, the elder from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion also had his pupils contract sharply, his face a picture of horror.
Lin Yi’s fists contained an extremely terrifying Power of thunder and lightning!
"No wonder it’s called the Thunder Tribulation Martial Technique, it’s so powerful!"
"It seems I can’t learn this move!" Lin Yi sighed, shaking his head.
Although his Cultivation had surged greatly, performing a Thunderstrike was still a bit forced.
"What kind of monster is this kid? Why has he become so powerful?" The elder’s complexion alternated between pale and flushed, looking extremely ugly.
The disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion had spent one to two thousand years training there before becoming disciples.
And he had stayed in the Spiritual Martial Pavilion for a full ten thousand years, yet he remained just an Outer Sect Disciple.
But Lin Yi had only taken half a year to go from being a disciple to becoming a Core Disciple of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion and even the Chief Disciple among them!
And all he could do was watch from the sidelines!
"Let’s go!" The elder from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion took a deep breath, gritted his teeth, and then led the remaining disciples away.
And as Lin Xuan watched the disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion leave, he too breathed a sigh of relief.
His goal was the position of the Peak Master of Purple Moon Peak, so it was best not to have any conflicts with the Purple Moon Sect; otherwise, his situation would become quite unfavorable.
However, a hint of mockery flashed across Lin Xuan’s face.
"This Purple Moon Sect really is arrogant!"
"They even dare to send disciples from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion to hunt me down, do they really think I won’t dare to kill you?"
A sly smile curled the corners of Lin Xuan’s mouth.
...
"What?!"
And when this news rapidly spread throughout the entire valley, the Spiritual Martial Pavilion instantly boiled over with excitement.
"What! Disciples of our Spiritual Martial Pavilion actually encountered Lin Yi outside?!"
"Good heavens, that’s a big fish! Lin Yi is a monstrous talent ranked ninth on the genius list, and it is said that he is also the Chief Disciple of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion!"
"And this Lin Yi is also an extreme prodigy!"
...
Under the attention of various powers, Lin Xuan’s name quickly became known to everyone.
During this time, his fame had soared throughout the entire East State due to his exploits while training outside.
Not only that, he had also founded a trading company and handed over all the earned Spirit Crystals to the Spiritual Martial Pavilion, allowing them to auction the goods and provide all resources for these trading companies.
In doing so, he not only alleviated the pressure on the Spiritual Martial Pavilion but also effectively advertised for them.
After all, it was a great opportunity.
Publicizing his information would undoubtedly cause endless shocks and significantly boost the reputation of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion.
And Lin Yi’s name, due to this action, greatly soared in fame and even set off a frenzy throughout the entire East State.
In the eyes of the disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion, that was a massive fortune!
"Lin Yi, you really are formidable, to have subdued the disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion in such a short time. That’s really awesome!"
Atop the roof of an inn, Xiao Yi couldn’t help but exclaim after hearing this news.
Lin Yi, that guy, really was surprising.
In just a mere two or three years, he had subdued all the disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion.
His potential was simply too heaven-defying.
"Haha, Elder Brother Lin is the most freakish person in our East State!"
"In these years, there have been very few in the East State who could contend against Elder Brother Lin!"
"With Elder Brother Lin’s strength, if he were to look at the whole world, he would surely count as a peerless powerhouse, right?"
...
With this news, the surrounding people also began to excitedly discuss.
"Hm?"
"Look, that Lin Yi is also walking with the disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion. Is he planning to directly provoke the Spiritual Martial Pavilion?"
Suddenly, Xiao Yi’s gaze also fell upon the mountain range not far away.
He saw that, at this moment, Lin Yi was leading the disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion at a brisk pace towards the Purple Moon Sect.
Clearly, Lin Yi planned to take advantage of this opportunity to challenge the Spiritual Martial Pavilion once again.
"Ha! I really didn’t expect that the kid would dare to provoke my Spiritual Martial Pavilion."
"It looks like he wants to take down my Spiritual Martial Pavilion in this trial! However, he’s still a bit too green. Does he think that with his power, he can challenge my Spiritual Martial Pavilion? What a delusional fantasy!"
A cold smile filled with a chilling light emerged in the elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion.
"Elder, what should we do?"
A disciple of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion rolled his eyes and asked.
"Simple, that kid wants to seek death! Then let’s give him what he wants!"
"Let him know that here in the East State, the Spiritual Martial Pavilion is not a place where he can run wild!"
"Let’s set out now, to the Purple Moon Sect."
Hearing this, the elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion sneered continuously.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 861 - 881: Stupid Things!
chapters.content:
Chapter 861: Chapter 881: Stupid Things!
"Lin Yi, won’t you come out and die?!"
"Are you scorning our Spiritual Martial Pavilion?!"
"Today, we will definitely make your blood spill on the spot, so you understand how foolish it is to provoke our Spiritual Martial Pavilion!"
Soon, the elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion arrived at the Purple Moon Sect and started berating Lin Yi.
"Oh, isn’t this that fellow called Zi Yun?"
"What are you looking for me for? Perhaps, you’ve come to beg for my forgiveness?"
"Hehe, you must be out of your mind, when did I ever say I would forgive you?"
"I’m here to teach you a lesson, and by the way, to take your damned disciple with me."
"Oh? Is that so? Looks like you want me to make a move!"
"Then let’s try and see! I want to see who’ll die first!"
Lin Yi snorted coldly and also stepped into the grand hall of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion.
"Lin Yi! You scoundrel, give back my disciple’s life!"
"I will tear you to pieces and extract your soul for torment!"
The disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion were boiling with rage and rushed towards Lin Yi.
"You want to kill me? Then let’s see if you have the ability!"
"Where is the elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion? I challenge him." Lin Yi glanced at them indifferently, a thick sneer surfacing at the corners of his mouth.
Lin Yi was someone who held grudges, if he did not get his revenge, he undoubtedly wouldn’t be able to sleep.
"How audacious! The esteemed name of our Spiritual Martial Pavilion’s elder, is it something that trash like you can insult?!"
"You’re courting death!"
"Kill him for me, I want him torn to a thousand pieces."
Upon hearing this, the disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion’s eyes blazed with killing intent, exploding outwards as they furiously attacked Lin Yi.
Bang, bang, bang!
The next moment, their attacks landed on Lin Yi’s body, sending him flying out while coughing up blood.
"What?!"
"This Lin Yi is actually enduring our attacks without a scratch, he’s not even injured, what kind of monster is he?"
"This guy’s physical body is probably not inferior to a Spiritual Artifact; otherwise, it wouldn’t be possible to block so many people’s attacks!"
"No wonder he has the guts to provoke our Spiritual Martial Pavilion!"
At that moment, the disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion looked at Lin Yi as if he were some kind of monster, their eyes filled with shock and apprehension.
Lin Yi’s strength was beyond their imagination.
"Lin Yi, well done." Xiao Yi couldn’t help but applaud.
Although in Xiao Yi’s eyes, Lin Yi’s strength was still only at the Holy King Realm, he was able to stand up against martial artists of the Spiritual King Realm, which was enough to prove how formidable his physical body was.
...
"Hmph!"
"I have other tasks to attend to and don’t have time to play with you; next time!"
"You just continue to be that useless trash!" Lin Yi glanced coldly at Xiao Yi, his figure suddenly vanished on the spot and darted away.
Boom, rumble, rumble.
Just then, within the Spiritual Martial Pavilion, the power of a mighty Formation was released, trapping Lin Yi within it.
"Don’t waste your effort, in front of me, you can’t escape!" Lin Yi scoffed.
The next moment, his fist harshly slammed into the Formation.
Immediately, the entire Formation trembled violently, as if it was about to shatter at any moment.
"Damn it, how could this happen."
"This Lin Yi is indeed no simple character, so powerful that even a mere Formation can’t trap him!" an elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion grimaced, his expression turning exceptionally grim.
"So what if you’re strong? An elder of our Spiritual Martial Pavilion can come out of seclusion at any time to deal with you."
"And before that, I’ll definitely kill you," the elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion sneered in his heart.
He had already decided that the next time he came out of seclusion, he would personally take action to suppress Lin Yi.
After all, Lin Yi’s performance just now was simply too dazzling.
Even he would not have been able to break the Formation easily before taking total control of it.
...
"Lin Yi, kneel down and kowtow three hundred times, and also break your own legs. Do that, and I’ll let you go tonight! Otherwise, don’t blame me for not being courteous."
"Hmph! This is the territory of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion, even if that elder of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion were to help you, he would just be punished by our elders. So today, you’re like a bird trying to escape with nowhere to fly."
"If you don’t want to be skinned and deboned, just kneel down and admit your guilt obediently."
"Otherwise, I’ll make you wish you were dead!" a group of disciples from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion scoffed.
"I want all of you to go to hell."
Lin Yi’s gaze suddenly sharpened, and with a stomp of his foot, a golden dragon pattern radiantly blossomed from the sole of his foot.
Roar.
All of a sudden, a Divine Dragon Phantom entwined with the Power of thunder and lightning rose up from behind him, roaring towards those Spiritual Martial Pavilion disciples.
"What?"
"What is that Divine Dragon Phantom? Such a terrifying aura! Is that a secret technique from the Dragon Clan?"
"No matter what kind of Divine Dragon secret technique he’s using, can’t we, with so many people working together, take care of him?"
"Humph! We have more than just one elder as our master."
"This Lin Yi, let’s leave him to us," several disciples from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion sneered.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh.
Just then, those several disciples from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion also launched their attacks toward Lin Yi.
"Go to hell." A young man of incredibly handsome appearance suddenly flashed and appeared behind Lin Yi, swinging his Longsword at the back of Lin Yi’s head.
"Hm?"
Lin Yi’s eyebrows furrowed slightly, and he couldn’t help but reveal a mocking smile on his lips.
Crack.
Suddenly, Lin Yi’s right leg shot up, delivering a kick to the side of the Longsword.
Instantly, a terrifying force surged out, sending the young man flying backward, vomiting a mouthful of fresh blood.
"This..."
"This Lin Yi is so formidable?"
"That’s impossible! How could this be possible?"
"Could it be that this guy is some kind of special beast reborn to refine himself? Otherwise, why would he possess such a terrifying strength?" the disciple of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion thought with an extremely ugly expression.
"You bastard, go to hell."
"Don’t think you’re so mighty. In front of me, you’re still just an insignificant ant."
Just at that moment, Lin Yi’s figure once again disappeared from the spot, reappearing in front of the young man.
Squelch.
Lin Yi’s fist smashed into the young man’s chest, shattering his breastbone.
Then, Lin Yi delivered another kick, bursting the young man’s abdomen open.
"No..."
The next moment, his body fell rigidly onto the ground, motionless.
"Not worth a blow."
Lin Yi sneered, pocketing the young man’s Storage Ring.

chapters.title: Chapter 862 - 882: Leave the Spiritual Martial Pavilion as Soon as Possible
chapters.content:
Chapter 862: Chapter 882: Leave the Spiritual Martial Pavilion as Soon as Possible
"Lin Yi, you dare kill our Young Master, the Spiritual Martial Pavilion will not forgive you," a disciple of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion said, glaring at Lin Yi with fury in his eyes.
"I know, but I am leaving now. If the elders of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion want to seek revenge, feel free to make your move,"
"Just, I hope you move quickly; otherwise, once I leave the territory of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion, capturing me will be difficult," Lin Yi shrugged his shoulders and said with a light smile.
"You... who exactly are you?"
"How can you be so powerful?"
The pupil of that disciple from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion suddenly contracted, feeling a sense of fear he had never experienced before.
...
"Worthy of being a genius of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion!"
"His strength is truly extraordinary. To think he could kill those disciples of a higher level."
"Such heaven-defying potential might even surpass the core members of our sect, right?"
At that moment, everyone present was immensely shocked, witnessing Lin Yi’s feats.
...
"No, I must leave the Spiritual Martial Pavilion as soon as possible."
"If Lin Yi lives and leaves Spiritual Martial City, then the martial artists of the entire Northern Cang Kingdom will surely learn of his existence."
"Therefore, I must find an opportunity to kill Lin Yi and rid us of this trouble forever!"
Just then, Xiao Ming’s gaze turned icy as he pondered in secret.
Lin Yi’s existence was like a time bomb, ready to explode at any moment throughout the Northern Cang Kingdom; thus, he couldn’t allow Lin Yi to continue living.
"You guys, stop Lin Yi for me," Xiao Ming said, glancing at the other disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion.
Upon hearing his words, those disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion quickly nodded and responded, "Yes!"
Whoosh!
Immediately afterward, five disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion dispersed and launched a fierce attack on Lin Yi.
Swish, swish, swish.
Lin Yi’s figure flickered, dodging the sneak attacks from two of the disciples.
"Damn it, how could he dodge my attack so quickly?"
The other disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion were left wide-eyed and incredulous.
"Get lost!"
"Bang, bang, bang!" Lin Yi coldly shouted as his figure charged again toward one of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion disciples.
"That damned brat!" The face of the disciple contorted with rage, his teeth clenched.
The next moment, he brought out a huge axe and cleaved it down at Lin Yi.
"Scram!" Lin Yi said disdainfully.
"What?" The pupil of the disciple suddenly constricted, and he involuntarily took a step backward.
This time, Lin Yi was too fast to avoid.
"Puchi!"
Lin Yi’s fist landed on the chest of that disciple, sending him flying with a crimson wound emerging on his body.
"Lin Yi!"
At that moment, the other disciples of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion looked at Lin Yi with immense anger.
They could never have imagined their companion would be instantly killed by this young man—how humiliating.
"Hmph!"
"Do you think you are worthy to challenge me?" Lin Yi scoffed disdainfully.
"Lin Yi, don’t be arrogant."
"After you die at our hands, no matter how arrogant you are, it won’t change your fate."
"I was careless this time; next time, I will make sure you pay a terrible price!" the older disciple of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion said solemnly.
"Heh heh," Lin Yi sneered, "If you can do that, then I’ll just wait."
"But, before you manage that, I’ll send you to the afterlife,"
Lin Yi finished speaking and rushed toward another person once again.
Boom, boom, boom.
Lin Yi’s fist, like a shooting star, violently struck the disciple from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion.
The disciple from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion instantly turned pale with fright.
Nevertheless, he desperately defended against Lin Yi’s attack.
However, when Lin Yi’s fist hit the disciple, it did not cause any damage to him; instead, Lin Yi himself staggered backward dozens of meters.
"This... this is impossible!"
"My physical body has reached the realm of a Third Grade superior weapon, how could I fail to catch even one of his punches?" The disciple’s face was full of disbelief as he shook his head and refused to believe what had happened.
"Your physical body is indeed strong, but unfortunately, meeting me, Lin Yi, means you’re doomed to be worthless!" Lin Yi grinned and taunted word by word.
"Go to hell!" The disciple from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion could no longer bear it and crazily stimulated his True Yuan, lunging at Lin Yi.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
At that moment, Lin Yi’s figure mysteriously appeared at his side.
"What’s going on? How could his speed have increased so much?"
The disciple from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion was filled with unwillingness and fear.
Bang!
But his fist firmly smashed into Lin Yi’s shoulder, emitting a muffled sound.
Crack.
Lin Yi’s body immediately emitted the sound of cracking bones, clearly indicating that the disciple’s physical body was far inferior to his own.
"Ah!" The disciple from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion screamed in pain and rapidly retreated.
However, after retreating hundreds of meters, he noticed that Lin Yi was not pursuing him and he finally relaxed.
"Lin Yi, I will remember today’s grudge!" The disciple from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion gritted his teeth.
"Hehe, your strength is not bad, but in my eyes, it’s nothing," Lin Yi shook his head and said disdainfully.
"Lin Yi, don’t be too proud."
"One day, I will personally take your life." The disciple’s eyes were bloodshot.
"Then let’s wait and see!" Lin Yi said with a smirky smile.
...
Lin Yi’s strength was beyond his imagination.
It made him feel incredibly stifled.
Unfortunately, Lin Yi’s speed was extremely fast, and even the talented disciples from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion could not catch sight of him unless they used a secret technique to pursue him.
But the consumption of the secret technique was too great, and even though he could attempt to chase after him using it, it would take a prolonged time and it was essentially impossible to catch up.
Therefore, he could only give up.
...
"Lin Yi’s strength is so strong!"
"My master might not even be his match."
...
The surrounding spectators were dumbstruck, completely shocked by Lin Yi’s performance.
Lin Yi was only twenty years old, yet he possessed strength comparable to the number one talent of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion, which was utterly inconceivable.
"Who exactly is he?"
"How have I never heard of such a person?"
...
Not just the spectators, many surrounding students were equally astonished.
Lin Yi’s strength had exceeded their expectations.
"Which power’s freak is this guy from?" The Pavilion Master of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion murmured with a slight frown and a serious look in his eyes.
...
"Hahahaha!"
"Lin Yi, today, let us gang up and tear him to pieces."
At that moment, a disciple from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion, with a fierce smile, swung his longsword and charged at Lin Yi.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!

chapters.title: Chapter 863 - 883: Resisting Dense Sword Qi
chapters.content:
Chapter 863: Chapter 883: Resisting Dense Sword Qi
In an instant, fierce Sword Qi, like a violent wind and storm, shot towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s expression darkened, and he quickly raised his arms to fend off the dense Sword Qi.
Pu Chi!
Pu Chi!
Blood splattered as a disciple from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion was continuously struck by Lin Yi’s fists.
In less than the time it took for three breaths, his body was covered in wounds, dripping with blood.
Lin Yi kicked him to the ground and looked down at him from a height.
"Now, is it your death or mine?" Lin Yi asked indifferently.
"Lin Yi, if you dare to kill me, you will face the vengeance of everyone in the Spiritual Martial Pavilion, and you will have no place to be buried!"
The disciple from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion threatened with a cold face.
"Heh."
"Since you’ve said so, let’s give it a try!"
Lin Yi smiled faintly, lifted his right leg, and stomped down fiercely.
Bang!
This kick, as if landing on steel, caused the disciple’s head from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion to cave in, his eyes bulging out in horror.
"You..."
"Don’t be afraid, I won’t kill you, I just want to teach you a lesson," Lin Yi said lightly, "I know there are many in this class who are discontented with you."
"But, once I, Lin Yi, decide to kill someone, I show no mercy to anyone!"
"So, just enjoy what it feels like to wish you were dead!"
The disciple from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion’s face turned ashen.
"Lin Yi, I surrender, please, spare me!"
"From now on, I won’t dare to provoke you ever again."
The disciple from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion howled, begging for mercy.
"Sorry, it’s too late!" Lin Yi shook his head, then suddenly lifted his fist and smashed it down hard on the disciple’s head, crushing his skull.
A head instantly exploded.
This scene was shockingly heart-stopping.
"How could this be possible, how could he have such formidable strength!"
All the surrounding students were stunned.
They all knew Lin Yi was a prodigy, but they never imagined he could be this formidable.
...
The stronger Lin Yi’s strength, the more those disciples from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion dared not provoke him.
Thus, it wasn’t long before his name appeared on the list.
And the name Lin Yi was instantly heard by all the forces.
"Lin Yi?"
"Lin Yi!"
...
When Lin Yi’s name reached everyone’s ears, their eyes all showed deep wariness.
Lin Yi had completely established a strong reputation in everyone’s hearts, even more formidable and awe-inspiring than Chen Haoran, the top prodigy from the Spiritual Martial Pavilion.
After all, Chen Haoran was just an Outer Sect disciple.
...
At this time, Lin Yi had already left the academy and headed deep into the Heavenly Wolf Mountain Range to hunt Demon Beasts.
During the process of hunting Demon Beasts, Lin Yi also continuously comprehended new sword techniques.
However, just as Lin Yi had stepped out of the academy, he immediately encountered a group of students.
"Yo! If it isn’t Brother Lin Yi. It seems you’ve been promoted to the Inner Court? Congratulations."
These students were led by a man in a black robe.
The man in the black robe had reached the Seventh Layer of the Spiritual Martial Pavilion, marking him as a core member of the same, his status and position were on par with Lin Yi.
"It turns out to be Brother Li! What a pleasure to meet you," said Lin Yi with a faint smile.
At that moment, the man looked at the basket on Lin Yi’s back and said, "Lin Yi, you wouldn’t just be coming out of seclusion to head deep into Heavenly Wolf Mountain Range to hunt demon beasts, would you?"
"That’s exactly what I’m doing," Lin Yi nodded and admitted openly.
Hearing this, the man surnamed Li suddenly showed a look of surprise and said, "That’s a very dangerous thing to do! Lin Yi, I advise you to ease your mind a bit earlier!"
"Mind your own business!" Lin Yi said lightly.
The man surnamed Li was taken aback for a moment but then chuckled and said, "Since that’s the case, I won’t say anymore."
With that, the man surnamed Li left with a few others.
"What a peculiar person," Lin Yi muttered.
"But, he does seem quite concerned about you!"
"It seems I need to be more careful at the academy from now on."
Lin Yi shook his head and proceeded towards the deeper parts of the Heavenly Wolf Mountain Range.
"Eh? What is that?" Suddenly, Lin Yi, with his keen eyes, spotted an ancient character on a stele upfront.
The character was similar to the Sword technique he used, except it had turned black in color.
Moreover, the content written in that character was not significantly different from the Sword technique Lin Yi mastered.
Could it be the Sword technique he was looking for?
"This stele seems to be incomplete; it must be a form of swordsmanship," Lin Yi surmised to himself.
Without hesitation, he walked over to it.
Approaching it, he closely examined the broken stele.
It was a damaged ancient scroll, adorned with lines of intricate text. However, Lin Yi could not comprehend the writing.
"Lin Yi, this is a fragment of an ancient tome, you needn’t waste time reading it. If you’re looking for something, it’s best to find a more complete ancient book that might contain some swordsmanship," the man surnamed Li suddenly suggested.
"Understood," Lin Yi nodded and replied, "Thanks."
With that, Lin Yi turned and walked away.
The man surnamed Li watched Lin Yi’s departing back, a sneer curling on his lips.
Lin Yi was truly arrogant to the extreme, not considering others at all!
However, the man surnamed Li didn’t dwell on it, continuing his journey deeper into the Heavenly Wolf Mountain Range.
...
Heavenly Wolf Mountain Range was an expanse of rugged mountains.
High above the mountains where clouds enshrouded, towering peaks stood like giant dragons sprawling across the land.
Lin Yi, travelling through the sea of clouds, keenly observed the scenery around him.
Above the mists, he discovered an enormously grand palace marked with ancient talismans, exuding a rustic and ancient aura.
The plaque over the palace read ’Heavenly Wolf Palace’ in ancient seal script.
Heavenly Wolf Palace was the most esteemed building of the Heavenly Wolf Sect, designated for the seclusion and cultivation of successive sect leaders and chief elders.
The selection of this time’s Heavenly Wolf Palace was also set here.
After navigating through the cloud sea for a while, Lin Yi finally arrived outside Heavenly Wolf Palace.
"The aura of this Heavenly Wolf Palace is much stronger than any palace I’ve encountered before! It looks like I’ll need to spend quite some time here if I want to cultivate," Lin Yi sighed lightly as he stepped into Heavenly Wolf Palace.
The palace was empty, void of people.
The moment he entered, Lin Yi felt a powerful presence from deep within Heavenly Wolf Palace surging toward him.
Lin Yi took a deep breath, his gaze intensively sweeping around, wary of any dangerous demon beasts that might rush into the Heavenly Wolf Palace and attack him.
Lin Yi did not dare be careless; he continued to cautiously observe his surroundings.
Suddenly, Lin Yi’s brow furrowed, and he shouted towards the depths of the Heavenly Wolf Palace, "Who is it? Come out!"
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s shout, a series of faint footsteps echoed from deep within.
Then, a young man slowly walked out.

chapters.title: Chapter 864 - 884: Commanding Respect without Anger
chapters.content:
Chapter 864: Chapter 884: Commanding Respect without Anger
"The young man was about twenty years old, handsome and graceful, possessing an exceptional temperament, akin to an Immortal stepping out of the mundane world, creating an ethereal impression as if he could, in a moment, touch the mysteries between heaven and earth."
"Are you Lin Yi?"
The young man asked, his voice cold and imposing, exuding a natural authority.
Upon seeing the youth, a hint of surprise flashed across Lin Yi’s face as he responded, "So, it’s Zhao Feiyan, the chief disciple of the Heavenly Wolf Sect."
"Lin Yi, I heard that you are the prodigy of our Heavenly Wolf Sect?"
"Heh, that’s just a rumor that has been exaggerated," Lin Yi said with a smile.
"Brother Lin Yi is being modest," Zhao Feiyan replied.
Lin Yi nodded and asked, "However, Brother Zhao, did you call me here to tell me that the Heavenly Wolf Sect is organizing a martial arts tournament?"
"Yes!"
Zhao Feiyan nodded and said, "It’s said that today is the day the tournament is to be held."
"A martial arts tournament?"
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed.
He wasn’t very interested in the martial arts tournament; instead, he was looking forward to the Spiritual Artifacts held by the disciples of the Heavenly Wolf Sect.
"However, before the event commences, there are some rules that need to be made clear," Zhao Feiyan slowly stated.
"Oh? Please, go on!" Lin Yi smiled and gestured for Zhao Feiyan to continue.
"The first rule is that all disciples of the Heavenly Wolf Sect who participate must unleash their full strength. Failure to do so will result in elimination!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi nodded slightly and inquired, "I understand. May I ask, what are the rewards for this martial arts tournament?"
Zhao Feiyan glanced at Lin Yi indifferently and said, "Each participant will receive a Spirit Crystal."
"Hisss!"
Lin Yi couldn’t help but gasp, a look of greed flashing in his eyes.
Spirit Crystals were incredibly important for a cultivator, packed with pure, abundant Yuan Force that could greatly benefit cultivation and even assist in swiftly breaking through realms!
"There must be some trick to this martial arts tournament!" Lin Yi thought to himself.
"The second rule is that each contender must defeat their opponent within the duration of one incense stick!" Zhao Feiyan added.
"Damn, doesn’t this leave me no time to rest?"
Lin Yi’s eyebrows furrowed, and he felt slightly irritated, "With this, won’t my chances of victory be even lower?"
"Exactly, therefore, you must secure the first place in this tournament. Otherwise, you will be disqualified from competing!"
Zhao Feiyan looked down at Lin Yi with a superior air.
"Hmph!"
Lin Yi snorted coldly, "Although the Heavenly Wolf Sect is organizing this tournament, I believe that with my own efforts, I can win this competition and secure the first place!"
"Let’s wait and see then!"
Zhao Feiyan sneered.
After saying this, Zhao Feiyan transformed into a streak of light and vanished from the Heavenly Wolf Hall.
Seeing this, Lin Yi didn’t bother about Zhao Feiyan’s attitude and sat down cross-legged to start cultivating the ’Nine Heavens Thunder Palm.’
...
Time flowed like water, fleeting in an instant.
Before he knew it, half a month had passed.
During this time, Lin Yi had been frantically cultivating, even attempting to break through to the later stages of the Lingji Realm.
With Lin Yi’s efforts, his experience rapidly increased, and soon, he was nearing the breakthrough to the later stages of Lingji Realm.
However, breaking through still required time.
Lin Yi was not in a rush to make the breakthrough; given his current strength was still weak, any amount of cultivation seemed futile.
Therefore, he planned to slowly refine himself and accumulate his foundation.
Time swiftly passed by.
In the blink of an eye, two months had gone by.
That night.
Lin Yi woke up from his cultivation, opening his eyes which emitted a mesmerizing brightness, akin to two brilliant stars.
"This period, my cultivation speed has been very fast, yet I still can’t reach the later stages of the Lingji Realm. I don’t know why, but my soul power always experiences short disturbances."
"However, I am not anxious anymore, after all, this situation is still considered normal; I can’t force it."
Lin Yi pondered and then stood up.
He immediately took out an elixir and swallowed it.
After consuming the elixir, Lin Yi felt the Qi-Blood inside his body becoming more vigorous, revitalizing him entirely.
"It is indeed a spiritual-grade elixir; the effect is truly extraordinary!"
Lin Yi sighed, then left the Heavenly Wolf Hall and headed to the plaza of the Heavenly Wolf Sect.
The plaza of the Heavenly Wolf Sect was an extremely majestic and expansive structure within the sect, covering thousands of feet in width and occupying a vast area.
All disciples of the Heavenly Wolf Sect gathered on the plaza, a sea of people.
Lin Yi walked to the end of the plaza, looking toward the disciples of the Heavenly Wolf Sect in the distance.
There, rows upon rows of figures stood packed together, dense like ants, creating an impressive sight.
Lin Yi’s gaze swept over the bodies of these Heavenly Wolf Sect disciples, finally resting on Zhao Feiyan and several elders.
On these elders, Lin Yi felt a certain oppression, which made his breathing slightly stifled.
"Elder Zhao, respected elders."
"Lin Yi pays respects to all the seniors!"
Lin Yi greeted respectfully.
"Hmm, rise!"
Zhao Feiyan said indifferently.
"Lin Yi, today you will face the challenge of the Martial Arts competition in the Heavenly Wolf Plaza," Zhao Feiyan stated.
Hearing Zhao Feiyan’s words, Lin Yi was taken aback.
This Zhao Feiyan, seemingly approachable, but in her bones, still carried a bit of arrogance.
"This guy, he must be targeting me purposely!"
"However, no matter what, I have to give it my all, I can’t be looked down upon by this guy!"
Lin Yi gritted his teeth.
"Lin Yi, you are a disciple of the Heavenly Wolf Sect, and your cultivation has already reached the Seventh Layer, according to the rules of the Heavenly Wolf Sect, you are not allowed to use Magical Treasures, thus, you have no weapons in your hands!"
An elder said.
"It’s alright, I’ll buy a weapon after the competition ends!" Lin Yi said.
"Good!"
The elder nodded.
Subsequently, Lin Yi turned and walked towards the outside of the plaza.
At this moment, the plaza was already filled with many waiting people, all disciples of the Heavenly Wolf Sect.
Of course, there were also disciples from other sects and powers, after all, the rule of this Martial Arts competition was simple: whoever reaches the final round of the platform fastest is the victor.
On the other side of the plaza, Zhao Feiyan stood aside, her gaze icy as she watched Lin Yi and said, "Lin Yi, if you lose after the contest starts, don’t blame the sect for being harsh on you!"
"I will not lose!" Lin Yi snorted coldly.
"I hope you do not disgrace the Heavenly Wolf Sect!"
Zhao Feiyan’s tone was chilling.
Having said this, she then left the area.
"I don’t care, after I get into the third round, I want to give Zhao Feiyan a good beating!"
Lin Yi clenched his fists, thinking fiercely.
"Alright, the contest has begun!"
At that moment, an elder announced.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Upon hearing this, everyone simultaneously turned their eyes towards the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 865 - 885: Stepping onto the Arena
chapters.content:
Chapter 865: Chapter 885: Stepping onto the Arena
Faces all lit up with excitement.
For the long-awaited Martial Arts competition was about to begin!
"Lin Yi, you may now ascend the platform!" said the elder, looking at Lin Yi.
"Yes."
Lin Yi nodded, stepped up onto the platform, and stood at one corner of the duel stage.
"My name is Zhou Haoyu!"
"Lin Yi, which Sect’s disciple are you? I want to challenge you!"
At this moment, Zhou Haoyu spoke.
Zhou Haoyu, being a Sixth Layer cultivator with a handsome and dashing appearance dressed in black, exuded a strong masculine aura.
However, deep within Zhou Haoyu’s eyes lay a thick murderous intent, almost as if he couldn’t wait to tear Lin Yi apart.
"I am Lin Yi, an Inner Sect Disciple of the Heavenly Wolf Sect!" Lin Yi said with a cold sneer.
"Ha ha, you are quite arrogant, kid! No wonder you dare oppose the Heavenly Wolf Sect since you’re just an Inner Sect Disciple!" Zhou Haoyu mocked.
"Hmph!"
Lin Yi snorted coldly and said, "This world is inherently a place where the strong prey on the weak. Since you are an Inner Sect Disciple, you should abide by the rules, or else I won’t be polite!"
"Heh!"
Zhou Haoyu scoffed and said, "Lin Yi, you are merely at Fifth Layer; are you seeking death by acting arrogantly in front of me?"
"Am I seeking death?"
"You can try and see if you can kill me?"
Lin Yi said disdainfully.
"Do you really think I can’t kill you?" Zhou Haoyu coldly shouted, his eyes flashing with ferocity.
"Whether you can kill me or not, let’s find out!" Lin Yi said with a light chuckle.
"Hmph! Lin Yi, since you wish to seek death, I shall oblige!"
Zhou Haoyu shouted angrily and with a wave of his hand, a silver-white curved blade appeared in his grasp.
Immediately, Zhou Haoyu leaped onto the duel stage.
Seeing Zhou Haoyu jump onto the duel stage, Lin Yi’s eyes sparkled.
"It seems this Zhou Haoyu is an expert. Moreover, his strength is definitely above the Eighth Layer. If he can defeat me, then he will surely win the championship and successfully enter the Spiritual Spring Valley. Then, I can obtain the Spiritual Spring Liquid and promote myself to the Spirit Pond Realm, or even higher!"
Thinking this, a fervent glint emerged in Lin Yi’s eyes.
He was eager to obtain that Spiritual Spring Liquid.
"Kid, today, I will show you that you are no match for me; you don’t even deserve the right to kneel and wail!" Zhou Haoyu shouted coldly, charging at Lin Yi.
His figure swept across swiftly, bringing a strong gust of wind that brushed against Lin Yi’s face, causing a stinging sensation.
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed, his figure shifted abruptly, dodging away.
Whoosh...
Lin Yi’s body turned into an afterimage, disappearing from the spot and appearing behind Zhou Haoyu.
"Such incredible speed, worthy of the best disciple of the Heavenly Wolf Sect!"
Lin Yi praised silently.
He stomped fiercely on the ground, propelling himself straight towards Zhou Haoyu.
"Hmph, trivial tricks!"
Feeling the danger approaching from behind, Zhou Haoyu snorted coldly, not retreating but advancing, colliding directly with Lin Yi.
Boom!
The two figures intertwined, releasing a deafening roar.
Lin Yi felt a huge stone pressing on his chest, his breathing turned rapid, and a trickle of blood showed at the corner of his mouth.
Zhou Haoyu was not faring well either. Although he was at the Ninth Level, he was still only in the Early Stage, and compared to Lin Yi, there was too much difference.
"Such an incredible movement technique!" Zhou Haoyu’s pupils shrank, a flicker of fear in his eyes as he roared lowly and his figure burst backward.
"Zhou Brother, I see you’ve run out of tricks!"
Lin Yi sneered.
"Is that so? I haven’t even used my full strength, take this!"
Zhou Haoyu roared, attacking again.
"If that’s the case, I’ll just play along!"
Lin Yi sneered, his footsteps constantly shifting, each movement creating an illusion, making him seem elusive.
"Your speed is too slow, you can’t possibly hurt me!"
Zhou Haoyu snorted coldly.
"Really? Then I won’t hold back!"
Lin Yi sneered.
Immediately, Lin Yi stomped on the ground, his body shot towards Zhou Haoyu like a cannonball, his legs forcefully propelling him forward.
Seeing this, Zhou Haoyu’s expression darkened; he spread his arms to block Lin Yi’s incoming right leg, while his right foot swept across viciously towards Lin Yi’s chest.
Boom!
Zhou Haoyu’s leg smashed hard onto Lin Yi’s stomach.
"Wow!"
Lin Yi couldn’t help but spit out a mouthful of fresh blood, his body flying like a broken kite, landing dozens of meters away on the fighting platform.
"Cough cough!"
"Lin Yi, this is just the beginning. I’ll let you see what the true cultivation technique of the Heavenly Wolf Sect is like, to let you know that our Heavenly Wolf Sect isn’t something you riffraff can provoke!"
Zhou Haoyu snorted coldly, his eyes filled with disdain.
After all, he was an elite of the Heavenly Wolf Sect, a standout among the younger generation. In his eyes, these people were nothing but ants.
"Zhou Haoyu, don’t you feel ashamed bullying us like this?"
"And what about us being Outer Sect disciples? Aren’t you one too?"
"People from your Heavenly Wolf Sect, each of you so arrogant, looking down on Inner Sect Disciples. And now, you bully us; we won’t accept this, we will protest to the Sect, demanding justice!"
"Yeah, if it weren’t for the Sect Master covering for you, you’d have been kicked out of the Heavenly Wolf Sect long ago!"
...
Lin Yi and a few other Outer Sect disciples were indignant at Zhou Haoyu’s actions.
Upon hearing this, Zhou Haoyu’s eyes glinted with a cold light.
Lin Yi and the others had actually challenged him to his face, which greatly angered Zhou Haoyu.
He was a Core Disciple of the Heavenly Wolf Sect, the future successor, and yet he was being looked down upon.
"Boy, you really have no idea what’s good for you. If that’s the case, then I’ll make you shut up permanently!"
As he spoke, boundless golden Primordial Energy burst from Zhou Haoyu’s body.
Then, his entire being soared like a sharp sword thrusting into the skies.
A golden mist enveloped him, swirling around him like a massive mountain falling from the clouds, carrying a terrifying force as it smashed towards Lin Yi.
"Hmph, mere child’s play!"
Lin Yi snorted coldly, his body erupting with brilliant sword light.
"Myriad Sword Technique!"
Lin Yi roared, waving his hand.
In an instant, resplendent golden swords, radiating terrifying fluctuations, materialized out of thin air, hovering mid-air, securely shielding Lin Yi within.
"Slash!"
At his command, Lin Yi clenched his hand.
Voom~!
The golden swords suddenly burst forth with a dazzling golden light, carrying a terrifying power that tore through the skies.
Sizzle! Sizzle! Sizzle!
The golden swords, like sharp blades, instantly slashed through Zhou Haoyu’s golden mist, completely shredding it.
"How, how is this possible?"
Seeing this scene, Zhou Haoyu’s eyes bulged in disbelief.
Zhou Haoyu was a powerful cultivator at the Eightfold Refinement!
But how could Lin Yi, who was merely at the Sevenfold Peak of Body Refinement, easily break through his technique?

chapters.title: Chapter 866 - 886: Shockingly Surprised
chapters.content:
Chapter 866: Chapter 886: Shockingly Surprised
Zhou Haoyu’s eyes were filled with horror and astonishment.
"How could this be, how is this possible!"
"Could it be that he has hidden his strength?"
Zhou Haoyu squinted, the thought popping into his mind, and he couldn’t help feeling worried.
If Lin Yi truly had concealed his strength, then this enemy was far too terrifying.
It should be noted that he had already reached the Peak of the Eighth Level of Body Refinement, while Lin Yi was only at the Seventh Level.
The gap was simply too large!
"Are you a disciple of the Heavenly Wolf Sect?"
Zhou Haoyu looked at Lin Yi and slowly asked.
"Yes, my name is Lin Yi, and I am an Outer Sect disciple!"
Lin Yi snorted coldly, his gaze sharp as he looked at Zhou Haoyu.
"You are an Inner Sect disciple of the Heavenly Wolf Sect, and I am only an Outer Sect disciple. You should address me as Uncle Master, otherwise, don’t blame me for being merciless!"
"Hmph, I think you should just obediently roll down!"
"However, considering you are an Inner Sect disciple of the Heavenly Wolf Sect, I will consider letting you off this time, but if you dare provoke me again, I will personally cripple your cultivation and send you to the Punishment Hall, where you will suffer endlessly and never transcend in death!"
Zhou Haoyu said with a grim look in his eyes.
"Want me to leave? First ask if they agree!"
Lin Yi pointed to the other Inner Sect disciples of the Heavenly Wolf Sect standing beside him and spoke indifferently.
Hearing this, Zhou Haoyu frowned slightly, then turned his head and asked the other Inner Sect disciples, "Who among you agrees with what I am doing?"
Upon hearing his words, the Heavenly Wolf Sect’s Inner Sect disciples shook their heads.
"Good, very good!"
Zhou Haoyu’s face was covered with frost, and a strong murderous intent emanated from him as he coldly said, "Since that is the case, then you shall all die!"
As Zhou Haoyu finished speaking, a golden mist around his body began to churn wildly.
He extended his hand and seized Lin Yi by the collar.
Lin Yi felt as if his body had sunk into a swamp, completely unable to move.
"Lin Yi, I give you three breaths of time to decide, either submit to me and become my female slave, or die!"
Zhou Haoyu spoke calmly.
His face bore a ferocious smile, and his eyes were filled with mockery.
Hearing this, Lin Yi clenched his teeth, anger evident in his eyes.
"Hmph!"
"What do you think you are? How dare you speak to me in that tone?"
Lin Yi snorted coldly, staring icily at Zhou Haoyu.
"What am I?"
"Heh, I am an Inner Sect disciple of the Heavenly Wolf Sect, the future successor, and you? You’re just an Outer Sect disciple, the gap between us is simply too large!"
Zhou Haoyu laughed out loud.
"No, I don’t believe it, I don’t believe it, you must be pretending, trying to scare me. I will not yield!"
Lin Yi shouted angrily, his eyes full of defiance.
"Alright, then let me put an end to your hopes!"
As his words fell, Zhou Haoyu slapped his Storage Ring and immediately took out a weapon, a Jade Slip.
"I will make you die here!"
Saying this, Zhou Haoyu, holding the weapon, fiercely stabbed towards Lin Yi.
"Hmph, you really are naive. Do you not know what kind of person I, Lin Yi, am?"
Lin Yi sneered, his body emanating a brilliant, dazzling golden light, like a golden sun, illuminating everything around.
Zhou Haoyu saw this scene, his eyebrows furrowed slightly, his expression growing solemn.
This golden light, he had seen it before in ancient texts.
The name of this power was called the "Great Sun Golden Yang Scripture!"
Reportedly, this was an ancient Cultivation Technique from the time of the ancients, a peerless Cultivation Technique left behind by a mighty figure from antiquity.
This cultivation technique, once practiced, absorbs the Golden Yang Qi, making the body as hard as iron.
Even, it can withstand the attacks of Martial Artists in the Body Refinement Realm, with a defense comparable to a Divine Artifact.
"Which sect are you a disciple of?"
Zhou Haoyu stared at Lin Yi and asked in a deep voice.
He hadn’t expected Lin Yi to be an Outer Sect disciple.
But how could an Outer Sect disciple have such formidable cultivation, to easily defeat him?
"I am indeed an Outer Sect disciple, but really, I’m an Inner Sect Disciple. And you? Merely an Inner Sect Disciple daring to challenge me, an Outer Sect Disciple - are you tired of living?"
Lin Yi responded mockingly.
Hearing this, Zhou Haoyu’s face darkened, filled with frustration and depression.
He was indeed an Inner Sect Disciple of the Heavenly Wolf Sect, even stronger than Lin Yi, yet unexpectedly, he couldn’t even handle a single move from Lin Yi.
Zhou Haoyu’s fists clenched tightly, his eyes revealing a fierce light.
He, a proud Inner Sect Disciple of the Heavenly Wolf Sect, was being mocked by a mere Outer Sect Disciple - how could he endure this?
"You’re seeking death!"
Zhou Haoyu shouted angrily, weapon in hand, he suddenly stabbed towards Lin Yi.
At that moment, Zhou Haoyu’s weapon, like a golden snake, coiled around Lin Yi, seeking to devour him.
The surrounding Inner Sect Disciples also drew their weapons and attacked Lin Yi.
"The ones seeking death are you!"
Lin Yi’s eyes flickered with a cold light, and a surge of golden light burst forth, transforming into a golden armor that covered his entire body.
Boom boom boom!
The next moment, a series of deafening sounds followed.
The attacks of these Inner Sect Disciples, for Lin Yi, were like mere tickles.
Lin Yi had no intention of fighting back, allowing Zhou Haoyu and the others to jump and hop around before him.
Watching Lin Yi, Zhou Haoyu’s pupils contracted, his face showing disbelief, his mouth gaping wide like he’d seen a ghost.
Their Heavenly Wolf Sect’s Inner Sect Disciples, attacking together, and still they couldn’t handle Lin Yi - how was this possible?
Could this guy really be at the Ninth Level of Body Refinement?
"Who exactly are you, and how come you have so many treasures? Have you encountered some incredible fortune?"
"No matter who you are, kneel and beg for mercy now, and we might let you live!"
Zhou Haoyu’s eyes flickered. After a moment’s hesitation, he spoke.
Although annoyed, he dared not continue the fight, so as to not disgrace the Heavenly Wolf Sect.
"Ha ha, I see you’re really pitiful idiots!"
"Did I tell you that I’m Lin Xuan?"
"Sorry, I’ve changed my name now. Do you still recognize me?"
Lin Yi laughed uproariously, shaking with laughter.
Hearing these words, Zhou Haoyu’s body trembled violently, almost collapsing to the ground.
"Lin, Lin Xuan... Are you Lin Xuan?"
"How could you possibly be Lin Xuan? I don’t believe it!"
Zhou Haoyu’s face turned ugly, his eyes filled with shock.
Lin Xuan, it was indeed Lin Xuan, a name he had heard countless times.
Years ago, his father’s cultivation was destroyed because of Lin Xuan.
Thus, he harbored a deep-seated hatred for Lin Xuan!
But back then, Lin Xuan had only just broken through to the Sixth Layer of Body Refinement, and it was still a long way from reaching the Seventh Layer—how could he possibly have advanced from the Fifth to the Sixth Layer in just a few hundred years?
Moreover, even if his father’s cultivation was restored, he wouldn’t be a match for Lin Xuan!
This was truly inconceivable.
Could there really be such a defy-the-heavens existence in this world?
At that moment, Zhou Haoyu finally believed in Lin Yi’s identity.
But he was still puzzled; Lin Yi’s father, being a Martial Artist at the Eighth Layer of Body Refinement, how could he have trained such an extraordinary son?

chapters.title: Chapter 867 - 887 The Reason Behind It
chapters.content:
Chapter 867: Chapter 887 The Reason Behind It
"Lin Yi, are you really Lin Xuan?"
"Your father?"
Zhou Haoyu fell silent for a moment, but eventually couldn’t help but ask.
He still wouldn’t accept it; he wanted to know the reason behind it all.
"Lin Xuan? Your father?"
When Lin Yi heard the name, a look of disdain flashed in his eyes and he sneered derisively, "You think you’re worthy of mentioning my father’s name?"
Upon hearing this, Zhou Haoyu’s heart skipped a beat.
His father was a genuine martial artist at the Ninth Level of body refinement, a super-master recognized throughout the entire Yunhai Empire.
In the Yunhai Empire, his name was known to all, let alone in other empires. His reputation was truly widespread.
Zhou Haoyu’s father was an extremely domineering and strong person.
He had a fiery temper, was prone to killing, and acted arrogantly and overbearingly. In the Heavenly Wolf Sect, he was notorious for being a spoiled and wasteful youth.
But such a man, surprisingly, raised Lin Xuan to be such a perverse genius. He really doubted whether this was just a coincidence.
"Your father was killed by someone two thousand years ago, and you’re his biological son. I’m not wrong, am I?"
A mischievous curve appeared on Lin Yi’s lips.
"Nonsense!"
Zhou Haoyu’s face darkened, and he gritted his teeth, "My father is an Inner Sect Disciple of the Heavenly Wolf Sect, while you, you’re just an Outer Sect
Disciple."
He did not believe that this young man before him could know so much about his father.
"Hehe..." Lin Yi shook his head with a mocking chuckle, "How do I know? I just happen to know, that’s all."
"You..."
Anger surged in Zhou Haoyu’s heart when he heard Lin Yi speak so contemptuously of his father, and he wanted to rush over and slap Lin Yi.
But he lacked the courage to do so.
Because Lin Yi was right, he was just an Outer Sect Disciple and a newcomer to the Heavenly Wolf Sect at that.
He didn’t even recognize his own father, so how could he possibly know about Lin Yi’s father’s deeds?
"Lin Yi, you’re going too far!" Zhou Haoyu clenched his fists tightly, his nails digging into his flesh.
His eyes were bloodshot, as if he were about to breathe fire, "Even if your father was powerful, he couldn’t control others, and you’re just an Outer Sect Disciple after all. Even if you know some secrets, so what? Can you change anything?"
The more Zhou Haoyu thought about it, the angrier and more aggrieved he felt.
Lin Yi’s father might be powerful, but he was confined to the bounds of the Yunhai Empire.
Throughout the entire Dongchen Continent, there were recluse masters far stronger than Lin Xuan’s father.
They even possessed combat capabilities surpassing a Ninth Level martial artist.
So, in their eyes, a Sixth Layer Peak martial artist like Lin Yi was simply insignificant.
What was more, Lin Yi’s father was killed two thousand years ago, and the perpetrator had more than once sent assassins to finish the job.
After Lin Yi’s father died, Lin Yi himself was sent to the remote Yunhai City, where he suffered constant bullying.
"Shut up!"
"You’re not worthy of mentioning my father!"
Lin Yi rebuked coldly, "My father’s reputation isn’t something just anyone can tarnish!"
"Lin Yi, you’re being too excessive!"
Zhou Haoyu’s face turned red, and veins bulged on his forehead, wishing he could tear Lin Yi to pieces right there and then.
But he dared not.
Lin Yi was, after all, a princess of the Royal House of the Yunhai Empire, with an extraordinary status. Even his master wouldn’t dare lay a hand on her rashly.
"You want to kill me?"
Lin Yi narrowed his eyes, looking at Zhou Haoyu with a mocking smile, his gaze playful.
"Dare not, dare not!"
Zhou Haoyu hastily waved his hands, "Just tell me how my father died, and I promise I’ll never speak of it again, deal?"
He did not want to die; he had a fiancée, and he had children.
Therefore, he couldn’t afford to offend this scourge.
"Haha!"
Lin Yi laughed loudly, "You really are utterly foolish. No wonder your father abandoned you."
He looked at Zhou Haoyu mockingly, "With your strength and intelligence, how could you possibly be a match for my father?"
"You..." Zhou Haoyu was at a loss for words but found none to refute.
"However..."
Lin Yi’s tone shifted, "Since you really want me to tell you about your father, then I’ll tell you!"
"Your father died at the age of seventeen," Lin Yi revealed astonishingly.
Zhou Haoyu’s pupils shrank sharply, his face filled with shock.
Seventeen?!
His father, only a year older than him?!
How could he be so fast?
"How... how is that possible?!"
"Heh, why not?"
Lin Yi snorted coldly, "Your father disappeared suddenly at the age of three. It was said that he encountered a powerful enemy and unfortunately perished."
"You’re talking nonsense!"
Zhou Haoyu’s face turned blue, his body trembling.
His eyes, moreover, were flashing with a bloodthirsty light, "Impossible, how could this be?!"
"Heh, if you don’t believe it, you can go ask your Royal Grandfather from the Yunhai Empire!"
"Royal Grandfather?" Zhou Haoyu’s pupils constricted, "Lin Yi, do not sow discord!"
"Oh?" Lin Yi’s lips curled with a sneer, "Then go ahead, ask your father."
"No need."
Zhou Haoyu said through gritted teeth, "You’re lying."
Lin Yi smiled, not responding to his words.
Seeing this, Zhou Haoyu’s rage rose from within, and with a swing of his fist, he lashed out at Lin Yi, "Today I’m going to give you a good lesson on behalf of my father, you bastard, daring to slander my father like this!"
"Heh..."
Lin Yi laughed coldly.
In front of him, Zhou Haoyu was nothing.
"Do you think I’d be afraid of you?" Zhou Haoyu shouted coldly, "Die!"
He swung his fist, aiming to smash Lin Yi’s chest into dust.
Lin Yi’s eyes grew cold, with a swift wave of his hand, Zhou Haoyu’s arm went numb, unable to move.
Then, he felt a sharp pain in his neck.
Lin Yi grabbed Zhou Haoyu by the collar and threw him to the ground.
"Ah~~~~!" Zhou Haoyu cried out in agony, falling in pain.
"Hmph."
Lin Yi snorted coldly, "What a brainless fool, daring to make a move on me; I wonder who gave you the courage!"
Zhou Haoyu lay on the ground, his eyes burning with hatred as he glared at Lin Yi.
"Lin Yi, don’t push people too far, otherwise my father will never let you off!"
Lin Yi was taken aback.
"Oh? Is your father that powerful?"
Zhou Haoyu’s face lit up with sudden ecstasy, replacing the anger.
"Yes! My father is an extremely powerful expert of the Heavenly Spirit Realm!"
"Is that so? Then where is he, why haven’t I seen him?"
Lin Yi raised an eyebrow, "If you’re lying, you will be punished."
"I have no need to lie!"
"Fine, then I’ll let you witness your father’s might!"
Lin Yi shouted, and a powerful aura burst forth from his body.
"Ah!"
Zhou Haoyu felt an invisible oppression that almost prevented him from breathing.
He felt as though his heart was being squeezed by something, having difficulty breathing, his face turning red.
"Bang!"
Lin Yi threw Zhou Haoyu to the ground, sneering, "Now, still dare to act tough with me?"
Zhou Haoyu lay on the ground, coughing violently.
He struggled to his feet, his eyes filled with venomous hate as he stared at Lin Yi and said deliberately, "Just you wait, I will have my revenge!"
Lin Yi shrugged nonchalantly.
"I’ll wait, but not now, because you simply aren’t qualified!"
"I..."
Zhou Haoyu was clenching his teeth in anger, but he was unable to refute.
Lin Yi was telling the truth.

chapters.title: Chapter 868 - 888: Dare Not Disobey the Order
chapters.content:
Chapter 868: Chapter 888: Dare Not Disobey the Order
