If he had the cultivation of the Heavenly Spirit Realm, perhaps he could have fought Lin Yi to a standstill.
But now, he was no match for Lin Yi at all.
"Remember, don’t even think about running away! I dare not disobey your father’s orders."
Lin Yi snorted coldly, "You’d better pray that your father survives, otherwise, even if he does by chance, he’ll have to hide for his entire life!"
A deep hatred flashed in Zhou Haoyu’s eyes.
Did anyone else know about his father’s affairs?
Could it be... could his father’s demise be related to Lin Yi?
Seeing the gloomy expression on Zhou Haoyu’s face, Lin Yi knew he must have thought of something and couldn’t help but sneer, "What? Do you suspect that I caused your father’s death?"
Zhou Haoyu’s body trembled violently, "Did you kill my father?"
"Indeed, it was I."
Lin Yi nodded with a smile, without a hint of shame.
"How dare you do it and admit it?!"
"Admit it?"
Lin Yi shook his head disdainfully, "I’m only admitting my courage. I killed your father because he deserved to die, he deserved it! Moreover, it was your father who killed my parents! Your father was no better than a beast, unworthy of being a father!"
"Lin Yi!"
Zhou Haoyu roared with fury, wishing he could rush forward and tear Lin Yi to shreds.
Lin Yi scoffed, "If you had the strength, you would have acted long ago, why would you need me to do it?"
"You..."
Zhou Haoyu’s face turned red but he was at a loss for words.
Indeed, he was no match for Lin Yi.
"I’ll warn you again, don’t provoke me, or I’ll make you beg for life and death!"
Lin Yi spoke coldly, "Get lost, and do not let me see you again, otherwise, I won’t hesitate to give you a taste of what I just did!"
"Get out, get out now!" Lin Yi barked angrily.
"Fine, I will leave."
Zhou Haoyu left with gritted teeth and in a rage.
Watching Zhou Haoyu’s retreating figure, Lin Yi sneered coldly.
"Hmph, I really don’t know where you got the courage to trouble me, simply tired of living."
He turned to the two men in black.
"Drag them away!"
"Yes!"
The two men in black replied and dragged Zhou Haoyu away.
"Kid, let’s leave quickly."
As soon as Lin Yi finished speaking, four men in black appeared beside him.
"Let’s go."
Lin Yi gave everyone a brief glance and then turned to leave.
His recent actions had already alerted the academy.
They would not let the matter rest.
Therefore, he had to leave quickly, otherwise, a disaster would surely await him.
Zhou Haoyu was carried away.
His father, Zhou Yuanfeng, had not returned, and their plan had failed.
Lin Yi, along with the two men in black, retreated swiftly.
...
Elsewhere.
At a certain spot on a hillside.
"Young Master, did you see that? That piece of trash Lin Yi actually made a move on Zhou Haoyu! And he killed Zhou Haoyu!"
"Yes, Zhou Haoyu’s father is a powerhouse of the Heavenly Spirit Realm, Lin Yi is definitely doomed this time!"
"Ha-ha, he’s finally dead!"
"Young Master, your vengeance has been served at last!"
A handsome man sat on a rock, gazing into the sky, deep in thought.
After a long while, a cold arc appeared at the corners of his mouth, "Lin Yi... Interesting!"
"Young Master, now that Lin Yi is dead, what should we do next?" a man in black asked respectfully.
"No rush, let’s wait and see!"
The handsome young man sipped his tea leisurely and spoke slowly.
"Yes, Young Master!"
The man in black respectfully saluted, then withdrew.
The handsome young man lifted his gaze to the horizon and murmured, "Lin Yi... huh... interesting..."
******
Half a year flew by.
Lin Yi’s days in Tianxing City were growing ever longer, and his cultivation had advanced considerably.
"Junior brother, did you manage to find a suitable weapon this time while you were back?"
"I haven’t thought it through yet, but don’t worry, senior brother, I definitely won’t disappoint you!"
"Mm, then I’ll be waiting for you!"
Lin Yi nodded slightly, then left the room.
He had just stepped out when he saw Su Chen standing at the door.
Upon seeing Su Chen, surprise flickered in Lin Yi’s eyes.
"What are you doing here?"
"Do you even need to ask why I’m here? Of course, it’s because you had me stay here!"
Su Chen pursed his lips and glared at him crossly.
"Oh, I see."
Lin Yi suddenly understood, then looked at Su Chen with a grin.
"Junior brother, you’ve been of great help to your senior sister these days! I really ought to thank you properly! Would you be interested in visiting our academy?"
Su Chen frowned. He didn’t like being watched, so he immediately refused.
"I do not have the time!"
Seeing this, Lin Yi felt somewhat disappointed.
"No matter, take your time to think it over, I’m heading back to my room!"
"Goodbye, senior brother."
Lin Yi waved to Su Chen and turned to go back.
"Hmph, you brat, do you know our young master’s identity? You dare to refuse! Just you wait!"
"Our young master is the only child of a Heavenly Spirit Realm powerhouse and is very likely to become the heir of the Tianxing Domain! He has taken a liking to you, your refusal is futile!"
Lin Yi heard the murmuring behind him, a fierce glint flashing in his eyes.
"I’ll let you roam free for a few more days, I refuse to believe that your luck can be better than mine!"
A crazed light twinkled in Lin Yi’s eyes.
...
In the blink of an eye, three more days passed.
That evening, Lin Yi awoke in the cultivation room.
"I feel a bit tired these days."
Lin Yi stretched his body, a trace of fatigue evident in his eyes.
Lately, Lin Yi had been in a constant state of high alert, guarding against those who sought to harm him in the shadows as well as being wary of Zhou Haoyu.
Though Zhou Haoyu had been severely injured, he was, after all, the son of a Heavenly Spirit Realm powerhouse. Who knew when Zhou Yuanfeng might break through his bottleneck and ascend to the Heavenly Spirit Realm?
Lin Yi dared not slack off.
Thus, even though he was tired, he could not afford to relax.
"I must seize the time to cultivate and strive to step into the Heavenly Spirit Realm sooner rather than later, then leave this cursed place, leave the Zhou Family behind!"
Lin Yi’s mind shifted, and he entered the virtual space.
In the virtual space, Su Chen sat cross-legged on a cushion.
"This haul is truly bountiful, having secured two Seventh Rank Demon Cores and some parts of a cultivation technique. I really wonder what this technique is."
Su Chen flipped through the Technique Jade Slip in his hand, a satisfied smile on his face.
"With this retreat, perhaps my strength can be enhanced!"
"Here’s hoping for even greater gains!"
...
Day after day, Lin Yi was immersed in cultivation.
During this period, Zhou Haoyu and Zhou Yuanfeng were not idle either.
Both were seeking opportunities to deal with Lin Yi and had been plotting in the dark on how to eliminate him.
Unfortunately, every time Lin Yi left his home, a team always followed to protect him, making it impossible for them to find an opportunity to strike.
Moreover, even if there was an opportunity, the shadow guards protected him relentlessly, leaving them no chance.
His cultivation had already reached the peak of the Sixth Grade Condensing Realm, just one step away from the Sixth Grade. With just one more Elixir, he would be able to break through.

chapters.title: Chapter 869 - 889: Feeling Very Depressed
chapters.content:
Chapter 869: Chapter 889: Feeling Very Depressed
Regrettably, that step was too difficult to take, so his mood was very gloomy.
Moreover, these past days, he had discovered that Lin Yi seemed to also be cultivating.
"Is he actually starting to cultivate?"
Zhou Haoyu was full of doubt and surprise; he had never expected that Lin Yi would be cultivating too!
"Hmph, this time you will definitely not beat me, no matter if you’ve had a fortuitous encounter, don’t even dream of evading my pursuit again!"
Zhou Haoyu gritted his teeth, his fists creaking as he clenched them.
"Hmph, this time I must deal him a fatal blow!"
Intense hatred blazed in Zhou Haoyu’s eyes.
He hated Lin Yi for stealing his thunder.
His own strength was already quite formidable, yet Lin Yi always seemed to suppress him by a level.
Moreover, lately Lin Yi’s strength had made leaps and bounds, a situation that truly left him restless.
He had to kill Lin Yi before he had fully recovered, nip him in the bud!
He could not endure it a moment longer.
He could hardly wait to kill Lin Yi!
...
In a blink of an eye, a month had passed.
During this month, Zhou Haoyu and Zhou Yuanfeng had been shadowing Lin Yi, seeking to find a weakness in his cultivation time to take the opportunity to eliminate him!
But after a month, they had discovered nothing, which also sapped their patience and escalated their anger.
One day, Lin Yi awoke from his cultivation.
"It seems they’ve given up; otherwise, why would they not appear for a whole month?"
Lin Yi muttered to himself with a hint of ridicule in his eyes.
"If that’s the case, then don’t blame me for making a move!"
Lin Yi let out a low shout, and his aura exploded in an instant.
The next second, he soared into the sky, his figure disappearing into the night.
He did not go directly after Zhou Yuanfeng and the others, but instead sought out another group of people.
These people’s Cultivation levels were all at the Heavenly Spirit Realm, and they were all direct disciples nurtured by the Zhou Family, with very powerful strength, totaling four or five hundred individuals.
Four or five hundred Heavenly Spirit Realm experts!
In the past, Lin Yi would have been terrified out of his wits just at the thought, but now, he felt only indifference facing these men.
"Master Lin!"
Upon seeing Lin Yi, the four or five hundred Zhou Family descendants all bowed in unison and called out.
In this world, the strong were revered; nobody would belittle the weak due to nobility of status, which was also the reason Zhou Yuanfeng held Lin Yi in such high regard.
"You are all my friends; there’s no need to be so formal with me in the future!"
"Yes!"
Lin Yi nodded lightly, then got straight to the point, "May I know if there’s anything you need my assistance with?"
"Hehe, Master Lin, the matter at hand is of great importance, so we won’t beat around the bush!"
"Master Lin, have you offended Young Master Zhou?"
A young man dressed in a splendid brocade robe came forward, smiling.
This person was none other than Zhou Yuanfeng’s second son, Zhou Tianyang.
"Yes, they’ve sent quite a few people to assassinate me; if it weren’t for my tough luck, I probably wouldn’t be here by now,"
Lin Yi sighed and said.
"Haha, if that’s the case, then you should join our Zhou Family!"
At these words, Zhou Tianyang laughed heartily and slapped his chest, making a grand offer.
"Zhou Family?"
Lin Yi’s gaze sharpened.
This was a massive force.
Although the Zhou Family was merely a secular clan, its strength was not to be underestimated, especially that prodigy of the Heavenly Martial Continent who was hailed as the future ruler of the Heavenly Martial Continent!
"How about it, willing to join us? As long as you join our Zhou Family, even Zhou Yuanfeng and Zhou Yuanlong won’t be able to touch you in the future."
Zhou Tianyang watched Lin Yi with a smile.
"Heh, truly like someone from the Zhou Family to speak so frankly."
Lin Yi laughed, then shook his head, "Sorry, I’ve already decided to join the Zhou Family! No matter what, I must resolve them with my own hands!"
Upon hearing these words, the expressions of Zhou Tianyang and the others immediately darkened.
They had not expected the other party to be so unappreciative.
As the overlords of the Zhou Family City, countless people were desperate to join; yet Lin Yi still sought to join them—was he provoking the Zhou Family?
"Lin Yi, you really are oblivious," said Zhou Haoyu, with a cold glint flashing across his face.
"Lin Yi, I advise you to think carefully. The Zhou Family is the overlord of the Zhou Family City. Within the entire city, neither the Heavenly Spirit Realm nor the Innate Realm are forces you can afford to provoke."
"If you join the Zhou Family, you can have everything, and even I will treat you with the utmost respect. If you reject my invitation, I wouldn’t mind making your life worse than death!"
"Not only that, the Zhou Family will bestow upon you immense benefits, even more precious than joining the Zhou Family itself!"
"I advise you to consider it well!"
...
People spoke one after another.
Zhou Haoyu, Zhou Yuanfeng, and Zhou Wenlong did not show any weakness; the three brothers were outstanding figures in the Zhou Family, enjoying generous resources and status.
Moreover, they had an older brother, a leading figure among the younger generation of the Zhou Family.
Faced with such generous offers, Lin Yi’s refusal caused them to lose face, as they had offered the best terms, yet the other party remained unmoved!
This infuriated them greatly.
"Heh, you really like to overestimate yourselves, really thinking I don’t know your plans?" Lin Yi sneered.
"Oh, since you know, then why do you still refuse? Could it be you think you can defeat the Zhou Family?" Zhou Tianyang frowned, a hint of wariness rising in his heart.
"Heh, I have the strength, but what can you do to me?" A hint of scorn touched the corners of Lin Yi’s mouth, mockery flitting through his eyes.
Although his cultivation was only at the Soul Condensation Realm, he possessed a physique comparable to the Heavenly Spirit Realm. Coupled with the Divine Sword, he was like two Heavenly Spirit Realm warriors besieging together, and he also mastered the Nine Revolutions Reincarnation Technique, indubitably matching the peak of the Soul Condensation Realm in combat power!
Even against someone at the intermediate stage of the Soul Condensation Realm, he could hold his ground!
Moreover, on this continent, there were many powerful figures hidden away; if they were angered, Lin Yi couldn’t guarantee if they would reveal themselves.
Therefore, to be on the safe side, Lin Yi did not want to take the risk.
However, Zhou Haoyu and the others did not see it that way.
"Lin Yi, I know you’re formidable, but you haven’t fully grown yet. If you’re willing to join the Zhou Family, you will be our most outstanding disciple. In the future, the resources of the Zhou Family will be shared with you, and I can even guarantee that your cultivation speed will be incredibly fast!"
"As long as you follow us, you will enjoy endless prosperity."
"Moreover, you can have many beautiful servants; you’ll be able to embrace life with joy from all sides!"
Zhou Tianyang continued to tempt.
They were all young men, naturally possessing a fervent heart, unable to resist beautiful women.
Many were already restless, itching to immediately take Lin Yi under their command.
Zhou Tianyang’s words indeed stirred Lin Yi’s heart.
But Lin Yi had a strong will, utterly unaffected by any influence.

chapters.title: Chapter 870 - 890: No Need to Waste Effort Anymore
chapters.content:
Chapter 870: Chapter 890: No Need to Waste Effort Anymore
He smiled and said, "I have enough maids, and they are all loyal to me. I don’t need anyone else to command them, so don’t waste your efforts—I won’t be joining the Zhou Family."
Upon hearing this, a flash of anger crossed the eyes of Zhou Haoyu and the others.
What did Lin Yi mean by this? Did he not want to become a member of the Zhou Family? Was he thinking of reneging?
That was completely unacceptable!
"Since that’s the case, don’t blame us for being ruthless!"
Zhou Tianyang’s face turned grim and terrifying.
In the next moment, he violently waved his hand and bellowed, "Attack, take him down!"
As his words fell, more than ten figures suddenly appeared in front of Lin Yi; each exuded the aura of the Soul Condensation Realm as they lunged to attack him!
Seeing this scene, several core disciples of the Zhou Family laughed, feeling immensely satisfied.
This Lin Yi, he truly did not know his own limits.
The Zhou Family was one of the top four powers in Donglan City, their strength unmatched and overwhelming. And yet, he dared to say he would not join the Zhou Family—it was sheer arrogance.
"Heh, Lin Yi, Lin Yi, let’s see where you can run to now," Zhou Tianyang sneered.
The others echoed his sentiments.
"Kid, I advise you to surrender obediently and spare yourself the agony."
"That’s right, the strength of our Zhou Family is not something a bumpkin like you can fathom. I urge you to submit to the Zhou Family!"
"Heh, I think you’re either stupid or brain-dead!"
"Hahahaha..."
The people of the Zhou Family mocked brazenly, looking at Lin Yi with utter disdain as if they had already sealed his fate.
"Heh, it’s true that the Zhou Family is one of the top four powers in Donglan City, and yes, the Zhou Family’s patriarch is a Transformation Pill Realm powerhouse, with unfathomable strength. But you have seriously underestimated me."
"Zhou Haoyu, Zhou Yuanfeng, Zhou Yuantao, I acknowledge that you are strong, but I am no pushover either."
Lin Yi snorted coldly, his eyes shining with a sharp glint.
On this continent, strength was the law!
"Good, today I want to see just how strong you really are and whether you can withstand the Pill Condensation Realm!"
Zhou Tianyang roared furiously, his feet stomping the ground hard as he transformed into a beam of light rushing towards Lin Yi!
"Lin Yi, just enjoy the gift I’m sending your way, heh, once I capture you, I’ll make sure you wish you were dead!"
Zhou Haoyu said with a vicious smile.
"Lin Yi, we will make you kneel and call us grandpa!"
Zhou Yuanfeng also sneered.
Seeing their demeanor, Lin Yi sighed slightly in his heart. These people were too arrogant and domineering, not taking him seriously at all.
"Heh, I’m waiting," Lin Yi said with a faint smile, showing no fear.
The next moment, Lin Yi’s figure suddenly burst forth, shooting towards Zhou Tianyang like lightning!
Bang!
Two terrifying auras collided, stirring up fierce gusts of wind!
Zhou Haoyu, Zhou Yuanfeng, and Zhou Tianyang were all sent staggering back several steps, their expressions turning exceedingly unsightly.
"How could Lin Yi’s strength have advanced so dramatically?!"
Zhou Yuanfeng’s pupils shrunk.
Zhou Tianyang was utterly shocked. It hadn’t been long, and Lin Yi had gone from the Eightfold Early Stage to the Soul Condensation Realm!
Such speed was simply terrifying!
Zhou Tianyang’s heart was filled with doubt and worry. Could it be that the power behind Lin Yi had given him some Elixirs to amplify his strength?
Otherwise, such results would be impossible!
"Damn it!"
Zhou Yuanfeng’s eyes flashed, and he said coldly, "No matter the cost, we must kill him!"
"Yes!"
The others shouted in unison, charging at Lin Yi once again.
"Heh, since that’s the case, then let me show you my true strength!"
Lin Yi said with a cold laugh.
As his words ended, he raised his arms violently, and two black-and-white longswords appeared, spinning above his head, emanating a chilling intent to kill!
"Sword Soul?"
Zhou Tianyang and the others felt a shiver in their hearts when they saw Lin Yi’s movements.
"What sword technique is this, how come I’ve never seen it before?" Zhou Tianyang couldn’t help but exclaim.
It was also the first time for everyone present to see Lin Yi’s movements.
"It’s indeed worthy of someone in the Soul Condensation Realm, actually able to invoke the Sword Soul, no wonder he is so arrogant!" Zhou Yuanfeng silently nodded in approval.
While Lin Yi’s invocation of the Sword Soul drastically increased his strength, to everyone present who were all superpower-strong individuals in the Soul Condensation Realm, even if he was in the early stages of the Soul Condensation Realm, they still didn’t take him seriously.
"Kill!" Lin Yi shouted loudly, swinging both hands fiercely, sword light flickering, sweeping toward Zhou Tianyang and the other two!
Seeing this, Zhou Tianyang and the others also quickly executed their own swordsmanship, attempting to fend off Lin Yi’s attack!
Boom boom boom...
For a moment, terrifying energies collided, severely shaking the void around them.
"So strong!" The expressions on Zhou Tianyang and the others’ faces changed dramatically, feeling even more horrified by Lin Yi’s formidable presence after sensing it!
Who exactly is this youth, and how could he be so monstrously talented!
"Zhou Tianyang, I advise you to surrender quietly, otherwise, don’t blame me for being merciless!" Lin Yi’s icy voice rang out.
Hearing this, Zhou Tianyang and the others felt their hearts clench.
Merciless?
Dammit, isn’t that a bit over the top!
"Lin Yi, stop dreaming!" Zhou Haoyu said through clenched teeth.
He didn’t expect Lin Yi to be so unreasonable.
"Is that so? Well, I’ll be waiting." Lin Yi’s mouth curved into a strange arc, a cold light surging in his eyes.
He knew these people would definitely not let things go easily, but as long as he stayed in Heavenly Martial City, they would be powerless against him!
"Lin Yi, you’re truly seeking your own death. We are not worthless like Zhou Haoyu and his group!" Zhou Tianyang rebuked angrily.
Lin Yi smiled coldly, without speaking.
"Hmph, Lin Yi, do you think we really have no way to deal with you? I’ll tell you, we have ways to capture you, then force the power backing you to hand you over!" Zhou Haoyu spoke gravely.
"Oh? Is that so? How do you plan to capture me?" Lin Yi asked with a raised eyebrow.
He certainly didn’t believe that the Zhou Family had the ability to catch him.
After all, the Zhou Family was just a minor family, how could they possibly have the means to catch him?
"Of course, by torture! We are the Young Masters of the grand Zhou Family, how could we possibly be lenient to our enemies?!" Zhou Haoyu snorted coldly.
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly.
The Zhou Family, Zhou Haoyu?
He seemed to have heard this surname before.
"Zhou Haoyu, how do you intend to torture me?" Lin Yi said mockingly, looking at Zhou Haoyu.
Hearing this, a malicious look flashed through Zhou Haoyu’s eyes: "Humph, Lin Yi, this has nothing to do with you. You just need to cooperate quietly, but if you’re unwilling to do so, then I don’t mind crippling you!"
"Oh? Is that so? Well, I’d like to see what kind of state you can beat me into!" Lin Yi sneered, his Yuan Force starting to circulate, his body emanating a dense Yuan Force.
"Hmph, you’re really asking for death!" Zhou Tianyang shouted coldly, and then threw a punch toward Lin Yi.
"Scram!" Lin Yi bellowed, extending his right palm to meet the incoming blow head-on.

chapters.title: Chapter 871 - 891: A Bout of Unsteady Qi-Blood
chapters.content:
Chapter 871: Chapter 891: A Bout of Unsteady Qi-Blood
"Bang!"
Lin Yi grunted, reeling backward continuously, his Qi-Blood churning and instability surging within him!
"How is this possible, his cultivation is clearly much lower than mine, yet he can block my attack!"
Zhou Tianyang looked at Lin Yi with doubtful amazement.
"Hehe, your strength is indeed weak, but I also can’t guarantee that I can completely suppress you!"
Lin Yi chuckled, shaking his head with a hint of mockery flashing in his eyes.
"Zhou Haoyu, you take action too! I don’t want to waste time!"
"Alright!"
Zhou Haoyu nodded, channeling his Sword Soul as he thrust his sword towards Lin Yi.
Although Lin Yi’s strength was higher than his, after all he was only in the Early Stage of the Soul Condensation Realm, so he was not frightened.
Zhou Haoyu and Zhou Yuanfeng teamed up, instantly surrounding Lin Yi, forming a circular attack ring, leaving Lin Yi no way to escape!
The strength of Zhou Yuanfeng and Zhou Haoyu had increased many times compared to before, especially Zhou Yuanfeng, who had reached the Intermediate Stage Peak of the Soul Condensation Realm, his power was enormously strong, almost comparable to a Later Stages powerhouse of the Soul Condensation Realm.
This result slightly surprised Lin Yi, but he was even more delighted.
Because, he felt that Zhou Tianyang and Zhou Yuanfeng’s cultivation was getting weaker.
Clearly, they were intentionally disguising their strength, aiming to let him lower his guard and then ambush him.
As long as their ambush succeeded, he would suffer devastating damage!
And now, they had finally shown their slip!
"Hmph, wanting to kill me, even a Latter Stages powerhouse of the Soul Condensation Realm can’t do it!"
A sneer curled at the corner of Lin Yi’s mouth.
The next moment, his figure burst forth, throwing a punch towards Zhou Haoyu’s head, simultaneously, his sword hacked down!
The sword flash shattered the void, splitting it as it ferociously chopped down towards Zhou Haoyu!
"Zhou Yuanfeng, you go distract him first, after we deal with this runt, cleaning up him won’t be late!"
Zhou Haoyu sneered, shouting at Zhou Yuanfeng nearby.
He had already treated Zhou Yuanfeng as cannon fodder, not expecting him to block Lin Yi at all!
Upon hearing this, Zhou Yuanfeng’s face darkened instantly, cursing: "Zhou Haoyu, to think you’re also named Zhou Haoyu, pushing your brother out as cannon fodder, it’s simply disgraceful!"
"Haha, Zhou Yuanfeng, at a time like this, don’t argue with me so much! Hurry up and go die!"
Zhou Haoyu scoffed disdainfully, then crazy Yuan Force surged into the longsword he held.
Buzz~!
Instantly, the longsword erupted with a blinding sword flash, like a proud sun glaring brightly!
The sword flash dazzled with brilliant radiance, carrying terrifying Sword Qi and sharp Sword Intent, slashing fiercely towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s eyelids twitched, a hint of wariness rising in his eyes, his wrist flicked, and the longsword spun up, forming a sword curtain, enveloping himself inside!
Sizzle!
Sizzla!
Fine sword marks appeared on the sword curtain, the sword blade radiating terrifying Sword Qi and sharpness.
"Lin Yi, die!"
Zhou Haoyu sneered, his longsword swinging out, sword flash rampaging wildly, like a fierce wind and sudden shower, bombarding densely towards Lin Yi!
Lin Yi’s eyes flickered, clutching his longsword, he counterattacked furiously!
Sword Qi, like lithe snakes, sprang from the hilt, crazily strangling Zhou Haoyu’s sword moves.
"What formidable swordsmanship!"
Zhou Tianyang and Zhou Yuanfeng, seeing this, their pupils suddenly shrank, their faces full of shock.
They hadn’t expected Lin Yi’s swordsmanship to be so profound and unfathomable!
At this moment, they realized that Lin Yi was not as weak as he appeared on the surface, and might even surpass them in swordsmanship!
How could a cultivator, who had only recently advanced to the Intermediate Stage of the Soul Condensation Realm, possess such profound swordsmanship?
"Indeed, it’s Lin Yi. Truly extraordinary!"
Zhou Haoyu and Zhou Yuanfeng murmured to themselves.
"Lin Yi, die!"
Zhou Haoyu yelled, his longsword bursting with even more ferocious power, a terrifying Sword Qi erupting from it.
This Sword Qi was extremely fearsome, carrying with it sharp, dominating, and fierce power!
This was a strength unique to the strong ones in the Soul Condensation Realm!
Zhou Yuanfeng wasn’t idle either; flames burst from his body, coalescing into a giant firebird that pounced towards Lin Yi, its scorching heat and terrifying Sword Qi instantly enveloping Lin Yi’s body.
"Lin Yi, accept your death!"
Zhou Yuanfeng said with a sinister smile.
"Hmph, overestimating yourself, die!"
Lin Yi coldly shouted, his gaze sharpening, his body suddenly shrinking like a magic trick, vanishing in an instant, and in the next second, he appeared behind Zhou Haoyu, a sword slashing towards Zhou Haoyu’s neck.
Zhou Haoyu’s pupils dilated suddenly, staring in horror at Lin Yi behind him, his heart feeling as if it was being tightly gripped, extremely uncomfortable.
He wanted to run, to shift the battlefield, but he didn’t have the power to do so, and could only allow Lin Yi’s sword to come down.
"Damn it!"
Zhou Haoyu glared angrily at Zhou Yuanfeng, gritting his teeth: "Idiot! Quickly die for me!"
Before his words finished, a massive force suddenly surged into Zhou Yuanfeng’s body, sending him flying!
Bang!
He heavily crashed to the ground, spitting blood, his eyes rolling back, fainting.
"Zhou Haoyu, you... you... you are so despicable!"
Zhou Yuanfeng’s angry shout echoed throughout, sending chills down the spine.
However, Zhou Haoyu didn’t care at all and continued to manipulate the longsword in his hand, frantically bombing at Lin Yi!
"Haha, despicable? That word should be coming from you!"
Zhou Haoyu laughed wildly, his smile filled with intense self-satisfaction and ferocity!
Zhou Yuanfeng lay on the ground, bleeding from his mouth and nose, his eyes bulging wide, displaying an unwillingness to die.
This made Zhou Haoyu’s heart feel elated, and his smile grew even brighter.
"Little beast, aren’t you very strong? Aren’t you very arrogant? Today, you will taste my power, haha, let me see if you can withstand my sword!"
Zhou Haoyu took a step forward, his longsword chopping down hard, the tip filled with terrifying Yuan Force fluctuations!
Lin Yi frowned, his eyes slightly narrowing, a peculiar glint flashing through them.
This guy could actually mobilize Yuan Force, which was totally unexpected!
Lin Yi knew, Zhou Haoyu was not any ordinary Martial Artist in the Later Stages of the Soul Condensation Realm.
Usually, Lin Yi might not care, but now, he was undergoing tribulation, and the Yuan Force stored in his body was almost completely depleted.
And with Zhou Haoyu being a Peak force in the Later Stages of the Soul Condensation Realm, Lin Yi’s strength was bound to be greatly discounted.
If he was careless and got injured, he might not be able to complete the tribulation and would ultimately perish in the Heavenly Punishment Forest!
"All in!"
Lin Yi gritted his teeth, his longsword suddenly trembling, a dazzling sword glow bursting out, colliding with Zhou Haoyu’s longsword, producing a crisp sound.
Pfft!
Lin Yi spouted blood, his body like a broken kite, sent flying hundreds of meters away.
"Damn it! You dare to resist? Seeking death!"
A flash of infuriated shame crossed Zhou Haoyu’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 872 - 892: The Battle Is Too Brutal
chapters.content:
Chapter 872: Chapter 892: The Battle Is Too Brutal
He had long suspected that Lin Yi was not a simple man, yet he never imagined that this fellow would dare to resist him!
"Little beast, you are merely at the Intermediate Stage of the Soul Condensation Realm, yet you dare to strike at me, you’re utterly ignorant of life and death!"
Zhou Haoyu roared in anger, and with a swing of his longsword, countless swords tore through the air, assaulting Lin Yi like a barrage of torrential pear blossoms needles!
"Damn it!"
Lin Yi cursed under his breath, a flash of panic crossing his eyes.
"Uncle Lin Yi, don’t worry about me, unleash your full power, I’ll help you withstand this attack!"
It was at this moment that a familiar voice reached Lin Yi’s ears, reviving his spirits. He then let out a thunderous roar, Yuan Force surging throughout his body, with his longsword emitting a faint golden glow.
"Little mongrel, today, you must die!"
Zhou Haoyu snorted coldly, the longsword in his hand chopping down once more, with numerous swords coming wildly howling towards him.
"Brother Lin Yi, I believe in you!"
Zhou Yuanfeng clenched his teeth, his gaze steadfast, grabbing the crimson long knife in his hand and slashing down furiously.
Boom, boom, boom!
The heavens crumbled, and a terrifying surge of Yuan Force swept across all directions, raising a cloud of dust in the air.
Their battle was too ferocious; the entire mountain range was leveled, pockmarked with pits and troughs.
Lin Yi’s clothes were torn, his skin covered with sword wounds, and the corners of his mouth were smeared with crimson blood, his appearance quite ragged.
On the other side, Zhou Yuanfeng was in no better condition, his body riddled with bloody holes, his skull almost split in half.
Both parties were grievously injured!
A hint of surprise flashed across Lin Yi’s face, followed quickly by a surge of joy.
"Great! Zhou Yuanfeng hasn’t let me down, he has indeed done it!"
Lin Yi couldn’t help but laugh heartily, the joy in his eyes intensifying.
Although Lin Yi did not know why Zhou Yuanfeng suddenly became so brave, he still felt comforted and happy for him.
In this world, apart from his parents and Ye Qiu, perhaps Zhou Yuanfeng was the most friendly to him?
"Boy, you’re quite the character!"
At that moment, a hoarse and weak voice suddenly rang out.
"Boy, you really haven’t disappointed me!"
The hoarse and weak voice echoed again, Lin Yi’s heart shuddered, he quickly turned his head, and saw a grey-robed old man standing not far away, his face tired and sickly, as if he might die at any time.
"Who are you?"
Lin Yi frowned and asked.
This grey-robed old man gave him a very strange feeling, like a dead man!
"Who am I? Heh heh!"
The grey-robed old man shook his head, sighing, "You’ve already guessed, why still ask?"
Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat, feeling as if the old man might know something, he pressed on: "Who exactly are you?"
"I am Li Yunxiao!"
"Are you the legendary Li Yunxiao?"
Lin Yi asked in amazement.
Li Yunxiao smiled and said, "Indeed, it’s me!"
"So it’s you, old man, your fate seems to have been decided, doomed that today you shall die without a doubt!"
Lin Yi sneered, "I advise you to save your breath, you are on a path to death, no matter how you struggle, it will be in vain!"
"Haha, Lin Yi, don’t try to win by mere words. Your strength is indeed not as good as mine, but I’m not afraid to tell you, before reaching the Intermediate Stage of Soul Condensation Realm, you are no match for me!"
Li Yunxiao smiled indifferently, speaking confidently.
"Hmph, I don’t believe your nonsense!"
Lin Yi huffed, a fierce gleam in his eyes, he exclaimed, "If you can defeat me, then consider me defeated! But if you can’t do it, then just admit defeat quietly and stop wasting time."
"Fine, I agree, if I can’t do it, I will admit defeat. But what if I fortunately win against you?"
Li Yunxiao’s eyes revealed a playful look, seemingly full of confidence in Lin Yi.
"If you win against me, I am willing to surrender my life to you."
Lin Yi agreed without hesitation.
Lin Yi also understood that he had reached the point where his strength was exhausted, and it would be decent enough if he could save his own life, let alone the fact that if Li Yunxiao could win against him, he himself would have made a profit!
"Very well! I hope you keep your promise!"
Li Yunxiao smiled and said, "You recover from your injuries first. Later, I will defeat you."
"No need, we can do it now!"
Lin Yi said indifferently, his figure shifting as he retreated backward.
"Hm? Lin Yi, what are you trying to do?!"
Li Yunxiao frowned, looking at him puzzledly and said, "Don’t tell me you’re thinking of conceding?"
Lin Yi shook his head and said with a light smile, "Since you mentioned that neither of us has defeated the other, why don’t we have a competition?"
"A competition? How?"
Li Yunxiao asked in surprise.
"I don’t need your help to defeat the opponent in this competition. I just need you to make a move and severely injure him!"
Lin Yi said, "That way, I can make sure that I can beat you."
Li Yunxiao paused for a moment upon hearing this, a hint of confusion emerging in his mind.
He had never thought about having Lin Yi help him defeat the opponent.
But since Lin Yi had suggested it, he naturally wouldn’t refuse.
"How do you want to compete?"
"It’s simple. Just strike him down, and I will concede voluntarily!"
Lin Yi said, "Of course, you can also refuse, but that would mean my victory comes at the expense of your sacrifice!"
Li Yunxiao raised an eyebrow and said with a light smile, "If you really lose, wouldn’t you also have to give up your life?"
Lin Yi’s expression darkened and he said, "If you’re scared, you can just concede!"
Li Yunxiao chuckled contemptuously and said, "When has Li Yunxiao ever been afraid of anyone?! Since you want to compete, let’s do it!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Li Yunxiao pushed off with his legs, transforming into a streak of light shooting up into the sky.
"Ha ha! That’s more like a man, come on!"
Lin Yi laughed heartily, his figure flickering as he also soared into the sky, flying towards the distance, and disappearing into the horizon in the blink of an eye.
"Hmph, you little beast, this time you won’t escape even if you had wings!"
A black-clothed young man sneered.
"Yeah, I’ve been fed up with this little beast for a long time!"
Another man in blue spoke in a mocking tone.
"Let’s go!"
Li Yunxiao gave a low shout and burst out in a flash.
"Kill!"
The other three quickly followed, chasing after him together.
Soon after, they arrived at a grassland.
At this moment, the setting sun on the horizon was gradually sloping westward, and the sky grew dim.
They stopped on the lawn, coldly staring at Lin Yi, waiting for his reaction.
"You were acting so arrogantly, why aren’t you running anymore?"
Li Yunxiao said sarcastically.
"Li Yunxiao, don’t put on an act here, I’ve already seen through your bluff, you can’t possibly beat me!"
Lin Yi said with a mocking look, laughing coldly, "I advise you just concede gracefully, to save yourself the suffering and punishment."
"Heh, Lin Yi, you really underestimate people. Who do you think I, Li Yunxiao, am? Would I cower just because you provoke me? The word ’submit’ doesn’t exist in my dictionary!"
Li Yunxiao said with a face full of ridicule and snorted coldly, "Today I will correct your arrogant and conceited problem!"
"Ha ha, what a problem of arrogance and conceit, Li Yunxiao, today you’re undoubtedly going to die, let’s see how you’ll fix it!"
Lin Yi sneered, and his aura erupted dramatically.
"Hmph, your cultivation speed may be fast, but it still lacks maturity. Let’s see how you break my Sword Array!"
Li Yunxiao’s face showed an increasing disdain.

chapters.title: Chapter 873 - 893: A Swordsmanship Master with Exceptional Talent
chapters.content:
Chapter 873: Chapter 893: A Swordsmanship Master with Exceptional Talent
"Hmph, Li Yunxiao, do you think you can crush my Myriad Sword Technique with that treasured sword in your hand? Dream on!"
Lin Yi sneered, his pupils shining brightly as he pointed his treasured sword. Immediately, thunder and lightning coalesced in the sky, forming a dense metallic sword rain that enveloped the sky and swooped down towards Li Yunxiao!
"Sword Array, Myriad Swords Flying Together!"
"Boom!"
The countless sword rain instantly descended, submerging the entire firmament.
Li Yunxiao let out a cold snort, and a surge of golden light swirled around his body, transforming into a golden bell shield.
The numerous thunder and lightning sword rain instantly struck the golden bell, emitting a loud crackling noise.
"Eh, it actually blocked my Sword Array! Worthy of Li Yunxiao, you have some skill!"
Lin Yi’s expression shifted slightly—his reason for so confidently initiating this battle was his belief that Li Yunxiao was unfamiliar with the Myriad Sword Technique. He didn’t expect Li Yunxiao would actually manage to block it.
He couldn’t help but snort coldly: "But you can block it once, twice, but definitely not the third, fourth, fifth time..."
Before he could finish speaking, a strange smile appeared on Li Yunxiao’s face, and his eyes shot out a sharp light.
The next moment, the sky full of golden bells suddenly exploded, transforming into millions of Golden Blades that slashed in all directions.
"What?!"
Lin Yi’s face turned pale, and he hastily summoned a Defensive Barrier to resist Li Yunxiao’s attack.
But Li Yunxiao’s Golden Blade cut through it as if slicing through tofu.
Lin Yi’s Defensive Barrier was instantly shattered, and the Golden Blades continued slashing downward.
He was so scared that his soul almost left his body, hurrying to dodge to the side.
"Bang!"
He didn’t manage to evade in time, his body was struck by the Golden Blade, instantly chopped into dust, reduced to ashes, and completely vanished.
"Hiss!"
All the Martial Artists around were dumbfounded, looking at Li Yunxiao with terror as if they had seen a ghost.
That was a high-level expert at the early Peak of the Martial Ancestor Level, who couldn’t even withstand a single move and was killed?!
Not only was Li Yunxiao a Nine-Star Martial Emperor, but he was also a swordsmanship master with extraordinary talent!
"What’s going on? How can this lad instantly kill Brother Lin?! That’s impossible!"
"Yeah, Brother Lin was a powerful figure at the early Peak of the Martial Ancestor Level. Even if he faced a Martial King, he shouldn’t be defeated in a flash, right?!"
"This person must be up to something fishy; he has definitely cheated!"
The crowd was in utter shock, but they didn’t dare to approach rashly anymore, all retreating instead.
Li Yunxiao put away his Longsword, a victorious smile on his face: "Brother Lin, didn’t you want to duel with me? How come you don’t have any Combat Power? I think it’s better for you to admit defeat early on, to prevent losing face. After all, losing to someone of Martial Ancestor Realm, that’s quite an embarrassment."
"Li Yunxiao, I’ll remember you. The humiliation of today, I will reclaim a hundredfold!"
Lin Yi glared at him with gritted teeth, wishing he could immediately rush over and tear him to shreds.
"Hmph, just remember me, that’s enough. You can get lost now."
Li Yunxiao waved his hand, looking nonchalantly aloof.
"Li Yunxiao, don’t be arrogant! One day, I will make you pay the price!"
Lin Yi roared angrily, his face contorted with fury as he left.
The onlookers all stayed far away from the battle, not daring to come close.
"Kid, Lin Yi is one of the best among the Inner Sect Disciples, possessing extraordinary strength. Don’t bring disaster upon yourself!"
Xiaohong’s voice echoed in his mind, reminding him to be cautious.
"Hehe, don’t worry about that."
Li Yunxiao laughed lightly: "Him, try to harm me? He’s dreaming!"
"Indeed, what Xiaohong said is correct. In front of me, Lin Yi is merely an ant-like existence."
The elder in the green robe slowly walked out and said, "You must be Li Yunxiao. I am Chen Qingfeng, a disciple of the Inner Enforcement Hall, and I have been ordered to arrest you. Please come with me."
"Chen the Enforcer, this Li Yunxiao killed my senior brother and crippled my Dantian. This vendetta is. irreconcilable. I wish to settle this with a fight to the death with Li Yunxiao. Please grant me this, Chen the Enforcer."
Lin Yi’s face was filled with frost and killing intent; he had been pushed to the edge of a cliff, and just needed to make one more effort to climb up.
"Hmph! Lin Yi, you are at the Martial Sovereign Realm, and I am merely at the peak of Martial Venerable. I advise you to give up!"
Chen Qingfeng said indifferently, "Otherwise, I won’t mind killing you so that you won’t even have the chance of reincarnation after death!"
"What?! You’re saying I am a Martial Sovereign?! How is that possible?!"
Lin Yi’s eyes were wide open with disbelief as he cried out, his face full of shock and fear.
"Lin Yi, have you forgotten that I was once ranked in the seventies on the Heavenly List as a super powerhouse? If you don’t believe me, you can personally check my records from back then!" Chen Qingfeng sneered.
"No no, it can’t be true, it just can’t!"
Lin Yi’s complexion turned pale, and his body shook uncontrollably, clearly greatly shocked.
A rank in the seventies on the Heavenly List, isn’t that the Martial Saint Realm!
"Alright, go back for now. We’ll talk about this matter later. First, heal your injuries," Chen Qingfeng waved his hand, signaling Lin Yi to leave.
"Understood."
Lin Yi took a deep breath, calmed his emotions, and turned to walk out of the mountain range, his eyes filled with unwillingness and rage.
In his heart, he vowed that once he had the chance, he would make Li Yunxiao pay dearly without a place for burial!
Watching Lin Yi leave, Chen Qingfeng couldn’t help but sigh, "It’s a pity that such a prodigy has fallen at my hands."
"Chen the Enforcer, Lin Yi’s background seems to be extraordinary."
The woman in black said, "You’d better not provoke him to avoid trouble."
Her voice carried a threatening tone.
Chen Qingfeng calmly replied, "Don’t worry, I’m not reckless and won’t take risks. However, this fellow has many secrets, and if we let him grow, it could be troublesome."
"Chen the Enforcer need not concern himself so much, just eliminate him, that’s all. Besides, he’s not worth fearing now."
"You’re right. Leave this matter to me, you all can leave first."
Chen Qingfeng nodded, "Although this person is strong, his cultivation speed is too slow, he will be a disaster sooner or later."
"Yes, then we will take our leave first."
The woman in black gave a salute, then turned and walked away.
Chen Qingfeng glanced at Li Yunxiao, and a sly smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, murmuring, "Li Yunxiao, you’re doomed in this battle! I want to see how you can escape from my Five Fingers Mountain!"
With a single palm strike, Chen Qingfeng suppressed Li Yunxiao to the ground.
His figure turned into a golden light and dissipated.
"Pfft!"
Li Yunxiao’s body shook violently, spitting out a mouthful of fresh blood, his complexion deathly pale, obviously severely injured.
"This damn guy, he actually managed to pierce through my Physical Body with one palm, almost shattering my Primordial Spirit."
Li Yunxiao cursed under his breath and hurriedly took out a piece of Spirit Grass to consume, barely recovering a trace of strength.
"Lin Yi, just wait, you will pay back double what you owe me one day!"
Li Yunxiao’s eyes were filled with a ruthless killing intent.
"Haha, and I thought you were so formidable, turns out you’re just trash!"
When Lin Yi returned from outside the mountain range, his face was full of mockery, and his eyes scorned everything.
"Trash?!"
Li Yunxiao suddenly became furious and threw a punch that exploded in the air, crushing the void and forcefully pressing Lin Yi to the ground.
A painful expression immediately appeared on Lin Yi’s face, his entire face twisted.

chapters.title: Chapter 874 - 894 Hastily Changed His Tune
chapters.content:
Chapter 874: Chapter 894 Hastily Changed His Tune
"Lin Yi, what did you say just now?!"
Li Yunxiao’s gaze was piercing as lightning, staring into his eyes, a cold killing intent swept over, causing him to shiver involuntarily.
"Li Yunxiao, I was indeed wrong to accuse you, I’m sorry." Lin Yi hurriedly changed his tone, squeezing out a smile uglier than crying on his face.
"What did you say? I didn’t hear you clearly." Li Yunxiao said: "Say it again!"
"I..." Lin Yi gritted his teeth and said: "I was indeed wrong to accuse you just now."
Li Yunxiao said: "If that’s the case, do you still dare to make a move against me?"
A fierce glint flashed across Lin Yi’s face, and he sneered: "Of course, Li Yunxiao, if you’re not afraid of death, go ahead and try!"
Li Yunxiao sneered: "Of course, I know you dare to make a move against me, because you don’t have the ability!"
Lin Yi shouted angrily: "Li Yunxiao, you rely on nothing but your strong physique, you’re actually just trash!"
Li Yunxiao’s expression instantly darkened, and he said coldly: "Lin Yi, don’t push it too far, believe it or not, I will beat you into a pulp!"
A sneer of mockery flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes, and he said sarcastically: "Li Yunxiao, you are nothing but a schemer, if you have the guts, come at me!" He stepped on Li Yunxiao’s shoulder, face full of provocation and eyes full of scorn.
Li Yunxiao’s brows furrowed, knowing his strength was currently inadequate, and that no matter what, he couldn’t compete with Lin Yi, but he couldn’t let this guy be arrogant.
"Hmph, Lin Yi, I’ll see how long you can be arrogant, one day I will trample you underfoot!" He swore silently to himself.
"Li Yunxiao, you better scram now, or else you’ll stay here forever."
Lin Yi sneered: "It’s not just you, even if the Martial Emperor himself came, he couldn’t break through my barrier."
"Barrier?!"
Li Yunxiao’s brows furrowed, sensing carefully.
Suddenly, an intense fluctuation rose from all around, forming ripples that spread out like waves, expanding continuously.
Li Yunxiao was stunned and said: "There really is a barrier, it seems Lin Yi is indeed not to be underestimated." His eyes shimmered with brilliance, and with a thought, the power within his body surged out, coalescing into a massive arm, and he slammed forward fiercely!
"Boom!"
A loud explosion sounded.
At Li Yunxiao’s location, the entire barrier shattered.
A terrifying force surged to the skies, instantly tearing apart the surrounding void.
"Hahaha! Li Yunxiao, now you know how powerful I am, still not kneeling to beg for mercy!"
Lin Yi threw his head back and laughed.
"Kneel down and beg for mercy? Lin Yi, you’re overestimating yourself, even if I kneel down to beg for mercy, I would never bow to you. In this life, you’re the only one worthy to kneel!"
Li Yunxiao sat cross-legged on the ground, staring coldly at Lin Yi, his hands forming hand seals, and numerous runes appeared on his chest, dancing in the air.
These runes spun continuously, emitting a strong aura.
"This, this is?"
Lin Yi’s pupils shrank slightly, revealing a look of shock.
"Li Yunxiao, you, you’re actually artifact refining?!"
Lin Yi exclaimed, his face filled with shock and jealousy.
"That’s right, I am indeed artifact refining." Li Yunxiao nodded, his hand seals becoming faster.
"You, you can actually refine Spiritual Weapons?!"
Lin Yi’s face showed surprise, and his heart was greatly shaken.
Spiritual Weapons were at the level of Immortal Artifacts, and they required a Spirit and a Weapon Soul to be used. Such Spiritual Weapons were extremely rare and hard to come by; even disciples of the Nine-Star Refining Art Sect might not be qualified to refine Spiritual Weapons.
Lin Yi wondered if he had ever refined Spiritual Weapons but did not achieve the miraculous effects like Li Yunxiao.
"Hmph, why can’t I refine them?!" Li Yunxiao sneered coldly, his hand seals moving even faster.
"Pop!"
A crisp sound rang out.
Li Yunxiao held an ancient longsword in his hand.
That was a longsword, yet not merely so, for its blade contained countless ancient symbols, and faintly, myriad spiritual beast patterns could be discerned.
"Buzz buzz buzz!"
The longsword emitted a vibrating sound, seemingly resonating with its master’s excited emotions, and slowly danced in the air.
"Li Yunxiao, you, you actually managed to refine a Spiritual Artifact! This, this, how is this possible...!"
Lin Yi’s complexion was extremely ugly, his heart was shocked to the extreme, he could hardly believe it.
In Lin Yi’s eyes, a Spiritual Artifact was already among the top weapons, even within the entire Northern Region it was a top existence, let alone for a Martial Artist.
This was simply unimaginable!
"What’s wrong? Lin Yi, are you surprised?"
Li Yunxiao sneered: " I might as well tell you, I truly haven’t refined a Spiritual Artifact before, but I possess a treasure that can temporarily elevate my artifact refining level by three ranks, or even five or six ranks!"
Lin Yi exclaimed in shock: "You, you can actually do this!"
"Hmph!" Li Yunxiao snorted coldly, gripping the ancient longsword with both hands as a majestic wave of Spiritual Energy poured into it, causing the entire longsword to light up instantly.
"Swoosh!"
Li Yunxiao flicked his fingers, and the longsword shot towards Lin Yi abruptly.
"Bang!"
Lin Yi was struck by the longsword and immediately spewed a mouthful of blood, his face showing horror, full of disbelief, he said: "How is this possible?!"
Although the longsword was just a Spiritual Artifact, it possessed a spirit and was extremely powerful; not even an early-stage Martial Sovereign could necessarily withstand it.
How could Lin Yi withstand it?
Lin Yi staggered, his face turned extremely pale, filled with terror, and he hastily retreated.
"Boom!"
A terrifying gust roared by, flipping Lin Yi to the ground, where he slid a thousand meters before stopping.
"Pfft!"
Lin Yi vomited another mouthful of blood, his face as pale as paper, his whole body shook, and he almost couldn’t stand steadily, his eyes filled with terror.
"How about it, Lin Yi, do you still wish to kill me?" Li Yunxiao looked at him coldly, his face full of mockery.
"I, I acknowledge that you are stronger than me, I am no match, but don’t even think about killing me."
Lin Yi ground his teeth, glaring coldly at Li Yunxiao, wishing he could flay and debone him.
"Lin Yi, I do not care who you are, but from this moment on, you no longer have a chance, for today shall be the day of your downfall!"
Li Yunxiao said coldly, his figure flashed, turning into a streak of light, rushing towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s face was fierce, and he swung his palm violently to meet the attack.
The two instantly engaged in battle.
"Boom boom!"
Terrifying Spiritual Energy exploded in the sky, with both parties wielding their longswords, clashing and colliding in the air, sparks flying everywhere.
Li Yunxiao’s speed was incredibly fast, every swing of the longsword in his hand was like thunder slicing through the sky, blocking Lin Yi’s attacks from the outside, completely unable to reach him.
"Dammit, how can this brat be so fast?"
Lin Yi was shocked to his core, his heart filled with reluctance, continuously urging his Spiritual Energy, bombarding with palm strikes over and over.
But those attacks were all countered by the longsword, not able to harm Li Yunxiao at all.
Lin Yi was in a great panic, his heart filled with a mix of shock and rage, almost going mad, he had never imagined Li Yunxiao would be this powerful.
Li Yunxiao at this moment was also exceedingly astonished, although he had studied Spiritual Artifacts alongside his cultivation, it was limited to understanding and usage.
He had not anticipated that refining a Spiritual Artifact could have such wondrous effects, able to improve an Artifact Refiner’s artifact refining capabilities within a short period of time.
Moreover, he was able to freely control a Spiritual Artifact’s power, wield it as if it were an extension of his body, with its might greatly magnified.

chapters.title: Chapter 875 - 895: An Invincible Presence!
chapters.content:
Chapter 875: Chapter 895: An Invincible Presence!
If he could fully control the spiritual weapon, it would be like having an extra life, an undoubtedly invincible existence!
"Lin Yi, die for me!"
Li Yunxiao let out a furious roar, spiritual power surged from his body, pouring into his longsword, he slashed out with it.
"Boom!"
The longsword fell, the space trembled, emitting a piercing whine, the sword light fiercely sharp.
Under that sword light, it was as if a mountain was pressing down from the sky.
"Bang!"
Caught off guard, Lin Yi was struck by the sword light, directly smashed into a stele, his whole body embedded within the stone wall.
"Ah, it hurts so much!"
Lin Yi let out a miserable scream, struggling incessantly inside.
Having lost all his cultivation, only left with the Martial Saint Realm, he was certainly no match for Li Yunxiao.
"Lin Yi, today I will make you understand, to humiliate me, Li Yunxiao, what a tragic end you’ll meet!"
With his successful strike, Li Yunxiao leaped into the air, the longsword sliced through the sky, a vast sword intent erupted, striking down directly.
"Crack!"
"Ah!"
Lin Yi issued a piercing, miserable scream, his body shattered inch by inch under the sword light.
"Clang!"
A ring fell to the ground, it was the storage bag that Lin Yi had just discarded, inside were many elixirs and primordial stones.
Li Yunxiao picked it up and opened it to take a look, he couldn’t help but be overjoyed; inside were no less than three million high-grade primordial stones!
Li Yunxiao stowed them away then searched the storage bag for other treasures.
Suddenly, Li Yunxiao’s eyes flashed, a strange smile appeared on his face, he reached over and searched through Lin Yi’s storage bag.
Eventually, Li Yunxiao pulled out a scroll and unfurled it.
On the scroll was a lotus flower, pure white as jade, the lotus scattered faint golden glimmers, the engraved patterns on it were exquisitely beautiful as if the object was alive.
Li Yunxiao’s brows furrowed, a curious expression crossing his face, he murmured, "Could it be, this lotus is the legendary Creation Lotus of Heaven and Earth?"
The Creation Lotus of Heaven and Earth is an important ingredient for the refinement of the Creation Elixir of Heaven and Earth, which requires forty-nine supreme grade spirit grasses for its refinement process.
If the refinement is successful, one can produce a supreme-grade spirit pill.
Once consumed, the spirit pill is equivalent to possessing a trace of a true god’s power, and could even surpass a true god.
Such items, the entire continent had only a few, let alone a newcomer like Li Yunxiao.
"Wow, actually there are forty-nine supreme-grade spirit grasses!"
Li Yunxiao’s face lit up with ecstatic joy, his heart trembling with excitement.
This was the main ingredient for refining the Creation Elixir of Heaven and Earth!
There were so many in Lin Yi’s storage bag, taking up more than half.
And in there was also a fragmented map, seemingly a map, likely hidden by Lin Yi.
Li Yunxiao felt secretly delighted and observed the fragmented map carefully, his excitement grew as he discovered that the map detailed a formation.
He immediately sat down cross-legged and began to ponder the fragmented map, carefully considering it.
Not long after, Li Yunxiao opened his eyes which shone brightly, his face revealed a look of pleasant surprise as he talked to himself: "So that’s it, this is a map, and it also has detailed records of the location of the Creation Elixir of Heaven and Earth."
"I wonder if this fragmented map has a method of deciphering? If deciphered, the Creation Elixir of Heaven and Earth could become my possession!"
He admired the fragmented map while thinking.
Unknowingly, half a year had passed.
Lin Yi had been imprisoned in a cage, already tortured for a year, worn out in body and mind, mentally exhausted, and with the torment of these days, his injuries had long been severe, nearly at the end of his tether.
"Lin Yi, if you know what’s good for you, hand over the Spiritual Medicine and Primordial Stones obediently, and I guarantee I’ll spare your life."
Li Yunxiao sat in front of the cell, staring coldly at Lin Yi, and spoke with an icy voice.
Lin Yi’s face was gloomy as he stared back at him, saying, "Hmph, dream on! Unless I’m dead, don’t you even think about it!"
"Heh heh, since you refuse the toast only to be forced to drink a forfeit, then I shall grant your wish!"
Li Yunxiao let out a cold laugh, saying, "The choice is yours, to do it yourself or shall I assist you?"
His body began to float slowly, emitting a terrifying aura, forming a huge black screen around his body.
Lin Yi’s complexion drastically changed, and he exclaimed in horror, "The power of Black Abyss?! Are you from the Demon Clan?"
"Ha ha, you are correct, I am from the Demon Clan!"
Li Yunxiao looked at him with a smiling gaze, his figure gradually fading away, eventually disappearing into the void, leaving Lin Yi sitting there in a daze.
After a long while, Lin Yi finally recovered from his shock, exclaiming, "How has my cultivation restored? No... that’s not right! You are not just from the Demon Clan but also a king of the inferno! What do you want to do?!"
He clenched his fists tightly, trembling all over, his face full of fear, his heart filled with panic. He had never seen such a bizarre event and did not know how to deal with it.
"Lin Yi, there’s no need to be afraid, I hold no ill will towards you."
A cold voice rose from outside the cell.
Lin Yi trembled all over and looked up in fright, asking, "Who?! Who’s out there?!"
Li Yunxiao walked in, smiling and saying, "You can call me Demon Emperor!"
"What?! Demon Emperor?! Impossible, I don’t believe it, I refuse to believe you’re from the Demon Clan, much less will I submit to your tyranny!"
Lin Yi shook his head vigorously, clearly unwilling to believe. The identity of Li Yunxiao was too absurd for him to accept.
"Lin Yi, since you refuse to submit, then go to your death!"
Li Yunxiao’s face darkened, and a surge of murderous intent exploded within his eyes.
Lin Yi immediately felt an overwhelming killing intent rush towards him, sending a chill throughout his body, as if falling into an icy cave, chilling to the bone, causing his pores to stand on end, his entire body stiffening.
"You... don’t you dare..."
He stammered out a sentence, but quickly came to his senses, grinding his teeth and saying, "Don’t even think about it!"
Lin Yi flicked his wrist, summoning a dagger.
"Whoosh!"
The dagger transformed into a stream of light and shot out, fiercely stabbing towards Li Yunxiao, with incredible speed, crossing a thousand meters in an instant.
"Bang!"
Li Yunxiao’s eyes suddenly burst into red light, and he slammed his hands down, two torrents of Blood Flame rushed out, forming a fireball in the void, smashing towards the dagger.
"Bang!"
The blood-red fireball collided with the dagger, creating a thunderous explosion. Cracks appeared on the dagger, and it shattered directly.
Lin Yi was terrified out of his wits, hurriedly retracting his body, waving his hands and summoning several Flying Swords, slashing towards Li Yunxiao.
The Flying Swords traced an arc in the void, sharp and ruthless.
"Bang bang bang!"
Li Yunxiao punched out, shattering the Flying Swords completely, and with a sweep of his arms, he sent out a palm strike.
"Bang!"
The Flying Swords were smashed, turning into a cloud of dust in the sky.
"What?!"
Lin Yi was shocked and his eyes bulged, not daring to believe what he was seeing.
Li Yunxiao’s figure flashed, and he appeared in front of Lin Yi, his hand stretched out with five claws, grabbing Lin Yi’s neck and throwing him into the cell, saying, "Lin Yi, I gave you a chance, but you didn’t treasure it. You can’t blame anyone else."
"Pu-chi!"
Li Yunxiao casually crushed the Flying Sword, piercing through Lin Yi’s chest, blood spurting out.

chapters.title: Chapter 876 - 896: Not Cherishing Oneself
chapters.content:
Chapter 876: Chapter 896: Not Cherishing Oneself
"Ah!"
Lin Yi let out a painful howl, struggled a few times, then fell to the ground, motionless and his fate unknown.
"Hehe, Lin Yi, I originally wanted to give you a way out, but unfortunately, you didn’t cherish it."
Li Yunxiao said with a cold laugh: "I can only send you on your way to the netherworld."
After saying this, he stretched out his hand to form a seal.
Suddenly, the cages opened, and the iron cages inside also began to slowly move, pressing towards Lin Yi’s body.
"No!"
Lin Yi suddenly woke up with a loud roar.
"Bang!"
All the iron cages got crushed.
"Puchi!"
Lin Yi spat out a mouthful of blood, his face pale, displaying a mix of shock and rage, and angrily shouted: "Li Yunxiao, you’re ruthless!"
"Hehe, didn’t you say I was despicable? Then let me show you my despicableness!"
Li Yunxiao sneered, took a step forward, reached Lin Yi, grabbed his shoulders and lifted him up.
Lin Yi’s armor was torn off, revealing a smooth body covered with scars, densely packed, horrifying to behold, with some places even deep enough to show ghastly white bones.
"Ah!"
Lin Yi let out a miserable scream, struggled desperately, but it was futile, Li Yunxiao easily lifted him.
"Lin Yi, don’t waste your strength. Your physical body has been destroyed, you have no way to resist me."
Li Yunxiao’s mouth curled up in a smile, his eyes twinkling with excitement, as if eager to see Lin Yi’s tragic condition.
"Li Yunxiao, I will kill you!"
Lin Yi roared: "No matter the cost, I will kill you!"
Lin Yi’s eyes were bloodshot, veins throbbing on his forehead, a surge of intense hatred rising to the heavens.
"Kill me? Hahaha!"
Li Yunxiao laughed heartily, saying: "You are such a pitiful wretch, you can’t even kill yourself, how could you possibly threaten me."
"No... impossible, I don’t believe it! I refuse to believe!"
Lin Yi shouted, his eyes filled with despair, his heart brimming with intense regret, wishing he could slap himself.
Originally, he should have ended Li Yunxiao’s life with a single stroke, to prevent future troubles, instead of letting him return, leading to this situation.
"Li Yunxiao, you can’t kill me! I am the prodigy of the Holy Domain, if you kill me, the Holy Domain will not let it go lightly, they might even flatten the Heavenly Martial Realm!"
Lin Yi roared hysterically, his heart filled with boundless fear.
Li Yunxiao sneered: "Holy Domain? So what? Haven’t I, Li Yunxiao, been hunted by the Holy Domain for a million years? I’m still alive, knowing this, what can the higher-ups do to me? Rest assured, I will be sending you to the netherworld to keep you company!"
He flicked his finger forward, about to pierce through Lin Yi’s forehead.
"Stop!"
Suddenly, a stern shout came, a golden lightning descended from the void, illuminating the entire prison brightly.
"Hmph, the Holy Domain? What of it?"
Li Yunxiao sneered, pointing his finger.
"Boom!"
The golden lightning was shattered by a palm, cracks appearing on the surrounding walls.
"Hmm?"
Li Yunxiao was startled, turned around, and it was Lin Yi’s master.
"Hmph, Li Yunxiao, I advise you to stop immediately, otherwise, I will definitely report this matter to the Holy Domain and you will not escape the consequences!" The Golden-robed Elder angrily rebuked.
"Oh? So you are from the Holy Domain, it seems you’re quite well-informed."
Li Yunxiao gave a faint smile and said, "I was actually having trouble finding you, but here you’ve come to me on your own."
"You, what do you want from us?"
The Golden-robed Elder’s face changed slightly, looking at Li Yunxiao with some fear.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s eyes nearly popped out in astonishment, "Yun Feng teacher?! Are you not dead?"
The Golden-robed Elder, named Jin Feng, was Lin Yi’s mentor and also his senior brother, equally matched in strength; both were at the Three-Star Martial Venerable Peak.
Jin Feng glared coldly at Lin Yi and said, "Do I need to report to you how I died?"
"That’s not what I mean..."
Lin Yi sheepishly smiled and said, "Teacher Yun Feng, Li Yunxiao is from the Demonic Path, he wants to target me, please you must stop him!"
"Hmph, what about the Demonic Path, you think you are still the previous Holy Domain Young Master?"
Jin Feng scoffed coldly and taunted, "You can’t even fight me now, I suggest you be sensible, kneel down and beg for mercy to avoid physical pain, otherwise, I’ll make you wish you were dead!"
"Beg for mercy?"
Li Yunxiao raised an eyebrow and couldn’t help but sneer, "Are you sure you want me to beg for mercy?"
"Yes, beg for mercy, and not only that, you have to surrender all the treasures on you, otherwise, it’s a dead end!"
Jin Feng stated coldly.
Lin Yi’s pupils constricted, angrily saying, "Teacher Yun Feng, you are being too much!"
"Too much?"
Jin Feng snorted coldly, "If I wasn’t too much, you would have killed me half a year ago. It’s all because of you! If I wasn’t stronger than you, you would have backstabbed and killed me already, and you dare say I’m being excessive!"
Lin Yi was at a loss for words, unable to retort.
"I advise you not to intervene, otherwise, your situation will only become more dangerous!"
Jin Feng said, "If you want to survive, it’s best to obediently listen to me, otherwise, I will have no choice but to kill you!"
Lin Yi’s face was gloomily uncertain, "Teacher Yun Feng, what do you mean by that?"
"What do I mean? Can’t you understand?"
Jin Feng sneered coldly and said, "The war between the Holy Domain and the Heavenly Martial Realm is about to begin. During this time, I will try my best to protect you and ensure your safe departure from this prison, and the Holy Domain will also send people to rescue you. At that time, with the Holy Domain’s experts abundant, your single strength isn’t enough to resist!"
Lin Yi’s face instantly turned pale, "Holy Domain experts? How many experts do you have?"
"You’re thinking too much."
Jin Feng shook his head, "With our two’s strength alone, we have more than enough to protect ourselves, but if you add my master and grand-uncle, the experts in the Holy Domain are countless, you definitely can’t stand against them."
"What?!"
Lin Yi’s face paled in shock, "Impossible! The big figures of the Holy Domain are in closed-door cultivation, they can’t come so quickly!"
"What’s so impossible about that. Do you know why they are in closed-door cultivation? It’s because they are cultivating some treasure, and I guess it’s some kind of magical Cultivation Technique or some unique Elixir that caused their sudden advancement."
"What?!"
Lin Yi trembled all over, completely dumbfounded.
Jin Feng said, "Lin Yi, you are a Holy Domain genius, if you don’t want to die, it’s better to cooperate with me, otherwise, I can only hand you over to the Holy Domain for disposal."
Lin Yi trembled all over, his face pale.
Li Yunxiao said, "You want him to cooperate with you?"
"That’s right."
Jin Feng arrogantly said, "If he cooperates with us, I guarantee that he will become the Young Master of the Holy Domain."
"Heh, Young Master of the Holy Domain? You’re not worthy. Let Lin Yi decide for himself."
Li Yunxiao looked disdainfully at Jin Feng and snickered, "Lin Yi, this is your only chance to survive, as long as you agree to cooperate with them, I can forgive and forget your past actions and let you leave, how about it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 877 - 897: Tasting All the Pain and Torment in the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 877: Chapter 897: Tasting All the Pain and Torment in the World
"Li Yunxiao, don’t go too far!"
Jin Feng’s face turned ashen, glaring furiously at Li Yunxiao.
Li Yunxiao remained unconcerned and continued to tempt him, "If you’re unwilling, then I’ll just kill all your junior brothers and sisters, preventing you from ever seeing them again, making you taste all the pain and torment in this world."
"Teacher Yun Feng, please, let us go!"
Lin Yi’s face changed, and he said in a panic, "We are willing to cooperate, please, I beg you, let them go!"
"Ha ha, good! Very good!"
Jin Feng’s expression softened slightly as he coldly stated, "This is your promise, I hope you will keep your word!"
"Of course, I, Lin Yi, may not be a gentleman, but I always keep my word!"
Lin Yi nodded emphatically.
"Very good."
Jin Feng nodded in satisfaction, then turned and said, "Let’s go, we’re heading back to the sect."
"Okay!"
Lin Yi quickly followed.
Jin Feng snorted coldly, "Lin Yi, you’re not refusing to cooperate with Li Yunxiao because you’re afraid of his threats, are you?"
"I, I wouldn’t dare!"
Lin Yi quickly denied.
"That’s good."
Jin Feng gave a cold smile and turned to fly away.
Li Yunxiao followed closely behind.
The three of them flew through Heavenly Martial City for thousands of kilometers and finally landed in a mountain range. Hidden deep within the mountain range was a huge Formation, guarded by two men.
These two were precisely the two Elders from the Heavenly Dragon Academy!
As Li Yunxiao and Lin Yi arrived, they immediately caught the attention of the two Elders.
Both Elders wore a look of surprise as if they had not expected Jin Feng to bring a junior with him.
"Eh, how dare you come here?!"
One Elder stared at Lin Yi, his face showing a mocking expression.
"Hmph, Li Yunxiao is my friend, and naturally, I can come here. Besides, he saved my life; naturally, I have to thank him."
Lin Yi retorted coldly, "Teacher Jin Feng, what exactly do you from the Holy Domain intend to do? Are you planning to trade my well-being for the benefits of your Holy Domain? Such despicable and shameless actions!"
"Hmph!"
Jin Feng glanced at him with a sharp look, speaking icily, "If the higher-ups of the Holy Domain hadn’t commanded, I would never have brought you here!"
Lin Yi angrily said, "You despicable person, had Brother Yun Feng not saved me, you would have killed me long ago!"
Jin Feng stared at him coldly and said, "If he hadn’t saved you, I would have killed you already, without waiting for you to talk this long!"
Lin Yi asked, "Can you let me go now?"
Jin Feng said, "Enter first, then we will talk. I need to take you in before I can tell you what the Holy Domain wants to do!"
Lin Yi clenched his teeth and said, "Then you might as well let me go. Otherwise, I will report this matter to the Sect Leader, and see who can protect me!"
Jin Feng replied, "Then go and make your report. But you need not worry; the Sect Leader will not blame us. The Holy Domain might be in a weaker position, but the strength of our sect’s higher-ups is still quite frightening."
Lin Yi said, "Rest assured, if you from the Holy Domain do something that harms our Academy, it won’t be easily explained away by saying it was detrimental to our Academy!"
Both of them sneered, walked straight over, grabbed Lin Yi, and entered the Formation.
Jin Feng waved his sleeve, and after arranging the Formation Patterns around them, he said, "Alright, this place is extremely hidden, you can be at ease now."
Lin Yi’s face turned pale as he pleaded, "Teacher Jin Feng, you can’t go back on your word. You said you were only temporarily protecting us and would never harm the lives of our Academy students. Don’t you have even that much honor?"
"This..."
Jin Feng’s eyebrows furrowed tightly as he said, "We won’t kill them, but we can use other methods to control them!"
Lin Yi’s complexion shifted slightly as he said, "What method are you referring to?"
Jin Feng replied, "We can make use of the Soul Imprint to erase their souls from within their bodies. From then on, their souls will wholly belong to the Holy Domain. They would become the slaves of the Holy Domain, to be dispatched as it wishes, and you too will become a slave to the Holy Domain."
Lin Yi’s face turned deathly pale, his eyes bulging and filled with disbelief, he exclaimed, "Soul Imprint, you—you’ve actually mastered such a secret technique!"
"So what if I have?"
Jin Feng gave a cold smile and said, "But rest assured, as long as you cooperate obediently, I will teach you the Soul Imprint, and then you will possess the strength akin to the elites of the Holy Domain!"
"No, no, I will absolutely not betray the academy!"
Lin Yi cried out, his knees giving way, and he collapsed to the ground, pleading, "Teacher Jin Feng, I beg of you, please let me go. I don’t want to be a slave to the Holy Domain, I don’t want to!"
"Don’t want to? What do you think the Holy Domain is? A place you can enter and leave as you wish? Dream on!"
Jin Feng cursed angrily and snapped his neck, tossing him on the ground.
Li Yunxiao stood by silently, his eyes flickering incessantly, clearly pondering something.
"Yun Feng, let’s go."
Jin Feng turned around and said, "He’s certainly dead now, but I want you to witness his death with your own eyes."
"Mm."
Li Yunxiao nodded slightly.
Lin Yi’s murder also left him feeling somewhat sad and angry.
The two soon shuttled through space and left the place.
"Boom!"
As the two departed, the earth shook violently as if the sky had collapsed.
Above the skies of Heavenly Martial City, a shadowy figure suddenly appeared—it was an elder from the Heavenly Dragon Academy, his expression dark as water, staring at the immense spatial rift in front.
The rift, hundreds of meters wide, loomed like a giant cauldron, emanating an overwhelmingly strong aura. It seemed to harbor a destructive power that struck fear into the hearts.
"Damned bastards, how dare you kill our Young Hall Master! You’re really seeking death!"
The elder from the Heavenly Dragon Academy slapped his palm on the spatial rift. It shattered instantly, revealing the scene within, where several elites of the Holy Domain floated in the air.
Fear was etched on their faces, as though they had been terrified out of their wits.
"Damn you, return the life of our Young Hall Master!"
Suddenly, a young man shouted, his Longsword turning into a streak of light as it rushed out, slashing open the spatial rift.
"Hmph!"
The elder struck with his palm, sending the young man flying and rebuked, "Are you blind? Can’t you see the Holy Domain’s people inside that rift? Are you asking for death?"
"Ah?!"
The crowd was dumbstruck, turning their gaze towards the rift.
In the spatial rift stood a man in black, wielding a Longsword with an overwhelming malicious aura around him, his murderous intent palpable and his eyes blood-red, as if he had just emerged from a sea of blood.
"Holy Domain’s strong one, how did you end up in this damned place!"
A young man trembled.
Though he was half a step Martial Emperor, he seemed utterly insignificant at the moment, like an ant.
"Hmph!"
The man in black snorted coldly, saying, "I ask you, where is Lin Yi?!"
Lin Yi?!
Upon hearing this, everyone was greatly shocked.
"Lin Yi!"
The young man’s pupils shrank, his face turning pale as he asked anxiously, "Could it be, could it be that the Young Hall Master is dead?!"
The expression of the man in black grew even grimmer as he said coldly, "I ask you again, where is Lin Yi!"
The young man was startled and trembled, "I—I—I don’t know."

chapters.title: Chapter 878 - 898: Trembling in Fear
chapters.content:
Chapter 878: Chapter 898: Trembling in Fear
The man in black said, "Since that’s the case, then I’ll send you to your death."
"No no no!"
The youth hastily said, "Lin Yi is our Holy Domain student, how could I possibly not know!"
"Hmph, not knowing is not knowing."
The man in black sneered coldly, then thrust his longsword fiercely through his heart—a "pfft" sound rang out as blood spurted, staining the sky red.
The other Holy Domain disciples trembled in fear, their faces deathly pale.
"Speak up, where is Lin Yi!"
Another figure in black shouted, his face twisted and terrifying, his eyes brimming with a denser killing intent.
"Lin Yi, Lin Yi is... is at our academy."
The youth spoke with difficulty, then his body gradually grew cold and began to fall slowly.
The other Holy Domain disciples were hugely alarmed, one after another quickly kneeling and begging for mercy, saying, "Please, my lord, spare our lives, spare our lives! We truly don’t know the Young Hall Master’s whereabouts! We are willing to work for you, to help you find the Young Hall Master, please don’t kill us!"
"If you’re unwilling to tell, then don’t blame me for being heartless!"
There was a hint of fierce light in the man in black’s eyes as his longsword stabbed ruthlessly.
"Pfft!"
A Holy Domain disciple screamed miserably as his body exploded.
"Don’t kill us, we’ll talk, we’ll talk."
The remaining few were so terrified they were pale as ghosts, looking as though they were about to cry.
One of the elders said, "The Young Hall Master is in a secret chamber behind the mountain of the academy, cultivating in seclusion. I will lead you there!"
The man in black’s face flickered with joy, and with a palm strike to the elder’s dantian, shattering it, he said, "Smart, get up and lead the way!"
"Yes, yes!"
The elder hurriedly got up and led the way.
In no time, the group arrived deep within the academy.
"Where is Lin Yi?!"
The man in black demanded.
The elder said, "The Young Hall Master is in seclusion in the secret chamber, and he will come out after about three hours. Please wait patiently, my lord."
"Oh? Another three hours, eh?"
The man in black said, "Good, let this lord rest for three hours. After this lord has recovered his Yuan Force, we will go and capture that little brat."
"Yes!"
The elder agreed repeatedly.
