The man in black sat down cross-legged, healing while simultaneously observing his surroundings. Suddenly, he vanished from the spot with a flash and darted towards the secret chamber.
...
Lin Family Secret Chamber.
Lin Yi was lying on the bed, his face deathly white, with a sharp sword tip embedded in his chest. Fresh blood flowed copiously, staining the sheets red. He was on his last breath, unconscious.
"No, I must leave immediately, or else when that beast comes, I will have no chance to escape!"
Lin Yi gritted his teeth, propping himself up, and was about to get off the bed.
"Shushushu!"
Suddenly a group of Holy Domain elites appeared, blocking Lin Yi’s escape path.
"Hahaha, Lin Yi, your time to die has come, today is your death anniversary!"
The man in black laughed loudly, his figure flickered, and he appeared in front of Lin Yi.
"It’s you!"
Lin Yi’s complexion changed drastically, and his face became extremely ugly, saying, "To think a powerful being of the Holy Domain would stoop to such vile and despicable acts!"
"Hehe, who made you the Lin Family’s legitimate young master and offended our Young Master, so don’t blame me for being impolite."
The man in black sneered coldly, "Lin Yi, accept your death graciously!"
After saying that, his hands formed seals, and a strange fluctuation emanated from his palms, condensing into a talisman paper, and slapped it towards Lin Yi’s heart.
"Ah!"
Lin Yi’s expression changed drastically, filled with shock and unease, he exhausted all his strength, urging the Yuan Force to resist.
"Boom!"
A massive energy backlash struck back, causing him to involuntarily spew out a mouthful of fresh blood.
"Ah! I’m not willing to accept this! I’m not!"
Lin Yi let out a wretched scream.
"Bang!"
His chest completely exploded, turning into a spray of blood rain, scattering around, dead beyond resurrection.
The expressions of other Holy Domain fighters were extremely ugly, none daring to utter another word.
Although they knew that the man in black was bluffing, they didn’t dare to say anything.
After all, the opponent was a Holy Rank powerhouse, and even stronger than Lin Yi; they had no ability to retaliate whatsoever.
"You lot, guard this place for me, don’t let anyone disturb me!"
The man in black ordered, then transformed into a gust of wind heading towards the secret chamber, his speed swift as a gale.
His eyes flickered with a chilling murderous intent, with a thought, he took Lin Yi into the storage ring and sealed Lin Yi’s soul to prevent the little beast from escaping.
He had already decided to first destroy Lin Yi’s Dantian, making it impossible for him to cultivate ever again, then to cripple his physical body, making him live a life worse than death, before torturing him to death—to satisfy his hatred.
"Hu!"
The man in black entered the secret chamber and took a long breath of relief.
In this chamber, there stood a huge stele, and in its center was a palm-sized Jade Slip, emanating a pale golden glow.
The man in black’s eyes glittered as he stepped forward and reached out to take the Jade Slip.
Raising his arm slightly, a strand of his soul penetrated the Jade Slip, swiftly obtaining what he needed.
Recorded within this Jade Slip were Lin Yi’s memories.
Lin Yi was the Lin Family’s sole genius, and three months ago, an extraordinary artifact named "Demon War Body" appeared in the Lin Family.
This Demon War Body could absorb various elemental forces and use these elemental forces to enhance the body’s defense and Attack Power.
Lin Yi was one of the Lin Family’s most promising geniuses, heavily nurtured by the Lin Family in the hopes that he could break through to the Holy Rank one day!
However, the Demon War Body also had a significant flaw.
It was that those who cultivated the Demon War Body would turn into a crazy monster that only knew slaughter, indiscriminate in their killing, decisive and bloodthirsty.
Initially, it was because Lin Yi cultivated this Demon War Body that he caught the attention of a ferocious beast and almost lost his life, nearly perishing at the hands of the monster.
Not only was Lin Yi targeted by the beast, but he even suffered betrayal from his companions.
His master died saving him, consumed by that beast.
In the end, he killed that beast, but unfortunately, his master also fell!
And the flaw of the Demon War Body was that it only allowed for cultivation once!
Once past the time limit, one would turn just like that monster, ruthless in killing, devoid of humanity, endlessly slaughtering and evolving.
In Lin Yi’s memories, only the fact of his cultivation of the Demon War Body was recorded, as for what exactly happened during the process, he had no clue.
Having reviewed the memories, the man in black hooked up a cold smile at the corner of his mouth, whispering to himself, "Lin Yi, although this Demon War Body is powerful, it also has a fatal weakness, that is, the time is too short. Even if you complete the cultivation, you will fall into a mad state, unable to control your actions. When that time comes, your death will also arrive!"
With a flick of his hand, a shimmer flashed, and a black Longsword appeared in his hand.
"Kill!"
The man in black roared lowly, directly stabbing through Lin Yi’s chest with the sword, piercing his heart.
"Bang!"
"Thump!"
Blood splattered, the body fell to the ground.
The man in black took up Lin Yi’s corpse and said, "Let’s go!"
With that, he turned and walked towards the outside.
...
Elsewhere.
"Swish!"
A figure darted out from the secret chamber, it was Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 879 - 899: A Glimpse of Despair
chapters.content:
Chapter 879: Chapter 899: A Glimpse of Despair
He was bathed in blood, his face deathly pale with pronounced hollows and bulges on his cheeks, clearly indicating the man in black had just dealt him a severe blow to his internal organs.
Lin Yi’s expression was frighteningly grim as he clutched at his chest, limping away into the distance, and emitting beast-like roars from his mouth.
His heart was filled with intense resentment, wishing he could flay the man in black alive and reduce his bones to ash!
"Damn bastard, I will never forgive you!"
Lin Yi bellowed in rage, engulfed in overwhelming fury, feeling as though he was sinking into an icy cave, with chills rising from his chest.
"Boom!"
Suddenly, a bolt of lightning struck just above Lin Yi’s head, enveloping him in an instant.
"Aah~"
Lin Yi screamed in agony, his body trembling, nearly falling to the ground.
"What’s going on? Why am I bound by the power of thunder and lightning?"
Lin Yi exclaimed in horror, his face showing a look of despair, for the power of thunder was terrifyingly potent, holding within it an extremely pure destructive force his physical body simply couldn’t withstand.
"Damn it!"
"I won’t accept this!"
"Lin Aotian, just wait for me. Once I break through to the Martial Sovereign Realm, I’ll tear you to pieces!"
Lin Yi ground his teeth in furious howls.
"Crash!"
Suddenly, an overwhelming aura burst forth from within him, shattering the thunderous power instantly, and his figure dashed forward at high speed.
Lin Yi’s injuries were too severe at the moment, making it impossible to use his movement technique.
Moreover, the power of thunder and lightning was too domineering; even if he fled, he couldn’t escape its grasp.
However, Lin Yi had other means.
There were hundreds of Elixirs inside his Storage Bag, each filled with powerful Primordial Energy strong enough to suppress his injuries.
He immediately consumed the Elixirs, healing his wounds while swiftly leaving this accursed place.
"The Lin Family, these bastards, have truly overstepped the mark. I will eventually annihilate your Lin Family!"
Lin Yi clenched his teeth, his hatred biting deep.
...
An hour later, Lin Yi finally returned to the Lin Family estate, to his own courtyard.
"Lin Yi, you’re finally back. Hurry up and apologize to the ancestor!"
A family elder rushed into the courtyard, his voice anxious.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi flew into a rage and said coldly, "I did nothing wrong. Why should I apologize to that old geezer? I’m telling you, you’d best get lost quickly, or don’t blame me for being rude to you!"
"Hmph, so ill-mannered. You haven’t even answered the ancestor yet!"
"I did nothing wrong. Why should I apologize to that old geezer?" Lin Yi asked coldly.
"You..." The elder was taken aback, then angrily said, "You scoundrel, dare to talk back to the ancestor? You don’t know what’s good for you. I’ll see how I handle you today!"
"Smack!"
The sound of a loud slap resonated.
Lin Yi’s mind went blank as he stood there stupefied, his face burning with pain.
The elder gave him a cold glance and then turned, striding towards the courtyard where Lin Aotian resided.
Lin Yi touched his swollen cheek, a trace of venomous hatred flashing across his eyes, his heart filled with towering hatred and murderous intent.
He swore in his heart that once he broke through to the Martial King Realm, he would kill every last member of the Lin Family and obliterate them completely!
A cold glint flickered in Lin Yi’s eyes as he slowly got to his feet and dragged his heavy legs into the house.
"Grandfather!"
Lin Yi came to the outside of the room and gently knocked on the door.
"Come in!"
"Bang!"
The room door was abruptly opened, revealing Lin Aotian’s grim face. He shot Lin Yi a cold glance and said disdainfully, "You rebellious child, I sent you to the secret realm for training, but not only did you not go, you almost died there. If it weren’t for my timely arrival, those creatures from the different spirit tribes would have torn you to pieces!"
Lin Aotian’s tone was indifferent and carried a trace of displeasure.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi laughed scornfully and said, "Grandfather, aren’t you underestimating those spirit tribe creatures a bit too much? They are no match for me!"
"You..." Lin Aotian was taken aback, then said with an ugly expression, "How did your strength improve so quickly? What exactly did you do?"
"Heh heh..." Lin Yi grinned and said, "One of my virtues is that I like to be lazy!"
"You..." Lin Aotian was so angry that his beard bristled and he ordered, "You rebellious child, kneel down!"
Taken aback, a look of bewilderment flashed across Lin Yi’s face as he asked, "Why should I?"
"I’m your grandfather!" Lin Aotian said coldly, "And you dare talk back to me!"
"Ha ha ha..."
Lin Yi burst into laughter, his eyes brimming with derision as he remarked, "Grandfather? Heh, you old fool, do you really think I’m an idiot?"
"If it weren’t for you forcing my father to leave the Lin Family, he wouldn’t have been eradicated by the enemies of our Lin Family. And now you dare to talk to me about this?" Lin Yi said with biting sarcasm.
Lin Aotian’s face turned livid with rage as he cursed, "You monstrous wretch! How dare you talk back to me? Don’t you believe I’ll spank you until your butt is a mess!"
Lin Yi responded with a dismissive smile, "Oh, so you want to fight, is that it? Come on then, hit me!"
"You monstrous wretch!" Lin Aotian’s face turned the color of liver as he bellowed, "Do you really think I can’t handle you?"
"You try touching a single hair on my head!" Lin Yi’s gaze surged with ferocity, staring coldly at Lin Aotian, "Aren’t you afraid I might just die right before your eyes?"
"Damn it, Lin Yi, you’re becoming more and more brazen!"
Lin Aotian roared in fury.
"Heh... I am brazen, what can you possibly do to me?"
Lin Yi said disdainfully.
"You... you..." Lin Aotian trembled with anger all over.
At that moment, Lin Yi spoke again, "Grandfather, this isn’t the outside world. If you dare to strike me, don’t even think of stepping into the Martial Emperor Realm!"
Lin Yi knew that Lin Aotian was cautious of his father, which was why he dared to use that as a threat.
Sure enough, upon hearing those words, the anger on Lin Aotian’s face deepened.
He was indeed very afraid of Lin Yi’s father and didn’t dare to act rashly against Lin Yi.
However, Lin Yi’s strength had grown significantly, he was already at the Martial King Realm, plus he had secret techniques. He could easily defeat Lin Aotian without him being aware.
In this way, Lin Aotian would be able to fully control Lin Yi and make him serve his purposes.
This little bastard, Lin Yi, actually dared to threaten him. He absolutely could not tolerate this happening.
"Grandfather, if you want to fight, go ahead! I’m already prepared for death!"
Lin Yi snorted coldly, showing a fearless stance as if he had long been indifferent to life and death.
"Damn you, you’re utterly lawless, you really deserve a smack!" Lin Aotian exclaimed angrily.
"Heh... Grandfather, if you’ve got the guts, hit me!"
Lin Yi sneered, watching Lin Aotian with a mocking expression.
"Grandfather, you might as well give me a couple of punches!"
"Slap!"
Lin Aotian raised his hand and slapped fiercely towards him.
However, as soon as his palm landed on Lin Yi’s cheek, it was firmly grabbed by Lin Yi.
"You..." Lin Aotian stared wide-eyed, his face full of astonishment.

chapters.title: Chapter 880 - 900: So Angry That I Can’t Even Speak a Word
chapters.content:
Chapter 880: Chapter 900: So Angry That I Can’t Even Speak a Word
He could never have imagined that this worthless grandson could actually catch his arm with his bare hands and hold on tightly, unable to free himself from Lin Yi’s Five Fingers Mountain.
"Insolence, let go of me right now!"
Lin Aotian’s face changed, and he roared angrily.
"Grandpa, why are you so agitated? I’m helping you here!" Lin Yi said with a cheeky grin. "Grandpa, you’re at the peak of the Martial King Realm now. Without using an external object, you probably wouldn’t be able to beat a third-level martial master, right?"
"You... you are humiliating me!" Lin Aotian trembled with anger.
"Haha... I’m not, I’m just telling the truth. Aren’t you scared?" Lin Yi mocked with a laugh.
"I... I..." Lin Aotian trembled with rage, a mouthful of fresh blood spewing out, his face deathly pale.
Seeing this, Lin Yi coldly laughed, "Grandpa, you’re really something, a strong Martial King being infuriated to the point of spitting blood by me, haha..."
"You... you..."
Lin Aotian was so angry that he couldn’t utter a single word.
Lin Yi’s expression suddenly turned serious, "Alright, Grandpa, this is still the Lin Family’s place after all. It’s better if you don’t mess around, otherwise, I can’t guarantee that father won’t find out."
With that said, Lin Yi turned and walked out.
"Stop right there!"
Lin Aotian hurriedly shouted, "Who do you think you’re talking to right now?"
Lin Yi stopped in his tracks, turned around and looked at Lin Aotian, "I don’t know if you’re willing to listen, but these are my words. If you want to seek death, go ahead!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Aotian’s brows furrowed, his face flashing with hesitation, and finally he gritted his teeth, "Fine, since you won’t heed my advice, I’ll sort you out first, you little bastard!"
After speaking, Lin Aotian suddenly leaped forward, transforming into a residual image charging towards Lin Yi.
Lin Yi had anticipated Lin Aotian’s actions and was already on guard. His body suddenly trembled, a black longsword appeared in front of his chest, and he quickly moved to the side, dodging Lin Aotian’s attack.
Boom!
A fierce attack smashed fiercely into the wall, instantly covering it with cracks and sending dust flying.
"What tremendous power!"
Lin Yi inwardly exclaimed in surprise.
Indeed, a high-ranking expert in the Martial Ancestor Realm, his palm strike was so powerfully formidable!
"Grandpa, feel free to use whatever moves you have!"
"Hmph, I’ll spare you today!" Lin Aotian angrily swept his sleeves and left.
"Huff!"
Lin Yi breathing heavily, his forehead sweating, and he looked weak.
While Lin Yi’s cultivation talent was low, he was presently only half a step into the Innate Realm, still far from truly reaching it.
However, Lin Yi was not discouraged. After all, he had reached the Martial King Realm in just a few short years, proving himself a prodigious genius, a true combat marvel among geniuses.
"I wonder if Grandpa has already brought over the Lin Family’s treasured object. I don’t know if this will go smoothly!" Lin Yi muttered to himself, his heart filled with anticipation.
Lin Aotian went back inside the house and immediately ordered people to move the Lin Family’s treasure vault into his own bedroom.
"The treasures of our ancestors are all there. I want to see what kind of disgraceful secrets you are hiding!"
"Hmph!"
Lin Aotian’s face darkened, his eyes narrowed, brimming with murderous intent.
...
On the other side.
"This time I’m really lucky. I didn’t expect that bastard Lin Yi to actually dare show up in front of me."
"Hahaha, it seems his days are numbered!"
"This time, I want to see how he can escape."
"Hehe..."
...
Lin Yi, carrying the key to the Lin Family treasury, left the Lin Family. He was no longer worried about Lin Aotian targeting him, as he had the power to protect himself.
...
Three days later, Lin Yi returned to the Lin Family with the treasury key.
At this time, the entire Lin Family was shrouded in a storm.
The upper echelons of the Lin Family and the guards had all gathered together, anxiously waiting for something.
"That bastard Lin Yi is back!"
"Good, we can finally make him pay with his life."
"He dared to steal the treasure of the town and turned our Lin Family into this mess; this time, we must not let him off."
The Lin Family’s upper echelons began discussing fervently.
Lin Yi walked over, swept his gaze around indifferently, and asked coldly, "What, are you planning to make a move against me?"
"Hmph, you unfilial son, to think you still dare to return! How shameless, you deserve to die!" Lin Aotian shouted angrily.
Lin Yi sneered, unafraid, and said, "Why shouldn’t I dare to return? Do you still want to kill me?"
Lin Aotian, furious yet laughing, retorted, "Of course! You traitor, daring to secretly manipulate the family’s wealth and even entrusting the treasury to outsiders, you have violated the Lin Family’s taboo and must be punished."
"How dare you!" Lin Yi’s expression hardened, and he glared furiously.
Lin Yi knew Lin Aotian was pushing him, and if he really dared to surrender himself, he was sure to face certain death.
Lin Yi couldn’t help but glance at Lin Aotian.
"Why wouldn’t we dare? You think just because you’ve grown up and become tough that you can mess around in the Lin Family? You’re too naive!" Lin Aotian stared coldly at Lin Yi.
At this moment, Lin Yi was at the end of his rope; he didn’t believe he could withstand many moves against Lin Aotian.
Although Lin Aotian was only half a step into Martial Sovereign Realm, he had lived for hundreds of years and was once a Martial Saint at the peak, his cultivation talent and foundation far surpassing ordinary people.
Lin Yi was no match for Lin Aotian.
"I admit, you’re more talented than I am, but don’t forget, the real power of the Lin Family now lies in my hands. I’m not an ordinary person; I am the only one in the Lin Family with a Soul Imprint! If you want to touch me, you must first ask if the Lin Family elders agree or not!" Lin Yi said coldly.
"What!? A Soul Imprint?" Lin Aotian’s expression froze, and his eyes revealed shock.
The Soul Imprint is a fundamental secret of martial artists, only accessible to Direct Disciples.
Such matters were known within the Lin Family but never revealed outside.
Because once such secrets were leaked, they would definitely bring fatal disasters.
"You need not doubt, the reason the Lin Family possesses these secrets is all because of me; if not for me, the Lin Family would have ceased to exist long ago!" Lin Yi said coldly, his eyes filled with intense hatred.
Lin Aotian took a deep breath, suppressing his shock, and said coldly, "In that case, I will completely erase your Soul Imprint!"
Lin Yi’s eyelids twitched; he hastily interjected, "No, if I die, my Soul Imprint will forever remain in the Lin Family, and my parents and siblings will also be implicated."
"Hmph! You actually think you’re something? With just a word from me, I can make your parents and friends die without a burial place!" Lin Aotian glared at Lin Yi, his eyes fierce with killing intent.
Lin Yi’s face dramatically changed, and he dared not meet Lin Aotian’s gaze any longer, instead turning to his father.
Lin Aotian’s eyes flickered with a cold light, and he said, "Father, do you really want to see me harmed for your sake?"
"I..."
These words from Lin Aotian abruptly put Lin Aotian himself in a dilemma.

chapters.title: Chapter 881 - 901: The Scheme Succeeds
chapters.content:
Chapter 881: Chapter 901: The Scheme Succeeds
"Father, if you really want to save me, then hurry up and transfer the Lin Family’s wealth into my storage ring," Lin Yi said.
Lin Aotian took a deep breath and nodded, "Alright, I’ll arrange for someone to handle this as soon as possible."
"Mm!"
Lin Yi nodded, a sly triumphant smile flashing across his eyes.
Then, he looked around at everyone and said aloud, "I’ve just returned, and I’m sure you all have much to discuss. I won’t disturb everyone any longer, I will take my leave!"
With that, Lin Yi turned and walked away.
The onlookers watched Lin Yi’s departing figure, their eyes filled with venomous hatred.
"This bastard, he still dares to come back, he’s really courting death!"
"I really want to see how exactly he’s going to die."
"That’s right, he actually had the audacity to break into the Lin Family’s treasury, this time, I will make him wish he were dead."
Lin Aotian glanced at the crowd and said, "Alright, disperse!"
Everybody scattered.
"Dad, are you really planning to give him the position of family head?" A middle-aged man beside Lin Aotian asked in a low voice.
Lin Aotian shook his head, "Of course not, I only want to scare him, to make him back down."
The middle-aged man let out a sigh of relief.
"This trash Lin Yi, he actually dared to steal the family assets, his crime is unforgivable!" Lin Aotian’s face was ashen, his eyes filled with rage.
Lin Yi returned to his residence, immediately closed the doors and windows, and then entered the Spatial Ring, taking out a Jade Slip and activating the Soul Imprint within.
Instantly, a powerful presence swept over him.
"Hu!" Lin Yi let out a heavy sigh, his face returning to normal.
"It seems this Soul Imprint really is effective. If I had really been caught, this Soul Imprint would have actually scattered my soul," Lin Yi’s face showed pleasure as he thought to himself.
"Lin Aotian, you are unkind, so don’t blame me for being unjust."
Killing intent surged in Lin Yi’s eyes as he said, "Now, I only have one last path to choose, and that is to join the Lin Family, help my father seize the position of family head, and then use this to threaten my father, making him pass the position to me. As long as father agrees, I can escape this disaster."
"But... I can’t control the evil power inside my body right now, what should I do?"
Lin Yi furrowed his eyebrows, pondering his next move.
"No matter what! I’m left with no choice, I must risk everything." Lin Yi gritted his teeth, determined, "Lin Aotian, you said you wanted to annihilate my entire family? Today, I will annihilate yours!"
Lin Yi’s heart had completely twisted, losing all sanity.
Lin Yi emptied everything out of the storage ring onto the ground, then took out all the Spirit Stones from his storage ring, stacking them into a small mountain of five to six million pieces, making the surrounding mercenaries’ eyes bulge.
"My god! These are all valuable Spirit Stones!"
"With these Spirit Stones, we could live a long time here, from now on we could live a carefree life!"
"That little wretch Lin Yi is really too extravagant, selling an Elixir for three hundred thousand Spirit Stones! All of this is money!"
Seeing these Spirit Stones, the people around were green with envy, greedy expressions in their eyes.
"Ha ha!" Lin Yi, seeing everyone’s reaction, wore a smug smile on his face.
"You bunch of fools, just you wait and see, I will reclaim all of this one day."
Lin Yi coldly shouted, directly collecting all the Spirit Stones heaped on the ground.
"You poor bastards, all of you scram!"
After saying that, Lin Yi put away the storage ring and turned to walk outside.
"Stop right there!" Suddenly, Lin Aotian shouted, and a torrential killing intent burst forth.
Feeling this scene, Lin Yi’s body shuddered, his face turned deathly pale, and his legs went weak uncontrollably.
Lin Yi’s heart felt ice-cold.
"Lin Yi, how dare you kill the members of the Lin Family, you brought this upon yourself. However, I must still thank you, for you have done me a great favor," Lin Aotian said with a hint of mockery in his eyes, looking indifferently at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s heart gave a violent twitch, and fear spread across his face as he hurriedly begged for mercy: "Father, I was wrong, please spare me, spare my life, it was all their sinister plotting!"
"Humph! You brought this disaster upon yourself!" Lin Aotian huffed coldly, "Someone, tie him up, I want to see what abilities he has to be so arrogant in front of me!"
"Yes, Patriarch!" A group of Lin Family guards swarmed in, completely surrounding Lin Yi.
Lin Yi was terrified and immediately knelt down to beg for mercy.
But Lin Aotian was unmoved and looked coldly at Lin Yi: "It’s too late for you to beg for mercy now, take him away!"
"Yes!"
The guards stepped forward and took Lin Yi away.
"Lin Xuan, you just wait for me! I will make you wish for death that you cannot achieve!"
Lin Yi had a vicious smile on his lips, his voice was shrill and sounded utterly terrifying.
...
Lin Yi was imprisoned.
"This old thief! He has actually locked me up and won’t let me leave this place!"
In the courtyard where Lin Yi was imprisoned, he roared angrily, his face twisted with ferocity, his eyes full of hatred and madness.
In front of Lin Yi were laid out hundreds of large boxes, all filled with precious materials, Spirit Grass, and Elixirs that he had snatched from Lin Aotian.
Lin Yi, while cursing and complaining, sorted through these materials, trying to refine them into Elixirs to enhance his cultivation.
"Humph! You want me to be obedient? Only if you kill me!"
Lin Yi’s gaze was icy as he stared at the boxes, his eyes filled with murderous intent.
Lin Yi’s eyesight was completely clouded by hatred, having forgotten that he was just an ordinary man.
"These materials are of decent quality, but I can’t use them at all!" Despair was written all over Lin Yi’s face.
"Here are two Supreme Grade Spirit Pills that can rapidly strengthen my soul power. Once I consume them, my soul power will reach the Martial Venerable Realm.
Then, even if Lin Aotian is a Heavenly Monarch Realm expert, I will cut him down to avenge my clansmen!" Lin Yi’s gaze was resolute, with a crazy light flickering in his eyes.
"But a Supreme Grade Spirit Pill is not so easily obtained!" Lin Yi’s brow furrowed slightly.
Though Lin Xuan was an Artifact Refiner, he didn’t know Alchemy.
Such things were only available to top forces, and they were always in the hands of the elders of the sect, and ordinary disciples could not possibly possess Supreme Grade Spirit Pills.
"Forget it, I have no way out now! I can only take a gamble!" Lin Yi’s expression was ferocious, "If I win, I not only get more resources, but I can also seek my revenge!
If I lose, then I’ll treat it as an indemnity, offering these treasures to the sect, letting them expel me from the family or even execute me!"
As he thought of this, the expression on Lin Yi’s face became increasingly twisted.
Finally, Lin Yi set his sights on those two Supreme Grade Spirit Pills.
Lin Yi took those two Supreme Grade Spirit Pills and swallowed them immediately.
In an instant, the two Supreme Grade Spirit Pills turned into overwhelming Spiritual Power that rushed into Lin Yi’s body, beginning to wildly destroy his meridians.

chapters.title: Chapter 882 - 902: No News Yet
chapters.content:
Chapter 882: Chapter 902: No News Yet
Lin Yi was in excruciating pain, but still clenched his teeth tightly, enduring the torment.
"Ha ha! It hurts, doesn’t it?"
Lin Yi’s eyes were filled with madness as he roared, "This pain is merely a bit of interest, and I will make Lin Aotian pay the price!"
...
Half a year later.
Tianyang City.
At the Lin Family estate, Lin Yi stood by the window, observing the outside scenery with a stern expression, his eyes filled with chill and murderous intent.
At this moment, behind him, a man dressed in black robes and wearing a mask stood respectfully, his expression also exceedingly solemn.
"Young Master, is there still no news of that little beast?" the man asked.
Lin Yi shook his head.
The man’s brow furrowed. After a moment of contemplation, he spoke, "Young Master, I came with you to Tianyang City not to kill Lin Xuan, but to find out how that little beast managed to infiltrate and kill him!"
Lin Yi slowly turned around, looked at the man in black, and a trace of appreciation flashed in his eyes as he chuckled, "You are truly worthy of being an Elite Guard of the Lin Family, indeed brave! You’ve done well, and I believe you can complete this mission for me!"
The man in black bowed respectfully and said, "Young Master, please rest assured, as long as our cooperation is pleasant, the Lin Family will surely reap great benefits."
"Good!" Lin Yi’s eyes shimmered with madness.
"Then, Young Master, I will make the arrangements now!" said the man in black obediently, turning to leave.
However, at that moment, his body abruptly stiffened, and a look of panic appeared on his face.
"What’s wrong?" Lin Yi asked, looking puzzled at the man in black.
"It’s nothing, Young Master, continue to rest, I shall take my leave!"
The man in black hurriedly turned and fled from the courtyard.
"Strange, I clearly sensed a powerful presence approaching, but why would that happen?"
Lin Yi’s heart was filled with doubts, not knowing what had happened. He quickly chased out the door, but the man in black had already fled far away.
"Nevermind! Since he doesn’t want to talk, I won’t ask further. I’ll ask when he returns!"
Lin Yi’s gaze once again turned towards the outside sky, his eyes flickering with intense murderous intent.
...
"Boom..."
Above the heavens, a burst of thunderous noise echoed.
On a massive palace, Lin Xuan sat in the master seat, his gaze sweeping over the Lin Family disciples below.
At this moment, the hall was filled with thousands of people, all members of the Lin Family.
"Today, I have gathered you all to announce something," Lin Xuan said coldly, looking down at the crowd.
"Lin Xuan, what are you doing?" Lin Aotian spoke up, his face looking ugly.
"Hmph, what am I doing? I’d like to ask you the same!" Lin Xuan snorted coldly, looking at Lin Aotian, "When I first brought Lin Yi to Tianyang City, I warned you. If you dare to harm Lin Yi, don’t blame me for being ruthless.
I, Lin Xuan, always keep my promises. Now, Lin Yi’s cultivation has already broken through to the peak of the Martial Sovereign Realm. Give him a few more months and he might directly break through to Martial Saint Realm!
So, you better not provoke him! Otherwise, I will definitely show you what I, Lin Xuan, am capable of!"
"You, your nonsense! How could Lin Yi’s cultivation progress so rapidly to Martial Saint!" Lin Aotian trembled all over, pointing at Lin Xuan and angrily said.
Lin Aotian was seething with anger, but he had no solution, because what Lin Xuan said was true.
Lin Yi’s strength had indeed reached the peak of the Intermediate Stage of Martial Saint, and he might break through to the Martial Emperor Realm at any moment!
Lin Xuan looked at Lin Aotian and scoffed coldly, "Do you know how he gained his cultivation? Who helped him improve?"
"Who?" Lin Aotian’s face changed slightly as he hastily asked.
"Me!"
Lin Xuan stated coldly, "Back then, it was I who personally helped Lin Yi enhance his cultivation! Now, Lin Yi has already broken through to the Martial King Realm!"
Shock filled Lin Aotian’s face, disbelief evident in his eyes as he stuttered, "Is, is, is this true?"
"You can try it yourself!"
Lin Xuan glanced indifferently at Lin Aotian, his eyes brimming with murderous intent as if he wanted to tear him apart.
"No, I won’t try, Lin Xuan, whatever you want to do, just say it. As long as I can do it, I will follow through," Lin Aotian quickly said.
Lin Aotian wasn’t foolish; he felt a strong threat from Lin Xuan’s words.
"The Lin Family, you no longer have a reason to exist!"
Lin Xuan shouted coldly, a token appearing in his hand which he threw directly at Lin Aotian.
"Swish!"
The token shot out and instantly arrived above Lin Aotian’s head.
Lin Aotian’s pupils constricted, and he hurriedly grabbed the token in his hand.
Suddenly, the token emitted a gentle glow, enveloping Lin Aotian’s body.
"Ah!"
Lin Aotian let out a scream, his entire body rapidly disintegrating, his robe soaked with blood, as black flames spread from his body and consumed him in the blink of an eye.
Everything happened in an instant; there was no time for anyone to react.
Lin Aotian, the head of the Lin Family, a high-ranking Martial Sovereign, was burned alive to ashes!
Lin Xuan snorted coldly, his gaze falling on Lin Yu as he said lightly, "Lin Yu, I have already taught your precious son a lesson, now it’s your turn!"
Hearing Lin Xuan’s words, Lin Yu’s body jolted, his face turning pale.
Lin Aotian was dead, yet he still controlled the position as head of the Lin Family; if Lin Xuan killed him too, he would completely lose his qualification to rule the Lin Family.
Lin Yu did not want to die, nor did he want to lose his position as the head of the Lin Family!
"Lin Xuan, what, what do you want to do?"
Lin Yu quickly looked at Lin Xuan, his face full of fear as he asked.
"Nothing much!"
Lin Xuan said with a faint smile, "I’m just telling you that I’ve taken a liking to your good son Lin Yi. If you want to save your life, obediently hand over the control of the family, then crawl back to your hole and never step foot in the Lin Family again."
Lin Yu’s heart trembled, his eyes filled with intense regret, cursing himself for his foolishness.
Had he known how formidable Lin Xuan was, he would never have sent Lin Yi to the Lin Family, let alone provoke Lin Xuan!
But now, it was all too late. Lin Xuan had not only taken control from Lin Yi but had also slain Lin Aotian here!
Lin Xuan was truly cruel!
Lin Yu suddenly kneeled, pleading, "Lin Xuan, please, don’t kill me, I’m willing to be your ox and horse if you spare me!"
"Ox and horse?" Lin Xuan sneered, "Lin Yu, are you even worthy of mentioning being an ox or horse to me? You are nothing but a dog of the Lin Family!"
Lin Xuan’s words pierced into Lin Yu’s chest like swords, blood gushing from the wound, soaking the front of his robe.
"Lin Xuan, you, you, you will not die a good death, I, I will not let you go!"
Lin Yu’s eyes flared with rage, glaring at Lin Xuan, wishing he could devour him.

chapters.title: Chapter 883 - 903: Pale as Paper
chapters.content:
Chapter 883: Chapter 903: Pale as Paper
Lin Aotian saw the situation and was overjoyed in his heart, hastily speaking, "Lin Xuan, since you’re unwilling to let Lin Yu off, then I, Lin Aotian, am willing to abandon the family!"
Saying so, Lin Aotian attempted to stand and leave.
However, just at that moment, Lin Aotian felt a burst of acute pain coursing through his body.
"Ah!"
Lin Aotian screamed in agony and fell back to the ground, his complexion pale as paper.
"I advise you to be more sensible!" Lin Xuan said coldly.
Lin Aotian clenched his teeth but dared not utter another word.
His strength was far too inferior to Lin Xuan’s, to the point where even self-protection was extremely difficult; where would he dare to dissent?
"Lin Yu, over these years, you’ve committed many wicked deeds; all along you have oppressed the members of our Lin Family, and you even abandoned a newborn child in the wilderness. Don’t you think you deserve to be punished?" Lin Xuan said coldly.
"This, this... I, I had no choice!" With a bitter expression, Lin Yu hurriedly began to explain.
"Had no choice?" Lin Xuan scoffed with a cold laugh, "Lin Yu, your gall is truly considerable; you actually dare to oppress the members of the Lin Family?"
"I, I didn’t want to, but who told them they aren’t from the Lin Family? If I spared them, that would be a truly grievous sin!" Lin Yu said with a bitter smile.
"Heh." Lin Xuan laughed disdainfully, "Lin Yu, I really question what your head is for!"
"What do you mean?" Lin Yu frowned.
"You think I don’t know that you’ve been intent on nurturing Lin Yi to become the successor to the family head and then seize the position of the head of the Lin Family?"
Lin Xuan spoke, "Lin Yi is my adopted son; how could I possibly stand by and watch you harm my adopted son?
If I don’t eliminate you now, would Lin Yi not continue to suffer such treatment in the future?"
Lin Xuan looked coldly at Lin Yu and said icily, "Lin Yu, if you know what’s good for you, hand over the control willingly. Otherwise, today will be your death anniversary!"
"You, you... Lin Xuan, don’t think I’m afraid of you! There are many masters in the Lin Family! If you kill me, you definitely won’t escape being hunted down!" Lin Yu hastily shouted with panic evident in his tone.
Lin Yu knew that Lin Xuan’s strength was extremely terrifying, and if he did not surrender, there would only be a dead end!
"Oh? Is that so? What I’m waiting for is precisely your family’s masters to come rushing over!" Lin Xuan sneered.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yu’s face suddenly stiffened.
Lin Xuan’s words were clearly meant to intimidate him.
If Lin Xuan were truly afraid of the family’s masters, he wouldn’t dare to be so arrogant!
"Lin Xuan, the masters of the Lin Family aren’t as simple as you think, each one of them capable of killing you," Lin Yu said coldly.
"And what of it?"
Lin Xuan smirked dismissively, "What of the Lin Family’s masters? I would still slay them all."
Lin Xuan wasn’t boasting; although he was unaware of exactly how many masters the Lin Family had, the strength of the Lin Family was definitely far beyond his expectations, even surpassing that of the sect of Dragon Tiger Mountain.
"Alright, enough nonsense! Now, I declare that you, Lin Yu, henceforth are a traitor to the Lin Family, no longer the family head," Lin Xuan said solemnly.
"You, what did you say? You, you can’t do this to me!" Lin Yu roared.
"Why can’t I? Lin Yu, I’m giving you two choices: submit to me, or die. Make your choice," Lin Xuan sneered.
"Hmph!"
Lin Yu snorted coldly, unwilling to just die like that.
But, he had no other choice, as there were too many formidable people present; dispatching any one of them was enough to kill him instantly!
Therefore, he could only choose to submit.
Of course, in choosing to submit, Lin Yu also passed on the position of the head of the Lin Family to Lin Yi.
He knew that Lin Yi was the unquestionable choice to be the head of the Lin Family!
...
When Lin Yi learned about Lin Yu’s predicament, he couldn’t help but sigh helplessly in his heart.
The number of masters in the Lin Family far exceeded Lin Yi’s estimation, so it was no surprise that Lin Yu was wiped out.
"Father, now that the position of the head of the Lin Family has been handed over to me, I will leave everything here to you," Lin Yi said slowly, with a smile on his face.
Upon hearing this, Lin Aotian felt a mix of emotions, as he had not expected Lin Yi to truly hand over the leadership of the family to him.
"Good, good, good."
Lin Aotian repeated the word "good" three times, obviously very satisfied with the outcome.
Lin Yi’s decision was entirely made from his perspective; Lin Aotian was deeply touched and comforted!
"Father, I must be going now!" Lin Yi said with a smile, then turned and walked towards the exit, seemingly without any attachment to the place.
"Um!"
Lin Aotian nodded slightly, his gaze following Lin Yi, his face showing a hint of worry.
"Father, there’s no need to worry. I, Lin Yi, am not a pushover. Not to mention the position of the head of the Lin Family, even if I had the entire Lin Family in my grasp, I could manage it!" Lin Yi said to Lin Aotian, smiling.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Aotian finally showed a smile: "Good, I believe in my son!"
"Father, I ask you to temporarily act as the head of the Lin Family for a while. I hope to find Lin Hao soon and avenge him," Lin Yi said.
"Alright, I promise you," Lin Aotian nodded slightly.
"Father, I have other matters to attend to, so I won’t accompany you any longer," Lin Yi said with a bow and then left the hall.
Watching Lin Yi’s retreating figure, Lin Aotian shook his head inwardly.
He knew all too well that Lin Yi wasn’t really concerned for Lin Hao’s safety, but rather saw this as an opportunity to bridge the gap with Lin Hao!
How could Lin Aotian not see through Lin Yi’s intentions?
But Lin Yi’s thoughts left Lin Aotian feeling helpless.
"Alas, Lin Yi, why are you so obstinate and insist on opposing the Lin Family?
Do you really content yourself with being just an ordinary disciple?" Lin Aotian sighed.
...
"Lin Xuan, I keep my word. I have defeated Lin Yu, and now the position of the head of the Lin Family is mine. Now, it’s your turn, isn’t it?" Lin Yi looked at Lin Xuan with a playful expression in his eyes, smiling.
"You want the position of the head of the Lin Family? Too bad, you’re not qualified!" Lin Xuan laughed, "I tell you now, I will make your life worse than death!"
"Hahaha!"
Hearing this, Lin Xuan burst into laughter.
"Lin Xuan, what are you laughing at?" Lin Yi raised an eyebrow, "Do you really think you can stand against me?"
"Of course. Killing you would be as easy as flipping my hand!" Lin Xuan said indifferently.
"Alright, then I shall see how you plan to kill me!" Lin Yi laughed.
Then, Lin Yi’s gaze swept over everyone around him.
"I don’t care for the position of the head of the Lin Family or the leadership of the Lin Family; I just want you dead!" Lin Yi declared.
As soon as Lin Yi’s words fell, mocking laughter broke out from the crowd.
"Lin Yi, have you lost your mind? The position of the head of the Lin Family is an honor in our family; how can you casually give it away to someone else?"
"Lin Yi, aren’t you being a bit too shameless?"
"What you’re saying is not just an insult to us, but also to the Lin Family. Do you know what kind of consequences your words will bring?"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 884 - 904: Unparalleled Prestigious Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 884: Chapter 904: Unparalleled Prestigious Identity
Lin Xuan stood beside Lin Yi, speaking indifferently, "Lin Yi, you useless trash, even if you hand over the Lin Family, what of it?"
"You all are useless, incapable of helping me in any way!" Lin Yi shouted.
Hearing this, the people around Lin Yi glared at him in anger, yet no one dared to speak a word.
After all, Lin Yi was the son of the Lin Family head, a person of incomparable status. Who would dare to provoke him?
"I know, Lin Yi, you must be thinking that you can definitely secure the position of the Family Head.
But don’t forget, you are just a piece of trash!
The position of the Lin Family Head is a glory of my Lin Family.
And a piece of trash like you doesn’t deserve it!
So, you might as well give up!" Lin Xuan said lightly, "You have one last chance, either hand over your life or the position of the Family Head!"
"Hmph, dreaming if you think I would give up the position of the Family Head!"
Lin Yi said through gritted teeth, no fool he.
He was well aware of how staggeringly powerful the Lin Family was, with his grandfather Lin Aotian being a Martial King Realm expert.
If he handed over the position of the Lin Family head, would he still be able to live?
"Hehe..."
Lin Yi chuckled coldly: "Even if I die, I won’t hand over the position of the Family Head!"
"Oh?"
Hearing this, Lin Xuan couldn’t help but laugh.
This smile of Lin Xuan was filled with mockery.
Seeing this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but frown.
He felt that there was something peculiar about Lin Xuan’s smile, almost as if mocking his stupidity!
"What exactly do you want?" Lin Yi asked coldly.
"I want you to kneel at my feet, kowtow begging for mercy, and promise that from now on, all members of your Lin Family will not defy Lin Hao’s orders, otherwise, I will make sure your Lin Family lives in misery," Lin Xuan said indifferently.
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s face changed, and his fists clenched tightly.
Lin Hao?
Could it be Lin Hao?
Lin Yi quickly realized, his eyes widening in disbelief: "Impossible, it can’t be Lin Hao, this is impossible!"
"Hmph, don’t believe? You can try!" Lin Xuan sneered coldly, "If you don’t do as I say, today, your Lin Family will face a calamity!"
"What exactly do you want to do? I’m telling you, this is the Lin Family, not a place where you can act wildly!
If you dare to kill any of our Lin Family members, my grandfather will never let you off!" Lin Yi threatened.
"Don’t worry, I will only kill all of you, as for your grandfather, he won’t make a single move," Lin Xuan said with a shrug and a smile.
"You..." Lin Yi’s face was extremely somber.
Seeing Lin Yi’s demeanor, Lin Xuan couldn’t be bothered to waste more words.
"Since you so wish to die, I shall grant your wish!"
With that, Lin Xuan walked directly towards Lin Yi.
The moment he approached Lin Yi, his aura dramatically increased, pressing down upon Lin Yi like a towering mountain.
Pfft!
Lin Yi spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, his body trembling involuntarily.
"You...what level of strength are you, how can you be so formidable?" Lin Yi asked in horror.
Lin Yi had never felt such a terrifying aura released by anyone, as if it was about to crush his physical body.
Lin Yi’s words made everyone from the Lin Family change their expressions drastically; they all felt the aura released by Lin Xuan, making their hearts beat uncontrollably, almost suffocating.
"What strength I have, can’t you feel it?" Lin Xuan’s mouth curled into a cold arc.
"Could it be... could it be that you are already at the Martial Sovereign Realm?"
Upon hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Xuan smirked slightly and nodded.
Lin Yi immediately felt a chill rush to the top of his head, his whole body’s hair standing on end, drenched in cold sweat.
"No... no, that’s impossible. You clearly are not at the Martial King Realm, and your cultivation is only at the peak of the Samurai Realm. How could you possibly reach the Martial Sovereign Realm?" Lin Yi looked at Lin Xuan incredulously, his face pale.
In Lin Yi’s memory, the Martial King Realm was the ultimate limit of the Samurai Realm!
And the Martial Master Realm was the peak of the intermediate stage for Martial Artists, also the ultimate limit of the Martial Master Realm!
And the Martial Sovereign Realm is the Martial Saint Realm!
Among these levels of powerhouses, Lin Yi had also encountered them!
However, that Martial Sovereign powerhouse was not someone Lin Yi could provoke.
Lin Yi could only look up, only look up!
And now, a mere peak Martial Ancestor also possessed the strength of a Martial Sovereign!
Lin Yi felt his worldview was about to collapse!
"Lin Yi, in this world, there are many things that do not need understanding, only recognition that strength is everything," Lin Xuan said coldly, indifferently.
Hearing these words, Lin Yi’s face became even more uncomfortable.
"You all listen, from today onwards, I am the head of the Lin Family, Lin Xuan!"
"Yes... Head!"
Everyone in the Lin Family present shouted respectfully, their faces filled with reverence.
"I will take you to meet the head of the Lin Family now!"
Lin Xuan looked at Lin Yi with a slight smug twist of his lips, carrying a hint of coldness.
"Okay!"
Seeing this, Lin Yi had no choice but to follow behind Lin Xuan, preparing to go meet the head of the Lin Family, Lin Hao.
Lin Xuan was quick as he led the Lin Family members swiftly to the Lin Family mansion.
As Lin Xuan and Lin Yi arrived at the mansion’s entrance, the guards on both sides immediately came over, respectfully saying, "Greeting the head!"
"Um, take me inside," Lin Xuan nodded, then turned to Lin Yi, "Remember, no tricks, or I will send you to your death immediately!"
"I know, I dare not, head please!" Lin Yi said, bowing his head.
"Hmph!" Lin Xuan snorted coldly, then led all the Lin Family members into the mansion.
Seeing Lin Yi and the other Lin Family members being led away, whispers also spread among the Lin Family.
The arrival of Lin Xuan and Lin Yi shocked all the Lin Family members, they all found it unbelievable.
Especially those followers of Lin Xuan, they were extremely astonished.
"Is the Young Master truly a Martial Sovereign powerhouse?"
"No doubt, absolutely right!"
"The Young Master is so young and has such strength, his future is boundless!"
"I believe, once Lin Xuan takes over as the head, our Lin Family will surely rise!"
"Hahaha... naturally, with the Young Master being so formidable, his future path is limitless!"
People showered him with praises, unaware that the faces of the Lin Family members were turning extremely grim.
They all felt humiliated by Lin Xuan!
"Lin Xuan, we have a feud now, and one day, I will have my revenge!" Lin Yi said fiercely to himself.
At this moment, Lin Xuan led the Lin Family members to the courtyard where Lin Hao resided.
"Stop!"
Seeing Lin Yi and Lin Xuan, several guards hurriedly came to block them, shouting coldly.
Lin Xuan stopped in his tracks, lifted his head to look at the several guards: "You guys, go report, say that the head of the Lin Family wants to see me!"
Hearing Lin Xuan’s words, the guards looked startled, then one of them laughed and said, "Kid, you’re at the wrong place, this isn’t where you should be, scram!"
"Scram?"
Hearing these words, Lin Xuan coldly smiled, swung his right hand, and slapped the face of that guard, sending him flying.

chapters.title: Chapter 885 - 905: Overestimating Oneself!
chapters.content:
Chapter 885: Chapter 905: Overestimating Oneself!
"Boom!"
With a thunderous noise, a guard smashed into the wall nearby, spitting out blood and falling unconscious immediately.
This scene stunned everyone; they just stared at Lin Xuan with shock, fear, and disbelief in their eyes.
"How... how... how did this happen?" Lin Yi’s eyes widened in disbelief as he stared at the scene before him, his mind going blank.
Lin Xuan actually dared to injure a guard of the Lin Family?
Has he gone mad?
Lin Yi felt that his entire worldview had been overturned; he simply couldn’t believe it.
"You Lin Family dogs are simply too insolent, daring to show disrespect to the Young Master and even use words to insult him, you deserve death!"
"Thinking that you lot could provoke the Young Master, utterly overestimating yourselves!"
Looking at the few guards, Lin Yi’s gaze was filled with murderous intent.
Lin Yi was certain, these lapdogs had come specifically to humiliate him!
"You... you actually dare to strike down my subordinates?!" Lin Yi pointed at Lin Xuan, shaking all over with rage.
Lin Xuan saw Lin Yi’s reaction and sneered, "What, can’t accept it?"
"Do you know who my father is? You dare to beat my guards; this will not end well!"
"Oh? It won’t end well? What do you want to do about it?" Lin Xuan asked, frowning slightly.
"I will kill you! I will grind your bones to dust and take revenge for my men!"
Lin Yi growled through clenched teeth.
"What did you say?!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Xuan’s eyes narrowed slightly, and his expression turned instantly grim.
Lin Yi’s words had utterly enraged him; his fury erupted in a flash, and his eyes gleamed with a chilling murderousness, like a sword emitting a numbing coldness.
"I don’t care who you are or how powerful your background is; today, you must die. Not only that, but you will pay for what you’ve done!" Lin Xuan said coldly.
"How dare you, do you know who you’re talking to?"
"You’re opposing the Lin Family; even if the Lin Family does not deal with you, the people of the Lin Family around you will certainly not let you off!"
Hearing Lin Xuan’s words, Lin Yi was enraged. He felt that Lin Xuan was incredibly audacious to threaten him!
"So what about the Lin Family?"
"To me, the Lin Family is just a fart, nothing but a fart!"
Lin Xuan uttered each word deliberately, his tone laden with contempt, showing no regard for the Lin Family, utterly disdainful of their strength.
"You..."
Hearing these words, Lin Yi shook with anger, eyes filled with resentment and fury.
"Fine, very fine, I, Lin Yi, will remember you!"
"You’d better pray you can stay alive today; otherwise, it won’t just be the Lin Family that won’t let you off, but I will also exterminate every single child of the Lin Family around you!" Lin Yi said venomously, his eyes brimming with killing intent.
"Hmph! Just try it and see if you have the ability!"
Lin Xuan replied coldly, looking at Lin Yi.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi felt a suffocating frustration in his chest.
He, the legitimate son of the Lin Family, couldn’t even compare to a mere servant?
But he also knew that he indeed could not beat Lin Xuan.
After all, to the Lin Family, he was nothing but trash.
Thinking this, Lin Yi took a deep breath and turned to enter the Lin Family estate.
The Lin Family estate occupied the largest area of the city, spanning hundreds of acres, a super-sized manor of the Lin Family.
This time, as Lin Yi returned to the clan, it was naturally impossible for the Lin Family to dispatch their most elite experts to welcome him; since this was Lin Yi’s first return to the clans, they naturally had to send the most formidable experts to ensure safety.
Therefore, the high-level members of the Lin Family were discussing matters in the hall.
When Lin Yi arrived at the hall, it was already filled with people; all members of the Lin Family were present, their faces bearing a grave expression.
Seeing Lin Yi appear, everyone immediately stood up and respectfully said, "Young Master, we salute you!"
"Dispense with the formalities!"
Lin Yi nodded his head, then took a seat in the principal seat.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s father’s complexion also turned uncertain, and a shade of worry appeared in his eyes.
He glanced at Lin Yi, then at Lin Xuan, and couldn’t help but sigh inwardly.
It seemed that things were about to become troublesome.
"You’ve returned?"
Upon Lin Yi’s entrance, the Great Elder of the Lin Family spoke indifferently, his tone also revealing a hint of subtle authority.
Lin Yi’s expression turned cold upon seeing the attitude of the Great Elder.
"Father, I have something to tell you!"
Hearing this, the Great Elder nodded his head and then walked to a chair on another side and seated himself.
Seeing this, Lin Yi took a deep breath and followed, taking a seat beside his own father.
The Great Elder surveyed Lin Yi and asked in a deep voice, "What has happened? You speak first!"
Upon hearing his father’s question, Lin Yi didn’t hesitate and immediately recounted the events, narrating his own experiences.
At this, the Great Elder of the Lin Family fell silent.
Although he had anticipated that Lin Yi’s return would surely invite trouble, he had not expected it to be so serious.
The expression of the Great Elder turned exceedingly somber, a powerful intent to kill flashed in his eyes as he coldly questioned, "You say he killed your servant, and you witnessed it with your own eyes?"
"Yes!"
"Then why did you not stop him?" the Great Elder asked.
"I..."
Faced with the Great Elder’s questioning, Lin Yi’s face showed a hint of embarrassment, but ultimately, he had no choice but to reveal the matter.
Originally, he indeed intended to stop Lin Xuan, but he was counterattacked by Lin Xuan.
Hearing Lin Yi’s explanation, the Great Elder’s face became even more grim, and his eyes were filled with icy contempt as he said, "You fool, is a servant of our Lin Family someone you can harm?"
"Besides, do you realize that his identity is special, as the future heir of the Lin Family? If he were injured, our Lin Family would suffer heavy losses. Are you trying to doom our Lin Family?"
"I... I just felt that wretched servant was too hateful, she does not deserve to be a descendant of the Lin Family!" Lin Yi defended.
Upon hearing this, Lin Xuan’s mouth curved into a mocking smile.
However, he said nothing.
Because he knew very well that these words were just excuses.
"You claim you are the heir of the Lin Family, but what makes you qualified to be the heir?" the Great Elder harshly rebuked.
"I..."
"I do not care whether you are the heir or not, but since you have returned, you should abide by the family rules. As a member of our Lin Family, you’re involved in disputes and jealousy with others, even resorting to murder. Are you intent on destroying our Lin Family?"
Hearing the Great Elder’s scolding, Lin Yi immediately felt a burning pain on his face.
"You bastard! No matter who you are, anyone who dares to bully my people must die!" Lin Yi roared, his eyes brimming with murderous intent.
"Heh, do you really wish to kill someone?" Lin Xuan stood up, his eyes holding a playful smile.
"Of course!" Lin Yi replied coldly.
"Very well, today I shall let you taste what it is like to wish you were dead rather than alive!"
As Lin Xuan’s words fell, he suddenly swept his sleeve robe.
Boom~

chapters.title: Chapter 886 - 906: Challenging the Bottom Line
chapters.content:
Chapter 886: Chapter 906: Challenging the Bottom Line
With a terrifying tremor echoing through the air, Lin Yi only felt a blur before his eyes and was then blasted away.
"Bang~"
Lin Yi’s body smashed into a stone wall, emitting a muffled sound as blood spewed wildly; his clothes torn to tatters, his appearance was extremely wretched.
"Pfft!"
A mouthful of blood sprayed out, and Lin Yi’s complexion turned exceedingly pale.
Staring at the injuries on his body, his eyes widened in shock.
His face became extremely unsightly, filled with disbelief.
He had not anticipated Lin Xuan to be so powerful; just one punch had left him in such a sorry state.
Inside, he harbored a deep wariness of Lin Xuan.
"However, I want to see just how capable you really are!"
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed, and a cold light shot from them. With a leap, he rushed towards Lin Xuan, his palm striking out. A robust burst of Spiritual Power exploded instantly, transforming into a colossal claw imprint, viciously clawing at Lin Xuan.
Seeing this, Lin Xuan was not to be outdone and threw a punch in response.
"Boom~"
A violent collision sounded, and Lin Yi’s form was directly sent flying by Lin Xuan’s punch.
"Thud~"
Lin Yi crashed to the ground, another mouthful of blood ejected.
His body convulsed ceaselessly, his complexion twisted hideously, his eyes filled with astonishment.
That punch just now had completely sent him flying; he simply couldn’t withstand the opponent’s attack.
"Lin Xuan, I will make you pay the price!"
Lin Yi’s eyes brimmed with venomous spite.
"What do you think you’re doing, daring to run wild here!"
At this moment, a guard suddenly charged in from outside.
Upon seeing this scene, the guard’s face lit up with joy.
"Young Master, someone’s causing trouble!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s face subtly changed, and he coldly turned his gaze to Lin Xuan, saying sternly, "Lin Xuan, no matter who you are, how dare you raise your hand against the Lin Family’s young master. You’re making an enemy of the entire Lin Family. I’d advise you to run away quickly!"
"Run away?" Lin Xuan snorted with derision: "After running away, how will you deal with me then? Lin Yi, I’m warning you, don’t blame me for being ruthless. If you don’t hand over my sister, I will ensure the Lin Family’s downfall!"
"Lin Xuan, you’re simply too ignorant of the immensity of heaven and earth!" Upon hearing Lin Xuan’s words, the multitude from the Lin Family also flew into a rage.
"Hmph, Lin Xuan, if you don’t hand over my sister today, the Lin Family will never let you go!" Lin Yi declared with a stern voice.
"Hahaha!" Upon hearing this, Lin Xuan burst into uproarious laughter.
"Lin Xuan, I don’t care about your background. Right now, you’d best return my sister! Otherwise, you’ll become a criminal of the Lin Family, and your life will be over!" Lin Yi continued to shout.
Seeing this, the people of the Lin Family all echoed in agreement, their voices full of threats and warnings.
Lin Xuan’s expression darkened, his eyes glinting with a sliver of icy sharpness as he addressed Lin Yi coldly, "Lin Yi, are you trying to test my limits today?"
Hearing this, Lin Yi was momentarily taken aback before his expression twisted savagely, his eyes filling with even more rage.
"You dare threaten me?"
"And what if I dare threaten you?"
At that, Lin Xuan’s expression turned even colder.
Witnessing this, the surrounding individuals shook their heads secretly, considering Lin Xuan utterly unappreciative.
The Lin Family’s power was enormous; the Great Elder had already reached the Yuan Dan Realm Peak, and even the family head, Lin Tian, had already reached the Fifth Layer of the Meridian Condensation Realm, with the clan elders having reached the Ninefold Bone Refinement. The entire Lin Family was exceedingly formidable.
Lin Xuan’s actions were tantamount to courting death!
"Good, very good! Lin Xuan, I want to see just how much you weigh, daring to threaten me. Today, I will not only make you die but also live in suffering worse than death!"
After speaking, Lin Yi’s eyes also flickered with a grim murderous intent.
"Is that so?" Lin Xuan’s lips curled up in a scornful smile, and his indifferent voice rang out once more.
"Your trump card has already been used up. What else do you have to fight me with?"
Upon hearing these words, Lin Yi’s face suddenly changed dramatically.
That’s right, Lin Xuan’s cultivation had already recovered to the Third Layer of the Meridian Condensation Realm, whereas he was merely at the Fourth Layer.
The gap between them was simply insurmountable!
"Lin Xuan, you... you... I don’t believe you can maintain this state forever!"
Lin Yi clenched his teeth as he spoke, aware that now he could only rely on himself.
Therefore, he immediately reined in his thoughts, preparing to wait for reinforcements from the Lin Family before making a move against Lin Xuan.
Seeing this, Lin Xuan’s face turned cold.
"Heh, Lin Yi, you truly live up to being the Lin Family’s trash, thinking of fleeing at a time like this. Do you think you can get away like this?"
After saying that, Lin Xuan’s fingers flicked lightly, and an overwhelmingly powerful force poured into Lin Yi’s body, causing him to convulse all over, with an expression of extreme agony.
"No..."
Lin Yi let out a miserable howl.
"Ah!"
This time, Lin Yi was truly in pain, his facial muscles twisting, clearly enduring excruciating torture.
"Ah!!!"
As Lin Xuan’s fingers trembled slightly, Lin Yi couldn’t help but let out another miserable shriek.
"Lin Xuan, you’ll not die a good death, you’re trying to end my life!" Lin Yi roared furiously, his eyes brimming with intense hatred.
Lin Yi’s voice completely enraged Lin Xuan.
His eyes iced over, sneering, "Lin Yi, do you really think I would give you a chance to survive? I won’t give anyone a chance; you must die!"
"Boom!!"
After speaking, a surging aura emanated from Lin Xuan’s body.
Lin Xuan took a step forward, his figure like a ghostly shadow, instantly closing in on Lin Yi, his right fist smashing out fiercely.
This punch carried unparalleled might.
"Boom!!!"
The air burst open, emitting a roaring sound.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s face changed drastically, hastily mobilizing the spiritual energy within his body, preparing to fend off Lin Xuan’s fatal blow.
But Lin Xuan’s speed was simply too fast, Lin Yi couldn’t react in time.
"Pfft!"
The next moment, Lin Yi’s chest was punched through, blood splattering.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s facial expression froze completely.
"Ah!!!"
Afterward, he let out another hysterical roar.
His body trembled violently, as if he was enduring immense pain.
Seeing this, the surrounding members of the Lin Family were terrified, staring dumbfounded at Lin Xuan.
Lin Xuan’s strength far exceeded their expectations, defeating Lin Yi with a single punch.
Such strength was truly monstrous!
Lin Yi was the foremost genius of the young generation in the Lin Family, but now he was defeated by a Martial Artist of the Third Layer of the Meridian Condensation Realm with a single punch.
This was truly heart-shaking.
"How... how... how is this possible!"
"How can Lin Xuan’s strength be so formidable!"
"What... what is the reason, why does Lin Xuan possess such power, it’s simply defying the heavens!"
"Could it be that the Lin Family has produced another peerless genius?"
...
Everyone was filled with questions, Lin Xuan’s emergence causing a deep sense of dread to rise in their hearts.
Not only them, but even the Martial Artists standing far away watching felt the same.

chapters.title: Chapter 887 - 907: Playing the Game of Cat and Mouse
chapters.content:
Chapter 887: Chapter 907: Playing the Game of Cat and Mouse
A single punch defeated a Martial Artist at the Third Layer of the Meridian Condensation Realm; such strength was absolutely terrifying!
"What’s wrong, Lin Yi? Didn’t you want to make my life worse than death? Now, it’s your turn!"
Lin Xuan’s eyes narrowed, and a bloodthirsty smile curled up at the corner of his mouth.
"No..."
Upon hearing Lin Xuan’s words, Lin Yi’s pupils shrank, his eyes flashing with fear.
Feeling the terrifying aura emanating from Lin Xuan, realizing that death was drawing ever closer, Lin Yi’s heart started to convulse uncontrollably.
"Lin Xuan, what... what are you going to do?"
Feeling that overwhelming aura of death, Lin Yi was in utter panic.
He couldn’t help but step back.
"Lin Yi, I’ve lost interest in playing a cat and mouse game with you; I want you dead!"
Having said that, Lin Xuan threw another punch, directly penetrating Lin Yi’s chest.
"Thud!!!"
A mouthful of crimson blood trickled down Lin Yi’s throat.
Watching Lin Yi’s body slowly fall, a cold light flashed in Lin Xuan’s eyes; he then grabbed Lin Yi by the neck, lifted him up, and walked outside.
At this moment, the crowd was already frightened out of their wits.
Lin Xuan’s punch that killed a Martial Artist at the Third Layer of the Meridian Condensation Realm was indeed terrifying.
For a time, no one dared to speak another word.
However, they were all somewhat puzzled; Lin Yi might have been a Martial Artist at the Third Layer of the Meridian Condensation Realm, but surely not just anyone could defeat him with a single punch.
How did Lin Xuan manage this?
Moreover, without even using a Spiritual Artifact, Lin Xuan had routed Lin Yi, which was truly horrifying!
What kind of freak was this Lin Xuan!
Frightened, the group didn’t dare to linger any longer and turned to flee, leaving the Lin Family behind.
"Lin Xuan, may you die a horrible death, your actions will surely provoke the Lin Family’s pursuit!" Lin Yi’s eyes showed malicious resentment as he stared fiercely at Lin Xuan.
"Pursuit?"
Upon hearing this, a shadow passed across Lin Xuan’s eyes, and with a flash of cold light he retorted coldly.
"Lin Yi, I gave you a chance, but you didn’t cherish it. Since that’s the case, don’t blame me for crushing you ruthlessly!"
After speaking, Lin Xuan flicked his sleeve, and a burst of flames shot out from his cuff, transforming into fierce flames engulfing Lin Yi’s chest.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s pupils contracted sharply.
He could clearly feel the scorching wave of heat; his skin felt like it was being seared.
"No, I... I surrender... spare me..." Lin Yi screamed.
Hearing these words, Lin Xuan paid no mind, continuing to move his hand forward, as flames rapidly spread, covering Lin Yi’s entire body.
"Sizzle~!"
Then, with a wave of his hand, Lin Xuan summoned a Flame Whip, which directly wrapped around Lin Yi’s body.
A piercing scream of agony instantly filled the entire villa.
"Ahhh!!!"
Lin Yi’s miserable screams echoed in Lin Xuan’s ears, giving him a particularly exhilarating feeling.
"Lin Yi, I’ll send you to your death now, so you stop polluting the environment!"
While speaking, Lin Xuan slightly lifted his palm and a Elixir was directly swallowed into his mouth.
"Boom!"
After that, a wild aura burst forth from his body, and his entire being seemed to transform into a fire Qilin, his body surging with flames, brimming with boundless power.
"Huff! Huff!"
Without further hesitation, Lin Xuan took a step and rushed out of the villa, heading towards the north of the city.
"Huff! Huff!"
Running wildly, Lin Xuan quickly reached a desolate small town.
This is an abandoned village, the surroundings are in disarray, overgrown with weeds, hardly any living creatures in sight.
Above the ruins, a plaque hangs crookedly, inscribed with the words ’Heavenly Mansion’.
"Heavenly Mansion?" Lin Xuan glanced at the plaque, his eyebrows raised, his eyes filled with surprise.
The Heavenly Mansion was the most elite residence within the Heavenly Mansion grounds.
This residence was the dwelling place of the master of the Heavenly Mansion.
Moreover, this residence was also protected by a Spiritual Artifact Formation.
Such Formations were incredibly sturdy, to the extent that even a full-force strike from a Spirit Sea Realm powerhouse might not shatter it, one could imagine its formidable nature.
Of course, not every powerful individual of the Heavenly Mansion was qualified to live here.
Only the most outstanding talents were allowed to reside within the Heavenly Mansion.
And Lin Yi was indeed the most exceptional among them.
Lin Yi was ranked sixth in the Lin Family, which also afforded him the privilege to reside within the Heavenly Mansion.
However, his cultivation was not very high, only at the Third Layer of the Meridian Condensation Realm.
Moreover, Lin Yi had only broken through to the Meridian Condensation Realm three months ago, so his strength was noticeably weaker than the average martial artist at the Firstfold of the Meridian Condensation Realm.
His physique was also very special, he possessed a Heavenly Constitution!
Inside the Heavenly Mansion, Lin Yi’s cultivation speed was several times faster than others.
The rate at which his cultivation improved was also dozens of times quicker than others’.
But all of this came crashing down in front of Lin Xuan.
Lin Xuan could beat a martial artist at the Third Layer of the Meridian Condensation Realm with a single punch.
Presently, he had also broken through to the Ninth Level of the Spirit Sea Realm, his strength considerably enhanced, his combat power also increased by who knows how many times.
Therefore, his attack power and defensive power were far greater than when he first entered the sacred Martial Arts grounds.
All of this, was thanks to that mysterious benefactor.
"Lin Xuan, you devil, I will not let you off even as a ghost..."
Lin Yi roared incessantly, his face completely twisted, ferocious beyond measure.
"Heh, how naive you are."
"You beast, if you kill me, you won’t live either!"
"I can ensure it with self-destruction, once I self-destruct, you’ll surely die!"
"If you don’t believe me, just try it, after all, you can’t escape."
Lin Yi’s eyes were filled with madness.
"Oh? Is that so?" Lin Xuan said indifferently, "Do you think you have the opportunity?"
Then, Lin Xuan slapped him straight across the face.
"Smack!"
Lin Yi fell directly to the ground.
"Let me ask you again, that mysterious person you spoke of, what’s their background?" Lin Xuan looked down at Lin Yi and asked coldly.
"I don’t know..."
"Don’t know?" Lin Xuan shook his head.
"Lin Yi, don’t force me to kill you!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s expression suddenly changed.
"I... I really don’t know, please, please don’t kill me." Lin Yi trembled, with a hint of pleading in his voice.
"I might not kill you, but first, I want to see your sincerity!" Lin Xuan said with a cold laugh.
"You, how do you want me to show my sincerity?" Lin Yi asked.
"Here, take what you need, and then leave!" Lin Xuan waved his hand and a Space Ring appeared in his palm.
"What? You’re letting me leave? Why should I leave, don’t go too far!"
Lin Yi was momentarily stunned upon hearing Lin Xuan’s words.
"Heh, if you don’t leave, do you plan to stay here instead?"
Lin Xuan said mockingly.

chapters.title: Chapter 888 - 908: Not Something He Can Contend With
chapters.content:
Chapter 888: Chapter 908: Not Something He Can Contend With
Lin Yi’s strength was at the very bottom of the Lin Family; he had no status at all. Therefore, he wasn’t afraid to torture Lin Yi however he pleased.
Upon hearing these words, Lin Yi immediately fell silent.
Indeed, he had nowhere to escape to, nor any other choice. After all, Lin Xuan was a superpower in the Spirit Sea Realm, completely beyond his ability to contend with.
Although Lin Yi wished for nothing more than for Lin Xuan to drop dead immediately, he absolutely did not dare to defy Lin Xuan’s words.
"Lin Yi, I do not like to drag things out, and thus, I don’t have the time to play these games with you."
"My patience is limited!"
"I hope that I will still see you after tomorrow."
"If you can’t do it, then just go and die."
Having said that, Lin Xuan’s figure flickered, vanishing on the spot instantaneously.
"Damn you, you..."
Seeing this, Lin Yi was startled, but his face revealed a look of resoluteness, and following a flash, he also disappeared within the Tian character residence.
...
When Lin Xuan’s figure re-emerged, he had already arrived in a secluded secret chamber.
At this moment, two people were already standing inside this chamber.
One of them was a man, Lin Yi, and the other was a woman dressed in a red gown who looked enchanting.
"Lin Yi, what is the meaning of this?"
Lin Xuan looked at Lin Yi, furrowed his brows, and asked, "How did you end up in this state?"
"I..."
Lin Yi clenched his teeth and told Lin Xuan about the scene that had unfolded in the Martial Arts sacred land.
When Lin Xuan heard Lin Yi’s narration, he too became silent.
He realized that he had indeed underestimated the extent of Lin Yi’s viciousness.
He was not as simple as he seemed on the surface.
This guy had actually hatched such a vile scheme to use others to deal with him.
Thinking about it, the words he had said earlier were probably just bluffs after all.
"Hmph, you really think I wouldn’t dare kill you?"
Lin Xuan said coldly.
"You..."
Upon hearing these words, Lin Yi was terrified, and his eyes started moving frantically, seemingly searching for some way out.
"Don’t waste your efforts. In the Martial Arts sacred land, if I want you dead, then you can only die. There is no second way out!"
Lin Xuan’s tone was icy, filled with a thick murderous intent.
Hearing this, Lin Yi closed his eyes in despair.
"Lin Yi, I advise you to confess honestly. Otherwise, I won’t hesitate to crush your bones and scatter your ashes!"
Lin Xuan said coldly, his voice laden with endless chill.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s body suddenly shook, and then he opened his eyes, his gaze shimmering with intense resentment to the extreme.
"Lin Xuan, I, Lin Yi, swear that one day, I will make you pay the price you deserve!"
Lin Yi roared inwardly.
"Heh, well, I shall wait and see."
Lin Xuan responded dismissively.
He was not afraid because he had a supremely strong backing!
"By the way, Lin Yi, have you seen this person?" Lin Xuan took out a portrait and handed it to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s pupils shrank slightly upon seeing the person in the portrait, his eyes full of incredulity.
His heart seemed to skip a beat.
"You know him too?" asked Lin Xuan.
"I do, he is the ancestor of our Lin Family!" Lin Yi took a deep breath and difficultly said, "Moreover, he has reached the peak of the Spirit Sea Realm!"
"Spirit Sea Realm peak!"
Upon hearing these four words, Lin Xuan couldn’t help but inhale sharply.
"Is what you said true? Is this person really an ancient ancestor of the Lin Family?"
"Mhm!" Lin Yi nodded.
"Oh my god, to think that he is a peak Spirit Sea Realm super existence!"
"It seems I must leave as soon as possible!"
Lin Xuan thought to himself and quickly changed the subject, "Lin Yi, you possess excellent talent, so I’ve decided to accept you as my disciple and pass on my cultivation method to you. I hope you will work hard and not disappoint me."
Lin Yi’s aptitude was something he had seen for himself; it was definitely incomparable to that of ordinary people.
Thus, he decided to take Lin Yi under his wing and help him improve his strength.
"Thank you, Master!"
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s expression changed slightly, and he immediately knelt down to kowtow, saying, "Disciple will follow Master’s command!"
Afterward, Lin Yi looked at Lin Xuan and asked, "Master, where is your cave dwelling located?"
"Within this mountain range, there is a place called Lingyin Mountain, where I have been in secluded cultivation," Lin Xuan pointed to a majestic and towering mountain range in front of them and said.
"Then I will come to pay my respects tomorrow."
"Mhm, remember, my requirements are not high. Just help me complete one mission, and I promise to raise your talent to the Spirit Sea Realm," Lin Xuan stated indifferently: "If you can’t do it, then you can go ahead and die."
"Master, please rest assured, your disciple will certainly fulfill the mission!" Lin Yi said resolutely.
"Good, I look forward to your good news."
Lin Xuan said indifferently and then his figure turned into a stream of light, instantly bursting out of the secret chamber.
...
The first thing Lin Yi did upon returning to the Lin Family residence was to go into seclusion.
Lin Xuan did not stop him.
After all, the current Lin Yi had no ability to resist him.
With his cultivation sealed, Lin Yi could not escape his control.
There was no worry for Lin Xuan; within Lingyin Mountain, what kind of waves could Lin Yi possibly stir up?
"I wonder if that Lin Yi has noticed me yet?"
Lin Xuan thought to himself.
"Regardless, I’ll first take a look at Lingyin Mountain."
With this thought, Lin Xuan’s figure vanished from within the Lin Family residence.
Lingyin Mountain was actually a vast canyon where spiritual beasts and ferocious beasts were extremely rare, and even Great Emperor Level existences were scarce.
In the center of the canyon, there was a platform where a colossal stele stood. On the stele, three big characters were carved: Lingyin Hall.
Around Lingyin Hall were scattered many formations rich in spiritual energy, one layer after another, like a labyrinth, catching one off guard.
Lingyin Hall was a forbidden area of Lingyin City.
Only those with cultivation like Lin Xuan’s could enter it.
Lin Xuan ascended the stone steps of Lingyin Hall and stepped into its boundary, immediately feeling as if he had entered a wondrous world.
He even suspected that these steps were formed by a formation.
But after a closer inspection, he found that the steps were made of special jade stone.
This made Lin Xuan more certain that there was something strange about Lingyin Hall.
However, having entered, there was no reason for Lin Xuan to retreat and he went straight inside.
In a short while, Lin Xuan came to a stone house.
The house was protected by many formations.
Lin Xuan pushed the door with his hand, but found that there was no one inside the stone house.
Lin Xuan furrowed his brows.
"Could it be that the person isn’t in this stone house?"
Lin Xuan thought to himself.
He checked the stone house again carefully, but found no clues.
Just as Lin Xuan was about to give up, suddenly, a powerful fluctuation emanated from the depths of the stone house.
