Feeling this fluctuation, Lin Xuan’s heart lifted, and he hurriedly rushed over, eager to see who exactly it was.

chapters.title: Chapter 889 - 909: A Future Without Limits
chapters.content:
Chapter 889: Chapter 909: A Future Without Limits
"Shua!"
The next moment, Lin Xuan’s figure appeared inside a room.
Before him, a young man in white was sitting cross-legged.
The youth appeared to be around fifteen or sixteen years of age, with long hair draped over his shoulders, and a handsome face, eyes tightly closed.
This young man was none other than Lin Yi!
Lin Yi’s aura was also very weak, obviously, his injuries had not yet recovered, or else he would not have been knocked unconscious by Lin Xuan with a slap.
However, Lin Yi’s cultivation had already reached the peak of the Ninefold Spirit Sea Realm, just one step away from the Mahayana Realm!
This was enough to shock anyone.
"Congratulations, Master, and joy to you for acquiring a genius disciple whose prospects are boundless!"
The figure of Lang slowly drifted out, saying respectfully.
"Hmph, just a piece of trash."
Lin Xuan let out a cold laugh, his eyes filled with mockery.
Trash, these two words, were not unfamiliar to Lin Xuan.
He had never been short of such people around him.
"Master, you mustn’t underestimate Lin Yi; this Lin Yi is extraordinary, a peerless prodigy!"
Lang quickly explained.
"Oh? Is that so?" A gleam flashed in Lin Xuan’s eyes.
"Mm!"
Lang nodded.
Lin Yi could be called a genius of the Lin Family; from a young age, he was sent into secret realms for training and had made a breakthrough to the peak of the Spirit Sea Realm in recent years, even comprehending Intermediate Grade Heavenly martial arts!
In Lin Xuan’s eyes, this Lin Yi was a monstrous talent, certainly not inferior to the likes of Lin Ao!
"If he is a genius, then let him become my servant."
Lin Xuan said indifferently, his voice carrying a hint of icy murderous intent.
His servants only could be commanded by him, and no one else.
"Master, Lin Yi is not only a genius, but he is also a master swordsman, with his swordsmanship reaching a level of sheer art. If you can have Lin Yi pledge loyalty to you, your future accomplishments in the way of the sword will definitely not be lesser than his grandfather’s."
Lang hurriedly spoke.
"Oh? Really?"
A cold curve appeared on Lin Xuan’s lips.
"Then, let me fulfill him!"
"Lang, wake him up."
"Yes, Master!"
"Xiu!"
Lang nodded, his figure instantly flying toward Lin Yi.
The next second, Lang turned into a red light, heading straight for Lin Yi.
The red light flickered and instantly enveloped Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s body shook violently, as if he had fallen into a deep sleep.
Before long, he awoke.
The moment he opened his eyes, he saw a familiar face and was startled.
"You, you..."
"Don’t be afraid; you have already submitted to me," Lin Xuan said coldly.
"Who are you!? Why should I trust you!?" Lin Yi asked guardedly, his eyes full of vigilance.
"I am your new master."
Lin Xuan said indifferently.
"New master? Who are you! Why should I believe you!" Lin Yi demanded.
"Because I hold a Soul Contract."
"What, a Soul Contract?"
Upon hearing this phrase, Lin Yi’s facial expression suddenly changed.
A Soul Contract was not just a simple oath.
Within Lingyin Hall, each disciple would sign a Soul Contract, and once a Soul Contract was signed, they would be forever loyal to Lin Xuan.
Because the conditions for signing a Soul Contract were very harsh.
First of all, the disciple must have at least Low Grade Heavenly-level strength to be qualified to enter into a Soul Contract.
Secondly, their bloodline must be of High Grade.
Of course, most crucially, he would need to possess a combat power that transcends his peers of equal level!
These two criteria are not easily met.
And this man in front of me actually has such strength?
How is this possible?
"Hehe, I know you can’t believe it, but what I say is true."
Lin Xuan said with a faint smile.
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly as he seemed to ponder.
"So, have you made up your mind?" Lin Xuan continued.
"Fine, I am willing to become your servant, but you must let me see my grandfather first."
Lin Yi said through gritted teeth, having decided to submit to Lin Xuan’s side for the time being—at least before his own strength had improved, Lin Xuan was his strongest support.
Lin Xuan did not reject the request upon hearing this.
Afterward, Lin Yi led Lin Xuan, heading outside.
Their destination was the room where Lin Ao was.
The moment Lin Xuan and Lin Yi stepped out of the hall, a middle-aged man clad in a black robe charged towards them rapidly.
"Lin Yi, where is my grandson, the one you were supposed to bring to me?"
The man in black roared in anger.
"Lin Ao is already dead," Lin Yi stated indifferently.
"What!? Dead!?"
The man in black, upon hearing these words, was momentarily stunned.
"Damn it!"
"My grandson, how could he possibly be dead!"
The man in black burst into a furious roar, unleashing an overwhelming aura that surged from within him.
He was a formidable powerhouse of the Fourth Rank in the Heavenly Monarch Realm, one level higher than Lin Yi.
Nevertheless, even so, he still could not do anything to Lin Xuan.
"Lin Yi, you’d better give me a reasonable explanation!" the man in black demanded sternly.
"Hehe, Lin Ao was at the Third Rank of the Heavenly Monarch Realm, and I am but at the Second Rank of the Spirit Sea Realm, and indeed, he is dead," Lin Yi said calmly.
Hearing this, the man in black was taken aback.
"You’re spouting nonsense. Your strength is clearly stronger than Lin Ao’s, how could you have lost to him!" the man in black shouted angrily.
"Don’t believe it?"
"Then fine, let’s have a spar," Lin Xuan said lightly.
"Hmph, then let me see, just how strong you really are!"
The man in black huffed coldly, swinging his arm and launching a fierce punch.
Lin Xuan chuckled coldly, also swinging his right hand, and threw a punch at the incoming attack.
"Bang!"
The two fists collided, emitting a piercing noise, and soon a layer of golden light appeared on both of their fists, exuding waves of terrifying pressure.
"This..."
The man in black’s pupils sharply contracted, his eyes filled with disbelief.
His strength, although nowhere near that of Lin Ao’s, was not weak, yet this young man before him was even more terrifying in strength!
Exactly what kind of freak was this young man?
Where did he come from!?
The man in black was immensely shocked, feeling that this young man in front of him was far more than just a simple Second Rank of the Spirit Sea Realm.
"Again!"
Excitement also shone in Lin Yi’s eyes.
He had not expected his luck to be so poor; just after obtaining a treasure, he encountered such a powerful master, practically a heaven-sent match.
"Alright!"
Hearing this, the man in black took a deep breath, then his figure flickered as he charged towards Lin Xuan.
"Hmph, a mere Firstfold of the Heavenly Monarch Realm dares to clash with me head-on!"
War intent filled Lin Yi’s eyes, his palms igniting with a furious burning of golden-yellow flames, sweeping toward the man in black.
"Golden Flame Slash!"
With his furious shout, a massive golden flame spear shot forth, carrying an endless heatwave.
"Bang, bang, bang!"
The two fists collided once more.
Instantly, an earth-shaking explosion resounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 890 - 910 Severely Injured
chapters.content:
Chapter 890: Chapter 910 Severely Injured
The air around also boiled up.
"Ah!"
Screams echoed around as Lin Yi was sent flying directly.
"Thump!"
Lin Yi fell to the ground, spitting out blood, severely injured.
Lin Xuan stood still, his face calm without any ripples, as if it was all to be expected.
"Alright, now, can you submit to me?"
Lin Xuan said lightly.
"Fine, I am willing to become your servant!"
Lin Yi struggled to get up, then kneeled on the ground.
This scene made everyone’s eyes widen.
A Martial Artist of the Heavenly King Realm and Sixth Rank becoming a servant to a cultivator of the Spirit Sea Realm and Seventh Rank, this was simply absurd.
However, this was the path Lin Yi had chosen for himself, no one could change it, given Lin Yi’s current dangerous state.
If Lin Yi did not submit, soon, he would suffer from Lin Xuan’s pursuit and ultimately death.
Moreover, Lin Yi’s fate was still in Lin Xuan’s hands.
Lin Ao had already died, and Lin Yi was undoubtedly doomed.
Thus, he had no choice but to obediently listen to Lin Xuan.
"Alright, now, I will send you back."
Lin Xuan said indifferently.
Hearing this, Lin Yi quickly nodded in agreement, and then followed Lin Xuan, leaving the mansion.
"Are you really Second Rank of the Heavenly Monarch Realm?"
Lin Yi looked at Lin Xuan’s figure and couldn’t help but ask.
"Yes."
"How strong are you really?" Lin Yi asked again.
"I am now Ninth Rank of the Heavenly King Realm!" Lin Xuan said lightly.
"What!? You are Ninth Rank of the Heavenly King Realm!?"
Lin Yi heard this, his pupils contracted.
"How is that possible? A Ninth Rank of the Heavenly Monarch Realm, able to defeat a master of the Heavenly King Realm and Sixth Rank?"
"Moreover, your realm is only Fifth Rank of the Heavenly Monarch Realm!? What is your actual strength!?"
"You aren’t deceiving me, are you?"
"I have no reason to deceive you." Lin Xuan said lightly: "You can go back now."
"I’m going back... "
"You’re not staying at the Lin Residence?" Lin Yi asked surprisingly.
"No need," Lin Xuan shook his head, dispassionately said.
"Alright, since you want to leave, then go, we can’t force you." Lin Yi sighed.
"Uh-huh."
Then, Lin Xuan turned around and left.
Lin Yi stood in place, watching Lin Xuan’s departing figure, a tear appeared in his eyes.
Lin Xuan was his benefactor, he naturally didn’t want anything to happen to Lin Xuan.
But, with his insufficient strength, what could he do?
Lin Yi sighed, turned around preparing to return to the residence.
However, just as he turned around, planning to return to the family, he suddenly stopped.
Because he suddenly noticed that a few figures had silently, infiltrated the Lin Family’s backyard.
Lin Yi’s face turned cold, his body instantly shot up, sweeping towards the backyard.
"Who’s there?"
Lin Yi was incredibly fast, reaching the backyard in a blink of an eye, he grabbed a young man who was covering his face.
"Boy, let me go, I’m telling you, offending our young master will not end well for you!"
"You dare to grab me, our young master will absolutely not spare you!"
"Hmph, I don’t care what kind of young master he is!" Lin Yi snorted coldly, then squeezed his right hand forcefully, instantly crushing the neck of the masked young man.
One move, fatal!
After doing this, Lin Yi finally released his hand.
Lin Yi looked at the corpse in his hand, his gaze icy cold.
"How dare they bully my friend, they’re really tired of living!"
He coldly surveyed his surroundings.
Soon, his gaze fell upon a fake mountain not far away.
"Come out!"
As soon as Lin Yi called out, a muffled groan came from atop the fake mountain, followed by several beautiful young women in red dresses jumping down and landing in front of Lin Yi.
"Greetings to the young master!"
"Hello, young master!"
These beautiful young women respectfully saluted, their voices sweet, giving a feeling of floating in ecstasy upon hearing them.
"How long have you been following me?" Lin Yi scanned them and asked.
"Repaying the young master, we have been following you for a full half year," the girl in the red dress replied.
"Half a year?" Lin Yi frowned slightly.
He remembered that initially, in the Beast Demon Valley, these girls seemed to have arrived when he entered the valley, and at that time, Lin Ao did not have so many people with him.
Thus, these girls must have tracked him from outside the Beast Demon Valley.
"What are you all doing here?" Lin Yi asked.
"Young master, we are here to discuss some matters with you," the girl in the red dress said.
"Oh, what matters?"
"Young master, we want you to help us deal with a person named Lin Xuan; his strength is too terrifying, and none of us are his match," the girl in the red dress hesitated for a moment and then said through gritted teeth.
"He’s that strong?" Lin Yi asked.
"His realm should have reached the Seventh Rank of Heavenly Emperor realm," the girl in the red dress replied.
"What about Lin Ao? What’s Lin Ao’s capability?" Lin Yi asked with a frown.
He knew Lin Ao was at the Sixth Rank of Heavenly King Realm, but he was not clear about the specifics.
"Lin Ao was at the Third Rank cultivation of Heavenly King Realm," the red-dressed girl said.
Hearing this, a flash of anger crossed Lin Yi’s eyes, then he asked, "How did he die?"
The girl in the red dress hesitated, but still revealed that Lin Ao died by Lin Xuan’s hand.
"So, since he wanted to kill you all, you should have killed him in return."
Upon hearing this, a deep fear emerged in the eyes of the red-dressed girl as she whispered, "Young master, Lin Ao’s strength far surpasses ours; we are simply not his match."
"Then what are you doing here now?" Lin Yi asked with a frown.
"Young master, Lin Xuan had saved us in the Beast Demon Valley, and he has shown kindness to us, which is why we came to seek you, young master," the red-dressed girl explained.
Lin Yi felt a surge of intense anger—he couldn’t believe these girls were so narrow-minded as to repay kindness with hatred!
"I understand, I will take action now; you all go back, don’t let others find out!" Lin Yi said coldly.
"Young master, you can’t take action!"
The red-dressed girl hastily shouted.
"Why? Why can’t I take action?" Lin Yi sneered.
"Young master, this person cannot be killed!"
"Why?"
"Because he is... is... the future heir of the Lin Family!"
"The Lin Family’s heir? Haha, that’s quite the joke," Lin Yi sneered.
"It’s true, Lin Xuan, he is the heir of the Lin Family," the red-dressed girl explained.
Lin Yi’s expression remained calm, disdainfully saying, "I say he’s useless, then he’s useless, don’t believe me, go check it out yourself."
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, the red-dressed girl was left speechless.
She knew Lin Yi wasn’t lying, but she couldn’t believe that Lin Xuan really was the future heir of the Lin Family.
"Lin Yi, I advise you not to mess around, otherwise, my father will never let you go!" Lin Yi’s sister Lin Xuan’er warned.
"Lin Xuan’er? Haha, Lin Xuan killed your father and mother in the Beast Demon Valley, don’t you hate him? Don’t you want revenge? Don’t you want to avenge your mother, your father?" Lin Yi said sarcastically.

chapters.title: Chapter 891 - 911 Cannot Stand Idly By
chapters.content:
Chapter 891: Chapter 911 Cannot Stand Idly By
"I...," Lin Xuan’er opened her mouth, only to find herself at a loss for words.
"Hmph! If you truly seek revenge, then come find me."
A hint of a cold smile appeared in Lin Yi’s eyes.
Lin Xuan’er’s parents had been murdered; naturally, she couldn’t just stand by idly. She must avenge her parents’ deaths!
Lin Xuan!
I will surely kill you!!
A fierce killing intent flickered in Lin Xuan’er’s eyes.
"By the way, I forgot to tell you, I have now reached the cultivation of the Eightfold Heaven of the Holy Emperor Realm."
"What?!"
"How is that possible!"
The girl in the red dress widened her eyes upon hearing this.
Although she had suspected that this Lin Xuan was unusually strong, she had never imagined that Lin Yi had actually reached the Eightfold Heaven of the Holy Emperor Realm.
"Let’s head back," Lin Xuan’er said, turning around and leaving the place.
Her steps were a bit frantic, seemingly surprised that Lin Yi had reached the Eightfold Heaven of the Holy Emperor Realm.
"Young Master, should we tell the lord about this?" a girl in a red dress asked hesitantly.
"No need, Lin Ao is already dead, after all."
"But... What if the lord finds out? I’m afraid he might blame us..."
"Hehe, what can he do about it if he blames us?" Lin Yi said with a light chuckle.
...
Lin Yi left the courtyard.
He did not immediately seek revenge against Lin Xuan but returned to his room instead.
He meditated, regulated his breathing, and consolidated his cultivation. A month later, he left his room once again and headed towards the Lin Family.
On the way, Lin Yi encountered many disciples of the Lin Family.
The disciples of the Lin Family were all immersed in rigorous cultivation, with only some of the older disciples occasionally venturing out for real-world experience.
When Lin Yi arrived at the Lin Family’s main hall, there was already a crowd gathered inside.
"Brother Lin Yi has arrived."
"Brother, you’re finally back!"
Upon seeing Lin Yi, the disciples of the Lin Family all hurriedly greeted him with a bow, their faces filled with excitement.
Lin Yi smiled and nodded, his gaze falling on the youngest disciples.
These people were all orphans taken in by Lin Yi, and during their time cultivating in the Ancient Tomb, they were also cared for by Lin Yi.
Because of their bloodline bonds, Lin Yi treated them even better than other disciples of the Lin Family, sometimes even imparting some of the cultivation techniques and martial arts to them.
Seeing everyone, Lin Yi was filled with many emotions.
He had never anticipated that one day he would become the Young Master of the Ancient Tomb.
"Brother Lin Yi, this is your second visit to our Lin Family."
"Brother Lin Yi, we would also like to learn a few moves from you."
A slight look of embarrassment appeared on Lin Yi’s face.
Ever since his entry into the Ancient Tomb, he had never actually sparred with these disciples from the Lin Family, which was no wonder they were so excited.
"Fellow brothers and sisters, my current cultivation is only at the Fivefold Heaven of the Holy Emperor Realm."
"Therefore, my current combat power is only that of the Fourfold Heaven, so I hope you won’t hesitate to give me advice, lest you lose to a noob like me."
Lin Yi said with a laugh.
"A noob? Haha, you Lin Yi are the top existence among the younger generation in Northern River City, and you dare to call yourself a noob?!"
"Haha, Brother Lin Yi, stop being so humble, you must be joking with us, right?"
"Indeed!"
The Lin Family disciples were all laughing heartily; it was clear that they did not believe for a second that Lin Yi was merely a novice.
"Alright, stop making fun of me." Having said that, Lin Yi then turned towards a young girl in green and asked, "By the way, Lin Xuan’er, where is Lin Xuan now?"
"Reporting to Young Master, Lin Xuan has gone to the Ancient Tomb and, it is said, he has obtained the inheritance. He is now the most dazzling new star in the valley!"
"What?" Hearing this, Lin Yi’s eyes turned suddenly frosty.
"He actually got the inheritance?!"
A serious look appeared on Lin Yi’s face.
The Ancient Tomb was full of dangers, and even he would not dare to step into it lightly.
Yet Lin Xuan had managed to acquire the inheritance in such a place, his strength must have skyrocketed, which was absolutely not good news for Lin Yi!
"Young Master, what do you plan to do now?"
Lin Xuan’er spoke up.
"Of course, take revenge on him!" Lin Yi said in a deep voice, his words thick with a strong intent to kill.
"But Young Master, your current Cultivation is too weak, I’m afraid you’re no match for Lin Xuan."
"I know, but I absolutely cannot let Lin Xuan live!" Lin Yi uttered through clenched teeth, "Lin Xuan must die!"
Seeing this, Lin Xuan’er had nothing more to say and could only sigh.
Lin Yi’s gaze swept across the surrounding Lin Family disciples and demanded, "Who among you knows of Lin Xuan’s whereabouts?!"
The crowd looked at each other, each shaking their heads in turn.
Lin Yi’s eyes narrowed, a chilling killing intent surging in the depths of his eyes: "Since no one knows, then I’ll go kill Lin Xuan now!"
With his words falling, Lin Yi transformed into a cloud of black mist, swiftly heading towards the outside of the Lin Family’s great hall.
"Young Master, be careful!" Lin Xuan’er shouted anxiously, wanting to follow but powerless to do so.
"Xuan’er, there’s no need to worry, Lin Xuan will not be able to escape."
"Hmph, I’m actually quite looking forward to seeing what kind of expression Lin Yi will have if he comes off worse in Lin Xuan’s hands."
"I think that scene would certainly be very exciting."
The people discussed among themselves.
Hearing what everyone said, Lin Xuan’er was momentarily stunned, then her cheeks flushed with anger.
She did not expect these people to be so bold as to compare Lin Yi with Lin Xuan, how outrageous!
...
Lin Xuan had returned home, and just as he stepped into his room, he was blocked at the entrance.
Startled, Lin Xuan looked up and saw Lin Haoyu, his brow furrowed.
"Lin Haoyu, what are you doing?"
Lin Haoyu stared at Lin Xuan coldly and snapped, "Lin Xuan, you’re really quite arrogant! To think you’ve taken away the inheritance of the Ancient Tomb!"
As soon as Lin Haoyu spoke, Lin Xuan’er immediately echoed, "Yeah! You’ve gone too far, that’s an inheritance that belongs to our Lin Family! How could you receive it?!"
Fury filled Lin Xuan’er’s eyes as she glared at Lin Xuan, her gaze brimming with murderous intent.
She was the woman Lin Yi cherished most and also his confidante, but now Lin Xuan had actually snatched away the inheritance from the Ancient Tomb, an act she found utterly intolerable!
"So you’re Lin Haoyu!"
Hearing Lin Xuan’er’s words, Lin Xuan couldn’t help but laugh: "Xuan’er, I advise you not to get involved in the enmity between me and Lin Yi, or else you’ll be in trouble!"
Saying so, Lin Xuan was about to close his room door.
But just then, Lin Xuan’er suddenly reached out, stopping Lin Xuan’s door and said, "Are you trying to shirk your responsibility?!"
Hearing this, Lin Xuan disdainfully curled his lip: "Your Lin Family only knows how to bully others with your power, acting as if you’re the lord of heaven."
Lin Xuan’s attitude completely infuriated Lin Xuan’er, who coldly snorted, "Lin Xuan, I advise you to be wise and leave behind the goods; then you may leave."
Lin Yi, upon hearing this, looked at Lin Xuan’er: "Xuan’er, you..."
Before he could finish his words, Lin Xuan’er directly waved her hand to interrupt him.
"Brother Lin Yi, don’t worry, he won’t be able to escape!" Lin Xuan’er said.
"Alright!"
Lin Yi nodded and then turned to look at Lin Xuan with cold eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 892 - 912 A Field of Golden Flames
chapters.content:
Chapter 892: Chapter 912 A Field of Golden Flames
In his eyes, a cold glint flickered, just like two sharp blades, giving Lin Xuan the sense that his neck was about to be severed.
Lin Yi was truly filled with the intent to kill.
"How about it, Lin Xuan? We of the Lin Family are not so easily bullied." Lin Xuan’er watched Lin Xuan with a cold gaze, "Aren’t you going to get lost from the Lin Family?"
"Xuan’er, after all, he is your brother. How can you speak to him in such a tone?" Lin Yi frowned and said.
Upon hearing this, Lin Xuan’er’s pretty face instantly soured.
"Brother Lin Yi, what do you mean by that? Am I not even qualified to scold someone?" Lin Xuan’er’s voice betrayed a sense of grievance.
"Xuan’er, step outside for now," Lin Yi said to Lin Xuan’er in a soft voice.
Hearing this, Lin Xuan’er bit her lower lip, then turned and left the room.
"Lin Xuan, do you hate me that much? Hate that I gave the inheritance from the Fiendish Demon Valley to Lin Xuan?" Lin Yi stared at Lin Xuan and spoke with a grave tone.
"Lin Yi, my affairs have nothing to do with you!"
Lin Xuan scoffed coldly.
Hearing this, the killing intent in Lin Yi’s eyes grew more intense: "Lin Xuan, are you really intending to oppose me?"
"I have always wanted to stand against you!" Lin Xuan said without hesitation.
"Then don’t blame me for not being polite to you!" Lin Yi sneered, "Lin Xuan, today, I will make you understand one thing, the inheritance from the Fiendish Demon Valley is not for you to covet!"
As Lin Yi’s voice fell, he took a step and his figure instantly transformed into a sheet of golden flames, lunging towards Lin Xuan.
Lin Yi was a Fire Attribute Spiritual Body, whereas Lin Xuan was a Water Attribute Spiritual Body, making their levels of cultivation fundamentally incomparable.
Seeing Lin Yi attacking, Lin Xuan couldn’t help but sneer: "Lin Yi, is that all you’re capable of?"
Lin Yi’s cultivation was merely at the Seventh Layer of the Nascent Soul Realm, but he was extremely sly and cunning, willing to use secret techniques during battle to temporarily boost his own strength.
Thus, his power had now reached the Eighth Layer of the Nascent Soul Realm!
Seeing Lin Yi coming at him, Lin Xuan also refused to show weakness.
He no longer concealed his power, and the five Flood Dragon veins within his body roared into life, with dragon roars resounding and dragon aura swirling around.
Dragon Might spread throughout the entire room.
Witnessing this scene, Lin Xuan provocatively said to Lin Yi: "Come on then, keep using your secret techniques if you dare!"
Hearing these words, indignation, mixed with a hint of rage, surfaced in Lin Xuan’s heart.
"Lin Xuan, I don’t believe that you, a mere martial artist at the Third Layer of the Foundation Establishment Stage, can contend against a powerful expert of the Eighth Layer of the Nascent Soul Realm!" Lin Yi’s eyes suddenly shot forth a sharp gleam.
Right after, his figure lunged at Lin Xuan once again.
Behind him, a fiery phoenix screeched forth, carrying with it an intense heat.
Seeing this, Lin Xuan’s eyebrows raised slightly, but no fear was present in his expression.
The next moment, he fiercely launched a punch!
BOOM!!!
A deafening explosion echoed, and a wild surge of air swept through, instantly reducing the door to ashes.
Subsequently, the two figures crossed paths once again.
This time, Lin Xuan did not use the Sword Soul Technique, but rather the strength of his Physical Body.
Lin Xuan’s physical strength was immensely powerful. Although he had only condensed three Flood Dragon veins not long ago, his strength now was not inferior to an average cultivator at the Ninefold Level of the Nascent Soul Realm.
Lin Yi’s strength was also above average.
But the difference in their strengths was quite significant.
BANG BANG BANG!!!
A series of intense collision sounds continuously echoed; their figures darted swiftly, their silhouettes blurred to the point of becoming indistinguishable.
"Lin Xuan, today, I must make you pay the price!"
Lin Yi’s body traced numerous afterimages in the air, each one emanating scorching flames.
His fists swung densely, like a torrential downpour, tightly packed and carrying scorching heat.
BANG!
After another exchange, Lin Xuan’s foot fiercely kicked into Lin Yi’s chest, sending Lin Yi flying backward.
"Puh-cht!"
As soon as Lin Yi steadied himself, he spewed out a stream of blood.
Lin Yi, looking at Lin Xuan, had a face full of ferocity.
"Lin Xuan, I will make your life worse than death!"
Hatred filled Lin Yi’s voice.
Lin Xuan snorted coldly, "Lin Yi, is this the extent of your strength? Then, today, let me show you my full power!"
"What?!"
Lin Yi’s eyes went round with shock when he heard this.
"How dare you underestimate me?!" Lin Yi shouted angrily.
"Lin Yi, I’ve told you long ago that the gap between us is too wide. Now, do you finally understand?"
"Today, I will send you on your way, to join your father in Hell!" Lin Xuan roared.
"Arrogant!"
Hearing Lin Xuan’s words, Lin Yi felt like his lungs were about to explode with rage.
His eyes seethed with crazed killing intent, and he articulated each word, "Lin Xuan, I will let you taste the flavor of falling!"
"Falling? Hahaha! I, Lin Xuan, have never feared the word ’fall.’ Today, I’ll let you understand who is the one to truly fall!"
"Die for me!" Lin Yi shouted, and suddenly, a red sphere of light appeared on his body.
Under his control, the red sphere quickly grew larger until it eventually transformed into a massive cauldron.
That colossal cauldron was covered with mysterious and unpredictable runes, each containing terrifying power.
These runes were the magic artifact employed by Lin Yi!
"Lin Xuan, let me show you how formidable I, Lin Yi, am!"
As he spoke, he suddenly pressed his finger on the red cauldron.
Buzz, buzz, buzz...
The next moment, the cauldron erupted with a brilliant red light, and under its radiance, the whole world seemed to be enveloped in red, creating an eerie atmosphere.
Lin Yi laughed loudly at Lin Xuan, "Lin Xuan, my magic artifact is now activated, you have no way out, die!"
As his voice fell, the red light above the cauldron suddenly exploded.
Instantly, it turned into a terrifying wave that rushed towards Lin Xuan.
Watching the oncoming surge of red light, Lin Xuan’s pupils constricted and he threw out a punch.
A golden draconic claw illusion roared into existence.
Boom, boom, boom...
Lin Xuan’s draconic claw illusion collided with the red light, immediately setting off a series of violent explosions.
Subsequently, Lin Xuan’s figure retreated sharply.
A trickle of fresh blood also escaped from the corner of his mouth.
Indeed, a magic artifact is formidable!
However, he had no intention of admitting defeat easily.
In that moment, around Lin Xuan, numerous golden dragon shadows appeared.
These dragon shadows, massive in size, resembled Flood Dragons, each approximately a hundred meters long, exuding a profound pressure.
This moment, they all spread their dragon wings and surged towards the overwhelming red light.
Boom, boom, boom...
Dragon wings and red light constantly clashed, lifting clouds of dust into the air.
"Lin Xuan, what else can you rely on now?"
"Do you realize how vast the gap between us is?!"
Seeing that Lin Xuan’s dragon shadows managed to block the red light, a smug look appeared on Lin Yi’s face.

chapters.title: Chapter 893 - 913: Magic Artifact
chapters.content:
Chapter 893: Chapter 913: Magic Artifact
"Heh heh, Lin Xuan, I advise you to surrender now, otherwise, this Magic Artifact of mine is not something you can withstand!" Lin Yi sneered repeatedly.
"Lin Yi, it seems you can only bully me with such despicable tricks!" Lin Xuan disdainfully said.
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s eyes rounded in anger, and he shouted furiously, "Lin Xuan, what did you say? Do you think you can beat me with these inferior moves?"
"What a joke. Each of my techniques is ranked among the top five within the Earth Rank Cultivation Techniques, and there’s no way you can withstand them!"
"Die now!"
As Lin Yi’s words finished, a series of red light pillars howled out, sweeping towards Lin Xuan.
Seeing this, Lin Xuan let out a cold shout, and a golden light suddenly surged over his body, turning into a golden long spear.
With the spear thrusting out, piercing the sky, it penetrated all the red light pillars.
The next moment, Lin Xuan suddenly looked up to the sky, a loud roar of a Flood Dragon echoed through the void.
Immediately following, Lin Xuan’s eyes burst forth with dazzling silver light, as bright as the stars.
"Long Teng Ascends to the Skies!"
Lin Xuan suddenly raised the long spear in his hand and slashed it down towards the sky.
Instantly, a gigantic dragon roared out, screaming to the heavens, carrying an earth-shattering aura as it charged towards the myriad of light pillars.
Crack crack crack...
As the giant dragon collided with the red light pillars, a series of fracturing sounds rang out, and the sea of red light pillars disappeared into nothingness.
Seeing his own offensive dissolve like this, Lin Yi was stunned.
How... how is this possible!?
His Soul Power was comparable to that of an Early Stage Yuan Dan Realm Martial Artist.
His attack, which he had executed, was actually unable to break through this youngster’s defense?
What kind of monster is this kid?!
Lin Yi’s face turned ashen, his fists clenched tightly, and veins bulged on his forehead, showing extreme anger.
"Lin Xuan, since you seek death, then I will grant it to you!"
In the next moment, his arms turned into a blood-red color, and a pair of blood-red wings emerged on his back.
"Blood Wings!"
Lin Xuan caught sight of Lin Yi transforming into a set of blood-red wings and was slightly taken aback.
"Boy, today is your day of death!"
A cold murderous intent flickered on Lin Yi’s face, and his arms were shrouded in astonishing blood light.
This scene made Lin Xuan feel a sense of danger rising in his heart.
His feet forcefully stamped on the ground, and his whole body shot out like an arrow leaving the bow, charging towards the Blood Wings.
Lin Xuan’s speed was incredibly fast, crossing thousands of meters in the blink of an eye, arriving right in front of Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s arms shook, and a surging power burst forth.
"Blood Demon Fist!"
Rumble...
With a loud shout from Lin Yi, a wave of bloody fluctuations spread out from his body.
Immediately, blood-red light pillars condensed in mid-air, smashing down towards Lin Xuan like meteors.
Lin Xuan frowned, clenched his fists, and met Lin Yi’s fist light head-on.
Thud...
Their fists collided, emitting a dull sound, and both of them were sent flying backward.
Spurt!
Lin Xuan spat out fresh blood, his complexion turning pale, and his breath grew weak, clearly suffering serious injuries.
Seeing this, Lin Yi burst into laughter, saying, "Lin Xuan, your strength isn’t yet enough to contend with me. Be smart and surrender; perhaps I’ll consider sparing your life. How about it?!"
"Hmph, dream on if you think I’ll surrender without a fight!"
Lin Xuan sneered and charged forward once again.
Seeing that Lin Xuan wouldn’t heed his warning, Lin Yi was thoroughly enraged.
"Lin Xuan, since it’s come to this, then don’t blame me for being rude!"
"Wind Blade Technique!"
As his words fell, Lin Yi’s palm abruptly coalesced into a pitch-black Wind Blade, ruthlessly slashing towards Lin Xuan.
This sword carried his unique ultimate technique.
Although the power of this sword could not compare to those ancient secret manuals, it was more than enough to deal with Lin Xuan.
Facing this fatal strike, Lin Xuan’s eyebrows slightly furrowed, his eyes revealing a grave expression.
Daring not to be careless, Lin Xuan gripped his spear with both hands, thrusting it forward.
"Nine Heavens Silver Dragon Technique, Fourth Form! Dragon Breaks the Universe!"
With Lin Xuan’s words, a massive silver Flood Dragon formed before him, baring its fangs and claws, furiously tearing towards the pitch-black Wind Blade.
Bang bang bang...
A series of ear-piercing collisions echoed over the square.
The silver Flood Dragon, transformed from the giant dragon, and the Wind Blade finally decided the victor.
After a brief stalemate, the silver Flood Dragon was torn apart, dissipating into the void.
And the pitch-black Wind Blade, although dissipated, still had a part that continued to charge toward Lin Xuan.
Witnessing this scene, Lin Xuan’s pupils sharply constricted.
"Damn it, this guy, he still has such a terrifying hidden card up his sleeve!"
At this moment, Lin Xuan’s heart was filled with urgency.
He involuntarily took several steps back.
"Kid, prepare to die!"
However, just as Lin Xuan had just steadied his stance, a sinister and cold sneer came from behind.
Hearing the voice, Lin Xuan turned around to look.
He saw that Lin Yi had already come right in front of him.
His eyes were swirling with ferociousness, his right arm enshrouded in a surging blood light.
"Blood Demon Transformation!"
As Lin Yi’s voice fell, the body beneath the blood-colored robe suddenly became much more solid.
Simultaneously, a blood-colored vortex also formed at his chest, rotating continually, emitting waves of extremely eerie fluctuations.
"Lin Xuan, prepare to die!"
As his voice fell, Lin Yi stomped forcefully on the ground with both legs.
The next instant, a massive blood-colored Wind Blade stabbed viciously towards Lin Xuan’s chest.
"Long Xiang Soars to the Nine Heavens!"
Faced with such an attack, Lin Xuan’s brow also displayed a deep gravity.
Without hesitation, he fiercely stamped the ground with his feet once more.
"Long Xiang Soars to the Nine Heavens!"
Following Lin Xuan’s low roar, a hundred-yard-long dragon also condensed behind him.
"Ao..."
The sound of a dragon’s roar arose as the giant dragon swung its tail, violently whipping out.
Thud.
The Wind Blade that Lin Yi had conjured burst apart under the impact of the giant dragon’s tail.
Lin Yi’s figure staggered back, a trickle of blood spilling from the corner of his mouth.
"Damn it, how can you possess such strength?"
Lin Yi’s face was filled with unwillingness.
Lin Xuan shook his head and said indifferently, "Lin Yi, do not think that just because you have some talent, you can strut around in front of me, being ignorant and foolish.
Over these years, I have been in closed-door cultivation. I’m unaware of all your deeds, which is why I’ve let you run wild until now.
But this time, your arrogance will finally come to an end!"
Finished speaking, Lin Xuan waved his hand.
The very next moment, the air in front of him seemed to ripple like glass, one wave after another, mixed with streaks of flames.
These flames were the Golden Flame True Fire. Under Lin Xuan’s control, they furiously burned, quickly scorching the surrounding space, leaving nothing but the golden blaze.
"Damn it, what do you think you’re doing?!"
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s face changed dramatically, he could not help but exclaim.

chapters.title: Chapter 894 - 914: Completely Ignoring Him
chapters.content:
Chapter 894: Chapter 914: Completely Ignoring Him
Lin Xuan, however, paid him no heed. With a flash, he charged towards Lin Yi, thrusting the Golden Flame Spear in his hand viciously towards Lin Yi’s body.
Lin Yi quickly raised the Wind Thunder Fan to block the assault of the golden flames.
Bang!
Clang!
The Golden Flame Spear and the Wind Thunder Fan clashed fiercely, instantly erupting into a blinding shower of sparks.
The spearhead of the Golden Flame Spear pierced viciously into the Wind Thunder Fan, then continued towards Lin Yi’s chest.
Witnessing this scene, Lin Yi’s pupils shrank instantly.
He wanted to dodge, but found that the tip of the spear contained a powerful devouring force, locking his body firmly in place.
"No!"
Lin Yi let out a wretched scream, his body bursting open instantly.
Drop by drop, his scarlet brain matter splattered everywhere, staining the ground.
Upon seeing this, everyone around widened their eyes in shock.
No one had anticipated that the mighty 8th-ranked powerhouse of the Tianyuan List would fall to Lin Xuan’s spear, without even a chance to flee.
"Dead?!"
Seeing Lin Yi killed, the shock was evident on the faces of the Lin Yi brothers.
At this moment, Lin Xuan also sheathed the Golden Flame Spear and slowly walked down from the arena.
"Senior Brother Lin Xuan is too formidable!"
"He’s truly a hero of our Lin Family; taking on two masters alone and defeating both of them."
"With such strength, even throughout the entire Spiritual Martial Country, he would be considered a top-notch expert. However, this time, Senior Brother Lin Xuan was perhaps a little too arrogant, he shouldn’t have let Lin Yi and his two brothers join forces against him."
After the three Lin Yi brothers were defeated by Lin Xuan, the surrounding spectators erupted into a buzz of discussion, each person stunned.
And the Lin Yi brothers’ faces turned unsightly to the extreme.
All three of them were at the peak of the Tianyuan Realm and were considered elite within the Lin Family.
Yet today, they had fallen at the hands of a junior at the Firstfold of the Pill Condensation Realm.
Moreover, their defeat was so swift and clean that they felt utterly humiliated.
"You three wastes, not only failed to kill Lin Xuan, but were also killed by him in turn! What a disgrace!"
Just as Lin Xuan stepped off the arena, a mocking voice sounded from behind the Lin Yi brothers.
Upon hearing this, the Lin Yi brothers turned their heads to look at the speaker, a man in green clothes.
The man in green had a hooked nose and a cold facial expression, with profound eyes.
He was the master of the three brothers, Lin Tian.
Seeing his three disciples ridiculed, Lin Tian’s face also turned somewhat gloomy, his eyes looking at Lin Xuan were extremely cold.
However, under these circumstances, he could not say much.
After all, if not for Lin Xuan, the Lin Yi brothers would not have lost so miserably.
"Lin Yi, you’ve indeed made a mistake this time. Lin Xuan not only has extraordinary strength, but his methods are also ever-changing!"
The more formidable Lin Xuan’s strength, the more uneasy Lin Tian felt.
"Lin Xuan, you better not push your luck. If you kneel down and admit your mistake now, I might consider sparing your life!"
"Otherwise, you must die today!"
Upon hearing this, the corners of Lin Xuan’s mouth curled up into a mocking smile.
"Oh? Are Senior Brother Lin’s words true? If I kneel down and admit my mistake, you’ll really spare me?"
Hearing these words, Lin Tian’s expression became rigid, but he quickly returned to normal and nodded.
"That’s correct, as long as you kneel and kowtow now, and admit your mistake, I will spare your dog’s life!"
"Heh, and if I don’t kowtow?" Lin Xuan’s mouth curled with a hint of sarcasm.
"You..."
Enraged by these words, Lin Tian exploded with fury.
The others beside him fixed their fierce gazes on Lin Xuan, their eyes filled with killing intent.
"If that’s the case, I’ll start by cutting down your left and right arms!"
Lin Xuan snorted coldly, his figure darting towards Lin Yi.
"Stop!"
As Lin Xuan moved, Lin Tian rushed to intercept, trying to stop Lin Xuan.
But as fast as Lin Tian was, Lin Xuan was faster.
In the blink of an eye, Lin Tian’s chest was pierced by Lin Xuan’s spear.
"Pfft!"
Blood splattered, staining the three comrades of Lin Yi.
"Ha ha, Lin Xuan, Uncle Master Lin Tian is dead, and you still dare to kill him!"
The two people beside Lin Yi immediately shouted in ecstasy.
"No, elder brother, I beg you, don’t kill me, I was wrong, please, spare my life, I don’t want to be a disciple of the Lin Family anymore!"
Lin Yi also knelt to the ground, knocking his head repeatedly while wailing.
He knew that once Lin Tian died, he would certainly be on a path with only death.
Because, after all, they were all trained by Lin Tian.
The death of Lin Tian was an absolutely heavy blow to them.
"Too late, you will all certainly die today!"
The corners of Lin Xuan’s mouth also revealed a cold curve.
The next moment, holding the Golden Flame Spear in his hand, a series of brilliant golden light bursts shot out, piercing through Lin Yi’s heart.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s complexion turned pale; he knew there was no saving him.
"I hate this!"
"Master, I have failed you!"
Lin Yi’s body slowly fell, his eyes filled with regret.
He knew that his life was completely ruined.
"Lin Yi, you ungrateful wretch, just keep being a good disciple of the Lin Family, so as to avoid further disgrace!"
Seeing Lin Yi dead, the other two disciples of the Lin Family similarly looked at Lin Xuan with fierce expressions.
"You don’t need to worry, the Lin Family won’t treat you badly, you can leave with him!" Lin Xuan said indifferently.
Lin Tian’s two disciples, although personally taught by Lin Xuan, were ultimately cultivated by Lin Tian and thus were considered his people.
Thus, Lin Xuan was willing to take them as disciples, but all of this was based on them not betraying the Lin Family.
If people like Lin Yi betrayed the Lin Family, he wouldn’t be merciful.
"Hmph, what can you do if we don’t follow you?"
The two disciples of Lin Yi were not intimidated by Lin Xuan’s words, on the contrary, they showed a venomous look.
"Not following me means a path to death. I advise you, better obediently follow him, or your fate will be the same as his."
With that, Lin Xuan waved his palm and two balls of Golden Flames immediately flew from his hands, instantly turning into two fireballs that enveloped Lin Yi’s two disciples.
"Ah!"
A piercing scream came, the two disciples immediately smoked from their bodies, quickly roasted.
Seeing this scene, the three of Lin Yi suddenly turned pale, trembling all over.
They had not expected Lin Xuan to be so ruthless, directly killing Lin Yi’s two disciples.
Their eyes also flickered with intense fear.
"Now, do you still want to kill me?"
Lin Xuan asked the three people of Lin Yi.
Hearing this, the three of them immediately shook their heads, their hearts filled with fear.
Because they knew, this young man would not let them go.
So what other choice did they have?
"We are willing to follow the young master!"
Lin Yi’s three men knelt on the ground and shouted respectfully.
"Good."
Seeing Lin Yi’s three people showing no resistance, a faint smile appeared on Lin Xuan’s face.

chapters.title: Chapter 895 - 915: Only By Capturing the Enemy
chapters.content:
Chapter 895: Chapter 915: Only By Capturing the Enemy
"Uncle-Master Lin Tian, rest assured, I will definitely avenge you."
"And your two sons, I will take good care of them."
"Let’s go!"
Lin Yi and two others hurriedly stood up and followed behind Lin Xuan.
"Master, what about me?"
Lin Xuan turned his head and looked towards Lin Tian.
"Go, pursue your enemies. Only by capturing those foes can you help me avenge my grievances!" Lin Tian sighed slightly, then his gaze fell on Lin Yi.
"Remember, no matter what, you must survive. Only if you survive, can you avenge your master!"
Lin Tian solemnly instructed Lin Yi.
"Master, rest assured."
"Your vengeance, I will remember it for a lifetime!"
Lin Yi took a deep breath, his eyes also flickering with intense fighting spirit.
"Alright, you may go."
Lin Tian waved his hand.
"Yes!"
Lin Yi turned around, glanced at the distant mountains, and then walked towards the other side of the mountain range.
"Lin Xuan, you really are a monster, to have killed a Martial Artist of the Spiritual King Realm, and not even left a corpse, it’s truly terrifying!"
"It’s no wonder you were nurtured by Senior Brother Lin Tian, you are truly formidable!"
Upon seeing Lin Xuan had dealt with Lin Yi, Li Yunfeng and others couldn’t help but praise.
"Hehe, this level of battle, I’ve seen a lot in the Immortal Cultivation World, but a Martial Artist of Lin Yi’s level indeed poses some difficulty."
"However, we must not be too careless, it would be dangerous if we encountered other Cultivators."
Lin Xuan also said with a smile, for him, this level of battle was all too common.
"We will continue to look for opportunities."
"After all, we haven’t reached the peak yet, otherwise, we would definitely be able to slay powerhouses of the Spiritual King Realm!" Li Yunfeng said.
Hearing this, Lin Xuan nodded, he also understood that they needed to enhance their strength as fast as possible.
Otherwise, if they encountered a powerhouse of the Spiritual King Realm, they would only have the option to flee.
Moreover, this secretive journey will definitely involve many people, so once they encounter them, they need to be careful in their dealings.
"Follow me closely on either side, do not act alone to avoid danger."
After saying this, Lin Xuan led Li Yunfeng, Sun Wukong, and the others, continuing to advance deeper.
After Lin Xuan and his group left, Lin Yi’s parents and two junior brothers also walked out from the woods.
Lin Yi’s father, Lin Tian, looking in the direction Lin Yi left, had a very complicated expression: "Is this Lin Xuan’s strength? I never imagined the disciple I nurtured would be killed by Lin Xuan!"
"Is this Lin Yi really my son, Lin Tian?" A bitter smile appeared on Lin Tian’s face.
This Lin Yi has been a waste since childhood, never possessing the potential for cultivation.
Even his parents once said, they wouldn’t teach him.
Lin Yi has shown great excellence since childhood, hence his parents finally agreed and allowed him to come to Demon Cultivation Island to study.
Not only that, Lin Tian also passed on some of his Cultivation Techniques to Lin Yi.
But unexpectedly, Lin Yi failed to grasp these Cultivation Techniques and instead became a stepping stone for Lin Xuan.
"Hopefully, this Lin Xuan can properly mentor my disciple; if he becomes a powerhouse, he might threaten the very existence of Demon Cultivation Island," Lin Tian thought to himself.
Lin Tian, Lin Yi’s father, is arguably the greatest genius on this continent.
He never expected that his life would be thwarted by one of his own disciples.
All of this was due to Lin Xuan’s machinations.
However, the massacre committed by Lin Xuan has brought a formidable enemy against his own Demon Cultivation Island.
"What should we do now, Uncle Lin Tian?"
"We no longer have any way out."
"We must either ally with Lin Xuan or Lin Yi; only by doing so can we ensure the safety of Demon Cultivation Island in the near future."
"True, Lin Yi’s strength is not particularly impressive, but his master is very powerful. If we ally with Lin Yi, we might still have a chance to win, but to think of matching a genius like Lin Xuan, we should not have such wild hopes."
"That’s right, although Lin Yi’s strength is formidable, he is nothing in the eyes of his master, who is a top-notch powerhouse at the Peak of the Spiritual King Realm. We are powerless against such a figure unless we possess the strength of the Spiritual King Realm!"
"Our Demon Cultivation Island is just a remote island with no significant power or Spiritual King Realm experts to defend it."
"Even we ourselves do not dare to say we have the confidence to fight against Spiritual King Realm powerhouses, hence allying with Lin Yi gives us a slim hope."
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s father fell silent, clearly disappointed. He had originally thought that with his son’s strength, it would be sufficient to defeat Lin Xuan.
But to his surprise, Lin Xuan’s strength was so formidable that even his own son could not prevail against him.
"Father, what should we do now?" A man next to Lin Yi’s father asked; he was Lin Yi.
Lin Yi’s father shook his head, "I don’t know, perhaps we can only ally with Lin Xuan, maybe only by doing so can our Demon Cultivation Island continue to exist!"
"However, if we ally with Lin Xuan, our Demon Cultivation Island will probably never have peace again!" Lin Yi’s father’s face was extremely solemn.
"Father, what do you mean?" Lin Yi’s junior disciple brother asked, puzzled.
"You’ve seen how strong Lin Xuan’s master is, and he is followed by four Spirit Emperor Realm experts, we are the same, also at the Spirit Emperor Realm level, how can we be his adversary?" Lin Yi’s father said slowly.
"Are we just going to give up?" Lin Yi’s father’s voice was low and filled with reluctance.
He had not expected that after so much effort in nurturing his son, Lin Yi would be so easily defeated by Lin Xuan, and die so tragically.
"What’s the use of giving up? Do you think Lin Xuan will spare us? Now the only option is to ally with him to protect Demon Cultivation Island!" Lin Yi’s father sighed, "Otherwise, our Demon Cultivation Island will undoubtedly be destroyed!"
"Then shall we ally with Lin Yi?" Lin Yi’s junior disciple brother asked.
"Yes, but we must hide our identity and must not let Lin Xuan discover us," Lin Yi’s father nodded. "And, you guys need to properly mentor Lin Yi to make him even better!"
"Father, rest assured, we will do our best to help Lin Yi excel," several people nodded in agreement.
"Since that’s the case, let’s go now. This time we cannot let Lin Xuan escape!" said Lin Yi’s father, who then transformed into a long rainbow streaming towards the distance.
At that moment, Lin Yi’s junior brothers also swiftly chased after him.
However, just as Lin Yi’s father soared up into the sky, suddenly an icy killing intent descended on his mind, making him feel extremely oppressed.
Lin Yi’s father hastily stopped and then turned around, only to see a young figure standing not far away.
This figure was none other than Lin Xuan.
At this moment, Lin Xuan looked at Lin Yi’s father with a cold smile: "I did not expect to encounter Lin Yi’s senior uncle in this place."

chapters.title: Chapter 896 - 916: More Than Just Friends
chapters.content:
Chapter 896: Chapter 916: More Than Just Friends
"Lin Xuan, what are you doing here?" Lin Yi’s father’s face showed surprise, and then his gaze narrowed slightly. He had not expected to encounter Lin Xuan here again.
Lin Xuan looked at Lin Yi’s father, the corners of his mouth lifting in a sneer: "It’s none of your business why I am here, but instead, this master of Lin Yi, trying to plot against me, how do you plan to settle this account?"
"What do you want?" Lin Yi’s father said coldly.
"Heh, revenge, of course!" Lin Xuan chuckled lightly, "But before that, there’s something I need to clarify!"
"What do you actually want to do?" Lin Yi’s father frowned.
"I want to kill Lin Yi!" Lin Xuan stated emphatically, his voice filled with intense murderous intent.
"What did you say? You want to kill Lin Yi? Do you know who he is? I advise you to leave this place immediately; don’t make any foolish moves, or you will regret it!"
"Foolish moves? I believe the people of Demon Cultivation Island have made plenty themselves!" Lin Xuan scoffed, "Lin Yi is my friend. I will not allow anyone to harm him!"
Lin Xuan’s tone was exceptionally firm; his relationship with Lin Yi was not just mere friendship but that of close brothers.
"Humph! Lin Yi is our disciple. He disobeyed my orders and acted on his own. Who are you to him?" Lin Yi’s father sneered, "You’re a despicable lowlife, absolutely unworthy of being one of us from Demon Cultivation Island!"
"No matter what, I will not allow anyone to harm Lin Yi!" Lin Xuan said coldly, his voice carrying a thick chill, as if it could freeze the surrounding space.
Upon hearing Lin Xuan’s words, Lin Yi’s father’s rage surged: "Arrogant fool, since you are looking for death, I will grant your wish!"
"Humph!" Lin Xuan scoffed disdainfully, and instantly, the Blood Spear appeared in his hand. A blood-colored rainbow shot out from the spear towards Lin Yi’s father.
"Boy, you are seeking death!" Seeing Lin Xuan’s action, Lin Yi’s father’s face darkened immediately, not expecting Lin Xuan to actually confront him head-on.
"Lin Yi, take him down!" Lin Yi’s father roared furiously. He had not expected his disciple to really dare to provoke him.
Lin Xuan’s figure instantly vanished from the spot, and the next second, he appeared in front of Lin Yi, ruthlessly slamming his spear into Lin Yi’s chest.
Bang!
A muffled sound echoed as Lin Yi’s chest caved in, and he was sent flying backward.
With a thud, Lin Yi’s body smashed into the ground, and from his mouth and nose, he spat out a mouthful of fresh blood. He felt as if all his internal organs had shifted.
"Puh~~~!"
Lin Yi couldn’t help but spit out another mouthful of blood.
"How can this be? My cultivation has clearly advanced to the Third Rank Martial Saint. How could I not withstand even one of his moves!" Shock filled Lin Yi’s eyes.
"Lin Yi, are you alright?" Lin Xuan’s voice came through, followed by a handsome face appearing in Lin Yi’s field of view.
Seeing it was Lin Xuan, a hint of hatred flashed through Lin Yi’s eyes as he gritted his teeth and glared at Lin Xuan: "You bastard!"
"Heh, Lin Yi, do you remember, I told you, I was going to kill you? I said I would kill you, but you never wanted to believe me!" Lin Xuan said mockingly.
"Humph, you think you’re the demonic genius of Demon Cultivation Island?" Lin Yi snorted coldly, "Even if you’re extremely talented, so what?
You’re just a Martial Emperor in Soul Power. What right do you have to kill me? Even if you succeeded, do you think your parents and friends could save you?"
"Oh? Why don’t you give it a try?" Lin Xuan smiled indifferently, his eyes flickering with cold murderous intent.
Lin Yi’s face drastically changed: "You, what are you trying to do!"
"What do I intend to do?" Lin Xuan said with a faint smile, "Didn’t you just say that you people from Demon Cultivation Island love to bully the weak? Well then, I’ll just kill all these so-called uncles of yours and see what you’ll do!"
Lin Yi’s face suddenly turned pale.
"Haha, go ahead then, kill us!" Lin Xuan’s father laughed loudly, "We are already irreconcilable with Lin Xuan. Even if we perish together, we are not afraid. Kill us, and you will suffer the pursuit of Demon Cultivation Island!"
"Really?" Lin Xuan said coldly, "Then I will fulfill your wish!"
As soon as his words fell, Lin Yi’s father, Lin Yi’s two brothers, and Lin Yi’s two mentors were instantly enveloped in a crimson glow unleashed by Lin Xuan.
"Lin Yi, stop him quickly!" Lin Yi’s father shouted.
"Lin Yi, what are you still waiting for? Stop him now!" Lin Yi’s two mentors urgently cried out.
"There’s no need to shout, I’ve already made my move!" Lin Xuan’s indifferent voice echoed.
The next moment, Lin Yi and others felt a terrifying force approaching, binding their bodies and making them completely unable to move.
"Damn it!" Lin Yi’s two mentors cursed, "Let us go! We aren’t your enemies, just let us go!"
"Is that so? But I really dislike your personalities, especially yours!" Lin Xuan said coldly as he looked at Lin Yi’s two mentors.
"You!" Lin Yi’s two mentors glared at Lin Xuan, unable to comprehend his confidence.
Lin Yi’s master looked at Lin Xuan and snorted coldly: "We people of Demon Cultivation Island absolutely will not allow anyone to threaten us! If you really kill us, you won’t live to leave this place!"
"Oh, is that so? I’m quite curious to see what you can actually do to me," Lin Xuan sneered.
Immediately, he clenched his fists tightly, a soaring will to fight radiating from his body, and a strong intent to kill also emerged in his eyes.
"You bastard!"
"Go to hell!"
Seeing Lin Xuan’s demeanor, Lin Yi’s two mentors shouted angrily, and then a terrifying aura erupted from them.
Lin Yi’s father also erupted with a terrifying aura, violently striking towards Lin Xuan’s head, hoping to defeat Lin Xuan in one move and then escape with Lin Yi.
Seeing this, Lin Yi also desperately circulated his Cultivation Technique, preparing to desperately block Lin Xuan’s attack.
Boom!
As their powers collided, the terrifying force instantly swept all around.
"No!" Lin Yi’s agonizing scream resonated.
Subsequently, Lin Yi’s body heavily fell to the ground, his ribcage directly shattered, and his Dantian was completely ruptured, his entire body slumping weakly on the ground.
Seeing Lin Yi’s miserable state, his father burst out in joy and looking at Lin Xuan, he yelled: "Lin Xuan, you dare to kill my son! You are dead for sure!"
"Is that so? Are you sure I am doomed?" Lin Xuan sneered, "My death isn’t for you to dictate; I decide how I die!"
After saying that, Lin Xuan’s gaze turned towards Lin Yi’s two mentors.
Seeing Lin Xuan look over, Lin Yi’s two mentors shivered slightly, a hint of murderous intent visible in Lin Xuan’s eyes.
"Lin Yi, weren’t you very arrogant? Show me that arrogance again!" Lin Xuan’s voice was icy cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 897 - 917: It Will Cause Great Ripples
chapters.content:
Chapter 897: Chapter 917: It Will Cause Great Ripples
Lin Yi’s two masters trembled in fear, as they did not wish to end up like Lin Yi.
"Lin Yi, you like to fight, don’t you? I’ll show you what a real fight is!" A murderous intent flickered in Lin Xuan’s eyes, "I will show you what pain really is!"
Then, Lin Xuan’s figure turned into a blur of shadows, rushing towards Lin Yi’s father.
"No, don’t!" Lin Yi’s father cried out in panic, "You can’t kill me! I am the Great Elder of Demon Cultivation Island!"
"Great Elder?" A mocking smile appeared on Lin Xuan’s lips, "Didn’t you say your Demon Cultivation Island is very powerful? Why would you be killed by me?"
"Because I am the Great Elder, a core member of Demon Cultivation Island. Killing me would cause great turmoil. I assure you, even the Island Master would struggle to bear my wrath, so you cannot kill me!"
"Heh, I want to kill you just the same!" Lin Xuan let out a cold laugh, his body now close to Lin Yi’s father.
"Lin Yi, get the hell away from me, or I’ll show you no mercy!" Lin Xuan’s father roared in anger.
"No mercy? How would you treat me with no mercy?" A curve formed at the corners of Lin Xuan’s mouth, "What can you do?"
"You!" Lin Yi’s father was suddenly at a loss for words.
Indeed, he had no real power to speak of. Although he was the Great Elder of Demon Cultivation Island and a Martial Artist of the Martial Ancestor Realm, he was just an Outer Sect Disciple, with no right to participate in the struggles of the Inner Sect Disciples.
Therefore, he really had no authority, and even if he wanted to kill Lin Xuan, it was impossible for him to do so.
However, Lin Xuan was, after all, a talented disciple from the Immortal Cultivation Continent, and the future of the Lin Family. If Lin Xuan were to die here, it would be a huge loss for their Lin Family.
Thus, he had to protect Lin Yi at all costs, to ensure that he was out of danger.
Moreover, Lin Yi was his son, so he also had to save Lin Yi’s life.
So, he had to temporarily set aside his hatred and ensure Lin Yi’s safety first.
With that thought, he turned to Lin Yi and said coldly, "Lin Yi, leave here now. I promise that as long as you leave, I won’t trouble you, or else I will kill you!"
"Heh, how laughable, why should I believe you? I’ll kill you right now, do you dare?" Lin Yi said with disdain.
"You!" Lin Yi’s father was nearly driven to a rage by these words.
Still, he suppressed his anger, grinding his teeth and saying, "Fine, you want to kill me, then let’s play!"
"Ha ha! Fantastic!" Lin Yi laughed arrogantly, his eyes revealing a chilling smile.
Seeing Lin Yi and Lin Xuan start to fight, Lin Yi’s two masters breathed a sigh of relief.
But they did not realize that at this moment, a pitch-black dagger suddenly appeared in Lin Xuan’s hand, filled with a bone-chilling glow.
As soon as the dagger appeared, it pierced the void, stabbing towards Lin Yi’s two masters. It moved as fast as lightning and instantly reached their side.
Lin Yi’s two masters had no time to react before they were directly pierced through the throat.
Pfft!
Blood gushed out at once, and the bodies of the two masters slowly fell to the ground, the life in their eyes fading rapidly.
Lin Yi’s father, seeing this scene, widened his eyes in disbelief, "How is this possible? How did you do it?"
"I’ve already told you, if I so desire, I can kill anyone at will!" Lin Xuan said indifferently, his expression unchanged.
"You kill them, and their corpses will end up in the mass graves! By then, even if you try to silence them, it will be too late. I advise you to release my son right now; otherwise, we will die together!" Lin Yi’s father roared.
However, Lin Xuan simply shook his head, "Do you think I would let you go? I’ve known for a long time that you two are Lin Yi’s parents. I specifically captured you to threaten Lin Yi. Otherwise, do you think I would have let you live until now?"
Upon hearing these words, Lin Yi’s father’s face stiffened, and he finally understood that this young man had no intention of letting either of them go.
They had, after all, killed two of Lin Yi’s martial uncles!
If word of this got out, it would surely bring huge trouble, possibly affecting the entire Immortal Cultivation World and even Demon Cultivation Island.
Therefore, Lin Yi’s father absolutely could not allow the incident involving his son to get out, and likewise, Lin Yi’s two martial uncles must not be allowed to leave alive.
"Don’t force me, or else I’ll take you down with me, even if it means we both perish!" Lin Yi’s father exclaimed angrily.
Hearing this, Lin Xuan’s face showed a thick sneer, "Do you think you are qualified? Even if you kill me, Lin Yi will not let you go. Just wait, he will definitely come for revenge!"
Lin Yi’s father felt a sudden pang of fear in his heart upon hearing this, and a flash of panic crossed his eyes.
He knew it was the truth!
Lin Yi truly would not let him go. If what Lin Xuan had said were to come to pass, wouldn’t he be doomed to mutual destruction with him?
Then, he would completely lose his son!
No, he could not lose his son, he absolutely could not lose Lin Yi!
"Lin Xuan, don’t spout nonsense. My son is a genius! Naturally gifted, he is destined to become a Martial Emperor Realm powerhouse in the future. How could he possibly stoop to your level? Just give it a few years, he will definitely reach the Martial Venerable strength!" Lin Yi’s father hurriedly explained.
"Is that so?" Lin Xuan, hearing this, suddenly widened his eyes. He stared intently at the dagger in his hand, his face filled with disbelief, "This... this is... a Holy Artifact?"
"What Holy Artifact? I don’t recognize it!"
"Yeah, where did this come from?"
"Could it be that he took it from someone else?"
Lin Yi’s master and the others were also full of confusion.
"You! Who are you?" Finally sensing something was amiss, Lin Yi’s father realized that this youth was not an ordinary person. Who was he to possess a Holy Artifact?
"Heh, you don’t need to worry about who I am! You just need to know that your son will not let you go!"
"You!" Lin Yi’s father, hearing this, trembled with rage.
He could not believe that Lin Yi would disregard familial bonds, harm him, and even kill his entire family.
He knew that Lin Yi disliked him, so he did not care about his own wife and son or those of his wife’s son.
But his wife and son were his bottom line.
Lin Yi meant everything to him; everything he had depended on his son. If he were to lose his son, then he would lose everything, all that he owned.
"No need to worry, your wife and your son are as good as dead!" Lin Xuan’s face bore an extremely cold smile, "Rest assured, once they die, I’ll accompany you on their journey, but this time I will send you to Hell first!"
"Hmph, if that’s the case, then I’ll send you to Hell first!" Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s father snorted coldly and immediately employed his movement technique, launching an attack on Lin Xuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 898 - 918: Striking Without Hesitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 898: Chapter 918: Striking Without Hesitation
Lin Xuan also did not hesitate to make a move, and the two began to fight in the void.
Both of them were at the Ninth Level of Qi Cultivation Stage, Lin Yi was stronger than Lin Xuan, thus he gained the upper hand, while Lin Xuan, though powerful, was not adept at close combat.
Lin Yi’s father was stronger than him, so all he could do was be suppressed in the fight.
Seeing Lin Xuan being suppressed, Lin Yi’s father’s smile on his face turned more ferocious.
His anger grew greater in his heart, he was determined to kill Lin Yi, absolutely determined!
His punches and kicks were ruthless and powerful, furiously launching assaults towards Lin Xuan.
"Bang, bang, bang..."
Lin Xuan staggered backwards dozens of steps, his mouth also starting to bleed.
Seeing Lin Xuan injured, Lin Yi’s father’s face sported an even more excited smile, "Lin Xuan, your cultivation is too far behind Lin Yi’s, you simply can’t beat mine!"
"Really? Are you sure I can’t beat you?" Lin Xuan coldly asked.
Lin Yi’s father nodded, saying, "Yes, you can’t beat me, so you might as well obediently hand over the Holy Artifact, otherwise, I will make your death very miserable!"
"Oh?" Hearing this, Lin Xuan couldn’t help but sneer.
"You still think, with this rubbish you can deal with me? That’s simply delusional!" Lin Xuan mocked.
"Ha ha! Whether it’s delusional or not, you’ll find out soon!" Lin Yi’s father responded with a cold laugh.
"You really aren’t afraid of death! Then let me sever your right arm first, to make you understand, your right arm will become your fatal weakness, and then, I’ll see how you’ll escape my pursuit!" Lin Xuan said darkly.
In his eyes, there was a cold and bloodthirsty look, as if pronouncing a tragic fate.
"Who do you think you are? Dreaming of severing my right arm, I will sever your left arm first, then let’s see if you can still be arrogant then!"
Lin Yi’s father laughed coldly, and then he charged towards Lin Xuan, his long knife slashing fiercely.
"Boom!"
A loud explosion sounded, his long knife had already chopped onto Lin Xuan’s shoulder.
However, something utterly shocking occurred.
His knife had merely scratched Lin Xuan’s shoulder and failed to sever his bone, which was simply unbelievable.
Lin Yi’s father was also stunned; his knife, couldn’t actually kill Lin Yi?
Lin Yi’s father’s heart violently twitched, he couldn’t believe that the cultivation technique he had painstakingly practiced was useless against Lin Yi!
Moreover, he was just a Basic Skills disciple!
"I should have realized earlier, how could a disciple who just joined the sect have such a terrifying cultivation technique, it turns out, it was all an illusion!"
Lin Xuan looked at the wound on his shoulder, his eyebrows immediately furrowed.
Just now, he had intentionally pretended to be injured to lure Lin Yi’s father into a trap.
And this Lin Yi’s father, really thought he had severed his arm, actually, Lin Xuan had only used a bit of force and didn’t hurt himself, and he wasn’t really injured.
"I’ve said before, you will regret the choices you’ve made, today you must die!" Lin Xuan’s eyes flashed coldly, his figure flickered, instantly appearing in front of Lin Yi’s father.
His hand suddenly reached out, grabbing towards his throat.
"You, what are you trying to do!" Lin Yi’s father was shocked, trying to dodge, but Lin Xuan’s speed was too fast, he couldn’t evade in time.
"Bang!"
Lin Xuan slapped his chest.
"""
"Phew!"
Lin Yi’s father suddenly spat out a mouthful of fresh blood and was sent flying, landing heavily on the ground, his body no longer possessing any strength to resist.
"You, how could you hurt me!" Lin Yi’s father struggled to stand up, unwilling to believe that Lin Xuan truly harmed him.
The look in Lin Yi’s father’s eyes turned to one of horror as he looked at Lin Xuan.
"You, who exactly are you! How can your strength be so formidable!" He uttered in absolute shock.
"Haha! Who I am doesn’t need to be revealed to you just yet!" Lin Xuan sneered, then waved his hand and a mass of black flames swept towards him.
"No! Someone save me!"
Seeing the black flames hurled by Lin Xuan, Lin Yi’s father screamed loudly.
"Hmph, it’s too late!"
With a cold snort from Lin Xuan, the man in blue robes beside him was engulfed by the black flames.
His legs burned in the black flames, and he wailed in agony.
This was the third time Lin Xuan killed him; the first time was at the Lin Family, where he slew Lin Yi’s grandfather to save Lin Yi, and the second time was here, killing him under his son’s watchful eyes. All of this filled Lin Yi’s father’s heart with resentment.
His face flushed red; he wanted to shout for mercy but found himself unable to make any sound, as if his throat was also sealed.
"What kind of person are you! Why do you treat me like this!" Lin Yi’s father roared in anger.
"What kind of person am I?" Lin Xuan sneered, then swung his hand, and the mass of black flames transformed into a sword shadow, stabbing towards Lin Yi’s father.
"No..."
Lin Yi’s father’s eyes widened in despair.
"Whoosh whoosh!"
His legs were penetrated by the black sword shadow, and he let out a piercing scream, then completely fell.
"You killed my father?!"
Seeing his father fall, Lin Yi completely lost it, his eyes bloodshot as he glared at Lin Xuan.
"Ha, your father wanted to kill me, should I have spared him? Since your father wanted to kill me, I could only cut off his arm first, then slowly deal with him later!"
Lin Xuan knew very well what kind of person Lin Yi’s father was—a despicable villain who would do anything to achieve his goals. Such a person was not worthy of sympathy.
Nor did he deserve to be his father!
His father had killed his parents, so he would let his father also taste that kind of agony.
"You, you, you devil, you will face retribution!"
Lin Yi clenched his teeth and stared at Lin Xuan.
"Retribution? I’ve never believed in any retribution!" Lin Xuan shook his head and said, "You better take care of your own life first!"
With that, he turned and walked away, leaving Lin Yi staring in stupefied silence.
He couldn’t believe that his father could actually die! He couldn’t believe that Lin Yi’s strength could be so great, and he couldn’t believe that Lin Xuan wouldn’t even spare his father.
His heart surged with endless hatred, his mind filled with intense murderous intent.
"Father, I must make Lin Xuan pay, make him pay a bloody price, I must make him die!"
Lin Yi roared inwardly, clenching his fists, his bones making crackling noises.

chapters.title: Chapter 899 - 919: Feeling Emotional as Well
chapters.content:
Chapter 899: Chapter 919: Feeling Emotional as Well
"Lin Yi, your father has already been dealt with by me!" A cold voice came from Lin Xuan’s ear.
Upon hearing the system’s prompt, Lin Xuan also let out a slight sigh of relief, feeling somewhat emotional.
His strength has indeed improved greatly, not only being able to defeat Lin Yi’s father, but also to kill him.
Truly worthy of being the system’s host, Lin Xuan praised himself inwardly.
"Lin Yi, now it’s your turn."
Lin Xuan turned and looked at Lin Yi, saying coldly, "I don’t wish to waste time here."
Hearing Lin Xuan’s words, Lin Yi’s heart trembled.
He also knew that his father could no longer protect him, so he could only hope that Lin Xuan would spare him, maybe then he could save his life.
Lin Yi’s heart was filled with anticipation.
He didn’t want to die, he wanted to live.
"My father can forgive you, but you must accept punishment!" Lin Yi glared at Lin Xuan and said coldly.
"What punishment should I accept?" Lin Xuan asked.
"You must kneel on the ground and kowtow ten times, then hand over all the treasures of the Lin Family to me; these items will all belong to me!" Lin Yi pointed at several corpses on the ground and spoke to Lin Xuan.
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Xuan couldn’t help but laugh.
He stared at Lin Yi and said, "Your father, what a fool!"
"What, what do you mean!" Lin Yi asked puzzled.
"Your father is an idiot, a moron! He actually handed those treasures over to you. If he hadn’t handed them over to me, I wouldn’t have plundered his wealth, but he insisted on giving me the treasures. Do you think I would spare him?"
"These treasures belong to me, I can take them whenever I want, all the properties of the Lin Family are mine, you have no right to stop me!"
Lin Xuan looked coldly at Lin Yi, his shocking words widening Lin Yi’s eyes.
"What?"
Lin Yi’s eyes widened, full of shock.
"It’s impossible! How could my father give those treasures to you!" Lin Yi said incredulously.
"Why wouldn’t he give those treasures to me, that’s his business, not yours!" Lin Xuan glared indifferently at Lin Yi.
"You..."
Hearing Lin Xuan’s words, Lin Yi was speechless.
It was true his father had no rights to manage those treasures, and indeed his father had given those treasures to Lin Yi.
However, Lin Yi didn’t want to admit this.
He thought that Lin Xuan was just bluffing, deceiving him!
Lin Xuan, he couldn’t possibly have so many treasures, Lin Yi didn’t believe this!
"Lin Xuan, don’t forget that just now you promised to grant me a swift end, if you go back on your word now, you’re nothing but a coward!"
"Ha ha ha! I am a coward! I’m a scaredy-cat, I’m not a coward, and I don’t need to grant you a swift end!"
Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Xuan laughed heartily, his laughter full of satisfaction.
His eyes shone with a chilling light.
"You!"
Seeing Lin Xuan’s demeanor, Lin Yi was stunned.
"What, scared now? Let me tell you, I’m not very patient!"
Lin Xuan stared at Lin Yi, speaking faintly.
"Hmph, I’m not scared, if you dare to hurt me, you’ll die too!" Lin Yi’s expression was fierce, his heart also holding a trace of fear.
His heart was worried, fearful, and at a loss.
"Then you’d better pray you can survive this ordeal, because, in the near future, your death will be your only fate!"
Hearing Lin Xuan’s words, Lin Yi’s body shuddered violently, and he couldn’t help but look around nervously.
His eyes suddenly widened, realizing that a group of people had gathered around him.
His gaze swept over, only to find that all these people were experts of the Martial Sovereign Realm.
Fear overwhelmed his heart.
These experts were all here waiting for him.
Lin Yi’s eyes shifted as he suddenly thought of his master.
"Master, please save me, they are all here to kill me, please, save me!" Lin Yi urgently cried out to Lin Ao in the void.
"Who is this master of yours, where is he? I’d really like to meet him."
Lin Xuan looked at Lin Yi with an indifferent expression, seemingly disdainful of Lin Yi’s plea for help, as if he didn’t know Lin Yi at all.
Hearing Lin Xuan’s words, Lin Yi’s face instantly turned ashen, his body trembling, clearly very angry.
Lin Xuan’s words had a huge impact on him.
"Lin Xuan, you are too bullying!"
Lin Yi roared: "Do you want to oppose the Lin Family? Are you not worried that your family will be wiped out!"
"Lin Yi, you are really ignorant. Do you think the Lin Family is such a huge entity?"
"In the Lin Family, I am the only young master, I can destroy the Lin Family easily. Do you think I am afraid of the Lin Family?" Lin Xuan said mockingly.
Hearing Lin Xuan’s words, Lin Yi’s heart also stirred up a tempest.
He finally understood why Lin Xuan was so indifferent towards the Lin Family—he had sufficient confidence!
"Hmph, the Lin Family isn’t just about one young master like you. Do you think you’re the only Martial King? You don’t know my strength has already reached the Fivefold Realm of the Martial King, much stronger than you!" Lin Yi said coldly staring at Lin Xuan.
Fivefold Realm of the Martial King!
Lin Xuan raised his eyebrows upon hearing this.
Unexpectedly, Lin Yi had already reached the Fivefold Realm of the Martial King!
The Lin Family is truly remarkable!
"Lin Yi, now, I will send you on your way!"
"Boom!"
Lin Xuan’s right foot stomped down.
His foot, carrying the mighty force of thunder, kicked fiercely towards Lin Yi.
Seeing Lin Xuan’s attack coming, Lin Yi’s face suddenly darkened.
He also waved the longsword in his hand, clashing forcefully with Lin Xuan.
"Bang!"
Two figures were blasted back, their silhouettes crossing each other in the air, leaving two trails.
The two paused their movements and landed again.
They stood hundreds of meters apart, looking at each other from a distance, a flame of battle spreading from the aura between them.
Feeling Lin Xuan’s oppressive aura, Lin Yi felt a bit panic.
Lin Yi’s strength wasn’t low, but there was a gap compared to a Martial Artist at the peak level of Martial King.
"Lin Yi, you are just a waste of the Lin Family, and I, I am the eldest young master of the Lin Family! I have no need to fear a waste like you, nor do I need to be wary of your background!"
"Now, I am going to take your life!" Lin Xuan coldly shouted, and then he charged towards Lin Yi.
His speed was extremely fast, and in the blink of an eye, he had already rushed in front of Lin Yi, and then brutally punched Lin Yi.
"Boom boom!"
The punch roared through the air, shattering it, making a series of piercing sounds.
Lin Yi felt as if he had been run over by a vehicle, his chest in severe pain, he opened his mouth and spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, and his whole person was blown away, crashing to the ground.
"Pfft!"
Another blood hole appeared on Lin Yi’s body.

chapters.title: Chapter 900 - 920: Defeated in Three Moves!
chapters.content:
Chapter 900: Chapter 920: Defeated in Three Moves!
Bright red blood streamed out from the bullet hole.
Seeing the blood on Lin Yi’s body, Lin Xuan shook his head slightly.
