Lin Xuan lifted his leg and kicked towards Lin Yi’s chest again.
"No, don’t!"
Lin Yi let out a shrill scream upon seeing Lin Xuan’s action.
However, before his voice could travel far, it abruptly ceased.
His pupils contracted, only to see that Lin Xuan had already reached him, his foot kicking squarely against his chest.
Lin Yi’s entire breastbone caved in, and his body, like a kite with its string cut, was sent flying backward.
Lin Yi’s body slid across the ground for several hundred meters before it came to a stop.
"Pu!"
Lin Yi spat out a mouthful of fresh blood and lay twitching on the ground, motionless, having fallen unconscious.
Seeing Lin Yi pass out, Lin Xuan retracted his foot, then leisurely walked up to him, patted his shoulder, and said disdainfully, "What a waste, defeated by just three moves from me!"
"No, no!"
Tears immediately welled up in Lin Ao’s eyes as he saw Lin Yi being knocked unconscious by Lin Xuan’s kick.
Lin Xuan was truly too arrogant, to have injured a young man like Lin Yi to such an extent—it was simply too brutal.
"You devil, Lin Xuan! How dare you kill a Lin Family disciple, aren’t you afraid of the Lin Family’s revenge?" Lin Ao said indignantly.
"Revenge?"
"Do you think you can stop the Lin Family from dealing with me?"
Lin Xuan gave Lin Ao a glance.
The look from Lin Xuan sent a shiver through Lin Ao’s body, and his complexion turned as pale as death.
Indeed, with Lin Xuan’s strength, should he truly wish to kill the Lin Family, they would have no means to resist!
"But rest assured, you won’t live long after Lin Yi’s death either," Lin Xuan continued.
"What do you mean?" Lin Ao’s gaze suddenly turned sharp.
Although Lin Yi was a waste, Lin Xuan still wasn’t qualified to get the Lin Family to deal with him!
"I’ve said it—you won’t survive tonight!"
"I will grind you into dust!"
Lin Xuan spoke coldly, devoid of any warmth.
Hearing these words, Lin Ao trembled.
"Lin Xuan, you devil! You dare!"
"I am the Young Master of the Lin Family, the head of the Lin Family. If you dare to touch me, that’s an act of enmity against the Lin Family!"
"I advise you to flee from here at once. If my father comes back, you won’t be able to escape!" Lin Ao said.
"Oh?"
"The head of the Lin Family? Lin Tian, he’s already dead, and Lin Yi is nothing but a stray dog!"
"The Lin Family has been destroyed, and Lin Yi is the future heir! So, killing you is no big deal!"
"You... you dare to kill the head of the Lin Family?!" Hearing Lin Xuan’s words, Lin Ao’s face showed an expression of disbelief.
"What? Do you think you can change your father’s decision?"
"Don’t forget, your father died half a year ago, and his body has long been buried in the Lin Family ancestral grave!"
"So, it’s impossible for him to return to the Lin Family."
"You say you can change the Lin Family’s decisions? Hahaha! Are you dreaming?"
"What you said is all lies, you must be deceiving me!"
"How could my father’s body be buried? How could it possibly be buried in the Lin Family ancestral grave?!"
Lin Yi roared hysterically, his entire person going mad, unable to stop the tears that streamed down from his eyes.
"Heh, do you think I would bother explaining such a thing to you?" Lin Xuan laughed, then once more delivered a kick to Lin Yi’s body.
"Boom!"
"Ah!"
Lin Yi’s body traced a parabola through the air, crashing straight into the ground, spitting out another mouthful of fresh blood before passing out completely.
And he never woke up again.
Looking at Lin Yi, who had passed out, Lin Xuan shook his head without any lingering affection and turned to leave the place.
"Hmph! Lin Yi, this trash, still thinks he can kill me. He should take a piss and look at himself. I can’t be bothered with him!"
Lin Xuan left the area, disappearing into the night, without a trace.
And Lin Yi remained unconscious there.
...
The next day, in the early morning, sunlight shone through the gaps in the tree leaves, casting a dappled shadow on the ground.
And atop a small hill, Lin Yi slowly opened his eyes.
His eyes were filled with venomous hate.
"Lin Xuan, you wait, I will make you regret this!"
"How dare you knock me unconscious! I will not let you get away with this!"
"Also, I’ll have the elders of the Lin Family make a move to kill you!"
"You’re a dead man!"
Lin Yi roared with rage in his heart.
"No, why should I tell the elders that I am from the Lin Family? Am I an idiot?"
"Why should I tell them I’m a Lin, their son? They will take revenge for me!"
"I’ll wait for them to strike down Lin Xuan!"
"They certainly won’t want a failure from the Lin Family as their heir!"
"I’ll wait for them to make their move first, then sneak away in the chaos. Then, I won’t believe you can still find me!"
A sly glint flashed in Lin Yi’s eyes.
"Hmph! Lin Xuan, the Lin Family will not let you off, just you wait!"
After saying this, Lin Yi stood up and quickly left toward the distant horizon.
"I must seek out opportunities to break through to the Martial Saint Realm, so I can protect my mother and sister, then return to seek my vengeance!"
"When the time comes, I will crush you to dust and appease the hatred burning within my chest!"
Thinking of Lin Xuan’s previous treatment, the resentment in Lin Yi’s heart grew even stronger!
"Lin Xuan, I will make you regret this for the rest of your life!"
"And I will also tell our parents that you have gravely injured their grandson last night; I want you dead!"
...
"Lin Xuan, you just wait, this matter is not over!"
Lin Yi roared maniacally in his heart.
"Lin Yi, stop right there!"
Just then, an icy voice rang out, making all the hairs on Lin Yi’s body stand up.
Lin Yi turned around and saw a young man standing behind him.
The young man was dressed in a blue robe, had handsome features, and piercing eyes sharp as knife blades.
"Who are you, and what do you want?" Lin Yi asked, looking at the youth.
"Hmph, you dared to injure my brother and even dared to harm Lin Tian! Do you know how serious this crime is?"
"Lin Tian is the future patriarch of our Lin Family, and Lin Tian is also Lin Yi’s brother. Injuring Lin Yi is akin to injuring the future patriarch of the Lin Family!"
"So, I now represent the family and declare that from this moment, you, Lin Yi, are expelled from the family! You shall never enter the Lin Family again!"
"And the body of my father will forever be buried in the Lin Family’s ancestral tomb; none of you from the Lin Family should ever dream of being able to find him!"
After listening to the young man’s words, Lin Yi’s face turned instantly pale, his body shook violently, and his features twisted into a ferocious snarl.

chapters.title: Chapter 901 - 921: Lin Yu’s Mortal Enemy!
chapters.content:
Chapter 901: Chapter 921: Lin Yu’s Mortal Enemy!
"Lin Xuan, I will not let you go!"
"Also, you wait for me too. One day, I will send your head back to the Lin Family, and then you will face the Thunderstrike of our Lin Family’s high-ranking members!"
"Hmph!" With a resentful expression on his face, Lin Yi sneered coldly and then quickly left the place.
After Lin Yi left, his face immediately turned pale as paper, his eyes filled with fear.
The young man just now was Lin Yi’s brother, Lin Yu. His cultivation had reached the Sevenfold of the Transformation Mortal Realm, and within the Lin Family, he was considered a genius.
However, due to Lin Yi’s reason, he was expelled from the Lin Family.
Now, Lin Yu was nothing but a mere follower of Lin Yi.
However, this made Lin Yi even angrier because in Lin Yu’s heart, there was only Lin Yi!
And Lin Xuan was Lin Yu’s mortal enemy!
Lin Yi was well aware that Lin Yu would definitely not let Lin Xuan go. He must quickly enhance his cultivation and then go to Lin Xuan’s family to rescue his relatives.
...
Three days later, Lin Xuan and Chen Xin’er also arrived at the Lin Family.
At this time, Lin Xuan recognized a few familiar people.
Among them were two youths, who were two elderly members of the Lin Family, named Lin Hao and Lin Hai.
When Lin Xuan looked at Lin Hao, he slightly squinted his eyes.
Lin Hao also noticed Lin Xuan the first time. He looked at Lin Xuan, a flash of surprise in his eyes, then said, "Xiao Xuan, you finally came."
"Yes, Grandfather Lin Hao!"
Lin Xuan smiled and called out.
"Xiao Xuan, your cultivation has now reached the Peak of the Sixfold Transformation Mortal Realm, not bad, not bad, your strength has improved a lot compared to before," Lin Hao said with a smile, "You should stay in the Lin Family for a while."
Lin Xuan nodded. He indeed needed to stay here until he reached the Sevenfold of the Transformation Mortal Realm so he could leave the Lin Family.
At that time, he could go to find Lin Xuan’s father and perhaps save his father.
As for Lin Yi, Lin Xuan would definitely not let him go. He must eliminate Lin Yi!
...
Lin Xuan stayed at the Lin Family, and his identity successfully attracted the attention of the family.
Thus, as soon as Lin Xuan appeared in the Lin Family, he was under the scrutiny of many people.
"Is that the waste Lin Xuan of our Lin Family?"
"His cultivation has actually reached the Peak of the Sixfold Transformation Mortal Realm, that’s really amazing!"
"Lin Yi was injured by him, he must pay a painful price!"
Voices of mockery and ridicule came through.
Lin Yi also heard this, and his face became even more embarrassing, even somewhat distorted.
He did not expect Lin Xuan’s cultivation speed to be so terrifying. In just a few days, he had cultivated from a mere mortal to his current realm!
Not only that, Lin Xuan had also injured Lin Xuan’s brother Lin Tian!
This was simply unbelievable!
"Hmph!"
"Wait and see, Lin Xuan, I won’t let you live and leave the Lin Family!"
"I will hang your head outside the great gate of Lin Family, letting everyone in the city and the whole world know that not only do I, Lin Yi, take back everything that belongs to me, but I will also make his family members die with him!"
"But before that, I need to make those who insulted me pay a painful price!"
"Lin Xuan, I will make you die with nowhere to bury!"
"And your woman, you must die too!"
Lin Yi viciously thought to himself.
"Hmph! Lin Xuan, I’m curious to see how you two will survive after being expelled from your Lin Family!"
Lin Yi’s heart was filled with a venomous look.
He hated, he hated everything.
Lin Yi knew that as long as his cultivation broke through to the Meridian Condensation Realm, he could return to the Lin Family, and then find an opportunity to deal with Lin Xuan, taking back the one million Spirit Stones.
After being expelled, Lin Xuan had no way to continue cultivating; he had to first enhance his cultivation.
However, over these few days, Lin Yi had also thought of numerous methods; he planned to find a place to cultivate in seclusion first.
Not long after, Lin Yi arrived in a valley.
This valley was located in the most remote area of the Lin Family, and it was usually devoid of people. After arriving, Lin Yi stripped off all his clothes.
"Ah..."
"Lin Yi, what are you doing?"
Lin Yi’s sudden action terrified the two attendants, and they hurriedly covered their chests.
These two attendants were slaves that Lin Yi had taken from the Lin Family.
At this moment, upon seeing Lin Yi’s actions, they immediately shouted, their eyes flashing with panic, as if they had seen a monster.
And Lin Yi simply stared at them coldly.
"Do you two really want me to kill you?"
"No, no, no, don’t kill us, we haven’t seen anything, we’re just slaves."
The two attendants quickly pleaded for mercy.
Although they were brought by Lin Yi, Lin Yi had not given them any antidote.
Moreover, every time at the Lin Family, Lin Yi had given them some Elixirs to consume and also provided them with Marrow Cleansing.
Their attitude towards Lin Yi had already changed.
So, they dared not provoke Lin Yi anymore.
"Hmph! Since you haven’t seen anything, then let me show you!"
Lin Yi sneered, and his hands reached towards the two attendants.
"Bang, bang, bang..."
A series of muffled sounds came from the chest of the two attendants, their Physical Bodies directly exploding, blood splattering everywhere.
Subsequently, not a single remnant of these two attendants remained; they were completely obliterated.
Lin Yi, killing like slaughtering hemp!
"These two beasts, trying to plot against me, deserve death!"
"Their fate is already over, in the next life, they are only fit to be a dog!"
"Hmph!"
"Now I’m going into seclusion for a while, and if anyone dares to scheme against me in secret, I will make sure they have no burial place!"
While Lin Yi spoke coldly, he walked into a cave nearby.
This cave was prepared specifically for himself.
Inside the cave, numerous Formations were set up, which could protect Lin Yi from being attacked.
After entering, Lin Yi locked the door of the cave, and sealed the entire cave.
Then, Lin Yi sat down cross-legged on the ground, relaxed his body, and slowly closed his eyes.
A faint golden sheen appeared on the surface of Lin Yi’s body, a sign of the Spiritual Energy circulating within.
He was absorbing the Primordial Energy of this space, then using this energy to assault his Physical Body.
Yet he could only absorb for around an Hour; exceeding an Hour, his body would burst, turning into a mud-like substance.
Therefore, Lin Yi had to be cautious.
"Huff puff!"
"Boom Boom Boom!"
As Lin Yi continued to absorb Primordial Energy, massive bolts of lightning moved continuously around him, incessantly striking his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 902 - 922: Enduring the Thunder Tribulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 902: Chapter 922: Enduring the Thunder Tribulation
Bolts of lightning struck Lin Yi one after another, leaving his entire body charred and emitting thick smoke, looking extremely wretched.
"Ahh!"
Nevertheless, Lin Yi continued to grit his teeth and endure the pain.
Because only through such intensity could his strength be enhanced.
Lin Xuan and Chen Xi, on the other hand, were quietly observing Lin Yi enduring the thunder tribulation.
Though the power of these bolts of lightning was terrifying, Lin Yi’s physical body was extremely resilient, not harmed in the slightest by them.
Moreover, these bolts of lightning were also a resource for cultivation.
Lin Yi, currently a Ninefold Innate Realm Martial Artist, had a physical strength that was even greater than that of a typical Ninefold Innate Realm Martial Artist, to the extent that his physical strength was comparable to that of a Martial Artist in the third level of the Innate Realm.
And his Primordial Energy was far superior to that of a Martial Artist in the second level of the Innate Realm.
His body was much stronger than Martial Artists of the same level!
For Lin Yi, these bolts of lightning were also the ideal choice for cultivation.
Shortly, Lin Yi had already withstood seven or eight waves of lightning.
These seven or eight waves of lightning had not reduced Lin Yi to ashes.
But he was severely injured, his clothing torn to shreds, and his body marked with dark, scorched traces.
"I can’t go on, I need to recover from my injuries quickly!"
Lin Yi shook his head and sighed, "Otherwise, my body will be destroyed!"
These bolts of lightning were indeed a treasure for cultivation, and the Heaven and Earth Laws and power they contained were exceptionally formidable.
If it were an ordinary Martial Artist in the third level of the Innate Realm, or even a typical one in the Fourfold Innate Realm, they would be struck dead.
Yet Lin Yi remained unharmed, which was enough to demonstrate how formidable his physical body was.
However, Lin Yi had only just reached the Ninefold Innate Realm, and was still far from the sixth level of the Innate Realm.
But his physical strength was not comparable to that of an ordinary Martial Artist in the Fivefold Innate Realm.
So for now, he was merely being struck temporarily.
"Huff puff!"
Outside the cave, there came gasping sounds.
"What? Lin Yi is cultivating inside the cave? Isn’t he being too bold?"
"Isn’t he a fool? Is this a place he should be?"
"His strength is nothing to speak of; cultivating here is bound to be fruitless."
"This Lin Yi, though strong, what a pity— he thinks he can cultivate here, it’s simply a fool’s dream!"
"No matter how formidable his strength might be, his current situation is very dangerous; one slight misstep could see him devoured by the Demon Beasts."
...
The people outside were all gossiping.
These individuals were also cultivating near the cave; they looked at Lin Yi’s mountain peak with an intense greed in their eyes.
However, no one dared to approach the cave; they all watched from a distance, their eyes filled with intense greed.
They were all thinking if there were no Spirit Grass inside the cave, they would seize the opportunity to claim the cave and then establish a dwelling inside.
That way, they would have a place to settle down.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi’s cultivation remained undisturbed.
His body was continuously undergoing the purification of lightning.
The qualities of his body were also soaring continuously.
After an unknown period of time, he finally absorbed these lightning bolts, and from within his body came crackling sounds, sounding like a gust of wind, emitting crisp noises.
Moreover, he felt that the Spiritual Power inside his body seemed to be more refined than before, as if there was boundless potential to be tapped, and inside his body, a space seemed to vaguely emerge.
Within this space, a vast amount of Spiritual Energy was surging.
The Spiritual Pearl was floating inside.
The Spiritual Pearl emitted a dazzling and striking radiance, and around it, a large amount of thunder roamed, transforming into small snakes constantly burrowing into the Spiritual Pearl.
"Buzz~"
At this moment, deep within Lin Yi’s mind, his Primordial Spirit suddenly began to tremble violently.
That Primordial Spirit was also spinning crazily, as if drawing the power of the thunder, causing the Primordial Spirit to continuously grow and expand.
"What’s going on? What’s happening?"
Lin Yi stared at the changes occurring to his Primordial Spirit in astonishment.
He could clearly feel the rapid growth of his Primordial Spirit, his strength was also continuously increasing, even those thunderbolts were being drawn to him, turning into threads and strands, being absorbed into the body of his Primordial Spirit.
Lin Yi felt incredibly shocked.
"Could it be that all those thunderbolts have been absorbed by me?"
Lin Yi secretly speculated.
Though Lin Yi had never tried it personally, he could feel that his Physical Body was becoming increasingly robust after absorbing those thunderbolts!
Moreover, this was just the beginning; as Lin Yi continued to absorb the thunderbolts, his strength kept increasing.
His Physical Body was becoming stronger and more stable.
Gradually, his Primordial Spirit was also continuously strengthening.
Lin Yi could feel his Primordial Spirit becoming stronger, increasingly approaching Perfection, more consolidated, and more powerful.
He felt like he had truly transformed into a Martial Artist at the Ninefold Perfection of the Innate Realm.
"How terrifying! What is happening?"
Lin Yi felt secretly horrified, realizing that his current strength was much stronger than before.
Moreover, his current Primordial Spirit was several times larger and thicker than before.
The power of his Primordial Spirit had also become even more vast and robust.
"Rumble!"
Suddenly, Lin Yi heard a loud noise, and his Primordial Spirit suddenly opened its eyes.
In his eyes, a brilliant light was flickering.
"Boom!"
At that moment, a massive pit suddenly exploded beneath the cave, forming a mushroom cloud.
"Hmm?"
Seeing this pit, Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat, and his expression instantly darkened, "Could it be that the cultivation process has drawn some powerful beings here?"
With a thought, Lin Yi leaped down to the pit to closely observe and see exactly what was going on.
This pit did not seem like an accident, but rather like people were fighting fiercely, making such a loud noise.
"There’s a fight here? Who could it be? Could it be that someone has discovered this mountain range?"
Lin Yi was somewhat surprised. Considering the vast number of Demon Beasts in this area, if it were discovered that someone was cultivating here, it would definitely be a disaster. Those Demon Beasts would surely attack furiously, causing extensive destruction and eventually causing the entire mountain to collapse!
This place was a vein of Spiritual Energy; nothing serious should happen here.
Lin Yi searched the nearby area, finding no special traces, and eventually gave up the search, continuing his own practice.
Anxiety started to build in Lin Yi’s heart.
His strength was continuously climbing; if discovered, that would be troublesome as the secret would no longer be safe.
He needed a quiet environment for cultivation now, not wishing to be disturbed by anyone.
Therefore, he needed to enhance his strength as quickly as possible.
Just then, the tribulation thunder on the Spiritual Pearl gradually dissipated, and the Primordial Energy within the Primordial Spirit became even more profound.

chapters.title: Chapter 903 - 923: Feeling Somewhat Relieved
chapters.content:
Chapter 903: Chapter 923: Feeling Somewhat Relieved
His Primordial Spirit seemed much stronger now.
His Physical Body had become even more powerful.
His bones had become tougher as well.
"Phew, it seems that I have cultivated for too long, causing my Physical Body and bones to transform; my Physical Body has now become much stronger than before."
A smile emerged on Lin Yi’s face, feeling quite pleased in his heart.
His Physical Body and bones had become even stronger, and far more robust than before, making it difficult even for Martial Artists of the same tier to crush his body.
His body was now no less inferior to a common Martial Artist at the Second Layer of the Innate Realm.
"Hmm? What’s this?"
Suddenly, Lin Yi’s gaze fell onto the Blood Pool on his chest and his expression subtly changed. He could feel the power of the Blood Pool steadily weakening.
"No way? This Blood Pool has been absorbed by my Physical Body?"
Lin Yi’s eyes widened in shock.
He had never imagined that the Blood Pool could be absorbed.
This Blood Pool was a peculiar existence. Whether it was Human Clan Cultivators or Demon Cultivators, as long as they consumed this Blood Pool, they could absorb the power within it, enhance their Cultivation, and temper their bodies.
Yet, Lin Yi had absorbed this peculiar existence!
"Does this Blood Pool also have this function?"
Lin Yi exclaimed in astonishment, feeling his strength seemingly become even more domineering!
"No wonder those Martial Artists all want to enter this Blood Pool to cultivate."
"Only, I just absorbed a little bit of the power from this Blood Pool, and my Physical Body has already become so powerful. If other people were to absorb the power of this Blood Pool, wouldn’t they become even more terrifying?"
Lin Yi’s mind stirred, feeling somewhat relieved that he hadn’t absorbed the power of this Blood Pool earlier.
Otherwise, his strength would definitely have seen an explosive increase!
Moreover, his Primordial Spirit inside his body would have gained a great enhancement!
Lin Yi’s Physical Body had become many times stronger than before!
"No, this amazing thing, I must take it back and let others know."
Lin Yi thought to himself, preparing to leave.
He had not walked far when he suddenly heard a clamor of noisy sounds.
"Run fast! The demon beast has come out!"
"Demon beast? What demon beast, run for your life, this is a tier-three demon beast!"
"Tier-three demon beast, what is that like? How could we possibly be its match, let’s just run for our lives, or we’ll be eaten by the demon beast!"
"We must not let the demon beast chase us down, or we will surely die without a place to be buried!"
"Run faster!"
"..."
The cries of these demon beasts sounded extremely frantic.
Lin Yi was somewhat astonished and stopped, looking towards the distance, only to see a surprising scene!
A huge bear, with its hands on its back, was walking slowly across the valley.
On the back of the bear, there rode a young man.
"It’s actually this young man!"
Lin Yi’s pupils constricted, his heart stirring up a huge commotion.
Lin Yi knew this person!
"Lin Yu! It’s actually Lin Yu! He has also entered this valley and is even riding the bear; how did he manage to do it? How dare he ride this demon beast into this valley!"
Lin Yi was surprised, a towering rage surging in his heart!
Lin Yu, his senior apprentice brother, was Lin Yi’s nemesis.
And now, Lin Yu had actually come riding such a powerful demon beast, how could he not be furious?
Lin Yi remembered Lin Yu’s performance at the Myriad Immortal Sect, his rage intensifying.
His teeth clenched tightly, wishing he could rush over and slay Lin Yu!
But he also knew that with his current strength, he was no match for Lin Yu.
"Damn it!"
"Lin Yu, Lin Yu, you and I are irreconcilable, I want you to pay the price!" Lin Yi clenched his fists, roaring in his heart.
During this time, Lin Yu’s performance in the Myriad Immortal Sect was truly shocking.
His strength had also qualitatively improved with the increase in his cultivation.
Moreover, his status within the sect had skyrocketed.
Among the sect disciples, his status had already surpassed the Great Elder and the head senior brother Li Xuan, becoming the right-hand man of the Sect Master.
In front of the Sect Master and Supreme Elder, Lin Yu also had significant say.
And his master was the grandson of the Myriad Immortal Sect’s Sect Master!
Within the Myriad Immortal Sect, there were few who dared to provoke him!
Yet Lin Yi repeatedly targeted Lin Yu, causing Lin Yu to harbor deep resentment towards him, wishing he could tear Lin Yi into pieces and scatter his ashes!
Moreover, the crucial point was that Lin Yu’s cultivation speed was too fast; in just one month, he had left Lin Yi far behind.
"Lin Yu!"
Lin Yi gritted his teeth, his killing intent toward Lin Yu growing stronger and stronger.
"Lin Yu, just you wait!"
Lin Yi swore secretly in his heart.
However, he did not act impulsively and instead hid himself, quietly observing Lin Yu.
Lin Yu’s expression was gloomy, and he was in a very bad mood.
He originally thought that with the rapid improvement in his cultivation, his status in the Myriad Immortal Sect would also rise, but he didn’t expect that Lin Yi’s cultivation would surpass his, leaving him even further behind!
Lin Yi was a heaven-defying genius, possessing incredible resources and with the aid of a treasure, his cultivation speed was nothing short of terrifying!
Lin Yu felt extremely frustrated.
He initially thought that with his talent, he could be considered first-rate within the Myriad Immortal Sect, but now, he was thoroughly distanced by Lin Yi.
Lin Yu felt extremely depressed and after thinking for a long time, he finally decided to create trouble for Lin Yi.
That day, he walked out of seclusion with a very unpleasant mood.
He was going to cause trouble for Lin Yi.
He wanted Lin Yi to know that he, Lin Yu, was not inferior to Lin Yi.
In his heart, Lin Yi was just an ant, the dust beneath his feet!
Lin Yu, accompanied by his giant bear demon beast, walked toward the entrance of this cave.
"Boom!"
The giant bear demon beast, with its heavy steps, set foot in the cave, causing a thunderous rumble.
With a "bang," the door of the cave was smashed open.
"Roar!"
The giant bear roared, bellowing towards the sky.
Its deep and powerful roar resonated out, causing the whole mountain to shake violently.
"Spurt!"
"Spurt!"
As the bear roared, the spectating demon beasts were all injured by the shock, spitting out fresh blood, their faces pale as they quickly fled.
The bear opened its mouth wide, releasing rolling black mist.
As the black mist spread, every demon beast transformed into chunks of flesh and blood, disappearing within the mist.
The bear’s form was faintly visible within the black mist.
"Roar!"
Another deep roar echoed, and the black mist quickly condensed into the phantom of a giant bear, roaring and tumbling within the mist as if it could tear the very heavens and earth apart.
"Is this the Demon King? Truly extraordinary. Although I have also cultivated to the Human Dan Realm, I am no match for a true Demon King and could probably only flee."
Lin Yi was horrified, his heart filled with fear.
"Roar!"
The bear roared, emitting a terrifying aura, sweeping towards all directions, causing the surrounding demon beasts to frantically dodge.
"Roar!"
The bear roared again, issuing another furious shout, charging directly into the cave.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s face turned pale, wanting to flee, yet unwilling to give up.

chapters.title: Chapter 904 - 924: A Once-in-a-Thousand-Year Opportunity!
chapters.content:
Chapter 904: Chapter 924: A Once-in-a-Thousand-Year Opportunity!
"No, I will not give up just like this, I absolutely won’t let go of this once-in-a-thousand-year opportunity! This is a Demon King, if I can catch a big fish, I will definitely become an extremely formidable Demon King!"
Lin Yi gritted his teeth, his eyes squinting slightly, a hint of ruthlessness and decisiveness gleaming in his gaze.
Immediately afterward, Lin Yi followed the huge bear’s figure, rushing towards the cave, while releasing his Soul to meticulously investigate.
"The aura of this giant bear, it’s actually much weaker than that giant bear. Could it be just pretending to be a Demon King?"
"Impossible! If the aura of this bear is weaker than that giant bear, then its cultivation should be much stronger than the giant bear!"
Lin Yi shook his head, dismissing this guess.
He dared not be careless; he must quickly ascertain the true strength of this demon beast, otherwise, once he falls into a disadvantage, he would die miserably, or even perish!
Lin Yi followed the giant bear into the cave, his body leapt, jumping into the cave, landing on the bears’ shoulder.
He lay on the bear’s back, advancing forward, heading deeper into the belly of the mountain.
He moved through the cave very cautiously, as if on thin ice.
He knew that if he were discovered by the giant bear, he would be doomed.
Lin Yi’s face was extremely pale, his forehead covered in sweat, his heart pounding incessantly, his heart almost in his throat, afraid that one careless move might alert the bear, resulting in his death.
Lin Yi dared not be negligent.
The bear’s steps were steady, and its speed was fast. He quickly caught up, following the bear deeper into the belly of the mountain.
The belly of the mountain was vast and empty.
The space here was also huge, about several hundred meters wide and more than three hundred meters long.
In this belly of the mountain, there were many rocks, these rocks emitting a faint spiritual energy, attracting Lin Yi, wanting to absorb them into his body.
"So many Spiritual Medicines, it seems that this mountain range contains rich Spiritual Medicines, I wonder if there could be a Millennium Snow Ginseng!" Lin Yi was secretly delighted, his gaze sweeping across the entire mountain range.
His Divine Sense enveloped the mountain range, searching for the positions of those Spiritual Medicines.
His Divine Sense covered a wide range, and soon he locked onto the center of the mountain range, within a giant tree.
This giant tree was more than thirty meters tall, crystal clear and translucent as if carved from beautiful jade, emitting a soft and warm glow, releasing bursts of fragrance that greatly stimulated the appetite.
On this giant tree, there was a fruit that emitted a dazzling light, exuding a rich aroma of Spiritual Medicine.
"That is a Millennium Snow Ginseng, it’s just a pity it hasn’t fruited yet, otherwise, it would certainly be an ancient ginseng." Lin Yi thought secretly.
Next to the Millennium Snow Ginseng, there was a large vat filled with pitch-black liquid, which emitted a strong medicinal fragrance, making anyone who smelled it tremble.
"What a rich aroma of Spiritual Medicine, truly worthy of being a Millennium Spiritual Medicine, possessing such a powerful aura!"
Lin Yi was excited, unable to help exclaiming, his eyes shining.
Millennium Snow Ginseng, a sacred product for cultivating Martial Arts, enhancing one’s cultivation, and replenishing Yuan Force, was a rare find.
Now that a Millennium Snow Ginseng was discovered here, how could Lin Yi not be amazed?
However, though his heart was excited, he still did not recklessly approach to pick it, but quietly stared at the Millennium Snow Ginseng from a distance, preparing to make his move when the opportunity arose.
"This Millennium Snow Ginseng is definitely invaluable, if I can get it, I can refine it into an Elixir to consume, enhancing my cultivation, and undoubtedly ensuring victory against Lin Hao!"
Lin Yi’s eyes sparkled, filled with excitement.
Following that, Lin Yi continued to follow the giant bear forward, incessantly exploring ahead, looking for the location of the Millennium Snow Ginseng.
"Hm?"
Just at that moment, his body suddenly paused.
"This aura!"
Lin Yi was shocked, suddenly lifting his head to look ahead, his expression changing slightly, a look of astonishment in his eyes.
In front of him, five figures appeared.
These five figures were five middle-aged men, each of their cultivation at the Mahayana Realm.
Lin Chen, Lin Peng, Lin Ao, Lin Tianlong.
"Five Demon Kings from the Demon Race?!"
Lin Yi looked at the five middle-aged men, his expression turned solemn, and his heart raced with a sudden sense of crisis.
"How do I handle this?"
"I’m no match for them!"
"Their strength is too overpowering!"
Lin Yi’s heart pounded with fear, he didn’t dare to linger and immediately turned to run.
But as soon as he turned around, a giant bear with a huge frame pounced in front of him, blocking his way.
"Roar!"
The giant bear roared, emitting a deafening sound, its large eyes like copper bells staring at Lin Yi.
"It’s over."
"There’s no escape."
Lin Yi bitterly smiled, a trace of despair appeared on his face, but he refused to accept his fate.
"If I can’t escape, then I’ll fight! I really want to see what kind of skills the united Demon Kings of the five Demon Races can muster!"
Lin Yi’s heart flickered with cold fury, his eyes filled with a fierce look, ready to face death.
"Roar!"
"Roar!"
"Roar!"
The giant bear let out several angry roars, as if urging Lin Yi to hurry up and attack him.
"Fine! Even if it means fighting with my life on the line, I have to take the chance!" Lin Yi gritted his teeth, his eyes flashing with determination, he took a deep breath, mobilized the Spiritual Energy in his body, operated his Cultivation Technique, clenched his fists tight, his body surfaced with a layer of purple-gold brilliance, appearing extremely dominant and violent.
"Boom boom boom!"
He stepped on the void, his figure sweeping out like an arrow, instantly reaching the giant bear.
"Roar!"
"Bang!"
The two spirit beasts collided, emitting a dull sound, Lin Yi threw a punch, striking the giant bear’s chest.
But to his astonishment, his full-force punch did not inflict any damage to the giant bear!
"How is this possible?!"
Shock appeared on Lin Yi’s face.
He felt that even a Transforming Divine Cultivator struck by his full punch would be blown away or even explode, dying completely.
Yet this giant bear remained unharmed, its body emitting a strong Blood Fiend Aura, chilling to the bone.
"How could this be?" Lin Yi frowned.
"Roar!"
The giant bear opened its mouth and spewed out a fireball, the fireball rolled with intense heat, burning a hole in the void and blasted towards Lin Yi.
"Damn, this giant bear’s flames are so formidable!"
Lin Yi felt the scorching heat, his face showing a grave expression.
He swiftly dodged to the left, simultaneously twisting his body, and threw a fierce kick at the giant bear’s ribs.
"Bang!"
The giant bear remained motionless, swatting with a palm.
Lin Yi’s face dramatically changed, he swiftly sidestepped, narrowly avoiding the hit.
"Ow!"
The giant bear slapped again, aiming at Lin Yi.
This time Lin Yi couldn’t avoid it, and was directly smacked flying, crashing into the mountain wall, blood spewing from his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 905 - 925: An Extremely Unsightly Expression
chapters.content:
Chapter 905: Chapter 925: An Extremely Unsightly Expression
"Damn it!"
Lin Yi cursed inwardly, his expression extremely unsightly.
"No way! I must find a way to escape this valley!"
Gritting his teeth, Lin Yi’s face was gloomy as he pondered a way to break free from the valley.
Just then, footsteps approached from ahead.
"Roar!"
Those five Demon Cultivators of the Demon Race, Demon Kings, had already caught up.
The strength of these Demon Kings was incredibly formidable; each one of them exuded an intense and fierce aura, like War Gods descending to the mortal realm.
These five Demon Kings, tall and brawny, each over three meters in height, all radiated an overpowering demonic aura, their presence shaking the heavens.
Behind them followed a group of people, all Human Clan Cultivators, with the lowest among them at the sixth layer of the Tribulation Crossing Realm, and the highest at the seventh layer.
These five Demon Cultivators, all at the eighth layer of the Tribulation Crossing Realm, were a total of seven people, all with considerable strength, top experts among the Human Clan.
These seven Demon Kings, all clad in suits of Gold armor, draped in Gold battle robes, carrying giant war spears on their backs, emitted an aura of murderous intent, akin to War Gods descending, with an awe-inspiring presence that struck fear into the heart.
"Haha, finally caught you."
"You think running into the valley could keep you safe? Dream on! Today, you are destined not to escape!"
"Today is the day you die!"
"Just wait obediently for death!"
The five Demon Kings all had ferocious smiles, their eyes filled with cruelty and savagery.
"You five beasts, I will send you all to Hell!" Lin Yi’s eyes were blood-red as he bellowed furiously.
"Humph!"
"An ant dares to talk big?"
"Die, human ant!"
The five Demon Kings sneered in unison, their faces cold as ice, a chilling murderous light flashing in their eyes.
"Die!"
"Perish!"
Lin Yi’s eyes flashed with a piercing killing intent, he shouted loudly, feet propelling off the ground, his figure leapt up instantly, like an arrow unleashed from its bow, charging out at an astonishing speed, reaching one of the Demon Kings in the blink of an eye.
"Bang!"
Lin Yi clenched his fists tightly, smashing down fiercely on the Demon King’s belly, sending the Demon King stumbling back several meters, Gold armor splitting open with several cracks, blood drenching his armor, in immense pain.
"Pugh!"
The Demon King spat out blood, his face pale and filled with shock.
His abdomen had been shattered by Lin Yi’s punch, his intestines and stomach pulverized, his bones broken in many places, his entire figure looking utterly miserable and chilling to behold.
"You... you dare to ambush me, you’re courting death!" The Demon King clutched his stomach and cursed.
But before the Demon King could finish speaking, Lin Yi threw another punch, like a cannonball, directly exploding the Demon King’s head, obliterating his Nascent Soul into dust.
In one move, he killed a ninth-level Tribulation Crossing Realm Demon King.
Lin Yi’s eyes were bloodshot, a towering killing intent lurking in their depths.
"Die! Die!"
"All of you go die!"
His eyes a deep red, his body emanating a murderous and combative aura, punching out one by one, annihilating them all, even obliterating their Nascent Souls, leaving no bones or corpses behind.
Such a scene was cruel and violent, making one’s skin crawl.
Lin Yi, like a Demon God, delivered death with each punch, killing all surrounding Demon Cultivators one after another, splattering flesh and blood everywhere.
Lin Yi’s silhouette, like a sharp sword, swept through everything, utterly invincible.
Throughout the journey, no Demon Cultivator could stand in his way for half a step; all were annihilated with a single punch from him.
In just a moment, he had broken into the ranks of the Demon Cultivators, unleashing a massacre, his presence domineering and unstoppable.
"Ah, help me, save me!"
"Spare my life, don’t kill me, I know I’m wrong!"
"Spare my life!"
The Demon Cultivators screamed in terror, souls scattered and in disarray, fleeing in all directions, desperate to escape from Lin Yi, but it was all in vain as he relentlessly slayed them, their Nascent Souls also perishing miserably.
"Ah, save me, save me!"
"Save me!"
While chasing down the Demon Cultivators, Lin Yi cried out.
But, not a single Demon King came forth to aid them.
For they had already recognized the futility of the situation, with no possible way to save their own kin.
Lin Yi’s combat power was too fearsome. Even if they were to band together, they wouldn’t stand a chance against him.
Moreover, Lin Yi had a special identity, a disciple of the Demon Emperor’s heritage, with an extraordinary status that not even the Demon Kings, let alone the Demon Emperor, would dare to offend easily.
"Kill!"
Lin Yi, like a ferocious tiger pouncing on the Demon Kings, swung his fists. With each punch thrown, it was like twin dark suns radiating boundless light.
Bang Bang!
His fists struck out in a barrage, each blow containing overwhelming power that made the very void tremble.
Fist imprints shot out like black suns, engulfing the Demon Cultivators within, causing them to wail miserably as they were obliterated into clouds of blood mist by the black sun, leaving no Nascent Soul or Demon Core behind.
In the blink of an eye, Lin Yi had slaughtered nearly a hundred Demon Kings, filling the group with bone-chilling terror and fear.
They had intended to capture this young man of the Human Clan, but instead, they were being cut down by him, effortlessly resolved with a single move, triggering a sense of deadly crisis that chilled them to the core.
"Run! Run for your lives!"
"He’s too powerful, we are no match for him."
The Demon Kings, panicked and disordered, hastened to activate Demon Instruments, Immortal Talismans, and various divine skills and secret techniques, attempting to make a distant escape.
"Think you can run? Too late!"
Lin Yi snorted coldly, dancing his fists and releasing a series of terrifying shadows, like meteors falling, like asteroids crashing through the void, obliterating all the fleeing Demon Kings without mercy.
His combat power was simply too formidable; a punch for each, leaving almost no Demon Cultivator capable of withstanding his might.
The group of Demon Kings was wiped out by him one by one, none escaped; all were smashed into meat patties, their terrible deaths staining the skies red, making one’s scalp tingle.
"Ding! Congratulations, the host has slain the Demon Cultivators of the Sevenfold Heaven and has been rewarded with 50,000 Merit Points!"
"Ding! Congratulations, the host has leveled up to the Peak of the Ninth Level of the Tribulation Crossing Realm!"
"Ding! The host has successfully leveled up!"
Lin Yi’s strength had broken through to the Tribulation Crossing Realm, reaching the Peak of the Ninth Level.
Lin Yi’s body surface shimmered with a purple-gold radiance, as if it were glazed, dazzling and brilliant.
Furthermore, within his eyes danced purple-gold flames, akin to the Purple Gold Divine Phoenix, sacred beyond measure.
"Finally leveled up."
"Now I am a great demon at the Peak of the Ninth Level of the Tribulation Crossing Realm."
Lin Yi grinned with pleasure, his heart pounding fiercely, his skin crystal clear, emitting a faint purple-gold glow, like a supreme Divine Weapon sparkling with radiance, both sacred and domineering.
Additionally, his bones became even sturdier and stronger, as if forged from divine iron, brimming with terrifying power, and within each bone seemed to hide a star, radiating endless starlight, dizzyingly brilliant.
"Haha, what a thrill!"
"Who would have thought I could ascend from the Eighthfold Heaven of Tribulation Crossing to the Ninefold Heaven!"
Lin Yi laughed heartily to the sky, feeling extremely refreshed.
Although he had ascended from the Eighth to the Ninefold Heaven of Tribulation Crossing, he felt no excitement or agitation, but rather a sense of disheartened loss.

chapters.title: Chapter 906 - 926: No Sign of Any Progress
chapters.content:
Chapter 906: Chapter 926: No Sign of Any Progress
Because he felt the weakness of his own cultivation, there was no sign of any progress.
Lin Yi knew that he was still far from transcending the Ninefold Heaven and needed a higher level.
With a thought, Lin Yi immersed his mind into the storage ring of the system and carefully examined it.
At this moment, there was a jade token in his storage ring, which sealed more than two thousand low-grade spirit stones, along with some keys from ancient relics.
This jade token, notably obtained from that temple, was a low-grade divine artifact jade token, a defensive magical treasure capable of withstanding a strike from a Ninth Level great demon, and could also automatically collect treasures.
Besides, the spiritual liquid in the jade token was also plentiful, enough to supply Lin Yi for a hundred thousand years.
After examining the jade token, with a thought, Lin Yi’s mind immersed into the low-grade divine artifact jade token to carefully inspect the treasures inside, wanting to know what other treasures could help him break through his bottleneck and step into the Ninefold Heaven.
"Hmm?!"
However, after his consciousness penetrated inside, he suddenly felt an immense power, like a primordial colossal dragon, coiling in his sea of consciousness.
That power was vast, like the power of the Heavenly Dao, and also like some mysterious and unfathomable rule.
In Lin Yi’s sea of consciousness, it was as if a mountain was pressing down, nearly making it hard for him to breathe, and he collapsed to the ground.
He felt that mysterious and unfathomable power, causing him to feel astonished and shocked.
"What a terrifying power!"
"Such intense rule power, such pure mysterious rule power, it seems just a wisp of divine sense possesses the might to destroy heavens and obliterate the earth."
"This is a wisp of rule power, is this the mysterious power?"
Lin Yi sensed a familiar taste, which somewhat surprised him.
"No matter what, this must be the mysterious rule power!"
"I can feel it, my soul and spirit are absorbing this mysterious power, it’s the rule power, and it’s the top ranked mysterious power!"
"This power is very magical, it seems it can transform my soul, endowing me with a divine soul, and my soul is becoming stronger and purer."
"However, it seems something is obstructing me, preventing me from continuing to absorb it."
Lin Yi furrowed his brows, feeling that rule power, wanting to absorb it, but unable to do so, he had to give up on absorbing and started to attempt refinement.
Lin Yi immersed his soul into the mysterious power, enticing out that mysterious force to refine and absorb.
However, that mysterious rule power seemed to have its own will, outright refusing Lin Yi’s absorption.
But Lin Yi had a conviction, once he persisted, he could absorb and refine that mysterious power.
"Good, I want to see just what might this mysterious power possess!"
Lin Yi gritted his teeth, merging his mind with the mystical power, refining that mysterious power together.
Boom!
Lin Yi’s soul became like a vast ocean, boundless and immense.
And his body turned into a colossal being, tens of thousands of feet long, hundreds of thousands of feet wide, hundreds of thousands of feet thick, with millions of feet in diameter.
His body was surrounded by countless thundering serpents, with a vast power fluctuating, causing the surrounding void to tremble, seemingly on the brink of shattering at any moment.
This immense power was slowly spreading, sweeping outwards in all directions, submerging the entire valley in thunder and storm.
Lin Yi’s physique was crazily growing, becoming more robust and towering. His every pore burst with infinite radiance, with golden-red divine halos swirling out, like a true god descending.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Blasting sounds exploded, deafening, as Lin Yi’s body continually expanded, growing sturdier, resembling an endless black hole devouring everything.
The aura emanating from him grew increasingly terrifying, as if a Demon King descended from the heavens, sweeping across the universe and grinding all living beings into dust.
"Haha! Hahaha!"
"Finally, a breakthrough to the Ninefold Heaven of Tribulation Crossing, I, Lin Yi can now dominate the world!"
Lin Yi excitedly howled to the sky, venting for a moment before calming down again.
"Although my physical body has undergone a transformation, it’s still newly advanced and slightly lacking. I must cultivate diligently and solidify my foundation soon; otherwise, my physical body is still fragile, and the slightest injury could cause it to collapse."
"Fortunately, I still have three drops of Immortal Spring Water that can help me solidify my cultivation realm."
"I must hurry and consume these three drops of Immortal Spring Water to break through to the Second Layer of Tribulation Crossing, and strive to break through to the Fourth Layer soon!"
Lin Yi made up his mind.
He quickly took out a few plants of Immortal Spring Water, held them in the palm of his hand, and crushed them into three drops of golden liquid.
After swallowing these three drops, Lin Yi immediately started to dissolve the mysterious rule power, rapidly tempering his physical body and enhancing his strength.
As time passed, Lin Yi’s physical body became more refined and powerful, his body surfaced with dense blood-red patterns, like billions of ants wriggling, moving under the skin, making him look like a Demon God, daunting to behold.
Lin Yi’s physical body grew stronger, his stature increasingly towering, his entire body covered with dense runes, shining with a mystical luster.
During this time, Lin Yi continually refined the three drops of Immortal Spring Water, tempering his physical body to its utmost.
"These three drops of Immortal Spring Water will allow me to solidify my cultivation to the Peak of the Fifth Layer of Tribulation Crossing within just ten days!"
"If I consume a few more drops, I might break through to the Sixth Layer in just three days!"
Lin Yi felt the surging power within him, and his heart was very excited.
"If anyone knew that I could break through from the Peak of the Fifth Layer to the Sixth Layer of Tribulation Crossing in just ten days, they might drop their jaws in astonishment!"
Lin Yi shook his head, somewhat wistful.
"My current combat power has already surpassed the Peak of the Seventh Layer of Tribulation Crossing, but still, I can’t contend with a Nine-Star Half Emperor, and my physical body is not strong enough compared to one, fearing that I can only match some who have just entered the peak of the Ninth Layer."
"Now, I only have to strive to cultivate diligently, constantly temper myself, enhance my physical body, and once I train my physical body to the peak, even if I encounter the great beings of the Eighth Layer, I can easily defeat them, perhaps even kill them!"
"Furthermore, my Soul Realm has already stepped into the Peak of the Ninth Level of Nascent Soul, with my Soul Power already very strong. If I can elevate my cultivation of the soul to the Perfection Realm of the Ninth Level of Nascent Soul, perhaps I could even slay those great beings at the Early Stage of the Ninth Layer of Tribulation Crossing!"
Lin Yi speculate solemnly, his eyes flickering with confident light.
He had confidence that someday he would be able to stand against those Nine-Star Half Emperors!
This was his dream, his pursuit, what he must achieve in his life.
Moreover, he also knew that in the Ancient Immortal Era, many strong beings possessed cultivation comparable to the peak of the Ninth Layer.
Even some unparalleled great beings transcended the peak of the Ninth Layer, reaching the Seventh Layer, or even the peak of the Ninth Layer.
These beings were the true era-defining powerhouses, the overlords of an era!
Although Lin Yi wasn’t afraid of those era-defining powerhouses, he also understood that he was still far from reaching them and needed to continually strive and press forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 907 - 927: Reached a Whole New Level
chapters.content:
Chapter 907: Chapter 927: Reached a Whole New Level
"My physical body must also put in more effort, striving to advance my Cultivation Realm to the Peak of the Transcending Tribulation Seventh Layer as soon as possible."
Lin Yi murmured to himself, his eyes filled with fiery flames, burning with a fighting spirit.
He harbored an audacious ambition, to break through to that realm!
Although Lin Yi’s Cultivation quickly improved, he was not satisfied with the status quo; he yearned for higher, more formidable power.
At this moment, Lin Yi had set his sights on the Nine-Star Demi-Emperor, and as long as he could raise his Cultivation Realm to the Peak of the Transcending Tribulation Seventh Layer, his power would soar to new heights, reaching an entirely new level!
Lin Yi sat cross-legged on the ground, continuously refining three drops of Immortal Spring Water, enhancing the strength of his physical body and soul, allowing his Cultivation Realm to climb ceaselessly.
This time, Lin Yi’s closed-door training lasted a full three days.
After three days, Lin Yi opened his eyes.
"Hmm? My Cultivation Realm has actually broken through, reaching the Peak of the Transcending Tribulation Fifth Layer."
Lin Yi was somewhat surprised.
His Cultivation had originally broken through to the Peak of the Transcending Tribulation Fifth Layer, but it had been stagnant at this plateau, never having made another breakthrough.
However, this time during his closed-door training, his Cultivation Realm had actually progressed again.
The corners of Lin Yi’s mouth lifted, revealing a radiant smile.
During the three days of closed-door training, he was in a constant state of tension and suppression, fearing any mishaps, but now he breathed a sigh of relief.
His Cultivation had reached the Peak of the Transcending Tribulation Fifth Layer, just one step away from stepping into the realm of the Transcending Tribulation Sixth Layer.
Once reaching the Transcending Tribulation Sixth Layer, even when facing an average Nine-Star Demi-Emperor, he could contend with them without being instantly defeated.
However, he did not give up.
Because his identity had not yet been made public, it was not advisable to fall out with those people just yet, otherwise, he would truly be in great trouble.
"There is only one year left in my lifespan, and in this one year, I must break through to the Transcending Tribulation Sixth Layer and reach the Transcending Tribulation Seventh Layer to completely stabilize the situation."
"If that time comes, I will have the capital to stand up against those great sect elders."
Lin Yi clenched his fists, his eyes fiery with determination.
He silently vowed that this year, he would break through to the Transcending Tribulation Seventh Layer!
In this one year, he intended to step into the Transcending Tribulation Seventh Layer with his Cultivation Realm in one fell swoop.
Lin Yi’s eyes were surging with intense fighting spirit.
Throughout this year, Lin Yi’s physical body also underwent continuous refinement.
This time, Lin Yi’s physical body was greatly enhanced; his physical strength had increased by more than a hundred times than before, so much so that even if a giant mountain fell upon him, he could blast it into smithereens!
The sound of crackling came from his bones, as if tiny arcs of electricity were flickering, causing palpitations.
Within his flesh, streaks of thunder coiled, containing terrifying destructive power.
In this one year, he not only cultivated the Chaotic Immortal Body to the Secondfold Perfection, but he also cultivated the Heavenly Demon Holy Body and the Primordial Holy Body, with the might of both Cultivation Techniques stepping up a notch, becoming much stronger than before!
Now his physical body was comparable to a High Grade Spiritual Artifact, with just one punch he could penetrate a Spiritual Treasure; if he used the Secondfold of the Chaotic Heavenly Demon Body, he could even stand firm against top-tier Spiritual Treasures!
"Truly befitting of the Heavenly Thunder Body, such a physique is indeed formidable. If it weren’t for my possession of the Immortal Sword Body, I probably wouldn’t be able to compete."
Lin Yi was inwardly shocked, astonished by the immense strength of the Heavenly Thunder Body, feeling an immense sense of amazement.
"The Secondfold of the Heavenly Thunder Body, I have already cultivated it to Perfection. I wonder if I can next bring this Secondfold Cultivation Realm to Perfection."
Lin Yi thought to himself, his eyes glittering brightly.
He felt that to reach the perfection of the Secondfold Realm, he just needed a little more opportunity, and then he could successfully cultivate and soar up high, entering an even more profound and enigmatic realm.
"Since that’s the case, let’s give it a try."
Lin Yi made up his mind, ready to attempt breaking through this layer of the realm!
He had already cultivated the Secondfold Realm to the peak of perfection, merely one step away from achieving true perfection.
Yet, this one step was as difficult as ascending to the heavens.
"What exactly does the Secondfold Realm need to breakthrough to the state of perfection? What should I do to make the Secondfold Realm reach perfection?"
Lin Yi fell into deep thought.
"Could it be that I need to find a piece of Immortal Spring Water and consume it?"
An idea suddenly surged in Lin Yi’s mind.
He remembered that the Immortal Spring Water he had previously consumed seemed to contain a rich Immortal Spiritual Power.
"My body possesses an Immortal Pond and Immortal Veins, and the Immortal Spiritual Power within me is extremely vast. I can use that piece of Immortal Spring Water to temper my Immortal Pond and Veins, enhancing the grade of the Immortal Pond. Moreover, the rich Immortal Spiritual Power contained within the Immortal Spirit Liquid can also help me quickly increase the grade of my Immortal Spirit Liquid!"
No sooner had he thought it than he acted, and Lin Yi immediately took out a piece of Immortal Spring Water and swallowed it.
This was the Immortal Spring Water he had obtained from the Immortal Spring Lake, its Immortal Spiritual Power was extremely majestic and vast, not inferior to ordinary Immortal Spring Water, and even stronger!
As he consumed the Immortal Spring Water, streams of thunder and lightning surged within Lin Yi’s body, ferociously bombarding his internal Immortal Spiritual Power.
With these bolts of lightning striking into Lin Yi’s body, pieces of Thunder Lightning Runes emerged on the surface of his body, bursting into a dazzling silver radiance.
These runes were precisely the Thunderbolt Runes.
This surge of Thunderbolt Runes transformed into numerous thunder dragons, rampaging inside his body, roaming within!
Lin Yi’s body surface began to show wisps of black mist; the black mist diffused, enveloping his body as if a malevolent creature lurked within the fog!
The black mist gathered more and more, forming a pitch-black cloud.
And within the pitch-black cloud, slivers of thunder leaped.
Within Lin Yi’s body, a terrifying aura of destruction began to spread.
Soon after, the black mist around Lin Yi dissipated, revealing his figure.
Now wrapped around him were dense and numerous Thunder Lightning Runes, which like black lightning danced and pulsed, emitting terrifying waves that caused the air currents to become rigid, creating a dreadful sense of pressure.
Lin Yi’s skin was crystal clear, sparkling with a golden glow, and upon it, Thunder Lightning Runes danced.
"This is the secondfold of the Heavenly Thunder Body, its might has increased several times from the firstfold, and now my Physical Defense is absolutely one of the most formidable existences!"
Lin Yi inwardly exclaimed in awe.
Now, his Physical Defense was comparable to that of ordinary low-grade Spiritual Artifacts.
"Such Physical Defense, among all the Spiritual Bodies I have seen, should be the strongest!"
Lin Yi remarked with emotion.
"It’s just regrettable that my Physical Body has not yet reached its limit. If I could enhance it a bit further, I’m afraid my Physical Defense would be even more superior, and not even a Spiritual Treasure could harm my body!"
Lin Yi shook his head in regret, somewhat disappointed.
However, he was not in a hurry, after all, his Physical Body had just been enhanced, and he needed time to consolidate.
In the following time, Lin Yi closed himself off for cultivation in his Cultivation Cave Abode.

chapters.title: Chapter 908 - 928: Need Time to Consolidate
chapters.content:
Chapter 908: Chapter 928: Need Time to Consolidate
Cultivating within his Cultivation Cave Abode, he could treat the abode as a sacred cultivation ground, where the speed of his cultivation was much faster than the outside world.
Moreover, by cultivating in the Cultivation Cave Abode, Lin Yi could also absorb the Heaven-Earth Vital Energy from the world, transforming it into immortal power stored within his body, enhancing his immortal power.
While cultivating in the Cultivation Cave Abode, Lin Yi’s cultivation speed was even faster, and his Immortal Spiritual Power had also been greatly replenished.
This situation made him feel extremely excited.
Lin Yi was very happy.
Under his subtle influence, his Immortal Spiritual Power had become increasingly robust, and there was more and more immortal power flowing within him, continuously strengthening his Immortal Spiritual Power.
Cultivating for one day in the Cultivation Cave Abode, his cultivation would see some growth.
This wonderful use of the Cultivation Cave Abode shocked him and felt unbelievable.
However, in his Cultivation Cave Abode, there was no concept of time.
Cultivating for one day in the Cultivation Cave Abode was equivalent to cultivating for one year in the outside world!
In this respect, it is somewhat similar to the Heavenly Thunder Body, both of which involve accelerated time, saving cultivators a lot of time.
However, this effect of time acceleration was not as terrifying as that of the Immortal Stone.
A single Immortal Stone could save three years of cultivation time, which is equivalent to cultivating for thirty days in a year. And it might also amplify a cultivator’s cultivation, advancing their cultivation progress.
Lin Yi’s cultivation speed was not bad, but compared to cultivators with fast cultivation speed, his was still far from the others.
But Lin Yi was not willing to give up just like that.
Cultivating for one day in the Cultivation Cave Abode was equivalent to thirty days in the outside world!
Lin Yi needed to quickly enhance his strength, which required constantly improving his own abilities!
Moreover, in the Immortal Pond, Lin Yi could also obtain a large amount of Celestial Water, which was very beneficial to cultivation.
He now had one hundred thousand drops of water from the Immortal Pond, enough for him to cultivate for an entire day.
And the water from Lin Yi’s Immortal Pond was Celestial Elixir, a heavenly liquid that had been nurtured in the Immortal Pond for billions of years, with an outrageous effect on enhancing strength.
In the Cultivation Cave Abode, Lin Yi absorbed a drop of this Celestial Elixir.
Lin Yi’s Physical Body once again improved, becoming even harder and stronger.
Cultivating in the Immortal Pond greatly replenished the immortal power within his body, and Lin Yi’s strength had also been upgraded to the Intermediate Grade Spiritual Artifact Level, while his Physical Defense reached an ultimate level, which probably even a common High Grade Spiritual Artifact would find hard to injure Lin Yi’s Physical Body!
Now Lin Yi’s Physical Body strength can even withstand a common High Grade Spiritual Artifact.
Not only that, but Lin Yi’s Physical Body also underwent great improvements, becoming even more suited for combat!
Lin Yi felt that the immortal power within him had become even more pure and vigorous, sharp like a precision blade!
Now, at his full explosive force, a single punch from him could directly shatter mountains and rivers!
Lin Yi felt incredibly thrilled; he sensed that his current Physical Defense was strong enough to clash head-on with a common Low Grade Immortal Artifact!
"Haha! My Physical Defense has reached this level now, so my strength will definitely increase greatly!" Lin Yi’s heart surged with excitement.
Lin Yi’s current immortal power was countless times stronger than before!
Lin Yi’s current Physical Defense had already surpassed that of a Supreme Grade Spiritual Artifact.
If Lin Yi were to strike with all his might, he could probably easily penetrate a common Low Grade Spiritual Artifact!
Moreover, Lin Yi’s physique was almost invincible in this world!
Lin Yi’s now Physical Body Power was enough to crush any Semi-Golden Core Peak powerhouse!
In this world, probably only Lin Yi could easily defeat a Semi-Golden Core strong practitioner.
This means that Lin Yi’s combat power could now be considered on par with a Semi-Golden Core!
"If I encounter groups like the Thunder Clan, Fire Clan, and so on again, I would be able to compete with them!"
Joy was written all over Lin Yi’s face.
His objective was clear.
"Now that my realm has stabilized, I can challenge the Immortals. I will seek out Immortal King Level powerhouses, slay them, seize the Immortal King Bloodline inside their bodies, and then successfully refine those bloodlines!" Lin Yi’s eyes glinted with cold light.
Now, Lin Yi’s Physical Defense had reached an extremely terrifying level, to the point where even some of the top Immortal Kings could not harm him, and he had no fear of those half-step into the Golden Core Realm powerhouses.
"Since that’s the case, I too shall strive for the Immortal King, to kill Immortal Emperor Level powerhouses and obtain the Immortal Emperor Bloodline!"
Lin Yi silently resolved in his heart.
Though Lin Yi’s combat strength was terrifying now, he was still in extreme danger.
After all, Lin Yi’s cultivation was merely at the Low Grade Immortal level, and he had just broken through to the Low Grade Immortal level, so his combat strength was definitely not yet stable.
If he encountered Immortal King powerhouses, Lin Yi was not their match at all.
What Lin Yi needed to do was to constantly enhance his combat strength.
"In the time to come, I will stabilize my strength at the Peak state, and then seek a breakthrough!"
Lin Yi’s eyes were full of expectation.
Lin Yi believed that once he broke through the Immortal Level, he would surely be able to sweep across the Immortal Domain.
Moreover, he had already comprehended the Thunder Tribulation Law, and could use the Thunder Tribulation Law to temper his physique, which made his cultivation speed a hundred times faster than normal.
Continuing this way, his Physical Body would surely achieve enormous enhancement.
Next, Lin Yi began to cultivate in the Cultivation Cave Abode.
He sat cross-legged in the cave abode, circulating the Primordial Thunder Emperor Technique, and fiercely absorbed the Spiritual Energy within the cave abode.
Inside the cave abode, immortal power surged like a sea, vast and mighty, enveloping the entire cave abode within it.
Under the nourishment of the immortal power, Lin Yi’s Physical Body underwent a tremendous transformation!
Lin Yi’s physique became even more tenacious and sturdy.
After three days of cultivation in the cave abode, Lin Yi’s Physical Body finally stabilized thoroughly.
His body, as if cast from iron, shone with a golden luster, resembling stars revolving, truly astonishing.
"Now, I can finally use my trump card--Nine Heavens Thunderfall Sword!"
A cold smirk appeared on Lin Yi’s lips, and immediately, he stimulated the Primordial Thunder Emperor Technique, invoking the lightning power within his body.
In an instant, thunder and lightning traversed the void, with thunderous roars resounding through the heavens, deafening to the ear.
"This is the Third Form of the Thunder Emperor Technique: Thunder Tribulation Sword!"
A brilliant and dazzling radiance suddenly burst forth in Lin Yi’s eyes.
Lin Yi formed a Sword Technique with his hands.
Whizz whizz whizz whizz...
A series of piercing sword cries sounded, and streaks of thunder coalesced between heaven and earth within the cave abode.
Lin Yi pointed forward, and the streaks of thunder in the void, like swords, bombarded towards the vast ocean below.
This ocean, penetrated by the thunder, formed numerous bottomless holes.
"Puchi puchi..."
The Thunder Tribulation Sword, piercing afar, split the ocean in two.
One after another, massive black crevices appeared in the void.
Lin Yi manipulated the Sword Technique again.
Whizz whizz whizz...
Streaks of thunder, once more split the sky, cascading toward the vast ocean below.
This time, Lin Yi did not use the thunder to attack the ocean.

chapters.title: Chapter 909 - 929: Don’t Want to Destroy Them
chapters.content:
Chapter 909: Chapter 929: Don’t Want to Destroy Them
The vast ocean was composed of Panthalassic boulders, and amidst these boulders, there were islands embedded within. Lin Yi had no desire to destroy them.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom...
The sounds of explosions resonated from atop these Panthalassic boulders.
Crack after crack appeared on the surface of the boulders, ultimately causing them to explode.
These Panthalassic boulders burst apart, turning into huge pits.
"Boom boom boom!"
Amidst the debris of the massive Panthalassic boulders, Lin Yi charged forward, heading towards the islands below.
Lin Yi’s Thunder Tribulation Sword was infinitely powerful,
Smashing through the Panthalassic boulders with ease, turning one island after another into ruins under its force.
Contained within these Panthalassic boulders were vast Immortal Crystals, veins of precious Immortal Crystal ore, which for Lin Yi, also amounted to a fortune.
Lin Yi took out the Immortal Crystals for cultivation and dug out all the Immortal Crystals from within the Panthalassic boulders, storing everything in his Qiankun Ring.
"You..."
"What?" Lin Yi looked up at the man before him, clad in black leather, tall and handsome.
"Lin Yi, do you know? We’ve known each other since childhood, and I’ve always liked you. You’re the most beautiful and outstanding girl I’ve ever seen."
"I don’t like you."
"I like you."
"I know."
"Then why? You know and yet you still reject me."
"I don’t like you."
"Impossible!"
Lin Yi frowned, looking at the man in front of her like he was crazy: "I really don’t like you, and I don’t owe you an explanation. We have nothing to do with each other, so please stop pestering me."
"Lin Yi, how can you be so heartless? I’ve been so good to you."
"Good? It feels to me like your kindness is only meant to make me into your puppet, right?"
"No, I truly like you."
"Enough!" Lin Yi cut him off, her eyes full of disappointment and pain: "We are siblings; how can you do this?"
"You’re talking nonsense, we have no blood relation, how could I possibly be your brother?"
"Impossible. You’re clearly the bastard child my father had with another woman!"
"You... you dare to slander me!"
"Slander you? Don’t you have any idea in your own heart? Do I need to remind you of how you came into this world?"
"No, impossible!"
"Hmph, whether you believe it or not, in any case, you will always be my sister! I will never accept you!"
"No, I don’t believe it, I don’t believe it."
Lin Yi shook her head and turned to leave.
From childhood, her parents had always protected her well; she had never even experienced what kinship felt like. However, she knew that she wasn’t the only one in the world.
She didn’t want to live a life as miserable as theirs.
Lin Yi descended the stairs step by step. With each step, tears fell.
Parents, what should I do?
Where are you?
I’m so scared.
I don’t want to become like them.
"You whore, it’s all your fault I lost everything!" Just as Lin Yi reached the second floor corner, a woman dressed in a black skirt suit and heavy makeup burst out and slapped Lin Yi across the face.
This woman was very beautiful, with delicate features, especially those watery eyes that seemed to speak, now glaring at Lin Yi as though hating her immensely.
"I don’t know you," Lin Yi said coldly, her eyes cast down.
"Of course, you don’t know me, you are the Lin Family’s illegitimate child! The disgrace of the Lin Family!" The woman pointed at Lin Yi and cursed loudly, "If it weren’t for you, how would I end up so destitute? You whore, I won’t let you off!"
Lin Yi frowned. She knew that her reputation had been utterly ruined these days, all because of those photos.
At the time, she was only thirteen, ill and always home, completely unaware of what was happening outside.
But now she knew, because her father, Lin Wenbo, had sold her to a fat man, ’Boss Wang’, as his mistress.
She dared not tell anyone, including her grandparents.
But that night, after drinking too much, she didn’t know why, she was discovered by that fat man’s people, that man was Boss Wang.
She was terrified and fought desperately, but those men were trained in martial arts, she couldn’t beat them, and in the end, Boss Wang violated her and then sent her to a bar where she was taken advantage of by those men in succession, her body nearly falling apart.
At that moment, she wanted to die but was not willing to give in; she wanted to run, but was pursued by them.
Eventually, she escaped, and Boss Wang couldn’t find her anymore, so she hid by herself.
But one year, two years, three years passed.
In a blink of an eye, seven or eight years went by.
Lin Yi could hardly remember how long she hadn’t returned, but she knew she was completely destroyed.
During these seven or eight years, she waited for the opportunity for revenge. However, she was doomed never to get that chance in this life. Those people had no pity for her, nearly incapacitating her, and Boss Wang had disappeared without a trace.
Later, she picked up a letter on the street; it was from her brother Lin Yi.
The letter only had a simple sentence.
[You are my sister, so you will always be my sister in this life, but do not come looking for me anymore, for your existence is an immense shame to me.]
After reading the letter, Lin Yi cried. For these seven or eight years, the only person who loved and cared for her in this world was her brother. She had never suffered from childhood, but now, she was betrayed by her own brother.
Crying, she ran back home, crying all the way to the Lin Family residence, thinking she couldn’t live like this anymore.
However, there was a car parked at the entrance of the Lin Family. It was her brother Lin Yi’s car. He wasn’t dead; he was still alive and had come back for her.
Lin Yi was stunned to see Lin Yi sitting in the car.
"Yi Yi, I’m back." Lin Yi’s brother looked at her tenderly. "Are you okay?"
Lin Yi shook her head and threw herself into Lin Yi’s arms.
This was the first time she embraced him so recklessly.
"Yi Yi, I know you’ve been wronged, I’m sorry. I didn’t expect those people to be so despicable, laying hands on a girl like that..."
"Brother, I’m okay. I don’t want to live like this anymore. I want to leave here with you, leave this place of heartbreak."
"Okay, then I’ll sell the house first, and we’ll go live abroad." Lin Yi’s brother smiled and stroked Lin Yi’s head. "Yi Yi, I know I owe you an apology, but I had no choice. I don’t want you to follow in my footsteps."
"I understand; I don’t blame you. Let’s leave this place," Lin Yi nodded.
"Mhm, let’s go, and pack up our things at home with me."
"Okay," Lin Yi nodded, following her brother Lin Yi into the car.

chapters.title: Chapter 910 - 930: The Heart Grows Colder and Colder
chapters.content:
Chapter 910: Chapter 930: The Heart Grows Colder and Colder
In the car, Lin Yi remained silent, staring at the scenery passing by the window while her heart grew colder and colder.
Her background had long since spread throughout The Imperial City.
Those who had once bullied and insulted her now dared not come near her, avoiding her from afar whenever they saw her.
The very people who once showed her warmth and affection, indulging and protecting her, had all turned to mockery, contempt, and spitting disdain.
She refused to acknowledge this reality, but facts proved that her suspicions were correct.
Money was the only thing in those people’s eyes; they didn’t care whether she lived or died. She had become their laughingstock; no longer the esteemed young lady surrounded by adulation, but merely an abandoned infant that had been cast aside.
Since then, she had never stepped half a foot into The Imperial City, until she was kidnapped. Only when those people found her did she return.
She knew that if she had not returned to The Imperial City, those people would surely have continued to torment her.
She didn’t want to continue living like that anymore.
She had always thought herself lucky, but in this lifetime, she had never met a man who truly loved her. Perhaps this was her only chance at happiness in this life.
She had already lost everything; she couldn’t bear the pain of losing him as well.
Hence, she had decided to leave with Lin Yi and go abroad.
Throughout the journey, she didn’t say much, but Lin Yi could read from her expression that she seemed preoccupied, so he too remained silent.
He knew that his sister must have suffered greatly, which was why she was so upset. He hoped to help her through this tough time and give her a better life.
Lin Yi’s brother was a very intelligent man. He sensed Lin Yi’s feelings for him and had always tried to be good to her, hoping that one day she would reciprocate his feelings. However, his efforts didn’t seem to win Lin Yi’s favor; instead, Lin Yi seemed to be avoiding him.
But he didn’t mind because he loved her, and he was willing to wait.
Finally, the car stopped at the entrance of a residential area. Lin Yi’s brother took Lin Yi by the hand and led her into the complex. They hadn’t walked far when Lin Yi caught sight of a familiar figure.
Lin Yi was shocked and quickly let go of her brother’s hand, looking over her shoulder, but she saw nothing.
Lin Yi’s brother turned around puzzled, then looked in the direction Lin Yi was gazing, but he too saw nothing.
"Yi Yi, what’s wrong?" Lin Yi’s brother asked worriedly.
"Nothing," Lin Yi turned back and forced a smile, "I’m hungry."
"Alright, let’s go eat. I’ll take you to a nice place."
"Sure." Lin Yi’s brother smiled and ruffled her hair, leading her towards the elevator.
As Lin Yi stood next to the elevator, waiting for it to descend, her gaze fixated on the elevator doors. She silently counted the time until it reached the basement level, where she saw the familiar figure appear and then walk in another direction.
Lin Yi’s complexion turned instantly pale; her heart felt as if it had plunged into an ice cellar.
"Yi Yi, what are you looking at?" her brother inquired upon noticing her behavior.
"Nothing, let’s go. Let’s go eat," she said.
Lin Yi took her brother’s hand and headed towards the restaurant.
At the dining table, Lin Yi kept her head down and continued to eat. Her brother noticed her demeanor and couldn’t help but feel concerned.
"Yi Yi, what’s wrong? Has someone upset you?" he asked softly.
"No, nobody’s upset me," Lin Yi hurriedly explained.
