"Really? Nothing?"
"Yes!" Lin Yi nodded vigorously.
"Then why are you suddenly unhappy?" Lin Yi’s brother inquired.
"Because you said you’d come to the UK with me, you know what? This is my second time running away from home!"
"Sorry, it’s my fault, brother won’t leave you behind again." Lin Yi clenched Weiwei’s hand tightly and said.
"Mhm, I don’t want to leave you either." Weiwei nodded and said.
After the two finished their meal, they headed straight for the airport.
Weiwei was restless all the way. She prayed the whole time, hoping not to be caught, hoping not, otherwise, she would have to live a life on the run again.
The plane landed in London, and Lin Yi and her brother waited at the exit gate.
"Let’s go."
"Okay."
Weiwei and her brother, carrying their luggage, walked out of the passageway. Just as they were about to head towards the exit, suddenly a few burly men in black closed in on them.
"What do you want?" Lin Yi’s brother stepped in front of Weiwei and asked.
Weiwei was trembling with nervousness, daring not to move.
"Pretty girl, running away from a wedding with your brother?" one of the brutes leered at Weiwei.
"Scram!" Lin Yi’s brother yelled at the man.
"Boy, who do you think you are? Daring to tell me to scram?" With that, he raised his hand as if to slap Weiwei.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s brother quickly pushed the man’s hand away and rushed forward, starting a fight with him.
The two wrestled, but Lin Yi’s brother clearly had the upper hand, after all, he had five years of training and was much stronger than the average person.
Lin Yi’s brother’s fists, raining down like torrential drops on those thugs.
In a moment, the thugs were lying on the ground, wailing incessantly.
Lin Yi’s brother looked at the fallen thugs with great satisfaction.
"What are you standing there for? Take them back!" Lin Yi’s brother ordered.
"Yes, young master." A bodyguard immediately ran forward and carried the thugs away.
"Yi Yi, are you alright? Are you hurt?" Lin Yi’s brother asked, supporting Weiwei.
"I’m fine, thank you, brother."
"Silly." Lin Yi’s brother said affectionately as he ruffled Weiwei’s hair and led her towards a taxi.
When Weiwei got home, her mother rushed to greet them as she saw Lin Yi’s brother return, anxiously asking, "Yi Yi, are you okay?"
"Mom, don’t worry, I’m fine. You and dad should go rest first, I want to be alone for a while."
"All right, you should go to sleep early; your father and I are going to bed." Weiwei’s mother said, looking at Weiwei.
"Mhm, good night."
After Weiwei’s mother left, Weiwei immediately sat on the couch, took out her phone and dialed a number. A smile appeared on her face, "Hello, may I ask if..."
"It’s me." Lin Yi’s brother spoke up.
"Lin Yi? You’re back, that’s great. Do you have any idea how worried your mommy has been? She’s been thinking about you every day. She wakes up from crying every night, then asks me where you’ve gone. I say you’re in America; she asks when you will return?" Lin Yi’s brother spoke as he walked towards the kitchen.
"I know, I know mommy worries about me, so I came back early."
"I thought you were never coming back. You child, you couldn’t even call home to let us know."
"I didn’t want to worry you."
"Well, since you’re back, that’s good. Take some time to rest at home, and once you recover from your injuries, you can go back to work. No matter what job you do, your father and I support you, don’t feel burdened, okay?" Lin Yi’s brother said tenderly.

chapters.title: Chapter 911 - 931: There Is Always Some Resistance
chapters.content:
Chapter 911: Chapter 931: There Is Always Some Resistance
"Mm." Lin Yi responded gently yet felt incredibly conflicted inside.
Although she knew her biological brother was a good person, for some reason, she always felt a sense of resistance, even fear.
Because her biological mother had once betrayed her father, and that was a fact that could never be changed.
Lin Yi and her brother talked on the phone for a long time before she reluctantly hung up.
She looked out at the nighttime scenery from the window, tears fell uncontrollably and landed on her fingertips. She quickly wiped them away, not wanting him to see her weakness.
The next day, when Lin Yi came out of her room, her brother and their mother were already waiting for her downstairs.
"Yi Yi, we’re leaving first. There’s a lot to deal with at the company. We’ll come back to keep you company in the evening."
"Oh, okay, goodbye."
Lin Yi saw them off and returned to the living room to sit on the sofa.
Suddenly, she felt that she might have been a little too much lately. She was indeed his most beloved sister, yet she had never done anything for him, only causing him trouble by needing his care.
With that thought, Lin Yi couldn’t help but laugh at herself mockingly. Lin Yi, what are you really expecting? Don’t you hate them? Why still long for their care?
"Lin Yi, are you awake? Come down and eat quickly," Lin Yi’s mother called out as she saw Lin Yi coming downstairs.
Lin Yi glanced at the lavish spread on the table and frowned: "Mom, did you buy all this first thing in the morning?"
"Of course! Do you think it fell from the sky?" Lin Yi’s mother said with a laugh.
"..." Lin Yi was speechless, simply nodded and then sat down at the table to eat.
After eating, Lin Yi’s brother drove her away from the Lin Family home.
"Yi Yi, you’re not coming back tonight?" her brother asked while driving.
"Mm."
"Okay then." Her brother sighed. "Just make sure you stay safe, remember to call home to check in, and don’t drink too much."
"Don’t worry, Brother, I’ll be fine," Lin Yi said with a smile.
"Mm, alright then, I’ll be off first." Having said that, her brother drove away from the Lin Family residence.
Watching the direction her brother left in, Lin Yi’s mind couldn’t help but conjure up the image of that black Maybach.
In this world, other than her brother, perhaps only that car could match his temperament, right?
But she didn’t like that car, never thought about wanting it, especially since she had personally given it to someone else.
"Lin Yi, no matter what you become, you will always be my most precious sister. I hope that we can always be friends," Lin Yi said to herself silently.
Lin Yi returned to her room, freshened up, and changed into a simple t-shirt and jeans.
She tied her hair up into a ponytail, then wound it into a bun.
Lin Yi’s skin was naturally fair, and with a ponytail, she looked remarkably delicate.
Ready to go, Lin Yi left the house to look for a job. She couldn’t keep relying on her brother’s support. She didn’t want him to feel guilty, so she decided to find a formal job to make up for what she owed Lin Yi.
Walking on the street, Lin Yi started to worry. She didn’t know any formal jobs, nor did she know any cultured teachers or schools. Where should she go to find work?
Lin Yi’s eyes scanned around and then she saw an office building.
Without a second thought, she headed straight for the building, all the while pondering which career she should choose.
"Hey, who are you? Why are you standing at the entrance to the company?" Just as Lin Yi was about to enter the building, a young man in uniform stopped her.
"I, I, I..." Lin Yi suddenly became flustered.
"Hey, don’t panic, explain your situation slowly."
"I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I didn’t mean to stand at the company’s entrance, I came here to look for a job," Lin Yi said frantically.
After hearing Lin Yi’s words, the young man’s face immediately showed a contemptuous expression.
"Looking for a job? A recent university graduate like you, and you’re saying you came here to look for a job? Are you sure you didn’t misspeak?"
"I didn’t misspeak, I’m really here to look for a job," Lin Yi insisted.
The man snorted coldly after hearing this and then said: "If you’re here to scam money, don’t blame me for being unkind."
"I’m not lying to you, I’m just looking for a job," Lin Yi explained.
"Are you sure you’re looking for a legitimate job?" the man asked suspiciously.
"Um."
"Do you have any proof that what you’re saying is true? Let me tell you, our company doesn’t need someone like you. If you’re not capable of the work, you’d better leave!" After saying this, the man started to step back.
"Hey, I really want to find a job, where are my documents? Hurry up and hand over my ID and passport," Lin Yi shouted anxiously.
"Heh, I’ve seen a lot of shameless people, but I’ve never seen someone as brazen as you," the man said with a face full of disdain.
"Please, give me my documents, I really came here to find a job, I’m begging you," Lin Yi pleaded.
"Women like you, I’ve seen plenty, but I’ve never encountered someone as shameless as you, actually coming to my company looking for a job, don’t you feel embarrassed?" the young man said with an angry face.
"I..." Lin Yi didn’t know what to do.
"Alright, alright, you don’t need to say anymore, I absolutely won’t agree to let you join our company."
After finishing, he turned and left.
"Ah..."
Lin Yi wanted to chase after him, but she knew that she physically could not outpace a normal man, so she didn’t chase after him and could only watch as the man grew more and more distant.
"Ah, where can I go to find a job?" Lin Yi watched the man walk farther and farther away, only to slump down on the ground in defeat.
She was now penniless, she had no funds to support herself, and moreover, she had to send living expenses every month; she couldn’t rely on her brother Lin Yi anymore.
But she didn’t have any credentials, where could she find a good job?
Just as she was at a loss, she felt someone squat beside her, and then a familiar voice came:
"Beautiful miss, could you lend me some money?"
Lin Yi looked up when she heard this, only to see a handsome guy with gold-rimmed glasses and dressed in casual clothes smiling at her.
She was stunned for a moment, then said: "Sir, are you joking with me? I’m just an ordinary person with no work experience."
"What, you look down on me?" the man with the gold-rimmed glasses challenged.
"Not at all, not at all, how dare I look down on you. It’s just that I really don’t have the money to lend you," Lin Yi quickly waved her hands and said.
Seeing this, the man laughed coldly: "No money? Then what are you doing here? But since you’re here, stay then. Don’t worry, I won’t treat you poorly."
"Ah?" Lin Yi was somewhat surprised as she looked at the handsome man in front of her.
"What, you don’t believe me? My name is Han Xuan, I’m the finance manager of the company. Our company is very impressive, you know. Come work at our company, a salary of ten thousand a week, it’s definitely enough for you to live a life of leisure forever."
Lin Yi watched as the man in front of her boasted and couldn’t help but laugh discreetly with a snort.
"Haha, what are you laughing at?" Seeing Lin Yi suddenly laugh, the glasses-wearing man’s face darkened.
"Nothing, I didn’t laugh at anything," Lin Yi shook her head.

chapters.title: Chapter 912 - 931: With a Confident Appearance
chapters.content:
Chapter 912: Chapter 931: With a Confident Appearance
"Why are you laughing if there’s nothing funny?" The bespectacled man glared, speaking indignantly.
"I was laughing at your self-praise, haha." Lin Yi covered his mouth as he laughed.
"Self-praise? You actually mock me for self-praising!" The man’s face turned ashen; he couldn’t believe that he, a financial manager, was being mocked by a student.
"You’re right, I’m mocking your self-praise. Not only that, but I’ll also tell you that I’m actually here to apply for the President’s secretary, believe it or not?" Lin Yi said confidently.
"President’s secretary? Are you serious? Are you sure you’re not deceiving me?" The man looked at Lin Yi suspiciously.
Seeing his doubt about her capabilities, Lin Yi said, "Believe it or not, I’m indeed here to apply for the President’s secretary. If you don’t believe me, that’s your problem. The position is vacant anyway, so I might just go directly to him, right?"
"You..." The man almost choked upon hearing Lin Yi’s words.
"What about you?" Lin Yi glared at him, then said, "Hurry up and hand over your ID and passport to me. If someone sees you hiding employee IDs and passports, I can’t be responsible for that. Also, don’t think you can bully people just because you’re handsome, you know?"
"I... how could I possibly bully anyone? Watch carefully, this is my ID, this is my passport." The man hastily said.
Taking a look at the two ID books and passports handed over by him, Lin Yi took the ID and passport, then stuffed them into his bag.
"If you don’t believe me, I can go to your company later and ask your president directly, would that be okay?" Lin Yi said assertively.
"Go ahead," the man nodded.
"Thanks, I’ll be going then, goodbye!"
"Goodbye."
"Goodbye."
Lin Yi turned around and left with his bag.
After Lin Yi left, the man watched her departing figure, a sly smile curving the corner of his mouth.
It seems today’s luck isn’t bad, to encounter such a Supreme Grade so soon.
He made a phone call to ask his company’s staff to investigate this girl.
After Lin Yi returned home, she packed up her belongings, ready to move to the hotel the next day.
The next morning, Lin Yi arrived at the hotel room door with her luggage.
She rang the bell, and within seconds, a uniformed waiter came to open the door.
Seeing Lin Yi’s attire and demeanor, the waiter’s eyes lit up involuntarily, and he swallowed hard, thinking, what a lucky day! To encounter such a beautiful lady!
"Hello, may I ask if you are...?" The waiter hurriedly approached, asking.
Lin Yi smiled and said, "Do you happen to know Han Xuan?"
"I... of course, I know him very well," the waiter nodded.
"Can I come in and sit for a while? I’m here to see your president."
"Of course, you can," the waiter quickly said.
"Thank you," Lin Yi smiled and said, then pushed open the door and walked inside.
After she entered, the waiter hurriedly closed the door.
"Are you new here?" A young woman dressed in black and white professional attire came downstairs and asked Lin Yi.
"My name is Lin Yi, today is my first day reporting here." Lin Yi smiled as she introduced herself.
"Then make yourself comfortable, sit down. From now on, you can just call me Auntie," the woman said with a smile.
"Um, okay, and you?"
"I’m Chen Yu, I’m your supervisor."
"Then I’ll call you Auntie from now on, I’m going to freshen up first, you do your thing." Lin Yi smiled and headed towards the bathroom.
"Um, go on."
After bathing, Lin Yi changed into a clean set of clothes and then sat down on the sofa.
Seeing a glass of milk and a sandwich on the table, she unceremoniously picked it up, took a bite of the sandwich, and then cast her gaze to the TV, starting to watch the news.
"Ding-dong! Ding-dong!"
Suddenly, the sound of the doorbell rang out, breaking the silence of the room.
"Could it be that guy coming?" Lin Yi murmured as she guessed, and then walked to the door to open it.
"Hello, may I ask if you are the new secretary to the president, Miss Lin Yi Lin?" Outside, there stood a tall and beautiful woman in a purple dress that highlighted her flawless figure, her delicate makeup making her look even more enchanting.
"Yes, are you looking for me?" Lin Yi nodded and asked.
"Miss Lin, I am here to apply for the position of secretary to the president," the beautiful woman said smilingly.
"Uh, applying for the secretary to the president?" Lin Yi was a bit confused when she heard this.
"Yes, because our president has been unwell recently, so I will be temporarily acting as his secretary," the beautiful woman explained with a smile.
"Oh, alright, please come in." Lin Yi hastily said.
Entering the house, Lin Yi looked around; the layout and decoration of this house was not much different from her own home, the only difference perhaps was that the furniture was more outdated, and there was a strange smell.
"The environment of this house is really nice, it looks like Han Xuan spent a lot of money," Lin Yi mumbled to herself.
"Miss Lin, hello, my name is Zhao Xuemei, I look forward to working with you." Zhao Xuemei said with a smile.
"Hehe, Miss Zhao, you’re too kind."
The two exchanged a few pleasantries, and then they sat down, with one playing host and the other playing guest.
"Miss Lin, may I ask what you like to eat? Coffee or tea eggs?" Zhao Xuemei asked.
"No need, I don’t eat sweets," Lin Yi quickly said, "Water is fine for me."
"Alright, Miss Lin, now let me take you to the company to familiarize yourself with the environment," Zhao Xuemei said as she stood up and led Lin Yi towards the door.
Walking along, Zhao Xuemei’s gaze occasionally drifted towards Lin Yi, filled with curiosity.
Seeing Zhao Xuemei’s gaze, Lin Yi suddenly felt uncomfortable and couldn’t help asking: "Miss Zhao, why are you looking at me like that?"
"Nothing, just that Miss Lin is quite unique, different from our previous secretary to the president, but I haven’t thought much about it, after all, no one would work with a dumb girl," Zhao Xuemei said with a smile.
Hearing this, Lin Yi cursed inwardly, me, dumb?!
Although she cursed inwardly, she maintained a faint smile on her face and said, "Is that so? Actually, everyone has a unique side."
Hearing this, Zhao Xuemei was slightly startled, then smiled again and said, "Yes, I understand."
After arriving at the company, Zhao Xuemei took Lin Yi around the entire company, then stopped and said to Lin Yi, "Miss Lin, you are now basically familiar with the company situation; I need to report back."
"Alright, safe travels," Lin Yi said smilingly.
"Mm, goodbye." Zhao Xuemei nodded slightly and then turned to leave.
Lin Yi watched Zhao Xuemei walking away, then returned to her office.

chapters.title: Chapter 913 - 932: Burying Oneself in Studying Hard
chapters.content:
Chapter 913: Chapter 932: Burying Oneself in Studying Hard
Back at his desk, Lin Yi placed his materials on the table and then picked up his phone to dial Li Yunxiao’s number.
"Hello, Yunxiao, it’s Lin Yi," Lin Yi said with a smile.
"Yeah, Lin Yi, you’ve arrived at the office, right?" Li Yunxiao asked with a laugh.
"I just got in, haven’t been here long," Lin Yi chuckled.
"Oh, is that so? Well then, how about we go out for coffee in half an hour?" Li Yunxiao suggested.
"Sure, I’m just bored in the office anyways, I’ll join you," Lin Yi readily agreed.
After hanging up, Lin Yi glanced at the materials on his desk and continued to bury his head in studying them.
...
Lin Yi arrived at the café and, looking at the street view outside the window, suddenly felt a sense of tranquility in her heart, as if everything had calmed down.
She knew that at this moment, she had already blended into her new life.
A month later, Han Xuan returned to the country, and Lin Yi finally saw the real Han Xuan.
Throughout that month, Han Xuan had stayed within the company, but Lin Yi had never seen him.
Over the month, Han Xuan dealt with all the big and small matters of the company and signed some important documents.
Although Lin Yi was not a businessperson, she could still tell that the company’s development was rapid, returning its initial investment in just half a month, and it was still expanding quickly.
This made Lin Yi very happy and secretly glad about her decision.
That day, as Lin Yi was looking at a document, she suddenly heard a sound from her computer, "Dingling~ Dingling~ Dingling..."
She looked up to see two lines of English letters on the screen: mylove!
"mylove?" Lin Yi frowned, "Could it be him? But, what does this mean?"
She thought curiously and then clicked her mouse.
A "beep" sound later, a photo popped up on the computer.
Lin Yi examined the photo closely, realizing it was Han Xuan.
Han Xuan was dressed in a black suit, standing by the windowsill, his face impassive and hard to read.
Seeing this photo, Lin Yi suddenly experienced a rush of inexplicable excitement and tension.
"He’s here, that’s Han Xuan, he’s here!" Lin Yi murmured to herself, then excitedly clicked "yes!"
Afterward, Lin Yi saved the photo and then set it as her phone’s screensaver.
After a month apart, Han Xuan looked even more handsome, about 185 centimeters tall, wearing a black suit, his whole figure seemed like a prince stepping out of a comic book.
"Lin Yi!" Suddenly, a man’s voice came from behind.
Hearing the voice, Lin Yi turned to look, only to see Zhao Xuemei smiling warmly at her.
"Oh, Miss Zhao, what can I do for you?" Lin Yi withdrew her gaze and then asked with a smile.
"Can’t I look for you without a reason?" Zhao Xuemei said with a laugh.
"No, of course you can," Lin Yi quickly shook her head, realizing she had forgotten that Zhao Xuemei was also a girl, and a pretty girl at that.
"That’s fine then, you take a seat, we’ll go out for a meal in a bit," Zhao Xuemei smiled and said.
"Mhm," Lin Yi responded.
Before long, Zhao Xuemei led Lin Yi out of the café and then to a nearby restaurant to order food.
"We’ll have two cups of coffee," Lin Yi told the server.
"Alright, just a moment," the server nodded with a smile and then turned to attend to other tasks.
"Lin Yi, where are you working now? Is it very tiring?" Zhao Xuemei took a sip of her coffee and asked after putting down her cup.
"I... I am the new assistant," Lin Yi hesitated for a moment before answering truthfully.
"Mm, it’s tough being new, but you’re doing great, becoming an assistant at such a young age. It looks like I can introduce you to President Han in the future," Zhao Xuemei nodded and said.
"Yes, I will work hard," Lin Yi said with a smile.
"You’re very modest. I have high hopes for you!" Zhao Xuemei smiled slightly, expressing her admiration.
Lin Yi couldn’t help but grin. It seemed that she had hit it off with Zhao Xuemei today.
"Ding-a-ling-a-ling..."
Just as Lin Yi and Zhao Xuemei were talking, a sudden urgent ring of the phone broke the silence.
Lin Yi looked down at the caller ID, and her heart skipped a beat.
"Miss Lin, this is President Li. Where are you now?" Li Yunxiao’s voice came through the phone.
"I’m currently at the café chatting with a friend. I’ll be right there," Lin Yi hurriedly responded.
"Then you must come to my office immediately. This matter is very serious," said Li Yunxiao in a grave tone, before hanging up the phone.
The busy tone of "beep beep" echoed in the receiver, and a foreboding feeling suddenly crept into Lin Yi’s heart.
"Lin Yi, President Li is asking you to come to the office. Is there some emergency?" Zhao Xuemei asked with concern.
Lin Yi took a deep breath, managed to squeeze out a smile, and said, "Nothing much, just a rather serious matter."
"Then you should hurry over, don’t delay any further," Zhao Xuemei urged.
"Yes, I’ll go now," said Lin Yi with a nod, and then hurriedly left the café and headed straight for Li Corporation.
In the Li Corporation headquarters office.
Li Yunxiao stood in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows, with his hands clasped behind his back, overlooking the constant flow of traffic below.
"Knock, knock, knock."
Suddenly, a knocking sound came from the door.
Li Yunxiao turned his head towards the door and said indifferently, "Come in."
Lin Yi pushed the door open and entered, then glanced down at her OL-style dress and unexpectedly felt somewhat embarrassed.
"Miss Lin, your work efficiency has been getting slower. Why did it take you so long to come here? I’ve grown a bit impatient," Li Yunxiao turned to look at Lin Yi and asked with a frosty tone.
At hearing this, Lin Yi’s face turned pale.
She clenched her teeth and said, "I... I..."
"What about you? I asked you to come to the company immediately to work, not to throw a tantrum. Let me tell you, no one dares to be petulant in my presence!" Li Yunxiao’s face showed a hint of frost as he rebuked her coldly.
Startled by Li Yunxiao’s shout, Lin Yi was momentarily stunned, standing there rigidly as if petrified, unable to utter a word.
"Speak up, are you mute? Do you think I don’t know what you’re thinking?" Li Yunxiao said with a sneer.
"I..." Lin Yi’s face changed colors and finally, after biting her lip, said, "I’m sorry, President Li, I... I realize my mistake."
"Good that you know! Remember, at this company, I am the boss, and you are just an assistant. In my presence, no matter what I say, you have to obey unconditionally. Do you understand?"
Li Yunxiao’s tone was icy, his eyes narrowed into slits, emitting a sharp aura, like a drawn sword with its blade bared.
Lin Yi shuddered involuntarily. With her head bowed, she didn’t dare to talk back.
"Alright, go to work," Li Yunxiao waved his hand, gesturing for her to leave.
"Yes, President Li," Lin Yi replied, then slowly backed out of Li Yunxiao’s office.
After reaching the office door, Lin Yi couldn’t help but let out a sigh of relief.
Through the time she had spent with him, Lin Yi realized that Li Yunxiao was not as capricious as the rumors suggested. On the contrary, he was kind and approachable.
But the more so he was, the more dangerous Lin Yi felt he could be.

chapters.title: Chapter 914 - 933: Really a Madman
chapters.content:
Chapter 914: Chapter 933: Really a Madman
Because this man was too terrifying, every word of his was like a thunderbolt, shaking her to the core.
"Ah... This man is truly a madman..." Lin Yi sighed, shook his head, and then turned to go downstairs.
It was a little past four in the afternoon.
Li Corporation.
CEO’s office.
"Secretary Lin, here is our performance report for the next quarter. Please take a look." A girl around twenty-seven or twenty-eight years old handed a stack of documents to Lin Yi.
"Alright, thank you." Lin Yi took the folder, then bowed slightly.
The girl glanced at her, a flicker of interest in her eyes.
"By the way, Secretary Lin, I just heard that you resigned. What’s that about? Your salary isn’t small, you know." The girl suddenly said.
"Heh, you’re quite well-informed, aren’t you?" Lin Yi replied with a light smile, then shifted her gaze away.
"I just like to gossip, so I’m very interested in every single thing," the girl said with a smile.
"Oh, right, Secretary Lin, this is a contract personally signed by the General Manager. Here, take it." Suddenly, the girl took out a golden contract from her bag.
The content of the contract was very simple: the company hoped to give Lin Yi as much support as possible to facilitate her promotion and appointment as the Assistant to the General Manager.
This contract was very tempting because the General Manager had a lot of power, and once Lin Yi became the Assistant to the General Manager, her salary would double. Who could resist such a temptation?
Of course, aside from the salary, Li Yunxiao also promised Lin Yi thirty million.
This number was certainly astonishing, but for Lin Yi, it held no allure.
Lin Yi wasn’t without money; she simply felt these things weren’t worth much.
"Secretary Lin, why aren’t you saying anything?" Seeing her staring blankly at the contract, the girl couldn’t help but ask in surprise.
Lin Yi came back to her senses and then smiled lightly, "I’ve already decided to resign. I don’t need this contract."
The girl’s face showed an expression of disbelief, as she exclaimed: "What? Resign? Why are you resigning?"
"That’s none of your business. You have no right to meddle in my affairs," Lin Yi said, lifting her head to look at the girl with a cold indifference.
Looking at the determined expression in Lin Yi’s eyes, the girl couldn’t help but frown and say, "Is there something you can’t talk about? Don’t worry, I won’t gossip about your matters."
"Do you think there’s any privacy left in this world? If you’re that bored, you could find something to do, instead of snooping on me," Lin Yi said with a sneer.
"You--" The girl glared, about to speak.
Just then, a knock on the door suddenly sounded.
With a "bang", the door was pushed open.
Lin Yi looked up and immediately shivered with fright, quickly stepping aside to avoid meeting Li Yunxiao’s eyes.
"What is it?" Li Yunxiao frowned and asked in a deep voice as he looked towards the door.
"President, here are a few documents from the company, please have a look," said a young man in a suit, respectfully handing a stack of documents to Li Yunxiao.
"Hmm, put them on the desk," Li Yunxiao glanced at the man and hmphed coldly.
The man in the suit quickly withdrew the documents from his hands and respectfully placed them on the table nearby.
"These documents are all yours," Li Yunxiao pointed at the documents on the table and said to Lin Yi.
"Huh?" Lin Yi was stunned, her face full of confusion.
"What’s wrong? Don’t you want to do this job? If you’re unwilling, you can leave the company any time; I won’t stop you. But don’t expect to find another suitable position elsewhere," Li Yunxiao said with a cold laugh.
"No no, I’m willing," Lin Yi hastily denied.
Of course, she would not refuse such a great opportunity, a tremendous honor. If it were someone else, they would have been jumping for joy already.
"Very good," Li Yunxiao nodded in satisfaction, "Now you may leave, and without my permission, no one is to disturb me."
"Okay, President," Lin Yi softly uttered the two words and then left the president’s office, gently closing the door behind her.
After Lin Yi left, Li Yunxiao began to review documents on his desk.
"Hmm, this month’s performance report is not bad, more than two hundred times better than before... Huh, what is this?" Li Yunxiao, after flipping through a few pages, noticed something unusual.
This was a new document, with a line of small red text: Lin Yi’s resignation letter!
"Lin Yi resigned?" Li Yunxiao’s eyes widened in astonishment as he saw the resignation letter.
"No, she has not only resigned but also been promoted to assistant general manager, she’s really skyrocketed," Li Yunxiao muttered to himself, a hint of shrewdness flashing in his eyes.
"Lin Yi is playing with fire! Daring to challenge me? Then I’ll have to teach her a lesson, to let her know what ’the sky’s high and the emperor’s far away’ means!" Li Yunxiao said coldly, a cold glint in his eyes.
Li Yunxiao tore up Lin Yi’s resignation letter into pieces and threw it into the waste basket, then picked up his phone to dial Lin Yi’s number.
"Hello, Secretary Lin, good day. I’m the General Manager Assistant specially appointed by the President, my name is Wu Xiaoming, you can call me Xiao Wu."
"Assistant General Manager? Why wasn’t I informed that I have an assistant? And appointed by the President?" Lin Yi asked, puzzled.
"This is arranged by the company, I’m only responsible for receiving you, as for other matters, I have no clue," Xiao Wu replied over the phone, his tone full of arrogance.
"Hmph!" Lin Yi snorted coldly and said, "In that case, let me tell you, you can leave now."
"Ha ha, Lin Yi oh Lin Yi, who do you think you are? Are you worthy of ordering me around? I’m your immediate superior, and if the President hadn’t specifically instructed, I would have fired you a long time ago!" Upon hearing this, a cold sneer appeared on Xiao Wu’s face, mocking her.
Anger flashed across Lin Yi’s face as she clenched her teeth and said, "Alright, I really want to see how you’re going to fire me!"
"Alright! We’ll just wait and see!" Xiao Wu huffed and then hung up the phone, turning to walk out of the office.
"Hmph, once I’ve succeeded in my promotion, I’ll resign from your job!" Lin Yi clenched her fists and spoke bitterly, her face full of hate.
After hanging up the phone, Li Yunxiao sat silently in his chair.
He was pondering why exactly Lin Yi had resigned, was it because she was hurt?
"Lin Yi is my woman, her resignation has something to do with me, I must find a way to keep her by my side."
"I must figure out a way to keep Lin Yi!" Li Yunxiao swore secretly in his heart, a murderous intent flashing in his eyes.
"Lin Yi, just you wait! I’ll make you pay!" Li Yunxiao spoke coldly.
This resignation incident caused Lin Yi to utterly loathe Li Yunxiao.
Although she didn’t understand why Li Yunxiao would target her, but she could feel his hostility towards her.
That’s why she would find a way to leave this job, to avoid Li Yunxiao’s entanglement.
She believes that as long as she has enough time, she can completely get away from Li Yunxiao.
Now that her job here was successfully completed.
So, she wanted to leave the company as soon as possible, to look for a job that suited her better.
"Li Yunxiao, I will not let you go!" Lin Yi’s eyes were shimmering with cold light as she swore bitterly in her heart.
Li Yunxiao sat in the boss chair, his face full of gloom, and a fierce cold light in his eyes.
He had never imagined that Lin Yi would take the initiative to resign; could it be she really developed feelings for him and didn’t want to stay by his side any longer?

chapters.title: Chapter 915 - 934: Developed Feelings
chapters.content:
Chapter 915: Chapter 934: Developed Feelings
"Hmph, Lin Yi, since you’ve chosen to leave, I’ll make sure you have no way out!"
"This matter is definitely not going to end here." A cruel smile surfaced on Li Yunxiao’s face.
With Lin Yi gone, there was no need for him to stay around any longer.
"Right, that resignation report states that she initiated it herself, so there shouldn’t be any opposition to it. Why then did someone remind me about it?"
Li Yunxiao frowned, and an image of someone popped into his mind--Zhao Xuemei.
"Yes, I’ve got it, it must be that crazy woman’s doing! I’m going to show you just how formidable I am!" A sinister glint flashed in Li Yunxiao’s eyes.
...
"Lin, why have you come back? Did the company arrange a new job for you?" Li Yunxiao was in his office dealing with documents when a female secretary hurried in, asking with surprise.
"No, the company didn’t arrange any work for me. I resigned because I was feeling unwell, and it has nothing to do with anything else." Lin Yi shook her head and spoke indifferently.
"Feeling unwell? Lin, what’s wrong with your health? Where do you feel uncomfortable?"
"I..." Lin Yi opened her mouth as if to tell the truth but then felt it was no big deal, and said, "It’s just a minor ailment."
"Lin, let me help you rest a bit. Otherwise, if you keep this up, you’ll break down sooner or later," the female secretary said with concern.
Lin Yi waved her hand, "No need, I just want some quiet."
"Lin, don’t push yourself. If your health fails, how am I going to explain it to the president?"
"It’s fine, it’s just some superficial wounds. I’ll be better after a sleep," Lin Yi said with a slight smile, and without further discussion, ushered the female secretary out of the office.
Li Yunxiao glanced around the office and then took the resignation report as he left.
This female secretary was named Zhao Qianqian, a very beautiful and enthusiastic and kind secretary. It was really pleasant to work with her.
But Li Yunxiao didn’t like her and wanted to avoid her as much as possible.
He had just exited the elevator and was about to head out of the office building when he suddenly heard Zhao Qianqian calling out, "Lin, wait for me. It’s too dangerous for you to walk around outside by yourself."
Lin Yi paused for a moment and then shook her head, "No need, you have important work to take care of."
"Lin, I’m your personal assistant now. Naturally, I should be by your side at all times. Don’t refuse, or I’ll really get angry," Zhao Qianqian pulled on Lin Yi’s sleeve, coquettishly speaking.
"Well, in that case, thank you." Lin Yi, at her wit’s end with the coquettish behavior, could only agree.
The two of them walked out one after the other, with Lin Yi also contemplating whether to bring Zhao Qianqian under her wing to help manage the company.
After all, Zhao Qianqian was tall and curvy, as well as beautiful.
Such a gorgeous girl, if made her secretary, would surely make the company’s staff green with envy.
Thinking about it, Lin Yi couldn’t help but reveal a sweet smile on her face.
"Lin, you look so beautiful when you smile!" Zhao Qianqian couldn’t help but compliment Lin Yi, who was blooming like a flower in laughter.
"Ah? Really?" Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s face flushed red, and she murmured with her head lowered.
"Of course, it’s true," Zhao Qianqian blinked her beautiful big eyes and said earnestly.
Lin Yi’s complexion grew ever more ruddy, yet he forced himself to act as if nothing were amiss, saying, "Hehe, Qianqian, let’s hurry up and not delay our work."
Zhao Qianqian nodded slightly and immediately led Lin Yi into another office area.
Li Yunxiao stopped downstairs, raised his head to look at the building, and felt a surge of complex emotions welling up inside him.
The name of this building was ’Shengshi Haoting’, which ranked among the top office buildings in the big cities of Huaxia and also held a position on the international stage.
"Shengshi Haoting, it seems my plan is about to begin," Li Yunxiao muttered to himself.
"Sister Lin, let me show you around the environment, and then take you to familiarize yourself with our company’s business, okay?" Zhao Qianqian turned her head, smiling radiantly as she spoke.
Lin Yi was slightly startled, then nodded her head.
"Sure."
Seeing this, Li Yunxiao quickly followed and said, "Qianqian, let’s go together; it’ll save us a lot of time."
Zhao Qianqian glanced at Li Yunxiao and said cheerfully, "Okay, let’s go together!"
Saying so, she led Lin Yi towards the company’s business department.
They arrived at the business department in no time, where a crowd had gathered, presenting a lively scene.
Li Yunxiao frowned upon seeing this.
Zhao Qianqian also noticed these people and quickly walked in, cupping her hands in greeting and asking, "Excuse me everyone, I’m sorry to interrupt, but what are you all doing here?"
A young man in a suit snorted coldly and arrogantly replied, "We’re discussing how to recruit a general manager. Sister Lin, since you are the general manager, why don’t you judge who has the ability to be the company’s general manager."
Lin Yi was taken aback; she had merely come to look around, not expecting these people to be discussing the company’s general manager, putting her in an awkward position.
Moreover, she knew that these people were sent by the board of directors, and it was impossible for her to be the general manager. Wouldn’t this disappoint the board?
So, Lin Yi smiled faintly and said, "The position of general manager isn’t something we, ordinary employees, are in a position to compete for. Let the board decide."
The young man in a suit gave her a displeased look and said, "Sister Lin, aren’t you being a bit out of line? After all, you count as one of Shengshi Haoting’s long-time employees, how can you not consider the company?"
Lin Yi sighed inwardly, thinking if it weren’t for making her job smoother, she wouldn’t bother with such matters. She genuinely didn’t understand why the board would do this.
"Sister Lin, don’t forget, there are many shareholders watching our company’s stock," said the suited young man with a mocking tone, wearing an expression as if watching a drama.
His words angered all the employees.
They were all cultivated by the board of directors and thoroughly despised those old and cunning folks on the board.
"Sister Lin, don’t worry, I’ll fight for you, and make sure you become the general manager!" said the young man in a suit, his eyes ablaze.
"Don’t listen to that little punk’s nonsense, Sister Lin, you don’t have to bother with him!" a female employee angrily glared at the young man in the suit and said, "Those directors on the board won’t care about these matters!"
"That’s right, Shengshi Haoting was established by the board. If they dare to interfere with this, they will definitely be punished."
"Hmph, they might scare the ordinary employees, but they wouldn’t dare to provoke us elites!"
Several female staff members spoke out one after another, looking righteously indignant.
Although what these people said was bold, it was also the truth.
Shengshi Haoting was a company founded by the board of directors after its formation, backed by members of the board, indeed possessing sufficient power to fear no one.

chapters.title: Chapter 916 - 935: The Power of the Grand Mansion
chapters.content:
Chapter 916: Chapter 935: The Power of the Grand Mansion
"""
"This..." Upon hearing the words, Lin Yi also started feeling uneasy. She knew about the power of Shengshi Haoting and didn’t dare to take the risk.
But Lin Yi couldn’t help but feel discontented, as her dream was to become a wealthy person.
Had it not been for her own efforts and struggles, she would have probably ended up on the streets a long time ago, and wouldn’t have achieved what she has today.
So, she must try her best!
After thinking for a while, she said, "Qianqian, please step outside; I want to talk to this director."
The young man in the suit gave her a cold glance and sneered, "Hmph, trying to find an excuse to slip away? No chance! Lin, stop struggling; you simply can’t beat me!"
As soon as he finished speaking, he waved his hand, and several strong men surrounded Lin Yi, tightly encircling her, making it impossible for her to move.
"What are you trying to do?!"
Lin Yi’s face changed slightly, and she shouted in panic, "Is this an order from the board of directors?"
"The board of directors ordered us to catch you!" The young man in the suit snorted coldly, "Just wait for the legal punishment!"
Upon seeing this, Lin Yi became desperately anxious; she truly hadn’t expected this to happen and felt even more frightened.
"Qianqian, I’m really sorry to trouble you," Lin Yi said hastily, seeking help.
Zhao Qianqian was startled, then understood her intention, and was deeply moved.
In this society, many women wish to cling to wealthy ladies, yet true wealthy ladies are not willing to condescend to be a mere salesperson. They’d much rather find someone with power and influence, so Lin Yi’s action touched her greatly.
"Lin, don’t worry, I will definitely seek justice for you!"
With that, Zhao Qianqian gritted her teeth and rushed forward, heavily slapping the young man’s face.
Slap--
The crisp sound of the slap resonated throughout the entire space, and everyone around was stunned.
No one had expected Zhao Qianqian to suddenly attack the young man in the suit, and they even forgot to stop her.
"Qianqian!"
"Qianqian, stop it!"
Lin Yi and the other employees were shocked, never having expected Zhao Qianqian to really dare to strike someone from the board, hitting him directly on the face.
"You bitch!" The young man in the suit, after being slapped by Zhao Qianqian, flew into a rage and raised his hand to hit her back.
Zhao Qianqian was caught off guard and was smacked across the face, her body flying out and crashing heavily against the wall.
She instantly fell to the ground, spitting out a mouthful of fresh blood, a look of agony on her face.
"Qianqian!"
"Quick, go help Qianqian!"
Lin Yi and a group of employees all cried out, hurriedly rushing over.
The young man in the suit gave a cold smile, flicked his hand, and commanded the bodyguards around him, "Catch her!"
"Yes!" The bodyguards responded and were about to lay hands on someone.
Just at that moment, Lin Yi’s phone rang; it was a text message. The sender’s name was boldly displayed as Liu Yun.
"Lin, someone sent a text message saying you need to rush to the general manager’s office immediately!" an employee ran over and reported.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi’s face showed a puzzled expression.
Why did Liu Yun want her to go to the general manager’s office?
Could something have happened to him?
Regardless of what it was, Lin Yi didn’t dare delay and quickly sorted herself out before hurrying out of the office area.
"Lin!"
"""
Zhao Qianqian struggled to her feet, her face ashen, with a trace of blood on the corner of her mouth, and her eyes full of venomous resentment.
She couldn’t believe Liu Yun would dare to allow her Sister Lin to be treated like this; it was simply too bullying.
After Lin Yi arrived at the general manager’s office, Liu Yun was leisurely sitting in his chair drinking tea.
Lin Yi breathed a sigh of relief, it seemed he hadn’t encountered any mishaps; otherwise, he would not be so nonchalant sipping tea.
However, she still had some doubts; after all, Liu Yun was the chairman’s secretary, this was the company of Shengshi Haoting; she couldn’t possibly be unaware of the rules here.
"Sister Lin, please come in." Liu Yun greeted with a smile.
"Manager Liu, what did you need me for?" Lin Yi also returned the courtesy.
Liu Yun smiled slightly and said, "It’s nothing major, just a small matter where I need your help."
"Please give your orders, Manager Liu, as long as it’s within my capabilities, I will assist with all my might!" Lin Yi said seriously.
Hearing this, Liu Yun inwardly commended her.
It seemed that his niece was indeed a clever person, very good at judging the situation, knowing what to do.
That was good, it saved him the trouble of further persuasion.
"It’s like this, the board has just discussed a new plan, take a look."
Saying this, Liu Yun picked up a stack of documents from the desk and handed them to Lin Yi, speaking in a very calm tone, as if discussing a trivial matter.
"A new plan?" Lin Yi was taken aback and asked with some confusion, "Wasn’t this already finalized before?"
She remembered that the board had already handed the plan to her; could it be that Liu Yun deliberately sidetracked her from participating in this project?
"I won’t hide it from you, the board’s decision hasn’t changed; you are still in charge of this plan," Liu Yun said.
"Manager Liu, what do you mean? What is this about!" Lin Yi’s face changed drastically, asking in disbelief, "Are you doubting my capabilities? Or are you actually not sincere in wanting me to take responsibility, hence you deliberately sidetracked me?"
A flash of anger crossed Liu Yun’s face as he said sternly, "You’re misunderstanding."
"Misunderstanding?" Lin Yi sneered, "If you’re unwilling to let me handle it, then please find someone else. Our company does not welcome people like you; you’d better leave our company as soon as possible."
She always felt that the board members were despicable for handing over this project to her and making her the leader.
She didn’t want to take on this project as it was bound to be her failure; she didn’t want to bear this responsibility.
"Sister Lin!"
Just then, Zhao Qianqian walked in from outside, her face pale and her forehead covered with fine sweat, obviously not lightly injured.
"Qianqian, are you alright?" Lin Yi asked, heartachingly.
Zhao Qianqian shook her head and managed a weak smile, "I’m fine, thank you for your concern, Sister Lin!"
"Qianqian! How could you be so careless!" Lin Yi spoke with slight reproach.
"I don’t know what happened..."
Zhao Qianqian hadn’t finished speaking when she suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood and collapsed straight onto the ground.
Seeing this, Lin Yi’s heart suddenly clenched, her face turning pale as she hurriedly went to check on her.
She was bleeding all over, evidently having hit a wall earlier.
Lin Yi didn’t dare delay, quickly checking her breathing and then her pulse.
Fortunately, she wasn’t dead, just unconscious.
"Qianqian, Qianqian! Wake up!" Lin Yi shook her anxiously, filled with self-reproach.
If not for her own carelessness, Zhao Qianqian wouldn’t have been hurt so badly.
And all of this, was her own doing!
"Qianqian, I’m sorry! It’s all my fault, please wake up soon!" Lin Yi burst into tears.
Liu Yun sat on the side, watching Lin Yi with interest, his eyes twinkling with a playful gleam.

chapters.title: Chapter 917 - 936 Inexplicable
chapters.content:
Chapter 917: Chapter 936 Inexplicable
Lin Yi, such a ravishing beauty, why does she like such an ugly monster? He was puzzled.
"President Liu, please save Qianqian!" Lin Yi hurriedly pleaded for help.
Although she was reluctant to deal with Liu Yun, for the sake of Zhao Qianqian, she still bent down to beg.
Liu Yun, however, waved his hand and said, "No need to make it complicated, just help Qianqian to the resting room first to treat her wounds, to prevent infection and possible complications."
Hearing this, Lin Yi couldn’t help but feel a surge of anger in her heart.
But she knew that this was a critical moment and she must endure.
Lin Yi clenched her teeth, quickly held Zhao Qianqian in her arms, and hurried toward the resting room.
"Lin, let me go, I don’t want to stay in the same room with such a disgusting man, and I don’t want you to touch me!"
However, just then, Zhao Qianqian suddenly opened her eyes, fiercely pushed Lin Yi away, then struggled up and ran into the resting room as if escaping.
Bang!
The door was slammed shut, and Zhao Qianqian’s voice disappeared inside.
Lin Yi was stunned, then her anger flared up, wishing she could immediately rush into the resting room and drag Zhao Qianqian out to give her a beating!
This woman was really hateful, to actually dare reject her!
The more Lin Yi thought about it, the angrier she got, and her chest felt unbearably tight.
She took a deep breath, tried hard to control her emotions, and slowly turned her head to look at Liu Yun.
Liu Yun looked leisurely and content, as if enjoying a good show, his eyes carrying a hint of mockery.
"President Liu, what do you mean?" Lin Yi asked coldly.
Liu Yun gave a faint smile and said, "You should understand by now."
"What?!" Lin Yi’s face changed.
"I just want to talk to you alone about this matter, I hope you can cooperate," said Liu Yun.
Lin Yi snorted coldly and turned away.
Liu Yun watched her defiant back, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth, then he stepped towards his office.
Inside the office.
"Let’s talk about your plan just now."
Lin Yi gave him a cold glance, then opened her laptop, sat on the sofa, and waited for him to finish.
Liu Yun sat down across the office desk, casually opened a video file, and then played it on Lin Yi’s laptop in front of her.
"Look, I have already reviewed the entire proposal," Liu Yun said.
Lin Yi glared coldly at him, then clicked the mouse and looked at the document on the screen, her pupils suddenly constricting.
It was a massive proposal, with tens of thousands of words.
Lin Yi frowned tightly, she hadn’t expected there would be so much content this time.
Such a thick document, how could she finish it?
But now, other than agreeing, she had no other choice.
Lin Yi took a deep breath and focused her attention on the document.
The document detailed the future development trends of the company, future strategic plans, and even listed many of the company’s flaws, including aspects of technology, skills, and employee professionalism.
What shocked Lin Yi the most were these words—technology, skills, employee professionalism, she couldn’t believe her ears!
This company actually developed these things?!
Moreover, they also listed a huge array of pros and cons, which are highly targeted!
In Lin Yi’s view, these pros and cons are simply insurmountable obstacles.
Lin Yi looked at the computer screen, her heart filled with shock.
The ambition of this company was beyond her imagination.
If the company truly develops according to this plan, it might not even take two years for the company to become nationally and globally renowned.
What a grand dream this is!
"President Liu, this project plan is simply perfect!" Lin Yi said excitedly, "I really don’t understand why you would hand this project over to me!"
Hearing this, Liu Yun’s face revealed a faintly mocking smile, saying, "Miss Lin, do you really think this company belongs to you alone?"
"Isn’t it? This is a property of Liu Group, of course, it’s yours."
"Then let me tell you, the founder of this company is my father," Liu Yun said, "Originally, my father was a business genius, he devoted all his energy to the business field, but after all, his energy was limited.
Therefore, he wanted to find a successor who could support his business, and I was undoubtedly the best choice."
"Mr. Liu is a great man, what you’re doing is definitely right, but our conditions cannot change!" Lin Yi firmly shook her head, said.
"Oh?" Liu Yun raised an eyebrow, and said with a smirk, "I have already made the conditions clear, you can choose to follow them or not, of course, provided that you are willing to sacrifice your innocence!"
"What did you say?" Lin Yi was stunned, "Impossible, I would definitely not do such a thing!"
"If that’s the case, then there’s nothing more to discuss," Liu Yun shrugged, said.
"Wait a minute!"
Lin Yi stopped Liu Yun, saying, "President Liu, are these documents from my father?"
Liu Yun sneered, saying, "Yes, I thought you would have understood by now, so there’s no need to waste any more words."
Lin Yi’s face went through a series of changes before she calmed down.
Regardless, this company was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for her, she must seize this chance and not give up!
Seeing that she wasn’t speaking, Liu Yun thought she had agreed, so he continued, "Don’t worry, just agree to be my girlfriend and marry me, I will help you destroy this document, ensuring no trace is left behind, how about it?"
"You..." Lin Yi was furious, "I absolutely cannot be your girlfriend!"
"Ha ha!" Liu Yun suddenly burst into unrestrained laughter.
"What are you laughing at!" Lin Yi shouted angrily, feeling her dignity trampled.
"What am I laughing at? Heh, in this world, no one can refuse me, and no one ever has!" Liu Yun stated emphatically.
Lin Yi’s breathing became heavier, her face ashen, furiously said, "You scum, even if I marry you, can I be happy?"
"Happy?" Liu Yun scoffed, said, "What is happiness? It’s just a transaction of money, no one cares! With money, anything is possible!"
Hearing his words, Lin Yi was completely devastated.
She knew that in this world, there are too many people unworthy of sympathy, because they simply do not understand love, do not understand cherishing.
"So? Are you agreeing or not?" Liu Yun stepped closer to Lin Yi, his eyes emitting an intimidating glow.
Lin Yi took a deep breath and said, "President Liu, I think you got something wrong, the reason I came to work at the company is because I had an epiphany! I don’t want to live like I used to, I want to do something that can take me further along my life’s path!"
"That’s because I didn’t make you feel happy!" Liu Yun scoffed.
"I am happy!" Lin Yi firmly said, "Besides, I’ve already found the other half of my life, I feel very happy now."
"Heh!" Liu Yun sneered, "Do you really think these things can stop me?!"
"Why not try and see?!" Lin Yi lifted her chin, looking at him arrogantly, "President Liu, do you think I’m right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 918 - 937: Smart Professional Attire
chapters.content:
Chapter 918: Chapter 937: Smart Professional Attire
Liu Yun snorted coldly, saying, "You’re right, but you have to understand, even if you have everything now, what can you do about it? Do you think with these things, you can defeat me and become the chairman of this company?"
"I don’t know!"
"Ha!"
"So, I agree to your terms!"
Lin Yi took a deep breath and said calmly.
"Very good!" Liu Yun sneered, "Since you’ve thought it through, I’ll grant you this! Tomorrow morning at eight o’clock, you will receive a phone call."
After finishing, he picked up the USB drive from the table and left.
Lin Yi watched his departing figure, a complex expression flashing through his eyes.
...
Sleepless through the night, the next morning Lin Yi got up early to wash and dressed in sharp business attire.
Today she was facing an important decision.
She couldn’t let these data leak, so she must destroy them as soon as possible.
But...
Lin Yi looked at the scars on her wrist, feeling bitter inside.
This time, if she failed, perhaps even this scar would disappear, and she would never see these scars again?
"Ding dong."
The doorbell rang, Lin Yi paused for a moment, then came to her senses about who it could be at this time.
She opened the door and saw Zhang Yang standing at the entrance.
"I... last night you..."
Lin Yi was about to explain, but Zhang Yang pulled her into his arms and sealed her lips with a kiss.
Lin Yi’s eyes widened, her eyes reddened, tears uncontrollably falling.
She knew she could no longer escape.
This was their first contact, and she had no reason to refuse.
For a long while, Zhang Yang finally let her go, looked at Lin Yi, and said, "You’re truly beautiful."
Lin Yi gritted her teeth and said, "Then why do you still provoke me?"
Zhang Yang smiled, saying, "Because I like you, I can’t bear to lie to you."
"Nonsense!" Lin Yi retorted indignantly, "Like me? You just want to take revenge!"
"Hehe, how can you think like that?" Zhang Yang laughed, gently pinching her tender cheek.
Lin Yi struggled, but Zhang Yang embraced her tighter, making it impossible for her to break free.
"Let me go!" Lin Yi struggled.
Zhang Yang shook his head and said, "Lin Yi, let’s get married."
"Get... married..." Lin Yi opened her eyes wide, unbelievingly staring at him.
"Yes!" Zhang Yang nodded, "Believe it or not, I don’t want to see you sad anymore in this lifetime, nor do I want to see you tangled with other men. I want to make all the men who covet you give up!"
"But..." Lin Yi still wanted to refuse.
"There are no buts, let’s just happily decide on this!" Zhang Yang declared dominantly.
"No!" Lin Yi shook her head, "This isn’t right!"
Zhang Yang frowned slightly and said, "What isn’t right?"
Lin Yi looked at him seriously and said, "Marriage requires the willingness of both parties, that’s the most basic!"
"I know that, but you’ve forgotten one thing, you’ve already been forced by me to sign an agreement," Zhang Yang said, "So, you must fulfill the content of the contract."
"But..." Lin Yi still wanted to argue.
"No buts!" Zhang Yang said, "It’s decided! Move in today, Uncle Chen will arrange a room for you."
Having said that, Zhang Yang didn’t give Lin Yi a chance to refuse and walked out of the room.
Lin Yi stood there in a daze, his words reverberating in her mind.
What did he say again?
He would give her a grand wedding ceremony?!
Is this not a dream?!
How is this possible!
But, as she watched him walk away, a sweet feeling inexplicably surged in her heart.
Could it be that he really has feelings for her?
...
"Both of you get up now!"
Lin Yi had just finished tidying up when noises erupted from outside, causing her brows to furrow slightly.
She opened the door and saw a young and beautiful girl arguing with two bodyguards.
Lin Yi was taken aback and asked, "May I help you?"
"Lin Yi, don’t be too arrogant!" The girl pointed at her nose and scolded, "You’re nothing but a cheap whore, how dare you seduce my brother?!"
"I..." Lin Yi’s face turned somewhat awkward.
"What about you huh?! I’m warning you, stay away from my brother and stop clinging to him, otherwise, I’ll make you pay!" the girl said.
"I... I..." Lin Yi tried to speak but finally chose to remain silent.
"What’s the matter? Got nothing to say?" The girl looked at her with disdain, scoffed, and turned to walk away with an air of superiority.
Lin Yi sighed, threw her utensils into the trash can, and went back to her bedroom to change clothes.
...
Lin Yi was already late when she arrived at the company.
She charged through the office area, drawing the eyes of everyone.
"What are you all looking at? It’s not my first day at work, what’s there to see?" Lin Yi looked around discontentedly and then asked Uncle Chen, "Uncle Chen, am I late?"
Uncle Chen smiled warmly at her and said, "Secretary Lin, don’t blame me for not reminding you, you know the president’s temper better than anyone, if you offend his sensibilities again, I’m afraid..."
He didn’t finish his sentence.
However, Lin Yi read between the lines from his words.
She bit her lip and said, "I understand! Thanks for the reminder, Uncle Chen!"
"Secretary Lin, I need to get going." Uncle Chen smiled then turned towards the elevator.
Lin Yi watched his receding figure, her heart filled with guilt and gratitude.
These days, Uncle Chen had taken great care of her, not only shielding her from various troubles but even stepping in when she faced difficulties.
Though he was just an ordinary employee, Lin Yi deeply appreciated his kindness.
She took a deep breath, adjusted her emotions, and headed to the top floor.
As she reached the office door, Lin Yi hesitated for a moment.
She raised her hand to knock, but the door was pushed open from the inside.
"You finally decided to come out!" Zhang Yang scanned her body and then said with a grin.
"Do you... need something?" Lin Yi asked warily, afraid of any strange actions he might take.
"Of course!" Zhang Yang nodded and said, "Tonight at 7:30, at the grand hall of Di Hao Hotel, I hope you can attend."
"A banquet?" Lin Yi frowned, "Why suddenly invite me to such a boring gathering?"
"You are my fiancée!" Zhang Yang said indifferently.
Hearing his words, Lin Yi was deeply shocked, a rage welled up in her chest, wishing she could punch him.
What fiancée!
This is clearly just a transaction!
Lin Yi took a deep breath, struggling to control herself, then said, "I’m not interested in attending such gatherings."
"You might think you’re not interested, but others are very much interested!" Zhang Yang sneered mockingly, "You think you’re so noble, but you’re just a sleep-in mistress!"
Lin Yi’s face flushed with anger, she exclaimed, "I warn you!"
"There’s no need for such a reaction! I’m not going to kill you!" Zhang Yang said, "I don’t like seeing you, so just obey and don’t force me to get rough!"
"You... you are shameless!" Lin Yi glared angrily at him.
"Really?" Zhang Yang smirked devilishly, "If you hate me so much, then disappear from my sight as soon as possible!"
Lin Yi clenched her fists tightly, staring at Zhang Yang with festering anger, unable to utter a word.

chapters.title: Chapter 919 - 938: A Man of Extraordinary Elegance
chapters.content:
Chapter 919: Chapter 938: A Man of Extraordinary Elegance
Moments later, she turned and walked away.
Zhang Yang watched her huffy figure, a smile growing more prominent at the corners of his mouth. He picked up his phone and dialed a series of numbers.
The call was quickly connected, and a chilly voice rang out: "What is it?"
"Young Master." Zhang Yang spoke, "I’d like to invite Lin Yi to have a drink with you."
After a few seconds of silence on the other end, the callous voice finally came through, slowly: "Fine."
After hanging up, Zhang Yang’s face broke into a sly grin.
The day was soon here, where he would use Lin Yi’s blood to avenge his brother!
...
Dusk fell, and the city lights began to shine.
Lin Yi sat in the car, her gaze calmly observing the scenery outside the window.
A white Ferrari passed by her, the window slowly rolling down to reveal a strikingly handsome man.
"Little Yi, long time no see!"
The man’s face wore a radiant smile, like a blooming flower.
Lin Yi’s heart clenched when she saw him, her complexion instantly turning pale.
Is it him?!
Hadn’t she already deleted his picture? How could he appear here?!
At this moment, Lin Yi felt as though she was engulfed in turmoil, unwittingly trapped in a predicament with no return.
Lin Yi instinctively leaned back, trying to keep her distance from this man.
Her behavior caused the man’s smile across from her to gradually freeze and then transform into a thick sneer.
"It seems you still remember me!" The man’s indifferent voice carried a mocking tone.
"I... I don’t." Lin Yi hung her head low, not daring to meet his eyes, "Excuse me for the interruption, I should be going."
"Wait!" the man called out.
Lin Yi stopped in her tracks, turned her head, and looked at him, perplexed.
"Join me for a meal," the man said with a smile, "as a celebration of our successful engagement."
"Engagement?!" Lin Yi’s eyes widened in disbelief.
"That’s right!" The man nodded his head, "We are getting married soon."
Lin Yi pursed her lips and replied, "Sorry, I don’t have the time."
"Oh?" The man raised an eyebrow, "I’ll give you three minutes to consider. If you refuse me, then by tomorrow your photos accompanying a drink or a bed along with a sensational headline ’Rising Star Lin Yi’s Sleep Scandal!’ will be all over the newspapers."
"You..." Lin Yi was furious but dared not to retort.
Seeing her expression, Zhang Yang couldn’t help but burst into laughter: "So, how about it? Will you join me for a meal?"
Lin Yi glared at him through gritted teeth and said, "Fine!"
She dared not defy him, nor disobey her father’s orders.
She couldn’t let herself become the laughingstock of the entire school!
...
Inside a high-end Western restaurant, Lin Yi watched the man opposite her elegantly sip his coffee, fury boiling up inside her, about to erupt.
"Zhang Yang, we are already engaged! Acting like this is no good for you, I advise you to stop pestering me!" Lin Yi couldn’t help but exclaim.
"Pestering you? Heh..." Zhang Yang chuckled lightly, "Lin Yi, I really wonder if your head was kicked by a donkey? Who do you think you are? Worth me scheming and chasing after you? We’re just engaged, I haven’t acknowledged your status at all."
Lin Yi, incensed, laughed in scorn, "You really are shameless!"
"The pot calling the kettle black." Zhang Yang glanced at her disdainfully and scoffed.
Lin Yi took a deep breath, suppressing the anger at the bottom of her heart.
No, she absolutely couldn’t lose her composure here!
She had to endure; otherwise, she would surely die at the hands of this devilish man!
She had to bear it!
"Zhang Yang, I came today to ask you something, and I hope you will answer me honestly!" Lin Yi took another deep breath, forcing herself to calm down.
"Oh? Ask away." Zhang Yang said, his eyes glittering with an amused glint.
"How much money does my dad actually owe you for you to treat him like this?" Lin Yi asked, "I remember you once promised him that as long as he paid up, you wouldn’t harass him anymore!"
"Lin Yi, is this your way of negotiating with me?" Zhang Yang snorted coldly, a flicker of displeasure in his eyes, "I already said, I am no gentleman, you asking me like this, I have no way to answer!"
"Fine, if that’s what you say, then forget it! I have other matters, so I’ll take my leave first!" Lin Yi said coldly.
Having said her piece, she stood up, ready to leave.
"Wait a moment."
"Anything else?"
Zhang Yang glanced at her, his tone indifferent: "Are you really sure you don’t want to join me for dinner?"
Lin Yi’s figure stiffened, her heart pounding fiercely twice.
This bastard! Was he threatening her?
If she agreed, then he would announce their engagement! By then, she would definitely become the laughing stock of the school, and even the whole Lin Family would be shamed!
But if she didn’t agree, he would really expose the incident of her accompanying drinks!
Her parents would definitely find out then!
Such a big scandal, once exposed, would be the downfall of their family!
Lin Yi hesitated for a moment, but ultimately compromised.
"Let’s go!"
The two re-entered the Western restaurant.
"Zhang Yang, I need you to do something for me," Lin Yi said straightforwardly.
"What is it?"
"Find me a team of High-Level hackers to help me break into a website and destroy it!" Lin Yi said.
"High-Level hackers?" Zhang Yang was momentarily stunned, "Whose account do you want to hack?"
"Of course, it’s mine!" Lin Yi said through clenched teeth, "If I find out who it is, I’ll make sure they never set foot in Jiang City ever again!"
Zhang Yang pondered for a moment, then nodded: "Alright, I will help you get to the bottom of this. I think there will definitely be some information about that person."
"Thank you," Lin Yi said with gratitude.
"Don’t mention it," Zhang Yang smiled and said, "I heard that you have been hanging out with a boy recently, a good-looking and wealthy boy, is he your new love interest?"
Lin Yi’s pupils constricted, she swept a cold glance at him, and said word by word: "You don’t need to pry into my business, I can judge for myself what kind of man I like!"
"Tsks..." Zhang Yang curled his lips mockingly, "I thought you were oh so chaste, didn’t expect you to be so open!"
"You--" Lin Yi trembled with anger, "Zhang Yang, I’m warning you, don’t go too far!"
"Am I going too far?" Zhang Yang leaned slightly, moving close to her ear and whispering suggestively, "Lin Yi, you know how much I hate being lied to!"
"That’s because you’re stupid!" Lin Yi bit back.
"Oh? In that case, I’m quite looking forward to seeing how you’ll make me look stupid," Zhang Yang chuckled, "Speaking of which, Lin Corporation has been having a tough time with cash flow, your father is already raising money, don’t you want to know why?"
Lin Yi was shaken and looked up at him: "You know the reason?"
"Of course!" Zhang Yang said, "Your father is an old fox in our business circles, even though he’s getting on in years, but he’s very shrewd; he must have guessed about you seeing some other boy, which is why he’s trying every means to stop you from dating other men!"
"You’re making things up!" Lin Yi frowned and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 920 - 939: Continue to Bewitch
chapters.content:
Chapter 920: Chapter 939: Continue to Bewitch
"Whether I’m talking nonsense or not, you can ask the boss of that little game company under Lin Corporation!"
"Lin Yi, if you really don’t believe it, you can check the company’s accounts," Zhang Yang continued to tempt.
Lin Yi was tempted: "Is everything you said true?"
"Of course!" Zhang Yang curled his lips, revealing a cunning smile, "As long as you agree to have dinner with me, this matter will be wiped clean."
Lin Yi frowned, hesitated: "But, my dad..."
"Leave Lin’s side to me."
"Fine, I accept your terms," Lin Yi said, "but you must not let a word of this slip out!"
"Ok."
Only then did Lin Yi sigh with relief, following Zhang Yang to sit down and began cutting the steak on her plate with a knife and fork.
Her mind had already wandered far away, completely oblivious to Zhang Yang chopping her steak into fine pieces and then discarding it...
Zhang Yang looked at the neatly cut steak and smiled contently with upturned lips.
This woman is really naive, thinking that he was really helping her, while he was merely using her!
"Lin Yi, how is it?" Zhang Yang looked at her.
"Hm? What?" Lin Yi was startled.
"You have quite a unique taste," Zhang Yang teased, "You ate so much steak just now and still want more!"
Lin Yi’s face flushed, she said angrily: "I’m not hungry, it’s just that the steak here is really good!"
"Really?" Zhang Yang said disdainfully, curling his lip, "I’ve been here before, and the steak is the worst! I remember the last time I brought my girlfriend here for dinner, her favorite was the lobster au gratin with foie gras sauce!"
Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat, and panic began to set in.
She knew Zhang Yang was no easy opponent, but she hadn’t expected him to investigate even this detail, let alone that he’d brought his girlfriend here before!
By doing so, had she not become a target?
Lin Yi suddenly felt nervous, biting her lip, she said: "Are you deliberately stirring up trouble between my father and me? Zhang Yang, you’re despicable!"
"Heh, this is called giving someone a taste of their own medicine," Zhang Yang sneered, "There’s no shortage of despicable people in this world!"
"You..."
Lin Yi was so angry her chest heaved violently.
"Lin Yi, I’m actually helping you here, and yet you repay kindness with ingratitude!" Zhang Yang put on an aggrieved expression, "I kindly found a solution for you, and this is how you treat me?"
Lin Yi bit her teeth, scoffed coldly, and ignored him.
She didn’t believe this matter would be exposed!
"Aren’t you speaking anymore? Didn’t you say you would have dinner with me?"
Lin Yi clenched her teeth, said: "What do you want to eat?"
"Anything, I’ll eat whatever you like," Zhang Yang shrugged.
"Then I’ll just pick something at random," Lin Yi said coldly.
Zhang Yang nodded.
At that moment, the waiter came up with a trolley, each dish was covered with a plate with a white cloth that looked like a layer of film.
Lin Yi glanced at it and realized all the food were her favorites!
Her pretty face turned somewhat pale.
Could this be Zhang Yang’s arrangement?
Lin Yi looked at Zhang Yang incredulously, what on earth did he want to do?!
"Miss Lin, aren’t you supposed to accompany me for dinner? Come on, eat up, I can hardly wait," Zhang Yang urged.
Lin Yi took a deep breath, picked up the knife and fork, and began cutting the steak.
Zhang Yang narrowed his eyes, thinking to himself, Lin Yi, you’re quite the clever one, aren’t you?
It seems you’re aware that my intentions aren’t pure, hence you chose such a cautious approach. But do you really think you can escape from the palm of my hand?
I’m no fool!
You wanted to know why? Well, I just won’t let you have your way!
...
After dinner, Lin Yi paid the bill and turned to leave.
Zhang Yang followed her: "What’s the rush?"
Lin Yi stopped in her tracks: "What do you want?"
"I don’t ask for much, I just hope to have the opportunity to spend a wonderful night with you!" Zhang Yang licked his lips.
Lin Yi frowned and remained silent.
"Miss Lin, surely you’re not going to refuse?" Zhang Yang feigned a hurt expression, "If that’s the case, then forget it. Just wait for someone to hunt you down."
Saying that, Zhang Yang strode towards the exit.
"Hey, don’t go!" called Lin Yi.
"What, changed your mind?" Zhang Yang stopped walking.
"I... just wait for me," Lin Yi hesitated for a few seconds before ultimately deciding to compromise.
"What are you up to?" Zhang Yang said with a grin, "Could it be, you really want to have dinner with me?"
Lin Yi’s face flushed red.
"If not, then forget it. It doesn’t matter anyway, I can handle it myself." Zhang Yang pretended to be angry and turned to leave.
"I’ll go with you," Lin Yi said helplessly.
Zhang Yang immediately stopped, grinning: "Miss Lin, that’s much better. Now we can go to the hotel together."
Lin Yi glared at him.
When they arrived at the hotel, Lin Yi checked into a room, and as she entered, Zhang Yang grabbed her arm.
"Let go of me!" Lin Yi snapped coldly.
"Don’t rush, let’s take a bath first!" Zhang Yang said, pulling her towards the bathroom.
"What are you doing! Let go!"
"Miss Lin, don’t forget, you’re the one who invited me!" he chided.
"Who said I invited you!"
"If not you, then who?" Zhang Yang chuckled mischievously, "Aren’t you Lin Uncle’s biological daughter, isn’t it you who invited me to dinner?"
Lin Yi was taken aback: "I’m dad’s biological daughter? You... how do you know?"
"Of course." Zhang Yang smiled, "It’s clearly written on your household registration book."
"But I have never been registered, nor taken any photos," Lin Yi frowned, growing more bewildered.
"Of course not, because that document has long been collected by your dad," Zhang Yang said with a smile, "You really pushed him into a corner, made him hide away the documents!"
"What documents?" Lin Yi asked.
"Heh," Zhang Yang didn’t answer, smiling as he opened the wardrobe, took out a box, and handed it to Lin Yi.
Inside the box lay a brand-new paper document. Before Lin Yi could react, Zhang Yang ripped the paper apart, shredding it, and then stuffed it into the nearby wastebasket.
"You bastard, how exactly did you find out my dad collected that document?" Lin Yi roared.
"Ha-ha, let me tell you, with this piece of paper, you’ll never be able to stir up any trouble. So, be a good girl for me. Not only can you help me get what I want, but you can also get what you desire. Why not enjoy it?"
Lin Yi trembled with rage.
This bastard! So despicable!
"Don’t worry, I won’t treat you badly, we can play games in bed, chat in bed, and even... roll in the sheets!"
Slap!
With a slap, Lin Yi knocked over a glass of red wine on the table.
Zhang Yang clutched his burning left cheek, glaring at her.
"Are you insane! This is a Five-Star hotel, if guests see this, we’re both dead!"

chapters.title: Chapter 921 - 940: Hooligan!
chapters.content:
Chapter 921: Chapter 940: Hooligan!
"I don’t care what damned hotel it is, I just want to hit you! You hooligan!" Lin Yi roared.
"Lin Yi, don’t go too far!" Zhang Yang grew angry too, grabbing Lin Yi’s arm and dragging her towards the sofa.
"Zhang Yang, I’m warning you, don’t go overboard, or do you believe I’ll scream indecency?!"
Zhang Yang sneered with a lopsided grin, grasping Lin Yi’s hands and leaning her against the sofa while pinning her down, looking down on her from above.
"Indecency? I’m actually looking forward to that!"
With these words, he leaned down, kissing Lin Yi.
"Uh..." Lin Yi was startled and desperately struggled.
Although this was not her first physical contact with a man, she had never done such a thing with one.
Her resistance was ineffective; her struggles were like tickling to Zhang Yang and posed no threat.
He easily pried open Lin Yi’s lips, recklessly conquering and invading, plundering her sweetness.
"Uh... No, help!" Lin Yi shook her head desperately, crying out in terror.
Zhang Yang laughed coldly.
Did she think this was her home, that screaming for help would do any good?
He didn’t believe so.
At that moment, he suddenly sensed something unusual, abruptly lifting his head only to find three additional figures in the room.
"Mr. Zhang, sorry to interrupt you!"
A young man in black stood at the door, offering an apology calmly, "However, your actions just now were excessively overboard, so we had to take action."
Zhang Yang scoffed: "Who do you think you are? You want to take my girlfriend away? Ask me if I agree first!"
"Sorry about this!" The man in black waved his hand, and the other two rushed in, surrounding Zhang Yang in the center.
Lin Yi felt a wave of relief.
She had already called the police; they just hadn’t arrived yet.
"Lin Yi, are you really the daughter of Mr. Lin?" Zhang Yang asked.
"Yes!" Lin Yi nodded firmly, "Let me go, or they will kill you."
Zhang Yang laughed: "Are you sure?"
Lin Yi gritted her teeth: "They won’t kill you, but I can’t make the same promise."
Zhang Yang glanced at the man in black and the other two, speaking coldly: "I don’t care who sent you, but I warn you, if you dare mess around, don’t blame me for being impolite!"
He was intentionally putting on a strong front, all to confuse Lin Yi.
"Ha ha!" The man in black laughed arrogantly, "Zhang Yang, you can’t fool me. If you’re really the daughter of Mr. Lin, why would your father entrust his documents to me for safekeeping."
"You..." Zhang Yang was at a loss for words, his face showing embarrassment.
"Zhang Yang, let me go, and I might consider cooperating with you," Lin Yi said.
"Ha ha ha... Your words sound so funny, what do you have to negotiate cooperation with me?"
Lin Yi bit her lip.
"Lin Yi, if you’re willing to be my mistress, I might consider helping you," Zhang Yang said.
"In your dreams!" Lin Yi cursed angrily, "I’d rather die than be your mistress."
The corners of Zhang Yang’s mouth curled into a chilling smile.
He reached out, grabbing Lin Yi’s neck, and lifted her up.
Lin Yi was terrified out of her wits.
She never thought that Zhang Yang would resort to violence so readily.
At that moment, she felt the breath of death.
Her heart pounded wildly, and her eyes instantly filled with tears.
She knew she was doomed.
She had never regretted getting involved with Zhang Yang before.
But now, she felt sorry for her old man.
"Mr. Zhang, don’t be rash, I was just joking!" The man in black hastily tried to stop him.
"Shut up!"
Zhang Yang gave him a cold glance and tightened his right hand around Lin Yi’s neck, squeezing hard and instantly making it difficult for her to breathe.
"Cough cough cough..." Lin Yi coughed violently, her eyes wide open, cheeks flushed, tears rolling down her fair skin.
