Seeing her tears, a sense of compassion inexplicably surged in Zhang Yang’s heart.
"Let her go!"
"Zhang Yang, have you gone mad? Let her go right now!"
Zhang Yang loosened his grip.
"Cough cough cough..." Lin Yi coughed desperately, her cheeks turning the color of liver.
Her breathing became difficult.
"Zhang Yang! You’re ruthless!" The man in black glared hatefully at Zhang Yang, then turned around and spoke in a low voice, "You all, step back!"
"Yes, young master!"
The black-clothed men responded and retreated.
After they left, Zhang Yang finally breathed a sigh of relief.
"Phew!"
Lin Yi exhaled heavily.
Just now, she truly felt the taste of death.
Her chest heaved violently, her complexion as pale as paper, tears continuously overflowing from the corners of her eyes, drenching her temples.
"Am I really going to die?" Lin Yi muttered to herself, tears streaming down.
Zhang Yang reached out to wipe the tears from her face, smiling, "Don’t be afraid, you’ll be fine."
"Thank... thank you..."
"Idiot." Zhang Yang gently stroked her head, "You’re my girlfriend, it’s only natural to protect you."
As he spoke, something suddenly occurred to him: "I want to know, how do you know Uncle Lin?"
Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat.
Uncle Lin... Uncle Lin...
The man who had raised her, the man she had admired for so long!
The name was like a needle, piercing into the depths of Lin Yi’s heart.
"Uncle Lin is my father!" Lin Yi bit her lip, silent for a long while before she finally choked out the words.
Zhang Yang was stunned, "What? You say he’s your father?"
There was some confusion in his heart; Uncle Lin was the mayor, Lin Yi was a big star, how could they be related?
Could it be...
Zhang Yang had a vague guess at the answer.
He suddenly felt some regret, he shouldn’t have pressured Lin Yi.
"Yes, he is my father!"
Lin Yi took a deep breath, holding back tears, "He passed away a long time ago!"
Zhang Yang was shocked, "He passed away?"
He suddenly realized that maybe things were not as simple as he had imagined.
He remembered Uncle Lin once told him Lin Yi’s mother had been an orphan before marrying him, picked up by Uncle Lin.
Back then, he just thought Uncle Lin was an ordinary father, who would surely take care of such a big daughter for life.
He never expected Uncle Lin to actually be Lin Yi’s father.
"Yes, he’s dead." Lin Yi’s eyes shimmered with tears, "He died suddenly from an illness! He got ill because of me!"
"I know, I know everything." Zhang Yang sighed, extending his hand to gently pat Lin Yi’s shoulder.
Lin Yi looked at him blankly, confused and surprised.
What’s with this guy? Why is he behaving so out of character?
She thought of Zhang Yang’s exquisite medical skills, but surely the news of Uncle Lin’s passing couldn’t be the cause of his grief!
"Don’t worry, Uncle Lin’s illness, though caused by you, didn’t actually harm his body." Zhang Yang smiled and said, "He just needs to adjust his condition, and he’ll be fine."
Lin Yi: "..."
What the hell is this guy talking about?

chapters.title: Chapter 922 - 941: Not Lying
chapters.content:
Chapter 922: Chapter 941: Not Lying
She looked at Zhang Yang with puzzlement but realized that his expression was very serious, and he was not lying.
Lin Yi’s mind suddenly flashed with insight, remembering something: "Is my father’s death related to you?"
Zhang Yang was startled.
This girl’s mind, how can it work so well!
Not only could she guess this, but she could also make connections to other aspects.
It seems like he really underestimated this little girl!
"How could you think that?" Zhang Yang feigned ignorance.
Lin Yi sneered: "I can be sure that my father’s death can’t be separated from you!"
"Lin Yi, don’t talk nonsense, he was killed by his enemies," the man in black rebuked sharply.
Lin Yi didn’t even glance at him, staring straight at Zhang Yang, and said in a deep voice: "Tell me, how did my father really die?"
Zhang Yang fell silent.
He really didn’t know how to answer this question.
"Zhang Yang, tell me the truth. I believe you’re not the petty minded person who forgets favors for profit!"
Lin Yi spoke with certainty, even with a hint of threatening in her tone.
Zhang Yang laughed bitterly and shook his head: "I really don’t know; if you don’t believe me, there’s nothing I can do."
"Then why don’t you dare to admit it?" Lin Yi sneered coldly.
"It’s not that I don’t dare, but I really don’t know. I also suspect it was the act of enemies, but I’ve found no clues!" Zhang Yang shrugged his shoulders, "I only know your father died at the hands of his enemy, but who exactly that enemy is, I don’t know."
Lin Yi said through gritted teeth: "Zhang Yang, I’m telling you, my father’s death definitely can’t be detached from you!"
Zhang Yang frowned: "Why would you say that?"
"You don’t have to quibble. If it wasn’t you, why wouldn’t you dare let me call you dad?" Lin Yi stared coldly at him, as if she was appraising an item of great value.
Zhang Yang gave a bitter smile.
This girl’s imagination really was rich; could she think he was her father?
"Lin Yi, your father’s death has nothing to do with me, you must believe this!" Zhang Yang said earnestly.
Lin Yi snorted coldly: "That kind of talk can only fool a three-year-old child!"
Zhang Yang was left speechless.
He didn’t know how to explain to her, nor did he know what to say.
He could only stand still and wait for her to finish speaking.
"Why won’t you admit it?" Lin Yi pressed on aggressively, "Are you feeling guilty? I’m telling you, if my father’s death has nothing to do with you, you would definitely be feeling guilty, definitely uneasy. I won’t be mistaken, you are the murderer!"
By the end, Lin Yi’s voice was almost a roar.
"Lin Yi, stop being unreasonable!" The man in black rushed forward to console her.
"Shut up!" Lin Yi shouted angrily, "Get out of my way, don’t think I don’t know what you’re planning!"
"I..." The man in black’s face flushed red, wanting to say something, but in the end, he said nothing.
He didn’t want it to be like this.
He had only wanted to use Lin Yi as a shield.
But who would have thought that Lin Yi would turn her suspicions towards Zhang Yang.
If Lin Yi really was related to Zhang Yang, then Zhang Yang certainly wouldn’t let him go, and his fate would likely be dire.
But if he said nothing, even if Zhang Yang didn’t act, Lin Yi would definitely hate him.
"You don’t have to say anymore. I already knew," Zhang Yang sighed, "Actually, I’ve been wanting to say this for a long time."
Lin Yi was stunned.
Zhang Yang continued: "I knew more than a year ago that your marriage with Lin Yuanfeng was a sham, you didn’t like each other at all, you only married him for money, you thought it was foolproof, but I know much more than you do."
Lin Yi’s pupils shrank abruptly: "How did you know?"
"Because Lin Yuanfeng wanted me to help him seize control of Lin Corporation, so he intentionally put on a show with you," Zhang Yang said lightly, "And besides, we also pretended to be spouses."
Lin Yi turned ashen, her hands trembling.
She never expected that her father’s death had something to do with this man!
Despicable!
This man is simply too despicable!
"How do you know my identity?" she asked, grinding her teeth.
"It’s not important how I know," Zhang Yang said calmly, "what’s important is, your father’s death is related to me!"
These words enraged Lin Yi completely. She screamed and lunged at Zhang Yang.
Zhang Yang had anticipated that she would attack and easily dodged.
Lin Yi raged, "You actually dared to kill my father!"
"He deserved to die; I did nothing wrong," Zhang Yang replied indifferently.
"He deserved to die, but I did nothing wrong!" Lin Yi shrieked, "You killed my father, and I won’t let you off!"
"Is that so?" Zhang Yang said indifferently, "You might as well try."
With that, his figure flickered, and he was already standing in front of the man in black.
He grabbed the man by the neck.
Lin Yi was petrified, stumbling backwards.
Zhang Yang kicked out.
Bang!
The man in black screamed out in pain, flying two meters away.
"You...you..." Lin Yi stood dumbfounded, in disbelief.
He actually made a move!
Lin Yi’s expression was a kaleidoscope of anger, fear, and confusion.
She had never imagined this man could be so violently ruthless, daring to be lethal even towards her bodyguard.
"You...you killed him?" Her voice trembled.
"He should feel lucky that I didn’t kill him; otherwise, he wouldn’t be lying in a hospital right now, but going to meet his old friend," Zhang Yang said coldly, "I’m warning you just once, don’t provoke me again, otherwise, don’t blame me for not being polite to you!"
Fear filled Lin Yi’s eyes.
She couldn’t believe that she was actually scared.
Zhang Yang sneered and turned to leave.
Lin Yi watched Zhang Yang’s retreating figure, silent for a long time.
She knew she was no match for Zhang Yang, who could even kill her at any moment!
"I will get my revenge on you!" After a while, she spoke through clenched teeth.
This man is a devil, he can’t be allowed to live!
Lin Yi silently swore in her heart.
She wanted to kill Zhang Yang and destroy everything!
Lin Yi returned home and found her parents were both there.
She walked into her room and sat on the bed.
"Yi’er, why are you home so late tonight?" Lin’s mother frowned, "Your dad and I have been waiting for a long time."
Lin Yi sat with her head down, burdened with heavy thoughts.
"What’s wrong? Did something happen?" Lin’s father asked.
"Nothing." Lin Yi gave a forced smile, "Maybe I just stayed up too late yesterday."
"Then you should go to rest. Your dad and I need to discuss some company matters in the study," Lin’s mother urged.
"Got it." Lin Yi nodded, then turned and headed for the door.
"Stop right there!" Suddenly, Lin Yi’s mother shouted angrily.
"Mom!" Lin Yi stopped in her tracks and turned to look at her mother.
"Kneel down!" Lin’s mother commanded sternly, "I must discipline you today!"
"Kneel down!" Lin Yi’s father also shouted, "If you refuse to kneel, don’t come back to the Lin Family anymore!"
Lin Yi clenched her teeth.
"Yi’er, did you have a fight with that man? I don’t think he seems like a bad person," Lin’s father said, puzzled.
Lin Yi remained silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 923 - 942 The Plan Did Not Succeed
chapters.content:
Chapter 923: Chapter 942 The Plan Did Not Succeed
She certainly knew that Zhang Yang was not a bad person, but she did not want to reveal that Zhang Yang was her husband.
After all, her plan with her father had not succeeded, and she did not want to be exposed!
Lin Yi knelt on the floor.
"Speak!" Mother Lin said angrily, "What exactly happened? Why did he suddenly find this place?"
"We..." Lin Yi hesitated.
Father Lin frowned and said, "Did he bully you? I’ll have someone throw him out immediately!"
Lin Yi quickly shook her head: "No, it’s not his fault! I... we broke up."
"What did you say?" Father Lin was so shocked he almost jumped up, "You broke up? What secret motives does that man have? Don’t worry, no matter the cost, I will avenge you!"
His attitude warmed Lin Yi’s heart, but she soon remembered her situation and displayed a sorrowful expression.
"He... he doesn’t love me; being together with him would just be a burden!" she choked.
"He doesn’t love you?" Father Lin was furious, "Are you blind? He’s so handsome, which girl wouldn’t love him? Besides, he is deeply devoted to you!"
Lin Yi forced a bitter smile: "I just don’t want to be a burden."
"What’s good about that man? Apart from being physically strong, he has no sense of romance and a terrible temper!" Father Lin said angrily, "I see he doesn’t truly like you, he just wants to use you!"
"No, I’m willing to believe him!" Lin Yi cried, "Although he sometimes seems annoying, he really treats me well!"
"You..." Father Lin was furious, but he couldn’t reveal his own plans, and could only be anxious.
"I really don’t deserve to be liked, he shouldn’t have to pay such a big price for me..."
"He treats you well for a reason!" Father Lin interrupted Lin Yi’s words, "Since you insist on not telling, then there’s nothing we can do, but I don’t care, I absolutely will not allow him to pursue you!"
"Dad! Don’t do this!" Lin Yi anxiously said, "He really treats me well, if you force me, it will make me very distressed... I’m just an ordinary person, I can’t bear his so-called affection!"
"You are my daughter! Would I harm you?" Father Lin shouted, "You’re not an ordinary person, you are the heir of the Lin Family, our Lin Family relies on you!"
"But... I..."
Mother Lin sneered: "You don’t need to but; just obey."
Lin Yi, feeling helpless, could only kneel on the floor.
Seeing this, Father Lin nodded his head in satisfaction: "Good, that’s more like it."
"Mom, I..." Lin Yi cried, "I want to move back to school, I want to study hard and try to get into college, then I will definitely marry a rich man!"
"Okay." Mother Lin agreed, "You just focus on studying at home."
Lin Yi breathed a sigh of relief.
Mother Lin snorted coldly and got up to leave the room.
Father Lin came over to help Lin Yi up, sighing, "You are too naive; his kindness to you has ulterior motives, don’t be fooled by him."
"Dad, no matter what, you all are my closest people, I don’t want to disappoint you, I don’t want to see you sad, so... I hope you can help me," Lin Yi pleaded, "Dad, I don’t want to be a sacrifice for the family’s interests."
Father Lin was stunned, then patted her shoulder, remaining silent.
"Alright, I’m going to pack my things." Lin Yi turned and walked into the bedroom.
She picked up her bag and walked into the bathroom.
"Yi’er!" Father Lin called out, "If he really treats you well, try being with him, Dad supports you!"
Lin Yi’s movements halted.
"Don’t refuse, our Lin Family owes Zhang Yang a lot, this is our only chance to repay him!" Father Lin said gravely.
"Okay, I promise you." Lin Yi nodded, "But you must promise me, don’t go against him."
"Go ahead." Father Lin waved his hand.
Lin Yi wiped away her tears and walked out of the bathroom.
"You can go." Father Lin told Mother Lin, "I’m going to the study to read."
"Alright, I’ll leave first then." Mother Lin said with a smile.
"Take care, I won’t see you out," Mr. Lin said.
After Mrs. Lin walked away, Mr. Lin’s smile instantly solidified.
He took out his phone and dialed a number.
"Hello, it’s Mr. Lin, yes, it’s me, I wanted to ask, how is the progress on your project?"
"The progress is good, we have completed two-thirds," a deep male voice came from the other end of the line, "Does Mr. Lin have any instructions?"
"Good!" Mr. Lin was thrilled, "I need you to wrap up this project within two days! Also, you must ensure that no one sabotages this bid!"
"Understood."
...
After hanging up the phone, Mr. Lin’s face became frighteningly somber.
He couldn’t believe Lin Yi dared to defy him.
He had thought that by leaking information in advance to the opposition, Lin Yi would definitely try his best to stop him from bidding, but unexpectedly, during this bid, Lin Yi had not a single word of complaint!
Mr. Lin felt uneasy.
Could there be something hidden he didn’t know?
At this moment, he began to contemplate this man.
He didn’t believe this man truly liked Lin Yi, nor did he think his intentions toward Lin Yi were sincere.
He just felt this man was very ambitious, wanting to use the Lin Family’s wealth to achieve his own goals!
His eyes narrowed, a decision forming in his heart.
...
After leaving home, Lin Yi didn’t go to work.
At this moment, she couldn’t focus on work.
Her mind was filled with thoughts of Zhang Yang, and the conversation she had had with her parents.
What exactly were Zhang Yang’s intentions toward her?
"No matter what his intentions are, it doesn’t matter, I’ve seen his true face now, and I’ll never pay him any heed again, not letting him hurt you!" Lin Yi vowed secretly, then took a taxi back to school.
On the way, the phrase continuously echoed in Lin Yi’s mind.
"No matter what his intentions are, it doesn’t matter, I’ve seen his true face now, and I’ll never pay him any heed again, not letting him hurt you!"
"I can’t let him deceive me anymore, not allowing him to ruin my happiness!"
...
Thinking this, she hastened her pace toward the school.
As she entered the academic building, she unexpectedly ran into a familiar figure--Su Jinmo.
"Mr. Su?" Lin Yi asked in confusion, "What are you doing here?"
Su Jinmo’s lips curled into a smile, he glanced at her and said lightly, "I just heard from your teacher that you’re resigning?"
"Yes, I won’t lie to you, I’m considering divorce," Lin Yi replied bluntly.
"Oh? Is it because you broke up with that Chen guy?" Su Jinmo asked.
"Yes, he and I are not compatible, I need a change of job," Lin Yi said.
"I can introduce you to a job, what do you think?" Su Jinmo suggested.
Lin Yi was stunned for a moment: "You know my classmate Chen Yi?"
Su Jinmo smiled: "He and I are also friends."
"Thank you," Lin Yi said politely.
"I still remember that banquet, you got drunk and I took you home, it was me who took care of you," Su Jinmo said, "You might want to consider it."
Lin Yi thought for a moment, but shook her head: "No, I don’t need it."

chapters.title: Chapter 924 - 943: No Regrets
chapters.content:
Chapter 924: Chapter 943: No Regrets
"Alright then." Su Jinmo shrugged, "I hope you find your happiness soon."
After saying that, he turned and left without any sign of reluctance.
Lin Yi watched his departing figure and suddenly felt a strange sensation, as if this man wasn’t as despicable as she had imagined.
Did he...
Truly like her and want to help her?
But who is he? What are his motives?
"Forget it, I can’t be bothered with such things!" Lin Yi shook her head and turned towards the classroom.
...
Weekend.
Zhang Yang rested in the dormitory for a night, woke up early the next day, washed up, had breakfast, and then left.
Though he was reluctant to believe Lin Yi, he was still a bit worried about her.
After all, she was an orphan with no one to rely on; outside she had to be cautious.
"Lin Yi, where are you?" Zhang Yang took a bus while texting Lin Yi.
Soon, Lin Yi replied to him.
[I’m home already, don’t worry, I’ll be fine.]
"Oh, then take care of yourself." Zhang Yang sent the message, then turned off his phone, ready to head to class.
Recently, he has been studying English and practicing daily, and now he has mostly mastered it; he felt it was time to go to school.
Upon entering the classroom, he found that everyone’s attitude towards him had become respectful.
"Hey, Zhang Yang, you’re not late today, did you go out stealing?"
A girl teased him, "You didn’t return last night and weren’t here this morning. You don’t know, your classmates were really worried about you, asking where you were."
Zhang Yang gave a wry smile and said, "I hope this doesn’t happen again."
"Don’t worry, we know your character, we won’t tell anyone, but if you have any problems, let us know so we don’t worry!"
"Yes, I understand."
After saying this, Zhang Yang took his textbook and sat down at his desk to continue reading.
...
After school in the afternoon, Lin Yi flagged down a taxi on the roadside and headed straight for home.
Lin Yi’s mother was overjoyed to see her daughter return, pulling her into the kitchen to prepare a sumptuous dinner, then urging her to go to bed early.
"Mom, don’t go to such trouble," Lin Yi said. "I’m not tired."
"You’re still young, of course, you’re not tired, but it’s different for mom. Mom is getting older, I don’t know how many years I have left, I just want to spend more time with you."
"Nonsense! You will live a long life!"
"Sweet child, don’t comfort me." Mother Lin sighed, "I know life has been tough, but at least I have you."
"Alright, alright, I’m going upstairs to sleep."
Lin Yi said and went upstairs to sleep.
Watching her daughter’s frail figure, Mother Lin sighed and then threw the kitchen knife into the trash can.
...
The next morning, Mother Lin got up early on purpose to prepare a nutritious breakfast and also brewed a soup.
She looked at the food on the table, her eyes becoming teary.
This was the daughter she had raised.
Her only family left was her daughter; how could she not cherish her?
"Mom, let me do it, you rest. Later dad can cook," Lin Yi suggested.
"No! I want to taste what I’ve cooked myself; otherwise, I’d rather not eat!" Lin Yi’s mother insisted on her own way.
Seeing her mother’s stubbornness, Lin Yi had no choice but to let her do as she wished.
After eating, Mother Lin began cleaning the room and then tidying up.
After busying herself for a long time, she finally stopped.
Mother Lin wiped the sweat from her forehead, then sat on the sofa and took a breath.
She took out a cardboard box and extracted a bottle of pills from it.
She took out two pills and swallowed them.
Soon, Mother Lin’s complexion gradually turned pale and eventually, she collapsed on the sofa, falling into unconsciousness.
...
Midnight.
Lin Yi’s mother slowly woke up, feeling an unbearable tightness and pain in her chest as if a force was rampaging through her body.
She reached out to grope around, and pulled a dagger from under the bed, plunging it fiercely into her abdomen!
Puff...
Blood instantly spurted out, staining Lin Yi’s clothes bright red.
"Ah..."
A wave of intense pain hit, and Lin Yi’s mother couldn’t hold on any longer and passed out.
As she collapsed, Zhang Yang also woke up.
He leapt up from the bed.
"Mom, Mom..."
Zhang Yang hastily ran out and was shocked to see Lin Yi’s mother lying in a pool of blood.
"Mom, Mom, wake up! Mom, please don’t scare me, please don’t scare me!"
Lin Yi knelt beside Lin Yi’s mother, crying and shouting.
"Mom..."
Using all his strength, Zhang Yang picked up Lin Yi’s mother and rushed outside; he had to save his mother and needed to find help fast.
...
Lin Yi rushed Lin Yi’s mother to the hospital and hurriedly went through the registration process.
Inside the hospital, the doctor examined her then said to Lin Yi, "The patient is about six weeks pregnant. Did she offend anyone?"
"I’m not sure, but she just had a miscarriage. I think she might have been stabbed by enemies chasing her," Lin Yi replied, looking down.
"How did she get injured?"
"I don’t know; all I know is that my mom got hurt and then she suddenly fainted."
"When did your mom get injured?" the doctor asked.
"Just last night, after she had been drinking."
The doctor frowned in thought, then asked, "How is your mom doing now?"
"I don’t know."
The doctor shook his head: "You’re her daughter, how could you not know her condition? How are you taking care of your mom!"
"I..." Lin Yi was at a loss for words; she was always busy with her studies, seldom went home, and hardly had time to spend with her mother.
"I’ll examine your mom again," said the doctor.
"No, no need, my mom, she’s okay," Lin Yi quickly declined.
"Your mom experienced a shock due to excessive blood loss; she just needs adequate nutrition to gradually recover, but she must rest quietly during this period to avoid severe bleeding!" the doctor advised.
"Yes, I understand!"
...
"Doctor, my mom, she..."
"Alright, I know. You can go and administer an IV, then take good care of her," the doctor waved his hand, signaling Lin Yi to leave.
"Thank you!"
Lin Yi bowed gratefully and then left the office.
"Whew... Lucky I reacted in time, otherwise, the consequences would’ve been unthinkable."
Lin Yi sighed in relief long.
Her parents were migrant workers, hardworking and frugal all their lives, never indulging in luxury. They hadn’t ever married or had children of their own.
Thus, she grew up solely dependent on her parents, cherishing this warmth.
So, in her heart, Lin Yi’s mother was just like her own mother, she couldn’t allow anything bad to happen to her at all!
Lin Yi returned to her mother’s room to see her mother lying on the bed, sleeping soundly.
Just then, Lin Yi suddenly heard the door move, and then a man walked in.
"Mom!" Lin Yi exclaimed.
The man turned his head to look at her.
"Who are you?"
The man asked looking at Lin Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 925 - 944: Walked Away Without Looking Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 925: Chapter 944: Walked Away Without Looking Back
"I am her daughter, my name is Lin Yi, and who might you be?" Lin Yi asked, perplexed.
"Your mother told me before she fell into a coma to take care of you. Are you Lin Yi?" the man asked.
"Yes, I am Lin Yi."
"Then you won’t be needing me. I’ll be leaving now. Just take good care of your mother," the man said with a cold smile.
"I won’t let you leave!" Lin Yi glared at the stranger. "I’m telling you, don’t think about taking advantage of my mother!"
"Ha, you’re really too cute," the man scoffed coldly. "You think I would like you? I’m telling you, I have a girlfriend already, and we are about to get married. I am your mother’s boyfriend now, understand?"
"Married?" Lin Yi was stunned. "You’re lying. How could you possibly have a girlfriend! You’re a liar!"
"Me, lying?" The man laughed. "I’m not deceiving you, I really do have a girlfriend. Believe it or not, that’s up to you."
After saying this, the man turned and walked away. Lin Yi panicked and hurriedly ran out to chase after him, to stop him.
"Stop right there!"
She shouted. The man glanced back at her indifferently and continued to walk away.
"Stop! You stop right there!" Lin Yi yelled.
The man walked out of the hospital without looking back.
"Stop! You stop right there!"
Lin Yi chased out of the hospital frantically, only to find that the man had long disappeared without a trace.
Lin Yi clenched her fists in anger, truly worried for her mother.
"Mom, I’m sorry," Lin Yi murmured to herself.
...
"Miss, you’re still keeping vigil at the hospital? You should get some rest. Your mother will be fine," a nurse said to Lin Yi with concern.
"Thank you, I’m not tired. You should go back and rest early too," Lin Yi responded with a faint smile.
After the nurse left, Lin Yi stayed a while longer, making sure her mother was truly alright before she went home feeling relieved.
Early the next day, Uncle Zhang came to the hospital and told Lin Yi that her mother was fine and that she didn’t need to worry.
"Uncle Zhang, thank you. I will take good care of my mother."
"Silly child, your mother is my old customer. How could I not care for her?"
"Alright, I’m leaving now. Call me if you need anything."
"Okay!" Uncle Zhang saw Lin Yi off, watching her retreating figure and heaved a sigh.
He knew that Lin Yi’s family was not wealthy. Although they had a good son-in-law who was a boss, he couldn’t bring any help to Lin Yi.
He also understood that such things required not only fate but also opportunity.
Therefore, Uncle Zhang did not press the matter and let Lin Yi seek out her own opportunities. He hoped Lin Yi would find the happiness that truly belonged to her!
"Miss, you look really beautiful today," Uncle Zhang sincerely complimented.
"Really? I thought I became an ugly monster after wearing high heels," Lin Yi joked.
"How could that be?" Uncle Zhang laughed.
Lin Yi laughed as well. She got along well with Uncle Zhang, which was a comfort to her.
"By the way, miss, why didn’t you stay at home last night and insist on staying here?"
"I wanted to take care of my mother at home for a few more days, but she said she wanted to go home to have a look, so I came out with her," Lin Yi lied.
Uncle Zhang was taken aback, then sighed, "Well, since the lady insists on going back, let her go."
"Anyway, I have something else to attend to, so I’ll be leaving first." Lin Yi hurried to the bus stop.
"Ah! It’s so late, where could a girl like her be going?"
Watching Lin Yi board the bus and leave, Uncle Zhang could not help but sigh.
...
After getting on the bus, Lin Yi immediately contacted her brother.
Lin Yi was the only child of the Vice President and Chairman of Lin Corporation, youthful, accomplished, and handsome, with a significant reputation throughout the capital. However, due to her reclusive nature, she rarely attended various gatherings or business events, so she was seldom seen in public.
At that moment, Lin Yi was at home, looking at her brother with red-rimmed eyes.
"What’s wrong? Why are you crying?" Lin Hao looked at his sister with surprise, asking in confusion.
"Brother..." Lin Yi threw herself into Lin Hao’s arms, sobbing uncontrollably.
"Don’t cry. Tell your brother what’s wrong," Lin Hao said as he patted Lin Yi’s back, trying to soothe her with his gentle voice.
"I can’t accept this... Sob... I really can’t accept it... Sob..." Lin Yi wept.
"You silly girl, honestly, it’s all in the past. What are you caught up on now?" Lin Hao sighed. He knew his sister had been wronged, but what could he do?
He was just an ordinary citizen without money or power; he had no way to help his sister seek revenge.
"Brother, I can’t accept this..."
"Alright, there, don’t cry," Lin Hao comforted Lin Yi as he wiped away the tears on her cheeks.
"Brother, I’m so sad," Lin Yi cried.
"There, there, stop crying. If you continue, your eyes will swell, and if your makeup gets ruined, you won’t look pretty," Lin Hao gently persuaded.
"I look so ugly now, sob..."
"Nonsense!" Lin Hao glared at his sister. "In my eyes, you’re always the most beautiful."
Lin Yi broke into a tearful smile. "Brother, thank you. You are the best brother in the world."
"Alright, alright, go wash your face," Lin Hao said with a smile as he pushed Lin Yi into the bathroom.
When Lin Yi came out from the bathroom, she saw her parents sitting on the sofa reading the newspaper.
Lin Yi hurried over: "Dad, Mom, how come you’re back?"
"What do you mean, how come we’re back?"
"Of course, we came to pick you up. Have you forgotten the promise you made to your father about coming home?" Lin Yi’s father glared at her.
"Oh, sorry, Mom and Dad, I forgot," Lin Yi said, lowering her head.
"Forget it, forget it. You’ve been out long enough; it’s time for you to return."
"I... I’ll stay with mom for a little longer, until she feels better, and then I’ll go back," Lin Yi pleaded.
"This is not up for discussion!" Lin Yi’s mother said in a cold voice.
"Please let me stay a little longer, Mom. I promise I won’t cause any trouble. I am really very filial; please agree," Lin Yi begged, holding her mother’s hand.
"You think by doing this, I would let you off the hook? I’m telling you, that’s impossible," her mother said coldly.
"Mom... how can you be like this?" Lin Yi frowned.
"Now you think you have a point, is that it?"
"I..." Lin Yi bit her lip and fell silent.
"I’m warning you, Lin Yi, if I find out you have anything to do with that despicable man again, I definitely won’t let you off the hook," Lin Yi’s mother threatened.
"I..."
"Alright, we are leaving now. You take care of your mother," Lin Hao said to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi nodded.
After Lin Yi’s mother and Lin Hao left, Lin Yi immediately phoned Lu Xiuwen; the phone only rang twice before Lu Xiuwen answered.
"Hello, how are you doing?"
"What else can I be doing? Obviously, you’ve worn me out."
"You..."
"Hmph, don’t think I don’t know you’re testing me. I’m telling you, I’m not afraid of anything. I just want you to see how formidable I am. I’m telling you, my patience is limited. I’m giving you one last day to think it over; I’ll come to see you tomorrow." Having said that, Lu Xiuwen hung up the phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 926 - 945: Sooner or Later Will Notice
chapters.content:
Chapter 926: Chapter 945: Sooner or Later Will Notice
Listening to the dial tone on the other end, Lin Yi gripped her phone tightly, clenching her teeth and staring out the window.
"Damn Lu Xiuwen! I won’t let you get away with this!"
...
Lin Yi spent the whole night tossing and turning, haunted by the images of her humiliation. Unable to sleep, she got up and took a shower, then called her mother and asked her to bring her clothes to wear.
She knew she had to leave quickly, otherwise, Lu Xiuwen would eventually catch on.
...
The next day, Lin Yi got up early. After breakfast, she was ready to leave.
But her mother stopped her.
"Yi, you can’t leave!"
Her mother said solemnly, looking at her beloved daughter.
"Mom, I really have an emergency."
"You foolish girl, do you think Lu Xiuwen will forgive you? Will he let you stay by his side?"
"Mom, what are you talking about?"
"Yi, Lu Xiuwen is a jerk. He’s just using you. He’s dumped you now, and he’ll find other women to play with in the future. You’re young and beautiful; you can’t just ruin yourself like this," her mother advised earnestly.
"Mom, stop it, I’ve already decided," Lin Yi insisted.
"Ah..."
Her mother took a deep breath, helplessly shook her head, "Well, since you say so, I won’t force you."
"Thank you, Mom." Lin Yi looked gratefully at her mother.
"What are you thanking me for?"
"You’re too good to me."
"Silly child, I only have one daughter. If I’m not good to you, then who would I be good to?" her mother said lovingly while stroking Lin Yi’s head.
...
After leaving home, Lin Yi headed straight for the downtown area.
Racing against time, she finally arrived at the airport before ten o’clock.
Before the plane landed, Lin Yi called Lu Xiuwen and asked him to pick her up at the airport.
Half an hour later, Lu Xiuwen arrived at the airport on time.
Dressed in a black suit, Lu Xiuwen stood out among the crowd at the airport entrance.
Seeing Lu Xiuwen, Lin Yi breathed a sigh of relief and hurried towards him.
"Mr. Lu, thank you for picking me up," Lin Yi said with a smile to Lu Xiuwen.
"Hah, I didn’t say I was here to pick you up. It was my secretary who came to get me," Lu Xiuwen scoffed.
"Really? But that’s not a secretary; that’s a driver."
"It was me who sent the driver to pick you up at the airport."
"What? It was you!"
"If you say it was me, then so be it. I’m the boss, what I say goes," Lu Xiuwen said provocatively.
"You..."
"What, you think you can do something to me?" Lu Xiuwen said laughingly.
"You... I don’t want to argue with you, come on, let’s hurry to the hotel," Lin Yi said through clenched teeth.
...
In the hotel.
Lin Yi looked around the unfamiliar room, anger rising to her head, "Why did you bring me to a hotel? Didn’t you say we were not familiar enough to stay in the same room?"
Lu Xiuwen shrugged his shoulders and said, "I only said I don’t like living under the same roof with women I don’t know. But I didn’t say we can’t stay in the same room, so you should be in a suite in the hotel right now."
"But why did you bring me here?"
"Heh, it may not be as luxurious as other hotels, but it’s quiet and there won’t be paparazzi chasing us here, and it’s also free of charge."
Lin Yi was stunned, not expecting Lu Xiuwen to have investigated the situation here so thoroughly.
"Alright, you will stay here temporarily today, and don’t think about running away. If I find you’re not here, you’re dead."
"You..." Lin Yi was taken aback, she didn’t expect Lu Xiuwen to treat her this way.
Lu Xiuwen looked at Lin Yi with a slight smile and said, "Don’t worry, I won’t touch you, because you are of no value to me now."
Hearing this, Lin Yi felt a pain in her heart, her eyes turning red.
She wasn’t a fool and naturally knew what Lu Xiuwen meant.
"Don’t worry, I won’t touch you, but don’t even think about escaping. I can have someone bring you back anytime," Lu Xiuwen said with a sinister laugh.
Lin Yi took a deep breath, suppressing the anger welling up inside her, and said with her head lowered, "I won’t run."
Seeing that Lin Yi was no longer resisting him as before, Lu Xiuwen nodded in satisfaction, "Then rest well, I’m heading to the company."
"Okay, sure," Lin Yi responded indifferently.
Lu Xiuwen walked out of the room, closed the door, and then went to his car, got in, fastened his seatbelt, and then took out his mobile phone to call Lu Xiuwen, "Hello, sir, I’ve already tricked Lin Yi into the hotel."
"Good, you’ve worked hard."
"It’s nothing, I’ll go check if she hasn’t returned to school yet. If not, then let’s start our operation."
"Alright."
...
Half an hour later, Lin Yi received a phone call from the school.
"Lin Yi, do you still remember me, your class teacher?"
"Of course, I remember, what’s the matter?" Lin Yi asked, puzzled.
"Are you still in class?"
"Yes, what’s up?"
"Oh, do you have time this afternoon? Could you come to the school?"
Lin Yi was startled, not knowing what the school wanted with her, but since the teacher asked her to come, she agreed.
"Alright, I’ll be there at three o’clock. Where should I meet you?"
"Okay, that’s settled."
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi frowned.
Why did Lu Xiuwen want her to go to school? Could it be that he already discovered she was not the same Lin Yi as before? Impossible, she had been very discreet. How could she have been noticed?
Thinking about this, Lin Yi felt even more uneasy.
By 5 p.m., Lin Yi arrived at the school and found the school office building.
Outside the office building, there were several police cars parked at the entrance.
Seeing the police cars, Lin Yi was taken aback; she never expected Lu Xiuwen to actually call people to arrest her.
As Lin Yi was thinking about how to escape, two police officers exited the office building.
"Lin Yi, please come with us," one of the officers said to her.
Hearing this, Lin Yi immediately shook her head in panic, "Mr. Police Officer, I don’t understand what you mean."
"We suspect you are colluding with Lu Xiuwen in an attempt to murder the young master of the Lu Family. Please come with us to assist with the investigation," the officer said.
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s expression changed.
"Lin Yi, what are you hesitating for? Hurry up and come with us," another officer urged.
"You... why are you treating me this way?"
Lin Yi was full of doubts; she couldn’t understand what Lu Xiuwen was plotting.
"Lin Yi, please cooperate with our work."
As Lin Yi was about to argue, another officer grabbed her.
"Lin Yi, you’d better come with us quietly, or else we will call the police and charge you with obstruction of justice!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi shuddered, her face turning pale. She never imagined Lu Xiuwen would actually do this.
Seeing the fearful expression on Lin Yi’s face, the officer smiled satisfactorily, leading Lin Yi to the police car.
The car remained silent as it arrived in front of a high-end villa.

chapters.title: Chapter 927 - 946: Do Not Let Down Young Master Lu’s Expectations
chapters.content:
Chapter 927: Chapter 946: Do Not Let Down Young Master Lu’s Expectations
Lin Yi followed two police officers out of the car and walked into the villa.
"Lin Yi, this place is the Lu residence, where every servant won’t lie to you. I hope you won’t let down Young Master Lu’s expectations."
After finishing their words, the two officers turned and left, leaving Lin Yi alone in the living room.
"Lin Yi, Young Master Lu is already waiting for you in the study. Please follow me," said a uniformed middle-aged man, with an imposing face, descending from the staircase.
"Alright, I’ll follow you to the study."
"Please," the middle-aged man gestured.
Lin Yi walked in front, with the middle-aged man leading the way ahead of her.
Following the middle-aged man, Lin Yi kept quiet during their walk, as he solemnly led the way without a word.
Lin Yi was secretly shocked; she had not expected Lu Xiuwen to send a bodyguard to escort her, and even more so, to show such respect to this middle-aged man. It seemed that Lu Xiuwen really trusted this person.
"Knock knock!" The study door was knocked on.
"Come in." A steady voice came from inside.
Lin Yi pushed open the door and walked in, spotting a handsome and compelling face at a glance. His figure was very robust, dressed in a black shirt and black trousers, exuding a mature male charm.
"Young Master Lu," Lin Yi softly called out.
Lu Xiuwen nodded, "Have a seat."
"Thank you." Lin Yi politely thanked him and sat down.
"Lin Yi, you must already know why I asked you to come to my home," Lu Xiuwen asked directly and to the point.
Lin Yi nodded, how could she not know?
Her heart was filled with confusion.
"I think you’re also aware of the feud between the eldest heir of the Lu Family and our family. I won’t hide it from you—our Lu Corporation is currently facing some troubles, and you, it happens, have a close relationship with Young Master Lu. Tell me, what kind of harm would it do to the Lu Family if I were to expose this matter?" Lu Xiuwen questioned.
Hearing this, Lin Yi was utterly shocked.
She thought she had been cautious, but she was careless after all. She never imagined that she would fall into Lu Xiuwen’s trap.
She could not believe that Lu Xiuwen would use such despicable means to threaten her.
"Young Master Lu, I..." Lin Yi hesitated.
"There’s no need to worry, I will ensure your safety," Lu Xiuwen said with a slight smile.
Lin Yi bit her lip, unable to speak a word.
"Young Master Lu, why are you doing this? Is it just because I resemble Lu Xiuwen’s girlfriend?" Lin Yi couldn’t help but ask.
Lu Xiuwen snorted coldly at her question, "Do you think you’re that pretty?"
Hearing this, Lin Yi’s heart skipped a beat.
Was Lu Xiuwen insulting her?
"You..."
"Yes, I do like beautiful girls, which is why I want to marry you. But you’re ungrateful," Lu Xiuwen sneered.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi became so angry her face turned red.
"You’re talking nonsense!"
Seeing her reaction, Lu Xiuwen’s smile grew thicker, "Don’t get excited; I’m speaking the truth. Do you think you can hold a candle to even one of Lu Xiuwen’s toes?"
At these words, Lin Yi exploded in anger, "You jerk! I’m not someone you can insult!"
"Lin Yi, don’t think I won’t dare to expose this. I assume you wouldn’t want to see this news spread, right?" Lu Xiuwen threatened.
At his words, Lin Yi’s body stiffened, her face turning deathly pale.
"What will it be? How do you choose now?" Lu Xiuwen asked with a smile.
Lin Yi hung her head low, struggling internally.
She couldn’t bear it; she didn’t want to be controlled by Lu Xiuwen, but she was also afraid of losing this opportunity, after all, she still needed money for her father’s medical treatment.
"Mr. Lu, please forgive my bluntness, your offer is too tempting." Lin Yi looked up, fixed her gaze on Lu Xiuwen, and enunciated every word, "I can help you, but, I can’t let you touch me."
Upon hearing this, the corners of Lu Xiuwen’s mouth lifted into a playful smile.
"Fine."
Lin Yi looked confused, unsure of what he was plotting.
Lu Xiuwen took out a delicate box from a drawer and tossed it onto the coffee table.
"This is the betrothal gift prepared by the Lu Family for you, you may want to consider it."
Upon seeing the box, a bad premonition surged in Lin Yi’s heart.
She instinctively stretched out her hands and took the box into her possession.
The moment she opened the lid, she was completely stunned.
A huge diamond necklace lay quietly inside the box, sparkling with dazzling brilliance.
"My God!" Lin Yi couldn’t help but exclaim, this was simply a priceless treasure!
Although she was a wealthy miss, her family was not wealthy, hardly enough for even a hundred dollars a year.
This was a dowry from the Lu Family for her; Lin Yi felt somewhat unable to accept it at the moment.
"Mr. Lu, are you deliberately making things difficult for me? This dowry is too valuable, I can’t accept it."
"No." Lu Xiuwen said decisively, "You can only accept this dowry, otherwise, I will give it to the media."
Hearing Lu Xiuwen’s threat, Lin Yi had to resign herself to fate; she didn’t want to see her parents in trouble.
Thus, she took the ring, turned, and walked away; she wanted to leave this damned place immediately.
"Hold on." Lu Xiuwen suddenly called out to her, "This is a decision you have to make today."
Lin Yi stopped in her tracks, a inexplicable rage welling up in her heart, but she forcibly suppressed her inner anger.
Lu Xiuwen picked up a pen from the desk and placed a contract in Lin Yi’s hands.
"From now on, you’re my fiancée, I will provide you with enough money, but you have to agree to three demands from me."
Looking at the contract in her hands, Lin Yi’s scalp tingled, a strong sense of unease swelled in her heart; she felt as though she had fallen into a vast conspiracy.
Lin Yi no longer wasted words, secured the contract, and left Lu Xiuwen’s villa.
Lu Xiuwen watched Lin Yi’s departing figure, revealing a triumphant smile.
He never failed to get what he wanted!
Lu Xiuwen sat on the sofa with crossed legs, a malevolent smile on his lips.
Lin Yi walked out of Lu Xiuwen’s villa, her face pale.
This was the most foolish decision she had ever made in her life.
She thought she could make Lu Xiuwen fall in love with her with her beauty and family background; she never expected to be used by him like a pawn!
She was really too naive!
Lin Yi took a deep breath, striving to calm her emotions; regardless, Lu Xiuwen was her only choice.
Indeed, Lu Xiuwen was her best choice; she couldn’t let her parents suffer any harm.
That night, Lin Yi was sleepless.
In her mind, she kept seeing scenes of being bullied, thinking of Lu Xiuwen’s lecherous expression made her shudder with disgust.
The next morning, Lin Yi got up, washed up, and hurried to the company.
As soon as Lin Yi arrived at the office, she received a call from the company’s director Wang Xiaoyun.
"Hello, Lin Yi, Mr. Lu asked me to inform you that you can move into the Lu Family villa tomorrow, but..."
Wang Xiaoyun hesitated, looked around, and seeing no one, continued in a lowered voice, "Remember to bring a few room cards with you."
"Oh." Lin Yi replied indifferently.

chapters.title: Chapter 928 - 947: Knowing How to Behave
chapters.content:
Chapter 928: Chapter 947: Knowing How to Behave
"Also, here’s ten thousand in cash, the pin is 123456. Just deposit the money into the bank account to get your deserved compensation," Wang Xiaoyun continued."Got it, I’ll take care of it right away," Lin Yi said.
After hanging up the phone, Lin Yi began to plan moving into the Lu Family home the next day.
The next morning.
While dressing, Lin Yi thought about what to bring over the next day and absentmindedly twisted his tie.
Just then, Lin Yi’s phone rang.
He looked down to see an unfamiliar number.
Lin Yi pressed the answer button.
"Little Lin, it’s me," came a kind voice from the other end.
"Mom..." Lin Yi called out.
Lin’s mother chuckled, "I heard you had dinner with that male classmate of yours last night. How was it? Did you two get along?"
"Pretty well, Mom, don’t worry, I know how to behave," Lin Yi replied softly.
"Good. Come on home now, your father and I are going back to your grandmother’s house," Lin’s mother said.
"Okay."
After hanging up, Lin Yi immediately changed into clean clothes and left the Lin Corporation with his bag.
...
Driving all the way to the suburb, he saw a standalone courtyard house appear before his eyes. Gazing at the familiar buildings within the courtyard, ripples of emotion surged in Lin Yi’s heart.
This was where his mother had lived before she passed away, and he had been raised here from a young age.
Therefore, Lin Yi cherished deep nostalgia for this place.
Lin’s mother’s car was parked outside the courtyard.
It was a four-story Western-style building, very elegant and had an ancient charm.
Walking into the villa, Lin Yi was stunned by the interior decors.
It was like a palace, luxurious throughout, with everything made from top-tier wood, the floors paved with mutton-fat jade, and the carved walls adorned with diverse paintings.
Lin Yi’s eyes were searching for something everywhere, but to no avail.
"Who painted this?" Lin Yi walked to the window, gazing at a calligraphic painting hung on the windowsill.
The painting was personally done by a handsome young artist named Li Qing, who was said to be a highly respected artist, but for some unknown reason, he suddenly disappeared without trace, and no matter how much Lin Yi inquired, he couldn’t get any information.
Lin’s mother came over, patting Lin Yi on the shoulder with a smile, "You’ve been living with us for so many years, you naturally aren’t familiar with these antique calligraphies and paintings. This painting, I had it specially commissioned."
Saying so, Lin’s mother picked up a painting hanging on the wall beside her and pointed to the young artist in the painting, saying to Lin Yi, "Look, this is Li Qing."
"Let me see."
Lin Yi took the painting Lin’s mother offered and examined it carefully.
His gaze lingered on the painting for a moment, then immediately looked up at Lin’s mother.
"Mom, where did you find this painting? It’s been a very long time since anyone touched this painting."
"Don’t worry about it too much, in any case, I bought it from someone else – your father Lin Guodong."
"What?"
Lin Yi exclaimed in surprise, "You’re saying, my father was painted by Li Qing?"
Lin’s mother nodded her head.
"Impossible!" Lin Yi widened his eyes in shock.
"You see, the young man in this painting looks exactly like your father. Also, I asked him, and his old friend Li Qing. He said he has never seen such a young artist like your father, and he also said that Li Qing hasn’t painted for eighteen years. He said your father was very talented, so he gave him the painting to study it well."
Lin’s mother paused, then continued, "Your father has been single for so many years and is unwilling to marry, you should understand his difficulties. Don’t you think so?"
Although Lin’s mother didn’t like Lin Yi, she knew that only self-interest could tie Lin Yi down, so she tried her best to win Lin Yi’s favor, to make her utterly devoted to her.
She hoped that Lin Yi would marry into a wealthy family and live a life of luxury.
"Mom, I understand. Don’t worry, I will take good care of myself," Lin Yi nodded, her tone very respectful.
"Good," Lin’s mother smiled contentedly and then turned and left.
"Hmph, ungrateful," Lu Xiuwen, who had been spying from a distance, sneered coldly and turned to leave.
...
Lin Yi returned to her apartment, got herself ready, changed into a new set of clothes, carefully made up, and then set off for Lu Corporation.
When Lin Yi arrived at Lu Corporation, Lu Xiuwen hadn’t yet come, so she waited in the lounge for a while until a group of staff members came to escort her up.
Upon reaching Lu Xiuwen’s office, Lin Yi found Lu Xiuwen reading the newspaper seriously, an image of concentration that made Lin Yi think of the hero-saving-the-beauty scenarios described in novels.
Lu Xiuwen put down the newspaper and looked up at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi was wearing a pink tank top, black skinny jeans, and a pair of white canvas shoes.
This attire was simple, fresh, and playful, completely different from the usual professional skirt suit and aristocratic elegance that Lin Yi wore, making her stand out.
"So you are Lin Yi?" Lu Xiuwen stood up and said to Lin Yi, "Lin Yi, these next few days, you will report to the finance department to start work. When the time comes, I will arrange your duties and you’ll know what to do."
"Yes, President."
Lin Yi bowed slightly, looking very obedient.
"Go," Lu Xiuwen said indifferently.
"Yes, President."
Lin Yi turned and walked out of the office, a sly smile curling up at the corner of her mouth.
Lu Xiuwen, you think you can have me join the company? Not a chance!
Lin Yi went to the reception desk, gave her instructions, and took her work badge to the finance department.
"Hello, may I ask who you are looking for?" The receptionist asked politely.
"Hello, my name is Lin Yi, please take good care of me in the future," Lin Yi said with a smile.
"Oh, so you are Secretary Lin, welcome to join us."
"Thank you."
"What work do you need?"
"I’d like to have a tour of the company."
"Okay, please follow me," said the receptionist.
Lin Yi followed the receptionist, step by step towards the interior of the company.
The interior of the company was very vast, comparable to the headquarters of Lin Corporation.
"Secretary Lin, please follow me this way," the receptionist led Lin Yi to the other side of the office, where the President’s office was located. In front of the office, there were two small partitions, one for the finance department and one for the sales department.
The personnel in the sales department all knew Lin Yi and greeted her very politely. After all, Lin Yi’s credentials were there for all to see - she was the young lady of the Lin Family, and these lower-level employees naturally didn’t dare to neglect her.
"Secretary Lin, the President’s office is on the third floor," the receptionist said with a smile.
"Thank you."
"You’re welcome."
The receptionist left with a smile.
Lin Yi headed towards the third floor and at the corner of the third floor, she encountered a man dressed in a suit and tie.
The man had handsome features and a tall figure, appearing rather dignified, but his face was sullen, with a strong air of hostility in his brows.
"Hello, may I ask who you are?" Lin Yi asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 929 - 948: Not Interested in Finance
chapters.content:
Chapter 929: Chapter 948: Not Interested in Finance
"Are you Lin Yi?" The man looked Lin Yi up and down.
"Mhm." Lin Yi nodded slightly.
"I’m sorry, there’s no job for you at the moment. You should go to the finance department first, the treatment there is better than for others," the man said with a firm tone.
Lin Yi’s heart stirred, but his face revealed no emotion, and he replied gently, "Okay, thank you."
When Lin Yi arrived at the finance department, they were in a meeting. Upon seeing Lin Yi, everyone stood up and shouted in unison, "Secretary Lin."
Lin Yi waved at everyone, smiled, nodded in acknowledgment, and then sat down.
The head of the finance department stepped out of the meeting room, looked at Lin Yi with a benevolently smiling face, and said, "Secretary Lin, you will be in charge of the finance department from now on. If you need anything, just let me know and I will arrange it for you."
Lin Yi shook his head: "No need, Director. I’m not interested in finance. Please assign someone else."
The director was taken aback.
"Is there a problem?" Lin Yi asked, looking puzzled.
"No, no problem at all. Since Secretary Lin said so, I won’t insist. But, please remind me immediately if there is any issue. You are the secretary personally appointed by the CEO, and he would definitely criticize me if there’s any problem," the director said with a smile.
Lin Yi smiled and rolled his eyes secretly.
She now understood why so many people were eager to work at Lu Corporation. Not only was the salary high and the treatment superior, but the working environment was also much better compared to smaller companies, making it more comfortable and convenient.
Lin Yi thought that he could learn some management experience here and, once he was familiar with the job, he could resign and go help his grandfather at Lin Corporation.
After making up her mind, Lin Yi stood up and said, "Since the director trusts me so much, I will definitely work hard."
"All right, I need to go now," the director said and then walked into the meeting room.
Lin Yi looked at the people in the meeting and frowned slightly.
The meeting was led by a manager named Chen Kaiwen, a middle-aged chubby man with a large mole on his face, looking rather unsophisticated.
Chen Kaiwen sat in the central seat at the conference table, with an older man standing next to him, Liu Hao, the executive director of Lu Corporation.
"Ladies and gentlemen of the board, this is Secretary Lin, whom I have just hired from overseas. Let’s welcome Secretary Lin!" Chen Kaiwen announced with a smile.
Everyone clapped in unison.
Lin Yi also stood up, smiled, and nodded in acknowledgment to everyone.
Then Liu Hao read out a series of procedures, and afterwards, Lin Yi was placed on a sofa in the CEO’s office.
Looking around, Lin Yi couldn’t help but marvel at the luxury. Just the coffee table must be worth tens of thousands, right?
Such luxurious desks probably only appear in television dramas.
As she thought about it, she sat on the soft sofa and closed her eyes to rest.
However, Lin Yi soon fell asleep.
She slept straight until past four in the afternoon. She rubbed her sleepy eyes, stood up, and prepared to go out for a meal, but just as she reached the door, she heard noises of quarrels, crying, and cursing.
Lin Yi’s brow furrowed slightly, following the sounds, and saw Chen Kaiwen slapping a girl across the face, angrily shouting, "Why are you crying?"
"Wuu... I want to die..." The girl cried even harder.
"You want to die? Then jump, see who dies faster!" Chen Kaiwen glared at the girl fiercely, anger flashing in his eyes.
"I... I can’t jump..." The girl said softly.
"If you can’t jump, then learn. Anyway, you have the money," Chen Kaiwen snorted coldly.
Lin Yi stood by, frowning even more deeply.
Although Lin Yi was only a sophomore, he had been trained from a young age, so ordinary people couldn’t get near him.
"Lin Yi, splash that coffee on that girl!" Chen Kaiwen suddenly turned his head, looked at Lin Yi, and commanded coldly.
Lin Yi glanced at the girl, who was wearing a white blouse, her neck and chest bare, her cheeks flushed and particularly enticing.
"Yes!" Lin Yi answered indifferently.
Lin Yi put his hand by his mouth and whistled; a thug immediately ran over.
Lin Yi looked at the thug: "Do you know what you’re supposed to do?"
The thug was startled, then quickly nodded: "I know, I know, I won’t let you down!"
Lin Yi patted his shoulder, saying, "Then go ahead, I guarantee no one will pursue this."
Hearing this, the thug was overjoyed and ran to the girl. Without a word, he picked up the coffee and threw it all over her.
The girl screamed and scrambled out of the office.
"You..." Chen Kaiwen glared at the thug.
Lin Yi glanced at him, saying, "Minister, it’s fine, no one will blame you."
"Hmph, I couldn’t care less about him," Chen Kaiwen snorted.
Lin Yi smiled, then turned and left.
Lin Yi walked outside the company and saw a car parked not far away. Lin Yi smiled slightly and walked over to open the passenger door and sat inside.
"Little Yi, you finally came. I thought you didn’t want to come to the company," Situ Haoyue said with a slight smile.
"Sorry, Master, I received a last-minute notice that I needed to go back home, so it took some time," Lin Yi said.
"It’s alright, visiting your mother is important. I’m not in a hurry, take your time going home," Situ Haoyue said.
"Okay, I’ll leave in a moment," Lin Yi said.
Situ Haoyue paused slightly, looked at Lin Yi, then sighed, "Would you like to come stay with me at the estate?"
"No need, I’m used to living at home," Lin Yi said.
"Oh, then never mind," Situ Haoyue said.
A glint of sadness flashed through Situ Haoyue’s eyes.
After chatting for a while, Lin Yi’s phone rang. She checked the caller ID—it was Grandpa Lin.
Lin Yi hesitated for a moment, then answered the call.
"Girl, where are you?" Grandpa Lin asked on the other end.
"I’m out eating, it’ll be a while before I’m back," Lin Yi said.
"Oh, don’t starve yourself at dinner, come back early, don’t come home too late," Grandpa Lin advised.
"I know, Dad."
After hanging up, Lin Yi packed up and then drove her own car from the company to Lin Family.
Lin Family is a famous Ancient Martial Arts Family in the capital, with tremendous influence. Lin Yi sped all the way back home.
As soon as she entered the door, Grandpa Lin came up to her: "Little Yi, you’re back? Quick, quick, go change into clean clothes and come with Grandpa to a banquet. Our Miss Lin can’t be seen like this."
Lin Yi rolled her eyes speechlessly: "Okay, wait for me for a moment."
"Alright, go take a bath," Grandpa Lin said.
Lin Yi went upstairs, opened the door, and saw a shadow rushing towards her. Startled, Lin Yi raised her foot and kicked, the shadow groaned and then fell to the ground.
Lin Yi saw the situation clearly, immediately frustrated, this person was actually a woman, and not only that, she was a beautiful woman embodying both beauty and wisdom.
"Little sister, why did you suddenly rush out? You scared me. Luckily I’m physically fit; otherwise, you would have been kicked to internal injury," Lin Yi said with a smile.
"Hmph, it’s because your car was parked at the door. I wanted to go out to find my car, and you stopped me. I haven’t even blamed you, how can you blame me?" the beautiful girl huffed.

chapters.title: Chapter 930 - 949: Not Afraid of Playing with Fire?
chapters.content:
Chapter 930: Chapter 949: Not Afraid of Playing with Fire?
Lin Yi looked at the snowy peaks on the girl’s chest and couldn’t help swallowing his saliva: "Little sister, are you a man?"
"Rubbish, of course I’m a man." The girl glared at Lin Yi, huffing angrily.
"Since you’re a man, why are you dressed like this? Aren’t you afraid of getting burned?" Lin Yi said.
"So what if I get burned? I just want to get burned. I like dressing this way, is that wrong?" The girl said defiantly.
The girl exclaimed in surprise, eying Lin Yi cautiously: "Pervert!"
"Oh, aren’t you afraid I’ll take responsibility for you?" Lin Yi said with a wicked smile.
"Pfft, who needs your responsibility?" The girl snorted coldly.
"Don’t get excited, I just meant that, if you don’t mind, I’d consider dating you for a while." Lin Yi said.
The girl was stunned for a moment, then looked at Lin Yi, seemingly confused.
Her bright eyes were filled with bewilderment and puzzlement, as if asking why he suddenly said he wanted to date her.
Seeing the girl’s dazed expression, Lin Yi couldn’t help but chuckle, then he took out a box from his bag and opened the lid.
Inside the box, a necklace lay quietly.
Lin Yi took out a pink diamond from the necklace and handed it to the girl: "This is my gift to you."
"This gift is too precious, I dare not accept it." The girl hurriedly declined.
Lin Yi looked at the necklace in his hand, then shook his head slightly: "This necklace, to me, is worth not a million, but ninety-nine thousand nine hundred, so you must accept this gift, otherwise, I’ll tell the master that you stole my stuff."
The girl looked at the pink diamond, then at Lin Yi: "Really worth ninety-nine thousand nine hundred?"
Lin Yi nodded: "Of course, and it’s made of pure gold, one of a kind in the world!"
The girl’s eyes suddenly sparkled, she quickly took the necklace and looked it over carefully for a long time, then carefully put it away.
"So beautiful, thank you, Brother Yi!" The girl looked at Lin Yi, her eyes showing excitement.
Lin Yi glanced at the girl: "Alright, you go upstairs to rest first, I’m going to change clothes."
"Okay." The girl nodded, then obediently walked to the stairs.
Lin Yi watched the girl go upstairs, a smile tugging at the corners of his mouth, a playful light twinkling in his eyes.
Lin Yi went upstairs, quickly changed his clothes, then came downstairs.
Old Lin was already waiting for Lin Yi in the dining room.
As Lin Yi walked into the dining room, he smelled a rich fragrance of food.
Old Lin sat in his spot, smiling at Lin Yi: "Yi, come here, sit here, the air is much better here than downstairs, I specially had the cook prepare this."
"Thank you, Grandpa, I love eating your cooking the most!" Lin Yi said with a smile.
Hearing Lin Yi’s sweet praise, Old Lin’s heart blossomed, and he felt even more pleased.
"Yi, you look spirited today, how did you sleep last night?" Old Lin asked.
Lin Yi smiled: "Grandpa, don’t worry, I slept very comfortably last night. When I woke up, I found myself in bed, and moreover, my strength has improved another level."
"That’s great, I believe that in a few more years, you will reach the Peak of Foundation Establishment, and then you can fly and escape through the earth." Old Lin said.
"Yes, when the time comes, I will take you on a tour of the Immortal Realm." Lin Yi said.
Old Lin laughed heartily: "A tour of the Immortal Realm, oh, I’ve been longing for that day."
"Rest assured, when the time comes, I will arrange a grand wedding and invite the best people from all over the world to attend our wedding," Lin Yi said with a smile.
"That’s more like it," Old Lin said.
"Alright, let’s eat."
Lin Yi and Old Lin sat together. Old Lin served Lin Yi food with a tender look and a loving demeanor.
Lin Yi looked at Old Lin, feeling a wave of emotions.
Ever since their last argument, he hadn’t returned; Lin Yi initially thought Old Lin would be angry, but unexpectedly, Old Lin was not only not angry, he cared even more about him.
Old Lin looked at Lin Yi and then said, "Lin Yi, I asked you to come down for lunch today because there is something I want to tell you."
"What is it?" Lin Yi was puzzled.
Old Lin sighed and slowly said, "You should be aware of the situation between Lin Yan and me."
"Yes," Lin Yi nodded.
"I’m doing this only because I hope you won’t be jealous of Lin Yan. Although she’s immature, I don’t want you two siblings to become too estranged. After all, she is your sister," Old Lin said.
"I’m not jealous of her, I’m quite happy to accept her admiration," Lin Yi said with a smile.
"That’s good," Old Lin sighed in relief. "Do you know, recently Lin Yan has been pestering me to get her a job at your company. I’ve been rejecting her, but she stubbornly refuses to leave. These last few days, she has been causing trouble at home quite a few times."
"These things can’t be rushed," Lin Yi said.
"Of course I know they can’t be rushed, but look, she comes to our house causing trouble every day when you’re not home. Doesn’t that make her even more arrogant?" Old Lin frowned.
"Alright, Grandpa, I’ll handle this matter. You don’t need to worry about it. Just focus on your health, and I’ll be back soon to help you," Lin Yi said.
"Alright, just be careful yourself, and don’t provoke her. After all, she is your sister," Old Lin cautioned.
"I understand, Grandpa, don’t worry," Lin Yi smiled.
After finishing the meal, Lin Yi drove his sports car towards the school.
Upon arriving at the school, he saw Su Feifei standing anxiously at the dormitory building. Seeing Lin Yi’s car, she immediately ran over.
Lin Yi got out of the car and, seeing a breathless Su Feifei, smiled and said, "I thought you’d be waiting for me at the academic office. It seems you intentionally didn’t wait."
"How dare I? If I waited outside for you and you didn’t come home, what would I do?" Su Feifei said while running.
"Why would you come to school then?" Lin Yi asked helplessly.
"I was worried about you!" Su Feifei laughed.
"Well, I know you’re worried about me, but isn’t it a bit too much? This is your family’s school, and I’m not a child. Surely I won’t get lost?" Lin Yi said with a wry smile.
"I don’t care if you get lost or not, I’m just afraid you’ll be mistreated since we’re siblings after all," Su Feifei said.
Lin Yi smiled and nodded, "Yes, I understand."
"Then you better hurry to class, I’ll wait for you at the school gate," Su Feifei said.
"No need, you go back. I’m heading to the library. I don’t have any classes today, so you don’t need to wait for me."
"Alright then..."
Although somewhat disappointed, Su Feifei obediently left.
When Lin Yi returned to his class, he saw Lin Yan pacing anxiously at the classroom door. She approached Lin Yi as soon as she saw him.
"Lin Yi, did Grandpa talk to you just now?" Lin Yan asked.
"No," Lin Yi replied. "Why are you so nervous?"

chapters.title: Chapter 931 - 950: Classmates Leave One After Another
chapters.content:
Chapter 931: Chapter 950: Classmates Leave One After Another
"I... Of course I’m nervous! You’re my fiancé, if I’m not nervous, who will be!" Lin Yan said.
Lin Yi chuckled, "Look how worried you are."
"Yi, hurry and go inside, I’ll wait for you here," Lin Yan said, then ran to the grassy lawn nearby, leaned against the wall, and closed her eyes to rest.
Lin Yi didn’t mind her and walked straight into the classroom.
The class ended and the students left the classroom one after another, but Lin Yi was still at his seat.
Watching his classmates leave, the image of Lin Yan’s delicate and fair face surfaced in his mind.
That night, at the banquet, seeing Lin Yan drunk with a charming demeanor, a touch of pity arose in his heart. That’s why he took the initiative to help solve Lin Yan’s problems, allowing her to successfully get into Huaxia’s best university.
But, he never expected that Mr. Lin would actually have someone watch him, and Lin Yan even knew about it.
Thinking about this, Lin Yi could not help but shake his head.
Forget it, let’s not think about these things, he thought. Let’s first catch up with this semester’s courses, so he could return home earlier.
Thinking of going home, Lin Yi remembered the promise he made to Li Wanru.
During this period, aside from attending classes, Lin Yi would visit his master to inquire about cultivation methods.
One day, just as Lin Yi arrived at Li Wanru’s doorstep, he saw a man in a black suit standing in front of Li Wanru’s house.
The man was very handsome, with peach blossom eyes that shone with a cunning light; he didn’t appear to be a bodyguard, but more like a rich, carefree second generation.
"Hey, beautiful lady, my name is Chen Wenlong, I came here to ask you out for shopping," the man said with a smile.
Looking at the familiar face, Lin Yi thought of the guy he had beaten up badly.
This guy was the one he had found online, and Lin Yi had not yet dealt with him, yet he had appeared again.
Lin Yi walked over: "What are you doing here?"
"Oh, I’m here for a date with my girlfriend!" Chen Wenlong laughed.
"Get lost! I don’t have time to play such childish games with you!" Lin Yi said coldly.
Chen Wenlong glanced at Lin Yi, snorted and said: "Hey beauty, don’t be so fierce, okay? I haven’t done anything to you, is there a need to be so harsh?"
"What do you think?" Lin Yi said coldly, glancing at Chen Wenlong.
Chen Wenlong looked at Lin Yi, "What school did you graduate from? Do you know who I am?"
"It’s none of your damn business, get lost," Lin Yi said.
"Wow!" Chen Wenlong sneered, "So arrogant? How about we have a competition then? Do you dare to accept my challenge?"
"I don’t dare!" Lin Yi said.
Chen Wenlong laughed heartily, then patted his chest, "Since you’re so cowardly, you better scram quickly, don’t delay my chance to pick up girls!"
"I’m out of here, you better damn well clear the way too!" Lin Yi said.
"Whoa there, you really are quite something. But I advise you to be more sensible, otherwise, I won’t be polite!" Chen Wenlong said fiercely.
"I advise you not to be too arrogant," Lin Yi said coldly, scanning Chen Wenlong with his eyes.
"Oh? You dare to threaten me?" Chen Wenlong said disdainfully.
"I’m warning you again, don’t be too arrogant," Lin Yi said.
"Alright, I want to see just how arrogant you can be!" Chen Wenlong said.
"Then I guess I’ll leave?" Lin Yi said indifferently.
"Wait, don’t forget our bet! If you lose, you disappear from my sight forever!" Chen Wenlong said coldly.
"No problem," Lin Yi said.
...
"Brother, I still think I’m more suitable for Lin Yi!" In a BMW X7, sitting in the driver’s seat, Zhao Feng suddenly said.
Inside the car, a tall, innocent-looking girl turned to look at Zhao Feng and said, "What’s gotten into you, little brother? Although Lin Yi is very capable, I think you’re much more handsome than he is. Even if you competed with him, he wouldn’t win!"
"Sis, I just want to prove myself!" Zhao Feng said with determination.
"Alright then, if you think you can beat Lin Yi, go for it!" The girl shrugged her shoulders.
"I will definitely win!" Zhao Feng clenched his fist, declaring with utmost confidence.
...
"Are we getting off here?" Lin Yi looked at a Bentley parked ahead.
Lin Yan said with a giggly smile, "Yes, big brother, don’t tell me you’re scared?"
Lin Yi gave her a glare and retorted, "Nonsense, I’m not scared at all!"
"Good to hear that!" Lin Yan laughed.
Soon after, they both got out of the car, one after the other.
"Wow, isn’t that Lin Yi?"
"Why would Lin Yi come here?"
"Isn’t he here to see Cousin Wanru? Why did he run over here?"
When Lin Yi and Lin Yan stepped out of the car, they immediately drew much attention from the people around.
Lin Yan spoke discontentedly, "Lin Yi, do you even have any manners? We’re all men here!"
"I’m a man, you’re a woman!" Lin Yi responded.
"You!" Lin Yan glared at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi just chuckled and ignored her, continuing to walk forward.
"Hey, don’t walk so fast!" Lin Yan hurried to keep up.
Just as Lin Yi and Lin Yan approached the Bentley, the car door opened, and a man dressed in black hopped out.
Lin Yi glanced at him and frowned, "Who are you?"
"I’m Cousin Wanru’s driver," the man said with a smile.
"Wanru’s driver?" Lin Yi was momentarily stunned, "Are you looking for her for something?"
"I’m ordered to protect Wanru," the man explained.
"Where is Wanru?" Lin Yi asked.
"I’ll take you to her," the man said.
Lin Yi and Lin Yan exchanged glances, both a bit puzzled. Wanru’s driver? Then why didn’t he come to find Wanru sooner and instead came looking for them?
But they didn’t think that far. After all, their school was more than a kilometer away from here. How long would it take for the driver to drive such an expensive Bentley over here?
Lin Yan watched Lin Yi’s retreating figure and sighed softly, "Brother, you’re really as dense as a block of wood, not even realizing that Wanru likes you."
Upon hearing this, Lin Yi abruptly stopped in his tracks and turned to look at Lin Yan.
Lin Yan was startled and nearly fell over, complaining, "Bro, what the heck?"
"What... did you say?" Lin Yi asked.
"Brother, I am of age already, alright? What do you need to ask me about?" Lin Yan rolled her eyes.
"How do you know Wanru likes me?" Lin Yi inquired.
"I guessed," Lin Yan replied.
"Did she tell you herself?" Lin Yi pressed on.
Lin Yan nodded, "She did tell me, but she still can’t give up on you."
"That’s impossible," Lin Yi stated, "I have no romantic feelings for Wanru at all, besides, she’s Cousin Wanru, I don’t want to hurt her."
"Pfft!" Lin Yan scoffed, "You, my dear brother, are just a fool!"
"What?!" Lin Yi looked at Lin Yan in astonishment.
Lin Yan stuck out her tongue teasingly, "Bro, just stop pretending, I know everything!"

chapters.title: Chapter 932 - 951 Stop Pretending
chapters.content:
Chapter 932: Chapter 951 Stop Pretending
Lin Yi frowned and said, "Know what?"
Lin Yan sighed inwardly as she looked at Lin Yi and said, "I thought I had hidden it well, but it turns out you saw right through me a long time ago!"
Looking at Lin Yan, Lin Yi said, "Yan Yan, I’m not that kind of person. I am lenient with you only because you are Wanru’s cousin. I don’t have any romantic feelings for Wanru."
Lin Yan nodded and said, "I know."
"Since you know, then why are you still trying to break us up?" Lin Yi asked, puzzled.
"I wish I could, but Cousin Wanru disagrees! I had no choice but to turn to you instead!" Lin Yan said.
"What do you mean?" Lin Yi was confused.
"I think I don’t need to play matchmaker for you two anymore. I feel that Cousin Wanru might have truly fallen for you," Lin Yan said.
Lin Yi shook his head slightly, gave a bitter smile, and said, "No, she doesn’t have any romantic feelings for me!"
"Really? I feel like there’s some ambiguity between you and Cousin Wanru. Are you guys dating?" Lin Yan blinked and asked.
Lin Yi said, "My feelings for her have always been brotherly!"
"Then what is your relationship?" Lin Yan asked.
Lin Yi shook his head and said, "To me, she’s just family; I have never thought of her as a lover!"
"Ah!" Lin Yan sighed, "Then why don’t you pursue Cousin Wanru?"
"Pursue her?" Lin Yi looked astonished, "I can’t pursue her."
Lin Yan said, "But surely you won’t go through life without ever dating, right?"
"Dating?" Lin Yi looked blank; the concept seemed to be something he hadn’t even considered!
"Of course, isn’t dating a perfectly normal thing? It would be strange if you’ve never dated!" Lin Yan said with a laugh.
Lin Yi shook his head and said, "I haven’t thought about it, but not wanting to date doesn’t mean I don’t have a girlfriend!"
"What?" Lin Yan’s eyes widened in surprise as she looked at Lin Yi.
"However, I currently have no plans to find a girlfriend," Lin Yi explained.
Lin Yan frowned, feeling that everything Lin Yi said seemed insincere!
She didn’t care about all that; today, she had to get to the bottom of Lin Yi and Wanru’s relationship.
"Brother, is the person Cousin Wanru likes you?" Lin Yan asked earnestly.
"Yes, she likes me!" Lin Yi nodded affirmatively.
"But..."
"But what?"
"I don’t understand. If you both like each other, why refuse each other? Isn’t that tiring?" Lin Yan said.
"Not tiring," Lin Yi shook his head, "Wanru likes me, but do I like her?"
"Of course, you like Wanru, and Cousin Wanru likes you too. The two of you are a good match," Lin Yan said.
Looking at Lin Yan, Lin Yi said, "Yan Yan, you should know that I don’t have any romantic feelings for her."
Lin Yan said, "I believe that the two of you would be happy together."
Lin Yi shook his head and said, "Wanru and I are like two parallel lines; even if we got together, we wouldn’t be happy!"
"How do you know you won’t be?" Lin Yan asked.
"I just know. We’re not suitable for each other, nor can we be together," Lin Yi said.
"What about me?" Lin Yan suddenly asked.
Lin Yi shook his head and said, "Yan Yan, it’s different for you and me; it’s forever impossible."
"Hmph, who says it’s impossible between you and me?" Lin Yan huffed coldly.
Lin Yi was taken aback, looked at Lin Yan, and asked, "What do you mean?"
"Hmph!" Lin Yan said, "I’m telling you, I’ve fallen for you!"
"What?" Lin Yi looked at Lin Yan in surprise, somewhat incredulous, "Yan Yan, don’t lie to me. You’re my little sister, how could you possibly like me?"
Lin Yan glared at Lin Yi: "Do you despise me?"
"I wouldn’t dare." Lin Yi shook his head and said, "But as a man, I don’t think we are suitable for each other..."
Lin Yan snorted and said, "Don’t think just because you’re handsome you can reject everyone. Let me tell you, there are plenty of guys who are more handsome and charming than you in this world!"
Lin Yi shook his head and said, "I know. But towards you, I only have sibling affection, nothing romantic."
Lin Yan looked at Lin Yi and said, "Fine, I admit that you are very outstanding, and the girls around you are beautiful, but can you resist temptation?"
Lin Yi frowned slightly and said, "What does temptation have to do with this?"
"Of course it does!" Lin Yan said, "Men all like beautiful women, especially a man like you. If you weren’t attracted to beauty, then you wouldn’t be a man!"
"Yan Yan, I don’t understand what you’re saying." Lin Yi shook his head.
"Alright, then let me give you a lesson." Lin Yan said, "Men need to conquer. If you want to conquer a beauty like cousin Wanru, you must win over her heart. Only then is there a chance of success, otherwise, you’ll never be able to enter her heart."
Lin Yi fell silent for a moment, then said, "Between her and me, it’s not just about romance, there’s also family duty."
"Hmph, I see it as just an excuse!" Lin Yan said coldly.
"That is your biggest slander against me. I can swear to heaven that there’s absolutely no romantic feelings between me and her!" Lin Yi said.
"Hmph, that’s your business, anyway, I have already fallen for you!" Lin Yan said with a reckless look.
"Yan Yan, don’t be rash." Lin Yi frowned and said.
"I’m not being rash. I know all these things, I just didn’t want to believe them!" Lin Yan said.
"Yan Yan, you..." Lin Yi paused, he had not expected that Lin Yan would be so obstinate, actually saying these words.
"Enough!" Lin Yan cut off Lin Yi’s words, "I came to talk to you today about your thing with cousin Wanru!"
Lin Yi sighed and said, "Yan Yan, why do you have to interfere? There’s no possibility between Wanru and me."
