Lin Yan looked at Lin Yi and said, "No, I’m going to interfere!"
"You... ah, I don’t even know what to say anymore." Lin Yi helplessly shook his head.
"Brother, stop thinking about running away. I won’t let you out of my sight," Lin Yan said earnestly.
Lin Yi was taken aback for a moment, then said, "Whatever you want, but I’m not going to like you."
Lin Yan pouted and said, "Don’t say that. I like you, and you like me, too. That’s an irrefutable fact, and there’s no room for change!"
"But I’m your brother."
"What does that matter?"
"But there is no blood relation between us..."
"You are my brother!" Lin Yan firmly interrupted Lin Yi’s words.
Looking at Lin Yan’s determined gaze, Lin Yi couldn’t help feeling perplexed.
Seeing this, Lin Yan said, "Alright, brother, stop hesitating and just marry me already! I don’t want to wait any longer!"
"Marry you?" Lin Yi was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 933 - 952: Striving to Calm Myself Down
chapters.content:
Chapter 933: Chapter 952: Striving to Calm Myself Down
"Yes!" Lin Yan nodded and said, "Anyway, I’ve already fallen for you. I won’t be content if I don’t marry you!"
"Do you even realize what you’re doing is ridiculous?" Lin Yi frowned.
Lin Yan humphed and said, "Aren’t you also single? We’re about the same age, and you’re not getting any younger. It’s time for you to find a girlfriend, and I am the most suitable choice!"
"But..." Lin Yi was about to continue persuading when Lin Yan cut him off.
"Brother, I don’t care, you must agree to marry me and take me back home!" Lin Yan declared with an air of dominance.
Lin Yi sighed and said, "I got it. You go back to your room and rest first. Let me think about it a little more, okay?"
"No! I’m going to wait right here until you make a decision!"
"Fine! Then wait here."
"Hmph, at least you know what’s good for you!" Lin Yan said with a satisfied smile.
Lin Yi rubbed his forehead, feeling an immense headache because he truly didn’t know what to do with Lin Yan.
"What are you two doing?" A charming voice came through, followed by the figure of a slender girl entering from the door.
Lin Yan looked up, and her complexion changed immediately upon seeing the tall girl.
Lin Yi turned around and asked with curiosity, "Yan Yan, do you know her?"
Lin Yan took a deep breath, trying to calm herself, and said, "No!"
"Oh," Lin Yi nodded, "Then why are you looking at her like that?"
"Hehe, brother, what are you saying? How did I look at her with ’that kind of eyes’? Don’t forget, this is the Lin Family, and I, Lin Yan, am the one who calls the shots!"
Lin Yi frowned and asked, "What do you mean by that?"
"What do you mean ’what do I mean’?"
Lin Yi said, "I just don’t like this part of your personality. Do you know? It’s too overbearing!"
"Hmph, I’m overbearing?" Lin Yan said, "Have you ever thought whether other men would like this kind of personality in a woman?"
Lin Yi shook his head and said, "No!"
"Then you’re correct! So, you must like this personality of mine, not girls like Wanru who are gentle and demure. I’m the one who’s best suited for you!"
Lin Yi shook his head and said nothing, just sitting in the chair and drinking water.
Seeing this, Lin Yan couldn’t help stomping her foot and said, "Lin Yi, I’m talking to you. Are you even listening?!"
Lin Yi remained silent, simply bowing his head to drink tea.
"Hmph!" Lin Yan, frustrated, swung her hand and stormed off.
"This girl, still as bad-tempered as ever," Lin Yi sighed and muttered to himself.
Lin Yi looked out the window at the scenery, and before he knew it, it had gotten dark.
"Brother, I’m leaving first!" Suddenly, Lin Yan ran in, then grabbed Lin Yi’s arm and said, "Come on, take me out to eat!"
"Yan Yan, I’m not hungry," Lin Yi said.
"Brother, stop pretending, it must be on purpose!" Lin Yan said, "You’re avoiding me, aren’t you?"
"Not at all!" Lin Yi quickly explained, "You’re overthinking it!"
"Then why won’t you go out to eat with me?" Lin Yan asked.
"It’s not that I won’t go out to eat with you. It’s just that I’m worried I won’t be able to take care of you by myself!" Lin Yi said.
"Humph, who needs you to take care of me? Rest assured, I’m not heartbroken yet; I have plenty of friends!" Lin Yan snorted disdainfully.
"Then I can’t do anything about that," Lin Yi shrugged his shoulders.
"Humph! I think you just don’t dare!" Lin Yan snorted.
"Think whatever you want," Lin Yi shook his head.
Lin Yan pouted and said, "Alright, alright, brother, let’s go out to eat together, and we can discuss cousin Wanru’s situation, okay?"
"No!" Lin Yi flatly refused.
"Lin Yi, you’re being unreasonable!" Lin Yan said, "After all, I’ve helped you out. How can you ignore me like this!"
"It’s not that I’m ignoring you; I really can’t go out to eat with you!"
Lin Yan said, "Fine, since you don’t want to go out with me, then forget it. I’m leaving!"
Having said that, Lin Yan turned around and walked away; it seemed she was really upset.
"Hey, Yan Yan!"
Seeing Lin Yan’s retreating figure, Lin Yi called out in a hurry, but Lin Yan ignored him completely and walked straight out of the room.
Lin Yi sighed. He hadn’t expected Lin Yan’s personality to be so dominant.
It was no surprise, after all, Lin Yan was the helmsman of the Lin Family, whose word was law.
"Forget it, I’ll go chase her."
With that thought, Lin Yi quickly followed her.
"Yan Yan, Yan Yan!" Lin Yi called out as he chased after her.
Lin Yan stopped in her tracks, turned around, and looked at Lin Yi, scoffing, "You actually came after me! I thought you didn’t care about me anymore!"
"How could that be! Of course, I had to chase after you!"
As he spoke, Lin Yi reached out and grabbed Lin Yan’s wrist, heading downstairs.
"Hey! You big jerk! Let go of me! Let go of me!" Lin Yan struggled.
"Yan Yan, listen to my explanation, things aren’t like you imagine, there’s really been a misunderstanding!" Lin Yi hurriedly explained.
"A misunderstanding? What misunderstanding?"
"Just hear me out..."
"I don’t want to, I don’t want to listen!" Lin Yan said petulantly.
"Ah..."
Lin Yi sighed lightly, knowing that Lin Yan wouldn’t believe his explanation.
"So, where shall we go for dinner?" Lin Yi said helplessly.
"I don’t care, as long as you go with me, I’ll believe you!" Lin Yan said.
"..."
Lin Yi pondered for a moment and finally gave in, saying, "All right, what do you want to eat?"
"Just decide for me, I’m not picky," said Lin Yan.
"I..." Lin Yi was somewhat speechless.
"What about you?" Lin Yan said. "Are you trying to brush me off?"
"Of course not!" Lin Yi quickly waved his hands in denial.
"Then let’s hurry up and get dinner, I’m starving!" Lin Yan cooed.
"Mm!" Lin Yi responded softly, "But, I’m afraid I can’t make it today! I still have things to deal with, is tomorrow okay?"
"Tomorrow?" Lin Yan’s eyes widened, "Didn’t you say you’d take me out to dinner today?"
Lin Yi smiled, "I really can’t today; how about another day?"
"You’ll just leave me behind again on another day!"
"I promise, I won’t leave you behind today!"
"Hmph, you say that as if you were going to leave me behind today!"
"Fine, then today!" Lin Yi said. "Let’s go, where do you want to eat?"
"Let’s eat roast duck!"
"Roast duck?"
"Yeah, I’ve never had roast duck before, and I really want to try it!" said Lin Yan.
"Then we’ll go for roast duck!" Lin Yi said.
"Hehe, brother, you’re the best!" Lin Yan laughed as she hooked her arm around Lin Yi’s.
Lin Yi smiled wryly, but he was very touched on the inside.
For many years, he had barely felt the taste of familial affection. To him, such affection was nothing short of a luxury.
He had thought countless times about cutting ties with his mother, but in the end, he found her presence to be like air to him; without her, like a fish deprived of oxygen, he couldn’t survive.

chapters.title: Chapter 934 - 953: The Environment is Quite Elegant
chapters.content:
Chapter 934: Chapter 953: The Environment is Quite Elegant
So, over the years, although Lin Yi never expressed it, deep inside, he was always hoping for his parents to return.
"Yan Yan, I bought you roast duck!" Lin Yi said with a smile.
"Really?" Lin Yan exclaimed happily, "That’s great, I want to eat lots and lots of roast duck!"
"Okay!"
Lin Yi took Lin Yan to a nearby roast duck restaurant.
"Would you like to order?" the waiter greeted warmly.
"Just one roast duck, thank you!" Lin Yi said indifferently.
"Alright!" The waiter retreated with a smile.
"Brother, look, the environment here is pretty elegant!" Lin Yan observed and commented.
"Yeah, not bad!" Lin Yi nodded in agreement.
As Lin Yi and Lin Yan approached the entrance of the roast duck restaurant, Lin Yi pulled out his wallet, took out five hundred yuan, and handed it to the waiter, saying, "This five hundred yuan is for your tip!"
"This..." The waiter hesitated.
"Take it! We’re not here to eat barbecue!" Lin Yi laughed.
"Thank you very much!" The waiter accepted the money and said, "Please wait a moment!"
"Okay."
Lin Yi and Lin Yan sat by the window and ordered a roast duck.
Lin Yi glanced at his phone - it was almost twelve o’clock, but there was still no news from Tang Qianyao, which made Lin Yi a bit anxious.
"Brother, your phone is ringing!" Lin Yan reminded him.
"Oh, thank you!" Lin Yi hurriedly took his phone.
"Hello, Qianyao! Are you busy? I just arrived at the hotel and wanted to see you, but your phone wasn’t connecting."
"Lin Yi, you should go back to your room and rest first, I’ll contact you later!"
"Okay. Be careful then."
After hanging up, Lin Yi looked up, just as Lin Yan’s gaze met his.
"Brother, I’ve realized that I can’t live without you anymore, what should I do?" Lin Yan stared at Lin Yi and said.
"Silly girl!" Lin Yi pinched Lin Yan’s nose and laughed, "It’s impossible between us!"
"Brother, are you despising me?" Lin Yan said, feeling wronged.
"No, I just don’t want to find a girlfriend for now," Lin Yi said, "I have something else to do, so I won’t chat with you any longer."
"Wait!"
Lin Yan stopped Lin Yi, saying, "I know, our relationship is only suitable as ordinary friends, you don’t have to force it! I know I’m not good enough for you, let’s break up!"
"What nonsense are you talking about? I won’t allow you to say such things!"
"But, our relationship isn’t suitable at all!"
"Then tell me, what kind of relationship do you think is suitable?"
"I..." Lin Yan opened her mouth but couldn’t say anything.
Because she also couldn’t clarify what her relationship with Lin Yi really was.
"It’s impossible for us to be together, you should stop wasting your time, find someone you like and marry him!" Lin Yi said, "You know about the relationship between you and your mom, if you don’t get married, we can never go back to how things were!"
"I know, but... I really can’t bear to break up with you! We’ve been together for so long, how can I possibly bear to break up with you?"
"You have to bear it even if you can’t! I’ve already decided, it’s impossible between us! If you want me to take responsibility for you, forget about me and find a new boyfriend!"
After hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Yan’s face instantly turned gloomy.
"Heh, do you think I’m shameless? You don’t have to take responsibility for me, nor marry me, you definitely have better choices!"
"No, I’ve never thought that way, I truly want to be with you! We’ve been together for so long, I really consider you my best girlfriend. Our relationship can never go bad!"
"I hope so!"
Lin Yan coldly said, "Lin Yi, you can leave now! From now on, you take your broad road, and I’ll take my single-log bridge. I hope we never meet again!"
"Yan Yan, listen to me!"
Lin Yi stood up and said, "Actually, I have my own principles! Whether you believe it or not, in any case, I will not be with you!"
"Haha, you really are stubborn!"
Lin Yan said mockingly, "Lin Yi, stop deceiving yourself. You clearly like me, why can’t you admit it?"
"Yan Yan! I don’t like you!" Lin Yi insisted.
Hearing this, Lin Yan suddenly laughed, "Haha... I knew it, you are lying to me!"
"I’m not, Yan Yan, I don’t want to hurt you. I just hope you can find a guy who loves you and who you love in return, not me!"
"No, I want to find a man who likes me!"
Lin Yan said decisively, "Don’t worry, no matter the cost, I will make my dad agree to let us be together!"
"You... Ah, forget it, do as you please!"
Lin Yi shook his head and said, "I’m leaving!"
"Wait!" Lin Yan grabbed Lin Yi.
"Yan Yan, is there anything else?"
"Lin Yi, if you want to repay me, I have two conditions!"
"Speak!"
Lin Yan thought for a moment and said, "First, you must get engaged to me! Second, you must marry me! If you dare to back out, I will have my dad kick you out of the family!"
"Yan Yan, when I was with you, I never thought about marrying you, let alone having your dad kick me out of the family. Just give up on that idea!"
"Hmph! No matter what you say, I won’t believe it!"
"Then do as you like."
"You..." Lin Yan was so angry that she felt tightness in her chest and almost fainted.
"Yan Yan, are you feeling unwell?"
Seeing this, Lin Yi quickly reached out to support Lin Yan.
"No... it’s nothing!" Lin Yan shook her head, "Lin Yi, no matter what you think, I will not separate from you!"
After saying that, Lin Yan turned around and ran into the house.
Lin Yi stood in place, momentarily at a loss.
He didn’t mean to hurt Lin Yan, it’s just that he really wasn’t in the right state of mind at the moment.
Lin Yi sighed deeply and also left the coffee shop.
"Xu Chen, how did it go?" Ye Qiu saw Lin Xuanyu coming in and quickly asked.
"What else could happen?" Lin Xuanyu gave a wry smile and said, "But this time, thanks to Lin Yi, otherwise, I really wouldn’t know how to handle this lawsuit!"
"Is that so?" Ye Qiu frowned, "Who exactly is this girl named Li Mengru?"
"She’s called Yang Xuewei, the deputy director of the city hospital."
Lin Xuanyu explained.
Ye Qiu nodded, surprised that this case was actually taken over by the city hospital.
"Since that’s the case, let the city hospital handle this case, we won’t interfere," Ye Qiu said.
"Right! That’s what I think too. During this time, you should stay in the capital to accompany the old man. I also need to be busy with company matters." Lin Xuanyu said, "After some time, I’ll find a chance to bring Yan Yan back to Jiangnan Province."
Ye Qiu nodded, indeed he needed some time to accompany Lin Aotian.
"That’s settled then!"
"By the way, I had Lin Yi check on something for you. Lin Yan’s mother, Yang Yuqin is a psychology expert who has done extensive research on mental illness. However, she has a peculiar taste for absorbing men’s yang energy, which is why she has so many admirers."
"Hmm, that’s a bit tricky!" Ye Qiu said, "If I want to convert Lin Yan from her misguided ways, I will need some strategies."

chapters.title: Chapter 935 - 954: This way, it’s foolproof!
chapters.content:
Chapter 935: Chapter 954: This way, it’s foolproof!
"I know," Lin Xuanyu said. "I’ll also help you think of ways to delay, to try to send her back to the United States before Lin Yan gets pregnant. That way, nothing can go wrong!"
Ye Qiu nodded and said nothing more.
Lin Xuanyu didn’t continue to disturb Ye Qiu’s rest and directly left the room.
Not long after he left, Lin Yan came in.
Seeing Ye Qiu practicing the Cultivation Technique, Lin Yan’s eyes flicked, and she shouted out of the window, "Brother, a handsome guy has come to visit the set! Hurry down!"
"Who is it?" Ye Qiu opened his eyes and asked.
"Guess?"
"I’m not guessing!" Ye Qiu rolled his eyes.
"Ugh! Such a buzzkill!" Lin Yan pouted, then shouted out the window again, "Handsome guy, I’m Lin Yan, I have something to talk to you about!"
"If you have something to say, then go downstairs!" Ye Qiu said, exasperated.
"Oh, handsome guy, you’re so bad!" Lin Yan mumbled as she walked toward the door.
Lin Yi was somewhat surprised when he saw Ye Qiu.
"Are you... Lin Yan’s brother?"
"Correct!" Lin Yi said indifferently.
"We are Lin Yan’s brother, as well as friends!" Lin Yi introduced himself.
Lin Yi was just like Lin Yan, both of them were rather reserved and quiet, so even in Lin Yan’s family, the two of them barely communicated.
"You understand the relationship between us two now, right?" Lin Yi said.
"Yeah, I understand!" Lin Yi said indifferently, "Lin Yan, she really likes you a lot! However, I hope that we can get along like normal friends in the future!"
"Alright, I respect your decision!" Lin Yi said.
After that, an awkward silence fell between the two.
Lin Yi, although a bit of a loner, was a good-hearted young man. He didn’t want to be too harsh to avoid making Lin Yan sad.
Seeing Lin Yi so understanding, Lin Yan finally felt the gloom in her heart dissipate quite a bit.
"Alright, I won’t take up more of your time." Lin Yi said, "I’ll be leaving now."
Just as Lin Yi was ready to leave, Lin Yan suddenly remembered something and called out to him: "Hey, brother!"
"Hmm?"
"I’ve made plans with Yang Yuwei to have dinner together tonight, do you want to join us?"
"There’s no need!"
Lin Yi declined indifferently.
"Umm..." Lin Yan paused, and then said, "Alright then! I’ll just go by myself!"
After speaking, Lin Yan turned and walked toward the room.
"Hey, Lin Yan, walk slowly, don’t trip!"
Watching Lin Yan’s somewhat awkward retreat, Lin Yi shook his head and couldn’t help but think to himself, this girl is really like a child!
...
The next morning.
When Yang Xuewei arrived at Lin Corporation and saw Lin Yi, she couldn’t help but be surprised.
"Why are you here?"
"What? I can’t come if you guys have made plans?" Lin Yi said indifferently.
"Er..." Yang Xuewei felt embarrassed, "Of course not, it’s just that today’s weather is quite hot, and I’m worried you can’t handle it!"
Hearing this, Lin Yi glanced at her indifferently and didn’t say much more.
He didn’t really like Yang Xuewei anyway, this girl, although quite pretty, had a very proud personality.
If he wasn’t mistaken, the reason she was willing to be friends with Lin Yan was definitely because of Ye Qiu.
After all, Ye Qiu was the only person he admired.
And his relationship with Ye Qiu was antagonistic.
Seeing that Lin Yi paid her no attention, Yang Xuewei felt snubbed and huffed, then headed straight toward the elevator.
"Ding-dong~"
After the elevator opened, Yang Xuewei stepped inside.
Just as she entered the elevator, she saw Lin Yi and two other bodyguards walking in from the outside.
The three of them, one on each side, escorted Lin Yi into the president’s private elevator.
In the elevator, only Yang Xuewei and Lin Yi were left.
Yang Xuewei, seeing that Lin Yi had said nothing to her the whole way, couldn’t help feeling annoyed.
She snorted coldly and turned her head away.
Lin Yi glanced at Yang Xuewei, feeling a bit agitated in his heart.
"Ding!"
As the elevator doors opened, Lin Yi was the first to walk out.
Upon seeing this, Yang Xuewei quickly followed.
Once in the office, she didn’t care about Lin Yi and sat directly on the sofa.
She took out her tablet and started playing with it, completely ignoring Lin Yi.
"I have work to do now, please leave if there is nothing else!" Lin Yi looked up and glanced at Yang Xuewei, said.
"Work, work, always about work, do you know anything else besides work?" Yang Xuewei said unhappily.
"What do you really want to do?" Lin Yi frowned, he had tolerated Yang Xuewei for a long time. If not for Lin Yan’s sake, he couldn’t be bothered to deal with this arrogant and capricious young lady!
"I just want to talk to you!"
"Then speak!" Lin Yi said, "I’m all ears."
"I just want to tell you, don’t bother Lin Yan anymore, she and I have nothing to talk about now!"
Lin Yi burst into laughter when he heard this.
He laughed very brightly.
"Miss Yang, please watch your words!" Lin Yi said, "No matter what, my sister is still your sister-in-law. You should respect her!"
"Lin Yi, you..." Yang Xuewei was immediately choked with anger, but indeed, she dared not offend Lin Yi and could only grudgingly close her mouth.
"I still have to work now, please excuse me!" With that, Lin Yi turned and left.
"Bastard!" Yang Xuewei cursed bitterly.
She never imagined that there would come a day when she would be looked down upon by Lin Yi!
"I will definitely make you regret this!"
Lin Yi had just arrived at Lin Yan’s office when he saw Lin Yan asleep on the desk. His gaze softened a little, but then a hint of coldness flashed in his eyes as he remembered something.
"Brother, I’m off to class now, I’m leaving!"
Yang Yuwei ran in from outside, waved at Lin Yi, and then dashed out of the company.
Lin Yi watched Yang Yuwei’s retreating back with an even colder look in his eyes.
Lin Yan had always been like this since she was a child.
He had never seen another girl who was as aggressive and domineering as her.
Not only that, but every time she argued with Ye Qiu, she would drag him, her brother, into it.
"Lin Yan, I really don’t know what to do with you!" Lin Yi sighed, muttering to himself.
Lin Yi walked over to Lin Yan and touched her forehead. Finding that she no longer had a fever, he finally breathed a sigh of relief.
"Brother!" Lin Yan rubbed her sleepy eyes and said in a daze, "Why are you back?"
"Now that you have recovered, I am relieved! I will take you to school, then head to my school," Lin Yi kindly said.
Upon hearing this, Lin Yan suddenly said with a cheerful smile: "Brother, I knew it, you are the best to me, I love you the most!"
Saying so, Lin Yan leaned in and kissed Lin Yi on the cheek.
Lin Yi was shocked and couldn’t help but glare at Lin Yan, "Why would you kiss me!"
"Brother, I just think, you’re getting more and more handsome! Hehe!" Lin Yan laughed foolishly.
"I am your real brother, you must not have any weird thoughts!" Lin Yi warned.
"Oh, I know!" Lin Yan obediently nodded.
Lin Yi and Lin Yan headed to the garage and drove the car out of the company.
"Brother, do you know where Ye Qiu has been lately?" Lin Yan suddenly asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 936 - 955: Won’t Mind
chapters.content:
Chapter 936: Chapter 955: Won’t Mind
Lin Yi frowned and said, "Didn’t I tell you to stop mentioning that man?"
"I didn’t mention him, I’m just curious!" Lin Yan pouted, dissatisfied.
"Why do I feel like you really care about him?" Lin Yi said doubtfully.
Hearing this, Lin Yan’s face turned red, and she stammered, "I, I’m just curious!"
"Heh, just ask if you’re curious, I won’t mind!" Lin Yi replied with a laugh.
"Really?"
"Yeah!"
"Then I won’t hold back, give me his contact information!" Lin Yan said expectantly.
"He doesn’t have any contact information!"
"What?"
Lin Yi explained, "Ye Qiu has his own power in the capital; we can’t trace him at all!"
"Ah? So powerful? Does that mean it’s very hard to find Ye Qiu?" Lin Yan said, disappointed.
"His strength is formidable, but he won’t leave the country."
"I see!"
Lin Yi sent Ye Qiu’s phone number to Lin Yan.
After receiving it, Lin Yan eagerly dialed Ye Qiu’s number.
"Ye Qiu, this is Lin Yan!"
"Yeah, I know!" Over the phone, Ye Qiu’s cold voice came through, as if from the depths of Hell.
"Um, I have something I want to ask you..." Lin Yan hesitated.
"Go ahead and ask!"
Lin Yan was delighted to hear Ye Qiu’s cooperative tone.
"Well, Ye Qiu, what’s the deal with you and Chen Mengyao?" Lin Yan inquired.
"You want to know?"
"Yeah!"
"But I don’t want to tell you!"
"You..." Lin Yan stomped her foot in frustration, but she was helpless.
Seeing Lin Yan’s reaction, Lin Yi couldn’t help but chuckle.
"Forget it, if you don’t want to say, then never mind!" Lin Yan said and then hung up the phone.
Ye Qiu hung up the phone with a cold laugh.
Chen Mengyao’s family runs a first-class enterprise in Huaxia.
And Chen Mengyao has been spoiled since she was a child, which is why she developed such an arrogant personality.
"Hmph, I’m curious to see just how long you can keep up this arrogance," Ye Qiu said darkly.
Lin Yan put away her phone and walked toward the academic building.
"Lin Yan, where have you been? I’ve been looking for you for ages!"
"Oh, I’m downstairs waiting for you!" Lin Yan said with a smile.
Yang Xuewei’s face darkened considerably when she saw Lin Yan.
She didn’t expect Lin Yan to even know Ye Qiu’s number.
This woman was simply her bane!
Seeing Yang Xuewei’s expression, Lin Yi immediately guessed what Lin Yan had done, and said coldly, "You caused trouble again, didn’t you?"
"I didn’t!" Yang Xuewei quickly shook her head, but her eyes were filled with disdain.
Lin Yi didn’t say anything but just walked ahead with Lin Yan.
Soon, the two arrived at the school’s entrance.
After parking the car, Lin Yi was the first to step out.
Seeing this, Yang Xuewei glared at Lin Yan unhappily before following them.
The three of them walked in silence.
After arriving at the school gate, both of them got out of the car.
However, just as they were about to part ways, Lin Yi suddenly turned around and looked at Yang Xuewei, saying, "Didn’t you say you wanted to repay me? How do you plan to repay me?"
"Then how do you want me to repay you?" Yang Xuewei asked with a smile.
"I think..." Lin Yi paused, then said in all seriousness, "Just give yourself to me as repayment!"
"Pfft!" Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Lin Yan burst into light laughter.
"What are you laughing at?" Yang Xuewei asked, feeling both embarrassed and annoyed.
"I’m laughing at how foolish you are. To actually let your lifesaver make such an impolite request, haha, that’s hilarious!" Lin Yan said in schadenfreude.
Hearing this, Lin Yi instantly became furious.
"You!" Yang Xuewei pointed at Lin Yan’s nose and snapped, "Don’t get cocky! Weren’t you dumped by Ye Qiu too?"
"Who says I was dumped by him?"
"Won’t you admit it? Lin Yi, do you think I’m a three-year-old kid?"
Seeing Yang Xuewei insisting that she was abandoned by Ye Qiu, Lin Yan was immediately shocked and blurted out, "You’re making stuff up!"
"Dare you say you weren’t just rejected by Ye Qiu?"
"I was not! Don’t accuse me wrongly!" Lin Yan argued.
"Not? Dare you call out in front of all our classmates for your ’husband’ to pick you up from school, or tell him yourself that it’s because you’ve fallen for him and want to be with him, that’s why you came to read in the senior year?" Yang Xuewei sneered.
At this, Lin Yan was suddenly at a loss for words and didn’t know what to say.
"Fine, since you don’t dare, then shut up!"
Seeing Yang Xuewei being so aggressive, Lin Yan felt the rage inside her bubble up and said, "Alright, since you really want to know, then I’ll tell you—I was rejected! I just wanted to see him regret it!"
"You jerk!"
Having said that, Lin Yan glared fiercely at Lin Yi and then stormed off from the school angrily.
Lin Yi was stunned, completely not expecting that Lin Yan would actually claim in front of all the classmates that he was her ’husband’!
Has she gone mad?!
Isn’t she afraid that after Ye Qiu finds out, he will break off all ties with her?
"This damn girl!"
Lin Yi cursed under his breath and then quickly chased after her, grabbing Lin Yan’s arm and said, "Lin Yan, stop messing around!"
"I’m not messing around, I’m serious!" Lin Yan stubbornly said, "Let go of me!"
"I won’t let go! I don’t care whether you’re serious or joking, I won’t allow you to do this!" Lin Yi said sternly.
Lin Yan did not expect Lin Yi to say such a thing.
She was moved to tears on the spot.
Seeing this, Lin Yi instantly panicked, "Lin Yan, don’t cry. If you really like Ye Qiu, then go pursue him. What’s the meaning of coming to school to find me?"
"I just want to see if he would accept me!"
"I didn’t!"
"Still arguing? I heard you call him!"
"Really? Then listen carefully, I was asking him for your number. Your number. I just wanted to know what exactly is the relationship between you and Ye Qiu!" Lin Yan said aggrieved.
"Didn’t I tell you, I’m already married?"
"I know you’re married, but I don’t care, I just want to know if you also like Ye Qiu. If you do, I’ll back off!"
"No way!" Lin Yi said decisively, "Stop being so temperamental, okay?"
"No way!"
Seeing Lin Yan’s stubborn attitude, Lin Yi became somewhat irritable.
Lin Yan, noticing the change in Lin Yi’s expression, felt her heart tighten, realizing that he was angry, quickly changed her tune, "Well, since you’re so opposed to me dating Ye Qiu, then I’ll just stop associating with Ye Qiu. You don’t like him either, and I can’t be bothered to compete with you over a boyfriend!"
Sensing this, Lin Yi instantly felt relieved.
"Are you really not joking this time?"
"Of course not. Do you think I’d joke about my own lifetime matters?" Lin Yan said petulantly.
Hearing this, Lin Yi breathed a sigh of relief, and then said, "In that case, let’s continue with our classes."
Seeing this, Lin Yan didn’t dare to go against his wishes, and could only nod her head, then she followed behind Lin Yi back into the school.
When Ye Qiu saw Yang Xuewei, he was momentarily taken aback, then smiled and said, "Lin Yan, what a coincidence, we meet again!"

chapters.title: Chapter 937 - 956: Taking the Initiative to Show Eagerness
chapters.content:
Chapter 937: Chapter 956: Taking the Initiative to Show Eagerness
"Yeah, what a coincidence, I didn’t expect to see you taking classes at school as well. I was feeling a bit tired, so I took a break to go shopping nearby, and then I bumped into you—what fate!"
"If you’re really tired, I’ll keep you company and rest for a while. This way, you won’t have to squeeze onto the subway!" Ye Qiu offered with a cheerful smile.
Yang Xuewei was thrilled by Ye Qiu’s eagerness to please, saying, "Thank you!"
Ye Qiu and Yang Xuewei walked side by side towards the school’s exit.
Lin Yan watched the scene unfold, with a venomous glint flickering in her eyes, seething with silent rage.
Ye Qiu, you can’t blame me for this! If there’s someone to blame, it’s yourself for attracting bees and butterflies!
Lin Yi, watching Ye Qiu and Yang Xuewei leave together, felt an even stronger surge of jealousy. He believed that if he hadn’t met Lin Yan, he would definitely have successfully wooed Yang Xuewei!
Unfortunately, Lin Yan intervened, ruining his chances!
Nevertheless, he refused to give in; he swore that he would make Ye Qiu regret it.
Lin Yan and Yang Xuewei chatted as they walked on one side.
Lin Yi followed behind them like a tail, bearing the look of a little brother, which amused Yang Xuewei to no end.
Yang Xuewei had experienced Lin Yi’s domineering behavior, so seeing him act so respectfully towards her felt novel and tempted her to tease him a bit.
"Lin Yi, do you also want to go shopping with me?" Yang Xuewei asked in a teasing tone.
Lin Yi was momentarily startled, then nodded, saying, "You want to buy clothes? How much do you need, I’ll treat you!"
After saying this, Lin Yi felt something was not quite right.
He knew Yang Xuewei came from a very poor family. Although he wasn’t short on money, he wouldn’t break the bank over just a few clothes.
Sure enough, Lin Yan, seeing Lin Yi splurge a thousand yuan to please Yang Xuewei for a few clothes, immediately looked down upon him with disdain.
"Hmph, it’s just a piece of clothing, right? I have money too!" Lin Yan said scornfully.
"That’s not what I meant!" Lin Yi quickly explained, "I... I meant, I have more money, so... I..."
"I know you are not short of money, but think carefully, I don’t need you to do this for me, and I don’t need your charity either!" Yang Xuewei interrupted him bluntly.
"I..."
Lin Yi was about to say something more, but Yang Xuewei cut him off directly, saying, "Lin Yi, don’t forget you’re a married man, so please mind your words. Otherwise, even if I do like Ye Qiu, I wouldn’t choose to be with you. I’d rather marry someone like Ye Qiu—a prodigiously wealthy second-generation rich kid!"
"You..." Lin Yi turned red with anger upon hearing this.
This Yang Xuewei was really detestable!
Seeing Lin Yi fuming with rage, Yang Xuewei felt immensely satisfied and even more pleased with herself.
However, Yang Xuewei didn’t stop walking.
Because she had already sensed a chilling and terrifying presence emanating from behind the classroom. The closer it got to the school gate, the more intense the eerie atmosphere became.
Lin Yi, seeing Yang Xuewei ignoring him, couldn’t help feeling a bit anxious.
He feared that if Yang Xuewei really got entangled by some evil spirit, it would be terrible.
Lin Yi quickly called out to Yang Xuewei, "Yang Xuewei!"
"Huh? What’s up?" Yang Xuewei turned her head to look at him.
"If you ever find yourself in danger, don’t forget to scream for help!" Lin Yi said gravely.
"I can protect myself, don’t worry about me!" Yang Xuewei replied coldly, then walked towards the school gate with Ye Qiu.
Watching Lin Yi and Yang Xuewei’s retreating figures, Lin Yan clenched her fists until they creaked with strain.
"These two jerks are just too hateful!"
Lin Yan thought, grinding her teeth in anger.
Lin Yi and Yang Xuewei entered the mall together.
Lin Yi spotted a high-end luxury store and his eyes immediately lit up, hurriedly he took Yang Xuewei inside.
Lin Yi looked at several pieces of clothing, all designed by internationally renowned designers, and the hefty price tags made him wince a little.
He was not a vain person, but he did indeed need money at the moment.
Thus, not only did he plan to buy these few outfits, he also intended to spend some time here to see if he could gather enough money to purchase them all!
"Yang Xuewei, wait for me, I will quickly earn enough money to buy these outfits for you!" Lin Yi thought to himself.
However, seeing Lin Yi so generous, Yang Xuewei couldn’t help but harbor some suspicions.
She felt that Lin Yi must be up to some scheme!
Yet Yang Xuewei didn’t call him out, because she trusted her intuition.
"How about this one?" Lin Yi asked, holding out a silver-gray dress to Yang Xuewei.
"It’s a black dress!" Yang Xuewei took the dress and gave it a look.
"Mmm, it really complements your skin tone!" Lin Yi agreed.
After hearing this, the corners of Yang Xuewei’s mouth lifted slightly, though her heart was somewhat disdainful.
Although the dress was pretty, it wasn’t anything special and even looked a bit old-fashioned.
Yang Xuewei put the dress down and said, "I really like this dress, but it’s simply too ugly! I’ll choose a different one!"
"Oh? Why do you say that?" Lin Yi was taken aback.
"I think this dress is definitely not for you. Your skin is so fair, wearing this kind of garment is simply a waste of resources!" Yang Xuewei shook her head.
"Hahaha... I think this dress looks very well-matched and beautiful on you, that’s why I wanted you to try it!" Lin Yi laughed heartily.
"No need to try, I feel that I can’t wear this dress at all," Yang Xuewei said lightly.
"Why can’t you wear it?"
"This dress is too dowdy! Plus, it’s a black miniskirt; how can a guy like me wear something like this?"
"Ha ha, don’t worry, this dress is pure black."
"Really?" Yang Xuewei became a little excited upon hearing this.
"Of course!"
After hesitating for a moment, Yang Xuewei finally agreed, "All right! Then I’ll try it. But after trying it on, you must take it off immediately, or else you’ll be at a big loss!"
Yang Xuewei finished speaking, stepped into the fitting room, then took off the clothes and handed them to Lin Yi before stepping out of the fitting room.
Seeing Yang Xuewei wearing the clothes, Lin Yi immediately showed an astounded expression and also heaved a sigh of relief.
"Indeed, wearing black makes one look particularly handsome!"
Lin Yi thought to himself, then packed the clothing into the bag, ready to take it away, planning to ditch it while Yang Xuewei was wearing it.
But just then, a female sales associate suddenly approached, smiling at Yang Xuewei and said, "Sir, hello, this outfit is a limited edition, we only have four in total, it’s sixty-five thousand in total, please make the payment!"
Lin Yi, upon hearing this, immediately felt disgruntled.
"We don’t know each other!"
"Don’t know each other?" The sales associate frowned upon hearing this.
"That’s right! We don’t know each other at all!"
"Since you don’t know each other, please hand over this dress, thank you for your patronage!" The sales associate said expressionlessly, pointing to a paper bag on the floor.
"I’m not selling!" Lin Yi said stubbornly.
"Then please hand this dress over to this gentleman!" the sales associate continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 938 - 957: The Jewelry is Quite Valuable!
chapters.content:
Chapter 938: Chapter 957: The Jewelry is Quite Valuable!
Lin Yi turned his gaze to Yang Xue, who nodded at Lin Yi.
Lin Yi was delighted and then handed over the paper bag to the female sales associate.
The sales associate received the paper bag, opened it, only to find it completely empty, with nothing inside!
At this moment, Lin Yi’s eyes fell upon Yang Xue’s neck.
"Sir, may I ask which brand is the necklace on your neck?" the sales associate placed the paper bag on the ground and asked Yang Xue.
"This necklace, I had it shipped from Europe!" Yang Xue said indifferently.
The sales associate’s eyes lit up upon hearing this and she thought to herself: This necklace must be a limited edition!
"Then, could you please tell me where you bought this necklace from?" the sales associate continued to ask.
Yang Xue thought for a moment and said, "I had it shipped from Frankfurt!"
Hearing Frankfurt, the sales associate’s eyes sparkled even more. She knew Frankfurt was one of the most bustling cities in the world and also the site of international jewelry exhibitions; the jewelry from there was of considerable value!
She was already contemplating whether to go to Frankfurt to purchase some jewelry to increase her own income.
Lin Yi was somewhat surprised upon hearing Yang Xue’s response.
Could Yang Xue actually afford to buy jewelry from Frankfurt?
Wasn’t that a bit too extravagant?
However, since Yang Xue had it shipped from Frankfurt, that meant he was indeed wealthy, not an ordinary person.
If only she could marry him, how wonderful that would be!
Images of Lin Ya came to Lin Yi’s mind.
Her appearance was absolutely beautiful, sexy, elegant, and carried a hint of nobility.
Such a woman was what men dream of.
"This dress, miss, what do you think about it?"
Lin Yi held the dress up in front of Yang Xue.
Yang Xue nodded and said, "It’s pretty good."
"Well, if you like this dress, then I’ll just give it to you!"
"No need!" Yang Xue refused.
"Why? I really like this dress!"
"Giving it to you would be an insult!"
"..."
Yang Xue’s candidness left Lin Yi speechless, unable to think of a response in the moment.
Just then, a voice came from the side, "Oh, sir, isn’t this dress a bit out-of-date?"
Yang Xue turned his head and saw a blonde, blue-eyed beauty of a sales associate standing in front of him.
"Is it?"
Yang Xue chuckled inwardly.
He had bought this dress at an auction.
But he himself felt it was out-of-date, after all, he was only there to visit the auction house.
Lin Yi, upon seeing this, became furious: "What did you say?"
The blonde, blue-eyed beauty quickly smiled apologetically and said, "I didn’t mean that, what I meant to say is that your dress does seem a bit out-of-date!"
Lin Yi snorted and said, "Your eyesight is not bad, but I’m not going to let you have this dress."
"What did you say?"
"I’ll say it again, I won’t sell this dress!"
"Well, then I’ll just have to throw it away!"
With that said, the blonde, blue-eyed beauty packed up the dress again and handed it over to Yang Xue.
Yang Xue took the dress and said to Lin Yi, "I’ll repeat what I said, your taste is indeed lacking, but I won’t stoop to your level!"
Yang Xue said her piece, picked up the dress, and left with a swagger.
Lin Yi stared blankly at Yang Xue, feeling extremely shaken inside.
What did his tone just now imply?
Could it be that he was pretending not to hear her words on purpose?
The more Lin Yi thought about it, the more wrong it felt, but he didn’t dare to question Yang Xue further, fearing she might reject him again.
Seeing the dress in the female sales clerk’s hand, Lin Yi suddenly remembered that Yang Xue had mentioned she was from France, so he quickly said, "Leave the dress!"
The female sales clerk’s face changed: "Sir, this is yours, why should I leave it?"
"Because I like it, and for you to keep it would be a defamation of my taste!" Lin Yi said coldly.
"Don’t push people too far! I was only speaking the truth!" The female sales clerk flared up in anger. She had not taken a liking to Yang Xue’s attitude to begin with, and now, seeing Lin Yi bullying others with his power, she exploded.
"Then, I have no choice but to call security!" Lin Yi said with a cold voice.
"You dare? Do you believe I’ll call the police?" the female sales clerk threatened.
"Whatever you like." Lin Yi said arrogantly: "If you call the police, I can have my lawyer talk to you."
After speaking, Lin Yi immediately dialed his lawyer’s number.
Yang Xue overheard the two’s conversation and was at a loss for words; he hadn’t expected that a casual remark of his could stir up so much trouble.
Lin Yi called the police?
Then, would the police take his side?
Regardless, he no longer wished to stay.
He looked at the female sales clerk and said indifferently, "I think you should be aware that this dress is worth tens of millions. It’ll be hard for you to swallow the cost if you just throw it away. Besides, this dress is a limited edition, you can’t afford it, so I suggest you sell the dress."
"You’re talking nonsense, who says I can’t afford it? My father is..."
The female sales clerk didn’t finish her sentence before Lin Yi interrupted her, "But you have no money, so you use this dress to deceive customers’ trust, right?"
Lin Yi’s words choked the female sales clerk; she was suddenly at a loss for a rebuttal.
"What’s the big deal? You’re just a poor student; can you afford such a nice dress?"
"Poor student?"
Yang Xue shook his head: "I think you’re the real fraudster, a complete fraudster. Your taste is really not that great. If I were to buy it, I would definitely buy something better than you, believe it or not?"
Upon hearing Yang Xue’s words, the female sales clerk was enraged.
"What are you talking about? I was only telling the truth. If you have the money, why don’t you buy it?"
Yang Xue shrugged his shoulders: "No money!"
After speaking, Yang Xue left.
"You..."
The female sales clerk was furious. She wanted to have the security guard stop Yang Xue, but as she was about to take a step, she felt the gazes of those around her.
She could only reluctantly give up the idea.
Yang Xue walked out of the mall, feeling great.
He saw that the blonde, blue-eyed sales clerk was waiting for him outside the mall, in the parking area, and he immediately walked over to her.
The sales clerk’s heart skipped a beat when she saw Yang Xue approaching.
"Hey, why are you back?" the sales clerk quickly asked, her eyes revealing a hint of panic.
"Did I not make myself clear just now?" Yang Xue asked with a cold smile.
"Just now..." the sales clerk hesitated for a long time before finally saying, "I spoke the truth."
"That’s just fine, then!"
Yang Xue nodded in satisfaction and then said, "This dress is the best one in your store. Give it to me!"
"That’s not possible!"
The sales clerk shook her head: "This dress was specifically picked out for Miss Lin. I must hand over the dress to our young lady!"
Lin Yi has good taste?
Does he really have that good taste?

chapters.title: Chapter 939 - 958 Lin Yi’s Desperate Pleas
chapters.content:
Chapter 939: Chapter 958 Lin Yi’s Desperate Pleas
Upon hearing this, Yang Xue immediately laughed and said: "Miss Lin? That’s just Lin Yi. Who’s your young miss?"
"Lin Fei."
"Oh, so she is your young miss! Now I get it!" Yang Xue had an epiphany, "Since this dress is a gift from Miss Lin to you, then I definitely can’t accept it, right?"
The female sales clerk hurriedly nodded: "Yes, that’s right!"
"Well, okay then."
Yang Xue said with a smile and turned to leave.
"Hey..."
Just at that moment, Yang Xue was suddenly stopped by a hand grabbing her sleeve.
"Yang Xue, don’t go!" Lin Yi pleaded earnestly.
"What else do you want?" Yang Xue asked, puzzled.
"Didn’t you say our young miss is beautiful?"
Lin Yi said: "Then, can you accompany me to shop around? I promise I won’t take advantage of you."
Yang Xue smiled faintly: "If you don’t take advantage of me, does that mean I can take advantage of you?"
Lin Yi’s cheeks turned slightly red upon hearing this, and she bowed her head: "I... I’m your classmate, can’t you go out and have fun with me? I’ll treat you to a meal..."
"I think you’re mistaken, we’re not classmates." Yang Xue said with a light smile.
"You..." Lin Yi’s face flushed with anger, her teeth clenched, "Even if we’re not classmates, you’re still my friend, what’s wrong with me inviting you to a meal?"
"Not just me, right?" Yang Xue looked towards the female sales clerk, "That girl is not bad either, why don’t you invite her as well, I’m hungry too."
"I..."
The female sales clerk was so angry she couldn’t speak.
"Yang Xue, how could you?"
Yang Xue spoke disdainfully: "How could I? Do you still think you are my classmate?"
"I... Of course, I’m not your classmate."
"Since you’re not my classmate, stop bothering me, sell the dress to whomever you want!"
Having said that, Yang Xue turned around and walked towards the company building.
"Yang Xue, stop right there!"
Lin Yi hurried forward and grabbed Yang Xue’s arm.
"Let me go, I have to work." Yang Xue said coldly.
"You... you jerk, don’t be too arrogant!"
Lin Yi yelled angrily, ashamed and furious, and with a forceful fling, she let go of Yang Xue and ran towards the store.
"Yang Xue, just you wait!"
Yang Xue snorted coldly, ignoring her.
"I don’t believe it, I refuse to believe that you can keep wearing such a dress, just you wait and see." Lin Yi ran and said with resentment.
She knew that this dress was Lin Yi’s trophy of the day, and if she failed to fulfill Lin Yi’s request, then Lin Yi would blame everything on her.
Thinking of this, Lin Yi hurried even faster towards the company.
Lin Corporation headquarters.
Lin Yi rushed into the building, heading straight to the top floor.
The CEO’s office of Lin Corporation.
Lin Fei was sitting in front of the CEO’s desk, busy with work, while a dress picked out by Lin Yi for Lin Fei was placed in a corner of the desk.
"Smack~"
Lin Yi fiercely pushed open the office door and slammed the box in her hands onto the desk.
Seeing this, the secretary in the office was startled and quickly turned off the computer, standing up.
"Xiao Li, pack up the things I brought for Mr. Lin, and get out right now, don’t let me see you again, you hear?" Lin Yi glared at her secretary.
"Yes." The secretary hurriedly responded.
Only then did Lin Yi slowly close her eyes, staying silent. She knew she needed to calm down now.
After a little while, Lin Yi opened her eyes, then grabbed the dress from the desk and walked towards the restroom.
Seeing Lin Yi enter the restroom, the office secretary breathed a sigh of relief.
This young lady’s temper was too strange.
Lin Yi quickly stripped off her dress after entering the restroom.
This dress was extremely sexy; she had taken to it with just one glance.
However, she knew she was utterly undeserving of wearing it.
Lin Yi tossed the dress casually into the trash bin and took out a mirror from her bag to look at herself.
In the mirror was the image of a delicate and exquisite girl, fully revealed.
Her skin was pale and delicate as if it could break with a mere blow, and the smoothness of her skin was virtually indistinguishable from natural suet jade.
Such skin was a natural beauty.
Lin Yi looked at the reflection and suddenly felt as though she had become someone else.
Was this the so-called "improvement by leaps and bounds"?
A smile of satisfaction crept across Lin Yi’s lips.
She knew she had made it; her efforts had not been in vain.
Her sacrifices had finally paid off.
All of it was worth it.
Just then, someone knocked on the restroom door.
"Come in."
Authority was evident in Lin Yi’s voice.
The door was pushed open, and Lin Yi turned around, her face immediately going blank.
"You... why are you here?"
Lin Yi looked at Yang Xue with disbelief.
"What else?" Yang Xue retorted.
Lin Yi, with a gloomy expression, asked, "Are you following me?"
"I have no interest in following you; you’re just too annoying."
"You..." Lin Yi’s face turned livid with anger.
"If you’re looking for trouble, bring it on; I’m ready to take you head-on," Yang Xue said with contempt.
"Hmph!"
Lin Yi scoffed with a smirk, "Good, I want to see just how bold you are to challenge me!"
"What do you want to do?"
Yang Xue’s tone was very calm.
"Are you new here?"
"What of it?"
"Then you should know the rules of the company. Violators are to be dismissed immediately, and furthermore, they are banned from setting foot within the company premises."
"I know," Yang Xue nodded.
"Good, I will notify the finance department to prepare the termination contract. You better go to the finance department now and get the money out!" Lin Yi commanded arrogantly.
"No money."
Yang Xue smiled faintly, "I’ve already told you, I have no money."
"You... who are you trying to fool? How could a poor student like you afford all those designer clothes? You must be lying to me, right?"
Lin Yi was relentless.
"Think whatever you want!"
Yang Xue turned and walked away, no longer caring to deal with Lin Yi.
"Stop right there!" Lin Yi bellowed angrily, "Not only do you refuse to compensate for my dress, but you’re also taking advantage of me because I’m in a vulnerable group? I’ll make sure everyone in the company knows what sort of end you meet here!"
"Do whatever you want!"
Yang Xue’s steps halted.
Seeing Yang Xue stop, a smug smile appeared on Lin Yi’s face; she knew Yang Xue did not dare to offend her.
"You stay right there, don’t move!" Lin Yi ordered.
Yang Xue stood still without moving, and seeing her compliancy, Lin Yi grew even more haughty. She stepped forward and tossed the dress in her hand at Yang Xue.
The dress landed in Yang Xue’s arms, and she deftly caught it, holding it against her chest.
Lin Yi, caught by surprise, couldn’t help but gasp with her eyes wide open.

chapters.title: Chapter 940 - 959: Provoking the Entire Company!
chapters.content:
Chapter 940: Chapter 959: Provoking the Entire Company!
She never imagined that Yang Xue would dare to snatch her skirt within the company.
Such behavior is simply a provocation to the entire company!
Lin Yi’s anger burned within her. She took a quick step forward, grabbed Yang Xue’s shoulder, and threw her against the wall.
"Bang~"
A dull thud sounded as Yang Xue’s nasal bone broke, blood spurting out. Yang Xue covered her nose in pain and bent over groaning.
"You... you..." Lin Yi opened her mouth in surprise.
Just now, she was only focused on teaching Yang Xue a lesson and did not notice the forehead of Yang Xue.
The impact caused Yang Xue’s wound to burst open, and blood gushed out.
"Ah..."
Seeing Yang Xue’s blood-streaked face, Lin Yi couldn’t help but scream.
Yang Xue ignored Lin Yi and continued to cover her nose, slowly squatting down.
At this moment, Lin Yi was completely dumbfounded. She never imagined that Yang Xue would have such audacity, daring to get physical right at the company’s entrance!
"I... I’m going to kill you!"
Lin Yi suddenly screamed, rushing forward and slapped Yang Xue’s chest.
Yang Xue quickly dodged to the side, avoiding Lin Yi’s attack. Lin Yi’s palm hit empty air and struck directly against the wall, leaving five clear Hand Seals.
"You... you demon, I’m going to kill you..."
Lin Yi went crazy, swinging her fists wildly at Yang Xue.
Yang Xue didn’t resist, but let Lin Yi attack. When Lin Yi got tired, she collapsed on Yang Xue, gasping for breath. After a long while, Lin Yi stood up, her eyes filled with anger as she stared at Yang Xue, "Yang Xue, I will make sure you pay dearly. I won’t let you off!"
"I will be waiting!"
Lin Yi glared at Yang Xue, then turned and left the office.
Watching Lin Yi leave in a huff, Yang Xue sneered.
It seemed she would not let this go.
But, he was not afraid.
Yang Xue didn’t believe Lin Yi would misbehave in the company. After all, this wasn’t the Lin Corporation. No matter how arrogant Lin Yi was, she couldn’t openly challenge the authority of the company!
Yang Xue returned to her desk and began working.
At four o’clock in the afternoon, Lin Yi arrived at the company, intending to deal with Yang Xue herself.
"I’m going to fire you!"
Lin Yi stood in the financial department’s office, glaring at Yang Xue.
"You want to fire me?" Hearing Lin Yi’s words, Yang Xue couldn’t help but laugh.
"Yes! You wretch, daring to hit someone inside the company, do you really think I’m so malleable, to be molded however you want?"
Lin Yi gnashed her teeth, her expression one of wanting to devour Yang Xue.
"So what?" Yang Xue spread her hands indifferently and shrugged.
Lin Yi scoffed coldly, took out a document, and threw it in front of Yang Xue, saying, "Yang Xue, this is the record and surveillance video of your disturbance and fighting last night. These two pieces of evidence are enough to land you in jail."
As soon as Lin Yi finished speaking, Yang Xue suddenly jumped up from her chair and punched Lin Yi, the punch coming frighteningly fast.
Yang Xue was too fast, Lin Yi hadn’t anticipated that Yang Xue would strike unexpectedly.
The punch landed solidly on Lin Yi’s face, causing her left cheek to swell up immediately.
"Ah~"
Lin Yi screamed in pain and staggered back a few steps, never expecting Yang Xue would dare to hit her.
"Miss Lin, isn’t it a bit too insulting to speak like that?"
A chilling glint appeared in Yang Xue’s eyes.
"You... you dare to assault an officer!" Lin Yi covered her face, angrily staring at Yang Xue.
"Assault a police officer?"
Yang Xue shook her head, "I am a law-abiding citizen."
Lin Yi was startled, then burst into loud laughter, as if he had heard the funniest joke in the world.
"I’m telling you, you bastard, you dare to claim you’re a law-abiding citizen in front of me? You think I would believe you just because you say that? I’m going to kick you out of the company today!"
Lin Yi roared angrily.
As he roared, he charged forward, attempting to grab Yang Xue.
Yang Xue swiftly dodged, avoiding Lin Yi’s attack.
Yang Xue moved extremely quickly, Lin Yi didn’t even touch him.
"Bastard, you dare to dodge!" Lin Yi bellowed, lifting his leg and aiming a kick at Yang Xue.
"Miss Lin, I advise you not to cause unnecessary trouble."
Yang Xue frowned.
Lin Yi, relentless, swung his fists and lunged at Yang Xue again, with Yang Xue deftly dodging and countering with a Lightning Leg.
